properties.name: Camping La Ferme de Lann Hoëdic
properties.description:
Camping La Ferme de Lann Hoëdic is located in the southern end of the Rhuys peninsula, between the Atlantic Ocean and the town of Sarzeau. It is an oasis of peace and quiet, where you can get away from it all and relax with family or friends. Because of its location, the campsite offers you the charm of the Breton countryside with the sea on your doorstep. An ideal combination of beautiful nature, a calm sea and a wonderful climate.

Spacious campsite

Here you will find 128 large camping pitches on a terrain of 3.6 ha in the semi-shade or full sun. Some pitches are separated by hedges. 108 out of the 128 camping pitches measure some 120 m2 each. These are intended as touring pitches. They are located in a natural, green and quiet surrounding. You can stay here with your tent, caravan or motorhome. 

Sizeable rental accommodation units

As is the case on most French campsites, you can also rent mobile homes. They have opted for a small number only, so that they blend better into the landscape. Each lot measures some 200 m2 and is surrounded by hedges for more privacy. The mobile homes are suitable for 2-6 persons and are fully equipped with private shower/toilet and electric heating. Each mobile home has a wooden terrace with table, chairs and a sun umbrella. Camping in luxury!

Fresh bread for breakfast

At the reception a small assortment of groceries is available, as well as cold drinks and ice cream. The local baker delivers fresh bread each morning, which has to be ordered from the reception the day before.

properties.name: First Camp Ekerum - Öland
properties.description:
First Camp Ekerum Camping is a large campsite located directly on a sandy beach. The campsite lies centrally in the Swedish Island of Öland, close to Borgholm. Easily passable roads will take you to the campsite. The grounds are large and everything is spaciously laid out. The first thing you will notice is the wooden mill on the camping grounds. The reception looks neat and is very functional. There is a small campsite shop and a restaurant-café.

Camping in Öland

Large numbers of trees provide ample shade on the spacious camping pitches. The camping fields are differently laid out, each with their own character. You can opt for a standard pitch or for a pitch with some additional facilities such as electricity, water connection plus drainage and cable television. There is also a field for tent campers with a seating arrangement at each pitch. 

Red-coloured accommodation

There are several rental accommodation units available on the campsite. These are mostly in the traditional red colour many people associate with Scandinavia. There are cottages in several sizes, from a small two- person cottage to ten-bed accommodation. 

Swimming pool and beach

Ekerum Camping has a beautiful, large swimming pool with slides for children and some play equipment. This can be found near the main building. The beach can be accessed directly from the campsite. Ideal for sunbathing or walking.

On your way with a Segway

Water aerobics is a daily activity on Ekerum Camping. In addition, there is a small pedal car track for children. Other facilities in the form of a bouncer and a large playground are also available. You can also play mini golf on the campsite or rent a skelter or a Segway.

properties.name: Bravoplaya Camping-Resort
properties.description:
Bravoplaya Camping-Resort is located on the Spanish Costa del Azahar, famous for its orange blossoms. South of Peñiscola and only 3 kilometres from the small beach Oropesa del Mar. Agricultural fields are typical for this area. The peaceful village is separated from the highway by mountainous hinterland. The region is sparsely populated in comparison with other coasts in the country. Therefore, it is also a great area for beautiful biking trips. There is a beautiful wooden cycling path going along the beach. A short bus or car ride south takes you to the beautiful city of Valencia.

Bronze, silver, or gold camping

The campsite is crossed by narrow or wider streets that take you to the three different types of camping pitches. The ‘Bronze’ pitches have a surface of up to 70 m2. On a silver pitch, you have somewhat more space, approximately 70-85 m2, and a golden pitch offers more than 85 m2.

Enjoy luxurious swimming pools

Swimming fans can choose where they go swimming. There are no fewer than three swimming pools across the terrain and they all have disabled access. On the edge of the campsite there is a Caribbean outside pool with fountains, Jacuzzis, and comfortable deckchairs. In the middle of the pool there is a bar with a small terrace that can be reached via a footbridge.

A little bit farther, there is the Torsal swimming pool, which consists of two pools, one with children’s entertainment. There is one more swimming pool that can be covered with a sliding roof during the winter months.

properties.name: Camping Leï Suves
properties.description:
Camping Leï Suves is a beautiful terraced campsite in Roquebrune-sur-Argens, at only 15 km from the sandy beaches of the Côte d'Azur. You are staying here on a very child-friendly campsite with a heated swimming pool and lots of activities offered by the entertainment team. Come and enjoy a superb camping holiday on shaded pitches.

‘Grand Confort’ pitches

When you drive onto the camping grounds, you will see immediately that the grounds are perfectly maintained. The spacious camping pitches, varying in size, are well maintained and a large number of cork oaks offer ample shade. All pitches carry the ‘Grand Confort’ label. This entails that the pitch has electricity (6A), a water tap and a drainage point. You can also rent a luxuriously equipped safari tent, mobile home or caravan.

Enjoyment for children and adults

In July and August the enthusiastic entertainment team organises all kinds of activities. Children can play games and do crafts in the mornings. In the evenings they can attend the mini disco or take part in a performance in the open air theatre. Parents can join the water aerobics during the day. And how about a great bingo or dance evening? A lovely heated swimming pool with separate toddler pool, beautifully surrounded by an oak forest, will provide ample water fun. There is also a large playground with slides. Sports enthusiasts will enjoy the tennis court, the sports field or pétanque pitch.

Feeling peckish?

A camping holiday in the south of France is just not complete without tasting the regional cuisine. You can do this in the attractive campsite restaurant, where they serve good quality meals.

properties.name: Camping de la Baie
properties.description:
Cavalaire-sur-Mer is a Mediterranean coastal resort with some 5000 inhabitants. Central in this picturesque spot lies Camping de La Baie. This campsite is surrounded by deciduous and pine trees and is less than a 10 minute walk away from the beach and the glorious Mediterranean. The entire family has been considered on this campsite: a swimming pool, well organised entertainment and ample amenities (catering and sanitary facilities).

Spacious camping in the shade

Camping de la Baie is slightly sloping. It is therefore laid out in several terraces. From the top of the campsite you have a splendid view of the Bay of Cavalaire. There are some 350 pitches on the grounds, 150 of which are touring pitches and a further 190 rental accommodation units.

The camping pitches are sufficiently spacious. If you wish, you can park your car in a nearby parking area. This way you have more space to sit and move around. Many of the pitches have shade because of the hedges and trees. Therefore, you also have ample privacy.

Fun in the water

The campsite has an attractive swimming pool (250 m²) which is enjoyed by all. This is open throughout the year and is heated in the low season. Activities such as aqua gym are offered here on a regular basis. There is a toddler pool for the little ones. Also nice: the two heated jacuzzis near the swimming pool. 

Entertainment for all

The campsite is well known for its professional entertainment (also in English). This is very extensive and geared towards both young children and teenagers. Organised activities are also offered regularly, such as jeu de boules tournaments and disco evenings. Guests can also amuse themselves in the playground or at one of the many sports facilities.

properties.name: Camping Les Sablons
properties.description:
Camping Les Sablons is located on the beach of the Mediterranean and by a lagoon near the town of Portiragnes-Plage (Languedoc-Roussillon). It is a very luxury campsite with an extensive water park and a separate balneo swimming pool with spa, many facilities for sports and games and a wide-ranging entertainment programme for young and old.

Luxury galore

As soon as you check in, you will notice the atmosphere and service of this well-equipped campsite. The campsite is subdivided in 'quarters'. For instance, some of the chalets are located by the lagoon with a view of the water. Another section houses the most luxurious rental accommodation. The cottages have a decked terrace or private garden with wooden garden furniture. The camping pitches are spacious, beautifully laid out and partially demarcated.

Sandy beach

A large advantage of Les Sablons is its location next to the wide sandy beach of Portiragnes-Plage. The beach can be reached directly from the campsite via a guarded access gate. You can hire pedalos for optimal enjoyment. You can also go on an exciting trip on a banana boat, go sailing or play a game of beach volleyball.

Sports, games and showtime

The varied entertainment programme is a top attraction of this campsite. There is a mini club for the little ones, where they can do crafts, water games, build sand castles and dance. Great fun for older children is 'Club Ado', where they organise all kinds of activities for two different age groups. Some of these activities: soccer games, water slide tournaments, beach games and tree climbing routes.

There is also no need to get bored in the evenings. Enjoy the camping show, the foam party, evening swims, live music or a cabaret show.

properties.name: Recreatiepark De Leistert
properties.description:
The amusement park De Leistert, located in Roggel in Central Limburg, is fully equipped to include all comforts. In this holiday park, you can camp in areas with own sanitary facilities, but there are also various types of accommodation available for rent. Swimming pools, a bathing lake, a bowling alley, and a lot more make sure nobody gets bored in the amusement park De Leistert! And there is plenty to do in the area too, with a variety of nature parks and fun fairs.

The amusement park is easy to reach as it’s located in the triangle formed by the A2, A73, and A67. Once you reach the reception area you immediately see it is a large park. Luckily, there are friendly employees available to help you find your way with a map. At the front desk, you can find out everything about the surroundings: there are various cycling and hiking paths, and you can buy discounted tickets for the nearby fun fairs, such as Toverland and Klein Zwitserland.

From basic camping to glamping

In the amusement park De Leistert you can either go for basic camping with your own camping equipment or rent a fully equipped (glamping) accommodation. And this park has a great range on offer in this last category, from a simple chalet to a child-friendly bungalow in the style of old Limburg farms.

Your neighbours are mainly families. That’s to be expected, given the attention given to children across all facilities. To start with, there is a subtropical indoor pool, a heated wave pool, and a play pond with a beach. There is also a large outside playground with a genuine play jungle as well as an indoor playground.

properties.name: Camping La Baume/La Palmeraie
properties.description:
Campsite La Baume/La Palmeraie is situated in a natural landscape only a few km from the Mediterranean. It is a holiday park consisting of two sections which overlap: campsite La Baume and mobile home Park La Palmeraie. You camp here with luxury facilities in a sunny part of France. Ideal for families with young children and teenagers.

The campsite is located in a perfect spot to explore the beauty of the Côte d’Azur. Apart from beautiful beaches, there are attractive towns such as Fréjus and St. Raphael, at only a 10-minute drive by car. The camping pitches for motorhomes, tents and caravans, all demarcated with vegetation, are spread over the spacious and wooded terrain. Campsite La Baume has quiet pitches but also pitches where it is slightly noisier. You can park your car safely at your campsite.

Paradise for swimmers

There are five outdoor swimming pools, one of which is heated. For total relaxation there are also 2 jacuzzis, a whirlpool and a hammam in the indoor pool. Children up to age 5 have their own swimming pool. Or to put it another way: their own water paradise with colourful climbing equipment and a broad slide. If you visit in low season, the water is warm as well.

Activities all the time

If you stay at Camping La Baume, you will be assured of all kinds of fun, sporty and musical moments. The professional and multilingual entertainment team organises many activities for all ages each day. From a competition in the skate park, archery, weekly disco evening and aqua dancing lessons to games evenings and shows in the theatre cafe.

properties.name: Camping Las Dunas
properties.description:
Campsite Las Dunas lies directly alongside a wide sandy beach in the picturesque Bay of Roses on the Spanish Costa Brava, the well-known coastal region in the north-east of Catalonia. The region is characterised by charming villages and towns, small bays, fine sandy beaches and -in the interior- by several nature reserves. Your camping holiday becomes even more enjoyable as a result of the Mediterranean climate.

Spacious campsite

Las Dunas is a modern, luxuriously laid-out campsite with vegetation offering shade and privacy. The spacious and level camping pitches on grass are sufficiently large for a caravan, awning and car (100m2). They are mostly surrounded by hedges. 

The campsite also offers a wide choice of rental accommodation units, such as mobile homes and bungalows. In peak season, the campsite is mainly geared towards families with children and youngsters.

Safe swimming

The campsite has a beautiful swimming pool. Sun umbrellas offer ample shade here. The sandy beach stretching out over the whole width of the campsite is directly accessible from the campsite. Life guards are on duty near the pool and on the beach. 

Shopping

In the camping shops you will find an extensive selection of goods. You can buy bread and pastries here as well as souvenirs, camping supplies, cosmetics, games, bijouterie, newspapers, magazines and books. In the boutique you can buy clothing and for the weekly shopping you can go to the large supermarket. 

Spanish cuisine

In the restaurant you can enjoy the Spanish cuisine, prepared with regional products. In addition, on the campsite there are several stands for snacks and drinks and you can get snacks and pizzas from the takeaway restaurant.

properties.name: Camping Cala Gogo
properties.description:
Water rats are in their element on Camping Cala Gogo. With a water park of 600 m2 and a private beach access to the Mediterranean Sea, there is more than enough water to cool down, if required. Eating, sports, dancing and entertainment for children; these are the ingredients for an successful holiday in the south of France.

Campsite Cala Gogo is very close to the Spanish border. You can enjoy the Mediterranean on the beach of Saint-Cyprien-Plage, but make sure you also explore the interior and surrounding nature. The protected nature reserve Mas Larrieu is located just outside the campsite. The river Le Tech enters the country here. Ideal for a great walking and cycling trip. Argelès-sur-Mer and the renowned town of Perpignan with its ramparts are in close proximity.

Swimming pool or beach?

This is a difficult choice when you stay at campsite Cala Gogo. The swimming section measures some 600 m2 and is a lovely relaxation area for young and old. Life guards keep an eye out. Around the swimming pool you will find beach umbrellas and palm trees for the necessary shade. Open your book and you are all set for the holiday.

Or maybe you are not, because the beach is also a temptation. A pathway leads to the beach from the campsite. This sandy beach is some 6 km long, enough room for everyone to put down a towel, build sand castles and play a round of beach volley ball. A bit further along is a separate naturist beach. Dogs are allowed both on the campsite and on the beach.

properties.name: Esterel Caravaning
properties.description:
The lovely family campsite Esterel Caravaning is located on the Côte d’Azur. The swimming pools, slides, sports facilities, wellness amenities and extensive entertainment mean you will want for nothing during your camping holiday. The campsite is situated between cities such as Cannes and Saint Tropez and amidst impressive cliffs by the deep blue water. From the motorway, it is another 5 minutes’ drive through the hinterland before you reach the campsite grounds.

Camping in luxury

At this campsite, you can only camp with your caravan or motorhome. At your pitch, you have access to water, electricity and waste water disposal. There are also luxury pitches equipped with a dishwasher, fridge and washing machine. The most luxurious pitches even have a private bathroom and a hot tub. Furthermore, at Esterel Caravaning you can also rent a mobile home. At this campsite, your neighbours will mainly be families with children of all ages.

Extensive entertainment

At Esterel Caravaning you will not get bored for a minute, you can play on the tennis court or follow a fitness lesson and you can relax in the wellness area or in the film room with library. Other options are horse riding and archery. Furthermore, the campsite offers an extensive entertainment programme with spectacular evening shows, dance evenings and quiz nights.

Discover the surroundings

You can also go exploring beyond the campsite. Esterel Caravaning is located in the Esterel Mountains, which offers plenty of possibilities from cycling to hiking. Furthermore, you can get a glimpse of the surroundings on a boat trip, during an afternoon of kayaking or while windsurfing.

properties.name: Camping Bella Italia
properties.description:
In the Italian province of Verona, you'll find the Bella Italia campsite, just outside the popular village of Peschiera del Garda. It's a 10 minute walk to the atmospheric centre along a lively shopping promenade. The southern part of Lake Garda is a lively place that's great fun for children, as there are lots of theme parks. But in the hinterland, there's also much to discover on a more cultural level, such as the towns of Bréscia and Verona and numerous traditional Italian villages.

Glamping or camping in the greenery

The spacious camping grounds slope slightly and there are camping pitches as well as lots of luxurious rental cottages. Well-equipped lodges lie next to each other on prettily landscaped streets. For campers with their own camping equipment there are also camping fields with a view of the deep blue water, mountains, and picturesque hills. It's a quick walk to a shower or a toilet. There are six comfortable and clean washing blocks, which are well maintained.

Swimming Paradise

What really makes Bella Italia campsite stand out, is the luxuriously landscaped swimming paradise. With five swimming pools, there's plenty of choice for campers of all ages. The fun pool slides and the water playground were obviously designed with care. This is one of the most popular spots at the campsite, and of course it is well-supervised by a lifeguard.

Italian day trips

Whoever visits this part of Italy will become curious about the surrounding area. Close to the campsite, you'll find the historic town of Sirmione, which is an absolute must to visit. Right at the end of a small peninsula, you don't just have a fantastic view, but you're also right in the midst of the ruins of a Roman villa at the Grottoes of Catullus.

properties.name: Camping Beauséjour
properties.description:
The child-friendly and authentic Camping Beauséjour is situated along a beautiful, broad and sandy supervised beach right on the Mediterranean Sea. In addition to this 'superpool', the campsite features a luxurious child-friendly swimming pool as well as spa facilities and an imaginative playground. This campsite is paradise for families with small children.

Mediterranean plants

The campsite grounds look lovely with Mediterranean plants and beautiful locations. Most of the pitches are located close to the sea and are spacious enough, most of them have plenty of shade and are usually marked by hedges. The campsite grounds look well-tended and are well-maintained. There are more than enough mobile homes available for rent.

Directly by the sea

The luxurious swimming pool has rounded forms, islets with plants, a water slide, a bridge and plenty of poolside loungers and greenery. The bottom of the swimming pool slopes gently down, making it safer and accessible for small children and older guests. Would you rather relax at the seaside? There are various wooden walkways leading from the campsite to the supervised beach, where you will find canoes, SUP boards and pedal boats which are free to use.

Family campsite for young and old

The campsite includes a sports and playing field, a boules court and a cross-country cycling area in the dunes for the little ones. The playground looks remarkable, almost like a fantastic village with houses on stilts, jungle gyms, and slides. There is entertainment for both the children and adults in the summer months.

Customer-friendly prices

There is a small supermarket with a wide range of products. The restaurant has an extensive menu with customer-friendly prices. Next to the pool is also a terrace with a spacious patio where the evening entertainment takes place.

properties.name: Camping Playa Tropicana
properties.description:
Camping Playa Tropicana is a medium-sized campsite directly next to the sandy beach south of Alcossebre. An indoor swimming pool with a jacuzzi, an outdoor pool surrounded by palm trees and the sea offer plenty of water fun during your stay on this Spanish campsite with an exotic atmosphere.

Camping in tropical style

To reach the campsite you will drive past almond, orange and olive trees, after which you will follow the coastal road leading to the campsite. Camping Playa Tropicana lives up to its name because you will be camping in between palm trees and Roman statues, completely in tropical style. You will find this tropical theme throughout the entire campsite.

Indoor and outdoor swimming

The site is also suitable for camping outside the peak season. The indoor pool ensures that it is never too cold to do a couple of laps. If the temperature allows it, you can also make use of the outdoor pool with water slides and a separate area for the children. The swimming pool is surrounded by palm trees so that you can swim in a tropical atmosphere.

To reach the sea, you only have to cross the promenade and you'll be standing with your feet in the sand. The beach is clean and the water becomes gradually deeper, making this ideal for children and very suitable for various water sports.

Paella and sea views

On the terrace of the restaurant, you will dine under palm trees with a view of the sea. Here you can enjoy Valencian dishes or seafood and paella. Camping Playa Tropicana also features a large supermarket with a wide range of products.

properties.name: Camping Piani di Clodia
properties.description:
In the north of Italy you will find Camping Piani di Clodia: a relaxing family campsite. You can camp here in style and enjoy Lake Garda, the many swimming pools and all sports facilities. Daily groceries and sumptuous meals are available on the campsite. This holiday park on Lake Garda is centrally located, fairly close to cities as Verona, Milan and Venice. Furthermore, the campsite is easy to reach; it is only a 10-minute drive off the freeway.

Fun in the water

Slides, waterfalls, bubble baths. Seven swimming pools! Water fun galore at Camping Piani di Clodia. In addition, there is the beach on Lake Garda for swimming and sunbathing.

On the move

Camping Piani di Clodia offers many possibilities to enjoy yourself during your holiday. You can choose between a game of tennis, soccer, (beach) volleyball or basket ball, but you can also beat your neighbours at a game of table tennis. Fitness lessons are also offered to sports fans, so that you stay fit during the holidays.

The entertainment team organises activities for young and old, both during the day and at night. Children will enjoy themselves with sports and craft activities or take the spotlight during one of the evening performances.

Hospitality for dogs

Dogs are very welcome on Camping Piani di Clodia. There is a special dog shower, a dog track and there are special pitches reserved for campers with a dog. This way you don't have to miss your faithful four-legged friend during your camping holiday!

properties.name: Camping Zum stillen Winkel
properties.description:
In beautiful natural surroundings in the Wiedtal, you'll find the Zum stillen Winkel campsite. Here you can really relax, surrounded by the countryside of the German Rhineland-Palatinate. You can camp on ample pitches close to the river Wied. Children can play in and around the river, and in the pretty forest which borders the campsite all holiday long. If you want a little more buzz, you can visit Coblenz or Cologne, both of which are nearby.

A friendly Dutch family manages the Zum stillen Winkel campsite, and makes sure that everyone can enjoy their holiday in peace and quiet. They are happy to help you find out about various daytrips. From the campsite, you can walk into the forest, and there are lovely hiking and cycling paths. The pitches are on well-maintained lawn in amongst the trees, which will make you feel like you are camping in a park. Many of the pitches have electricity, water, and a TV connection. It's also possible to rent one of the holiday homes.

Food delivered directly to your table

There's a mini supermarket at the campsite, and you can buy fresh bread rolls every day. There are no restaurants, but the owners have a great arrangement with one of the local restaurants. You can order food from them, and they will deliver it directly to your pitch.

The camping feeling

The Dutch owners make every effort to create the ultimate 'camping in the countryside' feeling, and they sometimes organise a spontaneous evening around the campfire. If that's not real camping, we don't know what is!

properties.name: Camping De la Sûre Reisdorf
properties.description:
The De la Sûre campsite is located in the heart of the Mullerthal, on the banks of the Sûre. The spacious campsite extends along the river. Enjoy views of the surrounding hills. With no entertainment programme, the campsite is peaceful and quiet but young and old will find lots to do. In the area: hike the Mullerthal Trail and admire the special rock formations and waterfalls.

Camping by the river

The De la Sûre campsite extends along the banks of the river. The campsite has an open feel. Narrow side streets lead you to separate grassy areas, where the spacious pitches have been laid out. They are not marked out, so you have relatively little privacy. But this does create a sense of spaciousness. The most beautiful (and therefore most expensive) pitches are located directly on the high banks of the Sûre. A few new mobile homes and safari tents complete the offering.

Quiet fun

The campsite has no entertainment programme, so it is peaceful and quiet all day long. So you enjoy your own company. Children can play in the playground or at the foosball table, while the older generation is probably more likely to play jeu de boules. Fishing enthusiasts are sure to find a nice spot on the Sûre.

Quality restaurant

The campsite offers a high-quality restaurant. The chef prepares traditional French and Luxembourg cuisine and local specialties. There is a special child's menu for the kids. Enjoy a three-course dinner or have a cup of coffee or refreshing drink. If you fancy a quick bite, you can get some chips.

properties.name: Aminess Style Camping Avalona Resort
properties.description:
If you like enjoying the quiet beach life and prefer a luxury campsite, then Aminess Avalona Camping Resort near Povljana on the island of Pag (Croatia) is for you. Pag is known for its rocky lunar landscapes and there are many bays with hidden beaches. This campsite is on a small peninsula and is largely surrounded by water. You can enjoy the most beautiful sunsets from your spacious pitch or fully equipped holiday home.

Luxury pitches with private swimming pool!

Aminess Avalona Camping Resort has various options for glamping in the purest sense of the word. There are many luxury accommodation for rent. Some of the holiday homes even have a private swimming pool! Most of the pitches are at the front of the site, some even have a private outdoor swimming pool.

Jump in the swimming pool or in the Adriatic Sea

Even if you stay on a pitch or in a holiday home without a private swimming pool, you can enjoy swimming at the campsite. There is a swimming pool that is open to all campers. And the sea is always close by. Around the complex, there are several beaches from where you can go into the deep-blue water of the Adriatic Sea.

Children's entertainment

Under the enthusiastic lead of the mascot Miramì (a joyful octopus), young children can take part in creative workshops, role play, fun picnics, sporting activities and exciting trips to explore nature. Sports tournaments and disco evenings are regularly organised for teenagers.

properties.name: TAIGA Costa Cálida
properties.description:
Calling all sun, sea and beach lovers! This campsite with its own beach is located on the Costa Cálida, in one of the sunniest parts of southern Spain. At Taïga Costa Cálida, you camp alongside a pristine bay, surrounded by steep mountainsides; enjoy lots of mountain sports opportunities. The campsite is a 20-minute drive from historic city of Cartagena and close to the village of Portús.

How is the campsite laid out?

The campsite has a good mix of tourist pitches, permanent annual pitches and accommodation, such as luxury bungalows, safari tents and apartments. There are great views of the bay from the accommodation, which is located in the higher part of the campsite. If you choose a camping pitch, you are closer to the beach and swimming pool. There are camping pitches of different sizes, with or without shade. Some pitches have a private sanitary unit. It contains a kitchenette and a bathroom with a toilet and walk-in shower.

Beautiful outdoor pool and fun activities

The beautiful swimming pool is next to the beach. This outdoor pool with separate paddling area is set in a grassy meadow, where you can relax under the shade of trees. Aqua fitness classes are often organised in the pool too. Or join a yoga session, or play a game of badminton, archery, table tennis, volleyball or basketball, etc. Creative workshop are regularly organised too; fun for young and old!

Relax at La Morena

La Morena is Taïga Costa Cálida's private sandy beach. There are a few more hidden beaches a little further on. The mountainous surroundings are great for hiking, mountain biking, rock climbing

properties.name: Bonterra Resort - Camping & Bungalows
properties.description:
This campsite is centrally located in the cosy seaside resort of Benicasim, on the Spanish Costa del Azahar (Valencia region). This is a great base for beach lovers, as the campsite is located just 300 metres from Benicasim's sprawling sandy beaches. Bonterra Resort - Camping & Bungalows is also located right along a Vía Verde (walking and cycling path) and close to a large, mountainous nature reserve. This internationally-oriented campsite features two swimming pools and a nice restaurant. Many fun activities are also organised for guests. These activities are coordinated year round, as the Bonterra Resort is also a popular destination for winter campers.

Neatly maintained pitches

Bonterra Resort is a beautifully landscaped campsite featuring a smart design. The tourist camping pitches and modern holiday homes are all located on short cul-de-sacs. So no matter where you stay on the site, there'll never be much car traffic passing by. Most touring pitches are separated by neatly maintained hedges. The trees on this campsite are also pruned considerably in the autumn. Those staying during the winter therefore benefit from the extra light and warmth from the sun.

Enjoy a swim in the sea or in the pool

This campsite's location is absolutely ideal for beach lovers. You can walk straight from your camping pitch onto Benicasim's sandy beaches. Of course, you can also enjoy a nice swim in the campsite's swimming pools. There's a large outdoor swimming pool with a separate paddling pool. There's also a swimming pool with a retractable roof that is heated during the winter.

properties.name: Terrassencamping Maltatal
properties.description:
Located in the 'valley of the falling water', Maltatal campsite enjoys a unique location. The area owes its nickname to the many impressive waterfalls. Surrounded by the beauty of this southern area of Austria, camping here is a breath-taking experience of tranquillity, space, greenery and clean mountain air. And this cosy, atmospheric family campsite has all four in abundance!

The natural environment in which you will be camping is perfect for a relaxed camping holiday with children. The children's farm is a great place for children to play and have fun with the goats and rabbits. The whole family can take a morning ride through the area on a train pulled by a tractor. The campsite is home to a swimming pool, which is encircled by a large sunbathing lawn. The pool belongs to the municipality and you can purchase a one-off ticket or multiple tickets so that you can take a refreshing dip whenever you feel like it.

An unusual acquaintance with Carinthia

The great thing about Maltatal terraced campsite is that there's so much to discover and enjoy, both on the campsite and nearby, that you will only find in this corner of Austria. It's an area largely untouched by mass tourism, and is a great place in which to spend a mountain holiday. The best way to discover everything that the area has to offer without having to spend too much money is to purchase a Carinthia card from the reception. The Carinthia card offers many benefits, including a substantial discount on family boat trips on Lake Millstatt or free entry to Rosegg Zoo.

properties.name: Camping Domaine de la Bergerie
properties.description:
The campsite is located near the medieval village of Roquebrune-sur-Argens and in an oak forest. The 60 hectare property is green, quiet and when you inhale, you smell the aromas of the Provence.

Grand confort, Premium or an accommodation

The pitches on campsite Domaine de la Bergerie are shady and in the midst of greenery. The sites are separated with hedges and have electricity. They provide access to one of the four sanitation blocks, one of which is heated.

There are also various mobile homes and cottages for rent. These are set up on terraces against the hillsides in the shade and there is plenty of space to park your car at the accommodation.

1400m2 swimming pool complex

At campsite Domain de la Bergerie you'll find a large water park of at least 1400m2 with slides, waterfalls and play equipment in an exotic environment.

Entertainment for children from 18 months to 18 years of age

From the Easter holidays, with the exception of Saturdays, there are various activities organized every day for children from 18 months to 18 years, from paint balling to music workshops. You can also use the mini golf course, various play equipment and the mini ranch with ponies which you can feed or take a ride on.

Dining in a sheep barn

The restaurant on campsite Domaine de la Bergerie is very special. The restaurant is found in a traditional, centuries old sheep barn. In low season you can dine by the open fire and enjoy a wonderful meal, and in the summer you can enjoy a glass of rosé from the region in the shade of hundred year old bramble bushes.

properties.name: Camping Wulfener Hals
properties.description:
The Wulfener Hals campsite, on the sunny island of Fehmarn, is an ideal spot for sports and water lovers. The campsite is on the beach, but there are also woods and meadows nearby. You can choose a spacious pitch next to the sea, from where you can see the surfers practising on the waves, or you can book a holiday home for that little bit of extra comfort. Taste the delicious food in one of the restaurants, enjoy a round of golf, or take a boat trip to Denmark.

Relax and enjoy yourself in comfort

The Wulfener Hals campsite is large and has plenty of amenities. There are nice comfortable pitches next to the sea, where you have all the space in the world for your caravan, motorhome or tent. People who prefer a little more luxury and comfort can stay in one of the bungalows, chalets or mobile homes.

Water and sports lovers

You'll find many sporty families at this campsite. There are many advantages to that! The children can have fun doing sports competitions with their camping neighbours, while you can enjoy reading a book or taking part in one of the sports activities at the campsite. In just a few steps from your pitch, you can be next to the pool, the sea or the inland sea. So, there are enough options for a swim. Surfing and kitesurfing, sailing, boating or a fun game of beach volleyball are also among the choices you have.

Sunny island

Fehmarn proves that a beach holiday in Germany really is a possibility. Without about 2200 hours of sunshine a year, it's one of the sunniest places in Germany.

properties.name: Camping Gritt
properties.description:
Camping Gritt, located close to the village of Ingeldorf on the Sûre in Luxemburg, offers a perfect mix of countryside and culture. Surrounded by hilly landscapes, it is the ideal spot for walking and cycling trips. The campsite is close to the cities of Ettelbruck and Diekirch and at driving distance from Luxembourg City, making it an excellent starting point for exploring the region.

Authentic camping experience

Camping Gritt's site offers an authentic camping experience with spacious grassy pitches in natural green surroundings. The tourist and seasonal pitches are wonderful laid out. Some pitches offer beautiful views of the river. You have free wifi all over.

Well-maintained toilet and washing facilities

There are two well-maintained renovated toilet blocks with modern facilities, including adapted facilities for the disabled and facilities for babies and children.

Enjoy a tasty meal

The campsite restaurant has a range of delicious meals for reasonable prices, with a focus on meat dishes and salads. There is a bar for drinks and ice creams. There are various shops in the area for home cooks.

Water fun in the Sûre

From the campsite, you can easily get to the banks of the Sûre via an excavated path. Depending on the water level, you can either go paddling or swimming. The Sûre is a wonderful place for water sports activities, such as fishing and canoeing.

Explore the region

The campsite is a lovely starting point for exploring the region. The Müllerthal, also known as the Little Switzerland of Luxembourg, is a highpoint for walkers. Furthermore, the proximity of Diekirch, Ettelbruck and Luxembourg City (reachable by free train transport from Ettelbruck) offers plenty of options for cultural outings.

properties.name: Campsite Polari
properties.description:
On the Croatian peninsula of Istria, on a beautiful bay south of Rovinj, you will find camping Polari. This large family campsite has a lot to offer with its number of camping pitches, rental accommodation and facilities. It is located directly on the Adriatic Sea and has a pebble beach and all kinds of water sports facilities.

Large campsite by the sea

The Polari campsite extends over a generous sixty hectares. It is a largely open terrain, with many avenues and mostly spacious pitches. Some parts are a bit newer, with a tighter layout, other parts consist of fields without clear delimitations. There are no less than 1.500 pitches.

Apart from the many touring pitches, the campsite also has over hundred permanent and six hundred rental accommodations. There are almost four hundred mobile homes for rent, but also caravans, tents or luxury lodge tents.

Large water playground

There is a beautiful outdoor swimming pool at the campsite. It is beautifully landscaped, with a separate shallow area for the little ones. A spacious sundeck with sun loungers and parasols all round. For children there is also a large water playground with various little pools, water jets and play equipment.

Restaurants and bars

There are various catering establishments at Polari campsite, so you don't have to leave the campsite for an evening out. At various locations you'll find a grill restaurant, a seafood restaurant and a pizzeria, but also a snack ba, coffee bars and cafes. By the pool is a beautiful, modern bar with views over the bay.

properties.name: Camping Europa Silvella
properties.description:
Camping Europa Silvella lies directly on Lake Garda and in close proximity to the villages of Manerba del Garda and San Felice del Benaco. In peak season this campsite is frequented by a large number of families with children and there is an extensive entertainment programme. A large number of sports and games activities are also organised. In low season there is less entertainment.

Directly into the lake from your camping spot

There are several types of camping pitches on the campsite. The lower-lying pitches are located at the water's edge. The higher-lying pitches and the rental accommodation units have a panoramic view of Lake Garda. The pitches all look beautifully maintained. They are spacious and are separated by bushes and hedges. The ratio between touring pitches and rental accommodation is well-balanced. The rental accommodations consist of various mobile homes, chalets and luxury tents. 

Water fun in swimming pool or Lake Garda

There are three swimming pools on Camping Europa Silvella. These have playful, rounded designs. Around the pools, you will find loungers and sun umbrellas. Of course, the lake itself also offers ample recreational opportunities, such as surfing, sailing and waterskiing. There are several sports fields for the sports enthusiasts on the campsite. There is also a playground for children. 

The entertainment team organises a variety of activities, such as excursions, sports training, games and walks. Children can join the mini club and shows are organised for the evenings.

Eating pizza whilst enjoying the view

The campsite restaurant has a large terrace with a view of the Gulf of Manerba del Garda. In addition to pizzas, you can also order other delicious dishes. The pool bar with snack bar is located adjacent to the swimming pool. Here you can enjoy breakfast, a refreshing drink, an ice cream or a Mediterranean snack.

properties.name: Campsite Valkanela
properties.description:
Camping Valkanela is a large and versatile campsite on the Adriatic coast, a few kilometres north of the town of Vrsar. At this bustling campsite you will find everything you need for a complete and carefree camping holiday: several restaurants and bars, swimming pools and plenty of entertainment for young and old.

Pitches by the sea

On the campsite you have plenty of choice of pitches. For example, there are more than 1,200 touring pitches on the site. The closer to the sea, the more expensive the pitches, but also the more luxurious they are. If you want a standard pitch, you are in the beautiful forest, a little further from the water. The choice is also wide in mobile homes. Some of the rental accommodations even have small (shared) swimming pools on their doorstep.

For the whole family

Close to the beach is the large swimming pool. The whole family can go here, as there are several pools. Cool down in a deeper pool, a separate pool for the slightly older children and a spacious paddling pool. Around the pools you can sunbathe or lie in the shade on the lawn. The swimming pools are more often the centre of the entertainment team, which in the summer months provides a full entertainment programme for campers of all ages.

Adriatic Sea

The campsite has built its pitches around a beautiful bay of the Adriatic Sea. Because of this, campers have access to a long (secured) pebble beach with sunbeds, from where they can take a dip in the water. There are small pontoons at the campsite where you can moor your boat, and nearby the water sports possibilities are endless.

properties.name: Camping Yelloh! Village Le Sérignan Plage
properties.description:
Le Sérignan Plage Campsite in Sérignan (Languedoc-Roussillon) is a campsite where water enthusiasts can indulge themselves. From the swimming paradise on the grounds in Mediterranean style to the Mediterranean within walking distance; water fun guaranteed for young and old! Le Sérignan Plage is situated some 20 km from the enchanting wine city of Béziers and at 500 m from the beautiful beaches of the Mediterranean.

In Mediterranean ambiance

The luxurious, large campsite exudes the charm of the Mediterranean region. The cypresses, firs, olive trees and eucalyptus trees are splendid in colour and scent. The swimming paradise (complete with columns in the style of a Roman bathhouse) is also unique. In peak season, employees can assist the guests in several languages.

Water paradise

The gigantic swimming paradise makes Le Sérignan Plage Campsite truly unique. Situated in the centre of the camping terrain and not to be missed. Surrounded by a sunbathing lawn for relaxation, is a gigantic swimming pool (850m2) in organic shape. In addition, there are two slides, a heated indoor pool and a toddler pool. At this toddler pool there is a variety of playground equipment for the little ones to enjoy themselves.

Entertainment for all

No shortage of entertainment at Le Sérignan Plage. There is a playground for children as well as an entertainment programme (2x weekly in peak season). The little ones can amuse themselves in the mini club (at least 4x weekly in peak season). Also offered in several languages. The trampoline and bouncer are also popular.

properties.name: Camping De Schatberg
properties.description:
Camping De Schatberg lies in a beautiful part of North Limburg, not far from De Groote Peel. This water rich area is known for its peat soil (peat extraction). You will be welcomed in a spacious reception, from where you can walk to the large Plaza. Here you will find a restaurant, a supermarket and an indoor swimming pool.

Level terrain with camping pitches and bungalows

The terrain is level with three lakes and a large number of trees spread over the campsite. There are separate sections with bungalows. The camping pitches are spacious, organised and are located on fields along lanes. The pitches vary in size and offer privacy to a greater or lesser extent. Each camping field has (partly) heated sanitary buildings. 

Indoor and outdoor swimming

There is an outdoor swimming pool on the campsite. This natural lake has a sandy beach, slide, water playground and sunbathing lawn. A bit further along on the campsite you will find a lake suitable for fishing and cable waterskiing (Seven Twenty Cablepark). Other fun activities on the lake: boating. Inclement weather? Then enjoy the indoor swimming pool!

Entertainment is organised for various age groups (0-10 years olds, 10-18 years olds and 18+). Therefore, no need for any guest to be bored. At the Schatberg you also have a wide choice of sportive activities: paintballing, waterskiing, climbing, fishing and billiards.

properties.name: Camp du Domaine
properties.description:
In the south of France, directly on the Mediterranean Sea, lies Camp du Domaine. On the way to the campsite you start to feel the Mediterranean climate. The campsite is surrounded by vineyards. The attractive village of Le Lavandou is nearby. There is a weekly market on Thursdays. From this village the boat leaves for Ile de Levant, one of the ‘Golden Islands’. Bormes-les-Mimosas, a bit further along, is renowned for its abundance of flowers.

Relaxing under your own thatched roof

The campsite is built against a hill. The pitches have lots of vegetation, so it looks like you are camping amidst nature. Near the beach you will find pitches that often have their own access to the beach. The advantage of these pitches is that they have a straw roof, so you will always have some shade at your pitch. The other camping pitches are also surrounded by much greenery. Therefore, whichever pitch you choose, you will always be guaranteed some shade nearby.

Private beach

With the sea at your feet and 750 m of private beach, there is no reason why you should not visit Camp du Domaine. Floating on an airbed in the sea, building sand castles or simply soaking up the sun; you can do it all on this glorious beach. Because the campsite is located in a small bay, the waves are quite moderate. This makes it also possible for children to swim in the sea.

properties.name: Camping Helios
properties.description:
Camping Helios, with its beautiful swimming pools, is located close the sea in the Languedoc. The campsite is quiet and has wellness facilities to provide campers with some extra relaxation during their holidays. There is a good quality restaurant with regional dishes and entertainment is offered in the evenings during the high season.

The campsite is located between the Mediterranean, the Libron river and the seaside resort town of Vias. An ideal spot for nice trips in the area. For instance, the towns of Béziers, Roquebrun and Sète are only a short distance away from the campsite, as well as the regional nature park of the Haut-Languedoc and the cave of Devèze.

This amiable family camping has spacious camping pitches which are demarcated with green vegetation. The pitches are well shaded and all have electricity. Each street of the campsite has a water tap connection and there are two excellent ablution buildings. The ratio between touring pitches and annual pitches on the campsite is more or less equal. Because of the ideal location of the campsite, many French people also enjoy spending their holidays at Helios.

Lots of water fun on and near the campsite

The Libron River lies across the street on which the campsite is located. You are allowed to fish here without a permit. The river also has a spot where you can launch boats and proceed to sail in the direction of the sea. The beach is only 200 m away. The sandy beach is an ideal spot to relax with the Mediterranean for swimming.

properties.name: Campingpark Freibad Echternacherbrück AöR
properties.description:
Freibad Echternacherbrück campsite is just a bridge away from the Luxembourg town of Echternach. The two biggest plus points of this campsite are definitely the beautiful, spacious outdoor swimming pool, and the Sauer river that the campsite lies on. Canoeing, cycling, taking part in a sports competition, or just enjoying nature; it's all possible at this campsite in the Southern Eifel.

Camping at the water's edge

Freibad Echternacherbrück campsite is divided into several open grassy areas. You can set up your caravan on a pitch by the water, under the trees, or in the sun. The pitches run parallel to the river. All the amenities are located centrally at the campsite. There are separate camping areas for youth groups and clubs, with their own beach volleyball court and their own barbecues.

A refreshing dip

In the middle of the campsite there is also a spacious outdoor swimming pool. Little ones can enjoy the special wading pool. You'll find the waterslide in the middle pool. At the reception, you can get a wristband for access to the swimming pool. For this, you will pay a deposit of € 10. In the summer, the swimming pool is also perfect for an evening of disco-swim, a game of water polo, or a diving course. Of course, you can also swim in the Sauer river.

A paradise for nature and culture lovers

With the historic towns of Trier and Luxembourg nearby there's no shortage of culture either. In Echternach there is even an ancient Benedictine abbey. Prefer to head for nature? Venture out by bike or on foot and discover the green Müllertal and the famous southern Eifel.

properties.name: Prümtal-Camping Oberweis
properties.description:
Prümtal-Camping Oberweis is a climate-friendly family campsite on the River Prüm in the green countryside of Eifel. The campsite has won various prizes and has an excellent entertainment team, good restaurant and a wonderful heated outdoor swimming pool with a slide. From the campsite, you can easily explore the various hiking and cycling routes with the campsite's app. For families, the Eifelpark and Dinopark are nearby. Tickets can be bought with a discount at the campsite. The various prizes this campsite has won are testimony to the fact you are staying at a first-class campsite here. The owner ensures you feel welcome and is very friendly and enthusiastic. The campsite has the ‘Klimafreundlich Betrieb' (climate-friendly operations) label and is committed to protecting the environment.

Heated outdoor swimming pool

If your holiday is not complete without a dip in the water, then the River Prüm flows past the campsite and is the perfect place for an afternoon of fun in the water. The campsite also has a heated outdoor pool with a playful water fountain and a wide water slide. The children’s pool, which is separated from the deep pool, is a safe place for the little ones to play.

Themed weeks

The entertainment team offers a varied programme based on themed weeks, such as a ‘caboodle of chaos’ week and a ‘thieves’ week. Activities are organised every morning (except on Saturdays), afternoon and evening. On Wednesdays, the campsite goes all out with even more games, snacks and drinks and great crafting activities.

First-class restaurant

The lovely restaurant Köhler-Stuben is situated next to the campsite swimming pool. Enjoy a good meal on the patio or in cold weather, in the conservatory with a wonderful view of Prüm Valley. The campsite also has its own pizzeria: Papa Razzo. Here you can eat in or take away a delicious pizza or pasta dish.

properties.name: Camping Au Port-Punay
properties.description:
If you love fresh mussels and oysters, you've come to the right place at Camping Au Port-Punay. And you'll easily find the necessary relaxation on the beach (only 300 metres away), in the charming villages on the Atlantic coast and the large campsite swimming pool with comfortable loungers. The campsite is located between the city of La Rochelle and near the charming fishing village of Les Boucheleurs. The village is known for its oysters and mussels. This is reflected on the menus of most of the restaurants in this area.

Up in the air

Camping Au Port-Punay has put up inventive lodge tents on the campsite. These tents are on stilts of 1.20 metres high, and you access them via stairs. Inside you'll find all you need for a relaxed, comfortable holiday.

Camping Au Port-Punay naturally also welcomes campers who bring their own equipment.

Plenty of cooling down

Because the beach is only 300 metres away, you can easily reach the beach for a refreshing dip, to build a sand castle or play a great round of beach volleyball. The water on the Atlantic coast can be a bit cold, especially at the beginning and end of the summer. The campsite swimming pool can remedy that. There is a separate section for the little campers and plenty of space around the pool to enjoy the warm summer sun.

properties.name: Camping Mas Nou
properties.description:
The Catalan campsite Mas Nou is located on the Costa Brava near Figueres, the town from which the artist Salvador Dalí hails. You camp here on neatly maintained grounds with a view of the mountains and within easy reach of the sea. Get ready to spend several days by the Mediterranean Sea, as the Empuriabrava beach is only some four km from the campsite.

Camping pitches with shade

A few wide, paved roads lead to the pitches. There are quite a number of them: some 450 touring pitches are allocated to campers who come to the Catalan coast with tent, caravan or motorhome. Carefully planted trees provide each pitch with shade. This also applies to the colourful bungalows, located at the back of the campsite.

Mediterranean paradise

Across the road is the outdoor swimming pool of the campsite. This spacious pool is surrounded by tall palm trees and oleanders. A day at the beach is a distinct possibility. The road to the beach, some four km long, leads you through Empuriabrava. The town has numerous canals. Very beautiful!

Sports and entertainment

For those campers looking to work up a sweat under the Spanish sun, there are several sports fields on the camping grounds. A game of tennis, basketball, soccer or pétanque are among the possibilities. There is a lovely entertainment programme for young and old: from a disco for children to swimming pool games and theatre shows.

Fresh bread

Doing your grocery shopping near campsite Mas Nou is a breeze. Just around the corner you will find a large supermarket. Fresh bread is available from the campsite itself.

properties.name: Club del Sole Le Palme Lazise Family Collection
properties.description:
Camping Le Palme is an extremely well maintained campsite with many amenities, situated on the south-eastern bank of Lake Garda (between the towns of Peschiera del Garda and Lazise). The terraced campsite is situated directly on the lake, a ten minute drive from the beautiful and lively fortress town of Peschiera.

Green and well maintained

The first thing one notices is that Le Palme is a green and extremely neatly laid out campsite: the palms to which it owes its name also feature prominently, of course. The welcome at this cheerful looking reception is friendly. You drive to your pitch over well-paved, wide pathways. The pitches are spacious and the lowest terraces offer a view of Lake Garda. Large numbers of trees offer ample shade. The rental accommodation (mobile homes, bungalows and one apartment) also look very attractive.

Lots of amenities

There are two swimming pools on the campsite, of which one with slides and hydro massage. Furthermore, Le Palme has a small fitness room and in high season there is an entertainment team to keep the children occupied. You can also go to the lake for entertainment. From the top terraces it is only a five minute walk. A gate -for which camping guests are given an access pass- gives access to the pebble beach.

Adjacent to the reception is a bar, often with live music in the weekends. The restaurant, with its comprehensive menu and friendly service, offers a beautiful view of the lake.

Sanitary facilities

The ablution blocks look very neat and clean. You can also book private sanitary facilities.

properties.name: Fornella Camping & Wellness Family Resort
properties.description:
The family campsite Fornella Camping & Wellness Family Resort is located on the quiet west side of Lake Garda. Here you camp in a colourful environment that looks like it could have come from a painting. It is set against a slight incline, by a beach with immaculate water and close to historic treasures. There are numerous activities during the days and evenings, but there is also time for quieter moments. In the afternoon, as the Italian tradition dictates, there is a siesta. At this countryside campsite with its many varied plants, the camping pitches are alternated with wonderful, fully-equipped mobile homes available for rent. As a guest with your own camping equipment you have a wide choice of sheltered pitches.

Four places to go swimming

The campsite has no fewer than three swimming pools (one of which is heated) including a separate children’s pool that is 50 cm deep. Besides the wonderful swimming pools, the two private beaches by the lake make this campsite extra special. There you can enjoy the water all day long; there is namely a ‘morning’ and an ‘evening’ beach. In the high season, there is a “mini club” for the little ones. Games are played there all-day long. The older campers have not been forgotten either, there are live music evenings and sport tournaments.

Family island

You can see it from the campsite: the impressive villa on Isola del Garda. A short crossing with the boat takes you to this fascinating island. A nice detail: the campsite owners also own this little paradise that was closed to visitors for a long time. Now you can admire this piece of history close up.

properties.name: San Benedetto Camping Relais
properties.description:
San Benedetto Camping Relais is a family campsite in Peschiera Del Garda, right on Lake Garda. You can camp here on one of the shaded camping pitches, or in a mobile home. Perhaps even with a view of the lake. At this campsite, you'll find plenty of amenities for families, such as a lovely swimming pool, entertainment and various sports activities.

Close to everything

The campsite is also located near to various theme parks, such as Gardaland and Canevaworld, but also the Viva Nature Park zoo, and the beautiful gardens of Sigurtà Park are easily accessible from the campsite. You can visit the charming villages around the lake, or take the cable car to the top of Monte Baldo. If you want to travel a little further, you can use the free shuttle service from the campsite to the Peschiera del Garda train station. San Benedetto Camping Relais is primarily designed for families with children. To make your stay as comfortable as possible, you can rent buggies, cots, and baby monitors at the campsite. You can also use their high chairs and baby baths. You will find two toilet blocks at the campsite. These are very clean and cheerily decorated with coloured mosaic stones.

Relax on Lake Garda

This campsite is situated next to a pebble beach on Lake Garda. So, bring your water shoes. The lake is ideally suited for a whole day of water sports. There are also two swimming pools at the campsite, where a lifeguard keeps an eye on things. There are parasols and sun loungers at the swimming pool. And if you want to cool down, just order a drink from the pool bar.

properties.name: Kikopark Playa
properties.description:
On a peaceful street in a quiet Spanish village between Valencia and Alicante you will find Kikopark Playa, close to the local marina on a beautiful beach. The neighbouring village of Oliva is just to the north of Dénia and Javea, well-known resorts on the Costa Blanca. This region has long been a popular one, especially in the winter months, thanks to the favourable Mediterranean climate.

A choice of camping pitches

The reception divides the campsite into two. The 170 separated camping pitches lie on either side of the reception, all with a gravel base. The smaller pitches are to the left, the larger pitches are to the right. A dedicated area at the front of the campsite is reserved for motor homes. Some pitches even have a canvas for additional shade. Shrubs and trees throughout the site also provide shade and help to ensure pleasant surroundings. The Gran Comfort pitches have the most shade.

In some areas of the campsite, you can hear the sea, and you are never more than few steps from the beach. The comfortable apartments that are available for hire at Kikopark Playa also have views of the water.

Authentically Spanish

Being so close to Valencia, a visit cannot be missed, and a look at the futuristic City of Arts and Sciences is also very interesting. It is the pride of the city!

If you'll be visiting Kikopark Playa in June, then a visit to the San Juan festival is a must. In honour of the longest day of the year, and the official start of summer, residents light a huge bonfire on the beach and release burning lanterns.

properties.name: Camping Seiser Alm
properties.description:
In the summer as well as the winter, Seiser Alm campsite is the ideal spot for a camping holiday in beautiful surroundings. You can camp on spacious pitches in the woods or the meadows, or in one of the wooden cottages, for a real Alpine experience. The campsite is very comfortable; in particular, the washing facilities are spa-like in their luxury.

Wooden rental cottages

It's the grassy fields that seem to invite you to unpack quickly and throw your shoes off. In the midst of all the green is where you'll find the spacious camping pitches (up to 1200m²), between the trees or on the camping meadow. You can also camp in a Forest Tent, a sustainable wooden tent in the woods, with high floors, tiled rooves, and panoramic windows. In need of some more luxury? Then rent a comfortable apartment in the 'Obermühle' house, or one of the 'Dolomite Lodges': spruce cottages with a large sun terrace facing the mountains, for a magical view. Perfect for families or just the two of you.

Nature's entertainment

Don't expect an extensive entertainment programme at Seiser Alm campsite: the campsite mostly offers relaxation and beautiful natural surroundings for people seeking peace and quiet. It's also perfect for families with (smaller) children. At the campsite, there's a natural playground with a petting zoo, and lots of activities focused on nature are organised for the little ones: voyages of discovery through the woods, swimming and climbing days, and golf lessons (there's an 18-hole course next to the campsite). The campsite is near the swimming lake the Völser Weiher (Lago de Fiè), so if you want to take a refreshing dip, or a boat trip with a view of the mountains, you've come to the right place.

properties.name: Camping Yelloh! Village Les Tournels
properties.description:
A fifteen-minute drive away from Saint-Tropez and less than 2 km from the Mediterranean Sea: this is the beautiful setting of Camping Les Tournels. You camp here between the Southern French vineyards, on the hilly Côte d’Azur. With its wellness facilities, restaurant with its own wine label and entertainment programme, this campsite is a luxury resort where you can wind down completely.

View of the sea

The camping pitches are laid out on well maintained terrraces. High hedges and the surrounding forestation provide shade and privacy. If you are looking for some extra luxury, you can opt for a mobile home or bungalow with attractive view of vineyards and the Bay of Pampelonne. In the 'premium quarter' you will even find rental accommodation units with their own whirlpool.

A water paradise between palm trees

At the front of the campsite, basking in the hot sun, are the swimming pools. This swimming facility, measuring some 5000 m2, can justifiably be called a water paradise. The serpentine swimming pools guide you past water slides, palm trees and wooden sunbathing decks. The little ones can amuse themselves with water play equipment in the spacious toddler pool.

The Pampelonne beach

You will reach the beach of Pampelonne after a walk of less than 3 km (or a slightly longer car ride). This wide and very long stretch of beach is popular with tourists. Not surprisingly, as it is ideal for sunbathing and swimming. A number of the beach clubs offer water sports.

Wellness centre of note

Camping Les Tournels has an active entertainment programme for the entire family. This includes sports tournaments and lessons, musical evenings and children's clubs. Still, it is also an very good spot to wind down. The wellness centre is very comprehensive. Enjoy a sauna, a Turkish bath, a massage bath, fitness bath and the whirlpools.

properties.name: Camping La Ballena Alegre Costa Brava
properties.description:
In the extreme north-eastern part of Spain, on the well known Costa Brava, lies Camping La Ballena Alegre. This large campsite (more than 1100 pitches), located directly by the sea, is a veritable holiday paradise. Sun worshippers, water sports enthusiasts and families with children have been coming to this campsite for years. The campsite restaurant has a wide selection of tasty dishes. A unique feature is the separate camping area for dog owners.

Broad range of accommodations

Camping La Ballena Alegre has no less than eight hundred touring pitches and more than three hundred rental accommodation units (bungalows and chalets). Most of the pitches are spacious and enclosed. Furthermore, the surface is mainly flat and covered with grass, which is perfect for campers. The pitches are well organised: each lane has its own access route.

Holiday paradise for all

Families will immediately feel at home on Camping La Ballena Alegre. Both young and old will be able to cool off in the beautiful outdoor swimming pools. You can, of course, also swim and relax in the largest 'swimming pool' at the campsite: the Mediterranean Sea! You can reach the large beach via one of the roads from the campsite. You can also indulge in windsurfing, waterskiing. snorkelling, scuba diving, sailing and fishing, all across the sea.

Entertainment

The other facilities at the campsite are also geared towards the entire family. Children can play the day away with all the activities and entertainment available. There is also a playground on the premises. Teenagers can keep themselves amused for hours in the recreational area, which includes gaming machines and a billiards table. There are several sports fields open for use. Not to mention that at night, you can show off your latest dance moves at the dance club on the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Giralda
properties.description:
The western part of Andalusia is not without reason a renowned holiday destination. The region has a wonderful climate and apart from the famous beaches, bustling coastal and harbour towns, there are some magnificent nature reserves along the coastline of the Atlantic Ocean (woodland and marshes). This is all within reach from campsite Giralda. The site is situated on the border of the National Park, 2 km from the picturesque harbour town of Isla Cristina.

Spacious pitches in the forest

The camping pitches on the Giralda campsite are not demarcated and have a woody surface. In high season you may have to stand fairly close together. In the wooded section the pitches are more spacious and provide more shade. The attractive sanitary facilities are cleaned several time a day. At the entrance you will find special units for the disabled (key available from the reception). You can rent recently renovated bungalows and rooms on the campsite.

Swimming pool with a view

The campsite has a beautiful swimming pool with view of the Rio Carreras, the river at the far end of the campsite. Near the pool you will find a sunbathing lawn and a restaurant with terrace. There is also a toddler pool. The beautiful sandy beach of the Atlantic Ocean is only a 5-minute walk away. You can reach this directly via a path from the campsite. Entertainment for children is available in high season.

Well-stocked campsite shop

In the reception building is a very well-stocked campsite shop. Fresh bread is also available. Furthermore, there is a snack bar and a self-service restaurant with large terrace, surrounded by lovely plants.

properties.name: Camping Fossalta
properties.description:
Fossalta is a fairly large campsite on Lake Garda. You can enjoy all kinds of tourist activities here, and the whole family will find something to entertain them in the swimming pool. Children can enjoy a wonderful playground. You can also easily reach the beach by the lake. The campsite is in an ideal setting for making sporty and cultural outings.

Well-organised family campsite

You will receive a warm welcome from one of the employees at the reception. It's also helpful that you can use your credit or debit card here. The campsite looks delightful, thanks to the many flowers and plants. You will notice right away that families with children are very welcome here. This is due to the beautiful swimming pool, the playground equipment and a nice bar with terrace.

Shaded areas and mobile homes

The camping pitches on the sloping terrain are well maintained. Most pitches are shaded, fairly spacious, and are demarcated by bushes. If you find yourself with first dibs, go for a pitch with a lake view. Modern mobile homes can also be rented. 

Swimming pool or beach

The spacious swimming pool with slides can be found at the start of the campsite. Loungers can also be found on the sun terrace. A footpath leads to the lower, sandy beach at Lake Garda.

On the terrace with a snack

There is a shop in which you can find a few basic groceries. Lazise features shops in which you can do any further shopping. There is also a bar where you can buy snacks. Call in or plop down on the terrace.

properties.name: Donaupark Camping Klosterneuburg
properties.description:
When you want to visit Vienna as a camper, Donaupark Camping Klosterneuburg is the place to go. You will be exposed to an overdose of historic, cultural and musical highlights. On this typical city camping, everything is immaculate and arranged in an almost business-like manner. The other side of the coin: no frills and a rather formal atmosphere. But does it matter? After all, you are here to visit Vienna.

From the campsite, you can cycle to the centre in just under an hour. Travelling by public transport (20-minute trip) is also very convenient.

A bit compact at times

Everything is well-organised and maintained. The only minor disadvantage is the fact that the pitches are somewhat compact. There are hardened pitches, sites with grass, with gravel and pitches that have both. Camper vans are on a separate field. In low season there is much more space and you can choose a pitch yourself.

Donaupark Camping Klosterneuburg is a typical overnight campsite and is clearly centred on people who are on the move during the day.

Swimming

The campsite itself does not have a swimming pool, but in the immediate surroundings there are plenty of places where you can swim (for a fee). In the city of Vienna, you can swim in both the new and old Danube.

Restaurant and shop

At Klosterneuburg campsite you will find a restaurant with outdoor terrace and a shop. The restaurant has a small menu and offers a daily variable menu of Austrian cuisine. The shop offers fresh bread, everyday groceries and toiletries.

properties.name: Donaupark Camping Tulln
properties.description:
Donaupark Camping Tulln is located on the Austrian Danube and borders a large recreational lake. The forests of the Wienerwald adorn the rolling landscape. The campsite is located just outside the centre of the flower town of Tulln and forms an ideal base for an excursion to the capital, Vienna. The campsite has a fine restaurant named Taverne2. Here you can enjoy seasonal and organic dishes from the Tullnerfeld region. Live music is performed on a regular basis.

Circular fields

Caravans and motorhomes are located on spacious pitches on a circular lawn with room for fifteen campers. There is a water point in the centre. Luxury pitches with their own water connection and drainage are also available. Each camping pitch has a free cable connection. The tents are located on separate fields. If you do not have your own camping equipment, you can hire a modern mobile home with air conditioning. 

Water fun in the lake

Water skiing, swimming or boating: it is all possible in the recreational lake Aubad, adjacent to the campsite. Entry is free, you can obtain tickets from the reception. There are beach volleyball fields for the sports enthusiasts, but make sure to head for the sandy beach and the sunbathing lawns as well. There are a few slides and play equipment for children. 

On the road with Franz

Twice a week, Franz, the campsite manager, organises a cycling tour in the area. In addition, the Wachau cultural landscape, a UNESCO World Heritage site, is located in the vicinity of the campsite. In the area you can admire castles, ruins and monasteries, to name but a few. The vineyards of Wagram are worth a visit if you appreciate a 'vino blanco'. The entertainment programme of the campsite is varied and changes from week to week.

properties.name: Camping Bor
properties.description:
In Croatia, on the island of Krk, is where you will find Campsite Bor amid the olive trees. Here you camp at a quiet campsite close to the centre of Krk and the sea. The campsite is run by the Mrakovcic family and they produce olive oil and wines there. It is a popular holiday destination for many campers due to the pleasant Mediterranean climate. Sun lovers can enjoy the warm rays of sun early in the spring and the clear water attracts many divers and water sports fans.

By foot to the historic city centre

The campsite is within walking distance of the historic centre of Krk. The ideal thing about this location is that you are not bothered by the busy city but it is very close by. During the summer months, cultural events are organised regularly in Krk.

Camping under the olive trees

The partly demarcated pitches are situated on wide terraces, with olive and fig trees providing shade. There is of course less shade in the areas with young olive trees. The special tent field is car free. The campsite offers the option to store your caravan here in the winter, for a fee.

Between the larger campsites nearby, this is the right place for campers who are looking for more peace and quiet. There are three swimming pools: a wading pool and two standard swimming pools. As the pools are not so large, it is quieter here. The beach is pretty busy and is approximately 800 metres away. The walk back is quite a hike as the campsite is situated on a hill.

properties.name: Camping Santa Monica
properties.description:
Camping Santa Monica is located in Raron, in the stunning Rhône Valley in the Swiss canton of Valais, a region filled with high mountains such as the Aletsch Glacier and picturesque alpine towns. The campsite is an excellent starting point for outings to the glacier, the Simplon Pass and the towns of Zermatt and Saas Fee.

Neatly maintained site

The campsite offers well-maintained annual pitches and tourist pitches in three categories, including five-star pitches with private water connection and some with private toilet and washing facilities. There are also mobile homes available, with free wifi on all pitches and in the accommodation.

Lots of fun in the water

A sunny swimming pool and a paddling pool offer lots of water-based fun, and the Löübbach, a stream behind the campsite, is ideal for children to play in. Furthermore, there is a playground, sports facilities, an indoor recreation room and an entertainment programme in the summer.

Own restaurant and shop

The campsite restaurant serves a mix of international and regional dishes, including Swiss specialities. There is a supermarket with a wide selection, including the possibility to order fresh bread, next to the restaurant.

Two well-maintained toilet blocks
