There are two well-maintained toilet blocks with individual washing cubicles, a baby area and facilities for the disabled.

Enjoy the versatile Swiss alpine landscape

The campsite is in a lovely valley in a rugged mountain range, ideal for those seeking peace and quiet, nature lovers and walkers. Nearby attractions are the Aletsch Glacier, the Simplon Pass and popular towns such as Zermatt and Saas-Fee, all within 40 minutes by car. There are numerous walking routes and cable cars in the area, as well as an impressive suspension bridge at Raron.

properties.name: Recreatiepark De Paalberg
properties.description:
Recreatiepark De Paalberg is in the north-west of Veluwe, close to Ermelo. It is one of the first campsites in the Netherlands. Already in 1915 there were campers coming to this part of Gelderland to enjoy the beautiful nature. Because the place is a great departure point for biking and hiking. There are paths going directly into the forest via the gates of the campsite. There are also numerous beautiful villages and towns nearby, such as Harderwijk or the smallest town in the Netherlands, Staverden.

Comfortable camping surrounded by nature

All pitches are very large. The difference between the standard pitches and the comfort pitches isn’t the size, but the water supply to the comfort pitches. Several fields look out on a playground. Campers who value their privacy may choose a private pitch. There is also equipped accommodation that can be rented.

Swimming allowed

Those who like to swim have a wide choice on Recreatiepark De Paalberg. The covered pool has a nice slide and there is some colourful playground equipment in the toddler pool. There is also the heated outside pool, which is ideal for swimming laps. During the school holidays, there is inflatable equipment in the water for great water fun. There is also a children’s pool outside, with a low slide. The campsite also has a whirlpool, a sauna, and a Turkish steam bath.

properties.name: Camping Spiaggia D'Oro
properties.description:
Large family campsite situated directly at Lake Garda with its own sandy beach. The swimming paradise on the campsite has various slides and numerous sporting activities are organised on the camping grounds.

A large number of camping pitches and rental accommodation.

Camping Spaggia d’Oro is a spacious and large family campsite where you can choose from a wide range of pitches and rental accommodation. It all depends on what you are looking for. For instance, there are various camping pitches, ranging from 80 to 100m2 at various spots on the camping terrain. You can opt for a pitch along the beach or, if preferred, a bit more central and close to all amenities.

At Lake Garda with sandy beach.

Many campsites at Lake Garda have a pebble beach, but at the Spiaggia d’Oro site you can enjoy a real sandy beach. The beach is exclusively for campsite guests and the water is demarcated with buoys, so that it is safe for children as well. By the way, did you know that you can reach enchanting Lazise via the beach? Ideal for a snack and a drink.

Cooling off is a must under the Italian sun in summer. The large swimming paradise of the camping is a more than welcome reprieve. Slide down one of the twisting slides or cool off under the fountain. Water fun is definitely part of the game. Before you realise it, the large bucket on top of the set turns over and you might just end up in a real water festival. Around the swimming pool you will find sufficient deckchairs, sun umbrellas and shady spots for a lazy afternoon, to read a book and enjoy an occasional snack from the snack bar.

properties.name: Camping Finca l'Air Marin
properties.description:
Camping L’Air Marin borders on the Canal du Midi, some 800 m from the Mediterranean Sea. The campsite lies between the medieval looking town of Vias and the modern coastal resort Vias-Plage. This family campsite is designed as a colourful Mexican village, with trees and plants in colourful terracotta pots throughout the site. The Mexican taste is especially evident in the catering facilities, such as bar-restaurant El Pueblo.

The spacious pitches on grass are located in the sun or receive shade from poplars. They are surrounded by trees and flowery shrubs and all have electricity. Campers without their own tent or caravan can choose between various types of rental chalets and mobile homes; from basic without sanitary facilities to spacious and equipped with all amenities.

There are two large sanitary buildings, with cubicles for disabled persons and a separate baby corner. There is a dedicated section with showers, toilets and wash basins suitably sized for children.

Plenty of entertainment for the entire family

The entertainment team offers an extensive activities programme for young and old. There is a mini club for children between the ages of four and eleven, with activities such as painting, crafts, sporty games, treasure hunts and show practices. There is also a wide range of entertainment for older children and for adults. There are also all kinds of sports tournaments. By the way, feel free to bring your own padel racket. The campsite has two exceptionally well-maintained padel courts.

The best family of L’Air Marin

In the afternoons summer dancing is organised around the swimming pool and you can also attend salsa lessons. There is a healthy competition with games and tasks for the title of 'Best family of l'Air Martin' at the 'Olympic Games Family Day'.

Enjoying the communal barbecue

There are three communal barbecue areas for grill enthusiasts where you can have a barbecue together with other camping guests.

properties.name: Camping Les Varennes
properties.description:
The peaceful family campsite Les Varennes on the French island Ile de Ré is a wonderful place no matter your age. The large outside pool provides the necessary cooling on warm summer days and you can easily walk to the beach. You can rent bikes at the front desk to explore the island. Would you like something more comfortable during your camping holiday? Then rent a mobile home on the campsite.

Campsite Les Varennes can only be reached via the toll bridge across the water. From the bridge, you can already see the beach of Ile de Ré. The island is known for salt extraction, which you can see in towns such as Loix and Ars-en-Ré. The campsite is located close to the picturesque Le-Bois-Plage-en-Ré, where a market with regional products is held every morning.

Camping as luxurious as you want it

The advantage of Campsite Les Varennes is that it isn’t a large campsite, but it is nevertheless fully equipped. There are 56 camping pitches for tents, caravans, and camper vans. The camping pitches are not delimited and have a surface of approximately 95 m2. During low season, you can take an additional car free of charge.

There is also a wide choice of comfortable mobile homes. You can make it as luxurious as you want, for example with 3 bedrooms, a large sitting area, and a covered terrace. You can also choose additional luxury, for example by taking a privilege package for your mobile home, so you can enjoy sun beds and a dishwasher during your camping holiday.

properties.name: Camping Les Gros Joncs
properties.description:
Enjoy the freedom involved in camping on an island during your stay at the Campsite Les Gros Joncs. From the campsite, you can quickly reach the beach, but other neighbouring islands are also easy to get to. Enjoy a tasty bite inside the campsite restaurant, join the children’s entertainment, or spoil yourself with a spa treatment. Plenty to do!

Green camping

The campsite is located between the dunes and the forest. Green deciduous trees, hedges and bushes create a natural atmosphere on the campsite and make sure there is always sufficient shadow on the camping pitches. If you prefer the ease and comfort of home on a campsite as well you can rent one of the mobile homes or chalets. They can house a maximum of six people.

A cool swim

If you like to cool off a little on a warm summer day you don’t need to look too far to find a place to swim. Will you choose the heated outside pool with deckchairs and water slides? Or do you prefer walking through the dunes to reach the large sand beach, where you can enjoy the surf, the fine sand between your toes, and the salty sea air? Advantage: there is a beach guard on the beach during high season! If the weather is not so good, there is always a plan B: the covered pool. There’s plenty of fun to be had here too, thanks to the high currents and the water cannon.

properties.name: Marina di Venezia Camping Village
properties.description:
Campsite Village Marina di Venezia is located in the peninsula of Cavallino Treporti. Here you can enjoy shopping in lovely boutiques, dine in beautiful restaurants and attend spectacular shows. There is a kids club for children, a Football Academy and, maybe even more importantly, a spectacular water paradise. There is also a large private sandy beach with nice little beach bars.

The campsite is located at the tip of the peninsula, near Punta Sabbioni. Venice is on the opposite side and is easy to reach from here by boat, as are the lagoon islands Murano and Burano. For boats to these destination you can buy an economical day pass, so you can visit all these pearls. The campsite bus takes you to the departure point of the boat for the price of 2 euro.

Camping pitches and accommodation

There is a wide choice of camping pitches when you bring your own camping equipment. From the camping pitches near the beach it is a ten minute walk to the central Piazza, where most of the facilities are located. You can also rent bungalows, apartments and mobile homes on the campsite.

There is a separate, fenced-off section for dog owners and your four-legged friends have access their own private beach. In peak season there are many German and Italian guests on the campsite.

Adventure in Leo World

In Leo World children can imagine themselves in a playful fantasy world with the most wonderful activities (for a fee). Drive a Bumper Boat of several funky designs or play a spectacular game of midget gold at Leo Golf, with a secret cave and a winged lion. Also exciting: the 3 climbing walls and Mixtreme, an adventurous climbing route at 4.5 metres up in the air.

properties.name: Camping Yelloh! Village La Plage du Dramont
properties.description:
It's possible to enjoy a relaxing camping experience in the woods right on the Côte d'Azur at La Plage du Dramont family campsite. The campsite is on gently sloping terrain and has one hundred pitches of varying sizes (60 - 130 m2). Set up your tent, caravan or motorhome under the high shade of the pine trees or choose to stay in one of the luxury mobile homes with a fully equipped kitchen and bathroom.

Camping by the sea

You won't get bored during a holiday at La Plage du Dramont Campsite. There is an entertainment programme, a multi-sports field, a jeu-de-boules court and table tennis tables. While the kids are having fun, you can enjoy a drink by the pool or visit the wellness centre.

From the campsite beach, water lovers can go kayaking, pedal boating or parasailing. If you've always wanted to try diving, you can even join the campsite's diving club. You can also swim in the campsite's large outdoor pool. The little ones can splash around in the paddling pool.

Something different every day

If you don't feel like cooking after a day full of activities, you can enjoy a meal with the whole family in the campsite's cosy restaurant. You can get something tasty at the pizzeria or the campsite's snack bar. The campsite has a bread service and a supermarket for your daily shopping. Just outside the campsite, there are also two restaurants where you can get a bite to eat.

properties.name: Camping Yelloh! Village Holiday Green
properties.description:
Camping Holiday Green is situated in Fréjus close to the beaches of the Var. The camping is beautifully laid out around the Californian swimming pool. The camping pitches have electricity, a tap and a picnic table. You also have the use of a fridge. In addition to camping pitches, there are luxury mobile homes (cottages).

Crêpe parties, water polo and salsa lessons

There are entertainment clubs for campers of different ages that organise craft workshops, crêpe parties and (mini) discos. Throughout summer dancing lessons, as well as water polo, water aerobics and shows are offered. Furthermore, there is a small petting zoo with rabbits, guinea pigs, chickens and ducks, who can be fed under supervision.

Childcare on the campsite

In addition to the various playgrounds, there is also at the pool an African-themed playground with emptying water buckets and climbing walls. Do you prefer to stay dry? Then play a game of mini golf. There are childcare facilities for children aged between 18 months to 3 years. You can bring the children here while you enjoy a massage or beauty treatment in the wellness centre.

Happy hour and evening entertainment

Camping Holiday Green has three heated swimming pools, one of which is a Californian swimming pool of 1000 m2 with a large terrace and a lots of loungers.

There is also a covered swimming pool. At the end of the day, campers gather at the bar and the swimming pool for Happy Hour. The entertainment team is also active at that time and organises cocktail games and dance lessons. You can also join in for the pool parties at the swimming pool. In the evenings the programme includes concerts, cabaret, magic shows and dance and music performances.

properties.name: Camping Goolderheide
properties.description:
Campsite Goolderheide is close to the border with the Netherlands, amidst a forest in the Belgian province of Limburg. You can camp here in peace and quiet among the trees, but thanks to the entertainment team and the many sports and game amenities there is plenty to do. There are camping pitches, but also rental accommodation such as hiking cabins, furnished tents, mobile homes and luxurious chalets. The many pine trees mean there is always plenty of shade.

Swimming pool

This campsite mainly attracts families with children. They come for the heated outdoor swimming pool (including a climbing wall with waterfall), the whitewater slide and the spacious sunbathing area. There are also two pools with customised slides for the little ones. In addition to the outdoor swimming pool, there is also a beach pool.

Plenty of entertainment

Thanks to the many sports and games facilities, there is always something to do. An active entertainment team ensures that there are several activities a day in high season for young and old alike. Take a look at the packed programme of activities and you'll know that you won't be bored for a moment at Camping Goolderheide. There are competitions of football, darts, jeu de boules and many other activities.

There is also a mini-farm with cuddly rabbits, pigs and goats. The site also has a mini-golf course and a bicycle cross-country course right through the forest.

properties.name: Camping Ar Kleguer
properties.description:
Four star campsite Ar Kleguer is located in western France, right on the Atlantic Ocean and near the historic town of Saint-Pol-de-Léon in Brittany. This hospitable family campsite has a swimming pool complex, complete luxury sanitation and activities for everyone. From the campsite you have an unforgettable view of the bay of Morlaix, the home of many islands to which you can sail from the campsite.

Camping on your own terms

On the campsite you will be received by members of the Kerbrat family, owners of Ar Kleguer for more than thirty-five years. Hospitality is king to them. They always try to let you pick your own campsite whenever availability allows. On the vast neat camping grounds you can camp with a tent, caravan or camper on spacious sunny and shady sites, separated by hedges and trees, some with a view of the ocean. Ar Kleguer also has a large selection of mobile homes, chalets and holiday cottages.

Magic shows and boat excursions

In the summer months of July and August there are organised activities for children almost every day of the week, from treasure hunts and sand castle competitions on the beach to magic shows and football tournaments. For the older camper there are performances and boat excursions.

The heated outdoor swimming pools provide plenty of fun on the campsite. From the water and the triple slide you have a lovely view of the other immense body of water. Parents can keep an eye on the kids from the campsite bar, if they aren't in the water themselves.

properties.name: Rosenfelder Strand Ostsee Camping
properties.description:
Rosenfelder Strand Ostsee campsite is a real beach campsite. You'll be on the beach in just a few steps. At the beach, there are plenty of activities for young and old. Everyone will feel at home at this lively campsite in Schleswig-Holstein. Something that really stands out is the clean washing block, and the restaurant with a view of the sea. Tip: the lively boulevard in the village of Dahme. The campsite is ideal as a stopover campsite on the way to Scandinavia, but thanks to the high quality of all the amenities here, you run the risk of staying at this campsite and never making it to Scandinavia.  

Pitches with a direct view of the sea

From the A1 (exit 12) it's about a 20 minute drive to the campsite. At the Rosenfelder Strand Ostsee campsite, you can choose between pitches with a direct view of the sea, or pitches that are a little further from the beach. Whichever spot you choose, you'll be able to feel the sand between your toes within a few minutes. There's also a separate part of the campsite grounds for guests who want to bring their four-legged friend with them. People who want a little more comfort can rent a fully-equipped caravan here. A wonderful afternoon building sandcastles, playing beach volleyball, or just lounging around are definite possibilities at this campsite.

During the winter months (November-March), the campsite is closed, but you are welcome with your camper or caravan. Check in yourself via the check-in terminal. Reservations cannot be made during winter.

Scandinavia

The beach is different here every day. You can often find mussels and starfish. You can take the ferry to Lolland in Denmark for the day. There's a ferry service from Puttgarden to this Danish island every day (it leaves at half past the hour). At least this way, you'll be sure to see something of Scandinavia during your holiday!

properties.name: Recreatiepark TerSpegelt
properties.description:
Right in the middle of the Brabant countryside, next to no less than three large recreational lakes, lies TerSpegelt, a complete recreation park with entertainment for young and old. You can camp here on comfortable pitches or in luxury 'glamping' accommodation. An ideal destination for an active or relaxed camping holiday. TerSpegelt recreation park is located in Eersel, in the beautiful wooded Brabantse Kempen with many cycling and walking options. Opposite the campsite lies Nature Gate TerSpegelt, the starting point to exploring nature and enjoying being active outdoors.

Glamping

Excellent levels of care for guests and for employees is of paramount importance to the owners. At TerSpegelt you can camp with your own tent, caravan or mobile home. The site is divided into intimate small camping plots with spacious and secluded yet sunny spaces. There are special family plots, camping options on the waterfront and camping plots with private bathrooms. Those who do not want to bring camping gear can rent one of the various glamping accommodations.

Lakes for fun

The park is an ideal spot for families with children. For grandparents who want to take their grandchildren along, TerSpegelt is also an ideal location. There are playgrounds, a sports square, pumptrack (for BMX bikes and steps) and much more. The three recreational lakes surrounding the campsite are an oasis for water lovers. You can swim, supp, fish and more!

StarBeach

It’s clear that TerSpegelt Recreation park is a special campsite, but what you absolutely should not (and cannot) miss is the indoor StarBeach, a water and sand playground with indoor heated pool, waterslide, whirlpool and wading pool for babies and toddlers. This indoor water park is one of a kind.

properties.name: Natürlich Hell
properties.description:
Natürlich Hell is a comfort campsite in the Tyrolean Zillertal. Both seekers of peace and quiet and active holiday makers feel right at home here. The area is excellent for walking and cycling trips, the campsite is a lovely resting point. Unwind in the wellness centre or in one of the swimming pools. Tirol is a perfect destination for summer and winter. In summer this is the land of hikers and cyclists (you can rent bicycles from the campsite), in winter however, winter sports enthusiasts set the scene.

Modern and luxury

The campsite is situated in the Alps, on a level terrain directly against the mountain slopes. The reception building is very modern and well maintained. A nice indication of what the rest of the campsite looks like: neat, sleek and well cared for.

Pamper centre

Camping guests of Hell are happy to be spoiled. A real relaxing holiday is something to look forward to on this comfort campsite. However, the energetics will also feel at home on Hell. The area is well suited for long hiking or cycling trips. Even though you might not see many of them, Hell is also a good place for children.

The heated indoor and outdoor swimming pools both have a children's pool as well. Adjacent to the indoor swimming pool you will find a real pamper centre. Whilst enjoying the luxurious design, you can ask for a massage, unwind in the Finnish sauna, bio sauna, the steam bath or the relaxation rooms.

properties.name: Camping IdeaLazise
properties.description:
Situated on Lake Garda, Camping IdeaLazise opened its doors in the spring of 2019. For campers who enjoy a lively atmosphere, this comfortable campsite is a good choice for a relaxing holiday. Enjoy beautiful views of the lake and mountains from the campsite pitches or the stylish restaurant.

Well-maintained impression

Amidst idyllic surroundings, the owner has carefully furnished the spaciously laid out campsite. The large, flat terrain is divided into different fields. Young plant cover provides natural shade. Walk to the lake from this campsite on a specially laid path. About half of the pitches come equipped with eco-friendly furnished accommodations. The campsite's lively heart is the square where you'll find a restaurant, swimming pool and supermarket.

Various options for swimming

The campsite has a beautiful new swimming pool. Or rather, a luxury water park with a high slide. The water is heated in the early and late season. Stay in the pool all day and enjoy a panoramic view of Lake Garda. Of course, a fresh dip in the lake is always a good idea!

Laugh and dance

In the summer months, children can have fun at the MiniClub. When evening falls, enjoy a laugh with the comedy show or get your feet moving during dance and music evenings. After the high season, enjoy a host of other activities such as the vintage market.

properties.name: Continental Camping Village
properties.description:
Do you want to holiday at a lively family campsite with everything you need? Then, Continental Camping Village, near Fondotoce in the Italian Alps, is the campsite for you. With a spectacular swimming paradise, a great children's entertainment programme, evening entertainment in an indoor arena and its own supermarket, restaurant and café, there is plenty for the whole family. What's more, you'll camp near a sandy beach next to the clear mountain lake Lago di Mergozzo.

Shady camping by the lake

This campsite is well laid out, with shady pitches separated by hedges and trees. Pitches along the edge of the campsite have great views of the lake and surrounding mountains. On the other side of the site, you are close to the swimming paradise. You can also book a stay in a modern mobile home or a chic apartment.

Entertainment for young and old

The swimming pool alone provides hours of entertainment. The aqua park has a wave pool, rapids and water slides. For the youngest campers, there is a spray park with fountains and water jets.

Gym sessions regularly take place in the pool; they’re just one of the many sports activities that the campsite organises. Others include joint yoga, pilates and aerobics classes and football, tennis and volleyball tournaments. There are also fun activities for children of all ages. These include creative workshops, treasure hunts, original games and children's discos. Later in the day, the indoor arena hosts spectacular evening entertainment, including musicals, musical performances and cabaret shows.

properties.name: Camping Village Isolino
properties.description:
Campsite Village Isolino is at the foot of the Italian Alps, on the shores of Lake Maggiore. Relaxation and activity go hand in hand here, making it perfect for both peace-seekers and active campers. The proximity of picturesque villages like Feriolo (3 km) means an excursion is never far away.

Camp in comfort

Campsite Village Isolino welcomes you with well-tended pitches, ranging from 70 m2 (standard) to 100 m2 (extra large), surrounded by greenery and equipped with modern amenities. All the pitches are large and access paths are paved.

Don't have your own camping equipment? Not a problem: besides traditional camping pitches, the campsite also has mobile homes. Handy for families who want a little more comfort. And for a camping holiday with all the comforts of home, there are bungalows. There are seven types to choose from; the most luxurious type overlooks Lake Maggiore.

Relaxation and fun for the whole family

The heart of the campsite is undoubtedly the colourful swimming pool complex on the edge of the lake. With slides, rapids and fountains, it’s perfect for young and old. Children will have fun here all day while you relax in the sun.

Village Isolino also has modern toilet and washing facilities, including children's toilets and a machine for cleaning chemical toilets. For groceries, there's a supermarket on site. Not in the mood to cook? Then eat at the restaurant overlooking the lake.

properties.name: Camping La Pierre Verte
properties.description:
The green terraced campground of La Pierre Verte is located in an expansive hilly Provençal pine forest, about 8 km from Fréjus. The name references the green natural stone you'll find everywhere in the area. The campground consists of a hilly area where the campsites are surrounded by trees and green natural stone. The campsites, generally very nice, differ from each other, but most have a great deal of shade.

Welcome

At the campground, the employees are ready to greet you. The campground is located in a protected nature reserve, and even the trees on the campground are part of it. The managers are committed to the conservation of water, energy and waste.

Sand lagoon

The campground gained one more attraction in 2017: Lagon Plage, a 1200 m2 artificial sandy beach on a lake. There are also two outdoor swimming pools with a slide and a separate kiddie pool. One pool is heated during the low season. The whirlpool is available for relaxation.

Zumba

There is a varied international activity programme, and the activities are divided up by age group. The youngest group consists of children from 4 to 6 years, and the oldest group is the Teens Club (14-17 years). There are excursions for the sporty holidaymaker. There is fitness, such as Zumba, Steps and Aqua Gym every day.

Original dishes

The range on the campground is fabulous. The campground shop is for the basic groceries such as fresh bread (daily). You look out onto the pool from the restaurant, where the cook creates proper and original dishes, according to guests. In the evening hours, you can see shows and concerts here in the high season.

properties.name: Camping Les Jardins de La Pascalinette
properties.description:
Less than four km from the Mediterranean Sea, on the Côte d’Azur, you will find Camping Les Jardins de La Pascalinette. This campsite is located in a botanical garden and is surrounded by vineyards. You can camp here between trees and in luxury lodge tents and mobile homes. The water paradise, activities for young and old, a restaurant and various wheelchair-friendly accommodation units make this a wonderful campsite for all.

Chirping of crickets

Old olive trees, oleanders and newly planted flowers and shrubs adorn the campsite. The pitches are located in the shade of these large trees. There are also 14 comfortable pitches with new private sanitary facilities. Most of the time it is very quiet on this park-like campsite. Then you will only hear the sound of crickets chirping.

Accommodation with private pool

If you arrive without your own camping gear, you have a choice of a wide range of rental accommodation units. From basic mobile homes to luxury lodge tents. In 2023, some new rental accommodations were installed where you can enjoy your own private pool and stunning panoramic views over the vineyards and Mediterranean Sea.

Accessible water paradise

The water park of Camping Les Jardins de La Pascalinette offers 2.000 m2 of enjoyment. In addition to two swimming pools, there are several whirlpools, a toddler pool and a shallow pool. The large water playground and the water slides complete the picture. 

For beachgoers and water sports enthusiasts

The Mediterranean Sea lures you at walking and cycling distance. Also easy to reach by car (free parking). The coast is not only suitable for beachgoers who come here to spend the day swimming and soaking up the sun. There is also plenty to do for the keen water sports fan. You can engage in water sports on your own or under the guidance of an instructor.

properties.name: Camping Globo Barcelona
properties.description:
Camping Globo Barcelona is located north of Barcelona. This family campsite has a wooded terrain and three outdoor pools. It's just a few minutes walk to the sandy beaches of the Mediterranean.

If you follow the A2 to the south from Girona, you can continue your way to the N-II in the direction of Barcelona. You can follow the flat coastal road N-II to the campsite, but you can also take a shortcut via the C32. Then take the exit Calella de Mar. Globo Barcelona is located directly on the N-II, just before the village of Canet de Mar.

Modern sanitary facilities

The Globo Barcelona campsite is flat and shady. There are 155 touring pitches, 15 permanent pitches and 19 luxury rental accommodations. Most pitches are rather small. There are three toilet blocks with modern sanitary facilities. They are cleaned several times a day. You don't need shower tokens and toilet paper is available.

Enough to do

In the campsite restaurant you can enjoy Catalan specialities, but you can also go there for pizza or pasta. There are three outdoor pools next to the restaurant, including a paddling pool. At the reception you can hire kayaks, rowing boats and SUP-boards to take you out to sea. In the summer months there is an entertainment programme. There is a campsite shop and you’ll find a supermarket within walking distance. By car it will take you less than an hour to get to Barcelona. From the campsite there is also a shuttle bus and even a night bus. You can go to Barcelona by train from Canet de Mar railway station.

properties.name: Vital CAMP Bayerbach
properties.description:
Vital CAMP Bayerbach with a fantastic panoramic view over the Rottal is situated in the Bavarian Bayerbach. The campsite is popular with cyclists and hikers because of the fantastic trips that can be made in the vicinity. Golfers will also be in their element here with no less than 40 golf courses in the region. From the campsite, numerous cultural excursions can also be made to, for instance, Passau, Regensburg or Landshut.

Holiday village on the campsite

The camping is laid out in terraces. When you make a reservation, the campsite will try to accommodate your preferences as much as possible. For the less-abled campers, there are special pitches close to the sanitary facilities, which are suitable for wheelchair users.

The camping is very suitable for winter campers. At night the camp is well illuminated so that you can always find your way around. The view over the Rottal is even more spectacular when it is covered by a layer of snow. There are also water sports opportunities in the vicinity.

Natural swimming waters and a large number of wellness facilities

On Vital CAMP Bayerbach there are three natural lakes with a total surface area of 6,000 m2. These are ideal for swimming. There is a more shallow separate section for children. Furthermore, there is a wellness centrum measuring 1,200 m2 with a covered thermal swimming pool, sauna, beauty salon and physiotherapist.

St. Christopher chapel An unique feature of camping Vital CAMP Bayerbach is its own chapel. The small chapel was built in honour of the patron saint of travellers: St. Christopher. Every day campers can go to the chapel and a major event is held in the chapel in August. You can even get married in the chapel!

properties.name: Pineto Beach Village & Camping
properties.description:
Pineto, in the Italian Abruzzen province, is one of the many attractive villages on the elongated coast. On the northern side of this small village lies Pineto Beach Village & Camping along a quiet road. On the one side, you will find the Adriatic Sea and on the other side the railway, linking several coastal towns. At the entrance, you will find the carefully laid-out central square where the colourful flowers extend a warm welcome. Adjacent to the reception on this part of the campsite, you will also find the restaurant, the spacious swimming pool, the disco and the bar.

Camping under the trees

The paved and car-free pitches are located under numerous trees. Here and there they are supplemented with oleanders and other vegetation which demarcate the camping pitches. The camping pitches vary in size. Some are fitted with shade cloth. The area for tents and caravans is located on a section of the campsite where many Italian families are staying. You can hear the sound of the waves from the pitches on the beach. You pay a bit more for this location. The thirty pitches laid out for campers are located at the far end of the campsite in the direction of the beach.

Swimming with a view

The swimming pool with a view of the hills is a real asset for the campsite. It is a large swimming pool surrounded by ample space to relax on a lounger under the sun umbrella. Children can play safely in the water because there is a lifeguard in attendance. At night, this section is beautifully illuminated.

properties.name: Recreatiepark De Achterste Hoef
properties.description:
Recreatiepark De Achterste Hoef is located in the middle of the North Brabant nature area of The Campine; surrounded by trees, vast fields and a stone’s throw from the village of Bladel. During a holiday here you combine the countryside with Brabant hospitality. The campsite is easily accessible from the A67. Furthermore, the campsite is almost at the Belgian border. You should certainly consider a day trip to Turnhout or Antwerp.

Something for everyone

Whether you like to camp with your own tent or caravan or whether you would prefer to rent a bungalow or tent, at Recreatiepark De Achterste Hoef there is something for everyone. The pitches are spaciously laid out and offer adequate shelter. There are also pitches with private toilet and washing facilities. The most beautiful pitches are perhaps the ones by the water, as you have a view over the recreational lake. Additionally, the campsite has a wide range of rental accommodation, from luxury chalets to safari tents and rugged hiking cabins.

Family campsite

Recreatiepark De Achterste Hoef is set up for family holidays, especially in the high season. There is plenty for children up to fourteen years to do and experience here. If you are pitched at this campsite there is a big chance you will be next to a family with children.

Swim indoors or outdoors

With both an indoor and an outdoor swimming pool and a large recreational lake, you will want for nothing at this campsite. The indoor pool offers a solution on rainy days. The outdoor pool has a slide. If you would prefer to feel beach sand between your toes then walk round the edge of the campsite to the recreational lake with playground equipment and a slide.

properties.name: Camping Village Parco delle Piscine
properties.description:
Camping Parco delle Piscine is an exceptionally well-organised campsite in the south of Tuscany. The campsite is named after the three swimming pools, which are filled with thermal spring water from their own source. The staff is enthusiastic and professional. The camping pitches are very spacious for an Italian campsite.

Top-class campsite

Parco delle Piscine is a relatively large and well-tended campsite. The campsite grounds are well-maintained and feature many high-quality amenities such as sports fields, swimming pools and the sanitary facilities. You can choose from open and marked pitches, some of which have more shade than others. Some pitches have a private water point.

Very spacious sites

All the pitches are very spacious, certainly by Italian standards. Some pitches have a paved surface, others are situated on grass. You will see green shrubs and trees everywhere. There are also many accommodations available for rent: mobile homes, safari tents, lodges and more.

Swimming in thermal spring water

There are three swimming pools, one of which has a paddling pool, water slide and play equipment. They are all filled with thermal spring water with a constant temperature of 24 degrees. The swimming pools are situated in the sun, with plenty of space to sit or lounge by the poolside. The campsite organises excursions in the surrounding area such as guided hiking tours. You can also take part in fun activities such as Italian cooking or a painting course. And there is entertainment for the children.

Marble bathrooms

The shop in Sarteano is so close by that the campsite doesn't need its own shop. The sanitary facilities are of an exceptionally high quality, both in the materials used (marble and stainless steel) and the design. Everything is very clean and spacious.

properties.name: Camping Le Ventadour
properties.description:
Camping Le Ventadour is a hospitable family campsite in the heart of the Ardèche. The campsite is situated along the river with the same name, in which you can swim. The campsite is a relaxing and friendly place for nature lovers. Le Ventadour is centrally situated in the regional Monts d’Ardèche Nature Park. In this country of volcanic mountain tops, waterfalls and wild churning rivers, the campsite is a peaceful oasis for campers.

Easily accessible

Barbara, Jean Pierre Leynaud and their two twins will extend you a warm welcome to their family camping. You can reach the campsite over easily passable roads. The camping grounds are located in pristine nature, between mountains along the Ardèche river.

A rugged landscape, a comfortable campsite

The campsite consists almost exclusively of pitches, located between trees. The site is also very accessible for larger caravans and campers; there is space for everyone. Would you rather hire accommodation? You can do that, too. There are several mobile homes among the shady trees.

Nature lovers

Nature lovers feels right at home on this campsite. However, the campsite is suitable for all: from young to old. There is an amicable atmosphere and small-scale entertainment.

Swimming fun in the river

Camping Le Ventadour does not need a swimming pool; it has its own river! The Ardèche running alongside - with waterfall to boot! - is ideal for splashing around, swimming and fishing. On top of this, it is a splendid sight. The campsite also has its own sandy beach.

properties.name: La Rocca Camping Village
properties.description:
In the bay of San Pietro, right on the south east of Lake Garda, you can camp at La Rocca Campsite Village, with an unforgettable view of the crystal clear water. Within walking distance of the picturesque Bardolino, and the lovely Garda, this family campsite is a perfect destination for the whole family. The campsite lies at the foot of the Rocca. This is an overgrown rock that is right next to the campsite, and is perfect for a nice walk. The plentiful olive and cypress trees make the natural experience at La Rocca complete.

Landscaped like a park

A through road divides the lively campsite grounds in two, and you can reach the other side through a tunnel. On one side, you have direct access to the lake, and this is where you can also find the supermarket and the restaurant. The swimming pools, the large playground, and the volleyball court are on the upper part of the campsite. Guests receive a card, which gives them access to the lake through a gate. Past the gate, there's a 200 metre wide stretch of lawn to lay your towel on, and there's also a pier. Next to the campsite, there's a promenade, where many people cycle and walk. There is plenty of choice: from a standard pitch for a tent, to a superior pitch right on the lake. The delimited pitches are located along paved streets.

properties.name: Naturisten Feriendorf Rutar Lido
properties.description:
Naturist campsite Rutar Lido is situated in a broad, mainly flat valley. From here you can enjoy a magnificent view of the surrounding mountains. Although the campsite allows children, Rutar Lido is actually only visited by adults and seniors. The grounds, which blend in with the natural greenery, are immensely expansive, thereby ensuring plenty of peace and privacy.

All the amenities

An access road takes you to both the Hotel Rutar Lido and the campsite's entrance and reception. At the hotel you'll also find a cosy bar and the supermarket. The campsite includes 15 hectares of rustic grounds with swimming pools, swimming lakes and even a hiking pasture for naturists. The restaurant cooks dishes from the Austrian cuisine. Have a seat on the terrace, which is definitely a lovely place to sit out when the weather's nice.

What does your pitch look like?

The campgrounds have scattered camping fields that are interwoven with the natural habitat. This means lots of greenery with (hedge) shrubbery and trees. The more than 300 pitches are between 70 and 140 m2 each. There are generally lots of good privacy pitches found throughout the grounds. No camping equipment? Then book a chalet, hotel room, studio or apartment.

Swimming and sunbathing

You will find the rectangular outdoor swimming pool (600 m2) at the centre of the campsite. The water is deep and slightly heated. Fantastic to swim laps in perfect peace in the morning when everything is still quiet. There is also a smaller indoor pool. You can use the sauna in the hotel. Of course, swimming in the lake is always a good idea, as is working on your tan on the sunbathing lawn next to the lake shore.

properties.name: Camping Les Embruns
properties.description:
Les Embruns is a campground on the Breton coast which is really worth exploring. The area is not very touristy, so perfect for camping. The campground is particularly well maintained and has parklike vegetation, flowers and fountains. The fields are spacious, flat and have sufficient privacy. Upon arrival you will find a well-organised campsite where you will be warmly welcomed.

Flowers, little ponds and playgrounds

When you arrive at the campground, you'll immediately notice many flowers, lawns and ponds. The entire area is nicely designed, which makes it a pleasure to stay here. Arriving on the campsites, they appear spacious and mostly flat. There is sufficient privacy thanks to the vegetation.

Lovely food

The restaurant serves wonderful dishes both inside and outside on the terrace. We recommend booking a table. Local specialities include mussels, but the pizzas are also recommended. In the campground supermarket you'll find everything you need. There are special barbecue zones for enthusiasts.

Recreation team and beach

They've thought of the children too. There is a spacious playground and a recreation team that plans treasure hunts, picnics and games. From the campground you walk about 400 m via the public road to the beach. It is usually not too busy.

Facilities

The sanitation on the campground is in the midst of a nice park with ponds, fountains and tropical plants. It is very well maintained.

properties.name: Camping Les Berges du Canal
properties.description:
Camping Les Berges du Canal is situated in the south of France, on one of the oldest canals in Europe. The canal connects Toulouse with the Mediterranean Sea and is still an important navigation route today. From the campsite, you can see plenty of boats passing by.

Cosy family campsite

The warm welcome at the reception desk makes you feel right at home on this cosy family campsite. The campsite is relatively small and quiet and has beautiful pitches, mostly in the shade of some trees. The pitches are sufficiently large. If you don't have your own camping equipment, you can stay in a mobile home or Coco tent. The sanitary facilities on the campsite are also excellent.

Specialities of the chef

Camping Les Berges du Canal provides entertainment for young and old. In high season there is an animation team for the children. There is always something to do on the sports field and in the playgrounds. You can keep fit in the outdoor fitness area or relax with a quiet game of pétanque. There is a small shop where you can get your daily groceries and some regional products. The campsite restaurant offers home-made dishes using seasonal products, homemade pizzas or tapas.

Pool or seaside

Here in the south of France, the sun shines brightly, so it's nice to be able to cool down once in a while. That's why there are two swimming pools in the centre of the campsite with a small sunbathing area all around. One of the pools has a shallow end, and there is a fun water mushroom for the kids.

properties.name: Strandcamping Wallnau
properties.description:
In the north of Germany, on the third largest German island (named Fehmarn), Strandcamping Wallnau occupies a unique location. The well-know bird sanctuary and protected nature reserve Wallnau are literally around the corner. Fehmarn is one of the sunniest regions of the country with the most hours of sun. The 78 km-long coast offers a wide variety of water sports opportunities. But cyclists and walkers, too, can feast their eyes. Close to the camping is a canal that separates the camp site from the Baltic Sea.

Camping on grass

The flat and spacious terrain of Strandcamping Wallnau has some 400 camping pitches. Most pitches provide sufficient privacy due to the vegetation and low hedges which demarcate the pitches. A number of mobile homes can also be rented. Because of the many attractions in the vicinity, the camp site has a wonderful character. There are 4 sanitary buildings in total, spread across the camp site. The 'North' sanitary block was renovated in 2016.

Beach camping

You reach the beach via a small bridge where you have a vast view of the sea. The camp site primarily revolves around the vast beaches for which the region is renowned. Walking, surfing, kayaking, diving, horse riding on the beach, beach volleyball. This is only a handful of the many possibilities of a day at the sea.

The day flies by

The camp site also organises all kinds of activities for children. Young campers take up bow and arrow as real Robin Hoods They can also amuse themselves on the bouncing cushion. Opposite the camp site is a riding stable from where young and old can venture on nature treks on horseback.

properties.name: Camping Denntal
properties.description:
The Ahr valley is well-known for its viticulture. The deep incisions (up to 300 metres) in the rocky landscape are characteristic of the region. Here you will find campsite Denntal, offering excellent opportunities to leisurely explore the area. The valley offers clearly signposted walking and cycling routes. The campsite itself is an oasis of peace and quiet. You are truly surrounded by beautiful nature here.

Let nature embrace you

Camping Denntal presents itself as the quietest and best-equipped campsite in the Ahr valley. You will realise what this means when you look around on a beautiful sunny day: everywhere you see wooded slopes, creating a glorious view in the sunlight. Nature embraces you at campsite Denntal.

Beautiful nature and modern sanitary facilities

The grounds are located in a beautiful natural area. There are demarcated and non-demarcated pitches, all of which have electricity, a tapping point and a drain for dirty water. A number of places are provided with a grass and concrete surface. The sanitary facilities are modern, comfortable and are well-maintained.

Fun playground and fully-equipped fitness room

The campsite is popular with senior citizens and couples, but also families with young children will feel at home here. There is a playground with a fairly large selection of equipment. There is no swimming pool on the campsite, but you can use the well-equipped fitness room if you want to have a good workout.

Restaurant Tannenhof is open from Wednesday to Friday and is known for its ‘gutbürgerliche’ (homestyle) quality and friendly prices. The campsite also offers some basic products.

properties.name: Camping Lug ins Land
properties.description:
You will find this quality campsite on a hill along the river Rhine. Enjoy the boating trips on the river and excursions to Freiburg or Basel. The campsite has a lovely restaurant and extensive wellness facilities. Horse lovers are also warmly welcome. If you need to, you can book your horse into a nearby boarding-house. The village of Bad Bellingen is conveniently nearby for your daily necessities. The border triangle of France-Switzerland-Germany is also found in the area. Towns such as Basle, Mulhouse and Freiburg are therefore easy to reach.

Stunning view

As the campsite is built against a hill, you have a stunning view over the river Rhine and the green, French Vosges from virtually every pitch. Adjacent to the reception is the heated outdoor swimming pool and the toddler pool. The swimming pool is centrally located on the campsite and several activities are organised here in high season, such as water aerobics and diving courses.

Total relaxation

Guests wishing to explore the region from the water, can go on a boat trip on the Rhine, organised by the campsite. You can completely relax in the wellness centre in the campsite. Enjoy a wonderful hot stone massage or one of the facial treatments.

Go on a tractor tour

The region around Camping Lug ins Land has an abundance of fruit trees. During harvest, nothing beats going on a tractor ride to see the cherry trees, walnut trees and grapevines. A ride on a tractor takes you to places you might have missed otherwise, which would be a pity.

properties.name: Wellness Camp Düne 6
properties.description:
Wellness Camp Düne 6 is situated in the Western Pomerania Lagoon Area National Park on the North German pensinsula of Zingst. With a wellness centre and sauna, a selection of massages and fitness options, the Baltic within walking distance and possibilities galore for outdoor sports, this is a great spot for a holiday.

Medium-sized birches

On the large, open grounds with medium-sized birches you will find the demarcated pitches located along wide gravel roads. The pitches are specious and well maintained. The surface is very firm. There is a separate field for tents. If you want to hire accommodation, you have a choice of mobile homes and apartments. The sanitary facilities on the campsite are luxurious and spotless.

Swimming and the beach

The covered swimming pool, accessible to the general public, is located in the wellness centre and look superb with beautiful mood lighting, plants, wooden decks and ample loungers around the pool. Due to the biological purification system, the swimming pool is not opened all day long. The sandy beach along the Baltic Sea is within walking distance and also provides ample space to naturists. Besides, it is a great spot for windsurfers and kitesurfers.

Wellness centre

There is a playing field and a sports field. In the spaciously laid out wellness centre adjacent to the swimming pool you will also find a sauna, a steam bath, massage and beauty treatment areas with sunbed and a fitness centre. Entertainment is offered in high season.

Luxury camping restaurant

Camping guest who do not feel like cooking every day during their holiday can enjoy a meal in the luxury camping restaurant with a wide choice. In the nearby lively small town of Zingst you will find more restaurants. Keen cooks can buy all they need in a nearby supermarket.

properties.name: Freizeitcenter Oberrhein
properties.description:
A well-maintained and large campsite in the warmest area of Germany in the Baden-Wurttemberg region. Surrounded by greenery and located on the river Rhine, the spacious grounds offer many amenities, such as two wonderful swimming lakes and two restaurants where you can enjoy an extensive menu indoors and outside on the terrace. The mini golf course, the climbing wall, the animation and the bouncy castle in the summer are nice extras for young children. At the Freizeitcenter Oberrhein, you will also meet many German guests who come back regularly and enjoy socialising. The most beautiful routes along the Rhine await hikers or cyclists.

Camping on the Rhine

In the heart of the Rhineland, Freizeitcenter Oberrhein is a well-organised and lively campsite. The river flows past the campsite, and Stollhofen is the nearest village. At the main entrance is the neat reception building, and from there, you drive between the two swimming lakes to the touring pitches.

Pitches around the lake

All pitches are located around the two swimming lakes and neatly set up on a street or an open field. The water is never far away, sometimes even a few steps away. All permanent pitches are separate, and a special area has been set up for campers. You can also enjoy a wonderful holiday in the luxury bungalows if you do not bring your own accommodation. The modern sanitary blocks are high quality and a real surprise for all campers. Thanks to the fun children's sanitary facilities, showering after a day outside is really a party.

properties.name: Camping Riva Bella Thalasso & Spa Resort
properties.description:
Camping Riva Bella Thalasso & Spa Resort is beautifully situated in nature and alternates beach pitches with woodland pitches. In high season it is a naturist campsite. Beyond this, non-naturists are also welcome. The private beach of the campsite is very special. The restaurant in which you can have a meal 'by the sea' is definitely worth your while.

Spacious pitches, naturists in high season

The spacious pitches are partly located in the woods and partly at the beach. It all depends on your preference. Furthermore, there are quite a few chalets or bungalows on the campsite. Riva Bella is a naturist campsite in high season (April to beginning of November). The guests are very diverse. Outside of the high season, non-naturists are also welcome.

A private beach

The campsite is situated along a private beach. Erosion has narrowed the beach somewhat here. On the campsite itself is a large lagoon (inland lake), which creates a very nice natural look. Swimming in the lagoon is not allowed.

Meals on the beach

The campsite has a small shop for basic necessities. Seven km down the road is a large supermarket. The restaurant is open where it faces the sea, creating a feeling of dining on the beach. The sanitary facilities are kept neat and tidy.

Active on and around the campsite

On the campsite you can participate in different activities, such as archery and paddle surfing. To do this, you rent a type of board to stand on and 'paddle' with an oar. In the surroundings you can visit the beautiful beaches of the east coast and explore the beautiful mountain villages.

properties.name: Domaine de Bagheera
properties.description:
On the East coast of Corsica, you will find naturist campsite Domaine de Bagheera, situated directly on a sandy beach and close to Aleria. Both the camping and the 5 km-long beach alongside the campsites are frequented exclusively by naturists. The campsite was established in the seventies by Afni Filippi as one of the first naturist campsites on the island. You have a choice of non-demarcated pitches with various degrees of shade. You can choose a pitch at the beach for an additional fee. There are in excess of a hundred rental bungalows on the grounds.

Eco camping

The campsite, which is located in dense eucalyptus woodland, is committed to sustainability. The sanitary facilities are heated by solar energy, cooking is done with biological products and electric vehicles are used on the grounds. The restaurant serves typical home-made Corsican dishes, often a fish dish. From the snack bar, you have a beautiful view of the beach. There are more seaside restaurants within walking distance. The camping shop stocks a limited range of necessities as well as fresh bread. There is a large supermarket some 6 km away.

Bird-watching

From the campsite, you can walk to the sea. The sea is calm and shallow here. There are numerous activities and facilities on the campsite, such as a sauna, massages (for a fee), yoga, bird-watching, and angling at the lakeside. Camping guests have a wide choice of sports: table tennis, jeu de boules, beach volleyball, tennis (for a fee) and there is a sports field. At the reception, you can rent bicycles, mountain bikes, canoes, kayaks, sailing and rowing boats and pedalos. You can also attend courses in windsurfing, sailing and diving.

properties.name: Ferienpark Terrassencamping Süd-See
properties.description:
You relax completely at Ferienpark Terrassencamping Süd-See. Each pitch allows you to enjoy the fresh mountain air and the view of the Walchsee lake. This area of the Austrian Tyrol is open the entire year round. In the summer you can go on wonderful hikes and bicycle rides and in the winter you can enjoy the snow on the ski runs.

A view of the lake everywhere

With a site that is at least eleven hectares, Ferienpark Terrassencamping Süd-See can most certainly be called spacious. The 150 pitches are located on terraces with a panoramic view of the Walchsee lake. Set up your tent or caravan on the grass among the trees. Each pitch allows you to enjoy the view. If you would rather enjoy a little more luxury, choose a glamping lodge or one of the cosy apartments.

Fun for the entire family

The charming restaurant also offers a view of the lake. Pull up a chair and enjoy the local cuisine. If you would rather eat at your own pitch, all dishes are also available as takeaway. For basic shopping, you need not travel far. The mini market at the campsite sell fresh rolls, delicious cakes, local products and other necessities.

Young campsite visitors can amuse themselves just fine at Ferienpark Terrassencamping Süd-See. During the high season, fun activities are organised three times a day. Enjoy crafting, playing or dancing. Bring the entire family to live music nights or to the campfire. Across the road from the campsite is a large playground, a sunbathing area with benches and a special doggy beach. Fun for the entire family!

properties.name: 50plus Campingpark Fisching
properties.description:
50plus Campingpark Fisching focusses specifically on campers aged 50 and over who like peace and quiet, walking and cycling. There is a large cycle path network around the campsite and there is a natural swimming pond with a lawn for sunbathing. The campsite is situated west of the town of Graz – listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site – in the valley by the village of Fisching. The area is ideal for (guided) walking and cycling tours. The campsite is in a wonderful location in the green countryside and you have a view of the surrounding mountains. 50plus Campingpark Fisching is run by the Pfandl family, who do everything possible to give campers an enjoyable time.

On your airbed or luxury Swiss pine bed

At the campsite, you camp on one of the 50 spacious pitches that are partly demarcated and covered with gravel and that all have electricity, water and cable TV. You can stay overnight in one of the apartments or bungalows. They are all elegantly furnished and have beds made of Swiss pine, which is considered to have healing properties.

Special for 50’s and over

The name already says it all really, 50plus Campingpark Fisching is specially for campers aged 50 and over. The campsite has chosen to focus on this target group, so that they can meet these campers’ wishes. And so, it is very quiet at the campsite with no children running around.

properties.name: Camping Les Cerisiers du Jaur
properties.description:
Nature plays a leading role in the French region of Hérault, north-west of the city of Béziers. Les Cerisiers du Jaur campsite, a green paradise in the Jaur valley, is situated in the heart of the Haut-Languedoc nature regional park. Dotted in the enchanting environment are a number of characteristic French villages to enhance a visit to this region. This diverse region of the Languedoc-Rousillon is also well suited to be explored by bicycle or on foot.

Spacious campsite

The camping pitches are distributed between the old and the new sections of the campsite. The majority is bordered by green hedges and equipped with electricity and water connections. Sufficient choice for a place in the shade. The old section of the campsite in particular is surrounded by trees, plants and shrubs. Rental accommodation is available in various types and sizes, from modern furnished mobile homes to wooden bungalows with partially covered verandas.

Swimming pool, river, lake or sea

For the swimming enthusiasts, Les Cerisiers du Jaur Campsite is definitely the place to be. On the campsite but also beyond, campers have a choice of various waters. In the centre of the camping grounds is a playful swimming pool, which can be accessed via a wide flight of stairs. Infants and toddlers have their own dedicated section of the pool. The river with private beach is also popular with the guests. The area at the dam is an ideal playground for children. Beyond the campsite are two beautiful lakes: Lake Vesoles and Lake la Raviège. Furthermore, the coast is some 50 km away near Béziers.

properties.name: Camping Zocco
properties.description:
Camping Zocco is situated in the north of Italy, with cities such as Milan, Verona and Venice within easy reach. On this quiet camp site in a natural setting you can overlook Lake Garda from the camping accommodation or the camp site. Your camping pitch is situated beneath the olive trees on a terraced terrain. Many camping spots overlook the lake. There is electricity at your camping pitch. Furthermore, overnight accommodation is available in apartments, cottages, bungalows or in a luxury tent. Your neighbours are mostly families with children and senior citizens. Even with the tranquil setting, older children can keep themselves entertained at this camping, helped by the surrounding beach clubs.

Swimming

Camping Zocco has a swimming pool and a paddling pool for toddlers. The swimming pool is surrounded by deckchairs, allowing you to work on your tan. Swimming in Lake Garda is also possible. This can be reached via our own access to the pebble beach.

Sport and games

Sports enthusiasts can indulge in their passion at Camping Zocco, because the facilities include a tennis court, soccer field, beach volleyball court and the opportunity to hire bikes, mountain bikes and sailing boats. Adults can also join excursions that are organised by the camping. Children can enjoy themselves on the playground, at the ping pong table and with the animation programme.

But hold on.....Pizza!

You start the morning with fresh bread rolls from the camping shop. You can also visit them for any necessary camping items and holiday toys. You can enjoy international dishes and pizzas in the excellent restaurant/pizzeria. Finally, to finish off the day, you can have a drink in the bar.

properties.name: NATURCAMP Pruchten GmbH
properties.description:
Overlooking the dune landscape, Naturcamp Pruchten is situated in the federal state of Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania. Here, you camp on spacious pitches or in one of the rental accommodations. The camping is conveniently situated for exploring the wetland area on foot or by bike. At Naturcamp Pruchten, you camp in the shade between the trees or in an open field. From the camping pitches, you have a beautiful view of the surrounding area.

Furthermore, there is a possibility to rent an apartment, bungalow or log cabin, offering you the opportunity to stay at this camping without your own camping equipment. Mostly elderly couples and families with young children spend their holidays at this camping.

Swimming, cycling and entertainment

Swimming opportunities are within easy reach of Naturcamp Pruchten. You can swim in the Baltic Sea or in the Bodstedter Bodden, a type of inland sea. This is only a short distance away by bicycle. In high season, small children can join in organised entertainment or enjoy a nice movie in the cinema. They can also romp around in the playgrounds on the campsite.

Sanitary facilities

The sanitary facilities at Naturcamp Pruchten are well-maintained and built in German style. The underfloor heating keeps your feet nice and warm. There is also a special shower for children, convenient to wash the little ones.

Not to be missed!

In September thousands of cranes gather in this region on the migration route. An amazing spectacle that you simply should not miss when you stay at Naturcamp Pruchten.

properties.name: Lærdal Ferie og Fritidspark
properties.description:
Campsite Lærdal is located in Laerdalsoyri, in the province Sogn og Fjordane. After a warm welcome (in Dutch, English, German, or Danish) at the front desk, you drive to the camping pitch, apartment, or bungalow. They can be booked with various comfort levels. Campers will be happy with the flat, grass-covered pitches surrounded by a few trees. There are pitches without and with some shadow.

Fjord at your feet

Campsite Lærdal has 100 touring pitches and 58 units of rental accommodation. Located directly on a sand beach and sunbathing area, it is the ideal place for lovers of nature and peace. You can spend undisturbed holidays on the camping pitches that are closest to the water.

The Sognefjord, the longest and deepest fjord in the country, is not only Valhalla for nature enthusiasts who enjoy the gorgeous views, but also for lovers of water sports. They can go on the water in a canoe or boat (both available for rent) and explore the surroundings, or go wild with windsurfing or water-skiing. The campsite is popular among Dutch people.

Fun for young and old

Even though the campsite is peaceful day and night, there is plenty to do. Children will spend hours playing on the playground or on the trampoline. There is also a leisure area, and you can play tennis or beach volleyball.

The main attraction of the campsite is the nearby Motorikpark, an activity park where the entire family can do lots of challenging things. Climbing, balancing, power training, riding a go-cart; everything is possible here.

properties.name: Alfsee Ferien- und Erlebnispark
properties.description:
This complete holiday park is close to the Hanseatic city of Osnabrück in Lower Saxony. You camp here in one of the two 'camping sections' of the large grounds, but there are also different types of rental accommodation. From stressing to de-stressing: this park will offer you all the activities to turn your holiday into a party. The area is perfect for cycling and walking, but you do not have to leave the park for activities and entertainment.

Endless possibilities

Upon arrival at the park you will immediately note the numerous possibilities. At the reception they are happy to assist you find your pitch and will give you information about the different facilities. The park is divided in different sections, each with its own character. There are two 'camping districts' available for camping. On these pitches you have access to electricity and on the more luxury pitches you also have water and a TV connection.

Always something going on!

On the camping grounds you will mainly find families with young children. In peak season, many activities are organised so that every day there is something going on. In low season it is much quieter: an ideal time to explore the area around this recreation park.

Not only is the park situated adjacent to the protected nature area around the Alfsee, it also has its own private recreation lake with sandy beach. For the real daredevils there is a waterski course and for the sports enthusiasts there is a beach volleyball and a beach soccer field.

properties.name: Camping Lou Rouchetou
properties.description:
You will experience a wonderful holiday in the beautiful Monts d’Ardèche nature park at Camping Lou Rouchetou. Situated alongside a river, it is close to the touristy city of Les Vans (5 km). The campsite gives a well-kept impression and has a wonderful swimming pool for cooling off on hot days. You can enjoy fresh local products in the restaurant and there is plenty for the entire family to do.

Green pitches

At Camping Lou Rouchetou you camp in green surroundings. There are plenty of trees and green growth that provide privacy and shade. The 120 pitches are level and are between 80 en 100 m² in size. Some pitches have a beautiful panoramic view of the landscape or overlook the river. Want more comfort? You can also rent a mobile home.

Splashing in the water

This charming family campsite has plenty to do for the entire family. The centre of the campsite has a beautiful swimming pool with a separate wading pool. There are chaise longues around the pool and you have a great view here! If you would rather swim in natural water, that’s possible, too. The campsite has a private beach along the Chassezac river.

Explore the beautiful region

Although there is plenty to do at the campsite, it is certainly recommended that you explore the surrounding area. The countryside is beautiful, and there is lots of history and charming villages. Banne (8.5 km) gives you a taste of the medieval atmosphere with its fort, rock paintings and old houses. The famous Pont d’Arc, the natural rocky arch over the river, is only 33.5 km away from the campsite.

properties.name: Eurocamping Vessem
properties.description:
Eurocamping Vessem is a child-friendly campsite, located in a forested area in the midst of lovely Brabant villages. The campsite has a well maintained tourist section with large pitches and large play area where there is enough to do for everyone: from swimming to football, from fishing to jumping on the bouncy cushions. Eurocamping Vessem lies in a forested area in the Brabant countryside. You will find many nice characteristic villages and nature reserves around the campsite where it is lovely to walk and cycle.

Spread out and spacious

When you are in one of the comfort sites or sitting in front of your lodge tent, there is a great chance that a young family will be next to you. The campsite is very suitable for families with young children, but also teenagers. In addition, there are campers from every age group. In the high season there are holiday makers from all over Europe on the campsite - the largest representation being from Germany, France and the Netherlands. In the low season there are mostly French campers "of a certain age".

Sports and play around the swimming pool

There is an open air swimming pool with kiddie pool in the midst of large grassy fields. When you climb out of the swimming pool, you can play a round of mini golf, play in the playground or jump into the air on the bouncy cushion. You can also get out on one of the sports fields if you want to kick or hit a ball. There is also a large fish pond on the campsite, for the necessary hours of relaxation. Cast a line and relax, nothing else is needed to get a bit of peace and quiet.

properties.name: Camping Park Umag
properties.description:
Camping Park Umag is a comprehensive family campsite on the Croatian coast, with a variety of amenities and activities. The luxury all-in pitches and the wide variety of accommodation ensure your camping holiday will be very comfortable indeed. The campsite is located less than 10km from the centre of the town of Umag. The area has a rich history and a beautiful countryside; there is much to discover.

Luxury spots

At the campsite, you will find a variety of pitches, from basic camping pitches to luxury pitches with sea views, private showers, free wifi, barbecue and gazebo: beautiful spots for a camping holiday with lots of privacy. The range of rental accommodation at Camping Park Umag is particularly extensive. You have a huge choice of different mobile homes (all with air conditioning and free internet) and luxurious lodge tents.

Safe swimming and playing

Camping Park Umag has a central swimming complex with three swimming pools. Children in particular can really let go here. Besides that, the site is very uncluttered - you won't easily lose sight of them. Swimming in the sea is of course also possible. Camping Park Umag has thought of every age group. There are several entertainment clubs, for children from 0 to 5 years, from 5 to 9, from 9 to 14 and from 14 to 18. So, you have enough time for a relaxing massage or an exciting diving course.

properties.name: Camping Club Californie-Plage
properties.description:
More than a campground, the Camping Club Californie-Plage is a pirate's paradise that really appeals to the imagination, certainly to the imagination of children. But not only to children, the entire family will enjoy a lovely holiday on this campsite. Go to the beach of the Mediterranean Sea, located at just 200 m from the campsite.

Camping by the beach

The location of the touring pitches is self-evident, as all rental accommodation is located on a dedicated area of the campsite. Are you lucky enough to find the campsite quiet? If so, you can score one of the most beautiful pitches: at the beach with a view of the sea.

Water paradise 

This real 'pirate campsite' has everything for a vacation full of water fun. With the whole family you can enjoy a brand new (2022) water park with a pirate theme. Among other things you will find a water slide, an indoor pool (heated to 28°C out of season) and a large jacuzzi.

Beach and sea

The campsite grounds are elongated in shape. Narrow from the entrance down to the sea. There is a bar here as well as sanitary facilities. One of the two campsite restaurants is located right by the sea. A freshly-caught fish on your plate, grilled over a wood fire. Enjoy!

Pirate theme

The campsite shop, the bar, the restaurant and a cosy terrace are all located around an attractive square. The shop on the campsite is well stocked. There is a large pirate ship near the restaurant/bar. Each Wednesday the entire crew of the campsite gets dressed up as pirates. Party time...

properties.name: Camping Cikat
properties.description:
At Camping Cikat children are the main focus. With a large aqua park and a special fun park for children, these young camping guests will have the time of their life on this Croatian campsite. The vast choice of eating establishments and the setting –in the bay of Cikat – create a lovely ambiance on the campsite. There are several rental accommodation units available, but you can also sleep in your tent or caravan.

Camping with creature comforts

If you like your creature comforts, campsite Cikat is the place for you. Not just because the campsite offers all kinds of facilities, but it also has new, comfortable rental accommodation. For instance, new mobile homes with all the conveniences of home, such as a fully equipped kitchen and own bathroom. You can soak up the Croatian heat on the covered terrace.

Families with children

The focus of campsite Sikat is on children. Therefore, you will probably find a large number of guests with (young) children. This is perfect, because your children will soon make new camping friends and you won't have to worry about them the rest of the holidays.

Large aqua park

The large aqua park on campsite Cikat extends over an area of 6300 m2. There are numerous slides, water play equipment and even sections of the pool that are covered. This allows you a refreshing dive while staying in the cool shade.

properties.name: Camping Savudrija
properties.description:
In the extreme north-western tip of Croatia, just across the Slovenian border, lies Camping Savudrija. This large, quiet four star campsite is located in a pine forest on the Adriatic coast, near the town of Umag. You camp here under tall trees, which provide ample shade. The campsite consists of two sections which are both located by the sea. The smaller northern section lies at the foot of the oldest lighthouse on the Adriatic coast.

For the adventurous swimmer

The crystal blue water is inviting, but the irregular rocky coastline with its stony beaches makes swimming here quite challenging. For those not quite as adventurous, the campsite has a beautiful outdoor swimming pool. 

Spotting and catching fish

You can hire pedal boats and jet skis from the campsite, but you may also bring your own boat along. The clear water is ideal for snorkelling as well. If you prefer to look at fish at the end of your fishing rod, ask around for fishing options in the area. 

For the entire family

Camping Savudrija is a real family campsite. There are a number of facilities for children: a trampoline, playground, swimming pool, table tennis table and mini golf course. Teenagers can play a game of beach volleyball or tennis. There is a mini club for children up to age twelve. The entertainment programme in high season is very popular. 

Dinner is served!

There are several lovely communal picnic spots on the campsite. Ideal for a barbecue with the family. There is also a small shop for daily groceries. You will find larger supermarkets in Umag town, some eight km from the campsite. If you prefer eating out, you have plenty of choice on the campsite: grab a seat in a restaurant, pizzeria or snack bar.

properties.name: Camping l'Ardechois
properties.description:
Camping L'Ardéchois lies hidden in the green heart of the Ardèche, beyond the busy, touristic section. After a warm reception, you can find a nice spot by the river or the swimming pool with a view over the mountain landscape. With an extensive entertainment programme, wonderful barbecue evenings and weekly performances by artists, you won’t get bored for a minute.

This luxurious family campsite is in the middle of the mountainous region of the Ardèche. The closest village is Saint-Sauveur-de-Montagut that is about 8 kilometres away.

Camping with a view of the mountains

The campsite consists of two parts and is separated by a quiet through road. As the campsite is divided up in terraces, there is an amazing view of the mountains from the camping pitches.
