There are also neat mobile homes for rent on the upper section. If you take your barbecue along, then make sure it works with gas or electricity because charcoal is banned throughout the Ardèche. There is also excellent wireless internet coverage throughout the entire campsite.

Outdoor swimming pool

On the section of the campsite situated above the road, you will find the swimming pool and from there you have a panoramic view over the mountain landscape. The little ones can play safely in the toddler pool and parents can relax on the sun loungers under the reed parasols. You are only permitted to wear swimming trucks or tight-fitting swim suits (no boxer shorts).

properties.name: Camping Stella Maris
properties.description:
The four-star campsite Stella Maris lies just across the border from Slovenia, in the westernmost point of Croatia. This large family campsite was fully renovated in 2018, which included the addition of a large outdoor swimming pool. The adjacent tennis park hosts the annual Croatian Open Umag, a famous tournament that attracts many visitors. A special train takes you to the city of Umag, two kilometres away.

Camping in pine forest

The site is well maintained and organised, with gravel pitches along straight roads. The majority of the camping pitches are located in pine forest. The pitches are clearly marked and separated by newly planted vegetation. The pine trees offer little protection from the wind, but do provide shade. Modern, deluxe mobile homes are available for rent on a separate section of the campsite.

Large swimming pool

At the edge of the campsite, there is a large swimming pool with a toddler pool. The pool is surrounded by a sunbathing deck with loungers and a sunbathing lawn. The restaurant is close to the swimming pool. There is a bar and covered terrace, which offer a beautiful view of the swimming pool. 

On foot to the beach

The campsite Stella Maris is roughly a 300-metre walk from the Adriatic coast. You can walk there directly by using a tunnel beneath the roadway. Stella Maris Beach is a rather narrow, sandy beach along a small bay. The water is clean and stays shallow for some distance, so it is really well suited for young children.

properties.name: Camping Villaggio Rubicone
properties.description:
Camping Villaggio Rubicone is directly situated along a sandy beach on the Adriatic Coast. Situated in a lively area on the outskirts of the village. There are numerous sports facilities and there is an entertainment team with a daily comprehensive programme for children, teenagers and adults. In the vicinity you will find interesting art cities such as Ravenna. Around the corner is a large shopping centre and the well-known water park Aquafan Riccione.

The camping pitches are spread over the campsite. In addition, there are rental bungalows, mobile homes and even hotel rooms at the main building. The pitches are neatly demarcated with shrubs and trees, offering sufficient privacy.

Private beach

You reach the gate of the campsite via a narrow tunnel. Wherever you look there are colourful flower boxes. Within walking distance there is a 200 m wide private beach with ample free sun umbrellas for all guests.

The campsite has two swimming pools, a whirlpool and a separate toddler pool in a neatly maintained garden. It is surrounded by a park with enormous lawn. You can play all kinds of sports on the lawn, relax or put a piece of meat on the barbecue.

Free sports lessons

You can practice virtually all sports at Villaggio Rubicone. You can practice archery, play golf and volley ball in a separate area. At the front of a campsite, a well equipped fitness centre has been established. Free sailing, canoeing and surfing lessons are also offered.

Hungry after all these sports? Take a seat under the awning of the cosy terrace for an award-worthy pizza. The restaurant was awarded a prize in 2016.

properties.name: Camping De Rammelbeek
properties.description:
Camping De Rammelbeek is in Lattrop in the Twente region, next to a quiet stream in a wooded landscape. The campsite has two sections, which makes it an ideal home base for both families and those seeking peace and quiet. From here it is convenient to explore the Twente region and the German border area.

Basic pitch or gypsy wagon

Although the campsite is large, it does not feel huge. Choose a basic pitch with or without electricity and private toilet and washing facilities. Or go for a comfortable mobile home, an adventurous safari tent, or a luxury chalet, bungalow or gypsy wagon.

There are two zones at Camping De Rammelbeek: one for families with children and one for those seeking peace and quiet. This allows you to meet like-minded campsite visitors!

For families and those seeking peace and quiet

The quiet zone contains the campsite restaurant and a pond where you can cast your fishing line. Here you are also closer to the recreational pond, where you can relax. In the zone for families, enjoy the indoor playground, the petting zoo and the heated indoor swimming pool with wading pool and slide. This section of the campsite is designed especially for families with children up to 12 years of age. The amenities are located centrally to prevent young children from getting lost.

Discover Twente

Explore the Twente countryside on your bicycle or put on your walking shoes. Do visit the cities of Almelo, Hengelo and Enschede, all of which are within 35 km. The campsite is 500 metres from the German border, which means that an excursion to Germany is also easily made. Go see Bad Bentheim or Schüttorf (25 km), for example.

properties.name: Camping Union Lido Mare
properties.description:
Union Lido campsite is on a headland in the Adriatic, very close to Venice. It's not just a campsite: it's a five-star resort where you'll find much more than you ever expected. Treat yourself in the luxury wellness complex, enjoy yourself playing sports on one of the many sports fields, or eat all you can in one of the dining areas. And feel free to bring your dog: there's just as much to do here for him as for you.

Really fantastic, and very clean

Once you're on the campsite grounds, it's clear what you can expect: a fantastically well-cared for holiday park with a huge range of activities and options. The well-organised, friendly reception staff will quickly show you to your pitch, which you'll easily find for yourself later as there are plenty of signs everywhere. A large part of the campsite is car and bike free, so a safe environment for young children. The campsite has pitches that are about average in size, but also some extra-large pitches, with lots of privacy, space, and freedom to move around. You can also spend the night in all sorts of different rental options: luxurious mobile homes, bungalows, apartments and SunLodges.

Treat yourself

The campsite is just a stone's throw from a long private beach, so sunbathing or swimming in the sea is possible every day. Apart from the swimming paradise with a choice of water play equipment, slides, and the option to take part in water aerobics, the campsite also has a large wellness complex, where you can let all your stress just fall away. A solarium, sauna, and an aromatic steam bath are just a few of the thing in this very modern building. Treat yourself!

properties.name: Camping Finida
properties.description:
Campsite Finida is situated on the coast of the Istrian peninsula, the most popular holiday destination in Croatia. This small-scale campsite is well suited to both seekers of peace and quiet as well as hedonists. Here you are camping in a beautiful, serene setting: between trees and by the Adriatic. The beautiful surroundings attract nature lovers and the numerous small towns are great destinations for day trips.

Something for everyone

The camping grounds are uncluttered and as far as camping pitches are concerned there is enough choice to suit anyone's taste On the edge of the campsite you may be bothered by traffic noises. If you do not like this, try and get a camping pitch which is a bit further away from the road. By the sea, for instance: from there you have the best view in any case.

The Adriatic Sea

It is perfect for paddling or to go for a swim. 

Looking for something more exciting? You can also indulge in snorkelling, diving or windsurfing here. The campsite also has a jetty to moor your boat (should you have one).

Sunset

Do not expect any spectacular evening shows, professional entertainment teams or large playgrounds at campsite Finida. You come here for peace and quiet, just to unwind. With a glass of wine and a lovely meal from the campsite restaurant, overlooking the sea and admiring the crimson colours of the setting sun.

properties.name: Camping Yelloh! Village Algarve - Turiscampo
properties.description:
Turiscampo Campingclub Algarve is situated in the southwest of Portugal. This highly luxurious family campsite features beautiful accommodations and recently landscaped pitches. The mini supermarket has a broad selection of goods and the restaurant has an à la carte menu, a buffet and a special menu featuring local products. A varied entertainment programme is available every day. The Atlantic Ocean is a ten-minute drive away.

High quality

Everything on Turiscampo Campingclub Algarve looks well-tended. From the reception to the restaurant and from the camp shop to the beautiful greenery you see all over the campsite grounds. The camping pitches are also beautifully laid out on hard surfaces. The pitches vary in size, with a choice of pitches with and without shade. There are also mobile homes and bungalows available for rent. The sanitary facilities are of excellent quality. For the many guests who bring their four-footed friend along to this campsite, there is a separate shower area for dogs.

Facilities and entertainment

You will find various amenities on the campsite. For instance, a medium-sized camp shop and a bar-restaurant with a fine terrace. The menu is varied and affordable. The campsite also has a daily programme and an entertainment team that organises different activities each day. You can also create your own entertainment on the multi-sports ground or on the pétanque court.

Swimming pools

You will also find entertainment and relaxation opportunities in and around the swimming pools. Turiscampo Campingclub Algarve features an outdoor pool with a separate children's pool and a covered swimming pool which has been open since 2019. This pool can also be converted into an outdoor pool thanks to the sliding roof. The two swimming pools are centrally located on the campsite grounds, in the full sun and surrounded by loungers.

properties.name: Camping Klausdorfer Strand
properties.description:
The Klausdorfer Strand campsite is situated on Fehmarn Island directly on the German Baltic coast. The spaciously designed family campsite is uncluttered and overlooks the water from virtually every camping pitch. The tranquil and green surroundings are eminently suitable for cycling and walking and, being situated on the water's edge, the campsite is ideal for water sports enthusiasts.

The campsite is located in a green and tranquil setting and the natural and sandy beach of the Baltic Sea can be accessed directly from the camping grounds.

Camping pitches with sea view

The first impression of the campsite is uncluttered and well-tended. The campsite is divided into small fields with the sanitary facilities in the centre of the grounds. These are clean and well maintained with special facilities for the disabled. The camping pitches are spaciously designed, offer adequate privacy and virtually all overlook the water.

Child-friendly and sporty

The campsite is suitable for all ages, but in high season you will find mostly German families. There is a good deal of entertainment for children on the campsite (playground equipment, sports fields etc.) and on the beach of the Baltic Sea.

Furthermore, the campsite has an entertainment team for children up to 12 and for youngsters between 12 and 18. Situated directly on the water's edge, the campsite is of course also an ideal location for water sport enthusiasts, walkers and cyclists. And when you return from an active day on the water or on your bicycle? Then you can relax in the campsite's sauna with sea view or in the whirlpool.

properties.name: Camping La Presqu'île de Giens
properties.description:
On the Côte d'Azur on the Giens peninsula, you'll find the campsite La Presqu'île de Giens. A green campsite where you can take lovely walks and cycling tours, visit authentic villages and the beautiful sandy beaches are only walking distance away. Perfect for families with young children, but certainly also for older campers who want to enjoy the sun in the early and late seasons. Since 2021, a brand-new water paradise with slides and jacuzzis has been opened.

Camping on a peninsula

The campsite La Presqu'île de Giens is located in Hyères in the department of Var. The campsite is in a special place: the Giens peninsula. The road to the campsite is a trip itself. Two tombolos (connections to the land) make sure that the mainland and Giens are always connected. Between these land bridges, there is a bird sanctuary with animals including pink flamingos.

Separate campsites for tent campers and luxury accommodations

There are pitches for tent campers and separate pitches for campers with caravans or campers. If you come with a tent, you'll camp on the part on the terraces on a shady and car-free hill. Campers with a caravan or camper stay on another part of the grounds with paved roads. You can also camp in one of the many mobile homes or bungalows, some of which have air conditioning and running water.

Water fun and white sandy beaches 

The brand new water complex is a true water paradise. It consists of a very large swimming pool with several slides. For ultimate relaxation, jacuzzis are available. There is also a section especially for children. Next to the pools there are more than enough fine sun loungers in the sun and shade. Lifeguards are always present for everyone's safety. And disabled campers can use a special swimming chair to enter the water. In low season the water is heated, so you can enjoy the pools then too.

Still not enough water fun? There are beautiful white sandy beaches within walking distance from the campsite. Even though you'll never be bothered by the Mistral on the sand on the east side of Giens, wind and kite surfers love this strong wind on the west side of the peninsula.

properties.name: Camping Yelloh! Village Saint Pabu Plage
properties.description:
Between Cap d'Erquy and Cap Fréhel, right on the Emerald Coast in Brittany, the 5-star Yelloh! Village Saint Pabu Plage campsite welcomes you to a beautiful setting. You will camp on terraces overlooking the Côte de Penthièvre, 4 kilometres from the port town of Erquy. Enjoy the ocean, the Breton lifestyle and fun activities on and around the campsite, such as yoga, kayaking and beach volleyball.

Wake up by the sea

At Yelloh! Village Saint Pabu Plage, you will wake up to the sound of the waves.

The flat and spacious pitches are surrounded by hedges and offer peace and privacy. Not bringing your own camping equipment? Then rent a luxury accommodation. These mobile homes are located on the higher terraces. From here you have a beautiful view of the sea. Now that's a nice way to wake up!

Fun activities for the whole family

For water fun and relaxation, visit the indoor swimming pool with balneotherapy area. Your stay includes enjoyable extras such as electric bicycles, water sports equipment, beach chairs, a barbecue, and beach and outdoor games. All kinds of activities are organised, such as fitness sessions on the beach, yoga, Pilates, hiking, beach volleyball and sports tournaments. There are separate clubs for children and teenagers. Every evening is dedicated to fun with live concerts or shows. The campsite also has various facilities, including a panoramic restaurant, bar, bakery and supermarket.

Explore the surroundings

The surrounding area is characterised by rocky cliffs, small bays and wide sandy beaches. The campsite is in a quiet location and is a good base for nature lovers and water sports enthusiasts.

properties.name: Camping Zelena Laguna
properties.description:
Zelena Laguna Campsite is on the Croatian peninsula of Istria in the Adriatic Sea. This campsite offers lots of activities for (water) sports lovers, and the range of entertainment for young and old is large. Other amenities available here include: a swimming pool with a view of the sea, a beach, and two restaurants. Zelena Laguna is a great campsite for families. In particular, families with growing children enjoy coming here, although the campsite offers plenty of activities and fun for all ages. You won't just find families with young children here, there are also lots of young people who enjoy coming here.

Swimming pool with a sea view

The swimming pool (also great for kids!) with a sea view, the paved beaches with parasols and sunbeds (against payment), the small harbour with berths: Zelena Laguna campsite uses its beautiful location very well. Dive into the sea, or try your hand at boating (boats are available for rent). There's a huge range of watersports available here. For even more adventure, there's an inflatable obstacle course just off the coast.

Extensive entertainment programme

As well as the many water sports, you can also work up a sweat on dry land. And how. The sports centre has room for table tennis tournaments, volleyball, indoor football, basketball, handball and badminton. The campsite organises mini-Olympic Games for real fanatics, but there are also other sports tournaments. At this campsite, you really don't need to sit still for a single minute. There's plenty to do for the kids as well. The professional entertainment team can look after your children, entertaining them with games, craft mornings, dance evenings and performances.

properties.name: Camping Bijela Uvala
properties.description:
You will find this cosy family campsite on the Adriatic coast in the north of Croatia. You camp in pleasantly demarcated places or stay in one of the many rental accommodations. With the sea, four swimming pools, entertainment and sports facilities, there is plenty to do at Camping Bijela Uvala each day.

As soon as you arrive at the campsite, you will see at a glance that it is a large, cosy family campsite. But you also have privacy at your pitch, because the sites are shielded with bushes and trees. You also have water and electricity at your disposal at your site. It is also possible to hire a tent, mobile homes or deluxe Sun Lodges. Your neighbours at Campin Bijela Uvala are mostly families with children of all ages.

Entertainment

Children can entertain themselves throughout the day with workshops, games and sports. There is live music and entertainment in the evening for young and old. Various activities are also organised for adults, such as sports tournaments and morning work outs. Would you rather relax? Then you'll feel right at home in the special reading and photo nook or in the massage parlour.

Jetties

If you have your own boat, Camping Bijela Uvala is a true pleasure. This is because there is a a little harbour next to the campsite and there are a few jetties that belong to the camping ground. That way, you can explore the Adriatic coast in your own boat from the camping ground.

properties.name: Camping Puntica
properties.description:
Quiet fisherman's village and lively harbour town Camping Puntica is near Funtana, a little fishing village with various restaurants where you won't be run over by tourists. Just 7 km to the north of the campsite is the 2,000-year old Poreč, a lively harbour town with many mosaics and the Euphrasius basilica.

Drive to the south, and you'll be in Rovinj. There are magnificent Venetian houses here, as well as a Romanesque church. Vrsar is 3 km away, this town is known for the famous Giacomo Casanova and the many sculptures that can be admired here.

Between the pines and the sea

The camping ground is situated between the pines on a tranquil bit of a peninsula, surrounded by small islets. Here, you can find nature, beach, clear sea and a magnificent view. The campsite is on a smaller scale than the numerous camping grounds in the area.

The campers who come to Camping Puntica prefer to be a bit further away from the bustle. You won't find large swimming pools and children's entertainment here, but you'll enjoy the tranquillity and nature.

Stairs to the sea

The campsite is located right along the sea. The beach beside the campsite is partly grassy and partly paved or rocky. You can get in the water via a rocky beach or staircase. There is a separate beach for children. In the high season, a festive evening is organised every two weeks in the nearby harbour. You can catch some of the music from the campsite, but it is, of course, more fun to take a look for yourself.

properties.name: Horsens City Camping ApS
properties.description:
Horsens City Camping is located right on the fjord, near the town of Horsens, on the east coast of Midden-Jutland. You not only have a quiet lake with an unspoiled beach available, but there is also a lot of greenery and a forest bordering the campground. Horsens City Camping is the first campsite in Jutland awarded with the new “Green Campsite” eco-label.

Your campsite

Everything is well maintained and spacious with grass, hedges and trees. There are very quiet sites, places for families with children and sites with a view of the fjord. The campground has no paths, you drive over the grass. The rental accommodations - trekkers huts and bungalows - look well maintained.

Who will you meet?

A campground for all ages, for people who want to be in the forest, or less protected with a lake view. You'll also meet campers passing through. Children will have fun in the large playground with climbing equipment and the indoor playground and on the bouncy cushions and the go-carts.

Have fun in the water

The broad but not very long beach with nearly white sand is about 50 metres away. You can swim in the fjord from the dock, also suitable for smaller children. You can also canoe, windsurf and water ski. Great for kids: catching crabs from the dock.

Eating and drinking

Go to the shops in Stensballe to do your shopping. The campground offers ice cream, refreshing drinks and fresh bread. Instead of cooking by your tent or in your caravan, you can also use a communal kitchen. The sanitation is exceptional: spacious and clean. Also family sanitation facilities.

properties.name: Komfort-Campingpark Burgstaller
properties.description:
Komfort-Campingpark Burgstaller is a fully equipped family campsite near Lake Millstatt in Austria (Carinthia). The campsite organises many activities, like ghost walks, hikes through the countryside, and there is an Indian Forest. Children can shower in an actual pirate ship that used to fire its canons once every hour. Adults can enjoy themselves on one of the many dance floors, listen to live music or dance at the disco.

Lake Millstatt

Pitches at this campsite are equipped with a connection for television, wifi, drinking water and electricity. You never have to walk far from your pitch to get to cool water. Lake Millstatt is just on the other side of the road. At the lake, children can live it up with the water slides, trampolines and sandy playground. There is also a section set aside for the little ones where they can play freely. Naturally, there is also a sunbathing area to relax. Dogs have their own swimming section on the southern bank of the lake.

Live music, (children’s) disco and playback shows

You can participate in all kinds of activities at the campsite. For example, have you ever undergone a rejuvenation cure in the bog? Or mined for garnet gemstones? In the evenings, the restaurants are transformed and you can go dancing, participate in a playback show or watch a game of football. Young campsite visitors can also join in on the mini playback show, the children’s circus or the sports competitions of the children’s Olympiad. There is also a great indoor playground and a cinema.

Two restaurants

Delicious food can be had in either of the two restaurants. There is a pizzeria with delicious dishes on the menu where you can go bowling. There is also the Tennis-Camping Restaurant. Sample typical Austrian dishes here.

properties.name: Camping La Torre del Sol
properties.description:
Wellness resort La Torre del Sol is a campsite for the entire family. Situated directly on the Mediterranean coast, the campsite is a perfect spot for a sun and beach holiday. Fill your holidays with great swimming afternoons and treat yourself to a relaxing time in one of the many bubble baths or the hammam in the wellness complex.

A holiday paradise on the coast

Camping La Torre del Sol is located directly on the golden beaches of the Costa Dorada. When you drive northward along the coast, you will get to beautiful cultural cities such as Tarragona and Barcelona. These cities with their rich history and culture are definitely worth a day trip. Barcelona is only one and a half hours drive away, whilst Tarragona is less than 30 minutes from the campsite.

There are spacious camping pitches between all types of Mediterranean vegetation, from palm trees to olive trees, or directly by the water, separated from the beach only by a strip of greenery. For the demanding campers La Torre del Sol has different rental chalets, lodge tents and a unique and characteristic brick holiday cottage (called ‘El Maset’) with outdoor fireplace.

Wellness

The extensive swimming paradise confirms that campsite La Torre de Sol deserves the title of wellness resort. Between the palm trees you will find a large swimming pool, a toddler pool and immense bubble bath, which winds its snakelike way between the trees. The swimming pool is not only used for swimming; diving courses, water games and aqua fitness are also offered. There is a beautiful thermal bath near the pool.

properties.name: Camping l'Àmfora
properties.description:
Camping l’Àmfora lies on the Spanish Costa Brava, right on the coast and a few kilometres away from the village of Sant Pere Pescador. You can walk straight from this charming family campsite to the wide sandy beach to go for a swim in the Gulf of Roses. The campsite has amenities such as a large swimming pool complex, sports and games equipment, restaurants and an extensive entertainment programme during the high season. What is unique about this campsite is the pump track for skaters, the assault course and the trampoline park.

Something for everyone

Campsite visitors stay on well-kept pitches. These vary from standard pitches on grass to spacious comfort pitches with their own toilet and washing facilities and an outdoor kitchen. You can also spend the night in a luxury accommodation. The communal toilet block has disabled toilet and washing facilities and special toilet and washing facilities for children as well as dog showers. This campsite is also ideal for families with children of all ages. Not only toddlers but adolescents as well have a wonderful holiday with their peers.

Splashing in the swimming pool complex

Camping l’Àmfora has lots to do and experience for all ages. The sandy beach is right across from the campsite. You can have a great time swimming in the Mediterranean Sea here. The water depth increases gradually, which is ideal for young children. The large swimming pool complex with several swimming pools and water slides will provide hours of water fun. There is an aquatic park for the youngest campsite guests and aqua-gym for adults. In addition, there are dance nights, concerts and shows for the entire family. The campsite has several playgrounds and sports facilities such as a tennis court, a fitness park, a basketball field and a mini golf course. Another option is to follow surfing, kite surfing or diving lessons for a fee.

properties.name: Camping Lido
properties.description:
Camping Lido is a large, well maintained campsite on the southern east banks of Lake Garda , between the towns of Peschiera del Garda and Lazise. Lido lies directly on the lake and is a ten minute drive from the attractive and lively fortress town of Peschiera. The Garda Lake is popular with tourists for the contrast between the lake and the surrounding mountains. Furthermore, a large number of lovely villages and towns are located along the banks of the lake.

A neatly laid out campsite

Lido is neatly and well laid out; there is one wide access road with various side paths. It is an attractive and green campsite with beautifully laid out, spacious camping pitches. You can also rent mobile homes.

So much to do

The campsite attracts mainly families with children, especially in high season. The little ones really enjoy themselves here. The campsite has a complete water fun park with large slides. Even the very tiny ones have been catered for with a real baby pool where they can splash around. Furthermore, Lido has its own (pebble) beach at the lake. Especially in high season there is plenty of entertainment for young and old.

They have the necessary sports facilities (including a tennis court and fitness room). The campsite has a good restaurant with comprehensive menu, where you can enjoy a meal seated inside or outside with a view of the lake. There is a sociable small bar near the swimming pools for a refreshing drink or an ice cream. The campsite supermarket is well stocked.

Sanitary facilities

There are five ablution blocks in total which are kept very clean. These are easily accessible from all pitches on the campsite. Furthermore, it is possible to book private sanitary facilities.

properties.name: Recreatiepark Beringerzand
properties.description:
Campsite Recreatiepark Beringerzand in Limburg is aimed specifically at children. With an indoor playground, an extensive entertainment programme and camping fields divided up by age group, every child will feel happy here. There is also plenty to do in the surroundings. Take your children along to Toverland theme park, the Klein Zwitserland adventure park or to Limburgs Museum in Venlo.

For relaxing walks, you can go towards the River Maas or De Peel national park. The campsite is easily accessible via the N560 and the N275.

Comfort camping pitch or accommodation?

After a friendly and quick welcome, your camping holiday can begin. There are comfort camping pitches, but also luxury Lodge Tents and Finnish Kotas for rent. The campsite fields are divided up in children’s age groups, so they always have children of the same age to play with!

“Beringerbos”

It can rain on occasion during a camping holiday in the Netherlands, so the campsite has “Beringerbos”, an indoor playground and swimming paradise: a heated indoor pool with a toddler pool and an indoor playground with climbing frames, slides and bouncy castle. It is ideal for the little ones. In nice weather, you can swim in the outdoor pool. There is entertainment every day during the school holidays. A professional entertainment team organises sports tournaments, crafting afternoons and theatre shows and also a bat-themed week, autumn treasure hunts and many more educational activities.

A bite to eat

The campsite restaurant “Café Restaurant Patershof” with Pater Pannenkoek is also completely child-friendly. At Pater Pannenkoek you can eat the most delicious pancakes and at Café Restaurant Patershof you can enjoy lunch, brunch or dinner.

properties.name: Camping Holländischer Hof
properties.description:
Holländischer Hof is an elongated campsite on a narrow peninsula in the Mosel, just a 10-minute walk from the charming village of Senheim. On both sides of the Mosel one finds steeply sloped vineyards. Between the peninsula and the riverbank is a small marina.

View of the Mosel

The elongated, tapered campsite is divided into several narrow and wider areas separated from each other by hardened pathways. On one side of the campsite there is a dyke and the Mosel flows on the other side of the grounds. It is quite a large campsite. The grounds are flat and grassed with a number of high trees providing some shade. The camping pitches are numbered but not demarcated. The pitches vary in size, some with direct views of the Mosel.

Entertainment programme

Throughout the season there is a weekly changing entertainment programme for adults with hiking and boat tours, tastings and evening sing-a-longs. At weekends, school holidays and in the summer months July and August, there is also an activity programme for children. There is no swimming pool, but you are allowed to swim in the Mosel.

Pleasant terrace

The camping shop is well-stocked. This is convenient, as there is no supermarket in the village of Senheim. You can also have a bite to eat in the restaurant, which has a nice terrace. The sanitary building looks neat and is located near the reception. This is the only sanitary building. At the far end of the campsite is a large portable toilet truck. This means that, depending on the location of your pitch, you may have to walk quite a distance to shower or wash the dishes.

properties.name: Camping Les Coudoulets
properties.description:
In the southern part of the Ardèche you will find the child-friendly Camping Les Coudoulets. This green campsite is ideal for families with young children looking for a campsite with a relaxed family ambiance, yet with enough activities.

Camping pitches and accommodation

The spacious camping pitches (80 to 160 m2) are laid out on terraces. Much attention has been paid to plants and because of the luxurious vegetation, the pitches are wonderfully shady. The new pitches also have private sanitary facilities against a fee. The most beautiful pitches are to be found high above the river.

Swimming pool with aqua-bikes

There is a swimming pool complex for the whole family. There are aqua-bikes and bubble baths in the heated indoor pool. At the outdoor pools is a playful children's pool with several water slides and fountains in the shape of a snake and a cheerful clown.

Would you like to explore the Ardèche river? You can access the beach along the river via a gate on the campsite. The beach is covered with pebbles and sand and the river offers ample space for water fun. Canoeing, swimming, fishing for carp: it is all possible here.

Join Lenny de Vos

The campsite goes all out in terms of entertainment. The entertainment team speaks Dutch and French and, together with mascot Lenny de Vos, are ready for action in high season.

Special sanitary facilities for children

The comprehensive sanitary facilities are very special; here, too, the focus is on children. There is a family shower, the tiles are colourful and when the children take a bath, it looks like they are in a real canoe. There is also a special shower for your faithful four-legged companion.

properties.name: Camping Ca'Pasquali Village
properties.description:
The Ca' Pasquali Village campsite is located on the Cavallino-Treporti peninsula. When you arrive, you'll be greeted by the stern of the reception building, which looks like a ship. The association is not surprising: the campsite borders a wide sandy beach, and you can walk straight into the shallow seawater.

On to your holiday paradise

You will spend the night here on the sun-drenched Adriatic coast. It is pleasant, spacious and yet friendly. The road across the campsite runs parallel to the beach and the sea. Different streets to the left and right will bring you to your camping spot at the beach or in the pine forest. The touring pitches are in a quiet and easy to access location. There are also different types of mobile homes for rent.

Very nice for small children

This campsite gets tourists all year, mostly from Germany and Italy. Most people come with their families, including small children. We've kept these guests in mind with children's sanitary facilities and an extensive animation programme for all ages. This also applies to the large, centrally located water park. There are several slides, fountains and tipping buckets of water to keep you entertained. For the parents, there is a wellness pool, a competition pool and a solarium.

Walk to the beach

Of course, you also came to this campsite so you can swim in the sea. You can walk to the sea straight from the campsite. The water is shallow for a good distance which is perfect for children. The spacious restaurant is also right on the beach. The campsite supermarket is modern and has a wide range of products. The sanitary facilities are also very modern. The beautiful tiles and flowerbeds make you feel completely welcome.

properties.name: Caravaning Oyambre
properties.description:
You will find the friendly terraced campsite Caravaning Oyambre on a gently sloping terrain near the town of San Vicente de la Barquera. The sea is only 500 m away from the campsite. You are staying here on the quiet Costa Verde amidst a protected nature area.

Well-maintained campsite

At Caravaning Oyambre you will get a spacious demarcated pitch or a spot on an open lawn. The campsite is clean and well-maintained. The camping pitches have no or little shade due to the relatively young greenery. From the terraces, you have a beautiful view of the Picos de Europa. Permanent guests are accommodated in a separate area from the touring pitches. There are also some fifty beautiful bungalows on the campsite.

Delicious and affordable dishes

In the attractive restaurant, you can choose between dishes on the extensive menu or the menu of the day. The tasty three-course dinner is reasonably priced. You can enjoy your meal in the charming restaurant or on the cosy terrace. In the camping shop, you will find a limited assortment of foodstuffs (also fresh bread).

Swimming pool and palm trees

The swimming pool (200 m2) is flanked by palm trees. The adjacent toddler pool measures approx. 16 m2. Adjacent to the swimming pool you will find several loungers.

Surfing in the sea

The campsite has a sports field. A short walk through the fields will lead you to a lovely wide sandy beach and the sea. You will find may surfers here. Bodyboarders also love riding the waves. You can look for crabs between the rocks. Great excitement for children!

properties.name: Camping De Zwaluw
properties.description:
Near the wide sandy beaches of the North Sea, only a few kilometres from Den Helder, you will find Camping de Zwaluw. It is a small-scale campsite with spacious pitches without shade. The campsite is quiet and ideal for a beach holiday. Furthermore, the campsite is an ideal base for excursions in the area. It is located on the boundary of a vast nature reserve with wide beaches. The beach is only a 5-minute walk and Den Helder is approximately 7 kilometres away.

Spacious pitches 

As you drive to the campsite you will pass tulip fields and cross dunes. Driving past the coloured fields in spring is a glorious sight and at times you can even smell the hyacinths all the way to the campsite. The camping pitches on Camping de Zwaluw are spacious and open. Sun worshippers feel right at home here, because there are no trees on the campsite to provide shade.  You can also choose for a rental accommodation. There are plain mobile homes.

The playground on the campsite has been entirely renovated since 2016. They now have an air trampoline, slides and climbing frames. There is a playhouse for the little ones next to the reception. Did you bring teenage children along? Challenge them to a game on the beach football field. The beach and the sea are only a 5-minute walk from the campsite. A walk through the dunes leads you to the wide beach.

properties.name: Camping Los Escullos
properties.description:
Camping Los Escullos lies approx. 1 km from the sea in the Cabo de Gata nature area. In winter you can camp nicely in the sun and in summer shade will be created. The campsite is spacious and has many facilities, such as a swimming pool, fitness area and a restaurant. The campsite is beautifully located between mountain formations and volcanic rock, in a very dry and desert-like region with a large diversity of flora and fauna and unique salt lakes.

The camping is located between the towns of Rodalquilar and San Jose at half an hour's drive from Almería. In the area you can still find artefacts of ancient civilisations and in the -at times more than 1000-year old- villages, some of the traditional trades are still being practised.

Sun in winter, shade in summer

Because the temperature in this area of Spain is pleasant throughout the year, you will find many hibernators on Camping Los Escullos. The campsites are laid out in such a way that they are in the sun in winter while in summer shade is provided in the form of shade cloth. The pitches are separated by hedges and trees and all have electricity.

Loungers under the palm trees

Camping Los Escullos has a swimming pool with a separate children's pool and jacuzzi. The swimming pool is surrounded by loungers and in peak season there are Balinese daybeds, which you can reserve. The large outdoor swimming pool and jacuzzi are open during high season. Check with the reception for times outside the high season.

properties.name: Camping und Appartements Seehof
properties.description:
There is lots to do both in summer and winter on Camping Seehof and in the vicinity. Camping Seehof is beautifully situated on the Reintaler Lake with a view of the mountains of Tyrol. You will recognise the entrance of the campsite by the wooden cottage near the access road. This is the reception. The campsite is partly laid out in terraces and the camping pitches are demarcated. Because most pitches are open, you have a magnificent view of the mountains around the campsite and of the lake.

Warmest lake in Tirol

From the campsite, you can easily walk to the Reintaler See, one of the warmest lakes in Tirol and ideal for swimming. You can also rent a boat and view the picturesque landscape from the water. You are also allowed to fish here with a fishing permit.

Things to do

During school holidays there is an entertainment programme for children, but throughout the year they can enjoy themselves in the play area or on the trampoline in the playground by the lake. At the Streichelzoo, the petting zoo on the campsite, they can take care of the goats, for instance.

Upon arrival at the campsite, ask for the ‘Alpbachtal Seenland Card’. With this card you have free entry to many activities, for instance, museums, swimming pools and use of the regional bus.

Dining with a spectacular view

The restaurant on the campsite has a large sun terrace with a view of the Reintaler See and the mountains. Do you have a sweet tooth? Try the home-made cakes, torts and do not give the Apfelstrudel a miss.

properties.name: Camping Mas Patoxas
properties.description:
Mas Patoxas campsite is located on a hilly estate on the coast of the medieval town of Pals. Mountains, beaches and beautiful bays surround this neat family campsite on the Costa Brava. Mas Patoxas has all the ingredients to give you a fantastic holiday with this great location and excellent facilities.

Siesta in the shade

You can choose a small or a large pitch on this large terraced campsite with wide paths. There are plenty of shady spots under the many trees here where you can take a delicious siesta. Don't have your own camping equipment? You can also stay in one of the campsite's fully equipped mobile homes or bungalows.

Two swimming pools

If you like swimming, you will find plenty to do at Mas Patoxas campsite. With two swimming pools, a paddling pool and the sea nearby, it will be a holiday full of water fun. You can swim in the special pool for adults. There is a large restaurant with a terrace overlooking the large swimming pool. Here you can order a pizza, hamburger or delicious Spanish paella!

Sports entertainment

In addition to playing football on the unpaved football pitch or throwing around a basketball, you can also try your hand at the popular racket sport of Padel at this campsite. There is a kids club for young children, and for the older youth, there are all kinds of fun activities. There are playgrounds for children of all ages and children can also play inside the campsite. In the evening, fun music shows provide entertainment for young and old.

properties.name: Camping Mareblu
properties.description:
Camping Mareblu is an attractive campsite with convenient location in popular Tuscany. The Mediterranean can be reached via a pretty footpath through nature. You then reach the beach which belongs to the campsite. The area around Marina di Cecina is part of the Etruscan Coast, which has a rich history. Interesting towns such as Volterra, Florence, Pisa and Siena are within easy reach for a day's outing.

Pitches in the pine forest

You will always find a pleasant pitch with shade on one of the lawns or along one of the streets at Camping Mareblu. The pitches are not demarcated which creates a lovely sense of freedom. At the front of the campsite, there are several types of rental mobile homes. They are all located between trees and come with all amenities and with their own wooden deck.

An exciting treasure hunt

Camping Mareblu accommodates many families with children of all ages. Therefore, there are ample activities for them to take part in. There are craft afternoons, sports competitions and there is a dance club. Young adventurers can put their name down for a treasure hunt or enjoy themselves on the climbing equipment in the playground.  

The spacious swimming pool on the campsite is a popular place for young and old. Thanks to its rectangular shape, it is ideal for swimming a few laps each day. As is the custom on many Italian campsites, bathing caps are required. There is also a small children's pool.

properties.name: Camping Le Prahay
properties.description:
Close to the village of Poupehan, the Semois river meanders through a magnificent landscape of woodlands and forests. Campsite Le Prahay is the very first campsite you will get to from the village. Here you camp in an oasis of greenery and tranquillity. With its takeover in 2018, a young Dutch couple has breathed new life into the campsite.

Green, greener, greenest

The camping pitches are very generous in size. When the campsite is not fully booked, you can choose a pitch near the river where the occasional tree will provide some shade. Alternatively, you can choose a spot a bit further away from the river on a separate tent area. Wherever you camp, you have a view of the surrounding forests. 

Camping in a rental tent

What to do if you want to spend your holiday here but do not have a tent or caravan. Then simply rent one of the accommodations. You can choose from a safari tent, lodge or tree house. All are fully equipped for a wonderful holiday.

Sports activities in and on the river

On Campsite Le Prahay you leave the hustle and bustle of city life behind you. Enjoy reading a good book while the children keep themselves busy in the river with a bucket and landing net. If you like to cast a line, don't forget to bring your gear along. Please note: you need a fishing permit.

You can also 'take on' the river by kayak. You can hire a kayak some five hundred metres along from the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Les Medes
properties.description:
This typical Spanish campsite is located in a beautiful spot on the Costa Brava. You camp within walking distance of the beach. Camping Les Medes is praised for its friendly staff and its sanitary facilities that are always kept spic and span. You will be staying at a small family-run business here, so the contact is very personal. The site is located two kilometres from L'Estartit and 4 kilometres from the Parc Natural del Montgrí.

A shady place

The camping pitches are demarcated and small-scale. More spacious spaces are also available. You can camp in the shade on the pitches, because there are plenty of trees on the site. There are also various bungalows accommodating from two to four people. The campsite is well maintained.

Close to the beach

The swimming pools are located at the front of the site: an indoor pool, an outdoor pool and a children's pool. A bathing cap is mandatory in the indoor pool. For campers with reduced mobility, the large outdoor pool has a hoist. The beach is only 800 meters from the campsite. So you can easily walk or cycle there. Part of the beach is also accessible for dogs and the campsite has a dog shower area.

Delicious Spanish dishes

Time to feast. The restaurant serves Spanish dishes of a high standard. You can choose a menu or eat à la carte. You can also pick up takeaway food there. There is also a snack bar-pizzeria and a small supermarket where you can buy fresh bread.

properties.name: Sportcamp Woferlgut
properties.description:
Snow-capped mountains in winter, green meadows in summer; the Sportcamp Woferlgut area looks like a postcard picture all year round. The vicinity of the campsite is crammed with sports activities, such as skiing, cycling tours, zip-lines for children and swimming a few lengths in the natural lake. You can enjoy delicious local specialities in the restaurant.

At the foot of the Großglockner, the highest mountain in Austria, lies Sportcamp Woferlgut. The campsite is not far from the attractive town Zell am See, the lake by the same name and the village of Kaprun.

Refreshing dive

Feel like cooling down? There is plenty of water around! The campsite swimming pool is lovely and heated and from the pool, you have a stunning view of the mountains of the Hohe Tauern National Park. On the other side of the road is a lovely, natural swimming lake with large sunbathing lawn.

Sporty holiday

The campsite is well-equipped for a winter sports holiday. There is a shuttle bus service to the piste from the campsite. After a lovely day of skiing or cross-country skiing, you can dry your ski equipment in the drying area, where you will also find a special ski boot heater.

The campsite is affiliated with Roadbike Holidays and has all the amenities for enthusiastic racing cyclists who are not afraid of climbing. At the reception, you can ask for more information regarding training, gear and cycling events in the region. At least once a week a cycling group departs from the campsite with a cycling expert.

properties.name: Camping Playa Bara
properties.description:
You will find this wonderful camping resort with spa on the sunny Costa Dorada, an hour's drive from Barcelona. As it is located right on the coast, a dip in the sea is never far away. Camping Playa Bara is located in a beautiful green pine forest with a botanical garden. The park is neatly laid out, well maintained and has abundant facilities, including a tropical swimming pool and an amphitheatre. The spacious camping pitches offer campers plenty of privacy. And for those who prefer to rent, this campsite offers stylish mobile homes and bungalows.

In the shade of a pine tree

Do you like being surrounded by nature? Then you can indulge yourself at this campsite. Here you will be camping in the shade of hundreds of pine and palm trees. The camping pitches have a solid foundation, are spacious and offer plenty of privacy thanks to the vegetation. The sanitary facilities are neat and thoroughly cleaned. They also undergo regular maintenance. There are special children's sanitary facilities for the youngest guests.

Tropical waterpark and amphitheatre

There is a beautifully landscaped, partially heated swimming pool. The round pool is surrounded by lush vegetation and palm trees. There are many sun loungers around the pool where you can warm up in the sun. Want to unwind even more? Relax in the jacuzzi or enjoy a massage at the spa. Special activities are organised for campers of every age. The youngest guests will have a great time in the mini club where they can take part in crafts, face painting and dancing. There is a junior club for older children and teenagers as well.

properties.name: Campingpark 'Ostseebad Rerik'
properties.description:
Campingpark Ostseebad Rerik can be found in the North German region of Mecklenburg-West Pomerania close to the Baltic Sea. Here you camp on neat, demarcated camping pitches. You can also stay in the rental accommodation. This beautiful area is great for hiking, cycling and windsurfing. The campsite is a half-hour drive from the motorway. At Campingpark Ostseebad Rerik you camp on the grass. A few pitches are in the shade, but most of the pitches enjoy the full sun. For a fee, you can have the convenience of a water connection at your pitch. It is also possible to camp in a mobile home or a luxury tent. This campsite is set up as a quiet family campsite and it is mainly families with young children who come here.

Beach

The shingle beach on the Baltic Sea is only a few minutes’ walk from the campsite grounds. Do keep in mind that you have to go down some steep steps on your way to the beach.

A holiday means relaxation

At Campingpark Ostseebad Rerik you can fully relax during your camping holiday. After a day at the sauna, some yoga and a massage, you can end the day at the campfire. On Saturdays, and also on Wednesdays in the high season, the fire is lit with a grill on top so you can roast marshmallows over the fire.

Medieval towns

At cycling distance from Campingpark Ostseebad Rerik there are lovely medieval towns such as Rostock and Wismar. In Schwerin, a little further away, there is a fairy-tale castle that is still in use today. Admire the splendour and wander through the immense castle gardens.

properties.name: Camping Le Cormoran
properties.description:
Camping Le Cormoran is the ideal basis for anyone interested in the Invasion of Normandy. Visible traces of this are never far away; the campsite is even directly located along the invasion beach, Utah Beach. It is just a matter of crossing the road. Le Cormoran is a well-organised, spacious campsite where you will find an international crowd. In addition to the historical aspects, the campsite and surrounding area are excellent for camping fun with an abundance of sun, water and sports/games.

Well maintained and comprehensive campsite

This campsite, which is easy to reach, is located on a flat site with lovely grass. Le Cormoran is a well laid out, neat and comprehensive campsite. Close to the reception you will also find tourist information, a shop, bar and take-away pizzas. The roads over the campsite are signposted so that you can easily find your camping pitch.

Comfortable camping pitches

The spacious pitches (approx. 100 m2) are level with well maintained grass. They are often separated from each other by hedges. There are also larger fields with each approx. 10 pitches. You have a choice of several comfort pitches. You can also rent mobile homes. The historical area is certainly a contributing factor for the public that chooses this campsite; history fanatics from all corners of the world stay at Le Cormoran to visit D-Day museums and commemoration sites.

Sports/games and good facilities

There are ample sports, recreation and wellness facilities. Enjoy yourself on the outdoor fitness equipment, various bouncers or the spacious sports fields. The swimming pool has a covered and outdoor section. Obviously, they also have a toddler pool. A grocery shop is present on site and take-away pizzas are made on the evening.

properties.name: Camping Sunêlia l'Hippocampe
properties.description:
Campsite Sunêlia l’Hippocampe is located in the town of Volonne, in the heart of Haute-Provence and on the river Durance. The typical Provençal landscape with lavender fields, sunflowers and olive trees surrounds the property. L'Hippocampe is a large family campsite with many excursions and activity programmes for all ages. There is a water park with two large heated pools, a kiddie pool, five water slides, a sunbathing area with lounges and a jacuzzi. Since 2024, the campsite has an additional area with pitches of 100m², 130m², 170m², and 260m². It includes a private reception with a shop and bakery, a beach bar, a sports field, and a 3400m² lagoon.

Plenty to experience

Sports, fun and activities are the key words at l'Hippocampe. The activity clubs are divided up by age: there are children's clubs for mini kids aged 4-9 and for children aged 9-13. These are both open in July and August. Workshops, cooking lessons, treasure hunts and performances are organised. For teenagers aged 13 and over there is the Teens club, with all kinds of sports tournaments, creative workshops, pool games and a weekly show. A special feature is that many activities take place in a yurt.

Fishing and canoeing

At the location of the campsite, the river Durance is so wide it has created a lake. You cannot swim in this lake, but you can fish. Also fun: take a water bike or canoe out onto the water. The sites are reasonably spacious, primarily flat and on grass.

The campsites with electricity are located in a orchard and are intended for tents and pop up campers. The comfort sites for caravans and campers (and also tents) have individual water and waste lines. You can also pitch a little tent for free on all sites. For campers, there is also a camper stop with a service area available for a special rate.

properties.name: Camping De Somerense Vennen
properties.description:
In the convivial Noord-Brabant, half an hour's driver from Eindhoven, lies campsite De Somerense Vennen. Surrounded by woods and moorland you feel like you are camping amidst nature. The last part of the route to the camping takes you past meadows and trees, which only enhances the natural atmosphere of the campsite. The village of Someren is within cycling distance: ideal to do some grocery shopping and to get fresh rolls in the morning.

Camping on the edge of the woods, with a view of the cows or close to the beautiful swimming pool; there are all kinds of beautiful pitches in various sizes on the campsite. The great holiday feel spills over into the Spanish chalets, which are fitted with a lovely massage shower, three bedrooms, and French doors opening onto the terrace with picnic table.

Fun under cover

In inclement weather it is nice to make use of the indoor facilities. They certainly have taken this into consideration at campsite De Somerense Vennen. There is a beautiful, indoor and heated swimming pool for lots of water fun for young and old. There is a separate children's pool for the tiny ones.

Not only is there an indoor swimming pool, there is also a large indoor playground and sandpit with zip-line where children can play and romp all day. But why stay inside, when nature awaits you outside? The campsite is situated in the middle of woods and a stone's throw away from the Someren moorland. Perfect for a cycling trip, walk or horseback riding. The stables on the campsite have a few horses for riding.

properties.name: Camping Les Sables
properties.description:
Campsite Les Sables is situated some three hundred metres from the coast of the Atlantic Ocean, slightly south of the harbour town La Rochelle. You can explore the old harbour of La Rochelle, the salt creeks in the area and the marshes of the Marais Poitevin regional natural park. With its large swimming paradise, the campsite is an excellent spot for the entire family.

Spacious pitches

The camping pitches are interspersed with mobile homes over the elongated camping grounds. Paved roads guide you to your camping pitch, which is brightened up by flowerbeds and is shaded by a tall tree. All pitches are sufficiently large for your car and caravan or for a motorhome. As the pitches are separated from each other by large hedges, you will enjoy ample privacy.

Swimming fun galore

The swimming paradise is located near the entrance of the campsite. This water park is guaranteed to offer swimming fun for the entire family. What can be found here? A beautiful covered swimming pool (which lets the sun in through a retractable roof), an outdoor swimming pool with large, winding water slides, a shallow pool and a spacious whirlpool. And with the Atlantic Ocean only five minutes away, there is even more water fun to be had.

Diverse area

There are endless activities to keep you busy in the vicinity of campsite Les Sables. For instance, you can explore the marshland of the Marais Poitevin by canoe (forty minutes by car), and the Ile de Ré is an excellent cycling area with beautiful harbours and salt creeks. The historical theme park Le Puy du Fou, located an hour and half's drive away, is a wonderful experience for children and a veritable tourist attraction. Also fun for children: Natur’Zoo de Mervent, a zoo at an hour's drive from the campsite.

properties.name: Camping de Peyroche
properties.description:
Here you'll be camping in the heart of the beautiful Ardèche, within walking distance of the picturesque village communes of Labeaume and Ruoms. Campsite de Peyroche is a beautiful, friendly French campsite for families looking for a real camping experience. The river that meanders past this campsite, located in the south of this green region, is an ideal place to take the kids for a swim. Everything is neatly arranged, but simple and not overly busy. The beautiful mobile homes, the new restaurant, the country store next to the campsite and the fun activities for children make for a relaxed destination with many nearby attractions.

Camping in the Ardèche

Campsite de Peyroche is located between Valence and Avignon, in a rural setting surrounded by vineyards. You'll likely encounter the owner, Mr. Champetier, at the small reception building. About 300 metres away, you'll also find a sandy beach where you can go swimming in the River Beaume. And those who enjoy walking and cycling can discover the most beautiful routes from the campsite.

Pitches along the river

The pitches situated along the long lanes differ in size and surface type. Sun or shade, both are possible. There are also 25 pitches overlooking the large field by the river. All pitches always have trees nearby and are demarcated with shrubs or plants. The sanitary facilities are neat and tidy. One building has been refurbished and the other has been completely renovated. Would you like to sleep in a furnished mobile home with air conditioning and a private bathroom? There are three different types to choose from.

properties.name: Erlebnis Resort Aufenfeld
properties.description:
The family-friendly Erlebnis Resort Aufenfeld is located In the Tyrolean village of Aschau. This large campsite offers camping pitches, wooden mobile homes and apartments. The campsite is ideal for children and teenagers, but also for their parents. There is a wide range of (organised) activities and facilities, including a wellness centre and a Western village.

Fun and relaxation in the water

This campsite is ideally suited to families with children. Teenagers will have fun here too. There's plenty of water fun. There is a landscaped swimming pond with a waterfall, wooden bridge, and spacious sunbathing area. On cold days, you can quickly get warm again in one of the two heated indoor swimming pools (water temperature 30 degrees Celsius). And if you've always wanted to know how quickly you can zip down the water slide, try the 60-meter-long water slide with a timer here.

Welcome to the Wild West

The Wild West comes to life in the summer with the Western town 'Mount Lake City'. Take a ride on a pony, drink a whiskey in the 'Old Mule Bar', or enjoy a delicious piece of meat in the steakhouse. While the real daredevils fight the mechanical bull, fortune hunters can learn the art of gold prospecting.

Ideal for winter sports enthusiasts

In the winter, you can rent skis and snowboards at the campsite. There are discounted family packages especially for families,. The free ski shuttle leaves from the campsite, and for the little ones there is a practice lift right next to the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Pascalounet
properties.description:
Pascalounet campsite is situated in La Couronne near Martigues. A town with a rich history and numerous cultural sites already embraced by painters and artists, but increasingly also by tourists. The limestone cliffs, white beaches and turquoise water of the region form a magnificent piece of nature. From 2012, the calanques (partially submerged valleys) along the coast between Marseille and Cassis are named Parc National des Calanques.

The camping is managed by the grandchildren of the founder. This makes it a real family campsite. The camping pitches are separated by hedges and have a gravel-hardened surface with an area of at least 70 m2 each. You can opt for a place in the sun, shade or a bit of both.

Accommodation

If you do not bring your own camping equipment, you can rent accommodation. At Pascalounet campsite, the bungalows are situated on the hills overlooking the pine trees. The mobile homes are near the beach or in a beautiful spot between the trees. There is additional accommodation with the comfort of a mobile home, combined with the charm of campsite as the terrace is covered with canvas.

Beaches

The beach is only a 100 m walk from the campsite and is easily accessible. The nearest beaches are La Saulce and Sainte Croix. These are surrounded by small calanques and pine trees. In cooperation with a number of partners, the campsite offers various water activities such as stand-up paddling, sea kayaking or waterskiing.

properties.name: Camping L'Artaudois
properties.description:
The quiet campground L'Artaudois is located to the east of the picturesque city of Toulon. This terraced campground is located about 1 km from the Mediterranean Sea in a Mediterranean pine forest with a lovely view of the surrounding area. On the terraces you'll find defined sites which are sufficiently large to spacious. The campsites get a range of shade from the trees. There are well furnished mobile homes to rent on the campground.

Cool off!

The outdoor swimming pool (350m2) and kiddie pool are central on the campground next to the Mediterranean forest. You'll find the sand and pebble beach about 1 km away.

Archery

The activities at the campground are fabulous. You can participate in organized walks. You can also play table tennis, practice archery and use the sports field. For children and adults, there is an entertainment programme in French every day. The mini-club, four times a week, is also offered in French. You don't even have to speak French for games in the pool, or for football or volleyball.

Fresh produce

In the charming Provençal village of Pradet, about 1 km away, you'll find shops and the weekly market with local products. Every morning there is fresh bread available on the campground. In the high season there is a snack bar and pizzeria open on the campground.

Smugglers Route

The Chemin des Douaniers is 1 km from the campground. This 52 km route runs from Six Fours to Giens. In earlier times, this was used to watch smugglers. Currently it is a lovely coastal walk.

properties.name: Camping Errota - El Molino
properties.description:
At approximately half an hour's drive from Pamplona lies campsite Errota - El Molino on the Arga River. The campsite has an indoor and outdoor swimming pool and a restaurant where you can order regional dishes. The campsite is situated just outside the village of Mendigorría, some 25 kilometres from the city of Pamplona in the Navarra region. This region is unique in Europe, because three climate zones come together here: the Alpine, Atlantic and Mediterranean, creating a remarkable mix of flora and fauna.

Stars and deer in Pamplona

In addition to Pamplona, with its historic citadel, Santa Maria cathedral and a plethora of restaurants, is Puente la Reina, with its Roman bridge and location on the pilgrimage route, definitely worth a visit. You can also make some nice day trips with children in the vicinity; visit the gardens of la Taconera in Pamplona, where you will find deer, peacocks and swans, or discover the world of astronomy, stars and the universe in the Pamplona Planetarium.

Camping fields and demarcated pitches

When you drive towards the campsite, you recognise the entrance by the white mill. Have you brought your own camping equipment to Camping Errota - El Molino? If so, you can choose to stay on a large camping field without demarcation, with grass surface and shade in places. If you prefer a bit more privacy, you can choose a demarcated pitch. These pitches have a grass surface, water drainage, electricity and lots of shade. When you stay on the campsite a bit longer, you can request a water connection for an additional fee.

properties.name: Camping Cala Llevadó
properties.description:
The Cala Llevadó campsite is situated between Tossa de Mar and Lloret de Mar (Costa Brava). The family that established this site in 1959 still manages the site. The location of the terraced campsite is glorious: on a slope and almost right on the sea. All kinds of activities are organised for young and old: sports and games, music and magic shows and an obstacle course. After a long day you can relax at the campsite's great restaurant.

Steep campsite by the sea

The Cala Llevadó campsite lies on natural terrain which consists of several terraces. There are separate pitches for tent campers, caravans and motorhomes. The pitches all vary in size due to the trees and steep slopes of the terrain. Many of the tent pitches overlook the sea. The numerous pine trees, cork oaks and carob trees mean you will be guaranteed a camping pitch in the shade. 

Wide range of rental accommodation options

In addition to the usual camping pitches, the campsite boasts 72 wooden bungalows. These are suitable for two to six persons. Some of the rental accommodation units overlook the sea, while others have a view of the Cadiretes forest. 

To the sea or to the swimming pool

From the campsite a steep path with a few rock stairs lead to the beach. There are three small bays (one of which is for naturists). It is a haven of space and tranquillity: the bays are less accessible for non-campsite guests. Don't like the feeling of sand between your toes? If not, you can simply dive into the swimming pool on the campsite! From the swimming pool you can see the sea down below. There is a separate pool for the little ones.

properties.name: Camping & Bungalows Roche
properties.description:
Camping & Bungalows Roche is located in a pine forest in Andalusia. The camp site is situated in a quiet part of the Costa de La Luz close to Conil de la Frontera and the beaches on the Atlantic Ocean. In the vicinity are numerous wonderful hiking and cycling routes and the cities of Sevilla, Vejer and Cádiz can easily be reached from the site.

Shade in summer and sun in winter

Campers with a caravan or camper have a choice of special spots. These are generously sized and have a flat surface. The spots are shady and there are a number of secluded places. Each pitch comes with electricity, water supply and drainage.

In addition, there are wooden bungalows in a separate area of the camp site which can accommodate five persons. They have two rooms, a kitchen, bathroom, terrace and parking space adjacent to the bungalow.

Overwintering in Spain

Camping & Bungalows Roche is a real family camping during the summer months. In winter this camping is home to many overwinterers. Because of the moderate climate the temperature is very pleasant for the most of the year.

The camping has an outdoor swimming pool with a separate children's pool. Next to the pool are deckchairs for you to enjoy.

Outdoor fitness and sports facilities

The camp site has a range of sports facilities. There is a tennis court, a padel court, ping pong table and an outdoor fitness facility with various fitness machines. Furthermore, it is ideal for jogging and walking in the pine forest. There are organised games for children.

properties.name: Camping Nautic
properties.description:
Campsite Nautic is situated on the east coast of Spain on the Mediterranean. On the wooded terrain of the campsite there are mainly pitches. You will also find a large swimming pool and a toddler pool, a restaurant which serves Catalan dishes and a beautiful sanitary building. Here, in the heart of the Gulf of Sant Jordi (patron saint of the region), the azure blue water of the Mediterranean and the bright green pines are awaiting you. The campsite is located next to the fishing village L’Ametlla de Mar, where the riches of the Catalan kitchen are in evidence in several restaurants.

Peace

Seekers of piece and quiet are definitely fans of Camping Nautic. There is a tranquil atmosphere on the campsite, you will definitely not find a action-packed holiday and entertainment here. However, the campsite is suitable for families. Although there is no entertainment, there is plenty to do for children. They will enjoy themselves in the playground.

Dying for a swim?

Looking forward to swim a few lengths in refreshingly cool water? The campsite has a large swimming pool and a children's pool, from where you have a view of the sea. The entire family will enjoy the water and the beautiful panorama here. You can sunbathe on the lawn next to the swimming pool, which is partly shaded by pine trees. If you are dying for a good swim, you can, of course, also make your way to the Mediterranean in no time at all.

properties.name: Camping La Plage
properties.description:
Campsite La Plage is situated along the coastal road between Saint-Jean-de-Monts en Saint-Hilaire-de-Riez. This large four-star campsite is pleasantly crowded in the high season. There are many mobile homes and tents available for rent, but you can also pitch your caravan or tent here. The pitches are situated on grass and are separated from each other by mid-height hedges.

Children's paradise

At campsite La Plage, you will mostly see families with children of all ages. It's no surprise that there are all sorts of activities for the children, especially in the high season. There is a mini club and entertainment for both children and teenagers, as well as a water park. This is a real swimming paradise, with heated indoor and outdoor pools, beautiful lagoons, various water slides and a whirlpool. The paddling pool with fun water jets is also heated. 

Beach and ocean

It's just a three hundred-metre walk to the sandy beach of the Atlantic Ocean from campsite La Plage. From the campsite entrance, you follow a small footpath through some woods to the dunes and the sea. The old tower on the camping grounds is clearly visible from the dunes. That way, you know which campsite is the right one when you return after a day at the beach. In this area, where the campsites are situated so close together, this will certainly come in handy. 

Entertainment for everyone

All our guests are catered for: there is not only entertainment for the children but also for teenagers and adults. You can join in with various excursions and there is entertainment almost every night. One night it could be a disco and the next day live music, karaoke or bingo.

properties.name: Camping Des Gorges
properties.description:
In Saint-Martin, directly located by the Ardèche River, you will find the quiet campsite des Gorges. However, it is not just the river where the water fun is to be found. The campsite also has a 200 m2 swimming pool, surrounded by palm trees and sun umbrellas. Canoeing on the river is highly recommended. The canoe trips start from the campsite. Enjoy your drink and a bit to eat in the evenings at the renovated camping restaurant with a view of the area.

Camping with a view

There are pitches in various sizes. Whichever pitch you choose, you will always be assured of ample shade from the poplars and acacias on the camping grounds. At the perimeter of the campsite you will find even quieter pitches as well as pitches with a lovely view of the hilly landscape. If you want some extra comfort, you can rent one of the new mobile homes for 5-7 person which are fitted with a dishwasher.

Refreshment galore

Life is not easy for water enthusiasts at this campsite. With a large outdoor swimming pool with children's pool and the Ardèche river within walking distance, it is really hard to decide where to spend the afternoon cooling off. At night the swimming pool is beautifully illuminated and during the day you have a lovely view from there because of the height difference. The sun umbrellas and palm trees ensure sheltered seating. In high season a lifeguard keeps an eye on things.

The Ardèche river has deep and shallow parts, so that young and old can enjoy the water. Tip: bring an air mattress to float down the river.

properties.name: Camping Le Nid du Parc
properties.description:
Birdwatchers can indulge in their passion in the vicinity of Camping Le Nid du Parc ; the flat area with numerous shallow lakes halfway in Eastern France is home to some 400 bird species. The landscape in this region is idyllic, indigenous and varied. An ideal spot for seekers of peace and quiet, nature explorers and outdoor sports enthusiasts. The campsite therefore attracts an international public.

Beautiful grounds

The campsite along the Chalaronne river (swimming prohibited) has a park-like design. Deciduous trees and conifers provide shade and the hedges around the spacious pitches guarantee ample privacy. If you want to rent something there is an abundance of choice: (lodge tents and tepee tents, trekker huts and Pipo mobile homes).

Municipal swimming pool

On the campsite is an outdoor swimming pool and next to the campsite is a municipal swimming pool. Some 30 km further on, there is a lovely swimming lake.

Excursion programmes

There is a plenty to do on the campsite. Enjoy yourself in the playground, on the sports field or in the facilities for bad weather (with TV and games). Next to the campsite you will find a tennis court. No inspiration at the moment? Children can join the entertainment programme and there are excursion programmes for adults. Satisfied and exhausted after your day? At night you can regularly join a (theme) dinner, barbecue or music concert.

Take-away meals

You can order daily fresh bread. At a distance of some 1.5 km, on the outskirts of the town, you will find a supermarket. The campsite has a restaurant with a small menu, where you can get snacks and take-away meals. For a more elaborate dinner you can walk to the nearby Villars-les-Dombes.

properties.name: Pausado Camping Les Tamaris
properties.description:
Fancy a holiday on a quiet campsite on the popular Côte d'Azur? Campsite Les Tamaris in La Couronne on the Côte Bleue, just west of Marseille, is the campsite for you. You camp here on a small bay and near rocky and sandy beaches. This small campsite’s facilities include a heated outdoor pool with paddling pool and entertainment for the whole family.

Pitches and accommodation

Les Tamaris has a clearly laid-out campsite, where paved paths lead to the accommodation and sunny camping fields. The touring pitches are clearly separated and have hard surfaces. Various types of pitches are available, including a number of tent pitches. Some are car-free. Modern chalets and mobile homes for two to six people are available too. Are you coming as part of a bigger group? Then book a stay in the double mobile home with shared terrace.

Family fun in the pool
