The campsite has a great foodtruck bar that serves cocktails and savoury snacks, and a heated swimming pool. Take a refreshing dip, while the little ones have fun in the paddling pool. There is also a colourful playground for the youngest visitors. Fun activities for young and old are organised during the summer holidays. End the day by taking part in a fun themed evening or enjoying surprising evening entertainment.

Beach and city

A holiday on the Côte Bleue is a delight for beach lovers. There are a number of beaches around the campsite bay. Beautiful coastal walking routes and the cities of Martigues (14 km) and Marseille (37.5 km) are all nearby.

properties.name: Pausado Camping Le Luberon
properties.description:
Campsite Le Luberon (some 10 acres) is located in green surroundings with lots of forests. This is the northern part of the mountain massif of the same name. The town of Apt lies at a distance of only 500 m south-west from the campsite. In the hilly surroundings of the campsite you will find numerous lavender fields, vineyards and picturesque villages. However, the campsite is also ideal for unwinding. Take a dip in the pool, play a game of pétanque or head for the restaurant.

Quiet camping amidst greenery

Le Luberon is reminiscent of a real forest. Hence, ample shade! The generally very spacious camping pitches are located on hard soil with lots of grass. In addition to the camping pitches, there are rental accommodation units (mobile homes, bungalows, apartments and lodge tents).

A lovely dip in the water!

Head for one of the two swimming pools on the campsite for a refreshing dive. These are not excessively large, but they are heated (from April to September). The setting is very attractive, with yellow and blue loungers around the pools. From the swimming pool you have a splendid view of the rock in the village of Saignon. 

Entertainment for the whole family

In high season there is a entertainment team (in French). Join in the swimming pool games, various workshops and sports tournaments. Furthermore, you can play a game of table football, pétanque and table tennis. Young children can play to their heart's content on the play equipment in the sand pit. You can go for wonderful walks directly from the campsite. Prefer some rest and relaxation? Settle into one of the hammocks. These are spread across the terrain.

properties.name: Camping Cap-Blanch
properties.description:
The Costa Blanca: beautiful bays, picturesque villages, gorgeous mountain landscapes, a lovely climate, plenty of sunshine, and good food. This is the setting for Camping Cap-Blanch. The campsite is simple yet beautifully landscaped and with plenty of charm. In the summer, sail shades are thoughtfully suspended over all 277 pitches so that everyone can keep their cool in the shade. Cap-Blanch is located directly on the Costa Blanca, with a large white pebble beach.

Tent or...?

The spacious pitches (80-120 m2) are surrounded by plants and various types of broad-leaved trees. The best pitches are located in the front of the campsite. All the pitches have electricity and a WiFi connection. Cabins and bungalows are available for rent, ranging from tiny to large enough for five people, and from very simple to well-equipped.

Sun, sea, sand and swimming!

You will not find a swimming pool here. That makes sense, considering you have the azure blue sea right at your doorstep. Simply cross the road across from the campsite and you'll be standing on the boulevard and at the water's edge. Loungers and umbrellas are available for rent on the beach. You can go windsurfing and water skiing here.

Restaurant and sanitary facilities

The campsite does not have a shop, but there are supermarkets in L'Albir (six-minute drive). The restaurant next to the campsite (with a light menu) has a patio with gorgeous views of the sea. The sanitary facilities are very clean but somewhat dated. The sanitary facilities are closest to the pitches located in the front part of the campsite. There are special facilities for children and a large area with sanitary facilities for the disabled.

properties.name: Camping Le Neptune
properties.description:
Campsite Le Neptune is on the river and close to the Mediterranean Sea. A campsite with a beautiful pool and various sports facilities. Leave the campsite to explore the beautiful region of Languedoc-Roussillon. The campsite is on the shores of the Hérault, only 2 kilometres from the Mediterranean Sea. On this campsite, you can swim in the pool or show off your athletic talents on the multisport field or the fitness room. The campsite is ideally located for going on fun trips in the area.

A lot of space

The campsite has been managed by the same family since 1972. Campsite Neptune is a flat campsite where all camping pitches have a surface of at least 100 m2. They are covered in grass and delimited by oleanders, hedges, and bushes. Many areas enjoy a lot of shadow and have electricity.

The campsite also offers a variety of mobile homes for rent. All types of accommodation are for 4, 5, or 6 people and have a kitchen, a sitting area, bathroom, and separate toilet. The more luxurious mobile homes also have air-conditioning, microwave oven, fridge with freezer, and a TV set. The big advantage is that there is a lot of space around, so that you can also park your car next to the mobile home.

Water everywhere

The river Hérault flows by the campsite. You are not allowed to swim here, but you can fish without a permit. You can swim on the campsite itself. There is a beautiful swimming pool with a toddler area.

properties.name: Pausado Camping Pegomas
properties.description:
Camping Pegomas, situated in Saint-Rémy-de-Provence in the department of Bouches-du-Rhône, offers an authentic Provençal experience. This family friendly campsite is at walking distance from the historic centre of Saint-Rémy-de-Provence, ideal for culture lovers and nature enthusiasts. The area is perfect for walking and cycling trips, with the Alpilles mountain range (9 km) nearby.

Well-maintained pitches and accommodation

The campsite offers just under 100 well-maintained camping pitches, demarcated and accessible via unpaved paths. For a more comfortable stay, there are 12 modern mobile homes and two vintage caravans available.

Dogs are welcome

Camping Pegomas is extremely dog friendly, with amenities, such as a dog shower.

Sunny outdoor swimming pool with playground and bar

One of the highlights is the sunny swimming pool, complete with a colourful water playground. Sun loungers, parasols and a sunscreen are available around the swimming pool.

The campsite has a lovely pool bar, where you can enjoy drinks and snacks. There is a mini library and a games cupboard as well as a food truck and breakfast service in the high season. There are supermarkets and shops within a kilometre of the campsite.

Well-maintained toilet and washing facilities

There are three well-maintained toilet blocks on the site, with amenities such as hand basin cubicles, showers, hairdryers, washing machines, a dryer and a baby bathroom. Two of these buildings are heated outside the high season.

Saint-Rémy within walking distance

Saint-Rémy-de-Provence, within a short walking distance, is a charming town with Roman ruins, churches, museums, galleries and city gardens. The town is known for its weekly Provençal market. Other nearby attractions are Les Baux-de-Provence, Maussane-les-Alpilles, Arles, Avignon and the famous Pont du Gard, all within a 30-to-45-minute drive from the campsite.

properties.name: Pausado Camping Relais du Léman
properties.description:
Camping Relais du Léman is on a forested slope by Lake Geneva, just outside the quiet town of Messery (Haute-Savoie). Here, you camp at only a few hundred metres from the banks of the famous lake. In Messery, you will find a lovely beach from where you can swim in the lake. Furthermore, this campsite is a great base for day trips to, for example, Geneva, Lausanne, the French Alps and the medieval town of Yvoire that is only five kilometres away.

Shaded site with touring pitches, mobile homes and chalets

If you would like to stay the night at this campsite, you have various accommodation options. First, there are dozens of tourist pitches. They are spacious and demarcated by natural elements. As well as on a shaded pitch, at Camping Relais du Léman you can book a stay in a modern mobile home or wooden chalet.

Swimming pool

Right behind the reception, you will find the lovely outdoor swimming pool that adorns Camping Relais du Léman. This campsite also has a lovely playground, a sports field and a jeu de boules court.

Takeaway a delicious meal from Chez Titi

If you like eating takeaways every so often while on holiday, walk to Chez Titi Pausado. This small restaurant is located in the same building as the reception. Chez Titi has a modest menu with tasty dishes prepared with fresh, local ingredients.

properties.name: Pausado Camping La Vallée Heureuse
properties.description:
Camping La Vallée Heureuse is situated in the middle of a green valley near the village of Orgon. The area surrounding the campsite features impressive rock formations, making the campsite a unique spot for camping. As you approach the campsite, you will be overwhelmed by the flora and fauna and the views of the Alpilles. Just close your eyes and smell the wild thyme, rosemary and lavender which grows all around the campsite.

With your own camping equipment, rented tent or mobile home

The camping pitches which are divided across various terraces, are at least 70 m2 and have boundaries marked by hedges and bushes. The pine and oak trees provide sufficient shade. All the pitches have access to electricity and there are various water taps on the campsite.

Would you like to try camping in a tent, but you're not sure whether it's right for you? In that case 'ready to camp' at Vallée Heureuse is just the thing for you. You can, for a fee, make use of a pyramid tent. This allows you to camp in a tent without having to buy one.

People looking for peace and quiet, nature lovers and families with children

Campers who are looking for peace and quiet and nature lovers have come to the right place at campsite La Vallée Heureuse. This is also a fine spot to visit with children.

Camping La Vallée Heureuse features an outdoor swimming pool with poolside loungers. Right next to the campsite is a lake where you can go swimming and fishing. Or go boating in a small boat or canoe.

properties.name: Camping Yelloh! Village Le Club Farret
properties.description:
Camping Le Club Farret is a luxury holiday village directly located at the fine sandy beach of the Mediterranean, near Vias-Plage. In the vicinity there is an attractive promenade with lots of shops, bars and restaurants. You do not have to leave the campsite for entertainment, because Club Farret offers all facilities a camper could wish for. Two swimming paradises, a private beach club on the beach and a shopping street with a well-stocked supermarket.

Camping in a green village

The campsite has been laid out as a village with different neighbourhoods and a shopping street. Everything is meticulously maintained on the campsite. The grounds are green with palm trees and Mediterranean plants and exude an exotic and luxurious ambiance. The spacious, neatly laid out camping pitches are surrounded by palm trees and hedges. There are dedicated areas for motorhomes with suitable amenities.

Club Farret offers a large choice of very luxuriously furnished mobile homes and cottages, which are located in various 'neighbourhoods'. They each have a different theme, ambiance and matching decorations.

Water sports and swimming fun

Club Farret borders directly onto the sandy beaches of the Mediterranean Sea, where you will find a private beach club. This is also the right place for a number of water sports facilities. The beach can be reached via a guarded access point at the camping pitches. There are two swimming paradises on the campsite: Pirate Bay (in Caribbean style) and Tao Beach (in Asian style).

Great shopping and food

Not just a simple campsite shop here, but a whole shopping street! There is a vast supply of products: a lovely range of bread products at the bakery, good quality fresh (barbecue) meat from the butcher and fresh vegetables and fruit.

properties.name: Pausado Ludo Camping
properties.description:
The peaceful and small-scale Ludo Camping is situated along a wide, shallow brook and is very suitable for families with children up to 12 years of age. The swimming pool, entertainment and a stream with waterfall will give them hours of enjoyment. In the region, you will find the old town of Aubenas perched high on a rock. The lively Vallon-Pont-d’Arc is only a thirty minutes' drive away.

Terraces with a view

There is great variation in elevation on the campsite. This means two things: a stunning view from your pitch and a steep walk up and down to get to the facilities. On the higher level, the pitches are smaller (100 m2) than they are below (160 m2). All pitches are located along streets on terraces and have a hard surface and much greenery. Some pitches are demarcated with hedges. Would you like to hire something really unusual? Sleep in a lovely tepee tent.

Waterfall

A shallow river with small swimming lake runs along the campsite. Perfect for children to build dams, catch fish and jump down the waterfall. There is also a heated, rectangular outdoor pool with a sunny terrace, loungers and a toddler pool.

Canyoning

There is a basic playground and a volleyball court. In high season entertainment is provided (treasure hunt, scavenger hunt and music on the square). Adventurous activities such as abseiling, paragliding and canyoning are organised in the area for adults.

Snack bar with ice cream

The supermarket on the campsite has a limited assortment of groceries and daily fresh bread. A small wooden building houses a snack bar with a small terrace where you can buy snacks, drinks and ice cream.

properties.name: Alannia Guardamar
properties.description:
Alannia Guardamar is located in Guardamar del Segura, Alicante. It is one of the best equipped resorts in Spain and is designed for families, especially those with small children or babies, who are looking to spend their holidays in a cosy and peaceful environment. It also enjoys an average annual temperature of 20ºC, which is ideal for camping lovers.

The establishment has a camping area with more than 80 pitches, glamping tents and a resort area with more than 100 bungalows, all types of accommodation are fully equipped with the necessary amenities. And this experience can be enjoyed with pets as they are welcome.

It has a wide variety of services and facilities: entertainment, outdoor swimming pool, spa, gym, heated pool, massage room, mini club, teen club, sports areas, playgrounds, supermarket, restaurants, night shows...

It is only 900 metres from Los Tusales beach, a beach of fine golden sand, surrounded by pine trees and dunes. Guardamar has great attractions: in addition to its 14 kilometres of beach, it has parks and a rich history.

The town also offers all kinds of water sports as well as cycling routes for the whole family along the banks of the Segura river, the pine forest and the port.

properties.name: Alannia Costa Blanca
properties.description:
It is one of the largest campsite resorts in Spain, thanks to having more than 1000 pitches (4 types: Comfort, Comfort Tahiti, Luxe and Premium) and more than 200 bungalows, creating an unforgettable holiday.It has one of the most spectacular water parks in Alicante, an enviable temperature all year round and a wide variety of facilities and services: supermarket, gym, spa, swimming pools with slides, outdoor and heated pools, restaurants, bars, mini club, teen club, games room, playgrounds, petanque, mini golf, sports facilities, barbecue area... And much more!

It is very close to large urban centres, such as Elche or the city of Alicante and its surroundings stand out for the number of sporting, leisure and cultural activities that can be done.

All this means that boredom is not an option at Alannia Costa Blanca, where there is also a great entertainment team which offers activities and games for all ages every day of the year. You can find: shows, workshops, outdoor activities, dances in the pool... In addition, adults can also enjoy entertainment with specific activities such as: relaxation and fitness workshops, tastings, tastings, themed dinners...

And that's not all. To relax and unwind, there is a spa and wellness area with all its services: saunas, massages and gym and a variety of gastronomic options in their restaurants where you can taste a wide range of Mediterranean and international cuisine.

Water everywhere

You won't have to worry about getting overheated on Alannia Costa Blanca with its water park of 5000 m2. You can swim among the hippos and the elephants, there are large water slides for the ultimate splash, and there are fountains everywhere. The beach is not far away; a daily shuttle bus runs between the campsite and Playa Los Tusales. Sometimes it's just wonderful to feel the sand between your toes, to build sandcastles and, above all, to enjoy the salty sea air and water. The campsite will be happy to take you there.

properties.name: Hello Soleil
properties.description:
Fancy a great nature holiday in the beloved Ardèche, with a quiet campsite as your base? If so, head to Hello Soleil near Lablachère in southern Ardèche. This site is surrounded by vineyards and forests; the campsite is a great starting point for beautiful walking and cycling trips. Various medieval towns and extraordinary cave systems are a short drive away. This small campsite's facilities include a heated outdoor swimming pool, a restaurant and a shop.

Camp in a pine forest

Love to holiday in a natural setting? Located in a pine forest, this campsite offers plenty of variety with its playfully-shaped camping fields, varied planting and many flowers. There are a number of terraces, with no steep climbs. Campers camp on well-kept touring pitches of about 100 m2. Modern cottages, mobile homes and safari tents are available too. Fancy a really special experience? Then book a stay in a squirrel hut, a cosy camping cabin or in the glass dome, from where you can enjoy the clear starry sky at night.

Large heated outdoor pool

Hello Soleil has a large outdoor pool, 20 m long and 10 m wide, and a paddling pool too. Solar energy heats the swimming water to a pleasant temperature. Next to the pool, you will find a good restaurant, where you can enjoy dishes including a tasty pizza, burger, paella, cocktails and desserts. The campsite also has a shop with basic necessities and local produce.

Paradise for hikers

There are wonderful hiking and mountain biking routes through the forests. You will pass beautiful viewpoints and clear rivers, fun for canoeists and kayakers too.

properties.name: Camping Alannia El Pinar
properties.description:
The good weather guarantee and the golden yellow beaches of the Costa Brava are all you need for a wonderful holiday in the sun. From the wonderfully quiet family campsite Alannia El Pinar you can walk straight to the beach without crossing a street or road. This campsite in the lively fishing village of Blanes is also an excellent base for fun trips to two of Catalonia's most beautiful cities: Barcelona and Girona.

Vibrant location, peaceful campsite

The campsite is located near the lively nightlife area of Blanes. But because the campsite is at the end of the street, it is nice and quiet here. You can choose between a beachfront camping spot or a poolside camping spot. There are spots with shade and spots in the sun. Those who would like a larger pitch can reserve a comfort pitch. Guests without their own camping equipment can stay in one of the rental accommodations such as a luxury mobile home or safari tent.

Sun, sea, pool

While this campsite obviously has a fantastic seaside location, there is more water fun to be had. The swimming pool is also the perfect place for a dip. The pool is clear and has a separate area for the little ones. Along the shore, you can read or lounge on one of the sunbeds.

In addition, the bays of Sant Francesc and Santa Cristina are wonderful places to spend the day. For spectacular slides, visit one of the amazing water parks in the area. The welcoming staff at the reception will be happy to tell you more about it.

properties.name: Camping La Garenne
properties.description:
Camping La Garenne is in the green heart of the Ardèche. It is a charming, medium-sized family campsite. The campsite is located in the beautiful Eyrieux river valley, in the centre of the Ardèche department. A beautiful part of France that hasn’t been overrun by mass tourism yet.

Camp in a quiet valley

Camping La Garenne has 119 camping pitches, incl. comfortable mobile homes & luxury safari tents with private toilet/washing facilities. The site is on two levels, in a quiet valley surrounded by hills and woods. Perfect for peace seekers, families and active holidaymakers. The pitches are varied: some are flat, others are on playful terraces. Every pitch has electricity and is suitable for tents, caravans or motorhomes; parking space often on or near the pitch. Due to the rocky ground - typical of the Ardèche - rock pegs are often needed. These are available at reception.

Splash in the large pool

There is a large 320-m² swimming pool on site, with a separate paddling pool for little ones and plenty of space to relax. In high season, an enthusiastic entertainment team organises fun activities for children: from crafts and pancake baking to live bingo, fox hunting and the popular moonlight swimming.

Feeling hungry after an active day on holiday? On the Bistro's sunny terrace, enjoy fine wines, cold beers and tasty meals, in a homely atmosphere where you’ll feel right at home straight away. The owner’s Indonesian evening has been a highlight for years: enjoy authentic dishes like rendang, gado gado and saté. Prepared with love!

properties.name: Chiemsee Strandcamping
properties.description:
In the south-east of Bavaria, not far from the Austrian border, lies the clear blue Chiemsee, the largest lake in Bavaria. A wonderful destination for water sports enthusiasts, mountain hikers and cycling enthusiasts. At the modern Chiemsee Strandcamping you camp right on the water. The bonus: beautiful sunsets over the lake! Strandcamping is located on a narrow strip directly between the road and the lake, two kilometres from the town of Chieming.

Camping on the lake

The first thing you notice is the fantastic location of this campsite. The camping pitches are located directly on the water and you have a beautiful view of the lake and the mountain landscape of Bavaria. The modern, new and clean sanitary building deserves a special mention. It might just look nicer than your own bathroom.

For active holidaymakers

The campsite is quite small in size with some 90 pitches for touring campers snugly arranged in about three rows by the water. The pitches can be a bit on the small side for large caravans and motorhomes. In the summer months, this beautiful spot can also fill up quickly and it is sometimes a bit busy. But the general feeling of the place is very friendly. Due to its location in Bavaria, close to the motorway, this campsite is also used as a transit campsite for a holiday in Austria.

Swimming and boating

In summer, the Chiemsee is a popular swimming location. From the campsite you can walk directly into the water from the gravel beach for a refreshing dip. Swimming shoes are a handy tip for the little ones.

properties.name: Camping Le Coin Tranquille
properties.description:
In the east of France, just a little way from the Italian and Swiss borders, and between the towns of Chambéry and Lyon, you'll find the friendly Le Coin Tranquille campsite. The peaks of the Alps offer a stunning backdrop for campers. Here, in the heart of the Isère region, nature plays a leading role.

Flowerbeds with colourful flowers

Le Coin Tranquille campsite appears spacious, well cared for, and friendly. The flowerbeds with colourful flowers lend a little something to the atmosphere. The flat, bucolic grounds are landscaped with plenty of greenery. There is a panoramic view of the mountainous surroundings from several of the camping pitches. In the centre of the campsite, you'll find the reception, the restaurant - which has a terrace - and the swimming pool. The road through the campsite separates the terrace from the rectangular heated swimming pool. At busier times, the swimming pool is the liveliest place at the campsite. Small children can splatter around in the toddler pool. If you'd like to sunbathe after your swim, there are sunbeds to use.

Chef's theme evening

In the peak season, the chef organises theme evenings. Guests can sign up for a delicious barbecue, or a rich paella. On other days, there's an extensive menu with all sorts of local produce that's worth trying. The spacious restaurant is well-regarded due to its high quality, reasonable prices, and the atmospheric design with wooden ceilings.

Bouncy Castle

Le Coin Tranquille campsite is one of the most child-friendly campsites, according to the organisation Kids Campings (Campsites for Kids). This is why many of the campers who stay here in the summer are families with young children, including many Dutch families.

properties.name: Camping Joan
properties.description:
Approximately 100 km south of Barcelona you will find the quiet, child-friendly family campsite Joan, close to the historic former fishing village of Cambrils. The campsite is located right at one of the most beautiful sandy beaches of the Costa Dorada. This spot is ideal for campers who like to enjoy Spanish beaches in peace.

Tall pine trees

The grounds look well kept with pitches of varying size. There are numerous mulberry trees offering ample shade, but you can also opt for a pitch in the sun. Note to owners of campers: quite a few pitches have low hanging branches. Want to hire something? There is a vast range of different mobile homes, studios, apartments and bungalows.

Water aerobics

The cosy, round swimming pool is especially suitable for children to cool off. It is also ideal for water aerobics, swimming a few lengths is more difficult, unfortunately. You will find nice wooden decking around the swimming pool and there are ample sun loungers with the odd sun umbrella here and there. The sea close to the campsite is suitable for children: the vast beach slopes gently into the sea. Breakwaters provide calm water.

Cycle-friendly

There is a playground for children and lots of entertainment for all ages. You can also use the fitness room and there is a choice of massages. Walking and cycling enthusiasts will be very happy with the number of trails in the area.

Good food

The campsite restaurant has an extensive menu with good quality dishes. From the restaurant you have a nice view over the campsite. Just outside the camping grounds you will find more eating establishments, with a sea view as a bonus.

properties.name: Alannia Els Prats
properties.description:
Alannia Els Prats is a camping resort located in Miami Platja, Tarragona. In the heart of the Costa Dorada, it is an ideal destination to spend a family holiday and enjoy all the activities and facilities on offer.The location by the sea makes Alannia Els Prats the perfect resort for all those who want to be surrounded by nature and enjoy a wide variety of nearby activities such as a day of attractions at Port Aventura, just 15 minutes from the resort, enjoy great beaches, hiking and cycling routes or discover the history of Tarragona and its municipalities.

The establishment has a camping area with more than 200 plots, distributed in 4 typologies; and a resort area, with approximately 150 cabañas (bungalows) distributed in 7 typologies and studios. With facilities prepared to cover all needs: gym, spa, supermarket, bars, restaurants, sports courts, mini club, teen club, games room, children's playgrounds, picnic area... It also has a swimming pool area with spectacular slides, a children's area and a play area with water jets.

Large, blue giraffe

Tiny swimmers can amuse themselves in a toddler pool with a large, blue giraffe. Next to the toddler pool is a spacious swimming pool with waterfalls and slides, as well as a large bubble bath. From this bubble bath you can catch a glimpse of the Mediterranean Sea.

Lively campsite

Alannia Els Prats is a lively campsite. It offers an extensive entertainment programme (with mini club, kids club and active programme for teenagers). There are also plenty sports opportunities on the multi sports field and and in the fitness area. Furthermore, you can book a padel court to acquaint yourself with this dynamic variant of the tennis sport (at a fee). Last but not least, the entire family will enjoy the theatre shows, film evenings and sports tournaments.

properties.name: Camping Le Beaulieu
properties.description:
Camp site Le Beaulieu is situated in the French Charente-Maritime region. The camp site is close to the town of La Rochelle, where you can stroll through the scenic streets or along the old harbour to taste the atmosphere of the town. In close proximity to the camp site you will find the Île de Ré island which is linked to the mainland via a toll bridge.

There are open spots at Camping Le Beaulieu where you can pitch your own camping equipment as well as spots that are (partly) sheltered by hedges. Hence you can choose a spot which is partially shaded or a spot in full sun. During peak season, the camp site is patrolled by a night watch. There are also various rental objects.

Dive into the pool or into the ocean

The camping has a spacious and heated swimming pool, which can be partially covered. Convenient when the weather is not at its best, you can still enjoy your swim. There are deckchairs around the swimming pool to enjoy those sunny days. There is a play area with water spouting toys/equipment for toddlers and a separate paddling pool. For the older children there is a fun slide and water aerobics is offered in summer.

The place for entertainment par excellence: L’Ami Temps

At the centre of the camp site lies the restaurant L’ Ami Temps that serves rolls, pizzas, chicken and fries and ice cream for dessert. In the evenings, campers gather at L'Ami Temps as this is the central meeting spot for entertainment and socializing, especially in peak season with paella evenings, musical disco and karaoke evenings.

properties.name: Camping Village de la Guyonnière
properties.description:
The five-star Village de la Guyonnière campsite is a campsite for the whole family situated in pristine countryside on the French Atlantic coast. Campers are assured a fantastic time on this campsite. You can camp on very spacious camping pitches or in a glamping tent, go swimming in one of the pools, feed the animals or take part in sporting activities. It's a complete campsite.

Natural harmony

The campsite has reached real harmony with nature. The campsite has not laid any tarmac roads or paths or built concrete buildings, instead opting for sandy paths and for leaving everything as nature intended, where possible. In exchange, campsite guests can enjoy as much of the unspoilt nature as they want.

The campsite comprises large, open grassy fields, partially shaded by trees, and some of the pitches are at different heights. This provides for beautiful views over the campsite. The spacious camping pitches, which average 225 m², provide open views and plenty of space around your tent. Accommodation has been spaced out with grassy patches in between, and nothing is arranged in rows. This gives you plenty of space and freedom in which to move.

Swimming pool and sea

The swimming pools are next to the campsite entrance — one indoor heated swimming pool (with toddlers' pool) and one outdoor swimming pool with slide, toddlers' pool and wild water slide. Plenty of space for cooling off! Plus, taking a dip in the Atlantic Ocean couldn't be easier — you can be at the coast in just fifteen minutes by car.

properties.name: Camping Le Clapas
properties.description:
Campsite Le Clapas lies directly on the Ardèche river. You camp here with the famous, very touristy Pont d'Arc and the impressive Gorges de l’Ardėche ‘just around the corner’. A truly fantastic campsite in the south of France. The English speaking owner is very helpful and hospitable.

Former municipal campsite

Around 2005 Le Clapas was still a municipal campsite. Subsequently, the camping was taken over by private owners. They planted trees and used stones from the river to construct walls. The many trees on the slightly sloping terrain now provide shade and create a park-like feel. Everything looks well cared for. 

The camping pitches measure between 75 and 100 m2. There are basic pitches for tent campers, who do not need electricity, as well as comfort pitches with electricity connections and even a well.

Snacks and barbecues

In high season a pizza delivery or snack van visits the campsite three times a week. Be sure to join the barbecue or meal (with regional products) prepared by the owner once a week. 

Swimming and kayaking

With its setting on the bank of the Ardèche, Le Clapas attracts many canoeists and kayakers The campsite jetty is an added attraction for kayak and canoe owners. With the river a stone's throw away, you will not miss a swimming pool. This is certainly the case when you see that there is an idyllic pebble and rocky beach. 

Furthermore, guests can enjoy themselves on the camping grounds with a game of volleyball or soccer. And if you like horse riding or paintballing, you can do both at about 5 km from the campsite. More information is available at the campsite reception.

properties.name: Camping Des Grottes
properties.description:
Nestled between the mountains, with the caves of Niaux within walking distance, it's instantly obvious how Camping Des Grottes acquired its name. Located beside a small river, with amenities such as a large swimming pool and a wide choice of children’s animation, it's the ideal place for a relaxing camping holiday. As well as large pitches, the campsite has many rental options for comfort seekers.

Optimal comfort Set up your tent or caravan under one of the large trees on the grounds, or add a little extra comfort by booking one of the campsite’s rental options. The campsite has many different chalets and mobile homes to choose from. Some of the chalets even accommodate eight to ten people. All of chalets and mobile homes have a nice covered veranda, where you can enjoy meals together or relax with a book.

Splash!

When you walk towards the campsite pool, you won't fail to notice the large water slides. With four slides to whizz down to the bottom, there's enough room for everyone. There is also a paddling pool and fun fountains for little ones to enjoy. And plenty of room to sunbathe by the water.

Caves of Niaux

You can probably guess how Camping Des Grottes gets its name. The caves of Niaux are a stone's throw from the campsite and visible from the campsite. They are well worth a visit, if only because of the fascinating pre-historic paintings.

properties.name: Camping Dolce Vita
properties.description:
The amiable, quiet campsite Dolce Vita is beautifully situated in woodland within walking distance of the beach and the sea. At only 4 km away you will find the beautiful town of Calvi, a highlight on the North-West coast of Corsica.

Campers with camping equipment exceeding 3 m in height use a separate entrance, the other guests drive underneath a bridge to get to the modern reception. The camping pitches are spacious, shaded and separated with stones. On the grounds are new chalets and mobile homes for rent. The campers come from all over Europe and consciously choose a campsite without entertainment. Many Italian regular guests in particular return to Camping Dolce Vita each year.

To Calvi by train, boat or on foot

From the campsite, you cross the river with a pontoon before following the path to the sea and private (pebble) beach. Near the campsite is a jetty for guests with their own boat who sail down the river to the sea and to Calvi. It is a 30-minute stroll to Calvi along the sea. You can also go to Calvi by train, there is a rail track near the campsite.

Pizza

On the campsite are a playground, sports fields, a jeu de boules pitch and a table tennis table. You can also go on horseback and pony rides in the vicinity. Fishing is possible in the river. The restaurant offers a wide choice, including pizzas and snacks. You can order fresh bread and croissants and basic foodstuffs are available.

properties.name: Strukkamphuk-Fehmarn
properties.description:
On the German island of Fehmarn, just across the Fehmarnsundbrücke, you will find the family campsite Strukkamphuk-Fehmarn. This campsite is suitable for young and old. The area is excellent for walks and cycling trips and there are plenty of things to do on the campsite. There are theme days for children, there is a skate track, a beach volley ball field and you can attend (kite)surfing lessons. Sailing boat owners can moor their boats near the campsite.

Strukkamphuk-Fehmarn is located in a lovely waterfront setting with a view of the bridge and the surrounding forests. The campsite is located just behind the dyke. The sea and beach are directly behind the dyke, ideal for cooling down on a hot summer's day. A bit further along you will find the small town of Burg auf Fehmarn, where you can go for a nice meal at night. You will also find the museum about the island here.

Sea, beach and surfing

The campsite is virtually surrounded by water. On one side of the campsite is an elongated beach and there is even a separate beach for dogs. The natural beach is well kept and cleaned of seaweed, so that you can enjoy a clean beach at all times.

Campfire on the beach

Children really enjoy the entertainment programme at Strukkamphuk-Fehmarn. What is better than taking part in a theme day and walk around all day dressed up as an Indian or pirate? In the evenings a campfire is lit on the beach or a show is presented in the Kaspeler theatre. For older children there is billiard table and skate track.

properties.name: Camping Jonio
properties.description:
Close to Catania, on the rocky coast of the Ionian Sea, you will find the medium-sized terraced campsite Jonio. The campsite extends at the foot of Mount Etna. The centre of Catania is some 5 km from the campsite. The campsite is very popular because of the beautiful view of the sea and its tranquillity. The campsite is located near a quiet residential area.

Camping with a sea view

Campsite Jonio (1.2 ha) is located in a wooded area. There are eighty touring pitches on the grounds. You have a choice of a pitch with more or less shade or even in the sun. Please keep in mind that the surface of the terraced campsite is mostly hard. The most beautiful pitches have seaview. Ideal to watch the sunrise. Camper vans and caravans are parked on a terrain with beautiful view of the cliffs and the waves. 

The well equipped bungalows and mobile homes stand relatively close together. Yet, you have ample privacy.

Swimming, windsurfing and snorkelling

You can reach the sea and rocky coast via a flight of stairs. There is no beach, but you can swim in the sea between the rocks. You can go windsurfing and snorkelling at Jonio. Diving lessons are also offered.

Dining out

The campsite restaurant offers an extensive menu and has a large terrace. Pizzas, snack and take-away meals are also available here. The bar has a spacious area featuring regular shows and performances by dancers or musicians. On the campsite you can buy daily fresh bread or breakfast and a modest range of groceries.

properties.name: Camping De Kienehoef
properties.description:
The family campsite De Kienehoef is located in the Bailiwick of Brabant. This lush environment boasts a natural setting and the ambience of the Brabant region. You can dive into the local history here or indulge in the delicious regional dishes at one of the many outdoor cafes. The campsite has no shortage of fun things to do. On the partially car-free camping fields, there are different kinds of playground equipment for the children. The campsite also boasts an open-air swimming pool, its own recreational pond, various sports fields and an activities team.

Car-free camping fields

Most of the touring pitches at De Kienehoef are located at the back on the partially car-free camping fields. These fields are beautifully arranged, each with playground equipment as the centrepiece of the field. There are also comfort fields. The camping fields at the back of the site have an additional sanitary facility.

Swimming pool and recreational pond

There is plenty to do for any guest at the campsite De Kienehoef. As soon as you check-in, you can head straight to the terrace of De Taveerne and enjoy a drink, ice cream or a snack from the small menu. It's also a great spot to keep an eye on the kids while they play in the open-air pool or children's pool, which are located just a bit farther along. If that's not enough aquatic fun for you, there is a recreational pond at the back of the campsite. 

Daily necessities

You can pick up some fresh rolls on the campsite every morning. You can buy all the other little things you need in Sint-Oedenrode, which is located one kilometre from the campsite. It has several supermarkets.

properties.name: Camping L'Escale
properties.description:
In Southern France, close to Narbonne, you will find Camping L'Escale. This charming campsite by the Mediterranean Sea, on the river Herault, is a lovely camping destination. You will spend your holiday on spacious pitches, or in one of the mobile homes. To cool down a bit, go to the swimming pool, and with a real bridge tournament, you will not get bored, even in the low season. It is a half hour's drive on the motorway to this campsite on the water.

You are welcomed at the reception by the owner who knows a great deal about the area and will gladly give you tips. You camp at campsite L'Escale on separated campsites with electricity. In addition, you can stay in one of the mobile homes for two, four or six people. In the high season, your neighbours are mostly families. In low season there are mostly seniors on this campsite.

Swimming and sunbathing

The campsite property has a swimming pool in Mediterranean atmosphere. There are loungers around the swimming pool, so you can laze around near the water. There is also a kiddie pool where the littlest ones can splash around. Campsite L'Escale also lies on the river Hérault. You can take the path via the bridge to the beach, because it is only 900 metres to the Mediterranean.

Wine tasting

There is great wine tasting in this famous wine region. If there is enough interest, the owner will arrange a visit to a vineyard, where you will get a tour about the wine making process.

properties.name: Camping Vela Blu
properties.description:
Camping Vela Blu is a campsite located in Cavallino-Treporti not far from Venice. You camp right on the beach on a generally quiet campsite. You’ve found a true gem here: everyone can enjoy the entertainment. For example, there is a pool complex. Or why not treat yourself to a delicious meal in on of the several restaurants. There are also many excursions you can go on: not only to the famous canal city but also to coastal towns on the Adriatic Sea and the Lio Piccolo lagoon.

Camping by the beach

This campsite is very well maintained and features all kinds of trees, hedges, and flowers. Campers have a choice of either 'pitch A' or 'pitch B' sites. The pitch A sites are spacious, shaded, and relatively close to the private beach and the sea.

The pitch B-sites are a bit smaller but still big enough for an average caravan or camper. In addition to all the camping sites, there are numerous accommodations for rent. Apartments, mobile homes, and cottages of all types and sizes.

Water fun and more

Of course, you can also have fun in and around the sea. And that’s easy to do here because Camping Vela Blu has a private beach. There are all kinds of chairs and umbrellas for a relaxing afternoon of sunbathing. Or why not be active for a while? Play a game of beach volleyball, build a sandcastle, or have a look at the colourful Bibo Play Area.

On the campsite itself, you can also take part in activities such as workshops, craft mornings, sports tournaments, pool parties, treasure hunts, and much more. But that's not all. Because in the centre of the campsite, you will find a swimming pool with slides, a whirlpool, a water spray park, and a bar.

properties.name: Villaggio Turistico Internazionale
properties.description:
The luxurious five-star campsite ‘Villaggio Turistico Internazionale’ is located on the Mediterranean. So get ready for a wonderful beach holiday! From the wooded campsite, you can walk straight to the beach. But not before you pass the huge swimming pool. Here you can splash, swim, and slide. Or would you prefer some activities on dry land? The sports fields are just the thing for you.

Villaggio: cosy suites, luxury mobile homes, and yellow villas

There’s a reason why this campsite is called ‘Villaggio’. The wooded campsite has nearly five hundred accommodations to choose from: cosy suites, luxurious mobile homes, and spacious villas. Of course, there are also plenty of pitches on the green grounds. Under the high trees, you are sure to find the perfect pitch.

Water park at sea

The water park on the campsite is a veritable water paradise. It is located a few meters from the Mediterranean Sea. The water park features a family pool, a paddling pool, and large whirlpools. Whilst the littlest ones slide down the lighthouse slide, the daredevils can race down the winding yellow water slide. All that swimming is sure to make you thirsty. So why not treat yourself to a summer cocktail.

An action-packed holiday

If you are looking for an active holiday, this is the campsite for you. Here is plenty to do for young and old. You want to find out what? Get on the little train, and let it take you across the vast terrain. You’ll come across the gym and all the sports fields. There is also an open air stage, where your children can dance along with spectacular shows.

properties.name: Sites & Paysages Au Clos de la Chaume
properties.description:
Camping Au Clos de la Chaume is located near the village of Corcieux, just ten minutes' drive from Gérardmer. The campsite is located alongside a stream, features a swimming pool and is ideal for making trips in the Alsace, Vosges and Lorraine.

Tailored to the needs of every camper

The camping features flat, spacious pitches of approximately 100 m2. The Grand Confort pitches are slightly larger and have water facilities and electricity. If you would like to camp on a Grand Confort pitch, it would be wise to make a reservation well beforehand. For campers with a camper, there is a flat paved area with water facilities. For more luxury, you can also stay overnight in rental accommodation.

Plenty of water fun by the river or in the swimming pool

Children can play to their heart's content at the river. For a bit of variation, there's also a heated indoor pool and an outdoor swimming pool. Is the entire family exhausted from all that playing and swimming? Then you can relax and get some rest on the sunbathing lawn.

The stream that runs through the middle of the campsite is a site for activities such as boat races and building dams. In July and August children can visit the mini club on Tuesday mornings. Nature plays a central role here as well, with activities such as going for walks or making homes for squirrels.

Stargazing

A special activity is stargazing. The camping is located in the middle of nature, making it the ideal location to gaze at the celestial bodies gracing our night sky. Once a week, the mountain guide organises an evening of stargazing.

properties.name: Camping Yelloh! Village La Plage Fleurie
properties.description:
The many natural features and unique attractions make the Ardèche one of the most popular camping destinations in France. The family campsite La Plage Fleurie is located in the south of this area – directly on the wide and calm part of the river. The campsite also features a water park with several (heated) pools, a paddling pool, and water slides.

View of the water

The La Plage Fleurie campsite is a fairly large campsite with a good mix of pitches and rental accommodations. The grounds are well maintained. There is sufficient space between the chalets and mobile homes. The pitches are also quite pristine. They are mostly located near the river and range from 100–120 m². You often have the choice between a spot in the sun or one in the shade.

Activities galore

The large family camp ground also has many facilities. There is a campsite shop, where you will find fresh bread, souvenirs, and a wide range of groceries. There is also a bar-restaurant. You can opt for either takeaway, chips, or pizza or a sit-down meal with all kinds of local dishes. The Ardèche is particularly well known for its sausages, cheese, and chestnuts. Of course, you won’t want to do without a nice glass of wine.

There is no need to worry about holiday fatigue – because there is always more than enough to do at the campsite. There are outdoor fitness machines, sports tournaments, and a nice kid’s club for the younger campers.

properties.name: Camping Des Abers
properties.description:
Among the dunes of the rugged Breton peninsula Sainte-Marguerite lies the terraced campsite Des Abers. It is beautifully situated on a wide bay with a nice sandy beach. At a distance of 2 km is the village of Landéda, where you will find the essential amenities. The beautiful flowery family campsite attracts many nature lovers, hikers, water sports enthusiasts and lovers of the sea.

The spacious pitches on the flower-decked terrain (10 ha) differ greatly from each other. The elevated pitches have a stunning view. The advantage of a pitch lower down is being better sheltered from the wind, thanks to the hedges. The rental mobile homes and apartments are located on the outside the camping grounds. The camping is situated on the GR34 and has direct access to the beach.

Musical evenings

The campsite organises great activities for guests. You can attend cookery lessons on Wednesdays and they also organise arts and crafts afternoons. The musical Breton evenings, two to three times per week, are varied and of a high standard. In peak season, takeaway meals are available on the campsite. You can get fresh oysters nearby.

Azure blue water

From the campsite, you can walk to the sandy beach and the sea with its azure blue water. Snorkelling and surfing are allowed here. The nearby L’Aber-Wrac’h has a water sports centre. You can go scuba diving and white water rafting in the area.

Sports entertainment

There is a playground for children, but no entertainment programme. Features: a sports field, table tennis table, pétanque pitch and beach volleyball field. You can get some training done on the attractive fitness equipment. In peak season, activities and excursions are organised for adults.

properties.name: Camping Domaine des Messires
properties.description:
Camping Domaine des Messires lies in an idyllic setting amidst nature next to the Regional Nature Park of the Vosges. The region is known for its vast panoramas and forests, making this an ideal destination for hikers and cyclists. On your way to the campsite you will pass green fields and a number of small villages. The capital of the region, Épinal, is only half an hour's drive from the campsite. It is one of the many locations in the region with beautiful sights and a rich history.

Unique location on a private lake

Passing through a stately gate, guests enter the attractive campsite which is spaciously laid out. The campsite is situated around a large portion of a clear lake. The lake is easily accessible over a sandy beach and if you bring your own boat, you can just sail away from the shore. Maybe you will come face to face the 'pet' beaver. There are five canoes on the campsite, which camping guests are allowed to use for free. Fishing enthusiasts can also indulge themselves here. There are several pathways for walkers and there is a route around the lake. If you want to do some mountain biking, you can hire one on the campsite.

Under the trees and by the water

A large selling point for Camping Domaine des Messires is the location of many pitches by the water's edge. There are also pitches around the small playground and close to the other facilities. Seekers of peace and quiet will favour a pitch on the perimeter of the campsite, where you also have a splendid view over the water.

properties.name: Mellerud Swe-Camp Vita Sandar
properties.description:
Situated on the bank of the Vänern, Sweden's largest lake, not far from the village of Mellerud in Dalsland, you will find the sprawling Mellerud Swe-Camp Vita Sandar. Dalsland is known as 'Little Sweden' because many of the features of other parts of Sweden can be found here. It is one of the smallest regions with a very diverse landscape.

Swimming pool and arcade games

Although swimming in the lake is possible all year round, when arriving you cannot fail to miss the magnificent swimming pool (270 m2) with dedicated children's section. There are children's playgrounds in several locations and there is also a room with arcade games. Furthermore, there is a very large multifunctional sports field, also suitable for football.

Eating at the campsite

Vita Sandar is not far from the village of Mellerud, where you will find several supermarkets and shops. Yet, it is also convenient not having to leave the camping grounds for basic groceries and to find your daily supply of fresh rolls at the shop. The 'Servering' as the restaurant at the campsite is referred to, has a small, but practical menu including pizzas and healthy salads. Frequently in the evenings, there is an ‘allsång’, the Swedish variant of karaoke, where you can just sing along. There are also actual karaoke and pub quiz evenings.

Ospreys

Using the campsite as a base, you can venture on long hiking and cycling trips in the region on marked trails. The area is rich in birdlife, especially in spring and autumn, but you can also observe rare species in summer, such as ospreys who come here to hunt for fish along the banks of the Vänern.

properties.name: Seencamping Stadlerhof
properties.description:
Seencamping Stadlerhof is located on the Tyrolean Krummsee. From your spacious camping pitch or apartment, you can walk to the lake, the heated swimming pools or the sauna landscape. Clean, private changing rooms are available and there a good restaurant. Nice to know: the campsite rents out e-scooters and makes its own liqueurs and jam.

Camping pitches and apartments

On the beautifully landscaped campsite, which is partly flat and partly terraced, you will find tidy, shady camping pitches between 70 and 120 m². There are special places available for campers who are in transit. For those who do not have a camping equipment, there are rustically furnished apartments for hire.

Heated pools and spa

On the other side of the street, you can see the Krummsee. Here you can swim or sunbathe on the lawn. Camping guests get a discount on entry to the lake. There is a heated indoor and outdoor pool with a special children's pool at the campsite. In the winter, you can warm up in 32ºC water after a cold skiing trip. For those who want to relax, there is a sauna and spa area of 500 m² with Finnish sauna, massages and sunbathing area.

Just for your four-footed friend

At the campsite, there is a tidy, modern bathroom. There are also five new private bathrooms with a spacious shower, toilet and washbasin. We've also thought of your furry friend, as there is a doggy shower and toilet.

Winter camping

Seencamping Stadlerhof is the ideal starting point in winter for anyone who wants to go cross-country or downhill skiing or sledding in the Ski Juwel Alpbachtal Wildschönau skiing area. A free ski bus runs and there is a dry room and boot heater for skis and snowboards.

properties.name: Domaine de Gil
properties.description:
Domaine de Gil campsite is a friendly well-organised family campsite in the south of the Ardèche. The river of the same name flows directly alongside the campsite, which makes the location really unique. Right on the water there are also a few great camping pitches, where the water falling from the dam acts as background music. There's a private beach where you can enjoy the beautiful colours of this rugged piece of natural beauty.

Camping under the trees

All the spacious pitches are flat and unpaved. They are separated from each other in a pleasant way with various shrubs, trees and hedges. The trees are spread over the whole area, making sure that the whole area is pleasantly shady. Something to be aware of with satellite reception. In quiet periods, it's even possible to choose your own pitch. At the campsite, there is plenty of space for different types of mobile homes, and for holiday rentals.

Double the fun in the water

The swimming pool is built with an eye for detail. Thanks to the heated water it's always fun to dive into the deep end. Then sunbathe on one of the wonderful sunbeds, or choose a nice place in the shade. There is plenty of shade thanks to the tall trees, covered terraces and thatched umbrellas. Children can enjoy themselves in the kids pool, while their parents keep an eye on them from the hot tub. The pool is illuminated at night, making it even more inviting. A short walk takes you to the river bank. The slowly meandering river is a wonderful place to play, flat around on an airbed or bathe. Or take your chair with you and enjoy the beautiful view.

properties.name: Johannesvik Camping & Stugby
properties.description:
Camping Johannesvik is a fjord campsite with its own beach between the rocks, including a safe swimming area for small children. The campsite is one of the best the Swedish fjord coast has to offer. The beautiful view, the ever-present nature and the possibilities for swimming and walking make this a top destination. This is a family campsite suitable for campers of all ages.

Surprise behind the rocks

Via a winding, ascending road you pass part of a former farmhouse before you reach the reception. The campsite is very well-maintained and lies amidst nature. At first glance, it looks like an average campsite with a large green lawn to the left of the reception. When you leave the reception, you pass an enormous rocky outcrop before you reach the far end of the campsite, which is located on the fjord with a view of the beach.

Fjord beach and wellness

The beach is situated along the fjord and consists mainly of a pebble and rocky beach. The campsite's own beach has a security fence for small children. There is a water trampoline and a pier where you can splash around in the water. The campsite also has a wellness centre (hot tub, sauna and jacuzzi). Minigolf (stone golf) and other sports facilities are in abundance. The floating sauna in the sea is a new feature since 2017.

Starters, pizzas and à la carte

There is a camping shop for basic foodstuffs (fresh bread) and a few camping items. The restaurant has a pleasant and amicable atmosphere. You can get pizzas, à-la-carte dishes, salads, desserts and children's menus here.

properties.name: Yelloh! Village Le Pin Parasol
properties.description:
Yelloh! Village Le Pin Parasol is a well-cared for campsite in the Vendée, on France’s west coast. The campsite, which is managed by a hospitable couple, has very large and well-maintained pitches and accommodation. The swimming paradise has various pools, slides, and a water playground for small children, and is the campsite’s highlight.

The campsite is located directly on the Jaunay lake, not even 15 kilometres from the Atlantic coast. This is where France has the most hours of sun exposure, just like on the Côte d’Azur. A good reason to go to the beach. Drive the car east for half an hour and you’ve reached La Roche-sur-Yon, a pretty town with a large shopping centre.

Large pitches

The large, orderly pitches are located on large grass fields and delimited by hedges. The smallest pitches are still 130 m² large, and the largest ones are even 220 m². That’s spacious and luxurious camping! In addition to the pitches, you may also choose from various cottages and chalets, some of which are equipped for disabled people. All of them are well maintained and have a beautiful colour.

Swimming paradise

The swimming paradise is what each holidaymaker will surely enjoy. On a 2500 m² surface, there is a covered pool, an outside pool, a children’s pool, a water playground for small ones, and four large slides. Even more water fun can be found on the southern edge of the campsite. This is where the lake of Jaunay can be found, which is great for fishing, canoeing, and kayaking.

properties.name: Cala Pola
properties.description:
On the rocky Costa Brava lies Campsite Cala Pola. You can camp directly on an intimate beach at this cosy campsite. Set up your tent under an old olive tree and pull on your swimsuit. Because you can walk straight from your camping pitch into the Mediterranean! And, of course, you can take a dip in the pool. The restaurant is the place to be if you want to have a good time and a delicious meal.

Camping by the beach

Your pitch is located on one of the terraces, nestled under an old (olive) tree. The further you are towards the coast, the nicer the pitches. And the quicker you can get to the beach from your camping spot. However, the view is beautiful no matter where you're camped. You look out onto the green rocks, which enclose the campsite. The view will help you feel like you're far away from the busy civilized world.

A refreshing swim

You may have already seen it on the other side of the reception: the swimming pool. Together with the playground, this swimming pool is the centre of the campsite. Especially for the younger campers. You can take a refreshing dip in the water every day. Even for our smallest guests. Next to the large pool is a small paddling pool.

Skatepark

You won't be bored if you like a bit of action either. There's a skatepark near the campsite. Here your tough teenage sons and daughters can go wild. On their own or under the guidance of a professional BMX'er. He will be happy to teach the campers all his tips and tricks. Bring your bike, scooter or skateboard or rent one.

properties.name: Camping Paradis La Bretonnière
properties.description:
Camping Paradis La Bretonnière is not far from the beaches of the Atlantic Coast, at a distance of some 2 km from the town of Saint-Julien-des-Landes. The area is rural and the very green grounds exude peace and quiet. A perfect choice for campers looking for quiet and are interested in walking and cycling. Families with young children will also get their money's worth here. Enough entertainment to be found without compromising the quiet atmosphere.

Rest and space on a green campsite

The most remarkable feature of this campsite is its well-cared for character with lots of greenery and flowers. The camping pitches are very spacious and attractively surrounded by vegetation. Furthermore, the campsite offers various types of rental accommodation: mobile homes, wooden chalets and furnished tents. Camping guests are provided with five ablution blocks, some of which have separate cubicles for babies and disabled persons. Free use of hot water.

Customised facilities

A nice feature of this campsite is the availability of all facilities, whilst retaining the small-scale character. There are two covered swimming pools, one of which is a heated pool, as well as some water playground equipment. There is a lovely multi sports field for sports and games, a soccer field and a volleyball field, tennis courts, recreation area and a mini-club. A quick bite to eat, nice snacks and takeaway meals are available from the (snack)bar. There is a mini-market for basic necessities.

Out into the open air

Paradis La Bretonnière is an ideal base for cyclists; the coastal region of the Vendée has a whopping 1500 km of bicycle paths. This way you can enjoy nature up close and feel the salty wind blow through your hair.

properties.name: Camping Le Rebau
properties.description:
Twenty kilometres from the Mediterranean coast, in the French department of Hérault, lies the well-shaded campsite Le Rebau. You'll find the campsite on the outskirts of the village of Montblanc, hidden behind a hedge of trees. The green camping area is surrounded by vineyards. Le Rebau is especially suitable as a transit campsite for campers on their way to or from Spain.

Shaded touring pitches

A little shade always comes in handy in the south of France. That's why it's great that mature trees provide full shade cover to the camping area of Le Rebau campsite. The many trees and bushes are sufficiently pruned, but larger motorhomes and caravans should have a good driver. Once you reach your pitch, you have plenty of space under fantastic trees.

The Pool and the Mediterranean

It's a pretty picture: the outdoor pool, at the front of the property, which is surrounded by trees and vibrant oleanders. Please note that the pool is only open from July through mid-September. Fortunately, you can take a dip in the Mediterranean all year round. If you are camping at Le Rebau you are only twenty kilometres from the beach of Vias Plage.

Renewed sanitary facilities

The sanitary facilities have been partially or completely renewed in several blocks. Some showers have an adjustable shower dial to choose the heat of the water yourself. Showers are free and open throughout the campsite's opening period.

Snacks are available at the snack bar. Groceries can be purchased at a larger supermarket six kilometres away.

properties.name: Camping bei Berlin Am Mahlower See
properties.description:
Because of its location close to Berlin, four-star campsite Am Mahlower See is the perfect holiday address for visits to the German capital. You can reach the centre within forty-five minutes by car or half an hour by train. The campsite is located in the countryside, just south of Berlin, facing a small lake; a peaceful and green setting. The campsite is rather basic, without frills and large scale entertainment, but fully equipped as a base for a visit to Berlin.

Well maintained comfort pitches

The well-maintained camping grounds, surrounded by cornfields, house some sixty spacious camping pitches. They are laid out on lovely grassy fields and are mainly demarcated with hedges and trees. Centrally located on the campsite, on the circular lawn around a small pond, are dedicated pitches for tent campers. Please note: near the pond you probably have to share your pitch with quite a few mosquitoes in summer.

Restaurant and lake

There is no swimming pool on the campsite, although there is a swimming lake across the road. It has a gently shelving beach, making it a safe place for children. You can enter the water directly from the small beach or sunbathing lawn. Adjacent to the lake is a restaurant where you can enjoy a tasty meal. Cooking yourself? If so, you can do your grocery shopping in the supermarkets of Blankenfelde-Mahlow, at a distance of only 2 km from the campsite. 

Comprehensive sanitary facilities

The sanitary facilities at camping Am Mahlower See are very comprehensive. The spacious showers and modern toilets always look immaculate and are scrupulously cleaned. In the sanitary building you will find separate children's sanitary equipment, as well as facilities for disabled person and private bathrooms.

properties.name: Camping Orchidea
properties.description:
The campsite Orchidea is located near Feriolo di Baveno, a charming Italian village. The beautiful camping pitches on this flat, lush campsite offer plenty of shade. Some rental accommodation is available as well. The campsite's private beach is really wonderful. The beach slopes gradually into the water. For more fun in the water, you can take a dip in the swimming pool on the campsite. The activities team gives it their all throughout the day to entertain both young and old. The restaurant (which includes a terrace with a view) serves up delicious dishes.

Spacious, lush pitches

Orchidea primarily features touring pitches (roughly 200), but there are a few mobile homes and apartments. The borders of the pitches are marked and there is plenty of space. There is no shortage of greenery, either. Are you coming with a big camper van? If so, inform the site ahead of time, because the many, tall broad-leaf trees mean that there are fewer pitches where your van will fit. 

The activities programme (particularly the kids' dance party) keeps the day entertaining and creates a lively atmosphere on the campsite. Those looking for peace and quiet are best served by choosing a spot by the lake.

Entertainment on the campsite and on the water

The campsite is clearly focused on families, which is clear from its activity programme and various sports fields (football, volleyball, table tennis, petanque). There are also two playgrounds for smaller children. The little ones can also enjoy themselves at the mini club or the juniors' club. If you're looking to cool off, you can find the solution in the modern swimming pool (built in the spring of 2017). 

Lago Maggiore

The largest "swimming pool" is Lago Maggiore, of course! You can easily walk here from the campsite. The campsite has its own sandy beach, which gradually slopes into the lake. This makes it perfect for smaller children, too.

properties.name: Camping Arquin
properties.description:
Right at the top of Italy, in the South Tyrolean mountain landscape, you will find Arquin campsite. This campsite is hidden between orchards, just outside the town of Lana. The well-maintained campsite offers a beautiful view of the mountains. The view is also wonderful from the swimming pool. If you want to go out for a day, you can go in all directions. Bozen (Bolzano) and Meran (Merano) are colourful cities.

Between the mountains

You will find your camping destination in the upper part of Italy. Once you have passed the Austrian Brenner Pass, it is only an hour's drive. The motorway takes you through the gigantic mountains. They make your car journey to the campsite quite an experience.

Find your own pitch

Don't speak Italian? No problem at all. The Italian owners can also give you a warm welcome in English or German. You can pick your own pitch on the well-maintained campsite. The pitches are of various sizes and are separated by hedges. Whichever spot you choose, the view of the mountains is equally beautiful. If you step out of your tent or caravan in the morning, you will be surprised every time.

Swimming with a mountain view

If you have been walking through the mountains all day or have just returned from a long bike ride, the swimming pool is waiting. The swimming pool looks, just like everything else on the campsite, beautifully cared for. Take a refreshing dip and let your tired legs rest. Like everywhere else on the campsite, you can enjoy the view while swimming.

properties.name: Camping de L'Hérein
properties.description:
Camping de L’Hérein is situated slightly east of the village of Visan. You camp here virtually on the border of two departments: the Vaucluse and the Drôme. In both departments you will find a large number of lavender fields, vineyards, attractive villages and regional markets. All in all, a veritable holiday region!

Camping with ample shade

The camping pitches, varying in size (150-400 m2) and shape, are located on a flat, compacted grass surface. The large number of trees and hedges provide a fair amount of shade and privacy on most pitches. Don't have camping equipment? If so, book one of the mobile homes (suitable for a maximum of eight persons).

Attractive swimming pool and a peaceful river

Centrally situated on the campsite is a modest, but attractive swimming pool (65 m2). Adjacent to this pool is a toddler pool with a wall fountain. The pools are surrounded by a terrace with a few sun umbrellas and loungers. The shallow river which calmly skirts the campsite, is yet another source of water fun. Children can thoroughly enjoy themselves here. Fishing in the river is also allowed.

Entertainment for the whole family

As one can expect from a real family campsite, there is something to do for each and everyone. Young children can take part in the entertainment or amuse themselves in the large playground (with trampoline, swings, seesaw and sandpit). There is a diverse and challenging programme for teenagers and adults. For instance, dance workshops, sports tournaments (including water polo and belly flying), shows and disco evenings. Furthermore, there is a 25 m long zip-line. 

Restaurant and market

The campsite restaurant, with shaded terrace, features an extensive menu. Fresh bread is available from the campsite shop. In high season, a campsite market is organised on Thursday evenings. Here you can buy the most delicious cheeses, cold meats, honey, olive oil and fruits.

properties.name: Camping Mazet-Plage
properties.description:
Camping Mazet-Plage lies in the south of the French Ardèche department. You camp among the woods of the Ardèche and the vineyards. The Chassezac river runs behind the campsite and is easy to access on foot. The river provides entertainment and there is plenty to do at the campsite as well. There are various athletic fields, a swimming pool, a restaurant and in the evening there is live music during the high season. The Bois de Païolive nature reserve is just a stone’s throw from the campsite.

Camping with a view of the river

Camping Mazet-Plage is an oasis of peace and quiet in beautiful surroundings. The grounds are spacious with well-kept pitches between 80 and 100 m2. The pitches are separated partially by hedges and partially by trees. You can also rent a luxury mobile home with your own kitchen and toilet facilities. All accommodations have a shady terrace with furniture. The campsite restaurant has a terrace with a view of the river. The restaurant is open daily during the high season.

Swimming in the swimming pool and the river

Take a dip in the swimming pool or relax in the whirlpool. The river is also suitable for swimming. A path runs from the campsite to a section of the river where the banks form a wide beach. If you want to exercise during your holiday, the campsite has fitness facilities as well as tennis courts. The surrounding area also invites you to participate in sports activities such as canoeing, climbing or hiking.

properties.name: Camping La Garangeoire
properties.description:
La Garangeoire castle campsite is a large, friendly campsite close to the Atlantic Ocean. The campsite near St. Julien des Landes has something to offer just about every camper, from horse riding to wine tasting and canoeing to massage. Camp on a spacious camping pitch or in one of the many accommodation units on the expansive site.

A rustic scene

La Garangeoire castle campsite is located at the heart of the French countryside and just 15 kilometres from the Atlantic coast. You can have your feet in the sand or dip your toe in the ocean within twenty minutes (by car), or for fun in the water closer to home, why not check out one of the many lakes that surround the campsite, such as Lac du Jaunay?

As you drive along the long driveway to the campsite, you will see the castle in the distance — through the trees. The grounds contain the castle and its extensive estate of mature forest, grass fields and sandy paths. It's a rustic scene. The site accommodates spacious camping pitches and a variety of accommodation types. Many of the pitches have private sanitary facilities.

A little charm

The campsite is popular with all manner of holidaymakers, from young families with small children to older children and couples looking to enjoy the countryside. This varied campsite is full of charm and offers something for everyone.

The campsite has a large heated outdoor swimming pool with slides and toddlers' pool. The campsite also boats a natural swimming pool with sandy beach, plus a lake on the northern edge, which is suitable for fishing and canoeing.

properties.name: Camping de Ramales
properties.description:
This charming campsite is located in the spectacular surroundings of northern Spain, on the banks of the Asón River in Cantabria. De Ramales Campsite offers a perfect location for nature lovers who enjoy outdoor activities. You will find these in abundance here. Numerous deep caves and abundant animal life are among this mountainous region's many remarkable features. Connect with the magic of nature, surrounded by the impressive foothills of the Pyrenees. This is a nice place to relax, get out and enjoy the Basque hospitality.

Mountainous Spanish Basque Country

You'll be amazed by the green surroundings as you travel through Cantabria. Once you have arrived at De Ramales Campsite's reception, you will be warmly welcomed and proceed to one of the wooded camping pitches. You'll be camping in a bucolic setting at this very charming campsite, but also nearby the quaint village of Ramales de la Victoria.

Wooded accommodation

De Ramales Campsite has narrow pitches, but you'll have everything you need while also enjoying a spectacular view of the mountains. The facilities are very clean, well maintained and comfortable. The campsite's abundant trees ensure that all pitches are sheltered from the sun. Here you can really be at one with nature and enjoy the peace and quiet. Would you prefer to stay in a rental accommodation? You can do that, too. The campsite has a number of bungalows and apartments designed in harmony with nature.

properties.name: Camping Platja Brava
properties.description:
Between the French border and the bustling city of Barcelona, situated directly along the beach of the Costa Brava, you will find the level-surface Playa Brava campsite. Here you can camp in a green environment, the protected natural park Montgrí-Baix. It is a very convivial venue with many great facilities. A wide range of activities both on the grounds and in the hilly surroundings. To experience the Spanish culture you can make excursions to neighbouring Girona, Pals or the magnificent Begur.

Playa Brava campsite is situated in a quiet location on the outskirts of a small coastal village. En route between a small inland lake and the circular road to the sea, you can already catch a glimpse of the stately reception. During the months of July and August it gets very lively and the entertainment team then organises an original programme for young and old. There are bouncy castles, swinging performances, karaoke evenings. You can also participate in spinning, water aerobics and a weekly craft class.

Lively or quiet

The pitches are all well-tended and are separated from each other by low hedges. There are deciduous trees on some pitches and around the campsite. The pitches under the trees are 800 m walking distance from the beach. Other pitches are slightly brighter and sunnier. Close to the water are the comfort plus pitches.
