With this set-up there is a choice for all. Do you want a lively pitch or rather a quiet spot?

In any event, you are never far away from a clean shower or toilet. Five sanitary buildings are scattered over the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Šobec
properties.description:
The location of Camping Šobec can truly be called unique. This is because here you camp in the middle of a pine forest surrounded by the Sava Dolinka river. The well-know tourist town of Bled is just 4 km away. Entertainment is provided. There are also many sports opportunities.

Camping in nature

The campsite is located on natural terrain with many pathways and trees. When you camp here, you are surrounded by nature. There is no busy road nearby and the only sounds you hear are the sounds of nature of the river and of birds. How great is that? 

The camping pitches are marked by posts but are otherwise not separated. You can choose between differently sized pitches. The pitches directly on the lake are rather small. A bit further from the water's edge are the larger pitches. Next to the pitches, you will find a few wooden cottages.

Professional entertainment and sports opportunities

Sports enthusiasts can indulge themselves on the many sports fields (including basketball, soccer, tennis, mini golf). For children, all types of activities are organised. Take your offspring to the entertainment and enjoy your 'time off'. With creative workshops, sports activities and an exciting treasure hunt, there is no need for anyone to be bored!

Campsite restaurant: tasty and local

In 2018, a completely new restaurant and supermarket were constructed with an additional television area, all under one roof. Just outside the campsite gate is a small campsite shop where you will find a small assortment of daily necessities. Some three km from the campsite is a large supermarket. The restaurant on the campsite has a lovely terrace and an extensive menu. The restaurant serves dishes from the Gorenjska region with ingredients from the surrounding farms.

properties.name: Camping Maeva L'Arbre d'Or
properties.description:
Camping L’Arbre d’Or is situated amidst the forests of the Landes region between Biscarosse and Mimizan at a few km distance from the Atlantic Ocean. At a distance of 500 m you can find the lovely town centre of Parentis-en-Borne with its restaurants and shops. Most of the camping pitches on grass are shaded by large numbers of trees, but there are also some sunny pitches. On a separate section of the campsite are wooden chalets and luxury mobile homes. For water fun there are two heated swimming pools with toddler pool and jacuzzi.

Lots of comfort and facilities

L’Arbre d’Or is a typical family campsite for people with young children. The atmosphere is amicable and the grounds are neatly laid out. The mobile homes are on spacious sites with the necessary privacy, have a covered veranda and air conditioning. Handy for families with little ones; some bedrooms have room for an extra cot.

There is a camping shop with fresh produce and a bar/restaurant where you can buy rolls, pizzas and take-away dishes. Naturally, there is also a swimming pool, a playground, a multifunctional sports field and a television lounge. The contemporary and recently renovated sanitary building is fitted with showers, toilets, separate childrens' toilets, a baby area and a laundry with tumble dryers.

Water sports

The Biscarrosse-Parentis lake is only a 5-minute walk away. You can do all kinds of water sports on this recreational lake, such as windsurfing, waterskiing, (catamaran)sailing, fishing and hydrojetting. Also fun: a boat trip or renting a water bike. The water sports centre (Aqua Loisirs), where you can hire all kinds of equipment, is just a stone's throw away from the campsite as is the sailing school. If you bring your own boat, you can use the mooring ring in the marina free of charge.

properties.name: Camping-Paradies-Franken
properties.description:
This is a simple yet exceptionally well-kept campsite, situated in hilly surroundings. It is the ideal location for people looking for quiet and nature enthusiasts who enjoy camping in a clean and green environment.

Well-kept grounds

At the reception, which is housed in a grey-blue building with a red slate roof, you will find plenty of tourist information about things to see and do in the area. Here, you will camp at a neat and quiet campsite, well-maintained and with plenty of greenery. 

Spacious pitches with little shade

There is not much shade on the grounds; most of the shrubs are relatively low. The grass is in excellent condition. To keep the grass green, campers are discouraged from using groundsheets under the tents and awnings. There are two fun cabins with an arched awning available for rent.

Guaranteed quiet

Peace and quiet are very important at this campsite. During the quiet hours, this campsite actually ensures that the grounds remain quiet. 

Simple and tasty

The restaurant offers simple yet tasty meals for a good price. There is a daily bread service available in the peak season. The sanitary facilities are ample, modern and exceptionally neat and clean. This environmentally friendly campsite has a separated waste collection program, completely in keeping with modern practice.

Nature, villages and towns

You can take a trip, for example, to Rothenburg ob der Tauer, approximately 20 kilometres away. The campsite is situated in the Romantic Road (Romantische Straße) region. You can go for beautiful hikes and cycling trips in this largely rural environment.

properties.name: Camping de Wildhoeve
properties.description:
In the eastern part of the Veluwe, located in woodland, you will find campsite De Wildhoeve. The campsite is divided into many small fields, thus creating a small-scale atmosphere. In addition to camping pitches, the campsite also offers some unique accommodation. There is plenty of water fun to be had on the campsite, with an indoor and outdoor swimming pool, slides and a water playground.

Explore nature

In low season, the campsite is familiar territory for nature lovers looking for peace and quiet. Both adults and children learn a great deal about nature during their holiday. There are, for instance, a number of guided walks that are very informative. Children can collect stamps in their books and become real 'trailblazers'. They learn to recognise tree species, tracks and animal droppings.

Special accommodation

The spacious pitches provide sun as well as shade. Several types of accommodation are available for a special overnight stay. You can opt for a charming safari tent, a fully equipped Astro Mobile Home or a forest cottage at an Artcamp. In the latter case, you rent not just one but three special tents. The upper two tents are equipped for sleeping and the bottom tent is for socialising, cooking, eating and playing games.

There is water fun for the entire family

In peak season, the campsite is a very popular holiday destination for young families. Children will love their wild adventures in the water playground. Climbing, scrambling, splashing and playing ferryman. The campsite also has a swimming pool with slide! Several slides, in fact. At the indoor pool, children have a choice of six different colour schemes to whiz down the slide with, for instance, Disco or Flash Light.

properties.name: Caravan Camping 'Sächsische Schweiz'
properties.description:
Explore Saxon Switzerland from Caravan Camping 'Sächsische Schweiz'. When you return you can dine in the campsite restaurant from where you have a panoramic view of the surrounding rock formations. Caravan Camping 'Sächsische Schweiz' lies on a high plateau in the heart of Saxon Switzerland amidst nature and is surrounded by panoramic landscapes.

The campsite is ideally located to visit towns such as Pirna, Dresden and Meissen. It is also conveniently located to visit the capital of the Czech Republic: Prague. More active types can also explore the immediate vicinity of the campsite from the water by canoe or travel through the Elbe valley by boat past castles and villages.

Easy manoeuvring on the camping pitch

The pitches on Caravan Camping 'Sächsische Schweiz' are spacious. The surface consists of grass with bushes, conifers and deciduous trees providing shade. The camping pitches are all located along paved roads, enabling you to manoeuvre your caravan or motorhome effortlessly into position.

Playing and swimming some laps

The campsite has a swimming pool with a few loungers on the adjacent sunbathing terrace. There is a toddler pool for the little ones and a slide for the slightly older children. There are dedicated opening times for adults only, allowing them to swim their laps in peace. In addition there is a Finnish sauna. 

Robin Hood playground and sports activities

In the 'Robin Hood' playground, with hanging bridge and sentry tower, children can play to their heart's content. Adjacent to the playground is the barbecue and campfire area, where you can enjoy toasting bread rolls or marshmallows.

properties.name: Camping Monte Generoso
properties.description:
Although you might consider Monte Generoso as a transit campsite, it would be a shame not to stay a little longer. Because it is a great base from which to make lots of fun excursions, by foot, by bike, or on the water. This charming family campsite is located right along the banks of Lake Lugano, thereby promising lots of water activities. Here you always have a priceless view.

Reception desk

Monte Generoso is a spacious campsite with a splendid view of Lake Lugano. At the reception desk, Italian, German and English is spoken.

Where is your pitch?

The pitches on the level grounds are spacious, some of which are separated by hedges. Some pitches are fully shaded. You can even rent a caravan. Monte Generoso is located right on the lakeshore, which begins with a (little) strip of pebble beach.

Clear water

The campsite guests are mainly Swiss, Germans and those travelling from north and west Europe; the latter due to the site's location along the Germany-Italy route. Monte Generoso is therefore also very suitable as a transit campsite. In the summer, families with children come because of the location directly on the water and the water sport activities.

All water recreation is done in the lake itself; there is no swimming pool on the campsite. The water in the lake is crystal clear and lake bed is made of pebbles. You can go right into the lake from the campsite.

Must see

Take the cog railway up to the top of Monte Generoso! There is a visitor centre there where activities are held and where you have a view of the Alps and the Po Valley.

properties.name: Camping Max 1
properties.description:
Are you looking for peace and quiet and want to pamper yourself, body and soul? Then travel to the spa and resort campsite Camping Max 1, an especially luxurious campsite with plenty of wellness options. The spa-linked campsite is situated in a virtually silent area in the scenic area of Bavaria. This is a place people have been coming to from time immemorial to enjoy the thermal baths!

Green and well-maintained grounds

Once you're there, you'll find a beautiful campsite with a variety of pitches. The grounds feature lots of green (well-maintained hedges, trees and demarcations). There are small pitches under trees and larger pitches in the open. All pitches are in quiet settings and are well maintained. The pitches are nicely laid out allowing campers take full advantage of all the facilities. Prefer not to camp out? In that case, you can rent one of the apartments.

Wellness is the order of the day

At Camping Max 1 great thought has been put into the wellbeing of the campers. The open nature swimming pool, the huge outdoor pool and the smaller covered swimming pool in the wellness centre are proof of it. You also have access to the sauna. Choose one of the wellness treatments or join in with an aquafitness class. Note that there are additional fees for some pools and facilities. Guests who stay at Camping Max 1 are almost exclusively (older) couples without children.

Good restaurant

The campsite's restaurant has an extensive menu and impeccable service. You can also enjoy dining sitting out on the shaded terrace. For a snack, lunch and dinner: here you can have it all. There is a small shop by the reception. For most extensive shopping or more food and dining options, go to Bad Füssing (three kilometres up the road).

properties.name: Camping Arterhof
properties.description:
Wellness aficionado? If so, Camping Arterhof in South-East Bavaria is the place for you. This region is home to numerous springs and thermal baths. In addition, this almost flat lowland has excellent walking and cycling paths. The Austrian border is only 30 km away and the Bad Birnbach Spa is even within walking distance (twenty minutes).

Well-tended and quiet campsite

The grounds look peaceful, clean and well maintained. The spacious to very spacious pitches are beautifully laid out and equipped with all conveniences. They are easy to reach over hardened pathways. You can choose between a pitch with much or less shade from leafy trees. Feel like a little luxury? There are pitches with private sanitary facilities. You can also rent an apartment.

Natural spring water

There is a covered pool and an outdoor pool with natural spring water. The outdoor pool with massage jet and four integrated bubble baths is located in a quiet spot on the camping grounds. You can unwind in a lounger on the decorative tiles and small lawn around the baths. Across from the campsite you will find a swimming pond with lawn, petting zoo and fragrant garden.

Sports and relaxation

There are ample facilities for children at Camping Arterhof. There is a small playground and bad weather facilities. Entertainment is also offered. In addition there is a golf practice area and some fitness equipment. There is a daily free shuttle bus to the nearby Bad Birnbach spa.

Sit out on the terrace or prepare your own meal

In the beautiful courtyard you will find the reception as well as the bar and restaurant with terrace. You can enjoy excellent meals here. Breakfast, lunch or dinner: everything is possible!

properties.name: Naturist Camping Ulika
properties.description:
Campsite Ulika is situated in the Croatian peninsula of Istria amidst beautiful nature. Guests can enjoy the splendid view of the bay from this spacious naturist campsite Ulika, situated slightly north of the charming coastal resort of Poreč. The immediate vicinity is made up of agricultural fields and a few tiny villages. From the campsite you can take a number of attractive cycling routes.

Large campsite, relaxing atmosphere

A narrow pebble beach, named ‘Beach Ulika’, borders the campsite and is accessible for undressed guests only. Furthermore, the sea can be reached via several short stairs from the jetties at the perimeter of the campsite. The beach near the campsite is also safe for children; it has blue flag status. Guests don't notice that this campsite covers quite a large area. This is due to the many trees, well-tended flower beds, pathways over the grounds, different fields and the relaxed atmosphere.

The sea as your front garden

You are spoilt for choice with the number of beautiful pitches on campsite Ulika. A large proportion of the camping pitches are demarcated with tall trees providing natural shade. In addition, there are several fields where you can pitch 'free'. The open pitches without demarcation are somewhat larger in size and campers may choose their own spot. On a separate section of the campsite are dozens of new caravans. This section has its own small swimming pool. As a big section of the campsite lies directly by the sea, a large number of pitches overlook the sea.

properties.name: Camping Kanegra
properties.description:
Lovers of the sun, beach and naturist holidays will feel right at home at Camping Kanegra. This campsite is situated on the northernmost point of the Croatian peninsula of Istria, close to the Slovenian border. Here you camp far away from any traffic, in a magnificent spot on the Adriatic coast. The ideal base from which to explore Istria and to make excursions to Rovinj, Pula and Poreč.

A quiet spot

The camping pitches are sufficiently large. They have little shade and are not demarcated with bushes or trees. The pitches are numbered, so it's easy to find your own spot. 

It's important to keep in mind that the camping pitches are intended for naturist campers only. In addition to the camping pitches, the campsite also has rental bungalows available. These are reserved for non-naturist campers.

Fun in and on the water

With the Adriatic coast right at your feet, there are always enough opportunities to cool down. The water is not only suitable for a refreshing dive, you can also indulge in pedal boating or canoeing here. Real adventurers can venture out on a banana boat ride or jet ski.

Everything for your pet

Leaving your faithful four-legged companion at home during your holidays? You don't have to when you are staying at Camping Kanegra. Even better, this campsite is totally geared towards camping with a dog or a cat. For instance, there are special pet showers and you can buy pet food in the supermarket. In addition, the beach has a separate section where your dog is welcome.

properties.name: Camping & Glamping Nautic Almata
properties.description:
Wake up to a view of a beautiful natural area? Then at the Nautic Almata campsite, you're in the right place. This campsite is located in Aiguamolls de l'Emporda Nature Park, full of wetlands, dunes and beach. There is a large swimming pool with a shallow tot pool at the camping ground. You can easily get from the campsite to the beach. There are also moorings for boats in the river next to the campsite.

From pitches to lodge tents

Of course, you can visit this campsite for a nice pitch for your caravan, camper or tent. If you want that extra bit of luxury, you can upgrade your pitch to an Almata Plus site. This pitch is surrounded by hedges, has its own water connection, water drainage and a 10A connection.

Fun in the water

Adjacent to the beach and with two swimming pools at the campsite, there is plenty of water fun at Nautic Almata campground. The campsite's pool has a nice pool where small children can safely play in shallow water. Adults can relax in the jacuzzi or enjoy a good book on the grassy field. Children have plenty to do on this campsite. Through the whole high season, there is plenty see and do in and around the campsite. For example, you can go to the magicians' shows in the evenings. And who will compete for Miss or Mister Almata this summer? There is also plenty of live music during the evening, great to listen to with a drink from the bar. And of course, you can't go without karaoke while camping, the same goes for the beach disco.

properties.name: Solcio Village
properties.description:
You will find Solcio Village in Lesa, a small town on Lake Maggiore in the Italian Alps. This is a small holiday park with modern mobile homes. This park is just 800 m from a sandy beach alongside the famous lake, and the resort itself has an outdoor pool and a restaurant. Nearby, there are atmospheric seaside resorts and the natural beauty of Piedmont.

Car-free park with modern mobile homes

Solcio Village is a small holiday park with several dozen modern mobile homes. These so-called maxi caravans are all equipped with air conditioning and a great veranda, where you can enjoy outdoor life. The accommodation is accessed via neatly laid-out footpaths. Guests park their cars at the reception, so it is always nice and quiet around the mobile homes.

Relax by the pool

Returning to the park after a long nature walk? There’s nothing better than taking a refreshing dip in the outdoor pool. After swimming, grab a drink from the adjacent bar and enjoy it on the sun terrace around the pool. Head to the campsite restaurant in the morning for an extensive breakfast. Later in the day, return for cocktails, a delicious pizza or meat or fish dishes.

Water sports and seaside resorts

Close to Lake Maggiore, the campsite is ideal for beach and water sports lovers. The nearest beach is in Lesa itself, a ten-minute walk from the park. There are also various lakeside resorts. One of these is fashionable Stresa, which you can drive to in 15 minutes.

properties.name: Camping Village Baia Azzurra
properties.description:
At a distance of 7 km from the coastal town of Castiglione della Pescaia, in Italian Tuscany, lies the attractive Village Baia Azzurra family campsite. This luxury, quiet campsite is idyllically located on an azure bay of the Mediterranean Sea. The campsite is characterised by the abundance of vegetation and the lush flowering plants and shrubs. The area with scattered forests is clearly touristy, but also pristine. Camping with (art)towns such as Lucca, Siena, Montepulciano and other pearls on your doorstep.

Pleasant pitches

The pitches are well maintained and vary in size (50 - 100 m2). Depending on the pitch they may offer much or little privacy. The surface is made of sand and is compact (bring a hammer). There are some one hundred rental bungalows. The sanitary facilities of the campsite are clean and contemporary, with attractively designed children's sanitary fittings.

Swimming in paradise...

You can enjoy yourself in the stunning swimming pool, deserving of the name of swimming paradise, complete with footbridge over the water. It looks comfortable and attractive because of its playful design. It is in full sun and is sheltered in some spots by bushes and trees. Unwind on one of the blue/white loungers with sun umbrellas. You will find them on the water's edge. Prefer to swim in the sea? You can reach the beach via a 200 m footpath. It is very quiet there, but it is not an official private beach of the campsite.

...and heavenly food

The campsite has a fine restaurant with extensive menu. Rather just have a quick bite and a drink? Head for the pizzeria or the bar.

properties.name: Camping Olea
properties.description:
This quiet, terraced campsite is situated along the beautiful azure blue sea on the Croatian island of Pag. You'll be camping in a fairly secluded area on the west side of the island. It is nestled amongst ancient olive trees and offers spectacular views, all within twelve kilometres from the town of Novalja. Tranquillity, nature and the sea are the keywords at Olea Camping. There is a bakery with fresh rolls, a restaurant and a beach bar.

Amazing views

Olea Camping exclusively offers touring pitches with no accommodations. This results in an extremely well-arranged campsite. All 200 pitches are beautifully laid out on terraces with most overlooking the picturesque bay. In terms of size, they vary between 100 and 150 m2. In some places you can enjoy the shade of the olive trees, but not all pitches have vegetation. The pitches are demarcated by low stones and rock walls. The campsite has three sanitary facilities that are clean and well maintained.

The wind in your hair

Sun worshippers will be perfectly at home here. The campsite features a pebble beach with sun loungers and parasols. Ideal for alternating between sunbathing and swimming in the Adriatic Sea. You can also enjoy watching unforgettable sunsets from this spot. There are numerous beautiful beaches and bays along the coast. Discover these while taking a boat trip that also offers fabulous food and snorkelling for enthusiasts. There is no entertainment at the campsite, but there is playground equipment for the small children. They can also play a game of ping pong or table football.

properties.name: Camping le Val de Saures
properties.description:
In the middle of the beautiful nature of the Aveyron and the Lotvalley you will find the pleasant and well-maintained campsite Le Val de Saures. Nature lovers, those in search of peace and quiet and active campers will find an ideal spot right by the River Lot and on the edge of a charming village. Take a canoe trip, have a swim in the adjacent pool or go exploring on the special plateaus.

Camping by the River Lot

The campsite is situated next to a football field and swimming pool. The grounds are flat and open, allowing you to look around. Many pitches are right by the river and from the campsite you have a view of a castle. There are also some lodge tents and chalets for rent. The sanitary facilities are clean and modern.

Summer water fun

Le Val de Saures does not have its own swimming pool, but a few minutes' walk away there is a large municipal swimming pool with paddling pools and sunbathing areas. The pool is open in July and August.

Do you like canoeing, kayaking or just a refreshing dive in natural water? You can do that in the river. At some places near the campsite, the slope to the water is quite steep, so find a good spot to get into the water. There is a canoe centre close to the campsite.

Pleasant summer evenings

In July and August, when it is a bit busier, some activities are organised for children and adults. Sometimes there is a music evening. Furthermore, the children can play freely in two playgrounds and the covered recreation room. In high season there is sometimes a market at the campsite with delicious local products.

properties.name: Camping Ferienparadies Natterer See
properties.description:
Close to the city of Innsbrück, still in the tranquillity of the countryside, lies this beautiful campsite with the most modern amenities. Ergo.. a cinema as well as a fun 'children's washland' with TV screens. Driving through small mountain villages you will reach Ferienparadies Natterer See with its breathtaking view of the private lake and the majestic Alps. When you enter the grounds, you will see a spacious, neatly laid out campsite.

The camping pitches here vary between 55 and 155 m, offering you a choice between a cosy pitch or all the room you need for you and your family. You can also opt for a spot by the lake. Furthermore, you can spend the night in a mobile home, apartment or a so-called 'sleeping barrel'. Glamping is yet another possibility.

In and around the campsite

At Ferienparadies Natterer See you will mainly see families with young children or teenagers during your camping holiday. They can enjoy themselves for days on end on and around the campsite's lake. There is a wide variety of play equipment on the lake. You can also rent a boat or do a bit of canoeing.

Sanitary facilities

The modern sanitary building offers everything you need. There are family bathrooms that provide the necessary privacy, but there is also a special 'children's washland' with TV screens where the little ones will enjoy brushing their teeth.

Innsbrück

Innsbrück, capital of the Alps, is easy to reach with the free shuttle-bus, which leaves from the campsite. You will find the glorious, old Austrian inner city here as well as a castle from the fifteenth century.

properties.name: Camping Alpenparadies Mayrhofen
properties.description:
Green meadows, tinkling cowbells and high mountains; on campsite Mayrhofen you camp amidst a typical Tyrolean landscape. There is a special raised area where motorhomes can stand with a panoramic view. There is a fine restaurant on the campsite with local dishes and a heated outdoor pool which you can use throughout the year.

When you arrive at the campsite, you will hardly notice the campsite itself. The first sight coming from the valley is that of gigantic mountain ranges facing you.

Fun in summer and winter

In summer this campsite lends itself perfectly to a cycling trip through the mountains, rafting down the river or an exciting canyoning trip. In winter, when the mountains and valley are mostly covered with a thick layer of snow, it is a veritable Valhalla for the winter sports enthusiast. During the day, you swish down the pistes and later in the afternoon, you will enjoy a nice drink during the after-ski. The campsite is also geared to winter sports enthusiasts. There is a drying area for your gear and a special ski boot heater to dry your wet shoes.

Restaurant Denggerhof

Local specialities, a nice piece of meat or something from the international kitchen; you can find it all in restaurant Denggerhof. In summer you can join a lovely grill evening with live music from the Zillertal, and this soon turns into a real Tyrolean party. If you want some extra comfort, you can choose to have a buffet breakfast in the restaurant for an additional fee.

properties.name: Camping Zaton Holiday Resort
properties.description:
1 km from the historic town of Nin, the oldest town in Croatia, you'll find the four star campsite Zaton Holiday Resort. This super equipped campsite is located on a flat property full of pine trees. Also nice: the location in a lovely bay of the Adriatic Sea with slowly sloping sea floor.

First impression

This large campsite has touring pitches, camper pitches and rental accommodations (mobile homes and glamping tents). The prices vary by zone. Despite the fact that the property is very spread out, there is a very relaxing atmosphere on the campsite. Beforehand take into consideration that all of the pitches come with advantages and disadvantages regarding walking distances to the campsite facilities.

Lovely pitches

Spacious campsites (80 - 120 m2) for tents and caravans are under (pine) trees and another area for the larger caravans is marked by young trees. The pitches have sandy ground, sometimes with grass.

To the swimming paradise or to the paradise-like beach?

Without exaggeration, you can call the swimming paradise exceptional. There is a large central swimming pool (with deeper water) with six smaller pools around it, all varying in size and depth. There are terraces with loungers and parasols everywhere. Children will have endless fun with the creative play equipment and slides. Or go to the lovely wide beach and swim in the clear and calm sea. 

Activities and fun

There are numerous activities organized for all ages (aerobics, surfing lessons, etc.) There are also evening performances with song and dance. Great for parents.

properties.name: Wirthshof Resort
properties.description:
Campsite Wirtshof is located in the southernmost part of Germany, where Switzerland, Austria and Germany converge. This large campsite is only 5 km away from Lake Constance, the large lake which connects the three countries with each other. This is a genuine family campsite: a place for an active play holiday for children and relaxation therapy for parents.

Playgrounds

The large indoor playground is one of the attractive features of the campsite. And when the weather is too good to stay inside, there is also some outdoor climbing equipment. Or children can participate in the entertainment activities which are organised each week in summer.

Wellness of top quality

Thus, while the children amuse themselves in the indoor playground or are being entertained, you can completely relax in the wellness building. Here you can enjoy a Finnish sauna, a Roman steam bath and massages. 

German beaches

If you believe that there are no beaches in the south of Germany, think again. Some seven km south of the campsite you will find Lake Constance. And this vast lake does, in fact, have beaches. Obviously it is not the Costa Brava, but there is sufficient space to sunbathe and soak up the sun.

properties.name: Tirol Camp
properties.description:
Snow in winter, sun in summer and always mountains in the surroundings for a sporty holiday. Tirol Camp in Fieberbrunn meets all the requirements and is furthermore located next to the cable cars of Fieberbrunn, which take you to the most beautiful spots for walking or skiing. The campsite is only a ten-minute walk away from Fieberbrunn.

The pitches on Tirol Camp are spacious and are laid out on several terraces. You can hire private sanitary facilities at the comfort-plus pitches.

Tirol Camp: more than just a campsite

In addition to the camping pitches, there are also modern and fully equipped apartments available for rent. These have a balcony or terrace and always have a superb view of the mountains of the Kitzbühel Alps.

Sports and wellness

If you like walking, this is the place for you. There are ample walking routes through the mountains, always with magnificent panoramas. And how nice is it to relax at the end of the day in the swimming pool or to be pampered with a massage in the wellness complex. You can do this all year long, summer and winter, because there is a covered pool and the sauna is nice and warm.

Stylish sanitary facilities

One of the two sanitary buildings on the campsite is housed underneath the reception. The ladies section is beautifully furnished with red leather bar stools and special make-up mirrors. They also have sanitary facilities for children.

Adventurous climbing wall

There is a cheerfully coloured 'chill bus' filled with games, especially for youngsters. You can also go on the internet or just 'chill' here. The climbing wall will undoubtedly attract the daredevils among the camping guests.

properties.name: Bären-Camp
properties.description:
Campsite Bären-Camp is located in a bend of the Moselle river. Here, you have views of steep hillsides covered with vineyards. The grounds are situated right next to the town of Bullay. You will find eating establishments and a supermarket within walking distance. From your lazy camping chair, you can watch the excursion boats and river boats slowly pass by. Along the Moselle river lie countless historical towns with age-old timbered houses. You won't have to look far to find a good glass of wine in this region...

Terrace with river views

The elongated campsite grounds are well-tended. The pitches are divided among five different camping fields which are connected with each other. The reception is housed in a small wooden cabin on wheels situated at the front of the campsite. Here, you will also find a small shop and a restaurant with a lovely large outdoor terrace, where you can dine with views of the river.

Swimming in the Moselle river

The camping pitches are numbered and are practically unmarked. The size varies from 70 to 100m2. There are only a few trees on the grounds so most of the camping pitches are situated in the full sun. A PodHouse is also available to rent at the campsite, which is a small wooden house for two people where you can camp in style. A cycling path separates the campsite from the Moselle river. You can swim in the river here. It is also possible to launch your own boat.

Dated but tidy

The sanitary facilities are somewhat dated but are neat and tidy. There are two shower blocks: one in the front and one halfway down on the campsite grounds.

properties.name: Camping Worriken
properties.description:
Looking for a campsite amidst nature not too far from charming small towns? Then come to Campsite Worriken in the Belgian Ardennes. It offers opportunities for walking, cycling, kayaking and skiing, yet with towns such as Malmedy and Monschau in close vicinity. Not to forget taking a refreshing dive in the reservoir. In high season, lovely activities are organised for children. In addition, you can take an archery lesson or learn how to handle a kayak.

First impression

Once you arrive at the campsite, you will notice that you have a view of the reservoir from every angle of Camping Worriken. Practically the first sight you come across is the gabled roofs of the rental chalets. A bit further along, just after the bend, are the camping pitches. The tourist pitches are laid out in terraces, ensuring an uninterrupted beautiful view of the lake. 

Recommendations for city trips

Malmedy is a perfect destination for a day trip. This town, nestling between the hills, has several charming little squares. Half an hour's drive away, just over the German border, lies the picturesque town of Monschau. A very attractive town with half-timbered houses and a historic centre.

A drink and a bite to eat

After a city trip or an active walking or cycling trip, you will enjoy a well-deserved drink in the restaurant. Or head for the snack bar and treat yourself to an ice cream or snack from the deep fryer.

Open throughout the year

Camping Worriken is open throughout the year. In summer for a refreshing dive in in the reservoir and in winter for a ski run on one of the nearby pistes. This makes this campsite in the Ardennes very special.

properties.name: Camping Omisalj
properties.description:
In the northernmost tip of the island of Krk, directly on the Adriatic Sea, lies camp Omišalj. With a panoramic swimming pool, luxurious rental accommodations (some with a private pool) and a sanitary building with royal allure, this is a five-star campsite for the luxury camper.

Luxury pitches and rental accommodations

Don't expect lush woodland or rugged nature at camp Omišalj: everything about the campsite is neatly laid-out. The campsite is slightly terraced, the height differences are marked by small stone walls. Plants and flowers separate the pitches. There is little shade, as the terrain is fairly bare. This allows you to enjoy the view of the Adriatic Sea from your camping pitch. 

You also have the choice to stay in one of the fully equipped mobile homes. They have air conditioning (fine during hot summer days) and some of these mobile homes even have a (partially) private swimming pool.

Beach and panorama swimming pool

The campsite stretches along the pebble beach of the artificially constructed Pušća Bay. The water is shallow and crystal-clear. It's ideal for a leisurely swim and children can play safely. The campsite swimming pool is close to the beach. From this long pool, where you can swim fine laps, you have a panoramic view of the Adriatic Sea. There is a toddler pool for little swimmers.

Culinary camping

At the poolside is the large restaurant, where several Mediterranean meals are served. If you'd like to try out being the campsite chef, you can find everything you need for a home-made meal in your caravan or camper in the supermarket on the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Le Soleil
properties.description:
Campsite Le Soleil is a large green campsite of ten hectares. The campsite is located in the village of Argelès-sur-Mer in the extreme south of France. This is the place for you if you love sun and water fun. That's what you'll find in the large swimming pool complex on the campsite, but you are also close to the beach. The campsite has a nicely stocked shop and a popular restaurant.

Varied pitches and accommodations

The pitches on the campsite are not all the same size. As a camper, you always have a pitch of 90 m2 or more. The pitches are clearly demarcated with trees and shrubs. There are also more than four hundred mobile homes on the Le Soleil campsite. These vary in size and luxury. 

In several areas on the campsite the pathways have been adapted to assist the blind and visually impaired in finding their way around.

Plenty of fun for everyone

No lack of fun here! Indulge yourself on the climbing wall, the multi-sports field, the jeu-de-boules pitch, the beach volleyball field, the golf course or at the table tennis table. In addition, there is also a bouncy castle, a trampoline and a playground.

No inspiration at the moment? Camping guests of all ages can take part in the entertainment. At least twice a week in the high season you can take part in all kinds of activities such as crafts, sports tournaments, (dance) shows, disco and a fair.

Swimming fun

The swimming pool is very spacious (1500 m2) and heated. It is playfully laid out. In the swimming pool complex there are also a few nice wading pools, a slide, jacuzzi and massage fountains. There is also a special chair so that the disabled can also get into the pool.

properties.name: Aminess Planet Camping Maravea Resort
properties.description:
Aminess Maravea Camping Resort is located on the Adriatic Sea, close to Novigrad. A small train runs several times a day between the campsite and Novigrad so you can leave your car at home. From the campsite, you will have a lovely view of the water. The resort has a swimming complex with children's pool, beautiful sunbathing area and modern sanitary facilities.

Camping freely in nature or on a marked pitch

The campsite is well-organised, with many different camping pitches, ranging from freestanding nature pitches to luxury pitches with water points and drainage. The level of privacy depends on which pitch you have booked. There are numbered, marked pitches separated by hedges and shrubs, but there are also numbered unmarked pitches. You can choose from spots with plenty or little shade. The mobile homes of the campsite are gathered in themed villages, surrounded by nature.

Cycling along the Istrian coast

The campsite is particularly suitable for families with children. There is sufficient entertainment in the peak season and events are organised as well. There are plenty of sports opportunities on the campsite, such as football, tennis and basketball. From the campsite, you can also go cycling or jogging along the Istrian coast.

Swimming in a salt-water swimming pool

Directly by the sea is a salt-water swimming pool with a separate area for small children. The campsite also has a pool complex with seven additional pools.

Supermarket and restaurants

There is a supermarket on the campsite for your daily groceries. Fresh bread is available daily at the on-site bakery. At the water's edge, you will find an excellent restaurant with an extensive menu featuring grill and fish dishes. The terrace near the campsite is covered and offers amazing views of the sea. A second (à la carte) restaurant is located in the centre of the campsite.

properties.name: Campingplatz Moselwunder
properties.description:
This is a nice family campsite near the town of Pommern in Rheinland-Palatine. This region is renowned for the beautiful landscape of the Moselle, the activity on the water, historic towns, the hillside vineyards and the hustle and bustle of wine festivals and wine tastings. The town of Pommern lies within walking distance. There are several nice, historic cities and attractive towns in the area. You can visit castles and fortresses, walk in the Hunsrück or follow the lovely cycling route along the Moselle.

Spacious pitches

The terrain is elongated and lies directly on the Moselle. The camping pitches are spacious and some of them offer a view of the river.

Beautiful swimming pools with terrace

There are two heated outdoor swimming pools on the campsite. Surrounding the pools there is a terrace with sun loungers and sun umbrellas. Enjoy a bite to eat or a drink while overlooking the pool and the river a bit further on.

Restaurant and fresh bread rolls

The restaurant is located in the reception building. There is also a snack bar and a small supermarket where you can buy essential groceries. Every morning, the baker delivers fresh bread rolls to the campsite.

Historic sites and imposing castles

As well as Pommern, which is within walking distance, Cochem and Koblenz are also lovely places to visit. There are also several beautiful castles in the area, such as Burg Eltz. The Eifel and Hunsrück regions offer lovely walks, and are also a must-visit for gemstone enthusiasts. Enjoy the beautiful landscape by taking a cycle ride along the Moselle.

properties.name: Camping Serenella
properties.description:
This immaculate family campsite is situated on the eastern shore of Lake Garda, only one km from the historical towns of Bardolino and Garda. The campsite is situated directly on Lake Garda, at the foot of the hills. The campsite has recently been partly renovated, so you can now enjoy the beautiful new swimming pool and restaurant.

Enjoy the shade

The pitches on Camping Serenella differ in size. They have a more or less compacted surface and are demarcated by trees and bushes. Prefer not to sit in the sun? No problem; there are sufficient pitches with ample shade from the many trees on the grounds. It can get pleasantly crowded on this popular campsite. Are you sure you have enough space? You may want to hire a mobile home or apartment.

Go for a swim or do something else?

The beautiful, new swimming pool is located at the far end of the campsite near the restaurant. In the centre of the pool is some fun water play equipment with three slides. Your neighbours on this campsite are mainly families with children. In peak season there is also an entertainment programme for children.

The campsite is located directly on Lake Garda where you can swim to your heart's content. The lake shore here is a meadow. You can get there via the back exit of the campsite, which crosses the walking and cycling promenade to Bardolino and Garda.

Fine food and drink

The campsite shop has the size of a supermarket and is well stocked. The restaurant has a good reputation and an excellent menu. You can eat inside (in the attractive conservatory) or outside on the comfortable terrace.

properties.name: Camping Village Butterfly
properties.description:
Camping Butterfly is situated on the extreme south-eastern tip of Lake Garda, close to the historic centre of the attractive fortress town of Peschiera del Garda. This corner is teeming with campsites, which are very busy in summer. Tourists flock to Lake Garda with all its water fun attractions, the beautiful towns along the banks, the mountainous surrounding area, the large amusement parks and beautiful cities like Verona and Brescia.

Small and uncluttered

Butterfly is a small, neatly laid out campsite with an extensive range of rental accommodation. The grounds are level and the section with touring pitches is located near the swimming pool and the restaurant. The pitches vary in size and the many trees offer ample shade. The grounds are partly sand and partly grass. The rental accommodation (mobile homes and six-person bungalows) have a well-maintained appearance.

Plenty to do

In summer there is an entertainment programme for children aged 4 to 12. There is a lovely playground for the little ones. The centrally located swimming pool is suitable to swim a few laps. In addition, there is a separate children's pool. You get to the beach by crossing the road from the exit of the campsite. At the campsite is a nice restaurant with terrace and a comprehensive menu (takeaway service also available).

Sanitary facilities

The sanitary facilities at the campsite are basic, but are kept neat and tidy.

Exploring the area

The attractive centre of Peschiera is within walking distance. There is a nice weekly market on Mondays. Surrounding Lake Garda you will find numerous attractive towns, often also accessible by ferry, for instance, Sirmione, which is located on a peninsula (19 km).

properties.name: Aminess Planet Camping Sirena Resort
properties.description:
Aminess Planet Camping Sirena Resort lies in a quiet location on a beautiful bay of the Adriatic Sea. This four-star campsite in Istria is a veritable camping paradise for those seeking peace and offers a splendid view of the sea, also from the pitches.

Camping pitches by the sea

Like to catch every ray of sun during your holiday on campsite Sirena Resort? If so, opt for a spacious pitch located right on the beach. These pitches offer no shade, but instead a splendid view of the sea! Prefer some shade on the camping pitch? There are ample pitches located between pines. The sanitary facilities are easily accessible to all. They have special sanitary facilities for children and disabled persons.

From each pitch on the campsite you can quickly reach the beach for a refreshing dip. The beach is rather rocky, but there are a number of plateaus where you can sunbathe. There is also a small gravel beach. If you are interested, the campsite also has rental mobile homes.

Campsite for seekers of peace and quiet

Camping Sirena Resort is predominantly a campsite for seekers of peace and quiet. Do not expect a comprehensive entertainment programme here. Some nice activities are organised, but only on a small scale. To get a taste of the local cuisine you don't need to leave the campsite. In the camping restaurant you have a selection of various regional dishes. On top of that, from the restaurant you have a view of the sea. You don't have to travel far for your daily shopping. There is a nice supermarket only 500 m from the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Playa de Poniente S.L.
properties.description:
In Andalusia, Spain, you will enjoy a relaxed beach holiday at Camping Playa de Poniente S.L. You benefit from lots of amenities, such as a swimming pool, athletic fields and an extensive entertainment programme during the high season. The surrounding area has lots of activities to do, such as a visit to the Sierras of Tejeda nature park.

Shade under the Spanish sun

Campsite visitors at Camping Playa de Poniente S.L. stay on spacious pitches. To help keep you cool under the Spanish sun, shade sails have been hung above the pitches. The campsite also has many trees. You can also choose to stay in a wooden chalet. All chalets have their own kitchen and toilet and washing facilities. The communal toilet building has special toilet and washing facilities for children. There are family showers, low toilets and baby baths.

Cooling off in the swimming pool and the sea

Just cross the road to walk right onto the beach and towards the azure blue sea! If you would rather swim in a swimming pool, there is a large swimming pool available. Young campsite guests can amuse themselves in the playground and an entertainment team is present during the high season. The evenings are often filled with live music and shows.

Day trip to Granada and Málaga

We recommend visiting the beautiful city of Granada (70 km) for a day trip. This city houses the Moorish Alhambra palace, one of the most famous monuments in Spain. Nerja (38.5 km) and Málaga (93.5 km) are also worth visiting and there are plenty of great beaches and villages to be found near the campsite.

properties.name: Camping L'Argentière
properties.description:
Just a twenty-minute drive from Saint-Tropez, in a wooded and protected nature reserve, lies the campsite L'Argentière. This beautiful four-star campsite is particularly well looked after and has a pleasant atmosphere. There are olive trees, palms and oleanders everywhere, and the many deciduous trees provide sufficient shade on the campsite.

Shaded camping pitches

The campsite with its many trees looks almost park-like. Camping L'Argentière has one hundred touring pitches and fifty permanent annual pitches, which are located on a separate part of the campsite. The pitches for touring campers are not all equally large, but they are wonderfully shady and situated on the grass. 

Lovely pool

Behind the reception are two beautiful swimming pools, a large paddling pool and a whirlpool. These heated outdoor pools (heated from mid-April) are surrounded by a spacious sun deck with plenty of sun loungers and fun thatched parasols. There is a triple water slide. In the paddling pool are all kinds of fun water jets and a playground.

A comfortable stay

As befits a real family campsite, L'Argentière is fully equipped. There are several restaurants of excellent quality, you can do your daily shopping and in high season there is professional entertainment for young and old. In principle, you do not have to leave the campsite, because everything is available for a comfortable stay.

If you do want to go out, there is plenty to do. The campsite is located in a nature reserve where you can go for lovely walks. Or get on your bike and ride from Port-Grimaud to Saint-Tropez via a beautifully laid-out cycle path, completely closed off from the road and overlooking the Mediterranean Sea.

properties.name: HolaCamp Albufeira
properties.description:
In the south of Portugal (the Algarve), close to the coast, you will find campsite Albufeira. This is a friendly family campsite with many hibernators during low season. The terrain slopes slightly but has flat pitches. The atmosphere is convivial and hospitable and there is a nice balance between activities and peace and quiet. The campsite is attractively located amidst a hilly landscape with interesting villages.

A pleasant, green campsite

On your way to the campsite you see a spacious field with beautiful swimming pools in the centre. You may choose one of the various (shaded and sunny) pitches. Albufeira is a campsite where you will soon feel at home. There is little demarcation between the pitches, but there are a large number of trees and plants. You camp on a hard, flat surface. In addition to camping pitches, there are rental mobile homes and bungalows.

Swimming and sunbathing

The swimming pools are located in full sun. From here you have a splendid view of the area. There is a toddler pool and and there are sufficient loungers around the pools. You can order a snack or a drink from the nearby restaurant. The beach is a few km down the road.

Regional products and sanitary facilities

The campsite has a good and affordable restaurant with a small and an extensive menu. There is a supermarket with a reasonably large selection and a choice of fresh food. You will also find good regional products here. There is a recreation hall for shows and parties. The sanitary facilities are spacious and clean and are divided over a number of blocks. There are special facilities for babies, children and disabled persons.

properties.name: Südsee-Camp
properties.description:
Do you want to camp at a perfectly maintained campsite on the Lünenburger Heide, you can at the Südsee-Camp. You will find a subtropical swimming paradise, recreational lake, several restaurants, and many other facilities at this extensive park. Families will find everything their heart desires here, from playground to riding school.

Large campsite, small scale feeling

Südsee-Camp is a large campsite with over seven hundred pitches, five hundred annual pitches and about two hundred rental accommodations such as mobile homes, chalets or Swedish cottages. There are also separate motorhome pitches. And yet, it doesn't feel so large. The campsite is divided into different themes with their own sanitary facilities, washrooms and playgrounds. There is a lot of green on the site, so you can choose whether you want to stand under the trees or in an open field.

Subtropical swimming paradise

Swimming between the palms and banana trees, you can do that in the beautiful subtropical swimming paradise with a pirate ship, slides, wild watercourse and wave pool. You can also warm up in the sauna. In summer, you can enjoy wonderful days on the beach at the large lake, the campsite's centre. Thanks to the fine beach and the fun playground equipment, you can enjoy yourself endlessly in and around the water.

Several restaurants

Although we can certainly recommend exploring the beautiful surroundings, you don't have to leave the park for your daily needs. There are several restaurants, bars and a campsite shop with its own bakery. Whether you fancy a snack, takeaway, a cup of coffee or a three-course meal, you'll find it all at this campsite.

properties.name: Eurocamping Pacengo
properties.description:
Eurocamping Pacengo lies near Pacengo village in a picturesque landscape. This green terraced campsite, near the water, offers many good facilities: a large swimming pool, a terrace with a view of Lake Garda and its own boat dock. You can walk straight onto the wide pebble beach from your pitch.

In a green setting

There are several paved roads throughout the campsite. The pitches are located along these roads on terraces that are divided into zones. Some pitches are right by the lake. Most of the pitches are spacious and shady.

Eating Italian

A delicious pizza with a view of the lake and the surrounding mountains. You don't have to leave the campsite to enjoy this. Restaurant Senzanome works magic to place tasty dishes on its tables every day. Lunch here is pure enjoyment as well. Be sure to sit on the terrace a time to watch the sun go down.

Large swimming pool

The swimming pool is reasonably central in the higher section. It is a beautiful sight when the oleanders around the swimming pool are in bloom. Small children can splash in the separate shallow section of the swimming pool and even have their own slide.

You have direct access to the wide pebble beach from the campsite. It is only a short distance to walk to take a refreshing dip in the blue water.

Disco for kids

During the summer holiday, there is something to experience every day at this child-friendly campsite. Games in the water, disco evenings, a Chinese lantern parade, talent shows and dress-up parties. At the end of May and the end of July, you can visit the fair, located next to the campsite, which makes for quite a spectacle.

properties.name: Camping Bonanza 1
properties.description:
On the Belgian coast, on the outskirts of the renowned coastal resort of Blankenberge, you will find the well-maintained family campsite Bonanza 1. The Belgian coast is well-known for its microclimate with significant less rain than further inland, and when it gets very hot in summer, it is always a few degrees cooler on the coast. Besides Germans, French and a few Dutch tourists, most of the holidaymakers are Belgian.

Family campsite

Bonanza 1 looks well-maintained; the paths are paved, the grass is trimmed and the pitches are fairly large. Even so, the campsite does not offer many facilities. However, there is a bar-bistro for a snack and a drink with a sun terrace overlooking one of the playgrounds for the little ones. There is no campsite shop, but the nearest supermarket is within walking distance (500 m).

Sanitary facilities

The sanitary facilities in the two ablution blocks are excellent. They are kept spotless, but they are cleaned between 21:00 - 12:00, so that certain sections are closed off during those hours. It is therefore handy to shower before then in the evening.

Where are we?

Blankenberge is a lively, touristy coastal resort. Both the centre and the beach can be reached on foot from the campsite (approx. 20-minute walk). Besides the beach and the pier, Blankenberge offers numerous attractions, a casino and endless numbers of bistros and beach bars.

A special attraction is the coastal tram, which follows the Belgian coastline from De Panne to Knokke-Heist. The hinterland of Blankenberge consists of polders where you can go for walks or cycling trips. And to top it all, the magnificent historical town of Bruges is only 13 km away.

properties.name: Camping Strasko
properties.description:
A large and modern reception welcomes the many campers looking for accommodation, especially in high season. After passing the barrier, you enter a large terrain, where you may need a bit of time to find your way around. But you will soon see that at Camping Strasko many measures have been implemented to ensure a comfortable stay: several shops, bars, restaurants, a long promenade and a wide (pebble) beach.

The pitches are spacious, demarcated and located between trees that offer much or, if preferred, less shade. A number of pitches are located at the sea. Holiday guests have everywhere access to amenities such as water, electricity, drainage and wireless internet connection. Furthermore, you can hire tents, mobile homes and bungalows, often located near the beach of the camping.

Sports activities or relaxing

For children and adults who like to be active, the campsite has a playground, indoor playground and sports field. The sporty holiday maker can go on excursions or make use of various cycle routes from the campsite. There is an entertainment programme, fitness room, whirlpool and beauty centre.

The campsite also has an outdoor swimming pool and a toddler pool. If you prefer salt water, you can of course swim in the sea. There you will also enjoy snorkelling, windsurfing or waterskiing.

If you don't feel like cooking a meal, you have a wide choice with a snack bar, pizzeria, restaurant with small menu and a restaurant with extensive menu. There are several small shops and a fairly large supermarket for your daily needs. The sanitary facilities on the campsite are neat and are well and regularly cleaned.

properties.name: Camping Bi-Village
properties.description:
On the west coast of the Croatian peninsula Istria lies Bi-Village camping resort. This large four-star campsite is spacious, stretching over at least 25 hectares. The spacious design and modern conveniences ensure a luxurious ambiance. Bi-Village can rightly be called a village with its shops, restaurants, approximately thousand pitches as well as almost five hundred rental accommodations. The campsite is right next to the sea and has three swimming pools.

Holiday village

The spacious pitches are lined up in rows along the straight gravel paths in the shade of the many trees. There are at least six different camping fields, each with its own toilet block. The pitches are not always level, but they are clearly demarcated. There is a separate field for tents. This tent field is the farthest from the sea, but it is right next to the swimming pool and the athletic fields. You can select your own pitch. If you prefer peace and quiet, choose a (somewhat) quieter section of the campsite.

Swimming in fresh and salt water

This campsite offers wonderful swimming in the clear water of the Adriatic Sea as well as in one of the swimming pools. Bi-Village has no fewer than three outdoor swimming pools. Two of them are located in the bungalow park and are surrounded by rental locations. You must walk to the other side of the campsite for these. The third swimming pool is next to the athletic fields and the tent field: the Garden Pool. There is a separate wading pool for the little ones and a lovely sun deck.

properties.name: Camping Caravan Park Sexten
properties.description:
Natural stone floors in the toilet and washing facilities, luxury accommodation, wine tasting and a range of wellness facilities. It should be clear that Camping Caravan Park Sexten is a perfect holiday address for glamping enthusiasts. Thanks to its location in a wonderfully quiet spot in a natural setting, this is a perfect place to completely unwind. Camping Caravan Park Sexten is also an ideal starting point for exploring the natural beauty of the Dolomites (South Tyrol).

Luxury accommodation and spacious camping pitches

Anyone who likes to stay in luxury accommodation is in the right place at this resort. After all, at Camping Caravan Park Sexten, you can book overnight stays in an apartment, hotel room, lodge, chalet or tree house. All accommodation are stylishly furnished. You can of course also come here to camp. There are various small-scale camping fields with spacious touring pitches.

Swimming, playing and enjoying culinary masterpieces

Camping Caravan Park Sexten has a lovely swimming pool where you can go swimming for a small extra charge. You can enjoy the playfully landscaped basic swimming pool and various hot tubs. The youngest guests will have plenty of fun in the miniature cinema, the playground and the kids' club. There is also a shop and five quality restaurants at this resort.

Enjoy the imposing natural beauty of the Dolomites

Walking, cycling, mountain biking, mountain climbing, paragliding and white water rafting. And of course skiing and cross-country skiing. You can do it all in the immediate vicinity of Sexten, and in one of the most beautiful and most rugged nature areas in Italy. You could also simply drive round and stop here and there to enjoy the panoramic views.

properties.name: Camping Villaggio San Francesco
properties.description:
Near the fishing town of Caorle, Camping Villaggio San Francesco is situated in a beautiful pine forest, right on the Adriatic Sea coast. You can enjoy a great holiday here, full of fun in the water, in the swimming pool and the sea, real Italian cuisine, and a comprehensive entertainment programme. And you can even bring your dog. Camping Villaggio San Francesco looks out over the clear water of the Adriatic, and is surrounded by hundreds of pine trees. A wonderful location with a Mediterranean atmosphere. Tip: go on a day trip to Venice. It's less than an hour's drive to the Floating City.

A complete holiday package

Even if you choose to spend the whole holiday at the campsite, you won't be bored. There are plenty of different places to spend the night. You could choose one of the various different pitches, or one of the many rental cottages - close to the pool, the beach, or the playground. Chalets, mobile homes, apartments: you can spend the night in luxurious surroundings. The campsite offers all the facilities you'll need for the total holiday package. With four swimming pools and the aqua park with huge water slides ensure plenty of fun in the water, while the entertainment team and trampolines make sure there's enough to do out of the water as well. You can also take lessons in football, tennis, archery, martial arts and more.

Something for everyone

Everything at the campsite is designed for people with disabilities. There are special ramps and lifts to make sure that people in wheelchairs can also enjoy the pool and the beach. This is how the campsite earned the quality award 'Village for All'.

properties.name: Camping Sunêlia Les Pins
properties.description:
Camping Les Pins lies close to the centre of the popular resort of Argelès-Plage. You camp here in a six-hectare green oasis of pines (les Pins) and palm trees. Have a refreshing swim in the attractive swimming pool and enjoy a bite to eat in the camping restaurant. A lovely feature of this campsite is its tranquillity, while the lively centre of Argelès-Plage lies just around the corner.

Camping in the shade and various types of accommodation

Campsite Les Pins has more than hundred touring pitches each measuring between 85 and 95m2. The pitches are demarcated with vegetation and offer ample shade from the pine trees on the grounds. The grassland here is great for camping. Don't have a camper van, caravan or tent? If so, you can rent one of the rental accommodation units, including chalets, caravans and mobile homes.

Cultural festivals, sports and relaxation

In summer there is an entertainment programme for both adults and children. A disco is organised on some evenings. So, hit that dance floor! Adults will really appreciate the Sunday Social (with Sangria), as well as the organised walking and cycling excursions.

Campsite Les Pins is also the place to be for sports activities. There is a multi sports field for soccer, basketball and volleyball. Additionally: a table tennis table and pétanque pitch. For some well-needed relaxation you can head for the wellness centre. Here you can enjoy one of the massages.

Fun in the water

The swimming pool of campsite Les Pins is not overly large (250 m2), but is beautifully designed and heated. There is also a slide and a toddler pool. For even more water fun there is the sea, of course.

properties.name: Camping Les Arches
properties.description:
On the sociable, child-friendly Camping Les Arches you will find much greenery, peace, space and hospitality. It is situated against a hill in a rural part of the Ardèche. The Claduègne river flows through the campsite and divides the campsite in two. By constructing a dam in the river in summer, a beautiful natural swimming lake with waterfall is created.

Splendid views

The campsite is well maintained, playfully and spaciously designed with a diverse vegetation of trees and shrubs. A river flows through the campsite. On one side of the water is the old section with lots of greenery and privacy. The newer section offers a splendid view, but less shade and privacy due to the young vegetation. Want to rent something? The accommodation units (mainly chalets) are spread over the campsite.

Natural swimming lake

There is a heated swimming pool with a separate children's section, surrounded by sun loungers, sun umbrellas and flowers. The largest attraction of the camping is the natural swimming pool which the owners create themselves by construction a dam in the river. Next to it is a natural grass and pebble beach.

Tractor rides

The campsite has several playgrounds, soccer fields, jeu-de-boule pitches, table tennis tables and a volleyball field. In high season a lot of attention is paid to children. For instance, Patrick, the owner, offers children a ride on his tractor. There is also a crafts afternoon twice a week, and there are guided walks and communal meals.

Campsite restaurant

There is a wide choice available in the camping restaurant with covered terrace. They also have ice cream and take-away meals. There is bread service.

properties.name: Camping Cros de Mouton
properties.description:
Camping Cros de Mouton is a terraced campsite at high altitude with a panoramic view of the Mediterranean Sea. The campsite, consisting of eight terraces, is laid out against a hill overlooking the bay of Cavalaire-sur-Mer. You camp here on pitches which are surrounded by palm trees and oleanders. With a sizeable swimming pool, the Mediterranean within walking distance and lively Saint-Tropez only half an hour's drive away, this campsite has everything you could ask for.

Camping with a view

The pitches on Cros de Mouton are level, but the pathways between the various terraces are rather steep. The lower lying pitches are more spacious than higher up. However, you have the most beautiful view of the bay from the camping pitches at the top. The vegetation is kept well pruned, therefore you do not have to worry that your view will be obstructed. 

A bit of a climb

If you are staying on one of the lower terraces, you're in for a bit of a climb. If you're not used to this, you will certainly get enough practice during your holiday. This is because it is quite a steep walk to the restaurant or swimming pool. Fortunately, each terrace is equipped with sanitary facilities. 

Fun in the water for young and old

The swimming pools of the campsite have a superb view. Your little ones can amuse themselves for hours on end in the spacious toddler pool with its fun water play equipment, sprayers and a little house with a water slide in the centre of the pool. Both this pool and the large pool have plenty loungers around them. 

At the large pool there is also a separate pool for children which is shallower. In addition, there are two whirlpools where you can enjoy the bubbles, whilst admiring the view of the bay below.

properties.name: Campofelice Camping Village
properties.description:
Campofelice Camping Village is considered to be one of the best and most beautiful campsites in Switzerland. On this large, luxuriously equipped campsite everything is of high quality: the rental accommodation, the entertainment programme, the restaurant and the ambiance. The campsite is bordered on two sides by water; water therefore features largely here.

Top campsite in Switzerland

At the entrance is a high rise apartment complex which belongs to the campsite. The reception is large with modern interior and has a large number of employees. At a glance you can see that the grounds are not only extensive, but also well kept. This camping is considered to be one of the top campsites of Switzerland.

Pitches

The pitches, situated on level terrain, are spacious and laid out in rows along parallel, paved pathways. The pitches are partly/partly not separated by hedges. Everywhere on the campsite are pine trees and deciduous trees, hence it is easy to find a nice spot in the shade. There are all types of rental facilities, such as the beautifully designed and contemporary styled bungalows/mobile homes.

Who are the visitors of this campsite?

The campsite is child-friendly (numerous play facilities) and is therefore popular with families with children of all ages. Most guests of Campofelice are fervent water sports or water fun enthusiasts.

Water and other entertainment

The campsite has a swimming pool with whirlpool and children's area. Sunbathing and water fun is also available at and on the lake. The campsite is for a large part situated along the water. There is play equipment for children along the water's edge. There is a safe, fenced-off area for the tiny ones. High-quality entertainment is provided for more than 50 hours/week (crafts, drawing, games, theatre).

properties.name: Camping Tiglio
properties.description:
The Tiglio campsite is located on the south bank of Lake Garda. This child-friendly campsite has camping pitches, rental tents and apartments with a private balcony. Head to the restaurant to enjoy homemade tiramisu and the homemade Pilandro wine. The swimming pools are located next to the restaurant and playground.

Apartments with a balcony

The open touring pitches and rental tents are centrally located on the water. The camping pitches are approximately 80 m2 and have little demarcation. This way you can easily get to know your camping neighbours better. The trees around the camping pitches provide some shade. Only the pitches along the water's edge have a bit less shade. You will find the apartments on the outside of the campsite, each with its own balcony.

Catering

The Tiglio campsite is a culinary feast with many homemade products. The camp shop has a wide assortment where you can not only get fresh bread, but you can also buy Pilandro wine from their own vineyard. And in the restaurant, you can, of course, opt for a (takeaway) pizza, but you can also enjoy homemade tiramisu. From the terrace, you can easily keep an eye on the children while they have fun on the equipment in the playground.

Swimming pool and Lake Garda

Next to the restaurant is the swimming pool, surrounded by sun loungers and parasols. The pool gradually deepens and is also suitable for swimming laps with a length of 25 metres. For the children, there are two separate swimming pools with colourful play equipment and slides next to the large pool. There is no shortage of water fun here anyway because from the campsite you also have direct access to Lake Garda.

properties.name: Camperpark Amsterdam
properties.description:
Camperpark Amsterdam, located in a peaceful, green area just outside the environmental zone of the city, offers motorhome owners an ideal home base. The metro will take you to the centre of Amsterdam withing fifteen minutes, and yet you enjoy peace and quiet and the comfort of this well-equipped park.

Helpful reception

You will receive a friendly welcome at the reception, where tourist information is available as well as public transport tickets. The grounds of Camperpark Amsterdam were designed for optimum comfort and convenience. The roads are paved and the spacious pitches are sheltered among the greenery. There are more than 300 motorhome pitches and also 100 pitches for caravans. Each pitch has free wifi.

Tasty dishes in the bistro

The park has various amenities for a pleasant stay. During the high season, modern toilet and washing facilities, a shop and a bistro are available. The bistro offers basic yet tasty meals, ideal for when you return from a day out in the city. The pizza machine and the free service point for motorhomes are open for use all year round.

Wander to the Gaasperplas artificial lake

Gaasperplas, a recreational area with a lovely city beach and various options for water sports, is within walking distance from the motorhome park. The surrounding Gaasperpark is an ideal place for a quiet walk or bicycle ride with a beautiful view of the water.

Explore bustling Amsterdam

The direct metro connection means you can be in the centre of Amsterdam within 15 minutes. The location of the motorhome park is ideal for experiencing both the bustle of the city and the peace and quiet of the countryside that surrounds it.

properties.name: Camping Le Solitaire du Lac
properties.description:
The Solitaire du Lac campsite is located on the shores of Lake Annecy. Here you can enjoy relaxed camping without the bells and whistles. You walk straight into the lake, whose water is lovely and warm in the summer. Boating, surfing, water skiing, cycling or mountaineering; it's all possible here. And by bike, bus or boat, you can easily reach the charming town of Annecy.

Well cared for campsite

The campsite itself consists of a well-kept terrain with half-high trees. If you walk down the camping area, you come to a meadow with some playground equipment, football goals, a volleyball net and a basketball court. Directly behind it is the lake, at a small grassy beach between the reeds.

Relaxed camping

This is a fine campsite without undue fuss. You will receive a friendly welcome at the reception and the camping pitches are well looked after and of average size. There is no organised entertainment programme; people just play and swim. In high season, children will easily find playmates for a game of football, table tennis or beach volleyball.

Water fun on the lake

Be sure to bring your own air mattress, inflatable toy, board or boat to endlessly float, paddle or surf. In the summer, the water temperature in Lake Annecy is easily 26 degrees, so that makes for pleasant swimming. At the campsite, you can rent bikes, kayaks and supboards. And nearby is a 'base nautique' watersports centre for even more water fun. A great time to learn water skiing or wakeboarding. A boat trip on the lake is also recommended.

properties.name: Miramare Camping Village
properties.description:
Miramare Camping Village is a lively, large-scale family campsite on the east coast of Italy. Located directly on a private beach on the Mediterranean, ideal for beach lovers. The campsite also has a lot to offer to small campers, with an extensive children's entertainment programme in high season.

A wide choice of pitches

There are pitches on both sides of the road; most can be found on the left, where the reception is also located. Especially at the front of the campsite are thepermanent pitches. Those won’t bother the touring camper; touring pitches are closer to the beach. The choice is wide, because the campsite has no less than 350 pitches. Some pitches are on grass, but most of them have a sandy surface.

With your feet in the sand

A paved road leads from the reception building to the private beach. A large part of the beach is filled with umbrellas and sun loungers for extra comfort.

Dancing and swimming

From June onwards, Miramare Camping Village becomes lively: the children's entertainment starts and the evenings are filled with performances and dances for the smaller campers. This entertainment programme lasts throughout the high season. Do you prefer to entertain yourself? Then the swimming pool is ideal for you. On the path from reception to the beach you’ll find the large swimming pool and the paddling pool.

A snack and a drink

At the campsite you can enjoy a pizza or a seafood dish. The food is of good quality. Prefer to cook for yourself? There are several supermarkets within a radius of three kilometres.

properties.name: Aktiv Camping Prutz
properties.description:
The wonderfully maintained Aktiv Camping Prutz is located near the town of Prutz, in Tyrol. The fast running river Inn runs right past the campground: not to swim in, but all the more perfect for rafting. Cross the bridge and you are in the charming town of Prutz (600 m).
