Here you camp in an area with mountains, lakes and fantastic natural surroundings. The topper of this real family campground is the free entry to the large swimming paradise in Prutz (1.5 km).

Green, but busy

All campsites are nicely maintained, with lovely grass trees. A nice amount of trees, so you won't lack shade. There are paved sites as well. The sites vary in size. It is very busy in the high season and you may want more space. There are many Dutch, Germans and Swiss, primarily young families. In the low season there are mostly seniors coming to the area for walking and cycling. It's much quieter and you can choose your own site.

Top (swimming) pleasure for everyone

The great advantage of the campground is the free access to the swimming paradise in Prutz, with the Summercard. A wonderfully laid out and complete whole, with pools of various depths, waterfall, slide (45 m long) and plenty of play equipment.

Eating and drinking

You can buy most of your necessities in the Minimarkt. The simple restaurant (small menu) has a salad with home made dressing that is very highly recommended. In the village you'll find a bakery, butcher and supermarket.

properties.name: Camping Winkl-Landthal GmbH
properties.description:
Camping Winkl-Landthal, situated in the heart of the Berchtesgadener Land, forms an ideal base for activities in this challenging region. This is where you can seriously engage in rafting, climbing, canyoning, paragliding and mountain biking. Those who like less strenuous activities can embark on light or moderate hikes, cycling trips or even alpine mountain trips.

Camping on a green and cosy site

This campsite is very green, compact and cosy. You have a wide choice of pitches. There are demarcated pitches, slightly more spacious comfort pitches for caravans and motorhomes and a large field for tents. In summer, the idyllic pitches on the clear mountain stream are very popular. These pitches on the stream are quiet and offer a view of the mountains; higher up the view is less interrupted and you can see the Alps even better.

Neat rental accommodation

If you are not travelling with your own camping equipment, you can rent fully furnished mobile homes on the campsite. These are suitable for two to six persons. Although the mobile homes are not very modern, they are quite comfortable. They are also very well maintained.

Sporty region

It goes without saying that a campsite in this region attracts mainly sporty (mountain) visitors who like (mountain) hiking and biking. In winter season the campsite attracts mainly cross-country ski enthusiasts, who are drawn to the many challenging ski tracks in the region.

Kiosk and cafeteria

There is a small kiosk near the reception where you can buy fresh rolls and a few other groceries. In addition, there is a cafeteria with a public area (table service) and a terrace. You can find a few supermarkets within walking distance in Winkl.

properties.name: Camping Europa
properties.description:
In Torre del Lago Puccini, a quaint Tuscan city located between the Tyrrhenian Sea and the large lake Lago di Massaciùccoli , lies the campsite Europa. This lush campsite is peaceful, full of shade and offers something for everyone. You can relax at the swimming pool, play on the sports fields or walk through the woods to the beach.

Beautiful touring pitches and luxury accommodation

The campsite Europa has roughly 450 pitches, nearly half of which are touring pitches. The borders of these are all well defined, and the pitches are grassy or sandy with plenty of shade. Rental accommodation includes mobile homes, bungalows and chalets. The four glamping tents are brand new, each with their own unique character and layout. These all feature their own sanitary facilities.

Fun in the sun and in the water fun

The campsite draws a mixed crowd. Guests often have something in common: a love for the sea, sun, beach or culture. A brief walk from the campsite through the forest leads you to the beach. Here you'll find several bars and restaurants. If you really love the water, you can also visit the big lake (located one kilometre from the campsite).

However, there is more than enough to experience on the site. The gorgeous swimming pool (200 m2) has a shallow area for smaller children and a separate, deeper area for those who like to swim laps. The swimming pool is located at the edge of the campsite, near the sports facilities and play equipment.

Feeling hungry after a long day?

The restaurant and bar on the campsite are excellent. You can order pizza and many of the meals are prepared with regional products. The meals can also be taken away. There is a small shop available for basic groceries like fresh bread.

properties.name: Camping Du Barrage Rosport
properties.description:
On the bank of the Sauer river and the border of Germany and Luxembourg lies campsite Du Barrage Rosport. The campsite is level, with well-maintained camping pitches on grassy fields directly by the water. You camp here amidst greenery with a splendid view of the river. Du Barrage Rosport is a family campsite which attracts mainly sports-minded campers.

Bring your boat and fishing rod

Campsite Du Barrage Rosport has a large number of annual pitches, but also numerous touring pitches. The camping pitches are located along straight, hardened pathways on well maintained level grassy fields. Here and there are a few deciduous trees which offer some shade, but most pitches are in the sun. The pitches by the water are ideal, certainly if you have brought your own boat or fishing rod. 

On the banks of the stream

You reach the water via a few steps from the grassy beach along the shore. There is a jetty for small boats. The Sauer is ideal for kayaking and paddle surfing. The banks are perfectly suitable for fishing (fishing licence required). The river is not really suitable for swimming. Fortunately, the campsite has a lovely outdoor swimming pool, surrounded by a sunbathing lawn with loungers and sun umbrellas. 

Juices and fresh bread

There is no shop on the campsite. You can do your grocery shopping in Rosport or Echternach. In high season a baker visits the campsite each morning. There is no restaurant on the campsite, but in high season the cosy bar and terrace are open. You can buy healthy snacks here, as well as fresh fruit juices and regional beverages. Last but not least, in high season there are regular theme evenings with music and dinner.

properties.name: San Francesco Camping Village
properties.description:
San Francesco Camping Village is located on the sunny south bank of Lake Garda, near Desenzano del Garda. This large, well maintained campsite lies at the beginning of the elongated peninsula, from which the attractive town of Sirmione juts out into the lake. Both children and adults will thoroughly enjoy themselves on the campsite or in one of the large amusement parks at the lake.

Not just camping

When you drive to the campsite, the first thing you will see is the wide driveway flanked by oleander trees. San Francesco Camping Village is a well laid out and very green campsite with paved main roads and straight side roads. The pitches vary in size, the surface is mostly hardened. As the name 'Camping Village' indicates, in addition to camping pitches, rental accommodation in the form of mobile homes is also available. These are suitable for four to seven persons. They are located in a separate section somewhat further inland, while the touring pitches are closer to the lake.

Enjoying the lake (and more)

The campsite has its own sunbathing lawn along the lake with shady trees. Here you can rent a boat or canoe. In the section with mobile homes you will find the swimming pool and the sports facilities (tennis and volley ball). There is a convivial small bar near the sun-drenched swimming pool. The centrally located restaurant (with bar and pizzeria) is very sociable. Across the terrace of the restaurant is a playground for the little ones.

Sanitary facilities

The sanitary facilities are clean and well maintained. The ablution blocks are neatly laid out. There are special children sanitary facilities with children's showers.

properties.name: Camping Valle Verde
properties.description:
Valle Verde is living proof that a three star campsite can also be a small paradise. You will be staying in the Dolomites, at an altitude of 1,050 m, in a green, flowery oasis of peace. The campsite only has beautiful grass pitches and very good amenities. You will savour the magnificent view every moment of the day, with meadows and brooks between imposing tree-covered mountains.

Where is your pitch?

All 117 pitches are well maintained, level and grass. There are three types of pitches: 'maxi' (more than 80 m2, electricity, TV connection, water and drainage), 'standard' (60-80 m2, electricity, generally with TV connection) and 'mini' (up to 50 m2, suitable for tent with car or motorcycle). There are quite a few trees on the site which guarantee ample shade. The winding paths are hardened with fine gravel. There are small drinking fountains throughout. There is no rental accommodation available on Camping Valle Verde.

Sportive fellow campers

You will encounter many sports minded (Italian) families and couples here. There is a small playground, a volleyball field and a soccer field. The walking and cycling trail Fiemme & Fassa starts near the campsite. The trail is some 50 km long and is suitable for everyone. You will come across a few picnic places along the way. Consolation for aching muscles at the end of a sporty day: the small wellness centre with infrared cabin.

Pizzas from Trentino

When you want to do your own cooking, you can go to the small campsite shop (bread can be ordered). You find a wider selection in the supermarket in Predazzo (2 km). The attractive restaurant with bar is housed in a log cabin type of building with nice terrace. You really should go there for the delicious pizzas, undoubtedly made according to Trentino tradition.

properties.name: Camping Le Palais de la Mer
properties.description:
The four-star campsite Le Palais de la Mer in Saintes-Maries-de-La-Mer is located reasonably close to the town of Perpignan (18 km) and offers direct access to the beach of the French-Catalan coast of the Mediterranean. An unique feature is the superb park, belonging to the campsite, which can be accessed via a small bridge over a river. The park has been designed as a petting zoo with chickens, peacocks, goats, donkeys and more. There is also a small tourist train in the park.

The campsite

The pitches vary from 80 to 100 m2 in size and the sanitary buildings have recently been renovated. This gives them an extremely attractive and functional appearance. There are various sports possibilities on the grounds. To socialise (especially in the evenings) there is the l’Embuscade pub, where musical performances take place three times a week in high season.

Swimming pool/beach

Adjacent to the bar are two swimming pools, one of which is heated, so that you can also swim outside the summer months in a pleasant water temperature. The swimming pool has a waterfall, a childrens' pool and a jacuzzi. The swimming pool is flanked by a number of sun loungers and a solarium. Since 2018, the swimming pool has been expanded with several long slides. The beautiful sandy beach along the Mediterranean can be accessed from the campsite.

Catering facilities/shop

The restaurant of the campsite is well-frequented and you will be able to watch the performances in the evenings. You can also buy take-away pizzas. In the camping shop you can get all basic necessities, but also beach and camping accessories. On the other hand, near the traffic circle in Saintes-Maries-de-la-Mer you will find some more shops.

properties.name: Flower Camping de l'Île des Trois Rois
properties.description:
The Flower campsite of I’île des Trois Rois is an excellent location for camping along the water's edge on a peninsula in the Seine. From the spacious camping pitches you also have a splendid view of the castle ruin, Château Gaillard, which rises above the tree tops. The family campsite with heated swimming pool is only 300 m from the picturesque small town of Les Andelys. Here you can enjoy walking through the narrow alleyways, see the old dwellings and quaint shops and there also is a supermarket.

Camping along the Seine

The camping pitches are spread out over large meadows and are almost all equipped with electricity and water connections. The generous camping pitches are separated by low hedges, allowing you an overview of the campsite. Do you want to enjoy this campsite by the Seine to the full? The beautiful camping pitches along the river are highly recommended.

Looking for rental accommodation? Then you have a choice of static caravans with terrace and a view of the Seine. Or you can opt for the Coco Sweet, a luxuriously furnished glamping tent with comfortable beds and a kitchenette. In 2018, two sanitary blocks have been fully renovated, including one heated building. 

A genuine family campsite in Normandy

Lots to do for the children. There are several playgrounds with swings and slides. And a bouncy castle in peak season! The children can enjoy themselves endlessly in the heated swimming pool with a separate toddler pool. Do the children still have energy left over after an entire day of splashing in the pool? Then they can attend the evening entertainment show, also fun for the parents, of course.

properties.name: Campingplatz Gerbe
properties.description:
Campingplatz Gerbe is located surrounded by hills, amidst traditionally built farms in the Swiss canton of Lucerne. On this small-scale farm campsite near Lake Zug, you will experience farm life first-hand. You can help with feeding the animals. And they also like to be petted!

Stopover or long stay

The campsite has 60 spacious touring pitches and 25 permanent pitches. It is also possible to sleep in a teepee tent or in a dormitory on straw beds. There are no real camper pitches, but you may park your camper in the parking lot at the stables. The campsite is particularly popular with campers passing through - from and to Italy - and with those who love camping on an original and traditional farm.

Swimming fun on and off the campsite

In the high season, Campingplatz Gerbe has a temporary pool, so there is no lack of water fun! You can also swim in Lake Zug or Lake Vierwoudstreek. These are both about a ten-minute drive from the campsite. Visit one of these great lakes for a wonderful day on and off the water. But if you have enough time, of course, you can go to both!

Farm shop and restaurant

The old Swiss stable has been transformed into a reception space and restaurant. Here you can choose from different dishes such as a hamburger or steak from their own farm. In the morning, you can enjoy breakfast service with freshly baked bread. The campsite shop has some necessary products, but mostly local produce. Try the delicious apple juice or buy a piece of meat for your evening barbecue.

properties.name: Camping La Pinède
properties.description:
Camping La Pinède is located in Consdorf, in the middle of the Müllerthal valley region, which is also known as Luxembourg's Little Switzerland. The most beautiful hiking routes begin right from the campsite. These take you along the spectacular rocks and gorges so characteristic of this area. The campsite is surrounded by abundant nature and set in a peaceful, shady area. Here you have all the necessary facilities that families with children seek.

Camping pitches

The camping grounds are slightly inclined, so the pitches are on different levels. This gives you a great feeling of freedom. The topmost pitches are separated by fences. The pitches are about 100 m² to 120 m² large. You have a bit more privacy around the sanitary block and the access way. Below, the pitches are more spacious, but there are no physical demarcations. La Pinède also offers various types of accommodation for rent.

Sports facilities

The campsite is ideal for sporty guests, as well as for families with young children and seniors. At the reception, the attached tourist bureau will be happy to help you plan your hiking and cycling tours in the area. The campsite also features a playground, a mini-golf course, tennis courts, a beach volleyball court and a bocce pitch (a sport very similar to petanque). You can also rent bicycles and mountain bikes.

Local products

While the campsite's restaurant is under construction, you can rely on the restaurants and eateries in Consdorf and the surrounding villages. Regional products are proudly featured there, such as honey, cheese, meats, sausages and all kinds of liqueurs.

properties.name: Camping La Grande Tortue
properties.description:
Thanks to its location in the heart of the Loire Valley in a beautiful 6 ha forest, Camping La Grande Tortue is the perfect base for trips to the most famous castles of the Loire (Chaumont-sur-Loire, Chambord and Chenonceau). With 169 pitches, including various types of rental accommodation, the campsite has something to offer for everyone. You also have a wide choice of activities and facilities for a lovely holiday.

Special pitches for cyclists and walkers

The restaurant, swimming pool and playground form the pulsating heart of the campsite. This is surrounded by the pitches and the rental accommodation. The pitches are partly located in the shade, but in the centre some of the pitches have to make do without shade. There are special pitches for cyclists and walkers.

Comfort, Grand Comfort and Comfort Premium

The campsite offers pitches in all kinds of shapes and sizes. Guests bringing their own tent can choose between three levels, the standard pitch being at Comfort level, while you have water supply and drainage facilities at Grand Comfort level and Comfort Premium comes with own sanitary facilities. There is a wide choice of rental accommodation: mobile homes, caravans, huts on stilts and so-called Coco Sweet tents.

Restaurant and shop

The campsite has a restaurant where you can have a leisurely meal or enjoy a drink or an ice cream on the terrace. The restaurant also offers breakfast, half board and take-away dishes (including pizzas). The shop stocks local products and daily fresh bread.

properties.name: Camping Ter Duinen
properties.description:
It is one of the pearls on the Belgian coast: the Flemish historical beach resort of De Haan. Just outside the village, at the edge of the wood, lies the Kampeerverblijfpark Ter Duinen campsite. With the beach within walking distance and shops and restaurants in the vicinity, this is an ideal spot to spend a holiday. Moreover, it is also perfect for cycling along the coast. You can also take lovely walks through the dune forests.

Camping lawn

The touring pitches are located on an open camping lawn without demarcation. Although the pitches offer little privacy, they are spacious and well kept.

Beach and water fun

In the direct vicinity of the campsite you will find lots to do. Adjacent to the campsite lies the recreation park Aquafun Sunparks with its subtropical swimming pool, wellness and various sports facilities. The beautiful sandy beach between De Haan and Wenduine, complete with promenade, is only 1 km away. You can reach the beach via a footpath through an attractive fir forest. In July and August there are weekly beach activities, such as a treasure hunt, sack races and making sand sculptures.

Artisanal ice cream

For everyday shopping, you can visit the vending machine shop at the campsite. Would you like to eat out? The campsite has a cosy restaurant with a terrace. Furthermore, there is plenty of choice in De Haan. Your daily shopping can be done at the vending machine shop on the campsite. Want to go out for dinner? The campsite has a cosy restaurant with a terrace. Furthermore, you will be spoiled for choice in De Haan: from pizzerias to restaurants with à-la-carte menus. You will also find stylish tearooms, cocktail bars and stalls with artisanal ice cream in this historic coastal town.

Sanitary facilities

The campsite has a number of ablution blocks with toilets and wash basins. There is a separate building with showers. Everything is clean and modern. On the campsite there is a launderette and ironing room.

properties.name: Camping Ettelbrück
properties.description:
Camping Ettelbrück is situated on a hill next to a residential area, a 15-minute walk away from the vibrant town centre. An excellent starting point from which to explore the Luxembourg Ardennes!

The reception and other central facilities such as the sanitary facilities and the playground are located at the entrance of the campsite. You will immediately notice the beautiful view. There is a small restaurant at the reception with a large terrace, serving vegetarian and regional dishes. You can also buy fresh bread here in the mornings. The grounds are full of trees and bushes. The caravans and tents are situated on grass pitches. You will also find four safari tents on the grounds. There are two shower blocks, which include sanitary facilities for the disabled, a drying area and a baby room.

Fun for the children

The campsite is very popular with hikers and people looking for peace and quiet. Young families like to come here as well, because of facilities such as the playground.

Harvest what you need from the herb and vegetable garden

The campsite is convivial and welcoming. There is a communal herb and vegetable garden, and games are available on loan at the small library. A small-scale entertainment programme is also available for all ages, and you can take part in organised day trips. For shopping and groceries, you can visit Ettelbruck which is accessible either on foot or by bus (the bus stops in front of the campsite).

properties.name: Au Paradis des Campeurs
properties.description:
Fancy a beach holiday in France? Then Camping Au Paradis des Campeurs is highly recommended. This terraced campsite is situated directly on a sandy beach in La Gaillarde, on the Côte d'Azur. This is one of the most touristic areas of Southern Europe. And that is not surprising, because it is beautiful here. You are only eleven kilometres from beautiful towns such as Sainte-Maxime, Fréjus and Saint-Raphaël.

A quiet family campsite

After taking exit 36 on the A8 motorway towards Fréjus, it is only a twenty minute drive to the campsite. Once you arrive at the reception, you will be greeted by attentive receptionists. The size of the pitches varies, but they are generally spacious and offer a lot of privacy. There are some two hundred pitches on a seven hectare site. The sanitary facilities are good and are decorated with palm trees and other plants.

No camping equipment at your disposal? Then you have the choice of various rental accommodations, including mobile homes. These are suitable for groups of two to eight people. Camping at Au Paradis des Campeurs is possible the whole year round, as the campsite is open from 1 January to 31 December! The campsite's shops and restaurants are open from mid-March to the end of October.

Modest entertainment

Camping Au Paradis des Campeurs is a family campsite where peace and quiet come first. But there is a playground for the children. During the summer months (July and August) they can also go to the children's club. In addition, open-air cinema and dance evenings are sometimes organised. Hikers and cyclists (bike rental available) have a choice of routes that start directly from the campsite. This way you can easily reach surrounding villages such as Saint-Aygulf and San Peire.

By land or sea

As mentioned, the campsite is situated at the beach of La Gaillarde. You only have to cross a road and your feet are already in the sand. Bring a book, lay down your towel and enjoy the sunshine. There is also a special beach area where dogs are allowed. For sporty people, there are many activities to do on the beach and in the sea. Go swimming, boating, canoeing or jet skiing. Do you want something else than a day at the beach? Then go horseback riding, walking or cycling in the area.

Saint-Tropez

For a nice day out, take the boat from Les Issambres to the fashionable Saint-Tropez. It is an hour's sail, so let your hair down and enjoy the sea breeze and the view. Before you take the boat to Saint-Tropez, visit the flea market on the boulevard in Les Issambres. It takes place every Friday from 09:00 to 16:00.

properties.name: Camping Münsterland Eichenhof
properties.description:
Münsterland Eichenhof campsite is located on the edge of the village of Sassenberg, just 100 m from Lake Feldmark. This swimming lake guarantees lots of fun on the water or on the sandy beach and also offers opportunities for surfing, sailing and fishing. There is also a small swimming lake on the campsite itself. The camping pitches are often around this and are well maintained.

As good as new

The campsite has been considerably renovated in recent years. As a result, there is less vegetation on the new part, but you do have a spacious and level campsite. Maybe even at the water's edge, because a natural swimming lake with a sandy beach has recently been built on this part. You will also find most pitches around this lake. At the front of the campsite, you will find the chalets and the year-round pitches.

Gasthaus Eichenhof

You can do some basic shopping in the camp shop. In the morning, you can also get your fresh loaves of bread here. For a large supermarket, you can go to the neighbouring village of Sassenberg (1.5 kilometres). And if you don't feel like cooking for yourself at the campsite for a change? Then stop by Gasthaus Eichenhof, the restaurant on the campsite. The locals also like to come and enjoy the delicious dishes and the beautiful terrace.

Swimming and sandcastles

You can let the children play on the playground behind the restaurant, or send them out with the entertainment team during the school holidays. But they'll find the most entertainment on and around the water. There is a recently built swimming lake at the campsite, especially for guests. Or opt for more spacious water and walk 100 m to Lake Feldmarksee.

properties.name: Camping Torre La Sal
properties.description:
The lovely Torre La Sal campsite is located on the beautiful Costa del Azahar. This campsite attracts campers throughout the year. Whether you are going for a Spanish summer full of sun, sea and beach, or are you looking for a nice rural place to spend the winter, Torre La Sal welcomes you with open arms.

Comfort throughout the year

Torre La Sal campsite offers camping pitches in the shade and in the sun. In the warm Spanish summer, most guests prefer a pitch under the trees, and sunny places are popular in the winter. Snowbirds are also welcome guests here.

Directly on the beach

The campsite is located on the beautiful Costa del Azahar and directly on a wide sandy beach! You reach the beach via an exit in the fence, which is closed at night. The beach is surrounded by a natural area filled with reeds and ponds. A beautiful wooden cycle path runs through it.

Swimming all year round

Swimming enthusiasts can also take a dip in the heated swimming pool at the campsite. The water temperature is thirty degrees all year round. During the colder months there is a roof over the swimming pool. Although cold is relative, because in October/November it is still around 25°C.

Excursions to fiestas

There are fun activities at the Torre La Sal campsite throughout the year. There is entertainment in German, English, Spanish and French. If you feel like it, you can play a game of football, basketball, table tennis or jeu de boules. You can also participate in excursions to places of interest.

properties.name: Camping Eucaliptus
properties.description:
Camping Eucaliptus is situated on the Mediterranean Sea, on the edge of the unique natural area of the Ebro Delta. This is an ideal location for both sun worshippers and naturalists. The wide and quiet beach is also in close proximity. The sea is suitable for sailing, windsurfing, kite surfing and waterskiing.

Enjoying the shade

The compact grounds are very well maintained and numerous eucalyptus trees provide ample shade. The pitches are laid out in rows, partly on grass and partly on sand. If you prefer to rent accommodation, you can opt for a bungalow. The rental accommodation is situated on the boundary of the campsite, near the large pond.

Under the palm trees

The rectangular swimming pool looks glorious. It is surrounded by a sunbathing lawn with ornamental shrubs and palm trees. Toddlers can splash around in a separate round pool. You can relax on the sun loungers in the shade of a Mediterranean palm tree. The covered terrace of the restaurant is located adjacent to the swimming pool.

Water sports

Prefer the sea? You do not have to walk far; the long sandy beach and the Mediterranean Sea are only 500 m away. You can reach the beach via a wooden deck.

Clowns and canoe trips

Children can enjoy themselves in the playground, on the sports field and at the table tennis tables. In peak season there is a varied entertainment programme for young and old, from a clown and dance performances to diving lessons in the swimming pool, windsurfing lessons in the sea and canoe trips.

Eating on a cosy terrace

You can eat fine meals in the restaurant which offers a wide selection of local produce (Catalanian cuisine). It has a convivial terrace with a bar bordering the sunbathing lawn.

properties.name: Camping Zum Feuerberg
properties.description:
At campsite Zum Feuerberg , you camp right along the Moselle river. The camp grounds are on the sunny southern side of the river. Here you can spend hours watching the cruise ships and inland vessels slowly passing by on the Moselle. Directly across from the campsite is the picturesque wine village of Ediger-Eller, famous for its historic half-timbered houses and cosy outdoor cafés and restaurants.

Information and fresh rolls

The reception is located in the main building and can be reached by a flight of stairs. There you can get information about the area as well as daily fresh rolls. The sanitary facilities, which are modern and clean, are also found here. Construction of several new sanitary facilities was completed in March 2018.

Tenting along the Moselle

The Dutch owner Harold van Dijk takes excellent care of his beautiful campsite. It is neat and tidy all round and you have a choice of spacious pitches of about 100 m2. The most beautiful pitches are located along the river. If you come with a tent, you can even set it up on a grass pitch with pebble beach right along the Moselle.

Swimming in the swimming pool or the river

The campsite, which is popular with families with children and older campers (in the off-season), has a simple little 50 m2 swimming pool. This is a nice place to cool off on a hot summer day. The swimming pool is right behind the main building. Around the swimming pool is lots of nice space for sunbathing or playing in the grass. Of course, you can also swim in the Moselle. At the pebble beach there is safe swimming area demarcated in the water.

properties.name: Camping Domaine de La Ville Huchet
properties.description:
Campsite Domaine de La Ville Huchet is situated in a beautiful area, where you can undertake something nice in the vicinity each day, be it sporty (cycling and walking) or culturally. The campsite, located in the park of a castle, is also excellently suited to enjoy camping life. The exceptionally varied water park certainly plays an important role in this...

Camping in a castle garden

When you arrive, you can see the castle and the beautiful reception at a glance. The reception is housed in a large and new building in Breton style. You will be welcomed by the camping owner or by his staff. The camping makes an open impression and is an attractive entity with the water park, the castle wall and the vegetation.

Entertainment for families

The camping pitches are spacious and distributed over the lawns of the castle. The surface is somewhat bumpy. The camping guests, especially in the peak season, are mostly from an international background. The campsite is specifically geared towards families with young and older children.

Large water park

There is a beautiful heated and covered swimming pool, located in a large open air water park. Enjoy yourself on the slides, bridges and waterfalls. On Domaine de La Ville Huchet you can play table tennis, billiards or play sports on one of the fields. There is a lot of entertainment for children in the summer holidays.

Fresh croissants

The shop stocks a limited range and the restaurant has a small menu. The restaurant is housed in the beautiful Breton building. Fresh bread rolls and croissants are available each morning.

properties.name: Camping Méditerranée Plage
properties.description:
Campsite Méditerranée Plage is located directly at the Mediterranean beach, a ten-minute bicycle ride from Portiragnes-Plage and 20 minutes from Vias-Plage. This is a large campsite with extensive entertainment and facilities and very suitable for families with children.

Warm welcome

Arriving at the reception you will straight away sense the professional approach of this top campsite, where everything is well organised. The proprietress is highly experienced and multilingual. The grounds are laid out in an uncluttered manner, the spacious pitches are clearly separate from the rental mobile homes. Pitches are demarcated, offer both sun and shade with large numbers of oleander shrubs. All pitches are within walking distance from both the swimming paradise and the beach, which is accessible via a wooden walkway over a low dune area. There are quite a few mobile homes available for rental on a separate area of the campsite.

Water fun and recreation

The campsite is located directly on the wide sandy beach. Close to the reception you will find the water park with slides, whitewater course, toddler pool and a sunbathing lawn with loungers. Camping Méditerranée Plage also offers a large number of other facilities such as a sports field, jeu de boule pitch and tennis. The entertainment team organises sports events for young and old and in the evenings there are performances, music, cabaret and shows put on by the entertainment team.

Grab a bite

At night you can enjoy dinner in the restaurant, which serves as a type of snack bar with basic dishes during the day. Take-away meals and pizzas are also available here. There are also two bars. The supermarket in the 'shopping street' has a selection of groceries with a separate section for vegetables, fruit and meat. Dayfresh mussels and oysters are available just outside the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Adria
properties.description:
Camping Village Adria is located on the Adriatic Sea in the Emilia-Romagna region, approximately 15 km north of Ravenna. This campsite is a must for families with children. The beach is within walking distance and the campsite itself has two swimming pools. There are also two bars, a restaurant, and a supermarket with a wide range of products. The flat terrain is ideal for cycling trips.

Child-friendly

Camping Village Adria is located in Casal Borsetti (Ravenna province). It is a welcoming and child-friendly campsite which caters especially to families. There is plenty to do for the children, such as activities and swimming opportunities. The beautiful pitches are situated on level ground and under shady trees. There are also mobile homes available for rent. The campsite has two swimming pools, one of which is designed as a beautiful lagoon. Furthermore, the beach is accessible by foot (cross the road and walk 250 m through a shaded wood).

Conviviality foremost

In the peak season, you will mostly be sharing the campsite with Italians, Germans, and Dutch campers. The entertainment team organises many activities (games, competitions and shows). Fun for the children, but also for the adults. The Arena Theatre, the stage for the evening activities, is unique.

Food and drink

Both swimming pools feature a poolside bar. The bar by the lagoon pool is especially fine, with a lovely terrace. You can dine in style at the à la carte restaurant. For those wanting to cook their own meal, the campsite supermarket, with a wide range of products, is certainly worth a visit.

properties.name: Camping Am Waldbad
properties.description:
A very attractive swimming pool with several water basins and a spectacular slide from where you can enjoy the view of the tree-covered mountains. You can find all of this on Camping am Waldbad, situated at only 1 km of the town of Dellach in Drautal, in the Austrian Carinthia. This is the ideal destination for a family holiday amidst nature. The terrain has a lovely grass surface, paved pathways and blossoming shrubs.

Where is your pitch?

The camping pitches are demarcated and spacious. There are pitches with and without shade. You can rent mobile homes and tents on Camping am Waldbad. These are spread over the grounds up to the back of the field, bordering the forest. Your neighbours will be families with children. This is a great campsite for seniors to enjoy the beautiful surroundings in peace and quiet in low season. The sanitary facilities of the campsite are modern and clean.

Swimming paradise, rafting, climbing...

The large heated swimming pool with gigantic slide and a toddler pool are surrounded by a lovely lawn. If you are looking for alternative amusement, other than the swimming pool, there is also a playground, a nice beach volleyball field, a slack-line (type of tightrope), a soccer field and a natural climbing wall. White-water rafting, kayaking and rafting are all allowed on the Drau. In July and August, various entertainment programmes are offered, both for children and adults.

Eating and drinking

There is a modest campsite shop with a fair assortment. You can buy fresh bread in the mornings. The restaurant has an extensive menu (including take-away meals). You can eat inside or al fresco on the terrace. There is also a snack bar.

properties.name: Schloß Helmsdorf
properties.description:
Schloß Helmsdorf lies with its small private marina directly on the Bodensee. This spaciously designed campsite, situated on the extensive grounds of a decommissioned beer brewery, is completely geared towards water sports. With its ideal location, luxury and modern facilities and fine restaurant featuring regional dishes, it's a wonderful place to camp. The campsite grounds are mostly occupied by permanent pitches, but there is a separate area for touring campers.

Separate touring pitches

This large campsite is mostly made up of permanent pitches (230), but touring campers are also welcome here. If you plan to stay in the peak season, be sure to book a spot beforehand because it gets busy in the summer. There are eighty touring pitches, situated on a separate part of the campsite. This camping terrain is situated behind the restaurant and does not lie directly on the lake. The pitches are numbered and are beautifully laid out on grass fields. Some are paved with gravel. The campsite grounds are slightly sloping, but you will be able to pitch your caravan without any problems. A separate field for tents is situated on the outskirts of the campsite, close to the main road.

Boating on the Bodensee

Schloß Helmsdorf's view is always aimed at the Bodensee. The private marina has enough space for you to moor your boat (for an additional fee). From the campsite, you can boat straight onto the large lake. Next to the marina is a fine spot where you can sunbathe by the lake in the green grass.

Excellent sanitary facilities

Schloß Helmsdorf sets a high standard for other German campsites with its excellent sanitary facilities. The modern sanitary facilities in the centrally located toilet block are in tip-top shape and always kept immaculately clean.

properties.name: Camping Riarena
properties.description:
Camping Riarena, located in the southern canon of Ticino near Cugnasco, offers a quiet camping experience on the Magadino plain close to Lago Maggiore. This excellent quality campsite, crowned with the ACSI Award for the Best Swiss Campsite of 2023, is perfect for exploring Ticino's stunning mountain landscape, lakes and cities.

Spaciously laid out site with touring pitches and caravans for rent

Camping Riarena has a spacious and well-maintained site with various pitches, including standard and premium pitches near the swimming pool. There is also a playground. Lovely furnished caravans are available for rent, with free wifi throughout.

Large outdoor swimming pool with paddling pool

The site has a large outdoor swimming pool of 250 square metres, ideal for swimming laps or for refreshment on sunny days and a paddling pool.

Lovely food in the versatile campsite restaurant

The campsite restaurant offers a mix of Swiss and international dishes and has an adjacent games room for children. There is a small shop at the campsite for daily groceries and fresh bread and Lavertezzo is a five-minute drive away for more extensive shopping.

Fully equipped toilet and washing facilities

The centrally located toilet block is fully equipped with hand basins, laundry, baby cleaning station and plenty of toilets and showers, including an adapted bathroom for the disabled.

Explore Ticino from the campsite

Camping Riarena is an ideal starting point for exploring Ticino. The cities of Locarno and Bellinzona can be reached within 15 minutes, and the eastern banks of Lago Maggiore are even closer. The area around Cugnasco offers options for walking and cycling trips, mountain sports such as paragliding and canyoning, and the impressive 130-metre-long Tibetano suspension bridge.

properties.name: Gran Camping Zarautz
properties.description:
Gran Camping Zarautz lies in Spanish Basque Country, close to the centre of the coastal resort with the same name. The terraced campsite is located on the Talai Mendi hill from where you have a beautiful view of the Zarautz Bay. This beautiful location makes this campsite an ideal home base for campsite visitors who love the countryside and water sports. The campsite has many amenities for entertainment, but it is also an ideal location for learning to relax in the midst of nature.

Perfect home base for the countryside and the city

Campsite visitors stay on demarcated pitches at the well-managed campsite. You can also find luxury glamping accommodation on the camping grounds. If sleeping in camping equipment is not your thing, another option is to stay overnight in the hostel.

Enjoy a delicious dinner at the campsite restaurant where you will savour the local cuisine. During the high season, the entertainment team organises activities for the youngest campsite guests. There are daily sports lessons for the adults, such as yoga and Zumba. There is a playground, both indoors and outdoors, a sauna and a health club that all campsite visitors may use.

441 steps to the beach

At the edge of the campsite, you have a beautiful view of the surrounding area. A long steep stairway (441 steps) will allow you to descend to the Zarautz beach. The beach is ideal for water sports activities such as surfing and kayaking. In the summer a shuttle bus runs from the campsite to the famous water sports resort of Zarautz. The campsite is also the starting point of many lovely walks and mountain bike routes in the immediate vicinity.

properties.name: Camping Panorama
properties.description:
Camping Panorama is located in the San Bartolo Natural Park, in Pesaro, Italy. This terraced campsite is situated in a picturesque region and offers something for every camper. From water fun in the campsite pool and relaxation on the beach of Pesaro to beautiful trips in the area.

Enjoy before you arrive

The campsite "Campeggio Panorama Pesora" is located in a hilly and beautiful area. The last part of the journey is a winding road surrounded by trees in many colours. You will also be treated to a view of the azure-blue Adriatic Sea along the way.

Friendly reception

On arrival at the campsite, you will be warmly welcomed by the owner or one of his colleagues. The well-maintained campsite has pitches of different sizes and with different degrees of shade. Don't have camping gear? Then you can also rent a mobile home or bungalow.

Swimming and beautiful trips

Want to relax in the water after a long trip? Dive into the pool at this campsite! Nearby, you can also swim in the beautiful Adriatic Sea. Be sure to bring your snorkel gear and see what fish you can spot! With a playground and sports ground, there is always something to do on the campsite, even on dry land.

No need to cook

Back at the campsite, with a restaurant, pizzeria and snack bar, you don't have to worry about eating. The next day you can enjoy freshly baked bread at breakfast. Sharing holiday snaps is easy, the WiFi on the campsite is free.

properties.name: Les Méditerranées - Nouvelle Floride
properties.description:
Camping Les Méditerranées-Nouvelle Floride is a large campsite at the Mediterranean Sea, located at two hundred metres from the centre of Marseillan-Plage. The campsite is part of an organisation of three independent campsites under the name Les Méditerranées. Free traffic is allowed between the campsites.

Well-organised campsite

The campsite is beautifully laid out and well-maintained, with fine camping pitches. Upon arrival, you will immediately hear the sounds from the swimming paradise across the reception. During the day the campsite makes a quiet impression despite the many activities.

Spacious and neat pitches

The pitches are quite spacious and sizes vary between 80 to 100 m2. There is a profusion of vegetation with flowers and trees and demarcation with hedges. Camping guests of all ages who like an extensive entertainment programme enjoy coming here: the swimming pool, the sports fields, the dance and theatre evenings as well as the mini club all contribute towards the entire family's enjoyment. 

Lots of water fun and theatre

The swimming pool is a veritable water paradise with a heated outdoor swimming pool, water games, a toddler pool, bubble benches and a few slides. The 'pentaglisse' (slide with five chutes next to each other) provides great fun for children. Perfect to hold competitions who gets to the bottom of the chute first. Ready, steady? Go! 

If you prefer swimming in a larger 'pool', the sea is another option. The sea is easy to reach via a footpath. Here you will also find a beautiful sandy beach.

Restaurant by the sea

The shop is very well stocked. In addition to food and beverages, you can buy souvenirs and clothing here. The restaurant offers a wide choice of dishes. You can order a drink in the cosy bar.

properties.name: Les Méditerranées - Beach Garden
properties.description:
Camping Les Méditerranées - Beach Garden is situated in Marseillan-Plage, in the sunny Languedoc-Roussillon region. You have direct access to the glorious (supervised) beach on the Mediterranean, which can almost be called a private beach. At Beach Gardens there is a lively atmosphere with many young families, teenagers, entertainment and activities. The swimming pool is a large contributing factor to this. If you are looking for quiet evenings, better give this campsite a miss.

Lovely, but busy

Beach Garden, a site with 370 touring pitches and 300 permanent pitches is undoubtedly a very contemporary, luxurious campsite abound with entertainment and romance. On the green, shaded grounds you will find beautiful, demarcated camping pitches (80-100 m2). Many of the tourist pitches are located in the vicinity of the swimming paradise. The 216 comfortable rental accommodation units ('cabanes de la mer’ and ‘maisons des sables’) have a designer interior.

Lots to do!

Here you can find an unprecedented amount of entertainment for young and old. These include sports and games, theatre, dance, children's club, teen club, disco and foam parties. Hardly surprising that especially young families stay here, as this is a real Valhalla for children. The Salon de Beauté (spa, hamam and sauna) offers beauty treatments and massages.

A swimming and beach paradise

There is a luxurious open (heated) swimming paradise (1200 m2) with a wide-range of child-friendly activities on the campsite It has a terrace with sun loungers. Next to it is a covered water park, including a wellness room, massage baths, bubble baths and jacuzzis. Enjoy!

The campsite borders a beautiful, wide sandy beach with light coloured sand on the blue Mediterranean.

properties.name: Les Méditerranées - Charlemagne
properties.description:
Campsite Les Méditerranées-Charlemagne is situated just two hundred metres from the centre of Marseillan-Plage. The campsite is part of a complex of three large independent campsites in Marseillan-Plage. All three campsites have direct access to the supervised beach. People can come and go between the three campsites.

For camping enthusiasts

Of the three campsites, this is the campsite for true camping enthusiasts. You will find yourself in a well-laid out campsite, beautifully and refreshingly landscaped with trees, shrubs and flowers. Les Méditerranées-Charlemagne is a quiet campsite for guests who are not looking for immediate entertainment, but who are primarily looking for peace and quiet and the joys of camping itself.

Green pitches

Half of the pitches are reserved for the mobile homes which are so characteristic of French campsites. The other half are touring pitches measuring between 80 and 100 m2, separated by hedges, flowering shrubs and trees.

Swimming paradise

This campsite features a fabulous swimming paradise with a heated outdoor pool with water slides, water games and paddling pools for the little ones, a seating area with bubbles and long stretches for those wishing to swim a couple of lengths. There is also a heated indoor pool with an adjacent wellness area. Wind down with a relaxing massage...

Beach bar with a view

A path runs directly from the campsite to the gorgeous sandy beach. Along the road leading to the beach, you will find a beautifully renovated bar with views of the sea.

Restaurant and shop

The restaurant at Les Méditerranées-Charlemagne is situated near the entrance and has views of the campsite swimming pool. You will find the supermarket in front of the campsite. This supermarket stocks a good range of products and features a separate vegetable and bread department.

properties.name: Camp MondSeeLand
properties.description:
A gem of a five-star campsite, and one that lives up to its stars. At Camp MondSeeLand in the Austrian Mondsee, everything is meticulously organised. The owners are very hospitable and you will stay on spacious pitches (grass). The (semi)covered swimming pool is very attractive. You find all this in a beautiful green, quiet area with trees and gently sloping meadows.

Holiday cottages in Austrian style

Most pitches are spacious, although some pitches may be more compact when it is busy. Otherwise, the terrain is well-tended and maintained with lots of surrounding vegetation. There are pitches with and without shade. Rather rent accommodation? Undoubtedly, you will then book a holiday cottage, obviously fully furnished in Austrian style.

Swimming and sunbathing

The covered swimming pool (with slightly warm water) is centrally located behind the reception. It is modestly sized and deep and, therefore, not really suitable for the little ones. It has an adjacent tiled terrace, where you can soak up the sun on the loungers. The area is excellent for cycling, walking, swimming and fishing.

Eating in a lovely atmosphere

You can enjoy a great meal here in the large restaurant with attractive Austrian decor. The menu offers ample choices with a selection of regional and traditional dishes. There is an attractive terrace so you can dine al fresco. Would you rather do your own cooking? There is a supermarket on the campsite.

Sparkling clean sanitary facilities

The centrally situated sanitary facilities are tastefully furnished, complete with flowers and fragrance. It is really meticulously clean and very pleasant.

properties.name: Camping Porte des Vosges
properties.description:
It is no coincidence that Camping Porte des Vosges, or ‘Gateway to the Vosges' is situated at the beginning of the Vosges. As the campsite is very close to the A31 highway, it is an ideal stopover site. Are you staying longer? Enjoy the diverse landscape; mountains, vineyards, vast woodlands and countless small lakes. The campsite is spaciously laid out and very green and sloping, creating the impression of camping in a park. The reception and snack bar are located in the same building. After a long day's journey, take a refreshing dive in the small outdoor heated swimming pool with adjacent sunbathing field.

Camping or glamping?

All types of campers feel right at home at the Porte des Vosges campsite. Guests with a tent, caravan or mobile home can camp on spacious pitches, some hardened and some grassed. The pitches are not demarcated, but are sufficiently spaced to ensure privacy.

Do you like camping, but are looking for more comfort and luxury? If so, you can rent one of the glamping tents. These lodge tents, suitable for 2-6 persons, are fitted with comfortable beds, a kitchenette and a wooden terrace. As soon as you arrive on the campsite, your holiday begins.

The sanitary facilities of the Porte des Vosges campsite have a modern look and are heated in low season. The campsite also has a dishwasher, a dog shower and a cleaning station for chemical toilets.

properties.name: Camping Ladouceur
properties.description:
Camping Ladouceur is located on the sunny Côte d’Azur. The campsite is in the centre of a pine forest and is a great location for nature lovers. The nearest beach, L’Escalet, is only five-minute drive away. This sandy beach is surrounded by rocks. Explore the countryside around the campsite or stroll around in the famous Saint-Tropez.

Camp in a pine forest

Camping Ladouceur is a basic campsite where you can still camp in a traditional manner. The pitches are spacious with a sandy base. Some of the pitches have a view of the surrounding mountains. On hot summer days, the pine trees provide shade and a cool spot.

The campsite has great facilities for a successful holiday in France. Active holidaymakers can play a game of table tennis, basketball or play the typical French game of pétanque. The campsite restaurant offers delicious full meals.

Five minutes to the sea

You can get to the beach of the Mediterranean Sea in no time. Enjoy the beautiful view while lying in the sand or go for a swim in the azure blue water. Water sports enthusiasts can go sailing or take out a jet ski. The area is also ideal for hikers. There are various hiking paths, including routes with a beautiful view of the coast.

Admire luxury yachts in Saint-Tropez

The coastal resort Saint-Tropez (10 km) is world-famous because of the jet set who goes on holiday here. Wander past the harbour and admire the luxury yachts that float on the azure blue water. Or enjoy the charming ambiance in the old centre with its narrow streets and small pastel-coloured houses.

properties.name: Camping Bon Port
properties.description:
Camping Bon Port is situated in the Petite Camargue, slightly more than 2 km from the small town of Lunel. This is the Herault tourist region, which extends between the mountains and the sea. In the direct vicinity you will find the beautiful coast of the Camargue. A visit to La Grande Motte beach, 10 kilometers away, is highly recommended. However, the hinterland also offers various options for nice outings.

Flowers, flowers, flowers

On your way to the campsite you will notice that the campsite makes a well maintained impression. You will also see a remarkable amount of flowers everywhere. Judging by the hustle and bustle there is a lot to do here. The camping pitches vary in size. They have a surface of grass and are laid out under pine trees.

Swimming paradise and large playground

The focus of the campsite is especially on children. In the high season you will, therefore, find many families with children here. The water park and large playground with countless climbing opportunities are particularly appealing. There are several swimming pools and beautiful water slides.

Supermarket, bar, restaurant with terrace

You can do your grocery shopping in a small supermarket on the campsite. Enough choice to tickle the palate: there is a restaurant with terrace and bar.

properties.name: Camping Ametlla
properties.description:
Camping Ametlla is situated in an attractive setting: close to one of the most beautiful nature areas along the Spanish coast (the Ebro Delta) and near two bays on the Mediterranean. The azure blue water between the rocks is ideal for snorkelling. The campsite even runs its own diving school. The fishing town of L'Ametlla de Mar is within walking distance.

In Mediterranean spheres

The demarcated pitches are beautifully laid out. Numerous olive trees create a Mediterranean atmosphere. Here and there interspersed with deciduous and pine trees. There is ample space, privacy and shade. The sizes of the pitches vary and the surface is largely of sand and stones.

Four swimming pools

There are four larger and somewhat smaller swimming pools with lawns of synthetic grass. There are also a few loungers and sun umbrellas. Lifeguards keep an eye on things. Prefer the sea? At a distance of approx. 100 m are two bays on the Costa Dorada of the Mediterranean.

Active entertainment team

Youngsters will certainly enjoy themselves here. There are several sports fields: a soccer field of synthetic grass, a basketball field and a beach volleyball field. In addition, there is an area with two table tennis tables. Relaxing after midnight without being a nuisance to the other camping guests is possible in a special club house. The entertainment team is very active during the summer months: they organise sports activities and daily evening shows for young and old.

Fresh bread

On the campsite you will find a restaurant, a bar and a small campsite shop with daily fresh bread. You will find a larger supermarket in the village of L'Ametlla de Mar.

properties.name: Camping Aux Rives du Soleil
properties.description:
The charming family campground Aux Rives du Soleil is located on the river Reyssouze (side branch of the Saône) in the Burgundy wine region. The spacious campsites on the well maintained property are very different. You can camp with a view of grazing cows, on the river or near the playground. Passers-through have their own field.

Varied campsites

Campers passing through are shown to a lovely passers-through field. If you want to enjoy the campground for longer, there is a sectioned off area with hedges and a large grassy field. In general, you have a spacious site of at least 100m2, so you can choose for yourself a sunny spot or a shady site (or something in between). One sanitation complex is like new, the other is well maintained.

Feeding the animals

Every day during the high season, there are activities for the children. Feed the animals, play ball games or do some arts and crafts. There is a trampoline and a field for animals on the playground. Seniors like to come here in the low season, and there are activities for them too.

Relax

The surrounding area is beautiful. Ask for the various cycling routes and marked walking routes near the campground. The table tennis table, the multi-sports field and the jeu-de-boules pitch get a great deal of use. There are swimming pools and a sunbathing lawn on the banks of the Saône. You can swim in the river or creek and sun yourself on the grassy beach.

Grab a bite

The old farm is set up as a restaurant, where you have plenty of choice. There is a small menu at the snack bar, pizzeria (only in high season) and restaurant. The baker brings fresh bread every morning.

properties.name: Camping Het Winkel
properties.description:
Campsite Het Winkel is situated in the far east of the Netherlands, on the outskirts of Winterwijk in the Achterhoek region This attractive family campsite, in the heart of a nature area, radiates peace and relaxation. Despite the large size of the campsite there is a cosy atmosphere . For a glamping holiday you can stay in a chalet, lodge tent or in Family Home Het Winkel.

Comfort pitches and luxury pitches

The camping has two sections, separated by a quiet public road. On one side, where you will also find the reception building, you camp close to the swimming pool. On the other side there is a large lawn with spacious camping pitches. Choose between standard pitches, comfort pitches and super luxury pitches. The pitches in the last category have their own sanitary facilities. 

A relaxing glamping holiday

For a glamping holiday, campsite Het Winkel has several chalets available for rent, equipped with flat screen TV, kitchen and dish washer. There are also some luxury lodge tents on a separate field. The most exclusive rental accommodation of the campsite is Family Home Het Winkel. This renovated farmhouse (also listed monument) accommodates no fewer than ten persons. .

If you stay in one of these glamping units, you can make use of the wellness facilities of the campsite at a reduced rate.

Water slide

The long water slide, which can be spotted a long way off from the grounds, leads into the heated outdoor pool. Next to the swimming pool is a toddler pool, where the little ones can splash around undisturbed. Parents can keep an eye out from the spacious sunbathing lawn.

For all ages

There are several sports fields for the active holiday maker. Children will enjoy the extensive entertainment programme, an indoor and outdoor playground and, of course, the large water slide. The campsite also has a petting zoo with chickens, cows, hogs and a pony.

properties.name: Vagues Océanes Marina Landes
properties.description:
Vagues Océanes Marina Landes is located on the edge of a vast forest in the Landes region, less than a kilometre from the beach and the Atlantic Ocean. There is something to do for everyone on this complete campsite. The large outdoor and indoor swimming pool, with paddling pools and slides, is fun for young and old. If you want to work up a sweat, visit the wellness centre (with sauna) or the fitness centre.

Well-organized camping terrain

The campsite is large, but orderly laid out. Well-paved roads lead you over the extensive camping grounds to your pitch, located in one of the different zones. Because of the high trees many touring pitches are in the shade. However, there are also plenty of pitches on a sunny spot. You can also choose one of the various rental accommodations: apartments, cottages and lodges are waiting for you.

Outdoor and indoor swimming pool

At the entrance you will find the swimming pools. Camping Marina-Landes has an indoor pool and an outdoor pool. Both pools are spacious and fun for children. The outdoor pool has several slides and a large water slide. You will also find several nice paddling pools, with a mushroom fountain and a crocodile. The indoor pool also has a children's pool.

Something to do for everyone

On the campsite there is something to do for every camper. Children can play to their heart's content in the large playground and swimming pool. If you want to unwind in the sauna, the wellness centre is the place to be. With a sauna, massage shower and hammam among other things, the possibilities here are countless (but paid for).

properties.name: Belvedere Pineta Camping Village
properties.description:
Belvedere Pineta Camping Village is a spaciously laid out campsite in a rural setting in the north of Italy. The campsite is located on park-like grounds. But this is not the only unique feature of this campsite. The private beach also makes this a suitable location for a relaxing holiday.

Choose your own camping pitch

The pitches are partly located on sheltered fields and partly on open grounds. You will find a pleasant shade everywhere and the pitches are not clearly demarcated. On Belvedere Pineta Camping Village you can choose your own favourite pitch.

Time to hit the water!

From the campsite you have direct access to the beach, which is reserved for campers. From your lounger in the shade you have a view of the water and you can watch the bobbing boats. The beach is also great for children. There is enough space to play and furthermore the beach slopes gently down into the sea. Also fun: take a trip with a kayak or water cycle!

For the entire family

If you cannot sit still for very long, you will feel at home at Belvedere Pineta Camping Village. Explore the two running tracks, play a game of volley ball or work up a sweat at the table tennis table. At the far end of the campsite you will find the clear swimming pool, ideal for swimming lengths. There is also a colourful slide. During the summer months children can join the mini club.

Vibrant centre

When restaurant guests enjoy a delicious dinner or when performances are staged, the square around the terrace becomes the vibrant centre of the campsite.

properties.name: Camping de L'Ardèche - Vallon-Pont-d'Arc
properties.description:
The relaxed campsite de L'Ardèche is directly situated along the river and in the region, both of the same name. You will be staying close to the bridge that connects the towns of Salavas en Vallon-Pont- d’Arc. This is very centrally situated in the southern part of this touristy nature area, although very tranquil and amidst greenery.

Green grounds

The 150 pitches are spread over the campsite along several pathways and streets, a number of which are cul-de-sacs.  The pitches are surrounded by trees, hedges and shrubs which offer shade and ample privacy.  Yet there are a number of pitches which are sunny most of the day. However, you will not find manicured or shielded pitches here, which makes for an amiable atmosphere. It is a sandy or grassy surface. A number of larger pitches are directly situated along the riverbank.

Safe swimming in the river

From the campsite you can walk to the riverbank where the view of the high rocks is characteristic for this region. Wonderful spot for swimming, fishing or spending time on the riverbank watching life on and around the water go by. There is a small dam in this part of the river where a wooden platform has been constructed. This is surrounded by several spots for sunbathing or to relax under one of the trees. In summer there is a lifeguard at the river to keep an eye on things.

properties.name: Camping Bagatelle
properties.description:
This very modest campsite with youth hostel and restaurant lies directly opposite the old centre of Avignon. From the terrace you have a view of the Palais des Papes, the largest Gothic building from the Middle Ages in Europe. The campsite lies directly on the Rhône, near the famous bridge over the river. You cannot camp any closer to the city, it is only a ten minute walk to the centre. Camping Bagatelle (open throughout the year) is convenient for a short stay only. For instance, as an overnight stop or to visit Avignon.

Transit campsite

There are more than 200 touring pitches and some 20 motorhome pitches. You can expect compact pitches. The terrain does not have much to offer. There a some hedges here and there for demarcation. Bagatelle also has a youth hostel and a hotel on the grounds. Your fellow campers are people who want to visit Avignon. They come here in July for the well-known annual arts festival. La Bagatelle is actually a transit campsite, intended for guests who are mainly interested in the city sights.

Swimming and canoeing

Adjacent to the campsite is a swimming pool (not part of the campsite), which is also located by the Rhône. The river is not suitable for swimming, but canoeing is a favourite pastime here.

Eating and drinking

The large campsite supermarket stocks an extensive range. The restaurant prepares good, affordable meals and has a large terrace. Both restaurant and terrace offer an attractive view of the city.

Sanitary facilities

The sanitary facilities are housed in a large and old building. All in all it is very basic and, according to Dutch standards, somewhat dated.

properties.name: Camping Relax-Sol
properties.description:
Camping Relax-Sol is a small, cosy campsite situated at some 150 m from a lovely sandy beach on the Costa Dorado. The fishing village of Torredembarra is within walking distance. Mass tourism has not yet reached this area and you can still find authentic Spain here. Both the sea and beach are child-friendly.

The campsite is situated along the coastal road AP7/N340 and is easy to find. Between the campsite and the beach is the railway line which follows the coast from Barcelona to Valencia. You can therefore also travel to the campsite by train.

Numerous pine trees

The grounds are quite shaded due to numerous pine trees. This gives the campsite a Spanish feel. The grounds look well maintained. The pitches vary in size. If you prefer to rent accommodation, you have ample choice between studios, apartments, hikers huts, lodge tents and mobile homes.

Vast sandy beach

There is no swimming pool on the campsite, but after a 150 m walk over a wooden walkway though a nature area, you will come face to face with one enormous wave pool: the Mediterranean. The vast sandy beach has not yet been invaded by tourists. Come and enjoy the peace and quiet.

Nature area

For the children there is a small playground situated adjacent to the terrace. From the camping there are walking trails in an adjacent protected nature area.

Eating on the boulevard

The restaurant at the campsite is of good quality and is reasonably priced. If you prefer to do your own cooking, you can go to the camping shop. Here you will find a limited assortment only, but there is a larger supermarket within walking distance.

properties.name: Camping Elizabeth Hoeve
properties.description:
If you prefer to spend your holiday in a quiet spot, in a quiet environment far away from highways and hectic city life, then this campsite is highly recommended. When you camp here, you're located centrally on the island of Goeree-Overflakkee in South Holland, next to the town of Melissant. The Elizabeth Hoeve Campsite sits in an open landscape. However, the spacious camping pitches are surrounded by lots of greenery, so you benefit from a lot of privacy and shade. The campsite is also located in an area that's beautiful for walking and cycling with several large sandy beaches.

Large pitches with lots of privacy

A special passer-by field has been set up on this spacious campsite for tourist campers. You will find large camping spots here where you can enjoy plenty of privacy.

Shopping and fine dining in Middelharnis

This campsite is located on the edge of the village of Melissant. The bakery and shops can be found in this village, less than a kilometre away. If you really want to do a big day out shopping or eating out? Then it is best to drive to the attractive town of Middelharnis. The town is about eight kilometres from the campsite.

Well maintained sanitary facilities

You will find a modern sanitary building at a central location on the campsite, close to the passer-by's field. You will find plenty of showers and toilets here. The facilities are in excellent condition and meticulously maintained.

A paradise for nature lovers and bird watchers

At The Elizabeth Hoeve Campsite, you'll be camping just a few kilometres from the Slikken van Flakkee nature reserve. This is a water-rich nature reserve where Heck cattle, fjord horses, Scottish highlanders, roe deer and rabbits roam.

properties.name: Rives d'Arc
properties.description:
This well-maintained campsite is situated in a well-known and popular area of the Ardèche. The famous Gorges de l'Ardèche and the Pont d’Arc are literally around the corner of the lively campsite. The riverbank (with spectacular views!) is directly accessible from the campsite. Swimming or canoeing on the river is an unforgettable experience for the whole family. But the unique swimming pool is also a great place to cool down for campers of all ages.

Green and friendly

The natural character of the region is reflected in the spacious camping pitches. They have a grass surface and the pitches are surrounded by trees for a pleasant shade. The comfort pitches have private water connections and drains. Different types of rental accommodation have recently been added and are separated from each other by hedges.

Swimming opportunities galore

On one side of the campsite is a swimming pool with a generous size of 300 m2. Children will not believe their eyes when they discover this swimming paradise. Waterslides, water with rapids, a waterfall, geysers and a bubble bath – it's all there.

On the other side of the campsite, you have direct access to a snug beach on the banks of the river l'Ardèche. A lively spot where you can spend all day swimming, canoeing, fishing and sunbathing. Part of the river is shallow and you have a good view of the water from a higher lying 'balcony' where guests can put their own chairs. The campsite rents out canoes and is also the starting point for wonderful trips of 7, 24 or 30 km.

properties.name: Camping La Yole
properties.description:
Campsite La Yole is located on the Atlantic coast, in the beautiful Vendée. A few minutes' walk and you're on the beach! The jewel in the crown of this well-kept campsite is the water park. Here, the whole family can swim, dip and slide. Together with the playground, the pools make La Yole a real family campsite.

Well-kept pitches

The multilingual receptionists show you the way to your pitch. It is not difficult to find, as the campsite is very well laid out. Spacious pitches are situated on grassy fields and along lanes. They are neatly laid out and are separated by hedges. Are you in for a holiday full of fun? Then choose a pitch on one of the lanes. Would you like a bit more privacy? Then choose a spot hidden between the bushes.

A real family campsite

Camping La Yole is a real family campsite. Your children will love it here. They can have fun on the large playground or in the inflatable ball pit. They will find friends for the whole holiday thanks to the many activities on offer. Together they can play games in the forest or climb on the climbing wall. The arcade is for gamers and table footballers.

A swimming paradise

The pool complex is the jewel in the crown of La Yole campsite. The beautifully shaped pools have room for all the family. The little ones can splash around in the large paddling pool with the water spouting monkey. The two lagoon pools are for the bigger water rats. Do you find it too hot in the French sun? Then there is even an indoor pool where you can splash around.

properties.name: Camp. & Ferienpark Markgrafenheide
properties.description:
Are you looking for a luxury campsite on which there is also plenty to do? This campsite is the place to be. You can determine for yourself how much luxury you want and at what price. The comfort is reflected -inter alia- in the luxury wellness and beautiful swimming pool of this campsite.

Large and well organised

This campsite offers a great deal of shade with its abundance of vegetation, creating a green appearance. At the spacious reception you are welcomed by one of the receptionists. You will notice immediately that everything is well-managed and spaciously laid out.

Different pitches and lots of entertainment

The pitches are all different; some pitches are more spacious than others and the amount of shade also varies. The rental accommodation is of high quality. The campsite offers lots of entertainment and luxury, but not everything is included in the price.

Water fun in style

The luxury swimming pool is located near the wellness centre, a spot where you can totally relax or, if preferred, get involved in sport activities. There is an additional range of sports possibilities on the campsite. You can get to the beach via a nice and easy pathway.

Eating and drinking

The restaurant offers a selection of different menus to choose from. You can also have a drink at the bar. The supermarket is well stocked and you can do all your grocery shopping here. The sanitary facilities are spacious, clean and environment-friendly equipped. They are in several places on the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Coll Vert
properties.description:
Camping Coll vert is an urban campsite in Pinedo, a southern suburb of Valencia. This is a great starting point for exploring this beautiful city with its lovely museums and impressive architecture. There is also the Playa de Pinedo within walking distance, one of the most beautiful beaches in the region.

Shade from the trees and nets

The camping pitches are located on grassy fields among trees and are accessible via half paved roads. Sometimes the trees are a bit farther apart, sometimes dense. The leafy canopy creates a nice shade. For extra shade, nets have been hung in some places. 

There are separate pitches for campers and caravans with a paved surface. The hire accommodations are located on a neatly laid out section of the campsite. The terrain and the cottages are very well maintained.

Swimming pool, sun and sea

There are two swimming pools on Camping Coll Vert. The kiddie pool is relatively large. Around the other pool, also large, there are loungers and thatched parasols ready for the real sun worshippers among the campers. There is a short water slide in one corner of this pool. If you'd rather go swim in the sea or tan on the beach, you only have to walk 300 metres to the loveliest beach you'll find for miles around.

Valencia by bus or bicycle

If you want to go to Valencia, it's easy to take the bus. One stops every half-hour at the campsite. You can also ride a bike. Follow the eight kilometre Cami Verde, a cycle path along the beach to the centre.

properties.name: Camping Strandbad Edam
properties.description:
The amiable family campsite Strandbad Edam is situated along the Markermeer, at the port entrance of Edam. You have a beautiful view over the Markermeer. The area attracts visitors from all over the world. You can amble through the narrow streets of quaint IJsselmeer villages and small towns, like Marken, Monnickendam and Volendam.

Well maintained camping lawns

The L-shaped campsite is beautifully situated along the Markermeer, part of the IJsselmeer. From the reception you drive over a tarred road to your camping pitch on one of the well maintained camping fields. Interspersed by trees. The camping pitches, which are adequate in size, are not separated. There are a number of rental trekker huts on the campsite.

Jetty for surfing and swimming

Children can romp around to their heart's content on family camping Strandbad Edam. There is a large lawn for them, a playground and a children's swimming pool with view of the Markermeer. For water sports enthusiasts there is a surfing and swimming jetty, stretching out into the Markermeer for quite a distance. Enjoy the view over the lake from one of the chairs along the water's edge. Backpackers can prepare a meal in a specially equipped cooking area.

Restaurant with view over the Markermeer
