On the campsite grounds, near the mouth of the canal which connects the Markermeer with Edam, is a restaurant with a large terrace with sun umbrellas. This stunning location is great to spend sunny days here. There is no shop or supermarket on the campsite. You can do your shopping in nearby Edam.

properties.name: Camping Le Saint Martin
properties.description:
Located in Moliets Plage in the French department of Landes, this campsite offers you everything at your fingertips: the sea with a beautiful wide sandy beach, heated swimming pools and a cosy village with nice restaurants. Campers from all over Europe know where to find this great holiday spot in the dunes. Le Saint Martin Campsite is the ideal base for a sunny beach holiday with the whole family.

Camping and glamping

Here you will camp on a hilly terraced campsite with your camper, caravan, folding trailer or tent. Most pitches are separated by hedges, so you have plenty of privacy. In addition to camping pitches in various sizes, this campsite has luxurious glamping accommodations that make for an extremely comfortable stay.

Swimming guarantee

Taking a dip, whizzing down waterslides, bubbling and splashing - you can do it all here. The campsite has an aqua park.. Here you will find several swimming pools, slides, a waterfall and a heated indoor swimming pool. The littlest ones can splash around in the paddling pool. When packing your suitcase, keep in mind that Bermuda shorts and swimming shorts are prohibited in the swimming pools.

Via the dune path to the beach

The sea is also very close. You can walk to the wide sandy beach along the Atlantic Ocean without having to leave the campsite. The Landes beaches are very popular with surfers and other water sports enthusiasts. But keep in mind that this place is not always the best choice for swimming with young children. The expansive beach, on the other hand, is ideal for looking for shells and building sandcastles with your little ones.

properties.name: Camping Kastraki
properties.description:
Camping Kastraki, located close to Asini and Navplion on the Greek peninsula of Peloponnesos, is an ideal destination for those who love culture, water sports and beach activities. Located right by a large sandy beach, it offers the perfect opportunity to enjoy the deep-blue water of the Argolic Gulf.

Demarcated pitches under pine trees

Camping Kastraki offers demarcated pitches under pine trees, ideal for caravans, motorhomes and tents. Although the pitches are on the small side, the pine trees provide plenty of shade. There are also neat caravans for rent, suitable for a maximum of two adults and two children. Free wifi is available in the rental caravans as well as at the pitches.

Fully equipped toilet and washing facilities

The campsite has a centrally located toilet block with spacious showers with hot water, a baby room and adapted bathrooms for the disabled.

Charming bar and fully-scale supermarket

For relaxation and pleasure, there is a charming bar with beautiful views of the sea and a full-scale supermarket with an extensive selection including traditional Greek delicacies.

Optimal enjoyment of the Greek beach life

Camping Kastraki offers direct access to the beach where you can enjoy activities such as swimming, stand-up paddleboarding, pedal boats, surfing, jet skiing, canoeing and snorkelling. There are also possibilities to hire equipment or to sail to deserted islands.

Ancient Greece ruins

The campsite is an excellent starting point for exploring the historic sights in Peloponnesos. Nearby attractions are the Cyclopean masonry of the old Asini citadel, the archaeological museum of Navplion and historic locations such as Mycene, Tiryns, Argos, Midea and Epidaurus, all within 40 minutes by car.

properties.name: Camping Lacona
properties.description:
Camping Lacona is located less than one hundred metres from the Mediterranean, in the south of the Island of Elba. In Elba you will recognise the characteristics of Italy: wooded hills, elongated coastlines and a rather rugged landscape. When you stay on Campsite Lacona, this is all within easy reach. 

Under the Italian pine trees

Camping Lacona is set amongst tall pine trees. They not only provide shade on the camping pitches, but also create a relaxing environment.  Despite its peaceful location, the campsite is not only frequented by seekers of peace and quiet... 

Up in the air

It is, in fact, the active holiday maker who will feel right at home. Pack those walking shoes in your suitcase, because Elba is a great hiking region. You will have to walk at a brisk pace though, as Campsite Lacona is situated on a hillside. When you go for a walk, this will invariably mean walking uphill. 

Swimming in the sun

In addition to walking shoes, swimwear is also useful on campsite Lacona. In one of the open areas, not sheltered by tall trees, you will find a large swimming pool. Ideal for swimming a few laps under the sun. Feel like a snack after your swim? Then head for the adjacent restaurant with its pleasant bar.

A deep dive

Of course, you can also walk a bit further along and dive into the Mediterranean. You can also opt for a deeper dive: the coast is well suited to snorkellers and divers. Do you want to go to the beach but have forgotten to bring a bucket and spade for the children? The campsite shop has a wide variety of beach items to choose from.

properties.name: Camping JP Vacances - camping de Noirrupt
properties.description:
Camping de Noirrupt, situated in the beautiful Vosges region, is reminiscent of a park. You'll be certain of enjoying nature here thanks to the many hiking and cycling options offered by the forested, hilly area. The atmosphere on the campsite is friendly. You don't have to cook every day - there's a good pizzeria.

In the hilly area with plenty of lakes, you can go hiking, cycling and mountain biking. You can reach the campsite from the Netherlands or Belgium via toll-free roads.

Camping in the forests

The enthusiastic owners, Jean-Yves and Anne, will bid you a friendly welcome at the reception. Some tourist information is available at the reception, and you will see the bar and pizzeria right away. The campsite is set out like a park and is situated in the middle of the forest.

Plenty of greenery

The camping pitches differ in size, but all are spacious enough. You will camp on a lovely grass surface and the pitches have plenty of privacy thanks to the plants. Chalets can also be hired at Camping de Noirrupt. Families with children have been camping here for a long time. The sanitary facilities on the campsite look well maintained.

Heated swimming pool

There is a lovely heated swimming pool with sun terrace and loungers. A special feature is the underwater viewing window. The swimming pool is in the sun and borders on the bar and the terrace. There is a playground available for children.

Delicious pizzas

If you don't fancy cooking at times, head to the pizzeria for delicious pizzas. Fresh bread is available in the high season, along with some groceries.

properties.name: Camping La Mer
properties.description:
Campsite La Mer is located in Cap d’Agde, the coastal area of the southern French city of Agde. The campsite is situated almost right on the Mediterranean coast, which makes it a perfect home base for many days at the beach. Furthermore, the campsite is an ideal starting point for city trips. From Cap d’Agde, you can get to beautiful French cities such as Carcassonne, Narbonne and Montpellier in no time. If you need to get some grocery shopping, then go on the bike! The local shops are very easy to reach.

Two parts

You will be warmly welcomed to the campsite grounds by Geraldine and Renée Pouget. The many (palm) trees will also heartily receive you. The campsite can roughly be divided into two parts. The pitches are mainly on the right side of the campsite and the left side is reserved for the accommodation.

With the whole family

Campsite La Mer is a real family campsite. There is plenty of entertainment, especially in the summer. Various games and sports tournaments are organised here. The bouncy castle also provides plenty of fun for the little ones. And of course, you can take a trip to the beach to build sandcastles every day.

Béziers

At 25 kilometres from the campsite is where you will find Béziers, one of France’s oldest towns. The town is an amazing sight: The River Orb flows through it, the cathedral stands out above everything and there are little old houses with orange roofs. The best way to drive into Béziers is from a south-westerly direction. You then go over the old bridge and you are almost directly at the cathedral, a must see.

properties.name: Camping Les Coteaux du Lac
properties.description:
The wonderful Camping Les Coteaux du Lac is situated in a quiet and wooded area at the Chemillé lake. From here it is not far to the castles of the Loire, the royal town of Loches, the ZooParc de Beauval, the most beautiful Zoo of France (more than 3000 animals). The campsite is equipped with all amenities.

Spacious set-up

When you arrive at the campsite, you will immediately notice the beautiful, open layout. Most pitches are generous and partly shaded by trees. There are different rental accommodation units such as chalets, mobile homes and lodges. The campsite makes a general nicely laid out and well cared for impression.

Swimming and eating

Because the campsite is situated directly by the lake, you get the impression that you can swim in front of your tent. Although the beach is nearby, it is located just outside the camping grounds. A great place to stay Les Coteaux du Lac has its own swimming pool with water slide. Directly situated at the lake you find Brasserie Carpé Diem, with a lovely terrace.  A bit further on is the restaurant Le Moulin de Chaudé, a real winner. You can enjoy traditional dishes made from regional ingredients, often grilled over a wood fire.

Top sanitary facilities

Camping guests will want for nothing during their stay on this campsite. There are well equipped and modern sanitary facilities. Everything is kept in pristine order. You can make use of the washing machines and dryers and even an iron.

properties.name: Camping Vinkenhof/Keutenberg
properties.description:
The quiet Vinkenhof/Keutenberg family campsite is in the south of Limburg. Here, you camp in lovely, natural green surroundings at the foot of the Keutenberg. The campsite is within walking distance of the picturesque village of Schin op Geul and at cycling distance from Valkenburg. You can choose from several types of pitches or an exceptional rental accommodation for your stay. At the campsite, you can take a swim in the heated outdoor swimming pool, the kids can play in the playground or with the recreation team, and you can treat your taste buds in the lovely Viva La Vink eatery. Will you be joining us on a camping holiday in Limburg?

Lovely camping pitches and unique accommodation

You will be warmly welcomed by the owners on arrival. The campsite is in an undulating landscape which provides stunning views from most pitches. The general toilet and washing facilities are neat and people with disabilities can use the special toilet and washing facilities. Holidaymakers without their own camping equipment can stay at a wonderful place at Camping Vinkenhof/Keutenberg. You can choose from various types of accommodation such as a dome, hunting cabin or chalet.

Fun in the water for ten

A new swimming pool and the lovely water playground opened at the campsite in 2023. The swimming pool is spacious, neat, and nice and warm! The water is heated to 26 degrees. Next to it, there is a water playground with a spray park where children can play safely. There are various sun loungers around the swimming pool so that you can relax by the water. Viva la Vink eatery is next to the swimming pool. Here, you can enjoy delicious regional dishes or a cup of coffee with a tasty slice of Limburg flan.

properties.name: Camping Belvedere
properties.description:
Belvedere is a rather large campsite on Lake Garda. The campsite is spaciously laid out with much greenery. You can go to Lake Garda via a footpath, but the swimming pool with slides is also very popular. It is well organised and facilities as the restaurant and shop are excellent.

Spacious and well organised

The reception is spacious and offers a lot of tourist information. You will be bid a friendly welcome by the receptionist Marco Tonioli. The campsite slopes down to the lake and there is a profusion of flowers and plants. The campsite looks spacious and tidy.

The most beautiful pitches on the lake

The shaded camping pitches vary in size, are reasonably spacious and are demarcated with hedges. The surface is level and not hard. You can also rent beautiful mobile homes. The most beautiful pitches are located on the boundary of the campsite and have a view of the lake.

Swimming pool with super slide

There are two swimming pools: a smaller pool (with sunbathing terrace, loungers and sun umbrellas) and a large pool (with various slides, including a long slide). Near the large pool is a kiosk where you can buy drinks and refreshments. The campsite is situated directly on Lake Garda. The beach is easily reached via a footpath. Roll out the towel and start soaking up the sun!

Terrace with view of the lake

The campsite shop is large and well stocked. The town of Lazise has a lot to offer in terms of shops. The campsite restaurant offers a wide choice of dishes. You can enjoy your meal on the large terrace with a view of Lake Garda. This will make you appreciate your meal even more...

properties.name: Capfun Camping Europing
properties.description:
Capfun Camping Europing is in a large pine forest by the sea, about 16 kilometres from the city of Tarquinia. Here, you camp right by a kilometres-long sandy beach. The campsite itself has a lovely leisure pool where you can go for a wonderful swim. Furthermore, you will find various sports and game facilities here, as well as a restaurant, bar and supermarket. The campsite is located in a region that is particularly interesting in archaeological terms.

Shaded campsite and very luxurious mobile homes

If you go to this campsite for a touring pitch, you will probably be assigned a pitch in the pine forest that covers the majority of the campsite. This forest means that almost all pitches are in the shade, which is ideal.

Holiday-goers who love glamping can also go to Capfun Camping Europing. Book a luxury mobile home for your stay, for example.

Wonderful swimming in the outdoor swimming pool or in the water of the azure blue sea

This holiday park is ideal for those who love beach life, because you can walk straight onto the beach from the campsite. From there, you can go for a lovely swim in the azure blue water of the Tyrrhenian Sea. On the way to the beach, you walk past the campsite's lovely swimming pool. This water park has a large basic swimming pool, a half-depth children's pool and a paddling pool.

Admire Etruscan remains

This region is the birthplace of the Etruscan culture that had its heyday about 2,600 years ago. So you will find numerous sights of immense archaeological value in the vicinity. You can for example visit the remains of a large necropolis (old cemetery), the Etruscopolis museum and the national archaeological museum, all in Tarquinia.

properties.name: Vakantiepark Capfun het Stoetenslagh
properties.description:
Vakantiepark het Stoetenslagh is a family campground where you'll find many young people. There is plenty to do on the campground thanks to many sports actvities, its own recreation lake and a lovely covered swimming pool. You have plenty of privacy on the protected campsites. Unique to this camping is that the activities and facilities are specially created for teenagers.

Beach camping

Arriving at the campground, you'll see the recreation lake and the modern, spacious reception building with a shop. Around the large playfully designed swimming lake with beach are the fields with names like Whale, Pelican and Gamba Beach. The beach theme is found all over the campground.

Spacious sites and plenty of action

The campsites are spacious (at least 120 m2), well maintained and surrounded by forests. Active children and teenagers will never be bored thanks to a panna field, bowling alleys, indoor beach, disco, beach volleyball field and white sandy beach by the lake. The most beautiful campsites are also by the water.

Swimming and chilling

The covered pool, that looks like a greenhouse from the outside, is one of a kind. There is a pebble beach, play beach, rapids, bubble bench and a shallow section for the little ones. The teenagers have their own space: the Box, a place where you can relax with people of your own age. There is free wifi all over the campground.

Surprising tapas

The beach theme is also present in the restaurant. Everything is prepared with fresh ingredients and there is a tapas menu with surprising dishes. You can buy your essentials in the shop. The four nice sanitation buildings are cleaned up to six times a day and leave nothing to be desired.

properties.name: Capfun Camping IJsselstrand
properties.description:
The IJsselstrand campsite sits on the banks of the Oude IJssel river, near Doesburg in Gelderland. This large family campsite consists mainly of permanent annual pitches and mobile homes, but there are also quite a few touring pitches available. The spacious pitches are laid out on the grass.

Camping on the dike

There are no less than 400 permanent annual pitches at the IJsselstrand campsite. There are also 480 rental properties. The majority of the campsite consists of mobile homes. However, there are 119 touring pitches, so you can enjoy camping here with your tent, caravan or camper. The touring pitches are located on separate camping fields. They are spacious pitches on the grass, mostly without shade.

Swimming and sunbathing

The campsite has a large swimming pool. This is a real swimming paradise with its large waterslides, spacious paddling pool, and nice bubble bath. You can sunbathe on the terrace or the lawn around it. You can also swim and play in the river. There's also a beautiful sandy beach along the shore.

Pleasant terrace

Next to the reception is the restaurant with a pleasant terrace. It overlooks the playground with various types of playground equipment. On the other side of the reception is a well-stocked supermarket.

Play paradise

There are extensive facilities at the campsite, especially for the children. In addition to the water park, there is an outdoor playground as well as a large indoor playground. In Speelparadijs Clapoe, older children and the little ones can have fun.

properties.name: Camping L'Arlesienne
properties.description:
A quiet family campsite in the heart of Roman antiquity. The beautiful centre of the famous city of Arles is only two kilometres away. In addition to an ideal location for nice excursions in the Bouches-du-Rhône, the campsite also offers a heated outdoor swimming pool for guests to enjoy. You can also have a nice drink or eat pizza in the evening on L'Arlesienne Campsite's terrace.

Camping in Provence

The A9 motorway runs from Nîmes to Marseille in the far south of France. Along the way, the main road will take you through Arles, the city of the Romans and of Vincent van Gogh. The entrance to the campsite is on a side street in a quiet residential area on the southern edge of the city. There is a bus stop within walking distance that takes you to Arles. An enthusiastic French couple manages the neat and well-appointed looking campsite.

Green all around you

Deciduous trees, planters, hedges - the campsite's abundant greenery provides pleasant shade and exudes tranquillity. The site has about 100 pitches on flat grass fields. A number of these feature stylish mobile homes for those who desire a more luxurious camping experience. All touring pitches are naturally demarcated and are spacious enough for large caravans. The two sanitary buildings, one of which has been recently renovated, look neat and tidy.

Nice outdoor pool

Next to the reception and the terrace is the spacious, rectangular swimming pool. But that's not all! The swimming pool also has two large water slides, and there is a paddling pool for the youngest camping guests.

properties.name: Camping Menina
properties.description:
Camping Menina is situated in the heart of the Upper Savinja Valley, in the northern part of Slovenia. The campsite is surrounded by mountain peaks, forest, farms and small villages. At a 20-minute drive from the campsite is the town of Mozirje. Here you will find a few shops and restaurants.

XXXL camping pitches

The camping pitches are located between trees and shrubs. They are spacious and not demarcated. There are also special XXXL pitches for groups or families camping together. In addition, there are various bungalows and mobile homes. The Bear Lodges are probably the nicest of all. These are bungalows made from large wooden beams. Here you can enjoy the outdoors from your own roof terrace.

Swimming pond and climbing park

The campsite is mainly geared towards families with school-age children. There are a large number of activities in terms of playing and things to experience. The swimming pond is eco-friendly and is built entirely from natural stones. When you walk down the path towards the edge of the campsite, you will reach the natural pond. It is ideal for swimming. In addition to a playground, there is also a climbing park on the campsite. 

Enjoying the Finnish sauna

Camping Menina has a perfect spot to relax in: the Finnish sauna. You can also go for various massages. In peak season there are regular fun activities (barbecue, wine tasting, Slovenian language lessons, cookery workshops and polka shows). The campsite is also open during the winter.

Campsite restaurant

The bar and restaurant are located at the front of the campsite. The terrace offers a view of a brook and a section of the campsite. The restaurant has an extensive menu.

properties.name: Camping Het Lierderholt
properties.description:
Do you feel like a camping holiday in which you will never be bored? At Vakantiepark Het Lierderholt you can spot the game from your tent, make cycling trips in the Veluwe, children can pretend to be star chefs and you can venture on an exciting ghost tour in the woods. In peak season there is a different entertainment programme each week, with the Summer festival in August as a highlight.

Watching game from your tent

The camp site has a wide choice of pitches with electricity. You have a choice of a quiet pathway, in one of the fields, or in the game spots along the game route (the animals cannot enter the camp site). The camping grounds have modern playground equipment for smaller children. Special camping spots are available for mobile homes. Furthermore, there is a Thetford machine at the campsite, so you can empty and flush your toilet cassette in a matter of minutes.

Heated water playground

Water fun is available in the heated outdoor swimming pool with a thematic children's pool. The little ones can paddle in the water playground, slide down the tree-trunk slide and play on the water crocodile. Water aerobics lessons in the swimming pool are organised regularly.

Dine with the season

For a tasty dinner with fresh seasonal products, step inside the à la carte restaurant Eeterij De Lierderhoeve. For a quick snack, the Friterie is the place to be. Of course, you can also cook for yourself, as the park shop has all the groceries you need. In the morning you can pick up fresh rolls here. Feel like a drink after dinner or a cup of hot chocolate after a walk in the woods? Then take a seat in the cosy Grand Café n° 49.

properties.name: Camping de Olite
properties.description:
Campsite de Olite is situated in the north of Spain, half an hour's drive from Pamplona on the main road to Zaragoza. Because of its location, this basic campsite is particularly suitable as a stopover campsite for campers on their way to the south or east of Spain. The overall look of the campsite is characterised by the large number of permanent pitches; at the far end of the terrain is a separate grassy field with touring pitches. The campsite is located near the monumental town of Olite with its medieval streets and superb palace.

Separate camping section

The camping grounds are filled with mobile homes and chalets, the fixed abode of annually returning camping guests. At the far side of the camping grounds, behind these permanent pitches, lies a separate camping field with touring pitches. Here you can set up your caravan or motorhome. There are some ninety non-demarcated pitches on a large, flat grassy field. From your pitch you have a panoramic view of the Spanish countryside.

Soccer and swimming

Kicking, throwing or hitting a ball? It can all be done at the front of the campsite. Besides a reception building, there are a soccer field, basket ball field and tennis court. In between the fields you will find the swimming pool, where you can enjoy a refreshing dive after a vigorous match. There is also a toddler pool.

The Royal Palace of Olite

The campsite houses a small supermarket and a restaurant, but you can also do your shopping in Olite, some 5 km from the campsite. A perfect opportunity to visit the Royal Palace of Olite. This Gothic palace towers high above the medieval houses of the town.

properties.name: Camping & Bungalows Zumaia
properties.description:
Camping & Bungalows Zumaia Cat. 1 is a brand new campsite, situated on the outskirts of the coastal town of Zumaia in Spanish Basque Country. Everything is very well maintained and the pitches are located on a level surface. Furthermore, the campsite is within walking distance of the beach and there are good bus and train connections to the attractive surfing town of Zarautz and the beach resort par excellence of Basque Country: San Sebastián.

Terraced campsite

The terraced campsite is located on a hill, so you are assured of a lovely view. The young vegetation offers little shade as yet. However, all pitches are demarcated and offer ample privacy. Like to take things easy? There are rental bungalows.

Beach between cliffs

The campsite has a large outdoor swimming pool with sun terrace and a toddler pool. If you prefer to swim in the sea, a lovely footpath will take you to the beach and the small town with its pleasant esplanade. The sandy beach of Zumaia is situated between impressive cliffs. Unfortunately, it is quite a climb back to the campsite.

Take-away meals

In addition to two outdoor pools, the campsite has a playground and a bar-restaurant with small menu. Take-away meals are available. At the reception you will find a limited selection of foodstuffs (also bread).

Excursion programme

The campsite offers an entertainment and excursion programme and there are several cycling routes. Rather prepare a day trip yourself? Wi-Fi coverage is available on 80% of the campsite. This means you can do some research on your laptop or tablet.

Brand-new sanitary equipment

The sanitary facilities are brand new and are kept neat and tidy. Please note: the road to the sanitary building has a slope. There are special provisions for the disabled with a wheelchair.

properties.name: Camping Les Druides
properties.description:
Between the Gulf of Morbihan and the Quiberon peninsula, you will find the peaceful campsite Les Druides. The peace and space on this campsite provide a feeling of well-being, as does the lovely heated swimming pool. The sandy beach and the centre of Carnac are nearby, as are the well-known prehistoric menhir fields and megaliths. The neighbouring Quiberon peninsula is also a tourist drawcard.

Shaded pitches

The campsite has a well-maintained appearance. You can choose between sunny and (partially) shaded pitches on a lawn along hardened main paths. Most pitches are surrounded by hedges or separated by trees. Want to hire something? There are several mobile homes and apartments.

Bubble bath

The beautifully shaped swimming pool with integrated toddler pool and bubble bath, surrounded by planters and palms, is a feast for the eye. There are a large number of sun loungers and the green fencing provides shade in several places. The sea is some 500 m away and can be reached via a paved road with footpath.

Sports and play

Apart from the swimming pool, there is enough to do on the campsite, including jeu de boule and table tennis. Furthermore: a multifunctional sports field and recreation room (TV, video games, pool table and table football). For the tiny ones, there are several playgrounds with a bouncy castle, slide and merry-go-round.

Food truck with chips

In high season a food truck passes by a few times a week with chips, pizza and snacks. The camping also offers fresh bread. At a distance of 500 m, you will find a very well-stocked supermarket.

Sanitary facilities

The sanitary facilities are clean and more than ample. In high season you may have to wait a while.

properties.name: Camping La Ferme
properties.description:
At La Ferme campsite, enjoy a camping holiday between the mountains and Lake Annecy. These beautiful surroundings invite you to sporting activities, but you can also completely unwind and recharge. The relaxed atmosphere and unique activities at this family campsite are sure to make for an unforgettable holiday. There are 'Olympic Games' for children and you can enjoy delicious tartiflette evenings (a Savoy oven dish with cheese, potatoes, onion and bacon).

Everything has been thought of

At this medium-sized campsite in the heart of the village of Chaparon, you'll find spacious and shady pitches on grass. The campsite also has modern rental accommodation. The mild climate, characterized by cooler summer evenings, makes this destination very suitable for families with young children. Your dog is also welcome. After a dip in the lake, they can take a special dog shower. Also handy: this campsite has free charging facilities for electric cars.

Holidays full of water fun

The campsite has an indoor swimming pool and an outdoor heated pool with a shallow end for the younger campers. There's even a steam room and jacuzzi to relax in. The campsite is situated only one kilometre from Lake Annecy. The water in the lake is of excellent quality.

Always something delicious

The ultimate holiday feeling of course also includes good food and drink. At La Ferme campsite you'll have plenty of both. The bar and restaurant with terrace offer a wide selection of dishes and drinks. You'll also find a campsite shop and a snack bar.

properties.name: Camping Dei Fiori
properties.description:
In the hills of the Italian region of Liguria, not even a kilometre from the Mediterranean Sea, lies the Dei Fiori campsite. The hills on the outskirts of the coastal town of Pietra Ligure boast a stunning view of the rolling landscape. The Dei Fiori campsite is fairly simple in design and great for the whole family, but also has a lot to offer the more active camper. The physical activity options in the area are virtually endless.

Terraced campsite

Even though the campsite is located along a main road that runs directly from Pietra Ligure to the beach, it is actually rather peaceful. The pitches, which are located on terraces, can sometimes be a bit on the tight side, but often receive plenty of shade. You can also opt for a modern mobile home. Some of the spots even feature a glimpse of the Mediterranean Sea.

A refreshing dip

During the hot Italian summer days, a refreshing dip in the on-site swimming pool is rather nice. A hedge of trees provides shade around the pool, which is not particularly large. This is not a problem though, because the Mediterranean Sea is a mere 600 metres away. Pietra Ligure beach is a fantastic place to take in the sea and sun, but you have your choice of beaches along the Italian coast. 

Active camping

Those who love physical activity will love it here as well. Ask about the outdoor activity options at the reception area. Of course, the coastal location means that water sports, like windsurfing, sailing and diving, are popular here, but there is plenty to do on solid ground as well. The Italian hills practically beg to be conquered on a mountain bike and the region has many steep areas for climbers.

properties.name: Camping Serenissima
properties.description:
Situated along the Brenta river on the agricultural mainland, in proximity to Venice, you will find Camping Serenissima. This peaceful campsite is especially popular with campers who want to visit Venice (bus stop in front of the campsite) and/or Padua. In terms of facilities Serenissima is a relatively basic campsite, most visitors only spend a couple of days here.

Quiet and green

The campsite with its abundance of greenery and deciduous trees is an oasis of peace, a lovely spot to relax after a visit to the, at times, hectic Venice. The reception is friendly and and the atmosphere amiable. The pitches are spacious, well maintained and largely shaded. You have a feeling of camping in a lovely, green garden. On the campsite you can rent basic mobile homes and bungalows, suitable for a maximum of four persons. The sanitary facilities are not hypermodern, but they are neat and clean.

New acquisition

The swimming pool on the campsite is brand new and a refreshing attraction after a visit to Venice on a summer day. Talking about refreshing: at the reception you will find a bar for an ice cream, a beer, cool drink or a lovely cappuccino. Furthermore, there is a basic restaurant and a small camping shop for the most important necessities.

Must see

Guests who camp here, mainly come to see Venice. The bus stops twice an hour in front of the campsite and takes you to Piazzale Roma in 20 minutes. From there you walk straight to the old centre of Venice or board a vaporetto, the boat that takes you through the canals.

properties.name: Camping Paradis L'Orangeraie
properties.description:
Halfway between Barcelona and Valencia, on the east coast of Spain, lies campsite L'Orangeraie. This small three-star campsite lives up to its name: the campsite looks like a botanical garden, full of lovely flowering shrubs and trees. The campsite is laid out on a sloping terrain with beautifully designed terraces. Here you can enjoy a well-deserved rest. L’Orangeraie is located some ten kilometres from the coast, but from your pitch, you can see the Mediterranean Sea glistening in the distance.

Like a botanical garden

The pitches are spread out across the park-like camping grounds on beautifully laid-out plateaus, surrounded by citrus trees, palms, cypresses and olive trees. With only 62 pitches, this is a small-scale campsite, resembling a botanical garden. The pitches are clearly demarcated and the numerous trees and bushes provide a fair amount of privacy. The pitches vary considerably in size. If you have a large caravan or motorhome, ask for one of the larger pitches when you make your booking. 

Soothing peace and quiet

On the campsite you do not notice anything of the hustle and bustle of the coast. For many campers, this is a great relief when compared to the busy, overcrowded campsites on the coast. In fact, it may be a bit too tranquil for some. Except for the swimming pool, there are few activities on the campsite and there is no entertainment programme. 

Blue lagoon

Campsite L’Orangeraie boasts a superb blue outdoor swimming pool, with a lagoon-shaped design and surrounded by large palm trees. There is a separate toddler pool. The swimming pool is surrounded by a tiled sun deck with loungers and thatch sun umbrellas. The swimming pool is located adjacent to the restaurant, offering a view of the azure water from the pleasant terrace.

properties.name: Camping Bella Vista
properties.description:
Camping Bella Vista is a name you'll hear in more than one country. If your holiday destination is Italy, our Camping Bella Vista is located in the Liguria region. Here, you'll be camping amidst flowers and a garden with greenhouses. Albenga, located on the famous Flower Riviera, is just south of Camping Bella Vista. The Mediterranean Sea is only a mile away from the campsite. An ideal campsite for families with children of all ages.

Camping

Here, you can camp among flowers and plants, on various small 'streets'. Bungalows, mobile homes and Coco Sweets are available for rent.

Enjoy Italy

The heated pool is surrounded by sun beds to laze on and get some holiday colour. And a requisite cooling dip in the pool is certainly not a bad idea... The facilities include sanitary facilities, a table tennis table and a playground for small children. Enjoy a snack or a meal in the bar (or take it away). Buy freshly baked bread rolls in the morning.

Cinque Terre

Anyone camping in Liguria should definitely visit Cinque Terre - it's more than worth the two-hour ride. The reward is fifteen kilometres of picturesque, rocky coastline. Cinque Terre refers to the five villages that spectacularly cling to the steep cliffs. A hiking trail takes you past all five villages. Visitors should be in good physical condition to visit the Cinque Terre as paths can be steep and steps many.

properties.name: Camping Covelo
properties.description:
Camping Covelo is located on Lake Iseo in northern Italy, near the town of Iseo. Lake Iseo is smaller and less touristy than nearby Lake Garda and is certainly worth visiting. The campsite is situated directly on the lake and the charming town centre of Iseo is 2 km away.

Italian family business

After you have reached the campsite via a relatively narrow road, you will be welcomed by the manager, who runs the reception together with his sister, while his mother tends to the kitchen and his father makes the pizzas. A real Italian family business. The flat terrain extends along the banks of Lake Iseo. The most beautiful pitches are located by the lakeside. The shaded pitches are not large, so caravans and camper vans are pitched lengthwise so that everyone has a decent view of the lake. 

The two very well-maintained sanitary blocks were renovated in 2016 and 2017 and are also suitable for the disabled. The campsite also has rental facilities available such as bungalow tents and caravans.

Enjoy Lake Iseo

Covelo is not aimed at a particular group of campers, but the majority of campers are seniors. Its location directly on the lake and the sunbathing area by the water are ideal. The large campsite restaurant, which also acts as a pizzeria and bar, is simply furnished and has a terrace with gorgeous views of the lake. You can order fine (regional) dishes and pizzas here. The campsite shop, which is located in the restaurant, only offers the most basic supplies. For your daily shopping, Iseo is nearby.

properties.name: Camping Les 3 Lacs du Soleil
properties.description:
Camping Les 3 Lacs lies in the department Isère, in the French Alps. You are camping here in a nature area surrounded by three ecological lakes. You can swim in the recreational lake which borders the campsite. It has a gigantic water slide, a sandy beach and a sunbathing lawn. There is also a swimming pool with children's pool on the grounds. The pitches are spacious and demarcated with trees, shrubs and hedges.

Lodge tent, bungalow or fishermen's cottage?

On Les 3 Lacs you will find many different types of furnished tents and mobile homes for rent. There are basic bungalow tents, but also more luxury and attractive lodge tents with private sanitary facilities and a wooden veranda. Mobile homes are available in various sizes and degrees of luxury. If you prefer peace and quiet and a beautiful view, you can choose one of the basic fishermen's cottages.

Three lakes = triple joy!

What is special about this campsite is its position in between three ecological lakes. Upon arrival you will immediately spot two of the three lakes on either side of the access road. Swimming, pedal boating and playing with inflatable toys is allowed in the lake bordering the campsite. There is also a large water slide with three sliding chutes.

Entertainment for all

In peak season many activities are organised for guests. Every guests can participate in the aqua gym, aerobics, dancing, beach volleyball, water polo, tennis and table tennis. The activities are divided in a morning and an afternoon programme. There is a mini club for children up to age 10 and a recreation hall with games and activities for teenagers.

properties.name: Camping Virgen del Mar
properties.description:
You will be camping at a quiet, well-maintained campsite just 300 metres from a beautiful beach on the rugged north coast of Spain. The beautiful city of Santander is within cycling distance. At Virgen del Mar Campsite, you can take a dip in the outdoor swimming pool and enjoy a delicious meal at the restaurant. A great base from which to explore Cantabria. Hikers and cyclists will find nice routes here and there is a beautiful course nearby for golfers.

Spot in the grass

What really stands out about the site are the many plants and shrubs. All pitches are spacious and neatly laid out on narrow streets. You will have beautiful green grass under your feet. Most camping pitches are not demarcated. Those with large campers should practice caution when driving past the trees. There is a large sanitary building on the campsite that looks neat and is clean. In addition to the touring pitches, the campsite also offers the option to enjoy your holiday in one of the 40 furnished bungalows or mobile homes.

Cooling off

The big advantage at Virgen del Mar Campsite is that you can either swim in the pool or walk 300 metres to the beach and take a dip in the Cantabrian Sea. Just watch out for the rocks and the often strong current there. You also won't want to miss the lookout point at the tip of Isla Virgen del Mar. There are several beautiful beaches a little further away, including Playa de la Arnía and Playa de San Juan de la Canal.

properties.name: Camping Le Sous Bois
properties.description:
On Camping Le Sous Bois you'll be camping in the Charente-Maritime, a region known for oyster and mussel growing, fishing and winemaking. The campsite is located on the west side of Ile d'Oléron, a stone's throw from the Atlantic Ocean and just outside of the town of La Cotinière. There are many activities organised, and evening markets and fireworks shows.

Accommodation with its own jacuzzi

The camping pitches look nice and vary in size. The camping pitches are (half) shady or sunny. The shade is created by the many acacias, oaks, mulberry trees, bignonias, pines and albizias. There is plenty of attention paid to the planting on the campsite. In additions there are many different accommodations, the most luxurious of which have their own jacuzzi.

Sports at Camping Le Sous Bois

For children there is a playground with wooden play equipment, a slide, swings and climbing nets. You can also practices sports on the campsite. You can play volleyball, basketball, football, petanque and table tennis. In July and August there are also sports tournaments organised.

On a humid summer evening

Opposite the reception you'll find a large tent where all kinds of activities are organised. There are plenty of activities in the heigh season, such as karaoke and dance evenings and performances. There are also quieter activities such as make-up workshops, hikes and horseback rides for you to enjoy. There is also an outdoor jacuzzi and a little sauna. You can also have a massage for a fee.

The bus is coming

From the campsite you can take a bus to various beaches in July and August. The bus runs multiple times a day during that time.

properties.name: Camping Estanyet
properties.description:
Estanyet is the most southerly located campsite in Catalonia. This quiet and charmingly landscaped campsite is located practically on the beach, just south of Les Cases d'Alcanar. The sanitary facilities here are excellent. There is plenty to do for the children on the campsite. The sea, of course, also offers plenty of opportunities for recreation.

Atmospheric and vibrant campsite grounds

The campsite grounds are charmingly landscaped. Everywhere are shrubs, colourful flower beds and tall palm trees. You drive to your camping pitch via a paved road which runs in a loop over the elongated grounds. The camping pitches are marked by hedges and wild growing trees, which also provide the necessary shade. The campsite also has several different types of homes available for rent. Most of them have a charming veranda.

Beautiful outdoor pool with patio

There is a beautiful and not too large swimming pool where you can take a refreshing dip. Comfortable loungers are available on the patio surrounding the swimming pool. The adjacent restaurant offers views of the swimming pool and has an exceptional menu. There is also a small campsite shop with a very limited range of supplies.

Beautiful promenade

The campsite is situated practically on the pebble beach. You only need to cross the road to get there. Just off to the left is the beginning of a palm tree-lined promenade which leads to the harbour of Les Cases d'Alcanar. It is fun to follow this promenade on foot, by bike or using roller blades. You can also have a wonderful time on and in the sea. Discover what lies beneath the waves while snorkelling or scuba diving or make a trip in a rented kayak.

properties.name: Camping Oda Hoeve
properties.description:
You will find the hospitable Camping Oda Hoeve senior campsite in North Limburg, on the edge of the Heldense Bossen. Surrounded by asparagus fields and meadows, this campsite is in the quiet countryside between the villages of Helden and Kessel. The campsite is affiliated to the SVR (Stichting Vrije Recreatie/Free Recreation Foundation), which indicates the campsite is all about quiet, space, nature and the hospitality of farmers.

A warm welcome

On arriving at the campsite, you will be welcomed with open arms in the recreation room, where a hot cup of coffee awaits you. This warm welcome comes from Maikel and Collin, the friendly campsite managers.

Campsite amid the meadows

At Camping Oda Hoeve, you can get a camping pitch amid the natural greenery, close to the Slawin nature reserve. The site itself is well-maintained and organised. The paved pitches for caravans are laid out so that you cannot see into the neighbour's, providing plenty of privacy. Every pitch is provided with water, electricity and wastewater discharge. Hedges have been planted between the pitches, which neatly demarcate each pitch.

Toilet and washing facilities

On the site there is a main building with two smaller buildings housing the toilet and washing facilities. These facilities are always exceptionally clean, neat and heated. There are also special toilet and washing facilities for the disabled.

Entertainment at the campsite

You don't have to leave the campsite for entertainment. Numerous activities are organised, varying from barbecue evenings on the patio to musical performances. Or go on an excursion with the comfortable Oda Hoeve covered wagon, which fits no fewer than 30 people. With this covered wagon, you can for example visit a castle, mushroom nursery, asparagus grower or beer brewery.

properties.name: Camping Village Adriatico
properties.description:
Camping Village Adriatico is located to the south of Venice, on the Adriatic Sea in the community of Sottomarina of Chioggia. It is a clean and charming campground that has limited space due to its location in town, so the sites, access drives and the manoeuvering space is limited. It is not a campground for large caravans or campers. In addition to the shady campsites, there are mobile homes and chalets to hire.

City camping on the beach

The campground has a swimming pool and a playground for the children. The swimming pool is in a central location with a less lovely view of the apartment blocks bordering the campground. There is a restaurant annex bar (also take-aways) and a small campground shop for just the necessities. Through the city location of the campground, there are legions of shops and restaurants in the neighbourhood. The beach, as is so often divided up in Italy, is reached by crossing the street from the campground. There is a private area of the campground with lounges and parasols (for a fee).

Little Venice

Adriatico is only a stone's throw away from the beach. If you want to go to Venice, you can take a boat from Chioggia. It's an hour's drive from the campground to Venice. A visit to nearby Chioggia is really worth the effort, which lives up to its name of Little Venice. There is also a lovely picturesque market once a week on Thursdays, one of the largest in the Veneto region.

properties.name: Camping Belvedere
properties.description:
Camping Belverdere is situated in Calceranica al Lago, on the southern shore of the attractive Lake Caldonazzo in the province of Trentino. Lake Caldonazzo, awarded with the Blue Flag, is renowned for its clear and pleasantly warm water in summer. The lake is a veritable El Dorado for swimmers and water sports enthusiasts. The surroundings of the lake are also excellent for cycling.

View of the lake

The first impression of Belvedere is one of a friendly, small family campsite with – by Italian standards – spacious pitches with little demarcation. An added feature is the view of the lake from some of the pitches. There is a camping shop where you can also get fresh bread. Furthermore, there is a bar with terrace where you can enjoy a lovely hot cappuccino or a cold beer.

Area with sports opportunities galore

The campsite has its own private beach along the lake, ideal for swimming, surfing, canoeing and waterskiing. Part of the ciclabile della Valsugana cycle route runs past the western shore of Lake Caldonazzo. The route is mainly flat most of the way and therefore not a problem for less trained cyclists. The mountains and hills around the lake provide ample scope for walking and mountain biking trips.

Sanitary facilities

The sanitary fittings in the central ablution block are kept spotless.

Must see

The beautiful town of Trento (from the campsite approx. 20 km down the SP1 and the SS47) is definitely worth a visit. Guaranteed to make your cultural heart beat faster. Visit the numerous churches, squares and museums.

properties.name: Camping Al Pescatore
properties.description:
Camping Al Pescatore is located in northern Italy. This quiet shady family campsite offers campers a lovely swimming pool and charming bar. On the other side of the street is Lake Caldonazzo, the warmest alpine lake and suitable for all types of water sports.

Flowery property

The sites on the property with many flowers and trees are located under leafy trees and along streets with little separation. The spaces are reasonably spacious and easy to reach. There is no rental accommodation.

Beautiful swimming pool and clear water

If you love swimming, you have the choice between the swimming pool and Lake Caldonazzo. The swimming pools are in a lovely location with sunbathing areas and plenty of greenery around them. You also have a view of the beautiful mountain landscape in the distance. In the kiddie pool there is a spraying mushroom and a slide, the deep pool has hydromassage. There are loungers and parasols. Next to the swimming pool there is a charming bar with a terrace and a view of the lake.

The lake with pebble beach is also attractive. The water is also very pure. (Blue Flag certification). You have to cross a road to get there, but it's worth it. The lake stays shallow for metres, so children can play and splash safely. Water bikes and boats for rent.

Playground

In addition to the swimming pool and lake, children will have fun in the playground. In the high season there is daily entertainment (sports tournaments, disco, etc.).

properties.name: Campingplatz Bullerby
properties.description:
Campsite Bullerby is located in a wooded area, slightly west of Osnabrück. The campsite borders Lake Atter, a large lake which is ideal for swimming, fishing and boating. The campsite has undergone an extensive facelift since the arrival of the new owner. The new camping field by the lake is beautifully laid out. The sanitary facilities have also been renovated. But here and there it is still obvious that previously the terrain was not in a very good condition. Therefore, Campingplatz Bullerby is a campsite with potential.

Transit campsite

Campingplatz Bullerby may be described as a stopover campsite. Its location, close to the highway, makes this an ideal campsite for campers on their way to the east or south of Europe. Furthermore, Osnabrück is within reach and the Teutoburg Forest is also not very far away.  The touring pitches on the camping field by the lake have been completely renovated and are beautifully laid out. The generously sized pitches offer a view of Lake Atter. 

Lake Atter

There is a large natural pool on the campsite. Lake Atter is ideal for swimming, but you can also get onto the lake with a pedalo or boat. The lake is accessible to all guests of Campingplatz Bullerby and to day visitors from the area. You can go for a lovely walk around the lake.

New sanitary facilities

The restaurant and reception have not yet been tackled, but the sanitary facilities have been renewed. The toilet building has been totally revamped and looks beautiful and well kept. The sanitary facilities are (obviously) only available for campsite guests and not for the day visitors who come to Lake Atter.

properties.name: Capfun Camping Ponderosa
properties.description:
Camping Ponderosa is located in a wooded and agricultural area in Noord-Brabant, between Breda and Baarle-Nassau. This comfortable four-star campsite is actually a holiday park, with touring pitches and a wide choice of rental accommodations. The touring pitchess are nicely laid out on separate fields. Each field has its own small playground.

Pitches

The campsite consists of different parts. There are over 130 touring pitches, which are located together on five fields, beautifully landscaped, with spacious pitches and greenery around.

Water fun for everyone

There is a beautiful, heated indoor swimming pool at the campsite. The swimming pool has a bubbling bench, a rapid and a water slide of no less than sixty metres long. There is also a separate paddling pool for the little ones with fun water jets and play equipment.

Plenty of entertainment

That Ponderosa is a family campsite shows in the professional entertainment team and the extensive entertainment programme. During the school holidays (May and Summer holidays) there is entertainment for the whole family with a separate entertainment programme for children, teenagers and adults. Especially for small children there is a spacious craft loft. Teenagers can go to the Chill Out Zone. Every week there are disco evenings and regularly you can go to a pool party. Camping Ponderosa also has a unique track where you can race a BMX.

Catering facilities

The campsite has a wide range of restaurants: there is a restaurant where you can have lunch and dinner. For a quick bite you go to the snack bar. Both the restaurant and the swimming pool are not only accessible for camping guests, but also for passers-by.

properties.name: Capfun Camping Erkemederstrand
properties.description:
Camping Erkemederstrand is a child and dog-friendly camping ground at the Nuldernauw in Flevoland. The camping has a marina, a field for youngsters, a group camping area, panna football cage and much more. There are numerous facilities for children, such as an Indian village, petting zoo, play forest and entertainment. A large number of water sport facilities in the vicinity.

At the waterfront or inside the dykes.

At Camping Erkemederstrand you have a choice between a camping pitch at the waterfront or inside the dykes. When you camp at the water's edge, there is always something going on. The beach is close by, just like the playgrounds and the bouncing castle. The pitches are a generous size of at least 125 sqm each and they all have electricity. If required, you can opt for a pitch with water supply and drainage or water tap.

Dog camping area

In Jyly and August, you can camp on a special camping area which has a play area and off-lead walking area for dogs. While you are relaxing in front of your caravan or camper, your dog can play in the fenced-off area. Dogs (on lead) are allowed everywhere on the camping.

Entertainment

The ‘Recrateam’ organises entertainment for all ages. Together with the mascots of the camping children can play games, practice little dance acts or do crafts. Children also have fun in the outdoor pool and on the water play island with various slides. It goes without saying that the open water offers numerous sports activities in the vicinity. There is a surfing school where you can take surfing or sailing lessons or you can rent a sailing boat, surf board or motor boat. There are two harbours: the Oude Haven and the Jutterhaven. Furthermore, ideally suited to cycle through the woods, along the water's edge or nature reserves in the region.

properties.name: Capfun Ferienpark Tecklenburg
properties.description:
Capfun Ferienpark Tecklenburg is situated in the natural surroundings of Münsterland, just an hour's drive from the Dutch border near Enschede. The campsite is easily accessible from the German A30 motorway (exit 12) and is situated in the wooded and hilly countryside on the outskirts of Teutoburger Wald. The campsite has a quiet and welcoming atmosphere.

Ferienhaus Holli

Ferienpark Tecklenburg is a large campsite with approximately a thousand camping pitches. You can, of course, come with your own camping equipment, but you can also rent a Ferienhaus Holli (mobile home) on the campsite.

Active recreation for the entire family

The campsite caters to the entire family and this is apparent in the sort of entertainment that you can find on the campsite. The children can play to their heart's content on the playing field with playground equipment and a fun jungle gym. In the peak season, an entertainment team organises numerous activities for the children. Dress up as Pocahontas on Indian day or sign up with the entire family for the Family Olympics.

Water fun and spa

On the outskirts of the campsite, you will find two swimming pools (indoor and outdoor pool) with spa facilities such as a sauna and a massage parlour. Both swimming pools feature a separate paddling pool and a slide for the little ones. Has an afternoon in the water made you hungry or thirsty? Walk over to the centre of the campsite and order a drink at the campsite bar or pull up a chair in restaurant 'Das Landhaus'.

properties.name: Lone Camping A/S
properties.description:
Lone Camping, located in Haukeland (province of Hordaland), is in a lovely location on a lake. You'll enjoy the view of the surrounding mountains. The campsite is located only twenty kilometres from the centre of Bergen. Handy: the buses toward Bergen stop in front of the campsite. Bergen is a city with a lovely historic centre with the Bryggen quay as the eye-catcher. It is on the list of Unesco world heritage sites.

Popular campsite

There is a modern reception at the entrance. The first contact is made by the reception staff, who will handle the formalities and can answer nearly all of your questions. You drive into the campsite from the reception. Consider that this is a very busy campsite. Not strange, considering the popularity of the Norwegian fjords in general and especially the city of Bergen.

Wet and dry

The pitches are marked out and you will be shown to your pitch. You can choose between pitches on gravel or pitches on the grass, by the water. The pitches by the water offer beautiful views. Like all campsites in Scandinavia, Lone Camping has typical Scandinavian hiker's cabins and holiday homes for rent.

Before the entrance to the campsite there are two regular supermarkets. There is also a restaurant with a large menu next to the petrol station a bit further on, while the petrol station does have a snack bar.

properties.name: Camping de Haro
properties.description:
Camping de Haro is situated on the banks of the Tirón River, in the La Rioja region, renowned for its prestigious wineries. The lively town of Haro is within walking distance and the culturally rich town of Vitoria is also not too far away. The location is ideal for wine aficionados.

Pristine grounds

The elongated, level and well maintained site is beautifully landscaped with numerous trees. The touring pitches have a grass surface (quite firm) between the permanent pitches or on fields. They are demarcated and are in full sun or (partly) shaded. The pitches vary in size. If you would like to rent accommodation, you can opt for a bungalow. There is a fence along the river, so that the campsite is also safe for small children.

Beautiful swimming pools

The spacious swimming pools near the entrance look beautiful and are ideal if you want to swim a few lengths. The swimming pools are surrounded by lush greenery which, as the day progresses, increasingly offers shade on one side. There are several sun loungers by the pools.

Festivities in Haro

There is a multi sports field where children and youngsters can enjoy themselves. Entertainment for children is offered in peak season. The small town of Haro, which organises regular festivities, is within walking distance. There, in numerous cellars, you can imbibe the tasty regional wines.

Snack bar

The camping shop has a limited choice of daily necessities in peak season and over weekends. There are good shopping facilities in the nearby town of Haro. Feel like a quick bite? No problem! The bar-restaurant is opened in peak season and during weekends.

properties.name: Camping El Pino
properties.description:
Camping El Pino is situated in the Andalusian hills in the south of Spain, less than one km from the Mediterranean Sea. It goes without saying that a camping holiday this close to the sea calls for a day of fun in the sun and the sea. A short walk down the hill takes you to the sea and the Torrox Costa beach.

Terraced campsite with lodge tents

You can spot the small lodge tents as soon as you enter the campsite. They are found all over the terrace-shaped campsite of El Pino. The terraces are easy to reach via paved roads. The camping pitches, varying in size, are located on an open terrain (which has a somewhat cluttered appearance). They are either not demarcated or marked with low stone ridges. 

In addition to the almost three hundred touring pitches, the campsite also houses a fair number of permanent pitches, bungalows and chalets. Many of these rental accommodations units are elevated, giving you a lovely view from your patio.

Swimming pool with a view

At the far end of the campsite, on the highest terrace, lies the large, new swimming pool. Great for swimming with the entire family under the watchful eye of a pool attendant. There is also a small toddler pool. Drinks, ice creams and tapas can be ordered from the bar and enjoyed on the roof terrace. From here you have a view of the surrounding area.

Mediterranean Sea

A walk of less than one km will take you to the beach of Torrox Costa. This coastal part of Torrox may well be less attractive than the centre of the town located in the hills, but the promenade along the sea has a lot to offer. Along the promenade, starting at the lighthouse, you will find numerous restaurants and bars.

properties.name: Alpinfitness Waldcamping Völlan
properties.description:
At Alpin Fitness Waldcamping Völlan in Lana, South Tyrol, you camp in a unique location with amazing views of the Adige Valley and the Dolomites. This small-scale terraced campsite is on the outskirts of the Völlan (Foiana in Italian) climatic spa. Here, you camp on a hill at 700 metres altitude between the apple orchards, chestnut groves and vineyards. It is the ideal place for active people and nature lovers.

Enjoy the outdoor life in comfort

Choose from three types of camping pitches, each with their own charm and the presence of sun or shade: small, standard or comfort. The toilet and washing facilities have recently been completely renovated, and there's the option to hire private bathrooms. Relax on a sun lounger by the swimming pool or go for a refreshing morning swim. For young campers there is a lovely forest playground where they can play and make new friends.

Fun barbecue and pizza evenings

There is a barbecue hut built in typical South Tyrolean style at the heart of the campsite. In the summer months this is a popular meeting place during the enjoyable weekly barbecue and pizza evenings. You can go to the bar for drinks, snacks, ice cream, coffee and pastries.

Explore the surrounding area with the Südtirol Guest Pass

The surrounding area invites you to go walking and cycling, with the campsite as the perfect starting point for various trips. From the historic village of Völlan, explore the paths that take you past panoramic viewpoints, castles and ruins.

With the Südtirol Guest Pass, you can explore the surrounding area easily and for free using public transport. Nearby lively places include Lana (7 km away) and Merano (13 km away).

properties.name: Recreatiepark 't Veluws Hof
properties.description:
On the edge of the Veluwe, only 5 minutes by bicycle from Hoendeloo, you will find the beautiful campsite ’t Veluws Hof. This is a well maintained, wonderful site to enjoy a carefree holiday with the entire family. The swimming pool with long slide is a veritable feast for children. The area is stunning, very peaceful and natural (woodland and heathland). Cycling and walking are very popular here.

Beautiful pitches

The camping section has a separate entrance. The pitches are well maintained and are located on a fairly new section. There are pitches with lots of sun, less sun and pitches in the woods and as a result with ample shade. All pitches are spacious and offer a certain degree of privacy. Bungalows are also available for rent.

Long slide

The heated swimming pool is first class, not in the least thanks to the long slide. There is also a toddler pool. The entire pool is energy-saving, with solar cells and heat pumps. In high season there is an extensive entertainment programme. Other entertainment can be found on the bowling alley (lots of fun: disco bowling) and the jeu de boule pitch.

Supermarket and catering

The campsite shop is a complete and luxury supermarket where you can really buy anything. They have regular specials such as delicious BBQ packs. Even campers of other campsites often do their shopping here. Catering facilities consist of a snack bar and a much larger restaurant. There is also a beautifully laid out terrace to enjoy your meal outside!

properties.name: Strandparc Nulde
properties.description:
About seven kilometres from the Gelderland village of Putten, Strandparc Nulde, on the Veluwemeer. The campsite has spacious pitches and comfortable accommodation in a watery environment. With several options for water activities, a restaurant with extensive menu and proximity to nature reserves such as the Veluwe, this is an ideal destination for families, couples and water sports enthusiasts alike. Its location just off the A28 makes the campsite easily accessible.

Wide choice on the campsite

The grounds of Strandparc Nulde have a separate camping area, with spacious pitches on grassy ground. Pitches are equipped with windbreaks, providing our pitch with extra shelter. Are you looking for a little more comfort? Then rent an atmospheric Beach House or villa. Ideal if you want to enjoy nature without compromising on luxury.

No two days the same

At Strandparc Nulde, you wake up every day with stunning views over the water. The campsite offers numerous opportunities for fun and entertainment during your stay. For example, play a game of football or volleyball on the sports field, discover the various playgrounds, relax on the sandy beach and take a dip in the Veluwemeer. In summer, the enthusiastic entertainment team provides a fun programme of sports, games and fun water activities.

Water sports and the Veluwe

There are lots of recreational options in the area. Live it up with water sports on the Veluwemeer lake, such as supping, boating or sailing. Don’t have your own water sports equipment? You can rent bikes on the campsite. Walkers and cyclists can explore the beautiful countryside on the Veluwe and surrounding Randmeren lakes.

properties.name: Camping La Grand' Terre
properties.description:
Camping La Grand' Terre is situated at a top location, bang in the middle of the Ardèche, directly on the river with the same name. The camping is situated near the small town of Ruoms where you you can wander among the attractive shops for tourists. Feeling like a more active day? Then there are fantastic walking, horse riding or exciting canyoning tour opportunities in the area.

Camping La Grand' Terre is a real family camp site and eminently suitable for families with young children. It is a very green camp site, creating a very impressive contrast with the grey-coloured rocks in the background.

The camping pitches are spacious and a large portion is shaded. The surface is very diverse: from grass to sand and rock-bed. Please take this into consideration when packing your tent pegs. You can choose between a spot along one of the pathways or between the trees in the woods.

Swimming pool 'with a view'

In the centre of the camp site, you will find a playfully designed swimming pool with a water slide and a separate paddling pool. The view from the swimming pool is magnificent; you look against impressive rock formations. The pool is surrounded by deckchairs which you can use free of charge. In peak season, water aerobic lessons and water games are organised in the pool.

Romping around the playgrounds and training on fitness equipment

Smaller children can climb and romp around to their heart's content in the playground and teenagers will get together at the ping pong tables or on the multi-sports fields. Enjoy a nice game of tennis or put in some training on the outdoor fitness equipment.

properties.name: Camping Le Puits de l'Auture
properties.description:
Camping Le Puits de l'Auture is located in the town of Saint-Palais-sur-Mer (130 km north of Bordeaux). You are here directly on the seafront with a view of the town's lighthouse. The four stars of the campsite probably need some clarification. They are, for instance, not representative of the amenities on the campsite (there is no swimming pool, no restaurant and no entertainment). Rather, it is the intimate atmosphere, the tranquillity, location on the seafront, attractive flowerbeds and excellent sanitary facilities that make the campsite a top destination.

Beautiful pitches and rental accommodation

The 186 spacious touring pitches of Le Puits de l'Auture are located in near park-like surroundings. You camp here on a well maintained, flat grass surface which is demarcated with hedges, bushes and trees. There are numerous open pitches, but also pitches with ample shade.

The well maintained rental accommodation units (21) consist of trekker huts, bungalows and mobile homes. These are modern, in cheerful colours and have a terrace or veranda in front.

Off to the sea

You can easily reach the beach on foot (Grande Côte). It is only a 200 m walk. In front of the campsite are a few rocks, but further along is a sandy beach. Le Puits de l'Auture does not have a swimming pool, organised entertainment or catering facilities.

Pizzas and barbecue

However, there is a pizza takeaway service, mini camp shop and a field with a few brick barbecues which you can use freely. There are also some handy picnic tables. Restaurants and other eateries are aplenty on the seafront promenade. Shops and a market can be found in Vaux-sur-Mer.

properties.name: Camping Bellavista
properties.description:
Campsite Bellavista is situated slightly south of the Spanish town of Aguilas. You can smell the sea air from this campsite: only a coastal road separates the campsite from the beach and the sea. You also have a clear view of the sea because of the slightly elevated position of the campsite. Plenty to do for the entire family with entertainment and a beautiful swimming pool. Furthermore, there is a trendy bar where you can also buy meals.

Camping with shade and privacy

On campsite Bellavista you have a choice of 65 camping pitches of varying size (60 to 80 m²). These have a fine gravel surface and are separated by hedges and trees for privacy. 

Rental accommodation is also available on the campsite. You can spend your holiday in wooden bungalows or mobile homes, all suitable for two to seven persons. In spring the camping pitches are covered with canvas sheeting to create shade.

Swimming fun on the campsite and in the sea

Overall there is an amiable atmosphere on the campsite. If you are looking for a quiet stay, you can choose a pitch at the far end of the campsite. Despite the peace and quiet there is enough to do. For instance, in the attractive swimming pool (100 m2). There is also a separate jacuzzi and a small toddler pool. You can of course also relax and swim in the Mediterranean. The beach and sea can be reached by crossing the road in front of the campsite.

Entertainment

On the campsite there is a variety of play equipment, a table tennis table and a jeu de boules pitch. No inspiration at the moment? The entertainment that is offered is suitable for all ages: from young children to adults.

properties.name: Recreatiepark Goorzicht
properties.description:
Camping Goorzicht is situated close to the nature reserve Het Goor, just outside the Gelderland town of Aalten. Here you are in a wooded part of the Achterhoek, not far from the German border. At the campsite, you can camp on one of the spacious pitches or enjoy the luxury of a mobile home, hikers' hut or log cabin. Children are lucky, because with the large playground, swimming pool (with toddlers' pool) and recreation team, they'll make friends in no time!

Camping by the pool

The 52 tourist pitches are divided over different fields. One field is close to the playground and swimming pool, another is closer to the edge of the forest. The pitches are generally spacious and all have their own electricity and water points. New since April 2021 are the comfort pitches with private sanitary facilities. Also possible: a stay in one of the mobile homes, hiker's huts or the log cabin.

Children's paradise

Goorzicht is mainly visited by families with children. Not only during the school holidays, but also at the weekends. The focus is mainly on children up to twelve years old. They can swim in the heated pool (1.40 m deep). There is also a paddling pool with a small slide. By both pools there is a small sunbathing area to enjoy the sun.

The campsite has two beautiful function rooms that the recreation team uses to organise all kinds of activities, such as a children's disco or bingo night (with great prizes). A favourite with many children is ride in a covered wagon. A fun way to explore the beautiful surroundings. Feeling hungry? The campsite has a cafeteria (with patio) where you can order something tasty from the small menu.

properties.name: Camping Mas de la Cam
properties.description:
The amicable, small-scale and neatly laid out campsite is a Valhalla for children. In high season mainly (Dutch) families visit this campsite. In low season senior citizens are frequent visitors.

Wooded landscape

The terrain is spaciously laid out with a diverse range of standard and comfort pitches in rows along pathways. Trees offer lots or a bit of shade. From your pitch the view is picturesque: the beautiful river with the sunbathing lawn and the pebble beach are surrounded by a gently sloping wooded landscape. Rental apartments.

Water playground

The luxury swimming pool complex of 500m2 consists of two outdoor swimming pools with rock formations, a waterfall and large water playground. One of the two swimming pools is heated.  The pool is surrounded by loungers and a few palm trees. The Gardon river flows alongside the campsite. The water is not too deep (knee deep on one side) and makes for a great deal of water fun.

Large play area

Children can enjoy themselves on a large play area with play equipment and you will also find a multi sports field, tennis court and table tennis tables. There is also an comprehensive entertainment programme for young and old, from water aerobics to disco. Around the campsite are (tough) cycle trails and the camping offers an excursion programme.

Tasty dishes

You do not have to leave the grounds for fresh croissants in the morning: there is a bread service. There is also a small shop with limited assortment. You will find a large supermarket some 3.5 km away in St Jean du Gard. The camping restaurant with small menu offers basic, tasteful dishes and has a nice terrace. Take-away meals are also available.

properties.name: Camping Le Lac D'Orient
properties.description:
In the northeastern part of France, just south of the Belgian border, lies the Champagne-Ardenne region. Are you looking to combine camping among the vineyards with a pitch at a very large lake? In that case, set up your caravan at Camping Lac d'Orient. This campsite is located directly on the lake of the same name. The water is surrounded by a gorgeous forested nature area.

Spacious pitches among the trees

Campers who arrive outside the peak season at Camping Le Lac d'Orient can often take their pick from the beautiful and spaciously laid-out pitches. The pitches are located on the playfully landscaped camping grounds. Some fields are long and narrow, whilst others are small and square or rectangular. The rental accommodations are located on a separate part of the campsite.

Facilities and entertainment

The reception, the small campsite shop, the laundry and the indoor swimming pool are located in a modern U-shaped building. Right behind this building, you will find the outdoor swimming pool and the restaurant which serves snacks.

An outdoor swimming pool, an indoor swimming pool and a lake; what more could a water enthusiast wish for? To reach that lake and its fine sandy beach, you only need to leave the campsite and cross the street. Before you know it, you'll be standing with your feet in the sand at the water's edge.

Entertainment in July and August

There is entertainment for all ages in the peak season. The entertainment team organises all sorts of sports activities, as well as dance parties and concerts. You can play a game of volleyball or basketball yourself on the enclosed sports field. Other fun tips: challenge your fellow campers to a game of petanque or work up a sweat on the outdoor fitness equipment.

properties.name: Camping Le Perpetuum
properties.description:
Camping Le Perpetuum is in the southeast of the Dordogne, just outside the lovely village of Domme. This region is also known as the Périgord Noir. Tourists love coming here to admire the impressive castles, exceptional cave systems and beautiful old towns. One of the most popular tourist attractions is the town of Sarlat-la-Canéda. You can drive there in about 15 minutes from the campsite. Furthermore, this campsite located by the Dordogne River is an ideal starting point for lovely walks and cycling trips in the forested hilly Dordogne landscape.
