Shaded site with mobile homes and spacious touring pitches

Campers are enthusiastically welcomed at the friendly reception. You have free wifi at the entrance of Camping Le Perpetuum. Spacious touring pitches are in the majority at the natural green campsite. At Camping Le Perpetuum, you can book a sunny pitch on the riverbank, for example. If you'd prefer a bit more shade, pick a pitch in a more central location at the site. It is also possible to rent various types of mobile homes.

Water fun in the leisure pool

This campsite's lovely leisure pool is right next to the reception. Here, you will find two playfully shaped swimming pools, one of which is heated. One of the swimming pools has a gradual sloping bottom, so ideal for young children. The youngest campers can have plenty of fun in the water in the paddling pool with water mushroom.

Cool down in the Dordogne River

A small path runs from the campsite to a small sandy beach by the river. You can find even more beautiful and mainly larger beaches at about 500 metres from the campsite, both upstream and downstream.

properties.name: Camping Grand Air Cadu
properties.description:
The Grand Air Cadu campsite is a unique spot in the south of Brittany, not far from the Atlantic coast on one side and the Gulf of Morbihan on the other side. Here you camp on a spaciously arranged pitch or stay in one of the finely furnished mobile homes. The partly covered, heated swimming pool is the heart of the campsite. In high season, you can visit the snack bar for pizza and ice cream.

Touring pitches and mobile homes

The Grand Air Cadu campsite is a medium-sized campsite with touring pitches and a large number of mobile homes. The spaciously arranged touring pitches are located at the front of the campsite grounds. Pitches with more than 100 m² camping space tend to be the rule rather than the exception. All the pitches come equipped with electricity and water. Many pitches are separated from each other by hedges. Together with the trees on the grounds, this creates plenty of privacy. Would you prefer to stay in a mobile home? That's an option as well. The campsite has a large number of relatively new mobile homes available for rent.

Swimming and sunbathing

The partly covered pool is the heart of the campsite. There is also a small playground and a sports field here. For the little ones, there's a separate pool for splashing around in, and the (slightly) older children can have fun on the water slide. You can dry yourself off afterwards on one of the loungers next to the pool. You don't have to go swimming at the campsite; the sea is within easy reach as well. After a walk of a few hundred metres, you can spread your beach towel out on a fine sandy beach.

properties.name: Camping Empordà
properties.description:
Campsite Empordà is situated on the Costa Brava, less than a hour's drive from Girona. This level campsite offers everything you need for a wonderful, sports-filled family holiday. You can play basketball or kick a ball around. In all likelihood, you do not have to worry about your children; they will thoroughly enjoy themselves with the entertainment team. Moreover, there is also a large campsite swimming pool.

Camping or renting?

Camping pitches of all types and sizes are located on grass between pine trees. Whether you are camping with a large motorhome or a small tent, there will always be a pitch to your liking. If you do not have your own camping equipment or like to enjoy a bit of extra comfort, you can also rent a luxury bungalow, of course. This will afford the whole family ample space for a comfortable stay.

Water fun!

Centrally located on the campsite you will find the large swimming complex. With a semi Olympic size swimming pool and a separate pool with various fountains for the children, there is more than enough water to enjoy your swim. Furthermore, the swimming pool is conveniently located near the restaurant and the bar, so you can order a delicious pizza or a drink on the terrace after a refreshing dive.

Sporty character

Camping Empordà is geared at the sporty camping guest. And that is quite obvious! On the sports field you can play basketball, soccer, a game of pétanque or beach volley ball. Young campers have also been taken into consideration with two children playgrounds and a fun kids club, which organises all kinds of activities in high season, including foam parties, disco evenings and canoe trips.

properties.name: Camping Don Quijote
properties.description:
Close to the university city of Salamanca, the capital city of the province with the same name, lies Camping Don Quijote. This hospitable campsite is an ideal holiday destination for sampling the Spanish culture and enjoying peace and quiet all year round. You can also sample the culture in the excellent restaurant. Explore the surrounding area by canoe on the Tormes river, or cycle to the historic centre of Salamanca.

Don Quijote shows the way

When you stay at camping Don Quijote, you are in the area of Salamanca, a historic city in the northwest of Spain. The campsite is just under four kilometres east of the centre of Salamanca, on the banks of the Tormes river. There, painted on a wall by the spacious entrance, you will see the man after whom the campsite is named: Don Quixote. He points you in the right direction, through the barriers, to the level, open terrain. And there you are, on one of the spacious touring pitches – especially suitable for motorhomes and caravans because of the hard surface.

On the Tormes

The campsite is right on the banks of the Tormes river, which starts in Prado Tormejón and flows past Salamanca to the Portuguese border. Those who love to fish should certainly take their rods. Note: you must arrange for a permit first.

Campsite restaurant

The atmospheric and cosy campsite restaurant has a good reputation. In the evenings, many guests come to enjoy the convivial atmosphere and delicious dishes. Due to its high quality, the restaurant is very popular, so it is best to reserve a table in advance.

properties.name: Camping El Helguero
properties.description:
In a gentle sloping landscape, some 4 km from the beautiful coastal resort of Comillas, lies the friendly family campsite El Helguero. You are camping here on an attractive terraced campsite with a friendly Spanish atmosphere. The demarcated pitches are located along a street. You can pitch your tent on the lawn. Apart from the 60 permanent pitches, there are 240 touring pitches on grounds measuring 6.5 ha. From the terraces you have a beautiful view of the mountains. There are 26 rental accommodation units on the campsite.

Charming restaurant

In the attractive restaurant (with bar and terrace) you have a wide choice of affordable, Spanish dishes. You will meet guests from different countries. Snacks and take-away meals are also available here. The small campsite shop has a reasonable selection. You can get fresh bread and local specialities every day.

Hit the dance floor

The outdoor swimming pool measures 200 m2, spacious enough for a few lengths. There is a toddler pool of approx. 15 m2. Children will have a great time in a playground or can join the entertainment programme (English and Spanish). In the evenings guests enjoy the lovely Spanish life: dancing on folk music or popular music (disco).

Tours through an undulating landscape

From the campsite you can follow signposted walking routes. You can also take lovely cycling tours through the gently undulating landscape. The campsite offers excursions to explore the area together with other guests. This is also a great way to get to know your camping neighbours a bit better! You can do horseback riding, mountain biking and surfing in the vicinity.

properties.name: Camping Im Aal
properties.description:
Only a few minutes' walk from Esch-sur-Sûre, one of the most beautiful villages in Luxembourg, you will find Camping Im Aal, attractively located on the Sûre River. You are here in the Luxembourg Ardennes, a hilly, densely-wooded region with lots of greenery and beautiful valleys. Im Aal is a quiet campsite, aimed primarily at persons looking for peace and quiet who like to walk in the beautiful natural countryside.

Camping by the river

The attractive road to the campsite offers a foretaste of its beautiful location, amidst greenery in a bend of the Sûre. The pitches (a mixture of touring pitches and permanent pitches) are divided into two sections.

Which?

The section closest to the main entrance looks like 'organised chaos' with the most beautiful pitches on the river. The pitches here are reasonably spacious and demarcated with hedges of approx. 1 m high. In addition to the pitches, there are rental mobile homes, a safari tent and a cabin. The other section (only used in peak season) is located on the other side of the Sûre.

Modest campsite for seekers of peace and quiet

As stated above, guests mainly visit here for peace and quiet and for walking. Im Aal is austere in terms of amenities. There is a small shop and a cosy café with a large terrace. You will enjoy the large selection of Luxembourg and Belgian beers. For restaurants, you will have to walk to Esch-sur-Sûre. You can do your shopping in a large shopping centre, 10 km towards the border with Belgium.

properties.name: RCN de Schotsman
properties.description:
Vakantiepark RCN de Schotsman is situated in Noord-Beveland along Lake Veere. It has a convivial ambiance. The position along the water's edge is very attractive with lots of greenery on the campsite. The site is ideal for water sports enthusiasts. The North Sea beach is also in close proximity. The camping section is situated directly alongside Lake Veere, so that you have an unspoilt view.

Professional

When arriving at the park, you will notice that time did not stand still here. A large number of new accommodation units such as bungalows and chalets are available. There is also a multifunctional building which include a swimming pool and brasserie.

Space and greenery

Spacious pitches have been laid out on several fields. The pitches located directly on the water's edge, are the most popular. The campsite is well maintained. Between the camping pitches there is sufficient room to kick a ball or play a game of badminton. The many trees offer ample shade on most pitches.

Sun, water and wind

There is a nice heated outdoor swimming pool with a number of slides. In the main building there is also an indoor pool. You can also show off your water sports skills on Lake Veere. You can go swimming, windsurfing and sailing (lessons possible). Children are also welcome here. Other activities: cycling, go-karting, canoeing and kayaking (equipment can be rented).

Brasserie

Catering facilities galore on the campsite. In the beautiful brasserie you can enjoy a cup of coffee, a nice lunch or dinner.

properties.name: Stover Strand Camping
properties.description:
Not far from Hamburg, directly along the Elbe river, you will find Stover Strand Camping. Despite the proximity of this city of millions, the campsite is situated in an amazingly green and rural area. The pitches are free to select and not demarcated. Nevertheless, there are many trees which provide shade. However, behind the dyke are pitches that are available throughout the year.

Two sites

The reception is housed in a fairly new building which is very well maintained. The staff makes one feel at home straight away. The site along the Elbe offers the most beautiful pitches with direct access to the beach. On the main grounds of the campsite you will find additional well-maintained rental accommodation (tents, mobile homes, rooms and bungalows).

Ideal base with all conveniences

The camping forms an ideal base for visitors wishing to explore the area (Hamburg, Lüneburg) or who like cycling. Many water sports enthusiasts visit here for boating activities on the river Elbe. The campsite has a boat hire service where small motorboats can be hired without a licence.

The city of Hamburg is easily accessible from the campsite by public transport. During the summer months, there is also a shuttle service on Saturdays. In addition, during the summer months there is a free bicycle bus that allows you to explore the Elbmarsch.

You do not have to leave the grounds for groceries; there is a large EDEKA supermarket with groceries as well as camping and angling supplies. There is also an excellent restaurant with regional dishes and a cosy cafe for coffee, bread and pastries.

Entertainment for children is offered on the campsite.

properties.name: Capfun Campo dei Fiori
properties.description:
The Campo dei Fiori campsite is located in Tuscany near the town of Vada on the Riviera degli Etruschi (Etruscan Riviera) in the province of Livorno. The campsite is a bit inland and located a pine forest. It is a large and well-organized campsite with many facilities.

Perfectly organized

The first impression is of a large well maintained campsite with plenty of greenery. The camping pitches vary in size and general space. They have plenty of shade and privacy as they are separated. There are a total of seven modern sanitation blocks. There are also children's sanitation facilities and those for less mobile campers. The rental accommodations (bungalows) are a bit old. A special new accommodation option is the fully furnished lodge tents.

For all ages

The campsite is focused on young families, and they are also the majority, certainly in the high season. On the campsite, you'll find a sleek swimming pool with many lounges around it. It also has a jacuzzi and a separate children's area. There is also a charming bar and there is a restaurant, gelateria, mini market and bazaar with beach and camping articles around a central square.

Beach fun and being sporty

The beach is accessible on foot. To get there, you cross the coast road and walk about 800 metres through a pine forest. For sporty types, there is a tennis court, football and volleyball pitches and a spot for archery on the campsite. There is a playground for the little ones. In the high season, an activities team organizes activities for all ages, such as sports, games and evening entertainment with music or shows.

properties.name: Capfun Groene Eiland
properties.description:
Picture this: you zip open your tent in the morning and the first thing you see are ducks and swans swimming past right in front of you. At Capfun Groene Eiland, just outside of Appeltern in the Land van Maas en Waal, this scene is a daily reality. Many of the pitches at this charming family campsite are right next to the water. The campsite is located on a peninsula in De Gouden Ham, a recreational lake with plenty of water sports options and free access to the Maas river.

Great waterfront camping

The majority of the pitches provide a great view of the water. Five modern sanitary buildings are distributed throughout the campsite – all with a baby care unit, toilets and spacious showers. Sanitary building 5 has a spacious bathroom for persons with reduced mobility.

Ideal home base for water sports enthusiasts

During the summer holiday, Capfun Groene Eiland has entertainment six days a week. In the morning there are fun activities for young children, and the afternoon is filled with sports and games for the entire family. Summer days come to a close with evening entertainment, like a movie, games or music.

Wakeboard, standup paddleboarding or water skiing

Its location by a lake means that the focus of this campsite is on water sports all year round. A refreshing swim can be done in the private swimming bay, where a safe area for swimming is marked off from the rest of the lake. There is also De Uitvliet, a water sports centre that is located on the campsite. Wakeboarding, water skiing, standup paddleboarding and banana rides are possible options offered right at the campsite. Of course, going sailing with your own boat is possible, too.

properties.name: Capfun Camping Heino
properties.description:
Camping Heino is a campground with a large choice of facilities and activities. You're in the right place for lovely cycling excursions and excursions for older guests. This makes Camping Heino a favourite destination for seniors and families for a short or longer holiday.

Charming atmosphere

Upon arrival on the campground, the reception shows that the rest of the campground is also well maintained. You'll also immediately notice the cheery atmosphere. The quiet of the forested environment can be found in the spacious, non defined campsites and car-free fields, where the grass is well maintained. You can park your car just outside of the campground.

The site has lovely play areas: the children can play for hours on the equipment in the playground, can swim in the covered swimming pool with slide and go on adventures with the activities team. The littlest guests can splash in a separate kiddie pool.

Older guests can, except for swimming, also participate in the common activities such as cycling excursions with a picnic, excursions, museum visits, aqua jogging, archery, ball shooting and jeu de boules. If you'd rather do your own thing, there's plenty of space.

The sanitary facility at Camping Heino is lovely, nearly new and is well maintained.

Dining options

Camping Heino has a good restaurant with an extensive menu. There is a special child's menu for the kids. You can also get a nice drink in the bar. Fresh bread can be picked up every morning on site. Only a few groceries are available. There are supermarkets in Heino, easily accessible from the campground by bike or bus.

properties.name: Capfun Camping El Escorial
properties.description:
In a wooded area, close to the Sierra de Guadarrama mountain range, lies this large campsite. If you’re looking for all-day entertainment for both young and old, you’ve come to the right place. Whether swimming and sliding down the spectacular slides, jumping on the bouncy castles, or dancing along with the entertainment – it’s all possible here.

Camping near Madrid and El Escorial

Outside the built-up area of the city of Madrid and in a green setting lies this beautiful family campsite. Capfun Camping El Escorial is a well maintained vacation park with touring pitches, permanent pitches, and rental accommodation. From the campsite, you can visit the old town of San Lorenzo de El Escorial by car within 15-minutes. This impressive complex of buildings was built in the 16th century by order of King Philip the second of Spain. Or would you prefer to soak up culture and shop in the big city? Within an hour’s drive, you are in the heart of Madrid.

Well maintained, large campsite

From the busy main road, turn towards the campsite. It is then easy to reach via a beautiful road through wooded area. Upon arrival at the campsite, you will be greeted by the friendly and professional reception staff. This campsite is known for its helpful staff with knowledge of several languages. The camping fields are spacious with plenty of shade from the large surrounding trees or awnings. Or would you prefer to opt for convenience and rent a comfortable vacation home? At Capfun Camping El Escorial, you can rent nice cottages or mobile homes.

properties.name: Paradiescamping Wolfgangsee Birkenstrand
properties.description:
In the touristy area of the southern part of the crystal clear Wolfgangsee lies Paradiescamping Wolfgangsee Birkenstrand. The campsite is located halfway between the towns of Sankt Gilgen en Abersee, both less than five km away. The Wolfgangsee in the vicinity of the campsite is a lovely place for families with young children. The reason is that you can walk quite a distance into the lake before it gets deeper.

Spacious campsite

Everything on Paradiescamping Wolfgangsee Birkenstrand is well organised and the spacious pitches are clearly demarcated. You can choose between pitches with and without shade. Please note that the pitches on the water's edge have the least amount of shade. The grounds have a hard grass surface and any potholes are immediately filled. The owners also have luxury rental studios and apartments. These are not located on the campsite but in Sankt Gilgen, some five km down the road.

Active and sporty

The Wolfgangsee has a pebble beach. Being able to walk into the water for quite a stretch before it gets really deep is an added bonus (bring you water shoes). Snorkelling, windsurfing and waterskiing are all allowed on the lake. Furthermore, this is a great area to explore by bicycle... Most routes are not very steep and are quite easy to negotiate.

Small kiosk

There is a small kiosk on the campsite for the basic essentials, also for daily fresh bread. The rest of your shopping can be done in Sankt Gilgen or Abersee. Unfortunately, there is no restaurant on this campsite. However, the take-away pizzeria makes up for this lack...

properties.name: Domaine Arleblanc Camping
properties.description:
Domaine Arleblanc is located along the rippling La Beaume river in the south of the beautiful and popular Ardèche region. At this campsite, which has been run by the same family for generations, you will experience camping in the Ardèche as it was meant to be. Relaxing on a pebble beach, going for a swim and having a nice dinner in the beautiful restaurant in the evening. Meanwhile, the children will easily make friends during all the fun activities.

Camping with beautiful view

The site consists of large fields of grass with plenty of shade from trees. You'll enjoy a beautiful view of the river and the cliffs from the camping fields. Now this is real camping in the atmosphere of the Ardeche! Most of the pitches are not demarcated. There are three pitches adapted for the disabled. There are also a number motorhomes or flats available to book.

Relaxing by a babbling river

Domaine Arleblanc Camping is located directly on the La Beaume river. The campsite borders the water for about eight hundred metres and features numerous pebble beaches. The little ones can play and paddle in the shallow areas while the deeper parts are suitable for swimming and sailing. There is also a swimming pool with a separate paddling pool at the campsite for even more water recreation. A separate section also features waterslides.

Entertainment

During the summer, you will find lots of families of all nationalities and ages at this campsite. There are a wide range of activities organised for the children, who can enjoy playing and dancing at the Lenny the Fox club. There are also fun theme nights in the summer.

properties.name: Camping Le Lac Amance
properties.description:
Campsite Lac Amance is on the outskirts of Dienville, a cosy village in the Aube. It's an ideal holiday destination for anyone who loves swimming and water sports. This is because you are camping just a few hundred metres from a recreational lake. The campsite itself has its own outdoor pool and paddling pool. The campsite also has a great playground, a good restaurant and a little shop.

Camping in peace, with space and privacy

If you like space and privacy, Lac Amance is the right campsite for you. All the pitches on this wooded park are about 100 m2. The touring pitches are also neatly separated by hedges, trees and bushes. Want a little more comfort? Modern safari tents and mobile homes are available too. These types of accommodation are suitable for four to six holidaymakers.

Campsite restaurant and heated outdoor pool

Do you enjoy eating and drinking out on holiday? Take a seat in the campsite restaurant and enjoy dishes including a homemade pizza, a juicy Angus burger or a fresh salad. The restaurant also has a delicious dessert menu. It has a great view of the beautiful swimming pool. This heated outdoor pool plus paddling pool is the perfect place to enjoy hot weather.

Near a beautiful recreational lake

The location of this campsite, near the shores of Lac d’Amance, is perfect for water sports enthusiasts. It’s just a short walk to the harbour and (motor) boats that will take you on great trips on the recreational lake. A visit to Nigoland amusement park (13 km) with the children is a must.

properties.name: Camping International
properties.description:
Camping International, on the French Giens peninsula, is situated near the blue water of the Mediterranean. The peninsula is not very large but offers numerous opportunities for fun outings. It is an ideal spot for water sports enthusiasts. The terraced campsite International is characterised by greenery. The basic, demarcated camping pitches are located along small lanes. Numerous mulberry trees provide the necessary shade on each camping pitch. The campsite also rents out well-equipped mobile homes.

Water sports, swimming and relaxation

The camping is frequented by many French guests. These are generally young families and fans of all kinds of water sports (especially windsurfing). You can rent the necessary equipment from the campsite or even take lessons at the diving and windsurfing school. From the campsite you can carry the equipment straight into the water. There is also a lovely small playground to entertain the little ones on this campsite.

The swimming pool is not very large but suitable for cooling down on hot summer days. For some time now, Camping International also has a building with wellness facilities (sauna, hamam, massage). The sanitary facilities of the campsite are fairly new and are well-maintained.

Fish dishes

Feeling peckish? Head for the pizzeria and the restaurant for a wide selection. Here you have a choice of various fish dishes. The restaurant has a lovely terrace overlooking the sea. It is located close to the beach. 

You can get fresh bread from the camping shop each morning. In addition, the shop stocks some basic supplies. Larger supermarkets can be found at a fairly close (walking) distance.

properties.name: Camping Podere Sei Poorte
properties.description:
In the interior of the Le March region, nestled among the green Italian hills, lies Camping Podere Sei Poorte (P6P). Coming from the north this camping is easy to reach from the A14. From there you enter the Italian interior and follow the hilly roads towards the camping along grain fields, vineyards and olive groves and picturesque little towns. The campsite is situated in a wooded and natural environment, away from the mass tourism on the coast.

Dutch glory

The Dutch owners (the Poorte family) or one of the staff members will welcome you to the campsite. The hilly landscape necessitates the layout of the grounds in a special terraced way.

It is obvious that the campsite is lovingly maintained. The camping pitches on grass are very spacious (150 m2) and are surrounded by trees and shrubs. Apart from pitches for tents, caravans, campers and folding trailers, Camping Podere Sei Poorte offers the opportunity of renting a mobile home, luxury lodge tent (glamping) or safari tent.

Swimming pool with a view

Although the sanitary facilities are not new, they are clean and well-maintained. Distributed over 9 small units on the grounds, these facilities are easily accessible to all. The swimming pool (8 x 16 m) also looks nice and is located on a hill so that you have a panoramic view from the loungers over the surrounding woods and fields.

Small children and youngsters can also amuse themselves in the play ground, on the trampolines or on the sports fields. There is an entertainment team for the little ones. In high season there are several families with teenagers, so that this group will also not get bored (night swimming, campfire or just hanging out together).

properties.name: Centre Naturiste René Oltra
properties.description:
Fancy a holiday with sun, beach, relaxation and freedom? Then opt for a stay at Centre Naturiste René Oltra near Cap d'Agde on the Côte d’Azur. This large naturist campsite is part of a naturist village with hotels, a small marina, shops, restaurants and nightclubs. When you reserve a pitch on the campsite, you receive an access pass for the entire naturist village. The campsite is set in a beautiful spot, between nature reserves, dunes and a long sandy beach on the Mediterranean Sea.

Large but well-organised holiday village

This naturist campsite has a unique camping area. The site is laid out clearly, so you can always find your pitch again easily. The pitches have a sandy or grassy surface. You can also rent accommodation, such as a modern mobile home, chalet or lodge.

Sport, entertainment and dining

There is plenty to do for active guests at this campsite. Play a game of football, tennis or beach volleyball, for example, or visit the sports and wellness centre. There are also sporting activities for children, along with creative workshops and surprising excursions. For a bite to eat, you don’t even need to leave the site. There are several restaurants on the campsite.

An ideal holiday address for beach lovers

For beach lovers, this holiday park enjoys a fantastic location. From the camping area there are four access points to a lovely sandy beach. The beach shelves gently into the sea, making it an ideal place for paddling with children. Active watersports fans can swim, hire pedalos, go stand-up paddleboarding, canoeing or kayaking. What’s more, several lively seaside resorts are located right around the campsite, including Cap d'Agde (2.5 km) and Marseillan-Plage (8.5 km).

properties.name: RCN Port l'Épine
properties.description:
RCN Port l’Epine is a well-maintained campsite in Brittany, located on a beautiful rocky coastline with beaches. Many families come here to enjoy the relaxing camping life, the activities and the special ambience of the coast.

Rich in vegetation and well maintained

The campsite makes a well maintained impression. The enormous amount of plants and stunning view are its defining features. The reception is housed in the main building annex residence, in which also the restaurant is located.

The most beautiful pitches along the water's edge

The camping fields are distributed over various fields and are easy to reach via paved roads. The fields look well maintained, with little demarcation. The most beautiful pitches are located along the water's edge with a view of Perros-Guirec. To simplify the camping process, you can also opt to rent a dome tent. You will find many families from the Netherlands here.

Lots of activities for children

You can swim and romp in the heated outdoor swimming pool with toddler pool, located in the sun, next to the restaurant and the playground. Therefore, easy to keep an eye on. From the campsite you can walk directly to the beach via a footpath. Are you camping here in high season? Then you can be assured of an extensive entertainment programme for children and adults (including guided walking tours).

Eating while keeping an eye on the children

The attractively decorated restaurant has a limited menu. You can also get takeaway meals there. From the terrace you overlook the playground and the swimming pool. The sanitary facilities are housed in one ablution block only and are kept well cleaned. Washing up is done in the open air.

properties.name: Camping Le Gibanel
properties.description:
In the Corrèze, in the heart of France, you'll find the lovely castle campsite of Le Gibanel. The campsite has a lovely location along the meandering river Dordogne. Some campsites are right on the water! You can step right out of your caravan for a refreshing dive! In the low season it is really quiet in this green oasis and in the high season young campers can easily find playmates at the swimming pool or table tennis tables.

At a castle

The campsite is in a very special location, on an estate with a castle. The property looks very tidy. This also applies to the sanitation facilities, where a part is accessible for the disabled. Thanks to the many trees, you'll easily find a spot in the shade. The real water lovers naturally go for one of the campsites right on the river. In addition to your own camping equipment, you can also rent a mobile home or rental caravan.

The special thing is that the castle is really a part of the campsite! You'll find the restaurant there and a covered recreation space.

Swimming pool and river

Whether you love swimming, fishing, canoeing or pedalos: in and around Le Gibanel it's all possible. At Le Gibanel's location, the Dordogne splits off, so there is a lake with a weaker current. One side of the campsite borders that lake. It's great for renting a canoe, kayak, pedalo or paddle board and exploring the area from the water. Love fishing? The people at the reception will be glad to tell you where the best fishing is.

properties.name: Campeggio Valle Gesso
properties.description:
The North Italian campsite Campeggio Valle Gesso is situated close to the French border. You are camping here on the edge of the magnificent Maritime Alps Natural Park. This is an excellent spot for (mountain)hiking enthusiasts. There is also a 'via ferrata' in the vicinity, a safe mountain climbing route for beginners. The village of Entracque is within walking distance. Here you will find a few restaurants, bars and supermarkets.

Magnificent mountain view

The well maintained campsite of Campeggio Valle Gesso is laid out in terraces and has a vegetation of deciduous trees, providing ample shade. The pitches are spacious, you have to park your car elsewhere. Caravans, mobile homes and tents are in separate sections. Each pitch offers a view of the mountains. There are rental chalets. There are two neat ablution blocks on the campsite.

Swimming laps with a view

Each person has been catered for in the swimming pool area: there is a playful pool with water slide, a toddler pool with a depth of 60 cm with a mushroom water feature, a pool for swimming lengths and a sunbathing terrace with loungers and sun umbrellas. There is also a whirlpool. Bathing caps are compulsory here. From the swimming pool you have a splendid view of the surrounding mountain landscape.

Sports entertainment for the entire family

Children can enjoy themselves in the playground with climbing equipment, slides and seesaws. Also fun: challenge each other to a game of table tennis and table football. Furthermore, there are soccer and volleyball fields, a pool table and a petanque court.

The beautiful area with water falls, streams, rocks and alpine meadows is extremely suitable for all kinds of outdoor sports. For instance: mountaineering, mountain hiking, fishing, rafting and horse riding. The campsite offers guided walking tours and excursion programmes.

properties.name: Camping Hafsten Resort
properties.description:
Not far from the town of Uddevalla, you will find Camping Hafsten Resort on a peninsula in the western archipelago. In addition to the terraced campsite, the resort also offers rental accommodation in the form of typical Swedish, completely furnished holiday cottages (stugor). The road leading to the campsite is rather narrow, but once you arrive you will be impressed with the location of the grounds.

Five star and quite rightly so!

The five star camping is manifested by the lavish range of activities being offered and the general layout of the very well maintained campsite. Hafsten Resort boasts two recreational swimming pools with water slides, including a children's swimming pool (10x10 m2) and a larger pool (12 x 28 m2) with a water chute of 86 m. The heated swimming pools are centrally located on the campsite with beach chairs, loungers and sun umbrellas. A bit further along there is an attractive sandy beach.

All kinds of entertainment

There is more than enough to do on Camping Hafsten Resort with a whopping sixty-odd activities for families and/or groups. There is a treetop adventure park, a children's club, an indoor play area, outdoor gym, TV and games area, a beach volleyball field, a pétanque pitch, a tennis court and much more. You can also hire pedalos, rowing and motor boats, canoes and kayaks. Furthermore, you can do walking tours from the campsite, or go on a pony or horseback ride. For total relaxation you can go to the hot tubs and saunas.

Feeling peckish?

Obviously, you will not want for anything on this five star campsite. Therefore, enjoy a meal in one of the restaurants. You can also order a take-away breakfast for the next morning here. The terraces are the social highlights of Hafsten.

properties.name: Camping Urbasa
properties.description:
Camping Urbasa is a tranquil campsite, set in a rugged nature park The campsite is situated between San Sebastian, Bilbao and Pamplona. Urbasa lies on a wooded plateau. This campsite is especially suitable for people looking for peace and quiet and for nature lovers. There are few facilities; you are simply surrounded by nature.

Verdant and vast

The campsite itself is completely fenced in. Driving through the electronic gate you reach the reception building, which is hidden under tall trees. The camping grounds are less wooded, but they are vast and verdant. The pitches are not demarcated. You may pick a suitable pitch for yourself.

Quiet and space

At campsite Urbasa you will mostly see hikers, who come here to enjoy nature and tranquillity. The area is ideal for walking. Guided walks are organised from the campsite. Tip: walk to the source of the Urderra river. 

There are a number of cycling routes and you can hire mountain bikes from the campsite. Mountain biking in this area is pretty challenging. However, you will be rewarded for your efforts, because the routes taking you through the rugged nature are breathtakingly beautiful.

In search of adventure

Besides for hikers and mountain bikers, this is also the perfect campsite for equestrians, mountain climbers and speleologists. The campsite has horse stables and you can take some riding lessons. The signposted walking routes in the area are graded into various levels of difficulty, the most difficult ones are intended for mountain climbers. Ask the reception about the possibilities for canyoning, speleology and bungee jumping. In the limestone rocks you will find a number of caves and gorges, which are definitely worth a visit.

properties.name: Camping La Tour des Prises - Ile de Ré
properties.description:
Centrally situated in the Ile de Ré island, you will find the friendly campsite La Tour des Prises. Its setting is magnificent: in an old orchard near grapevines and only 600 m from a fine sandy beach. This family campsite attracts a very diverse public, from families with young children and teenagers to young couples and seniors.

The level camping pitches (85-120 m2) have a grass surface and are separated by hedges. The trees provide ample shade. The touring pitches on this well-tended campsite are kept separate from the mobile homes.

Cooling off

The beautiful and heated swimming pool consists of an outdoor pool (160 m2) and a covered swimming pool (270 m2). There is a separate toddler pool for the little ones. The loungers at the swimming pool await you. Prefer the 'largest swimming pool in the vicinity'? After about 600 m along a paved road, you will reach the fine sandy beach Les Prises, on the Atlantic Coast.

Start the day with water aerobics

In summer, entertainment is offered for children. They also enjoy the trampoline and the playground. You can start the day off with water aerobics. You can practice several sports in the area, such as horseback riding, pony rides, beach volleyball and tennis. And the sea is perfect for kitesurfing, jet skiing, stand-up paddle boarding and (catamaran) sailing.

Eating pancakes near the pool

You can order fresh bread daily. The cosy bar with terrace overlooks the swimming pool. In the friendly restaurant you can order pancakes, take-away meals and ice creams. A few times a week the pizza car stops by.

properties.name: Camping Domaine de L'Orangerie de Lanniron
properties.description:
Domaine de L’Orangerie de Lanniron is in a beautiful location next to the River Odet at the southern edge of the beautiful, historic town of Quimper. The well maintained campging site is located in the park of a 17th century castle. The spacious campsites (80 to 160 m2) are separated by flowers and bushes. You have the choice of a spot with much, some or no shade.

17th century gardens

The campsite is nicely laid out next to the castle (a private estate) on a 6.5 hectare property. You have a lovely view of the river Odet, the orangerie and the gardens, laid out as they were at the end of the 17th century. Due to the tidal danger, swimming is prohibited. You can take a trip with the canoe and kayak club on the river.

Swimming paradise

There is a lovely heated swimming pool (750 m2) with rock fountains, massage benches, jacuzzis and three slides. There are separate kiddie pools with slide for the littlest children.

There is a restaurant/bar with terrace next to the pool. You can get snacks and take away meals on the campsite.

In the restaurant, a restored farm, there is plenty of choice of weekly changing traditional French dishes. Grocery items and regional products (fresh bread) are available in the camping shop. On the terrace you'll find two playgrounds (with trampoline and bouncy cushions) and sports fields (tennis, pony rides). For children there is an activity programme and a mini club (English and French).

Castle Park

The castle park with the 17th century gardens and a large park is 38 hectares: here you'll find Italian baroque and French classical style in the designs. Surely worth a visit.

properties.name: Camping Le Daxia
properties.description:
Camping Le Daxia is situated in a splendid green area in the Roussillon, close to the town of Saint-Clair-du-Rhône. The campsite borders on the Varèze river, where you can splash around and build dams. The grounds are very well laid out, with many trees and flowers and radiates the atmosphere of the Provence. There is a swimming pool with slide and a playful children's pool. You can eat on a shaded terrace at the restaurant-pizzeria.

Provençal atmosphere

Although the campsite is strictly speaking not located in the Provence, it has an undeniable Provençal ambiance with its greenery, the flowers, the ochre-coloured dwellings with tiled roofs and Provençal brickwork. The grounds are well maintained and have a clear street pattern. The amenities, such as reception, are housed in attractive buildings. The camping pitches are varied, but all spacious and surrounded by hedges, trees or flowers. Not all pitches are demarcated; there are also some pitches with facilities for campers.

Chalet or studio

If you prefer the luxury of a cottage, you can rent a modern studio or a basic, wooden chalet at Le Daxia, suitable for 2-6 persons. They look like log cabins and are fitted with a covered terrace. 

Building dams

The swimming pool has a unique construction style with towers around it and a slide. There is limited shelter, but is in a beautiful setting surrounded by a terrace and sun loungers. The children's swimming pool also has a playful design and is large. The river Varèze, bordering the campsite, offers even more water fun. There is playground equipment for the children, including a wooden school bus to play in.

properties.name: RCN de Potten
properties.description:
In Friesland, directly on the Sneekermeer, lies RCN de Potten, in the village of Offingawier. The campsite is a veritable paradise for water sports enthusiasts and people who want to discover the beauty of Dutch nature during their camping holiday. You are camping on spacious pitches, directly by the Sneekermeer. You can dine in the restaurant, which overlooks the water.

Camping on the Sneekermeer

Choose a spacious pitch by the water. These pitches are all equipped with a private water tap and electricity, some of them even have their own mooring for a boat. In addition, there are two fields for camping on the campsite. You can also camp with a tent or caravan here. Travelling with your motorhome? If you are, the paved motorhome pitches provides a solution.

When you walk around this holiday park in Friesland, you will also come across several rental accommodation units: from cosy holiday cottages to large bungalows. You can also rent a holiday villa on the Sneekermeer. Waking up each morning to a lovely view, who does not want this?

Water sports paradise

Water rats take note! At RCN de Potten you can take part in all kinds of activities in and near the water. For instance, sunbathing on the beach, swimming, canoeing, pedal boating or a trip in a rented (sailing) boat. 

There is plenty to do for children. They amuse themselves in the playground, on the sports field, the mini golf course and air trampoline. From April to October there is a fun entertainment team. At RCN de Potten they also organise inspiring holiday church services, accessible to everyone.

properties.name: Camping La Gaviota
properties.description:
Enjoy the friendly atmosphere at the La Gaviota campsite – located on the Costa Brava. This small Spanish family campsite is situated directly on the Mediterranean Sea. You’ll be camping right next to an extensive beach. For acquatic sports enthusiasts and beach goers, this is the ultimate holiday destination.

Particularly green and cosy

After a friendly welcome at the reception, it’s time to find your pitch. Even though it might not be particularly large, it is particularly green. You will camp on grassy fields under dense trees. Your children will also feel very welcome at the La Gaviota campsite. That’s not just because of the nice owners. There’s more than enough to do on the campsite. Whether playing ball or enjoying the sports field together. You can also let them loose in the playground. And, of course, the swimming pool is the real highlight.

Paella with a view of the beach

In the beach bar, you can enjoy a delicious meal. Sit in the sun, and enjoy the view. From your terrace chair, you look out over the beach and the Mediterranean. With a delicious paella or pizza, the view only gets better.

Holidays at the beach

The warm beach sand, the azure sea, the mountains in the background… you can enjoy this unique view over your entire holiday. If you walk off the camping grounds, you’re immediately on the beach. Are you ready for a lazy holiday? Simply lie down on the sand and close your eyes. Taking a cooling dip in the sea every now and then is also allowed!

properties.name: Nou Camping S.L.
properties.description:
This picture-perfect beautifully landscaped campsite is in the river valley of the stunning Vall d'Àneu. The whole area, just south of the French border, is dedicated to nature. The impressive Aigüestortes National Park, where you can hike, cycle, ride horses, fish or even have an afternoon of rafting, is just around the corner. There are no big cities nearby, and that's precisely the charm of this place. There are small villages, and there's a restaurant on the same street as the campsite, within walking distance. Just 500 meters away is the La Torrassa lake: one of the attractions of Nou Campsite. You can swim in the pool at the campsite, as swimming in the lake is not allowed.

Great service

The special countryside around Nou Campsite is perfect for long bike rides. The campsite can organise these for the whole family. But that's not all; you can go mountain climbing, horseriding, bungee jumping and rafting. This can all be arranged by the reception. You can also hire a small boat, book a fishing lesson, or join the archery course. And before you leave the campsite, they will fill a picnic basket up for you, stuffed with local delicacies.

Local party

Just north of the campsite is the village Esterri d'Àneu. This is where Esbaiola't takes place every summer. A street theatre festival, organised by the comedy troupe La Baldufaen. Are you going to be here in the last week of July? Immerse yourself in the local festivities and get to know the particular culture of this part of Catalonia.

properties.name: Romantikcamp. Wolfgangsee Lindenstrand
properties.description:
Want to camp on the shores of a crystal-clear mountain lake surrounded by high mountains? Then Romantikcamping Wolfgangsee Lindenstrand, in the Austrian state of Salzburg is the campsite for you. The campsite has its own pebble beach next to Lake Wolfgang. It’s the ideal starting point for beautiful walks and bike rides through the mountainous surroundings.

Very different camping fields; which one will you choose?

This well-organised campsite consists of two parts, separated by the access road. One side is near the lake, e.g. the Am Seeufer field. Here, on the shore, you fall asleep to the sound of chirping crickets; in the morning, you wake up to the sound of lapping waves.

A little further inland is great too, surrounded by imposing lime trees on the Bei den Linden field. Opposite the access road, you will find an old fruit orchard, where the shady Im Obstgarden field has been created. Finally, there is Auf der Sommerwiese, the campsite's sunniest and most spacious camping field.

Swimming in Lake Wolfgang

The Lake Wolfgang location is perfect for water lovers. The campsite has its own pebble beach alongside this beautiful lake with clear blue waters. Lake shallow for quite a distance, ideal for families with young children. The campsite also has its own swimming dock that extends far into the lake. There are water sports options too. E.g. rent a kayak or standup paddleboard. The campsite also has its own shop and an Argentine food truck regularly stops to sell juicy burgers and typical Latin American street food.

properties.name: Camping L'Isle aux Moulins
properties.description:
Planning to travel the Loire à Vélo? Campsite L'Isle aux Moulins is located on this delightful long-distance cycle route and is an ideal stopover for a short or longer stay. You camp here right on the banks of the Loire, with a great sandy beach just a few hundred metres away. Campsite L'Isle aux Moulins is also within walking distance of the centre of Jargeau, one of the most beautiful villages in the Loiret. Or visit the city of Orleans, also on the Loire. The bike ride there, along the winding river, is particularly beautiful.

Large touring pitches and different types of rental tents

L'Isle aux Moulins is a small family campsite with an intimate feel. But the pitches definitely aren’t small. The biggest pitches are just under 200 m2! Most pitches also have their own electricity connection; sunny and shady touring pitches are available. Coming without your own camping equipment? Then rent a simple tent, a cosy tipi tent or a fully-equipped safari tent with its own kitchen and seating area.

Things to do on and around this campsite?

Decide to stay at the campsite for a day/afternoon after a long bike ride? A good opportunity to work on your throwing technique on the jeu de boules court or play a game of miniature golf. The site has some playground equipment for children. A larger playground is about 200 metres away, near the sandy Loire beach. While you're there, go for a paddle in the river, or head off for a ride in a canoe, kayak or on a standup paddleboard.

properties.name: Camping Benista
properties.description:
The quiet green family campground Benista in the south of Corsica appears a bit dated, but the simple facilities are sufficient for a stay. The nice thing about this campground is that each campsite is different. The sites are about 100 m2 and partially separated by hedges. The many trees on the site ensure that most campsites have some shade.

The beach of Porticcio is 1.8 km away, about a 10 minute drive from the campground. There is a small supermarket and a few other shops nearby. There are studios and bungalows to rent on the campground. Guests come here for the beautiful, broad white sandy beaches in the area, and the many sporty activities.

Barbecuing together

There is a small but lovely swimming pool (170 m2) on the campground, which borders the river. There is a sports field and a little playground on site. Twice a week in the high season there is an activity program in French and English for the children. For young people from 13 through 18 years of age and for adults, there are also activities planned, such as a communal barbecue. There are regular competitions in ping pong, volleyball, badminton, jeu de boules and tennis.

Many sports

You can play tennis and mini golf for a fee. In the surrounding area there are plenty of options for water skiing, canoeing, diving, sailing, parasailing, horseback riding and there is a disco and a cinema in the area. You can spot wild boar on your walks.

Napoleon

You can travel by boat from the port of Porticcio to Ajaccio. Here there is a market every evening with local products. Also visit the birthplace of Napoleon or the Lac de Tolla reservoir.

properties.name: Camping Le Cottage Fleuri
properties.description:
Campsite Le Cottage Fleuri lies in the centre of the tourist town of Grière Plage, a green area only 600 m from the Atlantic Ocean. Nearby you will find La Tranche-sur-Mer, a coastal town with all types of shops and a large department store (50 m). There are also restaurants and each day there is a lively, busy market.

Camping in green surrounding

The camping pitches are grouped in fields. You are staying on a large campsite with beautiful touring pitches at the front of the campsite and a large number of mobile homes further down. The swimming pool and the recreation area are also at the far end of the campsite. Although located in the middle of town, you still have a feeling of being surrounded by greenery because of the many trees and hedges on the campsite. The pitches are well separated from each other and sufficiently spacious for your car and caravan or large motorhome.

Clean sanitary facilities

The campsite has three ablution blocks, which are not exactly brand new, but are kept clean. Toilet paper is not issued here, handy to know...

Swimming pool

Le Cottage Fleuri has a large, heated outside swimming pool with two long water slides, a toddler pool and a water play ground. At the back you will find a spacious, heated indoor pool and a solarium. You can take (paid) swimming lessons and in peak season there is an entertainment programme with children's club and mini club. From the campsite there is a paved road to a lovely sandy beach, approx. a 500 m walk.

Shopping within walking distance

The campsite does not have a shop or bread service. Fortunately, there are a few shops and a bakery within walking distance of the campsite (50 m).

properties.name: Camping La Cascade
properties.description:
Campsite La Cascade is located in the Alps, about one kilometre from Le Bourg-d'Oisans, near a waterfall in the midst of the quiet mountain nature. You have a beautiful view of the bald Alpine peaks. The grounds are nicely laid out with various types of trees and flowers and is perfectly maintained. The camping pitches are spacious, shady and bordered by natural hedges. At the back of the grounds, there are a few spacious sites on gravel for campers, for example.

For swimming pleasure, there is a simple heated pool, and in the high season, activities are organized and there is evening entertainment. For campers without their own tents or caravans, there are wooden chalets for rent.

Alpine passes

On the campsite, there are many cyclists with a passion for conquering mountain passes, such as the Alpe d'Huez and Les Deux Alpes. The location at the access road to Alpe d'Huez is an ideal starting point for this. Lovers of the high mountains come here too, to hike and climb. There is plenty of information available at the reception about walking tours and activities in the mountains, such as hiking, mountain biking, canyoning and mountaineering.

Comfort

The campsite is in a lovely location and is comfortable with simple facilities. The grounds are nicely laid out, the campsites with grassy ground are located next to paved paths. The two sanitation buildings are not very modern, but are heated and kept clean. A mountain river flows along the grounds, but it is not suitable for swimming or boating.

In the high season, there are activities including water games, sports tournaments, archery and regularly an evening programme with performances, music and karaoke.

properties.name: La Sorguette
properties.description:
Camping La Sorguette lies on the Sorgue River, within walking distance of the town of L’Isle-sur-la-Sorgue. The campsite looks green and well maintained and the La Clef Verte label is an indication of their approach towards sustainable tourism. Many activities take place on the river. Tours are also organised. The municipal swimming pool with three pools and a toddler pool lies at a distance of two km from the campsite. In peak season the entertainment team organises fun activities.

Tree hut or yurt

The spacious camping pitches are divided into four plots. They are wooded, easily accessible and all have electricity. The pitches have a reasonable amount of privacy and are surrounded by well-tended vegetation.

Even more fun: treat the children to a novel camping holiday in an exciting tree hut or a Mongolian yurt! These have authentic Mongolian furniture and are provided with hammocks and a barbecue. At night you can watch the starry sky through the 'eye' at the top of the tent.

The river as the source of life

The Sorgue River has always played an important role in this region. From time immemorial, activities such as fishing, agriculture and local festivities have always been inextricably connected to the river. These days you can take a leisurely walk along the quays and there is a pathway from the centre of town to Partage des Eaux.

You can also go on a trip on the river with a canoe or kayak. Canoe trips can be booked at the reception and canoes are for hire at the campsite. The river is reached via a gate at the far end of the terrain.

properties.name: Flower Camping Ser Sirant
properties.description:
Campsite Ser Sirant is located on lake Laffrey in the French Alps, near Les Ecrins National Park. It is a reasonably flat property with a little beach and terrace by the lake. You have a beautiful view of the surrounding mountains and the lake. The village of Saint-Théoffrey is within walking distance and the larger La Mure is ten kilometres away. The campsite is great for water sports on the lake and you can hire boats and take lessons here.

Water sports campsite

The campsite is located in the Rhône-Alpes, a lovely region with lakes and mountains. Holidaymakers come here to hike (in the mountains), sail, surf and indulge in adventurous sports. The campsite is not very large and has a convivial atmosphere.

Campsite Ser Sirant is a typical water sports campsite where you mostly find families with older children and couples who like to be active in nature. You can rent canoes and surfboards at the lake. There is a grassy beach with a pebbled area at the lake, as well as the terrace of the restaurant (bar).

Natural ambiance

The spacious campsites on well maintained grass are located on terraces. They are not really demarcated. Trees provide shade and all sites have electricity. The casual layout of the sites and the grassland give the property a natural ambiance. For campers without tents or caravans, there are chalets, luxury wooden mobile homes or basic tents (CoCo Sweet) for hire.

Italian Cuisine

Master chef Riccardo prepares delicious Italian dishes such as gnocchi, pasta escalope and tiramisu. If you want to eat on the terrace at the lake, reserve a table in advance!

properties.name: Camper Park Playas de Luz
properties.description:
In southern Spain, close to the Portuguese border, you will find Camper Park Playas de Luz. Here you camp close to the Spanish coast and the Atlantic Ocean. Ten minutes' drive and you are on the beach. Only pools of water and salt banks lie between you and the sea. The campsite, which is fully equipped for camper vans, is situated on a plateau. From your pitch, you can look out over the marshes of Isla Cristina.

Very suitable for motorhomes

The hard surface of the pitches is very suitable for motorhomes. Campervan owners will be well served by this 'camper park'. All facilities are there to make it as easy as possible for you. But if you travel with a caravan, you are also welcome here.

Refreshing dive

It can be lovely and warm under the sun here in Southern Spain. If you want to cool down, jump into the swimming pool! It is situated on the edge of the campsite. The pool is not particularly large. But it is perfect for a refreshing dip. You can dry off in the sun on one of the deck chairs around the pool.

Magnesium-rich bath

A short walk takes you from the campsite to the marshes. A lot of salt is extracted in this special place. Admire the salt banks and the meandering pools of water. Be sure to bring your swimming gear as well! Some of the ponds have been transformed into swimming pools. Here you can take a magnesium-rich bath. Good for body and soul. Would you like to enjoy the water without getting wet? In the neighbourhood, you can take to the water in a boat.

properties.name: RCN het Grote Bos
properties.description:
RCN het Grote Bos is situated in the triangle formed by Doorn, Driebergen and Maarn in the middle of woodland. The area around the campsite is very diverse. On one side is a river landscape with historical towns and old castles and on the other side is hilly woodland (De Utrechtse Heuvelrug).

Over winding pathways to your pitch

The large campsite is located in the middle of woodland. You reach your pitch via winding pathways. The camping pitches are at least 100 m2 in size and you can opt for a shaded pitch. There are special pitches for cycling campers and comfort pitches with water supply and drainage.

On the campsite, adjacent to the camping pitches, there are also safari tents, Finnish bungalows and holiday cottages. The sanitary facilities are well maintained and on several spots on the campsite you will find Thetford cleaning machines: a type of dishwasher for your chemical toilet.

Bowling, crossing and survival running

The campsite has a large number of facilities for young and old. There is a natural pond, fossil field and several playgrounds. For sports enthusiasts there is a soccer and a basket ball field, a tennis court and jeu-de-boule pitch, a table tennis table, bowling alley, bicycle cross track for children and skelter and bicycle rental.

From April to October and during school holidays there is a recreation team. The heated outdoor pool with slide in located in the middle of the campsite and is surrounded by a lawn. Also fun: In the Grote Bos you can take part in a great deal of survival fun. By climbing, hanging and swaying you can follow an exciting obstacle course, which will lead you through the woods and over water.

properties.name: Camping Le Panoramic
properties.description:
On a hill near the picturesque harbour town of Binic in de Côtes-d’Armor, a region with lovely fishing villages, you will find the terraced campsite Le Panoramic. To reach this friendly family campsite, located at an altitude of 56 m, you have to follow an inclined road. On a spacious terrain, some 6 ha in size, there are 57 rental mobile homes and lodge tents.

Camping on terraces

The sloping camping pitches are separated from each other by low hedges. They are distributed over several terraces. From the campsite, you have limited views of Binic. It takes ten minutes to walk to the wide sandy beach. Binic is also within walking distance from the campsite. There is a small camping shop where you can buy the essential groceries. You can order fresh bread.

Swimming paradise and entertainment

The aqua park consists of a playfully designed, heated outdoor swimming pool (125 m2) with a water slide and a toddler pool. You can also enjoy a swim in the covered, heated swimming pool (140 m2) or relax in the loungers around the pool.

In peak season, entertainment is organised for children and for adults. There is a playground with some playground equipment, a trampoline and a jumping pillow. Apart from the table tennis table and pétanque pitch, there is a sports field where you can also play beach volleyball. You can do horseback riding and play golf for a fee.

Tasty fish dish

The food truck and rotisserie on the campsite offer a reasonable selection in peak season. A tasty fish dish can be made on request. There is something happening every night: Breton dancing, karaoke, theme evenings and quizzes. In the bar things often get very relaxed and convivial.

properties.name: Camping Maeva Escapades Bel-Air
properties.description:
Camping Bel-Air lies in the heart of the wine region Entre-deux-Mers. This is a region with numerous wine châteaus, castles and historic towns. The campsite is within cycling distance of Bordeaux and only slightly more than an hour's drive from the Atlantic Ocean. In addition to city trips and tasting superb wines, the area lends itself very well to lovely walking and cycling excursions.

Spacious pitches with privacy

The grounds look neat and are well-maintained. The pitches are located along streets and have a grass surface, are spacious and are separated by hedges and pine trees, providing ample privacy. You can opt for a pitch in the full sun or a pitch with (some) shade. Just like the grounds, the contemporary rental accommodation units (mobile homes) are also scrupulously maintained.

Swimming pool and sandy beach

The swimming pool (100 m2) and the toddler pool are located in the full sun. The area around the pool is spacious and open, so you can enjoy relaxing on the loungers with sun umbrellas. Looking for spaciousness, a lovely sandy beach and great waves? Get your gear and drive to the coast: you will get there within an hour.

There is a playground, a sports field and a pétanque pitch on the campsite. The campsite offers several cycling routes for the sporty holiday maker.

Regional dishes and menus for children

Do you want to start the day with fresh croissants? Campsite Bel-Air has a bread service; they even deliver your order to your camping pitch! On the campsite is a restaurant with a limited menu where you can order snacks, pizzas and traditional regional dishes. They also have a special menu for children.

properties.name: Camping Les Sables Blancs
properties.description:
Camping Les Sables Blancs is situated in Concarneau, an attractive harbour town in the south of Brittany. You camp here in the so-called Breton Riviera: a landscape with beautiful beaches, idyllic bays and rugged rock formations. But there's also plenty to do on the campsite itself Dive into the swimming pool, join the karaoke and enjoy a meal in the restaurant.

Camping with sea view

The green camping pitches at Les Sables Blancs are average in size.  Because of the demarcation with hedges, you are assured of ample privacy.  The camping grounds consists of several terraces.  In addition to some hundred touring pitches, there are also fifty rental accommodation units (suitable for groups of up to eight persons).  The majority of the rental accommodation units have a terrace with garden furniture and a barbecue. 

Like a fish in the water

The heated swimming pool of the campsite is shaped like a fish.  It also has a heated toddler pool  as well as a separate jacuzzi with a sea view.  On the terrace adjacent to the swimming pool are a few loungers and sun umbrellas. 

For even more fun, head to the beach and the sea. This is easy to reach via a gate at the bottom of the campsite. You can indulge in various sea water sports: windsurfing, snorkelling, waterskiing, kayaking and sailing.

Entertainment for the whole family

Challenge your camping neighbours to a game of table tennis or pétanque.  Or work up a sweat on the fitness equipment. Children are sure to enjoy the trampoline, the bouncer and playground.  At least twice a week in high season, an entertainment team organises all kinds of activities for young and old.  Concerts are also offered on a regular basis.

properties.name: Cepo Verde
properties.description:
In the middle of the Montesinho nature reserve, one of the largest nature reserves in Portugal, lies campsite Cepo Verde. This terraced campsite has only forty touring pitches and some rental accommodation units, charming wooden chalets. There are no fixed pitches, but you can choose your own beautiful spot. Enjoy the swimming pool or wander through the mountains or old villages. The campsite has a good restaurant. If you are interested in souvenirs, you can head for the traditional wooden reception building. Here the largest pocket knife in the world is exhibited.

Camping in nature

Cepo Verde is a campsite with many trees. The centuries-old chestnut trees, oaks and cherry trees provide ample shade. At the bottom of the campsite there is a large camping field and higher up you will find the various terraces. Most of the surface is sandy or covered with grass.  As this is a natural campsite, the paths and other parts are not always level.

Entertainment for young and old

Families will thoroughly enjoy themselves. Do not expect bells and whistles, but a small scale entertainment team (English-speaking), some play equipment, a table tennis table and a modest swimming pool. This pool (120 m²) is beautiful and well cared for, but only open from 1 June to 30 August. You can relax on the lawn around the swimming pool. 

Baking bread and picnicking

Provided there is enough interest, the campsite organises activities such as bread baking in a traditional oven, deer spotting walks and picnics at a nearby mill.

Ecological sanitation facilities

The sanitary buildings at Cepo Verde are beautiful and recently renovated. There is also a toilet for disabled persons. The showers are eco-efficient, which is in line with the policy of this campsite amidst nature.

properties.name: Camping l'Île d'Or
properties.description:
Located in a wonderful natural paradise, just a stone's throw from the beach. Camping l’Ile d’Or, meaning 'the golden island', offers the best of both worlds. A real Mediterranean campsite without exaggerated luxury, but with the facilities and options you need for relaxation and excursions.

Camping in the shade

The camping area exudes a park-like atmosphere: green with plenty of trees. This ensures there is plenty of shade on the island, which can be a major bonus in this sunny region. The pitches at the campsite are not demarcated, but they are spacious. There is also enough room to park your car at every pitch. In addition, mobile homes can be hired at l’Ile d’Or. Ideal for anyone who wants a more comfortable overnight stay, without compromising on the charm of camping in nature.

Sports entertainment

There are two playgrounds on the campsite for the children. Leisure activities such as table tennis and table football are organised on a regular basis. You can also come here for tournaments.

Fun on the water starts four hundred metres from the campsite, on the sandy beach by the sea. Along with swimming, you can surf, windsurf, dive, sea kayak, pedal boat and much, much more. Surfing and diving schools offer rented equipment and courses for both beginners and those with more experience.

Simple facilities

The facilities on the campsite are a little simple, but meet your primary needs. Guests can have a drink at the bar. The restaurant serves delicious pizzas at a great price. The camping shop is open seven days a week for bread, croissants and grocery shopping.

properties.name: Ardoer Camping De Heldense Bossen
properties.description:
Ardoer Camping De Heldense Bossen in Helden in Limburg has everything a child’s heart desires during a camping holiday: from swimming pools to an animal park, from a water playground to forest theatre. Stay in a special bungalow or on a comfortable pitch in a forested area. This family campsite can be found in the middle of the woods in the Limburg town of Helden. The campsite is easily accessed via the Napoleonsbaan, that leads you past quaint villages on the River Maas: the castle village of Baarlo and the lovely Kessel.

Het Bosmannetje

When you arrive at this campsite, on a wide road and between the high trees, you will be warmly welcomed by a large green figure with an acorn hat on its head: Het Bosmannetje (the forest man). You will come across this figure at various places on the campsite. The staff at the reception will also give you a friendly welcome and show you the way to your pitch. You will find three types of camping pitches on the vast green grounds: basic pitches, basic plus pitches and extra-large comfort pitches. Various types of accommodation are clustered together. The cute camping bungalows can be found next to a football field and the spacious mobile homes with their large verandas are set up in a circle by the water recreation area.

Real children’s campsite

De Heldense Bossen is a real children’s campsite. Everything is set up to give children the time of their lives. Also in Restaurant Op d’n Berg, where they have a separate children’s menu, and children are sometimes even allowed to help the chef prepare the food.

properties.name: Camping Bocca di Cecina
properties.description:
Camping Bocca di Cecina, located in Livorno, Italy, is a large and modern campsite on the Tuscan coast. If you want to enjoy the sea, nature and the rich culture of the region, this campsite is a handy home base because of its strategic location. For example, from the campsite you have direct access to a private beach, and the city of Pisa with its iconic leaning tower is only a 50-minute drive away.

Spacious pitches and many types of accommodation

Upon arrival at Camping Bocca di Cecina, you will immediately notice the spacious layout and the selection of pitches. Choose a pitch in the new section with low trees, or choose the shady pine forest. If you prefer a rental accommodation, choose a mobile home, caravan or bungalow. Most of these accommodations offer modern conveniences such as air conditioning and well-equipped kitchens.

All kinds of facilities

At the campsite grounds you will find all kinds of facilities for a nice holiday. The swimming pool at the new site is partially heated and has a bar where you can order a refreshing drink. There is also an entertainment team for children and a shopping centre that includes a supermarket and a bazaar. The attractive restaurant serves delicious Tuscan dishes.

Historic cities and nature

The area around Camping Bocca di Cecina also has a lot to offer. Of course, you must visit one of the historic cities, such as Pisa (64 km), Livorno (56 km) and Volterra (41 km), during your camping holiday. For nature lovers, the nearby Tomboli di Cecina nature reserve, with its woods and hiking and cycle routes, is a must-see.

properties.name: Camping du Brec
properties.description:
A crystal-clear lake where you can go swimming, canoeing and water cycling and a beautiful river for fishing: these are the main attractions of the simple yet fine Camping du Brec. The rough campsite terrain has the look of a wild Canadian 'campground.' This is the ideal spot for people who love the wilderness.

Camping in the wild

The flat terrain is naturally landscaped and somewhat wild in nature, with bushes and trees offering shade to part of the campsite. It's almost as if you're camping in the wilderness. The spacious camping pitches are spread out in an irregular fashion. There are also a few modern bungalows available for rent.

Private lake with all the trimmings

Next to the reception lies the idyllic private lake with crystal-clear water, a sandy beach, several pebble beaches, a jetty, and trees and bushes providing shade all around. There is also a small island in the lake. In the lake, you can go water cycling, swimming or canoeing. You can use the canoes and kayaks for free.

White-water rafting trips

At the campsite, you will find a sports field, a boules court and a large tent with a table tennis table which is also used for activities. A few swings, a small sandbox and a teeter-totter are available for the little ones. There is no other entertainment here. Are you looking for more adventure? The on-site mountain and water sports centre organises guided white-water rafting trips.

Time for a snack

At the campsite, you can get a simple snack, a cold beer or an ice cream. The patio offers beautiful views of the lake. There is also a barbecue area with two large barbecues and a few picnic benches.

properties.name: Camping Ferienpark Perlsee
properties.description:
This campsite is located near the pleasant town of Waldmünchen in the Bavarian Forest, close to the border with the Czech Republic. Here, you'll camp in a wooded part of this beautiful middle mountain range. That's why Camping Ferienpark Perlsee is an ideal holiday address for nature lovers, especially for cycling and walking enthusiasts. During the high season, this campsite is also popular with families who have (young) children. You'll find many sports and playing facilities here, including a beautiful playground and a mini-golf course. The campsite also has its own sandy beach on the Perlsee. This recreational lake, located directly adjacent to the campsite, is perfect for a variety of water sports.

A beautiful terraced campsite - aimed at touring campers

The real camping feeling prevails at Ferienpark Perlsee. The most beautiful pitches may be found by the lake, although they're on a slightly sloping terrain. The pitches in the higher section of this terraced campsite are level. The campsite also offers rental accommodation, including mobile homes, some cosy sleeping barrels and a few more spacious holiday homes.

The Perlsee: a Valhalla for water sports enthusiasts

This campsite is located directly on the Perlsee, a recreational lake where you can swim, especially during the summer. You can also enjoy windsurfing, sailing and pedal boating here. This campsite is ideal with its own sandy beach on this lake.

Italian cuisine in Perlsee Wirtschaft

Right next to the campsite and close to the beach, you'll find the restaurant Perlsee Wirtschaft. The restaurant features a menu with Italian and Mediterranean dishes. Choose a pizza or one of the other delicious dishes; there is something for everyone.

properties.name: Camping Aach
properties.description:
Friendly terraced campsite with a view of the mountains near the town of Oberstaufen. Both those seeking peace and quiet and active campers stay at the Aach Campsite in a pleasant, casual atmosphere with simple facilities and a reasonable number of seasonal pitches. There are three golf courses, several summer toboggan runs and marked cycling and walking routes nearby.

Camping in Bavaria

Seven kilometres from the famous spa town of Oberstaufen, the Aach Campsite is located in a beautiful region of mountains and unspoiled nature. This part of the Bavaria region is a popular winter sports area and close to the Austrian border. The Blenk family welcomes all campers warmly and does their utmost to make everyone feel comfortable. They have been running the campsite for 50 years, and you can tell by how involved and hospitable they are.

Surrounded by greenery

The 120 pitches are spread along different paths, some offering a panoramic view. You can set it up on the special tent field if you come with the tent. Families stay in mobile homes for the whole season, and you can tell by the decor. The sanitary facilities are not modern but clean. You can rent the holiday home or the wooden wine barrels if you want to spend the night more comfortably.

Grab a bite
