The Biergarten on the campsite offers a limited menu, such as Flammkuchen with toppings and other specialities. To get the new day off to a good start, you can buy fresh bread rolls at the kiosk or, even better, sit down for breakfast in the restaurant. For enthusiasts, there is table tennis, and you can play a game of billiards after dinner.

properties.name: Camping Am Berg
properties.description:
Camping am Berg is a rural campground in a hilly region. Near the Dutch border, to the west of the state of Lower Saxony, the campground is located just outside of idyllic Bad Bentheim. You can take a little walk to the historic town on a forest path from the campground. There are many cycling routes in the immediate vicinity. There are also lovely paths to walk your dog, including one through the marsh landscape at the Glidehauser Venn nature reserve.

Upon arrival, the Dutch owners will welcome you to Camping am Berg, where they have created an atmospheric oasis of peace and quiet. There is no play equipment for the children, for example.

Royal campsites

Your caravan or camper will have plenty of space in one of the fields or on one of the narrow streets. If you want shade, its best to be on the flat part of the campground, where there are a number of trees. There is little shade on the terraced section. There are great sites set up especially for tent campers. There is grass everywhere, which is well cared for by the owner. The paths and roads are all well lit.

Fresh rolls

With fresh rolls available daily, your camping holiday in Germany is truely complete. The campsite does not have a restaurant or shop. For this, you can visit Bad Bentheim, which is about a 5-minute drive away.

Take the bike-bus

There is a special bike-bus between Bad Bentheim and Emlichheim during the summer months and at weekends. A fun option is you want to leave from another starting point. This service has a trailer to transport your bike.

properties.name: Camping Alegria del Mar
properties.description:
The Alegria del Mar campsite is located on the Costa del Azahar, the Spanish part of the Mediterranean coast that includes the provinces of Castellón and Valencia. At this coastal campsite you will camp on large, flat pitches delimited by colourful oleander hedges. Not only can you enjoy good food in the cosy restaurant; flamenco evenings and karaoke sessions are also held regularly. The beach is only two hundred metres away.

Spacious pitches

The campsite is spacious and includes large touring pitches. Especially the comfort pitches are extra roomy. The pitches have a hard gravel surface and are surrounded by green, colourful oleander hedges. There is not much shade, although there are a few (small) trees around each touring pitch. Shade tarps can keep you out of the sun. A small but fine luxury: every pitch has its own sink.

Holidays at the beach

You only have to walk two hundred metres to get to the beach. The beach here is not particularly wide and consists mainly of small pebbles. So don't forget to bring flip-flops or water shoes. Nevertheless, you can sit or lie by the Mediterranean Sea. A dip in the sea is a must when you are on holiday on the Costa del Azahar.

The heart of the campsite

The restaurant is the lively centre of the campsite. In the summer months the pavement café is filled with guests all day long. The restaurant is also the heart of the entertainment. Something is organised every day. Paella evening, flamenco shows or karaoke sessions; there is something fun for everyone.

properties.name: Camping du Lac
properties.description:
The attraction of Lac Cormoranche, a lively charming campground in Cormoranche-sur-Saône, is the location by a recreation lake and nature reserve. There is plenty to do in the high season. The campground attracts a diverse public: anglers, water sports enthusiasts and parents with children have a great deal of fun here.

Show fewer

The campsites vary in size and are separated by hedges. You can choose your site yourself- with or without shade - which is lovely considering all of the sites are easy to reach with a caravan. There is grassland with sandy soil.

Plenty of fun

The mostly French and Dutch campground guest come above all for the recreation lake and the water sports (fishing pond). Families with small children are also well served: there is a playground with a number of pieces of play equipment, including a large climbing house. Children who understand English or French can go to the mini-club with the activity programme. In the high season, the offering of guided walks, disco evenings, concerts and fireworks varies.

Sleeping in the wild

Here you have the option of sleeping in a simple teepee or bivouac tent right by the beach. The teepee is made of wood and sailcloth. Would you rather be more comfortable? Hire a mobile home or chalet.

Multi-faceted beach

You're right on the lake when you arrive. From the campground, you only have to cross a paved road to enjoy the sand and grass beach and the sunbathing area. The lake is popular with the French from the area, they pay for entrance. The beach and facilities are free for campground guests.

properties.name: RCN de Jagerstee
properties.description:
RCN de Jagerstee is a a lovely campground in a forested part of the Veluwe, within walking distance from Epe. A wonderful starting point to explore the lovely Geldern nature. In the forests there is an extensive network of cycling paths, so you can exlore the area on your bike. Not far away are the cities of Hattem and Deventer, lovely destinations for a day trip.

Well maintained, much greenery

The site makes a well-maintained impression. The very green plants catch your eye. The campsites are spacious. They are the same size over the campground and set up in a comparable manner. Around the camping fields there are trees to provide shade in the summer. The sanitary facilities are wonderful. Rental accommodations are on their own part of the campground. You have a choice of bell tents, luxury mobile homes, 6-person accommodations and trekker huts for 2, 4 or 6 people.

Camping guests and facilities

The campground is visited by a mixed public. In the summer months, the number of families with children is larger, and we primarily have seniors staying in the low season. There is a lovely heated outdoor pool on the campground and a kiddie pool for the little ones. There is a spacious grassy field around the swimming pool for playing and sunbathing. There is playground equipment and a trampoline. Also fun: challenge each other to a round of mini-golf.

A wonderful campground shop

The campground has a great campground shop. There is also a good restaurant with a lovely menu offering plenty of choice. If necessary, you can do your shopping in Epe.

properties.name: RCN Domaine de la Noguière
properties.description:
RCN Domaine de la Noguière forms part of a large holiday park in beautiful Provence, some 16 km from the Mediterranean Sea. It offers numerous facilities and different types of amenities. With a triple and quadruple slide, two water plateaux, a fish pond, recreational woodland with running track and lots of entertainment, there is simply not enough time in the day to do it all.

Terraced grounds

The slightly sloping grounds with numerous rental accommodation units look well maintained and are partly laid out in terraces. From the campsite you have a magnificent view, including of the Rock of Roquebrune. The pitches are separated from the permanent sites, are mostly spacious and offer little shelter. If you wish to rent something, you have a choice of mobile homes with a veranda and bungalow tents.

Swimming pool complex

The swimming pool complex is a veritable paradise for water rats. There are two playfully designed water plateaux with mega slides, bridges, rock formations with Mediterranean plants and surrounded by sun loungers. Want to go to the Mediterranean? Coastal resorts such as St.-Raphaël, Fréjus, and the cosmopolitan resort St.-Tropez are not far away.

Canyoning trips

There are several sports fields, a playground, a recreation room, jeu-de-boule pitch, table tennis tables, recreational woodland with running track and a fishing lake where you can freely fish for carp. And if that's not enough, the entertainment team also organises numerous great activities: dance and music evenings, guided canyoning trips in the gorge of the Gorges du Verdon and looking for fossils. In high season there are also holiday church services.

Pleasant terrace

The restaurant with limited menu is well maintained and has a very attractive terrace. Take-away meals are also offered. There is also a lounge bar, a camping shop and daily fresh bread.

properties.name: RCN Belledonne
properties.description:
Nestled between the rugged nature of the French Alps you will find RCN Belledonne. This large-scale campsite has a swimming pool and very spacious pitches which offer ample privacy. The area is excellent for keen walkers and cycle racing enthousiasts. The campsite is only 5 km from the cycling capital of France: Le Bourg-d’Oisans. And in the distance you will catch a first glimpse of the Alpe d’Huez in all its glory...

Large campsite with spacious pitches

It is a large campsite and that's why the grounds are divided in several fields. A large section is reserved for rental accommodation, such as mobile homes and safari tents. In another section you will find the spacious camping pitches with a level grass surface. The sites have a great deal of privacy. The ablution blocks are spread over the campsite. Furthermore, a new sanitary building with contemporary look, also suitable for disabled persons, was recently constructed.

Swimming, sports and playing

The highlight of RCN Belledonne may well be the swimming pool with the huge mountains in the background. A dive in the pool and basking on a sun lounger to dry on are not exactly punishments either! For some extra relaxation you can use the sauna and hammam.

Besides water fun, there is plenty more to do for children. The entertainment team has a busy programme during school holidays. Furthermore, there is a selection of playground equipment, table tennis tables, a volleyball field and a pétanque pitch.

Feeling peckish?

The campsite restaurant, with several terraces, is a great place to spend some time. The restaurant has a trendy look with lots of colours and offers a view of the swimming pool.

properties.name: RCN le Moulin de la Pique
properties.description:
RCN le Moulin de la Pique is a very well-maintained, child-friendly campsite situated on an estate with 18th-century buildings. The campsite is located near Belvès, in the beautiful and nature-rich Dordogne-Pèrigord-Noir region. What makes this region special are its many historical towns, caves and museums.

Large campsite with a small-scale feel

As you drive to the camping pitch, you will discover how large the campsite really is. On the one side, you will find pitches for motorhomes and some of the touring pitches, and on the other side lie the other touring pitches and the accommodations. The touring pitches all measure between 100-140 m2 and are separated by hedges and trees. The twenty paved motorhome pitches are more than 100 m2 in size. Besides touring pitches, the campsite also has quite a few rental accommodations such as (lodge) tents, mobile homes and a few apartments.

Four swimming pools and three large slides

On the campsite, you will find no less than four swimming pools (total surface area 660 m2). The heated paddling pool is roughly 55 m2. You will find three large slides by the swimming pool. In other words, plenty of water fun! Next to the campsite lies a lake suitable for swimming, boating and fishing.

Entertainment team

In the peak season, the campsite offers entertainment for all ages. From the campsite, you can take a guided hiking tour or follow one of the marked trails. On the campsite itself, you will find many facilities: a playground, sports field, tennis court, mini-golf course, boules pitch, fitness area, table tennis tables and a volleyball court. The on-site shop offers a few groceries such as fresh bread. There is also a restaurant with an extensive menu.

properties.name: Camping Internacional Las Palmeras
properties.description:
Camping Internacional Las Palmeras is located between Murcia and Alicante in the south-east of Spain, just 20 minutes' drive from the beach. Perfect for peace seekers or campers travelling through Spain. Fully equipped camping pitches or luxury bungalows and a beautiful swimming pool will allow you to enjoy your camping holiday in complete peace. The restaurant is definitely also a must!

Camping Internacional Las Palmeras is just a five minutes' drive from the motorway (A7). The campsite reception can be found in the hotel on the site. You'll receive a warm welcome here and be guided through the campsite, past the many tropical plants.

The comfortable camping pitches are separated by palm trees and have electricity and water. You might like to stay in one of the ‘Casas Rurales’ for a more luxurious holiday experience.

Swimming paradise

Camping Las Palmeras is not a typical family campsite. Older couples in particular come here to enjoy the warm weather, nature and peace. Relax by the beautiful mosaic-tiled swimming pool paradise between the palm trees. Sunbeds are dotted around the pool, so you can sunbathe and relax after taking a dip. 

La Palmera van Elche

Camping Internacional Las Palmeras is a good base for visiting the town of Elche. In the time of the Moors, a huge palm tree forest was planted here, which is maintained by a centuries-old irrigation system. UNESCO has designated the palm tree a World Heritage Site.

properties.name: Camping Hohenbusch
properties.description:
Camping Hohenbusch is situated in the German-speaking part of the Belgian Ardennes. You camp here on a beautiful and spacious campsite in an area where you can really enjoy both nature and the culture. The green campsite with luxury facilities is ideal for families and sports-minded walkers and cyclists.

Goat meadow near the reception

On Camping Hohenbusch you are warmly and professionally welcomed by the owners, who have run this campsite since 1977. The goat meadow near the reception is great fun with a photo and name displayed of each goat.

Luxury camping fields and private sanitary facilities

The camping fields are located on different terraces. The fields are separated by much vegetation and hedges, providing ample privacy. The pitches are spacious to very spacious: between 100 and 150 m2. The largest comfort pitches even have private sanitary facilities. A car-free field is ideal for families with young children. There are also pitches for hikers with a hide. Furthermore, there are mobile homes and a few apartments.

Renovated swimming pool

There are several playgrounds distributed over the terrain, so that children can play to their heart's content. There is also a modern swimming pool which was fully renovated in 2017. Adjacent to the shallow end there is a toddler pool and a whirlpool. The swimming pool is located in full sun with next to it a large terrace and lawn.

Daily specials in the tavern

The tavern serves delicious daily specials, and sells snacks, take-away meals and daily fresh rolls. Next to the restaurant you will find a large terrace. There is no shop on the campsite, but you can do your shopping in the supermarket, some five km down the road.

properties.name: Camping Marisheem
properties.description:
Campsite Marisheem is located in an attractive, rural setting in the narrowest part of Limburg. This spaciously laid out family campsite consists mainly of chalets and mobile homes. The high season on this campsite covers a period of approximately four weeks. In low season it is very quiet here. Marisheem is a neat campsite, located in a beautiful area which lends itself excellently to cycling and walking.

Neat camping pitches

You reach the swimming pool via the small pathway on the left. The touring pitches are grouped around the pool. On the remainder of the campsite you will mainly find chalets and mobile homes: campsite Marisheem has no fewer than two hundred permanent pitches. The camping grounds are neatly laid out, with flat pitches on grassy fields surrounded by greenery. The vegetation is well maintained, although the owners of the permanent pitches are responsible for cutting the grass on their pitch.

Water slide

Camping Marisheem has a beautiful outdoor swimming pool with a triple water slide. There is also a fun toddler pool with an array of play equipment and sprayers. Great for swimming and splashing around for both the little ones and older children. Especially the water slide is an endless source of amusement, as you can whoosh down the slide three at a time. There is a sunbathing lawn with loungers, picnic tables and sun umbrellas around the swimming pool. The swimming pool is securely fenced-in. The adjacent playground is also home to a range of fitness equipment. 

Short season

There is no camping shop, but there are ample shopping opportunities in Echt (approximately three km away). The bar and snack bar of the campsite are only open during a short period in July and August. You can also buy fresh bread during that time. Other amenities are also limited or not accessible outside this period. Fortunately, the swimming pool is open for a slightly longer period: from mid-May to the end of August.

properties.name: Domaine du Ceinturon III
properties.description:
Domaine du Ceinturon III is near the vast beach of Ayguade-Ceinturon and centrally located in the Côte d'Azur. This is the perfect campsite for a great beach holiday. It is close to the interesting town of Hyères-les-Palmiers and the Golden Islands too. There are also numerous local options for walking, cycling and water sports enthusiasts. This well-maintained family campsite has a heated swimming pool, an excellent restaurant and (in the summer holidays) a varied entertainment programme.

Shady campsite and modern accommodation

Temperatures can sometimes soar on the southern French coast. So, it's great that there’s shade everywhere on this campsite. You camp among pine trees, mulberry trees and fragrant eucalyptus trees. The accommodation is cool too because every chalet and mobile home has air conditioning. Some accommodation even has a hot tub. There is also a large mobile home with extra easy access for people with reduced mobility. This mobile home’s facilities includes a ramp and an adapted bathroom.

Heated pool next to campsite restaurant

Love eating out when you’re on holiday? Have a cosy dinner at r'Est o'Sud, the campsite's restaurant. Enjoy a full breakfast here in the morning; traditional dishes, freshly baked pizzas and tasty cocktails are on the menu later in the day. The restaurant is next to the pool. The water in this outdoor pool and adjacent paddling pool is heated to 28 degrees throughout the season. Lots of entertainment in the high season. This includes activities like crafts, laser games and gym classes and evening entertainment like magic shows, live music performances and dance nights.

properties.name: Camping De Ruimte
properties.description:
It comes as no surprise that the first thing you see is the spaciousness when you enter campsite De Ruimte from the forest. The owners knew what they were doing when they named their campsite. This beautiful, peaceful family campsite is located in the oldest woodland of Flevoland, a forestry area which used to belong to the State Forestry Commission. The spacious camping pitches are located in open areas in the forest.

As 'De Ruimte' is a family campsite which is visited by a large number of children, the campsite is car-free. The campsite is spaciously laid out in such a way that all facilities are easily accessible to persons with physical disabilities. The pathways are paved to make the entire campsite as wheelchair-friendly as possible.

Sand and water

Both the sanitary facilities and playground equipment are perfectly suitable for children with disabilities. This includes the water playground as well as the sandpits which are both fully wheelchair accessible. In addition to the shallow swimming pool, there are water tables and sand tables, all kinds of water play equipment and sprayers, a horizontal swing, hammock swing and wheelchair see saw. 

Furthermore, virtually any conceivable equipment is either available on the campsite, or can can be hired upon request. For instance: tandems, electric wheelchair cargo bikes, hoists and hi-low beds.

Even more water fun

Located between Dronten, Kampen and Elburg, this campsite is the perfect base for both nature and culture lovers. The area around the campsite is ideal for walking and cycling. Less than one km away is the Drontermeer, one of the lakes bordering Flevoland. The Drontermeer feeds into the Ketelmeer in the north and into the Veluwemeer in the south. The border lakes, with their clear swimming water and clean, peaceful sandy beaches, are an ideal destination for a day on or by the water.

properties.name: MS Vacances - Camping Club Plage Sud
properties.description:
In the South West of France, in the heart of the town of Biscarrosse-Plage, you will find the Campéole Plage Sud campsite. Here, you are less than one kilometre from the Atlantic coast. The lively Biscarrosse-Plage is a true water paradise. And if the endless ocean is not enough, there are also several large lakes near Biscarrosse-Plage – each with its own beach. There is a snack bar on the campsite. Just outside the campsite is a pizzeria.

Traditional camping or a bit more luxury

Campéole Plage Sud is a busy campsite in a wooded area with a relaxed atmosphere. The campsite has flat, delimited, and shaded places. Besides comfort pitches, there are also special ‘signature’ pitches with extra luxury. In addition to traditional camping, there is also the possibility to relax in one of the many comfortable accommodations. For example, mobile homes and lodge tents. Campéole Plage Sud is a real family campsite. There are therefore quite a lot of activieis on the campsite. Among other things, there are several playgrounds and an activity tent.

Make a splash!

The campsite is ideal for water lovers. There are two beautiful swimming pools, a whirlpool, a spectacular slide, and – especially for the little ones – a fun paddling pool. Please note that you are not allowed to wear swimming shorts in the swimming pools.

The Atlantic Ocean is just a stone’s throw from the campsite. Here you can practise many water sports. Biscarrosse-Plage is a real surfing paradise and features beautiful sandy beaches and challenging waves along the ‘silver coast’ of Les Landes. You can even find several surf schools. Kiwi Surf is one that focuses mainly on younger visitors.

properties.name: Camping Les Fosses Rouges
properties.description:
A beautiful beach nearby, a zoo within cycling distance and forests and dunes to explore. Sounds good, doesn't it? You can find all of this at Camping Les Fosses Rouges, situated in the Vendée. You are here in the dynamic and hospitable region between the Atlantic Ocean and the green interior.

The pitches are sufficiently large for a car with caravan or for a large motorhome. You almost always stand between trees. The rental mobile homes are located in a separate section of the campsite. In peak season there are families with children, from toddlers to teenagers. In low season you will mainly see senior camping guests. The two sanitary buildings are dated, but clean.

Swimming on the campsite or in the sea

There is a heated swimming pool. In inclement weather the retractable roof comes in handy. Do you prefer the waves and the beach of the Atlantic Ocean? Hop on the shuttle bus (in peak season) of get on your bike and look for the beautiful sandy beach of Les Sables d’Olonne, some 2 km down the road.

A blast at night...

Each night there is something going on at the campsite: karaoke, bingo, live music and dancing. And, provided you have not partied the night away, you can always join the water aerobics in the morning!

Great breakfasts and snacks!

The shop has a fairly wide range. Therefore, you do not have to leave the grounds to prepare a nice meal. Fresh rolls for a delicious French breakfast. You can get pizzas in the snack bar, or order some French fries, hamburgers, drinks or an ice cream.

properties.name: Camping Peñiscola
properties.description:
Have a great beach holiday on the Spanish coast at campsite Peñíscola, near the town of the same name on the Costa Azahar. You will camp here five kilometres from the medieval centre of Peñíscola, next to which is a vast sandy beach. Swimming is also possible in the amazing aqua park on the campsite itself. Campsite offers entertainment and various sports/games facilities throughout season.

Fully-equipped touring pitches

The pitches are bordered by neatly-kept hedges. There are 3 categories of touring pitches: bronze, silver and gold. A parcela gold has 120 square metres of camping space, and the bronze (70 m2) and silver (95 m2) pitches are not small either. Whichever pitch you choose, you will have a water supply and water drainage on your pitch and also your own sink for washing dishes. You could also book a luxury bungalow.

Splashing fun in the swimming paradise

Campsite Peñíscola has a beautiful swimming paradise with two outdoor pools. A swim-up bar has been built into the main pool, so you can enjoy a drink while you are in the water. Spray park and large paddling/children's pool are next to main pool. You will also enjoy a varied entertainment programme. This includes fun pool and jeu-de-boules competitions, bingo, live music performances and weekly flamenco shows. The campsite also has its own shop, restaurant, playground and sports field.

Enjoy Peñíscola's beaches

Peñíscola is one of the most popular destinations on Spain's east coast. This is partly because of its long sandy beach, which extends all the way to the atmospheric port town of Benicarló. Take a dip in sea or go paddleboarding, kayaking, diving, snorkelling or sailing.

properties.name: Camping Clair de Lune
properties.description:
Seekers of peace and quiet will find a great place at campsite Clair de Lune on the sunny French coast. Thanks to the central location on the Giens peninsula, the campsite is a lovely starting point for taking hikes and cycling tours along the charming villages, creeks and fragrant pine trees. The gulf of Giens is only two hundred metres away.

Rolling property with shade

The special thing about the campsite Clair de Lune is that there are few true campsites. Primarily mobile homes and bungalows. There is a suitable accommodation for every budget that has been laid out with care. Many offer a phenomenal view of the sea. Trees are spread out over the entire property and ensure natural shade. Thanks to the quiet character, the campsite is also ideal for young families. The fine sandy beach only a few hundred metres away has a very gradually slope to the sea.

Pizzeria

In the morning you'll wake up to a concert of crickets. If you camp here in the summer months, the fresh rolls will be ready for you. On the terrace at the bar/restaurant you'll not only enjoy tasty pizzas, but also a lovely sea view. In the village of Giens there are all kinds of restaurants and shops.

Indoor and outdoor play area

Peace and a familial atmosphere are high up the list at the campsite. Don't expect entertainment or bustle in any form. For children, this is a lovely place to enjoy your entire vacation. In addition to a lovely playground, there is an interior space with all kinds of games and a large bookshelf.

properties.name: Camping Les Peupliers
properties.description:
Camping Les Peupliers is a relaxed and friendly campsite in the south of France, within walking distance of the famous Canal du Midi. An ideal place for taking lovely walks and bike rides. Take a dip in the campsite pool, order fresh bread for breakfast or take a boat trip on the Canal du Midi. Within walking distance is the charming village of Colombiers (1 km), with several shops and restaurants.

Pitches and accommodations

This campsite has a wide range of camping pitches and rental accommodation. The pitches for tents, caravans and motorhomes offer privacy and are equipped with power supply. For hikers and cyclists, there is the special 'Cyclo Lodge', a simple and cosy hiker's cabin equipped with basic comfort. Those who like a bit more luxury can choose from a range of comfortable mobile homes, eco-lodges and wooden chalets.

The campsite's heated toilet and shower facilities ensure comfort even in winter. A launderette is available for a fee and the campsite also has free Wi-Fi every six hours for 30 minutes. This can be extended with a paid package.

Facilities for a pleasant stay

The park has various amenities for a pleasant stay. Start the day with freshly baked bread and croissants from the seasonal bakery, or enjoy a quick snack in the restaurant. Cool down in the sheltered swimming pool, where younger children can also have fun in the separate paddling pool. There is also jeu de boules, a bowling alley and table tennis.

properties.name: Camping Les Bouleaux
properties.description:
Camping Les Bouleaux is located in the village of Vilsberg, between the Parc Naturel Régional des Vosges du Nord and the "rest" of northeast France. Here, you'll camp with Remco and Sandy, who run Les Bouleaux with their twins.

An oasis of peace and quiet

The owners say about their campground: "it is a quiet, green family campground." It's true. It is located in the midst of nature with lovely views from your camping pitch, which is always at least 100 m2. There is a wonderful peace, which is "disrupted" in the mornings by the tweeting birds that wake you. In this way, nature lovers and peace seekers have the very best. Tent campers have the most beautiful sites at the edge of a forest. There are two mobile homes, a wooden chalet and two CosoSweet glamping tents for hire.

Play meadow and fresh bread

For children, there are many play options at Les Bouleaux, there is a play meadow with a teeter-totter, trampoline, swing and a climbing frame. One of the two swimming pools is especially for the little ones. The water in the largest pool is heated. There is no campground shop, but you can order fresh bread rolls. You can buy a snack, ice cream or a drink at the bar. You'll find shops in Phalsbourg, two kilometres away from the campground.

The largest ship elevator in Europe

You can take many excursions from the campground. Such as to the "Route du Plan incliné" at Saint-Louis-Arzviller, a 15-minute drive away. There is a 45-metre lift that enables boats to bypass the 17 locks in the Marne-Rhine Canal.

properties.name: RCN de Noordster
properties.description:
RCN de Noordster is tucked away in the nature reserve Nationaal Park Dwingelderveld, near the village of Dwingeloo in Drenthe. On this neat and well maintained holiday park, nature takes centre stage. The spacious camping pitches are attractively situated between trees. Children will enjoy themselves on the play grounds, in the recreation area and in the water play paradise.

The Drenthe heathland

On the perimeter of Nationaal Park Dwingelderveld and bordering the Drenthe heathland you will find RCN de Noordster. Both the bungalows and camping pitches are beautifully located in the woods. The park has a very clean and well maintained look. This also applies to the sanitary facilities.

Plenty to do

For youngsters there is plenty to do in the park. The forest is a natural playground, but there are also playing fields, sports fields, an indoor recreation area and an active entertainment team. In warm weather you can go the water play paradise. Adjacent to the park is an outdoor swimming pool. When the weather is less favourable, children can enjoy themselves in the planet-themed indoor playground or in the glow-in-the-dark panna area.

Clear skies

In high season RCN de Noordster attracts many families with children. Out of season you will find peace and quiet here. You will enjoy the woods and the heathland. The night skies in this area are really dark; in good weather you will get clear skies with myriads of stars.

properties.name: RCN les Collines de Castellane
properties.description:
In the Southern French region of Paca, close to La Garda, you will find the child-friendly yet peaceful terraced campsite RCN les Collines de Castellane. The campsite is recommended for families with children, especially because of the exciting swimming pool. The proud town of Castellane is approximately 10 kilometres further west, where you can walk through the medieval streets. Here, you will find fun shops and sidewalk cafés.

Hillside terraces

Standing on top of the hillside, you can see the entire campsite: spacious pitches with plenty of shade. There are many accommodations available for rent, such as lodge tents and beautifully designed bungalows. People do not come here often to camp with a tent outside of the peak season due to the cold nights. The guests are mostly families with young and teenaged children.

Exciting swimming pool

The (heated) swimming pool is the big attraction for younger campers. Here, you will find a broad 3-lane water slide and water features between the 'rocks'. It is not excessively large (250 m2), but it is well-maintained and beautifully decorated with plants. The bridge crossing the pool is a reference to the original bridge in Castellane.

Entertainment, food and drink

Many activities are organised (from the beginning of May until the end of August) in English, French and Dutch. There is the occasional disco evening as well. There is a jungle gym, complete with rope courses through the trees and a zip line which takes you to the other side of the campsite. Exciting! The restaurant is basic, but it has a breakfast service as well as takeaway meals. You can dine here with views of the swimming pool, inside or on the patio.

properties.name: RCN la Ferme du Latois
properties.description:
RCN la Ferme du Latois is located in the sun-kissed rural Vendée region. The sandy beaches of the Atlantic Ocean are just 15 kilometres away from this farm campsite. The whole terrain exudes a relaxed country atmosphere, with ample opportunities for an outdoor holiday. And for campers looking for a little more action, there are plenty of opportunities in this versatile region.

In the middle of nature

The camping pitches at La Ferme du Latois are very spacious. There are several open camping pitches situated on grass. The trees bordering the camping fields provide shade. Campers have a choice of a standard pitch with electricity or a comfort pitch with a private water point and drainage. Clean and well-tended sanitary facilities are always nearby.

Water everywhere

The well-maintained swimming pool is divided into two parts: a splashing area for the slides and an area for swimming. The heated swimming pool is surrounded by a wooden fence. There is also a small paddling pool. Next to the campsite lie two lakes where you can go swimming, water biking, fishing or canoeing. On the nearby beaches, you can hunt for shells, go swimming or practice water sports.

Sport and games

There is plenty of playing room on the campsite for the children. The entertainment team also provides plenty of entertainment with a crafts club, dancing lessons and afternoons with face painting. There are also trampolines and table tennis tables and you can play a game of jeu de boules.

Food and drink

You can have a tasty and affordable meal at the small but welcoming restaurant on the campsite. You can also grab a tasty snack at the snack bar or in the small supermarket. And for a delicious breakfast, visit the croissant shop in the mornings.

properties.name: RCN Val de Cantobre
properties.description:
RCN Val de Cantobre is located in the Les Grands Causses regional natural park, close to Nant d'Aveyron and the Gorges du Tarn. This region boasts many historical towns, spectacular nature and mostly fine weather. The campsite is located on a hillside, offering you panoramic views of the Dourbie valley and the historical village of Cantobre.

Camping at a medieval fortified farmhouse

RCN Val de Cantobre is a terraced campsite situated near a medieval fortified farmhouse. The infrastructure on the campsite is well-tended. All the pitches measure between 100 and 150 m2 and are situated on grass. There are also various rental possibilities such as chalets and luxury mobile homes. The most luxurious of these even has a sun terrace on the roof! The sanitary facilities are luxurious and modern.

Playing pool in an old sheep pen

The entertainment team organises crafts activities as well as all sorts of sports activities and games. You can also play sports on the multi-functional sports field or the basketball court. Other possibilities include table tennis, minigolf and jeu-de-boules. In the old sheep pen, you can play a game of pool. The swimming pool is located on the outskirts of the campsite. Here, you will find a 40-metre long wild water slide from which you can slide down with your inflatable tube. The Dourbie stream, where you can wade in the water or go kayaking, flows right past the reception building.

Restaurant with a varied menu

The restaurant at Val de Cantobre has an extensive à-la-carte menu and a fine terrace.

properties.name: Camping Des Glaciers
properties.description:
At a unique location amongst the highest peaks of the Swiss Alps, in the south-western part of the country, lies mountain campsite Des Glaciers. This is a fully-equipped campsite with a friendly atmosphere. The campsite is located at an elevation of 1600 metres. Here, you camp in the heart of the Val Ferret, a valley in the Mont Blanc massif. A true paradise for mountain climbers and hikers. There are also trails for less experienced mountaineering enthusiasts.

Camping in unspoilt nature

Camping in the middle of unspoilt nature and under the stars: At campsite Des Glaciers, you camp with the ultimate sense of freedom. Non-demarcated pitches of varying sizes lie scattered over the beautiful and vast campsite grounds. Choose for a spot in the shade of the pine forest or in the sunny meadow. 

The view of the mountaintops and the glacier from your camping pitch is truly phenomenal, whether you're located at the edge of the forest or on an open field.

For campers looking to get even higher...

One of the two playgrounds on the campsite features a large climbing wall. A fun way to get some practice in before tackling the mountains. This climbing wall, which you climb with the necessary safety precautions, is also a favourite with children. You will also find a tree-top adventure course with a zip-line and a large inflatable air cushion.

Swiss cuisine

Bread and a small selection of groceries is available at the reception. You can do the rest of your grocery shopping in the small supermarket in the village, a ten-minute walk from the campsite. Here you will also find several restaurants where you can enjoy the Swiss cuisine.

properties.name: Camping Zeeburg Amsterdam
properties.description:
Camping in nature, but still close to the city? It's possible at Campsite Zeeburg in Amsterdam. On this camping island, you will find yourself surrounded by greenery and directly on the water. The friendly atmosphere and the colourful ambience will give you that real island feeling! This campsite is also an ideal starting point for your city trip to the always-bustling city of Amsterdam.

Sustainable camping

On this campsite, you can come with your tent, camper or caravan. There is a separate field for tents, and for campers and caravans, there are designated pitches available. Those who do not have their own camping equipment are welcome to stay in one of the colourful wagonettes or in an eco-cabin. In the summer this is a campsite where you will meet backpackers from all over the world.

Go wild

You can be active both around and on the campsite. For example, the campsite is located on the IJmeer lake. There is a sandy beach and the water is suitable for swimming. There are also several beautiful running, skating, cycling and sailing routes from the campsite. Children are bound to make some quick holiday friends here and have a great time at the children's farm.

Everything right on site

During your camping holiday, you are provided with all conveniences. Next to the reception, you will find a supermarket and a cosy square with a terrace and a café-restaurant. Here you can have breakfast, lunch, dinner or a nice drink by the fireplace. You can cook for yourself in the covered camping kitchen which is equipped with hotplates, refrigerators and a microwave. With the right harvest from the campsite's herb garden, you can season your pasta, soup or salad perfectly!

properties.name: Camping La Mignardière
properties.description:
Only 8 km south-west of the city of Tours, you will find camping La Mignardière, the ideal base for exploring the Touraine region. The region is rich in history, gastronomy and attractive nature. The campsite presents itself as ‘hôtellerie de plein air’ (open air hotel) which is an indication that everything revolves around pleasing the holiday guests.

Peaceful ambiance

Once arrived on the campsite you will feel the peaceful atmosphere. The pitches are situated along wide, paved roads and make a well maintained impression. The right hand side of the camping grounds is reserved for the permanent pitches and the rental accommodation with high hedges between the pitches and the left hand side is for overnight guests with less clearly demarcated pitches under scattered trees. If you have not brought your own tent, caravan or camper van, you can rent a chalet or mobile caravan for max. 6 persons.

Service

The shop on the campsite stocks all basic necessities, such as daily fresh bread, and you can get snacks in the cafetaria. Restaurants and a supermarket can be found in Ballan-Miré, 2 km away, or in Joué-lès-Tours, on the other side of the D37. There is a market in Ballan-Miré on Fridays and Sunday mornings. 

Swimming pool

Near the entrance you will also find a heated swimming pool consisting of a covered and an open section, surrounded by an attractive terrace. Next to this are a tennis court and a soccer field/playing field. Further than that there is little entertainment on the campsite, but across the road is a fun park with an extensive range of attractions for young and old.

properties.name: Camping Tikvah
properties.description:
Camping Tikvah is a small-scale campsite in Drenthe, situated between woods, moors and sand drifts. The theme of the campsite is Memorial Camp Westerbork, located just a few kilometres from the campsite. You camp there in peace on a spacious comfort pitch or in a luxury safari tent. The sanitary building, with underfloor heating and facilities for the disabled, is also comfortable.

Spacious comfort pitches

Large lawns accommodate over fifty touring pitches. All these pitches are very spacious, most of them are even comfort pitches. If you camp on such a comfort pitch, you have access to running water, a drainage point and electricity. The lawns are extensive and give a spacious impression. Trees around the fields offer shady spots at the edges. If you want extra comfort (or a week of glamping), you can choose a safari tent or an apartment in the holiday home.

Child-friendly camping

For campers who like to visit Camp Westerbork Remembrance Centre, Camp Tikvah is the ideal base. But the campsite is more than that. With playground equipment, a youth centre including a table tennis table and table football table, and a toddlers' corner with toys, children can also enjoy themselves. Mostly Dutch campers visit the campsite.

Christian services

There is also a place for religious camping guests at camping Tikvah. Weekly services are organised, in which people pray together and talk about the Christian faith. However, don't be afraid that i twill be forced upon you once you have chosen the campsite as your camping destination. Everyone is welcome on the campsite and everyone is free in his or her activities.

properties.name: Seecamping Berghof
properties.description:
You will find the green Seecamping Berghof in Villach, South Carinthia to the west of the capital city of Klagenfurt. The well-maintained and pleasant campgrounds (10 ha) lie directly on a crystal clear lake, Lake Ossiach. There is also a small private beach here. In these natural surroundings, everyone can find peace and quiet. But there are also plenty of opportunities for active recreation.

Varied campsite

This terraced camping has four hundred touring pitches of 80-150 m2. The pitches are demarcated and there is water and electricity at every pitch. The campsite features man different kinds of pitches: pitches for families, quiet pitches, pitches with either a full or a very limited view of the lake, meadows and fields with different degrees of privacy.

For caravans and campers there are also luxury comfort pitches (for a supplemental fee). For tent campers, there are nice, more secluded pitches. You can also rent beautifully furnished caravans, tents or holiday homes.

Kids are King!

Seecamping Berghof is a very popular destination for families with children. The campsite is very child-friendly, with beautiful playgrounds, play equipment in the lake and an extensive entertainment programme.

Active with or without water

Here you can do practically everything either by or on the water: sunbathing on the lake shore, pedal boating, (wind)surfing, waterskiing, scuba diving, canoeing, kayaking and sailing. You can also take all kinds of lessons. It's very pleasant swimming in the lake. The water slopes gently down which is nice for smaller children. There is original play equipment in the water.

Homey restaurant

The large restaurant is located in an old barn and is very attractively furnished. The food here is excellent! The camping shop has a wide range of goods (including camping accessories).

properties.name: RCN de Flaasbloem
properties.description:
RCN de Flaasbloem is located in the woods of Brabant near Chaam. This large and spaciously designed holiday park is fully integrated with nature and offers a wide choice of accommodation and camping pitches. With various sports fields, a fishing pond, a disc golf course, a large recreational lake, three water slides and a water play paradise, there is no need for anyone to get bored.

Hire your own tree hut

The holiday park has spacious camping pitches which blend in perfectly with the natural landscape. The pitches offer ample shade and besides the standard pitches you can also choose a comfort pitch with private sanitary facilities or a pitch with your own tree hut. Back-to-basics camping can be done at nature park De Wildenberg. This is a pristine piece of nature, without roads or pathways, and you may pitch your tent wherever you want.

Disc golf and water fun

The recreational possibilities at De Flaasbloem are virtually endless. You will just love the beauty of nature and the tranquil surroundings, while the children climb the tree huts or play on the smuggler's beach. In addition, there are several sports fields and playgrounds, a fish pond and an active entertainment team. New to the park is a disc golf course (a frisbee version of golf). In peak season, the Flaasbloem slow-train takes you to any location within the park.

This is a great spot for water fun, too. At the centrally located recreation lake you can swim, sunbathe and play in the water. Build a sand castle or whizz down one of the three water slides at full speed. For children up to age ten there is a separate water play paradise. There is also a smaller indoor pool.

properties.name: Camping Village Mar y Sierra
properties.description:
On the East Coast of Italy, between the well-known coastal resort Rimini and the port town of Ancona, you will find the terraced Village Mar y Sierra campsite. From your camping pitch you have a panoramic view of the hills and old towns, with the Adriatic Sea in the distance (only 10 km away). The campsite is suitable for young and old, from beach lover to culture enthusiast.

Terraced campsite

The pitches vary in size and are laid out on terraces, which are easily reached via a paved access road. Rather rent accommodation? The rental accommodation units (bungalows, cottages and a hotel) are excellent. The sanitary facilities are satisfactory and kept very clean.

Swimming pool and beach

The beautifully constructed swimming pool has decorative tiles and is surrounded by trees. On the sunbathing terrace are ample loungers and sun umbrellas. There is also a separate children's pool with a depth of 60 cm. Friendly lifeguards keep an eye on things in high season. The swimming pool is located next to the restaurant. Do you want to go to the beach or swim in the sea? At a distance of 10 km you can enjoy the Adriatic coast and a beautiful boulevard littered with nice beach tavernas.

Swimming and water aerobics classes

Children can enjoy themselves in the playground with a range of playground equipment. Furthermore, there are a sports field, billiards and a TV room. Camping guests can also take swimming and water aerobics lessons. In weekends the roof comes off (live music).

Pizza restaurant

The campsite has a bread service. For other grocery shopping you have to walk a bit further: there is a supermarket some 3 km away. The campsite restaurant serves tasty pizzas. The terrace offers a beautiful view of the sea in the distance.

properties.name: Camping Les Micocouliers
properties.description:
Welcome to this lovely French campsite in the Provence. Owners Sarah and David took over this wonderful spot in 2023. They happily spoil guests at Camping Les Micocouliers with self-made pizzas and delicious, freshly delivered sandwiches. The campsite is extremely quiet and suitable for all ages. You can enjoy yourselves to the full at this rurally located campsite near the village of Graveson.

Star gazing from bed

The camping fields at this campsite in France have lovely pitches with plenty of grass and shade. There are a few pitches per field. You will have plenty of peace and space here. The toilet and washing facilities are at the front and rear of the campsite. Furthermore, there are nice mobile homes, lovely lodge tents and adventurous star bubbles for rent. In these exceptional bubble tents, you can see the starry sky from your bed.

Cycling over the Voie Vertes cycle path

This campsite is a lovely spot for families with children of all ages. There are playing options such as a bouncy castle and playground for the younger children. Meanwhile, their older brothers and sisters can enjoy themselves on the volleyball or badminton pitch or the football field. Sportive people with or without children can go on extensive bike rides in the area, hire a quad or do horse-riding lessons at the nearby riding school.

A new restaurant

Cosy and nice is a great description of the campsite's swimming pool. The swimming pool with paddling pool is at the campsite entrance and is open from spring (May/June) to September. The new owners are also full of plans to update the campsite. For example, the inner courtyard has been renovated and the new restaurant opened in 2023.

properties.name: Grønhøj Strand Camping
properties.description:
Grønhøj Strand Camping is situated in North Jutland, the northernmost region of Denmark. The name says it all: this campsite revolves around the beach. You camp here only seven hundred metres away from the North Sea. A ten minute walk and you reach a wide sandy beach. Grønhøj Strand Camping is a large family campsite for a quiet, relaxing camping holiday. Without a busy entertainment programme for children, but with playgrounds, a mini golf course and a petting zoo where they can go on pony rides.

The murmur of the sea

Tranquillity is the keyword of the campsite. From your campsite you can hear the murmur of the sea and even hear the tides change. You camp here on uncluttered, spacious camping pitches, separated by hedges and pine trees. You can also rent one of the cosy log cabins with their own kitchen and sleeping area. The largest cabins have private sanitary facilities. Furthermore, the campsite is perfectly suitable for a camping holiday in your tent. 

Beach camping

A walk of some seven hundred metres takes you to the North Sea and its sandy beach. This is not a beach as found on the Côte d’Azur, with beach clubs and mass tourism. The beach near Grønhøj Strand Camping is quiet and clean. This piece of North Sea coast is perfect for a lovely walk, but also simply suitable for swimming. You can also drive onto the beach by car.

Shopping in Løkken

Located adjacent to the reception building is a small camping shop, where you can find the most essential groceries. Do you need additional supplies? You will find them in Løkken, some eight km north of the campsite. Løkken was a fishing village in the early days, but has now been turned into a popular beach resort and is great for a relaxing stroll.

properties.name: MS Vacances - Camping Club La Côte Sauvage
properties.description:
Camping Club La Côte Sauvage is situated on the rugged but beautiful French coast. You are camping here with direct access to the beach of La Palmyre. On the campsite itself, the key word is comfort. Spacious pitches in shady spots with lots of privacy. On the terrace of the restaurant, you can enjoy the good life. And in the water park, there's room for everyone. The slides provide fun for young and old.

Space, rest and privacy

You camp here between the greenery on a shady spot. Trees not only provide shade, but also privacy. So open up your camping chair and enjoy the peace and quiet in front of your camping gear. Are you travelling without a tent, caravan or motor home? Then stay in one of the modern mobile homes.

Pass the ball!

You don't have to worry about your children this holiday. They'll have a good time. The playgrounds are in the shade, protected from the fierce sun. Gamers can go to the arcade. Sporting youngsters can choose from basketball, football, badminton, mini-golf and beach volleyball. Feel free to hit, kick or throw a ball.

The beach within walking distance

The Atlantic Ocean: you can almost smell it from the campsite. Not surprising, because the coast is not far away. A few minutes' walk and you are already on the beach. This makes this campsite a perfect camping destination for beach lovers. Every day you can dive into that infinite ocean. Follow the red lighthouse of La Coubre and you'll find yourself between the waves.

properties.name: MS Vacances - Camping Club Médoc Plage
properties.description:
Camping Campéole Médoc Plage is situated in the town of Montalivet. The campsite has 148 pitches spread over 32 hectares. A forest path leads from the campsite to the beach. This is a great spot for surfing. Throughout the season, the entertainment team offers entertainment for young and old. This includes excursions, karaoke and archery.

Camping and renting

The pitches are shaded by the pine forest. The pitches are also spacious. The rental accommodation is found at the back. There is plenty of choice of mobile homes. The village square is home to several shops. There is also a wellness area with a nail salon, hairdresser and osteopath.

Close to the sea

From the exit of the campsite, you can simply walk to the beach via a forest path. Alternatively, you can drive the distance of just under 1 km by car or go by bicycle. Montalivet is a veritable surfing paradise and attracts large numbers of youth in high season. In the off-season, the target group is somewhat older. The campsite itself has a swimming pool with a whopping thirteen slides. There is an outdoor and a 550m² indoor pool. You can also relax in the whirlpool bath. The little ones will enjoy the paddling pool with play equipment. For adults, there is a Zen pool.

Extensive entertainment programme

Throughout the season, there are numerous possibilities with a wide variety of entertainment for children of all ages. There is also a vast array on offer for adults, including sports activities: water aerobics, fitness, archery, excursions, concerts, dance evenings, karaoke. Plenty of choice.

properties.name: MS Vacances - Camping Club Le Littoral
properties.description:
Camping Club MS Vacances Le Littoral is located on the edge of the Mas Larrieu nature reserve. You don't even have to leave the campsite to get to the quiet golden beach of Argelès-sur-Mer. Lying on the beach you can enjoy a beautiful view of the Pyrenees. It won't be difficult to enjoy a wonderful time at this lively family campsite.

Large choice of rental accommodations

The campsite offers camping pitches, mobile homes and luxury lodges. The pitches are separated by hedges and shrubs and there is plenty of shade on the mostly level, tree-lined site. You will camp here mainly between families with French nationality, which gives you a wonderful feeling of anonymity and privacy.

Water fun and wellness

What immediately stands out in the swimming pool complex is the enormous adventurous colourful slide, also known as the 'space hole'. Small campers have also been thought of, as there are two paddling pools with water play equipment. But in addition to splashing, swimming and enjoying yourself in the (partly covered) swimming pools, the swimming paradise is also perfect for sunbathing and lazing on one of the sunbeds. Looking for even more relaxation? Near the water park you can enjoy the sauna for a fee. Here you can also enjoy a wonderful hammam, massage or beauty treatment.

Play and sports

Toys, climbing frames, bouncy castles and trampolines; children will never be bored here. And for sports enthusiasts too, the possibilities on and around the campsite are endless. There is a gym, sports fields, tennis courts and you can rent bicycles and mountain bikes to explore the southern French countryside.

properties.name: MS Vacances - Camping Club Navarrosse Plage
properties.description:
Campéole Navarrosse Plage is a friendly campsite located on the banks of Lac de Sanguinet-Cazaux in the South West of France. Thanks to its beautiful location, the campsite is a paradise for water sports enthusiasts. You can choose a pitch under the trees or directly along the lake. There are also mobile homes. From the campsite, you have direct access to the lake. There is also a small harbour and you can bring your own boat.

Camping and glamping by the water's edge

This friendly, family campsite has spacious pitches and comfortable rental accommodations. The pitches are situated between the trees on sandy soil. They are located separately from the rental accommodations for an optimal camping experience. Do you like glamping? Then spend your holiday in a mobile home, equipped tent or chalet.

A water sports paradise

Lovers of water(sports) and nature will be delighted by the Campéole Navarrosse Plage campsite. You will be camping on the banks of Lac de Sanguinet-Cazaux. The campsite even has its own small marina (120 moorings). The lake is a great place for sailing, windsurfing and kite surfing. Also boating, paddle surfing, fishing and of course swimming is possible here. The water is warm (28 degrees) and shallow making it ideal for (small) children.

Something for everyone

Besides all the water activities, there is also plenty to do on land at the campsite. There is a tennis court and a beach volleyball court. You can also play football and table tennis. For the children, there is a playground, a bouncy castle and an animation team.

properties.name: MS Vacances - Camping Club Les Tourterelles
properties.description:
The beautiful Campéole Les Tourterelles is located on the popular surfing beach Saint-Girons-Plage. The campsite is located in the Landes region, an area directly on the Atlantic Ocean with beautiful beaches and forests. In short: a wonderful destination for a camping holiday! It's all about water fun in the summer at this cosy and lively campsite.

Swimming and surfing

Campéole Les Tourterelles is the destination for surfing and water enthusiasts! You can walk to the beach of Saint-Girons-Plage in a few minutes. It's charming here with restaurants, surf shops and supermarkets. There is a surf club where you can take lessons, and the beach has a lifeguard here in high season. If you want a little more peace, walk a little further and relax on the beautiful sandy beach with your towel and a parasol.

At the campsite itself, you can also take a dip in one of the heated outdoor swimming pools. The little ones can enjoy playing in the water playground and the toddlers' pool. You can also relax in the hot tub and complete the wellness experience with a massage (for an additional fee).

A lively atmosphere

Camping Campéole Les Tourterelles is filled with life and laughter throughout the season. There is entertainment for all ages with a kids club, sports tournaments, excursions and evening shows. Or try a lesson in archery or aqua gym. Surfing is one of the most popular summer activities. In that period there are various surf camps in the area.

properties.name: Camping Yelloh! Village Domaine Sainte Cécile
properties.description:
Camping Domaine Sainte Cécile is a campsite in the south of France with a complete water park, only 500 m from the sandy beaches of the Mediterranean. The area offers plenty to do for young and old: from a theme park and disco to boat trips and sailing, surfing and diving activities. The level cycle paths along the well-known Canal du Midi are excellent for cycling.

Shaded pitches

The campsite is situated in a park and is meticulously cared for. You will be staying on beautifully laid out, spacious and (partly) shady pitches. The surface is largely flat. There are rental mobile homes for guests who do not have their own camping equipment.

Beautiful swimming pool complex

The beautiful swimming pool complex consists of various heated pools in lovely shapes with decorations in Oriental style, three large slides, a heated toddler pool, a bubble bath and a water playground. There is also a bar. Furthermore, the Mediterranean with its child-friendly sandy beaches is not far away.

Evening shows for the whole family

There is a playground for the little ones. In addition, there is a sports field, a fitness trail, a tennis court, a pétanque pitch and table tennis tables. There is entertainment galore for young and old, from treasure hunts and games to sports events. In the evenings there are performances for the entire family in the restaurant.

Delicacies

The campsite shop has an extensive assortment as well as fresh products such as bread, meat, vegetables, fruit and a large choice of delicacies. The restaurant serves snacks and pizzas but also regional dishes. The terrace is located on the first floor. From there you have a view of the beautiful water park, the sea and the evening shows.

properties.name: Piccolo Camping E Maieu
properties.description:
In the province of Alessandria, in the North Italian Piëmont region, you will find Piccolo Camping E Maieu (also referred to as Emaieu). It is a small-scale nature campsite, quietly situated, even a tad in the middle of nowhere. You can really unwind in the green, hilly surrounds or on the other hand indulge yourself in all kinds of sports activities. You are in the Tortonese region, where the foothills of the Ligurian Apennines dominate the landscape.

Camping in nature

E Maieu is a terraced campsite situated amidst nature in the hilly countryside, within walking distance of the village of Garbagna. Small-scale is the key word which describes this quiet campsite. Nice to know: the owner, Fausto Moressa, is also the postman. E Maieu is predominantly a campsite for campers with tents. There are spacious and less spacious pitches. There are also a few apartments available for rent, suitable for up to two persons. E Maieu has good sanitary facilities, both in the main building and lower down on the campsite.

Remarkably, some 90% of the guests are Dutch and Belgian, usually seekers of peace and quiet and nature lovers. There is not a lot of choice in terms of amenities. However, there is a small swimming pool (for a fee). You can go to Garbagna for a meal or for shopping.

Heading out

The area is eminently suitable for sporty activities. From the campsite you can take lovely hiking and cycling trips. You can already find some interesting routes from the camping website. Nice for cycling fans: in the village of Castellania, only 6 km from the campsite, you will find the birth house (now a museum) of the legendary cycling champion Fausto Coppi.

properties.name: Azienda Agrituristica Malapezza
properties.description:
Two km from the beach of the Adriatic Sea, in the tip of the Italian 'boot', lies Azienda Agrituristica Malapezza. This 'agricamping' site consists of a farm with several orchards, vegetable gardens and a restaurant. You camp here partly in an orchard.

In the orchard

Azienda Agrituristica Malapezza covers an area of almost 15 acres. The pitches are not marked or demarcated. You may choose your own pitch under the centuries-old olive trees and pine trees. The campsite lends itself excellently to tents, but you can also stay here with your caravan or motorhome. This is a cosy, small-scale campsite with only eighty touring pitches. There are no permanent pitches. However, there are some chalets, apartments and room available for rent.

Fresh and organic

You cannot do your daily shopping in a campsite shop; instead, you can get these in the vegetable garden and the orchards. Everything is sustainably grown here. You can buy fresh bread on the campsite as well as all types of home-made products. For instance, wine and olive oil, but also jams and limoncello. Intrigued? Why not attend a tasting session. 

Solar energy

This agricampsite is nature and environment conscious. Therefore, all buildings on the campsite are equipped with solar panels. In the neat sanitary building you can take a shower heated by solar energy. 

Rocky coast and turquoise water

Azienda Agrituristica Malapezza does not have a swimming pool, but the Adriatic Sea is only two km away from the campsite. It takes only ten minutes by bicycle to get there. The turquoise water is crystal clear. The coastline is rocky, but it is interspersed with patches of sandy beach.

properties.name: Campingdorf Hofer
properties.description:
Campingdorf Hofer lies in the beautiful mountainous landscape of Austria’s Tirol. You camp within walking distance of the charming holiday village of Zell Am Ziller in the Ziller Valley. This is a popular holiday destination in both the summer and the winter. The campsite is open all year round to welcome mountain climbers and those enjoying winter sports. The surrounding area is characterised by the imposing mountains, green alpine meadows and crystal-clear mountain lakes. Europe’s largest waterfalls, the Krimml waterfalls, are a fifty-minute drive from the campsite.

Camping with mountain views

Campingdorf Hofer is a green campsite with a view of the mountains. You camp on grass or gravel here. Pitches vary in size, with the standard pitches between 60 m² and 95 m² and the comfort pitches 90 m² to 100 m². The site is richly planted with trees and, for the most part, is surrounded by meadows, which gives a feeling of freedom. The campsite consists of several camping fields that are linked together by means of an asphalted pathway.

Indoor swimming pool and hours of fun

Campingdorf Hofer is a family campsite with amenities for the entire family. The swimming pool guarantees water fun and is open for five months of the year. The pool is covered with a glass roof, which means you can also swim on rainy days. There is also a sun deck with sun loungers. Children can have the time of their lives in the playground with various climbing frames and on the trampoline. During the high season in the Zillertal Arena (1.6 km), weekly activities are organised for children aged five and up.

properties.name: Camping de Cromenac'h
properties.description:
Camping de Cromenac'h is a cosy French campsite in authentic Southern Brittany. This area hasn't yet been discovered by mass tourism and it is certainly wonderfully quiet in the off season. Select a campsite with a view of the bay and let the soft sound of the waves lull you to sleep every evening.

Pure Camping Pleasure

When you reach the property, you'll see rental apartments and a number of pitches right behind the reception. Just past the reception you'll pass an old chapel. Behind it there is a field with campsites with a sea view. The pitches are demarcated and there are many old trees around them. Here you will find the most touring campers. In addition to apartments, there are also caravans and mobile homes for rent.

Swimming, fishing and snorkelling

Camping de Cromenac'h is located right on the sea. You are on the sandy beach surrounded by low cliffs in the blink of an eye. A perfect spot for endless afternoons swimming, sunning, fishing and watersports. Campers with their own boats can bring them. But you can also find a 'Base Nautique' in the area and hire a sailboat, kayaks or pedal surfboards.

Bouncy castle and table tennis

There is a playground for the little campers. The kids can have fun and jump on the trampoline. Jeu-de-boules court naturally can't be missed on this French campsite. There is also a recreation room with a pool table, some games and a television. For younger and older children, there is plenty to do around the campsite. For example, take a day at the pool in Surzur or visit the aquarium or the butterfly garden in Vannes.

properties.name: MS Vacances - Camping Club La Côte des Roses
properties.description:
Campéole La Côte des Roses campsite is located between the French towns of Narbonne-Plage and Gruissan. Here you can enjoy the nearby sea, a large swimming paradise and an area full of vineyards. In addition to spacious pitches, you can also rent numerous accommodation here. Hikers can indulge in the 15,000-hectare Massif of la Clape, a green oasis with beautiful chalk cliffs, gorges, pine forests and vineyards.

Natural environment and water fun

At Campéole La Côte des Roses, you can camp by the sea or at the foot of the beautiful Massif de La Clape nature reserve. Extensive relaxation, water fun or a beautiful hike - it's all possible in this natural environment.

The sandy beach is approximately 400 metres from the campsite. In addition to relaxing and swimming on the water, you can also enjoy excellent kite surfing and windsurfing. Prefer the swimming pool? There is a large swimming pool complex with sunbathing lawn, four slides and a hot tub on the campsite. Children can have fun here for hours!

Open character

On arrival you will be professionally assisted in a modern reception building by friendly and multilingual staff. As you drive across the campsite, you will immediately see its open and expansive character. Besides comfort pitches, there are also special ‘signature’ pitches, equipped with extra luxury. Renting an accommodation is also an option here.

Various facilities

At the campsite itself, you will find a grocery shop with all kinds of products. Where you can also find the necessary beach items. With a bar, restaurant and bakery there is something delicious to eat at any time of the day. Throughout the season there is daily entertainment for the children, young and old. There is also a wellness area with hairdresser, massages and beauty treatments.

properties.name: CityCamp Assens Strand
properties.description:
Due to the rural character, the sparse population and the many orchards, the island of Funen is also called the Garden of Denmark. CityCamp Assens Strand is on the southwest of Funen, bordering the city of Assens. You camp right by the sea and a large sandy beach. You have lovely views of the water from the park-like campsite. Above all, here you see the most beautiful sunsets as the sun slowly sinks into the sea. This is a recently renovated campsite with modern amenities.

Spacious camping pitches and modern chalets

When you initially walk or drive over the campsite, you will first see a number of modern chalets behind the reception. Besides in a bungalow, you can stay on a spacious pitch at CityCamp Assens Strand. In fact, tourist pitches are clearly in the majority here. There are three categories of touring pitches. The difference is in the location with regards to the beach. If you want to camp close to the beach at CityCamp Assens Strand, it is advisable to book in advance.

Wonderful swimming in Little Belt

If you love taking a refreshing swim in natural water on summer days, then this campsite is the place to be as here you camp right next to the sandy beach of Assens. This campsite is connected to this beach via a lovely path. You can jump into the sea from a sturdy swimming jetty.

properties.name: Sport-Camping-Flaschberger
properties.description:
This beautiful, quiet and simple campground, Flaschberge, is located in Carinthia, not far from the Italian border. The campground is located just outside of the town of Hermagor-Pressegger See, where you can shop. The mild climate ensures warm weather in the summer and in the winter you are near to the Nassfeld ski area, and you can take the free ski bus from the campground.

A spot with sun or shade

You will receive a warm welcome from one of the Flaschbergers, junior or senior. The campground is spacious, well maintained and has much greenery. The campsites are not fenced off, but the natural planting designates the separation. There are sites with sun and through the many trees also many spots with shade. You can hire apartments and bungalows.

The guests in the low season are usually older campers and young families. The campground is open year-round, so in the winter there are winter sports enthusiasts, and in the summer the more sporty campers who want to cycle, hike and indulge in water sports.

Small but lovely swimming pool

There is a small nice (unheated) swimming pool on the campground. You can also play tennis and bowl (both indoors) on the campground. As a campground guest you have free entry to the Pressegger See swimming pool.

Restaurant annex café

There is a very simple restaurant annex café with a terrace on the campground. The campground shop has a good selection. The sanitation block is at the end of the campground. It looks a bit dated, but the facilities are sufficient and clean. There are also separate cabins with toilet, sink and shower.

properties.name: RCN de Roggeberg
properties.description:
Bordering the Nationaal Park Drents-Friese Wold lies the beautiful family campsite RCN de Roggeberg. The beautiful nature in the area invites to go walking or cycling. Furthermore, it is located in Appelscha, a picturesque village where you will feel at home straight away. It is a large campsite, but due to the separation of the camping fields, it feels like camping on a small-scale campsite.

Camping amidst green

RCN de Roggeberg offers the camper generous pitches between trees on beautifully laid out lawns. Some of the camping fields have a playground in the middle of the field. This way you can keep an eye on the children or grandchildren while you are enjoying yourself. For camper owners, there are special camper sites, with a paved area. Do you prefer some extra comfort? Opt for a more spacious camping pitch with private sanitary facilities.

It is also possible to rent one of the accommodations.

Holiday fun for all

RCN de Roggeberg offers something for everyone. There is mini-golf, a pumptrack track and a multifunctional sports field. For a fee you can have a game of tennis, or go climbing and abseiling in the climbing park. In addition to these facilities, there is an entertainment team on the campsite from April to October and during the school holiday. Small children will have fun in the water play paradise. Furthermore, within walking distance from the campsite is an outdoor swimming pool.

Something to eat?

Visit the Brasserie for a cosy lunch or dinner. Fancy a quick bite to eat? Then there is the Brood & Snack. Here you can get freshly baked rolls in the morning and fries and snacks in the afternoon.

properties.name: Camping Au Bocage du Lac
properties.description:
Camping Au Bocage du Lac is situated at the Côtes d’Armor in Brittany, some 800 meters from the town centre of Jugon-les-Lacs and alongside a 70-ha-fishing lake. Jugon-les-Lacs is a small town between Dinan and Lamballe, 20 minutes from the sea. From the campsite, you can visit various historical and tourist sights as Saint-Malo, the Mont Saint-Michel or Dinard.

Enjoying the starry skies

The campsite is much frequented by both couples and families with children. Here you'll be staying on spacious, comfortable and demarcated pitches with a grassy surface. There are special pitches without trees for camper vans. There are two toilets and showers blocks with modern newly renovated facilities. The campsite has direct access to the lake. There are also various types of rental accommodation units: mobile homes, chalets and bungalows. The L'Insolite with spa is set among the trees, with lake views and a whirlpool in which you can enjoy the starry night sky.

Kids' club and activities

Small children can join the kids' club with all kinds of activities, such as treasure hunts, crafts and face painting. In the petting zoo you will find ponies and goats. For teenagers and adults, there are activities such as water aerobics, bubble-football, foam parties and olympiads. Crêpe evenings, magic shows, karaoke evenings and Breton song and dance are also organised.

Outdoor swimming pool with lake view

The campsite's water park has a heated outdoor pool with water play equipment and there is a toddler pool for the little ones. Furthermore, there are massage jets, a hydro jet and several water slides. Near the sun terrace is a kiosk where you can buy candyfloss, waffles, ice cream and sweets in high season.

properties.name: Camping Des Mégalithes
properties.description:
The Des Mégalithes campsite is located on the south coast of Brittany, three kilometres from the Atlantic Ocean and the beach. This campsite is near Carnac in the rustic surroundings of Morbihan, which is known for its thousands of megaliths. On the campsite you will find a very spacious demarcated campsite. This is a quiet starting point during your camping holiday for cycling tours to the beach and visits to the megalith parks.

Quiet and spacious camping pitches.

Des Mégalithes campsite is divided into two sections. The central section of the campsite has space for about 90 touring spots. Here you'll always find a quiet campsite. The touring sites are on flat grassy fields and are very spacious. They are demarcated by lovely manicured hedges. Some pitches are in the shadow of small trees, but most pitches are in the sun. There are holiday homes of the permanent sites around this section for touring campers.

Swimming pool with toddler pool

The swimming pool is behind the reception building surrounded by walls. The round swimming pool is a great place for a refreshing dive, even for the little ones.
