A toddler pool is separate from the deeper section. There is a fountain, which is a favourite of the littlest ones. Around the swimming pool there is space to lie in the sun on the loungers.

The Atlantic Coast

A flat cycling path will take you the three kilometres to the Atlantic Coast. A large part of the coast consists of cliffs and dune areas, but you can also find a lovely sandy beach. At ebb the sea is shallow for a long way, so shell seekers can search to their heart's content. But you can also swim and kite surf.

properties.name: Camping Arc en Ciel
properties.description:
Have you always wanted to go canoeing on the Ardèche river? You can do that right from the campsite at Camping Arc en Ciel. Here, you camp by the river where it's lovely for swimming, sunbathing and sailing. And for real water lovers, there is also a lovely outdoor swimming pool with slide. Explore the castles, villages and caves of the Ardèche from this friendly campsite.

Renovated campsite

The campsite makes a good first impression. The pitches are on grassland and thanks to the many trees, you are nicely shaded in summer. The campsite was completely refurbished not long ago. The swimming pool, restaurant and toilet and washing facilities have been renovated. The toilet block includes family showers, toilet and washing facilities for children and for the disabled. There are about 130 pitches and 65 accommodation.

Swimming in the river and leisure pool

You are guaranteed fun in the water at Camping Arc en Ciel. Thanks to the lovely swimming pool with slides and paddling pool, you can spend an entire day here splashing, jumping, whizzing or in the bubbles of the hot tub. You can relax on a sun lounger with parasol by the swimming pool. The Ardèche river is a wonderful place for swimming, sailing and fishing.

Beach volleyball tournaments and dance evenings

The campsite organises numerous activities in the summer holiday. These range from crafting and outdoor activities for the youngest ones, to beach volleyball tournaments and party evenings to get those feet moving. Invite your neighbours for a game of table tennis or jeu de boules or let the children play to their hearts' content on the bouncy castle.

properties.name: Camping Les Sources
properties.description:
Camping Les Sources is located in the Cevennes National Park, at the foot of the Cevennes Mountains. You'll find this small campsite on the outskirts of Saint-Jean-du-Gard, an old village on the river Gardon. Here you'll camp on a well-kept, green terraced campsite with playfully landscaped touring pitches. Within a twenty minute walk you are on the lush banks of the river Gardon and from Saint-Jean-du-Gard you can catch the authentic steam train to Anduze.

The campsite is situated on a hillside, on a road that climbes up from the village. A narrow exit leads you to the central camping building. There you can check in at the reception or relax on the pavement café.

Well-maintained nature campsite

On the campsite, tall trees provide shady spots in the middle of nature. The touring pitches have a beautiful view, as do the chalets and mobile homes. On the side of the campsite is the heated swimming pool, complete with a shallow pool for the little ones. In the attractive central building you'll find a restaurant. In high season a professional chef cooks here. In low season you will find owner Françoise in the kitchen.

Quiet camping destination for families

During the high season, the campsite is mainly frequented by young families from all over Europe. In low season many people over fifty come here for walking or cycling through the mountainous nature. In the attractive town Saint-Jean-du-Gard you can take the steam train to Anduze. This little train makes a stop at the bamboo gardens of Prafrance, just outside Anduze.

properties.name: Camping Le Castelet
properties.description:
Looking for a paradise hidden in the countryside of the French Ardèche? At Camping Le Castelet, you camp at a tree-filled site on the banks of the Doux river. This charming and small-scale campsite is ideal for families with young children, nature lovers and people wanting to relax and unwind. You can take wonderful walking and cycling trips in the natural green surroundings. Visit charming French villages and go for a ride on the steam train that passes close to campsite. You can go to the swimming pool for a refreshing swim. The friendly bar with patio is perfect for a drink after swimming.

Camping on a natural green site

When you arrive at Camping Le Castelet, you will notice that the site is neatly maintained and spaciously appointed. The many trees offer plenty of shade. The site has 58 pitches. The campsite also rents mobile homes suitable for four to six people. The toilet and washing facilities are clean and tidy.

Fun in the water in the swimming pool and the river

Le Castelet has a lovely heated swimming pool, which is highly suitable for young children. Next to the swimming pool there is a pool with water games and a separate paddling pool. You can have even more swimming fun in the Doux river that also has a beach.

Valhalla for young children

There is no lack of entertainment! In the high season there is an enthusiastic entertainment team that organises all kinds of fun activities. For example, face painting, drawing, outdoor games and football or table tennis matches. There are various playgrounds at the campsite, a BMX track, a fitness field and a basketball pitch.

properties.name: Camping Park Delle Rose
properties.description:
A crazy big swimming pool complex, tennis courts, a large playground under the trees and a great sandy beach with a swimming pier on Lake Garda: these are only a few of strong points of the Camping Park Delle Rose in Italy. The campsite is particularly suitable for families.

The property appears spacious, nice and well organised. The flat pitches surrounded by trees vary in size, but are all generally spacious. The loveliest spaces are located on the lake. If you want to rent something, you can stay in one of the lovely mobile homes.

Extensive swimming complex

The swimming complex is impressive. You'll have plenty of fun in the three pools on the complex. Toddlers can splash in the large kiddie pool. Other finds here: a few metres of water slides, a water mushroom, hydromassage, a very spacious sunbathing lawn and numerous loungers and parasols.

A ride on the banana boat

You can also swim in Lake Garda. Between the campsite and the water there is a sandy beach that slowly slopes into the water. From the beach you have a lovely view of the mountain landscape of the Alps. You can windsurf in the water and take a ride on a banana boat! Always a good idea.

Boredom is not an option!

The campsite has tennis courts, a play area with four table tennis tables, two large playgrounds for the little ones, a well equipped fitness room, various sports fields, a spacious mini golf course and activities. The activities team organises things for all ages. In the evening there are often great shows.

Restaurant and shop

The restaurant on the campsite has a great menu. The camping shop also has a good range.

properties.name: Camping Paradis La Cailletière
properties.description:
Centrally situated in the island Ile d’Oléron, at the edge of the forest, lies campsite La Cailletière. Ile d’Oléron is a large island off the French coast, in the Bay of Biscay. This virtually flat island has a large number of sandy beaches. The nearest beach is four km away from the campsite. La Cailletière is a quiet family campsite with lots of greenery and a remarkable amount of flowers. You camp here on grass under old oak trees.

In the forest

Camping La Cailletière is located in a wooded area. The campsite is lush and floral: oaks, oleanders, palm trees, eucalyptus trees and mimosa. The campsite has forty touring pitches and the same number of permanent pitches. Furthermore, rental accommodation is also available: thirty mobile homes and six lodge tents. The touring pitches are located on a separate section of the campsite, on grassy fields under trees. If you prefer, you can choose a pitch at the edge of the forest.

Heated swimming pool

Centrally located on the campsite you will find a beautiful heated swimming pool with sliding roof. Weather permitting, the indoor pool is transformed into an outdoor pool. For the little ones there is a tiny separate toddler pool, which is separated from the large pool with an additional fence. There are a great many loungers on the tiled sun deck. 

Cycle island

Ile d’Oléron measures 12 km in width and is 34 km long. There are numerous signposted cycling routes on flat cycling paths. If you have not brought your bicycle, you can hire one from the campsite. Cycle to the old lighthouse and the surrounding ornamental gardens. Visit the markets in the various villages on the island. Alternatively, cycle along the beaches and promenades and enjoy the view of the Atlantic Ocean.

properties.name: Camping Le Capeyrou
properties.description:
Camping Le Capeyrou is located in a green paradise on the banks of the Dordogne. Here you will camp at the foot of Château de Beynac. You choose a camping pitch under the trees or directly at the water. In the pool, overlooking the castle, you take a royal dip. Would you like to see all the beauty that the Dordogne has to offer? Step into a canoe for a relaxing trip. Afterwards, you can end the day with live music on the terrace of the campsite.

Camping in the Dordogne

What strikes you most when you're looking for your pitch is the space. The space and all the greenery around you. Would you like a pitch with a view of the castle? Or do you prefer camping directly on the banks of the Dordogne? Wherever you choose to make camp, you're always under trees. On each spacious pitch, you can enjoy the cool shade and the peace and quiet.

Royal swimming

The royal castle can be seen from anywhere on the campsite. But the best view is from the pool. It is situated on a raised plateau, surrounded by hedges and a lawn. Plunge into the water with your children, big and small.

Dining with pizza and music

You've already had a drink. But of course, you can also have a bite to eat in the campsite restaurant. With a good pizza and live music, this is a great place to dine. Also because the castle looks even more beautiful at night than during the day. Do you prefer eating under your own tree in front of your camping tent? The pizzas can also be taken away.

properties.name: Camping Les Romarins
properties.description:
If you would like to experience the atmosphere, countryside and old towns and villages of the Provence, then Camping Les Romarins in Maussane-les-Alpilles (Bouches-du-Rhône) is for you. This campsite is in a quiet location, just by the charming village centre of Maussane. From here, you can get to other lovely towns in the area, including the popular Les Baux-de-Provence. This is a well-maintained campsite with a park-like allure, with lots of natural greenery and flowers.

Playfully appointed campsite with authentic approach

The reception building is by the barrier, it also houses an office du tourisme. The pitches are spread out over the site in a playful way. This is an authentic campsite that only has touring pitches. Each pitch is about 80 square metres in size and enclosed by hedges. You have free wifi throughout the campsite.

Three well-maintained toilet blocks

Three toilet bocks are spread across the site. One of the toilet blocks has facilities for the disabled. The toilet and washing facilities are well maintained. The campsite uses environmentally products for cleaning, water savers have been installed all over, there are motion sensors, and the water is heated by solar energy.

Enjoy the heated outdoor swimming pool

You can find the lovely swimming pool right after the entrance. This heated swimming pool was installed in 2018. With a surface area of 112 square metres, this pool is big enough for swimming laps and for cooling down after a day of sightseeing.

properties.name: Camping Daftö Resort
properties.description:
The Swedish Daftö Resort is a luxury 5-star campsite in a region (Bohuslän) characterised by sea, beach, sand, rocks and woodlands. The terraced campsite is located by the sea and is bordered by woodland. The campsite is laid out in an unusual design: everything has a pirate theme, including a pirate swimming paradise. The well-known pirate play paradise Daftöland is, in fact, located next to the campsite.

Beautiful green grounds

You will find spacious, demarcated pitches (a varied selection) here with attention to greenery and the unavoidable pirate details. The pitches have a nice grass surface and are fitted with all amenities. Even more pirate themes? You can rent a cottage or tree house in a pirate theme, from basic to very luxurious.

Activities galore

On the campsite there is plenty to do for small children. They can enjoy themselves on the bouncer, on the playground or on the mini golf course. Teenagers will appreciate the multi sports field and the discotheque.  Parents will also not get bored with a choice of theatre, signposted walking routes and excursions. The largest crowd-puller, however, is the Daftöland Theme Park adjacent to the campsite.

Pirate ships in the swimming pool

The (heated) swimming pool also has a pirate theme design. It is very attractive with several pools and with 'pirate ships'. There is also a heated toddler pool.

Beautiful beach

The seashore (with calm water) can be accessed directly from the campsite. It is beautifully designed, with stretches of sandy beach and lawns (grass). The rocks are an invitation to clambering, or otherwise the play equipment a bit further down in the water poses a real challenge for teenagers.

properties.name: Heidepark Veluwschkarakter
properties.description:
Heidepark Veluwschkarakter is located in the friendly village of Vierhouten, in the centre of the north of the Veluwe. This nature campsite is right next to the extensive fields of heather and surrounded by wooded areas. It is an ideal starting point for endless hiking and cycling fun past the highlights of the Veluwe. The campsite itself is quiet and low-traffic and is very well maintained.

Three car-free camping fields, which one will you choose?

An unpaved access road lined with old trees leads you to the camping grounds. Set up your motorhome, caravan and/or tent on one of the green touring pitches. Most of the spacious comfort pitches can be found on the sunny Hoge Weide field. If you prefer a little more shade, reserve a pitch on the Valkenweide. You could also camp on the large field (Lage Weide), an open field where you can choose your own pitch.

Chalets, log cabins and luxury heather lodges

If you would prefer to rent an accommodation, that’s possible, too. You can choose from a modern chalet or a friendly log cabin. You can also stay overnight in a luxury heather lodge, where you combine the comfort of home with a stay in the unspoilt countryside of the Veluwe.

Enjoy the natural beauty of the Veluwe to the fullest

Heidepark Veluwschkarakter is a great location for nature lovers. This location allows you to walk straight onto the beautiful Noorderheide and Elspeterheide. This extensive fields of heather are beautiful all year round, but especially so during the flowering time in August and September. You can also walk and cycle in the surrounding woods with its kilometres of marked trails that have been laid out. The campsite has (electric) bikes, tandems and carrier tricycles for hire.

properties.name: Camping Les Chênes
properties.description:
Les Chênes campsite is located in a wooded area in the rugged countryside of the Gard. This well-maintained family campsite is a suitable destination for the whole family. You'll camp on shady pitches under oak trees, on a quiet campsite with an outdoor swimming pool.

Camping among the oak trees

On the campsite there is room for about seventy touring pitches. These well-maintained pitches are playfully laid out between the many oak trees. The trees form the natural delimitation of the pitches, while their low hanging branches provide nice shady spots. Which is very pleasant during the hot summer days in the south of France. You can also book one of the gypsy caravans or mobile homes.

Swimming pool in the sun

The swimming pool, situated in the middle of the campsite, is not particularly large, but it is a nice place for a cooling dip. The swimming pool is situated in an a sunny area. Luckily the surrounding trees provide some shade. Next to the swimming pool is a small paddling pool with a slide. For sunbathing there are the sun loungers.

Playing outside

On the campsite children can play outside, without a busy entertainment team or organised activities. A trampoline, various playground equipment, sports fields and a bouncy castle are ready for young camping guests. And of course, the swimming pool is also an important source of entertainment.

Shopping

For fresh bread, an ice-cream or a snack you can go to the campsite shop at the reception or to the snack bar. And for the daily groceries you don't have to go very far: within a ten minute drive you're in Sommières, where you’ll find several supermarkets.

properties.name: Camping Fontisson
properties.description:
Just east of the beautiful city of Avignon, Fontisson campsite is located next to the village of Châteauneuf-de-Gadagne. This part of southern France, the Vaucluse, is the heart of Provence. Beautiful natural areas, ancient castles and lovely towns make this a relaxing and diverse destination. On the campsite's central square is the outdoor swimming pool, the shop and in the summer months a nice restaurant.

Spacious under the trees

The flat, spacious pitches are a particular advantage of this well-tended campsite. The terrain is slightly sloping and full of trees. There are also plenty of sunny corners. Some pitches are delimited, others are not. The sanitary facilities are clean, but not new. What is new is the possibility of renting private sanitary facilities if you are camping on a touring pitch.

Swimming and relaxing

Fancy a refreshing dip? There is a rectangular swimming pool on the outside of the campsite. There are several shaded areas, but you can also dry off in the sun on one of the sunbeds.

Eating on the patio

During the summer months, you can have a bite to eat on the patio of the restaurant. On some evenings, there is live music. You can also have a nice breakfast, because fresh rolls are available in the morning.

From the playground to boules

No one gets bored at Camping Fontisson. Sports enthusiasts can head to the multi-sports pitch, the gym or the aqua aerobics classes. Or why not play a game of boules or table tennis? Young children will have a great time in the colourful playground, and in high season they can go pony riding every week.

properties.name: Camping Paradis Family des Issoux
properties.description:
Camping Paradis Family des Issoux is located on the banks of the river with the same name in the French Ardèche department. This family campsite has many things for the entire family to do. There are organised activities, a campsite restaurant, a playground and swimming pools with playground equipment. The river has a beach where you can relax and swim.

Sleep in a yurt or a gypsy wagon

You stay here on spacious pitches that are distributed over the campgrounds. The pitches vary in size and the amount of shade. All communal sanitary buildings have children’s toilet facilities with a bath in the shape of a canoe and a baby changing table. Staying overnight in a luxury accommodation is also possible. Choose from a mobile home, a safari tent on poles, a yurt or a gypsy wagon without toilet facilities.

Water fun in the river

The Ardèche river flows past the campsite. There is a path on one side of the campgrounds that leads right to the beach. The river is good for a refreshing dip as well as good fishing. The campsite itself has several swimming pools with slides – ideal for hours of entertainment.

What is there to do?

Activities are organised daily during the high season. For example, themed evenings in the campsite restaurant, theatre shows, dancing parties and live music. There are also amenities such as a playground, a health club and a table-tennis table. The reception has board games you can borrow to relax in the covered lounge. The spa is open during the high season for a small fee. It can be used for free during the off season. The campsite is within walking distance of a large supermarket.

properties.name: Camping Clos Nenn
properties.description:
Camping Clos Nenn is in the south of Brittany, only one kilometre from the Atlantic Ocean. You camp between the sea and the Pénerf river. Brière Regional Natural Park is half an hour’s drive away. The surrounding area has more than enough to offer for campsite visitors. The campsite has plenty for the entire family to do as well, having a playground and water sports activities.

Children’s and disabled toilet facilities

You camp on grass here with the pitches distributed over the level camp grounds. The pitches are separated by hedges and there is always a water tap nearby. You can also stay in a bungalow tent or mobile home. All accommodations have a partially covered terrace and terrace furniture and are separated by hedges.

Camping along the Atlantic Ocean

The Atlantic Ocean is 500 metres from the campsite and is easy to reach using a footpath, making this ideal for a wonderful day at the beach. The campsite has a covered recreational area with a table football table and a pool table. For children, there is a playground, a trampoline and a bouncy castle. Naturally, this French campsite has a jeu de boules court. During the high season, the entertainment team organises activities such as a pancake night, a jeu de boules tournament or a communal barbecue. The baker also comes to the campsite daily with fresh rolls during the high season. A food truck comes to the campsite two evenings a week.

properties.name: Camping Le Paradis
properties.description:
Camping near the Mediterranean beaches of Valras-Plage, but away from the crowds and mass tourism. Does this sound like music to your ears? Then Le Paradis in Sérignan Campsite is your ideal campsite. You will discover complete relaxation at this green, friendly and small-scale spot. The hospitable managers have created a flowery paradise here with a swimming pool, jacuzzi and restaurant. An excellent base for cycling trips to the beach or a visit to Béziers or Montpellier.

A green oasis

The campsite itself is located on a wonderfully green and park-like site with lots of flowers and lovely details. Clearly a lot of care has been put into it. You can hear the birds chirping cheerfully here but it is also wonderfully quiet. The campsite is small in scale, with just under 90 touring pitches, 13 permanent pitches and 23 mobile homes. The camping pitches and mobile homes are in separate areas, so you really have an old-fashioned camping atmosphere here.

The camping pitches are sufficiently spacious, even for campers and caravans, and the sanitary facilities are extremely neat and clean. All of this is very much appreciated by the guests. You can also find campers here who have been coming for years. The campsite attracts many seniors and peace seekers. Families can also be found here during the high season.

Swimming pool with jacuzzi

Of course, water recreation is also part of any holiday in the South of France. Le Paradis also provides for this. The beautiful outdoor pool is open from the beginning of May to the end of September. There is also a waterslide for the children and a lifeguard on duty.

properties.name: Camping Municipal de Loupian
properties.description:
The Languedoc-Roussillon is one of the largest wine areas in France. The area, stretching from the shores of the Rhône to the Spanish border, enjoys a dry climate and plenty of sun. Ideal for creating lovely wines and for holidaymakers who love the sun. On Camping Municipal Loupian, you're extremely well-placed for enjoying the sun, the wine, and the beautiful region. For example, you could head to the Gallo-Roman Museum in Loupian, where in addition to a villa, a whole range of archaeological finds can be viewed.

Spacious campsite

The terrain of the municipal campsite looks good and is well-organised. You drive to your pitch on semi-paved paths. The camping pitches are spacious, and tidily demarcated by trees. This means that they still offer plenty of privacy.

The facilities here are fairly standard. This means that there is no swimming pool. As a result the site is very quiet, and ideal for seekers of peace.

Time for a snack

Take-away meals can be obtained from the snack bar, and a few simple menus are on offer. You can also dine on the terrace. The service is friendly. Camping Municipal Loupian does not feature any shops. Head to Mèze, two and a half kilometres further on, for a supermarket.

The Thau Lake and charming coastal villages

Not far from the campsite you can find the Thau Lake, a vast lagoon connected with the Mediterranean Sea. Oysters and shellfish are cultivated in the inland lake. Coastal villages such as Mèze, Bouzigues, Balaruc-les-Bains, Sète and Marseillan can be found around the lake. Here you can stroll along the waterfront, taste the local atmosphere and enjoy the beautiful views.

properties.name: Camping Village du Parc
properties.description:
Camping du Parc is located directly on Lake Garda, one and a half kilometers from the beautiful Lazise. Here you can camp on a touring pitch close to the beach. But you can also choose a luxury mobile home or chalet with a view of the water. In the restaurant at Lake Garda you can enjoy a lovely pizza. The sunset and the view give your Italian holiday some extra atmosphere. Dive into Lake Garda, take the banana boat or walk to the historic center of Lazise.

Camping on Lake Garda

For every camper there is a suitable place to be found on this campsite at Lake Garda. Walk over the sloping terrain towards the water and you'll see smaller, but also large touring pitches. Do you really want to enjoy Lake Garda? Then choose a pitch directly at the beach. You can also camp in modern mobile homes or luxury chalets. Many of these accommodations have their own TV connection, air conditioning and spacious private sanitary facilities. And a view over Lake Garda of course!

Swimming in Lake Garda

Fancy a dip in the water? From your pitch you can be in Lake Garda within a few seconds. The campsite is situated on a long beach where you can sunbathe. In for an adventure on the water? Then take a bicycle boat or banana boat onto the lake. You can also enjoy a relaxing swim in the swimming pool located at the entrance to the campsite. The swimming pool is simple, but large. There is a nice children's pool with slides next to it.

properties.name: Camping Essenza Alpina
properties.description:
Campsite Essenza Alpina is in a wooded area near the village of Folgaria, in the heart of northern Italian Trentino. With its luxury facilities and extensive wellness centre, this campsite has the feel of a real mountain resort. From your spacious pitch, you will enjoy great views of Folgaria and the surrounding mountains. Winter sports enthusiasts flock to this campsite in the winter; it’s close to the Alpe Cimbra ski area.

Neat terrace pitches and luxury chalets

When you arrive, you will notice the chic main building. The campsite is behind it and has neat terraces that slope downwards. Would you like to be close to the main building and all its facilities? Then choose a comfort or comfort-XL pitch. Would you prefer to be close to the forest? Then choose a Nature pitch (also available in XL), lower on the site. You could also book a stay in a luxury chalet.

Relaxation and entertainment in the main building

The main building plays a central role on the campsite. Its facilities include luxury sanitary facilities, a mini-market and a great children's playroom with building blocks and (in high season) a kids' club for campers aged 4 and above. Teenagers will have fun at the Junior Club, where I-Wall, an interactive play wall, is particularly popular. There is also a luxury wellness centre with a Finnish sauna, steam bath, massage room, a relaxation room and a herbal room. An expert sauna master is on hand for advice on creating the sauna that best suits your specific needs. Also visit the Essenza Alpina Bar, for an authentic Trentino breakfast, a tasty lunch or a delicious appetiser, etc.

properties.name: Campingplatz Ostsee Katharinenhof
properties.description:
At the sunny north coast of Germany lies the island of Fehmarn. Within cycling distance of the town of Burg, in a very unique location, lies Campingplatz Ostsee Katharinenhof. Surrounded by nature and directly at the sea is the well-tended campsite where young and old enjoy the space and peace.

A few steps to the beach

As soon as you reach the well laid-out campsite, you will feel the relaxed mood and you will instantly see the homely reception building. Via a short footpath through the woods you will reach the quiet sandy beach. On the camping square you will find a small supermarket and the restaurant with a cosy terrace.

Camping on spacious pitches

The friendly character of the campsite is expressed in the neat green landscaping. Campers make the most of the favourable location at the side of the island where there is less wind. The sanitary facilities are well looked after and heated. There are specially adapted sanitary facilities for children. People with disabilities can also use adapted facilities in the same building.

Animals and play grounds

Animals are well loved at Campingplatz Ostsee Katharinenhof Dogs are welcome and on the grounds there are goats and a donkey. There are also small ponies for children to ride. Teenagers and adults will enjoy nature tours. The three play grounds on the camping will provide hours of fun.

Diving in the German sea

Apart from walking and cycling, the Baltic Sea is also an ideal location for water sports enthusiasts. Campingplatz Ostsee Katharinenhof is the only campsite on the island with a diving school and an oxygen filling station. Together with an experienced instructor beginning and experienced divers can explore the wonderful underwater world.

properties.name: Camping La Vologne
properties.description:
La Vologne is a medium-sized campsite in a natural setting, where you can enjoy relaxed camping. The stream that runs through the middle of the site is suitable for playing in. Are you looking for more fun in the water? The nearby Longemer lake is just a few minutes away on foot. These areas are spacious and surrounded by greenery.

On the banks of a stream

The spacious visitor parking area is just a few steps away from the reception, where the hospitable owner will bid you a warm welcome. You can check in at a classic reception with a wide range of folders about all kinds of activities in the region.

The campsite is very spacious and is located across both banks of the Vologne stream. The different camping pitches are separated from each other by spacious green zones. The surface for your tent or caravan consists of well maintained grass. You can select a pitch yourself, and the most beautiful ones are on the banks of the river.

Playing in the stream

The river, which is more of a stream, is ideal for children to play in, to paddle in and to skim stones. After a couple of minutes' walk in the Vologne valley, you will reach the banks of the lake. On the banks of sand, grass and gravel you can sunbathe or go for a refreshing swim.

There is a playground with trampoline and you can also get active on the jeu-de-boules track or on the sports field (soccer and volleyball).

Daily necessities

There is a small shop for necessities. You can also get fresh bread from the shop each day.

properties.name: Recreatiepark De Voorst
properties.description:
Recreatiepark De Voorst is in the heart of the beautiful Voorsterbos (Flevoland). With its ponds and ditches and its location near the Zwolse Vaart canal, this is a water-rich campsite. The park is also surrounded by forests with great hiking and cycling routes. With children's entertainment in high season, an excellent restaurant, multiple playgrounds and an outdoor pool plus paddling pool, this is an ideal holiday address for families with (young) children.

Beautiful camping fields and luxury accommodation

This campsite has a fantastic mix of accommodation and great fields with tourist pitches. Basic and comfort pitches are available for campers. Comfort pitches have 16 amps of electricity (instead of 10) and a private water tap. It’s also good to know that this campsite has a pet-free field. One more thing about accommodation: you can rent modern lodges and chalets here.

Plenty of opportunities for children to play

The youngest campers won't get bored for a moment on this campsite. There are two large playgrounds and two bouncy castles, and play equipment on all camping fields. Recreatiepark De Voorst also has an outdoor swimming pool, as well as a paddling pool with water mushroom next to it. You can also take a refreshing dip in the Zwolse Vaart from the swimming dock. This canal is also a good place to go boating or paddleboarding. There are also a whole range of fun activities for children. These include ghost walks, musicals, children's discos. Restaurant Buitengewoon De Voorst serves tasty lunches and extensive dinners.

properties.name: Camping Tamaro Resort
properties.description:
Holidays by the water and mountains everywhere you look. That's camping at Camping Tamaro Resort! You will find this campsite on Lake Maggiore in Switzerland. The campsite lies directly on the banks of this part of this impressive lake and has its own beach. The popular city of Locarno is nine kilometres away. You can take the boat there and back for free. Are you coming here to camp?

Sleeping under the stars

The grounds are neatly arranged and well maintained. There are pitches for campers, (igloo) tents and caravans. But maybe you prefer one of the modern bungalows. The pitches are spacious and shaded by trees. The Tamaro Night Sky accommodation is very atmospheric. This cube-shaped accommodation with glass ceiling is made to make the most of the starry sky. Romantic!

Yoga, Zumba and archery

There is enough to do at Camping Tamaro Resort to keep you entertained all day. Learn to juggle, let your children do crafts or go wild at the Kids Dance. For adults, there is also a lot to experience, such as yoga, Zumba, archery or SUPping. There is a playground for children and a sports field for adults. Workshops are also organized, such as making jewellery with gemstones.

Free swimming pool and beach

Would you like to take a dive in the pool or swim in the lake? You can do both! There is no other swimming pool at the campsite, but guests of Tamaro Resort can dive in the adjacent public pool for free in high season. The campsite does have its own sand and pebble beach on Lake Maggiore. In the summer, you will also find a small bar for a cool snack.

properties.name: Camping Vreehorst
properties.description:
Camping at campsite Vreehorst means camping in one of the most beautiful parts of the Achterhoek. The campsite is quiet, you have a nice and spacious pitch and good sanitary facilities. The area is beautiful and there is lots to do. You can cycle or walk through the characteristic Achterhoek scenic landscape. Or visit Winterswijk, only 3 km away.

Spacious pitches

The pitches are not demarcated and vary in size (100 - 140 m2). The pitches are divided over various wooded camping fields offering a view of the beautiful countryside of the Achterhoek. You will usually be allocated a spacious comfort pitch. Persons preferring some extra luxury can reserve a comfort pitch with private sanitary facilities. Some of the pitches overlook a small lake in the far northwest corner of the campsite. You can rent safari tents and chalets on the camping grounds.

There are two sanitary buildings made of brick. Each building is of a very modern and sustainable design and has a luxurious look. There is a separate children sanitary section with cheerful colours.

Entertainment team during school holidays

In high season the camping attracts mainly families from the Netherlands. Small children enjoy themselves in the sand, on the jumping cushion or on the exciting, high playground slide. During the school holidays an entertainment team organises fun activities for children up to age 12. On rainy days they enjoy themselves in the covered playground.

The campsite has an outdoor as well as an indoor swimming pool, so you can swim whenever you want. Furthermore, there is a small Finnish sauna where you can totally relax. Next to the swimming pool is a restaurant with a lively terrace.

properties.name: Camping L'Océan
properties.description:
Camping L’Océan is located in the west of the Vendée, not far from the Atlantic coast Within a fifteen minutes walk you're on the beach. This large family campsite has mainly rental accommodation: you can stay in one of the mobile homes or lodges, some of which even have a private whirlpool. With a restaurant, entertainment for young and old and a large outdoor swimming pool, this campsite has plenty to offer.

Mobile homes and lodges

On this campsite the scene is mainly set by mobile homes. No less than 265 rental accommodations are nicely spread throughout the campsite. Book a stay in a mobile home or lodge. For those who come with own camping equipment there are spacious touring pitches available. These are separated by hedges. Tall trees provide some shade.

Entertainment for everyone

During the summer months, there is entertainment for everyone. The little ones can participate in the kids club, while sports competitions are organised for the slightly older youth. In the evenings there are regular music and theatre shows.

Swimming paradise

The pavement cafe looks out over the outdoor pool. This large pool, complete with pirate ship, slides and paddling pool, is decorated with palm trees and has a beautiful sun deck. But that's not all. In addition the campsite also has a true swimming paradise. In this covered complex with lagoon, whirlpool and slides, designed with rocks, footbridges and Mediterranean plants, you can swim and play for hours.

properties.name: Camping Le Vaudois
properties.description:
Camping Le Vaudois is situated just four kilometres away from the wonderful beaches at Saint-Aygulf. The terrain is perfect: quiet and right by the sea. You can cycle to the Fréjus coast in just ten minutes. The campsite is popular with guests in search of sun and peace. The campsite is located in Roquebrune-sur-Argens, a medieval Provençal village.

Welcome!

The campsite is a green oasis of peace. Trees provide plenty of shade. The pitches are in a spacious, beautiful setting. The campsite is well maintained and primarily visited by families with children. This is remarkable as there is no organised entertainment. In turn, the prices are lower than in the similar campsites in the area. 

Comfortable mobile homes

You can hire a range of mobile homes (with covered terrace) at the campsite, suitable for up to four people. The accommodations are complete, with a kitchen featuring a refrigerator-freezer, hob and microwave. There are two bedrooms, each with a bathroom and shower, with sink and a separate toilet.

A refreshing dip

Because it's still a few kilometres by bike to the sea and beach, it's handy that the campsite features its own swimming pool with a surrounding spacious terrace. This allows you to take a refreshing dip. In addition, you can drive to the Saint-Aygulf beach, four kilometres away. This location features free parking.

Pizzas and snacks

You won't be searching for a nice restaurant on the Côte d’Azur for long. That's why you won't find a restaurant at Le Vaudois. However, you can order pizza and snacks at the campsite.

properties.name: Les Châtaigniers Camping
properties.description:
The small-scale, attractive campsite Les Châtaigniers is situated in a quiet spot in the touristy south of the Ardèche, not far from the hot spots in the region: Vallon Pont d’Arc and the Gorges de l’Ardèche. It is surrounded by vineyards and the village of Laurac-en-Vivarais is within walking distance. The lively, picturesque village of Joyeuse is also located in the vicinity.

Chestnut trees

The first thing you will notice on the campsite is the beautiful large chestnut trees, providing ample shade and a natural demarcation on the older section. The lower section of the campsite is demarcated by hedges. The pitches measure between 80 and 120 m2. The surface is very firm. Want to hire something? A few neat mobile homes, some with covered terraces, are apart from the tourist pitches.

Elegant swimming pool

There is an elegantly shaped swimming pool with separate toddler pool and numerous sun loungers scattered here and there in shady spots. The water is extremely clean. If you are looking for open water, you can swim in the river in a lovely spot with a sandy beach near the medieval artist village of Labeaume (approx. 11 km).

Jeu-de-boule

There is a small playground, a large jeu-de-boule pitch and a table tennis table. There is no entertainment offered so that it is nice and peaceful. There is no restaurant or shop. However, you can buy a cool drink or an ice cream at the reception. The pizza baker passes by once a week with delicious pizzas. A bread service is also available.

Sanitary facilities

The open sanitary facilities are neat and are cleaned twice a day. There are special facilities for babies and disabled guests.

properties.name: Camping La Plaine
properties.description:
The Ardèche is known for its lovely nature, old towns and atmospheric cities. Above all the impressive cliffs along the river and the naturally-formed arched bridge at Vallon-Pont-d'Arc are very well known. The area around the village of Joyeuse is less touristy, but certainly not less lovely. Here you'll find Camping La Plaine, your quiet base for a fantastic holiday.

Nicely maintained and plenty of greenery

Everything on this campsite is nicely maintained. The hedges are cut evenly and the grass is carefully mowed. The property is lovely and green. There are trees all over the camping fields, so there is always plenty of shade. The camping pitches are spacious, not too close to each other and easily accessible on paved roads.

Lovely rental accommodations

There are also a number of types of mobile homes for rent on the property. The rental accommodations are located on a separate street in the middle of grass and greenery. They all look lovely and are fantastically maintained.

Inviting swimming pool

Two round playfully formed swimming pools and a kiddie pool are inviting. Around them there is a spacious terrace with loungers and thatched parasols. There is a jacuzzi section in one of the pools. There is a little lake at the edge of the campsite. Here you can't swim, but you can fish.

Pizzeria with lovely terrace

There is a bar with a little indoor space. You can still get something to eat at the pizzeria. Outside there is a lovely terrace surrounded by buildings where you can eat your meal in a nice atmosphere.

properties.name: Camping Paradis Les Nobis d'Anjou
properties.description:
The four star campsite Les Nobis d’Anjou is ideally situated on the crossroad between the Anjou, Touraine en Poitour regions, only 15 km from the town of Saumur. You can enjoy a lovely holiday on a 3 ha campsite on the banks of the Thouet, at the foot of the castle of Montreuil-Bellay.

Pitches and accommodation

The campsite has a nice reception with ample tourist information about the area. There are spacious pitches which provide ample shade. The owners are investing in more greenery, entertainment and sanitary facilities. The campsite has around 50 rental accommodations.

Swimming and sunbathing

Camping Les Nobis d’Anjou has a fairly modest pool, which is still lovely, also because of the view of the castle. It is surrounded by ample loungers on which to soak up the sun. Moreover, the attractive lounge terrace is located under the trees at the entrance of the campsite.

Museums

In the immediate vicinity of the campsite you can, of course, visit the various attractions of Montreuil. Also nice: visit the Cadre Noir of Saumur (the oldest still existing riding school for equestrian sports in France) or the Musée de la Cavalerie (cavalry museum).

properties.name: Camping le Tedey
properties.description:
You will find Camping Le Tedey in the heart of the famous coastal resort of Lacanau, France's ultimate surfing spot. Le Tedey is the ideal place for a relaxed camping holiday among the trees and by the water. This child friendly campsite is on the banks of Lake Lacanau, only a stone's throw from the Atlantic Ocean. The many water sports options mean the campsite is extremely popular among families with teenagers.

Vast choice of pitches & accommodation

The site at Le Tedey is in a large pine forest and offers plenty of choice of the various camping pitches and luxury holiday homes, such as mobile homes, tiny houses and lodge tents. The special thing here is that you can choose a premium pitch. That is a pitch with a hut that looks like a little garden house containing a small kitchen with tableware and a fridge. You also get comfortable garden furniture at this pitch. Ideal for campers with a tent!

Water sports adventures

There may not be a swimming pool at this campsite, but camping Le Tedey's location right by the lake and close to the sea is perfect for doing many water-based activities. Stand-up paddleboarding, canoeing, sailing and surfing in particular are popular here. At the campsite there are two gently sloping beaches with a sailing and surfing school that also rents out pedal boats and sailing boats. If you feel like swimming in the Atlantic Ocean, the beach at Lacanau Plagebeac is only 7 kilometres away. You can cycle there in about 30 minutes via a lovely route through a forest.

properties.name: Camping Parc du Val de l'Eyre
properties.description:
Camping Parc du Val de l’Eyre is in the French department of Gironde. You camp on the outskirts of a large wooded area and by the Leyre river. The village of Salles is within walking distance, and a large supermarket is located directly across from the campsite. During the high season, the entertainment team organises activities daily for the entire family. There is also a swimming pool, a playground for the youngest campsite visitors and various sports options. The surrounding area will lure you to go out and enjoy all that Gironde has to offer.

Spacious, park-like camping grounds

At Camping Parc du Val de l’Eyre, you camp on spacious grassy pitches that are at least 100m². The pitches are demarcated by low hedges. The spacious grounds have lots of trees, providing shade as well as a park-like ambiance. The pitches are interspersed with rental accommodations. You can also stay in a mobile home, chalet, gypsy wagon or teepee.

What is there to do?

Camping Parc du Val de l’Eyre has a lot to offer its campsite visitors. The swimming pool provides hours of fun for young and old. Go for a refreshing swim, go down the slide or play at the man-made beach with its pirate ship and inflatable play castle. The restaurant with terrace is almost right next to the swimming pool. Snacks and local dishes can be ordered here daily. The Leyre river, which flows behind the campsite, invites you to go canoeing, kayaking or fishing. For children there is a playground, an entertainment programme during the high season and a petting zoo.

properties.name: Camping L'Île de la Comtesse
properties.description:
In the green hilly valley of the Rhône you'll find the child-friendly campsite Île de la Comtesse in a regal position: on Lake Cuchet at the foot of the rugged Alps range. Enjoy the lovely mountain air, the quiet atmosphere and the special sights in the area (a wild animal park, the waterfalls at Glandieu and Lyon).

Lake view

The property looks spacious, is organized and well maintained. There are many trees providing shade. The spacious sites separated by greenery are set up along long streets. The sites have grassy ground, and some have a view of the lake. Want to rent something? You can choose between mobile homes, wooden chalets and bungalow tents.

Water pleasure

Kid's always have fun when there's water around. You can choose between the heated swimming pool with water slide and Lake Cuchet. They've even thought about toddlers, with a pool, little slide and mushroom. Are the older kids coming too? They'll have a great time. They can windsurf and waterski on the lake.

Mini club for children

There is a playground, a sports field, a panna field, facilities for poor weather and cycle hire. There are also Dutch language activities for all ages, such as a daily mini club where children can do crafts and sports.

Restaurants

There are several restaurants in and around the campsite. A small selection of groceries and the bread service are available in the shop at the reception.

properties.name: Camping Des Grands Cols
properties.description:
Des Grands Cols campsite is located in the shade of the high mountains of the Savoie. A real campsite for cycling enthusiasts who want to conquer the infamous Alpine cols of the Tour de France. Des Grands Cols campsite is also a good starting point for mountain hikers and motorcyclists. On this neat, small-scale campsite you can camp on spacious pitches between trees and hedges in a green, relaxing environment. And always with that beautiful view of the 'grands cols'.

Camping pitches with shade

The camping fields bear the names of the cols and each contain about eight to ten pitches, mainly for caravans. These pitches are spacious and often in the shade of trees and hedges. For tents and campers there are separate, slightly smaller pitches. Sometimes you will see a special hiker's cabin among the pitches, but most of the rental accommodations are located on the higher part of the campsite.

Cycling, hiking boots and motorcycle helmets

The majority of campsite visitors consist of avid cycling enthusiasts who are eager to climb the mountains by bicycle or mountain bike. But the mountain landscape is also a paradise for hikers and motorcyclists. At Des Grands Cols campsite, you will also come across many hiking boots and motorcycle helmets.

Restaurants in Saint-Jean-de-Maurienne

In the restaurant at the reception, you can satisfy your worst cravings with small dishes and snacks. For a more extensive meal there are nice, cosy restaurants to be found in Saint-Jean-de-Maurienne, just a ten-minute walk away. This is the perfect place for your daily shopping.

Sanitary building

There is only one toilet building at the back of the campsite grounds but for the eighty pitches, this is enough.

properties.name: Flower Camping Les Rives de l'Aygues
properties.description:
Camping Les Rives de l'Aygues is a campsite located in the countryside, right on the river L'Aigue. It is situated in a flat area, in a small forest and on the edge of vast vineyards. You'll camp on a well maintained site with a nice swimming pool, a good quality restaurant and a number of lovely camping pitches by the river.

Private and romantic touring pitches

The camping pitches of Les Rives de l'Aygues are particularly beautiful and offer a lot of privacy thanks to a small boundary created by bushes and hedges. There is plenty of shade provided by the tall trees. The touring pitches vary greatly in size: the largest measure no less than 300 square metres! Romantic pitches can be found right next to the river.

Water fun in swimming pool and river

The swimming pool of this campsite is over 14 meters long. This is an ideal place to play or to swim some laps. Even when the weather is not so good, because the pool is heated. The youngest campers have fun in water play area. In the summer the river has a lower water level so bathing is possible.

Musical theme evenings

In the high season, occasionally theme evenings are organised by the campsite management. Music plays a prominent role. DJ's, singers and various musicians create a festive atmosphere.

Eating out on the campsite

In the restaurant you can also enjoy a tasty meal, such as homemade pizzas, salads and meat dishes. Furthermore, the (snack) bar with its pavement café overlooking the pool is very inviting.

properties.name: Camping Beau Rivage
properties.description:
Camping Beau Rivage is a charming family campground with many activities for children. The campground is located in the midst of mountainous southern France in the French department of Gard, that borders the Ardèche.

Provençal atmosphere

The camping has a convivial, Provençal atmosphere. The fact that the campground owners speak Dutch makes communication that much easier. The campground is playfully designed with spacious pitches. Each site is a little bit different than the others. Many pitches have a view of the river Le Gardon. There are mobile homes for rent for extra comfort.

Playful fields

The varied fields are occupied by families in the summer. There are many sport and play activities organised for children, such as looking for gold and fishing in Le Gardon. In the low season, the focus is on the older generation. They can enjoy music and jeu-de-boules. The campground has its own swimming pool, central between the reception and the large covered terrace. The swimming pool can be seen from everywhere, and parents can easily keep an eye on their playing children. If you want to get out, you can walk and cycle in the natural surroundings of the campground.

Fantastic pizzas At the reception, there is a small shop where you can get the necessities. In Lezan, 3 km further you can do the rest of your shopping. The restaurant is known for its fantastic pizzas. On the charming terrace, you have a view of the swimming pool and part of the campground. The sanitation facility is beautiful and clean. Music provides a lovely atmosphere.

properties.name: Camping Pilù
properties.description:
Campsite Pilù is right by Lake Idro, in the south of the Italian Alps. This friendly family campsite has lakeside pitches with views of the surrounding mountains. Peace-seekers can relax at the campsite, where guests are served free pasta every summer Friday evening and can join in the karaoke.

Camping by the lake

Campsite Pilù is located right on the shore of Lake Idro. A large, tree-filled grass field has more than 170 shaded touring pitches. Not all pitches are the same size and the lack of demarcation means there’s little privacy sometimes. However, there are also bigger touring pitches. Every pitch on the camping field has a wonderful view of Lake Idro and the green mountains. The view of the surrounding area is also beautiful from the balconies of the apartments in the white buildings.

Lake Idro

The campsite pools are located close to reception. These pools, one shallow, the other slightly deeper, are not very large. But they do give campers a chance to take a dip and cool down. Lake Idro is perfect for this too. Just a fence separates the campsite from the lake and a small beach. Besides swimming, options on the lake include pedalos, windsurfing and canoeing.

Pasta evenings with karaoke

In the summer months, campsite Pilù guests can enjoy a free plate of pasta (if they buy a drink) every Friday evening. This creates a friendly, cosy atmosphere and campers can join in the karaoke after eating together.

properties.name: Camping International Touring
properties.description:
Camping International Touring is situated in the North Italian Aosta Valley. The campsite pitches, not all clearly demarcated, are mostly located under trees which provide ample shade. This is not the case at the outdoor pool and surrounding sunbathing lawn where the sun has free rein. The campsite also has a small playground for children and a tennis court for the sport enthusiasts. The campsite restaurant serves delicious pizzas, baked in a traditional wood-fired oven.

Camping under the trees

The large number of trees on the grounds create a feeling of being in the forest.  Due to the limited demarcation between the pitches, you are fairly free in the choice of where to set up camp. As a result, you may find that you have somewhat less privacy in the peak season. However, you camp amidst nature with the sound of chirping birds in the background.

Don't have camping equipment? Other than vacant campsite pitches, you can also rent mobile homes and bungalows on the campsite.

Enjoy the water fun

Camping International Touring has a tennis court and a playground with play equipment for children. In high season, there is an entertainment team for the young guests and you can take a dive in the outdoor swimming pool. The swimming pool is located in an open space with lots of sunlight, a view of the mountains and has a spacious sunbathing lawn with loungers. After your dive you can rinse off and freshen up in the renovated sanitary buildings where you will find neat and modern facilities. 

Venture into the surroundings!

Explore the beautiful nature around the campsite and go on a walk or cycling trip, for instance in the nearby Parco nazionale del Gran Paradiso.

properties.name: Camping Bel Air
properties.description:
This campsite is in a green area, just outside the atmospheric Les Sables-d'Olonne, one of the most beautiful seaside resorts in the Vendée. This town's historic centre and large sandy beach are only a few kilometres away. You can also take beautiful forest walks near the Bel Air Campsite and participate in various water sports activities. You will also have a great time at the campsite itself. There is entertainment all year round, the beautiful indoor and outdoor swimming pools are open every day, and there are numerous sports and leisure facilities.

Spacious grass pitches and luxury rentals

Bel Air is a neat, well-maintained campsite with lots of vegetation. There are many rental accommodations such as studios, cottages and mobile homes, some of which even have their own hot tub. The tourist camping pitches are neatly grouped at the front of the site. The pitches are spacious, grassy and separated by neat hedges. Large pines and oaks provide shade.

Aqua park with full indoor and outdoor pool

This campsite has a beautiful aqua park. For fun in the sun, there's a large outdoor swimming pool. Do you think it's a bit too cold to swim outside? Don't worry, because there is also an indoor swimming pool. Like the outdoor pool, the indoor pool has a whirlpool, a spectacular water slide and a paddling pool with water games.

Animation and other entertainment all year round

Many activities are organised at this campsite from May to November. Think of workshops, sports competitions and tournaments and accessible theme parties. Some activities are especially for the children.

properties.name: Camping Passeier
properties.description:
The Passeier campsite is located in the middle of South Tyrol’s mountains among green apple orchards. This Italian campsite at the foot of the Hirzerberg is surrounded by beautiful wooded mountains. The campsite is located just after the Jaufenpass. Not far away (10 km), you will find Meran – also called Merano.

Staying overnight on a family farm

You will find pitches between 80 and 100 m². They are neat and tidy. Scattered over the campsite are several trees, which provide the necessary shade. There are paved areas for campers. If you like to have your own bathroom, you can rent a private one. The campsite also has several renovated apartments in a family farmhouse.

Swimming with a view

After a hike on the Hirzerberg or a mountain bike ride to Merano, you’ll probably be ready for a nice swim! There is a small but cosy swimming pool near the reception. There is an outdoor pool, a covered area, and a children’s pool. From here, you have a beautiful view of the mountains. On the campsite, you will also find a wellness area for wonderful massages, a supermarket with local products, and a café-restaurant with pizzeria.

Up with the cable car or e-biking to Merano

Of course, you can enjoy hiking in the mountains. Take the cable car to Hirzer or visit the historical centre of Meran(o). You can also reach this city with an e-bike rented at the campsite. In the spa town, you will find Theme Merano, a wellness centre with thermal baths, saunas, and a spa. Great for a day of relaxation!

properties.name: Camping La Grande Vallée
properties.description:
In the southern Vendée on the Atlantic Ocean, in the vicinity of Les Sables d’Olonne (40 km) and La Rochelle (60 km), you will find the lively seaside town of La Tranche-sur-Mer. Here you can look forward to a large number of restaurants and there are shops galore. There also is a daily market. It is here that you will find campsite La Grande Vallée, located between the trees and only 700 m away from the sea, with a lovely sandy beach.

Campsite

It is a rather small, but generally busy campsite with many touring pitches and some mobile homes. The campsite is well maintained and exudes an easygoing atmosphere. The touring pitches are more or less demarcated, in rows between trees, rather spacious, with sun or shade. Most pitches are sufficiently spacious to accommodate a car and caravan and have a grassed surface. In addition to mobile homes, there are also some canvas bungalows for hire.

Camping La Grande Vallée attracts a wide range of nationalities, obviously the French, but also some English, Dutch, Belgian and German guests. Both young families and slightly older guests.

Beach

The campsite does not have its own swimming pool, but it is only a 600 m walk on a tarred road to the beach of the Atlantic Ocean (be careful when crossing the road).

Activities

There is little entertainment: 2x weekly in high season only for children up to 12 years of age. There is also a weekly jeu de boule competition for adults (with participants from surrounding campsites).

Sanitary facilities

The sanitary facilities are new, always immaculately clean and well maintained. There are sufficient toilets and showers for the number of pitches.

properties.name: Camping Stel - Roda de Berà
properties.description:
The Stel campsite is located on the Spanish east coast in Catalonia, between Barcelona and Tarragona. Find a place in the sun or in the shade of the tall palm trees. Wherever you pitch your tent, you'll be camping almost directly on the beach here. You just have to cross the road and you can dive into the Mediterranean Sea. With its extensive swimming paradise, Mediterranean restaurant and full entertainment programme, the Stel campsite offers a complete camping holiday for young and old.

Camping under the palm trees

Palm trees are everywhere on the large campsite. 520 camping pitches and 80 permanent annual pitches are laid out between the trees. Every pitch has its advantages. If you are at the front of the campsite, you don't have to walk far to the swimming paradise. If you are camped at the rear of the site, you can almost smell the Mediterranean Sea. You will find the rental accommodations on a separate section at the front.

Family campsite with animation

You're at the right address for a beach holiday at this campsite. Due to a full entertainment programme, you will mainly find families with children in the high season. Shows and music performances are regularly held on the central square of the campsite, also for the little ones. While the youngest campers have fun with the mini club, the older kids can enjoy themselves during sports competitions and beach games.

Swimming paradise

The swimming paradise is located behind the reception, close to the entrance. Here you can swim in various large swimming pools. Fake rocks, tall palm trees and thatched parasols create a Mediterranean atmosphere. The small swimmers have plenty of room in the spacious paddling pools with slides and water play equipment. The older kids will want to brave the big water slide.

properties.name: Flower Camping Le Plan d'Eau
properties.description:
Mountainous landscapes, meandering rivers, historical little towns and lovely weather every day: this typifies the Ardèche region. This is the setting of the peaceful, wooded Flower Camping Le Plan d'Eau. The campsite is in a beautiful location along the river, with a view of the mountains. The old town of Aubenas and the renowned Vallon Pont d’Arc are not far away. A top location for nature lovers and outdoor sports enthusiasts.

Leafy grounds

There is a long avenue from the entrance to the river. The shaded pitches are located along straight side streets off this avenue. The demarcation with hedges offers ample privacy. Some of the pitches are situated along the river, and who knows, you may still find a top spot there. You can choose between standard pitches (approx. 100 m2) or XL-pitches (130 m2). Want to hire something? The rental accommodations (chalets and safari tents) are situated close to the entrance.

Swimming in the Ardèche or the swimming pool

The campsite is situated directly on the Ardèche river. There is an artificial beach with chairs. It is suitable for swimming (provided the water level is not too low), but the river is not suitable for canoeing near the campsite. However, you can float around on an inflatable boat or an air bed. Canoeing is possible in Vallon Pont d’Arc (30 km).

Sports and eating out

Children are guaranteed to enjoy themselves on the campsite. Features: a multi-sports field, table tennis tables, playground, jeu-de-boule pitch and entertainment. At the reception is a small shop for daily necessities (fresh bread). Taking things easy today? The camping restaurant has a limited menu and a terrace in the shade. In high season, takeaway meals are available.

properties.name: Camping Yelloh! Village Domaine de l'Esquiras
properties.description:
Camping Domaine de l’Esquiras is a family-friendly campsite in the Ardèche, within walking distance of the centre of Vallon-Pont-d’Arc. The campsite is situated close to the Ardèche river, which is suitable for canoeing, rafting and swimming. With only about one hundred pitches and rental accommodation units in total, the amicable atmosphere on the campsite is guaranteed.

At the campsite you are warmly welcomed by Stéphanie and Rémi. They accompany you to your camping pitch and ensure that you can look forward to a lovely holiday. Furthermore, they can give you advice about outings, because they know the area like the back of their hand.

For all

Almost everyone will find something to their liking at campsite Domaine de l’Esquiras; the seekers of peace and quiet, who can walk or cycle in the area, families with children with a wide range of activities on the campsite, and sports enthusiasts who will get their money's worth on the Ardèche river and in the numerous caves in the region.

Swimming

The campsite has an outdoor pool and -as only campsite of Vallon-Pont-d’Arc- an indoor swimming pool. There is also a children's pool. There is plenty of room for sunbathing near the swimming pools. While the children glide down the slides, you can laze around and relax.

On and around the campsite

During summer, many activities are organised on the campsite. Treasure hunts, sports tournaments and disco evenings are organised at the kids club (for children aged 5-12). Sports activities, 'mussel evenings' and pub quizzes are organised for adults.

properties.name: Camping Kervilor
properties.description:
Camping Kervilor lies in a quiet location in the vicinity of the towns of La Trinité-sur-Mer and Carnac. It is a large, but well structured campsite, hidden in the forests. The spacious pitches are partly in the sun and partly in the shade. Opt to stand close to the swimming pool and the playground or in a very quiet spot at the back.

Children's Paradise Kervilor

Camping Kervilor is very popular with young families. There are good reasons for this: a beautiful newly (2017) constructed playground with colourful equipment, bouncy castles, a mini golf course, trampolines, a multi sports terrain, table tennis tables and much more! In short: families with (small) children will think of this as a veritable children's paradise. The campsite also has a very enthusiastic entertainment team.

Swimming fun for the entire family

To top it all, there are several swimming pools, slides and a jacuzzi. There are two covered swimming pools: one for adults and one for children. In between these pools is a large jacuzzi. In addition, there is an outdoor pool with several slides. The complex is surrounded by a sunny terrace with loungers and palm trees providing shade. A real tropical swimming paradise!

All kinds of activities

The campsite organises various activities, such as an afternoon of climbing and scrambling in the tree tops of Forêt Adrénaline Carnac, a boat trip in the Gulf of Morbihan, or an outing from Quiberon to the island of Belle-Île, located off the coast of Brittany.

Snacks, drinks and ice creams

There is a small shop with essential items as fresh bread. You will find a range of other shops and supermarkets in La Trinité-sur-Mer. The campsite cafeteria offers snacks, drinks and ice creams.

properties.name: Camping La Charderie
properties.description:
Camping La Charderie is situated on the green, wood-covered banks of the Ardèche. At this beautiful campsite you camp right at the water's edge. There are plenty of shady spots on the woody campsite. From your spacious pitch you can walk straight to the private beach. There you can sunbathe or swim in the river. Or fish of course! And do you really want to relax during your holiday in France? Then drive to Val-les-Bains for a day in the thermal baths.

Camping in the Ardèche

A patch of forest on the banks of the Ardèche: your camping location this summer. It offers sheltered and shady camping pitches. You can pitch your caravan, motorhome or tent on one of the beautiful grassy pitches. Extra spacious pitches can be found on the river side. If you camp there, you can see the rippling water through the trees.

Private beach at the river

From your pitch you can walk straight into the river Ardèche. A lovely place to paddle and sunbathe. Bring a towel and lie down on the private beach. Your children will enjoy themselves in the shallow water. You will not find a more beautiful natural swimming pool. Don't forget your fishing rod. The river is full of bite-happy trout.

Entertainment in the summer

At La Charderie campsite, you can enjoy your holiday in peace and quiet. But also if you are looking for a good time, this is the place to be. In high season there is a lively atmosphere two evenings a week. Not disturbing, but small and convivial. Go dancing one evening or sing at the top of your lungs during karaoke. Or join the bingo.

properties.name: Camping Esmeralda
properties.description:
Camping Esmeralda lies directly behind the dunes, on the Belgian coast in West Flanders. The campsite is easy to reach by car and public transport. This campsite is nice for families. The coastal strip benefits from a favourable microclimate: milder temperatures, more sun and less rain than in the region behind it.

Luxury sanitary facilities

The grounds are divided into fields for tents, motorhomes and caravans. The terrain is open, without demarcation between the pitches. The sanitary facilities are luxuriously equipped with underfloor heating, even in the showers.

Eating and drinking

During the summer months, there are plenty of activities for young and old. There is an entertainment programme for children, as well as themed evenings and shows. Fancy a bite to eat? Enjoy a tasty treat at the bistro, or a snack at the snack bar. You can also head to the bistro for breakfast. The terrace at the bistro is a lovely spot for an ice cream or a refreshing drink. There is also a convenience shop for essential groceries.

In the nearby area

Blankenberge (2 km), with its lively harbour festivals in May, is just a stone’s throw away. Here you can stroll through the streets lined with shops, bars and restaurants. For nature lovers, a beautiful cycle route through the Hinterland starts behind the campsite. Do you love culture? Visit historic Bruges (12 km) or bustling Ostend (20 km), both within easy reach. What’s more, a pedestrian bridge takes you to the beach in just 200 metres, where you can enjoy a refreshing sea breeze.

properties.name: Camping Gaalgebierg
properties.description:
The Gaalgebierg campsite is located in a quiet forested area on a hill near the former industrial town of Esch-sur-Alzette. The campsite is well maintained and is wonderfully quiet and green. Directly next door there is a zoo (free access) and there are numerous sports fields and city gardens in the immediate vicinity. Esch-sur-Alzette is located in the "Terre Rouge" region, an area of former mines and heavy industry. There are lovely walks in the surrounding area.

Quiet and green

The campsite looks wonderfully quiet and green. There are beautiful trees. The grounds are divided into terraces, which creates a nice atmosphere. Some pitches are a little small or are somewhat hidden away, but there are also plenty of spacious sites.

The large central sanitation block is immaculately clean. The building is well maintained and heated. You will also find a baby care site and facilities for wheelchair users.

Hiking

Because of its location, the campsite is popular with hikers and peace-seekers. The bus near the campsite will take you (every 30 minutes) to the town swimming pool for free.

Charming café

There is a charming café with terrace on the campsite. There is also a restaurant with a reasonable menu. People from outside the campsite like to come to the bar and restaurant. You have to go to the centre of Esch-sur-Alzette for shops and a supermarket.

Esch-sur-Alzette offers great shopping, and the animal park near the campsite is also worth a visit. The Belval district is something truly special in Esch-sur-Alzette. The steel industry used to dominate here. Nowadays, urban renewal is taking place without losing sight of the industrial history.

properties.name: Camping Uit en Thuis
properties.description:
The campsite Uit en Thuis is located in a forested property with spacious campsites offering plenty of privacy. Located in a hidden corner of the Brabant Wal in the west of North Branbant, this is a unique camping opportunity for people looking for space and peace. You'll really relax here in beautiful natural surroundings, and at the same time you are only five kilometres from a lovely town.

Time for the guests

You'll receive a warm welcome in the reception building, attached to the home of the Kipping family. You can order fresh bread daily.

Easy on the eyes

The property is 8 hectares large, has a few altitude differences and is easy on the eyes through the natural organization. Generally it is quiet there. Even when the campsite is "full", it still doesn't feel crowded. The forest-like environment consists of pine trees with some open spaces here and there. The campsites are larger than 100 m2, have a forest floor and grass base and have plenty of privacy and shade nearly everywhere thanks to the planting of hedges.

There are various accommodations for rent on the campsite. On the trekkers field there is a trekker hut and spread over the property there are various mobile homes and safari tents for rent.

Sanitation and swimming pool

You will find easily accessible sanitation facilities on four locations accross the property. The facilities are not new, but are cleaned a number of time each day. For children there is a small heated swimming pool. In the middle of the campsite there is a snack bar with a small menu.

properties.name: Camping Le Fief d'Anduze
properties.description:
Looking for space and peace, but still want to have enough options for exploring further afield? Then head to the Le Fief d’Anduze campsite, located in a wooded setting nearby a small lake and a river. There's a lot to see and do in the area, such as the beautiful cities of Nîmes and Aigues-Mortes.

Pleasant vegetation

On the grounds, you'll find plenty of space and peace. The pitches are large and are nicely arranged between hedges, along straight lanes. You can choose a spot in the sun or in (partial) shade. There are plenty of shaded spots thanks to the pleasant vegetation. Want to hire something? There are numerous caravans and mobile homes for rent.

Gardon River

Near the terrace of the local restaurant, you'll find two modest swimming pools, including a kiddie pool. One pool is heated and in the high season, only adults are allowed. If you prefer to swim or snorkel in natural water, you can reach the fishing lake and the Gardon River by taking a path from the campsite for about 300 m.

Children's club

There is a large playing field with a beach volleyball court, swings, two bouncy play sets, a climbing frame and a sandbox. There is also entertainment, from dance nights and musical performances to crafts in the children's club. So there's plenty to do for the kids. In the meantime, parents can relax in the sauna with whirlpool and steam bath.

Local dishes

At the reception, there is a simple shop with a limited selection of supplies and fresh bread. You'll eat well in the campsite restaurant at good prices, from pizza to local dishes. The terrace near the restaurant is quite delightful and offers a view of the swimming pool.

properties.name: Sierra de Albarracín Las Corralizas
properties.description:
In the north-east of Spain lies the unspoilt region of Aragon. Between the mountains of the Sierra de Albarracín, Camping Sierra de Albarracín Las Corralizas has a unique location. In fact, it is the highest situated campsite in the country. The surroundings breathe tranquillity and nature. Albarracín, just thirty kilometres from the wooded campsite, was once declared the most beautiful town in Spain.

Freedom

The beautiful camping pitches are not laid out or delimited. This means that you have all the freedom you need, which emphasizes the feeling of camping in the great outdoors all the more! For smaller tents, raised plots have been created that offer extra privacy. On the site there are beautiful wooden chalets for rent.

Want a bite to eat?

Bronchales is a small but lively town a kilometre away. Here you can find a supermarket and a few bars and restaurants. But they also prepare delicious meals in the charming campsite restaurant. The Iberian ham with paella is a favourite. The restaurant has a shaded terrace.

Outdoor life

The superbarbecue is a beautiful communal outdoor cooking area that is illuminated at night. A popular place where you can have a chat with other campers while grilling. Behind the terrace, children can play a game of table football. There is also a small playground where children can swing under trees and between the rocks. If that's not a camping adventure!

Discovery on foot

Due to the high altitude, the temperature in the summer months is pleasant during the day. Those who like to explore the rugged, mountainous surroundings on foot can have fun. The campsite is in fact an ideal starting point for various walks along beautiful plains at the foot of Montes Universales.

properties.name: Camping Urrobi
