properties.description:
Campsite Urrobi is situated on the border of France and Spain, on the edge of the Pyrenees. The campsite is well-suited for nature lovers and hikers. The camping terrain is surrounded by wooded mountains and makes an ideal base for a long walk. The campsite is also ideal as a stopover campsite on your way to Santiago de Compostella, for instance.

Wooden bungalows

Campsite Urrobi has a large number of permanent pitches. These pitches are very well maintained. Apart from these, there is enough room available for touring pitches. You camp on large lawns and non-demarcated camping pitches. Beautiful, well-maintained wooden bungalows (with own sanitary facilities) are also available for rent.

Diverse group

On the campsite you will come across a diverse group of people. Guests are often nature lovers or travellers with Santiago de Compostella as final destination. There is no extensive entertainment programme for young or old and children will have to amuse themselves with outdoor activities. This should not be a problem in this beautiful area.

Swimming in rainy weather?

Past the campsite flows the Urrobi river, which is suitable for swimming. When you stand by the river with your caravan, you can jump straight in. The campsite also has a swimming pool. This is basically an indoor pool, but it has a retractable roof. When it rains, the roof can be closed. And so the rain will not be a spoilsport when you go for a swim.

Spanish cuisine

In the reception building near the entrance you will also find the restaurant. This serves regional dishes. In the evenings you can enjoy a Spanish meal for a reasonable price.

properties.name: Camping Le Mas
properties.description:
Glorious Southern France at her best and that is where you will find this campsite. Just a few steps away before you get to the sandy beach; from some camping pitches you have a fantastic view of the deep blue sea. The entire family will have a great time at Camping Le Mas with a wide choice of sports, relaxation and games for everyone.

The cosy, shaded pitches amongst pine trees make for terrific camping. Against an additional fee, you can also opt for a wonderful pitch with sea view. You can also rent a mobile home or chalet on campsite Le Mas.

Families

On this family campsite you will mainly see families with small children and teenagers. The entertainment is adapted to this with a special programme for the little ones and a programme for teenagers.

The swimming pool on Campsite Le Mas is a great spot. Little ones can splash around in the water and also participate in the mini-disco in the swimming pool. Parents can watch this from their sunbeds in the pool.

Rocks and cliffs

While the children enjoy themselves with the entertainment, crafts or treasure hunt, you can have a relaxing massage. The campsite also organises guided walks along the most beautiful calanques (deep valleys with steep, partly submerged slopes).

Less than 10 minutes away from Camping Le Mas you can explore the clear blue waters whilst diving or snorkelling. It is also worth your while hiring a boat or canoe in the magnificent region with its rocks, cliffs and clear blue water.

properties.name: Camping Park Mara
properties.description:
Camping Park Mara is located in the village of Borgio Verezzi in the province of Savona, in Liguria. Borgio Verezzi is located on the Riviera di Ponente, halfway between the cities of Albenga and Savona. Park Mara is located a bit inland, a terraced campground within walking distance from the sea. Note: the road to the campground is very steep!

Camping against the side of a mountain with sea view

Camping Park Mara is located on the side of a mountain. This terraced campground is less suitable for large caravans or campers, due to the steep road leading up to it. The first thing you will notice is the brand new reception building, which even has a lift and a beautiful view of the sea and the mountains. In addition to the sites for tents, caravans and campers, there are rental accommodations in the form of mobile homes and bungalows (with or without toilet).

The campground has a small swimming pool and a playground. In the high season, there are activities for the children and adults, including music and theatre. The beach is within walking distance (400 metres, 10 minutes walking) and in the high season, a free shuttle bus runs to it (except for in the weekend). There is a bar and a shop for the most necessary items in the new reception building.

In the area

Borgio Verrezi is made up of two parts. Borgio is on the coast, but the old town Verezzi, which is on the list of "the most beautiful villages in Italy", lies further inland. Near the centre (within walking distance) you'll find the Grotte Valdemino, stalactite caves with the most fantastic colours. There are many places to rock climb in the area surrounding Borio Verrezo.

properties.name: Camping International du Lac Bleu
properties.description:
Come and camp in the east of France. The Camping International du Lac Bleu is situated between the mountains on the shores of Lake Annecy. The campsite has its own access to the lake. There is also a beach and jetty. Nearby (3 km) you will find the historic town of Doussard.

Camping by the water

You will notice that not all pitches are equally large, but they are well defined. If you want a pitch at the lake, book in time. They are very popular! The campsite also rents out mobile homes and apartments. The sanitary facilities of this campsite are in two buildings. They are modern and well maintained. There is also a sauna.

A beach at the lake

The campsite has a nice swimming pool. There is a rapid, a paddling pool and three slides. The pool is not overly large, but very pleasant. Special: Camping International du Lac Bleu is one of the few campsites with a beach on Lake Annecy.

Just enjoying

Just outside the campsite, you will find a small supermarket. The campsite itself has a snack bar and a cosy restaurant with a large menu. In the morning you can enjoy a delicious breakfast in the restaurant. The bakery has fresh rolls every morning.

Entertainment

This campsite has several animation clubs: one for younger children (4 to 12 years) and one for teenagers (13 to 17 years). In addition, you can do sports on your own or with the animation team, such as bocce, basketball or even archery.

properties.name: Camping La Créole
properties.description:
Enjoying the shade of tall poplars and direct private access to the glorious sandy beach ... Camping La Créole is the place for you! The campsite lies in the centre on one of the bustling shopping streets of Marseillan-Plage, an authentic fishing town which is also a lively seaside resort. You can enjoy the good life on the very well maintained campsite: (almost) always great weather, fine food, and the sea and the beach on your doorstep.

Small but perfect

The pitches are small: 80-95 m2, but are very neatly laid out. The site itself looks spacious and is demarcated with lots of greenery and trees. You are standing on a soft surface of sand and/or grass. There are a modest number of beautifully laid out pitches (50 m2) available. You can rent mobile homes, lodge tents and ready-to-camp pitches.

Sun, sand and sea!

Your fellow campers are genuine sun, sea and beach worshippers. The marina (1.5 km away) is popular with water sports enthusiasts. Waterskiing, sailing and fishing...see it all each day in and just outside the marina. In peak season families, couples and older children flock to the entertainment at Camping La Créole. Furthermore, there are lots of activities, such as beach games (also for the tiny ones), jeu de boule competitions, dance evenings, sangria evenings and much more.

Popular tapas restaurant

A bakery, supermarket and greengrocer are located across the road opposite the entrance of the campsite. It does not get easier than that. The campsite does not have a restaurant, but across from the campsite is a very popular (tapas)restaurant. Conviviality and delicious fresh food are key here.

properties.name: Village Les Rives de Grand Lieu
properties.description:
Camping Village Les Rives de Grand Lieu is situated in the small town of Saint-Philbert-de-Grand-Lieu, slightly less than 30 km south of Nantes. Feel like experiencing the smell of a fresh sea breeze on the coast? Good idea! It will take you less than an hour to get there. The campsite is ideally located for those wishing to explore the beautiful scenery in the area by car, bicycle or on foot. When you enter the camping grounds, you will immediately see the large number of trees. Just a short walk from the grounds is a small river, which empties into quite a large lake.

A spacious pitch

The pitches are spacious, often separated by greenery and in the shade or in the sun. The flat surfaces and thick grass on most of the pitches are a bonus. The pathways are sandy, but still well-navigable. There are several mobile homes and hiker's cabins for rent. The campsite exudes an ambiance that far outweighs its two stars.

Active without and with water

On the campsite, there are endless sports activities available for young and old, also near the water. The beach is only a few hundred metres away and you can swim in the large lake. The water is supervised by a lifeguard. Windsurfing, kayaking and canoeing on the lake is permitted. There are ample fishing opportunities in the vicinity of the campsite. The supermarket (Hyper U) is close by. There is a basic restaurant with a small menu on the camping grounds, also for pizza and snacks. Regional products and fresh bread are on sale at the reception.

properties.name: Camping Les Brillas
properties.description:
This well-maintained campsite is located in a rural area in the Loire-Atlantique, just outside the pleasant coastal town of Les Moutiers-en-Retz. You can camp here just over a kilometre from the sea and the beach. Les Brillas Campsite offers spacious touring pitches, a beautiful indoor swimming pool, a nice petting zoo and fun and sporting activities in high season. This is also a neatly laid out camping area with many hedges, flowering shrubs and trees.

Spacious touring pitches

At Les Brillas Campsite, you can opt for a spacious pitch demarcated by green hedges and much larger pitches (up to 200 square meters) that have a more open character. The larger camping pitches are generally at the back of the site. In addition to tourist camping pitches, this campsite offers rental accommodations such as mobile homes and bungalow tents.

From treasure hunts to karaoke nights

In high season, fun activities are organised on this campsite for campers of all ages. For example, children aged 4 to 12 can sign up for the Happy club. Every morning they do fun things under animated supervision, such as crafts, sports and treasure hunting. There is also plenty to do for teenagers and adults in the summer, such as sports competitions, dance lessons, karaoke sessions and poker competitions.

properties.name: Nationalpark Cp. Andrelwirt
properties.description:
Nationalpark Camping Andrelwirt is located on an alpine meadow surrounded by mountains in National Park Hohe Tauern. This quiet family campsite is open all year round. From the flat terrain you have a beautiful panoramic view of the mountains. In the surroundings you'll find endless walking and cycling possibilities. In the winter you can go cross-country skiing from the campsite, and at four kilometres away there is a skiing area to which a shuttle bus runs in winter.

Real Austrian

Nationalpark Camping Andrelwirt is a small, quiet campsite. The whole site has a well-kept air: really Austrian. The campsite is situated at an altitude of almost a thousand meters. On the grass, along straight paths, there are fifty touring pitches, thirty-five permanent pitches and around twenty rental accommodations. From every pitch you have a panoramic view of the surrounding mountains. The touring pitches are fairly spacious and nicely flat. They are spread out between the permanent pitches.

Mountain river

There is no permanent swimming pool on the campsite, but in high season there a swimming pool for children is provided. At about one hundred meters from the campsite there is a small, fast flowing river where you can cool off. Children can paddle and build dams there.

Lovely restaurant

At one hundred meters from the entrance of the campsite you’ll find Restaurant Andrelwirt, which belongs to the same owner as the campsite. The restaurant is nicely situated on the edge of the village. On the campsite you can get some groceries, but for the nearest supermarket you have to go to Rauris, four kilometres away.

properties.name: Camping Appesbach
properties.description:
Camping Appesbach, located on the banks of Lake Wolfgang, one of the warmest lakes in Austria, offers an ideal camping experience in the region of Salzkammergut. The region is known for its mountains, large lakes and its proximity to the city of Salzburg. This medium-size campsite is perfect for fans of the Alps.

Water fun and water sports

The clear blue water of Lake Wolfgang is perfectly suitable for swimming, fishing and various water sports. The campsite has two sunbathing lawns with direct access to the lake, one of which is accessible to dogs. For water sports fans there are facilities for hiring pedal boats, canoes, kayaks and stand-up paddleboards, as well as the possibility of taking wing surfing lessons.

Local food and amenities

The campsite restaurant, Båcherls, serves delicious daily meals focused on Austrian dishes such as Wienerschnitzel and Käsespätzle, as well as fresh fish from Lake Wolfgang. There are also vegetarian and vegan options. For home cooks there is a small shop at the campsite with basic essentials and fresh bread daily. St Wolfgang is in the vicinity for more extensive grocery shopping.

Explore the Alps and Salzburg

Camping Appesbach is an excellent starting point for exploring the Alps, with options for walking and outings to nearby lakes such as Attersee and the Mondsee. The region is famous from the film 'The Sound of Music'. Salzburg, the birth city of Mozart, is 45 km away and offers charming little streets, boutiques and the impressive Hohensalzburg Fortress.

properties.name: Camping-Resort Allweglehen
properties.description:
Camping-Resort Allweglehen is a splendidly located terraced campsite on a mountainside with a fabulous view of the Alps. The campsite is located in Berchtesgaden, South-East Bavaria. You camp here in the northern Alps, on the boundary of the Berchtesgaden National Park and not far from the well-known Königssee. The campsite is not only geared towards the 'usual' camping guest, but also towards guests with an interest in the comprehensive wellness programme.

Spacious campsite

The pitches are spacious, clearly demarcated and have connections for electricity and water (including drainage). Not all pitches provide shade – something to keep in mind in hot summers.

Rental accommodation with a view

Since 2014, Camping-Resort Allweglehen has had new chalets and wooden lodges. Each unit has its own terrace and offers an unrestricted view of the famous Watzmann mountain (2713 m). Each chalet houses up to six persons and is fully furnished. The wooden lodges accommodate a maximum of three persons.

Wellness

The campsite not only offers modern sanitary facilities, newly installed in 2017, but there is also a comprehensive wellness centre (complete with sauna, massage, thermal baths, beauty centre and steam baths).

Cosy restaurant with live music

The campsite has a good and cosy restaurant with an extensive menu, including take-away meals. The restaurant can seat approximately one hundred guests. The open fireplace creates a homely atmosphere. The daily changing menu offers mainly regional specialities. Weekly events are organised in the restaurant, such as the traditional 'Schuhplattler' folk dance. The barbecue evenings and live music evenings are also great fun.

properties.name: Camping de Belos
properties.description:
Camping de Belos is located in the French department of Ardèche, with direct access to the river with the same name. Here, you camp in a quiet, wooded area. The campsite offers entertainment in the form of a playground, sports options, the swimming pool and, of course, the river. This is an ideal location to completely relax in nature, with the sound of water flowing in the background.

Camping in the woods

At Camping de Belos, campsite visitors stay in an oasis of tranquillity. The campsite is located in the woods, among the oak and fruit trees. All pitches are grassy and about 100 m2. You can also stay overnight in a chalet or mobile home. Dogs are welcome at the campsite. The river is a short walk from the campsite, where you have access to the beach on its banks.

Sports, relaxation and cuddling with goats

During the high season, the campsite team organises activities such as laser gaming, archery or a communal game of bingo. Sports enthusiasts have great fun at the fitness equipment, around the table-tennis table, on the multi-functional playing field or at the jeu de boules court. Children have fun in the playground, on the mini golf course or in the petting zoo with the goats, chickens, rabbits and ponies.

Go for a refreshing swim in the swimming pool, whizz down the slide or relax on one of the chaise longues. End the day with a meal at the campsite restaurant. This is also where sports events are watched regularly. Board games can be rented from the reception.

properties.name: Camping Warande
properties.description:
Warande is a campsite under the gentle sun on the Belgian coast. The camping is mainly geared towards families wanting to enjoy the beach. The campsite itself is very quiet, with some play equipment for children, but no organised activities. The town of Bredene is within walking distance if you want a bite to eat or a drink.

Ideal location by the sea

Because of its ideal location, campsites in this area are side by side. Camping Warande, therefore, has other campsites on either side. The owners will welcome you in the brick reception building, cheerfully surrounded by red geraniums. The grounds look open and most pitches are located in full sun, although there are some pitches where you can sit in the shade of a tree. The campsite is quiet and attracts mainly beach visitors, who are not really interested in entertainment on the campsite.

Level, neat and quiet

You reach your pitch via compacted pathways. Some pitches are demarcated with hedges, but most pitches do not have this advantage. The terrain is nice and level with well-tended grass. In addition to caravans, motorhomes and tents, rental accommodation (mobile homes) can be found on a separate section of the campsite.

This is particularly suitable for families with growing children. In addition to the beach and the sea there are some fun playgrounds. There are petanque courts as well.

Close to the beach

To reach the beach, you have to cross the through road via a pedestrian and bicycle bridge. You then have to pass the dune belt. All in all it is less than 600 m.

properties.name: FKK-Camping Müllerhof
properties.description:
This is a beautifully located naturist campsite with luxury pitches, some 7 km from the Austrian town of Keutschach am See. Müllerhof is located on the south side of the Keutschacher See and borders directly on the very clear water. The terrain is nicely open for naturists: no walls or fencing, but only separated from a piece of neighbouring land by a high, green hedge. It is very tranquil and you have a spacious pitch with a lot of shade or a bit less shade.

Find your own beautiful pitch

The pitches are spaciously laid out. You therefore have lots of space. Between the pitches there are several types of demarcations, such as neatly trimmed hedges or 'wild' bushes, showing off their beautiful flowers. Everything is clean and well maintained, including the thick grass and paved pathways. You can rent modern and luxuriously appointed mobile homes.

Active sports!

The lake, adjacent to the campsite, is excellent for swimming. You really do not need a swimming pool here! You can sunbathe and laze the day away on the pebble beach. The campsite has a sports field and several cycling routes for the sporty holiday maker. For the children: an entertainment programme, an outside and an indoor playground. And at the end of a sporty day it is lovely to relax in the sauna.

Restaurant and shop

The restaurant has a modest menu. Fortunately, the friendly staff do their utmost to make up for this. The good pizzeria and attractive terrace also contribute towards this. The small campsite shop stocks the necessities for a simple meal. There is also fresh bread daily.

properties.name: Camping Camp Liza
properties.description:
Campsite Camp Liza is located in a beautiful spot in Slovenia's Julian Alps, in the Bovec valley. This is a great destination for people who love action and adventure like water and mountain sports. The campsite hires all the equipment you will need and arranges transport to the activity locations. Naturally, you can also just enjoy the peace and quiet of the natural beauty. Campsite is close to the Soča Trail and Alpe Adria Trail (long-distance hiking trails) and Soča and Koritnica rivers.

Pitch your tent on the Koritnica

Camp Liza has a well-maintained campsite surrounded by beautiful nature and mountains. The campsite is divided into six zones. Fields 1 to 4 have demarcated grass pitches for caravans and motorhomes. Zones 5 and 6 are for tent campers on the banks of the Koritnica River. Please be aware that the tent camping fields are car-free. There is a central parking area for your car about 100 m away. Prefer a stay with a little more luxury? Then choose a hotel room or bungalow.

Dining at Gostilna Liza restaurant

This campsite is in a mountainous area, far away from big cities. So, it’s great that the campsite has a restaurant: Gostilna Liza. Sit back and order one of the tasty regional meals on the menu. There are meat and fish dishes, but vegetarian options available too. There’s something for everyone! The campsite also has a small supermarket that sells basic necessities and local produce.

properties.name: Camping Maroadi
properties.description:
Do you like surfing, mountain biking, walking or mountaineering? If so, Camping Maroadi, located on the northern shores of Lake Garda, is an excellent choice. The nearby centre of Torbole with its lively promenade and restaurants, the direct access to the lake and the beautiful mountain landscapes of the Dolomites offer a wide choice of opportunities for camping guests.

Superb view

The campsite was completely renovated last year. Most of the pitches are located in streets next to each other and are demarcated with bushes. There is ample shade and you have water connections and drainage. The most beautiful pitches are located by the lake and offer a superb view. Want to hire something? There are also beautiful mobile homes and apartments available!

The country's largest lake

The campsite is located on the largest lake in Italy and has direct access to a pebble beach. There is a walking and cycling path between the campsite and the beach. The lake is very suitable for sailing, surfing and other water sports. Adjacent to the campsite is a mooring jetty, a slipway and a sailing/surfing school where you can also hire equipment.

Sports terrain and Bike Shuttle Service

There is a multifunctional sports terrain and a playground on the campsite. Further entertainment is available in the form of an entertainment programme for adults and bicycle hire (first three hours free). The campsite offers a Bike Shuttle Service and a repair service for mountain bikers.

Shop and bar

The camping shop is small, but well stocked. Adjacent to the shop is a bar (with terrace) where you can also order small dishes.

properties.name: Camping Le Pastural
properties.description:
Slightly north of Aubenas, against a mountain slope, you will find campsite Le Pastural. The pitches on this small family campsite are laid out on terraces, between deciduous trees and tall hedges. A small stream flows along the campsite. Children will enjoy paddling, splashing around and jumping off the rocks in this shallow river. Campsite Le Pastural is amiable and small scale, but still offers excellent facilities (including a restaurant).

Natural environment

Campsite Le Pastural is a small-scale four star campsite, laid out on green terraces against a mountain slope. There is a fair height difference, so that you have a splendid view of the surroundings from the the uppermost terraces. You camp here in a natural ambiance, in the shade of the numerous deciduous trees and tall hedges. The pitches are spacious and beautifully laid out. The neat rental mobile homes are also located amidst greenery.

Splashing in the waterfall

Le Pastural is a real family campsite which is geared towards (small) children. There is ample opportunity to play, a heated swimming pool and two lovely toddler pools. Along the campsite flows a small stream, in which children can play to their heart's content. You can walk to the river bank and a small sandy beach via a gate. The water is too shallow for swimming, but it has a waterfall which has formed a lovely pool where you can jump in from the rocks. Building dams, splashing around and paddling also provide endless fun. 

Aubenas

Le Pastural is located in a natural, wooded area, nevertheless only four kilometres from lively Aubenas. Make sure to visit the Château d’Aubenas, a beautifully restored castle in the centre.

properties.name: Camping Linda
properties.description:
Surfing, sailing or diving on Lake Veere or on the Eastern Scheldt, and thereafter some delicious fish in one of the local restaurants. You are undeniably in Zeeland. Camping Linda lies directly behind the Eastern Scheldt at Lake Veere, so that you are guaranteed of all ingredients for a top holiday : walking routes, water sports, delicious food, peace and nature.

Campsite Linda lies in South Beveland, directly on Lake Veere, with a large number of water sports possibilities. The closest village is Wemeldinge, and Goes is a bit further along.

Inviting campsite

Upon arrival the campsite looks inviting and diverse. There are two separate sites with a mixture of permanent and tourist pitches on each one. You are bid an enthusiastic and friendly welcome by the campsite staff. The reception forms part of a building where the shop, the playground and the washing machines are also housed. There are many facilities for families and children on campsite Linda.

For young and old

The camping pitches look neat and well-kept. They vary in size and shape. In addition to Dutch guests, there are also many German and Belgian guests.

You can swim in Lake Veere, which you can reach by crossing the adjacent dyke. There is an entertainment programme for young and old, and regional events, such as fishing days in Yrseke, also receive a lot of attention.

Nice dishes

There are good meals available in Wemeldinge, Goes or Yrseke, but on the campsite you can also enjoy lovely dishes. The sanitary facilities are of good quality and are kept spotless.

properties.name: Landschapscamping De Graspol
properties.description:
National landscape Het Groene Woud, located in Meierij in Brabant, has a varied landscape with lovely trees, little villages and picturesque farms. Landschapscamping De Graspol is located in this environment, at the edge of the village of Nijnsel on the Dommel river.

Very spacious with beautiful plants

De Graspol is a very quiet and luxurious quality campsite. The property is spacious and there are lovely plants. You can really call the campsite a landscape campsite.

Unknown luxury

The standard campsites are located at the front of the property. They vary in shape, but each have an area of about 100 m2. They are located in the midst of lovely landscaping. Further to the back of the property there are the comfort campsites. These are separated by greenery and each are about 200 m2. You'll enjoy space and plenty of privacy. The sanitation is beautiful, just like the recreation room, and offers superior luxury.

Ideal for active nature lovers

The campsite targets specifically seniors and nature lovers who want to walk or cycle and want some luxury from a campsite. It is an excellent base for exploring the beautiful surroundings. From the site you can cross directly to the banks of the small Dommel river. There you can take lovely walks. If you want to go a little further, you can take lovely walks in the Vressels Bos. You can also take beautiful cycle rides through the area. Visits to picturesque Sint-Oedenrode and the somewhat further away Oirschot are definitely worthwhile.

properties.name: Strandcamping Waging am See
properties.description:
Strandcamping Waging Am See in southern Germany is an ideal place for families with children. Because you are right on the Waginger See, you have plenty of water recreation at your disposal. Located in the beautiful Bavarian landscape, the area also offers many lovely excursions. On the campground, you can have a nice drink on the terrace by the water. Dogs are welcome.

The Bavarian region is the ideal location for anyone who wants to relax during their holiday and also actively explore nature and cultural and historic cities. If you camp at Strandcamping Waging Am See, you'll enjoy this combination. Relax for an afternoon on the lovely lake, then visit the capital city of Bavaria, Munich, or go to the Eagle's Nest (the former home of Adolf Hitler).

Waginger See: for people and animals

Camping by the lake also naturally means that you are camping near plenty of water fun! The campground has a large beach with play equipment, slides that end in the water and bouncy cushions. A little further on there is a surf and sailing school, and you can hire boats. The beach is divided up into various sections. There is a fitness section and a dock for boats. The beach can be optimally utilized!

There's not only the beach to experience, all kinds of things are organised on the rest of the campground. For example, play a round of mini golf or take part in the mini-golf tournament. Children will love the torch walks, Indian days and water fights. Real football lovers from 6-15 years of age can train with two professional footballers every Monday in the high season.

properties.name: Camping Ca'Savio
properties.description:
Because Camping Ca'Savio is located on the Italian peninsula Cavallino Treporti, you are surrounded by water here. Venice is an hour away by car from the campsite. If you have more time, you can of course take the boat to this city full of canals and gondolas. When you drive towards the campsite, the green setting quickly becomes apparent. The large pines provide a lot of shade in this region.

Unique rental accommodations

The special feature about Camping Ca'Savio is that there are unique rental accommodations for the guests, in addition to the normal pitches. Such as the Airstream-park, a park full of unusually designed caravans which are situated in an open, natural setting.

A kilometre-long beach

Camping Ca'Savio features its own fine sandy beach of nearly 1 kilometre in length. With daily maintenance and beach patrols, there is always a good feeling there. Out of respect for nature, there are no sun loungers and eating facilities on the beach. Do you want to lie under a sun umbrella or sit in a beach chair? You will find it all at the shop at the campsite.

The swimming pool complex is located in two areas on the campsite. One swimming pool can be found near the restaurant. Perfect if you want to have a bite after a refreshing dive, or fancy a tasty snack. In this pool you can pretend to be a pirate on the pirate ship and go down the slides.

Fully equipped

You never lack of anything at Camping Ca'Savio. The camping offers various services, such as a shuttle between the airport and the campsite. Furthermore, in the case of an emergency, a private doctor is in attendance at the camp site in peak season.

properties.name: Les Rives du Douet
properties.description:
The French town of Doué-la-Fontaine is located in the Maine-et-Loire department between Angers and Saumur. This region in the Loire is known for its castles, vineyards, and picturesque villages. But also the impressive marl quarry of Falun. The Les Rives du Douet campsite is a small-scale family campsite that can be used as a base for visiting these attractions.

Spacious pitches and camper vans

The Les Rives du Douet campsite is spacious and situated on a site consisting mainly of grass fields with the occasional tall tree. Paved paths lead you to your spot. There are spacious pitche – both in the sun and in the shade. The rental accommodations are situated on al separate terrain. Near the reception are about 20 camper places.

Also for people passing through

With the city just around the corner, you won’t need many amenities on the campsite itself. Within a few minutes cycling distance, you will find numerous shops, supermarkets, cafés, and restaurants. There is a launderette directly on the campsite. There are also shared barbecue facilities and a campsite shop with regional products, groceries, and (in high season) fresh bread. The Les Rives du Douet campsite is also popular with cycle tourists. Especially for this group of campers, it is possible to order a breakfast and lunch basket in July and August.

Water fun next to the campsite

At this campsite, your daily dose of water fun is literally just around the corner. Here, you will find the public indoor swimming pool, which camping guests can use at a reduced rate. The swimming complex has a large (competition) pool, a paddling pool, and a large water slide. You can also go fishing in the Douet stream.

properties.name: Camping Rioclar
properties.description:
Family campsite Rioclar is beautifully situated in a widely-forested area with views of the surrounding Alpine peaks in the heart of the Alpes-de-Haute-Provence department. With 8000 trees covering 200 camping pitches, you can imagine how green it must be. Everything revolves around sports and active recreation: you can go hiking, cycling, mountain biking, rafting, paragliding, and kayaking down the churning river. After an active day, you can relax and unwind in the heated swimming pool with wonderful views.

Laze in a hammock

The pitches are situated among the pine trees, larches and Mediterranean trees on the banks of the Ubaye river. An ideal spot to tie up your hammock and laze the day away. If you forgot to bring a hammock, don't worry, you can rent one at the campsite shop. Each pitch varies in shape and size, therefore it is important that you specify the kind and size of pitch you need when making the reservation so that the owner can find the ideal spot for you.

All the pitches have shade and electricity and there is always a water tap nearby. The pitches are mostly level. People wishing to rent accommodations can choose from comfortable mobile homes in the woods, characteristic cabins and simply-furnished caravans, which have beautiful views but no sanitation. The sanitary facilities are modern and clean.

Adventure sports

This area, with its tall mountains, offers plenty of opportunities for the active cyclist and for white-water sports. Racing cyclists can indulge themselves in the surrounding mountain passes. Mountain bikers can explore the 340-km network of marked trails. The Rioraft club is situated next to the campsite. The club also organises baby rafting for children from 5 years of age.

properties.name: Onda Blu Resort
properties.description:
If you are looking for a suitable campsite at Lake Garda, where young and old can enjoy themselves, you don't have to look any further. With the camping pitches at the water's edge, a beach for sunbathing and a large swimming pool, this campsite offers you everything you could wish for. Not to mention the campsite restaurant. You can have breakfast here or dine with a view of the lake.

Camping on the lake

The camping pitches on Onda Blu are located in the best spot of the campsite; directly by Lake Garda! The grounds are well-tended, with ample shade due to the large number of deciduous trees, and offer sufficient space to enjoy a carefree holiday.

Cooling off safely

When Lake Garda is not enough for you, you can also indulge yourself at the luxurious swimming pool. It measures a whopping 360 m2. You can let your children swim safely here, there usually is a lifeguard in attendance.

On and around the lake

With Lake Garda at your feet, there is lots to do on and around the water. Rent a canoe, bring your own boat or rent a boat in the harbour of one of the surrounding villages. There are quite a few cycling paths around the lake.

Culinary enjoyment

During your holidays on campsite Onda Blu you will want for nothing. In the mornings you can get fresh rolls from the restaurant or enjoy the breakfast buffet inside the restaurant. You can also have dinner in the restaurant or order a meal to take to your tent, caravan or mobile home.

properties.name: Belt-Camping-Fehmarn
properties.description:
Belt Camping Fehmarn is located in the northwestern part of the beautiful island of Fehmarn. Its location on the Baltic Sea provides plenty of water sports opportunities, and in the peaceful region, you can take one of the hiking and cycling routes through farm villages and past lakes and meadows. The children can have fun on the sports and playing field and an entertainment team is available twice a week for the little ones.

Elongated campsite in Northwest Fehmarn

The campsite is situated beautifully on the Baltic Sea, behind a dike and sheltered by trees. On one side of the campsite, you will find a beautiful nature area. Cross the dike using the steps and you will be standing on the natural sandy beach.

The campsite itself is elongated like a ribbon with various camping pitches on either side of the paved road, surrounded by hedges and offering space to approximately twelve camper vans or caravans. The camping pitches are spacious (70 to 120 m2) and the layout of the campsite is well-structured. There are two luxury and clean heated sanitary blocks with facilities for the entire family and a special shower for the disabled.

Sports and games on the campsite

Just outside the entrance of Belt Camping Fehmarn is a large playground with various playing fields and play equipment for both the little ones and for older children. There are jungle gyms and swings, but there is also a football pitch and a volleyball court. There is also an entertainment team which organises activities twice a week for children under 13. And then, of course, there is always the Baltic beach, where you can cool off with a refreshing dip in the water.

properties.name: Camping am See
properties.description:
You will find Camping am See in the town of Alt Schwerin in northern Germany, east of Hamburg. What makes this campsite in the Mecklenburg-Vorpommern region unique is its location: the campsite grounds are situated lengthwise along a large lake, the Plauer See. Here, everyone can enjoy views of the water! The Plauer See is a popular lake for boating: with a private yacht, a rented boat or with a tourist boat, complete with a captain, guide, food and drink.

What a view!

It doesn't get better than this: a radiant view stretching as far as the eye can see. All the camping pitches have been thoughtfully marked and arranged so that everyone has - and keeps - as beautiful a view as possible. The 138 touring pitches are beautifully landscaped, relatively spacious (180-120 m2), and are situated on full grass. You will find guests on this campsite from all over Europe. Young families will feel right at home here, if only because of the child-friendly playing areas.

Swimming in the lake or boating on the lake

There is no swimming pool here as you can always swim in the lake. The water is refreshingly chilly! All the pitches are situated by the water, so you will not have to walk far. Here and there are some sandy beaches, but you can also enter the water from the bank itself. Some spots on the lake shore have been converted to a slipway where you can launch your boat.

Cosy restaurant

The campsite has a fine restaurant. The restaurant is small and welcoming, reasonably priced, and has views of the lake.

properties.name: Camping Tunnel International
properties.description:
When you enter Italy through the Great St Bernard Tunnel, campsite Tunnel is the first campsite you will see. This terraced campsite is beautifully located against the mountainside near the village of Etroubles, at an altitude of 1,280 m. The mountain landscape is rugged and wooded and the panoramic view from the camping pitches is magnificent. This is an ideal stopover campsite when your holiday destination is still quite a distance away in Italy.

Manoeuvring for a view

The campsite is beautifully laid out and well maintained, with level camping pitches on terraces. When you arrive with your caravan, it takes a bit of manoeuvring to get to your pitch. The infrastructure is a bit tight. However, this is amply compensated by the panoramic view. 

Pods and bubbles

When you do not have your own camping equipment, or when you are in transit, you can rent a nice 'pod' on this campsite. A threesome of basic, but comfortable trekker huts together form a cosy 'pod village'. They are especially popular with hikers and cyclists.

And after a long travel day, or after hiking or cycling in the mountains, you can take a hot shower. Or you can relax in the bubble bath. Campsite Tunnel not only has a whirlpool, but also a small swimming pool: a rare luxury at this altitude.

Restaurant with mountain view

Campsite Tunnel is especially popular with hikers. Not surprisingly, because you can make beautiful trips in the area. And when you have worked up an appetite after a demanding walk, you can head for the fine campsite restaurant. They offer a choice of various regional dishes. From the balcony of the restaurant you have a view of the surrounding mountains.

properties.name: Camping Dümmer See
properties.description:
Camping by the Dümmer See in Germany’s Lower Saxony can be done at Camping Dümmer See. The campsite is in a rural setting with many cycle routes. The lake is ideal for water sports. Camping Dümmer See consists of two smaller campsites that are 450 metres apart. The campsites belong to the same owner and the joint reception can be found at the camping site right on the lake, Camping Dümmer See C10. The second campsite, Camping Dümmer See C12, is closer to the village centre.

Camping equipment easily set level

Camping Dümmer See C12 has the tent field and several touring pitches. You camp on grass here. The majority of C10’s pitches are right by the lake. You camp here on partially paved pitches. Large tiles make it easy for you to level your motorhome or caravan. The tiles are surrounded by grass, so the awning or canopy is on the grass. You can also choose to stay in a wooden pod, a caravan or a mobile home.

Recreation around Dümmer See

Young campsite guests will have fun in the adventurous playground on the banks of the lake. Feel like swimming? You can swim in the lake, too. Water sports enthusiasts can rent a stand-up paddleboard at reception, and the sailing and surf school is within walking distance. The local indoor swimming pool, with sauna and mini golf course, is within walking distance. As are a bakery, fish and chip shop, and ice cream parlour. A large restaurant, which serves mainly German dishes, is located at the entrance to the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Les Oliviers
properties.description:
The French island of Corsica is known for its pristine nature and spectacular landscapes. Camping Les Oliviers, near the Gulf of Porto, is an ideal base from which to explore the island. You will camp close to the Scandola (UNESCO World Heritage Site) and Calanches de Piana nature reserves. The campsite is set in a beautiful location, on a wooded mountainside, near a babbling river, and less than two km away from the clear blue sea. The campsite has good facilities, including a swimming paradise, gym and restaurant.

Beautiful site with steep slopes

Les Oliviers is a beautiful, green campsite. There are great terraced pitches, some with views of the surrounding mountains. There are considerable height differences on the site, with a gradient of up to 20%. Its steep slopes make it especially suitable for smaller caravans and motorhomes. Would you rather rent accommodation? Luxury bungalows, small cabins and charming gypsy caravans are available.

Relax in the swimming paradise

Take a refreshing dip in the outdoor swimming pool with heated water. The swimming paradise is surrounded by a sun terrace. With a lazy river, water play equipment, a hot tub and a paddling pool, hours of splashing fun is guaranteed for young and old. The campsite has a wellness zone and various sports facilities, including a free gym with group classes. The campsite’s charming restaurant serves an extensive breakfast in the morning; later in the day, homemade pizzas are available and (in the summer holidays) there are fun themed evenings. In high season, La Paillote is open next to the swimming pool. This beach hut sells tasty paninis, crepes, waffles and salads.

properties.name: Camping Terra Nautic
properties.description:
Along a quiet country lane, on the banks of the river Vecht in Overijssel, lies Camping Terra Nautic. From here it is only four kilometres to the lively Hanseatic town of Zwolle. The campsite is very popular with anglers and water sports enthusiasts. You can also make lovely walking and cycling trips in the area.

As the name suggests, water plays an important role at Terra Nautic. Adjacent to the campsite is a marina belonging to the campsite and at the entrance to the campsite, you will find a water sports store.

Peace, quiet and nature

The campsite is a veritable refuge for anyone who likes peace, quiet and nature. With so much water around, Terra Nautic is obviously very popular with anglers and water sports enthusiasts. However, other sports-minded people also enjoy staying there. The IJssel-Vecht area is namely excellent for making beautiful walks and cycling tours.

Private angling jetty

The campsite looks very green and the camping pitches are quite spaciously laid out. Tent campers may choose a pitch under the trees in the orchard and all the mobile home guests have private angling jetties at their disposal.

Boating on the Vecht

Especially anglers love to visit Camping Terra Nautic. Not surprising, as the campsite is beautifully located in a bend on the river Vecht in Overijssel. Added bonus: from the campsite you can take your boat straight onto the river. There is a slipway to launch your own boat, which you may obviously bring along. The campsite offers opportunities for children to play table tennis, jump on the trampoline, romp in the playground or throw a ball on the pétanque pitch.

properties.name: Camping Città di Angera
properties.description:
Camping Città di Angera is situated in a beautiful location near the village of Angera on the eastern shore of Lake Maggiore. Here, you can camp in the middle of a varied natural landscape. For example, you can enjoy lovely walks and bike rides through wooded hillsides or visit charming seaside resorts around the lake. Water sports enthusiasts will also be in their element here. The wooded campsite features a lovely water park and an excellent restaurant, amongst other amenities.

Wooded location by the water

This campsite is an ideal spot for a lovely camping holiday all year round. Even in summer, as it is located in a wooded area by the water, ensuring plenty of shady and cool spots. The pitches are spacious and some offer unobstructed views of Lake Maggiore. There are also a few accommodation options, such as modern bungalows for four to six people.

Water sports enthusiasts, this is for you!

Perfection: the campsite has its very own beach by the lake. You can paddle and swim in Lake Maggiore from this beach, where the water is shallow for metres on end. There are also water sports activities on offer here, such as sailing, windsurfing, water skiing and pedalos. At Camping Città di Angera, you can also cool off at a beautiful swimming pool with a large paddling pool and a variety of spectacular water slides.

Has swimming made you work up an appetite? There is an on-site restaurant with an extensive menu. The homemade pizzas from the wood-fired oven are very popular here, although the salads, sandwiches and burgers are also highly rated. You can finish off a perfect day at the campsite in the café, where you can enjoy tasty snacks and delicious cocktails.

properties.name: Capfun de Bongerd
properties.description:
You don't have to go far for a great camping vacation. Capfun Campsite de Bongerd in Tuitjenhorn is pure family camping. The campsite is located in the North Holland region, a good twenty minutes (16.5 km) from Callantsoog. The Schoorl Dunes (15.6 km) and the beach (12.5 km) are also nearby.

Everything about this campsite tells you that it's geared toward children. At the entrance to the campsite, you are greeted by unique cottages and fairy-tale trees. The reception is also located in a fairy-tale building. You will receive a friendly welcome at this excellently maintained campsite. De Bongerd campsite is car-free. This allows children to play, ride bikes and scoot safely.

A genuine family campsite

Both the campsite and the pitches are spacious. Green spaces separate the camping fields. There are also more than ten types of bungalows and three studios for rent. You will find many families with children at this campsite. You'll also find seniors here in the off-season. The target group of Capfun Campsite de Bongerd is children up to eleven years old and their (grand)parents.

De Holle Bolle Boom (The Hollow Tree) theme park

At the campsite, you will find the extensive Holle Bolle Boom theme park, designed for young children. The theme park is divided into three parts: Hollow Bolle Inside, Outside and Splash. There is an indoor playground, an indoor tropical water playground and an outdoor water park. Visitors to the campsite have free access to the Holle Bolle Boom (CampingCard ACSI card users excluded).

properties.name: Capfun De Belten
properties.description:
The Vechtdal in Overijssel is a wonderful holiday destination with plenty of natural beauty. Capfun Camping De Belten is located centrally in Vechtdal, close to the village of Rheeze. Here, you camp amid a vast forested area and the River Vecht. You can therefore take many varied walking and cycling trips in this region. With sports fields, an indoor and outdoor playground, a brasserie and two swimming pools, among others, there is plenty to do at the campsite itself.

What accommodation options are there?

Behind the large reception building you will find a lovely site, where neat paved paths lead you to the camping pitches and accommodation. At Capfun Camping De Belten, you can choose a spacious pitch, but there are also options for booking overnight stays in a modern mobile home, a luxury chalet or a holiday home.

Lots of fun in the jungle-like paddling pool

This campsite is highly recommended for children who love swimming. Indeed, the campsite has a lovely indoor swimming pool, of which the paddling pool particularly stands out. Thanks to lots of play equipment, slides and fountains, the youngest campers can splash about for hours in this paddling pool, which is decorated completely in jungle style. You can have even more fun in the water in the large outdoor swimming pool with slide.

Two recreational lakes with sandy beach

It's also lovely swimming in the recreational lake at the rear of the site. An even larger recreational lake is Zwemplas de Oldemeijer. That is about a kilometre from the campsite. Enjoy sunbathing around both of these lakes and relaxing on the surprisingly large sandy beaches. In fact, you can also find a large play beach at the campsite itself, almost right next to the outdoor swimming pool.

properties.name: Clicochic Camping Etang de La Mutche
properties.description:
Clicochic Camping Étang de La Mutche is situated on the beautiful little lake Étang de la Mutche, near the village of Harprich (Moselle). Thanks to its location on the recreational lake and next to a water sports centre, this holiday park is ideal for water sports enthusiasts. You can take a refreshing dip in both the lake and the water park at the resort itself. There is also a restaurant, various sports and recreational facilities and (in high season) a varied entertainment programme.

Stay in a modern mobile home

At this spacious holiday park, you can choose from a range of rental accommodation units. Scattered across the green grounds, you will find mainly modern mobile homes. These come in various shapes and sizes and are suitable for four to ten holidaymakers. Some feature lovely extras, such as a playroom for children, a private veranda and/or unobstructed views of the lake.

Plenty of entertainment and a beautiful aqua park

Especially in high season, this is a popular holiday destination for families with (young) children. This is because fun activities are organised during this time.

But the real showstopper of the campsite is undoubtedly the wonderful water park, featuring several heated swimming pools, a large paddling pool and thrilling water slides. The centrepiece is the Boat Spacebowl, where you can whizz down in an inflatable ring.

Perfect base for nature and water sports fans

Be sure to bring your walking shoes or bike, as there are beautiful hiking and cycling routes around the holiday park. For a bit more rugged, unspoilt nature, drive an hour eastwards. There, you will end up on the edge of the Northern Vosges, where you can enjoy several (mountain) hiking routes, mountain bike trails and spectacular mountaineering opportunities.

properties.name: Capfun Camping Suzel
properties.description:
At a distance of approximately 6 kilometres from the attractive town of Colmar, in a rural setting, you will find the stylish and quiet Suzel campsite. On the large four-hectare campsite you will find a great diversity of trees, bushes and flowers. The 135 demarcated touring pitches measure between 90 - 100 m2. You have a choice of pitches with or without shade. There are twelve rental bungalows on the campsite.

Fine camping

A great way of camping on fields with a maximum of six beautiful and spacious pitches. The clear demarcation creates ample privacy. Families with young children like to stay here in summer while senior citizens are more likely to visit out of season. You can buy basic necessities at the reception. Fresh bread can be ordered daily. You can get takeaway meals from the snack bar.

Entertainment for all

Near the beautiful, heated swimming pool measuring some 200 m2, you will find a number of loungers in peak season. There is also a small paddling pool. Children enjoy themselves in the playground and the recreation area. The mini club and entertainment programme for children is offered in German, English and French. On the grounds of Camping Suzel you can also play table tennis, beach volleyball and make use of the pétanque court. You can even practice archery under supervision.

Lots of excursions

There are several castles to visit in the vicinity, such as the Hohlandsbourg. At the reception, they will gladly advise you about interesting excursions. You can also follow cycling routes from the campsite.

properties.name: Capfun Camping La Mirabelle
properties.description:
Looking for a nice family campsite in northern France? At Capfun La Mirabelle Campsite, near Thionville, you will enjoy a lovely swimming pool, lots of fun, games, and activities for children. This is also a good base from which to explore the cities of Luxembourg and Metz. Or spend a day watching rhinos and gorillas at the Amnéville Zoo.

This campsite has been recently renovated, and you'll find beautiful new mobile homes. The pool, slides and playground equipment also look great. This makes the campsite popular among families. During the holidays, you will find many Dutch, German and English families here. Because of its location in northern France, it is also a convenient place if you are passing through on your way south.

Swimming pool with colourful slides

The beautiful pool is the favourite spot of most families who come here on holiday. Here you can choose from an indoor pool with a retractable roof and a toddler pool, and two lovely warm outdoor pools. The colourful slides provide even more water fun. On sunny days, the roof is retracted, and you can get the full summer swimming experience. Around the pool is a large sunbathing area where you can lie in the sun with a book.

Are the kids not done playing yet? Then there is much more to experience with the colourful play castle, bouncy castles, outdoor fitness equipment, a tennis court, sports field and miniature golf course.

properties.name: Capfun Camping Les Flots Bleus
properties.description:
Here you can enjoy a relaxing holiday with the whole family directly on the Mediterranean Sea. The campsite is located in the sunny department of Hérault, where you will find beautiful cities, breathtaking nature, enchanting lakes and, of course, wonderful beaches. Capfun's Les Flots Bleus Campsite has a fabulous water park with two swimming pools, spectacular waterslides and plenty of entertainment for young and old alike. You can also enjoy swimming and sunbathing at the beach; the campsite has direct access to the sea. The campsite has a small supermarket and a restaurant with a bar.

Camping right by the sea

When you arrive at Capfun's Les Flots Bleus Campsite, you will immediately be struck by its spectacular location. The campsite is adjacent to the beautiful sandy beaches of the Mediterranean Sea. Who wouldn't want to camp close to the sea? Find a nice pitch where you can smell the fresh sea air. Not bringing your own camping equipment? Then you can choose from a wide range of chalets and mobile homes. The mobile homes each have their own terrace and some also have a TV and air conditioning.

Whoosh down the waterslides

Not only is the beach a major plus, but the campsite's waterpark is also worth checking out! Here you will find two heated outdoor swimming pools, a jacuzzi, two paddling pools, one with a kiddie slide, and exciting waterslides for older children. The Spacebowl – a funnel slide – is an exceptionally fun experience! Next to the swimming pool is the restaurant with terrace and bar. Perfect for a refreshing drink and a tasty snack after a swim.

properties.name: Capfun Camping Le Pachacaïd
properties.description:
This nice family campsite is located at the foot of the Massif des Maures mountain range and less than 10 kilometres from the Mediterranean Sea. There is much to discover in the vicinity of Capfun's Le Pachacaïd Campsite! The campsite features all the necessary amenities, including a restaurant, waterpark with no less than ten waterslides, and a fully organised entertainment programme in high season. During the summer months, from the beginning of July to the end of August, there is at least one Dutch-speaking entertainer present at the campsite.

Large terraced campsite in the woods

Capfun Le Pachacaïd Campsite is located in a pine forest and is built against a hill. The campsite consists of eleven terraces on which approximately 440 luxury mobile homes are situated. You have a beautiful view of the surrounding area from the top of the hill. The organised activities and swimming pools can be found at the bottom of the hill.

The campsite features a playground, bouncy castles, table tennis tables and a multi-sports field. The campsite has a small supermarket with basic products. There is a larger supermarket about 9 kilometres away. You can also have a bite to eat at the campsite restaurant. It is open from the beginning of April to the end of September. Pets are not allowed at this campsite.

Water fun in the aqua park

Do you enjoy water recreation and activities? Then you've come to the right place! There are no less than ten different waterslides that you can whiz down during your stay. The most striking slide is the Space Bowl, where you end up in a large funnel. How many times can you spin around the bowl before you fall into the water?

properties.name: Capfun Camping La Route Blanche
properties.description:
Camping La Route Blanche is situated in Bréville-sur-Mer, less than one km from the Atlantic Ocean. The neat and friendly campsite is adorned with colourful flower beds and stylish sanitary buildings. You can swim in the sea, but also in the extensive aqua park on the campsite. Across the road is a golf course with a view of the Atlantic Ocean.

Colourful

The camping grounds are neat and uncluttered. They are well maintained and a large number of flower beds create a colourful appearance. The vegetation is neatly landscaped, creating a harmonious atmosphere on the campsite. The roads (all one-way) to your pitch are wide and of good quality.

You have a choice of several types of rental accommodation, all comfortable.

Aquapark

Camping La Route Blanche is less than one km away from the wide beaches of the Atlantic Ocean. This means a refreshing dive in seawater each day! But you can also swim at the campsite. Near the entrance lies the water park, where you can enjoy a heated swimming pool, slides, a bubble bath and (for the little ones) a toddler pool.

Jumping and dancing

There is lots to do for children (from the age of 6) on the campsite. There is a playground, bouncing castle and a trampoline. Lots of fun to be had here. In peak season all kinds of activities are organised, and not only for the little ones. You can sing along heartily at the karaoke evenings or show off your best dance moves.

properties.name: Capfun Camping Fort Falabraque
properties.description:
This cosy family campsite is in a green, wooded area in the beautiful French region of Alsace. You'll be staying near the German border in an area with rivers and lakes. Capfun Campsite Fort Falabraque has brand new chalets. You'll have lots of water fun in the swimming pool with great slides. There is a nice playground where children can let off steam. The campsite has a restaurant, bar, a boules court, and table tennis tables.

Brand new chalets

When you arrive at Capfun Campsite Fort Falabraque, you will immediately see the beautiful new chalets. This campsite is in transition and is being transformed into a beautiful campsite where old mobile homes are making way for new chalets. All chalets have their own terrace with garden furniture, and most chalets have a television. The kitchen also has modern facilities, such as a dishwasher and microwave.

Spectacular slides

Attention swimming enthusiasts! Take a refreshing dip in the beautiful swimming pool. At the pool are three spectacular slides, including the Spacebowl, where you slide into a large funnel. We've also kept the littlest swimmers in mind. There is a separate paddling pool with slide and water sprinklers.

Animation and entertainment

In high season, children between 4 and 12 years old can go to the Kids Club. Fun activities are organised there on weekdays, such as crafts, dancing and treasure hunts. Children between the ages of 13 and 17 can attend the Teen Club, which meets at least once weekly. There are fun shows and performances for the whole family, three evenings a week. The animation on this campsite is in French.

properties.name: Capfun Camping La Tordera-Naciones
properties.description:
This beautiful family campsite is located right by the sea on the popular Costa Brava, between the charming seaside resorts of Malgrat de Mar and Blanes. This is a good base from which to explore the beauty of Catalonia, such as the mountainous interior and the famous cities of Barcelona and Girona. In the summer months, Capfun's La Tordera-Naciones Campsite is an ideal holiday destination for families with children. With its beautiful waterpark, the unique playgrounds and the varied entertainment program, there is plenty to keep you occupied.

Spacious touring pitches and an abundance of mobile homes

Rental accommodations such as mobile homes are the primary form of accommodation at this Capfun campsite. These are available in different sizes. The smallest ones can accommodate up to four people, while the largest homes can accommodate ten holidaymakers. There are also plenty of spacious tourist camping pitches on the site. Top Presta pitches also come with a garden shed. In it you will find a refrigerator, a garden set and two sun loungers.

Plenty of water recreation in the waterpark and in the sea

At the centre of the campsite is a beautiful outdoor waterpark consisting of two heated swimming pools. Several colourful waterslides lead into the smaller, shallow pool. This includes two slides that are ideally suited for toddlers. In the summer you can participate in aqua fitness in the large outdoor pool.

Swimming and having fun in the water can also be done in the sea, of course. The campsite is located directly on a large sandy beach, which also connects to the beautiful Delta de la Tordera nature reserve.

properties.name: Capfun Het Wieskamp
properties.description:
Camping Het Wieskamp is located on the outskirts of Winterswijk, in beautiful natural surroundings. This large, comfortable family campsite mainly has many permanent, but there are also four separate camping fields for touring campers. The spacious touring pitches are all equipped with private sanitary facilities. There are many facilities for children, including an outdoor swimming pool, indoor playground and petting zoo.

Four camping fields

Camping Het Wieskamp consists largely of mobile homes, as there are 220 permanent pitches. There are also bungalows, chalets and lodge tents for rent. In addition, the campsite has four separate camping fields for touring campers: one large field and three smaller ones. In total there are 50 very spacious pitches, each with private sanitary facilities, electricity and wifi. The fields are situated on the edge of the campsite, so it's nice and quiet. Two of the smaller fields are also sheltered at the edge of the woods.

On solar energy

At the entrance, behind the main building, there is a simple outdoor swimming pool. It is surrounded by a tiled terrace with sun loungers and parasols. In the period from Ascension to the end of August you can swim there, because the water is heated by solar energy. There is a separate paddling pool for the little ones.

For the whole family

In high season there is an entertainment programme for children, but also for teenagers and adults. There is live music and entertainment, theme nights, crafts and pancakes. The entertainment team organises several activities every day during this period, so there is always something to do for the whole family. There is also an excursion programme with all kinds of excursions, walking and cycling tours.

properties.name: Capfun Camping Dune Fleurie
properties.description:
Capfun Campsite Dune Fleurie is located in the northern French region of Picardy, just five minutes from the wide sandy beach of Quend. This lively family campsite in the Bay of Somme is a paradise for beach-goers, water sports enthusiasts, nature lovers and children who want nothing more than lots of entertainment and a water park with super-fast slides. It will be fun with the whole family!

Sleep among the trees

Capfun Campsite Dune Fleurie is actually a large park. The large camping area is wooded and flat, and there is a beautiful fishing pond. You can easily find both the shade and the sun. You won't be spending the night at this campsite in your own tent or caravan but in one of the 900 mobile homes or chalets for two to eight people. The campsite focuses mainly on families, which means the dog can also come on holiday here.

Water fun for everyone

Thanks to its location by the sea, you can be floating in the water in a matter of minutes. In addition to looking for shells and building sand castles, you can also spot lazing seals here. Would you rather dive into a pool? Then you're in luck because the campsite has a fantastic water park with several (indoor) swimming pools.

Entertainment and animation

Swinging on the pirate swing, a game of mini golf or watching an exciting film in the cinema will keep you busy during the holiday. And that's not all. In the high season, the animation team is available almost every day with treasure hunts, craft afternoons and shows. Unique to this campsite is that fun activities are organised every weekend, even in the low season.

properties.name: Capfun Camping Wondermolen
properties.description:
Thinking of a dream holiday with the kids? Then this campsite located in the cosy province of Brabant, between Breda and Tilburg, is the ideal place for you. You'll be staying in a luxury chalet or mobile home in a wooded area. Capfun Wondermolen Holiday Park is located near the Biesbosch and offers plenty of fun activities, both indoors and out. For example, you can enjoy yourself for an entire day in the large water park featuring cool waterslides. There is plenty for both children and parents to do each day. It is located in the middle of the tranquil woods, but with two cosy, bustling cities just 20 minutes away.

Child-friendly mobile home

At Capfun Wondermolen Holiday Park, you can enjoy your holiday in a chalet or a mobile home. All accommodations are furnished with a well-equipped kitchen where you can prepare the most delicious meals. The semi-covered terrace offers shade when enjoying a nice breakfast, lunch or dinner.

Spectacular water park

It should come as no surprise you that you will encounter many families with children at this children's campsite. Kids range from young children to teenagers. They can let off steam in one of the many swimming pools at the 'Splash Lagoon' water park. Here you can swim in both an indoor pool and in the open air. Your kids won't know which pool to choose first. The one with the coloured slides or the water playground. The so-called Spacebowl is a very special slide where you end up in a large funnel. Whoever spins the most laps wins.

properties.name: ClicoChic Camping Les Gorges du Gardon
properties.description:
This beautiful family campsite is located right on the Gardon River, close to the famous Pont du Gard aqueduct and cities rich in cultural-historical heritage (such as Avignon and Nîmes). In addition to its cultural highlights, this area also offers wonderful hiking and cycling tours through nature. Capfun Les Gorges du Gardon Campsite is popular with families with children in high season. This immaculately maintained campsite near Vers-Pont-du-Gard features an amazing water park, a unique playground and a cosy restaurant. In the summer there are fun activities for both young and old.

Rental accommodations and charming camping pitches

Capfun Les Gorges du Gardon Campsite mainly offers seasonal pitches and rental accommodations. There are also several dozen spacious touring pitches available. We offer many different types of camping spots. Are you a fan of real camping? Then try to get one of the idyllic spots on the river bank. The sanitary facilities are modern. They are also extremely well maintained. There are more than enough facilities for a campsite of this size.

Colourful water park with four water slides

At the centre of the campsite is a beautiful water park where you can enjoy yourself for hours. There are two heated swimming pools and a paddling pool with a fun snake slide. In addition, there are four more spectacular waterslides that help make the water park an extremely colourful place. You can also freshen up in the river. There are numerous places where you can venture out into the water a bit and bathe.

properties.name: Capfun Camping La Pergola
properties.description:
You will find this family campsite par excellence in a wonderfully tranquil spot, centrally located in the French Jura. This leisure park is located directly on Lac de Chalain, an emerald green lake on which the campsite has its own beach. The terrace of the campsite's restaurant offers a beautiful view of the lake. Furthermore, Capfun Campsite La Pergola has a spectacular waterpark, and in high season there is an entertainment team that organises fun activities for the whole family. This is a large campsite with comfortable rental accommodation.

Colourful waterpark with spectacular slides

One of the absolute highlights of this campsite is the beautiful waterpark. The colourful waterslides help contribute to its aesthetic appeal. The most eye-catching waterslide is the spectacular Space Bowl. This slide is tens of metres long and ends in a funnel. There are also two large, heated swimming pools, one of which has a retractable roof. It can thus be converted into an indoor swimming pool on cold or rainy days, for example.

Plenty of entertainment for young and old

During the summer months, as well as during the Easter holidays, Ascension Day and Pentecost, La Pergola organises fun activities. Children aged 4 to 6 can join the mini club, while children up to the age of 10 can enjoy themselves at the kids' club. Together they can do crafts, dance or go on a treasure hunt, for example. The campsite has a very nice outdoor playground. There is also plenty to do for teenagers and adults. Think of aqua gym, sports tournaments, family games, foam parties, disco swimming and evening shows.

properties.name: ClicoChic Camping Longchamp
properties.description:
Just off the beautiful coastline of Brittany, only 13 kilometres from the ancient fortified city of Saint-Malo, lies this lovely family campsite. From the campsite, it is a few minutes walk to the lovely sandy beach Plage de Longchamp. The campsite is a good place to be. There is a lovely water park, where you can swim in both good and bad weather. There is plenty to discover in the beautiful surroundings of the campsite. Visit one of the atmospheric old coastal towns and fall in love with Brittany!

Experience Brittany

On the north coast of Brittany, near the town of Saint-Lunaire, is Camping Longchamp. In the vicinity of the campsite, there are nice towns to visit. For example, Dinard with its stately buildings by the sea and pirate city Saint-Malo, the beautiful, old port city. With the sea around the corner, you will be able to enjoy the beach, the sea, and the fresh air every day. Take endless walks along the beach, and enjoy the beautiful Breton nature.

Holiday fun

Upon your arrival at Camping Longchamp, you will receive a friendly welcome in the well-maintained, wooden reception building. Next to the reception, you will immediately see the beautiful water park of the campsite. Before you even arrive at your camping spot, you probably feel like taking a refreshing dip! The campsite is neat and well maintained. You will camp on grassy fields with spacious pitches separated by some low vegetation. For those who prefer to stay in a less rustic accommodation, there are different types of mobile homes for rent.

properties.name: Capfun Camping Fredland
properties.description:
‘Experience the family vacation you dreamed of as a child’. That’s the motto of the Capfun campsites. At the Fredland campsite, you’ll be able to do just that. The campsite has a swimming pool with multiple slides, an adventure playground, and a multi-purpose sports field. In high season, the entertainment team organises activities for children and youth of all ages. From the campsite, you can easily take a day trip to the city of Paris or the Disneyland Paris amusement park.

Special accommodation

Capfun Camping Fredland is located in the forest and by a small lake. It is not possible to camp at the campsite with your own camping equipment. At Capfun Camping Fredland, you can only rent accommodations. Choose a luxury mobile home or wooden lodge for two to ten people. You can also opt for a vacation in a special accommodation. Sleep in a tree hut, a wizard’s lair, or a witch’s cottage.

Fun in the water

All Capfun campsites feature a swimming pool with several slides. Camping Fredland has no less than five water slides. The most spectacular slide is the space bowl, a funnel-shaped slide. This slide is only for true daredevils. Younger children can splash around in the paddling pool in the playground.

The pool has a sliding roof, so you can swim even on less beautiful days.

Day trip to Paris or Disneyland

Capfun Camping Fredland is located less than 40 kilometres outside the city of Paris. Tournan train station is only a 650 metre walk from the campsite. From this station, you can reach Paris in only 30 minutes by train.

properties.name: Capfun Camping Imbours
properties.description:
Just outside of Larnas, a charming village in the south of the Ardèche, lies Capfun Camping Imbours. This campsite is ideal for families who enjoy spending plenty of time at the campsite. Thanks to the water park, the sports and recreational facilities, the various catering outlets and the extensive entertainment programme, there is plenty of fun to be had for both young and old. Furthermore, this holiday park is located in beautiful, wooded surroundings. Popular attractions such as the Pont-d'Arc and the Gorges de l'Ardèche are within easy reach. This holiday park is also situated in a beautiful, wooded area. Popular attractions such as the Pont-d’Arc and the Gorges de l’Ardèche are within easy reach.

Spacious touring pitches and lots of accommodation options

This campsite offers a wide range of accommodation options. For example, you can book a stay in one of the comfortable mobile homes, some of which have their own hot tub. There are also several types of luxury apartments available for rent. Of course, traditional campers are also more than welcome. Spacious camping pitches are available for them, most of which offer plenty of shade. Some pitches come with a garden shed containing garden furniture, a fridge and a barbecue.

Plenty of fun and water activities

The resort has several playgrounds, tennis and padel courts, multi-sports pitches, a pump track circuit and a climbing course for children. Speaking of children, there is also plenty of entertainment for them. In high season, there are fun workshops, dance sessions and treasure hunts several times a week. Family games are also organised regularly, as are lively themed evenings with entertainment.

But the true showpiece of the resort is undoubtedly the stunning water park paradise. Here you can enjoy several heated outdoor pools, a heated indoor pool and several paddling pools with water toys. Have a race down the double Twister slide, brave the lightning-fast Spacebowl and head to the Tsunami for a backwards ride down on an inflatable tube.

properties.name: Capfun Camping Pachy
properties.description:
Just outside Fosses-la-Ville, a small village in the peaceful countryside of Wallonia, lies Capfun Camping Pachy. Thanks in part to its wonderful swimming pool complex, sports facilities, playgrounds and cafeteria, this is an ideal destination for holidaymakers who enjoy spending the whole day at the campsite.
