During the high season, plenty of fun activities are organised, especially for primary school-aged children.

Child-friendly resort – and partially car-free

At this resort you will find a variety of modern mobile homes and holiday cottages, suitable for four to ten people. If you have (young) children in your group, you can opt for accommodation with an extra playroom and located around a grassy area with a small playground. These places are usually completely car-free. These areas are usually completely car-free. Ideal for the little ones and their parents or carers!

Wonderful water park and children’s entertainment

This is an especially popular holiday destination for families with children during the high season. That’s because fun activities are organised several times a week for children aged between 4 and 10. This includes fun craft activities, active dance sessions and exciting treasure hunts. What’s more, there is regular evening entertainment during the summer holidays. Children can also enjoy themselves in the spectacular water park with a paddling pool. There are also three water slides, including a spectacular Spacebowl.

Visit beautiful Namur and Dinant

This bungalow park is conveniently located near several attractions in Wallonia. For example, the city of Namur (19 km) with its charming town centre, historic buildings and imposing citadel, is well worth a visit. Also head to Dinant (27 km), known for its colourful village centre on the Meuse and its citadel, situated much higher up. Closer to the campsite, you can enjoy lovely walks and bike rides.

properties.name: Capfun Camping Le Sagittaire
properties.description:
This French campsite is situated on a beautiful open landscape in the Drôme, surrounded by the colourful fields that are so characteristic of this region. Here you will camp at the foot of an impressive low mountain range close to the beautiful town of Vaison-la-Romaine, whch is known for its Roman bridge. At Capfun's Le Sagittaire Campsite, families with children can enjoy themselves all day long. This holiday park offers great sports and play facilities. In addition, there is a wide range of activities for campers of all ages during high season. Le Sagittaire's crown jewel is its waterpark, where you can enjoy hours of fun splashing around in three beautiful swimming pools featuring at least eight spectacular water slides.

Focus on mobile homes, some of which have a special theme

Mobile homes are clearly the main type of accommodation at Le Sagittaire Campsite. There are models of varying designs and sizes, some of which have a special theme. Think of mobile homes that are completely decorated in the style of a pirate ship, for example. In addition to rental accommodation units, there are also a few dozen pitches for tourist campers at this well-maintained recreation park.

Entertainment for the whole family

During the high season, the evening entertainment consists of fun shows, game nights and foam parties. In the summer months, children from 4 to 6 years old can join the mini club, while slightly older children can join the kids club. Together they can do crafts, dance, play games or go on a scavenger hunt. You will also find a unique children's playground, a pump track and a cinema at this campsite.

properties.name: Capfun Camping Lou Village
properties.description:
Lou Village Campsite, situated right on the Mediterranean Sea in the south of France, is a family campsite with friendly staff, spacious pitches, and plenty of entertainment. The swimming paradise and the sea ensure plenty of fun in the water. At Lou Village campsite, you can fully enjoy the French beaches and the sea. The campsite is located on the popular beach Valras-Plage, right on the beach on the Mediterranean coast. Cities of culture such as Narbonne and Béziers are nearby; perfect for a day trip.

Campsite grounds

The pitches are spacious, and all have electricity. They are separate from the accommodation section, where you'll find different types of chalets and mobile homes, from standard to luxurious and extra-large.

Swimming Paradise

This campsite is particularly suitable for families with children, young and old. The can have fun in the swimming paradise which is over 2000m², with two children's pools, five water slides, and plenty of space to sunbathe. You can also sunbathe on the beach, which is just 50 metres from the campsite. It's not just swimming that's possible in the clear blue ocean here; the campsite also organises diving courses.

Entertainment

There's lots to do at the campsite. There's plenty of entertainment, with music, dancing, theatre, circus and a cabaret. There's a spectacle of some sort every evening at Lou Village - but they do make sure that things quieten down in time for everyone to get a good night's rest. Young people (from 4 to 12 years) can experience the most exciting adventures in the Pirate Club. Sporty types will find something to enjoy, with aerobics classes, aqua gym, and various sports tournaments.

properties.name: Camping De Eikenhof
properties.description:
On the outskirts of the village of Oldemart, in the north-western corner of Overijssel ('Kop van Overijssel'), Camping de Eikenhof has been a household name for some 50 years. The many cycling and walking routes in this watery area will let you experience the beauty of the region in a sporty way.

Camping amidst green

The camping pitches of Camping de Eikenhof are located in a quiet part of the campsite and close to the playground, where it is a bit more lively. In addition to the demarcated pitches, you can also camp on lawns surrounded by woodland. All pitches are spacious and well maintained, but the comfort pitches offer the most space. Apart from camping pitches, there is a section of the campsite with mobile homes, bungalows, trekker huts and wood lodges. Ideal if you want to rent ready-made accommodation.

Eating and drinking

The campsite has a homely restaurant where you have a choice of several dishes from a limited menu. This is a nice spot for a bite to eat or a drink. The terrace offers ample space for a relaxing moment in the sun or the shade.

Play paradise

Camping de Eikenhof is also a wonderful destination for families. During the summer months all kinds of activities are organised for children, from crafts afternoons to watching a movie together. Furthermore, there is a swimming pool, where tiny campers can play in the toddler pool. The colourful indoor playground is a highlight for children, as is the petting zoo with goats and kangaroos roaming in the spacious meadows. And the cherry on the cake: a climbing forest adjacent to the campsite.

properties.name: Capfun Vakantiepark De Fruithof
properties.description:
Are you looking for a beautiful vacation park in Drenthe with a lovely pool and swimming lake, good facilities and a beautiful walking and cycling environment? Then you're in the right place at this campsite. During the May or summer vacations, children can play and swim endlessly. You can sit here quietly in a beautiful part of the Netherland in the early and late seasons. The facilities are also tiptop.

When you arrive at the campsite, you immediately see the green and rural grounds with lots of space. A spacious parking lot is in front of the campsite, right in front of the reception, where you will also find extensive tourist information. Here you will receive a warm and hospitable welcome.

Beautiful camping fields

When you go to your pitch or accommodation, you will immediately notice how neat and well-maintained this park is. A paved path runs across the property; in the middle is a circular field and a field around the swimming pond. The pitches are playfully laid out and spacious, and the grass is well-cut. You will find spots in the sun and the shade; bushes delimit some spots. The atmosphere on the camping fields is very friendly. The campsite is especially popular among Dutch and German campers. In the high season, it is a cosy family campsite and an ideal base for hiking and biking in the low season. The campsite has clean and modern plumbing. The building is heated, and there is also a baby room for young families.

properties.name: Capfun Camping De Pekelinge
properties.description:
In the restful environment of the Zeeland island of Walcheren and close to the cleanest beaches in the Netherlands, you will find this well-cared-for campsite. The touring pitches are neatly maintained and spacious. For those who prefer to rent accommodation, there is plenty of choice – from mobile homes to chalets to wooden cabins. Capfun Camping De Pekelinge offers entertainment for everyone. Enjoy water fun in one of the pools, relax in the indoor play paradise, take part in archery or laser gaming, and cuddle with the animals at the petting zoo. Are you a true beach lover? Then get your fill at one of the many picture-perfect beaches in the area.

Travel to beautiful Zeeland

To reach the campsite, follow the N57 from Middelburg towards the sea. Turn left onto the N287. Just outside Oostkapelle, Capfun Camping de Pekelinge is located in a quiet area. This lovely campsite is located 3 kilometres from the sea. From here, it is only 10 minutes by car to the vacation resort of Domburg. Arriving at the campsite, you are welcomed by the friendly receptionists and can then quickly go to your pitch.

Spacious pitches and beautiful accommodations

At Capfun Camping de Pekelinge, you will stay on spacious pitches in various fields that are neatly maintained. There are several sanitary buildings on the campsite. These facilities are always well cleaned. For those without their own camping equipment, the campsite offers a wide range of luxury rental accommodations. Rent one of the cosy wooden mobile homes, some of which are specially equipped for a stay with small children.

properties.name: Capfun Camping De Rotonde
properties.description:
This large family camping site is located in the municipality of West Betuwe. There is plenty to do in the area, but you won't be bored at the campsite itself either. In peak season, the entertainment team organises activities for the whole family. Water is never far away at Capfun Camping de Rotonde thanks to the swimming lake, fishing pond and indoor heated swimming pool.

Family campsite

Capfun Camping de Rotonde is a large family campsite with camping pitches, season pitches and rental accommodations. The luxury mobile homes are available in variants for two to eleven people. There is plenty for children to do at the campsite. There are several playgrounds, with the highlight being the water playground next to the swimming lake at the campsite. In peak season the entertainment team organises various activities. There is evening entertainment for the whole family three evenings per week. The atmosphere at the campsite is friendly and cozy.

Fun in the water

At Capfun Camping de Rotonde, the water is always close by. The campsite has a large swimming lake where you can cool off. Younger children can play in a shallow protected area of the lake. There is also a large water playground with movable flumes and pumps. Fun is guaranteed. Older children can swim in the deeper part of the lake. The adventure island in the water has places for climbing and scrambling. Speed demons whizz down the long slide by the lake. The campsite also has an indoor heated swimming pool. Fishing is possible in the fishing pond at the campsite.

properties.name: Capfun Camping Fort Bedmar
properties.description:
This lovely, family-friendly campsite offers entertainment both on and around the site. Capfun Camping Fort Bedmar is located near the village of De Klinge in Flanders. It is a comfortable campsite situated practically right on the border between East Flanders (Belgium) and the Dutch province of Zeeland. The fortified town of Hulst in Zeeland is just six kilometres away, and Flemish cities such as Sint-Niklaas and Antwerp are also within easy reach. From the campsite, you can enjoy some lovely walking and cycling routes through vast forests. The campsite itself has a nice location, partly surrounding a pond.

Spacious campsites and many modern mobile homes

This campsite features mainly modern accommodation units. For example, you can choose from a range of mobile homes in various sizes and styles. There are also a number of annual pitches, and of course there is space for touring visitors who come with their own caravans, motorhomes and/or tents. Some of the spacious camping pitches offer unobstructed views of the pond.

What can you do at this campsite?

Do you enjoy staying active and keeping fit while on holiday? Then this campsite is the perfect place for you. Feel free to challenge other campers to a game of tennis, table tennis or beach volleyball. Or have a go at football, handball or basketball on the multi-sports pitch. Of course, you can always swim a few laps in the heated outdoor pool, which also has a large paddling pool next to it. A great idea for the smallest campers, who will also enjoy the many playgrounds on the campsite. That includes a colourful playset castle with a high slide. The campsite also has a welcoming cafeteria with a pool table and a dartboard.

properties.name: Camping Aiguille Noire
properties.description:
In a mountain valley in the Italian province of Aosta shines the green valley Val Veny. The Aiguille Noire campsite sits at the heart of this oasis, about ten minutes by car from the town of Courmayeur. You can camp here in complete harmony with the surrounding impressive nature.

Recharge in nature

Campers can choose from a variety of great options for spending the night on the flat pitches. If you come with your tent, caravan or camper van, you can set up your pitch in the large open field or on the edge of the site among the many Larch trees. Or choose a fully equipped hikers cabin, bungalow, sturdy camping pod, glamping tent with a transparent roof or an apartment. Wherever you are on the campsite, this is the view you want to wake up to every day.

Wellness at the campsite

The natural environment helps you to unwind completely. But also a yoga class, a visit to the sauna, or a wonderful massage will help create an unforgettable experience in the open air of the Aosta Valley. Every week there is even a beautician, and there's a small pool for the swimmers. And if that isn't enough luxury!

Eating pizza whilst enjoying the view

At the campsite, you will find a pizzeria-restaurant with a cosy terrace. You can also enjoy the view from the wooden picnic benches. The small supermarket offers a good assortment, and there is a common room for camping guests. We haven't forgotten about young children. They can play on the slide and the swings in the playgrounds between the trees.

properties.name: Camping Höllensteinsee
properties.description:
Camping Höllensteinsee is a paradise on earth. The couple that manages the campsite, is full of enthusiasm to perfect this campsite. The campsite is in an idyllic location in the Bavarian Forest: on a promontory in a curving, wide section of the Regen River, where the lake is called the Höllensteinsee. Key words on the campsite: tranquillity, green and water.

Experience nature in optima forma

You can select your own pitch, level and not demarcated. There are some 150 pitches, half of which directly on the water. There are a large number of trees on the grounds, although the pitches are rather open. The sanitary building has the luxury of a hotel. This is an ideal campsite to experience nature, peace and fun! You can moor your canoe or kayak directly next to your pitch, so to speak.

Water activities

Camping guests consist largely of seekers of peace and nature such as anglers, swimmers and canoeists. In short: campers who like to enjoy themselves near water. In the holiday periods you will find many families and groups. Swimming and snorkelling in the lake is allowed. Favourite pastimes, however, are canoeing, rafting and fishing. Swimming in deep water is not recommended here, certainly not for the youngest swimmers. There is a pebble beach.

Catering

At the reception you will find a small canteen with limited menu. You can enjoy a meal and drinks at picnic tables under a canopy. There is not (as yet) a camping shop. Who knows..they may still build one. You can, however, get fresh bread.

properties.name: Grange Farm Campsite
properties.description:
Are you going on holiday in England and crossing the channel with the ferry from Hoek van Holland to Harwich? Grange Farm Campsite, near the village Thorpe-le-Soken (Essex), is your ideal first place to stay after you’ve crossed the channel. This small-scale farm campsite is less than 25 minutes from Harwich’s ferry terminal by car. It is handy that the campsite management takes the arrival times of the ferries into account. This is also a nice campsite for a longer stay. You then have the time to enjoy the typical English country life.

Small-scale campsite

This farm campsite has three attractive camping fields. Cherry Field and Brambles Field have grassy pitches, and the pitches on Brambles Field are suitable for tents and small caravans and motorhomes. Oak Field has a mix of grassy pitches and paved pitches.

Enjoy life on the farm

If you have always wanted to camp at a farm, the camping fields belong to an arable farm where there is lots of activity, in part due to the agricultural vehicles that drive around the grounds. At harvest time, the working day is long. Beautiful scenes: the combines and tractors that are busy with the harvest until late in the day while the sun slowly sinks below the horizon ...

What is there to do in the vicinity?

The surrounding area has lovely walks and bicycle rides through gently rolling landscapes. The nearest walk is one to the centre of the village of Thorpe-le-Soken (1.1 km). Be sure to visit one of the local pubs there. This campsite is a short distance away from the North Sea coast. Fun coastal resorts like Frinton-on-Sea, Clacton-on-Sea and Walton-on-the-Naze are only a fifteen-minute drive away.

properties.name: Feddet Strand Resort
properties.description:
A large, very well maintained family campsite in a beautiful location in eastern Denmark. A genuine countryside getaway with plenty to do for children of all ages. In addition to wonderful swimming pools, there is a miniature golf course, an indoor and outdoor playground and a bouncy castle in the summer. Feddet Strand Resort lies on the coast in the Zealand region on a vast, child-friendly beach in the middle of a dunes.

Camping on the Danish coast

The holiday park of the same name is located between the towns of Praesto and Faxe Ladeplats, on the beautiful Feddet peninsula. Despite the spacious grounds with hundreds of pitches, you do get the feeling of being in the middle of the countryside here. The squirrels scuttle past and in the distance is the continuous sound of the sea.

Nature all around

Thanks to the size of the pitches, which vary from 110 to 150 square metres, there is sufficient privacy and you can choose a spot with shade from the trees or an open, sunny spot. All pitches are marked out and a separate field has been set up for tents. Campers also have adapted pitches with a hard surface. The modern and clean sanitary facilities are a big plus. And those who prefer to rent accommodation can stay in a luxury mobile home or a furnished holiday home.

Water paradise

Swim in the sea or in one of the luxurious swimming pools, both are possible when you are on holiday at Feddet Strand Resort. The sleekly designed water park consists of an indoor swimming pool and a 45-centimetre deep toddler pool. As a campsite guest, you can also make use of the spa free of charge.

properties.name: Camping Chalet Salten
properties.description:
On the sunny terraces above Bolzano, in the midst of the majestic Dolomites, lies Camping Chalet Salten. It is a small-scale campsite that focuses on enjoying outdoor living. However, there are no amenities lacking: everything has been taken care of, down to the last detail. The campsite offers a beautiful view and serves as a home base for outdoor activities or a visit to Merano or Bolzano.

Camping in the midst of the Dolomites

Contrary to what the name suggests, Camping Chalet Salten offers more than just luxury chalets as accommodation. The site also has spacious pitches, all with a breathtaking view of the Dolomites, part of UNESCO’s World Heritage List. The pitches, located in a long green arc, have been fitted with all of the necessary connections.

Relax at a high altitude

Camping Chalet Salten offers a comfortable holiday. For starters, the toilet facilities are clean and accessible. The site also has a mini-market with regional specialities. Not in the mood to cook? Then enjoy a delicious pizza in the restaurant. A playground has been constructed for the children to enjoy themselves. If you would like to explore the area by bicycle, you can rent one from the bicycle rental.

Beautiful mountainous landscape and lively cities

The campsite is located at a high altitude between the cities of Bolzano (17 km) and Merano (43 km). But the greatest attraction is the immediate surroundings of the campsite, with numerous trails for cycling and hiking. If the beauty of nature is what you seek, you are in the right place.

properties.name: Camping Sass Dlacia
properties.description:
Do you like mountain hiking, mountain biking, skiing, wellness, or just enjoying the beautiful alpine scenery? Then Sass Dlacia campsite in the Italian Dolomites is for you. At this beautiful and well-organised campsite, you can enjoy a wonderful outdoor holiday. Extra bonus: you can also pamper yourself in the wellness centre.

Varied campsites

As soon as you arrive at Camping Sass Dlacia you will notice that everything is in perfect order. The pitches are beautiful and naturally landscaped. They vary in size. This means that even very large caravans and motorhomes will always find a spot. But no matter where you stand, the view is amazing. The campsite also rents out a number of chalets, apartments and hiker's huts.

Pizza or breakfast

The campsite has a cosy restaurant where you can enjoy a pizza or other meal at reasonable prices. There is also a shop where you can get some daily products and local delicacies. Do you have a brisk morning or afternoon walk planned? Then you can also opt for a hearty breakfast at the campsite.

Active in nature

Mountain hiking, cycling, mountain biking, skiing, climbing, and via ferrata snowshoeing. Yes, for families there is plenty to do in the magnificent nature of the Dolomites. It is therefore not surprising that you won't find any children's clubs or other organised entertainment on the campsite itself. For the little ones, there is some playground equipment, and there is a cosy indoor area to play a game. And in the evening you can enjoy the starry sky.

properties.name: Nymindegab Familie Camping
properties.description:
Family campsite Nymindegab is located near the Danish North Sea coast, not far from the beautiful Ringkøbing Fjord. There is plenty to do for the children on this peaceful family campsite. The highlight is definitely the large heated swimming pool with a 22-metre high water slide. Nature lovers, hikers, cyclists and water sports enthusiasts, on the other hand, can enjoy the beautiful area surrounding the Ringkøbing Fjord and the wide, sandy beaches along the North Sea.

Campsite in the dunes

The campsite partly blends in with the surrounding nature, giving the campsite a peaceful atmosphere. The camping pitches vary in size, but they are well-tended and reasonably marked. There are pitches available both in the woods and on open terrain.

In the peak season, mainly Danish, German and Dutch families with children stay at the campsite.

Swimming, sliding and golfing

As you drive onto the campsite, the heated swimming pool with the 22-metre long water slide immediately draws your attention. The children can enjoy themselves here just fine, and if they're not in the mood for swimming, the campsite also features a giant air pillow, playground equipment, gaming machines, a pool table and a TV room. It's also worth playing a game of mini golf on the miniature golf course, which is designed as a Japanese garden.

Walk to the beach

The area is well-known for its beautiful wide and sandy beaches, so a visit to the North Sea is a must when staying at this campsite. You can walk to the beach from the campsite via a paved road through the dunes (2 km).

properties.name: Camping Miramare
properties.description:
Camping Village Miramare is situated on the tip of the Cavallino peninsula, the elongated promontory which separates the Venice Lagoon from the Adriatic Sea. You are just a stone's throw away from the docks of the ferries to Venice and the lagoon islands. For people looking for a quiet spot from which to visit Venice, this is an ideal campsite, even more so because you leave your car here and take the ferry across to San Marco Square.

Beach (temporarily) inaccessible

Miramare is a neat small-scale campsite. The camping pitches are spacious. In addition, there are mobile homes and bungalows to rent. Due to the proximity of the dock for the ferries, Miramare is an excellent base for people wanting to visit Venice. For beach lovers, Miramar is less well-suited at the moment. On the beaches in the direct vicinity of the campsite, a barrier is being built which should protect Venice against flooding.

Camping without frills

In terms of campsites, Miramare is of standard quality. It does not offer entertainment, which you will find at other campsites. However, there is a moderately sized swimming pool with separate children's pool, a sunbathing lawn and a bar. In the direct vicinity you will only find a few restaurants, no shops. The camping shop only stocks the bare necessities.

Sanitary facilities

The sanitary facilities are not very modern but are kept neat and tidy.

Why visit here?

To make the crossing by boat from Punta Sabbioni to Venice. The boat trip is an unforgettable experience when you approach the famous San Marco Square over the water via Lido.

properties.name: Red Kite Touring Park
properties.description:
Welcome to the beautiful Mid-Wales! Red Kite Touring Park is an adults-only campsite with stunning views over the valley. You’ll camp just a 20-minute walk from the historic town of Llanidloes, the first town on the River Severn. It’s ideal for daily shopping or a visit to the local pub. Red Kite Touring Park is open all year round. Even in winter, you can enjoy peace, the starry sky, and excellent facilities.

Views over the Clywedog Valley

This well-maintained campsite caters to adults with motorhomes or caravans. You can choose from one of over sixty standard or premium pitches, including spaces for large motorhomes. As the campsite is built on the southern slope of the hill, you’ll have breathtaking views over the Clywedog Valley. The owners have a special place in their hearts for dogs. There is a 4-hectare dog-walking area, a dog pond, a fenced dog-training area, and a dedicated dog wash station.

Adults Only: ultimate peace and comfort

Red Kite Touring Park has a small shop for essential items, and for larger shopping trips, you can venture out. The facilities, including the bathrooms, are modern and spotlessly clean. The site also has a fishing pond with carp, bream, and tench, where you can fish daily for a small fee. If you wish, you can even camp just 100 metres from the pond. The campsite is perfect for those seeking peace and quiet, dog lovers, and hikers. As it is an adults-only campsite, you’ll find ultimate relaxation and tranquility here.

properties.name: Camping Miramar
properties.description:
Camping Miramar is located on the southern side of the German island of Fehmarn. It is a popular holiday island with plenty of opportunities for water sports enthusiasts. This family campsite features many sporting and fun activities, entertainment in the high season, a minigolf course and access to the sandy beach. Have a refreshing drink or ice cream at the beach bar and in the evening, enjoy a meal at the Globetrotter restaurant.

Also for motorhomes

Camping Miramar is a large campsite with spacious camping pitches. The well-maintained access roads and spacious pitches also make this a suitable holiday location for motorhome owners. The annual pitches are located at the back of the campsite; the touring pitch fields are located closer to the sea. Hedges separate the various camping fields, but there is less demarcation on the fields themselves. 

Vibrant square

Centrally located on the campsite is a square where you will also find the restaurant and supermarket. In the high season, it tends to be pleasantly busy. That's when the campsite draws many (German) families who come here to enjoy the sun and sea. In the low season, guests come here for hiking and cycling in the surrounding rural area. 

Water and playing fun

The campsite is a paradise for water enthusiasts, especially when the sun is shining. The wide sandy beach is a perfect spot for some sunbathing and a refreshing dive in the sea. The beach has separate areas for water sports and people who want to go boating. There is also a separate area for naturists. But there is also plenty to do on dry land. The campsite also has a field with play equipment, a minigolf course, a table tennis table, a beach volleyball field and an indoor playground.

properties.name: Camping La Nouzarède
properties.description:
La Nouzarède is situated on the outskirts of the charming village of Joyeuse in the Ardèche. This is a real family campsite with a large swimming pool, paddling pool and whirlpool. There are lots of outdoor activities for the children in the surrounding area. The medieval village of Joyeuse offers many advantages for the camper, such as shops, a supermarket, cafés and the large weekly market. Everything is close by, even within walking distance.

Comfortable camping

There are touring pitches measuring, on average, 100 m2. The Grand Comfort pitches (120 m2) have water points and drainage and electricity. The pitches have a hardened surface. There are also mobile homes and chalets available for rent. Gîtes are available for rent just outside the campsite.

Fun in the water

Campsite La Nouzarède has a heated swimming pool. You will also find a separate paddling pool and whirlpool here. Surrounding the pool is a large tiled terrace. This is situated in the full sun and lies adjacent to the restaurant patio.

The river Beaume is close by, with refreshing and clear water and a spacious sand and pebble beach. It's an ideal river for boating, swimming and fishing. You can reach the river via the campsite's back gate. You will be there in no time!

Eating and drinking

For something to eat you can visit the restaurant. Here, you will also find a snack bar, a pizzeria, a bar and a patio. The campsite shop only supplies the essential groceries. The supermarket in Joyeuse is within walking distance from the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Ansitz Wildberg
properties.description:
At Camping Ansitz Wildberg, located in the picturesque Sankt Lorenzen in South Tyrol, you step into a world where the nostalgia of the past is still tangible. You can wonderfully relax around the old farm amid the charm, surrounded by the fresh scents of flowers and wood while the waterfall splatters quietly in the background. It is a place where you can completely unwind and take the time to enjoy the outdoor life.

Modern comfort in the Wildberg Badl

The modern Wildberg Badl offers spacious toilet and washing facilities with an extremely luxurious vibe, including special amenities for children and family showers. The heated outdoor swimming pool with waterfall and paddling pool are open daily from May to early October. And for those seeking ultimate relaxation, the sauna in the Mühlhäusl invites you to completely unwind.

Meet the campsite animals

Animals are part of the family at Camping Ansitz Wildberg! Children can meet ponies and donkeys every morning at 10 am. The curious lamas are ready for some attention, while goats, guinea pigs rabbits and chickens cheer the place up.

Explore South Tyrol with ease

The village of Sankt Lorenzen is within a fifteen-minute walk from the campsite. The surrounding area is perfect for walking and cycling trips. At Camping Ansitz Wildberg, you can also make use of free bus and train tickets for the whole of South Tyrol. With bus stops at only 300 metres away and free entrance to more than 80 museums in South Tyrol, this campsite is an ideal starting point for an unforgettable holiday.

properties.name: Camping Völlan
properties.description:
Camping Völlan in Lana, South Tyrol, is a small-scale, family-friendly campsite located between luscious apple orchards and forests. The family that runs the campsite is ready to open you with open arms from the first signs of spring to the lasts rays of the autumn sun. Leave the stresses of every day behind and dive into a world of quiet, enjoyment and discovery in the area around the city of Merano.

Relaxation by the swimming pool

Enjoy the breathtaking views from the campsite, located at an altitude of 650 metres. It offers a panoramic view of the valley and is an ideal starting point for active holidaymakers. Camping Völlan is a terraced campsite with comfortable camping pitches of between 80 to 90 m2 in size. The swimming pool is exactly what you need on hot days. It's ideal for relaxing, playing, reading or simply enjoying the view. Children can have plenty of fun in the playground or at the tennis table and indoor football table.

Picnics and walking with alpacas

Discover the shop filled with fresh regional produce, varying from fresh bread and fruit to local dairy products and South Tyrolean specialities such as smoked bacon, cheese and wine. Here, you will also find all the other daily groceries you need during your stay at the campsite.

Cycling to Merano

Explore the campsite's impressive surroundings on foot or by bike. The charming centre of Merano is only a 35-minute bike ride from the campsite. With the free public transport card that Camping Völlan makes available and with a bus stop right by the campsite, you will be there in no time!

properties.name: Camping St. Josef am Kalterer See
properties.description:
Camping St. Josef am Kalterer See is in the Italian province of South Tyrol, right by Lake Kaltern (Lago di Caldaro). Here, you are surrounded by vineyards and fruit trees and there is the perfect mix of mountains and lakes. Although this is a fantastic place to relax and unwind, you will also want to get active here and go cycling, walking and of course eat delicious food. In short, South Tyrol at its best!

Comfortable camping

With over 100 well-maintained motorhome and tent pitches, surrounded by natural greenery, this campsite guarantees camping comfort in the countryside. A lovely restaurant and café, covered in vines, a small shop and clean toilet and washing facilities ensure a pleasant stay.

Relaxing by the swimming jetty

A small path leads you straight to a lovely wooden jetty on the campsite's private beach. It's a wonderful spot for sunbathing, swimming, pedal boating and for enjoying the view. The turquoise water is exceptionally clear and offers views of the bottom of the lake.

The right tour for everyone

South Tyrol is known as a paradise for hiking enthusiasts, but what makes Kaltern and the immediate vicinity so appealing are the various hiking routes that are suitable for all kinds of hikers.

Wine village of Kaltern-Caldaro

The campsite is within a short distance (5 km) of the wine village of Kaltern an der Weinstraße (Caldaro sulla Strada del Vino) with its lively squares and narrow streets. In the mornings, you will meet the local residents enjoying their espressos on the bustling market square, and in the evenings, people relaxing with a glass of wine after a day of work.

properties.name: Camping Al Plan - Dolomites
properties.description:
Camping Al Plan is your home away from home in the enchanting village of San Vigilio, South Tirol. Located on the edge if a wooded area and only a 7-minute walk from the centre, this small-scale campsite in the mountains offers a charming and relaxed atmosphere, both in the summer and in the winter. Camping Al Plan is one of the first campsites in South Tyrol with GSTC certification for sustainable tourism.

A beautiful view of the Dolomites

Each pitch gives you an amazing view of the impressive mountains and the picturesque valley of the Dolomites, whether you are on the tent field or have booked a motorhome pitch. The alpine glow of the Dolomites is a real ‘wow’ moment that you can experience every day during your stay to Camping Al Plan.

Culinary pampering at the campsite

You don’t have to leave the campsite to enjoy delicious food. At Arnold's Restaurant-Pizzeria you can enjoy local and international specialities. Whether you would like a quick bite or a sumptuous dinner, there is always something delicious on the menu!

Fanes-Senes-Braies Nature Park

The campsite is right next to the visitors’ centre of UNESCO’s World Heritage Site Fanes-Senes-Braies Nature Park. Here you can enjoy amazing walks and other activities, in both the summer and the winter. There is also a large playground and a summer yurt for yoga and meditation.

For the adventurous among us, the challenging mountain bike paths of South Tirol are waiting to be explored, starting right at the campsite. And, in the winter, your snow adventures begin right in front of your pitch as well. After a day filled with activities, you can relax in the sauna.

properties.name: Waldcamping
properties.description:
At Waldcamping in Naturns, located in South Tirol, you are in the middle of the countryside. Surrounded by the imposing Alps, lush apple orchards and the cheerful chirping of birds, this green oasis with 315 sunny days per year offers a perfect holiday destination for the entire family.

Spacious pitches and private toilet facilities

The pitches at Waldcamping are nice and spacious, with around 100 m2 per pitch. For extra comfort, you could choose a pitch with private toilet facilities or a comfortable apartment. The central garden at the campsite entices cozy get-togethers, a game of table tennis with the family, or simply an opportunity to relax in a hammock while you enjoy the view.

Fresh delicacies at the campsite kiosk

The main building contains a charming campsite kiosk from which the smell of freshly baked rolls and croissants will greet you early in the morning. In addition to the delicious rolls, you will also find local farm products, home-made apple juice, fresh vegetables and fruit from the garden as well as home-made jam and cakes.

Swimming fun and playing fun

For fun in the water, there is a covered swimming pool. On sunny days, the nearby sunbathing area is the ideal place to relax on chaise longues while the children amuse themselves in the shade. The adventurous playground at the edge of the campsite offers amusement for all ages. The little ones can enjoy themselves in the sand and water playground.

Exploring the area

For active holidaymakers and nature lovers, there are many activities in the area, such as mountain biking, cycling and hiking. Highly recommended is an excursion to Naturnser Sonnenberg, which hikers can climb with the assistance of the Unterstell cable car.

properties.name: Camping Markushof
properties.description:
The idyllic Camping Markushof is in the village of Ora in the Italian South Tyrol. The campsite is quiet and surrounded by lots of natural greenery and vineyards. You also have stunning views of the surrounding mountains. If you like the countryside and are a walking or cycling enthusiast, then this is the ideal holiday spot. Camping Markushof is focused on the over 50s. The campsite is not suitable for children under the age of 16.

Natural green campsite for those seeking peace and quiet

Camping Markushof has 58 camping pitches ranging in size from 80 to 100 m². There is plenty of natural planting, including apple and palm trees, which provide shade and privacy. It makes you feel like you are camping in the middle of the countryside. If you pitch at the edge of the campsite, you will have the fortune of enjoying the beautiful views of the vineyards and mountain tops.

Swimming with a view

The swimming pool is by reception. It is ideal for a wonderful, refreshing swim. There are sun loungers and parasols around the swimming pool where you can also enjoy the mountain views. The campsite is in the rural wine village of Ora, which means you are within walking distance of charming restaurants, bars and shops.

Discover Lago di Caldaro

Lago di Caldaro is only 4.5 kilometres from the campsite. This is one of the cleanest and warmest lakes in Italy. You can take lovely walks around the lake and there are numerous walking and cycling routes. You are also at the right place for water sports such as windsurfing and sailing.

properties.name: Camping Goldrain Cevedale
properties.description:
Camping Goldrain Cevedale is in the stunning region of South Tyrol, where you are surrounded by the Austrian Alps. They are of course an irresistible attraction for sportive holidaymakers. Camping Goldrain Cevedale is an ideal starting point for an active mountain holiday. You can completely relax and unwind at this small-scale and neat campsite amid the orchards. After an active day of mountain hiking or cycling, enjoy a well-deserved swim in the lovely outdoor swimming pool.

Magical sunsets

With 51 camping pitches and one holiday home, Camping Goldrain Cevedale is a friendly and small-scale campsite. The camping pitches are divided into normal and larger premium pitches. The pitches are well maintained and are shaded by small trees. The campsite is an oasis of peace and quiet and is surrounded by orchards and vineyards. You look out over the impressive mountain peaks on both sides of the valley. The coloured sunsets create a magical spectacle in the evenings.

Dive into the swimming pool

In the summer months, you can enjoy the wonderful outdoor swimming pool at Camping Goldrain Cevedale. The swimming pool is open in June, July and August, sometimes longer or sometimes shorter depending on the temperature. It's a wonderful place for cooling down and relaxing after an active mountain hike or mountain bike trip. Furthermore, the campsite has all the basic necessities for a relaxing stay. You can buy fresh bread rolls and some basic necessities and there is a recreation area. There is some playground equipment for the little ones. There is no organised entertainment.

properties.name: Camping Mals
properties.description:
Camping Mals is in the extreme north of Italy, on the outskirts of the eponymous village. Here, you camp right by the border with Switzerland and at about 135 kilometres from Liechtenstein. This family campsite mainly attracts people with young children and seniors. It is quiet here and the area is perfect for walking.

Absolutely stunning view of the mountains

You look out over the stunning glaciers of the Ortler mountain from the pitches at the campsite. Camping Mals is a terraced campsite giving you absolutely stunning views. The campsite's toilet and washing facilities have recently been expanded. There are spacious showers with underfloor heating.

Free swimming and bread rolls from a basket

This campsite does not have extensive entertainment teams or disco evenings, making it nice and quiet. There is a playground for the little ones and public transport is on the doorstep. The Sportwell recreation centre is within a few minutes' walk (250 metres), and where campsite guests can use the swimming pool for free.

Get on the train

As mentioned, the train station is close by (150 metres). It is also a big a plus for this campsite. You can also transport yourself by bike or mountain bike. There is a 80-kilometre cycle path through the valley: the Vinschgauer cycle path. Finally, South Tyrol offers plenty of other amazing things. If you are going out with your children, the descent with special carts at the Watles mountains are great fun.

properties.name: Camping Tisens
properties.description:
In Tisens, a municipality in South Tirol, lies Camping Natur Caravanpark Tisens. You will find yourself among the apple orchards in the Adige Valley, in the centre of the Dolomites. All of the campsite’s amenities exude luxury. There is always plenty to do: from the heated swimming pool to guided walking tours and quaint villages and towns in the neighbourhood.

Varied locations for each holidaymaker

Camping Natur Caravanpark Tisens offers plenty of variety with regard to pitches. Nicely in the shade, full in the sun, or a little bit of both. There are also pitches that give you a beautiful panoramic view of the Gampen Pass. Whether you are travelling with a tent, caravan or motorhome (paved pitches, even for lengths of more than 5.5 metres), you will always find a nice spot at this campsite.

Want a delicious meal? The choice is huge!

Don’t feel like cooking? There is an extensive choice at the campsite. There is a bar, snack bar, a pizzeria and a campsite restaurant. In other words, there is plenty to eat. You could also take along a gas barbecue and start grilling yourself. Is your gas cylinder empty? Simply exchange it here.

There is plenty for sports enthusiasts to do at Camping Natur Caravanpark Tisens as well. There is a great heated swimming pool, with a separate wading pool and sunbathing area, where you can splash about from early in the morning until late in the evening. You can explore the area via one of the many hiking paths in the area or take advantage of the guided walking tours that the campsite offers.

properties.name: Camping Montiggl
properties.description:
Camping Montiggl is located in South Tirol’s Appiano sulla Strada del Vino. This medium-sized campsite is located in the heart of the nature reserve Montiggl forest, making it the ideal place for a quiet camping holiday. Relax in the swimming lake or at one of the Montiggl lakes, visit one of the wine taverns in the area or go out into nature.

Spacious pitches for all types of camping equipment

Camping Montiggl has 80 spacious and sunny pitches, all with electricity and drinking water and waste water connections. All types of camping equipment are welcome here, including motorhomes that are longer than 5.5 metres. There is also a motorhome service station. For motorhomes that are passing through, the campsite has separate motorhome parking spots with their own toilet facilities.

Relaxation, action and enjoyment

The campsite has a large swimming lake with sun loungers on the covered terrace. If you want some action, rent an e-bike or a car to explore the area. Not in the mood to cook? There is plenty of choice – the campsite has a snack bar, a pizzeria and a restaurant.

The countryside and the city

The nature reserve has two lakes with a beautiful panoramic view of the forest. For active holidaymakers, there are various hiking and cycle routes through the area. There is also a special walking tour that takes you past three castles in the area. The region is also known for the many wine taverns and wines that are produced here.

properties.name: Alpina Mountain Resort Caravan Park
properties.description:
At the foot of the majestic mountain Ortler lies the Alpina Mountain Resort Caravan Park, one of the highest campsites in Europe. The resort provides direct access to the ski resort in Solda, which has kilometres of slopes. If you are going in the summer, be sure to take along your hiking boots because, during the hot months, the area turns into a paradise for hikers.

Camping at an altitude of 1,920 metres

Alpina Mountain Resort Caravan Park offers pitches for both motorhomes and caravans at a high altitude. The camping site is paved and is located on a hill that is slightly lower than the rest of the village, including the resort. The camping site does provide power but be sure to take along an extension cable that is at least 25 metres long.

Access to the resort

When you book a pitch, you have access to all resort facilities, including a restaurant, pizzeria, and a spa with a swimming pool and sauna. The location also offers conveniences: there is a shop and a bank within walking distance. Bring the children to the playground in the neighbourhood.

An active Alpine holiday

Spending your winter sports holiday in the Italian Alps and the Solda ski area means pleasure fun in the snow on 44 km of varying levels of slopes with modern lifts and a fun park. Skiing for the first time? The ski school at Solda would love to teach you all you need to know.

There is plenty to do here in the summer as well. The hiking area in Stelvio National Park is known for its fourteen mountain tops and its beautiful natural landscape.

properties.name: Sandgold Alpine Glamping
properties.description:
Sandgold Alpine Glamping is a small holiday paradise amid high mountains, fir trees, larches and pine trees. You can enjoy the peace of the forests and the sound of the brook from your camping pitch or luxury chalet. It is not a traditional campsite, but a resort equipped with many luxury amenities. The campsite is known for its hospitable and friendly atmosphere, making you instantly feel at home.

Sleep on poles

The campsite has a range of camping pitches for caravans and motorhomes, all located around a natural lake with stunning views. All camping pitches are equipped electricity and water. The chalets at Sandgold Alpine Glamping are unique due to their design; they are on poles in and around the natural lake.

Luxury toilets and washing facilities

The general meeting room and Greenhouse restaurant is the central point of the campsite. You can relax with a snack and drink in this modern and beautiful glass greenhouse. The toilet and washing facilities in the Greenhouse are modern and have a high level of comfort, with individually lockable rooms with a shower, hand basin and toilet. So not your standard campsite toilet and washing facilities. If you'd rather have your own bathroom throughout your stay, you can hire private toilet and washing facilities.

Saunas and baths

Cascade Spa is within a five-minute walk. This facility is managed by the campsite. It offers more than 3,500 m2 of sauna amenities including five saunas, a natural swimming lake and a heated outdoor swimming pool. Guests of certain accommodation can use these facilities for free, while others can benefit from an attractive discount.

properties.name: Camping Bergkristall
properties.description:
If you really want to camp in a peaceful spot, Camping Bergkristall in the Italian South Tyrol is for you. This campsite, with about 40 camping pitches, is in a stunning location in the Alps. Bordering a pine and spruce forest, this is a lovely starting point for long walking trips. There is a small camping pond and you can fish in the nearby Pfeldererbach stream with a fishing permit.

Plenty to beautiful things to see in the surrounding area

In the mornings, you can get fresh bread rolls at the reception. In the evenings, you can enjoy a pizza delivered to your door or visit one of the restaurants in the vicinity. A bus ticket is included in the overnight price, as is a return trip on the Bergbahnen Pfelders cable car. In the summer, you have free admission to the outdoor swimming pools in Martin and St Leonhard. You can go for excellent walks and mountain bike rides through the Alps in the vicinity of the campsite. There are plenty of mountain peaks to climb, alpine meadows to visit and mountain huts to relax in. You will also find several climbing walls. Plenty of reasons to explore the surrounding area.

Conquer night skiing or walking through the mountains

The campsite is open all year round and it is well equipped for winter sports. If you enjoy skiing, cross-country skiing skating or sledging, you will really like this campsite. You can go night skiing, book a guided skiing tour or go on a night walk in the surrounding area. This campsite has a separate room for drying your skis and hiking boots. So no worries about wet feet!

properties.name: Camping Komodo
properties.description:
At Camping Komodo in South Tirol’s municipality of Gargazon, you camp among the apple orchards in the heart of the Etschtal. The campsite has its own fruit orchard, an herb garden, a barbecue pit and its own cafe in the centre of Gargazon. Whether you are looking for a peaceful or sporty holiday, Camping Komodo is the ideal home base.

View of the Etschtal

The campsite has 60 spacious pitches with electricity. There are also six compact bungalows that can fit two guests, each with its own terrace offering a beautiful view of the Etschtal. Sustainability is of paramount importance at Camping Komodo. They have a solar and photovoltaic system for hot water and power generation.

A farmer’s life outdoors

Want to enjoy a gourmet breakfast? Visit the Rustner Hof Cafè, a 14th-century farm in the centre of Gargazon, run by the same family. The campsite also has a barbecue pit with seating, an outdoor kitchen and an herb garden. The farm shop sells fresh vegetables, fruit and beer. Just a two-minute walk from the campsite is a swimming lake for lots of fun in the water.

The countryside and the city

The centre of Gargazon is 1.5 kilometres away, which is where you can find a supermarket, pizzeria, bakery and motorhome service. The campsite lies directly on a cycle route and there are numerous walking tours in the area. Bolzano (20 km) and Merano (10 km) are nearby should you want an excursion to a city. Do you like travelling with public transport? A bus and train station is just a two-minute walk from the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Residence Sägemühle
properties.description:
Camping Residence Sägemühle is in the village of Prad am Stilfserjoch, in the middle of the Val Venosta in South Tyrol. If you are looking for a good starting point for an extremely varied range of mountain sports then this campsite is ideal. Here, you have plenty of options for walking, mountain climbing, mountain biking and paragliding. Moreover, this luxury campsite is surrounded by various winter sports resorts.

Neatly maintained site with a focus on camping

This excellently maintained site is mainly suitable for campers who like authentic camping. Tourist pitches are clearly in the majority here. There are touring pitches in three categories: standard, comfort and premium. At Camping Residence Sägemühle, not only can you book a stay on a lovely pitch but also in a modern mobile home or in a luxury apartment.

What entertainment does the campsite offer?

Even though there is so much to do in this part of South Tyrol, you won't get bored if you stay an entire day at the campsite. Go to the lovely swimming pool for example, where a lazy river, a waterfall and paddling pool offer relaxation. Camping Residence Sägemühle also has a wellness zone and a good restaurant beside the swimming pool.

Enjoy the unspoiled countryside on foot, by bike or on skis

Nature lovers and active campers can enjoy the beautiful area around Prad throughout the year. You can take numerous mountain bike rides and (mountain) walks from the campsite, such as through or over the mountains to the south and west of the village. A visit to Stelvio National Park is highly recommended, this unspoiled nature park is a bit further south.

properties.name: Camping Kiefernhain
properties.description:
Camping Kiefernhain is on the edge of Prad am Stilfserjoch, a lovely village in the Vinschgau Valley. This region has a lot to offer mountain sports enthusiasts above all. Nature lovers and those seeking peace and quiet are also in the right place here, as this part of Northern Italy is known for its unspoiled countryside. The fact you camp in the sunniest part of South Tyrol here is ideal. The campsite itself is well maintained and is right next to a large swimming pool that you can use for free as a campsite guest.

Authentic campsite in a lovely pine forest

Anyone who likes authentic nature campsites will certainly be happy at this campsite. The level campsite only has tourist camping pitches. You benefit from plenty of shade of the pine trees on most pitches. For sun worshippers, there are also pitches without shade.

Have fun splashing about in the adjacent outdoor swimming pool

This campsite is right next to the Prad am Stilfserjoch's municipal outdoor swimming pool. All guests at Camping Kiefernhain can use this swimming pool for free. There are two basic swimming pools, one of which is big enough for swimming laps. There is also a 42-metre-long water slide you can enjoy whizzing down. Meanwhile, the youngest campers can enjoy the paddling pool, also with a small slide.

Ideal destination for mountain sports enthusiasts

The Vinschgau is a wide valley with plenty of options for nature lovers and fans of active mountain sports. There are various lovely (mountain) walking and mountain bike routes around Prad. Moreover, in the immediate vicinity you can go mountain climbing, paragliding and skiing (in winter) to your heart's content.

properties.name: Camper Park Terlano
properties.description:
Camper Park Terlano is an ideal base for exploring South Tyrol. You’re close to the motorway, yet as soon as you park your motorhome you find yourself surrounded by the greenery of Trentino–Alto Adige. The owners give you a warm welcome. It’s a peaceful place where you can enjoy the fresh mountain air. The area is perfect for walking or cycling, and the cities of Bolzano and Merano are just around the corner.

Well-maintained camper pitches

The well-kept site offers paved camper pitches laid out next to each other, with lovely views of the surrounding mountains. Check-in is done at the automatic terminal, ideal after a long day on the road. The sanitary facilities are modern and comfortable, with stylish showers and clean toilets. Travelling with a caravan? That’s possible too, as long as you let them know in advance.

Everything you need

The facilities make your stay extra comfortable. There is a laundry area with washing machines and dryers, and washing-up liquid is provided as well. Handy if you’ve already been travelling for a few days. The friendly owners are happy to offer you a glass of wine from their own vineyard. These homemade wines are also available to buy as a lovely souvenir to take home.

Nature and culture close by

From Camper Park Terlano you can head straight into nature for a beautiful walk. Or cycle towards Bolzano or Merano and enjoy vineyards and mountain panoramas along the way. Prefer to stay closer by? The village of Terlan is within walking distance. Pick up fresh bread from the local bakery or take a seat at one of the small restaurants in the village.

properties.name: Camping Main-Spessart-Park
properties.description:
In the north of Bavaria, about five hundred kilometres from Utrecht and forty kilometres from Würzburg, the neat and nice Main-Spessart-Park Campsite is nestled among the vineyards. A wide variety of campers love this campsite. Families enjoy the adjacent pool, fun activities, and outings during the summer holidays. And culture and nature lovers can indulge themselves in this beautiful region full of rich history.

Hospitable, well cared for and excellent sanitary facilities

The Main-Spessart-Park Campsite is a green, well-kept campsite with spacious and well-maintained pitches. You have a view of the Main River from some of the pitches. You can also rent mobile homes and an apartment here or opt for a special overnight stay in a large wine barrel. The campers highly appreciate the nice and clean sanitary facilities. Scattered around the grounds are several sanitary buildings. There are special children's sanitary facilities, and one of the buildings has all the amenities for disabled campers.

Italian restaurant with schnitzels

For a pleasant meal, you can visit the campsite restaurant. Here, Italian cuisine is combined with local favourites. Schnitzel or pasta; the choice is yours. A few kilometres from the campsite is the town of Marktheidenfeld, where you can also find lovely restaurants and cafes. Next to the reception is a small store and you can get fresh rolls in the mornings from April to the end of October at the campsite.

Swimming, wine and culture

The campsite is three hundred meters from an outdoor swimming pool. That means plenty of swimming fun in the summer. In July and August, there are also fun activities for the children, such as sports tournaments, boat trips, outings and campfires.

properties.name: Camping Stobrec Split
properties.description:
Would you like to camp on a bay with a beautiful pebble beach? You can do that at the Stobrec Split campsite. The campsite is located in Dalmatia and, as the name implies, close to Split. After about a nine-kilometre drive, you are already in this beautiful port city. You don't have to leave the campsite to find entertainment, though: enjoy the wellness centre or a round of Zumba. Water lovers, meanwhile, can enjoy themselves in the sea.

Personalised counselling

You will be personally escorted to your pitch, mobile home or bungalow upon arrival. Meanwhile, feast your eyes on the sights. They know how to give a proper campsite atmosphere here! The grounds are lush green with beautiful flowers. Shrubs and oleanders surround the spacious pitches, and the mobile homes have beautiful gardens.

Swimming pool

Once you're settled in, of course, it's high time to take a look at the pool. This is not just any old campsite: this campsite has a real wellness centre by the sea! You can enjoy the jacuzzi, saunas and gym here for free.

Splash into the sea!

Are you feeling more like a quick dip? Then just walk to the sea. The campsite has no less than two beaches, so you can always find a place. The beach slopes gently, making it very suitable for children as well.

Entertainment

After a day of lazing around and swimming, your kids will probably enjoy having fun at the kids' disco or mini-karaoke. Or send them on a treasure hunt with the entertainment team. Who knows what they'll find!

properties.name: Aminess Style Camping Atea Resort
properties.description:
You will find Aminess Style Camping Atea Resort on the beautiful Croatian island of Krk. It is one of the first campsites after the bridge to the island, within walking distance of the town of Njivice. Here you can find several restaurants and bars. Nearby, of course, you will find the sea, several beautiful beaches, and nice picturesque villages. There is a pizzeria at the campsite itself.

A private pool in the garden

The campsite is well cared for and has many new (shady) pitches. The pitches are delineated by plants and equipped with water, a drain and electricity. Some of the pitches are equipped with a swimming pool.

If you want to stay in luxury, choose one of the many mobile homes. There are several types to choose from. With or without a view? With or without a private pool? It's all possible!

Fun: a special dog swimming spot

If you take your dog to this well-maintained campsite, they can swim in the sea here. There is a special area cordoned off on the beach for this purpose that even has some showers for four-legged friends.

For the children there is a special children's pool and a water playground between the mobile homes. There is an entertainment program at this campsite, and various sporting events are held. Also, follow one of our many workshops, such as the cooking workshop. Here you will learn to cook the most delicious local dishes. Ideal for surprising your family when you get home.

properties.name: Camping Brunner am See
properties.description:
This campsite has a beautiful location right on the Millstätter See in Carinthia. You camp here right by the clear blue water, with views of the mountains. So it is no coincidenc that the Brunner am See campsite won an ACSI Award in the category campsite with the most beautiful location in Austria in 2022. The campsite is located in the town of Döbriach, in fairly green surroundings.

Private beach on the Millstätter See

The medium-sized Brunner am See campsite is open all year round. The campsite is located directly on the water and has a private beach. Here you can soak up the sun and take a dip in the lake. Fishing is also permitted. The view of the lake from the beach is magnificent!

Forest playground

Across the road, which runs alongside the campsite, is a multi-purpose sports field which belongs to the campsite. Here you can ride on go-karts and play sports on a volleyball and football pitch. And of course there is also a table tennis table. There is also a forest playground with slides. For the little ones, there is an indoor playground.

Discover the region

In the Carinthia region, it is recommended to use the Kärnten card. You buy the card for a certain period and use it to do over a hundred activities in the area.

A 40-minute drive from the campsite is the Nockalmstrasse. This is one of the most beautiful panoramic roads through the mountains in Carinthia.

properties.name: Camping Veštar
properties.description:
Camp Veštar is located on the Croatian peninsula of Istria, between Rovinj and Bale. This large family campsite has recently been refurbished. The campsite has been completely renovated, with easily accessible pitches on pebble beds. Both the pitches and the paths are paved. Camping Veštar is a family campsite that is particularly popular with families with young children.

Paved paths and pitches

The large campsite covers fifteen hectares and is clearly laid out. The mostly straight paths are all paved. Camping Veštar has almost five hundred touring pitches, some permanent annual pitches and almost three hundred rental accommodations. Two hundred of these are mobile homes. These are located in a separate part of the campsite.

Isle in the swimming pool

In the middle of the campsite, between the section for touring campers and that for mobile homes, there is a beautiful swimming pool complex. It consists of several outdoor pools and a water playground. There is a deep swimming pool with a diving board, and a large recreational pool with an island and nice little bridges. On the tiled terrace are sun loungers and parasols.

Snorkeling

Camp Veštar is located directly on the Adriatic Sea, around a beautiful bay. Narrow pebble beaches have been laid out along the rocky shore and there is also a sunbathing lawn on the water's edge. In the clear water you can go snorkelling and scuba diving.

Bakery and ice-cream parlour

Scattered over the campsite you will find several restaurants. There is a pizzeria, a snack bar and a nice restaurant, located directly on the beach. Close to the swimming pool there are a few shops: a bakery, a fruit stall, a massage parlour and a shop with water sports equipment. There is also a bar and ice-cream parlour on the beach.

properties.name: Valamar Camping Lanterna
properties.description:
Looking for a lively family-friendly campsite for all ages? Then Valamar Camping Lanterna, just outside Poreč in Istria, is highly recommended. This is a large holiday park with all the trimmings. You will find a large water park, several beaches, supermarkets, a fresh market, entertainment for all ages, its own amphitheatre and plenty of sports and recreational facilities.

Planning to camp at Lanterna? Things to keep in mind

The sheer scale of this resort becomes apparent as soon as you arrive. The large car park houses several reception areas for a variety of organisations, although you can also check in online. Many of the pitches on this hilly campsite offer unobstructed views over the bay surrounding the campsite. Bringing your dog along? There is a special zone for campers with pets, including a vet clinic. Also good to know: due to the size of this holiday park, many people move around on (electric) folding bikes or scooters. There is also a little train that runs throughout the campsite.

Wide range of swimming pools, beaches and activities

If you decide to holiday at Lanterna, one thing is certain. You will certainly never get bored. The magnificent Aquamar swimming complex alone guarantees hours of fun. This open-air water park boasts no fewer than ten swimming pools! There are also a variety of water slides, a pirate ship and water toys. If you prefer swimming in the sea, you can do so from several of the campsite’s own beaches.

Fun activities are also organised at this resort, as well as evening entertainment. For example, you can enjoy a spectacular show in the resort’s own amphitheatre. You will also find a friendly atmosphere in the restaurants and cafés scattered across the grounds.

properties.name: Campsite Koversada Covered
properties.description:
Koversada Covered is part of the Koversada Park Camping Resort, just a few kilometres from the port town of Vrsar. Here you can camp in the great outdoors. With caravan or camper you are right on the waterfront, with a tent you can camp on an idyllic and car-free island. Scattered over the terrain are several restaurants and bars.

Space and tranquillity

You can opt for a standard pitch, for more luxurious, larger pitches directly by the sea or a variety of themed pitches to choose from. You can choose pitches with a private bathroom, but also with child-friendly amenities, such as a wooden playhouse. For barbecue lovers, there are pitches with its own outdoor grill, dining table and gazebo. Unique is the car-free island, which is connected to the mainland by a footbridge. Here you can camp under trees and spacious lawns. These pitches are for tents only.

Beach on the Adriatic Sea

The campsite is located directly on the beach, from where you can dive into the Adriatic Sea. Although the Istrian coast consists mainly of rocky and pebbly beaches, the campsite also has a sandy beach. This is particularly suitable for children. If you have a lounger, you can sunbathe on the pebbles or rocky plateaus. You can take to the water by canoe or kayak, which can be hired at the campsite.

For the sporty camper

For campers who want to work up a sweat, there are plenty of active options. Play a game of beach volleyball or explore the beautiful coast by bike. For those who prefer to take it a bit easier, there is a mini golf course.

properties.name: Camping Le Clos du Rhône
properties.description:
In the Camargue, the marshy habitat of flamingos, black bulls and wild horses, you will find campsite Le Clos du Rhône. Here you camp directly at the Mediterranean Sea and the sandy beach, the place for a fresh dive or a kite surf adventure. If the sea is too cold, you can take a dive in the heated swimming pool. For a special experience, drive to the ornithological park of Pont-de-Gau, the place to spot flamingos. Don't forget your binoculars!

Welcome to the Camargue

White cobblestone houses with orange roofs: you will recognise Le Clos du Rhône campsite by its characteristic building style in the Camargue, the vast marshland area in the south of France. This is where the Rhône finds its exit to the Mediterranean. The campsite is situated directly at the sea, on a quiet spot between the various lakes of the nature reserve.

Swimming pool complex

A large area near the entrance of the campsite has been transformed into a swimming complex. Here you can take a dip in the heated swimming pool, between clusters of deckchairs and wicker parasols. For the little ones, there is a nice paddling pool where they can enjoy a bath. Two large water slides are the domain of the adventurous youth.

Saintes-Maries-de-la-Mer and the Mediterranean

Pass through a gate and you are on the sandy beach at the Mediterranean Sea. For a day of sunbathing and swimming, beach and sea are perfect. And when the wind does its work, the kite-surfers come to this stretch of sea. The beach extends as far as the little port of Saintes-Maries-de-la-Mer, where, after a few interruptions and sections with beach huts, it stretches along the kilometre-long coast.

properties.name: Camping Aquarius
properties.description:
Camping Aquarius is located in the north of Spain, directly on the bay of Roses. With the beautiful surroundings of the Costa Brava and the Mediterranean Sea within walking distance, it's a good place to stay. The campsite has a quiet atmosphere, is well maintained and offers something for every camper. With lively entertainment, numerous facilities and a beautiful location, there is always something to enjoy for the whole family.

Quiet campsite with a lovely beach

The pitches at Camping Aquarius are 70 to 110 m² on average, but the beautiful landscaping is certainly above average. Don't have your own camping equipment? There are several mobile homes for rent. The campsite has a quiet character. The majority of the guests consist of young families and elderly people.

The vast sandy beach of Sant Pere Pescador offers endless water fun and relaxation. Here you can sunbathe, laze and enjoy the Mediterranean all day long. There is no large swimming pool, but for small campers there is a paddling pool available.

There is plenty to do!

At Camping Aquarius you won't get bored for a moment! In high season there is plenty of entertainment for all ages. From a mini disco, playground and fun theme days to Spanish language lessons and shows with live music. Or a cooking course to learn how to make a real paella?

Sports enthusiasts will lack for nothing. Choose aerobics, yoga or wake up with morning fitness. There are also football tournaments, bike rides and all kinds of other ball games. Of course, a quiet game of jeu de boules or mini golf is also possible.

properties.name: HolaCamp Barcelona
properties.description:
HolaCamp Barcelona is located on a beautiful sandy beach about twenty kilometres south of Barcelona. This beach campsite is set in a pine forest directly on the Mediterranean Sea. The campsite is ideally located for a visit to Barcelona: by bus you can get to the centre in three quarters of an hour.

Beach atmosphere

HolaCamp Barcelona is beautifully situated in a pine forest directly on the beach. There is a lot of green on the campsite and there really is a beach atmosphere. This is enhanced by the many palm trees. The campsite has about three hundred touring pitches. No two pitches are the same. They differ in terms of privacy and shade. The pitches directly on the beach have a beautiful view, but offer little shade and privacy. There are also all kinds of rental accommodation available, from traditional mobile homes to lodge tents and even ecological 'domos'.

The better water fun

On the side of the motorway there is a large but simple outdoor swimming pool that is only accessible during the summer months. There is also a separate paddling pool for the little ones. For better water fun go to the beach, of course. HolaCamp Barcelona is located on a public sandy beach directly on the Mediterranean Sea. From the campsite there is a gateway to the beach. The beach is kilometres long and nicely wide. There is also a sailing and surfing school here.

Campo y Playa

The campsite has its own supermarket with a wide range of groceries. The Campo y Playa restaurant has a lovely terrace. Breakfast, lunch and dinner are served. It is not a star restaurant, but the offer is fairly good and you can eat well.

properties.name: Camp Almissa
properties.description:
The Galeb campsite is located on a beautiful sandy beach near Omiš on the Dalmatian coast. The simple, shaded campsite is laid out in an orderly fashion. The most beautiful pitches are located directly on the sandy beach unique to this region. This makes the campsite very popular with families with children.

Clear and simple

The campsite is clearly laid out, with straight, paved paths. The 230 touring pitches are simply laid out on the grass. They are in straight rows along paths and are clearly marked. There are quite a few trees on the campsite, but the pitches are not separated by vegetation. The most beautiful sites are located directly on the beach and have a magnificent sea view. There are fifty mobile homes for rent.

A day at the beach

Although most of the beaches on the Dalmatian coast are pebble beaches, the Galeb campsite is located on a natural sandy beach. The beach is not very wide, but the water is beautifully clear and is shallow for quite a ways from the beach. You can walk to the water from the flat camping pitches. At the beach, there is also a simple swimming pool surrounded by palm trees and loungers.

Stylish restaurant

Surrounding the pool is a stylish terrace belonging to the new restaurant and cocktail bar. There is no campsite store at the campsite itself, but there is a supermarket across from the campsite entrance.

Entertainment for the whole family

For children as well as for teens and adults, there is an English-language entertainment programme in high season. In addition, the campsite provides an extensive excursion program during the summer months. There is something for everyone, as the campsite offers a wide range of sporting, adventure, romantic and cultural excursions.

properties.name: Valamar Camping Istra
properties.description:
Valamar Camping Istra, near the town of Funtana (Istria), is a large holiday park offering entertainment for all ages. This resort is beautifully situated on a peninsula, so you are almost completely surrounded by the clear blue Adriatic Sea. Swimming is also possible in the beautiful pool complex at the holiday park. There are also sports and game activities, a wellness centre, dining options and entertainment. nice day out? This part of Istria is home to several charming towns with historic centres, such as Poreč (8 km away) and Rovinj (32 km away).

Wide range of accommodation options

This luxury resort offers a wide range of accommodation options. Campers will find beautiful pitches by the sea or higher up among the trees, often with sweeping views of the surroundings. There are touring pitches in a variety of comfort levels. If you opt for one of the most luxurious pitches, you will have your own bathroom, barbecue, veranda and/or whirlpool bath. Rental accommodation is also available. At Valamar Camping Istra you can book a stay in a glamping tent, a modern chalet or a luxury villa with private pool.

Plenty of sports, games and entertainment

Scattered around the site are sports facilities and playground areas, both outdoors and indoors, right down to the luxury sanitary facilities. On top of that, there are many activities organised for children of all ages. For a bite to eat and a drink, head to one of the cafés and restaurants. And end your day at the Istra Theatre, where you can enjoy surprising evening entertainment such as fun family films or a professional music, dance or magic show.

properties.name: Camping Orta
properties.description:
Camping Orta has been located on the east side of rustic Lake Orta since 1959. The lake in the province of Piedmont, to the west of larger Lago Maggiore, is known as one of the quietest lakes in the area. The well maintained campground is on both sides of the road running around the lake. The two parts of the campground are connected with each other via a pedestrian tunnel.

Italian hospitality
