After the barrier, you will arrive on the lively square where you will find the reception, the bar and the little playground. Carlo and his daughter are always nearby to welcome campers or to help in their hospitable manner.

Always a beautiful view

Camping Orta has two types of campsites. Right on the lake, you'll camp with private access to the water. The sites are not very spacious, but have a priceless view as soon as you step outside in the morning. There are also larger sites on the terraces of the campground. These sites are on one side of the narrow gravel and grass paths, so everyone has a lovely panorama. If you choose a place up top, the campground owner will bring your caravan up.

Passion in the kitchen

The campground shop is little but perfect, and each day there are wonderful fresh rolls. They cook any dish you choose from the small menu with love in the new restaurant with charming terrace.

One of the charms of Campint Orta is that there is no activities programme. However, there are more than enough options for fun in the beautiful surroundings.

properties.name: Camping Viter
properties.description:
Camping Viter is located directly on the sea in the charming Croatian coastal town of Zaostrog. This small-scale family campsite is located approximately halfway between Split and Dubrovnik and is a great base for a relaxing holiday on the Adriatic coast. Here, you can camp surrounded by greenery, with the sea and a beautiful pebble beach literally on your doorstep. Restaurants, ice cream parlours and small shops are within walking distance, so you can often leave your car behind. Here you can enjoy the good life outdoors, the sound of the waves and the warm Mediterranean atmosphere.

Choose your own camping pitch

The camping pitches are spread across the site and each have their own character. Some pitches are in the sun, others in the shade of trees and Mediterranean vegetation. Upon arrival, you will be personally guided to the pitches and you can choose the one that suits you best. This ensures a relaxed start to your holiday. The pitches are close to the sea, so you often wake up to a fresh sea breeze. Thanks to the abundance of greenery, the grounds feel cosy and natural.

Enjoying the Adriatic coast

Camping Viter is a great place for those seeking peace and quiet, beach lovers and active holidaymakers. From the campsite, you can walk straight onto the pebble beach for a dip in the clear water. Swimming, snorkelling and windsurfing are popular here. At Beach Bar Viter, you can relax with a cold drink, a cocktail or a cup of coffee with a view of the sea. In the village of Zaostrog, you will find various restaurants, bars, supermarkets and souvenir shops within walking distance.

properties.name: Camping Drewoldke
properties.description:
Drewoldke is a well organised campsite on the coast of the island of Rugen. On the elongated campsite the most beautiful pitches, which also have the most shade, are for tent campers. Many families camp here. You can make interesting day trips from the campsite and enjoy walking and cycling through nature. You can swim in the sea nearby and sunbathe on the beach.

The campsite is located near a sand-gravel beach on the Baltic Sea, in the elongated island of Rugen. The island is characterised by the variegated coastline with chalk cliffs, sandy beaches and unique forests. There are well-constructed cycle roads and tracks in this flat landscape. Some 2 km away from the campsite you will find Altenkirchen, interesting both from a historical and practical (shopping options) point of view.

Sheltered camping between the dunes

On the elongated campsite you will find the fields for caravans on the one side and a (pine) forest strip for tent campers on the other side. The fields for tent campers have a natural demarcation and lots of shade. The pitches are beautifully located in small dune hollows. A little higher up is the site with rental caravans and chalets. 

Beach within walking distance

Several pathways lead from the campsite to the adjacent sand-pebble beach. You can reach the beach within a few minutes.

Small but perfect

Camping Drewoldke has a small, but well-stocked campsite shop. The restaurant has a small menu and there is a snack bar. The sanitary facilities are housed in two large, new buildings: one for the terrain on the left and one for the terrain on the right. There are excellent facilities for disabled persons.

properties.name: Camping Villaggio Europa
properties.description:
Camping Villaggio Europa is a beautifully maintained family campsite on the north coast of Italy, situated between the Adriatic Sea and the Lagoon of Marano. You camp on a wooded terrain directly on the beach and the sea. The whole family can enjoy a relaxing camping holiday here. Children will especially enjoy the large water park, the open air theatre and the clear sea water of the Adriatic.

Via Monfalcone, a northern Italian town on the northernmost tip of the Adriatic, you will drive through a flat wetland nature reserve to the campsite. It is located directly on the coast, about seven kilometres from the harbour town of Grado.

Camping on the beach

The largest part of the campsite is located directly on the beach. There are 400 rental bungalows and chalets in this holiday village. The pitches are located in a wooded area with high pine trees.

Water park

The extensive water park at Villaggio Europa campsite is situated in a clearing surrounded by trees. A few large water slides lead to a beautiful swimming pool, with a separate area for the youngest children. The campsite is located right next to the Adriatic Sea, so fanatical swimmers can also dive into the sea.

Outdoor theatre and sports fields

With its own open-air theatre, various sports fields and nice playgrounds, Villagio offers something fun for every camper. In high season there are performances, live concerts and fun musical shows.

Good facilities

On the campsite you will also find a large supermarket and a good restaurant. At the front of the campsite there are several sanitary blocks which are also accessible for disabled people.

properties.name: Camping Ribamar
properties.description:
Are you a lover of peace and nature, but also like the sea? If so, ecocampsite Ribamar in Alcossebre, Castellón (Province of Valencia) may be just up your street. The entire site is beautifully laid out; an oasis of tranquillity and green. Everything testifies to the quality. Enjoy the beautiful outdoor pool, the excellent restaurant and the sports field. There are stylishly furnished rental bungalows. All camping pitches are spacious, beautifully laid out on fine gravel, surrounded by green and fitted with a water connection (and drainage).

Beautiful grounds

Camping Ribamar has 66 spacious touring pitches. Upon arrival you can select your own pitch. There are relatively few tents, due to the hard surface of compacted white gravel. The superbly equipped rental cottages are located on one site (at a reasonable distance from each other), between attractive greenery and shady trees.

Come along for a swim?

On the campsite is a beautifully laid out swimming pool (180 m2), adjacent to which is the restaurant and terrace. The swimming pool is surrounded by loungers and sun umbrellas with nothing but greenery and palm trees behind you. Ideal for swimming a few lengths. Or walk to the Mediterranean (150-500 m, depending on the location of your pitch) with the sparkling white beaches. The beach is pristine, no facilities or eateries.

Restaurant

You can have a meal in the restaurant, la Taula d’Irta. Take a seat inside or on the attractive terrace. They offer an excellent menu and similar wine list. The campsite shop has a limited assortment.

properties.name: Terrassencamping Osebos
properties.description:
Osebos is a terraced campsite, situated on a southern slope, with a very nice view over the hilly landscape of Zuid-Limburg. The region is splendid and touristy but in an attractive way. Ideal for hiking and biking through the hilly countryside. The campsite is also a wonderful base for visiting all kinds of unique towns such as Aachen, Maastricht and Liege.

Spaciously laid out, well-tended and with a lovely view

The reception is on the left in the building with the M-shaped roof. The receptionist welcomes you and will provide full information about the campsite. The grounds are spaciously laid out and well maintained. The pitches are situated on terraces which are laid out against a south-facing slope. These are generally quite spacious, sunny and offer a lovely view of the southern hilly landscape. Some pitches are separated by hedges. Some of the pitches have a hardened surface. The fields on the lower section are suitable for families with small children as the camping fields are car-free with sufficient room to play.

Paddling pool and toddler pool

There is plenty to do on the campsite . At the entrance of the grounds near the reception is a swimming pool where children can splash around. There is a paddling pool for the tiny ones. Theme days, treasure hunts and play activities are organised for children.

Neat camping shop and mini restaurant with sunny terrace

There is a neat, well-stocked camping shop so you do not necessarily have to leave the camping grounds for your daily shopping. On the right hand side of the reception is a bar and a mini restaurant with sunny terrace.

properties.name: Camping Village Santapomata
properties.description:
On the coast of popular Tuscany, near the village of Castiglione della Pescaia, you'll find the picturesque Camping Village Santapomata. The campsite, located right on the sea, has shady pitches with grass. A few pitches are within walking distance of the sea. There is a small rocky outcropping, La Rocchette, crowned by an old castle not far from Castiglione della Pescaia.

Oasis of peace

Peace is worth a lot during your holidays in the tourist heart of Italy. You'll find exactly that on this campsite. The pitches are spacious and have plenty of privacy. They are not all of the same size and not demarcated. Travelling without your own tent or caravan? You can easily hire a lodge-tent or a mobile home.

Beach and bar

Camping Village Santapomata does not have its own swimming pool, but the sea is not far away. At the beach you can hire kayaks and water bikes (fun for the whole family). There is also a bar where you can have a bite and drink on the shady terrace.

Fresh fish and pizzas

There is a restaurant on the campsite where you can have lunch or dinner. The cuisine is Tuscan, complete with all of the culinary refinements that go with it. You should really order one of the delicious fish dishes. They also bake fantastic pizzas. You can take away your meals and also stay on the campsite based on half or full board.

Sanitation with camper service

There are two sanitary buildings with warm showers that work without coins. There are also sinks with hot water and a special camper service. Handy!

properties.name: Parque de Campismo de Vila Chã
Camping Romantische Strasse
properties.description:
The 385 km long Romantic Road is one of the most popular tourist routes in Germany. The route follows the course of the river Main up to the German Alps and has been in existence since 1950. It goes without saying that the Camping Romantische Strasse is located on the eponymous route and certainly in Creglingen. Here you camp amidst the magnificent green surroundings of the Tauber Valley. During high season, the campsite is mainly visited by families with children. Outside high season, Camping Romantische Strasse is predominantly frequented by senior citizens.

Accommodation with hammocks

You will arrive at a well maintained, terraced campsite with many trees. These provide ample shade during the summer, which can sometimes be hot. There are several rental mobile homes on the campsite. They are modern, well kept and can accommodate four people. Three rooms here boast a unique feature: each room has two comfortable hammocks which are suspended in a special frame. 

Spacious, shaded pitches

However, most guests arrive with their own tent, caravan or camper van. The campsite features plenty of space for these on large, shaded pitches. Some of these pitches are located next to the Herrgottsbach, a stream which runs across the length of the campsite.

Heated swimming pool

The campsite has a spacious covered and heated swimming pool, which incidentally, is also frequented by guests from outside the campsite. The reservoir in the vicinity offers ample opportunity for open water swimming.

Restaurant with beer terrace

The campsite restaurant serves a wide variety of dishes. A special feature is the spacious beer terrace, which offers delicious, German craft beer.

properties.name: Campsite Amarin
properties.description:
Camping Amarin is located on the Istrian peninsula, directly on the Adriatic Sea. This large campsite is part of a holiday village. The campsite is surrounded by holiday homes and apartment complexes. From the pavement café in front of the restaurant you have a beautiful view over the swimming pools and the sea. In the distance you can see the city of Rovinj.

Beautiful campsite

On arrival, you can park your car next to the reception building. The campsite is beautifully landscaped, with lots of greenery that is well maintained. The larger roads are neatly asphalted and the smaller paths are paved with pebbles.

Very large campsite

Camping Amarin is a large campsite, with an area of more than twelve hectares and around 300 touring pitches. There are 190 rental accommodations: tents, safari tents and mobile homes. The sloping terrain was taken into account when constructing the pitches. The pitches closer to the sea are smaller, more expensive and more crowded than those further away from the beach. Choose a pitch at the back : quieter and more spacious.

A refreshing dive

A swimming pool complex is situated between the restaurant and the beach. It consists of two large outdoor pools, surrounded by a stylish sun deck with sun loungers and parasols. Use of the sun loungers is at a charge. There is a separate paddling pool for the little ones, but no play equipment or slides. On the other side of the campsite, you will find a freshwater swimming pool complex.

properties.name: Camping Adria
properties.description:
On the Italian east coast, near San Marino, you will find Camping Adria. This large beach campsite is an excellent holiday destination for a camping holiday by the Adriatic Sea. The bustling campsite comprises temporary pitches, rental accommodation and permanent pitches, all of which offer varying degrees of shade. All you have to do for a day at the beach, is cross the road.

A well-maintained site with lovely camping pitches

With over 700 camping pitches – more than 200 of which are reserved for regular guests – Camping Adria can rightly be called a large beach campsite. There are also 30 chalets available for rent on the site. The campsite is neatly laid out: from the wide central avenue, straight paths lead guests to their pitches. These pitches are all shaded. The pitches are available in various categories.

Operative beach campsite

If you don’t mind a bit of hustle and bustle you're in the right place for a beach holiday at camping Adria. During the summer holidays beachgoers from all over Europe flock to the Italian east coast to enjoy the Adriatic Sea. At camping Adria you will see many families visiting the beach. Especially during the summer holidays the large campsite is full, which means you end up in the middle of the bustling camping life. Good to know for dog lovers: your pet is very welcome at the campsite.

The beach by the Adriatic Sea

All you have to do to get to the beach is cross the street. Although the Adriatic Sea is free for everyone, the beach here is filled with sun loungers, accompanied by umbrellas. After a dip in the sea, you can take a seat in the restaurant on the beach.

properties.name: Camping Confort
properties.description:
An attractive family campsite in a beautiful valley in the heart of the Belgian Ardennes. You will camp here in complete peace on large pitches, right on the banks of the Semois. Cycling, mountain biking, hiking, kayaking or rafting, the imposing countryside is never far away for countless activities. In the adjoining town of Bohan there is a small supermarket and cosy eateries. Camping Confort has also established a cosy terrace where theme evenings regularly take place.

Camping in the Ardennes

Camping Confort is very close to the French border. At the entrance, the large main building is easy to spot. This houses the reception where service and hospitality are of paramount importance. This well-kept campsite is surrounded by woods on a slope, but the site itself is spacious and open. An ideal destination for families where you can hear the soothing chirping of the birds and the water flowing past in the background.

Near the water's edge

The relatively spacious site with a long strip along the water is striking. The large open touring pitches on the riverbank are one of the campsite's big plus points. In total there is room for 210 pitches. The pitches that are not by the water have a hedge, giving you some extra privacy. Here and there the surface is quite hard, so bring the right pegs with you. The mobile homes house the regular guests, and are not located directly next to the touring pitches. The sanitary facilities are well looked after and the shower works with coins that allow you to enjoy the hot water for more than five minutes.

properties.name: Numana Blu Resort
properties.description:
Numana Blu Resort is located in the region of Le Marche, nearly right on the Adriatic coast. The region is known for its unique combination of beach, hills, forests and culture. You can dive into the tourism on the beaches, but also have endless enjoyment of the natural areas and Italian villages.

Nice and modern

On the way to your accommodation you'll already have a good picture of the modern campground. You'll drive along well maintained roads along the sports fields and pass the swimming pool before you arrive at the campsites. These are well maintained and offer plenty of shade to escape the sun now and then.

Sport and play paradise

The camping is a sport and play paradise for the entire family. With five different sports courts (football, basketball, tennis, padel and volleyball), a playground and a fitness area, there is always the option to be active. There is also always the activities team that will take you for a number of activities on the campground or on the beach. Even your dog won't be bored here, because there is a separate dog play area and dog agility training is offered.

Cooling down

Want to cool off after sports and play? To cool down, jump in the large and modern swimming pool and dry off in the sun on one of the sunbathing lounges. The nice swimming pool also has multiple whirlpools and there is a separate kiddy pool. Rather swim in the lake? Walk from the campground (300 metres) to the private beach and take a dive into the Adriatic Sea.

properties.name: Camping und Mobilheimpark Am Mühlenteich
properties.description:
Camping Am Mühlenteich is situated near the town of Lingerhahn in the Hunsrück, a hilly and wooded region between the Rhine and the Moselle. The valleys of the Rhine and the Moselle are located nearby and offer beautiful landscapes, old towns, castles and vineyards.

Lovely greenery

The well-maintained campsite is situated on an extensive terrain and has a park-like landscape. Because of the many trees and shrubs, your pitch does not create a feeling that you are camping on a large campsite. The sanitary facilities are very neat and also open during winter. Camping in luxury is possible in a fully-equipped safari tent with all amenities.

Natural swimming pool

The proximity of the A61 makes the camping very suitable for overnight stops for travellers on their way to the south. However, the central location in this beautiful tourist area is certainly tempting enough to extend your sojourn. The beautiful natural pool is also great for swimming and relaxation.

Playing and scrambling

The campsite offers an abundance of exciting opportunities for children. There is some climbing equipment and they can play on a genuine road roller. For the littlest ones, there is a lovely indoor play area. Older children will enjoy themselves in the 'games room' or in the crafts house.

Fresh rolls and a fine restaurant

Each morning the baker from the village stops by with fresh bread and other delicacies. You can eat well in the affordable camping restaurant.

properties.name: Interpals Eco Resort
properties.description:
On the Costa Brava, within walking distance of the Playa de Pals, you will find the attractive family campsite Interpals Eco Resort. The campsite is situated on a green mountainside and in the shade of pine trees. Different terraces ensure flat camping pitches and there is a wide range of bungalows and chalets. All facilities look neat and tidy. The spaciously laid out restaurant with its lovely patio is no exception. Camping Interpals Eco Resort is particularly popular with young families.

In the shade

The different terraces ensure that the pitches at Camping Interpals Eco Resort are level. The campsite has a modern feel and is spacious. You will camp in a pine forest with more than enough shade. The pitches vary in size and are delimited by stone walls.

Lots of fun and games

Camping Interpals Eco Resort is particularly popular with families with young children. There is plenty to do for everyone. The playground has plenty of equipment for climbing and clambering, and the sports field is ideal for a game of football or volleyball. In addition, in high season there is an entertainment team that organises a lot for children. The other facilities on the campsite all look good too. The restaurant is spacious, has good take-away facilities and also a nice patio. A supermarket is literally around the corner from the campsite.

Sea and swimming pool

Water lovers will also have a wonderful holiday here. The campsite has a large outdoor swimming pool with a separate shallow children's pool. There is also a jacuzzi for extra relaxation. The swimming pool is surrounded by a sunbathing area. Within walking distance is Playa de Pals, where you can enjoy a nice day on the beach by the Mediterranean Sea.

properties.name: Camping Park Soline
properties.description:
Camping Park Soline is a Croatian campsite situated directly by the sea, within walking distance of the charming seaside resort of Biograd na Moru. At the campsite there are activities for young and old, an enthusiastic entertainment team will take care of that. Although there is no swimming pool there is plenty of water fun. This is because you are camping by the sea. The beach here consists of pebbles, but a little further on there is also a sandy section.

Wide range of camping and rental facilities

This campsite covers an area of twenty hectares. Enough space for 550 touring pitches, just as many campervan pitches, 200 long-term pitches and 200 rental accommodation units, mainly mobile homes. You can camp on a spacious pitch (90-100 m2). Stone walls provide boundaries, pine trees provide shade.

Entertainment for the whole family

Camping Park Soline offers activities for young and old. There's an entertainment team that organises fun activities for young and old. You can play sports on the multi-sports field, the tennis courts (further away in Biograd) or in the outdoor fitness area on the grounds. You can also play a game of table tennis, jeu de boules or beach volleyball.

Water sports

Here at the coast, sun, sea and sand are the order of the day. Grab a towel and walk to the campsite's pebble beach or to the sandy beach towards Biograd. Don't forget to take a dip now and then. On and in the crystal clear water you can windsurf, snorkel, dive, water ski, sail or fish.

Catering

With a restaurant (specialising in Mediterranean dishes), snack bar, pizzeria, communal barbecue area and shop, you won't have to starve here. The patio of the restaurant, with more than two hundred seats, has a sea view.

properties.name: Camping Neset
properties.description:
Camping Neset is situated on a gently sloping, triangular promontory directly on the wide Otra River. You can be assured of an unspoiled view of the crystal clear water and the low mountains each second of the day. You can camp right at the water's edge, or alternatively slightly further up on the campsite. Adjacent to a spacious lawn is a special, hardened peninsula for campers. Swim a few laps, take a trip -in a steamboat- on the river, or go rafting. In the vicinity of Evje you will find quarries and a mineral park, where you are allowed to look for rocks or hammer them out yourself. An unique experience

Separate peninsula for campers

The well maintained campsite has a good grass surface. The trees here are few and far between, so you can enjoy the sun to the fullest! There are no demarcated pitches and you may therefore stand where you wish. Once you have found a nice spot, you will experience the peaceful atmosphere. Camper vans are allocated a partly paved peninsula with a strip of grass. You can also rent new and recently renovated trekker huts and bungalows.

There are three large ablution blocks. Everything is new or recently renovated. Special features: family bathrooms, sanitary facilities for children and for the disabled.

Rafting and a colossal bouncer

You can get straight into the water from many spots along the banks. There are two sandy beaches and a couple of boardwalks. When the water is not warm enough, you may want to go rafting. There is a rafting centre some 10 km away from the campsite. On the campsite you can take part in beach volley. There are play houses and a colossal bouncer for the little ones.

properties.name: Camping du Port de Plaisance
properties.description:
Camping du Port de Plaisance is situated a few kilometres south of the town of Péronne (Somme department). You are here in the north of France, about sixty kilometres east of Amiens. Besides being a wonderful place to spend your holiday, this campsite is also a green stopover on your way to the south. You are camping here not far from the A1 motorway.

At a small marina

Here you camp quietly at a small marina. The spacious pitches are on grass. You can also stay in a safari tent or a chalet. In the evening it's very quiet because the campsite gate closes at 21.00 (in low season at 20.00) for vehicles. The sanitary facilities have recently been renovated and are considered by many guests to be a major plus point.

Swimming pool at the Somme River

The campsite has a beautiful heated outdoor swimming pool with a paddling pool. There are sunbeds where you can relax after a long day of travelling. There is also a terrace where you can order a nice summer drink or an ice cream. A special feature is that the swimming pool is adjacent to the Somme River. Along the Somme, there is a beautiful cycle route that leads you to Amiens or even further to the coast. The campsite does not offer an entertainment programme, but with its swimming pool, sports field, playground and ping-pong tables, your children are bound to have plenty of fun!

Fresh rolls

The campsite has a bar, snack bar and bread service. There is a small shop for basic groceries. Via the river, you can walk or cycle in a few minutes to a larger supermarket.

properties.name: Camping Dreiländereck
properties.description:
Dreiländereck Campsite is a neatly laid out campsite in the centre of the town of Ried im Oberinntal, in the beautiful region of Tiroler Oberland. In the summer season, this campsite is the perfect base for sporting activities in the area. Hikers and cyclists will have a great time here, but you can also do some excellent rafting, climbing, swimming and canyoning. Other features of this campsite include a cosy restaurant, numerous wellness facilities and beautiful pitches with views of the surrounding mountains.

Sunny pitches with mountain view

On Dreiländereck's neatly landscaped camping grounds, you'll find three different types of pitches. The distinction here is made in the pitches' dimensions. In general, all the pitches are sunny. You will also enjoy a wonderful view of the surrounding mountains from every spot. In addition to touring pitches, this campsite offers apartments, chalets, wooden sleeping vessels and log cabins for rent.

Recharge and relax in the cosy restaurant

At the front of the campsite, you will find a cosy restaurant (Gastlokal), with a bar and a pool table. The restaurant is the ideal place to recharge in the morning for another active day. Especially the varied Campingfrühstück - with fresh juice, richly filled rolls and coffee/tea - is worth a warm recommendation. After returning from hiking, biking or skiing, it's great to rest in this restaurant while enjoying a nice drink. You can do your extensive shopping in the village centre, just a few hundred meters from the campsite.

properties.name: Camping De la Sûre
properties.description:
Camping De la Sûre is situated in Diekirch, within walking distance of the old centre. It would be a good idea to combine an extended tour to this interesting town (with war history) with an overnight stop at Camping De la Sûre. The Sûre (or Sauer) river runs along the campsite. You can walk directly into nature from the campsite. Nature lovers can go canoeing or fishing in the area, and also go on cycling and walking trips.

Park-like campsite

You arrive at a well maintained campsite with an attractive reception/bar. You will be welcomed here by the Manager, who manages the campsite for the tourism services of Diekirch. On the way to your camping pitch the campsite offers a park-like impression. The grounds are flat and have a grass surface. Here and there are some tall trees. At the entrance (with reception, bar and playground) there is a convivial atmosphere.

Spacious and open

The spacious pitches are not demarcated, offering less privacy, but providing a sense of space. Due to the trees some of the pitches are provided with ample shade. You have a view of the river, with a large number of cyclists and hikers on the other side, especially when you stay here during the first weekend after Whitsun. This is when the two-day traditional walk 'Marche Internationale de Diekirch' (also called: Marche de l’Armée) is held.

Campsite De la Sûre is mainly frequented by families with young children. The campsite is also popular with senior campers. In peak season, swimming in the river is prohibited.

properties.name: Camping Armanello
properties.description:
The cheerful campsite Armanello is situated in the province of Alicante near Benidorm, between the mountains and the sea. There is a wonderful beach of fine sand and you will enjoy the lovely climate through the year. You camp in Armanello within walking distance of the centre, boulevard and sea. Everyone is welcome: families, young people who are here to enjoy the beach and discos, but also senior citizens spend winter here and stay in comfortable bungalows.

A varied terrain

The terrain is divided in an older section at the front (only permanent pitches) and a new section at the back. The new section looks well maintained with a tent area and a 'district' with bungalows. A part of the tent area looks more like a campsite for the youth: lots of small tents close to each other. The sites are beautifully laid out, with alternating sunny pitches and pitches partly under trees.

Unique accommodation

On the new section along neatly paved streets are 31 surprisingly modern rental accommodation units. These range from small barrel homes, larger sleephouse cottages and mobile homes to cheerful and brightly coloured luxury bungalows (air-conditioning, TV, microwave, large fridge, veranda). This 'district' looks rather barren: not a blade of grass in sight. However, here and there is a hedge or palm tree.

Swimming

When you come here to swim in the sea, it is only a 1.5 km walk from the campsite. The beach here is one of the most attractive in the country, with white fine sand. There is also a swimming pool on the campsite (60 m2) with grass lawn, sun loungers, sun umbrellas, palm trees, terrace and bar.

properties.name: Camping La Buganvilla
properties.description:
Camping La Buganvilla is located on the Costa del Sol, between Málaga and Marbella. This large terraced campsite is situated seven hundred metres from the Mediterranean Sea. On the terrain and around the buildings you can see purple flowers everywhere, namesakes of the campsite. There are mainly touring pitches. You can winter on this campsite, because it is open all year round.

Both sun and shade

The campsite has an open character: the pitches are clearly marked out, but without vegetation in between. This enhances the view, but you don't have much privacy on your pitch. The ground is hard, whether you're standing on sand or grass. There are both sunny and shady pitches available. However, all tent pitches are in the shade of the old pine trees on the lower part of the campsite.

Costa del Sol

At the entrance to the campsite there is an outdoor swimming pool that is open all year round. There is also a large paddling pool for the little ones. Both swimming pools are situated right in the sun. All around is a large sunbathing lawn directly adjacent to the sidewalk café of the restaurant. If desired, the necessary shade is provided. Attention beach lovers: the Mediterranean Sea can be reached via a footbridge over the road and is about seven hundred meters from the campsite.

Moorish Marbella

The bus to Marbella stops in front of the campsite entrance. The old Moorish town centre is certainly worth a visit, but the town is primarily a fashionable seaside resort on the Costa. Enjoy the extensive beaches, prestigious pleasure port, small streets and atmospheric bars.

properties.name: Campsite Porto Sole
properties.description:
Campsite Porto Sole is a family campsite on the Croatian peninsula of Istria. The campsite is located directly on the Adriatic Sea, just below the coastal town of Vrsar. The old town can be visited by tourist train. You can camp on the flat and sunny part that characterises the well-organized campsite. There are also several mobile homes and rooms for rent.

Camping by the sea

The pitches behind the reception are situated on a sunny and well-organized area with several avenues. If you camp on the slope leading to the sea, trees provide shady spots. Here the pitches are slightly sloping, so you'll probably have to adjust your camping equipment a little. You can also camp directly by the sea. The pitches offer a fantastic view over the water, although the demarcation of the pitches here is a bit more unclear.

Swimming in the Adriatic Sea

The swimming pool is a little higher on the campsite. From the beautiful swimming pool, the spacious paddling pool and the sun loungers around it you have a panoramic view over the bay of the Adriatic Sea. The campsite is stretched out on the coast; here you won't find a sandy beach, but a few pebble beaches and plateaus with steps.

Sports fields

Mini golf, tennis, soccer, fitness: it's all possible on the campsite. When you drive to the barriers, you can already see the tennis courts on the side of the road. Here you will also find the soccer field and the mini golf course.

Pizza by the sea

After a day of swimming or sports you must be hungry. On the campsite you'll find both a restaurant and a pizzeria. Especially the pizzeria is beautifully situated by the sea.

properties.name: Camping in der Enz
properties.description:
Camping in der Enz lies in the heart of the splendid Eifel region, close to the Luxembourg border (15 km). You camp close to Neuerburg (3 km), an officially recognized Luftkurort or ‘climatic spa’. The air outdoors is particularly healthy. How could it not be in such a green area? Whether you want to relax at the campsite, by the swimming pool, for example, or be active in the surrounding countryside, Camping in der Enz has it all.

Spacious pitches and rental accommodations

The pitches at Camping in der Enz are spacious and well-kept. Whether you come with a tent, caravan or motorhome, you will always find a spot that fits. The pitches are well kept and laid out beautifully. In addition to pitches, mobile homes and cabins are also available. Curious as to who your neighbours are? In high season, there are many families, and in the off season, people looking for peace and quiet and nature lovers.

Dive into the swimming pool

Camping in der Enz has many amenities that will enhance your stay. It has a swimming pool in the full sun, ideal for a refreshing dip on a hot day. If you’re not up to cooking, the restaurant has a small menu with tasty dishes. In the high season, an entertainment team provides entertainment for young and old.

Hiking in de Eifel

Visit Neuerburg (3 km) or the beautiful city of Luxembourg (70 km). The Eifel is a region known for its amazing hiking and cycle routes.

properties.name: Recreatieoord Kikmolen
properties.description:
On the edge of the Hoge Kempen National Park, just across the border near the Flemish town of Maasmechelen, lies Recreation Resort Kikmolen. At this campsite you will find beautiful touring pitches on small grassy areas scattered throughout the wooded campsite. Walk or cycle directly from the campsite into the multifaceted nature park, or take a dip with your children in the large swimming lake with its water slides.

The campsite is located about 5 minutes from the A2 highway. Take exit 33 towards Lanaken and you will soon find yourself in the wooded area of the campsite. These forests are part of the Hoge Kempen National Park, the large Flemish nature reserve on the Kempen plateau. From the campsite, you can walk or cycle straight to the Hoge Kempen National Park.

Camping on small grassy fields

Most of this large campsite consists of permanent year-round sites. Nearly 130 more touring pitches are scattered around the campsite on separate grassy fields. Nice modern sanitary buildings with rooms for disabled people, baby rooms are close to the touring pitches.

Swimming in the natural pool

The extensive swimming lake at the front of the campsite is ideal for young swimmers or kids who can't yet swim (properly). Much of the lake is quite shallow, making it safe for even the youngest to swim.

Hoge Kempen National Park

From the campsite, you can walk or cycle straight to the Hoge Kempen National Park. There are some 200 kilometres of hiking trails in this more than 5,700-hectare nature reserve.

properties.name: Camping Centro Vacanze San Marino
properties.description:
San Marino is a special holiday destination, because it is the oldest republic in the world (since 301 AD). Furthermore, it is a modern and prosperous country with beautiful nature and interesting historical sights. Camping Vacanze San Marino is situated on an open hill near the capital with the same name. The area is hilly and wooded and has a rich culture. To reach the campsite, you have to drive up the mountain over winding, but easily passable roads.

Friendly campsite

The shady campsite makes a well maintained and friendly impression and there is an attractive looking swimming pool. This is a very pleasant family camping. The camping pitches vary in size; you may, however, choose your own pitch. You can also rent a luxury glamping tent, or a standard tent, mobile home, room, studio or apartment. The campsite is frequented by a mixed public of young people, families and senior citizens. A number of people come here specifically to visit the town of San Marino.

Attractive swimming pool

The swimming pool is lovely and you can enjoy the sun on the adjacent lawn. In high season entertainment is organised for all ages. Furthermore, the campsite has playground equipment and several sports fields.

Delicious pasta

You can buy basic necessities from the small shop as well as fresh bread. There is a large restaurant with a good choice of pizzas and pasta dishes, which are very popular. The sanitary facilities are modern and are well maintained.

Convenient by bus

From the campsite there is a direct bus connection to the beautiful historical town of San Marino or the Italian Rimini beach.

properties.name: Camping Lido Verbano
properties.description:
Camping Lido Verbano is situated on the south side of the Lago Maggiore, in the town of Castelletto sopra Ticino. Although Lido Verbano is situated on a busy road, this is not really noticeable on the campsite. The pitches are located quite a distance away from the road, in the direction of the lake.

Spacious campsite

The campsite is extensive and spacious and the pitches are large, level and clearly demarcated. Lido Verbano does not offer much in the way of amenities; the campsite depends mainly on its favourable location on Lago Maggiore and the many water sports opportunities. The lively town of Arona is close by and has a number of restaurants and pavement cafes by the lake.

Sunbathing at the Lago Maggiore

The first impression Lido Verbano gives you is that it is cared for and well maintained. This applies to the pitches, but also to the rental accommodation. The campsite has a water park, but you can also swim in the lake, where you will find a beach lawn and a beach bar on the shore. The campsite also offers various activities for adults and children.

Enjoy the sports

Camping Lido Verbano offers the camper a number of sports facilities such as a soccer field, tennis court, basket ball and beach volley ball field and a pétanque court. If you wish, there are also plenty of water sports opportunities on the lake.

Cosy restaurant

The campsite also has a bar and a small-scale restaurant with friendly service. There is a supermarket diagonally across from the campsite. Besides, the road to Arona is littered with shopping centres and all kinds of megastores, so you can buy virtually anything here.

properties.name: Plitvice Holiday Resort
properties.description:
A short distance from the Plitvice Lakes National Park is the quiet family-run Plitvice Holiday Resort campsite. From here you can take the most beautiful trips through the Croatian countryside. The campsite has a small swimming pool with sunbathing area, a lovely restaurant and a nice playground. The pitches are located on a flat terrain and mostly among the trees.

Special places to sleep

Plitvice Holiday Resort is situated on rolling terrain. Nevertheless, there are plenty of flat and paved pitches for your tent, caravan or motorhome. The grounds look well-maintained and you can mostly camp among the green trees. There are many different lodging options. For example, you can choose your own tipi tent or a modern treehouse, but there are also luxury glamping options, poolside mobile homes and comfortable cottages by a lake.

Active and sporty

All kinds of sporting activities are organised on and around the campsite. For example, you can go rafting on the Mrežnica River, paintballing, horseback riding through the mountains and archery. You can also work up a sweat on the volleyball court and at the table tennis table. There is a fun playground with equipment and a climbing house for the children. You're bound to be hungry after all that activity. You can regain your energy at the restaurant with some tasty Croatian specialities.

Just cool off

You can take a refreshing dip in the outdoor pool to cool off. The pool has a separate shallow area for children. Umbrellas and sunbeds surround the pool so you can dry off in the sun or the shade.

properties.name: Camping de la Trye
properties.description:
Camping de la Trye is located near the town of Bresles in the Oise, a natural area north of Paris. This is a friendly family campsite where you can enjoy camping. All kinds of activities are organised for children. Especially the covered wagon tours are very popular! In the surrounding area you can visit Paris, beautiful Beauvais and various amusement parks.

Comfortable pitches and special accommodations

At the Camping de la Trye we have paid a lot of attention to special rental accommodation. Think of tree houses, tipi tents and a colourful caravan. When it comes to pitches, those in the lower part of the campsite are especially popular. In this part, the touring pitches are very spacious and you can enjoy the green surroundings in peace.

Get on a covered wagon for a relaxing ride

At this campsite, everything is organised for children to have a wonderful holiday. Especially for children who love ponies this is a paradise. There is even a daily covered wagon ride. Furthermore, there is a rubber swimming pool, handy for those who want to cool down on a hot day.

Eat on the terrace at the food truck

At the Camping de la Trye you will find a restaurant that looks like a food truck. You can enjoy your meal on the friendly terrace around it. There is also a snack bar at the campsite where you can order pizzas, hamburgers, fries and ice cream. The nearest supermarkets and shops are in Bresles. There is a weekly market in this village on Thursdays.

properties.name: Camping Alicante Imperium
properties.description:
Camping Alicante Imperium is just a few minutes away by car from the lovely bathing resort of Villajoyosa. The new campsite (2017) has all modern conveniences for ensuring campers are as comfortable as possible. There are spacious pitches, a designer pool, brand new sanitary facilities (also for dogs), a great restaurant and so on ...

Luxury campsite

The site has been set out very spaciously and you can easily get around, even with larger campers or caravans. Everything on this campsite feels highly luxurious. You can see this in the lovely, sleek building in which the reception is based. 

Spacious pitches

The site has spacious, flat camping pitches of differing dimensions. Most pitches are sunny, making them suitable for tents along with caravans and campers. Each pitch has a water connection and drainage point. There are also special pitches for large caravans and campers. 

View of the mountains

The site as a whole features a fairly young planting of shrubs, trees and palm trees. Sun shades are hung in the summer to keep the sun out. You can still camp comfortably in temperatures above thirty degrees. Bungalows can be hired on site, and you can also spend the night in luxury wine barrels.

Roman-style swimming baths

You'll feel as though you're in paradise in the modern, designer Roman-style swimming pool. It is wonderful in the sun and from the water you have a magnificent view of the mountains around the campsite. The bottom of the baths runs down very gradually. Younger guests will have the time of their lives in the kids' pool.

properties.name: Camping Riberamar
properties.description:
The Riberamar campsite is situated on Spain’s Costa del Azahar in the Valencia region, just north of Castellón de la Plana. The campsite is located about two hundred metres from the beach and the Mediterranean Sea, allowing campers to get to the beach on foot. You can camp here under the shady canopies on gravel pitches, or stay in one of the rental accommodations.

Camping in the shade

The pitches have plenty of space and a fine gravel surface. Although there are quite a few trees on the campsite, there aren’t quite enough to protect campers from the sun, which can be very intense during Spanish summers. For this reason, canopies have been put up over the pitches so you are always camping in the shade. The campsite is nicely complemented by mobile home and bungalow options.

The Mediterranean Sea

Just outside the campsite and past the modern artwork on the roundabout, you will find yourself practically on the beach. This stretch of the Mediterranean coastline is long and has not yet been taken over by countless beach bars and campsites. That means you can enjoy the sun and the warm waters of the Mediterranean on your beach towel at no cost.

Spacious swimming pool

You can choose to take a dip in the Mediterranean Sea or enjoy a refreshing swim at the campsite. There is a large swimming pool in a sunny spot near the entrance. The spacious, rectangular pool is suitable for children to play in as well as for swimming laps. There is also a paddling pool next to the main pool.

properties.name: Sites & Paysages Camping de Gien
properties.description:
On the banks of the Loire, within walking distance of the village of Gien, you will find Sites & Paysages Camping de Gien. This campsite in central France is spacious and many of the pitches offer views of the river. The campsite has a pool with a sliding roof, so you can swim even on days when the weather is less than ideal. The campsite offers direct access to the beach.

Sleeping in a gypsy wagon

Sites & Paysages Camping de Gien has nearly two hundred pitches along the banks of the Loire. These pitches are spacious and partially separated by hedges. If you do not have your own camping equipment, you can stay in one of our unique accommodations. Sleep in an elevated safari tent or in a wooden gypsy wagon with private bathroom.

Water recreation and heading to the beach

You can cool off at the campsite in the zodiac swimming pool. This is a pool with an inflatable rim, making it extra safe. The pool has a sliding roof, so it can also be used as an indoor pool. Prefer a real beach experience? Along the banks of the Loire River is a sandy beach overlooking the village of Gien. You can access it directly from the campsite. The beach club organises various beach activities for small children and young people during the summer.

Great cycling: Loire à Vélo

Bring your steel steed with you on holiday and explore the area. The Loire à Vélo is an absolute must for long-distance cyclists. The bike route runs from Cuffy (near Nevers) to Saint-Brevin-les-Pins (Loire-Atlantique). Sites & Paysages Camping de Gien lies directly along the path of the nine-hundred-kilometre-long bike route.

properties.name: Camping Altomira
properties.description:
Camping Altomira is situated between the Espadán and Calderona nature reserves, some 25 km from the Mediterranean and an hour's drive from the fascinating city of Valencia. It is a quiet spot from where you can venture anywhere. From the campsite there are wonderful walking and cycling routes over paved trails.

Stunning view

The terraced campsite offers reasonably large, beautifully laid out pitches on compacted gravel. On the lowest section you will find touring pitches and some permanent pitches, as well as most of the facilities. Rental accommodation units (bungalows) are located on the middle section. On the top section, campers have a splendid view of Navajas and the surrounding area. The pitches here are demarcated with hedges and are sheltered by an artificial sunroof.

Nice swimming pool

There is a lovely swimming pool with separate toddler pool (depth 50 cm) surrounded by sun loungers. It is a wonderful area to relax in the shade of the pine trees.

Walking along former mining routes

Children can play to their heart's content on a play area and sports field. Furthermore, there is an entertainment programme in high season. There are also excursion programmes and guided walks. Starting from the campsite are some great walking and cycling routes over the so-called 'camis verdes', paved trails on former narrow-gauge railway lines used for mining. There is a bicycle workshop for campers with their own bicycle. Very handy when your push-bike has to be repaired.

Paella

There is an excellent restaurant with a wide choice where you can also eat delicious paella for a very reasonable price. Daily fresh bread is available. You can also buy basic essentials at the campsite. There is a bigger supermarket at a distance of only 4 km. There are a few barbecues on the campsite.

properties.name: Alpencamping Mark
properties.description:
With the Alps within 'grasp' and mountain lakes to walk past or wade through, Tyrol is a favourite destination for sporty holiday makers. And where better to stay than on a campsite where the owner welcomes you in a real mountain hut? Welcome to Alpencamping Mark ...

Camping with a view

You drive to your generous pitch on paved streets, and find that this also has a hardened surface for your caravan or motorhome. The campsite is not actually laid out in terraces, but a portion is slightly elevated here and there. Because of its location, you have a view of the surrounding mountains and on one side you can even see the church steeple of Weer. 

Activities of the outdoor club

The swimming pool is filled with pure mountain spring water. After a day's walk in the mountains or participating in one of the many activities of the outdoor programme, there is nothing like a refreshing dive. After a tiring day you will enjoy a meal in the campsite restaurant. They also serve breakfast and apple strudel.

Horse-drawn carriage rides

Children have the time of their life here. There is a special entertainment programme for them with daily horse-drawn carriage rides. In addition, children amuse themselves in the indoor and outdoor playgrounds. There is also a soccer field and a crafts room.

Parents also need a holiday...

Would you like a trip without the children? If so, childcare in combination with the entertainment team, has the answer for you. So, spend a day shopping with your partner in Innsbruck, less than a thirty-minute drive from the campsite.

properties.name: Camping El Bahira
properties.description:
In the north-west of Sicily, near the town of San Vito Lo Capo, lies Camping Village El Bahira. San Vito Lo Capo is a gorgeous place and a very popular, exclusive holiday destination for Italians from the mainland. In addition to enjoying the sun and the sea, you can take beautiful trips in the western part of Sicily.

Beautiful sunsets

El Bahira is beautifully situated on the sea, on the west side of the cape where you can also find San Vito lo Capo. You can enjoy beautiful sunsets here. The first thing that strikes you are the many cosy corners and the abundance of greenery. On the campsite a lot of attention is paid to ecology and peace. Therefore, car traffic on the campsite is limited.

The pitches for tents, caravans and mobile homes are separate from each other. The pitches have quite a bit of shade. In addition, there are beautiful and well equipped rental mobile homes.

Herb path and garbage donkey

Two special features linked to the attention paid to ecology are the herb path and the donkey that comes to collect the (separated) garbage from the campsite each day.

Swimming pool with seawater

El Bahira has a swimming pool with seawater, which overlooks the sea, a separate children's pool and loungers around. To get to the sea, you have to walk down from the campsite. There is a restaurant with full menu, but there are also other nice eating establishments in nearby San Vito Lo Capo.

For coffee, a drink or an ice cream you can go to the campsite bar. In peak season there is the usual organised entertainment.

properties.name: Camping La Touesse
properties.description:
Close to the historic Brittany town of Dinard lies Camping La Touesse. The campsite is located at a five minute walk from the beach (with a lovely fine sandy beach) on the one side and on the outskirts of Dinard on the other side. The sheltered camping grounds are basic, quiet and fenced. In 2015, La Touesse was complemented by a large swimming paradise!

Camping in the shade

La Touesse is situated on intimate and sheltered grounds. There are fields with spacious pitches, some of them offering more privacy than others. Vegetation and trees provide ample shade. The fields are subdivided by hedges into smaller plots with room for two or four pitches. If you do not have camping equipment, you can also hire a mobile home or apartment. 

Beach, swimming pool and playground

There is a large-scale, beautiful swimming paradise with a number of slides. They also have a spacious indoor pool, situated next to the outdoor pool. Adjacent to the pools there is ample space (tiled) to relax and soak up the sun.

The wide, elongated beach is only a five minute's walk away (three hundred metres) from the sea. You can reach this via a greenery strip of bushes and trees. The sea bottom slopes down gradually and the waves are gentle. On top of all the great water fun, there is also a lovely playground for children, complete with bouncers.

A nice bite to eat

The basic restaurant has a modest menu at reasonable prices. You can get take away meals there. There is also a small friendly bar. Furthermore, the campsite has a small, neat shop with the basic necessities.

properties.name: Camping Puzol
properties.description:
Camping Puzol is an ideal campsite to visit Valencia. The campsite is located less than twenty kilometres from the bustling city. And what could be nicer than going to the beach after enjoying a day of culture in Valencia? The beach is located just a few hundred metres from your camping spot. The campsite features a large swimming pool. In high season, the bar-café is open and there is an entertainment programme available.

Lovely campsite

There are two areas to the campsite. The first is an area with permanent pitches, mainly for long-term Spanish campers. The second area is intended for the touring pitches. The pitches here are spacious and shaded and feature water and electricity. There are special pitches for motor home travellers. Those who do not have any camping equipment can hire one of the bungalows.

Fun in the water

The campsite's best asset is the beautiful swimming pool. It has a separate shallow area for small children. You can also enjoy the slides and the colourful water play equipment. Enjoy a nice view of the surroundings from the pool. You can also take a dip in the sea, of course. You only have to walk a few hundred metres to stand with your feet in the sand.

Facilities and entertainment

Camping Puzol has a simple restaurant (with terrace) and a small shop. Twice a week during the high season, there is entertainment for the children. Adults can also enjoy paella evenings and musical activities. Those who have brought a bicycle or hired one can take a lovely trip to Valencia.

properties.name: Camping Torre de la Mora S.A.
Camping Platja Cambrils
properties.description:
Camping Platja Cambrils is located near the seaside resort of Cambrils and 250 metres from the beach. This is a large campsite ideal for families with children. The campsite has a large swimming pool with slides, a good restaurant and many sports and games activities.

Welcome!

When you drive to your pitch or rental accommodation, you'll immediately notice that this campsite has a lot of vegetation. The numerous pitches, mobile homes and bungalows are well maintained. The fact that most pitches have natural shade is a great advantage for many guests.

From swimming laps to pure water fun

On a central spot on the campsite you will find a large swimming pool of Olympic size. Here you can look for some refreshment, but you can also be sporty by swimming laps. Genuine water fun is guaranteed here thanks to the water slides. Of course you can also swim in the sea.

Musical dining out at the campsite

Next to the swimming pool is an attractive restaurant. In high season, music shows are often organised here in the evenings. The restaurant also serves take-away meals. The campsite also has a large supermarket.

Sports, games and Library Truck

Camping Platja Cambrils has a lot of entertainment to offer. For the youngest there is a Kids Club. For sports entertainment there are several sports fields. For water sports, just walk to the beach and the sea. There is also a Library Truck at this campsite. Here you will find books in all languages and suitable for all ages.

properties.name: International Camping
properties.description:
The l’Ardèche forms the backdrop of International Camping. All the delightful attractions, shops and lovely villages are situated near the campsite and are within walking distance. The vast choice of walking and mountain biking routes allows you to explore this region to the fullest. Campers looking for a genuine camping feeling will enjoy a relaxing holiday on the waterfront.

Perfect base for excursions into the region

Driving on the bridge over the river l'Ardèche from the town of Vallon-Pont-d’Arc, you can see the campsite on your right. After the roundabout, you will reach the tastefully decorated reception. There you will also find the swimming pool, restaurant, shop and a large green area with ample room for sports and games.

Water fun galore

Children will enjoy themselves in the river which flows along the campsite. Its location near the waterfall adds to the fun. It is advisable to bring your water shoes because of the pebble beach. The modest but beautiful outdoor swimming pool offers a lovely alternative to the natural swimming spot. There is even a separate toddler pool for the tiny water rats. 

Cave paintings

Near the village of Vallon Pont d'Arc, you can visit the Grotte Chauvet 2 with its 32,000-year-old cave paintings. That is to say... not the real ones, but a replica. The real cave, discovered as recently as 1994, has never been opened to the public. The spectacular exposition in the cave is impressive and a good reason for an excursion for young and old.

properties.name: Ferienpark Teutoburgerwald Barntrup
properties.description:
Ferienpark Teutoburgerwald Barntrup occupies a quiet spot just outside the village of Barntrup, in the east of North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany. From this beautifully-landscaped 4-star campsite, head off on great walking and cycling trips through wooded hilly landscapes. Beautiful nature areas like Teutoburger Wald and Weserbergland are within easy reach. In high season, this is a popular holiday address with families with children up to the age of 12.

Neat pitches and clean washing and toilet facilities

On this well-organised campsite, paved paths lead to small camping fields. These fields have large touring pitches, mostly separated by hedges. In front of this campsite’s barrier, you will also find a nice field with camping pitches with a tiled and artificial grass surface.

Need some extra space and comfort? Book a comfort pitch with a private bathroom unit. The modern safari tents and chalets come with private toilet and washing facilities too.

Swim for free in the big municipal swimming pool

Freibad Barntrup is right next to the campsite. Campsite guests can swim for free in this municipal outdoor pool. Swim lengths in the large basic pool, while the youngest campers can have fun in the paddling pool, which has a slide. There’s plenty for children to do on the campsite itself too. Let them run wild in the playground or join in fun activities in high season. Children's entertainment is available in Dutch and German and takes place in the recreation tent. Next door, there’s the Living Room, or campsite café, where tasty drinks are served.

properties.name: Camping Sonnenberg
properties.description:
This child-friendly gem is lies in Lower Saxony, between the cities of Hamburg and Hanover. Rural, yet only a ten-minute walk from the village of Müden with the Lüneburger Heide right next door. This oldest nature reserve in Germany is a Valhalla for nature lovers. Peace and quiet is one of the key words in the midst of this charming campsite that has it all, including spacious pitches and a friendly restaurant.

Find the pitch that suits you best

The whole site has a well-kept appearance and is beautifully landscaped. There are open grassy areas where the pitches are playfully arranged. Under the tall trees you will stay on spacious pitches on slightly sloping ground. Further on, you will come across beautiful, bounded pitches with plenty of privacy. So every camper at Camping Sonnenberg can enjoy a suitable spot.

Families with children love the luxury safari tents and the apartment is also in demand by guests without their own camping equipment. A pitch with private sanitary facilities is also available.

Music and fresh rolls

At the entrance to the site is the terrace with an outdoor and indoor area. An evening of music is scheduled a few times a week in the high season. If you like to start the day with fresh rolls you can order them from the front desk the night before and your holiday-feeling will be complete. There is also a supermarket two kilometres from the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Weißer See
properties.description:
In the Mecklenburg Lake District in northern Germany lies the Camping Am Weissen See campsite. You can camp here in peace. As the name suggests, this campsite is located on a lake. The grounds are full of pine trees. Right next to the campsite, you will find the Müritz National Park. Two kilometres away is the town of Wesenberg. Here, you will find supermarkets and restaurants.

Which camping spot will you choose?

At the reception of this wooded campsite, you will be welcomed by the manager. During the lunch break (1:00 – 3:00 p.m.), there is a no-entry zone. In the reception building, you will also find a small shop. The camping spots have different sizes. There are also a few caravans and accommodations for rent.

Laze and swim

Ultimate relaxation can be found at the campsite's lake. Walks down the steps to get to the lake. On the sandy beach, you can laze around while the kids are playing. For some coolness, you can take a dip. If you want, you can also bring a boat. However, motorboats are not allowed. The restaurant is close to the beach and overlooks the lake.

Walking to Wesenberg

Time for some exercise. The town of Wesenberg is within walking distance (one and a half kilometres). And if you have your bicycle with you on holiday, it's the ideal way to explore the Müritz National Park. For example, cycle to the Käflingsberg observation tower. Or take a guided hike through the National Park. In the park, you can also do geocaching.

properties.name: Campingplatz Am Drewensee
properties.description:
This campsite is located in the beautiful Mecklenburg Lake District, about eighty miles north of Berlin. With an abundance of forests, there is plenty of natural beauty to enjoy during your camping holiday. The campsite is located directly on the Drewensee lake, one of hundreds in this region, offering many fun water options: boating, fishing, snorkelling, diving, swimming or canoeing.

Camping or renting?

There are pitches of different sizes (70-150 m2). They are located on an open lawn or more on the edge of the forest. In total there are 150 touring pitches and 70 permanent annual pitches. Don't have your own camping equipment? Then you should book one of the three mobile homes. Your camping neighbours are mostly from Germany.

Land and watersports

The campsite is on the lake and you can walk right into the water. The little beaches are sand. The campsite's jetty is one of the best featuers. Here there is room for about sixty boats. So feel free to bring yours! Would you prefer to keep your feet dry? Then there is also plenty to do. How about table tennis or beach volleyball? Children will love the playground. There is also entertainment (in German) twice a week during high season. Also fun: the bi-weekly campfire nights where you can bake bread and make music with other campers.

Eating and drinking

Some food items are available for purchase in the reception area. For other groceries you will have to go to the nearby town of Wesenberg (8 km). There are also some restaurants, shops and a castle there. In high season there is a tent at the campsite where drinks and some snacks are served.

properties.name: FKK Camping Naturista Almanat
properties.description:
On a beautiful slice of beach on the Costa del Sol, in the southernmost part of Andalusia, lies naturist campsite Naturista Almanat. With Málaga some 28 kilometres away, Torre del Mar less than three kilometres away, and many touristy spots in the mountains, these surroundings make for a fine holiday destination. The tropical climate certainly helps too.

Palm trees

The campsite grounds are beautifully landscaped. Tall palm trees and many flowers add colour to the campsite. The roads leading to the camping pitches are well-maintained and the facilities are modern. Trees, palm trees and tall hedges demarcate the pitches and provide the necessary shade. You can also choose to camp in one of the bungalows (with a rooftop terrace). 

Indoor and outdoor pools

The campsite has private access to a wide beach. Here, you can go for a swim in the Mediterranean Sea. This is especially refreshing in the summer when the temperatures tend to reach tropical heights. The outdoor swimming pool at the campsite is also a fine place to go swimming. Or soak up some sun on the sunbathing lawn surrounding the pool. 

Will you camp here in the winter? Then it may be too cold to go swimming outside. But don't worry, you can warm up in the heated indoor swimming pool which is open in the low season.

Restaurant on the beach

Enjoy a meal with a fabulous view and the sun shining on your face: the campsite restaurant is situated right on the beach. The charming terrace looks out over the Mediterranean Sea. You can also order takeaway meals here.

properties.name: Camping La Bien Assise
properties.description:
Camping La Bien-Assise issituated close to the centre of Guînes, a village not far from Calais. The castle campsite is therefore popular with British tourists for whom this is the first (or last) stopover in France. The campsite is located in an attractive, rather flat, rural area. The grounds are dominated by large trees and look very attractive. The rural setting will give you an immediate French holiday feeling, while the coast of the English Channel is not far away.

Campsite and sanitary facilities

There are 46 mobile homes on the campsite which are fitted with all amenities. There are also four wooden, fully furnished rental holiday cottages. Other camping guests have access to good and modern sanitary facilities in the service building.

Swimming pool

Because camping La Bien-Assise is not directly situated on the sea, a lake or river, it has a covered swimming pool with large water slide. However, at a distance of only 16 km, you will find Escalles and Cap Blanc-Nez, where you can spend the day on the beach. Wimereux and Sangatte are located at similar distances.

Hotel/Restaurant

On the grounds you will also find the three-star hotel L’auberge du Colombier, located in a small 19th century castle, as well as the restaurant La Ferme Gourmande. The restaurant serves classic French dishes, also on the terrace when the weather allows it. From here you have a view of the castle's dovecote. There is a cosy bar near the reception (with a small library).

Shop

As is the case at most campsites, camping La Bien-Assise also has its own small shop. Are you looking for a larger assortment? In Guînes itself there is a variety of supermarkets and typical French shops.

properties.name: Camp. Village Il Poggetto
properties.description:
Camping Village Il Poggetto is located twenty kilometres east of Florence, in the middle of the hills of Tuscany. This terraced campsite is very suitable for a stopover when you are passing through, but it is also a nice place for a longer stay. From the swimming pool and the restaurant you have a beautiful view of the hilly surroundings.

Terraced campsite

The location of the campsite, so close to the motorway, can be advantageous for campers in transit. The disadvantage, however, is that the traffic on part of the campsite can be heard reasonably well. The pitches are situated on well-tended, wide terraces. At each pitch there is a little tree for some shade. The regular pitches are about 80 m2, but you can also choose extra large pitches. There are also several rental accommodations.

Swimming with hillside view

On the north side of the campsite you will find the swimming pool, which is beautifully situated on a higher platform. Here you have an unobstructed view of the surrounding hills. The pool is spacious. For the little ones there is a paddling pool right next to the large pool.

Horseback riding

The campsite has an entertainment program for children in high season, but this is not very extensive. That's not a problem, because for the smaller campers there is plenty to do to enjoy themselves. Of course, the swimming pool is always a good start, but there is also a ranch near the campsite, from where you can explore the Tuscan landscape on horseback.

properties.name: Village Camping Santa Fortunata
properties.description:
The terraced campsite Village Camping Santa Fortunata is beautifully located at a high elevation. From here you have a glorious view of Sorrento Bay, the island of Capri and the Vesuvius volcano. On the campsite there is plenty to do for the entire family. Children can go to the playground or the mini club. Adults keep fit in the fitness area. Find out about the guided walking tours from the reception. And of course, the campsite swimming pool is ideal for cooling down.

Each camping pitch is unique

The slightly sloping camping grounds (30 ha) are well maintained with lots of vegetation. There is a vast choice of camping pitches. Each pitch differs in size (80-120 m2). The large pitches with view of the bay are the favourites. There are pitches which are demarcated/not demarcated and pitches with or without shade. Rental accommodation is also available: lodge tents, studios, apartments and bungalows.

Private rocky plateau on the sea

At the lowest point of the campsite is an outdoor swimming pool (150 m2) with loungers. There is a small pool for toddlers. It is a 10 minute descent on a narrow footpath to the stony beach on the rocky coast. This plateau belongs to the campsite. Here you can swim and snorkel in the sea.

Enjoy the South Italian cuisine

Village Camping Santa Fortunata has a well-stocked shop, including fresh bread and breakfast. Obviously, you will start the day with an Italian cup of coffee. When you want to go out for a meal, you have a choice of a pizzeria and a restaurant with South Italian dishes. Take-away meals are also available.

properties.name: Camp Velenje
properties.description:
On this small-scale campsite on the Velenje Lake you can totally relax and unwind. Park the caravan, motorhome or tent on one of the available free camping spots and enjoy. Soak up the sun on the beach, plunge into the lake or take a seat on the terrace of Café Lago.

Free camping spots

Each pitch on the campsite offers a view of the large recreation lake. The campsite consists of an open terrain with grass, which means that the camping spots are not demarcated. You can therefore decide where you want to stand. In low season you will be guaranteed a spacious pitch, within walking distance of the lake. In peak season, when it becomes busier, it becomes more difficult to choose a good spot. There are also some mobile homes distributed over the campsite.

Swimming and sports

In peak season fun activities are organised for children every now and then. There is also a small playground. However, the campsite is mainly geared towards guests who come here to find peace and quiet and who can entertain themselves on the campsite. Because of the location directly on Velenje Lake, there is no need for a swimming pool: you can simply dive into the refreshing lake! You can also play tennis, basketball and beach volleyball on the campsite.

Bar with view of the lake

Enjoy the splendid view over the Velenje Lake with a coffee or drink on the terrace of Café Lago. You can also order some snacks from this bar. At a distance of some 2 km from the campsite there are a few supermarkets.

properties.name: TAIGA Almeria Playa
properties.description:
Camping Taïga Almería Playa is in the Spanish region of Andalusia. This fully renovated campsite is 400 metres from the beach and just outside of the village of Palomares and Garruscha. This charming family campsite has much to offer the entire family. Jump into the swimming pool, have hours of fun at the beach, benefit from an extensive entertainment programme and enjoy delicious food at the campsite restaurant.

Luxury accommodations

Taïga Almería Playa is a spacious campsite with both pitches and luxury accommodations. The pitches have a gravel surface and are demarcated with green hedges. There are few trees on the campsite. In order to provide enough shade for campsite visitors nevertheless, shade cloths have been hung above the pitches. The rental accommodations at the campsite are luxurious and fully furnished. Choose a glamping tent with its own bathroom, a mobile home or a chalet. Pets are welcome at the pitches and in the accommodations.

Family holiday with water fun

Campsite visitors at camping Taïga Almería Playa lack for nothing. The swimming pool with a large sunbathing area is right next to the entrance of the campsite. This is ideal for cooling off and relaxing. For children there is an enclosed playground where they can enjoy themselves for hours. During the high season, the entertainment team organises activities for the entire family. End your day with a good meal in the campsite restaurant.

Beach holiday in Andalusia

Take your swimming costume and beach towels along because Taïga Almería Playa is only 400 metres away from the beach. The region has even more beaches that are also worth visiting. Playa Quitapellejos is only a two-minute drive from the campsite and is surrounded by pine trees and eucalyptus trees.

properties.name: Camping Sokol Praha
properties.description:
Camping Sokol is one of the better spots from where to visit Prague without a hassle. You can get to virtually anywhere in town by public transport. You can buy train tickets on the campsite. Transport to the train station by mini bus is provided free of charge. The campsite itself is an oasis of peace; a location amidst nature where everything is well organised. Children can also enjoy themselves here and food and drinks are available at the campsite.

Green, tranquil campsite

The camping field is located in the centre of the campsite, surrounded by mobile homes and greenery. You are camping in green surroundings, creating a feeling of tranquillity. This is also due to the good organisation. The spacious and numbered fields vary in size. There are pitches with and without shade. Hedges and trees offer some privacy. You will meet many people here from the Czech Republic and from all over Europe. The latter group shares a common interest to visit Prague.

Swimming and playing

There is a well maintained swimming pool with separate toddler pool. The pool is located in the sun, with ample surrounding space to relax on the loungers. The campsite organises various excursions and there is an entertainment team for the children.

Full amenities

The shop has a fairly wide assortment with daily fresh bread. The restaurant serves breakfast, lunch and dinner. This can be eaten inside or al fresco on the terrace. The sanitary facilities are luxurious and spacious, with provisions for people with disabilities in the same building.

properties.name: TAIGA Puerto Santa María
properties.description:
