On the beach of El Puerto de Santa María (Andalusia), just a kilometre from the centre of this pretty seaside resort, is Taïga Puerto Santa María. This is camping in a real holiday environment. In summer, the sun almost always shines, while the lovely sea breeze provides just the right coolness. The campsite itself has a large outdoor swimming pool with paddling pool and a good restaurant.

Spacious touring pitches and luxury bungalows

For campers coming with their own caravan or motorhome, this campsite has beautiful pitches of between 75 and 90 square metres. Special car-free camping fields have also been set up for campers in tents. Prefer to park your car next to your tent? Then book one of the standard pitches or medium-sized plots, which are up to 60 square metres. For even more comfort, book a stay in a fully equipped bungalow.

To the pool or the beach?

There is lots to do in and around the campsite. You can dive into the lovely swimming pool and do some lengths. There is also a separate paddling pool. And you can swim in the sea too, of course. Just cross the street, go down the steps and you are on the wide sandy beach of Playa de la Puntilla. In summer, the campsite also organises fun activities like games, workshops and evening parties in summer. At the end of the day, enjoy the atmospheric campsite restaurant Hippie, whose specialties include rice and grilled meat dishes.

properties.name: Piomboni Camping Village
properties.description:
Piomboni Camping Village is a large family campsite on the Italian east coast, ten kilometres from the centre of Ravenna. The four hundred pitches are situated in a wooded area shaded by tall pine trees. The Mediterranean Sea and its beautiful sandy beach are less than a hundred metres away.

Shady pitches

The entrance to the campsite may seem a bit messy, but the rest of the campsite is spacious and well-organised. On the well-maintained grounds there are four hundred touring pitches, varying in size. You can choose a standard pitch, but also an extra large pitch. In any case, you have a shady spot at your disposal; the high trees on the densely wooded terrain will take care of that. In addition to the four hundred touring pitches, the campsite has reserved space for fifty permanent annual pitches. And on a separate part of the campsite there are about fifty mobile homes.

The campsite is also very dog-friendly. There are dog playgrounds, a washing facility for dogs and a separate free beach where they can run around and swim.

Swimming pool for the youngest guests

Especially the swimming pool is nice for the youngest camping guests. The spacious paddling pool is located near the entrance to the campsite, in the shade of the trees. With a toadstool shower, water pistol and slide the older children can also have fun in the water. Around the swimming pool there are plenty of sun loungers for parents to keep an eye on. And in the whirlpool you can relax.

Pizza and fish dishes

If you are hungry, take a seat on the terrace or in the atmospheric restaurant. With a large pizza or a plate full of seafood or fish, your hunger will be instantly satisfied. If you like to cook for yourself, you don't have to leave the campsite. The supermarket on the campsite is well equipped.

properties.name: Camping Oaza Mira
properties.description:
Oaza Mira is a beautiful terraced campsite around a glorious bay in Croatia, on the Adriatic Sea. The beach consists of white-yellow pebbles and slippers or aqua shoes are recommended. The campsite features level, spacious pitches with a view of the bay. You camp here within walking distance (three hundred metres) from the village of Drage, where you will find attractive eateries.

On which side of the hill?

There are almost two hundred touring pitches, more than one hundred of which overlook the coast.  The remaining pitches are located on the other side of the hill and have a view of a pine forest. Please take this into consideration when you make a reservation! WiFi reception varies and is dependent on where you stand. There are beautifully furnished rental bungalows and mobile homes (with air conditioning).

Active!

There is a swimming pool on Oaza Mira (260 m2), although located on a higher plateau, slightly separate from the camping grounds. In addition, there are a large number of sports and playing fields, which are also not all centrally located (volleyball, tennis, basketball, mini golf, fitness, pétanque). Special provisions are available for larger boats, such as a boat crane and a slipway.

Pebble beach

The (pebble) beach is available to all and looks well maintained and neat. Lovely for the little ones to play on the shore with water and pebbles.

Eating and drinking

There is a well-stocked supermarket on the camping grounds. There is also a fine restaurant, but, just like the swimming pool, it is also located at the far end of the terrain. The amiable bar with a view of the sea is open from mid-June. Smallish shops and restaurants can be found in the village of Drage, some 300 m away.

properties.name: Camping Zur Warme
properties.description:
Within walking distance of the German town of Zierenberg (Hessen), a charming place with authentic half-timbered houses, lies Camping Zur Warme. You camp here in a peaceful spot surrounded by nature. A stream flows through the grounds, and the campsite is located at the foot of a beautiful nature reserve. The area is hilly and forested, offering plenty of opportunities for hiking and cycling enthusiasts. Additionally, the lovely city of Kassel (20 km) is nearby. The campsite's convenient location near the A44 highway exit makes it a popular stopover for travellers.

Spacious pitches and clean sanitary facilities

This campsite has around one hundred pitches. Most of them are permanent spots, but there is also ample space for touring campers. The pitches are flat, usually have a solid surface, and are neatly demarcated.

Enjoy a delicious meal at Gasthaus Zur Warme

Life at this campsite revolves around Gasthaus Zur Warme and its accompanying Biergarten. Here, you can enjoy delicious schnitzels, salads, and local beers. The campsite also hosts special events a few times a year. Regular events include the Easter bonfires, May gatherings, the Bavarian week during Oktoberfest, and the New Year's Eve party.

Hike through Naturschutzgebiet Dörnberg and Bergpark Wilhelmshöhe

The area surrounding the campsite is perfect for pleasant walks or bike rides in the Naturschutzgebiet Dörnberg. This is a hilly nature reserve right next to the campsite. Immediately north of Zierenberg, you'll find vast forest areas that are also great for hiking. A visit to Kassel is highly recommended as well, with highlights such as the city park Park Karlsaue and Bergpark Wilhelmshöhe.

properties.name: Camping Ur-Onea
properties.description:
Camping Ur Onea is situated close to the Atlantic Coast, in the characteristic Basque town of Bidart. It is a well kept, medium-sized campsite where everything revolves around the sea, beach and water fun. From the campsite it is only a short walk to the beautiful sandy beaches of Bidart. Enjoyment to the fullest. Prefer freshwater? If so, the tropical water park on the campsite is the place to be.

Tropical water paradise

The most remarkable attraction of the campsite is the extensive water park. Here you can enjoy the following: an indoor and heated balneo swimming pool, a heated outdoor pool with paddling pool, a water playground for the little ones, a lagoon pool, a lazy river, whirlpool baths and a spa.

Space and shade

On the well kept grounds in a beautiful setting, the -mostly shaded- pitches on grass are surrounded by greenery. They are spacious to very spacious, nicely level and clearly demarcated. Some of them are situated on easily accessible terraces. There are standard pitches for tents, comfort pitches (larger) with electricity and extra luxury pitches with water connections and drainage. Nice detail: on most pitches you are allowed two side tents.

Three renovated and clean sanitary buildings provide unlimited hot water, shower and washbasin cubicles and separate cubicles for babies and disabled persons. The luxury camper can rent various types of mobile homes, such as five chalets in Basque style.

Entertainment for all!

For families with children, entertainment is offered in the form of a mini club with face painting and crafts. Swimming pool games and sports tournaments are also organised. In the evenings there are quizzes, cocktail games or Basque evenings with folklore, songs and dancing.

properties.name: Camping Saint Disdille
properties.description:
Camping Saint Disdille is a large and beautifully situated campsite near Thonon-les-Bains. This is a touristic but friendly town in the Hautes-Alpes and on Lake Geneva. Thanks to the extensive entertainment programmes at the campsite and the fine swimming in the lake, this is a child-friendly campsite.

Comfortable pitches

On one side of the 'main road' of the campsite are the rental accommodations and on the other side are the pitches. Camping is a comfortable affair on this campsite. The pitches are well-maintained, neatly flat and generous in size. They are usually separated from each other by shrubs or trees.

Swimming in Lake Geneva

About two hundred meters from the campsite entrance, on Lake Geneva, there is a stretch of beach belonging to the campsite. In a demarcated part of the lake it is safe and pleasant swimming. The bar and pavement café help to make this beach a lively place. Do you prefer swimming in a swimming pool? Then the municipal swimming pool and thermal baths in Thonon-les-Bains are the solution.

Entertainment for everyone

On and around the campsite there is a lot to do. For example, an expert entertainment team takes care of young and older children. The youngest campers can have fun in the children's club and the campsite's fun playgrounds. Children from the age of thirteen are welcome in the teenagers' club. Fun water sports activities are organised for them on the lake. Adults can of course also go sailing, surfing and take a diving course there. The campsite also organises dance evenings, quizzes, karaoke and magic shows.

properties.name: Camping Triocamp
properties.description:
Camping Triocamp is a small-scale campsite with neat, grassy pitches, various types of accommodation and a small swimming pool. This campsite is located on the north side of the Czech capital Prague, in the atmospheric Dolní Chabry district. The accessibility from the highways is excellent. All this makes this campsite very suitable as a base from which to visit Prague. You can get to the centre of Prague by public transport in less than half an hour.

Grassy campsite

The pitches on this campsite have an open character. Almost all of them have the same size and grass as surface. Furthermore, there are all kinds of accommodations for rent. Think of rooms, lodge tents, bungalows and also special cabins for two persons.

Take a refreshing dip!

Certainly on summer days, after a long day strolling through the city, you'll want to cool off a bit. With Camping Triocamp as a base, that's possible. There is a modest but functional swimming pool here. Children can enjoy themselves further in the fun playground.

Attractive restaurant with terrace

In the small-scale restaurant of Camping Triocamp various dishes are available. On the cozy outdoor terrace they taste extra good. In addition, fresh bread is available every morning. Less than a kilometre from the campsite you will find two supermarkets for further shopping.

A neat sanitary building

All sanitary facilities are housed in one sanitary building. The facilities you will find here are neat and well maintained. There are also special facilities for the disabled. You will need a separate key to access them. This is available at the reception desk.

properties.name: Camping Val Saline
properties.description:
Camping Val Saline is a very modern Croatian campsite with a private beach. The entire campsite is neat and well maintained: from the beautiful pitches and accommodation units to the restaurant. Enjoy the beautiful sunrise and sunset, the beach and the green surroundings. The campsite is situated along the clear waters of the Adriatic Sea and is, with its 300 camping pitches, a small-sized campsite for Croatian standards. The town of Rovinj (Istrië), at a distance of some 5 km, is in an area waiting to be explored. However, you do not have to leave the camping grounds; there is more than enough to do.

Long pebble beach

Camping Val Saline lies on a 730 m long pebble beach. Maybe not the type of beach to spread your towel on, but the campsite provides lovely loungers and a number of sun umbrellas - ideal for sunbathing and swimming. This is also possible in the seawater-filled lagoon, separated from the sea, or the swimming pool close to the beach. In the sea is a water park with air cushions where children can play to their heart's content. Lifeguards keep an eye on things. If you have a boat (up to 5 m long), you can use the small harbour of the campsite.

On land there is also a lot to do: from soccer lessons on the artificial grass pitch to morning gymnastics and dancing in the dance school. The campsite features a beautiful Wellness building with three different saunas, a beauty salon and various massage treatments. The campsite organises boat trips and excursions, for instance to the old town of Pula or even Venice.

properties.name: Eurocamping Zedano
properties.description:
Eurocamping Zedano is located between the Oldenburger Graben river and the Baltic Sea, The campsite is located directly behind the dike. Walk up onto the dike and you will see the sea. Zedano is designed for families with children. There is an array of entertainment to enjoy in the summer, such as live music for adults and open-fire baguette baking for the children. The Dahma beach spa and the lovely promenade along the sea are a short walk away.

First class camping pitches

You will find camping pitches in all shapes and sizes at Zedano. If you're taking your own caravan or tent on holiday, one of the 100 m2 pitches is likely to meet your needs. For a little more privacy, we recommend the first-class pitches. These have a private toilet.

Want that camping feeling with a little more luxury into the bargain? Then go glamping and rent one of the safari lodge tents. For those seeking something in between a normal camping pitch and glamping, the campsite also rents mobile homes. These are 100 metres from the beach.

Close to the sea

Leave the campsite, cross the street, walk over the dike and you’re on the beach. You will encounter many surfers and kite surfers on the beach, since this is also home to the Dahme surfing school. You too can take surfing lesson, if you like. The campsite has its own jetty on the beach, which means you can take your own boat.

properties.name: Camping Les Baleines
properties.description:
Campsite Les Baleines is beautifully situated in a nature reserve with conifers. The campsite is located in the north-west of the Ile de Ré. A 100 m walk will take you to the Atlantic Ocean and the rugged shore. From the friendly terraced campsite you have a splendid view over the bay and Le Phare des Baleines lighthouse. The convivial, busy campsite has a beautiful swimming pool.

Campsite with Ecolabel

Friendly staff members will welcome you at the reception. The touring pitches are separated from the mobile homes. The level campsite pitches with a sand surface are not demarcated and are to be found between conifers.

The campsite is proud to have been awarded an EU Ecolabel. They also motivate campsite guests to use water and electricity sparingly. The campsite shop stocks a range of locally produced groceries, such as jam, butter, coffee, milk and orange juice.

Crabbing between rocks

From the campsite you can follow a sandy path through the forest and over a small dune, to get to the beautiful sandy beach. Parents with strollers can take the Pas de Bœufs. At low tide you will find crabs in the small pools between the rocks. Great excitement for children! There is a playground on the campsite. Children who understand some English (or French) can join the entertainment programme.

Wide choice of sports

The vicinity of the campsite is eminently suitable for various sports. For instance, you can participate in kitesurfing, wind surfing, waterskiing and sailing. On the campsite there is a field for beach volleyball and at the riding school you can do horseback or pony riding.

properties.name: TAIGA Lake Caspe
properties.description:
You travel to Taïga Lake Caspe through the open plains of the Aragón region, alternated with agricultural and horticultural fields. Situated at the edge of the reservoir of Mequinenza (a quiet region in the North Spanish interior) Taïga Lake Caspe is a green oasis. Camping guests for whom an ideal holiday consists of a combination of nature, peace and sporty activities, will find a paradise on this campsite.

Tranquillity prevails on this campsite. Even so, thanks to its location on the picturesque lake, there is lots to do for young and old. There are no villages or towns in close proximity, but amidst the sounds and colours of nature this is an excellent spot for swimming, fishing, kayaking, waterskiing, windsurfing, sailing, pedal boating, walking and cycling. The nearest town is Caspe which is less than a 10-minute drive by car.

Water and lake

Swimming a few laps in the spacious pool should be alternated with an ultimate relaxation moment on a lounger on the beautifully laid out lawn. Under the hot sun, which shines most of the year in this region, or in the shade of one of the many trees or under a thatched sun umbrella. In this attractively landscaped garden you can have a drink or a bite to eat.

Campers who bring their own boat can sail for hours on this vast lake which stretches over 100 km. The marina, which is located by the campsite, can be used by guests. The boat may also be parked on the pitch.

properties.name: Camping Bois Soleil
properties.description:
Camping Bois Soleil is situated on the long sandy beach of Saint-Georges-de-Didonne, a charming seaside resort on the Gironde. Here, you can camp in a beautiful pine forest right by the Atlantic Ocean. This five-star campsite has plenty of sports and recreational facilities, a heated outdoor swimming pool, a wellness centre, two restaurants, a supermarket and, of course, that ideal beach location. During the summer holidays, there are also lots of fun activities planned for both young and old.

Set up camp by the sea or in the woods?

Bois Soleil offers a lovely mix of accommodation, permanent pitches and touring pitches. The touring pitches are divided into three zones. If you like sunny spots close to the beach, the Parc la Mer camping field is for you. The fairly well-shaded Parc les Pins is centrally located at the campsite, and Parc la Forêt is nestled right in the heart of the woods. Would you rather combine the joys of the great outdoors with the comforts of home? Then opt for one of the modern mobile homes or contemporary furnished holiday cottages.

Plenty of excitement during the summer holidays

At the edge of the campsite is a beautiful outdoor swimming pool, which also includes a hot tub and a separate paddling pool. In high season, swimming lessons, water polo matches and aqua gym sessions are often held here. And that is just a small sample of the activity programme! In summer, the entertainment team organises fun activities through the children's clubs. There is a club for small campers aged 5 to 8 and one for children aged 8 to 12. Older children can take part in suitable activities at the youth club. The evening shows, held twice a week in the amphitheatre, are great for the whole family.

properties.name: Sperrfechter Freizeit-Park
properties.description:
Sperrfechter Freizeit-Park is a modest campsite with an attractive setting by several lakes. Perfect for swimming, paddling or fishing. A number of facilities may be slightly dated, but the staff members are helpful and friendly. You can choose your own field and pitch and enjoy all types of water activities.

Spacious fields and siesta

The pitches are spacious and the overgrowth offers a bit of privacy. You can choose between various pitches, the most beautiful of which are located by the bathing water. There are also rental mobile homes. You will find quite a lot of German guests here and a smaller number of Dutch people. In peak season there are mainly families and in low season often senior citizens. Between 13:00 and 15:00 is siesta time on the campsite.

Fun in the water

The various lakes are suitable for a range of activities, such as swimming, rowing, fishing or canoeing. Dogs can swim and splash around in the river outside the camping grounds. They will just love this! A very special feature: barefoot walking through the salutary spring water basins. You can get information about this from the reception.

Shop and sanitary facilities

The shop stocks the basic necessities. The sanitary facilities have recently been renovated. There are special provisions for children and for guests with disabilities. The restaurant is not always open; it depends on the availability of a manager. Fortunately, the village of Oedheim is close by.

No driver needed

Gasthaus zur Krone is a real topper for a tasty and affordable meal. They also have an attractive Biergarten. It is a twenty minute walk. This means you do not have to crawl behind the steering wheel to get back ...

properties.name: Nordsee Camping "In Lee"
properties.description:
Nordsee Camping In Lee is situated near the North German village of Stinteck (Schleswig-Holstein). The campsite is located on a well maintained terrain with lots of grass. With several sports fields, catering establishments and hire facilities of (electric) bicycles, one finds all amenities for a comfortable holiday. You camp here within walking distance of green beaches which are a feature of this region.

Welcome!

When you explore the grounds, you will notice that the campsite is spaciously laid out and very neat. The pitches vary in size (80-120 m2) and all have water and electricity connections. The pitches are located along partly paved roads. There is very little demarcation, so you will have to arrange your own privacy.

Entertainment and amenities

A large playground, volleyball field, table tennis table, bouncer and entertainment team (in summer) offer endless fun to, especially, young children. A special game which can be played on the campsite is Pit-Pat, a fun combination of snooker and mini golf. Feeling peckish? The restaurant is only 50 m from the campsite. It has a very extensive menu. There is also a small camping shop.

Explore the surroundings

Campers visit here mainly to enjoy nature and the healthy air. You can explore the natural surroundings in an environmentally friendly manner with the electric bikes that are for hire on the campsite. The distance from Nordsee Camping in Lee to the tourist coastal resort of Büsum is only 4 km. Here an artificial island has been created: Watt'n Insel, complete with sandy beach and water sports school. Fun for young and old. Guests on the campsite are given a free access card to the beach.

properties.name: HolaCamp La Franca
properties.description:
Do you like the combination of sea and mountains? If so, HolaCamp La Franca is the place for you. You are staying here on the green coast of Spain, the Costa Verde. The renowned Parque Nacional Picos de Europa is situated in the area. Moreover, the campsite has direct access to a fine sandy beach.

Attractive hydrangeas

You will be staying among an abundance of hydrangeas on the grounds. The pitches are located in long rows on a lawn along paved roads. Some have a sea view and some are partly shaded. Rows of trees, hedges and a few buildings provide shelter against the wind. The camping is surrounded by tree-covered hills. The sanitary facilities on the campsite are new and are cleaned daily.

Beautiful sandy beach

It takes less than a minute to walk to the beautiful and sheltered sandy beach, bordering the campsite. For children (possibly for adults, too) this is one big play paradise. The considerable tidal difference will allow you to amble between the rocks, where there are lovely little water pools for children. There is also a great eating establishment at the beach. From here you have a superb sea view. Over weekends, many Spanish day visitors flock to the bay, but during the week the hotel and camping guests have the place virtually to themselves.

Fun and games

Apart from the beach, children will enjoy the playground and soccer field.

Great daily menus

The camping shop has a generous range. Feel like a luxury meal out? The adjacent hotel offers a good daily menu at discounted prices to camping guests.

properties.name: Camping Hitjesvijver
properties.description:
The Hitjesvijver campsite is located on the edge of Heerlen in Limburg. This friendly campsite is located in the hilly region of Parkstad Limburg. You can camp near Kerkrade, Landgraaf and Valkenburg, or in Belgium and Germany. The campsite has separate pitches for campers, and there are several other nice accommodations. Will you be coming to this city campsite?

Car-free pitches

The Hitjesvijver campsite has various pitches with and without shade. All pitches are car-free. If you're coming with a caravan, then you'll be setting up somewhere else. The caravan places are kept separate from the camping pitches. This city campsite also has furnished lodge tents with sanitary facilities, chalets and mobile homes. Are you looking for something with a bit of extra atmosphere or do your children like an adventure? Then book one of the hiker's huts at altitude.

Playing together

Swimming, playing and making friends; many families with (young) children stay at this campsite for the summer. But they are not the only guests because older folks also know how to find this campsite. They book a place here in both high and low seasons. And because the campsite is close to the A76, it is also very popular as a stopover campsite.

Swimming in a boat?

This friendly campsite has a beautiful swimming pool in the shape of a big boat. There is an accompanying children's pool and several playgrounds nearby. You will also find a nice brasserie on the grounds. The spacious terrace overlooks the pool and playground. The brasserie has a cosy interior and an extensive menu.

properties.name: Camping De Wite Burch
properties.description:
Campsite De Wite Burch is located in the Frisian town of Bakhuizen, close to the IJsselmeer. Here, you camp in a wooded area on quiet demarcated camping pitches. This is a great spot for anyone looking for quiet, but there is also plenty to do for children at this campsite. For instance, the extensive entertainment programme includes activities such as pony rides and theatre shows. In addition, there is the Avonturij, an indoor playground, the perfect spot to play when the weather is not so great.

Sheltered and spacious campsites

Most of the pitches at the campsite are permanent sites, but there are also sixty pitches for touring campers. These are located at the edges of some of the campsites, sheltered among the trees. The well-maintained, grassy fields offer both protected and spacious camping pitches for your caravan or your tent. There are also rental units spread out across the grounds. In addition to new chalets and mobile homes, you can spend the night in comfortable lodge tents with private sanitary facilities and cosy cabins.

Cycle to the IJsselmeer

The area is excellent for cycling tours. Cycle to Stavoren, for example, a fun little town with a large marina on the IJsselmeer. The coast can readily be explored by bicycle. You are just 3 km from the IJsselmeer, Stavoren is a half-hour bike ride away.

Pony rides and theatre shows

Children will not be bored at this campsite. That's because there is so much fun to be had. They can amuse themselves to their hearts' content on the playgrounds, and an entertainment team provides for fun activities every day during the school holidays. The little camping guests may ride a pony in the children's farm (where there are also goats) and theatre shows are organised regularly.

properties.name: RCN Laacher See
properties.description:
At this campsite, you will be staying in a beautiful natural area where volcanic activity was very much alive and well thousands of years ago. The results are still visible today, including the special crater lakes that formed there. One of these lakes is the Laacher See, on which the Camping RCN Laacher See campsite is located. RCN Laacher See has a neatly laid out camping site, which includes an excellent restaurant, modern sanitary facilities and a varied entertainment programme in the high season.

Camping with a view of the lake

After registering at the reception desk, you can drive along neatly paved paths to your pitch. It quickly becomes apparent that this is a very well organised and maintained site. The pitches are demarcated by hedges. They vary considerably in size and amount of shade. From some of the higher spots, you have a nice view of the lake. A number of sites are even located directly on the water.

A refreshing dip in the crater lake

One of the great advantages of RCN Laacher See is its location directly on the recreational lake of the same name. In this crater lake, you can safely take a nice refreshing dip. Camping guests have free access to the lake and its sunbathing areas.

Dancing, crafts and scavenger hunts

In addition to water fun, there are many other forms of entertainment at this campsite. For example, in the high season, there is an entertainment programme. This is especially geared toward the youngest campers. Take Fun2Dance, for example. All the children at the campsite can go wild under the musical guidance of the entertainment team.

properties.name: Camping Les Genêts d'Or
properties.description:
Les Genêts d'Or campsite lies in the Cèze valley. You can camp here in the woods on the banks of the river. There is plenty to do for young and old at this campsite. Bridge nights, canoe trips, playing in the playground. And of course swimming in the pool or in the Cèze. If you fancy a day out, drive along the Cèze to the Cascades du Sautadet. And a little further on is the beautiful town of La Roque-sur-Cèze.

Camping in nature

Would you like to camp at the edge of the woods, with a large grassy area in front of your tent? Or would you prefer a pitch among the trees with lots of shade? The pitches at Le Genêts d'Or campsite are well maintained. Whichever one you choose, you will always be camping in the middle of nature. With a great sense of freedom. The space around you will take care of that.

Water fun!

You probably saw the pool on arrival. This is because it is right next to the entrance, among the palm trees. Young and old can enjoy a plunge in the deep end here. Or in the shallow end, as there is a lovely paddling pool next to the swimming pool. Even in the late season, when it gets colder, you can take a dip because then the pool is nicely heated.

In the summer you can also swim in the Cèze. Beautiful footpaths take you to the river bank in just a few steps. The shallow water of the river is great for bathing. Anglers will find ideal spots to catch carp and catfish.

properties.name: Camping Olbia
properties.description:
Far away from the hustle and bustle of the Côte d’Azur, Olbia is a small, terraced campsite in a nature paradise. You will find this campsite on the extreme western tip of the peninsula Presqu’île de Giens, where it fits in beautifully with the nature of the southern part of the peninsula. This is the right place for natural beauty and water sports facilities.

The campsite only has camping pitches and no rental accommodations. All pitches are shaded. You will be welcomed by a small, pleasant and efficient team.

Century-old trees

The well-tended and functionally laid out campsite is situated in the Parc des Chevaliers, a unique protected pine forest. The coastal road between La Tour Fondue and La Madraque is a largely pristine and protected nature area. The campsite is ideally situated near the sea and in the forest. The demarcated pitches on the sloping grounds are well or only partly shaded by century-old pine and eucalyptus trees.

Excellent food

The camping shop stocks the most essential grocery items and fresh bread is available each day. The cosy pizzeria and the restaurant with terrace serve great dishes according to the guests. You can also order take-away meals and snacks from here.

Water sports aplenty

You will find a lovely sandy beach and rocky coast within walking distance. There are more beaches in the area. The beach of Alamanarre is frequented by wind and kite surfers. Canoes, kayaks and motor boats can be rented from the campsite. There is a diving school at the marina of Madraque. You will be taken to a diving spot with underwater shipwrecks and coral with unique types of fish.

properties.name: TAIGA Delta de l'Ebre
properties.description:
Taïga Delta de l'Ebre is situated in the north of the Ebro delta. The site borders the boulevard, which features a lovely beach. It is only a 15-minute walk to the fishing village of Ampolla, with its beautiful harbour. You can get there even faster by bike. The bike is also a great way of getting to know the wonderful nature of this coastal area. Anyone looking for the Spain of times gone by can take beautiful trips inland to the historical places on the Ebro.

Animal friendly, park-like site

The large, animal-friendly site makes a green and somewhat park-like impression. The camping pitches provide plenty of space and have a surface partly covered in grass. They can easily be reached via gravel roads. Here and there you will see colourful bushes and atmospheric palm trees.

Dishwashing outside

It is pleasing to see that facilities have been placed under a shaded roof at various locations so that you can enjoy the pleasant outdoor air while washing dishes. 

Restaurant with lovely terrace

Anyone wanting to eat out can come to the campsite restaurant. This is where amazing meals are served. Outside, there is a terrace with bright flower boxes and a thatched roof. Enjoy the shade, ideal for a summer's day in Spain. The site features a simple shop with a limited range.

Palm trees and flamingos

The campsite is right by the boulevard. An easy walk or cycle ride to the town and harbour of L’Ampolla. Fans of short or longer trips are in the ideal place. The Ebro delta boasts very special flora and fauna. There are plenty of locations at which you can spot local birds such as flamingos.

properties.name: Camping La Chapoulière
properties.description:
Located on the bank of the Ardèche river, Camping La Chapoulière offers an idyllic holiday destination for nature lovers and families who want to enjoy peace and space. The campsite is close to the picturesque village of Ruoms and is surrounded by impressive countryside. And the famous Gorges de l’Ardèche is only half an hour’s drive away.

Spacious pitches and beautiful mobile homes

Camping La Chapoulière has spacious pitches (standard >100 m2 and comfort >120 m2) that are partially shaded. For lodgings that are extra comfortable, choose a luxury mobile home or bungalow. These accommodations are fully equipped with modern amenities. They differ in degrees of luxury, square metres or view.

Heated swimming pool and lots of activities

The campsite has a heated outdoor swimming pool for the necessary refreshment, and a separate paddling pool for the little ones. Sports enthusiasts have great fun playing football, volleyball or tennis at the playing field. There is also a jeu de boules court and the entertainment team organises activities regularly. Children have fun in the playground while adults relax by the river or join in on organised hiking and cycling trips in the area.

Explore the Gorges de l’Ardèche

The area surrounding Camping La Chapoulière is perfect for outdoor activities. The famous Gorges de l’Ardèche (22 km), with the impressive cliffs and clear blue water, is perfect for canoeing, swimming or hiking. Be sure to visit the Pont d'Arc, the natural arch over the river. Also in the vicinity is the Chauvet cave, known for its beautiful cave paintings. The replica cave (Chauvet-2) is open for viewing (15 km).

properties.name: Camping del Mar
properties.description:
Experience a luxurious beach holiday on the Costa Brava at Camping del Mar. At this stylish campsite in Malgrat de Mar, you camp on grass which is quite unique in this area. You can cool off in the spacious swimming pool. Or in the Mediterranean of course. You can walk straight to the beach from the campsite! End your day with a good paella on the spacious patio.

Pitches with grass surface

At first sight, the campsite does not look very special. Spacious pitches are neatly arranged next to each other. They offer enough space for your tent, caravan or motorhome. But many of these pitches have a grassy surface. And that is quite unique in this location on the beach. You do have to provide your own shade. And of course you can also opt for the cool comfort of a modern mobile home.

A cooling dip

Just like everything else on the campsite, the swimming pool looks neat. Without all the frills such as water play equipment. But for a cooling dip, the pool is perfect. It is spacious and deep enough to swim a few lengths. The little ones can splash around in the paddling pool. For safety reasons, it is separated from the main pool.

Play tennis or minigolf

Keeping fit is easy at Camping del Mar. Grab your tennis racket and hit the courts. After a game of tennis you can cool down in the pool or sea. Is it too hot for a tennis match? Then you can also enjoy a quiet game of miniature golf. That is, if your children can get away from the playground.

properties.name: Camping Class
properties.description:
Camping Class is just outside the village of Eupilio and the slightly larger town of Erba, in the Italian region of Lombardy. Here, you camp by Lake Pusiano. The campsite has a private pebble beach by this lake, but you can also go for a lovely swim in one of the outdoor swimming pools. This is a typical Italian campsite that is very popular among families with children, particularly in the high season. You have lovely views of the lake and surrounding mountains from the pitches and bungalows at Camping Class.

Spacious camping pitches by the lake

This campsite's reception is right by the entrance. Behind it, you mainly see bungalows at first glance. The tourist pitches are at the rear of the site. If you decide to book a camping pitch at Camping Class, you can look forward to a shaded pitch close to the lake.

Water fun and swimming laps in the leisure pool

Camping Class has a lovely swimming pool in the centre of the site. Although, swimming pool... in fact, it's a veritable water park with three separate outdoor swimming pools. Water fun is guaranteed, in part thanks to the three colourful slides. The smallest of these ends up in the paddling pool, the other two slides lead to the playfully shaped swimming pool.

Private beach by Lake Pusiano

If you prefer swimming in natural water, you are at the right place at Camping Class. This campsite has a private pebble beach by Lake Pusiano. Besides going for a refreshing swim, you can do all kinds of water sports at this lake.

properties.name: Camping Les Charmilles
properties.description:
The rural Camping Les Charmilles is situated in the sunny valley of the Auzon, on the south side of the volcanic mountain region of Coiron. The campsite is in a small-scale, quiet and relaxed location, not far from tourist attractions. Both Aubenas, perched high upon the rocks, and the renowned Vallon-Pont-d’Arc can be reached within half an hour.

Wooded terrain

The site has a wooded, attractive and well-maintained appearance in a beautiful setting with stunning vistas over the mountainous and wooded surroundings. The pitches are partly on terraces and have a playful design. There are cherry trees on the terraces. There are also camping pitches in the forest where oak trees provide ample shade. Want to hire something? Choose between different types of mobile homes, safari lodges and bungalow tents.

Royal swimming pool

The heated swimming pool lends a royal aura to the campsite: after a relaxing swim, you can enjoy the stunning view of the area in a sun lounger under a sun umbrella. There is also a large toddler pool. The swimming pools are situated near the restaurant with a large terrace.

Entertainment galore

Playgrounds, a sports field, large jeu-de-boule pitch and entertainment: enough action on the campsite to never get bored. In high season there is a comprehensive entertainment programme each day; in low season there are various sports, recreative and creative activities, such as jeu-de-boule, walking and painting.

Organic dishes

The restaurant offers high-quality, organic dishes with products from the region. Prefer to do your own cooking? There is a small shop with limited selection. A bread service is also available.

properties.name: Camping Natuurplezier
properties.description:
Reuver lies on the right bank of the Meuse, between Venlo and Roermond. Some 3 km east of this Meuse village you will find Camping Natuurplezier. The campsite lies on the border with Germany. The Dutch part is characterised by meadows and fields, the German part is a densely wooded area: the Brachter Wald. On the edge of the campsite, behind the Manager's house, lies restaurant-café De Grens. Here you also find a terrace. Ideal to enjoy a tasty meal.

Spacious, well maintained pitches

The pitches on the campsite are spacious and well maintained. Most pitches have an artificial grass surface. The 55 permanent pitches have electricity, TV and water connections as well as Wi-Fi.

The campsite is beautifully laid out with pitches in rows. A few bushes and trees provide some privacy and shade. There is also a separate field for groups and hikers and there are five pitches for motorhomes.

Rental accommodation

You can also stay on the campsite if you do not have a tent, caravan or motorhome. You then have a choice of a log cabin, an apartment, a mobile home and group accommodation (up to 28 persons). There are four log cabins. The apartment on the campsite is suitable for two persons, possibly more in consultation.

Petting animals and into the woods

There is an animal meadow with adjacent playfield, play barn and a pétanque pitch. Children can also kick a ball around or go into the woods. There is no swimming pool on the campsite; you will however find one in Reuver.

properties.name: Flower Camping Le Rompval
properties.description:
Flower Camping Le Rompval is located to the north of the seaside resort of Mers-les-Bains, on the edge of a protected woodland area on the Atlantic coast. Here you camp on a quiet campsite with an indoor swimming pool. The surroundings of the campsite are a fine walking and cycling area.

Colorful buildings

On the day of arrival, you are welcome from 1.00 p.m. Striking when you drive onto the terrain are the colourful, semi-circular buildings covered with grass. In these tunnel houses you'll find the communal areas, such as the camping shop and the sanitary facilities. The reception is located in the yellow building. Also colourful are the small chalets, one of the types of the rental accommodations available. Another option is to book a mobile home. Furthermore, there are almost eighty touring pitches, situated between green hedges.

Swimming in all weather

Especially the indoor swimming pool attracts many young camping guests. This swimming pool, located on the left side of the campsite. Whatever the weather: at Flower Camping Le Rompval you can always swim. When the sun shines, the sliding roof opens and the tall surrounding trees provide shade. In the unlikely event that it rains during your camping holiday on the west coast of France, the roof simply closes.

Seafood restaurants and coastal cottages

If you are on holiday on the Atlantic coast, you will of course be looking for a good seafood restaurant. Fortunately, they are plentiful. Get on your bike and ride along the impressive chalk cliffs of the coast to Mers-les-Bains. The coastal cottages are especially nice to see. Between the houses with their colourful window frames and pointed turrets you have plenty of seafood restaurants to choose from.

properties.name: Bavaria Kur- und Sport Camping
properties.description:
Less than one km from Eging am See, beautifully located in the Bavarian Forest, you will find Bavaria Kur-und Sport Camping. This campsite lies along a river, in the direct vicinity of a large swimming lake amidst green surroundings. On the campsite you can practice a number of sports, such as tennis, table tennis, mini golf and swimming. The historical town of Passau is not far from Eging am See.

Ample shade

The campsite is neatly laid out with pitches between trees. This ensures ample shade during the sometimes rather hot Bavarian summer. Please ensure you bring long power cables, as the distance to the nearest power points may be rather far. Bavaria Kur-Sport Camping Park is a rather traditional campsite with permanent guests and touring guests. The campsite also has some rental accommodation available.

Walking, cycling and water fun

From the campsite you can go on different kinds of walking and cycling trips. You can swim in the Eginger See, a few minutes away. You will also find a spacious sunbathing lawn, a sandy beach and a restaurant here. At the lake you can hire boats and there are a few water slides for children.

Typical Bavarian restaurant

Wirtshaus Bavaria, which is owned by the campsite, has a limited but typical Bavarian menu. The dishes have a good price-quality ratio. You can have lunch and dinner at the restaurant. The restaurant is furnished in a Bavarian style and has a lovely terrace.

Wellness

Do you want a real Bavarian wellness treatment? If so, the Esinger Sonnen-Therme by the lake is the place for you. The qualified therapists are ready to welcome you.

properties.name: Camping Hellas
properties.description:
Camping Hellas is situated on the Pilion peninsula, on the east coast of the Greek mainland. The Pilion is a mountainous area with high peaks where you can even ski in winter. There are also a number of bays and beaches. You will enjoy the environment!

Signposted footpaths lead you over the kalderimi (old donkey trails) to the mountain villages in the vicinity. However, spending a lazy day on the beach is also fun! Have a swim in the calm see or float in a boat on the deep-blue waters.

In the olive grove, on the beach

The campsite is actually one large olive grove. At the side of the beach, the surface is level, with spacious pitches in close proximity to, or sometimes literally by the beach. On the other side there are also spacious pitches, on terraces and under shady olive trees. Guests do not have to cross a road or pathway to get to the sandy beach and the sea.

Hellas is a quiet campsite, especially in the low season. However, during weekends in high season it may be somewhat busier because of the excellent restaurant popular with many people. There are typical Greek chairs to sit on and you will enjoy the scrumptious regional dishes, often prepared with fresh fish and seafood. The location of the restaurant, the terrace and the bar is very attractive: right at the beach.

Sanitary facilities

The sanitary fixtures were partly renovated in 2017 and look nice and modern. An older section has also been earmarked for renovation.

properties.name: Camping Sikia
properties.description:
Camping Sikia is a very well-maintained campground located in a beautiful landscape. The campground is located on the Pagasetic Gulf, on the surprising and green Pilion peninsula. The campground lies between the villages of Kato Gatzea and Kala Nera in a large olive grove. The terraced campground offers beautiful views, a beach, sports fields and a good restaurant with a bar right on the beach.

Stylish and spacious

The reception is always occupied by someone from the Pandeli family. The marked sites are to the left and right of a paved road on the terraces. Families of various nationalities, with children of all ages, and seniors will feel right at home here. You'll notice the large number of visitors who come back every year. The campsites all have shade from the old olive trees or shade nets. Some are very spacious and separated, others are a bit smaller and some terraces are non-separated sites for campers with a tent.

Beach

You access the sandy beach of Camping Sikia along the shady olive grove located at the front of the campground. There is a cliff beach suitable for snorkeling and swimming. The taverna and the bar are in a lovely location on the beach. There is a supermarket in the same building, where you'll certainly want to try the olive oil and honey.

Greek and international

The restaurant, with a beautiful view of the bay, offers a wide choice of Greek and international dishes. In addition to a big menu, there is a daily changing menu of traditional Greek dishes. The sanitary facilities, a large central sanitary block and smaller ones spread out over the property, are large and clean, even in the high season.

properties.name: Camping Le Marqueval
properties.description:
Camping Le Marqueval is located one and a half kilometres off the coast of Normandy, near the harbour town of Dieppe. If you camp at this green campsite, you can walk to the beach. With its enormous cliffs and chalk cliffs, it is beautiful here. On the campsite itself you'll find peace and quiet. Chances are that you will camp on the banks of one of the fish ponds.

Camping at the pond

Three fishponds give the campsite Le Marqueval a calm, natural look. On the campsite it is therefore very quiet. Most of the pitches are situated around the ponds. Lovely for fishing enthusiasts, who can throw out the fishing rod from their pitch. An extra advantage is that the water is full of fish. In addition to touring pitches, the campsite has mobile homes and gypsy caravans where you can stay.

Swimming pool in the sun

When you arrive at the campsite, your eye will be on the swimming pool. Close to the entrance is the beautiful outdoor pool, in a sunny spot. With lots of space all around, you have plenty of space to sunbathe. There are two smaller pools attached to the large pool: paddling pools where the little ones can splash around.

A plate full of paella

Would you like to have a bite to eat after a dip in the pool? Within a few steps you are in the restaurant. Here you have to be for a nice fries or a plate full of paella. You can also enjoy a dance evening, karaoke or live concert. Prefer to cook for yourself? You can find your ingredients in the small campsite shop or in a large supermarket nearby.

properties.name: Lou P'tit Poun
properties.description:
The location of Camping Sites & Paysages Lou P'tit Poun couldn't be better: between the Atlantic Ocean and a beautiful, green countryside. And that is wonderful for nature lovers, walkers and cyclists. Less than ten kilometres away, the cultural city of Bayonne has plenty to offer. At the campsite, there is a restaurant, a playground and, of course, jeu-de-boules courts.

Space and tranquillity

All the pitches on the campsite have one thing in common; they are set amongst beautiful plants and flowers. The advantage of this is that there is always shade to be found. On the gently sloping grounds, most of the pitches for caravan, tent or motorhome are laid out along different streets. There is no lack of space, because although the pitches are of different shapes, they are all spacious and flat. The campsite also rents out beautiful chalets and mobile homes.

Heated swimming pools

At the entrance to the campsite is the modern water park. The water in the two pools is always pleasantly warm. If you want to experience complete relaxation, step into the whirlpool every day or use one of the spas. There is also a separate pool for toddlers with all kinds of water games. Around the pools are comfortable sunbeds for a well-deserved sunbath.

Beaches around the corner

The Basque coast is about ten kilometres from the campsite. Plage de La Barre and Plage du Métro are two beautiful sandy beaches. They are well supervised because of the frequent currents. During the summer months, the campsite offers a free shuttle bus that takes campers directly to the beautiful Plage d'Ondres.

properties.name: TAIGA Conil
properties.description:
Taïga Conil is in the Southern Spanish Andalusia, at about a 30-minute drive from the city of Cádiz and a 10-minute drive from the beach at the Gulf of Cádiz. In this green oasis amid the pine trees, you enjoy the quiet, a lovely outdoor swimming pool and nice new toilet and washing facilities. It is lovely and quiet in the low season and fun activities are organised for all ages in the high season. You can get to the beach in 30 minutes by bike.

Camping amid the pine trees

At Taïga Conil, you camp on one of the 40 spacious camping pitches, many of which are in the shade of the pine trees. The climate is exceptionally pleasant, with the sea close by. If you'd prefer to stay in a luxury safari tent, bungalow or mobile home, you can choose from more than 60 luxury accommodation. The toilet and washing facilities are new and look good.

Lovely outdoor swimming pool

From May, you can swim laps or go for a refreshing swim in the wonderful outdoor swimming pool every day at Taïga Conil. The restaurant is next to the swimming pool, where you can go throughout the day for breakfast, dinner or a snack in between.

Gravity workout or treetop adventure park

There is plenty to see and do in the immediate vicinity of the campsite, from cultural excursions to sporting activities. If you'd like to spend a day snorkelling, take surfing lessons, have a massage, or an exceptional yoga class where you hang in the air on cables (gravity workout), you can arrange that at reception. You can also hire bikes at the campsite.

properties.name: Camping de la Baie
properties.description:
From Camping de la Baie, located on the Breton coast, you have direct access to the beach on the Bay of Quiberon. You camp on a well-kept terrain on a touring pitch with privacy provided by large hedges. At this quiet campsite you can take a dip in the swimming pool, but especially around the campsite there is a lot to do. Join a boat trip on the Gulf of Morbihan or cycle to Carnac. Almost three thousand menhirs to admire here.

Well-maintained campsite

About a hundred touring pitches can be found on the campsite, which is only separated from the beach and the Atlantic Ocean by a road and car park. The terrain is well kept: narrow roads provide a sense of tranquillity, large hedges and trees delimitate the touring pitches. The pitches are large enough for every type of camping. However, placing a motorhome or caravan may require some driving skills.

Swimming pool

The swimming pool is situated in a sunny spot at the entrance of the campsite, It is separated by a wall. It's not very big, but nice to cool off. For the youngest swimmers there is a shallow, shielded area where they can paddle in peace and quiet. There is a waterslide for the daredevils.

Ebb and flow

If you cross the parking lot at the entrance of the campsite, you will be on the beach within a few steps. At high tide (and nice weather) you can swim in the Atlantic Ocean. At low tide a fairly muddy part of the coast of the Bay of Quiberon is exposed. This, in turn, is ideal for gathering shellfish.

properties.name: Camping Le Neptune
properties.description:
Camping Neptune, situated in the village of Saint-Mitre-les-Remparts, lies on a sloping terrain on the elongated lake l’Etang de Berre. The medieval village is located in the Bouches-du-Rhône (the Provence), only a few dozen kilometres from the Mediterranean Sea. Neptune is a rather small, mainly French family campsite. Friendliness, sun and water are key words here.

French conviviality

Driving from the reception to your pitch, you can already enjoy the beautiful view of the lake. Neptune is a rather small campsite, where it is lovely and peaceful in low season. In peak season it is bustling with lots of French camping guests.

Enjoy the sun (and shade)

Reasonably level and spacious pitches have been laid out on the sloping grounds. Some pitches have more shade than others. The bushes between the pitches provide ample privacy. You will meet many families with children of all ages who come here primarily to enjoy the water and sun.

Bread and (water) games

There is a shop on the campsite for some basic foodstuffs, such as fresh bread. The rest of your shopping can be done in several places within a few kilometres. In addition, the campsite has a modest snack bar, where you can sit outside in peak season. From there, you have a lovely view of the water. Children enjoy themselves with the playground equipment or go to the pool, complete with lawn and a separate toddler pool. To get to the lake, you only have to cross the road. The lake offers ample opportunities for various types of water sports.

properties.name: Camping Arena Blanca
properties.description:
Camping Arena Blanca (Spanish for white sand) is on the Costa Blanca, in a natural setting between the sea and the mountains. This region is characterised by the lovely sandy beaches and bays, an impressive mountainous landscape, picturesque villages and a wonderful climate. The campsite is just six kilometres from the centre of Benidorm.

Friendly reception

You will receive a warm welcome from the friendly receptionist at the reception. The first thing you'll be able to see on the campsite are the lovely restaurant, the terrace and the swimming pool. You won't be able to see the camping area from reception. But that's okay; there are plenty of touring pitches that are easy to reach on paved paths, flanked by deciduous trees.

Camping with demarcation

The average camping spot on this site measures around 60-80 m2 and is well cared for. Demarcation has generally been made using trees and shrubs, but it's always clear where the border is. The two toilet buildings are centrally located and are well-maintained.

Fun in the water

Camping Arena Blanca has a lovely outdoor swimming pool which is covered and heated during the winter. There is a sunbathing lawn and a lovely playground next to the swimming pool. You can find a few loungers under large umbrellas on the terrace by the swimming pool. The Playa de Levante sandy beach is just ten minutes by car. Fun in the water is guaranteed!

Modern restaurant

The restaurant has a lovely, modern design. The use of nice furniture and large parasols ensure a bright appearance of the terrace. Meals can be obtained for a reasonable price, and you can also go there for breakfast. You can buy some groceries in the supermarket.

properties.name: Camping Village Rocchette
properties.description:
Camping Village Rocchette is located on the hilly west coast of Tuscany, a few hundred metres from the beach. The modern buildings, the water park of no less than two thousand square metres, and the sleek sports fields give this three-star campsite a luxurious appearance.

Glamping holiday

The campsite is nicely landscaped: modern buildings are situated between the many trees and nice paths. The shady pitches vary in size. If you camp on a regular pitch, it may feel a bit cramped. The wide comfort pitches are more spacious and better defined. Especially the rental accommodation determines the view of the campsite: bungalows and mobile homes, but also lodge tents in all kinds of sizes for a luxury glamping holiday.

Modern water park

More than two thousand square metres of swimming pool: the pool complex at Camping Village Rocchette can justifiably be called a water park. Its sleek design gives the complex a modern look. All the pools are connected to each other, but have their own function. Some of the pools are shallow; here toddlers can play in the water.

Sun, sea, beach

If you walk for ten minutes, you'll end up at the beach. On this piece you see many sun loungers and umbrellas. These can be reserved at the campsite. If you don’t like this, you can walk a little further. There is the free beach, where you can lie on the sand with your towel.

Mama Restaurant

From the higher terrace of Mama Restaurant you look out on the swimming pools; in the morning with a croissant and a cup of coffee, in the afternoon during lunch or in the evening sipping a glass of wine.

properties.name: Camping Maremma Sans Souci
properties.description:
Camping Maremma Sans Souci is a true nature campsite in the midst of the forest and yet right on the beach. Here you camp to the north of Castiglione della Pescaia, located in the heart of Italy and in one of the most popular tourist regions of the country: Tuscany. You can leave behind the hustle and bustle at this campsite and enjoy the peace that this shady spot has to offer. Because the campsite is easy to reach, you can easily take day trips to the many highlights of Tuscany.

Pine trees and Mediterranean shrubs

Camping Maremma Sans Souci is located completely hidden in a lovely centuries old pine forest. The property is about thirty hectares and has 370 demarcated pitches, separated by bushes and Mediterranean shrubs. It doesn't get any more lovely than this! The pine trees provide the essential cool and shade in the hot Tuscan summers.

Private beach

From the campsite you have direct access to a private sandy beach on the Tyrrhenian Sea. There are loungers and parasols available. There are showers on the beach and there is a separate section for kite surfers.

Wooden rental accommodations

The campsite has forty fully furnished wooden cottages suitable for four to five persons. There are also lodge tents in various sizes and mobile homes for hire. Upon request it is possible to book half board for these accommodations.

Dining and shops

The campsite offers its guests a restaurant take away service, a pizzeria, a bar and a well stocked camping shop and a kiosk. You can buy sim cards and newspapers there. There are more shops in Castiglione della Pescaia.

properties.name: Camping de Tournus
properties.description:
Because of its location only 1.5 km from exit 27 of the Autoroute du Soleil (A6), Camping de Tournus is an ideal overnight campsite. The spacious pitches on grass are not really demarcated. All have electricity. There is a bar with a breakfast service and takeaway meals as well as a small shop with daily fresh bread, drinks and (regional) products for your convenience. Fifty metres from the campsite entrance you will find the Tournus municipal swimming pool.

Excellent stopover

Due to its favourable location close to the highway, Camping de Tournus, on the outskirts of the town by the same name, is ideally suited for a short sojourn on the way to or from the south. The camping grounds are not very extensive but are well-tended with spacious pitches on grass. They are equipped with all amenities. Several pitches are paved which makes them suitable for campers as well. There are two clean sanitary buildings which are also accessible for disabled persons.

Funky 'cabanes'

Recently, the campsite has also added some very funky rental huts. The huts are built as a type of wooden tent. They can accommodate five people in real beds. In each hut, there is a mezzanine bed of 90 x 190 cm, a double bed of 120 x 190 cm and a sleeper couch which converts into a bed of 140 x 190 cm. The furniture consists of a folding table and stools. Pillows and duvets are available for free, sheets or towels can be rented. There is electricity and a radiator/towel dryer.

The huts have no sanitary facilities but are close to a sanitary building with toilet, shower and washbasin. Great idea for a comfortable stopover with children!

properties.name: Campsite Koversada Uncovered Naturist
properties.description:
Campsite Koversada Uncovered Naturist is situated near Vrsar in Istria, right by the sea, surrounded by the lush Mediterranean countryside. This campsite has a long tradition of naturism and offers plenty of space for a relaxing stay in a natural setting. In particular, guests appreciate the waterside location, the peaceful atmosphere and the sense of freedom that is central to the experience here. A lovely spot for naturists who value simplicity and nature.

Camping in the peace and quiet

At Koversada Uncovered Naturist campsite, you can choose from a variety of camping pitches, some right by the sea and others offering more shelter amongst the trees. The pitches are spacious and equipped with electricity and water connections. In addition, modern mobile homes and other rental accommodation are available for those seeking a bit more comfort. The car-free part of the island also makes the campsite special, providing an extra sense of tranquillity.

Yoga, relaxation and good food

Activities are offered on and around the campsite, such as sports and yoga, creating a relaxed holiday atmosphere. For additional facilities, you can also visit the adjacent Koversada Park Camping Resort, which is also part of Maistra. Here you will find restaurants, bars and shops, amongst other amenities. The campsite is particularly suitable for couples and families who wish to combine naturism with peace and nature.

Visit Vrsar, Rovinj and Poreč

The area around Vrsar offers plenty of options. The centre of Vrsar is about three kilometres away and is lovely for a stroll along the harbour. Rovinj is about thirty kilometres away and is known for its old town and art galleries. Poreč (27 km) is of interest to culture lovers.

properties.name: Camping La Vallée de l'Indre
properties.description:
Camping La Vallée de l'Indre is a true oasis of peace and quiet and countryside, located on the banks of River Indre. This exceptional location offers stunning views and the possibility to enjoy the natural beauty of the Loire Valley. It is a region also known as 'the garden of France' due to the many (botanical) gardens. Located at only a few kilometres south of the iconic city of Tours, it is the ideal place for a relaxing stay with family, friends or as a couple.

Pleasant camping pitches

The camping pitches at the campsite are spacious, some are demarcated by bushes and there are both shaded and sunny options. In terms of size, the camping pitches vary from 40 m² (specially for hikers, cyclists and motorbike riders) to 100 m², and you can choose a pitch with or without electricity. Furthermore, you can pick from mobile homes in various sizes with air-conditioning or for a chalet or bungalow tent.

Activities at and around the campsite

At the campsite, guests can relax by the heated swimming pool that is open from mid-June to mid-September. Furthermore, there are various sports and games facilities, including tennis, miniature golf, and volleyball and badminton courts. There is a playground and skate park for the children.

One of the campsite's highlights is the dance party held every Sunday afternoon in the large hall next to the campsite. For culinary enthusiasts, there is a restaurant next to the campsite with a vast choice and a charming patio with parasols.

properties.name: Flower Camping Les Aubépines
properties.description:
The Flower Camping Les Aubépines campsite is situated close to the Bay of Somme in Picardy, on the Atlantic coast. At this cosy family campsite, you can camp on attractive, clearly defined pitches. You can also enjoy the luxury of half board in one of the mobile homes: accommodation, breakfast and dinner all in one.

Sunny pitches and half board

At the campsite, you will find a nice mix of pitches and rental accommodations. Some seventy touring pitches are bordered by green hedges, giving you plenty of privacy on your pitch. You won't encounter many trees on the site, so most touring pitches are sunny. There are almost sixty mobile homes on the right-hand side of the site, and another seventy or so permanent sites. For that extra bit of luxury, you can opt for a half-board holiday.

Swimming and sunbathing

The two swimming pools at the campsite are popular with children. The outdoor pool, located behind the reception building, can be seen when you check in. A small part of this pool is cordoned off for the smallest swimmers. Many loungers have been positioned around the pool with sunbathers in mind. If the weather doesn't cooperate, you can go to the indoor pool. This is wonderfully heated. Inside, you'll also find a fun water play area.

Eating at the campsite

If you choose a half-board holiday, you needn't worry about shopping, of course. But even if you don't have any catered meals in your camping package, there is a solution. You can eat at the campsite restaurant, and the campsite shop boasts a fairly large selection.

properties.name: Camping Terme Banovci
properties.description:
The north-east of Slovenia is known for its unspoiled nature and vineyards. This wooded area is also a great destination for sports enthusiasts who enjoy cycling and walking. Camping Terme Banovci is a real family campsite and is one of the few campsites in Slovenia to have a separate naturist area. Both the swimming pool and the sanitary facilities have their own facilities for naturists. The campsite has a shop with a small assortment and a restaurant where you can enjoy local dishes.

Spacious pitches

The flat terrain looks neat and orderly. Here, mainly Slovenians, Austrians and German campers enjoy the freedom of a holiday in the countryside. There are over 100 good sized touring pitches, laid out along gravel paths, all with their own electricity connections. Both the pitches and the sanitary building for naturists are separate. You can also rent a neat mobile home with a wooden roof over the terrace. The hotel adjacent to the main building is part of the wellness complex and campers can book breakfast and dinner there.

Luxury wellness

For those who love wellness, Camping Terme Banovci is a paradise. The area has been popular for years for its healthy hot springs. All the beautiful swimming pools on the campsite are filled with thermal water and there is a sauna, whirlpool and steam bath to relax. In addition to the spacious outdoor pool, you can always enjoy the heated indoor pool regardless of the weather. The naturist section of the swimming pool complex is also screened off with its own swimming pool. To complete the experience, why not get a massage?

properties.name: Ardennen Camping Bertrix
properties.description:
Ardennen Camping Bertrix is a family campsite in the Ardennes, in the south of Belgium. Here, you camp on a natural camping terrain with many different pitches. Some are located in the shade of the forest edge, while others are in the sun and offer views over the surrounding fields and forests. With an outdoor pool, playground, sports fields, and a play forest, both young and old can have fun.

Camping spots with character

The campsite is located in the hilly landscape just outside Bertrix; its terrain is sloped, and the camping pitches are situated at different heights. There is a spot for every camper: large and small touring pitches, some with plenty of shade and others in the sun, offering views over the surrounding fields and forests, or located at the edge of the forest.

Swimming pool and terrace

In the centre of the campsite, near the entrance, you find a large outdoor pool and the children's pool. From a higher terrace, you can enjoy a beautiful view of the pools. The terrace is a great spot to enjoy the sun. With a Belgian beer and Belgian fries on the table, it’s sure to be an enjoyable experience. A playground, sports fields, and the playroom, the central point for animation activities during the high season, surround the pool and terrace.

The play forest

At the edge of the campsite, a play forest has been created. The forest already existed naturally, and play equipment (a log bridge, a climbing wall, and swing ropes) has been added specifically for the children. In the play forest, they can climb and run to their heart's content.

properties.name: Camping de Ceyreste
properties.description:
In the picturesque region of Provence, only 3 km from the Mediterranean Sea you'll find the floral Camping de Ceyreste. Part of the sites on the shady property have a view of the sea. It is a cosy campground: not too big, but with everything you need.

The campsites are located on small terraces with a substrate of gravel. They are not very spacious and the selection is limited. Tip: get there fast. You can also hire a mobile home on the campground. These are nicely furnished with wooden verandas and surrounded by sumptuous plants and trees.

Atmospheric swimming pool

The swimming pool at Camping de Ceyreste is charming and has flowing round shapes. You'll find lounges along the edge and plenty of greenery. There are a wide slide and a kiddie pool, ideal for kids of any age.

Sports and play

Even though the surrounding area is begging for trekking, there is also plenty to do on the campground for a lovey holiday. There is jeu-de-boules, a mini golf course, a playground for children and a giant trampoline. There are also activities in the summer for children and adults (aquagym lessons, swimming pool games, sports competitions, archery).

There is a small grocery on the property with fresh bread and a restaurant with a simple menu. For a larger supermarket, you need to go to the centre of the neighbouring toan of La Ciotat (5 km).

Sanitary facilities

The sanitation is especially clean. It is even required that you take your shoes off before you go in. There is a baby bath and even a place to wash your dog.

properties.name: Flower Camping Au Bois des Biches
properties.description:
This large, internationally-oriented family campsite is located just a few kilometres from the sprawling sandy beaches of the Vendée. Here you'll be camping in the middle of a ten-hectare pine forest, just outside the village of Saint-Hilaire-de-Riez, which is built next to the popular seaside resort of Saint-Gilles-Croix-de-Vie. Flower Camping Les Biches is an extremely well-maintained campsite with high quality facilities. It is an ideal holiday destination for families with children, especially during high season. Among other things, the campsite offers a large waterpark, sports and play facilities, a real escape room and a varied entertainment programme.

Spacious pitches in a wooded setting

When you walk or drive across Les Biches for the first time, you'll quickly notice that this is a beautifully laid out and well-maintained campsite. The wooded terrain features a variety of tourist camping pitches. You'll generally be setting up your camping equipment on a grassy spot, although there are also pitches with a more sandy surface. In addition to touring pitches, there are mobile homes, holiday homes and lodge tents for rent.

Water park with two slides

Swimming enthusiasts will have a great time at this campsite. Les Biches has a large waterpark consisting of an indoor pool and two lovely outdoor pools. The water is heated to a pleasant temperature of 28 degrees. A family slide and a spectacular waterslide provide even more splashing fun.

Eating out in the campsite restaurant

You can enjoy a tasty meal in the campsite restaurant right next to the waterpark. The menu includes burgers, pizzas, mussels, salads and surprising daily specials. There's also a snack bar and a nice bar where you can grab a drink.

properties.name: Camping De Krabbeplaat
properties.description:
Campsite De Krabbeplaat is a perfect spot for a camping holiday by the water. This family campsite with own beach and private harbour is located directly on Lake Den Briel. From here, it is only a fifteen minute drive to the Maasvlakte beach on the North Sea. There are all sorts of activities for the entire family on the campsite. While the children jump around on the bouncy castle or play a game of soccer at the water's edge, you can shows off your skills at a game of tennis. Or get onto the water: learn waterskiing or explore Lake Den Briel in a boat.

Separate touring pitches

With some 360 permanent pitches, the campsite relies mainly on its annually returning guests. However, you will not be bothered by this as a touring camper. Almost seventy touring pitches are located on grassy fields on a separate section of the campsite, apart from the permanent pitches. Are you here without camping equipment? If so, the luxury and fully furnished safari tents or the cosy trekker huts will appeal to you. 

Lake Den Briel

Campsite De Krabbeplaat is located directly on the banks of Lake Den Briel. A section of the lake is demarcated for swimmers and you can get further onto the water in a rowing boat, sailing boat or canoe from the water ski school. If you want to bring your own boat, you can moor it in the private harbour of the campsite. You can also cast a line without being disturbed. There are separate fishing jetties on the lake.

For children

Theatre shows, treasure hunts, sports tournaments: entertainment for children is offered on a large scale on the campsite. Additionally, besides the playground and sports fields, there is a petting zoo with deer and goats and children can race around the camping grounds in go-carts.

properties.name: Camping Eléovic
properties.description:
Camping Eléovic sits on the Atlantic coast, close to the French town of Préfailles. This family campsite is located directly on a pleasant beach. Choose a spot with a view of the sea or spend the night in a comfortable mobile home! With a number of activities and facilities, as well as the magnificent setting where you are staying, the entire family will have a wonderful holiday here.

Enjoy water everywhere

At Camping Eléovic, fun on the water is guaranteed. You camp right on Plage de la Raize, a pebble beach where you can have a nice swim and go snorkelling. Would you rather relax on a sandy beach? Plage de l'Anse du Sud (500 m) and La Grande Plage (1 km) are nearby. The indoor pool (with retractable roof and toddler pool) makes sure you have the chance to float and splash at the campsite.

Various pitches

Camping Eléovic is situated on a sloping terrain that goes down toward the coast. This provides plenty of pitches with a splendid view of the sea. Depending on your site, the tall trees on the grounds provide the necessary shade. The sites are separated from one another by small hedges. There are both mobile homes as well as lodges for hire.

Numerous facilities

In the modern reception building, you can also find the little shop for your daily shopping. Grab a bite to eat in the restaurant, pizzeria or snack bar. And you can order some fresh bread for a tasty breakfast.

We also cater to the sporty holidaymaker. There is a bike rental service, fitness room and multi-sports field available on site. The youngest campers can use up their energy in the playground or with the fun entertainment programme.

properties.name: Camping Labadusa
properties.description:
Campsite Labadusa is located in the south of Croatia in a bay on the island of Čiovo. Here nature is still pristine, with a lovely coastline and charming bays.
