You'll feel right at home on this charming terraced campsite. With a good restaurant, direct access to the gravel beach and brand new sanitary facilities, you've got all of the ingredients for a relaxed camping holiday.

Cosy camping

There are fifty touring sites, mostly defined by trees, bushes and low stone walls. These sites are a bit compact, but if you don't have a huge caravan or camper, you won't find this a problem. Twelve ready-to-use mobile homes can be rented. New sanitary facilities were constructed in 2019.

A day at the beach

From the middle path of the campsite you can walk to the beach, and there are trees here and there for a bit of shade. The type of ground along the beach varies. The area with fine gravel is best suited for children. The other area is a combination of pebbles and larger stones. The beach bar has modern lounge benches and parasols and offers a lovely view of the beach and sea.

Exceptional restaurant with view

The restaurant on the campsite Labadusa is highly recommended. It features a large menu with Dalmatian specialities, lovely decor and nice prices. The wines served mostly come from the region. The shady terrace looks out over the sea.

There is a round bar in front of the restaurant. Here you can get a hot or cold drink while you enjoy the same lovely view. There is a playground right by the bar. Here the little campers can have fun on the trampoline, slide, swings and in the sandpit.

properties.name: Camping Kikopark Rural
properties.description:
Camping Kikopark Rural looks like a small village with a small church and is situated amidst a magnificent natural landscape with mountains and forests; an attractive walking area. It is lovely and peaceful. There is a reservoir nearby where a number of white-water sports can be practised.

Splendid views

The grounds are flat and well maintained. The spacious pitches, demarcated with hedges, are laid out in rows on terraces. From the site you have splendid view of the surrounding mountain landscape and the slightly lower reservoir. If you want to hire accommodation, you can choose between trekker huts, rooms and bungalows.

Two swimming pools

There are two swimming pools at the campsite where children can play and adults can cool off. Surrounding the pools is a large sunbathing area with a few trees.

White-water sports

For the little ones, there is an entertainment programme and a fun playground. The campsite offers excursion programmes, guided walking tours and several cycling routes to the active holiday makers. On the reservoir and the fast flowing river, some 12 km away, there are opportunities for white-water boating, kayaking, rafting and fishing. Hiking, mountaineering and mountain biking are all popular activities here. For other sporting activities, there are sports fields, an adventure course and a climbing wall at the campsite.

Extensive menu

There is a restaurant with a wide choice of tasty dishes, a snack bar and a bar. There is a campsite shop for your daily shopping and fresh bread.

properties.name: Camping Prima
properties.description:
Czech campsite Prima is located in Týn nad Vltavou, by a river in South Bohemia. The whole family can relax by the water or work up a sweat rowing, fishing and taking trips. Not only is there a lot of nature at the campsite, you are also camping close to a beautiful nature reserve. Welcome to a quiet campsite which is a great place for families.

Friendly reception

The campsite is easy to reach. After leaving the 159 take the 105 towards České Budějovice and you will soon arrive at your destination. The road is easily accessible even for larger caravans and motorhomes.

At the entrance an equipped mobile home serves as a reception building. You will receive a very friendly welcome here. Before you know it you can go to your pitch. There are several pitches; with and without shade and by the river or a little further inland. There are also beautiful glamping tents and various mobile homes available. The choice is all yours.

Facilities

You don't always have to cook, because the campsite has a snack bar and restaurant. Sitting on the terrace by the river with a drink in your hand is also highly recommended. And every morning you can enjoy fresh bread.

At the bar you can buy some products, but for the real shopping you have to go to one of the villages in the area. At the reception you can not only ask all your questions, you will also be helped with nice cycling routes.

properties.name: L'Espérance
properties.description:
L'Ésperance is a campsite in Normandy, located near the beach and the English Channel. You camp on a playfully landscaped campsite, where the touring pitches are delimited by conifers. With its beautiful swimming pool and modern sanitary facilities, this campsite is very suitable for families with children. Ideal for a day at the beach to swim or look for shells.

The campsite is located in the French department of Manche, on the Normandy coast. The seaside resort of Denneville-Plage is located roughly off the British island of Jersey. The campsite is situated just behind the dunes, five hundred metres from the beach.

Family campsite on the coast

The campsite attracts many French and Dutch families, who seek refuge in a quiet part of France. On the campsite you can relax and unwind, even though once in a while the regular guests can have an enjoyable time until late in the evening.

Complete campsite

The 35 touring pitches are separated by beautiful conifers. Apart from the touring pitches there are about twenty mobile homes and lodge tents and also permanent pitches. The outdoor swimming pool is situated behind the reception building. Part of the pool is shallow so the smaller swimmers can stand there easily. Next to the pool, you can sit down with a drink on the covered terrace. The pool also features a triple water slide.

Heated toilet block

The toilet block has ample facilities and is heated. There are separate sanitary facilities for children and disabled people.

properties.name: Valamar Camping Krk
properties.description:
The five-star family campsite Valamar Camping Krk is on the beautiful island of Krk in Croatia, also called the 'Golden Island'. This campsite is right by the azure blue Adriatic Sea. The emphasis is on quality and comfort, with facilities such as heated outdoor swimming pools, a restaurant and a supermarket.

Spacious pitches and luxury accommodation

If you come with your caravan, motorhome or trailer tent, then you will stay on a well-maintained and paved site at Valamar Camping Krk. The camping pitches range in size from 80 m2 to 110 m2 and have all the necessary connections. Each camping pitch is surrounded by a hedge, which contributes to the feeling of privacy and peace.

This campsite stands out due to its rental accommodation: glamping tents and luxury mobile homes, some with sea views. All models are equipped with air-conditioning and a veranda.

Everything within reach

Valamar Camping Krk is right by the sea. It has a pebble beach with a paved patio with sun loungers and parasols for hire. Swim in the outdoor swimming pools with a panoramic view of the sea. Take your bathrobe with you as there are wellness amenities here, such as a sauna and several whirlpools.

Explore the island

The campsite's central location makes it easy to explore the island of Krk by car. Visit the village of Punat (8 km), for example, the observation point at Mali Hlam (13 km) or the stalactite caves in Biserujka (25 km). If you'd rather put on your walking shoes, the town of Krk (2 km) is about a 30-minute walk.

properties.name: Camping Les Genêts
properties.description:
Camping Les Genêts, located in the Midi-Pyrénées in the South of France, is a valhalla for swimmers. There's a water park on the campsite. The largest recreation lake in the South of France (Lac de Pareloup) is also right on the doorstep. A large playground, multi-sports field, recreation area, disco and entertainment team make this holiday paradise complete.

Wooded terrain

On the green property there are many tall trees and bushes that provide shade and privacy. The pitches are located on terraces or directly on the water and are demarcated with low bushes. The ground is grassy. 

Want to hire something? You can also book a mobile home, tent or chalet. The rental accommodations seem to be very close together at first glance, but are looking good and have sufficient privacy.

Water park with a theme

The water park on the campsite has an Indian theme. The kids can play in a teepee by the swimming pool. There is also a swimming pool with a current and and a toddler pool with a slide. Around the pools there are several chairs and loungers. 

Lake with plenty of opportunities

In the nearby lake, you can practice water sports: kayaking, surfing, sailing, waterskiing and fishing are just a few options. There is also a jetty and in the water there are a few inflatable toys. You can easily rent a kayak, surfboard and boat at the campsite. You can also take surfing and sailing lessons. 

A snack al fresco

Considering that it is about 30 km driving to the nearest large supermarket, it's nice that you can get all of your groceries on the campsite. For a snack away from the camper or caravan, come to the camping restaurant.

properties.name: Camping Karda Beach and Bungalows
properties.description:
Camping Karda Beach and Bungalows lies in the green Greek island of Corfu, only a fifteen-minute drive from the capital, Kerkyra. Your pitch here is only a one minute walk away from the beautiful pebble beach of Dassia. Instead of swimming in the Ionian Sea, you can also dive into the attractive campsite swimming pool. The level grounds are a former olive grove; a natural and lovely ambiance.

Sun and shade on spacious pitches

The demarcated pitches are amply shaded thanks to the olive trees on the campsite. Prefer some more sun? If so, choose a pitch on the large, open field near the swimming pool. All pitches are level and vary in size, but even on the smaller pitches, motorhomes with awning can easily be accommodated. The demarcation with flowering bushes ensures ample privacy on your pitch. The surface is a tad hard in the dry summers. Kada Beach also has very comfortable bungalows and tents for hire.

Swimming pool or the sea?

The attractive and spacious swimming pool (with toddler pool) is surrounded by a terrace with lawn, sun umbrellas and sun loungers. There is a restaurant and bar next to the swimming pool. Prefer to swim in the sea? Follow the footpath (100 m) to the beach. The beach consists of both sand and pebbles. The beach is popular with tourists, yet stylish. You will find a wide range of shops, restaurants, cocktail bars and water sports locations here.

Regional dishes in the restaurant

The restaurant offers daily freshly prepared regional dishes. There is also a cafeteria/bar for snacks, grilled dishes, drinks and cocktails.

properties.name: Camping Aginara Beach
properties.description:
Campsite Aginara Beach is beautifully situated in the western part of one of the most spectacular regions in Greece: the Peloponnese region. This small-scale campsite is located directly by the sea, making it an ideal destination for a beach holiday. Here, you can camp in undisturbed bliss on a spacious pitch with shade, with every facility at your fingertips. The campsite is located in Glifa, a quiet village far away from the busy roads. To reach the campsite, you will drive past a market garden landscape, a feast for the eyes!

Camping amidst green

On this green campsite, you will camp on spacious pitches. These pitches are not marked, but they are separated so everyone can enjoy the privacy of their own pitch. You will camp comfortably among the trees, which offer plenty of shade. The sanitary facilities on the campsite are simple and well-maintained. Don't have camping equipment? In that case, there are cosy and cheerful bungalows available for rent.

Beach holiday in Greece

You will not need a swimming pool at Aginara Beach. Gorgeous sandy beaches are always within walking distance of the campsite. Just dive into the water and enjoy! You can also go windsurfing or water skiing here. Ideal for if you are looking for an active vacation.

This is a small-scale campsite, but there are some facilities, such as a restaurant. Take a look at the menu and you will be surprised at the many Greek specialities that you can choose from. There is also a beach bar with spectacular views of the Ionian Sea. The small on-site supermarket has a basic supply of groceries, allowing you to cook your own meals.

properties.name: Camping de Kreekoever
properties.description:
Camping de Kreekoever is located in the middle of the wooded creek area of the Zeeland peninsula Schouwen-Duiveland, within walking distance of the Oosterschelde. This is a wonderful area for relaxing, enjoying water sports, or taking a lovely cycling or hiking trip. The beach, the forest, several museums and picturesque villages can all be reached on foot or by bike.

Shade and privacy

The site looks tidy and is well-maintained. The tourist pitches are on the edges of fields lined with old oak trees and sheltered fields. There is plenty of space and you can enjoy the shade every day. The central fields are all permanent and seasonal pitches, bordered by high hedges. Rent a chalet or lodge tent for added comfort. 

Strolling along the Oosterschelde

In the Oosterschelde, one kilometre away, you can enjoy swimming, kite and regular surfing, sailing, scuba diving and sunbathing. There are two sandy beaches in the immediate vicinity of the campsite. Take a stroll along the edge of the water; who knows what will wash up... 

Play or head to the entertainment

Children can play on a playground with all kinds of equipment or show off their skills on the trampoline. Sporty guests can enjoy the spacious grass field or the table tennis table. There is an entertainment team in the high season to organise a range of activities, from kid's bingo to ghost tours.

Camping shop

The camping shop has a limited range, featuring fresh vegetables and fruit. Fresh bread is also available in the high season. Two restaurants can be found in the area surrounding Camping De Kreekoever, while more choice is available in Ouwerkerk, which is close by.

properties.name: Airotel Le Raguenès Plage
properties.description:
Airotel Le Raguenès Plage is located just three hundred metres from three beautiful sandy beaches, a quiet family campsite surrounded by greenery. This four-star campsite is ideal for families with young children. There are many play facilities and all facilities are designed for small children and their parents.

In the green

The campsite is beautifully landscaped and well-maintained. The many trees provide shade and the pitches are separated by wide, high hedges. Camping Le Raguenès Plage consists mainly of touring pitches, but there are also a few permanent pitches. There are also more than seventy mobile homes for rent. Not all of them are brand new, but they are well-maintained and clean.

Swimming and relaxing

On the edge of the campsite, next to the restaurant, is a beautiful water park. From the pavement café at the bar you overlook the heated paddling pool. Behind it you can see the large outdoor pool and the indoor pool. The four water slides lead into a separate pool. All baths are heated and located in the full sun. And what could be nicer than spending an afternoon relaxing in the sauna or beauty centre while the children are taken care of by the entertainment team?

Lovely beach holiday

From the campsite you have access to three beaches with fine, white sand. It's only a three hundred metre walk to the nearest sandy beach. From a small gate on the edge of the campsite, a path leads through the fields directly to the beach. Plage de Raguenès is a clean beach with plenty of showers and waste bins. The sea here is usually calm and clear.

properties.name: Ideal Camping
properties.description:
Ideal Camping is a family campsite where you can enjoy the sun, sea and beach. You are here in the village of Saint-Georges-de-Didonne, located in the tourist region of Charente-Maritime (on the French west coast). The campsite is situated just 200 metres from the sandy beach and 7 kilometres from the popular seaside resort of Royan. The campsite has several sports fields. Entertainment is available during the high season.

Camping between trees

Ideal Camping looks well maintained. The campsite is located in the heart of the Suzac Forest. For example, there are pine, oak, acacia and sycamore trees. The pitches are on level ground and are intermittently separated by trees. Want a little more luxury? Then you can opt for a caravan (all are equipped with a wooden terrace).

Water fun with tropical atmospheres

Families with children, in particular, can have a great time at this campsite. For example, there is a fantastic (heated) water park with slides. There is a toddler pool for the little ones. Every day, you can join in the aqua gym. Prefer to relax for a while? That is sure to happen in the Jacuzzi or on the sun terrace with free sun loungers. Do you prefer to lie by the sea? Just cross the road and you can enjoy a relaxing beach day by the sea.

A nice drink on the terrace

Ideal Camping has its own restaurant-snack bar with a terrace. You can go there for a bite to eat or order take-out. There are also themed evenings, such as a 'moules-frites' (mussels and chips) night or a grill night. For your basic necessities, visit the small supermarket in the campsite. You will find local produce and fresh bread.

properties.name: Camping Clair Matin
properties.description:
Camping Clair Matin is located in the low mountain range of the Isère, at the foot of the Alps. You'll camp here in a green mountain landscape near the spa town of Allevard. This old but well-kept campsite offers a friendly atmosphere and shaded touring pitches. The pitches on the terraces are spacious and sheltered. There is something to do for everyone. The swimming pool is ideal for water lovers. You’ll find thermal baths in Allevard.

Shady terraced campsite

Campsite Clair Matin is an old lady: tall, old trees and spacious planting provide plenty of shade and privacy on the touring pitches. There are spacious pitches on several terraces, they in fact consist of two pitches. One is for your caravan or tent, the other serves as an approach road to your pitch. Some terraces are more difficult to reach because of the steep slopes. If necessary, your caravan can be brought to your pitch by tractor.

Sunny swimming pool

The swimming pool is situated on a lower part of the terrain. Many of the pitches on the higher terraces overlook the outdoor pool. The pool is in a sunny spot, but surrounded by trees and shrubs. So if the sun is too much you can always quickly seek out the shade. A paddling pool provides water fun for the youngest swimmers.

Food truck with pavement café

lose to the entrance of the campsite is the restaurant: a food truck where they serve tasty dishes at fair prices. The pavement café is under a large tent in front of the truck. Please note: at the foodtruck you cannot pay with your bank card.

properties.name: RCN Zeewolde
properties.description:
RCN Zeewolde is situated in the Flevopolder. This campsite is sought-after by tourists because of its proximity to Wolderwijd, a large lake where water sports are very popular. However, the campsite itself also offers ample amusement for young and old with a swimming pool, playgrounds, entertainment, yoga lessons and sports fields (panna field, tennis court, table tennis table, pétanque court and volleyball field).

Camping by the water

The pitches look spacious and are mostly located at the edge of the forest. There are shaded pitches with trees and sunny pitches for sun lovers. The pitches by the water are the most beautiful, but are somewhat more compact and less demarcated than the other pitches. Rental accommodation is also available at RCN Zeewolde (bungalows, cottages and lodge tents).

Water fun galore

The little ones can splash around in the open in a colourfully designed shallow pool. Here are also a few slides and some play equipment. There is also a covered swimming pool. In summer you will, of course, look for the lake and the beach, a five minute walk from the camping fields.

Children can enjoy themselves in the playgrounds and sandboxes (with nice wooden play equipment). In bad weather the recreational area is a lovely retreat. Also fun: the petting zoo and the fossils field. No inspiration at the moment? If so, there is an entertainment programme for children and adults.

Supermarket and restaurant

The supermarket is well-stocked, not only with foodstuffs and beverages, but also non-food items (newspapers, cosmetics and toys). This allows you to whip up some tasty dishes to serve at the camping table. Not exactly a Cordon Bleu chef? Sit down at one of the restaurant tables (full menu) or go to the snack bar.

properties.name: Flower Camping La Vidaresse
properties.description:
Camping La Vidaresse is a cosy French campsite in Provence. You will camp in the heart of beautiful nature and a five-minute walk from the cosy village of Sainte-Anastasie-sur-Issole. On the campsite, the swimming pool and its two slides is the main attraction. There’s a great bar with a terrace, where live music is often organised in the evenings. This is the perfect base for the beach, visits to picturesque villages and walks among lavender fields and vineyards.

Relaxed atmosphere

The campsite is flat and has about 30 pitches. In between them, there are mobile homes, which might be for you if you like a little more luxury. You can choose from different sizes. All of them have a private patio where you can enjoy a fresh breakfast in the morning.

Swim in any weather

The outdoor pool is large and has two big slides. You will have many hours of water fun here! In bad weather, the sliding roof of the pool is closed. The loungers invite you to lay back and read a book and aquagym lessons are on the programme in summer. A private pool has been created for the little ones. Swimming in the Mediterranean is wonderful too; the nearest beaches and pretty seaside resorts are a 40-minute drive from the campsite.

Tasty snacks and drinks

The bar is at the heart of the campsite. For a drink, an ice cream or a sandwich in the daytime; in the evening, it also serves simple meals in high season. Children love the Kids Club. The trampoline, playground, tennis court, volleyball court and boules court are all popular as well.

properties.name: ParcCamping de Witte Vennen
properties.description:
ParcCamping de Witte Vennen is a family campsite in the vicinity of Venray, located on a large lake with a separate recreation lake. The campsite has spacious pitches and comfort pitches directly by the water. There is also a possibility to rent luxury bungalows and chalets. On the campsite you will find playgrounds, a sports field, tennis courts and (free of charge) pedal boats.

Gigantic camping pitches and luxury accommodation

You are camping here amidst greenery on a park-like terrain. All standard pitches are spacious (125 m2) and you don't have any neighbours facing you. At Parc de Witte Vennen you can also rent luxury bungalows. These are situated in a wooded area or by the water. You can enjoy the view from your terrace.

Centrally situated on the campsite you will find the new, very luxurious sanitary pavilion with splendid children's sanitary facilities. You will also find modern sanitary buildings on the other fields. Thought has also been given to disabled persons.

Plenty of activities to keep both children and couples occupied

On this campsite you will mostly come across children of up to age 14 during weekends and holidays. There is an extensive range of facilities for this age group, such as various playgrounds on the camping fields. Near the large playground on the beach pool, there is also an 18-hole mini golf course, beach volleyball field and a small football pitch. You can also play table tennis. 

Pedal boats are available free of charge for exploring the large lake. In the meantime parents can try their hand at a game of tennis. A great entertainment programme is also offered during the holiday periods. The social hub of the campsite is the beach pool (with the best swimming water in the Netherlands) including sunbathing lawn and large water slide.

properties.name: Camping de Haspelschiedt
properties.description:
Camping de Haspelschiedt is situated in the Vosges du Nord Regional Nature Park, not far from the French-German border. In this stunning location, high up on a mountain, you camp on non-demarcated pitches, with a view of Haspelschiedt lake. With this lake at the foot of the campsite, you have a great swimming spot on your doorstep. The campsite forms an ideal base for a long walk through the forests and the unique nature of the Pays de Bitche, the area surrounding the town of Bitche.

Free camping

The campsite itself is modest and basic, though its location is beautiful: on top of a mountain overlooking the lake. You can camp on the large field on spacious, non-demarcated pitches. There are also some rental bungalows available.

Nature lovers and motor cyclists

In summer, the campsite is very popular with nature lovers. The surrounding nature area deserves to be explored further. In low season you may come across young people and motor cyclists. 

Etang d’Haspelschiedt

The proximity to the French-German border is borne out by the name of the lake at the foot of the campsite: Etang d’Haspelschiedt. Only a few minutes' walk to get there. The lake is very suitable for swimming and the lawn by the quay is perfect for soaking up the sun.

Restaurant

You don't have to traipse down the mountain for your dinner. The campsite has a restaurant overlooking the lake where you can enjoy a meal. Alternatively, you can gather the necessary ingredients for a quick dinner from the campsite supermarket.

properties.name: Camping De Kérantérec
properties.description:
Along a natural stream on the southern coast of Bretagne lies campsite De Kérantérec, a quiet family campsite just five hundred metres from a beautiful sandy beach on the Atlantic Ocean. For even more water fun, you can go for a swim in the swimming pool complex. After a day of swimming, grab a bite to eat at the pizzeria. Campsite De Kérantérec is green in two ways: there are broad-leaved trees, palm trees and flowers everywhere on the camping grounds, and the campsite cares for the environment as well.

Camping on green terraces

De Kérantérec is a terraced campsite, situated on a sloping property. The paths are narrow in places, and not all of them are paved. The campsite grounds are nicely laid-out and well-maintained; the spacious camping pitches and the surrounding greenery are well-tended. Here, you camp on grassy pitches under the broad-leaved trees. The pitches are surrounded by tall hedges. The mobile homes are also situated on spacious green pitches which are separated by hedges. The best spots are naturally those with a view of the sea.

Complete beach holiday package

If you head the other way from the campsite, you will reach the Plage de Kerléven after a ten-minute walk, a sandy beach in Concarneau bay. On this beautiful sandy beach, you can sunbathe and play to your heart's content and savour the sunset. In the ocean, you can go swimming, snorkelling or scuba diving. Windsurfing, sailing and waterskiing are also allowed here. 

Materials and lessons

Boats, surfboards and materials are available for rent at the harbour, but you are also allowed to bring your own sailing or motor yacht with you. If you are less experienced, you can follow sailing or surfing lessons on the spot.

properties.name: Camping Des Hautes Grées
properties.description:
Camping Des Hautes Grées is a well-maintained campsite close to the port town of Erquy on the Breton Côte-d'Armor. Here you camp almost by the Atlantic Ocean and the beach. The campsite is decorated with flowers and consists mainly of spacious touring pitches, situated on lawns lined with hedges.

Well-kept and calm

The campsite is very well-cared for and orderly. Colourful flower boxes brighten up the site. Approximately one hundred and eighty touring pitches are situated on lawns, bordered by hedges and shrubs. The touring pitches are situated in small groups and enclosed by high hedges, providing enough privacy for a quiet pitch. In addition to the touring pitches, there are over thirty rental accommodations to choose from.

Swimming pool

The outdoor swimming pool is situated in a sunny area of the campsite. Even when it's a bit colder, you can take a dip; the pool is wonderfully heated. Next to the spacious swimming pool is a paddling pool, with sun loungers all around. The whole complex is fenced off by a low fence. Next to it there is another toilet block. The sanitary facilities on the campsite are, like everything else, well taken care of.

Picturesque Erquy

For groceries you go to the supermarket in the center Erquy which is only a pleasant trip of fifteen minutes by bike. You can also extend your bike ride by cycling along the steep coast and enjoy some beautiful views. Anyway, Erboquy is worth a visit. In the summer there is often a weekly market.

properties.name: Camping Terme Olimia/Natura
properties.description:
Camping Terme Olimia/Natura is located near Podčertek, a town in eastern Slovenia situated along the Croatian border. The area surrounding the campsite is hilly. The campsite grounds, on the other hand, are flat. The area reserved for camping is relatively small and is part of a holiday park with bungalows and glamping tents. One kilometre from the campsite, you can make use of the many spa activities and a subtropical water park for a fee.

Bungalows, glamping tents and touring pitches

The grounds seem well-organised and are not particularly large. It is just a short distance from the reception to the camping pitches. The pitches are arranged in small lanes and the grounds are well-kept. There are few touring pitches because the grounds are currently being re-landscaped. How the touring pitches will be situated once this is done is not clear yet. The current pitches are all similar in size.

There are many bungalows on Camping Terme Olimia/Natura as well as glamping tents, which are situated on two separate fields. This campsite is actually more of a holiday park with mostly bungalows and glamping tents and a few touring pitches. The sanitary facilities are fine and well-maintained.

Swimming and spa

In the peak season, many campers come to make use of the thermal waters in the swimming pools and the facilities of the resort within walking distance from the campsite. Here you will also find spa facilities.

Bites and drinks

There is a small supermarket on the campsite for your daily needs. There is also a bar and a restaurant at the water park complex. The restaurant does not have a special menu but serves typical snacks and meals.

properties.name: Camping des Gayeulles
properties.description:
Camping Des Gayeulles, nestled in the beautiful Gayeulles Park, is located in the heart of Breton’s capital city Rennes. You experience the best of two worlds here: the nearness of the city and the tranquillity of the countryside. Whether you come with your own camping equipment, choose to rent a luxury city lodge or prefer a small hut, Camping Des Gayeulles has something for everyone.

The vast Gayeulles Park

The park in which the campsite is located is more than 100 hectares in size and is an ideal spot for families and sports enthusiasts. Enjoy lovely hikes through wooded areas, over open meadows and past ponds. There are also sports paths, foot trails and cycle paths and a recreational lake with an indoor swimming pool. The neighbourhood boasts a petting zoo as well.

Food and drinks along the waterfront

You are very welcome all year round in Camping Des Gayeulles’ modern reception building. The campsite attracts mainly pensioners, resulting in a quiet and relaxed atmosphere. Although the campsite itself does not have a restaurant, Brasserie Le Parc de Bois is only a five-minute walk away. From April to October this bustling location on the water is also the place to be with its evening concerts and music.

Travelling without a car

Camping Des Gayeulles is easily accessible by public transportation or bicycle. The bus stop is only 500 metres away and the nearest metro station is a fifteen-minute walk away. A lovely green cycle route, about 5 kilometres long, takes you to the historic centre of Rennes.

properties.name: Alannia Costa Dorada
properties.description:
Camping Alannia Costa Dorada is located in the centre of the Costa Dorada and is surrounded by greenery, sea and mountains. The campsite is not far from the long beautiful sandy beach of L'Hospitalet de l'Infant. Over the past fifty years the domain has developed into a comfortable and quiet family campsite covering an area of some 10 ha. Here you can enjoy the shade provided by more than three thousand trees.

Variety of pitches

At Camping Alannia Costa Dorada you have a choice of various camping pitches. A standard camping pitch is some 45-60m2 in size. The larger pitches measure 75m2 and are equipped with electricity conection (6A). 

Which accommodation suits you best?

Are you arriving without your own tent or caravan? If so, choose between a large number of bungalows and mobile homes, which are equipped with all amenities. Enjoy the luxury of a fridge, a microwave oven and a Nespresso coffee maker. The rental accommodation units are suitable for up to six persons. There are also several mobile homes and (lodge) tents for rent. Are you coming with a dog? They are welcome in one of the 'classic tents'.

Swimming pool and wellness

The campsite has several luxury swimming pools, surrounded by sunny terraces with sun umbrellas and loungers. In addition, there is a comprehensive wellness service with jacuzzis, solariums and a range of massages.

Food and drink

Obviously, this large campsite also has its own restaurant and bar. There is also a supermarket. Fortunately, the campsite is close to charming villages, so you can easily eat out in one of the many restaurants there. The choice is yours ...

properties.name: Camping De Peel
properties.description:
Camping De Peel is situated on the border of Noord-Brabant and Limburg, in the centre of the Peel area. On this small-sized family campsite, priority is given to a relaxing atmosphere. The spacious and neat camping pitches are spread over different camping fields and the campsite also has some chalets and motorhome sites. Families with young children, seekers of peace and quiet, as well as nature lovers will really feel at home here.

Relaxed campsite

The campsite is pleasantly laid out on several small fields without being too rigidly demarcated. At the front of the campsite you will find the newer pitches. Further down are the remaining camping pitches, all speciously laid out with a level grass surface. You can also stay in a chalet or bungalow on the campsite. These are very neat units, entirely in style with the campsite.

Entertainment in various forms

Centrally located on the campsite you will find the recreation area with terrace, where you can enjoy a drink or an ice cream. From the terrace you can overlook the central playground and the campsite pool with slide. Children amuse themselves in peak season with treasure hunts, drops, crafts afternoons or by looking after the goats, chickens and ponies on the farm. In addition, they can explore the camping grounds on borrowed go-karts.

Bread roll service and food truck

Camping de Peel does not have a campsite shop or restaurant, although it offers a bread service. To add variety to your evening meal, a food truck stops by twice weekly. You don't have to go far for your daily shopping, there is a supermarket in nearby Heusden.

properties.name: Naturcamping Lassan
properties.description:
Naturcamping Lassan is by the water in a quiet section of the German Baltic coast. The charming town of Lassan, right across from the island Usedom, is near the friendly campsite. The restaurant offers a varied and high-quality menu and looks welcoming. The campsite has a sauna, and you can visit the recreational lake (within walking distance) to cool off. This region is ideal for lovers of water sports and hiking enthusiasts.

View of the island

There is an informal atmosphere at the camping site of Naturcamping Lassan. Tents, caravans and motorhomes are pleasantly mixed together on several grassy fields. All pitches are level and vary in size. Some pitches are under old trees. Adding to the charm is the view of the island Usedom from several pitches. The wine barrels (glamping pods), furnished for overnight stays, are very nicely decorated. The young owners like to think in sustainable solutions, such as the use of solar panels.

Child-friendly swimming lake

The well-kept camping site is linked to the inland sea of Peenestrom/Achterwasser by a canal. To get to the small swimming area (flat and child-friendly), follow a nature path for 150 metres. Dogs are welcome as well and there is a playground. The water sports school, where you can rent a standup paddleboard, a pedal boat or a surfboard, is located on the site.

Delicious local food

Camper Treff is the restaurant with a beautiful interior and a charming terrace. The menu has local dishes as well as pizza. A good breakfast or a piece of pie is also available. Fresh fish is smoked regularly and you can attend live concerts.

properties.name: Ballum Camping
properties.description:
Ballum Campsite is a quiet, sheltered natural campsite. The campsite is located in the heart of the Vadehavet (Wadden Sea) National Park in very rural surroundings. From here it is not far to the Wadden Sea island of Rømø (with the widest sandy beach in Europe) and the historical towns of Ribe and Tønder . The campsite forms an ideal base for exploring the thinly populated region.

Spacious campsite

The campsite consists of clearly separated fields each offering space for several tents and caravans. A new circular-shaped terrain has been laid out for motorhomes. The sizes of the pitches vary from 100 to as much as 240 m2.

Relaxing in a rustic chalet

Ballum Campsite has four chalets which can be rented throughout the year. These rustic wooden chalets are in a quiet location and offer ample privacy. The chalets can be booked per night or per week. You can make use of all the campsite facilities. The chalets are suitable for two (type B) or four people (type A). Luxury safari tents are also available for rent.

Dogs are welcome

The campsite owners are real dog lovers. That is why your four-legged friends are welcome at Ballum Campsite. The campsite has a fenced-off leash field where you can play with your dog, It is also easy to walk the dog outside of the campsite. On the camping grounds, the dog must be leashed; this is not necessary near your camping equipment. 

Entertainment for children

For the children there is a playground which includes playground equipment and a bouncy castle. There is also a lovely area where you can read or watch TV. You also have the possibility to get active with free go-karts, table football, table tennis, billiards and bowling.

properties.name: Camping Le Pontet
properties.description:
Camping Le Pontet is situated in the south of the Ardèche, near the village of St-Martin-d’Ardèche. You’ll be camping at a well-maintained family-friendly campsite where you can experience French camping life to the fullest. There’s a lovely swimming pool, fun entertainment and a bar where the owner herself does the cooking. Just a stone’s throw away is the famous Route des Gorges de L’Ardèche, and the surrounding area is also known for its stunning cycle routes.

Camping under the trees

The site looks lovely and green thanks to the many trees, which contribute to a relaxed atmosphere. The campsite consists of two parts. In one part you’ll find the pitches and accommodation, with the spacious touring pitches and seasonal pitches separated from the mobile homes. In the other part of the campsite are the swimming pool and sports fields.

A splash in the swimming pool

Fancy a swim in the French sun? The swimming pool is open from May. The youngest campers can splash about in the separate paddling pool. Next to the swimming pool is a small playground that also provides plenty of entertainment. The young French owners ensure that everything runs smoothly and organise fun activities for all the campsite's guests. Games, pony rides, sports competitions, as well as music and dance evenings in the summer. On the charming outdoor terrace under the trees, they serve a range of items, including breakfast, chips, cocktails and Belgian beers.

The natural spectacle of the Ardèche

If you’re going camping in the Ardèche, a visit to the spectacular Gorges de l’Ardèche is an absolute highlight. The Pont d’Arc is a must-see. Fancy some action? The campsite regularly organises canoe and kayak trips on the river.

properties.name: Camping Lann Brick
properties.description:
On the west coast of Brittany, on a peninsula between the Gulf of Morbihan and the Atlantic Ocean, you find the Lann Brick campsite. At this child-friendly campsite, just a few hundred metres from the beach, you'll camp on a small-scale terrain where peace and quiet dominate. The friendly owners ensure a family atmosphere.

Quiet campsite

On the small-scale campsite of Lann Brick there peace and quiet dominate. The site has around forty touring pitches and the same number of rental accommodations. In addition, another thirty pitches are reserved for regular guests. The touring pitches are beautifully green and delimited by hedges. In principle they are spacious enough, but for extra-large campers or caravans they can be a tight.

Quiet and child friendly

The quiet character of the campsite is reflected in its guests: campers looking for peace and quiet, families with children, because the campsite is certainly child friendly. Especially the heated swimming pool (with sliding roof), brightened up with palm trees, is popular with younger campers. With a paddling pool, separated from the rest of the pool by a net, even the smallest bathers have the opportunity to enjoy the warm water.

Fresh bread and fresh fish

Shopping? At the campsite you can buy only the bare necessities. For more extensive groceries you only have to drive five minutes to a supermarket north of the campsite. But first drive on to Crac'h where you'll find a patisserie, bakery and fishmonger.

properties.name: Camping Village Lago Maggiore
properties.description:
With a versatile environment (nature and culture in abundance) the area around Lago Maggiore is popular with many holiday makers. Camping Village Lago Maggiore, near the town of Dormelletto, is a spacious campsite on the southern shore of the lake. The entire family will have a top rate holiday on this child-friendly campsite.

Spacious campsite

The campsite consists of some three hundred pitches, mostly demarcated and in the shade. There are approximately two hundred permanent pitches. The remaining pitches are located close to the beach. The section with rental accommodation is separated from the remainder of the campsite. The camping pitches are predominantly level and spacious by Italian standards.

A holiday oasis on the most beautiful lake

Near the restaurant and the entertainment area lies a glorious outdoor swimming pool with colourful slide. There is also a kiddie pool. The largest swimming pool is of course Lago Maggiore! This beautiful lake is situated within walking distance of the campsite. There is an adjacent, well maintained sunbathing lawn with two small beaches.

Entertainment and disco

The campsite itself also offers sufficient entertainment. There is an entertainment team for young children. Teenagers will thoroughly enjoy themselves on the sports fields or in the recreation area. On the disco evenings you can hit the dance floor on the terrace next to the swimming pool.

Cooking or eating out?

Whether you like to cook yourself or rather eat out, you can do it all at camping Village Lago Maggiore. Hobby cooks can do their shopping in the campsite shop or in the large shopping centre across from the campsite.  Don't feel like cooking or doing the dishes? On and adjacent to the campsite are several eating and drinking establishments.

properties.name: Campingplatz Eulenburg
properties.description:
On the southwestern edge of the Harz nature reserve in Lower Saxony, Germany, you find the cosy Campingplatz Eulenburg. Here, you camp amidst greenery, surrounded by trees, streams, and the Söse river. The campsite is an ideal vacation spot for nature lovers and families with young children.

Camping in the green

You are welcome with your tent, caravan, or motorhome on one of the camping pitches, ranging in size from 80 to 200 m². There is a separate motorhome area where 13 motorhomes can park. This motorhome area also features a camping meadow with a barbecue spot, a hut, and a small stage where groups regularly stay.

Outdoor pool and a cosy beer garden

Children have plenty of fun on the campsite. The outdoor pool is spacious and ideal for a refreshing swim and guaranteed fun in the water. At the front of the campsite, little campers can play at the playground with swings, slides and climbing frames. A fun game of bowling can be enjoyed at the bowling centre. Feeling hungry after an active day? Try a delicious schnitzel or currywurst at the restaurant Gaststube Zur Eule and enjoy a beer in the cosy beer garden.

Explore the Harz

Climb the highest mountain of the Harz and northern Germany, the Brocken (1141 meters). You can do this on foot, but what might be even more fun is taking the steam train from Drei Annen Hohne (54 km). It takes you to the top of the mountain in about 40 minutes.

properties.name: Camping Les Ceriselles
properties.description:
You will find the well-organised campsite Les Ceriselles near Vincelles in a hilly area with vineyards and cherry trees. The campsite is beautifully situated along the Burgundy wine route near the Yvonne river. This modern, clearly organised campsite is situated at an elevation of approximately 150 metres.

The spacious pitches (80 - 120 m2 in size) are situated along pathways. You will have the most privacy on the outskirts of the campsite. The level grass pitches are demarcated and offer little or no shade. Campers from Western Europe, most of whom are travelling through, visit the campsite.

Going for a refreshing swim

There is a small heated indoor swimming pool (44 m2) with a sliding roof. The beach volleyball sports field, the boules court and the table tennis table are the places to show off your sports skills. For fishing enthusiasts, there is a large fishing pond measuring 4 hectares in the vicinity.

Entertainment and sports

There is a playground for the children as well as an entertainment programme in English and French. You can play a game of minigolf for a fee. There are also tennis courts available for rent. The snack bar offers a limited menu. You can also get takeaway meals here. For your grocery shopping, you will find a large supermarket just 200 metres from the campsite. The campsite shop stocks a limited range of products and there is fresh bread available.

Beautiful cycling trips along the canal

You can rent bicycles (also electric bicycles) and mountain bikes at the reception. The campsite is the ideal starting point for beautiful and level cycling routes along the river and the canal. It's fun to see how the manually-operated locks work from up close...

properties.name: Flower Camping La Sténiole
properties.description:
In the green surroundings of the Vosges and located in the Ballons des Vosges Regional Nature Park, you will find camping La Sténiole. This mountainous part of France in the northeast of the country is a superb walking region with vast forests. On the campsite you camp on pitches at the edge of the forest, where you can build and sit around a campfire at night. Savour the homemade pizzas and tarte flambée in the campsite restaurant.

Camping with a view of the forest

The camping pitches at campsite La Sténiole are located between trees and meandering streams. At the edge of the forest, around the small lake or on open lawns. You are staying on a terraced campsite, hence the camping pitches are located at different elevations. The mobile homes have a terrace with a beautiful view of the forest.

The highest water slide

Since 2018 campsite La Sténiole boasts the highest water slide in the area. Undoubtedly, children will be eager to slide down this chute. The slide is located near the outdoor swimming pool. There is also a indoor pool with a retractable roof. When it starts raining, the roof can be closed. You can also go fishing in the small lake. Getting onto the water with a canoe or rubber dinghy is also great fun.

Playing outdoors

Excursions from the campsite revolve around the beautiful nature. At the reception they will gladly provide you with information for an energetic walk in the Vosges. Furthermore, you can also indulge in mountain biking, bungee jumping or tree climbing in the area. The area around the campsite is a veritable outdoor play paradise for children. Here they can play near mountain streams in the woods or go canoeing on the lake.

properties.name: Sites & Paysages De Penboch
properties.description:
At Camping Sites & Paysages De Penboch you can camp in the middle of nature, close to the Gulf of Morbihan. On the campsite you have the choice of different types of pitches. You can choose a nice, secluded spot for some extra privacy, or an open spot in the pine forest. The campsite is a good starting point to discover the islands of the Gulf.

Welcome!

You will be welcomed to the modern campsite reception by the owners or by one of the campsite's experienced receptionists. You can then pitch your tent, camper or caravan on one of the spacious pitches. Don't have your own camping equipment? Then you can rent a mobile home (4 to 8 people) or a holiday home.

Private sanitary facilities

The location of the mobile homes and pitches has been carefully considered. Most pitches are close to the sanitary facilities, so you don't have to walk far. The sanitary facilities on the campsite are well maintained and even here you have a choice. For example, in addition to the normal sanitary facilities, there are private sanitary units that you can rent.

Swimming fun

The campsite has a water park with two swimming pools. During the summer season you can enjoy the heated outdoor pool with slides and a children's pool. The indoor pool, also heated, is open from April to September. Ideal to have fun when the weather is a bit worse! Are you ready for something tasty after your swim? During the summer months and long weekends, the campsite's snack bar is open. The campsite also has a shop where you can order fresh bread and croissants every day.

properties.name: Camping Les Bords de Loue
properties.description:
Camping Les Bords de Loue is situated, as the name suggests, on the banks of the Loue River (abounding in fish), not far from the village of Parcey and the town of Dole (Jura). This region is characterised by its many rivers which flow from the mountains through the hilly landscape towards the west and the south. The campsite makes a very green impression and looks very appealing because of the large number of trees on the grounds.

Green and spacious

You will be warmly welcomed in the spacious reception by the owners or one of their helpful employees. You can see at a glance that the campsite is not only green, but also very spaciously laid out. The pitches are located between trees which offer ample shade. One section of the campsite is reserved for mobile homes, but the majority is made up of touring pitches. The pitches measure at least 80m2 and are all equipped with electricity.

Accommodation

There are different types of rental accommodation on the campsite. The basic units - (bungalow tents, holiday cottages and tithomes) do not have private toilet facilities. Fortunately, most of them have running water and possibly a shower. The chalets and mobile homes are more luxurious and have their own shower/toilet.

Swimming pool and restaurant

The campsite has a generous swimming pool with slides, which is surrounded by a sizeable terrace with sun loungers. You can also splash around in the river. In high season the restaurant is open to guests. They serve pizzas and a few à la carte dishes. The associated bar has a terrace which borders the swimming pool.

properties.name: Camping Slamni
properties.description:
Camping Slamni is a surprising destination: it is a small-scale campsite which borders the attractive Soline Bay. You camp here on the Croation island of Krk. The bay on campsite Slamni has a very calm current and could almost be called a private inland sea. It is excellent for sailing, fishing and windsurfing. The campsite is very neat and especially popular with families with young children. There is a fun, shallow children's pool directly at the (pebble) beach.

Camping or renting?

There are 45 not very large camping pitches (35-80 m2) demarcated with walls. Other pitches are demarcated with beautiful shrubs and trees. The surface consists of crushed stone. The staff members put in a lot of effort to keep the terrain tidy at all times.

Rather rent accommodation? Book one of the twelve luxury rental accommodation units. There are new mobile homes on both sides of the campsite. These are furnished with care. You may also opt for one of the equally luxuriously equipped lodge tents. These have a homely ambiance and a wooden built-in bed with storey.

Good meals

The restaurant of the campsite looks attractive: the walls are made of white limestone, the same colour as the furniture. There is also a low walled terrace. You can sit inside, although this is also more or less outside. The food is of good quality, especially the regional dishes. And what's more: the meals are affordable.

There is a small shop for daily groceries. You will have a wider choice in the shops in Klimo. This is located within easy walking or cycling distance.

properties.name: Camping Preishof
properties.description:
Camping Preishof is located in the hilly landscape of south-east Bavaria. This campsite is part of a wellness hotel just outside Bad Füssing and offers a view of the surrounding fields. Here you will find Bavarian cosiness in the restaurant and first class comfort in the wellness area of the hotel. Bad Füssing is also a good place to be: there is an immense wellness complex with several thermal baths, sunbathing areas and restaurants.

Campsite with panoramic views

Around the colourful hotel, which is part of a complex of several buildings, lies the large campsite. This site gives a tidy impression and has room for over two hundred touring pitches, all spacious and equipped with hedges for demarcation and privacy. Especially the pitches on the edge of the terrain are beautiful. Here you have a wide view over the surrounding fields and meadows.

Peace and wellness

Camping Preishof and its surroundings breathe tranquillity and are therefore a wonderful holiday destination for campers who come for their peace and quiet. Senior campers in particular appreciate the extensive wellness facilities at the campsite and in Bad Füssing.

Bavarian cosiness in the Preishofstadl

In the large former 'stadl', a traditional barn whose authentic details can still be discovered, you will find the campsite's restaurant: restaurant Preishofstadl. The typical German benches, the heavy wooden beams and the big tap: everything indicates that you can find Bavarian conviviality here in the summer evenings. After a good meal there is always room for live music and a dance. When the weather is nice, the conviviality moves to the Biergarten.

properties.name: Camping Abijune
properties.description:
French Camping Abijune is located in picturesque Le Tilleul in Upper Normandy, just 3.5 km from Étretat. This town is known for its famous chalk cliffs, including the 'elephant rock'. On this quiet, medium-sized campsite, you’ll camp in the heart of nature, close to the GR21 walking trail. Its location by the sea, its small size and green surroundings make it an excellent destination for walkers or a relaxing stay close to the sea!

Food from a food truck

Camping Abijune has a heated and partially-covered outdoor swimming pool. The pool is conveniently located near the snack bar, so you can order a refreshing drink after a swim. Food trucks also stop by the campsite on multiple days, in both low and high season. Fun music evenings are organised in the summer too. Your (grand)children will have fun on Abijune, with the wooden play equipment or just on the campsite itself. No entertainment is organised; great if you’re looking for peace and quiet.

Renaissance architecture and green artworks

Camping Abijune is perfectly located for anyone wanting to explore the Upper Normandy coast. A visit to the iconic cliffs of Étretat, for example, is a must. Will you spot the elephant trunk in one of the rocks? Or travel to the nearby towns of Yport (15 km) and Fécamp (18.5 km). Here, you will discover the charm of the region, including the beautiful Renaissance architecture of Fécamp's Benedictine palace. Another must-see is Les Jardins d'Étretat (5 km), full of green landscape art.

properties.name: Camping Village Oasi
properties.description:
Camping Village Oasi is located to the south of Venice. The campground is located at the mouth of the river Brenta. A popular sight in the area is the town of Chioggia, a miniature Venice. From Chioggia you can take a boat to Venice (about an hour and a half).

Own marina

After leaving the centre of Sottomarina, you'll enter a quieter environment with many campgrounds each with their own access to a private beach. Camping Village Oasi has its own marina. You'll reach the campsites along the many rental accommodations (mobile homes). They are nicely maintained with here and there a flower and shade under the low growth. The sites are usually spacious enough, just a bit tight for large caravans or campers. The campers here are of many nationalities and there are tourists passing through who do not spend their entire holiday here.

Culinary restaurant

There is a swimming pool on site, where young people love to have fun and there are the necessary sports facilities. From the end of May to the end of August there is an activities programme, primarily for the children. Oasi has two bar-restaurants, one by the swimming pool and the very culinary restaurant Le Tegnùe is by the beach, which far surpasses the average campground restaurant and is also visited by many locals. The specialities are pasta and fish dishes. The campground shop has an extensive selection of groceries.

Sanitary facilities

Classic campground sanitation, clean and well maintained, with all of the necessary facilities without frills. Excellent disabled sanitation facilities.

properties.name: Camping Riva di Ugento
properties.description:
Camping Riva di Ugento is located in the most southern part of Italy's 'heel of the boot'. It is a large shady campsite, which stretches out along the Ionian Sea: an ideal place for beach lovers. With shops, restaurants, a swimming pool and sports fields, this large campsite on the Italian coast lacks nothing.

Camping Riva di Ugento is located just south of the town of Ugento, an hour's drive from Lecce. Via the coastal town of Gallipoli you drive on the SS274 in the direction of Ugento, from where it is only a short distance to the coast of the Ionian Sea. There you will find camping Riva di Ugento: a large, well organized campsite.

Shady campsite by the sea

You can choose from as many as 1000 touring pitches, many of which are in the shade. These pitches are quite spacious by Italian standards, especially when you book a comfort pitch. In addition to the many pitches, there are 170 rental accommodations: you can rent different types of mobile homes. The sanitary facilities are generally well-maintained and varied: in many sanitary blocks you will also find children's and baby facilities. Sometimes the sanitary facilities can be cleaned a little better, especially during the peak summer months.

Refreshing dip in the campsite pool

At the campsite there is a swimming pool, where you can - for a fee - take a refreshing dip. But also the various sports fields, the large restaurant with a nice terrace and several shops, including a supermarket and a bazaar.

properties.name: Camping Arizona
properties.description:
Camping Arizona is at the foot of the Northern Apennines, a ten-minute drive from the thermal baths of Salsomaggiore Terme (Emilia-Romagna). This large terraced campsite is surrounded by a hilly landscape that varies between woods and meadows. The campsite is only 15 minutes away from the A1, making it a good stopover campsite. However, staying for a longer period at Camping Arizona is also rewarding – not only due to the beauty of the surrounding area but also because of the beautiful swimming pool complex, the sports facilities and play areas and the restaurant at the campsite.

Shaded pitches

Most of the pitches at Camping Arizona are well shaded and grassy. You can also book a stay in a modern mobile home or a luxury villa. Your faithful four-footed friend is also welcome at the campsite.

Ideal holiday address for sports enthusiasts and water lovers

Camping Arizona has athletic fields and an impressive outdoor playground. You can indulge yourself in the beautiful swimming complex with its large basic swimming pool and a smaller pool that catches people coming down the two water slides. There is also a good-sized swimming pool for (young) children, also with water slides. After all of that fun swimming, collapse on the charming terrace of Ristorante Pizzeria Al Pirata for a delicious bite to eat and a drink.

What is there to do in the vicinity?

The vicinity has many historic towns and nostalgic castles. Busseto (28 km), which is where the legendary composer Verdi caused such a furore, is highly recommended. Parma (34.5 km) is also worth visiting. The hiking and cycling in the mountainous landscape of the Northern Apennines is also amazing.

properties.name: HolaCamp Palamós
properties.description:
Camping 3 Estrellas Costa Brava is an easily accessible campsite on a level terrain. The campsite is situated in the heart of the Costa Brava, not far from the town of Vall-llobrega. You camp here in the vicinity of some beautiful sandy beaches. The campsite is especially popular with families with young children. There is enough to do to keep this target group busy and the campsite also delivers in terms of facilities.

Camping on a level campsite with lots of shade

Camping 3 Estrellas Costa Brava has almost 200 touring pitches as well as 22 rental accommodation units. The camping pitches are neatly laid out and mostly demarcated with green hedges. The pitches vary in size, but are always sufficiently large. There are many trees and bushes on the terrain and as a result quite a number of pitches have shade. Don't have camping equipment? You can rent one of the mobile homes or tents. 

Swimming, dancing and sports

The square outdoor pool (200 m2) of the campsite is a lovely spot for cooling down. Here you also find a separate toddler pool.  Around the large pool are sun umbrellas and comfortable loungers and sunbeds. 

Children also thoroughly enjoy the entertainment programme (at least 2x week in peak season). Furthermore, there is a playground with colourful play equipment. Sports activities are also possible at Camping 3 Estrellas Costa Brava. Kick a ball around on the multi sports field or get out those metal rascals for a game of pétanque.

Dining and shopping

The campsite restaurant is of modest design and offers a few fixed menus. The restaurant with terrace is centrally located on the camping grounds. You will also find a (snack)bar here. At a distance of 1.5 km from the campsite is a largish supermarket, called Dia.

properties.name: Camping Détente et Clapotis
properties.description:
In the Rhône-Alpes, on the banks of the Lac de Paladru, you will find camping Détente et Clapotis. Everything on this campsite is dedicated to water. The outdoor pool is connected to an indoor pool. Here you can take a refreshing dip while the children play in the sand on the artificial beach. A real beach is just a few meters away, on the vast lake.

New campsite

The campsite was completely redesigned in 2016. At the front of the terrain are the touring pitches. There is not much cover on this part, so most of these pitches are in the sun. A little further back, on a sheltered spot, are mainly new, modern rental accommodations: glamping tents, eco chalets and family tents.

Swimming pool

Directly on the lake is a large swimming pool. This outdoor pool is connected to an indoor pool, so you can swim both outside and inside. Next to the pool a small beach has been created, where children can play in the sand. There is not much space for sun loungers around the pool, but right next to it is a sunbathing lawn.

Lac de Paladru

Your camping holiday at the Détente et Clapotis campsite is largely devoted to enjoying the waterfront. You will camp directly on the Lac de Paladru. Large open lawns are connected to the beach, from where you can walk straight into the clear water. Part of the lake is screened off for swimmers. You can also take a boat on the lake.

properties.name: Camping l'Escale
properties.description:
The village of Le Grand-Bornand lies in a fairytale setting in the French Alps, at an altitude of no less than 1,000 metres. Just south of this mountain village you will find Camping l'Escale. This campsite is located on spacious grounds at the foot of the famous Col de la Colombière, a renowned mountain pass in the Tour de France.

Views of high mountain peaks

At the beautiful campsite entrance, in the same building, are the restaurant, the swimming pool complex and the children's playroom. Behind the campsite you can see a hill with charming wooden mountain houses. The spacious site is divided into three fields with large pitches on a hard grass or gravel surface. The sanitary facilities are extremely clean and tidy.

Swimming indoors or outdoors?

Whatever the weather, great swimming is always possible at Camping l'Escale. The indoor pool is well heated and connects to the outdoor pool, which is located on a sunny terrace above the reception. The sun loungers around it invite you to enjoy a book, the view or just the peace and quiet.

Eating in a lovely atmosphere

Anyone entering the rustic restaurant 'La Ferme du Pépé' will feel instantly welcome. Campers can indulge in delicious specialties here. The village of Les Clusaz further down the road also offers good food. Or you could make your own summer meal at the campsite's barbecue and picnic area. Fresh bread rolls are available at the reception for breakfast. And don't forget to taste the local cheeses.

properties.name: Flower Camping Dieppe Vitamín
properties.description:
Flower Camping Dieppe Vitamín is a peaceful campsite centrally located in the heart of Upper Normandy, not far from the beautiful beach of Plage du Petit Ailly. The main road is just a stone's throw away, making it easily accessible. There's also an extensive shopping centre, including supermarkets, within walking distance. You can enjoy all sorts of tasty treats at the campsite bar or visit one of the seafood restaurants in the lively town of Dieppe during the evening.

Camping on the Alabaster Coast

The extraordinary Alabaster Coast is located to the north of the city of Le Havre. This part of Normandy is characterised by its towering, awe-inspiring cliffs and hilly landscape. The friendly owners are happy to provide guests information about the most beautiful sights at the reception.

A variety of nice pitches

There are several lanes with spacious, demarcated pitches near the playground and the sports fields. There are separate pitches for campers and tents, and there is plenty of shade everywhere. Two neat and tidy sanitary buildings are spread across the campsite. In addition to touring pitches, there's also a selection of turnkey accommodations, such as mobile homes, cabins and a cosy gypsy wagon for extra comfort.

Water everywhere

Flower Camping Dieppe Vitamín offers you plenty of options for splashing around in the water. Take your pick of one of the two pools or the sea! Plage de Dieppe is a beautiful beach famous for its chalk cliffs. You can also walk straight from your tent or caravan to the heated indoor pool or take a refreshing dip in the outdoor pool.

properties.name: Camping L'Ombrage
properties.description:
In the middle of the natural environment of the Ardèche lies the Camping L'Ombrage campsite. Located on a hilly terrain, it serves as a perfect starting point for exploring the surrounding area. You will be staying here near the town of Ruoms, and from the campsite, you can see the rock of Sampzon in the distance. In 2021, the pool was completely renovated to include a large sun terrace with comfortable loungers and a toddler pool. Both pools are heated.

XXL camping

This tranquillity originates in part from the very generous camping pitches. Each spot is at least 150 m2 in size! The natural delineation and very well-maintained camping grounds also create an attractive appearance. The low trees also provide sufficient shade and give you a real Provençal holiday feeling. In addition to an XXL camping spot, mobile homes are also available for rent.

Mini concert at the campsite

The Camping L'Ombrage campsite is geared towards lovers of nature. Therefore, the facilities are not on a large scale and are limited. So you can buy fresh bread at the campsite, but you will find the nearest supermarket four kilometres away. In high season, the campsite bar – with terrace – is open, and you can go there for drinks, ice cream, snacks and pizza. From time to time, communal dinners are arranged in the evenings, accompanied by a mini concert.

Playing in nature

Nature is also the biggest playground on the campsite. There is a small playground, but little can beat romping around in the grass and between the trees and bushes. To cool down afterwards, we have a swimming pool. This is located next to the terrace. Around the water, you will find a small sunbathing area.

properties.name: Camping Étang de la Bonde
properties.description:
Camping Étang de la Bonde is right by the eponymous lake in the French Sannes, in the region of Provence. It may be a quiet campsite but that does not mean there is nothing to do. Go for a swim, visit one of the lovely villages in the area or go out and explore on foot or by bike.

Camping with a view of the water

The campsite has 118 large camping pitches and 45 accommodation. You can choose the hire accommodation as luxurious as you'd like to make it. How about a bungalow with a private Jacuzzi? There are also mobile homes with lake views.

Fun in the water

You can have something tasty to eat in the campsite restaurant and the snack bar, with views of Lake La Bonde. Of course, you go for a refreshing swim in the blue water. Take water shoes for little feet because there are pebbles on the beach and in the water. There is also plenty to do at the campsite itself. Hit a ball on the tennis court or try your hand at a game of jeu de boules.

Plenty to do in the Provence

Camping Étang de la Bonde is in Vaucluse, a department in the region of Provence, known for the many different landscapes and villages. For example, visit villages such as Cucuron (7 km), Bonnieux (26 km), Roussillon (40 km) and Oppède-le-Vieux (42 km). The area also has some lovely, large cities, such as Aix-en-Provence (35 km), Marseille (65 km, go to the French coast while you're there) and Avignon (80 km).

properties.name: Camping & vakantiepark De Twee Bruggen
properties.description:
Camping Vakantiepark De Twee Bruggen is a large family campsite close to lively Winterswijk. Thanks to the many sports and games facilities and the extensive entertainment programmes during the school holidays, this is a top spot for families with children. The whole family can enjoy themselves with craft activities, face painting, outdoor theatre, sports competitions, boot camp and live music. In addition, this campsite has an indoor and outdoor swimming pool with a total of four water slides.

Attractive camping fields

At this campsite you can choose from touring pitches of three comfort levels. In addition, various types of rental accommodation are available. All the chalets, glamping tents and camping pitches are in perfect harmony with each other. There are various fields, with some play equipment on most of them.

Enjoy the swimming paradise

Holiday park De Twee Bruggen has a modern water park with an indoor and outdoor swimming pool. Indoors it's wonderful to swim laps, while in good weather you can choose the heated outdoor pool. In total there are no less than four water slides. Swimming is also possible in the Slingeplas, a lake with a beautiful beach just a few hundred metres from the campsite.

From a quick bite to extensive dining

At this campsite you can eat excellent food in restaurant De Schoppe. This restaurant has a cosy terrace and a playground, ideal for young families with children. There is also a food corner, where drinks, sandwiches, snacks, fries and pizzas are available. The campsite also has an adequate supermarket.

properties.name: Camping Delle Rose
properties.description:
In the hinterland of the Italian Riviera of Flowers, in the Liguria region, Delle Rose Campsite is situated near the village of Isolabona. This is a wooded and mountainous environment, from where you can see the foothills of the Alpi Marittime, the so-called Sea-Alps. The surrounding of the campsite provides opportunities for walking and mountain biking. And the sea is some 13 km away, hence beach fun is also within easy reach.

Nature all around

Delle Rose is a small-scale terraced campsite which may look confusing at first, but you will soon find your way around. Due to the different elevation levels and the rather compact pitches, Delle Rose is mainly a campsite for tents. Cars are not allowed on the pitches and have to be left in the parking area. Mobile homes and apartment are also available for rent.

The campsite has a nice swimming pool in a sunny location (with a separate toddler pool) and a bar for a drink or an ice cream. There is also a restaurant with a wood-fired pizza oven.

In July and August there is an entertainment programme for young and old. In addition, the surrounding region of the campsite offers opportunities for walking and mountain biking.

Sanitary facilities

The sanitary facilities, spread over several buildings, are modern and clean and offer unrestricted hot water.

In the region

Dolceacqua, at a distance of 5 km from the campsite, is an attractive medieval village along the Nervia river with an interesting 15th century bridge and a castle from the 13th/14th century. Fashionable San Remo (28 km from the campsite) and situated on the coast, is definitely worth a visit.

properties.name: Camp. Village Resort & Spa Le Vieux Port
properties.description:
Village Resort & Spa Le Vieux Port campsite is a spacious campsite close to the village of Messanges in the French department of Landes. The campsite offers a wide selection of accommodation. There's also an entertainment programme for campers of all ages. The campsite is located at the heart of a pine forest immediately adjacent to the Atlantic coast and just an hour and half's drive from Spain. It enjoys a green environment a little south of the coastal resort itself.

Its layout has been designed to be as spacious as possible, something that you will notice as soon as you enter the site. Drive past the large parking area and new Arena du Vieux Port (a theatre, music venue, disco and eatery) and you will find the campsite's terraces and shops.

Space for everyone

The campsite offers a range of accommodation, from luxury tents for two and covered wagons to wooden cabins and tropical mobile homes. Choose the accommodation that suits you best. If you'd prefer the simplicity of a tent, you'll find plenty of space between the high pines.

XXL water park!

The campsite has a spacious, heated water park. This includes 14 slides, a wave pool, a fun aqua splash zone especially for children. There is even a surf machine that campers young and old can use! And if that is not enough, the campsite is right next to the beach, so you can take a dip in the Atlantic Ocean, take to the waves on a surfboard or just build sandcastles on the beach.

properties.name: Camping La Sfinge
properties.description:
In La Spezia, in a valley on the Ligurian coast, you will find camping La Sfinge. This simple terraced campsite is an ideal operating base from which to visit Cinque Terre and Portofino. The free shuttle bus takes you in less than ten minutes to Deiva Marina, where you'll find not only the train station, but also the beach.

Popular with tent campers

La Sfinge is a friendly campsite with limited space. On less than two hectares you'll find over a hundred touring pitches, twenty permanent pitches and almost forty rental accommodations. Therefore the pitches are tight, but they do differ in size and are hardly delimited. The terrain is sloping, with many terraces and stairs.

On the lower part of the campsite there are pitches for caravans and camper vans. The tent pitches are higher, on shady terraces. From the higher part of the campsite you have a beautiful view over the valley.

For a short stay

Although it is often busy at the campsite, especially in high season, it is always quiet. Most campers only come here for a short stay. On the campsite itself there is not much to do. There is no swimming pool or entertainment. For groceries, you can go across the street, where you will find a supermarket and a cosy restaurant.

Clean sanitary facilities

The sanitary facilities on the campsite are excellent: a bit dated, but spotless, with nice showers. Do you want to relax for a day? The shuttle bus will take you to Deiva Marina beach in ten minutes.

properties.name: Erholungsanlage Hertha-See
properties.description:
Camping Erholungsanlage Hertha-See is in Germany’s state North Rhine-Westphalia. You stay in green surroundings about 4 kilometres from the village of Hörstel. A small lake, the Herthasee, lies in the centre of the campsite. On sunny days, this is a wonderful place for swimming and for relaxing in the sun. There are also many sports and games facilities, and the entertainment team organises all kinds of activities.

Camping by the lake

Camping Erholungsanlage Hertha-See consists of several camping fields. Campsite visitors are free to camp around the lake where the pitches are not demarcated. The many trees here provide campsite visitors who are right next to the water with lots of shade. The pitches on the other fields of the campsite are demarcated. The restaurant with terrace is located beside the lake, giving you a beautiful view of the lake and the surrounding pitches.
