Sports, games and swimming fun

Sports enthusiasts can enjoy themselves on the tennis court, the basketball court, the table-tennis table or the playing field. There is a mini golf course, playground and an indoor playground. During the summer holiday, the entertainment team organises all kinds of activities for children six days a week. The water in the recreational lake is about 1.3 metres deep, making it ideal for true water lovers of all ages. Go for a refreshing swim, go out in a rubber boat or rent a stand-up paddleboard at the reception.

Explore Osnabrück and Tecklenburg

The city of Osnabrück (38.5 km) is great for a day out. Visit the charming historic centre, enjoy a cake at a local bakery and examine the extensive range of shops. The attractive village of Tecklenburg (24 km) with half-timbered buildings is definitely worth a visit.

properties.name: Camping Canoë Gorges du Tarn
properties.description:
The Canoe Gorges du Tarn Campsite is In the southern French department of Aveyron. This verdant family campsite is located on an elongated site right on the Tarn River. Trees, hedges and shrubs give the campsite its green look. At the front of the campsite are the shop, bar and restaurant. The terrace overlooks the pool. There is more water fun to be had in and around the river.

Green camping

The Canoe Gorges du Tarn Campsite generally has free, spacious pitches. The narrower spots are only found directly on the river. Hedges separate the camping spots, and most are shaded by trees. This also gives the campsite its lush, green surroundings. In addition to free pitches, there are some modern and well-equipped caravans for rent.

An active holiday

There is plenty to do in and around the campsite. Children can enjoy the playing field with bouncy castle and trampoline. There are also several sports fields. Entertainment is offered in high season. To recover from the activities, settle into the terrace. The terrace is adjacent to the restaurant, which serves all kinds of pizzas.

Two times the water fun

The campsite pool is located directly in the sun next to the reception and terrace. There is also a toddler pool available here. Around both pools, you can enjoy the sun while relaxing on a lounger. The pool is not too big, but there is a long slide. For even more water fun, head to the river. There are two pebble beaches, and children can splash and play in the shallow water.

properties.name: Camping Durance Luberon
properties.description:
Camping Durance Luberon is located not far from various nature parks, the Durance River and the town of Mallemort. This is a lovely and peaceful campsite with plenty of room and privacy and a beautiful large swimming pool with a Mediterranean ambiance.

Shaded and well-maintained

The flat, rectangular terrain has countless broad-leaved trees and tall shrubs which provide plenty of shade. Everything looks well-tended. The pitches are located along gravelled paths, are very spacious and offer ample privacy. You can choose a pitch in the sun or (partly) shaded. Want to hire something? You can choose from three types of mobile homes. 

Mediterranean

On the outskirts of the campsite lies a large swimming pool and a round paddling pool (still quite deep) with a Mediterranean atmosphere. There is ample room surrounding the pools and loungers are available. Trees line one side of the swimming pool complex. Campsite guests can also find a spot in the shade under the awning. Catch up on some reading or dream the day away.

Multi-functional sports field

Children can play to their heart's content on the multi-functional sports field. Campsite guests can play tennis for free or work up a sweat on the outdoor fitness equipment. Kayaking and canoeing on the nearby Durance river is also possible.

Bread service

There are no eating establishments or shops at the campsite. There is, however, a bread service. In the nearby village just three kilometres away, is a large supermarket.

Sanitary facilities

The modern sanitary facilities are centrally located and are kept clean and tidy. Part of the sanitary facilities is closed in the low season. A key is required to make use of the children's washrooms.

properties.name: Prades Park & Spa
properties.description:
Camping Prades Park is in the heart of the Prades Mountains. Driving towards the camp site, you will immediately notice the rugged scenery. Sports enthusiasts can enjoy a mountain ride with quite a climb, a ride on horseback or a nice game of soccer. After a sporting session you can make use of the new refreshing rain showers. Of course, an afternoon of relaxation at the camping pool is always a good idea!

A place to suit everyone

The camping pitches are approx. 70m2 in size and mostly separated from each other by trees. Are you camping with a tent? In that case there is a separate field to pitch your tent, amidst other tent campers. The camp site also offers a wide range of rental accommodation, from wooden chalets to mobile homes. Going on holiday with a large family or a group of friends? We have holiday homes that sleep as many as 30 persons.

Festive and sportive camping

Soccer, basket ball, horse riding or aqua fitness? Prades Park offers you a wide variety of sports activities. During the peak season you can participate several times a week in the entertainment programmes. Join the pirate theatre, dress up for a horror party or dance along at one of the disco evenings. Party time guaranteed!

Sustainable sanitary facilities

When you walk towards the sanitary block, you cannot fail to notice the large number of solar panels on the roof of the building. These are used to heat the water in the building. And that is not all - when you enter the sanitary block, you will see that the sanitary equipment looks new. You will also enjoy taking a rain shower.

properties.name: Camping La Focetta Sicula
properties.description:
This Italian campsite is located 15 kilometres from the beautiful town of Taormina and its famous Greco-Roman open air theatre. A bit south-west of that is the Mount Etna volcano. This makes Camping La Focetta Sicula an ideal base for visiting these two highlights of the island of Sicily. The shady grounds of this small-scale campsite run directly along the banks of a wide sand and pebble beach. When not visiting the many sights Sicily has to offer, you can relax and unwind while sunbathing and swimming in the Ionian Sea.

Shaded touring pitches and comfortable accommodations

You'll be welcomed by the owner's daughter at the reception. This tree-lined campsite offers mainly tourist camping pitches. Some of these pitches are demarcated. In general, the pitches are quite spacious, although the exact size also depends on how busy the campsite is. Some of the touring pitches are situated almost directly on the beach. In addition, the campsite rents out a number of comfortable mobile homes.

Direct access to the Ionian Sea beach

Camping La Focetta Sicula is located directly on a sand and pebble beach. The campsite has its own access path to this beach, from which you can take a wonderful, refreshing dip in the Ionian Sea. You can also enjoy excellent diving, snorkelling, sailing, water skiing and windsurfing here. You can rent the necessary equipment not far from the campsite. During high season, the campsite hosts regular disco and karaoke nights in the atmospheric Lounge Bar.

properties.name: Camping Le Val d'Amour
properties.description:
Le Val d'Amour campsite is located in the village of Ounans in the Jura. The pitches are situated in an old orchard, where the lawns surrounded by tall trees offer you a lot of shelter. During the day the large swimming pool with water slides guarantees water fun and cooling, while the whole family can enjoy shows in the evening.

Welcome!

In Ounans, the campsite is already signposted. Drive through the village and follow the camping sign to the right, into an avenue with tall trees. At the end of the avenue you will find a wooden chalet, which is the campsite reception building. Almost a hundred touring pitches are situated in the shade of the tall trees of the old orchard. You can also choose a mobile home, chalet, lodge tent or cosy oval house.

At Le Val d'Amour campsite you'll mainly see French, but also Dutch families. The campsite has a large swimming pool with a few large slides. There is also a paddling pool where the little ones can play under a fountain.

Snacks and drinks

Peckish? Then the big tent is the place to be. Here you can get snacks and the occasional regional dish. A cool drink after a game of football or basketball is also possible. The restaurant overlooks the sports fields of the campsite. This tent is also the location for the pleasant theme evenings.

Tips for excursions

Near the campsite you will find beautiful cities like Dijon and Beaune. The medieval town of Dole with its picturesque winding streets is the closest and must be seen.

properties.name: Camping Les Saumonards
properties.description:
Hidden in the woods on the French coast is Les Saumonards campsite. This natural campsite is located directly on the beach of Île d'Oléron in the Charente-Maritime. As you dive toward the Atlantic Ocean, you look out on Fort Boyard. This world famous fort can be admired from the beach. Would you like to have a closer look? Take the ferry to Île d'Aix, a small island with beautiful beaches. It’s something you won’t want to miss.

This year, why not enjoy a holiday with the sun and the beach! Where else but in the Charente-Maritime? The Les Saumonards campsite is situated in a special place in this southern French department: Île d'Oléron.

Right in the middle of the forest

The campsites are in the middle of nature. Without demarcation but with a sandy soil. You are sure to fee quite free on this rugged campsite. In the woods, you will find peace. Enjoy a long, relaxing walk along the coastline. There are some nice stretches of beach for variation. Only a 20 minute walk south and you’re in Boyard-Ville. In this cosy harbour town, you can treat yourself to some nice fresh fish.

Eat at the campsite or in Boyard-Ville

Are you visiting Camping Les Saumonards during the summer months? You won’t have to think long about what to eat. A large food truck offers quick but tasty meals. You can also have breakfast at the campsite. If you want to cook for yourself, you can cycle or walk to Boyard-Ville. There’s a well-stocked supermarket there. You also have several nice restaurants to choose from.

properties.name: Vakantiepark de Italiaanse Meren
properties.description:
Vakantiepark de Italiaanse Meren is located in a lovely quiet spot in the Achterhoek, a 10-minute drive from Winterswijk, right on the German border. This campsite is ideal for families with children up to the age of 12. There’s plenty for them to do in high season in particular. Playgrounds, sports facilities, a varied entertainment programme, a great aqua park, a real gnome forest and cosy catering establishments provide plenty of entertainment. Good to know: this holiday park is named after the ponds located at the wooded edge of the site.

Large touring pitches and glamping accommodation

Although there are a relatively large number of seasonal pitches and permanent annual pitches at this campsite, there’s also plenty of space for tourist campers. The pitches are at least 150 m2. Many also have a private bathroom unit with its own shower, washbasin and toilet. The glamping accommodation - like the luxury tiny houses and safari tents - offers even more comfort. This accommodation is located next to the ponds at the edge of the campsite.

Sports, games and swimming fun

Families with children won't have time to get bored at Vakantiepark de Italiaanse Meren. The water park alone guarantees hours of fun. The swimming pool consists of three parts: a toddlers' pool with a slide, a water play park and a large basic pool with a family slide. You can also play in the large central playground. Take your children to look for hidden gnomes in the gnome forest and, in high season, join in the original games and activities that the entertainment team organises. End the day with a tasty meal in the café-restaurant.

properties.name: Camping Le Renom
properties.description:
Camping Le Renom is a beautiful municipal campsite in the Ain region. This eastern part of France is known for its many lakes and historic towns. Mâcon, for example, is only a twenty minute drive away and the watery town of Vonnas is just around the corner from the campsite.

Camping by the river

The reception building is beautifully decorated with flowers and via a paved path you reach the camping site. Along the way you will also find the permanent pitches. All pitches have a grass surface and are neatly separated from each other by green hedges. In general the pitches are spacious. Some pitches have river view. The mobile homes are laid out next to each other. There is a special gypse caravan which stands out right away.

Catering facilities

The snack bar is open from 4 pm to 9 pm, serving ice creams, drinks and meals. At a little distance; in the village there are several supermarkets for daily groceries.

Summer concert

Every Saturday evening, in high season, there are concerts at the campsite’s pavement café. But you don’t have to get bored during the rest of the week. There is a tennis court next to the campsite and there is an opportunity for fishing nearby. Children can have fun in the small playground. Regularly there are petanque tournaments.

properties.name: Camping Costa Ponente
properties.description:
Camping Costa Ponente is on the north coast of Sicily. It overlooks the bay of Mazzaforno and the main sounds are the sea and wind. It’s a great spot for campers who love nature, peace and space. Lively Cefalù is only three km away as well. What could be more perfect? Relax by the sea during the day and stroll through an atmospheric Sicilian town full of culture, restaurants and small streets in the evening. Whether you want to relax or go out, this is the place to be.

Camp with space and comfort

The pitches at Camping Costa Ponente are large, private and benefit from natural shade. Perfect for tents, caravans and motor homes. Want slightly more comfort? Then the glamping accommodation is for you. Choose between luxury safari tents and modern mobile homes. They are surrounded by green space and equipped with everything you will need. Air conditioning, a great kitchen and comfortable beds are included as standard. So, you can enjoy outdoor life, but with less of the discomfort. This is a great option for families in particular.

Swimming pool with a view of the sea

The swimming pool is undoubtedly one of the most beautiful parts of the campsite. It is panoramic and overlooks the sea. Make yourself comfortable in the sunbathing area, take a refreshing dip and then zone out for a while. Get a drink or a snack at the pool bar. Children can have fun in the recreation areas, where they’ll quickly make new holiday friends. Want to go out? There’s a good connection from the campsite to Cefalù.

properties.name: Camping Le Diben
properties.description:
The Camping Le Diben campsite is located in a green area approximately one kilometre from Larmor-Baden and from the sea. You are here in Brittany, by the Gulf of Morbihan. This region is renowned for its many islets, beaches and seaside resorts. The campsite offers modest entertainment. Throw a ball on the bocce court, challenge each other to a game of table tennis and don't forget to treat yourself to something tasty from the food truck in between! There is also a recreation room.

Welcome!

Camping Le Diben is located on manicured grounds in a beautiful bay. The campsite offers a hundred spots for tents and caravans. These are spacious and have plenty of shade and privacy, thanks to the hedges and trees. Eight spots are available for RVers. The vast majority of the nineteen accommodations are mobile homes. There are also two caravans and two lodge tents without sanitary facilities.

Water fun at the campsite and beyond

This campsite features an excellent outdoor pool (heated). The pool is located in the sun. Next to it, you will find a sunbathing area. The beach is a ten-minute walk away. The rocky coast here consists of a beach with sand and pebbles. Because you are here at a bay, a place where salt and freshwater meet, the water here is significantly warmer than in the sea beyond.

Facilities

There is a small shop where you can buy fresh bread and some groceries in July and August. You can also get ice cream here! In the high season, a food truck comes almost every night. All kinds of tasty meals are served here. With three restrooms, no one will have to wait long for their turn.

properties.name: Camping Wies-Neu
properties.description:
Wies-Neu in Dillingen is a well-maintained large family campsite located along the banks of the river Sûre. Germany is on the other side. The campsite is long, so you have plenty of opportunities to camp along the water. Around the campsite there are numerous walking and cycling paths.

Camping by the river

On the quiet and well maintained property of nearly 5 hectares, you'll find the section with the seasonal campers separated from that of the touring pitches. The touring pitches are located on "the first part" on the water side. The "second section" is park like, with high trees. Demarcated by paint lines on the road.

Fun for children

In principle you can have fun safely on the river. Children can jump into the water from the bridge or bank and float with their boat or inflatable mattress all the way to the end of the campsite. Do note the water levels, they determine whether the river becomes more wild. Asking at the reception is handy...

There is also fun in the form of a children's farm with rabbits, goats and horses. Great for kids to learn more about these animals!

Jump on your bike

The camping shop only has the necessities, such as daily fresh bread. To do your shopping or sit on a terrace, take your bike (or car) to Dillingen, Bollendorf, Echternach or Diekirch. There is only a snack bar on the campsite. The pizzeria in Dillingen is good, and only a few minutes away on foot.

properties.name: Camping Barco Reale
properties.description:
Campsite Barco Reale is a stone's throw away from the village of San Baronto, in Northern Tuscany. Pistoia, acclaimed cultural capital of Italy in 2017, is also in the vicinity of this campsite. Pine trees and oaks provide a lot of shade. As a result the pitches have ample privacy. The region is verdant and hilly and the nearby villages are all full of charm. There is plenty to do on the campsite. Highlights are the swimming pool (with a view of the extensive valley) and the restaurant.

Camping and renting

The campsite is located on a hilly piece of land, but everything is well organised and practically laid out. You can bring you own camping equipment or rent one of the forty campsite's accommodation units. For instance, you can opt for a fully equipped mobile home, bungalow tent or luxury glamping tent. 

Entertainment for the whole family

At campsite Barco Reale an enthusiastic entertainment team offers a varied programme in high season. The evening performances are recommended for the entire family, as are the other musical and cultural activities. Sports can be played on various fields and small children are certain to enjoy the playground. 

There are also ample excursions on offer in the beautiful region. For instance, guided walking tours to a local olive mill or bus tours to Florence. You can also go on lovely walks and cycling trips directly from the campsite.

Dreamlike swimming pools

The three swimming pools are found on the perimeter of the campsite. There is a large shallow pool for children as well as a small pool of approx. one metre deep. The focal point is the enormous (270 m2) pool with a splendid view of the valley with its peaceful Tuscan rural life.

properties.name: Camping Le Rotja
properties.description:
No tourist crowds, but peace reigns supreme at Camping Le Rotja. The campsite is located in the river valley of the same name, from where you have a view of the Pyrenees and the impressive mountain, le pic du Canigou. The surrounding area, National Nature Reserve Pyrénées-Catalanes, is excellent for splendid walks and adventurous outdoor sports.

Camping in a green valley

The campsite is situated in the Rotja valley and is surrounded by a beautiful mountain landscape. The campsite is partly wooded and partly open. It is spotlessly maintained and offers both sunny and shady pitches. The pitches are not excessively large and are fairly well demarcated with trees. The surface is very firm. Want to rent something? You can choose between a mobile home and a luxury safari tent.

Small, but beautiful swimming pool

There is a small heated swimming pool to cool off, as well as a lovely, round toddler pool. The pools are surrounded by decorative tiles. The swimming pools are located in full sun. Don't forget the suntan lotion. The view of the surrounding mountain landscape is breath taking.

Guided walking tour

Children can enjoy themselves in a playground and at the table tennis tables. In peak season entertainment is organised for all age groups, including guided walking tours and barbecue evenings. There are many walking routes in the area. You can rent a bicycle from the reception.

Tasty daily menu

The campsite restaurant has a limited choice but offers tasty daily menus. There is also a nice little bar, a cold beer after a walk is therefore never far away. There is also a bread service. You can find a supermarket in Prades. Each Saturday morning there is a local market with regional products.

properties.name: Camping Kerleven
properties.description:
Between Concarneau and Bénodet, in the heart of the Riviera of Brittany, lies campsite Kerleven. This quiet family campsite is just two hundred metres away from the beach and the Atlantic Ocean. The permanent pitches outnumber the touring pitches, but this is nonetheless a fine campsite for touring campers. The camping grounds are spacious and green with hedges and deciduous trees separating the pitches.

Camping pitches in greenery

Campsite Kerleven has slightly more permanent pitches than touring pitches. All the necessary facilities for touring campers are available, however. The touring pitches are situated on separate fields. You can choose whether you would like a spot close to the swimming pool and the playground or whether you would prefer a pitch on a field slightly further away from the hustle and bustle. The pitches are situated on grassy fields separated by hedges, deciduous trees and shrubs.

Camping by the poolside

Some of the touring pitches are located right at the water park on the outskirts of the campsite. Campsite Kerleven has a heated indoor swimming pool with a sliding roof and a heated outdoor pool with a separate heated paddling pool. The indoor swimming pool features an integrated whirlpool, fun water play equipment and water jets. There is also a spacious paddling pool with a small slide. Next to the outdoor pool are two large water slides with a separate landing pool. 

Sea with shallow waters

Everything here is within walking distance. Two hundred metres from the reception lies a beautiful beach with fine white sand. You can hear the sea from the campsite. The ocean here is clean and tranquil. The water is shallow and slopes very gently; ideal for small children. At low tide, however, the sea is quite a distance away.

properties.name: Camping Le Tournefeuille
properties.description:
Camping Le Tournefeuille is beautifully situated on the banks of the Sauldre river, on the outskirts of the town of Romorantin-Lanthenay. This is the capital of Sologne, a thickly wooded region in the Loir-et-Cher department. From the campsite you can go on lovely walks and cycling trips. The Loire river, well known for its many castles, flows in the vicinity of the campsite.

Sunny or in the shade

The camping pitches are distributed over a large, green field. They have a flat surface and are demarcated with a few low bushes. Some of the pitches are located near the river and offer a bit more shade. The remainder is located in direct sunlight. Both in peak and low season, the campsite attracts visitors from near and far who like walking and cycling.

Excellent sanitary facilities

The sanitary facilities are fairly new, very well maintained and are kept very clean. There are special facilities for disabled persons. There are six attractive rental chalets on a separate section of the campsite. 

Covered swimming pool

You can splash round in the river, but to swim a few lengths you have to use the covered swimming pool of the campsite. There is a small, but colourful playground for children. You can also rent bicycles on the campsite. You can play a game of tennis on the tennis court of the adjacent sports complex via the campsite.

Welcoming restaurant

The small, friendly restaurant of the campsite is a good choice for a simple meal. There is no shop, but in July and August you can get fresh bread each day. All other shopping can be done in town.

properties.name: Camping Port Mulon
properties.description:
On the Erdre river, in the French department of Loire-Atlantique, lies Camping Port Mulon. You can enjoy a peaceful camping holiday on the shady campsite with its excellent sanitary facilities. Explore the surroundings by bike or kayak and take a dip in the pool.

The campsite is located just south of Nort-sur-Erdre, in a quiet rural area. You will be camping on a circular site with 78 spacious pitches, close to the banks of the Erdre. Tall trees provide plenty of shade. A special feature are the eco lodges that can be rented and bivouac huts: small tents on poles.

A family campsite with a pool

At the centre of the circle, easily accessible from each touring pitch, is the large sanitary building. With a baby room and sanitary facilities for the disabled, every camper will be able to enjoy it. The facilities are kept well clean and look spick and span. Great for families with children, Camping Port Mulon has a playground and a heated pool.

Action and culture

Bicycles and kayaks can be rented at the campsite. An extensive network of bike paths is waiting for you. Be sure to visit the quaint little port of Nort-sur-Erdre. You can walk to it in twenty minutes. A half-hour drive away is Nantes. The Machines of the Isle of Nantes project is a particularly special sight. On a site of old shipyards, artists have brought enormous steel structures to life. So don't be too surprised when you see a mechanical elephant or large spider making its way through the town.

properties.name: Flower Camping Loire et Châteaux
properties.description:
The name of Camping Loire et Châteaux says it all: the campsite lies in the heart of the Val de Loire, the region which is well known for its many castles. The campsite is in a beautiful rural location and radiates in all respects the freedom which makes camping so special. Here you will find numerous amenities for cyclists.

Amenities for cyclists

The spacious camping pitches are beautifully laid out and nice and sunny. The relatively young vegetation does not provide much shade. Campsite Loire et Châteaux is popular with cyclists. There is a dedicated covered area for them where they can prepared their meals and eat. In addition to mobile homes and bungalow tents, the campsite also rents out so-called Campétoiles, tents on stilts providing an ideal accommodation for hikers and cyclists.

Heated outdoor pool

A refreshing swim after a tiring day of cycling, walking or visiting castles? You can do so in the heated outdoor pool next to the restaurant. The swimming pool offers special provisions for guests with physical limitations. The littlest ones can splash around in the paddling pool.

One cannot imagine a French campsite without a petanque court. Hence, you can hit a few balls on this campsite, too. During the months of July and August there are even organised competitions. During this period there are also great theme evenings.

Restaurant and shop

If you don't feel like cooking one day, you can go to the restaurant. They offer a daily menu as well as some basic dishes. You can enjoy a drink on the terrace adjacent to the swimming pool. Basic and regional products are available in the shop.

properties.name: Camping Vert Auxois
properties.description:
Camping Vert Auxois is a quiet, small-scale campsite on the banks of the Canal de Bourgogne. The campsite is an excellent base for cycling tours along the canal or to discover the beautiful nature of Burgundy. You can camp on pitches overlooking the fields or in small, comfortable lodge tents.

At the Vert Auxois campsite, you'll be camping in a peaceful, green setting. On the edge of the elongated site, tall trees provide shade on some pitches. The more than sixty pitches are situated on grass fields separated by hedges.

Comfortable lodge tents

In principle, the pitches are spacious, but in busy times the owners sometimes want to create more pitches than usual. Because of this, your pitch can be a bit smaller than expected. The most beautiful pitches can be found at the southern edge of the site. This is also where the lodge tents are situated: small but comfortable tents with an unobstructed view over the vast fields. In addition to the lodge tents, there are a few mobile homes for rent.

Heated swimming pool

Behind the reception building is the new swimming pool, nicely heated and in the sun. The pool is quite straightforward and has a good size for the capacity of the campsite. In a separate area small children can paddle

Restaurant Le P'tit Troquet

Le P'tit Troquet is the campsite's restaurant, located in front of the campsite next to the reception building. Here you can have a bite to eat from a small menu, or have a drink on the cosy terrace. For the groceries you don't have to go far: about five minutes drive away is a large supermarket.

properties.name: Lima Escape Camping & Glamping
properties.description:
In the north of Portugal, on the inner edge of National Park Peneda-Gerês, lies Lima Escape Camping & Glamping. Here you stay beneath high fir trees with the Lima river at your feet and magnificent nature surrounding you. Ideal for seekers of peace and for hikers. On the campsite you will mostly find very satisfied campers, irrespective of whether they are staying in a tent, caravan, mobile home or in one of the exciting tree huts or luxury glamping tents.

Tree hut and glamping tent

The sloping grounds offer spacious pitches with a lot of shade or with some shade. Glamping tents, mobile homes, apartments and bungalows as well as a few exciting tree huts can be booked. There is no TV or WiFi in the glamping tents and tree huts. How peaceful is this?

The Lima River

You can swim in the Lima river. The grounds also border a lake/recreational water. In adddition to the river, the campsite also has a beautiful swimming pool in the summer months, made from a recycled container. The pool has a less deep children's section and nice views over nature. Surrounded by the natural shade of the trees and comfortable loungers, you can cool off and unwind here.

Jeep safari

Lima Escape Camping & Glamping offers a wide variety of activities and entertainment: from walking, cycling, quad and jeep safari to different water activities including electric boat trips, kayak and water-bicycle renting. Also make sure to visit one of the natural lakes nearby, waterfalls and make unexpected discoveries in National Park Peneda-Gerês. The campsite provides several walking and cycling routes for the sporty fellows. There is a (free) WiFi spot still wifi is provided only at the reception an bar area.

Comprehensive menu

Lima Escape Bar locating on the camping entrance offers great variety of snacks, sandwiches, light dishes, salads and vegetarian options. It is a lovely, lively place with a large shaded terrace in summer and wood fire-place in winter, great choice of local and international drinks. The campsite also offers fresh bread (with pre-advise order) and has a small shop.

Sanitary facilities

The sanitary facilities have recently been renovated and are kept in a tidy and clean condition.

properties.name: Camping Park Weiherhof
properties.description:
This relaxed campsite is located directly by a fine recreational lake and in a wooded area. You will find this beautifully landscaped and well-maintained campsite near the village of Seck in the Westerwald region, a quiet and relatively undiscovered low mountain range in the German state of Rhineland-Palatinate. Especially for hikers, but also for cyclists and mountain bikers, the Westerwald region is a true paradise. Camping Park Weiherhof offers wonderfully spacious sites on beautiful, rolling terrain. Some sites have a view of the lake.

Will you choose a wooded spot, or camp by the lake?

Upon arrival, you will be warmly welcomed by Mr Stelzen. Together with him, you can set off to look for the ideal camping spot. Quiet spots in the forest can be found mainly at the Birkengrund camping area. Would you rather be close to the lake? Then, of course, choose a nice spot in the car-free section of Seewiese. Extra-large sites for groups are also available, as are various types of rental accommodations.

Carefree swimming in the recreational lake

A big plus of this campsite is its location directly on the Großer Weiher lake, also called Secker Weiher. The water quality of this lake is monitored regularly. Here you can swim without a care in the world! In addition to this lake, the water playground is a real hit with children. Do you prefer to swim in a pool? Then it's only a ten-minute drive to the Freibad Westerburg. This uncovered water park, with its leisure pools and slides, guarantees a wonderfully relaxing day out for the whole family.

properties.name: Camping Homair La Croix du Vieux Pont
Camping Champ Tillet
properties.description:
Camping in a green valley with two beautiful lakes nearby. You can at the Champ Tillet Campsite in Marlens, a village in the green, hilly east of France. The plus points of the campsite are the two swimming pools, the restaurant and the animation programme. Lake Annecy is just a ten-minute drive away.

Camping in nature

At this flat campsite, you can camp beautifully among the trees. The more than 100 touring pitches are large (80-110m2) and are on a grassy surface. And those who book a spot at Champ Tillet Campsite will be camping with a view of the mountains. After all, here you are on the edge of the Parc Naturel Régional du Massif du Bauges.

Those who come without camping equipment have the choice of dozens of caravans and some bungalows. There are also lodge tents and hiker's huts for rent. The hut on stilts is quite special. You have power there, but no water. So, it's a little extra adventure.

Animation and sporting entertainment

In high season, there is entertainment for the whole family at least twice a week. Children can also play by themselves in the playgrounds, which include a trampoline and a bouncy castle. The campsite is an ideal starting point for mountain hikes. There is also a neat bike path from the campsite to Albertville.

Fun in the water

With two pools, you have nothing to complain about here as a water lover. One of the two pools is covered, ideal if it rains. Young children enjoy a toddler pool, and older children you'll see hurtling down the slide again and again. There is also wellness available. Book an hour in the sauna, relax in the whirlpool or take a massage.

properties.name: Camping des Lacs
properties.description:
This simply furnished and quiet campsite is situated in a green valley in the High Vosges region. A cheerfully babbling shallow stream runs past the campsite. A reservoir (with a large beach) where you can go swimming is just a ten-minute walk away. In this region, home of the so-called Pierre-Percée lakes, you will find two interesting destinations not far from the campsite: Aventure Parc Pierre and the Pole Sport Nature water sports centre. You can bring your own yacht or sailing boat with you to the campsite; a slipway is available.

Nature, water and peace

The reception building doubles as a campsite shop, with a small bar, snack bar and TV room. You will feel right at home here in these green surroundings; the campsite is an oasis of tranquillity. The grounds have neat pitches, some of which are separated with hedges, offering privacy. The campsite is situated lengthwise along a shallow stream. All 122 pitches (situated on well-maintained grass) are spacious and have views of the hills. The many trees provide refreshing shade on hot and sunny days. The rented chalets, cabins and lodge tents are scattered over the campsite grounds.

Swimming pool or reservoir?

The simple yet fine swimming pool measuring 220 m2 is centrally located on the campsite grounds. There is a separate paddling pool and a sunbathing lawn for catching a tan. If you walk about ten minutes down a level path, you will reach the reservoir. Here, you will find a surprisingly large beach with coarse sand. There is also entertainment on the campsite, with a bouncy castle, a trampoline and the mini club.

Sanitary facilities

The sanitary facilities are clean and have recently been renovated.

properties.name: Camping Notre-Dame
properties.description:
Tucked away in the mountains of Provence-Alpes-Côte d’Azur, Camping Notre-Dame is situated on the outskirts of the charming village of Castellane. Here, you will be surrounded by fragrant pine trees and close to the River Verdon. The atmosphere at this small campsite is friendly and welcoming. And with the village of Castellane just 600 metres away, you can easily walk to an outdoor café terrace or bakery for fresh croissants. Tranquillity, nature, and a friendly atmosphere come together effortlessly here.

Camping with a touch of comfort

Whether you are travelling with a tent, caravan or motorhome, you will always find a lovely spot at Camping Notre-Dame. The camping pitches are sheltered amongst the trees, keeping you nice and cool on hot summer days. Looking for something a bit more comfortable? Then the mobile homes are a great choice. They feature a fully equipped kitchen, a cosy sitting area and a spacious terrace.

Swimming in the Verdon River

At Camping Notre-Dame, it’s all about keeping it simple. For a refreshing dip, simply walk to the River Verdon, just 300 metres away. Prefer to swim a few laps? The municipal swimming pool is only 800 metres further on. And for those who prefer a peaceful stroll, you can follow the pathway along the river directly from the campsite.

Explore nature right from the campsite

The Castellane area is ideal for nature lovers and adventurers. Visit the impressive Gorges du Verdon, just three kilometres away, a paradise for hikers, climbers and water sports enthusiasts. The clear blue Lake Castillon (5 km) is perfect for swimming, canoeing or simply relaxing on the beach.

properties.name: Les Jardins de Kergal
properties.description:
On the Breton coast of France, you can enjoy a wonderful camping holiday at Camping Les Jardins de Kergal. This peaceful holiday spot in the vibrant Morbihan region lies between Guidel town centre and the beach. The campsite is located in a beautiful wooded and flowery landscape. There is something for everyone in the area: walking, cycling, swimming in the sea or going to the zoo. You can go in all directions here!

Camping in colours and scents

The grounds of this bustling family campsite are divided into two sections. There is a section with 57 touring pitches for your own tent, caravan or motorhome. And there is a section with 66 chalets and mobile homes. That the campsite caters specifically for families is reflected in the sanitary facilities. There are special children's sanitary facilities and family sanitary facilities. The pitches are spacious, level and bounded by shrubs, trees and flower beds.

Beach and pool

The campsite's location makes it ideal for beach-goers. A beautiful walk of about 1.5 km will take you to the sandy beach. If you prefer to take the car, that's no problem. There is ample parking at the beach. At the campsite itself there are two swimming pools, one of which is covered by a sliding roof. So for water fun you are not dependent on a sunny weather forecast, making this campsite wonderful even in the low season. Away from the swimming pool, there are two water slides and a paddling pool for the little ones to splash around in.

properties.name: Autocamp Peros
properties.description:
On the Adriatic coast, near the old town of Zadar, you will find Autocamp Peros. This small campsite has lovely pitches in a charming wooded area. Here you can enjoy your holiday in Croatia in peace and quiet. There are two swimming pools at the campsite for cooling off. And within ten minutes you can walk to the Adriatic. There you can lie on the beach or have a nice swim. Fancy a cultural trip? Then drive or cycle to the historic centre of Zadar.

Charming camping pitches

Autocamp Peros is a small campsite, especially by Croatian standards. Around sixty pitches are spread out over the campsite. They are spacious pitches, often in the shade of a tree. The foliage provides a pleasant and cool atmosphere. With a bit of luck, you can see the Adriatic Sea from your pitch.

Relaxed and carefree

If you are looking for peace and quiet, Autocamp Peros is an excellent holiday destination. The atmosphere is relaxed and carefree. Perhaps it is because of the beautiful weather and the bright sunshine. Or maybe it is the friendly staff. Whatever the reason, you will enjoy your holiday in peace and quiet.

Spotlessly clean swimming pools

Two swimming pools are waiting for you at Autocamp Peros. An exceptional luxury for such a small campsite. There is plenty of room for a refreshing dip. Just like all the other facilities, the pools are clean and tidy. So you can swim in them without a care in the world. You can also swim in the Adriatic Sea! Ten minutes' walk and you are already on the beach.

properties.name: Camping Le Bois Vert
properties.description:
The tranquil green campsite Le Bois Vert, situated in a hilly region, can be found on the outskirts of the medieval town of Parthenay. The beautiful, spacious pitches (max. 130 m2) on this -wellmaintained campsite are located along paved roads and are separated from each other by hedges. You have a choice of pitches with or without shade.

A limited number of rental mobile homes and tents are spread out over the camping grounds (2 ha). This campsite is mainly frequented by French and British families.

The Grosset family will extend you a warm welcome at the reception and will gladly give you information about the tourist sights in the area. From here, you can embark on some easy walking and cycling routes. Follow the ‘Voie verte’ or go for a beautiful walk in the Thouet Valley.

Swimming fun and disco evenings

The campsite has a heated swimming pool (100 m2) and toddler pool. There is a small selection of playground equipment for young children. There is also a pétanque pitch and a table tennis table on the campsite. Near the restaurant (limited menu), where you can also get takeaway meals, you will find a terrace with a view of the swimming pool. Themed dinners and disco evenings are organised on a regular basis. On the campsite, you can get a few basic foodstuffs and fresh bread.

In the region

There is a supermarket at one and a half kilometres' distance from Camping Le Bois Vert. Fishing is allowed in the nearby lake and in the river. On the other side of the river, you will find a generously proportioned playground. There is an aqua park in close proximity and you can also do some abseiling. There is also a tennis court, which camping guests are allowed to use.

properties.name: Camping Sanfilippo
properties.description:
On the northern coast of Sicily, in a small bay in the Tyrrhenian Sea, you will find the Camping Sanfilippo campsite. This shady terraced campsite is very well cared for, with pitches delineated by greenery. From the terraces, you have a beautiful panoramic view of the bay.

Shaded terraced camping site

Camping Sanfilippo is a shady terraced campsite. The reception is located at the highest point. So you can enjoy a lovely panoramic view. From the reception, a wide, paved boulevard runs down the hill. The camping area is very well cared for and extends all the way to the sea. There are about a hundred touring pitches in the campsite, which are nicely demarcated by greenery.

A small bay with a sandy beach

Camping Sanfilippo is located directly on the Tyrrhenian Sea, in a small bay with a sandy beach. The coast here is rocky, and there are also many rocks and stones on the sandy beach and in the sea. Still, it's possible to enjoy swimming and snorkelling in the bay. All along the coast of Sicily, you will find beautiful beaches. One of the most beautiful is Lido Salinelle, four kilometres away. Cefalù is also a great place to swim and sunbathe.

Simple facilities

In terms of facilities, the campsite is simple. There is a small camping shop and a simple bar, but no restaurant. However, you can get a takeout at the bar. Just outside the campsite, you will find a small restaurant and a beach pavilion. In Cefalù, a nice tourist village five kilometres from the campsite, you will find an abundance of restaurants, pizzerias and bars. There is a shuttle bus from the campsite, but you can also take the (cheaper) public bus.

properties.name: Camping Roland
properties.description:
Camping Roland is situated in the beautiful surroundings of the Maasduinen National Park in North Limburg. You can camp here in a forest just five kilometres from the German border. Peaceful Afferden is the closest town to the campsite. The campsite has a beautiful outdoor swimming pool with a waterslide, several sports fields, and a bar-restaurant.

Camping in nature

You can reach your pitch via unpaved but still good roads. The pitches are spacious (80-120 m2) and beautifully situated amongst the greenery. There are three separate camping fields (Europalaan, Pheasant Field and Rainbow Field). The amount of shade and privacy varies by field. Wherever you camp, the pitch you'll be camping on will be grassy. The Rainbow Field is car-free.

The six-person Limburg lattice tents, Navajo tents and luxury safari tents are particularly interesting. There are also about twenty bungalows in which you can stay. Motorhome owners have a choice of nearly forty RV sites. There are a large number of permanent sites at the Roland Campsite: 292.

Water fun galore.

The heated pool (over 200 m2) of Camping Roland is fun for young and old. There is a heated paddling pool and a long slide. There is also a sunbathing area. The whole thing is beautifully designed. The pool is often the setting for games like water polo and water basketball.

Fun away from the pool

In high season there are animation programmes for children. There are also playgrounds and an air trampoline. There is a spacious indoor playground (suitable for children aged 4-12) for those rainy days. You can do anything with a ball on the multifunctional sports field. Camping classics such as bocce, mini-golf and table tennis are also available at the Roland campsite.

properties.name: Campingplatz am Dobbertiner See
properties.description:
Campingplatz am Döbbertiner See is situated in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, a region with many beautiful forests and lakes. The campsite lies on the outskirts of the village of Dobbertin, on the banks of a beautiful lake. The village is mainly known for its abbey. Visitors to this region come here for the tranquillity and nature. Slightly north and north-west of the campsite is a lovely walking area with a large number of lakes.

Sociable and a lovely view

The facilities on the campsite are not in contemporary style, but this only enhances the cosy atmosphere. Many of the camping pitches offer a beautiful view of the lake. A number of trees dot the camping fields. The camping pitches have a grass surface. As they are not demarcated, the available space may differ per season.

Clean sanitary facilities

The sanitary facilities, as mentioned before, are not exceedingly modern, but are kept meticulously clean. Apart from an area to play table tennis and volley ball, there are few facilities available for children. There is no swimming pool on the campsite, but swimming in the lake is allowed. A large wooden tepee, where you can make a fire, serves as the central meeting place.

Quiet and space

The campsite is an ideal spot for nature lovers and is therefore mainly frequented by holiday makers looking for quiet and space. The area is eminently suited for walking and cycling. Guided walks are also offered. The area north-west of Dobbertin, abound with lakes, is definitely worth a visit.

properties.name: Camping Le Parage
properties.description:
If you are looking for a place to stay close to the sea, the Keukenhof and charming cities, Camping Le Parage near Noordwijk (South Holland) is ideal. This quiet campsite borders on a woods and a dune area. A nice twenty-minute walk through the dunes will bring you to the expansive sandy beach of the North Sea. Cities like Leiden and Haarlem, fun for a day out, are nearby.

Car-free site with small-scale fields

As a campsite visitor, at Camping Le Parage you have a spacious grassy pitch. The tourists pitches and motorhome pitches are set up on small-scale fields. Outside of the high season, special pitches for tent camping can also be rented. The year pitches are located at the back of the campsite. There is a central parking area for your car. The camping site itself is car-free.

Charming canteen and plenty of sports options

There are many activities for children. They can amuse themselves in the children’s playground and on a large playing field. There is an actual football and basketball cage and a table-tennis table. At Le Parage’s charming canteen you can play a game of darts while enjoying a drink and a bite to eat. A local bakery delivers fresh rolls to this canteen every morning.

Feast on a pancake

A good meal can be had in the pancake restaurant across from the campsite entrance. This is an ideal location for families with children because the restaurant has a fun play area and is located next to a gnome path. This path leads through the Hollands Duin nature reserve, which borders on a quiet sandy beach. Dogs may be off lead in a specific section in the dune area and on the beach.

properties.name: Camping Homair Domaine de Soleil Plage
Autocamp Tiha Silo
properties.description:
The Croatian island of Krk is home to Autocamp Tiha Šilo. You camp right on the beach, 500 metres away from the village of Šilo. The beach is the source of more than enough fun and relaxation. Children have fun in the playground and sports enthusiasts enjoy themselves on the tennis court. The beautiful island of Krk invites you to go out into the countryside and visit the charming villages on the island.

Luxury accommodation with air conditioning

The pitches at this campsite are distributed throughout the camping site and vary in size. The campsite has pine trees spread all over, providing plenty of shade. Some of the pitches have a beautiful view of the azure blue water of the Adriatic Sea. You can also rent a luxury mobile home, fully furnished with a kitchen, one or more bathrooms, air conditioning and a terrace. Some accommodations overlook the cove.

Cocktail with a sea view

The region around Šilo is famous for its azure blue water and its beautiful inlets. Autocamp Tiha Šilo is located by a pebble beach and is ideal for water activities like swimming, snorkelling or standup paddleboarding. The beach has several chaise longues with parasols for complete relaxation. If you want a cold drink or a snack, the campsite has a cocktail bar with a view of the sea.

Holiday on Krk

The popular holiday island of Krk has much to offer tourists and is a good mix of nature and culture. The west side of the island is very green while the east side is little less green with a rocky landscape. The island has many coastal locations that have an impressive history.

properties.name: Camping Le Beau Vezé
properties.description:
Camping Le Beau Vezé is located on the Côte d'Azur, just a few kilometres from the Mediterranean Sea. Here you camp on a sloping terrain, where pines and centuries-old olive trees provide shady spots. At the child-friendly campsite, children can swim in the outdoor swimming pool (with slide) or take part in the summer entertainment programme. The summer evenings are enlivened by music, but you can also spend the night in peace and quiet.

Camping in nature

The more than one hundred touring pitches and thirty-five rental accommodations are shaded by tall pine trees. Wide forest paths take you over the elongated, sloping terrain along which the beautifully landscaped camping pitches are situated. Little walls and the trees provide a natural divider between the pitches. The unspoilt nature provides a calm and relaxed atmosphere. Especially when you're camping at the back of the terrain you’ll enjoy the peace and quiet.

Camping for children

In the high season you will see many families with children on the campsite. Logical, because one of the attractions on the campsite is the swimming pool. The large, rectangular swimming pool, and two smaller pools and a waterslide, are nicely landscaped on a sunny spot between the trees. At the pool young camping guests can join in with water games. The rest of the campsite also offers activities for young people: laser games, crafts afternoons and disco evenings.

Conviviality at the pavement cafe

Summer evenings at Le Beau Vezé campsite are long and enjoyable. Guests can dine together at the pavement cafe next to the swimming pool and enjoy musical performances. If you want to be assured of a quiet spot, ask for a pitch a little higher up on the terrain.

properties.name: Camping La Belle Etoile
properties.description:
About fifty kilometres southeast of Paris, directly on the river Seine, you will find camping La Belle Etoile. Here you can camp on sheltered touring pitches or on lawns with an open character. For children there is plenty to do on the campsite. Especially in the new swimming pool, which is covered and heated, you will often find them.

Sheltered and open pitches

The campsite is divided into several fields, with a total of 156 touring pitches. Many of the touring pitches are sheltered between hedges and in the shade of trees. Other pitches are situated on a field with a more open character. Most of the rental accommodations, thirty in total, are chalets and mobile homes. But you can also camp in one of the Coco-sweet tents.

Covered and heated swimming pool

Since 2019 campsite guests can take a dip in the brand new swimming pool (heated) at the campsite. Also with rain, because the pool is covered. When the sun shines, the roof is partly opened, so you can swim and enjoy the sun. Adjacent to the pool is a paddling pool. Kaa, the snake from The Jungle Book, separates the paddling pool from the large pool, so small children can splash safely in the shallow water.

Pizza with brie

It is good to relax on the pavement café of the pizzeria it is located near the pool. Here you can go for a quick snack, but more extensive dining is possible. Mainly pizzas are served, with one specialty in particular: a pizza topped with Brie de Melun, the cheese made in Melun.

properties.name: Camping Padimadour
properties.description:
Camping Padimadour is located in the area between the Dordogne and Lot rivers. This very well maintained family campsite has a park-like layout and has spacious camping pitches, camper pitches and lodge tents. You can go to the camping shop for some basic purchases and regional products, and the restaurant on the camping site serves home-made pizzas. The radiant centrepiece is the heated swimming pool, beautifully situated under the sun.

Well-maintained campsite

Camping Padimadour looks great in all aspects. The camping site is neatly laid out and has the appearance of a park with circular paths and playfully landscaped camping fields. The camping pitches are spacious, well maintained and clearly demarcated. There are special spacious pitches for campers and there is a separate field for the lodge tents.

Homemade pizzas

At the front of the campsite you will find many facilities, such as the camping shop (with a limited range and some regional products), the restaurant and the snack bar. Home-made pizzas are offered here, among other things. The restaurant is only open in the evenings. Close to the restaurant you will also find some fun playgrounds for children, you can also play a game of table tennis or jeu-de-boules.

Swimming pool under the sunshine

The radiant centrepiece of the campsite is the beautiful heated swimming pool. It is wonderfully situated under the southern French sun. Just next to the swimming pool there is a separate paddling pool and you can unwind completely in the whirlpool. Once out of the water, you can get a cold drink or an ice cream at the bar and settle down to dry off in the sunbathing area on a bed or chair.

properties.name: Flower Camping à la Rencontre du Soleil
properties.description:
In the rugged nature of the French High Alps, in the Rhône-Alpes region, lies Camping Sites & Paysages à la Rencontre du Soleil (in short: A la Rencontre du Soleil). You camp here at the foot of the Alpe d’Huez, known from the Tour de France. The area is an excellent destination for seekers of peace and quiet, nature lovers, cyclists and mountain hikers. The campsite has a restaurant (with terrace), bar and shop.

Camping on flowery grounds

The well maintained, cheerful looking campsite with its numerous flowers, offers spacious pitches on grass. A small river, in which you can paddle, flows along the campsite. Demarcated with high hedges, bushes and tall, deciduous trees and conifers, most pitches offer ample shade and privacy. 

Swimming with a view

The oval swimming pool of Camping A la Rencontre du Soleil has a sliding roof and offers a splendid view of the surrounding mountains. The pool is beautifully designed, well maintained and has a depth of approx. 90-120 cm. You will find a few loungers on the decorated tiles around the swimming pool, so bring your book or e-reader!

Entertainment for all

Children can keep themselves busy on a small playground, multi-sports terrain, tennis court or on the large playing field. A rainy day? Off with the children to the bad weather facility or the kids club (in high season). In the evenings there are regular performances and music shows. The campsite also organises excursions.

Bites and drinks

In the summer season the bar and the restaurant (with full menu) are operational. The catering facility looks well maintained and is attractively furnished including some sofas.

properties.name: Flower Camping La Guichardière
properties.description:
At Camping La Guichardière, situated at only three hundred metres from the sea, you can enjoy a wonderful holiday on the Atlantic Coast. You camp here in the Loire-Atlantique region, a unique combination of history, culture and seaside fun. The campsite is located in the vicinity of the historical city of Nantes and within walking distance of the Atlantic Ocean.

A genuine family campsite

The entertainment team of La Guichardière organises a wealth of activities in high season, which makes for a friendly atmosphere. Join the theme evenings, karaoke evenings, water activities and much more. The tiny ones are also not forgotten as there is lots of entertainment for them. They are kept busy with crafts, playing games, treasure hunts and various tournaments.

Luxury accommodation

If you travel without camping equipment, you can rent one of the fully equipped mobile homes. Even more fun: book one of the Cabanes de Pêcheurs: luxurious and spacious mobile homes furnished in a characteristic ocean atmosphere. They also have a covered terrace. 

Heated swimming pool

Swimming fun is guaranteed with the various activities organised in the heated outdoor swimming pool (minimum temperature: 26 °C). You can, of course, also swim, play and swim some laps on your own. There is also an indoor swimming pool with hydromassage, suited for the disabled.

Join a culinary world tour

Camping La Guichardière has a small camping shop and a bar/restaurant. Restaurant dishes include pizzas, roasted chicken, chips or sandwiches. During the theme evenings you are taken on a culinary world tour. Make sure you join the Spanish paella evenings or the Breton evenings to discover the traditional Breton galettes and crêpes (savoury and sweet pancakes).

properties.name: Camping Le Camp de Florence
properties.description:
Camping Le Camp de Florence is located on the outskirts of the pretty village of La Romieu. A very well-maintained campsite with Dutch owners. Around an authentic farmhouse, between sunflower fields, you’ll find a green campsite with touring pitches overlooking the hills of Gascony. With a swimming pool, children's club and alpacas in the animal pasture, there's a lot to do for children. There is also a good restaurant with an intimate terrace.

View over vines and sunflowers

Full-grown trees, sunflowers and climbing plants give character to the well-kept campsite Le Camp de Florence. The most beautiful pitches offer a vast view over the hills of Gascony, filled with vines and sunflower fields. Other touring pitches overlook the church of La Romieu. For pilgrims on their way to Santiago de Compostella there is a separate field with tent pitches.

Tropical swimming pool with view

The campsite's outdoor swimming pool slopes gradually, making it safe for children. There is also a large shallow area with a nice slide and sprinklers. A lifeguard offers extra safety during the summer months. But also for the bigger swimmers the tropical swimming pool is nice. One part is deep enough to swim in, while you can also sit in the whirlpool.

Cuddling alpacas

Alpacas: the increasingly popular cuddly animals. You can also meet these fluffy friends at the campsite. Alpacas are especially fascinating for children. Younger campers can also indulge themselves on one of the large sports fields. The Lenny Club is also fun. In this kids club the little ones can do arts and crafts, play games or look for treasures every day in July and August.

properties.name: Camping de la Forêt
properties.description:
Camping de la Forêt is located in eastern France, in the heart of the Jura Mountains. The campsite has camping pitches and a few rental accommodations. The staff provides entertainment for young and old. The campsite's café has a terrace where you can sit on the lounge sofas and enjoy delicious food. The campsite also has a swimming pool.

Camping at a great campsite

The reception has a cosy café. In front of the reception, there are wooden benches and lovely lounge areas. The campsite has marked camping pitches, chalets, mobile homes and lodges. The campsite's plumbing is fairly outdated, but clean and well maintained.

Activities for all ages

In high season, there is plenty for children to do. Treasure hunts, scavenger hunts, crafts and more. There is also entertainment in the evening. For example, there are fun karaoke nights and concerts. Furthermore, the entertainment team organises walks with Kiki and Lulu, the campsite ponies. Sports enthusiasts can participate in various sports competitions. Among others: pétanque, table tennis and table football. And the campsite also boasts a floodlit bowling alley.

Restaurant with lounge sets

From the 1st of July, the campsite's terrace and restaurant will be open. The outdoors is an especially delightful place to be. You can take a seat there on the wooden benches or on the lounge sets. You can see the children playing a short distance away. Enjoy delicious pizzas, fries, pastries, refreshing drinks and ice creams. Every morning, you can get fresh bread and breakfast cakes. The restaurant's meals are freshly prepared by a restaurant in the village!

properties.name: Flower Camping de La Hallerais
properties.description:
Flower Camping de la Hallerais, located in the Rance Valley, offers a quiet and strategic starting point. You can explore Brittany at your own pace from this campsite surrounded by forests and countryside by River La Rance. With its own amenities, such as a swimming pool, restaurant and supermarket, the campsite has all modern conveniences. Explore the area by bike, or visit historical towns, including Dinan, Saint-Malo and the iconic Mont Saint-Michel.

Camping on spacious pitches

This campsite has a large number of camping pitches, including special stabilised pitches for motorhomes. The camping pitches are all equipped with a power supply and a water point with discharge. Natural hedges separate these pitches, which gives a sense of privacy. If you don't have your own camping equipment, book one of the hire accommodation. You can choose from chalets and mobile homes.

With all modern conveniences

Whether it is hot or cold, you can swim in the heated outdoor pool from mid-June to mid-September at La Hallerais. The site also has a beach area with sun loungers that invite you to relax and unwind. The campsite also has a restaurant with a bar and a small supermarket.

What can you do?

Hire a bike at the campsite, ideal for exploring the area. Dinan (4 km) is a must-visit with its historical architecture and lively markets. And of course, the tidal island of Mont Saint-Michel (54.5 km) is not to be missed.

properties.name: Dancamps Nordsø
properties.description:
Dancamps Nordsø is a campsite in Hvide Sande, situated on the coast of Mid Jutland. This well maintained campsite lies along the Ringkobing Fjord and directly behind high dunes. This creates beautiful panoramic views of the hilly landscape. Special Viking events are organised in the area.

Basic as well as highly luxurious accommodation units

The pitches offer you enough space for your own caravan, motorhome or tent. There is no shade, but the pitches are neatly and evenly laid out.  You can also rent one of the well equipped holiday cabins, mobile homes, apartments or comfort tents. The accommodation varies from basic to highly luxurious. 

Activities for the entire family

There is always something to do on the campsite. Young campers, for instance, are entertained with a swinging mini disco or with an adventurous treasure hunt.  When you are into swimming and surfing, the sea is always nearby. The sea can be reached directly from the campsite via a constructed dune passage to the beach. 

The campsite is also ideally situated for a cycling or walking trip through the green landscape. The swimming paradise with several slides is the ideal spot for more water fun. Or enjoy some relaxing camping time in the Turkish bath, the sauna or the spa.

Eating at the campsite

If you want to cook your own meals, you can do your shopping in the camping shop at the reception. Here you will also find a cosy coffee corner. Cooking on the campsite with its superb cooking facilities in the accommodation units is an absolute pleasure.

Dancamps Nordsø has no restaurant, but has a friendly cafeteria which is open in high season.

properties.name: Camping Les Deux Vallées
properties.description:
Camping in the heart of the Dordogne, overlooking the castle of Beynac. This is possible at Les Deux Vallées, a beautiful family campsite at less than half an hour's walk from the river Dordogne. The surroundings offer plenty of possibilities for a varied holiday. Visit one of the thousand castles in this region, discover prehistoric cave paintings or explore the river by canoe.

With a beautiful view

Les Deux Vallées is a very well maintained 3-star campsite. The pitches are of medium size and all overlook the Château de Beynac. You'll be camping on lawns bordered by many hedges, shrubs and trees provide to provide shade and shelter. The sixteen rental mobile homes are located on the edge of the campsite, near the fishing pond.

Swimming pool with allure

Centrally located on the campsite is a heated swimming pool of recent date, with a separate paddling pool. Both pools are nice and clean and radiate a certain allure. All around is a sundeck with sun loungers and parasols. Swimming is also possible in the river Dordogne, but is actually more suitable for other water sports. In half an hour you walk to the bank of the river. There you can canoe, kayak and even paddle surf.

You feel at home here

As befits a real family campsite, Les Deux Vallées has many facilities for families with children. The campsite has everything you need for a pleasant and comfortable holiday. There is a well-equipped campsite shop, a restaurant with French cuisine and a particularly friendly sidewalk café.

properties.name: Havelberge Camping Resort
properties.description:
Do you like large-scale campsites with all the trimmings? Then Havelberge Campsite and Holiday Park is for you! Here at the Woblitzsee, you will find everything you need. The campsite is located in Müritz National Park in the Mecklenburg Lake District. This makes it the ideal base for water sports enthusiasts and nature lovers.

Reception at the campsite

The grounds of Havelberge Campsite and Holiday Park are at different elevations, which gives extra atmosphere to the campsite. You can stay on one of the various pitches, for example in the forest or at the swimming pond with a playground. Havelberge Campsite and Holiday Park also rents out all kinds of accommodations.

Entertainment at the campsite

Don't feel like leaving the campsite? You don't have to; there's plenty to do. You can do archery here, for example, while your kids have fun on the trampolines (for a fee) or have fun in the climbing forest! For children and adults, there is an extensive entertainment programme (language: German) from the beginning of April to the end of October. The campsite also has an animation team for young people (13-18 years) and a German- and English-speaking mini-club in high season.

Plenty of amenities

As described earlier, this campsite has all the amenities. The camping site shop is well stocked. Also, both fresh bread and a full breakfast (in high season) are available at the campsite. You can also eat delicious food at the restaurant. The restaurant's terrace overlooks the campsite's theatre stage. Great if you feel like catching a show while you eat! The campsite has several sanitary facilities.

properties.name: Camping Muhlenbach
properties.description:
Just a stone's throw away from the German border, in the vast forests of the northern Vosges, Camping du Muhlenbach offers a wide range of accommodation options (tepees, Gypsy wagons). The campsite is located a few kilometres from the Citadelle de Bitche, a fortress the oldest parts of which date back to the Middle Ages. It is, therefore, an excellent base for excursions in the surrounding region by car, bicycle or on foot.

Peace

Above all, Camping du Muhlenbach radiates tranquillity. It won't come as a surprise, therefore, that the majority of the guests visit this campsite to enjoy the peace and quiet amidst the breathtaking nature in this French-German border region. The pitches are beautiful and large and offer an attractive view of the surroundings and the lake. You can swim and go fishing in this lake. As a river empties into the lake on one side and discharges into another lake on the other side, the water moves continuously. As a result, there are no mosquitoes and the water is always clean and cool, safe for swimming.

Angling

There is ample fish in the lake, including carp, trout and pike. However, you do need a fishing license (obtainable from the reception). There are also very strict regulations governing the ways of fishing. The receptionist will gladly give you information about this. You can prepare your catch in the grill area in the evening.

Catering facilities/shop

You do not have to leave the campsite for groceries as there is a small, well-stocked shop. Or you can eat in the restaurant, while you enjoy the lovely view over the lake.

properties.name: Camping Le Devançon
properties.description:
In the picturesque region of the Provence, lies the small campsite called Le Devançon. Here you will be camping at a peaceful location in the woods. This primarily French campsite is perfect for those looking for some peace and quiet as well as lovers of culture and the great outdoors. The region that you are in is very popular with tourists, but you'll hardly notice them when you are on the campsite. It is wonderful to come home to this small, green oasis after a day out.

Wooded terrain

The wooded terrain provides a sense of calm and gets excellent shade in several areas. Other locations get more sunlight. The pitches are located on terraces and are relatively flat. The pitches here have a gravel surface. Low hedges mark off the pitch boundaries to a certain extent. Want to hire something? If so, you can book a great mobile home or bungalow.

Swimming, hiking and cycling

The swimming pool and children's pool are beautiful. They have been built in a simple yet stylish way. You can swim a few laps and then relax on a lounger. 

Children can enjoy themselves in the small play area and on the trampoline or play a game of table tennis. Activities are held on the campsite as well. The area around the campsite is great for brilliant hiking and biking adventures: there are all sorts of routes laid out through this extensive wooded terrain.

A drink at the lively bar

The bar on the campsite, which is decorated in a retro style, is a great place to relax after a day full of cultural activities, hiking or biking. You can also grab something to eat at the snack bar. There is a charming patio between the bar and the swimming pool, in the shade of the trees. You can purchase fresh bread every day on the campsite.

properties.name: Gammelbro Camping
properties.description:
Would you like to camp on a large campsite at the seaside? No problem at Gammelbro Camping, situated in the south of Denmark. Its location makes this a popular campsite for beachgoers and water sports enthusiasts. The campsite also caters to children who like to get creative. Amateur chefs take note: there is a communal kitchen area with several stoves and an oven.

Just like a holiday village

The very spaciously laid-out campsite looks just like a holiday village. The camping pitches on this campsite vary in size. You can place your pitch on a large field, or choose for a cosier spot on a smaller field. Some pitches even have a view of the sea. Rather rent accommodation? The campsite also rents out simple cabins. 

Fun in the water

You can visit the indoor pool with several water slides and a special paddling pool for toddlers. The water temperature is always 28 degrees. You pay a small fee to make use of the swimming pool, but it's the ideal location for a rainy day. And when the sun is out? Find a spot on the fine sandy beach at the seaside. The beach with a jetty offers plenty of opportunities for sunbathing, taking a dip in the sea or engaging in water sports. 

Indoor and outdoor fun!

There is plenty more to experience besides water fun. In the high season, numerous activities and shows are organised for the children. There is also a special area where they can do crafts, read and play. There is also an area with a table tennis, pool and air hockey table. Outside you will find three playgrounds which include a jumping pillow, miniature digging equipment and go-karts.

properties.name: Camping Bañares
properties.description:
In the heart of the La Rioja wine region, on the Santiago de Compostella pilgrimage route, lies Camping Bañares. Wine and culture lovers can really indulge themselves in the region. But as a matter of fact, you do not have to leave the campsite, because it offers everything you need. Furthermore, you can sleep in a large 'wine barrel'. How fitting...

Sleeping in a wine barrel

The grounds are neatly laid out with straight hedges and paved pathways. There is little shade as yet and there are many permanent pitches. The tourist pitches are located in rows on a still quite open field with young vegetation. There is no demarcation. If you want to hire accommodation, you can choose between traditional (mobile home) and adventurous (wooden bungalows in the shape of a wine barrel). The matching seating arrangement is also in wine barrel style. The campsite is popular among permanent guests from Spain.

Large swimming pool

At the heart of the camping grounds you will find the large swimming pool. The toddler pool is also fairly large. The pools are fenced in, with the loungers outside. Therefore, the chances that you will be soaked are slim. Around the pool there is vegetation of medium-sized trees, so that you will always find a spot in the shade. The sanitary facilities are fine.

Sport and games

In terms of facilities Camping Bañares has it all. Guests can enjoy themselves on the pétanque pitch, on the tennis court and with the entertainment. Small campers will amuse themselves on the playground, of course.

Great restaurant

The restaurant is new and of fine quality. There is also a terrace. The supermarket on the campsite has a large range.

properties.name: Camping Creuse Nature Naturiste
properties.description:
In the Limousin region, in a large forest, lies the Creuse Nature Naturiste campsite. The camping area of this naturist campsite is laid out around a small lake. Although there are many activities for the campers in high season, it is still a quiet campsite. In addition to a heated indoor pool and a simple outdoor pool, Creuse Nature also has a sauna and whirlpool. In the restaurant, you can eat delicious food.

Camping in the forest

The sprawling campsite is located in a fenced-in forest area of up to nineteen acres. Most of the pitches are located in the shady forest edge, but you can also choose a pitch in the sun or by the lake. You are sheltered and have a lot of privacy. There are 120 touring pitches, as well as some permanent annual pitches and special camper pitches. In addition, there are several bungalows, chalets, caravans and tents for rent.

Swimming pool and sauna

A heated indoor pool is located in the centre of the campsite. The atmospheric circular pool has all kinds of facilities around it, such as a bar, restaurant, terrace and sauna. The simple outdoor pool has a separate, shallow section for small children. For the little ones, there is also a separate paddling pool. In the early and late season, you can use the sauna free of charge every evening.

Safe and child friendly

Creuse Nature offers eco-camping in the middle of nature. The campsite has been set up with attention to child-friendliness and safety. The terrain is mostly flat, and therefore also very suitable for disabled campers. In high season, there is a varied entertainment program,e for children and adults. You can participate in a variety of activities, from archery and sculpture to wine tastings and bocce tournaments. In the summer, you can join the open stage night and join us around the campfire.

properties.name: Camping L'Alquería
properties.description:
