The quiet campsite l’Alquería is situated in a urban area in the Valencia Province, near the vast sandy beaches of the lively beach resort of Grau de Gandía on the Mediterranean. The large city of Valencia is in the vicinity. This is an ideal spot for sun worshippers, beach lovers, walkers, cyclists and culture enthusiasts.

Palm trees and deciduous trees

On the grounds you will see decorative paving everywhere as well as a variety of palm and deciduous trees. The pitches are adequately sized and have a gravel surface. You can choose between pitches with a lot or with some shade. Want to rent something? There are several types of bungalows and trekker huts on the campsite.

Sunny swimming pool and beautiful sandy beach

The swimming pool is in a lovely sunny location and is surrounded by loungers. There is also a toddler pool. You can also relax in the large jacuzzi, of course. In winter the swimming pool with jacuzzi is covered and there are changing cabins. Prefer the sea? The campsite is only a few minutes away by bicycle from the esplanade and the sandy beaches.

Sport and entertainment

The campsite has a pétanque court, a soccer field, a table tennis table and an area with computer games. There is a lovely playground for the little ones. Especially in summer there is a great deal of entertainment: lots of sports and games for children, daily water aerobics for adults.

Limited menu

In peak season the camping restaurant keeps a small menu. The food is basic, but of good quality. It is also reasonably priced. In peak season the camping shop is open. You can get fresh bread daily.

properties.name: Camping Roca Grossa
properties.description:
Camping Roca Grossa is a beautifully landscaped terraced campsite close to the popular seaside resort of Calella. From many of the pitches you can enjoy a beautiful view. This family campsite has everything to offer, such as a large swimming pool, sports facilities, various entertainment programmes and the proximity of a beach.

Pitches with beautiful view

In terms of size, the pitches are not spectacular, although it should be noted that one pitch is larger than the other. The mainly terraced pitches are neatly laid out and delimited. All pitches are equipped with an electricity connection. Moreover, from many of the touring pitches you can enjoy a beautiful view, for example over the mountains or the sea. The same can be said about the various types of rental bungalows.

Swimming at the highest level

For the swimming pool you have to go to the highest part of the campsite, but you don’t take the trouble for nothing. The large swimming pool of Roca Grossa offers the necessary cooling, but people who want to swim a few lengths will also find what they are looking for. A large paddling pool is also available. Moreover, from the pool area you have a beautiful view over the campsite and the sea.

Enjoy the Mediterranean cuisine

This campsite has a friendly restaurant with a typical Spanish atmosphere. Here you can enjoy delicious Mediterranean dishes. Furthermore, the campsite has two bars, one of which is near the swimming pool. There is also a supermarket on the campsite for your most needed groceries.

properties.name: International Camping Village
properties.description:
International Camping Village lies in the South Italian region of Calabria. You camp here directly by the sea on a lovely bay. The attractive island of Isola di Dino lies on your doorstep. Campers come to this part of Italy to be guaranteed of the sun. The beautiful coastline and direct hinterland are sparsely populated and will let you enjoy nature and attractive small towns.

Spacious pitches

The restaurant, the shop and the reception are housed in one building. There is also an aviary with budgies, a playground for children and a stage for performances. International Camping Village is a large campsite with spacious pitches. The trees, as well as a number of shade cloths here and there, offer ample privacy and shade. There are also slightly larger pitches, especially for large motorhomes. The bungalows also look well cared for.

Day on the beach and snorkel party

You only have to cross the road to get to the (pebble) beach of the campsite. On the beach you will find a small bar for campsite guests. From the beach you have a vast and beautiful view, especially of Isola di Dino looming up in front of you. The water is clear which makes snorkelling a feast for the eye.

Culinary must

The restaurant on the campsite is a definite must for any culinary aficionado! The restaurant has a limited menu, but serves quality dishes. The regional dishes come highly recommended. Not to mention the beautiful terrace...The supermarket only stocks the bare essentials.

properties.name: Sites & Paysages Camping Le Petit Liou
properties.description:
Camping Sites & Paysages Le Petit Liou is situated on the edge of the Ecrins National Park. You camp here on level terrain with a view of the snow-capped mountains of the Hautes-Alpes. Peace and space are the key words for this campsite, emphasised by the calming surroundings and the spacious camping pitches. The reservoir of Serre-Ponçon is one kilometre away. It is a great place for swimming and sailing. There is also a small island in the lake with a chapel. In winter, during low tide, you can walk to the island.

Camping in nature

The pitches are located on large, level lawns between the mountains. You have a choice of camping on open fields or more between trees. Do you prefer a bit more luxury, whilst retaining that camping feel? If so, you have many rental accommodation options. The eco-lodges and eco-tents are especially popular.

Environmentally friendly holiday

The campsite owners are eco-conscious. Camping guests can also do their part towards making their holiday environmentally friendly. Waste is separated, for instance, and water is used in moderation. This is appreciated by the guests of Le Petit Liou. 

Entertainment for the whole family

There is an entertainment programme for children in the summer months with evening dance parties and arts and crafts afternoons in the recreation area. Adults won't be left out, though: there are plenty of more mature activities, from concerts to pétanque tournaments. There is a swimming pool on the campsite for some water fun. It is not very large, but does the trick when you want to cool off. 

Homemade regional dishes

The restaurant has a rather limited menu. However, it boasts several regional dishes. The homemade pizzas and artisan ice creams are very popular with both young and old.

properties.name: Camping Slatina
properties.description:
In an idyllic spot, in a large Mediterranean forest on the beautiful Croatian island of Cres, lies this large terraced campsite. With a location directly on the Adriatic Sea, you can dive straight into the water. In any case, Camping Slatina is a campsite where you can have fun all day, given the numerous opportunities for sports, recreation and entertainment. Furthermore, Camping Slatina pays extra attention to campers who bring their dog(s).

The island of Cres is known for its beautiful beaches and bays, atmospheric villages and numerous cycling and hiking opportunities. This island also offers excellent sailing and diving opportunities. Who knows, you might even spot a dolphin or two!

Camping pitches with sea view

This is a terraced campsite with some very steep paths, sometimes with a gradient of up to 20%. If necessary, the campsite management will provide towing assistance with a tractor. Whether it turns out to be necessary or not, once you are settled in your pitch, it all seems worth the effort. In fact, this campsite has numerous pitches with a great view of the deep blue sea. Some sites are even located almost directly on the water.

Swimming, boating and diving

The Camping Slatina campsite is situated around two bays (Slatina and Tiha). There are two large pebble beaches along with several plateaus and a swimming jetty. So you can make the most of every opportunity to enjoy the seawater. And in a completely safe way, because there are cordoned-off areas where you can swim under supervision.

properties.name: Camping De Couwenberg
properties.description:
The De Couwenberg campsite is in a very rustic and peaceful location in De Kempen and borders a beautiful nature preserve with forests, heath and marshes. The friendly family campsite is located in Netersel, a small farming village that is called one of the 'Eight Contentments'. The campsite is popular with Dutch families with children looking for an affordable holiday.

Seasonal and regular campers

At the entrance to the campsite, which is about 8 ha. large, there are 100 touring pitches around a swimming pool and a playground. You can camp on a nicely landscaped green, spacious pitch (80 to 120 m2) on a small-scale camping field with a water tap. There are demarcated sun and shade pitches. The tall trees offer loads of shade. Some pitches are located in extra quiet places, offering lots of privacy. On the campsite, there are 190 annual pitches for regular guests, which are kept separate from the touring pitches.

Swimming, playing and relaxing

For children and their parents, it's nice that the heated, open-air swimming pool (72 m2), playground, canteen and terrace are centrally located in the campsite. During school holidays and at the weekend you can order snacks at the café, which has a small menu. At the reception desk you can order fresh bread for the next morning.

During the high season, fun activities are organised for the children. They can have loads of fun on the bouncy castle in the recreation area. Adults can entertain themselves with bingo, darts, billiards and at music nights. There is a fishpond at the campsite where you can float about on a dinghy. For sports activities, you can go to the panna field.

properties.name: Hertugbyens Camping
properties.description:
Hertugbyens Camping is a simple but quiet campground located in South-Jutland. The campsite is located on a fjord, about 10 km from the historic town of Sønderborg. The campground is in a beautiful location in the midst of nature, where you have greenery all around you. The property borders directly the Augustenborg fjord and is also sensitive to wind. There is a lovely sandy beach along the fjord.

Peace, quiet and greenery

Peace, quiet, simplicity and greenery are high on the list here, you'll feel it immediately. To retain this, you'll not find any luxury or activities on the campground, and you'll have to leave the campground for a restaurant or shop.

Sleeping by the fjord

The campground is located next to the castle park of Augustenborg. The property is actually the land of an old farm that belonged to the castle. The sometimes hilly terrain has sites without shade and with some shade (few trees) on a well-maintained grass ground. There are many green hedges between the non-separated campsites and there are a number of trekkers huts with small verandas on the property, for 2 to 6 people. The lane of Castle Augustenborg is used to walk to the water from the nearby fjord.

Active on holiday

The fjord offers various options for swimming and sports. Get into nature in the beautiful environment and visit the villages and towns in the immediate vicinity, they are very charming.

Sanitary facilities

The sanitation facilities are good and sufficiently clean in the high seasons, but can leave something to be desired in the quieter periods.

properties.name: Camping Il Villaggio di GiuEle
properties.description:
Camping Il Villaggio de GiuEle is located near Finale Ligure on the Riviera di Ponente in the Liguria region. It is an expansive, highly luxury holiday park with rental accommodation, a hotel and a campground (also called Eurocamping Calvisio). The park is located a few kilometres inland in a hilly area with vineyards and olive groves.

Luxury surrounding

The first impression is of the spacious, nice and clean campground. The camping area is flat with vegetation providing shade. The campsites are not excessively large and vary from 25 to 70 m2. Of the 120 sites, 80 have private sanitation. The communal sanitation is nice and clean. The rental apartments are in the form of a small village near the swimming pool. There is a spacious swimming pool with lounge chairs and parasols and a separate kiddie pool. At the swimming pool you'll find a bar and a Spanish restaurant which also has pizza on the menu. There is also an extensive supermarket with regional products and wine and olive oil from the estate.

Lovely holiday destination

The beautiful, peaceful environment and the many facilities make it possible to have a wonderful holiday here. The campground is located a few kilometres from the Val Ponci, which has many options for trekking on foot, by mountain bike or on horseback. Finale Ligure is known as a centre for rock climbing. For the youth there is an activities team in July and August that keeps kids and teenagers busy with games and music evenings. Kids can also learn to ride horses on the campground. The beach of Finale Ligure is 3 km away.

properties.name: Vakantiepark Delftse Hout
properties.description:
Holiday Park Delftse Hout, which also calls itself a 'town campsite' is a lively family campsite with something to do for everyone. You have a wide choice of rental accommodation here, from chalets and bungalow to huts. There's lots of entertainment on the grounds and there's also plenty to do in the vicinity of the campsite. Join in with the entertainment team, for instance. On the campsite you will find a bakery, a shop, a brasserie and a snack bar.

A wide range of camping options

At Holiday Park Delftse Hout, you can bring your own tent, caravan or motorhome. Special pitches are available for motorhomes and caravans (paved and equipped with water tap and drain). The pitches are separated from the permanent pitches. 

Family field

The family field is clear and uncluttered because of the low vegetation. As a result it is very easy for children in particular to make contacts. There are also special fields with four to six pitches offering a bit more privacy.

Swimming, playing and sports

The campsite has a heated outdoor pool (91 m2). There is also a paddling pool for babies and toddlers. The recreational lake adjacent to the campsite is also a great source of pleasure. Here you can indulge in swimming, surfing, pedal boating or canoeing.

Not much of a water lover? In the middle of the campsite is a large playground where children can play to their heart's content. You will also find a pétanque pitch here. Table tennis is also available. Small children will enjoy the water playground and the petting zoo. These are located in the adjacent nature area at a few minutes' walk from the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Liesbos
properties.description:
Camping Liesbos is situated in the nature-rich area surrounding Breda and Etten-Leur. The Brabant landscape flourishes here, with its woods, fields, horticultural plots, bogs and numerous farms. However, the conveniences of the city are close at hand as well. Both Etten-Leur (4 km) and the centre of Breda (8 km) are just a bike ride away from the campsite.

Camping and Citysleepers

As you drive to your pitch, you will first pass the many permanent pitches located at Camping Liesbos. The camping fields, where you can stay with your camper van, caravan, trailer tent or tent, are located at the back of the campsite. The pitches are well-tended, spacious and feature all the basic amenities for camping. You can also visit the campsite without camping equipment; 'Citysleepers' (chalets) are available for the non-camper.

Terrace by the playground

You can immediately see upon arrival that the campsite caters to the entire family. Here, you will find nearly all facilities for all ages in one location. For the children, there is a small playground and a multifunctional sports field where you can, for example, play a game of tennis or football.

You can keep yourself entertained even when it rains. For example, at the covered boules court. There is also a heated outdoor swimming pool with a separate paddling pool. In the weekends and in the peak season, an entertainment team is available to entertain the children with fun activities and sports competitions.

Centrally located near the entrance is café-restaurant Strix, where you can enjoy a drink at the bar or have something to eat in the restaurant. In the café area, you will also find typical pub games such as billiards or darts.

properties.name: Le Moulin Sites & Paysages
properties.description:
In the Haute-Garonne region of southern France, south of Toulouse, you can find Sites & Paysages Le Moulin. You'll end up here on a well-tended green campsite on the banks of the Garonne. Camping Le Moulin is a real family campsite. There are many play opportunities for children, as well as a large swimming pool and a petting zoo.

Martres-Tolosane is a charming French town one hour's drive from Toulouse. Driving across the canal in the village, turn left to drive to the campground. Just down the road, you can already see the reception in a beautiful authentic barn.

Southern French charm

In total, there are sixty touring pitches and forty rental accommodations. These are all screened with nice thick hedges. Numerous colourful flower boxes, fragrant lavender bushes and large trees provide colour and shelter. In the authentic buildings, you will find modern and well-kept facilities. There is also a good restaurant in the stylishly restored part of the old barn.

A large percentage of the campers consists of Western European families. The children will have a great time with the bouncy castles, go-karts, an arcade and a petting zoo. The modern pool, to the right of the entrance, has a nice view of the mountains through the trees. A path through the woods to the rear of the campsite leads to the Garonne river. Here you can enjoy paddling, casting a fishing rod or canoeing. From the campsite, you can reach the archaeological theme park of Le Village Gaulois in fifteen minutes or the university town of Toulouse in an hour.

properties.name: Camping Les Violettes
properties.description:
Camping Les Violettes is located just below Toulouse, on the Canal du Midi. This simple, green campsite has had new owners for a few years now, who are renovating it step by step. A new swimming pool with sliding roof has been built and the sanitary facilities have been completely renovated. The shaded campsite has sheltered pitches under the tall deciduous trees.

Sheltered and shaded

The new owners are working hard to make the campsite comfortable and modern. The pitches are spacious and delimited by vegetation. Because they are sheltered under tall trees, the pitches are wonderfully shady. There are about sixty touring pitches and about ten permanent pitches. There are also five mobile homes and three lodge tents for rent.

New swimming pool

Behind the main building a new swimming pool with sliding roof has been constructed. You can swim from May until the end of September.u As soon as the weather permits, the transparent sliding roof opens and the indoor pool becomes an outdoor pool. Around the pool are colourful seats and comfortable sun loungers.

Good restaurant

If you arrive late in the evening, you don't have to look for a restaurant in the area. At the campsite restaurant you can eat well. The menu is not too extensive, but the dishes are prepared with care. If you prefer to cook for yourself, you can also make use of the communal barbecue area.

Local products

Fresh bread and pastries are daily available at the campsite. In the main building you'll find a small shop with a limited range of groceries. All kinds of local products are also available there. There are also several supermarkets in the immediate vicinity for more extensive shopping.

properties.name: Camping Les Tailladis
properties.description:
At Les Tailladis campsite, located about ten kilometres from both Sarlat and the Caves of Lascaux, you will be welcomed with a cup of coffee and a big smile. Enjoy a relaxed atmosphere at this family campsite. You will camp at the foot of a hill, next to a small river, on a rugged campsite that is nicely integrated into nature.

Natural pitches

The rugged campsite is situated against the slope of the hill. The surrounding area has been taken into account in lay out of the pitches. A few central paths lead to the naturally delimited pitches, situated between shrubs and in the shade of dense trees. Some of the pitches are situated directly on La Beune, the small river that runs alongside the campsite.

Choice of heated swimming pool and natural pool

The campsite has two swimming pools: a heated swimming pool (located just behind the reception) and a large natural pool. The latter is situated on the edge of the campsite, next to the small river. If you follow this river for a few kilometres in a southwesterly direction, you'll come across a large swimming lake just before Tamniès. Here you can swim too, but to be honest, the water of the natural pool at the campsite is just as refreshing.

Regional dishes

If you want to get to know the local cuisine, you can go to the restaurant on the campsite. Every day there are different regional dishes on the menu. The restaurant and the large pavement café have the same family atmosphere that you feel all over the campsite. Once in a while the tables are pushed together for a ‘table d'hôte’ where you can eat with your fellow campers.

properties.name: Camping Les Ombrages de l'Adour
properties.description:
On a shady spot on the banks of the river Adour, in the French department of Landes, is the campsite Les Ombrages de l'Adour. Choose your own pitch on the flat campsite, which is partly shaded by trees. The campsite is suitable for longer stays, but because of its location it is also frequently used as a transit campsite.

Choose your own pitch

Although the campsite is not modern, it looks neat and tidy. Christophe and Valérie maintain their campsite well. There is plenty of choice: on the banks of the river or closer to the entrance, in the shade of the trees or on a sunny spot. In total there are some ninety spacious, undefined touring pitches to divide up. You can also stay in a mobile home.

Groceries

The most necessary groceries are available at the campsite, as well as snacks, drinks and ice creams. Just a few minutes drive and you'll find yourself in front of a larger supermarket. There are also plenty of restaurants in Aire-sur-l'Adour.

Clean sanitary facilities

Do not expect hypermodern and brand new sanitary facilities when you visit the toilet on the campsite. The sanitary facilities are old, well maintained and cleaned several times a day.

Water fun

In a sunny spot at the entrance to the campsite you can take a dip in the swimming pool. This pool is not too big, but it is heated. Bigger water is within easy reach, as you can reach the Adour within a few steps. Especially fishing enthusiasts are attracted by the flowing water of this river. Kayakers also see their chance to explore the wooded banks in the water.

properties.name: Le Perrier Camping La Maison Blanche
Camping La Ferme de Castellane
properties.description:
Nestled in the mountains and situated between pine forests and along a shallow river, lies Camping La Ferme de Castellane. This is a beautifully located oasis of peace, a few km from the attractive town of Castellane. The camping site is also ideally located for visiting the Gorges du Verdon.

Well-kept and neatly laid out grounds

The reception is located in the attractive building of an old water mill. La Ferme de Castellane is a campsite with relatively little luxury, but everything is well cared for and neatly laid out. The attractive camping grounds radiate peace and tranquillity even when fully occupied. The pitches on grass have ample shade. These are playfully laid out and vary in size, but are generally sufficiently large for your camping equipment. The campsite also has a number of mobile homes and chalets.

The sanitary facilities of the campsite are modern and immaculate, complete with a shower area for the disabled as well as a baby bath.

Shallow stream adjacent to the campsite

Entertainment on the campsite is available in the form of a heated outdoor pool, an illuminated pétanque pitch and some very clean playground equipment for children. There is also a small, shallow stream where you can paddle safely. There is a weekly barbecue with music for all guests. The communal room is located in a log cabin.

Pizzas from the oven

The campsite does not have a restaurant. You can find eating establishments in nearby Castellane. However, fresh rolls are available each morning (have to be ordered). Occasionally, pizzas are baked in the oven on the premises. You can do your shopping in a supermarket just ten minutes away by car.

properties.name: Flower Camping La Châtaigneraie
properties.description:
Flower Camping La Châtaigneraie is an attractive family campsite in a hilly and mountainous area. The terraced campsite offers everything that is needed for a relaxing and active camping holiday with children. On the campsite you can play freely, take part in activities and swim the entire day. You will not easily get bored with the beautiful landscape.

Terraces with various fields

The various terraces of the campsite are easy to reach. The spacious pitches are well maintained and demarcated with low vegetation. Each pitch has a different size and design. The fields are located on different levels, with the most beautiful view obviously from the highest level. Especially families with children up to 12 have a great time here. La Châtaigneraie is also a suitable campsite for an overnight stop.

Swimming, playing and good food

On the lowest level of the campsite is a large, heated swimming pool with a separate toddler pool. In summer lots of activities are organised there. Although the swimming pool is in the full sun, it has a sheltered location. Furthermore, there are sports fields and a nice but small petting zoo. In high season the camping is bursting with activities for different age groups. In a small shop at the reception you will find regional products with a touch of Moroccan influence. You can also place an order for bread. You need your car for grocery shopping. There is a large restaurant with a beautiful terrace shaded by a century-old tree.

Sanitary facilities

The sanitary facilities are modern and clean, and the newest building is fitted with family cabins. There is a sauna for aficionados.

properties.name: Camping La Plage
properties.description:
In the beautiful Cèze valley, Camping La Plage is surrounded by greenery on the banks of the river Cèze. You can swim, sail, fish or sunbathe endlessly on the private beach. Camping life is simple and relaxed. You have the river, some playing facilities and a nice restaurant. And in the summer there are cosy evenings with live music.

Camping by the river

A large number of the pitches at Camping La Plage are situated directly by the river. Ideal for water lovers. They are delimited and mostly shaded. There are also a few beautiful lodge tents for rent. The campsite is well organised. Above the bar is the sanitary facilities. It may look somewhat dated, but it is kept neat and tidy.

Swimming, fishing and canoeing

All visitors to Camping La Plage enjoy the river Cèze. Whether you like swimming, canoeing or fishing. There are pebble beaches near the campsite and there is a dam near the site. There are deeper stretches where you can swim, but also shallow stretches where the little ones can paddle and play safely. The water is beautifully clear! Would you like to rent canoes or kayaks? At the reception they will help you with this!

No animation, but cosiness

There is no special entertainment programme for the little ones, but there is plenty of fun. In high season there are cosy evenings with live music or a bouncy castle. There is also a playground and a recreation room with a billiard table, television and library. There is no swimming pool, but with all the water fun in and on the river this is not missed at all.

properties.name: Flower Camping Le Peyrelade
properties.description:
Le Peyrelade Flower Campsite is located in the south of France. You are here just outside the village of Rivière-sur-Tarn, about an hour-and-a-half's drive from Montpellier. The campsite is beautifully situated on the banks of the River Tarn. From the campsite, you can walk to the large pebble beach and the water.

Spacious campsites

The camping area slopes gently down to the river. Most of the sites are spacious and in the shade. There is little delineation in the form of hedges, but signs with numbers indicate the sites. If you come without camping equipment, you can stay in an accommodation. For example, there are nearly 50 caravans and 8 lodge tents.

Entertainment for the whole family

In high season, there is entertainment for campers of all ages. Then all kinds of games and sports tournaments organised. Small children easily make friends at the mini-club or on the playground.

After a day of games and sports, you must have gotten hungry. Time to grab a bite to eat at the campsite restaurant. There is also a pizza bar. In the on-site shop, you will find all the groceries to cook yourself a nice meal.

Swimming pool and river

With a beautiful competition pool and a children's pool full of play equipment, water fun is guaranteed at Camping Le Peyrelade. Swim, play and splash; it all happens here. Tired of all the exertion? Then book an hour in the hammam. The pebble beach on the Tarn and the river itself are also a great source of pleasure. Enjoy the sun while relaxing on a towel and watch the kayakers sail by. Or get out on the water yourself!

properties.name: Camping Yelloh! Village L'Oasis et California
properties.description:
Camping L'Oasis - California is a large family campsite close to the Mediterranean beach, just north of Perpignan. The large campsite offers a wide choice of shady or sunny touring pitches, as well as many different types of rental accommodation. The campsite is friendly and lively: every summer evening you can enjoy concerts and performances, while daytime entertainment activities are organised for young people.

Campsites with their own character

oth parts of the campsite have their own character. For example, the (often Mediterranean) vegetation on California is a little denser, so you can quickly find a camping spot in the shade. L'Oasis has a slightly more open character, which gives the campsite a spacious look. In addition to the touring pitches, you'll find many rental accommodation on the campsite, including mobile homes, lodge tents and hiker's huts.

Swimming park

After an extension, the swimming pool on the campsite can best be called a swimming park. Several swimming pools are situated at the front of the site, where you can let your children slide down one of the water slides while you lie in the sun on one of the sun loungers. One of the large swimming pools is especially for the youngest water lovers.

Le Barcarès on the Mediterranean

From the campsite entrance it is less than a kilometre walk to the beach. A small road brings you to the river Agly, which flows a few hundred metres into the Mediterranean Sea. The beach is on Le Barcarès. On the seaside resort's promenade you can grab a terrace or eat an ice cream, but you can also take a refreshing dip in the Mediterranean.

properties.name: Camping La Marjorie
properties.description:
Camping La Marjorie is located in the heart of the Jura, on the edge of the spa town of Lons-le-Saunier. You'll camp here at the foot of the Jura's high mountains, on a wooded campsite. Visit the centre of Lons-le-Saunier or explore the beautiful Jura with its cirque valleys and waterfalls.

The campsite is located at the foot of the Jura high mountains. You'll find the campsite on a sloping road north of the town, right on the edge of the built-up area.

Wooded campsite

There is room for two hundred touring pitches on the campsite. These are laid out with a maximum of six together on beautiful lawns, separated by hedges. The lawns are well-maintained and offer plenty of privacy.

If you want to be assured of complete peace and quiet, you can ask for a camping pitch a little further from the road. Apart from the touring pitches you have the possibility to camp in one of the chalets or lodge tents.

Swimming pool

Since 2019 the campsite has its own swimming pool. Extensive swimming is possible in the public swimming pool, 300 meters from the campsite. If you stay longer than five days, the entrance is free. On the campsite you will find a restaurant and a shop. The somewhat outdated sanitary facilities are cleaned three to four times a day.

Towns

There are many beautiful towns in the Jura. For example, you can be in Baume-les-Messieurs within a twenty-minute drive. In the valley you can visit waterfalls and caves. Another beautiful place is Château-Chalon. This village is situated on top of a mountain, in the middle of the vineyards.

properties.name: Camping de l'Ile Verte
properties.description:
The modest but very well maintained Camping de l’Ile Verte boasts a beautiful setting: on the bay of Mont Saint-Michel, some 30 km west of the famous tidal island. The campsite is quiet and modestly-sized and borders the friendly houses of Saint-Benoît-des-Ondes, a picturesque coastal town which is not only convenient for shopping, but also great to visit. The beach is a stone's throw away from the campsite.

Camping with children

The spacious pitches are all neatly maintained and separated by trimmed hedges. They are located on a fine grass surface. They all have a certain degree of privacy. The twenty-odd rental accommodation units are on a separate section. The chalets are modern in design (with small garden or veranda) and have a lovely kitchen. Your fellow campers are mostly young families. Hence there is a nice range of playground equipment for children.

Water!

The campsite has a medium-sized, heated swimming pool under a plexiglass tunnel cover. You can therefore also swim on a cool day. There is also a spacious toddler pool, complete with fun slides. Lovers of the sea only have to walk a few hundred metres. 

Enjoy eating oysters

The campsite has a basic eating establishment. Choose something nice from the small menu. The atmosphere is very amiable here, especially on the terrace! The mostly local specialities are tasty and very affordable. You will also find some nice restaurants in the village. Camping de l’Ile Verte does not have a shop, although fresh bread is available daily. In Cancale, at a distance of some 9 km, there is a large supermarket.

properties.name: Camping Le Moulin à Vent
properties.description:
South of the Luberon, 2 km from the village of Cucuron, lies campsite Le Moulin à Vent. From here you have a beautiful view of the mountains. The spacious campsite in natural setting can be found between vineyards and orchards and measures some 2.5 ha. There are many old oak trees on the grounds. The region is quite touristy with a large number of attractions and many small, characteristic Provençal villages.

Fresh breakfast

Le Moulin à Vent is a real nature campsite in a forest providing lots of shade. The pitches are spacious, not all the same size and laid out on terraces. The campsite does not have its own swimming pool; swimming is possible in the Étang de la Bonde lake, a few kilometres from the campsite. Coffee, bread and breakfast are available at reception. A caterer comes once a week.

Walking and cycling

You will find a great many signposted walking and cycling routes in the area, as well as the regional nature reserve Luberon, to the north of the campsite. A visit to one or more wineries surrounding the campsite is also a possibility, of course.

Surroundings

Camping Le Moulin à Vent would serve as an excellent base for a longer sojourn in the Provence. Its central location allows you to make day trips to several interesting sights before returning to the peace and quiet of Cucuron at the end of the day. You could, for instance, visit the flamingoes of the Camargue, the beaches of Calanques or the Gorges du Verdon.

properties.name: Camping L'Isle Verte
properties.description:
Camping L'Isle Verte is a beautifully located campsite, right on the banks of the Loire. The campsite is situated in the charming village of Montsoreau in Maine-et-Loire. This is a good starting point to visit the castles, caves and vineyards in the area. In addition, many cyclists use this campsite as a stopover. There are even special accommodations available for them.

Pitches with river view

Along the shore you will find a strip of camping pitches and accommodations. An attractive area with a view over the river at many places. Most of the touring pitches are neatly demarcated and therefore have a lot of privacy. In terms of rental accommodation, there are various types of mobile homes, chalets and lodge tents available. Special are the bivouac tents. These are built on poles and equipped with LED lighting, telephone charging systems and of course beds. Bivouac tents are rented out to cyclists who stay overnight at this campsite while taking the popular Loire à Vélo cycle route.

Swimming fun and creative entertainment

he swimming pool of this campsite is a nice place to take a refreshing dip. Because of the size of the pool it is also possible to swim laps. Enjoy the sun on the sunbeds around the pool. If you prefer to lie in the shade, just slide your sun bed under one of the parasols. In high season an entertainment team organises all kinds of fun activities.

Tasty dishes and local wines

The campsite has a pleasant restaurant where guests can enjoy tasty salads, sandwiches, pizzas and meat dishes. The accompanying pavement café is a pleasant place to stay. Once a week there is live music in the restaurant. Occasionally wine tastings are organised at the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Santa Marta
properties.description:
The terraced campsite Santa Marta in Cullera (Valencia) is situated directly by the sea in a lovely pine forest. From the campsite, you have access to wonderful sandy beaches, the Albufera nature park and picturesque villages in a wonderful Mediterranean climate. The hinterland is beautiful and invites you to take long hiking and cycling tours. The small camping pitches beneath the pine trees are designed for tents, and the larger pitches for caravans or campers. Bungalows are also available for rent.

Camping under the pine trees

The reception is based in a lovely, small building that blends in perfectly with the landscape. This is a wonderful campsite. The best pitches under the pine trees are designed for tents. The pitches are nicely separated by stones. The large pitches for caravans and campers are also suitable for campers who are staying for the preseason or winter in Spain.

Swimming pool and beach

The campsite features a large swimming pool in which you can swim lengths. It is surrounded by a terrace with loungers and sun umbrellas here and there. The wonderful sandy beach along the boulevard is less than 250 metres away.

Lovely time on the terrace

The campsite features a small shop with basic products only. There is also a cafeteria with a small terrace. Both are only open in the high season. But do not worry, along the boulevard there are plenty of restaurants and bars. There is no lack of shops in Cullera.

Sanitary facilities

The sanitary building is wonderfully integrated into the landscape, meaning that you might have to climb a hill or two to get there. The facilities are a model of cleanliness.

properties.name: Camping Lilybeo Village
properties.description:
The small campsite Lilybeo Village is situated on the west coast of Sicily, only 9 km from the lively town of Marsala. You are camping in peace and quiet in the shade of olive and pepper trees. The campsite is an ideal base to explore the western part of Sicily with its beautiful nature and centuries-old history.

Quiet and shaded

The grounds of this small-scale campsite are well maintained and the camping pitches look well cared for. There are cosy spots all over where you can pitch your tent or park your caravan, so that you have ample privacy. The best pitches, especially suitable for tents and small camper vans are to be found at the far end of the grounds. Here it is very quiet and shady. There are also new, beautiful rental bungalows on the campsite. 

Swimming under the stars

It can become pretty hot in the Sicilian sun. On such days, the swimming pool offers a refreshing respite from the sun. There is also a beautiful green lawn to relax on. The swimming pool is attractively illuminated in the evenings. You can therefore also swim under the stars. Romantic!

Shuttle bus to the beach

The campsite offers a free shuttle service in summer to the beach of Lido Signorino (3 km). More fun in the sun and water are available on the beautiful sandy beaches of Marsala.

Supermarket and bakery

No shop or catering facilities are available on the campsite. In the immediate vicinity of the campsite you will find a supermarket and a bakery, as well as a few bars and clubs where you can enjoy a quick meal.

properties.name: Camping Zwenzower Ufer
properties.description:
In the northern German Mecklenburg Lake District lies Camping Zwenzower Ufer. This quiet family campground is located directly on the Labussee and borders the village of Zwenzow. The campground extends along the lake shore. The pitches vary in size, but almost all have views over the water.

Camping by the water

Right on the road is the campsite reception building. Because the building is located on a hill, you immediately get a nice view of the campground. This extends along the lakeshore. There are pitches of different sizes where you can pitch your own tent or caravan. There are also some mobile homes for rent.

Campfire nights

In the campsite shop, you can get most of your daily groceries. There is also fresh bread every morning. You don't always have to cook yourself, because there is also a restaurant-snack bar with an (indoor) terrace. Make sure you have some space left in your stomach, because the campfire evenings that are regularly organised in the high season are very special. While enjoying some music, there is then also the space to roast some goodies on the fire yourself. In high season, there is also entertainment for the children once a week. On the other days, they can play by themselves in the playground or romp around by the water.

Water fun at the Labussee

Camping Zwenzower Ufer guarantees water fun. There are several jetties at the lake, so you can dive into the water for a swim anywhere. For the children, there is a small slide in the water.

properties.name: hu Firenze Certosa camping in town
properties.description:
hu Firenze Certosa camping is a large terraced campsite situated in the hilly Tuscan landscape. You camp here only ten kilometres from Florence. Although the campsite and its facilities are a bit cluttered, you will stay on a beautiful campsite: on the slope of a hill and among the trees. Because of its location, close to the motorway and the cultural city of Florence, this campsite is particularly suitable for city visits and as a transit campsite.

Camping against the slope

The campsite looks a bit cluttered, especially the back part. Nevertheless, you have beautiful place. The pitches, some shaded by trees, are spacious enough on their own, but offer little privacy. Despite the fact that the campsite consists of terraces, not all pitches are straight. When you come with caravan or camper, it is therefore important that you can correct this. The mobile homes are also situated against the slope.

City visitors and travellers

At Firenze Certosa camping mainly city visitors and holidaymakers who are travelling south, or coming from there. The campsite is less suitable for longer stays.

Cooling down

At the bottom of the hill, in the warm sun, are the two swimming pools. One of these pools is a paddling pool, so the children can have a nice bath here as well. Ideal to cool off after a tiring ride or a long day in Florence.

Pizzas and wine

At the front of the campsite you will find the restaurant and the shop. The pizzas in the restaurant are fine and the assortment in the shop is quite extensive. Of course you have a wide choice of good Tuscan wines.

properties.name: Landgoed Eysingastate
properties.description:
Landgoed Eysingastate is in the middle of the Frisian lake district, close to the village of Sint Nicolaasga. This holiday park is on a forested estate. It is surrounded by a typical Frisian polder landscape, where you can enjoy lovely walking and cycling trips. This campsite is highly popular among water sports enthusiasts. After all, from the harbours at the campsite you have an open sailing connection to the Langweerder Wielen and from there to other large Frisian lakes.

Two types of camping pitches and plenty of glamping options

If you want to book a camping pitch at Landgoed Eysingastate, you have two options. On the one hand, you could pick a standard camping pitch. These well-maintained touring pitches are by the restaurant, the swimming lake and one of the harbours. On the other, you can pitch on a nature camping pitch and then on the nature campsite on the other side of the road in the forest.

Landgoed Eysingastate also has lots to offer when it comes to glamping. You can, for example, stay in a luxury bungalow or holiday villa.

Jump in the swimming lake or go for a day of swimming in Swimfun

You can go for a lovely refreshing swim in the swimming lake. There is a sandy beach, grass meadow and beach showers by the lake. As a camping guest at Landgoed Eysingastate, you can also swim in a swimming pool. It is only a five-kilometre drive. The subtropical leisure pool Swimfun is in Joure. With a spectacular lazy river, a long water slide, a wave pool and a paddling pool, Swimfun guarantees a day filled with water fun!

properties.name: Vesterlyng Camping APS
properties.description:
At the Vesterlyng Strand, in the middle of a nature reserve, you'll find a dream spot overlooking the sea. Vesterlyng Camping, in Danish Seeland, is a family campsite located 800 metres from the beach.

Here you can camp on spacious pitches with a view of the sea.

Largest pool

The campsite has a swimming pool with a beautifully landscaped sunbathing area. The largest swimming pool, however, is just a few minutes' walk away: the sea!

The children can also climb in the playground, jump on the trampoline or help feed the farm animals each day. Tee off together on the mini golf course.

The campsite's sanitary facilities are beautifully tiled with neat washbasins. You can also enjoy a rainshower.

Vesterlyng Café

If you decide not to cook for yourself, you can eat out nearby. Vesterlyng Café is the 'place to be' and also offers take-away. You can get your groceries in the supermarket opposite the harbour. There is a walking/cycling path from the campsite to the harbour (2 km). You can also buy bread in the campsite shop.

From pure nature to Copenhagen

You can enjoy cycling and walking in the vicinity of the campsite. The campsite is located on the Kattegat. This is a mecca for watersports enthusiasts and fishermen. Take a ferry ride to one of the islands that you can see from Vesterlyng Strand.

It's also well worth taking a day trip to Copenhagen (92 km away), one of Europe's hippest cities. It's Tivoli Gardens amusement park is great fun for young and old alike.

properties.name: Mon Perin Camping Resort
properties.description:
This quiet campsite in Croatia, located on the Istrian peninsula, consists of two long properties, in the middle of a wide swathe of beautiful nature. They are connected by a foot and cycling path. Both properties are wooded, terraced and located right on the azure blue Adriatic Sea. The campsite is very well maintained, has a rural yet chic atmosphere, and thanks to its location, plenty of greenery.

Sleeping by the sea and in nature

The campsite has over four hundred touring pitches vary in size from 80 - 150 m2 and offer plenty or only some privacy. The campsite is a mix of older, smaller pitches and newer pitches. The pitches are divided into different categories. The most luxurious pitches have their own whirlpool or even a private barbecue, veranda, shower, drainage and a connection for satellite television.

In addition to camping pitches, there are also fully equipped mobile homes and luxury glamping villas available for rent. All accommodations offer first-class comfort and privacy.

Diving, sailing or swimming?

All pitches are not far from the beach. You'll be there in a flash via the paths. It is lovely to swim in the sea: there is hardly any current and the water is clear and clean. Spend time in the beach bar and let the children play in the nearby playground. They can also participate in the activities. For relaxation, there is a Wellness & Spa centre with heated outdoor and indoor swimming pools and saunas.

Terrace on the sea

Both properties have a few small shops and supermarkets (daily fresh bread available). The restaurants have regional dishes on the menu in addition to the regular ones. You'll eat on a terrace with a view of the sea.

properties.name: Verneda Camping Mountain Resort
properties.description:
In the impressive nature of the Catalan Pyrenees lies Camping Verneda, a campsite for seekers of peace and quiet and sporty campers. Go rafting or hiking (and skiing in winter) in the mountainous surrounding area or enjoy the tranquillity on the campsite. Camping Verneda is located in Val d’Aran, the northernmost region of Catalonia, in the heart of the Pyrenees. The beautiful area is excellent for challenging hikes and less difficult walks. Especially the National Park Aigüestortes, an hour's drive from the campsite, is a well-known hiking area.

Camping in summer and winter

The campsite is located on the Garona River between wooded mountains, and the campsite itself also has lots of greenery. The camping fields are separated by hedges and a large number of trees provide shade and demarcation.

Apart from camping in a tent, caravan or motorhome (Vernede is also a very convenient campsite for an overnight stop) you can rent wooden cottages and bungalows. Lovely accommodation for the summer, but especially in winter these rental houses have great charm and beauty. They are there for a reason, because Camping Verneda is a fantastic destination for a winter sports holiday in the Pyrenees.

Churches

Not only the nature of Val d'Aran is impressive. The number of churches in the area is also noteworthy. Because of the location of Val d'Aran, encapsulated by mountains, these romanesque churches, like the art in this region, have developed a character of their own. Definitely worth your while to visit a few of these churches in addition to the many hikes you will do.

properties.name: Houstrup Camping ApS
properties.description:
This rural area in the west of Denmark is ideal for a camping holiday with children in the midst of wide-open nature. In addition to wonderful cycling and walking opportunities, there is also plenty for children to do near the Houstrup Camping campsite. You can walk over to 'SeaWest' with the longest water slide in Denmark and a bowling alley. And for a walk on the North Sea beach, just grab your bike. The campsite's heated outdoor pool will be the highlight for water lovers young and old.

Camping in West Jutland

Via road 181, which runs from the south past the town of Esbjerg, you will reach the Houstrup Camping campsite. The small towns of Nørre Nebel and Houstrup are nearby, as is the coast. The building that houses the reception has a neat and tidy appearance, and that's where you will also find the shop, the snack bar and the terrace. All facilities, including the sports field and miniature golf course, are conveniently located together. One thing that strikes you as you walk across the medium-sized campsite is its peaceful and relaxed atmosphere.

Ample privacy

The spacious, demarcated pitches are a definite plus. The fairly high hedges provide separation and, of course, plenty of privacy. There are two sanitary buildings on the clearly laid-out, rectangular site, which look neat and clean. In addition to the many touring sites, there are also campers with permanent sites, mostly Danish families. For anyone without their own tent, caravan or motorhome, there are furnished hiker's huts that can accommodate up to four people.

properties.name: Camping Le Canigou
properties.description:
Camping Le Cangou is located between the villages of Prades and Vinca, about 50 kilometres to the west inland from the coastal city of Perpignan. The campsite is in the valley of the river Llech. Not a busy tourist trap, but peace and nature. Enjoy a view of the Pyrenees, the Pic du Canigou and the nature reserve around the campsite. The campsite has a natural water basin in the Llech as a swimming pool. A special experience!

Camping among the cherry trees

You'll drive on the paved roads to the property and your pitch. The pitches are not exceptionally large and vary in the amount of shade. You need a hammer to pound the stakes into the ground, as it is very hard. Delineation of the pitches is natural here, as there are many trees (primarily cherry trees) and bushes. Camping Le Canigou also offers seventeen accommodations for hire.

Natural swimming pool

You swim here in the water of the Llech! This river is safely dammed: so you are swimming in a natural swimming pool. Wonderfully refreshing, with crystal clear water. You can go canyoning in the Llech. This sport is a combination of all types of things: hiking, climbing, jumping, swimming and absailing. Also fun: in the high season there is a large climbing course set up on the campsite.

Long live the chef

The restaurant on the campsite has a fantastic cook. Sometimes there are theme evenings organised. There is also a charming little bar. The campsite shop stocks a reasonable selection. Need more? Jump in the car and go to the supermarket in Prades (seven kilometres away).

properties.name: Camping du Vieux Verger
properties.description:
Camping du Vieux Verger is situated in Brittany, in the south of the Finistère peninsula. This campsite lives up to its name: you camp here between fruit trees. The orchard and the authentic farmhouse which houses the reception, radiate tranquillity. This small-scale campsite is basic, but beautifully laid out and lovingly tended.

Camping in the orchard

The campsite is divided into two sections, which are separated from each other by a garden and a ruin. If you have young children, choose a spot in the section adjacent to the swimming pool. If you stay in the other section, you have to walk along the road to get to the swimming pool. The pitches are level, spacious and green in both sections. 

Here and there, the pitches are separated from each other by hedges, flowering shrubs, trees and fences. Camping du Vieux Verger mainly focuses on tourist campers: there are only four permanent camping pitches as opposed to one hundred tourist pitches. In addition, there are several beautiful mobile homes and one apartment for hire. 

Family campsite

You are here on a real family campsite, perfect for young families. Quiet and small-scale, but with a lovely swimming pool. The gorgeous swimming pool takes this orchard campsite to a higher level. The swimming pool is fenced in and heated. There is also a separate toddler pool with a fun water sprayer: ideal for young children. There is also a triple water slide. 

On the coast

Only a fifteen-minute walk separates you from a swim in the sea, with the beach less than one km away from the campsite. The coastline here is very jagged, with splendid white sandy beaches located between the cliffs of the rocky shore.

properties.name: Camping Les Flamants Roses
properties.description:
Camping Les Flamants Roses is an oasis of tranquillity in the midst of the lively coastal resorts along the coast of the Eastern Pyrenees Region. You will be camping right next to a bird-watcher’s paradise named Etang de Canet ou de Saint-Nazaire, which is where the name of the campsite, The Pink Flamingos, comes from. Pink accents can be found everywhere in the campsite, like the water slides in the water park with a heated swimming pool, and in the playground and climbing park.

A warm welcome

When you enter the campsite, you will notice the well-maintained greenery, which creates a pleasant atmosphere. The reception is housed in a beautiful country house that makes you feel welcome.

There is a separate section for pitches, and luxury mobile homes are available for rent. The pitches at the campsite are spacious and bordered with hedges that provide privacy. The green between the pitches contribute to the tranquillity.

Heated swimming pool

The heated swimming pool at the campsite is a real eye-catcher, beautifully designed with pink sun loungers that look over the water. Camping Les Flamants Roses has many sports activities such as climbing, archery and tree climbing. There is a miniclub with entertainment in the evening.

Culture and nature are near

From the campsite you can cycle onto two beautiful paths to, for example, the beach (only seven kilometres away). For the adventurous, there are various activities in the surrounding area, such as the Tour de Madeloc, which is a popular hiking and cycle route.

properties.name: Flower Camping Les Tomasses
properties.description:
Camping les Tomasses is located on the border of the quiet Provence and the more busy Côte d’Azur. You can enjoy the lovely location and the charm of both areas while camping. Enjoy your stay on this French nature campsite with swimming pool, in the midst of trees and quiet. At the same time, you'll be close to the many tourist attractions in the region.

Welcome to the green campsite

The camping area makes a pleasant and amiable impression. It won't be long before you feel right at home. The area is comprehensive and contains a range of shaded areas with plenty of forestation. The flat camping pitches are spacious and laid out playfully. All pitches are surrounded by shrubs, giving you the privacy you need. Alongside camping pitches, Les Tomasses also features rental accommodation.

Versatile entertainment for the whole family

Both children and adults will have enough to entertain them at Les Tomasses. There is also a refreshing swimming pool with kid's pool. There is an amusement programme for children during the high season. Treasure hunts along with sports tournaments, mini discos and song and dance events are organised on a regular basis.

Hospitality and sanitary facilities

This campsite features a small snack bar with terrace. You can buy pizzas, simple meals and ice creams here. Camping guests can also order bread for the following morning. The rest of the shopping can be done in the village, two kilometres away. Larger supermarkets are around five kilometres away. The Les Tomasses sanitary facilities have been recently (2018) renovated.

properties.name: Parc de Loisirs Le Val Fleuri
Långasjönäs Camping & Stugby
properties.description:
In the Blekinge region, known for its largest number of sunshine hours in Sweden, lies Långasjönäs Camping & Stugby in the heart of the nature reserve of the same name. This nature reserve is characterised by beautiful landscapes and old ruins. If you like tranquillity and nature, this is the place for you.

Camping on Lake Långasjönäs

At Långasjönäs Camping & Stugby you can choose between a pitch in the sun or in the shade. There are separate pitches for campers with a caravan, motorhomes and tent campers. The pitches are all fairly spacious and beautifully laid out. This campsite offers you a splendid view of Lake Långasjönäs.

You can also rent one of the fifty cottages. These look very cheerful due to their mostly red colours. Almost all of them overlook the lake. They are basic, but above all comfortably furnished.

Exploring nature

Around Lake Långasjönäs you will find several beaches. The largest beach (and warmest of the entire Blekinge region) is located near the campsite. You can experience the beauty of the nature reserve in many ways. Walk on one of the many paths or get on your bicycle to experience nature. You can also rent boats to enjoy the surroundings from the water.

Freshly baked waffles on the terrace

There is a small kiosk where you can get some basic supplies. In Karlshamn, at a distance of some 5 km, you will find a large supermarket. The café-restaurant of the campsite overlooks the lake. Sit down on the terrace and enjoy a cup of coffee and a freshly baked waffle. The restaurant offers various dishes, bread rolls and snacks.

properties.name: Camping 't Weergors
properties.description:
Campsite 't Weergors is located in Hellevoetsluis in Zuid-Holland, near the Haringvliet. On this family campsite, laid out around an old farmhouse, you camp on a spacious terrain or in one of the special rental accommodations. The campsite is an ideal base for trips to the beach or to Hellevoetsluis.

Special camping

There are a hundred touring pitches on large lawns, separate from the permanent pitches. The open character of the campsite gives you a feeling of freedom and spaciousness, although you have a little less privacy. Especially in the low season there is plenty of space and an open view.

Camping ’t Weergors also offers more special accommodations. Apart from the usual mobile homes and chalets, the campsite has a wooden igloo and gypsy caravan for rent. But also the Dijkwachterslodge is special. This fully equipped cottage (including sauna) is situated on top of the dike and offers a panoramic view over the water and the surroundings.

Entertainment for children

Different playgrounds are scattered over the campsite: on the right side of the campsite there is a natural playground, and close to the restaurant you'll find the large playground. There you'll also find a hangout for the youth and an amusement arcade for entertainment when the weather is bad.

Cycling, hiking and fishing

If you want to discover more of Voorne-Putten, it's best to do so by bike. There is an extensive network of cycling routes waiting for you. Of course you can also explore the area on foot. There is a tenniscourt to enjoy if you prefer to stay at the campsite. A fishing pond, located right next to the campsite provides a calm and relaxing way of entertainment.

properties.name: AZUR Waldcamping Ingolstadt
properties.description:
On the outskirts of Bavarian Ingolstadt and close to the motorway, yet delightfully surrounded by greenery, is AZUR Waldcamping Ingolstadt. Located on the shores of Lake Auwaldsee, this peaceful campsite is the perfect base for a relaxing holiday in southern Germany. Here you will enjoy the best of both worlds: peace and nature by the water, as well as the liveliness of the city within cycling distance (5 km).

Comfortable overnight stay in a pod

The campsite has a friendly, simple atmosphere and is popular with peace-seekers, cyclists and nature lovers. It is also ideal as a transit campsite. You camp on spacious, open pitches in green surroundings. Early in the morning, you can spot lots of wild rabbits. Don’t have your own camping equipment? Then there are also 'camping pods', camping barrels and, for active campers, bike lodges for rent. These cosy accommodations will make your holiday complete.

Swimming, sunbathing and hiking around the lake

The best thing about AZUR Waldcamping Ingolstadt is of course the lake. Here you can swim or sunbathe on the grass in summer. This is also a nice place for a quiet walk or a picnic. The campsite also organises special fishing days for fishing enthusiasts.

At the lake's edge, you can rent boats. Great for a nice trip on the water. Close to the lake is a playground, where children will have a great time. And those who fancy an ice cream or a cooling drink can visit the simple kiosk on site. On the campsite, you will also find a mini golf course, a table tennis table and a tennis court.

properties.name: Camping Les 2 Vallées
properties.description:
Only a stone's throw from the Cévennes National Park you'll find the small campsite Les 2 Vallées. Here you're in an area with many forests near the charming village of Nant. A stream flows along the campsite. The campsite is very suitable for seekers of peace and quiet and for families with (small) children.

Green hills

The campsite has many trees and shades and offers a view of the green rolling hills around it. In some places you have a lovely view of Beynac Castle. A little stream runs along the property, as well as a train track, and on the property itself there is a fish pond. 

The pitches are located in rows along paved roads. The pitches are reasonably large, demarcated with low hedges and well maintained. You can choose a spot with (some) shade or in the full sun. Want to hire something? Book one of the many mobile homes or bungalows. 

Intimate swimming pool

The rectangular swimming pool is intimate and has loungers with thatched parasols around it, and is a great spot to cool off and get some peace and quiet. There is a fence around the swimming pool, so that the little ones in the nearby playground cannot fall into the water. 

Entertainment

Children can play in the playground (with teeter totters, swings and a table tennis table). There is also (English) children's entertainment. But you can have hours of fun at the jeu-de-boules pitch, the outdoor fitness equipment and on the volleyball court.

Snack bar with terrace

There is a snack bar with a little terrace on the campsite. You can also get take-away meals. There is also fresh bread available every day.

properties.name: HolaCamp Mequinenza
properties.description:
HolaCamp Mequinenza is in the Spanish region of Aragón, close to the Catalonia border. This campsite is ideal for campsite visitors who prefer peace and quiet and require little entertainment. You camp right next to the Segre river with a view of the water. A quiet road runs between the campsite and the water. A ten-minute walk will take you to the centre of the historic village of Mequinenza, where there are several small restaurants and a supermarket. The surrounding area has many walking tours and spots where you can fish.

Camping with river views

Many pitches and glamping accommodations have a view of the Segre river. You camp on clearly demarcated grassy pitches. Standard pitches are 60 m2 and comfort pitches are 90 m2. If you prefer a little more luxury, you can stay in a glamping tent. Some tents are equipped with a small kitchen. The campgrounds also have a hostel. As a campsite visitor, you may use the facilities in the hostel, such as the kitchen and the recreational area.

Swim in the municipal swimming pool

HolaCamp Mequinenza is ideal for those wanting some peace and quiet during their holiday. There is a small playground and a playing field for the children. The river is easily accessible from the campsite and is suitable for anyone wanting to fish. If you want to cool off during your holiday in Spain, go for a refreshing swim in the municipal swimming pool, right next to the campsite. As a guest, you can swim there for free. While swimming in the water, you have a beautiful view of the river.

properties.name: Domaine du Château
properties.description:
Domaine du Château is located in the hilly and water-rich Vosges mountains, an area perfect for hiking and mountain bike tours. The medieval centre of Epinal is located a half an hour's walk from the campsite. You reach the centre via a lovely route through a park, where you'll see the famous castle.

Blooming bushes and deciduous trees

The partially flat and partially rolling terrain is shadowy and planted with blooming bushes and deciduous trees. The spacious pitches are laid out in rows on lawns or gravel. The paths are paved. There is also a choice of various rental accommodation.

Take a dip

The elegant swimming pool has lovely round shapes. There is also a jacuzzi and separate kiddie pool. A pergola and decorative stones around the property make it a contiguous whole. Plop down into one of the loungers and work on your tan! The covered terrace of the restaurant is next to the swimming pool. In the high season the owners come by with a slice of melon or another snack.

Animal garden and playground

There are provisions for bad weather with a TV on the Domaine du Château. Next to the campsite there is a lovely park with a zoo and a playground.

Tasty dishes

In the charming camping restaurant you can have a meal, but also order a snack. The decor is charming thanks to the lovely atmospheric lighting. On the terrace there are a few picnic tables where you can eat and drink. On the campsite you can also shop in the small shop with fresh bread every day. There is a larger supermarket 10 minutes drive away.

properties.name: Flower Camping Le Mas de Mourgues
properties.description:
Camping Le Mas de Mourgues is a small-scale attractive campsite near the village of Vauvert in the Herault, a lovely area for some nice trips. Explore nature or visit a historic town or village. The nearby nature reserve, the Camargue, is renowned for its large number of bird species. Wild horses and bulls are also well represented in the marshy nature reserve. Le Mas de Mourgues is a family campsite with several fields, an abundance of flowers and a small swimming pool.

Cosy campsite with different pitches

On the attractive campsite you have a choice of different open fields, all looking beautiful and well maintained. Some pitches with more shade than the next. In high season it is a real family campsite and in low season it is mainly frequented by senior citizens who like walking or cycling.

Happy hour

The small swimming pool is centrally located on the grounds. You can swim at a beach some 10 km away. The camping shop and bar are basic, but sitting on the terrace with a view of the campsite is enjoyable. They also have happy hour at 18h00 each afternoon! You can do your shopping some 4 km away. There are two sanitary buildings with vegetation on the roof. The sanitary facilities look neat and are currently being renovated. 

Cultural and sporty outings

From the campsite you can, for instance, cycle to Aigues-Mortes, a historic fortified town, the former point of departure of the crusades. Day trips to Arles (tip: weekends are very busy) or Montpellier are also recommended.

properties.name: Camping Le Vaurette
properties.description:
Campsite Le Vaurette is located on the northern bank of the Dordogne, near the village of Argentat. From the green campsite you have a view of the wooded hills, which border the Dordogne valley. Many Dutch campers will find a camping spot directly by the river or closer to the hills. The Dordogne is a source of entertainment for young and old.

At the small reception, which is next to a attractive bar, you will probably be welcomed by the daughter of the Dutch owner. Although she was born and raised in France, she speaks Dutch pretty well.

Camping on the Dordogne

The gently flowing Dordogne on one side, hills covered with forests on the other: the campsite Le Vaurette is situated on a beautiful spot in the Corrèze. There is a wide variety of touring pitches. They are all spacious and have a well-maintained grass surface, but the view from the pitches is different everywhere. From some places you look out over the fields. Other touring pitches are in the shade of tall trees, which form the beginning of the surrounding hills. You can also camp directly on the Dordogne, under low hanging trees.

Swimming pool

The swimming pool is surrounded by shrubs and the benevolent green of the wooded hills, but is itself in a sunny spot. The whole family can enjoy a cool dip here: children splash around in the spacious paddling pool or the shallow part of the pool, while the parents can also sunbathe in a deck chair. The area is beautifully decorated with rocks, thatched parasols and flowers.

properties.name: Camping Les 2 Lacs
properties.description:
Camping Les 2 Lacs is a small-scale campsite on the edge of the old village of Beauville, in the hilly countryside of the Lot-et-Garonne department. The campsite is situated on two lakes. In one lake you can swim and canoe to your heart's content, in the other you can fish. Les 2 Lacs is a friendly family campsite.

You'll find the campsite in the rolling countryside, just outside the old village of Beauville. If you drive via the D656 from Cahors to Agen, you will see the campsite on the right side of the road a few hundred meters after Beauville. A long driveway brings you to the camping. At the reception building you will be welcomed by the Dutch owner, who knows everything about the area.

Kids club and paintball

In high season, Les 2 Lacs campsite is perfect for families. The youngest can join the mini-club. Older children can spend an afternoon playing paintball. In the smallest lake there are separate areas for swimming and canoeing.A heated swimming pool is also located here. In the largest lake there are many pike and carp that you can catch without a fishing license.

Wooded campsite

The wooded campsite has room for fifty touring pitches and eleven rental accommodations. The touring pitches are beautifully landscaped between hedges. The sanitary facilities look good and are well cleaned. The campsite has a restaurant with a bar. Here you can get snacks, pizzas and takeaway meals. The restaurant is also the centre of sociable evenings with karaoke or dance parties.

properties.name: Sites & Paysages Domaine Catinière
properties.description:
The quiet and friendly campsite Domaine Catinière is situated in a green area near the village of Fiquefleur. At a distance of only 5 kilometres, you will find the picturesque town of Honfleur.

A small river flows through the campsite, which is located at the foot of a hill. The spacious pitches on the campsite (100 m2) are separated by green hedges and are positioned along pebbled streets. You can choose between a pitch with lots or with little shade or a pitch in an open field. Here you have a free view of the petting zoo. There are rental mobile homes and tents without sanitary facilities on this (5.5 ha) campsite.

Petting zoo and heated swimming pool

This is a favourite place for families with small children. There is a playground with playground equipment, a trampoline, a jumping pillow and a petting zoo with chickens, donkeys, sheep and goats. An entertainment programme for children is available in peak season. Activities for teenagers and adults are also organised. Near the entrance, you will find a heated swimming pool (84 m2) with water slides, water walking balls, an inflatable giraffe and a toddler pool.

Small campsite shop

The small campsite shop stocks basic groceries, regional products and fresh bread. There are several large supermarkets in the vicinity. The restaurant has a limited menu. You can also get snacks and takeaway meals here.

Dance evenings

Various activities are organised in the bar on a regular basis: bingo, dance evenings, shows and karaoke. The partly covered terrace of the bar overlooks the pétanque pitch. Additionally, you can play basketball, soccer, table tennis and make use of the fitness equipment. There are signposted walking routes in the vicinity.

properties.name: Camping Les Pommiers d'Aiguelèze
properties.description:
Camping Les Pommiers d'Aiguelèze is a friendly family campsite in the Tarn department, about twenty kilometres west of ancient Albi. From your shady pitch on the campsite it's only a five minute walk to the river Tarn, where you can take a boat or canoe out on the water.

Shady pitches

A little over fifty touring pitches have been created on the well-kept campsite. These pitches are often shaded by shrubs and trees, which provide delimitation and privacy. The newer part of the campsite has a more open character: here the planting is still quite young, the pitches are less shaded. With an added thirty rental accommodations, campsite Les Pommiers d'Aiguelèze is quite small.

On or near the Tarn

Only a few hundred meters walk and you're standing on the river Tarn. This name giver of the department meanders from Albi along the campsite in the direction of Gaillac. Not far from the campsite there is a small harbour, from where you can navigate the wide river by boat, canoe or pedal boat. The river is also suitable for various water sports. Also on the campsite you can enjoy the water; the swimming pool is located on the edge of the campsite, behind the restaurant with the pavement café.

A local wine at the pavement café

Colourful bistro chairs under the trees, a local wine on the table; a perfect wayto enjoy the warm summer evenings. On Sundays you can participate in the ‘table d’hôte’ for a very reasonable price.

properties.name: Camping Le Malazéou
properties.description:
The southern French family camping Le Malazéou is situated in the Pyrenees, along the access road to Health Spa Ax-les-Thermes. In winter the ski areas are nearby, in summer the area offers excellent walking opportunities. Here you will find peace and quiet, the historic Cathar region and the access road to Andorra and Spain. An ideal region for numerous outdoor sports.

Wooded terrain

The mostly flat, wooded terrain lies between the foothills of the Pyrenees. The shallow, fast-flowing river Ariège flows adjacent to the campsite and a small creek winds its way through the grounds. The grounds are well-kept. The sizes of the pitches vary and depend on the size of your camping equipment. You can choose between a spot in the sun or in a (partly) shaded area. The tent pitches are located on the hill. Do you prefer rental accommodation? You have a choice of 73 mobile homes.

Outdoor swimming pool

The heated outdoor swimming pool is surrounded by greenery: a combination of trees and hedges. You will find loungers and some sun umbrellas around the pool. The swimming pool is not very large but is to the liking of most guests.

Outdoor adventure sports

Facilities include an outdoor playground, a sauna with steam bath, a fitness area and fitness track, two beautiful jeu de boules pitches, a brand new mini-golf course and bad-weather facilities. There are activities for children and an entertainment programme for adults. Do you love the outdoors? The area offers ample opportunity for outdoor activities: walking, mountain biking, bicycle racing, horse riding, climbing, paragliding, canyoning, canoeing and rafting are all possible.

Friendly restaurant

You can enjoy delicious French regional dishes in the cosy restaurant. The campsite also offers a bread service on request.

properties.name: Camping Marmotel
properties.description:
In the southern French Aveyron, on the banks of the Lot River, lies Camping Marmotel. Bordering two nature parks and surrounded by rolling hills and lots of greenery, this is a wonderful place for nature lovers. The family campsite offers rental accommodations and spacious camping sites, mostly in the shade. There are also spots with private sanitary facilities. Many amenities can be found in the village of Saint-Geniez-d'Olt.

Shade and private sanitary facilities
