Camping Marmotel looks well maintained. At the front of the site, the mobile homes and chalets are located. Further on are the camping pitches and at the very back – towards the river – there is a new section with many pitches including private sanitary facilities. The pitches are spacious and benefit from the shelter of trees. All the pitches are situated on a grassy field, and a one-and-a-half metre high hedge provides sufficient privacy.

Hit the dance floor

In the village of Saint-Geniez-d'Olt, you will find most of the amenities you could need, such as a supermarket and some restaurants. Still, there is more than enough to do at the campsite itself. For example, you can visit a restaurant-snack bar with a large terrace. For the children, there is a fun playground. In the high season, the entertainment team organises many activities for young and old. For example, there are sports tournaments during the day, and the evenings are filled with dancing, karaoke or quizzes.

Swimming, sliding and sunbathing

From the terrace, you can already see the heated outdoor pool. The swimming pool catches the sun and is surrounded by a generous sunbathing area. For real water fun, there is a slide, and for the little campers, there is a paddling pool. You can also entertain yourself on and in the river.

properties.name: Camping Beau Rivage du Lac de Pareloup
properties.description:
On the Lac de Pareloup, a reservoir in the southern French department of Aveyron, you’ll find camping Sites & Paysages Beau Rivage. The landscape here is formed by rock plateaus and wooded hills. The campsite is situated against the hillside. From the well-maintained, shady terraces you have a beautiful view over the lake, a water sports paradise for surfers, water skiers and sailors.

Lake view

A small road leads down to the terraced campsite. Between well-maintained hedges are over fifty touring pitches. These pitches have a lot of privacy and trees provide shady spots. But the biggest plus is the view: from almost every pitch you look out over the vast lake.

The rental accommodations, especially mobile homes and chalets, are also situated on beautifully tended lawns and in the shade of trees. And from these spots the view over the water is also beautiful.

Lac de Pareloup

The first thing you encounter when you reach the campsite is the swimming pool. Especially for younger children who can already swim this pool is fun. Luckily the Lac de Pareloup with its 12.6 km2 is big enough for everyone. Via stone steps you can walk from the campsite to the sandy beach.

Water sports

Part of the lake is cordoned off for swimmers. Especially popular with the older youth is the floating trampoline, which forms an island where you can sunbathe and of course you can jump off. Outside the swimming area, Lac de Pareloup is a water sports paradise. Surfing, water-skiing, sailing: it's all possible.

properties.name: Flower Camping du Lac de la Chausselière
properties.description:
On a large lake in the Vendée, five kilometres from Montaigu and half an hour's drive from Puy du Fou, you’ll find Flower Camping du Lac de la Chausselière. Here you can camp in a landscape with vast fields. Go for one of the green touring pitches or choose a separate rental accommodation by the lake. The campsite is suitable for families with children, who can take a dip in the pool, but also for those looking for peace and quiet. On the shores of the lake you can enjoy peaceful fishing.

Camping near the water

The campsite is situated in a quiet area directly on the water. Well-paved paths lead to the eighty spacious to very spacious touring pitches with a grassy ground and the thirty rental accommodations. Both the touring pitches and the accommodations are delimited by green hedges, so you will always find a pitch with privacy.

Chalets and tipi tent

Modern chalets and lodge tents are close to or near the water. Nice are the wooden chalets on legs, situated in a group near a small pond. And don't forget the tipi tent, furnished with a stove and a bedroom on the first floor. All accommodations are well-maintained and look neat.

Heated swimming pool

On the campsite you will find families with children as well as couples of all ages. Especially the indoor swimming pool, directly behind the restaurant, is popular with younger camping guests. The pool has a maximum depth of one and a half metres, so it is particularly suitable for the slightly older children. Of course adults can also swim here. Do take your Speedo with you, because you are not allowed into the water with swimming shorts.

properties.name: Camping Ferme Pédagogique de Prunay
properties.description:
Camping-Ferme de Prunay is a quiet, child-friendly campsite in the Loire Valley, amidst agricultural fields. You camp on very spacious touring pitches in an orchard or on open lawns, with a view of the vast surroundings. The campsite is very child friendly. With educational activities in the summer - a visit to the petting zoo and donkey rides - the youngest camping guests will have the holiday of a lifetime. If you love splendour, visit one of the many castles on the Loire.

View of endless fields

On Camping Ferme de Prunay you'll camp on a wooded campsite. Especially the middle area is shady; here you camp in an orchard. The touring pitches on the outside are very open and spacious, and offer a view of the endless fields. Besides about 70 touring pitches (which differ in size, but are all very spacious) you can camp in a gypsy caravan, a modern bungalow tent or one of the chalets.

Outdoor pool and Tiki Bar

An hour splashing in the water? The outdoor swimming pool at the campsite is ready for it. You'll find the swimming pool near the entrance, in a sunny spot. It's not too big, but the children don't care about that. Drying up in the sun can be done on a lounger at the edge of the pool.

Or take an ice cream or drink on the terrace of the Tiki Bar. This bar is located under the roof of one of the authentic buildings next to the pool. Weather permitting, the covered terrace is extended outside the canopy and you can sit nicely among the trees.

properties.name: Camping Paradis Domaine de Bellevue
properties.description:
A quiet, beautifully landscaped campsite in the rolling countryside of the Vendée, that's Domaine de Bellevue. The spacious grounds are well-maintained. You'll find spacious pitches, neat facilities and several beautiful fishing ponds. The campsite mainly consists of rental accommodations and permanent, but there are also touring pitches.

Verdant, spacious pitches

The campsite is situated on a large domain of about thirteen hectares. The campsite is very spacious, with larger than average pitches and wide gravel paths. The pitches are laid out on largely flat lawns, delimited by hedges, deciduous trees and flowering shrubs. Some of the pitches are located directly on the banks of natural ponds.

Heated swimming pools

Directly behind the reception and the restaurant are the heated swimming pools. There is a large swimming pool with a glass sliding roof and a water slide. There is also a balneo pool especially for adults. Next to it the spacious paddling pool with a water playground is wonderful for little children. But being in the Vendée, you can also go to the sea. By car you can reach the beach of (for example) Saint-Hilaire-de-Riez in less than half an hour.

Neat facilities

The restaurant and supermarket of Domaine de Bellevue are only open in July and August. The bar is a little longer (March to October). The assortment in the shop is very limited. You can do your shopping in the village of Saint-Christophe-du-Ligneron, two kilometres from the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Nostradamus
properties.description:
Camping Nostradamus, less than ten km away from the town of Salon-de-Provence, is located in an oasis of green along a water channel. The campsite is surrounded by quiet, agricultural areas. The elongated campsite tapers to a tip, but the pitches are exceptionally spacious and at the back there is an area specially allocated to tents. The campsite, because of its many ancient trees, creates a green and pleasant impression. These trees provide ample shade, no unnecessary luxury in the Provence during summer...

‘Slow camping’

You will receive a warm and personal welcome in the modest reception. Near the reception is a terrace where drinks and snacks are served. You can also find tourist information here about the region. The campsite profiles itself as a 'slow campsite' where conviviality and peacefulness are the prime focus.

Accommodation with ambiance

At Camping Nostradamus you can rent one of the two mobile homes, one of which accommodates up to five persons and the other one a maximum of six persons. If you want to experience a real French atmosphere, you can rent the gîte La Balladine. The gîte is suitable for up to four persons.

Attractive swimming pool and pizzeria

In addition to a lovely terrace, the campsite also has a simple, but nicely designed swimming pool to cool down. Swimming in the canal is dangerous because of the fast-flowing water.

The campsite does not have a fully-fledged restaurant, but has a good pizzeria instead. However, in France you never have to search long for an eating establishment and in Salon-de-Provence you will find a wealth of great places to eat. There are also supermarkets and other shops.

properties.name: Camping Grosswalsertal
properties.description:
This campsite is located in the middle of the beautiful Großes Walsertal biosphere reserve in the mountainous western region of Austria. This is a quiet area with no mass tourism. It is ideal for nature lovers and hiking enthusiasts. Grosswalsertal Campsite is also in a great spot with fantastic hiking trails in the immediate vicinity. You'll enjoy a spectacular view of the surrounding mountain landscape from every vantage point at this friendly family campsite.

Open camping field with beautiful grass pitches

The reception is in a large log cabin. Owners Anita and Sigmar will offer you a warm welcome. You will find immaculately maintained grass pitches at this campsite. You also have a beautiful view of the surrounding area from all pitches. There is a steep drop off at the edge of this open terrain. You can also rent a luxury flat of at least 70 square metres here.

Please be aware: when the campsite is very busy, campers are asked to park their car in the parking lot in front of the campsite. This helps maintain the peace and tranquillity of the campsite.

Relax in the heated pool

The campsite has a basic rectangular swimming pool. This is the ideal place to freshen up and relax after a nice day of walking. The water is heated to a pleasant temperature by means of solar energy. There are also several larger indoor and outdoor swimming pools in the area. You can also go swimming in natural waters, of course. One of the best places to do that is the idyllic Lake Seewaldsee near Fontanella.

properties.name: Alpenresort Eienwäldli Engelberg
properties.description:
Camping Eienwäldli is situated in the heart of the Alps, in the town of Engelberg. This means: green, high mountains, lakes, fresh air, walking (and in winter skiing, of course). From the campsite you have a splendid view on the mountains on all sides. This charming campsite is a wonderful place for families, sports enthusiasts and active holiday makers. The campsite also serves as a hotel with extensive wellness facilities.

Pitches

The campsite is quite touristy, both in summer and winter, and therefore has paved camping pitches at the front part of the campsite. Smaller camper vans and tents are allocated pitches on the second part of the grounds, on grass. The sizes of the pitches vary: they are more generous on the lawn. The campsite is surrounded by high mountains, therefore you cannot rely on the sun at all times. You can also rent rooms in the hotel.

Sports and wellness

The hotel has a heated indoor pool (with water chute and toddler pool). The campsite is focused on the sporty holiday maker and offers excursion programmes, guided walking tours and cycle routes. You can also get busy climbing, mountain biking, skiing, paragliding or play golf. There is an entertainment programme for children.

Do your own cooking?

You do not have to do your own cooking because you have a choice between delicious food from the snack bar, pizzeria and two restaurants (one with a small menu and one with a more extensive menu). You can also enjoy a meal in one of the many restaurants in Engelberg; Eienwäldli guests are provided with a bus pass for free transport to Engelberg and back.

Sanitary facilities

The sanitary facilities deserve praise. They are spacious, luxurious and heated.

properties.name: Camping de Courte Vallée
properties.description:
The Courte Vallée campsite is a small campsite with British owners on the edge of the medieval Airvault, in the western region of Poitou-Charentes. The campsite, which is extremely clean and friendly, is a great stopover campsite, and a good base to visit the French countryside and the surrounding towns and villages.

Lots of destinations

This campsite is on a quiet spot on the Thouet river, in the village of Airvault (the church here is a nice place to visit). There are many iconic places to visit nearby: Poitiers, Thouars, Chinon and Parthenay. If you want a day out with the kids, then the Futuroscope and Puy de Fou theme parks are good destinations. Despite the fact that this campsite is in the French countryside, and away from the main tourist routes, there's plenty to do in the vicinity. And you can be sure of a welcoming reception here. The British owners attach a lot of importance to a friendly and informal atmosphere. The grounds are green and exude tranquillity. This is partly due to the well-kept lawns, and the exceptionally generous pitches.

British hospitality

Many campers think it's an advantage that there isn't any organised entertainment at the Courte Vallée campsite. There is a heated outdoor pool, playground, table tennis table and jeu de boules area, so there's plenty to do. And of course, there's plenty of British hospitality. For example, barbecues, quiz and music nights are organised at the Bistro on the campsite. Everything is family-oriented and small-scale. For the gourmands, there are also evenings with speciality menus and wine tastings, and there are organised vineyard tours as well.

properties.name: Jägersbo Camping
properties.description:
In the town of Höör, in the heart of the southern province of Skåne, you'll find the Jägersbo campsite on Lake Ringsjön. The campsite is spacious and the campsites are right on the water. The trees on the property create shade, without disrupting the view. The lake lures you out for a swim, to get out in a boat (canoes and row boats are rented at the reception) and to fish.

Tent, hut or cabin

The campsites are not separated from each other, but the minimum distance is 4 metres, so that privacy is guaranteed, even in the high season. This typical Scandinavian campsite has trekker huts, luxury holiday homes and also, naturally, a sauna.

At the reception there is a restaurant in the high season. There is a little shop open year-round for daily shops. The permanent pitches and the rental accommodations are located in a separate part of the campsite.

Variety

A large number of campsite guests are Swedish families who often stay for a longer period. Foreign guests are usually passing through. The campsite attracts many active guests (water sports enthusiasts, anglers, hikers and cyclists). The varied landscape attracts nature lovers with the nearby Söderåsen national park.

Dining and music

The restaurant is located in the reception building, but Jägersbo Nöjesrestaurang doesn't just offer dining. During the summer season, artists regularly perform to entertain the guests. The restaurant also provides freshly baked rolls every morning. Separate from the reception-restaurant building, central on the campsite there is a large toilet building with all of the facilities you can wish for.

properties.name: Camping Le Suroit Eden villages
properties.description:
Camping Le Suroit is situated on the sun-drenched island of Ile d'Oléron. Entertainment for children is organised on the campsite and the beach is within walking distance. In the restaurant, the brasserie or during an Atlantic Ocean seafood evening you can feast on the local delicacies. The beautiful island of Ile de Ré is situated just off the French coast near Rochefort in the Charente-Maritime region. To reach Camping Le Suroit, you have to drive over a 3 km overpass to the island.

The camping is situated on the western side of the island and is sheltered by the dunes. The partly shaded camping pitches are separated by natural vegetation. Mobile homes can also be rented on the camping. The Keywest mobile homes are the most luxurious. In fact, one can hardly call them mobile homes, but rather holiday cottages. Nice to know: the accommodation can be rented for a weekend or even for one night.

French language lessons and karaoke

At a distance of some 600 m you will find the beach and, with the large number of sun hours per year in this region, it is ideally situated for swimming, sunbathing or lovely walks. Furthermore, the camping has a heated swimming pool with an open roof in summer and closed roof when the weather is less favourable. The slides and paddling pool for the little ones with play equipment are always in the open air.

properties.name: Camping De Knieplanden
properties.description:
In the middle of the Drenthe countryside, near the characteristic village of Zweeloo, you will find the peaceful campsite De Knieplanden. Children can swim in the large swimming pool or play on the large camping grounds. Go for a spacious camping pitch among the trees and experience the peace and quiet of a small campsite in Drenthe.

Quiet and comfortable camping

The campsite of De Knieplanden exudes tranquillity. You camp on a spacious pitch in the open air: the approximately seventy pitches are situated on various grassy areas, hidden between the tall trees. Because the pitches are not delimited or fenced, you feel free and have a wide view. The five hiker's huts you can stay in are basic, but provide that little bit of extra comfort. You have good beds and cooking facilities.

Spacious swimming pools

Next to the campsite is the municipal outdoor swimming pool. Campsite guests have access to the pool, which is also used by people visiting. The pools are extremely spacious. A large water slide leads to the competition pool. This large pool is joined by an equally large pool, which is slightly shallower. This part is particularly fun for children. Next to it is a shallow paddling pool, where the little ones can bathe safely.

Excellent facilities

The campsite facilities are excellent. The cosy canteen 'Any Tyme' has a modern look and nice outdoor seating. During the high season you can get take-away meals and snacks there. For the daily shopping you can go to Aalden, one kilometre away. The sanitary facilities are also very modern. The toilet buildings, centrally located on the site, have facilities for disabled persons and small children.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Mont-Saint-Michel
properties.description:
Camping Sandaya Mont-Saint-Michel is ideally located near the sea and the world-famous tidal island Mont-Saint-Michel. This is one of the most visited places of interest in north France. This campsite offers a perfect combination of nature, culture and relaxation. Children will have an excellent time in the swimming pool with water slides. The surrounding area has various hiking and cycle routes, making it easy to explore the beauty of Normandy.

Spacious pitches and luxury cottages

Camping Sandaya Mont-Saint-Michel has a variety of pitches that are either sunny or shaded. The pitches are spacious and suitable for tents, caravans and motorhomes. Some pitches have private toilet and washing facilities. For those who want more luxury, fully furnished cottages and rental tents are available. These are equipped with all of the modern conveniences and available in various designs. The most luxurious cottage has its own hot tub.

Heated swimming pool and activities for young and old

There is water fun to be had in the water park with a separate paddling pool, perfect for a refreshing swim on hot days. When the days are colder, the roof of the heated swimming pool can be closed. There is a nice playground for the children and an entertainment team organises all kinds of activities and games during the high season. Sports enthusiasts have great fun at the multi-functional playing field or playing a game of table tennis.

Explore Mont-Saint-Michel and the surrounding area

Just a stone’s throw away from the campsite lies the famous Mont-Sint-Michel, one of the most iconic places in France. Visit the abbey and enjoy the spectacular view over the bay. The campsite is also an excellent home base for exploring the surrounding coastlines of Normandy and Brittany.

properties.name: Camping Domaine Les Peupliers
properties.description:
Domaine Les Peupliers campsite is situated on the grounds of a sixteenth-century farmhouse in the north of Brittany, You'll be camping here on a well-cared-for campsite, where you'll find delimited touring pitches between tight hedges. For children there is plenty to do on and around the campsite. The heated swimming pool is ready for a dip, while the little ones can take a ride on a pony in the nearby riding school.

Well-maintained campsite

There are thirty spacious touring pitches on the well-kept campsite. They are delimited by green hedges, so you have a lot of privacy. The pitches are scattered over the terrain, between the mobile homes. Most of these accommodations are permanent pitches. In the high season you will encounter mainly families on this campsite.

Fun on and around the campsite

At the front of the campsite, behind the country house, the heated outdoor swimming pool is located. With space for sun loungers at the edge of the pool and a spacious lawn next to it, it's a good place to be. A large bouncy castle and a playground next to the swimming pool provide fun on dry land. But also close to the campsite there is a lot to do for the children. Less than half a kilometre away is a riding school with a pony club. At ten minutes by car you'll find the large indoor playground Woupi Cap Malo.

Appetizers and burgers

For a drink, a hamburger or a salad you can go to the campsite’s recently renovated restaurant. Be sure to try the cider on the menu. In high season you can buy fresh bread daily at the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Le Courounba
properties.description:
Le Courounba is a campsite for the whole family. Located at the edge of the Des Ecrins National Park, you camp with a splendid view of the mighty Alpine peaks. And all of this at a spacious pitch or in a luxurious mobile home. In the high season, you can get your daily rolls from the bakery at the campsite. The heart of the campsite is the lovely eco swimming pool with spacious sunbathing lawn. /p>

Camping with a view

The grounds look well-maintained and the campsites are neatly arranged. From the spacious camping pitches, you also have a magnificent view over the distant mountain peaks that jut high above the landscape. In addition to a pitch, you can also hire a mobile home. Some even have their own sanitation facility. But you can also use the campsite sanitary facilities guilt-free. These are very clean.

Sports and jumping

You can find most basic amenities at the campsite. In the high season, the bakery and snack bar are open, and you can find a pizzeria just outside the camp grounds. For the children, there is plenty to do at Le Courounba. The sports field lends itself to sports like basketball, football and volleyball. There are a few fun bouncy castles. In the high season, there is even an entertainment team.

Environmentally-friendly swimming pool

The central attraction of the campsite is the lovely eco swimming pool that is surrounded by a spacious sunbathing lawn. With a slide, climbing wall and a separate wading pool for the smallest children, there is entertainment for everyone here.

properties.name: Camping Le Rochat Belle-Isle
properties.description:
The tranquil, green Le Rochat Belle-Isle campsite is situated in a park-like environment on the banks of the Indre river, which is excellent for fishing. Nearby, in Châteauroux, there are various facilities, so you will not miss them on the campsite. At the reception you are welcomed with a smile and you will be given information about the spacious and flat, well-demarcated camping pitches (80-130 m2) between the trees. Static caravans are also for rent.

The campsite (some 6 acres) is often used as a stopover campsite because of its favourable location along a traffic corridor to the south. The attractive feature of the campsite is the location at the river's edge and its proximity to a lovely recreational lake. Visitors appreciate the campsite for its beautiful location, walking distance to the recreational lake, swimming pool and running track.

Lac Belle-Isle

The nearby recreational Lac Belle-Isle has a large play area, beach showers and play ground equipment. The lake has a demarcated area where children can swim safely. From the restaurant at the water's edge, where the natives also like to eat, you have a splendid view. Guests also enjoy the dance evenings and performances that are organised here on a regular basis.

Aquatic centre in Châteauroux

Since 10 June 2021, a new aquatic centre called Balsan'éo has opened in Châteauroux. It is located three kilometres from the campsite and is open every day until 7 pm. The campsite offers free access to the aquatic centre for one person per stay. You can buy extra tickets at the campsite reception. In the centre you will find a large competition pool (indoors), an outdoor pool, a wading pool, wellness area, massage showers, saunas, solarium, hammam and herbal tea room.

properties.name: Camping Le Moulin
properties.description:
The lively family campsite Le Moulin is located in close proximity of the town of Patornay and the larger Clairvaux-les-Lacs. The outdoor swimming pool (170 m2) of the campsite has a slide and a small covered swimming pool. A calm river suitable for boating - with beach - flows along the campsite. All in all, a very amiable site with lots of communal activities.

Lovely communal atmosphere

This popular campsite is characterised by narrow roads and a large number of trees. The entire site looks very well-maintained. The pitches at Le Moulin vary in size. They are mostly demarcated by greenery. The surface is mostly grass, here and there you camp on gravel/pebbles. Don't have your own camping equipment? You can also rent a mobile home, cabin or bungalow.

This family campsite is a wonderful relaxing resort for those who like the entertainment on offer, such as activities for children, a children's club and mini disco. There are naturally also various activities for the youth and adults. There is an amicable, relaxed atmosphere with much camaraderie.

Water spectacle

The indoor and outdoor pools of the campsite are not very large but offer lots of water fun for children. The swimming pool lies at a slightly higher section of the campsite, ensuring a wonderful view. From the campsite you can easily reach the river. The water's edge is an ideal spot to relax. Swimming and boating are also allowed. 

Eating out or preparing your own meal?

There is a small shop on the campsite. The restaurant, terrace and bar are at a slightly higher level, offering you a lovely view of the campsite and surroundings. There is a fairly standard menu, including pizzas and fries.

properties.name: Camping Yelloh! Village Le Ridin
properties.description:
In the north of France, not far from the estuary of the river Somme, you will find Yelloh! Village Le Ridin. This four star campsite is especially nice for families with young children. There are plenty of possibilities to play both inside and outside and there is an entertainment programme in high season.

Welcome!

In Belgium, take the E40 via Ostend. In France, the E40 becomes the A16. Follow the coast past Dunkirk and Calais, and take exit 24 towards the fishing village of Le Crotoy. At the roundabouts, follow the signs for Le Crotoy until the campsite is signposted. The campsite is situated next to a sand and gravel excavation, whose installations can be seen from afar.

Half or full board

The Le Ridin campsite consists mainly of mobile homes, as there are sixty rental accommodations and as many permanent year-round pitches. However, there are also about forty camping pitches and ten pitches for motorhomes available. The pitches are separated by hedges. At restaurant Le Mayocq, across the street, you can have breakfast, lunch and dinner. You can even stay at the campsite on a half or full board basis.

Playing and swimming

Le Ridin has an outdoor playground with trampolines and a bouncy castle, but there's also an indoor playground for when the weather is not so good. In the high season, there is an entertainment programme. As most of these facilities are on the other side of the street, the children have to cross the road. Fortunately, it is very quiet. From May to September, everyone can enjoy bathing in the heated outdoor pool, the paddling pool and the indoor whirlpool.

properties.name: Camping Domaine du Haut des Bluches
Flower Camping de la Plage
properties.description:
In the valley of the Lot, directly on the banks of the river and near the medieval Saint-Cirq-Lapopie, you will find Camping Paradis de la Plage. Here you can camp on a touring pitch between the trees and at the water's edge. Via a small gate you reach the beach and the river. The campsite is a real family campsite with lots of entertainment: from volleyball tournaments to movie nights.

Camping in the green

Because of the many greenery and full trees, the campsite looks a bit like a park. Between the trees are about a hundred touring pitches. Your pitch is nicely sheltered between hedges and shrubs. Some overlook the river or the rocky plateaus that surround the Lot valley. In addition to touring pitches, you'll also find some rental accommodation on the campsite. These safari tents and bungalows are not particularly new anymore, but are well maintained.

Swimming in the river

The location of the campsite is his business card. From the campsite you walk through a gate to the beach on the Lot. All children are equally safe: in front of the gate you need a code, while the beach is guarded. You can take a nice dive in the river, but you can also go up the river by canoe or pedal boat. By the way, you have to share the beach with day trippers from the neighborhood.

Restaurant with regional products

At the front of the campsite is the restaurant. Not for nothing this is called in the camping name: it may be small, but the food is delicious. The menu is quite extensive: you can go there for a three-course dinner, but also for a tasty homemade pizza.

properties.name: Camping L'île aux mille Charmes
properties.description:
In Charmes, situated in the Vosges (not far from Nancy), you will find the two-star campsite L'île aux mille Charmes. The Vosges is a touristy, hilly region with numerous lakes and extensive walking and cycling paths and mountain biking possibilities. The campsite is situated on the strip of land -it cannot really be called an island- between the Canal des Vosges and the Moselle river. It is a very quiet, green oasis five minutes' walk from the town centre. The campsite is opened from April to October.

Peace and simplicity

Camping L'île aux mille Charmes is a campsite, which is mainly of interest to people who are looking for peace and quiet and are averse to coordinated entertainment. The campsite is beautifully situated along the Moselle, far away from the hustle and bustle of the town, which extends on both side of the river. The river here is also not navigable for larger vessels. The water traffic along the canal is also limited because of the relatively small locks.

Overnight campsite

Camping L'île aux mille Charmes is a typical overnight campsite with hardly any permanent pitches. It is a rather open site interspersed with a few trees and unclearly demarcated pitches. The sanitary facilities are basic, but well maintained. As on most French campsites, L'île aux mille Charmes also has a petanque pitch.

Surroundings

In the vicinity of the campsite you will find a mini golf course and tennis courts. Fishing in the Moselle is allowed (fishing licenses are obtainable in town). Directly from the campsite there are signposted walks and cycling paths into the area. The campsite does not have a shop or restaurant, but Charmes counts several supermarkets, bakeries and restaurants.

properties.name: Camping du Buisson
properties.description:
Camping du Buisson is located in the park of a former castle in Louvemont, just east of the Lac du Der. This small-scale campsite is split in two by a small river. The touring pitches are situated directly on the water's edge or on an elevated part overlooking the rest of the campsite.

Camping at the waterfront

The campsite is situated in the former garden of the castle. A small river divides the site in two. Especially the spaciousness and the quietness of the campsite are striking. About fifty touring pitches are spread over the eight-hectare site. If you like camping by the water, you can choose from many pitches. You can also camp on a higher part, where the pitches offer a beautiful view over the campsite. Three luxury lodge tents and a few furnished chalets complete the range of camping options.

Heated swimming pool

In the centre of the campsite, on a sunny spot, is the swimming pool. Although it is fairly small, young and old can swim here. And even when it's colder outside, you're welcome. The water is heated. Around it is a large paved sun terrace, where you sunbathe on one of the sun loungers.

New climbing course

In 2019, a climbing course has been created in the forest area directly adjacent to the campsite. Here the smaller adventurers can indulge themselves on the lower course, while the real climbers are on the ladders and platforms high up in the trees. A fun adventure for younger children and the slightly more experienced climbers.

properties.name: Camping De Bronzen Emmer
properties.description:
The campsite De Bronzen Emmer is located on the outskirts of the village of Meppen, in the midsts of the woodlands of Drenthe. With its large selection of recreational opportunities, equestrian centre, bistro and lovely atmosphere, the campsite De Bronzen Emmer is a laid-back family campsite. The site is also a great place to start a hiking or cycling tour through Drenthe's beautiful natural environment.

Straight from your tent to the football field

The spacious camping pitches are playfully designed on large, well-kept lawns. The fields are surrounded by woodlands. Some pitches are bordered by bushes and trees. Active campers can choose a spot near the (car-free and dog-free) sports field. Great fun for families with children. Between the trees and separate from the camping pitches are a number of Finnish bungalows. These cosy accommodation units are peaceful and provide ample privacy.

Swimming for both young and old

This campsite is great for all ages, which is clear from its covered swimming pool. The littlest visitors can splash around in the wonderful heated toddler pool, whilst the more mature guests will enjoy swimming a few undisturbed laps during the daily senior hour. When the weather allows for it, the sliding doors of the swimming pool are opened for easy access to the sunbathing lawn. 

Treasure hunts and sport tournaments

An adventurous treasure hunt in darkness finished off with a campfire, sports tournaments for the entire family or arts and crafts sessions: the recreation programme at the campsite De Bronzen Emmer is extensive (especially in high season). The more active campers will enjoy themselves on the sports fields. There are several playgrounds for young campers on the camping grounds, but a deer meadow, adventure forest and recreation area also provide plenty of fun.

properties.name: Camping Côté Plage
properties.description:
The Côté Plage campsite is located just outside the tourist resort of Saint-Jean-de-Monts, which is on the French west coast. Saint-Jean-de-Monts has a beautiful sandy beach eight kilometers long. At Côte Plage, you can camp just two hundred metres from the beach! There's also lots to do at the campsite itself with its large swimming pool, all kinds of sports fields, entertainment for young and old, and a restaurant.

Welcome!

When you camp here, you enjoy a well-maintained, modern family campsite with all the facilities you could want. And the natural location of Côté Plage campsite in the middle of a forest and the dunes is also a big plus. There are one hundred touring pitches and sixty permanent annual pitches. These are separated by small hedges. The size of the pitches varies: 80-120 m2. There are also some ninety mobile homes.

Water fun at the campsite and beyond

An outdoor pool of about two hundred square metres is the place to cool off. There is something for children of all ages to enjoy thanks to the large slide and heated paddling pool. A terrace with bar is located next to the swimming complex. A five-minute walk takes you to a large sandy beach. Lay down your towel for a relaxing afternoon or run as fast as you can to the sea for a refreshing swim. This part of the ocean is popular with windsurfers.

Other facilities

The Côté Plage campsite has a nice shop with a very wide range of products. Next to the pool is a bar. For those with a big appetite, there is a restaurant and a pizzeria. The campsite plumbing is very clean and complete.

properties.name: Les Cyprès
properties.description:
Les Cyprès campsite is located in the French department of Vendée. This family campsite offers pitches and mobile homes. The entertainment team provides plenty of amusement in high season. The Jaunay river runs along the campsite. The cycle path along the banks takes you to the town of Saint-Gilles-Croix-de-Vie.

Lovely camping

The well-maintained grounds of the Les Cyprès family campsite offer a large number of camping pitches. The pitches vary in size and offer the possibility of staying overnight in a tent, caravan or motorhome. The campsite also offers mobile homes, with two or three bedrooms. The pitches are separated from the accommodation. The sanitary facilities on the campsite are neat and tidy and are also suitable for families with children.

Entertainment for the whole family

In high season the entertainment team provides a lot of amusement. They organise a kids club four times a week. Children quickly make new friends and do lots of fun activities. There is also a recreation room and a bouncy castle. Furthermore there are disco evenings. Adults are not forgotten either. In high season the entertainment team organises a programme for them twice a week. There is also a fishing facility at the campsite and various cycling and walking routes have been mapped out for sporty campers.

Heart of the campsite

The central point of the campsite is the outdoor swimming pool. The swimming pool is sheltered, by pine trees. There is also plenty of space to enjoy the sun on the sun deck. Next to the outdoor pool there is also an indoor pool.

properties.name: Camping De Hooiberg
properties.description:
Camping De Hooiberg is located close to the village of Bladel in Noord Brabant. The surroundings of this mini campsite are suitable for walking and cycling, but there are also many pleasant villages to be found. Only adults can stay at campsite De Hooiberg. You will camp in the yard of a cheese farm, on an elongated campsite surrounded by trees.

Camping in the countryside

The campsite is beautifully situated between the fields and surrounded by trees. This creates a camping world of its own where you can enjoy your holiday in peace and quiet. There are about twenty spacious pitches, which are situated around a large lawn. In addition, there are a few pitches especially for motorhomes. On this mini campsite you will be camping in the middle of nature, where peace reigns and where traffic noises are far away.

Adults only

What is particularly special about this campsite is that, in order to promote peace and quiet, only adults can camp here. You will not find any children here. It is mainly seniors who find the campsite and enjoy the peace and nature in the southern part of Noord Brabant. The small-scale nature of the campsite gives it a family atmosphere.

Organic farm shop

As you would expect from a cheese farm, you can buy cheese on the campsite: from nettle cheese, clove cheese to the ordinary mature cheese. But that is not all. In the farm shop you will find a wide variety of organic regional products. Milk from their own cows, different types of ham, jam and potatoes. In the shop, the choice is huge.

properties.name: Camping La Simioune
properties.description:
Camping La Simioune is an older, renovated campsite near the town of Bollène on the edge of Provence. The campsite is situated on the top of a hill, in the middle of a pine forest: the ideal playground for children. Next to the campsite is a climbing course, where small adventurers can climb to their heart's content.

Camping in the forest

This campsite is not suitable for campers who like straight, well-defined plots. The natural environment has been taken into account in the construction of the pitches. This has resulted in pitches with sandy soil, a natural and random demarcation of tall pine trees and, above all, lots of space. Sandy paths lead you to your camping pitch or rental accommodation, which are situated at different heights.

Swimming pool and sports fields

Most of the facilities can be found near the entrance to the campsite. On the right side of the reception building, in a sunny spot, are the modern swimming pool and the cheerful paddling pool. On the other side there is a volleyball court and basketball court.

Bollène Aventure climbing park

The tall trees on the campsite invite you to climb, especially among the younger campers. Now, the straight trunks of pines on the campsite may not be ideal for climbing, but fortunately the Bollène Aventure climbing park is right next to the campsite. Here, campers of all ages and levels can climb up on different courses.

Music nights and pizza

The snack bar at the reception building is often the setting for evenings with music during the high season. During these cosy gatherings, good food is provided; at other times you can order fries and pizza in the snack bar.

properties.name: Camping La Venise Verte
properties.description:
Camping La Venise Verte is situated in a quiet spot on the Sèvre Niortaise river, some 1.5 km from the town of Coulon. You are genuinely camping on a location amidst the interesting Marais Poitevin natural area. There are a large number of navigable canals here. Pity to miss out on a boat trip here...

Camping amidst green

The campsite is wonderfully quiet and you can hear the birds from sunrise. The spacious pitches are laid out in rows on a lawn, along paved roads. There are a number of medium-sized deciduous trees that provide shade. Low vegetation and shrubs provide demarcation. Want to hire something? You can choose between a mobile home and a chalet.

Swimming and sunbathing

The swimming pool (open in peak season only) is eminently suitable for playing and cooling down. There is a toddler pool for the little ones. You will find some loungers here and there. Ideal for working on that tan. A fence surrounds the decorative tiles of the pool and a there is a lot of vegetation.

Cycling paradise

Children can play to their heart's content in the playground, at the table tennis tables, on the jeu de boules pitch and the beach volleyball field. In high season entertainment is offered including an excursion programme and guided walking tours. Bicycles (also routes) and canoes can be rented at the reception. From the campsite there are numerous cycling options.

Regional dishes

At the reception you can buy a few regional products as well as daily fresh bread. It is only a 7 km car ride to a supermarket. Don't feel like cooking? The campsite restaurant has a small menu and a bar with a terrace where you can enjoy delicious regional dishes.

properties.name: Camping Le Parc de Vaux
properties.description:
Campsite Le Parc de Vaux is located on the la Varenne river, near the village of Ambrières-les-Vallées. The camping grounds are in an idyllic setting under tall trees on the riverbank. On the water you will see canoes, kayaks and pedalos while the area along the green banks is popular with walkers, cyclists and horse riders. The camping pitches on this traditional campsite are separated from each other by hedges.

Camping by the river

The campsite is spaciously laid out in a park-like setting on the sloping river bank. You camp along paved pathways on grass and mostly under trees. You can opt for a pitch directly by the river. The camping pitches are separated from each other by hedges. The terrain is hilly, so that most pitches are not level. There are some attractive rental bungalows available on a separate section of the campsite. You can also hire motorhomes and a few tents there. 

Recreational park

The campsite forms part of a recreational park. Directly next to the campsite is a heated outdoor swimming pool with toddler pool and water slide. Camping guests may make free use of this. There is also a playground. You can play a game of tennis or a round of mini golf for a fee. You can rent pedalos, canoes and kayaks near the jetty. There is also a canoe club where you can learn canoeing and kayaking.

Modest facilities

The campsite is suitable for guests who are often out and about to explore the area. The facilities on this campsite are very standard and the sanitary facilities are fairly modest. There are a few additional amenities only during the peak season, in July and August. The bar and restaurant are also open during that time.

properties.name: Camping De Ikeleane
properties.description:
In rural surroundings, in the middle of the Frisian forest area, you will find campsite De Ikeleane. This pleasant family campsite is beautifully laid out around an old farm. The campsite is car-free and fully equipped for families with young children. For example, each field has a small playground with fun equipment.

Car-free campsite

Camping De Ikeleane consists for a large part of permanently occupied pitches, but there are also 86 touring pitches. These pitches are situated on separate fields and there is also a special field for tent campers. The pitches are situated around grassy areas with low bushes. Furthermore, there are bungalows and hiker's huts for rent. The whole campsite is car-free.

Swimming pool in the village

There is no swimming pool at De Ikeleane campsite, but there is a large outdoor pool in the village of Bakkeveen. If you stay longer at the campsite, you'll get free access to the pool. You can cycle there in five minutes. There is a competition pool, a recreational pool, a toddlers' pool and a separate pool with diving boards.

Play areas everywhere

At De Ikeleane campsite, children can let off steam on the fun equipment in the playgrounds. In the large barn there is a complete indoor playground where they can enjoy themselves endlessly in case of bad weather. Next to the main building is the 'Farmers Playground', an outdoor playground where children can go-carting, drive tractors and splash around with sand and water. For little animal lovers, there is an animal meadow with rabbits, goats and chickens.

Pancakes at the outdoor café

There is a small restaurant at the campsite. The pancakes are an absolute must. From the sunny outdoor café you have a view on the 'Farmers playground' so you can keep an eye on the little ones.

properties.name: Camping de Chênefleur
properties.description:
This campsite is situated in south of the Belgian Ardennes, on the Semois River and near the village of Tintigny. You are here in the Gaume region, which has a friendlier and slightly more French appearance than the Ardennes. It is also a bit sunnier and therefore warmer here. The park-like, well organised campsite is mainly geared towards families with children, mostly from the Netherlands.

Beautifully laid out campsite

The first impression is that Camping de Chênefleur is beautifully laid out and well maintained. The spacious pitches are divided in groups and demarcated. The most beautiful pitches are located by the river. If you insist on a pitch with ample shade, you will have to search a bit. The rental accommodation consists of bungalows, mobile homes and tents. The wooden mobihut, which can be positioned in any desired spot, is something special..

Bar-restaurant

On the campsite you will find a modest bar-restaurant (outside the peak season and school holidays only open during weekends) and a small shop for basic groceries. You will find more eating establishments in Tintigny as well as a small supermarket (2 km from the campsite).

River as water fun park

The campsite has a heated swimming pool, but in summer the Semois River turns into a real water fun park. Children can play to their heart's content in the shallow water, build dams, catch fish or float on an airbed.

During peak season and school holidays lots of activities are organised on the campsite by a professional entertainment team. In addition, all kinds of outdoor sports activities for young and old are organised by the campsite, such as canoeing and mountain biking trips, climbing and abseiling and horseback riding tours.

properties.name: Camping La Côte
properties.description:
Come and camp among the open fields of France's Nouvelle-Aquitaine region. At campsite La Côte for example, you can enjoy a heated swimming pool with jacuzzi, a game of football or an afternoon of jeu de boules. There is no entertainment team at this campsite. This makes it extra quiet. But you will have a great time, because there is plenty to do in the area. Are you going to take a lesson at the surf school?

Immerse yourself in peace and quiet

The first impression is a good one: La Côte campsite is well maintained. Immerse yourself in the peace and quiet of this campsite. You can sleep comfortably in your tent or caravan on a spacious and shady pitch. The sanitary facilities are clean and well cared for. But you can also come here without your own camping equipment. There are several mobile homes and cottages in various designs.

Enough to do

As there is no entertainment team present, you can enjoy plenty of peace and quiet. However, there is also plenty to do. Hire a bicycle, for example, or enjoy a game of jeu-de-boules. You can also use the sports fields for a game of football or basketball. The little ones can enjoy themselves in the playground. And with the sea nearby, you can go surfing or swimming.

Dive into the pool before dinner so you are refreshed to join the queue for a takeaway pizza. In high season, you can pick it up at reception. Need more groceries? You can find a supermarket along the D652, just one kilometre from the campsite.

properties.name: Linnhe Lochside Holidays
properties.description:
Linnhe Lochside Holidays is a quiet campsite in a lush garden on Loch Eli. The campsite provides wonderful views of the inlets on Loch Eli and Loch Linnhe, and you can see Ben Nevis from the private beach. The campsite is an ideal starting point from which to explore the Scottish Highlands. You actually don't even need to leave the campsite to enjoy the wonders of nature. You can spot otters, owls and deer from the campsite. If you choose to take a boat trip on the lake, you can even see seals or porpoises.

Narrows Park or Dinghy Park

The campsite is terraced and divided into different areas. If your pitch is located on the Narrows part, you have a beautiful view of Loch Eli, which discharges into Loch Linnhe. The Dinghy Park area is ideal for canoeing enthusiasts because it is near the spot where you can launch your canoe. From this part of the campsite you can enjoy the gorgeous sunsets over the Glenfinnan hills. The campsite also has a special area for smaller tents accommodating one or two people. The sanitation building is well-tended and heated in the colder winter months.

Environmentally friendly campsite

Linnhe Lochside Holidays is an 'eco-friendly' campsite. This means that everything is done in an environmentally conscious manner. Think of, for instance, planting animal-friendly plants and flowers, installing nest boxes for birds and bats, and providing campers with information about environmental awareness and recycling. Think of, for instance, planting animal-friendly plants and flowers, installing nest boxes for birds and bats, and providing campers with information about environmental awareness and recycling.

properties.name: Camping Le Grand Calme
properties.description:
Le Grand Calme campsite is located partially under a lush canopy of deciduous trees, at the foot of various mountain peaks, including the famous Alpe d’Huez. The Verney lake is close by. This is the ideal campsite for fans of mountain sport, cyclists and mountain bikers, who love the rugged nature of the high mountains.

The campsite, run by two friendly and helpful brothers, is situated along the through road towards the Col de la Croix-de-Fer, on the main street of the quiet village of Le Bourg-d’Oisans.

Camping on a green alpine meadow

Upon arrival the campsite looks like a spacious and fresh alpine meadow with beautiful, large deciduous trees, surrounded by beautiful wooded mountain scenery. The demarcated pitches with plenty of privacy are spread over the grounds on a beautiful lawn. There is partial shade thanks to the (medium)tall leafy trees. A shallow stream runs through the site. Mobile homes and bungalows can be hired.

Trip around Lake Verney

You can find a lovely swimming pool within walking distance (around four hundred metres). Lake Verney is also close by. You can make a splendid cycling trip around it. On the way there are several picnic tables to catch your breath and have something tasty to eat.

Everything within walking distance

When you are happy but exhausted after a day in the mountains, you can have a pizza on the campsite. A bakery, a small supermarket and a few restaurants can be found within walking distance in the village.

Trendy sanitary facilities

The sanitary facilities were totally renewed in the summer of 2017, with a modern and trendy look. It is also kept clean.

properties.name: Camping Thoissey Val de Saône
properties.description:
In the sunny south-east of France in the Rhône-Alpes region, you will find Campsite Thoissy Val de Saône where you can enjoy holidays in a natural environment with many great attractions nearby, such as the medieval town of Châtillon-sur-Chalaronne. The municipal swimming pool next door is free for campsite guests!

Spacious pitches with shade or sun

Campers have a lot of choice in the type of pitch. On a grassy base, there are spacious pitches under a large tree with plenty of shade. Sunny pitches are also spread out over the well-kept grounds. At the entrance to the campsite, campers can pitch their tents, and the tipi tents, retro caravans, charming cabins and new safari lodges are all around.

Two-way water fun

When the French sun is shining brightly, real water rats naturally want to go into the pool. Within a few steps you are at the edge of the large, heated municipal swimming pool. Access is free for campsite guests. Speed down the long slide or relax on one of the sun loungers. Just what you want. From the terrace on the top of the hill, you have a beautiful view over the swimming pool and in the background the boats sail by on the river. The river is accessible from the campsite through a small gate. This leads to the river bank.

Eating at sunset

After a wonderful day, you can relax together on the charming terrace. In the summer months, there is happy hour at the bar every day at the end of the afternoon. Advantageous! At the waterside they serve snacks, hamburgers, pizza, salads and ice cream. Once a week they serve “moules-frites” (chips and mussels).

properties.name: Camping Les Portes de Sancerre
properties.description:
Camping Les Portes de Sancerre is a quiet campsite on the banks of the Loire, which forms the natural border of the departments of Cher and Nièvre. You'll camp on shady grounds in a wine region around Sancerre, the medieval village where famous wines from the Sauvignon Blanc originate. A tasting in one of the local wineries is definitely an option!

Camping on the Loire

In the quiet campsite you will camp on shady touring pitches, the most beautiful of which are situated directly on the banks of the Loire. The site is separated from the river by a fence. Most of the touring pitches are undefined, which gives a spacious feeling. On the left side of the campsite you'll find most of the rental accommodation. They are mainly mobile homes, but also some lodge tents.

The Loire

There is a swimming pool next to the campsite, which guests can use. But especially the Loire, which runs along the campsite, is an attractive place for water lovers. Not only can you swim in the river. At the campsite you also get the chance to go canoeing or kayaking. If you prefer to stay on dry land a walk along the river bank will give you a nice impression of the river and the adjoining hilly landscape.

Old, but clean sanitary facilities

The sanitary facilities on the campsite are rather outdated and do not always work properly. However, the campsite staff is helpful. A facility that no longer works will be repaired as soon as possible. Moreover, the sanitary facilities are kept very clean.

properties.name: Camping Paradis La Promenade
properties.description:
Camping La Promenade is located just a few steps from the banks of the Loire, in the village of Montjean-sur-Loire. Under the watchful eye of the cathedral of Montjean-sur-Loire, which towers above the surrounding area, you camp on a terrain with many spacious and delimited touring pitches. For a cultural day out, get on your bike to go to one of the many castles close to the Loire.

Well-maintained campsite

A pebble path takes you to your camping pitch or rental accommodation, set among tall trees and delimited by green hedges. The terrain looks beautiful, as do the bungalows, lodge tents and chalets. The touring pitches are in the vast majority: this campsite is ideal for campers travelling with tents, trailer tents, caravans or motorhomes.

Nice to stay on the Loire

It is nice to stay on the Loire, where the beach is wide and the water calm. Because of the calm character of the river, bathing is also an option for smaller children. To get to the river you have to cross the road and walk through a park (with picnic benches and playground equipment). The campsite has its own indoor swimming pool. You can also use the swimming pool across the road. This pool, with a paddling pool next to it, is located on the side of the campsite.

Modern sanitary facilities

At the entrance of La Promenade, across from the reception, is the toilet block. Here you can make use of modern sanitary facilities. They are clean and also easily accessible for the disabled.

properties.name: Camping Le Pastory
properties.description:
In the heart of the Vaucluse, northeast of the famous city of Avignon, Camping Le Pastory is a pleasant place for those looking for peace and quiet. Your tent, caravan or motorhome will be near vineyards and only ten minutes' walk from the village of Bédoin. You can swim in the campsite’s swimming pool or in one of the natural lakes about seven kilometres from the campsite.

Shade or sun

Here you wake up every day to the sound of the birds and you are surrounded by nature. The site has no designated spaces, yet the layout ensures enough privacy. All pitches are flat, easily accessible and vary in size. Of the three modest sanitary buildings, one is equipped for disabled campers. The well-kept mobile homes and sturdy lodges are mainly located at the edge of the forest and offer the more refined campers all the convenience in a lush setting.

Cool off in the area

There are a few options for a refreshing dip. There is a swimming pool on the campsite. Another great option is an afternoon’s swim in one of the nearby lakes.

A bite to eat in the village

There is a snack bar on the campsite, and there are restaurants in the village of Bédoin, about 700 metres away. There you will also find a supermarket and a bakery for your daily shopping. Or visit magnificent Avignon.

properties.name: Flower Camping Le Mât
properties.description:
Situated on the edge of the sandy beach of Trestel is Flower Camping Le Mât. This family campsite is located along the Côtes-d’Armor and is not far from the famous Pink Granite Coast and the group of islands called Les Sept Îles. This makes it a very suitable location for those who love water, nature and going for walks. The swimming pool is heated and has a handy sliding roof. You can dry off in the sunbathing area or on the terrace.

A place in the sun

After a warm welcome, you find your way to your pitch. A paved road runs along the swimming pool, dividing the campsite into two sections. On the left are the accommodations and permanent pitches, on the right the camping pitches. These are spacious, clearly separately by green hedges and located on a well-maintained field of grass. A few trees provide some shade, but most of the pitches are in the sun.

Breton crepes

Flower Camping Le Mât offers most of the comforts of home. There is a small shop for fresh bread daily, and snacks are available in the summer. Anything you have forgotten to take along can be found in the immediate vicinity. Right next to the campsite are restaurants where you can eat pizzas or Breton crepes. For the children there is a playground with equipment and there are playing fields for a game of football or badminton. The campsite bar is open in the evening for a cosy get-together with music, dancing and entertainment.

properties.name: Camping l'Abbatiale
properties.description:
Camping l’Abbatiale is located in the French department of Saint-Leu d’Esserent. A good campsite with amenities like a multi-functional playing field and a restaurant. There are plenty of things to do in the surrounding area as well, such as a visit to the popular Parc Astérix amusement park. The Chantilly castle is only a 15-minute drive away and the centre of Saint-Leu-d'Esserent is less than 2.5 kilometres away.

Accommodations with air conditioning

You camp on grassy pitches that are about 90 m2 in size, demarcated by hedges. There are barbecues and picnic tables for communal use. You can also stay in a luxury mobile home. The mobile homes are fully furnished, have private toilet and washing facilities and can house a maximum of six people. The accommodations have air conditioning and a terrace with furniture and a barbecue. Pets are welcome in the accommodations and at the campsite, but they may not be left unattended.

Sports and games at the campsite

There are various amenities on the campsite for a pleasant stay. Every morning you can pick up fresh rolls. Children can have fun in the playground and sports enthusiasts can play a game of football or volleyball on the multi-functional playing field. The reception has board games to borrow and can provide information about activities in the vicinity or about public transport. End your day with a drink in the bar or with an extensive dinner in the restaurant.

Château de Chantilly

The village of Saint-Leu-d’Esserent (2.5 km) is distinguished by a large abbey church dating from the 12th century and is certainly worth a visit. Nor should you miss a visit to the nearby Château de Chantilly.

properties.name: Camping Homair Riva Bella
properties.description:
Camping Riva Bella is situated along the canal from Ouistreham to Caen. This former municipal camping of substantial proportions is situated in the heart of a protected nature reserve. You will be warmly welcomed by Katja, the manager, to this green and well maintained campsite.

Lovely grounds

There is ample space for many guests on the beautiful site. Tents and caravans are kept separate from the camper vans. All pitches are more or less the same size. The campsite has new bungalows for rent. They have been placed in such a manner that several families can stay here together. In high season the campsite is frequented by families with children whereas in low season there are many senior citizens.

Wellness facilities and activities

Near the heated swimming pool is a terrace where you can order drinks and snacks. The spa, sauna and jacuzzi are very popular with guests. Children will not get bored in the pirate playgrounds. In the small camping shop you will find the basic necessities. Across the campsite you will find several large supermarkets. In high season several activities are organised for guests.

D-Day and beach excursions

You can exit the campsite via a gate with a code, so that you can go for a walk or cycling along the canal to the renowned Pegasus bridge. This bridge was recaptured by British units in the night of 5/6 June 1944, who herewith created an important link for the invasion units.

The landing area Sword Beach was one of the main landing areas during D-Day. The campsite organises regular excursions to the landing beaches for guests.

properties.name: Camping Le Fief
properties.description:
In the Loire-Atlantique, between Brittany and the Vendée and close to the mouth of the Loire, the luxury holiday village Camping Le Fief is located. This 5-star campsite is popular with families with children of all ages. A unique feature of this campsite is its beautiful uncovered water park, as well as its spacious indoor swimming pool with two slides. Activities are constantly organised for young and old.

Well-maintained grounds

On the well-maintained grounds you will find many mobile homes in different sizes and of course camping fields. Most pitches are partly shaded and separated from each other by subtle planting.

Endless swimming fun

The water park of Camping Le Fief is one of its showpieces. With its slides, river and water playground, this playful water park guarantees endless water fun. And if that's not enough, an indoor swimming pool has recently been added. In this indoor pool you'll also have plenty of swimming fun, because here you'll find two water slides, a playful paddling pool and a pool for swimming laps. Because you are only one kilometre away from a beautiful sandy beach, swimming in the sea is also a good option.

Tasty food at Le 57

A campsite of this standard should of course have a good restaurant. There is: Restaurant Le 57. The menu is extensive, the quality is excellent and the prices are attractive. They provide takeaway meals here, but lunch or dinner on the accompanying terrace is of course so enjoyable. There is also a shop with an extensive assortment of groceries. Larger supermarkets can be found in Saint-Brevin-les-Pins.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Le P’tit Bois
properties.description:
Are you looking for a fun family campsite? Then Camping Sandaya Le P'tit Bois in Saint-Jouan-des-Guérets (Brittany) is a great destination. The facilities at this well-maintained five-star campsite include an indoor and outdoor swimming pool, entertainment, a restaurant and sports and games facilities. The campsite is in natural green surroundings with lots of flowers. For a day out, several beaches and Saint-Malo are nearby, while Le Mont-Saint-Michel is also within easy reach.

Private toilet and shower facilities on all pitches

Most of this campsite's facilities are centrally located on the site. As is the reception in a colourful chalet. Around it you will find a nice mix of spacious pitches and comfortable accommodation, such as modern safari tents and mobile homes for two to ten people. As a camper, you also have plenty of comforts at this campsite. Every pitch at Camping Sandaya Le P'tit Bois has a private bathroom unit with washbasin, toilet and shower.

Entertainment and lovely aqua park

In high season, the campsite is lively. For example, there is a Kidsclub where children aged 5 to 7 years take part in fun craft activities and games. The Club Juniors is specially for children aged 8 to 12. Meanwhile, teenagers report to the Club Teens (13-17 years), while the very youngest campers have fun in the indoor playground.

In summer, go for a refreshing dip in the swimming pool. Do some laps in the outdoor pool and zoom down the slide. Incidentally, you can swim here all season because there is also a heated indoor pool with a whirlpool, several slides and a wonderful water playground.

properties.name: Camping Les Erables
properties.description:
Camping Les Erables is situated on the east side of the town of Millau, known for the towering viaduct. From the campsite it is a fifteen minute drive to this impressive construction. There is also plenty to see and do at the campsite itself. You can relax at the swimming pool and in the river Tarn. Furthermore, there are fun pétanque tournaments organised.

Camping in nature

You camp here under the watchful eye of the Puncho d'Agast, a mountain that is popular with paragliders. Furthermore, the Grands Causses national park is just around the corner. This natural environment is also reflected on the campsite itself. Most of the pitches are on grass and there are many trees and hedges for the necessary shade and privacy. The campsite is not very large, but still offers space for about seventy pitches. There are also a few mobile homes for rent.

Water fun

On the campsite you will find a small swimming pool. You can have more fun in the river Tarn. You can walk to it from the campsite. You also have access to a small beach. Another fun activity: in high season there is a regular boules tournament with a drink afterwards. There is also a small playground and a place with a pool table, table tennis and football table.

Snacks and drinks

At the campsite there is a nice bar with outdoor seating. It is the perfect place for a tasty snack. You can also buy some groceries in the shop, but for the big shopping you have to go to Millau. It is only a fifteen minute walk to the centre.

properties.name: Camping La Truffière
properties.description:
Gently undulating limestone plateaus with caves and deep river canyons: this describes the Lot region, where the cosy Camping La Truffière campsite is situated. The grounds beneath the oak trees offer spacious pitches, a lovely atmosphere and panoramic views over the valley. An ideal spot for lovers of quietude.

Panoramic view

The undulating and partly sloping terrain is spaciously laid out and shaded by oak trees. The pitches are laid out on terraces with magnificent views or on a flat grassy strips. The surface is very firm. Authentic wooden chalets can also be rented.

The Lot river

The playfully designed, heated swimming pool is centrally located in a sunny spot. There is also a toddler pool. With spacious surroundings to relax: loungers are provided. The river Lot also offers swimming opportunities and a 5-minute drive away is a supervised beach shaded by tall trees. There, you can also hire a pedalo or canoe.

Beautiful walks

In the centre of the grounds is a very sizeable play area with trampolines, a jeux de boules pitch, table tennis tables, volleyball field, fitness course, monkey bridge, climbing wall and playground equipment. Children have all the space they need and will not get bored. Entertainment is also available (treasure hunt, crafts, games day). In high season guests can go on a boat cruise or join group walking tours.

Limited menu

There is a modest restaurant with limited menu, a bar and a terrace. Near the reception is a small shop with basic necessities and bread service. There is a supermarket 19 km away.

Sanitary facilities

There are a few sanitary buildings in different locations on the camping grounds. They are partly renovated and are well maintained.

properties.name: Flower Camping Le Val de l'Arre
properties.description:
This beautiful, quiet campsite is situated just outside the centre of the town of Le Vigan. You camp here on the Arre river and partly in the pleasant shade of a forest. Family ambiance, comfort and care are paramount here. The camping grounds, where you can also find a heated swimming pool, actually is one large green park by the river.

Leafy pitches

You drive on small leafy roads to a well maintained pitch. Everything looks very hospitable and tidy. The pitches have all kinds of nuances of sun and shade, choose whichever one you prefer. Part of the campsite is laid out according to the classic pattern: central lane with on both sides neatly demarcated, rectangular pitches. Along the river the setup is a bit less structured and some pitches are even more spacious. Rental chalets are also available. 

Heated swimming pool and entertainment

The large and heated swimming pool is spacious (150 m2). The pool is in full sun. It is surrounded by a terrace with loungers. During high season there is well organised entertainment for young people (all ages). On a regular basis you can also enjoy evening entertainment, fun for the entire family.

Catering: modest but good

There is a very popular, modest al fresco restaurant. Here you will also find a friendly bar and a small snack bar. Next to the reception is a small, well-stocked camping shop. You can order daily fresh bread from here. The town of Le Vigan is 2.5 km away and is easily reached on foot or by bicycle. It has some larger supermarkets.

properties.name: Camping Camp Redon
properties.description:
Camping Camp Redon is a small-scale and charming campsite in the Tarn, centrally located in the Midi-Pyrenees. You camp here about five kilometres from Cordes-sur-Ciel. The site has a beautiful location in a hilly agricultural area between grain fields, corn fields and sunflowers. From here you can enjoy beautiful panoramic views and unparalleled sunsets.

Shady and open camping pitches

Thanks to the varied vegetation, this campsite has shady pitches, but also pitches with an open character. Many pitches have a beautiful view of the rural surroundings. In high season, this is a convivial campsite where you will meet many families with children. In low season, the campsite is populated by people looking for the peace and quiet of the Tarn.

Attractive swimming pool

The playfully designed swimming pool at the side of the campsite is ideal for a refreshing dip on a hot southern French summer's day. There is a separate children's pool for the smallest swimmers and the pool has a spa.

Entertainment on and around the campsite

Children are well entertained at this campsite. Under the guidance of the entertainment team, many fun and sporty games are organized. In addition, they bake pancakes together, there are weekly droppings and once a week in the high season guided canoe trips are organized over the Aveyron river.

Fresh bread

At Camp Redon it is possible to order breakfast for the next morning. There are several types of bread available. The special thing is that the baker of this campsite delivers your order personally. Furthermore, snacks and ice creams are available at the campsite. You can do your shopping in several supermarkets in Cordes-sur-Ciel.

properties.name: Camping De la Bonnette
properties.description:
Camping De La Bonnette is located in the small valley of its name giver, the river Bonnette, in the southern Tarn-et-Garonne. From the green, open campsite you look out on the high meadows and woods all around. The campsite is surrounded by numerous medieval villages, with Caylus within walking distance.

Intimate camping

With its 49 touring pitches, the campsite is small and intimate. On either side of a wide avenue, the spacious touring pitches are beautifully situated under large trees. These provide nice shady spots. Most pitches are delimited by hedges providing enough privacy. In addition to these pitches, you can also choose one of the rental accommodations. For example, a mobile home or a glamping tent, fully equipped with kitchen and private sanitary facilities.

Cool off in the pool

The swimming pool is situated in a sunny area at the front of the campsite, close to the road. The rectangular swimming pool is not very special, it's mainly a nice place for a refreshing dip. The first part of the pool is shallow. This makes it ideal for children who are not yet able to swim so well.

Delicious food and music

The restaurant and covered pavement café, are the pleasant centre of the campsite. In addition to the fact that you can enjoy a delicious meal from an ever-changing daily menu, the summer evenings are often enlivened by live music and theme nights. Should it be unexpectedly colder in July or August; the pavement café can be heated so you can enjoy the relaxed atmosphere and delicious food until late.

properties.name: Camping Les Ilots de St. Val
Camping Le Cézanne Sainte Victoire
properties.description:
Camping de Puyloubier - Le Cézanne is less than a kilometre away from Puyloubier in the Provence (department of Bouches-du-Rhône). It is the perfect holiday address for those seeking peace and quiet and nature lovers as it is in the heart of the countryside. It is also a great starting point for walkers, mountain bikers and mountain climbers. That is due to its location on the foothills of the mighty mountain Sainte-Victoire. From your camping pitch, bookable for a friendly price at Camping de Puyloubier - Le Cézanne, you have splendid views of the surrounding mountains.

Camping with mountain views

You will receive a friendly welcome at the reception. This campsite consists of two parts: a terraced part and a level site. You have stunning views of the surrounding mountains from every pitch. There are also glamping options such as staying in a modern mobile home or group gite, where you can spend the night with up to 10 people. The accommodation have recently been fully renovated.

Enjoy a delicious pizza

If you like going out to eat during your holiday, make sure you visit the campsite's restaurant that is open in the high season. The pizzas here are extremely popular. You can of course also prepare your own meals. There are various shops in Puyloubier.

Explore the stunning countryside

This campsite is in a lovely nature area at the foot of Sainte-Victoire. This mountain has a rocky face, which is ideal for experienced mountain climbers. You can also take great walks and go mountain biking around Sainte-Victoire.

properties.name: Camping Rio Vero
properties.description:
Camping Rio Vero is a quiet, green terraced campsite amidst nature, ideal for finding some peace and quiet. But also adventurers who do not fear water and canyons will feel at home here. The campsite is situated in a forested region of the Spanish Pyrenees, some 5 km from the medieval town of Alquézar. The nature park Sierra y Canones de Guara, renowned for its canyons, pink/red rock formations, flora, fauna and pre-historic rock paintings, is also close by.
