Camping pitches

The campsite is open and elongated and lies at an altitude of 500 m. It is not excessively maintained or laid-out, but rather blended-in with nature. The Rio Vero river runs alongside the campsite. The camping pitches, with little demarcation and partly under tall trees, offer ample space. There are a few dozen tents and mobile homes for rent.

What do campers look for here?

The campsite mainly focuses on white water rafting enthusiasts and canyon hikers. The less adventurous hiker can walk on well laid out trails along rock faces and gorges. You can bathe and play in the river next to the campsite.

Camping shop and restaurant

The camping shop is a small supermarket with basic foodstuffs. The range is more than adequate. In the shop you can also get material for rafting, canyoning, via ferrata and climbing (buy or rent). The restaurant with cosy terrace and fast service is located at the entrance of the campsite. The menu offers ample choice. There is also a pizzeria. Take-away meals are also offered.

Clean sanitary facilities

The sanitary building, centrally located on the grounds, has rather dated sanitary fittings. Everything is kept in clean condition, though.

properties.name: Camping Signol
properties.description:
You will find Camping Signol on the French island of Ile d'Oléron. This family camping is located on the outskirts of the village of Boyardville. In addition to camping pitches, the campsite also has rental accommodation. There are lots of activities for all ages on the campsite: a playground with trampoline and air cushion, swimming pools and sports fields.

Camping Signol is tucked away in a pine forest. The trees on the terrain provide ample shade on the pitches. The pitches are distributed over the grounds and in between the various rental accommodation units. You can hire one of the bungalows, mobile homes, lodge tents or chalets.

Stay fit during your holidays

On this campsite there is no need for anyone to get bored. Children enjoy themselves in the playground with climbing equipment, swings and trampolines or with the entertainment programme. If you want to stay fit during your holidays, you can make use of the many sports facilities. Tournaments are organised regularly on the multi sports terrain or on the beach volleyball field.

The hungry camper

After a sporty session you can replenish your energy with a bite to eat in the restaurant or a drink in the campsite bar. Here the day often ends with a show or karaoke evening. And after a good night's sleep there is nothing better than a breakfast in French fashion, complete with fresh rolls and croissants.

Four slides

Still not fully awake after breakfast? Dive in one of the heated swimming pools or join the aqua gym session. Rather be in the open water or on the beach? At a distance of 800 m of the campsite, you can feel the sand beneath your feet.

properties.name: Le Ventoulou Sites & Paysages
properties.description:
On the edge of the Les Causses de Quercy Regional Park you will find campsite Sites & Paysages Le Ventoulou. This small-scale family campsite is located in a rural setting in the Lot department and not far from the village of Thégra. In the region, you will find numerous cultural-historical attractions and an abundance of natural beauty. The campsite features a recreation room with table tennis and foosball. Outdoor sports can be played on the multi-sport court.

A very well-maintained campsite

Everything on the campsite looks very well cared for. From the reception building at the entrance to the well-travelled roads across the campsite. And from the spacious pitches on the grassy green fields to the various rental accommodations. You won't find anywhere as neat and tidy as campsite Sites & Paysages Le Ventoulou.

Attention all gourmets

Of course, you can cook for yourself at the campsite. In the camp shop, you will have access to a modest selection of groceries. It's easy to prepare yourself a camping meal. But be sure to visit the restaurant as well. This has recently been renovated and is now so well regarded that even non-camping guests like to come and eat there. Choose your favourite dish from the menu, or be inspired by the chef's daily suggestions.

Swimming and sunbathing

The showpiece of the campsite is the swimming pool. This will immediately attract your attention as soon as you enter. Like everything else at the campsite, the pool is well taken care of. The water is heated, and the pool is surrounded by a sunbathing area with chairs and loungers. Enjoy the French sun here or unwind after an active day in the Dordogne Valley.

properties.name: Camping Le Puits Rochais
properties.description:
Camping Le Puits Rochais, located on the wide beaches of the west coast of France in the municipality of Château-d’Olonne, is an ideal campsite for families with children. There's plenty of fun here with a swimming pool, disco and sports cage. The beautiful nature and the beaches are perfect for long cycling tours and walks. The location on the Atlantic coast makes the four star campsite is a perfect spot for water sports enthusiasts and beach-goers.

Quiet and conviviality

At the entrance of the campsite you'll find the reception building, with a supermarket, café restaurant with swimming pool, a football/basketball cage and a playground. All facilities at a central point.

The friendly reception employees will show you the way to your campsite. This is generally well maintained and shady. The property is expansive, hence enough space to find a lovely spot. Note: if you are looking for peace and quiet, reserve timeously. The last few pitches (for caravans and campers) are across from the café-restaurant and a bit noisy in the evenings. If you are looking for nightly conviviality, then these spots are perfect. In addition to the campsites, you can choose from various spacious mobile homes and chalets.

Youthful pleasures

Children of all ages can enjoy water fun in the heated swimming pool. Entertainment for young children is organised on the campsite in high season. Great performances with clowns, sports tournaments, trampolining and more are including in the programme. The older kids can have fun with music performances and disco evenings, where they can let their hair down.

properties.name: Camping Ma Prairie
properties.description:
Welcome to Camping Ma Prairie, a cosy 4-star campsite in Canet-en-Roussillon (southern France), just 3 kilometres from the beach. Here you’ll find yourself in a lush, Mediterranean setting where tranquillity and comfort go hand in hand. In the morning, you can pop down to the sea for a refreshing dip, and in the afternoon, you can relax by the pool. There is also a restaurant, a playground and an entertainment team.

Spacious camping pitches in natural greenery

You can choose from pitches ranging from 65 to 100 m². Whether you’re coming with a tent, caravan or motorhome, there’s always the right spot for you. The pitches are surrounded by greenery and feel sheltered and spacious, creating a relaxed atmosphere. Prefer a bit more convenience? Then rent a modern, air-conditioned mobile home. You’ll enjoy comfortable beds, your own kitchen and a lovely terrace to sit outside on in the evenings.

Plenty of enjoyment for the whole family

The heated swimming pool with a slide is the perfect spot for fun in the water. The little ones can splash about safely in the paddling pool while you relax in the sun. In summer, the entertainment team keeps things extra lively with activities for all ages. Want to get active? You can work out in the gym or join an activity on site. Need some peace and quiet? Then treat yourself to a wellness experience. Warm up in the sauna, relax in the hammam or book a massage. We’ve also got you covered when it comes to good food. Pull up a chair in the restaurant, grab a bite to eat at the snack bar or enjoy a drink in the bar.

properties.name: Flower Camping Le Petit Paris
properties.description:
This campsite is located further inland, in the middle of nature and close to the sandy beaches of cosmopolitan Les Sables-d'Olonne. In this vibrant and welcoming region between the ocean and the countryside, you will discover countless possibilities for cultural trips and active recreation. The village of Le Château-d’Olonn is just three kilometres away, with restaurants and a daily market.

Well-structured campsite with plenty of greenery

This campsite is very green due to the varied vegetation. The grounds are well-organised and the campsite exudes a peaceful atmosphere. The touring pitches are well-maintained and clearly marked by hedges and trees. They are situated on grass and are spacious enough for a car with a tent or caravan, or a motorhome. There are also various types of accommodations available for rent: mobile homes, 'roulottes' (covered wagons), furnished bungalow tents and cottages.

Large outdoor pool and picnics with horse and carriage

There is a large heated outdoor swimming pool with a sliding roof and a water slide. The pool is situated in the sunshine, and there are also poolside loungers available. There is also a paddling pool and a unique man-made 'lagoon' (swimming pond), complete with sandy beach, palm trees and loungers. All sorts of special activities are organised for the campsite guests. In the peak season, there is an entertainment programme for the children and aqua gym every day. The picnic trips with horse and carriage are also really fun. Other activities include folk evenings, complete with bagpipes, accordions and folk dancing.

Pizza or hamburger?

In the restaurant, you will find a simple menu and takeaway meals. Would you rather have a pizza, hamburger, or chips? Next to the restaurant is a bar with a patio. There is a shop, but with a very limited range of products.

properties.name: Camping Le Bois de la Gachère
Camping Les Hauts de Port Blanc
properties.description:
Les Hauts de Port Blanc campsite is located just a few kilometres from the rocky Atlantic coast of Brittany. This open family campsite has a well-kept character, with spacious touring pitches on lawns. These are delimited by hedges for that little bit of extra privacy. Heated swimming pools - one of which is covered - are ready for a dip. And the jagged Breton coast is also nearby to be discovered. Several characteristic harbour towns interrupt the rocks and beaches in this region.

Neat and tidy

The tidy entrance reveals the character of the rest of the campsite: neat, spacious and open. A paved path leads you along beautiful fields with lots of vegetation. One of these spacious fields, delimited by green hedges, is the pitch of your caravan, camper or tent. An excellent camping spot where you can enjoy peace and privacy. Separate from the touring pitches are the rental accommodations: different types of mobile home and hiker's tents.

Breton family campsite

Especially in high season it is mainly families who stay at the campsite. Many French families spend their holidays in their own country, but campers from the Netherlands, Germany and England also travel to the Breton coast. In the low season, it is mainly senior citizens who fill the campsite.

Heated swimming pools

In all likelihood you will soon find the children in the swimming pools, one of which is covered. They will never be too cold, because the pools are nicely heated. At the swimming area you can get a drink at the bar and choose a sun lounger. These are nicely arranged under palm parasols.

properties.name: First Camp Bogense City - Fyn
properties.description:
First Camp Bogense City is located amongst the rolling hills on the beautiful island of Funen. This is an ideal campsite for those who enjoy a good mix of the beach, nature and the city. Here you'll be camping just a 5-minute walk from the harbour, the beach and the centre of Bogense. What more could one ask for? Your children will not be bored either. They can choose from a lovely swimming pool, playgrounds and a mini golf course.

From camping pitch to glamping

You camp on grass and have a choice of pitches from 80 to 200 m². Each pitch has electricity. Don't have your own camping equipment, but you still want to spend your holiday at First Camp Bogense City? Then go glamping by renting one of the bungalows. Each bungalow is equipped for 6 people.

Splashing in the pool and the sea

You'll have no trouble finding the swimming pool. It is located in the middle of the campsite. Relax under an umbrella on one of the sun loungers. Too cold to swim outside? You can also swim indoors. But the largest swimming pool - the sea - is less than 500 meters from the campsite. Roll out your towel and jump on in.

Entertainment for young and old

If your children are tired of swimming, they can play on one of the playgrounds or jump on a large bouncy castle. Or play a game of mini golf or football together.

The area around the campsite is ideal for hiking and cycling trips in the beautiful surrounding nature. There are more than 1,100 kilometres of cycling paths.

properties.name: First Camp Hasmark Strand - Fyn
properties.description:
First Camp Hasmark Strand on the Danish island of Funen is a large, child-friendly campsite with a Viking theme, including a playground ship and bouncy castles. For water fun with the whole family, visit the indoor water park measuring no less than 650 m2. Get a table in the bistro with Viking atmosphere or wander through the campsite shop. The beach is a stone's throw away. Go to the lively city of Odense for a cultural excursion.

Rows of camping pitches

A big plus at this campsite is the spacious layout with wide paths and spacious camping pitches. You are welcome here with your tent, caravan and motorhome. The fields are demarcated with hedges with little or no shelter. If you don't have your own camping equipment, hire one of the huts, mobile homes or glamping tents.

A camping holiday in Viking theme

As soon as you arrive at this campsite, you step into the world of the Vikings. You are greeted in the large Viking castle, the centre point of the campsite. During the summer holidays, the entertainment team and mascot Yessi organise many activities for children. And there is often live music in the evenings for parents. Or join in with the bingo or karaoke in Valhalla.

The campsite's main attraction is the large water park in Viking theme, with slides both inside as well as outside. If you prefer the sea, you can walk straight to the sandy beach (150 m) from the campsite. And if you have worked up an appetite after a day full of relaxation or fun, you will be treated to an extensive buffet in the restaurant.

properties.name: First Camp Aarhus
properties.description:
First Camp Aarhus is close to Aarhus, Denmark's second largest city. You'll be camping here in a wooded area about eight kilometres from the centre of Aarhus. The green campsite has a playground and everything you need. Because of its location, First Camp Aarhus is particularly suitable as a transit campsite and as a city campsite.

Camping in the woods

There are two hundred camping pitches on a green campsite in the middle of the woods, which are partly marked out by hedges. Some camping pitches are on the edge of the forest and receive shade from the surrounding trees. An elongated lawn on the side is reserved for campers. On an open lawn surrounded by trees, you can camp freely with your tent.

Facilities

There is a playground and playroom for children. You will find everything you need in the service buildings. For a more extensive shopping trip, you'll have to take the car. Just ten minutes away, in the northern part of Aarhus, are a few larger supermarkets. If you would like to cook but don't have a stove, you can use the kitchen at the campsite.

Transit campsite and city campsite

First Camp Aarhus can be described as both a transit campsite and a city campsite. Not only is the campsite close to Aarhus, but it is also not far from the motorway. The campsite is an excellent stopover for those crossing from Frederikshavn to Norway or Sweden. Frederikshavn is just under two hours' drive from the campsite.

properties.name: First Camp Frigård - Flensborg Fjord
properties.description:
Camping at a great Danish family campsite close to the water can be done at First Camp Frigård - Flensborg Fjord. Stay overnight on a pitch, in a glamping tent or a stuga (small house). Frigård - Flensborg Fjord is one of the most southern locations in Denmark, with the German border only a few kilometres away. This makes a visit to a German city like Flensburg easy and fun.

Large family campsite close to the water

This large family campsite is a five-minute walk from the waters of Flensborg Fjord. The pitches have electricity. Depending on the location, you will be close to the amenities (the Midtpunktet section), close to the beach (the Dalen section) or in the quieter part of the campsite (the Lunden and Lysningen sections). First Camp Frigård - Flensborg Fjord also has several cabins, stugas and glamping tents.

Go for a swim

First Camp Frigård has a heated swimming pool and rents out its Jacuzzi and sauna. In the early morning hours (from 8.00 to 9.00), the pool is reserved for the adult sports enthusiasts. The campsite also has a small shop that is open during the high season. You can order bread from the local baker here. The campsite’s large kitchen is available if you want to prepare a meal yourself. There are also sports activities to participate in. From beach volleyball to fitness and go-karting – you can do it all. The kids’ club and the playground ensure that children will have the time of their lives.

properties.name: First Camp Bøsøre Strand - Fyn
properties.description:
First Camp Bøsøre Strand - Fyn is a veritable paradise for families looking for a campsite with endless water fun or who like to explore the surrounding area. A dive in the sea, splashing around in the swimming pool and a trip to LEGOLAND®. With its rural setting, this campsite is in a beautiful location in the south of Funen, Denmark.

Camping with a sea view

On this green campsite you can camp on different camping fields, which are demarcated with hedges. This way you enjoy ample privacy during your camping holiday. You can see the water from each pitch. Camping with a sea view - sheer enjoyment. The pitches are spacious and have a grass surface. In addition to this, the sanitary facilities are very beautiful and well maintained. 

Water spectacle on the campsite

Both children and parents are guaranteed endless water fun on First Camp Bøsøre Strand - Fyn. The campsite is located by the sea. Splashing around in the sea and soaking up the sun on the beach will, therefore, become part of your daily routine. But there is even more! In summer children enjoy playing at the water spectacle with four water slides, fountains and water spouts. There is also an indoor swimming pool with a few slides. Feel like a bit of relaxation after all this splashing around? Head for the sauna with a beautiful view of the Great Belt. 

Copenhagen and LEGOLAND®

The campsite offers ample opportunity to keep busy all day long. Feel like getting out and about? Make your way to Copenhagen or LEGOLAND®, both only one and three quarter hours drive away.

properties.name: Camping Les Albères
properties.description:
At the foot of the Pyrenees, a half-hour's drive from both the Spanish border and the coast of the Mediterranean Sea, lies Camping Les Albères. This is an ideal spot for holiday makers who like variety. Cycling, walking, fun at the beach and soaking up culture: it is all possible. On the campsite, you have access to an extensive swimming complex with wellness facilities.

Camping with shade and privacy

The camping grounds are beautifully maintained and offer spacious pitches on terraces, both in the sun and in the shade. Bushes and trees essentially define the boundaries of each pitch. The pitches at the edges of the campsite have the most privacy. The tent pitches are in a separate location. 

For those who want to rent an accommodation, a mobile home, a bungalow, a large glamping tent and a canvas mini-house are all available.

Opulent swimming pool complex

This campsite has a real trump card: a luxuriously designed swimming pool complex with outdoor and indoor pools, water slide, counter current pool, jacuzzi, children's pool, rock features, waterfalls and palm trees. All pools are heated. There are numerous loungers near the outdoor pool. Adjacent to the swimming pool is a lovely small bar.

Entertainment for the whole family

Children can enjoy themselves in the playground or on the athletics field. There is also a comprehensive (English language) entertainment programme for all ages, from games for the little ones to aquarobics for adults. Music evenings are also organised: fun for the entire family. 

Catering

You can do your daily shopping on the campsite (for items such as fresh bread). Feel like going out for a bite to eat? Take a seat at the campsite restaurant and order something from the small menu. There is a terrace with sunshades. You can get take away meals there.

properties.name: Camping Les Hortensias
properties.description:
Pays Bigouden is the name of the special region where Camping Les Hortensias is situated. The area is known for its long and photogenic beaches, traditional fishing villages and numerous historic towns. This location makes the friendly campsite a good base for nice trips in the area. And when you return to the campsite, a whirlpool and heated swimming pool await you. But also a snack bar (with outdoor seating) where they serve delicious pizzas.

Beautifully tended pitches

Each pitch is well used, but the many trees and bushes give the campsite a welcoming feel. The pitches are partly delimited by hedges and of course by hydrangeas. Trees provide natural shade everywhere. Most touring pitches are on grass. The mobile homes are arranged in small streets.

Heated water

The swimming pool complex is at the front of the campsite. The indoor pool is nicely decorated with a small bridge and plants. There is also a whirlpool. In fine weather the roof can be opened. A small part of the pool is reserved for toddlers. If you want to swim in the sea, you can go in all directions. At the marina in Loctudy, a small ferry boat sails across to the beautiful beach of Ile-Tudy during the high season.

Playing outside

Nobody will be bored at Les Hortensias campsite and children certainly won't be. There is a playground with a climbing frame and some other playground equipment. But there are also two trampolines, a table tennis table and a volleyball court. And what is more fun when you are on holiday in Loctudy than to go cycling together? You can hire one at the campsite.

properties.name: Camping La Corniche
properties.description:
Camping La Corniche is a campsite in Brittany, located near the west coast of France. One and a half kilometres away is the Baie d'Audierne, a bay on the Atlantic coastline. The landscape here is open, the views wide. Especially for cyclists and hikers this is a nice place.

Spacious camping

When you drive through the campsite, you mainly see rental accommodation. These are mainly mobile homes. Not all of them are new, but they are well maintained and tidy. Newer are the furnished lodge tents in which you can stay. They are situated between the touring pitches, a little further down the campsite. Especially the part of the touring pitches has an open and spacious character. The campsite has been laid out in an orderly manner; the touring pitches are spacious and are nicely situated along the small roads on the campsite.

Swimming pool for children

Especially the swimming pool is a nice place for the younger camper. It is centrally located on the campsite, next to the reception building. A large part of the pool is not too deep, so ideal for small swimmers. The area near the mushroom shower is suitable for the little ones. In this shallow area toddlers can have a nice swim.

Entertainment for young and old

With performances by the men's choir, dance evenings, communal dinners, (sports) games for the children and much more. In high season La Corniche provides entertainment for young and old. Of course you can also organise your own sports match on the volleyball field, football field or the petanque court. If the weather doesn't cooperate, you can enjoy a game of table tennis or table football in the indoor recreation room.

properties.name: Camping Etxarri
properties.description:
Campsite Etxarri is ideally located between two nature parks, the Parque Natural Aralar and Parque Natural Urbassa y Andía. Hiking and cycling enthusiasts, in particular, will be able to indulge themselves in this region. The peaceful Basque family campsite is mostly quiet but comes to life on the weekends with its many Spanish permanent guests.

Between the age-old oak trees

The grounds are partly situated in a forest with tall, age-old oak trees. They offer both sunny and shaded pitches. The pitches are partly separated by low trees and privet hedges. They have a grassy surface. Want to rent something? Choose from one of the bungalows or the rooms. The communal sanitary facilities look neat and tidy.

Enormous swimming pool

The swimming pool, which is open to the public, is almost Olympic-sized and is well-tended. There is a separate paddling pool for younger children. Surrounding the pool is a sunbathing lawn with trees where you can lie on a towel in the sun or shade.

Numerous playing areas

There are numerous playing areas for both children and adults, such as a basketball court and a playground. Also fun: play a round of squash or tennis on one of the courts or a round of minigolf on the golf course. There is an entertainment programme for the children in the peak season.

Good food and fresh bread

The food in the campsite restaurant is excellent, although it is somewhat expensive by Spanish standards. You can, however, order takeaway meals to eat by the tent, caravan or motorhome. The campsite shop stocks limited supplies, but there is fresh bread available daily. You can do your main grocery shopping in the nearby town of Etxarri-Aranatz.

properties.name: Camping du Lac de Saint-Cyr
properties.description:
Camping du Lac de Saint-Cyr is rustig en schilderachtig gelegen in het departement Vienne (Poitou-Charentes). De camping ligt tussen de belangrijkste plaatsen Poitiers (twintig kilometer) en Châtellerault (vijftien kilometer) in. Zoals de naam al prijsgeeft, ligt de camping aan het meer van Saint-Cyr en in het recreatiepark van Saint-Cyr. Dit is een ideaal uitgangspunt voor een onvergetelijke vakantie vol water en plezier.

Bijzondere kampeerervaring

Breng je vakantie door op een van de ruime kampeerplaatsen, die gescheiden zijn door heggen. Daarnaast kun je op camping du Lac de Saint-Cyr ook kiezen voor een stacaravan, een ingerichte tent of een lodge. Wil je een bijzondere kampeerervaring? Kies dan voor de nieuwe ecolodge (2020) of voor de yurt, die omgeven is door bloemperken.

Zwembad

Het zwembad op de camping is uitgerust met watervallen, massagestralen, een peuterbadje en een bubbelbank. Dankzij deze voorzieningen biedt het verwarmde zwembad plezier voor de hele familie.

Naar het meer!

Daarnaast heeft de camping een eigen toegang (met een speciale pas) tot het meer van Saint-Cyr en een eigen zandstrand. Het 85 hectare grote meer leent zich uitstekend voor activiteiten en ook voor veilig (onder toezicht) zwemplezier. Ga lekker vissen, windsurfen, kanoën, waterfietsen, peddelsurfen of spelen op het opblaasbare aquapark. Ook een potje golf, tennis of beachvolleybal behoort tot de opties. En wat te denken van mooie wandel- en fietstochten rond het meer? Tussen 10:00 en 12:00 kun je gratis kano’s en waterfietsen lenen.

De camping organiseert wandelingen, fietstochten en culinaire activiteiten. En dan zorgen ze in het hoogseizoen ook nog eens voor een Kids Club (6-12 jaar).

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Domaine de la Dragonnière
properties.description:
Camping Sandaya Domaine de la Dragonnière is a luxurious and child-friendly campsite in Vias, in the Languedoc-Roussillon region. The term 'luxury holiday village' seems more appropriate for this domain, which offers truly every modern comfort and an extensive range of facilities.

Children reign supreme

The youngest campers reign supreme on Camping Sandaya Domaine de la Dragonnière. There are several kids' clubs available for them. The Baby Club is for children aged 2 to 5 years, the Sunny Club is for children aged 6 to 12 years and the Youth Club is for 13 to 17-year-olds. In July and August, a free train drives through the campsite.

Fun or zen

The campsite offers 18000 square metres of water fun with three aqua parks, each with its own ambiance. The 'Sports and Games' park features four swimming pools, of which three are heated, a four-lane water slide, paddling pools, and play equipment. There is an indoor swimming pool complex and, as of 2017, a large lagoon with palm trees, waterfalls and fine white sand! In the 'Espace Zen', you can completely unwind in a Graeco-Roman-themed environment.

Luxury accommodations

Camping here isn't exactly what you would call primitive. The pitches are spacious, surrounded by Mediterranean greenery, and equipped with heated private bathrooms. The rental accommodations vary from simply furnished tents and chalets to highly luxurious mobile homes with dishwashers and designer fittings. The accommodations are grouped into 'neighbourhoods' with similar types of accommodations.

Plenty of dining options

Throughout the entire season, you can enjoy the Mediterranean cuisine in the main restaurant 'La Terrasse'. In July and August, the 'Garden Grill' and the Rôtisserie are open as well. At Le Jack's, you can feast on hamburgers, mussels, pizzas, tortillas, salads and children's menus. You can even have your food delivered your tent or caravan!

properties.name: Camping Sandaya L'Anse du Brick
properties.description:
At Camping Sandaya L'Anse du Brick in Maupertus-sur-Mer, you’ll enjoy a pleasant holiday on the Normandy coast. Choose from a range of luxury accommodation and camping pitches with a sea view. Enjoy facilities like heated swimming pools, a solarium and a bar. The surroundings invite you to head off on nature walks and explore historic sites. This small, five-star campsite uniquely combines tranquillity, nature and luxury.

Large pitches and luxury accommodation

There are numerous accommodation options at Camping Sandaya L'Anse du Brick, from luxury mobile homes to comfortable lodge tents. Each option offers space and comfort and some even panoramic sea views. Whether you are with family, friends or alone, there’s always accommodation to suit you. Pitch your tent on a large camping pitch or opt for a villa with the best views. All accommodation is well-equipped and spread over a green, hilly site for maximum privacy and tranquillity.

Swimming fun in the water park

The campsite has excellent facilities. The swimming pool is halfway up the hill next to the bar/pizzeria. In the water park, you’ll find both indoor and outdoor pools, perfect for any weather. With a large slide and a separate paddling pool, there’s plenty of water fun for young and old alike. You can also enjoy relaxing in the spa or grab a bite to eat overlooking the sea in the modern restaurant.

Explore Normandy

Explore the rugged nature along the Normandy coast or take a trip to historic sites like the invasion beaches. There’s plenty to see and do for nature and history lovers. For example, walking trails or a day at the beach.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Le Plein Air des Chênes
properties.description:
The Sandaya Le Plein Air des Chênes Campsite is located in the green belt of Montpellier. From this beautiful four-star campsite, it is only eight kilometres to this cultural city. The area around the campsite offers you a mix of the sunny interior, the beautiful Mediterranean Sea and the Camargue gardoise. This nature reserve, also called Petite Camargue, consists mainly of lakes, reed beds and marsh terraces.

In the shady oak forest

At this campsite, you'll find a varied selection of caravans, lodge tents and camping pitches. The camping sites include private sanitary facilities. Everything is located in a beautiful and shady oak forest.

On to the beach

Le Plein Air des Chênes' 1,200 m² aqua park is the perfect place to swim and splash around. There are four swimming pools with all the trimmings. And you can sunbathe by the water. Are you more of a beach lover? Then hop on the campsite's free shuttle bus. Before you know it, you're on the beach. The beaches of Palavas-les-Flots, Carnon, La Grande Motte and Grau-du-Roi are a good thirty minutes' drive away.

A comprehensive offer

The Sandaya Le Plein Air des Chênes Campsite offers an extensive range of entertainment for the young and old. There are all kinds of free clubs for children ages five to seventeen. Children are assigned to one of three groups based on age. From sporting events, performances to themed evenings; there's plenty to choose from. There is also plenty for adults to choose from. How about beach volleyball, fitness, petanque and water polo? In addition, the campsite has a bar, snack bar and an attractive restaurant.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Les Tamaris
properties.description:
This campsite is located in the French department of Hérault (Languedoc-Rousillon). You'll be camping close to the beach at Frontignan-Plage. At the campsite, the entertainment teams, water park and sports fields provide plenty of fun.

Camping near the beach

You are here at a real beach campsite with a wide variety of pitches. They are mostly located on grassland and are demarcated. But there is a difference in the degree of shade and the size of the pitch. The most beautiful spots are close to the sea. Don't have your own camping equipment? Then book one of the mobile homes (cottages) or chalets. They can accommodate groups of up to six people.

Water fun!

The beautiful water park of Sandaya Les Tamaris campsite is divided into four pools: a pool for swimming, a pool with slides, fountains and water jets, a toddlers' pool and a play pool with a "mushroom shower". All pools are heated. The entire complex is walled. You'll be swimming in full sun here, so sunscreen is definitely a must. On the shore, you will find the requisite loungers to work on your tan.

Here on the coast, the French coast. Here you will experience the ultimate in water fun. Because if you simply cross the road at the campsite, you will find yourself on a large sandy beach. For a fee, you can rent comfortable loungers or use the private section of the beach.

Bites and drinks

At the Sandaya Les Tamaris campsite, you will find a supermarket with a wide range of products. Here you will find everything you need to put a delicious meal on your camping table. Or you can opt for convenience and take a seat at the restaurant.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Douce Quiétude
properties.description:
Less than ten minutes from the Mediterranean Sea, at the foot of the Esterel Mountains, you will find Camping Sandaya Douce Quiétude. If you are looking for a lively family campsite on the French Côte-d'Azur, this is the place to be. In need of a day of sun, sea and beach? Take the shuttle bus and within ten minutes you are standing with your feet in the sand!

Consideration for nature

Camping Douce Quiétude is situated in woody surroundings on top of a hill. The large site has almost ninety pitches that have been laid out with great attention to the natural environment. The pitches vary from 60-100 m2. There are some pitches with private sanitary facilities. The campsite has a wide choice of rental accommodations, some even with their own whirlpool bath. For real luxury seekers!

All kinds of water fun

The campsite has two large swimming pools with jacuzzis in between. One of the pools has a slide and there is a paddling pool with play equipment. If you want some relaxing time for yourself, you can treat yourself at the campsite's wellness centre.

Entertainment for children and teenagers

Both children and teenagers can count on having a good time at the recreational facilities. There are three clubs for children of different ages. The entertainment team organises sporting activities such as aqua gym and walking tours, as well as fun shows and disco evenings.

Dining by the pool

Next to the swimming pool you will find the restaurant. Here you can enjoy Mediterranean and international specialities. In the evening, the sun loungers give way to tables for fine dining. Special is the possibility to book half or full board for your stay.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya La Nublière
properties.description:
Camping Sandaya La Nublière is located on the southernmost point of Lake Annecy. Before reaching the campsite, you drive alongside the lake which is surrounded by mountains. Once you arrive at the campsite, you have a choice of your own pitch, lodge tent, chalet or caravan. The recently renovated campsite has a new water playground and a wellness area.

A large village

When you arrive at the campsite, you will be warmly welcomed in the renovated reception. You will then imagine yourself in a large village with beautifully landscaped flowerbeds. On one side of the terrain, you will find a large number of tall trees; the other side has more open spaces. The campsite comprises a total of 57 pitches and 257 rental accommodation units. These accommodation units range from lodge tents and chalets to (premium) mobile homes. The campsite has three sanitary buildings, surrounded by flowers and plants.

Lake Annecy

The campsite lies in a beautiful location on Lake Annecy and is one of few campsites with direct access to a beach. After a refreshing dive in the clear blue water, you can relax on the sunbathing lawn. Enjoy the view of the surrounding mountains. The lake is an ideal spot for water sports enthusiasts. The water playground for children as well as a wellness area for adults are recent additions to the campsite. At the wellness area, you can enjoy the sauna, steam bath, jacuzzi and swimming pool.

Fun for young and old

The campsite has also taken the little ones into account with a playground, mini club and entertainment programme. Special disco evenings are organised for young guests. Sports enthusiasts can play a game of table tennis or enjoy a game of beach volleyball or pétanque.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya L'Île des Papes
properties.description:
Surrounded by the Rhône River, Camping Sandaya L’Île des Papes is situated on the tip of a small island. This campsite offers various types of accommodation besides the camping pitches. In summer you can use the heated swimming pools. The entertainment team does everything in its power to entertain guests. A visit to Avignon and the world-famous Palais des Papes is an absolute must.

Camping pitches and types of accommodation.

The campsite rents out mobile homes. The campsite also has about 70 pitches. All pitches are provided with electricity.

Fun in the water

If the weather permits, you can jump in the outdoor swimming pool of the campsite. A special children's pool with play equipment and a slide is also available. The paddling pool is suitable for tiny toddlers! The campsite is situated on the Rhône, but this river is not suitable for swimming. However, it is ideal for fishing.

Activities for all ages

There is plenty to do for both young and old in the peak season (early July to end August)! Children will enjoy themselves in a kids' club, go dancing in the mini disco or join the craft activities. Adults are also not left out: walks, excursions, karaoke and film evenings. If you like to work out during your holiday, there are special fitness sessions to take part in.

Grab a bite

You can enjoy a tasty breakfast, lunch and dinner in the campsite restaurant. Alternatively, head to the pizzeria for a bite to eat or get a snack from the snack bar.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Val André
properties.description:
If you are looking for a campsite by the sea in the French region of Brittany, then look no further. Camping Sandaya Val André is at the highest point of the French coastal resort of Pléneuf-Val-André. You only have to walk 300 metres from the campsite to get to the sandy beach and into the sea! You can come here for relaxation on the water, but also for sporting activities and fun excursions.

Camping pitches with sea views

Camping Sandaya Val André has 55 camping pitches and over 60 accommodation for hire. The pitches are at least 90 m2 in size. You have lovely views of the bay of Saint-Brieuc and over Pléneuf-Val-André from some pitches. If you don’t have your own camping equipment, no problem. Hire one of the luxury cottages with veranda or stay in a cool lodge tent.

Exceptional entertainment programme

Throughout the whole season you can use the bakery service. In the high season you can get tasty snacks from the snack bar and have a drink on the bar's patio. Little ones will certainly not get bored here, there is a very extensive entertainment programme in the high season.

History, green and gastronomy

This quiet part of the Brittany region offers many options. Discover the rich history, the countryside, the French specialities. You can, for example, visit Erquy (12 km) or the well-known port city of Saint-Malo (54 km).

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Le Moulin de l'Eclis
properties.description:
If you're looking for a holiday full of sun, sea, beach and sporting activities, Sandaya Le Moulin de l'Eclis is the place to be. At this campsite in Assérac (Loire-Atlantique), you'll find the perfect balance between a dynamic and a relaxing holiday. There is an attractive restaurant where fun theme nights are organised. Its bay-front location makes it a perfect destination for families and kite surfers alike.

View of the sea

The most beautiful places can be found under the old pines overlooking the sea. Sunnier camping is available on the higher portion of the campsite. If you prefer to rent accommodation, you have a lot to choose from at the Sandaya Le Moulin de l'Eclis Campsite. There are several modern cottages and chalets.

Indoor and outdoor swimming

The campsite has a large pool complex with no less than three slides, a toddler area and a spa. The pool has a retractable cover, so you can also take a dip in the early and late season. Those who are ready for a little relaxation can enjoy the hot tub or sauna.

Good place to be at the bay

The campsite provides direct access to the sandy beach. Because of its location on a small bay, the water is calm and slopes gently. Ideal for children. Note that there is a big difference between low and high tide here. Therefore, swimming is possible only when the water is high. At low tide, it's fun to seek out sea creatures and shells. Disabled campers have also been considered. In fact, there are two wheelchairs that allow guests with disabilities to visit the beach.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Parc la Clusure
properties.description:
Sandaya Parc la Clusure campsite is located in the Belgian Ardennes. You can camp here on a spacious pitch, or in rental accommodation. Due to its location on a river, there's always the opportunity to cool down on a hot summer's day. As well as plenty of outdoor activities in the beautiful location, there's lots to do at the campsite itself, for children as well as adults.

A steep narrow road brings you to the campsite entrance; for some campers who are towing a caravan, this can be a challenge. Flags from different European countries fly at the reception, welcoming all holidaymakers. The well-kept greenery, flowers, and the natural surroundings characterise this campsite.

Building dams and rafts

The many rivers and extensive forests in the area ensure you keep cool during the warm summers. A calm river in the Ardennes is also an ideal playground (for older children). It's a great place to get together with new friends and build dams and rafts. Or, take part in the campsite-organised activity "Having fun in the river" - a guaranteed afternoon of fun in the water with just inflatable armbands or a pool float. Bring aqua shoes with you, as there are sometimes slippery stones on the riverbed.

Meter-high stalactites

One thing you should definitely do if you're staying at the Sandaya Parc la Clusure campsite, is to visit the Grotten van Han (Han Caves) in Han-sur-Lesse. This world-famous landmark is less than 10km from the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Le Ranolien
properties.description:
In the western tip of one of the most beautiful regions of Brittany, you will find this luxury campsite in a wonderful location. At Camping Sandaya Le Ranolien you can combine a holiday in nature with plenty of facilities and entertainment for the whole family. Do you prefer to come off-season to walk the coastal path 'Sentier des Douaniers' or to make beautiful cycle trips? Then too, you'll find a great base with all amenities at hand.

Fairytale cliffs

And then you suddenly find yourself in an exceptionally beautiful part of France: the so-called Côte de Granite Rose of Brittany. This is a fairytale landscape with impressive cliffs and rocks and wonderful hidden bays. During a walk along this coast, you will be surprised every time by a new view of the impressive landscape.

Extensive facilities

And it's not just the surroundings that are first-rate here. The campsite itself is completely tip-top. The staff are very friendly and helpful and you will find all the facilities you could wish for. From the gym and wellness to a cool stunt scooter track.

For campers with their own tent, caravan or motor home, there are about 110 pitches available. The sanitary building is clean and well equipped with children's sanitary, a baby room and sanitary that is accessible for the disabled. Do you like swimming, waterslides, paddling or scuba diving? You can do it all at Le Ranolien campsite. The centre of the campsite is a beautiful pool complex with an indoor pool, several smaller outdoor pools and beautifully laid out slides among the rocks.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Le Littoral
properties.description:
Campsite Sandaya Le Littoral has an exceptionally fine location by the sea, less than three kilometres away from the town of Talmont-Saint-Hilaire with its restaurants and a daily market. From the campsite, you have direct access to a sandy beach and the sea. Here, you will find yourself on a well-tended and very large campsite with every comfort and a beautiful swimming pool. The touring pitches are spread out between the mobile homes as if you're camping in a village.

Standard or comfort?

The pitches are separated by hedges and there are enough trees to provide the necessary shade. They are spacious enough to accommodate a car with a caravan or a motorhome. The layout is clearly structured with pitches organised in long rows on either side of paved lanes. A 'standard' pitch measures 100 m² and comfort pitches are 130 m² in size.

Top-class water paradise

The campsite boasts a water complex with a large heated outdoor pool with water slides (aqua splash), rapids, a separate paddling pool, jacuzzis and a solarium with loungers where you can sunbathe.

Next to this outdoor complex lies a new covered swimming complex measuring 270 m² with a spa (massaging jets, anatomic benches and bubble baths), a covered aqua splash area and a heated paddling pool measuring 120 m² with all sorts of water games. The complex lies near the campsite entrance, next to the restaurant, and is located in the full sun among the palm trees.

Lots of amenities

Sandaya Le Littoral has a large shop with a wide range of products. There is also a large bar with a patio offering views of the swimming pool and a restaurant with an extensive menu. You will find other shops and a supermarket some three kilometres away.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya l'Estanquet
properties.description:
At l'Estanquet campsite, you camp between the sea, nature and lots of beautiful sights in the French region of Charente-Maritime. Relax on the Côte Sauvage, dip into the heated pool complex and hop on a bike to explore the area. The choice is endless this holiday!

Beautiful accommodations

There are beautiful, demarcated camping pitches (with private toilet and shower facilities), but most of the campsite is occupied by rental accommodation. The choice is vast: there are no less than 13 different types of accommodation! From a small cottage for two, to a chalet for seven, there is sure to be a nice option for you. And: your four-legged friend is always welcome too!

Swimming and barbecue

In the huge 500 m2 heated pool (with slides!), you will have a great time. Finished swimming? Relax on one of the loungers or settle down on the terrace of the campsite restaurant, which is right next to the pool.

Children certainly won't be bored at l'Estanquet campsite either. For the youngest campers, the campsite organises free kids' clubs and lots of other fun activities. There is plenty for adults to do as well. Join one of the barbecue evenings or dance along to the live music!

Discover the varied Charente-Maritime region

Spend a lazy day on the sandy beaches of the Côte Sauvage, a 10-minute drive away. Visit the island of Île-d'Aix (60 km) and hike through nature. Or head to the larger island of Île d'Oléron (38 km). Prefer the atmosphere of the big city around you? Visit the lively port city of La Rochelle (70 km).

properties.name: Camping Kerabus
properties.description:
Camping de Kérabus is located just north of the Breton town of Carnac, known for its many menhirs. This family campsite, brightened up by many flowers, will delight small children. With a nice swimming pool and a large playground, they'll have plenty to enjoy. Apart from playing children, it's mainly peace and quiet that reigns over the campsite.

Quiet and green campsite

You imagine yourself in a large garden when you're camping at the Kérabus campsite. Beautiful paths lead through the colourful campsite to the touring pitches, which are delimited by trees. Because of this you don't have too much privacy, but you do get a spacious feeling. Moreover, you have a good view on the flowers, which brighten up the campsite. The many greenery, the neatly laid out camping pitches, the unobstructed view: everything provides peace and quiet.

Safe swimming pool

Near the entrance you will find the nice swimming pool. This semi-circular outdoor pool is not too big, but big enough for children to spend the necessary hours of water fun. Next to it a round paddling pool. Thatched umbrellas brighten up the pool. There is a fence around the whole area for safety.

The megaliths of Carnac

It is a special sight: fields full of menhirs, arranged in rows, from small to large. Whichever way you walk from the campsite, you'll find them everywhere. Over a length of eight kilometres the megaliths stand around the Breton landscape. The first of these huge stones were probably placed around 5,000 BC. How were they placed? That's still a mystery...

properties.name: L'Oasis des Garrigues
properties.description:
The quiet family campsite L'Oasis des Garrigues allows you to camp right next to the Ardèche river in French region with the same name. The area is known for its natural beauty and idyllic villages. Walking tours take you through the mountainous landscape. The small campsite exudes tranquillity and charm. If you enjoy swimming, you can do so in the outdoor swimming pool or 150 metres away in the river. The bar is open the whole day for breakfast, an ice cream or a drink.

Camping amid the trees

The campsite is on the outskirts of a quiet residential area and has 59 well-kept pitches. The site has many trees and bushes. The touring pitches are mainly in the area of the terrace and the swimming pool. If you would like to stay overnight in an attractive chalet or a mobile home, you will enjoy comfort and have a covered outdoor terrace.

Swimming pool and bar together

The outdoor swimming pool has a separate paddling pool section for the youngest campsite visitors. For families, the location of the swimming pool next to the bar and the playground is ideal. In July and August the bar is open and owners Céline and Julien ensure a hospitable atmosphere. The bar also serves breakfast in the morning sun. Dance nights and karaoke are organised regularly on the covered terrace and children may participate in the entertainment.

Playing in the river

The river, which is within walking distance, is a wonderful outdoor playground. The pebbled beach ensures safe access for children. The more adventurous go a little further up river to jump from a rock placed for that purpose.

properties.name: Camping De Geelders
properties.description:
Whether you enjoy cycling, walking or simply relaxing, Camping De Geelders offers everything you could want in a peaceful 50+ campsite. Camping De Geelders is located on the edge of the rural village of Olland, surrounded by a green and varied landscape of meadows, forests and farms. You will be camping between Den Bosch and Eindhoven, ideal for a day of shopping.

Peace, nature and Brabant hospitality

With 25 spacious pitches spread over three attractive fields, you can enjoy privacy and comfort here. Cars stay in the car park, keeping the site safe and quiet. Most pitches have a paved terrace. Thanks to the natural vegetation, you can always find a nice sheltered spot. Your dog is also welcome here.

Camping on the farm

The owners run a calf farm next to the campsite. They are happy to share stories about farm life and working with the animals. And you can also take a look at the calves. If the weather is bad, you can visit the recreation room 't Onderonsje.

Cycling paradise in the heart of Brabant

Camping De Geelders is particularly popular among cyclists and walkers. From the campsite, you can easily access the junction network for beautiful routes through the De Geelders nature reserve, the Dommel valley or to charming places such as Schijndel, Sint-Oedenrode or Liempde.

Explore the region

From the campsite, it is a 15-minute cycle to the well-known camping shop De Wit in Schijndel, which is a nice outing. Along the way, you will pass farmers selling local products such as honey, asparagus, jam, or locally brewed beer.

properties.name: Randsverk Camping
properties.description:
Oppland is one of the most beautiful provinces of Norway, where the village of Vågå is located between three national parks. Some 30 km south of Vågå, Randsverk Camping is situated directly on the National-Touristic route 51, so that the campsite forms an ideal base for a hike through the magnificent nature.

In addition to its strategic location between the national parks Jotunheimen, Dovrefjell en Rondane, Vågå (also referred to as Vågåmo) is especially known for its beautiful church (partly 12th century).

Into the wild

In the midst of the panoramic scenery of Oppland, Randsverk Camping is situated on the intersection between Road 51 and Road 257. You will find the reception directly at the entrance in an imposing log cabin. The adjacent cafetaria, with comprehensive menu, is a great place to spend time.

The campsite has a somewhat terraced lay-out and offers flat, free and spacious pitches with beautiful views. The grounds are exceptionally well kept, as is the centrally located service building with modern sanitary facilities. At the entrance you will find a well-stocked supermarket for the daily necessities.

Heading out

With so much beauty surrounding it, it goes without saying that (international) guests use the campsite to prepare for their trips in the Norwegian mountain world or to recover after a hike.

Is your interest more in the cultural sphere? Then you can make a day trip from Randverks Camping to Vågå, where the old church is worth a visit. The oldest parts of the church are from a 12th century stave church, but the larger part goes back to the 17th century. The interior, in particular, is really magnificent.

properties.name: Camping Val de Boutonne
properties.description:
The busy campground Val de Boutonne is within walking distance from the town of St. Jean d'Angély. The campground is well maintained and is in a quiet environment in a lovely park by a river and very near a recreation lake. The campsites are between 80 and 100 m2 and are lined up on streets in the shade of deciduous trees. You have the choice of separate or open sites. There are many passers-through who sometimes stay longer than planned because of the beautiful location.

Swimming and shopping

There is a small swimming pool (12 by 7 metres) and a kiddie pool where the guests can sun themselves on the lawn. The lifeguard monitors safety and makes sure that the French hygiene rules are followed. The most popular groceries are available on the campsite. You can order bread for the following morning.

Sporty

The managers rent bikes, mountain bikes, canoes, kayaks, water bikes and row boats. So you can enjoy the lake and the surrounding area. The campsite is located on a cycling route. The lake is popular for anglers and canoers. We recommend having a drink at the restaurant on the lake to watch the sun go down. There are regular fireworks shows and wine tastings.

Beautiful starting point

The campground is near the historic town of St. Jean d'Angély, 3 km from the A10 motorway. An hour's drive away in the tourist area of Charentes you will find lovely villages and sights. The town centre of St. Jean d'Angély, built around the abbey, is an UNESCO World Heritage Site. You can walk there in just ten minutes.

properties.name: Camping D'Arrouach
properties.description:
On the outskirts of Lourdes and at the foot of the Pyrenees, you’ll find the Camping D'Arrouach; an ideal base for excursions to the famous pilgrimage site. The tarrain of this simple, but very well-maintained campsite is laid out around a restored farmhouse on top of a hill. The farm, the restaurant, the sanitary building: everything is equally well-maintained. From the spacious pitches you have a view of the Pyrenees.

View of the Pyrenees

Around the stately farmhouse is the hilly campsite. You have a view of the mountains from the flat, delimited pitches. The various rental accommodations, situated on terraces, also have a view of the Pyrenees. These mobile homes and Coco Sweet lodge tents are nicely integrated in the terrain.

Lake Lourdes

The campsite does not have a swimming pool, but within walking distance (1.5 km) you’ll find Lake Lourdes. The lake can be reached via a dirt road through the meadows. Here you can have a lovely swim. Further on, in the river, you can go fishing, kayaking and rafting.

Attractive restaurant with local products

Next to the reception, in an old outbuilding of the farm, you will find the sanitary facilities, the recreation room and the campsite restaurant. Although the menu is not very extensive, you can enjoy a delicious meal. Fabian is a good cook who uses only local products for his delicacies. You can also enjoy a drink at the bar in the attractive restaurant. In the main building there are also some local products for sale. You will also find the fitness room and sauna there.

properties.name: Les Prés Hauts Sites & Paysages
properties.description:
This lovely campsite is located in a beautiful, mountainous area in the Alpes-de-Haute-Provence, along the banks of the Durance River. With around 300 sunny days a year, this is one of the most sun-drenched regions in France. The historic centre of the town of Sisteron is only 2.5 kilometres away. Les Prés Hauts Campsite is an ideal base for hiking and mountain sports enthusiasts. The campsite has a beautiful outdoor swimming pool and a nice range of activities in high season.

Well-shaded camping pitches on neatly maintained grounds

New campers are given a warm welcome in the beautiful reception building. It's all about the real camping life here. Tourist camping pitches are the primary form of accommodation. These are spacious and predominantly shaded touring pitches demarcated by natural features. Separate pitches are reserved for caravans and motorhomes. In addition to camping pitches, a small number of comfortable mobile homes are available for rent.

Sunny outdoor swimming pool

A beautiful, rectangular outdoor pool is located behind the reception. This is a wonderful place to cool down on warm summer days. Of course, the pool also provides you an opportunity to do something sporty during your holiday, in the form of swimming laps. Next to the swimming pool is a small paddling pool. Here the youngest campers can splash around in the water to their heart's content.

Fun nights with dancing and playful nature lessons

There are plenty of activities to enjoy at Les Prés Hauts Campsite, especially in high season. Once a week, for example, there is a festive evening with live music performances. And there are regularly fun activities for children during the day.

properties.name: Camping de la Durance
properties.description:
Camping de la Durance is situated at the foot of the Luberon, directly on the Durance. This river forms the natural border between the departments of Vaucluse and Bouches-du-Rhône. This quiet campsite in the heart of Provence is particularly suitable as a stopover for campers travelling to more southerly destinations.

Camping in the green

The elongated avenue with plane trees takes you to the spacious pitches. These are beautifully landscaped in the green surroundings and are separated by hedges. You will see a lot of motorhomes there. There are also pitches especially for tents. These, too, are tastefully situated in the greenery. In addition, you have a choice of around twenty rental accommodations.

Transit campsite

Camping de la Durance is mainly visited by campers in transit to more southerly destinations such as the Côte d'Azur or Corsica. Because of its location, not far from the coast and almost along the Route du Soleil, the campsite is ideal for a stopover of a few nights. But this transit campsite is also perfectly suited as a base from which to explore Provence more extensively.

Municipal swimming pool

There is no swimming pool on the campsite itself, but as a camping guest you can take a dip in the adjoining swimming pool, located on the municipal sports grounds. Here you can also hit a ball on one of the tennis courts.

Facilities

In its facilities, the campsite really characterises itself as a transit campsite. The sanitary facilities are excellent: the toilet block has recently been renovated. But there is no restaurant or shop on the campsite. Not bad, because just outside Cavaillon there are several supermarkets.

properties.name: Camping Paradis de la Motte
properties.description:
Camping de la Motte is located in the hilly countryside of the Vendée. You will find this campsite in the village of Vendrennes, an hour from the Atlantic coast. Fanciful camping pitches are situated around a pond and on spacious lawns. Ideal for both passers-by and families with children. The latter will especially enjoy one of the swimming pools. The campsite's restaurant serves tasty snacks and wines.

Camping with the goats

The pitches at de la Motte campsite are spacious. And for every camper there is a spot to his or her liking. On the fanciful and well-kept camping grounds you will find pitches between large hedges. But you can also choose a spot by the pond. Around which ponies and goats graze.

Passers-by and camping friends

This campsite is a great place for everyone. Whether you stay one night or camp for a fortnight. So it may well be that your neighbours are leaving the very next day. But you can also meet camping friends with whom your children will hang out for weeks.

Splash into the pool

Up the steps, down the slide, splash! Three water slides end up in the outdoor pool at de la Motte campsite. You will find the swimming pool just behind reception. But that's not all. Behind the outdoor pool (with whirlpool) is the indoor pool. There you can swim laps or have a splash with the little ones. Or pack your swimwear and towel for a day at the seaside! An hour's drive and you are on the beach of Saint-Jean-de-Monts.

properties.name: Camping Risle et Seine
properties.description:
Campsite Risle Seine is situated near Toutainville, a village close to the town of Pont-Audemer and directly along a large lake with plentiful water sports opportunities. The region forms part of the Parc Naturel Régional des Boucles de la Seine Normande, an enormous, vast natural area with numerous forests, villages, towns and especially the famous bends in the Seine. This makes the campsite an ideal base for excursions in the area.

Friendly reception

The reception stands out for its explosion of flowers. The entire campsite makes a neat and well maintained impression. The pitches measure some 80-100 m2, slightly deeper than wide, but still sufficiently spacious. They are separated by tall hedges, offering ample privacy. Near the reception is a small campsite shop with a limited range. Additional shopping and restaurants are available in Pont-Audemer. 

On stilts

The rental accommodation is exceptional. There are ten bungalows on stilts near the lake, creating an impression of floating above the water. You are not allowed to swim in the lake, but there is a small swimming pool on the campsite. The lakes around the campsite are eminently suitable for fishing, although it will be a challenge to catch a fish which is large enough for a complete meal. 

Coast and art

Pont-Audemer is not far from the coast. This coast is unique because it takes less than half an hour to drive to Honfleur. This town is illustrious because the picturesque harbour has been immortalised many times by artists such as Gustave Courbet and Claude Monet.

properties.name: Camping Du Lac
properties.description:
Camping Du Lac is an excellently maintained campsite in the middle of a rural area in the department of Gers. The campsite is within walking distance of a beautiful recreational lake and the centre of Marciac. This town is known for its international jazz festival (August). The campsite has a terraced character and shaded pitches. There is a heated swimming pool and a bar with pavement café.

Lots of variation in touring pitches and accommodations

At the front of the property you will find many tall trees that provide shade. Some pitches are surrounded and delimited by hedges, others have a more open character. There are also several rental accommodations. These vary from lodge tents for two people to fully equipped mobile homes for up to eight people.

Swimming and sunbathing

Those who feel like taking a refreshing dip can go to a (heated) swimming pool. Around the pool there are sun loungers, ideal for getting a tan. Would you rather lie in the shade? No problem, there are plenty of parasols available.

Skittles and water sports

Camping Du Lac has a separate play ground where children can enjoy themselves in a sporty way. During the high season, campers of all ages can participate in 'Quills de Gascogne', a local game similar to skittles. At 300 metres from the campsite there is a beautiful recreational lake, ideal for lovers of water sports such as kayaking and fishing.

Bar with attractive pavement café

Close to the campsite entrance and the swimming pool you will find the bar with an attractive pavement café. Delicacies such as snacks, sandwiches and local wines are available. You can also order breakfast here. The baker from Marciac delivers freshly baked bread to the campsite every morning.

properties.name: Flower Camping La Beaume
properties.description:
Flower Camping La Beaume is located in the south of France, hidden in the Alpine mountains. Far away from the urbanised world you can celebrate your holiday here. Camp in the wooded countryside on a spacious pitch where peace and quiet reign. Close to the campsite is Esparron Lake: the ideal spot for a refreshing dip. You can also jump in the campsite swimming pool.

Camping in the countryside

This campsite has taken camping in nature to a higher level. The large lawns offer spacious pitches. Here you can camp peacefully between trees and bushes. With a lot of privacy and a spectacular view over the mountains. The silence here can be at least as impressive. A place therefore that is ideal for a quiet camping holiday in nature.

Water fun and aquagym

You can have fun with the whole family in the swimming pool. This small but lovely pool is heated and covered. So you are protected from the sun and always jump into a warm pool. For the little ones, there is a water playground next to the pool. That's great for splashing and paddling! Do you want to start your day well? Then join in the aqua gym and stay fit during your holiday.

Shopping in Greoux-les-Bains

Camping far from civilisation also means being far from the facilities. So if you want to prepare a camping meal, you have to get in the car. Greoux-les-Bains (15 km) is the obvious place to do your shopping. It is certainly not a punishment to look for a supermarket there. Greoux-les-Bains is a pleasant town with nice shops and outdoor cafés.

properties.name: Camping Paradis des Pins-Soulac
properties.description:
Camping Paradis des Pins-Soulac is located on the Médoc peninsula, the wine region above Bordeaux on the western bank of the Gironde. Here you'll camp in a forest on the west coast of France, close to the Atlantic Ocean. The sea here is not only great for swimmers; also lots of surfers also head for the Atlantic coast. And of course wine lovers will also enjoy the region.

Camping in the forest

The location of the campsite, in the middle of a forest and close to the beach, has many advantages. You camp on a very quiet spot, which is largely sheltered by the dense foliage of the trees. In order to preserve the peace and quiet, cars are only allowed on the site upon arrival and departure. In between your car is parked on a separate parking lot. A disadvantage of camping in the woods is the subsoil; the touring pitches are on loose sand. It can take a while to level your camping equipment.

The Atlantic Ocean

Near the entrance of the campsite you will find the swimming pool. This is quite simple: rectangular and large enough, with a small area for toddlers. A nice place to cool down. You can also decide to go to the beach, which is perhaps easiest to reach by bike. Although you can also easily walk the two kilometers.

Soulac-sur-Mer

At the campsite you can eat a pizza in the restaurant, but if you want to taste local dishes, Soulac-sur-Mer is a great destination. You can count on it that one of the restaurants on the boulevard will serve different kinds of seafood.

properties.name: Camping de la Plage
properties.description:
A small, intimate campsite half a kilometre from the beach: camping de la Plage is located on the north coast of the Cotentin in Normandy. With pitches among flowers, free showers and a few luxury glamping tents, you'll soon feel at home there. A few minutes walk and you're on the beach.

From Caen, the N13 takes you north via Bayeux to the Cotentin peninsula. You drive through a flat landscape with a lot of forest and scattered picturesque stone houses. Once you've passed Valognes, it's only half an hour to the campsite, where an enthusiastic couple will make you feel right at home at camping de la Plage.

Between flowers and trees

The touring pitches have been carefully laid out between the flowers on beautiful lawns. Special are the wooden cabins and the spacious glamping tents. Furthermore, there are forty places reserved for regular guests, mainly French. They are all friendly holidaymakers looking for peace and quiet and small-scale conviviality. The touring campers come from all over Europe to enjoy the calm life on the coast. Just four hundred metres from the campsite you'll find a quiet beach. There you can sunbathe or take a dip in the sea.

Small and intimate

On the campsite you'll find fun playgrounds, a mini golf course and a court to play jeu de boules. The recreation room has a friendly bar with tables and chairs. The modern sanitary facilities are very clean.

properties.name: Flower Camping de l'Olivigne
properties.description:
In the southern French region of Languedoc-Roussillon, among endless vineyards and olive groves, lies Flower Camping de l'Olivigne. This beautiful campsite is within walking distance of the medieval town of Bize-Minervois. Here, you will enjoy peace, conviviality and lots of water fun in the ecological swimming pool and the river Cesse.

Beautiful campsite

As you drive onto the grounds, you immediately notice that this is a well-maintained campsite. Everything is beautifully laid out. The roads are good, the sites spacious and easily accessible. All camping facilities such as sanitary facilities, water, electricity, power and dirty water disposal are nearby. Spend the night in your own camping equipment or in caravan, lodge tent or hiker's hut.

Kids club, social evenings and excursions

In high season, the campsite is mostly visited by families from all kinds of countries. Fun activities and games are then organised for little ones between the ages of two and eight. Families know how to find the playground, sports field and table tennis table. For the adults, there are cozy evenings where meals are eaten together. You can also opt for a guided excursion to Bize-Minervois.

Chlorine-free swimming

What is a camping vacation without water fun? For that, you'll be fine at the de l'Olivigne Campsite. There is a fine, ecological outdoor chlorine-free pool. This is because the water in the pool is naturally purified. Directly near the campsite also runs the river Cesse. You can have fun swimming, paddling and clambering over the rocks here. You can find even more water fun in the village of Bize-Minervois, within walking distance of the campsite. Here is a charming outdoor pool.

properties.name: Flower Camping Le Pré des Sables
properties.description:
Flower Camping Le Pré des Sables is situated north of the coastal town of La Rochelle, on the edge of the village of L'Aiguillon-sur-Mer. The Atlantic Ocean is just a stone's throw away, but the campsite also has a lovely swimming pool for plenty of swimming fun. The campsite is situated between the sea and the forest and it only takes a 10 minute walk to get to L'Aiguillon-sur-Mer with its shops and good places to eat. The nearest beach is Plage des Bélugas, just 2 kilometres away. You can easily discover the beautiful nature by bike or on foot. Children will have a great time in the covered swimming pool and there are fun activities on the programme during the high season.

Camping in the Vendée

The department of Vendée in the South West of France is a varied region. Ideal as a holiday destination because of the marshes, sandy beaches, nice bathing resorts and rocky coasts. You drive the last kilometres towards the coast through rural Vendée. Just at the roundabout you will find the well maintained campsite with many trees. In a small building at the entrance you will find the reception where Félix and Fanny welcome you. The medium-sized campsite has spacious pitches and is situated in the middle of a lovely walking and cycling area. Near the campsite there are routes that are also suitable for children, for example through the dunes that are so characteristic of this nature-rich region.

Space and privacy

All camping pitches are neatly grouped along charming streets. The sanitary building has recently been renovated and looks neat. Most of the pitches are very spacious and you can choose a nice spot in the sun or perhaps go for some more shade. Characteristic for the pitches is the delimitation by low hedges. If you prefer a more luxurious night, you can rent one of the beautiful glamping accommodations. Choose from a trendy Coco sweet tent, a mobile home or a furnished wooden lodge.

properties.name: Camping Les Pins du Soleil
properties.description:
Camping Les Pins du Soleil is situated on the outskirts of Dax, which is well known for its popular spa. The centre of Dax, the capital of Landes, is some 3.5 km away from the campsite. Landes is a wooded region along the Atlantic Coast. This region used to be marshy, but under the reign of Napoleon III thousands of pine trees were planted and the region became habitable.

Watching TV on your camping pitch

The pitches on the campsite are fairly spacious and have television connections. However, you need a long cable for this (15-20 m). Camping Les Pins du Soleil also has rental accommodation units, such as bungalow tents, mobile homes and chalets. A number of these units are situated close to the entrance of the campsite.

All types of entertainment

There are various sports facilities on camping Les Pins du Soleil: a volleyball and badminton field, table tennis table, basket ball and soccer area and a fitness area for adults. From June to late September, activities are organised on weekdays (country performances, events and dance evenings). During the rest of the day, activities are organised for different age groups (pony rides, archery, water polo and Zumba).

The swimming pool on the campsite has a separate toddler pool and a heated bubble bath. There are sun loungers around the swimming pool. The distance from the campsite to the sea is approx. 30 km.

Relaxing under shade cloth at Cabana Elisé

There is a shop with limited supplies on the campsite. Warm and cold dishes are available at Cabana Elisé (bar, restaurant and pizzeria). You can also eat outside at the restaurant. The terrace is covered with shade cloth.

properties.name: First Camp Klim Strand - Nordvestkysten
properties.description:
This large family campsite is located on the north-west coast of Jutland, the mainland of Denmark. First Camp Klim Strand - Nordvestkysten is a luxury campsite that is mainly visited by (Danish) families with children. It features a beautiful indoor swimming pool, sports and play facilities, a wellness centre and an excellent restaurant. There's also an extensive entertainment programme during the summer holidays. Moreover, the campsite is right on an expansive beach on the North Sea. There are three beautiful dune paths that lead from the campsite to this beach. You can go on wonderful hiking and cycling tours in the campsite's unspoilt surroundings.

Spacious touring pitches and thatched cottages

There are about 500 spacious touring pitches on this large campsite. These are neatly separated from each other by low shrubs. There are also rental accommodations, including different types of mobile homes and holiday homes. The Strandstuga is the most eye-catching. These are white houses with thatched roofs that are beautifully integrated into the landscape. These accommodations are located on the beach side of the campsite.

Make your way to the waterslide

You can swim laps in the rectangular covered swimming pool. Meanwhile, the children can enjoy themselves in the heated paddling pool. The most eye-catching element of the swimming pool is the playfully designed waterslide. The entrance to the slide can be reached via a climbing wall, but the falling water makes climbing more difficult. Those who successfully make the climb are rewarded with a ride down the spectacular waterslide!

properties.name: First Camp Grenen Strand
properties.description:
