First Camp Grenen Strand – Skagen is located at the tip of Denmark, at the Kattegat and the Skagerrak. The campsite is located directly on a private beach and is within walking distance of the attractive town of Skagen. The site is well-maintained and is an excellent base for discovering the North Jutland region with the family. Skagen and Aalborg are good destinations for a daytrip./p>

Clean and simple

The campsite has pitches with some shade and there are several accommodations for rent. The sanitary facilities are well-maintained and there is a playground for the children. The bungalows at First Camp Grenen Strand – Skagen are beautifully decorated. This way you have your own toilet and bathroom and, in the most luxurious ones, you can jump into your own jacuzzi.

Kilometres of beach

You can get a breath of fresh air on the sandy beaches of North Jutland. You have direct access to the beach from the campsite. You can walk for kilometres here or you can take a ride with the "Sandormen". This traditional tractor transports nature lovers every day and is suitable for young and old. This is also a great place for those who want a more active camping holiday. Cycle with the whole family through the rugged dunes or master the waves by (learning) windsurfing.

Natural phenomenon

You should certainly not miss a visit to the "meeting of the two seas". Just above the town of Skagen, the Kattegat and Skagerrak intersect, creating a special pattern in the sea. The surf from both sides is a beautiful natural phenomenon, but be careful. The current is treacherously strong here, so you are not allowed to swim on this stretch.

properties.name: First Camp Holbaek Fjord
properties.description:
First Camp Holbæk Fjord - Sjælland, a campsite on the island of Zealand (Sjælland), is situated in the middle of the Danish fjord landscape. In these vast and green surroundings with beautiful beaches, you will instantly find yourself in a holiday atmosphere. Do you like to cycle, sail or play golf? Or are you looking for a holiday full of water fun and games with the children? This beautiful and modern campsite offers you plenty of opportunities for both.

Camping in style

The campsite has two hundred generally spacious pitches spread out over multiple fields. Everywhere you look on the grounds, you will notice that this campsite is well-tended. In addition to the camping pitches, there are also several cabins, mobile homes and caravans available for rent. Several cabins have been modified to accommodate the disabled. Just like the rest of the campsite, the sanitary facilities are spotless.

Swimming, playing and jumping

This is not a busy campsite full of entertainment, activities and parties. There is no entertainment programme here. But families will definitely not have to feel bored here! There is a fun covered pool with a toddler pool, a playground, a jumping pillow and a recreational area. And you can set up a game of football, basketball or table tennis with the neighbouring children in no time!

There is much more water fun to be had not far from the campsite. Follow the footpath to the small marina and the beach. You will also find a fun town beach in the town of Holbæk. For a more active outing, visit the climbing park or the go-kart track in Holbæk.

Jacuzzi and massage

Are you in the mood for some wellness and relaxation? Campsite guests can make free use of the sauna on the campsite. For that ultimate feeling of luxury, you can order champagne and fruit to enjoy while you're having a soak.

properties.name: First Camp Råbjerg Mile - Skagen
properties.description:
This campsite is located near the northernmost tip of Denmark, surrounded by an unspoilt landscape featuring dunes, forests and beaches. You'll be camping just a few kilometres from the Råbjerg Mile, one of Denmark's most remarkable natural phenomena. This is a huge sand dune that towers some twenty metres above the surrounding landscape.

First Camp Råbjerg Mile - Skagen is a large family campsite with a very friendly atmosphere. The campsite offers: an indoor and outdoor swimming pool, many sports and leisure facilities, a restaurant and a supermarket. The area is also suitable for cyclists and walkers.

Looking for peace and tranquillity? Book a spot in the adults-only area

Many families with children from all over Europe stay here during the high season.

In addition to regular camping pitches, this campsite also offers annual pitches and rental properties.

Campers searching for peace and tranquillity can book a spot in the adults-only area.

Indoor and outdoor pool

There's a beautiful outdoor swimming pool with a paddling pool in a sunny spot. You can plunge into the heated water via the slide. There's also an indoor swimming pool. The indoor pool also features a whirlpool and a sauna.

Sports entertainment

There are playgrounds and sports fields spread across the campsite. There's also a mini golf course. Sports activities are organised in high season, especially for children. These include workouts and sports tournaments.

Supermarket and restaurant

There is a supermarket located next to the reception. There's also a restaurant on the campsite.

properties.name: First Camp Ajstrup Strand
properties.description:
First Camp Ajstrup Strand - Aarhus is located right by the Kattegat, on the east coast of Danish Mid Jutland. You can camp here next to the beach on spacious camping grounds which primarily feature touring pitches. Beachgoers will find their way to the water easily and quickly; within just a few moments, you will feel the sand beneath your feet. With its comprehensive and modern sanitation facilities for young and old, this campsite is fully equipped with all the amenities.

Spacious touring pitches and cosy cabins

380 touring pitches are situated on large lawns which are demarcated by hedges and natural greenery. However, you also have a choice of pitches which are quite separate, offering you ample privacy. The cabins on the campsite are very cosy but may be a tad small for an extended stay.

Beach camping

First Camp Ajstrup Strand - Aarhus is a campsite dedicated to beach and sea enthusiasts. A small path takes you from the campsite to the beach in no time at all. Even though this sandy beach is not excessively broad, beachgoers can relax in the sand for hours on end. Swimmers may also count themselves lucky because the temperature of the water is very pleasant in the summer.

Child-friendly campsite

Young camping guests will definitely enjoy the beach, but the campsite itself also has plenty to offer. They can enjoy themselves to their heart's content in the playground, especially on the popular bouncy castle. A round of mini golf or a game of football with the entire family always makes for lots of fun. The sanitary facilities have been designed with little campers in mind as well. The two large sanitation buildings on the camping grounds include children's sanitary facilities, family bathrooms and baby rooms.

properties.name: First Camp Bøjden Strand
properties.description:
First Camp Bøjden Strand – Fyn is a family campground on the west coast of the Danish island of Funen. Here you can camp directly on the Baltic Sea, on a well-kept campsite with spacious camping pitches. You can look out over the vast water from every location on the sloping terrain. There is daily entertainment for young and old at the campsite with a playground, a beautiful mini golf course and an indoor and outdoor swimming pool. The sea also provides plenty of water fun.

View of the sea

Despite the considerable size of the campsite, finding your camping pitch won't take long. The campsite is well organised. There are 130 camping pitches on well-kept lawns, marked by thick hedges. Because the campsite slopes downwards, even the camping pitches that are closest to the entrance overlook the sea. You can also camp right on the beach.

Swimming indoors or outdoors?

The swimming paradise is at the centre of the campsite. Next to the outdoor swimming pool is a large toddlers' pool, where the smallest water lovers can play under the sprinkler. The older children will especially appreciate the water slide. You have a view of the indoor pool from the outdoor pool. Here too there is something for everyone. The deeper swimming pool is accompanied by a paddling pool with a small castle.

Beach and sea

Not to mention: this campsite is located directly on the Baltic Sea. The beach is not particularly wide, but there's also enough space in the grass for you to spread out your beach towel. The water remains shallow for a long time, so that even the smaller children can paddle safely here. You can reach a slightly deeper part of the sea via a long jetty.

properties.name: Camping Club Mahana By La Pège
Le Verger de Jastres
properties.description:
Le Verger de Jastres is 3 kilometres from Aubenas, centrally located in the popular French Ardèche region. This is a small, atmospheric family campsite by the river Ardèche. Across the river, Jastres hill is the place to head for a beautiful view of from the campsite. Especially at sunset, when you can see the cliffs of the Jastres changing colour. The campsite has a lovely outdoor swimming pool, plenty of sports and play facilities and a varied entertainment programme in high season.

Shaded pitches by the river

There are more tourist pitches than any other pitches on this well-maintained campsite. All the pitches on this shaded site have electricity and a grass surface. Some pitches also have a private toilet and washing unit plus a kitchen and bathroom. Modern mobile homes and chalets are also available for rent at Le Verger de Jastres. The accommodation is close to the swimming pool, while the camping pitches are right by the river, some even right on the bank.

Plenty of sport, games and water fun

The shallow river that runs alongside the campsite is a great place to paddle and cool off. Of course, you could also splash around in the swimming pool (which has a slide). Water polo matches are often held here in summer. There’s always plenty to do on the campsite in high season. For example, original games and sports tournaments for children. In the evening, you’ll enjoy entertainment like live music performances, shows, karaoke and dance evenings. In bad weather, head to the cosy recreation room to play pool, video games and board games, etc.

properties.name: Camping Yelloh! Village Port’Land
properties.description:
Camping Yelloh! Village Portland is located on the coast of Normandy. You will be camping not far from Omaha Beach, one of the invasion beaches where the historical significance of this region can be felt. This beautifully landscaped five-star campsite, with its varied vegetation and water features, looks a lot like a landscape park.

Large, green pitches

The campsite is beautifully landscaped and well maintained. The many greenery provides the necessary shade, but you can also choose a spot in the full sun. There are one hundred and fifty touring pitches, most of which are laid out on grass, others on a combination of grass and gravel. All touring pitches are beautifully spacious and delimited with beautiful green hedges. There are also around one hundred mobile homes for rent on the campsite, as well as twenty-five permanent annual pitches.

Water park

Just behind the entrance, next to the reception, is a water park. There is a simple indoor swimming pool. On nice days the sliding roof is opened. There is also a large, heated outdoor swimming pool with all kinds of slides. Around it is a tiled sundeck with sun loungers. Both inside and outside there is a separate paddling pool for the little ones. The terrace of the restaurant is next to the water park.

Playing in the park

Especially in high season there is plenty to do on the campsite. Then there is an extensive entertainment programme for children and adults. In July and August you can choose from a wide range of fun workshops, concerts, disco and dance evenings, cabaret and live entertainment. If you prefer to make your own plans, you can visit the water park, the sports field, the recreation room or the fishing ponds.

properties.name: Camping Palafavera
properties.description:
In the middle of the Italian mountain range the Dolomites, Palafavera Campsite is a heavenly place to stay. The backdrop of mountain tops and green expanses will make you feel like you're on holiday straight away. The impressive surroundings are a paradise for hikers and nature lovers. This region, in the north of Veneto province, has been on UNESCO's World Heritage list for years. The entrance to the campsite is opposite a large car park on a through road that winds itself through the area. In keeping with the surrounding montane landscape, you'll find the attractive wooden reception on the left, after the barrier. In the nearby village, there's a supermarket and a few restaurants.

Naturally landscaped

Despite the fact that the campsite is surrounded by tall conifers, most of the pitches are open and sunny. Part of the campsite is made up of terraces. The rest is flatter, and lies off a small street. These pitches are particularly suitable for motorhomes, caravans and trailer tents. Camping in a tent is particularly special here, as your pitch is in a beautiful forest. In the winter, this is a perfect winter sports campsite, with ski lifts nearby.

Taste the mountain air

Palafavera Campsite is the ideal starting point for trips in the healthy mountain air by mountain bike, or on foot. There are various routes that will take you to places with panoramic views. The area is also popular for climbing and mountain tours. There's extensive information about all of this at the reception. Prefer a day in the city? Venice is easily accessible by train from Palafavera Campsite.

properties.name: Camping Seekirchen am Wallersee
properties.description:
Beach camping Seekirchen is situated on the southernmost point of the Austrian Wallersee, amidst diverse vegetation with palm trees and with a beautiful view of the lake. In this oasis of peace you can relax totally. If you are a bit more actively inclined, you can indulge in an extensive range of watersports on and around the lake.

Lush vegetation

The reception is housed in one of these buildings, where you can also pick up tourist information about the multi-faceted region. The camping grounds are beautified with gravel paths and lush vegetation. The pitches are demarcated, spacious and mostly have ample shade.

Fresh bread is available on the campsite. You don't have to cook yourself every day. While the large restaurant with snack bar doesn't boast a comprehensive menu, most guests will find something to their liking for a reasonable price. When the weather is good, you can sit out on the nicely laid out terrace.

Day beach with entertainment

A real crowd-puller at the Strandcamping Seekirchen is the public beach on the lake, where both camping guests and day visitors can go. It can get pretty busy here at times: after all, besides a nice spot by the water, the beautiful playground and a few exciting water slides are also real attractions. Furthermore, you can rent boats and diving equipment.

Fun tourist tram

The town of Seekirchen can be reached within a few minutes by walking along the cycle trail. Also fun: board the tourist tram which will take you to Seekirchen. Some famous attractions in the region are the Wenger Moor nature park and the ice cave in Werfen, which will definitely appeal to the little ones.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya L'Orée du Bois
properties.description:
A beautiful swimming paradise, numerous activities for young and old, a nice restaurant and an impressive wellness offer. When you realise that this is just a selection of what Camping Sandaya L'Orée du Bois has to offer, you know that no one will be bored here. This luxury family campsite is situated in a lovely woody location just a few kilometres from the wide sandy beaches of the Côté Sauvage.

Plenty of choice of camping pitches and accommodations

For those who come camping at Sandaya L'Orée du Bois, there are both sunny and shady pitches available. The pitches are spacious and often delimited by hedges and/or trees. Thirty of the pitches have private sanitary facilities. Furthermore, all kinds of accommodation can be booked.

Hours of water fun in the swimming paradise

The heated outdoor swimming pool is perhaps the showpiece of this campsite. In this true swimming paradise, you can slide down spectacular slides and have fun in the wild water river and recreational pool. There is a separate pool that is ideal for swimming laps and the youngest campers have also been thought of: they can go to the children's pool, which is much like a water playground.

From handicrafts to an exciting escape game

All campers can easily spend the whole day at Sandaya L'Orée du Bois. In the Kids Club, for example, young children can playfully learn how to cook, do crafts, paint and dance. For older children, including teenagers, many sportive and exciting activities are organized. Do you want to do something fun with the whole family? Then try to escape from the mysterious room of the challenging escape game.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Le Truc Vert
properties.description:
You will find Camping Sandaya Le Truc Vert in a wooded area on the popular peninsula of Cap Ferret in the Gironde department. This original campsite is close to a large sandy beach on the Atlantic Ocean. This peninsula also has many amazing hiking and cycle paths through the wooded areas. At the campsite you will enjoy the mixture of the clean air of the sea and the woods.

Original camping in a green decor

This campsite has been beautifully placed in a large pine forest. The neatly maintained pitches are also separated by trees and hedges. If you decide to book a pitch at Camping Sandaya Le Truc Vert, there is plenty of choice since there are five types of touring pitches. The main difference between the pitches is size.

Entertainment for campsite visitors of all ages

If you are looking for a campsite that organises fun activities for young children, this is the spot to be. At Le Truc Vert there is a varied entertainment programme for children.

The campsite also has entertainment for older children and adults, with mainly entertainment in the evening that focusses on singing, dancing and having fun.

Beautiful holiday destination for beach lovers

This is an ideal holiday address for beach lovers. You camp here only a couple of hundred metres from a sandy beach that stretches for miles, often more than a hundred metres wide. If you follow one of the wood-paths leading from the campsite, you will be there in no time and can swim in the Atlantic Ocean. Enjoy gorgeous sunsets from the beach in the evening.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Château des Marais
properties.description:
This castle campsite is located amidst historic and tourist sites. Special Loire castles, beautiful vineyards, dark green forests, picturesque cities and more. These are the ingredients for your holiday. Lovers of history, cultural heritage, wine and nature can feast their eyes on this site!

Lovely camping

After the barrier you see the recreation area with the aquapark and the restaurant. The castle also catches the eye. If you drive a little further into the grounds, you will come to a green area with several camping fields. There are spacious pitches with enough room for your car, caravan, motorhome or tent. No own camping equipment? Then hire one of the chalets, cottages or tents. Or you can let your children decide, in which case it will probably be a sturdy tree house!

Water fun and entertainment

The swimming pool at Camping Sandaya Château des Marais has various slides and pools. It is situated in the full sun, centrally at the entrance. For ultimate relaxation, you can also enjoy a steam bath or sauna. On dry land, no one has to sit still either. Especially for children, there is plenty to do, including the mini club and the entertainment teams that focus on older children and adults. They can do sports, do crafts, rehearse for a music or drama evening and dance. Fun for the whole family: a game of mini golf, table tennis or jeu de boules.

Restaurant

The campsite has a supermarket with many products, such as fresh bread every day. You can also enjoy an attractive restaurant with outdoor seating and a pizzeria. You will find a wide choice of dishes and children's menus.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Les Alicourts
properties.description:
In the heart of France, about two hours drive from Paris, you will find Camping Sandaya Les Alicourts between the woods of Loir-et-Cher. Here you will camp between the impressive castles and near the vineyards of Cheverny with all the luxury amenities at hand. The Sandaya Les Alicourts campsite is located near Pierrefitte-sur-Sauldre, a pretty village in the Loire valley near the Sologne nature reserve.

Camping in the forest

Before you arrive at the campsite, you will drive through picturesque French villages that will get you into the holiday mood. You will be welcomed in the large reception hall and then your holiday can really begin. Whether you come with your motorhome, caravan or tent, for each camping vehicle you will find a unique spot. The pitches are spacious and the ones with the best view are situated on the sandy beach by the swimming lake. Even if you do not have your own camping equipment, you are welcome at this campsite in one of the mobile homes or chalets.

Swimming pools and sandy beach

The campsite's pride and joy is the huge water park with several (heated) swimming pools with slides. While the children are having the time of their lives in the pool, you can let yourself be pampered at the wellness and spa. Beach lovers will also have a great time at this campsite. Lay your towel on the private sandy beach by the lake and daydream with open eyes. Sitting still is not for you? Go supping, kayaking or try 'cable skiing': water skiing on a cable suspended over the lake.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Le Carbonnier
properties.description:
Camping in the Dordogne: a perfect summer holiday for many holidaymakers. This campsite is located 15.5 kilometres from the beloved Castelnaud castle and about 20 kilometres from historic Sarlat. Le Carbonnier Campsite is of course located in the popular holiday destination of France! There is plenty of entertainment for young and old. From fishing and football to aqua gym and mini golf - you will certainly enjoy yourself here. You will not find many Dutch people at the campsite. If you like that, then you're in the right place.

Slow down

At Le Carbonnier Campsite you can relax in a nice comfortable spot. There is space here for tents, caravans and campers. There is also plenty for accommodation enthusiasts to choose from. There are three types of accommodations - from comfort to exclusive. There is also a type of mobile home to accommodate disabled campers.

Lazing around or aqua gym?

This campsite offers water recreation activities for everyone, both big and small. There is a nice water playground and a heated paddling pool for the little ones. Do you have older children? Then you can visit the comfortably heated indoor pool and the outdoor pools. The outdoor pools feature several waterslides, so they can let off some steam.

Free entertainment

You don't have to leave the campsite to enjoy a nice bite to eat. They have a snack bar, pizzeria, bakery and bar. These are all open in high season. The campsite also has a small shop. Of course there is much more to do at this campsite. For example, you can fish, canoe, play football and mini golf. Entertainment is offered in high season.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya La Ribeyre
properties.description:
Camping Sandaya La Ribeyre is situated in the Auvergne, a region in the middle of France. You camp here within walking distance of the village of Murol. Special about the region is that there are old volcanoes and vast lakes. The campsite's biggest plus are the water park, the private lake with beach and the many sports and entertainment options. There is also a snack bar-pizzeria.

Large camp site

This is a very large campsite (13 ha) with over two hundred camping pitches and almost one hundred and fifty accommodation units, such as various chalets and cottages. A lot of vegetation on the grounds ensure a fresh and green look. And you also camp among the greenery. Often on grassy pitches and between trees and bushes. The most beautiful pitches are close to the lake.

Aquapark with all the trimmings

The campsite has a water park covering an area of 2,500 m². You will find slides, water cannons, indoor and outdoor pools, waterfalls and a hot tub. The thatched parasols on the shore give the complex a tropical atmosphere. Still not enough water fun? The campsite has its own lake where you can swim and sail.

Children are king at La Ribeyre

Children of each age group are offered the best activities. The Kids Club (5-7 years) offers fun games, face painting workshops and craft mornings for the youngest campers, whilst older children can go to the Juniors Club (8-12 years) or the Teens Club (13-17). All sorts of exciting adventures await them there, such as a canoe race or disco. Sports enthusiasts can work up a sweat on the tennis court, beach volleyball court, Pétanque lane or multi-sports field.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Les Jardins de Privas
properties.description:
Glorious nature with beautiful rivers, adventurous outdoor sports, historical towns and villages: you will find it all in the Ardèche. Les Jardins de Privas offers a tranquil site from which you can undertake as much as you want to. However, you do not have to leave the camping grounds, thanks to a water park with double slide and a vast choice of play equipment.

Eye for detail

The campsite looks very attractive, partly due to the lovely vegetation. It is well-shaded, nicely kept and fitted with eye for detail. The small Ouvèze river flows along the campsite. All pitches are spacious. Some of the pitches are located on terraces. The campsite also has rental lodge tents.

Double slide

With a heated, covered swimming pool with water chute and double slide as well as an exciting toddler pool with play equipment, children have no grounds for complaint at all. It is located in the sun, surrounded by lots of greenery. Next to the campsite flows the small river l'Ouvèze, where you can catch fish by hand with a small net. Aqua shoes come in handy.

Jumping castle and children disco

In addition to the playground with trampoline and jumping castle, children can enjoy themselves on the sports field. In high season entertainment is offered for children (crafts, swimming pool games and a children's disco). Much attention is paid to the little ones. Lovers of adventurous outdoor sports can go on a razzle in the vicinity (mountain climbing, canyoning, and mountain bike and canoe trips).

Varied menus

On the campsite is a bar-restaurant with large terrace where you have a choice of an attractive diversity of dishes. Take-away snacks, pizzas and meals are also available.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Domaine Le Midi
properties.description:
Camping Sandaya Domaine Le Midi is located on the French island of Noirmoutier along the West French coast. The island can be reached via a bridge and an old access road. The access road is only passable at low tide. The campsite is located directly on the beach overlooking the ocean. Some of the accommodation is situated in the dunes with little shade and the rest in the forest, with a lot of shade.

Special accommodations

The campsite has a large number of rental accommodations. Sleep in a tipi tent, a wooden lodge or a luxury mobile home. If you want to enjoy the starry night, choose a tent with large windows on the sides and top. Even when you are inside, you can enjoy the surroundings.

Active holidays

Anyone camping at Sandaya Domaine Le Midi doesn't have to be bored. There's plenty to do on the camping site for holidaymakers of all ages. The entertainment team organizes all sorts of activities. In the high season you can join in with aqua gym, football or basketball, among other things. There are also activities organized in the evening. Are you too tired to cook after an active day on the island? There is a snack bar at the campsite.

Water fun

The campsite has direct access to a beach that is about eight kilometres long. Bring your diving goggles and go snorkelling in the ocean. The surrounding area is ideal for waterskiing and surfing. During the high season, you can even take windsurfing or catamaran lessons. You don’t like to swim in the ocean? The campsite has two swimming pools.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Le Kérou
properties.description:
Camping Sandaya Le Kérou is close to the Breton coast, in natural green surroundings. It is a campsite equipped with all the luxury you need during a camping holiday in France. And that is whether you want to go swimming, join in with an organised sports tournament or explore the area. This campsite is a good starting point for a holiday on the Breton coast.

Luxury camping pitches

The campsite has 40 camping pitches and more than 100 accommodation for hire. The camping pitches are on the outer edge of the campsite. Most pitches have luxury private toilet and washing facilities. So, ideal for campers who don't want to walk far for the toilet or to do the washing up. Campers without their own camping equipment can choose from various models of mobile homes and safari tents.

Beach holiday in Brittany

Water is always close by at Camping Sandaya Le Kérou. There is an outdoor swimming pool with several slides. Moreover, there is a swimming pool with a retractable roof so you can also go for a swim on rainy days. Campsite guests can use the wellness facilities at the campsite for a fee.

The ocean is a 500-metre walk from the campsite. Plage de Kérou is a sandy beach where you can swim in the clear-blue ocean. The water has a lovely blue colour on sunny days in particular.

Large campsite with many amenities

The campsite offers enough facilities for a sporting challenge. There is a multi-functional sports field, there is outdoor gym equipment and a table tennis table. The entertainment team organises activities for children in various age groups in the high season. For example, performances, group games and organised sports tournaments.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya la Bosse
properties.description:
Enjoy your holiday with your toes in the sand at Camping Sandaya la Bosse in L'Épine, Vendée. You will camp between the dunes of the Atlantic Ocean in the south of France. Here you will experience the old-fashioned camping feeling: basic, but with all the ingredients for a wonderful relaxing holiday. For those who want nothing more than to enjoy peace and quiet, the sea and nature.

Island feeling

Sandaya la Bosse campsite is located on the island of Noirmoutier. You camp here between the forest, the sea and the marsh. The sloping grounds are large, but there is a peaceful atmosphere at this campsite. There are 274 sunny and shady touring pitches (60 - 150m2) and 40 rental accommodations including fully equipped glamping tents.

Wake up to the sound of the waves

La Bosse is especially popular with beach lovers. Here you can sleep with the sound of the waves in the background. During your stay you won't have fun in a swimming pool, but in the sea. In the vicinity you can try out various water sports. You can alternate lazy days at the seaside with walking and cycling trips in the surrounding area.

The power of simplicity

Enjoying nature and tranquillity is paramount at La Bosse. There's no entertainment programme, but nobody needs to be bored here. After a day full of beach adventures, the children can have fun in the playground or play a game of jeu de boules with the family.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Côte de Nacre
properties.description:
For a real French beach holiday on the Normandy coast, the pleasant Camping Sandaya Côte de Nacre is the place to be. The beach is within walking distance, there is a swimming paradise with slides and you can let yourself be pampered in the spa. In the summer holidays, the enthusiastic entertainment team ensures fun for young and old.

Sheltered by greenery

You arrive on a lively site with more than 140 camping pitches and 340 mobile homes. The reception, swimming pool and restaurant are situated at the beginning of the site. The campsite is situated on well-maintained grounds with excellent facilities. The pitches are spacious and set between high hedges. So you can sit here in the shade.

Entertainment and wellness

In the school holidays, many families with children find this campsite. With a water park, playground, climbing wall, sports fields and bouncy castles, children never tire of playing here. And thanks to the kids club, junior club and teens club, they easily meet other children of their own age. There are also plenty of activities for adults, such as aqua gym, fitness, yoga or fun evenings. Or go for an afternoon of relaxation in the sauna or hammam.

Swimming paradise with slides

From approximately mid-June to the end of August, the outdoor pool is open. And by outdoor pool, we mean a complete swimming paradise with slides, a wild water river, whirlpools and waterfalls. Great for summer water fun! The swimming pool is located right behind the restaurant terrace, so you will find all the pleasant meeting places close to each other here. Swimming in the sea is also possible. You can walk through the village to the sandy beach in ten minutes.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Les Péneyrals
properties.description:
France is and remains one of the favourite holiday destinations. Do you fancy a holiday in France? This terraced campsite is located in the Dordogne, a department with a thousand castles. The first impression of camping Sandaya Les Péneyrals is good. The sanitary facilities are well maintained and the camping pitches are well marked. The grounds are very well cared for and have a welcoming feel. The pitches are at least 80 m2 in size and fit nicely into the wooded area. You will also find a wide choice of mobile homes, cottages and chalets. What attracts you the most?

Discover the six swimming pools

At Les Péneyrals, you will be mostly in the company of Belgian and Dutch families with children. There is a water park with no less than six swimming pools, a water playground, several slides and a sun terrace. There is something for everyone: you can swim laps, play with your children in the water playground and relax on the edge of the pool. Please note that swimming shorts are not allowed in the swimming pools.

Invigorating yoga classes

At this five-star campsite in the Dordogne you can participate in all kinds of activities every day during the high season. Join an invigorating yoga class, play a game of football or volleyball and have fun at the unmissable pétanque competitions. In the evening you will be entertained with performances and dance lessons. There is also plenty of choice for children. The campsite has several free children's clubs and an extensive range of activities. For instance, a bouncy castle, dance lessons, mini golf, mini disco and an evening programme full of French-language entertainment.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Cypsela Resort
properties.description:
A hilly landscape, wide bays and high cliffs. You are in the northeastern part of Spain. Sandaya Cypsela Resort Campsite is located on the Costa Brava, 2 kilometres from Platja de Pals beach. This beach offers beautiful views of the Medes Islands. In the vicinity of this camping you will find pine woods and picturesque villages. The campsite is also close (16.5 km) to the Montgrí Massif.

Colourful cottages and sheltered camping spots

The camping area of this campsite is large and the pitches are spacious. If you want to explore the entire campsite, it's fun to rent a bike. The terrain is quite hilly and the sites are divided into terraces. There are many trees and the pitches are demarcated by hedges and walls. This gives you plenty of privacy in your camping pitch. There are also various types of rental accommodation available at Cypsela Resort. This large campsite offers a wide range of lodging options, from colourful cottages to bungalows and lodge tents.

Bubbling, swimming lengths and balneo

Your fellow campers are mostly French, Belgians and Dutch. This site is very popular among families with young children. Your children will have no trouble making holiday friends as a result. In any case, making friends is a piece of cake in the large pool. Go down the slide together, bubble in the hot tub or climb the pirate ship. For those who prefer an active holiday, there is a half-Olympic-size pool. You can relax on the hydro massage benches and at the balneotherapy. The Mediterranean Sea beach is also easily accessible. The campsite's free shuttle bus takes you there in no time.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Les Deux Fontaines
properties.description:
White sand and blue sea are not only to be found on tropical islands, but also in France. Camp within walking distance of the sandy beach and discover the Brittany region. Camping Sandaya Les Deux Fontaines is a great base for a camping holiday on the west coast of France. This spacious campsite has many amenities, including a water park with slides, a skate park, a multi-purpose sports field and a table tennis table.

Camping or renting

Camping Sandaya Les Deux Fontaines has about 100 touring pitches for campers with their own camping equipment. The pitches are at least 90 m2 in size, and you camp on grass surrounded by trees.

In addition to camping pitches, the campsite has a wide range of luxury mobile homes and safari tents. The largest mobile home can accommodate a party of ten.

Water fun in the aqua park

Aquatic fun is guaranteed at Camping Sandaya Les Deux Fontaines. The campsite features a tropical pool with multiple slides and a hot tub. Part of the pool is outdoors, and part is indoors. You can also use the pool on days when the weather is a little less than perfect. Would you rather swim in the sea? No problem! From the campsite, it is 900 metres to the Plage de Tahiti beach. According to other travellers, this is one of the most beautiful beaches in Brittany. The sandy beach is almost white, and the ocean is clear blue, which, especially on sunny days, immediately evokes a holiday feeling. The ocean slowly gets deeper, so it's a good place to swim.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Séquoia Parc
properties.description:
Imagine yourself in a historical place on this castle campsite near the Atlantic Ocean. A swimming paradise with sauna, hammam, Jacuzzi, massages and face cares, fitness area and solarium and the many organised activities will ensure a top holiday on Camping Séquoia Parc. The campsite is situated in the French Charente-Maritime region, renowned for its large number of sun hours per year. The beach of Marennes in its sheltered bay is only 5 km away from the campsite.

When you arrive at the campsite, it feels like you are standing in an authentic village. The historical courtyard, the castle La Josephtrie and the adjacent farm buildings create a wonderful atmosphere. The green plants on the campsite complete the picture.

The camping pitches, measuring an average of 140 m2, are very spacious. The pitches are mostly separated by hedgerows and they all have electricity. Rental accommodation is also available on the campsite.

Swimming paradise and lots of entertainment

The campsite has a large water park of no less than 200 m2. There are five swimming pools, three of which are heated. In the swimming paradise you will find slides, play equipment and a exciting Lazy River where you get carried along on an inflatable tyre by the current.

Oysters and Cognac

From the campsite you can make some lovely culinary excursions. Marennes, only 5 km away from the campsite, is the oyster capital of Charente-Maritime. So, if you like oysters, you just have to enjoy this sea delicacy at a pavement cafe. A bit further inland lies Cognac, famous for its alcoholic beverage. You can go on a guided tour in several cognac houses and round this off with a testing session.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Soulac Plage
properties.description:
In a quiet area, wooded and right by the beach, you will find Camping Sandaya Soulac Plage. This campsite is located in the Gironde department in the Aquitaine region in the west of France. With its beautiful swimming pool, the extensive entertainment programmes and the fine restaurant, this is an ideal family campsite. This campsite is also an excellent base for beach lovers.

Route, location and possibilities for excursions

On the way to the campsite you will drive through vast landscapes and later wooded areas. This is typical of the beautiful Gironde region in which this campsite is situated. All in all, an excellent environment to discover at your leisure by walking or cycling. There are also plenty of nice trips to make, for example to the city of Bordeaux or the spectacular Arcachon bay.

Book a camping pitch or accommodation by the sea

There are two areas at Campsite Soulac Plage where you will mainly find camping pitches. These are well-maintained pitches where you can choose between a sunny or a shady spot. Whatever you choose, the refreshing sea air is everywhere! In addition, this campsite has numerous rental accommodations that are suitable for four to ten people. Some of these accommodations are right on the beach.

Hours of fun in swimming pool and sea

The heated swimming paradise is probably the showpiece of this campsite. One of the pools can also be turned into an indoor pool via a sliding roof. With the leisure pools, the family slide, the large paddling pool, the river, the whirlpools and the water playground, hours of splashing fun are guaranteed in this sunny aquapark.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya La Grande Côte
properties.description:
Sandaya La Grande Côte is a perfect family campsite in the Vendée, situated among dunes and woodlands. Come camp here on a spacious pitch or spend the night in a comfortable lodge tent. Take a refreshing dip in the swimming pool, or walk to the beach at Fromentine. You'll love it here.

Large campsite for the whole family

The camping pitches are located on a sloping property, and the pines provide sufficient shade. It is a large property, with over 300 camping pitches. The pitches are spacious (varying between 80 to 120 m²), but barely separated from each other. That allows for a very open feel. Do you want to rent accommodation? No problem! Choose from lodges, mobile homes and chalets.

Splashing holiday

You're directly by the sea! You just have to walk a little bit through the dunes to reach the broad sandy beach at Fromentine. You can also hire a sailboat, go fishing or go for a ride on horseback! There is a heated swimming pool with a wading pool at the campsite. Please note: shorts/Bermudas are not allowed.

The kids don't feel like swimming? Then they'll be happy at the playground, the multi-sports field or in the kids' club (4-12 years) and youth club (12-17 years). The entertainment team organises games, sports tournaments, workshops, dance evenings and cabaret shows.

Fresh rolls

You can also find a small supermarket and snack bar at the campsite. There is also a bread service, so that you can order fresh rolls every day. In the evenings, enjoy a tasty drink on the terrace of La Casa camp bar.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Le Lac de Sanguinet
properties.description:
The Sandaya Le Lac de Sanguinet campsite is situated near the lake of Sanguinet, one of the most beautiful and largest lakes in Europe. Enjoy a relaxing holiday in a beautiful dune and forest area with the Atlantic Ocean within cycling distance. The campsite is quite green and tropical with all kinds of trees, plants, and flowers. With entertainment for young and old, multiple sports fields, a large outdoor pool, and an outdoor bar, you are guaranteed a fun-filled holiday!

Fine camping

The Sandaya Le Lac de Sanguinet campsite has 150 camping pitches. They range from 80 to 150 m². The pitches are generally well defined by hedges and trees. You can either choose a shady spot or seek out the sun. Camping here is great: your camping equipment is on a level field. Don't have your own camping equipment? No need to worry! You can choose from dozens of bungalows, chalets, and mobile homes.

Fancy a swim?

This is a cosy campsite with lots to do. Especially for the water rats. With a large, heated swimming pool of no less than 240 m², there is plenty of room to swim and play. There is also a separate paddling pool for the smallest campers. Because the campsite is situated at the lake of Sanguinet, you have an even bigger ‘pool’ at your disposal. All kinds of water sports are possible – from windsurfing and SUP-ing to kayaking and diving.

Fun away from the pool

There is entertainment for campers of all ages. There are creative workshops, a mini disco, face painting, table football and boules tournaments, karaoke and dance evenings, and all kinds of concerts. Your little ones are sure to enjoy the playgrounds and the bouncy castle.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Amis de la Plage
properties.description:
Camping Sandaya Amis de la Plage campsite is located on the French island of Ile de Ré. Here you can camp directly on one of the most beautiful beaches in the region. There is a peaceful atmosphere at the campsite and in the surrounding area. A wonderful place for both families and cycling enthusiasts. With a nice climate, beautiful landscapes and a hundred kilometres of cycling paths, you're guaranteed to have a good time.

Various pitches

The campsite sits on a slope and most pitches have a sandy surface. Choose a pitch between the conifers or spend the night closer to the dunes. The choice is yours. Most camping pitches are not separated from each other, but are spacious enough for your car and caravan. Depending on your wishes, there are pitches with or without shade. Do you want a bit more privacy and luxury? Then spend the night in one of the mobile homes.

Gorgeous countryside

Ile de Ré is a cycling island par excellence. On your "steel steed" you can enjoy the mild climate, the many hours of sunshine and a varied landscape. There are also all kinds of picturesque villages, swamps, pleasure harbours and forests to discover. So go out with the whole family! Prefer to relax or have some fun in the water? With a location directly on the beach, you can dive straight into the Atlantic ocean.

Facilities on and outside the campsite

At the campsite, you will find a small shop with fresh bread and the essentials. You won't find a bar, restaurant or swimming pool on the campsite, but you'll find them just off the campsite. The town of Le Bois-Plage-en-Ré is about one and a half kilometres away. Here you will find a supermarket and cosy restaurants.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Belle Plage
properties.description:
The southern coast of Brittany is a popular holiday destination because of its beautiful inlets, extensive beaches and attractive villages. Camping Sandaya Belle Plage is an ideal home base for exploring this part of France. You camp next to the beach of Lomener (municipality of Ploemeur), close to Lorient, one of the larger cities in Brittany. The campsite was taken over by the Sandaya chain in 2023. The reception and restaurant have been renovated since then.

Camping next to the sea

This campsite has a good range of neat tourist pitches, usually separated from one another by green elements. There are also about the same number of accommodations. If you want a place at Camping Sandaya Belle Plage as close as possible to the sea, a number of pitches, mobile homes and cottages are located by the access path to the beach.

Swimming fun for everyone

At the front of Camping Sandaya Belle Plage is a heated pool (with a wading pool) where you can always swim comfortably because of its sliding roof. If you prefer to swim in the sea, walk to the back of the campsite and through the gate, where you will step onto the beautiful sandy beach of Lomener.

Varied entertainment programme in the high season

During the summer holiday, there is a full entertainment programme at Camping Sandaya Belle Plage. Adult campsite visitors enjoy the aqua gym sessions and the sporty tournaments especially. The children’s programme is extensive and original. They can be a gardener for a day or follow a fun cooking workshop. If you are still hungry after tasting the meal your little master chef made, head over to the campsite restaurant, where you can enjoy a seafood dish or a pizza.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Le Grand Dague
properties.description:
Would you like to celebrate holidays in the attractive French Dordogne, while the children are looking for a campsite with a large swimming pool with slides? Then your choice may well fall on Sandaya Le Grand Dague campsite, close to Périgueux in the south west of France. This campsite is part of a large holiday park, so there is always something to do, especially during the summer holidays.

Le Grand Dague is situated near Périgueux, in the heart of the Dordogne. The route to the campsite from the motorway leads over a narrow road through a wooded area. With a caravan or motorhome, that last bit requires some careful driving. The park consists largely of mobile homes and rental tents. For campers with their own tent, caravan, motorhome or trailer tent, there is a camping field with some 55 spacious pitches.

Ideal for young families

Le Grand Dague is especially a magnet for families with children of primary school age. The staff is fully geared to this group. For example, in the summer holidays, the swimming pool is carefully supervised. It is very safe. In the summer holidays, there is a good chance that your neighbours are Dutch. That makes it easy to make new friends.

Beautiful water park

The main attraction of Le Grand Dague is the extensive water park with four swimming pools, a wild river and slides. The little ones can play and splash about in the paddling pool with pirate ship, while the older children can let themselves be carried along on the current of the wild water course.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Les Rivages
properties.description:
Situated in the French departement Aveyron, east of the town of Milau, is the luxury campsite Les Rivages. Offering a view from many sites of the renowned viaduct, some 5 km away, it is an extraordinary location. Also the direct location along the Dourbie river makes Les Rivages a unique and lovely spot, where you can enjoy your camping holiday in peace.

Utter enjoyment

The campsite is beautifully located between mountains, but the campsite itself is not at all hilly. The very spacious pitches are separated by hedges and trees. Choose your own pitch with lots or just a bit of shade. Les Rivages is a campsite for the entire family. With entertainment for teenagers and adults, a swimming pool, sports fields and organised excursions, there is lots of fun to be had for everyone. Less active guests who prefer peace and quiet will enjoy the lovely, secluded pitches. The campsite is popular amongst guests from the Netherlands.

The Doubrie, a source of pleasure

Les Virages is a campsite in a beautiful setting. The Doubrie river flows along the campsite. This crystal-clear river is popular with young and old. Great for swimming, canoeing, crayfishing, building dams and much more! Lovely tanning sessions on the pebble and grassy beach. Not a great fan of open water? You will also enjoy the heated outdoor pool (404m²), located near the reception.

Convenience for all

The sanitary facilities are made with everyone in mind. For instance, you will find toilets for children, for seniors, showers for seniors and family showers. The facilities are kept very clean.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Le Col Vert
properties.description:
In the south of France, Sandaya Le Col Vert is a large campsite situated on the shores of Lake Léon. You are surrounded by forests, but the beaches of the Atlantic coast are also close by. The city of Dax is 35 km away and the regional nature park Landes de Gascogne is only one hour away (93 km).

You can reach Sandaya Le Col Vert from Castets by driving in the direction of Léon. From the centre of Léon, drive in the direction of St. Girons until you reach Vielle. From this road you can follow the camping signs. At the campsite you will receive a warm welcome at the reception.

Between mimosa trees and oaks

Are you already in a holiday mood? At this well-tended campsite you will be camping in green surroundings. It is a large site with well-maintained, spacious pitches. Surrounded by mimosa trees and oaks, you will have a wonderfully relaxing holiday here. There is also plenty to choose from for accommodation lovers. Go for a cottage, a lodge tent or a coco sweet.

From supping to windsurfing

Bubbling, splashing and swimming. At Le Col Vert you will find several swimming pools and a spa. The pools can be partially covered; great if the weather is a bit poorer. You can also swim in the lake. This is shallow and has a sandy beach. The lake of Léon is also very suitable for water sports. There is a water sports centre 200 metres from the campsite. From supping to windsurfing, there's plenty to do!

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Aloha
properties.description:
Camping in a Hawaiian atmosphere: that's what Aloha Sandaya campsite is all about. Relaxation is the key word here. At Aloha campsite, you are free to be whoever you want to be. Nothing's a must, and anything goes. Take a dip in the swimming pool or in the Mediterranean Sea, lie on the beach for a day, or go running twice a week with the running club.

Clean and luxurious

The campsite itself is gleaming: the grounds look very well cared for, and the staff are very customer focused. You'll camp amongst the Mediterranean greenery, on spacious pitches. Or you could choose one of the various other accommodation options: spend a romantic night for two in the charming and luxurious 'Cocoon', stay in the new Hula Lodge, or in one of the chalets. All in Hawaiian surroundings.

Swimming Paradise

Something you really don't want to miss at this campsite are the two endless water slides that lead into the swimming pool. Here, you can take a dip, or just paddle around, surrounded by palm trees. They've also taken the little ones into consideration: there is a separate toddler pool. Do you want more water? No problem, because the campsite lies directly on a Mediterranean beach. Start your day well: enjoy the beach in the rising sun, and then check out the warmth of the sea.

No fuss at Aloha

Aloha is for people who really want to relax on holiday, and not for those who want overpowering entertainment. There is entertainment, but you're absolutely not forced to take part if you don't want to. You can enjoy one of the evening shows, or for the little ones there's a kid’s club and a baby lounge. There are no nightly teen parties at Aloha.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Blue Bayou
properties.description:
This campsite is located in the Languedoc region of southern France. You camp here less than 500 metres from the coast, with direct access to the beach. Just one of the many advantages of Sandaya Blue Bayou campsite. The campsite is especially popular with families with children because there is plenty to do: a large aqua park, sports fields, entertainment and much more!

Camping pitches and rental accommodations

The grounds of Camping Sandaya Blue Bayou are well maintained and the camping fields are tidy. The pitches vary in size (80-100 m2), but are spacious enough. There are also beautiful cottages to book. The smallest are suitable for four people, the largest for a group of ten!

Water fun!

At Camping Sandaya Blue Bayou you'll find a large water park where everyone's been thought of. Children can enjoy fun slides and a water playground, the little ones can go to a paddling pool and adults have a separate pool to relax and swim laps. A footpath that starts at the campsite takes you quickly to the beach and the sea.

Lots of entertainment

At this campsite you can really do something different every day. For example, work out in the fitness room, join in with aqua gym or play a game of table football, table tennis or billiards. Not inspired? The entertainment teams provide daily entertainment, such as sports tournaments, shows, music evenings and theme dinners.

Beautiful restaurant with patio

Camping Sandaya Blue Bayou has a modern restaurant with a high patio. Here you can enjoy a beautiful view over the sea in the distance. In the restaurant you have a wide choice of hot and cold dishes.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Sanguinet Plage
properties.description:
Come and camp in the southwest of France. At the Cazaux-Sanguinet lake in Les Landes, you will find the Sandaya Sanguinet Plage campsite. With direct access to the lake, an extensive swimming paradise and the surf beaches of Biscarrosse close by, you will have a wonderful holiday here. The campsite is situated between Biscarrosse and the Arcachon Basin.

Sleeping in a gypsy wagon

The campsite is well maintained. You will find spacious and shady camping pitches. There are more than seventy pitches and 280 accommodation units. Will you choose a mobile home or even a gypsy wagon Especially families with children will have a great holiday at Sandaya Sanguinet Plage. The Aqua Caraïbes water park, with its three swimming pools and water playground, is the ideal place for swimming enthusiasts.

Dancing in the mini disco

Swinging in the playground, theatre and games by the lakeside. There is plenty to do for children of all ages at this campsite. Think of the mini-disco, a playing field and a bouncy castle. In high season, they can join in with the free children's clubs (5 to 17 years) and the entertainment programme. The team speaks English and French.

On the water

Adults are also well catered for at this campsite. Play tennis, volleyball or take sailing lessons. If you like to go on the water, this is the place to be. You can reach the lake by crossing the road. You can go windsurfing, canoeing and paddle boarding. In the evening, you can finish off the day with a delicious barbecue or join the restaurant.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Domaine du Verdon
properties.description:
Camping Domaine du Verdon lies in the mountainous northeastern part of the Provence in South-East France. It is a large campsite with three swimming pools, water slides, several eating establishments and lots of entertainment. An ideal destination for families with children. There are many places of interest in the area for outdoor sports enthusiasts, city tourists and nature explorers.

Camping with greenery and space

The large, park-like developed site is defined by its numerous trees. A small brook runs through the grounds and the Verdon river flows past the campsite. The spacious pitches on the various fields offer ample privacy. Do you want to rent accommodation? You can find it all on the campsite: from attractive wooden chalets to mobile homes.

Water slides

Crazy about water? Hold it right there! With three swimming pools and a large water slide on the campsite, children are bound to enjoy themselves. Past the campsite flows the (shallow) Verdon with pebble beaches: ideal to splash around and float on an air mattress. There are two swimming lakes in the vicinity: Lake Castillon (10 km) and the reservoir of Sainte-Croix (one and a half hours away).

Foam party

There is lots of entertainment for young and old, from foam parties and late night campfires to shows. Furthermore, there are bad weather facilities, a trout pond, a playground, a sports field and a mini-golf course. You can also hire bicycles on the campsite.

Just like a village square

Camping Domaine du Verdon looks like a small village with several eating establishments and various side-walk cafes located around a village square. There is something for every taste and budget. The supermarket on the campsite stocks a fairly large assortment.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Paris Maisons Laffitte
properties.description:
The Sandaya Paris Maisons-Laffitte campsite is located in a green oasis along the Seine, at the edge of the city of Paris. This family campsite is the ideal place to alternate your camping holiday with a city trip to Paris or a day at Disneyland. You can be in the centre of the French capital in less than half an hour. The location of this campsite is also ideal as a stopover campsite further south.

Special nights

Sandaya Paris Maisons-Laffitte campsite has almost two hundred camping pitches. The pitches are spacious and flat. Those who like to enjoy extra comfort after a day in the city can choose one of the campsite's accommodations. For example, a completely furnished cottage. Do you really want a unique night? Then go for a night in one of the beautiful tree houses with a deck. It is good to know that the reception staff are happy to help you book tickets for tourist attractions. The campsite sometimes has special offers and tickets are available so that you don't have to queue. Very convenient!

Water fun for young and old

Back at the campsite after a wonderful day in Paris, you can relax in the swimming pool. There is also a spray park and a bubble bath. There are sun loungers along the side where you can read or relax in the sunshine or under a parasol. Finished swimming? At Paris Maison-Laffitte children of all ages can join in with fun games, creative activities and themed evenings. A game of table tennis or jeu de boules will also give you that ultimate holiday feeling. The little ones can enjoy themselves on the grounds with wooden and inflatable playground equipment.

Dining by the Seine

At Paris Maisons-Laffitte campsite, you will want for nothing. Taste a delicious French wine in the restaurant while enjoying a view of the rippling Seine. Or go for something tasty from the snack bar. You can buy groceries for breakfast at the campsite shop with bakery.

Leave the car at the campsite

What's nice is that you can leave your car at the campsite if you want to visit Paris. The metro and train station are at a 10-minute walk away. Admire the Champs-Élysées, visit the Louvre museum or go for a picnic in Jardin du Luxembourg. Want to see a lot in little time? Then book a fun (electric) bike tour of the French capital at the campsite! What you must not miss during your camping holiday at Maisons-Laffitte is a visit to the Maisons-Laffitte castle. It is also within walking distance.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Soleil Vivarais
properties.description:
Camping Sandaya Soleil Vivarais looks forward to welcoming you for a great holiday in the beautiful region of Rhône-Alpes, France. Located on the picturesque banks of the Ardèche, this 5-star campsite combines nature, luxury and adventure activities. The whole family will relax and have fun on the green 14-hectare estate.

Pitches and accommodation

There are a wide range of camping options at the Camping Sandaya Soleil Vivarais. Whether you have a tent, caravan or motor home, the 129 camping pitches are large and well-equipped. For anyone seeking a little more luxury, there are 331 rental properties, including the luxury mobile homes at 'Les Jardins'. They offer all the comforts of home with a camping atmosphere.

Two aqua parks with slides

Water fun is guaranteed with two aqua parks at Camping Sandaya Soleil Vivarais, complete with heated pools, slides and whirlpools. There’s also an extensive wellness area with a spa, Turkish bath and sauna. Sports enthusiasts can indulge in activities like beach volleyball, tennis and yoga. Mascot Koolaya provides entertainment in the free children's clubs, so the youngest campers will never be bored either.

Discover the Ardèche

The Ardèche is a paradise for nature lovers and adventurers. Camping Sandaya Soleil Vivarais is close to famous attractions like Vallon-Pont-d'Arc and the Gorges de l'Ardèche. It’s a good place for activities like canoeing, canyoning and caving. Visit picturesque villages like Sampzon and Ruoms or enjoy local events like the Aluna Festival. Whatever you choose, this campsite is a good base from which to explore the region.

properties.name: TAIGA Tarifa Valdevaqueros
properties.description:
Camping Valdevaqueros Cat.2, on the southern Spanish Costa de la Luz, lies in a stunning location: within walking distance from the Valdevaqueros beach. This is one of the most popular spots for kite and wind surfers. The eastern side of the campsite features a mountainous landscape, defined by the largest oak forest of the Iberian peninsula.

Camping with mountain view

The grounds are mostly level and numerous deciduous trees provide ample shade. The reasonably spacious, well demarcated pitches are located in rows on beautiful turf. You can choose a pitch near the pool or near the playground. Also possible: a pitch in a quieter location at the far end of the terrain. You have a view of the surrounding mountain landscape. The rental accommodation units (bungalows) also look very neat.

Swimming pool or the sea? Both, of course!

At Camping Valdevaqueros you have a choice between the campsite swimming pool and the sea, some 200 m from the campsite. You can get to the sea safely via a tunnel passage under the main road. At the seaside a superb sandy beach awaits you for endless walks.

The rectangular campsite swimming pool is ideal for swimming a few laps. Thereafter, you can relax on a lounger. There is also a special toddler pool. The swimming pool is surrounded by lawn.

Children's playground and walking tours

There is a children's playground as well as a sports field on the campsite. There is no entertainment or mini club. In peak season the campsite organises twice weekly guided walking tours. Tarifa (9 km from the campsite) offers a large variety of entertainment. There is a ferry service from Tarifa to the Moroccan town of Tanger.

properties.name: Camp Kovacine
properties.description:
Camp Kovacine is on the Croatian island of Cres right by the sea. The campsite is a 20-minute walk from the town of Cres that you can reach via a lovely promenade. The spacious family campsite offers many facilities such as a large swimming pool, gym, wellness centre, pizzeria and a private beach by the bay. You can also take part in water sports, go on excursions or go out and about on your own to admire the hilly hinterland. Besides the lovely camping pitches, there are neat glamping accommodation so you can camp with every luxury. All under centuries-old pine and olive trees. A separate section has been reserved for naturists.

Camping amid the olive trees

Due to the charming setting against a hill, the campsite is divided into terraces, partly under many olive and pine trees, partly in the full sun. The permanent pitches are separate, as is the naturist area. All camping pitches are surrounded by lots of natural greenery and the trees determine the size of the pitches, which are generally very spacious. Some pitches have views of the clear-blue water.

If you want a bit more comfort, there are lovely mobile homes for hire.

Plenty of swimming fun

At Camp Kovacine, you have the luxury of alternating between swimming in the sea and in the swimming pool. From the campsite, you walk via a lovely beach straight into the clean sea. When you are done swimming, you can always go on a paddling on a standup paddleboard.

The lovely swimming pool has a separate paddling pool with a slide, and it is surrounded by a large playing and sunbathing meadow with sun loungers.

properties.name: Camping Le Pavillon Royal
properties.description:
Le Pavillon Royal five-star campsite is on the Atlantic Ocean coast, between a golf course and a pine forest. This campsite has pitches with a view of the sea, and is ideal for surfers. Take a trip to Biarritz, Bidart and towards Spain, treat yourself in the massage salon at the campsite, or dive into the water. The pine trees welcome you when you drive on to the campsite. You'll be able to see the ocean through the branches. Rows of trees have been planted on the camping grounds, which provide the necessary shade - the closer you get to the water, the sunnier the pitches are.

Lavish camping

The pitches at the campsite are spacious and separated by hedges. There's always a water connection and an electricity point nearby. If you're right at the back of the campsite, you're in luck: you'll have a view of the endless ocean, and be just a few steps from the beach. If you want more space, you can rent one of the various chalets and apartments.

Swimming and surfing paradise

Le Pavillon Royal Campsite is perfect if you're a water lover. With a swimming pool and its location on the Atlantic Ocean, swimmers, water sports enthusiasts, and beach lovers are all bound to enjoy themselves. The beach is ideal for children: the sea is shallow for some distance, and in the peak season there are lifeguards present. The high waves ensure that the beach is a surfer's paradise: probably one of the best surfing beaches on the Basque coast. Near the campsite you'll find a surfing school where you can rent boards and other equipment.

properties.name: Camping Les Casteillets
properties.description:
On the Route du Soleil, just before the Spanish border, is the Les Casteillets campsite. At this campsite, you'll see mostly mobile homes, but there are also fifty touring pitches. The circular campsite is laid out around the toilet block and offers both shaded and sunny pitches. In July and August, groceries and fresh bread are available at the campsite. That's when the restaurant is also open, and you can get pizzas and takeaways.

Around the campsite

The campsite consists mainly of rental accommodations: there are sixty mobile homes and nine tents for rent. There are also about fifty touring pitches, some of which are wonderfully well-shaded and others in the full sun. At the edge of the campground, in the outer circle, is where you will have the most privacy.

Swimming pool with a view

Behind the reception, next to the bar, is a simple outdoor pool. This pool is heated and open from April to October. There is a separate paddling pool for the little ones, and around the pools, there is a tiled sun deck with loungers and shade screens. From your lounger, you'll have a beautiful view of the foothills of the Pyrenees.

For a short or longer stay

Although Les Casteillets is mainly used by campers as a stopover campsite, there are all kinds of facilities that make it attractive for longer stays. For example, in the high season, there is an excursion programme and an extensive entertainment programme for children, teenagers and adults. In the evening, there is often live entertainment in the form of cabaret, karaoke or theme nights. The disco and dance nights sometimes last into the wee hours of the morning, but fortunately the bar is located a short distance from the campground.

properties.name: Sites & Paysages Au Gré Des Vents
properties.description:
Sites & Paysages Au Gré Des Vents campsite is located on the edge of a forest, within walking distance of the beautiful medieval village centre of Rochefort-en-Terre. This campsite is ideally situated in a hilly area in the Morbihan (Brittany). You'll also be camping close to a beautiful recreational lake. This campsite attracts campers from around the world. These are mainly couples of all ages, but also numerous families with (young) children during high season.

A wide range of touring pitches and rental accommodations

There are a number of rental accommodations located at the front of this well-maintained campsite. Beyond those are large, level touring pitches neatly demarcated by hedges. There is also another large camping field in the lower part of the campsite. The camping pitches there are up to 150 m2 in size. These pitches can be a bit more rugged, but also particularly attractive thanks the presence of old-growth trees and other rustic features.

An indoor and outdoor pool in one

Au Gré Des Vents campsite features a lovely swimming pool with a spacious paddling pool next to it. The water in the indoor pool can be heated up to 28 degrees. It also has a retractable roof, so is easily converted into an outdoor swimming pool on hot summer days. During the summer holidays, the campsite organises fun activities such as aqua fitness, water games and private swimming lessons.

A lake for even more water recreation

A path through the woods next to the campsite takes you to the the beach along the beautiful Étang du Moulin Neuf recreational lake. In addition to swimming, you can also go pedal boating, kayaking, sailing and paddle surfing in this lake.

properties.name: Flower Camping La Vallée Verte
properties.description:
Within walking distance of St.-Nectaire, known for its cheese with the same name, you will find the Flower Camping La Vallée Verte. This tranquil, green campsite lies at an altitude of 700 m on the flanks of the Puy de Dôme, in the sloping, green volcanic region of Parc Naturel Regional des Volcans d’Auvergne.

On this well maintained campsite (2.5 ha) you have a choice of camping pitches varying in size from 80 to 100 m2, which are separated by hedges or other greenery. The trees offer adequate shade and the beautiful flower beds give the campsite an attractive appearance. The mobile homes, bungalows and trekker huts are located behind the swimming pool.

Swimming pool with sliding roof

The heated swimming pool (91 m2) has a sliding roof and toddler pool (25 m2). Children will be happy to see that besides a playground, there is also a trampoline and bouncer. Join a game of table tennis or table football, or play a game of badminton or jeu de boules.

Walking along waterfalls

The campsite is an excellent base to explore the volcanic, green region by bicycle or on foot. The hiking trails near the camping are moderately difficult. In the Sancy mountains there are more than thirty short and long walking trails in the vicinity with lakes and waterfalls.

Basic dishes

At the fairly basic snack-bar you can buy snacks, pizzas, wine, ice cream and take-away meals in high season, which you can eat and drink on the terrace or elsewhere.

Fresh bread is available by order. You will find a few restaurants and a small supermarket in St.-Nectaire at 400 m from the campsite. In high season there is a regular market around the church of St.-Nectaire.

properties.name: Camping Maeva Escapades La Clairière
properties.description:
Camping La Clairière has everything you need to make the most of the outdoors and the beautiful countryside. Its location in the forest and along rippling river gives the campsite a relaxed character. Cycling enthusiasts will enjoy the varied region of Les Landes, with hundreds of kilometres of good cycle paths.

Camping in the green

Most pitches are spacious, partially delimited and suitable for all types of camping equipment. For extra space you can ask for the larger pitches upon arrival. In addition to coniferous trees and tall oaks, the terrain is decorated with young greenery. There are also several beautiful rental accommodations scattered over the terrain.

A nice swim

Of course a refreshing dive is also on offer. At the front of the campsite you will find the rectangular pool which is heated and very well maintained. There is a fence around the pool area and the sunbeds and parasols provide a relaxing place. In the evening the swimming pool is beautifully illuminated.

Friendly bar

The lively bar is the heart of the campsite. Here you will daily find fresh bread and croissants to start the day well. A tasty snack, refreshing cocktail or a simple meal are also on the menu. You'll have plenty of fun during the music performances and karaoke in the summer months.

All attention on the children

Every morning, during the high season, there is a fun activity at the Kids Club, such as dancing and crafts. In the afternoon teenagers can participate in a sports tournament or a treasure hunt. And the foam parties are absolutely spectacular.

properties.name: Camping Saintes Grandes Rives
properties.description:
Camping Saintes Grandes Rives is just a ten-minute walk from Saintes, one of the most beautiful towns of the department of Charente-Maritime. You camp along the Charente river, where you can enjoy wonderful bicycle rides. This river also offers many options for water sports enthusiasts. Because it is located a couple of kilometres away from the A10, this campsite is often used by campsite visitors in transit.

Spacious site with large pitches

The trees on this site include plane, ash, poplar and maple trees, some of which are already many decades old. As a result, a good portion of the pitches are in the shade. The site is spacious and the pitches are large. If you want to camp by the water, some of the pitches are by the river. You can also book a stay in a modern safari tent or a tiny house.

Restaurant, swimming pool and water sports

This campsite has its own restaurant with delicious dishes, located at the campsite entrance, which is also where the outdoor swimming pool is. Fun in the water can also take place in the Charente river, where you can practice water sports as well. Kayakers especially love to navigate the river, which twists and turns through a landscape that varies from city to meadows and woods.

Discover Saintes

Many campsite visitors choose this campsite as a home base for a visit to Saintes (1.5 km), walking to the historic centre. This centre is home to the Arch of Germanicus and an amphitheatre, with a good selection of Gallo-Roman heritage, not to mention all the other historic monuments, medieval buildings and narrow streets.

properties.name: Camping La Plage
properties.description:
On the banks of the Dordogne river, near the village of Meyronne, is camping La Plage. You'll camp here on the grass, on a spacious pitch under the walnut trees. The most beautiful pitches are right on the water's edge. The campsite has its own pebble beach along the river, where you can make beautiful trips by canoe or kayak.

Under the walnut trees

The campsite is beautifully landscaped and well maintained. Because of the many walnut trees the campsite is wonderfully shady. The pitches are on the grass, under the trees. They are marked, but not delimited by vegetation. La Plage is a relatively small campsite, with sixty touring pitches, twelve bungalow and lodge tents and four caravans.

Swimming pool in the sun

There is a simple, heated outdoor swimming pool on the campsite. It is situated in full sun and has a beautiful sun deck with sun loungers and parasols around it. The pool has a separate, shallow area for the little ones. The pebble beach, with its fast-flowing water and the departing and arriving canoes and kayaks, is perhaps a little too exciting for young children.

Boating

At campsite La Plage you can rent canoes and kayaks. They are waiting for you at the pebble beach; you can take them straight up the river. From the campsite you can make beautiful trips and discover the Dordogne river. There are beautiful castles on the banks.
