Because the river has several gullies, you can opt for a quiet or a more wild ride. In addition to canoeing and kayaking, you can also go rafting and paddle surfing.

properties.name: hu Montescudaio Village
properties.description:
In the west of Italy, on the Tuscan hills, Camping hu Montescudaio Village is situated near the town of Cecina, a stone's throw from the ancient village of Montescudaio. You will be camping in the middle of a large Mediterranean oak forest with the Mediterranean Sea and a fine sandy beach only four kilometres away. Enjoy the swimming complex, then relax with a drink in the bar and finish off the evening with a show in the open-air theatre.

From caravan to bungalow

hu Montescudaio Village is a terraced campsite and has a sloping terrain with spacious marked out pitches. Because the campsite is in the middle of the forest, there is plenty of shade. If you don't feel like bringing your own tent or caravan, you can opt for a bungalow or mobile home. The rental accommodations have private sanitary facilities, comfortable beds, a spacious kitchen and a private terrace.

Water fun

There are two large family pools and a paddling pool with a colourful slide and water features. The two larger pools have a hydromassage area for relaxing under the Tuscan sun. For even more convenience while swimming and sunbathing, sunbeds and umbrellas are at your disposal free of charge. In addition, the sea is only four kilometres away.

Activities galore

The campsite has an entertainment team that organises a fun programme for young and old in July and August. There are theatre performances, sports tournaments and aerobics in the swimming pool. In high season there is also regular live music at the bar and you can enjoy musicals in the open-air theatre.

properties.name: hu Park Albatros Village
properties.description:
hu Park Albatros Village is a large and luxurious family campsite close to the town of San Vincenzo on the Etruscan coast, one of the most beautiful coastal areas in Tuscany. The campsite is situated in a hilly area in a pine forest, only eight hundred metres from the beach. This is a top campsite for families with children of all ages.

Pitches with natural privacy

The pitches are generally not really separated from each other. Yet you have enough privacy. This is due to the woody character of the campsite. The pitches differ slightly in size, but they are all spacious. There are also nice rental accommodations to book. Choose for example a SunLodge. This mobile home is suitable for up to six people and has, among other things, luxury beds, a kitchen, air conditioning and a covered terrace.

Endless swimming pleasure

A spacious water park with various lagoons, water slides and playground equipment, but also an Olympic size sports pool for swimming. The phenomenal swimming pool complex of hu Park Albatros Village has it all. You would almost forget that this great water park also has a private beach. This is just a kilometre from the campsite.

Show off your climbing and dance skills

This campsite has entertainment for campers of all ages. For the youngest there are activities organized in the mini club, the mini disco and the playground. The slightly older children will have a great time in the climbing forest that belongs to the campsite. Children will also have a great time with the sports tournaments, talent shows, cabaret shows and dance parties.Fun shows are organised for adults, for example with live music.

properties.name: hu Fabulous Village
properties.description:
Camping hu Fabulous Village is located on the outskirts of Rome, ten kilometres from Ostia Antica. Here you camp in a pine forest, not far from the Mediterranean Sea. The campsite has many different holiday homes: from mobile homes to lodge tents. Young and old can enjoy the water on the campsite. Swimmers who want to do laps get their chance in the large competition pool, while a beautiful lagoon pool is the ideal playground for children.

Different holiday homes

Hu Fabulous Village is very suitable for campers who like to spend the night in holiday homes. All kinds of rental accommodation are scattered over the large grounds: from classic mobile homes to modern chalets and glamping tents. There are seventy pitches for touring campers.

Competition pool and lagoon pool

The swimming complex at hu Fabulous Village is large. There is a large competition pool for swimmers who like to do their daily laps during their holidays. There is also a nicely shaped lagoon pool, especially for the children a nice water playground. In the shallow pool, with a small hill with tunnel, they can play while the parents are lying in the water.

Ostia Antica on the Mediterranean Sea

If you want to swim in the sea, you don't have to drive very far. Fifteen minutes by car and you are on the Mediterranean Sea. If you do go to the beach, take a stop in Ostia Antica. The ruins of this old Roman seaport are five kilometers from the coast, on the Tiber.

properties.name: hu Norcenni Girasole Village
properties.description:
Camping hu Norcenni Girasole Village is a large, luxurious campsite in the hilly Chianti wine region of Tuscany. For families with children of all ages this is a true holiday paradise. With its five swimming pools, varied entertainment programmes and numerous sports and games activities, no one will be bored here. The restaurants, supermarkets and wellness facilities will make your stay here even more comfortable.

Pitches and rental accommodations

The pitches you will find at hu Norcenni Girasole Village are large enough, but sometimes offer little privacy. It may therefore be useful to inquire in advance whether a touring pitch with extra comfort is available. In addition to pitches, the campsite offers a wide choice of rental accommodation: mobile homes, bungalows, cabins, apartments and rooms.

Swimming laps and old-fashioned water fun

hu Norcenni Girasole Village is a vibrant campsite where you can undertake numerous activities. For example, the campsite has no less than five swimming pools! These are divided into two zones. The pools in the lower part of the campsite have a sleek design and are therefore ideal for swimming laps. In the upper part you'll find three more pools, including two real swimming lagoons. Children and teenagers can have fun here to their heart's content.

Delicious food

This campsite has several restaurants with delicious dishes. Two restaurants have their own menu, while in the restaurant in the high part of the campsite you can enjoy a Tuscan buffet four nights a week. From the accompanying terraces you can also enjoy a beautiful view of the surroundings. In addition to restaurants, this campsite has a pizza stall, a bakery, a fish stall and two supermarkets.

properties.name: Flower Camping Le Pont du Tarn
properties.description:
In the heart of the National Park de Cévennes, on the banks of the Tarn, lies the quiet campsite Le Pont du Tarn. The charming village of Florac lies within walking distance. The campsite is an idyllic site, ideal for nature lovers and outdoor sports enthusiasts. Families with children will also have a wonderful time here.

Wooded terrain

The level wooded grounds offer ample shade in the warm summer months. The fairly spacious pitches are laid out along the river and around a playing field. You can opt for a pitch in the sun or in the shade. Want to rent something? The rental accommodation units also look in tip-top order and have undergone major renovations in 2016 and 2017. You have a choice of mobile homes, lodge tents and bungalow tents.

Idyllic river

Swim enthusiasts and sun lovers can choose between the heated, attractive swimming pool and the idyllic river. The swimming pool has a beautiful design and is surrounded by decorative tiles, sun loungers, wicker sun umbrellas and greenery. There is a separate toddler pool with mushroom and a water playground. The river is suitable for swimming, fishing, canoeing and kayaking. There are numerous natural beaches along the river.

Entertainment

Children can play to their heart's content on this campsite: there are several playgrounds with imaginative play equipment. In high season there is also an entertainment team to provide the children with an unforgettable summer. There is a jeu-de-boule pitch, table tennis table and a sports field.

Cosy terrace

The camping restaurant with bar offers basic, but tasty dishes and has a covered terrace. It is opened throughout the day. There is also a bread service. Within walking distance (near the traffic circle) you will find a large hyper-modern supermarket.

properties.name: Flower Camping Les Chevaliers de Malte
properties.description:
On the outskirts of Villedieu-les-Poêles, a historic town of bell foundry and coppersmithing, you'll find Flower Camping Les Chevaliers de Malte. This well-kept city campsite has friendly owners. The spacious touring pitches have grassy ground and are delimited by hedges. There is also plenty to do for children: swimming in the heated outdoor pool or jumping in the bouncy castle.

A city campsite in the green

Flower Camping Les Chevaliers de Malte is the proof that a city campsite can also be very green and doesn't have to be full of asphalt or concrete at all. The almost eighty spacious touring pitches are situated on beautifully tended lawns between many trees. This, together with the orderly arrangement of the pitches, gives the campsite a calm appearance. It ensures that you can camp comfortably in quiet surroundings close to the city. The small river that runs along the campsite, La Sienne, gives the campsite extra charm.

Bouncing and swimming

Children don't have to be bored at the campsite. On the contrary: they bounce into the holiday spirit when they discover the trampoline and the bouncy castle. They can also roll over in the heated outdoor swimming pool, located near the entrance. The pool is rectangular and quite large. On the opposite pavement café you can enjoy a french fry or a drink.

Well-facilitated

With its small restaurant, small shop and clean sanitary facilities, camping Les Chevaliers de Malte is a well-facilitated city campsite. And everything you can't find on the campsite is nearby. A large supermarket for example, a walk of just a few minutes away and several restaurants in the city centre.

properties.name: Camping La Rivière Dorée
properties.description:
Camping La Rivière Dorée is in the region of Île-de-France, on the outskirts of the Forest of Fontainebleau. This charming family campsite has camping pitches as well as accommodation. The campsite is an oasis of peace and quiet and only one hour's drive from the French capital of Paris. But you won't get bored here because there is plenty for active campers to do both at the campsite as well as in the direct vicinity.

Exceptional overnight stays

At Camping La Rivière Dorée, you camp with your own camping equipment or choose for an overnight stay in one of the exceptional accommodation. You could sleep in a tipi tent, a large bubble tent with views of the starry sky or a tent at high altitude. All accommodation have a comfortable bed and clean sheets.

Active holiday

There is plenty for active campers to do at the campsite. There is a volleyball field, a jeu de boules court and a table tennis table. The campsite is surrounded by water on both sides, offering fishing options. On one side, you cast your line in River Le Loing. On the other side of the campsite, you fish in the Canal du Loing.

Visit Fontainebleau

The French city of Fontainebleau and the eponymous castle are a 30-minute drive from the campsite. Visit the charming city centre and the former royal palace of France. The French emperor Napoleon regularly stayed at this castle. The city and the castle are surrounded by the largest forest in Île-de-France, the Forest of Fontainebleau.

properties.name: Camping Le Martin-Pêcheur
properties.description:
In the heart of the Marais de Poitevin, near Magné, you will find the small family campsite Le Martin-Pêcheur. This is a good base for exploring the drained marshlands with their many canals, also referred to as La Venise Verte (the green Venice). You can do this, of course, in a special flatbottom boat or on foot. The Marais Poitevin is an unique nature reserve, in terms of size it is the second largest marshland area of France. Nature is still mostly unspoilt here. There are some 250 birds species in this marshy region. If you look very carefully, you may even spot a coypu.

Small-scale campsite

You will be welcomed to a very well-maintained campsite, where you will be staying on a spacious, demarcated grass pitch. The spacious pitches are perfectly shaded by beautiful trees. On this small scale campsite you can also stay in one of the modern mobile homes. There is a communal room where guests can make use of the tables. This may be a bit more comfortable than sitting at your camping table.

Quick trip to Magné

You can buy basic necessities at the reception. In the village of Magné, some 300 m from the campsite, you can do your shopping in the supermarket, buy bread at the bakery and enjoy a meal in one of the restaurants.

Heated swimming pool

Just outside the campsite is a heated municipal swimming pool (250 m2). This is only open during the summer months. The swimming pool is freely accessible for camping guests. The Sèvres river is on the opposite side. You can take lovely walks along the river. There is a new playground for children.

properties.name: Camping De la Baie de Térénez
Flower Camping Le Martinet Rouge
properties.description:
Between the cities of Carcassonne and Mazamet, in the beautiful south of France, you will find this camping gem near the village of Brousses-et-Villaret. Here you are in the 'Land of the Cathars', a hilly region rich in history, castles and picturesque villages. The immediate vicinity of Le Martinet Rouge campsite has a large network of cycling and walking routes.

Natural surroundings

Lovers of peace, nature and a pleasant atmosphere enjoy camping here. All pitches are easily accessible and look neat. Amidst trees, high hedges and other greenery, you can enjoy your privacy. If you are looking for ready-made accommodation with a bit more luxury, you have a lot of choice: nice lodge tents, but also fully equipped mobile homes.

Splashing around under the palm trees

You can spend hours at the lovely swimming pool right behind the bar. It is not very large, but it looks attractive. For children, there is a fun, round slide and the youngest guests will find refreshment and water fun in the toddlers pool. The swimming pool is open from Juni onwards. In the summer months, there is occasionally live music on the terrace in combination with a tasty barbecue.

Playing at the campsite

After a breakfast with fresh French bread, it is time for the children to play a game of football or basketball on the sports field. There is also a nice playground with a slide and swings where both children and parents gather. In the summer months, fun activities are organized by the entertainment team.

properties.name: Camping Cabestan
properties.description:
In the heart of the Vendée, with more than 250 kilometres of coastline and many beautiful beaches, you will find Camping Le Cabestan. In the middle of a beautiful cycling area, this is a wonderful place for an active or just a relaxing holiday. On the campsite you will find a fairly large swimming pool with sliding roof and nice sunbeds. The neighbouring village of Brétignolles-sur-Mer has charming boutiques and a weekly market with local specialities.

Spacious and quiet

On the site there is a relaxed and quiet atmosphere. A separate part of the campsite has been set up with spacious, sunny pitches with a grass surface. The sanitary facilities are adequate; somewhat basic, but clean. In the colder months, the sanitary facilities are heated. If you walk to the other part of the campsite, you'll find the streets lined with at least ten different types of mobile homes. Varying in luxury, space and the size of the veranda.

To the pool or the sea?

The great advantage of Camping Le Cabestan is its many swimming opportunities. Swim a few lengths in the pool in the morning and take a dip in the Atlantic Ocean in the afternoon. If you want to enjoy a moment to yourself, you can relax on one of the sun beds around the pool. You can end the afternoon with a refreshing drink or an ice cream at the bar. There you will also find a small patio.

Crafts and outdoor enjoyment

Spending a day at the campsite? Children have fun at the crafts club and the playground with trampoline and swings is also very popular. The jeu-de-boules court is a meeting place for young and old. Thematic evenings and karaoke are also organised regularly.

properties.name: Camping Les Acacias
properties.description:
This quiet family campsite is close to the Atlantic Ocean near the town of Messanges. Here you'll enjoy beautiful nature and the sea. Les Acacias Campsite is well maintained and has spacious camping pitches. The campsite has an abundance of greenery, which not only provides privacy but also offers the feeling of being in nature.

Les Acacias Campsite offers plenty to do for campers of all ages, especially in high season. There's an entertainment team that organises fun activities for children in the morning. You can also compete in a pétanque match. Or you can enjoy a game of table tennis or make the most of our game room, which features air hockey and a pool table, among other games. There is play equipment for small children. You'll enjoy breakfast with fresh rolls and croissants. There's also a small shop for purchasing basic items. Fancy a bit of reading? Then head to our small library to check out a good book. You can order delicious food at a food truck in the evening.

Spacious campsites

If you come with your own camping equipment, you can choose from a standard pitch or a comfort pitch. The pitches are level and separated by trees and shrubs. There are pitches in both the sun and the shade. WiFi is free on the campsite. You can also do laundry, if needed. You can also choose from various rental accommodations, such as a mobile home or a chalet, which are fully equipped. The campsite's sanitary facilities are modern and extremely clean.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Valencia
properties.description:
Camping Sanday Valencia is located at a distance of only 150m from the glorious sandy beaches of the Costa Valencia. It is also a great spot from which to explore the fascinating town of Valencia, located at only 20 km south of the campsite. You can conveniently travel to Valencia by metro. City hoppers, sun worshippers, swimming enthusiasts and aficionados of the Spanish way of life will enjoy Camping Valencia!

Pitches

The pitches are spaciously and beautifully laid out and can be found between trees and shrubs. There are many shaded pitches. If you do not have your own camping equipment, you can rent a spacious bungalow.

Water paradise

There is a large swimming and water paradise with water slides, a separate toddler pool surrounded with a large lawn with loungers and sun umbrellas. Lifeguards keep an eye on things, so you do not have to worry about the children. The quiet sandy beach at the Mediterranean Sea is certificated with the international 'Blue Flag' eco-label, a label which guarantees a clean and safe beach as well as seawater.

Do you feel like a nice lunch, a coffee or a cold beer in between all the sunbathing and swimming? No problem! Along the beach is a beautiful esplanade with convivial restaurants.

Active entertainment team

Children can enjoy themselves in the playground, at the table tennis table or on the tennis court. In peak season there an active animation team organises aerobics in the swimming pool each day, as well as all kinds of nice games for young and old. You can enjoy fine meals in the camping restaurant. There is also a bar and a supermarket.

properties.name: Camping L'Etang des Haizes
properties.description:
This lovely four star campsite is located in Normandy, near the town of La Hay-du-Puits. You'll camp here not far from Cherbourg, Granville and the Mont Saint Michel. The spacious camping pitches on L'Etang des Haizes have space for tents and caravans, but you can also rent mobile homes and fully furnished tents. The campsite has a focus on quality, whereby respect for the environment and the surrounding area is also important.

A great place to camp

You'll arrive on an open, very well maintained campsite where there is an eye for detail. The camping pitches are numbered and you pitch your stent, caravan or camper on a nicely maintained lawn. The pitches are spacious enough (90-100 m2) for a car, caravan and a few tents for the kids. And even then you'll have sufficient living space.

The heart of the campsite

Cantral on campsite L'Etang des Haizes there is a large swimming pool, which has a water slide and plenty of space for playing children and lap swimmers. In addition to this swimming pool there is a large pond, where you can pedal. There is a bar with a lovely terrace next to the swimming pool. A nice drink after swimming? It's waiting for you!

In summer, activities such as archery, a ping-pong tournament or bingo and quiz nights are organised. If the weather doesn't play ball, there is a covered recreation space.

Shop and sanitary facilities

As everything on this campsite, the sanitary facilities are also first rate. The sanitary facilities are also heated, which is great when the weather is a bit colder. The camping shop has only the bare necessities, but there is a reasonable selection of shops in nearby La Hay-du-Puits.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Toscana Bella
properties.description:
Camping Toscana Bella is located in the forest, within walking distance of the Italian West Coast. You camp here in the picturesque Tuscany region. This is an ideal holiday destination for beach, nature and art lovers. The area invites you to undertake active outings to art cities or nature areas. And upon your return 'home' to the campsite, tired but satisfied, you can collapse on a comfortable chair in the campsite restaurant for a delicious Tuscan meal!

Camping among eucalyptus trees

The grounds are shaded by numerous eucalyptus and olive trees. The light is filtered by their foliage, so that you are also comfortable near your tent or caravan on hot days. The pitches, demarcated with hedges, vary in size. You have a choice of pitches measuring between 40 and 70 m2 and a luxury pitch of 100 m2. The surface is very firm. Want to hire something? Choose between one of the many mobile homes and lodge tents.

Dream away peacefully in a lounger

The swimming pool is reasonably-sized and is surrounded by a beautiful green hedge. There is ample space around the swimming pool to relax on one of the loungers. Adjacent to the swimming pool is the restaurant terrace. There is also a sunbathing lawn. Prefer the sea? It is an easy and comfortable walk to the sandy beach and the Mediterranean Sea.

Active entertainment team

Children can enjoy themselves on the spacious, shaded playground with monkey bars, slide, swings and a Wendy house. In addition, you can let off steam on the beach (volley)ball court, the pétanque pitch and the basketball field. To top it all, there is a daily entertainment team which organises all kinds of activities.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya La Roubine
properties.description:
Camping Sandaya La Roubine is situated in a beautiful spot on the banks of the Ardèche River, close to the charming village of Vallon-Pont-d’Arc. Here, you can camp surrounded by nature. Take a dip in the swimming pool, explore the water park or relax by the river. Whether you’re looking for adventure, nature or relaxation, this campsite has it all.

Camping in green surroundings

At Camping Sandaya La Roubine, you can choose how you want your stay to be. Pitch your tent or park your caravan on a spacious pitch surrounded by greenery, or opt for the convenience of a modern mobile home with all amenities close by. The location by the river is what makes it extra special. From the campsite, you have direct access to the Ardèche. Perfect for a refreshing dip, an afternoon of sunbathing or a nice paddle. For fishing enthusiasts, there’s even a special area set up along the water’s edge.

Swim, have fun and relax

Water lovers are in for a real treat here. The swimming pool complex offers plenty of fun for young and old alike. Swim a few lengths in the heated pool or relax in the hot tub while soaking up the sun. For children, there’s an adventure playground and water park where they can entertain themselves for hours. Meanwhile, you can completely unwind in the wellness area or the outdoor seating area with a drink in hand. We’ve also got you covered on the culinary front. Take a seat in the restaurant, have a drink at the bar or grab a quick bite at the snack bar. Here, you can enjoy the relaxed camping rhythm every day.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Le Pianacce
properties.description:
Nestled in the green hilly inland of Tuscany, some 6 km from the Tyrrhenian Sea, you will find Camping Le Pianacce in a wooded area near the village of Castagneto Carducci. This large, luxurious campsite with its lodge-type rental accommodation embodies the definition of 'glamping in Tuscany'.

Camping with all the trimmings and more

The first impression is of a well-maintained terraced campsite with lots of foliage and flowers, a spot where you feel at home as soon as you arrive. Le Pianacce is an oasis of peace, where everything is perfectly organised. The pitches are spacious and offer ample privacy. They vary in size and the best pitches offer shade.

The campsite is mainly geared towards families with children. There is a swimming paradise with slides, from where you have a splendid view of the Tyrrhenian Sea. All in all, you will find everything you need for a pleasant stay: a restaurant with lovely atmosphere and a comprehensive menu (take-away possible), an amiable bar and a small supermarket.

Glamping in Tuscany

In addition to mobile homes and bungalows, Le Pianacce also has unique rental accommodation in the form of fully furnished lodge tents (two to nine persons) with wooden floor, kitchen and bathroom. The largest tent even has a private jacuzzi and a gas barbecue.

Free shuttle bus to the beach

In addition to the aforementioned swimming paradise, Le Pianacce also offers ample sports facilities. There is a tennis court, soccer and volleyball field and a mini-golf course. In peak season a team of professional entertainers keeps the children busy with games and discos. Trump card of the campsite: a free shuttle service to the beach.

properties.name: Camping Ushuaïa Villages Le Port de Lacombe
properties.description:
Camping Le Port de Lacombe is a clean medium-sized family campsite in the French Midi-Pyrénées. The campsite borders on the Lot river and has its own beach and a jetty for the excursion boat. The heated swimming pool with water slides provides extra water fun. The playground, the fun entertainment and the bar make this an ideal holiday destination in the French countryside.

Camping amid greenery

At the campsite you get that feeling of really camping. There is lots of greenery, so that you think you are in the middle of the countryside. There is room for 75 touring pitches on level sandy soil. There are also 20 glamping accommodations in the form of sturdy safari tents and mobile homes. With the generous pitches separated by hedges and bushes, there is no lack of space and privacy.

Whizz down the slides

The bar, the playground with trampoline and the swimming pool form the campsite’s agreeable centre. The swimming pool has two fun water slides and there is also a beautiful view of the green landscape! In the summer months the programme includes dancing and musical performances, games at the KidsClub and fun theme evenings. The bar has a dining area where you are able to enjoy, say, a delicious pizza.

Have fun on the river

Enjoy the surrounding hilly area during, for example, a magnificent excursion on the Lot river. It is very handy that the boat stops at the campsite jetty. Or rent a canoe or a pedal boat to explore the area from the water. Hiking enthusiasts put on their sturdy shoes for a route through the valley.

properties.name: Camping de l'Océan
properties.description:
Camping Le Relais de l’Océan is situated in the Quiberon peninsula (Brittany), directly by the Atlantic Ocean. This large campsite on the coast is eminently suitable for the entire family. The heated outdoor pool, multi-purpose sports field and a nice animation programme (with Breton games and karaoke) offer entertainment to young and old. Furthermore, there is a bar (with terrace) where you can get a bite to eat and a drink.

Cosy camping

Several small paths on the camping ground lead to the camping pitches. If you want a quiet camping spot, your best choice is at the far end of the campsite. Here you are far away from the swimming pool and entertainment activities at the front of the campsite. The pitches are spacious and are tucked away between tall trees. You can opt for an open camping pitch under the trees, but also for a cosy spot between hedges. 

Heated outdoor pool

At the front of the campsite lies the heated swimming pool in a sunny location. You are bound to find your children here as well, because the swimming pool is popular with the little 'water rats'. In the meantime, you can soak up the sun on a lounger along the edge of the swimming pool or take a dip in the warm water yourself. 

Breton games and karaoke

Children (as well as adults, of course) will find enough to do on the campsite. In addition to the swimming pool, there is a multi-purpose sports field for a game of soccer, basketball or volleyball. The large playground has a variety of equipment for the little ones and for slightly older children. In summer, fun activities are organised for all age groups: traditional Breton games, sports tournaments and karaoke evenings, accompanied by mussels and fries.

properties.name: Camping Monte Rosa
properties.description:
You can experience space, peace and freedom in the Monte Rosa mountain range at an altitude of 577 metres. The unique setting in Val d’Anzasca, one of Val d’Ossola's seven valleys, makes for an unforgettable camping holiday here. Camping Monte Rosa is incredibly quiet and small, an ideal starting point for mountain walks. You can walk right to Monta Rosa at the end of the valley where lovely routes start. You look out over the high snowy mountain tops and the deciduous forests from your tent, caravan or motorhome. The neat site is very clearly laid out and the rear of the campsite borders the River Anza.

Camping in Val d’Ossola

The campsite is along the road to Monta Rosa between the impressive backdrop of the high mountains, in a rural nature area. The road is windy and sometimes steep, which means the last part of the route is not very suitable for large caravans or motorhomes. You can see the wooden reception building by the side of the road. The reception is also a meeting place where you can read in less favourable weather.

Space and peace

The spaciously laid out campsite only has 25 camping pitches. You can see the countryside wherever you look, which creates a calming atmosphere. The many trees offer adequate shade, but you can also get a pitch in the sun. None of the pitches are demarcated, and they are on a large grass field and indicated by a number, but you can choose your own pitch. The toilet and washing facilities have been renovated and are neat.

properties.name: Camping De Heibloem
properties.description:
Camping De Heibloem is a mini campsite in Baarschot in the province of Noord-Brabant, located on the edge of Landgoed De Utrecht. Here you can camp in the Brabant countryside, between fields and forests, on comfort pitches or in one of the nice "sleepover cars". Those looking for peace and quiet will find the campsite to be a great holiday destination and a suitable base for cycling trips and walks.

Comfort places

In the beautifully tended grazing area of the campsite there is room for about twenty touring pitches. These are very spacious and have an electricity connection, water supply and drainage and their own washbasin. Due to the extensive fields, which you can look out over from your pitch, the camping site has a very spacious character. In addition to the touring pitches, you can also stay in one of the two-person "sleepover cars", cosy wooden rental accommodations with their own cooker.

Fine neighbours

As usual with a mini campsite, camping De Heibloem is fairly simple. The sanitary facilities are very good. However, you won't find many facilities there. That's why it's nice that the campsite has a neighbour: less than two kilometres away is a large Landalpark (Vakantiepark Duc de Brabant), where you can find fresh bread and the main groceries. Guests of De Heibloem campsite can also use the outdoor swimming pool of this holiday park free of charge.

Horse station

Camping De Heibloem is not only a campsite but also a horse station. Campers who like to go on holiday with their horse can take that with them to the campsite. There are special stables where the animals can spend the night. The owners of the horse are warmly welcomed in the Bakhuis, an old cottage on the campsite with a communal area.

properties.name: Camping Hetzingen
properties.description:
Camping Hetzingen is in the German town of Nideggen, near the Eifel National Park. You camp right by the Roer river. Spend your holiday with a view of the historic fortifications of the town of Nideggen, less than three hours’ drive from Utrecht. The campsite is open all year round.

Sleep in a wine barrel

The campsite has pitches and rental accommodations, some of which do not have their own sanitary facilities. The pitches are divided into three classifications, going from standard, with a 16-ampere electricity connection, to comfort, which is more spacious and has water and drainage connections. The premium pitches are right next to the river.

From kayak to sauna

There is plenty to do on this large campsite. Enjoy freshly baked rolls with your breakfast every morning, and in the evening pull up a chair in the campsite restaurant.

Play a game of jeu de boules, kick a ball around the football field or take your bats along for a fanatic game of table tennis. There is also a fun playground and the campsite rents out kayaks and bicycles.

Camping Hetzingen is unique in that it has a sauna. You can relax here with a view of the fortifications.

On foot or on a bicycle?

Camping Hetzingen is a perfect spot for nature lovers, cycling enthusiasts and hikers. There are literally 300 kilometres of footpaths and cycle routes at your feet. The medieval town of Nideggen, known for the fortifications that can be seen from the campsite, is two kilometres away.

The Roermeer is 11 kilometres away, where you can go for a refreshing swim, rent a small boat or go sailing.

properties.name: Camping Vittoria
properties.description:
Camping Vittoria is located close to Venice. Here you camp on spacious pitches under the pine trees. The swimming pool with water slides and play equipment, the entertainment team and the beach will ensure that you have a fantastic holiday. And in the restaurant you can enjoy a delicious authentic Italian meal.

Discover the campsite

Once you've set up your camping equipment, it is time to explore the campsite. The children may already have found the playground or the large swimming pool. There you will find water slides, play equipment and daily aqua gym lessons. Don't forget to bring your bathing cap when you go swimming!

Do you prefer salt water? Then Camping Vittoria is also the right spot for you. From the campsite, you can walk onto the beach and down to the sea. The wide sandy beach is exclusively for campsite guests and has a free area and an area where you can rent loungers and sunshades. There is also a bar, a beach volleyball court and a football pitch on the beach.

In the low season, there is entertainment during the weekends and in peak season, activities are organized daily. The little ones can visit the Miniclub where they can do crafts or have their face painted. There are magician shows, music bands and special acts in the evenings.

Italian dining

The camping has a fine restaurant and pizzeria if you're looking for an authentic Italian meal. You can choose to go out for dinner or you can take out your meal and enjoy your food at your tent or caravan.

properties.name: Valjevikens Camping
properties.description:
Valjevikens Camping, located between Valje and Sölvesborg in South Sweden, offers a wonderful camping experience in the Valje nature reserve. The area is known for its beautiful walking and cycling routes. Nature lovers can enjoy the vast forests north of Sölvesborg. The campsite, which is right by the sea, has excellent reviews and its own private beach and swimming jetty.

Open campsite with spacious pitches – some with sea views

The site at Valjevikens Camping is spaciously appointed and has an open character. You have lovely views of the sea from some of the pitches. Besides spacious pitches, there are mobile homes, hiker's huts and caravans available for rent.

Private sandy beach and jetty by Valjeviken bay

This campsite is by Valjeviken bay, connected to Hanöbukten bay and the Baltic Sea, and is ideal for swimming without too many waves or a strong current. The site has its own sandy beach and swimming jetty. For more entertainment, there is a playground and miniature golf course.

Own restaurant and shop

In the same building housing the reception, you will find a restaurant with meat and fish dishes and a shop with a basic selection of groceries. For more eating and shopping options, the city centre of Sölvesborg is about three kilometres away.

Modern toilet and washing facilities

The campsite has a modern toilet block with regularly cleaned facilities, including three family bathrooms. A disabled bathroom is under construction.

Dance round the midsummer pole during the Midsummer celebrations

From late-May to early-September, Valjevikens Camping organises various activities, including dance evenings and themed parties. The Midsummer celebrations, with traditional folk dancing around the midsummer pole, are an exceptional experience for guests.

properties.name: Flower Camping Provence Vallée
properties.description:
The charming green campground Flower Camping Provence Vallée is located in the hilly landscape at the edge of the former Roman trading town of Manosque (to the southwest in the region of Alpes-de-Haute-Provence. The surrounding area is a picturesque region with impressive nature, lovely towns and the scent of thyme and lavender everywhere. Welcome to the South of France!

Lodge tent with a view

There is plenty of vegetation and privacy on the long, slightly sloping property. You can choose a place in the sun, with some or a great deal of shade. Looking for rental accommodation? Choose one of the special lodge tents on terraces with a lovely view of the Alps and the Durance valley.

Water pleasure

There is a lovely swimming pool on the property where you can swim laps with a surrounding lawn and comfortable lounges. The pool is in the direct sunlight. There is also a kiddie pool. The water sports region Lac des Vannades is 7 km away, and a shuttle bus goes there from the campground. What is by the sea? Various play equipment, a fitness course, a restaurant with a simple menu, a pebble beach with shallow water, sufficient shade and toilets. Tip: take your aqua socks with you.

A variety of activities

In the high season there are plenty of activities for all ages, from water games and treasure hunts to morning exercises and dance evenings. In the area there is paragliding, canoeing, climbing, golf, tree climbing, walking and cycling.

Food trucks in the high season

There is a small grocery and an outdoor bar at the campground. In the high season, food trucks also stop here. There is a larger supermarket 3 km away.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Les Tropiques
properties.description:
The four-star Les Tropiques campsite in Torreilles Plage (Roussillon) offers all the luxury amenities and activities you could wish for. The campsite is located 400 metres from the beach directly accessible from the property, and has a water park with slides. For the children there are well maintained playgrounds and there is a fabulous activities programme on offer. The campsites are partly located in the sun, and some are in the shade.

Warm welcome

The entrance and the spacious reception make a good impression. On the other side of the road there is an "Office du Tourisme". Flat paved roads lead to the campsites, which are in the minority compared to the rental accommodation. The sites are spacious and separated by the lovely greenery. They are on straight paths. In addition to the comfortable mobile homes and chalets, there are also special tents to rent, like the domed Coco Sweet (one or two bedrooms).

Water paradise

In the high season, Les Tropiques is very popular with families. Not surprisingly, there are many facilities and activities for them. For example, the spacious water park of 3200 m2 of water surface, divided among four heated swimming pools. Other facilities: five slides, various playground equipment and a wellness centre. The public beach lies behind a broad dune area accessible by a path.

Wonderful facilities

Les Tropiques looks very well maintained and offers everything a camper needs. There is a restaurant with a lovely menu (take-aways possible). Other facilities: a supermarket, lovely playgrounds, a rope pyramid, a multi-sports field, a BMX circuit and outdoor fitness equipment.

properties.name: MS Vacances - Camping Club Le Vivier
properties.description:
Campéole Le Vivier is at the heart of the pine forests of the Landes-Aquitaine coastline. The friendly seaside resort of Biscarrosse Plage is only two kilometres away. Just a short walk away, you can already get a breath of fresh air on the Atlantic Ocean coast. The campsite is popular among surfers for a reason, but parents and children will also have a great time here.

Camping in the forest

There is nothing like a spot in the shade in the sunny south of France. At Campéole Le Vivier, you're in the middle of a pine forest. Besides comfort pitches, there are also special ‘signature’ pitches, equipped with extra luxury. Don't have your own camping equipment? The lodges and tents are fully equipped. Mobile homes are available in basic and luxury versions.

Ideal for families

Children can have fun in the campsite swimming pool. And there is also plenty to do in the playground. Climbing, sliding and frolicking on the bouncy cushions, for example. There is no lack of entertainment. There are clubs for young and old, disco and karaoke nights and shows. Are you a sporty type? Then there's plenty for you to do too. Here you can practise archery, ball sports and real Olympic sports competitions are organised.

Surf school

Many surfers know where to find this campsite, but wouldn't it be cool to be able to ride the wild waves yourself? Well, you can learn that here too! With its direct access to the beach, you can take surfing lessons at a real surf school here.

properties.name: Bank Farm Leisure, Camp. & Car. Park
Flower Camping St. Lambert
properties.description:
Camping St. Lambert is located in the unspoilt countryside of the Aveyron, just outside Millau. You will find this family campsite by the river Dourbie. From the private beach on the riverbank you have a view of the limestone mountains. You can cool down in the river or swimming pool. Your spacious camping pitch is in the shade of the many trees. Enjoy the peace and quiet of nature or a live performance at the restaurant.

Shady pitches by the river

It is a shady spot by the river Dourbie. The spacious pitches are accordingly situated under the trees. In the open air at this campsite, you can enjoy camping with a tent, but the spacious pitches are big enough for the largest caravan. Perhaps the most beautiful pitches are on the river bank. You can look out over the water from your camping chair.

Quiet family campsite

In high season, it is mainly families who stay at St. Lambert's campsite. So there are plenty of holiday friends for your children. There is no full entertainment programme or mini disco at this campsite. The children can have fun in the playground, the swimming pool or in nature.

A splash in the pool and river

A splash in the swimming pool is an everyday occurrence at St Lambert's campsite. This pool is especially fun for the children. It is not too deep, so they can swim safely. The river Dourbie is also fairly shallow, especially near the beach. You can have a lovely swim here with the whole family. Are you ready to dry off? Lie down on the soft grass and let the sun do its work.

properties.name: Sportcamping & Glamping Resort Rio Vantone
properties.description:
Sportcamping & Glamping Resort Rio Vantone lies at a beautiful location on Lake Idro, near the border between Lombardy and Trentino-South Tirol. This five-star campsite has its own surfing school, making it popular among water sports enthusiasts. Its location in a mountainous area makes it an ideal holiday address for those who love mountain sports as well. The campsite also has entertainment for children, a heated outdoor swimming pool and a fine catering establishment.

Safari tent with views of the stars

It is a delight to camp on one of the small-scale camping fields at this well-kept campsite. There are five categories of touring pitches. If you would like a large pitch near the lake, then choose a comfort water pitch. You can also book a stay in a modern mobile home, safari tent or apartment. One of the safari tents stands out. The ceiling can be unzipped to admire the beauty of the starry skies from the comfort of your bed.

Culinary delights from Lombardy

Lombardy has some of the best food in northern Italy. Enjoy a regional dish at the campsite restaurant Ristorante La Tavolal. The menu includes delicious salads, amazing bruschettas, home-made pasta, pizza and delectable regional wines. A tasty drink can be had at Bar Vantù as well. The campsite also an ice-cream parlour, a supermarket and a clothes shop.

Lots of fun outdoors

Enjoy yourself in the swimming pool with wading pool. The youngest campsite visitors will have fun at Villa Bambini, the children's club. They can do crafts here and go on exploratory trips through the woods and along the beach. The beach, which is part of the campsite, is the location of a professional surfing and (water) sports centre. Here you can rent water sports items, such as boats, surf boards and standup paddleboards.

properties.name: Camping Stein
properties.description:
Camping Stein is close to the town of Bad Endorf in the hilly southeast of Bavaria. Here, you camp in wooded surroundings with many large lakes. The most well-known (and most touristic) lake in this area is the Chiemsee. If you would rather stay in a slightly quieter area, a better holiday destination would be the Simssee located slightly further west. Camping Stein is right by this lake. From the campsite's grassy beach, you can literally walk straight into the wonderful water of the Simssee. You camp on a neatly maintained campsite in Bavarian style, with many playing options for (young) children and surprisingly good snack bar.

Wine barrels, chalets and many touring pitches

You can meet the campsite owners, the Stein family, at the friendly reception. The first time you walk or drive across the site, you will soon notice that this is a structured and well-maintained campsite. Tourist camping pitches are clearly in the majority at this spaciously laid out site.

If you book a camping pitch at Camping Stein, you could get a spacious grass pitch, or a pitch with a gravel surface is also a possibility. There is a large tent field, the Bulliwiese, by reception. You can also hire a luxury chalet or mobile home. Or spend the night in a charming wooden wine barrel.

Swimming in the child-friendly Simssee

This campsite has a private beach by Simssee. The bottom of this lake slopes very gently. So, it's ideal for children! There is a lovely playground beside the grass sunbathing meadow, where children can have plenty of fun.

properties.name: Gryta-Camping
properties.description:
Gryta Camping is located right at Lake Olden, between the fjords of the Jostedalsbreen National Park in the west of Norway. At some ten km distance from the campsite lies the Jostedalsbreen, the largest glacier on the European mainland. Gryta Camping is an amiable campsite with a view of the lake and the surrounding fjords. You camp here in unspoilt nature, with the comforts of a neat campsite.

Breathtaking view

The view of the lake from the camping pitches is truly breathtaking. This privilege is not only afforded to pitches directly by the water. Because of the terraced setting, each camping guest has a clear view of the lake and the fjords. The campsite also has rental wooden chalets available in the same typical style as the reception building.

Lake Olden

Gryta Camping is located between various glacier tongues, which give rise to numerous small rivers. One of these streams flows across the campsite and feeds into Lake Olden. The colours of the lake change in the course of the day from pale green to dark green and blue. When there is no wind the lake looks like a mirror and the water surface reflects the surrounding mountains. 

If you want to go onto the lake, the campsite owner is happy to lend you one of his boats. These rowing boats and canoes can be rented (free of charge) from the reception. The lake is excellent for fishing. The Norwegian summers are not particularly hot, but should the sun manage to raise the temperature of the water, you can also go for a dip.

Barbecue by the water

There are several picnic tables and a communal barbecue along the water's edge. Quite often, a large bonfire is lit and the day's catch is eaten.

properties.name: RCN Toppershoedje
properties.description:
An enormously large sandy beach, wind and dunes: these are the ingredients for a camping holiday in true Dutch style. Welcome at RCN Toppershoedje! You will find this park near Ouddorp on Goeree-Overflakkee in the province of Zuid-Holland. The small-scale park is situated near a wide North Sea beach. The camping fields are spaciously laid out and have a playful design, which makes for a nice ambiance.

Pleasant welcome

Upon arrival you are warmly welcomed at the modern reception, where you can get all necessary information about the campsite and the area. There is fun playground equipment for children and the camping pitches are spacious. Most pitches are located in the shade, some more so than others. When you go to the camping fields, you will also see the bungalows and chalets. Once you reach the camping field, you will find it peaceful and relaxing.

To the beach with a handcart

During weekends and school holidays there is an entertainment team which organises all kinds of fun activities. Furthermore, there is a recreation field, table tennis and a sports cage. You can rent bicycles, go-karts and handcarts. You have to cross a range of dunes to get to the beach. Voilà: the widest sandy beach of the Netherlands. It is a 10-minute walk to the beach, therefore a handcart for the tiny ones can be very convenient (and lots of fun as well).

Well-stocked supermarket

The campsite has a restaurant, snack bar and croissanterie. In the spacious restaurant you can order a delicious meal or a three-course dinner. There is a well-stocked supermarket some 300 m away.

properties.name: Camping de Bourges Onlycamp
properties.description:
Camping de Bourges is located just north of the centre of France, in the Centre-Val de Loire region. Here you'll camp on the edge of the historic centre of Bourges, with its impressive cathedral as a crowd puller. Because of its central location, this city campsite is ideal for a stopover and/or city visit.

Spacious pitches

The campsite has an oval shape and is surrounded by trees, so you don't feel like camping on the outskirts of town. In the middle of the oval are very spacious pitches with a hard surface, ideal for (larger) camper van for example. Delimited by hedges. In the second 'ring' there are slightly smaller pitches. These are on grass and have a little more shade from the trees.

Entertainment nearby

The campsite is quite simple. Apart from a playground, there is little to do for children. There is also no entertainment program offered. Pleasant and quiet place to spend the night for a stop-over. In the vicinity, however, you will find plenty of opportunities to have fun. Next to the campsite is the river Auron, where you can go fishing. At less than 2 km this river flows into the recreational lake Du Val d'Auron, where you can take to the water on a surfboard or rowboat.

Hot shower

The sanitary facilities are simple, but a hot shower and a clean toilet are available. You can have a small bite to eat on the campsite, but for dining out Bourges is a better option.

properties.name: Camping de Nevers Onlycamp
properties.description:
Situated on the banks of the Loire, directly opposite the city of Nevers, lies Camping de Nevers. Although the campsite is situated in the south-western part of the Bourgogne, there are fewer vineyards here. The main focus of Camping de Nevers is on the neighbouring city and the Loire river region. At night the campsite has a splendid view over the illuminated city. Situated on the A77, this is also a popular stopover campsite for holiday makers on their way to the south.

Camping spot on the water's edge

When you arrive at the campsite, you simply follow the road to the pitches, where you have a choice between pitches directly on the riverbank or a bit higher up. Camping de Nevers also offers an opportunity to rent a mobile home.

Bridge to the city

The campsite is virtually next to the bridge in the direction of Nevers. When you cross the bridge, you are in the centre of Nevers. From the campsite it is only a 750 m walk to the centrally situated Place de Republique. In Nevers you will find all facilities of a large town such as a bakery, supermarket, shops, restaurants and sidewalk cafes on town squares. These facilities are not provided by the campsite, and therefore convenient to have within walking distance.

The campsite obviously offers sanitary facilities (basic but functional) and the children will enjoy themselves on the banks of the Loire river where there is a small beach.

properties.name: Camping de Bourbon-Lancy Onlycamp
properties.description:
Slightly south-west of Bourbon-Lancy, a medieval village known for its thermal baths, lies Camping de Bourbon-Lancy. This green campsite is located on a large lake, suitable for fishing and boating. You can swim in the swimming pool on the campsite. In the camping shop you can also buy fresh bread.

Camping in the greenery

Camping de Bourbon-Lancy is narrow and has pitches on both sides of the paved road. You camp here on spacious pitches between the trees which provide a lovely shade. The pitches are separated by hedges which almost always offer you privacy. 

In addition to touring pitches, you also have a choice of rental accommodation, including mobile homes and bungalows. These bungalows are well maintained and stand out because of their cheerful colours. There are special paved pitches of some 15 m2 for motorhomes. 

Swimming, fishing and boating

At the centre of the campsite is a small swimming pool (60 m2), directly adjacent to a few camping pitches. The youngest campers can enjoy themselves in the adjoining toddler pool. Situated adjacent to the campsite is a large recreational lake. This can be reached by exiting the campsite via the entrance and exit. The lake is widely used for fishing and is also suitable for boating. You can relax and sunbathe on the small beach. 

Other entertainment is offered in the form of a pétanque pitch and a table tennis table. You can also hit a ball on the beach volley ball field. During the summer months there is a Kids Club which organises great activities for children.

properties.name: hu Venezia Camping in Town
properties.description:
Hu Venezia Camping in Town is a well-kept city campsite on the ring road of the Italian city of Venice. The shuttle bus takes you from the campsite to the centre of Venice in 15 minutes. It’s a modern park, consisting mostly of mobile homes and glamping tents. The large outdoor pool and bar (which has a terrace and shop) are perfect after a day in the city. Everything’s close at hand here.

Immaculate accommodation

Most guests book their accommodation for just a few days to visit the city, so there isn't really a traditional camping atmosphere here. The separated lanes are mostly lined with furnished glamping tents and the mobile homes. Although the holiday park has relatively few traditional pitches, they do look great: green, large and shady. Your dog’s welcome too.

Swim, enjoy the bubbles and relax

As soon as you see the pool, you’ll want to do just one thing: take a refreshing dip. Or how about a nice bubble bath? There’s a separate children’s pool with a play lagoon for the youngest campers. Relax with a book on one of the many sunbeds. Children can also have fun in the playground or at the pool tables. Fancy an Italian coffee, a sandwich or a tasty pasta? Then take a seat on the large terrace of the Bacaro Moderno restaurant.

Explore atmospheric Venice

The shuttle bus from the campsite is a convenient way to get to the city. The historic city centre is home to the famous St Mark's Square, the Doge's Palace, the Rialto Bridge and the beautiful islands of Murano and Burano.

properties.name: Camping Les Prades
properties.description:
In het bergachtige landschap van de Aveyron, aan de zuidelijke oever van de Tarn, ligt camping Les Prades. Deze gezellige gezinscamping heeft moderne voorzieningen, gelegen in authentieke gebouwen. Kampeer op een toerplaats aan de rivier, eet in het chique restaurant en zwem in een zwembad met glijbanen en jetstreams.

Kamperen aan de Tarn

Op de camping zie je een mengeling van moderne huuraccommodaties en ruime toerplaatsen. De toerplaatsen, niet afgescheiden maar wel mooi gelegen onder de bomen, zijn in de grote meerderheid. De plekjes aan de oever van de Tarn zijn iets kleiner dan de rest, maar dat maakt ze niet minder mooi. Het aanbod aan huuraccommodaties bestaat uit mobilhomes, coco-sweettenten en appartementen.

Gezellige gezinscamping

Een gezellige gezinscamping zonder harde muziek en overenthousiaste animatieteams: camping Les Prades is ouderwets gezellig zonder toeters en bellen. Het terras van het restaurant, het zwembad en sportmogelijkheden – volleyballen, zwemmen, boogschieten – nodigen uit om andere kampeerders te ontmoeten. Kinderen maken er gemakkelijk vakantievriendjes.

Glijbanen, fonteintjes en jetstreams

Je vangt er waarschijnlijk al een glimp van op wanneer je naar het receptiegebouw loopt: het grote zwembad, gelegen aan de kant van de weg. Met glijbanen, fonteintjes en jetstreams is dit zwembad voor de waterliefhebbers de grote attractie op de camping.

Kanotochtjes

Camping Les Prades is een van de weinige campings gelegen aan de zuidelijke oever van de Tarn. Niet dat deze oever minder mooi is dan zijn overzijde. Of dat er minder te doen is. Integendeel. Voor de avontuurlijke zwemmers lenen de rotsen zich uitstekend voor een salto in de redelijk snelstromende rivier, terwijl kanoërs vanaf het kiezelstrandje gemakkelijk te water kunnen.

properties.name: Camping Les Lanchettes
properties.description:
Camping Les Lanchettes is located in the heart of the high mountains of the Vanoise, a national park in the south-east of France. This mountain campsite is situated at the end of a valley in the Alps. A small river flows through the slightly sloping, terraced terrain. From the spacious touring pitches you have a beautiful view of the surrounding mountains. Which are extremely suitable for mountain hikers, while in winter especially winter sports enthusiasts will find a good base at the campsite.

Camping between the mountains

The campsite, situated between the high mountains, is rather flat. The little river Le Ponturin crosses the campsite and divides the site in two. On the slightly sloping terraces on both sides of the water there are about seventy spacious touring pitches, from where you have a beautiful view of the surrounding mountains and - when camping on a higher part - of the valley. The site breaths nature and peace and quiet. You are away from the hustle and bustle of the city, encapsulated between the Alps.

Restaurant with regional dishes

In the stately main building of the campsite you will find the reception as well as the restaurant. In this attractiverestaurant you can have breakfast and in the evening you can enjoy local Savoyard dishes: cheese fondue, tartiflettes and diots (sausages prepared in white wine). Do you prefer to eat in? Then just pick up a french fry. There is a supermarket in the village, three kilometres away, where you can buy your daily groceries. There is also a bakery in the village.

properties.name: Big Bear Plitvice Nature Resort
properties.description:
Surrounded by the untouched nature and many waterfalls and lakes of Plitvice Lakes National Park, this campsite is a dream location for outdoor enthusiasts. The modern campsite in Croatia is conveniently located amongst the world-famous Plitvice Lakes and has everything you need for both an active and a relaxing holiday in nature.

View of the mountains

The campsite has sixty sunny pitches and various luxury mobile homes. The mountain views are stunning from every spot. The camping pitches are spacious and paved and therefore very suitable for motorhomes.

The Plitvice Lakes and waterfalls

The picturesque nature of the national park in which the campsite is located is truly breathtaking and will enchant you with its lush forests, clear lakes and spectacular waterfalls. Unfortunately, you are not allowed to swim here, but you are allowed to do so in Lake Rastoke and Lake Sabljaci.

Sandwiches and burgers

Guests can enjoy affordable local dishes and tasty burgers in the restaurant. You can go for breakfast in the morning. There's also a bar and a gym.

Children can enjoy themselves on the playground equipment and on the trampolines.

Kayaking and ziplining

The area is a paradise for active adventurers. There are plenty of cycling and hiking trails. Bicycles can be rented at the campsite. Another unforgettable excursion is a visit to the bear sanctuary in Kuterevo. And a kayaking trip in a transparent kayak on the clear Gacka River is equally memorable.

Or let yourself be carried away on one of the longest zip lines in Europe! Zipline Pazi Medo is located 2.5 kilometres from the campsite.

properties.name: Camping de Bocht
properties.description:
Close to Oirschot, considered the most beautiful village in De Kempen, you'll find the peaceful and friendly De Bocht campsite. It is a good base camp for discovering the beautiful nature reserves with forest, heath, farmlands, marshes and country estates. While you are out on a cycling or hiking tour, stop by one of the many inviting restaurants or cafés in the area.

At the reception desk you will find flyers on the beautiful and pleasant environs. Next to reception there is a charming café-restaurant with a bowling alley. Here you can enjoy sitting on the terrace.

Comfortable camping

Chalets and bungalows are rented out year round on the well-maintained campground, featuring a comfortable sanitary building and good facilities. You can choose one of many spacious camping pitches (100 m2) on grass with plenty of privacy thanks to the greenery. You get your own little field where you look out onto the centre of the campground. In the summer, little tents can be set up here. At a comfort station, you have access to water, electricity and an antenna connection.

The campsite is popular with seniors, but also with families with children, thanks to the swimming pool and the little playground. They can go round the campsite on rental carts. The swimming pool (100 m2) is only open in high season. The toddler pool measures 18 m2.

Bowling alley

Nearby for a fee, you can golf but you can also use the bowling alley on the campsite grounds. The four fully automatic bowling alleys are open all year round. This is definitely a fun activity for those rainy times.

properties.name: Camping I Tre Moschettieri
properties.description:
On the east coast of Italy, the elongated beaches of the Adriatic Sea are beckoning. Along one of those beaches, right between Venice and San Marino, you will find campsite I Tre Moschettieri. A campsite especially for beachgoers and campers who feel right at home by the sea.

A veritable swimming paradise

The many trees on the campsite make way for the campsite's swimming paradise. No fewer than six swimming pools are to be found here. However, they have not lost sight of the numerous camping guests with young children: one of the swimming pools is a toddler pool. You will find many families with children at the swimming pool. The campsite and swimming pools are also popular with teenagers and senior citizens. 

Sun, sea and sun umbrellas

When you come to campsite I Tre Moschettieri, it is with the beach uppermost in your mind, of course. To reach the sea, you only have to walk down the camping grounds. The sun umbrellas are beaming at you once your feet touch the warm sand. The beach slopes down gently, ideal for children to paddle. 

Entertainment for children

Especially for children there is no lack of entertainment on the campsite itself. There is a large-scale entertainment programme. Children will enjoy themselves endlessly with theatre shows, theme evenings, swimming pool games, animation clubs and much more.

Camping life

Although it may be worthwhile to visit the lively Lido delle Nazione at night, you do not actually have to leave the campsite during your camping holiday. Children can amuse themselves all day there and the beach will always continue to attract, of course. Furthermore, you can head for the campsite restaurant.

properties.name: Camping Edy
properties.description:
Liguria is a beautiful coastal province in North Italy. The western part is also referred to as the Flower Riviera. The terraced campsite Edy (CITR 008027-PAR-0002) is situated close to the highway, on a steep slope above the harbour town of Diano Marina. You can use your tent, but the grounds are more suitable for caravans and camper vans. The beach is not far away and a small bus is available to take guests to the beach.

Attractively laid out olive grove

The campsite is laid out on terraces in an old olive grove. The old trees therefore dominate the vegetation of the grounds. On the higher, sloping sections of the campsite are rental accommodation units of all kinds and sizes. Many have a nice terrace where you can sit outside and enjoy the lovely view and wonderful climate. The camping pitches are located at the foot of the slopes on the lower part of the grounds. Once again, they are laid out on terraces and have a surface of fine gravel.

Nice bar with splendid view

There is a fine, not excessively large outdoor swimming pool. Adjacent to it is a large whirlpool. There is also a nice bar on the campsite. There is a seating area with large windows and splendid view of the slopes covered with olive trees.

Shuttle bus to the beach

The campsite organises excursions and offers entertainment. There is a shuttle bus that takes sun lovers to the beach and back again to the campsite. In the nearby Diano Marina is a bowling centre with a large swimming pool and all kinds of recreational facilities.

properties.name: Camping Marino
properties.description:
Campsite Marino (CITR: 008027-PAR-0003) is a campsite in Diano Marina, Imperia, located by the sea.The campsite has which are marked out, pitches with shade, pitches without shade and pitches with some shade. Camping Marino is located close to a sandy beach. It is possible to rent mobile homes. The campsite has a playground.

The following rules apply to pets at (Camping Marino):                                                      - Dog(s) permitted in low season (if on a lead) - Dog(s) permitted in high season (if on a lead)

The camp site has an outdoor swimming pool. You can swim nearby in the sea. At Camping Marino you can go snorkelling, windsurfing and waterskiing. You can also use the internet, as the camp site has one or more computers with an internet connection and you can access the internet with your own laptop in 80% of the camp site.

properties.name: Camping de Collonges-la-Rouge Onlycamp
properties.description:
This neat campsite is located in the French Corrèze, near the picturesque village of Collonges-la-Rouge. Here you can enjoy peace and tranquillity, ancient medieval villages and beautiful nature. Campsite de Collognes-la-Rouge is small-scale and offers camping pitches shaded by trees. In addition to camping pitches, you can also opt for rental accommodations, such as mini-chalets and mobile homes. You can get all necessary provisions at the supermarket, and for a tasty snack you can go to the snack bar, which is open in July and August.

Quiet campsite with lots of greenery

When you arrive at Campsite de Collonges-la-Rouge, you will notice that the grounds look well maintained. The quiet campsite has a green appearance due to the many trees and lush vegetation. This affords you a cool camping spot in the shade. The 68 camping pitches are large and demarcated. If you come without your own camping equipment, you can opt for a mini-chalet, various mobile homes and an eco-lodge. Your four-legged friend is also welcome at this campsite.

Water recreation at the nearby swimming pool

Guests of Campsite de Collonges-la-Rouge can use the municipal outdoor swimming pool, which is close to the campsite, free of charge. Children can whiz down the slides, there is a paddling pool for the littlest ones, there are water games and you can relax in the sunbathing area around the pool.

Activities for young and old

In high season, there is a Kids Club for children between 4 and 12 years old, where activities are organised 1 or 2 times a week. They can also play in the playground. There is plenty for sports enthusiasts to do in the summer months as well, such as fitness and pilates classes and aquagym.

properties.name: Camping du Puy-en-Velay Onlycamp
properties.description:
Small-scale campsite du Puy-en-Velay is located in the heart of Puy-en-Velay. This peaceful campsite, situated on the banks of a river, is an ideal starting point for exploring the Massif Central in Auvergne. This municipal campsite only has 72 camping pitches, giving the campsite a relaxed and familiar atmosphere. Here, you can sit back and relax, and enjoy the beautiful green surroundings.

Municipal campsite in Puy-en-Velay

Camping du Puy-en-Velay is a small-scale and welcoming campsite with just 72 camping pitches, suitable for tents, caravans and camper vans. The camping pitches vary in size and have plenty of shade. Campers come here to enjoy the peace and quiet and to explore the surroundings. The campsite itself does not have many amenities, but it is ideally situated. A very large supermarket, where you can do your daily groceries, is just a five-minute walk away. Furthermore, you can walk within a couple of minutes to the historical town of Puy-en-Velay.

Especially for culture enthusiasts

Le Puy-en-Velay is a town that has secured a spot on the UNESCO World Heritage list. It is also known as the pilgrim town. The town is one of the most important stopping places along the pilgrim route to Santiago de Compostela. The town is staggeringly beautiful with its cathedral, beautiful squares, and the Black Madonna which you can view here. Are you looking for a challenge? Then climb 80 metres up to the chapel of Saint-Michel D'Aiguilhe, built on top of an old volcanic plug. From here, you will have a beautiful view of the Haute-Loire region.

properties.name: Camping de la Bageasse Onlycamp
properties.description:
Nature lovers and seekers of peace are at the right place at Camping de la Bageasse. This camping, located on a river, is green and equipped with all amenities. Take excursions to the surrounding area, enjoy the French hospitality and relax at the camping pool.

The best of two worlds

The hilly region of the Loire will entice you to go on walks and cycling trips, while you can explore unique volcanoes in the Auvergne. The camping is located just outside of the town of Brioude and cities as Le-Puy-en-Velais and Issoire are easily accessible.

On the river

When you arrive at the campground, you cannot fail to notice the l'Allier river. The flowing water lends atmosphere and character to the location. At Camping de La Bageasse, you are camping in the midst of nature. With the view of the river and the many trees on the camping, your daily worries will soon be a thing of the past. If you want a little more comfort, you can rent one of the caravans or chalets.

Fun in the water

Alternate days on the river with a day at the swimming pool. The swimming pool is in the centre of the camping grounds. Take a good book and stretch out on one of the loungers. Even the smallest campers have been considered, as there is a small toddler pool near the swimming pool. Camping by the river is not only wonderful for the necessary cooling off, but invites you to take part in water sports activities. Near the campground there are kayaking and rafting opportunities, but you can also cast a line. Not much of a water lover? You can also play volleyball and jeu de boules. There is a special playground for the children.

properties.name: Camping de Montlouis-sur-Loire Onlycamp
properties.description:
Camping de Montlouis-sur-Loire in Montlouis-sur-Loire is a small campsite with only the basic amenities that you need to enjoy a quiet and peaceful camping holiday. This campsite is also often used as a campsite for travellers passing through, so that you can enjoy a wooded campsite by the water a little longer before heading further down to the south of France.

Small-scale campsite

The campsite is a small and welcoming campsite with 76 spacious camping pitches. There are also a couple of mobile homes for rent for a comfortable holiday in the Loire region. From the reception at the front of the campsite, you can drive to your camping pitch over well-paved roads. The camping pitches are grass and are separated by low hedges. Furthermore, it is possible to choose a pitch with plenty of sun or shade.

The sanitary facilities on campsite de Montlouis-sur-Loire are well-cared for, and there are facilities available for the disabled.

For the children

Do you feel like going for a swim? You can do so in the public outdoor swimming pool just 200 metres away from campsite de Montlouis-sur-Loire. But there is plenty to do at the campsite as well! There is a playground, a boules court, a table tennis table and a volleyball court. In the peak season, several fun activities are organised throughout the week by an entertainment team.

Activities in the area

The historical town of Amboise is located just a few kilometres from the campsite. Here, you can visit the castle, an architectural gem from the Renaissance period. The balconies, rooftops and gardens of this castle offer stunning views of the Loire region.

properties.name: Camping de Santenay Onlycamp
properties.description:
Camping de Santenay is located in the southern part of French Burgundy. The campsite, which is located near the village of Santenay, has all of the characteristics that make this region so special. On the site you'll stay in a quiet and wooded environment and from the campsite you look out over the hills and vineyards of the Cote de Beaune.

The campsite can be easily reached from the motorway by following the signs toward Santenay. You'll first reach the reception upon arrival on site. After you have checked in, you drive past trees and bushes to your campsite.

Peace, space and nature

At Camping de Santenay you will be camping in a green and quiet environment, and with a little luck, you'll have squirrels scurrying by your tent. The campsites in the grounds are spacious. Some sites are hidden among the trees, others are located on the grass field and have a broad view of the vineyards. Don't have camping equipment? Rent a lovely caravan.

Swimming pool around the corner

The campground only has basic facilities such as the sanitary facilities and a playground for the children. The sanitary facilities are simple and the facilities and buildings really aren't new anymore. But everything is clean and close to every site.

Opposite and next to the campground there are a few sports fields (basketball court and football pitch), and the municipal swimming pool. In July and August, campground visitors can use the swimming pool for a fee.

properties.name: Camping Villaggio Gilda
properties.description:
On the Adriatic coast, roughly halfway between San Benedetto del Tronto and Pescara, lies Camping Villaggio Gilda. You are here in the Abruzzo region, where the mountainous interior (with the highest Apennine mountains in Italy) forms a lovely contrast with the coastal region. The campsite is located near Roseto, a seaside resort with wide sandy beaches, a beautiful beach boulevard and numerous shops, hotels, and campsites.

Small-scale and friendly

Camping Villaggio Gilda is a small-scale campsite with few seasonal pitches. The campsite makes a welcoming impression, both in appearance and in ambiance. Besides the pitches for tents, caravans and motorhomes, there are also a few rental accommodation units such as homes and mobile homes.

Beautiful, child-friendly beach

Gilda does not have a swimming pool but is situated directly next to a sandy beach which gradually slopes down to the sea. This makes it ideal for children. You can play a game of beach volleyball there, and it's also perfect for a relaxing walk along the beach. At the beach is also a welcoming bar where you can enjoy a drink while enjoying the beautiful sea view.

Dine at the campsite or in Roseto

The campsite has a restaurant-bar-pizzeria (with takeaway). You will find a supermarket 100 metres from the campsite. The centre of Roseto has many more shops and eating establishments. Good to know: the campsite provides a free shuttle service and rents out bicycles. In the peak season, Gilda offers the usual entertainment programme for all ages, with sports and games during the day and dancing and live music in the evenings.

Sanitary facilities

The sanitary facilities are modern and well-maintained. There are separate sanitary facilities for children and for the disabled. There is also a dog shower.

properties.name: Camping Velling Koller
properties.description:
Experience ultimate peace and quiet at Camping Velling Koller, located in the picturesque Søhøjlandet lake district in Denmark. Camp between forests and lakes here. Escape from everyday life and have the perfect mix of adventure and relaxation during your camping holiday.
