Go for a long walk through the ancient forests, step onto a mountain bike or just enjoy the peace and atmosphere.

Pitch, mini-cabin or hotel

Put up your camping equipment on one of the more than 130 pitches. Prefer a bit more comfort? Then stay in one of the mini cabins for 2 or people or one for 4-5 people with private toilet and washing facilities. There’s also a small hotel on site, where you can stay in luxury in the nature of Denmark's West Jutland.

No crowds but fun

It’s back to basics at this campsite, but you will find everything that a camper might need. This simplicity is more than compensated for by the beautiful natural surroundings. The campsite has a large communal kitchen where you can prepare tasty meals and a number of dining tables. There is also a barbecue, a campfire area and some camping games.

Denmark's most beautiful train ride

Take a dip in one of the lakes or go fishing. Hop on your bike to explore the area around the campsite. Or take an unforgettable train ride on "Denmark's most beautiful train track" between Horsens- Bryrup.

properties.name: Camping Bijar
properties.description:
In a beautiful spot, in a centuries-old pine forest and right on the west coast of the Croatian island of Cres, you will find this campsite. The Camping Bijar campsite is located in a central spot for exploring Cres and the connecting island of Lošinj, and is close to the lovely town of Osor. On the grounds of Bijar, which slope down to the sea, you will be camping on shaded sites that are playfully designed and some of which offer a view of the sea. This is a fairly small-scale campsite, so it's ideal for peace seekers and nature lovers.

From Brestova in Istria, you can take the ferry to the island of Cres. Then drive south to the village of Osor. About four hundred metres before Osor you will find Camping Bijar on the right side of the road. After arriving at the campsite, you will be welcomed by professional receptionists in the reception area. If you think you might need some help with a tow on this sloping terrain, you can tell us right here.

Playfully landscaped, shaded pitches

As a touring camper at Camping Bijar, you can choose from pitches with four comfort levels. The level of comfort is mainly determined by the location of the sites: the closer to the sea, the higher the level of comfort. In general, the pitches have plenty of shade, although the Superior pitches right by the sea also have sunny sections. A special feature is that the shapes and the separation of the camping spots are determined by the numerous coniferous trees. In addition to these playfully laid out pitches, there are luxury (stationary) caravans for rent.

properties.name: Camping Baldarin FKK
properties.description:
If you like to spend your holidays in unspoilt nature, in a place free of crowds and noise, the Camping Baldarin campsite is an ideal option. This campsite is located in the forests in the south of the Croatian island of Cres. Right alongside the campsite runs a jagged coastline with several small and larger beaches. From there, it's lovely to swim in the deep blue and crystal clear sea. So all in all, a wonderful destination for naturists, and indeed: for the most part, this is a naturist campsite.

Camping near the beach or in the woods

Camping Baldarin has five categories of pitches. Want to pamper yourself and your travel companions? Then choose a beautiful Superior Mare pitch, right on the beach. If you prefer more shade, you can of course choose a spot further into the forest. In addition to camping pitches, there are also several beautiful (mobile) caravans for rent here. In addition, chic glamping tents are available for two to five people.

A paradise for beach and sea lovers

The campsite is located on a coastline with many small bays and numerous secluded beaches. Especially around the rocky beaches, there are also stretches of beach with sand. The slightly larger pebble beach Bokinić is located at the campsite entrance. This is the ultimate family beach, with a playground, sports fields and a beach bar next to it. What all the beaches have in common is that they offer excellent access to the crystal-clear sea. In addition, the swimming areas are cordoned off by safety lines.

properties.name: Ardoer Camping Tempelhof
properties.description:
You will find this cosy family campsite in the north west of the Netherlands. You have the choice of camping with your own equipment or to rent accommodation. A swimming pool, playground, sports hall and a restaurant on the campsite will ensure that you have a relaxed, complete holiday. Camping Tempelhof is located between the sea, dunes and woods near Callantsoog in Noord-Holland. The helpful staff at reception will help you find your way amongst all the facilities that Camping Tempelhof has to offer.

You have access to water and power at your pitch and for a small fee you can enjoy cable TV and private sanitary facilities. When you camp with a tent, you can also choose to pitch on the hiker's field. It is also possible to stay in a bungalow or chalet at Camping Tempelhof.

Swimming pool and beach

This campsite is primarily aimed at families. Special attention has been given to seniors, who may enjoy quiet laps in the swimming pool between 9-10 in the morning. Thereafter, children can have fun all day in the indoor pool with slide. At two kilometres distance from Camping Tempelhof lies the Callantsoog beach, the oldest seaside resort in the Netherlands.

Sanitary facilities

Camping Tempelhof has luxury sanitary facilities that are also sustainable. There are solar panels on the top of the toilet buildings and flushing is done with rainwater. Children can use their own children's sanitary facilities. There also is a possibility to rent a private bathroom with whirlpool for the duration of your stay.

properties.name: Campingplatz Dockweiler Mühle
properties.description:
Campingpark Dockweiler Mühle is peacefully located in the German Eifel region. The campsite is situated around three fishing ponds and offers spacious pitches on grass. Many pitches are situated on terraces between the year-round pitches. For the children, there is a nice adventure playground and the campsite has sanitary facilities and a laundry. For a bakery or restaurant, you walk to the neighbouring village of Dockweiler.

Old watermill

The highlight of the Campingpark Dockweiler Mühle is the 18th-century watermill. Nowadays the mill is out of service and the mill wheel hangs on the reception desk for decoration. At first glance, the campsite seems to be full of year-round pitches, but there is also room for free touring pitches on several terraces. In front, there is also a field with only pitches. The pitches are generally spacious, situated on grassy fields and demarcated by hedges.

Peace, quiet and nature

Campingpark Dockweiler Mühle is a quiet campsite where you can quickly feel one with nature. You will stay near water, surrounded by greenery and you can catch glimpses of the Eifel right from your pitch. The children also become familiar with nature in a pleasant way. From the reception building, they can reach the adventure playground by a small bridge. There is plenty of room to play, do sports and horse around on a grassy field by the water's edge.

Casting a fishing rod

Central to the campsite are three fishing ponds. Swimming is not possible here, but relaxing along the waterfront is of course possible. If you have a little more time (and patience), you can also cast your rod there.

properties.name: Ardoer Camping Torentjeshoek
properties.description:
On camping Torentjeshoek you camp in a natural area, amidst still unspoilt woodlands. This peaceful, friendly campsite is situated on the edge of the Dwingelderveld National Park, one of the many nature areas in the province of Drenthe. Enjoy the most beautiful walks across the moors and fens.

Camping between trees

Dwingeloo itself is fairly green. However, only when you get to the campsite have you reached the real woodlands. You camp right in the midst of these on campsite Torentjeshoek. The spacious camping pitches are on large lawns, between trees and bushes. Unique rental accommodation units on the campsite are an army truck, a boat and a few treehouses.

Privacy and conviviality

When you cherish your privacy, camping Torentjeshoek is the right place to be. Your neighbours have also come here to enjoy the peace and quiet. Furthermore, the spacious pitches provide a little extra privacy. However, this does not mean that it is not a convivial campsite. You can enjoy a bite and a drink with your fellow campers on the terrace and in the brasserie. There is also an entertainment programme for adults in high season.

Little adventurers

From the terrace you have a good view of the large playground, where the smaller adventurers enjoy scrambling on the climbing equipment or jump around on the bouncy castle. When the weather is not good enough for the playground, you will find the children in the indoor playground. Here they can do plenty of climbing and scrambling, playing in the sand or sliding down the slides.

Swimming pool Beleefpark Dwingeloo

The campsite itself has no swimming pool, but campers have free access to swimming pool Beleefpark Dwingeloo. This large outdoor pool, with toddler pool and water chute, is located a few hundred metres along the road from the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Du Château de Poinsouze/les Castels
properties.description:
Camping Le Château de Poinsouze, part of the Les Castels chain, is a comfortable campsite near Boussac-Bourg. The campsite is on a country estate with a castle, by a lake. Far from the motorway, it is an ideal spot for relaxing and unwinding. In the high season, this campsite for families with children is an excellent choice.

Spacious pitches

You can choose from pitches of different comfort levels. In any case, you are guaranteed a large, well-maintained pitch. They are demarcated with hedges, trees and plants. This campsite also has accommodation for rent, for example wooden chalets, fully furnished mobile homes and gypsy wagons.

Water fun, entertainment and sporting pleasure

It is great fun in the water park at Camping Le Château de Poinsouze. That consists of a lovely overflow pool, a water slide and whimsical water playground. Furthermore, children can enjoy the three activities the recreation team organises daily in the high season. The focus is on sport, play and creativity.

Restaurant with local dishes

In the campsite restaurant, you can enjoy traditional dishes prepared with fresh regional produce. The restaurant offers various menus and accompanying wines. Good to know: this restaurant is not open every evening, but you can always get take away meals. Furthermore, there is a bar with patio by the swimming pool and a small supermarket.

Water sports on the campsite lake

The lake plays an important role at this campsite. Via the campsite, you can hire canoes, a sailing boat or pedal boat, with which you can go for a trip on the lake. That way you can admire the castle in a completely different way.

properties.name: Camping Le Clos Bouyssac
properties.description:
In the middle of the Lot hills, in a quiet spot by the water. That's where the Camping Le Clos Bouyssac campsite is located. Here, you will find complete peace and quiet in a green setting near the village of Touzac. You will be camping on a spacious pitch directly by the river Lot. A perfect place to relax or to cast your fishing rod. Need a little more relaxation? Then take a dip in the large pool or choose a lounger on the shore.

Camping by the river

The Camping Le Clos Bouyssac campsite has very spacious pitches for your caravan, camper or tent. Almost all spots have a view of the river. Will you choose a large pitch under a tree right on the water? Or perhaps a slightly higher spot in the more heavily wooded area? Here, you will also find the new safari tents, for an extra luxurious camping holiday.

Swimming in the sun

Every French campsite needs a swimming pool. This campsite is well aware of this fact! In the middle of the grounds, we have a rectangular pool. Nothing fancy, but it's clean and spacious. Perfect for taking a refreshing dip if you like, and for hours of fun in the water for the kids. Sun worshippers can choose a lounger around the pool. They are all located in full sun.

Cheers to your camping holiday

Do you feel like raising a toast to your holiday with your fellow campers? Then raise your glasses in the new bar or on the terrace. There is always room for small-scale conviviality at the campsite. This will make you feel at home very quickly.

properties.name: FKK-Camping Am Useriner See
properties.description:
If you think you would enjoy camping between a lake and the forests of the Müritz National Park, the Camping Am Useriner See campsite is the place to be. At this mixed naturist and non-naturist campsite in the northeast of Germany, you will experience the ultimate feeling of freedom. The campsite is situated next to the beautiful Useriner Lake, but the clear lakes in the surrounding area are just as inviting for swimming, canoeing or boating.

Camping amidst green

Once you arrive, set up your camping gear in one of the spacious open spaces in the forest, or rent one of the caravans on the campsite. Large groups can stay overnight in a log cabin. There are special RV sites for RVers.

Swimming in the lakes

During a holiday at the Camping Am Useriner See campsite, it's great to spend a lot of time by the water. Laze around on the fine sandy beach or take active trips through the forest and water-rich environment. There is a separate beach area for naturists. Those who like to ride bikes can rent them at the campsite. Along the way, you'll encounter large and small clear forest lakes where you can swim or just enjoy the view. Children can romp around in the campsite's playgrounds or visit one of the sports fields.

Fresh bread rolls in the morning

To make sure that you get off to a good start every day, the campsite has a shop with a small selection of products. Among other things, fresh bread rolls are available. On the small terrace near the reception, you can enjoy a drink or an ice cream. About five kilometres away, you will find several restaurants and supermarkets for the rest of your shopping needs.

properties.name: Ardoer camping Zonneweelde
properties.description:
Close to the coast (800 m), enabling you to explore Zealand and part of Belgium, you will find the quiet campsite Zonneweelde. You camp here on sheltered pitches with ample privacy or in one of the unique rental accommodation units. With an extensive entertainment programme for young children and teenagers, as well as the interesting, sometimes rugged surrounding nature, there is plenty to do for young and old during the holidays.

It is situated near the village of Nieuwvliet, also popularly referred to as Sinte Pier, after one of earliest medieval settlements in this area: the Fiefdom of St. Peter. It is a nice base for trips to, for instance, Breskens or to Belgian coastal resorts like Knokke.

Large water playground and indoor playground

The campsite is very popular among children, also because of the 250 m2 indoor playground, the outdoor swimming pool and the water playground. With a slide, climbing tower, sprayers and a water playground in the sand to build dams and canals, children can enjoy themselves for hours at a time. In July and August, the swimming pool is open each day in low season it depends on the weather.

Campsite Zonneweelde is also a very good base for a beach holiday. Some 800 metres from the campsite you will find the Nieuwvliet beach and a bit further along lies the Groede beach, hailed as one of the cleanest beaches in the Netherlands. The white sandy beaches are wide and have a beautiful natural dune area. In peak season lifeguards are in attendance on the main beach of Nieuwvliet and the beach is cleaned on a daily basis.

properties.name: Camping Bissen
properties.description:
Camping Bissen is located in the picturesque Sûre Valley, approximately 2 km from the beautiful village of Esch-sur-Sûre. You can spend hours hiking or cycling through the surrounding densely-forested green valleys of the Luxembourg Ardennes.

Main building in eco-friendly style

The reception is located in the brand new and eco-friendly main building, halfway along the elongated campsite grounds. Here you will find the owner, Marc Bissen, who will help you look for a fine pitch and get you acquainted with the surroundings. The permanent pitches are located on the elevated part of the grounds; the lower area by the river has pitches reserved for tourists.

Camping by the river

Your tent or caravan will stand on on grass pitches, right by the water. There are also cabins and mobile homes scattered around the grounds, and there is an apartment available for groups up to nine people. There are three well-tended shower blocks, which include a baby room and bathroom facilities for the disabled.

Air mattress race or ghost hunt

The campsite is ideal for children. There is an indoor playground, and in the peak season, the campsite provides an extensive entertainment programme with activities such as an air mattress race or a ghost hunt in the dark. Sports competitions are organised for the sports enthusiasts, and you can go fishing and swimming in the Sûre river.

Conviviality foremost

Next to the reception, you will find a café with a terrace for a quick snack or bite to eat. Bingo evenings and karaoke nights are held here in the summer. Across the street from the campsite is a restaurant with an extensive menu. There is also a shop with fishing gear. To do some shopping, you will need to visit the shopping centre 10 km further down the road towards the Belgian border.

properties.name: Bad Sonnenland Ferienpark & Campingplatz
properties.description:
This well-maintained campsite is located near the town of Moritzburg, just a 15-minute drive from stunning Dresden. Here you'll be camping in a quiet, wooded area right along the banks of a recreational lake. It is therefore an ideal spot for watersports, hiking and cycling enthusiasts alike. Bad Sonnenland Ferienpark & Campingplatz is a well-organised and well-maintained campsite featuring beautiful camping pitches that are especially well-suited for touring campers.

Choose your own spot on the wooded camping fields

After registering at the reception, you'll then walk or drive another three hundred metres before arriving at the actual camping area. This predominantly wooded site features mainly shaded touring pitches. The camping fields are neatly arranged with plenty of spacious pitches for you to set up camp. The annual pitches are located on a separate field.

Plenty of relaxation on and around the lake

Bad Sonnenland campsite is located directly on the Dippelsdorfer Teich recreational lake. You can walk across the campsite to one of the beaches or sunbathing areas located along the lake shore. The lake is a wonderful place to go for a swim on hot summer days. Its also ideal for enjoying various water sports activities.

Delicious brunch or dinner in Moritzburger Seeterrassen

The elegant Moritzburger Seeterrassen restaurant is located in a beautiful spot close to the lake. The large terrace offers you a gorgeous view of the lake as you enjoy flavourful dishes and drinks. The extensive Sunday brunch is also highly recommended!

properties.name: First Camp Skovlund - Lillebaelt
properties.description:
If you would like to go on a camping holiday in the stunning countryside on the coast of the Danish island of Funen, First Camp Skovlund – Lillebælt is an excellent choice. Here, you camp at a well-maintained campsite with lovely green camping fields. The sea is a 5-minute walk. You look over Båring Bay from the coast. At the campsite itself, the whole family can have fun in the lovely water park or at one of the playgrounds. The 'Garden of Denmark', as Funen is also called, is perfect for island hopping and for long walks and bike rides.

Spacious pitches on green fields

Once you have registered, you will be allocated a camping pitch. All pitches are large (>100 m2), neat and demarcated by hedges. You have plenty of space around you. As there are only a few tall trees around the fields, you can enjoy that extra bit of sun.

Even if you come without your own camping equipment, you can have lovely holiday at First Camp Skovlund. Indeed, there are various types of wooden chalets and holiday homes to hire, which have all the modern conveniences. And for those wanting to experience that genuine camping feeling, a furnished bungalow tent is available.

Splashing in the heated water park

The highlight at the campsite is definitely the heated water park. Splish and splash in one of the swimming pools, whizz down the slides or enjoy the water mushroom. Both young and old will have an excellent time in the swimming pool. There is a paddling pool specially for the little ones.

properties.name: Camping Maarlandhoeve
properties.description:
Hidden behind an imposing country house with a historic farmhouse, located on the outskirts of Uithuizen, you will find camping Maarlandhoeve. You will camp here on the peaceful campsite of a mini-camping, situated in the vast Groningen countryside. Relax completely on this quiet spot in the north of the Netherlands, where meandering gullies and ditches cross the flat landscape.

Total tranquillity

On the farm campsite you can hear a pin drop. A total tranquillity envelops the large lawn of the campsite and its surroundings. Those seeking peace and quiet can camp here on spacious touring pitches on the edge of the plot. Tree rings provide shelter, especially against the wind. Furthermore, the campsite, which overlooks the wide surroundings, has a very open character.

Uithuizen and the Menkemaborg

If you camp at camping Maarlandhoeve, you are just in the built-up area of Uithuizen. Handy, because you never have to go far for groceries. In its centre, less than a kilometre away, there are several supermarkets together. Be sure to drive along the Menkemaborg if you decide to explore Uithuizen. Where there used to be more than two hundred of these Groningen castles, now there are only a few left.

By bike or canoe?

The flat landscape of the Hogeland, a region in the north of Groningen, attracts many cyclists. The roads are narrow and quiet, here in the countryside; ideal for campers who like to cycle through the charming villages of Groningen, situated between the fields. You can also explore this area from the water. Canoes can be hired on the campsite.

properties.name: Camping & Hoevelogementen Aldörrum
properties.description:
The small, charming campsite Camping & Hoevelogementen Aldörrum is situated in a quiet area in South-East Brabant and offers a view of the De Biezen nature area. After a long bike ride or walk you can unwind on one of the spacious camping pitches set amidst greenery. Bicycles can be parked in a covered bicycle shed, which is fitted with several charging points for electric bicycles.

Attractive camping pitches

The camping pitches can be found in a former fruit orchard. Each of the spacious pitches is equipped with a 6A electricity connection. The terrain is divided into three fields. Travelling cyclist and hikers can always find a camping spot with a bench close by.

Luxury accommodation

If you arrive here without your own camping equipment, you can hire one of the appartments. The appartments accommodate two to four people. Guests have access to a kitchenette, TV and free internet connection.

Right across the campsite is the good and affordable restaurant with beautiful terrace. For enthusiasts, there is also a 9-hole golf course there.

Extensive sanitary facilities

The campsite has excellent heated sanitary facilities which are spotlessly clean. The well maintained toilet building has an outside and an inside area. All showers have a wet and a dry section with bench. A few showers are equipped with safe wall brackets. It is also possible to rent a private bathroom.

properties.name: Agritur Montibeller
properties.description:
Small but perfect: this is how you can best describe the friendly Agriturismo Montibeller. The campsite is only a 10 minute walk from the health resort Roncegno Terme and is surrounded by the glorious nature of the Valsugana region. The small campsite only has fifteen camping pitches. In the direct vicinity of the campsite you can make lovely cycling and walking trips. Tourist attractions such as Venice and the well-known Lake Garda are within reach.

Small camping with all comfort you need

The campsite is located behind a farmhouse and has fifteen small pitches, each with a level and partly-hardened surface. Because of the steep access and the fairly compact pitches you will see mainly tent campers here. There are also some apartments for overnight accommodation.

The campsite is equipped with all amenities. It has contemporary and very well maintained sanitary facilities, a cooking area, a washing area, communal area and a covered terrace with three barbecues for guests.

Simple, delicious dishes

Don't feel like cooking? Heave a seat in the restaurant and enjoy. Here Mama Rosalba Montibeller rules the roost. She conjures up all kinds of mouthwatering dishes. All ingredients are fresh from the land (hers) or from the farmers in the vicinity. Camping guests can also have breakfast there or even arrange full board. 

Enjoying the wellness complex

The wellness areas of the campsite are absolutely unique. After an active day you can dream away and relax totally for a while in different types of baths. In the wellness complex organically grown herbs are used, obviously grown by the family themselves.

properties.name: Odden Camping
properties.description:
A Japanese garden in the high north? Sure! And this describes the five-star campsite Odden: here you find peace, nature and lovely details. It is spacious, luxurious with numerous amenities and possibilities to explore, especially in or on the water of the Otra River, which borders the campsite. Boating especially is popular, including the adventurous rafting sport.

Luxury and peace

There are a large number of nice pitches and everything is well maintained. You can choose your own spot on the lawns. There are also spacious paved pitches (for caravans), with grass in front. It is a real family camping, mostly frequented by Norwegian families, who often stay here for the duration of the holidays. Approximately one third of the camping guests come from elsewhere in Europe. Don't feel like sleeping in a tent? There are luxury rental huts, which are brand new.

Great supermarket

The supermarket at the entrance of the campsite is opened throughout the year and is very well stocked. The campsite has its own (self-service) restaurant with limited menu. The limited menu should not pose a problem, because during dinner you overlook the adjacent Japanese garden. As if this is not enough to relax ...

Sanitary facilities

The sanitary facilities also look exemplary and are kept in pristine condition There are three modern, fitted sanitary buildings spread over the campsite. Each building contains special children's sanitary facilities. Everything is easily accessible for the disabled.

properties.name: Camping Le Hameau des Champs
properties.description:
If you want to go on a countryside holiday in the Burgundy region, then Camping Le Hameau des Champs is the right address. This campsite is perfect for those seeking peace and quiet and for cyclists. After all, here you are right in the middle of the 70-kilometre-long Voie Vert cycle route. The campsite is on the outskirts of the village of Cormatin and close to the medieval town of Cluny. Furthermore, this spot is also highly suitable as a stopover campsite for going southwards to France and Spain.

Dogs are welcome

The large site is in a quiet setting and the pitches are spacious and demarcated with low bushes. You can install your motorhome, caravan, tent or trailer tent on one of the touring pitches. Or pick one of the holiday homes for four, five or six people.

Swimming and savouring

The campsite has a heated swimming pool with special toddler section. Café La Belle Epoque is right at the edge of the swimming pool. It's a lovely spot where you can enjoy things like cold drinks, wines, snack platters, breakfast and lunches. After taking a swim in the campsite's swimming pool and having eaten an ice cream on the patio, you can check out the activities around the swimming pool. There is a jeu de boules court, a table tennis table and a small playground, for example. There is also a multi-sports field, where you can take part in a game of football, basketball or hand ball.

Vineyards, castles and markets

Surrounded by vineyards, castles and bustling markets, the area around Camping Le Hameau des Champs offers plenty of opportunities for walking and cycling trips. The impressive Château de Cormatin is well worth a visit during your camping holiday.

properties.name: Blair Castle Caravan Park
properties.description:
Blair Castle Caravan Park is situated between the rolling hills of Cairngorms National Park. Here you camp in the southernmost tip of the national park, which forms part of the Scottish Highlands. This makes the campsite an ideal base for exploring this unique region.

Camping amidst green

This campsite is popular with families, older couples and keen walkers. Dogs are also welcome at this idyllic spot! Two dogs are allowed per camping pitch, provided they are kept on a leash.

Camping is very comfortable on the green country estate of Blair Castle. This is because the campsite is very spacious, as are the camping pitches. All pitches for motorhomes and caravans are partly paved and partly covered with grass. Extra large camping pitches are also available (eighteen metres long).

Accommodation

Hikers without camping gear can spend the night in a Camping Pod or one of the new Glamping pods on the campsite. Would you like to rent accommodation for a bit longer in this location? If so, enjoy your stay in a luxury Woodland Lodge with all the trimmings.

Exercise and relaxation

Children can play outside and thoroughly enjoy themselves on this campsite. There is also a playground. In high season it is also possible to feed the deer at the castle. Children can head for the 'game room' to play pool, ping pong, or table football. In high season, there is on-site segway tours and bikes to rent. The campsite has its own beauty room. You can go there for a massage, haircut or beauty treatment.

properties.name: Trollveggen Camping
properties.description:
The child-friendly camping Trollveggen, one of the absolute top campsites in Norway, is directly located on the Rauma river, amidst the imposing mountainscape near the Romsdalshorn and the Troll-Wall. The campsite is bordered by high cliffs, both at the front and back. You come here for peace and quiet, where the tranquillity and the pristine, breathtaking surroundings give you a feeling of being one with nature.

Quietness, space and nature

The campsite lies in a magnificent natural setting and is well maintained and very clean. It is undoubtedly a haven of tranquillity, also due to the quietness. There are 70 level terraced pitches of no less than 100-150 m2. Arriving without a booking is a risky business: there are only four cottages. The campsite is located on the Rauma River and you can walk from your pitch straight to the river. A beautiful footpath in good condition runs along the river. Tip: wear sensible walking shoes.

Eating and drinking

The campsite shop has a limited range, although fresh bread is available each day. You can do your shopping in Åndalsnes, 10 km away.

Sanitary facilities

Very remarkable is the sanitary building with a beautiful, vegetated green roof. All sanitary facilities are well maintained and immaculate. There are also family showers. As is customary in Norway, you have to use coins for the showers.

Inflatable bouncer

Enjoy the magnificent nature and explore the area by bicycle, on foot or by climbing a mountain. You can spot rare plant and bird species, or catch a fish in the river (fishing permit required).

properties.name: First Camp Stensö-Kalmar
properties.description:
First Camp Stensö-Kalmar is the perfect destination for nature and outdoor enthusiasts. The campsite is located on the south-east coast of Sweden, near the town of Kalmar and the bridge that takes you to the beautiful island of Öland. The campsite's seaside location makes it an ideal place to enjoy peace and nature. At the same time, you'll benefit from all the comforts and conveniences of a modern campsite.

From traditional camping pitches to luxury accommodations

At First Camp Stensö-Kalmar you'll be personally welcomed by the owner upon arrival. Although there are 300 pitches and more than 50 modern accommodations for rent, the atmosphere on the campsite is quiet and friendly. The sanitary buildings were renovated in 2018 and provide all the comfort you need, even in the colder early and late seasons.

Dream location for sports enthusiasts

Camping Stensö-Kalmar is not just about lazing on the beach and swimming in the sea. There are also plenty of fun sporting activities to take part in. For example, take a walk through the beautiful surroundings or rent a bicycle or canoe and go on an adventure. The campsite also features a newly constructed adventure golf course and a playground with a bouncy castle. Various fun activities are organised in the summer, such as a children's club, outdoor training, yoga and music nights.

Discover Kalmar

The picturesque old town of Kalmar, with its beautiful historic buildings and cosy streets, is only 2 kilometres away from the campsite. Kalmar has been voted Sweden's most popular summer city numerous times.

properties.name: Camping De Helfterkamp
properties.description:
Campsite de Helfterkamp is located on the edge of the Veluwe natural area in wonderful surroundings, on the outskirts of Vaassen in Gelderland. Here you can visit Cannenburgh Castle from the 16th century or the lovely windmill. The campsite is encircled by forests, so you camp in the wonderful green countryside.

Excelling in hospitality

It is not only the staff who contribute to this, the grounds are also very inviting. The campsite consists of various grass fields, most have a small playground in the middle. This means that children can play to their hearts’ content while parents can keep an eye on things. There are also fields without a playground, for those seeking more peace and quiet. Furthermore, there are various car free fields. The spacious pitches have been provided with a layer of crushed stone (natural stones) for the awning so that you do not have to camp in the mud. Furthermore, there are eleven mobile homes and a holiday home surrounded by a garden (and so plenty of privacy!).

Easy going and friendly

Such an easy going and hospitable atmosphere attracts a public looking precisely for that. At the campsite, you will mainly find families with young children who like playing outdoors and enjoy small-scale entertainment. The campsite is also perfectly suited for seniors, in particular due to the wonderful countryside location. Beside the campsite, in the woods, children can enjoy the countryside. It’s great for playing around and hiking and there is a spot for a large campfire at the edge of the forest. So, an evening of scary stories and roasting marshmallows is guaranteed.

properties.name: Steinvik Camping
properties.description:
In the east of Norway, you'll find the Steinvik family campsite. This campsite has a fairy-tale location on Lake Mjøsa, the largest in the country. You camp about 1.5 km from the village of Moelv. Steinvik campsite has rental accommodations as well as touring sites. There are also special spots for campers. There's plenty of fun in the water and on the water's edge.

Camping by the water

With a hundred touring sites and forty rental accommodations, huts perfect for a maximum of five people, Steinvik campsite is of average size. The huts have great furnishings, including a kitchen (with oven), coffee maker, shower and Wi-Fi. All accommodations have a covered terrace. The touring sites are between 80 and 120 m2. They are on grassland and have little demarcation and shade. Near the sanitation building, there are ten spaces especially for campers. These have a view of the lake.

Beach and lake

With direct access to some beaches and the lake there is always fun in the water here. The beaches are child friendly (with slide) and the water slopes away gradually. There is also a special wheelchair ramp for the disabled. Take a dive or hire a waterbike to explore the lake at your leisure. There are loungers and benches on the wooden terrace.

Playing and hiking

There is a playground on the campsite, primarily great for kids up to 12 years of age. Adults may be interested in the many hiking options. In the high season, there are some groceries available, including fresh bread. There is also a bar.

properties.name: First Camp Torekov-Båstad
properties.description:
First Camp Torekov- Båstad is located directly by the sea on the west coast of Sweden. At this quiet campsite, you'll be camping in a coniferous and deciduous forest, and you can walk to the sandy beach in no time. There are pitches in the woods, but also right by the sea. Extremely suitable for families with children. From the beach you can fish for crabs and take a dip in the water from the jetty. There are also beautiful hiking trails along the coast. These lead, for example, to the town of Torecov, where all kinds of restaurants and shops can be found.

Camping pitches and glamping

The campsite's spacious pitches have plenty of shade and are well maintained. Dogs are also allowed here.

There are also different types of accommodation for rent at the campsite. There's a glamping tent with comfortable beds and your own terrace. There are also several cottages for rent.

Barbecuing or cooking in the kitchen

At the reception is a restaurant with a terrace and a shop with a fairly extensive range. You can barbecue yourself, but you can also use the communal barbecue area. There's also a complete shared kitchen with dining tables.

Activities for all ages

First Camp Torekov- Båstad offers entertainment for the whole family, such as a children's mini club with many fun activities. You can rent Segways and there are go-karts that you can drive around in. You can also play a game of mini golf between water obstacles, bunkers and bridges. There are various playgrounds around the campsite and a large bouncy castle to let off steam.

properties.name: Camping La Cascade/Cevennes
properties.description:
Camping La Cascade/Cevennes is located in a vast unspoilt nature reserve in the Cevennes. Far from highways and urban bustle this is a true Paradise for nature lovers. The small scale and environmentally friendly approach of this campsite are a perfect fit. The only sounds you'll hear are from the small river near the campsite and the whistling of various birds. In the meantime you can enjoy a great view of the surrounding mountains.

A friendly welcome

The hospitable owners of this campsite, Mr. and Mrs. Gache, welcome new guests in the small main building. This also serves as reception and restaurant(s). You will soon notice that respect and love for nature are of paramount importance here. The small-scale campsite is well maintained and is always spotless.

Spacious pitches and wooden chalets

The pitches are very spacious and laid out in a natural way. There is not much demarcation, but that enhances the free feeling of camping in nature. Some beautiful wooden chalets have been placed that fit in well with the camping image. And wherever you are on the campsite, you will certainly have a fantastic view of the surrounding mountains!

Facilities

At campsite La Cascade/Cevennes you'll find a bar, a snack bar with an attractive terrace and a modest restaurant. In the shop you'll find some basic groceries. Meyrueis, a four kilometre drive away, is ideal for more extensive shopping. On Wednesdays there is a weekly market here, very nice for lovers of fresh produce.

properties.name: Camping Le Chenantier
properties.description:
The vast campsite Le Chenantier is located between the Alps of the mountainous Savoy, all the way to the east of France. This small-scale campsite is situated in the midst of the rugged nature of Valoise National Park and is an ideal holiday destination for mountain hikers and cyclists. Without too many facilities and with spacious pitches, this is a simple but comfortable campsite.

Mountain views

Almost fifty pitches are scattered across the green campsite, which, with its open character and extensive lawns, breathes spaciousness. The terrain is rugged and the pitches are situated on different terraces. Many of the pitches are sunny and are located in the open field.On the edge of the forest, pines will give you shade. Shady or not, all pitches are spacious and from every spot on the campsite you have the same beautiful view of the surrounding mountains. The rental accommodation on the campsite is special: a teepee, yurt (a traditional round tent) or log cabin, built with tree trunks.

Campsite for mountaineers

Whether you bring your mountain bike, racing bike or hiking boots, you are in the right place as a mountaineer at this campsite. The whole camping season you will find lovers of the high mountains here. Campers of various nationalities find their way to the campsite and its surrounding Alps.

Valoise National Park

Alpine meadows, over a thousand different flowers and plants, many special animal species: Valoise National Park is a paradise for nature lovers. Hikers and mountaineers in particular will appreciate it here. You can spot all kinds of animals: ibexes, chamois and golden eagles show up regularly, provided you don't make too much noise.

properties.name: Camping De la Ferme de Croas-Men
properties.description:
In the middle of a wooded area, Camping De la Ferme de Croas-Men has an idyllic spot in the French countryside. Here you can experience the freedom of camping in peace and quiet. And here in Brittany, there are always nice seaside resorts nearby. For young children, this farm campsite is one big playground, where they can cuddle with the rabbits and donkeys.

Space and privacy

Although all kinds of vegetation has been planted, the beautifully tended lawns have a roomy look and feel. The spacious pitches are not delimited, which increases the feeling of freedom. At the edge of the quiet terrain, there are two cosy gypsy caravans next to the meadow. The family has also carefully decorated the chalets. The colourful sanitary facilities are simple, but neat.

Monday pizza evening

Every Monday evening in summer, someone comes to the campsite with his mobile oven to bake pizzas. Very tasty! Let yourself be pampered with the breakfast service, to be eaten in an authentic part of the charming house. Among other things, fresh bread, homemade yoghurt and pancakes will be served. In the nearby village of Plouigneau you'll find a supermarket for your daily groceries.

On the tractor or donkey

Children's activities are in keeping with the family atmosphere and simple outdoor life. For example, small campers can get to know farm life and ride a tractor. They can also take a ride on the donkey or help look after the animals. If you want to swim, you can go to the sea or to a public swimming pool in Plouigneau.

properties.name: Camping Termika
properties.description:
Camping Park Lijak Active Holidays is located in Western Slovenia, close to the Italian border, amidst vineyards and the green mountains of the Vipava valley. This modern campsite is a veritable paragliding paradise. The level campsite overlooks the Trnovo plateau. Lots of paragliders take off from there and, after a wonderful flight, land on campsite Park Lijak. With its sixty touring pitches, the campsite is rather small-scale and peaceful. There is a lovely grill restaurant (with roof terrace), where you can enjoy the taste of regional dishes and Slovenian wines.

Camping with beautiful view

On campsite Park Lijak you camp on an open terrain resembling a meadow. Some sixty non-demarcated pitches for tent, caravan or motorhomes are distributed among well maintained grassy fields, which are partly shaded by tall weeping willows and other trees. However, most pitches are in the sun and the stunning view of the mountain ridge at the back of the campsite is not obstructed by the trees. 

You can also stay in one of the mobile homes, even though the choice is limited. Unique are the so-called 'habitats sleeping quarters', offering a type of casemate accommodation.

Walking and cycling

The Vipava Valley, the part of Slovenia where the campsite is located, is a terrific walking and cycling area. Directly accessible from the campsite are walking trails and cycle routes of different levels of difficulty that lead you through forests, past vineyards and over hills. If you are a real biking fanatic, you will head for the rugged terrain on top of the Trnovo plateau on your mountain bike. The campsite offers cycling and walking arrangements, including two guided excursions and bed & breakfast.

properties.name: Aire Naturelle de Camping Du Toy
Saksida Wine and Camping Resort
properties.description:
Saksida Wine and Camping Resort is located between the vine filled hills in the west of Slovenia, close to the Italian border. On this terraced campsite you'll camp on a hillside between the vineyards. In the restaurant, campers who mainly use the campsite for a stop over, can enjoy a six-course dinner with a selection of winew.

Terraced campsite between the vineyards

The campsite was already known as a camper stop, but has now grown into a complete campsite. The campsite is situated against a hillside, which is full of vineyards. You camp on terraces in the middle of the vineyards. The terraces are very well cared for and have room for thirty touring pitches. Some of these pitches are quite small; ideal for an overnight stay with a tent. The larger touring pitches are suitable for caravans.

Transit campsite

Saksida Wine and Camping Resort is usually used as a transit campsite. Northern European campers in particular find an excellent stopover at the campsite during their onward journey. These campers like to stay for a few nights, to enjoy the quiet surroundings and the delicious food. Keep in mind that thhere are not many facilities for children.

Swimming pool in the sun

Campers have the luxury of a small swimming pool. This is located at the front of the campsite, on the lowest part of the terraces. Here you can enjoy a nice swim in a sunny spot. The swimming pool is not particularly large, but because the campsite is small and mostly used as a transit campsite, there will always be enough space. Around the pool are sun loungers with parasols.

properties.name: Camping Floria Glamping Garden
properties.description:
Camping Floria Glamping Garden is just outside of the Croatian city of Labin. This is a campsite in Istria where campsite visitors relax completely and expect plenty of luxury. There is a beautifully laid out swimming pool, a massage salon and there are glamping tents with a private swimming pool or Jacuzzi. The closest beach is 3.5 kilometres from the campsite.

Glamping with Jacuzzi or private swimming pool

Camping Floria Glamping Garden has mainly glamping accommodations. There are also several spacious and partially paved pitches. Glamping enthusiasts stay in a luxury tent with its own toilet and washing facilities and comfortable beds. Some of the glamping tents have their own swimming pool or Jacuzzi. The tents are separated by green growth, giving everyone privacy. The camping site feels luxurious because of the vegetation and trees. It has a Mediterranean feel to it with the nearest beach, Plaža Mali Portluk, a five-minute drive away.

Swimming and wellness facilities

The outdoor swimming pool is beautifully landscaped and is refreshing on hot days. Luxurious chaise longues, chairs and lounge sofas are available around the swimming pool. The terrace of the catering facility borders the swimming pool. Enjoy a refreshing drink. There are also wellness facilities with a sauna and a massage salon. This luxury campsite primarily attracts guests without children.

Visit historic Labin

The historic town of Labin (2 km) lies in the hills of Istria. The small town has a rich culture and history, originating in Roman times. Stroll through the narrow streets in the centre and admire the beautiful old buildings.

properties.name: Natuurlijk de Veenhoop
properties.description:
Camping Natuurlijk De Veenhoop is centrally located in the area of the Frisian Lakes. De Veenhoop is also the name of the rural village in the municipality of Smallingerland, where the atmosphere is relaxed and convivial. The Zandstra family welcomes everyone on their green campsite of a modest size.

Camping between water and nature

The marina belonging to the campsite is situated on a through waterway. This location gives it a picturesque appearance. From the campsite you can cycle into the vast nature with a different surprising route every day. You can also enjoy the surrounding nature on foot and from the water. What could be nicer than boarding a sloop after breakfast for a nice trip?

Green and spacious pitches

Camping Natuurlijk De Veenhoop has spacious pitches with various types of pitches, including the option of private sanitary facilities. Trees and shrubs on the edge of the campsite provide a neat setting. The tasteful chalets offer wonderful accommodation for those who do not bring their own camping equipment.

Restaurant around the corner

The restaurant It Polderhûs is just a hundred metres from the campsite. In the former farmhouse you can enjoy lunch or a delicious dinner. Through the campsite's website, you can order rolls from the local bakery for a delicious breakfast.

properties.name: Camping Domaine de l'Épinette
properties.description:
Camping Domaine de l'Épinette is a quiet campsite in the Jura. Six kilometres away, you will find the town of Doucier. The capital of the Jura, Lons-le-Saunier, is about twenty kilometres away. The border with Switzerland is also relatively close (about a hundred kilometres away). Furthermore, the campsite is located on the River Ain. Domaine de l'Épinette is surrounded by lakes, hills, mountains and many forests.

Something for everyone

Because Camping Domaine de l'Épinette is a terraced campsite, no two pitches are the same. The pitches by the stream are slightly smaller but very popular. This is a sought-after location among bookers. In addition, you will find several cottages and chalets in this small piece of France. So you'll have plenty to choose from! The campsite is often pleasantly busy.

Heated swimming pools

Domaine de l'Épnette is beloved by families with children. There's a children's pool, a large pool and two water slides. Both pools are heated in July and August. They are fairly new and are located a little further from the pitches. In addition, in the high season, there is a children's club for children aged 5 to 12.

By the river Ain

When you walk downhill at this terraced campsite, you end up at the River Ain. This is a nice place to rest or cool off. Furthermore, the Camping Domaine de l'Épinette campsite has a small shop where you can order bread one day in advance. For more extensive shopping, you can go to Doucier; there are several supermarkets there.

properties.name: Camping Les Pêcheurs
properties.description:
In the Jura, along the river Ain, you will find the 3-star campsite Les Pêcheurs. This quiet, typically French campsite has simple facilities and little luxury. You'll camp here on a spacious pitch in the middle of the greenery. The touring pitches are on lawns, surrounded by tall deciduous trees and green hedges that provide shelter. There is a new swimming pool on the campsite, but you can also enjoy a nice swim in the river Ain.

Green oasis

Camping Les Pêcheurs mainly consists of touring pitches, but there are also beautiful lodge tents and mobile homes for rent. The green pitches are spacious and well maintained. They lie on lawns and are bordered by deciduous trees, shrubs and hedges. A narrow green strip with tall trees separates the campsite from the sunbathing lawn on the banks of the river Ain.

Fresh dive

In the river Ain, which flows directly along the campsite, you can have a nice swim. There is a beautiful sunbathing lawn along the water. From the campsite you can go through a fence to the bank, where you can walk into the water for a refreshing dive. For those who prefer to swim in warmer water, Les Pêcheurs has a nice new swimming pool since 2018. It is a heated outdoor pool, stylishly landscaped on a large sun deck. The paddling pool has a nice water sprinkler.

Fun to play

As mentioned before, there is no animation program. However, for children who can enjoy themselves there is plenty to do on the campsite. For example in the fun playground, in the recreation room or on the two large bouncy castles. And of course you will also find some table tennis tables and a jeu-de-boule alley.

properties.name: Ferienpark Moränasee
properties.description:
The Moränsee holiday park is located at the point joining Hanover, Bremen and Hamburg. This southern region of Lower Saxony is known as a green valley in a large heath and forested landscape. The spacious camping pitches, the lake and its own beach offer nature lovers everything for a relaxing holiday.

All space

The campsites are open and comprehensive, without any type of demarcation. The ground is grassy and there is your own tap on each pitch. There is also a separate field for groups and in the middle a space for a campfire. There is also a 'tiny house' park on the property. How about a night in a tipi tent?

Natural lake

A private lake with a beach lies in the natural shade of the trees. Swimming fans can bathe in the lake and there is a sunbathing lawn for those who love the sun. The lovely beach bar with a terrace overlooking the water really finish off this favourite part of the park.

Home-made cake

The 'See Bistro' is a cosy combination of a shop and a café. In the morning, you'll smell the aroma of fresh rolls. The eggs are laid by the chickens that range around the property. There is home-made cake available every day. And there are tasty dishes for lunch or dinner on the menu.

Outdoor playground

The great advantage of this campsite is that kids can play outside safely. They can run round in nature, jump on the trampoline or look at the animals that live on the little petting zoo on the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Domaine de l'Oiselière
properties.description:
In the countryside of the Vendée, three quarters of an hour below Nantes, is the Domaine de L'Oiselière campsite. This eco campsite around a renovated farmhouse is a small, lovely family campsite with spacious pitches and a heated outdoor swimming pool. The modern facilities are fresh and tastefully decorated, as are the beautiful lodge tents and atmospheric cottages. In the campsite restaurant they cook with organic local products, also for sale in the shop.

Whistling birds

Domaine de l'Oiselière is a small but spacious campsite. Scattered on the large campsite are thirty very spacious touring pitches delimited on grass fields. Here and there are tall, old trees. You can see from the young planting that this is a new campsite. The campsite is largely car-free. The pitches are laid out with respect for the natural environment, where peace and quiet reign supreme.

Atmospheric swimming pool

There is a heated outdoor swimming pool in the centre of the campsite. There is also a paddling pool and a sun terrace with sun loungers. The whole area is fenced, so that small children cannot just walk to the water.

Free bicycles

On the vast terrain you will find all kinds of fun playing opportunities. The natural hills have been cleverly used in the construction of slides and tunnels. There is a nice play forest with cable car and climbing net. The animal pasture on the campsite is fun for everyone: camping guests can pick up the fresh eggs in the morning. In the vegetable garden you can help gardening, pick herbs or harvest fruit and vegetables. In high season there is a varied entertainment programme and children can look after ponies and learn to ride them. The campsite also has excellent bicycles, which you can use free of charge.

properties.name: Camping Au Soleil d'Oc
properties.description:
Campsite Au Soleil d’ Oc is located on the banks of the Dordogne, just a few kilometres from the village of Argentat. At this campsite you'll camp on spacious pitches under trees or directly on te waterfront. Children can swim in the two swimming pools, an indoor pool and an outdoor pool. They can also take a dip in the river, also a great place for canoeing and fishing. In the vicinity you can discover many pretty villages (Monceaux-sur-Dordogne and Beaulieu-sur-Dordogne).

Camping at the waterside

The campsite is very green. The many trees and shrubs give the campsite its natural character, although because of them and the different narrow roads it can look a bit wild. On the other hand, this lay-out makes the campsite playful and creates beautiful private spots.

The roads to the pitches may be quite narrow, but the almost a hundred touring pitches are all the more spacious. You camp under the trees, in the shade. Especially the pitches directly on the banks of the Dordogne are beautiful. At the front of the campsite there are many rental accommodations, while the touring pitches are situated on the edges of the terrain.

Swimming

he campsite is very suitable for those looking for peace and quiet, but also children can enjoy themselves. The swimming pools, located near the entrance to the campsite, are especially attractive for children. At the campsite you will not only find a large outdoor pool, but you can also take a dip in an indoor pool. Parents can keep an eye on their children from the pavement café, sipping a drink.

properties.name: Camping Floreal La Roche-en-Ardenne 1
properties.description:
Camping Floreal La Roche-en-Ardenne 1 is two km away from La Roche-en-Ardenne, a charming little town in the Belgian Ardennes. The campsite is in a quiet spot near the river Ourthe, surrounded by wooded hills. There are plenty of opportunities for walking, cycling and mountain biking. The campsite itself has sports and play facilities and there is an extensive entertainment programme in the summer holidays.

Open site with well-maintained pitches

This campsite is located on the N860, the main road between La Roche-en-Ardenne and Houffalize. Planning to stay at this campsite with a (large) caravan or motor home? Then travel to it via La Roche to avoid the sharp turn onto the side road to the campsite. The well-maintained campsite has an open character. Paved paths lead to the neat grassy pitches with touring pitches, which are at least eighty square metres in size. Prefer accommodation? Then rent a modern safari tent, mobile home or eco-lodge.

Entertainment and campsite restaurant

The campsite organises entertainment for the whole family. In high season, play darts, Kubb, boules or bingo, while the children have fun with games, crafts and fancy-dress parties. Would you like to spend an afternoon swimming in good weather? There is a beautiful, outdoor swimming pool at the Floreal hotel, about 1.5 kilometres away. As a campsite guest, you can swim there for a discounted price in high season. Back at the campsite, end your day in the campsite restaurant, which has a bar and terrace.

properties.name: Camping Floreal Kempen
properties.description:
Camping Floreal Kempen is located in a nature reserve on the Kempen Ridge. Here you camp in the middle of the woods! Besides tranquillity, you will also find numerous fun activities here. And famous Belgian cities like Antwerp and Brussels are easily accessible. Put your bike on the back of the car (or rent one on the campsite) and bring sturdy walking shoes, because this promises to be an adventure.

Adventure in the Kempen

Here you can enjoy camping holidays in the Belgian Kempen all year round. Just choose between a spacious camping pitch or a cosy rental accommodation. Open your door or tent canvas, and you will notice it immediately. Here you are camping in an adventurous place, in the middle of the forest.

Enjoy activities and the camping bistro

But you don't have to leave Camping Floreal Kempen to enjoy yourself for a day. Play a game of football, basketball, table tennis or jeu de boules, or have fun together in the playgrounds. In summer, you can also take a nice dip in the (inflatable) pool set up on the campsite. And how about a yoga class, various markets or other fun activities? You can find those here too.

After an active day, visit the campsite bistro with its welcoming terrace. Here you will enjoy a changing menu or new dishes every week. Prefer to eat at your own pitch or accommodation? No problem, just pick up a nice meal. And you don't have to leave your four-legged friend at home either. They can just come with you on holiday (with the exception of the mobile home).

properties.name: Tipperne Camping
properties.description:
On the Danish west coast lies Tipperne Camping, a quiet campsite in a wooded area. This campsite is a perfect starting point for cycling and hiking. For example, you can bike to the beach. A short fifteen minutes and you are already on the North Sea. Or visit the Viking village of Bork Vikingehavn. Here you can see how things used to look a thousand years ago. At the campsite, you will enjoy the peace and quiet. The small-scale, cosy campsite offers spacious pitches and comfortable glamping tents.

Enjoying the cosy atmosphere

What strikes you most when you drive up to the campsite is the sense of space. The large grassy fields can accommodate some seventy large camping pitches. On the open grassy fields, the pitches are bordered by high hedges. So you will have more than enough privacy while enjoying your breakfast. This will give you a cosy feeling. The tall trees provide shelter from the wind and sun.

Sleeping under the stars

Do you want to enjoy nature, but also all the comforts of modern life? Then camp in one of the glamping tents. The translucent roof allows you to truly sleep under the stars here, without getting cold. Or stay in a cosy cabin in the same Danish style as the reception building. For a hot shower, you can head over to the modern sanitary building.

By the North Sea

At Tipperne Camping, you will be camping just four kilometres from the North Sea. The beaches in Denmark are not very different from those in the Netherlands: wide and often spotlessly clean. In the high season, at least, the sea water is warm enough for a swim. And all year round, you can take endless walks through the dunes.

properties.name: Camping de l'Ile
properties.description:
You will find Camping de l'Ile in the village of Ranchot, not far from Besançon . As the name already suggests, this campsite is located on an island. In this case, the island in question is situated on the Doubs river. On this peaceful campsite, you can enjoy the greenery between the river and a shaded park.

Camping with a view

You arrive at a campsite which lies in the middle of nature, surrounded by trees and the two arms of the Doubs river. The pitches are spacious and vary in size. Most guests come here to enjoy the natural surroundings. For example, to go fishing or take long cycling or hiking trips in the beautiful environs. Many of the pitches are situated right at the water's edge. 

Regional specialities

The restaurant serves delicious regional specialities, such as 'goujonette de truite' and 'fondue à la cancoillotte’. The restaurant is open daily in July and August and regularly hosts evenings featuring themed meals (such as paella, couscous or fried mussels).

All kinds of activities

Camping de l’Ile offers various activities such as canoeing, paddleboarding, table tennis, petanque, fishing and cycling and hiking trips. You will also find a climbing wall and a multi-sport field nearby. Do you want to explore the surrounding area by yourself? You can rent bikes (including tandems) at the campsite. There are also canoes and paddleboards available for rent.

Shopping in the area

There is a bakery less than a hundred metres from the campsite. Not only can you find daily fresh bread here but also other basic groceries. An even larger supermarket is located three kilometres further away.

properties.name: Buytenplaets Suydersee
properties.description:
Camping in a relaxed atmosphere, on a small-scale campsite that is beautifully integrated into the wooded area on the eastern edge of Lelystad. That's what it's all about at Buytenplaets Suydersee, where you can choose from several truly unique types of accommodation. This is an ideal campsite for peace seekers and nature lovers.

Spend the night in eccentric accommodations

Campers who come with a caravan or motorhome can choose a spot on one of the three camping fields after registering at the reception. As a motorhome owner you can of course also book a motorhome pitch. Do you have a tent as camping equipment? Then you can go to the cosy tent field.

Buytenplaets Suydersee is a campsite that also features unique rental accommodations. Have you ever slept in a tree house, a tipi tent, a gypsy wagon, a shipping container or even a fake sewer pipe? You can do all of these at this campsite!

Escape from the escape room or go swimming in De Koploper

A caravan is placed on the tree house field every Friday. But this is not your average caravan. If you enter this caravan, it certainly won't be easy to get out again. Because it's actually a challenging escape room! Escape room enthusiasts will certainly want to take part in this challenge.

Meanwhile, children can have fun in the animal meadow, on the cosy playground or with the bicycles, go-karts and other toys that are free to use. As a guest of the campsite, you can also go swimming for free in the swimming pool at Sportcentrum De Koploper. This is about a five minute walk from the campsite entrance.

properties.name: Camping Holiday
properties.description:
The medium-size Camping Holiday in Giulianova is located close to a beach. Only a traffic-free esplanade separates the camping pitches from the beach. You are here in Abruzzo, a region not yet affected by mass tourism. Camping guests here are eager to enjoy the Italian sun, sea and the sandy beach. The campsite has a restaurant which serves tasty meals.

Touring pitch or rental accommodation

The camping pitches (grass) on the well maintained terrain are laid out next to each other along a small lane. You can choose between a demarcated pitch with much shade or less shade. A touring pitch measures a maximum of 50m2. There are also rental apartments and bungalows with lovely view of the sea and the hills. 

Swimming like a fish

The campsite has a lovely outdoor swimming pool (300 m2) in the shape of a fish, complete with water slide and sunbathing terrace. There is a safe, shallow pool (50 m2) for toddlers. As a result of the large number of sun hours the palm trees are doing very well. These trees, together with the flowers and ornamental plants, lend a green and attractive character to the campsite.

Water sports

The sea is not only suitable for swimming, but windsurfing and waterskiing are also possible. With a hired canoe, surf board or pedalo you can get into the sea on one of the two private beaches of the campsite. 

Sports and games for the entire family

Children can play to their heart's content in the playground. The table tennis table, jeu-de-boule pitch and beach volleyball field are also very popular. There is a mini club in high season (languages: French and Italian). Disco evenings are organised on a regular basis. There is a separate field for youngsters.

properties.name: Camping du Sierroz
properties.description:
Located on the banks of Lac du Bourget, between Petit Port and Grand Port in Aix-les-Bains, you'll find Camping du Sierroz. Thanks to its natural hot springs, Aix-les-Bains is known as thermal spa resort. It also attracts many visitors for the beauty of its landscapes. For hikers, cyclists and water sports enthusiasts, the campsite is the ideal accommodation.

Shady pitches

The campsite has demarcated pitches for motorhomes, caravans, vans and tents. The pitches have grassy ground and a stabilised area with gravel for the vehicle. Some of the pitches are shaded by trees.

The campsite also rents accommodation. You can opt for mobile homes or special accommodations such as the Coco Sweet or the bivouac tent.

Close to all amenities

The campsite does not offer any entertainment. Children can have fun in the play area, while older children can enjoy the table tennis, volleyball and petanque courts. There is also a snack bar for breakfast, lunch and dinner. The town centre, 3.5 km away, can be reached in 15 minutes by bike or bus and offers a wide choice of restaurants and shops.

Beautiful trips

The surrounding area lends itself to beautiful trips along the lake shore, through mountains, green meadows and vineyards. There are several signposted cycling and walking routes to explore.

A stone's throw from Lac du Bourget

Lac du Bourget is just 100 m from the campsite entrance. Here you can swim, sail, paddle, water-ski and dive. Don't have your own equipment? No problem! Canoe and paddle can be rented close to the campsite. If you want to relax, the supervised sandy, pebble or grassy beaches are a 10-minute walk from the campsite.

properties.name: Macugnaga Natural Camping
properties.description:
Macugnaga Natural Camping is in the stunning area of the Italian Alps. You stay at the foot of the Monte Rosa in the Valle Anzasca. Due to the breathtaking views of the mountains, this region has been named as one of the seven wonders of the Ossola Valley. You can also camp at this campsite in the winter and trek into the mountains to ski down to the bottom. And in the summer, Monte Rosa is perfect for active campers who like walking and cycling.

First impression

The reception is located in a classic Italian building where you will be warmly welcomed. You drive to the camping pitches on the grass via paved roads. Fifty camping pitches are available. These are spacious pitches for tents, but the pitches for motorhomes or caravans are not particularly generous.

The toilet blocks look dated but the toilet and washing facilities are neat, well maintained and clean.

Discount from the campsite

If you fancy a drink after a long walk, you can get one at the campsite's bar. The closest supermarket is in the village, within a 15-minute walk. The campsite owners have a good relationship with the local restaurants and cafés in the village. You can enjoy a meal at a discount there.

Italian flavour

There is plenty to do at the campsite. There is a playground for the children, a ping pong table and a jeu de boules court. You can go horse riding and hire bikes. And there is an added extra, a kitchen garden. You can pick the herbs and vegetables to give your meal that extra bit of Italian flavour.

properties.name: Harz-Camp Bremer Teich
properties.description:
Bremer Teich, a large lake measuring 3.7 ha, is situated in the middle of the Harz mountains. On the banks, you will find the campsite Harz-Camp Bremer Teich. The campsite has two separate sections: one for groups and one for individual campers (170 pitches). Furthermore, there are 15 holiday bungalows in 4 price classes, from basic to luxurious. The campsite a great base for nature lovers who want to explore the natural beauty of the Harz mountains.

Pitches and facilities

The pitches vary in size and are usually not separated by hedges or fences. You will find many guests from the region who spend the entire season on the campsite.

Because of the remote location of campsite Harz-Camp Bremer Teich, it comes in handy that the camping shop is well-stocked. The restaurant has a lovely terrace and attractive garden.

Surroundings

The Harz is an area for outdoor sports enthusiasts who can indulge in short or longer cycling and walking trips. However, you will have to master a few steep hills. Therefore, you should be in fairly good physical condition to enjoy the area on foot or by bicycle. Alternatively, you could take a trip with a electric bicycle.

Quedlinburg

The area surrounding the Harz mountains is rich in historical towns, of which Quedlinburg is the nearest. Since 1994, the abbey church of St Servatius, the castle and the historical town centre are listed UNESCO World Heritage Sites. This is mainly due to the history of Quedlinburg as a royal city, the medieval street patterns and striking half-timbered houses. Each of them is a highlight of Romanesque architectural style.

properties.name: Vestbirk Camping
properties.description:
Surrounded by lakes and rivers, a few kilometres outside the town of Østbirk (Central Jutland), is Vestbirk Camping. You can enjoy canoeing, boating and swimming in the surrounding waters, while taking beautiful walks through the forests surrounding the lakes. The well-maintained campsite is family friendly and facilities include a heated outdoor swimming pool, a snack bar, four playgrounds and a petting zoo.

Different types of pitches, which do you choose?

At this campsite, you get to choose from all the pitches available on your arrival. Prefer a quiet spot? Then choose one of the 'orange' touring pitches along the edge of the campsite. Those who like to be closer to the central, lively part of the site will go for a 'blue' pitch. There are also special (red) comfort pitches with their own water supply and drainage. And do you like to go back to basics? Then book a spot on the car-free tent camping field. Located right by the lake, this field offers an authentic camping experience with campfire areas, central water taps and picnic tables. You can also spend the night in a well-kept caravan, hiker's hut or safari tent.

Activities, a petting zoo and a lovely outdoor swimming pool

There are many activities for children. These include a varied entertainment programme and four playgrounds all around the site. Moreover, there is a petting zoo with goats and rabbits which are happy to be petted. To top it all off, there is a heated outdoor pool with a large paddling pool and a spectacular water slide. After an afternoon swim, pick up a tasty meal from the snack bar.

properties.name: Kabelvåg Feriehus & Camping
properties.description:
Kabelvåg Feriehus & Camping is just outside the town of Kabelvåg on the Norwegian Lofoten island group. This campsite is on Austvågøy, one of this archipelago's central islands. Here, you camp on a lovely spot by an inland bay. This location provides plenty of shelter from the sea wind. Around the campsite, you can take spectacular walking trips through the rugged nature area of Lofoten. This is therefore a great destination for nature and walking lovers.

Stay on a spacious touring pitch or in a hiker's chalet

This campsite is on a lovely spot by a small bay. Here, you are on an open site. Partly due to the terraces, you have beautiful views of the lake and the surrounding mountains from many pitches. At Kabelvåg Feriehus & Camping, you can book a spacious pitch on the tent camping field or in the part designated for tourists with a caravan or motorhome. Furthermore, you can stay the night in a comfortable hiker's chalet or in a modern apartment.

Central service building as a meeting place

There is a service building at a central spot on the campsite that all campsite guests can use. You will find the well-maintained toilet and washing facilities in this building. There is also a small kitchen with several dining tables. It is a lovely place to meet other campers and enjoy a (homemade) meal together! Anyone still needing groceries to prepare a meal can go to Kabelvåg (2 km). There, you will find several shops, a supermarket as well as some charming restaurants.

properties.name: MS Vacances - Camping Club Le Trianon
properties.description:
Camping Club MS Le Trianon is a modern family park on the outskirts of the popular French coastal resort of Les Sables-d'Olonne. The white beaches of the Atlantic Ocean are only three kilometres from this holiday resort. The enormous leisure pool with seven slides provides hours of swimming fun! Furthermore, you will find all you need here for a lovely holiday, such as an extensive entertainment programme, a restaurant, a snack bar and even a wellness centre for ultimate relaxation. You spend the night in one of the many glamping accommodation. There is even a cabin with a private Jacuzzi.

Glamping for everyone

Comfort, luxury and convenience. That is what you can expect if you travel to the west coast of France. What instantly stands out is that Camping Club MS Le Trianon is completely focused on hiring glamping accommodation. The accommodation are on reasonably spacious spots and are made of high-quality materials.

Whizz down one of the slides

The main attraction during your holiday is the big water park. There is a lovely swimming pool measuring 1,100 square metres to swim laps, an indoor paddling pool with heated water and a water playground. And of course, the seven spectacular slides you can happily whizz down.

Enjoyment for the whole family

There is a vast selection of activities and entertainment. There is the Kids Club for young children and teenagers. And entertaining shows for the whole family in the evenings. Children can have fun in the large playground on the colourful climbing equipment, slides and bouncy castle. There is also miniature golf, and you can play football.

properties.name: MS Vacances - Camping Club Les Brunelles
properties.description:
The Vendée is a department in the west of France full of beautiful landscapes, rich heritage and tasty gastronomy. Camping Club Les Brunelles is located in the south of the Vendée, not far from golden beaches and charming seaside resorts. This large and luxurious family campsite is a perfect place to discover the region.

Well-maintained

Camping Club Les Brunelles is spaciously laid out. There is a wide range of rental accommodation available. On well-kept lawns, you will find mobile homes separated by hedges or flowerbeds. Like the rest of the campsite, all are clean and well-maintained.

Water fun for everyone

The eye-catcher is the large swimming paradise with whirlpools, rapids, a jacuzzi and several spectacular slides. There's also loads of water play equipment and a large separate area for toddlers and preschoolers.

Something to do everywhere

Fresh rolls for breakfast, a newspaper and all the ingredients for your favourite camping meal. You can get it all at the campsite shop. You can also choose to get a quick bite at the snack bar or enjoy an extensive meal in the restaurant. Here you will also find a bar, a cocktail bar with lounge and a disco where you can often enjoy yourself late into the evening. There's also plenty to do during the day.
