There are two playgrounds for children, several sports fields and an animation team that ensures there is always something to do for young and old alike.

properties.name: MS Vacances - Camping Club Les Tamaris
properties.description:
Camping Club MS Les Tamaris is just outside the charming tourist resort of Le Barcarès, in the Southern French department of Pyrénées-Orientales. Here, you stay in a popular holiday area. A large sandy beach by the Mediterranean Sea is within walking distance, while inland you can enjoy the natural beauty of the foothills of the Pyrenees. At Camping Club MS Les Tamaris, you can only book a stay in a modern mobile home for two to eight people. This luxury five-star resort also offers a lovely leisure pool complex and an extensive entertainment programme.

Enjoy the lovely leisure pool complex

Here, you swim in a heavenly setting with palm trees, playfully laid out bridges, loungers and parasols. Thanks to the lagoon swimming pool, thrilling rapids, a colourful water playground and various hot tubs, you can hours of fun splashing about. This leisure pool complex also has four water slides. The U-shaped slide, which you go down on a rubber tyre, is spectacular! There is also a swimming pool with retractable roof, so that you can also go swimming on cold or rainy days.

What is the entertainment programme like?

All kinds of activities are organised at this resort in the high season. The youngest park guests can have fun doing crafts, making things with clay, playing ball games and at the miniature disco. Meanwhile, teenagers can enjoy a holiday with sports competitions, trips to the beach or the carting track and make their own video clips. There is plenty of entertainment in the evenings at Camping Club MS Les Tamaris. For example, musical performances, karaoke, lotteries, quiz evenings and cabaret and magic shows. Dance evenings are organised regularly and sometimes a foam party!

properties.name: Parc résidentiel de loisirs St Vit
properties.description:
Do you enjoy camping in a quiet spot? And what about getting out on the water during your holiday? Then your ideal destination is Parc résidentiel de loisirs St Vit in Neufgrange, in the French Moselle region. This is a peaceful campsite situated next to a recreational lake and a vast forest. It offers plenty of opportunities for water sports, walking and cycling. The campsite itself is well maintained and offers a variety of sports and leisure facilities.

Plenty of peace, space and privacy

St Vit has large grass pitches that are also spaced far apart. When booking, please feel free to let us know whether you’d prefer a spot with a little or a lot of shade, and the friendly owners will take that into account. Most of the pitches at this campsite are designed for caravans. However, it is also possible to stay in modern accommodation units. Choose from one of the comfortable mobile homes or a large holiday home.

Plenty of watersports opportunities

This campsite offers a boules court, table tennis and two playgrounds. Another convenient feature is that the campsite reception offers meals delivered from two restaurants in the area. However, most guests come to this campsite for the peace and quiet as well as its location on the beautiful recreational lake, Étang Saint-Vit. Take a refreshing dip in the lake from the campsite’s own grassy beach, or go for a paddle in your own canoe or on a stand-up paddleboard.

Beautiful walking and cycling routes

There are lovely walking and cycling routes located right near the campsite. Take a walk around the lake and explore the forest on the northern shores. If you go half an hour east, you will end up in the northern Vosges.

properties.name: Camping Les Patîs
properties.description:
Camping Les Patis in Nazelles-Négron, close to the town of Amboise, is a wonderful place to unwind and to explore the Loire region. River La Cisse meanders beside the campsite, where you go fishing in the peace and quiet. The enchanting forested area offers options for both relaxation as well as adventure. Furthermore, the campsite is on the well-known Loire à Vélo tourist cycle route, making it easy to explore the stunning surroundings on a bike.

Camping pitches, motorhome pitches and accommodation

This small-scale family campsite is a place where young and old come together. There are 60 spacious camping pitches, where you can enjoy both sun as well as shade. There are separate pitches for motorhomes. You can also stay in one of the hiker's huts or on the lodge tents with private toilet and washing facilities.

Fun activities at the campsite

There is something different to do every day at the campsite. There is no entertainment programme or swimming pool, but with a small petting zoo, a library, a skate park and a playground, no one will get bored. Wine tastings are regularly organised and you can watch films under the starry sky at the outdoor cinema in July and August. And a camping holiday in France is of course not complete without a game of table tennis and jeu de boules!

Enjoy the food truck/restaurant

At the campsite, you can savour the honest and fair dishes at the lovely food truck. Enjoy a relaxing meal amid the trees decorated with lanterns. End your evening on the patio with a refreshing drink or tasty ice cream, while enjoying the atmosphere and company of your fellow campers.

properties.name: First Camp Norsjø
properties.description:
First Camp Norsjø in Norway’s Telemark is an ideal destination for camping enthusiasts who love nature and water. Located on the beautiful Norsjø lake and the Telemark Canal, this campsite has combination of mountains, nature and swimming opportunities. It is a favourite spot for both holidaymakers and the local population.

Various accommodations

At the campsite you can choose from various accommodations, such as comfortable cabins, luxury glamping tents or pitches for motorhomes, caravans and tents. All pitches are close to the lake and the beach, and many have a good view of the water.

Activities for everyone

For those who enjoy an active holiday, First Camp Norsjø has many options. You can play a game of mini golf, for example, and there is a playground and a bouncy castle. You can also rent canoes and SUP boards. The Cablepark is a popular attraction where you can go wakeboarding and waterskiing – ideal for adventurers!

Good and drinks at the campsite

The campsite has a shop with a limited variety of the basic necessities. The restaurant has been converted into a charming bistro where you can enjoy delicious meals in a relaxed atmosphere with a wonderful terrace.

Explore the surrounding area

The campsite is by the Telemark Canal, ideal for bicycle rides along the water. You can join round trips over the canal at the pier by the campsite. Bø Sommarland, the largest water park in Scandinavia, which is especially fun for families with children is only a 20-minute drive away.

properties.name: First Camp Lunde
properties.description:
In the 19th century, the Telemark Canal was built in the south of Norway. At the time, Europe viewed this as the eighth world wonder. First Camp Lunde lies directly under this canal, in the town of Lunde. You camp only a few hundred metres from the Lunde lock and a fifteen-minute drive from Vrangfoss, where you will find the largest (and most imposing) lock of the Telemark Canal. You can go on lovely walks and bicycle rides in the area around this neatly kept campsite.

Spacious touring pitches

This campsite is mainly aimed at tourist campsite visitors who have their own camping equipment. The neatly arranged grounds have various open fields with spacious pitches. Some pitches have a mixture of grass and gravel, although you can book a pitch at First Camp Lunde with a grassy surface. Some pitches are almost right by the water. A separate field has been set up for those camping with a tent.

Ideal destination for water sports fans

The situation of this campsite is ideal for those who love water sports. The campsite rents out kayaks, canoes and SUP boards, which means you can go for a nice trip on the water. On hot days it is very tempting to look for some refreshment in the river, made possible by a sandy beach, a large grass beach and two swimming docks.

Paddling on the Telemark Canal

It is an amazing experience to canoe over the Telemark Canal. Being on the water gives you a unique view of the surrounding hills and mountains. It is also unique that you are allowed to enter the chambers of the locks with your canoe – with a guide – in Lunde and nearby Vrangfoss.

properties.name: Skotteksgården Camping & Stugby
properties.description:
Two kilometres south of Ulricehamn, Sweden, you will find the Skotteksgården Camping & Stugby campsite. This cosy family campsite is open year-round. Everything is possible here; lazing, relaxing or just an enjoyable active holiday in the snow or in the sun.

Cosy campsite, spacious pitches

This quiet campsite has fifty spacious touring pitches. There are flat paved sites with grass and dedicated RV facilities. For tent campers, there are separate sites under the trees overlooking Lake Åsunden. At Skotteksgården Camping & Stugby, you can also rent accommodations with a camping atmosphere. For example, you can spend the night in a hiker's hut, a romantic camping barrel or a comfortable bungalow.

Swimming in the lake

For a dip in the lake, you only have to walk three hundred meters from the campsite. The sandy beach and the lake here are also very suitable for (small) children. The clear lake also lends itself perfectly to snorkelling or water sports such as kayaking, water skiing, sailing or windsurfing.

Plenty to experience

Although there is no entertainment at this campsite, children will have a great time here. The recreation room, playground and table tennis tables will take care of that. Not to mention the endless possibilities on, by and in the water!

Everything at your fingertips

During the summer period (mid-June to mid-August), a delicious breakfast is provided. Then you can also visit the bar and restaurant. The campsite also has a well-equipped kitchen where you can prepare your own delicious dishes. There is a camp store with a small selection.

properties.name: Camping La Brande
properties.description:
Camping La Brande is situated on the southern coast of Ile d'Oléron, the second largest island in France after Corsica. This part of the island is known for oyster and mussel farming, fishing industry as well as viticulture. The campsite clearly caters to families with children. There is an entertainment program for all ages. There is also a nice restaurant on the campsite, where mussels are the speciality. A piece of meat or fish can be grilled on one of the communal barbecues.

Camping amidst green

The 115 camping pitches on the campsite are surrounded by greenery. You will find no less than fifty different types of trees and shrubs here. The pitches vary in size. You can also choose between shady and sunnier pitches. 

Don't have your own camping equipment? No problem; you can choose from many different types of rental accommodation, varying in size and level of luxury. You can also rent a beautiful safari tent.

Slide and splash

There is a (heated) swimming pool measuring some 180 m2. The pool is covered with a sliding roof. There is also a fun slide. A paddling pool is available for the youngest campers. You can also indulge in the sauna or whirlpool. If you think the swimming pool is too small for your taste, the sea is less than five hundred metres away from the campsite. 

Entertainment for the whole family

Small children can enjoy themselves at the mini club, but older children and adults will not have to feel bored for one minute. They can play a game of tennis, table tennis, jeu de boules, mini golf or throw a few strikes at the bowling alley. A particularly original activity is an excursion with a tractor to the oyster beds.

properties.name: Camping De Paal
properties.description:
Rurally situated in the Campine woods, this top campsite is aimed at young children and has a unique artificial dune landscape: the 'Biebelebontse Paalbergen'.

Close to the attractive town of Bergeijk you will find child-friendly campsite de Paal. You are camping here on attractively positioned fields, spacious pitches or in a unique rental accommodation. Thanks to the many trees there is ample shade to be found. Campsite de Paal is a true children's paradise; a spot where there are lots of activities for children and for the parents.

Comfort or super comfort?

There are beautiful car-free comfort pitches which are located on the spaciously laid-out (more open) fields. You can also choose a super comfort pitch. In addition, there are (luxury) rental accommodation units, of which Paalcasa is the most unique: a cottage covered with earth and plants with a chalet in front.

For the children

When you see the swimming pools on the campsite, you will understand why children love coming here. There is a beautiful, covered sub-tropical water playground as well as a beautiful, heated outdoor swimming pool with slide. They are centrally located on the grounds and close to the other amenities. But there is more, much more, such as a bicycle cross track, a fitness area, a panna field and a petting zoo. And De Paal also organises an extensive entertainment programme during the holidays and the weekends.

Not to be missed

Not to be missed on this campsite are the Biebelebontse Paalbergen. The Martens family (camping owners) had an artificial dune landscape built, where children can indulge themselves with buckets and spades. Fun with sand and water!

properties.name: Camping Parc de Fierbois
properties.description:
Camping Parc de Fierbois is a family campsite on a recreational lake, just south of the Loire Valley in the Indre-et-Loire department. Adventure trail, tree houses and water park: here you'll find everything you need to give children a fantastic holiday. Enjoy a comfort pitch with private sanitary facilities, a game of pool in the bar and dive into one of the swimming pools.

Welcome! Welcome!

The A10 takes you via Tours through the Loire Valley, where you cross the Indre just under Tours. At Sorigny's, you trade the A10 for the D910. Then drive south for another 15 minutes. The last part you drive on a narrow road through a forest. When you pass this road the gate of Camping Parc de Fierbois appears. The receptionists speak English.

Camping

You can choose a comfort pitch, situated on the shady edge of the forest or a spacious touring pitch on lawns with a more open character. Some pitches have private sanitary facilities, for extra luxury. Part of the communal sanitary facilities will be renewed in 2018.

Entertainment for the whole family

In addition to chalets, mobile homes and gîtes, you can also rent a tree house. Also adventurous for children is the climbing course at the lake. The lake itself offers all possibilities for anglers and water sports enthusiasts. The children can have even more water fun in the water park on the campsite. Deep and shallow pools run into each other here. The bar at the water park has a spacious outdoor café and there is often live music. The bar has a games hall with a.o. pool tables. There is also a separate restaurant and an extensive supermarket on the campsite.

properties.name: Solar Caravan Park
properties.description:
Solar Caravan Park is close to the tourist city of Pärnu, in the natural green coastal area of Estonia. This campsite, powered by solar energy and crowned as the Best Campsite in Estonia in 2023, offers a combination of spacious comfort and sustainability. You will find caravans, tents, large motorhome pitches and adequate privacy while you are surrounded by stunning countryside, including Estonia's most beautiful beach.

Spaciously appointed campsite

At 100 m2, the caravan pitches can be called generous and tents have 16m2 pitches. On the first field, the pitch demarcation is still under development with saplings. The second field offers an open space without demarcation, which gives the feeling of freedom and space. The campsite is a sanctuary for those seeking peace and quiet. In the high season you will encounter many international groups of Finns, Germans, and Dutch, while it is mainly Finns who seek the quiet at this spot in the low season.

Showering under a rain shower

You will find luxurious, modern and clean toilet and washing facilities, where each unit is large enough for a wheelchair and equipped with a toilet, hand basin and rain shower. The campsite also has a laundry room with washing machine and dryer.

Groceries and shopping

Want to do grocery shopping without leaving the campsite? For a small grocery shop, the reception sells ice cream, crisps, fizzy drinks and hand-made items and jewellery. You can also hire bikes here. For more extensive groceries and shopping, you can go to Pärnu (10 km).

properties.name: Fjordlyst - Aabenraa City Camping
properties.description:
Fjordlyst - Aabenraa City Camping is a charming campsite in South Jutland, Denmark. Located on a hill, the campsite offers great views over the town of Aabenraa and the similarly named fjord. Its location is ideal: just 2 km from the town centre, 500 metres from the beach and port and 300 metres from the forest. Here you will enjoy a perfect balance between nature and the town.

Spend the night with a view

The campsite has a variety of pitches, ranging from sheltered spots surrounded by hedges to open pitches with views of the fjord or town. There are special fields for tent campers, including one overlooking the water and another sheltered from the wind. There are also several hiker's huts for rent such as standard, comfort and bicycle cabins. Special pitches are available for campers, and for those looking for more comfort, a small hotel is also available on site.

Sports, games and relaxation

At Fjordlyst, children have fun playing mini-golf, in the playground or indoor play area. For sporty guests, there are several cycling routes in the area and there is a sports field on the campsite for kicking a ball around or playing beach volleyball. Nearby, you can swim in the sea, snorkel, windsurf and water-ski.

Explore the surrounding area

Aabenraa is a historic town with a rich maritime history. You can walk straight here from the campsite. Visit Brundlund Castle and Aabenraa Museum. There are also friendly cafés, shops and cultural activities.

properties.name: Camping Les Grésillons
properties.description:
Camping Les Grésillons is between the vineyards of Anjou. Located in the heart of the Centre-Val de Loire region and on the banks of the River Layon, the charming French rural life embraces every camper at this campsite. If you love historic towns and villages, the countryside and relaxing in natural surroundings, this is the perfect place for you. Les Grésillons is close to the village of Saint-Georges-sur-Layon and the town of Doué-la-Fontaine.

The site

The pitches for caravans and motorhomes are up the top and easy to reach. In terms of pitches, they are spacious and of various sizes. But what they all have in common is that they are beautifully landscaped, framed by bushes. From some pitches you have breathtaking panoramic views of the valley of the Layon.

Various types of bungalows can be hired at this campsite, which are ideal for families with children. There are three types: Isabelle (four people), Olga (five people) and Laura (six people).

Swimming and playing sports together

Fancy a swim? The campsite has a heated swimming pool in a sunny spot. Families with children are more than welcome. There is a heated paddling pool by the swimming pool, for example.

If you'd like a nice ice cream after your swim, you can get one from reception. For daily groceries, there are small shops in the village or a supermarket in Saint-Georges-sur-Layon (1 km).

Furthermore, young and old can have fun on the beach volleyball court, the pétanque area or on the table tennis tables. For the littlest ones, there is a special nursing area, complete with a changing table and a baby bath.

properties.name: Camping Les Chapelains
properties.description:
Les Chapelains campsite is located in the lush countryside of southern France. Here you can camp on the banks of the river Drôme. Pitch your tent in the woods and enjoy the peace and quiet and the mountains. The campsite is one big playground for the children. They can play in the play corner, but especially the river is their favourite spot. In the quiet water they can swim, paddle in the shallows and canoe.

Camping in the countryside

Are you coming to the South of France with a caravan? Then you can choose a nice delimited pitch between the trees. With a view of the surrounding mountains. Tent campers will pitch their tent in the woods, close to the river. That is camping as camping is meant to be. Tie your hammock between two trees, put out your folding chair ... and let the enjoyment begin.

Water fun in the Drôme

From the campsite you can step straight onto the pebble beach at the Drôme. Perhaps not the best place for sunbathing all day, but certainly the best place for a refreshing dive. The calm water is perfect for swimming. The shallow water is perfect for bathing with small children. An outing with the whole family? Take a trip in a canoe.

A different restaurant every evening

Away from the hustle and bustle usually means away from the facilities. At campsite Les Chapelains this is not too bad. For a quick snack you can go to the bar. For your shopping you only have to go to Crest. Not only is there a larger supermarket, but you can also visit a different restaurant every evening.

properties.name: Camping Sudersé
properties.description:
Centrally located between the old town of Workum and the IJsselmeer you’ll find Sudersé campsite. This small-scale farm campsite has very spacious pitches on green camping fields surrounded by trees and bushes. Near the campsite, there is an organic agricultural and horticultural farm. In the farm shop, you will find organic products of their own cultivation.

Spacious pitches

Sudersé Camp Site is a small camp site with sixty pitches in total. There are 42 very spacious pitches, laid out on grass fields surrounded by greenery. The rest of the pitches are intended for permanent guests or campervan owners. There are also four wooden hikers' huts and a bungalow for rent.

Sandy beach within walking distance

Although the Zuiderzee has been the IJsselmeer for a long time now, you still feel as if you're by the sea on the wide sandy beach. You can swim, surf, sunbathe and enjoy the sunset. On the beach, you will see sailing boats, surfboards and catamarans everywhere, as there are several sailing and surfing schools. There is even a beach pavilion. This is located less than two kilometres from the campsite.

Ultimate tranquillity

This is truly a campsite for campers who love peace and quiet. So be sure to pack a pile of novels and board games, because there is no entertainment programme at this campsite. This does not mean, however, that there is nothing to do at Sudersé. Families with small children will have a great time here with the playground, sandpit, trampoline, animal pasture and sports field.

Fresh and organic

There is no restaurant, bar or supermarket on the campsite, but there is a farm shop. There you can find fresh, organic products. You can also get fresh rolls every morning.

properties.name: Camping Mialanne
properties.description:
Camping Mialanne is a small campsite in a magnificent spot in the Pyrenees National Park. The campsite excels in cleanliness and friendly staff. From the flat and well-kept terraces against the slope of a mountain, you have a view of the surrounding mountains. The highest mountain, whose summit is close to the campsite, is the Col d'Aubisque. Cycling enthusiasts should not forget their bikes.

Phenomenal view

What makes the campsite stand out immediately is the great variety of wild flowers and plants. In between are the beautifully tended terraces, easily accessible by paved roads. The more than forty touring pitches are flat, spacious and have plenty of privacy. The spots on the highest terraces are most suitable for tent campers. Wherever you stand, the view of the surrounding mountains is phenomenal.

Multifunctional main building

In the main building, with its plastered walls and wooden doors and beams typical of this region, there is a cosy meeting room and a games room, in addition to the reception. In the meeting room you can use free Wi-Fi, a microwave, kettles and fridges. This is also the place to go if you want to learn more about the area. Part of the room has been transformed into an information corner. Table tennis and games are available in the playroom.

Arrens-Marsous

Arrens-Marsous is a small mountain village close to the campsite. It only takes a few minutes to cycle to the centre, but the village begins on the other side of the road. There is a supermarket. In the village you will also find a bakery, a butcher, a pizzeria and a restaurant. Furthermore, on Wednesday afternoon there is a small market in the centre.

properties.name: Camping Het Twiskerveld
properties.description:
Camping Het Twiskerveld is a small farm campsite in the heart of North Holland. You will camp among the animals, vast meadows and close to charming towns. It's ideal for anyone looking for peace and quiet, but there’s also plenty to do in the area. Walk or cycle through the West Frisian countryside, taste local produce or start the day with freshly baked bread rolls.

Pitches and The Milkmaid

The mini campsite has 25 large pitches for tents, caravans and motor homes. All the pitches have a 10-ampere electricity supply and are close to well-kept toilet and washing facilities. Want to try something unique? Then choose 'The Milkmaid', a cosy little house in the shape of a milk tank, complete with its own bathroom. There’s also a comfortable mobile home for up to 4 people. All accommodation is furnished with care and offers plenty of privacy and comfort.

Feed animals and play boules

There’s plenty for both young and old to do at Het Twiskerveld. Children can jump on the trampoline, play table tennis or discover the large playground with sandboxes and playhouses. Sports enthusiasts can play a game of boules, while the little ones can help feed the chickens and goats. The campsite is particularly suitable for families with children up to the age of 9.

History, culture and nature nearby

Het Twiskerveld is a perfect base for cultural trips. Visit the historic triangle of Medemblik (10 km), Enkhuizen (24 km) and Hoorn (12 km), where time seems to stand still and you’ll find some interesting museums. There are also beautiful cycling routes through West Friesland.

properties.name: Swichumer Pleats
properties.description:
Fancy camping in a beautiful, quiet area with sweeping views of the Frisian countryside? Swichumer Pleats is a small-scale campsite in the heart of Friesland. You can take beautiful hiking and cycling trips in the area. If you fancy something a little more lively, you can easily bike to cosy Leeuwarden (4 km). The spacious grounds feature a playground with plenty of play equipment for children. The campsite does not have many facilities, but there are plenty of fun things to do in the area. For example, spend a day at the AquaZoo in Leeuwarden or cycle the Elfstedentocht route.

Farm campsite with expansive views

Swichumer Pleats is built around a farm, which is no longer in use. You'll be camping on a flat grass field. The campsite is spacious and because there is little vegetation you have a beautiful view over the meadows. The campsite has spacious touring pitches with electricity connections. In addition, there are several accommodations.

The campsite features two neat, modern sanitary buildings offering you plenty of privacy. Each shower facility has its own mirror with sink. The sanitary facilities are clean and well maintained.

Playground and bread service

When you come to Swichumer Pleats, you're mainly coming for the peace and quiet and to enjoy the Frisian countryside. There is therefore no entertainment programme or swimming pool. For children there's a playground with, among other things, a double swing, slide, sandpit, playhouse and table tennis table.

properties.name: Camping Le Grand Cerf
properties.description:
Near the sleepy village of Le Grand-Serre, on the edge of the Drôme, lies Camping Le Grand Cerf. This four-star campsite has a heated outdoor swimming pool and two tennis courts. The campsite is laid out on two spacious terraces. You camp on a delimited pitch on the grass. There is a beautiful sunbathing lawn and even a sandy beach for campers.

Terrace campsite

The campsite is laid out in terraces, because the campsite is situated a bit higher against the hill. This gives you a panoramic view over the valley and the surrounding hills from most of the pitches. There are sixty touring pitches, divided over two spacious terraces. In addition to touring pitches, there are also seven fixed annual pitches and eighteen rental accommodations on the campsite.

For children

In the middle of the campsite there is a heated outdoor swimming pool in full sun. Next to it is a separate paddling pool, which is also heated. Around the pool you can sunbathe on the sun loungers and the artificial grass sunbathing lawn. Next to the swimming pool are the tennis courts, which also serve as sports fields. On the other side is a nice sandy beach. There is a playground and there is a trampoline and a bouncy castle. There is also a petting zoo.

Bar and bistro

From the slightly higher terrace at the bar and restaurant, you look out over the pool and playground. The restaurant is a simple bistro that is only open in July and August. Besides camping guests, there are also many local residents. The menu is extensive, and you can also get pizza, snacks and takeaway food. At the bar you can get drinks and ice creams.

properties.name: Genuss-Camping Bad Gleichenberg
properties.description:
With just 19 pitches, Genuss-Camping Bad Gleichenberg is a very intimate campsite. It is located in the lovely spa town of Bad Gleichenberg. The Steiermark region is a thermal and volcanic area, close to Slovenia (12 km). The campsite is surrounded by a variety of sports facilities, and both the city and nature are within walking distance.

Modern facilities

The camping pitches are paved and demarcated with grass and plants. The rows of pitches are opposite each other and there is limited shade.

The neat, clean and modern sanitary facilities at Genuss-Camping Bad Gleichenberg are also a major plus. The sanitary facilities are in the nearby sports halls and can always be used with an access card.

Staying active around the campsite

There are many facilities around Genuss-Camping Bad Gleichenberg. Next to the campsite is the multi-sports complex where you can play tennis and football and work out. There's also a fishing pond. An outdoor swimming pool and a children's playground are just 500 metres away. Fresh pastries can be ordered at the campsite and are delivered by the bakery. There are several restaurants in the immediate vicinity of the campsite.

In the thermal baths or on the go

Bad Gleichenberg's town centre, where you'll find several restaurants and shops, is just a 15-minute walk from the campsite. Be sure to take a stroll through the verdant Kurpark, where you'll find all sorts of art on display.

The Steiermark region is known for its thermal baths and spas. There are also vineyards in the area. It's a perfect starting point for wonderful cycling and hiking tours. Styrassic Park (2.5 km) is highly recommended for families with children.

properties.name: Campingplatz Weißenthalsmühle
properties.description:
Campingplatz Weißenthalsmühle is located in the quiet Habichtswald in Hesse, surrounded by two streams. This campsite is popular among lovers of tranquillity and nature who want to get away from it all. Here you can choose from spacious camping pitches and cosy tiny houses. From the campsite, you can walk or cycle straight into nature, with lots of lovely routes to choose from. The cities of Fritzlar and Kassel are within driving distance.

Pitches and accommodations

The spacious pitches at Campingplatz Weißenthalsmühle offer a choice of both sunny and shady spots. The pitches are not demarcated, which adds to the feeling of freedom and space. Don’t have your own camping equipment? On the campsite you will also find cosy tiny houses. These rental accommodations have a kitchen, bathroom and cosy seating areas in an enclosed garden.

Facilities on the campsite

The Biergarten, which is open on weekends and holidays, serves a simple but tasty menu. Here you can eat a pizza, bratwurst and fries, for example. There is also a small kiosk for coffee, ice cream and supplies. There is also a bread service, where you can give your choice of breakfast until 18.00.

Enjoy the terrace with plenty of flowers and seating. And for real relaxation enthusiasts, there is a salt cave on site, where you can go for soothing salt therapy.

Explore the surrounding area

There is also lots to do in the surrounding area. The Habichtswald nature reserve, known for its many hiking and cycling routes, is highly recommended. And Bergpark Wilhelmshöhe, known for its waterworks and Hercules statue, is also within driving distance (30 km).

properties.name: Myrhøj Camping
properties.description:
Space and nature are the words best used describe the west coast of Himmerland, in the north of Denmark. Located by Denmark's largest fjord in the Myrhøj nature reserve, Myrhøj Camping's location truly could not be better. It is situated near the immense Limfjord as well as the beach and numerous beautiful cycling routes. The campsite fully accommodates the needs of children up to about twelve years of age, with a playground full of climbing equipment, a sports field, a cable car and even an indoor playground.

Neat lawns

What really stands out as you walk through this campsite is the amount of greenery. The grounds are well-organised and beautifully maintained. The pitches vary in size and their amount of green growth. From some pitches you'll wake to a view of the fjord - a truly remarkable experience. The wooden hiker's cabins provide accommodation for campers who do not have their own equipment.

The three sanitary buildings are all kept in very clean condition. There are also facilities to accommodate guests with physical disabilities.

Maximum fun

Spending the whole day at the campsite? The kids would probably love nothing more! Start the day with fresh rolls from the campsite shop. Sufficiently fueled up? Then they're sure to entertain themselves for hours in the colourful indoor and outdoor playground. Or they can check out the goats, sheep, rabbits and chickens. Fun activities, such as treasure hunting or crafts, are regularly scheduled.

Still want to venture outside of the campsite for a bit? There are plenty of beautiful bays around the Limfjord, also a short walk from the campsite. There you will see large rock formations. You can enter the water from the swimming jetty.

properties.name: Hals Strand Camping
properties.description:
This large family campsite located in the northernmost part of Denmark, North Jutland, is within walking distance of a beautiful sandy beach. North Jutland is known for its tranquillity, abundant space, unspoilt nature and beautiful beaches. An ideal holiday destination for families, peace seekers and nature lovers. At Hals Strand Camping you can almost smell the sea, and you have a view it from many of the pitches. The campsite has a heated swimming pool, a large playground and a restaurant & bar. The town of Hals, which features several shops, restaurants and a harbour, is about 6 kilometres away.

Large camping area by the sea

When you arrive at Hals Strand Camping, you'll immediately notice the vast, flat terrain. The campsite is especially suitable for campers who come with their own tent, caravan or motorhome. The camping pitches are separated by small hedges and low vegetation. There are also some rental accommodations available, including a few mobile homes and apartments.

Swimming fun in the heated pool

At the front of the campsite you'll find a heated swimming pool with a large slide and a separate paddling pool for small children. Go down the slide together! There are sun loungers around the pool where you can relax and enjoy the sun.

Playground and cuddling with goats

Children will have a great time at the campsite. There's a large playground with climbing equipment, two bouncy castles and climbing walls. You can kick a ball together on the football field. Another popular activity is adventure mini golf. Have fun on the 12 courses, each more challenging than the last.

properties.name: Camping Hohenwarth
properties.description:
Amid the rolling surroundings of the beautiful Bavarian countryside, less than two km from the village by the same name, lies Camping Hohenwarth. The campsite is located on a through road. On the northern side of the campsite you will find the meandering Weißer Regen, a tributary of the Danube. There is also a small lake, where you can swim, fish or float in a boat.

Spacious campsite

There are spacious pitches throughout the grounds, some of which located near the playground and others by the lake. The sanitary facilities are pristine and well maintained. Bread and drinks are available in the shop. You can do your other shopping in nearby Hohenwarth.

Swimming and fishing

Children can enjoy themselves at the lake and in the playground. The lake also offers good fishing opportunities. You can join a (supervised) treasure hunt on the campsite. The river is suitable for canoeing. In the immediate vicinity of the campsite there are a large number of walking and cycling routes, leading through the magnificent nature of the Kötztinger Land.

Dragons in Furth

The immediate vicinity of the campsite offers ample opportunities for nice day trips. Children will definitely be keen to visit the Dragon Museum in Furth im Walt, at a distance of some twenty km from Hohenwarth. Each year in August there is a traditional dragon festival, a five hundred-year old tradition you cannot afford to miss.

properties.name: Gl. Ålbo Camping
properties.description:
Gl. The Ålbo Campsite is located on the Danish coast, right on the water's edge. This is the ultimate holiday destination for anglers, divers and water sports enthusiasts. The Kleine Belt strait is a perfect fishing spot. But you can also come here to enjoy the peace and quiet. You can also find some peace on the spacious pitches, which are situated on terraces. Or on one of the small beaches along Denmark's coast.

Camping on terraces

The beautiful campsite is terraced: against the slope lie spacious, flat pitches. You'll be able to camp on beautiful green grass. From the higher pitches, you can see a glimpse of the sea. You didn't travel to the Danish coast with a caravan or motorhome? Then you can stay in one of the comfortable wooden houses.

Pizza or burgers

Are you hungry? You don't even have to leave the campsite. In the campsite shop, you can find enough ingredients for a one-pot meal. But maybe you don't feel like cooking at all. Then a takeaway pizza or a tasty burger is a great option. It's best to drive to Kolding for bigger shopping trips. You can reach this old port in twenty minutes.

Sanitary (fishing) facilities

Has it been a long trip, and do you badly need a trip to the loo? Don't worry! You'll find the facilities right behind the reception desk. The sanitary facilities are very clean and well maintained. And even when the campsite is at its busiest, there are plenty of facilities. In the sanitary building, you can not only wash yourself, but you can also wash your dishes. It's also possible to clean your catch of the day there.

properties.name: Halk Strand Camping
properties.description:
Halk Strand Camping is located in Southern Denmark, right by the Baltic Sea. This place is ideal for those seeking peace and quiet as well as for water sports enthusiasts. The campsite is in the middle of the countryside, allowing you to enjoy the roar of the sea or the singing of the birds. If you are ready for some action, Live life to the full in one of the playgrounds, on the playing field or on the sea where water sports enthusiasts can indulge themselves.

Glamping with a view of the sea

Waking up in your tent to be greeted with a view of the Baltic Sea: this is possible at Halk Strand Camping. A short path (250 m) takes you from the campsite to the beach. The campsite has spacious grassy fields for caravans, tents and motorhomes, but there are also comfortable accommodations such as apartments and mobile homes for those seeking a little more luxury.

Camping for all ages

There is fun to be had by all ages at Halk Strand Camping. Children can have the time of their lives in the (indoor) playground, or together you can have fun at sports facilities such as mini golf or one of the cycle routes starting at the campsite. You are at the right address here for water fun as well. The Little Belt strait, close to the campsite, is the perfect place to go swimming, fishing, sailing or water skiing. During the high season Halk Strand Camping organises activities regularly, like eating together in the large communal kitchen.

Explore Southern Jutland

Southern Jutland has so much more to offer than just the beach! Both nature lovers and culture enthusiasts will be happy. Explore Christiansfeld, a UNESCO’s World Heritage Site (30 km), admire the impressive Haderslev Cathedral (15 km) or go for a relaxing bicycle or walking tour. And don’t forget the beautiful Haderslev Fjord (21 km).

properties.name: Capfun Camping La Nautique
properties.description:
Camping La Nautique is situated close to Narbonne and is adapted to the needs of disabled persons. The neat camping pitches have their own sanitary facilities and overlook the saltwater lake, where you can enjoy kite surfing and canoeing. Children thoroughly enjoy themselves six days per week with the entertainment team and kids club. Foam parties, horse riding, wine tasting: you will never get bored at this camp site.

Pitches surrounded by oleanders

The camp site is situated on a hill at the foot of saltwater lake L’étang de Bages. The camping pitches are delineated with typical vegetation of the South of France: hedges, trees and oleanders of varying heights which create shady spots. Camping pitches in sunny spots are also available.

Take a refreshing dive

Relax on a deckchair under the palm trees or slide down the water slide into the outdoor swimming pool. You can also do this on cooler days, as the swimming pool is heated in spring and autumn. There is a paddling pool with a small water slide for the little ones.

Canoeing and windsurfing on the lake

Camping La Nautique is situated on the Bay of Bages, a saltwater lake where you can enjoy various water sports. The lake is accessible via a gate. When you feel like an active day on the water, you can rent canoes, wind surfing equipment and water cycles at the camping.

Adapted for persons with disabilities

Camping La Nautique carries the Tourisme & Handicap mark since 2005. This means that there are adapted camping spots for caravans, folding trailers, tents and campers. From these pitches, the adapted sanitary facilities can be reached via a paved surface. The swimming pool is also accessible to persons with disabilities.

properties.name: Camping Le Soulhol
properties.description:
Set directly on the banks of the River Bave, Le Soulhol is a quiet family campsite in the beautiful countryside of the Lot department. As well as in the river, you can also swim in the campsite's swimming pool. Visit the Gouffre de Padirac, an underground river that has carved out a spectacular cave system.

Welcome !

The river Bave runs alongside the timber-framed houses of the old village of Saint-Céré. If you follow the river to the east, you'll find the campsite just outside the centre. Here you can camp directly on the river. These are nice pitches where you look out over the water, but the places a bit further from the river bank are quieter. A large part of the almost 120 touring pitches are in the shade of large trees and on well maintained lawns. Lovely sanitary facilities There are three sanitary blocks on the elongated campsite. Small campers can make use of children's sanitary facilities and there is a baby room. The sanitary facilities are well-cared for and kept tidy.

Water fun

Although there is no entertainment programme, Le Soulhol campsite can be described as a family campsite. Little guests can have fun in the bouncy castle and in the swimming pool. There is a paddling pool next to it. And of course you can also bathe in the river. Fishermen are also welcome here. The Gouffre de Padirac is half an hour's drive away. This is a spectacular stalactite cave, eroded by a river, which still flows through the cave system. Next to two large underground halls you can admire the long carved passage from a gondola.

properties.name: Camping Les Rives du Lac Cantalès
properties.description:
Camping les Rives du Lac Cantalès is located on the banks of the French lake Lac de Saint-Étienne-Cantalès. This is a family campsite with plenty for the entire family to do. Children have great fun in the playground or on the playing field, there is water fun for young and old in the lake and in the outdoor swimming pool and you can participate in organised activities.

Various pitches

Campsite visitors stay on different pitches. The nature pitches are among the trees and you camp on grass. The comfort pitches are somewhat larger, and you can choose a pitch in the shade or a pitch that gets more sun. The premium pitches has wooden, partially covered veranda with a picnic table and two chairs. You can also stay in a luxury mobile home. All mobile homes have a fully equipped kitchen and private toilet and washing facilities.

Follow a yoga lesson or play a laser game

The reception can provide you with information about fun activities in the region as well as information about the campsite’s activities programme. Would you like to follow a relaxing yoga lesson today? Would you like to play a laser game or would you rather go to a concert in the evening?

Next to the reception, there is a small shop where you can some basic shopping. Each morning you can pick up the fresh rolls you ordered the day before. The campsite restaurant is open in the afternoons and evenings. End your day with a refreshing drink and a delicious dinner from the menu.

properties.name: Camping Nature l'Airial
properties.description:
In the French region de Landes lies campsite l’Airial, bordering on the village of Soustons. The campsite has spacious pitches which are demarcated with small hedges. The playground, sports fields, entertainment team and extensive swimming pool complex with water slide make this campsite suitable for the entire family. As the Atlantic Ocean is only 7 km away from the campsite, camping l’Airial makes also a perfect base for water sports enthusiasts.

The campsite is located on level terrain and looks neat and well maintained. The spaciously laid out pitches are demarcated with hedges. The sanitary facilities on the campsite are fairly traditional and possibly dated, but they are clean and well maintained.

Family campsite with great entertainment

Camping l’Airial will suit the entire family and is particularly popular with French and Dutch tourists. They have a kids club and there are play facilities for the little ones. Teenagers can indulge themselves on the sports field or on the tennis court and in high season there is an entertainment team for all ages. In the bar of the campsite you can participate in quizzes and karaoke evenings or enjoy a show or entertainment. On the campsite is a camping shop for daily groceries, a snack bar and a restaurant (take-away possible).

Complete swimming pool complex

The eye catcher of the campsite is the swimming pool complex, consisting of a covered indoor pool and a heated outdoor pool with long water slide. Across from the campsite is the Soustons Lake. Although swimming in the lake is not allowed from the shore on the campsite, there are many water sports and boating activities.

properties.name: Naturcamping Lagom
properties.description:
Green camping in an incredibly relaxing environment. That's exactly what you'll experience when you holiday in the Swedish Gräsmark and spend the night in the middle of nature. Naturcamping Lagom is located in a pine forest opposite a lake. The towns of Gräsmark (12 km) and Torsby (28 km) are also located nearby. The area offers abundant natural beauty and countless opportunities for hiking.

Camping among the pines

The campsite is in the middle of a pine forest and surrounded by greenery. Peace and space are the key concepts for the owners, and this is evident everywhere you look on this forest campsite. The name of the campsite means 'just right', and that's exactly what Naturcamping Lagom is. The campsite also focuses on sustainability. For example, cleaning is done using biodegradable cleaning products, and the Lagom Café mainly serves local and organic foods.

The best campsite for your dog

This campsite offers spacious nature pitches, including 45 free pitches and 50 numbered pitches with electricity. The camping pitches are large and have a lot of space around them. There are also a variety unique accommodations, such as a tipi, a Finnish kota and various stugas. The sanitary facilities are designed in completely Scandinavian style. In the middle of the sanitary building, there is also a service room with a washing machine, dryer and refrigerator, among other amenities. The campsite is extremely dog-friendly and has even been awarded the 2022 ACSI Award. The best campsite in Sweden for your dog! There are countless options for walking with your four-legged friend in the area.

properties.name: Camping De Graniers
properties.description:
Camping De Graniers is in the department of Gard in the south of France. This family campsite is surrounded by wooded areas at the foot of the Cévennes. It is an ideal home base for hikers. You can stay healthy at the campsite by visiting the health club and you can relax at the swimming pool with its chaise longues. During the high season, end your day with a basic meal at the campsite’s snack bar.

Sleep in a unique accommodation

At Camping De Graniers you stay on spacious grassy or sandy pitches. Part of the campsite is terraced while the other part is level. It is also possible to rent a mobile home or chalet. If you would rather stay overnight in a unique accommodation, choose a wooden log cabin with a tent-cloth roof or a bubble tent with a view of the starry heavens. There is plenty of space between the accommodations, allowing you as a holidaymaker to enjoy privacy.

Good swimming and fresh bread rolls

Cooling off on hot days is done in the large swimming pool. During the high season, the bar-ice cream tent is open until 23:00. During the day you can pick up takeout meals here and in the evening the tables on the terrace are served. You can also order fresh rolls daily at the reception during the summer months.

Walking in the Cévennes

Children can amuse themselves at the playground and the indoor play area that includes a table-football table and a billiard table. The campsite is in an area with lots of hiking paths. You can book a guided walking tour at the reception. A guide will take you to the nature reserve of the Cévennes for a walk through the countryside.

properties.name: Camping de la Biche à Seyssel
Camping Le Clos de la Lère
properties.description:
North of Toulouse, in the Midi-Pyrénées, Camping Le Clos de la Lère has a friendly location in the vast countryside. Hidden between the spectacular regions of Tarn-et-Garonne, Lot and Aveyron, this is an interesting hiking paradise. The pretty village of Cayriech can be reached on foot from the campsite.

Between the green

The spacious pitches are situated on a street with trees and shrubs on either side. Campers who like to find a spot in the shade, have plenty of choice. The mobile homes, chalets and sturdy safari tents are situated between the touring pitches. There's no lack of privacy, as hedges demarcate the green camping pitches everywhere.

Heated swimming pool

The spacious and beautiful swimming pool at the front of the campsite is a wonderful place to sunbathe, swim laps or listen to the birds whistling in peace and quiet. The temperature is always nice thanks to the heated water. There are comfortable loungers under the cosy thatched parasols.

Regional delicacies

At the bar you can drop by in high season for a drink, an ice cream or a small snack. In the morning the smell of fresh baguette invites you to get your breakfast here. Feel like tasting something local? There are all kinds of local products in the shop. Once in a while the owner cooks something tasty and campers can join in.

Indulging in the great outdoors

Young children have plenty of room to play here. Of course there is a playground, but a trampoline also invites all sorts of tricks. Furthermore, a game of table tennis or table football are among the possibilities. If you really want to start the day sporty, take a tour on the fitness machines.

properties.name: Camping Les Peupliers
properties.description:
Camping Les Peupliers is a small-scale campsite in the Breton countryside, not far from the Atlantic Ocean. On this friendly campsite, you'll find peace and quiet on a green, well-maintained campsite with spacious touring pitches and rental accommodation. The fitness room, the aromatic garden, the natural swimming pool: they all contribute to a relaxing camping holiday.

Colour and tranquillity

Immediately notice the nicely tended camping pitches, wrapped in greenery. A wide variety of trees and shrubs give colour and tranquility to the terrain, large boulders mark the 24 very spacious touring pitches. The rental accommodation is also surrounded by greenery. The mobile homes are well maintained, but especially the cosy lodge tents and the very spacious 'gîtes' are beautiful accommodations.

Swimming pool for children

When you drive onto the campsite, your eye will probably immediately catch sight of the swimming pool. This is not a standard rectangular pool. Because of its oval shape, sometimes erratic at the sloping edges, it looks a bit like a natural pool. For adults the pool is too cramped, but for small children it is perfect. A shallow area is trimmed with boulders, allowing the smallest swimmers to swim in complete safety.

Zen or sweating

There are many ways to relax on the campsite. Work up a sweat in the gym and then continue sweating in the sauna. Or enjoy the relaxing effects of nature in all its scents and colours. At the swimming pool you'll find a so-called 'espace zen', a place to completely unwind. Opposite this zen area lies the aromatic garden, where the soothing aromas of plants help you relax.

properties.name: Camping Le Clos Lalande
properties.description:
Camping Le Clos Lalande is located a few steps from the river Aveyron. This well-maintained family campsite has a very pleasant atmosphere. The campsite is very child-friendly: with the children's farm, with an outdoor swimming pool and fun activities nearby, young campers can enjoy themselves here.

Shady pitches

The campsite is quite small: on the tarrain there is room for 35 pitches. These pitches are spacious and often shady. Some pitches are delimited by green hedges, but most of them are fairly close to each other without any partition. This gives you a bit less privacy, but at the same time it might give you the chance to enjoy the pleasant atmosphere on the campsite. You can also spend the night in one of the rental accommodations.

Swimming pool

The swimming pool is situated in a sunny spot in the centre of the campsite. It has varying depths, making it suitable for everyone. Around the pool are sun loungers and armchairs where you can relax with a book.

Activities for young and old

On and around the campsite there is a lot to do for young and old. For example, the children's farm is fun for the children, and the adult campers can join in a game of jeu de boules. For an exciting afternoon you don’t have to drive far, because there is an altitude track in Saint-Antonin-Noble-Val. Here you can walk over bridges and ropes between the tall trees.

properties.name: Camping Vert Lavande
properties.description:
Unwind in picturesque southern France! Located at the edge of the medieval village of Belmont, Camping Vert Lavande is a lovely place to relax. Here you will find slow tourism on large, wooded pitches on the banks of the Rance River. In the morning, you can easily walk to the village bakery for a fresh baguette, while enjoying the peace and space around you.

Space, tranquillity and a warm welcome

At Camping Vert Lavande, you'll feel right at home. The campsite is located in the Grands Causses regional natural park. Whether you come with a tent, caravan or motorhome or stay in accommodation - such as a mobile home, small log cabin or furnished tent - you will find a place to suit you. The spacious pitches (min. 90 m2) are both sunny and shady, and usually you get to pick your own spot. Hikers, cyclists, motorcyclists and nature lovers appreciate the relaxed atmosphere and beautiful surroundings.

Live music at the terrace

This southern French campsite is a great place for holidaymakers who love nature and conviviality. There is a playground for children aged 2 to 12, a snack bar and rotisserie service. On several evenings, live music is played on the terrace of the (snack) bar. A 500-metre walk away is the public swimming pool. Here you can cool off on a hot summer’s day.

The menu will surprise you

The owners of the campsite have a background in hospitality, and you can taste it! Here you will enjoy delicious dishes prepared with local produce. From a quick snack to a full meal, there is something for everyone.

properties.name: Camping Le Lavoir d'Arlinde
properties.description:
An oasis of peace and quiet, ideal for campers who like camping with hardly any facilities. This is Camping Le Lavoir d’Arlinde, also known as ‘Camping & Gites Les Fumades’. You are camping here on a beautiful spot amidst pristine nature. Enjoy the chirping of birds and a brook in which you can fish.

Peace and harmony

You will find mainly French and Dutch campers here. The campsite is geared towards campers without children, towards people who are looking for peace, tranquillity and nature. Although children are welcomed, there are no special provisions for toddlers and infants whatsoever (no swimming pool, no playground and definitely no entertainment). Neither is there a restaurant or shop on the campsite. However, fresh bread is available daily.

Back to nature!

The 25 large touring pitches are either in the sun or in the shade. There are a large number of trees, so when you prefer to be in the sun for part of the day, please be aware of this when selecting a pitch. There is sufficient distance between the pitches to provide privacy. A brook flows next to the campsite.

Large charming gîtes

There are two large brick rental houses, called gîtes. One is suitable for up to four persons, the other for six persons. They can be found on the boundary of the terrain. The houses are sparsely furnished and spotlessly clean. In the gîtes you will find everything you need for a relaxed holiday: a good bathroom, complete kitchen and a terrace with dining room table and chairs.

properties.name: Camping Les Chalets sur la Dordogne
properties.description:
As the name of the campsite suggests, Les Chalets sur la Dordogne campsite is situated on the banks of the Dordogne. On this small campsite with swimming pool, you'll be camping in the middle of nature, on pitches by the river or between the trees. Cruise the Dordogne by canoe or discover the beautiful surroundings, with the city of Rocamadour and the Padirac cave as main attractions.

Small campsite, wide choice

Camping Les Chalets sur la Dordogne is a small-scale campsite. In addition to around sixty spacious pitches (including pitches especially for camper vans), the campsite has ten permanent pitches and fourteen rental accommodations. Despite the small number of accommodations, the choice is large. For example, you can choose from various mobile homes, a bungalow tent and a chalet. All pitches are located in the countryside and are separated from each other by hedges or trees.

The Dordogne

The river Dordogne also welcomes every camper. Fishermen can cast their fishing line to their heart's content. You can stand well in the shallow part. Moreover, the river is full of trout. In the high season an instructor visits weekly to explain different fishing techniques and fish species to camping guests. Of course you can also swim in the river. From the campsite you can take the canoe up the Dordogne to explore the beautiful surroundings from the water.

Poolside terrace

For a bite to eat you can go to the restaurant, located at the entrance of the campsite. The outdoor café overlooks the swimming pool. For shopping you can go to Bretenoux.

properties.name: Camping du Faillal
properties.description:
Camping du Faillal is situated in a beautiful hilly landscape of Midi-Quercy. You camp here near the border of Tarn-et-Garonne and Lot. The small-scale campsite is simple, but friendly and personal. For example, party evenings with barbecue and live music are regularly organised. Be sure to visit the medieval town of Montpezat-de-Query. The Flemish tapestries in its church are beautiful.

Camping between trees and shrubs

The campsite has a typical French feel: old-fashioned and simple, but beautifully situated in the countryside. The green campsite is circular and has around forty touring pitches. There is quite a difference in height in the terrain, but the pitches are almost flat. You camp nicely sheltered between the trees and shrubs. You can also stay in the cottages, with their colourful shutters.

The swimming pool: a lovely spot

On the edge of the campsite is the beautiful swimming pool. This large outdoor swimming pool is a lovely place to cool down. You can regularly take part in an aquagym lesson. There is a spacious sunbathing lawn around the swimming pool to work on your tan, but you can also choose one of the colourful chairs at the edge of the pool.

Party evening with live music

The facilities at this small campsite in France are basic. The sanitary facilities are in need of renovation, but they are kept very tidy. And the snack bar is simple, but the selection of local wines is extensive. In addition, a party is organised regularly. Together with your fellow campers you can eat and dance to live music.

properties.name: Hygge Lake
properties.description:
Camping Hygge Lake is the perfect place to experience the beautiful Danish outdoors. This small campsite is located in Gram, just a 15-minute drive from Ribe, Scandinavia's oldest city. Here,on the shores of a beautiful lake and surrounded by a forest, you will find peace and relaxation but also plenty of opportunities for adventure and fun for the whole family.

Luxury and comfort in the countryside

Camping Hygge Lake has everything you will need to make your stay comfortable. With only 20 pitches, this cosy campsite in Gram has a personal and quiet atmosphere, which makes it the perfect place to relax.

The modern toilet/washing facilities are fully equipped and the outdoor showers are a wonderfully refreshing experience in the heart of nature. Want to completely unwind? Try the hammocks in the trees or book the private sauna overlooking the lake.

Fun evening around the campfire

The campsite is even cosier in the evening hours. Gather with other campers at the campfire to share stories and experiences, roast marshmallows and enjoy typical Danish 'hygge' (conviviality). It's a fun way to end the day and meet new people.

Water fun and adventure

Rent a paddle board or kayak and explore the vast 25,000-m2 lake. There’s plenty of space to catch tadpoles or have a nice swim. Walk into the water from the sandy beach or dive into the deep end from the jetty with steps.

properties.name: Camping The Shepherds Rest Pub
properties.description:
In the middle of Northern Ireland, seventy kilometres west of Belfast, is The Shepherds Rest Pub. This remote pub has a small, quiet campsite. The campsite is well kept, with flat pitches and excellent facilities.

Space, quiet and green

The site consists of about thirty pitches on beautiful grassy banks. These are bordered by trees and shrubs. In the slightly sloping grass field, platforms have been laid out for caravans and motorhomes. This saves having to level your camping equipment. Furthermore, there are paved camper pitches. The campsite is surrounded by meadows, so it's nice and quiet here in the green. In the Campers Cottage you can cook and sit by the fireplace. If you are not camping, you can stay in a nice hiker's hut.

Homey and cosy

At The Shepherds Rest Pub, the atmosphere is friendly. You have plenty of space and it is nice and quiet. Most guests come to the campsite to cycle or walk in the area. The campsite is less suitable for children, although there is some play equipment.

A secluded spot

There is no restaurant on the campsite, but you can go to the homely pub for simple simple, good meals. There is also a recreation room with games, books and a television. Because you are in such a remote place, you won't have much range with your phone. Also the internet reception is not the best. The Shepherds Rest Pub does not offer wifi. So it's back to basics...

properties.name: TAIGA Tarifa Punta Paloma
properties.description:
Taïga Tarifa Punta Paloma is located in the most southern point of Spain. This campsite resort, with a view of the Strait of Gibraltar, is all about experiences. Here they do everything possible to provide a fully catered holiday. You would not expect so much luxury in the middle of the countryside!

Luxury in wood and canvas

At Taïga Tarifa Punta Paloma you can choose from six types of glamping accommodations to relax. Whichever glamping tent you choose, these wooden and canvas accommodations are beautiful. Your faithful four-footed friend is also welcome!

From 10 m2 to 45 m2, 2 persons or 4. All tents have comfortable beds and their own bathroom with a shower. Some tents have the toilet and washing facilities inside the tent while others have them in a separate area right next to your tent. This is not a problem, since these areas are also pleasant and require a security key. Charming small terraces and sitting areas have been created around the tents

Plenty to do

You don't have to leave the campsite for a refreshing swim. Relax in the beautifully landscaped swimming pool with a cascade, or enjoy a drink at the edge of the pool. Hungry? Pull up a chair in the campsite restaurant where, in addition to pizzas and varied children’s menus, you can also order tapas. Or choose a delicious dish and have it delivered to your accommodation!

Children have been considered here, too. They can have fun in the playground, on the fun mini golf course and on the playing field for football, basketball and tennis. All kinds of fun activities, workshops and entertainment are organised as well.

properties.name: Camping Homair Le Soleil de la Méditerranée
Camping Sandaya L'Escale Saint-Gilles
properties.description:
In the south of the beautiful department of Brittany, in the unspoiled region of Quimper, this campsite is right by the sea. Here, you can enjoy a wonderful camping holiday at the beach with numerous authentic fishing villages in the vicinity. Camping Sandaya L'Escale Saint-Gilles campsite is spacious and offers a numerous luxury rental accommodations. Here you can enjoy a beautifully landscaped pool and imagine yourself in the tropics thanks to the atmospheric planting. For a little extra relaxation, let yourself be pampered in the wellness area.

Enjoying the Brittany Riviera

The Camping Sandaya L'Escale Saint-Gilles campsite is located on the Brittany Riviera, a lovely place to stay. In this authentic region, you can enjoy beautiful, wide sandy beaches, charming villages, extraordinary landscapes and Breton cuisine. The campsite is within walking distance of the fishing village of Bénodet. From there, you can take the pedestrians' and cyclists' boat to the other side and visit the charming Sainte-Marine. This town has an idyllic marina located in a bay between the rocky coast and pine trees.

Relax with the luxury of Sandaya

At this well-maintained Sandaya campsite, you can enjoy a relaxing stay. On the one hand, because of the luxury rental accommodations, on the other hand, because of the wide range of facilities on the campsite. The campsite is clearly and neatly laid out. There is a brightly decorated sanitary block that is kept clean and tidy. For extra comfort, you can choose the new PREMIUM Green Square accommodations.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Port Manec'h
properties.description:
Camping Sandaya Port Manec’h is located in the south of the French department of Finistère. This area is beautiful because of the unspoilt coast, the turquoise-blue water and the greenery. This family campsite has many things for the entire family to do. There is a water park, entertainment for all ages and sports facilities. You needn't be bored for a moment around the campsite, since the beach is only 200 metres away. Brittany has plenty to offer for holidaymakers.

Luxury accommodations

At Camping Sandaya Port Manec’h, you stay in a luxury accommodation at the park. The chalets, tiny houses and cottages are reasonably far apart, giving you some space around your holiday home. All accommodations provide comfort, have their own toilet facilities and are pet-friendly. For parents with a baby, the chalets are equipped with handy essentials such as a baby bath, bottle-warmer and a barrier to enclose the terrace.

A guarantee for water fun!

You can keep cool during your holiday in the water park. Whiz down the water slides, relax in the Jacuzzi or join the aqua gym lessons to stay fit. A section of the swimming pool is covered, which means you can still go swimming on rainy days. The snack bar with a small menu is right next to the swimming pool. The beach on the Atlantic Ocean is only 200 metres away from the campsite. Just cross a quiet road to get to the beach. Activities for children aged five and older are organised daily at the park. There is an activities programme for adults as well.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Etoile d’Argens
properties.description:
Camping Sandaya Etoile d'Argens is in the heart of a Natura 2000-protected area, close to the Mediterranean. So, this five-star Var campsite is a great place for anyone looking for peace and quiet, nature and luxury. The campsite has several swimming pools and a short river shuttle takes you to a quiet sandy beach. Pleasant towns like Saint-Raphaël (7.5 km) and Fréjus (5.5 km) are close by too.

Shaded pitches and eco lodges

There’s lots of space to camp comfortably on the 16-hectare site. Choose from shaded pitches for your tent, motor home or caravan and luxury eco lodges and fully-equipped chalets and cottages. The fully-equipped rental accommodation is in a car-free area by the river.

Everything you need for a carefree holiday

Water fun, wellness and good food: it's all here. The aqua park has several pools, whirlpools and a separate area for little ones. Want to unwind? Head to the wellness area for massages and treatments. Then go to the restaurant for a Provençal meal or order a drink at the bar. Also handy: the campsite has a shop and bicycle rental.

Taste the atmosphere of southern France

Charming villages, fine sandy beaches, chic coastal towns and impressive nature: the Côte d'Azur has it all. Stroll through the old streets of Fréjus (5.5 km) or enjoy the views in Saint-Raphaël (7.5 km). For a lazy beach day, the beaches of Saint-Aygulf (6 km) are close by. Prefer to get out into nature? Go for a walk at Cap d'Estérel (18 km) or hop on a boat to the Îles d'Or.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Les Mathes
properties.description:
Camping Sandaya Les Mathes is in Charente-Maritime, in an area filled with pine trees. The vast sandy beaches of the Côte Sauvage are only four kilometres away. Les Mathes also has a large swimming pool complex that is good for days of fun swimming. Curious as to who your neighbours are? The campsite is very popular among families and couples.

Comfortable stay in attractive cottages

Although there are no pitches, you can choose from various comfortable rental accommodations, such as premium cottages with private hot tubs. The campsite has a total of 142 rental accommodations for four to six people. And pets? Pets are allowed.

Days of water fun and entertainment

With a water park that is 500 m² in size, including spectacular water slides, a paddling pool and a covered swimming pool, water fun is always possible, regardless of the weather. Sun loungers are set up around the pools, where you can enjoy a good book or a refreshing drink under a thatched parasol. Extra nice: if you stay at this campsite, you also have free access to the swimming pools of the adjacent campsite L’Estanquet.

Entertainment for the children is provided, allowing them to participate in workshops and activities. There is a fun cooking workshop, a science workshop or they can be a gardener for a day.

Explore the area surrounding Les Mathes

There is plenty to do in the area around the campsite. Visit the impressive La Palmyre zoo (6 km) or venture into the Indian Forest (900 m), a challenging tree-climbing park. For a day of culture, the island Île d’Oléron (20 km) is definitely recommended. If you feel like having a day at the beach, the vast sandy beaches of the Côte Sauvage are just around the corner.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Soustons Village
properties.description:
Camping Sandaya Soustons Village is near the town of Soustons in the Landes region (Aquitaine). This five-star resort is surrounded by the vast Forêt des Landes forest. It's the ideal place to rest and head off on beautiful walking and cycling trips. This car-free holiday park’s facilities include a spa, a heated water park, a varied entertainment programme, a restaurant and sports and games facilities.

Car-free site with many types of accommodation

Soustons Village is a holiday park with accommodation. So, traditional camping with your own camping equipment isn’t possible here. There are various luxury cottages, chalets and safari tents for 2 to 10 people. This resort is also completely car-free. In front of the reception, there’s a large central car park where you can park your car. The campsite does provide assistance when you arrive: a golf cart will take you, your travelling companions and your luggage to your accommodation. On site, you’ll enjoy peace and quiet and an extra safe play area for children.

Wonderful aqua park and entertainment

There’s a lot for families with children in particular to do at this holiday park. The wonderful water park alone guarantees many hours of enjoyment. This heated aqua park has an indoor and outdoor section and a wave pool, a spray park and a paddling pool. There’s also a spa with wellness facilities, including hot tubs, saunas, Turkish baths and a massage parlour. There’s also a varied entertainment programme for all ages. Children take part in games, treasure hunts, sports tournaments and mini-discos, for example. Evening entertainment is organised for adults too. Sit down for a delicious bite to eat at restaurant bar La Terrasse.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Les Vagues
properties.description:
Enjoy the good life in a real holiday environment on the coast of the Mediterranean Sea. You can do that at Camping Sandaya Les Vagues in Valras-Plage in the Southern French department of Hérault. This lively holiday park is only a few hundred metres from a large sandy beach and close to nice coastal resorts, including Vendres-Plage, Cap d’Agde and Valras-Plage itself. Furthermore, the campsite is surrounded by vast vineyards and lovely places such as Narbonne, Béziers and Gruissan are no more than a 30-minute drive away. At this internationally-oriented resort, a fabulous leisure pool and abundant entertainment programme ensure you never get bored.

Unique glamping experience

At Camping Sandaya Les Vagues, you can book a stay in various types of modern mobile homes, called cottages at this park. L’Ilot Robinson is probably the most beautiful part of this resort. Thanks to the fine sand, the hammocks, palm trees and the cottages nicely incorporated into the landscape, L’Ilot Robinson reminds you of a tropical holiday island. You can also continue the real glamping feeling at Playa del Sol, a new park area close to the beach.

Enjoy the lovely aqua park

The swimming pool at Camping Sandaya Les Vagues is undoubtedly one of the most beautiful campsite swimming pools in France. This leisure pool includes a wave pool, a playfully shaped recreational pool, three water slides, a paddling pool and a water playground where you can have fun playing and splashing about with fountains and water jets. Palm trees, bridges and many sun loungers complete the picture. A real beach is an option too as it is only 500 metres from the campsite.

properties.name: Village Vacances Sandaya Cap Sud
properties.description:
Village Vacances Sandaya Cap Sud is situated on the north-east coast of the French island of Corsica. Here, you’ll feel like you’re on holiday straight away, with the sun on your face and the beach within walking distance. The park is spacious and surrounded by greenery. During the day, you can enjoy the great outdoors while your children take part in activities or make new friends. Here, you can truly unwind and discover the beauty of Corsica.

Your ideal place for a stay

At Cap Sud, you can enjoy a stay just the way you like it. Bring your own tent or caravan to a lovely pitch under the trees. Or opt for extra comfort in a fully equipped bungalow. Everything is spacious and surrounded by greenery, giving you a real feeling of being in the heart of nature. One major plus point: the campsite is completely car-free. That means peace, plenty of space and, above all, lots of fun for the children. You can relax and read a book in front of your tent or on your terrace while they run around and make new friends.

Swimming, bubble baths and relaxation

Water lovers are in for a treat here. Swim a few laps in the heated pool or relax in the hot tub. Prefer the sea? You can walk straight to the beach from the campsite. Ideal for a refreshing dip or a long stroll along the beach. Fancy a bit of extra relaxation? Then visit the wellness facilities, book a massage or a beauty treatment and take a moment for yourself. Don’t feel like cooking? Then take a seat in the restaurant or grab a pizza or a quick bite at the snack bar.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Carnac
properties.description:
Camping Sandaya Carnac is in the French region of Brittany. This family campsite is in the municipality of Carnac.
