You will not be at all bored at the campsite thanks to the organised activities and the amenities. There is a large pool with water slides, a multifunctional playing field with organised sports tournaments and an extensive entertainment programme throughout the entire season. The activities accommodate campsite visitors of all ages, including teenagers.

Luxury camping holiday

Camping Sandaya Carnac only rents out accommodations. You stay in luxury mobile homes for two to eight people. The accommodations have all of the modern luxuries and their own bathroom. Your dog is welcome in almost all of the accommodations. If you are going on holiday with young children, rent a highchair and baby’s cot at the campsite.

Water park with slides

Hours of water fun in the huge water park that has several swimming pools with slides. You can even swim when it rains because part of the swimming pool has a roof. If you'd rather swim in the sea, the closest beach is less than ten minutes from the campsite by car. In the summer months, a free shuttle service runs from the campsite to the beach and the other tourist attractions in the city.

Taste Breton crêpes

Brittany is famous for several delicious local dishes. Did you know that crêpes come from this region? It is not without reason that you can order this French delicacy in the campsite restaurant.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Europa Village
properties.description:
Europa Camping is a very large campsite close to Venice, located on the Cavallino peninsula. An additional advantage is the possibility to visit Venice by boat from here. The focus of Europa Camping Village is clearly on families with children.

A comprehensive campsite

The Cavallino peninsula is in fact an elongated promontory which separates the Venetian lagoon from the Adriatic Sea. On the seaward side are mile-long sandy beaches. And this is what attracts tourists: everything revolves around mass tourism and beach holidays. You can, in fact, spend a splendid holiday at Europa Camping Village without even leaving the grounds.

Water fun park and wellness & beauty

The pitches on the campsite are not very spacious, but they are well-demarcated. Despite the crowdedness, the atmosphere is convivial and staff members are friendly. As the name ‘Camping Village’ suggests, rental accommodation is also available (bungalows and mobile homes). You can walk directly onto the beach from the campsite, but there is also a veritable water fun park on the grounds.

In addition, Europa Camping has a wellness centre. Classic entertainment (music, sports and games) for young and old is of course offered in high season with enough entertainers to ensure everything runs smoothly.

Good meals

The restaurant in contemporary design is highly recommended. They serve mostly classic dishes (pizzas, hamburgers, pasta, meat and fish). In addition, there is also a cafe for breakfast, coffee or an aperitif.

properties.name: Camping Yelloh! Village Domaine de l'Orée
Camping Yelloh! Village Le Village Western
Camping Yelloh! Village Domaine Les Ranchisses
properties.description:
In the French Ardèche department lies Camping Yelloh! Village Domaine Les Ranchisses, situated in a wooded area and on the banks of a small river. The campsite has two water parks and, during the high season, children have fun with an extensive entertainment programme and there is entertainment for the entire family. Nature lovers and active holidaymakers will enjoy it here as well. Monts d’Ardèche nature park is nearby and there are many outdoor sports activities to participate in, such as kayaking, mountain biking and hiking.

Pitches and accommodations

Camping Yelloh! Village Domaine Les Ranchisses is wooded and consists of various sections. A river runs through the grounds. You cannot swim here, but you can go canoeing or kayaking. You camp on grass and the pitches vary in size from 95 to 120 m2. Some pitches are right by the water. On the other side of a quiet road lies a section with mobile homes. This site consists of terraces on which the accommodations stand. All accommodations have a fully equipped kitchen, their own toilet and washing facilities and air conditioning. On the other side of the river is the hotel, which also belongs to the campsite.

Wellness centre and swimming pool

You will have hours of swimming fun in the large swimming pool complex with its several swimming pools and water slides. A part of the pools are outdoors, but there is also an indoor swimming pool. A great massage or a sauna session can be had at the wellness centre. Sports enthusiasts live it up with amenities such as a health club and a padel court.

properties.name: Camping Yelloh! Village Le Parc Sainte Brigitte
Camping Yelloh! Village Les Cascades
properties.description:
The friendly family campsite Les Cascades is located directly on the bank of the Cèze river. The name of the campsite is derived from the water falls ('les cascades') which you can see and reach directly from the campsite. The wooded region in which you are staying is called Vallée de la Cèze. Although very touristy these days, there are still numerous quiet spots to be found and the hilly landscape is as beautiful as ever. The campsite is in close proximity to the medieval town of La Roque-sur-Cèze.

Where is your pitch?

There are some eighty touring pitches and more than fifty rental accommodation units available on Camping Les Cascades. The terraces are beautifully laid out. The pitches are of virtually similar sizes (90-120 m2). The mobile homes are located in one row, with sufficient distance between them. This ensures the necessary privacy.

Everyone in the water!

The rectangular, heated swimming pool (128 m2) is located close to the entrance and is surrounded by a wide terrace (securely fenced) where you can soak up the sun on loungers. Directly behind this you will find the cosy restaurant terrace. A path and gate with electric lock (all guests are given a key) lead to the waterfalls. You can also swim in the river a bit further along, but this depends on the water level and the current. There are some private beaches here and there.

Eating in Italian style

The campsite is Italian-oriented, which is borne out by the number of Italian dishes on the menu of the excellent restaurant. The products all come directly from Italy. The supermarket is large, with, not surprisingly, an extensive range of Italian products.

properties.name: Camping Yelloh! Village Avignon Parc
properties.description:
The beautiful region of Vaucluse is known for its vineyards, castles, old Provencal towns and fragrant lavender fields. This means a holiday full of fun trips where culture and nature go hand in hand. Camping Avignon Parc is also a wonderful place to spend the whole day. The waterslide is a favourite with young children and the smallest campers have a great paddling pool to splash around in. But the Kids Club also ensures an unforgettable holiday every day.

Variety in beautiful pitches

The pitches on the slightly sloping site are arranged in a playful manner. In some places, you even have a view of the Mont Ventoux. There is much variety, both in size and in shelter. Walking across the site, you will also come across many beautiful glamping options. Good-looking mobile homes with a lovely covered terrace under hundred-year-old trees, for example.

Cooling down in style

The eye-catcher at the campsite is the small water park on the hill near the terrace. It is beautifully laid out and equipped with sun loungers and parasols. In addition to an outdoor lagoon, there is an indoor pool with a glass cover. In summer this is an additional outdoor pool, but in the other months it is just as pleasant to swim as the water is heated.

Crafts, face painting and sports

Are you going camping with children between the ages of five and twelve? Then they are guaranteed to have the time of their lives at this friendly campsite. A mini disco, craft clubs, face painting afternoons, sports competitions and pony rides. It is all organised with great pleasure in the high season.

properties.name: Camping Yelloh! Village Le Domaine de Louvarel
Camping Yelloh! Village Les Mouettes
properties.description:
Camping Les Mouettes is situated in the Breton department of Finistère. You can look forward to seeing stunning coastal towns, deeply incised rocky coastlines, bays, beaches and unique nature areas. All in all, plenty to do! However, the campsite itself also has a lot to offer. Enjoy the very extensive swimming complex, join in the entertainment and head for the restaurant for typical Breton dishes.

Camping with sea view

This is a vary large-sized campsite of no less than 34 acres. The camping pitches are spacious with an abundance of vegetation. The most beautiful pitches are found on the flat portion of the campsite. 

In addition to more than one hundred touring pitches, there are almost three hundred luxury accommodation units (chalets, mobile homes and cottages). These are located in various quarters, each with their own character. Most of the accommodation units have a sea view. Some cottages have a private spa.

Water fun for the entire family!

The hub of the campsite is the luxury swimming paradise, complete with covered section, spectacular slides and a water playground for the little ones. The colourful complex is attractively designed with surrounding palm trees and plants. There is also a wellness and relaxation area with whirlpool bath and sauna.

Entertainment throughout the day

A varied entertainment programme is offered during the day. Children are kept busy with arts and crafts, sports, treasure hunts, dancing and much more. There is also a mini bioscope. In the evenings, young and old can enjoy performances: live music, dance shows or performances by an illusionist. In consideration of the night's rest of all guests, this entertainment always ends before midnight. 

Sports enthusiasts can indulge in aqua-gym, soccer, basketball, jogging and horse riding. There is also a multi-sports field.

properties.name: Camping Yelloh! Village Le Pré Lombard
Camping Yelloh! Village Le Castel Rose
properties.description:
In the south of France, this beautiful campsite is situated near a beach. With the small village of Anduze within walking distance and many attractions nearby, families enjoy a water park, a good restaurant and a creative children's club.

Surrounded by woodland, the child-friendly 4-star campsite Le Castel Rose - Ciela Village is located in the heart of the Gard department. You camp here on spacious pitches or in beautiful glamping accommodations directly on the green banks of the river Gardon. There is a lot for everyone to enjoy. From early morning to late evening, you can enjoy the water fun in the swimming pools, floating on an air mattress in the river, joining in with fun games or climbing around in the large playground. For the adults there is even a luxurious jacuzzi, sauna and hammam.

Camping in the Gard

The campsite is conveniently located and easily accessible from the Autoroute du Soleil in the direction of Montpellier. Once near Anduze, which is only 1.5 km away, follow the signs. The last part coming from the D907 is quite narrow. You arrive in style at the characteristic reception building on the ground floor.

View of the river

Walking across the long stretched campsite, you come across different types of pitch. At the back you will find the most peaceful and there is little traffic. Everyone wants a pitches right by the river, but from the other pitches you can also reach the water quickly. The four sanitary blocks are partly renewed and heated, but you can also book private sanitary facilities.

properties.name: Camping Yelloh! Village La Grange de Monteillac
Camping Yelloh! Village Mas Sant Josep
properties.description:
The Mas St. Josep campsite is conveniently located in the Aro valley between the mountains and the Costa Brava. The area in the versatile region of Catalonia is characterised by a green landscape full of cork trees, beautiful beaches and historic cities. The campsite is well-maintained and the golden yellow beaches of Playa d'Aro are accessible by bicycle.

Pleasant camping

The campsite is clearly arranged and consists of several sections divided by straight paths. The large pitches are partly paved and separated. Pleasant shade is provided by the many trees on the property. The bungalows and mobile homes where you can stay overnight are comfortably furnished.

Swimming paradise

There is a huge swimming pool in the centre of the campsite. Around it are comfortable sunbeds and a sunbathing area. The palm trees provide some shade and a tropical touch. The small children's pool deserves special mention. Colourful playground equipment ensures all-day water fun. There is always a lifeguard present.

Grab a bite

The on-site restaurant overlooks the pool and offers a small menu. The covered terrace is a nice place to relax from a day at the beach while enjoying a drink. The restaurant is also attractively decorated inside. A wide range of groceries are available in the supermarket.

Entertainment for all

In the summer months there is daily entertainment on the programme. At the Kids' Club, the youngest children can craft and colour to their heart's content. Teenagers can participate in musical performances, treasure hunts, table tennis tournaments and grooving in the mini disco to the latest summer hits.

properties.name: Camping Yelloh! Village Les Bois du Châtelas
properties.description:
Camping Les Bois du Châtelas is in the natural green, mountainous French department of Drôme. It is a medium-sized family campsite with plenty of activities for the whole family. Play in the water playground, splash in the indoor or outdoor swimming pool, exercise in the gym or sing along during an organised karaoke evening. You won't get bored at this campsite.

Camping in a forested area

The campsite is in a mountainous, forested area. You have stunning views of the surrounding mountains from your pitch or accommodation. You can stay there in your own camping equipment or hire a luxury accommodation.

Fun in the water in the Drôme

Water fun is guaranteed at camping Les Bois du Châtelas. The outdoor swimming pool is no less than 1,000 m2 in size and there is plenty to do. The youngest campsite guests can splash about in the paddling pool, there is a large water playground and older children can whizz down the slide. And when it's raining, guests can swim in the indoor swimming pool. You can relax in the sauna, the hot tub or on one of the many sun loungers on the sunny patio.

No time to get bored

In the high season, the entertainment team organises activities for the whole family. Creative activities such as face painting and crafting. Sporting activities such as sports tournaments and treasure hunts. Party evenings and shows are also organised for young and old. Moreover, there are enough amenities for you to do sport. Use the multi-sports grounds, the outdoor gym equipment and the fitness room. So you can even keep nice and active during your holiday.

properties.name: Camping Yelloh! Village Le Pré Catalan
Camping Yelloh! Village Nature et Rivière
Camping Yelloh! Village Les Sirènes
properties.description:
Camping Yelloh! Village Les Sirènes is a campsite in Saint-Jean-de-Monts, on the Atlantic coast of France. The campsite is in a wooded area, between the city and the sea. With the sea, a swimming pool, charming town and various on-site activities, there is something for everyone here.

Natural setting

The campsite is well-maintained, natural and with little demarcation. Campsite pitches of 90 to 150 m² are available. This is a great area for a holiday, even if you don't have your own camping equipment. Hire one of the beautiful mobile homes or bungalows. Families with children come here in the high season, seniors in the low season.

Water fun for everyone

Located on a sandy beach, there is water fun for everyone. You can go for a refreshing swim in the Atlantic Ocean. It is very safe for children, because there are no sea currents. Rather stay at the campsite? Then jump into one of the two heated swimming pools. There's even a special pool for toddlers.

So much to do

The campsite has a snack bar and bakery where you can get fresh bread in July and August. Entertainment is also provided. The campsite also has sports field, a pétanque court and table tennis. There's fun for young and old.

There are also shops, restaurants, a market and a nightclub within a 20-minute walk. The surrounding grounds also offer water sports and a day of golf. Fancy a trip? The islands of Yeu and Noirmoutier and the port city of Saint-Gilles-Croix-de-Vie are definitely worth a visit!

properties.name: Camping Yelloh! Village Le Bout du Monde
Camping Yelloh Village Au Lac de Biscarrosse
properties.description:
This campsite is located right next to Lake Biscarrosse, one of Aquitaine's major recreational lakes. In addition, the long sandy beaches on the Bay of Biscay are less than ten kilometres away. Camping Au Lac de Biscarrosse is therefore an ideal base for water sports enthusiasts. You can go pedal boating, canoeing, kayaking, surfing, sailing and supping, all in the immediate vicinity. You can also enjoy hiking in this region, for example in the extensive pine forests near the coast. This five-star campsite offers a beautiful water park, a luxurious wellness centre and many fun activities in high season.

Three beautiful camping fields with spacious touring pitches

This campsite's tourist camping pitches can be found on three well-kept fields spread over the site. Here you'll be camping on spacious pitches where trees and shrubs create plenty of shady spots. You will also have the privacy you require here. This campsite also offers mobile homes for rent.

Lavish water park with spectacular water slides

You are guaranteed to have fun in the water here. For example, in the spacious, playfully landscaped outdoor pool. Adjacent to this is a large paddling pool with a fun water playground. And as if that wasn't enough, there is also a separate swimming pool with a retractable roof. The water in all these pools is heated. In addition, there are several spectacular water slides, including a family slide.

Completely unwind in the wellness centre

L'Escapade Bien-Être is located right next to the water park. This is a wellness centre where you can choose a massage or beauty treatment. Of course you can also visit the sauna or hammam independently.

properties.name: Camping Yelloh! Village Domaine de Drancourt
Camping Yelloh! Village La Plage
properties.description:
Camping Yelloh! Village La Plage is situated in the Finistère, a department in Brittany. Enjoy the beaches, the sea, the rugged nature and charming seaside towns in this coastal region. However, for a top holiday there is actually no need to leave the four star campsite La Plage at all. With entertainment for all ages, a swimming complex, sports fields, wellness facilities and various catering establishments (restaurant, pizzeria, bar) each and every camper will undoubtedly enjoy a wonderful holiday.

Luxurious camping and various types of accommodation

This campsite can accommodate any type of camping equipment. Set up your tent, trailer tent or motorhome on a pitch of at least 80 m2. A premium pitch offers you at least 150 m2 of space. This will give you the luxury of garden furniture, a gazebo, a barbecue and WiFi. 

The rental accommodation is completely separated from the touring pitches. The 250 rental accommodation units of Campsite Yelloh! Village La Plage vary widely. Cottages, tents and tree huts (with sea view) can house two to seven persons.

Water fun on the campsite and in the sea

This campsite is located by the sea. As a result, you have immediate access to a vast sandy beach (Plage du Ster). In addition to sunbathing, paddling and swimming, you can engage in plenty of water sports in this coastal region. Not just fishing or canoeing, but also more adventurous activities such as windsurfing, waterskiing, diving and sailing. 

Not a seawater fan? If so, dive into the heated swimming pool (200 m2) on the campsite. There is also a separate toddler pool. The slides and play equipment provide lots of fun for children.

properties.name: Camping Yelloh! Village Les Voiles d'Anjou
properties.description:
Camping Yelloh! Village Les Voiles d'Anjou is a family campsite near Les Rosiers-sur-Loire, a village on the banks of the Loire. Here you camp in one of the various rental properties or on a delimited touring pitch in the shade. There’s plenty to do for children on the campsite: they can swim in the indoor and outdoor pools, while in summer craft hours and sports competitions are organised.

Pitch with privacy

From the road you can already have a look at the campsite. The site is well organized: spacious touring pitches are shaded by trees and delimited by well-kept hedges. This gives you a lot of privacy and a quiet camping spot. Different types of cottages and mobile homes, as well as lodge tents and gypsy caravans complete the offer of camping possibilities.

Family camping for children and parents

Les Voiles d'Anjou is a real family campsite. Especially the various rental accommodations are occupied in high season by families from all over Europe. In summer lot is organized for children on the campsite. They can take part in a sports competition, all kinds of outdoor games and craft activities. In the meantime, parents can completely relax in the campsite's wellness centre.

Indoor and outdoor pool

The swimming pools are also popular with smaller camping guests. Slightly to the side of the campsite, behind the reception building, there are two swimming pools. One of them is covered. The outdoor swimming pool is large and suitable for children. The indoor pool is smaller but also a bit deeper. Parents can choose a sun lounger at the edge of the pool.

properties.name: Camping Yelloh! Village Parc du Val de Loire
Camping Yelloh! Village La Roche-Posay
properties.description:
La Roche-Posay Vacances is a 5 star family-run campsite in La Roche-Posay, in the Vienne department of Nouvelle-Aquitaine and a stone’s throw from the Loire Valley. Bustling tourist town and renowned thermal spa town, La Roche-Posay offers lots of services: a bakery, a butchers, a race course, a newsagents, a pharmacy, a golf course, a casino, a supermarket, a spa and bars and restaurants.

On the banks of the river Creuse, the campsite offers spacious camping pitches, in the sun or the shade, as well as 1, 2 or 3-bedroom mobile home cottages for hire.

On-site, discover a waterpark comprised of a covered and heated pool, an outside pool with water slide and bubble baths, and a fun paddling pool for the kids. For sporty holidaymakers, the campsite offers many trails to discover on foot or by bike, as well as canoe trips on the river. In summer, there's a mini club for younger children! Activities include crafts, treasure hunts, sports... and a mini disco. Older children also have plenty to choose from: hiking and jogging, yoga and aquafun, sports tournaments... and the whole family is invited to evening entertainment: concerts, theme nights, shows and much more!

The campsite offers a snack bar and a small restaurant. In the morning, you can purchase fresh bread. You can also use the internet, as the campsite offers WiFi access throughout the entire site. Other on-site services include a brand new fitness room, a launderette, a new playground area for kids and bike rental.

Between the Nouvelle-Aquitaine region and the Loire Valley, the campsite is located in a region full of things to do. The campsite is close to Futuroscope theme Park and Beauval Zoo. For history lovers, the campsite is near to many of the impressive Loire valley castles and charming villages. And for a breath of nature, La Brenne Nature Parc is only a stone’s throw away.

properties.name: Capfun Camping Lac des Trois Vallées
Camping Yelloh! Village La Petite Camargue
Camping Yelloh! Village Alfacs
properties.description:
Camping Alfacs is located to the south of Ebrodelta, right on the coast of Sant Carles de la Ràpita, a prosperous town with a large harbour for fishing boats, sailing ships and luxury yachts. The campsite features a small beach and a rocky coast. The camping pitches at Alfacs are located close to the sea and have plenty of shade thanks to the many trees.

Accommodation for all

In addition to the shaded camping pitches (all with electricity connections), the campsite features a range of different accommodation types. The apartments, which feature a direct view of the sea, are very popular. They are available in three sizes and are suitable for three to seven persons. They have one or two bedrooms, a kitchen, a shower/toilet and a terrace or balcony.

There are some bungalows on the site for up to five people. They feature a kitchen and bathroom, and some feature air conditioning. Free WiFi is available on the campsite.

Sports centre within walking distance

Guests of the campsite have free access to the Serramar sports centre, less than two hundred metres from the campsite. This is where you can use the football pitch and the tennis and padel courts (a racket game that is similar to tennis and squash). Rackets can be hired at no cost from reception.

The use of the swimming pools is included in the cost of the bungalows. If you are camping or staying in one of the apartments, an additional cost of one euro per person per day applies.

Clean sanitary facilities

The sanitary facilities are typically Spanish and are not luxurious. However, the staff do everything they can to keep everything clean.

properties.name: Camping Yelloh! Village l'Etoile des Neiges
Camping Le Chaponnet
properties.description:
Le Chaponnet is a four-star campsite on the French coast in the Vendée department. The campsite is located close to the beach at the heart of a small village. The surroundings offer plenty of activities including cycling and hiking, and the campsite itself offers plenty in terms of sport and relaxation. Le Chaponnet is at the centre of Brem-sur-Mer, a village just two kilometres from the sandy beaches of the Atlantic coast. You can drive there in your car or cycle, and in July and August there is a free shuttle bus from the campsite.

Wooden tents

On the campsite, you have a choice of camping pitches or the option of holidaying in colourful mobile homes or wooden tepees. The tepees are ideal for passing cyclists looking for a stop-off on their trips across the country.

Cyclists and bathers

The campsite is perfect for cyclists. Bikes can be hired from the campsite itself, and the surroundings are great for bike rides. The campsite is also great for beach lovers, water enthusiasts and those just looking for some relaxation.

The campsite has both an indoor and outdoor swimming pool, the latter has two large slides and more are planned! You can also take a refreshing dip in the ocean, or sun yourself on the beach. You can have your feet in the sand in less than ten minutes!

properties.name: Camping Yelloh! Village Le Jard
properties.description:
Camping Yelloh! Village Le Jard is located near the charming resort of La Tranche-sur-Mer, with many restaurants, shops and a market every day. It is a large campground in a green environment. Most of the sites are spacious enough for a car and caravan. They are on grass and are located among the trees, with and without shade. There is electricity everywhere and there are comfort campsites with water and sewer. The sanitation on the campground is new and usually very clean and well maintained, there are sufficient toilets (with toilet paper!) and showers.

Camping Le Jard attracts many nationalities: mainly French, but also English, Dutch, Belgians and Germans. This is a family campground with a varied public: families with teenagers (many activities and music at the pool), young couples and seniors.

Go to the swimming pool or the sea

The campground has a heated indoor/outdoor pool with two water slides and a separate kiddie pool with a nice little slide. The swimming pool is in the direct sunlight, with space to sunbathe in sturdy lounge chairs around the pool. From the campground you can cross the road and walk 600 metres on an asphalt road to a lovely sandy beach.

Activities for all ages

There are many activities organised on the campground, such as crafts, creative workshops, games, ball pit for children up to 5 years. There is aquagym in the pool every day, and in the evening there are spectacles such as magic shows, disco, karaoke and concerts. There is a mini-supermarket with a broad selection of groceries and other basic products.

properties.name: Camping Yelloh! Village Eurosol
properties.description:
The Landes department in southwestern France has everything for an unforgettable camping vacation. Come enjoy that at Camping Eurosol, located near the seaside town of Saint-Girons Plage. Here you will find yourself among countless pine and fir trees, in the middle of nature. Ideal for enjoyable cycling. Or rent a surfboard to brave the waves.

Beautiful pitches

The entire site looks manicured. The front is a bit busier than the back. Under the pine trees, there are plenty of fine shaded areas. For your own tent, caravan or motorhome, there are several pitches, but they are not equally flat everywhere. Those who like to camp with a little more luxury will find lodges and tents.

Water paradise

Reading a book on one of the sunbeds under a palm tree, while the kids have fun in one of the pools? Now that's a vacation! At the attractively landscaped pool complex, everyone can have fun from morning to night.

Cocktails, snacks and local dishes

After a wonderful day of vacation at the campsite or outside, it is good to relax on the large and cozy terrace. Both local delicacies and international dishes are prepared with care. Or sip a refreshing cocktail at the bar.

Sports grounds, playgrounds and more

Camping Eurosol is fully equipped for a carefree vacation. For example, you can make an appointment at the hairdresser's and there is a library to borrow a magazine or book. For young people up to about seventeen, there is a fun entertainment program throughout the day. The three playgrounds feature slides, swings and climbing equipment. In high season, there is also a trampoline and bouncy castle.

properties.name: Camping Yelloh! Village Domaine des Chênes Verts
Camping Yelloh! Village Les Grands Pins
Camping Yelloh! Village Saint - Émilion
properties.description:
Close to Saint-Emilion, in the midst of the vineyards and wine estates, you'll find Camping Saint-Emilion, a picture perfect example of the French style of living. The campsite is located in the midst of the vine-covered hills. The campsite is only three kilometres from the town of Saint-Emilion, and is on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

Lush green campsite

After the barrier, you'll enter a spacious courtyard with a wine press fountain. Here you'll find the reception. Via well maintained roads among the greenery you'll find your pitch. These are separated and have plenty of space. You have a choice between sunny and shady pitches.

Camping on a lake

The camping has a broad choice of rental accommodations (chalets, holiday cottages and mobile homes). There is even a floating cottage in the lake at the campsite! The accommodations are suitable for two to six people and there are various price classes.

Swimming paradise with sun and shade

The pearl of the campsite is without a doubt the large heated 120 m2 swimming pool. Kids love the high, covered slide and a large heated wading pool of 80 m2. The swimming pool is in the full sun, but there are more than enough loungers with parasols where you can enjoy the shade.

Restaurant and shop

The campsite has a modern restaurant with a small menu and a charming terrace in the shade or in the sun. The menu has traditional snacks and pizzas, but also some regional dishes.

properties.name: Camping Yelloh! Village Le Pré Bas
Camping Yelloh! Village Colina do Sol
Camping Yelloh! Village Panorama du Pyla
First Camp Lakolk Strand-Rømø
properties.description:
First Camp Lakolk Strand is located on the Danish island of Rømø, close to the border with Germany. The widest sandy beach in Europe starts next to the campsite. From this beach you can swim in the North Sea and take part in various watersports activities.

This campsite is also an ideal base for a wonderful cycling holiday. You can go on a variety of long bike rides through this peaceful island's vast dune landscapes. This campsite is visited by many families with children during high season. There are numerous play areas for children.

Neat grass pitches

You'll enjoy camping on neat grass pitches at this spacious campsite. In addition to touring pitches, Lakolk Strand offers numerous permanent annual pitches. There are also some charming hikers' cabins for rent.

Wide beaches

The wide beaches of Rømø begin behind the campsite. You can fly kites and go blokarting (sand yachting) here. Of course, you can also enjoy swimming, kite surfing, windsurfing or sailing in the waters of the North Sea.

Restaurants right at your doorstep

Directly in front of the campsite is a cosy street with a few restaurants, a café, a few cafeterias and various shops. There is also a large supermarket where you can get all your daily groceries.

Modern sanitary facilities

The sanitary facilities are exactly what you would expect from a campsite belonging to Scandinavia's largest camping chain: modern, high quality and well maintained.

Pedal cars and bicycles

At this campsite you can rent fun pedal cars to explore the immediate vicinity and the beaches. If you want to go a little further, it is best to go by bike.

properties.name: First Camp Gränna
properties.description:
Close to the harbour of Gränna, on the shore of the Vättern Lake, you will find this friendly family campsite. You are staying here on a spaciously laid out campsite or in one of those typical Swedish holiday cottages. Although the campsite is fairly bare and has no demarcations between the spacious pitches, you will feel at home instantaneously. Just outside the campsite, the ferry departs for the beautiful island of Visingsö, an eminently suitable destination for a day trip on your bicycle.

Trekker hut or holiday cottage

The campsite, like many other Swedish campsites, has a fairly large number of trekker huts and holiday cottages. The former are quite basic with only cold running water, a basic kitchenette (with microwave) and communal sanitary facilities. The holiday cottages have a TV, a better equipped kitchen, hot and cold water and a private shower and toilet. In addition, there is a luxury holiday cottage. It is advisable to book a trekker hut/holiday cottage well in advance in the peak season.

Castle on an island

As mentioned above, Gränna is very popular, especially among Swedes. There are several reasons for this. First of all, the proximity of the island of Visingsö, in the middle of Lake Vättern. Here you can visit the ruins of the sixteenth-century Visingsborg castle, the former residency of the noble Brahe family.

Candy canes in all colours

The candy cane (polkagris in Swedish) is the second reason for Gränna's popularity. In 1859 Amalia Eriksson started with the production of these candy canes. This was such a hit that many others followed her. These days, you can buy candy canes on virtually each street corner in all kinds of shapes, sizes and colours.

properties.name: First Camp City-Stockholm
properties.description:
If you are travelling through Sweden and want to explore Stockholm from a campsite, First Camp City-Stockholm is your ideal starting point. Take the bus or bike to this vibrant city and enjoy the sunset over the lake in peace and quiet in the evening at the campsite. This campsite is also a great choice for a longer stay filled with water activities, culture and countryside.

Central, yet quiet

First Camp City-Stockholm is beautifully tucked away between the forests, close to the town of Älta. Here, you are in a central location and yet far away from traffic noise and urban bustle. You will be warmly welcomed at reception, after which you can go to your camping pitch or house. With roughly 120 camping pitches and 12 holiday homes, the campsite is relatively small scale.

Jump into the lake

The campsite is by a lovely lake where you can enjoy swimming in the summer. A path through the woods take you to a swimming pool with a sandy beach and jetties. Or try your luck fishing. Enjoy a beautiful sunset over the water in the evening. Now that's what we call a holiday!

By bike to Stockholm

If you would like to visit Stockholm, you have various options. A bus stops close to the campsite and it will take you to the centre in a 30 minutes. But going on a bike is also a nice option. It's about a 15-kilometre cycle to the centre and the route is almost entirely on safe cycle paths.

properties.name: First Camp Sibbarp-Malmö
properties.description:
With its lovely city parks, compact centre and diverse architecture, Malmö is one of Sweden's most beautiful cities. Would you like to visit Malmö while also spending the night in a serene and quiet spot? Then First Camp Sibbarp-Malmö is the place for you! This campsite is located right on the beach, seven kilometres from the centre. Various spots across the campsite offer views over the imposing Öresund Bridge, which connects Denmark with Sweden. Thanks to its location near this bridge, this campsite is popular with campers who are just passing through. It is also popular with families during high season.

Book in advance and choose your own spot

First Camp Sibbarp-Malmö is a large campsite with a calm, friendly atmosphere. It mainly features tourist camping pitches. These include many options. There are sunny and shady spots, and the sizes of the touring pitches vary considerably. If you book in advance, you can choose your own spot. In addition to regular camping pitches, there are also rental accommodations, including bungalows and hikers' cabins.

Taste of Swedish beach life

There is a sandy beach next to the campsite. This beach is located in a small bay, so you can safely enter the water. There are also other nice beaches in the area. These include the Klagshamnsstranden, which are located in a green setting just south of Malmö. And if you drive about six kilometres to the northeast, you'll end up at the Ribersborgsstranden. Here you'll find a beautiful outdoor pool at the beach.

properties.name: First Camp Kolmården-Norrköping
properties.description:
At this campsite you'll be camping in the southern Swedish region of Östergötland. It is close to the large forest area of Kolmården and directly on the Bråviken Bay, which is connected to the Baltic Sea. First Camp Kolmården-Norrköping is located in a beautiful area with plenty to experience. For example, the largest zoo in Europe is less than 5 kilometres away from the campsite. You won't be bored for a second, whether on or off the campsite. Just enjoy your holiday.

Swimming in the sea

First Camp Kolmården-Norrköping is a large family campsite with both camping pitches and rental accommodations. You can enjoy a holiday in a luxuriously furnished wooden house. The campsite has a small harbour and a beach with a jetty where you can swim. For groceries, you can go to the campsite shop, which features a wide range of foodstuffs, toys and swimming gear.

Sports at the campsite

Campers can use the volleyball court throughout the season. You can also rent bicycles to explore the area. There is also an adventure mini golf course and a playground right next to the sea-view terrace.

Zoo day

Kolmården Wildlife Park is one of Sweden's largest zoos. While staying at First Camp Kolmården-Norrköping, a visit to the park should not be missed because it is practically around the corner. The zoo extends over 1.5 square kilometres and is home to more than 600 different animal species. There are numerous attractions in this wildlife park that distinguish it from many others.

properties.name: First Camp Edsvik-Grebbestad
properties.description:
First Camp Edsvik-Grebbestad is the ideal destination for adventurous families. Here, you camp in the enchanting landscape of the Southern Swedish region of Bohuslän. With the beach, sea and a nature reserve on your doorstep, this is a wonderful holiday address for nature lovers of all ages. Here, all you will want to do is go swimming, fishing and enjoy the calming surroundings.

Camping pitches with sea views

This campsite has spacious camping pitches in open and natural green surroundings. Although the pitches may have slightly less privacy than some would wish, there is something for everyone with camping pitches of various dimensions. The best pitches are right by the sea.

The campsite also offers the option to sleep in an authentic Swedish stuga. These traditional Swedish houses are cosy and comfortable and enable you to experience a unique camping experience amid the countryside.

Family holiday in Sweden

This campsite is the perfect starting point for a family holiday in Sweden. A path runs from the campsite to a child-friendly beach. At the campsite, children will soon make friends at the children's club, in the playground, on the bouncy castle or during a game of miniature golf.

Adventure in Grebbestad

The highpoint of your stay at First Camp Edsvik-Grebbestad will undoubtedly be exploring the surrounding nature reserve. Put on your walking boots, jump on a bike or step into a canoe and go on an adventure. The town of Grebbestad is only 2.5 kilometres from the campsite and it offers a variety of excursions. Go on a boat trip, discover the underwater world on a diving adventure or explore the coastline in a kayak.

properties.name: hu Firenze camping in Town
properties.description:
Firenze Camping In Town is located just outside the centre of Florence. This modern campsite is the perfect base for visiting the Italian city of art (located at a 15-minute bike ride away). The campsite has all the luxury you could want. The swimming pool and lagoon pool will keep you cool. In the modern restaurant, you can eat your fill of pizza.

Modern and luxurious campsite

The pitches are not spacious, but they do look immaculate. They have a nice grassy surface, are well laid out and neatly delimited. Do you really want to camp in luxury? Then choose one of the many safari tents, chalets or mobile homes.

Quiet city campsite with two swimming pools

The location of Firenze Camping In Town is perhaps its greatest asset. You are right next to the centre of Florence. And yet you'll be camping far from the hustle and bustle of city life. But that is not the only luxury you have at this city campsite. You can splash around in a lovely pool! Swim a few lengths for a fresh start to your day. Or cool down after a long day in Florence. The adjacent lagoon pool is a great place for children to play.

A fresh pizza and Chianti wine

Right next to the pool is the restaurant. In this modern building, you can enjoy a refreshing drink. Or perhaps the children would like a real Italian ice cream. But this is also the place to be if you want to linger at the table. With a fresh pizza on your plate, you can eat yourself to the bone here. Add a Chianti wine and it is perfect.

properties.name: hu Roma Camping in Town
properties.description:
Feel like soaking up some culture in beautiful Rome? The city campsite hu Roma Camping in Town is an excellent base from which to do this. You'll be camping just 5 kilometres from the Vatican City. Before you explore the Italian capital, you can take a refreshing morning dip in the campsite's swimming pool. Tired but satisfied, you'll return to the city campsite after a long day of sightseeing and end your day at the cosy restaurant & bar. You can also enjoy the pool table, table tennis and a basketball court.

Camping on a large city campsite

Hu Roma Camping in Town is a large campsite comprised mainly of rental accommodations. There are various mobile homes for rent, from simply equipped to more luxurious models. The camping pitches are located at the front of the campsite.

The sanitary facilities are clean and tidy. There are also sanitary facilities for people with disabilities.

Relax by the pool

The rectangular swimming pool, where you can go for a nice refreshing dip, is located at the centre of the campsite. There are also two whirlpools where you can relax and unwind. The pool and hot tubs are open daily from May to October.

Italian food

Fancy a tasty Italian pasta or pizza after a long day out and about? Then you can go to the campsite's restaurant. Between swims, you can order a refreshing drink or cocktail at the cosy pool bar.

properties.name: Thorsminde Camping
properties.description:
Kite surfers, fishers and nature lovers take note! If you would like to explore the open coast of West Jutland in Denmark from a well-equipped campsite, then Thorsminde camping, about 40 kilometres north of Ringkøbing, is an ideal destination. When you arrive, do not be surprised if you see large kites flying above the campsite. Beginner and experienced kitesurfers have the time of their lives on the water of Nissum Fjord. There are facilities for everyone here. From a kitesurf school to a creativity corner, from a barbecue area to a dog training field.

Open camping site close to the water

Thormsminde Camping is on a headland with the North Sea on one side and Nissum Fjord on the other. There is one main road through the campsite with pitches on both sides. You stay on a fairly open site where tall vegetation is scarce. The campsite has camping pitches close to and a little further from the fjord. There are also special motorhome pitches and several huts, including a small cabin without toilet facilities and larger huts for families.

Pool and children’s activities

At the campsite entrance is a heated indoor pool with a slide and a sauna. Wonderful for a somewhat cooler day. For the young campsite guests there are many fun places to meet up: the playground with trampolines, recreational areas with games and, of course, the kitesurfing school.

Water sports Valhalla

Nissum Fjord is a favourite location for water sports enthusiasts. The water is usually not that rough, is shallow and has no rocks, allowing you to safely sail, standup paddleboard and canoe. And, of course, kitesurfing – a hobby that lures many campsite visitors to this place!

properties.name: Drejby Strand Camping
properties.description:
Welcome to Drejby Strand Camping, right on the Danish coast. Here, you’re just a stone’s throw from the water, with sea views and a constant refreshing sea breeze. It’s a lovely family-friendly campsite situated next to a large, shallow lagoon. Your days here will be all about having fun in the water and enjoying the fresh sea air. Or explore the region via the many walking and cycling trails!

Camping pitches and accommodation units

The pitches at Drejby Strand Camping are just as varied as the surrounding area. You can choose a sheltered spot surrounded by greenery or a spacious pitch with a sea view. There are all sorts of lovely spots for your tent, caravan or motorhome. The campsite is clearly laid out and easily accessible. Prefer a bit more comfort during your holiday? Then the modern accommodation options are a great choice.

Swimming pool, spa and restaurant

There is plenty to do at the campsite for both young and old. The heated swimming pool is a popular spot, but please check whether it is open during the low season. After an active day, head over to the restaurant for a good meal without having to cook yourself. Those who truly want to relax can visit the campsite’s spa. A lovely place to unwind and enjoy a relaxing end to the day.

Explore the area surrounding Sydjylland

The Sydjylland region is known for its diverse landscape and well-maintained cycling and walking routes along the coast. The surrounding area is dotted with charming villages where you can experience Danish culture. Nature lovers will also find plenty to enjoy here.

properties.name: Hummingen Camping
properties.description:
Hummingen Camping is on the Danish island Lolland. The beach on the Baltic Sea is only 800 metres away. This wide sandy beach guarantees hours of pleasure in and around the sea. This campsite is the perfect spot for a comfortable family holiday on the Danish coast. Lolland has everything to offer, the highlight being the largest safari park in northern Europe. But everything you need to relax completely is at the campsite as well.

Attractive wooden chalets

Camping is done on the grass at this medium-sized campsite. The pitches are spacious and not demarcated. If you don’t have your own camping equipment, choose one of the attractive wooden chalets at the campsite. They are not extremely luxurious but are attractive and have all the modern conveniences. The campsite has a small campsite shop where you can purchase fresh rolls daily. Not in the mood to cook? Visit the campsite restaurant, which has a small menu.

Heated outdoor swimming pool

Children have hours of fun in the playground with climbing frames, table-tennis table, bouncy castle and go-kart track for small children. There is also plenty of room for playing football, badminton or other campsite games. Go for a swim in the heated outdoor swimming pool with slides, wading pool and Jacuzzi. The water is heated using solar panels.

Explore Lolland

Lolland-Falster island has 600 kilometres of coastline. On the island, the landscape alternates between sandy beaches, wooded areas, picturesque harbours and charming towns. Go fishing, hiking, kayaking, surfing, cycling, horseback riding and explore the smaller islands Fejø, Femø, Vejrø and Askø-Lilleø.

properties.name: hu I Pini Village
properties.description:
Camping hu I Pini Village is a family campsite about thirty kilometres north of Rome. You camp on a sloping campsite on the edge of a pine forest. Everything is dedicated to young campers. There are special Hello Kitty cottages in which you can stay, and the children's sanitary facilities have been expanded. A beautiful lagoon pool offers safe water fun for the little ones, and the entertainment programme for children is extensive. A campsite shuttle bus will take you to Rome within an hour.

Family camping for the whole family

The name of the campsite tells it all: hu I Pini Village is a campsite for the whole family. The family campsite excels especially in child friendliness. Everything is designed with younger campers in mind. This is reflected in the campsite's guests, especially in high season. Then it's mainly families with children who find a nice camping destination in this campsite near Rome.

Lagoon pool for the little ones

Like everything else, the swimming pools are designed for younger guests. Especially the lagoon pool is a beautiful water playground for the little ones. The water in this pool is very shallow, so even the youngest water lovers can swim safely here. The lagoon pool is beautifully designed with a small hill with a tunnel in the centre, and a wide slide on the side. There is also a slightly deeper, rectangular pool, with a simple paddling pool next to it. Around the pools there is plenty of space for sunbathing. There are plenty of sun loungers, of which there are always some free.

properties.name: Himmerland Camping
properties.description:
Himmerland Camping is situated in the lush countryside of Festhimmerland in Denmark. This modestly sized, peaceful campsite is a lovely spot for campers who love nature and tranquillity. You will stay in well-maintained grounds with spacious pitches and a friendly atmosphere. The indoor swimming pool with sauna are a huge bonus. Lace up your walking shoes or hop on a bike and explore the peaceful, open landscape of North Jutland, or play a round at the nearby golf resort.

Pitch, cabin or glamping?

The pitches at Himmerland Camping are spacious and neatly laid out, with a fine mix of sun and shade. Here you will be right in the heart of North Jutland’s countryside, with modern facilities within easy reach. Prefer a bit more comfort? The cosy cabins and charming glamping tents offer a lovely base after a day outdoors. You can park nearby and walk straight into your accommodation.

Something for everyone

Rain or shine, you will never get bored here. Take a dip in the heated indoor pool or warm up in the sauna. The modern family bathrooms make it extra comfortable, especially with children. For the little ones, there is a playground, and during the summer holidays you can get a tasty snack from the grill bar. The campsite is open 365 days a year and the cabins are available for rent all year round.

Explore the surrounding area

The location in Himmerland is ideal for those who love to get out and about. Walk or cycle through Aars Skov and Uhrehøje Plantage. Or you can visit Lake Vilsted, which is perfect for a picnic or a canoe trip. The Limfjord is a short drive away for a refreshing swim or an ice cream by the water.

properties.name: Vorupør Camping
properties.description:
On the Danish island of North Jutland is Vorupør Camping, a campsite located in Thy National Park. The beach is only 50 metres away from the campsite and the centre of the nearby village of Nørre Vorupør is within walking distance. Vorupør Camping is a self-service campsite, which means that you check yourself in and out.

Tiny house or private hot tub

At Vorupør Camping you camp in the dunes, close to the sea. The pitches are spacious and separated by low fences. Some of the pitches overlook the dunes. There are two tent fields, located on a dune, giving campsite visitors with a tent a beautiful view of the North Sea. There are several luxury accommodations at the edge of the campsite. Stay in a beautiful beach house, a cosy tiny house or a luxury chalet with its own Jacuzzi and sauna.

Communal kitchen

The service building houses a communal kitchen with induction hobs, ovens, microwaves, a fridge and large freezer. Any meals you make can be eaten on the terrace next to the kitchen. The playground is right next to the service building. Campsite guests may exercise free of charge at the village’s gym, which is less than a kilometre away.

Oldest national park in Denmark

Vorupør Camping is located in Thy National Park by the North Sea. To get to the beach, wander through the dunes or follow the paved road. The national park has beautiful wooded areas and attractive coastal villages. The nature reserve is home to many wild animals, such as red deer, eagles and cranes. Be sure to take along your binoculars as there is a good chance you will see seals along the coast.

properties.name: Tornby Strand Camping
properties.description:
This spacious campsite with excellent facilities is located in the north of Denmark, in the North Jutland region. Here you can camp on spacious fields or rent a wooden bungalow or Scandinavian-style cabin. Tornby Strand Campsite is a fifteen-minute walk from the beach of the same name and a seven-minute drive from the harbour town of Hirtshals, where you will find various restaurants and shops. The ferry to Norway departs from this location, which makes the campsite an ideal place for travellers to stay overnight. But Tornby Strand is also a great place to enjoy a wonderful beach holiday.

Space and cleanliness

Upon your arrival at the neat and well-maintained campsite, you will be welcomed by the friendly owners. The camping pitches are large and separated by hedges. There are also pitches which allow you to camp on an open field.

There are a few sanitary blocks scattered around the campsite, some of which have been renovated. The buildings that still need to be modernised may not be gleamingly new, but they are spotlessly clean and meet all necessary requirements.

Entertainment and water recreation

For swimming fanatics there are no less than two swimming pools, an indoor and outdoor pool. The indoor pool is not very large, but meets guests' needs. The outdoor pool has a deep end and a shallow end for small children. In addition to the swimming pools, the campsite has a nice mini golf course, where you can putt with the whole family. The youngest guests can also let off steam on the playground and on the football field.

properties.name: Hedebo Strand Camping
properties.description:
Hedebo Strand Camping is located in the northeastern part of Jutland directly on the Baltic Sea, with a large beach perfect for shell hunting. The large campsite grounds are within walking distance of the picturesque harbour town of Sæby. The campsite has plenty of plants, grass and hedges. You can also rent modern wooden homes here. Children will enjoy themselves immensely in the well-equipped playgrounds and swimming pools.

Charming cottages

The pitches are spacious and a few pitches are located just a stone's throw from the sea. The pitches are arranged in straight rows, partly separated by tall hedges. You can also rent modernly designed cottages here. The cottages are very pleasant and have a large veranda in front of the house.

Swimming pool land

On the campsite, you can make use of two outdoor swimming pools, one of which is a large heated pool. There are also various water slides (open and enclosed) and the little ones can splash away in the paddling pool. Relax in one of the comfortable poolside loungers. The sea is also a fine place to go swimming. Also fun: stay dry and go hunting for shells on the beach.

Unique museum and entertainment

The campsite is equipped with a playground, indoor playground, sports field and mini-golf course. What's unique is the museum near the campsite's entrance, where you can find classic cars and motors. There is a fun entertainment programme and active campers can find information about local cycling routes at the reception.

Food and drink

There is a large supermarket near the campsite which stocks a wide range of products (including camping equipment), ideal for if you want to cook your own meals. You can also dine at the restaurant (which also has a snack bar and patio).

properties.name: Glyngøre Camping
properties.description:
Glyngøre Camping is situated in the heart of the Danish fjord region in North Jutland, just outside the fishing village of Glyngøre. It is a wonderful holiday destination for those seeking peace and quiet, and for anyone who wants to explore the Danish fjords on foot or by bike. The campsite itself is close to the impressive Limfjord and the crossing to the island of Mors. In addition, this charming family-friendly campsite is popular among families with young children in the summer. You will find several sports and play facilities, a heated swimming pool and an animal enclosure.

Spacious pitches with sweeping views

The campsite is spacious and the grounds are divided into small fields of about ten spacious pitches. One special feature is the open area in the middle of the campsite. Camping is not permitted in this section, as it is the remains of an ancient burial mound. This means you can enjoy unobstructed views of the surrounding area from a number of spots. There are also modern accommodation options available for rental, such as camping tents, safari tents and hikers’ huts with varying levels of comfort, from basic to luxury.

Plenty of playground facilities and a heated swimming pool

There is plenty to do at the campsite, especially for families with (young) children. For example, you can take them to the animal enclosure where they can pet adorable little goats. There is also a ball pit, a challenging obstacle course and several playgrounds and bouncy castles. The swimming pool at Glyngøre Camping has a large main pool and a separate paddling pool, both with water heated to 27 degrees. After swimming, you can enjoy the small café by the reception, where ice creams and hot and cold drinks are available. At reception, you will also find a small shop selling basic necessities.

properties.name: Toftum Bjerge Camping
properties.description:
Toftum Bjerge Camping enjoys a wonderfully peaceful setting in the green surroundings of Central Jutland. You can look out over the beautiful rolling hills and take a short walk to the cliffs, which offer breathtaking views of the Limfjord. Here, you can breathe in the fresh sea air while listening to the birds and the wind. Fancy a cultural outing? Struer is nearby and ideal for an afternoon stroll, with the Struer Museum and the Bang & Olufsen Museum (8.5 km) as fun stops along the way.

Combine the great outdoors with more comfort

Whether you’re arriving with a tent, a campervan or a caravan, you will find spacious camping pitches that feel nice and open. You will be on clearly marked fields with low hedges here and there for extra privacy. Prefer a more sheltered spot for the night? Then opt for a cabin or a glamping tent. This allows you to enjoy the great outdoors while still relaxing in comfort. Many camping pitches have a 230V power connection with a minimum of 10A. This is handy for your cool box, for charging your devices, and for anything else you want to keep close at hand.

Meet other campers

The campsite itself is a great place to be. The children can burn off some energy in the large playground, while you kick back at the restaurant during the high season and enjoy a tasty bite from the snack menu. Outside of high season, a shared meal is prepared once a week. It’s the perfect opportunity to meet other campers and exchange tips about the local area. There is a petting zoo with goats for younger campers and a multi-sports field where you can all have fun together. Small-scale activities are frequently organised during the holiday periods.

properties.name: Sønderballe Strand Camping
properties.description:
Sønderballe Strand Camping has a wonderful location on Genner Bay in South Jutland, Denmark. From the quiet family campsite, cross the street to the boat jetty with a sandy beach next to it. It’s the ideal place to get a breath of fresh air on the coast, visit islands, play water sports or cycle. The campsite's mini golf course and playground are popular with children.

In idyllic nature

The campsite is divided into a number of terraces. The view of Genner Bay is especially impressive from the highest pitches. You’ll see the coming and going of fishing boats and sailing boats there. The campsite is on the edge of a forest, a big advantage if you’re bringing your dog with you. Besides the permanent pitches, there are fields where you can set up your tent or caravan. For families, a pitch near the playground can be handy. There’s a separate section for motor homes and wooden cabins.

Mini golf, playground and pancakes

Children have priority here. And a day at the campsite flies by! Start with freshly-baked bread rolls for breakfast, then head to the playground or the bouncy castle and later in the day play a game of mini golf. And have a nice ice cream at the snack bar in between too. There’s also a great pancake house nearby, so the whole family will enjoy themselves there in the evening.

Water around you

Would you like to snorkel, windsurf, water-ski or canoe? You can do all of these right next to the campsite. Fishing is possible too. Or walk to the beautiful Kalvø peninsula (3 km).

properties.name: Lærkelunden Camping
properties.description:
Lærkelunden Camping is in the south-east of Denmark, close to the charming village of Grasten. The thing that makes this campsite so nice is its unique setting right by the sea next to the Flensborg Fjord. Here, you can enjoy the view of the Baltic Sea every day and the proximity of the beach. The campsite is also ideally located for walkers, considering the popular Gendarme Path walking route runs through the campsite.

Spacious pitches

The well-maintained site has asphalted paths and 220 spacious (> 100 m2), clearly designated camping pitches. There are also other overnight options, including huts, hire caravans and luxury tents.

Relax by the swimming pool or by the sea

The indoor swimming pool is a nice facility at the campsite. The pools are heated, providing comfort when swimming. There are shallow and deep pools.

With the campsite being right by the sea, you only have to take a few steps to reach the beautiful beach. Here, you can relax on the sand, enjoy the cool sea wind and take part in various water sports activities.

Activities at the campsite

Beside the swimming pool and the many activities you can take part in on the sea, there is also plenty to do at the campsite itself. Play a game of Krolf (a mix of golf and croquet) and pétanque with a view of the campsite. For children there is a playground, a bouncy castle and a multi-functional sports field. There is also an indoor play area with a table tennis table, table football and a PlayStation – handy in bad weather!

properties.name: Løgballe Camping
properties.description:
øgballe Camping is a rural family campsite. The campsite is located in Jutland (Denmark), five kilometres from the village of Stouby. Children can have a good time at the small-scale campsite. There is a playground with a bouncy castle, slide and a race track for go-karts. In the high season there are also fun activities for children and adults. For example of making candles or baking bread over the fire.

Pitches, bungalows or cabins

Did you come to the campsite with your motorhome? Then you can go to one of the beautifully landscaped pitches with electricity. These are located outside the campsite, but of course you are allowed to use all facilities. The pitches are spacious and have a lot of privacy. The campsite has a total of 150 pitches and two fields for tents near the stream.

Don't you have your own camping gear? Then you can rent a bungalow or hiker's hut (without sanitary facilities). The cabins are located close to the sanitary facilities, so you don't have to walk far. The sanitary block is well maintained and clean.

Food and entertainment

Løgballe Camping has an outdoor pool with paddling pool that is heated by solar energy. In the summer (June-August) you can swim your laps here or just relax. If you like to cook your own meal, this campsite is the place to be. There is a communal barbecue area and kitchen with several hotplates at your disposal. There is no restaurant on the campsite, but you can buy fresh bread every day in the campsite shop. In the shop you'll find all your daily groceries. There is also a supermarket in Stouby.

properties.name: Købingsmark Strand Camping
properties.description:
On the beach near the Danish town of Nordborg lies this quiet campsite. You will be camping here directly on the Baltic Sea. From your spacious pitch, you will have a beautiful view over the water at Købingsmark Strand Camping. The sea is popular with water sports enthusiasts. But even if you just want to stroll along the beach, you're in the right place. The campsite is closed in winter, but it is possible to stay in one of the camping huts.

Driving to the coast and campsite

Købingsmark Strand Camping is located in the south of Denmark, directly on the Baltic Sea. Via Sønderborg, you drive onto the island of Als. There, you will have distant views over fields and meadows until you reach your destination. The 405 brings you to Nordborg. From there, the signs will show you the way to the coast. Can you see the sea already? Then you're right at the campsite. Just before you reach the coast, turn left into the camping area. There, a friendly welcome awaits you in an old farmhouse.

Camping with a sea view

Have you set up your caravan or tent? Then first things first, take some time to enjoy the view. The long grassy fields with pitches are just a bit higher than the Baltic Sea. From your pitch, you can look out over the water. The view helps to create the peace and freedom you feel here. RVers won't be able to believe their luck here either. The new RV sites are particularly spacious.

Enjoying the tranquillity

Most campers all come here for the same reason. They want to enjoy the peace, the sense of space and the water. You can catch a breath of fresh air on the beach or go for a scenic bike ride.

properties.name: Camp Hverringe, Bøgebjerg Strand
properties.description:
You will find that you unwind straight away at Camp Hverringe on East Fyn (Denmark). Right on the coast of the Great Belt, with beautiful views over the water. Relax or get active in nature, it's all possible here. For children, there are trampolines, bouncy castles and an animal pasture. Rent a pitch, or choose a cosy cabin. And there’s plenty to do in the area too, like a visit to the city of Nyborg or Odense.

Camp the way you like it

At Camp Hverringe, you’ll always find a spot for your tent, motor home or caravan. Many pitches are right by the water. And, for families, there are pitches close to the playground, so the kids can have fun while you keep an eye on them. Coming without camping equipment? Rent a cosy cabin, a great safari tent or even a tepee.

Everything you might need (and more)

The facilities at Camp Hverringe are excellent. Take a dip in the pool, or freshen up in the modern service buildings. Feel like adventure? Rent a paddle board or kayak and take to the water. Campers who prefer to stay on dry land can play foot golf or test their precision with archery. If you are a music lover, you can indulge in the music room.Just want to relax? Then go see a movie in the small cinema.

Discover Oost-Fyn

At Camp Hverringe, the most beautiful spots of East Fyn are within easy reach. A short drive and you’re on the motorway to Nyborg (30 km) or Odense (25 km).

properties.name: Møn Strandcamping - Ulvshale
properties.description:
Møn Strandcamping - Ulvshale is located on the Danish island of Møn. You will camp right by the Baltic Sea, behind the dunes of the gently sloping Ulvshale beach. This small campsite offers peace and space, surrounded by nature and overlooking the sea. Take endless walks through the dunes and along the beach while the sun slowly sets. Or cycle towards the nearby island of Nyord. Guests particularly appreciate the relaxed atmosphere, the well-kept site and the personal approach of the campsite owners.

Camping comfort by the sea

The campsite has about 130 touring pitches (80-120 m²) for caravans, motor homes and tents. Most pitches are located in a sloping landscape of dunes and woods, a short distance from the beach. Both shaded and open pitches are available. The pitches are large, with privacy provided by vegetation. The site is overseeable and well-maintained.

Basic facilities and personal atmosphere

Do you love peace, nature and the sea? Then this campsite is for you. Don't expect entertainment or a swimming pool but bird song and the murmuring sea. Møn Strandcamping - Ulvshale has simple but well-maintained facilities. The toilet and washing facilities are functional and clean, with a dedicated family bathroom and laundry facilities. There’s a small kitchen for general use and a bread-roll service in high season. Wi-fi is available free of charge at reception. There’s a small kiosk for day-to-day shopping. The atmosphere on the campsite is friendly and informal, with personal attention from the managers. There’s a good playground for the youngest campers.

properties.name: Falkensteiner Premium Camping Zadar
properties.description:
Three kilometres from the Croatian harbour town of Zadar you will find Camp Zadar. The location of the campsite is ideal because of its proximity to attractive towns and the lively coast. The many pine trees close to the beach and around the campsite ensure ample shade. The centre of Zadar can be reached via a short bike ride along the coast.

Park-like terrain with a view

Camp Zadar is located in park-like surroundings and has a Mediterranean and hospitable ambiance. The shaded terrain is divided into several fields. There is a small playground near the water's edge where you will also find the more spacious open pitches with a view of the sea. A view for miles of the clear seawater is a pleasant treat. The campsite offers free access to the narrow beach with small pebbles.

Swimming pool with terrace

Close to the sea you will find the beautiful outdoor swimming pool complex with several pools and a separate children's pool. An elevated terrace overlooks the swimming pool and the beautifully kept lawn. Everything is decorated in fresh and light colours.

Joint activities

There is always something going on at Camp Zadar. There is a childcare facility for children from the age of three, so the parents can also participate in activities. In summer the campsite organises several excursions to which young and old are invited. Teenagers can give it their all at sports tournaments. You will meet your fellow campers when you enter the communal barbecue area.

Zadar promenade

Zadar is known for its beautiful sunsets. On the promenade there are two works of art: a sea organ and a beautiful monument powered by solar energy.

properties.name: Camping Cisano/San Vito
properties.description:
Camping Cisano/San Vito is a large-scale campsite directly on Lake Garda. The campsite consists of three sections and has a large range of pitches and accommodation units. This campsite is very suitable for campers who like the conviviality of a large campsite. Campsite Cisano/San Vito is located south of the tourist town of Bardolino, directly on the largest and most popular lake of Italy. There are many tourist attractions in the vicinity, such as the Movieland Park and Gardaland theme parks.

Large-scale campsite

The campsite is a large-sized operation and is divided into three sections. In the eastern section are sports fields and swimming pools, the southern section is located on Lake Garda and houses several small shops and the campsite restaurant.

With no fewer than 460 pitches, there is ample choice to select your ideal spot. For instance, directly by Lake Garda, with a vast view of the water, or closer to the swimming pool. Camping Cisano/San Vito also has a wide selection for the sybarites amongst campers; stay in a brick bungalow, a bungalow by the lake, one of the many apartments or in a mobile home.

Enjoyable swim

The atmosphere is lively around the three swimming pools in the eastern section of the campsite. One of these swimming pools, the largest, is suitable for children. The bubble bath is excellent to relax. You can, of course, swim in Lake Garda as well. From the campsite you can walk straight into the water.

properties.name: Camping Village Scarpiland
properties.description:
Camping Village Scarpiland is located on a peninsula just off Venice. This peninsula is surrounded by the Venice lagoon on one side and the Mediterranean sea on the other. With almost 250 pitches and over a hundred mobile homes, this is quite a large campsite. Because of its location directly on the Mediterranean Sea, it is not a loss that the campsite does not have a swimming pool.

Pleasant holiday village

With its nearly 250 pitches and over 100 rental units, Camping Village Scarpiland is like a holiday village. Fortunately, the pitches are all laid out in an orderly fashion. The mobile homes are grouped together at the front of the campsite, and the various types of pitch are spread over several fields. These pitches are mostly sandy and bordered by green hedges. Tall pine trees and colourful flower beds give the campsite a pleasant holiday atmosphere.

Child-friendly family campsite

Camping Village Scarpiland is a very child-friendly campsite, particularly popular with German and Italian families. Children have fun on the lovely playground or on the safe beach. The well-stocked entertainment programme, culminating in the disco, is also very popular. This entertainment is for several age groups. Sporty campers are also welcome at the campsite. On the new sports fields you can play football, archery and jeu-de-boules. Next to the sports fields is a brand new dog area.

Pasta, pizza and ice cream

Just outside the campsite you will find a small shopping centre. You can go to the supermarket and the butcher's to do your daily shopping, and you can buy beach articles in the souvenir shop. There are also several restaurants, which of course serve various pizzas, pastas and ice creams.

properties.name: Eurocamp Spreewaldtor
properties.description:
Amidst the forest and wetland area Spreewald, only an hour's drive from Berlin, and 25 km from Beeskow, you will find EuroCamp Spreewaldtor. The campsite is directly located on the shore of the Gross Leuthen lake, in which you can take a dive from a jetty to have a refreshing swim. You can explore the lovely towns in the area, enjoy cycling trips and even take a boat cruise through the extensive Spreewald.

Swimming or canoeing in the lake

The camping pitches are spread over various fields. The campsite looks modern and very well maintained, with landscaped greenery and no high vegetation. It is a peaceful campsite, with an entertainment programme for children during school holidays. For luxury camping enthusiasts there are rental safari tents, trekker huts and even wooden tepees available on the campsite.

Water playground and wellness centre

There is a footpath from the campsite to the lake, which has a small sandy beach and a water playground. There is also a separate beach for dogs. New as of the 2018 season is a small wellness centre with sauna and a heated outdoor pool with special children's pool and sunbathing lawn.

Catch a ride!

A convenient feature offered by the campsite is a shuttle service to take you to some of the attractive towns and villages in the area, such as watery Lübbenau. On the square is a camping shop with limited supplies, you will have to go to Lübben (20 km) for larger shops. There are also a few small shops in Märkische Heide, a village within walking distance of the campsite. The sociable camping restaurant serves modest meals.

Rain showers

The sanitary facilities, fully equipped for all target groups, has spacious and clean rain showers.

properties.name: Eco-Camping & Chalets Koren
properties.description:
Eco-Camping & Chalets Koren is located in beautiful countryside on the fairy-tale Soča River. This campsite is ideal for nature lovers, and prides itself on its environmentally-friendly policies. The staff are ready to give you any information you might need about walking, mountain biking, canoe trips or outdoor activities in the vicinity. The friendly atmosphere at Eco-Camping & Chalets Koren ensures a wonderful holiday for young and old.

The campsite has non-demarcated camping pitches in various zones and terraces, including zones for tents, a car-free zone, and a zone for caravans and motorhomes. Spread all over the grounds, you'll find picnic tables, campfire areas and barbecue areas. As well as touring pitches, Eco-Camping & Chalets Koren offers 6 spacious and fully-equipped comfortable wooden eco-chalets, suitable for 6 people (4+2).

Pick your own herbs at the campsite

Eco-Camping & Chalets Koren has a camping shop with eco-friendly products from their own garden, and from farms in the vicinity. You'll find various things, including honey, cheese, herbs and fresh vegetables. Guests can even pick their own herbs on the grounds, to include in a pasta dish for example. Want to eat out? You can easily walk to the town of Kobarid, with nice restaurants and cafés.

Adventurous all-in holiday
