Do you want an adventurous holiday with a group? On request, Eco-Camping & Chalets Koren can offer an all-in package for three or five days where you can do all sorts of activities with local guide. The campsite can organise the guide, transport, equipment and tickets.

properties.name: Lopari Camping Resort
properties.description:
Lopari Camping Resort is situated in the Croatian island of Lošinj. It is known for its beautiful bays and pristine nature in the interior. The campsite is situated in a green valley in an inlet of the Adriatic Sea. You are camping in a spot where you can enjoy the sun, sea, nature and beautiful villages in peace. The campsite is located between the historic town of Osor and the small fishing village of Nerezine.

View of the sea

The modest terrain is flat and provides shade in places. The pitches are spaciously laid out. You have a view of the sea from almost every pitch. Here and there there is some vegetation in the form of olive trees, conifers and deciduous trees. These provide some shadow. Want to hire something? You can book a mobile home or an apartment. There is a separate field for dogs.

Water sports possibilities

Lopari Camping Resort lies directly on the sea. Water sports fans can indulge themselves here, from windsurfer to snorkelling enthusiast. Leisurely floating on an airbed or a playing a game of beach tennis are other options, of course. The water is accessible to wheelchair users and there is a pebble beach.

Surf school and kids club

On the campsite is a surf school, a playground and a few table tennis tables. Furthermore, all kinds of activities are organised, from yoga lessons to cycling and walking tours. There is a kids club for children a few times a week. Older children can take part in the entertainment. Boats and bicycles can be hired on the campsite. 

Restaurant and shop

The campsite has a restaurant and a shop with a reasonable range and daily fresh bread. At a distance of some 1.5 km you will find a larger supermarket.

properties.name: Baia Domizia Camping Village
properties.description:
Between tall pine trees you will find the attractively laid out holiday park Baia Domizia Camping Village. Situated directly by the Tyrrhenian Sea and close to Naples, Rome and Pompeii, this a pleasant location for an enjoyable holiday. The entire site is neatly laid out with much vegetation. The large campsite is located near the lively coastal resort town of Baia Domizia. Via a quiet road past agricultural fields, you arrive at the square in front of the reception. This is also the entrance of the campsite where everything is about enjoyment and relaxation.

Summer atmosphere at the swimming pools

The campsite has two large outdoor swimming pools and a toddler pool. The sunbathing lawn is well maintained and the palm trees create a real summer atmosphere. Important information for swimming: you can rent sun loungers and the pool supervisor insists on bathing caps.

If you prefer the sea, you can access the 1200 m long narrow sandy beach from three spots on the campsite. There is a shower and it is staffed by a lifeguard on busy days. Wind surfing is allowed at the beach and a large number of sports fields are located near the sea.

Homemade ice cream

When you go to Italy, you will most likely want to have a real Italian ice cream now and then. This is also possible at Baia Domizia Camping Village. There is an ice cream parlour where you can choose a different flavour each day.

properties.name: Camping und Ferienpark Orsingen
properties.description:
Only a 10-minute drive away from the Bodensee (Lake Constance), lies Camping und Ferienpark Orsingen. There is a large play castle for children and camping guests can use the municipal swimming pool which is on the campsite. The campsite is located near the villages of Orsingen and Nenzingen, where you will find a baker and a restaurant. The car will take you quickly to larger towns like Singen and Stockach as well as to attractive villages on the Bodensee. The Bodensee is the largest lake in Germany and borders Switzerland and Austria.

Rheinfall, castles and old towns

There is lots to do in the vicinity of Camping und Ferienpark Orsingen. The famous ‘Rheinfall’, a large waterfall spanning the entire width of the river Rhine, the castle of Laufen or the old town of Lindau near the German/Austrian border are all very interesting attractions. Travelling with children? Pay a visit to the Affenberg Zoo near Salem.

The camping pitches are located in the centre of the campsite and are divided in standard pitches with electricity and a water point nearby and comfort pitches with private water connection and drainage. In addition there is a choice of rental accommodation. In addition to traditional mobile homes, there are mobile homes with a wooden extension and a covered veranda, three small wooden huts and also the Bodensee Hostel, where also groups can spend the night.

Municipal swimming pool and Bodensee

Camping guest have free access to the heated municipal swimming pool on the campsite grounds with a separate pool for young children. In addition, the Bodensee is of course perfect for a day of water fun.

properties.name: Camping Village Conca d'Oro
properties.description:
Camping Village Conca d'Oro is a delightful family campsite on one of Italy's most popular lakes, Lake Maggiore. The natural surroundings, water, entertainment (including for teenagers) and the many amenities combine to make this a campsite on which you can enjoy a truly carefree camping holiday. Don't miss a visit to the magical Borromean Islands while you are here.

The campsite is rich in lush green vegetation of maple trees, birches, ash and alder wood. The majority of paths on the campsite are unpaved, adding to the natural feel of the environment. This also helps to make the campsite especially safe for children.

Camping or glamping?

Village Conca d'Oro campsite has 250 grassy camping pitches of various sizes, shaded and unshaded, and all with electricity (max. 6 A). If you're looking for a little more luxury and comfort, why not hire a mobile home with patio or glamping tent?

Floating around on the lake

Village Conca d'Oro does not have a swimming pool, the site's location on Lake Maggiore (the south-eastern side, so sunshine all day long!) renders a pool unnecessary! The lake slopes gently downwards, so camping guests can take to the waters for a refreshing dip. The campsite has a 400-metre stretch of private sandy beach on the lake, so you'll always be able to find somewhere to relax and soak up the sun.

properties.name: Moselcamping Wolf
properties.description:
A lovely camping pitch right by River Moselle with pleasant views of the river and the vineyard opposite. That's what you get at Moselcamping Wolf! This small-scale campsite is near the town of Traben-Trarbach, in the middle of the Mosel region in the German state of Rijnland-Palts. This campsite is laid out on a long section of the inner bank of this river. Moselcamping Wolf mainly attracts campers wanting to explore this stunning region on foot or by bike. Thanks to the vineyards and wine tastings, wine lovers will also feel at home here.

Book a camping pitch by the Moselle

If you decide to book a pitch at Moselcamping Wolf, there's a good chance you will be allocated a camping pitch right by River Moselle. You can take your dog to the campsite, as long as it's kept on a lead.

Swimming in the river or in the Kröv municipal swimming pool

If you need to cool down on a hot summer's day, you can get into River Moselle from your private jetty at the campsite. For an afternoon of swimming, you are best going to the municipal swimming pool in Kröv, less than a 10-minute drive from the campsite. As a guest of Moselcamping Wolf, you can use this large swimming pool for free.

Get at a table on the Moezelterras and enjoy a tasty Flammkuchen

There is a lovely restaurant at the front of the campsite with a wonderful patio by the Moselle. The house speciality is the Flammkuchen. You can also go here for nice drinks, such as coffee, wine, beer and soft drinks. The campsite also has its own shop with a reasonably wide range of groceries.

properties.name: Moselcampingplatz Alf
properties.description:
The Moselcampingplatz Alf is located in the German Rhineland-Palatinate, near the Moselle. The campsite is located in the forest and on a beautiful stream that runs into the river. In the surrounding area, you can enjoy various historical towns, numerous wine festivals and a lovely selection of cycling and hiking trails. There is plenty for the whole family.

Choose your own spot...or wine barrel!

Upon arrival on the campsite, you'll notice the various fields with beautiful open pitches. The greenery will immediately put you in the holiday mood! The reception building is staffed every morning and there is always someone available by phone. Here you can choose a lovely spot and can get tourist information.

Don't have your own camping equipment? No problem! You have a choice of options on this campsite. Choose a chalet, completely furnished tent or sleep in a wine barrel! The so-called "Alf XL wine barrel" is made all of wood and has heating, its own toilet and a charming outdoor terrace.

Fun in the water

You can swim in the stream at the campsite or go looking for gems with the kids. The Moselle is only 500 metres away, the river which the stream flows into. There you can sit on the banks, watch boats or enjoy a nice cycling tour along the water's edge.

Surroundings

And there are plenty of cultural excursions. Historic wine towns such as Cochem, Koblenz, Bernkastel and Trier are more than worth a visit. In addition to the lovely drinks, you can also enjoy charming squares, picturesque streets and lovely monuments.

properties.name: Camping Piantelle
properties.description:
Camping Piantelle is situated along a private pebble beach on Lake Garda. The campsite has well-tended delineated pitches, many of which have beautiful views of the lake. Campsite amenities include a swimming pool, a fine restaurant and entertainment in the peak season.

Camping among the olive trees

Camping Piantelle is situated among the olive trees and is a relatively quiet and well-tended family campsite. The camping is partly flat, with terraces closer to the lake. The spacious pitches are subdivided into various categories, depending on the level of luxury.

Camping Piantelle has two swimming pools, one of which is a children's pool with a depth of only 60 cm. There is also a spray park. A large sunbathing area with loungers and sunshades surrounds the swimming pools. There is also a Swedish sauna at the pool. Fancy a bite to eat? Then you can have a snack at the poolside snack bar.

Pebble beach on Lake Garda

The campsite is situated directly on Lake Garda. The 250 metre-wide pebble beach slopes gently to the water, making it ideal for children to play in the lake. There is a wooden jetty for campers with a boat, but there are also buoys for boats with a maximum length of six metres, as well as a boat ramp.

Special olive oil on Camping Piantelle

The olive trees on the campsite have been around much longer than the campsite itself. In October and November, the olives are harvested by hand in the traditional manner. They are cold pressed within 24 hours to produce home-grown extra virgin olive oil. The olive oil is, of course, sold on the campsite.

properties.name: Flower Camping Les Truffières
properties.description:
Flower Camping Les Truffières is located close to the old village of Grignan in the Drôme, between lavender fields and vineyards. You'll be camping in an old oak forest where truffles used to be grown. With an outdoor swimming pool and an attractive restaurant, where the owner himself is in the kitchen, you can relax here the French way.

Natural camping site

The sheltered touring pitches are located on the campsite's natural site. In many places, the old oak trees provide shade, while sometimes along with hedges and shrubs, they also demarcate the pitches. If you want a camping holiday with a touch of luxury, choose a lodge tent or mobile home.

Swimming pool in the sun

The pool may be not too big, but it is a nice place for a refreshing dip. This rectangular outdoor pool is situated in a sunny area, surrounded by trees. After playing in the water for a while you can look for shade on the lawn. Or sunbathe on one of the sun loungers. Next to the pool is a small paddling pool.

Attractive restaurant

The owner himself stands behind the stove in the restaurant on the campsite. This restaurant, located at the reception, is the heart of the campsite. You can get not only simple but quality dishes, it is also a place full of conviviality. The outside seating, situated under the trees, is often nicely busy.

properties.name: Ostseecp-Ferienpark Zierow KG
properties.description:
Ostsee-Camping Ferienpark Zierow is a well-maintained family campsite on the beach in North Germany. Both young and old will enjoy themselves at this campsite. With the extensive wellness amenities, fitness activities and hospitable campsite staff, you will be able to completely relax. Tip: Hanzestad, Wismar is 6 kilometres away.

You can choose from various pitches on the vast campsite grounds, from simple pitches to comfort pitches with a view of the sea. Every pitch has a power connection. You can also rent a bungalow or mobile home if you want that extra bit of comfort

Junior and senior

The campsite is perfectly suitable for families with young children, but seniors are also at the right place here. Swimming lessons and water aerobics are organised in the indoor pool (with sauna!) and there is supervised fitness training in the gym for all ages. The littlest ones can enjoy themselves in ‘Willy’s Watthaus’, the indoor playground with a ball pit. In the high season the children are treated to treasure hunts and sand castle building contests. If you want to completely unwind, then you can have a massage or relax your muscles in the wellness amenities. And don’t miss out on a pedicure, manicure or facial treatment. Restaurant Oase, the campsite’s eatery, has an extensive menu. Here everyone can enjoy German cuisine. And if you want a colouring page with dinner, no problem. It’s a good way to keep your children occupied during your dinner.

Wismar

One place you cannot miss is Wismar, it is listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site and can be reached via the Ostseefernradweg. Here you can visit the old historic market, St Nicholas Church (St Nikolai Kirche) and the picturesque old harbour.

properties.name: Camping Village Pino Mare
properties.description:
The Italian Camping Village Pino Mare lies on the Adriatic coast. It has the advantage of being directly on the sea, but there's also a huge (saltwater) swimming pool where you can cool off on hot summer days. There's an extensive entertainment programme, so there's enough to keep you busy. And if you want a special trip, then Venice is just an hour's drive from the campsite. In the north east of Italy, where the Tagliamento river flows into the Adriatic, you'll find Camping Village Pino Mare, in the town of Lignano Sabbiadoro. The town is situated on a headland, between the Gulf of Venice and the Laguna di Marano.

Comfortable or extra comfortable?

The shady camping pitches are spacious and there's lots of greenery on the camping grounds. There are many different categories of camping pitch: standard, maxi comfort and premium. All pitches have water, electricity and television connections, as well as free wifi. If you're camping with a tent, you'll be on a standard pitch. If you're visiting with a caravan or a mobile home, you can choose from all three options.

Campsite guests

At this campsite, your neighbours will likely be families with children. The facilities are perfect for young children, and that's what the campsite focuses on too, in particular with the entertainment. It's a lively campsite, where lots of activities are organised. Guests come from Germany, the Czech Republic, Austria and even Italy itself.

Private beach

The campsite offers a private beach with supervision. There are plenty of parasols available for the guests. The beaches are wide, and the sea descends slowly from the beach, which is ideal if you're on the beach with young children.

properties.name: Pappasole Camping Village
properties.description:
Pappasole Camping Village is located in Tuscany on the Tyrrhenian coast, between the towns of Piombino and Follonica. Everything is tip top, you can have a lovely beach and relaxation holiday combined with excursions into the area.

Privacy through hedges

Pappasole Camping Village makes a well maintained and green impression. The sites are spacious and have shade and privacy through the separation by hedges. The sanitation is housed in modern octagonal buildings and is nice and clean. There are also rental accommodations, such as bungalows and mobile homes for two to six people. The campground has a charming restaurant with an extensive menu (also take-aways), a charming bar and a large supermarket with an extensive range.

Water fun guaranteed

Many families with children come to the campground, and there are many nationalities represented. Here you will find a true swimming paradise, with four swimming pools, including a lap pool and one with wellness facilities such as massage jets. The beach is about 400 metres away and on the campground's section there are lounges and parasols.

At Pappasole Camping Village there are many sports facilities, including tennis courts, volleyball and basketball and mini golf. There is a playground for the little ones. In the high season, there is a professional activities team to keep everyone busy, both on the campground itself as well as on the beach, with aquagym, beach volleyball and numerous of other sports activities with music, dancing and a show in the evening.

properties.name: Playa Montroig Camping Resort
properties.description:
Playa Montroig Camping Resort is a luxurious campsite on the beach of the Costa Daurada. It has a large swimming pool complex (a swimming paradise!) and excellent amenities. Truly a place for campers looking for extra comfort. The location, on one of the most exclusive beaches and close to Port Aventura and Tarragona, makes this a popular holiday spot. In a shaded area, between beautifully landscaped gardens, you are given a warm welcome.

The camping pitches are spread over several zones. You can camp directly by the beach, in the friendly, lively heart of the campsite or at the quieter outskirts. All pitches are spacious with greenery and are located among neat gardens.

Environmentally-friendly and stylish bungalows

The rental accommodation is a good choice for campers looking for more comfort and privacy. The bungalows are located in greenery and near the sea. They are built of environment-friendly material and stylishly furnished. With a television, microwave, fridge and dishwasher, the accommodation units are equipped with all modern conveniences.

Let yourself be pampered

Playa Montroig is the ideal holiday destination for campers who like to be pampered, because personal attention features high on this campsite. With the sunny climate you can enjoy the swimming pool or the sea for a large part of the year. The swimming pool complex is laid out in a garden with a lively bar with terrace in the centre. The complex consists of heated swimming pools with slides and water falls. For adults, activities such as aqua gym are organised and a large lagoon swimming pool has been constructed for children.

properties.name: La Marina Resort by Samay
properties.description:
La Marina Camping & Resort is located on the Costa Blanca, an area with more than 300 days of sun a year. This campsite is fantastic for water lovers: a swimming paradise with different water slides and the beach close by. The campsite is near Alicante and Elche, and just half an hour's drive from the motorway (A70). You will be welcomed by the helpful staff, who will show you around the large grounds.

Pitches of different sizes are available, all of which are separated by a hedge. Alternatively, you could stay in one of the bungalows, on the campsite or in the Marina Village, which a little further away from the camping pitches.

Swimming paradise with spectacular water slides

The swimming area is divided into two at La Marina Camping & Resort: the aquamarina and the themed pool. The aquamarina has ten spectacular water slides and guarantees a full day's fun in the sun. The themed pool is surrounded by tropical plants and has a jacuzzi.

Many shops and catering facilities

The campsite has many shops and catering facilities: not only a restaurant with an extensive menu based on local dishes, but also a café. And if don't need to leave the campsite if you yourself would like to cook, as there's a large supermarket on site with its own baker, butcher and grocer.

properties.name: Devesa Gardens by Samay
properties.description:
The Devesa Gardens resort is situated to the south of Valencia, close to the Mediterranean Sea, between pine forests and rice fields. Valencia, with an abundance of sights to see, is just a fifteen-minute drive away. In addition, there is a bus stop for the bus to Valencia opposite the campsite. The site is on the edge of the Albufera nature park featuring a wonderful lake and a range of water and songbirds.

Well maintained camping pitches

Devesa Gardens Resort is situated on a well maintained site with modern buildings and lovely trees. The camping pitches and bungalows give a well maintained impression. The pitches are large and in a quiet setting. All camping pitches have a good demarcation and you have the choice of pitches with and without shade. Sun canopies are available for the camping pitches during the summer. 

The campsite features nicely-furnished bungalows with a wonderful view over the vast rice fields. The newest bungalows are close to the restaurant.

Water fun for ten!

The campsite has a lovely swimming pool with a sunbathing lawn, featuring umbrellas, parasols and several loungers. The swimming paradise features many slides. The campsite has direct access to the Albufera lake, which means that you can take a boat trip along the rice fields from the campsite. The beach is within walking distance. 

Spanish cuisine

The campsite boasts a fabulous large terrace, a nice bar and an extensive menu. It has been well-equipped and serves traditional Spanish food such as paella, among other dishes. There is plenty of choice for kids too. The small supermarket is relatively well-stocked and contains everything you need to make a meal.

properties.name: Camping La Ca'
properties.description:
Lake Garda has been a very popular destination for years. On the west side of the lake, on a beautiful bank is where Campsite La Ca’ has been since 1954. This provides an extraordinary view of the surrounding hills. The campsite is a feast for the eyes, certainly for garden lovers, due to the wonderful planting, the sculptures in the borders and the lovely flowers that give the entire grounds a Mediterranean feel. It is only a short walk via the promenade by the lake to the lovely town of Padenghe sul Garda. You will also find great outdoor cafes and a supermarket within walking distance.

Private view guaranteed

Thanks to the location of the campsite, on a reasonably steep slope, most of the pitches offer glorious views over Lake Garda. You camp here on well-maintained grass fields with demarcated pitches with some shade. The size of the camping pitches varies. The campsite also rents out bungalows, which are spread out over the grounds. The three toilet and washing blocks are well maintained. You can also rent private toilet and washing facilities at La Ca’ campsite.

From the swimming pool to the lake

The first-class swimming pool also offers a view over the water of the beautiful lake. In the evenings, it is even more beautiful due to the lighting. There are numerous seats and a number of loungers around the swimming pool. Don’t forget your swimming cap if you use the swimming pool. From the campsite, you walk down a few steps to the shingle beach. There is a cycle and foot path between the beach and the campsite. If you want to go into the water it is sensible to wear water shoes.

properties.name: Camping Solcio
properties.description:
This small campsite in the north of Italy offers all you need during your camping holiday: natural surroundings, relaxation, and activities for the whole family. You can camp in amongst the trees here, or with a panoramic view of Lake Maggiore. You can paddle around in this lake, or sunbathe on one of the free sun loungers. Finish the day with a freshly-baked pizza in a restaurant that the locals flock to as well.

Tidy camping pitches with a panoramic view

Once you arrive at the campsite, you'll be warmly welcomed by the campsite owners. They'll help you find the perfect pitch. You'll quickly see that the camping grounds are very well maintained: the washing block is clean, and the paths and the beach are swept every day. The camping grounds are divided up into cosy sheltered pitches, with plenty of shade. Some of the pitches offer a view over the beautiful Lake Maggiore and the mountainous surroundings.

Something for everyone to do

Thanks to the many activities organised by the baby club, Solcio Campsite is a very family-friendly campsite. But it's not just families that stay here: couples, both young and old, as well as groups of friends. A lively mix of guests.

Get to know the surroundings

There are plenty of opportunities to get to know the surroundings. You can visit the town of Stesa by bike, and visit the romantic islands with ancient palaces. You can also go for a cruise on the huge lake. Tip: take the panorama train on the way back to see a totally different side to the lake.

properties.name: Pausado Camping Les Chênes Blancs
properties.description:
Camping Domaine des Chênes Blancs is situated in the Vaucluse. The camping is situated in the vicinity of Apt, a village that is known for its candied fruit. There are several villages in the vicinity, such as Rousillon and Gordes, definitely worth a visit. The Provence, the region in which the camp site is situated, is well known for its beautiful nature reserves and the large number of sights. All in all, plenty to do with the camp site as a base.

Between the vineyards and with lots of sun.

Domaine des Chênes Blancs is a quietly located camp site in the Luberon, surrounded by vineyards. The camp site is for a large part covered with oak trees which provide plenty of shade. The camping is primarily geared towards families. The camping has a relaxed atmosphere and you can let your children play on the grounds without any worries. With 300 days of sunshine each year, the camp site has a swimming pool to cool off.

Sports facilities: from jeu de boule to canyoning

In the multi-sports area you can play soccer, volley ball or tennis and activities are organised for children.

The snack bar next to the swimming pool and restaurants is open during the peak season. In the restaurant you can buy refreshments, dine or enjoy a delicious pizza. The camping shop, where you can find basic products, also has a bakery. Bread can be ordered one day in advance for the next morning.

properties.name: Camping Paradis Robinson
properties.description:
People who like to relax at the seaside and want a quiet camp site are at the right address at Camping Paradis Robinson. This campsite is situated between the Mediterranean and Lake Thau (or Bassin), well-known for its oyster and shellfish hatcheries. The camp site is situated on the canal which runs to the port of Marseillan-Plage and has direct access to the beach.

Pitch or accommodation

The pitches at Camping Robinson are demarcated. In addition to camping in your own tent or caravan, you can also spend your holidays in rental accommodation on this camp site. Would you like to spend the night in a tent, but have not brought all camping gear? Then you can camp in a fully equipped Coco Sweet tent. You can also choose from several special accommodation options. Opt for the Robinson or Crusoe mobile homes that have a roof terrace overlooking the sea. Or the Eden Spa mobile home with private jacuzzi.

Entertainment in optima forma

The camping has direct access to the sea. You can do stand-up paddling, water cycling or diving. Would you prefer to keep your feet dry? Then you can do horse riding in the vicinity or go to a climbing park. You can also relax in a beautifully designed swimming pool during your holiday at Camping Robinson. The bubble bath and small water features are very attractive. There is also a water playground.

Children can live it up at the Piki Club. The multilingual entertainment team arranges fun activities 5 days per week in peak season, such as baking workshops and conjuring tricks. Soccer tournaments, volley and hockey games are organised for young and old at the sports grounds.

properties.name: Camping Playa Taray
properties.description:
Fancy a nice beach holiday in a sunny destination? Then head to Campsite Playa Taray near La Redondela on the Costa de la Luz in Andalusia. It’s sunny here most of the time in the summer. Thanks to the Atlantic influences, it’s never too hot or muggy. The campsite has a great outdoor pool, a shop and a restaurant. There's a long, sandy beach 100 m away.

Which accommodation options are there?

Playa Taray is a well-organised campsite with permanent pitches and tourist pitches. Campers can also rent luxury bungalows, modern mobile homes and charming cabins.

Sandy beach, swimming pool, restaurant close by

This campsite’s location is ideal for lovers of beach life. A short walk through the pine forest brings you to the sandy beach of Playa de la Redondela. You can also take a refreshing dip in the campsite's outdoor pool. Near the pool, you will find a cosy beach bar where tasty snacks and drinks are available. Head to the campsite’s restaurant for an extensive meal.

Enjoy atmospheric coastal resorts

Beach life lovers will enjoy a visit to a great seaside resort. There are plenty of them in the area. The modern resort of La Antilla is five kilometres away. It has bars and restaurants and scenic boat trips along the coast. Isla Cristina is a ten-minute drive from the campsite. This is an authentic fishing village with a lively port on the Carreras River.

properties.name: Camping Mar Azul Balerma
properties.description:
On the south coast of Spain between the towns of Almeria and Motril in eastern Andalusia, you will find this newly constructed campsite. Camping Mar Azul Balerma offers its guests first class facilities on a level and open terrain. The fishing village of Balerma is only a short distance away and at approx. 10 km from the campsite you will find the attractive small town of Almerimar with a lively harbour packed with restaurants.

All possible flags of Europe welcome you from the through road, which runs parallel to the sea. The campsite is located a bit further off the road. The helpful Dutch owner has built a complete and relaxing campsite in a short period of time in a region which is very popular with hibernators. But also in summer months, this is a paradise. This is certainly the case for families, also due to the entertainment programme and the lovely swimming pool.

Palm trees

On campsite Mar Azul Balerma you can find sunny pitches everywhere and the vegetation is still young. Most of the pitches are provided with shade cloths. Pitches are given an extra tropical touch with a palm tree on each pitch. The pitches with loose gravel are located along several streets which are well-illuminated. If you are camping with a large motorhome (8-10 metres), please contact the campsite in advance.

In the centre of the campsite are a number of colourful wooden bungalows in a row.

Arabian atmosphere in the mountains

A short drive towards the north brings you to Granada where the Alhambra towers above the city. This impressive palace complex from the times of the Moors in on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

properties.name: Rapoca Camping Village
properties.description:
Rapoca Camping Village is situated in an atmospheric pine tree forest, directly on the sea, slightly north of the historical fishing town of Nezerine. You are camping here in the island of Lošinj, an ideal location for a beach holiday. There are numerous bustling towns and villages to visit in the island. Therefore, you will be able to soak up the culture as well. The large numbers of walking and cycling enthusiasts will certainly enjoy themselves here.

Camping in a pine tree forest

The grounds have been kept as natural as possible. There are a lot of pine trees which offer ample shade and the pitches are fairly spacious. The numerous permanent pitches, mostly occupied by lively families, have a dominant presence. The road to Nerezine runs along the campsite. If you want to hire accommodation, you can choose a mobile home or an apartment.

Entertainment

Children can enjoy themselves in the (small) playground and on the (beach) volleyball field. Entertainment is offered in high season. An attractive cycle and walking path runs along the campsite. The campsite has a small pebble beach, a small harbour and a slipway. The water is ideal for windsurfing and snorkelling enthusiasts.

Coffee bar and attractive harbour

On the campsite you will find a coffee bar and a small campsite shop with daily fresh bread. Looking for more action or shops? In the centre of Nerezine, within walking distance, there are numerous bars, restaurants and shops. Tip of the day: in the lively harbour of Nerezine there is a small bistro (Rio) where you can enjoy a lovely meal for a very reasonable price.

properties.name: Club del Sole Le Gorette Cecina Easy Cp Village
properties.description:
Delle Gorette Campsite is located in the beautiful hilly Tuscan landscape. The campsite location - among tall pine trees and on the fascinating Etruscan coast - is perfect for spending the hot Italian summer.

Camping and glamping

Delle Gorette Campsite offers different types of accommodation and pitches. The campsite consists of clearly marked shady places varying in size. There are also camping pitches for shorter stays and rental accommodations such as mobile homes, safari tents and modern apartments. You can also go to this campsite for a unique glamping experience!

Swimming and bubbling

During your stay at Delle Gorette, you have the luxury of being able to choose between a dive in the pool or the sea. You can reach the beach that gently slopes into the sea by walking a few minutes through the pine forest. The spacious pool has a slide and a toddler area. You can soak up the sun poolside. In the separate whirlpool, you can relax after a day full of activities!

Provided with all comforts

This campsite has everything you need for a relaxing holiday. Enjoy a summer drink at the cosy bar or have a bite to eat at the campsite restaurant. It is also possible to grab some tasty takeaway. There is a supermarket with an extensive range, and at the bakery and butcher, you can get fresh bread and meat. The animation team organizes fun activities daily in the high season. You'll be able to enjoy a variety of camping activities like table tennis and petanque at the sports fields. Many camping guests mention the perfectly maintained and clean sanitary facilities as an important plus point. It makes your camping holiday extremely comfortable.

properties.name: Camping Molino a Fuoco
properties.description:
Idyllically located against a pine tree forest and just one hundred metres from the beach on the Mediterranean Sea, with a trendy appearance: this is eco-campsite Molino a Fuoco. But the campsite has more to offer, such as an excellent Tuscan restaurant and a swimming paradise. This is the ideal location for families with children to enjoy a luxurious holiday. The campsite is pleasantly car-free. Obviously, your car is safely parked within the gates.

Flowering shrubs

There are 120 touring pitches, varying in size (depending on the degree of occupancy 40-75 m2 or more). These are partly in the shade and partly in the sun. The pitches have a hard surface of grass. You will see vegetation, flowering bushes and trees everywhere. As a result there is ample privacy. You can rent well equipped lodge tents as well as nice bungalows. The sanitary facilities at Molino a Fuoco are well equipped and spotless.

Paradise-like swimming

There is a gigantic swimming paradise (300 m2) with several pools, designed in the shape of an elongated 'bubble'. It is surrounded by a lovely lawn. You can also head for the shade of sun umbrellas and palm trees in a chair or on a lounger. These are grouped on the tiled terrace around the pools. There is a walking and cycling path directly from the campsite through the pine forest to the beach on the Mediterranean Sea.

Tuscan dining par excellence

The campsite restaurant, with spacious amiable terrace, has a very good reputation. Unadulterated enjoyment of the typical Tuscan dishes. The restaurant exudes an elegant atmosphere. It is advisable to dress accordingly. In the stylish bar you can also order a small snack besides your drink.

properties.name: Camping Le Parc de la Bastide
properties.description:
You will find Camping Parc de la Bastide amid the enchanting landscape of the Provence, surrounded by bamboo and Mediterranean tree species. This charming campsite near the town of Saint-Rémy-de-Provence is a true oasis of quiet, perfect for those seeking relaxation in the middle of the countryside. The campsite is close to Alpilles Regional Natural Park, where you can take spectacular walks past olive groves and vineyards and walk through the mountains.

Spacious pitches

The pitches at Camping Parc de la Bastide are spacious, and you have the freedom to choose your own pitch that suits your wishes. The pitches are level, shaded and demarcated by bamboo hedges, so you can enjoy your stay in complete privacy. Another option is to stay in a comfortable mobile home.

Versatile options for relaxation and entertainment

Whether you are seeking peace and quiet or like to be active, Camping Parc de la Bastide has something for everyone. The campsite is popular among families as well as seniors. With a refreshing swimming pool and comfortable sun loungers, you can nicely relax on a hot day. There is no entertainment programme but children get together on the trampoline or table tennis table or during a game of jeu de boules.

Fresh bread and chicken and chips

The staff at Camping Parc de la Bastide are extremely friendly and helpful, making you feel instantly welcome. Enjoy fresh bread, coffee biscuits and croissants in the mornings. Although there is no restaurant, on Sunday you can enjoy chicken and chips from the take-away kiosk.

properties.name: Camping Houtum
properties.description:
Camping Houtum is located in the Belgian Kempen, near Kasterlee. This medium sized campground is ideal for those seeking peace and quiet, hikers and nature lovers. In spring, all of Kasterlee is tinted orange during the pumpkin festivals. The high point is the pumpkin regatta, where participants kayak down the river in a hollowed out pumpkin.

Charming atmosphere

The campground is located on a little river in an extensive forest and heath area, the warmest place in Belgium in the summer. The reception is located in a modern building surrounded by greenery.

The campground has little definition between the campsites, so there is an open and convivial atmosphere. If you need more shade or privacy, you should bring a parasol and/or windscreen.

Fun for discovery and play

Children can play for ours in the indoor and outdoor playground. There are also great things to do in the area, such as in the Forest of the Gnomes. The Bobbejanland fun park is nearly around the corner (6 km). Curious and sporty campers can participate in a treasure hunt, geocaching, cycling or kayaking in the natural area around Kasterlee.

A lovely nibble

Campingcafé De Congé looks charming , light and airy. Here you can order coffee, tea and snacks (also to take away). There are regular organized activities as well as pool, dancing and bingo. Outside there is a lovely terrace where the fire baskets are lit when the evenings cool off. The campground does not have a shop (supermarket 1 km away), but you can order bread rolls.

Well organised

The bathroom facility is new and modern and is kept spic and span. There are also bathroom facilities for the disabled. There is free wifi all over the campground, with nearly all areas having good reception.

properties.name: Camping Seehäusl
properties.description:
Camping Seehäusl is in Germany’s Bavaria, right on the Chiemsee. Here, you camp with the meadows and trees on one side with the expansive lake on the other. A beautiful spot for people looking for peace and quiet and for nature lovers wanting to spend their holidays in southern Germany. Go explore the beautiful surrounding area and enjoy all the beauty that Bavaria has to offer.

Camping next to the Chiemsee

You camp here at a small-scale, basic campsite in a green setting. The pitches are grassy and separated at the back by hedges. The roads are partially paved. A few pitches have a view of the lake, others overlook the meadows or the edge of the woods.

It is easy to wander to the lake and take a refreshing diver from the jetty. There is plenty for nature lovers to do in the area surrounding the campsite. Wander through the beautiful valley, along the banks of the lake or head into the mountains. End your day with a delicious pizza at the campsite restaurant.

A day in Munich or Salzburg

You will find lots of history, culture and charming catering establishments in the Bavarian capital city Munich (94.5 km). The main square, the Marienplatz, is a popular spot where you can admire the impressive Neues Rathaus (New Town Hall) with its famous clockwork. The Englischer Garten (English Garden) is one of the largest city parks in the world. It is also the perfect place to relax and to enjoy nature. The Austrian city of Salzburg (55 km) is also definitely worth a visit.

properties.name: Villaggio Camping Mimosa
properties.description:
In the southernmost province of Italy, Calabria, Mimosa Village Campsite has a great location on the Tyrrhenian Sea. This area is also known as the green coast of Calabria, and it shows in the exceptional landscapes and beautiful beaches. Sicily is easily accessible from the campsite, as is the unique volcanic island of Stromboli. There are several small villages near the campsite, such as Rosarno and Nicotera, and you'll find plenty of supermarkets and lively restaurants here. This charming campsite has been run by a very friendly family for more than 40 years. They've landscaped the grounds beautifully, with many oleanders, eucalyptus trees, olive trees, palm trees, and of course the Mimosa tree.

Camping in an orange orchard

The mostly flat pitches are very spacious by Italian standards. There are pitches under the trees, in a small orchard, or in an open field. In places with less natural shade, canvas has been stretched over them to give shade. There are also various accommodation options to rent. For instance, a fully equipped caravan, where you can enjoy the outdoor life thanks to its outdoor kitchen, and the veranda.

A picture of a sunset

The walk to the sea from the campsite is on a beautiful path, and you'll soon see the blue water sparkling before you. The private beach is a great place to while away the time at dusk, and watch a beautiful sunset. During the day, the sandy beach is a place to enjoy sun, sea and sand on the free sunbeds provided. If you prefer to swim in the beach, this is just a stone's throw from the beach.

properties.name: Wald- und Seeblick Camp Zislow
properties.description:
Nature as far as the eye can see: forests, meadows and a grand view of the lakes reflecting the surrounding landscape... That is what you will find on this simple, yet very rural campsite, situated directly on the Plauer See (in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern). You can choose your own pitch on Wald- und Seeblick Camp, and usually, you will be able to find one on the lake. Definitely bring your fishing rod with you!

Beautiful pitches by the lake

The campsite grounds are reasonably large, with 180 seasonal pitches for permanent campers and 220 touring pitches. The layout is simple and welcoming, without any bells and whistles. The pitches that you can freely choose from are spacious. Everyone will be able to find a pitch close to the lake or at least have a good view of the lake. You camp on a beautiful grassy pitch with quite a lot of trees and shrubs.

Time to hit the water!

The Plauer See is ideal for going swimming. There is also a sandy beach. You can reach the water's edge just by crossing the campsite on foot. There are plenty of water sports options available: windsurfing, water skiing, scuba diving and sailing. Taking your own motor or sailing yacht (up to 10 metres) with you is allowed, and even considered normal here. There is a sports field and also a playground for the children.

Food and drink

In Malchow (12 km) and Waren (32 km), you will find shops and supermarkets for your (main) grocery shopping. The campsite itself has a simple supermarket (with daily fresh bread). There is a small restaurant with a light menu and the snack bar is open in the summer months. The catering facilities on this campsite are very welcoming!

properties.name: X-Camping Dolomites
properties.description:
Have a great nature holiday in the Dolomites at X-Camping Dolomites, near Deutschnofen (South Tyrol). Here, you will camp in a quiet spot in the Eggental. This valley is surrounded by mighty mountains, which you will have great view of from your pitch. There are plenty of hiking and mountain biking-routes and other mountain sports opportunities. The Obereggen ski area is only 10 km away as well.

Sunny terrace pitches with mountain view

At this small campsite, you will camp on a sunny pitch with hard standing and clear demarcation. There are 5 categories of touring pitches: S, M, L, XL and XXL. Which pitch is best for you depends on the length of your vehicle. The S pitches are equipped for vehicles or vehicle combinations with a maximum length of 6 m, while XXL can handle up to 12 metres. Thanks to its terraced layout, all the pitches have great views of the forested mountains around the Eggental.

Sauna, swimming pond and cosy bistro

Returning to the campsite after a challenging hike or an exciting mountain bike tour? The Finnish sauna is the ideal place to unwind. Or take a refreshing dip in the clean water of the swimming pond from the jetty. Afterwards, cosy up in the atmospheric bistro. This excellent restaurant at X-Camping Dolomites serves typical South Tyrolean specialities; classics famous internationally are on the menu as well. You are also welcome there for a hearty breakfast, a savoury snack, a sweet treat or (on Sundays) a extensive brunch.

properties.name: Campingplatz An der Havel
properties.description:
Located in a quiet nature area near Ketzin in Brandenburg, Germany, Campingplatz An der Have offers a serene camping experience right by River Havel. This location is ideal for nature and water sports lovers, with a nearby beach by the river and options for various water sports. Cycling fans can enjoy the beautiful river cycling path Havelradweg.

Open site with neat grassy pitches

The campsite, known for its hospitable atmosphere, has spacious tourist pitches and permanent annual pitches on an open site with neat grassy fields. Besides camping pitches, the campsite also offers mobile homes and caravans for rent. All campers have access to a modern and well-maintained toilet block.

Plenty of swimming fun at Ketziner Havelstrand

Ketziner Havelstrand is right next to the campsite, where guests can safely swim in a cordoned off part of the river. The beach also has amenities such as a snack bar, beach volleyball field and has rowing boats, canoes and stand-up paddleboards for rent.

Order breakfast at reception

Guests can order fresh bread from reception for breakfast. For more extensive grocery shopping, Ketzin, with various supermarkets, is only a kilometre away from the campsite.

Ideal starting point for day trips to Berlin

Campingplatz An der Havel is also an excellent starting point for day trips to Berlin, with easy access to public transport for visiting famous sights such as Brandenburger Tor and the Reichstag.

properties.name: Baia Saraceno Camping
properties.description:
On the paradise that is the Emerald Coast, also called the Gold Coast of Sardinia, you will find an abundance of beautiful beaches. Here you camp in a diverse region with a landscape full of olive and eucalyptus trees. Camping Baia Saraceno is designed to be in harmony with the natural surroundings and offers an idyllic view over the rocks and hills. The campsite has a restaurant that is universally acclaimed.

Photogenic

From the cosy little port town of Palau, the path leads to the entrance of the campsite. The attractive reception building will then come into view. The helpful staff speak English well. The small shop offers a reasonable assortment. There is a fun playground for the smallest campers.

Between the granite boulders

Various terraces offer a view of the sea. A number of pitches are sheltered by bamboo stands. There are rocks scattered around the grounds that lend an extra dimension to the camping feeling. There is a separate car park for the cars, which makes for a safe camping area. Campers may park their accommodation in a separate field.

The cosy, round cottages (called tukuls) are spread out over the grounds and are a a feast for the eyes. Other well-maintained bungalows are a fine place to spend the night, as well.

Swimming in the clear sea

You can be walking into the crystal clear water in just a few steps. For the adults, white sandy beaches are just a ten-minute walk away. Take note of Spiaggia Liscia and Spiaggia del Principe, which are absolutely worth exploring. Snorkellers can discover a submarine world along this coast. Campers who want to go diving can get a nice discount at the local diving school.

properties.name: Acapulco Camping
properties.description:
Camping Acapulco is centrally located along the Costa Smeralda, in the north of the magnificent island of Sardinia. It enjoys a landscape setting of crystal-clear waters, countless bays and granite rock formations. The beach is just a few steps from your tent, where you can enjoy a spectacular panoramic view of the three islands off the coast. The charming restaurant serves local fish specialities.

Between the rocks

What makes camping here extra special is the different pitches available. Each pitch is different both in terms of size and layout. You can pick out a pitch yourself, and some reed stands and trees offer pleasant shade. Some pitches are separated by large rocks, but there are no demarcated pitches here. Besides the camping pitches, there are also charming white cottages on the grounds you can rent. The campsite's terrace with a view of see is a perfect spot to sit and read.

Surfing and diving

Swimming in the crystal clear water is a daily treat. Still, many visitors don't just like swimming, as this part of the island is very popular with watersports enthusiasts. There's also surfing, snorkelling, sailing and diving from the pearl white beaches. Porto Pollo, to the west of Palau, is a famous surfing paradise. On the neighbouring La Sciumara beach, campers enjoy a discount for a variety of watersport lessons.

Fresh fish or pizza?

The large restaurant with many windows and terrace offers a view of the National Park with the Magdalena Islands. The restaurant's décor alone makes it worth a visit. It is designed in a Mexican style, where you can enjoy either fresh-made pizza or Italian cuisine with seafood.

properties.name: Camping Miramare
properties.description:
On the Tuscan coast, close to tourist cities such as Pisa, Lucca and Livorno, you will find Camping Miramare. At this campsite you camp directly on the rocky coast of the Mediterranean Sea. The most beautiful camping spots are right by the sea: delimited comfort pitches with a beautiful view over the water and a private terrace. The campsite has a swimming pool.

Camping at the entrance or by the sea

The campsite has different characters. If you are on a touring pitch close to the entrance, you may occasionally be bothered by the busy road next to the campsite and the tracks behind it. At the back of the campsite you'll find the most beautiful spots: comfort pitches with a view of the Mediterranean Sea and a private terrace. More expensive than the other touring pitches, but worth the money.

View over the Mediterranean Sea

From the entrance of camping Miramare you still look out on the hills, the view on the other side of the camping is completely different. Here you can sit on a bench on a higher part for a beautiful view over the Mediterranean Sea. But also directly at the water there are seats waiting for you. Via a staircase you reach the land border, which doesn't serve as a soft sandy beach, but as a rocky coast.

Seafood and pizza

If you are camping in Italy by the Mediterranean Sea, you can expect delicious seafood. Next to the swimming pool is the campsite's restaurant, where seafood is the centre of the dishes. But of course you can also taste different pizzas and the youngest guests will be taken into account.

properties.name: Camping Alexa
properties.description:
Camp on top of a high cliff with stunning views of the Baltic Sea. That's what you can expect at Camping Alexa in Polish Pomerania. Peace and nature play a major role at this spacious campsite. Children can have fun in the playground or play a game of mini golf. Fun activities for all ages are organised regularly. For a tasty meal, you can head to the restaurant. Fancy a day out? The colourful, historic city of Gdańsk (69 km) is nearby.

Spacious, well-maintained campsite

When you arrive at Camping Alexa, you can already see the sea in the distance. You can choose from various sized camping pitches, ranging from 80 to 120 m². You camp on a nice grassy field. The sanitary facilities are modern, well maintained and are kept clean. There are also sanitary facilities for families with babies and for disabled people.

Great views of the sea

The absolute highlight of this campsite is its location. Camping Alexa is located on top of a cliff directly on the Baltic Sea. This gives you a fantastic view. Of course you can also go to the beach for a wonderful day of swimming, building sandcastles and sunbathing.

Sports and games for all ages

There is an activities team that organises fun activities for children during high season. Children will also have a great time in the fun playground. Or how about a game of mini golf or volleyball? In the summer, the campsite also organises fun sports activities for adults, such as zumba or outdoor fitness on the beach.

properties.name: Tiliguerta Glamping & Camping Village
properties.description:
This paradise-like camping ground is located on the beautiful island of Sardinia in Italy. The wooded campground gradually melds into the beach and offers a magnificent view from the many overnight campsites. You can enjoy both an active and a relaxing holiday at this camping ground due to the many facilities and activities offered there.

You will find Tiliguerta Glamping & Camping Village along the white sandy beaches of Costa Rei in the south of Sardinia. The campsite is easy to reach because it is just a few minutes by car from the provincial road.

Camping on the beach

Most of the pitches are in the shade of the many eucalyptus and pine trees. The closer you get to the sea, the greater the feeling you get that you're camping on the beach. The ground becomes increasingly sandy and the trees gradually thin: you can enjoy the wonderful view! The rental accommodations, such as the bungalows and mobile home, also offer beautiful views of the clear blue sea.

Dining for any diet

With yoga, pilates and Ayurveda it is of course also important to keep the inner person happy. You can prepare your own fresh meal with local and organic products that are available in the supermarket at the campsite. You will also be spoiled for choice in the restaurant with pizzeria. We've thought of everything, as vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free meals are available.

Dogs are more than welcome

Dogs in all shapes and sizes are heartily welcome in Tiliguerta Glamping & Camping Village. In the summer, dog shows are organised and there is a special beach where dogs can run, play and swim.

properties.name: Camping Grubhof
properties.description:
A stay at Campsite Park Grubhof can easily be called luxury camping. Here you will find plenty of peace and quiet, spacious pitches in a large park, a great restaurant and beautiful, clean sanitary facilities. For example, part of the sanitary facilities has been renovated in 2021 and equipped with XXL bathrooms. You can lock and unlock these with a pass. You will also receive a Summer Card from the campsite. With this card you can use the cable car, the bus, the swimming pool and many other activities free of charge. This service and many other advantages make the Grubhof a popular and award-winning campsite. From 2017 to 2020 Camping.Info even voted Grubhof the best campsite in Europe!

Clean all over

On the campsite, paved roads lead to spacious pitches, some of which are located along the river and with a view of the mountains. The pitches have sewage connection and electricity. The campsite also has a number of very luxurious rental log cabins. The grounds are beautifully laid out and are well maintained.

Fine food and wellness

In the large authentic farmhouse, where the reception is housed as well, there is a well-stocked supermarket and fresh bakery. There is also a good quality restaurant with Austrian but also Italian and European dishes. On the first floor is a large wellness section for guests.

Luxury bathroom facilities

The sanitary facilities are houses in three buildings, which are very spacious and luxuriously finished, with large shower areas and generous toilets. You can also rent private sanitary rooms.

Swimming

Although Park Grubhof is a quiet campsite without much entertainment, a number of activities are available for children: a trampoline, soccer field and table tennis table. The river on the campsite is not really suitable for swimming, but in July and August you have free access to the swimming pool of Lofer (2 km).

properties.name: Moselcamping Rissbach
properties.description:
At Moselcamping Rissbach in Traben-Trabach, you are in the heart of the Moselle. You camp directly on the river and in the midst of beautiful German nature. At this real family campsite, there is something for everyone. From relaxing in nature and cultural trips to beautiful bike rides and fun in and on the water.

Plenty of camping choice

From the reception you drive along the Moselle to your camping spot. The camping pitches are located in three rows along the river. You can choose from places with or without demarcation. The amount of shade also varies for each pitch. Anyone without their own camping equipment can sleep comfortably in a wooden wine barrel.

The campsite has a restaurant with a modest menu. There is also a small supermarket with basic necessities. The centre of Traben-Trarbach is a five-minute drive away, where you will find plenty of shops and restaurants.

Plenty of water fun!

Water fun is of course guaranteed at a campsite right on the river. You can swim, sail, fish and even water ski in and on the Moselle. Or grab your camping chair and watch the passing boats together. Prefer the swimming pool? No problem! Young and old can relax in the heated outdoor swimming pool and toddlers' pool.

Wines, wines, wines

The town of Traben-Trarbach was one of the most important wine trading towns in Europe in 1900. The town still has the highest concentration of wine cellars in all of Germany. With numerous guided tours, wine tastings and walks through vineyards, you will reap the rewards! The campsite itself stores various wines in a cellar and regularly organises tastings.

properties.name: BurgStadt CampingPark
properties.description:
Camping Burgstadt lies in the beautiful town of Kastellaun with a historical centre. Camping Burgstadt is a fantastic place for those looking for peace and quiet and is yet to be discovered by the public at large. Adults with children from the age of 14 are welcome here. On the same grounds, there is also a large hotel which offers its facilities to camping guests as well (restaurant, wellness, fitness).

You register at the hotel reception. You will be warmly welcomed here. The first thing you will notice is the tranquillity. The grounds have a park-like appearance with some terraces and surrounded by trees and shrubs.

Where is your pitch?

BurgStadt has some 100 pitches, loosely demarcated. The pitches are spacious to very spacious (depending on bookings), are on level grounds, partly on terraces and are well-maintained. Trees are not in abundance and as a result, finding a pitch with a lot of shade is not easy. The pathways in between are wide and paved. The sides are bordered by bushes or other nice greenery. Each pitch has power and water connections: you pay on departure according to consumption. The surface is paved and consists of a layer of grit, through which grass grows. There are hardly any facilities for children, as children under 14 are not catered for. The only alternative overnight facility is the adjacent hotel.

Eating and drinking

The campsite does not have a camping shop, you can do your grocery shopping in the large supermarket, next to the campsite. However, fresh rolls are available at the hotel from half past six in the morning. You can have a delicious (Greek) meal in the hotel or go to the Biergarten.

properties.name: Europacamping Nommerlayen
properties.description:
Nommerlayen is a large campsite in the heart of Luxembourg, highly suitable for active campers, especially for families with children of all ages. There is plenty to do in terms of sport, play and fun on the water, and adults can enjoy a range of wellness facilities. The area is also highly suited for activities: visit castles and cities or hike and cycle through the surprisingly pristine nature.

Camping or renting?

Nommerlayen is a large campsite with many centrally-located amenities such as a swimming pool and catering facilities. The further you camp from this central part, the quieter the campsite gets. The camping pitches provide the necessary privacy thanks to the hedges and differences in height. The flat portions have larger pitches but less of a nice view.

There is plenty of rental accommodation on Europacamping Nommerlayen. These include luxury furnished mobile homes, cottages, chalets and hire tents, all spread out in groups over the site.

From toddler pool to Turkish steam bath

The campsite offers something for everyone: entertainment for children, a heated 50-metre bath and well-organised sport activities. In addition to the 50-metre bath, you can have fun in the water in a playful outdoor swimming pool. There is also a lovely water playground for toddlers and infants. A number of deckchairs can be found along the side. The wellness area with solarium, sauna, Turkish steam bath, whirlpool and fitness equipment is very special.

A nice glass of wine on the terrace

There is a small supermarket on the campsite in which you can buy essentials. Fresh bread is available in the mornings, although reservation is recommended. It is also advisable to make a reservation for the popular restaurant. The fantastic wine menu is especially delightful. You can also sit at the bar or on the large, cosy terrace.

properties.name: Camping Sunêlia Domaine de Champé
properties.description:
Sunêlia Domaine de Champé campsite is located in the Vosges, at the foot of the Col de Bussang. On this quiet campsite, you can camp on the shore of the Moselle where it's still more like a gently flowing stream. The structured camping area is a good place to stay, with camping pitches and mobile homes with mountain views. You can also look out on the mountain peaks from the terrace of the cosy café.

Camping by the Moselle?

110 well-maintained, grassy camping pitches overlook the surrounding mountains. The most beautiful camping pitches can be found by the stream, which flows right through the campsite. At first glance this stream doesn't seem like anything special, but it is nothing less than the Moselle. In addition to the camping pitches, the campsite has various rental accommodations: lodge tents, mobile homes and modern bungalows.

Swimming and building dams

The outdoor swimming pool is located next to the entrance to the campsite. You can take a dip or sunbathe on the edge of the pool while enjoying a beautiful view of the mountains. Children especially appreciate the large water slide. The stream that flows through the campsite is also a good playground for the young camping guests.

Cosy heart of the campsite

The café is the cosy heart of the campsite. In this log cabin, typical of the region, you can sit with a drink at the bar or have a relaxed, leisurely dinner in a cosy atmosphere. It's also lovely to sit on the covered terrace. Specialities from the Vosges are served here and for the children there is a special children's menu. On many summer evenings, the café is graced by live concerts and karaoke.

properties.name: Camping La Tamarissière
properties.description:
The French Camping La Tamarissière is a family campsite in Agde (Hérault). Here you will camp in an old pine forest and by a river. The surroundings consist of mountains, but you are also close to the Mediterranean Sea. With all these ingredients, it is here for peace and quiet seekers and nature lovers to enjoy. From the campsite, you can walk straight onto the sandy beach for a swim or to laze about.

Surrounded by nature

The grounds of this wooded campsite are natural. Therefore, there are only a few paved paths. Because of its location between high pine trees, there are many shady camping spots. Those without their own camping equipment can stay in a furnished lodge tent or chalet.

Plenty of water!

Although the campsite itself does not have a swimming pool, there is no shortage of water. Go for a swim in the sea or play by the river which flows next to the campsite. Nearby, there are several water sport opportunities, and a visit to the large Étang de Thau - an inner lake where you can enjoy oysters - is also worthwhile!

Entertainment and restaurant

The entertainment team is ready with fun activities for young and old, from sports competitions to fun theme nights. Or enjoy a game of table tennis, pétanque or football. Feeling peckish? The campsite has a bar and a restaurant with a terrace. Less than five minutes' walk from the campsite, you will find a nice street with many more nice restaurants on the water. Many campers visit the castle with its Domaine Preignes Le Vieux vineyards.

properties.name: Camping Fuentes Blancas
properties.description:
City campsite Fuentes Blancas is ideally located for a visit to Burgos, a city steeped in history, evidenced today by a baroque cathedral and impressive archaeological museum. From the campsite you can cycle to the city centre along the beautiful Arlazón river. There is also a beach in the vicinity.

Shaded by deciduous trees

The campsite is mainly frequented by camping guests wanting to visit Burgos or for overnight accommodation. You can choose your own pitch on the woody, neat-looking grounds, which are level and offer ample shade. This is as a result of the many deciduous trees. The pitches are located on turf in rows along paved roads. Rental bungalows are available, if you do not have a tent, caravan or motorhome.

Shallow swimming pool

The rectangular (shallow) swimming pool in full sun is located in a corner of the campsite. The area around the swimming section is tiled. There are no loungers or sun umbrellas, but you can bring your own camping chair. There is a playground for children. Entertainment is offered in high season.

Reasonably priced dishes

The campsite has a bar-restaurant and a small shop. Each day, the restaurant offers one or two local dishes of good quality, which taste even better because they are reasonable in price. It can get pretty busy over weekends. Adjacent to the campsite is a large public barbecue area. The campsite shop stocks a reasonable selection. There is also a bread service.

properties.name: Camping Drepanos
properties.description:
Do you want to enjoy the sand, sea and quiet? And all of this in the shelter of a nature area? If so, go to camping Drepanos, a few km from the harbour town of Igoumenitsa, in the north-west of Greece. The campsite is situated virtually at the end of a crescent-shaped peninsula. A remarkable feature is the position of the campsite: directly along a long, slightly sloping sandy beach. So, from your tent you can walk straight onto the beach.

Shade of the eucalyptus

The surface is hard and the pitches are not demarcated. The pitches which are directly situated along the beach are more or less demarcated; these offer a wide view over the sea. From the beach you can see the ferries from and to Igoumenitsa. There are tall eucalyptus trees on the campsite.

Your fellow guests

Your camping neighbours form an international and colourful group of people who are not very demanding as far as luxury or perfect maintenance is concerned. During the weekend you will also see many Greeks from the city to spend a few peaceful days.

Azure sea

A swimming pool is superfluous here. From your pitch you just walk onto the beach and straight into the sea. On the (child-friendly) beach you can chill on the blue sun loungers under a white sun umbrella; an attractive colour palette with the azure sea in the background. There is also a lovely beach bar.

Fine local dishes

The much frequented restaurant (comprehensive menu) is also popular with guests from outside the campsite. From the restaurant terrace you have a view of the campsite (one side) and the sea (the other side). For many guests, good food and a relaxed atmosphere compensate the otherwise basic amenities.

properties.name: Kompas Camping Westende
properties.description:
Not far from Nieuwpoort, on the Belgian North Sea coast, you will find Kompas Camping Westende. The campsite is not located directly on the beach, but this can easily be reached on foot. Just be careful when crossing the N34 and the coastal tramway. Camping Westende is a large, well maintained family campsite with spacious pitches and a wide selection of rental accommodation.

Family campsite

The pitches on Kompas Camping Westende are spacious and it is evident that in high season mainly Belgian and Dutch families with children visit this campsite. There is a lovely water playground for children and numerous activities are organised during the Belgian school holidays. There are also special family sanitary facilities.

Fresh fish and Belgian beers

The campsite restaurant, BAS. Grill & terrace, has a menu with a wide range of delicious dishes. You can go there for dinner, but also for a typical Belgian pint. Belgian 'frietjes' (chips) and other snacks are available from the chip shop on the campsite.

properties.name: Kompas Camping Nieuwpoort
properties.description:
Kompas Camping Nieuwpoort is a spacious and well maintained family campsite near the coast of the well-known town of Nieuwpoort. The beach and boulevard of Nieuwpoort-Bad are tourist attractions, as is the large marina. On this campsite there is plenty to do for families with children up to the age of 12.

Well maintained, spacious campsite

You arrive at a large camping which makes a well maintained impression. Lots of families stay on the well maintained campsite; a real family campsite. The pitches are spacious and attractively laid out, so that it is easy to find a pitch with any type of camping gear. It soon becomes obvious that many camping guests are regular visitors. This makes for a amicable atmosphere.

Perfect for families

The swimming pool and entertainment are mainly aimed at children. Children can play inside and outside and there is also a sports field and a MTB track for the youth. During Belgian school holidays there is a daily entertainment programme for young and old. The campsite has two swimming pools, one children's pool and a lovely water slide. It is best to go by bicycle or take the car to get to the beach and boulevard at Nieuwpoort-Bad. The recreation lake is also easy to reach.

Wide and fresh selection

The brasserie and snack bar offers a wide choice of dishes and snacks, including Flemish 'frieten', of course. Take-away is also possible. You can do your grocery shopping in the well-stocked supermarket. Moreover, the campsite has its own bakery with daily fresh bread and rolls. The sanitary facilities are clean and well maintained.

properties.name: Selema Camping
properties.description:
The friendly Selema Campsite is situated on a magnificent location on the east coast of the Italian island of Sardinia. You are staying amidst a pine tree forest with both the Mediterranean Sea and the picturesque fishing village of Santa Lucia within walking distance (200 m). There are ample walking options in the area. The shallow sea is very suitable for small children.

Shady pine tree forest

The shaded grounds make for an enjoyable stay. You are standing in a dense pine tree forest where you can stay comfortably, even on very hot days. The pitches vary in size and the pathways to the pitches are narrow. Want to hire something? You can book a modern mobile home or bungalow.

Swimming pool and beach with surf pool

The splendid swimming pool is in an idyllic setting. It has a playful design and is partly in the shade. There is a separate toddler pool with a depth of sixty cm. It is surrounded by lawns with shade from olive trees and a terrace with loungers. Rather watch the horizon and sunbathe on the beach? No problem! Near the beach you will also find a sailing and windsurfing school.

Tennis court

There is a small playground for the little ones. Older campers can hit a few balls on the tennis court or go to the sports fields. The wooded area offers a large number of walking possibilities.

Delicious pizzas

The cosily furnished restaurants with extensive menu has a large terrace and a bar. You can enjoy delicious pizzas there. The campsite shop only offers the bare necessities and a few beach items. In Santa Lucia, at a distance of some two hundred metres, there are a number of restaurants and several small shops.

properties.name: Le Grand Large
properties.description:
Campsite Le Grand Large is located on the west coast of the Cotentin peninsula, in the dunes of Normandy. You camp among the dunes, with a wide sandy beach. The campsite exudes order and tranquillity, with manicured lawns that are demarcated by hedges. At the campsite you can swim in an outdoor pool, a heated indoor pool with sliding roof and a paddling pool.

Orderly and peaceful campsite

The campsite is clearly arranged. There are camping pitches on either side of the lanes, which are delimited by hedges. The camping pitches are all the same size. This fixed pattern offers not only orderliness, but also privacy and tranquillity. There are fifty rental accommodations on the edge of the campsite.

Swimming pools

The swimming pools are located directly to the right of the entrance. This water park consists of three pools: an outdoor pool, a heated indoor pool with sliding roof and a paddling pool. Along the edges are sunbeds for sun worshippers. You'll also find the large paddling pool. Furthest from the entrance is the heated indoor pool with sliding roof, where you can also relax in the bubbles of the whirlpool. A small snack bar with terrace is adjacent to the pools.

Just sanitary

The large sanitary building is located at the front of the campsite. In this building, partly made of brick, partly made of natural stone, you will find neatly grouped sanitary facilities. Plants and flowers provide a colourful atmosphere in the sanitary spaces.

properties.name: Camping Playa Arenillas
properties.description:
The Playa Arenillas campsite is half an hour's drive from the beautiful city of Bilbao. In total, this campsite has 120 pitches and some rental options: two mobile homes and six tents. When the tide is low, a sandy beach appears next to the campsite. A little further is another sandy beach. There are various beautiful cycling and walking routes around the campsite. The children will also enjoy themselves on the large playground. In the morning you can go to the campsite for fresh bread and in the evening the paella is recommended in the campsite restaurant.

Accommodation options

The flat terrain of the campsite is subdivided into different pitches. Regular guests are generally more at the back and tourist pitches are at the front of the campsite. The site has large plots with space for 120 pitches. The sanitation is neatly arranged by the campsite staff. There are also some rental options. The campsite has a total of two mobile homes, with two rooms and a kitchenette. And the campsite also has six tents available.

Beaches

Right next to the campsite, at the foot of a high mountain, a sandy beach appears at low tide. A normal sandy beach is about one kilometre away. At high tide this is the ideal terrain for surfers. Surfboards can be rented at the campsite for a fun day.

Entertainment

Children will have fun at the campsite's large playground. They can clamber in the play equipment or play a game of table tennis. There are also various walking and cycling routes around the campsite. These routes are of medium difficulty and ideal for exploring the neighbourhood.

properties.name: Camping Tredue
properties.description:
Campsite Tredue is in the charming seaside town of Sottomarina, about 50 km from Venice. This campsite is the ideal starting point for a day trip to Venice but also for a great beach holiday. You'll camp here near a kilometre-long sandy beach on the Adriatic Sea. Facilities on the campsite itself include a large outdoor swimming pool with paddling pool, a shop, a good restaurant, various sports and play facilities and entertainment for campers of all ages.

Neat pitches with natural boundaries

Driving onto this campsite, you will pass some annual pitches. You will then see the tourist pitches. These are neatly laid out, well-maintained and demarcated by hedges, trees and bushes. In summer, shade nets are hang up over many pitches for some extra shelter from the bright sun. Modern mobile homes and chalets are also available to rent at Tredue campsite.

Enjoy a swim in the pool or sea

This campsite’s location is perfect for beach lovers. Because you walk straight out onto a kilometre-long sandy beach. On this beach, the campsite has a private zone with play equipment, a beach volleyball court, sun loungers and parasols. Or take refreshing dip in the large outdoor pool on the campsite itself.
