This water park has a paddling pool and slide, fun for the youngest campers! Tredue also has a shop and a good restaurant. Also, there’s all-day entertainment for the whole family in the summer.

Visit Venice or Padua

Venice is one of the world’s most extraordinary cities. It’s just under an hour away from the campsite by car. Padua – another charming city with beautiful architecture – is a similar distance away.

properties.name: Camping Calabrisella
properties.description:
Camping Calabrisella is situated in the extreme south of the boot of Italy, by the Ionian Sea between the towns of Catanzaro Lido en Santa Maria del Mare Torrazzo This region of Italy is called Calabria. If you like peace and quiet, very old buildings and white sandy beaches, this is your ideal camping spot.

Beautiful pitches

The roads and pathways on this charming family campsite are in good condition. The camping pitches vary in size. They are all located in a large pine forest, descending to the sea with its sandy beach. A few lucky campers may even secure a pitch only five metres away from the beach. The campsite also rents out caravans, mobile homes and well-equipped apartments with private terrace.

Pizza and more

The campsite restaurant offers dishes that are prepared with local produce. The menu varies from day to day. It goes without saying that the menu features various types of pizza. There is a bar and you will find a small kiosk on the beach. In addition, the campsite has a motorhome service area, a laundry and an ironing service. The camping shop stocks a limited range of groceries.

Water fun, disco and sports

Sports like windsurfing, snorkelling, waterskiing and sailing are all allowed near the campsite. But there is also plenty to do on the campsite itself during the months of July and August. Entertainment is then provided by a (German-speaking) entertainment team. The campsite has a mini club (in Italian) for young children. Older youth will appreciate the disco most of all.

Sports activities such as table tennis, on the multi-sports field and beach volleyball are also available. Are you into mountain biking? If you are, get out and explore the routes through the pine forest along the sea.

properties.name: Camping Aranjuez by Samay
properties.description:
In central Spain, just south of Madrid, lies Camping Internacional Aranjuez. It is in a central location, convenient for exploring the versatile region. The Rio Tajo river, which flows behind the campsite, is located between the enormous park of the Royal Palace of Aranjuez and the campsite. It is a 30-minute walk to this most important landmark of Aranjuez. The capital can easily be reached by public transport.

Shade and comfort

There is definitely a suitable pitch for each camper on the campsite. There are three different types of pitches in terms of size, on a surface of grass or pebbles and demarcated with hedges and vegetation. When you enter the campsite, the comfort pitches can be found on the right hand side of the grounds. The level of shelter on the touring pitches is variable as is the presence of a private tap. There is a separate street with twenty wooden bungalows suitable for 5 persons. The campsite also has 10 rooms available for rent.

Fun in the water

The swimming pool complex consists of three beautiful pools. The shallow children's pools are equipped with nice play equipment and several slides. After a city visit it is a great place to relax in the sun or in the shade. From your easy chair it is only a few steps to the nearby bar. At times during the summer months some entertainment is offered near the pool during the day. The lifeguard keeps an eye on the children and is in charge of the First Aid post.

properties.name: Camping La Sousta
properties.description:
Campsite La Sousta can be found between Avignon and Nîmes, within walking distance of the famous Pont du Gard. This four-star campsite near Remoulins is laid out in the forest on the banks of the Gardon River. The many facilities at this family campsite guarantee a comfortable and exciting holiday for the whole family.

Nature and fun

The large camping area of campsite La Sousta extends over twelve acres, and consists mainly of spacious touring pitches. There are two hundred and sixty pitches for touring campers. They are nicely distributed throughout the forest or along the river, and are playfully laid out on the natural terrain. No straight rows of caravans at this campsite. Most sites enjoy wonderful shade.

New water playground

The campsite has a simple outdoor pool at its centre. You can swim there from early May to late October, but it is not heated. The pool enjoys full sunlight, and is surrounded by a beautifully tiled sundeck. In addition, there is a large paddling pool and a fun new water playground with all kinds of water sprayers for the little ones.

Paddle and play

The Gardon River flows directly past the campsite. The beautiful pebble beach is only accessible to campsite guests. Small children can paddle and play there, but canoeing in the water is also fun Sports enthusiasts can swim all the way to the Pont du Gard! There also some fine fishing spots along the river. Nature lovers are in for a treat here. Not only are there herons, kingfishers and bee-eaters, but you might just run into a beaver.

properties.name: Camping Am Sandfeld
properties.description:
The island of Usedom is located in the north-easternmost tip of Germany. This island largely belongs to Germany, but also partly to Poland. Camping Am Sandfeld is located on the German side in the sunny state of Mecklenburg-Vorpommern. From the campsite, it's only a 700-metre walk to a lovely white-sand beach. This location is also an ideal base for exploring the island, for example by bicycle.

The campsite is sunny and surrounded by rich forest. Camping Am Sandfeld is located on the south-east side of the village of Koserow. Here, you'll camp in a beautiful region on the Baltic Sea Coast with inviting forests and beaches.

Surrounded by forest

When you arrive at the campsite, you'll find yourself in an open area surrounded by forest. Park at the entrance of the campsite and walk to the reception. This is a new wooden building on the access road. You'll be welcomed in this attractive building by the friendly owners.

Clear and orderly

After visiting reception, you'll drive to your pitch. The path is paved, but a bit bumpy. You camp here on a slightly sloping site, without terraces. The pitches (80 – 100 m2) are clear and orderly. The majority are situated on the open field, but it's also possible to hire a pitch in the pine forest. There are special, level pitches of approximately 80 m2 for campers. The sanitary facilities are located near the entrance. Although the three buildings are not that modern, they are clean and easy to reach.

properties.name: Camping Les Champs Blancs
properties.description:
The Campsite Les Champs Blancs in the Mediterranean South of France is an intimate family campsite where every camper will feel at home. The large water park and the various activities organised by the entertainment team for the youngest campers makes it into an ideal campsite for everyone, young or old. Close by there is the large water park Aqualand and (only 2 kilometres away) there is the beach of Cap d’Agde. The towns of Beziers and Narbonne also not too far.

The campsite is located in the very diverse Agde, with the pine forest La Tamarissière on one side and 14 kilometres of sand beach on the other side. The campsite Les Champs Blancs is located close to the national road D612, which crosses Agde. Thanks to the fact that the campsite is just outside the city and surrounded by pine trees, you have the feeling you are really in the countryside. The centre of Agde is only ten minutes away by car.

Camping with private bathroom

On the Campsite Les Champs Blancs you can choose between pitches, mobile homes, and beautiful chalets. If you travel with your own camping equipment, you can choose extra comfort by going for a pitch with a private bathroom. There are also mobile homes and chalets with air-conditioning to be rented. Ideal for hot summer days. Many mobile homes can house a maximum of six people. Enough room for the whole family. Many mobile homes are equipped with a veranda or terrace where you can have your breakfast in the sun and a great barbecue in the evening. The pitches are nicely separated by oleander hedges, which give you sufficient privacy.

properties.name: Camping Les Jardins d'Agathe
properties.description:
This charming family campsite in Southern France is less than a kilometre from the sea. Here, you camp in the town of Agde, in the Le Grau d’Agde district by the sea. At Camping Les Jardins d’Agathe, you can enjoy the lovely swimming pool with slides, a range of sporting activities and a lovely miniature club under the French sun. Hire a mobile home, an adventurous Bengali tent or romantic Coco Sweet tent and camp under the palm trees and pine trees.

Quiet and neat campsite

When you arrive at this campsite, you will see the reception with veranda and patio right by the entrance barrier. The campsite's calling card is right next to reception: a wonderful swimming pool. When checking in, you will be warmly welcomed by the Dutch owner Charlotte and her husband Robert. Once you have been allocated the pitch you'll be staying at for the coming time, you drive onto the well-maintained campsite.

Camping amid the natural greenery

The campsite is neat and exudes friendliness. The little roads on the campsite all have street names inspired by the time when Agde was a Greek colony in the sixth century BC.

The campsite mainly consists of accommodation for hire. You can hire various types of accommodation, from mobile homes to charming tents. The 30 available pitches are spacious (between 80 to 110 m2) and are demarcated by many trees and hedges. The ground can be sandy, but the owners were planning on installing grass in 2023. The toilet and washing facilities are modern and neat.

properties.name: Camping La Roche d'Ully
properties.description:
This quiet, green campsite is situated in the La Loue Valley in the Jura Mountains. You can camp here on the comfortable spacious pitches or in a rented tent or chalet. There is a swimming pool nearby and there is an entertainment team as well. Camping Ecologique La Roche d'Ully form an excellent base for walking and bicycle tours, giving you an opportunity to get acquainted with the beautiful region.

This ecological campsite is situated in Eastern France, close to Besançon (the greenest town in France). The road to La Roche d'Ully takes you over the hills, along brooks, and through forests. The convivial village of Ornans is only a 10-minute walk from the camping grounds.

Green camping

Upon arrival at the reception, you will see at a glance that this is an extremely neat and modern camping. The first impression one gets is that a great deal of attention is devoted to 'green camping'. Camping La Roche d’Ully carry the EU EcoLabel: this means, for instance, that they try to limit the impact of camping on nature by separating waste and running an organic vegetable garden.

Camping La Roche d’Ully is a small, cosy campsite with just over 100 pitches. The camping pitches are separated by shrubs and small trees and measure in excess of 120 m2. All the pitches are provided with water and electricity. It is also possible to stay in a rented tent or luxury chalet. It is a real family campsite which is mostly frequented by families with young children. There is not really much to do for older children.

properties.name: Camping Playa de Mazarrón
properties.description:
In Bolnuevo, an old fishing village in the sun-drenched region of Murcia in southern Spain, you'll find the campsite Playa de Mazarrón. Thanks to the canvases hung around the campsite, you can spend the entire spring and summer in the shade on your camping pitch. Don't have camping equipment? Why not reserve a wooden cabin or bungalow? You can take a dip in the beautiful swimming pool or enjoy yourself at the nearby beach. If you're hungry, the campsite restaurant is the place to be. Bolnuevo has more restaurants as well as a supermarket.

Camping or renting?

Playa de Mazarrón boasts nearly five hundred touring pitches and several annual pitches. Wooden cabins and bungalows by Gitotel are located at the centre of the campsite. The pitches are tidy and vary in size. Even though the campsite is large, everything is easily accessible: the two large sanitary facilities are centrally located on the property. 

Plenty of fun in the water

Relaxing in and around the well-kept swimming pool (250 m2) is a great way to spend the day and Playa de Mazarrón also features a separate toddler pool. Make sure to grab a drink at the bar in order to keep yourself hydrated. A day at the beach is also an excellent idea. Leave the campsite through one of the exits and walk along until you reach the adjacent beach and the sea. Spread out your towel and soak up some sun! Or you can put on your snorkel and go for a refreshing dip.

Get in some exercise and head off to see some entertainment

The north side of the campsite features a playground, tennis courts and other sports facilities (like squash). There are several activity programmes focused on children, teenagers and adults. These are only available during high season and are offered in Spanish.

properties.name: Camping Beauregard Plage
properties.description:
People who are into real camping should go to Camping Beauregard Plage. The focus of this campsite is on real camping in a natural environment and there is no rental accommodation. The campsite lies directly along a fine sandy beach, which can be accessed via its own path at the far end of the campsite. Outside the campsite you find charming little shops on the boulevard and cosy terraces where you can get a drink and a bite to eat.

Respect for nature

When you turn the corner of the busy boulevard in the direction of Camping Beauregard Plage, you imagine yourself instantly in nature. The abundant greenery, including the large pine trees and the naturally laid out camping pitches on either sand or grass, creates a pleasant atmosphere on the campsite.

On Camping Beauregard Plage you will not find mobile homes or any other rental accommodation. All the available space is allocated to the genuine camper who likes to spend their holidays with their tent, caravan or camper van. This is reflected in the camping pitches, which measure at least 80m2. There is a wide choice of pitches with a lot or a with little shade. Whatever your preference. At the reception you can rent a fridge, if you wish.

Enjoy the small things in life

The campsite is not excessively lavish. There is no entertainment or swimming pool. It will therefore become apparent that you have fellow campers who enjoy nature, the surroundings and the small things of life, like the warm sand between your toes or the sound of birdsong.

properties.name: Polidor Camping Resort
properties.description:
The small family campsite Polidor Camping Resort is not even a full kilometre from the western coast of the Croatian peninsula Istria. The private beach, which sets the atmosphere with its hip beach bar, provides a unique setting along the Adriatic Sea to you, the camping guest. On the site itself, you can relax and enjoy camping on one of the separate pitches or opt for one of the deluxe mobile homes or lodge tents. The amenities, which include the restaurant and sanitary facilities, are of exceptionally high quality.

Camping

The pitches on Polidor Camping Resort are separated by hedges and situated fairly close to each other. However, there is a fair amount of space and in some locations, plenty of shade from the trees. The surface of the pitches primarily consists of pebbles.

The luxury of your own jacuzzi

If you always tend to camp in your caravan, camper or tent, Polidor Camping Resort may tempt you to try spending the night in a rental accommodation. The luxury mobile homes and lodge tents almost seem like small hotels in some cases. One of these glamping accommodation options even has its own jacuzzi.

Private beach with bar

The swimming pool on the campsite is rather small, but does have a nice toddler pool and a sizeable 'water bar'. The seating for this bar is located in the water. Polidor Camping Resort also has a private beach, roughly 800 metres from the property. Those who prefer not to walk can take a free shuttle to the pebble beach from the campsite. Upon arrival, you'll hear the summery music from the hip beach bar, where you can lounge and enjoy a drink. A little too hip for your taste? No worries: there is another, slightly more peaceful beach nearby.

properties.name: Costa do Vizir Camping
properties.description:
Costa do Vizir Camping is in the southwest of the picturesque village of Porto Côvo. You can get to Praia Grande within five minutes, it is a lovely sandy beach with high cliffs. The campsite is luxurious with every conceivable amenity, such as a lovely outdoor swimming pool, a trendy restaurant, fun activities and bike hire. Drive to the village of Vila Nova de Milfontes for a fun outing, explore the spectacular beaches or go out and about in the vast countryside.

Portuguese vibes

The campsite grounds are park-like and have a Portuguese vibe. The touring pitches are at the back, where you can pick your own pitch. Motorhomes and caravans stand in clearly arranged rows surrounded by colourful flowers. The toilet and washing facilities are spaciously laid out and look neat. If you choose a charmingly furnished bungalow or apartment, then you stay close to the swimming pool.

Get nice and active

Swimming enthusiasts take note! Go for a swim in the sea or swimming pool. It's a lovely place for relaxing on a sun lounger of a comfortable lounge bed. The youngest campers can swim in a separate paddling pool, clamber around in the playground or join in with the entertainment team in the summer. Fancy some action, follow a Zumba class, try the gym equipment or hire a bike for a trip in the vicinity.

Try local food

You are in the right place for tasty local food. Alma Nomada is the campsite restaurant and the menu is quite exclusive for Portuguese standards. You can go to this charming restaurant for lunch and dinner and you can try the best wines from the region.

properties.name: Camping Erbenwald
properties.description:
In a rural location in the southern German Black Forest, Camping Erbenwald is just a five-minute walk from the town of Neubulach. The densely wooded area has some great hiking trails. For example, near the campsite you will find the Beilfelsen route, the Fledermauspfad and the well-signposted Wanderweg Teinachtal. For families with young children this campsite is a friendly holiday address with small-scale entertainment in the summer months.

Choose your own pitch

When you arrive, you can choose your own pitch. Go for a large pitch or a more compact one. The ground is a grass surface and the degree of shade varies. Many pitches at the campsite belong to long-term guests. The other part of the campsite, just behind the swimming pool, has tourist pitches. They are neatly arranged and have fewer boundaries and trees. Do you really want to spend a special night? Book one of the wooden wine barrels that have been furnished as attractive accommodation!

Heated swimming pool

At the front of the campsite you will find the outdoor swimming pool. The water is heated and for the toddlers there is a separate pool that is adjacent to the large, rectangular pool. Next to it is the sunbathing lawn for sunbathing or where you have all the time to read your favourite book.

Playing outside

Children enjoy camping life to the full thanks to the fun playground with a slide and swings. They can also play a game of table tennis, football or basketball. If the weather is not so good, there is an indoor play area. In the summer months, there is fun entertainment with games twice a week. Furthermore, on designated days children can ride a pony near the campsite.

properties.name: Torre Rinalda Beach Camping & Resort
properties.description:
The large Camping Torre Rinalda Beach Camping & Resort lies directly on the outskirts of the town by the same name. You camp here near a beach at the sea. On the site (measuring 15.5 ha) there are no fewer than 730 touring pitches and 300 motorhome pitches. Entertainment is offered with swimming pools, a playground, an entertainment programme and organised excursions. And after a long day you can relax in the camping restaurant.

Camping and glamping

At the quietly located Torre Rinalda Beach Camping & Resort, the flowers and plants create an attractive ambiance. Olive trees and tamarisks provide the necessary shade. The demarcated camping pitches along streets have an average size of 81 m2. You can also hire a private toilet. 

The accommodation units are separate from the camping pitches. There is a separate glamping area with luxurious rental tents. The campsite has modern and spotless sanitary facilities.

Swimming, sports and entertainment

There are two swimming pools with a sun terrace. There is also a playground on the premises. You will also find a table tennis table, a sports field and a pétanque pitch. Sporty excursions are organised for the holidaymakers. The entertainment programme and the mini club are offered in Italian only.

Sunset by the sea

After crossing the road you will reach a beach where you can enjoy spectacular sunsets in the evenings. The sea lends itself for windsurfing, sailing and waterskiing. Rather get into the sea? How about some snorkeling?

Wine tasting with olives

There is a large supermarket at only 200 m from the campsite. Fresh bread can be bought on the campsite. The Lecce province has a large number of olive groves and wine regions. On the campsite you can join in a wine tasting with wine and olives.

properties.name: Campingplatz Ostseecamp Seeblick
properties.description:
Campingplatz Ostseecamp Seeblick is located in the German region of Mecklenburg-Vorpommern. Here you camp right next to the Baltic Sea – an ideal base for beach and water sports enthusiasts. The family campsite has many amenities for the entire family. There is an extensive entertainment programme, various sports options, wellness facilities and even a cinema.

Camping with a sea theme

Beach lovers are at the right place at Campingplatz Ostseecamp Seeblick. The entire campsite focuses on the sea. The restaurant looks like a ship and is decorated in pirate style. There is also a lighthouse at the campsite. Holidaymakers camp on spacious grassy pitches. Most of the pitches have lots of shade. You can also rent an apartment, chalet or bungalow.

Entertainment, beach and relaxation

The entertainment team organises fun activities for the whole family several days a week. Evenings regularly have an entertainment show with live music scheduled. The sea, accessed via stairs from the campsite, also provides hours of fun. Go for a refreshing swim or go surfing, go stand-up paddleboarding and build sand castles. Stand-up paddleboards can be rented from reception. If you want even more relaxation, visit the sauna or book a massage at the wellness facilities at the campsite. The campsite also has a cinema, a large supermarket and a restaurant that serves Italian dishes.

A day in Rostock

There is plenty to do in the area surrounding Campingplatz Ostseecamp Seeblick. The coast has lots of beaches that are fun to visit. A number of cities in the area are also worth a visit, such as Rostock (34.5 km).

properties.name: Camping Lago Le Tamerici
properties.description:
The rustic camping of Lago le Tamerici is located in Coltano, in the north of Tuscany. The sites are large, grassy and pleasant, with shade from the trees and covers. In many places you have a view of the neighbouring lake, where you can fish and canoe. The country environment and cosy atmosphere ensure that you can really unwind.

If you like to delve into culture, you can easily drive or take the bus to Pisa and Livorno. These two cities, a half hour's drive from the camping, are each really worth a visit.

The camping is surrounded by a nature area that has not been discovered by many tourists. A 6 km drive from the A12 motorway, largely through this nature area, will take you to this camping. The access road to the camping is partially tarred, but there is also a stretch of uneven gravel road. Not easy to reach, but this contributes to the peace that reigns there.

Water fun in the swimming pool and around the lake

On camping Lago le Tamerici you can enjoy the outdoor swimming pool (105 m2) or the lake where you can fish from the shore or with a small boat. You can also play jeu de boules or play sports on the multi-sports field. Children can also enjoy themselves on the playground equipment or go for a pony ride. Walking and cycling are wonderful in the surrounding area of the camping (take a tour around the lake). An excursion to the organic farm is also one of the options.

properties.name: Simos Camping
properties.description:
The Simos campsite has a unique location in the protected nature reserve on the idyllic island of Elafonisos, which lies to the south of the Peloponnese. Just fifty metres from the campsite, beyond the dunes, lies a spectacular sandy beach along the Mediterranean. Simos is a well-organised, spaciously designed campsite with large pitches for caravans and campers as well as separate areas for tents.

Camping amidst the mountains

Elafonisos is a hilly island: you can even see the green mountains rising around the campsite. However, the site itself is entirely flat, which makes it a perfect place to set up your camping equipment. The property has separate areas for those camping in tents. These are kept apart from the touring pitches for caravans and campers. Nearly all the pitches are in the shade, which is largely provided by hung cloths, but also by trees. 

The clear waters of Simos Beach

The only thing separating Simos Beach, the broad sandy coast along the Mediterranean Sea, from the campsite are the dunes. The beach is composed of fine, white sand, which is fairly unusual for Greece. The water here is crystal clear and the view is stunning: both sides of the bay are enclosed by the island's rugged hills. You can hire a thatched umbrella or a lounger for some additional comfort. 

Souvlaki and cocktails

The cafe and restaurant on the campsite serve breakfast, lunch and dinner. The authentic Greek dishes, like souvlaki, are the highlight, but you can also order baked goods and ice cream. The large covered terrace provides a wonderful seating area in the shade. The campsite also features a mini-mart with a decent range of offerings. The bar on the site, which opens at 10 in the evening, is a great place to spend sultry nights filled with summery music and refreshing cocktails.

properties.name: Camping Bad Neunbrunnen am Waldsee
properties.description:
Camping Bad Neunbrunnen am Waldsee is near the village of Maishofen, close to popular Zell am See in the Austrian Alps. You will camp near a beautiful lake, surrounded by richly-forested mountains, where a wide variety of mountain sports are possible. This is also an excellent base for winter sports enthusiasts. The large Saalbach-Hinterglemm ski area is just a 20-minute drive away.

Large pitches with mountain views

The campsite has about 60 tourist pitches, each equipped with an 8 to 16-amp electricity connection. Have you chosen a comfort pitch? Then you will have extra space and your own water tap and drainage. Some of the pitches are on the shores of the lake; all of them have beautiful views of the surrounding mountains. In the summer, the campsite also has well-maintained gravel pitches for motorhomes, especially for short stays. There is also a modern toilet block with underfloor heating, a ski storage room and a drying room for ski boots. Prefer a little more comfort and your own bathroom? Luxury rooms are available for rent in the hotel.

Swimming lake and excellent restaurant

Visiting this campsite in the summer? Then the small lake is a great place to cool down. Splash into the water from the swimming dock or paddle from the sandy beach. The campsite has a playground and a table tennis table. Fancy eating out in the evening? Then you won't need to leave the campsite because the hotel has an atmospheric restaurant that serves a delicious buffet.

properties.name: Belle-Vue 2000
properties.description:
The large, simple terraced campsite is located in the village of Berdorf in the east of Luxembourg, close to the German border. For those seeking tranquillity, the central location is ideal for discovering the rest of Luxembourg. This is also a very popular area among hiking, and cycling enthusiasts called the 'Little Switzerland'. Belle-Vue 2000 Campsite, for example, is located next to the forest, on the Mullerthal route and within walking distance of beautiful caves and a few restaurants. There is a nice playground for young families, and the campsite's shop provides a small assortment of goods, including fresh bread rolls in the morning.

Camping near Echternach

Belle-Vue 2000 Campsite is idyllically located in the middle of a wooded and hilly hiking area, less than ten kilometres from the historic town of Echternach. The driveway is on a quiet street between a house and a farm. The reception and shop are located in the main building, where the Speller family provides a friendly welcome. The large grounds with several terraces exude a park-like atmosphere.

Space in nature

The tranquillity and spacious, demarcated pitches immediately strike you when you drive onto the campsite. The flat ground is grass, and another advantage is that the pitches face the sunny south side of the campsite. The sanitary facilities are neat and heated, but not very modern. You've also come to the right place for a glamping experience in Luxembourg's nature. Choose a furnished mobile home with a veranda or a sturdy safari tent, including its own kitchen.

properties.name: Camp Vita/Glamping Village Terme Tuhelj
properties.description:
Kamp Vita is located about 45 minutes from Zagreb. The campsite has a total of 56 camping pitches. Hotel Terme Tuhelj is located next to the campsite. The hotel has the largest water park in Croatia! You can also relax in the spa. The campsite also has a little restaurant for a tasty treat. During your holiday in Croatia, you can't miss a visit to the capital city. There are also many picturesque villages in the vicinity of the campsite.

Spacious pitches

The property has been refurbished and has lovely laid out paths. There are also spacious pitches with gravel areas for campers. The pitches are not fenced. In total there are 65 campsites. The sanitation is brand new and very modern. There are also two family bathrooms and a children's bathroom.

Plunge into the water paradise.

The campsite has a veritable water paradise, the largest in Croatia! It is also called Water Planet. This swimming pool complex is open to campsite guests (at an extra charge). It has a plethora of facilities: five slides, one lazy river, a golf pool, a children's pool, a water cannon and a bubbling relaxation bath. Do you want to get away from all of the fun in the water. Dry off at the cocktail bar and order a tasty drink.

Fun away from the pool

The campsite staff will do everything they can to offer guests a lovely time. There is an entertainment and excursion programme.

Restaurant on the campsite.

The campsite does not have its own shop, but there is a supermarket within walking distance from the campsite. There is a restaurant on the campsite for a bite to eat or a cooling drink.

properties.name: Camping Gythion Bay
properties.description:
The campsite Gythion Bay is located on the south coast of the Greek Peloponnese region, right on the beach and the Mediterranean Sea. On this beach campsite, you are camping in the shadow of orange and olive trees. With a luxurious outdoor swimming pool looking out on to the beach, a restaurant with a terrace under the olive trees and modern sanitation, this Greek campsite is complete.

Camping in the orchard

With your tent or caravan among the olive trees: at the Gythion Bay campsite, you camp the Greek way. The campsite is located in a large orchard, where olive trees, orange trees, fig trees and nut trees alternate with each other. They provide shady spots, but some of the three hundred touring sites are also in the sun. You can camp right on the beach, on demarcated pitches.

Mediterranean Sea

From the swimming pool, you have a view over the beach and the Mediterranean Sea. Beach and campsite are separated from each other by a fence, but you'll just walk through the gate and have your feet in the sand. There is space for everyone on the broad sandy beach. There is a beach volleyball pitch for everyone who wants to play a round. Or dive into the clear water of the Mediterranean Sea.

Restaurant and mini-market

The restaurant is just near the beach and the swimming pool. Here you can enjoy a Greek meal on the terrace in the shadow of the olive trees. Or have a glass of wine or cocktail and enjoy the long summer evenings. Next to the terrace, there is also a cosy bar where you can toast your holiday.

properties.name: Camping Village Pedra e Cupa
properties.description:
Camping Village Pedra e Cupa is located on the north-east coast of Sardinia, less than fifty metres from the Mediterranean Sea. Here, the rocky coast of Sardinia makes way for a beautiful sandy beach, where you can sunbathe and swim. On the campsite, you can camp in the shade of shade sails and pine trees, or in one of the mobile homes. The pool and the sea are within easy reach and you can enjoy the water and sun the entire holiday.

Camping in the shade

Most pitches are covered with a shade sail. Some pitches are in the shade of pine trees. The pitches are not particularly spacious and on the simple side, but otherwise neatly laid-out. On a separate part of the campsite are about thirty rental accommodations in different sizes. These mobile homes are modern and well-maintained.

Swimming pool in the sun

Would you like to swim a few laps or cool off in the water? The campsite swimming pool is close to the entrance. The pool is not very large but spacious enough for the camping guests. Especially when you consider that the sea is less than a hundred metres away.

Pizza after swimming

The restaurant with terrace is located next to the swimming pool. After a refreshing dive or a few laps, you can satisfy your hunger here with a real Italian pizza. For smaller children, there are modest portions for a lower price. You've also come to the right place for a refreshing drink.

Sanitary facilities

The campsite has two toilet blocks, one for men and one for women. The plumbing is perhaps somewhat dated, but clean and tidy.

properties.name: Camping Torre Salinas
properties.description:
On the east coast of the Italian island of Sardinia, a stone's throw away from the Thyrrhenian Sea, you will find Camping Torre Salinas. The campsite is located in a beautiful region with numerous forests, lagoons and white sandy beaches. The camping is in a rural setting and the terrain has a large number of trees providing the necessary shade. As a result the campsite makes a very attractive and green impression.

Quiet campsite

Immediately upon your arrival at Torre Salinas you will see the modern reception building. The restaurant is also located here. The pitches are reached via a sandy road. They vary in size and are located on both sides of the road. It is also evident that this is a very peaceful campsite which attracts mainly nature lovers.

Rental accommodations

Camping Torre Salinas also has several bungalows available for rent. These look very traditional and are well adapted to the hot climate. In addition, there are new rental mobile homes and caravans.

Sardinian specialities and wood-fired pizzas

No need to go hungry when on holiday in Sardinia. The campsite restaurant serves typical Sardinian dishes. The fish and meat dishes are truly delectable. These should obviously be accompanied by a typical Sardinian wine or a traditionally brewed beer. The restaurant also serves delicious pizzas from the wood-fired oven.

Lovely breakfast and fresh ice cream

The meeting venue for breakfast is located at the entrance of the adjacent hotel, where you can enjoy a cool drink, pre-dinner drink, a cup of coffee or a refreshing ice cream at any time during the day. The campsite shop is modestly stocked, although fresh bread is available daily.

properties.name: Camping Village Orrì
properties.description:
Camping Village Orrì is a campsite with a relaxed atmosphere in Tortolì, located in the Italian island of Sardinia. The campsite is situated directly on the east coast, famous for its white beaches and quiet surroundings. The campsite is beautifully landscaped with green and flowering plants. The design is playful and the pitches are not numbered. From the campsite you can walk straight onto a quiet sandy beach.

Wooded campsite with shade

Camping Village Orrì is situated in the foothills of a forest and is characterised by the many trees dotting the campsite. They provide the necessary shade. The pitches are not demarcated. When you arrive, you can choose a nice site with the help of an employee.

On Camping Village Orrì you can rent bungalows which are modestly furnished. Some are made of brick and rather small (one room), the other of wood and slightly more spacious (two rooms). They are distributed over the entire site. Mobile homes are also available.

Swimming fun for all

Despite its location directly on the sea with the beautiful, white beach, the campsite also has its own swimming pool. Spacious enough for everyone. It is surrounded by a large number of loungers and sun umbrellas. One section of the swimming pool is suitable for small children. In peak season excursions are organised in the area by the campsite. There is also an entertainment team for children.

Shop and restaurant

Camping Village Orrì has a small shop where you can buy some daily groceries as well as daily fresh bread. The campsite restaurant is of good quality and has an extensive menu with mostly (Italian) regional dishes.

properties.name: Camping Toblacher See
properties.description:
Camping Toblacher See is in a wonderful setting by a picturesque lake in the north of Italy. You have lovely views of the lake and the peaks of the Dolomites from your camping pitch or chalet. You camp close to the village of Toblach. This is the ideal spot for exploring the stunning region and for going on walks or bike rides.

Luxury accommodation with sauna or Jacuzzi

The well-maintained campsite offers panoramic views of Toblacher See and has spacious, lovely landscaped pitches on various levels. You can also hire a luxury chalet with a (partially) glass roof. Ideal for stargazing! The chalets also have a sauna or a Jacuzzi.

Eating, walking or cycling around the lake Toblacher See

You can enjoy delicious meals in the restaurant with stunning views. There is also a cafeteria with patio. The shop has some basic necessities. If you'd like to go on a cycling trip, guided cycle tours are organised here in the months of June, July and August.

Enjoy in the summer and in the winter

There are plenty of activities to do in the surrounding area of Camping Toblacher See. For example, go for a walk around the lake, where there is also a nature path for children. You can hire boats and pedal boats here. Adventurers can climb or hike in the mountains. In the winter, the campsite is the ideal starting point for winter sports such as cross-country skiing and skiing. There are 32 ski lifts in the area with 110 kilometres of slopes.

properties.name: Camping Continental
properties.description:
The Continental natural campsite is located near the lovely beach of Marina de Castagneto. The beach has the "Blue Flag" certification, granted because the beach is very clean and safe here. You can swim, windsurf and sail in the sea. You have plenty of shade on the campsite thanks to all the trees. This forested environment radiates an oasis of peace and quiet. The campsite is a great starting point for a visit to lovely Italian art cities such as Florence, Siena, Lucca and Pisa.

Experiencing nature

At Camping Continental you can find irregularly laid out, hidden spots where you have quite a bit of privacy. The trees in the forest provide a natural demarcation of the pitches. The most beautiful pitches are near the beach. There are lodge tents for hire, but they have no sanitary facilities.

Sports entertainment

You can stay in shape during your camping holiday, perhaps on the beach volleyball pitch or in the fitness room. Ask at the reception for the excursion programme, all kinds of activities are organised. The cycling routes are also easy to follow. Don't have a bike? No problem! You can rent one at the reception.

On the campsite you'll find a playground and a bouncy castle. The entertainment programme for kids is only offered in Italian. The mini club is also in English. 

Pizzas, snacks and drinks

You can eat out in a restaurant on this campsite where they have a small menu. For example, pizzas and snacks. You can also get take-away meals here. And order a cooling drink in the charming little bar. You can find fresh bread and a few other things in the small supermarket on the property.

properties.name: Themencamping Grünewalder Lauch
properties.description:
Themencamping Grünewalder Lauch is situated in a remote and quiet nature area in the eastern German federal state of Brandenburg. The campsite is located amidst forests and directly on the shore of Grunewald Lake with a large beach. Everyone is welcome on the campsite and the beach. In addition to the 'regular beach', the campsite also has a separate naturist beach and a designated area for dogs and their owners.

Accommodation in cosy wine barrels

A large portion of the campsite is reserved for permanent pitches. This section is separate from the touring pitches. When you camp with your tent or caravan, you will be allocated a pitch between trees on separate fields. Just off the campsite, there are some fifty nice spots for motorhomes, hence this is a convenient campsite when you are travelling through with your motorhome. In addition to camping pitches, the campsite has a few rental mobile homes. You can also choose one of the cosy wine barrels for a romantic night for two.

Pleasant terrace

When you have run out of groceries, you can head for the supermarket in Lauchhammer. This is about 10 km away. A bit closer to the campsite you will find a smaller supermarket, but Lauchhammer is best for more extensive shopping. However, you do not have to leave the campsite for your evening meal. After all, the restaurant (with terrace) serves tasty meals. 

Sanitary slogans

The (good) sanitary facilities do not really differ from those on other campsites. That is to say, except for one feature: on all walls of the three toilet buildings you will find different slogans coined by the owner. Are you inspired by this? If so, you are welcome to add your own slogan to the collection.

properties.name: Camping Giardino
properties.description:
Camping Giardino in Tuscany is very suitable for families. There is a great play area and at least three swimming pools. Are you more of a beach bum? You can hear the crashing of the waves from the campsite, as it is only 100 metres away. You don't have to fear that it will be too warm in the Italian sun, as the campground is very shady.

Colourful camping

Upon arrival you will be greeted with a smile by the hospitable owners Gianni, Elisabetha and Andrea. You'll feel right at home at this campground in Tuscany.

Giardino means "garden" and the campground lives up to its name. The campground is very green. Right at the entrance you'll be greeted with flowers and the spacious campsites are located among the trees and are delineated by low hedges. Camping Giardino offers campsites with hard bases of grass and pebbles, so we recommend using a groundsheet. The sites are also very shady through the shade netting and the many surrounding trees.

Campground with three swimming pools.

You can cool off in three swimming pools during a camping holiday at Camping Giardino. There is even a large swimming pool for swimming laps. The swimming pools are heated by the sun, and there is a beautiful view of the marble quarries from the swimming pool. There is also a separate space with fitness equipment.

You can also take a refreshing dip in the sea, and there is a beach within walking distance. But take note that it can be very crowded there in the high season.

properties.name: Camping Lido Salpi
properties.description:
Camping under an olive tree? Lounging on a lovely large beach with silvery-white fine sand? Swimming in the Golfo de Manfredonia? You can do all this and more at campsite Lido Salpi in Apulië, directly on the Adriatic Sea. The endless beaches invite you to take long walks, Thereafter, you can visit the campsite restaurant where the owner makes the most delicious home-made pizzas.

Welcome to camping paradise!

You will immediately feel the relaxed ambiance as you drive onto the campsite. You can choose your own pitch here. Noticeable are the numerous motorhomes, the pitches directly by the sea (or close to the sea), and the beautiful shaded pine trees and poplars. A true camping paradise. The pitches are simple but well-maintained. They are almost always located under the trees. You will camp on the sand with some grassy patches. There are beautiful pitches behind the dunes directly by the sea, but you will have to walk a bit further to reach the sanitary facilities.

Party by the sea

The sea and the beautiful sandy beach is the place to be for entertainment. You will not miss a swimming pool here. There is a playground (on the sand). In the weekends, parties are regularly organised with music and dancing, as well as culinary feasts. People who prefer quiet nights can enjoy an extra long walk on the beach on Sunday night (karaoke night).

Pico bello pizzeria

Next to the reception is a shop with a limited range of products, including a few local products. You can also buy fresh bread here in the mornings. There is also a small bar. Adjacent to the bar is a welcoming restaurant, where you will find simple yet delicious dishes (including pizzas).

properties.name: Camping El Naranjal
properties.description:
Endless sandy beaches, delicious food and lovely weather: that's what Camping El Naranjal has to offer. The campsite is located in a quiet part of the charming resort of Jávea (also called Xábia). There is a lovely sandy beach about 500 metres away. A lovely promenade runs along the sea with plenty of shops, restaurants and terraces.

Nice awnings

The pitches are 60-70 m2 and are located on a grist ground along paved pathways. Awnings among the trees provide shade in the high season. In the low season these awnings are removed and you can enjoy the sun. There is little demarcation, which has the advantage that you can easily maneuver your caravan or camper. You can also hire bungalows. These vary in size but nearly all have air conditioning.

Lovely swimming pool

There is a beautiful swimming pool perfect for swimming laps. Around the pool there are loungers in both sun and shade. From the swimming pool you have a green, wide view of the surrounding hilly landscape.

Fitness room and diving school

Children can have fun in the playground with swings, a climbing gym with slide and teeter totters. There is also a small fitness room. Diving lessens are given in the swimming pool, and at the diving school on the beach. There are tennis courts and a mini golf course across from the campsite.

Spanish tapas

The campsite has a nice restaurant with a bar. Choose delicious local dishes from the extensive menu and enjoy them on the terrace of the swimming pool. There is also a choice of Spanish tapas.

properties.name: Camping Pico de la Miel
properties.description:
If you are on your way to the south of Spain or Portugal, you'll find that campsite Pico de la Miel is a suitable stopover campsite. It is situated some sixty km north of Madrid, near the mountain village of La Cabrera. The campsite is somewhat disorderly and consists chiefly of bungalows and chalets, but the swimming pool has been completely renovated and the view of the mountain range is unique.

Chalets and bungalows

Both the camping grounds and the reception have a somewhat cluttered look. Campsite Pico de la Miel is a large campsite, mainly consisting of a maze of bungalows and chalets: there are no less than three hundred permanent pitches and some thirty rental accommodation units. The pathways are mostly unpaved. Most of the permanent guests are Spanish people, who tend to park their cars on the empty touring pitches. 

Transit campsite

The touring pitches are located on a separate section of the campsite, which is not easily accessible. The path leading to the pitches is narrow with lots of overhanging branches. This is something to keep in mind if you have a large caravan or motorhome. The touring pitches are rather tight. Most of the grass has gone as well, as a result of which they can get muddy or covered with drift sand. Therefore, Pico de la Miel is primarily suitable as a stopover campsite for one night.

Catering in high season

Centrally located on the campsite there is a square with a playground. All facilities are also found here: a restaurant, a sociable bar with terrace and a campsite shop. These facilities are open in high season (mid- June to mid-September). In low season all catering facilities on the campsite are closed during the week, including the campsite shop.

properties.name: Camping Riaza
properties.description:
The quiet and hospitable campsite Riaza is situated in the rugged nature of Castile and Leon. You can camp here near numerous old Castilian villages with a rich past. Because of its central location, camping Riaza is a perfect transit campsite for campers on their way to Madrid and the Spanish south coast. But you can also stay there for a longer period of time. The campsite's facilities are almost perfect: the sanitary facilities are modern and you can eat in the typical Castilian restaurant.

Quiet camping

The open camping area has around 80 touring pitches, all very spacious and equipped with electricity, a water supply and drainage. Groups of oak trees provide shade on some of the pitches. Because there are no hedges between the pitches, it is possible that you may have less privacy in the high season. If you do not have your own camping equipment, you can stay in one of the mobile homes or log cabins.

Swimming pool

On the edge of the campsite is the old but clean swimming pool. The swimming pool belongs to the municipality, but guests can use it free of charge. From the pool you have a beautiful view of the mountains. Please note: the swimming pool is only open in the summer (July and August).

Sporty holiday

The sports complex is located beside the swimming pool. The sporty holidaymaker can work up a sweat here on the large football pitch or on one of the tennis courts.

Castilian restaurant

In the large restaurant, built in the same Castilian style as the reception building, you can enjoy delicious food. Traditional regional dishes are served at a reasonable price. In the weekends, many villagers come to eat here and it is busy, but in a friendly way.

properties.name: Camping Troisvierges
properties.description:
Camping Troisvierges lies some 200 m from the centre of a village with the same name and is located in a forested area. The campsite forms part of the leisure centre Troisvierges. Here you will find a heated outdoor pool with gigantic water slide, an indoor pool (currently closed due to renovation) and a children's pool (free of charge for camping guests). For the sport lovers there are several sports fields (tennis, soccer, squash, beach volley, petanque and table tennis).

A neat camping

In the basic reception area, which also serves as a snack bar, you will be welcomed by the managers or their employees. The campsite makes a very neat, well maintained impression and has a range of rental accommodation units, including mobile homes and comfortable bungalows. The most remarkable units are the Glamping Pods. These are modern, cosy wooden hiker huts for 2-3 persons.

Is your group larger than this? If so, you can rent one of the safari tents. These are suitable for 4-5 persons and have two sleeping areas and a kitchen. Naturally you can also bring your own equipment, whether this is a hiker's tent, a caravan or a mobile home. The camping pitches are spacious and demarcated.

Eating and drinking

The reception building doubles up as the cosy heart of the campsite, where you can have something to eat or to drink. You can also have breakfast here and in the evenings there is a small menu.

Sanitary facilities

In a round building behind the reception you will find the main sanitary facilities with modern fittings, also for the disabled. Elsewhere on the grounds is a second ablution block.

properties.name: Camping El Cid
properties.description:
This campsite is located within walking distance of the beach town of Peñíscola. The historic city centre (which is built on a peninsula), the long sandy beach and the pleasant boulevard make this one of the most beautiful seaside resorts in Spain. Moreover, Camping El Cid is located on the edge of the Sierra de Irta: an impressive nature reserve where you can enjoy hiking and mountain biking. The campsite features a good restaurant with local specialities, a nice outdoor swimming pool and a programme of activities during the high season.

A well-maintained, shady campsite

Camping El Cid primarily has spaces for tourist camping pitches. However, there are also spacious touring pitches available that are both well defined and maintained The campsite also has wooden bungalows and nice retro caravans for hire. Furthermore, this area is relatively green. There are plenty of shady spots due to the many trees on site.

Take a refreshing dip in the outdoor pool

At the front of the campsite, you'll find a large, rectangular outdoor swimming pool. It's an ideal place to cool off on hot summer days. Of course, you can also stay in shape by swimming laps in the pool. A paddling pool is located right next to it. This water park is completely safe for swimming, thanks also to the presence of professional lifeguards.

Diverse entertainment programme during the high season

The swimming pool is also the location for regular aqua-gym sessions during the summer. In any case, many fun activities are organised during the high season. From pétanque tournaments and paella cooking competitions to spectacular water festivals, foam parties and summer carnivals: there's entertainment for campers of all ages. There's also a special entertainment team for young children, who can also enjoy themselves on the cheerful outdoor playground at the El Cid campsite.

properties.name: Camping Jezera Lovišća
properties.description:
Looking for the real Mediterranean holiday feeling? Then you are in the right place on the Croatian island of Murter! You camp here overlooking a beautiful bay with crystal clear water, surrounded by many trees and greenery. Camping Jezera Lovišća is a real family campsite and is spacious. Most camping pitches are by the sea. The bay of Lovišće is an ideal place for swimming and water sports. During the day and in the evening, the entertainment team provides entertainment for young and old. In the restaurant you can enjoy delicious meals and there is a small shop where you can buy the necessary food.

Camping with a sea view

When you arrive at Jezera Lovišća, you are immediately struck by how well-cared for the terraced campsite is. There is plenty of natural forestation on the site, made up of native pine, olive and oak trees. The resort also offers apartments and mobile homes.

The sanitary facilities at Jezera Lovišća are excellent. There are five sanitary blocks, all of which have been refurbished to the latest standards within the last three years.

Entertainment for the whole family

The entertainment team provides an unforgettable experience for children. Younger children aged 4 to 12 can enjoy the mini club. Kids ages 13 to 19 are entertained at the teen club. In the evening there are fun shows with live music. You can have a great time at the campsite playing sports such as tennis, beach volleyball, mini golf, pedal boats and trampolining. There is no shortage of water fun, because the pebble beach is just around the corner.

properties.name: Camping Le Galet
properties.description:
Camping Le Galet is located in the charming centre of the authentic fishing village of Marseillan-Plage only 200 metres from the beach. The Étang de Thau inland lake and the famous Canal du Midi are nearby, as is the marina, which is popular with fishermen and water sports enthusiasts. There are numerous lovely cycling paths in the surrounding area.

Palm trees

On the extensive, green property, the pitches are located along a lovely main road with palms and bushes with a few side streets. You can choose a spot in the sun or in (partial) shade. The size of the tree-lined sites varies from 50-80 m2. If you want to rent something, there are mobile homes for rent. 

Lovely swimming pool

The heated swimming pool is luxuriously designed in playful shapes. You'll have more fun in the water in the jacuzzi and on the three slides. The little campers can have fun in a kiddie pool with water mushroom and slide. The slowly sloping bottom is great for the disabled. 

Around the pools you'll find colourful (lounge) chairs, thatched parasols and palm trees. There is an adjoining bar with covered terrace. Here you can enjoy the shade and a tasty drink. The sandy beach is within walking distance and can be reached via a small side road. 

New multi-sports field

There is a lovely new multi-sports pitch on Camping Le Galet. In addition, young people can enjoy themselves in the playground, playing table tennis and on the bouncy castle. 

Tapas restaurant 

The camping restaurant is quite busy. Opposite the exit to the campsite there is a charming and very popular tapas restaurant. Just outside of the campsite there are a few shops, such as a bakery, a vegetable shop and a well-stocked supermarket.

properties.name: Camping Le Barralet
properties.description:
Enjoy an unforgettable holiday in the South of France at the Camping Le Barralet campsite. This green campsite is located on the banks of the river Gardon, in the village of Collias. The campsite is located in an area with many remains from the Roman era. For example, the Pont du Gard is a stone's throw away. This impressive Roman aqueduct is on the UNESCO World Heritage List and is well worth a visit. The campsite restaurant (with bar and terrace) is the perfect place for a nice meal or a quick snack.

Terraced campsite

Camping Le Barralet is a terraced campsite and slopes slightly uphill from the entrance. The campsite offers about ninety flat pitches, demarcated by bushes. You can choose between places in the sun or in the shade. In addition, there are about forty fully-equipped mobile homes for rent.

At the campsite, you can have a great time. Among other things, you'll find playground equipment, a bocce court, a multi-sports field and a table tennis table.

Fun in the water

For a refreshing swim, you can go to the swimming pool at the campsite, where the wearing of swimming shorts is not allowed. Around the pool are sunbeds, where you can enjoy the French sun after your swim. Moreover, from the pool and sunbathing area, you will have a beautiful view of the river. If you walk down from the campsite, you will naturally end up at the banks. This is another place for a nice swim, with the many colourful canoes you see here in the background. Rent one yourself to explore the river while paddling.

properties.name: Camping Le Tropicana
properties.description:
Family campsite Le Tropicana is in the French Vendée, close to the Atlantic coast. You camp in the Saint-Jean-de-Monts seaside resort. Besides the beaches just around the corner, there is a large water paradise on the campsite for hours of fun. Head to the cosy restaurant for homemade dishes. The attention to sustainability is clear throughout the campsite.

Traditional camping or prefer a mobile home?

The camping pitches are all in a pine forest. So, you’ll enjoy the shade. For a small extra amount a day, you can rent a fridge. So, you’ll be able to keep all your fresh produce nice and cool. The campsite also has a large number of mobile homes. This luxury accommodation provides great extra comfort. Including a fully-equipped kitchen and bathroom.

Swimming pleasure for young and old

The beautiful swimming paradise is the highlight of the campsite, especially for children. Enjoy one of the outdoor pools. The youngest campers are catered for in the water playground. Zoom down the slide or relax in the wellness area. Prefer the sea? Take a refreshing dip at Plage des Mouettes beach, just 800 metres away.

Relax on the terrace

The campsite’s great terrace is open for snacks and drinks throughout the day. Delicious homemade dishes are served in the evening. You won’t want to miss the music nights either. Part of the terrace is turned into a dance floor for them. In high season, the campsite also organises all kinds of activities for children and teenagers.

properties.name: Vakantiepark Hof Domburg
properties.description:
Vakantiepark Hof Domburg is within walking distance of the North Sea beach and the authentic town of Domburg. This luxury resort is a good starting point for wonderful bicycle rides through Zeeland and excursions to the best attractions in the province. Middelburg, Vlissingen and Veere are less than 25 minutes away by car, and Neeltje Jans, known for its information centre about the Zeeland Delta Works, can be reached in about the same time. Hof Domburg is especially loved by families with young children because the park really does have everything.

Three entrances, hundreds of pitches and many accommodations

Luxury holiday villas, modern safari tents and various bungalows and chalets – just a random selection of the accommodations at this resort. Of course, you could find a beautiful pitch at Vakantiepark Hof Domburg as well. This campsite has a few hundred pitches, distributed among neatly placed camping fields. There are also special motorhome pitches.

Swim in the North Sea or in De Parel swimming complex

Will you go down the 63-metre-long super slide, or will you zoom down the ultra-short pelican slide to splash down into the water? Vakantiepark Hof Domburg has a beautiful swimming pool where all of this is possible. The subtropical swimming pool complex De Parel also has rapids, a Jacuzzi, wading pool and outdoor swimming pool. If you prefer to swim in the sea, it is only a ten-minute walk from the campsite entrance to the wide sandy beach of the North Sea.

What other entertainment does Hof Domburg offer?

For children, there is plenty to do at this resort all year round. Just consider the entertainment at the park. The programme includes crafts, dancing, laser gaming, special shows and various sports activities. You can also participate in a meet & greet with Koos the mascot. The campsite also has billiards, bowling, mini golf and squash. A delicious bite to eat and a drink can be had to the pub or the restaurant.

properties.name: Landal Vakantiepark Kijkduin
properties.description:
Vakantiepark Kijkduin is on the southwestern side of The Hague, only a couple hundred metres from Kijkduin beach. This is an ideal holiday address for beach lovers as well as for people who want to explore The Hague. Moreover, you are only fifteen minutes away from Scheveningen with its bustling boulevard and fun attractions like Madurodam theme park and the Sea Life aquarium. The large park has lots of amenities and activities for families with (young) children and is low-traffic.

Various types of touring pitches and accommodations

This campsite makes ample room for campsite visitors, making a few hundred touring pitches available on these thickly wooded grounds. A section of the campsite has a sandy base while other areas are covered with grass. Most camping pitches are grouped and in the centre of the grounds. You can also stay overnight at Vakantiepark Kijkduin in a luxury bungalow, chalet or safari tent.

Swimming pool and restaurant

If it is too cold to swim in the sea, go to Magna Aqua, the indoor swimming pool of Kijkduin Holiday Park, with a basic swimming pool, a wading pool and a Jacuzzi. The main building of the resort is next to this indoor swimming pool. It contains several playgrounds, the kids’ club, the restaurant, snack bar and large supermarket. The restaurant, which underwent a major renovation, has become the main attraction of the park.

During the high season, twice a week there is entertainment for children up to and including 12 years of age. The programme includes doing crafts, dancing and fun children’s shows.

properties.name: Landal Camping Coldenhove
properties.description:
Camping Coldenhove is just outside of Eerbeek in Gelderland, in the midst of the wooded areas of the Veluwe. The spaciously laid out family park is an ideal starting point for beautiful walks and bicycle rides through the woods and past fields of heather and sand drifts. There is lots of entertainment for young and old at the campsite, including an indoor swimming pool, a large indoor play area, several athletic fields and (the entire season!) children’s entertainment.

Book a comfortable bungalow or camp in the woods

At Coldenhove you camp on a spacious grassy spot in a thickly wooded area. The bungalow park also has holiday homes for rent. There are, for example, bungalows with specific facilities for children or babies. If you are taking your dog along, choose a bungalow with special dog facilities, like a dog cage and an enclosed garden.

Entertainment all year round

Fun activities are organised for children by the enthusiastic fun & entertainment team throughout the entire season. Sports enthusiasts will live it up on the various athletic fields, at the table-tennis tables, at the archery range and at the Adventure Golf mini golf course. If the weather is bad, the indoor playground and the indoor swimming pool provide fun. The swimming pool has a wading pool, slide, rapids and a new spray park. A good day at the campsite is ended at our restaurant De Brasserie.

Enjoy the natural beauty of the Veluwe

You can start wonderful walks from the holiday park through the wooded areas of the Veluwe. The Veluwezoom National Park is about fifteen kilometres away. You can also visit Apeldoorn (20 km) to go to the Apenheul primate park or the Julianatoren children's amusement park. Arnhem (30 km) houses the Dutch Open Air Museum and Burgers’ Zoo.

properties.name: Landal Camping Rabbit Hill
properties.description:
If you want to wake up in clean woodsy air with rabbits and squirrels passing by your door, this is an everyday reality at Camping Rabbit Hill near Nieuw-Milligen! Here you combine a stay in a thickly wooded area with all the comforts and activities that belong to a large campsite. This holiday park includes an indoor and an outdoor swimming pool and lots of catering establishments, playgrounds and sports facilities.

Fun camping in the woods

If you like to camp in the woods, this campsite, with many of its pitches under the shade of the trees, will certainly make you happy. Sun worshippers need not fear: there are also some pitches with more sunlight.

In addition to booking a pitch, you can also book a stay in a modern bungalow. There are various types of holiday homes for rent, including accommodations with specific facilities for babies and children and special dog bungalows. In any case, Camping Rabbit Hill is suitable for a holiday with your dog. The campsite has dog showers and toilets and waste bag dispensers. An off-lead area, where the dogs can run free, can be found in the Speulderbos (10 km).

Two swimming pools, numerous playgrounds and entertainment all year round

The large building complex contains the reception, the restaurant, the snack bar, bowling lanes, the beautiful indoor playground, the Craft Club and the indoor swimming pool. The swimming pool provides plenty of swimming fun with the rapids, the wading pool, Jacuzzi and two water slides. The outdoor swimming pool is also open in the summer. Outdoors there is also a Sports Arena, a Kids & Running Track, an open-air theatre and various playgrounds. And if that isn’t enough, fun activities are organised all year round.

properties.name: Camping International de L'lle aux Cygnes
properties.description:
Camping International de l'Ile aux Cygnes is situated at the foot of the Alps and the Jura, in the Savoie Departement. The campsite is in a lovely setting: directly on the Lac du Bourget. The fairly large campsite has a private small boat harbour. The pitches are also spacious. The most beautiful pitches are directly located at the lake shore.

Water sports and safe splashing

Due to its location on the large Lac du Bourget, the campsite attracts many water sports enthusiasts. The campsite has a private pebble beach on the lake. The water temperature can go as high as 26 degrees in summer. The water close to the shore is not very deep, so it is safe for children.

The campsite has a volleyball field, a pétanque court, two playgrounds for children, two table tennis tables and several games, such as a pinball machine and video games.

Luxury accommodation

Apart from in a caravan, motorhome or tent you can spend the night in one of the ten chalets and mobile homes. These are suitable for two to eight persons and offer all amenities. There are three ablution blocks spread over the campsite with spacious shower cubicles and toilets, as well as a toilet for disabled persons. There is a dedicated section with a compacted surface for motorhomes. There is an automated entrance, allowing you to come and go when you want.

Le Swan: a fine bistro

The campsite has its own bistro, Le Swan, where you can enjoy breakfast, lunch or dinner on the terrace. Take-away meals are also offered. This way you can enjoy meals in your own surroundings.

properties.name: ArdenParks Petite Suisse
properties.description:
The Petite Suisse Campground is located in the hilly surroundings of the Belgian Ardennes. From the quiet terraces you can look out over the hills of the Ardennes, the perfect place for long walks and mountain bike rides. The Petite Suisse Campground is a real family campsite, with a full entertainment programme during the school holidays with music shows, forest games and sports tournaments.

Camping with a panoramic view

From the terraces on the green campsite you have a beautiful panoramic view. From the touring pitches, you can look out over the hills, which are covered by vast forests. The campsite is large, but because the touring pitches and fixed annual pitches are spread over the various terraces, you won't notice anything. You can camp in complete peace and quiet.

As well as camping pitches, the campsite offers accommodation of all types and sizes. The accommodation also boasts stunning views over the valley.

Outdoor swimming pools

Behind the main building is the campsite's large swimming pool. This consists of three parts. The largest pool, with a slide in the middle, is for the slightly older children. They should be able to stand here easily. Next to it there is a deeper swimming pool and a shallow toddlers' pool, where the little ones can splash and ride the rainbow slide.

Child-friendly restaurant

There is a cosy restaurant in the main building. Here you can dine extensively, but you can also sit at the bar for a Belgian speciality beer. If you prefer to sit outside, the terrace (which overlooks the swimming pool and the surrounding area) is a nice place. Fresh bread is available every morning in the camp shop, and you can get a fair amount of food there.

properties.name: Landal Camping Sonnenberg
properties.description:
A swimming pool complex, a brasserie with a wine shop, a climbing park and playgrounds and sports facilities. At Camping Sonnenberg, it is easy for the entire family to amuse themselves all day. This is possible outside of the high season as well, since many amenities are located under a roof. This five-star campsite is situated on a mountain just outside of Leiwen (Rijnland-Palts), a friendly village on the Moselle river. It is surrounded by wooded areas that lie above the vineyards along the river slopes.

Spacious pitches and modern mobile homes

This campsite welcomes campsite visitors with their own caravan, motorhome and/or tent. The site has around 130 touring pitches. There are basic and comfort pitches, the main difference being the size of the pitch. You can also book a stay in a modern mobile home at Camping Sonnenberg. Some of the accommodations have special access for people with reduced mobility.

The recreational options: worthy of a five-star campsite

Camping Sonnenberg’s fun and entertainment programme offers entertainment for all ages and is organised throughout the entire year. There is also an indoor playground complex, a bowling alley, a deer enclosure (purchase special food for the deer at the ParkShop!) and a climbing park with at least six courses and forty climbing elements.

Swimming fun at the campsite

You can swim at Camping Sonnenberg in a covered swimming pool with slides, rapids, a wading pool and a Jacuzzi. For snacks, go to the snack bar, or visit the brasserie for an evening of fine dining. Are you a true lover of wine? Do visit the wine shop and take home a lovely bottle of wine from a regional wine bar.

properties.name: Adria Resort
properties.description:
Camping Adria is ideally situated in Slovenia, namely on the azure blue Adriatic Sea and between Italy and Croatia. This allows you to also make lovely excursions to neighbouring countries during your beach holiday on this campsite. The campsite directly on the beach is a favourite destination for young families and senior guests. The restaurant with sea view is a definite must!

Camping between pine trees

You drive to your pitch on paved roads. The pitches measure approximately 80 m2 and are surrounded by lovely vegetation. Choose a sunny pitch near the sea or camp on a pitch with more shade. The campsite is very popular, which is borne out by the large number of permanent pitches. It is also possible to rent a mobile home. You can spend a holiday in one of these with up to seven people.

Swimming fun

Enjoying a swim in the sun? You can do this in the large seawater pool. Rent a sun lounger and sun umbrella to recuperate from all those water activities. From the swimming pool you can walk straight to the beach. The beach slopes gently down into the calm sea, ideal for small children who also like to play in the water. Furthermore, there is also a covered swimming pool with wellness centre on campsite Adria.

Entertainment for all

During peak season lots of activities are organised by the entertainment team. For instance, there is a mini club in the mornings where children can do crafts, play and even go on treasure hunts! There are also several playgrounds on the campsite. You have a choice of sports activities: soccer, tennis, mini golf, bowling, horseback riding, fitness, jet-skiing, surfing or diving.

properties.name: Dünencamp Karlshagen
properties.description:
Campsite Dünencamp Karlshagen is located in a pine forest on the outskirts of an urban area, right behind the dunes on the unspoiled northern part of the island of Usedom. The Baltic Sea beach is within walking distance. Half a kilometer further along you will find the centre of the seaside resort of Karlshagen. Here, you will come across all sorts of fun shops and eating establishments. The vibrant seaside resort of Zinnowitz can easily be reached by bicycle.

Plenty of green and a structured layout

At the reception, you will immediately notice the pleasant, nature-rich ambiance thanks to the profusion of hedges and tall stately pine trees. This elongated wooded terrain stretches out behind the dunes and is laid out in a structured manner. Most of the touring pitches are located among the trees on the dune side of the campsite. There are also quite a few seasonal pitches. Caravans are towed to the pitch with a tractor.

Beautiful camping pitches in the woods

The camping pitches are numbered, but not demarcated. The ground is often coarse and sandy. It can sometimes be a tight fit in the peak season. During this period you will also have less privacy, especially in the front part of the campsite grounds. The pitches further back are quieter and offer more privacy. The camping pitches are located among the trees in a pine forest, so they usually have sufficient shade.

Very clean sanitary facilities

The sanitary facilities are situated in three welcoming blocks which are easily accessible, also for the disabled. The buildings are spacious, clean and together they provide sufficient capacity, even in the peak season. With the aid of an electronic key, you can decide how long you need to shower.

properties.name: Landal Camping Dishoek
properties.description:
There's a great holiday atmosphere at campsite Dishoek, near Dishoek op Walcheren (Zeeland), all year round. This campsite is near a kilometre-long sandy beach in one of the regions with the most hours of sunshine in the Netherlands. So, it’s the perfect place for a wonderful beach holiday. From here, you can also go on beautiful cycle trips across Walcheren and it’s a good base for visits to the beautiful cities of Middelburg and Vlissingen.

Authentic campsite

Do you like traditional camping life? Then this is the place for you. The campsite only has tourist pitches. Most pitches are sunny and clearly separated by hedges. If you book a comfort pitch, it will measure about 50 m2. Want more space? Then book a royal pitch, which are about 75 m2.

Enjoy the vast beach

Many campers choose this campsite for its location by Strand Dishoek. All you have to do is cross the dunes and you’re there. Enjoy playing in the sand, taking a dip in the sea or getting a breath of fresh air with a beach walk; it’s all possible here. All these activities are 100% safe because the beach has a Blue Flag. Back at the campsite, enjoy a snack and drink at the eatery.

Visit Vlissingen and Middelburg

The lively town of Vlissingen is about 5.5 km away; its centre is full of historic buildings. A rich cultural heritage can also be found in Middelburg, Zeeland's capital (10 km). Admire the old city hall, the abbey tower, the Kuiperspoort and the many special museums.

properties.name: Kamp Danica Bohinj
properties.description:
In the Slovenian village of Bohinjska Bistrica, in the heart of the Julian Alps, lies Kamp Danica Bohinj. This is a traditional area with picturesque houses. National Park Triglav is situated in the region around the mountain of the same name.
