Danica Bohinj is an ideal spot for holidaymakers such as mountain hikers, cyclists, kayaking and rafting enthusiasts. There are also ample winter sports possibilities.

Family campsite on a river

The campsite lies alongside the Sava River and has a large central area with non-demarcated pitches. There are also pitches by the river; these are the nicest. In peak season it can get pretty busy here. In July and August you can swim in the shallow and fast flowing water. You can also hire tents on the campsite.

Traditional Alpine style

The campsite restaurant in traditional Alpine style is an absolute must. It has a fine menu, a reasonably priced luncheon menu and you will enjoy Slovenian cuisine. The campsite has a playground for children and further offers various sports, such as tennis, badminton and volleyball. Other than that, Danica offers only basic facilities. In the village, within walking distance, you will find a supermarket and various restaurants. Furthermore, at some 200 m from the campsite, there is a lovely thermal swimming pool with indoor and outdoor pool and an extensive range of wellness options.

Attractive and modern sanitary facilities

The main sanitary building is attractive and contemporary. There are two further ablution buildings in container style, which are quite compact and very basic. They also have sanitary facilities for children. In peak season, when the campsite is fully booked, you do not always have unlimited hot water for showering. A matter of getting there in time...

properties.name: Domaine Mon Calme
properties.description:
In the south of Brittany, in the coastal town of Piriac-sur-Mer, Mon Calme campsite is located a stone's throw from the Atlantic Ocean. The centre of Piriac-sur-Mer is a five minute walk away. Here you can fall for the charms of the authentic architecture, historic buildings and flowery streets. The surrounding area also offers many interesting sights, such as the salt marshes of Guérande and the bay of La Baule.

Something for everyone

This family campsite offers spacious pitches and fully equipped mobile homes. The pitches are located on a separate field, separated from the mobile homes, and are separated by half-high hedges or hedgerows. There are trees scattered throughout the site, which provide shade, but there are also pitches in the sun. In addition to the rental of mobile homes, there are also studios for three or four people for rent.

Water fun

Water lovers will be in their element at Mon Calme campsite. At the campsite itself you will find a heated outdoor swimming pool with a paddling pool. There is also a small road from the campsite to the sea, about five hundred metres long. The Piriac marina is two kilometres away. There are also several beautiful bays in the vicinity, such as the bay of La Baule.

Traditional pizzas

The campsite has a nice bar-restaurant-pizzeria with a terrace by the swimming pool. Here you can enjoy the daily menu, dine à la carte or enjoy a drink. A nice extra is that they also serve traditional pizzas, baked in a wood-fired oven. You can eat them in the restaurant or on the terrace, or you can take them with you to your camping spot.

properties.name: Camping Vidor Family & Wellness Resort
properties.description:
You will find this beautifully set up terraced campsite in the Valle di Fassa mountain valley, surrounded by an imposing mountain landscape in the middle of the Dolomites. This is an ideal campsite for families thanks to the swimming pools, extensive play options and the fun entertainment programme. In addition, Vidor Family Campsite & Wellness Resort has a modern wellness centre where you can undergo treatments that boost your body and mind. In the summer, you can make beautiful mountain walks, cycling, and mountain bike tours in the immediate vicinity. In winter, this is a real winter sports area. There are direct connections to several ski slopes.

Camping pitches with stunning views

The Vidor Family Campsite is part of a real resort that includes luxury apartments, lodges and chalets. There are camping pitches in three comfort levels, which are differentiated by the size of the pitches. All pitches are laid out on neat terraces, giving you a beautiful view of the surrounding mountains.

Water fun in the water park

This campsite has a nice outdoor and an even more impressive indoor pool. There are three spectacular water slides in the indoor pool. What is also special is that the campsite offers special swimming lessons for pregnant women and babies.

Child-friendly camping site

The Vidor Family Campsite is an excellent campsite where you can enjoy yourself on dark, rainy days. There is a large covered recreational space where you can play billiards, table tennis, football and darts. There are also many games, a beautiful indoor playground and even a cinema, where fun films are shown for the whole family.

properties.name: Camping Wulpen
properties.description:
Camping Wulpen is a well maintained campground in an agricultural area near Cadzand and Cadzand-Bad, a lovely coastal town with a nice high street and impressive marina. The campground has lovely campsites with sufficient shade and modern sanitation. A wonderful spot to explore the Zeeuws-Flanders coastal area.

Relaxed atmosphere and greenery

As soon as you step out at the entrance, the beautifully landscaped and well-maintained grounds immediately create a pleasant, relaxed atmosphere. You will receive a friendly welcome at reception.

Spacious campsites, modern sanitation

The campground consists of two parts. The smaller fields are in the front section. The sites here are delineated with hedges and offer plenty of privacy. Behind the campground there are large fields with spacious campsites. On the property you will find two spacious and clean sanitation buildings.

Mixed public

In the high season, the campground is mainly visited by families with children. The guests come from the Netherlands and Germany. In the low season, there are mostly older couples.

Beautiful beaches, nice towns

You can take all kinds of excursions in the immediate vicinity. Visit Cadzand or Cadzand-Bad. Or cycle 15 minutes to the lovely beach with white sand and multiple beach pavilions. The area is perfectly connected for cyclists with an expansive cycle route network. A little further inland is Sluis with its charming shops, restaurants and Het Belfort museum. Knokke-Heist and Bruges in Belgium are a little further away, but are definitely worth a visit.

properties.name: Båstad Camping
properties.description:
On the Swedish west coast, close to the beach, you will find the Båstad campsite. On this large and cosy campsite, you can enjoy a fun-filled holiday. Seek out fun activities, or enjoy the peace and quiet of your pitch. Are you in for a special holiday full of glamping? You can camp in a safari tent or a floating tent. Together with your children, you can play a round or two on the adventure golf course. Or walk to the beautiful sandy beach.

Camping pitches, motor home pitches, and glamping

Looking for your spot, you drive into a large and lively camping area. Your spacious pitch is situated on one of the grassy field. Are you travelling with a camper? The Båstad campsite has a nice place for you right at the front of the site. Or enjoy a glamping holiday in one the large safari tents.

Adventure golf course

Immediately upon entering, you will see the adventure golf course. Try to hit the ball between rocks and over bridges towards the holes. Especially if you’re on holiday with your kids, this golf course is a lot of fun.

Home-made pizzas

A home-made pizza is waiting for you on the table. You can see your kids licking their lips in anticipation. It’s time to attack! You’ll want to join us every evening in the campsite restaurant. And, of course, you are always welcome. Or would you rather cook for yourself? If so, the camp shop is sure to have what you are looking for. If not, it’s only a few minutes’ drive to a larger supermarket.

properties.name: Family's Camping Le Savoy
properties.description:
Family's Camping Le Savoy is a campsite in the heart of nature in the mountainous département of Savoie (capital: Chambéry). Here in the west of France, a lot of tourism revolves around winter sports. If you come to the campsite in the spring or summer, you can enjoy walking and cycling. There is also a large lake adjacent to the campsite, great for a swim or an afternoon of fishing!

Camping and renting

Family's Camping Le Savoy has touring pitches, ranging from 80 to 150 m2! The campsite is very well looked after and there are hedges to demarcate many pitches. Trees provide the necessary shade. You can reach your camping pitch via asphalted roads. There are also special camper pitches and rental accommodations.

Water fun in the lake

The recreational lake, which is situated in the extension of the campsite, is a pleasant place for young and old. With a large grassy meadow next to it, you can enjoy the necessary hours of sunshine, have a nice picnic or play a game of football. Inflatable play equipment is regularly placed in the lake to form a course.

Bar with lounge

The bar (with beautiful outdoor terrace) is only open in high season. You can go there from eight o'clock in the morning for fresh bread. Snacks and drinks will also be served. In Challes-les-Eaux, you will find more catering facilities, including restaurants and cafés. The campsite has an indoor area where it is often a pleasant mess. You can sit down on one of the comfortable sofas, for example in the evening when there is musical entertainment or a performance or show. There is also a pinball machine, table tennis and pool table to use.

properties.name: Camping Club Benelux
properties.description:
The Camping Club Benelux is located on the banks of the Ourthe River. This friendly campsite is situated in a beautiful part of the Belgian Ardennes, close to the tourist town of La Roche-en-Ardenne. There is an amiable and relaxed atmosphere on the campsite. Take a dive in the heated swimming pool, buy a bread roll from the brasserie and join in the entertainment. No reason to get bored!

Camping amidst green

The spacious camping pitches (grass surface) are well-maintained. You can choose for yourself whether you prefer to set up camp in the sun or a (semi) shaded spot. There is also a special lawn for tents. Here you really camp in the midst of nature, with trees and bushes on the one side and the babbling river on the other side.

If you prefer to rent an accommodation, you can opt for a cosy chalet (max. four persons). These are very modern and comfortably furnished.

Entertainment for the whole family

Great activities, especially for young families, are organised by the entertainment team during the school holidays. For instance, arts and crafts, painting, sports tournaments, raft building, campfires and much, much more. In the evenings, activities are regularly organised for the parents. The Ardennes are also eminently suitable for an adventurous holiday. Climb on a mountain bike, go for a hike or take part in a GPS-tour through the green forests. 

Water fun!

The swimming pool (open from May - October) is heated. You can also go for a swim in the refreshing Ourthe River. Children can romp around here to their heart's content and look for tadpoles and frogs.

properties.name: RCN la Bastide en Ardèche
properties.description:
In the south of the French Ardèche, directly situated along a river with the same name, you will find RCN la Bastide and Ardèche. The well maintained family campsite has spacious and well maintained camping pitches. There is lots of entertainment for children, because apart from the entertainment team, the campsite also has sports fields, table tennis tables and a swimming pool with water chute. Furthermore, you can also swim in the Ardèche river, where a sandy beach is laid out in the summer months.

A piece of the Netherlands in France

At the reception you are warmly welcomed by the RCN staff or the park managers. At the front of the campsite are all facilities such as the camping shop, swimming pool and restaurant. A bit further on you will find the mobile homes and beyond this the camping pitches. You have a choice of standard or comfort pitches with an average camping size of some 100 m2. There are two sanitary buildings on the campsite; the large central building is the latest. As a result it looks very neat and well kept, as does the rest of the campsite.

Swimming pool with water slide

The entertainment team is very active with a daily entertainment programme for young and old. However, even without this team there are ample activities on the campsite: a sports field, table tennis table and jeu-de-boule pitch. At the front of the campsite is a large swimming pool including toddler pool and water slide.

The French evening sun

Across the swimming pool is the campsite restaurant with a large terrace. Here you can have a delicious meal while enjoying the French evening sun. At the reception you will also find a well-stocked camping shop.

properties.name: Camping Orio/Orio Kanpina
properties.description:
In the green and hilly Spanish Basque country, you will find Camping Orio. This medium-sized family campsite is situated in the peaceful surroundings of the village of Orio, where the River Oria flows into the Bay of Biscay. From the campsite, you can walk straight to the beach.

Neat campsite

The grounds of Camping Orio are well maintained, and the pitches for your tent or caravan are laid out on different grassy areas. The fields are bordered by hedges and for the most part, also have a tree for some shade. In addition to places for your own camping equipment, there are also about thirty bungalows available.

Eating and drinking

Most of the facilities you need for a successful holiday can be found at this campsite. There is a campsite shop where you can do your daily shopping. And for the children, there is a small playground outside and a play area inside. As soon as you get hungry in the evening, there's plenty of choices. Of course, you can make your own meal, but there is also a fine restaurant with an adjoining terrace.

Wide sandy beach

Located at the point where the Oria flows into the Bay of Biscay, water plays an important role at Camping Orio. There are many water sports possibilities, such as kayaking, rowing and SUPping. There is also a small harbour for pleasure boats just fifty metres from the campsite. By walking down the street (two hundred metres), you are already on the wide sandy beach. You can also take a refreshing dive at the campsite. In the far corner is a swimming pool surrounded by a sunbathing area with chairs and parasols.

properties.name: Camping De Zandput
properties.description:
Camping De Zandput lies just outside of Vrouwenpolder, a friendly coastal resort in the northwest of Walcheren, which is a former island in the Zeeland province. This campsite is beautifully located in the Manteling nature reserve of Walcheren and along the extensive sandy beach of the North Sea. Wonderful bicycle rides cross the island, leaving from the campsite, and the fun historic city of Middelburg is close by (12 km). The Zandput is a large yet quiet campsite that, during the high season, is very attractive to families with children.

Have fun camping next to dunes

This campsite is mainly dominated by camping pitches. The touring pitches are located on playfully landscaped fields, for the most part next to the dunes. The toilet and washing facilities are wonderful with water-saving showers and urinals. This holiday park also offers overnight stays in a luxury bungalow or a modern safari tent.

Swimming at Roompot Beach Resort

If you stay at Camping De Zandput, you have free access to the indoor swimming pool at Roompot Beach Resort in Kamperland, about ten kilometres away. This swimming pool complex includes a wave pool, rapids, a wading pool, a 63-metre-long water slide and an outdoor swimming pool.

The campsite does not have an entertainment programme. Entertainment at Camping De Zandput consists of “Do It Yourself” activities. Children can get started on a craft activity on their own or together with others. The campsite also has a playground.

properties.name: Nederrijkswald BV
properties.description:
Recreatieboerderij Nederrijkswald, located in the forested landscape of Berg en Dal, offers peace, countryside and space. The top location amid the forests and farmland is a wonderful starting point for an active walking or cycling holiday. Furthermore, you can reach the centre of Groesbeek within five minutes from the campsite. Nijmegen, the oldest city in the Netherlands, is about a 6-kilometre-drive and the German border is also close by.

Spacious pitches in natural greenery

When you arrive at the campsite you immediately notice how well-maintained the site is. The green grassland, part of the mixed farm with agriculture, offers a relaxing ambience. The campsite is neat and clearly appointed, with 51 demarcated pitches (120 m²), which offer plenty of privacy and are supplied with water and electricity.

Good amenities and lots of entertainment

The campsite is not only a place to stay but also a destination in itself. You will find spacious pitches amid the countryside and excellent amenities. The modern toilet block offers separate facilities for men and women, including private cubicles and special spaces for the disabled and babies. Additionally, there is a washing up area, laundry facilities, a recreation room and a fridge/freezer for guests.

Sports and playing options at the campsite include an illuminated jeu de boules court, checkers and chess boards and a football and volleyball field. There is a playground, trampoline and sandpit for the younger guests. The campsite also organises all kinds of activities. In the high season, they organise barbecues, disc golf and horse-drawn carriage rides for example. Furthermore, you can join in with agility games, archery or follow a mountain bike clinic.

properties.name: Flower Camping Le Pilon d'Agel
properties.description:
This well-maintained campsite in the heart of Provence is beautifully located in a wooded area. Children will have a great time in the water or at the entertainment activities. Flower Camping Le Pilon d'Agel has recently been renovated and features a beautiful outdoor pool and a restaurant.

Located between the departments of Bouches-du-Rhône and Vaucluse, the campsite is set in stunning surroundings. The elegant town of Saint-Rémy-de-Provence, with lovely restaurants and cafes, is less than a 10-minute drive away. You can also enjoy natural beauty in the nearby Alpilles Natural Park.

Camping in Provence

Flower Camping Le Pilon d'Agel is located southeast of Avignon. The A7 motorway is nearby and the entrance to the campsite is only a few hundred metres from the main road. The campsite is 4 hectares and flat. You can also expect a warm welcome from the hospitable owners.

Spot under the trees

All kinds of trees provide shade during hot days but also ensure adequate privacy. Campers can choose between three types of pitches; comfort, privilege and nature, which differ in size. In addition, mobile homes offer comfortable rental accommodation for families.

Swimming paradise

The swimming pool is the campsite's major attraction. Once it turns 11 a.m., the water fun can begin. Sunbeds surround the outdoor pool offering maximum relaxation. There is also a grassy sunbathing area surrounded by olive trees and oleander, and a heated indoor pool especially for the adults where you can enjoy pure luxury.

properties.name: Sites & Paysages de l'Etang
properties.description:
Castles, vineyards and picturesque villages characterise the area surrounding Camping de l’Etang in Brissac-Quincé. You camp here on the old farm grounds of the Château of Brissac, an authentic and vast area which is eminently suitable for rest and relaxation. The large pond adjacent to the campsite, abound with carp and sun perch, is popular with anglers.

Glamping on the campsite

The terrain measures approximately 8 ha, but you are not allowed to drive your pegs into the ground or turn out the caravan legs just anywhere. This is only allowed on one of the 100 easily accessible pitches which measure at least 100 m2. There are forty rental cottages, chalets and safari tents. The most beautiful accommodation units are undoubtedly the huts with their own porch and jetty, located at the fishing pond.

Children keep themselves busy

This is absolutely fantastic for children. When they discover the adjacent adventure park with water slides, pedal boats, a mini train and many more great attractions, there is no holding them back. Camping guests are given a discount on the entrance fee. Young and old can participate in all activities organised by the entertainment team.

The campsite vineyard

The domain produces a fruity rosé, a delectable white wine and a red wine. Each week you can taste these wines freely on the wine-tasting tour. The restaurant borders the swimming pool. You can also relax on a sunny terrace.

In the camping shop you can buy daily fresh bread and croissants as well as regional products and, of course, the campsite wines.

properties.name: Landal Camping Esonstad
properties.description:
Camping Esonstad is in the north of the Netherlands, right on the bank of the Lauwersmeer. This family campsite has lots for the entire family to do. The entertainment team organises fun activities and there are plenty of amenities that campsite visitors may use. There is a pitch & putt golf course, a bowling alley, an indoor playground and a heated indoor swimming pool. A quick bite to eat can be enjoyed at the snack bar and an extensive dinner can be had at the brasserie. In short, you don’t have to leave the campsite at all!

Campsite with many amenities

Camping Esonstad has several camping fields separated from one another by trees. You camp on spacious open grounds and all of the pitches are grassy. Holidaymakers who would prefer to rent an accommodation can stay in one of the luxury holiday homes on the other side of the road. As a campsite visitor at Camping Esonstad, you can use all amenities at the holiday park, such as the swimming pool and the indoor playground.

Pitch & Putt and an indoor playground

Lot of entertainment is provided for children especially. The entertainment team organises fun and creative activities. The covered swimming pool with its large slide is open daily and will provide hours of water fun. In the summer, you can swim in the Lauwersmeer and relax on the beach. There is also plenty for sports enthusiasts to do at the campsite. Play volleyball, table tennis, a game of jeu de boules or challenge family members on the Pitch & Putt golf course, which is right next to the camping site. There is also an indoor playground with trampolines, climbing frames and slides.

properties.name: Landal De Katjeskelder
properties.description:
De Katjeskelder holiday park is located in the middle of the wooded areas of the Vrachelse Heath, a beautiful nature reserve near the charming city of Oosterhout (North Brabant). This is a great place to come to relax, but there is also plenty to do, especially for families with children. The park has an indoor and an outdoor swimming pool and activities all year round. There are favourite amusement parks, cities and nature reserves in the immediate vicinity, making De Katjeskelder an ideal spot for a long family holiday!

Wooded grounds with luxury bungalows and spacious pitches

This resort consists mostly of holiday homes. The accommodations are generally quite distant from one another, providing lots of privacy. In addition to a luxury bungalow or a modern safari tent, you can also opt for a pitch at Vakantiepark De Katjeskelder. The pitches are at the back of the park, around the main toilet and washing facilities. Nature lovers will love it here since this is perhaps the most wooded part of the campsite. Moreover, next to the camping section is one of the resort’s two walkway exits.

What is a typical day at Katjeskelder?

Vakantiepark De Katjeskelder has entertainment for children five times a week all year round. The activities programme is very diverse. The littlest ones have fun doing crafts, dancing or playing in the kids’ club, while the somewhat older children can participate in sports events, archery, laser gaming or cooking workshops. There is also an indoor swimming pool with slides, rapids and a wading pool. On summer days, the outdoor swimming pool is open as well. End a lovely day at the campsite in the pub or the à la carte restaurant.

properties.name: Camping Paradis L' Arada Parc
properties.description:
The friendly family campsite L’Arada Parc is situated on a low hill near the town of Sonzay in the Loire Valley. The grounds with many flowery shrubs look well maintained.

Relaxed camping

On the slightly hilly terrain the camping pitches are closer to the amenities than the rental accommodation units. The terrain is laid out with numerous trees and bushes and has a varied appearance. The pitches differ in size and comfort but are all spacious. The luxury pitches have electricity and water supply plus drainage. A number of pitches is dedicated to campers. Rental accommodation consists of furnished tents, mobile homes and chalets.

Wellness in old mobile home

The owner has converted an old mobile home into a relaxation and wellness area with a Turkish bath, balnéo, an infrared sauna and some fitness equipment including two bicycles. There is a heated indoor pool, with toddler pool, and outdoor pool with nice slide and jacuzzi.

Campsite owner and chef

The owner is also the chef and the restaurant offers a small menu with pizzas, meat dishes and the Arada menu. The terrace of the restaurant, with a view of the swimming pool, is a lovely place to relax in the sun or the shade. You can buy various groceries and beverages in the reception area. There is adequate choice for a reasonable price.

Not to be missed

From the campsite you can take a large number of walking and cycling trips in the area and you can rent bicycles from the reception. Wine tasting options are also offered on the various vineyards. You can also visit one of the many castles on the Loire or the regional nature park with wildlife.

properties.name: Vakantiepark 't Urkerbos
properties.description:
Hospitable, green campsite at a 10-minute bike ride from the centre and harbour of Urk, the former Zuiderzee island, where you are welcomed by Mr and Mrs Scheckman. When you drive to the campsite, you will notice how green and extensive the grounds are. The swimming pool and horse stables are immediate eye catchers.

Camping fields, safari tents and gnome houses

The camping pitches are spacious, have a grassed surface and are spread over several fields. The camping fields and pitches are not physically separated. In addition to the the basic camping pitches with and without electricity, there are fields with comfort pitches and pitches for camper vans. Some pitches are located between the seasonal pitches. Spread over the campsite you will find several modern ablution blocks. You can also rent accommodation, such as a luxury safari tent or a gnome house.

Bring your horse along!

The campsite is popular with senior citizens, but there are also ample facilities for children. There is a swimming pool with a sun-drenched terrace. Furthermore, there is a playground and covered wagon tours are also organised. This is the place to be for horse lovers. There is a pony-riding centre where you can take pony riding lessons and you can even bring your own horse.

Urk is a stone's throw away

When you want a bite to eat, you can go to the restaurant on the campsite, next to the pool. It has a cosy ambiance. You can also get takeaway meals there. Other catering facilities are available in Urk, where you can also do your daily grocery shopping. In the centre, a 10 minute walk away, you will find supermarkets, a bakery and butchery.

properties.name: Camping Domaine l'Eau Rouge
properties.description:
Close to the world-famous racing circuit at Spa-Francorchamps, in the north of the Belgian Ardennes, you'll find the environmentally-friendly Camping Domaine l'Eau Rouge. You can camp here on a camping pitch, or in rental accommodation. The campsite is an excellent starting point for outdoor activities such as hiking and cycling. Jump into the saddle and take a trip to the nearby town of Spa, where the historical grandeur is still there to be admired. Camping Domaine l'Eau Rouge is just outside the town of Stavelot. The campsite is in a green, forested area, and on the banks of the river Eau Rouge. Good to know: at the nearby racing circuit, there's a challenging curvy part of the track which is named after the river, and so the Eau Rouge is world famous in racing circles.

Pool

It has a heated, energy-efficient swimming pool and features a massage corner with lounging and seating areas.

Don't miss

Spa is a historic wellness retreat, and one of the oldest tourist destinations in Belgium. Wealthy people have visited Spa since the 18th century for its wellness retreats and casinos. Everything in the town exudes grandeur from the noble elite who used to visit the spas here. The stately homes, the ancient baths, and the casino give the town a unique atmosphere.

properties.name: Camping Les Avignon
properties.description:
Camping Les Avignon is less than five kilometres from the French city Avignon, just on the other side of the Rhône river. This campsite is located across from an old fort and a monastery, nestled among green rolling hills. Camping Les Avignon is an ideal campsite for campsite visitors who love the combination of the countryside and the charm of a city.

Green campsite with lots of shade

The campsite is on the outskirts of the large city of Avignon and yet it is an oasis of peace and quiet. The grounds are green with hedges and large trees that provide welcome shade. You camp on grass and all of the pitches are around 100 m2. You can choose from a pitch with or without electricity. Renting a mobile home is also an option, suitable for four to six people. Fresh rolls can be picked up daily from the reception, where local wines, snacks and ice cream are also available. If it rains, just go to the covered recreational area where there is a television. There is also a corner with books that can be borrowed or where you can have a pleasant conversation with other campsite visitors.

Swimming in the municipal swimming pool

The campsite itself has no swimming pool, but the municipal swimming pool (indoor and outdoor) is right next to the campsite. Campsite guests may swim here for free in the summer months. Not in the mood to cook? Enjoy a delicious lunch or dinner at the campsite restaurant. Have a seat on the terrace or take the food to your own pitch.

properties.name: Landal Camping Warsberg
properties.description:
Camping Warsberg lies at the top of the Warsberg mountain, next to the beautiful city of Saarburg (Rijnland-Palts). This is a true family park with many amenities, including an indoor swimming pool, activities hall, mini club, restaurant and shop. Thus it is a self-supporting campsite, making it unnecessary to go up and down the mountain very often (the last three kilometres have a ten percent gradient). Furthermore, you have a great view of Saarburg, easily accessed by means of a chair lift next to the campsite.

Wide choice of touring pitches and accommodation

Camping Warsberg is actually a bungalow park and campsite in one. The accommodations are separated from the camping fields where campsite visitors stay overnight on spacious pitches separated by hedges. With regard to accommodation, you can choose from a modern mobile home, safari tent or bungalow.

Next level fun in indoor swimming pool, games room and play areas

Whether it is sunny or rainy, this holiday park offers plenty of fun under all conditions. Take, for example, the beautiful indoor swimming pool, where children can enjoy the wading pool, the children’s slide and the recreational pool. Adults can totally relax in the Jacuzzi, the Turkish steam bath or the infrared cabin. The NXT LVL games room contains, among other things, playing fields, games, climbing walls and a ball pit. Outdoors there are athletic fields and play areas. This park also has its own supermarket and a cafe-bistro.

Go down to Saarburg with the chair lift

The castles, water mills, small colourful houses and the various water falls in particular in the city centre make Saarburg a favourite attraction. If you stay at Camping Warsberg, go for a walk to the nearby cableway station from where you can take a chair lift right down to the centre of Saarburg. Warsberg mountain also has an exciting luge run.

properties.name: Landal Camping Wirfttal
properties.description:
Just outside of the charming village of Stadtkyll, in the centre of the Eifel mountain range, lies Camping Wirfttal. This holiday park has green grounds with many differences in height. In the ‘lower’ area, the Wirft river flows and there is a small recreational lake, whereas higher up you enjoy an impressive view of the mountainous surroundings. This is an ideal family campsite with numerous facilities and activities for children up to about 12 years old.

Level camping section and accommodation on a hill

The touring pitches and safari tents are near the lake and along the Wirft river, on the level section of the campsite. The modern and luxury bungalows and holiday homes are on a hill. The highest point of the site is eighty metres above the main facilities. Good to keep in mind if you have restricted mobility or are travelling with a lot of baggage or with prams. Check the map of the campsite beforehand and be sure to indicate your preferences when reserving.

Holiday for your faithful four-footed friend

This resort rents out bungalows reserved for dogs. With a dog cage, dog basket, warm dog shower and enclosed garden, these accommodations offer everything you need for a comfortable stay for your four-legged friend. The campsite also has a dog playing area and a dog track.

Entertainment for the entire family

Powering a pedal boat around the lake, playing in the playgrounds, doing crafts in the studio and enjoying sports in the Sports Arena are only a few of the activities in which you can participate. And there is also a new NXT LVL games room that is filled with creative games. There is fun to be had in the campsite’s swimming pool, which has a large basic pool and a wading pool with a slide.

properties.name: Sites & Paysages Les Pinèdes
properties.description:
Welcome to Sites & Paysages Les Pinèdes, a sunny oasis just seven kilometres from the Mediterranean Sea in the south of France. This four-star campsite in the Alpes-Maritimes is located exactly between Nice and Cannes. It’s an ideal base for city buzz, beaches, nature and picturesque villages. On the campsite you can unwind by the pool and enjoy delicious dishes in the restaurant.

Green terraced campsite

At Les Pinèdes you can camp with your tent, caravan or motorhome on spacious, fenced terraces on a hilly site. It’s pleasantly peaceful and green here. Prefer a bit more luxury? Then choose one of the modern mobile homes, ranging from cosy and compact to the Premium SPA cottages with private spa. Perfect for bubbling away under the stars in the evening. All accommodation comes with air conditioning, a fully equipped kitchen and a sunny terrace where you can sit down straight away for breakfast.

A splash in the pool

The heated outdoor pool beckons as soon as you wake up. Take a dip, then grab a sun lounger and feel the Mediterranean sun do its work. You’ll find extra relaxation in the new spa. Afterwards, stroll over to the restaurant for a pizza, a fresh salad or something a little more celebratory from the chef. Children can pick up an ice cream at the summer kiosk and let off steam with games and activities.

Out and about on the Côte d’Azur

From the campsite you’re right in the middle of the highlights of the Côte d’Azur. Wander through the arty Saint-Paul-de-Vence (5.5 km), soak up the city energy in Nice (20 km) or go people-watching on Cannes’ promenade (25 km).

properties.name: Camping Merendella
properties.description:
In the northeast of the island of Corsica you'll find the campsite Merendella. The campsite is located in an area known for the pristine white beaches and idyllic bays. This family campsite has a swimming pool, paddling pool and wellness pool. In the high season, daily activities are organised.

Beach or park?

The campsites vary in size, but are all at least 80 m². On the campsite you can choose from two areas for camping. Would you rather have a camping pitch among the trees on the park section of the campsite? Or a spot on the sea with a beautiful view. Your choice. The sanitation facilities are spread out throughout the campsite Merendella.

Heated swimming pool

Regardless of when you visit campsite Merendella in San Nicolao, you can always swim! The outdoor pool is heated and can be covered. Around the swimming pool there are lounges, so you can comfortably dry in the sun after a dip in the pool.

From the swimming pool you have a splendid view of the sea. For small children, there is a special section with sprinklers, slide and other water facilities. Are the children a bit older? Then they'll love the three slides! For adults, there is a wellness section with massage streams, solarium and sauna.

Entertainment for all

In the high season, there are daily activities organised for campers of various ages. Creative workshops, plays and dance evenings. Sporty types, don't despair: there are also various competitions held.

properties.name: Camping Sassabanek
properties.description:
Fancy waking up by the beautiful Lake Iseo? That’s possible at Camping Sassabanek! Here, you will be camping surrounded by greenery, with views of the water and the mountains of Lombardy. During the day, you can take a dip in the lake or go for lovely walks. In the evening, you can sit down to a plate of fresh pasta.

Camping by the water

The campsite is spacious and you can choose from over 270 camping pitches and a number of comfortable mobile homes. Whether you are travelling with a tent, caravan or motorhome, you will always find a nice spot. Thanks to the many green areas, you will enjoy plenty of shade – just the thing on hot summer days.

Swimming and delicious food

With two swimming pools at the campsite and three adjacent pools that you can use as a campsite guest, there’s always somewhere to cool down or take a dip. And of course, a refreshing swim in Lake Iseo is a must. The campsite has its own sandy beach there.

Yet another bonus: good food is never far away. At the campsite restaurant, you can enjoy pizzas fresh out the oven and local dishes. There is also an entertainment team that organises activities for all ages. There are plenty of options for sports enthusiasts, too. Try your hand on the tennis court or challenge your fellow campers to a game of beach volleyball. And water sports such as kayaking or windsurfing are also available.

properties.name: Cieloverde Camping Village
properties.description:
In the Meremma region of Tuscany lies Cieloverde Camping Village near the resort town of Marina di Grosseto. The campsite is situated in a pine forest and is equipped with all amenities.

Wild West in Maremma

The campsite is generously sized, beautifully laid out and well-structured with plenty of rental accommodation in addition to pitches for caravans, mobile homes and tents. The pitches are spacious and offer shade and privacy. Spread out over the camping you will find six large, luxuriously equipped sanitary buildings.

The facilities on the campsite are good. There are no less than three restaurants: a self-service restaurant/pizzeria, an à-la-carte restaurant and a 'Wild West' restaurant. For guests wanting to do their own cooking, there is a large well-stocked supermarket. Furthermore, there is a bar and a gelateria for a lovely cappuccino, a beer or an ice cream.

Taking the train to the beach

Cieloverde Camping Village accommodates a large number of families with young children and teenagers. Therefore, there are facilities for both young and old. There is a swimming paradise surrounded by a sizeable area for sunbathing. The swimming pool is in the full sun, hence sun umbrellas are a necessary luxury in the summer months. The beach is situated some 800 m from the campsite and can be reached on foot, by bicycle or with the small train from the campsite. On the beach, you will find a beach bar.

There are various sporting opportunities. For instance, there is a fitness trail, a volleyball field and a jeu de boule pitch. There are two playgrounds for the little ones. In high season, the camping offers programmes for young and old with sports, games and entertainment.

properties.name: Camping Hof Biggen
properties.description:
The hilly Sauerland with its rivers and dams forms the perfect background for a stay at campsite Hof Biggen. This is a well maintained campsite along a lovely lake, with slightly different elevations in places. You stay here to do some walking or simply to enjoy camping life, possibly alternated with cultural and sporty day trips.

Attractive view

The campsite is very diverse. It is quite a steep climb to some of the pitches but you will get a splendid view in return. These pitches are also the most spacious. The other pitches are also nicely laid out and in a beautiful location. The atmosphere is relaxed and amicable. If you have not brought any camping gear, you can rent one of a few dozen of tour caravans.

Form campfire to Playstation

Children and teenagers will enjoy the play equipment, sports fields, a Playstation room and a children's cinema. In high season all kinds of activities (campfire) and excursions are organised. Because the campsite does not have its own swimming pool, you can board the 'swimming bus' once a week to swimming paradise Aqua Magis. At a distance of just 4 km from the campsite you will find the Biggesee, where you can swim and take boat trips. Also fun: hire a bicycle and explore the lake area.

Free rental car

There are two rental cars available for camping guests (only petrol costs are charged). This service is ideal for camper van owners.

Old-fashioned cosy restaurant

The campsite shop is well-stocked with daily necessities. The restaurant is managed by an elderly couple and has a convivial ambiance.

properties.name: Camping Antholz
properties.description:
Camping Antholz is a beautifully situated campsite in the region of Trentino-Alto Adige/Südtirol near the village of Rasen-Antholz. The campsite is located near the Austrian border and the Antholzer See. Thanks to its proximity to Kronplatz Mountain, the campsite is a perfect base for an active holiday both in summer and winter. Antholz is an extremely well-maintained terraced campsite that exudes a pleasant feeling of tranquillity. It's the perfect place to slow down and rest.

Family business

Camping Antholz is operated by the Wieser family, who do everything to make their guests feel at home. The perfectly tended pitches are spacious and even large campers have plenty of room. Next to the pitches you can rent so-called "sleeping barrels", which are romantic wooden huts for two to four people. 

Into the mountains

The campsite is mainly geared towards guests who come here in summer to hike in the mountains (guidebooks with hiking trails are available from the reception). In winter campers come here to enjoy the wide range of winter sport options the region has to offer. The campsite borders the Rieserferner Ahrn nature park with its many glaciers, mountain torrents and waterfalls. 

Winter sport: The 2,275 m high Kronplatz mountain (located 27 km from the campsite) boasts a total of 114 km of pistes. It is one of the few ski resorts in the Alps with no fewer than five black pistes. But there's also everything here to delight beginner and intermediate skiers too.

Sanitary facilities

In one word: perfect. In the basement where the sanitary facilities are housed, you will also find a sauna and some infrared cabins.

properties.name: Camping Latsch
properties.description:
At Camping Latsch, on the outskirts of the village of Latsch in South Tyrol (Italy), you enjoy a holiday in a sunny valley by the babbling River Adige. You stay at the foot of the Sonnenberg, one of the giants of the mighty Ötztal Alps. You can take many lovely walks and bike rides in the surrounding area.

Friendly campsite with spacious pitches

Hotel Vermoi is the first thing that stands out when you arrive at the site. This hotel houses 12 luxury apartments and 30 hotel rooms. The campsite itself is behind this building. If you appreciate quiet, try and book a pitch behind the hotel building and preferably close to the river at Camping Latsch. Then you will barely hear the sound of the traffic on the main road that runs past the campsite.

Wonderful relaxation in an indoor and outdoor swimming pool

This campsite has a lovely outdoor swimming pool. It's wonderful swimming here thanks to its playful shape and the beautiful view. If you'd rather swim indoors, you can use the hotel's indoor swimming pool for free. The hotel building also has a Finnish sauna, a small supermarket and an excellent restaurant.

Take the cable car to the top of the Sonnenberg

From Camping Latsch, there is a small bridge over the Adige. It's handy because it means you can walk to the charming village centre within five minutes. The St Martin cable car is even closer. It takes you to the typical mountain village of San Martino Al Monte. This village is on the Sonnenberg, where you can follow various high mountain trails and mountain bike routes.

properties.name: Camping Le Ventoux
properties.description:
Mont Ventoux is a popular destination with cycling tourists. Campsite Le Ventoux is close by, near Mazan. From this small campsite, it’s a short drive to Bédoin, the starting point for a climb up Mont Ventoux. This mighty mountain is also surrounded by a beautiful nature area. You will also find lovely landscapes with lavender fields and vineyards near the campsite. The campsite's facilities include a large outdoor pool, a good restaurant and a fun entertainment programme for young and old.

Compact site with spacious pitches

The campsite is well-organised; the touring pitches have a fine gravel base and are separated from each other naturally. The standard pitches measure 70 to 100 square metres. Want more space and great views? Then choose a panoramic pitch; these measure 150 m2, have a terrace covering and unobstructed views of the vineyards and Mont Ventoux. Modern mobile homes are available too.

Large swimming pool and entertainment

Take a refreshing dip in the campsite pool. At the pool bar, order a tasty snack platter, crepes or a refreshing ice cream. Entertainment is provided in the summer holidays too. For children, there are fun games, face painting sessions, treasure hunts and mini-discos etc. Adults can enjoy wine tastings, sports tournaments and fun themed evenings in the restaurant.

Climb Mont Ventoux

Are you a trained cycling fanatic? Then head to nearby Bédoin (10-minute drive), where the most famous (and toughest) climb of Mont Ventoux starts. Another good starting point is Malaucène (20-minute drive).

properties.name: Camping Adriatico
properties.description:
Do you like to spend your holiday on the beach? Then travel to campsite Adriatico in Martinsicuro, the Abruzzo region. This campsite is located just 100 metres from a long sandy beach on the crystal-clear Adriatic Sea. The campsite is small and quiet. Facilities include a playground, shop, restaurant and (in high season) entertainment for all ages.

Shaded pitches and modern accommodation

At this well-maintained family campsite, paved paths lead to the pitches. All pitches are neatly separated by hedges and trees. There is also plenty of shade throughout the site. The smaller pitches are 48 m2. Would you like more space? Then choose a larger pitch: 96 m2. For extra comfort, book a modern mobile home.

Close to family-friendly beach

This campsite is a great base for a beach holiday. There is a kilometre-long sandy Adriatic beach about 100 metres from your pitch. For families with (young) children, this beach is ideal because the seabed here slopes down very slowly. Want to bring your dog with you? About 400 m away, there is a beach where dogs are welcome. The campsite itself is a dog-friendly destination too because it has a dog park with fun games.

Campsite entertainment mainly organised in high season. Children are then welcome at the mini-club or junior club; later in the day, the whole family can enjoy entertaining evening shows. The campsite also has an atmospheric restaurant serving pizzas and other Italian specialities.

properties.name: Landal Bospark 't Wolfsven
properties.description:
Between the villages of Mierlo and Geldrop in North Brabant is an expansive wooded area with various lakes and fens. Bospark ’t Wolfsven lies in the centre of these wooded areas, five minutes from Mierlo’s village centre and only a couple of kilometres from the beautiful Strabrechtse Heide. At this holiday park, families with children are able to have a great time. There is a beautiful indoor swimming pool, a small swimming lake with a sandy beach, and there are fun activities during the high season. The campsite also has its own restaurant and supermarket.

Nice selection for those who love to go camping and glamping

Bospark ’t Wolfsven is a resort with comfortable accommodations. For example, you can stay in a luxury bungalow, chalet or tiny house. For those who want to camp with their own caravan, motorhome and/or tent, this holiday park has tidy camping fields with spacious touring pitches. Various well-kept toilet and washing facilities are distributed throughout the grounds; they fit in with the nature and size of the campsite.

Plenty of water fun and a varied activities programme

The holiday park has several ponds and small lakes. There is a special fish pond and a wonderful swimming lake with a sandy beach. Among all this water is a somewhat larger lake where you can have fun on a pedal boat. The main building of the campsite is on its banks, which also houses Wolfshoeve restaurant, the game zone and the kids’ club. Bospark ’t Wolfsven organises many kinds of activities during school holidays, especially for children.

At the centre of Bospark ’t Wolfsven is an indoor swimming pool. It has a large basic swimming pool with a slide. The wading pool also has a slide and water play equipment. You can relax in the Jacuzzi nearby.

properties.name: Les Bois Flottés
properties.description:
Camping Les Bois Flottés is situated in the extreme south of France, on the south side of the town of Salin-de-Giraud. You camp here in the heart of the Camargue where wild horses gallop on the beach and flamingoes colour the sky. Do you like camping on a large pitch, near a river and close to the sea? If so, you will have a wonderful holiday at Les Bois Flottés.

Welcome!

At the campsite you will notice immediately why it is called 'driftwood'. The reason is that a lot of this type of wood has been used to make gates and terrace covers. Yet, the campsite has a modern appearance, which can be seen in the restaurant, swimming pool and sanitary facilities, for instance.

Unique swimming pool

The swimming pool has an unusual shape. In the centre is a white ramp with a few fountains on top and an illuminated 'tunnel' underneath. Very unusual! The area around the pool is suitable for sunbathing. You can enjoy a drink or a scrumptious meal on the terrace. Also find a spot under some shade cloths, which -needless to say- are draped over driftwood frames.

Various rental accommodation units

Even if you don't have your own tent or caravan, you can still spend the night at this campsite. You can rent a Coco Sweet for four persons or one of several mobile homes. A Coco Sweet is a quirky combination of a tent and a caravan. The mobile homes all have their own terrace. 

Regional products

The reception building houses a camping shop where you can buy a large assortment of regional products. Enough choice to prepare a tasty meal.

properties.name: Camping Si Es An
properties.description:
Camping Si Es An is an attractively laid out and well maintained campsite with clean sanitary facilities and spacious camping pitches. Si Es An is situated in the Het Reestdal, an old cultural landscape on the border of Overijssel and Drenthe. You can make lovely cycling and walking trips in the area. There are also all kinds of nice attractions in the vicinity. The campsite is situated some 5 minutes from Balkbrug, where you can do your shopping.

Beautifully laid out grounds

When you enter the campsite, you will see a few bungalows on your right and the attractively laid out camping grounds on the left side of the road. The tourist pitches are located on spacious camping fields bordered by trees. The pitches are not separated, although you will always have 'back coverage' from the woodland or wooded bank. Because of their spaciousness, the camping pitches provide ample privacy, despite the lack of demarcation. On the campsite there are also several trekker huts, a bungalow and chalets for rent.

Ideal for families with children

There is plenty do for children on the campsite and in the vicinity. As a result you will find quite a number of families with small children here during high season. In low season you will mainly come across senior citizens who are looking for space and enjoy walking and cycling.

Attractive brasserie

There is no swimming pool of other swimming provision on the campsite. There is, however, a playground with a bouncer and some playground equipment. You can get a bite to eat or a drink in the brasserie, which is housed in the renovated farmhouse where the reception can also be found.

properties.name: Camping Ciudad del Ciclismo
properties.description:
Are you a true cycling or mountain bike enthusiast? Camping Ciudad del Ciclismo, near the small village of Cervera del Maestre (Castellón province), is an ideal holiday destination. This campsite has its own amazing mountain bike circuit. There are also many routes for hiking, cycling or mountain biking in the hilly area around the campsite. The campsite has been newly built and is run by an enthusiastic staff with a passion for both camping and mountain biking.

What accommodation options are there?

This small-scale campsite has five categories of pitches, of which the dimensions vary from 50 to 80 square metres. At Camping Ciudad del Ciclismo you can also book a stay in a modern glamping tent. These are suitable for a maximum of four people and have extra storage, which is handy for your bicycles and suitcases!

Relax in the swimming pool and at Cova Fonda restaurant

Have you had a great mountain bike ride or walking tour and are you tired when you come back to your pitch? First go for a refreshing dip in the outdoor swimming pool and then settle down on the charming terrace of Cova Fonda restaurant. This restaurant serves delicious grilled dishes.

Live life to the full on the mountain bike circuit

Ciudad del Ciclismo is the only campsite in Spain with its own mountain bike circuit. This circuit, with its stiff climbs, steep descents and challenging turns, is a pleasure for both beginning and experienced mountain bikers. An added attraction is being able to follow various tracks at this circuit. The campsite team gives professional training to children who want to perfect riding a mountain bike.

properties.name: Landal Vakantiepark Hunzedal
properties.description:
De Hondsrug in Drenthe is the only geopark in the Netherlands. Halfway up this ridge lies the village of Borger, home to Vakantiepark Hunzedal and to one of the most beautiful megaliths in Drenthe. Together with the Hunebedcentrum, it is a favourite attraction. It is only a few minutes away from the campsite by car. The surrounding area also offers walking and cycling opportunities through extensive natural landscapes. The holiday park itself has fun activities for young and old.

A selection from the options for accommodations

As you would expect from a holiday park, at Hunzedal you can choose from various luxury accommodations. For example, choose to stay in a safari tent, a modern mobile home or a luxury holiday home. If you prefer to camp, these neatly kept grounds accommodate a few hundred spacious pitches and a series of motorhome pitches.

What entertainment does this holiday park offer?

At Hunzedal you can have fun in all weather conditions. The beautiful swimming pool complex is open the entire season. The indoor section guarantees water fun, including a basic swimming pool (25 metres long!), a whimsically shaped recreational pool, two wading pools, rapids and a spectacular water slide. If the weather is nice, you can swim from the indoor pool to the outdoor swimming pool.

During Dutch school holidays, the park is especially attractive to children because of the entertainment. The programme includes crafting, dancing together, reading stories aloud, climbing, archery and laser gaming. Koos the mascot is a main figure in the children’s entertainment. The grounds also house a supermarket, restaurant, snack bar and cafe.

properties.name: Vakantiepark Callassande
properties.description:
Vakantiepark Callassande is near the beach of Callantsoog, in the top of North Holland. This is a well-kept campsite with lots of play and sports options, an indoor swimming pool and entertainment during the high season. This holiday park is also ideal as a starting point for wonderful walks and bicycle rides through the extensive landscapes of polder and dunes.

Which accommodation options does this campsite offer?

The pitches are distributed over small-scale fields with lots of greenery. Standard pitches are equipped with an electricity connection and are on average 80 square metres in size. To have more room, your own water tap station and/or private toilet and washing facilities, it is possible to book an upgrade at Vakantiepark Callassande. You can also rent a modern safari tent, a chalet or a luxury bungalow for your stay. Dogs are permitted in some of the accommodations; other accommodations are pet-free.

Fun in the water in the indoor swimming pool

Enjoy yourself in the beautiful indoor swimming pool. You whizz down a spectacular water slide, while the youngest campsite visitors have fun splashing in the wading pool. Vakantiepark Callassande’s swimming pool has a sliding roof that can be opened on summer days. For a delicious bite to eat go to the restaurant with its extensive menu. You can enjoy breakfast here as well.

Enjoy the beach, dunes and fields of flowers

If you feel like having a day at the beach, it's only a twenty-minute walk from the campsite to the wide sandy beach of Callantsoog. In the spring, you can enjoy the colourful fields of flowers that blossom. This is the largest uninterrupted flower bulb growing area in the Netherlands. If you feel like a day of strolling around or shopping in a city, go to the port of Den Helder (13.5 km) or Alkmaar (30.5 km).

properties.name: Camping La Cerise
properties.description:
Camping La Cerise is a small-scale family campsite in Malemort-du-Comtat, in the heart of the French department of Vaucluse, at the foot of Mont Ventoux. This spot under the cherry trees is an ideal spot for those seeking peace and quiet, families and nature lovers. It has all the ingredients for the perfect holiday in the Provence.

Camping in a wooded area

At this car-free campsite you camp on large pitches in a wooded area. If you would prefer a charming accommodation, there are fourteen mobile homes available, all of which have air conditioning. Not an unnecessary luxury in the department of Vaucluse!

Provençal evenings

Go for a swim in the heated outdoor swimming pool with paddling pool and sunbathing area. You can walk from the swimming pool straight onto the restaurant’s charming terrace. Enjoy a tasty lunch or dinner, made from local products, or have a delicious local beer or a glass of wine. If you would rather eat at your caravan but are not in the mood to cook, choose a takeaway meal. If you want to cook yourself, the small grocer’s carries products from various local farmers and businesses.

Themed evenings are organised regularly as well, where you pull up a chair in the campsite restaurant and, together with other campsite guests, enjoy the cosy atmosphere and authentic tastes of the region.

properties.name: Camping de Montréal
properties.description:
Some may call the Limousine region the real France, as it has not been invaded by mass tourism yet. You can still find peace and quiet, yet there is enough to do. Camping de Montréal is located in this tranquil region, next to a swimming and fishing lake and only a stone's throw away from Nature Park Millevaches en Limousin. The attractive town of Limoges is half an hour's drive away.

Well maintained grounds

The campsite looks well maintained and is kept neat. The pitches are predominantly level, spacious and beautifully laid out and demarcated with straight hedges. Trees provide some shade. Most of the pitches overlook the lake and the surrounding hills. There are a few luxury rental chalets at an affordable price.

Watercycling, fishing and walking

Swimming enthusiasts have a choice: do you jump into the pool or will you swim a lap in the lake adjacent to the campsite? Close to the reception is the well maintained swimming pool with vegetation, loungers and sun umbrellas along one side of the pool. Just outside the entrance gate is the sandy beach with sunbathing lawn along the lake. There are two diving boards here. Also nice: rent a pedalo! Anglers are also welcome, disabled anglers can take a seat on the jetty. There is a playground for children with climbing equipment, a slide and a see-saw, as well as a sports field. There are many walking opportunities in the area. Bicycles can be hired at the campsite.

Tasty dishes

The campsite restaurant with terrace is open to the public during the summer months and offers simple, but tasty dishes. Take-away meals are also offered. A bread service is also available. There is no camping shop, but it is a short walk to the nearby St.-Germain-les-Belles.

properties.name: Camping Plantaza
properties.description:
At this quiet family campsite in Croatian Dalmatia, you can camp directly on a bay of the Adriatic Sea. The clear blue sea invites you to take a refreshing dip or go snorkelling. The Plantaza Campsite is within walking distance of the centre of Starigrad, where you will find several restaurants. There is a restaurant on the campsite where you can eat local dishes while looking out over the sea. The terraced campsite has pitches of various sizes with shade from the Mediterranean trees and plants on the site. At the Plantaza Campsite, you can enjoy a peaceful holiday in nature. The beautiful surroundings invite you to explore.

Family campsite

The small-scale family campsite is equipped with everything you need as a camper. A beautiful location with clean sanitary facilities, friendly staff and a lovely camping restaurant. People who've dined at our restaurant have given it positive reviews. Local dishes are served here, and guests describe the staff as very friendly and helpful. The terraced campsite has 100 comfortable camping pitches with plenty of shade. In the high season, you will mainly meet young families from the Netherlands, Germany and the Czech Republic at the campsite.

Snorkelling at the campsite

You can get a taste of the real Mediterranean atmosphere at the campsite! Take a cooling dip in the clear seawater. The Plantaza Campsite has its own beach that you can walk to from your tent. The bay at the campsite is great for swimming, and we can also recommend snorkelling there. You should know that the beach is a pebble beach. So we recommend water shoes.

properties.name: Vakantiepark Klein Vink
properties.description:
If you would like to camp near the Maas with the Castle Gardens in Arcen and De Maasduinen National Park just around the corner, the location of Klein Vink Holiday Park is absolutely ideal. This large resort serves as a starting point for amazing walking tours and bicycle rides along the Maas and through the countryside. Furthermore, you are only half an hour from Toverland amusement park, Fun Forest climbing park and Klein Switzerland playground. There is also plenty to do at the holiday park itself, especially for families with children.

Campsite or Résidence, which will you choose?

The grounds of this large holiday park has been split into two parts. First there is Campsite Klein Vink, where you can camp with your own tent, caravan or motorhome. In addition to spacious touring pitches, you will also find year pitches and modern safari tents. Even more glamping is available on the northern part of Klein Vink Holiday Park. This is Résidence Klein Vink, with luxury holiday villas, tiny houses and hotel rooms.

What is there for those who love to swim?

Wherever you are at Klein Vink, you are never far from water. On summer days, you can actually swim in the recreational lake on the edge of the Résidence section. A visit to the indoor swimming pool is always an option as well. And then there is also the Arcen thermal baths, which is next to the Klein Vink Holiday Park and is one of Limburg’s most beautiful spas.

Fun game activities

The school holidays are especially lively because then there is entertainment for children up to 12 years of age. Activities are organised at least five days a week. These include crafts, dancing, playing games, scavenger hunts through the woods, cooking workshops, bingo and laser gaming.

properties.name: Landal Bospark Lunsbergen
properties.description:
Bospark Lunsbergen is in the centre of De Hondsrug geopark, close to the charming village of Borger. You camp in a large woods where you can go on wonderful walks and bicycle rides. The spacious campsite is a favourite among families with (young) children during the high season in particular. It has a covered swimming pool, a restaurant, a supermarket and activities during the school holidays.

Low-traffic campsite with various accommodation options

Upon arriving, report to the campsite’s service point; next to the reception is a small restaurant and a small supermarket. At Bospark Lunsbergen you can stay on a spacious pitch, or you can stay in a modern mobile home, bungalow or safari tent. During your stay, your car must remain at a central parking area, keeping the campsite car-free.

Indoor swimming pool and lots of children’s entertainment

If you want to swim some laps or simply have fun in the water, Bospark Lunsbergen’s swimming pool is open the entire season. The indoor swimming pool is a large basic swimming pool with a small children’s slide. There is a wading pool with a small fountain for the little ones. In addition, during the school holidays, there is entertainment at least twice a week. Children can do crafts at the kids’ club, participate in playful cooking workshops or follow fun archery lessons.

Walking and cycling in the area

Beautiful walks and bicycle rides through the woods can be done starting right from the holiday park. One of the most fun walking tours in the vicinity of Bospark Lunsbergen is the Boomkroonpad (Treetop Path), where you walk along the treetops. Also nearby is the Hunebedcentrum (5.7 km) in Borger, the Drouwenerzand amusement park (8.3 km) and Wildlands Adventure Zoo (23.5 km).

properties.name: Camping Le Vélodrome
properties.description:
Camping Le Vélodrome lies on the outskirts of Albert, in the north of France in the department Somme. Albert is a town with a turbulent past. During the First World War, it was situated in or near the frontline for a long time. Many military cemeteries and monuments in and around Albert still remind one of that period. Due in part to the major British involvement in the aforementioned war, Albert is still often visited by British tourists and historians. Many of them choose Camping Le Vélodrome as a place to stay, although it is usual for this internationally oriented campsite to be visited by campsite visitors of all nationalities. It is a fairly simple campsite with few amenities.

Park-like site with various accommodation options

Camping Le Vélodrome has beautifully designed grounds with many small-scale camping fields. The touring pitches at this park-like campsite are spacious and are neatly separated as well. Other possible overnight accommodations: a modern mobile home, a charming caravan or a cosy Coco Sweet tent. The accommodations were new when installed in 2018 and are still in very good shape. A sanitary block for general use is at the centre of the campsite. The toilet facilities are somewhat dated.

Ideal location with respect to supermarkets and restaurants

The location on the outskirts of the town gives the added advantage that shops and catering establishments are nearby. There are several large supermarkets within a radius of one kilometre around the campsite. Going out for to a tasty snack and drink is easily done in the town centre. The walk there takes only 15 minutes.

properties.name: Camping Valira
properties.description:
Camping Valira is at walking distance from the centre of Andorra la Vella, the capital city of the mini state of Andorra in the Pyrenees. You will find an indoor swimming pool and own supermarket at this internationally oriented city campsite. The surrounding area is wonderful for walking, mountain biking, cycling and shopping. Considering the entertainment options on and around the campsite, you can easily entertain yourself for several days or even weeks here. This is also an excellent stopover campsite for holidaymakers travelling between France and Spain.

Shaded pitches with mountain views

On arrival, you will receive a friendly welcome from a member of the family that has run this shaded terraced campsite for dozens of years. Emilio is usually the one who takes you to your pitch. The campsite has neat, demarcated pitches with views of the surrounding mountains. As a camper, you can use the well-maintained toilet and washing facilities here. You can also stay in a lovely bungalow.

Wonderfully relaxed in the indoor swimming pool

Swimming fanatics are at the right place at this campsite as there is an indoor swimming pool with heated water. Covering about 100 square metres, this indoor swimming pool is large enough to swim some laps. A hot tub and a slide give the swimming pool at Camping Valira that bit extra flair.

Out for dinner, grocery shopping and (tax free) shopping

There is a charming restaurant right next to Camping Valira where you can have delicious meals. You don't have to leave the grounds to do grocery shopping either because the campsite has its own supermarket with a wide selection of essentials and camping equipment.

properties.name: Camping Le Florival
properties.description:
The Le Florival campsite is set among the green hills of Alsace. This municipal campsite is friendly and quiet. It is the perfect camping destination for hikers and cyclists. You can easily walk or cycle to Cernay and Guebwiller. A little further away, the half-timbered houses in Colmar are worth a visit.

Well-kept and green camping pitches

The Le Florival campsite in one word? Pristine. The spacious pitches are nicely situated next to each other. And all the greenery is well kept. Here you are sure to get a nice pitch with lots of grass and privacy. There are trees around many of the pitches. So you can also sit in the shade. Are you without your camping gear? Then stay in one of the chalets.

Ideal for children and elderly

This quiet campsite is ideal for families with small children. The Le Florival campsite is also a great camping destination for older campers. The little ones can play in the playground. Swinging and going down the slide: that’s all they need. Are your kids a bit older? Then hit the volleyball court. Or maybe they’ll like to play bocce ball.

Swimming pools, slides, and white-water rapids

Of course, the biggest attraction of the campsite is the swimming pool complex. This is right next to the campsite. A few minutes walk, and you are already in the water. Dive into one of the large pools together or paddle in the children’s pools. The possibilities are endless! Thrill seekers can zip down the slides or white water rapids. Those looking for peace and quiet are sure to find it in the hot tub.

properties.name: Camping Continental
properties.description:
If you like swimming, fishing, windsurfing, good food and lazing under the Italian sun, Camping Continental is the right place for you. The campsite is located on the eastern side of Lake Garda, only 1 km away from Bardolino and Garda. The region is very popular for its climate and the beautiful landscape. The campsite borders directly on Lake Garda, interrupted only by a walking and cycling path lined with beautiful trees on the water's edge.

Ideal for young families

The pathways on the campsite are paved and well maintained. The terrain is slightly sloping. The pitches are neat and measure 50-70 m2. You will stay on a fine grass surface, demarcated with shrubs. And the lush greenery of (pine) trees everywhere! There are also beautiful cottages and bungalows available for rent. These have a cheerful look and are made of sleek and contemporary materials.

New and beautiful swimming pool

The campsite was almost entirely renovated over the last few years. It now boasts a sparkling new swimming pool of 500 m2 with lovely water play equipment. There are bright, contemporary colours all around the pool. You won't believe your eyes! It is surrounded by a lawn with loungers and white sun umbrellas.

Do you prefer open water? No problem. Leaving the exit at the back of the campsite, you have to cross the walking and cycling boulevard which runs between Bardolino and Garda. On the water's edge you will find a small-sized beach (sand with pebbles) and a lawn.

Eating and drinking

The campsite shop is well stocked. The new amiable restaurant has an excellent menu. The furnishing is comfortable and colourful, both inside and outside on the terrace.

properties.name: Sonnenplateau Camping Gerhardhof
properties.description:
Sonnenplateau Camping Gerhardhof is situated on the sunny plateau Wildermieming. Thanks to its favourable high altitude location, Camping Gerhardhof enjoys sunshine all year round. Furthermore, this destination is guaranteed to have snow in the winter. Here you can enjoy the fresh mountain air surrounded by beautiful Tyrolean nature.

Decor of pine trees and mountains

Camping Gerhardhof knows that the ideal camping holiday is different for everyone. At this modern campsite, you can therefore bring your camper, caravan or tent. But also for a special night in a luxury glamping tent. Whatever you choose, you will sleep here nestled in a natural setting of pine trees and mountains. The new and perfectly maintained sanitary facilities are also worth mentioning.

Natural swimming

The large swimming pond in the middle of the campsite is a real eye-catcher and invites you to take a refreshing dip. The water of the swimming pond comes from a private source and is cleaned with a biological filter system. Around the pond are sunbeds where you can dream away in the sun.

Regional dishes and local products

The shop at the reception offers basic products such as bread and a wide range of Tyrolean specialities. For your shopping, you can go to the town of Telfs, less than five kilometres away. In the historic inn the Gerhardhof, the most delicious regional dishes are prepared for you. It's cosy both inside and out! Children can play in the playground next to the restaurant. In this special place, you will experience traditional Austrian hospitality. Be pampered and enjoy!

properties.name: Camping Les Ballastières
properties.description:
Camping Les Ballastières is at the foot of the southern Vosges in the Haute-Saône and is a quiet family destination by the water. But quiet does not mean boring here! There is plenty to do on and around this campsite, located in the Ballons des Vosges Regional Mature Park, for both for children as well as adults.

Spacious camping pitches and special accommodation

With spacious camping pitches and unique accommodation, this campsite has something for everyone. And that, whether you bring your own motorhome, caravan or tent and get lucky with a spot with views of the river or opt for a comfortable mobile home or special accommodation. For example, a Canadian tent or a tent on poles. Take advantage of the proximity of large supermarkets and a local baker and butcher.

Enjoying the waterfront

If you like water-based fun, you can choose from jumping into the swimming pool or in the lake with a sandy beach, beside the campsite. You can then relax by the waterfront at the bar and restaurant. Here, you can enjoy a snack and drink with a stunning view. If you want a bit more action, you can play a game of table football, table tennis or billiards, and in the high season they organise fun activities and themed evenings for the whole family.

The campsite's surrounding area.

Thanks to the many cycling and mountain bike routes around the campsite, you can explore the area in a fun and sporting way. Lac du Malsaucy is 12 km away, a coastal resort including pedal bike hire and water sports options.

properties.name: Camping du Vieux Château
properties.description:
Camping du Vieux Château is situated in the famous Saint-Emilion wine region, located at the foot of the medieval castle of Rauzan. You will find centuries-old trees on the camping grounds. It is very green and tranquil. Rauzan is within walking distance and the cities of Libourne and Bordeaux are not far away.

Campsite with a rich history

Nature on the campsite is rich in history with some trees being older than 100 years. The campsite looks like a park and offers ample shade. You can opt for a sunny pitch or one completely in the shade. The pitches are all spacious (at least 120 m2) and demarcated with shrubs. They have a grass surface. Want to rent something? There are rental mobile homes and bungalows, as well as a converted, old Swiss army truck. Unique!

Elegant swimming pool

The heated swimming pool has an attractive design and ample space and greenery around it. Pot plants, loungers and sun umbrellas create a nice atmosphere. The lovely, circular toddler pool has a water slide. From here you also have a splendid view of the nearby castle.

Geocaching

There is also a playground with a bouncing castle, a spring rider and a double swing. You can also have fun on the multi-sports field. In peak season, owner Tom offers archery lessons and geocaching. Also during peak season, social evenings are held in and around the restaurant on Thursdays.

Restaurant with nice terrace

There is a restaurant with a limited menu and a cosy terrace. The tent cloth covering makes this a nice and shady spot. In the camping shop you can buy some basic foodstuffs and regional products.

properties.name: Boutique Camping Bunja
properties.description:
