The island of Brač is located in central Dalmatia, one of the most beautiful areas of Croatia. The island is very wooded. But in the South, there are barren plains and some quarries. Brač, with more than 2,700 hours of sunshine per year, is one of the sunniest areas on the Adriatic coast. Boutique Camping Bunja is a small and quiet campsite on the island. With an excursion programme for adults, an outdoor swimming pool, some play equipment, and high quality sanitary facilities, you have everything you need.

Well maintained campsite

The campsite is located two kilometres from the ferry port of Supetar. Take the ferry from Split to get there. A two-kilometre winding road leads from the harbour to Boutique Camping Bunja. This fairly new campsite is neat and clean. The paths to your pitch are laid out with pebbles. To the left and right of the paths, you will find large and smaller pitches (60–130 m²). There are also 14 modern mobile homes on a terrace area.

There is water fun for the entire family

The campsite has a nice pool measuring 10 × 3 m. The water is heated in the early season. More water fun? Near the campsite is a public pebble beach, where many day trippers come. You’ll also find lounge chairs and parasols. The sea here is crystal clear. Rent a canoe or a paddleboard and get out on the water!

Eating and drinking

At the pool is a beach bar, where you can order something from the small menu. There is also a restaurant with a wider range of dishes. You can go there all morning – also for a nice breakfast. The terrace offers a spectacular of the sea.

properties.name: Camping Lesny Nr. 51
properties.description:
Camping Lesny Nr. 51 lies in the north of Poland in the Pommeren region. This campsite, in the village of Łeba, is within walking distance of restaurants and shops. The beach on the Baltic Sea is only 800 metres away from the campsite. Camping Lesny Nr. 51 is an ideal holiday destination for campsite visitors who love nature, walking, cycling and charming villages. The campsite has amenities such as a swimming pool, playground and communal kitchen.

Communal kitchen

You camp on spacious, non-demarcated grassy pitches, surrounded by trees. The toilet and washing facilities also house the communal kitchen, washing machines and a covered recreational area. If you would prefer to rent an accommodation, stay in a holiday home equipped with its own kitchen, bathroom and air conditioning. The campsite has enough amenities to amuse you during your holiday in Pommeren. There is a playground for children and an outdoor swimming pool to cool off.

Swimming, cycling and hiking

At Camping Lesny Nr. 51 you are only a stone’s throw away from the sea. You can walk from the campsite through the village and the dunes to the beach. Go for a stroll along the beach or a dip into the sea. The surrounding area has plenty of hiking and cycle routes in the beautiful countryside. The reception has information about the routes and the options for day trips with a guide. For example, it is possible to book a sea fishing excursion. You can also rent bicycles here if you have not taken your own bicycle with you.

properties.name: Camping Duinezwin
properties.description:
Camping Duinezwin is situated on the Belgian coast, immediately behind a narrow belt of dunes. An ideal spot to catch a breath of fresh air during a seaside holiday at the characteristic Belgian coast with its wide beaches. The village of Bredene lies in the vicinity. From the campsite you can take the classic cycle routes or use the junction network.

Well maintained

The campsite makes a well maintained impression. At the reception you will be warmly welcomed by the owners, who will allocate a pitch to you on one of the camping fields. The three sanitary buildings of the campsite have undergone extensive interior renovations. There are special facilities for the disabled, children and babies.

Relaxation and play

The campsite makes a very well maintained impression. There are spacious pitches with well-tended grass. The grounds are open, with some interspersed vegetation. At the front of the campsite there are dedicated pitches for motorhomes. On the campsite you will find a few play fields with modern and colourful playground equipment. There is also a soccer field and a pétanque pitch on the last field. Wi-Fi is available for a fee around various Wi-Fi hotspots.

Beach fun

You can get to the beach quickly via a pedestrian bridge over the main road. On hot summer days you can easily spend the entire day sunbathing, swimming and splashing in the water. On other days the beach is ideal for walking and enjoying the sea breeze. There are several free Wi-Fi hotspots on the Bredene beach. There is also a nudist beach in a sheltered location at the foot of a protected dune reserve with ample privacy. Dressed bathers do not experience nuisance from this.

properties.name: Camping Lido
properties.description:
Camping Lido is located in the Italian town of Bibione Pineda. The campsite is situated in a beautiful pine forest and has its own sandy beach on the Adriatic Sea. This pleasant family campsite has many facilities, so young and old can enjoy themselves all day long. From a large swimming pool and a lively sports programme to relaxation and wellness.

Sporting fun for all

With the Adriatic sea and a swimming pool, there is plenty of water fun for everyone at the campsite. The real fanatics will soon discover the nearby Camping Capalonga. Here you can learn to surf, windsurf, sail and sail on a catamaran. The guests of Camping Lido are more than welcome here. Camping Lido offers many different sports courses: archery, tennis, volleyball, canoeing and aquagym.

Wellness

The natural environment together with the smell of the sea make you feel relaxed. On the grounds of the neighbouring campsite Capalonga, relaxing in the Seawell SPA goes a step further. Hit the sauna, get a massage and look out over the Venice lagoon from the patio. Finish your visit with a refreshing drink and you'll feel like a new person!

Entertainment

For children from 5 to 18 years, there is a fun and varied entertainment programme at the campsite. The Bibione Crocky Club has something fun to offer every day! There are games to play throughout the day and in the evening you can have fun with musical evenings and shows for young and old.

Are you camping with avid soccer players? Then the children can register for the Soccer Camp that organises all kinds of competitions and tournaments. Lovers of dance and theatre are also catered for with the Dance and Arts Camp. Together with professional dancers, you will playfully get to work with music, dance and theatre.

properties.name: Camping Village Capalonga
properties.description:
Village Capalonga campsite is located in a beautiful landscape nestled between the sea and the lagoon north of Venice. Camping here you're just a few minutes drive away from the city of Bibione Pineda. This site sits next to a beautiful wide sandy beach where the sea is calm and shallow. And entertainment is always at your fingertips at the campsite. Multiple animation teams treat the whole family to all kinds of fun activities. With two restaurants and two bars, you can always order a tasty snack and drink.

Camping and renting

There are almost eight hundred camping pitches and over five hundred rental units. The camping pitches are beautifully maintained. They are spread over the campsite and differ in size (70-90 m2) and amount of shade. If you don't have camping equipment, just book an accommodation. The majority consists of all kinds of mobile homes. They are brightly coloured and do differ in the level of luxury they offer. So you'll always find a suitable mobile home for you.

There is water fun for the entire family

Capalonga's swimming complex is no less than 1,500 square metres. Here you will find, among other things, a heated indoor pool with a retractable roof. There is also a heated outdoor pool. Slides, play equipment, a paddling pool, a wellness area and a sunbathing area complete the picture. As a result, there is always something to experience for the youngest and the oldest camper.

Sporting fun!

At the Village Capalonga campsite you can play football, tennis, fitness, archery and table tennis. Would you rather not get sweaty? Throwing a ball on the jeu de boules green or hitting the ball on the mini golf course is also great fun. And what do you think about yoga, horseback riding or darts? J

properties.name: Camping Löwenhof
properties.description:
If you enjoy lovely trips into the countryside during your holiday and you prefer staying at a small-scale campsite, Camping Löwenhof is the perfect holiday address. This campsite is in the middle of the lovely town of Brixen in the Eisack Valley. That makes Camping Löwenhof an excellent starting point for numerous beautiful walks though the Dolomites. This area also offers many possibilities for doing other mountain sports.

Neat campsite hidden behind the hotel

When you drive onto the site, the first thing you notice is the modern-looking Hotel Löwenhof. The camping section is behind that. This clearly laid out campsite has a few dozen neatly maintained camping pitches. Here, you choose from a classic, comfort or premium pitch. They vary in size.

Enjoy the lovely heated outdoor swimming pool

As a campsite guest, you can use all the hotel's amenities. That includes a lovely wellness zone with a swimming cave, sauna, solarium and hot tub, among others. Furthermore, the hotel has a specialty restaurant, a little shop, play areas and modern toilets and washing rooms, which were renovated in 2019. Camping Löwenhof also has its own outdoor swimming pool with paddling pool.

Conquer the Plose - walking, climbing or with the cable car

When you book a stay at Camping Löwenhof in Brixen, you automatically get the so-called Brixen Card. This is extremely handy because it gives you free use of public transport in the region. One of the most significant sights around Brixen is the Plose, an impressive mountain just east of the town. It is certainly worth conquering the Plose walking or climbing.

properties.name: Camping Morski
properties.description:
Campsite Morski 21 is on the Polish coast. You camp in a wooded area close to the Baltic Sea, just minutes away from the beach or a stroll along the marina. You can completely unwind or get out and about here. Put on your hiking boots for a trek through Słowiński national park, or stroll to the lively centre of Łeba. The campsite has a cosy bar, a playground, a volleyball court and a campfire and barbecue area.

Camp in comfort in the forest

Campsite Morski 21 is a green site with lots of trees. It has both camping pitches and accommodation. The pitches are large and covered with grass. Would you rather rent accommodation? Choose a spacious apartment with a private terrace or a cosy room with kitchenette. All accommodation is modern and has everything you need, from comfortable beds to a well-equipped kitchen.

Always something to do, for young and old

The location close to the sea is ideal. A refreshing dip is just a 500-metre walk away. Afterwards, head to the campsite bar for homemade dishes and cold drinks. Children will have adventures in the fun playground, while you read a book near your tent. Handy: the campsite also has a supermarket and a kiosk, so there’s no need to leave the site for your day-to-day shopping. In the evening, light the barbecue and end the day with the smell of roasted corn cobs in the air.

properties.name: BijBatenstein stadscamping Woerden
properties.description:
Do you want to rest and relax on holiday but also like having the conveniences of city life close at hand? Then city campsite BijBatenstein in Woerden is for you. Here, you camp in a natural setting in Brediuspark. Want to go shopping, eat out or visit tourist hotspots? All of this is possible on foot, as Woerden's historic city centre is only 800 metres away. Camping in the middle of the Green Heart, you are within easy reach of the centre of Utrecht for a day of culture and shopping.

Camping on water-rich site

This campsite is almost completely surrounded by water. A few streams flow through the site too. So, many of the pitches are by or near the water. At this park-like campsite, you will also find several motorhome pitches and a relatively high number of seasonal pitches. A number of other types of accommodation are available too. Spend the night in a glamping tent or glamping hotel room. The campsite is car-free.

Enjoy the swimming pool next door

Zwembad Batenstein is a swimming paradise and right next to the campsite. As a campsite guest, you get a discount on this beautiful indoor pool with paddling pool and a spectacular water slide. Behind the pool, you will find BatensteinBuiten, a freely-accessible sports and play paradise. Facilities include an air trampoline, cable car, sandy area, swings, mini-golf course and climbing and scrambling zone. On the campsite itself, there’s a lot of fishing (for licence holders), especially for big carp and pike.

Explore Woerden

Woerden is an old fortified town with a history that goes all the way back to Roman times. There’s lots to see in the city centre. The various churches, the city hall, Woerden Castle and the distinctive Gildepoortje.

properties.name: Panorama Camp Zell am See
properties.description:
In the well-known Austrian village of Zell am See lies the charming campsite Panorama Camp Zell am See. The campsite is a ten-minute drive from the village and only 500 metres from the southern banks of the Lake Zell, a beautiful lake surrounded by high mountains. In the summer, the family campsite is the perfect home base for hikers, cyclists and water sports enthusiasts. In the winter, the campsite is open for winter sportsmen and sportswomen who enjoy winter camping. In short, the attractive Zell am See is a good place for holidaymakers all year round.

View of imposing mountains

Panorama Camp Zell am See has a beautiful location with a view of imposing mountains such as the Kitzsteinhorn and the Schmittenhöhe. You camp on grass and there are lots of trees on the grounds. The campsite has a playground, a multi-functional playing field and a table-tennis table. Animal lovers will enjoy themselves at the campsite’s petting zoo, which includes rabbits and chickens. Right next to the campsite is a farm with cows and horses. Dogs are welcome at the campsite. 500 metres away is an off-lead area where your faithful four-footed friend can run free.

Swimming in Lake Zell

A pathway leaves the campsite that will take you to the beach by the lake in about ten minutes. Campsite visitors at Panorama Camp Zell am See are granted free access. Take a refreshing swim in the clear water and enjoy the impressive view. Various cycle routes leave the campsite, which is a great way to explore the surrounding area. Bicycles can be rented from the campsite’s reception.

properties.name: Spreewald Kneipp- und ErlebnisCamping
properties.description:
In the Spreewald, located right on the banks of a river, lies the campsite Kneipp- und Erlebnis. This eco-camping property consists of various fields on open pitches in the woords. The site is located amidst peaceful, idyllic surroundings and exclusively features touring pitches. Discover the Spreewald by kayak or bicycle, or relax with a massage or a visit to the sauna at the campsite's wellness and beauty centre.

Friendly reception

The large wooden reception building was constructed in typical Spreewald style and has a very welcoming look to it. Next to the reception area is Gasthof Zum Plon, a cafe and restaurant with a terrace. The Kneipp- und Erlebnis campsite features hundreds of touring pitches, spread out across various grassy areas in the woods. There is a small area for tents as well as two large camping fields for caravans and campers. 

The site is almost exclusively oriented towards touring campers: there are no permanent pitches and only four rental accommodation options. This means that there are no mobile homes here. The rental accommodation options are charming pod cabins made from large, old wine barrels.

Still waters

Most of the guests at this campsite are water sports enthusiasts. Many bring their own kayaks, but canoes and kayaks are also available for hire. The site is located along the Südum Fluter, a branch of the Haubtspree river. You can explore the Spreewald by canoe, kayak or 'kahn' (a type of rowboat). Coast quietly through woods across the calm waters and take in the many aquatic birds, tranquillity and natural surroundings. 

Pure relaxation

Grassy knolls run from behind the main building down to the water. Wooden steps lead to the piers, where boats from the campsite are docked. When the weather is nice, you can also take refreshing dip in the creek.

properties.name: Camping Osenbach
properties.description:
Camping Osenbach is a campsite for everyone who wants to enjoy nature and peace in an eco-friendly environment. The campsite is beautifully situated on one of the plateaus from which you have a view of the mountainous area. You will find both open and sheltered pitches. On this campsite you will mainly come across sporty campers and nature lovers.

Respect for nature

Camping Osenbach creates an open impression with a flower meadow in the centre. From outside, the receptions looks like a sports canteen, but it has a modern interior. The entire campsite exudes respect for nature and is located in a magnificent area.

You can choose between an open, at times hardened pitch, or a sheltered spot 'in the woods'. The campsite is well maintained and is an oasis of peace with all its colourful flowers. The camping is laid out in terraces which blend naturally into the landscape. The splendid view of the valley is an added bonus. The wooded pitches are a bit more difficult to reach with somewhat longer camping gear. There are also rental huts, trapper cabins, lodges and cottages.

Regional products

There is a small snack bar where you can also find a few regional products. You can place a daily bread order here. There is a spacious seating arrangement under a wooden overhang. You can simply go to the village to do your shopping.

Clean sanitary facilities

There are two toilets and showers blocks, of which the building near the reception is the most modern. The buildings are kept neat and tidy.

properties.name: Villaggio Camping Capo Ferrato
properties.description:
Near a lovely sandy beach on an equally lovely sea near a lively tourist town: that's the location of Villaggio Camping Capo Ferrato. You're camping on the south east coast of Sardinia. A paradise for lovers of sun and sea who want to relax during the day and have fun at night. But also a great camping destination for families.

Wooded terrain

The leafy, partially sloping property looks very well maintained. The numbered pitches are sufficiently spacious and are lined up next to each other. You have a lovely view of the sea from most of the pitches. Want to hire something? Choose one of the simple or luxurious bungalows and mobile homes.

Diving and snorkeling

The campsite is located right on the Mediterranean Sea with a lovely bay with sandy beach. Here you'll find a restaurant where you can dine on a spacious terrace under awnings. On the beach there are various parasols with lounge chairs to hire. The sea is suitable for all kinds of activities such as surfing, diving and snorkeling.

Sardinian parties

Children will have fun in the playground or during activities. There are all kinds of things organised, even for adults, such as Sardinian themed evenings for the entire family. The area is very suitable for exploring by bike (also mountain bike) or on foot.

Dining on the covered terrace

The food is great in the campsite restaurant with a broad menu and covered terrace. There is also a good pizzeria and a bar. The camping shop offers everything for your daily needs, including fresh rolls. If you are looking for a more generous range, you can go to the nearby village, within walking distance.

properties.name: Camping Les Grangettes
properties.description:
Campsite Les Grangettes lies between a forest and Lake Geneva, just 9 km from Montreux. Here you are in the heart of the Les Grangettes nature reserve. Enjoy a walk over the long and wide beach. The campsite is an oasis of peace and quiet from where you can enjoy an exceptional view of Lake Geneva and the Castle of Chillon.

Camping with a view

When arriving at the campsite, you will immediately see the spacious parking facilities. On the left-hand side you can see the terrain with the permanent pitches, while on the right-hand side there are mainly touring pitches. The grounds have a level grass surface, meaning that there are not a lot of shady pitches. The pitches are not very large and are not demarcated. However, the whole campsite has an attractive view of the lake. 

Rental accommodation and sanitary facilities

Guest who arrive without their own camping equipment have a choice of three teepee rental tents for 2 to 10 persons and two holiday cottages, so-called 'pods', for 2 to 3 persons. The accommodation units are well maintained. The sanitary facilities of campsite Les Grangettes are very neat and are cleaned on a regular basis. 

Safe swimming

As the campsite is located directly on Lake Geneva and the water along the shore is shallow, children can also swim safely there. There is a slipway near the beach allowing you to use your own boat on the lake. 

Bites and drinks

Campsite Les Grangettes has a cosy restaurant with a large terrace and an extensive menu. The cuisine is traditional. You can have breakfast there from 9 a.m. Daily fresh bread is also available. The campsite does not have a shop.

properties.name: Comfort-Camping Freizeitpark Am Emsdeich
properties.description:
The child-friendly four star camping Am Emsdeich is spacious and in a beautiful location by the Freizeitssee. This is a natural, moderately-sized lake near Westoverledingen (4 km away) with a large sandy beach. They have constructed a few wooden platforms that project over the water, ideal for sunbathing. Also handy to tie up your boat. Canoeing and kayaking are favourite pastimes here, as are fishing and windsurfing.

Rural, spacious and calm

The campsite is well maintained everywhere and offers shade and privacy. This is borne out by the neatly maintained hedges and bushes around the demarcated pitches. The 350 touring pitches all look well maintained and are spacious (100 m2). Ready for a change? You can rent a glamping tent, a sleeping barrel with view of the lake or a wooden lodge.

Active and sporty

This is a great campsite for people who like active holidays (cycling, walking and water recreation). There is also a fun entertainment programme for children, who can also enjoy themselves on the playground with giant slide. Parents can enjoy themselves in the fitness area, sauna, on the sunbed and with all kinds of water sports possibilities.

Eating by the lake

There is a small camping shop/bar by the lake. The restaurant, on the other hand, is spacious and has a comprehensive menu. The restaurant is also located on the lake, which means a relaxing meal with beautiful view! Take-away meals are also offered.

Sanitary facilities

The sanitary facilities are well maintained and clean. Upon arrival all guests receive a key for the sanitary building. There are also toilets for seniors.

properties.name: Camping Village Internazionale
properties.description:
Campsite Internazionale is near the cosy village of Sirolo, in a beautiful spot on the Riviera del Conero. This is a well-maintained terraced campsite; there are unobstructed views of the Adriatic Sea in many places. Its location alongside two beaches is ideal for beach and water sports lovers. There are hiking and mountain biking trails in nearby Conero Park. On the campsite, you will find an outdoor swimming pool with paddling pool, a supermarket, a restaurant, a café and (in high season) a varied entertainment programme.

Terrace campsite at bottom of steep mountain road

Planning to stay at this campsite with a caravan or motorhome? Be aware that the access road from Sirolo is steep (up to 18%) and winding. So, descent only possible with a motorhome or caravan of no more than 6.9 m in length. On the way back up, the campsite offers a towing service. The access road may be challenging, but it’s all worth it once you get to the campsite. Its terraced layout gives you unobstructed views of the deep blue Adriatic Sea from many places. There is a mix of comfortable camping pitches and other modern accommodation like mobile homes and bungalows.

Things to do at the campsite itself?

Staying at the campsite for a day? Take a dip in the pool. Afterwards, relax on Café del Camping's panoramic terrace and order a drink or ice cream. Good food is served at campsite restaurant Ristorante Rosmarino. In the summer, there’s also entertainment for children aged 5 to 11. In the evening, enjoy entertainment like magic shows, cabaret performances and dance evenings.

properties.name: Strandcamping Groede
properties.description:
Strandcamping Groede is situated directly at the North Sea coast in Zeeland Flanders. This is the right place for either a lazy or an active holiday on the beach. There is an abundance of (water)sports options on and around the campsite. From horse riding on the beach to windsurfing on the foaming waves.

The campsite is easy to reach via Antwerp or the Western Scheldt tunnel near Terneuzen. The long, straight polder roads will then take you to the campsite.

The campsite, surrounded by dunes and polders, is neat and vast. It has a great number of pitches, situated on demarcated fields with each two to twelve pitches. They also have Comfort-XXL-pitches of 200 m2 located along the water, dog-free pitches and pitches on a special children's field with play ground equipment. Would you prefer a luxury holiday? You can rent chalets (with a spacious porch) as well as mobile homes.

Recreation for all

In high season anyone can participate in the entertainment programme with boat camps, 'crea-afternoons', playing tag and treasure hunts on the beach. In Cadzand, less than a 15-minute drive, there is a wide range of (water)sports facilities. You can go kayaking, horse riding and windsurfing here. In the vicinity of the campsite you will find play and information park Groede Podium, where you can go climbing / balancing and find out more about the region.

Sleeping on the beach

Wake up each day to glorious sea views? At Strandcamping Groede you can stay in a ‘panoramic cabin’, a cabin on the beach, a few metres from the sea. It may cost a bit extra, but you will have a truly unique holiday. Furthermore, the cabins are made of sustainable material and are environmentally friendly.

properties.name: Amaron Camping & Resort
properties.description:
Amaron Camping & Resort is just outside the friendly village of Elbrinxen, in the heart of Germany's Weserbergland. You’ll camp here in a hilly area with thickly-wooded areas and vast fields of rapeseed. Great destination for peace-seekers, walking and cycling enthusiasts. Facilities on the well-maintained campsite include a playground, large pitches, outdoor fitness and a snack bar. Next to the campsite, there is a public outdoor swimming pool that is free for campers to use.

Touring pitches & several accommodation units

This campsite has a relatively large number of annual pitches, but there’s plenty of space for touring campers too. The tourist section is nice and flat and well laid out. All pitches have water and electricity. Fancy a back-to-basics camping holiday and coming with just a tent? Then you can head to the special tent field. If you want more comfort, book a camping cabin, mobile home or chalet.

Free swimming in Freibad Elbrinxen

Feel like taking a refreshing dip during your camping holiday? Freibad Elbrinxen is just 100 m from the campsite. As a campsite guest, you can swim for free in this outdoor public pool. Swim some laps, zoom down the water slide or head to the adjacent paddling pool with the little ones. On the campsite itself, facilities include a fun playground and an outdoor fitness trail, where sports professionals offer support and even organise relaxing yoga sessions. In the high season, a party tent is sometimes set up for entertaining events. Many campers end the day here together, sitting around a cosy, crackling campfire.

properties.name: Blucamp Natural Village
properties.description:
Camping Blucamp is situated on top of a hill in the picturesque region of Tuscany. You are staying between olive, walnut and chestnut trees, at only 8 km from the sea. In the vicinity you will find the beaches of the Gulf of Baratti and beautiful, historical towns as Populonia, Massa Maritima and Volterra.

Tuscan hilly landscape

The grounds are hilly and offer different pitches with ample privacy on elongated terraces. There are large differences in elevation, on the highest pitches with a splendid view of the Tuscan hilly landscape, the pine forests, the sea in the distance and even of Elba and Corsica (in clear weather). The camping pitches further down offer more shade and space. If you want to rent something, you have a choice of eight bungalows.

Gulf of Baratti

The swimming pool is small and modest, looks nice and makes for lovely swimming fun during hot days. It is surrounded by sun loungers and the view of the green hills is magnificent. At a distance of 8 km you will find the beautiful pine tree beaches along the Gulf of Baratti. This is perhaps the most beautiful bay of Tuscany with clear water and a child-friendly sandy beach.

Playgrounds

The little ones can enjoy themselves on the attractive playgrounds. Teenagers can hit a ball at the table tennis table.

Pizza restaurant

You can enjoy a good meal in the restaurant with limited menu. It has a pleasant terrace. If you want a drink only, you can visit the convivial bar. You can get takeaway meals here, as well as daily fresh bread. Do you have a long shopping list? If so, there is a supermarket only 400 m away.

properties.name: Camping Malibu Beach
properties.description:
By the Adriatic Sea and less than an hour from Venice. The location of the Campsite Malibu Beach is amazing! Water enthusiasts, old and young, can go wild here. The campsite has a large outside pool (420 m²) with slide. For the little ones (small children), there is a paddling pool with sprinklers. The more athletic campers can leave the campsite and find themselves directly by the sea, where they can windsurf, sail, and kayak.

Welcome

Campsite Beach Malibu is a compact, family-friendly campsite where you will immediately feel at home. It starts already at the front desk. It is staffed by friendly and helpful personnel. During high season, they can help you in English, German, French, or Italian. They are there for you every day from 7:30 AM to 10:30 PM. The campsite is accessible almost the entire day, from 7:00 AM to 12 PM.

Cooling off in the shadow and in the water

The camping pitches are delimited and are either fully or partially in the shadow. That’s great in the summer! You can also cool off in the pool or by the sea. Malibu Beach has direct access to a large private beach with sanitary facilities. A new water park with slides and water games opened in 2016. Plenty of deckchairs and umbrellas are available for a fee. Safety first: beach guards and special staff hold everything well under control.

properties.name: Camping Badlerhof
properties.description:
If camping at a small-scale quiet campsite surrounded by the stunning countryside and mountains is your thing, Camping Badlerhof, located in the village of Laas in South Tyrol is for you. The well-maintained campsite has 40 camping pitches and wonderful wellness facilities. Go on the most beautiful walks or cycling trips in the area and enjoy a relaxing holiday in the countryside.

Relaxed camping

Camping Badlerhof makes a neat and tidy impression. The pitches are spacious, level and covered with grass. You can choose from various sizes and all camping pitches have electricity and water connections. If you want even more relaxation, go to the small wellness centre with swimming pool, Jacuzzi, sauna and Turkish steam bath.

Enjoy an apple strudel on the patio

If you are in the mood for something tasty, the campsite has a lovely bar with a beautiful patio. Order a lovely coffee with apple strudel while enjoying the sun on the patio. There is a bakery, a supermarket and restaurants within walking distance of the campsite. When the weather is less favourable, the lounge offers space for playing games or for reading a book.

Go out and about in the Vinschgau Valley

Nature lovers and active campers will definitely have a great time here! The area is ideal for going on lovely hikes and mountain bike trips. Swimming enthusiasts can go to the swimming pool in Laas (1.5 km), where camping guests have free admission. The outdoor swimming pool is only open in the high season.

There is a train station close to the campsite, from where you can easily explore the Vinschgau Valley by public transport. You can get a free public transport card at the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Zum See
properties.description:
If you are looking for a lovely campsite in a panoramic landscape, Camping Zum See in St. Valentin, in the Italian South Tyrol, is just what you are looking for. This campsite is situated by the three point border of Italy, Austria and Switzerland and offers a mix of relaxation and activities in the countryside. With the impressive Ortler mountain and the Königsspitze in the background, camping at Camping Zum See is an exceptional experience.

Generous camping pitches

The camping pitches are a combination of paving and grass, thereby offering a solid surface throughout the year. Every pitch, measuring 90m², offers both space and privacy thanks to the smart layout. With facilities such as a dry room for your ski gear, campers' needs are catered for in every season.

Everything within arm's reach

Camping Zum See stands out due to its facilities. The toilet and washing facilities are modern and clean and there is a large restaurant with a patio and extensive menu. There is no lack of sporting activities. The campsite is next to a mountain lift, which can also easily accommodate mountain bikes. Shops and bars/restaurants are within walking distance.

A stunning mountain landscape

The area surrounding the campsite is a paradise for nature lovers and sporty campers. There are vast hiking and mountain bike routes and the cable car beside the campsite is an entrance gate to the mountains. The area is also popular in winter, when the mountains form the setting for a range of winter sports. One of these areas is Haideralm Ski Resort, located at 2,700 metres.

properties.name: Camping Schartner Alm
properties.description:
Camping Schartner Alm is on the outskirts of a small South Tyrolean village. This family business is aimed at families who like comfort and style. A top restaurant, great toilet and washing facilities and a large indoor playground: young and old are pampered here to the full.

Open pitches

There are 40 camping pitches on an open site beside the swimming pool. The pitches are mainly spacious in the length. Young planting separates you from the neighbours. All pitches are on paved ground and look out over the massive high mountains. As well as the camping facilities, there are also six stylishly furnished lodges.

Swimming pool with a view

There is a small grass field around the natural swimming pool and comfortable loungers on a plateau beside the water. There is also a smaller children's pool. If you want to unwind, grab a spot in the aromatic herb bath or in the panorama sauna.

Quality restaurant

Besides the magnificent countryside surrounding you, the restaurant is also one of the campsite's highlights. Head chef Helmut turns every evening into a feast. A fresh pizza, the local 'kaminwurzen’ or other dish. It looks almost too good to eat. They have a fun concept for children where they can compile their own pizza.

properties.name: Camping Wieshof
properties.description:
In the beautiful Austrian Salzburgerland, an hour’s drive from Salzburg, is the Wieshof campsite. It is a good place for campers who are attracted by the beauty of nature. The hospitable owners, the pristine sanitary facilities, and the good camping equipment make for a comfortable base. You can do anything here – whether summer activities or various winter sports.

Beautiful view over the mountains

You arrive at a well-maintained property, where you have a beautiful view of the surrounding mountains and the town centre of Sankt Johann im Pongau. The campsite consists of several streets with undefined grassy pitches. You can choose between larger or smaller pitches. There are also some new chalets on the campsite, and you can rent apartments. The sanitary facilities deserve a special mention. It is modern (2019), beautiful, and very clean.

Nature and wellness

Wieshof is truly a campsite where you enjoy the environment and nature. In terms of facilities, the campsite is more than adequate. However, you shouldn’t expect extensive entertainment, swimming pools, and shows. For the children there are a few playgrounds and a recreation room. Otherwise, the facilities are mainly focused on providing a pleasant stay. You can warm up in one of the saunas or exercise in the gym.

Wintersport camping

With plenty of downhill and cross-country skiing opportunities nearby, the Wieshof campsite is a popular starting point for a winter sports holiday. There are several facilities for this: ski storage, drying room, and ski rental. You will also find a cosy restaurant on the campsite. Here you can buy fresh bread and a delicious breakfast.

properties.name: Parque de Cerdeira
properties.description:
Parque Nacional Peneda-Gerês is one of Portugal's most beautiful natural parks. Campsite Parque de Cerdeira near Terras de Bouro is an ideal base for walks in this diverse nature area. There’s plenty to do at this wooded campsite too. For example, a large outdoor pool, an excellent restaurant, a small supermarket, sports and play facilities and an exciting rope bridge circuit.

Wooded site with spacious pitches

This is a true forest campsite with plenty of shade. Do you like getting back to basics on holiday? Then pitch your tent on one of the tent pitches, each measuring 80 m2. Want even more space and some extra comfort? Then choose a 100-m2 XL Pitch with up to 16 amps of electricity. You can book a private bathroom with walk-in shower, washbasin and toilet here. Good to know: these private bathroom units are in the toilet block near the pool. You will also have a private bathroom if you book one of the fully-equipped bungalows or modern camping pods.

Complete the spectacular rope bridge circuit

This place is a paradise for sports and adventure lovers. There are all kinds of outdoor sports options in the area. The campsite has something very special: a spectacular rope bridge circuit with zip line; proper safety equipment is compulsory. You can also play a game of tennis or football or swim laps in the outdoor pool. End the day at Restaurant Cerdeira, the campsite restaurant that serves Portuguese specialities. The cod and lamb dishes and fresh vegetables from the campsite’s own vegetable garden are particularly popular.

properties.name: Camping Sanghen
properties.description:
Campsite Sanghen is in a perfect location. This family campsite is situated in one of the most beautiful bays of Lake Garda. From the swimming pools on the campsite you have a beautiful panoramic view of the famous lake. Set up your caravan, motorhome or tent between the olive trees and let the holiday begin!

Camping among the olive trees

On this campsite on the shore of Lake Garda there is a relaxing atmosphere with lots of fun. Moreover, the campsite pitches are located between the olive trees, so your spot is surrounded by greenery. The olive trees also provide shade and have a cooling effect when the Italian sun shines. A campsite pitch is approximately 60 m². Unfortunately, motorhomes and caravans which are longer than 6.5 metres are not allowed on the Sanghen campsite.

In addition to camping, you can also rent luxury accommodations here, such as an apartment. These apartments are also referred to as small villas and are suitable for a maximum of six people.

Water fun galore

Lake Garda is, of course, an endless source of water fun. Feel like a dive in the lake? Walk down the stairs to the beach and jump in the lake. It is also the perfect spot for water sports such as boating, windsurfing or snorkelling.

To top it all off, there are no less than three swimming pools on this campsite! All with a splendid view of the beautiful lake. Adjacent to the pools is a sunbathing lawn with a few loungers. Apart from swimming, children can also participate in the entertainment programme (June to September).

Feeling peckish?

If you don't feel like cooking yourself, enjoy a meal in the restaurant on campsite Sanghen. You can opt for a table on the roof terrace for instance, from where you have a panoramic view.

properties.name: Camping Bela krajina - river Kolpa
properties.description:
Do you love the outdoors and spending your free time doing adventurous outdoor activities? If so, campsite Bela krajina - River Kolpa near Podzemelj in southern Slovenia is the ideal holiday destination for you. This campsite has lots of sports facilities, including a unique slackline course. The local area is perfect for hiking, cycling and water sports. You camp here near the crystal-clear waters of the Kolpa River.

Authentic waterside campsite

The rectangular campsite is located alongside the river. So, wherever you are on the campsite, you will always hear the lovely, rippling sound of the flowing river water. When you arrive, you will choose your own sunny or shady spot. Modern mobile homes for 6 to 8 people are available too. Looking for romantic accommodation for two? Then choose a Celtic chalet made of natural materials. One of these chalets even has its own wellness corner with hot tub and sauna.

Brave the spectacular slackline course

The campsite has a lot to offer active holidaymakers and outdoor sports enthusiasts. The campsite has an outdoor sports zone where numerous sports are possible. Campers probably enjoy the exciting slackline circuit, also known as the adrenaline park, most. This is a unique rope course that runs between treetops in the campsite. The campsite also organises all kinds of fun activities in the high season. These include creative, musical and culinary workshops for children; wine tastings, dance classes and live music performances for adults.

properties.name: Camping Tenuta Squaneto
properties.description:
In Piedmont, in a wooded valley in the green hills, you will find Camping Tenuta Squaneto. This quiet, well-maintained family campsite has hospitable owners. Tenuta Squaneto is surrounded by a forest and a small river flows behind the campsite. The campsite is very secluded, so it is always nice and quiet on the campsite grounds.

Space and comfort

The well-organized campsite consists of spacious, flat pitches on beautiful fields. One of the camping fields is completely car-free, which is very nice when you are on holiday with young children. Because the campsite is only a few years old, the borders between the pitches consist for the most part of young plantings. An awning providing shade is recommended. If you would like natural shade, choose a spot at the edge of the forest. In addition to the 72 touring pitches, there are also 15 rental accommodations on the campsite: comfortable lodge tents with their own sanitary facilities.

Pizza from the wood oven

In the modern main building you will find not only the reception, but also the restaurant, the bar and a small shop. The Italian cook makes delicious dishes, and a few times a week there is pizza from the wood oven. The restaurant also has an excellent wine list. On the terrace you can sit under the lime trees, but the inside is also very nice.

Swimming in the lagoon

Right out in the sun is a beautiful outdoor pool, which is well maintained. You can take a refreshing dip or do relaxing laps in the twenty-five-meter pool. But actually the paddling pool is the most beautiful part. It is a real lagoon, separated from the large pool and equipped with a beautiful fountain and water play equipment.

properties.name: Aigüestortes Camping Resort
properties.description:
Aigüestortes Camping Resort is located in the middle of the Pyrenees, with a wonderful view of the mountains. The village of Esterri d’Aneu is located nearby. During the day, you can relax in the campsite pool, or go for a hike through the Aigüestortes National Park. You can then sit on the covered terrace of the campsite for a well-deserved drink.

Have you always wanted to camp in the mountains? Aigüestortes Camping Resort is surrounded by the Spanish Pyrenees. You’ll notice them when driving to the campsite. You reach it via mountain roads, which is a great way to already get a taste of the surroundings. The campsite is right next to the little town of Esterri d’Aneu, which is crossed by the river Noguera. The campsite underwent a complete renovation in 2016.

There are 154 pitches under the trees, so that there is always sufficient shadow. Log cabins with own verandas can also be rented. From the veranda, you have a beautiful view of the meadows, and, in the distance, the mountains.

Cool off in the pool or the river

There is plenty of water on the campsite and around it. Dive into the campsite pool, which also has a separate area for children. There is plenty of grass around the pool where you can put down your towel and lie in the sun. The campsite borders almost directly on the river Noguera Pallaresa, which flows into lake La Torrassa. There are plenty of opportunities for canoeing, kayaking, rafting, or canyoning.

properties.name: Camping Schwarzfelder Hof
properties.description:
Campsite Schwarzfelder Hof is in a wonderfully quiet spot, on a small recreational lake near Leipheim (Bavaria). The campsite is a park-like site with deciduous and coniferous trees. Its waterfront location offers plenty of opportunities for swimming and water sports. This is a farm campsite with many animals, a hay barn and an authentic farm shop. The campsite is close to Günzburg (8 km), where there are several popular theme parks, including Legoland.

Camping by the water

At Schwarzfelder Hof, you will camp in comfort on a large, level pitch separated from other pitches by neat hedges or trees. Many pitches are right on the lake shore. A special grassy area has also been created for tent campers. Want some extra comfort? Then book a cosy but modern sleeping barrel. Or book one of the luxury apartments; some have views of the water.

Swimming, tending animals and playing in the haystack

Fancy taking a dip in the recreational lake? All this is possible from the grassy/pebble beach at edge of campsite. Naturally, boating or paddleboarding across the lake is possible too. Or fishing; day passes are available at reception. On dry land, children can entertain themselves with the farm animals. The campsite's tame goats, donkeys, rabbits, ponies and chickens are happy to be petted and fed by the youngest campers. Children will also enjoy playing in the outdoor playground, the play barn and the hay paradise in the old calf barn. A food truck regularly stops at the campsite to sell fresh pizzas and salads.

properties.name: Ansitz Gamp
properties.description:
Whether for a stopover or for a holiday of several days, you are at the right address at Camping Gamp between Brixen and the South Tyrolean capital of Bozen. The campsite is within walking distance of the centre of Klausen. Here, you experience the charm of an artist's town, which many consider to be one of the most beautiful old towns in Italy. Furthermore, the campsite is an ideal starting point for walks and bike rides in the stunning area of the Eisack Valley.

Discover the hospitality of a family business

This family business, run by a friendly family for more than 60 years now, is all about hospitality. The small-scale campsite is favourably located close to a motorway but still surrounded by natural greenery. From families with children to mountain climbers, everyone feels at home here. The campsite also offers attractive apartments and chalets.

Relax

For relaxation and entertainment, the campsite has a sunny swimming pool and a playground. A small supermarket provides fresh bread and other daily necessities.

Camping in winter

Camping Gamp also offers a comfortable stay to its guests in the cold winter months. Every day, a free ski bus takes you to ski resorts and areas for winter hiking such as Plose, Gitschberg-Jochtal, Obereggen and Gröden. A visit to the traditional Christmas markets in Klausen and surrounding area is not to be missed during a winter holiday.

properties.name: Camping Moosbauer
properties.description:
Located close to the town of Bolzano, Camping Moosbauer offers an excellent starting point for families and adventurers looking for walking and cycling options. With stunning paths that wind through the mountains and past the vineyards and orchards of South Tyrol, there is something for everyone. And due to the short distance to the Autostrada, only four kilometres away, the campsite is easy to reach.

Wine, mountains and hours of sun

In this beautiful region, South Tyrol is known for its viticulture and fruit growing, surrounded by imposing mountains. Here, you enjoy the most sun hours in all of Italy while walking or cycling through the picturesque countryside. Bolzano, only five kilometres away, offers a bustling cultural centre full of historic charm, lively markets and culinary surprises. Discover all the highlights in South Tyrol and immerse yourself in the local culture.

Heart and eye for nature

Sustainability is a priority at Camping Moosbauer. As a climate neutral business, they aim to increase awareness of the importance of the environment and nature. So they regularly organise events to involve guests in their efforts.

Family fun and relaxation

For the little ones, Camping Moosbauer has a lovely playground located next to the restaurant. So you can relax with a glass of wine while still keeping an eye on things. Furthermore, Moosbauer organises the 'Children's Summer' in summer, when the little ones can do crafts and play five times a week. Older children and teenagers can get together at the table tennis tables.

properties.name: Schlosshof Luxury Camping Resort
properties.description:
Schlosshof Luxury Camping Resort is a campsite in Lana, South Tyrol. You can count on a luxury stay in Mediterranean style at this campsite near Merano. Campsite guests can use the amenities at the accompanying hotel. The campsite is perfectly accessible from the border with Austria via the Brenner Pass. Families, couples and solo travellers: everyone is warmly welcome to enjoy the Schlosshof feeling here.

Campsite with hotel amenities

This campsite and the accompanying hotel have been run passionately by the same family for three generations. The campsite offers pitches in all sizes, as well as apartments and studio apartments. As a campsite guest, you enjoy luxury hotel amenities. That could be a lovely aperitif on the patio, a delicious dinner in the restaurant or a relaxing massage. When it comes to comfort, you will want for nothing at Schlosshof Luxury Camping Resort.

Three swimming pools for relaxation

Relax in the outdoor swimming pool with paddling pool, waterfall and whirlpool, or enjoy the exclusive rooftop swimming pool 'Piscina Blu' with a stunning view (for a surcharge). On cooler days you can go for a swim in the heated indoor pool.

Explore Lana and the surrounding area

Enjoy the quiet setting amid orchards, at only a 10-minute walk from the bustling city centre of Lana. As a guest at Schlosshof Resort, you can use the public transport in South Tyrol for free, meaning nearby cities such as Merano (6 km) and Bolzano (20 km) are easy to reach. You can also explore the stunning world of the South Tyrolean Alps without a car or public transport. There are endless walking paths and numerous cycle paths in the immediate vicinity of the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Thöni
properties.description:
Camping Thöni is in the South Tyrolean St Valentin auf der Haide. This small-scale campsite is a paradise for active holidaymakers. Due to its location at an altitude of 1,470 metres between two lakes, it is the ideal location for mountain walks, cycling and mountain biking. If you like to go on a winter sports holiday with your motorhome or caravan, the campsite is open almost all year round and has a ski store.

Relax in the fresh air

The campsite has 30 spacious camping pitches with views of the Alps. Six special pitches are available for motorhomes. Almost all the pitches are in the sun, but the altitude and fresh air from the lakes ensures the temperature is always pleasant.

Close to the Austrian and Swiss border

The village of St Valentin auf der Haide (200 m distance), offers all the facilities you need. There is a tasty pizzeria, bakery and supermarket. Fire up a charcoal barbecue at the campsite, after which you can enjoy local products with views of the highest mountain in Tyrol. In less favourable weather, you can use the lounge, where you can play games and table tennis.

Cycling and walking in the Alps

There is plenty for everyone to do in this Alpine region. The campsite is on the cycle path towards Merano (68 km). There are no fewer than 250 kilometres of cycling and mountain biking routes available. If you prefer walking, you have 300 kilometres of paths at your feet. You can also go higher up: take the cable car (500 m away) and take a lovely fresh mountain walk.

properties.name: Camping Hermitage
properties.description:
Camping Hermitage offers breathtaking views of Merano, the surrounding mountains and forests. It is a modern and quiet campsite, within a short distance of the centre of Merano (5 km). If you don't want to walk, you can easily take the bus that runs every 20 minutes. The proximity of the Prinz Rudolf Smarthotel means campsite guests can also use the hotel's amenities.

Luxury campsite with stunning views

The camping pitches are equipped with water, electricity and Wi-Fi. There are also modern toilet and washing facilities, private toilet and washing facilities and a washing machine and dryer are available. You can also hire luxury chalets with a private sauna, free-standing bath, garden and patio with hanging design sofas. You have breathtaking views from the pitches as well as the lounge sofas at the chalets.

Swimming pool, wellness and local food

You can use the swimming pools on the hotel's roof, these pools are surrounded by a green meadow where children can play. Guests can use the wellness area including a sauna (from age 16) for a reasonable price. The restaurant and pizzeria serve delicious traditional South Tyrolean dishes and pizzas. There is a children's menu available for the little ones.

Adventure and culture around Merano

For adventurers, the nearby Meran 2000 cable car offers options for stunning walking and mountain bike trips in the mountain region. You can ski here in the winter and there are lovely mountain cabins with panoramic views. The botanical gardens at Trauttmansdorff Castle, Empress Sisi's summer residence, are only a few kilometres away.

properties.name: Camping Zögghof
properties.description:
Camping Zögghof is in a beautiful mountainous area in South Tyrol. This Italian terraced campsite is small scale but equipped with all modern conveniences. The St Leonhard in Passeier Sportarena is next door. It's ideal for a refreshing swim or to hit a ball.

Panoramic view over the valley

The campsite has almost 40 camping pitches and a number of bungalows and chalets. Camping Zögghof is a terraced campsite, meaning you have a lovely view of the surrounding area from your camping pitch. From the modern chalets (from 2020), you even have panoramic views of the Passeier Valley.

Enjoy the winter garden or the sunny patio

While on holiday, your day starts with tasty bread rolls or local specialties such as South Tyrolean bacon and eggs from reception. You can then visit the nearby Sportarena, where you will find a swimming pool, tennis court, climbing hall, bouldering course and restaurant. Campsite guests can use the swimming pool for free. At the campsite, you can use the gym, go to the bar with a winter garden and sunny patio, and there are two playgrounds for the children.

Free public transport

The campsite is open all year round and is equipped with a special ski room and dryer for ski boots. This also makes Camping Zögghof very appealing for winter sports enthusiasts. In the other seasons, you can fish for trout, play golf at the golf course in St Martin (4 km) or walk from mountain hut to mountain hut. With the Südtirol Guest Pass, that you get on arrival at the campsite, you can travel on public transport and take various cable cars for free and you get discounts on museum visits and other activities.

properties.name: Camping-Park Steiner Südtirol
properties.description:
Steiner Südtirol Campsite Park in a family-friendly campsite near Bozen in South Tirol, the northernmost province in Italy. Here, you can enjoy the mountainous countryside, the nearby lakes and the Italian-Tirolean cuisine (South Tirol is where the most delicious wine comes from). You can fully relax, but tough mountain hikes are also possible.

Steiner Südtirol Campsite Park is situated in a wide valley amongst the Tirolean Alps, surrounded by lush green Alpine meadows, slopes of vineyards, charming villages and mountain lakes. The campsite is to the north of the town of Leifers.

A typically Tirolean camping experience

You can spend the night on a spacious pitch with gravel which allows for any rainwater to drain quickly, so you don't end up on with a swamp underfoot. The landscaped grounds ensure plenty of shade and privacy. Do you want a genuine Tirolean camping experience? Stay in one of the wooden holiday homes.

For the outdoorsy types

Nature lovers and those seeking peace and quiet will be very happy at Steiner Südtirol Campsite Park. The campsite is a perfect starting point for mountain walks and bike rides. You won't find too many young people here; but the campsite is very family friendly, so feel free to bring your (little) children. The children can have fun in the outdoor pool or the heated indoor pool. If you really want to go swimming, you can go to one of the nearby mountain lakes: Lake Caldaro (right on the Tirolean wine route) or the Montiggler Seen. Here you can swim between the mountains! Kite and windsurfing, paddle boarding and sailing are also possible here.

properties.name: Camping Olympia
properties.description:
This family-friendly campsite is centrally located in the Italian Dolomites. This excellently maintained site has an outdoor swimming pool, children's entertainment, a restaurant, a bar and a small zoo.

Camping Olympia is in the Puster Valley. From here, you have breathtaking views of the surrounding mountains. The countryside is absolutely stunning here. This is therefore a perfect starting point for those who like walking, cycling, mountain biking and the countryside. In the winter, it takes no time at all to reach various large ski resorts in the area.

Plenty of choice of spacious pitches

You have a wide choice of spacious camping pitches at Camping Olympia. They are spread out over small, neat fields. The amount of shade can differ greatly. You can also stay in a luxury Alpine Lodge or hire a lovely apartment. The campsite has two large toilet blocks. The toilet and washing facilities are in excellent condition and are clean.

Enjoy yourself in the lovely swimming pool and at Mini Zoo Olympia

There is a large rectangular swimming pool with a lovely paddling pool alongside. It's a great place for cooling down on summer days. It's lovely swimming here even when the weather is not so hot as the water is heated to 28 degrees. Children can also have fun in the lovely playground and at the Mini Zoo Olympia animal pasture, just outside the campsite. Goats, rabbits and ponies, among others, wander about there.

Wide range of wellness options

Camping Olympia offers even more facilities that are good for the body and mind. There is a Finnish sauna, a Turkish steam bath, an infrared cabin and a facial solarium.

properties.name: Club del Sole Caldonazzo Family Collection
properties.description:
Camping Club del Sole Caldonazzo Family Collection is located close to Lake Caldonazzo, in the mountainous surroundings of Trentino. At this medium sized campsite you can camp in the shade of trees and with a view of the mountains. The atmosphere is friendly and quiet. For children there is an entertainment program, but they can also enjoy swimming in the pool or in the lake.

Medium sized, friendly campsite

With its almost 160 touring pitches, camping Club del Sole Caldonazzo Family Collection distinguishes itself from the larger Italian campsites located by a lake. This campsite is medium-sized and exudes conviviality. There are many trees on the campsite, which provide the pitches with shade. Between the trees you can catch glimpses of the mountains. In general it is very quiet on the campsite, but on some pitches you can experience ambient noise from a nearby pub. So take a good look at which pitch you want.

Swimming pool

At the front of the campsite, next to the reception, is the swimming pool. This spacious pool is a great place for a refreshing dip. Next to the pool, there is a paddling pool for small swimmers. The pools are supervised by a lifeguard. They not only watch over the safety of the children. They also make sure that the sun loungers around the pools are not left occupied but unattended for hours.

Lago di Caldonazzo

A walk of a few dozen metres is enough to reach Lake Caldonazzo. In summer, the lake's water is warm enough for a swim, but you can also take a boat out onto the lake. The forest and green mountains that surround the water make the lake a pretty picture.

properties.name: Club del Sole Val di Fiemme Easy Camping Village
properties.description:
Camping Fiemme Village is a beautiful terraced campsite on a partly sloping terrain close to the mountain village of Bellamonte in Trentino (Dolomites). This campsite is a fantastic base for keen walkers and mountain bikers. In winter this is an ideal place for winter sports enthusiasts, because you are in the popular ski area Alpe Lusia. The campsite has a small swimming pool, a wellness centre and a good restaurant.

There are pitches of various sizes, so there is a suitable pitch for every type of camping equipment. There are also a number of accommodations for rent.

Swimming fun

The heated swimming pool of this campsite is not exaggeratedly large, but still a nice place for a cooling dip. Especially for children there is a small slide. On the sunbeds (with parasols) around the pool, it is pleasant to stay.

Animation for everyone

In high season there is an entertainment team that provides entertainment with a varied entertainment program. Dance activities and creative games are organised for children. A clown with his hilarious performances also provides the necessary entertainment. Adults can take part in special dance evenings. Or taste the culinary delights offered during theme evenings.

Eating out at Ristorante Bear Stube

There is a restaurant on the campsite: Ristorante Bear Stube. This is a cosy and inviting place to go out for dinner. Here you can enjoy regional meals as well as classics such as pizzas. They work as much as possible with fresh products from the region.

properties.name: Club del Sole Due Laghi Levico Family Collection
properties.description:
Club del Sole Due Laghi Levico Family Collection is located near the town of Levico Therme in green Valsugana, a popular hiking and cycling area. The campsite gets its name from the two lakes nearby (Lake Levico and Lake Caldonazzo). In addition to a swimming pool, the campsite has a private beach on Lake Levico. On the campsite you will find two restaurants and a small camp shop.

Two lakes campsite

Due Laghi Levico Family Collection is located in the northern Italian region of Trentino near Levico Terme. The campsite is very shady due to the many large trees, but also a bit darker. The campsites are not very large. Mobile homes and tents are also rented.

A dip in the lake or in the swimming pool

A footpath leads from the campsite to the private beach on Lake Levico. If you find the water too cold, you can always take a dip in the swimming pool on the campsite itself. The campsite is not especially focused on families with children, but in the high season there are activities for children organized (such as a children's disco). There are also two playgrounds for children from 0-6 years and from 6-12 years. There is also a beach volleyball field, football pitch and tennis court.

Food and drink

The campsite has two restaurants. Caffè Due Laghi offers snacks and pizza as well as regional dishes from Trentino. Restaurant Bandus specializes in meat and fish from the grill, but also serves traditional Neapolitan pizzas. There is an ice cream parlour only a few dozen metres from the campsite. The campsite shop is a little small, but there is a large supermarket opposite the entrance to the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Vilanova Park
properties.description:
Camping Vilanova Park is located in Vilanova i la Geltrú, one of the many charming coastal resorts in Catalonia. With three swimming pools, a rich entertainment programme and various catering establishments, playgrounds and athletic fields, this large holiday park has everything needed for a successful family holiday. Vilanova Park is also a good departure point for an excursion to Barcelona, which is a good forty kilometres away.

Large holiday village with numerous accommodation options

Camping Vilanova Park has several luxury accommodations that can be booked. Glamping lovers are certainly in the right place here. Of course, you can just go camping in this holiday village as well. At Camping Vilanova Park you choose a sunny or shady pitch.

A selection of the ample leisure time offers

There is a large supermarket, a souvenir shop and a charming restaurant at the front of the site. Next to it is the first swimming pool of Camping Vilanova Park. The other large outdoor swimming pool is located in the centre of the holiday park. The main swimming pool has spectacular water slides. On days when the weather is not so nice, you can swim in the indoor swimming pool, which is also located in the centre of the campsite.

An ideal home base for visits to Sitges and Barcelona

If you like attractive coastal resorts, Vilanova Park is an excellent holiday address. Here you camp fifteen minutes away from Sitges, while attractive coastal resorts such as Segur de Calafell and Salou are also within easy reach. You can also take the train from Vilanova to the biggest attraction in this region: Barcelona. In addition, buses leave from Vilanova, going directly to the capital city of Catalan.

properties.name: Camping Ionion Beach
properties.description:
Camping Ionion Beach, on the west coast of the Greek Peloponnese, amid an agricultural area, welcomes you with the promise of peace by the sea. This modern campsite, easily accessible via asphalted back roads, offers a luxury camping experience near the village of Glyfa (1.5 km). Towns such as Vartholomio (9 km) and Gastouni (14,7) are also within driving distance. And if you want to cool down, you can walk straight to the beach (Glyfa Beach) from the campsite or go for a refreshing swim in the swimming pool.

Campsite with views of Zakynthos

Camping Ionion Beach is, as the name suggests, by the Ionian Sea. From the campsite, you look out over the clear blue sea and you can see the popular holiday island of Zakynthos in the distance.

The camping pitches at Ionion Beach are spacious and neatly demarcated with trees and bushes, providing shade for most of the day. If you don't have your own camping equipment, choose a bungalow (maximum of four people) or a luxury apartment. Please note: the apartments are in Arkoudi, a fishing village at about 10 minutes' drive from the campsite.

With a drink under a wicker parasol

The beautiful swimming pool with lawn offers refreshment on hot days. It is wonderfully relaxing here on a sun lounger under a wicker parasol. After swimming, enjoy a nice drink at the poolside bar. You don't have to leave the campsite for a tasty Greek meal. The restaurant serves an extensive menu with traditional Greek dishes. You can go to the nearby campsite shop for daily groceries.

properties.name: Camping Oliva
properties.description:
Oliva Camp & Residence is located on a beautiful bay on an inlet of the Adriatic Sea. The campsite is only five hundred metres from the former fishing village of Rabac. This village has a lively promenade and can be reached via a lovely path along the water. You'll find lovely old villages and islands in the area. You'll also have optimal enjoyment of the magnificent rugged nature.

Camping in an olive grove

The property is nicely maintained and looks atmospheric through the numerous lovely olive trees. The pitches are reasonably large. There is little privacy and you have some shade. Want to hire something? In that case, you can hire a mobile home or stay in one of the three hotels next to the campsite.

Elegant swimming pool

The swimming pool with lovely round shapes belongs to the hotel, but camping guests can use it for free. There is an enormous sunbathing lawn next to it. There is a separate wading pool for toddlers. There are plenty of loungers around the swimming pool. Don't forget to enjoy the view of the mountainous hinterland.

Sea and beach activities

Rather jump into the sea? In that case, you don't have far to walk. Along the beautiful bay there is an extensive pebble beach (take water shoes with you). The sea is perfect for snorkelling. Boat hire, diving, waterskiing and windsurfing are possible activities here.

Entertainment for all

There's plenty for the kids to do: from the mini club at the hotel to the ball pit. There is also the playground, trampolines and tennis court. Also fun: challenge each other to a round of mini golf or football.

properties.name: Camping Biarritz
properties.description:
The Biarritz campsite is located in the southwest of France, in the French Basque region. The campsite borders the spa town of the same name, known as an outstanding surfing location. This makes the campsite popular with families and young people. Biarritz campsite has its own shop, bar-restaurant and snack bar. For cooling off, take a dip in the pool, and then relax on the loungers in the sun or in the hammam.

Spacious pitches and many rental accommodations.

The campsite houses primarily families and young people. The pitches for these groups are separate from each other, but they are all spaciously laid out. Many trees provide shade. In addition, Biarritz campsite has a broad offering of rental accommodations. For example, choose from one of the caravans or rent a large bungalow tent for four to six people.

Facilities

You'll find the other facilities at the front of the campsite. In addition to the reception, there is a camping shop with a broad selection and a bar-restaurant. This is open daily for lunch or dinner (from 7:00 pm). The snack bar is open every day. The campsite also has a playground for the kids, a table tennis table and a jeu-de-boules pitch. Golf lovers can bring their clubs. There are a few lovely courses in the direct vicinity of the campsite.

Water sports

The environment around Biarritz is known around the world as an outstanding surfing location. So no surprise that many water sports enthusiasts like to spend their time here. But the beach - only a few hundred metres from the campsite - is also suitable for sunbathing and a dip in the water.

properties.name: Camping Eden
properties.description:
Camping Eden, a small-scale campsite, is situated in the Lagoni di Mercurago nature park. It is a fantastic location to enjoy a camping holiday by the water. Camping Eden is situated directly at the Lago Maggiore. This campsite has a personal and relaxed atmosphere, perfect for young families and seniors. The spacious camping pitches offer a splendid view over the water.

Camping pitches by the water

From the reception area, you first pass the permanent pitches before you get to the end of the camping with tourist pitches at the lake. The camping pitches are not demarcated and vary in size from 40 to 80 m2. The surface is grass, which is well-maintained.

Small campsite with many facilities

Camping Eden is the perfect place to indulge in water sports. How about water skiing, windsurfing, canoeing or just swimming? Leisurely sunbathing or paddling is possible on the private sandy beach with jetty. You can also cool off in the small swimming pool next to the reception. You can visit the restaurant with terrace for a nice breakfast, lunch or dinner. This offers a view of the small swimming pool with a slide for the little ones as well as a play ground.

Lively environment

The region is known for the diversity of breathtaking landscapes and a richness of art, history and culture. At a distance of 2 km from Camping Eden you will find Arona, a bustling little town on the lake. Here you can go shopping, relax at a side walk cafe on the boulevard or join the night life.

properties.name: Camping La Vallée de Deauville
properties.description:
Camping La Vallée de Deauville is the ideal campsite for all types of campers. Whether you enjoy relaxing by the pool, spending an afternoon on the beach or immersing yourself in the region's rich culture, it's all possible at and around this campsite. There are many different activities for the kids too: a full animation programme (in the high season) and football pitches and pools for them to swim in and have a kick-about on with friends.

Typical Norman accommodation

Camping La Vallée de Deauville has everything. You can book a large pitch for your own tent, caravan or camper. Or for those who prefer more luxury, there is a large choice of mobile homes, small but comfortable 'tithomes' and chalets built in traditional Norman style. These houses are spacious enough for 6 people and equipped with a dishwasher, fridge, barbecue and three bathrooms. Guests at these may use the campsite swimming pool.

Waterpark

The occasional dip in refreshing water is part and parcel of a warm holiday in the French sun. This is one of the many things that has not been forgotten at Camping La Vallée de Deauville. The large waterpark is suitable for young and old alike. With waterfalls, water slides and fun water activities, an afternoon relaxing at the pool is soon filled. The pool is also beautifully lit in the evenings.

For a change, a day at the beach is a great option – if only to see the charming old houses of Deauville you pass on the way there.

properties.name: Tamarit Beach Resort
properties.description:
Tamarit Beach Resort lies near the Catalan town of the same name on the Costa Dorada. There is lots to do for sporty holidaymakers, from stand-up paddle boarding and diving to Tai-Chi and water aerobics in the sea. The fitness room at Tamarit Beach Resort has recently been renovated for even more comfort. Children will enjoy themselves splendidly with the entertainment team, which organises shows and theme days such as a Superhero Day. Also very special: dining on the roof terrace of restaurant Brisa with a view of Tamarit castle. Recently, twenty luxury mobile homes have been added to the offer of accommodations. These are located in a green setting of trees, hedges, shrubs and flowers. They have a fun and modern interior.

The campsite is situated north of the city of Tarragona, directly on a sandy and pebble beach. It is a quiet area in green surroundings. The campsite has 24-hour security.

Own fridge or private sanitary facilities

At Tamarit Beach Resort you can book bungalows, cottages, lodge tents and camping pitches. The pathways and camping pitches are flanked by palm trees and are demarcated with hedges. Do you want a pitch with a sea view? You can rent premium pitches, which are located directly on the beach. On the second row from the beach are pitches with private sanitary facilities. When you have a pitch but like to keep your foodstuffs and drinks cool, you can rent a fridge.

New kids zone

Tamarit Beach Resort is a campsite for the entire family, but children take central place here. The campsite is frequented by many families with young children. They especially enjoy the renovated kids zone, more fun and safe. The weekends may get quite busy, because Spanish guests with permanent pitches will then flock to the campsite.

Learn about nature

Would you like to learn more about nature? Then visit Hort de la Sinia, which is situated adjacent to Tamarit Beach Resort. Here children will discover everything about plants and farm animals.

properties.name: Ljubljana Resort (hotel & camping)
properties.description:
Camping Ljubljana Resort is a medium sized transit campsite surrounded by greenery in a natural environment. The campsite is situated on a large complex with an accompanying hotel. The centre of the beautiful city of Ljubljana, which was chosen as the green capital of Europe in 2016, is just six kilometres away.

On the outskirts of town

From the motorway, the road leads you along a number of meadows to the outskirts of Ljubljana, where you will find this urban campsite. Some signs still indicate the campsite with the old name 'Jezica'. The friendly reception is located at the bar and restaurant. The bus to Ljubljana stops in front of the campsite entrance.

Avenues and fields

At Ljubljana Resort the delimited places are not too big, but neatly groomed. Some places have a subsoil of grass, others a subsoil of sand. The terrain is divided over several avenues and fields. A paved area has been reserved especially for motorhomes. You can also spend the night in a mobile home under the trees or in one of the hotel rooms.

Heated swimming pool

The beautiful swimming pool is right next to the campsite. After a day in town, this is a nice place to cool off. Its use is for a fee. Ask at reception when the swimming pool is open. There is a sunbathing area by the pool where you will find comfortable chairs and parasols.

Snacks and drinks

If you like to have a bite to eat at the campsite, you can join us in the restaurant next to the reception. There is a nicely decorated terrace and the menu also includes local dishes.

properties.name: Camping Taimì
properties.description:
Camping Taimì, near the well-known sights of Tuscany, is just 500 metres away from the beach. The campsite features a swimming pool, spacious pitches and a fine restaurant. Dogs are also welcome on Camping Taimì.

The camping pitches on Camping Taimì are spacious and unmarked. The pitches have plenty of shade from the tall trees, electricity, and water facilities and drainage upon request.
