You can park the car next to the pitch. The camping offers spacious mobile homes for rent with a veranda so that you can enjoy the Italian sunshine. The accommodations are very luxuriously furnished and have air conditioning.

Take the dogs on holiday with you

You are allowed to bring your cat or dog with you to Camping Taimì. There is a special shower for the animals and there is a large dog park just across from the campsite. You will find a special beach for dogs, Bau Beach, just 700 metres away.

Swimming, reading and soccer

To cool off, you can visit the swimming pool or the beach, which is just 500 metres from Camping Taimì. The swimming pool is surrounded by wood flooring instead of tiles, making it blend in nicely with the surroundings. From the swimming pool, you can be at the bar and the restaurant in no time. Take a book from the small library and enjoy a drink and a good read at the poolside. Or read a book in the specially created shaded lounge area with hammocks and comfortable chairs.

properties.name: Mols Bjerge Camping
properties.description:
This is a simply equipped, but attractive and well-maintained terraced campsite in the municipality of Ebeltoft, Central Jutland. You are staying on a real family campsite with many facilities. The campsite is situated amidst nature of the Djursland region on the northern perimeter of the overwhelmingly beautiful National Park Mols Bjerge. Whilst walking or cycling on the gentle slopes in spring and summer, you will come across an explosion of colours.

The pitches

The campsite has a grass surface. Most of the pathways to your pitch are hardened with gravel. Spacious pitches alternate with less spacious pitches. There is also a large selection of rental accommodations: tents, mobile homes, cabins/chalets and rooms. The communal sanitary facilities are neat and tidy.

Lovely swimming pool and more

The large heated swimming pool (standing height) with water slide and playground equipment is a veritable source of enjoyment for children. Adjacent to the pool is a tiled terrace with sun umbrellas, loungers and picnic tables. Furthermore, there is a playground and a sports field on the grounds. Games are organised during the summer holidays and you can enjoy yourself with table tennis, pétanque, soccer, minigolf and moon cars (a type of go-kart). Activities are organised for the little ones and arts and crafts are also offered. In inclement weather, you can sit around a huge barbecue with lots of other guests.

Regional specialities of the Chef

The restaurant is rather basic in design, with a small menu and a daily changing set menu. Real bonus points: the cosy terrace and the Chef's regional specialities. There is also a good snack bar. The camping shop is large and has a wide selection.

properties.name: Camping Klein Strand
properties.description:
Camping Klein Strand is situated near Jabbeke, in the Belgian province of West-Flanders. The campground consists of two parts. There is a small area around the lake with the beach, from which Klein Strand derives its name. They have mostly permanent pitches. There is also a second section, which is located on the other side of the Varsenareweg. This section is also used for short-term camping. These pitches are also close to the beach. Both sections of the campsite have a self-check-in machine, so you can enter the campsite without intervention of the reception.

The reception is located on the side of the lake, just like the restaurant. At the entrance on the other side of the road, you’ll find a toddler pool (Pirate pool) with several slides and climbing equipment customised for toddlers.

Spacious pitches and different types of accommodation

The campsite is well maintained and has spacious and somewhat less spacious pitches. There are basic pitches, although there is no space for your car. You can park your car in the large parking area near the entrance. There are also comfort pitches and paved pitches.On the campsite you can rent holiday chalets for max. 6 persons. You can also rent luxury tents (glamping) for up to 4 persons.

Endless water fun

Fun for all in the large lake: swimming, the water slides or swimming in the secured section. You can even take waterski lessons on the lake and in summer there are waterski shows. In the small lake you can fish for bream, carp and eel.

properties.name: Camping Bellsol
properties.description:
Camping Bellsol is located on the Costa Brava, close to Barcelona. Come to this Spanish campsite for a wonderful beach holiday. The Mediterranean Sea is waiting for you on the other side of the road. Cross the road and you are on the soft sand. By the way, there is also a swimming pool on the pleasant campsite itself. Would you like to go out for the day? The train takes you to beautiful Barcelona within an hour and a half.

Attractive pitches or mobile homes

The pitches at camping Bellsol are not particularly large. The low trees give the campsite an intimate feel. And the shade protects you from the hot Spanish sun. For a luxurious holiday at the beach, book one of the modern rooms. Or stay in one of the mobile homes.

A cool dive in the pool and sea

The tall palm trees in the middle of the campsite reveal the location of the swimming pool. It is situated exactly between them. Put on your swimwear and run to the pool for a cool dive. Of course you can also walk a little further. Just cross the road and you are already on the beach. There is always a place to lay down your towel.

Trendy restaurant by the pool

All that swimming and sunbathing makes you hungry! Fortunately, there is a restaurant by the pool. In this trendy restaurant you can get a cool drink. But there is always a free table for you to enjoy a tasty pizza or snack. In the meantime, the children can entertain themselves in the playhouse.

properties.name: Skiveren Camping
properties.description:
If you fancy a holiday in the middle of the dunes of North Jutland, Camping Skiveren is the place for you! The expansive campsite is located in a beautiful nature reserve overlooking the North Sea. It has everything holidaymakers need to relax and unwind while their kids can play to their heart's content. It'll be hard to choose between splashing in the campsite pool or playing on the beach, less than 250 metres away. You don't have to go far to reach the nearest town either. Skiveren is just two minutes away by car.

Camping or renting

You'll be camping on a beautiful and well-maintained lawns and can choose from spacious camping pitches in the shade or in the sun. Sizes vary from 60 to 140 m². Do you not have your own tent, caravan or motorhome, but would still like to spend your holiday in this special place? Then you can do so in one of the rental accommodations. Camping Skiveren rents out hikers' cabins, mobile homes and bungalows.

Stroll to the beautiful beach

After a nice breakfast, perhaps including a smørrebrød (traditional Danish open-faced sandwich), you can walk straight to the heated swimming pool. There is a separate, shallow part of the pool where small children can stand and play undisturbed. In the high season you'll find many families with children here.

Relax in the wellness centre

For even more relaxation, you can take advantage of the campsite's attractive wellness centre. A spa, sauna and steam bath are all at your disposal there.

properties.name: Camping Park Garda
properties.description:
The Camping Park Garda is a terraced campsite on the shores of Lake Garda. Its pitches, located on the sloping grounds, offer panoramic views of the water and mountains. Of course, the most beautiful pitches are located right on Lake Garda. Also, you can look out over the water from the beautiful pool and terrace. Take a dip in Lake Garda, tan on the pebble beach near the campsite or visit Limone sul Garda, famous for its lemons.

Camping at Lake Garda

A fairly steep and winding but paved road brings you to the campsite. Not all of the two hundred pitches on the terraces of this campsite are equally spacious, although they are large enough by Italian standards. You have a view of Lake Garda from the pitches, or you can often catch a glimpse of the sparkling water and the imposing mountains. The camping area extends to the shore, where perhaps you'll find the most beautiful pitches at Camping Park Garda.

Restaurant and pool with views

There's not much for children to do at the campsite, so Camping Park Garda is not really for families. However, if you're one of those bon vivant campers, you'll enjoy this campsite. Enjoy a tasty pizza on the restaurant's terrace overlooking the lake. Also, be sure to dive into the beautiful pool. Not only is it lovely to swim here, but the sunbeds are also often in use.

Versatile Lake Garda

A refreshing morning swim, an afternoon on the pebble beach next to the campsite or windsurfing in the middle of the lake: in and on Lake Garda, you can do it all.

properties.name: Camping Toscolano
properties.description:
On the western shore of Lake Garda, near the coastal town of Toscolano-Maderno, is Toscolano campsite. At this large, somewhat outdated campsite, you'll camp within the old monastery walls on a property lined with cypress trees. Overlooking the mountains and in direct connection with Lake Garda, this campsite is ideal for those seeking peace and quiet. Take a dip in one of the pools or visit the paper mills in the Valle delle Cartiere.

Camping in the shade

Upon arrival, you are greeted by a large old monastery gate: the entrance to the campsite. On the other side of the gate lies a world of peace. On a flowery square you will find the reception, behind it are the camping pitches. There are also plenty of rental properties. You’ll also be sharing the campsite with a number of permanent residents. The touring pitches are not particularly large, but are nicely situated in the shade of cypress and olive trees.

Lovely swimming pool

The campsite has set aside plenty of space for the swimming pool. It’s situated in the middle of the grounds, surrounded by sun loungers. Children can also enjoy a swim in the paddling pool.

Facilities

Camping Toscolano is a particularly great destination for touring campers with a caravan or camper. The campsite has a lovely beach bar, sun loungers available for guests and a campsite shop.

properties.name: Camping Fontanelle s.r.l.
properties.description:
Fontanelle Campsite is situated on the western shore of Lake Garda in Italy's Lombardy region. Mobile homes in particular fill the terraces at this campsite, but there is also plenty of choice of touring pitches. The nicest pitches are found on the lowest part of the campsite, close to Lake Garda. The view of the lake and mountains is beautiful from several areas of the terraced campsite.

Terrace campsite with mobile homes

As you drive into the campsite, it quickly becomes apparent that you are staying at a terraced campsite. To the left of the entrance are a few more terraces with mobile homes. On the other side the terrain slopes down to the shores of Lake Garda.

Swimming in Lake Garda

Fontanelle Campsite is a campsite for pure relaxation: sunbathing besides the lake or taking a dip in the campsite pool, which is centrally located on the property. You can also take a swim in Lake Garda. A small pebble beach located at the campsite leads straight into the water.

Waterfront restaurant

The restaurant and camp store are situated on one of the lower terraces near the water. Neither is particularly large but they look great. From the restaurant's terrace you can look out over Lake Garda, while sampling various dishes made with local produce. The store is well stocked and you can certainly find the ingredients for a simple meal there.

properties.name: Badiaccia Camping Village
properties.description:
This campsite is situated directly on the shore of Lake Trasimeno, north of Castiglione del Lago. The view from the campsite over the lake is truly beautiful. The numerous facilities, such as a private beach, sports fields, a pizzeria and a bar, guarantee a wonderful holiday at Badiaccia Camping Village, not to mention the wide beach and sunbathing lawn.

Large number of accommodation units

The camping pitches vary in size, are often shaded and are demarcated. The sanitary facilities are well maintained and neat. In addition, there are several types of accommodation units such as mobile homes (varying degrees of luxury) and chalets.

Cycling around the lake

The campsite offers the sporty camper a range of possibilities: tennis, volleyball, soccer, basket ball, pétanque and table tennis. There are cycle and walking trails alongside the lake. Adults can also participate in sport activities, such as aqua gym, aerobics, soccer and volleyball tournaments and archery.

Younger camping guests are, of course, also taken into consideration; they can join the mini club and take part in sport tournaments and games. In the evenings the entertainment programme ranges from a masked ball to cabaret and disco evenings.

Swimming in the swimming pool or the lake

Camping Badiaccia has two outdoor swimming pools. The largest swimming pool is surrounded by a large lawn. The smaller children's swimming pool is situated near the beach and the lake. At both swimming pools you can make free use of the showers, sun umbrellas and loungers. Obviously, the lake also offers options for various water sports, such as windsurfing and sailing. Kayaks and pedal boats can be rented from the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Trasimeno
properties.description:
You will find Camping Trasimeno by the lake of the same name, the fourth largest lake in Italy. From one of the more than sixty pitches you can stand with your feet in the water in no time. You camp here on the edge of Umbria. The campsite is therefore a good base for both Umbria and Tuscany. Trasimeno campsite has only been open for a few years, but the owners have years of experience in the camping sector.

Camping

Campers place their tent, camper or caravan on one of the pitches. These are large and have a water tap, waste water drainage and electricity connection. Don't have your own camping equipment? Then rent a mobile home or one of the nine lodge tents. These comfortable tents were installed in 2018 and are very complete. In the accommodations you can sometimes hear some noise from the road.

A refreshing dive

On Lake Trasimeno you can fish, windsurf and water ski. You can even bring your own boat. There is also a beach at the campsite for sunbathing. The sun loungers are provided by the campsite. The lake is not suitable for swimming in all places. If you want to be sure of a swim, there are two swimming pools and a whirlpool at the campsite.

On an excursion!

There is entertainment for children and teenagers in high season at this lovely campsite. There is a separate excursion programme for parents. If you stay at the campsite, you can play table tennis or do sports on the multi-sports field. Are you hungry? The campsite has a mini-market with enough sweets for your cravings.

properties.name: Camping Kursaal
properties.description:
At Lake Trasimeno, in picturesque Umbria, you will find Camping Kursaal. This campsite is part of a hotel. If you are camping at Kursaal, you can enjoy all the hotel facilities. Jump in the pool and have a three-course dinner in the restaurant. There is plenty to see in the surrounding area. The beautiful cities of Perugia and Assisi are close by.

Sheltered pitches near the water

Between the tall trees of the shady campsite there are about sixty camping pitches. Here you will camp nicely sheltered with plenty of space around you. Lake Trasimeno is always nearby. Some pitches are even located directly at the water's edge. From your camping chair you have a beautiful view over the lake.

Swimming with a lake view

You can also see the lake from the swimming pool. Especially if you lie down on one of the loungers. They are located on a sunbathing platform and on the private beach at the lake. And the view is also beautiful from the jacuzzi located higher up. If you just want to swim, the deeper pool is the ideal place. For the children there is a separate shallow pool with slide. Sliding and swimming all day long! In low season, the pools are heated.

Hotel-restaurant

If you are camping at Kursaal campsite, don't forget to pay a visit to the hotel restaurant. The locals also come here regularly for a bite to eat. That usually means that the food is of good quality. Find a table on the patio terrace overlooking Lake Trasimeno. In the meantime, enjoy a delicious pizza or a good pasta.

Every morning, you can buy your fresh breakfast items in the breakfast corner near the bar.

properties.name: Vakantiepark De Duinpan
properties.description:
Campsite De Duinpan is located at the foot of the dunes and between stunning flower bulb fields. You camp here on a spacious pitch or in a luxury chalet. With the beach and dunes just around the corner, there is enough to do to keep yourself amused during your holiday. You can join a forest ranger for a walk through the nature park or cool off in the North Sea on a warm day.

Pitch or chalet?

De Duinpan grounds are divided into two sections: a section for touring caravans, tents, trailer tents and motorhomes and a section with luxury chalets.

The 2-person chalets are located on the edge of the dunes, have a country-style decor and are equipped with HD television, oven and dishwasher. A garden and lounge set are also standard and when you want to escape the heat, the sun umbrella provides ample shade.

Entertainment

The campsite does not have a swimming pool, but you don't have to go far to cool off; the North Sea is just around the corner. Via a quiet walking or cycle path, you will reach the Noordwijk beach within ten minutes for a spot of sunbathing, surfing, kite flying or walking. The beach is no less than thirteen km long.

Fresh rolls

Each morning, Camping De Duinpan provides a service of freshly made rolls. The rolls must be ordered a day in advance and when you pick them up from the reception, you can grab a newspaper at the same time.

Sanitary facilities

There are heated, centrally located sanitary facilities. They are always within easy reach. The sanitary facilities are modern and showers are free of charge. You will also find a laundry there.

properties.name: Camping Sabbiadoro
properties.description:
Camping Sabbiadoro is a large campsite located on the north coast of Italy, directly on the Adriatic Sea. Here you can completely relax on the private beach, located a hundred meters from the campsite. With its good facilities, extensive campsite shop and beautiful swimming complex, Camping Sabbiadoro is a complete family campsite.

Camping Sabbiadoro is located in the north of Italy on the Adriatic coast, about a hundred kilometres northeast of Venice. With more than 2,000 pitches, camping Sabbiadoro is a really big campsite. The campsite is well maintained and wooded.

Complete family campsite

Are you a lover of sun, sea and beach? Then camping Sabbiadoro is a very suitable holiday destination. Its good facilities and location on the sunny Adriatic coast make this a very popular campsite. Dogs are also more than welcome at camping Sabbiadoro.

Swimming pool with paddling pool

Immediately at the entrance are the large swimming pools of the campsite. Next to the large competition pool is a spacious paddling pool. There are plenty of sun loungers around. On the side of the complex is a meadow where you can spread your towel.

Facilities on the campsite

On the campsite you will find a restaurant, beach bar, ice-cream parlour and a supermarket. There are four large toilet blocks scattered throughout the campsite, with - in addition to the standard facilities - sanitary facilities for the disabled, children and baby rooms.

Private beach on the Adriatic Sea

For ultimate relaxation you walk within a hundred meters from the campsite to the private beach. At the beach bar you can get a nice drink.

properties.name: Camping Eichenwald
properties.description:
Camping Eichenwald is located between the Tyrolean mountains in Stams, Austria. The terraces of this campsite have lovely lawns. You'll be camping here with a view of the high Alpine peaks. Immerse yourself in Austrian culture and join in the dance evenings. An Austrian beer in the Biergarten makes it extra special. Jump in the pool with your children or visit the Stuibenwaterfall.

Wake up with an Alpine view

Every morning you wake up with a view of the Alps. From most of the pitches at Eichenwald campsite you'll have a wonderful panoramic view. Behind the reception is a green campsite with landscaped lawns and plenty of trees. That's where you'll find your camping pitch, in the shade and surrounded by nature.

Swimming pool between the mountain peaks

Of course a swimming pool is a must for the children. Fortunately Eichenwald campsite has one, right behind reception. The pool isn't big, but luckily it's never really busy. Settle down on a lounger while the little ones enjoy themselves in the water. Close your eyes and enjoy the silence. Or just keep them open to admire the snow-capped mountain peaks in the distance.

Austrian dance evenings

Want to immerse yourself in Austrian culture? Then visit a dance evening in high season. The campsite owners will proudly show you traditional Austrian dances. And you can dance along too. Do you prefer to stay put? Order a delicious beer in the Biergarten and enjoy the music. Or come to the restaurant at a quieter time for an Austrian dinner.

properties.name: Salema Eco Camp - Regenerative Camping & Glamping
properties.description:
In the beautiful Portuguese Algarve is Camping Salema Eco-camp Surf & Nature. This eco-friendly resort combines the charm of the location as a surfing paradise and camping in the beautiful countryside of southern Portugal. It is close to the beach and the lively town of Salema (1.5 km), known as the hotspot for surfing lessons. You can also visit the lovely towns of Sagres (16 km) and Lagos (17.5 km).

Pitches and (luxury) accommodation

Will you be arriving with your own camping equipment? At the campsite you will find a sun-drenched site with some trees where you can park your motorhome, caravan, tent or trailer. But Salema excels in the area of accommodation. Safari tents, eco-lodges with balconies, mobile homes, apartments and even teepees: there is a huge choice.

The safari tents combine camping with comfort and are equipped with a double bed or bunkbeds, outdoor furniture, electricity and a minibar. Eco-lodges and mobile homes offer even more comfort: they are roomier and fully equipped with handy amenities, such as their own kitchen and bathroom. And who would not want to sleep in a teepee? Great fun for the children and adults.

At the campsite

Although the campsite has no swimming pool (the sea is only 1.5 km away), there are many amenities that ensure your comfort. An attractive restaurant with a small but sophisticated menu, a charming bar and a small supermarket ensure that the basic needs are met. The campsite also puts in a lot of effort to make the place a surfing hotspot, renting out surfing equipment and offering surfing lessons.

properties.name: Camping Le Florida
properties.description:
Camping Le Florida is located in the hinterland of Perpignan, in the vicinity of the town of Elne. You camp here at a distance of only 3.5 km from the sea. From the well maintained campsite, with its beautiful camping pitches, excellent sanitary facilities and beautiful swimming pool, you can make all kinds of nice excursions in the area. And after a long day away, you can enjoy some nice food from the snack bar or the campsite restaurant.

Rental accommodations

You will reach the large lawn at the back of the campsite via a paved road. Everything on the campsite is very neat and well maintained. On the right hand side several roads lead to a section of the campsite where the larger pitches and rental accommodation can be found. You can rent a caravan or mobile home, suitable for two to six persons.

Spacious campsites

The camping pitches are very spacious and demarcated with well maintained trees and bushes. For campers there are special pitches with a compacted surface. Each pitch is fully or partly in the shade of the well maintained greenery.

Beautiful swimming pool

The campsite has a large, organically-shaped pool, surrounded by a terrace with palm trees, thatch sun umbrellas and loungers. It looks fresh and well cared for as does everything else on the campsite. The 26 m long swimming pool water slide is a great attraction for any child.

properties.name: Flower Camping Le Nauzan-Plage
properties.description:
In the Poitou-Charentes region, between La Rochelle and Bordeaux, is the Flower Camping Le Nauzan-Plage campsite. The campsite is located near the centre of the village of Vaux-sur-Mer, a ten-minute walk from the beach. This cosy campsite is a fun destination in the summer for families of all ages. With two pools and the Atlantic Ocean around the corner, there is plenty of opportunity for fun in the water. In the area, there is a great deal to see, experience and taste.

A spot in the shade or the sun

Flower Camping Le Nauzan-Plage is a fine, green campsite that is well maintained. The touring pitches are spacious and nicely laid out, and you have plenty of privacy. There are sites with lots of shade and sunny sites. In addition to camping pitches, there are also a few mobile homes and chalets for rent.

Pools, beach and fun

There is a heated outdoor pool and an indoor pool at Le Nauzan-Plage. So you can enjoy swimming every day. For sea and beach fun, you only need to walk a short distance to a sandy beach located in a small bay. The little ones can also play on the campsite in the playground or on the bouncy castle. In the summer, there is entertainment for all ages.

Delicious and affordable food

The Camping Le Nauzan-Plage campsite is well equipped to satisfy your inner camper. For your fresh croissants in the morning, just head over to the camp shop. There is also a restaurant where you can have a nice meal for a reasonable price.

properties.name: Vakantiepark Ackersate
properties.description:
On the edge of the Veluwe, near the village of Voorthuizen in Gelderland, lies Vakantiepark Ackersate. This family campsite is a paradise for children with all its play facilities. The A1 motorway brings you right to this campsite; take the Voorthuizen exit, then it's only a ten minute drive. You'll find the campsite just outside Voorthuizen and you have the Veluwe as your backyard.

Complete and comfortable

On several lawns there are spacious touring pitches, bordered by trees and shrubs. There are almost two hundred touring pitches, some with private sanitary facilities. These pitches are alternated with permanent pitches. For an extra comfortable camping holiday, you can choose one of the mobile homes, chalets or lodge tents.

In the various sanitary blocks you will find well-maintained and modern sanitary facilities. In two buildings there are special children's sanitary facilities and sanitary facilities for the disabled. Showers and toilet paper are included in the price. Handy: dishwashers are available on the campsite.

For young and old

Dine out at the Karrewiel restaurant at the campsite. Or visit the cafeteria for a quick snack. The little ones will love the large sand and water playground 'De Watervallei'. In addition to a heated outdoor swimming pool there is a large indoor pool, there are two children's pools and a whirlpool. Fun are the two large water slides. Weather permitting, the trampoline park is open (entrance fee). The older youth can enjoy themselves on various sports fields, but also in an indoor sports corner with air hockey tables and table football. In the theatre there are fun shows, which are part of an extensive entertainment programme.

properties.name: Camping La Boutinardière
properties.description:
La Boutinardière Campsite is a large, well-kept campsite on the west coast of France. Come dance with our mascot Capi, take part in the water fun or play a game of mini golf. There is plenty to do for the whole family. There is also plenty to experience just beyond the campsite. For example, follow the path to the beach. Here you can sunbathe or float around in the sea.

Camping or renting?

La Boutinardière Campsite offers a wide range of accommodations. There are mobile homes, chalets, camping pitches, and even apartments with a shared jacuzzi! Whether you prefer to camp in your own tent or enjoy the luxury of an apartment, you will find it all here.

Indoor and outdoor pool

The tropical-themed indoor pool is fun for both young and old alike. It features a paddling pool and several slides. The pool is heated, making it ideal for indoor recreation on a cold day. But you can also relax in the outdoor pool, which features hydromassage jets, slides and lagoon. Do you really want to experience luxury? Then try the campsite spa. You can choose from different types of massages and facials. Or relax in the sauna and jacuzzi.

The star of the evening

While you enjoy a relaxing massage, the kids will have a great time at the kids' club. Children from four to eleven can do crafts, play mini football and hunt for treasures here. In the evening there is a mini disco with mascot Capi. But the best part is yet to come: every week the older children here rehearse for a spectacular performance. Maybe your child will be the star of the evening.

properties.name: Camping Village Cigno Bianco
properties.description:
Camping Village Cigno Bianco is an attractive and quiet campsite on the island of Sardinia. The camping is beautifully located by the sea. You camp near the town of Tortolì (slightly less than 4 km along), in the natural, rugged Ogliastra region. The camping terrain has a large number of trees providing shade and flowering shrubs, which is very relaxing. The grounds are some 300 m in length and also border 300 m of beach.

Well maintained campsite

The campsite has one hundred well maintained pitches. There are sufficient trees to offer everyone the much-needed shade. The flowering shrubs complete the greenery. The actual pitches are not very large (60-80 m2), please note that a lot of privacy cannot be guaranteed during busy periods. Don't have camping equipment? There are also beautifully equipped mobile homes with generous surrounding space.

Lovely sandy beach

Guests on Camping Village Cigno Bianco like sunbathing and swimming. The seawater is very calm here with very little current. Therefore, some camping guests bring their canoes or inflatable boats. Snorkelling, too, is always popular. The beach, with fine white sand, extends very far. Take a relaxing stroll on the beach or jog along the shore. On the campsite itself all kinds of activities are organised for children.

Welcoming restaurant

The restaurant chef produces excellent meals. The restaurant is located in the middle of the campsite. You can make a choice from an extensive menu. The contemporary furniture creates a lovely ambiance. The largest part of the restaurant consists of a terrace (partly covered). Also featured: a pizzeria and bar. Take-away meals are also available. The camping shop is small, but has an impressive range.

properties.name: Camping Didota Eco Resort
properties.description:
Surrounded by numerous cycling and walking routes, Camping Didota Eco Resort is the place to be for outdoor lovers. The campsite is equipped with a swimming pool and is located directly on the beach. Ideal for a refreshing dive. The campsite is not very large and as a result easy to oversee for families with young children. All kinds of shows and activities are organised for the evenings and the food in the camping restaurant is delicious.

Various camping options

Whether you arrive with a motorhome or caravan, or you want to rent a bungalow; it is all possible. It should be taken into consideration that the camping pitches are laid out on a gravel surface. When you come to Camping Didota Eco Resort with a caravan, tent or motorhome, it is handy to bring an extra ground sheet. In addition to pitches, there are also rental bungalows with air conditioning on the campsite and you can also book a log cabin.

Swimming pool or beach?

Are you a beach lover? Or would you rather put your towel down on a lounger near the pool? You can do both at Camping Didota Eco Resort. Adjacent to the restaurant you will find the campsite swimming pool, surrounded by palm trees and with a canopy for the necessary shade.

From the campsite you can walk directly onto the warm, Spanish beach. A dive in the salty water of the Mediterranean, snorkelling or reading a good book, of course, are but some of the possibilities. Besides, the sea is ideal for a kayak or sailing trip.

properties.name: Camping Lido di Sesto
properties.description:
Camping Lido di Sesto is located alongside Lake Maggiore, in the heart of the Ticino Nature Park. It’s wonderful for campers who love nature, water and Italian charm. Use your own camping equipment, or rent a modern mobile home or bungalow. You’ll fill your days here with water fun in the pool or lake, strolling in the surrounding villages, or cycling through the green surroundings.

Camping pitch or mobile home?

At Camping Lido di Sesto, choose between pitches and modern, fully-equipped rental accommodation. For example, a mobile home or bungalow with a bathroom, kitchen and often a nice veranda or garden. Rather use your own camping equipment? There are large pitches for your tent, caravan or motor home. Surrounded by greenery, the lake is within walking distance.

Activities for the whole family

There’s always something to do at this campsite. Of course, you’ll dive into the swimming pool or lake every day. Children will play in the playground and sports enthusiasts will head for the football pitch or rent a bicycle. Fancy something tasty? The restaurant serves typical Italian dishes and the terrace is a great place for a drink.

Discover Lago Maggiore

Walk or cycle through the peaceful Ticino Park. Take a boat trip to the Borromean Islands, or visit the impressive Rocca di Angera castle (8 km). The monastery church of Santa Caterina del Sasso (22 km) is recommended too. Prefer a day of shopping and culture? Arona (10 km) has cosy streets and great terraces.

properties.name: Camping Scholtenhagen B.V.
properties.description:
Scholtenhage is a friendly campsite in a setting that is equally friendly. Without any city hustle and bustle here, nature will let you unwind completely. This feeling of being one with nature is seamlessly continued on the campsite. You do not really have to leave the campsite thanks to the pleasant atmosphere and the available amenities. However, it would be a pity not to explore the Twente landscape on foot or by bicycle.

Vibrancy

The campsite impresses straight away with its vibrancy and children will definitely be eager to play in the beautiful playground (with climbing tower). The camper van pitches near the entrance also look very attractive. The reception is conveniently located in the large and well appointed restaurant building.

Convivial campsite

On the way to the camping field you will see that everything is well cared for. At the far end of the campsite there is a large field with spacious pitches for tents and caravans. From there you can set out into the forest for a walk. Holiday makers who like a bit more comfort, can hire one of the special glamping tents, if they wish.

Entertainment and swimming

In peak season there is an entertainment team that organises a great programme. Besides the area, the campsite itself is also a very pleasant spot to play or relax in front of your tent. Camping guests have free access to the tropical swimming pool de Wilder, located next to the campsite.

Central restaurant

A real eye catcher is the beautiful central building with restaurant, reception and terrace (with nice view of the playground). In peak season you can order a bite to eat from a small menu. The sanitary facilities are well maintained and include a baby room.

properties.name: Camping Rodas
properties.description:
Camping Rodas is in the north of Catalonia, bordering the charming fishing town of Roses. This family campsite is by one of the most beautiful bays in Spain, the Bay of Roses. From the campsite, you can get to Playa de Santa Margarida and the lovely promenade with bars and restaurants in no time. Camping Rodas has camping pitches in the shade, mobile homes and lodge tents.

A pitch in the shade

It can be hot in the summer on the Costa Brava. So it's nice that many of the camping pitches are in the shade of the trees. The pitches are an average size and surrounded by hedges. So you have privacy everywhere. Besides pitches for your own tent, caravan or motorhome, there are mobile homes and lodge tents to hire.

Jeu de boules and disco

There is plenty for everyone to do at the campsite. For the children, there is a playground and an entertainment team that organises fun activities for kids up to age 12. The centre point at Camping Rodas is the swimming pool with the adjacent patio belonging to the campsite bar. They regularly organise evenings filled with music, disco and dance.

Swimming pool or sea?

You have a lovely view of the fenced leisure pool from the patio. There is a large oval-shaped pool and a shallow pool for children. The pools are surrounded by a generous sunbathing area where you can enjoy the sun. Playa de Santa Margarida is a little further away and the source of more sun and water fun. With a shallow slope to the sea and a permanent life guard, this beach is very popular among families with young children.

properties.name: Camping Estrella de Mar
properties.description:
If you'd like to go on a city break to Barcelona and are looking for someone to stay nearby, this campsite is a good option. Camping Estrella de Mar is only 20 kilometres from the centre of Barcelona. With its outdoor swimming pool, restaurant, entertainment programme and sports and games facilities, the campsite also has plenty to offer. Furthermore, here you camp 500 metres from an expansive sandy beach.

Shaded site with pitches, mobile homes and lodge tents

A large part of Estrella de Mar consists of fields where you can camp with your own caravan, motorhome and/or tent. The nice thing is that most pitches have plenty of shade. So, it's a nice place to be on hot Spanish summer days. At Camping Estrella de Mar not only can you book a spacious pitch, but you can also stay in a modern mobile home or safari tent.

Swimming pool or sea, which one will you choose?

Castelldefels is by a wide sandy beach that stretches for many kilometres. You will also find a lovely place to swim closer to the campsite. The campsite itself has a large swimming pool, which is lovely for swimming some laps. This swimming pool is also appealing to children, as there is a paddling pool next to the main pool.

Plenty of sport, games and entertainment

There is plenty of entertainment at this campsite in the form of a lovely landscaped playground and various sports facilities. Here, you can play football and basketball, while the padel court, a jeu de boules court and table tennis table are available for use. Furthermore, the entertainment team organises many fun activities in the summer.

properties.name: Camping & Ferienpark Falkensteinsee
properties.description:
Camping & Ferienpark Falkensteinsee is situated in a wooded area in Lower Saxony, Northern Germany. The campsite winds its way around the lake, the Falkenstein Lake. The greenery is evident everywhere, in the shape of trees and a beautiful grassy surface. The campsite is very spaciously laid out and exudes peace. Often, the only sound you hear is the chirping of birds. Daydream away on one of the benches on the water's edge...

New and modern

You camp on spaciously laid out pitches, mostly demarcated with hedges. All pitches are grouped around the lake, including the rental accommodation units. You have a choice of barrel-shaped mini homes, trekker huts and large holiday homes. Everything is modern, colourful and comfortably furnished. 

(Water)activities

Being so close to the lake, recreation on and near the water is a given. You can go fishing, snorkeling and scuba diving. Twice a year there is a weekend get together for model ship builders. There is a challenging large playground on a sandy surface for children. Challenge your fellow campers to a game of mini golf.

Shop, bistro and outdoor kitchen

There is a small camping shop with a good range. Bistro het Seehuus, in the same building, will not disappoint you either. You can enjoy delicious meals there. Outside there is a cosy terrace with sun umbrellas, naturally with a view over the water. Would you rather do your own cooking? You can make use of the outside kitchen, complete with stove, kitchen sink and wooden furniture.

Eco-friendly sanitary paradise

There is a new and very well maintained sanitary building. It has an ecological design, everything according to the latest environmental standards. The facilities here compare very favourably with a hotel.

properties.name: Mosel-Islands Camping
properties.description:
In the middle of an island in the Moselle river is the Mosel-Islands Camping campsite. You will find this campsite in the west of Germany between historic towns, wine hills and many cycle paths. You can camp right on the water here. There you will find not only well-kept pitches, but also cosy wine barrels in which you can stay. Enjoy the passing boats or go up the Moselle yourself.

Camping by the water

A pitch right on the water. Views of the wine hills. The green grass under your feet. Camping at this German campsite is exactly how camping is meant to be. On the island, you will feel completely free, away from all the hustle and bustle. The pitches are not defined, but are nicely organised on the site. Do you want to give your camping holiday an extra special touch? Then camp in one of the romantic wooden wine barrels.

A special splash

Where there is water, there is swimming. That's also the case at the Mosel-Islands Camping campsite. Dive right into the Moselle from your caravan or wine barrel for a cool splash-around! Would you rather not get wet, but still want to enjoy the water? Then try your luck in the little marina. Perhaps you'll get to ride along on one of the pleasure boats. And then there's the good restaurant by the harbour. From the terrace, you can still admire the boats and the river.

High sanitation standards

There are plenty of toilets and showers in the central sanitary building. They also look clean and well maintained. The sanitary facilities are on a higher floor. Are you less mobile? No problem. The sanitary facilities for disabled campers are located on the first floor.

properties.name: Camping Luna
properties.description:
Close to the beach of Marina di Massa, on the coast of Tuscany, is Luna Campsite. At this small-scale campsite, you will camp on a quiet and shady plot. You can really relax here, as there is no entertainment programme or swimming pool. But you are in luck: the beach and the Mediterranean are within walking distance.

Quiet and comfortable camping

The campsite is well looked after. Straight gravel paths lead to the shady touring pitches and the bungalows. Sometimes it is a bit cramped. Especially the touring pitches are not particularly large, so it takes some skill to get your camper or caravan parked. The pitches are largest just behind reception.

Beach within walking distance

The Mediterranean Sea is perfect for a dip in the water, all the more so as large boulders offer swimmers a protected and safe swimming area. On the beach there is enough space to lay out your towel, but the image here is (at least during the summer months) mainly determined by the numerous sun loungers. These are owned by the many restaurants that have gathered along the coast. For a fee, you can sit on one of the chairs.

Restaurants and bars

The advantage of the many restaurants and bars at the beach is that there is always somewhere to eat. For example on the beach or in the resort of Marina di Massa. The campsite also has a bar, the central meeting point for campsite guests. You can enjoy a drink with your fellow campers in the atmosphere of a shady garden.

properties.name: Camping Begur
properties.description:
Càmping Begur is located in a green, hilly area close to the Costa Brava's most beautiful bays. This quiet family campsite is perfect for a relaxing holiday in north-east Spain. Here you will find modern facilities, spacious pitches, luxury lodge tents and mobile homes. The village of Begur is just 1.5 km away and the beach of Cala Aiguablava (2.5 km) is also easily reached.

Camping pitches with privacy or luxury in a lodge tent

The campsite is in the middle of this nature reserve. You camp here on demarcated pitches with plenty of peace and privacy. Choose from standard pitches or go for extra large and comfortable. There is always a place that suits your needs. Want to stay here without your own camping equipment? Then there are lodge tents for a glamping experience, bungalows and modern mobile homes. Everything is well maintained. Here you can really enjoy a carefree holiday, as a couple or as a family.

Swimming pools, playground and a supermarket

At Càmping Begur, there are two outdoor pools: a heated pool and a saltwater spa. Around these pools, there is plenty of space to lay your towel. Children can have fun in the playground, kids’ club or on the sports fields. There is a gym and you can barbecue for free. Everything is provided: from a supermarket to a laundrette, car wash and a charging station for your electric car. In the evening, finish the day on the terrace.

An inviting environment

The area is perfect for an active day trip. Walk to the hidden beaches of Aiguablava, Sa Tuna or Platja Fonda surrounded by rocks and pine trees. Don't forget your snorkel, because the water here is crystal clear.

properties.name: Camping Salatà
properties.description:
Camping Salatà, less than 700 metres from the coast, is in Catalonia, Spain. This family campsite is a wonderful location for young and old because of the entertainment programme during the high season, amenities such as the playing field and swimming pool and the beautiful surroundings. During the off season, the campsite is ideal for those seeking peace and quiet.

Supermarket with local products

Camping Salatà’s campgrounds are well-kept. There is plenty of vegetation and the pitches are grassy. The size of the pitches vary and are clearly demarcated. You can also stay overnight in a luxury mobile home or safari tent. A good meal can be had at the restaurant, and you needn’t leave the campsite for your basic needs since there is a supermarket that sells mainly products from local suppliers. You can also purchase fresh rolls here every day.

Within walking distance from the sea

Camping Salatà is within walking distance from the Mediterranean Sea. You can walk to the centre of Roses (2.5 km) via the boulevard along the beach. Roses is a charming village with shops and restaurants. It also has various options for water sports.

If you would rather go for a refreshing swim in the swimming pool, no problem! Those who love the water will have hours of fun in the swimming pool with a separate wading pool and a large Jacuzzi. During the high season, the entertainment team organises daily activities such as aqua-gym, yoga mornings and sampling of local products. Plenty of things are organised for children as well. There is also a small garden where the youngest campsite guests are welcome to learn all about the vegetables growing there.

properties.name: Camping Los Naranjos by Samay
properties.description:
Camping Los Naranjos by Samay is situated in a quiet coastal area some 2 km from the town of Moncofa (also called: Moncófar). You will enjoy the pleasant Mediterranean climate in this region. As a result, the campsite is open throughout the year. At some 250 m from the campsite there is a sandy beach, ideal for the sun and beach lovers. Furthermore, you can make lovely excursions in the area, not only to natural areas but also city trips (Castellón de la Plana and Valencia).

Shade from mulberry trees

The terrain of Los Naranjos by Samay is attractively landscaped and the pitches offer ample space. They are easy to reach and are demarcated by a large number of mulberry trees. Together with the nets that are present everywhere, they provide wonderful shade. The sanitary facilities of the campsite are good. There are many new chalets for rent.

Beautiful swimming pool within walking distance

In the middle of the campsite is a lovely swimming pool. There are two pools: a medium-sized kidney shaped basin for adults and a round children's pool. Around the pool, there are sun loungers under cosy parasols on artificial grass. It is not a very spacious area, but perfectly suitable to cool off and sunbathe. You can also sunbathe on the nearby beach, located at some 250 metres from the campsite.

Entertainment programme

In peak season there is a varied entertainment programme for children. Feeling peckish? You can enjoy a drink or a bite to eat in a bar/restaurant on the campsite. There is also a shop where fresh bread is available. You can do your daily shopping at a supermarket in Moncofa.

properties.name: Camping Municipal Molsheim
properties.description:
Municipal Campsite Molsheim in the Alsace is exactly what you would expect from a campsite in this border region (France-Germany). Enjoy the timbered buildings and the wine landscape, the beautiful broad-leaved trees on the campsite and the municipal swimming pool on the other side of the road.

Timbered houses and broad-leaved trees

It's another two kilometres to the campsite from the motorway. You will drive through the town of Molsheim before reaching the campsite. The campsite is beautifully situated opposite the town's swimming complex with linden trees and red beeches. The reception is based in a timbered house where the manager, Laurent, or his assistant, Vanessa, bids you a warm welcome. You can find tourist information here and you can collect your previously ordered fresh bread.

Spacious shaded pitches

On your way to your pitch, you will drive over a park-like terrain covered with beautiful trees. The pitches are very spacious and are shaded by the broad-leaved trees. The campers - both families and couples and sometimes groups - have various nationalities.

Swimming

Across from the entrance lies the municipal swimming pool with several pools, a patio and large lawns where you can sunbathe, as well as a bar, a restaurant and an ice cream seller. The swimming pool is freely accessible for camping guests.

Facilities

The best place to shop is at the Super-U, a large department store. You will also find many restaurants in town (within walking distance). The sanitary facilities are, just like the reception, located in a large timbered building.

Wine route with wine tasting

Unique is the 'La Route des Vins d'Alsace', a wine route which passes lovely villages with timbered houses and their characteristic flower decorations. As part of the route, you can do a wine tasting at one of the local wine producers.

properties.name: Camping Peña Montañesa
properties.description:
The large family campsite of Peña Montañesa is located in the town of Labuerda, in the Huesca region. Something for everyone on this lively and beautiful campsite in the Pyrenees, with two natural parks in the immediate vicinity. Thanks to the location along a river, there is water close by as well. The campsite offers mainly sporty entertainment to families with children.

Reception and first impression

Properly maintained, paved pathways (gently sloping here and there) will take you to well-kept fields. You will find a large variety of pitches, all with a view of the Peña Montañesa mountain. Although not very large, the pitches are adequate. You can choose between pitches with or without shade. The degree of privacy also differs. The campsite also has a few mobile homes and bungalows for rent.

Swimming to your heart's content

There is an outdoor swimming pool and a heated indoor swimming pool, toddler pool, jacuzzi, sauna and whirlpool. The outdoor swimming pool is adjacent to the restaurant terrace, in an open section of the campsite, very sunny and with a view of the surrounding area. The Cinca river, in which you can swim, flows along the campsite.

Please note: the water is not suitable for tiny swimmers. This is because you bathe between boulders and stones. However, the river is suitable for white water rafting, kayaking and rafting.

Sports entertainment

There are excellent sports fields, with athletic track and cycling/roller blade track as well as a tennis court. More than 18,000 m2 of recreation! The restaurant with terrace caters for all tastes. Here you can enjoy eating outside next to the swimming pool. You can also get take-away meals.

properties.name: Flumendosa Camping Village
properties.description:
Flumendosa Camping Village is situated in the south of Sardinia, the well-known island west of Italy. The shaded campsite with an abundance of pine trees offers beautiful pitches and is located at only 150 m from the beach, accessible with a pathway. The campsite has recently been renovated. This is evident from the swimming pool, reception, the pizzeria and sanitary facilities.

Mobile homes with sea view

The campsite has almost 100 touring pitches and 34 rental accommodation units. The level and hardened pitches are located in the shade and have electricity connections. Mobile homes are available in different levels of luxury, for instance Classic, Superior and Superior with sea view. To wake up in the latter is a real joy. All guests who book a mobile home have free access to the swimming pool.

Swimming and playing fun galore

The campsite has an average-sized outdoor swimming pool of some 130 m2. Adjacent to this is a modestly-sized toddler pool and a field with seats and sun umbrellas. You can also head for the 'free of charge' swimming pool: the Mediterranean Sea, some 150 m away. 

There is a lovely mini club for the littlest camping guests (languages: English, Italian and French). In peak season they can attend this at least four times a week. Twice a week in the peak season there is an entertainment programme for slightly older children (Please note: entertainment in Italian only). Children will certainly enjoy themselves on the bouncy castle.

New pizzeria

There is a modest selection in the campsite shop and restaurant. Since 2016 there is a new pizzeria. You can also get take-away meals.

properties.name: Camping Smeraldo
properties.description:
Camping Smeraldo is located in the north of Italy, directly on Lake Maggiore. This is a real Italian campsite with many annual guests from the home country. Lie down on the shores of Lake Maggiore, discover the surroundings from the water or visit beautiful villages on the shore, such as Arona and Angera.

Mainly fixed annual places

The campsite mainly accommodates annual guests. That is why there are mainly fixed annual pitches. But camping Smeraldo is also ideal for touring campers. Some thirty-five touring pitches are situated on a lawn, where tall trees provide the necessary shade. The touring pitches are not particularly spacious and undefined, but they are comfortable enough for a week's camping. You can also spend the night in one of the mobile homes.

Lake Maggiore

In front of the campsite, opposite the reception building, is the swimming pool. The swimming pool (with a paddling pool at its side) is small, so it can be quite crowded in high season. Fortunately, Lake Maggiore is only a few steps away from your pitch. A central path leads to an open area on the lake, where a beach volleyball court has been created. Directly on the water, pebbles form a narrow beach. Maybe not ideal for lying on, but the lawn behind it offers enough space to spread your towel.

Supermarket

On the small square at the entrance of the campsite you will find the terrace. Here you can have a refreshing drink. For your daily groceries you don't have to drive far. In Dormelletto, just a few minutes by car, there is a large supermarket.

properties.name: Papillon Country Resort
properties.description:
Campsite Papillon Country Resort is a well maintained campsite with spacious campsites and great sanitation, located in Twente and within biking distance from the village of Denekamp. The campsite is located right on the border with Germany. The surrounding area is famous for its lovely nature and babbling streams and is also fantastic for hiking and cycling. You can make an international trip of it with no problems by taking an excursion to the German town of Nordhorn.

Camping pitches

There has been much thought put into the sustainability and environment of the campsite. The campsites are spacious, well marked and wonderfully maintained. Many sites are located around a field, a few around a pond. The sanitation is fantastic.

Water spray park and swimming pond with climbing hill

If you love water and swimming, this campsite is the place for you. Near the entrance there is a swimming pool with a retractable roof. There is a paddling pool for the tiny ones. In addition there is a water spray park where the water really comes from everywhere. Elsewhere on the campsite there is a lovely pond with a sandy beach. The challenging climbing hill rising from the water is very special. Sunbathing and playing are possible on the sunbathing and play area.

There is a shop on the property where you can do your daily shopping. There is also a restaurant.

properties.name: ArdenParks Baalse Hei
properties.description:
An abundance of peace and greenery amidst fens, heather and forests. And besides nature, Flemish culture and ambiance is never far away. In addition, there are recreation lakes for the necessary water fun. These are the main advantages of camping at Baalse Hei in the Kempen.

From the reception you will reach the tent of caravan via grassy nature paths. The quietly located pitches can be more or less shaded, according to preference. Furthermore, they are equipped with water, electricity, drainage and cable television. In addition to these pitches, this campsite also has several types of rental accommodation: luxury mobile homes, safari tents and camping huts.

Lots of fun on the water

The three water bodies on this campsite provide lots of water fun amongst nature. First of all in the swimming pond near the bar/restaurant, with adjacent sandy beach and grassed area. You will also find a rowing and fishing pond. Further down the grounds there are play areas with swings, slides, walking bridges and shelters for the children. Adults will also have no difficulty keeping fit at Camping Baalse Hei with the sport fields and sporting facilities (soccer, tennis, table tennis, volley ball and petanque).

Regional beers

At the campsite you will be able to buy fresh bread. The tavern has a menu to appease both small and large appetites. If you prefer takeaway, you can find it at the Belgian Fry. Obviously, you will also find the well-known beers of this region here.

The numerous marked walking trails and cycling routes in the area are an invitation to explore the Antwerp Campines. With beautiful and interesting towns like Turnhout, Antwerp, Ghent and Bruges at relatively short distance, there is a plethora of day trips to choose from. Theme Park Bobbejaanland is only a 20 minute drive away.

properties.name: Dolomiten Camping Amlacherhof
properties.description:
Dolomites Camping Amlacherhof lies at the foot of the Lienz Dolomites, one of the most beautiful areas of the mountainous Tyrol (Austria). You camp right next to the long-distance cycle route Drauradweg. For mountain climbing enthusiasts, there is plenty to do in the area. It is also advantageous that, at Dolomites Camping Amlacherhof, you can book a stay in a modern mobile home, a room or an apartment almost the entire year round. This makes the campsite an ideal home base for fun skiing in the winter sports centres Zettersfeld and Hochstein.

Camping in a sunny country house garden

A beautiful country house plays a central role at this campsite. The basement of this stately building contains the well-maintained toilet facilities. The rooms and apartments are located above. Camping is done in the open gardens behind the country house on spacious grassy pitches. There are both sunny and shaded touring pitches. Almost every pitch at Dolomites Camping Amlacherhof has an attractive view of the surrounding mountains.

Swimming pool, riding school and a charming bar

There is a beautiful swimming pool in the centre of Dolomites Camping Amlacherhof. This whimsical outdoor swimming pool is only open to campsite guests. Horse riding enthusiasts will enjoy the riding school next to the campsite. The campsite has its own bar, cafeteria and charming terrace. Fresh rolls and cakes can be ordered here to be picked up the following morning.

Enjoy the natural beauty of the attractive town of Lienz

The campsite has an ideal location for hikers. If you exit the camping site at the back, you will find yourself in the wooded mountains of the Lienz Dolomites. In any case, wonderful mountain walks can be had in the mountains around the town of Lienz. There are also plenty of walking tours that are more level, especially in the valley of the Drau.

properties.name: Camping Paklenica
properties.description:
Camping Paklenica with an adjacent pebble beach is situated directly on an inlet of the Adriatic Sea, some 40 km from the historical harbour town of Zadar. You camp here on camping pitches at the water's edge or in modern rental accommodation. The campsite forms an ideal basis to explore the mountainous Paklenica National Park and to add a sporty touch to your camping holiday in Croatia.

View of the sea

Paved pathways lead to the pitches over a well maintained terrain. These are alternated with modern and well equipped mobile homes. The most beautiful spots are found at the water's edge. You will find no shade here, but there is a beautiful view of the sea.

Attractive pebble beach

The lovely pebble beach off the campsite is a great place for an afternoon of sunbathing and swimmig. You can also head out to sea by canoe or rowing boat from here. There are more spots by the water where you can relax and indulge in several water sports. You can also go for a swim in the campsite swimming pool.

Visiting Zadar

Camping Paklenica is located in a less-visited region of Croatia. Yet, there are several attractive towns in the area which you can visit. Zadar, for instance (a 45-minute drive away). In this harbour town you will find the Saint Donatus Church and the Roman Forum. Zadar is also well-known for its beautiful sunsets.

Spoilt for choice

The restaurant on the campsite has a good menu with fair pricing, but there is a much wider range in Starigrad and the immediate vicinity.

properties.name: Camping Lloret Blau
properties.description:
Camping Lloret Blau is a town campsite in the north of Lloret de Mar, the famous seaside resort on the Mediterranean coast. You camp on the Costa Brava, not far from the beach and the centre of Lloret, with its many bars, shops and restaurants.

Campsite for touring campers

The Lloret Blau campsite is quite open, despite the many shrubs and trees that surround it. Paved paths take you over the slightly sloping terrain to the touring pitches, often delimitated and situated in the sun. The pitches are not particularly large, but the open character of the campsite still gives you a spacious feeling. The fact that the campsite focuses on touring campers is evident from the three hundred touring pitches and forty special camper van pitches on offer.

City campsite

Camping Lloret Blau is a real city campsite. Not only because of its location, but also in its basic facilities. On the campsite you won't find a supermarket, but there is a lively café and bar. You won't need much either, as the centre of Lloret de Mar is within walking distance. Within a few minutes you are in the supermarket, and in the city centre you will find several restaurants.

Swimming

At the campsite you do have the luxury of a swimming pool. This can be found next to the bar and café. Although it is a simple swimming pool, you can go there for a cool and quick dive. This is no unnecessary luxury, as the Costa Brava is known for its beautiful weather with - especially in summer - high temperatures. Of course you can also walk to the Mediterranean Sea.

properties.name: Camping Riviera
properties.description:
Campsite Riviera is located in Calceranica al Lago, on the southern banks of beautiful Lake Caldonazzo (Trentino province). It is a relatively basic family campsite which offers plenty of opportunities for an active holiday. Lago di Caldenazzo, well-known for its crystal-clear and warm waters in the summer, is ideal for swimmers and water sports enthusiasts.

Campsite and hotel

Campsite Riviera is located behind hotel Bellavista, which is where families visiting the campsite guests often stay. The campsite makes a peaceful impression and the pitches are spacious by Italian standards. The facilities on the campsite are modest. Food and drinks are available at the hotel: a bar/ice cream parlour with a patio, where you can also enjoy breakfast or an aperitif.

Free guest card

One special feature is the free guest card for campers, which allows you to use all the public transportation facilities in Trentino province for free and gives you free access to many sights (such as museums and castles, as well as wine tastings, for example).

Enjoy Lake Caldonazzo

There is no swimming pool, but this is more than compensated for by Lago di Caldenazzo. You only have to cross the main road to reach the sunbathing lawn by the lake. Here you can swim in water with a comfortable temperature of 22°C. Besides swimming, you can go windsurfing and paddle board surfing, water skiing, canoeing and fishing. Just four kilometres away from the campsite lies an adventure park (Acropark) with a challenging ropes course. Fun for the whole family!

Sanitary facilities

The sanitary facilities are centrally located on the grounds and are well-maintained. Riviera even has an area where you can wash your dog.

properties.name: Camping Brugger am Riegsee
properties.description:
Campsite Brugger am Riegsee is situated in the Bavarian Alps, on the banks of the Riegsee. This beautiful terraced campsite has a lovely sunbathing lawn and its own beach on the swimming lake. Most of the pitches offer a beautiful, panoramic view of the lake and the mountains. Camping Brugger am Riegsee is an eco campsite in a stunning, natural setting.

Camping with a view of the lake

Campsite Brugger am Riegsee has no fewer than three hundred permanent pitches. The touring pitches, one hundred in total, are located on a separate section of the camping grounds. There are three different tent fields. The pitches for camping guests vary in price, depending on size, the amount of shade and the vastness of the view. 

Walking pleasure

Around the Riegsee and other lakes in the region you will find several easy walking routes. A walk around the Riegsee is approximate 9 km long and leads you along the smaller Froschhauser See as well. You can also go for beautiful walks around the nearby Staffelsee. This lake is located at some five km from the campsite and is considerably larger; a walk around this lake covers a distance of approximately 22 km.

Swimming in the mountain lake

The Riegsee is one of the warmest lakes of Bavaria. The clean, clear water lends itself excellently to swimming. Campsite Brugger am Riegsee has a sunbathing lawn with grassy beach on the lake. In addition, there also is a nice pebble beach. The beach slopes gently down into the water, so that it is also ideal for children to swim and play in. There are pebbles and stones on the bottom; therefore, aqua shoes are recommended. You can also engage in surfing and sailing on the lake.

properties.name: Aquacamping De Rakken
properties.description:
Here you'll be welcomed by the stunning vistas of south-west Friesland. The name of the campsite says it all: Aquacamping De Rakken has no shortage of water. You can see the boats sail by across the Heegermeer from the camping pitches. The pitches along the water offer places to dock your own boat. There is also a marina (blue flag distinction) with a trailer ramp for small boats and the options to hire electric sloops or sailboats. The site is located in the charming centre of Woudsend.

Breakfast on the water

Want to wave at the boats sailing by as you eat breakfast? Choose one of the camping pitches along the water. You can dock your own boat (or a rental) here as well. Standard pitches not located on the water are available, too. All pitches are partially bordered by trees and hedges. Pitches for campervans are located just off the site, on a property that is secured with a boom barrier. These pitches are partly paved: you park your camper on the gravel and there is grass where you can set up tables and chairs. 

Diverse accommodation

If you don't have your own camping equipment, you can rent a holiday home or a deluxe wooden pod cabin.

Playing around in the water sports building

The activities team organises all sorts of entertainment for children during high season. Mornings are great for playing around in the water sports building and afternoons can be dedicated to games. Every Wednesday, the activities team sets up shop in the village community centre and special events are planned. You won't be bored between Wednesday and Friday either, because the activities team will be ready and waiting with an exciting evening for you.

properties.name: Camping & Village Rais Gerbi
properties.description:
At Camping & Village Rais Gerbi you will always camp with a view towards the clear waters of the Mediterranean Sea. This large campsite with mainly touring pitches is located on the rocky northern coast of Sicily, with the sea within easy reach and the mountains of Madonie inland. From the terraces, the spacious swimming pool and the covered outside seating of the restaurant, the view over the Mediterranean Sea is sublime.

Terraced campsite

As on almost every campsite on the north coast of Sicily there is a railway running right through the campsite. However, in most places you won't be bothered by the train, which passes almost invisibly through a small valley. On nicely shaped terraces, separated by stone walls, there are over two hundred pitches with a hard surface. The hard surface is very nice, because when it rains you don't have to worry about a squidgy soil. The only drawback is that it is difficult to get your pegs in.

Swimming pool by the sea

The large campsite pool is located on a plateau close to the sea. While lying in the water or sitting on one of the sun loungers, you can enjoy a beautiful view. In high season the swimming pool is quickly discovered by a large number of camping guests: it’s gets crowded in and around the pool.

Pizza with sea view

A good pizza is of course an important part of your camping holiday in Italy. Luckily they know how to make a good o ne in the campsite's restaurant, located next to the reception. Take a seat on the covered pavement café, which overlooks the swimming pool and the Mediterranean Sea.

properties.name: Cesenatico Camping Village
properties.description:
Cesenatico Camping Village is set in natural surroundings in the northern Italian region of Emilia-Romagna. With unobstructed sea views, three swimming pools and beautiful surroundings, this large family campsite is a great place to stay. With Rimini, Ravenna and San Marino nearby, there are plenty of fun excursions too. Recover from a city trip on your lovely camping pitch or in rental accommodation.

Splashing water fun

With a location close to the Adriatic Sea, there’s plenty of water fun on offer. The beach is just 500 metres away and there’s even a little train in high season. Thanks to the gently sloping seabed, the sea here is ideal for families with small children. Or enjoy a game of beach volleyball.

Prefer to head for a pool? Cesenatico Camping Village has three! With a large Olympic-size pool and two smaller pools, a refreshing dip is always possible!

Facilities at the campsite

With a restaurant, snack bar and pizzeria, there’s no need to cook. Tasty snacks are always available. Delicious fresh bread is sold every morning. There’s wi-fi reception in most parts of the campsite. This makes it easy to send photos to people back home.

With a playground, sports area and entertainment programme, there is always something to do here. And when you’ve had enough? Then relax in the sauna, whirlpool or beauty centre. As you can see: the campsite has everything you need for a carefree holiday!

properties.name: Camping de Laborie
properties.description:
Camping de Laborie is a well-kept, wooded campsite on the east bank of the Ardèche River. Here you will find the imposing, natural ‘arch bridge’ Pont d’Arc and the Route des Gorges, a spectacular boating route through a rocky part of the river. In addition to enjoying nature, you can taste the local atmosphere in towns such as Ruoms and Vallon-Pont-d’Arc.

Spacious, demarcated pitches

The camping pitches are situated on fields along surfaced avenues. In some places they are demarcated with hedges, in others with trees. The pitches are spacious to very spacious and have a rocky surface. Generally, the trees provide ample shade, but some pitches have more sun.

Modern rental mobile homes, small wooden bungalows and tents with a fixed bottom are also available on the campsite. Everything looks spick and span. The sanitary facilities are meticulously clean and are housed in a centrally located, vibrantly decorated building. There are sanitary facilities for the disabled.

Great swimming facilities

Apart from a nice swimming pool, there is a children's pool and a heated water fun park for the children. There is a playground near the swimming pool. The pool is surrounded by loungers, ready to welcome sun lovers. Slightly older children will also enjoy playing in the river. The river bank is directly accessible from the campsite by way of a shortcut. Ideal for paddling, canoeing and fishing.

Fresh bread and pizzas

There is a snack bar on the campsite that also serves pizzas. You can buy basic foodstuffs including fresh bread in a small shop. For a larger assortment you have to go to Pradons or Ruoms.

properties.name: DKamping Village, ex International Camping Ispra
properties.description:
DKamping Village (ex International Camping Ispra) is located on the winding road coming from the south running along the east bank of Lago Maggiore toward the north. The quiet location of the campground is a big plus point. The campground is located right on a private beach on Lago Maggiore. This part of the lake is the most natural and is not located in the touristy area.

Camping on the water

At DKamping Village you'll not find defined campsites, but open sites that vary in size and foundation. There is a long, narrow zone of campsites on the lake. The other campsites are a bit further away from the lake. Accommodations are the minority, there are only wooden chalets for hire.

Beach or pool

From your campsite you are only a few steps from the beach. The first metres of water are shallow, so ideal for kids. There is a sunbathing area with comfortable chairs you can use for a fee on site. You can also swim in the well maintained swimming pool. There is a colourful slide for children.

Multi-faceted bar

The bar is the heart of the campground and also serves as a small shop. There is a terrace looking out on the pool and the sea. In the summer months, pizzas are baked and there are rolls available in the morning.

Jumping and dancing

There are plenty of activities for children up to 10 years old. Regularly there is a bouncy castle, or you can dance during the music evening, where parents are also very welcome.

properties.name: Camping Willam
properties.description:
The well organised and well maintained campsite William is located directly on Lake Constance. An ideal destination for water sports enthusiasts, anglers and camping guests with their own boat. Cyclist can clock up a few km on the famous Lake Constance Cycle Route, which runs around the lake. And be sure to have a bite to eat in the excellent campsite restaurant.

Camping on the lake

Campsite William is a large, rather busy campsite. Some of the camping pitches are located on the water's edge. Different rates apply for these pitches. A railway line runs along the other site of the camping grounds. On a few camping pitches on that side you may experience a bit of noise from this. There are a large number of permanent pitches for longer-staying, predominantly German guests. There is no rental accommodation here.

Water sports and relaxation

This campsite is extremely suitable for water sports enthusiasts and keen anglers. This is borne out by the amenities. For instance, there is a generous boat storage facility and a boat launching ramp for guests with their own boat. You can also hire canoes, kayaks and motor boats. The Untersee lake is suitable for windsurfing, waterskiing, sailing and snorkelling. You can also go for a swim in the lake, of course. The bottom slopes down gently, making it ideal for the little ones to paddle. Sunbathing lawns and beach showers are also available. 

Excellent restaurant and sanitary facilities

The camping restaurant is highly recommended. The portions are generous and you have a splendid view of the lake. There is also a small campsite shop. The little ones can enjoy themselves in the playground. There are two sanitary buildings with modern, good and clean sanitary facilities. You need coins to shower; these are available from the reception.

properties.name: Camping River
properties.description:
Camping River is located on the River Magra, close to the Ligurian coast and the Mediterranean Sea. With its large swimming pool and quite spacious touring pitches, overlooking the hills, it is a good place to stay. Bear in mind that the facilities on the campsite are rather basic. Camping River is a good base for trips to Cinque Terre, Lucca and Pisa.

Camping between river and sea

The land between river and sea consists for a large part of green hills. This terrain accommodates almost two hundred flat pitches, which are certainly quite spacious by Italian standards. The delimitated pitches are tidy and get enough shade. The hills in the background only lose their height when they reach the Mediterranean Sea. The steep rocks with afforestation make a pretty picture. Especially when you sail along the coast with a boat.

Large swimming pools

On the edge of the campsite, near the river, there are two large swimming pools. For swimming laps there is a separate competition pool, while the other pool is mainly for fun and games in the water. A separate paddling pool ensures that even the youngest water enthusiasts have fun.

Basic facilities
