The facilities on the campsite are quite simple. There are sufficient , well cleaned sanitary facilities, but very old-fashioned. The assortment in the small shop is very small. Luckily you only have to drive five minutes for more extensive groceries. If you want to take it easy, get a takeaway meal from the campsite restaurant.

properties.name: Settebello Village and Camping
properties.description:
Settebello Village and Camping is a large family campsite on the Italian coast, directly on the Mediterranean Sea. The campsite is located in a pine forest, along the coastline between Rome and Naples. The sprawling campsite, which offers touring pitches and rental accommodations in both the sun and the shade, is bisected by the road. With a large swimming pool, sports fields and a restaurant with a sea view, there is plenty to do on the campsite.

Extensive, wooded campsite

The campsite has different faces due to its large size. In some areas - where the forest is denser - the tall pines offer plenty of shade to the touring pitches. Other camping spots are provided with artificial shade from tarps. There are beautiful touring pitches located close to the beach, though these are a bit on the small side. The spots further from the Mediterranean Sea are a bit more spacious. The campsite has 430 touring pitches and more than 150 different types of mobile homes.

Enticing swimming pool

The campsite has an enticing swimming pool, located in the wooded area across the road. Its wonderful to go for a swim in the circular pool's clear water, soak in the whirlpool or sunbathe on the wrap-around sundeck. Campers can do all of these things for a reasonable fee. Incidentally, you'll also find most of the sports fields and the open-air theatre next to the swimming pool.

Pizza by the sea

The shop is located close to the reception, on the sea side of the campsite. In contrast to the shop's limited assortment, the pizzeria offers a wide variety of options. And there is a nice terrace. Sit down and enjoy a pizza and a glass of wine while looking out over the Mediterranean Sea.

properties.name: Camping Calypso
properties.description:
At Camping Calypso, you camp in a relaxed way on the Adriatic coast in Italy. What stands out about this campsite is the lively atmosphere and neat, family-friendly amenities. Here, you will find pitches and hire accommodation, making the campsite suitable for any type of camper. You won't get bored for a second: jump into the swimming pool (with slide), walk along the beach, or explore the history and natural beauty of Le Marche.

Spend the night under the pine trees

The camping pitches at Camping Calypso are thoughtfully laid out under the shade of pine trees, which is pleasantly cool during hot days. The pitches vary in size. If you come with large camping equipment, you are advised to book in advance.

For those who would like added comfort or that don't have their own camping equipment, this campsite has stylish mobile homes and bungalows with all modern conveniences. They include a private bathroom and kitchenette, for example.

Comforts at and around the campsite

There is plenty to do at the campsite, especially for families. The swimming pool with slide is near reception. There is also an entertainment theatre for children, where they regularly organise performances and activities. You can go to the spacious patio for something to eat and to the bar for a drink. It's nice and busy here in the high season in particular. There is also a supermarket in the vicinity. And the beach? You can walk to it in no time!

properties.name: Camping Augstfelde-Vierer See
properties.description:
Camping Augstfelde-Vierer See is just outside the town of Plön, centrally located in the Holsteinische Schweiz in the German state of Schleswig-Holstein. This campsite is right by Vierer See, one of the many large lakes adorning this lovely lake area. You can go on lovely walks and bike rides past these lakes. The campsite is also an ideal base for water sports enthusiasts. Furthermore, you will find all you need for a wonderful family holiday: sports and play facilities, a youth centre, a cinema and an excellent restaurant. There is a varied entertainment programme in the high season.

Park-like site with spaciously laid out camping fields

On arrival, you will be given a friendly welcome. If you look at the map of Camping Augstfelde-Vierer See at reception, you will see that a large part of the site comprises annual pitches. Yet there are also a few hundred tourist camping pitches on this park-like landscaped campsite. The camping fields are spaciously laid out and are mainly along the outskirts of the campsite, also close to the lake.

Water fun on and around the Vierer See

This campsite has private sandy and grassy beaches by Vierer See. This is a recreational lake with clean swimming water; ideal for a refreshing swim on hot summer days! You can also do water sports on Vierer See, such as sailing, rowing, windsurfing, canoeing and kayaking. The Vierer See has a narrow waterway connection with the larger adjacent lake Großer Plöner See. Active rowers, kayakers and canoers can take trips from the Vierer See to Plön, Malente or Eutin. You can even sail all the way to Kiel via the River Schwentine.

properties.name: Bryrup Camping
properties.description:
Centrally located in Jutland, surrounded by forests, lakes and hills, is Bryrup Camping. In high season this is a real family campsite where families with (young) children feel completely at ease. This is also an ideal place for sporty holidaymakers such as hiking enthusiasts. On the terraced pitches on the side of the site you can enjoy a beautiful view.

Neat and partly terraced terrain

Anyone who is on this campsite for the first time will soon notice: this campsite is neat and very well organised. The terraces on the side of the campsite are also eye-catching. Especially from the higher pitches you have a beautiful view over the campsite and the surroundings. The majority of the campsite consists of touring pitches, although there are also cabins, tents and bungalows for rent.

Splashing in the water park

At Bryrup Camping the heated outdoor swimming pool is one of the eye-catchers. Campers of all ages have old-fashioned water fun here. The water slide, the children's pool and of course the swimming area are just as much fun. In addition, special swimming evenings are sometimes organised here. Swimming is also possible in the swimming lakes around the campsite.

Plenty of entertainment for children

For children there is plenty to do at this campsite. For example, there is a beautiful playground with bouncy castles, a lot of climbing and playing equipment, a lot of smaller playground equipment and a sports field. Mini golf and table tennis are also possible of course. There is also a covered play area where you can play pool, air hockey and table football. In the high season there is also a passionate animation team active.

properties.name: Sandager Næs Camping
properties.description:
Sandager Næs Camping is located twelve kilometres from the charming harbour town of Assens on the Danish island of Funen, and is a lovely family-friendly campsite. With its heated swimming pools, original playground equipment and fun activities, this three-star campsite offers entertainment for campers of all ages. The campsite also has a café and a large supermarket. It is situated next to a beautiful nature reserve and just 800 metres from a large sandy beach on the Little Belt.

Small plots, large pitches

This well-organised campsite features several modestly sized pitches divided by tidy hedges. If you appreciate plenty of camping space, choose one of the pitches by the water, which range from 100 to 140 m². With an area of between 80 and 120 square metres, the other pitches are certainly not small either. You will also find a number of rental accommodations at this campsite, such as comfortable camping cabins and luxury bungalows.

Wonderful water park and exciting recreational facilities

At the front of Sandager Næs Camping is a lovely water park. In this open-air aqua park, you can enjoy a large main pool, a spectacular family slide, a lovely paddling pool (also with a slide), rapids and a hot tub. The water is heated to 28 degrees.

Young children can enjoy themselves in the indoor and outdoor playgrounds, not to mention the petting zoo with its adorable goats. In addition, there are regular sports tournaments, a challenging mini-golf course and a real High Jumper. This is a trampoline where you can jump up to seven metres high with a harness and ropes. For teenagers, there is a TeenLounge with PlayStation, pool table, table football and a chill-out corner.

properties.name: Feriendorf am Maltschacher See
properties.description:
In Carinthia, Austria, you will have a great holiday at Feriendorf am Maltschacher See. You camp on the banks of an idyllic small lake, surrounded by green wooded areas, hills and meadows. If you like nature, swimming and water sports, this is the place for you! The campsite has its own restaurant by the lake and the surrounding area is perfect for great walking and cycling trips.

Book an apartment or one of the green pitches

The Ferienhof am Maltschacher See grounds are spacious and green. There are 200 pitches right on the banks of the Maltschacher See. If you don’t have your own camping equipment, you can also book an apartment or studio.

Sailing, swimming or standup paddleboarding

The Maltschacher See is a small but idyllic lake. Swimming is great here, as is water sports like sailing, standup paddleboarding or surfing. Don't feel like cooking? Then head to the restaurant next to the campsite. Take a seat inside or, if the weather is nice, on the terrace where you can enjoy a beautiful view of the lake.

Out and about in Carinthia

The state of Carinthia has beautiful nature, known for its many lakes, mountains, wooded areas and beautiful landscapes. It is a Valhalla address for hiking and cycling enthusiasts.

If you'd like to sample some culture, Carinthia’s capital city, Klagenfurt, is only 20 km away. Stroll through the centre with its stately buildings from the Renaissance, admire the dragon fountain and visit the miniature city of Minimundus.

properties.name: Camping Playamonte
properties.description:
Do you enjoy taking long brisk walks and hikes past the most spectacular natural sights on holiday? If so, Camping Playamonte, just outside the village of Navarrés (Valencia province), is the ideal starting point. This peaceful campsite is surrounded by impressive natural reserve areas. Yet another great feature is the family-friendly recreational lake, just a kilometre away.

Peaceful camping under the olive and broadleaf trees

This campsite has a well-organised camping area that is split into two sections. At Los Olivos, you will find lovely touring pitches under olive trees, while at Pawlonias you will camp under broadleaf trees. Paved paths lead to the camping pitches, some of which are also paved. In the centre of the site, there are a number of fully equipped bungalows with a kitchen, bathroom and air conditioning. This campsite mainly attracts those seeking peace and quiet. But if you want to mingle with your fellow campers, there is a welcoming bar at reception with table football and billiards.

Plenty of fun on the water at Playamonte centre

In Spain, summer temperatures can get very high. So the lovely recreational lake just a 15-minute walk away is certainly a nice touch. You will find this safe swimming lake (blue flag!) in the village centre of Playamonte, where you enter the water via a sandy beach. There is often an inflatable water playground set up in the middle of the lake, complete with obstacles and slides.

Enjoy the beautiful natural surroundings

This campsite is a fantastic base for nature and outdoor enthusiasts. For example, you can drive to the beautiful Los Chorradores nature reserve (5 km) with its impressive waterfalls. Or set off on a lovely walk past the imposing Sansón rock formations, and at Los Charcos de Quesa (16 km) you will find a series of natural pools with beautiful little waterfalls with crystal-clear water.

properties.name: Camping International d'Aups
properties.description:
Camping International d'Aups is in the picturesque Aups, one of the charming villages that fill the Provence. From the campsite, it's only a 10-minute walk to the photogenic village centre. A visit to Aups is highly recommended on market days in particular. Then you will be able to enjoy the best delicacies that the Provence has to offer, such as white and black truffle. You can also wander through the narrow streets and past small restaurants and lovely souvenir shops.

Shaded touring pitches and modern accommodation

If you decide to book a pitch at Camping International d'Aups, there is a big chance you will end up somewhere at the front of the site. That is where most of this campsite's touring pitches can be found. The front part of the campsite is also the most shaded part. The pitches are spacious and neatly demarcated.

Furthermore, glamping options at Camping International d'Aups have greatly increased in recent years. Indeed, quite a few new accommodation have recently been built. At the campsite, you can spend the night in a luxury mobile home or a surprisingly spacious lodge tent, for example.

Lovely water park with hot tub and slides

In the middle of the site there is a lovely water park that was fully renovated in 2022. Since the renovations, the idyllic swimming pool at Camping International d'Aups has become the campsite's showpiece. Here, you can enjoy the large general swimming pool, a playfully shaped paddling pool, a hot tub and various spectacular water slides. The wooden bridges, stylish parasols and many loungers make a visit to this swimming pool even nicer.

properties.name: Camping Airotel La Roseraie
properties.description:
Between Brittany and the Vendée, Camping Airotel La Roseraie is ideal for families. You are staying here less than two kilometres from La Baule beach, the longest beach in Europe! You can enjoy the sea here or end the day with a long walk. There is also plenty to do at the campsite itself. Take a dive in the swimming pool, work out in the fitness room and get a snack in the restaurant. Fun for the whole family!

Enjoy the privacy

The campsite grounds are well maintained and modern. At the beginning of the summer season there are many international families at the campsite. So your children can make lots of friends! Are you more in need of some peace and quiet? No problem: the pitches are surrounded by hedges, giving you plenty of privacy. You can choose a spot with a lot of sun or a spot with some shade. The campsite also has many (new) mobile homes for rent, if you do not have your own camping equipment.

Jump, dive, splash!

Are you real swimming enthusiasts? Then this is the right place for you. The campsite has a water park with an indoor pool with sliding roof, an outdoor pool and a children's pool. The swimming pool is next to the road, so you can sometimes hear the traffic, but it is lovely in the sun.

AIn the summer season, there is entertainment (also for teenagers and adults) in French and English. The campsite also has a trampoline and a bouncy castle. The table tennis table, the sports field and the fitness room are accessible free of charge. For an additional fee you can play tennis, mini golf or even horseback riding.

properties.name: Flower Camping Le Rochelongue
properties.description:
Camping Le Rochelongue lies on the outskirts of the popular coastal resort of Cap d’Agde, some 500 m from the Mediterranean. The harbour, the shopping esplanade, Waterpark Aqualand, theme park Luna Park, Canal du Midi and a few discos are all located in the vicinity. Whether you are a sun lover, cycling enthusiast or angler, you will always find something to do.

Green grounds

The green grounds are located along a quiet road. The pitches are of a reasonable size (80-90 m2), demarcated with low shrubs and neatly laid out. You can choose a pitch in the sun or (partly) shaded. The surface is partly made of grass, partly of sand. There are quite a lot of rental mobile homes.

Atmospheric swimming pool

There is a beautifully laid out, heated swimming pool with a playful, heated toddler pool surrounded by loungers. You can always find a shaded spot here. You camp here within walking distance of the Mediterranean. The child-friendly beach slopes gently into the sea.

Fun boat and aqua gym

There is a playground for children, a brand new multi sports field, a climbing wall, table tennis tables and entertainment for all ages. Small campers can join the Children's Club. Treasure hunts, archery lessons, a fun boating event and sport tournaments are also organised. Senior citizens are also not left out: they can join the morning gym, water aerobics and stepping tutorials.

Terrace with cosy seating

The campsite shop has a fairly large range. Don't feel like cooking every now and then? The restaurant has a limited menu but serves also snacks and pizzas. There is also a bar with terrace. Flop down on one of the comfortable seats and enjoy the view of the pool.

properties.name: Camping Valle Gaia
properties.description:
Tuscany is one of the most beautiful regions of Italy. At the Camping Valle Gaia campsite in the village of Casale Marittimo, you can experience the best of both worlds: the Mediterranean Sea and the green, hilly interior. This cosy campsite located in a forest features several beautiful pools and two restaurants where you can indulge in delicious Italian food.

Fine camping

With 220 pitches on a well-maintained property, camping at Valle Gaia is a truly wonderful experience. Cypresses, oleanders and other trees provide shade and demarcation. The pitches for caravans, motorhomes, tents and trailer tents are exactly the way many campers like to see them: spacious, demarcated and with privacy. The most beautiful and spacious spots are on the higher part. Those without their own camping equipment can book one of the sixty apartments, suitable for two to six people.

Swimming fun for young and old

The campsite's two large and two smaller pools form a beautiful ensemble. They are often pleasantly crowded with children playing in the water and their parents on a deck chair with a book. By the pool is a cosy little bar. Beach and sea lovers are in for a treat. In the seaside resort of Cecina (5 kilometres away), you can enjoy yourself on one of the beaches.

Fun away from the pool

In the high season, children can join in with the entertainment almost every day. There is also a special kids zone with brand new playground equipment. Furthermore, there are plenty of opportunities to enjoy sports at the tennis court and football field. The outdoor fitness equipment is very popular among campers to ensure you can still get a good workout during your camping holiday.

properties.name: Elements Camping Selce
properties.description:
Elements Camping Selce is situated in sunny Croatia, on the Dalmatian coast. You can walk straight into the sea from the campsite. The pebble beach makes this an ideal snorkelling spot. Half an hour's drive from the campsite, you will find Croatia's third largest city, Rijeka.

Shaded pitches

Once you arrive at the campsite, you will see that most of the site is located in the shade. In high season, the campsite predominantly accommodates families, but in the off-season it is mostly frequented by overnight guests. The sanitary building on the grounds is pristine and has dedicated children's facilities.

Dive into the sea

Surrounded by Mediterranean trees, it is a 200 m walk to the sea. This Croatian coastal region is very popular with families. Because of the clear water, this is an ideal spot for snorkelling or diving! There is a diving centre on the beach. Windsurfing and waterskiing are also possibilities You can rent a lounger for a fee on the sun terrace if you want to soak up the sun. In addition to the glorious sea, you can amuse yourself with a great game of table tennis, mini golf or jeu de boules.

A bite to eat at the campsite

You can do your daily shopping in the supermarket on the campsite, but for freshly baked bread you have to go to the bakery. You don't have to leave the campsite if you want something to eat. Head to to the snack bar if you just want something light.

properties.name: Amadria Park Camping Trogir
properties.description:
If you camp at Amadria Park Camping Trogir, you will spend your holiday in a beautiful spot in the south of Croatia, directly on the Dalmatian coast and near the old coastal town of Trogir. From the shady terraces you have a beautiful view over the Adriatic Sea. Enjoy the luxury of this large campsite with a homely atmosphere.

Camping with sea view

he steep terrain is made up of several terraces. The upper rows are housed by mobile homes. On the terraces below you will find the touring pitches. The most beautiful spots on the campsite are perhaps those closest to the sea. The view over the Adriatic Sea and the islands in the distance is phenomenal.

Swimming in the pool and sea

Swimming with a sea view? The new swimming pool, with its beautiful round shapes, is situated on a sun deck not far from the seawater. While you swim, you can enjoy the beautiful view at the same time. Even the youngest swimmers can play in the water, in a shallow part of the pool. Of course you can also take a dip in the sea itself. Via a ladder from one of the flat rocky beaches you can walk straight into the water.

Local specialities and special wines

With a large restaurant, pizzeria, sports bar, beach bar and ice-cream parlour, there is no shortage of eateries at Amadria Park Camping Trogir! Especially the large pavement café next to the restaurant is a great place to dine. All the more so because the restaurant offers a wide choice of local specialities and special Croatian wines.

properties.name: Amadria Park Camping Šibenik
properties.description:
Located directly on the Adriatic Sea, Amadria Park Camping Šibenik is an ideal resort for families and nature lovers. Here you camp just five kilometres from the historic city of Šibenik. Its location in Croatia's Dalmatia region makes it an excellent base for trips to national parks, such as the Krka waterfalls and the Kornati islands. The campsite is part of a larger resort with extensive facilities and activities for young and old.

Camping on the beach

The campsite offers spacious, shaded pitches under pine trees, separated by bushes and oleanders. Some pitches are right by the sea and have stunning views, while others offer tranquillity among the greenery. For those looking for more comfort, there are modern mobile homes and new bungalows overlooking the sea. The accommodations are suitable for families and couples.

Swimming pool with a view of the sea

Amadria Park Camping Šibenik has extensive facilities, including a large swimming pool with water jets and an adjacent beach bar. There is a pizzeria, a beautiful and modern campsite shop and several restaurants within the resort, including an atmospheric Dalmatian restaurant serving local food. The campsite attracts families with children as well as couples and seniors. The toilet and shower facilities are modern, clean, spacious and well maintained.

Explore Dalmatia's wonderful nature

The historic centre of Šibenik (5 km) is worth a visit, as is St. Nicholas Fort (3 km). There are also excursions to Krka National Park (16 km) and the Kornati Islands.

properties.name: Camping Allerblick
properties.description:
Camping Allerblick is a friendly, not too large campsite in a quiet landscape along a meandering river (the Aller). This small river is suitable for swimming and canoeing. The area is ideal for walking and cycling, or for trips to a beautiful town or the Bergen-Belsen memorial camp. The tourist town of Celle is within walking and cycling distance.

Park-like campsite

The campsite exudes an amicable atmosphere. The campsite is open, well maintained and is directly situated along the river. Part of the campsite lay-out resembles a park. The reception can be found in the centre of the campsite, in the same building as the restaurant. The campsite is uncluttered, with well maintained pitches and free fields; you can decide where you want to pitch your tent or put your caravan. The pitches are all different, on an open field, at the water's edge or under trees. The campsite does not specifically cater for families, although there is a playground.

Boating on the river

Via a jetty with sunbathing lawn you will reach the peaceful Aller River, where you can swim. You can also navigate the river with a canoe/kayak or with a cruise boat.

Simple and tasty food

There is a simple restaurant on the water's edge with a small menu, which serves homely fare. You can also sit on the terrace by the river. For shopping you can go to the nearby Winsen or Celle. You can order bread rolls on the campsite. The sanitary facilities are housed in a central building. The simple building is spacious and clean.

properties.name: Camping Village La Chiocciola
properties.description:
The peaceful family campsite La Chiocciola is located between the Tuscan hills and cities such as Florence and Siena. After a long day, you can enjoy the peace and privacy of your pitch.

Green park

The first thing you notice when you arrive at the campsite is the silence. You feel as if you are in the tranquillity of a green park. You can stay in one of the mobile homes at the campsite, or enjoy camping. The spacious pitches are bordered by laurel hedges and trees that provide plenty of shade.

A place to relax after visiting cities

Camping La Chiocciola is not really a children's campsite, but especially in high season you will encounter many families with children there. The campsite is also an ideal base for visiting Tuscan cities. Many campers seek the peace and quiet of the campsite after a long day in Florence or Siena.

Particularly spacious swimming pools

The swimming pools at the campsite are particularly spacious. There are three in total: a deeper pool, a shallow pool for children and a paddling pool. So the whole family can enjoy themselves here. There is plenty of space to lie down around the pools. The campsite has responded to this by providing plenty of sun loungers with parasols.

properties.name: Camping Village Punta Navaccia
properties.description:
Surrounded by the green hills of Umbria lies Camping Village Punta Navaccia, located directly on the shore of Lago Trasimeno, or the Trasimenian lake. The area is ideal for making lots of day trips. Obviously, you can visit the villages around the lake, but you can also travel further inland into Tuscany. Visit for example Siena and Perugia. But Asissi (the famous pilgrimage site), Spoleto (home to the annual summer music and opera festival Festival dei Due Mondi) and Montefalco are also worth a visit while staying at this campsite.

Lodge tents with a view of the lake

Village Punta Navaccia is a fairly large campsite with level and shady camping pitches. Most of these are located near the lake. The sanitary facilities are of satisfactory quality. Apart from the camping pitches, there are several types of mobile homes: ‘standard’, ‘superior’ and ‘deluxe’. One of the mobile homes is equipped for disabled camping guests. In addition, there are safari lodge tents and Coco lodge tents with a view of the lake.

Dive into the swimming pool or the lake

There are two outdoor swimming pools, one of which is an shallower toddler pool. Pool parties are held regularly. The pools are in a nicely sheltered spot between the trees. Around them are loungers and sun umbrellas. The campsite borders the lake. There is a sandy beach, but there are also sun umbrellas and loungers which are freely available. There are also floating platforms in the lake. The lake is excellent for waterskiing, windsurfing, sailing and canoeing.

Entertainment: performances in an amphitheatre

There are many sport facilities on the campsite. You can play tennis, basket ball, beach volleyball, table tennis, go swimming, do fitness training or play mini football. In peak season there is entertainment for both children and adults. The little ones can join the miniclub or the baby dancing. Later in the evening, the youngsters can join the disco. There is also a large, covered amphitheatre where the entertainment team organises evening performances such as musicals and other shows.

properties.name: Camping Lido di Monvalle
properties.description:
Camping Lido di Monvalle is a tranquil campsite in the north of Italy, located directly on Lago Maggiore. The lake lies on the border between the Lombardy and Piedmont regions. Their hills, covered with vines, as well as the large lakes attract many nature lovers. On the campsite you can combine a tour of the rolling landscape with a long afternoon of swimming and soaking up the sun.

Camping with a lake view

Camping Lido di Monvalle has quite a number of permanent pitches, where especially Italians and Swiss guests have made their fixed abode. The touring pitches are used by camping guests of different nationalities. The pitches are not particularly large, but they are beautifully laid out in the natural surroundings. Some of them are situated almost directly on Lago Maggiore. You can therefore camp here with a superb view of the lake. 

Lago Maggiore

Whilst enjoying the view of the Piedmont mountains, you can go for a swim or engage in some water sports and enjoy the peace and quiet on and around this vast lake. At the back of the campsite is a lovely lawn where you can soak up the sun on one of the loungers.

Conviviality

Every now and then in high season the campsite organises live concerts, musical evenings and foam parties. At the bar and by the lake the social get-together can at times continue until the early hours of the morning. These evenings may be a bit noisier than usual, but the night-time rest of the campers is taken into consideration. 

Italian specialities

The large restaurant is the hub of the campsite. You can enjoy a glass of Italian wine and eat your pizza whilst overlooking the lake. What more could one ask for?

properties.name: Spreewald-Natur Camping "Am See"
properties.description:
Spreewald-Natur-Camping 'Am See' is seven kilometres from Lübbenau (Brandenburg). It is an ideal starting point for lovely boat trips though Spree Forest. Part of the site is around a lovely recreational lake. The campsite has several private beaches and a swimming jetty by this lake. Furthermore, this authentic campsite has a restaurant, a bistro and plenty of options for relaxation and entertainment, including in the form of a cheerfully decorated bowling alley, a mini library and a wellness zone.

Elongated site with mainly camping pitches

This campsite runs along the north and west sides of Hindenberger See. It is a well-maintained site with a friendly character. If you book a pitch at Spreewald-Natur-Camping 'Am See', there is a big chance you will have a view of the lake.

You can also book a stay here in a modern mobile home, a holiday home or a charming two-person hut.

Lots of water fun on and in Hindenberger See

There are plenty of spots at the campsite grounds from where you can access the water. There are various beaches and a swimming jetty. Certainly on hot days, it's enjoyable swimming in Hindenberger See. Many water sports activities are possible at the recreational lake. For example, standup paddleboarding, rowing and pedal boating.

Sports, games and sauna

There are also plenty of options for sports and active enjoyment on land. The campsite has a beach volleyball court, a sports field, table tennis, an animal meadow, playground and a real bowling alley, for example. The bowling alley is decorated as an underwater world. To relax and unwind, the campsite offers a sauna and massages by a professional masseur.

properties.name: Camping Resort Riegersburg
properties.description:
Camping Resort Riegersburg gives a unique camping experience in the beautiful Austrian region of Stiermarken. This modern campsite is located opposite a lake and opened in 2024. With spacious pitches, comfortable accommodations and numerous activities in the surrounding area, this is the ideal home base for nature lovers and culture enthusiasts. Enjoy a relaxed holiday with a panoramic view of the Riegersburg Castle.

Spacious pitches and modern accommodations

At this orderly campsite the pitches have been placed along narrow asphalt laneways. If you arrive with a motorhome or caravan, you can choose from between a standard, premium or superior pitch with a paved surface. The difference lies in the size of the pitch and the type of connections. Campsite visitors with a tent can pick a pitch on the tent field. If you prefer a little more comfort, choose a luxury mobile home or a glamping accommodation. These are fully furnished and give a homey feeling, perfect for families and couples who enjoy conveniences.

Extensive amenities for young and old

Camping Resort Riegersburg has excellent amenities. There is a modern reception and toilet block, a playground for children and a swimming lake for cooling off. For campsite visitors who love sports, there are cycle and walking tours that start at the campsite. The campsite focuses on families, active holidaymakers and those seeking peace and quiet. A small farm shop sells the daily necessities and in one of the restaurants around the lake you can enjoy local specialities with a beautiful view.

properties.name: Camping Domaine de Longemer
properties.description:
Camping Domaine de Longemer near Xonrupt-Longemer is a wonderful holiday address for anyone wanting a wonderful stay in the mountains. Here, you can enjoy the impressive natural beauty of the French Vosges to the full. There are all kinds of things to do on and around the campsite. These include endless walks or bike rides through the richly wooded mountains, water sports on Lac de Longemer, or enjoying the swimming pool or entertainment at the campsite itself.

Spaciously appointed site

Domaine de Longemer is a playfully appointed site where camping pitches are clearly in the majority. You have plenty of space on and around your pitch. Glamping lovers will also have a wonderful time here. You can book a stay in a luxury holiday home, a comfortable safari tent or a cosy hiker's cabin.

Get in the mood with a welcome drink

Every Monday in the high season, there are welcome drinks for new campsite guests at the snack bar's patio. The activities programme for the following week is also announced at the same time. Entertainment at Camping Domaine de Longemer includes fancy dress parties, crafting hours, sports tournaments, quizzes and musical evenings. There is also a wellness zone and an indoor swimming pool. You can also swim in the natural water of Lac de Longemer.

Enjoy the natural beauty

This campsite is only a 15-minute drive from the Hohneck, one of the highest mountain tops of the Vosges. From here, you have breathtaking views of the surrounding mountains. On clear days you can even see the Alps in the distance!

properties.name: Camping L'Aigle
properties.description:
Would you like to visit Verdon Gorge and you are looking for a campsite nearby? Then a stay at Camping L'Aigle in Aiguines, in an authentic village in the Provence is recommended. Here, you camp at a short distance from various lovely viewpoints over the gorge. Furthermore, the campsite is in the middle of walking and climbing routes, many of which go along and through the river canyon. You can relax and unwind at the campsite after a lovely day of walking. It's highly enjoyable in the communal hot tub or in the restaurant, which has a patio offering stunning views of the Lake of Sainte-Croix. That is the lake the Verdon Gorge ends.

Lovely terraces with spacious camping pitches

You have lovely views of the surrounding area and of course of the Lake of Sainte-Croix from many of the pitches. Furthermore, many of the pitches have a reasonable amount of shade and privacy. As well as on a spacious pitch, you can spend the night in a modern mobile home, chalet, lodge tent or camping pod at the campsite. These accommodation have recently been erected.

Relax in the hot tub

There is a communal hot tub at the front of the site. Another place to optimally unwind is the restaurant, including a lovely bar and superb patio. This patio may offer the best views from the entire campsite. It's a wonderful spot to enjoy a tasty Provencal meal or simply have a delicious drink.

properties.name: Delphi Camping
properties.description:
On the southern slopes of Mount Parnassus in Greece lies Delphi Camping. Surrounded by the largest olive groves in Greece and with a beautiful view over the Gulf of Corinth, this campsite has a prime location. The surrounding area has ample typically Greek places, including the harbour cities of Itea (11 km) and Kirra (11 km).

Camping with a view of mountains and sea

What makes Delphi Camping special is the terraced character of the two campsites, providing a flat surface without demarcating the areas. This site, carefully maintained, offers both sunny and shady spots because of the natural shading of trees and reflective mats. The spots at the edge are somewhat smaller, but this is compensated by the lovely view.

Its own swimming pool, restaurant and shop

It can get quite hot in the Greek mountains, which makes it great to be able to go for a swim in the campsite swimming pool. The swimming pool is encircled by shady spots and sun loungers with a view of the surrounding mountains.

The restaurant with terrace serves delicious local dishes and has a permanent exhibition with water colours done by one of the founders of the campsite. For the daily necessities there is a shop that sells, among other things, products from its own olive grove.

An area rich in history

The archaeological diggings of Delphi, on the UNESCO World Heritage List, are only 4 km away. In classical antiquity, Delphi was known as the centre of the world and was the seat of the Oracle of Delphi. Today it is a tourist attraction.

properties.name: Cp. & Bungalowpark Ottermeer
properties.description:
Camping & Bungalow Park Ottermeer is situated right on the lake of the same name, in the heart of East Frisia. Here you can camp in a natural setting, with all the amenities you need close at hand. These include a modern toilet block, a small shop and a snack bar. You will never have a dull moment outside the campsite either. Wiesmoor, also known as the ‘flower town’, is just a short distance away, and the peat routes lead you through the beautiful countryside.

Generous camping pitches

The pitches at Camping & Bungalowpark Ottermeer are generously sized and have their own water taps. You can pitch your tent, park your caravan or motorhome on open fields that are clearly laid out and surrounded by well-kept flower beds. For those who really want to enjoy some peace and quiet, there is even a separate field with private sanitary facilities. If you don't have your own camping equipment, the bungalows and fully equipped rental caravans are a great choice.

An abundance of amenities

In the centre of the campsite, there is a modern sanitary block equipped with all the modern conveniences. Here you will find spacious showers, accessible bathrooms and bathroom rentals for extra privacy. For daily shopping or a quick bite to eat, you can pop into the small shop or snack bar.

Enjoying the Ottermeer

The campsite is situated right beside the Ottermeer, inviting you to enjoy the outdoors. Here you can relax by the water’s edge, take a refreshing dip or simply enjoy the view. It’s also a great spot for water sports enthusiasts. The surrounding area is perfect for exploring by bike. The well-known peat routes take you past open landscapes, small villages and quiet country lanes.

properties.name: ErlebnisCamping Lausitz
properties.description:
ErlebnisCamping Lausitz is situated in a green and rolling landscape marking the border between the German states of Brandenburg and Saxony. This recently re-opened family campsite is small in scale and features spacious camping pitches on grass separated by bushes and trees. At the campsite, you can swim a few lengths in the swimming pool or bathe in a separate pool with a water slide and a whirlpool bath.

Spacious and comfortable pitches

The campsite itself isn't big; the pitches, on the other hand, are. Almost all the pitches are very spacious and are equipped with a water connection. Shrubs and hedges provide a natural form of demarcation and privacy on the campsite grounds. Everything on the campsite is well-maintained, including the sanitary facilities. ErlebnisCamping Lausitz has recently been re-opened, which may mean that a few buildings are still awaiting minor renovations.

Climbing, clambering, swimming and fishing

The swimming pool at the campsite has already been renovated and is ideal for swimming a few lengths. Next to this pool lies a shallower swimming pool with a water slide and a whirlpool bath. Can't get enough of the water? Next to the campsite, there is a lake where you can go fishing (for a fee). And the children can climb and clamber to their heart's content in the rocky playground.

Face to face with the wolf?

For basic supplies, visit the village of Ortrand next to the campsite. The extensive Königsbrucker Heide nature reserve is also situated close to the campsite. It's an area that is known for its varied flora and fauna, ensuring beautiful cycling and hiking trips. With a bit of luck - or not - you might even come across a wolf here.

properties.name: Vejers Familie Camping
properties.description:
Not far from the North Sea beach, in the town of Vejers Strand, lies the Vejers Family Camping. Not only is the beach attractive here, but so are the dunes with extensive pine forests, which were planted to prevent sand-drifts. However, most guests come here for a relaxing holiday on the endless and wide sandy beaches, which start only a few hundred metres away. Are you bringing your children on a camping holiday? If so, a visit to Legoland (BIllund) is an absolute must. It takes a hour by car to get there.

Well-defined pitches

In the modern campsite reception you will be welcomed by one of the owners, who will let you choose your own spot. The campsite is mainly geared towards caravans and motorhomes, but the tent camper will be given a similar pitch as the motorhome guest. The pitches are well defined, but offer little privacy as there are hardly any trees or shrubs on the campsite. 

Trekker huts

The rental accommodation consists of sixteen trekker huts/holiday bungalows. Most are equipped with a shower and toilet and are suitable for two to six persons.

Water fun in the pool or the sea

Vejers Familie Camping has an attractive swimming pool, even though the campsite is not far from the sea. The pool is heated and measures almost 200 m2. Next to it is a toddler pool of 40 m2. Here the little ones can play safely. 

As far as children are concerned: there is an entertainment team twice a week to keep them entertained with games and other activities. In addition, camping guests have free access to Badeland Blåvandshuk, a water paradise and wellness centre.

properties.name: Campingplatz Dresden-Mockritz
properties.description:
Campingplatz Dresden-Mockritz lies in a Dresden suburb. Although the campsite is located in town, it looks very green and has a large number of big, old trees. The terrain makes a spacious impression. In peak season it is often very busy on the campsite. Especially in late afternoon lots of new campers use this as an overnight stop on their way to, for instance, the Czech Repulic.

Camping next to a natural swimming pond

As the terrain is not entirely level, you have to be careful where to park your motorhome, caravan or tent. The front portion of the grounds has a lot of old, big trees. The section at the back is slightly smaller and the pitches there are separated by hedges and shrubbery.

Next to the campsite you will find a reasonably sized natural swimming pond with a large, green lawn with play equipment for children. There is also a special field for tents. This terrain partly borders the swimming pond and is separated by a fence. You can also rent a mobile home or one of the seven bungalows.

Shop and restaurant

The shop near the reception stocks basic necessities for guests, but there are sufficient supermarkets in Dresden (also in the suburb of Mockritz). The restaurant is housed in the same building as the reception. You can eat al fresco on a terrace with modern chairs and tables. The restaurant has a fine cuisine with a full menu at reasonable prices.

Renovated sanitary facilities

The sanitary facilities have recently been entirely renovated; only the outer walls are still the same. A baby room was added and there are also separate children's sanitary facilities (to be opened with a key).

properties.name: Siblu Camping Meerwijck
properties.description:
The family campsite Siblu Camping Meerwijck, in the far north of the Netherlands, is in a stunning setting near the village of Kropswolde. The campsite is in a unique location in the forest and by the Zuidlaardermeer combined with a lively marina. The restaurant and the swimming pool are lovely facilities, and it is also a paradise here for children thanks to the entertainment, the playground and the beach. Cycling fans and water sports enthusiasts will have the time of their lives in the area.

Camping in Groningen

You can enjoy the countryside to the full amid the Dutch landscapes and just south of Groningen. There are various towns and village in the area, for example for groceries or to go out for a bite to eat. The central location is convenient, close to the A7 and A28 motorways, in the triangle between Laren, Hogezand and Zuidlaren.

Lovely fields

If you come with your own tent, caravan or motorhome, then you pitch on grass. Many touring pitches are on neat fields, with a small playground in the middle for the youngest campers. If you would like to spend the night in accommodation, you also have various options: a hiker's cabin, a lovely glamping tent, a furnished mobile home or a cool pod.

Heated indoor swimming pool

A big plus at Siblu Camping Meerwijck is the indoor swimming pool. It is a lovely swimming pool for all ages. It's not massive, but it is nicely landscaped. The spacious private sandy beach is ideal for outdoor swimming fun. It is by shallow water and it only takes a few steps to reach from your camping pitch.

properties.name: Siblu Camping De Lente van Drenthe
properties.description:
Dolmens, untouched nature where you can take endless walks and cosy, picturesque villages. That must be Drenthe! You can easily explore this beautiful rural province from Siblu Camping De Lente van Drenthe. At this family campsite you can enjoy all kinds of (sports) activities and after a day's holiday you can enjoy a delicious meal in the restaurant.

Spacious camping pitches

The well-tended grounds are divided into spacious camping pitches with sufficient privacy and space to set up your tent, caravan or motorhome. From your pitch, you also have a beautiful view of the woods and surrounding meadows. Prefer slightly more comfort? Then rent a luxury lodge tent with sanitary facilities or a comfortable chalet.

Adventure park, swimming pool and beach

There is no shortage of swimming fun at Siblu De Lente van Drenthe! There is a small but fine swimming pool on site and you can walk straight to swimming lake 't Nije Hemelriek. Younger ones can enjoy themselves at the boulder hall for children, the kids' club and the pumptrack. Within walking distance of the campsite, on the banks of recreational lake the Gasselterveld, is the largest open-water park in the Netherlands: DX Adventurepark.

Explore Drenthe's nature and theme parks

The province is famous for its megalithic tombs. You can admire these special stone monuments in abundance in the area. Borger (8 km) is home to the largest hunebeds in the Netherlands. You will also find the Hunebedcentrum here.

Out and about with the family? A great outing is WILDLANDS Adventure Zoo in Emmen (27 km). For the little ones, the gnome forest in Eext in Drenthe is recommended.

properties.name: Siblu Camping Lauwersoog
properties.description:
Take a trip to Schiermonnikoog by boat: yes, your adventure starts at campsite Siblu Lauwersoog. Here you are surrounded by water and this is where nature beckons. The campsite offers numerous rental accommodation units where you can spend the night in comfort. In summer, the Lauwersmeer is ideal for swimming. An ideal campsite for those who like to explore and love water and space.

Ample camping options

Camping pods, bungalows at the water's edge, cosy trekker huts or beach chalets; this campsite has plenty of rental accommodation units to make your stay even more enjoyable. If you would rather bring your own camping equipment on holiday, you have a choice of more than 250 different pitches. Some of them are located on an open field with play equipment, so that children can play freely here. Enough options!

A unique spot amidst nature and with adventure

Are you standing at the edge of the Lauwersmeer with the Waddenzee as a backdrop? Then the obvious option is to engage in aquatic sports during this holiday. Swimming, sailing or boating with your own boat are all options. 

Looking for an unusual water activity? How about mudflat hiking to Schiermonnikoog? Or how about a seal expedition? And if this is not enough, you can make a trip with a lifeboat on the Waddenzee or do some wreck diving. Who knows what finds you will make.

More than a restaurant

Want to relax on the campsite after a such an adventurous day? Restaurant Het Booze Wijf offers a splendid view of the water. Here you can order seasonal dishes. Much of the produce is regional. The restaurants also offers a breakfast service or picnic baskets.

properties.name: Nationalpark Camping Kals
properties.description:
In the east of the tourist Tirol region, on the south side of the mighty Grossglockner, lies Nationalparkcamping Kals. You camp here on a low lying field or on one of the terraces. The campsite is popular with nature lovers and sports enthusiasts. With ski pistes galore, walking and cycling paths (from easy to strenuous) in the immediate vicinity of the campsite, there is no need to be bored.

Camping amidst the mountains

On campsite Nationalparkcamping Kals you can choose your own pitch. This can be down on the campsite or up on one of the terraces. Although the pitches are not demarcated, you will have ample privacy. This is because the pitches are very spacious. The pitches are level with a grass surface, but vegetation is limited because of the high altitude of the campsite. 

There are more than one hundred touring pitches. The campsite does not offer rental accommodation, so you have to bring your own tent, trailer tent, motorhome or caravan.

Winter sport paradise

Winter sport enthusiasts will appreciate the shuttle bus which travels between the campsite to the pistes. However, even if you do not like snow that much, you can indulge in other sporty activities. You can go walking or cycling, for instance. On the campsite and in the village of Kals you will also come across many mountaineering fanatics. There is not a great deal to do on the campsite for children, but there is a playground within a two minute walk from the grounds. 

Restaurants in Kals

There is no restaurant on the campsite, but you will find a few eating establishments in the village of Kals. You can also do your shopping in Kals.

properties.name: EuroParcs Hermagor
properties.description:
EuroParcs Hermagor is situated in the Gail Valley, a valley in the South Austrian province Carinthia. You camp here on a pitch with a view of the Carinthian Alps, or in one of the various rental accommodation units. This five star campsite forms an excellent base for a hike or cycling tour in the mountainous surrounding area. You can also camp in the snow. This is a lovely winter sports area with lots of pistes.

Camping with mountain view

The campsite is large and has some three hundred touring pitches. These are located on well maintained fields, separated by low hedges. You can opt for a pitch close to the petting zoo and the sports fields. Or, if you prefer, a pitch near the restaurant and spa. There are also some rental mobile homes available, and you can camp in a cosy, wooden barrel. And all around with that view of the surrounding mountains.

Wellness

On the north of the campsite you will find the wellness complex, which guests can use for an additional charge. Here you can take a dip in the heated indoor or outdoor pool or in the swimming pond. There is a toddler pool for the little ones. The complex houses various types of saunas, a relaxation area with loungers and an infrared cabin. 

Comprehensive entertainment programme

In high season, the campsite offers a comprehensive entertainment programme for all age groups with soccer tournaments, water aerobics, film evenings and pony rides. These ponies can also be stroked in the petting zoo, where rabbits and goats are eagerly waiting to meet some friends.

Superb sanitary facilities

The sanitary facilities of the campsite are very luxurious. There is even an indoor playground to climb and scramble in when Mom or Dad spend too much time showering.

properties.name: EuroParcs De Wije Werelt
properties.description:
On the Veluwe, surrounded by drifting sands, beautiful woods and vast moorland, you will find the cosy and luxury family campsite Europarcs De Wije Werelt. Children can play here and splash in the swimming pool (with water play equipment) to their heart's content. All facilities are perfectly fine.

Super comfort pitches

There are various types of camping pitches: economical backpacker pitches for passing cyclists or hikers, nature pitches on the edge of the wood and super comfort pitches with private sanitary facilities. The pitches are spacious and are spread over various fields in the sun or shade. The campsite stands out for its unusual accommodation (small pod, Veluwe Hikers Cabin and various kinds of tree houses).

Climbing, swings, see-saws and swimming

There is plenty to do for families with young children. Spread over the grounds are various playgrounds where children can enjoy themselves climbing, on the swings and the see-saws. In bad weather they can enjoy themselves in the indoor playground.

The swimming pool is in a sunny spot and is situated close to the terrace. Convenient for parents to keep an eye on their offspring. During the holidays a recreation team organises an extensive entertainment programme for children of all ages.

At the heart of the campsite grounds are the central facilities such as the restaurant and the camping shop. Here you you will find your daily supplies, fresh rolls and newspaper. There is also a small petting zoo, a theatre and a kids club.

Warm feet

The modern sanitary buildings, fitted with underfloor heating, are well distributed over the campsite.

Spotting wild animals

Only 2 km away from the campsite, you will find one of the entrances to National Park De Hoge Veluwe. You are likely to spot deer or wild boar here.

properties.name: EuroParcs Gulperberg
properties.description:
In the heart of the South Limburg hills lies EuroParcs Gulperberg. And it has that name for a reason. The campsite is located on the southern slope of the Gulperberg, giving you a beautiful view of the surroundings. From your camping spot, you can look out over nearby Gulpen and the green catchment area of the small rivers Geul and Gulp.

Camping at altitude

This high-altitude terraced campground has a cosy atmosphere. Everything on the campsite has a well-maintained appearance. Despite the fact that the campsite is quite large, everything is arranged in an orderly fashion. The sanitary facilities – divided into three heated blocks – also look neat and tidy. At the front of the site are the rental accommodations, and further back, you will find the camping fields.

Children's paradise

EuroParcs Gulperberg is a paradise for children. There are several playgrounds with wooden equipment and there is a sports field for a game of basketball or football. You can also join the entertainment team and participate in a delicious picnic or the playback show.

Many activities take place at the front of the campsite. Here you will also find the large restaurant where you will be introduced to Burgundian Limburg. Enjoy a sumptuous dinner or a cosy drink while keeping an eye on the children at play.

Outdoor swimming pool

Opposite the restaurant is the swimming pool, which is surrounded by a beautiful sunbathing area. There is an outdoor pool where you can swim some laps or simply cool off. For the little ones, there is a shallow pool with a fun slide.

properties.name: Camping Les Breuils
properties.description:
The campground of Les Breuills is located just outside of the city of Verdun, by a river. The campsites are separated by high hedges, so the guests have plenty of privacy. The most beautiful sites are on the large fish pond. The farther you are from the busy swimming pool, the more peace and quiet you'll enjoy. There are sites with lots and little shade in a 5.5 hectare park.

Passers-through choose this easy to reach campground, because it is a great spot for visiting the memorials from the First World War. There are special campsites for disabled people.

Popular swimming pool

Upon arrival you will be pleasantly surprised by the large heated pool, with slide, in the sun. Note: limited opening times.

Great campground

The French owner will welcome you at the reception. Here you will also find the reasonable restaurant with a large terrace and a shop with the most popular groceries and a bread service. The restaurant has a small menu. Children love the great playground. Facilities such as a multi-sports complex, beach volleyball court, jeu-de-boules pitch and ping pong table are all on site.

Plenty to do

You'll meet people from France, Britain, Germany and the Netherlands on the campground. Seniors interested in history love to stay here. There is a lovely lake with a beach within cycling distance. You can paddle a canoe along the Mass and there is a paintball centre in Thierville. In Consenvoye you can ride on the old rails with the vélorail bikes and go to Verdun for carting adventures.

properties.name: Flower Camping Les Reflets du Val d'Argent
properties.description:
Seekers of peace and quiet, nature lovers, active types and water fans: everyone will feel at home at this campsite in the middle of the French Alsace region. Visit the unique mineral exhibition in Sainte-Marie-aux-Mines at the end of June, go on a hiking excursion in the mountains with the owner, or spend the afternoon relaxing by the pool: anything goes here.

Camping in the shade

The owners bid you a warm welcome at the reception. They can tell you everything about the surrounding area. From which hiking and cycling trails to take, to fun events and fine museums. Once you are checked in and on your way to your camping pitch, you will notice that the campsite grounds are flat and elongated. Shaded camping pitches, surrounded by trees and shrubs, offer ample privacy. There are mobile homes and wooden chalets available for campers who prefer to rent an accommodation. 

Water fun in the shade

You've probably already seen the campsite swimming pool whilst you were checking in at the reception. Here, too, you will find plenty of shade, so you can choose whether to cool off in the shade or soak up the sun after a refreshing swim in the pool. Surrounding the pool are sufficient loungers so you can relax in comfort.

Hikers take note!

The vicinity of the campsite is an open invitation to explore the surroundings. Discover nature at its best, either by foot or by bike. The campsite owner organises beautiful mountain hikes to picturesque villages such as Ribeauvillé and Hunawihr. Those looking to get even higher can best take the car and follow the route over the highest peaks of the Vosges (the Route des Crêtes). You can also go wine tasting in the area and there is a new mining museum in Tellure.

properties.name: Camping Du Pont
properties.description:
Camping Du Pont is situated in the southern part of the Ardèche, close to the Pont d’Arc. The campsite is within walking distance from Pradons, a small village with a supermarket. More well-known towns like Ruoms en Vallon Pont d’Arc are close-by and are certainly worth a visit.

Small-scale family camping

Camping Du Pont is a small-scale campsite with an amiable atmosphere. It is popular with many families with children. The owners like to make their guests' stay as comfortable as possible.

Many camping pitches are separated by trees and hedges which also provide shade. Almost all camping pitches have electricity. There are separate pitches for campers with water supply and drainage.

Nomad tents

You can also spend the night in rental accommodation at Camping du Pont. Would you like to combine the charm of a tent with lots of comfort? If so, you can stay in a nomad tent. These are fully furnished and suitable for five persons. All accommodation units have a covered porch, so that you can enjoy the outdoors to the fullest.

River = lots of fun

Camping Du Pont ligt is located on the banks of the Ardèche. You can reach the sandy beach and the river with an easy walk from your camping spot. The river lends itself to swimming, paddling and floating down the river on an air mattress. The campsite itself has a heated swimming pool. Surrounding the swimming pool are a few loungers and wicker sun umbrellas.

properties.name: Sites & Paysages Le Panoramic
properties.description:
In the green surroundings of the Regional Natural Park d'Armorique, on the Breton peninsula of Crozon, lies Sites & Paysages Le Panoramic. Here you can camp less than a kilometre from the rugged Breton coast. Le Panoramic is a quiet, friendly campsite with spacious pitches and mobile homes.

Camping with fantastic view

The biggest plus of the campsite is the view. The best pitches and mobile homes located on terraces offer a panoramic view of the Bay of Douarnenez. But from several places at Le Panoramic you can look out over the sea for miles. Whether you're on one of the pitches with a unique view or not, you'll be camping very spaciously and in green, wooded surroundings. The pitches are situated on grass and are separated by high hedges. These provide a lot of privacy so you can enjoy a quiet camping holiday.

Heated swimming pool

At the bottom of the campsite there is a spacious swimming pool with paddling pool. These pools are heated, so even when it's a little colder, you can take a dip. Or have a nice bubble bath in the heated whirlpool.

Eating with a view

The interior of the restaurant may be a bit simple, but the great view of the Atlantic Ocean makes up for everything. In addition, the food is fine and the staff friendly. In the morning you can get fresh bread at the campsite, but for more extensive shopping it's best to drive in the direction of Telgruc-sur-Mer (less than two kilometres) and also Crozon is closeby. Within a fifteen minutes drive you are in one of the larger supermarkets.

properties.name: Camping du Lac de Bonnefon
properties.description:
The friendly family campsite Camping du Lac de Bonnefon lies on a small, natural fishing lake (Lac de Bonnefon) in the former region of the Midi-Pyrénées. This is a hilly, green region with four reservoirs and numerous charming old villages and towns in the vicinity. An excellent spot to unwind in the French countryside.

High laurel hedges

The partly sloping terrain is well maintained and offers ample privacy. The pitches are spacious and partly demarcated with high laurel hedges. Slightly dated, but well maintained log cabins and mobile homes can be rented. The campsite also offers new safari tents with a beautiful view of the lake.

Swimming and sunbathing

Swimming enthusiasts will enjoy the lovely and heated campsite swimming pool with separate toddler pool and whirl pool. The pools are located in full sun and, although not very large, are adequate. Guests can make use of the loungers and dream the day away with a view of the horizon.

Entertainment for all

On the grounds you will find a playground with trampoline and a bouncing castle, a (beach) volleyball field, a mini golf terrain, table tennis tables, a jeu de boule court and bad weather provisions. Entertainment is offered in peak season, including a daily evening programme until the early hours.

Snacks and pizzas

Don't feel like cooking some days? No problem. In peak season the campsite snack bar is open and you can order snacks and pizzas. There also is daily fresh bread. Near the reception is the bar with recreational area. The village of Naucelle with a supermarket and restaurants is close by, approximately half an hour's walk away.

properties.name: Camping Municipal de Brouillet
properties.description:
On the edge of the Cevennes National Park, at the starting point of the Gorges du Tarn, you will find the Municipal de Brouillet campsite. The site is beautifully situated on the banks of the river Jonte. Here you can camp on shady pitches overlooking the surrounding limestone plateaus. The campsite is an ideal starting point to discover the beautiful nature: conquer the rocky Causses on a challenging walk or admire the beauty of the Gorges du Tarn from your canoe.

Camping with mountain view

On the green, playfully landscaped campsite, there are some 150 spacious pitches between shrubs and in the shade of trees. Some of them are situated on the banks of the river. The mobile homes, six in total, are also surrounded by trees. The view from your pitch is beautiful: the wooded mountains with their rocky peaks loom up on both sides of the site.

Adventurous campers

Camping Municipal de Brouillet attracts a varied camping public.In high season you will find many young families but also senior citizens (especially in low season) are attracted to the campsite. All campers who like a bit of adventure and nature.

Sunny swimming pool

The polygonal swimming pool, with a round paddling pool, is just outside the campsite. This pool is located on a slightly higher part, right out in the sun. A joy to swim in the warm sunshine. Again, the view of the mountains is magnificent. You can only enter the swimming pool area waring a bracelet from the campsite. Of course you can also swim and float in the river.

properties.name: Camping Platja Vilanova
properties.description:
Campsite Platja Vilanova is located at some 150 metres from the beach and the Mediterranean Sea. The sizeable family campsite is situated between Barcelona and Tarragona. Here you can experience the real Spanish holiday culture. Have a siesta in the afternoons and enjoy the long evenings with late meals and lots of entertainment. The region is not very touristy, but boasts lots of good wine.

Straight rows

The camping grounds are uncluttered and neatly maintained. There are a few tall palm and pine trees providing shade. Shade nets have been fitted above the pitches for additional shade. This campsite has mainly permanent pitches and rental accommodation, located in rows along straight pathways. There are separate parking areas for your car, so that you do not have to park on your camping pitch. 

Vamos a la playa

The distance from the entrance of the campsite to the beach is three hundred metres, only a five minute walk. The seawall has created beautiful, bowl-shaped sandy beaches, where the water remains shallow for a long time and there are only light waves. Hence, it is also ideal for young children to swim and paddle. Along the beach runs an attractive esplanade with small restaurants and bars overlooking the water. 

Different rhythm

At Platja Vilanova most people take a siesta in the afternoon. During that time not much is going on. So why not adopt this Spanish custom, so that you can enjoy the longer evenings. You will really need this, as entertainment is provided until the early hours of the morning. Besides, the restaurant on the campsite only opens at 9 p.m.

properties.name: Camping Resort Els Pins
properties.description:
Camping Resort Els Pins is a modern beach campsite in Malgrat de Mar. The campsite is located directly on the beach of the Costa Brava. You are just an hour's drive from Barcelona. Get ready for a camping holiday by the Mediterranean! You can take a dip in the sea or in the swimming pool. There are no fewer than three at the campsite. After a day on the beach, tapas will be ready for you in the campsite restaurant.

Open camping area

There is room for over 200 pitches on the spacious camping grounds, most of which are grassy. There is a small tree next to each pitch. This does not provide much shade, but the pitches are big enough for an awning or sunscreen. So enjoy your self-made shady spot or seek out the warmth of the sun.

Three pools to cool down

You can use a bit of cooling during your holiday in Spain. That should be possible at Camping Resort Els Pins. The campsite has three swimming pools. The largest pool is perfect for swimming laps. If you want to float or splash around, dive into the family pool. For the more daring there are large water slides.

To the beach every day

The coastal road is the only thing between you and the beach. Cross the road and your feet are already in the sand. So be sure to pack slippers, a bath towel and swimwear. From the campsite you can go to the beach every day. Start the day with a fresh dive in the sea. Or enjoy the long summer evenings on the beach.

properties.name: Camping Pueblo Blanco
properties.description:
Pueblo Blanco campsite is situated on the top of a hill in the Sierra de Cádiz. From many pitches you can enjoy spectacular views. This is a young campsite with neatly laid out pitches, a fine swimming pool and a restaurant with tasty local dishes. The friendly town of Olvera is about three kilometres away from this very quiet campsite.

A characteristic farmhouse

The reception is situated in a farmhouse in typical Andalusian style. This former farmhouse also has a courtyard which is now used as a outside seating area. At the other side you'll find the swimming pool. This way you immediately get in the holiday mood! You soon notice that this campsite is still young; many trees and shrubs are not fully grown yet. In various places beautiful ornamental planting and trees have been planted.

Camping with a view

Especially the pitches at the top, along the fence, offer a panoramic view of the surroundings. This promises a spectacular sunrise and sunset every day. Of course, there is some climbing involved here.. If you prefer not to do this, the campsite has plenty of nice pitches in the lower areas. The advantage is that you are closer to the swimming pool, restaurant and supermarket. Most pitches do have some shade, sometimes with the help of shade netting.

Cooling down in the swimming pool

Camping Pueblo Blanco has a fine swimming pool to cope with the heat of southern Spain. Here you can cool off and swim laps. Around the swimming pool there is a large sunbathing lawn where thatched parasols provide the necessary shade.

properties.name: Flower Camping Le Lac du Causse
properties.description:
Flower Camping Le Lac du Causse is located right on the banks of the Lac du Causse, a large lake in the Corrèze. You'll camp here on beautiful terraces overlooking the water and the hilly surroundings. Hikers, cyclists and water sports enthusiasts will enjoy this terraced campsite on the lake. The rugged, wooded shore is ideal for active campers who prefer to stay on dry land. Water sports enthusiasts can go to the water sports centre next to the campsite.

Camping with lake view

Over eighty large touring pitches have been laid out on the beautiful terraces which line the hillside on the lakeshore. The road to these terraces is easily passable. The many trees on the campsite block the view of the lake for some places, but you always look out over the surrounding hills. Most of the touring pitches, which often have a gravel surface, are shady. Many of the chalets and ecolodges also overlook the wooded landscape.

Outdoor swimming pool and water sports centre

From the campsite's outdoor swimming pool you can look out over the even larger natural pool just a few metres away; the lake. For a quick dip or a water game with the children, the swimming pool is a great place. By the way, if you fancy a french fry or a cool drink, take a seat on the pavement café next to the swimming pool. In high season this is also the scene of music and dance performances. There is a water sports centre right next to the campsite. Here you can go on the laker with a canoe, pedal boat and paddle board. Of course swimmers are also welcome to 'enter' the lake.

properties.name: Recreatiepark Den Blanken
properties.description:
Recreatiepark Den Blanken, on the border between the Achterhoek and Twente, is a very comfortable park for the over-50s and families with young children. The camping pitches are spacious and there are special camping meadows for senior citizens, close to the sanitary building. Amusement and entertainment facilities are available at the pool, the sports fields or in one of the playgrounds. There is enough to keep you busy in the vicinity of the park as well. Cycle or walk through the green environment, cast a line in the Buursebeek or take your children or grandchildren to the family fun park De Waarbeek or Klimbos Achterhoek.

Fun for the entire family

In addition to the very well-maintained facilities, Recreatiepark Den Blanken excels in entertainment opportunities. At the entrance is a tennis court as well as a jeu de boule area. Adjacent to the tennis court there is a playground for children and you will find jungle gyms or slides in the various camping areas. In the peak season, there is a very active entertainment team that organises various activities during the day for the junior campers. On a warm day you can splash in the outside pool (separate paddling pool for toddlers) with a small slide for the little ones.

"De Hoeve"

You do not have to leave for your meals and drinks. Next to the reception is a shop for the daily groceries and in the mornings you can order fresh rolls via the app. At "De Hoeve" (with outside terrace) you can enjoy a drink, a tasty snack or an ice cream.

properties.name: Village Camping Spinnaker
properties.description:
Village Camping Spinnaker lies in the south-west of Sardinia, amidst a pine tree forest by the sea. The campsite is located in the village of Torre Grande, approximately 5 km from the town of Oristano. The campsite is easy to reach via Torre Grande and is very clearly signposted.

Well illuminated campsite

The pathways on the campsite are rather narrow, but fortunately the campsite is very well illuminated at night. The camping pitches vary considerably. Many are beautifully laid out and are separated by lying tree trunks. In addition, there are wooden huts, bungalows, safari tents and apartments available for rent.

Water fun in the sea or the swimming pool

The private beach of Village Camping Spinnaker can be reached via a wooden walkway on the sand. It is a wide, white sandy beach especially for camping guests. There are sun umbrellas and loungers freely available to guests. Adjacent to the beach the campsite also has a swimming pool (with lifeguard). There is also a separate section for small children. Near the swimming pool are tables, sun umbrellas and loungers for camping guests.

Professional entertainment and sailing instruction

The professional entertainment team organises activities for young and old. They organise, for instance, sports competitions, games, karaoke and many other activities. In peak season many of these activities take place in the central square of the campsite. At Village Camping Spinnaker you can also take sailing lessons. 

Snack bar next to the swimming pool

Next to the swimming pool you will find the snack bar. Here you can buy various snacks and ice cream. You can then enjoy eating these on your lounger near the pool. In addition to pizzas, the pizzeria restaurant also offers traditional Sardinian dishes.

properties.name: Camping Verona Village
properties.description:
The Verona Village campsite opened in the beginning of 2019. The spacious camping pitches are at the edge of Verona in an urban area, but beyond it, the Veneto region is beautiful and rich in many art towns. Thanks to the motorway being nearby, the campsite is also a nice stop if you are heading toward the south of Italy. The property is laid out practically and nicely, and the friendly owners will do everything they can to offer guests a nice stay.

Lovely property

On the through road, you'll find the open, flat property that is set up primarily for campers or caravans. The modern and large reception building is located at the front of the site, by the parking area reserved for campers with a car. The gate is locked at night. The bistro is open for breakfast, and later in the day you can get a cup of coffee or a little snack on the terrace.

Comprehensive sites

In addition to the paved pitches, there is a separate zone for tent campers and a separate zone with nice caravans. Ideal for a stay if you are looking for a nice accommodation for a city trip to Verona. There are no demarcated sites on the grassy field intended for tents. The streets on which the campsites are located are broad and paved and have grass pavers.

A nice BBQ

If you want to eat in the campsite after a day in the city, you can grill your meat on the communal barbecue. It is near the terrace. There is also a small playground for kids that has a trampoline.

properties.name: Camping Pian dei Boschi
properties.description:
In the western part of the Ligurian Riviera, the so-called Flower Riviera, you will find Camping Pian dei Boschi. Here you camp on the foothills of the inland mountains, a ten minutes walk from the Mediterranean Sea. Neat terraces offer shady, somewhat small touring pitches. After hours of swimming in the spacious swimming pool you can eat a nice pizza at the pavement café opposite the swimming pool.

Shady terraces

Once you've reached the pastel yellow entrance to the campsite, you are on holiday! Palm trees, swimming pool and friendly people at the reception of Camping Pian dei Boschi create a pleasant atmosphere. A little further down the campsite are more than two hundred touring pitches. Well-kept terraces, shaded by overhanging trees, offer beautiful pitches. The touring pitches are laid out with an Italian eye for space, which means they are rather small.

Swimming between the palm trees

At the entrance, surrounded by palm trees and under the watchful eye of the white houses that fill the hills, you’ll find the large camping pool. A place for water fun for young and old. Lying on one of the sun loungers you see a colourful scene of the mandatory swimming caps.

Bar, shop and pizzeria

Opposite the pool, you can have a nice sit-down at the attractive covered pavement café. Here you can enjoy an ice cream and a refreshing drink in the shade.
