You'll also find the campsite shop here, which has a fairly extensive assortment. Next to the shop is the sidewalk café of the pizzeria, where you can enjoy a glass of wine and a good Italian pizza.

properties.name: Camping Siesta
properties.description:
Welcome to Camping Siësta, a wonderfully quiet campsite in the Antwerp Campine region. Surrounded by lovely pine forests, you camp in the middle of the countryside here. The pitches are spacious and are on grass or crushed stone. Coming with your own tent or caravan? Or would you rather enjoy more luxury in a safari tent, chalet or tiny house? You can do them all here.

Camping in the forest

At Camping Siësta, you camp in the shade of the tall conifers. At the renovated campsite, special pitches have been made for motorhomes and there is a motorhome service station. There are also spacious pitches for campers with tents and people camping in a caravan. The heated toilet block was renovated in 2021. And for campers wanting that bit of extra luxury, there are pitches with private toilet and washing facilities.

Fun and enjoyment

The campsite organises many fun activities in the high season; there is something to do every week. These range from a fun paella evening at the campsite to an active game of Archery Tag. In the surrounding forest, you can do various QR tours, follow geocoaching routes and the campsite organises a safari with their own Siësta Ranger.

Bread, drinks and tapas

Get your day off to a good start and get fresh bread from the bread vending machine at the campsite entrance. At the end of the day, you can enjoy the delicious dishes at La Cantina tapas bar. It's so quiet at this campsite that you don't (usually) have to book a table. Spanish tapas are the perfect way to end your day.

properties.name: Camping La Foce dei Tramonti
properties.description:
In the Campania region, south of the town of Salerno, lies campsite La Foce dei Tramonti at the mouth of the Sele river. This modest, small-scale campsite is situated near the famous excavations of Paestum, the ancient city with its beautiful Greek temples (UNESCO World Heritage).

Camping by the sea or the river

La Foce dei Tramonti looks very well-tended, with lots of greenery and beautiful flowering plants. You are warmly welcomed at the reception. Paved, parallel running pathways lead to the pitches at the far end of the campsite. These vary in size, but are all sufficiently spacious and partly demarcated with plants or hedges.

The most beautiful pitches are located on the promontory jutting out into the sea, but these are also the least shaded. The pitches by the river are ideal for fishing enthusiasts. There is a special area for motorhomes with a view of the sea. You can also rent a bungalow.

Enjoy the delicious regional dishes

There is a small swimming pool for young children on the campsite. The pool is surrounded by a few loungers and sun umbrellas. The sandy beach belonging to the campsite can be reached via a flight of stairs. Furthermore, there is a bar and a restaurant-pizzeria with a modest menu (take-away possible). You can go here for delicious regional dishes. The service is friendly and you can eat al fresco on a covered terrace at large wooden tables. There is also a small supermarket on the grounds.

Neat sanitary facilities

The sanitary facilities look impeccable. The showers with solar collectors are located at the front near the reception.

properties.name: Tavolara Camping Village
properties.description:
Tavolara Camping Village is located close to Olbia, the capital of Sardinia. This is a very favourable location for campers who travel by ferry to Sardinia, because Olbia is the large harbour town of the island from which many of the ferries arrive and depart. The campsite has several pitches, varying in terms of shade and demarcation. There are also separate motorhome pitches. The campsite is pleasantly car-free. Staff members drive around in electric vehicles to keep the noise levels down as much as possible.

Caravans with wooden veranda

There are several types of mobile homes with two to five beds. These are all well equipped. They have a tiled veranda with tables and chairs, covered with a wooden pergola. In addition, there are also caravans surrounded with a wooden construction and veranda. The bathroom is outside and may be private or semi-private.

Named after an island

The beach is only 500 m from Tavolara Camping Village. There is a convenient shuttle bus from the campsite to the Porto Taverna beach. This is a glorious sandy beach, the sea is crystal clear and deepens very gradually.  From the beach you overlook the narrow island of Tavolara with steep, chalk cliffs. The campsite is named after this island.

Entertainment galore

There are a number of sports and recreational facilities on Tavolara Camping Village. There is a playground and sports fields and you can play table tennis or table football. Entertainment is offered on the campsite from mid-June to the beginning of September . During this period disco evenings, cabaret and theatre shows are organised. There is a restaurant and a pizzeria for your evening meal or a quick snack.

properties.name: Flaminio Village Camping & Bungalow Park
properties.description:
Flaminio Village Camping & Bungalow park is a four-star campsite in the north of Rome, which more than deserves its stars. The campsite is magnificently situated, very charming and features a beautiful swimming pool and an excellent restaurant. In short: the perfect city campsite with de luxe facilities. The pitches are small and things can sometimes get crowded, but after all, you've come here to see Rome! You can get to the city by bus (bus stop in front of the entrance) or by bicycle (for rent at the campsite).

Your own camping caravan/tent or luxury bungalow?

There are 180 touring pitches on the campsite. The many trees offer plenty of shade on the numbered or open pitches. Not all pitches are equally nicely situated; some can also be a bit on the cramped side. People preferring lots of privacy will then do best to stay in a rental accommodation. Choose from 130 beautifully situated bungalows. These feature amenities such as bath, heat and A/C, TV, a kitchen, a veranda, loungers and a grill. And a breakfast buffet is included in the price!

Fantastic dining, drinking and swimming

You can enjoy fantastic dining in the large restaurant. There are also lots of tables outside, under colourful parasols. The small camp shop offers a limited assortment but sells fresh bread daily.

At the end of the campsite is the swimming pool with a chic vibe. All around the pool, there are sunbeds with large parasols where you can let yourself drift away. The campsite has an excellent sanitary facility that is spacious and colourfully tiled. It's even decorated with plants! You hear classical music playing all day long – very relaxing.

properties.name: Camping La Digue
properties.description:
Camping La Digue is located in the south of the Ardèche, on the banks of the river. This neat, flowery four-star campsite consists of two parts. Camp on a quiet touring pitch on the Ardèche or in a lively area, with all amenities within easy reach: an outdoor swimming pool with paddling pool, the restaurant and the central sanitary block.

Camping in the Ardèche

The flowers at the entrance can be seen all over the campsite. Here you will find 69 well-kept touring pitches, some in the shade of trees, others with a more open character. The campsite consists of two parts: Les Bastides and Les Jardins. The first part, Les Bastides is situated in a wooded area directly on the banks of the Ardèche. It is very quiet here. If you're camping in Les Jardins, you'll be on a lively spot close to all amenities. At the entrance are neat mobile homes, surrounded by flowering shrubs.

Ardèche wines

A large covered terrace, atmospheric between the grapevines and flowers, is a great place to unwind. Ans while you’re at it, choose a nice, homemade pizza or go for a more elaborate dinner. And certainly don't forget to taste the different wines from the Ardèche. In the campsite shop you can get stamps, cards and magazines, as well as fresh bread and pastries.

Ardèche Gorges

Near the bank you'll find the swimming pool. This rectangular pool is accompanied by a paddling pool. Lovely for the little ones to cool off. But of course you can also take a dip in the Ardèche. Moreover, the river is ideal for canoeing.

properties.name: Camping Valencia el Saler
properties.description:
Camping Valencia El Saler is located on the Costa del Azahar, at the edge of the village of El Saler. You camp here near the enormous lagoon of the L'Albufera national park. The expansive white sandy beaches of El Saler are within walking distance and the exciting city of Valencia is easy to reach. Whether you want to experience culture in the city, sunbathe for a day on the beach or get up and active, everything is possible in this region!

Blooming shrubs on a sunny property

The small and sunny camping pitches are separated from each other by low and higher blooming shrubs. The ground is a bit hard and sandy. About half of the pitches are intended for passers-through, the rest for return guests. The sanitary facilities are nice and well maintained. There are special amenities for the disabled. There are many wooden bungalows for hire on the property.

Lovely sandy beach

There is a lovely swimming pool with a special wading pool near the entrance. There is a sunbathing lawn and loungers around the pools for everyone who wants to soak up the sun. Swimming in the sea and sunbathing on the beach is also possible. From the campsite you can walk to the lovely kilometer long sandy beach of El Saler in only five minutes.

Restaurant with nice terrace

The campsite has a simple restaurant with a charming terrace. If you want to go shopping, you need to leave the site. There is a supermarket in El Saler about 500 m from the campsite. You'll also find lots of great restaurants in the tourist village.

properties.name: Camping Municipal de la Route d'Or
EuroParcs Poort van Maastricht
properties.description:
EuroParcs Poort van Maastricht, in the south of Limburg, is a neatly laid out family campsite in a beautiful natural area. Enjoy a peaceful holiday in nature, visit the cultural city of Maastricht or go swimming with the children in the indoor and outdoor swimming pool.

EuroParcs Poort van Maastricht is situated between Maastricht and Valkenburg, directly along the N590. This is a hilly part of the Netherlands where you can enjoy walking and cycling.

Organised

Directly from the national road, you turn into the campsite where you can park your car and caravan at the front. At the entrance you will find the reception building, the campsite shop, laundrette, sanitary building, canteen and entertainment building. Please note that sanitary facilities are open from the beginning of April.

The campsite is neatly laid out. The standard pitches and comfort pitches are laid out in rows and on separate fields. You can also rent mobile homes and chalets. At the far end of the campsite there is dog-free and car-free camping field, perfect for a peaceful camping holiday.

Swimming and sports

Close to the entrance, you will find the heated indoor swimming pool with a sliding roof. At the back of the campsite, adjacent to the playground, is a large sports field where there is always something going on. In the theatre, indoors and outdoors, children can give free rein to their creativity or enjoy nice shows.

properties.name: Santa Marina Boutique Camping
properties.description:
The Boutique Camping Santa Marina campsite is located on the Croatian peninsula of Istria. It's a luxury campsite on open terrain in a forest. Nearby, you'll find picturesque little villages, beautiful beaches and great restaurants. Still, the area is nice and peaceful. One kilometre from the campsite, you will find the village of Vabriga. You can reach the campsite by driving from Novigrad towards Poreč. Then take the exit for Vabriga/Santa Marina.

A sunny pool

On the way to your holiday spot, you can get a good look at the new campsite. The lodge tents and mobile homes are located at the rear of the site. From the mobile homes, you can dive into one of the two adjacent pools. The most luxurious mobile homes have their own jacuzzi or even a swimming pool.

If you are staying in a lodge tent or on a camping pitch, you can splash around in the campsite's sunny swimming pool. Eight hundred metres from the Boutique Camping Santa Marina campsite is a pebble beach. Walk, bike or take the shuttle bus here.

The Family Fun & BBQ zone

After a morning at the beach, it's time for entertainment! A lot of effort is made for the children. The paddling pool has a pirate ship with a slide, and there is plenty of entertainment in the high season. At the mini club, they can enjoy crafts or learn a little Croatian, for example.

Holidays also mean spending time together. You can do that at the Family Fun & BBQ zone. While you are cooking the most delicious things on the barbecue, the children can let off steam in the playground. Well done! Do you fancy an evening out for dinner? Then pull up a chair at Da Giusto restaurant.

properties.name: Camping Pyrénées Nature
properties.description:
From this campsite just outside the centre of Oloron-Sainte-Marie you can enjoy beautiful mountain views. Indeed, the Camping Pyrénées Nature campsite is located at the foot of the Pyrenees. Here, you will wake up to a view of this imposing high mountain range. The campsite is rural and well cared for. You'll find lots of greenery and large pitches. A small river runs across the campsite. The region is especially renowned for its beautiful nature and old towns with magnificent buildings.

A colourful oasis

In the spring and summer, the campsite is an oasis of flowering plants. The pitches are spacious and separated by hedges. The surface of the pitches is grass. There are two fields: the one at the front has large trees that create shade, and the one at the back is sunnier. Pyrénées Nature has a well-maintained sanitary block on both camping fields. In addition, there are chalets, bungalows and "bivouaci huts" for rent.

Cosy dining in the open air

The campsite has no swimming pool, but 250 metres away is a large pool where you can swim for a fee. In addition, you may fish in the small river that runs across the campsite. At the Pyrénées Nature campsite, you can buy local products and order bread. 300 metres away, you will find a large supermarket.

A restaurant with a small menu is open in the high season. This cosy spot is located in the open air and is covered by a tent. It also has a terrace.

properties.name: Camping Homair Domaine du Logis
properties.description:
Camping Domaine du Logis is located on the estate of a 15th-century castle in French Brittany. The historical buildings, such as the old stables, have been renovated and now serve as a restaurant or sanitary building. The swimming pool is located between the old buildings. The campsite is near La Chapelle-aux-Filtzméens, between Rennes and Saint-Malo. Take your car to visit sights such as the Mont-Saint-Michel, Cancale or Combourg. Or climb on your bicycle and follow the cycle route along the Canal d’Ille et Rance to Saint-Malo and Dinard. To explore the area from the water, you can rent a canoe near the campsite.

Grand Confort camping pitches and modern mobile homes

Family campsite Domaine du Logis is located in a wooded area and is divided into one section for campers with their own camping equipment and one section with rental accommodations. You can opt for a Grand Confort pitch, where you camp on a pitch separated by hedges and provided with electricity, water and drainage connections, or you can camp on a slightly more open field with younger vegetation.  All camping pitches are spacious and have a grass surface. 

Swimming in a castle-like setting

The swimming pool at campsite Domaine du Logis is located in the courtyard between the old outbuildings of the castle. This creates a special atmosphere. The swimming pool is heated and there is a separate section for small children. During high season you can join the aqua dance lessons which are offered several times a week. The Atlantic Ocean is roughly half an hour's drive away.

properties.name: Camping La Grappe Fleurie
properties.description:
At camping La Grappe Fleurie you'll be camping in the middle of the Beaujolais vineyards. The campsite is located in this southern part of Burgundy in the rural surroundings of the village of Fleurie, sixty kilometres above Lyon. Here you'll find spacious touring pitches in the shade of large trees, but you can also spend the night - all in style - in a wine barrel. The indoor heated swimming pool is especially fun for children.

Neat camping

The layout of the campsite is very well-organized: the touring pitches are arranged in a few rows. Between the touring pitches there are full hedges, which separate the spacious lawns. Each pitch is accompanied by a large tree, so you will always have a shady spot. Especially on the outer row the touring pitches offer a beautiful view of the vineyards.

Sleeping in a wine barrel

Compared to twenty-five rental accommodations, the almost sixty touring pitches are in the majority. Nevertheless, the range of accommodations is quite diverse. In addition to chalets, you can spend the night in a cottage tent (half cottage, half tent) and a wine barrel.

Covered and heated swimming pool

Walk all the way to the back of the campsite and you'll find the swimming. This heated swimming pool is covered, but open at the sides. Especially the children can be found in the rectangular pool, which is also suitable for swimming laps.

Simple facilities

Camping La Grappe Fleurie has many characteristics of a small-scale campsite: the spacious touring pitches, the rural location and the simple amenities. Fresh baguette is available at the reception and in the evenings during high season a food truck provides pizza. Sanitary facilities are plentiful, but a bit outdated.

properties.name: Lavanda Camping
properties.description:
Lavanda Camping is located directly by the sea, not far from Orebić . Enjoy the beautiful view of the islands off the coast, including Korčula. The relatively new campsite consists of different terraces. The campsite is situated at the foot of the 961 m high Sveti Ilija mountain. The campsite has more than seventy camping pitches. Of course, the most attractive pitches are directly by the sea, but all pitches offer a fantastic view.

Camping on a new campsite

The pitches on Lavanda Campsite vary in size (60 to 110 m2). Most of them are without shade, although the trees will provide more shade over time. All pitches are numbered and fitted with connections for electricity, water and drainage. The smallest pitches, suitable for tents, do not have such connections, but already offer a fair amount of shade.

Luxury rental accommodation

Rental accommodation comprises a few beautifully furnished mobile homes and bungalows. The Deluxe mobile homes are by the sea and have a terrace (24 m2). These are suitable for up to six people (four adults and two children). They feature satellite TV, air conditioning, a dishwasher, two bathrooms with shower/toilet and a jacuzzi on the terrace. The Premium mobile homes are located higher up on the campsite and have a slightly smaller terrace (18 m2).

Three beaches

From Campsite Lavanda you can access as many as three beaches. The main beach is located in the centre, just in front of the restaurant and the beach bar. This is perfect for families with small children. On the western part of the beach is a dedicated spot for dog lovers. On the eastern side is the nudist beach.

properties.name: Seecamping Mössler
properties.description:
In the warmest region of Austria, situated amongst the mountains, is Seecamping Mössler. This campsite is located on Lake Millstatt in Döbriach, Carinthia. The visitor is always number one at this small family campsite. The owners welcome you personally upon arrival. Fun on and around the lake will be the main focus of your holiday. And there's a pizzeria to cater to you, so you don't always have to cook.

Small is beautiful

The camping pitches are demarcated by hedges and are well maintained. There are three levels of pitches that vary in size. All amenities are nearby and the sanitary facilities are cleaned several times a day.

Are you going on a trip without camping equipment? Then stay in one of the mobile homes.

Swim in the heated pool

You'll be camping just a two-minute walk from the lake, where you can take a refreshing dip. But swimming in the heated pool is also nice. The temperature of the pool is around 28 degrees.

Lake Millstatt

The lake in Carinthia is 12 kilometres long and 1.5 kilometres wide. Here you can relax on a beautiful sandy beach. You can easily walk to the lake via a gate on the campsite. It's not even 100 metres away. Once you've arrived at the lake, you can relax and enjoy the sun from the spacious sunbathing area. You can also take part in many watersports on the lake, such as sailing, supping and fishing. The clear water is between 22 and 27 degrees. That is a wonderful temperature for taking a dive.

properties.name: Camping Belsito
properties.description:
Camping Belsito is a terraced campside amidst olive groves, beautifully situated in the Tuscany hills between the resort town of Montecatini Terme and the hill town of Montecatini Alto. Belsito has two swimming pools and if you want a bite to eat there is a restaurant as well as a supermarket.

Please note: the road to the camping is narrow in several places and has blind curves. You should therefore drive carefully and adjust your speed accordingly. You can then also enjoy the beautiful scenery on the way.

Spacious pitches

The quiet campsite has spacious pitches offering sufficient privacy and, if required, private sanitary provisions. Bungalows are also available for rent.

Swimming pool with wellness area

The campsite has two swimming pools, the largest and newest of which has a wellness area with bubble baths and massage jets with an adjacent paddling and toddler pool. Next to the swimming pool, beautifully located on the highest point of the camping, is a snackbar where you can enjoy a bite to eat and a drink. For children up to 12 there is also a playground on the campsite.

Time for a pizza?

The restaurant also offers a beautiful view, reservation in advance is required. In addition to Italian and international dishes, the restaurant also serves Tuscan specialities and pizzas from a traditional wood-fired oven. You can also order takeaway meals here. The supermarket is not large, but has all the necessities for a camper for an enjoyable stay.

Sanitary facilities

There are two sanitary blocks, one of which is new. All sanitary facilities are neat and clean and have hot water. A special feature is the dog shower.

properties.name: Camping Sènia Tucan
properties.description:
In the famous resort of Lloret de Mar, close to the beach, is Camping Sènia Tucan. You can enjoy a dip in the Mediterranean every day. The large swimming pool is the jewel in the crown of this Spanish campsite. With slides, a toddlers' pool and bubble bath the whole family can swim and bathe here. You can also relax the terrace by the swimming pool. With a refreshing drink and delicious food, your day is complete.

Shady camping pitch or modern mobile home?

A sea of flowers welcomes you as you enter the campsite. If you peek past the reception building, you can probably admire the swimming pool. Behind the swimming pool are the camping pitches: delimited pitches on sandy soil. Some of these pitches are shaded by trees, some trees are still quite young. With a bit of luck, you will get a cool, shady spot. You can also choose a modern mobile home with air conditioning.

Swimming pool, whirlpool, paddling pool

The highlight of the campsite is right at the entrance: the lovely swimming pool. There's plenty of room for everyone to take a refreshing dip. Next to the large swimming pool is a jacuzzi and paddling pool. Here the smallest swimmers can play with the crocodile and turtle. In addition to this play equipment, there are three slides.

First exercise, then relaxation

Young and old can let off steam at this campsite. On the beach football field, your children can play a game of football with all their holiday friends. Or maybe they would like to try something new. Then let them practice archery under supervision of course. In the meantime, you can work up a sweat on the fitness equipment. Finished exercising? Then relax on the sundeck by the pool.

properties.name: Camping Sènia Cala Gogo & Internacional
properties.description:
Sènia Cala Gogo is located on the Spanish Costa Brava, north of Platja d'Aro. At this large terraced campsite on the Mediterranean Sea you can enjoy a lot of luxury, such as a swimming paradise with four swimming pools, comfortable lodge tents and extensive entertainment. Although most of the touring pitches are small, the pitches and rental accommodation offer views over the Mediterranean.

The campsite is situated on the Costa Brava along a main road. This road separates the campsite from the beach and the Mediterranean Sea. If you drive into the campsite, you will find a lot of parking space at the entrance with the reception on the left.

Terraced campsite with sea view

The terraces are nicely situated against a hill. Because of this you always look out on the Mediterranean Sea. The roads on the campsite are quite steep. A strong car is therefore handy. In total you'll find no less than 670 touring pitches and almost 200 rental accommodations such as lodge tents and mobile homes.

Everything at hand

If you like an all-inclusive holiday and you like to have everything at hand, then this campsite is the perfect address. The campsite has several swimming pools, a supermarket and a bakery. You'll also find sports fields, mini-clubs and a game hall. One of the toilet blocks was renovated in 2019.

The beach of the campsite is nicely situated between the rocks. From your pitch you can walk to the beach within a few minutes. If you find the roads too busy, let the little tractor train take you there. The campsite is ideal for a beach holiday by the Mediterranean Sea.

properties.name: Camping Mare Monti
properties.description:
Mare Monti Camping is located on the Italian Riviera. Enjoy the peace and tranquillity of nature and the beautiful Ligurian coast at this family campsite between Genoa and La Spezia. The campsite is situated on a hill, affording you a beautiful view of the sea or the mountains from your pitch. The campsite is well maintained and has a swimming pool with a separate paddling pool.

A pitch with a view

Mare Monti Camping is fairly small but well tended. The pitches are situated on a gravel base, mostly in the shade of trees. These spots offer you a beautiful view. The pitches are neatly demarcated so that everyone has some privacy. You can also rent a comfortable motorhome at the campsite.

Cosy, but nice

The facilities at the campsite fall into the 'small, but nice' category. For example, the on-site market offers a limited selection, but you can order fresh rolls there. There is also a small bar with a terrace. In the summer evenings, this terrace will occasionally be the setting for a night of dancing and karaoke.

Shuttle bus to the beach

The campsite swimming pool is located next to the terrace and is a great place for a swim. There is also a separate paddling pool for the littlest campers. You can hear the sound of the sea waves in the distance. That means relaxing days on the beach! It is only two kilometres from the campsite to the sea. During the summer months, a free shuttle bus runs along the campsites to take you there.

properties.name: Überland Campotel
properties.description:
Überland Campotel is a large campsite in the Osnabrück Land, located on the outskirts of the historical town by the same name. Exercise and relaxation go hand in hand here. Explore the beautiful Teutoburg Forest by bicycle or on foot, visit the saline springs (salt walls) and take a dip in the salty water. There are various spas in the area.

A unique main building

The driveway takes you around the large, semi-circular main building. This used to be a hospital. All amenities are (centrally) located here. Here you find the reception, sanitary facilities, a fitness room, squash courts and a restaurant.

Climb on your bicycle

The area is great for cycling. Go on a relaxing cycling trip through the Teutoburg Forest on level cycling paths, or take your racing bike or mountain bike into the hills for a trip involving some serious climbing. 

Water everywhere

If you like swimming, this is the place to be. In the spas in the region you will find all kinds of salt water pools, heated pools, mud baths and mineral baths. Even a wave pool with warm, saline water. The campsite itself has a beautiful, small natural lake which is ideal for swimming on warm days. There is also a sandy beach where you can soak up the sun or play a game of beach volleyball.

properties.name: Camping La Roquette
properties.description:
Between the Provencal towns of Avignon and Saint-Rémy-de-Provence, La Roquette is an intimate family campsite with a relaxed atmosphere. With small-scale entertainment for children, an outdoor swimming pool and a friendly bar, young and old can enjoy a quiet camping holiday.

Pleasant camping

La Roquette campsite has room for around fifty touring pitches and just under twenty rental units. The terrain is quite small, although it does not feel that way. The relaxed atmosphere makes it feel more intimate and cosy. The touring pitches are spacious enough, and are separated by green hedges. Trees provide shade and flowers give the campsite a colourful sight.

Cooling dive

In summer it's not often that the sun doesn't shine in Provence, so a swimming pool on the campsite is no luxury. The pool of La Roquette is not too big, but lovely for a cooling dip. Thatched parasols around the pool add a Mediterranean touch and shrubs surround the attractive complex.

Nature reserve for running

If you like to start he day with a run, the nature reserve opposite the campsite offers various paths to make some rounds. In the afternoon you enjoy yourself on the jeu de boules court, while the children amuse themselves with the fun games of the entertainment team.

Nice restaurant

In the summer evenings, the restaurant is a great meeting place for campers. The dishes they serve there are simple, but tasty and reasonably priced.

properties.name: Camping Terme 3000
properties.description:
Camping Terme 3000 is an impressive holiday and water fun park in Slovenia, including 22 outdoor and covered swimming pools, a very steep slide and an aqua parcours. Water fun guaranteed! Furthermore, the holiday park has a wellness centre, a camping terrain and a hotel complex with golf course.

Beautiful, level grassland

The campsite consists of two sections. The oldest section, with a large number of mobile homes, looks a bit cluttered. The camping terrain with tourist pitches consists of beautiful, level grassland with young trees which offer little shade as yet. The pitches are spacious and demarcated. Some pitches are paved. Want to hire something? You have a wide choice of apartments and bungalows. Also possible: book a hotel room.

Swimming paradise

The swimming pool complex is undeniably the main attraction of this campsite. It is located at some 100 m from the campsite. Young and old can enjoy themselves for days on end in the various pools and thermal baths. There are several water slides for children, one of which is a slide with spectacular looping. There are also several toddler and paddling pools. Good to know: Life guards are on duty in many places.

Morning gymnastics and dance performances

You do not have to leave the premises for entertainment: you can bathe, splash around and steam until you are completely 'Zen-ned'. Rather do something more active? You can join morning gymnastics and aqua gym every day. There are also various sports fields and a playground. In peak season great music and dance performances are organised in the hotel.

Restaurant and shop

The à-la-carte restaurant offers excellent dishes. You will enjoy the view of the swimming pool complex from there. There are also several snack bars on the campsite. You can do your shopping in a small supermarket, where fresh bread is available daily.

properties.name: Camping Bled
properties.description:
Camping Bled is situated directly at the lake of the same name in the Julian Alps. You camp here in the north of Slovenia. Bled is a tourist attraction because of its unique location by the lake. You have a view of a small island in the middle of the lake on which stands a picturesque small church.

Spectacular route and attractive view

The last four km to the campsite lead over a scenic road, first through the village of Bled, thereafter along the lake. The campsite is located between two mountains in an elongated valley with lots of vegetation. The campsite slopes gently upwards with a few terraces. The higher you are, the more beautiful the view. 

Diversity of accommodation

On the campsite you can rent lodge tents (glamping), unique trekker huts and very modern mobile homes. The lodge-tents are found on the edge of the forest. The latter are particularly striking. They are located on a separate, very quiet section of the campsite. They have a wood-fired tub to bathe in. 

Swimming and other activities

Obviously, you will be swimming in Lake Bled. The lake looks splendid and from the bathing resort you have a spectacular view of the lake and the surrounding mountains. There is a sunbathing lawn with nice play equipment for children. You can go on great walking trips directly from the campsite. Furthermore, on the campsite you can play beach volleyball, basketball, soccer and badminton.

Slovenian wines

Feeling peckish? In addition to the usual tourist dishes, the camping restaurant menu also offers many regional specialities. These taste even better with a lovely Slovenian wine.

properties.name: Camping Terme Ptuj
properties.description:
Camping Terme Ptuj consists of two sections: one section with four or five camping pitches grouped together, demarcated with hedges and a second section under the trees with non-demarcated pitches. The campsite is within walking distance (approx. 1 km) of Ptuj. This town is beautifully located between the high hills of Pohorje and the lowlands of the Drava river. You camp here in the vicinity of the wine area between Ormož and Ljutomer.

Unique rental accommodation

On the campsite you can rent the usual mobile homes (with air conditioning), but you can also rent one of the wine barrels which have been converted into glamping-accommodation. A unique overnight accommodation suitable for two persons. The barrels are remarkably comfortable. They are grouped around a communal fire pit, lovely for relaxing at night.

Water fun and more

The swimming facilities are exceptionally beautiful, with several cold water pools and thermal pools (outdoor and indoor). There are also water slides and you can get snacks from the bar on the terrace. The swimming pools can be accessed from the campsite with a badge. There are also saunas and whirlpools. You can also make use of the wellness programme. The Drava river flows within walking distance. There are regular water activities for children. They also amuse themselves with the wide range of play equipment. At night there is often live music. 

Food and drink

There is a snack bar near the swimming pools. Make a selection from the small menu. The self-service restaurant and the à la carte restaurant are beautifully and luxuriously furnished, with tasty dishes and perfect service. The camping shop is rather small, but you will find sufficient shops and supermarkets in Ptuj.

properties.name: Bungalow Camping Baciccia
properties.description:
On the Ligurian Riviera, the Italian coast west of Tuscany, lies Bungalow Camping Baciccia. Here you will camp on a green campsite between houses, just one kilometre from the Mediterranean Sea. Although the touring pitches can feel a little cramped, you can pitch under tall trees, never far from the large swimming pool. There is a good restaurant with authentic Italian dishes.

Camping under the trees

Tall trees fill the campsite and create shady spots. The 110 touring pitches, with a gravel base, are shady and - by Italian standards - spacious enough. However, there will be plenty of campers who prefer a bit more space. Choose one of the modern rental accommodations: a appartment overlooking the pool or one of the bungalows.

Pool

At the campsite, they have clearly done their best on the swimming pool. The large outdoor pool is located at the side of the campsite and is surrounded by a sun deck with deckchairs. The pool is spacious, especially for the number of guests the campsite can have. Next to the pool is a paddling pool and a playground.

Mediterranean Sea

properties.name: Holiday Village Florenz
properties.description:
Holiday Village Florenz is situated in the north of Italy. The campsite is separated from the sea by only a few hills. Would you like to paddle in the sea every day and enjoy delicious pizzas? Then this is the place to be! And your favourite four-legged friend is welcome too, because the campsite has a special beach for dogs. You will find Holiday Village Florenz in the village of Lido degli Scacchi, next to Lido di Pomposa.

Well-maintained

The campsite grounds are varied and well-maintained. First check in with the friendly reception staff and then head off to your pitch or accommodation. On the way, you will pass by a number of facilities, such as the shop and one of the restaurants. There are two restaurants at this campsite: one on the campsite grounds and one on the beach.

Camping under the trees

Holiday Village Florenz has many shady pitches under trees and various types of mobile homes. The campsite is very suitable for families with young children, but older guests will also have a great time here. There is a swimming pool, a wellness centre and several sports fields.

Children's clubs, musicals and beach parties

There is plenty to do for children at this campsite! There is a mini club, a junior club and an extensive playground. For the little ones, there is even a baby room with all sorts of games. There is also a babysitter (on request), so you can relax in the wellness area. In the evening, let yourself be carried away by musicals, cabaret and karaoke. And in the summer, you can dance the night away at the beach party!

properties.name: Country Camping Schinderhannes
properties.description:
Country Camping Schinderhannes is a largely wooded terraced campsite, located on a lake. It is situated south-east of the village of Hausbay. The camping pitches are spacious, have a grass surface and offer ample shelter. There is always plenty to do, both on the campsite and in the area.

Large, wooded grounds

The grounds of Camping Schinderhannes cover a large area. There are no less than 200 touring pitches. From the reception, you follow the gravel paths to the camping meadow where your pitch is located. There are a few trees and the perimeter is bordered by a hedge of trees and bushes. Most pitches, therefore, have a 'back cover' of green foliage. A few pitches offer a lot of shade.

Charming restaurant and fresh rolls

Motorhome owners are also welcome, either on the campsite or off the grounds. If you wish, you can rent a touring caravan. You do not have to cook yourself: there is an attractive restaurant with a menu which offers ample choice. The campsite has a small shop where you can buy essential foodstuffs and fresh bread is available in the morning.

Plenty to do

You will never get bored here. The area is eminently suited for walking and cycling. Inform yourself about enjoyable routes at the reception. The zoo in Bell with tigers and raccoons is a lot of fun for children.

properties.name: Camping Den Molinshoeve
properties.description:
Would you like to enjoy a holiday on both the Dutch and Belgian coast? Then head to the Den Molinshoeve campsite in Zeelandic Flanders. The beach of Cadzand-Bad is just a ten-minute walk from the campsite, and the Belgian coast town of Knokke-Heist can be reached within twenty minutes by car.

Camping in the polder

Camping Den Molinshoeve is a small-scale campsite with a friendly atmosphere. It is the ideal place for campers who want to spend their holidays close to the Dutch coast. The campsite is very green and the pitches are spread out over multiple grassy fields. The wide sandy beach at Cadzand-Bad is naturally a wonderful place to go for long walks with your dog. That's why dogs are welcome at the Den Molinshoeve campsite! Please note: no more than two dogs are allowed per camping pitch. And they should be on a leash at all times, even when they're on your pitch.

Plenty of fun and games!

There are two playgrounds where the children can spend hours enjoying themselves. Or they can pedal around on one of the toy tractors or go-karts. And there is also a table tennis table! The shed houses a comfortable space where children can play board games, draw or watch a video. And a game of pétanque will make your holiday complete!

Sanitary facilities with rain shower

The sanitary facilities are very clean and modern. The showers are equipped with rain showerheads and have a thermostatically controlled tap so you can adjust the temperature yourself. Would you rather have the comfort and convenience of your own bathroom? In that case, book a camping pitch with private sanitary facilities.

properties.name: Baia Holiday Camping Village Roma Capitol
properties.description:
Baia Holiday Camping Village Roma Capitol is located between Ostia and Rome, in a quiet wooded area. This large campsite is laid out in a scenic area with tall pine trees. There are all kinds of sports facilities and beautiful swimming pools. With the excavations of Ostia Antica within walking distance and Rome close by this campsite is an excellent starting point to get acquainted with Roman culture.

Extensive campsite

On the vast campsite, the pitches are arranged in rows along the straight paths. The seven hundred touring pitches are numbered but not separated from each other. When busy you have little privacy on your spot.

Luxury swimming pools

There are three heated outdoor pools on the campsite: a competition pool, a shallow recreational pool and a paddling pool. The pools are stylishly laid out on a sun deck, from where you have a beautiful view of the surrounding pine trees. The complex gives a luxurious impression and has not been made especially attractive for children. For example, there are only a few pieces of playground equipment or slides.

Open for a limited time

Baia Holiday Camping Village Roma Capitol has beautiful sports facilities. During the season, there are entertainment programmes for children, teenagers and adults. The campsite has a supermarket, a pizzeria and an attractive bar. Whether these facilities are open depends on the number of guests at the campsite. In low season most facilities are closed anyway. This also applies to the sanitary facilities, which are brand new and very luxurious. There are nine toilet blocks, in low season often only one is open.

properties.name: Baia Holiday Baia Blu La Tortuga
properties.description:
Camping Village Baia Blu La Tortuga is a campsite in Aglientu, Olbia-Tempio, located by the sea and in a wood.This terraced camp site has which are marked out, pitches with shade, pitches without shade and pitches with some shade. Camping Village Baia Blu La Tortuga is located close to a sandy beach. It is possible to rent caravans, mobile homes, Studios and bungalows. The campsite has a playground and a sports ground. Since 2018, the campsite has a new swimming paradise.

The following rules apply to pets at (Camping Village Baia Blu La Tortuga):                                     - Dog(s) permitted in low season (if on a lead) - Dog(s) permitted in high season (if on a lead)

For sportive holidaymakers the camp site offers excursion programmes. There is a fitness room. The camp site has a new swimming paradise (2018). You can swim nearby in the sea. At Camping Village Baia Blu La Tortuga you can go snorkelling, windsurfing and waterskiing.

You don't always have to cook, as the camp site has a snack bar, pizzeria, self service restaurant and restaurant (with full menu). The camp site also supplies fresh bread. You can also use the internet, as the camp site has one or more computers with an internet connection and there is a WiFi point.

properties.name: Baia Holiday Mare Pineta
properties.description:
The family camping Camping Village Mare Pineta extends on a cliff, high above the Sistiana Bay. Here you will enjoy the glorious view of the Adriatic Sea. You will find the sea, the forest as well as Triëst in close vicinity. The area is characterised by splendid views, a beautiful bay and cliffs. On the camping grounds are several amenities like a restaurant, a supermarket and a disco. In the weekends you can also enjoy the music in the restaurant (until 01:00).

Terraced campsite with sea view

The camping pitches on the terraces are well maintained. Keep in mind that they have a hard surface and limited privacy. The demarcated pitches measure between 80 and 100 m2. You can choose a pitch with or without shade. A higher fee is applicable for a pitch with sea view. 

Lovely swimming pool and whirlpool

Everyone will enjoy the large swimming pool (576 m2). You can also make use of the whirlpool and the sunbathing lawn. Toddlers have their own pool in which they can safely play.  In high season there is an entertainment programme for children in several languages (English, German, Spanish and Italian) as well as a mini club.

Take the train to the beach

You can walk down a demanding footpath to the sea. In high season you can take the small train or bus to the grassy and pebble beach. Here you can engage in snorkelling, windsurfing, white-water rafting, kayaking and rafting. Windsurfing and sailing courses are also offered. Camping guests have free access to the beach.

properties.name: Baia Holiday Laguna Blu
properties.description:
On the west coast of the island of Sardinia, between the sea and a natural lagoon, lies Camping Village Laguna Blu. On this large four star campsite you'll camp under the pine and eucalyptus trees. The terrain is well laid out and clearly structured, with straight paths and spacious pitches. The campsite is a real holiday village, with all the facilities you could wish for.

Sea and lagoon

Camping Village Laguna Blu is located at the tip of headland between the lagoon of Calik and the Mediterranean Sea. The beach is less than twenty metres from the campsite; all you have to do is cross the road. The narrow white sandy beach stretches almost continuously as far as Alghero, a beautiful harbour town two kilometres south of the campsite.

Swimming paradise

For a day of splashing about you can also visit the water park on the campsite. It has recently been constructed and is completely environment-friendly. The large outdoor swimming pool consists of several beautiful lagoons. Next to it is a large paddling pool with all kinds of fun water sprinklers, play equipment and slides. In short, a complete water playground.

Sporty holidays

You won't get bored on this campsite, because you can practice almost all forms of water sports and water recreation. Surfing, sailing, snorkelling, scuba diving ... There are also boats and accompanying equipment for hire on the campsite. If you're not such a water rat, you can let off steam in the gym or practice your swing on the golf course. There are all kinds of cycling and walking routes in the area, and in high season there are even hiking tours organised from the campsite.

properties.name: Baia Holiday Isuledda
properties.description:
Centro Vacanze Isuledda is located on the east coast of Sardinia, directly on a bay of the Mediterranean Sea. Here you can camp on a pitch by the water, overlooking the La Maddalena archipelago and the hilly landscape on the other side of the bay. The car-free area of this large campsite includes 650 pitches and almost 250 mobile homes, lodge tents and bungalows.

Private beaches

This campsite is ideal for beach lovers and water sports enthusiasts. The campsite has a small private beach with sunbathing area, some pitches have the luxury of a tiny beach on your doorstep. If you really want to lie down in the sand or swim in the sea, you can go right next to the campsite. Here you will find a larger and longer beach. Water sports enthusiasts don't have to go far either: there's a sailing and diving school on the campsite.

Massages and musicals

There is plenty to do at the campsite. The facilities are extensive and the entertainment program filled. At the wellness centre, located on the water's edge, you can let all the stress slip away during a massage or sauna visit. Don't forget to drink, for example in the Bio Café, which overlooks the sea. The amphitheatre at the entrance to the campsite and the stage near the beach are often the scene of musicals, (children's) disco and shows, especially during summer evenings.

Cosy restaurant

In fact, you don't have to leave the campsite. Everything you need is there. In the campsite shop you can get your daily groceries and for an evening out you are welcome in the cosy restaurant.

properties.name: Baia Holiday Cavallino
properties.description:
Centro Vacanze Cavallino is located in a pine forest directly on the beach on the Cavallino-Treporti peninsula. This peninsula is enclosed by the Lagoon of Venice and the Mediterranean Sea. The beach beckons when you are on holiday here: choose a deck chair or take a dip in the sea.

Camping in the shade

A large part of the campsite is covered by a pine forest, so many of the pitches enjoy shade. Only the row of pitches closest to the beach is just outside the forest. With no less than 560 pitches, this is a very large campsite. The almost 370 lodge tents (SunLodges), bungalows and apartments are not even taken into account.

Frog slide

Among the attractions of the campsite, for young and old, are the swimming pools. These round pools, situated on a sunny spot, include whirlpools. The smaller swimmers can go crazy in the spacious paddling pool with a large frog slide. The children can also spend their energy in the small indoor playground or during one of the games of the entertainment team.

Shops and restaurants

In the supermarket you can get fresh bread, fruit and vegetables daily. And in the campsite shop you can buy all kinds of camping and holiday items (hats, jewellery, towels). Of course a pizzeria is a must in Italy. On the higher terrace, overlooking the coast, you can enjoy a delicious pizza. But the outdoor café on the ground floor is also a great place to enjoy an Italian specialty in the sun.

properties.name: Baia Holiday Poljana
properties.description:
Camping Village Poljana is located in a unique location on the Croatian island of Lošinj. This large campsite borders on of the Adriatic Sea on two sides. The campsite is laid out in terraces in the pine forest. Most pitches have a magnificent view of the bay and the surrounding islands.

Camping with sea view

Camping Village Poljana is a large terraced campsite. The campsite is well maintained, with paved paths and mostly flat terraces. There are over five hundred touring pitches. The pitches are separated from each other by natural vegetation. Most pitches overlook the Adriatic Sea. In addition to touring pitches, the campsite also has pitches for camper vans. In addition, there are rental accommodations: mainly mobile homes, but also bungalows and a number of lodge tents.

Crystal clear water

Camping Village Poljana borders on both sides on the crystal clear sea. There is a marina on the southwest side of the campsite. The pitches on this side directly by the sea have their own mooring buoy. On the northeast side of the campsite there is a V-shaped bay with narrow beaches made up of rocks, sand and pebbles. It is a public beach, part of which is reserved for nudists. On the beach there are showers and a nice beach volleyball court

For real water rats

In the sea around the campsite you can not only swim, but it is so clear it lends itself especially well to scuba diving and snorkeling. Windsurfing, water-skiing and sailing are also allowed. If you like entertainment, you will also be well catered for at Camping Village Poljana. From May to September there is a varied entertainment programme for children, teenagers and adults.

properties.name: Baia Holiday Capo d'Orso
properties.description:
Attention water sports enthusiasts and beach lovers: from your camping pitch at Camping Village Capo d'Orso, the Mediterranean Sea is just a few steps away. This large campsite is located directly on the west coast of Sardinia. Its private beach is the ideal spot for campers who like to explore the beach and the sea.

Pitches on the beach

Most rental accommodations are situated around the reception building. The bungalows, with their terracotta-coloured walls entirely in Italian style, are new and luxurious. There are also two other types of mobile home. The only disadvantage of these accommodations may be that they are located quite far from the sea.

The pitches are relatively closer to the beach. Especially when you camp on the pitches at the bottom of the hill, you're standing with your feet in the sand. You camp on a hard surface, and everywhere you can find a spot with shade. The view over the sea or the mountains on the other side of the bay is a big plus.

In the Sardinian sun

Sporty campers can go to the side of the campsite. There are several sports fields, where you can sweat in the Sardinian sun during a game of football, tennis or volleyball. Behind the reception building and the restaurant is a small open-air theatre, where performances are held and children can rehearse dances.

Fish dishes and beach balls

The restaurant in front of the campsite has a large menu. Of course you can't miss fish dishes, but grill dishes are also on the menu. For quick snacks and takeaway meals you can go to the bar, where they also serve tasty drinks.

properties.name: Camping Al Lago
properties.description:
Camping Al Lago is situated on a beautiful spot on Lake Ledro, the little brother of Lake Garda. This friendly family campsite is suitable for those looking for peace and quiet, hikers, water sports enthusiasts, families with children. In short: friendly for everyone. Although the touring pitches are a bit small, you'll be comfortable on the campsite. The most beautiful spots offer a view of the lake. Also from the pavement café near the restaurant you look out over the water.

Camping pitch by the lake

The friendly welcome makes you feel right at home at the campsite. The relatively small scale also contributes to this. As a touring camper you have found your place on this campsite at Lake Ledro. The rental accommodations are at the front of the campsite, you can also stay in one of the apartments in the chalet.

The rest of the campsite is for touring campers. The site isn't very large, so the ninety touring pitches are a bit on the small side. However, this is not strange in Italy. On the other hand, you do have a beautiful view over Lake Ledro. Especially if you manage to get one of the pitches directly at the lake.

Italian wines and a wood oven pizza

With an Italian flair the staff of Camping Al Lago serves its guests in the restaurant. The chalet's main entrance takes you into the attractive restaurant. Take a seat at one of the wooden tables for an Italian wine, a pizza from the wood oven or a regional dish. From the partly covered patio you look out over the campsite and the lake.

properties.name: Glavotok Premium Green Camp
properties.description:
On the west coast of the Croatian island of Krk is Camping Glavotok. Surrounded by pine trees and right by the sea, this is a great place for couples, families and other holidaymakers who like peace and quiet. From the campsite, you can walk straight into the sea for a refreshing dip. Here you will discover several bays and beaches. The rest of the island also has plenty to do and see, such as wine town Vrbnik or you can take a relaxing boat trip.

Wide choice of camping pitches and accommodation

There are various types of pitches at this campsite. Choose a spot close to the beach, or a quiet spot among the trees. Those who prefer more comfort choose a mobile home, bungalow or simple villa. These are practically furnished with plenty of privacy and often with sea views.

Family-friendly camping

The campsite has all the modern conveniences: a heated swimming pool with children's area and pool bar, a restaurant serving local food, sports fields - basically everything you need for a comfortable holiday.

But what makes the campsite special is its easy access to numerous beaches. Quiet bays with spots for snorkelling and even a dedicated dog beach. Find a quiet spot to soak up the sun with your partner, or choose a more lively setting on the central beach. Fancy an activity? Then hire a kayak or SUP or sign up for a jump into the deep end at the diving school.

properties.name: Camping Ugljan Resort
properties.description:
This campsite is located on the Croatian island of Ugljan, just five kilometres from the town of Zadar on the mainland. Ugljan is a not too touristy island with unspoilt nature and many hidden beaches where you can swim in the crystal clear sea. The Ugljan Resort Campsite is located on a small bay on the island's west side. You can enjoy beautiful sunsets here in the evening, where the sun slowly sinks between the surrounding islands.

Inviting grounds with vegetable gardens and lots of greenery

After arriving at the campsite, the enthusiastic reception team will welcome you in a friendly manner. Like the reception building, the campsite itself has a new and inviting character. Various large and small (olive) trees provide enough shade. Nice vegetable gardens have also been laid out between the camping pitches, where tomatoes and cucumbers grow, among other things.

Cool off in the bio pool or the sea

In a sunny spot, centrally on the site, you will find the beautiful biodesign swimming pool this campsite has. A bio swimming pool like this looks a lot like a swimming pond but offers the luxury of a swimming pool. This outdoor pool is shallow and has gently sloping sides. Ideal for children! Around the pool, the many sun loungers and thatched umbrellas provide plenty of space for relaxation.

Visit Beach Bites, the cosy beach club

The campsite has its own restaurant on Suha beach: Beach Bites. Plenty of tasty drinks are available here, as well as snacks and even complete meals, such as burgers, pizzas and salads.

properties.name: Campingpark Eifel
properties.description:
Located in the picturesque landscape of the Eifel, Campingpark Eifel offers an ideal destination for nature lovers and families who want to enjoy peace and space. The campsite is located on the outskirts of the charming village of Waxweiler, surrounded by vast wooded areas and hills. You camp here on spacious pitches or sleep in a luxury holiday home.

Spacious pitches and luxury holiday homes

Campingpark Eifel has spacious pitches of 80 m2 or 100 to 120 m2, both in the sun and in the shade. There are also paved pitches for motorhomes with an electricity connection and water supply.

In addition to pitches, you can also rent an accommodation at Campingpark Eifel. Choose from among comfortable mobile home or luxury holiday homes. The accommodations are furnished with all of the modern conveniences.

Large heated outdoor swimming pool

The campsite has various amenities for the sports-loving holidaymaker, such as a multi-functional playing field for football, volleyball and basketball. There is also a table-tennis table and a jeu-de-boule court. Children will have the time of their lives in the adventurous playground and an entertainment team provides entertainment in the high season. The heated outdoor swimming pool with a separate paddling pool is perfect for cooling off on hot days.

The oldest city in Germany

The area surrounding Waxweiler is ideal for walking and cycling tours. The many routes laid out take you past picturesque villages, vast meadows and dense wooded areas. The Eifelsteig, one of the best-known hiking trails in Germany, passes close to the campsite. For cyclists, there are numerous well-maintained paths that wind through the varied landscape. Visit the neighbouring cities of Trier (54 km) and Bitburg (25 km) as well.

properties.name: Camping Les Vernières
properties.description:
Camping Les Vernières is located on the banks of the Dordogne. You'll be camping on spacious, well-maintained touring pitches or in one of the exceptional rental properties, such as a yurt. With a an indoor, heated swimming pool, cuddly donkeys and a large playground, this is truly a family campsite. The surrounding area is a paradise for hiking. For example, climb the highest peak of the Massif Central.

Welcome!

When you swap the A71 for the A89 at Combronde, you are already driving towards the 'dômes', the dome-shaped mountains of the Massif Central. Take exit 25 at Saint-Julien-Puy-Lavèze in the direction of La Bourboule. When you have reached La Bourboule, you are in the middle of the domed mountains, in the valley of the Dordogne.

Adventurous rental accommodations

Les Vernières has 165 flat and spacious touring pitches, situated on well-maintained lawns, separated by hedges or shrubs. A small disadvantage: between the river and the campsite there is a road. The touring pitches along this road may have some trouble with noise. The campsite has 19 rental accommodations. In addition to chalets and bungalows, you can stay in an ecolodge or an ecological hut. Or choose a yurt for a very adventurous holiday.

Being active outdoors

A large playground, trampoline and bouncy castle guarantee hours of fun. Small campers can also have fun in the covered and heated swimming pool. And you are only twelve kilometres away from the highest peak of the Massif Central: the Puy de Sancy. Suitable for hikers of all levels. Walk along waterfalls and through flowering meadows.

properties.name: Camping Azzurro
properties.description:
Camping Azzurro is situated directly on Lake Ledro in the mountainous landscape of Northern Italy. You are camping here just northwest of Lake Garda. This area is a wonderful place for water sports enthusiasts, hikers and mountain bikers. But this campsite is also suitable for those who like to sunbathe and swim. Enjoy the Italian life: drink a cocktail and enjoy the view. The children will enjoy themselves in the swimming pool or one of the playgrounds.

Camping by the lake

Many camping guests find their way to the campsite every year. On the campsite you will find many permanent annual pitches. In addition, there are plenty of touring pitches to choose from. These pitches are not all the same size, but they do look neat. The nicest ones are by the lake. From there, the view of the water and the mountains is magnificent. Do you prefer a luxury holiday? Then the modern mobile homes (with kitchen, bathroom and air conditioning) are for you.

Splashing and playing

Children are also catered for at Camping Azzurro. Every day they will want to jump in the swimming pool. Children can also play in the playgrounds. Sliding, climbing and swinging; it's all possible while overlooking the lake.

Start the day with breakfast; end it with a cocktail

Start the day off right with breakfast! In the little restaurant at the entrance, they will take care of it for you. You can also go there for a quick lunch. And do you want to end the day with a nice drink? Then you have plenty of choice in the restaurant. Enjoy a cocktail while challenging your fellow campers to a game of table football.

properties.name: Is Arenas Camping Village
properties.description:
Is Arenas Camping Village is on the west coast of the lovely Italian island of Sardinia, near the historic towns of Cuglieri and Oristano. The campsite lies on the "Spiggia di Is Arenas", a long beach with golden sand, surrounded by dunes and forests. This is a lovely destination for seekers of peace and quiet and families that are looking for an authentic part of Sardinia, away from the hustle and bustle. The campsite has a fine restaurant.

Camping between pine trees

The campsites are located in the forest and are not demarcated, so the pitches vary in size and amount of shade. A great place to hang up a hammock to laze about or read in the hottest hours. There are also bungalows available for rent at Is Arenas Camping Village. The sanitary facilities are nice and the campsite is particularly dog-friendly. So dogs may go on the beach and there are dog showers.

Entertainment for all

From the beginning of June to the beginning of September, the little ones can play in the mini club and there are activities for older children. The entertainment is good, but not over the top. There is also a playground, table tennis table and multi-sports field. There is an above-ground swimming pool, modest in size, but a nice place to splash around.

Beach fun

For plenty of water fun, just walk along the path to the beach, only two hundred metres from the campsite. For real relaxation, rent loungers and sun umbrellas. The beach slopes gradually, so the kids can safely play in the water.

properties.name: Camping Village Baia Paradiso
properties.description:
Ready for a real beach holiday? Then choose the Camping Village Baia Paradiso campsite! This campsite is located near Li Junchi beach: one of the largest beaches in Sardinia. Clear your head on a walk along the beach or let the children build a big sandcastle.

Blue, yellow or green?

At this cosy campsite, you can choose from among the spacious pitches. These are indicated by colours: blue (four-person), yellow (six-person) or green (six-person). You can also choose from one of the accommodations: rooms, apartments, chalets and mobile homes.

Good food on the terrace

The campsite has a restaurant with a nice open terrace where you can eat delicious meals. Or prepare your own food at the communal barbecue area. You can even pick herbs from the herb garden of the Camping Village Baia Paradiso campsite. The campsite also has a small supermarket.

Water sports paradise

Camping Village Baia Paradiso is a small slice of heaven for true water sports enthusiasts. You can even camp less than a kilometre from the beach. Here you can surf, paddle surf and swim. You can take surfing lessons at the surf school in Badesi.

Sea or pool?

Do you think the sea water is still a bit too chilly? Then take a dip in one of the outdoor pools. The Camping Village Baia Paradiso campsite has no less than two outdoor pools! They are in the sun and surrounded by a meadow with sun beds.

Entertainment

Entertainment at the campsite is provided by a theatre company. During the day, you can participate in aerobics or various games on the beach. Meanwhile, the kids can have fun playing at the Kids Club. In the evening, there are several performances in the campsite's amphitheatre.

properties.name: Camping Les Loges
properties.description:
On the banks of the river Allier, in the hilly surroundings of the Auvergne, you will find Les Loges campsite. You camp here on a flat and quiet terrain, not far from the A75 motorway. This makes campsite Les Loges a suitable transit campsite. Take a dip in the outdoor swimming pool (with water slide and paddling pool) and have a snack on the large covered sidewalk café.

On the banks of the Allier

In contrast to the hilly surroundings, the campsite is flat. Large lawns provide spacious touring pitches, delimited by hedges. Many pitches are on open field, only a few are in the shade. Some of the touring pitches are situated on the banks of the Allier. Only a row of trees separates you from the river. The pitches overlook the surrounding hills of the Puy-de-Dôme. Mobile homes and lodge tents complete the camping offer.

Swimming pool with slide

After a long trip, a cool dip in the pool is no luxury. You find the spacious outdoor pool on a sunny spot at the entrance. For the youngest children the paddling pool is extra fun; the slightly older children will not be able to get away from the large water slide.

Conviviality at the sidewalk café

The facilities on the campsite are quite simple, but all are well-taken care of. Next to the swimming pool is the restaurant. The sidewalk café is regularly the stage for musical performances and bingo drives. This conviviality can sometimes continue until late. If you don't like that, make sure you have a spot close to the river. It's nice and quiet there.

properties.name: Camping Röse
properties.description:
The Camping Röse campsite is located on the south side of Lake Maggiore, near the villages of Domelletto and Dormello. The campsite's private beach, which guests are allowed to use, is beautiful. Here you can camp under large trees, so you can always seek shelter from the Italian sun. The atmosphere at the campsite is friendly and the entertainment modest. Here you are located about a five-minute drive from Arona, a real attraction!

Cosy camping

You will find yourself here at a small, quiet campsite with thirty touring pitches and about the same number of permanent pitches. The size varies quite a bit from place to place. Overall, there is little demarcation. However, there are plenty of trees to provide shade. There are also about thirty accommodations for rent, including mobile homes, lodges and tents.

Water fun and more

You will experience this to the fullest at the campsite itself and in the lake. In the sunny pool (80 m2) with a whirlpool, you can splash around to your heart's content. There are also some sun loungers and parasols available. But the real attraction, of course, is Lake Maggiore. Swimming, diving, fishing, surfing, sailing, boating. Is there anything that isn't possible? You can dry off on a towel on the campsite's private beach. Other events and activities are organised by an entertainment team, such as disco evenings.

Eating and drinking

Camping Röse has a cosy restaurant with a bar and a terrace under the trees. Having a drink on the terrace is extra fun, as you can enjoy views of the beach and lake. The campsite doesn't have a shop, but in the immediate vicinity, you will find a large supermarket.

properties.name: Sivinos Camping Boutique
properties.description:
Sivinos Camping Boutique is located on the west coast of Lake Garda. The panoramic view over the water is magnificent from this campsite. Camp on pitches with grassy surface that overlook the beautiful lake. But you can also look out over the water from the patio. With a good glass of wine, the view is even more beautiful. Lake Garda offers possibilities for every water lover. Swim in the lake or take a diving lesson with the children. For a beautiful trip across the lake, you can get on the ferry.

Pitch with panorama

The west coast of Lake Garda is mountainous. This is reflected in the campsite's terrain. The terrain is slightly sloping. Nevertheless, it is no problem to pitch your caravan or tent. The pitches are nice and flat and spacious. You stand on the grass and with a bit of luck under a big tree.

The grassy areas and trees give the campsite the feel of a park. Each pitch has its charm and advantages, but especially the pitches directly by the lake offer a beautiful panorama. Waking up every day to such a beautiful view: that is ultimate enjoyment.

Patio on the waterfront

It's above all the peace and quiet that camping guests of Sivinos Camping Boutique seek. You'll find peace and quiet everywhere on the campsite. Even on the lovely patio on the waterside. Take a seat under a parasol, between the trees and the blossoms. Enjoy the view and a large glass of Italian wine. Are you hungry? Then you can order a sandwich or snack here.

properties.name: Lago Idro Glamping Boutique
properties.description:
This campsite, located in the beautiful village of Anfo, is an ideal place for those seeking tranquillity and comfort on the shores of Lake Idro. Thanks to its fantastic location, Lago Idro Glamping Boutique offers you beautiful panoramic views and is an excellent base for mountain and water sports enthusiasts of all levels. This is not only a fantastic place in the summer, but you can also go here for a unique glamping experience during the winter. Families, couples, sports enthusiasts and peace seekers - everyone quickly feels at home here.

Glamping for everyone

The journey to the campsite is already a holiday in itself. After taking a scenic route through the mountains, you will suddenly find yourself driving along the shores of Lake Idro. The small-scale campsite is newly built, which is reflected in the modern facilities, among other things. Choose one of the comfortable pitches for campers, caravans or tents, or stay in a luxurious accommodation such as a mobile home or a tipi tent.

Bubbles and more

The blue reflective waters of Lake Idro naturally invite you to take a refreshing dip. If you walk 150 metres, you'll reach a fine pebble beach where you can enter the water. But for those who prefer to swim in a pool, there is a small but nice swimming pool on the campsite. Go down the waterslide, relax in the hot tub, or enjoy the sun and a good book on one of the sun loungers. More active people can go pedal boating, windsurfing or paddle boarding on the lake.

properties.name: Weekend Glamping Resort
properties.description:
On a hill on the west side of the beloved Lake Garda, among the olive trees and with beautiful views over the bay of Salò, lies this lovely family campsite. Entertainment for the whole family is available on the beautifully landscaped grounds. Think of heated outdoor pools, extensive entertainment programmes, playgrounds and a cosy restaurant. From Weekend Glamping Resort, you can walk down a 400-metre path to get to the lake.

Luxury pitches and glamping accommodations

As you enter the campsite, you will quickly notice that this is an excellently organised and cleverly laid-out site with lots of greenery. There are various types of camping pitches available in different sizes. From some places, you have a wonderful view of the bay. The same is true of some of the glamping rental properties.

A lovely water park with a bay view

This campsite has a beautiful water park consisting of several pools. Here, you can cool off or participate in water aerobics. In addition, you'll have a great time in the playfully landscaped lagoon, the water slide, the two whirlpools and the special paddling pool with a soft bottom. Around the water, relaxing on the sunbeds is a real treat, while the bay of Salò provides you with a pleasant view.

Follow Gazetta dello Spot for the extensive entertainment programme

Extensive entertainment programmes for campers of all ages are available. Plenty of fun activities are organised, including sports tournaments, diving lessons, pony rides and evening shows. Each day, the programme varies, so follow the campsite newspaper Gazetta dello Spot closely for the latest information.

properties.name: Camping Fusina
properties.description:
Camping Fusina is situated near the urbanised industrial area on the mainland opposite Venice. Not the most attractive setting, but most practical for a visit to the famous Italian city. In fact, from the campsite you can step onto the vaporetto, the water bus that takes you to this illustrious town. It is precisely for this reason that camping guests from all over the world come to this campsite. Camping Fusina offers a shuttle bus service to various places, including Marco Polo Airport (Venice) and Canova Airport (Treviso). 

International visitors

The road to the campsite is characterised by docks, industry and highway on and off ramps. However, once you have reached the campsite, you find yourself in an exceptionally green oasis beyond the industrial area. The campsite consists of a lawn with tall deciduous trees. There are no demarcated pitches; you can choose your own spot. The rental accommodations (mobile homes) are fully occupied throughout the year with tourists from all over the world.

Only the strictly necessary

The campsite has a beautiful swimming pool. The other amenities on the campsite are strictly in the catering sphere. Hence, there is a bar, pizzeria, Biergarten and smaller restaurant with a slightly more sophisticated menu. There is also a camping shop for the daily necessities. The campsite is popular with young people, so the evenings tend to get quite lively...

You are here only for one reason

It is obvious that Fusina is not a campsite to spend your entire holiday. It is however, an ideal campsite for a visit to Venice, close to the mooring of line 16 of the vaporetta, which takes you across every hour.

properties.name: Villaggio Camping Internazionale Manacore
properties.description:
Villaggio Camping Internazionale Manacore is located on the edge of Gargano National Park, a beautiful natural area on the Italian east coast. With a private beach, this campsite is situated directly on the Adriatic Sea. Although you have left the mountains of the interior behind, you are still camping in a hilly area.

Pitch with sea view

Considering the size of the varied and hilly campsite, it is useful that a camping employee accompanies you to your pitch in a golf cart. If you're lucky, you'll get one with a sea view. The pitches are well demarcated with fences, but do not always have a level surface. There are enough trees to protect you from the Italian sun.

Swimming pool and beach

Just for the view you should take a dip in the camping pool. From the water you look out over the Adriatic Sea, the beach and the surrounding green mountains. The pool is spacious and has a shallow area for children. The sea is also safe for children. The water in the bay, on which the campsite has a private beach, is slowly getting deeper. Don't feel like walking? There is a little train running across the campsite that will take you to the beach.

Complete holiday village

Villaggio Camping Internazionale Manacore goes about it on a large scale with its facilities. Around a central square you will find several shops: from supermarket and greengrocer to hairdresser and first aid. The restaurant’s pavement café is also situated on the square. And in summer there are various activities for every age group in the amphitheatre.

properties.name: Chrissa Camping
properties.description:
Here you find Greek culture at its best. Camping Chrissa is actually only a stone's throw away from the world-famous archaeological site of Delphi. Apart from being an attractive and well maintained campsite, you have, from virtually all pitches, an unrivalled view of the Gulf of Corinth and the olive tree-covered plain.

Terraces against the hill
