The campsite derives its view from a steep slope and is therefore laid out as a terraced campsite. The terraces look beautiful and offer an impressive view of the surroundings. The pitches are spacious, level and have a firm surface. You can rent family rooms in the main building and there are mobile homes and bungalows also available. The camping pitches are not separated from each other, but offer ample shade.

Swimming pool with panoramic view

There is a lovely swimming pool with separate children's pool. The swimming pool also overlooks the hilly landscape. The swimming pool is surrounded by a lawn with sun loungers, strategically laid out beneath sun umbrellas and palm trees. Reading a good book in the shade and having a stunning view: what else could one ask for?

Greek cuisine

The restaurant on the top floor of the main building has an extensive menu and serves Greek specialities, of course. The shop has a limited range, but stocks some nice souvenirs. The sanitary facilities, located near the main building, are excellent. You rarely have to queue.

properties.name: Flower Camping Le Jardin de Sully
properties.description:
Camping in a green valley on the Loire with Château de Sully-sur-Loire only a stone's throw away...what more could one ask for? It is all possible at Le Jardin de Sully, a quietly situated, modestly equipped campsite on the north bank of the Loire river. Here you will find spacious, green pitches with attractive vegetation. A region of tranquillity and nature, ideal for exploring on hiking and cycling trips.

Spacious, shaded pitches

The campsite offers eighty spacious, quiet and mostly shaded touring pitches on the bank of the Loire. The amenities are modest, but good. There are some thirty rental accommodation units (bungalows, chalets, mobile homes, trekker huts) in various prices. These are simply, but adequately furnished.

Colourful swimming pool

At the front of the campsite is the attractive and child-friendly swimming pool (only open in July and August). It has a creative and colourful design. Children of all ages can safely swim and play in the two heated pools. There is a shallow pool for the little ones. 

The Loire is within walking distance and has a sandy beach. In high season the campsite organises dance evenings and entertainment for children. There are wonderful cycling and canoe routes which start from the campsite. More information is available from the reception.

Bites and drinks

There is a camping shop with small range on Le Jardin de Sully. It has a special corner with regional products, though. Larger shops are not far from the campsite, for instance in Saint-Père-sur-Loire. The restaurant has a basic menu and an attractively furnished terrace. It consists of a wooden deck and has a few sun umbrellas.

properties.name: Camping Mas de Reilhe
properties.description:
In a small valley, next to an old vineyard, you'll find Camping Mas de Rei near the village of Crespian. The campground is a refuge for seekers of peace and quiet and nature lovers. You can take wonderful walks in the surrounding hills and vineyards, and there are plenty of towns to visit. You'll find peace and quiet on the campground.

Campground against the hill

You will receive a friendly welcome by a couple who have owned the campground for a few years. The spacious property has campsites divided by hedges. A campground with fields of various size, spread out over the property agains the hill.

Great for kids

In addition to campsites, there are also mobile homes to rent on the campground. Many families with small children camp here during the summer holidays. Mostly seniors come in the early and late seasons. The people camping here often come to take excursions into the surrounding area, such as Nimes, Montpellier, the Camargue or the Pont du Gard.

Swimming pool with jacuzzi

For kids there is an activities team in the high season that organises many great activities. The swimming pool with jacuzzi is in a central location on the campground. You can also take a day trip to the sea, about 60 km away.

Terrace with view of the swimming pool

The restaurant has a lovely large terrace, with a view of the campground and the swimming pool. You can do your shopping in the village of Crespian. The sanitation is modern and is thoroughly cleaned daily.

properties.name: Camping Le Rey
properties.description:
Camping Le Rey is a small campsite located in the Vallée d'Ossau, at the foot of the Pyrenees. The spacious and wooded campsite has been laid out with great care: spacious, sheltered touring pitches are surrounded by trees and offer a view of the surrounding mountains. Enjoy the small-scale conviviality, the peace and quiet and the mountainous nature. Hikers and cyclists will find Le Rey campsite a wonderful destination.

Camping spots under the trees

You can see that the owners have laid out their campsite with care. Paved roads take you to the elongated campsite, where you will first discover the mobile homes that stand between shrubs and behind trees. You can also stay in so-called pods, cosy oval wooden houses, or comfortable lodge tents without sanitary facilities. The rental accommodations are mainly separated from the camping pitches. There are only 38 touring pitches on the campsite: spacious sheltered spots under the trees, overlooking the mountains. This gives campers a very spacious feeling.

Paella evenings

Camping Le Rey is above all a campsite where you can enjoy the peace and quiet and nature. Of course, this does not mean that there is nothing to do. For example, you can take a dip in the heated swimming pool, located directly behind the reception. Even the smallest swimmers have been thought of: next to the swimming pool is a paddling pool.

In July and August there are things regularly organised at the campsite. You can take part in pleasant paella evenings, where the famous dish of the southern neighbours takes centre stage. There are also nice evening markets on the campsite with regional products.

properties.name: Camping La Pierre Longue
properties.description:
Camping La Pierre Longue is a pleasant family campsite in Brittany. You camp here on a headland in the sea. You are close to the salt marshes of Guérande, seaside resorts, and beaches as well as other places of interest. On the campsite itself, you can have fun in the swimming pool, with the entertainment team, and on the sports fields.

Nice and spacious camping

You are on a well-organised campsite with about 50 pitches. These range from 100 to 150 m². There are also around 70 permanent pitches. Don't have your own camping equipment? Then there are all kinds of mobile homes and hiker’s huts to rent. Camping La Pierre Longue has a modern reception with a restaurant and bar next to it. Every day, you can enjoy different dishes, including paella, mussels, and pancakes.

Fun for the entire family

Want to play a game of table tennis or jeu de boules? That’s always a good idea. But there are also other possibilities. Animal lovers can (for a fee) ride a horse or a pony. And why not take a trip in a canoe, kayak, or sup-board! Kayaks, surfboards, and motorboats can be rented at the beach. The entertainment team organises a number of activies, including disco evenings, aqua gym, and games.

Want to swim?

The pool of La Pierre Longue is quite large. It is also covered and heated. Lovers of the sea will find no better place than this campsite. Because it is located on a narrow headland, there is water on both sides. About 500 meters to the South, there is a stretch of rocky coast. If you walk or cycle to the north, you will find several beaches just over one kilometre away.

properties.name: Camping Cambrils Caban
properties.description:
Beach lovers take notice: this campsite is only 300 metres from an extensive sandy beach on Spain's Costa Dorada. At Camping Cambrils Caban you camp between the popular seaside resorts of Cambrils and Salou. This campsite started an extensive refurbishment in 2022. Further renovations will take place in 2023 and 2024. Among other things, the sanitary blocks and rental accommodation will be substantially modernised.

Three types of pitches and various rental objects

When you check in at reception, you can choose between camping pitches in three comfort levels. The difference is mainly in the size of the pitches, which can range from 40 to about 120 square metres. Besides camping, you can rent accommodation at Cambrils Caban campsite.

Cool off in the pool or sea

At the centre of the campsite is a large, rectangular outdoor pool. Next to it is a paddling pool, where the youngest guests can play in the water safely. This campsite is only 300 metres from the nearest sandy beach.

Plenty of entertainment in high season

Cambrils Caban is a campsite where there is plenty to do all year round. For example, there are live music performances and magic and cabaret shows in the evenings. In high season, there are also regular aquagym sessions and zumba classes. Moreover, you can then take part in one of the numerous sports tournaments.

Enjoy a good meal at the campsite restaurant

Right next to the swimming pool, you will find an attractive restaurant with an enticing outdoor terrace. This restaurant offers a wide range of tasty dishes. The menu includes paellas, pastas, pizzas, tapas, sandwiches and desserts.

properties.name: Domaine Naturiste des Lauzons
properties.description:
If you are looking for a naturist campsite in France, Domaine Naturiste des Lauzons in the Provence has all the amenities for a wonderful and relaxing holiday. Jump into one of the swimming pools on a hot summer's day and enjoy lovely walks and cycle rides through the varied countryside. From undulating hills around the campsite to lavender fields, gorges and mountains, they are all in the vicinity. In the summer holidays this is a real family campsite with many activities, playing fun and enjoyable evenings for young and old.

Lovely setting

The campsite is amid a natural green and hilly area. The beautifully appointed site offers a choice of over 100 camping pitches, spread out over four camping fields, each with a toilet block. Handy to know: the site is sloping here and there, so not all pitches are completely level. There is also the choice of over 50 hire accommodation, such as mobile homes, chalets and lodge tents that are spread over the campsite.

Water fun, walks and enjoyment

Domaine Naturiste des Lauzons has all the amenities for a lovely holiday, ranging from an outdoor swimming pool to the restaurant and even a sauna and massages. You can have water fun in the two swimming pools, one of which is heated, and there is a paddling pool for the little ones. In the summer, the water slide is open in the afternoons, so you can whizz into the swimming pool. Furthermore, all types of fun activities are organised for young and old in the summer, such as crafting for the little ones, creative activities for adults, sports tournaments and music evenings.

properties.name: Camping De la Baie
properties.description:
Campsite De La Baie sits between Brittany and the Vendée. This is a small, peaceful campsite especially for families. And the best part? The campsite is within walking distance of the sea! Splash in the indoor pool, take part in a sports tournament, eat something at the snack bar and enjoy the sun on your spacious camping pitch.

Camping with lots of privacy

Do you want to enjoy the sunshine? Then choose a spot close to the well-maintained sanitary building. Do you want some more shade on your camping pitch? Then you'll want the camping pitches near the entrance of the campsite. The pitches are spacious, well maintained and demarcated with high hedges. It is also possible to rent a mobile home.

Entertainment for all

Throughout the summer, the animation team offers activities that are fun for the whole family. Consult the weekly programme immediately upon arrival so as not to miss anything. Think of boules tournaments, bingo nights, treasure hunt and mini club shows. And how about a foam party for the kids?

Take a dip

You can of course swim in the sea, which is only six hundred metres from the campsite. But you can also take a dip in the heated indoor pool (28°C). The little ones can enjoy the paddling pool with a slide.

Time to eat

There is a small supermarket on the campsite where you can order fresh bread. There is also a snack bar, the place to get a tasty hamburger, salad, waffle or pancake. Would you like to eat out? Then drive over to the town of Assérac (10 minutes) or Pen-Bé and you can find a nice restaurant there.

properties.name: Camping Domaine du Surchauffant
properties.description:
Campsite Domaine du Surchauffant is by the blue-green water of Lac de Vouglans. At this campsite, there is plenty for water(sport) lovers to do. Moor your own boat at the moorings by the campsite and in the summer, you can also follow water-skiing lessons. This terraced campsite is situated in the unspoilt countryside of the Jura Mountains. A path through the woods takes you to the sandy beach by the lake. The vast, countryside campsite undergoes daily maintenance.

Heated outdoor swimming pool

For those who like the water, there is a heated outdoor swimming pool at the campsite. The toddler pool is separated from the big pool by a fence, so the little ones can play safely. Follow a path through the woods, down the steps to the wonderful sandy beach by the turquoise Lac de Vouglans. Life guards supervise the beach by this 35 kilometre lake in July and August. It is a perfect fishing spot, if you cast out your line you can catch zander and pollen. During the summer months, there is a KidsClub for the children and there is an entertainment programme for adults. In the protected nature park, Parc Naturel Régional du Haut Jura, opposite the campsite you can discover the stunning flora and fauna of the Jura. By mountain bike, horse or foot you will encounter wonderful lakes and waterfalls. There are various routes past the campsite. You can hire mountain bikes for children and adults at the campsite.

Exceptional diving spot

Take your diving gear and discover La Chartreuse de Vaucluse Abbey, that lies 40 metres under the surface of the water.

properties.name: Homair - Camping Domaine La Yole
properties.description:
Domaine La Yole Camping Resort & Spa in Valras-Plage, in the département of Herault, is located near the beautiful beaches of the Mediterranean Sea. This luxury campsite offers a wide variety of activities for young and old. A day trip to the cultural city of Béziers is a great option. The campsite offers plenty of shade due to the many poplar trees and is around a five-minute walk from the sunny beach.

Peace and space

The vast luxury campsite has almost 600 pitches and 350 rental accommodations. The camping pitches are on located on grass or sand. They are spacious (10m x 10m) and separated by many poplar trees, which together with several other types of trees provided plenty of shadow. This is very welcome in the sunny south of France. You can enjoy a well-earned break in complete privacy here. Besides camping in your own tent, caravan or camper, different types of rental accommodation are available at the campsite.

Fun in the water and away from the campsite

Those who like nice swimming pools will really appreciate the Domaine La Yole Camping Resort & Spa. It is a true paradise of no less than 1200m2, with an outdoor pool, an indoor pool, a paddling pool, water slides and more. The perfect place for young and old alike to cool off.

A short walk from the campsite (accessible by road), the Mediterranean Sea is perfect place for watersports fanatics to burn off some energy. Everyone can fish, windsurf, swim, snorkel, water ski, sail and sunbathe in peace to their heart's content at the beach.

properties.name: Camping Pra' delle Torri
properties.description:
The family campsite Pra' delle Torri is an hour from Venice and ten minutes from the colourful fishing village of Caorle. People of all ages are welcome to enjoy the vast swimming paradise (covering an area of 4000m2), the soft sand on the private beach and the animation team shows at this super campsite on the Adriatic coast. Go on an excursion to Venice, learn to dive or make your own souvenir in the ceramics laboratory.

When it comes to facilities and size, this campsite is like a mini village. Therefore, it might be useful to bring scooters or bikes for the kids.

Excursions to Venice and Verona

Many of the facilities at Pra’ delle Torri are on the main square. Different excursions can be booked at the information office, such as a boat trip through the nature reserve and excursions to Venice and Verona. The office staff can also help if you have any questions about the environment or you would like to buy public transport tickets. If you'd like to send home photos of all the great things you've been doing during your holidays, you can use the WiFi available throughout the campsite.

Camping between the pine trees

Amidst the campsite's well-maintained greenery, you will find luxury mobile homes, furnished lodge tents, bungalows and apartments. There are also more than a thousand grass pitches, of different sizes (up to 150 m²) and offering different facilities. Will you be camping in a tent? Then perhaps a spot in the pine forest is worth considering. These pitches are exclusively for tents.

properties.name: Camping Residence Punta Spin
properties.description:
Camping Residence Punta Spin is a large family campsite in northeast Italy, located between the Lagoon of Marano and the Adriatic Sea. With three swimming pools, a restaurant, a beach bar and a campsite shop with a wide range of products, this campsite is very complete. For children the spacious paddling pool and the mini golf course are fun.

Camping by the Adriatic Sea

On the front part of the vast campsite, located in a fairly wooded area by the sea, you'll mainly find rental accommodations. In total there are about 180. Nevertheless, touring pitches determine the picture on the campsite. In total there are 500 pitches. Some of these touring pitches are, certainly by Italian standards, quite spacious. Some pitches offer a view over the Adriatic Sea. Large trees provide shade on almost every pitch. There are also about 250 permanent pitches.

Pizza, ice creams and cocktails

For lunch or dinner, the campsite restaurant is the place to be: a seafood dish or good pizza is not lacking during your camping holiday in Italy. For an ice cream or cool drink you can go to the pool bar. If you want a quick meal, go to the beach bar, where you can also sit down for a cup of Italian coffee.

Wide choice of swimming

On the campsite you have a choice of no less than three swimming pools: a 25-metre pool for lazy swimmers, a beautiful large paddling pool with water slide and a semi-covered swimming pool. As if that wasn't enough, the Mediterranean is always there for a cool dip. And at low tide the beach is wide and you can sunbathe and build sand castles.

properties.name: Camping du Lac
properties.description:
Enjoy camping in a nice spot on a beautiful recreational lake? You can do this at Du Lac Campsite. This campsite is located near the town of Les Mesnil-sous-Jumièges, in the French department of Seine-Maritime (Normandy region). This is a beautiful, hilly area where the River Seine winds its way through extensive forests. Its an ideal campsite for nature lovers, hikers and cyclists. Du Lac Campsite is also popular with families with children during high season.

Spacious with a focus on touring campers

The spacious grounds mainly consist of tourist camping pitches. These are available in different comfort levels and are usually separated from each other by neat hedges. There are also special spots for tent campers. A limited number of rental accommodations are also available. There are two sanitary buildings spread over the campsite. One of these is heated. The sanitary facilities are clean and of good quality.

Live it up at the Base de Loisirs

At Du Lac Campsite you'll be camping next to a recreational lake. Take a refreshing dip while enjoying the beautiful sandy beach. There is also an attractive leisure park at the campsite: Base de Loisirs Jumièges – Le Mesnil. Campers of all ages will enjoy the leisure and sports activities offered there. These include mini golf, tennis, BMXing and treasure hunting. You can also enjoy pedal boating, canoeing or stand up paddle boarding on the lake.

Tips for eating and drinking

Base de Loisirs has a cafeteria where you can buy snacks, treats and drinks. There's also a small shop on the campsite. You can purchase bread and croissants there, among other items.

properties.name: Camping Garden Paradiso
properties.description:
Garden Paradiso campsite is near Venice, and right on the beach. The campsite is spacious and has many amenities: from swimming pools and a restaurant with a rooftop terrace, to sports fields and a shopping area. At the campsite, there are various accommodation options, including luxury cottages with their own barbecue. A day trip to the Floating City is easy, and definitely worth the effort.

Reception

The campsite doesn't just benefit from its great location. The reception at the campsite has a very spacious set-up: you reach the round reception building via a large driveway. Here you can buy tickets for museums, buses, boats, and all sorts of attractions nearby. You can also book an excursion to the lagoon, Venice, or one of the surrounding islands. And of course, they're very happy to show you how to get to your rental accommodation or camping pitch. Drive further, and you'll reach a broad boulevard. Just before this boulevard, which is car-free, you turn left or right towards your camping pitch. On the boulevard, which is lined with tall trees on both sides, you will find all possible amenities: a supermarket, sports fields, a shopping area, stage, restaurant and swimming pools. At the end of the boulevard you'll find the entrance to the beach.

Relax in luxury

At the campsite, you can find numerous accommodation options. The mobile homes and caravans are situated between green flowerbeds with colourful flowers and plants, and are connected to each other with pretty paths. Something that's quite unique here are rental cottages with their own barbecue/stone grill. So, you can have a delicious barbecue right in front of your house. Another luxury option is the spacious camping pitches with private toilet blocks.

properties.name: Camping Am Bärenbache
properties.description:
Am Bärenbache terraced campsite is in the mountainous region of eastern Lower Saxony, in the heart of a wooded nature reserve. Nature lovers can relax and unwind at the campsite and go for walks in the beautiful surrounding area. Enjoy German cuisine in the many small restaurants in the area or walk into Naturpark Harz.

Camping with a view

When you drive over the site to your pitch, the spaciousness stands out. Terraces with spacious camping pitches have been constructed at the site, which is slightly sloping. Here, you have views of the surrounding forests. There are various trees on the site, which provide shade at some pitches. If you come with a motorhome, you will be allocated one of the special motorhome pitches.

Enjoy the countryside

If you love forests, this campsite will be a wonderful holiday destination for you. You camp in natural surroundings, where dense forests alternate with vast fields. You can take endless walks over the forested hills here. This is also a paradise for dogs. It's a lovely place to relax and unwind and leave the bustle of the city behind you. And that's what many of the guests at Camping Am Bärenbache do in fact, they seek out relaxation and quiet and find it in the countryside.

German cuisine

Want to eat out every day on your holiday? That's easily done. There are numerous little restaurants in the immediate vicinity of the campsite. German cuisine offers good meals for walkers. After a good walk, you can usually find a spot at table in a typical German restaurant.

properties.name: Camping Alpenblick AG
properties.description:
The campsite borders a -not too busy- thoroughfare. During the day you can hear some traffic noise, but less so at night. When you enter the campsite, you will find a well maintained set-up. Everything is neat and clean.

The size of your camping pitch ranges from spacious to slightly compact. The sanitary facilities on the campsite are attractive, clean and tidy. The campsite also has three rental tents. On 80% of the campsite you will have internet access on your laptop.

Active and sporty guests

The lake, a 50-100 m walk away, is ideal for swimming. Windsurfing and waterskiing are allowed. Public beaches are within walking distance. Walking and cycling are other activities to enjoy here. There is a bus stop at 10 m from the campsite. You can take the bus to the train station free of charge with a guest card. From there, you have numerous options for exploring the mountains. You can also play golf or go paragliding in the vicinity. You can ski there in winter; a shuttle bus will take you to the ski area.

Campers on Camping Alpenblick are generally sports enthusiasts who like a challenge. You will mostly find youngsters or families with teenagers here.

Eating and drinking

There is a reasonably well-stocked supermarket and daily fresh bread. The restaurant offers good quality with affordable prices and has an attractive terrace.

properties.name: AZUR Cp-park Wertheim am Main
properties.description:
AZUR Camping Wertheim is located directly alongside river Main, on the outskirts of the historic town of Wertheim. This well-kept campsite has large pitches, rental accommodation and modern toilet and washing facilities. Its location in the green Main-Spessart region makes it a great destination for peace-seekers, active campers and families. In the surrounding area, there are castles, vineyards and walking trails as well as attractive excursions like a climbing park and an outlet centre.

Spend the night by the water or in a nature lodge

The pitches are large and on a flat grassy field. The best pitches are right by the river; you pay a surcharge for them. Other accommodation is available for anyone who prefers not to bring their own camping equipment. For example, a simple touring tent or a luxury nature lodge. Whether you prefer simple camping or a little more luxury, there’s plenty of choice at Camping Wertheim.

At the campsite

There are a number of supermarkets just 1 km from the campsite for day-to-day shopping. There’s a cosy beer garden on the campsite itself, where you can have a drink; it’s the perfect place to relax after a day full of activities. The public swimming pool is right next to the campsite and is free for guests. The campsite mainly attracts German and Dutch campers, of all ages, so there’s a very friendly atmosphere.

Wine, walking trails and timber-framed houses

AZUR Camping Wertheim is located in the hilly Main-Spessart region, known for its viticulture, castles and nature. The centre of Wertheim, with its timber-framed houses and restaurants, is 2 km away. The impressive Wertheim Castle is there too.

properties.name: AZUR Camping Altmühltal
properties.description:
AZUR Camping Altmühltal in Kipfenberg, Bavaria, is surrounded by nature. The area around Kipfenberg is part of the Altmühltal, a valley with valleys, rivers and rock formations. There is plenty to do here for every type of camper: go on beautiful walks or bike rides, take a dip in the Am Limes outdoor swimming pool (10 km), or stroll through Kipfenberg Castle (7.5 km). The cities of Nuremberg and Ingolstadt (29 km) are also well worth a visit.

Pitches and rental accommodation

Are you coming with your own caravan, camper van or tent, or would you prefer to rent something? There is always an option that suits you. Choose one of the spacious camping pitches, or stay in a cosy camping pod or camping barrel. For those who want a little more luxury, there is the Bike Lodge and Nature Lodge Deluxe. Dogs are also welcome: there are special areas designated for four-legged friends where they can run around.

Active or relaxed?

There is plenty to do at the campsite. Hire an e-bike and explore the area by bike, or hop into a canoe from the jetty and paddle down the Altmühl. On hot days, a visit to the Am Limes outdoor swimming pool (10 km) is highly recommended. End your day in the cosy restaurant at the campsite, which offers a simple but tasty menu. Everything you need for a wonderful, carefree holiday is right here.

Exploring the Altmühltal

There is plenty to see and do in the surrounding area. From the campsite, you can cycle straight onto the 166-kilometre-long Altmühltal cycle path. Along the way, you will see castles, forests and charming villages.

properties.name: Camping Sènia Cala Canyelles
properties.description:
Camping Sènia Cala Canyelles is a terraced campsite located between Lloret de Mar and Tossa de Mar. The campsite is divided into three parts. A lower part close to the beach, a middle part with most facilities and an upper part. A big plus of the campsite is its proximity to the beautiful beach of Cala Canyelles, which gave its name to the campsite. In high season, a small train can take you from the campsite to this beach for free.

Camping or renting?

The 300 touring pitches are not overly large, but the average tent, caravan or motor home can easily fit in. The range of rental accommodation is diverse. Choose one of the mobile homes, flats or lodge tents. The smallest accommodations are suitable for three people, the largest for a party of six.

Food, drink and entertainment

There is a restaurant with a nice bar, both only open in high season. Take-away meals are available. The restaurant and bar area are situated by the swimming pool. In the evenings it is the place for musical entertainment and live shows. The campsite shop offers a wide range of groceries.

Water fun and more!

The campsite has an outdoor pool with slide, some water games and a paddling pool. You can also swim in the sea, as there is a sandy beach and the sea only 500 metres away. This is one of the most beautiful bays of the Costa Brava. To get here, follow a small road. Near the beach there is a large restaurant and some public toilets. With a playground, entertainment for children and adults (in Spanish), a multi-sports field, an indoor area (with television, pool table and slot machines), there is plenty to enjoy for young and old.

properties.name: Camping Marelago
properties.description:
Camping Marelago is a well looked after family campsite on the Venetian Riviera. The beach on the Adriatic is only 300 metres away. You can also have fun in the water at the campsite: go to the swimming pool with sunbathing area. The campsite is popular with young families, which is not surprising. There is plenty to do for small children, such as a mini club, children's discos and fun playgrounds.

Well cared for

Although located in a tourist region, the campsite is very peaceful. Everything also looks well cared for. From the reception building to the mobile homes you can rent, and from the roads leading to the pitches to the pitches themselves. These are spacious and delimited by hedges. The sanitary facilities are in a few large buildings.

Fun for children

The campsite's mini club provides plenty of entertainment with regular craft activities, games and children's discos. There is also a playground with swings and slides. But there is also plenty to do for adults. Next to the reception is the restaurant with a covered patio where you can enjoy Italian delicacies. In the morning you can get fresh rolls from the campsite shop and opposite the campsite there are a number of sports fields where you can play tennis, beach volleyball and football.

Train to the beach

The 300 metres to the beach can be done on foot, but you can also take the shuttle train that runs through the different villages and also stops at Camping Marelago. On the beach you can rent beds and umbrellas, but there is also space to roll out your towel on the sand.

properties.name: La Tuquette
properties.description:
In the hot sun of Southern France, close to the Provençal village of Fayence, lies the nudist campsite La Tuquette. A well-maintained campsite with a relaxed atmosphere, spacious pitches and spots with shade. Facilities such as a swimming pool and a bar with a sunny terrace ensure a relaxed holiday. For an active excursion, visit Gorges du Verdon, also known as ‘Europe’s Grand Canyon’.

Small-scale campsite, spacious pitches

The friendly nudist campsite gives a neat impression with many flowers, plants and ground cover. The pitches are spacious and offer adequate privacy, allowing you to relax undisturbed. The pitches are flat and there is plenty of shade. If you are looking for something slightly more luxurious, there are also cottages, holiday homes or a lodge to rent. These accommodations have several bedrooms and their own bathroom.

Everything within reach

Although you as a campsite visitor mainly enjoy the tranquillity, this does not mean that the campsite is lacking in amenities. Go for a swim in the beautifully landscaped swimming pool, located by the bar with a sunny terrace. Cooking is not always necessary since the campsite has a snack bar and a pizzeria. Guests are also pleased with the charming restaurant, which has a delicious menu.

Gorges du Verdon

The Gorges du Verdon (80 km) is a drive of about one and a half hours north of the campsite. With rock faces up to 700 metres high, this is one of the deepest gorges in Europe. According to some people, it is the most beautiful hiking area in France and is therefore most definitely recommended.

properties.name: Camping Lido di Salerno
properties.description:
In the south of Italy, right by the sea, is the Camping Lido di Salerno campsite. From the campsite, you can walk right onto the sandy beach. The front pitches have panoramic views of the Gulf of Salerno and the Amalfi Coast. It is the ideal base for visiting Salerno, Naples, Paestum, Pompeii and Vesuvius. Lido di Salerno is a simple campsite with its own beach, a pizzeria and a pleasant terrace.

A simple campsite

The simple, open campground has 75 small touring sites and fifteen RV sites. The palm trees, olive trees and flowering shrubs provide little shade, but shade screens are stretched above the pitches. There is little demarcation between the pitches. The most beautiful pitches are located directly on the beach and have a beautiful view of the sea. The campsite visibly still needs a lot of maintenance, but the owner is working hard to make it into something beautiful.

Own beach

The Lido di Salerno campsite is located directly on the sea and has a private beach. From the campground, all you have to do is go down a flight of stairs, and you'll find yourself on the beautiful sandy beach. From the beach, you can look out over the Amalfi Coast. In the Gulf of Salerno, the water is a brilliant blue. You can enjoy swimming, but you can also surf and sail here.

Summer entertainment

In July and August, the campsite organises an entertainment programme for children as well as teenagers and adults. Other than that, there is little to do on the site: you'll only find a recreation room and a table tennis table. There is also little entertainment to be found in the immediate vicinity of the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Lido Okay
properties.description:
Camping Lido Okay lies directly on Lake Maggiore and has a private beach and sunbathing lawn. The camping is small-scale and very suitable for families. There is a swimming pool with a shallow end for children as well as a restaurant. Lido Okay is situated on the south-eastern part, the quieter part, of the lake at some 4 km from the town of Sesto Calende where you will find lovely little shops. It is also the ideal base from where to visit Milan (the Duomo di Milano) or Varese.

Obviously, there is also lots to do near Lake Maggiore. Pay a visit to the Borromeo islands in the middle of the lake and explore the stunning gardens and palaces or discover the small lakeside towns. The nature in this region also invites to be explored. Take long (mountain)hikes, go mountain biking or even parachute jumping.

Popular with families

The camping pitches on the campsite have water and electricity. The rental accommodation units are spaciously laid out, are close to the lake and all have their own terrace. Camping Okay Lido is an amiable and small-scale family campsite on the south-east side of Lake Maggiore. The campsite is especially popular with families with young children.  

Swimming pool and a private beach on Lake Maggiore

There is a swimming pool on the campsite with a separate shallow section for children. Furthermore, Camping Okay Lido is directly located on Lake Maggiore. From the camping you have direct access to a private beach and a sunbathing lawn to relax by the water. There is also a boat ramp at the lake from where you can launch your own boat.

properties.name: Happy Village & Camping
properties.description:
Happy Village & Camping is a terraced campsite in the Lazio region, close to the ring road of Rome (northern side). It is situated on a beautiful and naturally landscaped terrain, with many flowering shrubs. This small-scale campsite with a very relaxed atmosphere features a bar, a (new and fine) restaurant and a swimming pool. The campsite shuttle service takes you for free to metro station Prima Porta, from where you can be in the heart of Rome in just 20 minutes.

Sloping terrain

The terrain, dotted with pine trees, is slightly undulating and has marked pitches with varying degrees of shade. The pitches are well-maintained and separated by greenery. They tend to be on the small side. The bungalows and campers which are available for rent are surprising: they are simple but spacious and well-maintained.

Food, drink and entertainment

The campsite shop has a limited range of supplies. There is also a supermarket 4 km further down the road. The restaurant offers a typical Italian menu, delicious and full of flavour. In the evenings it can get a little noisy due to the convivial atmosphere. There is also a bar and a pizzeria.

The beautifully landscaped swimming pool (200 m2) with a fun round paddling pool, is situated higher up on the terrain. Surrounding the pool is a tiled patio with loungers and sunshades. The attractively situated restaurant with patio has views of the swimming pool. Here, you will dine under the palm trees and there are flowers everywhere. This colourful abundance of flowers is a unique feature of this campsite.

properties.name: Donau Camping Emmersdorf
properties.description:
Donau Camping Emmersdorf lies right on the Donau, with a beautiful view of the imposing Melk Abbey. Here you stay in a beautiful natural area across from the town of Melk in the Lower Austria region. Hiking and cycling enthusiasts can live it up here because of the many beautiful routes. If you love culture and history, a visit to the abbey is a must, and there are more monasteries and fortresses to be found in the vicinity. A trip to Austria’s capital city, Vienna, is also recommended.

Spacious camping pitches

The campsite is run by an enthusiastic young couple. There are 47 pitches for caravans and motorhomes, 20 tent pitches, or you can rent one of the 11 cosy camping pods. The pitches are not demarcated. Almost all pitches give a beautiful view of the Donau river. You benefit from a fast wifi connection, and your faithful four-footed friend is also welcome at the campsite.

Fresh rolls for breakfast

Donau Camping Emmersdorf is an ideal spot for people who want to enjoy nature and cultural excursions. There is no entertainment programme or swimming pool but there are fun activities to do around the Donau. There is the Donau cycle path, close to the campsite. You can also go on a boat trip or go fishing. The campsite facilitates a bread service, so you can enjoy delicious fresh rolls for breakfast. There is a small playground for the little one at the entrance.

properties.name: Camping Partaccia 1
properties.description:
Camping Partaccia 1. is situated in an oasis of green and close to the beach, offering numerous opportunities for lovely (long) day trips. Famous cities and sites as Pisa, Lucca, Florence or Cinque Terre are a must during your holidays in this region. If you wish, you can also travel by public transport, as the railway station is close to the camp site.

In a tent or bungalow between the pine trees

This park-like designed and well maintained camp site is nestled between pine trees and close to the sea. The camping pitches have a grassy surface and electricity is provided. Camping Partaccia 1 also offers various types of accommodation. You can rent wooden bungalows, mobile homes, safari tents and apartments.

Enjoy life on your towel or deckchair

The beach is only 65 m away from the camp site. When you leave the camp site, you only need to cross the street to reach the sea. In addition to the areas with rental loungers and parasols, there is also a free area to put down your towel. There are also several beach bars and restaurants.

The camp site has a bar, TV room and a mini-market for essential groceries. Just outside the camp site you will find pizza restaurant 'Mauro' for pizzas, pastas and other delicious Italian dishes.

Karaoke and sports tournaments

This camping organises entertainment, especially for children. There is a mini club where several activities are organised. Older children enjoy participating in the sports events. At night there are karaoke and dance evenings or stage performances by children.

properties.name: Naturist Camp Konobe
properties.description:
On the Croatian island of Krk, in unspoiled nature directly on the Adriatic Sea, Naturist Camp Konobe is located. The facilities at this naturist campsite are simple and the touring pitches look messy, but the location is really beautiful. From the terraces on the steep slope you look out over the bay and the clear waters of the Adriatic.

Messy terrain with beautiful views

The campsite is divided into two parts. A flat camping area extends along the coast. This area consists of touring pitches with an uneven surface and some neglected fixed annual pitches. The other part is hilly and rises quite steeply. You camp here on terraces, in the wooded nature. From the touring pitches, which have a lot of privacy, you look out over the water. The most beautiful spots are perhaps for tent campers. Between the low hanging trees, they can choose a small piece of land directly on the rocky cliffs by the sea.

Limited facilities

acilities on the campsite are rather limited. The sanitary facilities are dated, but are usually kept clean. In the small restaurant, also a bit outdated, the choice is limited. For the daily groceries you can go to Punat, about five kilometres from the campsite.

Pebble beach

The Croatian coast on the island of Krk consists mainly of rocks, but every now and then you will come across a pebble beach. This is also the case at Naturist Camp Konobe. On the flat part of the campsite there is a small beach, from where you can dive into the Adriatic Sea.

properties.name: Camp Marina (NP. KRKA)
properties.description:
At Camp Marina, a small-scale campsite in Croatian Dalmatia, you camp in the shade of full trees. The friendly owners create a lovely ambiance. The campsite forms an ideal base for exploring the stunning nature or to visit one of the Croatian harbour towns. Camp Marina is located on the border of the Krka National Park, a not yet very touristy, hilly area with magnificent nature.

Naturally demarcated camping pitches

The camping pitches are not demarcated, but are defined in a natural manner (and thus rather haphazardly) by full trees. These provide protection against the blazing Croatian sun. You camp on a hard surface. Despite its natural appearance, the campsite is uncluttered and well organised. Paved and unpaved paths lead you to your pitch. Don't have camping equipment? There are several rooms available for rent.

Small, but beautiful swimming pool

After walking all day through the Croatian nature or one of the coastal towns, a refreshing dive in the campsite swimming pool is just what you need. This pool is rather small, but considering the number of guests this small-scale campsite can accommodate, it is more than adequate. It is located in full sun, so if you want to do some sunbathing you can do so in and around the pool.

Honest meal

There is a restaurant with bar near the swimming pool. A lovely place with great ambiance and good food. The restaurant does not boast a large menu, but serves tasty and honest meals, mostly prepared from regional products. You can also get take-away meals here. There is no supermarket on the campsite, but fortunately Skradin, where you can do your grocery shopping, is in close proximity.

properties.name: Camping Village Molinella Vacanze
properties.description:
Camping Village Molinella Vacanze is located at a sandy beach on the sea in the Gargano National Park. Charming Vieste is located about 5 km from the campsite. This area is characterized by lovely rocky coastlines and picturesque bays with a sandy beach.

Compact and green campsite

The campsite (2 hectares) is described as compact, charming and green. The one hundred touring pitches (3-60 m2) and fifty camper sites are located close to each other and near the sea and the beach. The pitches near the beach are a bit on the smaller side. However, a pitch in the forest is larger and shadier. 

Swimming, surfing and snorkelling

The campsite is located on a broad sandy beach and a private beach. This is perfect for water sports enthusiasts. You can swim, surf, snorkel and dive in the clear water. The sea is not too rough, so children can also safely swim here. Camping guests can rent canoes and water bikes. 

There are loungers on the beach. You can also have a drink at the bar. Here you've got a lovely view of the old city of Vieste and the rocky coastline. Everything is nicely illuminated in the evenings.

Sport and games

There are a few pieces of play equipment for kids. They can also take part in the entertainment programme (Italian). Disco evenings are organised on a regular basis. You can also get sporty: table tennis, jeu de boules, beach volleyball and fitness. 

Camping shop

On the campsite there is a small supermarket with fresh bread, meats, cheese and other products to prepare a lovely breakfast, lunch or dinner.

properties.name: Camping Listro
properties.description:
Camping Listro is a smaller, friendly campsite that runs the entire length of Lake Trasimeno. Because the water remains shallow for a long time, the lake is ideal for children. You are surrounded by the picturesque landscape of Umbria with its many castles and cultural-historical villages and towns. The old centre of the cosy Castiglione del Lago is within walking distance.

Camping on the lake

With about a hundred pitches and some rental accommodations, Camping Listro is a smaller campsite. Although the pitches are not particularly large, many are right on the water. From these camping spots, you can enjoy the most beautiful sunrises. And they are ideal for a cool morning swim to rinse the sleep from your eyes. These modern mobile homes are located in quiet spots under the trees.

Historic Castiglione del Lago

There is a small shop next to the campsite restaurant, but Castiglione del Lago is the place to go for larger shopping trips. There are several supermarkets less than a kilometres away. There are also numerous restaurants in the village. Look for a place to eat in the old town of Castiglione del Lago. This area, on a hill directly on the lake, is completely surrounded by old city walls, from which you will have beautiful views of the lake.

Sanitary facilities

A small and a larger toilet block are located on the camping grounds. The sanitary facilities are excellent; in addition to normal showers, there are several larger cabins with washbasins, toilets and showers. There are also family and children's sanitary facilities. The larger washbasins and children's sanitary facilities are in the big building.

properties.name: wecamp San Sebastián
properties.description:
The large, well maintained terraced campsite wecamp San Sebastián is situated close to San Sebastian between the mountains and the sea. Because the campsite is located on a hill, you have a good view of the beautiful surroundings. Hikers often use wecamp San Sebastián as a base to explore the beautiful coastal region for a few days.

Camping with a view

The site, which is typified by different elevation levels, measures some 5 ha. The majority are touring pitches, in addition to mobile homes and safari tents. Most camping pitches, demarcated with hedges, are 70 m2 in size. Electricity and water are also available at the pitches. The terraced pitches with ample or less shade, are allocated to guests. If the allocated pitch is not to your liking, you may choose another one. Several pitches offer a beautiful view. Please note that camping with your own tent is not allowed on this campsite.

There is a special area for motorhomes with pitches of 28 m2 each. You can stay here for a maximum of two nights. The campsite shop has a limited range of groceries, including fresh bread. The restaurant also provides take-away meals.

Nice playground and a new swimming pool

The new, beautifully constructed swimming pool is approx. 220 m2 in size. Also present: a small toddler pool and a sunbathing lawn. The pool is only opened during the summer season. There is a nice playground with challenging play equipment for children.

Day at the beach or visiting San Sebastián

Some 5 km from the campsite you will find the Ondarreta beach, superbly located near the mountains. Many guests prefer to take the bus to the town of San Sebastián rather than negotiating the steep road by (electric) bicycle or on foot.

properties.name: wecamp Cadaqués
properties.description:
Wecamp Cadaqués is in an ideal location, near various sandy beaches on the Spanish Costa Brava, close to the French border. The luxury and eco-friendly campsite is in the higher part of the Cadaqués, one of the region's most beautiful coastal resorts. An overnight stay is extra special in the stylish glamping tents or bungalows. The charming swimming pool and restaurant are especially popular among families also due to the views of the bay of Cadaqués. Sportive guests can explore this hilly part of Catalonia via one of the stunning walking or cycling paths.

Stylish and modern glamping accommodation

You are at the right address at wecamp Cadaqués for stylish options to spend the night. Walking over the terraced campsite, you see many white safari tents in various sizes, and lovely apartments. Although the focus is on renting the stylish accommodation, there are also touring pitches. Please note that camping with your own tent is not allowed on this campsite. All amenities were fully renovated in 2022. During the renovations, they invested heavily in good amenities for campers with motorhomes. The toilet block also looks spick and span.

Exceptional views from the swimming pool

The spacious, rectangular swimming pool is beside the restaurant. For ultimate relaxation, give yourself time to unwind on the sun loungers or in the comfortable lounge corner. There are few campsites with such spectacular views from the swimming pool. You actually look out over a villa where painter Salvador Dalí lived for years, and which now houses a museum Casa-Museu Salvador Dalí. You don't have to walk far to swim in the clear blue water of the Mediterranean Sea, you will find a beach at 400 metres.

properties.name: Camping Barcelona
properties.description:
Camping Barcelona is a fantastic starting point for exploring the cosmopolitan city of the same name. Campsite at the coast: Shuttle bus to Barcelona every day. Public transport to Barcelona is available 24hrs.Their free buses also take you to several beaches, to their Beach Club, train station and local markets. Swimming pool and entertainment all year round. Free Wi-Fi on all the pitches (2000 Megas).

View of the sea

The pitches (90-100 m2) are located in rows on a nicely maintained turf or on gravel along the paved roads. There are medium high trees on the property. Some of the pitches have a sea view. For families with children there is a great field near the playgrounds and the children's farm. Guests without camping equipment can hire one of the bungalows. The campsite offers free wifi on every pitch.

Lounging by the pool

The heated swimming pool is quite large (25 metres long), well maintained and clean. It has various depths and is perfect for swimming laps. Around it there is plenty of space to relax on one of the numerous loungers. From the swimming pool you have a lovely view of the Mediterranean Sea. At the swimming pool there is a covered terrace and a spacious lounge bar with fantastic loungers. The swimming pool is open all season long.

Barcelona at a discount

There are playgrounds, a children's farm and activities in the form of daily excursions and activities for all ages. In the evening there are often shows or live music (every night in July and August).

In the low season the campsite organises plenty of activities for the guests. In addition, the campsite offers discounts on tickets for many attractions in Barcelona. With these tickets, you can skip the line for highlights such as the Sagrada Família, Parc Güell and FC Barcelona. Other tickets are available for Bus Turistic and several museums.

properties.name: Camping de la Plage
properties.description:
Campsite de la Plage is situated in the south of the Finistère Department (Brittany). You camp here on the outskirts of the coastal town of Bénodet. This three-star campsite has beautiful, shaded pitches separated by tall hedges. The grassy fields on which the pitches have been laid out, are bordered by tall trees. The sea is at a distance of some two hundred metres. Due to the long beaches with fine, wide sand, this coastal region is lovingly referred to as the Riviera of Brittany.

Nestled in greenery

When you enter the campsite, you may think that the campsite is rather small. However, nothing could be further from the truth. You will find a large number of touring pitches and almost as many rental accommodation units, both on separate sections of the campsite. The touring pitches are located amidst greenery, on grassy fields which are bordered by tall trees. The pitches are separated from each other by high hedges. You are in a lovely sheltered spot here, almost totally hidden by greenery. 

Complete water park

There are no less than three large, heated swimming pools, two of which are outdoor pools and one indoor swimming pool with glass retractable roof. Furthermore, there is a heated toddler pool, also two whirlpools and two large water slides. The entire complex is designed on a lovely sun deck, surrounded by loungers. Hence, a veritable water paradise for both children and adults. 

Use those legs

This part of Brittany is relatively flat, therefore excellent for cycling, certainly along the shore. There are many signposted cycling and walking routes in the area. Explore another hidden corner of beautiful Finistère each day. Cycle or walk along the endless sandy beaches and the jagged, rocky coastline, visit the small fishing villages and enjoy the Breton delicacies on the way.

properties.name: Camping de Vechtvallei
properties.description:
The family park De Vechtvallei is located on an old arm of the Overijssel Vecht, at the edge of the forests. The campground is surrounded by plenty of nature, such as the Hardenberg Range and the lateral moraines of the Rheezer belts, situated along the winding Overijssel Vecht. It is in a lovely location. Take into account that everything is closed on Sundays, including the reception, so you cannot arrive or depart on that day.

Family park

The campground is laid out like a park and is surrounded by green and low hedges, which create a great deal of privacy. There is a playground for the children on the central grass field. The comfort sites have a water connection, all sites have electricity and wireless internet (for a fee). There is a central sanitary building. You can hire various types of accommodations on the campground (trekker huts, luxury chalets and Finnish bungalows) that are equipped with all comforts. There is also a group accommodation for younger people.

Swimming pool

The Vechtvallei has a covered swimming pool, with a roof that can be opened in the summer. The old arm of the Vecht is a fantastic place to cast a fishing line. The restaurant (with terrace) has a small menu. You can also have breakfast there.

Play and leisure

The guests of family park De Vechtvallei are not left to their own devices because there is a complete recreation team in the high season. The campground also has great sports facilities (playgrounds, trampolines and a leisure hall with foosball and table tennis). Outside, you have a football pitch, two volleyball courts and a basketball court.

properties.name: Camping Bella Torino
properties.description:
For a city visit to Turin, camping Bella Torino is the ideal camping destination. This campsite is a 15-minute drive from the beautiful northern Italian city. You will see many camper vans on the well-maintained campsite. If you camp here, you can enjoy the view. From your pitch you can see the mountains in the distance.

Just above Turin

The journey to Bella Torino camp site is special. You drive through the beautiful landscape of the Italian Alps. The first large town you'll encounter is Aosta. From there you will continue towards Turin. Your campsite is located about fifteen kilometres northwest of Turin in the Italian countryside.

Views of the Italian mountains

From the campsite the northern Italian mountains in the background offer a beautiful view. Especially as the campsite is flat and spacious. It gives you a feeling of freedom and space. On the campsite you can choose a pitch on gravel or grass. If you are camping in a tent, then a grassy pitch is preferable. Especially if you also have the shade of a tree. For camper vans (stopping over for example) a gravel pitch might be a better idea.

A safe place for your campervan

The guests at Camping Bella Torino come from all over Europe. Especially if you are just passing through, this campsite is suitable. Or if you want to visit Turin. And would you like to leave your campervan here for a while? For example to discover Italy on your bike or mountain bike? Then camping Bella Torino offers a safe place to park.

properties.name: Vallicella Glamping Resort
properties.description:
In the hilly interior of the Maremma (Tuscany) region, not far from the village of Scarlino, you will find Vallicella Glamping Resort. It is a large, rather new campsite in a beautiful green area some seven kilometres from the coast. Apart from relaxing on the campsite, you can go on numerous excursions in beautiful Tuscany.

Camping in an olive grove

Vallicella Glamping Resort is a beautifully laid-out terraced campsite in a century-old olive grove, located on a hillside and surrounded by oak trees and Mediterranean shrubs. Everything looks well-tended and the camping grounds are rich with greenery. The pitches (240 in total) are spacious, offer ample shade and are well-demarcated. As a result, they offer ample privacy. In addition to camping pitches, rental accommodations are also available in the form of bungalows (from two to six persons).

What is available on this campsite?

There is a restaurant-pizzeria with a limited menu (takeaway also possible) and a terrace with a beautiful view. There is a bar where you can enjoy a cappuccino or a drink and for your daily shopping, you have to go to the small supermarket. In high season the campsite attracts mainly families with children.

There are two swimming pools and a separate toddler pool with ample surrounding space for loungers and sun umbrellas. You can play a game of tennis or soccer and there is a playground for the little ones. Of course, in high season you have the usual entertainment with sports, games and activities.

Sanitary facilities

The sanitary facilities, divided over various buildings, are in need of a facelift but are neat and tidy. They are also kept spotless in high season.

properties.name: Chianti Glamping Resort
properties.description:
In the heart of the Chianti region in Tuscany lies the the Orlando in Chianti Glamping Resort. At this terraced campground, located in the countryside south of Florence, you'll be camping among vine-covered hills. Modern mobile homes, chalets and lodge tents give the campsite a glamping vibe. The long pool and modern restaurant, which serves Tuscan regional dishes, add to the luxury experience.

Camping or glamping?

The campground is located up the hill. The pitches and accommodations are laid out on different terraces. The terrain is quite steep and not equally accessible everywhere, so you may have to do some manoeuvres to get to your pitch or lodge. There are tall trees all over the campsite, providing plenty of shady spots. Rental accommodations are in a large majority at this campsite. Opposite some fifty touring pitches (not always on even ground), there are over two hundred accommodations.

Fun in the woods

Not only is the campsite a convenient starting point for trips in the Tuscan hills, but the whole family can relax there in luxury. The forests are one big playground for children and a nice resting place for adults.

Refreshing dive

The pools, in particular, are fun for every member of the family. These are located at the front of the campsite, in an open area under the sun. The largest pool is quite simple, but the decoration is very nice. There is plenty of room to lie down around the pool (under parasols), and the grassy lawns and flower beds provide a touch of colour. Next to the pool, you'll find the whirlpool, and a wide slide will take you to the toddler pool below.

properties.name: Trasimeno Glamping Resort
properties.description:
Trasimeno Glamping Resort is located right on Lake Trasimeno in the region of Umbria. With pitches directly on the water, a small private harbour and a swimming pool, this campsite is ideal for those who love water. The beautiful surroundings lend themselves to fun cycle rides too. Lake Trasimeno is fifteen kilometres west of Perugia. The campsite is in an area with green sloping hills, planted with vineyards and olive trees. This restful region, with idyllic villages and spacious lawns, is an ideal cycling area.

Camping right next to the lake

The campsite has many types of mobile homes, from basic to super deluxe. All of the mobile homes have either a private garden or a terrace. If you want to camp, there are also several options. Will you choose the standard pitches? Or a pitch right on the water? All of the pitches are car-free: you can only use your car when you arrive and when you leave. There are also pitches where dogs are permitted.

Restful

This campsite is particularly suitable for guests who want to enjoy a restful holiday, the beautiful surroundings, and lively evenings on the lake. There are two grassy beaches, where you can relax in the sun. It's possible to swim in the lake, but Trasimeno Glamping Resort also has a large pool with several pool slides, a nice children's pool, and a jacuzzi.

properties.name: Camping Riva Nuova
properties.description:
On the Adriatic coast in the Central Italian region of Abruzzo, just south of the coastal resort San Benedetto del Tronto, lies Camping Village Riva Nuova. This well maintained holiday village with rental accommodation and a camping area for campers is situated in a region not yet overrun by mass tourism. The beach is a stone's throw away from the campsite.

Bustling holiday village

A well maintained, park-like campsite with modern buildings: this is the first impression of Riva Nuova. When you drive to your pitch, you will first pass a section with rental accommodation. Behind this section you will find the spaciously laid out campsite. You have a choice of three categories of pitches which vary mainly in terms of size. They are located next to each other along avenues which cross the access road.

Campsite Riva Nuavo has a total of some 200 rental accommodation units in the form of mobile homes and bungalows for four to six persons. You have a choice of various categories of luxury.

Enjoying the sun and the sea

The campsite has a swimming pool with slide, hydro massage, sun terrace and a separate children's pool. The beach is across from the campsite on the other side of the esplanade. Riva Nuova has a private section here with loungers and sun umbrellas. You can rent surfboards and boats here.

The campsite has tennis and basket ball facilities. There is a lovely playground for the little ones. In peak season the entertainment team organises activities like water aerobics, sports tournaments, dancing lessons, disco and other types of entertainment. No reason to get bored!

Private sanitary facilities

On the campsite you will find new, contemporary ablution blocks with children's sanitary facilities. In addition Riva Nuova also offers the option to rent a pitch with private sanitary facilities.

properties.name: Camping Betuwestrand
properties.description:
The Camping Betuwestrand campsite is located in the village of Beesd in, you guessed it, the Betuwe region. The Betuwe region lies between the Waal river in the south and the Nederrijn and Lek rivers in the north. The area is traversed by the Linge river. The Betuwe landscape offers plenty of cycling and walking opportunities; for example, the campsite is located on the beautiful "Lingeroute". At the campsite itself, you can enjoy a recreational lake with a sandy beach, where you can swim, water ski or wakeboard, among other things.

Something for everyone

The pitches at the Camping Betuwestrand campsite are located on separate fields. The pitches are spacious and some are clearly defined. You can also choose from slightly larger comfort pitches and some pitches right on the water. There are also several rental accommodations at this campsite, including mobile homes, chalets and hiker's cabins. Dogs are allowed at several of the camping pitches and rental accommodations.

Endless water fun

At the Camping Betuwestrand campsite, the whole family can experience endless water fun. From swimming, sunbathing and building sandcastles to water skiing and wakeboarding on the water ski course. The recreational lake is no less than seven acres and has its own sandy beach. On the lake, you will also find a floating trampoline and water slides and diving boards.

Outdoor or indoor entertainment

In addition, the campsite offers an extensive recreational programme. The entertainment team organises all kinds of activities on and around the water. All ages are catered for, with a kids' club for the younger holidaymakers and a special teen programme for older children. In the covered square at the campsite, you will find trampolines and a playhouse for playing and crafting.

properties.name: Camping Cassandria-Bad
properties.description:
Come and breathe the healthy, salty sea air on Cadzand's coast. You can do that at the campsite 'Camping Cassandria-Bad' in Zeelandic Flanders. This nice, family-oriented campsite is comprised of sheltered green camping areas, but you can also stay at a chic rental house. This campsite has entertainment programmes for all ages. Whether you enjoy cycling, walking or lying on the beach - the region has a lot to offer. And how about searching for real shark teeth on Cadzand's beach?

A cosy atmosphere and personal service

The entrance to 'Cassandria-Bad' is located in the Zeeland meadows. The campsite, run by Claudy and Joop Basting, consists of large fields with sheltered pitches that can be reached via paved roads and dirt roads. Providing a cosy atmosphere and personal service - that's the Basting family's motto.

Cars are not allowed at the campsite: Campers must park their cars in the central parking lot.

Entertainment for everyone

This campsite is popular with families, but that doesn't mean campers without children or grandchildren aren't welcome: The campsite's wide range of recreation programmes are targeted at all age groups.

There's no swimming pool at the campsite, but a 5 to 10-minute bike ride will take you to Cadzand-Bad on the North Sea coast. Here you can build sand castles and swim in the ocean to your heart's content.

Shark teeth

The shark teeth found at and in the estuary 'Het Zwin' are millions of years old. Hunting for shark teeth: Don't miss out on it during your stay at 'Camping Cassandria-Bad'. You can go by yourself or join a hunt for these fascinating fossils that the campsite organises on a regular basis: Success is guaranteed!

properties.name: Camping Kato Alissos
properties.description:
Camping Kato Alissos is situated in the North Western region of the largest Greek peninsula: Peloponnese. You camp here directly by the sea. The campsite is truly idyllic: from your sojourn under the lemon, orange and olive trees to dining under a thousand-year-old imposing olive tree with mood lighting in the branches. During the day you have a view of the sea.

Camping in a shaded orchard

On Kato Alissos you camp in a shady orchard. The pitches vary in size and are grouped around a few ablution buildings. The surface of the terrain is partly compacted, so it is best to bring different types of tent pegs. Don't have camping equipment? You can also rent rooms.

Directly by the sea

The campsite is directly located at the seaside. You can reach the 8m lower-lying, elongated sandy and pebble beach via a stone flight of stairs. Here and there you will find thatched sun umbrellas. Windsurfing and snorkelling are allowed here.

An evening of Greek culture

There is a modest playground with a see-saw and swings for children. There is also a bad weather provision. In peak season there are regular folklore evenings with folk music and dance. A lovely way to get in touch with typical Greek culture. Cooking classes and wine tastings are also organised.

Thousand-year-old olive tree

During the summer months (from June) you can enjoy your meals outside under a truly beautiful centuries-old tree. During the day you have a splendid view of the sea. At the same time you can enjoy the delectable, traditional Greek dishes. Preferring to do your own cooking? Go to the small campsite shop. In the nearby Kato Achaia (three km) you can also find everything you need.

properties.name: Flower Camping Le Vorlen
properties.description:
Just 250 metres from the beach is Flower Camping Le Vorlen. There are views of the Glénan Islands from this family-friendly campsite in southern Finistère. There is a heated swimming pool with slides and fun activities are organised in high season. With the sea around the corner and beautiful nature and villages nearby, it is an ideal destination for campers wanting to explore Brittany.

Camping in a forested area

The site has both wooded and open areas. The campsite has a wide range of pitches, including shaded areas and pitches with private toilet and shower facilities. Don’t have your own camping equipment? Then rent a mobile home. These can accommodate 4 to 6 people and offer amenities such as a semi-covered terrace and a well-equipped kitchen.

Outdoor pool with slides

You will have plenty of water fun on the campsite. The heated outdoor pool with fun slides and a paddling pool is popular with young and old alike. After a swim, relax on a sun lounger under a wicker parasol. Now, that's luxury! During the high season, activities are organised for children. There are no catering facilities on the campsite itself, but there are several places you can eat in the vicinity.

Surroundings and activities

The campsite’s location makes it easy to explore the Breton coast and inland. Visit the Glénan archipelago, known as the "Breton Caribbean", for a day trip by boat (departure 1 km away). Stroll along the Pointe de Mousterlin (5 km) or discover the bustling town of Quimper (22 km) with its historic centre and museums.

properties.name: Camping Roc de l'Arche
properties.description:
Camping in green, fairytale surroundings? Camping Roc de l'Arche is in the heart of the Lot valley and at the foot of the Monts d'Aubrac. You will camp on the banks of river Lot, just 300 metres from the centre of the medieval town of Espalion. Enjoy a relaxing camping holiday in the Aveyron.

Large pitches

The pitches at this campsite are large. And whether you're travelling with a tent, caravan or motor home, you’ll find the perfect spot for you. Prefer more luxury and comfort? Then rent a mobile home, which can accommodate 2 to 7 people.

Free municipal swimming pool

About 100 m from the campsite, there’s a municipal swimming pool (with a children’s pool and paddling pool), which you can use free of charge, and a tennis court. On the campsite, you can play volleyball, boules or table tennis. There’s a small playground for children.

Explore the adventurous surroundings

Adventure is never far away in the Aveyron. Take a dip in the river, rent a canoe or kayak, go mountain climbing, walking, cycling, fishing or horse riding. It’s a 10-minute walk to the centre of the old town of Espalion, along the banks of the river Lot. Cross the ancient and UNESCO-worthy bridge and wander through the historic streets. There are quaint shops here and cosy restaurants serving local specialities. The local markets are an absolute must as well!

properties.name: Flower Camping Les Deux Rivières Sasu L'étoile
properties.description:
Flower Camping Les Deux Rivières is located in a green valley between two branches of the Varenne River. You can camp here on more than two hectares. The water-rich area where this charming municipal campsite is nestled is ideal for anglers and other water sports enthusiasts. With green pitches, demarcated by hedges and trees here and there, it is very peaceful. Les Deux Rivières lies on the Avenue Verte, and old railway line of about forty kilometres long that now serves as a cycling and hiking trail.

Camping by the water

The campsite is mostly located on flat land, with pitches on grass. Most of the pitches are along the pond or river. Generally, you have a feeling of space. The entire terrain offers space for about eighty touring pitches, forty permanent annual spaces and one mobile home. Most of the guests come from France itself.

Sports, play and themed evenings

There is a fun playground for children. There is also a recreation space (including table football) For a fee, you can also play a round of billiards or try your luck on the gaming machines. Another fun activity: challenging your camping neighbours to a round of table tennis or boules. In the high season, there are themed evenings (barbecue, paella, mussels). There is a supermarket two kilometres away. There are multiple large supermarkets in Dieppe.

For water sports enthusiasts

Next to the campsite there is a large water sports centre. Here you can do everything, including canoeing, rowing, waterskiing and windsurfing. The large lake is also the domain of anglers. There's even more to experience on dry land. You can indulge in archery and climbing.

properties.name: Camping La Plage
properties.description:
In the French department of Dordogne, in the town of Vézac, lies the Camping La Plage campsite. In "the region of a thousand castles", this campsite is a wonderful base with a family atmosphere. Enjoy the river, take a dip in the pool and embark on endless trips in the area. Whether you like nature, history or relaxation, you're sure to find it here!

Enjoy the beautiful Dordogne

Even before you reach the campsite, you'll be able to feast your eyes on the beautiful surroundings of the Dordogne. After your arrival at the reception, make your way to your seat. These range from full sun to partial shade. The most beautiful spots have a view of the water and the castle of Castelnaud. Don't have your own camping equipment? You can also rent a beautiful mobile home.

The Dordogne River is a great place to be, especially in the warm months. A refreshing swim is a real treat! But there are also plenty of opportunities to get sporty! Explore the river by canoe, or cast your fishing rod to hook a fish. Those who prefer to stay on dry land can also go horseback riding, mountain biking or hiking in the area. And of course, a nice car ride is never a bad thing either!

At the campsite

At the campsite, you will find some convenient and nice facilities. The reception building is next to the pool and also serves as a shop and a restaurant. The shop only offers some basic necessities, but there are plenty of other shopping options in the immediate area. A playground is available for children.

properties.name: Camping Mun. Le Vallon de l'Ehn
Camping du Vieux Château
properties.description:
To the north of the popular seaside resort of Pornic, just five hundred metres from the elongated sandy beach, Camping du Vieux Château is a great destination for the whole family. From the campsite, which is situated in the middle of a quiet residential area, you can walk to the restaurants and shops in the town centre within a few minutes.

Compact campsite

The compact campsite is well-organised and has slightly more mobile homes and chalets than touring pitches. A number of trees and shrubs provide shade, but there are also many pitches for sun lovers. You have quite a bit of space on the pitch itself, but there is less space between the pitches.

Always swimming

At the entrance, the swimming pool and the bar form the heart of the campsite. In the summer months there is plenty of liveliness, but always in a friendly way. Even when the weather is not so good, you can enjoy a nice swim at Camping du Vieux Château. The water is heated to 28 degrees and has a glass canopy.

Bite and drink

The bar (open mid-June to end of August) is a great place for a drink or snack. In the summer months there are pizzas on the menu and you can order bread for the next morning. For daily shopping there is a supermarket about three kilometers away. Or stroll through the weekly market in Tharon-Plage for fresh fruit, vegetables and fish.

Fun and games

For children there is an enclosed playground. But there is also plenty to do outside the campsite. For example on the child-friendly beach to which you walk in only a few minutes.

properties.name: Camping Quercy Vacances
properties.description:
At the Camping Quercy Vacances campsite, your family can experience outdoor life to the fullest. The nearby Causses du Quercy Natural Regional Park (Parc naturel régional et Géoparc des Causses du Quercy) lends itself perfectly to beautiful walks through hilly landscapes and along rivers. This tidy campsite offers a pleasant balance between spacious touring pitches and beautiful glamping accommodations where you are surrounded by lots of greenery.

Spacious pitches

On the gently sloping grounds of Quercy Vacances, all facilities are centrally located on the campsite. The grassy fields with the touring pitches look neat and orderly. They have no demarcations.
