So with your tent, caravan or motorhome, you have all the space you need to set up a nice home away from home. Have you ever stayed in a log cabin on stilts or in a luxury safari tent? For glamping guests, the various accommodations are mostly located on the other side of the campsite.

Swim or bubble

The lovely pool looks as well cared for as the rest of the campsite. This is a circular outdoor pool in a sunny spot surrounded by sunbeds to catch up your tan and meanwhile keep an eye on your kids while they are in the water. For the youngest campers, a paddling pool is available.

Mexican Evening

Not surprisingly, the restaurant is a popular place to be all day long. In the morning, the day starts with a fresh baguette, and throughout the day, you can choose from snacks, ice creams, and pizzas. At dinner, a wider menu is available. During concert evenings and themed meals, long tables are set up on the terrace. Then the whole family can join us for, say, a Mexican evening.

properties.name: Oasi Park Falconara
properties.description:
Oasi Park Falconara is located at the southern end of the island of Sicily, five kilometres from the Vendicari nature reserve. This small, basic campsite is frequently visited by by travelling camper van tourists. If you like, the friendly campsite owner will take you to the pebble beach, just 1.5 kilometres away, by shuttle bus. The bus that stops in front of the campsite also travels to the baroque city of Noto.

Basic camper van pitches

The small (0.5 hectare), well-organised campsite Oasi Park Falconara features 45 touring pitches and 10 pitches for camper vans. The borders for the pitches have been created with young shrubs and citrus trees, which provide some shade. Camping pitches vary in size from 42-100 m2 and are perfect for tents. The campsite has simple and clean sanitary facilities. There is some playground equipment on the campsite for children to enjoy. 

The baker's on the way!

During the summer, a baker stops by every morning with fresh bread and croissants. The fishmonger and greengrocer also regularly visit, so that camping guests can buy what they need. There is a pizzeria across from the campsite that we highly recommend. More shops are available in the town of Noto Marina as well. 

Most beautiful beach in the country

You can visit the nature reserve Vendicari, located in the south. These coastal wetlands, which stretch from Noto to Marzami, are dotted with lakes and dunes, and feature typical Mediterranean vegetation. You can follow the coastal path here (the route from the campsite is about twelve kilometres), which ends at the sandy beach of Calamosche. This beach was named the most beautiful beach in Italy several years ago. The beach slopes gently here, so children can swim safely.

properties.name: Camping Le Napoléon
properties.description:
This beautiful campsite in southeast France is close to Gap (3.5 km). Because Camping Le Napoléon is at an altitude of 1000 metres, you have an amazing panoramic view. It is a terraced campsite with an informal atmosphere. The various amenities and friendly owners will make your holiday complete.

Friendly atmosphere

The campsite has about thirty pitches, varying in size, with some located on a sloping piece of land. There are also various chalets, cottages and a nice Airstream caravan on the grounds. Camping Le Napoléon is very suitable for those who want peace yet enjoy a pleasant atmosphere. The campsite is perfect as a stopover campsite, but a longer stay is also an excellent option. If you value privacy, this campsite may be less suitable for you.

Wood-fired pizzas

Le Napoléon has various amenities. The reception, the bar and the restaurant form a lovely whole. In the restaurant you can enjoy, for example, wood-fired pizza and grilled meat. You can eat here and in the campsite cafe even if you are not staying at the campsite. The restaurant looks out onto the basic but sunny swimming pool, which is where you can cool off during a hot summer’s day. The campsite supermarket has all you need for a delicious homemade meal.

Activities at and around the campsite

In the summer there are many guided walks and excursions organised at the campsite. There is also entertainment (during the high season), a play area for children, and a bouncy castle is set up regularly.

properties.name: Flower Camping Le Bois d'Amour
properties.description:
Flower Camping Le Bois d'Amour is located on the Breton peninsula of Quiberon, 150 metres from the beach and the Atlantic Ocean. This family campsite has a large swimming pool with sliding roof and a fun paddling pool for the little ones. Just a few minutes walk and you'll be on a large beach on the Breton Côte Sauvage. Buy your ticket for a boat trip to one of the islands near Quiberon at the campsite!

Quiet campsite

The lively and well-kept entrance has a green character due to the dense foliage of the trees. The white reception building contrasts sharply with its bright green background. Through the trees you'll see a quiet campsite with many rental accommodations: various types of mobile homes and lodge tents. Sometimes they are a bit close together. In between there are a few touring pitches, but most of those pitches are located in a separate central part of the campsite.

Open or closed?

With a bit of luck the weather in Quiberon is beautiful and the sliding roof of the campsite pool can be opened. The spacious pool is still partly covered, and the large shallow paddling pool is still under the roof. Fine in itself, because the smaller swimmers can enjoy the heated water and the fun water play equipment in the shade.

Pizza and baguette

Take a seat at the pleasant pavement café at the front of the campsite where you have a view of the swimming pool. For a pizza, homemade hamburger or tapas you've come to the right place. Around the café you'll find most of the campsite's amenities: a shop, a games room and a bar.

properties.name: Flower Camping La Chênaie
properties.description:
Flower Camping La Chênaie is located close to the town of Yport, between the coastal towns of Dieppe and Le Havre. Here you camp on the wooded hillside, under tall trees or on the edge of the forest. With an indoor swimming pool, younger guests can enjoy themselves on the campsite, while the Normandy coast with its chalk cliffs offers beautiful walks along the Atlantic Ocean.

Wooded pitches

On the green, wooded campsite, mainly rental accommodation define the picture. Over sixty well-maintained chalets and mobile homes are situated on the hillside, in the shade of tall trees. Some of the rental properties offer a beautiful view of the campsite. There touring pitches are on a more open terrain. These pitches are not particularly spacious and are not delimited.

Amenities: simple but good

The facilities at the campsite are quite simple, but good. In the shop, near the reception, you can get some groceries. In high season there is also a snack bar. On the campsite you'll find two toilet blocks: one in the reception building, the other on the other side of the campsite. The sanitary facilities on the campsite are modern and tidy.

Chalk cliffs and coastal towns

The Normandy coast is never far away when camping at Flower Camping La Chênaie. Less than half an hour's walk and you're already on the beach at Yport. You'll find many restaurants in this charming coastal village. The sea is a little less suitable for swimming here, but walking along the impressive coast is all the better. The steep, white chalk cliffs run all the way to Fécamp, the harbour town north of Yport.

properties.name: Camping Le Haras
properties.description:
Camping Le Haras is a beautifully landscaped campsite in Languedoc-Roussillon, less than ten kilometres from the coastal towns of Saint-Cyprien and Argelès-sur-Mer. You'll be camping on the Mediterranean coast with a view of the Pyrenees. With the beach a short distance away and a swimming pool on the campsite, water fun is guaranteed.

Abundant flora

Between the many trees and flowers are a hundred beautifully landscaped pitches. Hedges and colourful plants provide delimitation and privacy. Because of the many trees and abundant flora, the terrain might appear a bit crowded, but there are also plenty of pitches with a more open character. There are also some twenty rental accommodations scattered among the plants.

Swimming pool in the sun

Next to the restaurant you’ll find the swimming pool. The water in the rectangular pool is not heated, but it lies in the sun, so you can count on a nice water temperature in the summer months. Attached to the pool is a semi-circular shallow pool, ideal for smaller swimmers.

Mediterranean Sea

You can almost smell the Mediterranean Sea when you're camping at Le Haras. A drive of less than ten kilometres and you're on an endless sandy beach that starts at Argelès-Plage and continues to Saint-Cyprien and Canet-en-Roussillon. Outside the centres of these towns there is plenty of free parking space.

Catalan specialities

Within a ten minute walk from the campsite you will find two bakeries, a grocery store, a greengrocer and a restaurant. On the other side of the village is a wine castle. In Elne you can find all the big supermarket chains. Fresh bread is available on the campsite and there is a fine restaurant.

properties.name: Flower Camping Le Conleau
properties.description:
Flower Camping Le Conleau is located on the outskirts of the old town of Vannes, near the Gulf of Morbihan. The campsite is spacious and slightly sloping. This provides a view of the rest of the campsite from the pitches and rental accommodation. The large swimming pool provides water fun, but for true water enthusiasts, the Gulf of Morbihan is the ultimate location.

Spacious campsite

Behind the reception building you will discover a very spacious campsite. The front part is still flat, but if you drive on to the back, you will notice that the terrain is slightly uphill. Although the touring pitches here are sometimes not completely flat, they overlook the rest of the campsite and are in the shade of trees.

The highest pitches are mainly for tents and mobile homes. In the centre on the flat part the pitches are also shady. The ring around it is mostly sunny. There are special pitches for campervans around a sanitary building.

Large swimming pool

At the back of the terrain is the large, rectangular indoor swimming pool. Next to the pool is a shallow paddling pool.

Restaurant

The pavement café near the restaurant is situated slightly higher than the rest of the campsite. This gives you a view over the campsite, although the roof of the swimming pool blocks part of the view. The restaurant mainly provides pizza and snacks. The camping shop has a small assortment. However, there are plenty of restaurants and shops in the vicinity of the campsite.

properties.name: Flower Camping Les Bouleaux
properties.description:
Flower Camping les Bouleaux is a comfortable campsite in the Alsace with a number of extraordinary facilities. The hammam is one of the most remarkable features in this respect. This is a campsite for active nature lovers and people who like their creature comforts and luxury. Families with young children and teenagers feel as much at home as couples and seniors. The Alsace is a beautiful region not overrun by tourists, an area for lovely walks and bicycle trips.

Beautiful and different pitches

The reception - also serving as restaurant and bar - can be found in a building in typical Alsace style. Upon arrival, you will see at a glance what the campsite has to offer: a swimming pool, a restaurant and beautiful camping pitches. The most beautiful pitches are located at the front of the campsite. They also have some hardened pitches for camper vans. After passing a few mobile homes and luxury lodges, you will see more camping pitches. You have a choice of pitches in the sun or in the shade. The sanitary facilities are well-maintained. The block near the reception has recently been renovated.

Swimming pool with hammam

There is a swimming pool with bubble bath, hammam (Turkish bath) and a toddler area. This is situated near the restaurant. You will also find a recreation area with nice playground there. You can order regional dishes in the restaurant. There is a covered terrace from where you have a view of the playground.

Fresh bread and regional products

Each day a baker visits the campsite (excluding Wednesdays) so that you can buy fresh bread. The supermarket is 1 km away from the campsite and stocks an extensive range of goods, including regional products.

properties.name: Flower Camping Les Granges
properties.description:
In the Loire Valley with its impressive castles, 13 km from the university town of Tours, you will find Flower Camping Les Granges. This an amiable campsite for seekers of peace and quiet who appreciate nature and culture. This is also a good site for the entire family as it has a comprehensive entertainment programme. In 2018 the campsite changed owners.

Cosy and well cared for

The grounds are well-maintained and look cosy. Everywhere on the grounds, you will find tall deciduous trees offering ample shade. The camping pitches are demarcated with hedges and low shrubs. If you are looking for rental accommodation, you can choose between tents, chalets and mobile homes. The sanitary provisions are fine and kept spotless.

Playful swimming pool

The heated swimming pool has a playful design with rounded shapes and stone walls and gates. It is surrounded by loungers and thatched umbrellas. Adjacent to the swimming pool is a playground. Between the playground and the swimming pool is a fence to keep the little ones from accidentally falling into the water.

Endless entertainment

There are numerous recreational facilities for children: a playground (bouncer and trampoline), a multi-sports field and indoor play area (table football, billiard and table tennis tables). There is also some fitness equipment. In high season there is a Children's Club each morning and there are weekly music performances for the entire family. The area is ideal for fishing, walking. cycling, canoeing, kayaking and go-karting. The ‘Loire à Vélo’, an extensive network of attractive cycle paths, is close by.

Small, sociable terrace

There is a snack bar, open throughout the season, with a small and attractively furnished terrace. There is also a camping shop with a limited assortment and daily fresh bread.

properties.name: Flower Camping Les Paludiers
properties.description:
Flower Camping Les Paludiers is located in an exceptional area. You'll be camping here on the peninsula south of Guérande. You're literally trapped between the salt marshes on one side and the Atlantic Ocean on the other. Beach and sea are just a hundred metres from the campsite.

Welcome! Welcome!

You cross the large area of salt marshes, which separate the mainland from the peninsula when you drive from the direction of Guérande towards the campsite. The campsite is located just past Batz-sur-Mer, a seaside resort on the Atlantic Ocean.

Flower Camping Les Paludiers has around 120 touring pitches. Green hedges and small trees separate the sites. If you want a bit more comfort, choose a lodge tent or a comfortable mobile home. There are 140 rental accommodations. The three modern sanitary blocks are wonderfully heated. And great for campers with dogs: at the entrance to the campsite there is a vast field to walk them.

Sea, outdoor and indoor swimming pool

There's no shortage of swimming opportunities at Les Paludiers. First of all, of course, the sea and the beach, only a hundred meters away. Would you like to make a day trip go to the village of Le Croisic. Apart from spending time on the beach there is the old harbour, the large villas and the aquarium to visit. On the campsite itself there is a shallow outdoor swimming pool and a large indoor swimming pool, both with a separate paddling pool. Especially the indoor paddle pool is spacious and fun for the little ones.

properties.name: Camping Du Domaine De Pont Mahé
properties.description:
On the border of Brittany and the Pays de la Loire, close to the beach of the Atlantic Ocean, the campsite Du Domaine De Pont Mahé is situated. This quiet family campsite is very suitable for families with children, who can have fun in the heated and covered swimming pool and of course on the beach and in the sea.

Silence and sea noises

Although the tranquillity dominates at Du Domaine De Pont Mahé, on some pitches on the street side it is drowned out by the noise of traffic. However, at most of the almost forty touring pitches and over thirty rental accommodations you can enjoy the silence and the gentle rustling of the waves, carried inland by the cool sea breeze. For a comfortable stay, the campsite has large touring pitches, most of them grassy and delimited by green hedges.

Heated and covered swimming pool

Keeping a close eye on the weather forecast is not necessary here, because even in bad weather you can have a nice swim. Then the indoor swimming pool at the front of the campsite is waiting for you. This is not particularly large, but it is wonderfully heated. Ideal for children who are eager to dive into the water.

Bartender Romain

If you need a drink, you should be at bartender Romain's. In his snack bar he prepares the most delicious cocktails (also non-alcoholic) for you. And if you're hungry, you can also order fries, pizza or hamburger from Romain. If you want to throw a burger on the grill yourself, you can use one of the communal barbecues for free.

properties.name: Flower Camping Du Port Caroline
properties.description:
Very green and spaciously laid out campsite in the Anjou prefecture, a region with beautiful rivers, imposing castles, vast vineyards and picturesque villages. The campsite is situated along the Authion river in a wooded meadow area east of Angers. The bustling small town of Brain-sur-l’Authion is situated on the other side of the river.

Green, spacious and mental repose

As soon as you pass the barrier, you will get a sense of tranquillity, space and lush greenery. The camping pitches are situated on well maintained camping fields, separated by medium-height hedges. The odd tree provides some shade and the site is adorned with shrubs. This creates all sorts of sheltered corners with ample privacy and shade. The sanitary facilities are found in two ablution blocks. The facilities are not excessively modern, but are kept neat and tidy. In addition, rental accommodation in all shapes and sizes is available on the campsite. You can park your car at your tent.

Lovely swimming pool

There is a beautiful and fairly large heated swimming pool with transparent roofing. Wonderful for cooling off. If you want to go cycling, you can rent a bicycle on the campsite. Furthermore, there is a small shop which stock mainly snacks and sweets. You can do your daily shopping in the small town on the other side of the river.

properties.name: Flower Camping Les Ilates
properties.description:
In Loix, the smallest village on the Ile de Ré, island on the west coast of France, you'll find Flower Camping Les Ilates. This lively campsite is located between salt marshes and oyster beds, close to the Atlantic Ocean. Here, campers can take a dip in the large heated swimming pool with paddling pool, where water polo matches are held in high season. The summer months are full of fun anyway, as the entertainment programme is extensive.

Well-maintained campsite with mobile homes

The campsite looks well cared for and tidy. Approximately seventy spacious touring pitches with grassy ground are separated from each other by large hedges. So you always have privacy on your pitch. Most of the pitches on the campsite are reserved for rental accommodations. You can choose from mainly classic mobile homes, but you can also spend the night in glamping tents or in a special Cabane Lodgetent on stilts.

Large heated swimming pool

The beautiful swimming pool is situated in the middle of the campsite. This heated outdoor pool is very spacious. In addition to the large pool is a spacious paddling pool, so even the youngest water enthusiasts will be able to enjoy their water fun. Big advantage: the swimming pool is also open in the evenings. Got hungry from all that swimming? Next to the swimming pool is the restaurant. Take a seat at the pavement café and order a pizza.

Atlantic Ocean and beach

If you like the sea, you'll be fine here. From the campsite, a paved road takes you to the sandy beach at the Pointe du Grouin, one kilometre from the campsite. Because this wide sandy beach on the Atlantic Ocean is quite remote from the rest of the island, it's a lot quieter here than on the other large beaches of Île de Ré.

properties.name: Kanopée-Village à Trevoux
properties.description:
The location of campsite Kanopée-Village à Trevoux is unique: within walking distance of the lovely town of Trévoux, on the banks of the Saône river and at half an hour's drive from Lyon.

Bird nest

The campsite has a large range of pitches, is shady and has a diversity of greenery. Most pitches are separated by hedges. Some pitches are located along the jogging track and water. However, the houses on stilts ('bird nests') are the main attraction of the campsite. They are of a striking design and attract many weekend guests. Because the units are spread across the grounds, the adjacent pitches are slightly less private.

Pathway along river

The campsite itself has few amenities. The campsite relies on the surrounding area. There is direct access from the campsite to the walking and cycling trail along the Saône. Routes are available from the reception. The campsite also offers guided walks. You can go canoeing and hiking in the vicinity.

Regional products

At the reception you can buy regional products (such as wine). There is also a bread service. There is a supermarket within cycling distance. Just outside the campsite you can enjoy a meal for a reasonable price.

properties.name: Flower Camping de La Pointe du Talud
properties.description:
Flower Camping La Pointe du Talud is located just a few metres from the coast of Brittany, slightly south-west of the harbour town of Lorient. Here you camp directly by the Atlantic Ocean and four hundred metres from the beach. There is enough to do for all family members on this friendly family campsite: swimming in the covered pool, taking part in game evenings and arts and crafts with the entertainment team.

A great atmosphere

The friendliness of the proprietress is reflected throughout the campsite. There is an amiable atmosphere on the well maintained grounds, where you camp on average-sized pitches, separated by hedges. Some pitches are located in a beautiful setting under the trees. A fairly large proportion of the campsite is reserved for mobile homes.

Covered swimming in the sun

The covered swimming pool is located near the entrance. The roof is transparent so you can bask in the sunlight even when you are in the pool. Attention gents and boys: bring your speedo along, because -as is the case on many campsites in France- the 'slip de bain' is compulsory here.

Rocky coast

A sand track near the entrance leads to the rocky coast of the Atlantic Ocean. Great for a walk or to catch a breath of fresh air, but swimming is not possible here. Not to worry, because some two hundred metres along, between the rocks, you will find a sandy beach from where you can get into the sea. There are more similar beaches in the vicinity, hence plenty of choice.

Activities for young and old

The activity hall, behind the swimming pool near the entrance of the campsite, is the central meeting place of the camping guests. In addition to having a meal together here, concerts and games evenings or arts and crafts afternoons are organised in this hall.

properties.name: Camping L'Hermitage des Dunes
properties.description:
On the French Atlantic coast, less than one hour from Nantes, is the de L’Hermitage du Dunes campsite located right by the sea. From the bar, and some of the camping pitches you have a breath-taking view over the ocean, which has very strong tides here. Local tip: gather your own seafood by ‘foot fishing’ on the beach.

View of the sea

When you find your pitch, you will immediately notice how nice and quiet the atmosphere on the campsite is. The pitches are spacious, and some have views of the sea. The campsite also rents out a number of mobile homes. In the summer, you will find many French families with children. In the low season, it is a popular place for rest seekers from all over the world.

Swimming and foot fishing

Do you like swimming? Thanks to the heated and covered pool, you can enjoy the water starting in April. The little ones can splash and play in the paddling pool. And, of course, you can enjoy the beach and the sea. The beach is only 50 metres from the campsite. You can walk there through the gate of the campsite.

Depending on whether it is low or high tide, the beach varies considerably in size. You can sunbathe and swim or walk and bike. Foot fishing is also a popular activity here. That means you can collect your own shells and seafood while you’re hiking and then prepare a fresh meal at the campsite! Because of the many sharp shells, water shoes are recommended for the little ones.

properties.name: Camping Le Lac des Sapins
properties.description:
In the middle of the countryside in the French department of Rhône lies Camping Le Lac des Sapins. It is less than one kilometre to the city centre of Cublize and an hour’s drive to Lyon. Those who love to swim can enjoy themselves in Europe’s largest ecological swimming pool right next to the campsite.

For all campsite visitors

Those who love traditional camping will be in their element at this campsite. There are 181 clearly defined spacious pitches for caravans, tents and motorhomes. But for those who appreciate their comforts while camping can also find an accommodation here. For example, there are mobile homes, chalets and cabins for rent.

Europe’s largest ecological swimming pool

The campsite is only a stone’s throw away from the Lac des Sapins and Europe’s largest natural swimming pool is right next to this lake. You can go swimming here, go hiking on the trails around the lake, go cycling, pedal boating, stand up paddleboarding, sailing or even climb trees. A gate on the campsite leads you to a stream that will take you to the lake in just a few minutes.

Entertainment and activities

During its opening period, and in the summer season especially, Camping Le Lac des Sapins offers activities, services and entertainment for all ages. Their programme includes concerts, shows and many other fun things. You can also amuse yourselves at the playground, the tennis court, bowling alley and ping pong table.

properties.name: Flower Camping La Canadienne
properties.description:
Flower Camping La Canadienne is located in the heart of Arcachon Bay and just 7 kilometres from the beach. This is an ideal location for holidaymakers who want to enjoy water, nature and the outdoors. Whether you come for the tranquillity or the many adventure opportunities nearby, this campsite offers something for everyone.

Sleeping among the pine trees

Flower Camping La Canadienne is suitable for young and old. Various types of accommodation are available, including comfortable mobile homes and spacious pitches. Don’t have your own camping equipment? Then you can count on a pitch among the pine trees. And booking private toilet and shower facilities will give your camping holiday an extra upgrade.

With all modern conveniences

The campsite has a boat-shaped, heated outdoor pool and a paddling pool for children. You can also do all kinds of water sports at Arcachon Bay or at the beach, such as fishing, sailing or canoeing. And if you don't feel like cooking one evening, you can visit the campsite's snack bar, pizzeria or restaurant.

Note to nature lovers

The campsite is surrounded by lots of natural beauty. That makes it a wonderful area for varied walks and bike rides. Less than 5 km away, you will find Prés Salés nature reserve. This nature reserve is known for its unique ecosystem with various bird species, lizards and European pond turtles. This campsite is also a good base for Cap Ferret (25 km) and Bordeaux (51 km). And of course, a day at the beach on the Atlantic Ocean cannot be missed.

properties.name: Camping Homair Le Lac des Vieilles Forges
Flower Camping Le Bel Air
properties.description:
Camping on an island is extra special. The French Île de Ré is located in the Atlantic Ocean and is relatively small, but there is plenty to do. The cosy campsite is located on the edge of the village of La Flotte-en-Ré in an idyllic location 900 meters from the Arnérault beach. It is a relaxing destination on the French west coast for families with children of all ages. You are surrounded by forest, the area is a true cycling paradise, and the large swimming pool at Flower Campsite Le Bel Air guarantees hours of water fun.

Under the trees

The touring pitches are usually next to each other in narrow streets on the well-maintained camping site. They are all easily accessible with a caravan. If you want extra space, you can set up your pitch at one of our comfort pitches. There are plenty of places to escape the sun thanks to the many trees. The three sanitary buildings on the campsite are well maintained. For a glamping experience in style, you sleep in a nice log cabin or in wooden lodges on nicely decorated stilts.

The large swimming pool is located at the entrance of the campsite. It is continuously heated to 25 degrees. There is a separate paddling pool, and around the pool are sunbeds and parasols.

Active holiday

Children can participate in fun activities during the summer holidays. Together with the campsite mascots, Mister Flower and Dino, there is a game or excursion on the programme almost every day. There is a welcome get-together for campers every Sunday evening. There are also gym lessons; you can try out an adventurous climbing lesson at the climbing wall.

properties.name: Flower Camping Mas de Champel
properties.description:
Camping Mas de Champel is situated in the valley of the river Eyrieux, a less touristic part of the Ardèche. The landscape here is mountainous: from the campsite you have a view of the surrounding mountains. The restaurant, located in an old farmhouse has a pavement cafe from which you have a panoramic view. Water fun is possible in the swimming pool or in the river.

Magnificent view

Well-paved paths take you across the campsite to the various terraces. Spacious pitches and rental tents are sheltered under the trees. From your pitch you have a beautiful view of the surrounding mountains. The view from the mobile homes on the higher terraces is even more beautiful. The view of the river is obscured by high trees.

Swimming in pool and river

Next to the reception building, on a lower part, is the heated camping pool. Even when the sun hasn't warmed up the water, you can have a nice swim here. Next to the swimming pool is a small paddling pool with some water play equipment. Around the pools there is plenty of space to sunbathe. You can also swim in the river. A path leads from the campsite to a small beach on the river. If you prefer to stay dry, take your fishing pole with you or discover the river in a canoe.

Restaurant with panoramic view

Perhaps the most beautiful place on the campsite: the restaurant. This is located in an old farmhouse behind the reception building. From the pavement cafe you have that beautiful panoramic view over the campsite, the swimming pool and the mountains.

properties.name: Gern-Campinghof Salem
properties.description:
Gern-Campinghof Salem is situated on the outskirts of the village of Salem, less than ten km from Lake Constance. This peaceful four-star campsite with eco-label is managed by the Gern family. It is a true family campsite with an amiable, hospitable atmosphere. Children are allowed to help look after the animals in the animal enclosure.

For touring campers

The campsite consists of level grassy fields along straight cul-de-sacs. To compensate for the difference in height of the slightly sloping landscape, some terraces have been laid out. Standing between the camping pitches are deciduous trees and tall hedges, although the vegetation offers little shade in summer. The campsite is neatly laid out and is well maintained. It consists mainly of touring pitches, but there are 25 permanent pitches as well. In addition, there are two mobile homes and one trekker hut available for rent. 

Petting zoo

Gern-Campinghof Salem is a true family campsite. It is especially popular with families during the peak season. In low season it is mostly frequented by senior citizens. There is lots to do for small children. In addition to an outdoor playground, there is an indoor playground and a recreation area. However, the most popular attraction of this campsite is the animal enclosure with ponies, horses, rabbits, goats and chickens. 

The most beautiful lake

At a distance of some eight hundred metres from the campsite lies the Schloßsee, a beautiful lake which is great for swimming. A ten minute walk through the fields will get you there. The water is clear and always a few degrees warmer than Lake Constance. Swim to Robinson island, or walk there by crossing the bridge. There are clean pebble beaches (bring your aqua shoes!) and beautiful lawns with ample shade.

properties.name: Camping La Croix d'Arles
properties.description:
Camping La Croix d'Arles is located in the southern part of the French Champagne-Ardenne region. The campsite is easily accessible from the N19 heading towards Vesoul and is located directly along the D974. The campsite is not only suitable for longer stays, it's also the ideal campsite for travellers passing through on their way south (or back north). The area surrounding the Langres Plateau is strewn with pine and broad-leaved trees, lakes, and streams.

Spend the night in a special accommodation

As you find your way to the camping pitch, you will drive through a green area with many flowers and trees. The campsite is well-tended and, although it is busy during the peak season, you will find yourself in an oasis of tranquility. The camping pitches are spacious and have sufficient shade, especially the pitches at the back of the campsite. And would you like to try something different than the standard camping options? Book a night in one of the special accommodations such as the kota room!

Local produce on the menu

The campsite facilities may not always be modern, but they are clean and well-cared-for. In the campsite shop, you will find a small selection of bread and local produce. These products are also used in the dishes which you can eat in the restaurant on the campsite.

No room for boredom

The campsite features a playing field for the children and an outdoor swimming pool with a separate paddling pool. The swimming pool is well-tended and you can soak up the French sunshine on one of the poolside loungers. If you don't feel like swimming, you can also opt for a game of mini golf.

properties.name: Baia Holiday Gasparina
properties.description:
Camping Gasparina is right next to Lake Garda, between the green hills and the vineyards. The Gardaland amusement park (1.5 km) and the town of Peschiera del Garda (4 km) are very close, making the campsite a handy home base for visiting these popular places. Camping Gasparina also has spacious pitches, rental accommodations and many amenities, such as swimming pool, a restaurant, a supermarket and an entertainment programme.

Spacious pitches and mobile homes

If you are visiting Camping Gasparina with your own camping equipment, you can choose from all kinds of pitches, from basic pitches for tents to luxury pitches by Lake Garda for caravans and motorhomes. The surface of the ground is grass and sand. Many pitches are partially or completely in the shade of the trees. If you would prefer to rent an accommodation, there are modern mobile homes available, each with its own terrace.

Facilities for young and old

The camping site has a large swimming pool with lanes for sports enthusiasts. For the little ones there is a play pool with water attractions. If you don’t feel like cooking a time, visit the restaurant with a view of Lake Garda. Choose from all kinds of delicious Italian dishes. The campsite also has its own shop with a wide range of daily shopping. There is an interactive entertainment programme for the children in the high season.

Popular spots just a stone’s throw away

Camping Gasparina has a practical location with several tourist attractions that are just a few minutes away by car. For example, the Gardaland amusement park (1.5 km) is within walking distance. A visit to the tourist spot Peschiera del Garda (4 km) is easy from here.

properties.name: Baia Holiday Centro Turistico San Nicola
properties.description:
Centro Turistico San Nicola is located on the coast of Gargano, the Italian peninsula known as 'the spur of the boot'. At this large, fully-equipped campsite, you'll be camping directly on a private beach on the Mediterranean Sea.

Welcome!

The campsite is located near the charming town of Peschici, situated on the rocky coast of the Adriatic Sea. A truly picturesque camping experience, with the sea on one side and the mountainous interior of the Gargano National Park on the other. Once you've passed Peschici, you'll soon start seeing signs for the campsite. They'll lead you down the hill into a green valley. You'll find the well-maintained campsite there.

View of the sea

The extensive sanitary facilities are very modern and well cared for. Despite the fact that this is a large campsite with 650 touring pitches, the demarcated camping pitches will provide you with a reasonable amount of privacy. Some of the pitches, like the rental accommodations in the pretty yellow houses, offer a view of the bay and the Adriatic Sea. You can also camp in one of the new modern chalets. Want to know exactly which camping pitch suits you best? You can view each touring pitch on the campsite's website.

Facilities

In principle, you don't have to leave the campsite for anything. You can do your shopping in one of the shops, located atop the hill on the campsite. Or go out for dinner in the campsite restaurant. There's also a beach bar on the private beach. Still fancy a day trip? Then opt for an excursion to the caves of Gargano or the Tremiti Islands.

properties.name: Camping Royal
properties.description:
Amidst nature, at an elevation of some five hundred metres, lies Campsite Royal. On this peaceful campsite, you will be camping on shaded pitches which are mostly separated by bushes or deciduous trees. Due to the relatively high altitude of the campsite, you have a glorious view over nearby Lake Orta from many spots. Fantastic!

Camping in all peace and quiet

Camping Royal only has sixty pitches: thirty permanent pitches and thirty touring pitches. Three of these are specifically for motorhomes. If you arrive without camping equipment, you can rent one of the seven bungalows or mobile homes. The camping pitches are laid out with respect for the natural surroundings. Even though they are not excessively large, they offer ample privacy. The sanitary facilities are very clean.

Swimming pool and other entertainment

The swimming pool on the campsite is not very large or deep (only 1.20 m), but is very tidy. It is a spot where you can cool off and relax. There is lots to do for children. There is, for instance, a playground with some equipment: slides and swings. 

You can indulge in sports at the table tennis table, the pétanque pitch or the multi-sports field. No inspiration at the moment? The entertainment team organises all kinds of simple but fun activities in the evenings. There is also a disco evening every now and then.

Going out for a meal or barbecuing at the campsite

On the campsite is a camping shop for basic groceries. You can buy fresh bread each morning. There is also a bar. Some 100 metres from the campsite you will find the charming Madonna della Neve restaurant. You can make use of the barbecues in the communal barbecue area.

properties.name: Camping Blauer See
properties.description:
At this family-friendly campsite in Lünne, Germany, you will be camping in a rural setting by the water. The area is characterised by forests, lakes, canals, rivers and farms. There a many cycling and hiking trails and you will find numerous historic buildings in the area, such as monasteries, castles and churches. This is the right place to be for an active or relaxing holiday full of nature and culture.

Camping on the lake

Blauer See Campsite is located between a lake, forest and heather fields. The campsite has about 30 level touring pitches of various sizes and a number of rental units. A large part of the campsite is reserved for annual pitches. The touring pitches are separate, partly on grassy fields with groups of trees and shrubs and along the lake. Fast, free WiFi is available throughout the campsite.

Toes in the sand

The campsite is located on a natural lake with water of superb quality. There is a small and uncluttered sandy beach where you and your children can sunbathe, play and swim in the shallow water. Paddle boards are available for free. Though there is no live entertainment at the campsite, children can still have a great time. In addition to a playground and children's hut with a TV, there is also a small bilingual (NL/DE) library, including children's books.

Own honey

Blauer See Campsite pays considerable attention to ecology, holism and especially the environment and biodiversity. There are many rare trees, plants, shrubs and flowers and many different species of insects and birds. The campsite has its own "Blue Bee" apiary, so a jar of honey is the perfect souvenir.

properties.name: Campingplatz Storchencamp Purbach
properties.description:
This Austrian campsite is located southeast of Vienna. An hour's drive and you're already in the capital! Much closer to the campsite, about four kilometres away, is a large lake: the Neusiedler See. You can have a lot of fun in the water here, as it is the second largest lake in Central Europe after Lake Balaton. Near the Storchencamp Purbach campsite is a large bathing complex. Here you can enter for free as a camping guest.

The Storchencamp Purbach campsite is an ideal base from which to discover the picturesque town of Purbach or making cycling trips around the Neusiedler See.

Camping pitches and accommodation

The campsite has 80 pitches for travellers passing through, most of which are sunny. There are also 350 permanent pitches and 60 rental accommodations, including guest rooms, apartments and teepees. A large lawn area at the entrance is suitable for short stays.

Restaurant

Restaurant 'Storchenbeisl' has two beautiful terraces. You can find a large menu full of local dishes. There is a small grocery shop right next to the reception.

Water fun and other entertainment

Close to the campsite, almost next door, is the Erlebnis-Solarbad. This is a large swimming complex with all the trimmings. Camping guests have free access. Another perk: as a camping guest, you will receive the Burgenland Card. This gives you access to all outdoor pools around Lake Neusiedl. You will also benefit from numerous discounts. At the campsite itself, you can enjoy a game of table tennis or tennis.

properties.name: Camping Internazionale Castelfusano
properties.description:
In the dunes near Ostia, 35 kilometres from the centre of Rome, you will find Camping Internazionale Castelfusano. This large but simple campsite is conveniently located for a visit to Rome or Ostia Antica. Most camping guests come for a short stay.

Natural terrain

Camping Internazionale Castelfusano is a large campsite with a wooded terrain. The campsite is situated in the dunes, on the edge of a wood. The pitches vary in size and are placed freely in the natural terrain. There is enough space on the campsite to choose a shady spot on the grass. The campsite consists for the most part of touring pitches, but there are also mobile homes, chalets and even rooms for rent.

A refreshing dip

There are two semi-permanent frame swimming pools on artificial grass. Around them are some sun loungers and parasols. Nice to cool down for a while, but not enough for the better water fun. Through a gate, for which camping guests get a key, you can walk to the beach. The Mediterranean Sea is one hundred and fifty meters away, but you have to cross the busy boulevard. In the sea you can not only swim, but also snorkel, scuba dive, sail and surf.

Few amenities

In high season there is a modest entertainment program on the campsite for both children and adults. You can also go cycling and walking in the vicinity of the campsite. The facilities on the campsite are simple: there is a small supermarket and a fairly large restaurant. There is a bus stop in front of the entrance. By public transport you can reach the centre of Rome in one hour.

properties.name: Camping Aquileia
properties.description:
Just outside the ancient town of Aquileia is the campsite of the same name. From this well-maintained campsite, you can walk right into history. In fact, right next to the campground are archaeological digs. At the campsite you will find, above all, an abundance of peace and quiet. The spacious pitches under the tall trees are lovely spots. So there's no need to search around for shade. Are you looking for a way to cool off? Then take a dip in the pool: the perfect place for a few laps.

Camping under tall trees

Camp in peace and cool shade. The Camping Aquileia campsite is an ideal camping location for those looking for peace and quiet. On the spacious, well-maintained pitches, there is plenty of room for your camping equipment. Whether you come equipped with your caravan, campervan or tent. You can camp under the tall trees, on large grassy areas. This gives a sense of spaciousness and calm. Just what you need for a relaxing camping holiday in Italy.

Swimming in the sun

As soon as you arrive at the campsite, you can dive straight into the pool. Right by the entrance, you will find this wide, long pool. The perfect place for lap swimmers! You can swim in the sun, but you can also seek out the shade. And the children? They can bathe in the toddler pool.

One-pot meal or Italian pizza?

For a one-pot meal for your stove, you don't have to walk far. In fact, across the street from the campsite is a supermarket. Here, you will find everything you need for an evening meal. Don't feel like cooking during your trip? That's no problem either! Next to the campsite, you will find Ristorante la Capannina.

properties.name: Camping Oasis du Berry
properties.description:
On the outskirts of Saint-Gaultier, a small town on the river Creuse, is the campsite Oasis du Berry. The camping site of this quiet campsite is green; you camp under full trees, on sheltered and spacious touring pitches. It's an oasis of peace and quiet, where the children can enjoy themselves (sports fields, playground, swimming pool).

Sheltered pitches

The campsite Oasis du Berry is shaded by tall trees. You camp at the edge of the village, against a forest on the banks of the river. South of the campsite, the woods and fields stretch out over the French countryside. Just like the surroundings, the campsite is green. 41 touring pitches are nicely sheltered under low hanging trees on spacious lawns. This assures you of a quiet camping pitch with privacy.

Swimming pool and sports fields

With its playground and sports fields (soccer field, volleyball field, basketball field and bowling alley), there are plenty of opportunities for children to play at the Oasis du Berry campsite. The summer animation is also fun for the young guests, although the animation team only speaks French. A dip in the open air swimming pool always does the trick.

Homemade grill burgers

The terrace of the restaurant overlooks the swimming pool. You sit here nicely, overlooking the woods. Even when it rains, the terrace is covered and very spacious. The staff of the restaurant prepares delicious dishes with great care. You can taste homemade pizzas and grilled burgers, mostly prepared with local products. Regularly you'll find cosiness on the terrace, while enjoying a glass of wine and a nice fresh meal.

properties.name: Camping Château des Tilleuls
properties.description:
Camping Château des Tilleuls is located in Port-le-Grand on the west coast of France, about fifteen kilometres from Channel coast and the bay of the Somme. This terraced campsite is situated on the vast estate of an old mansion. You camp in green surroundings, on spacious delimited pitches. Or in special rental accommodation, such as hiker's huts or a tree house.

Camping in the green

The vast terrain of the campsite is increasing gradually. There is plenty of room for entertainment on the large lawns at the front. One level higher, in green surroundings, there are just over forty pitches. These spacious, marked out pitches are separated from the 180 permanent pitches.

Coastal tidal flats

Next to the castle, partly shaded by tall trees, is the camping pool. This is not particularly large, but enough for hours of water fun. For the little ones there is a paddling pool. The coast is about fifteen kilometres from the campsite. Within a twenty minute drive you're at the Channel Coast, where the river Somme reaches open water. The estuary has a very wide beach, although you are not allowed to swim there. But just walking across the mud flats is maybe even better.

Sporting fun

Camping Château des Tilleuls does not offer entertainment, nevertheless there is a lot of entertainment to be found. With a playground, multisports field and fitness room, sporty campers of all ages will find what they are looking for. The petting zoo and bouncy castle are especially fun for the children. The campsite's green surroundings are suitable for exploring by bicycle.

properties.name: Camping L'Ultima Spiaggia
properties.description:
The four-star L'Ultima Spiaggia Campsite is located directly on the picturesque Sardinian coast near the town of Bari Sardo. There are trees all around you - from eucalyptus trees to mimosas and pines. The waterpark is the absolute crown jewel of the campsite. All facilities are of a high quality and the campsite looks neat and clean. Campers are welcome to join excursions and guided hikes.

Camping in Sardinia

This family campsite's beautiful location on the Mediterranean Sea is a major selling point. In the heart of the province of Ogliastra, you will find unspoilt natural beauty, a huge coastline with rugged rocks and authentic villages. You can walk from the campsite to the beach via a direct entrance. Sunbeds and umbrellas will be waiting for you.

Spot with a sea view

The wooded, terraced grounds have 280 pitches, with the touring pitches separated from the glamping accommodations. All pitches are spacious and well maintained. You can even set up on a spot with a sea view on the edge of the campsite. There is nothing but praise for the sanitary facilities: clean, spacious and modern. Are you looking for a furnished mobile home, luxury chalet or a cool lodge? Then you will certainly appreciate the comfort, beautiful finishes and attractive decor offered here.

Paradise for swimmers

When visiting the beautifully landscaped waterpark, you will imagine yourself in a tropical garden with colourful shrubs and flowers. There are four different pools connected by bridges. Beach lovers walk down a footpath to the sea. For a fee you can rent a bed there to sunbathe. Snorkelling and windsurfing is also allowed on this lovely beach.

properties.name: Camping Delfino
properties.description:
Camping Delfino is situated in the Liguria region on the Italian Riviera, the piece of coast from the French border to Tuscany. The camping grounds, located between the motorway and railway line (but also directly by the sea) are covered with shade cloths. You camp here on rather tight but cool camping pitches between vines and under shade cloths.

Camping in the shade

You will notice immediately that the pitches are rather small: they stand close together in rows. If this does not appeal to you, you can opt to stay in one of the mobile homes, located on a separate section of the grounds. This is not exactly the quietest campsite in the country. The nearby motorway and railway line are quite noisy. This campsite is not recommended if you are a light sleeper.

Superb view

The Mediterranean Sea is a five minute walk away. The beach here is is not particularly wide and consists mainly of pebbles. However, the view is spectacular. Overlooking the sea you can see the wooded island of Gallinara. Inland, the landscape is determined by high mountains. The coast south of the campsite is recommended if you are looking for a more attractive beach.

Dolphin and whale watching

Near the campsite you can get onto the Mediterranean Sea by boat for a wonderful experience. If you sail away from the coast a bit, chances are you will encounter whales or dolphins. Granted: it takes a bit of luck, but if you spot such a mighty whale or a school of playful dolphins, you will be richer for the experience.

properties.name: Camping Les Ilots d'Or
properties.description:
Camping Les Ilots d'Or is in the beautiful Porto-Vecchio on the bay of Golfo di Sogno on Corsica. The campsite is located in a wooded area and has its own beach. For social contact and delicious food, you need not leave the campsite. The restaurant is open all day long and themed evenings are organised regularly in the bar. There is a playground for children.

Sun and shade

Whether you come with your own motorhome or caravan, or set up a tent, there is always a comfortable spot for you. The oak and eucalyptus trees protect you from the sun and the fresh scents complete the picture. If you are looking for a little more comfort, stay in one of the accommodations that includes a terrace and air conditioning.

Mediterranean experience

The campsite has all of the modern conveniences. During the day, enjoy the sun and the beach while the children amuse themselves playing table football and table tennis or in the playground. In the evening, return to the restaurant with its open kitchen for a delicious wood-fired pizza or grilled dish. End the day in the bar with lively themed evenings. A great Mediterranean experience for the entire family!

Central location

Take your bicycle to Porto-Vecchio. This cultural city has beautiful beaches, a harbour and many cafes and restaurants. Water sports enthusiasts will also enjoy themselves in this region: from diving to jet skiing to sailing or a recreational round trip.

properties.name: Thermenland Camping Rath & Pichler
properties.description:
A camping holiday in Thermenland Styria means a holiday full of relaxation. From Thermenland Camping Rath & Pichler in Bad Waltersdorf, you can easily visit three thermal baths in the immediate vicinity. The surrounding nature is also ideal for exploring on foot or by bike.

Family business

The campsite is run as a family business with a small team, so there's a nice family atmosphere. After receiving a warm welcome at the reception, you'll set up your camper, caravan, folding camper or tent on a circular lawn with tall trees. The modern, clean and fully equipped sanitary facilities are a major plus for many guests.

Fun in and on the water

The thermal baths are within walking and cycling distance, but you can also use the free shuttle service from the campsite. Campsite guests receive free entry to the Bad Waltersdorf waterpark. If you really want to get away from it all, you can also go to the Stubenbergsee, 22 kilometres away.

On the road with the covered wagon

You can discover the area around this campsite in numerous ways. There are many beautiful cycling and hiking trails. Up for a more unique trip? The campsite owners will be happy to take you around on a tractor and covered wagon, or you can step into the old vintage Mercedes bus.

Holiday tip

Be sure to visit one of the Buschenschänken in the area during your holiday. This is a kind of tasting room where farmers serve their own juices and wines, among other products. These may also include sausage or dairy products they have produced, for example. Bushenschänk Thaler is within walking distance of the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Sonnenstrand
properties.description:
From Camping Sonnenstrand you have a magnificent view of the Rhine Valley and the heavy shipping traffic on this river. Along the Rhine, there are beautiful villages and a large number of castles, lovely sights when cycling along the banks. There are also many hiking possibilities in this region. Where the campsite is located, you can swim in the Rhine.

View of the Rhine

On the left-hand side near the entrance of the campsite, there is an area for motorhomes. To the right is the entrance of the campsite. The reception is located upstairs in the modest building where you will also find the restaurant. The camping pitches are on an elongated flat field, running parallel with the Rhine and the B9. The pitches are demarcated. For a pitch with a direct view of the Rhine, you pay an additional surcharge.

Unique swimming opportunity

An unique feature of this campsite is the sandy beach along the Rhine with a magnificent view over the valley and adjacent hilly landscape. There is some basic wooden playground equipment on the bank of the river. There is a sandbank in the Rhine and the river flows past the other side of the island. On this side - the side of the campsite - the water is calm. It is ideal for swimming. On sunny days the beach attracts many visitors.

Shopping in Bacharach

On the campsite, there is a small shop which stocks the essential foodstuffs only, including bread. The building where the reception is located also houses a good restaurant. Downstairs in the building are the sanitary facilities.

properties.name: Camping Du Pont de Bourgogne
properties.description:
Camping Du Pont de Bourgogne is located on the banks of the Saône, just outside Chalon-sur-Saône. The location of this three-star campsite is extremely favourable in several respects. The campsite is easily accessible from the A6 motorway and is therefore very suitable as a transit campsite if you are travelling along the Route du Soleil. The beautiful old town centre of Chalon-sur-Saône is within walking distance.

Choose your own pitch

On this campsite you can choose your own pitch. Just behind the reception the pitches are a bit smaller, but delimited with hedges. Further on, you will find an open terrain with less delimitation, but somewhat larger pitches. TAll pitches are nicely flat, neatly laid out and well- maintained. The campsite is long and narrow.

Municipal swimming pool

There is no swimming pool at the campsite, but there is a large municipal swimming pool across the river. Delightful for a refreshing dip after a long car journey. You'll find a large wave pool, a whirlpool, two indoor pools, water slides and a hammam. Via the bridge you can walk there in ten minutes.

Camping Du Pont de Bourgogne is a real transit campsite. There is no animation and no activities are organized.

properties.name: Camping Pila
properties.description:
In the south-west of Krk island, you will find Camping Pila. Modern facilities, spacious camping pitches and direct access to the sea make this a great camping holiday. With entertainment, sports and excursions from the campsite, nobody needs to get bored during the holidays!

Camping Pila is located near the town of Punat and is separated from the sea by only a pleasant boulevard.

Wide choice of pitches

At Camping Pila you will camp on spacious pitches under trees. With 600 camping pitches, there is always a spot to suit your needs. Some pitches even offer a sea view.

For water lovers and seekers of rest and relaxation.

The campsite is located directly by the sea. Just a few minutes walk from your pitch, you reach the crystal clear sea that the island of Krk is famous for. Water rats will have a great time here, splashing and swimming in the azure water. Do you prefer peace and quiet? Then relax on the clean pebble beaches under the Croatian sun. The campsite itself has a cosy beach bar where you can enjoy the sea view with a cup of coffee in your hand.

Entertainment for young and old

At Camping Pila, young and old can enjoy the entertainment. Children from the age of 3 can participate in shows, workshops and games in Falky Land and will soon make friends. For young people and adults, activities such as mini-golf, bowling, aerobics, tennis and basketball are available to enjoy their holiday to the fullest.

properties.name: Club del Sole Adriano Family Collection
properties.description:
Adriano Family Camping Village is located in the Italian region Emilia-Romagna, not far from the cultural city of Ravenna. The large family campsite, situated in woody grounds, is only 400 metres from the beach on the Adriatic. A day of water fun is therefore always within reach. On the campsite itself there is also a beautiful water park with children's slides, jacuzzis, hydromassage and a rapid.

Neat family campsite

The entrance of Adriano Family Camping Village looks sleek and modern. Everything looks well maintained. There are many permanent pitches and rental accommodations on the campsite. Enough choice if you do not have your own camping equipment. The pitches are spacious, well defined and mostly situated on grass and in the shade of pine trees.

Sport, entertainment and good food

There is plenty to do for young and old. You can play beach volleyball, basketball and football, there are nice playgrounds and there is varied entertainment. There is also a restaurant where you can enjoy Italian meals and pizzas. You can do that on the attractive outdoor patio, but you can also take your meal with you to your own pitch. In the morning you can get fresh bread and other groceries at the campsite shop.

Swimming paradise and sea

The pride of this campsite is the water park. There are dolphin fountains, children's slides and a mini rainforest, as well as sunbeds in the water, a rapid, a jacuzzi and hydromassage. Around the pool there is a sunbathing area with beds and parasols. For even more fun in the water, you can also spend a day at the beach, which is about 400 metres from the campsite.

properties.name: Club del Sole Vigna sul Mar Family Collection
properties.description:
Vigna sul Mar Family Camping Village is a pleasant and large campsite just outside Lido di Pomposa, about 80 kilometres south of Venice. You will be camping by the sea, in a tourist area with several campsites on the same road. Nature lovers are in luck, because twenty kilometres north of the campsite is the beautiful natural park of the Po Delta.

Welcome!

Here on the Adriatic coast you will find your campsite within walking distance of a private beach and the sea. This is one of the many advantages of the Vigna sul Mar Family Camping Village. The 13 hectares of the campsite are full of trees, which means that your pitch (70-80 m2) will have plenty of shade. There are over six hundred of them! There are also hundreds of bungalow tents and mobile homes.

Water fun

A beautiful and wide sandy beach is directly accessible from the campsite. There are a few beach showers. Work on your tan on the sand and jump into the sea every now and then. Do you prefer not to bathe in sea water? Then there are also two swimming pools at the campsite.

Entertainment on land

A professional entertainment team is active at the campsite for young and old. There is even a mini club for the youngest campers four times a week. If you want to keep in shape while on holiday, you can do sports. Challenge your camping neighbours to a game of table tennis, boules or beach volleyball.

Facilities

Everything you need for a comfortable holiday is available at this large campsite. You can get a bite to eat in the restaurant, take away a pizza or have a drink in the bar. You can buy everything you need to cook for yourself in the supermarket.

properties.name: Camping Bella Austria
properties.description:
In the green heart of Austria lies the diverse region of Styria. There you will find the Camping Bella Austria campsite. It is surrounded by beautiful Alpine peaks, forests and green meadows. From the spacious pitches, you can enjoy spectacular scenery all day long and comfortable facilities such as a swimming pool, saunas, and a cosy restaurant. Rental bicycles are also available to explore the area.

Sunny pitches

You can set up your tent, caravan or motorhome on a flat spot near the campsite entrance. The view of the mountainous surroundings there is unforgettable. There are some trees on the property, but truly shady spots are minimal. Neat mobile homes and bungalow tents are located along several avenues.

A refreshing dip in the pool

Looking to enjoy the sun on a sunbed or swim a few lengths in the pool? There are two swimming pools at the front of the campsite. A round and entertaining pool with a newly constructed lagoon pool for the smaller campers. This toddler pool is wonderfully heated; the larger pool can be a bit chilly.

Dining with a view

Basking in the views of the pool and the surrounding mountains, enjoy a nice drink or ice cream on the terrace during the day. In the evening, of course, you should opt for one of the restaurant's delicious dishes. The stylish decor with Austrian spheres gives the restaurant a cosy atmosphere.

Fun and games

For children, Bella Austria is one big play paradise. Go to the playground, greet the animals in the small park or join in the games organised during the summer months. A game of basketball or football is also a fun way to make friends.

properties.name: Camping Le Moulin
properties.description:
Along the babbling brook, the Boutonne, between fields in an agricultural area with forests, lies the small family campsite Le Moulin. This is a place to camp in an oasis of peace on a well-organised campsite. The spacious camping pitches, loosely demarcated, are separated from the rental accommodations. In high season, fresh bread is delivered to the campsite upon request.

Eating in a restored farmhouse

The campsite owners take pleasure in organising theme evenings for the guests. On Fridays, it is time for the quiz and while pondering over the answers, you have a choice between mussels and chicken. You definitely have to make early dinner reservations for the jazz band performances; such evenings are very popular.

The small, heated pool (50 m2) with terrace is located adjacent to restaurant des Canards. In the 350-year-old restored farmhouse, traditional French and international dishes are served. This includes fish and chips, Chinese dishes and all kinds of curries. Ice cream, snacks and takeaway meals are also available.

Excursions

There is some playground equipment for children and a table tennis table. From the campsite you can follow easy walking and cycling routes. The camping owners organise excursions for the guests (canoe or kayak trips and a visit to local wineries and distilleries in Cognac).

Javarzay Castle

Within walking distance lies Chef-Boutonne where you can visit the beautiful castle. This Renaissance castle dates back to 1514 and has been renovated several times over the years. There is a fish pond in the castle park. You can also take walks along the Boutonne river. Here you will also find a nice playground.

properties.name: Camping Seespitz
properties.description:
One of eastern Tyrol’s warmest lakes is 668 metres above sea level: the Walchsee. A beautiful lake where you can enjoy walking, water sports and the fresh mountain air. On the shore of this clear blue lake, you’ll find Camping Seespitz, a modern campsite that’s open all year round.

A wonderful view

At Camping Seespitz, it doesn't really matter which pitch you choose: all of them have electricity connections and free wi-fi and all of them have the same beautiful view. Some pitches do stand out though: the ones closest to the lake are the most beautiful.

The toilet and washing facilities are modern, clean and fully equipped with separate cabins, a baby room, facilities for the less mobile and even a shower for dogs. Washing machines, dryers and a heated ski and boot room the in winter make the comfort complete.

From sunny summers to sporty winters

In summer, life at the campsite focuses on water fun: dive off the jetty, jump on the water trampoline or slide down the slide. The lake also lends itself to a relaxing day of angling or a fun boat trip, with or without water skis. There are special areas where dogs are allowed in the water.

Coming to this beautiful part of Austria in winter? Then the free ski coach gives you a smooth connection to the slopes of Zahmer Kaiser and Hochkössen, where you will enjoy days of winter sports fun.

properties.name: Camping Putterersee
properties.description:
The Austrian campsite Putterersee is a very pleasant, quiet campsite, situated along a small lake at 2 km distance from the town of Aigen im Ennstal (Steiermark). Cows graze peacefully all day on the adjacent meadows. All around you there you will see green grass, sloping hills and woods. On the lake you can show off your sporty side: paddle surfing, canoeing and swimming.

The attractive grounds

Camping Putterersee is a very neat and perfectly maintained campsite with 70 touring pitches on grass. The grounds are spacious, level and is located between surrounding farmhouses. You also have a view of the Putterersee and the often lavishly flowering meadows and surrounding green hills. Enjoy the ambience, peace and quiet so appreciated by many campers.

There are only two pitches for campers. You can also rent overnight accommodation on the campsite, such as a lovely apartment, room or hiker hut.

Swimming in a warm lake

The lake is unique because of its relatively warm water, which makes swimming here really enjoyable. There is a long jetty leading into the water and there is a modest sandy beach. You can float around in your inflatable boat or go canoeing/kayaking. A very good idea here: paddle surfing!

Typical Austrian Imbiss

The campsite has a small shop for daily necessities. A small supermarket is found 2 km away, in Aigen im Ennstal. You can eat in the Imbiss, obviously with typical Austrian look and decor.

Sanitary facilities

The sanitary facilities are amazingly well designed, certainly for a transit campsite. It is generous in size and very clean. All shower rooms have a separate wash basin.

properties.name: Camping Paradise Garden
properties.description:
Peace seekers and nature lovers beware! At this campsite in the Austrian Wienerwald Forest, you will camp among forests and green hills with grazing sheep. You will stay in the middle of nature, away from the hustle and bustle, on a farm campsite. The owner of Paradise Garden campsite is a sheep and fruit farmer. You will make the most beautiful walking and cycling trips in the surroundings. And do you fancy a bit more liveliness and culture? The beautiful Austrian capital Vienna is only 50 kilometres from the campsite.

Green, spacious pitches

When you arrive at Paradise Garden campsite, you will see neat and tidy green grounds. About half of the pitches are permanent pitches. The tourist pitches are on a nice flat grassy field. You will camp on a spacious pitch of over 100 m². There are several apple trees on the site, providing shade. From your pitch, you have a view of the beautiful green hills.

Take lovely walks and visit Vienna

The surroundings of Paradise Garden campsite are perfect for lovely hiking and cycling trips. In the Wienerwald are many forests, streams, caves, valleys and hills. Feel like something other than nature? Then visit Vienna (50 km). Schönbrunn Palace is one of the city's highlights and famous for Sissi. In this magnificent palace, 40 of its 1,400 rooms are open to the public. In addition, the palace is surrounded by a beautiful park, where you can enjoy a stroll.

properties.name: Camping Reussbrücke
properties.description:
The Swiss campsite Reussbrücke is located a half-hour drive from the city of Zürich. This mid-sized campsite has 110 sites. The Reuss river flows along the campsite. There is a modest swimming pool to cool off in. Camping guests enjoy daily fresh bread and can get a bite in the restaurant of the campsite.

Camping by the water

A warm welcome awaits you at the reception. Then you will be taken to your campsite. The mid-sized campsite Reussbrücke has a total of 110 campsites, 60 permanent and 50 tourist pitches. Some campsites are paved and some are on a neat lawn. The most beautiful campsites are right on the river. Campers without any camping equipment can hire a caravan.

Swimming pool and playground

For a refreshing dip in the summer, just jump into the outdoor pool at the campsite. It isn't big, but perfect to cool off in. The river Reuss is right next to the campsite. Here you can take a nice trip out on a canoe or kayak. There is plenty to do for young camping guests. There is great table tennis and climbing in the playground is also an option.

Have a tasty bite

Every day, camping guests can order fresh bread. That's a good start to the day. There is also a little camping shop with a limited selection of groceries. There is a larger supermarket in the village of Ottenbach. In the evening you can have a bite at the campsite restaurant. It is a cosy building with quite a small menu.

properties.name: Bergwitzsee Resort
properties.description:
The Bergwitzsee Resort is situated right on the shores of Lake Bergwitz. It’s a lovely spot for campers, families and those in search of peace and quiet in the heart of nature. Here, you can camp in lush green surroundings, with the lake as the centrepiece.

Camping by or on the water

The resort offers plenty of choice. You can bring your tent, caravan or motorhome, or opt for a bungalow, holiday home or apartment. The campsite is spacious and features various zones, from a lively family area right by the water to quieter spots a little further away from the hustle and bustle. Electricity is available everywhere and dogs are welcome.

The floating holiday homes on Lake Bergwitz are truly unique. You can literally sleep on the water here! The homes feature two bedrooms, a kitchen and a charming living room. On hot days, the air conditioning will keep you cool, while you can cosy up next to the fireplace on chilly evenings.

Everything you need

On the site, you will find several modern toilet blocks, a beach with a sunbathing area, and all sorts of sports and recreational facilities. Children can entertain themselves at the playground or by the lake. For motorhome owners, there is a separate motorhome area with its own check-in machine, waste disposal point, camperclean station and electricity hook-ups.

A wonderful holiday at the sea

The Bergwitzsee is the heart of the resort. Swimming, stand-up paddleboarding, sailing, fishing or simply relaxing on the shore – you can do it all here. There is also a volleyball court, table tennis and a station for hiring bicycles, boats and children’s pedal cars. Fancy a day out? The resort is located in the Dübener Heide, close to well-known places such as the UNESCO World Heritage sites of Wittenberg (16 km) and Dessau (30 km).

properties.name: Kongsøre Camping
properties.description:
Do you like to spend your holidays in a quiet rural environment? Then this campsite on the Danish island of Seeland is perfect for you. The campsite is located among grain fields and is a great place to start beautiful walks and cycling tours across Seeland. That’s because Kongsøre Camping is right on the Ice Age Trail. This is a beautiful cycle route that leads through forests and along fjords. This small campsite has large touring pitches with panoramic views. In high season, many fun activities are organised, for adults and (young) children.

Large pitches with panoramic views

Upon arrival, you are welcomed by the enthusiastic couple who own the campsite: Dorte and Henrik. On this well-maintained campsite, you will find a long lane with side paths on both sides, where the large pitches are located. Some of the pitches are separated by hedges, trees and/or bushes. Almost all the touring pitches have a panoramic view of the Grevinge hills, etc.

Besides pitches, Kongsøre Camping rents out accommodation too. Several rooms, four large caravans, five cosy hiker's huts and even three shelters. A shelter is the perfect place to experience authentic camping life while enjoying a campfire.

Outdoor swimming pool for young and old

Close to the campsite entrance, you will find a beautiful outdoor pool. This is an L-shaped pool with a separate section especially for (young) children. There is a small slide for them to slide down as well.

Plenty of fun activities

In the summer, Kongsøre Camping often organises fun activities, especially for children. Activities include face painting, baking rolls, crafts and crab rides.

properties.name: Løkken Klit Camping
properties.description:
Looking for a comfortable five-star campsite with plenty of entertainment for families with (young) children? Then a holiday at Løkken Klit Camping near the town of Løkken (North Jutland) is an excellent choice. There is plenty to do here, from a fantastic water park to a fun little campsite train, and from a mini zoo to a varied entertainment programme. The campsite also has a self-service shop and a welcoming bistro. Its location near the port of Hirtshals (35 km) is also convenient; ideal for travellers passing through on their way to or from Norway.

Large touring pitches and modern cottages

Would you like to book one or more nights at Løkken Klit Camping? There are two options. You can choose to stay in a modern cottage, or sleep in your own accommodation on one of the touring pitches. All touring pitches are spacious and clearly marked out by neat hedges. On site, you’ll also find various service buildings with fully equipped kitchens, where everything you need to cook a delicious meal is provided. A professional dishwasher is available free of charge for washing up.

A wonderful family holiday

During the school holidays, this campsite is a great destination for families with children. An enthusiastic entertainment team organises all sorts of activities during this time. These include sports tournaments, children’s discos, educational workshops and cosy film nights. Apart from that, children can enjoy themselves in the playgrounds, on the sports fields, at the mini zoo and on a ride on the Futte, the campsite train that runs around the grounds.

There is also a beautiful outdoor swimming pool. The large pool, the two spectacular water slides and the paddling pool guarantee hours of fun splashing around. Day tickets are available for access to the swimming pool at Løkken Klit Camping.

properties.name: Camping Mitte
properties.description:
This well-maintained German campsite is located in a rural area near the picturesque village of Medelby, just a stone's throw from the Danish border. Mitte Campsite is frequently visited by travellers on their way to Scandinavia, but there are also many guests who enjoy a wonderful holiday here.
