At the campsite itself, you can have a great time in the indoor and outdoor swimming pool, relax in one of the four saunas, and the children can enjoy themselves on the playground. There is also plenty to do in the area. The lovely German harbour town of Flensburg is just 30 minutes away by car.

Unwind at Mitte Campsite

When you arrive at the campsite, you will see the reception building with a small shop immediately past the gate. You will be warmly welcomed by the friendly hosts, Bruno and Volker. They'll do everything they can to make your stay as pleasant as possible. Dogs are also welcome here. You will quickly feel at home at this wonderful place in the state of Schleswig-Holstein, where you completely relax and unwind.

Large pitches and beautiful accommodations

With approximately 150 pitches (up to 130 m2), you will always find a spot that suits you at Mitte Campsite. You'll be camping on large fields demarcated by neatly maintained hedges. Your neighbours are often at least 30 metres away, so you'll have plenty of privacy.

Don't have your own camping equipment? That's no problem here. The campsite offers various rental accommodations, including a flat, fully equipped caravans with awning, and a mobile home.

properties.name: Camping & Ferienpark Brilon
properties.description:
Less than three hours drive from the Dutch border and you find yourself in a completely different world: the mountains and forests of Sauerland. The terraced grounds of Camping & Ferienpark Brilon are situated on a hill overlooking the surrounding area. For hikers and cyclists the mountainous landscape, with the Rothaar Mountains as the highest part of Sauerland, is a true paradise. The area is also ideal for winter sports enthusiasts.

Pitches with panoramic view

Very spacious, well-tended touring pitches fill the terraced grassy area of the campsite. Although a large forest extends over the hill at the edge of the campsite, the campsite itself has a very open character. There is very little vegetation on the terraces, apart from hedges demarcating the pitches. That's a good thing, because then you have every chance to enjoy the beautiful panoramic view of the surrounding hills as much as possible from your pitch.

For walkers and cyclists

Most of the guests at Camping & Ferienpark Brilon travel by bicycle or mountain bike on the back of their camping equipment and hiking boots in the travel bag. During the day you won't encounter many of your fellow campers at the campsite, as the surroundings invite you to go for long walks and bike rides.

Mountain huts

The fact that this is a campsite where most campers are out all day is also reflected in the facilities. They are small and fairly simple. The sanitary facilities are clean and good, but the campsite does not have a shop or restaurant. Not a problem in itself, because there are plenty of cosy mountain huts and restaurants nearby where you can eat for a very reasonable price.

properties.name: See-Areal Steindorf
properties.description:
If you are looking for a quiet campsite in a mountainous area, a trip to the north-eastern side of Lake Ossiach in Carinthia (Austria) is certainly recommended. Directly next to the lake you will find this small-scale campsite with a friendly atmosphere. Camping See-Areal Steindorf is located between several imposing mountain ranges. An ideal base for hiking enthusiasts, but also for mountain bikers and practitioners of other mountain sports. On the campsite you will find an excellent restaurant, luxurious sanitary facilities, a large grassy lawn and a swimming jetty, from where you can take a refreshing dip in the lake.

Neat camping area

On the well-kept campsite, the tourist camping spots are situated on both sides of the central path. As a camper, you have no neighbours on the rear side. Furthermore, most spots enjoy a fair bit of sunshine. In addition to touring spots, there are a few apartments for rent.

At the Ossiacher See

See-Areal Steindorf has its own grassy fields at the Ossiacher See. Directly from the campsite you can take a wonderful, refreshing dip in the lake. There are a few bathing jetties from where you have easy access to the water, which remains shallow for a long time at the shore. You can also water ski, sup and sail on this lake, for example in a rowing boat.

Enjoy a nice meal in the restaurant

On the waterfront you will find the welcoming restaurant belonging to this campsite: Seerestaurant Steindorf. Enjoy a delicious meal while admiring beautiful views of the lake and surrounding mountains.

properties.name: Gudhjem Camping
properties.description:
The Danish island of Bornholm is a paradise for cyclists, water sports enthusiasts and nature lovers. Here you can enjoy beautiful views of the rocky coast, the beautiful green interior and the cosy towns. Thanks to an excellent network of cycle paths and boat connections, all of these beautiful places are easily accessible. Gudhjem Camping is located directly on the cliff coast. This is a beautifully maintained terraced campsite with a fantastic view of the sea. Take a refreshing dip from the pebble beach or enjoy a breath of fresh air while walking on the rocky paths along the coast.

Unique views

The first thing you'll notice when you arrive at the campsite is the beautiful view of the coastal cliffs. The campsite is located on a beautifully maintained and open piece of land that slopes down to the sea. The terrain is terraced and sloping. This gives you a beautiful view of the Baltic Sea from pretty much all camping pitches. It is useful to bring wheel chocks so that you can place your caravan or motorhome in a stable position. There are about 150 unmarked camping pitches and a few rental tents.

Active campers

You'll receive a warm welcome from the helpful and enthusiastic manager. The campsite attracts a nice crowd of hikers, water sports enthusiasts and cyclists. Groups of kayakers also come here during low season. The guests are mostly Danish and German seniors, but younger nature lovers also enjoy coming to the campsite. There are no special facilities for children. The sanitary facilities look a bit dated, but are still neat and clean.

properties.name: Skive Fjord Camping
properties.description:
Skive Fjord Camping is situated in one of the most beautiful spots on the Limfjord in Jutland, Denmark. Here, you will be surrounded by water, greenery and tranquillity. From your pitch, you can look out over the fjord and hear nothing but the sound of the wind. The campsite has a terraced layout, so you get a wonderful view from anywhere. Best of all, the charming town of Skive is nearby, offering shops, restaurants and everything else you could possibly need for a relaxing holiday.

Camping with a view

At Skive Fjord Camping, camping truly feels like freedom. The pitches are situated on spacious terraced levels overlooking the water, ideal for anyone who loves nature and open spaces. The rosehip hedges provide a bit of privacy and add a lovely scent to the air. Whether you are travelling with a caravan, motorhome or tent, there is always a spot to suit you. Prefer a bit more comfort? Then the charming tiny houses are the perfect solution. Attractively and practically furnished, all with that same stunning view.

Fun on the water, camping ponies and a ‘krolf’ course

There is plenty to do at this campsite. Take a dip in the solar-heated swimming pool, or relax on one of the sun loungers by the pool. Children can enjoy endless fun at the playgrounds with pirate ship, zip line and climbing towers. For those looking for a little something special, you can hop into a glass-bottomed kayak and discover the underwater life of the fjord. Or go for a ride on the campsite ponies – a real treat for young campers. And how about a game of ‘krolf’, a cross between croquet and mini-golf?

properties.name: Arrild-Ferieby-Campingen
properties.description:
In the town of Arrils, some 30 km north of the border with Germany, lies the Arrild-Ferieby-Campsite. You camp here on spacious pitches with lots of privacy. Bring your own camping equipment or rent a caravan or exceptionally nice trekker hut. All family members can keep themselves busy on the campsite with the many sports facilities and the nearby Arrild-Svømmehal swimming pool. You can enjoy a quick meal in the campsite restaurant.

Camping with shade and privacy

The campsite has some 250 generous touring pitches, varying from 100 to 140 m². The level terrain with grass surface is very suitable for camping. Tent campers will agree with this. The camping has recently been extended with an area with newly planted vegetation. Most pitches are sheltered from the wind by trees and hedges. As a result you also have ample privacy. If you don't have your own camping equipment you can hire a caravan or trekker hut. 

Swimming pool with exceptional slide

Directly next to the campsite you will find a large swimming paradise. Ideal for a swimming a few laps in the heated swimming pool (250 m²). Also good fun: slide down the longest slide (one hundred metres) in Denmark, complete with lovely light and sound effects. Guests of the campsite are given 25% discount on a day ticket for the swimming pool.

Sports entertainment

Active campers won't believe their luck. You can play a game of tennis, table tennis, volleyball, go horseback riding or fishing on the campsite, or enjoy walking and cycling in the area. Also fun with the whole family: a game of mini golf or jeu de boules! Children can enjoy themselves on the bouncy castle or in the large playground with climbing equipment and sand bath.

properties.name: Rosenvold Strand Camping
properties.description:
Rosenvold Strand Camping is located in the east of the Danish region of Central Jutland. This fairly large family campsite is well visited, especially by Danish families. The campsite looks well maintained and borders directly on the Vejle Fjord beach. For a small extra charge, you can even choose a pitch with sea view. You can sunbathe for hours on the wide sandy beach - and the lawn behind it - and build the most beautiful sandcastles together with the children.

A spot with sea view

You are here on a fairly large family campsite where there is a lot to do early in the season. The pitches are well maintained and are situated on different fields separated by low hedges and small roads. Pitches with a sea view are available for a small extra charge. The sanitary facilities are spread over two locations: an older and a newer building.

Regional football tournament for campers

On the campsite there is something to do for every member of the family. Sports enthusiasts will enjoy themselves on the sports field where you can play volleyball and football. Every year a football tournament is organised in cooperation with other campsites in the area to determine which campsite has the best football players. For smaller children there is a separate play ground and animal lovers can cuddle with the small goats in the petting zoo.

Groceries

Facilities on the campsite are fairly limited, but you can buy fresh bread and other essentials in the small campsite shop every day. In Stouby (4 km away) you'll find a supermarket for more extensive shopping.

properties.name: Campingplatz Sonnenkap
properties.description:
Campingplatz Sonnenkap is right by the town of Prenzlau, in the north of the German state of Brandenburg. This campsite is in the Landkreis Uckermark. Over half this region is a protected nature reserve. This rural area is wonderful for cycling through the forests, small villages and meadows. You will also find many small and large lakes in Uckermark. This well-maintained campsite with spacious pitches is by one of the lakes. There is a restaurant, and you can relax in the wellness facilities.

Spacious touring pitches and various types of accommodation

There are various categories of camping pitches. If you appreciate a lot of extra room, you are best booking a premium pitch. Furthermore, there is a separate field with pitches for campers passing through and a secluded tent camping field for the ultimate camping experience! Besides spacious tourist pitches, this site also has various types of accommodation.

Go for a refreshing dip in the Unteruckersee

If you cross over the cycle path from the campsite, you reach a beach with grass and sand. From here, you can go for a lovely swim in the Unteruckersee. There are also water sports options on this lovely recreational lake, such as surfing and sailing.

Enjoy regional specialities in the campsite restaurant

You can enjoy delicious meals in the restaurant at Campingplatz Sonnenkap. The menu has small and some large dishes with a regional touch. Beside the reception there is a small shop where you can get basic necessities, regional products and souvenirs. You can go to Prenzlau (3.5 km) for more extensive groceries.

properties.name: A35 Sindal Camping Danmark & Kanoudlejning
properties.description:
A35 Sindal Camping Danmark & Kanoudlejning is located on the outskirts of the village of Sindal, in the Danish north of Jutland. Because of its location, in the north of Denmark, this campsite is ideal as a transit campsite for campers on their way to Scandinavia. But this very well maintained and modern campsite is also a great holiday destination for a longer stay.

Pitches with cosy atmosphere

The pitches on the well-maintained campsite, ten of which are for camper vans, are spacious and are situated on beautiful lawns. There are large hedges every few pitches, which provide the necessary privacy. Tall trees around the campsite give it a cosy atmosphere and provide shade for some of the pitches in sunny weather. You can also rent one of the five nice wooden camping cabins.

Heated swimming pool

Maybe you won't immediately notice it when you drive onto the terrain, but at the front of the campsite is the swimming pool. It's partially hidden behind the main building. There it is situated in a secluded spot, where the camping guests can swim in peace and quiet. The swimming pool - with separate wading pool - is not particularly large, but it is heated.

Together around the campfire

Don't expect a jolly, flashy entertainment programme at Sindal Camping Danmark. As a guest of this campsite you are probably not looking for that either. In the high season, cosy music evenings are organised and you can gather around a large campfire every week. This is also fun for children. They can have a great time on the campsite, because next to the swimming pool there are large playgrounds, sports fields and a bouncy castle.

properties.name: Boeslunde Camping
properties.description:
Boeslunde Camping is set up like a park and located in the rural setting of the Danish island Seeland. There is a splendid view of the countryside from the edge of the campsite. The campsite is located on the site of an old, renovated farm, dating from 1820. It is an ideal destination for nature campsite visitors looking for some peace and quiet. Boeslunde Camping is also very suitable for families with children. The kids will have a great time in the swimming pool with water slide, on the bouncy castle and in the fun, natural playground. Fancy a dip in the sea? The nearest beach is only 3.5 kilometres away.

Spacious pitches on grass

The campsite is beautifully designed, with lots of greenery and gardens, masking the fact that it is a rather large site. Your pitch for this holiday is a spacious pitch with a grass surface. There are also pitches in the shade.

Holidaymakers without their own camping equipment can also stay here. There are rooms and apartments available for families to rent in the farm. The wooden bungalows and log cabins are distributed throughout the campsite.

Heated swimming pool and horseback riding

The heated and partially covered swimming pool is fun for young and old. Fly down the slide or splash with your baby or toddler in the shallow children's section. The fence surrounding it makes it a safe place to play. Sports are available as well: from volleyball to table tennis to horseback riding. Your faithful four-footed friend has also been considered. Dogs are allowed to run free in a fenced in area of grass.

properties.name: Camping Juritz
properties.description:
Campsite Juritz is an amiable and car-free campsite where the guest is king. Enjoy the nature, dive into the heated swimming pool or sit down in the restaurant for a typical Austrian dish. The campsite is situated on the outskirts of Feistritz im Rosental, a small village in the south of Carinthia. Furthermore, you are campsite here in close proximity to the Slovenian border.

Relaxed campsite

Campsite Juritz is a small campsite where you can select your own spot. The grounds actually consist of a large lawn with spacious pitches. It is also a car-free campsite, making it ideal for seekers of peace and quiet and families with children. The sanitary facilities are very luxurious and clean. You will need coins for the showers. 

Swimming in all seasons

The heated swimming pool of the Juritz campsite is ideal. In fine weather, the sliding roof of the swimming pool is opened. And, of course, in inclement weather it is closed again. Those who prefer a dive into natural swimming waters will find a swimming lake, the Ferlacher Stausee, at a five-minute drive away. 

Apart from swimming, children can also enjoy themselves in the special play area on the campsite. Here you will find a jungle gym, playground, trampoline, table tennis table and beach volley field. Every now and then a campfire will be built, on which children can roast marshmallows. One of the highlights is the weekly magic show (in peak season).

Restaurant Juritz

You can enjoy a meal in the Gasthof, which looks very elegant with beautifully set tables. The menu offers a variety of dishes. When the weather is nice, you can sit on the covered terrace located between the trees. In pre-season there are fun grill evenings.

properties.name: Ribe Camping
properties.description:
Ribe Camping is a large, well-kept campsite in southern Denmark. Here you will experience the real camping feeling thanks to the spacious camping pitches and fun, Scandinavian accommodation. The campsite borders the Wadden Sea National Park and the town of Ribe. So enjoy the fresh air by the sea or wander through the colourful streets of Denmark's oldest city! Back on the campsite, prepare the tastiest meals in the large, communal areas with kitchen. The campsite's dog walking area makes this a popular destination with dog lovers.

Camping your way

On the campsite, you will find tranquillity, space and many different pitches and accommodations. So you always park your motorhome on gravel, but can choose a terrace of grass, wood or concrete tiles. Coming with your caravan or tent? On the large pitches, you have all the space you need to enjoy camping life! There are also several accommodations for rent - all with a nice Scandinavian design.

Tailored to perfection

Ribe Camping has all the facilities to make your holiday a success. A lovely swimming pool with paddling pool in the summer months, large communal areas for relaxing and well-equipped kitchens. Also nice: special toilet and shower facilities for the disabled and families. Enjoy a massage at masseur Bruun or take your kids for a go-kart race at the big playground!

On holiday with the dog

Of course, your holiday is not complete without your four-legged friend. On the campsite, you will find a dog walking area with picnic tables and a dog bath in one of the service buildings. So lots of fun for the dog too!

properties.name: Tranum Klit Camping
properties.description:
Tranum Klit Campsite is located in the midst of nature, within walking distance of the North Sea. You can spot squirrels, birds and deer from your green camping pitch. An ideal spot for nature lovers and seekers of peace and quiet. Mountain biking route ‘Tranum Klit Bike Path’ runs along the campsite and there is a private meadow for guests who bring their horse or pony along.

Hidden camping pitches between greenery

The idyllic camping pitches are located between trees and thickets, where the sun also makes a regular appearance. Here you enjoy the tranquillity around you. The spacious pitches offer sufficient space for your tent and vehicle. Don't have your own camping equipment? Nestled among the trees you will find renovated log cabins with a terrace and barbecue. 

The perfect spot for a game of hide-and-seek

Tranum Klit Campsite attracts a large number of nature lovers who are looking for peace and quiet. A large proportion of the guests are Danish, German and Dutch. Children and grandchildren are very welcome here as well. The sheltered surroundings and secret hideaways are ideal for an exciting game of hide-and-seek. 

Blue Flag: sandy beach ‘Jammerbugt’

There are several footpaths from the campsite leading to the beach. The shortest route is one and a half km. You can reach the sandy beach of Jammerbugt by bicycle in approximately five minutes. The beach was awarded the Blue Flag ecolabel; this means that the beach is clean and safe. The environment is also taken into account.

properties.name: Hestehaven Camping
properties.description:
Hestehaven Camping is situated in a lovely spot in Djursland, Denmark, close to the beach and the countryside. This friendly family campsite is known for its spacious pitches, green hedges and relaxed atmosphere. Whether you’re taking a dip in the heated swimming pool, going for a walk to the beach or simply relaxing at your pitch: at Hestehaven Camping, you can really unwind. At the same time, there’s plenty to do for families and active holidaymakers.

Spacious camping with lots of privacy

At Hestehaven Camping, you’ll camp on spacious, clearly marked pitches. The natural partitions formed by the birch hedges provide plenty of privacy and a green, natural feel. Whether you’re travelling with a tent, caravan or motorhome, there’s always a pitch that suits you. Thanks to the sheltered layout, the site feels peaceful and well-organised. Prefer a bit more comfort? Then you can choose one of the luxury accommodations on the campsite.

Swim, have fun and relax

The campsite features modern facilities to make your stay extra comfortable. The heated swimming pool is a popular spot for both young and old. Swim a few laps or splash about with the children. For the youngest campers, there is a modern playground with a bouncy castle where they can entertain themselves for hours. All sorts of fun activities are also organised. For example, the legendary pool parties for children, complete with inflatable toys, games, music and free ice cream. There are also regular live music evenings. Everything you need for a carefree and relaxing camping holiday is here.

properties.name: Hygge Strand Camping
properties.description:
Hygge Strand Camping is located in central Jutland, centrally between Aarhus and Horsens. You camp here almost directly by the sea, which brings a lot of water fun. Relaxing on the beach or enjoying a walk is of course also a good idea. The fresh sea air will do you good! Hygge Strand Camping's campsite is flat, green and taut.

Camping on a beautiful terrain

Hygge Strand Camping is a spacious campsite with beautiful touring pitches. These pitches are situated in straight lines, on beautiful lawns. The grass is neatly mowed. There are small hedges to demarcate the pitches, but there are hardly any trees. You will therefore often have to create your own shadow.

In addition to the touring pitches, this campsite has permanent annual pitches and camper pitches. The pitches for camper owners and tent campers have a table and benches to use. If you don't have your own camping equipment, you can stay in a hiker's hut or appartment.

Water fun for everyone

The beach (awarded Blue Flag status) is just a hundred metres away. The sea here is ideal for families with young children. The water runs down slowly. You will find a jetty to jump into the water. Other facilities here include toilets and a shop.

Games and sports

Those who prefer to enjoy themselves on dry land can go in all directions. Children can go to the playground or jumping cushions. All kinds of sporting entertainment is also possible. Challenge the neighbours to a game of petanque. There is also a multi-sports field for playing football or basketball.

properties.name: Tårup Strand Camping
properties.description:
Tårup Strand Camping is a tranquil campsite on the east coast of the island of Funen. From the campsite you have an unrestricted view of the strait and Sjælland. This is a well maintained campsite which is run with a great deal of enthusiasm. Do you like nature, fun on and around the water, fishing and the odd (cultural) trip thrown in? You can stop right here!

Well maintained and typical Danish

Upon arrival the campsite makes a well maintained first impression. The reception is located in an old, typical Danish farmstead. On the campsite you will find spacious, beautiful pitches on grass with an attractive view. Near the water is a large lawn which slopes down towards the sea.

Sea view

The campsite has beautiful spacious pitches on grass. The pitches overlooking the sea are the most popular. The grounds are fairly open; some pitches have a bit more shade. In addition to Dutch, Belgian and German guests, you will also see a number of Danish visitors who return each year. You can also rent trekker huts.

Own beach

From the grounds you can walk onto the pebble beach where you can play, swim and sunbathe. Windsurfing and waterskiing are also allowed. There is a fun playground including a bouncer for children. In addition, you can play beach volleyball, table tennis and bocce (similar to jeu-de-boule).

Basic shop

There is a small shop near the reception for basic necessities, such as fresh rolls in the morning. The rest of your grocery shopping can be done at the village supermarket in Tårup. The sanitary facilities are neat and tidy.

properties.name: Skovly Camping
properties.description:
The campsite is situated in a wooded area on Denmark’s largest island, Zealand. No matter where you are on the island, the coast is never more than 52 kilometres away. Outdoor living takes centre stage at Skovly Camping. From the campsite, you can walk straight into the woods to explore the surroundings. At this green campsite, you can truly unwind amidst the Danish countryside. There are fishing spots available and, in nice weather, you can cool off in the swimming pool.

Back to basics

When you first drive onto the campsite, it may seem a bit rough around the edges initially.

But once you’re inside, it’s a truly lovely spot. Guests are given a warm welcome and outdoor enthusiasts will enjoy a wonderful holiday here. There are guests who return every year to use their annual pitches. But there are plenty of touring pitches for summer campers. If you don’t have your own camping equipment, the campsite also offers a range of accommodation options.

Child-friendly campsite

Children are very welcome at the campsite. While there is no entertainment team organising major activities every day, there are plenty of things planned during the high season. Creative children can take part in workshops. For bingo, the children’s cards are filled with characters so that youngsters from different countries can all join in. You can also go on a treasure hunt, take an evening stroll or have dinner by the campfire. On the campsite, there is a covered recreation room, a swimming pool and a mini-golf course, which you can use for a fee.

properties.name: Feriebyens Camping
properties.description:
On the Danish island of Seeland, near the town of Rødvig, is the small Feriebyens Camping. The camping area is uncluttered and consists of small grass camping fields. Children easily find their way to the bouncy castle and sandpit here. You can make really big sandcastles a kilometre away, on the extensive beach of the Baltic Sea. A short bike ride will take you to one of Denmark's most extraordinary landscape phenomena - the chalk cliff formation Cliffs of Stevns.

Sheltered camping pitches

The Danish landscape is open and rolling. A border of trees surrounding the site provides much-needed shelter. Pitches are also separated by trees and bushes. The well-maintained lawn is divided into spacious pitches. Besides camping pitches, Feriebyens Camping also has several hiker's huts. This is handy if you are passing through. Do you want more luxury? Then rent a furnished glamping tent.

Taking the go-kart for a spin

The atmosphere on the campsite is quiet and child friendly. Don't expect an entertainment programme here. Play facilities are simple, matching the friendly atmosphere. For example, your kids can pedal around the campsite on a go-kart. Swimming is possible in the sea, which is within walking distance. Near the friendly fishing village of Rødvig are several child-friendly sandy beaches. On the campsite, you can buy tasty bread rolls and essential groceries.

Chalk cliffs full of fossils

The area around Feriebyens Camping is great for hiking and cycling. The Cliffs of Stevns (7.5 km) is a destination you should definitely not miss. This coast with white chalk cliffs full of fossils is a Unesco World Heritage Site.

properties.name: Camping am Königsberg
properties.description:
Camping am Königsberg is situated amongst the green hills in the middle of the Lautertal nature reserve, in the German Rhineland-Palatinate. This is an ideal place to relax and enjoy nature. You can take beautiful hiking and cycling trips through forests and along rivers and castle ruins in the area. This campsite has spacious, level camping pitches. Children will have a great time on the playground or with a game of mini golf.

Spacious campsite

When you arrive at Camping am Königsberg, you'll immediately notice the well-kept and spacious grounds. The pitches are level and have a grass surface. There's abundant vegetation, which provides privacy and shade. All 100 camping pitches are supplied with electricity and almost all have a water and drainage connection. There are also some nice rental accommodations. There's a special Route 66 mobile home and an attractive Iglu. Your four-legged friend is also welcome at this campsite.

Clean and unique sanitary facilities

The modern and luxurious sanitary facilities, which were renovated a few years ago, are striking. The showers have two shower heads, and there is free shampoo and shower gel. There are also special sanitary facilities for disabled people. And showering is a blast for children! There are beautiful children's sanitary facilities with a jungle theme.

Water recreation in the nearby swimming pool

Next to the campsite is a municipal outdoor swimming pool, which is open from mid-May to mid-September. As a camping guest you can use this for free. This pool also has a separate paddling pool, a springboard and two jumping towers.

properties.name: Terrassen-Camping am Richterbichl
properties.description:
Terrassen-Camping am Richterbichl is right on the Romantische Straße, the popular tourist route in Germany. The campsite is within walking distance of the town of Rottenbuch, in an area where you can go on endless walks and bike rides. Fancy a refreshing swim? There is a swimming pond where guests can cool down on hot days.

Breakfast at the campsite

Terrassen-Camping am Richterbichl is a medium-sized campsite with 50 camping pitches. If you don't have your own camping equipment, you can spend the night in a wine barrel, wooden house or apartment.

The main building with reception, the toilet and washing facilities and the restaurant is at the campsite entrance. You can enjoy breakfast, snacks and simple meals at the restaurant with patio. There is also a small campsite shop where you can go for basic necessities and some local products.

Water fun

There is a large swimming pond on the edge of the campsite, which provides refreshment on hot days. There is a large meadow around the water so you can completely relax and unwind. For children, there is a small playground with a trampoline and table tennis table. There is also a small petting zoo with rabbits, chickens and tortoises.

Romantische Straße

Terassen-Camping am Richterbichlis is right on the Romantische Straße. This popular car route runs through stunning landscapes and the idyllic villages of Bavaria. The route is 385 kilometres long, starting in Würzberg and ending in the German Alps. Rottenbuch, within walking distance of the campsite, is one of the villages on the route. This village is known for the monastery church: Ehemalige Klosterkirche Mariä Geburt.

properties.name: Campingplatz Bergmühle
properties.description:
You camp at this friendly family campsite in a quiet and natural green part of the German state of Lower Saxony. Campingplatz Bergmühle is an idyllic campsite with a lovely atmosphere, rurally located in a forest and by River Innerste. The campsite is south of the city of Hanover, close to several motorways. Thanks to the good accessibility, this is also a great location when passing through. Although the campsite is close to the motorway, you can hardly hear the traffic. Some of the pitches are right by the river and the toilet and washing facilities are well maintained. The old watermill and the accompany nostalgic building are real eyecatchers and give this campsite a rural charm.

Camping by the watermill

When you arrive at the small campsite, the first thing you will notice is that the site has been fitted out with a lot of care and attention and is also suitable for cycling campers. On the site behind an old watermill, the neat campsite has various types of spacious camping pitches, with or without shade.

Cool down in the river

You can have a wonderful time and enjoy the outdoor life to the full at this campsite. A swim in the river is lovely in hot weather. Children can have fun playing there. Furthermore, there is a miniature golf course and a playground to run around and play in. If you fancy a bite to eat in the evening, there is a restaurant only a kilometre away or get a pizza at the campsite. There is also a small café at the campsite next to reception, where they also sell some basic necessities and fresh sandwiches.

properties.name: wecamp Jávea
properties.description:
Wecamp Jávea has a beautiful location in a popular part of the Costa Blanca. For years, it's been a popular region for campers from all over Europe to spend the winter. The great location with a beautiful view to the Montgó Massif, as well as the helpful owner, ensure that everyone quickly feels at home here. The village of the same name offers sea, hills, valleys, cliffs, and a wonderful pebble beach in particular: Cala de la Barraca.

Amongst the orange trees

You reach the gate of the campsite, which is amongst the orange trees, via a long driveway. The beautiful large pool is installed on a spacious lawn, and lies towards the front of the camping grounds. In the beautifully landscaped garden and lawn, you can enjoy a view of the Montgó Massif while relaxing in a sunbed. There's a bar and a tennis court on the central square of the campsite, and the English-speaking owner is always keen to help guests.

Well-maintained pitches

There's a canvas stretched over most of the pitches, which offers a pleasant amount of shade all day long. There are also a few pitches intended for people staying the winter, without a 'roof'. The format of the pitches differs, and they are all set on a surface of gravel. Your neighbours will be a good distance away. The pitches are on rectangular fields that are separated from each other by narrow paths, with some trees and greenery here and there. Please note that camping with your own tent is not allowed on this campsite. If you prefer to spend the night in a bungalow, that's also an option. Fully-equipped rentals for 2 or 4 people are next to the camping pitches.

properties.name: wecamp Cala Montgó
properties.description:
Wecamp Cala Montgó is at walking distance from the Mediterranean Sea between the Spanish cities of Girona and Figueres. With the lively coastal resort of l'Escala around the corner with its stunning beach, water sports options, great shops, bars and restaurants. Everything is about comfort at this very well-maintained family campsite. The swimming pool and the luxury glamping accommodation are the main attractions. The campsite is also an ideal starting point for fun excursions in the vicinity.

Under the pine trees

On the map of wecamp Cala Montgó, you can see that the site is made up of two parts. The upper part of the campsite has been renovated and the lower part is the original part of the campsite. You will see fir trees all over, which provide plenty of lovely shade in the summer. The spacious pitches are spread over several terraces. For the construction of the toilet block, light, sustainable materials have been used that fit in with the natural surroundings. Please note that camping with your own tent is not allowed on this campsite.

Glamping for everyone

Much of the site consists of stylish, modern glamping accommodation with lovely furniture. Besides the modern furnished mobile homes and wooden bungalows, the campsite offers lovely tents that look fresh and clean.

The swimming pool or the sea

The beautiful outdoor swimming pool is on the top part of the campsite, by the restaurant and large patio. It consists of two different swimming pools encircled by palm trees and a lovely sunbathing meadow with sun loungers for a well-deserved siesta. You don't have to walk far for a refreshing swim in the sea. You arrive at a 'Blue Flag' beach by the Mediterranean Sea.

properties.name: Sunêlia Domaine Les Nids Du Lac
Camping l’Océan et Spa
properties.description:
You will find Camping l'Océan et Spa in the very heart of the island of Ile de Ré, near the charming fishing village of La Couarde-sur-Mer. This luxury campsite lies between the sea and the salt marshes that have made the island famous. The paradise island of Ile de Ré, just off La Rochelle, is one of the busiest holiday destinations in the Charente-Maritime. The campsite is centrally located; just fifty metres from the sea and five minutes from the centre of La Couarde-sur-Mer.

More than enough choice

Camping l'Océan et Spa offers a variety of camping options. For example, there are pitches in four different grades; standard, comfort, comfort plus and privilege. They are all large, green plots bounded by hedges. The comfort, comfort plus and privilege pitches are also equipped with a water tap and electricity. In addition, you can choose a fully equipped mobile home or a lodge.

Water fun galore

The most popular feature of this luxury campsite is without doubt the water park. Here you will find two large, heated pools and a heated paddling pool. In addition, l'Océan et Spa campsite has a spa and wellness centre including a hammam, sauna, whirlpool bath and hydro-massage bath. For even more water fun, you can, of course, seek out the sea. The campsite is only fifty meters from the beach.

Daily fresh oysters

Camping l'Océan et Spa has a large bar-restaurant with an extensive menu. There is also a supermarket for all your daily needs. If you prefer to go 'out' for a bite La Couarde-sur-Mer is the place to be. The seafood restaurants near the harbour are proud to serve the local speciality: daily fresh oysters!

properties.name: Camping O Muiño
properties.description:
Do you love camping by the sea? Then the campsite O Muiño is the perfect spot for you. Right on the water with the sound of the crashing waves and beautiful views of the cliff coast and Atlantic Ocean. With fresh and clean sanitation, a restaurant with great fish and meat dishes and its own swimming pool. And the bar, supermarket and the lovely atmosphere complete this campsite.

The numbered sites are not very large, but are sufficient for a pleasant stay. Water and electricity are nearby each site. You can park for free on the car park outside of the campsite.

Dining and shopping

The restaurant of O Muiño offers good meals, and the service is helpful and friendly. At the front there is a small terrace to linger on. The supermarket is located between the restaurant and reception. You'll find your daily needs there. At this site you will also find the large toilet building with enough showers and toilets for the number of guests. The building is in good condition. There is also a small toilet building at the beach, which can be reached via stairs from the campsite.

The rugged coast in this part of Spain is very rocky and not really suitable for swimming. No problem, just jump into the outdoor pool on the campsite, from where you have a great view of the cliffs and the sea.

Pilgrimage Route

A large number of the guests at O Muiño come from Spain. In addition, there are many German and Dutch families and walkers on their way to Santiago de Compostella.

properties.name: Camping Baliera
properties.description:
Campsite Baliera is located in the Spanish Pyrenees, near the cute village of Bonansa, and is a lovely starting point for nature lovers and outdoor sports enthusiasts for discovering the lovely, varied nature. On the campsite you'll find spacious pitches, comfortable accommodations, green fields and many trees.

Walk through the lovely nature

At the middle point of the valleys Isabena, Benasque, Aran and Boi and between the (in summer) green mountain slopes you will find Camping Baliera. This campsite is easy to reach via the Vielha tunnel and the towns of Huesca and Barbastro. From the campsite you can take wonderful walks, both relaxed and more adventurous, through the lovely, diverse nature. Actually, the area is one large nature park.

You can reach the grounds of Campsite Baliera by crossing the bridge over the river on which the campsite is located. You'll be welcomed in the reception building on the campsite. Here you'll find plenty of information about the area and excursions.

For families

There are many families on the campsite in high season. You'll hear plenty of languages around you, because the visitors to campsite Baliera are of various nationalities. In the low season, there are mostly seniors on the campsite.

The swimming pool on the campsite is basic. Perfect for a refreshing dip or an hour of sun on the sunbathing lawn. You can also cool down in the river. For more fun you can play on the sports fields, where in the summer months of July and August there are small scale activities: from soccer competitions to aerobics, from motocross to crafts.

properties.name: El Solsonès Vacances
properties.description:
Campsite El Solsonès Vacances (near the village of Solsona) is in a rolling rural area at the foot of the Pyrenees. The surrounding area is perfect for long walks or cycling trips. Solsona is a quiet town with a medieval centre in the Catalan province of Lerida. The campsite is open year-round. The campsite is run in an ecologically responsible manner.

Simple but well-maintained campsite

El Solsonès Vacances is a simple but well-maintained campsite with part permanent pitches and some touring pitches. The touring pitches are about 80 m2 large and covered with grass. They are a bit bare in the dry summers or are covered with gravel. The trees at the campsite provide plenty of shade. 

The rental accommodations are simple but nice and well-maintained. You can also spend the night in charming igloo pods, luxury tents (glamping) and comfortable bungalows and chalets.

Swimming pool with terrace

The swimming pool is the central point of the campsite. It is surrounded by the terrace of the bar and it's always bustling. The water is ecologically purified. The water in the sanitation facilities is heated with solar boilers. The used water is also recycled.

Taste the local cuisine

The restaurant at the campsite El Solsonès Vacances is wonderful. Thanks to the air conditioning, it's cool there even in the hottest summers. The typical Catalan cuisine is ecologically prepared and the extensive menu has something for everyone. You can get snacks and drinks in the bar and on the terrace by the swimming pool. You can get your everyday needs in the camping shop.

properties.name: Vall d’Or Camping & Beach
properties.description:
Vall d'Or Campsite is located directly on the long sandy beaches of Platja d'Aro (Costa Brava). Here you can enjoy the soothing sound of the waves from your camping pitch. Meanwhile, a wonderful sea breeze and shady trees provide just the right amount of cooling. This is an internationally-oriented campsite that is mainly visited by seniors in the low season - especially those who love the beach life. In the high season, you'll also find many young people and families with children here.

Touring pitches in four comfort levels

Vall d'Or offers several dozen beautiful mobile homes for rent that can each accommodate four to six people. However, the campsite's main focus is on tourist camping pitches. These are available in four comfort levels. The largest touring pitches are about sixty square metres. Furthermore, the pitches are generously shaded and demarcated by trees and plants.

Ideal location for beach and sea lovers

This campsite is ideally located for beach lovers. You can even slip through openings in the campsite fence and walk directly from the camping area onto the sprawling sandy beach located next to the campsite. From there you can take a refreshing dip in the Mediterranean Sea. You can also enjoy beautiful sunrises on the beach.

Crafts, dancing and sports

Vall d'Or Campsite offers plenty of entertainment, especially in the summer months. There's an extensive entertainment programme with fun activities for all ages. The youngest campers can draw, do crafts and participate in gymnastics under expert supervision. For older youth and adults, the campsite offers dance and zumba lessons, pilates sessions and sports competitions, among other things. Fun theme parties are also organised for all camping guests.

properties.name: Camping Unterägeri
properties.description:
Do you enjoy swimming and cycling? Then this campsite on Lake Ägeri is perfect for you. The campsite grounds are mostly situated right on the lake and the campsite has a private pebble beach with a sunbathing lawn exclusively for guests. In the region, you will mostly find lakes surrounded by mountains. The campsite facilities are limited but its beautiful and tranquil location by the lake, the wide views, space, and the natural surroundings more than make up for this.

Grass or gravel?

The 'top' part of this beautifully situated campsite is very hilly. The pitches, however, are all situated on level ground. The pitches are well-maintained. The sizes vary from small to reasonable and spacious. One solution is to park your car at the campsite car park. The pitches are straight and located along straight paths, and are situated on grass or on gravel (for caravans and motorhomes). Everyone is welcome at this campsite because it doesn't cater to a particular group of people.

Swimming and cycling

Lake Ägeri is a wonderful place to go swimming. You can also indulge in all sorts of water sports on the lake. The campsite has its own beach (with small and large pebbles) with a sunbathing lawn for the exclusive use of the guests. The playground is modest and there is no entertainment programme. Children will mostly entertain themselves by, in and on the water. 

Eating

The campsite shop is small but sufficiently stocked. The restaurant is simple, neatly furnished and has a patio.

properties.name: ThürKies See-Camping
properties.description:
ThürKies See-Camping is ideal for campers who like water sports, walking, cycling and a relaxed atmosphere. The campsite is in the green heart of Germany near the Thuringian Forest. Here, you camp in a rural, level area with many forests. The campsite is right by the Alperstedter See. There is a lovely sandy beach by this lake where children can have fun playing. There is also a bar with a lovely patio. The large city of Erfurt is only 11 kilometres to the south.

View of the lake from your tent

The stunning location by Alpenstedter See gives an ultimate camping feeling. The campsite has 70 camping pitches. All spacious pitches are close to the lake, many on grass. If you come camping with a tent, you can pick your own pitch.

Go for a swim in the water

You can walk straight from your camping pitch to the water for a refreshing swim. There is a sandy beach by the lake. If you'd like something active, hire a canoe or a standup paddleboard and go paddleboarding on the lake. There is a small snack bar by the lake where you can get drinks and some snacks.

Start your morning with a yoga class

Although ThürKies See-Camping is a fairly quiet campsite there are a number of activities on the programme in the summer months. Do a yoga class in the morning sun? You can on Sundays. On Saturday evenings, there is live music by the patio and you can enjoy fresh bread rolls in the mornings at weekends.

properties.name: Blushøj Camping - Ebeltoft
properties.description:
Blushøj Camping is situated in Central Jutland, a few kilometres southeast of Ebeltoft, on a large promontory and directly by the sea. The campsite is simple in design, but located in a beautiful setting amidst greenery and is impeccably maintained. Everyone is welcome, but the campsite is mainly frequented by young families. This makes perfect sense, considering the lovely swimming pool and the child-friendly atmosphere.

Space and privacy

The grounds are partly level and partly laid out in terraces. There is ample space and as a result also ample privacy. There is a large diversity of sites and pitches, all on a nice grass surface. You can camp by the sea, or in a more sheltered spot. You can also rent a cabin on Blushøj Camping.

Swimming and more

Children will thoroughly enjoy themselves in the large playground with air cushion and in the large, heated swimming pool, complete with cool slide. There is also a toddler pool. The swimming pool is in a sheltered location and has an adjacent terrace with a few tables and chairs.

Prefer swimming in the sea? That is also an option! There is a walkway leading down to a narrow strip of beach. There is a wooden pier with stairs to get into the water. It is also an excellent starting point for windsurfing.

Eating out of (caravan)doors

The campsite supermarket is well-stocked. You can also buy daily fresh bread here. Do you feel like cooking, but not near the tent? If so, there is a well-equipped kitchen unit with individual cooking areas. If you want to eat out, you will have to go to the nearby, friendly village of Ebeltoft.

properties.name: Campingplatz Wesertal
properties.description:
Campingplatz Wesertal is in a wonderful setting right by River Weser and surrounded by green hills. Here, you can enjoy a peaceful holiday on the campsite or go out and about and explore the lovely surrounding area. The campsite has a restaurant, beer garden and jetty where you can moor your own boat for a fee.

Something for everyone

Campingplatz Wesertal has various types of camping pitches. For campers with a tent, there are pitches with or without electricity. And there are even pitches with a wooden chalet, ideal for rainy days. Campers with a trailer tent, caravan or motorhome can choose from standard, classic and premium pitches. The premium pitches are at least 120 m² in size and have lovely views.

Eating at the campsite

There is a communal kitchen at the campsite that campsite guests can use. You can also choose to have a bite to eat at the campsite restaurant, which is open all year. There is a daily bread roll service for campsite guests and it's possible to have breakfast in the restaurant. There is also a real German beer garden where you can get local beers.

Swimming for free

The campsite does not have a swimming pool but, as a campsite guest, you can use the indoor pool right next to the campsite for free. Rather swim in the open air? You can also swim for free in the outdoor swimming pool in the nearby village of Gieselwerder. That swimming pool is less than four kilometres from the campsite. So you can go for a swim on both hot as well as cold days.

properties.name: Camping Les Cigognes
properties.description:
Camping Les Cigognes is situated along the Haut-Rhin in the Elzas, within walking distance of the village of Cernay. This vibrant village is located 20 kilometres from the sights of Mulhouse. The campsite is especially suitable for people who are looking for peace and quiet and who want to enjoy the natural surroundings. Active families who enjoy being outside in a peaceful environment will also feel at home here. The camping pitches are varied, offering plenty of choices. The regular appearance of storks makes this location unique. The campsite owes its name to these beautiful birds.

Bustling reception

The reception is also an information point for tourist attractions in the area. There is also a small grocery shop for the most basic supplies (fresh bread) and a few local products.

Free choice of pitch

You are free to choose your own pitch. There is a choice of sunny and more shaded spots, but they are all level and spacious. Some of the camping pitches offer a lot of privacy and are surrounded by greenery, others are more open. There are also a couple of charming mobile homes available for rent. The campsite is popular with people passing through, although some campers tend to stay longer because of the tranquillity of the campsite. There are plenty of activities for families with young and older children.

Sunny swimming pool and clean sanitary facilities

There is a basic swimming pool, large enough for you to be able to swim lengths comfortably. The swimming pool is situated in a sunny spot but as a campsite guest, you can make use of the sunshades. The sanitary facilities are divided over a larger and a smaller (more modern) building. The sanitation is neat and clean.

properties.name: Flower Camping Les Dunes
properties.description:
Are you looking for a cosy campsite near the beach? Flower Camping Les Dunes is located in Longeville-sur-Mer, Vendée, opposite Île de Ré. Here you camp in a forest and close to the dunes. The campsite is particularly popular with families with young children and campers who love tranquillity, space and green surroundings. With a large water park, entertainment and beautiful hiking and cycling routes nearby, this campsite is ideal for a relaxing holiday on the Atlantic coast.

Choose your ideal accommodation option

You can choose from shady camping pitches or comfortable rental accommodation. The pitches are distributed among the trees and offer plenty of privacy. They are suitable for tents, caravans and motorhomes. Would you prefer a little more luxury? Then rent a mobile home or lodge with its own bathroom. Some have their own wooden (covered) terrace, where you can an aperitif in the evening. Your pet is also welcome on the campsite.

Splash in the water and zoom down the slide

The big swimming pool is a real eyecatcher on the campsite. Or rather, the XXL water park. Zoom down the slide, relax on a lounger or play water games together. The little ones splash around in the separate paddling pool. Children can also have fun in the playground or on the bouncy castle.

During the high season, activities like sports tournaments and crafting hours are organised. There is a bread service, and you will find several restaurants in the nearby village of Longeville-sur-Mer (6.5 km).

properties.name: Camping Du Bois de la Dame
Camping La Peyrugue
properties.description:
Camping La Peyrugue is a naturally landscaped terraced campsite in the Périgord-Noir, one of the most beautiful areas of the Dordogne. The campsite is situated on the flank of a hill planted with beautiful oaks, walnut trees and pine trees. From some of the pitches the panoramic views are incomparable. With treasure hunts, pony rides, make-up workshops and more, there is plenty of entertainment for children.

Three types of pitches

There are three types of pitches. Are you going for a wooded pitch, a pitch on one of the terraces or a panoramic camping pitch? Feel free to let the campsite management know your preference and they will take this into account as much as possible. In general, all pitches are shaded, although there is also room for sunbathing.

The rental accommodations are set up between the pitches in such a way that they fit in perfectly with the campsite image. In addition, there is a special field where teenagers aged fourteen to eighteen are allowed to camp in their tents without parents or carers.

‘Soirées piscine nocturne’

This campsite has a spacious swimming pool with accompanying paddling pool, where the youngest among us will have fun with water toys. From your lounger by the pool you can enjoy the view over the beautiful surroundings and the castle of Peyruzel. In high season the pool is sometimes opened in the evening for special swimming evenings, the so-called 'soirées piscine nocturne'.

From barbecue evenings

Barbecue evenings often take place in high season. The campsite management provides the barbecue, tables and chairs, while campers bring their own plates, cutlery and food. A great way to meet other campers!

properties.name: Flower Camping Monplaisir
properties.description:
On the Île d'Oléron, in France's Charente-Maritime, you'll find Flower Camping Monplaisir. Here you camp between the sea and the forest domain of the Office National des Forêts. Enjoy the island atmosphere, relax on the nearby beaches and unwind completely. Or seek adventure!

Under the pine trees

The campsite has camping pitches, where you can set up your tent, caravan or motorhome for a wonderful holiday under the pine trees. Or stay in one of the cosy wooden mobile homes! They are all equipped with an atmospheric kitchen, bathroom and terrace, ideal if you are looking for convenience and comfort.

Everything for a relaxing holiday

Take a dip in the heated outdoor pool or play together in the separate paddling pool. Children can blow off steam at the kids' club, and fun activities are organised five times a week during high season. Afterwards, grab a tasty meal at the pizzeria or visit the cosy bar for a drink. Or throw some meat and vegetables on the barbecue, as that is allowed here!

Do you like go on outings during your holiday? On the campsite, you can rent (electric) bikes and mountain bikes. Ideal for an adventurous day in the forest and across the island.

Discover Île d'Oléron

From the campsite, you can easily explore Île d'Oléron. The centre of Oléron is less than a kilometre away and the beaches of Saint-Trojan-les-Bains are also within easy reach. That's just a 10-minute walk! In fact, there are numerous great walking and cycling tours nearby.

properties.name: Camping La Dourbie
properties.description:
In the south of France, near the beautiful village of Saint-Jean-du-Bruel, lies the Flower Camping La Dourbie campsite. The campsite is located by a quiet main road and the river Dourbie. This is a great place for fishing, as well as kayaking and canoeing. In the centre, which is a short 15-minute walk away, a market is held every Thursday.

Comfortable camping!

Flower Camping La Dourbie is a modern campsite in an idyllic, natural setting. The campsite offers spacious, comfortable pitches. They are partially shaded and lie on the banks of the river. The pitches are located along roads and are separated by trees and hedges. There are also fully equipped mobile homes and modest cabins without sanitary facilities.

At this authentic family camping ground, there is plenty to do for both young and old. There are also several pieces of playground equipment, such as a trampoline and an air castle.

Fun in the water

There is a heated outdoor pool and a wading pool at the campsite. This is where you can head when you need to cool off. From the campsite, you also have direct access to the Dourbie. For swimming, this little river is a little too shallow, but you can enjoy paddling or fishing and relax along its banks.

Bites and drinks

Don't feel like cooking? No problem! In fact, the campsite has a snack bar, where you can get yourself a tasty takeaway. There is also a restaurant with a terrace overlooking the pool. You will also find a mini supermarket at the campsite for some small groceries and regional products. This is where you can also get fresh rolls every morning.

properties.name: Flower Camping Le Kerleyou
properties.description:
Flower Camping de Kerleyou is at the edge of the charming port town of Douarnenez, in the middle of Finistère (Brittany region). This campsite is an excellent departure point for outings in lovely Brittany. The campsite is right on the GR34 coastal walking path and there are various lovely towns, vast sandy beaches and impressive nature reserves in the vicinity. The campsite itself is small and hospitable. The park-like site has many plants and flowers. As a camper, you can take advantage of a heated swimming pool with retractable roof, a shop and a fun range of activities, among others.

Wide choice of touring pitches and accommodation

About half of this well-maintained campsite is set up as a camping site. Here, you will find neatly laid out touring pitches on small fields. You can book a shaded pitch, but sunny pitches are also available.

At Flower Camping de Kerleyou, you can also stay in a lovely mobile home or in a charming lodge tent. There are accommodation for two to eight people. One of the mobile homes is wheelchair accessible.

Swimming fun for young and old

You will find the lovely swimming pool right behind the reception. It has a retractable roof, meaning it can also be used on cold and rainy days. The water is always heated to a pleasant temperature of 28 degrees. That is also the case for the open-air paddling pool next to the basic swimming pool.

What other forms of entertainment are there?

At this campsite, you can entertain yourself in the playground, on the table tennis tables, at the jeu de boules court and in the recreation room, where you can borrow board games for free. Additionally, numerous fun activities are organised in the summer months.

properties.name: Flower Camping L'Ile d'Offard
properties.description:
Flower Camping L'Ile d'Offard is a town campsite on the outskirts of Saumur, located on a small island in the Loire. Here you camp under the watchful eye of the Castle of Saumur which is situated on a hill in the centre of town, on the other side of the river. With a wide and varied range of rental accommodation and delimitated touring pitches, the campsite has a place for every camper.

Camping on the Loire

The campsite, which stretches out on both sides of the Loire, offers space for almost 190 touring pitches and over 80 rental units. The many pitches, where the ground is not always level, give the campsite a slightly untidy impression. Nevertheless, the spacious touring pitches are clearly delimitated by hedges and trees. The most beautiful spots on the campsite are for the rental accommodations. You have a wide choice: from luxury lodge tents and chalets to the simpler mobile homes.

International camping public

The campsite attracts an international camping public. The rental accommodations are mainly occupied by families with children, while the touring pitches are occupied by campers of different ages.

Swimming with a view of the castle

The swimming pool is located att the front of the campsite, in a clearing in the sun. Here you can swim while overlooking the Castle of Saumur. Next to a large swimming area are a paddling pool and a whirlpool. Around the pools you will also find a large sun deck with sun loungers. Swimmers get thirsty. Have a drink on the pavement café of the bar!

properties.name: Flower Camping Cap Finistère
properties.description:
Flower Camping Cap Finistère is a cosy family campsite in the south of Brittany about 2 km from the sea. An ideal spot to enjoy a fantastic swimming complex, the South Breton coast, fishing villages and cliffs. There is a bistro (with bar) on the campsite. A daily menu is available a few times per week.

Demarcated pitches in the shade

There are many mobile homes and chalets available on this campsite for regular guests, but there are touring pitches as well for those passing through. The pitches are located along streets on a grass surface. They are demarcated with low hedges. There is a shady tree on nearly every pitch. If you want to rent something, you can rent a mobile home. 

Enjoy a fantastic swimming complex

The swimming complex is in a splendorous setting. For the little ones there is a lovely water park with a shower mushroom and a slide. Parents can keep watch from a lounger on the edge. For sun worshippers there is a lovely pool with many curves, rock formations, plants, showering sprays, massage jets, fast currents and loungers around it. There is a third pool under a sliding roof with a jacuzzi, large water slide, plants and loungers. 

Fun for the entire family

For kids there is a great playground with a fun bouncy castle (only in high season), a jungle gym with slide and a trampoline. You'll also find a beach volleyball court on Camping Cap Finistère, bad weather facilities and a few table tennis tables. There is also entertainment in high season, from crafts club to circus workshops. Water aerobics are offered each morning and in the evening quizzes are organised as well as bingo and disco activities.

properties.name: Flower Camping La Sagne
properties.description:
This campsite is located in the heart of the Périgord Noir, perhaps the most beautiful part of the Dordogne. Here you'll be camping in a mountainous landscape surrounded by vast swaths of forest. Flower Camping La Sagne is situated right along the banks of the Dordogne River. It is also close to numerous beautiful castles, magnificent cave systems and historic towns, including Sarlat-la-Canéda (9 km). Moreover, this internationally-oriented campsite attracts guests from around the world while maintaining an intimate feel. It features a swimming pool with a retractable roof, a shop and a nice restaurant with a shaded terrace, among other amenities.

Neat grounds with touring pitches in three comfort levels

Flower Camping La Sagne's neatly maintained grounds feature a variety of accommodations, including mobile homes, lodge tents and caravans. Touring pitches come in three comfort levels. Did you select a Nature Privilège pitch? Then you'll be assigned a wooded spot at least 200 square metres in size.

Two places to cool off

On summer days, guests at the campsite have two options for cooling off. First, you can take a dip in the swimming pool, which has a retractable roof. This pool also features a paddling pool and a relaxing whirlpool. Alternatively, you can walk to the Dordogne River to go for a swim there.

Plenty of fun activities in high season

La Sagne offers a lively and cosy holiday atmosphere, especially in July and August. Every Sunday, for example, a nice welcome reception is organised especially for new camping guests. There are also weekly pétanque tournaments and aqua gym sessions.

properties.name: Camping Le Grand Corseau
properties.description:
Le Grand Corseau campsite is located in the heart of a large pine forest on the Atlantic coast. You will be camping on an extensive site right by the sea and a large beach. Here you have a view of the bridge to Ile de Noirmoutier, a great destination to explore by bike or car. Jump into the campsite swimming pool or walk to the sea for a refreshing dip.

Under tall pines

In the pine forest, a very spacious campsite with a sandy soil awaits you, with space for almost three hundred touring pitches. Around seventy mobile homes are also spread around the campsite. Tall pines provide plenty of shade, although it is less densely wooded than in the immediate vicinity. Be careful when driving to your pitch, as there are high concrete ramps on the campsite's paved roads.

KSwimming in the sea

The large swimming pool is situated in the front part of the campsite, in a lovely sunny spot. With a paddling pool and whirlpool, this is a good place to enjoy the cool water. If you are camping at Le Grand Corseau you can also swim in the sea. A forest path leads you from the campsite to the dunes within a five minute walk. Behind them, the beach and Atlantic Ocean are just waiting for you to spend a day sunbathing and taking a dip.

Groceries

In high season, food trucks provide the campsite guests with pizza and hamburgers. Breakfast - fresh bread and a newspaper - is available at the bar. For other shopping needs, you only need to drive five minutes in the direction of Le Barre-de-Monts to find a supermarket.

properties.name: Camping Kanic
properties.description:
You can relax in style at this small and atmospheric terraced campsite on the Croatian island of Pag on the Adriatic Sea. Kanic Campsite has a beautiful location in an ancient olive grove between the towns of Novalja and Lun. The crystal clear sea borders directly on the campsite which offers picturesque views from all around. There is a café with a bar and grill where you can socialise with other campers.

Between old olive trees

You will immediately notice the friendly atmosphere when you arrive at the campsite. Kanic Campsite has only 40 pitches. It is popular among campers who want a beautiful environment with neat basic facilities. There are several paths along the sloping terrain, and you can look out over the water from a number of places. In addition to the old pitches, new pitches have been created that are somewhat more spacious and are located in the shade. When planning to set up your spot, think of a size between 30 and 150 m2. Everything is well maintained and the sanitary facilities have been renovated and look neat.

Sea at your doorstep

This compact campsite's biggest attraction is that it has its own beach. Between the rocks is a sandy beach with a pier where you can lay out your towel or recline on one of the sun loungers. You can also moor your boat here. The beach is accessible from the campsite via a staircase. Would you like to access the sea from another beach? Plaža Braničevica and Plaža Planjka Trinćel are other beaches nearby.

properties.name: Flower Camping Le Port de la Chaine
properties.description:
On the rugged coast of northern Brittany, overlooking the Île-de-Bréhat archipelago, is Flower Camping Le Port de la Chaîne. This campsite in Pleubian is popular with people seeking tranquillity, hikers and families who love nature, sea and space. You stay on a green campsite with an indoor and outdoor swimming pool, near a quiet beach and with play and sports facilities.

Camping with a sea view

The campsite offers spacious pitches, both sunny and shady, with or without sea views. You can also rent a mobile home. The different types of mobile homes can accommodate 2 to 6 people and have a private terrace. Sometimes even with a sea view! The many trees on the campsite mean you benefit from shade.

Swimming, playground and delicious food

There is no shortage of swimming fun at Flower Camping Le Port de la Chaîne. The sea - where you can take a refreshing dip - is obviously very close by. And the campsite also has a nice outdoor pool with slide. Has the weather changed? Then take a dip in the indoor pool. Children can also enjoy playing in the playground and in the sports fields. This campsite has its own restaurant serving delicious dishes.

Walk along the Pink Granite Coast

The unique rocky coast near the campsite is known as the Pink Granite Coast. Lovely to explore on a walk. A boat trip to Île-de-Bréhat (9 km) is also recommended. And towns like Paimpol (17 km) and Tréguier (14.5 km) are worth a visit too.

properties.name: Camping Le Floride & l'Embouchure
properties.description:
With clubs for children and teenagers, a large swimming paradise and a wide diversity of rental accommodation, Camping Le Floride & L'Embouchure offers something for everyone. There is a wide variety of restaurants to choose from and a sandy beach just a 15-minute walk away. There is also plenty to and see in the surrounding area, from a visit to Perpignan to a drive towards the Spanish border.

Camping Le Floride & L’Embouchure is located in the most southern part of France. The campsite is divided into two areas: ‘Le Floride’ and ‘L'Embouchure’, which is on the opposite side of the road. A 25-minute drive along this road will take you to the delightful city of Perpignan and in 40 minutes, you'll find yourself in the border village of Perthus. There is a fun fair next to the campsite, which means that you may experience a little noise from time to time.

3000 m2 swimming fun

There's no shortage of places to take a cool dip at Camping Le Floride & L'Embouchure. With a swimming paradise of no less than 3000m2, there is plenty of room for everyone to enjoy the refreshing water. There are three 21-metre slides, and one water slide even measures 35 metres.

With such a large swimming pool, the beach almost seems unnecessary. However, it can still be nice to alternate your swimming pool days with relaxing beach ones. The beach is just under a 15-minute walk from the campsite.

properties.name: Camping De Pampel
properties.description:
Veluwe camping De Pampel is a unique camping situated amidst woodland. You camp here on a spacious camping pitch or spend the night in a luxury farmhouse or lodge tent. On this special campsite for children you can look for deer in the deer forest, swim in the pool and so much more. The campsite is situated in the nature area De Veluwe, centrally between Arnhem, Apeldoorn and Ede. It is a beautiful woodland and you camp here between high trees on green lawns.

Glamping

On the lawns are spacious camping pitches, some of which have private sanitary facilities. You have a selection of lively lawns or pitches with more privacy. There are also some pitches in the middle of the woods. The campsite is also familiar with the concept of 'glamping'. Camping in style can be done in one of the wood lodges, forest lodges or farmhouses. There is even a farmhouse with wellness facilities, including a whirlpool bath and infrared sauna.

Children reign supreme

Camping guests that are pampered most of all, are the children. The campsite is very suitable for children under 12, but the older generation will also enjoy the natural beauty and tranquility of the area.

The theme of the campsite is 'woodland'. And not just because of the area and the deer forest -where deer roam freely- but also because the buildings and facilities play a part in this. In the swimming pools (indoor and outdoor), for instance, you can climb on tree trunks and even on an island.

properties.name: Baia di Gallipoli Camping Village
properties.description:
The Gulf of Tarente is located on the Salento peninsula, the ‘heel of the Italian boot’. This coastal strip is known for its beautiful beaches, rugged cliffs and the many remains of Greek antiquity. This is the setting of Baia di Gallipoli Camping Village. Here you camp just a stone's throw from the azure blue sea. A free shuttle bus will take you there.

Large shaded pitches

The pitches on the campsite are generally spacious and shady. The flower boxes, poplars and pines on the site create a peaceful atmosphere. The separate field for young people under the age of 25 is also a smart measure to keep the peace and quiet. In addition to a number of mobile homes, there are also glamping tents for rent. The five sanitary buildings look neat and tidy.

Eating out

Of course you also go to Italy for the delicious food. In the campsite's Trattoria they always know how to put something tasty on the table. Prefer to cook for yourself? Thanks to the wide range of products in the campsite shop, amateur chefs are perfectly at home here.

Tropical beach

Do you want to enjoy the beach? Then get in the free shuttle bus that will take you to the beach eight hundred meters away. Along the Gulf of Tarente there are several rocky beaches that seem to come right out of a photo album. Also take a look at the 'beach of purity', the city beach of Gallipoli with crystal clear water. At the campsite you can cool down in the spacious and rectangular swimming pool. It is well-maintained with colourful sunbeds under the tall trees.

properties.name: Camping Valdeiva
properties.description:
In the hilly region Liguria, just a few kilometres from the Italian Riviera and the Mediterranean Sea, you will find Camping Valdeiva. Many regular guests come to this campsite, but touring campers are also welcome. They camp on well-kept, but somewhat small pitches. From the campsite, a shuttle bus will take you to the beach and the Mediterranean Sea, as well as to the station of the seaside resort of Deiva Marina.

Well-kept but small pitches

On the campsite you will meet a lot of regular guests. 85 permanent pitches are intended for annual campers, mostly Italians who spend holidays in their own country. In addition, there are 65 touring pitches. Although they are well maintained, they may be a bit tight. Because of this you do not have a lot of privacy when you come camping on the Italian coast with a motorhome, caravan or tent. 18 wooden chalets and bungalows complete the camping offer.

Swimming pool with a view

A number of improvements have been made on the campsite. The swimming pool, for example, has undergone a complete renovation. Now you can take a dip in a modern and neat pool, situated on a beautiful sun deck. From the pool and the sun loungers all around you have a beautiful view of the surrounding mountains.

To the Mediterranean Sea

The campsite is only four kilometres from the Mediterranean. Too far to walk, but you can just leave your car. From the campsite a shuttle bus will take you to the coast of Deiva Marina, where a beautiful beach alternates with a modern promenade with pavement cafés. A large part of the beach is reserved for sun loungers, but there is also an area with space to spread your own towel.

properties.name: Camping La Pineta
properties.description:
You'll find the atmospheric, shady campsite La Pineta on the North West Cape of Sicily. This is beautifully situated on the rocky coast on the sea. 500 metres from the campsite you'll find San Vito La Capo, a charming resort that is equipped for the many tourists. La Pineta is a well maintained campsite (3.2 hectares) with two hundred touring pitches. You'll enjoy plenty of shade, created by the many pine trees.

There is water fun for the entire family

From the two attractive, large swimming pools of the campsite you have a view of a rock wall. You can relax in a lounger at the edge of the swimming pool. Even the toddler pool is quite large (75 m2). Children can also play in the playground and take part in the entertainment programme (only in Italian). 

300 metres from the campsite you'll find a lovely and broad sandy beach with clear seawater. You can windsurf here, sail and snorkel, so you can enjoy the lively underwater world. Diving courses are also offered here.

Culinary regional dishes

You will find a good selection in the large camping shop, including fresh bread. The busy restaurant is well known for Sicilian regional dishes and pizzas. Stylish servers work in the restaurant. 

Tennis lessons and nature activities
