You can get sporty on the jeu-de-boules court, the soccer field, the volleyball court, playing table tennis or on the tennis court. You can even take tennis lessons. The entertainment programme for adults and for teenagers is only in Italian. During the day, for example, there are activities organised in the water or in nature. There is a disco on the campsite in the evening.

properties.name: Camping Gajole
properties.description:
Camping Gajole is situated on the western shore of Lago di Corlo, near the town of Arsiè. The campsite is actually one large lawn, dotted with a few trees. A bit further away from the water you will find a number of higher-lying terraces. Whichever pitch you stand on, the view is superb. The campsite is restful and attractive, surrounded by nothing but lushly vegetated mountains and the blue water surface. There is a small private beach on the lake.

Camping near the lake

The one hundred touring pitches of Camping Gajole vary in size (50-90 m2). 'Down below' the grounds constitute one large lawn. This borders the lake. The higher-lying terraces are spacious lawns intended for tents, cars, caravans and motorhomes. These fields are connected to each other by pedestrians stairs at regular intervals.

The sanitary facilities of the campsite are well maintained and have nice children's facilities.

Swimming and sunbathing

You do not need a swimming pool here as the lake awaits you. If you prefer to stay dry, you can paddle a canoe or soak up the sun on the lawn by the lake.

Modest catering facilities

The catering facilities of the campsite are rather basic. There is a bar for coffee, a few drinks and ice cream, however. The campsite shop stocks a limited assortment. The restaurant is small and so is the menu. You can eat outside on the terrace. Some three km further along you will find more village with a wider selection of shops and restaurants.

properties.name: Camping Het Horstmannsbos
properties.description:
Camping Het Horstmannsbos is located in a beautiful wood and heathland area in the northeast of Drenthe. This natural campsite has large, shady pitches at the fringe of a wood, but also spacious pitches on sunny lawns. Het Horstmannsbos is a real family campsite, with extensive facilities for families with children.

Natural camping

There are one hundred touring pitches and fifty permanent, spread over twelve camping fields that bear bird names. Choose a sunny pitch on one of the open lawns, lined with greenery. Or choose more privacy and shelter on a pitch separated by hedges.

Do you like simple, back-to-basic camping with the tent? Then choose a spot in the strip of forest p at the back of the campsite. There you can really enjoy natural camping on a spacious pitch between the trees or around one of the sand drifts.

Family holiday

Camping Het Horstmannsbos offers extensive facilities for a comfortable camping holiday with the whole family. The campsite is car-free, so that children can play safely. Next to the restaurant is a nice playground with playground equipment, trampolines and bouncy castles. There is a water playground on the sand drift. For a few weeks in high season there is an entertainment team present on the campsite for children and adults.

Everything nearby

If you want to dine out, you don't have to go far. The small restaurant on the campsite has a limited menu. You can also get snacks and takeaway meals. In the nearby village of Gasselte you'll find more restaurants. You can get fresh bread at the campsite. Het Horstmannsbos doesn't have a grocery store. However, there are plenty of shopping opportunities in the area.

properties.name: Camping Drijfveer
properties.description:
Sail on Frisian waters during the day and then camp by the open waterway or by the impressive marina. This idyllic picture is a reality at Camping Drijfveer near Akkrum (in central Friesland). This is a campsite where it's all about water sports. The campsite has been built around Jachthaven Tusken de Marren (marina), as it were. You have views of the water and the passing boats from everywhere. There are several types of boats for hire, but you can also take your own boat.

Neat camping and motorhome pitches, many right by the water

This campsite has various neat fields with well-maintained camping pitches. Some of the touring pitches are right by the water. For large groups, there is a separate camping field with picnic benches and tables, among others.

Furthermore, Camping Drijfveer has paved camping pitches.

Entertainment: what is there to do?

Camping Drijfveer maybe popular with campers who enjoy boating, but there is also plenty to do at the campsite itself. There is a lovely playground with climbing equipment, a slide, swing, sand pit and horizontal bar. Furthermore, Camping Drijfveer regularly organises activities or events.

Delicious meal out in De Koken

If you stay at this campsite, we recommend going to dinner at De Koken restaurant. This restaurant belongs to the campsite and has a frequently changing menu. The dishes are made with high-quality organic ingredients.

properties.name: Agricampeggio & Glamping "Torre Sabea"
properties.description:
In the 'heel of the boot', directly on the Mediterranean Sea, lies Agricampeggio & Glamping ''Torre Sabea''. This small-scale campsite offers the best of both worlds. Not only can you go there for a relaxing camping holiday among the oleanders, but Torre Sabea is also suitable for campers who love glamping. The campsite has several luxury lodge tents.

Camping by the Mediterranean Sea

The campsite breathes tranquillity. You put your camping equipment on one of the beautiful, spacious pitches. There are as many touring pitches as there are motorhome pitches on the site, so motorhome owners are also well catered for. Trees and shade cloths provide plenty of shady spots, oleanders add colour to the campsite. Between the trees you can catch a glimpse of the clear blue waters of the Mediterranean Sea from your pitch.

Glamping

As the name suggests, this campsite also offers glamping holidays. Campers who enjoy luxury accommodation will find a total of fifteen comfortable lodge tents and beautiful stone bungalows in a separate area of the campsite. The rental accommodations are beautifully laid out, like a small village, but with plenty of privacy. There is also a beautiful swimming pool in the middle of the glamping accommodation.

Setting sun and accordion music

On this campsite, in an area of vineyards and olive groves, a restaurant cannot be missed. In his restaurant Torre Sabea serves delicious local dishes with local products. During theme evenings, with the setting sun and atmospheric accordion music in the background, you can taste Italian wines and enjoy the company of your fellow campers.

properties.name: Recreatiepark De Koornmolen
properties.description:
The De Koornmolen recreation park is located near Rotterdam, Gouda and Zoetermeer. In the midst of all these cities, you will find this quiet campsite. There is an extensive network of bicycle paths around the campsite. Here, you are in the Green Heart, in the middle of the Rottemeren nature reserve. So you can enjoy a beautiful nature reserve just a stone's throw from the city!

Camping amidst green

When you drive onto the campsite, you first pass the permanent pitches and the comfort pitches with private sanitary facilities. The pitches are spacious and surrounded by greenery. Do you value privacy? Then it's best to rent a comfort pitch, these are screened by hedges. If you want a permanent roof over your head, book a hiker's hut (without sanitary facilities) or a bungalow.

Cooking and grilling for yourself

You don't always have to cook for yourself at this campsite, because for a bite to eat, you can head over to Taverne 't Middelpunt. If you feel more like cooking for yourself, you can order one of the barbecue or gourmet packages from the reception. These will be delivered to your accommodation on a day of your choice. For a delicious breakfast, you can buy fresh bread at the campsite in the high season.

Active Fun

Do you want to get active during your holiday? Then you can make (paid) use of the BeweegpuntBas sports centre. You will find this sports centre on the grounds of the recreational park. Of course, you can also rent a bike to explore the beautiful surroundings. Children can have fun in the high season with the entertainment team and mini club.

properties.name: Dalgård Camping
properties.description:
In the beautiful region of Djursland, not far from Fjellerup, lies the welcoming family campsite of Dalgård. Here everything is geared towards a wonderful holiday for families with children. From the campsite you can walk along the site's path to a vast sandy beach. The children can swim safely in the clean water of the Kattegat. The spacious pitches on the campsite are surrounded by trees, which provide refreshing shade. The Djurs Sommerland amusement park is not far from the campsite.

Well-maintained grounds

You will arrive at a well-maintained campsite with spacious pitches which are laid out naturally. The trees and the flowering shrubbery provide you with plenty of privacy on your pitch. Are you travelling without your own tent, caravan or camper? Then book one of the beautiful bungalows or trekker huts. These vary in size from 8 m2 to 35 m2 and are available at different luxury levels.

Fresh fish from the grill

The campsite unfortunately does not have its own restaurant, but lots of culinary activities are nonetheless organised, such as grill nights. Fun for the entire family. With its location right on the seaside, the campsite is also very popular with fishermen who can easily catch enough fish together for their meals. A convenient little corner has been set up at the campsite for cleaning the catch. You can then prepare the fish at one of the grilling areas.

Top class sanitary facilities

As should be the case for a family campsite, the sanitary facilities here are top class. There are even special areas where families can shower and brush their teeth together. The sanitary areas are kept meticulously clean.

properties.name: Camping De Lombarde
properties.description:
In West Flanders, near the seaside resort of Nieuwpoort, you can camp a mere 800 metres from the sea. The beach is just a ten-minute walk via an inviting dune path. Camping de Lombarde offers a cosy bar with terrace, fish pond and playground. And, in the summertime, children can enjoy craft hours and sports competitions here. Cycling enthusiasts can rent a bike from the campsite to explore the area via one of the many cycling routes. A major advantage of the campsite is its central location for exploring the rest of the Belgian coastline.

Camping near Westende

The quiet location of the car-free Camping de Lombarde is a big plus. The campsite, which lies adjacent to a fish pond, is beautifully situated amidst the trees and nearby seaside. Thanks to its proximity to the motorway — only five kilometres away, the campsite is easy locate just south of Westeinde. Managers Guy and Sigrid will welcome you warmly upon your arrival.

Plenty of choice

The grounds are well maintained, and the camping pitches are sufficiently spacious. Besides the caravan and motorhome pitches, there's a tent field for smaller tents. The spacious feeling is enhanced by the lack of hedges as borders. The campsite also has hikers' cabins, comfortable safari tents and holiday homes available. Camping de Lombarde has several well-maintained sanitary facilities.

Play tennis, cycle or go for a walk

There are many sporting activities at the campsite. Visit the tennis court, for example. You can play a game of pétanque or table tennis on the well-maintained courts. There's a beautiful playground in the middle of the campsite, where the little ones can enjoy themselves.

properties.name: Camping Les Embruns d’Oléron
properties.description:
In the town of Château d’Oléron, in the south-east of the exceptional island Ile d’Oléron, you will find Camping Airotel Oléron. You will enjoy the shade and privacy on the spacious pitches of this wooded campsite (21 ha). A large number of rental accommodation units is available, including unique tents and mobile homes. Take a refreshing dive in the swimming pool. There is a varied entertainment programme for campers of all ages. Other than this, the campsite is especially geared towards horse lovers. Go on glorious beach rides (for advanced riders) or take some lessons (also for beginners).

Camping amidst green

The campsite consists of level pitches separated by trees and bushes. The well maintained campsite has paved roads, along which the pitches are located. The wooded terrain is home to 130 touring pitches. These pitches vary in size from 80 to 150 m2. The pitches for tents are truly magnificent.

Swimming and relaxing

Near the entrance of the campsite you will find a large, heated outdoor swimming pool (200 m2). There is also a separate toddler pool. Here you will find all kinds of colourful water-spewing animal figures. Around the swimming pool are some loungers and a few thatched sun umbrellas. Camping Airotel Oléron is less than 1 km away from the sea. This is also ideal for swimming and sunbathing. 

Dining out and barbecue

Breakfast as well as fresh bread are available on this campsite. The camping shop stocks a limited range of provisions. The restaurant offers a wider choice. For a quick bite to eat you can head for the snack bar (with attractive saloon doors) and the pizzeria. There is also a amiable bar.

properties.name: Camping Les Pins d'Oléron
properties.description:
At the tip of the colourful island of Oléron, close to the through road, you'll find Camping Les Pins d'Oléron at the edge of the village. The island is located in the Charente-Maritime, a region known for the many hours of sunshine. Only 1 km from the campground there is the sandy beach and the lagoon where you can cycle and walk for kilometres. It's only a short walk from the campground to the centre of the charming village of Le Grand-VIllage-Plage.

The lovely cycling paths in the immediate vicinity of the campground are suitable for any fitness level. This makes this campsite an ideal starting point to explore the multi-faceted region.

Water sports

The location of Les Pins is ideal for many types of water sports. You can sail and relax in the lagoon to enjoy the surrounding nature. You'll find more action on the beach, where surfing instructors give lessons for all ages and levels. Or let the wind help you to ride with a sturdy cart over the beach.

Would you rather swim at the campground? There's a lovely swimming lake with a sandy beach around it. Ideal for smaller children, because they can play in the shallow water. There is a volleyball net on the side for adolescents. The campground terrace has a view of this lagoon. The snack bar on its banks serves snacks, chips, hamburgers, pizzas and ice cream. There is fresh bread there in the morning.

properties.name: Camping Regio
properties.description:
The Camping Regio campsite is located in the Spanish village of Santa Marta de Tormes, on the outskirts of the beautiful city of Salamanca. You can bike there in less than twenty minutes. The campsite is part of a luxury hotel complex with all kinds of facilities. As a campsite guest, you may use these (sometimes for a fee). Here in western Spain, you'll be camping about a two-hour drive from Madrid and from the Portuguese border.

Camping and renting

The camping area consists of some 130 spots for touring campers (70–120 m2) and an equal number of campervan spots (80 m2). The terrain is flat almost everywhere. The spot you choose depends on whether you want to camp in the shade or not. The campsite does not have deciduous trees throughout. Don't have your own camping equipment? Book one of the 24 wooden bungalows (suitable for groups of up to five people) or one of the 10 mobile homes (for up to six people).

Luxury hotel = luxury holiday

The Camping Regio campsite is located on the grounds of a luxury hotel complex. And that's good news!

In fact, camping guests may use all the facilities belonging to the hotel. How do you feel about two outdoor pools, multiple tennis courts, a restaurant, a café and a supermarket? This represents fantastic swimming and sports opportunities. It's easy to take good care of your inner being here.

Water fun!

The hotel's two pools cater to young and old. Adults can swim laps in the large, rectangular pool. The youngest campers can splash around in the wading pool a little further down the road. Next to the pools is a beautiful sunbathing area with parasols. There are also deck chairs where you can relax with a good book.

properties.name: Camping Benisol
properties.description:
A holiday where you don’t have to worry about a single thing. For that, you have to be in the south of Spain. For example, on the Costa Blanca. Camping Benisol is situated in the heart of this area just north of the tourist resort of Benidorm. The pleasant climate also makes this family campsite a popular destination in the autumn and winter months.

Plenty of greenery

Camping Benisol is situated on a well maintained terrain. There is a lot of green on the campsite. This is combined with Spanish elements such as statues and fountains. The pitches are 60 m² to 80 m² on average. They are separated by hedges. A shade cover ensures that you can take shelter from the sun. The campsite also offers glamping possibilities and chalets for rent.

There’s always something to do

At Camping Benisol, there’s always something to do. There’s entertainment for children and adults: a nice playground, a tennis court, a multi-sports field, and a bowling alley. At the campsite shop, you can get some essential items such as fresh bread. And, of course, there is also a restaurant. Spanish delicacies such as paella are served here. You can also order pizzas and meat dishes. At the bar, you can enjoy a drink until late in the evening.

Fun in the water

There is also a bar on the campsite. This is located in the colourfully decorated outdoor pool. It features a slide and some playground equipment. Your children are sure to have a great time here. The pool is ideal for relaxing in the soon. It is surrounded by a sunbathing area. For the little ones, there is also a separate paddling pool.

properties.name: Camping Le Château
properties.description:
Camping Le Château is a beautiful campsite with a peaceful location on the edge of the village of Hauterives in the Drôme. Hauterives is best known for the famous Palais Idéal du Facteur Cheval. The campsite is built next to a beautiful 17th century castle. The campsite also has a good restaurant and a large outdoor swimming pool.

Attractive camping fields

This campsite consists for a large part of circular camping fields separated by hedges, trees and bushes. Most of the pitches therefore offer plenty of shade and privacy. The touring pitches are mainly situated at the front part of the campsite. There are also rental accommodations: from hiker's huts with only basic facilities to fully equipped mobile homes. There is also an old Airstream caravan with an unusual interior.

Large outdoor swimming pool

Central to this campsite is a large heated outdoor swimming pool and a large paddling pool. A lovely place to swim laps or cool off on hot days. Moreover, you can let your children do as they please, as there is always a lifeguard present. Swimming is also sometimes possible in the small river that runs alongside the campsite.

Varied entertainment programmes

In the high season, there is plenty of entertainment at the campsite. Sports tournaments, horse and pony rides, themed evenings, shows, games and karaoke nights are just some of the activities on offer. The activities mainly take place in the extremely attractive castle garden.

Eating out at the campsite

Restaurant L'AuthentiK is located in one of the castle's outbuildings. The menu includes pizzas, salads and meat dishes. The terrace in the courtyard is a pleasant place to enjoy your meal.

properties.name: Camping Atlanta
properties.description:
The Atlanta campsite is located to the south of the fishing village of Chioggia, an hour's drive from Venice. This campsite looks a bit old-fashioned, with its many permanent pitches and sober layout of the touring pitches. But everything is neatly maintained and you camp here in a quiet environment, directly on the Mediterranean. The campsite has a private beach where you can rent sun loungers and parasols.

Pitches on the beach

The front part of the campsite is reserved for regular guests: they have permanent pitches here, mainly in the form of cottages. If you drive a little further, you will come across the touring pitches. These are situated in straight rows next to each other. Small trees stake out the pitches, but provide little privacy or shade. Further on towards the beach are the better pitches, so it is worth trying to get a spot there.

For the children

The entertainment programme on the campsite is especially fun for children. Under the supervision of the animation team, they can play games both on dry land and in the swimming pools. These can be found centrally on the campsite. In addition to a large paddling pool, the campsite has a real olympic pool, ideal for swimming your daily laps. You can also take a dip in the Mediterranean.

Supermarkets

On the campsite there is a small supermarket and a restaurant. In the supermarket you will find some much-needed groceries, but the assortment is not extensive enough for your evening meal. Luckily within a radius of two kilometres there are several large supermarkets.

properties.name: Camping Village Internazionale
properties.description:
In the Italian Veneto region, on the strip of land of Sottomarina, you will find Camping Village Internazionale. This well maintained campsite is directly situated on the Adriatic Sea. The most spacious camping pitches are across the road, where the campsite has completed an extension. There is an entertainment team to occupy the children and you can cool off in the outdoor swimming pool with toddler pool. The campsite has direct access to the beach of Sottomarina.

Neat, well maintained campsite

The campsite consists of two sections, separated by a road. In the section towards the coast are the permanent pitches, mostly occupied by Italians. A bit further on are the rental accommodation units and the tourist pitches. The campsite has a neat and well organised appearance and the sanitary facilities are also well maintained.

A delicious Italian meal

On the campsite you can buy the basic necessities but for most shopping you will have to go to neighbouring Chioggia. Obviously, you can also have a meal in Chioggia or in one of the restaurant on the beach. The campsite also has a restaurant where you can enjoy an Italian meal at night or in the afternoon.

Entertainment on land or in the water

The campsite has some playground equipment, a pétanque court and an entertainment programme for children. In the Italian sun however, most activities take place by the water. The outdoor swimming pool on the campsite has a separate toddler pool. The swimming pool is almost directly situated on the shoreline and it is a short step from the campsite to the beach.

properties.name: Camping Sunêlia La Presqu’ile
properties.description:
In the mountainous Hautes-Alpes, on Lac de Serre Ponçon, lies this beautiful terraced campsite. From the camping pitches, you have the most beautiful views of the lake. But you can also enjoy it to the fullest at the Camping La Presqu'île campsite's restaurant and pool. Be sure to take a dip in the water. Or take to the lake by kayak, windsurf or paddle board.

Between the Alps

Camping La Presqu'île is located between the Hautes-Alpes mountains, in the south of France. A beautiful drive through the Alps brings you to the mountain town of Prunières. If you drive a little further, you will find Camping La Presqu'île. The campsite is located in a beautiful spot: on a peninsula on Lac de Serre Ponçon. This lake is located on the border of Hautes-Alpes and Alpes-de-Haute-Provence.

Pitches with fantastic views

The view from the campsite is truly fantastic. Not only will you have a view of the surrounding mountains from your pitch. You can also look out over the glistening waters of the lake. The pitches are located on terraces. This often allows you to catch a glimpse of the lake. The most beautiful pitches are located by the water.

A pool between the mountains

Feel free to bring your children to Camping La Presqu'île, because they will love the pool. For your daily swim, you can head to this welcoming place. The little ones can also splash around in the paddling pool here. The pool sits on a plateau in the sun. And of course, there's that view again. Those high mountains all around will make your dive pretty special.

properties.name: Sosta Camping Torre di Bari Sardo
Camping Village Mugello Verde
properties.description:
Camping Village Mugello Verde is a terraced campsite in Scarperia e San Piero (Mugello valley), a village in the touristy Tuscany region. This campsite is located on a hill and is heavily wooded. In addition to a good restaurant and a large swimming pool, Mugello Verde is also attractive because of its proximity to the art city of Florence. A free of charge shuttle bus will take you to a railway station. From here you can take the train and you will reach this famous art city within half an hour.

Large pitches with shade

This terraced campsite has predominantly level, paved and windy roads. This site has 250 touring pitches and 94 rental accommodation units. The pitches vary in size and have a grass surface. The trees offer ample shade. The pitches are partly demarcated. 

The rental accommodation units, suitable for two to six persons, are completely surrounded by trees at the back. These apartments have a fully equipped kitchen, a living room and outside furniture.

Swimming and sports

The attractive open swimming pool of the campsite is semi-Olympic size (200 m²). It is eminently suitable for swimming lengths. There is a lifeguard on duty. Prefer sunbathing? You can do this in the loungers around the swimming pool. 

There is some nice play equipment for children. You can get active on the tennis court or at the table tennis table. Indoors you will also find a pool table as well as a table football game. Equipment for all sports can be obtained from the reception counter.

Motorcyclists take note!

At a distance of less than 10 km from the campsite lies the Mugello Race Circuit. In June a well-known motor race is held here. Don't be surprised when you see campers sporting caps and shirts bearing the number 46, the number of the Italian motorcycle racing hero Valentino Rossi.

properties.name: Camping Stieglitz
properties.description:
Stieglitz campsite is just a stone's throw from the Baltic Sea. This spacious campsite with familial atmosphere has everything that you need for an enjoyable holiday on the German coast. Treat yourself to local produce from the campsite shop, or try some out in the Deichgarten restaurant. For utmost relaxation, the Dahme beach spa is the place to be.

Countryside camping

Camping pitches at Stieglitz campsite are entirely grass and have been separated from one another by half-height hedges, while trees and other plants provide shade through the summer months. There's so much greenery, giving a real feeling of being at the heart of the countryside. The campsite is spacious, with each pitch offering a minimum of 100 m2 for your caravan, tent or motorhome. For a little additional comfort, you could opt for one of the campsite's mobile homes.

Germans enjoy holidaying in their own country, and Stieglitz is no exception. You'll also meet many young families with children, but campers of all ages will feel at home at Stieglitz.

Relax in the beach spa

Not far from the campsite, you will find the Dahme beach spa, with an indoor swimming pool and a range of thermal baths. A few steps further and you're right on the beach, where you can hire wicker seats for relaxation. There's also a sauna or you can book a nice massage for the utmost pampering.

properties.name: Arena Grand Kažela Campsite
properties.description:
Arena Grand Kažela Campsite is a large campsite on the Istrian peninsula, close to the Croatian seaside resort of Medulin. For water sports enthusiasts this campsite is a true paradise.

The campsite is located directly on the coast of the Adriatic Sea, in the south of the Croatian peninsula of Istria. From Pula, the historic town on the west coast of the island, take the road towards the seaside resort of Medulin. You will find the campsite just below Medulin. Once you have passed the last houses, you will find yourself in a flat, expansive landscape. In the distance you can already see the large pine forest, which is part of the campsite.

Large campsite with a large offer

With more than 1400 touring pitches, there is always a spot available on the huge Arena Grand Kažela Campsite. Many of the touring pitches are shaded by pine trees. However, most of the 300 rental properties are not in the shade. Especially the modern mobile homes are beautiful. They offer a view of the Adriatic Sea. The sanitary facilities are clean and well-cared for. The only problem is that the hot water often runs out in high season.

Eating, drinking, water fun

There's no need to get bored here. The modern swimming pool has a large water slide. There is also a paddling pool. The campsite has four restaurants, five bars and a snack bar. There is a surf school and a diving centre. Furthermore, jet skis, banana boats, motor boats and rowing boats are rented out.

properties.name: Arena Stoja Campsite
properties.description:
Arena Stoja Campsite is a large campsite on the west coast of the Croatian peninsula of Istria. This older campsite is located on a wooded piece of land surrounded by the Adriatic Sea, about three kilometres from the historic centre of Pula. You will camp in a pine forest, on a rugged terrain with lots of shade.

In the shade of pine trees

Arena Stoja Campsite is a lot older than many of the modern campsites in Istria. The extensive, largely wooded campsite is unpaved and quite rough. Although the more than seven hundred touring pitches are not all equally flat, you can camp on beautiful spacious pitches in the shade of pine trees. These trees, however, can slightly obstruct the passage to your camping pitch.

Swimming, diving and snorkeling

The headland on which the campsite is situated is surrounded by water. The Adriatic Sea encloses the entire campsite, allowing you to dive into the clear water from various points. The coast here is rocky and has no sandy beaches.

Not only swimming goes well here. There is a diving school on the campsite. Divers can rent their equipment here or take lessons to discover the underwater world of the Adriatic. If diving is a little too much for you, take your snorkel and mask with you.

Supermarket and restaurant

With a supermarket with a wide range of products, a restaurant and a beach bar, the campsite's hospitality is in good shape. The restaurant has an extensive menu, which mainly includes grill, pizza and seafood dishes. On the large outdoor terrace you can enjoy a long dinner in the sun.

properties.name: Camping Kampeerbos De Simonshoek
properties.description:
The peaceful campsite Kampeerbos de Simonshoek is the place to be if you are looking to enjoy nature. The campsite, which is a forest measuring some eight hectares, features a large swimming pool. Children can play in the playground or the air trampoline. Get something to eat and drink at the campsite restaurant. Fun fact: Kampeerbos de Simonshoek has been around for over fifty years.

Camping in a forest

The campsite is called Kampeerbos (camping forest) de Simonshoek for a reason. There are trees everywhere you look, providing you with plenty of shade. At the front of the campsite, you will find many permanent pitches; the other camping fields are located along the side and further back. The pitches on these sites are spacious but not really demarcated, with the exception of a few hedges. The campsite has 75 touring pitches and 100 permanent year-round pitches (mobile homes and chalets).

A unique treehouse

There are five unique rental accommodations available; a luxury safari tent nad four 'camping barrels'. These round wooden huts are a sight to behold. Two of these camping barrels are situated on the ground, the other two are located in a tree. The camping barrel offers space for four people. A daily breakfast is provided for people staying in one of these camping (tree) barrels.

Swimming in the indoor pool

Directly next to the entrance of the campsite you will find the large swimming pool (265 m2) with a sliding roof. With a water temperature of around 29 degrees, it is very pleasant here. Besides swimming laps, you can also slide down the colourful slide. For smaller children there is a separate paddling pool (105 m2).

properties.name: Waldcamping-Birkendorf
properties.description:
In the South German Black Forest, near the town of Ühlingen-Birkendorf, you will find Waldcamping Birkendorf. You are here in the Rothauser Land, the region on the southern edge of the Hochschwarzwald close to Switzerland, which forms part of the much larger Southern Black Forest Nature Conservation Area. Waldcamping Birkendorf is a modest campsite for nature lovers and walkers.

Tranquil and relaxed

Waldcamping Birkendorf is a tranquil, relaxing campsite where you are warmly welcomed by the owners. The campsite has permanent pitches, but there are also 50 touring pitches.

Natural bathing lake

About 900 metres from the campsite you will find the natural swimming lake Naturena Badesee, which can be accessed free of charge by campsite guests. The lake has a diving rock, volleyball court, a large playground with water games and a children's pool for the youngest.

Those who prefer to take it easy can enjoy the sunny terrace of the campsite restaurant Waldschenke. Directly opposite the restaurant, children can have fun on the playground. There is also the Schlücht, a small stream that runs along the campsite, with several nice spots where you can get into the water.

In the region

The Black Forest, the largest forest area in Germany, is one of the most popular tourist destinations in the Federal Republic. The wooded surroundings are a paradise for walkers and nature lovers. The campsite lies directly on a walking route. Beyond this, the Rothauser Land offers some 300 km of signposted walking and cycling trails.

You will find a unique natural spectacle at a distance of some 18 km, namely the Wutachschlucht, a breathtaking canyon, which can justifiably be called 'the Grand Canyon of the Black Forest'. Yet another interesting outing is Sankt Blasien (distance of approx. 20 km), with its colossal cathedral.

properties.name: Club del Sole Adriatico Cervia Easy CP Village
properties.description:
Adriatico Family Camping Village is located in Pinarella (part of the resort of Cervia) on the Adriatic Sea. Cervia, located between Ravenna and Rimini is part of Milano Marittima (or: Milan on the Lake). Adriatico Family Camping Village is a quiet nice campsite. Plus points are the many sights in the surrounding area and the cycling options.

Camping for seekers of peace?

The first impression is of the open and well-maintained campsite with a great deal of renovated buildings. The camping pitches are beautifully laid out and quite spacious. They are all under trees. There are also lovely mobile homes for rent. Ýou'll also notice the quiet atmosphere on the campsite. The swimming pool is closed at midday, for example. The beach, divided into beach pavilions where lounges and parasols can be rented, is 500 m from the campsite.

Even though the campsite itself is quiet, we must note that the so-called Riviera Romagnola (the Adriatic coast between Ravenna and Rimini) changes into a huge disco for partygoers from the large northern Italian cities from Thursday night to Sunday midday. The surrounding area is really less quiet during these days.

Facilities

Adriatico Family Camping Village is a simple campsite. There is a semi-Olympic swimming pool with a kiddie pool next to it. You will also find a playground, mini market and a simple restaurant-pizzeria, which looks cosy.

Sanitary facilities

Not much to say about the sanitation facilities. The toilet buildings look clean and well maintained.

properties.name: Club del Sole Riccione Easy Camping Village
properties.description:
Camping at a walking distance from the sea and on the edge of Motor Valley is possible at Club del Sole Riccione Easy Camping Village. This modest campsite next to the village of Misano Adriatico is ideally situated for motor sports fans. The Misano World Circuit Marco Simoncelli is just five kilometres away. San Marino is thirty kilometres away. But even if you just want to enjoy the beach and the lovely villages in the hilly hinterland, this campsite is a good choice.

Pets allowed

Don't expect a very luxurious campsite, everything is modest here. The pitches are available in various sizes and have a grassy surface. For those who love renting, there are many accommodations to choose from. Pets are allowed at this campsite. The campsite is very popular with Italian families and senior citizens (especially in low season).

On to the beach

There's no swimming pool on the campsite, but you can easily reach the beach from the campsite. Cross the road or take the pedestrian tunnel under the road. The tunnel takes you to beach zone 3, where small dogs are also allowed. Your dog is allowed everywhere in the campsite except in the sanitary facilities and the playground. There are also special dog showers opposite the campsite.

Italian food

On the beach you will find Dolcevita Restaurant & Bar, where your dog is also allowed. Here you can enjoy fish specialities, pizzas, pastas and meat dishes. The campsite also has a small restaurant serving simple Italian dishes and a supermarket with a wide range of products.

properties.name: Club del Sole Marina Julia Family Collection
properties.description:
At the northernmost tip of the Adriatic is Marina Julia Family Camping Village. A holiday full of swimming fun awaits you here. You camp directly by the sea. You can even sunbathe on a private beach! The campsite itself also offers plenty of water fun. Swim a few lengths in the large competition pool or jump from the spectacular diving board. The pool complex is popular with young and old.

Shady pitches

There is a good chance that you will be able to camp in the shade on this campsite. The campsite is full of tall trees. If you are staying in one of the mobile homes, you can also enjoy shady pitches. The most beautiful pitches are located close to the beach.

Private beach on the Adriatic

The beach is one of the main attractions of Marina Julia Family Camping Village. The campsite is situated directly on the Adriatic Sea. As a camping guest, you have the privilege of getting a tan every day on a private beach. It is wonderful to swim and sunbathe undisturbed with your family.

Playing on dry land

Between the tall trees of the campsite you will find a lot of entertainment. The little ones can have fun in the playground. Sporty campers will also get their money's worth at the campsite. You can hit, throw or kick a ball on the tennis court and the multi-sports field.

Well-filled plates

The small shopping centre is the campsite's latest addition. Several shops, a supermarket and a restaurant ensure that you will not be short of anything. Here you can get a quick snack. Or you can choose to linger over your dinner. For example with a steaming risotto or authentic pizza ...

properties.name: Club del Sole Stork Family Collection
properties.description:
In the middle of Italy, you will find four-star campsite Stork Family Camping Village directly on the beach of the Adriatic Sea. From this sunny, tidy and well-maintained campsite you can walk straight from your accommodation onto the private beach. Stork Family Camping Village is a campsite you don't really need to leave if you love the sun, beach and swimming pool. Good news for your four-legged friends: the campsite is extremely dog-friendly.

Waking up on the beach

The last two hours of the route to Stork Family Camping Village are almost entirely along the coast, if you drive via Bologna. Plenty of time to get the holiday feeling and get used to beach life, because that is where a holiday at this campsite mainly takes place. Many pitches are located directly on this private sandy beach, where you can walk straight into the azure sea.

The campsite has many mobile homes, bungalows and flats in different comfort classes. If you are staying in your own tent, caravan or motor home, the trees on the campsite provide shade from the hot Italian sun.

Entertainment for the whole family

For children there is plenty to do at the campsite. There is not only a playground, but also a lovely swimming pool with a large slide and a paddling pool. In addition, there is daily (Italian) entertainment for all ages, group lessons in the swimming pool and a lovely theatre for shows.

Eating and drinking

You can, of course, have breakfast, lunch or dinner in your own accommodation, but it's just as delicious to eat in the campsite restaurant. The campsite also has a bar, shop and arcade.

properties.name: Club del Sole Roseto degli Abruzzi Easy CP Village
properties.description:
On the outskirts of the charming village of Roseto degli Abruzzi, north of the larger coastal town of Pescara, you can enjoy the sea and the versatile hinterland on EurCamping Roseto Concept Glamping. The region has many picturesque mountain villages which are easy to reach. The central location of the campsite, along the coast of the Adriatic Sea, also offers many possibilities for lovely walking and cycling trips.

Green and comfortable

All pitches are surrounded by greenery, some sunny, others delimited by eucalyptus trees that provide a pleasant coolness. There are three sanitary buildings and a camper service.

Beach on your doorstep

A modest sandy beach with fine gravel is directly across the campsite and is for the use of camping guests only. You only have to cross the small road leading to the marina. Also an excellent starting point for cycle trips along the Adriatic.

At the entrance lies the spacious, attractive swimming pool, which is closely supervised by the lifeguard. There is a large area for the loungers and there is a toddler pool next to the large swimming pool. As is the case on many Italian campsites, bathing caps are required.

An area to be explored

A trip to the Gran Sasso mountain range is a unique experience. Pack some warm clothing because even in summer, it can cool down considerably.

properties.name: Club del Sole Stella del Mare Family Collection
properties.description:
The Stella del Mare Family Camping Village is located in a wooded area on the Tuscan coast. Here you can not only enjoy nature and peace and quiet. You can also get ready for a holiday in the water. This campsite is situated directly on the beach and the Mediterranean Sea. And you can also dive in the beautiful camping pools! For a cultural trip, the Tuscan art cities of Florence, Siena and Pisa are recommended. Florence has the beautiful Duomo and many museums, while in Siena you shouldn't miss the cathedral and the Piazza del Campo.

Shady pitch or luxury mobile home?

You drive up to your pitch past lush plants. It is situated under trees and between bushes. A spot with a lot of privacy and space. And shade of course. If you want a luxurious camping holiday full of comfort, choose a mobile home. These new rental properties are also situated in the shade.

Beach with a view

A dune path takes you to the beach within a few steps. You trade the shade of the trees for the warm sun. Like many Italian beaches, this one is full of deckchairs. If you are a camping guest, you can rent one (with parasol). Enjoy the view of the yellow rocks, the green hills and the small castle at the top while sunbathing or swimming.

Swimming pools for the whole family

The water park is where your children will be found every day. Not surprising, because the pools at this campsite are impressive. Three pools with different depths: they have thought of the whole family.

properties.name: Club del Sole Orbetello Family Collection
properties.description:
Southern Tuscany is known for its rugged, beautiful nature. Surrounded by the most beautiful beaches of the region and with a rich history, Orbetello is a diverse holiday destination. In the surrounding area you will find many picturesque villages. The campsite has a unique location on the Tómbolo della Gianella headland. A safe crossing allows you to walk in just five minutes to the private beach where sunbeds and parasols await you.

Under the pine trees

Several small streets lead you to your pitch to install your tent, motor home or caravan. The many pine trees provide natural shade and smell delicious. The modern sanitary buildings are situated on the edge of the site and look neat. Bungalows, mobile homes and lodge tents are located on a fairly large part of the campsite.

Diving and swimming

Swimming in the large swimming pool or diving into the beautiful Mediterranean? During your holiday you can choose every day. The beautifully designed swimming pool complex is located close to the reception. The campsite's own beach is easily accessible; just cross the coastal road and walk fifty metres through a dune area.

Italian menu

The restaurant and bar are situated on the central square of the campsite. Here you will also find a large patio with lovely seats and flowers. There is an extensive Italian menu. It gets pleasantly busy in the evening.

Entertainment

The entertainment team at Orbetello Family Camping Village does a great job in the summer months. Young children and teenagers will love the daily games, kite flying workshops, sports competitions and theatre performances. Please note that the entertainment is in Italian.

properties.name: Club del Sole Spina Family Collection
properties.description:
On the Adriatic coast, in the middle of the beautiful surroundings of the Parco Regionale Veneto del Delta del Po, you will find Spina Family Camping Village. Camping at this large family campsite is a real treat for the whole family. There is a large water park and a private beach. And you don't need to leave the campsite for your shopping or dinner either.

Welcome!

At this family campsite, situated in a forest, you can pitch your caravan or tent in the shade of the pine trees. There are marked out pitches of various sizes on grass and sand. You can also camp without your own camping equipment in one of the various chalets or luxury safari tents.

Swimming pool and private beach

If you like swimming then this campsite is perfect for you. With a large aqua park and its own beach, you can choose where you want to have fun every day. The private beach is about seven hundred metres' walk away. Too far? There is a free shuttle bus service. The sandy beach, which slopes gently into the sea, is ideal for children. The campsite's water park also has a shallow splash pool, making it safe for the smallest campers. Feeling peckish? Then head for one of the restaurants by the beach or the restaurant next to the swimming pool.

Entertainment

Spina Family Camping Village attaches great importance to ensuring that guests of all ages have an unforgettable holiday. The entertainment team therefore organises fun activities for both children and adults, with a special focus on teenagers. Every day there is something fun to do, such as a musical, disco evening or talent show. The campsite also has various sports fields and a playground.

properties.name: Sonnencamp am Gösselsdorfersee
properties.description:
Carinthia is the southernmost and sunniest state in Austria, and is known as the land of mountains and lakes. From Sonnencamp am Gösselsdorfersee you can take the most beautiful trips through this area. Hike the flanks of the Southern Alps or visit the Obir Tropfsteinhöhlen. You will also be staying near to the Gösselsdorfer See, a beautiful swimming lake in a protected nature reserve. Nice bonus at this campsite: one child up to the age of 10 years stays free of charge.

Plenty of space

The campsite is on level ground, looks well maintained and everything is nicely organised. The pitches are spacious and range from 80 to 144 m2. You can choose a standard pitch or a more spacious 'comfort' pitch. The main road is paved and the other roads are covered with gravel.

An active holiday

In addition to being the southernmost and warmest state, Carinthia is probably the most active state in Austria. And that's what the guests at Sonnencamp am Gösselsdorfersee like. You'll find an international crowd here that loves to head out through the region. After such an active day, you can relax at the campsite on the terrace near the restaurant. Daily specials are also served here, and it's wonderful to relax here with a drink, under the trees and parasols.

Swimming and lakes

On hot days, the swimming lake is 'the place to be'. You can cool off, dive in the water from the small jetty or just sunbathe on the grass. The first few metres of the lake are very shallow, so even little ones can play here. A little further along is the Gösselsdorfer See, a beautiful swimming lake in a protected nature reserve.

properties.name: Tolne Camping
properties.description:
The Tolne campsite is situated in a lovely spot in a nature reserve and on a hill. The campsite is close to the tiny town of Tolne (North Jutland) in the very north of Denmark. Camping here means you're not far from the port city of Frederikshavn (15 km), beautiful beaches and the shallow bay Albæk Bugt. It is a very wooded area. The campsite is popular with those looking for peace and quiet, but this does not mean that there is nothing to do. There are sports facilities, you can get a bite to eat at the food truck, and a recreation room.

Terraced camping in nature

Here you'll find a well-maintained yet natural campsite with about 130 spacious camping pitches. You can pick your own spot. For example, in an open field or a bit more towards the forest. There are also rental accommodations. Handy if you are on holiday in Denmark without your own camping equipment. There are luxury cabins and glamping tents (for up to six people) with private sanitary facilities. The shared sanitary facilities are fine and clean. They are spread over two heated buildings.

Entertainment for young and old

Every Friday night in the low season (and a bit more often in the high season), they often eat together around the food truck. This is a fun way to get to know your fellow campers. And now that you've gotten to know them a little, you can ask them to play a game of table tennis, mini-golf or jeu de boules. Children can enjoy themselves in the playground, in the bouncy castle or in the recreation room. All kinds of games can be played here, such as chess or billiards.

properties.name: Camping Hümmlinger Land
properties.description:
Camping Hümmlinger Land is just outside the town of Werlte in Emsland, a national region in the west of Lower Saxony. Here, in Naturpark Hümmling, you camp far from motorways and urban bustle. The various places of interest and numerous cycle paths and hiking trails in the area have much to offer. This very well-kept campsite attracts many seniors and families with (young) children.

Beautiful camping site with extraordinary accommodations

This is a clearly laid out campsite that has grouped together pitches, year pitches and accommodations. As a campsite visitor, you can select from neatly laid out touring pitches that vary in size. The pitches are separated by beech wood hedges. There is also a lovely meadow for campsite visitors with a tent.

Just before the barrier there is a small field with charming sleep barrels. And there are more types of unique accommodations. You can also stay overnight here in an authentic shepherd’s wagon or in a real tree tent – which is something between a hammock and a tent.

A game of Pit-Pat?

Plenty of campsites have billiards tables and mini golf courses, but did you know that there is a game that combines billiards with mini golf? It’s called Pit-Pat. The campsite’s delightful Pit-Pat course has eighteen challenging lanes mounted on tables. These lanes look a lot like ‘normal’ mini golf tracks. Using a billiard cue, try to sink the little ball into the hole with as few hits as possible. Good luck!

There is a great playground with a cable car, climbing facilities and other play equipment. A shop is located in the centre of the site with a lovely dining room next to it as well as the toilet facilities, which were fully renovated in 2023.

properties.name: MeerReise Camping
properties.description:
MeerReise Camping, in the charming town of Großenbrode, is at the easternmost point of the mainland of Sleeswijk-Holstein (Germany). Here you camp almost at the tip of the peninsular, between two large sandy beaches. There is a lively promenade along one of the beaches. If you like the beach and water sports, this is a great place to be, but this also a popular destination with cyclists and walkers. From the campsite, you can go on lovely trips through beautiful rural surroundings. You can cross the Fehmarn Sound Bridge by bike and continue your bike ride on the island of Fehmarn.

Spacious camping pitches and mobile homes in pirate style

At MeerReise Camping, you can book a stay on a spacious pitch, a seasonal pitch or in a modern mobile home or luxury safari tent. Seasonal pitches are in the majority on this excellently maintained site. If you stand with your back to the entrance barrier, the touring pitches are on your left. There is also a separate site with motorhome pitches. You can take your dog to the campsite. Pets are not allowed in the accommodation. The mobile homes are decorated completely in pirate style.

Plenty of activity around the Südstrand and its promenade

There is much more to do around the beaches at Großenbrode than 'simply' swimming, sunbathing and sailing. There is plenty of activity around the Südstrand in particular and then mainly during the holiday periods. Then there are entertainment programmes for children, who can join in with miniature discos, 'star shows' and beach volleyball tournaments, for example.

properties.name: Camping Murinsel
properties.description:
Camping Murinsel is in Großlobming, in the middle of the beautiful Styria. This five-star campsite is in an attractive location between the River Mur and a serene lake. That makes the campsite a good choice for nature lovers. This campsite – winner of the ACSI Awards in 2023 – is also a good campsite for motor sport fans, seeing as the Red Bull Ring is only five kilometres away.

Camping amenities

The campsite is well-maintained and exudes a pleasant calm. The pitches, some right by the water, are nicely laid out and suitable for both long-term campers and those passing through. With 80 camping pitches on a site covering five hectares, there is plenty of space for every visitor. Each plot is about 100 tot 140 m² in size and provided with water, sewage and electricity connections.

The campsite does not have a supermarket, but you will find one in the village that is only 1 km away. And if you bring your loyal four-legged friend, there is a pool-pond measuring 600 m² and a meadow where they can be taken for a walk.

Relaxation by the pond

There is a second, larger pond of about 1.2 hectares where you can wonderfully relax. This natural pond - surrounded by plants and flowers - invites you to unfold a chair and completely unwind. You can go for a swim, finally finish that book you never get the chance to read or cast a line in a quiet spot.

properties.name: Sejs Bakker Camping
properties.description:
The friendly campsite Sejs Bakker is a wonderful camping destination with children who love the outdoors. With a child-friendly beach nearby and a beautiful forest full of hiking trails, you'll be outdoors enough. And sitting by the campfire is the perfect way to end the day. Besides the beautiful nature, there are also plenty of nice places to visit nearby, such as Silkeborg and Aarhus.

Privacy on your pitch

All the pitches on the campsite look very neat with lots of trees and shrubs. There is one large field and several smaller fields, all on a grass. In terms of size there is some difference between the pitches, but they all offer privacy. Chances are that your neighbours are a Danish family. On the attractive campsite there are also a number of large, neat log cabins to spend the night.

Playing outside

The Danes know exactly how children can have fun in nature in a simple way. The playground includes a colourful bouncy castle and a sandpit. And every now and then children can ride along with the wagon. But sitting together at the large open fire pit also gives a real camping feeling. Every summer there is an extensive programme for young and old with, for example, mini golf and football matches.

Covered patio

Not only during the activities there is a pleasant atmosphere. The covered patio is also a great place to catch up while enjoying a drink. You can grill your hamburgers or prepare a nice fresh fish on the communal barbecue.

properties.name: Uge Lystfiskeri og Camping
properties.description:
Looking for a campsite surrounded by greenery, with space, tranquillity and plenty of fishing? Uge Lystfiskeri og Camping in South Jutland is the place for you. You’ll camp among the meadows, close to fishing ponds and walking routes. There’s something for everyone: a playground, fresh rolls daily and cosy Danish towns.

Lots of space, lots of choice

The pitches are large and separated by green hedges. So, there’s lots of privacy and plenty of space for your tent, caravan or motor home. If you would prefer more comfort, you can opt for a cabin or room. The campsite is located behind a farm, which creates a rural atmosphere.

Everything you might need

The site has a little shop that sells fresh bread rolls. Children can head to the playground or meet the animals in the small petting zoo. There are various places to enjoy a barbecue too. Although there’s no swimming pool, the fishing ponds and natural swimming lake mean that there’s always plenty of water fun. Around Easter and on 21 June (midsummer night), there’s even more, with fun activities for the whole family.

Explore South Jutland

The three large trout ponds make this an angler's paradise. Walkers and cyclists are in the right place too: the area is green, with rolling hills and quiet routes. Towns like Tingley (5 km), Åbenrå (15 km) and Tønder (31 km) are close by. Perfect for an active day out with an ice cream on a terrace.

properties.name: Seeweide Naturcamping Penzlin
properties.description:
The southern interior of Mecklenburg-Voor-Pommeren is also known as the ‘Land of a Thousand Lakes’. Seeweide Naturcamping Penzlin is located on the Großer Stadtsee van Penzlin, one of the nicer recreational lakes in this area. This campsite is ideal if you like to camp in a quiet spot in a natural setting. It is a good home base for water sports activities on the lake and cycling and walking tours through the wooded surrounding area. The camping site gives you a good view of the rolling landscape.

Open site with large pitches

The comfort pitches especially are very generous, although the standard pitches, which are at least 100 square metres in size, certainly are not small. Each pitch at Seeweide Naturcamping Penzlin has grass and some demarcation. The site is open with young vegetation. The new toilet and washing facilities, like the campsite itself, are maintained excellently.

Plenty of water sports options

The big advantage of this campsite is its location by the Großer Stadtsee Penzlin. Even better, the camping site has a sandy beach right next to it. Having fun jumping into the lake is also possible, thanks to the two swimming docks next to the beach, one of which has a slide. You can also go standup paddleboarding, canoeing, go out in a pedal boat, rowing and fishing on the Großer Stadtsee. Fun can be had the campsite as well in the natural playground, at the petting zoo or on the mini golf course. Moreover, four times a year there is a fun music night.

properties.name: Kalundborg Camping
properties.description:
If you like to spend your holidays in quiet, wooded surroundings, this campsite on the island of Zealand (Denmark) might be your ideal holiday destination. This is an excellent starting point for beautiful hiking and cycling trips. Kalundborg Camping is also less than two kilometres from the long beaches of Saltbæk. An added bonus is that this part of Zealand is one of the sunniest areas in Denmark. All in all, this is an excellent campsite for those seeking peace and quiet and nature lovers who do not necessarily need a lot of luxury.

Large pitches in a green ambience

The campsite owner welcomes new campers in the wooden reception building,. On the spacious campsite grounds, you will then find neatly kept lawns surrounded by many trees and bushes. The pitches are generous in size and partly delimited by bushes and hedges. There are also five attractive hiker's huts and four modern mobile homes for rent.

Entertainment in the playground and on the mini-golf course

At the front of the campsite you will find a fun playground, consisting of a large sandpit with various original play equipment. These play facilities are suitable for children up to about ten years old. The campsite also offers a table tennis table, a nice mini-golf course and two large bouncy castles.

Visit Copenhagen

Nice sights nearby are the Røsnæs Fyr lighthouse (20 km), the castle-like church Vor Frue Kirke in Kalundborg and of course the Danish capital Copenhagen, which can be reached in just over an hour by car.

properties.name: Camping Südeifel
properties.description:
Camping Südeifel is in beautiful, natural surroundings in the south of the German Eifel region. Here, you camp next to the River Prüm, on the outskirts of the village of Irrel. The campsite is ideal for people looking for quiet and wanting to enjoy the countryside. From here, you can get to the Teufelsschlucht in no time; it is a well-known gorge where you can go on lovely walks.

Traditional camping or glamping

Whether you bring a tent, caravan or motorhome, or prefer a bit more luxury, everything is possible at Camping Südeifel. You camp on a spacious and open grass field, with views of the trees and right by the Prüm. You can paddle in the river and throw out a line. Furthermore, there are several furnished safari tents for the ultimate glamping experience. The toilet and washing facilities are recently renovated and look great.

Try delicious Italian dishes

Camping Südeifel is the right address for people seeking quiet above all. So do not expect extensive amenities or an activities programme. You don't have to leave the campsite for a tasty meal. You can enjoy delicious Italian dishes at restaurant-pizzeria Da Toni. The pizzas are made with fresh ingredients.

Go out and about in the Eifel

The Eifel is known for its stunning natural beauty. The waterfalls of Irreler are in Südeifel nature park. The waterfalls can be reached via a suspension bridge that opened in 2023. It's a lovely area for walking. The well-known Teufelsschlucht is also close by. Here, you walk between the imposing rock formations that originate from more than 200 million years ago.

properties.name: Camping Wiedhof
properties.description:
This small farm campsite in Waldbreitbach, Germany is a fantastic destination for camping enthusiasts looking for a unique and relaxing holiday. Located in the heart of the beautiful Westerwald, this friendly campsite on the Wied River offers breathtaking views of the surrounding nature. If you enjoy hiking or cycling, there's no better place to stretch your legs than in the beautiful surroundings of Camping Wiedhof.

Everyone's always welcome

Campers can visit Camping Wiedhof 24 hours a day, regardless of the reception's opening hours. Dogs are also very welcome at the campsite. The camping pitches are all situated on the river. They are spacious and well maintained. It is also possible to stay in the apartment above the reception. The sanitary facilities are considered a major plus by many guests. They are modern and clean, with adequate showers and toilets.

Enjoying the river

Children have plenty of room to play on the large lawn, on the playground and at the table tennis table. In the evenings you can enjoy the friendly atmosphere around the campfire. Thanks to the campsite's location on the river, you can also go swimming, fishing and boating. For a perfect end to your day, you can walk to the Riviera ice cream parlour in just 10 minutes.

Cycling and hiking paradise

Whether you're a hiking fanatic or prefer to cycle quietly from village to village, Camping Wiedhof is a popular destination for hikers and cyclists alike. The beautiful wooded area is best explored via the countless trails.

properties.name: Campinggarten Wahlwies
properties.description:
Campinggarten Wahlwies lies in the south of Germany, between fruit orchards and close to Lake Constance. On this small family campsite, you can savour the peace of the countryside, whilst camping under apple trees. However, tourism around Lake Constance is also close at hand. The camping pitches on Campinggarten Wahlwies are spaciously laid out and the recently renovated sanitary facilities look immaculate.

Camping under apple trees

The campsite is modestly sized, so that the campsite owners are able to pay attention to each guest. Fruit farming, which you will often come across in the area, also plays an important role here. The spacious camping pitches at the front section of the campsite are located under the apple trees. Further towards the back are more camping pitches, also spaciously laid out, on an open field. 

Modern toilet facilities

There are two buildings with sanitary facilities, one of which has very recently been upgraded (2018). The other building will be renovated in 2019. 

Catering

You can purchase a few groceries and regional products at the reception of this small family campsite. Further shopping can be done in the village of Wahlwies (2 km) or Stahringen (4 km). You are spoilt for choice when you want to go out for a meal. For instance in Bodman (6 km), with view of Lake Constance, or near the glider airfield of Stahringen.

Also for four-legged companions

Furthermore, the campsite has a small playground with a jungle gym and a table tennis table. Your four-legged companions will also enjoy themselves on Campinggarten Wahlwies. There is a dedicated playing field and a separate dog shower for them.

properties.name: wecamp Cudillero
properties.description:
Wecamp Cudillero is located on the Spanish northwest coast close to an idyllic surfing beach. The location of the campsite is also appealing due to being near the unique and colourful fishing village of Cudillero. You can enjoy the nice outdoor swimming pool and spacious pitches amid the countryside at the quiet, small family campsite. There are lovely routes in the vicinity with vast views of the Cantabrian Sea for walking enthusiasts.

Camping in peace and quiet on spacious pitches

After a warm welcome from the owners, you arrive at a well-cared for and clean campsite. A calm atmosphere prevails and all the grassy fields with spacious touring pitches are nice and neat. The pitches are surrounded by low hedges for additional privacy. Please note that camping with your own tent is not allowed on this campsite. The toilet and washing facilities are lovely and clean. If you would like to spend the night in one of the wooden bungalows, you can choose from various types that vary in size.

Go for a lovely swim

If you would like to go for a refreshing swim, the campsite has a lovely swimming pool with a separate paddling pool. The clearly laid out swimming pool is in a sunny spot and has lovely palm tree landscaping. There are sun loungers around the swimming pool. It is also lovely swimming in the sea of course. You can get to the beach in no time.

Local fish in Cudillero

Due to the picturesque fishing harbour, Cudilleo is a popular attraction drawing many visitors. This is nestled between stunning cliffs where you see hanging houses with brightly-coloured window frames. The lovely centre is the ideal place for a bite to eat. You will find fresh seafood on the menu at any restaurants.

properties.name: wecamp Pedraforca
properties.description:
Camping Repòs del Pedraforca is situated in the Catalanian Parc Natural del Cadí-Moixeró nature reserve. Here you are surrounded by the Pre-Pyrenees, the massive foothills of the Pyrenees. From this campsite you have a view of the highest mountain of the Cadí-Moixeró: the Pedraforca. Camping on campsite Repòs del Pedraforca revolves around the mountains. The campsite is a good base for a great hike or a challenging mountain bike trip.

Terraced campsite for tent campers

Camping Repòs del Pedraforca is -how could it be otherwise?- a terraced campsite. The terrain climbs fairly steeply in some places. Therefore, it may require some skill to manoeuvre the caravan onto its spot. If you want to make things easier for yourself, you can also rent a chalet. However, you can also bring your tent. The camping pitches are very suitable for tent campers. 

Cookery workshops and water aerobics

You can get to know your fellow campers a bit better at one of the activities which are organised on the campsite. Discover the Spanish cuisine with a cookery workshop or work on your condition with a water aerobics lesson in the outdoor swimming pool. Children can participate in all kinds of games. The campsite also has an indoor swimming pool with whirlpool.

Hearty meal

After a day's hike or bike ride, you deserve a hearty meal. In the campsite supermarket you will find sufficient supplies to satisfy your appetite. For a more extensive range you can go to Saldes, a five-minute ride from the campsite. Or you can enjoy dinner for a reasonable price in the campsite restaurant.

properties.name: wecamp Cabo de Gata
properties.description:
You will find wecamp Cabo de Gata in the south of Spain in the province of Almería at walking distance from a stunning bay. In the eponymous UNESCO nature reserve, you stay in a volcanic landscape with steep cliffs. The luxury campsite was completely renovated in 2022 and exudes pure comfort. The lovely swimming pool, restaurant and neat toilet and washing facilities make this a wonderful sun destination for families. A walk through the desert-like backdrop to the nearby village of Las Negras only takes 20 minutes.

Shade awning above your camping pitch

Surrounded by the beauty of the large rock formations, you camp on level pitches on a gravel surface. In the summer, shade awnings are hung above the pitches, which provide the requisite shade. Please note that camping with your own tent is not allowed on this campsite.

Luxury glamping accommodation

There are also luxury glamping tents, furnished bungalows and cool pods at wecamp Cabo de Gata. They are all fully equipped and provided with lovely bright furniture. The amount of space between the accommodation differs. From many pitches you can witness an unforgettable sunset every evening.

Swim in the sea and the swimming pool

Thanks to the lovely weather, here you can enjoy both the swimming pool as well as the water of the Mediterranean Sea. Ideal for children. The lovely outdoor swimming pool is a decent size, it is surrounded by sun loungers and sheltered by a mountain on one side. It is in a lovely location next to Restaurant La Cantina. There are fun activities on the KidsClub programme in the summer months.

properties.name: wecamp Santa Cristina
properties.description:
Wecamp Santa Cristina is in the middle of a forest and two kilometres from the centre of the Spanish town of Santa Cristina d'Aro. It is a modern and luxury family campsite on the Costa Brava for those who like peace and quiet. The closest beach is a 10-minute drive and the city of Girona is also easy to reach (30 km). Despite the vast number of activities in the area, wecamp Santa Cristina campsite is an oasis of peace and quiet.

Camping on the Costa Brava

Wecamp Camping Santa Cristina is on the Costa Brava. It is a stretch of coast on the Mediterranean Sea with stunning beaches. The region attracts many tourists each year, but you can also find quiet spots. Wecamp Camping Santa Cristina is one of those quiet spots in the tourist region. The campsite has 208 camping pitches and some luxury rental accommodation. You camp amid the old cork and fir trees. Enjoy the peace at the campsite or use the amenities. Please note that camping with your own tent is not allowed on this campsite.

Plenty to do

There is plenty for the whole family to do at the campsite. The outdoor swimming pool is in a central spot at the campsite and surrounded by wooden decking with beach beds. There is also a sports area with a beach volleyball and tennis court, a table tennis table and options for hiring both mountain bikes as well as electric bikes.

Modern toilet and washing facilities

The campsite has a modern, stylishly furnished toilet block equipped with all the amenities. For example, there are communal dishwashers and washing machines. The walls are covered in lovely green tiles, combined with bright wooden partitions. And to complete your luxury holiday, there are rain showers.

properties.name: wecamp Pirineos
properties.description:
Wecamp Pirineos is surrounded by the beautiful nature of the Spanish Pyrenees. You can camp amidst the lush green nature in a small field, or stay in one of the rentals between the trees. Pirineos is a real family campsite, with plenty for young and old alike to do and see!

Wecamp Pirineos is the perfect combination of nature, adventure and culture: close to majestic mountains and nature parks, but also not far from delightful villages where you can sample the traditional Spanish lifestyle. Once you leave the motorway, roads enclosed by beautiful nature will take you towards the campsite.

From the reception, you will arrive at spacious camping grounds with different terraces. You'll immediately notice how well maintained everything is and how green much attention goes into the greenery. As a result, many of the pitches are located in the shade and creatively integrated into their surroundings. The pitch sizes vary from 80 to 120 m2. Please note that camping with your own tent is not allowed on this campsite.

Active family campsite

Wecamp Pirineos is a real family campsite. Your neighbours will be families and older people of all different nationalities. In the low season, you'll meet mainly Spanish families and older generations.

The swimming pools have also cleverly been integrated in the natural surroundings of this campsite. There is a paddling pool for the little ones and a large pool where you can swim lengths to your heart's content. An array of activities such as aquagym and animation for the kids are organised in the swimming pool in the summer months. You can relax and enjoy the Spanish sun on the sun terraces around the pools.

properties.name: Camping Alpes Dauphiné
properties.description:
Camping Alpes Dauphiné has a wonderful location about three kilometres north of the town of Gap. In the summer months, a bus will take you to the centre for free from the campsite. The mountainous Les Ecrins National Park is also just around the corner, ideal for hikers.

Spacious pitches with shade

Thanks to the terraces, all spacious pitches have privacy. Some sites are slightly sloped, for campers there are stabilised sites. There are trees all over the campsite that provide pleasant shelter during hot days. Those who do not bring their own tent, caravan or camper can spend the night in a fully equipped chalet, bungalow or gîte.

Swimming with a view

The large swimming pool will surprise you. Young and old can enjoy themselves here all day. Around the pool are comfortable sun loungers. The beautiful view of the mountains is for free! For the little ones, there is a separate children's pool. And, for ultimate relaxation, there is even a Jacuzzi.

Eating out

A stay at this campsite is not complete without a visit to the atmospheric restaurant L'Oregon. In the summer, a band plays occasionally and there are weekly themed meals. The extensive menu includes regional specialties and fresh pizzas. If you prefer to eat at your own camping spot, just pick up the food.

Children's campsite

Face painting, dancing and crafts. That and much more is enthusiastically offered at the kids' club in the mornings during the summer vacations. For teenagers, there are sports competitions in the afternoon. The playground is also a fun place to play with new friends.

properties.name: Camping Las Torres
properties.description:
In the south-east of Spain, in the Murcia region, you will find Camping Las Torres. The easily accessible campsite is located in the interior behind the coastal town of Puerto de Mazarrón. Your view from the campsite is determined by the barren mountains on the one side and the orchards, horticultural areas and sea on the other side.

Spending the winter in the sun

The campsites, located on sand and gravel, are generally spacious and spread out over the complex. Palm trees and orange trees provide shade and greenery. The toilet facilities, in a sanitary building with nice wall murals, are clean, functional and well-maintained.

The large camping also has many rental accommodations and permanent sites and is open all year round.

Bingo and petanque

The facilities and entertainment on the camping are also adapted to this. In addition to an outdoor swimming pool, there is also a heated covered pool where you can regularly participate in aqua gym lessons. Outside there are opportunities to play a game of tennis or petanque and afterwards you can relax with a snack or drink in the camping bar. At night you can take part in a bingo or quiz evening or enjoy live music.

Golden beaches on the Costa Cálida

The quiet golden beaches of the Costa Cálida are 2.5 km from the campsite. Would you rather go to a more touristy beach? Then visit the coastal town of Puerto de Mazzarón with a marina and a charming boulevard with many restaurants and bars.

properties.name: L'Amuravela
properties.description:
Camping L'Amuravela is a well-kept family campsite on the unspoiled Costa Verde. The campsite has a spacious pool and is ideal for children. The site is close to a wide sandy beach and is near one of the most beautiful fishing villages in the region: Cudillero.

Historical location near the coast

Just south of Cudillero, L'Amuravela Campsite has a special location in the walled grounds of a nineteenth-century villa. The site is built with low terraces. The campsite looks neat and orderly.

Neat pitches on grass

A place in the sun or in the shade? You choose! All the pitches are spacious, and the lawn is well-maintained. In addition to touring pitches, the campsite rents out various types of wooden bungalows.
