Fun in the pool or the sea

Start the day with a dip in the fine pool. Do bring your swimming cap, as that is the house rule. The rectangular pool is located in a sunny, open area. Swimming in the Atlantic Ocean is also a treat. Aguilar beach is ten minutes by car. Parking here is free in high season.

Bar with good coffee

You can also get a simple bite to eat on the campsite. The cafeteria offers sandwiches, burgers and pizzas. And not to forget; a nice cup of coffee on the cozy terrace. There is a small supermarket if you need the odd item of shopping. Feel like eating somewhere else? The nice restaurants on the waterfront are always worth a visit. Who knows, you might even find fabada on the menu. This is a popular regional bean dish with bacon and spicy sausages.

properties.name: Camping Gran Sol
properties.description:
Camping Gran Sol is situated in the north of Spain, just south of Andorra. Here you find the Spanish Pyrenees towering over the landscape as well as the capricious Segre river. Campsite Gran Sol is an ideal spot for active campers. The area is ideal for outdoor activities: a brisk hike through the Spanish mountain landscape or rafting down the wild river.

Level camping pitches

From the entrance you can see the town of Montferrer, high atop the mountain overlooking the campsite. You can see the mountains all around campsite Gran Sol, but the campsite itself is in a level area. The grounds are well organised: you camp on spacious pitches which are shaded by planted trees.

Cooling off in the pool

After a long mountain walk in the Spanish sun, a refreshing dive is just what you need. The spacious swimming pool is just the ticket to cool down. Perfect for swimming a few laps. At times there is a lively atmosphere, at other times it can be surprisingly quiet.  

Restaurant

The campsite has a small shop which stocks a few items. You can do your daily shopping in La Seu d'Urgell, located at some three km from the campsite. However, before you start preparing a meal, have a look at the extensive restaurant menu. 

Hiking and rafting

At campsite Gran Sol you camp in a magnificent area which is extremely suitable for a number of outdoor activities. You can walk (or ride your mountain bike) from the campsite straight into the mountains. To paraphrase: 'and what goes up must come down'. By paragliding, for instance. The Segre river, a few hundred metres from the campsite, has a rather capricious nature. Ideal for rafting.

properties.name: Camping La Vieille-Eglise
properties.description:
Camping La Vieille-Eglise is located at the foot of the Alps in Haut-Savoie, on a hillside on the shores of Lake Geneva, on the border of France and Switzerland. On the higher part of the campsite you have a beautiful view over the lake.

The campsite is located west of the village of Lugrin. From the hillside you overlook Lake Geneva. Via the D1005 you drive along the bank in the direction of Lugrin. There you follow the camping signs. After a few kilometers uphill you reach the campsite where you will be welcomed by Bernard and his staff, who speak good English.

Campsite at Lake Geneva

The touring pitches on the lower part are shady. The pitches higher up are slightly sunnier and have a nice view over the lake. The way up is a bit tight with a large caravan or motorhome. In addition to the more than seventy touring pitches, there are also several mobile homes. The campsite swimming pool, with paddling pool, can be found next to the reception. At the reception you can get some groceries or order bread in high season.

Camping at Lake Geneva

A short drive and you're on the shore of Lake Geneva. At Lugrin the shore is rocky, you can best drive on to Évian-les-Bains. In this town it is pleasant at the waterfront. A little further to the west lies Thonon-les-Bains, from where you can make beautiful trips on the lake. Ferries bring you to Geneva and Lausanne.

properties.name: Camping La Clé de Saône
properties.description:
Along the banks of the Saône, next to a recreational lake, is camping La Clé de Saône. This simple 3-star campsite has very spacious pitches on the grass, under the trees. The most beautiful pitches are located directly on the river and offer a beautiful view over the water. Because of its location along the Route du Soleil, between Dijon and Lyon, this is an ideal transit campsite.

On the banks of the Saône

Camping La Clé de Saône is beautifully situated on the banks of the river. The campsite is beautifully green and consists of several camping fields. There are 160 spacious touring pitches available. The many trees provide shade, but you can also choose a pitch in the full sun. On some fields the pitches are separated by hedges, others are more open. The most beautiful spots are right next to the river.

Refuel for a while

Next to the campsite, directly on the river, is a restaurant. The dishes are simple and the choice is limited, but on the terrace you can sit at the water's edge. You can also go there for a drink or an ice cream. In the morning you can get fresh bread, but you have to order it the day before. If you want to eat out a bit more extensively, you'll find all kinds of restaurants in Crêches-sur-Saône.

properties.name: La Gallouette
properties.description:
La Gallouette is a coastal campsite on the edge of the fishing town of Saint-Vaast-la-Hougue on the Normandy peninsula of Cotentin. You'll camp here on a quiet campsite with an open character, directly on the bay.

Welcome!

The campsite is located in the northeast of Cotentin Peninsula in Normandy. 110 spacious touring pitches are situated on neat, beautifully tended lawns, all separated by hedges. The Mobile homes are on the side of the terrain, separated from the touring pitches.

A heated pool

The swimming pool is located next to the reception building, where you will also find the restaurant with snacks. The spacious pool is heated. Next to the pool is a round paddling pool. If the little ones get tired of the water, they can let off steam in the playground. There are two sanitary blocks on the campsite. The friendly staff is busy cleaning all day long, so the sanitary facilities are always clean and fresh.

Fort de la Hougue

The area is a wonderful walking and cycling area. For example, walk along the narrow spit of land. At the end is the former fortress of La Hougue with its tower, from where the view over the Sea and Saint-Vaast-la-Hougue is beautiful.

properties.name: Flower Camping La Plage
properties.description:
In the heart of the Plateau de Millevaches regional natural park, Flower Camping La Plage is truly a camping destination for people who love the outdoors. This pleasant campsite overlooks a large lake with a sandy beach where guests can enjoy swimming, canoeing and pedalos.

Camping at the waterfront

At Flower Camping La Plage the pitches are located on one of the four little streets. The trees, plants and shrubs characterise the spacious pitches. Those who need little comfort, choose a nature pitch without electricity. Many pitches offer a view of the lake, but are not always flat. On the gently sloping terrain there are also a number of good-looking sturdy lodges and furnished tents. The two sanitary blocks are neat and well maintained.

Private beach

A small tunnel under the road takes you to the campsite's trump card: the beautiful sandy beach and the lake of Bariousses. In the clear water you can swim, rent a canoe or ride a pedalo. During the summer months, a small bar is open and a lifeguard keeps an eye on you. Even when the weather is not so good you can swim at the campsite, because at the front near the reception is a heated swimming pool that can be covered.

Fun and games

In the summer holidays children make friends at the Kidsclub. Five days a week there is plenty of fun with an entertainment team, for example to draw together or play at the bouncy castle. Children can also have fun in the playground on the beach. For teenagers there is a ping-pong table and there is plenty to do around the lake.

properties.name: Flower Camping Les Ondines
properties.description:
On the green banks of the river Dordogne, the natural environment is rugged and hilly. Here you camp in the Massif Central, the heart of France with its picturesque landscapes. The beautiful surroundings of Flower Camping Les Ondines are perfect for cycling and walking.

Camping on grass

The terrain has several small streets along which the pitches are laid out. You can choose between a nature pitch and a comfort pitch. Hedges and shrubs create a natural border between the spacious pitches. The many trees on the site also provide plenty of shade. A separate field has been set up for tent campers. Campers without camping equipment can spend the night in the tidy mobile homes and sturdy lodges.

Campsite for swimming enthusiasts

Flower Camping Les Ondines offers plenty of choice for those who love swimming. The campsite's swimming pool is heated and conveniently located for sunbathing. For safety, a low fence has been placed around the pool. The fountain in the paddling pool makes it a friendly place for young families. Right next to the campsite, teenagers can spend their energy in the Quercyland water park with high water slides. Finally, the Dordogne offers cooling, the river flows opposite the campsite.

Good food and drink

In the wooden building next to the swimming pool you can enjoy ice cream, a drink or a snack all day long. In the morning you can get fresh baguettes at the bar. For a bite to eat in the evening, you can walk to the village centre of Souillac for pleasant restaurants. All amenities, such as large supermarkets, are also there. On Friday morning there is a market.

properties.name: Camping Campilô
properties.description:
In the sloping landscape of the Vendée, less than ten kilometres south of La Roche-sur-Yon, you will find camping Campilô. Here you camp on a spacious pitch or in a mobile home right next to a large fishing lake. The covered outdoor swimming pool with water playground is the place to be for children, while nature lovers can enjoy a quiet evening stroll around the lake.

New campsite

The campsite is new and it shows: on a well-maintained terrain there are over forty touring pitches beautifully laid out in the natural surroundings. Tall trees provide shade for each pitch. The mobile homes and chalets, situated directly on the lake, are modern. You can also spend the night in a Coco Sweet tent, an attractive tent furnished with a small kitchen.

Indoor swimming pool with water playground

The covered, heated swimming pool is a great asset. The transparent roof allows the sun to heat the pool. Next to the swimming pool, between thatched parasols and sun loungers, is the water playground. Here children can run through the fountains and enjoy themselves, while the parents lie in the sun and keep an eye on things.

Facilities at the campsite

The reception is centrally located and also contains a bar. Here you can enjoy a drink on the pavement cafe with a nice view. The campsite shop provides basic supplies, for more extensive groceries you can go to La Roche-sur-Yon. The sanitary facilities on the campsite are excellent. Very clean and brand new, like the whole campsite.

properties.name: Camping Demoiselles Plage
properties.description:
Camping Demoiselles Plage is in a prime location in the Vendée: in the heart of the dune forest and just 200 m from the beach. The site is large and gently sloping. It’s a great place to enjoy peace and quiet and the great outdoors! The heated swimming pool, various playgrounds and an enthusiastic team complete the picture.

Camping pitches with character and comfort

The separated camping fields vary in size between 40 and 90 m² and are spread across the hilly site. The pitches are for tents, caravans, motor homes and trailer tents. Electricity is optional. Accommodation is grouped close together, in various types and sizes. For example, luxury lodge tent with patio and various mobile homes with private toilet/washing facilities. Fun fact: there are information boards about the landscape and local plants. It’s a fun way to learn more about the beautiful surroundings.

Swim, play and relax at the campsite

Head to the heated swimming pool, paddling pool and slides to cool off and have fun, but there’s plenty to do everywhere on the campsite. Entertainment is organised for toddlers and teenagers and there’s a multi-sports field and a playground with a bouncy castle. Lots is organised in the evenings too, from dance evenings to bingo and live music. Or how about a summer evening party by the pool? The campsite is popular with French campers. So, entertainment is in French and English. Things like breakfast service, a cosy restaurant and charging stations for electric cars haven’t been forgotten either.

properties.name: Ringkøbing Camping
properties.description:
In Denmark, the water is never far away. This is also the case at Ringkøbing Campsite, from which you can cycle to a fjord or the North Sea beaches. But what is really unique about this beautiful campsite is that you are also in the middle of the forest. This makes it feel like a real nature campsite. The atmosphere is friendly and welcoming, and you can easily fill your entire holiday with cycling and walking tours, swimming and water sports. If you like, you can also dive into Denmark's rich Viking history.

When you arrive at your destination, you'll feel like you are in the middle of the forest on a real nature campsite that is also neatly maintained. At the reception, which also serves as a camping shop, you will receive a friendly welcome from the owners. There are more than 100 spacious camping pitches on the campsite, separated by trees and shrubs, so you have plenty of privacy. There are also a number of hikers' cabins, 'nature suites' and a safari tent for rent.

Walking in the dog forest

The area is particularly suitable for exploring by bike, thanks to a good network of signposted cycle paths. This makes the campsite ideal for cycling enthusiasts. Dogs and their owners also feel at home at this campsite. The site borders on a 'hundeskove', an off-leash dog forest where you can walk for hours. The campsite is mainly visited by guests from Denmark, Germany and also some Dutch people. Families with children also frequent this campsite.

properties.name: Camping Simmerschmelz
properties.description:
Camping Simmerschmelz is in a somewhat remote location, in a hilly area amidst the forests of the Eisch Valley and approx. 2 km from the village of Septfontaines. The Eisch Valley, together with the Mamer Valley, is a part of the largest nature reserve of Luxembourg. This beautiful spot is crossed by numerous cycling and walking paths.

Great camping amidst greenery

The camping area is split up in several fields. They are separated from each other by trees and bushes. A part of the pitches is reserved for permanent guests. The tourist pitches are located on the east side at the back of the campsite. The majority of the pitches is rather compact, although a few fairly large pitches are also available. The grounds look very green due to the trees, the bushes, the grass and the forest which starts on the periphery of the campsite.

Restaurant

The campsite is in a fairly remote location. There is a restaurant (reasonably-sized menu) with a terrace overlooking the playground and the lawn behind it.

properties.name: Camping De Rimboe
properties.description:
In the heart of the Netherlands, on the Veluwe, you can find Camping De Rimboe. This is a quietly-set wooded campsite with remarkably spacious pitches, both on a central grassy area and in the forest. De Rimboe is an ideal base for hiking and cycling fans, thanks to the many routes leading from the campsite to the wonderful nature.

A good first impression

Camping De Rimboe is located on a slightly sloping terrain with spacious spots in the forest. The pitches are not demarcated and feature plenty of shade. The pitches on the grassy field do, of course, receive plenty of sunlight. The modern sanitary facilities on the campsite are plentiful, even in the busier high season.

Natural camping

A special feature here is that you can reserve a pitch in the middle of the forest. You will camp a little further away from the campsite, but will have an area measuring around one hectare where you can camp in the wild. You can, of course, use all the facilities of De Rimboe.

Swimming pool with a hint of the park

Camping De Rimboe does not have its own swimming pool, but the wonderful Bosbad Lunteren, a natural swimming pool with an undulating shape, is just nine hundred metres away. The lawns are terraced and the garden parties and trees of the grounds give the whole area a park-like twist.

Fantastic cycling routes

From the campsite you can cycle from junction to junction following the numbered signs of the Veluwe bicycle node network. These bicycle routes, often car-free, are set out across the best cycling paths and are signposted in two directions. The network of bicycle routes runs through forests, heathlands and meadows, but also through villages and towns.

properties.name: Camping Domaine Le Pommier - Ciela Village
properties.description:
On the large-scale family campsite Domaine le Pommier, situated in the south of the Ardèche, there is plenty to do for each family member. With a gigantic swimming complex (12 slides), several types of sports fields and professional entertainment teams there is enough to keep one busy. The campsite is located on a mountain. This provides you with a lovely view of the rugged, lush environment.

Pitches and accommodation for all

The campsite is large and has a large number of streets. There is a fair amount of vegetation in the form of bushes and trees. You have a beautiful view from virtually everywhere. The large site is home to 220 touring pitches and almost 600 rental accommodation units. The pitches are demarcated here and there and most of them are in the shade. The surface is grass or gravel. 

Furthermore, there is a large variation of accommodation units: tents, mobile homes, bungalows and 'Pipo' caravans. Both small and large groups can be accommodated here.

Largest swimming pool complex in the country

Water fanatics do not need to look any further than campsite Le Pommier. The swimming complex of the campsite is the largest in France. Laid out on 1.2 ha are 12 water slides, various heated pools, waterfalls, a jacuzzi, a pirate ship and a variety of play equipment. 

The little ones can play in the toddler pool, real water fanatics can head for the pool with underwater jets. The pools are located in the sun but with a large number of sun umbrellas and loungers available you can also enjoy the shade.

Spoilt for choice

The campsite has no fewer then six catering establishments, varying from a large, luxury restaurant (with an array of delicious regional dishes) to a pizza restaurant. The last restaurant has an attractive terrace and a stage. Here you can enjoy a variety of evening performances.

properties.name: Camping Les Fontaines - Ciela Village
properties.description:
Camping Les Fontaines is situated just a kilometre away from Pernes-les-Fontaines, south of Carpentras. Pernes-les-Fontaines is a lovely small town with charming narrow streets, shops and restaurants. You can easily walk into town from the campsite.

Pitches and rental possibilities

Most of the camping pitches are located on grassy soil and have marked boundaries and electricity.

Furthermore, at Camping Les Fontaines you have plenty of choice when it comes to rental options. Several mobile homes are available for all budgets, for up to 8 people. All mobile homes are fully equipped and have a pleasant wooden terrace.

Water park with play equipment

The water park at Camping Les Fontaines, with its Provençal family atmosphere, is guaranteed to be loved. There is a lovely heated swimming pool, a paddling pool, water games, a water slide and a sun terrace with loungers and parasols to enjoy the sun.

There is plenty of entertainment available on the campsite. There is a kids' club, a playground, a petanque court, a multi-sports ground and a bouncy castle. The campsite also offers a variety of daytime and evening activities for young and old.

properties.name: Camping Les Marsouins - Ciela Village
properties.description:
Camping Les Marsouins is located in the region of Languedoc-Rousillon, about 800 metres from the beach of the Mediterranean Sea (Côte Vermeille). From the entrance of the campsite, a tourist train leaves regularly to the centre of this village and to the centre of the historic town of Argelès-sur-Mer.

Spacious pitches in the greenery

The touring pitches at Les Marsouins campsite are rectangular in shape and have a clear demarcation of lovely plants. The pitches are more than 90m2 (comfort pitches are even 120 m2) and are particularly spacious. You can also stay in one of the modern furnished mobile homes. 

Swimming pool and beach

The heated swimming pool with five slides stretches out over a lovely green area of at least one hectare. Around it there are sunbathing lawns of real grass with loungers. There is also a terrace like solarium. The lovely sandy beach of the Mediterranean Sea is only 800 metres away.

Entertainment and sports

The activities include, crafts, music, sports and games, depending on the age of the children. For the very young (from 5 years) there is a kids club. During the day there are aqua aerobics, swimming pool games, sports tournaments and more.

Dining and shop

Camping Les Marsouins has a nicely stocked shop. Not enough choice? There is also a large supermarket not far from the campsite. The restaurant has a menu with a wide choice.

properties.name: Veluwe camping 't Schinkel
properties.description:
Camping ’t Schinkel is situated on the edge of the Veluwe, not far from the eastern entrance of National Park de Hoge Veluwe. (Young) visitors reign supreme on this campsite. For the naming every effort has been made to give the facilities a royal touch. And where in the world can one spend the night in a dragon egg?

Lovely sloping terrain with beautiful vistas

The terrain slopes gently and has sunny spots all over. The camping pitches are spacious and are located on camping fields names reminiscent of fairy tales, such as Spinnenrijk, Apenwoud or Regenboogdal. In many places there are hedges, separating the pitches at the back. Due to the sloping landscape, many pitches have a lovely view over the grounds . The distance to your neighbours is always generous. The more shady pitches are located at the perimeter of the campsite.

Royal Bath Houses

The sanitary facilities (the Royal Bath Houses) are neat and tidy. In the centre of one of the fields is the sanitary building for children with decorated exterior. This decoration extends to the interior.

Sleeping in a dragon egg

On the grounds there are unique types of rental accommodation available. You can, for instance, spend the night in a Dragon Egg or Royal Abode. The Dragon Egg is suitable for two adults and a maximum of two small children. The Royal Abode is a bungalow for four persons, equipped with all amenities.

properties.name: Camping Les Vergers de Squividan
properties.description:
Les Vergers de Squidivan is a friendly campsite in the southwest of Brittany. The campsite is full of trees and flowers. There is also plenty of nature just around the corner. A short 400-metre walk away, you will discover a beautiful beach and the sea. The campsite entertainment is modest, but enjoyable. For example, there is a small pool, you can play table tennis, and there are workshops on baking bread.

Camping with a sea view

Les Vergers de Squidivan is characterised by its many trees and flowers. It is a green campsite where nature still has free rein. Some fifty camping sites are located in this beautiful setting. You will have plenty of privacy and space to camp. There are also many fine spots with shade and with a sea view! Those who arrive without camping equipment can choose from one of the twelve bungalows, an apartment or a luxury cottage.

Fun in the water

Of course, with the sea just around the corner, you can practise all kinds of water sports. Swimming, boating, diving and fishing; whatever you feel like. The beach consists of fine, white sand. Sunbathing here is a real treat. Children also know how to make the most of it by building sandcastles. Not a seawater fan? The campsite has had an indoor pool since 2020. There is also a paddling pool for the very youngest campers. What's more, there's also a sauna.

Sporting activities

With a table tennis table, multi-sports field and bowling alley, you can stay in shape on holiday, too. If it rains, the large recreation room is the best place to meet fellow campers. Sit cosily by the fireplace, read a book or play a board game.

properties.name: Camping De Bovenberg
properties.description:
Just outside the village of Markelo in Twente you will find camping de Bovenberg. This family campsite combines simple camping fun with tranquillity and luxury. The pitches of this campsite are very spacious. Children can play there. There is a natural swimming pool with a migratory raft and a sandy beach. You can play inside in the indoor playground. With a special sanitary building and cosy log cabins, camping de Bovenberg is not a standard campsite.

Quiet camping

The first thing you notice when you walk onto camping de Bovenberg, is the space. The terrain consists of large lawns surrounded by trees. On these beautiful camping fields there are very spacious touring pitches. So you can enjoy your holiday in peace and quiet. Don't you bring your own tent or caravan? Then choose one of the log cabins on the campsite. These cosy accommodations have private sanitary facilities and a TV connection. And they can accommodate an entire family.

A beach in Twente?

You might not expect it, but at this campsite you can lie on the beach. Close to the entrance there is a natural swimming pool with a sandy beach. It's great for sunbathing and swimming. Especially the children will enjoy the swimming pond. In the clean, clear water there is an inflatable slide and a towing raft.

Fresh bread and the morning newspaper

Fancy a nice fry? At the entrance of the campsite you will find a snack bar. Sit down on the terrace and enjoy fries and an ice cream. In the campsite shop you can buy the morning paper and a fresh roll. Cycle or drive to the centre of Markelo.

properties.name: Camping De Molenhof
properties.description:
Between Weerselo and Reutum, two charming villages in Twente, lies Camping De Molenhof. This large family campsite is a wonderful vacation destination for families with children. There are two swimming pools, fun activities, sports facilities, and play areas. The surrounding area offers plenty to explore with its walking and cycling routes, amusement parks, and cosy towns in Twente. After an active day of holidaying, you can enjoy a meal at the café, or grab a takeaway from the snack bar or the pizzeria.

Choose your own spot at this large five-star campsite

Looking for a campsite where tourist pitches are still the majority? Then come to De Molenhof and choose your own comfort pitch. Would you like to be near the fishing pond, one of the 34 (!) playgrounds, or perhaps on a quiet spot? The choice is yours. The sanitary facilities are as you would expect from a five-star campsite: heated, easily accessible, and excellently maintained. For the youngest campers, there are children’s toilets in a cheerful farm style. If you stay in a camping hut, you will also use the shared showers and toilets. The luxury lodges and holiday homes have their own sanitary facilities.

Loads of activities for children

Swim to your heart’s content in a beautiful indoor pool with a retractable roof, along with an outdoor lagoon pool. There are two spectacular water slides, a toddler pool, and numerous water play structures at the pools. More water fun awaits at the PlonsPlas, where children can splash around and play with water and sand. To make it even more exciting, there are also some obstacles and a zip line here. During school holidays, there is daily entertainment for children.

properties.name: Camping de Renval
properties.description:
Camping de Renval is situated on the outskirts of Bastogne (Bastenaken) in the heart of the Belgian Ardennes. The campsite, situated in a hilly landscape with forests and winding rivers, consists mainly of a rather large field with spaciously demarcated pitches.

Bastogne is, of course, mostly known for the Battle of the Bulge (1944). You will find a number of reminders of this in the region, such as the American tank near the Tourist Information offices and the impressive Mardasson Memoral, just outside the town.

Large camping

Of the 270 pitches on the campsite grounds, 150 are reserved for permanent guests who have their caravans there. The remainder is allocated to mobile homes and tents/caravans. The pitches for the mobiles homes have water and electricity. There is free wifi all over the campground.

Belgian beers and trout on the barbecue

Right next to the campsite you'll find a cafeteria with lovely terrace and spacious facilities, including a wide choice of Belgian beers and small snacks. The adjacent restaurant offers a small menu with dishes from the grill, fish and shellfish. On the campsite there is a fishing pond where you can catch your own trout, which you can subsequently prepare on the barbecue. The sanitary facilities are housed in two heated buildings, where you will also find washing machines and dryers.

Activities

In addition to the mini golf course, the campsite has a petanque pitch (jeu de boules). Furthermore, there are tennis courts, squash courts and signposted walking and cycling routes in the immediate vicinity. The outstanding RAVel-parcours (to Wiltz and Gouvy) over traffic-calmed roads makes for excellent walking and cycling.

properties.name: Camping de Pallegarste
properties.description:
Camping de Pallegartse in Mariënberg in Overijssel is a true family campground where children of all ages can have a fantastic holiday, together with their parents, naturally. The campground is located in a charming landscape where you can enjoy the beautiful natural surroundings. Swimmers certainly have plenty to do. The campground has spacious campsites, much greenery and fantastic play options. The many facilities on the campground are of a good level.

Friendliness

The atmosphere on the campground is very inviting. The reception is located in the outbuildings of the farm. There is also a restaurant and bar with an indoor play area. The more than 200 campsites are spacious and playfully laid out and the entire campground makes a well maintained impression. On the way to your spot, you'll notice the swimming pools and many modern play areas: a truly child-friendly campground. The facilities on the campground and the campsites are fantastic (water, power, wireless internet, cable TV).

Fun for all ages

Both in the high and low seasons there are families with (young) children on site. There are more seniors in the low season. The Pallegartse is a typical family campground with swimming paradise, playground equipment, sports field, indoor play area and activities. The swimming paradise in the open air is really worth a try. The enthusiastic activities team ensures that children and adults never get bored, regardless of the weather.

Facilities

You can order various snacks and menus in the restaurant/snack bar. It's lovely to sit on the terrace. There is also a shop for the necessities. The sanitation is good (accessible for the disabled), but very simple.

properties.name: Camping Le Garrigon
properties.description:
In the beautiful surroundings of the Drôme department lies the Le Garrigon family campsite. At this campsite, among the vineyards and cornfields, you can really get away from it all. It is located near Grillon (two kilometres) and Valréas (seven kilometres). On the way to the campsite, you are surrounded by fields and greenery.

Comfortable camping

After checking in, you can head for your camping spot. Are you looking for a spot in the sun or something nice and shady? At Le Garrigon, you can choose from both! Or choose to spend the night in one of the mobile homes (with air conditioning).

After a wonderful night, enjoy a fresh roll or croissant from the campsite. In the evening, you can choose from fries or a takeout. In the high season, you can also order something from the modest menu.

A dip on a hot summer's day

At Le Garrigon, you can enjoy an outdoor pool. It's lovely to take a dip in on a hot day. Or enjoy sliding into the water. Fun for young and old alike! For the little ones, there is a paddling pool. In addition, the campsite offers a number of playgrounds, a recreation room and even a bouncy castle.

In the high season, children can attend the children's club in the morning. There is also evening entertainment for adults (in the high season), such as concerts and bocce tournaments. Do you feel like being even more athletic? There is a tennis court two hundred metres from the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Le Petit Trianon de Saint Ustre
properties.description:
Camping Le Petit Trianon de Saint Ustre is a castle campsite in Poitou. In this region you can enjoy the Roman art of the centuries old churches and the avant-garde techniques in Futuroscope. Castles and country houses are in abundance and one of them is Le Petit Trianon. At the foot of the castle towers you'll experience a holiday characterized by comfort, peace and space.

Princely welcome

Once you arrive on the campsite and behind the entrance, you'll see a well maintained property with high trees and an open field in front of the seventeenth century castle. In the reception, housed in the castle, you'll receive a princely welcome from the owners. Their campsite is very spacious and makes a quiet and peaceful impression. The pitches are relatively large, so you have enough space for all of your gear.

Camping in the trees

Except for the usual mobile homes and a number of cottages, you can hire a unique tree house (for two people) on the campsite Le Petit Trianon de Saint Ustre. You climb up some stairs to an attractive wooden hut. A real "nest under the stars". You hire the hut with hotel service: bed service and breakfast!

For the little ones

There is a lovely swimming pool (with small slide) on the campsite. Children can play in the playground, jump in the bouncy castle or play on the mini golf course. In the high season there is an entertainment team for the little campers.

Regional dishes

The campsite does not have a restaurant, but for lunch or dinner you can go next door to the Auberge de la Ferme. They serve lovely local dishes.

properties.name: Camping La Naranja
properties.description:
This family-friendly campsite in Gandía (Valencia region) is located in a nature reserve on the outskirts of the city centre. It's just a few minutes walk from the sandy beach. But even if you don't like the sea or the beach, at Naranja Campsite you can enjoy swimming and sunbathing at the campsite pool. The modern city of Valencia can be reached within an hour.

Camping and renting

The campsite has a friendly atmosphere. The site staff are very helpful and will do everything they can to make sure you have a great holiday. Set up your tent, caravan or motorhome on one of the touring pitches or sleep in rented accommodation, such as a static caravan or a tent.

Swimming pool and sea

During the hot Spanish days you can cool off in the sea or in the sunny pool of this campsite. Along the side are sunbeds where you can read and sunbathe. It is only a fifteen-minute walk to the fine sandy beach of Gandia. Perfect for a swim or to laze on the beach, as well as for water sports and boat trips.

Enjoying a nice meal together

The campsite has a communal barbecue area where you can enjoy a nice dinner with friends, family or other camping guests. For grocery shopping you only have to drive ten minutes. Don't feel like taking care of your own food? Have dinner at one of the inviting restaurants that are within walking distance.

properties.name: Flower Camping La Pinède
properties.description:
La Pinède Campsite is located in the the Drôme valley in the heart of Provence. At this family campsite, you will camp on the green banks of the Drôme River: an ideal place for swimming, canoeing and building dams. Children will never be bored at La Pinède. The extensive activity programme provides plenty of entertainment, while the pools and river also serve as fun play areas.

Pitches on the river

La Pinède Campsite is located in a beautiful spot: in the shade of a large forest along the banks of the Drôme. The terrain has a playful character, with several sheltered camping fields situated along sandy paths. Because the touring pitches and the various bungalows and chalets are mixed together, it can look a bit disorganised. Furthermore, not all pitches are the same size. But you can still camp there beautifully. The spacious touring pitches by the river offer an especially lovely and quiet camping experience.

Charcoal-grilled pizza

A pizza from the charcoal oven sure hits the spot after a walk or an hour of playing sports with the activity team. The on-site restaurant has pizzas on the menu, as well as fries and fish dishes. The large terrace overlooks the pools.

Building dams in the Drôme

You are invited to take a dip at the campsite's two swimming pools. With their water slide and paddling pool, the pools are fun for both young and old alike. But the kids will just as soon jump into the river. The shallow water is ideal for smaller swimmers, who can enjoy cooling off and building dams here. Canoeing is also an option. Several routes have been mapped out from the campsite.

properties.name: Camping La Croix du Bois Sacker
properties.description:
Camping La Croix du Bois Sacker is located in a secluded spot in the rural surroundings of Lorraine, near the German border. Here you camp in a hilly landscape, at the edge of the woods and on the banks of a natural swimming and fishing lake. Those looking for peace and quiet will find this campsite a great destination.

Camping in nature

The campsite is situated on a beautiful spot in the middle of nature. Surrounded by forests, which cover the hills, you camp on the green banks of a natural lake. On the campsite there is room for about fifty touring pitches: the reasonably spacious pitches are situated on lawns. Most of the pitches on the campsite are permanent pitches, but these are separated from the touring area.

Swimming and fishing lake

Between the woods, at the back of the campsite, you'll find a small lake. The campsite is bordered by a small beach at the lake, where a part is set aside for swimmers for a cool dip in the natural water. Another part is for fishermen. Sit quietly on the water's edge with your fishing rod; for some campers there's no better holiday.

Breakfast at the campsite

In high season the baker is at the campsite every morning at half past nine. Buy a jar of jam in the small shop at the reception and your breakfast is almost ready. For dinner you have to leave the campsite. The easiest way is to drive to Bouzonville, where you'll find some supermarkets about twenty minutes from the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Les Places Dorées
properties.description:
Camping Les Places Dorées is located in beautiful surroundings in the Vendée. You camp close to the Atlantic Ocean (800 m) and the forest (300 m). This family campsite has plenty to offer young and old alike. For example, a water park with slides, a kids' club, a wellness centre and sports facilities.

Pitches and accommodation

At Camping Les Places Dorées, you can choose between pitches and rental accommodation. Whether you arrive with a tent, caravan, trailer tent or motor home, you’ll have a pitch of about 80 m2 in size. Do you want a sunny or shaded pitch? Both are possible. Prefer accommodation? Various mobile homes are available.

1, 2, 3 ... slide!

The fun water park is the highlight of the campsite. This consists of several pools with slides. Little campers have their own pool with fun water toys. There are sunbeds to relax on around the pools. In need of even more relaxation? Then have a sauna or head to the whirlpool or the Turkish bath. Sports enthusiasts are catered for too at Les Places Dorées. Facilities include a fitness room and multi-sports pitches.

Beach, water sports and forest

From the campsite, it’s a short walk to the wide sandy beach on the Atlantic Ocean. Enjoy a beautiful sunset here or take a dip in the sea. This region is a must for nature lovers. There are many beautiful walking and cycling routes that lead through the landscape with forests, dunes and water.

properties.name: Centro Turistico Pian di Boccio SRL
Kamemi Camping Village
properties.description:
Kamemi Camping Village is located on the south coast of Sicily, between the towns of Agrigento and Sciacca. The campsite is situated slightly inland, but within walking distance of the beach and the sea. A wonderful place to relax and explore the south-west of Sicily. A topper for sights is the famous temple valley of Agrigento with its ancient Greek temples (UNESCO World Heritage Site).

Right across from Africa

The campsite is about 700 m from the beach near the village of Seccagrande. Here you are in the deep south of Europe: Africa is right on the other side of the Mediterranean Sea.

When you drive to your pitch after visiting reception, you will notice that there is a large area with permanent sites and that the touring pitches are located at the front and the back of the camping. Here there are delineated campsites for small or large tents, caravans or campers. In addition, there are one room chalets for rent for 2 to 3 people (including breakfast) and bungalows for a maximum of 6 people.

Swimming pool with entertainment

It is worth mentioning that the swimming pool, which is prominently displayed on the Kamemi website, is also extremely attractive in reality. This is the backdrop for the entertainment in high season (including disco and live music). As mentioned, the beach is 700 m away and you can get there on foot. There is a separate section of the camping with loungers and parasols.

The campsite has a restaurant (only open in the evening) where you can enjoy Sicilian specialities (also take away). In addition there is a bar and a well-stocked supermarket.

properties.name: Azzurro Camping Village
properties.description:
Camping Azzurro is located directly on Lake Bracciano, not far from Rome. Here you can camp in a quiet and shady camping area by the water. The relaxed atmosphere at the campsite is enhanced by the beautiful location. Camp on a pitch under the trees or in one of the wooden cottages and enjoy the peace and quiet. The campsite is a good base for trips to Rome: within an hour you will be in the capital of Italy.

Shady campsite

On the campsite there is a quiet and relaxed atmosphere. First you will come across the wooden bungalows and chalets, which are separate from the touring pitches. You'll find them on the right side of the campsite and a little further towards the lake shore. The campsite is filled with tall trees, which shade the spacious pitches.

Lake Bracciano

A major plus of the campsite: its location. Many of the Italian, French and Dutch families you see on the campsite come to visit the Lake of Bracciano. From the campsite you are within a few steps on the small beach by the water. The beach is narrow, but on the large lawns behind it there is enough space to sunbathe. You can swim in the lake, but there are also regular campers with a surfboard or boat on the water.

Bar

Almost directly on the beach is the bar. There you order a drink, eat a pizza and in the evening you can throw your feet off the floor. A lovely place to stay.

properties.name: Camping Laguna Village
properties.description:
On the Italian east coast, just above Caorle, you will find Camping Laguna Village. Pack your swimming trunks and towel, because its location directly on the Adriatic Sea makes this large family campsite ideal for a beach holiday. There is plenty to do for the whole family: young and old can enjoy the cool water in the swimming pools.

Camping at the beach

The large campsite consists of two parts, located on both sides of the road. Both parts have their advantages. If you are on the side of the reception building, you camp closest to the beach. But if you camp on the other side of the road, the swimming pool and restaurant are never far away.

Water fun for the whole family

In the large swimming pool, with its rounded shape, a section is reserved for the smaller and novice swimmers. There is also a whirlpool. The second pool is rectangular and especially suitable for laps.

Extensive animation programme

As befits a family campsite, Laguna Village also has an extensive and varied entertainment programme. From May onwards, the professional entertainment team will provide all kinds of fun games for children of all ages. Children will also find the sports competitions, children's disco and theatre shows unforgettable.

Supermarket and bazaar

If you are on a pitch on the side of the reception, you have to cross the road to get to the facilities. In the restaurant you can eat a good pizza, and in the supermarket you can do your daily shopping. There's also a bazaar with beach equipment.

properties.name: Camping Baia del Sole
properties.description:
If you like the beach and the Italian way of life, Camping Baia del Sole is highly recommended. It is next to a lovely beach on the south coast of Sicily. On the other hand, you will be nice and cool at the campsite itself. Because here, you camp in the shade of tall pines and eucalyptus trees.

Shaded pitches on a paved circular path

On arrival, the friendly campsite owner or one of the equally enthusiastic staff will lead you to your camping pitch. The pitches are on a paved circular path that runs over the campsite. The touring pitches are also spacious enough and mostly in the shade. You have free Wi-Fi on all pitches at Camping Baia del Sole.

Ideal setting for beach lovers

Fans of breakfast in bed, are at the right place at this campsite. Pre-ordered bread rolls are brought right to your camping pitch in the mornings. There are of course also shops and restaurants in the vicinity where you can go for meals. Furthermore, Camping Baia del Sole is only a few 100 metres from the beautiful sandy beach at Marina di Ragusa.

Admire the stunning town of Scicli

The most varied day trips can be taken from the campsite. River Irminio flows a few kilometres east of Marina di Ragusa, for example. It is surrounded by a nature reserve where you can go for lovely walks. Sicily is known for its numerous historical villages with monumental buildings and narrow winding streets. If you like that kind of thing, drive to Scicli, only 20 minutes from the campsite.

properties.name: Agricampeggio Alessandra
properties.description:
On the north coast of Sicily, near the picturesque town of San Marco d'Alunzio, lies Agricampeggio Alessandra. This small-scale campsite was built in 2018 and everything is brand new and ultramodern. On the spacious campsite you will find beautiful touring pitches.

From Messina take the A20/E90 towards Palermo and turn off at Rocca di Capri Leone onto the SP156. Turn right onto the SS113 and immediately turn left onto Via Zappulla (SS158). Cross the railway and turn onto Via del Mare. Agricampeggio Alessandra is already signposted in the bend. The campsite is directly by the sea, just past a small industrial estate. In one of the white buildings you will receive a friendly welcome from the owner.

New campsite

Agricampeggio Alessandra has been renewed in 2018. There are 43 neat and spacious touring pitches on a pebble bottom. For tent campers there is a separate tent field. The pebble beach is next to the campsite. The sea water is clean and clear and you can swim here. In the distance you can even see the Aeolian Islands.

Excellent facilities

Each pitch has its own facilities: a drinking water point, electricity, waste water disposal and private sanitary facilities. Campers can make use of the communal barbecues, vegetable garden and bread service. The whole campsite has free wifi access. Every morning a shop on wheels comes to the campsite.

At Agricampeggio Alessandra you can book excursions to all sorts of sights in the area. Capo d'Orlando, the picturesque San Marco d'Alunzio and Palermo and Taormina are all worth a visit. You can also climb Mount Etna or spend a day in the Aeolian Islands.

properties.name: Camping Alpendorf
properties.description:
Enjoy a wonderful camping experience on a spacious grass pitch with views over the spectacular mountain landscape of the Gailtal. All this awaits you at Camping Alpendorf in Weißbriach (Carinthia). Nature lovers and those in search of peace and quiet will enjoy this campsite, where there is virtually complete silence in the evenings and at night. It is also a wonderful base for hiking and cycling trips through the surrounding mountains. The location is also ideal for winter sports enthusiasts, as it is right next to the ski lift to the Weißbriach ski area.

Camping with stunning views

When you arrive at the campsite, you will see a small kiosk and the reception area immediately on your left. New campers are welcomed by the friendly campsite owners there. The sanitary facilities and the small camping pitches on the site are all very well maintained. Touring and seasonal pitches are spread out across this green campsite, which has an open layout, giving you an even better view of the sweeping landscape.

Mountain sport activities around Weißbriach

Do you enjoy active mountain sports that really get your adrenaline pumping? This part of Carinthia offers plenty of challenging mountain bike trails and mountain climbing routes. Accessible cycling routes are also nearby. There are also mountain walking trails close by that lead past alpine meadows and authentic mountain huts, such as the Möselalm and the Napalalm.

In addition, there are several beautiful mountain lakes within easy reach, such as the Weißensee, which is just a 20-minute drive away. While in summer you can enjoy swimming, fishing and boating on this lake, in winter it transforms into Europe’s largest natural ice skating surface. All those with a passion for skating on natural ice can enjoy over 25 kilometres of designated skating tracks.

properties.name: Arena Indije Campsite
properties.description:
On the Croatian peninsula of Istria, on the Adriatic Sea, is Arena Indije Campsite. You'll find this quiet campsite on the west coast on a southern part of the island, near the old town of Pula. The campsite is located in an open pine forest, where the most beautiful touring pitches have a view of the Adriatic Sea.

Camping on the Adriatic Sea

Four hundred touring pitches are located on the campsite grounds. For tents the pitches are slightly smaller, caravans and motorhomes get larger pitches. The terrain is rather uneven (certainly towards the coast the terrain is decreasing in height) so the pitches are on different terraces. Not every terrace is equally flat and also the touring pitches are often uneven. So you may have to level your caravan or campervan. The large pine forest provides enough shade, although because of its open character there are also many spots to be found in the sun. The most beautiful (and most expensive) touring pitches offer a beautiful view over the Adriatic Sea.

Diving in the Adriatic Sea

Via stairs you reach the beach below. That consists mostly of rocks and stones, so it might be a bit less comfortable to lie here with a towel. However, swimming is excellent; the Adriatic Sea welcomes swimmers with open arms. Snorkeling and diving are also good. There is a diving school near the campsite.

Restaurant/shop

Next to a supermarket with a reasonable assortment you will find two restaurants on the campsite. In the pizzeria there are of course several pizzas and grill dishes on the menu. The other restaurant, which offers a beautiful sea view, introduces you to meat and seafood specialties from the Croatian cuisine.

properties.name: Arena Stupice Campsite
properties.description:
Arena Stupice Campsite is located in the southernmost part of the Croatian peninsula of Istria. At this large campsite you camp in a pine forest on sloping terrain directly on the Adriatic coast.

The A9 motorway takes you from the northern border all the way to Pula, a historic coastal town in the southernmost part of Istria. There you follow the signs to Premantura, where the campsite is located just outside the centre. A slightly descending road takes you to the wooded campsite with its modern reception building.

Camping with a view

The campsite is largely shaded by tall pine trees. The terrain is rugged and descends towards the coast, so many of the more than 900 touring pitches are not flat. The most beautiful spots can be found directly on the coastline, from where you have a view over the Adriatic Sea. These pitches are also often uneven. Special is the tiny peninsula into the Adriatic Sea. Here you can also camp on a flat, round lawn.

Excellent facilities

The campsite has two restaurants and a snack bar. You'll also find a supermarket with a fairly extensive assortment. Directly at the campsite you can windsurf, kayak and go stand-up paddle surfing. Hiking and cycling routes lead to the nature reserve cape Kamenjak. With its well-preserved Roman amphitheatre, the historic centre of Pula is a nice destination. Twenty minutes by car and you are in the centre.

properties.name: Arena Medulin Campsite
properties.description:
Arena Medulin Campsite is located in the south of the Croatian peninsula Istria, on a small peninsula in the Adriatic Sea. This holiday village offers shady pitches by the sea, restaurants and entertainment. Visit for example the luna park, the amusement park near the campsite which includes a Ferris wheel.

Pine forest by the sea

Arena Medulin Campsite is surrounded by the Adriatic Sea and lies in the shade of a pine forest. An excellent location, although the trees can be obstacles for large motorhomes or caravans. The most beautiful touring pitches are right by the sea. The large campsite is reasonably quiet during the day, but at night the sounds of the beach bar next door reach your pitch. Various sanitary blocks are scattered over the extensive campsite. Some more modern than others. The sanitary facilities are cleaned throughout the day.

Catering

There are as many as six restaurants and several snack bars. On the campsite you will also find a shop with a wide range of products. For further shopping you can also go to Medulin. Less than two kilometres away you'll find a large supermarket.

Ferris wheel ride and day on the beach

There is an extensive entertainment programme, from gymnastics to children's disco and from sports competitions to aquarobics. Have a go on the Ferris wheel, sailing with bumper boats through the pool or a ride in the 'Super Twister'? You can do it here in the luna park (only to be entered for a fee). A part of the west coast of the campsite consists of a sandy beach. The bay gets only gradually deeper; ideal for children. You can also rent boats at the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Vigna Maggiore
properties.description:
Just to the south of Olmeto, a densely forested area about 1.5 kilometres from the beach, lies the campsite Vigna Maggiore. This meticulously maintained campsite has plenty of pitches in both the sun and shade. You can choose your own pitch. There are also small houses for rent. Enjoy some time in the swimming pool or play a game of table tennis or petanque. This is a great place to get your exercise in outdoors. Many pitches on the campsite boast gorgeous views of the Gulf of Valinco.

Choose your own pitch or a lovely house

This campsite features 140 touring pitches between 70-180 m2. Most of the pitches are located on terraces. There are also 40 houses available for rent. These offer varying degrees of luxury. Each boasts its own (furnished) terrace, a barbecue and a parking space in the area. Those staying in an accommodation near the swimming pool will be treated to a gorgeous view of the sea. 

Swimming pool with a view 

The area around the large swimming pool (300 m2) has loungers and umbrellas. Everything here is done in tropical style. The smaller pool for children (50 m2) is heated and features a small waterfall. You can take a break from all that fun in the water at the bar or on the terrace near the swimming pool. There you can enjoy a drink and take in the scenic view of the Gulf of Valinco. In July and August, there are weekly evening concerts at the bar.

Delicious pizzas

The snack bar is open every afternoon. There is also a restaurant/pizzeria with a limited menu. The meals here are also available for takeaway. There is also a restaurant with a wide selection.

properties.name: Club del Sole Marina Romea Easy Camping Village
properties.description:
Sole Family Camping Village is a large family campsite on the east coast of Italy, near Ravenna. The campsite is located three hundred metres from the Mediterranean Sea, where you can play volleyball, basketball and beach tennis on the private beach. The holiday village is fully equipped, so there's no need to go offsite for groceries.

Welcome!

Sole Family Camping Village is located in Marina Romea. The coastline here is adorned by pine forests. The campsite is situated in one of these large forests. The entire campsite, which spans seven hectares, is shaded by the tall pine trees. Sole Family Camping Village is a true holiday village. With its restaurant, large supermarket and a shop with beach equipment and souvenirs, you'll have everything you need at your fingertips here.

Camping and renting

In addition to the touring pitches, you can rent a cottage, bungalow or chalet. The only drawback is that the holiday homes are quite close to each other, so they don't offer a ton of privacy. There are no fewer than six sanitary blocks well distributed across the extensive grounds. The sanitary facilities are not new, but they are clean and well-maintained. Moreover, the hot showers are free.

Private beach

The swimming pool may seem small given the number of campers, but it is actually a quite suitable size when you consider that the campsite lies almost directly on the Mediterranean Sea. A large part of the private beach is filled with sun loungers and umbrellas. There are also sports areas on the beach.

Ravenna

It is certainly worth taking a drive to Ravenna. This town, located about fifteen kilometres from the campsite, is renowned for its world-famous mosaics. The most beautiful mosaic works can be seen in the baptistery, the Mausoleum of Galla Placidia and the Basilica of Sant'Apollinare Nuovo.

properties.name: Club del Sole Rivaverde Easy Camping Village
properties.description:
Rivaverde Family Camping Village is located on the coast of the mosaic city of Ravenna. This campsite is perfectly located for a beach holiday: only a hundred metre walk from the Mediterranean Sea. Guests can also take a dip in the sleekly designed swimming pool.

Welcome!

The pine forest in which the campsite lies is slightly less dense than in other places along the Italian east coast. But nevertheless, most touring pitches are in the shade of trees. Many touring pitches have Italian dimensions, so it might be a bit cramped for some campers. The rental properties include quaint mobile homes, which look rather like Gypsy wagons, and modern lodge tents.

Plenty of sanitary facilities are available. Even when the campsite is full in the high season, you won't often have to queue at the showers and toilets. The sanitary facilities may be a little dated, but they look absolutely fine and are properly cleaned.

Feet in the sand

The Mediterranean Sea is just across the road from the campsite. A large number of sun loungers and parasols are available here for camping guests. There is also plenty of room on the wide beach.

Facilities

Camping guests can settle down comfortably at the bar or enjoy a pizza on the terrace. The camping shop is also well stocked. Or go shopping by bike (available for rent at the campsite) and cycle to Marina di Ravenna in less than 15 minutes. Here you will find several supermarkets. The centre of Ravenna, world famous for its mosaics, is only fifteen minutes by car from the campsite.

properties.name: Club del Sole Viareggio Family Collection
properties.description:
In Torre de Lago Puccini, a town in the north-west of Tuscany, lies Club del Sole Viareggio Family Collection. This spacious, wooded campsite is beloved by families because of its swimming pools, sports fields, activities and the many excursions available in the area (city trips and days at the beach). The nearby beach is just a one-kilometre walk away.

Spacious pitches and comfortable accommodation

The campsite has nearly 300 pitches. There is a division between the pitches and the rental accommodation. The rental bungalows and mobile homes are all roughly the same size. You are also welcome to bring your own camping equipment, of course. Simply choose a location on the large field. The most spacious pitches are at the back of the campsite.

Swimming and sports

The swimming pools on the campsite, which are centrally located near the restaurant and the shop, are great places for both young and old to cool off. They are surrounded by a grassy field. There is an admission fee for the pools, unless you have booked a bungalow. In the latter case, you will receive a pass for free entry to the pools. 

Those who enjoy staying active can play on one of the many sports fields (football, table tennis, petanque and tennis). Bicycles are also available for hire on the campsite: the gorgeous surroundings definitely deserve to be explored. Activities are organised in Italian, but are still worth the effort. Older children will love the outdoor dance party (only during high season).

Italy at its best: cappuccinos and pasta

The great restaurant on the campsite has plenty to offer those with refined palates. It serves authentic Italian dishes. In the morning, you can pick up fresh bread from the camping shop. A wonderful espresso or cappuccino is an excellent way to start the day!

properties.name: Camping Les Etangs du Moulin
properties.description:
The quiet campsite of Les Etangs du Moulin in the hilly Northern French region of Aisne is designed in the style of the Wild West with saloons, log cabins, covered wagons and tepee tents. Even the local population joins in for a meal in cowboy style. Anglers can fish to their heart's content in three fish ponds.

Covered wagons and tepee tents

The open terrain is situated among agricultural fields. The spacious and beautifully laid-out pitches with ample privacy are situated adjacent to the fish ponds or on the perimeter with a beautiful rural view. The tents look out on the covered wagons which can be rented. There are hardened areas for campers and caravans. In addition to covered wagons, log cabins and tepee tens can also be rented.

Western style

The heated indoor swimming pool with toddler pool and waterfall is also situated in a Western style wooden building with lovely wood beamed ceilings. Loungers can be found outside. The swimming pool closes at 18:00.

Fish ponds

There are several fish ponds where camping guest are allowed to fish. Equipment can be rented. There are two ponds with trout and two carp ponds. The campsite has a playground, a sports field and trampolines for children. Mountain bikes and go-carts can be rented and cycling routes are available.

Lively bar

Of course, you also want to step inside the saloon for a beer. The lively bar with fine Belgian beers as well as the cosy restaurant with limited menu is entirely in the style of the Wild West. Locals join in style and dress up as cowboys when eating at the campsite. This is however not compulsory for camping guests.

properties.name: Camping Le Fief Melin
properties.description:
Camping Le Fief Melin is situated on the charming island of Île d’Oléron off the west coast of France. You’ll be camping just 1.8 km from the Atlantic Ocean and right next to the centre of Le Château-d'Oléron. This lovely family-friendly campsite features a heated swimming pool, a bar and a shuttle bus to the beach. Fun (sporting) activities are also organised. The island is an ideal holiday destination for lovers of water sports, walking and cycling.

Camping next to the sea

At the campsite, you’ll mainly find French families looking to enjoy island life. There’s a relaxed atmosphere. The camping pitches are spacious and shady. Prefer a bit more luxury? Then rent a glamping accommodation. For example, a fully equipped tent, a mobile home or a wooden cabin on stilts. Pets are also welcome here.

Fun on the water, music and treasure hunts

Would you rather take a dip in the swimming pool or in the Atlantic Ocean? The choice is yours! The heated swimming pool has a water temperature of 27 degrees and a retractable roof. So whatever the weather, swimming is always possible. In the summer, there’s always something fun to do at the campsite every day. The entertainment team organises treasure hunts, a craft afternoon or games by the bouncy castle. In the evening, there’s often a band playing, or bingo, karaoke or a dance night on the programme. The outdoor terrace is a lovely spot to enjoy a pizza, burger or salad.

Discover island life

From the campsite, you can reach one of the nearby beaches in no time. During the summer months, a beach shuttle runs. Le Château-d'Oléron has a quiet beach.

properties.name: Le Moulin des Oies
properties.description:
Camping Le Moulin des Oies is a campsite close to the Morbihan, in the south of Brittany. This campsite is an ideal starting point to walk and admire the beautiful surroundings of this sea inlet. The island of Île de Saint-Cado, within walking distance of the campsite, is particularly eye-catching.

Various camping pitches

On this campsite you really have something to choose from when it comes to camping pitches. Do you prefer a spacious spot in the sun or do you prefer a place with a view of the water basin? The pitches at the back of the campsite are separated from each other by hedges and therefore offer more peace and privacy. In addition, this campsite has twenty mobile homes for rent.

Swimming in the seawater basin

This campsite has a unique basin filled with natural sea water. Swimming pleasure is guaranteed in this approximately 1.250 m2 (!) large basin. The trees on the side provide some shade here. Along the basin there is an opportunity to sunbathe on lawn and the sandy beach.

Breakfast and meals

Le Moulin des Oies has a cafeteria where pizzas, salads, sandwiches, snacks, drinks and desserts are available. You can eat on the modest pavement café that goes with it. Fresh bread can also be ordered here. For extensive shopping you can go to the large supermarket in Belz.

Sanitary facilities and playroom

The building in which the sanitary facilities are located on the ground floor is not only the place for a shower or toilet visit. On the first floor there is a cosy recreation room. Children have fun here in the reading corner, with the games and with the table football and billiard table.

properties.name: Recreatiepark de Kuilen
properties.description:
The vicinity of Someren is rich in nature. It is characterised by woodland, heath, natural pools and marshy wetlands caused by peat-digging, such as De Vloeten and De Vlerken. The Strabrechtse Heide and Beuven, also located there, are beautiful cycling and walking destinations. Camping de Kuilen is in a convenient location from where to explore these nature areas.

Good sanitary facilities

When you enter the site, you will see the basic, but clean sanitary facilities on the left. There is a riding hall for horse lovers.

Neat camping lawns and lovely chalets

The pitches are located along the edge of a few rectangular, spaciously laid out and neat camping lawns. They are separated from each other by high hedges and all have their own tap. The most beautiful, new pitches are located at the back of the campsite. The first, richly shaded field is particularly beautiful. You will find some lovely wooden chalets here. These can be rented and all have their own terrace.

Swimming and horse riding

To cool off in warm weather, a small swimming pool is erected at the front on one of the camping fields. Because of its height this swimming pool, is mainly suitable for older children. A great feature of this campsite: you may bring your own horse. Stabling is available for horses owned by guests. The covered riding hall may also be used by them. Of course, it is much nicer to explore the beautiful nature in the area. There are ample riding trails on passable sandy paths in the area.

properties.name: Nissum Fjord Camping
properties.description:
In the village of Fjand, situated between Nissum Fjord and the Husby Klitpantage, you will find the peaceful campsite Nissum Fjord Camping. Its location directly along Cycle route 1 make this campsite an ideal location for cycling enthusiasts. It is not far to the North Sea beaches from the campsite. As you drive up to the campsite, you will immediately notice the parade of flags along the main drive.

The campsite itself is made up of various fields with spacious pitches separated by rose bushes. These bushes not only offer plenty of privacy but also provide shelter from the westerly winds and produce the necessary shade. There are also various rental accommodations on the grounds. These range from simple to quite luxurious.

The campsite draws Dutch tourists but is a popular location for the Danes as well. The campsite shop supplies only the most basic items, you can do your grocery shopping at Thorsminde or Sønder Nissum. The two service buildings house not only the sanitary facilities but also a fully-equipped kitchen fitted with range tops, an oven, and a microwave oven.

Sun, sea and sand

In the summer, people come here mostly for a holiday in the sun, close to the beach. Nissum Fjord Camping is, therefore, a fine choice during a warm summer. The sandy beaches of the Danish west coast are broad and endlessly long, and the sea tends to reach swimming temperatures quite quickly. If the water is too cold, the campsite also has a swimming pool (with a paddling pool).

properties.name: Hvalpsund Familie Camping
properties.description:
Hvalpsund Familie Camping is on the outskirts of a stunning fjord in the North Jutland Region. This region has stunning countryside surrounded by lots of water. The setting right by a child-friendly beach is ideal for families. Hvalpsund's harbour is only a 800-metre walk. You can also jump straight into the swimming pool at the campsite itself. The central square has a lovely café where you can get groceries, drinks and fresh sandwiches. Walkers and cyclists will feel like a fish in water here thanks to the many marked out routes.

Camping in North Denmark

When you arrive at the campsite, you are instantly in a holiday mood due to the peace and the space. If you look at the campsite's map, you will see that many camping pitches are on the fjord side, divided into straight streets. You look out over the water from the edge of the campsite and as evening falls, the sunsets here are unforgettably beautiful.

Maintained campsite

On the open site, you can choose from a wide range of various camping pitches on grass. The well-maintained campsite has about 230 pitches that look neat and are surrounded by some trees and bushes. The pitches are also easily accessible if you come with a motorhome. If you camp with a tent, you can choose from pitches with or without electricity. Anyone looking for lovely accommodation, can spend the night in one of the campsite's beautiful cottages. The two toilet blocks are seen as an important plus point by many campers.

properties.name: Camping Le Coin Charmant
properties.description:
Camp along the Ardèche River at Le Coin Charmant Campsite in the south of the Ardeche. The name says it all: here you can fully enjoy the charm of France. This nature campsite offers an ideal location from which to visit lovely French villages and towns and the surrounding area is a dream for sporty campers.

Camping pitch or accommodation

Le Coin Charmant Campsite is a small-scale campsite in the village of Chauzon. The spacious shaded camping pitches are demarcated by shrubs and offer plenty of privacy. If you do not have your own camping equipment, you are more than welcome to stay in one of the rental accommodations. The campsite features modern sanitary facilities as well as special sanitary facilities for the little campers.

Plenty to do

Although the campsite is not large, it offers everything you need for a pleasurable stay. In the high season, the campsite is especially popular among families with young children from France, Germany and the Netherlands. Both children and adults have fun with the entertainment team that organises fun activities. The playground and the ping pong table are also nice places to meet new friends on holiday.

Endless water recreation

The on-site swimming pool complex has a separate shallow end for the little ones to splash around in safely, and there are plenty of sun loungers for soaking up the sun. And you don't have to go far to enjoy even more water recreation activities. The campsite is located directly along the Ardèche River. There is a sand and pebble beach where children can play.

properties.name: Camping Waldfrieden
properties.description:
In a beautiful green valley in the state of Rheinland-Pfalz (Rhineland-Palatinate), the Camping Waldfrieden campsite is surrounded by meadows, mountains and forests. On the sloping camping grounds, situated against the edge of the forest with tall trees, you will find a playground and a nice bar with an attractive indoor area and a covered terrace. With the green surroundings, you might almost forget that you are camping close to the touristy Saarburg. In just a few minutes by bike, you can be in the cosy, historic city centre with nice restaurants and beautiful sights.

Green all around you

On the gently sloping grounds, there are different types of touring pitches. The hedges and bushes that delineate the pitches provide plenty of privacy. In the front, near the playground, are some comfortable pitches with grass concrete blocks, ideal for campers. If you walk a little further back, you'll come across the places where the regulars make their camps. Those who would like to come and spend the night without their own camper or caravan can rent the mountain hut. The heated sanitary facilities are not very modern, but they are clean. As the sun sets, listen out for the owls that regularly make themselves heard on the grounds.

Lantern parade and a campfire

Especially in the summer months, the campsite is a real delight for children and their parents. Have a dance at the children's disco, make some crafts or join in with the lantern parade. It's all possible. There is a playground, and if the weather is not so great, you can also play inside with your new friends. Snacks and drinks are served on the patio, but you can also use the grill and fire pit. Fancy a walk? Then inquire at the reception about guided hikes. Those who want to swim can walk to the municipal swimming pool, which is about two kilometres away.

properties.name: Camping Moulin de Campech
properties.description:
Camping Moulin de Campech is located in the lovely, hilly landscape of Lot-et-Garonne, not far from the cities of Casteljaloux, Tonneins and (a bit further away) Agen. You have broad views and can visit the lovely old villages. The campsite is spaciously laid out and kids will feel safe on this calm and peaceful campsite. With only 46 pitches, Moulin de Campech is a real campsite without chalets, mobile homes or other accommodation.

Water mill

After coming up the drive, you'll see the lake in front of the campsite and the old water mill. This houses the restaurant, bar and reception. The camping pitches are spacious and spread out over the campsite. The pitches are partially demarcated with shrubbery. Guests can use the swimming pool.

Animal-friendly fishing

You can fish for trout in the lake by the water mill. There are strict rules regarding fishing gear (namely the hooks). The intention is that the fish are returned to the water living and undamaged after being caught. If you want to keep the fish to eat, you have to pay a sum at the reception.

Bar/restaurant

Camping Moulin de Campech has a restaurant with good choice menu. You preorder take away fries/chips. There is also a charming bar. You can also buy bread and other groceries. The range is limited, however. The restaurant has a long menu, with plenty of fish and poultry and delicious desserts.

properties.name: Camping L'Enclave
properties.description:
Camping in France with a Spanish touch. This is possible at the Camping L'Enclave campsite, located in a large valley in the eastern Pyrenees, close to the Spanish border. You will be camping here in the middle of the high mountains of the Pyrenees, a fantastic area for brisk walks.

Camping among the Pyrenees

The elongated campsite stretches along the L'Angust river, which flows right through the campsite. Fortunately, it does not form an obstacle to reaching the beautiful spacious touring pitches. There are 175 touring pitches in total, all with a grassy base and shaded by trees. The thirty-plus rental accommodations are scattered among the camping sites. If you like to camp in peace and quiet, try to get a spot at the rear of the property.

For families and nature lovers

Although the campsite is not a typical family campsite, you will encounter many families with children. During the summer months, all sorts of things are organised for children: from sports competitions and theatre performances to overnight stays in the open air. And with the Pyrenees just around the corner, nature and hiking enthusiasts also know where to find the campsite.

Swimming pool and water playground

Across the cul-de-sac that leads to the campsite entrance, you'll find the pool. This outdoor pool is large and rectangular: ideal for a refreshing dip. During the summer months, water games are occasionally organised in the pool. The new water playground is fun for the little ones.

Pizza night

Next to the pool is the restaurant, so after a dip in the pool, you can dry off on the terrace. In the high season, certain dishes are highlighted on themed evenings, for example, pizzas or mussels.

properties.name: Camping du Vivier aux Carpes
properties.description:
Attention fishermen: this is the ideal campsite for a fishing holiday in France. Camping du Vivier aux Carpes is situated next to several fishing ponds and the river Somme. You will be camping in the peaceful countryside of Picardy. Cast your fishing line and enjoy the peace and quiet. And of those many biting carp! If you want to get away from it all, drive to Saint-Quentin. Between the mansions and squares are nice pavement cafés. And don't forget to visit the large basilica.

Camping with privacy
