The campsite consists of sheltered holiday spots, closed off from the outside world by green bushes and trees. The perfect place to completely unwind. Paved paths lead to your pitch. It is spacious and delimited by hedges. The best pitches are located by the pond.

Active holidays

In between fishing you might like to do something else. Swimming, for example. That is possible at this campsite. The indoor pool at the front of the campsite may not be very big, but it's great for a quick dip. Take a bike and explore the rolling countryside of Picardy. The weekly market in Saint-Quentin is a great destination.

Fresh croissants and pizza

Fresh bread, fruit and vegetables and a tasty pizza... That is all you need on a holiday. You can get it all at the campsite. The baker comes by every day with croissants and baguettes. And in the campsite's snack bar you can get fries or a pizza. Take a seat on the lovely covered terrace and enjoy your meal.

properties.name: Camping Le Gallo Romain
properties.description:
Camping Le Gallo-Romain is a very well maintained campsite for families and active campers in a beautiful mountain landscape. The Gallo-Romain style to which the campsite owes its name makes this campsite different from others. To camp here you do sometimes have to manage some elevation differences, but you'll get a beautiful view for your efforts.

Lions and flowers

At the entrance, two large stone lions welcome you. The reception building really emanates a gallo-roman style and the entire campsite looks very well cared for. You'll really notice the beautiful flowers. These flowered fields give the campground a little something extra. In the spring there are more than 20 types of orchids to admire.

The sites are beautiful, spacious and open. Upon arrival you can choose a higher or lower site. The lower sites have more shade thanks to the trees. Up top there are many sites that have a beautiful view of the valley and the mountains. In addition to campsites, there are also mobile homes to hire on the campsite.

Water, walking and wellness

The nice swimming pool is in a central location with a number of lounges and parasols around it. You have a perfect view of the pool from the higher terrace. The lower campsites are located on the river.

Dining with a view

There is a little camp shop for the necessities and you can pick up bread at the reception in the morning. To eat, you can sit on the spacious terrace where you can enjoy several dishes. There is a nice menu with well-priced meals.

properties.name: Flower Camping Le Clos Auroy
properties.description:
Centrally located in the Auvergne, 250 m from the centre of the charming village of Orcet, lies the well maintained campsite Le Clos Auroy. On the campsite (2.5 ha) you will find attractive flower beds which give the campsite a charming appearance. You have a direct view of the swimming pool and slides, bar and terrace. Especially families with young children, often in transit, visit this campsite.

View of the mountains

You will find the spacious camping pitches (100 m2) on four flat elevations with a great deal of privacy being provided by the tall conifers on both sides. You can also opt for a sociable small field that is shared with other campers. On the terraced campsite with hard surface, most camping pitches are in the shade. You can hire an ecolodge tent without sanitary facilities. There are also a few rental mobile homes on the campsite.

Swimming paradise

The swimming paradise has a playful design with artificial rocks. You can swim in the heated pool (72 m2), glide down the water slides or enjoy the jacuzzi pool with rapid. The heated toddler pool with fountain is quite large.

You can order pizza, French fries and ice cream from the snack bar. There is also a small camping shop for basic groceries. The village has a supermarket. Each morning (in high season only) a baker with bread cart can be found at the gate.

Nature trail

The campsite is directly situated along a river with adjacent footpath. This allows you to explore the region starting from the grounds. On the campsite is a large playground, a trampoline, a sports field, jeu-de-boule pitch and a table tennis table.

properties.name: Camping Seasonova Haliotis
properties.description:
Camping Seasonova Haliotis is a medium-sized campsite just north of the village of Pontorson. You can camp here less than ten kilometres from Mont Saint-Michel. On the way, you pass by the village of Beauvoir, which has a zoo housing a variety of crocodiles and turtles. The campsite is also full of animals as it has its own children's farm. The swimming pool, sauna, playground, bar and entertainment team also provide plenty of amusement.

Park-like campsite

With 150 touring pitches and more than 40 accommodation units, this is a medium-sized campsite. The pitches for your own camping equipment are between 90 and 150m2. Those who prefer private sanitary facilities should opt for the most luxurious spaces. This park-like campsite is full of trees, shrubs, hedges and flowers. There is even a Japanese garden. The accommodation units are also very comfortable. Go for one of the mobile homes or the cheerful Coco Sweet tents. Most accommodation units have a sunny or shaded terrace.

Entertainment for the whole family

In the high season there is an entertainment programme for young and old at least twice a week. Children can have fun in the playground (with trampoline and bouncy castle). For the youngest campers, there is a heated paddling pool to splash around in. The campsite's farm animals - including goats, ponies and rabbits - are also popular with children.

The recreation room has a few slot machines, a pool table and a television. Those who prefer outdoor sports can kick a ball around on the multisport field. And if you would rather throw or hit a ball the table tennis table and the jeu-de-boules court are just the thing for you.

properties.name: Camping Le Rouge Gorge
properties.description:
Campsite Le Rouge Gorge is located in the Saint-Laurent-sur-Sèvre, practically on the border of two departments in the Vendée region. For those in the know: the campsite is located near the large theme park Puy du Fou. No wonder you find so many families with children at this campsite. They also enjoy themselves in the fun playground with trampoline, the swimming pool and the paddling pool.

At Le Rouge Gorge, you can choose a pitch on the well-maintained camping grounds. You have a choice of pitches among trees and flowering shrubs. The rented tents, mobile homes and chalets are spread out over the campsite.

Campsite shop and snack bar

The region surrounding the campsite is fantastic. Characteristic of Pays de la Loire is the undulating landscape where you can go for endless walks and bicycle trips. If you're fit enough, you can walk to Saint-Laurent-sur-Sèvre to do some shopping. This is convenient because outside of the peak season, you will have to make do with the town facilities. The campsite shop and snack bar have limited opening hours during this period.

Put those hiking boots on!

Are you wearing your hiking boots? Good. You can explore the surroundings as soon as you leave the campsite via various paths. You can, for example, walk right into the forests of Barbinière. After a day of hiking, unwind by swimming a couple of lengths in the heated indoor swimming pool. There is also a whirlpool. You will find a number of poolside loungers here as well. With or without a sunshade, whichever you prefer.

Campsite Le Rouge Gorge also has a boules court, of course, as well as a volleyball court and a soccer pitch. You will often find the youngest campers on the bouncy castle.

properties.name: Camping Paradis Les Amarines
properties.description:
Between the lavender fields and vines of the Gard department, you will find Camping Paradis Les Amarines. This campsite is situated in a green spot right next to a river. Lie down in the grass while the children paddle in the calm water. Or splash around in the pool together! Enjoy the peace and quiet on your spacious pitch, in the shade of a tree. If you feel like an ice cream, then walk to Goudargues. Because of the canal this village is called the 'Venice of the Gard'.

Spacious and shady camping pitch

The open campsite with its wide avenues gives a feeling of freedom. And so do the spacious pitches. On this campsite, you will camp on beautiful lawns and between large hedges. There is a large tree on every pitch to provide the necessary shade.

Swimming pool and river

The swimming pool is the place for your children to meet their holiday friends. While your children swim and splash about, you can relax in the sun. Another place on the campsite where it is always fun: the river. At the back of the campsite you can walk straight into the Cèze! Sit down in the grass, have a chat or doze off a bit.

Fun and games

The campsite's bar is the place to be for a good time, especially in the evenings. There you can dance with the whole family. Or take part in a bingo, while the children enjoy a snack. In the high season there are also regular activities for the little ones. Let them do crafts with their peers. Or play with them in one of the playgrounds.

properties.name: Camping Les Trois Sablières
properties.description:
The Baie de Somme is without a doubt one of France’s most beautiful inlets. If you stay at Camping Les Trois Sablières (near Le Crotoy), you can walk directly to the huge stretches of sand that are part of the Baie de Somme. This makes it an ideal holiday address for nature lovers – in part because the Parc du Marquenterre nature reserve is located next to the campsite. Highlights of the quiet campsite itself include the heated outdoor swimming pool and the brasserie.

Touring pitches, accommodations and tents for campsite visitors who hike and cycle

This green campsite has accommodations that suit all camping enthusiasts. At Camping Les Trois Sablières you can book a stay in a modern mobile home or a safari tent. There are special accommodations for campsite visitors who hike and cycle. This means comfortable tents with room for bicycle storage for cyclists and bivouac tents for hikers. At Camping Les Trois Sablières you can also stay overnight at a standard pitch. The tourist pitches differ hugely with respect to shape, surface area and amount of shade.

What does the campsite offer in the way of fun?

There is a lovely, heated outdoor swimming pool with a paddling pool at the front of the site. After a couple of hours of swimming, grab a bite to eat at the Brasserie L’Ilette next door. This campsite restaurant is famous for its tasty dishes. Specialities of the house are the grilled dishes, tartare, salads and mussels. During the high season, a food truck also visits regularly. In addition, during the summer holiday, there is entertainment once a week at Camping Les Trois Sablières.

properties.name: Camping Pinède en Provence
properties.description:
On the edge of the Uchaux massif, the campsite Pinède en Provence is located in a wooded area. At the campsite you can show your sporty side by playing a game of volleyball, football or table tennis. In the high season, fun activities are organised. Do you like walking or cycling? The green surroundings have attractive routes for a long or short trip. About two kilometres away is the town of Mondragon with various shops.

Peace and quiet under the pine trees

You can choose from a variety of pitches on the sloping campsite. Choose from a spot with shade or with more sun. Most of the pitches are reasonably deep, but not always wide. On the field where tents can be pitched, you will find a few picnic tables. There are some well-kept mobile homes and wooden chalets with their own veranda. You can stay there comfortably without your own tent, caravan or motor home.

Water fun

Want to go swimming every day during your holiday? The swimming pool is the centre of the campsite! Behind the pool is the circular water slide which does not end up in the pool itself, but in a separate part. The pool is fenced for safety. Toddlers can also splash around undisturbed in their own paddling pool.

Covered patio

The campsite's charming bar has a covered patio and nice lounge sofas. Ideal for eating an ice-cream after swimming or for recovering after a pleasant day out. During the summer months, fresh rolls are available at the shop in the morning. In the evening, the menu offers local specialities as well as tasty snacks.

properties.name: Camping Seasonova Ile de Ré
properties.description:
The charming campsite Seasonova Ile de Ré is located in the north of the French island Ile de Ré. The campsite offers all conveniences for a lovely camping holiday: well-tended sanitation, a shop and Wi-Fi. You are camping here at the edge of the village of Les Portes-en-Ré, only a few hundred metres from the beach, the sea and the nature reserve Lilleau des Niges.

Camping and renting

There are 130 campsites and ten rental accommodations on a property of 2.5 hectares. Renters have the choice of Ecolodges and Bungalodges, a combination of a bungalow and a lodge tent. Campers have lovely sites, demarcated with trees and bushes. The sanitary facilities are well-tended and only accessible with a code.

Entertainment and Catering

For kids up to 12 years, there is a modest entertainment programme in the high season. The campsite also organises excursions to the nearby nature reserve Lilleau des Niges. The owners also provide yoga, meditation and massages. You can take relaxing classes on the beach.

You can get your bread in the small shop on the campsite. For the rest of your shopping, you can go to the Carrefour, within walking distance. In July and August there is a lovely market in Les Portes-en-Ré nearly every morning. Don't feel like cooking? In the high season, a food truck comes to the campsite regularly.

Fun in the water

With the sea so nearby, it's not strange that water sports are really popular and a top experience. Two hundred metres from the campsite there is a surfing school. Not a fan of the sea? There are plans to build a swimming pool in 2020.

properties.name: Camping Alto de Viñuelas
properties.description:
At Alto de Viñuelas campsite you will be camping with a view of the snow-capped Sierra Nevada mountains. This small-scale campsite is situated on a mountainside in the mountainous interior of Andalusia: a vast hiking area, rugged and wild, for those who like to go on. You will find peace and quiet at the campsite itself. Granada, with the Alhambra as its big attraction, is half an hour away. The bus will take you there from the entrance to the campsite.

View of Sierra Nevada

With around forty touring pitches and five bungalows, Alto de Viñuelas campsite is a small-scale campsite. The stone walls that shape the terraces, the Mediterranean vegetation: everything about this campsite breathes Spain. In the distance are the snow-capped peaks of the Sierra Nevada. From your pitch on one of the terraces you have a view of these peaks and the mountainous surroundings of Granada.

Swimming pool

In a sheltered spot on the campsite, between bushes and a stone wall, lies the swimming pool. The pool is not very big, but it is deep. Fortunately, you don't have to share the pool with many people, as the campsite is small and many campers are out and about all day. Next to the pool, the smallest water lovers can splash around in a paddling pool.

Granada and the Alhambra

The Alhambra is the medieval Moorish palace and fortress just outside the centre of Granada. With its richly decorated courtyards, it is a prime example of Moorish influence in southern Europe. The bus, which stops near the campsite, will take you to Granada in under half an hour. If you want to see the inside of the Alhambra, be sure to book well in advance. Only a limited number of visitors are allowed in each day.

properties.name: Camping Pommiers des Trois Pays
properties.description:
Camping Pommiers des Trois Pays is a charming, small-scale family campsite. Staying here places you not far from the beaches of Calais (25 km) in the north of France. The campsite is in the French countryside, but the village centre of Licques is only a short walk away (1 km). Have fun at the campsite in the beautiful swimming pool, at the playground with bouncy castles and at the jeu de boules court. The beautiful hilly area is ideal for exploring on foot or by bicycle.

Camping amid the fruit trees

The site of Camping Pommiers des Trois Pays is well-kept with much vegetation. There are 24 pitches for tents, caravans or motorhomes. If you don’t have your own camping equipment, rent an accommodation, such as a chalet, mobile home or lodge tent.

Swimming and delicious food

The campsite has lots of things for the entire family to do. There is no entertainment team but there is a great covered swimming pool for the necessary water fun. For the younger campsite visitors there is a playground with bouncy castles. For a bite to eat, visit the brasserie next to the swimming pool.

Visit Calais and go to the beach

From the campsite you can easily reach the vast beaches along the Atlantic Ocean. About 30 kilometres away you will find the impressive white chalk rocks of Cap Blanc-Nez and Cap Griz-Nez, the coast nearest England. Saint-Omer (25 km) is also worth a visit. This town has old ruins, a beautiful cathedral and an attractive historic city centre.

properties.name: Camping Domaine de la Cigalière
properties.description:
The valley region in the Maures mountains is in fact one big Provençal savannah. Against this backdrop of hills, olive trees and vineyards, you will find campsite Domaine de la Cigalière. It is a friendly campsite with a focus on sustainability. The charming villages of Les Arcs (15 km), Lorgues (20 km) and Tourtour (30 km) are all situated within driving distance.

A park-like terrain

The pitches on the campsite are spacious and are mostly demarcated with low natural stone walls The 25 touring pitches are located on various terraces. The pitches are generally very spacious (100-140 m2) and are situated in the shade of oak, pine and olive trees. There are also 36 permanent pitches and 10 rental accommodations.

Take a dip

On this campsite, you will find a modest yet well-maintained swimming pool. The water is heated with solar panels. A few loungers are situated around the pool. There is also a jacuzzi. In high season, fun activities such as water polo and aerobics are organised at the swimming pool.

Fun away from the pool

With several playgrounds, a volleyball field, a table tennis table and two pétanque courts, there are plenty of sporting opportunities. And then there is also 'La Grange'. This indoor space features a billiards table and a table football table. You can also watch television and play board games here. Ideal for a rainy day! On Saturday evenings (high season), you can enjoy themed meals, karaoke and disco nights.

Eating and drinking

The restaurant is very basic but has a fine atmosphere. There is also a modest selection of groceries available. For the rest of your shopping needs, your best option would be to go to the nearby town of Le Cannet-des-Maures.

properties.name: Camping Huttopia Sarlat
properties.description:
Camping Huttopia Sarlat is situated in the Dordogne, near the river by the same name and the medieval town of Sarlat (and this is a real landmark). On the campsite you can camp in luxury and unique rental accommodation, amidst green and wooded surroundings. There is a lot of difference in elevation on this campsite. The campsite is situated on the D47, which follows on the D56 north of the campsite. When you drive past the campsite gate, you will get to the charming town of Sarlat. It is only a 10-minute walk from the campsite. With its medieval houses, markets and restaurants, Sarlat is an attractive town.

Hammocks

When you drive onto the wooded campsite grounds, you will find the reception on the left hand side. With the terrace and hammocks at the front of the building, you will immediately get into a relaxed holiday mood. When you walk past the hammocks, you can check in and are ready to drive to your pitch. You may have to climb a bit, because the terrain slopes (beware: it may even be steep in places). The higher you get, the more beautiful the view.

Dordogne

You will find the swimmers in the middle of the campsite. This is where you will find the swimming pools: a heated outdoor swimming pool, an indoor pool and a children's pool. A lovely place for paddling. If you want something more, you may want to take your car or bicycle. Less than a 10 km drive to the south will get you to the Dordogne River. Swimming, canoeing and kayaking: it can all be done amidst high rock formations and along a wooded bank.

properties.name: Camping Domaine de la Faurie
properties.description:
Camping du Domaine de la Faurie is located on a hill near the village of Séniergues. This campsite is situated in the middle of a natural park where you can enjoy walking and cycling. Furthermore, you're close to some fantastic places, including the famous Rocamadour. On the campsite you'll enjoy two fine swimming pools and a good restaurant.

Spacious pitches

The pitches offer a lot of variety in terms of shade and privacy. What the pitches have in common is that they are neatly laid out and that nature is omnipresent. Furthermore, they are all spacious. Tip: the lodge tents on the edge of the campsite have a great panoramic view.

Water fun

The water park of the campsite consists of two swimming pools. One of the two pools is suitable for swimming laps. In the other pool there is space to relax, for example at the jacuzzi bench, the waterfall or the fountains. The pool area is beautifully laid out on the hillside. While swimming and sunbathing you can also enjoy the surrounding landscape.

Activities for the whole family

Under the leadership of Clotilde and Christophe, the Domaine de la Faurie team succeeds in creating a great holiday atmosphere. For example, on Sunday afternoons, a welcome drink is offered to all campsite guests at the bar. Under expert guidance, campers of all ages can go canoeing in the valley, climbing, caving and taking interesting nature walks. Furthermore, in high season weekly concert evenings are organised. While enjoying a barbecue, you can dance to live music. Fun for the whole family!

properties.name: Camping Seasonova Le Point du Jour
properties.description:
The friendly family campsite Seasonova Le Point du Jour is located directly by the sea, near the town of Merville-Franceville-Plage. This is an excellent base for a beach holiday or an active excursion to the magnificent hilly, green hinterland and the attractive small towns with nineteenth-century villas.

Camping by the sea

The pitches of Camping Le Point du Jour are located along paved roads and are demarcated with hedges. There are few or no trees, so the pitches do not have a lot of shade. The nicest pitches are at the seaside. The mobile homes are spread over the campsite, often on the boundary of the grounds.

Sauna and snorkelling

The swimming pool with jacuzzi (150 m2) is covered and is located next to the heated paddling pool (20 m2). You can use the sauna and whirlpool for a fee. The sandy beach can be reached via a dune path from the campsite. In the sea you can practice (and learn) windsurfing, waterskiing, kayaking and sailing. Snorkelling here is also great fun. The area is excellent for a level cycling or walking trip. 

Disco and dance

For children there is a playground and a few times a week also a mini club (English and French).  Everyone will enjoy the disco evenings, irrespective of the language you speak. Hit the dance floor!

Eating establishments

You can order fresh bread from the bar. Near the campsite there are several snack bars for pizzas, French fries, etc. Within walking distance you will find several eating establishments and in the village you can do your shopping.

properties.name: Camping Bedurá Park
properties.description:
Camping Bedurá Park is located in the heart of the Spanish Pyrenees, in the beautiful Val d'Aran – an ideal place for anyone seeking peace and quiet and nature. The campsite is located directly on the River Garonne, on a wooded mountainside. From here, impressive hiking trails lead through unspoilt mountain landscapes. The campsite itself has a heated outdoor swimming pool, a cosy restaurant and, in high season, a varied programme of activities for the whole family.

Peace and quiet in a natural setting

The wooded campsite is primarily geared towards tourists. A narrow path leads past several terraces where the pitches are located. They are spaced far apart and offer plenty of peace, space and privacy. Some pitches offer magnificent views of the surrounding mountains through the trees. There are also a few simple, cosy trekking huts on the terraces. Those who want more comfort can stay in one of the modern bungalows with private bathrooms.

Outdoor swimming pool and children's entertainment

After a long hike in the mountains, there is hardly anything better than jumping into the water. Bedurá Park has a heated outdoor pool with a shallow area for younger guests. After swimming, you can relax on one of the sun loungers around the pool. In high season, the campsite crew organises creative and nature-based activities for children, with a focus on discovery, crafts and artistic design. In the evenings, small shows by the mini club children provide entertainment. There are also regular magic shows, live music, karaoke evenings and communal barbecues.

properties.name: Camping Seasonova Saint Michel
properties.description:
Camping Seasonova Saint Michel is located near the town of Courtils (Normandy). You will camp here surrounded by greenery, flowers and trees. Whether you are just passing through or want to stay for a longer period on this campsite, you will certainly feel at home here on the French coast. There is a bar, a shop and a swimming pool on Saint Michel campsite. There is entertainment for all ages. Children can also have fun in the playground and the animal pasture.

Fine pitches in green surroundings

The touring pitches all have a nice, neat lawn that is well maintained. Shrubs are planted between the different pitches to demarcate them. You can pitch your tent in the sun or in the shade of the trees. Camping Saint Michel has no fewer than fifty mobile homes at its disposal. Book one and enjoy the flowers, plants and trees around you from your own terrace.

A campsite for everyone

Enjoy a well-earned glass of wine at the bar. Or go for a cocktail by the pool for that real holiday feeling. Your children will also have a great time here. In addition to a swimming pool, the campsite has a playground, a bouncy castle and a football pitch.

Petting zoo

Or you can let them wander around the children's farm. They can cuddle with the guinea pigs and play with the goats. There are even kangaroos running around! If that's not enough, the campsite also has various entertainment programmes in high season.

properties.name: Camping Le Chatelet
properties.description:
The well organised terraced campsite Le Chatelet is beautifully situated in the hilly landscape of the Breton peninsula in the Côtes d’Armor. You will find it in St.-Cast-le-Guildo, well-known for its seven beautiful beaches. The campsite offers a splendid view of the bay with mussel beds and the sea beyond.

Rental teepee

The campsite is situated in a large park of some 9 ha where nature takes high priority. The pitches here provide ample privacy. They vary in size. The most beautiful pitches on the rocks overlook the sea and the attractive Fort La Latte. The beautifully landscaped fish pond is surrounded by furnished rental tents. You have a choice of a pendola tent, a smaller or larger safari tent, a cocoon tent and a teepee.

Heated swimming pool

The heated swimming pool (200 m2) has a retractable roof and a wooden deck for sunbathing.

There are two playgrounds for children. There is an entertainment programme and disco evenings in peak season. On the campsite you will find a sports fields and a pétanque pitch. You can also play table tennis. Horseback riding and pony riding or golf are available for a fee. Tasty takeaway meals and pizzas can be enjoyed at a cosy bar with wooden terrace.

A steep flight of stairs takes you to the sandy beach, some 40 m below. The coast can only be reached on foot here.

properties.name: Camping Toulouse Le Rupé
properties.description:
Camping Toulouse Le Rupé is an urban campsite on the outskirts of Toulouse in the Midi-Pyrenees. From the campsite you can cycle to the centre of this historic city, where you can visit such sights as the cathedral, the pilgrims' church and the capitol. You will camp on demarcated camping pitches in a secure area, which also offers accommodation in various mobile homes or hikers' huts. The campsite, which is mainly used as a base for visiting cities and as a transit campsite, has very modern and clean sanitary facilities.

Behind the gate

Behind the campsite gate there are more than 80 touring pitches on demarcated grassy areas. Most of these pitches are spacious, and there are also separate fields for campers arriving by bike with tents. You can also choose from about fifty rental accommodations such as comfortable hikers' cabins and fully equipped mobile homes.

Transit and urban campsite

Many of the campers do not stay longer than a few days at the campsite. So Le Rupé is a transit campsite as well as an urban campsite. In the well-kept toilet block you can use spotlessly clean and modern sanitary facilities.

Toulouse

Toulouse, with its 450,000 inhabitants, is the fourth largest city in France. From the campsite you can cycle to the centre of this university town within half an hour. The hip bars and friendly pavement cafes show that this is a true student city. The 13th century university is the oldest in France second only to that of Paris. There are many beautiful buildings to see in the historic town centre. For example, take a look at the 13th century cathedral or the Basilique Saint-Sernin de Toulouse, a pilgrims' church and stopover on the journey to Santiago de Compostela. Also beautiful is the Capitol on the Place du Capitole, in the heart of Toulouse.

properties.name: Camping Terra Verdon - Ciela Village
properties.description:
Amidst the rugged nature of Parc Naturel Régional du Verdon, a stone's throw away from the well-known Gorges du Verdon and the lively town of Castellane, lies Camping Terra Verdon - Ciela Village. This is a holiday paradise, where you can find tranquillity, beautiful nature and room to unwind completely. Lac du Castillon is located in the area.

Spacious pitches

The spacious and well-shaded pitches are located in streets along paved roads. The pitches are demarcated with hedges. The rental accommodation (mobile homes and bungalow tents), generally relatively new, can be found in a separate section.

Water park and more

The campsite has a wonderful water park with a leisure pool, an indoor pool, a paddling pool with water games for children, slides, a whirlpool and a solarium. Young and old can cool off here and have fun during their holidays. Next to the pool is a large children's area with colourful play equipment and sports fields. Children can have fun on the inflatable play equipment, while the older ones enjoy the beautiful views of the surrounding mountains and a range of sports activities.

Kids club and evening entertainment

There is no need for children to get bored with a spacious playground, a bouncer, table tennis tables, monkey bars, a mini golf course and lots of entertainment. The entertainment team offers a wide range of activities: from kids club and soccer tournaments to pool parties and treasure hunts. The campsite also offers guided walking tours and evening entertainment. Please note: the entertainment is in French!

Provençal dishes

In the robust camping restaurant, furnished in Provençal style, you can eat excellent regional dishes. The service is fast and friendly. Prefer to eat elsewhere? Head for a restaurant in the nearby town of Castellane. If you prefer to cook yourself, you can do your shopping in a small supermarket with mostly local products and daily fresh bread.

properties.name: Camping La Liez - Ciela Village
properties.description:
Camping Le Lac de la Liez is locate in the Champagne-Ardennes in France, at the edge of the lake of Liez. The campground is easily accessible from the N19 (toward Vesoul) and is used by many holidaymakers as a transit point toward the South of France or Spain. The hilly area of the plateau of Langres is covered with trees, forests, streams and lakes where you will lose yourself in an oasis of peace. Want it a little more lively? Visit the fortress town of Langres, with its historic centre and monumental buildings.

Camping on the lake

The campground is located on a hill on the lake of Liez. By the terrace design of the campground, nearly every campsite has a view of the water. The campsites of varying sizes can be called lovely, and the campground looks well maintained.

In addition to the open campsites for your tent, camper or caravan, there is also an option to hire a (safari) tent, chalet, trailer or lodge.

Stairway to the water

Because the camping is used for longer stays as well as for a transit stay to the south, there is great diversity among the guests. Water lovers will love the heated indoor or outdoor pools (with slide and jacuzzi), and you have a panoramic view of the lake of Liez below. Take a (narrow and steep) stairway down to the lake, and there is plenty to experience. Stretch out on the sandy beach, take a refreshing dip in the water, hire a waterbike or take sailing and surfing lessons.

properties.name: Camping La Farigoulette - Ciela Village
properties.description:
Spending your holidays in the Provence... always a splendid idea! Especially when you are staying at Camping La Farigoulette. This campsite, directly located on a side arm of the Lac de Sainte-Croix, offers many amenities. Enjoy the private pebble beach on the Verdon river, a beautiful swimming pool, a restaurant, a tree adventure park, several sports fields and a comprehensive entertainment programme. A real family campsite!

Spacious pitches

In front of you you will see a spacious open terrain with a large number of rental accommodation units (121). There are also 113 touring pitches. These spacious pitches offer ample shade. The surface is mostly made of sand and pebbles rather than grass. The further away you are from the rental accommodation, the more privacy you have.

Heated swimming pool and sports activities

The swimming pool (100 m2 and fairly deep) has a stylish and contemporary look. There is also a very nice toddler pool. Around the pools you will find a wide terrace with loungers and sun umbrellas. Everything is protected by stone walls. At the bottom of the campsite you will find a wide, pleasant pebble beach by the Verdon. With its clean water and no dangerous current, it is ideal for swimming. The river is also popular with canoeists.

During your stay at camping La Farigoulette you can enjoy a wide range of sporting activities: paddle, badminton, tennis, archery, pétanque and minigolf. You can also hire electric bikes, take part in water sports on the lake and enjoy a superb tree climbing park! The entertainment team offers a wide range of daytime and evening activities.

Always a table, always something nice to eat

The campsite has a restaurant with two lovely terraces; one near the pool and the other opposite the stage where the entertainment takes place. Here you can enjoy delicious dishes prepared with local products.

properties.name: Camping L'Abri des Pins
properties.description:
The L'Abri des Pins campsite in beautiful Pays de la Loire is a wonderful place for anyone who loves the beach, nature and relaxation. You’re surrounded by green space but with all the luxury you might want at your fingertips. Whether you like spending hours by the pool or are planning a sports-filled holiday or family holiday, this campsite has it all, in a relaxed atmosphere.

Shaded pitches and great accommodation

The pitches are large, with plenty of green space all around for privacy. It's easy to pitch your tent or park your motor home without being too close to your neighbours. Prefer more comfort? The modern mobile homes are fully equipped and feature comfortable beds, kitchens with appliances and a cosy seating area.

Adventurous campers will like the furnished rental tents. These cover all the basics, so you don’t have to bring much yourself. However you travel, you will always find accommodation to suit your needs here.

Splashing around in the water park

The heated pool is a great place to relax, while the entertainment team organises fun activities for young and old. After a day of adventure, enjoy regional dishes in the restaurant. Or head down to the bar for a fun end to the day.

Wellness lovers will enjoy the spa or solarium. There’s a fun kids’ club for the children. The site also has sports facilities like tennis courts and a gym. Fancy sampling the local atmosphere? Visit a local market or step inside a tasting room full of local products.

properties.name: wecamp l'Escala Punta Milá
properties.description:
Wecamp l'Escala Punta Milá is the perfect place to go camping in a large nature park with charming seaside resorts within easy reach. This campsite is situated in a large pine forest just outside l'Escala, an attractive harbour town on the Costa Brava. It’s an ideal base for beautiful nature walks, challenging mountain bike trails or simply a lovely afternoon at the beach. There’s plenty to do at the campsite itself as well. It features a number of amenities such as a large outdoor swimming pool, various sports and play facilities, and its own restaurant and supermarket.

Sunny destination, shady spots

At wecamp l’Escala Punta Milá, you can enjoy a lovely holiday on the sunny Costa Brava, while your pitch offers plenty of shade under the pine trees. The pitches are generally large and have a hard surface. Prefer to enjoy camping life with a bit of extra comfort? Then you can also book a stay in a modern glamping tent. The tents are fully equipped, including a kitchen and bathroom.

What’s there to do at this campsite?

If you like to stay active and sporty on holiday, this campsite is the perfect choice. Play a game of football on the pitch, show off your skills at tennis table and swim a few laps in the rectangular outdoor pool, which also features a paddling pool. After your session, you can join us at Miluus Restaurant, the welcoming campsite restaurant with a lovely outdoor area. You can, of course, also prepare your own meal using groceries bought from the campsite shop. The campsite is nice and quiet in the low and mid-seasons, while things get a more lively in the high season. At that time, fun activities are organised for campers of all ages.

properties.name: Camping Chez Gendron
properties.description:
Camping Chez Gendron is a small-scale campsite in the Gironde countryside, amidst vineyards. The Dutch owners organise a lot for their young guests: from horse rides to craft days. Despite this hustle and bustle, you can enjoy peace and quiet on the vast campsite. If there is enough interest, the owners organise a guided tour with a tasting at one of the wineries in the area.

Quiet and spacious spot

The owners have made their place in the countryside of the Gironde a fine destination for those looking for peace and quiet. The campsite is spacious, especially considering the number of pitches. There are fifty touring pitches on the extensive lawns. These are not demarcated, which enhances the spaciousness. Some of the pitches are intended for tent campers. Opposite the fifty touring pitches are four rental accommodations.

Many playing possibilities

You'll find the swimming pool right at the entrance on the right. This is a nice place to play in the water, but certainly not the only place to have fun. With the playground, the large football field and the sweet goats, there is something to do for every young camping guest. Behind the campsite, in the woods, is a mountain bike trail.

On horseback

In high season Sander and Aletta organize fun activities. For example, craft hours, picnic tours and sports tournaments are on the program. But the icing on the cake are horseback rides. Five sweet ponies and horses, from small to large, are ready to be brushed and ridden, whether you are an experienced rider or have never been on a horse before.

properties.name: Camping Les Chambons
properties.description:
Camping Les Chambons is located on the banks of the Creuse in the vilage of Argenton-sur-Creuse. Les Chambons is a nice spot to set up your tent, caravan or camper. All pitches have running water and electricity and the entire campsite was renovated in 2017. On Sunday afternoon the owner welcomes you with a complementary drink. This also sets the tone for the relaxed atmosphere on this campsite.

Camping comfort all year round

The sixty camping pitches of Camping Les Chambons can be reserved year round. Because most of these pitches are connected to electricity and running water, they also offer maximum comfort in the cooler seasons. The lovely pitches are also spacious and have sun as well as shade. The campsite has two new toilet buildings with individual showers, toilets and sinks. The toilet buildings are heated, so that they can be used year round.

Comfortable mobile homes

Camping Les Chambons rents six mobile homes year round, three of which with two bedrooms and three with three bedrooms. The mobile homes are each equipped with a half-covered terrace, a TV and wifi. The pitches for the mobile homes are so spacious that you can also park your car on them.

For young and old

Camping Les Chambons is a place of relaxation for all ages. For the very little ones, there is a range of play equipment, such as a trampoline and play castle. Older campers can toss a ball on the jeu-de-boules pitch or play table tennis. In the high season there is an entertainment team for young people. In the summer months there is regular musical entertainment.

properties.name: Natuurcamping Landgoed Old Putten
properties.description:
Old Putten is an estate campground with lovely spacious campsites. The site is located on the estate of the same name. From the camping, you can take a short walk to Elburg, located on Lake Veluwe and Lake Dronten. A visit to this old fortified town with its numerous monuments and lovely cafés and restaurants is really worth the effort. You can also take wonderful walks and cycling excursions in the area.

You'll notice right away: the campground is in a lovely location in the midst of a plethora of trees and greenery. You'll immediately experience the lovely atmosphere.

Spacious sites and clean sanitation

All campsites are very spacious and are highly maintained. The fields are set apart with hedges and bushes, and you are surrounded by trees. There is plenty of shade and privacy. The grass is mowed regularly. There are also accommodations to be hired on the campground. There are two spacious trekker huts and a comfort hut, each with four beds. 

Great activities

The campground is visited by parents with children and seniors. There is no swimming pool. In the high season there are all kinds of daily activities organised. You can make pottery, ride ponies, decorate pots with mosaic stones and much more. There are also tours of the estate.

Veggies from the farmer

There is no shop on the campground, but you can buy fresh vegetables from the farmer right behind the campground. Attention strawberry lovers!: During strawberry season there are plenty of these kings of summer! Cheese can also be purchased in the area from a cheese dairy.

properties.name: Camping Starnbosch
properties.description:
Camping Starnbosch is located in the middle of a forested area between Dalfsen, Heino and Ommen. From the campsite, there are many hiking and cycling trails leading through the Overijsselse Vecht valley region. There are several ways to camp on the campsite: on one of the spacious camping fields in the park area of the campsite or on a pitch in the wooded area. You can choose from pitches with a little or plenty of shade.

Camping Starnbosch is a beautiful and well-tended campsite with an exceptionally fine thatched reception building. Next to the reception is a former hay barn where you have free internet access.

Camping pitches

The camping pitches look well-tended and are located on beautiful manicured lawns or amongst the trees. The pitches are spacious and offer sufficient privacy. The pitches are separated from each other by beautiful plants. Some pitches have private sanitation at their disposal (for a fee). The communal sanitation facilities, however, are of exceptional quality. The campsite rents out furnished tents, luxury safari tents and lodges, cabins, and furnished caravans and also has a group accommodation for rent.

Swimming pool

Camping Starnbosch features a beautiful swimming pool with a sliding roof. Everyone can come here to swim a couple of lengths or have fun in the water. There is plenty of space surrounding the pool where you can lie back and soak up the sunshine. The campsite also has a spa area (sauna, hot tub, rain shower and terrace with relaxing loungers).

Eating and drinking

The campsite has a shop with a wide range of products. There is plenty to choose from on the menu at the restaurant. There is also a snack bar and a terrace where you can have a drink and a bite to eat.

properties.name: Camping Fuussekaul
properties.description:
This lovely family campsite is located in a hilly region with beautiful valleys in the heart of Luxembourg. Fuussekaul Campsite is an ideal base from which to visit tourist attractions such as the Öewersauer Nature Park and the beautiful town of Vianden. Fuussekaul is also ideally suited for families with (young) children. There is plenty for the youngest campers to do here, especially in the high season.

Wide choice of accommodation options

At Fuussekaul Campsite you will find a nice variety of rental accommodations and camping pitches. The latter come in two categories. There are standard camping pitches of around 90 m². If you want even more space, you can book one of the comfort pitches. These are approximately 110 m² in size. A neat field with motorhome pitches has been set up on the other side of the road.

Water recreation at the campsite

Guests have access to a heated outdoor swimming pool during the summer months. This is a rectangular pool where you can enjoy swimming a few laps. In addition, there is a nice paddling pool with colourful pool toys. There is also a small kiosk next to the swimming pool where you can order refreshing drinks and ice cream, among other things. Want to swim in natural waters? You can do this in the Lac de la Haute-Sûre reservoir, about a fifteen minute drive from the campsite.

Entertainment and playgrounds for children

The campsite has a wide range of sports, games and leisure facilities. The youngest campers in particular will have a great time here. For example, they can enjoy a fun entertainment program in addition to outdoor playgrounds, large trampolines and a beautiful mini golf course. They can also play in the indoor playground.

properties.name: Camping Valkenburg-Maastricht
properties.description:
Camping Valkenburg-Maastricht is located in the woods north of the well-known and lively Valkenburg aan de Geul. As its name suggests, Maastricht is also easily accessible from here. This campsite is also an excellent starting point for lovely hiking and cycling trips through the rolling hills of South Limburg.

Park-like grounds with large pitches

Tourist camping pitches are clearly in the majority at this well-kept campsite. The spacious touring pitches are on flat areas. At the back, they are usually screened by a hedge, on the sides there is no separation. In addition, this beautifully landscaped site with park-like appearance offers two large fields with nature pitches. Accommodation is also available, namely modern chalets, safari tents and gypsy caravans.

Dive into the pool

Are you tired after returning from an intensive mountain bike ride or lovely forest or city walk? Relaxing in the water is then a good idea. At this campsite, you can do that in a heated outdoor pool, consisting of two sections and surrounded by a neat decking terrace. Near the pool you will also find a fun playground, a shop, an atmospheric bar and a food truck. At the latter, you can get tasty pizzas and burgers.

Visit Valkenburg and Maastricht

Valkenburg is perhaps one of the nicest towns in the Netherlands, and this campsite is only two kilometres away. Here you stroll along the river and through charming streets lined with terraces. There are also caves, museums and castles. It is also less than 15 kilometres from Maastricht, which can be easily reached by train from Valkenburg.

properties.name: BLU Camping Holiday Garden
properties.description:
This medium-sized Italian family campsite is located right on Lake Bolsena. You can walk from the campsite to the largest volcanic lake in Europe. There you can swim, lie on the beach or participate in water sports. BLU Camping Holiday Garden has beautiful camping pitches on the lake, where it is a bit busier. The quiet pitches are situated a bit further away on the camping meadow. There are many trees on the campsite, so there is plenty of shade. You can also go to the swimming pool to enjoy a little water recreation.

BLU Camping Holiday Garden is an excellent base from which to explore the culture of Rome for a day. The Italian capital can be reached within an hour by car or by train. The picturesque town of Bolsena is also worth a visit.

Green surroundings

BLU Camping Holiday Garden has 180 camping pitches offering plenty of shade. You can also opt for a mobile home, lodge tent or an apartment. Your four-legged friend is also welcome at the campsite. The site is surrounded by lots of greenery and nature. The swimming pool is basic, but very nice for cooling off. Around the pool is a sunbathing area with lots of trees.

Tasteful restaurant

The campsite restaurant is a well-known and popular spot in the area. Both locals and guests from other campsites come to the restaurant to enjoy delicious Italian dishes and local specialities. You can also get fresh bread rolls at the campsite. There's even a small shop where you can buy food.

properties.name: Sporting Club Village & Camping
properties.description:
Sporting Club Village & Camping is located slightly south of the town of Mazara del Vallo, on the west coast of the Italian island of Sicily. Although the campsite is located at some 2 km from the sea and a tiny beach, the position is not the main reason for the popularity of the campsite. The most important trump cards are the two swimming pools, a fine restaurant, the ambiance, the number of palm trees, but especially the sports activities. Sicily is also an island with plenty of cultural value. With Selinunte and Marsala nearby, you can already enjoy yourself.

Camping between palm trees

The campsite is located on a large and open terrain. Yet there are also fields with more trees, such as palm trees. The pitches are spacious, providing ample privacy in general.

Don't have camping equipment? There are various caravans and mobile homes available for rental at Sporting Club Village & Camping. There is considerable variation: from renovated to old and from basic and small to luxurious and large.

Two swimming pools

The two attractively built swimming pools (one of them deep, and one shallow) are located next to the restaurant. There is also a tiled terrace and a sunbathing lawn with loungers and sun umbrellas near the pools. All in all a very attractive venue to spend your holidays.

Sicilian regional dishes

There is a small campsite shop. More shops are to be found in Mazara del Vallo, an easy walk or bicycle ride (four km). The campsite restaurant has an extensive menu, with delicious and affordable dishes. These are prepared with products from the region.

properties.name: Camping Cerquestra
properties.description:
Camping Village Cerquestra is located in a lovely spot with a panoramic view of Lago Trasimeno. The camping is perfect for a relaxing holiday on this lake. You can also use the campsite as a starting point for excursions into the nature of Parco Naturale del Trasimeno, located on the border between Umbria and Tuscany. Enjoy the natural beauty, the mild climate, the historic villages and cities of this part of Italy.

Cosy campsite with a view

The campsite doesn't look very big. But the pitches have plenty of privacy due to the vegetation. The campsite is not directly on the lake, but you can enjoy a wide view over the water. Campsite Cerquestra is a terraced campsite, so the higher you are, the more lovely the view. The rental accommodations consist of lodge tents (without bathrooms) and mobile homes.

Sportive campsite and environment

Campsite Cerquestra attracts many people who want to have an active holiday with kite surfing on the lake or exploring the environment on foot, by bicycle or even on horseback. The campsite has its own swimming pool, but that is only used for recreation swimming. It's not far to the lake, however.

Restaurant and pizzeria

You can also go to the restaurant for pizzas, but they also serve all kinds of à la carte dishes from the famous Italian cuisine. During the day you can get snacks, lunches and other bites and drinks. In the evening there is plenty of organised entertainment. Cooking yourself? In that case you can get your ingredients in the small camping shop.

properties.name: Camping de la Moselle
properties.description:
This modest, attractive campsite is situated in a non-touristy, green and hilly area in the town of Liverdun, north-west of the interesting city of Nancy. The site of Camping de la Moselle is beautifully situated on a loop of the Moselle, next to a sports and recreational field. You have a lovely view of the castle of the medieval Liverdun.

Hearty reception

This is a former municipal campsite, extensively renovated by the Quinot family and lovingly managed by them. You will notice straight away that the owners have implemented several original ideas, for instance a lowered desk for disabled persons. The campsite makes a well maintained impression.

Where is your pitch?

The 192 touring pitches are fairly spacious (70-140 m2), non-demarcated and have a grass surface. The paths running alongside are not hardened with gravel, but are made of loamy sand. The trees offer a fair degree of shade. The grounds have been partly raised. There are separate pitches for the disabled and there are four rental accommodation units.

Activities galore

There is a small, oval-shaped, sunny swimming pool (water at chest height) on the campsite, safely fenced-off. Cyclists and mountain bikers are pampered here with special facilities (bike rental and a breakdown service point). Walkers and other nature lovers will also spend a wonderful holiday here. There is playground equipment for the little ones and nearby sports facilities.

Making dinner or going out?

When you want to do your own cooking, you can get your supplies in the small campsite shop. Expect a limited range. However, fresh bread is available on a daily basis. There is a small restaurant, with breakfast service, a bar and a cosy terrace.

properties.name: Camping Lestaubière
properties.description:
In the southern French region of Nouvelle-Aquitaine, north of the town of Bergerac, Camping Lestaubière has a beautiful location overlooking the wide valley. Thanks to its rural location in the Périgord, lovers of hiking and biking can have a great time here. Children have plenty of room to play. There is an entertainment programme for young and old.

Space around you

The campsite has a higher and lower part. Below are the open and sunny pitches, at the top the pitches are sheltered by trees and shrubs. You can choose your favourite spot yourself. A characteristic of all pitches is that they are very spacious. A little further on you will find the mobile homes and the beautiful safari tents. Also here you have enough privacy. On the open field next to the swimming pool is the playground.

Swimming, fishing and boating

The beautiful swimming pool forms the heart of the campsite and borders a small lake where you can swim, fish and sail. From the sandy beach you can walk straight into the water. You can relax on the sunbathing lawn and on the sun loungers.

Attractive pavement café

Don't you feel like cooking? Then eat french fries at the snack bar, order a freshly baked pizza or take something tasty from the small menu. It is lovely on the pavement café under the trees. There are attractive tables and chairs everywhere and the tasteful decor is immediately noticeable. Every morning you can start the day with fresh rolls. Within walking distance there is a small supermarket.

properties.name: Camping Parco Capraro
properties.description:
Camping Parco Capraro is located not far from Venice, on the outskirts of the seaside resort of Lido di Jesolo. This complete family campsite is a five-minute walk from the beach and the Mediterranean Sea. With a restaurant with a pavement café, a large supermarket and an outdoor swimming pool, you'll have everything at hand at this beach campsite. If you still want to go on a trip, Venice is the destination par excellence. Buy your bus and boat tickets for Venice easily at the campsite itself.

Split in two

The campsite consists of two parts, separated from each other by the road at the reception building. The oldest, original part is laid out a bit more playful. Here, in addition to shady (and slightly small) touring pitches, you'll find most of the amenities: restaurant, supermarket, playground and swimming pool. The area across the road is quite practical. The straight pitches are mainly meant for campervans. This part is quieter and closer to the beach.

A dip in the Adriatic Sea

A five-minute walk through a beautiful forest and you stand with your feet in the sand. The Adriatic Sea is waiting for you here: a dip in the clear water is a must. A large part of the beach is filled with sun loungers. To rent at a charge.

A dip in the pool

The campsite's large outdoor swimming pool is located behind the main building at the front of the campsite. Even if you stay on the other side of the road, it's closeby. The rectangular pool has a round area on one side. Here it is shallower and small children can swim.

properties.name: Camping La Grange Neuve
properties.description:
Camping La Grange Neuve is located in the south of France, approximately between Narbonne and Perpignan. Because of its location close to the motorway, the campsite is particularly suitable as a transit campsite for campers travelling to Spain. During a stopover in this eastern part of Languedoc-Roussillon, the adjacent Sigean Africa Reserve is a great destination for an outing. Or go for a day at the beach on the Mediterranean Sea, before continuing your journey south.

Well-maintained campsite

The campsite is well maintained, with well-kept and spacious touring pitches. Mobile homes and chalets complement the camping offer. These rental accommodations are for holidaymakers staying longer, while the touring pitches are generally occupied by campers in transit to Spain.

Swimming pool or beach

A thick palm tree points out the location of the pool. This outdoor pool is spacious and has a separate, shallow area for the youngest swimmers. Thatched umbrellas, palm trees and a beautiful mural give the pool a Mediterranean touch. Of course a day at the beach is also possible. A twenty minutes drive and you are on the wide beach on the Mediterranean Sea.

Pavement café

Conviviality can be found in the restaurant and on the large pavement café. There you can dine extensively and taste typical dishes of the region.

Reserve Africaine de Sigean

More than three hundred hectares of animal park extends in the area next to the campsite. The entrance to the Réserve Africaine de Sigean is one and a half kilometres from your campsite. In this Africa reserve hundreds of mammals, reptiles and birds live in relative freedom.

properties.name: Campeggio Principina
properties.description:
In a pine forest, at one km from the coastal village of Principina a Mare (Toscane), lies the quiet and modest Campeggio Principina. There is a large amount of greenery on the campsite which creates a relaxing atmosphere. From the campsite it is a ten minute walk to the sea. The campsite offers an entertainment programme for young and old (in Italian, sometimes in English).

Sleeping between pine trees

Unpaved paths will lead you to your pitch, located on neatly maintained fields. You will find pine trees in many places. There are no less than four hundred touring pitches, varying from 50 to 140 m2. By and large you are assured of sufficient privacy. There is little demarcation between the pitches, this is more or less left to your own discretion.  There are 72 rental accommodation units (lodge tents, cottages and mobile homes).

The ideal beach

When you feel like a swim, you will undoubtedly head for the sea! This can be reached via a cycle/footpath. This is one of the most beautiful beaches in this part of the Mediterranean Sea in Italy: a wide swathe of beach with fine, almost white sand. White sun umbrellas and loungers await you here and there is a wooden jetty leading down to the sea.

The hungry camper

The small restaurant with lovely ambiance has a limited menu with good quality dishes. It has a cheerful appearance and two terraces. You can also get take-away meals. You can enjoy a drink at the bar. There is also a pizzeria. The small supermarket only stocks a few essentials. In summer, after 1st June, the range is extended.

properties.name: Molecaten Park De Agnietenberg
properties.description:
Molecaten Park De Agnietenberg is located directly on the Agnietenplas, an extraordinarily beautiful recreation area with a sandy beach, situated on the northern edge of the Hanseatic city of Zwolle. You reach this charming campsite through the forest of De Agnietenberg, with its ancient trees and beautiful forest trails. This rustic location is one of a kind and immediately gives you a nice holiday feeling. And yet you're also quite close to the city.

Camping or renting

The pitches can definitely be called spacious, although the fields differ; there are fields on the Agnietenplas, but also some closer to the forest. The entire campsite looks very well-maintained. Since 2017, there are a few luxury chalets on the site: Chalet Kamille even has two bathrooms and you'll experience hotel-level comfort. Chalet Pioen offers an exquisite view over the water. Chalet Akelei is especially suited for those who plan on a longer stay at the campsite. There is also the Mansion, which can lodge up to 18 people.

Activities

With its sandy beach, the Agnietenplas is the ideal place for sunbathing, swimming, rowing/canoeing, fishing and surfing. On the campsite you will also find a playground, a table tennis table, an air trampoline, a panna and basketball court and a volleyball court.

Eating and drinking

In the park, you can satisfy your hunger with food and drinks at the Zomers cafeteria. Here you can get a cup of coffee or tea with a delicious bite to eat, such as soup or Dutch pancakes. And you can always head to the terrace café for a cool drink. You can also order fresh bread for the next day.

properties.name: Camping Paradis Rocher de la Granelle
properties.description:
Camping Rocher de la Granelle is a quiet family campsite in the Dordogne, located directly on the river Vézère. You camp here in the Périgord-Noir, known for its many caves with rock paintings (Lascaux). Choose one of the large, shady touring pitches right by the river and let your children loose on the campsite. At the bar you can enjoy a pizza or fries.

Camping by the river

Although the campsite is quite simple, you'll enjoy the large touring pitches under the trees. The abundant greenery on the campsite and the spacious pitches create a convivial atmosphere. Each pitch has plenty of shade and green hedges for the necessary privacy. The most beautiful pitches are situated directly at the calm waters of the river.

Friendly family campsite

Campers of all ages can have fun on the campsite, but you will mainly see families with younger children. The campsite organises a lot in high season. Think of a mini club, rides in a tourist train and karaoke afternoons. Adult guests can also seek out the cosiness, for example during dance evenings.

Outdoor pool and river

In a sunny area to the left of the entrance is the large outdoor swimming pool: the meeting point for the youth. On sunny days you will see many children here, playing in the pool and racing off the water slide. For toddlers there is a paddling pool. You can also swim in the river. Via a small beach at the back of the campsite you can walk into the shallow, calm water. Canoes are waiting for you on the bank, time for a relaxing trip.

properties.name: GenussFerien, Natur und Strandcamping
properties.description:
This idyllic and peaceful nature campsite is located on the Jabelscher See and near the Nossentiner/Schwinzer Heath Nature Park in Germany. This multifaceted part of northern Germany is a great destination for hikers and cyclists. The campsite is located directly on a lake with a beach where you can swim. GenussFerien, Natur und Strandcamping offers beautiful pitches with a view over the lake. Relax on the lovely terrace and enjoy a drink, cake or a dish from the small menu.

Under the trees by the lake

The large camping area looks nice and is beautifully situated around the lake. There are several camping pitches on the shore that offer a fantastic view. The larger pitches in the middle of the campsite provide less shelter, but this also gives them a more spacious feeling. The sanitary facilities were built a few years ago and are neat and clean. If you visit the campsite without your own tent or caravan, you can stay in a rental caravan or rent a holiday home.

Swimming and watersports

You can walk straight from the campsite onto the beach by the lake. In addition to taking a dip in the water, you can also enjoy all sorts of watersports. Fancy an adventurous canoe trip? You can rent canoes at the campsite and explore the Jabelscher See from the water. Or sail along the banks of the bison reserve and the Nossentiner/Schwinzer Heath Nature Park. Here you'll pass through extraordinary and untouched nature with rare animals such as bison, eagles and kingfishers. You can also rent a pedal boat, a rowing boat or a stand-up paddleboard.

properties.name: hu Birkelt Village
properties.description:
In the middle of Luxembourg, in the green region of Mullerthal, Camping hu Birkelt village has a beautiful location. You will be camping close to the touristic town Larochette, known for its castle. A nice trip when you are staying at hu Birkelt village! With a swimming pool, large indoor playground, entertainment and restaurant, there is also plenty to do on the site itself. Here you are at a real family campsite in the countryside.

Pitches and rental accommodations

The campsite consists of two parts: one with regular camping pitches and one (increasingly larger) part for rental accommodations. For your camping equipment, there are spacious pitches on grass lawns, separated by man-sized hedges. This ensures a lot of privacy. Some of the pitches are along a street, others are on a square. If you do not have a caravan, campervan, tent or trailer tent, you can stay in one of the mobile homes or safari tents.

Water fun!

The campsite has a heated indoor pool and a large outdoor pool (450 m2) with slide and water features. Around the outdoor pool you will find several loungers you can use. After a nice afternoon's swimming you can rinse off the chlorine in one of the showers.

Entertainment

The large indoor playground is the eye-catcher of hu Birkelt village. You can play sports on the multi-sports field. Not inspired? Then an entertainment team is ready to entertain young and old throughout the season. Of course, all that fun makes the children hungry. Time for bite to eat in the restaurant. The large outdoor seating area is a good place to be.

properties.name: Camping Orbitur Sao Pedro de Moel
Camping Orbitur Guincho
properties.description:
In the coastal area near Cascais, west of Lisbon, is Camping Orbitur Guincho. The beach is a stone’s throw away and the Portuguese capital city Lisbon (30 km) is less than an hour’s drive. The campsite is a good home base for those who like tranquillity and for active campsite visitors. Visit the rugged coastline with its famous rock formations, go for a refreshing swim in the sea or take lessons at one of the local surfing schools.

Camping in the dunes

Most of the pitches at Camping Orbitur Guincho are between the trees for some extra shade, although there are spots in the full sun. The large camping site has paved roads, which makes driving with your own recreational vehicle somewhat easier. There are also a large number of mobile homes and wooden cottages, located in the dunes with a view of the sea.

All amenities for a relaxed holiday

The swimming pools, located in the full sun with sun loungers and parasols, are perfect for a refreshing dip. Not in the mood to cook? Visit the restaurant, which has a charming terrace and a simple menu. Children will have great fun in the play zone while you enjoy some peace and quiet.

Plenty to see and do

Nor will you be at all bored outside of the campsite. The lively city of Lisbon (30 km) is easy to reach and fun for a day out with the entire family. A visit to the beautiful town of Sintra (18 km), known for the colourful Palácio da Pena in particular, is also a must.

properties.name: Camping Village Paestum
properties.description:
On the west coast of Italy, some sixty kilometres south of Pompeii, lies Camping Village Paestum. Only a pinewood separates campsite guests from the beach and the Mediterranean Sea. With its spacious swimming pool (complete with new paddling pool with slides), some 300 touring pitches and various rental accommodation, this is a large family campsite.

Plenty of choice

Spread out over the spacious campsite, neatly arranged in rows and easily accessible, there are almost three hundred pitches. They are separated by thin hedges and have a hard surface with grass or sand. Shadow is abundant on a large part of the campsite. On the side of the campsite are all the rental accommodations, just over seventy in total.

On the Mediterranean Sea

In the summer months, a shuttle bus takes you to the beach, which is only five hundred metres from the campsite. So it's also good to walk, with a bicycle and footpath along the busier road. The last part of the route goes through the forest. Once you've passed the trees, you stand with your feet on the sandy beach at the Mediterranean Sea.

Swimming pool with dolphins

You'd rather stay at the campsite, but do you fancy a swim? Then, under the watchful eye of the ceramic dolphins at the bottom, you can swim in the large swimming pool. The youngest visitors will be a lot in the large paddling pool. This sloping pool has no less than four slides. This makes the paddling pool not only suitable for small campers who want to paddle, but also for the adventurous swimmers.

properties.name: Camping Pradelongue
properties.description:
The Camping Pradelongue campsite is located in the Haute-Garonne, a department in the south of France. You can camp here in the valley of Luchon, surrounded by thirteen mountain peaks that reach an altitude of over three thousand metres. The campsite is located two kilometres from Luchon. The village is best known for its thermal baths and is the starting point for many outdoor activities.

A spacious, natural campsite

The Pradelongue family campsite is located in a green setting. The property is located along the access road to Luchon and is surrounded by mountains with mountain passes. Among them is the famous Col de Peyresourde, almost an annual feature in the Tour de France. The terrain is flat, and the 170 pitches are spacious (minimum 100 m2) and delimited by hedges or bushes. The entire campsite covers an area of four acres. Holidaymakers without their own camping equipment can choose from a variety of luxury mobile homes.

Fun in the water

The beautiful nature surrounding the campsite invites you to explore the area. After a day of adventure, cool off in the pool. Even when it's not so hot, it's a great place to be. The swimming pool at Pradelongue campsite is heated. Children can have fun in the wading pool with a mini slide.

Supermarket around the corner

Don't feel like cooking? By the pool is a small snack bar. During the months of June through September, you can go here for a small snack or a simple meal. In July and August, you can order fresh bread rolls at the campsite. Next to the entrance of the site, you will find a large supermarket.

properties.name: Camping Figurotta
properties.description:
The sun is almost always shining in the southern French coastal region of Languedoc-Roussillon. The nature in the area is breathtaking and offers an ideal holiday destination for nature lovers. The intimate Figurotta Campsite is the ideal base from which to discover the region. There is also plenty to do at the campsite during the high season. Cool off in the pool, eat in the restaurant or participate in the organised activities. In the low season you can check in independently via an automated reception.

Shower in the open air

The small-scale Figurotta Campsite has 44 touring pitches and 15 rental accommodations. There are two sanitary facilities: one building with toilet and shower cabins under a large roof and another heated sanitary building. This is especially useful in winter, because the campsite is open all year round. Campers appreciate the clean, renovated sanitary facilities. During the summer season, campers can enjoy the campsite's outdoor swimming pool.

Organised activities

It would be a waste for this campsite situated between local vineyards and wineries to not offer wine tastings. These are therefore regularly organised. As are Zumba classes, astronomy nights and pony rides. Despite the amount of activities at the campsite, the atmosphere remains calm. Peace seekers who do not require an entertainment programme can also enjoy a pleasant stay here.

Camping holiday for nature and culture lovers

There is much to do in the vicinity of the campsite for both nature and culture lovers alike. Several historic towns and villages are less than an hour's drive from the campsite. In the wider area you will find castles and abbeys that are also worth a visit. Sports enthusiasts can explore the area on foot or by bike.

properties.name: Camping Les Acacias au Bord du Lac
Camping Youpendi
properties.description:
In the heart of the Ardèche department, you will discover this authentic French family campsite. Here, you will find a wonderfully relaxed and casual atmosphere that campers come back for time and time again. Camping Youpendi is the perfect place to enjoy a nice long holiday, but it's also an ideal transit campsite.

A view over the water

The campsite is located in a small forest on the banks of the Drôme River. In addition to 60 shaded camping pitches, 20 of which have direct access to the river, you can also stay at this campsite in one of the mobile homes or luxury glamping tents. You can use the free Wi-Fi available throughout the campsite.

Swimming pool and river

For water fun during your holiday, you can choose from the pool or the river. The sun terrace by the pool and the pebble beaches by the river are an amazing place to be. There are sunbeds with parasols and picnic benches. Everything you need for a wonderful day on the water. The side stream of the river is shallow, making this place a great water playground for young and old. Float down the river on an air mattress or inflatable rubber ring. Children can jump off the rocks, splash around and build dams.

Numerous activities

With two playgrounds, a trampoline, bouncy castle, table tennis and sports fields, there's plenty of holiday fun to be had. In July and August, the entertainment team is ready to provide fun activities for all ages. From water games to marshmallow roasting. And from bocce tournaments to a fun quiz for adults. 8–13-year-olds can participate in a canoe trip with an instructor.

properties.name: Camping Couleurs du Monde
properties.description:
Camping Couleurs du Monde is in Faverolles-sur-Cher, between the vineyards of Touraine, the castles in the Loire Valley and the well-known Zoo de Beauval. During your holiday at this spot, you combine quiet, countryside and culture.

Camping amid the flowers and trees

The campsite has 108 camping pitches and about 30 hire accommodation. The site is filled with flowers and plants, making it feel like you are camping in a park. The camping pitches are separated from each other by bushes and trees. There are camping pitches with and without shade.

From breakfast to sports competitions

You can go to the campsite restaurant for a tasty snack, an ice cream after a long hot day, for a beer to accompany a sports competition and even for breakfast. There is a large supermarket and a French boulangerie beside the campsite.

There is plenty for children to do at the campsite. There is a nice and warm swimming pool with a retractable roof, an additional swimming pool for toddlers with playground equipment, a playground, a games hall and even a small petting zoo. In the high season, there is a special entertainment programme for the little ones, when they can play, do crafts and dance.

Amid the Loir-et-Cher castle region

There is plenty to do around Camping Couleurs du Monde. Discover the surrounding area on foot, hire a bike at the campsite or go on River Cher in a canoe. The medieval town of Montrichard is 1.5 kilometres away, and it has a small sandy beach by River Cher. If you would rather go for something bigger, visit the cities of Tours (60 km), Blois (35 km) and Orléans (100 km).

properties.name: Camping Le Dolmen
properties.description:
Camping Le Dolmen is on Quiberon Bay, in the south of Brittany. At this well-kept campsite, families with small children in particular have a good time. There is a great covered swimming pool, a playground and a multi-sports field. There is plenty to do in the area around Camping Le Dolmen. The beach is only 600 metres away and the towns of Carnac and Quiberon are nearby.

Mobile homes and green pitches

You will find pitches and mobile homes at Camping Le Dolmen. You camp on a grassy or sandy surface and there are many trees. It is also possible to book a pitch with private toilet and washing facilities. If you want more comfort, there are various mobile homes from which to choose.

Swimming fun and a game of jeu de boules

At the front of the campsite is the beautiful heated swimming pool, covered by a glass dome. For the littlest ones, there is a separate paddling pool.
