After swimming, pick up a cool drink or a snack at the bar. Have a seat on the terrace that overlooks the swimming pool. If you'd like to do something active, play a game of jeu de boules or have fun playing basketball on the playing field.

Menhirs, beach and fun towns

Fun excursions can be had in the vicinity around the campsite. For a fun day at the sea, you can walk straight to the sandy beach. Carnac (2.5 km) is also nearby, where you will find several shops and restaurants. Carnac is famous for its megaliths. It is home to more than 3,000 pre-historic menhirs (stones).

properties.name: Camping de l'Ayguette
properties.description:
Camping de l'Ayguette is located in the heart of the Drôme Provençale. The beautiful surroundings consist of mountains, forests and vineyards, but also of an infinite number of picturesque villages. This is also an ideal base for walking and cycling enthusiasts. Children of all ages are well catered for; there is plenty of space to play outside and during the summer months everyone can join in with small-scale activities that suit this charming campsite.

Places in the forest

All the pitches at Camping de l'Ayguette are situated around the vineyard. This means a beautiful view for the adjoining pitches. In terms of pitches, there is a choice between shade and sun. Would you like to go for a higher pitch or would you like to camp a bit closer to the swimming pool and restaurant?

Nice pool

At the reception is the heated swimming pool. It's not very big, but just a nice bath to cool down for a while. Sun worshippers take a seat on one of the comfortable sun beds.

If you like to swim in natural water, head for the Gorges de L'Ouvèze (just above Buis-les-Barronies) about a twenty minute drive from the campsite. There flows a beautiful river for swimming and fishing. Also fun with children, because they can romp around and build dams.

Cosy terrace

For a bite to eat you can join the nice restaurant on the campsite. In high season they serve pizzas and other simple but tasty dishes. The cosy covered patio is a lively and popular place for a drink throughout the day.

properties.name: Camping Il Melo
properties.description:
In a secluded spot in Piedmont, in the shadow of the Italian Alps, you'll find the Camping Il Melo campsite. This small campsite is an ideal starting point for mountain hikers. In addition, the nature and small scale of the campsite make it a relaxing place to camp for those seeking peace and quiet. From the green camping area, among flowers and trees, you can overlook the mountains. A cultural trip to Cuneo is definitely worthwhile.

Camping in the Alps

On the camping grounds of Il Melo campsite, you camp under the watchful eye of the mighty Alps. They, together with the small scale of the campsite, provide a calm and relaxed atmosphere. You will find about forty touring pitches on the campground, set among colourful flowers and mature trees. The pitches are not very big, but they are well kept and lie on a nice grassy base. The owners maintain the campsite well, but always with respect for nature. The pitches are minimally defined, which gives them a spacious feel.

For the mountain hiker

With the mountains so close, the Camping Il Melo campsite is an excellent base for mountain hikers. You will meet many outdoor campers and nature lovers, who often pitch a tent at the campsite. In the high season, however, you will also see families with children who are looking for a quiet place for their camping holiday.

A sunny pool

The swimming pool, located at the front of the campsite, is a great place for relaxation for both small and large guests. The rectangular pool is of a medium size, and leaves plenty of room all around for loungers. You can take a refreshing dip while the sun shines on the water.

properties.name: Camping Le Moulin du Bleufond-Lascaux
properties.description:
Near an old mill on the banks of the river La Vézère is the Camping Le Moulin de Bleufond-Lascaux campsite. Within walking distance of this quiet three-star campsite, you'll find the bustling town of Montignac. In addition, the campsite is close to the Lascaux Cave with its magnificent rock paintings. The campsite has a simple outdoor pool, heated sanitary facilities and a cosy restaurant.

Sunny or shady

The camping area is richly covered with tall deciduous trees. It is separated from the river by a quiet road. The campsite consists of two parts: an older part with sheltered pitches in the shade of the trees, and a newer part with young plantings and sunny pitches. There are approximately ninety touring pitches, separated by hedges. Thirty well-kept mobile homes are located in a separate part of the campsite.

Sunny terrace with palm trees

At the cosy entrance to the campsite is a small but beautiful pool. It is beautifully landscaped on a sunny terrace, which is lined with palms and other vegetation. The outdoor pool is heated, as is the separate toddler pool. Around the baths, you will find deck chairs. Large parasols provide the necessary shade. There is also a nice massage bench in the pool.

Delicious daily specials

Right at the entrance of the campsite is a restaurant with a cosy terrace. You can have breakfast and dinner, but takeout is also available. In addition to pizza, fries and snacks, there are also excellent daily specials on the menu. At the reception, there is a small shop where you can find some local specialities and food. Fresh bread, croissants and chocolate rolls are available for purchase at the campsite every morning.

properties.name: Camping de la Forêt
properties.description:
The quiet family campsite La Forêt, as the name suggests, is located near a beautiful forest. The well maintained campsite is close to one of the most beautiful loops in the Seine near Jumièges, a historic village on the beautiful river. In the vicinity you will find a vast nature area with lots of forests, villages and towns, through which the Seine winds her way.

Camping with shade and privacy

You will see at a glance that the grounds are well-tended. The spacious pitches, varying in size (100 to 200 m2) but always spacious enough, are located along streets. Depending on your wishes you can choose between a pitch with or without facilities (as electricity and water). The pitches are demarcated with high beech hedges, a guarantee for privacy. You can also rent a tent, a mobile home or trekker hut at Camping de la Forêt.

All amenities for a perfect holiday!

There is a small, covered swimming pool with sliding roof and a lovely toddler pool with a few slides and a small rock. The water in both pools is nicely heated. There is playground for children, but no entertainment programme. You can play table tennis on the campsite and make use of the pétanque court. You can play tennis for a fee.

Fresh bread

The campsite shop has a limited assortment, but you can buy the most essential groceries. The baker delivers daily fresh bread on order. In peak season you can also get take-away meals, such as pizzas, French fries and snacks. There is a large supermarket at some five km from the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Pineta
properties.description:
Camping Pineta is on the Adriatic coast in Croatia’s Istria. This is a beautiful family campsite, where you camp under the conifer trees. The campsite is located on the beach and has a view of the Brijuni islands. Small campsite guests have fun in the playground while adults enjoy a drink on the terrace. The beach also has everything you need for a relaxed beach holiday in Croatia.

Camping amid the pine trees

At this vast campsite, you camp on spacious, non-demarcated pitches. The majority of the pitches are under the trees. You can also stay in a luxury mobile home. The mobile homes are suitable for a maximum of six people and have their own toilet and washing facilities, a fully equipped kitchen and air conditioning.

Beach holiday in Istria

You can walk straight onto the pebble beach from the campsite. Go for a refreshing swim in the sea, go snorkelling or relax on your towel. Children have fun in the playground on the beach, where there are trampolines and a basketball court. The daily shopping can be done at the mini market at the campsite. A delicious meal is available at the campsite restaurant, where local dishes are served. The terrace provides a beautiful view.

Brijuni National Park and Pula

Fazana (3 km) is the village closest to the campsite. The boats to the Brijuni islands, also known as Brijuni National Park, leave from the harbour in Fazana. This is a group of 14 islands, the largest of which can be visited. Pula (11.5 km) is also worth a visit. It has a historic centre with a large amphitheatre.

properties.name: Camping Porte de Provence
properties.description:
Who wouldn't want to enjoy a heated swimming pool in the middle of the hills? If you agree, then make your way to the Camping Porte de Provence! At this campsite, you can pitch your tent in a beautiful wooded area. Camping Porte de Provence is located near the town of Mirmande in the French department of Drôme. You will be welcomed in a beautiful wooden chalet. Here, you will discover the reception and a small shop. The campsite consists of two levels. At the campsite, you will find several cherry trees. You can simply pick and choose. Tasty! Thanks to the numerous trees, the campsite is particularly shady.

Sun, pool, restaurant!

Want to dive straight into the pool after you arrive? No problem! The swimming pool is located next to the restaurant. This is a great place to bask in the sunshine. In high season, there are various games to play in and around the pool.

In addition, the English-speaking supervisors of the children's club organise many activities in the high season. The children can do crafts and play here almost all week (closed on Wednesdays). But parents need not get bored either: in the high season, an entertainment team is ready for them. Extra fun: night swimming on Friday evening!

Food and other amenities

The campsite's restaurant is open during the high season. In addition, from the beginning of May to the end of September, you can buy breakfast and fresh bread at the campsite. In Saulce-sur-Rhône (eight kilometres away), you will find a supermarket. The campsite has a large building with separate restrooms. If you feel like being sporty, you can play a game of football or volleyball on the multi-sports field.

properties.name: Camping Les Puits Tournants
properties.description:
Les Puits Tournants campsite is located in the northern French department of Somme. On the quiet route to this small family campsite the cornfields and small villages give you that real French holiday feeling. Once you arrive at this campsite, you are constantly in contact with nature. Go fishing from your pitch or enjoy the varied landscapes during a cycling or walking tour.

Peace and quiet at the fishpond

After a personal welcome you can choose your (mostly sunny) pitch at this campsite. Will you choose a pitch by the water or rather a pitch a bit further away? The pitches are spacious, often marked out and laid out with an eye for detail and privacy. At this campsite, it is also possible to stay in a beautiful mobile home, tipi or yurt.

The campsite is situated around a fishpond near the beautiful River Somme. Cast your rod here and enjoy the peace and quiet by the water. From the campsite you can make lovely cycle and walking trips along the Somme.

Always (water) fun

Since 2018, the campsite has a brand new indoor heated swimming pool with a jacuzzi and wellness. The children can have a great time in the paddling pool. In addition, you will find a playground, a miniature golf course and a trampoline at the campsite.

Fresh bread rolls

The campsite has a small shop with the basic necessities and a bread service where you can get the best fresh rolls every day. For the rest of your shopping and a wide choice of restaurants you can go to the nearby village of Corbie.

properties.name: Camping Le Fun
properties.description:
On the shores of Leucate Lake, in the French department of Aude, lies the Camping Le Fun campsite. You will have a great time here, especially on the water. During your camping holiday, you can surf and use your SUP (stand-up paddleboard), sunbathe and swim. The latter can be done in the pool, but also in the Mediterranean Sea. From Le Fun campsite, the sea is only a fifteen-minute drive away. At the campsite itself, you will find mostly peace and quiet.

Camping under the olive trees

A paved road leads to the campsite's large pitches. You can choose one yourself. Select a nice pitch in the sun or in the shade. Ancient olive trees provide shady spots and demarcation. A delightful camping experience!

Endless fun for surfers and SUP'ers

Sports enthusiasts in particular will have an incredible time at Camping Fun. Leucate Lake is the place to be for surfers and SUP'ers. The strong coastal wind makes it extra fun for real water sports enthusiasts. This allows kite surfers to jump to impressive heights. Looking for calmer waters? Then dive into the campsite pool. This large pool is an amazing place for hours of swimming fun.

Eating mussels and more

The small bar with a small menu at the campsite may be enough to satisfy all your needs. But there are plenty of larger restaurants in the area to enjoy throughout your holiday. Especially at Port Leucate. This is where you'll find the best spots for mussels, the speciality of the region. But Perpignan or Narbonne are also great places to eat out. Why not combine your meal with a day trip to these beautiful historic cities?

properties.name: Camping Le Rhône
properties.description:
At the edge of the Ardèche, directly on the river Rhône, you will find Le Rhône campsite. From your pitch you have a view over the river and the vineyards. This campsite is ideal if you are passing through. But it is also a great campsite for longer stays. You can walk straight into the centre of Tournon-sur-Rhône, with its restaurants and shops. Would you like to discover the beautiful nature of the Ardèche in a special way? Then get on the old steam train in the neighbourhood.

With a glass of wine at the water's edge

The pitches are not all the same size. But high trees provide nice shady spots. It also gives an intimate feeling. The most beautiful pitches are along the Rhone. The view from your pitch is wonderful. Not only do you look out over the water. You can also admire the hilly landscape on the other side of the Rhone. The hills are covered with vineyards. Maybe you will have a glass of wine on your table made from those grapes!

Motorhome travellers in transit

The attractive pitches with their high trees are ideal for motorhomes. Many guests pass through with their campervan. It makes camping Le Rhône a great destination for a short stay. But if you want to stay longer, that is also possible. Especially if you are looking for a quiet campsite.

Floating in the swimming pool

Lying down with a drink under a thatched parasol, this is how you can dry off after a dip in the pool. And all this while looking out over the hills of the Ardèche. The campsite's beautiful swimming pool is suited to everyone.

properties.name: Camping Naturiste du lac de Lislebonne
Camping L'Escapade
properties.description:
L'Escapade campsite is tucked away in Cahagnolles, a tiny village in Normandy with a church and a handful of houses, and is the perfect peaceful location for your camping trip. Here you'll be camping along a lake that is great for both swimming and fishing. The partially terraced campsite has a park-like feel and very spacious pitches. The swimming pool on the campsite has a sliding roof, so you can still go for a refreshing dip in less than wonderful weather.

Camping par excellence

The campsite features 43 spacious, touring pitches and 5 separate pitches for campers. The grass surface on the site is well maintained. The paths are paved and wide. The 36 rental accommodation units are spread out and are composed of large tents and mobile homes.  This is an excellent campsite for longer stays, but also makes for a great pit stop if you are travelling along the south west coast of France. 

Swimming in the pool and the lake

The heated swimming pool (180 m2) is located near the reception area, the sports field and the tennis court. It is covered with glass roofing. Of course, we open this up during summer weather. The swimming pool has a rather straightforward design. However, there is a slide (10 metres) for the children to enjoy. The lake, which also offers fishing, is located right next to the entrance of the campsite. 

Delicious menus

The restaurant at L'Escapade is a small, charming restaurant with an appealing design. For instance, the bar is made of stacked wine crates. The menu is modest, but everything is high quality! You can also take your meals away. The pizzeria is open in July and August as well. There is another nice restaurant in Lingèvres , ten kilometres away. The camping shop is quite small, but does offer fresh bread every day.

properties.name: Flower Camping Les Plages de l'Ain
properties.description:
Camping Les Plages de l’Ain is beautifully situated in a wooded area, some 30 km from Lyon. The campsite lies on the banks of the river l’Ain, a location guaranteed to offer children hours of fun. The campsite is a good base for walking and cycling trips or excursions in the area, such as Lyon or the medieval town of Pérouges.

Shaded or sun-drenched

The campsite makes a well maintained impression with spacious, level camping pitches on a grass surface and neat sanitary facilities. Some pitches are demarcated with greenery. Numerous trees ensure shaded pitches, but for sun lovers there are also sunny sites. The sizes of the pitches are not all the same. The pitches for tents are slightly smaller. Scattered over the grounds are mobile homes. bungalow tents and cheerful Coco tents.

Building dams in the river

Children are sure to enjoy themselves on this friendly campsite. They can indulge themselves in the playground, swim in the two small swimming pools or build dams in the river l'Ain, which can be reached via a direct access from the campsite. Fishing is allowed in the river and in high season canoeing and kayaking trips are organised.

Morning exercises and outdoor laser game

The swimming pool is in a sunny location. In the summer months you can start the day with sporty morning exercises. There is an outdoor laser game for aficionados. In high season you can enjoy regional dishes in the restaurant (limited menu). The friendly owner regularly organises activities during the months of July and August, such as a concert or barbecue.

properties.name: Camping Lac de Villefort
properties.description:
In the town of Villefort (Languedoc-Roussillon) you will find the pleasant family campsite Camping Lac de Villefort. The beautiful view over the lake is without doubt the biggest asset of this campsite. This terraced campsite is located in a wooded region with many old castles and old villages where you can enjoy that authentic French atmosphere.

A nap in the shade

The pitches at the campsite are not overly large (85 - 100m2), but they are mostly in the shade. This means you can relax! Another big plus is that all pitches overlook Lake Villefort. You can also book a mobile home, wigwam tent or log cabin.

Swimming and more

Maybe you'll jump in the pool first and then dive into the lovely lake afterwards. You can do both at Camping Lac de Villefort. The rectangular camping pool is perfect for swimming laps. There is also a paddling pool for the youngest guests. Sporty campers will also be in their element at Camping Lac de Villefort. From the campsite there are various cycling and walking routes. And almost all water sports are permitted on the lake.

Entertainment

Children can also have fun in one of the playgrounds. Or challenge each other to a game of table tennis or jeu de boules.

Eating and drinking at the campsite

You don't always have to cook for yourself at Camping Lac de Villefort. You can order meals prepared by a local caterer. There are also fresh rolls available every morning and a small campsite shop where you can buy some basic products.

properties.name: Camping Huttopia Royat
properties.description:
On the flanks of the Puy de Dôme, in Auvergne, you’ll find the Huttopia Royat campsite. This well kept campsite is ideal for the whole family. Children can swim in the heated swimming pool or play in the children's club while parents relax on the sheltered, green pitches.

Well-maintained campsite

The well-maintained campsite has 125 spacious pitches. There are trees and shrubs all over the terrain. These provide plenty of shade. The most beautiful pitches are at the front of the campsite, on the right. They are close to all amenities: swimming pool, sanitary facilities, reception and bar. On the outside of the campsite you'll find the rental accommodations. You have a choice of modern wooden chalets, mobile homes, gypsy caravans or lodge tents.

Child-friendly campsite

Especially in the summer months, many families with younger children come to this child-friendly campsite. It offers a lot of fun and play opportunities for children. The summer children's club and entertainment team have something fun in store for everyone. A short selection: workshop for making bows and arrows, tree climbing, treasure hunts and live concerts. In the low season it is nice and quiet. Which attracts especially seniors and those looking for peace and quiet.

Swimming pool in the sun

From the reception you can already see it: the swimming pool. The circular pool lies in the sun, in the middle of a sun deck. Here you can sit on a lounger while your children jump into the water. This pool is ideal for them: spacious, heated and not too deep. A separate area, shielded by a fence for extra safety, is very nice for the youngest water lovers.

properties.name: Camping Seasonova Les Mouettes
properties.description:
Camping Seasonova Les Mouettes is situated between the port cities of Calais and Le Havre. A short footpath is all that separates you from the Atlantic Ocean. Les Mouettes is a quiet campsite on top of a hill from where you can enjoy the magnificent view of the sea. The charming village of Veules-Les-Roses with a small river, a water mill and quaint shops, is in close proximity.

Tent on stilts

On the campsite you are allowed to choose your own pitch in low season, but this does not apply in peak season. The pitches are rather compact and there is little room to manoeuvre, camping guests with rather large caravans have to take this into consideration. The pitches are laid out both in long rows and on fields. Hedges and shrubs demarcate the sites. Want to rent something? Choose between a mobile home or a tent on stilts.

Chalk cliffs within walking distance

The covered, rectangular campsite swimming pool is located next to a terrace. Around the pool are loungers and there is also a toddler pool. Rather explore the tempestuous Atlantic Ocean? After a 300 m walk from the campsite, you will reach the high chalk cliffs.

Entertainment for all

With free access to the fitness room as well as the municipal sports fields adjacent to the campsite, camping guests can really indulge themselves. There is a small playground for children, a mini club and a recreation area with a table tennis and pool table, a table football game and a pinball machine. You can relax in the wellness area with sauna, spa and a choice of massages.

Snack bar

Feel like a quick snack? You can order snacks from the snack bar (with terrace) in peak season. Looking for restaurants? If so, you can go to the esplanade or to the centre of Veules-Les-Roses.

properties.name: Camping Seasonova Etennemare
properties.description:
Camping Seasonova Etennemare is located in an excellent location for exploring the coast of Normandy. The historical towns of Veules-les-Roses and Dieppe and the famous chalk cliff near Etretat are definitely worth a visit. The campsite is within walking distance from the sea, the centre of St.-Valery-en-Caux, the marina, the casino and the Etennemare forest.

Spacious

The green site looks quite basic, but offers beautiful and spacious pitches on a lawn. The camping pitches are positioned in rows and demarcated with hedges or shrubs. Rather rent accommodation? There are numerous mobile holes in rows on a field. There is a central sanitary building, which is relatively new and is kept spotless.

Swimming in calm water or with waves?

The beautiful covered swimming pool is relatively new and of reasonable size. There is also a separate paddling pool. There are also some loungers to relax on. Do you prefer the waves and gazing at the horizon? Take a walk through the centre of the nearby town to the guarded pebble beach on the Atlantic Ocean. It is ideal for swimming.

Aquazumba

The amenities on this campsite are basic. There is a small petting zoo with a few goats and chickens. Children can climb and scramble on the playground equipment. The small-sized entertainment team organises bingo, karaoke and aquazumba.

Snack bar and camping shop

The catering facilities on Seasonova Etennemare are also basic. You can get a drink, ice cream or French fries from the bar. At the reception you can get some necessities like milk. There is a larger supermarket nearby. At the reception you can order fresh bread each day.

properties.name: Camping Les Calquières
properties.description:
Camping Les Calquières is situated in an area with beautiful nature reserves and historical sights. The grounds are an oasis of peace with playfully designed pitches, with separate pitches for extended stays and overnight stops. The small-scale campsite has a lovely maintained and clean swimming pool.

Peace and quiet and friendliness

When you arrive at the camping side which is surrounded by hedges, a world of peace unfolds. Behind the barrier you can see a fairly new combind building with reception, kitchen, restaurant and shower for the disabled. Once on the campsite, you will see a beautiful serene terrain with playfully designed pitches, where the section for overnight pitches is separate from the section for an extended stay.

Playfully laid out grounds

The pitches of at least 100 m2 in size are very attractive, some are more spacious than others. In short: all pitches differ slightly. All mobile homes and lodges are brand new, neat and well maintained. Previously, this was a well-frequented overnight campsite, but over the last few years the focus has been more on long-term campers.

Swimming pool with sliding roof

The swimming pool can be fully covered and heated, but is mostly open in summer. The children's pool is properly separated from the deeper end. The swimming pool is located next to the terrace of the restaurant. You can go to the beach (only a few km) by bicycle or by car. Special feature: option to rent e-bikes on the campsite.

Choose a hamburger

The restaurant has a comprehensive menu, their speciality is a large variety of hamburgers. In high season it is best to make a booking, as it can be very busy.

properties.name: Camping Champ la Chèvre
properties.description:
Campsite Champ la Chèvre is located in the Drôme, about 200 metres from the village of Lus-la-Croix-Haute. The location is beautiful: an alpine meadow amidst high mountains where nearly all of the campsites have a beautiful view. The campsite is an oasis of peace with a small heated swimming pool with a retractable roof. Guests staying here are mostly sporty campers who want to enjoy the surrounding mountain environment.

Comfort in nature

Upon arrival you will see immediately how extensive the property is. The spacious, grassed and flat campsites are laid out on terraces and offer beautiful views of the surrounding mountain peaks. All sites have electricity and there are taps in several locations on the grounds. There are also facilities for camper guests.

In the middle of the property there are three well maintained sanitation buildings, one with family cabins and a bathroom for babies. There are various types of accommodation to rent, varying from simple tents without a bathroom to more luxurious mobile homes and wooden chalets with their own sanitation.

Family campsite

Champ la Chèvre is a typical family campsite. The children can swim in the heated pool with a kiddie pool and jacuzzi. In July and August there is an activity programme with drawing, crafts and games. For parents and children free guided tours are organised to explore the region. You can eat out with the family on the charming terrace of the restaurant with regional specialities. There is also a pizzeria on the campsite.

Discover the Drôme

In the hilly landscape with many vineyards, lavender fields and charming villages, there is plenty to enjoy during a walk, cycling tour or drive.

properties.name: Camping Les Rives de l'Ardèche
properties.description:
Camping Les Rives de l’Ardèche is located on the banks of the Ardèche river in the French department with the same name. The surroundings are quiet and green, inviting you to explore the countryside. The campsite has a restaurant and a playground. In particular, the river, which flows behind the campsite, is the source of much entertainment. Go swimming, kayaking or fishing. The river is ideal for fly fishing and holds a lot of trout.

Luxurious mobile home or gypsy wagon

Les Rives de l’Ardèche, a terraced campsite, has well-kept grassy pitches. You can also choose to stay in an accommodation. Stay in a mobile home with its own toilet and washing facilities and kitchen, surrounded by trees. Or choose a luxury safari tent with its own toilet and washing facilities or a basic safari tent with sleeping accommodation only. Staying overnight in a wooden gypsy wagon is already a unique experience.

Order fresh rolls and cakes every day at the reception. There is also a small shop with basic products and regional delicacies such as jam and local wine. A wooden chalet at the campsite houses a library and games room – ideal for when the weather is bad.

Swimming in the river

Camping Les Rives de l’Ardèche is right by the famous river, which flows behind the campsite. The river with its pebbled banks is the perfect place to cool off on a hot summer’s day. The water is crystal clear and cool because the source of the river is only ten kilometres upstream. There is plenty of room along the banks of the water to sit and enjoy the beautiful surroundings.

properties.name: Camping Huttopia Le Moulin
properties.description:
At the beginning of the village of Saint-Martin-d‘Ardèche, just 200 metres from the centre, you can find the Huttopia Le Moulin campsite. Here you can camp on large, shady spots. The campsite features around 200 spots, over half of which have touring pitches. The rented accommodations feature caravans, including static caravans, and various types of tents from standard to luxury.

The heated swimming pool is popular, and the entertainment team does everything they can to delight young and old alike. The surrounding area is home to beautiful cities (Orange, Avignon) and natural sites (Pont d’Arc).

Everything in its place

The campsite is made up of three parts. There is a special part for tents and smaller caravans. There is also a separate section for tunnel tents and larger model caravans. It is also possible to camp on the edge of the site, without electricity. You are, of course, very welcome at Camping Le Moulin with your own camping equipment, but there are also several caravans, static caravans and tents for hire. You can hire a tent for 4 or 5 people and you have the choice of tent with or without its own sanitary facilities.

Entertainment for the whole family

Nobody will find themselves bored at Huttopia Le Moulin. The heated outdoor swimming pool (170m2), with separate toddler area, is a great place for cooling off on a summer day. If you're someone who prefers natural water, walk from the campsite to the Ardèche beach. This river is ideal for light swimming or paddling a canoe or kayak. Real daredevils can also go whitewater rafting.

properties.name: Camping Seasonova le Domaine Saâne et mer
properties.description:
Discover Camping Seasonova le Domaine Saâne et mer, located in Quiberville-sur-Mer on the Normandy coast. Surrounded by the beauty of the River Saâne and the glistening water of the sea, this campsite offers amazing views of the Saâne Valley. Whether you come as a couple, family or solo traveller, here you will find the perfect balance between relaxation and adventure, with the calming sound of the waves in the background.

Modern conveniences

This modern campsite by the sea in Normandy opened its doors in 2034 and has all the comforts you could wish for. Choose from comfortable camping pitches for motorhomes, caravans or tents, or stay in one of the environmentally friendly hire accommodation.

Activities for everyone

The heated outdoor swimming pool with loungers is a wonderful place to cool down. Or show your competitive side on the jeu de boules courts and the football pitch. Children can have fun playing safely in the spacious playground with swings and slides. The pebble beach is only a kilometre away, ideal for a day by the sea. For those who like fish, there is a fresh fish market by the campsite every morning.

Explore the surrounding area

The Normandy coast enchants with its impressive cliffs and idyllic beaches. In Étretat, you can admire the Cliff of Aval and its spectacular arch. Dieppe, a charming coastal town with a rich history and culinary highlights, is about 16 kilometres away. Explore the lively port, sample fresh sea food and admire the view of the English coastline.

properties.name: Camping Les Cochards Onlycamp
properties.description:
This campsite is located in a wonderfully tranquil spot on the banks of the River Cher in the beautiful Loire Valley, close to the famous ZooParc de Beauval (Beauval Zoo). It lies on the outskirts of the charming village of Saint-Aignan, where you will find one of the many distinctive castles characteristic of this region. Les Cochards Campsite offers a heated outdoor swimming pool, a snack bar and very spacious touring pitches.

Neat grounds with spacious touring pitches

Les Cochards Campsite has very spacious camping pitches. These are typically demarcated by natural features. Some pitches are right on the river. The campsite is also suitable for bigger caravans and motorhomes. There is even a service area for motorhomes. You'll also find various rental accommodations spread across the well-kept grounds, such as mobile homes and Coco Sweet tents.

Lovely outdoor pool with sun and shade spots all around

At the edge of the campsite you will find a beautiful outdoor swimming pool. Enjoy swimming in the heated water in this playfully shaped pool. It is surrounded by a terrace with sun loungers and parasols. Numerous trees around the pool provide the necessary shade. Do you prefer swimming in natural waters? You can do so in the beautiful recreational lake on the other side of the river. You can also enjoy all sorts of water sports activities there. Outside of the pool, campers can also have fun on the playground and in the recreation room throughout the season. You can enjoy playing table football or a board game in the rec room.

properties.name: Camping Huttopia Étang de Fouché
properties.description:
Huttopia Etang de Fouché campsite is a child-friendly campsite in the heart of Burgundy. The campsite is situated on a large recreational lake, a great place for swimming and fishing, but also for walking around. Burgundy is a true walking and cycling paradise. And a trip to the capital Dijon is also well worth it.

Touring pitches and lodge tents

There are around 160 spacious touring pitches on the green campsite. Some pitches are situated between the trees, others are slightly more open. Separated from the touring pitches are the rental accommodation. You can choose from modern and comfortable lodge tents and chalets, gypsy caravans or mobile homes. The lodge tents and chalets are new.

Children's pool

Although there are few facilities for children (the playground on the campsite is not too big), the campsite is still nice for the smaller camper. This is mainly because of the swimming pool and the lake. The swimming pool has a shallow area with a fountain, especially for toddlers, and a slightly deeper area for older children.

Etang Fouché: a large recreational lake

For adults the bath is slightly less suitable, but fortunately the campsite is situated next to a large recreational lake: the Etang Fouché. Around the lake there are several beaches, from where you can enter the water. The lake is also child-friendly: there is a large water slide, you can hire paddleboards and there is a swimming area with supervision by lifeguards. If you prefer to stay dry, but prefer to sit by the water, there are plenty of places where you can fish. A quiet evening walk along the lake is also lovely.

properties.name: Camping Au Bon Endroit
properties.description:
Camping Au Bon Endroit is a spacious and quiet campground. The campground is located in a park with high trees within walking distance of the small provincial town of Paray-le-Monial. This pilgrimage destination is located in the wine region of South Burgundy between Digoin and Charolles, an area where you can take wonderful bike rides. The quiet campground in the park has well maintained sites.

You have the choice of spacious campsites with fences. You'll have plenty of shade under the old high trees. You'll camp on grass in the open field. A fenced off site with a little shade is also one of the options. There are fully furnished chalets for hire. Campers are welcome.

Take a dip

The owner will ensure a pleasant stay and will give you tips about the surrounding area. There is a swimming pool with parasols and a kiddie pool at the reception. In the high season, you can have a drink in the bar or in the shade on the small terrace. For campers who like fresh bread for breakfast, there is the breakfast servivce.

The sanitary facilities are simple. The three complexes are located a short distance from the campsites.

Quiet

The quiet campground attracts primarily seniors, families with young children and cyclists. Small children can play in the kiddie pool and on a few playground items. Want to be active on the campground? Then play a round of table tennis or use the jeu-de-boules pitch or the sports field.

properties.name: Camping Château Le Verdoyer
properties.description:
Camping under the watchful eye of a stylish castle, it's possible in the Dordogne! Camping Château Le Verdoyer adjoins the domain of the castle of the same name in the wooded countryside around the village of Champs-Romain. The terraces on the fancy campsite are shaded by trees and offer - on the edge of the site - a beautiful view of woods, ponds and fields. Take a dip in the swimming pool and eat in the castle's restaurant.

A wooded nature reserve with a view

On the campsite there are over 100 touring pitches and 75 rental accommodations (mainly chalets and mobile homes, but also some lodge tents) in a beautiful wooded nature reserve. The jagged terrain, which is built up from terraces, is completely surrounded by ponds, woods and lawns. As a result, the pitches at the edges have beautiful views. The central pitches are nice and shady.

Swimming at the castle

There is plenty to do for young and old at camping Château Le Verdoyer. Swimming for example: the campsite has several swimming pools. The outdoor pool is the most beautiful. You can swim and play with a view of the castle. If the weather is not so good, you can go to the indoor swimming pool.

Fashion shows and musical evenings

Theme weeks, musical evenings and children's shows: in the summer months there is something going on at the campsite every week. For example, you can enjoy a drink in the restaurant while enjoying an acoustic performance. And your children can take part in the playback and/or fashion shows. After eleven o'clock in the evening it's almost always quiet again on the campsite.

properties.name: Sites & Paysages De Martinière
properties.description:
Camping De Martinière is located in the Isère, in the heart of the Chartreuse Massif. The campsite offers an exceptional view of the surrounding Alpine peaks. The spacious pitches are laid out on meadows of an old Carthusian farm. The comfortable wash room has given the century-old farm a new lease of life. The wood and utensils of olden days make for a lovely ambiance in 'l'Atelier' (a bar/restaurant). Children will thoroughly enjoy themselves with the heated swimming pool, the play equipment and activities.

Experiencing nature

The small-scale family campsite De Martinière has been established with respect for nature and is lovingly managed. The grounds are in a magnificent setting with the old, renovated monastery farm building. Over the years the owners have worked the fields and improved them with indigenous trees, shrubs, hedges and plants. The spacious and shady pitches are located on both sides of the farm, some with ample privacy.

Mountain huts

The rental accommodation is very special, mobile homes in harmony with nature and environment. There are also basic tents on wooden stilts with a terrace. They have a real bed, two chairs, a dining area and electricity. The lodge huts are also very tasteful, beautifully executed in wood with a large covered terrace. The three wooden chalets are inspired by the mountain huts of the shepherds and have been constructed with environment-friendly material. The furniture was especially designed for the chalets.

Games and mountain sports

Children will enjoy themselves in the heated swimming pool with toddler's pool and the small playground. Also fun: the trampoline, bouncing cushions and jeu-de-boule pitch. In high season there are organised activities (biathlon, treasure hunts, story evenings and cheese and wine tastings).

properties.name: Vakantiepark 'La Draille'
properties.description:
Holiday Park 'La Draille' is located on the border of the Dordogne and Lot, in a hilly nature reserve. You'll find the campsite in the green valley of the river Borrèze, where you camp in peace on shady touring pitches. Holiday park 'La Draille' is a Christian campsite; campers can go to church services and sing-ins every week.

Camping at the Borrèze

On the natural campsite, surrounded by hills, there are 146 touring pitches. These spacious pitches are situated between laurel bushes and in the shade of numerous trees that colour the valley of the Borrèze. There are also spots to choose from along the river itself. The terrain lies against the hillside and slopes slightly upwards. Some camping pitches and rental accommodations are situated on higher terraces. The range of holiday homes is extensive: choose from various types of mobile homes and chalets.

Children playing

Walk in a parade with Chinese lanterns over the campsite, slidie down the soap slide or sit together around the campfire: in the summer months there is a lot to do at 'La Draille' Holiday Park. Especially for children, who can take part in sports tournaments or discover all the playing possibilities on their own. Playgrounds, a bouncy castle, a cable way and various 'chill places'. They will find something to do everywhere. And then there's also a large, rectangular swimming pool.

Chez Nous

Chez Nous is the campsite's charming restaurant. The interior of the restaurant is attractive, but sitting on the pavement café is especially beautiful. Under large grape vines you can taste wine and enjoy a delicious dinner.

properties.name: Camping Les Bois du Bardelet
properties.description:
Camping Les Bois du Bardelet lies in a charming landscape, a few km from the town of Poilly-lez-Gien. In this tranquil area between lakes and forests you can enjoy a family holiday amidst nature. With the lakes surrounding you, ideal for fishing or canoeing, the campsite offers you the comfort of a five-star campsite. Enjoy an excellent restaurant, a shop, an outdoor swimming pool and an indoor water playground. This will ensure that even the tiny tots have plenty of water fun throughout the season!

Comfortable rental accommodation

The campsite pitches are generous in size. In addition to the usual mobile homes on the campsite grounds and the chalets near a recreation pond, at Camping Les Bois du Bardelet you can also rent one of the attractive gîtes by the fishing pond. These will accommodate four to six persons and are equipped with all amenities.

Recreational pond, sandy beach and swimming pool

In addition to the fishing pond, there is also a recreational pond on the campsite. There are chalets on one side of this pond and a sandy beach with sunbathing lawn on the other side. There you will also find a nice swimming pool for children with a water playground. Furthermore, there is an indoor swimming pool with jacuzzi. The campsite also offers an extensive entertainment programme for children. 

Good restaurant

Adjacent to the reception you will find the restaurant, where you can enjoy an excellent meal. The meals can also be taken away. If required, you can book a half board package at a very reasonable price. During the day you can get snacks here. The tennis court is located next to the restaurant. Ideal to shed those few extra pounds.....

properties.name: Camping La Citadelle
properties.description:
Within walking distance of the centre of the historic town of Loches, on the banks of the Indre river, you'll find the charming campsite La Citadelle. This natural campsite is ideal for a relaxed holiday with the entire family. Kids will have plenty of fun at La Citadelle with the lovely playground. Behind the city walls of Loches there are a mishmash of medieval streets. Twice a week there is a market with lovely regional products. Certainly try the special goat's cheese and the tender chicken.

Green pitches

The pitches are located on separate fields and partially separated from each other with plants. The pitches are spacious and some have their own sanitation facilities and a kitchenette for an extra fee. How convenient! In total you can choose from four different categories, from simple to "Gold". You always have a sunny lawn with plenty of privacy.

Accommodations in all shapes and sizes

The rental accommodations also fall into four categories, from relatively simple Coco Sweets (two to four persons) and two person huts to mobile homes with two bedrooms, your own terrace and complete furnishings. The largest accommodation is the "Grand Espace" (four bedrooms). In short, plenty of choice.

Entertainment

Children can play in the play area or take a dip in the covered pool, renovated in 2017, with their parents. In the summer there are plenty of activities for the whole family.

Fresh rolls and croissants

The camping shop has the daily necessities, such as fresh rolls and croissants The restaurant (with bar and terrace) serves pizzas and has a small menu.

properties.name: wecamp Campismo S. Miguel
properties.description:
Campismo S. Miguel is in the popular holiday region of the Algarve on the west coast of Portugal. The closest beach is only 4 kilometres away, making this campsite the ideal home base for a Portuguese beach holiday. The campsite has a large outdoor swimming pool, a restaurant with terrace and a supermarket where daily shopping can be done.

Green campsite in Portugal

Campismo S. Miguel has a sandy surface. The pitches are spacious and nicely laid out. The site has plenty of trees, making the area green and shady. Holidaymakers without their own camping equipment can rent a chalet or a safari tent. The rental accommodations are in a different section than the pitches. The chalets are among the pine trees, all have their own terrace with garden furniture and a hammock. The tents are equipped with a bed, bed linen and electricity.

Will you choose the sea or the swimming pool?

For a refreshing swim, go to the beach, which is only a ten-minute drive from the campsite. You can choose from several wonderful sandy beaches and enjoy the impressive rocky coast of the Algarve. You can also stay at the campsite for a refreshing swim in the large outdoor swimming pool.

Nature and history in the Algarve

The coast of the Algarve is beautiful with impressive rock formations that alternate with vast sandy beaches. The nearest village is Odeceixe (2.5 km), where there are several shops and charming restaurants. The lovely city of Lagos (50 km) is about an hour’s drive away, With many cafes and restaurants and a relaxed atmosphere.

properties.name: Camping Les Flots-Atlantique Villages
properties.description:
Camping on the second largest island of France? Then you should go and visit Île d’Oléron. Camping Les Flots-Atlantique (formerly known as La Perroche Plage) is only a stone's throw away from Saint-Pierre-d’Oléron and the beach is nearby. Water sports enthusiasts are at the right place here, but families with small children will also feel at home. When you camp on Île d’Oléron, a visit to the colourful oyster huts in the vicinity of Le Chateau d’Oléron is definitely a must.

Upon arrival, you can see at a glance that the campsite has a large number of trees and shaded pitches. On the grass and under the trees you will find spacious, beautiful pitches to put up your tent or caravan.

Direct access to the beach

You can reach the beach via a footpath at the far end of the camping. This beach has quite a few rocks, but also sand. It is advisable to bring aqua shoes when you visit this campsite. In the Bay of La Perroche, 200 m from the camping, there is ample opportunity for water sports such as windsurfing, sailing and snorkelling. Do you have your own boat? Do not hesitate to bring it, as there is a jetty to moor your boat.

Child-friendly

Camping Les Flots-Atlantique is a moderately-sized campsite so that it is easy to maintain an overview. Parents can, therefore, let their children play on the camping without having to worry. Directly behind the reception is a large, enclosed playground where children can enjoy themselves. A bit further on you will find some sun loungers. A great place to relax while the children romp around in the playground.

properties.name: Camping Saint-Paul
properties.description:
In the heart of one of the most beautiful beech forests of France you will find Camping Saint-Paul. This is a great base from which to explore Normandy. Especially for nature lovers. You can start such an excursion virtually from your doorstep, in bustling Lyons-la Fôret, hailed as one of the most beautiful villages in France.

Spacious camping

The campsite looks peaceful and tranquil and has lovely, generous pitches. These are distributed over a flat terrain on the bank of the La Lieure river, a tributary of the Seine. All pitches are surrounded by bushes and hedges which provide a certain degree of privacy. Furthermore, all pitches have their own parking space. Campsite Saint-Paul also has a fair amount of rental accommodation, such as fully equipped chalets, mobile homes and tents. 

Swimming fun

Adjacent to the campsite, some 200 m further along, is a communal swimming pool with retractable roof. Camping guests may make free use of this. You can also play mini golf for a fee. A rainy day? Go to the recreation area (with table football game and television). There are also two play areas for children. 

Sports entertainment

Furthermore, the campsite has a pétanque pitch as well as possibilities for volleyball, badminton and table tennis. There is also a large field for soccer tournaments. In the high season, Saint-Paul organises dance evenings, treasure hunts and pétanque competitions. La Lieure offers a nice challenge for anglers, but is prohibited for bathers.

Chips plus plus

Saint-Paul has a bar during the high season. Here you can buy chips, snacks, quiches and ice cream. Take-away meals are also available. At the reception you can only buy a few basic necessities. In nearby Lyons-la Fôret you will find a few shops.

properties.name: Camping Le Plein Air des Bories
properties.description:
Camping Le Plein Air des Bories is located on the banks of the river Dordogne, in the Périgord Noir. The family campsite for a quiet holiday in a very touristy area. You are surrounded by castles, caves and medieval villages like Sarlat-la-Canéda. Take a dip in the Dordogne or discover the river by canoe. And is the weather unexpectedly a little less? Then you can swim in the swimming pool, covered with a sliding roof.

Welcome!

eave the A20 motorway at Souillac and drive into the Dordogne valley. Camping Le Plein Air des Bories is located near the village of Carsac-Aillac, about ten kilometres below the town of Sarlat-la-Canéda. Driving from that village to the banks of the Dordogne will take you to a sparsely populated rural area. That's where the campsite is located.

Camping on the banks of the Dordogne

The camping fields with spacious touring pitches are alternated with rental accommodations. Many pitches are delimited by hedges or shrubs and are sheltered by trees. The most beautiful pitches are located directly by the river. The Dordogne has lovely swimming water and stays shallow on the banks for a long time. So if you are on holiday with small children, they can safely (but under supervision) swim in the river. There is also a swimming pool on the campsite. When it rains, the sliding roof closes.

Entertainment

For the little ones there is an entertainment programme during the summer months. Enjoy paella evenings and barbecues at the bar, the place to be also for karaoke and dancing. If you want to go out for dinner or do some shopping, Carsac-Aillac is a great destination.

properties.name: Slow Village Anduze
properties.description:
Between two riverbeds of the river Gardon, sheltered by the mountains of the Cevennes, you’ll find family campsite Inspire Villages Anduze. The spacious touring pitches are close to the river or in the hills, from where you have a beautiful view. At the child-friendly campsite, children can have fun in the playground or on the river, which, with its rock formations and wooded banks, has different characters.

Spacious campsite with microclimate

Due to its sheltered location between the hills, the campsite has a microclimate. This means you can camp amidst over 140 species of trees and plants. The campsite, hilly in character, is very spacious. Both on the open terrain at the river and in the wooded hills are spacious touring pitches. From the higher situated pitches you have a beautiful panoramic view. In addition to the almost 230 touring pitches, there are 16 rental accommodations. These chalets are freely situated on the hilltop and offer that same beautiful view.

Family campsite for nature lovers

The campsite is very child friendly. A large part of the camping public therefore consists of families with children. Young children can play in the large playground. In summer, pottery workshops, pony rides and archery courses are organised. These are also fun for adults.

Homemade desserts and fresh produce

The restaurant is at the front of the campsite. Here Isabelle is in charge of the kitchen. In addition to salads, she also prepares grills, desserts and ice creams. In the small supermarket she sells fresh products from the region: jams, honey, wines and olive oil. Next to the restaurant is a large covered pavement café and a beautiful outdoor sidewalk café where you can sit quietly in the shade of the tall trees.

properties.name: Slow Village La Roque-sur-Cèze
properties.description:
The charming, terraced campsite Slow Village La Roque-sur-Cèze is located in Vallée de la Cèze, a lush region in France that has yet to become popular with most tourists. Here you'll be camping on spacious pitches that can be either sunny or shaded. The sanitary facilities are of exceptional quality. With a wonderful swimming pool, the Cèze within walking distance and an extensive activity programme, there is plenty to enjoy at the campsite. Not to mention a restaurant with delicious pizzas and snacks.

A wide range of camping options

Slow Village La Roque-sur-Cèze is well maintained and organised. You have a wide range of camping pitches to choose from, which vary in size and surface type. The standard pitch is about 100 m2, but the deluxe pitches (Grand Confort) are up to 120 m2 in size. These pitches also come with an additional perk: private sanitary facilities. Some of the pitches feature a beautiful view. 

Handy tractor service

For those having trouble getting their caravans or trailers to the top, the campsite offers a handy tractor service. Don't have camping equipment? If not, you can rent a tent, mobile home, chalet or glamping accommodation. For example, the Royal Lodge is a luxury designer tent that is as comfortable as can be.

Swimming pool with terrace

The swimming pool (130 m2) is located at the bottom of the campsite. There is a charming terrace next to it. There is a separate baby/children's pool for the little ones as well. The kids will love the 12 m long slide. The artificial beach next to the pool has comfortable loungers. 

Other activities on the campsite take place on the all-purpose athletic field: you can play a game of tennis, beach volleyball, petanque, soccer or table tennis. Children can head for the playground, attend the mini club or participate in the activity programme. Don't worry, there's plenty for the adults to do, too. The campsite organises activities such as hikes and canoe trips.

properties.name: Camping Ria de Arosa 2 (Rural)
properties.description:
This beautiful and quiet campsite is situated in a relatively unknown, but magnificent nature area in north-western Spain. Galicia is being discovered by an increasing number of campers. Camping Ria de Arosa 2 (Rural) is situated in the green Barbanza peninsula and has everything you need for a very special camping holiday.

You are camping here in the Spanish countryside with a lot of space around you. Less than 10 km away you will find the most glorious beaches and an exceptional dune landscape. This area, slightly north of the charming fishing village of Ribeira, is eminently suitable for short and long walking trips. The world-famous pilgrimage destination Santiago de Compostela is less than an hour's drive away from the campsite.

Nice atmosphere

The campsite may be slightly isolated, but you can find everything you need on the grounds. Adjacent to the two swimming pools is a terrace which forms part of the Cascada restaurant, where they like to treat you to local dishes. It is a lovely spot to enjoy the calm and the view. Children will enjoy themselves in the playground, on the trampoline or on the back of a pony.

Towering dunes

The National Park Currubedo: this is a spot that warrants a visit from everyone in this region. Amidst the quiet sand looms a 15 m high dune up with a length of no less than a thousand metres. The beautiful beach can be accessed from the visitor's centre. There is also a wooden walkway which leads you past the most beautiful spots in this exceptional piece of nature.

properties.name: Camping Municipal Le Braou
properties.description:
The region to the south-west of Bordeaux is famed for its wonderful nature and lovely climate. Pine trees, the ocean and the coastal area with its wonderful bays and lakes characterise this area. Camping Le Braou is near the town of Audenge, on the bay of Arcachon. You are camping here in the heart of the Regional National Park, Les Landes de Gascogne. The fabulous surroundings are best explored by bicycle.

Camping amidst green

The varied vegetation of flowers, shrubs, coniferous and deciduous trees gives the terrain a pleasant atmosphere. The pitches are at a reasonable distance from each other between the trees and bushes. These generally provide the necessary shade. A range of accommodation is available to hire on site, from chalets to caravans and mobile homes. 

Please note that trailers on the pitch are subject to a charge.

A lovely swimming pool

The medium-sized swimming pool is in a central location on the campsite and is surrounded by lovely bushes and trees. A tiled terrace stretches around the basin, where loungers are ready and waiting for you. You can also find a shallow kid's pool. A restaurant with a limited menu is situated beside the swimming pool. There is also a shop with fresh bread and more. You will have to head to the supermarket for groceries. It's just a short walk away (one kilometre).

Entertainment

The campsite offers entertainment for young and old alike in the high season. You can take part in an aqua gym or participate in the gymnastics programme in one of the tents next to the swimming pool. A snack bar can be found in the wooden shack. All types of entertainment can be found in the evenings during the high season, from bingo and games evenings to cabaret and theatre.

properties.name: Camping Le Lac ô Fées
properties.description:
Enjoy a holiday in a peaceful environment, surrounded by nature? If so, Camping Le Lac ô Fées in Priziac in Morbihan (Brittany) is a must. Here you camp by a beautiful recreational lake, where the campsite has its own sandy beach, and in green surroundings with many hiking trails. This eco-friendly campsite includes a water sports centre, a very good restaurant, a shop and interesting accommodation.

Large pitches and special accommodation

At this small-scale campsite, unpaved paths lead to the well-maintained pitches. There is also accommodation for rent, including modern mobile homes and luxury safari tents. These are spaced far apart and on large plots, giving you plenty of space and privacy. Fancy a really special experience? Then book a stay in the mysterious fairy hut or the magical alchemist's dome.

Water sports, entertainment and Breton specialities

A big bonus of this campsite is its location on the recreational lake Lac du Bel-air. From the private sandy beach, take a refreshing dip in this little lake. The site also houses a water sports centre where you can rent pedalos, canoes and stand-up paddles. Particularly in high season, there’s a lively atmosphere at this campsite. Craft hours, sports competitions and nature activities are then organised for children. Themed evenings, often accompanied by live music performances, provide fun for the whole family. A meal at La Tavarn Ar Farfadet restaurant is an excellent way to end the day.

properties.name: Slow Village Les Ponts-de-Cé
properties.description:
Slow Village les Ponts-de-Cé is a spacious campsite in the green surroundings of Les Ponts-de-Cé, a village just below Angers. Les Ponts-de-Cé is located on an island in the Loire River. You can easily walk to the village from the campsite. Take a dip in the pool, go canoeing or throw a ball on the bocce court. At the entrance to the campsite is a fine restaurant with a terrace.

Camping with space and shade

The pitches at this campsite vary in size, which creates a playful appearance. There is plenty of shade in many places, especially in the orchard.

Those who come without a tent, trailer tent, caravan or campervan can stay in one of the bivouac tents or bungalow lodges. These have all been given a beautiful place in nature.

There is water fun for the entire family

Just outside the campsite is a large outdoor pool. The pool is surrounded by trees. The water slide and the paddling pool provide entertainment for children small and large. Next to the pool, you will find a lovely sunbathing area. Of course, the Loire is also a source of pleasure. Cast out a fishing line or hop in a canoe!

Entertainment on dry land is also available. For example, there is some playground equipment, and you can throw a ball on the bocce courts. The recreation room features slot machines and a television. There is no entertainment programme.

properties.name: Camping Mirabel La Renaudière
properties.description:
This family campsite on the French Jade Coast is within walking distance of Pornic's beaches. Large pitches, comfortable accommodation and a large water park with indoor and outdoor pools make this a great campsite for young and old. Thanks to its central location, you can easily discover the Pays de Retz from here, with charming coastal villages, walking trails, nature reserves and towns like St. Nazaire and Nantes.

Shady family campsite

Camping Mirabel La Renaudière is a real family campsite with a good mix of pitches and permanent accommodation. The pitches vary in size from 80 to 120 m2. On the large pitch field, there are plenty of trees to provide pleasant, shady spots. You choose the pitch you prefer. There’s a wide choice of rental accommodation too. Ranging from a simple studio for two people without a toilet and washing facilities to a fully-equipped mobile home for 6 people.

Water fun in any season

The large water park and sports and games facilities catch your eye straight away when you drive onto the campsite. Both the indoor and outdoor pools are heated, so you can enjoy the water whatever the season. There are four slides, hydromassage benches and a paddling pool. Around the pool, there are sun loungers to relax on in good weather. In the summer, the entertainment team organises water fun too.

Prepare to be surprised in Pays de Retz

You'll camp in the Pays de Retz, between South Brittany and the Vendée, near the mouth of the Loire. Visit port town of St. Nazaire (26 km) and its impressive shipyards.

properties.name: Camping Montorfano
properties.description:
Montorfano Campsite is a large yet cosy Italian campsite. You'll be camping in the Como region, ten kilometres from the famous Lake Como. Lake Montorfano is even closer. Dive into the clear natural waters to enjoy that real holiday experience in Italy. You can also splash around in the beautiful swimming pool at the campsite itself. The kids will have a great time doing this as well! The trees and hedges surrounding your camping pitch will afford you plenty of privacy.

Lombardy Lake District

Montorfano Campsite is located in the middle of the lakes. Lake Como is the largest and most famous lake in the Italian Lombardy region. But there are more bodies of water in this region just below Switzerland. Lake Montorfano, for example, near the town of the same name. The campsite is located on the outskirts of this area. A long lane leads you to the cosy reception building. There you'll be welcomed with open arms.

Camping in privacy

Despite Montorfano Campsite's large size, you'll have no trouble finding peace and quiet here. If you want it, that is. There is always a pitch offering plenty of privacy among the trees and hedges. But there are also open spaces on beautifully maintained lawns. Thus, there is a pitch to suit every camper's needs.

Child-friendly campsite

Attention children: for an unforgettable holiday, go to Montorfano Campsite. Here you'll make new holiday friends while playing on the playgrounds and the sports fields. The entertainment program helps make this campsite especially child-friendly. Your little ones can participate in fun activities every week throughout the summer. You can also enjoy peace of mind when leaving your littlest camper at the baby club.

properties.name: Camping La Quercia
properties.description:
Camping La Quercia in Lazise is situated right on the shores of Lake Garda and boasts its own sandy beach covering no less than 6,500 m². The campsite features a large swimming pool with water slides, a lush park full of mature trees, and a strong focus on sustainability. Since 1958, the Russo family has been welcoming guests who appreciate the spaciousness and relaxed atmosphere of the lakeside.

Camping with respect for nature

You will be camping on a 20-hectare site with over 2,800 trees, including a 400-year-old oak tree that gave the campsite its name. The pitches and mobile homes are scattered throughout the park, so you’re always surrounded by greenery. Camping La Quercia has a strong commitment to environmentally friendly management. For example, the campsite uses a hundred per cent electricity from renewable sources and has solar panels on several buildings. Rainwater is collected for watering the park, and smart systems ensure water savings in the sanitary facilities and at the swimming pools. The site is largely car-free, and staff use electric vehicles to get around.

Swimming pool, entertainment and beach at Lake Garda

The swimming pool complex features three pools, including an Olympic-sized pool, a splash park for younger guests and thrilling water slides. There is entertainment for children and teenagers, sports tournaments and evening shows on a large stage.

The restaurant and the Tiki Beach Bar overlook the lake. The campsite’s beach is the largest sandy beach on Lake Garda. Fancy a bit of exercise? Explore the lake by canoe or go windsurfing!

properties.name: Camping Oldevatn
properties.description:
Camping Oldevatn is a fairy tale that begins even before you get there. It's beautifully situated with views of Lake Oldevatnet and the fjords, and the facilities on the campsite are also of a high quality. Make free use of the rowing boats and other possibilities for endless fun on the water. The natural environment invites you to engage in fun activities such as taking day trips and hiking.

Converted Norwegian farmstead

The campsite is situated on the grounds of a former farmstead. The red cabins (summer homes) fit perfectly into the fjord landscape. The campsite is well-organised, and everything works as it should. The pitches are spacious and many pitches have views of the lake in which the mountaintops are reflected. There are also cabins available for rent (renovated in 2017). The campsite is suitable for all ages: both young and old are well catered for. Despite the many facilities catering to children, the campsite is, for the most part, peaceful and quiet.

Pets are allowed for campers with their own camping equipment but are not allowed in the cabins for hygiene reasons.

Canoeing, fishing and barbecuing

The campsite is situated directly on the edge of the lake, and there's all sorts of water equipment available, which can be used for free. You can also make free use of the picnic tables and barbecue areas. There is a large campfire by the lake where guests can cook or relax. You can go fishing in the lake for trout and eels. Equipment can be bought at the reception. A playing area of 600 m2 has recently been added. Children can play to their heart's content on the water trampoline or in the canoes and rowing boats, and on the water bikes and surfboards.

Well-maintained

There is a shop with a limited range of groceries. You can order fresh bread and rolls every morning. The sanitary facilities are new, clean and well-maintained. There are no computers available at the reception, but the entire campsite has access to a high-speed WiFi connection.

Glaciers and fjords

The prime attraction of this campsite is its magnificent location in the midst of the Norwegian fjord landscape. It is also an excellent starting point from which to explore the Kjenndalen and Briksdal glaciers. The campsite is just a 10 to 15-minute drive from Via Ferrate Loen, a wonderful place to go climbing. The spectacular Skylift is also nearby. Guests interested in guided tours or other activities can request more information at the reception.

properties.name: Camping Les Cigales - Ciela Village
properties.description:
This wooded campsite lies on the outskirts of the quaint French village of Rocamadour. You can easily walk to the sacred sites of the old city from the Les Cigales Campsite. Or would you like to see the free-roaming monkeys in La Forêt des Singes? You will never be short of things to do when staying at this campsite. It is always nice to take a dip in the outdoor pool. You can also relax on the bubble hydrotherapy bench in the covered indoor pool. Even the littlest swimmers have been thought of. You will find paddling pools both inside and outside.

A beautiful spot in Rocamadour

Les Cigales Campsite is located in a beautiful spot: on the outskirts of Rocamadour, France. This town is built atop rocky cliffs in the wooded region of Lot. The old town is quite touristy - and rightly so given its extreme beauty. But you will be camping just outside of that area in a quiet location among the woods. Directly across from the campsite is La Forêt des Singes. This primate forest is teeming with friendly, free-roaming macaques. Perfect for a first outing together with the kids.

Shaded camping pitches

At Les Cigales Campsite, nature is given free reign. Within certain limits, of course, as the campsite is very well maintained. Just don't expect to see neatly trimmed hedges. The grounds, however, are full of old trees and beautiful plants. These help demarcate the spacious pitches. You can set up your caravan, camper or tent under one of the trees. A shady pitch is a wonderful place to spend your holiday.

properties.name: Camping Le Caussanel - Ciela Village
properties.description:
Camping Le Caussanel is situated directly on the shores of Lac de Pareloup, in the Aveyron region. At this family campsite, children will have a great time: in the swimming pool with its large slides, on one of the sports fields or in the playground by the lake. The open campsite is stretched out along the Lac de Pareloup.

View over the lake

The campsite Le Caussanel has a very open character. The lake also contributes to this: from your pitch you have a panoramic view over the vast water. Some pitches are right on the water's edge, others are a little further away. But all have a view of the lake.

Swimming in the sun

Behind the central stone buildings lies the swimming complex. It has a large paddling pool, large slides and a pool for swimming laps. Around the pools you will find several sun loungers. The lake is also a great place to sunbathe. When the water is low, you can lie on a sandy beach. When the tide is higher, you can use the large lawn. The water gets deeper gradually, which is ideal for small children.

Sports and games

As soon as you enter the campsite, you can see them: the sports fields. Ideal for an hour of sweating on the tennis court, the multi-sports field (for a game of football or basketball) or the beach volleyball court. The entertainment team also organises competitions and games for the little sports fans. For a bit of action, the children can also go to the playground. The climbing castle and some other playground equipment are located on the large lawn directly at the lake.

properties.name: Camping le Lac Bleu - Ciela Village
properties.description:
Camping Le Lac Bleu is situated in the valley of the Drôme, on the southern bank of a lake. From the most beautiful spots on the flat campsite you look out over the water and the surrounding Vercors. Camp on the waterfront in a teepee or even on the water, in the special floating cabin.

Flat campsite between the mountains

There are approximately as many touring pitches on the campsite as there are permanent pitches. The pitches are spacious and offer views of the Vercors mountains. Despite the fact that you are camping in a mountainous area, the grounds of Le Lac Bleu are flat. From the most beautiful pitches you look out over the water of the lake, the central point of the campsite.

Camping on the lake

In addition to the classic mobile homes and lodge tents, there are a few special holiday homes. For example, you can camp in a teepee, which stands on stilts directly on the shore. But you can also camp on the lake. If you want ultimate piece and quiet a wooden cabin, floating on the water, is the accommodation for you! You can fish in peace from your cabin and also plunge directly into the cool water.

Indoor heated swimming pool

If the water in the lake is a little too cold for you, you can jump in the camping pool. This indoor pool is heated. Especially for the children this heated pool is pleasant. But for the younger campers who prefer to stay dry, there is also plenty to do at the campsite. The little ones have fun on the playground equipment, while there is a summer entertainment programme for campers of all ages.

properties.name: Domaine Camping Les Roches
properties.description:
Domaine Camping Les Roches is located in the hilly French region of the Ardèche Verte. This terraced campsite is on a slope and offers a beautiful view of the green surroundings and the Gorges du Doux. The Doux river, a river that is 70 kilometres long, flows at the bottom of the campsite. Domaine Camping Les Roches is ideal for campsite visitors who love to cycle and hike through the woods and past beautiful views.

Camping with a view

Domaine Camping Les Roches is a terraced campsite, which means that each pitch has a view of the valley. The pitches are spacious, all being more than 100 m², and have sufficient shade. The toilet and washing facilities have special family cabins with a shower, a chest of drawers and a baby bath. There are also larger cabins for people with restricted mobility. Pets are welcome at the campsite for a fee, but they must stay on a lead. Holidaymakers without their own camping equipment can rent a chalet or a mobile home at this campsite. All accommodations are fully furnished and have their own kitchen and private toilet and washing facilities.

Fun in the swimming pool and the river

The outdoor swimming pool with paddling pool offers hours of water fun for the entire family. Swimming and fishing is permitted in the river, which is located at the bottom of the campsite. There is a small sandy beach on banks of the water and a grassy field for relaxing. Several playgrounds, both outdoors and indoors, are available for the small campsite guests. During the high season, the entertainment team organises activities for children between the ages of 5 and 13. There is also a mini market and a campsite restaurant with a varied menu.

properties.name: Camping Huttopia De Roos
properties.description:
At Camping Huttopia De Roos you camp in the middle of the unique hilly country near Beerze-Ommen along the Overijsselse Vecht. Young and old can enjoy a holiday here filled with water fun in natural swimming water. Dive into the river from the swimming dock or let the little ones play safely in the enclosed lagoon while you keep an eye on them from the sandy beach.

An ideal campsite for families

Huttopia de Roos is a great place for everyone, but certainly for parents with young children. The camping site is located along the Vecht and a branch of the river winds through the campsite without a current. During the high season, fun free and paid activities are offered every day. Build your own kite or explore the local flora and fauna with a guide while on hikes or attend a workshop.

Choose your own ideal spot: pitches and accommodations

Will you choose to stay next to the water, among the trees, or will you choose a view of the meadow? Huttopia de Roos offers plenty of variety in accommodation and pitches. The unique accommodations are the most striking. There is the Trap Door hut and the Cahutte tent (a hut or a tent?), which is typical of Huttopia campsites.

Out and about in the area

There is much to explore in the area around Huttopia Camping de Roos! There are charming little places and beautiful nature along the Vecht, such as the Sahara d’Ommen sand drifts.
