Lovely villages like Beerze and Ommen are just a few kilometres away. For excitement, visit the Slagharen amusement park (20 km). For an adventure with the entire family, a day at Kabouterland in Exloo (60 km) comes highly recommended.

properties.name: Huttopia De Veluwe
properties.description:
At a lovely location on the Veluwe, in a densely wooded area between the villages of Harskamp and Kootwijk, lies Camping Huttopia De Veluwe. Here you wake up in the morning to the singing of the birds. There is also a good chance that a rabbit or squirrel will hop past your tent every now and then. This oasis of rest will allow you to fully recharge your batteries. There are trails all around the campsite, in landscapes that alternate between wooded areas, heathland and drifting sands. There are fun activities organised at the campsite, particularly in the summer.

Wooded campsite with only unique pitches

If you want to go back to the basics while on holiday, this campsite is highly recommended. You camp in a densely wooded area. The pitches have been adapted into the woods in a creative manner. This means that no pitch is the same and that all touring pitches provide complete privacy. Would you like to shut out the outside world entirely for just a short while? At Camping Huttopia De Veluwe, it is possible to book a pitch without electricity. Of course, there are pitches with electricity, too. Would you like a little more luxury? Then stay in a comfortable safari tent.

Enjoy the musical performances, film nights and the campfire

At Camping Huttopia De Veluwe, fun activities, such as, for example, building huts and treasure hunts, are organised regularly in the summer. Activities that are fun for the entire family are the live musical performances, the theatre and magic shows and the film evenings in the open-air cinema. They also often have fun campfire evenings and guided walking tours through the woods.

properties.name: Camping Jacobus Hoeve
properties.description:
Camping Jacobus Hoeve is located on the edge of the Veluwe, amidst several forestries and close to the De Hoge Veluwe National Park. The campsite is but a five minute cycle ride from the village of Stroe, where there is a wide range of eateries and shops. Camping here means freedom and comfort against the backdrop of the beautiful nature of the Veluwe.

An amiable campsite

Your attention is immediately drawn to the small-scale setup of the campsite. This is emphasised by the dividing hedges between the pitches. It is a perfectly organised campsite, where everything is geared towards the quintessential Dutch notion of 'gezelligheid' (conviviality). For instance, in summer there is an entertainment team, which does its utmost to please all guests. In order to camp comfortably in all weather conditions, the pitches are provided with a paved terrace. 

Versatile accommodation options 

If you are travelling without you own camping gear, but still want to enjoy the advantages of camping, you can rent several types of accommodation at Jacobus Hoeve. If you prefer luxury, you can opt for one of the comfortable chalets, suitable from two to six persons. Are you just passing through or on a cycling or hiking holiday? If so, a Tiny House trekker hut is the ideal choice for you. 

Catering facilities on the campsite

You will find the restaurant at the entrance of the campsite. Here you can choose from an extensive menu. Rather eat in your own surroundings? Many dishes can also be taken away. Near the restaurant is a friendly bar with terrace. The campsite does not have its own shop, but a few supermarkets can be found in Stroe and Voorthuizen.

properties.name: Camping Exloo
properties.description:
The Exloo campsite is located in Geopark De Hondsrug (Drenthe) and is situated on a large grassy field, where you can find an excellent location to set up shop with your camping equipment. There is a separate car park for vehicles, which ensures that the campsite is very peaceful and makes it a touch safer as well. In the surrounding area, you will find many traces of prehistory, from dolmens to burial hills.

Welcome!

The reception area has extensive tourist information available about the area. Each morning, you can enjoy a nice cup of coffee or tea in the cafeteria. When the weather is pleasant, you take it outside with you and sip away under an umbrella. The campsite consists of a well-maintained field with a paved central path, which leads to a meadow with sheep at the end of the campsite. The camping area is surrounded by trees and shrubs. The campsite is open all year round. However, in the winter months only for campers with their own facilities. The sanitary building is closed during these months.

Having fun together

There are evenings in which the owners and guests take part in a friendly petanque tournament.

There is no swimming pool on the campsite, but fortunately, Exloo boasts the gorgeous, outdoor swimming pool De Leewal. This pool is just four kilometres from the campsite. The campsite attracts a wide variety of people, primarily from the Netherlands and Germany.

For lovers of the great outdoors

Most visitors to the campsite are the types who enjoy getting out into nature. This is an area where they can really indulge themselves. De Hondsrug not only features prehistoric monuments, but it also boasts a diverse landscape with a wide variety of equally diverse flora and fauna.

properties.name: Camping Huttopia De Meinweg
properties.description:
Ever dream of a holiday surrounded by the beautiful nature of a National Park? A place that offers peace and tranquillity for you and plenty of water recreation activities for the kids? Camping Huttopia De Meinweg, in the heart of Limburg, guarantees you this sort of relaxing stay! De Meinweg is located in the nature park bearing the same name, a stone's throw from Roermond (10 km). Enjoy staying close to nature, where your children can swim and you can go on the most beautiful bike rides.

Glamping: from tent to gypsy wagon

You'll be camping on a site with old oak trees and streams. Set up your tent, caravan or motorhome on one of the spacious pitches. These vary in size from 90 to 120 m². Do you want to rent accommodation? Torn between a tent and a chalet? Then choose the Cahutte, a kind of forest chalet with a tent roof. You can also choose from other types of chalets.

Swim in the pool or head to the Maasplassen

Its always a pleasure to go for a swim at Huttopia De Meinweg campsite. There is a beautifully maintained swimming pool complex with two heated outdoor pools, one of which is covered. Relax on a lounger on the spacious terrace while the children enjoy themselves in the water. The Maasplassen offer a good option for swimming in natural water.

Food trucks and other food options

Huttopia De Meinweg has two food trucks waiting for you. Here you can have a drink and eat a pizza. You can buy fresh bread and other products at the campsite grocery store. If you need more groceries, you can be in the village of Herkenbosch (3 km) in no time.

properties.name: Camping Les Neufs Prés
properties.description:
Les Neufs Prés Campsite is located in a beautiful spot in the Belgian Ardennes. It is situated in a hilly, wooded landscape along the Salm river. This campsite is centrally located in the Ardennes and is surrounded by many charming towns. Many sporty campers come to this well-maintained campsite. There are also plenty of families with children, especially during the high season. Among other things, they can enjoy the heated outdoor swimming pool that is open at that time of year. A railway line runs behind the aforementioned river, but the occasionally passing train traffic is not disturbing.

Sunny, shady or riverside camping

Upon your arrival, the manager of this municipal campsite will extend you a warm welcome. You can then choose from a sunny or shady camping pitch. Some of the pitches are almost directly on the river. People without their own camping equipment can also go here, because there are three lodge tents (without sanitary facilities) for rent.

Come and swim in the heated outdoor pool

Les Neufs Prés Campsite features a large heated swimming pool. Here you can swim laps to your heart's content, but you can also just enjoy some old-fashioned splashing around. In addition to this large pool, you will also find a large paddling pool. This sunny waterpark is open in July and August. Around the pool there is a large sunbathing area where you can sunbathe. In addition, the tennis court, playground, sports field and mini golf courses offer plenty of sporting entertainment.

properties.name: Camping Dornbirn
properties.description:
In the middle of nature yet close to the city centre. This describes Camping Dornbirn's ideal location in the Austrian Vorarl Mountains. Whether you're looking for rest, a day of mountain biking or canyoning, there's something for everyone on and around this versatile campsite. Your children will also have a great time playing in the stream and swimming pool. Camping Dornbirn stands for family, sports and camping fun.

Green, green, green

The campsite extends to the outskirts of the town of Dornbirn. You'll be camping on spacious pitches. Each pitch is about 100 m² in size and has an electricity and water connection. From every camping pitch, wherever you look, it is green. From the campsite to the mountains around you. Your neighbours range from those seeking peace and quiet to families and sports enthusiasts who enjoy hiking and cycling.

From swimming and canyoning to yoga

On holiday with your family? Then you'll be happy to know that the Dornbirner Ach flows on the other side of the campsite. Even better: there's an outdoor swimming pool with a waterslide just 350 metres from the campsite. This swimming pool is beautifully situated between the woods and the stream. Your children can enjoy swimming there.

Fancy a little more action? Sports enthusiasts will be delighted to know that there are many cycling and mountain bike trails in the area. Canyoning enthusiasts will also get their money's worth. You can also enjoy complete relaxation at the campsite. Just join one of the yoga classes.

properties.name: Freizeitpark Wisseler See GmbH
properties.description:
You will find this large campsite close to the town of Kalkar in the German state of North Rhine-Westphalia, just over the border with the Netherlands. Here, you camp next to a lovely recreational lake, where the campsite also has a private beach. Ferien- und Camping Park Wisseler See is also an ideal holiday address for water sports enthusiasts. Families with children also like coming here. In the high season, all kinds of fun activities are organised for children and adults. Furthermore, the campsite is only a few kilometres from the well-known Wunderland Kalkar family amusement park.

Several camping fields

Ferien- und Camping Park Wisseler See only has a few hire accommodation and many annual pitches. However, there are also large fields with tourist camping pitches. They are neatly maintained pitches of various sizes, varying from 40 to 100 m². The touring pitches are neatly demarcated. If you like to take your dog(s) camping with you, then you will be allocated a nice pitch on the Südplatz, close to the lake. The other camping fields are dog free.

Swimming, pedal boating and standup paddleboarding

This campsite's grounds lead right to the private sandy beach on the Wisseler See recreational lake. There are various water sports and recreational options. For example, pedal boating and standup paddleboarding. Furthermore, you can swim safely in a special separate section of the lake. There is also a spectacular slide by the beach.

What other entertainment does this campsite offer?

The entertainment programme is mainly aimed at (young) children. Activities include crafts, games and sports tournaments. You can also get active in the bowling alley and the sports hall.

properties.name: Agri. Gar. Tur. SRL Camping Centro Vacanze Oriente
Balatontourist Camping & Bungalows Füred
properties.description:
Balatontourist Camping & Bungalows Füred is located on the edge of Lake Balaton in Hungary. With direct access to the lake, a heated swimming pool and an aqua park opposite the campsite, the focus here is on having fun in the water. Furthermore, there are nice little beaches to play on and sunbathing areas for relaxing. At this large family campsite, every member of the family can have fun. In addition, the campsite has a wide range of catering services.

Camping under the trees

Balatontourist Camping & Bungalows Füred has a large number of camping pitches, bungalows and mobile homes. Yet there's room for everyone to have their own space. The campsite is large, and the spacious pitches are under the shade of trees. The sites are clearly demarcated, and scattered throughout the flat camping fields are five buildings with sanitary facilities. It is also possible to rent your own private cabins.

Pleasure all day long

You won't find yourself getting bored here any time soon. There is an entertainment team that organises everything for young and old from early morning until late at night. But there are also nice playgrounds for the children and numerous sports facilities such as a tennis court, volleyball court and mini-golf course. Experiencing a little muscle pain after all that exercising? Then dive into the sauna or visit the massage parlour. There is also plenty of room to recover from your efforts. There are several restaurants, cafes and bars.

Fun in the water

Still, the main attraction at this campsite remains the lake. Still not enough water fun? There's also a large heated swimming pool at the campsite and a large aqua park just outside the campsite!

properties.name: Camping Sunêlia Etang de Sologne
properties.description:
Camping Etang de Sologne is a quiet campsite on the outskirts of the small town of Nouan-le-Fuzelier. This campsite is ideal for overnight stops, but is also suitable for extended stays. You camp in a quiet park, bordering a large fishing pond in the wooded nature of Central France. The tranquillity on the camping grounds is only occasionally interrupted by a passing train. The train will take you to beautiful Orléans within half an hour.

Comfortable camping pitches

You arrive at park-like camping grounds, perfect for campers who want to combine simplicity and convenience with a natural environment. The shaded, semi-shaded and sunny pitches are all equipped with electricity connections. The sanitary facilities are standard, but fully equipped. There are disabled toilets, washing machines, tumble dryers, washing-up sinks, changing tables and special children's toilets.

Municipal pool and pond.

Next to the campsite, you will find the municipal pool, which you can use free of charge as a camping guest. This competition pool is especially suitable for swimming laps, while the little ones can play in the toddler pool. The campsite also has a two-hectare pond. In the summer months of July, August and September, there is a special swimming area where you can cool off. Anglers can cast their lines throughout the season to catch one of the many fish.

Bread and pastry service

In high season you can make use of the bread and pastry service. However, should you miss this opportunity, you can walk to the centre of Nouan-le-Fuzelier within five minutes. There you will find a bakery and a small supermarket. The village also has a few restaurants.

properties.name: Slow Village Saint-Cybranet
properties.description:
At Slow Village Saint-Cybranet, you camp in green surroundings and by a river in France's Périgord Noir, in the Dordogne. Time seems to stand still here, allowing you to totally unwind. Dive into river Céou, enjoy the local cuisine and wander around the picturesque villages.

Spacious pitches in the French countryside

The campsite has wooden tiny houses, for 2 to 4 people. Or go for one of the safari tents. All the accommodation is designed to minimise the impact on the environment. But that certainly doesn’t make them any less comfortable! You can also bring your tent and choose one of the camping spots in the middle of nature. All pitches are spacious and offer plenty of privacy.

Wherever you stay or however you camp, you will wake up to birdsong. With your feet in the grass, walk straight to the river for a fresh morning swim.

Sustainability and local products

Slow Village Saint-Cybranet puts great emphasis on sustainability and ecological construction. This is reflected in the wooden accommodation as well as in the kids' club. In high season, young campers can play and explore here. They also learn more about nature in a fun way. There’s a petting zoo, where children can stroke and cuddle animals. Dive into the clear waters of the river or the three heated outdoor pools. Then enjoy a drink at the guinguette, a small outdoor café under the trees.

properties.name: Camping Sunêlia La Clémentine
properties.description:
This beautiful terraced campsite is located in a quiet, green area. You'll be staying in a forest of green oaks and acacias in the middle of the Cevennes national park. 1.5 kilometres from Camping Sunêlia La Clémentine is the village of Cendras, and you will find the city of Alès 6.5 kilometres away. The campsite has beautiful hilly, green grounds and plenty to do for the whole family. Are you going to spend your vacation at this southern French campsite?

This campsite is easily accessible. You get there easily via the public road to the campsite entrance. The campsite grounds are green and hilly. Camping Sunêlia La Clémentine is also a terraced campsite. You especially notice this when you walk to an accommodation. The pitches are spacious and set in natural surroundings. Fine for a quiet, green vacation. There are four modern washrooms. And this campsite has a choice of as many as six types of comfortable chalets and cottages.

Sociability and fun activities

With all the activities the campsite offers, you'll make a connection in no time. Think beach volleyball, basketball, bocce ball and mini-golf. There is also time for fun dance nights, karaoke sessions, theme nights and game tournaments. Fancy a dip? The campsite pools are open from mid-April to the end of September. There are three heated pools: a paddling pool, a pool for lounging and a larger pool for swimming laps.

properties.name: Slow Village Séveilles
properties.description:
Camping Les Valades is between the French rivers of Vézère and the Dordogne. It is a spaciously laid out campsite in a natural green, wooded area. The campsite has a private lake where you can go swimming, fishing and canoeing. You can also go for a swim in the indoor or open-air pool. Activities are organised for young and old in the high season. There is plenty to see and do in the surrounding area, so you won't get bored for a second.

Spacious camping pitches

Camping Les Valades is on a large hill, surrounded by trees. The campsite is landscaped as a large park, with less than 100 camping pitches and a wide range of accommodation. The camping pitches vary from between 90 m² to 300 m². Some of the pitches have luxury private toilet and washing facilities and a private washing up area.

Local food at the campsite

The reception building is stylishly designed and is the centre of the campsite. There is an indoor area with a pool table, toys and boardgames. There is also a restaurant with a patio where you can get local dishes and pizzas in the high season. In July and August, there is also a small campsite shop for basic necessities. You can order fresh bread at reception throughout the camping season.

Water fun

Water fun is an important factor at Camping Les Valades. There are no fewer than three swimming pools you can splash about in. There is a heated indoor pool for colder days and an outdoor pool with paddling pool for when the sun shines. You can also have lots of fun in the swimming lake. There is a water trampoline floating on the lake, and you can use the canoes for free.

properties.name: Camping De la Grève Blanche
properties.description:
At the Breton campsite De la Grève Blanche, you have a fantastic view over the Atlantic Ocean from your pitch. The campsite is located in the Finistère region. This literally means 'end of the world'. This is where France stops and the Atlantic Ocean starts. It is a region of rugged, rocky coastlines punctuated with sandy beaches. This makes this campsite perfect for beach and water sports enthusiasts.

Camping with a view

Check-in at the charming reception building, where a bar and a small restaurant are also housed. You are welcomed by the campsite owner here. After this, you can set up your own camping equipment on one of the two well-tended fields. Due to the low vegetation, the campsites have fairly little privacy, but that is generously compensated by the magnificent view from each pitch. Apart from pitches, there are also mobile homes, cabins and lodges for hire. The most beautiful and popular campsites are directly by the sea, right against the front of the dunes.

Beach and watersports

The location and nature play the starring role at this campsite. All the basic facilities are present and in working order. There is no swimming pool, but you won't even need one with the beach and the sea right around the corner! There is a watersports centre (Club Nautique) a 10-minute walk away, where you can hire sailboats, kayaks and paddle boards, as well as book lessons and activities.

During peak season, you can participate in activities like themed evenings and folk dance lessons. Or play a round of volleyball, table tennis or petanque together. For the little ones, there is a playground, and the rocky coast makes a huge, natural playground for climbers great and small!

properties.name: Camping Sunêlia Baie de Saint Pol
properties.description:
In Brittany, on the north coast of the Finistère, you will find Camping Sunêlia la Baie de Saint Pol de Léon. This coastal campsite is very suitable for campers on their journey to or from England, given its location close to the ferry in Roscoff. You will camp on a very well maintained campsite, where children can have fun in the playground and the heated swimming pool. Discover the varied Breton coast and the islands in the Bay of Morlaix and the English Channel.

Well-maintained campsite

Paved streets take you from the wide entrance to the campsite. The terrain is well-organised and neatly laid out. On various camping fields there is always room for a few touring pitches. The fields are bordered by well-kept hedges. There are plenty of shady pitches, but there's a chance you'll be in the sun. Besides touring pitches there are rental accommodations. These mobile homes (and some tents) are located at the back of the site.

Transit campsite

The campsite is frequently used by English campers, who are travelling to or from their home country. A fifteen minute drive will bring you to the ferry in Roscoff. This makes the campsite a transit campsite. But the campsite is also suitable for campers who want to stay longer.

Conviviality by the pool

Next to the entrance of the campsite is the heated outdoor swimming pool. Here you can go for a refreshing dip. Also for the little ones, because next to the swimming pool is a round paddling pool. There's also a playground for the youngest guests, with a large sandbox and a bouncy castle. The older campers can play a game at the jeu-de-boules court. Next to the swimming pool you will find a bar.

properties.name: Slow Village Breizh Légendes
properties.description:
Do you love beach life or would you like to walk the spectacular GR34 walking trail along the Breton coast? Then Slow Village Breizh Légendes in Plounéour-Trez in the north of Finistère is right for you. This well-maintained campsite is located on this walking route and also alongside a wide sandy beach on the Celtic Sea. The campsite’s highlights include sea views, a heated outdoor swimming pool, a cafeteria and a children's entertainment programme.

Book a sunny touring pitch with a sea view

This campsite has a great mix of accommodation and tourist pitches. First, a word about the touring pitches. Different sizes and views are possible. Some pitches have an unobstructed view of the beach and the sea. Most pitches are sunny too. Prefer accommodation? You can choose from luxury safari tents, mobile homes, cottages and tiny houses. Authentic bivouac tents can be rented as well; ideal for cycling and walking tourists.

Great destination for swimming enthusiasts

The campsite's location on Baie de Goulven is ideal for beach lovers. From the campsite, there are several access points to the huge beach on this bay. This is a great place for a refreshing dip in summer. Of course, you can also take a dip in the heated outdoor pool with paddling pool on the campsite itself. Next to the pool, there is an atmospheric cafeteria where all kinds of delicious treats are served in high season. Numerous fun activities are organised for children aged 6 to 12 in the summer. These include games, creative workshops and nature discovery tours.

properties.name: Camping Eden villages Cap de Bréhat
properties.description:
Camp in a quiet spot in an unspoilt area on the rugged North Breton coast, right on the spectacular GR34 walking route. And with a bit of luck, you have a beautiful view of the sea and the island of Île-de-Bréhat from your camping pitch. That's what you can look forward to if you decide to stay at Le Cap de Bréhat Campsite. An ideal holiday address for peace seekers, nature lovers and hiking enthusiasts. Families also know how to find this campsite, especially in the high season. The varied entertainment program and the beautiful swimming pool (with a retractable roof) provide plenty of entertainment.

Reception and layout

After arrival, you can report to the reception. Then you walk or drive onto this well-arranged terraced campsite. You will find open camping pitches in the lower part, while the higher part has more enclosed pitches. On this campsite, there are two sanitary buildings that meet modern standards.

Camping spots with sea views and unique rental accommodations

Some camping spots offer a wonderful view of the sea and (at low tide) the oyster beds. Pitches with private sanitary facilities are also available. In addition to touring pitches, Le Cap de Bréhat Campsite offers several rental accommodations, such as tiny houses and a beautiful tree house. In addition, there are some Bivouac tents, especially for backpackers and cyclists.

Participate in a sports tournament

In the summer months, the enthusiastic animation team of the campsite organises many fun activities. Campers of all ages can participate in various sports tournaments. There are also often special themed evenings. You can then taste typical Breton specialities.

properties.name: Camping Le Domaine de Bréhadour
properties.description:
You will find this campsite in the Loire-Atlantique, a beautiful coastal region between Brittany and the Vendée. You can camp here near the gates of the beautiful medieval town of Guérande. In addition, the large Brière nature reserve and a unique salt production area are nearby. Le Domaine de Bréhadour Campsite itself offers, among other things, a beautiful water park and numerous sports and play facilities.

Grouped touring pitches and various types of mobile homes

The camping site is well organised. The tourist camping pitches are neatly grouped together at the back of the site. Some pitches are sheltered between trees and hedges, while other touring pitches have a more open character. There are camping spots for different comfort levels. With a private bathroom and kitchenette, the privilege pitches offer the most comfort. In addition, mobile homes can be rented at this campsite. The sanitary facilities of this campsite are being completely renovated.

Swimming fun for the entire family

There is a nice water park near the campsite's entrance. You can swim laps in the rectangular pool that has a retractable glass roof. There is also an outdoor pool, which has three fun water slides. We've also kept our smallest campers in mind, so there's a paddling pool where they can play in the water. The water in all these baths is heated to 28 degrees.

Sports, games and animation

Le Domaine de Bréhadour is considered a child-friendly campsite. There is a beautiful playground, and you can play football, basketball, table tennis, tennis and jeu-de-boules at this campsite.

properties.name: Camping Sunêlia Le Séquoia
properties.description:
Camping Le Séquoia is centrally located for a visit to the historic towns and sights in the Lot. For example, go to a few interesting caves and castles. Famous towns in this area are Rocamadour, Sarlat, Lacave and Quercy. The department of the Lot is varied with cliffs, meadows and historic towns. The campsite itself is small, but offers the advantages of a large campsite, such as the very spacious water park and high service level.

Well-kept grounds

What you notice directly are the well maintained paths and the lovely pitches. Camping Le Séquoia is a large campsite with many rental accommodations. The pitches are of average size and certainly not small. Most of the pitches are demarcated with a hedge or other types of plants. You can spend you holidays in privacy.

Swimming pleasure and more

This campsite is ideal for for families with children up to 10 years old. Why? Because they can play in the lovely laid out swimming pools. The outdoor swimming pools are heated and there is also a covered swimming pool. The swimming pools are surrounded by green grass and plenty of trees. Little campers can also cavort to their hearts' content in the playground.

Restaurant and shop

The well maintained campsite has a good restaurant with an extensive menu and many local dishes. There is also a bar where you can get a snack and a drink. Take-away meals are also offered. The bar has a panoramic terrace with a view of the swimming pool and the playground. The camping shop has a limited offering, but there is a supermarket only 500 metres away from the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Le Chanet
properties.description:
Camping Le Chanet is a terraced campsite located against a ridge. The campsite is situated in the vicinity of Ornans, in the Jura mountains. The emphasis of the campsite is on environmental awareness (no chlorine in the swimming pool, preventing water wastage). The layout if the campsite is very natural and you will enjoy the lovely view of the mountainous landscape.

Ornans is certainly worth a visit because of its good quality restaurants and a few interesting museums. The area is not very touristy and makes for good cycling and walking.

Natural campsite with lots of greenery

When you arrive at the campsite, you will first see the reception building and the petanque pitches. At the back of the building, you will find the sanitary facilities, supplemented by a massage bench, solarium and fitness room.

To get to your pitch, you have to drive up a slope to one of the side streets. Some pitches are demarcated; the pitches on the upper field are open. The mobile homes and playground equipment are located in the middle of the campsite. The campsite has a natural look, with lots of greenery. The view of the surrounding mountains is a daily source of pleasure. Campers have a choice of different kinds of pitches, all spacious. They vary in view, shade and privacy.

Environmentally-friendly swimming pool

The swimming pool is cleansed in an environmentally friendly manner with plants. They use no chlorine whatsoever. Adjacent to the swimming pool are the snack bar and childcare. In the mornings you can get a delicious packed breakfast from the snack bar. In the camping shop at the reception you will find basic foodstuffs and essentials.

properties.name: Camping Manoir de Ker An Poul
properties.description:
You will find this campsite on the Rhuis peninsula in the Morbihan, in the south of Brittany (France). This is an ideal base for scenic walks or bike rides along the South Breton coast. In the low season, the Manoir de Ker An Poul Campsite is mainly visited by those seeking peace and quiet and lovers of beach life. During the summer months, this is a popular campsite for families. The campsite has a beautiful water park with slides, and many fun activities are organised in the high season.

A courteous welcome

At the campsite entrance is a beautiful fifteenth-century country house. You will find the modern reception in one of this manor farm's outbuildings. The campsite is neatly laid out and well maintained. This is a fairly large campsite, but the extensive greenery gives the campsite a cosy character. There are two modern sanitary buildings on the grounds.

Grouped pitches in a green setting

There are also rental accommodations at the Manoir de Ker An Poul Campsite, including mobile homes and caravans. The camping pitches are neatly grouped and centrally between the two sanitary buildings, and there is a lot of greenery. There are camping pitches available at three comfort levels. The difference is mainly in the size of the pitches. It is also possible to book a camping pitch with private sanitary facilities.

From treasure hunts to karaoke nights – something for everyone

In the summer months, the animation team organises all kinds of fun activities every day. For example, children can participate in a treasure hunt or mini disco. Sports tournaments, live music performances, quizzes and karaoke evenings are organised for teens and adults.

properties.name: Arena Tašalera Campsite
properties.description:
Arena Tašalera Campsite is located in southern Istria, just above the seaside resort of Premantura, directly on the Adriatic Sea. Here you camp on slightly sloping terrain in the shade of a pine forest, or on a flat piece of land directly by the sea. With only the basic facilities, the peace and quiet of the campsite is maintained.

Unlike many of the ultramodern campsites on the Croatian coast, Arena Tašalera Campsite is a fairly simple campsite, without too much fuss. However, you can eat out in the grill restaurant 'Tašalera'. The camp shop has a small assortment for when you want to cook for yourself. The sanitary facilities are simple and fairly standard, but they are well-kept and clean.

Natural view

Some places offer a view of the Adriatic Sea. In addition to the one hundred touring pitches, the campsite has more than two hundred permanent pitches. There are only five mobile homes on the campsite, so the Croatian nature is not interrupted by the view of holiday homes.

Surroundings

Near the campsite there is a small jetty, which small pleasure boats and rowing boats gratefully use. This makes the part of the bay near the campsite a little less suitable for swimmers. They are better off diving into the water a few kilometres away. The old coastal town of Pula is less than half an hour from the campsite. After the invasion by the Romans a large city wall was built, but especially the amphitheatre just outside the centre appeals to the imagination.

properties.name: Arena Runke Campsite
properties.description:
Arena Runke Campsite is a quiet campsite in the south of the Croatian peninsula Istria. The campsite is located between the nature reserve of Cape Kamenjak and the seaside resort of Premantura. Here you camp in the shade of pine trees, on a sloping terrain with only touring pitches. The most beautiful pitches offer a view of the Adriatic Sea, which is directly connected to the campsite by pebble and rocky beaches.

Camping on the Adriatic Sea

The campground, which is located directly on the Adriatic Sea, is rather sloping. This makes it a little more difficult for larger motorhomes and caravans. Tent-campers will also have to look for an even spot. An advantage is that many of the 250 touring pitches are shaded by pine trees, in a wooded area that exudes a lot of tranquillity.

Croatian grill dishes

For a fair price you can taste Croatian grill dishes and pizzas in the campsite restaurant. With a nice glass of wine your meal will be a complete success. You can also cook for yourself. In the supermarket on the campsite you may not find everything you need, but there are several supermarkets in the centre of Premantura (just a few minutes walk away).

At the Adriatic Sea

With a pebble and rocky beach right next to the campsite, this campsite is ideal for lovers of the sea. The clear water of the Adriatic Sea invites you to swim, but divers are also welcome here. The ultimate part of the sea is Cape Kamenjak, the southernmost part of the peninsula. You can easily walk or cycle there. From the steep cliffs the view over the water is very beautiful.

properties.name: Camping Au Coeur des Vignes
properties.description:
As its name already suggests, Camping Au Coeur des Vignes lies in the heart of the vineyards. Just five minutes of walking will take you to the wine village Arbois, in the southern part of the French department of Jura. This terraced campsite is good for relaxation or fun excursions.

An accommodation for everyone

There are various spacious pitches at this campsite. If you would like to go camping but have no camping equipment, choose one of the mobile homes, lodge or safari tents or pods. The accommodations are suitable for 2 to 4 people. If you are going on holiday with a larger group, you can rent the cottage, allowing you to enjoy your holiday with a maximum of 10 people.

In the morning, you will cross the grass when you leave your camping equipment. The rolling landscape around you is reflected in the campsite as well. Because you are camping at the foot of a vineyard, you always have a beautiful view.

Quiet home base in the French department of Jura

Camping Au Coeur des Vignes is an ideal, quiet home base for a holiday in the Jura. In the morning, fetch delicious fresh rolls or enjoy a full breakfast served in the restaurant. In the evening, sample local dishes and regional wines while listening to live music. All kinds of other activities are organised as well in the high season.

Go for a refreshing swim in municipal swimming pool, right next to the campsite. There are also several athletic fields where you can kick a ball around with your children or other holidaymakers.

properties.name: Camping le Val de Cesse
properties.description:
Camping le Val de Cesse is located in a peaceful spot in sun-drenched Languedoc-Roussillon, right next to the river Cesse. The emphasis here is on relaxing in nature, with plenty of opportunities to get out and about. Take a dip in the heated pool, settle down by the water or explore the surrounding area for some culture and history. The atmosphere is friendly and relaxed: perfect for a carefree camping holiday.

Plenty of space and comfortable accommodation

At Camping le Val de Cesse, you will camp on large, well-kept pitches separated by hedges. This ensures privacy and a green feel. Prefer a little extra comfort? There are modern mobile homes with air conditioning, ideal on hot summer days. For a special experience, choose a riverside glamping lodge. Stylishly furnished, with a large patio and water views. A great place to really unwind.

Activities for the whole family

The campsite has everything you might need for a relaxing stay. The heated swimming pool with separate paddling pool is a favourite spot for young and old. While the children splash around, you can enjoy the sun from the side of the pool. You can enjoy a snack or drink at the restaurant and bar next to the pool. For children, there are play areas and organised activities, so they will never be bored. The small supermarket is open in the morning and sells bread rolls and essentials.

properties.name: Flower Camping La Rivière
properties.description:
Flower Camping La Rivière is in the hilly countryside of the Provence, amid the lavender fields. Here, you camp on a demarcated touring pitch or in one of the various accommodation for hire, ranging from lodge tents to mobile homes. The view of the surrounding forested hills from the campsite is beautiful. Cool down in the large swimming pool or the shallow river, or cast a line in the fishing pond.

Camping is calming

Flower Camping La Rivière offers you a secluded place to camp for a quiet holiday. Hedges around the touring pitches and hire accommodation give you enough privacy, while the tall trees and green bushes have a calming effect. There are enough pitches (around 40) for campers coming with their own camping equipment. Furthermore, you can choose from 60 hire accommodation, lodge tents, mobile homes and bungalow tents.

Swimming in the swimming pool and river

The swimming pool is at the entrance to the campsite, in a sunny spot. It is a large pool with a paddling pool alongside. The entirety is surrounded by sun loungers and wicker parasols. You can also paddle in the river that flows past. The shallow, cool water of this stream is ideal for children in particular.

Paella on the patio

Enjoy an authentic Spanish paella or a refreshing drink? You can do that on the swimming pool patio. Here, you sit in the shade of the full trees. You are best going to Forcalquier for your groceries. You will find various supermarkets there. There's a nice market on Mondays.

properties.name: Libranoo Arnaoutchot
properties.description:
If you are looking for a good naturist campsite that allows you to enjoy the countryside and nudism in complete freedom, then Libranoo Arnaoutchot, just outside of Vielle-Saint-Girons in the department Landes, is an ideal holiday address. This holiday park is located in a large pine forest near the Atlantic Ocean, where the campsite has a private naturist beach. You will find a swimming pool complex, three restaurants, two bars, various shops, sports facilities and a wide range of activities. If you would like to go site-seeing for a day, visit the neighbouring nature reserve Courant d'Huchet or go for great walks or bicycle rides through the wooded areas and dunes of the department of Landes.

Accommodation options: something for everyone!

If you prefer to go camping with your own caravan, motorhome and/or tent, this campsite has standard pitches (with or without electricity) and premium pitches, which are near the well-kept toilet and washing facilities. It is also possible to stay in a fully equipped mobile home, bungalow or cottage. If you are looking for a unique experience, rent a four-metre-high cabin on poles. With a little luck, you will have a great view of the sea!

A paradise for swimming enthusiasts

The naturist beach can be accessed right from your pitch or accommodation, where you can enjoy a refreshing dip in the ocean. You can also challenge the waves on a surfboard or paddleboard. The campsite itself has three large swimming pools, one of which is covered. The possibilities include swimming laps, whizzing down the water slides or relaxing in the Jacuzzi. Children enjoy the splendid water playing zone.

properties.name: Camping le Lac de Thoux - Ciela Village
properties.description:
Camping Le Lac de Thoux is located in a quiet area in the Midi-Pyrénées region, between the cities of Toulouse and Auch. This region, known for its dry and sunny summers, is an ideal summer destination. Thanks to its location on the lake of the same name, this family campsite is a perfect base for water sports enthusiasts and campers who like to fish. An entertainment team provides entertainment for young and old alike.

Spacious pitches and good sanitary facilities

The campsite is located on a gently sloping terrain. The 94 spacious pitches (100 - 150m2) are located on grassland, situated between trees and shrubs. For the best view, book one of the unique touring pitches or luxury accommodations on the lake. The campsite rents camping pitches, various luxury tents and mobile homes. The clean and modern sanitary facilities are fully equipped and are a major plus for many camping guests.

Water sports and recreation

What is special about this campsite is that it is located directly on Lac de Thoux-Saint-Cricq. It is nice to be in and on the clear water, especially during the summer. Close to the campsite you will find a water sports school that rents out surfboards, canoes, boats and pedal boats, among other things. You might even take your first sailing or surfing lesson here. Fishing enthusiasts can cast their line here and sun worshippers have plenty of space on the nice sandy beach.

For even more water recreation activities, there is a large aqua park just next to the campsite with all kinds of waterslides and whirlpools. The pool also has some shallow parts and is therefore perfect for young children. Because the swimming pool is located in a separate part of the campsite, it is nice and quiet on the campsite itself.

properties.name: Camping le Bontemps - Ciela Village
properties.description:
Camping Le Bontemps is located in the region of Isère, in the heart of the Rhône-Alpes. This region is known for its castles, churches and museums, but also for its impressive nature. From the quietly situated campsite you’ll find something of interest in all directions. Campers can enjoy beautiful facilities such as a swimming pool, a good restaurant, a tennis court and a fishing pond.

Green and park-like terrain

The grounds of the campsite are a flat and well-kept park with trees that provide pleasant shelter. The campsite offers beautiful and spacious pitches on a grassy surface. Trees and hedges of various heights delimitate the pitches.

Swimming and playing

The pool complex consists of a beautiful rectangular pool, a long slide and a duo slide. Several sun loungers with parasols make this a popular and pleasant spot on the campsite. When the weather is not so good, the swimming pool can be covered. Children can play in the shallow stream that runs along the campsite.

Active enjoyment

Although this is a lovely campsite to unwind, campers can also get plenty of action. How about fitness, a game of mini golf or an exciting tennis match? Fishermen throw out their fishing rod in the pond at the front of the campsite. Children will have the time of their lives, because in summer there is a bouncing castle and the Kids Club organises all sorts of activities. Outside the campsite there are lovely walking trails in the Pilat Regional Nature Park.

properties.name: Camping Les Princes d’Orange
properties.description:
Les Princes d'Orange is a campsite in the Hautes-Alpes, located at the foot of the French Alps. You camp in the regional nature park des Baronnies Provençales, near the border with the Drôme. You will find touring pitches and glamping accommodations on well-kept terraces. With its outdoor swimming pool and playground, this terraced campsite is a suitable destination for families with children. At the covered climbing wall you can practice for the real thing: climbing the steep rocks around Orpierre.

Welcome!

The D30 leads you from Eyguians to Orpierre, where you turn left at the camping sign. A little further on a passable road and you have reached the campsite.

Camping or rental accommodation

In the middle of the rugged nature are spacious touring pitches. The terraces on the campsite offer a view of the surrounding rocky mountains, which give the area a rugged but tranquil feel. In addition to various chalets, mobile homes and bungalow tents, holiday homes with their own whirlpool are also available for rent.

Swimming and climbing

Active families are in thei element at campsite Les Princes d'Orange. Children can have fun in the large playground and the beautiful swimming pool. Also good to know for the gentlemen: you can just pack your swimming shorts. You don't necessarily have to wear a Speedo, like almost everywhere in France. Everyone can train in mountain climbing here at the indoor climbing wall on the campsite. The restaurant looks simple, but you can eat well there. In July and August live performances, karaoke and dance evenings are held here twice a week.

properties.name: Camping les Routes de Provence
properties.description:
Between the green hills and purple lavender fields in the French Provence you will find the small-scale family campsite Camping les Routes de Provence. You will camp here on the edge of the fortified town of Forcalquier. The spacious pitches of the campsite are situated on well-designed lawns and mostly under trees. There are chalets, bungalows and mobile homes for rent.

Charming camping

Camping les Routes de Provence is a small-scale campsite with a family atmosphere. On entering the site you will be warmly welcomed by the owners. There are spacious pitches situated on grass. Most of the pitches have sufficient shade and are separated by high hedges. For campers without their own camping equipment, there is the possibility to rent a mobile home, chalet or bungalow. There are three sanitary buildings spread over the campsited.

Fresh croissants

Most facilities can be found at the front of the campsite. Here you will find the café-restaurant, where you can enjoy simple dishes. The outdoor patio is a particularly good place for a meal or a cup of coffee. Fresh bread and croissants can be ordered and collected the next morning. For many other facilities you can walk to the centre of Forcalquier.

Sport, games and water fun

On the campsite there is plenty to do for young and old. There is a playground for the children, a games room (with free wifi) and plenty of space to play a game of volleyball or jeu de boules. In addition, there is an entertainment team in high season that organises lots of craft activities for the children. Camping les Routes de Provence also has a heated swimming pool with a paddling pool. The pool is situated opposite the outdoor café and is surrounded by a beautiful lawn.

properties.name: Camping Les Gorges du Chambon - Ciela Village
properties.description:
In the vast nature of Charente lies this green campsite. This spacious campsite is a wonderful place to relax. At the sloping campsite of Camping Les Gorges du Chambon, the view over the forests is beautiful. Take a dip in the pool or slide down the new water slides. And after a nature walk, you can dine on the terrace.

Beautiful views

Your camping destination is on the edge of the Charente and Dordogne rivers. The last stretch to the campsite looks out over wooded hills. Before long, you will find yourself in the woods yourself. Among those forests lies the campsite. One thing strikes you immediately: those charming French buildings. You will be welcomed in one of these buildings.

Camping with a view

Everything exudes a sense of spaciousness at this campsite. The pitches are arranged in a circle. The best camping pitches can be found on the outer perimeter. Not only are these the largest, they also have the luxury of stunning views. Large trees lend these pitches the necessary shade. Do you want the luxury of your own kitchen, whirlpool bath or soft bed? Then you're in luck: the choice of rental accommodations is wide.

A cool splash

Fancy a cool splash? The swimming pool at the campsite is not difficult to find. It is located right next to the new water slides. These tower over everything. Race down the slide one more time before diving into the water. You can dry off in the sun, but you can also look for a shady spot.

properties.name: Camping le Colporteur - Ciela Village
properties.description:
Le Colporteur campsite is a friendly family campsite in the Écrins National Park. It is well suited to cyclists and outdoor enthusiasts. The campsite offers spacious camping pitches and chalets for the very best in relaxation and comfort. This four-star campsite is located between the steep mountains of eastern France and very close to the centre of Bourg d'Oisans.

More than enough space

Every camping pitch has an area of around 100 m2 and all are separated by hedges, so there's plenty of space. Chalets come in all shapes and sizes, with space for anywhere between 3 and 8 people. One of the chalets is specially equipped for people with physical disabilities. All are spacious, have their own kitchen and bathroom, enjoy beautiful green surroundings and are complemented by a patio area with fantastic views.

Outdoor enthusiasts

Campers at Le Colporteur are true outdoor enthusiasts. With such a beautiful landscape, what would you expect? The surroundings are ideal for (mountain) hiking, cycle rides and winter sports. The lakes and rivers of the National Park offer a variety of sports, from rafting to fishing.

Alpe d'Huez

Le Colporteur is at the foot of Alpe d'Huez, a mountain pasture made famous through its association with the Tour de France. Take your racing bike or mountain bike with you and tackle the 21 notorious hairpin bends as you climb the mountain. In the winter, the mountain is a fantastic location for skiing.

properties.name: Camping Liberté Landrellec
properties.description:
On the Breton peninsula of Landrellec is the cosy family campsite Camping Liberté Landrellec. You will be camping here in a special part of France, the Côte de Granit Rose. Take walks along this spectacular granite coast or visit the extraordinary islands of Île-Grande and Les Sept-Iles. Camping Liberté Landrellec is located directly on the sea and in the shelter of a bay.

View of the sea

Most pitches are surrounded by hedges. Only the pitches directly on the beach are less sheltered, but they do offer an extraordinarily beautiful view of the sea. From the ring road that runs across the campsite, all touring pitches can be reached. Around the reception are the rental accommodations such as mobile homes and chalets.

Fresh rolls

Every day, you can visit the campsite shop for fresh bread and croissants. And while you're still enjoying your breakfast, the kids may already want to play. They have the option to head off to the playing fields, the playground or the sandy beach. In high season, there is also an entertainment team present. The campsite restaurant, including the bar and terrace, is in a beautiful location by the water.

Swimming pool and sea

Most campers have one thing in common: their love of water. And there's plenty of that here. A modest swimming pool is available at the campsite. This is in the sun, can be partially covered and has a separate pool for the little campers. For those who enjoy luxury, there is a small wellness centre with a sauna and jacuzzi. But the main attraction is the sea. The sandy beach slopes gently into the water, perfect for children who want to splash around and play.

properties.name: Camping Le Deffay
properties.description:
In the southern part of Brittany you will find Camping Le Deffay, between the village of Sainte-Reine-de-Bretagne and the small town of Pontchâteau. The campsite is situated on the grounds of an 18th century castle in a green setting. In the old outbuildings of this castle you will find a snack bar and the campsite shop.

Camping between tall trees or by the fish pond

The spacious camping pitches are located between old tall trees and allow you to opt for a pitch with either lots of or somewhat less shade. The pitches around the small lake are sunnier and have a view of the water abounding with fish. In addition to camping pitches, campsite Le Deffay also has rental accommodation (mobile homes, chalets and bungalows). The accommodation units near the lake are generously spaced.

Swimming pool with terrace

There is a heated outdoor swimming pool with a toddler pool. There is a special chair to get into the pool for guests who require assistance to enter the water. Next to the swimming pool is a spacious terrace where you can enjoy the sun in warm weather.

Sports entertainment

There are opportunities on campsite Le Deffay to play volleyball, tennis and pétanque. There are trampolines and games for children. You can fish in the lake. Surrounding the lake is a fitness track, called: Body Boomer. Outside the campsite are pathways which are ideal for jogging.

properties.name: Flower Camping La Davière Plage
properties.description:
La Davère Plage campsite is located immediately on the Atlantic coast, slightly north of St. Jean de Monts. This family campsite, located within walking distance of the beach, has a swimming pool, fitness park, playroom and more. It is a friendly and hospitable campsite in a natural environment. Why not take the kilometre and a half walk towards the coast and sink your feet into the sand while you admire the views of the Atlantic Ocean?

Something for everyone

There's something for everyone at La Davière Plage. The beach is nearby, so sun worshippers and sea swimmers will really be in their element, while the surrounding countryside has plenty to offer outdoor enthusiasts, including hikes and cycle rides. In addition, the campsite itself has plenty for families with children.

Coast of the Light

The campsite is within walking distance of the Atlantic, so you can be on the beach within just a few minutes. The wide sandy beach is perfect for long walks and the sea is great for a dip — the Coast of Light, the area of coast at St Jean de Monts, enjoys some 2450 hours of sunshine every year, and the water warms up quickly. You can also swim on the campsite, which boasts a swimming pool with toddlers' pool and jacuzzi. For some sunbathing, there is a sunbathing lawn with lounge chairs.

Sport and games

To get to know the local area, just hop on a bike. The whole family can hire a bike from the campsite. Sports enthusiasts can also burn off some energy on the campsite — get those muscles working in the outdoor fitness park while the children enjoy the play area and table tennis tables.

properties.name: Camping Huttopia Baie du Mont St-Michel
properties.description:
The Huttopia Baie du Mont St-Michel campsite is located In Normandy, close to the coast. At half an hour's drive from the campsite you’ll find Mont Saint-Michel, the tidal island with its world-famous medieval abbey. It's a great place to camp.

Park-like campsite

The campsite, situated between two fishing ponds, has a park-like appearance. The spacious pitches, often accompanied by trees, are nicely integrated into the landscape. The maintenance of the site could be improved. Also, not all pitches are equally flat. In addition to two hundred touring pitches, you can also stay in one of the rental accommodations: mobile homes or lodge tents.

Swimming paradise

The guests you will meet at this campsite are mainly families with children. Especially the swimming paradise is a plus for the smaller campers. This swimming area is centrally located on the campsite. Although it is not particularly large, it will be spacious enough for most children. You can sunbathe on the spacious sunbathing lawn.

Varied entertainment programme

Music concerts, baking workshops for the little ones, magic shows: at the Huttopia Baie du Mont St-Michel campsite, the entertainment programme is varied. If you prefer to amuse yourself you can play tennis on the tennis court or organise a volleyball match.

Dol-de-Bretagne

For a nice pizza or a cool drink you can go to the bar on the campsite. For your daily groceries it is best to drive to Dol-de-Bretagne. Outside the centre, about five minutes away by car, there is a large supermarket.

properties.name: Camping Le Lidon
properties.description:
The well maintained family campsite Le Lidon is located in Saint-Hilaire-la-Palud, the marshy part of the Marais Poitevin. The campsite is an oasis of peace and quiet. The camping pitches are spacious (90 - 120 m2), although there is little or no demarcation. There is ample shade everywhere. Some pitches are adjacent to the small canal. On the campsite (some 3 ha) there are rental mobile homes, some of which look like a gypsy caravan. You can also hire several types of tents.

Lovely swimming and food

There is a small lawn near the heated swimming pool (160 m2) with toddler pool. There are water aerobics lessons and water polo competitions in the pool in peak season. Next to the campsite is a restaurant/bar with a small menu. They also do take-away meals. There is a limited choice of regional products, but fresh bread is available on a daily basis.

Entertainment for all

There is a small playground for children and an entertainment programme in peak season (English and French). Take part in the outdoor games and party games. From the campsite you can follow signposted cycling and walking routes. You can make a boat or canoe trip from the jetty to one of the canals of the Marais Poitevin Nature Reserve. The nature area is also excellent for walking.

Join a skipper

The wetland region of Marais Poitevin is also referred to as the 'Venice of France'. The region knows three zones: a coastal zone, the reclaimed marshland and the wet marshland. Highly recommended: explore the marshy regions with a punt (a traditional flat-bottom boat) with a skipper and pay a visit to the Abbey of the Marai in Maillezais.

properties.name: Camping La Source
properties.description:
In the small town of Le Petit-Appeville, in the north of Normandy (Seine-Maritime department), lies a green oasis of peace and quiet: Campsite La Source The spacious camping pitches here are suitable for any kind of camping equipment. There are also some mobile homes and a special tent, the Coco Sweet. Campsite La Source is located less than 500 km from Utrecht.

Rustic camping

The 120 pitches, including 70 touring pitches, vary in size. Even the smaller pitches are sufficiently spacious. The site is well maintained and pitches are demarcated with hedges. In addition to the camping pitches for your tent, caravan or camper van, there are also some rental accommodation units. For instance, you can opt to stay in a comfortable mobile home or in the Coco Sweet. 

Sports and swimming

Guests on campsite La Source appreciate the peace and quiet. After all, you're in a forest with a babbling river adjacent to the campsite. Children can play to their hearts content in the playground, kick a ball around, play badminton, table tennis and volleyball. Do not expect any bells and whistles in terms of entertainment. Although in high season some activities are organised, such as a pétanque tournament or a couscous evening. 

There is also a heated swimming pool (100 m2) which is open from 15th May to 15th September. For more water fun you only need to walk down the campsite towards the Scie. This river is suitable for fishing, peddling or canoeing.

Bar and bread

In the evenings you can enjoy a drink in the bar (near the pool). There is also a small camping shop with fresh bread. Within a radius of a few kilometres around the campsite, there is an ample choice of restaurants.

properties.name: Camping Sun Valley
properties.description:
Around a large, old farmhouse in the French department of Indre you’ll find campsite Sun Valley. Here you camp on a spacious terrain near the Lac d'Éguzon, the reservoir into which the river Creuse flows. For children this campsite is a great holiday destination: they will soon find holiday friends with whom they can go go-karting, crafting or swimming.

Spatial camping

The campsite gives a spacious feeling; from the entrance you can look far into the campsite and have a view of the beautifully laid out lawns. Most pitches are sunny. There are some scattered trees, but they don't provide the pitches with much shade.

Family campsite

The campsite is very suitable for families with children. For the younger campers there are bicycles and go-karts, large playing fields and a games room to be found on the campsite.

Heated swimming pool

At the side of the old farmhouse you will probably quickly spot the spacious swimming pool. This is located at the entrance of the campsite, on the side of the road. Even in less warm weather it is nice to swim here, as the water is heated. Next to the swimming pool is a paddling pool, for safety’s sake well fenced off.

Food and drink

The large farmhouse is the centre of conviviality at the campsite. Here you can also eat a nice pizza or hamburger with fries. Shopping for groceries is easy: in the village there is a bakery and supermarket, but also several restaurants.

properties.name: Camping Paradis Les 2 Iles
properties.description:
In a wooded area, a little outside Peyrat-le-Château (Haute-Vienne), lies Camping Paradis Les 2 Iles. Here, you camp directly by the beautiful recreational lake Lac de Vassivière, where the campsite has its own beach. This is a popular destination for water sports enthusiasts. Hiking and cycling lovers also feel at home here, as the campsite is located in the heart of nature, surrounded by hilly landscapes with vast forests.

Stay in a floating lodge

The touring pitches are well-maintained and separated by hedges. Generally, the closer you are to the lake, the more sun you'll get. At Camping Paradis Les 2 Iles, you can also book a stay in a modern mobile home or cottage. Looking for a unique vacation experience? Then stay in a floating water lodge. You simply can't get closer to the lake!

Enjoy a delicious meal and evening entertainment

Don't feel like cooking after a beautiful day of hiking or water sports in Haute-Vienne? At the campsite bar, you can enjoy delicious pizzas, burgers, salads, and some local specialties. During the summer, there is plenty of entertainment around the bar, such as magic shows, live music performances, and disco and karaoke nights. Even during the day, there is animation in the high season at Camping Paradis Les 2 Iles.

A true paradise for water sports fans

This is an ideal vacation spot for water sports enthusiasts. The campsite has its own beach, dock, and boat ramp at Lac de Vassivière. Water sports you can enjoy here include windsurfing, waterskiing, rafting, canoeing, kayaking, rowing, sailing, and of course, swimming.

properties.name: Camping Seasonova l'Étang des Bois
properties.description:
Do you prefer to spend your holiday in natural surroundings, far from the hustle and bustle of the city? Then definitely consider a stay at this quiet campsite in the Loiret, just south of Paris. Here you'll be camping on the edge of the vast forest area of La Forêt d'Orléans. You can go on wonderful hiking and cycling trips in this unspoilt environment. In addition, Seasonova l'Étang des Bois Campsite is located right next to a sandy beach on a beautiful recreational lake. This campsite has undergone extensive renovations since being taken over by the Seasonova chain in 2022.

Wooded grounds with large touring pitches

If you love the real camping life, then this is the campsite for you. After all, tourist camping pitches are clearly in the majority here. The spacious pitches are separated from each other by neatly maintained hedges. There is abundant shade thanks to the wooded location. There are also a number of accommodations for rent at this campsite, such as lodge tents and mobile homes.

Enjoy the beach life

You'll be camping right on the Étang des Bois recreational lake. The lake's large sandy beach is right next to the camping area. The lake is also a great place for fishing, windsurfing and canoeing.

Good food at the campsite restaurant

Right next to the lake is a cosy restaurant with a modest but tasty selection. You can go there for waffles, fries, snacks, ice cream and refreshing drinks. There's also a small shop on the campsite where you can get fresh bread every day.

properties.name: Camping Des Étangs
properties.description:
Camping Des Étangs is a quietly situated four star resort measuring only two hectares. You camp here at an elevation of almost two hundred metres and at a ten minute walk from the friendly, historic town of Aubigny-sur-Nère. In this region (the Sologne) you will find tranquillity, nature, castles, vineyards and an extensive array of historical heritage. The campsite is popular with both couples and families. The campsite has a very modest, but well-tended swimming pool. Some ten steps further you will find the elegantly situated lake, a swimming, fishing and recreational water in one.

A spacious pitch in the shade

On this quiet and small-scale campsite you will find 85 shaded or less shaded pitches. Everything is perfectly maintained. There are only spacious to very spacious pitches. The tall trees offer the ideal shade. The lake bordering the grounds is a lovely fishing spot. Suitable for swimming for all because of its shallow depth. You can also rent bungalows and chalets. 

Water fun galore

The lovely swimming pool on the campsite is eminently suitable for a quick refreshing dip. From the swimming pool you have a view of the small lake. This lends itself better for a proper swim. There is also a small river which flows behind the swimming pool. Would you like to spend a day in a really large swimming pool? If so, you can go the the municipal pool adjacent to the campsite. As a camping guest you will have access at a discounted fee.

Enjoy the French cuisine

The small supermarket is open only in high season, during which time you can also get daily fresh bread and pastries. The small supermarket, bar as well as the beautiful restaurant (French cuisine) are extremely well-kept.

properties.name: Camping Le Repos du Baladin
properties.description:
Camping Le Repos du Baladin is a small-scale family campsite in the Regional Natural Park of the Auvergne volcanoes. You'll find the campsite in the heart of Puy-de-Dôme, east of the medieval village of Murol. Here you camp on a spacious campsite, under the watchful eye of the Château de Murol. This castle, situated on a mountain, is a nice destination for a day trip.

Small-scale campsite with large grounds

Despite its small-scale character, the campsite is spacious. Behind the main building you first see a playground and the sanitary building, most of the touring pitches are situated behind it. In total there are sixty pitches; they all look different. The site is divided in several small fields, which are mostly flat, but increase slightly at the back. There, on the wooded slope, are most of the tent pitches. On the flat part you'll find comfort pitches and rental accommodations, separated from each other by thick hedges.

Outdoor and indoor pool

Just a cooling dip? To the left of the entrance are the two swimming pools. A spacious outdoor pool (heated, for when it's unexpectedly a little cooler) and an indoor pool. Probably the outdoor pool is warm enough, as it lies in the sun. Around the pool are sunbeds and some parasols.

Snack bar

The former inn does not only house the reception but also the snack bar.It is open in high season. Don't expect a three-course dinner, but it’s open for a good pizza or some fries from mid-June.You can also order fresh bread during the same period. Outside you'll find the covered patio.

properties.name: Camping Saint Gabriel
properties.description:
Camping Saint Gabriel, situated in the Provence, is a three star campsite with a difference. The campsite is compact (1.4 ha), with a lovely ambiance. You camp here in the vicinity of the small town of Tarascon, centrally located for excursions to famous sights. Just think of Arles, Avignon en Saint-Rémy (all inextricably linked with Vincent van Gogh).

Small, but well-tended grounds

The touring pitches of this campsite vary in size (also depending on the season). The pitches are separated by hedges. Don't have your own camping equipment? You can book a mobile home. 

Pleasant swimming

Camping Saint Gabriel is mostly frequented by adults who enjoy nature and the culture in the area. The elegant swimming pool (heated) offers welcome refreshment after a day out in the region. The pool measures 60 m2 and is open from mid April to 1st October. The swimming pool is attractively designed and is surrounded by lots of greenery. Around the pool is a terrace with a few sun umbrellas and loungers. 

Apart from the small toddler pool, there are no special amenities for children. Next to the swimming pool, in the open barn, is some fitness equipment.

Eating and drinking

There is a bar, a shop (fresh bread rolls available in the morning) and a reception. There is also a nice and affordable restaurant with a terrace in the courtyard. All dishes are very tasty. Once a week there is a wine tasting.

properties.name: Camping Seasonova Vesoul
properties.description:
Camping on a spacious, well-maintained pitch at a pleasant family campsite right by a large recreational lake and next to a beautiful outdoor swimming pool. That is what you can look forward to when you go camping at Camping Seasonova Vesoul. This campsite is ideal for both seniors and families with young and older children. This campsite is often used as a stopover on the way to the south, but during longer stays you will also have a great time here.

A warm welcome

When you arrive at the beautiful, spacious reception building at Camping Seasonova Vesoul, you will receive a warm welcome. You then drive along well laid out (and partly paved) paths to your pitch. You'll soon notice that the whole area is excellently maintained. A good start!

Pitches and accommodations for everyone

The very spacious and well-marked pitches on this campsite are separated by hedges and/or trees. In terms of privacy, this is a good place to be! There are 36 pitches especially for (heavy) motorhomes. In addition, there are various rental accommodations for two to six people, including some accommodations for people with limited mobility. Some pitches are situated almost directly on a branch of the Durgeon River.

Plenty of water fun right next to the campsite

The campsite is situated almost directly on the Lac de Vesoul. This recreational lake has a lovely sandy beach, which is right next to the campsite entrance! On this side of the lake there is a section that has been cordoned off so that you can swim safely. There is also a nice restaurant next to the beach. On the other side of the lake, in Montoille, there is a water sports centre.

properties.name: Camping Ile de Boulancourt
properties.description:
Camping Île de Boulancourt is just outside the village of the same name in the Île-de-France region, between Malesherbes and Puiseaux. Set in green, peaceful surroundings, the campsite is a great place to escape the hustle and bustle. Want a bit more life? Head to Paris for the day. The French capital is 87 km away. The campsite has well-kept grounds and you can choose your own pitch. Like peace and nature? Then this is the place for you!

Freedom and a variety of accommodation

The camping pitches at Camping Île de Boulancourt are large and on a natural site that’s largely unfenced. So, you can choose whether you prefer sun or shade. It’s also possible to rent a mobile home, cabin or chalet, a good solution if you are travelling without your own camping equipment. The pitches are simply furnished but well-maintained. The informal set-up and green character give the campsite a small and personal feel. A swimming pool is deliberately missing, to maintain the tranquillity of the site.

For people seeking peace and quiet and nature lovers

The facilities at this campsite are simple but clean and well-maintained. Environmental friendliness is a priority too. Energy and natural resources are used carefully. In high season, most guests are Dutch or German. Out of season, sports climbers flock to the area because of the climbing areas nearby. Thanks to its quiet, natural surroundings and eco-friendly approach, this campsite is popular with environmentally-aware campers.

properties.name: Camping Les Îles
properties.description:
Les Îles campsite is located in the Morbihan region, in the south of Brittany. This is a 5-star luxury campsite in an ideal location, right on the beach and five kilometres from the village of Pénestin. From the campsite you have direct access to the beach, so swimming in the sea is always an option. There are also several beaches nearby where you can look for sea creatures and shells.

Comfortable camping ... with sea view!

The pitches are mostly flat, grassy and well delimited by trees and hedges. Most pitches have a lot of shade. The pitches with panoramic sea views, which can be booked at an extra fee, have more sunshine.

Playfully designed swimming paradise

The large and heated swimming pool is one of the showpieces of this campsite. This is a playfully landscaped lagoon including a whirlpool and a paddling pool. Water fun is guaranteed here thanks to the family slide and the lazy river.

Top shows and sporting entertainment

In addition to swimming, there are many other opportunities for sporty entertainment. In the high season, for example, sports tournaments are organised on a daily basis. Camping Les Îles also offers a varied entertainment programme. Children can register with the children's club to show their singing and dancing skills on stage. There are also regular concerts, magic shows and themed meals.

Feast on local specialities

Next to the swimming pool you will find the charming restaurant. The menu consists mainly of local specialities with seafood and shellfish. Traditional meals such as meat dishes, salads and pizzas are also available. Furthermore, this campsite has a small supermarket with the most necessary groceries.

properties.name: Camping Les Écureuils
properties.description:
Les Écureuils is a beautiful 4-star campsite ideal for families with children of all ages. This campsite is located close to the centre and the beach of the village of La Bernerie-en-Retz. This is an area famous for its large tidal movements and the beaches that stand clear of the water as a result. The highlight of the campsite itself is the water park.

Well-maintained pitches

The campsite is divided into two parts. In the front part, most of the pitches are not far from the sanitary building. The pitches in the rear part have more shade thanks to the many trees. On this campsite, which also has a variety of mobile homes, chalets and lodge tents, you will mainly meet many French families with children.

Generous aquatic area

At this campsite, you can be sure that you will lack for nothing in terms of swimming pleasure. There are two spacious outdoor pools, a paddling pool and a real water playground. All pools are also heated. There is extra water fun thanks to the family slide and the water slide. Would you rather swim indoors? Then take a relaxing swim in the swimming pool, which is covered by a sliding roof. You can also swim in the sea, as the nearest beach is just a few hundred metres away.

Next to the water park there is a bar with pleasant outdoor seating where camping guests can relax and enjoy a snack and a drink. It is also possible to order takeaway meals.

Varied entertainment programmes

properties.name: Camping Le Parc
properties.description:
Camping Le Parc is situated in a forest with pine and oak trees, approximately four km from the town of Saint-Paul-en-Forêt (located in the Provence). The spacious pitches are located on the sloping terrain, demarcated with trees and stones. The furnished rental tents and chalets are in a separate section of the campsite. A large, but basic swimming pool with bubble bath and solarium, a mini golf course and a tennis court offer entertainment for young and old. In peak season activities such as water aerobics, sports tournaments and dance evenings are organised.

Family campsite with all amenities
