This family campsite with Provençal ambiance is quietly located in the hinterland of the Côte d’Azur and offers everything for a relaxing holiday for the entire family. There is a rectangular and spacious swimming pool for a refreshing dive and activities are organised in peak season. There is a mini club for the little ones offering craft activities and outdoor games.

Once a week there is a theme dinner evening, for instance mussels with fries, paella or couscous. At the snack bar you can order pizzas, French fries, grilled meat and salads. The campsite shop has fresh bread and a basic assortment of groceries.

Different types of accommodation

At Le Parc you can rent furnished bungalow tents, mobile homes and chalets. The Trigano is a basic model for up to five persons, the lodge tent is attractive and more spacious with a deck terrace and wooden garden furniture. You have the luxury of a real bed, yet you are still close to nature. Some evenings you can hear the chirping of crickets... If you prefer to have your own sanitary facilities, you can choose between comfortable wooden chalets or mobile homes.

properties.name: Camping Huttopia Calvados - Normandie
properties.description:
Next to the park-like estate of a castle, on the border of the departments of Calvados and Eure, you’ll find campsite Le Colombier. Here you camp in the green countryside of Normandy, between woods and apple orchards. The Normandy half-timbered houses in which the reception and épicerie are located make the site a cheerful place. With play areas, beautiful nature and calvados distilleries nearby, this campsite is suitable for the whole family.

Peace and space

On the campsite you will only find touring pitches. These are spacious and flat. From the pitches you can look far ahead over the spacious lawns, which are enclosed by tall trees. Peace and quiet prevail here: you are far away from busy roads and tourist cities. The campsite is next to the estate of a castle. This estate is no longer accessible to camping guests. A pity, because the park-like castle gardens are beautifully landscaped. Especially the private swimming pool, situated at the foot of a turret and between tightly cut lawns, is a picture.

Young and old sports enthusiasts

Young and older sports enthusiasts will have a great time at the campsite. You can play football and basketball on the multi-sports field. Next to it is the playground and a little further on there are some table tennis tables. On the mini-golf course the whole family can play a game of golf.

Calvados and cider

There is a small shop on the campsite. For the nearest larger supermarket you have to drive ten minutes to the north. Calvados is of course the region of the well known drink, so you will come across many calvados distilleries and cider farms nearby. The first one is just around the corner.

properties.name: Flower Camping Moulin des Iscles
properties.description:
Flower campsite Moulin des Iscles is located by the water's edge of the Argens River, nestled amidst French nature. An oasis of peace and tranquillity in the Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur, one of France's most touristy regions. On this small-scale campsite you stay in unspoiled nature, between large trees and on the bank of the river. With charming Provençal villages and towns close by and only a fifteen minute drive away from the white beaches of the Mediterranean Sea.

Congenial and authentic

The congenial appearance of the campsite and its owners contribute towards its amicable atmosphere. The campsite is modest but authentic. Spacious camping pitches, some of which on the water's edge, are provided with ample shade by full trees. With some eighty touring pitches to choose from, the campsite is modestly sized.

Canoeing on the Argens

You do not need a swimming pool, with the Argens river flowing past the campsite. The Argens is very suitable for swimming, but it may be even more fun to take your canoe onto the water. Fishing is also excellent there.

Small-scale conviviality

The entertainment programme is as unpretentious as the campsite. A long table on the square, a glass of wine and some music: you don't need more for an convivial evening. During the day you can take part in a pétanque tournament.

Home cooking

An enjoyable evening outdoors goes hand in hand with great food. You can leave this in the capable hands of the campsite owner. She does the cooking herself and can rustle up delicious meals. The restaurant is housed in that beautiful building covered with climbers. You can really relax on its lovely terrace.

properties.name: Camping Le Val d'Hérault
properties.description:
Camping Le Val d'Hérault is located on the edge of the Cévennes, near the friendly village of Brissac (Hérault). The campsite’s facilities include an outdoor swimming pool, restaurant, supermarket and sports and games facilities. While here, you can also enjoy the peace and quiet of the southern French countryside. You will camp right by the river Hérault and in a wooded area, where many beautiful walks and cycle routes are possible. For example, to the Pont de Saint-Étienne d'Issensac, an eleventh-century bridge over the Hérault.

Shady site with large pitches

At the entrance to the campsite, you’ll find the restaurant, reception and the swimming pool. The large campsite is located behind this and has beautiful pitches in the shade of centuries-old oak trees. The camping fields are small. There are several special comfort pitches with private toilet and washing facilities. Naturally, you will also have your own toilet and washing facilities if you book one of the modern mobile homes or chalets.

Swimming in natural water or swimming pool. Which will you choose?

If you enjoy swimming and water sports, this campsite is for you. The banks of the Hérault, with its own sandy beach, are a short walk from the campsite. Take a refreshing dip in the shallow, slow-flowing river water or go canoeing, kayaking or rafting. Head to the lovely outdoor pool for even more water fun. You can also enjoy a meal at the adjacent restaurant or a drink at the bar. There’s also a small supermarket, a mini library and various sports and game facilities.

properties.name: Flower Camping Domaine de Pendruc
properties.description:
Finistère is one of the most beautiful regions of the French peninsula of Brittany. The campsite is located in a quiet area just 800 metres from the Atlantic Ocean and close to the town of Concarneau. Here, you can combine a wonderful beach holiday with visits to atmospheric, historic places. Flower Camping Domaine de Pendruc is a real family campsite with something for everyone. There is a spacious outdoor pool with slides, an indoor heated pool, and a paddling pool for the little ones. Many activities are organised, such as water polo tournaments, aqua gym sessions, a scuba diving course and archery.

Camping in comfort

Flower Camping Domaine de Pendruc has a neat, modern appearance with many trees and hedges that ensure privacy. At the campsite, you can choose from 38 spacious shaded, semi-shaded or fully sunlit pitches. The pitches have an area of 80 – 100 m². There are also some pitches with private sanitary facilities. Would you like a little extra comfort? Then choose a mobile home with a capacity of two to eight people. At the campsite, you can use the free Wi-Fi. The sanitary facilities are modern and clean.

Good meals

Don't feel like cooking every night? No problem! Domaine de Pendruc has a restaurant where you can enjoy a hamburger, a pizza or a pancake. You can also have breakfast at this campsite. The bar with veranda and pergola is the ideal place to get together for a drink, a game of billiards or table football.

properties.name: Flower Camping Le Val Vert en Berry
properties.description:
At the edge of the Indre region, on the banks of the river of the same name, lies Camping Le Val Vert en Berry. This small-scale family campsite - which has the European Ecolabel and the Camping Quality label - is located in a green valley a few kilometres from the charming village of Le Châtre. The surroundings served as inspiration for the French writer George Sand in the eighteenth century. Come and visit us and you will soon see why she was so attached to this stitch.

Friendliness and plenty of space

This terraced campsite exudes luxury and looks very well cared for. The pitches are spacious and you can choose between a shady or a sunny pitch. There are also some log cabins for rent. The sanitary facilities on the campsite are well maintained.

Regional products

Camping Le Val Vert en Berry is strongly linked to the region. This is also reflected in the campsite restaurant. Here, they mainly use local products and serve tasty side dishes. To enjoy the beautiful surroundings while eating, the campsite has a terrace where you can dine under parasols.

From bungee jumping to fishing

On the various lawns at the campsite you can kick a ball or play badminton. For the smaller children, there is a nice field with some playground equipment. But there are also plenty of activities in the vicinity of the campsite. Daredevils can go tree climbing, kayaking or bungee jumping. Or go fishing in one of the surrounding lakes. Back at the campsite, you can cool off in the lovely swimming pool.

properties.name: Camping La Grisse
properties.description:
In the midst of the green interior of the Vendée you'll find the small, quiet farm campground of La Grisse. By car you can be at the sandy beaches of Longeville-sur-Mer in about 10 minutes. The simple campground is spacious with plenty of greenery and trees with very large campsites. The campground is an oasis of peace with many lovely excursions in the nearby area for children and adults.

Very spacious sites

You'll find very spacious sites on the green campground. The campsites are not very separate from each other, but because you have so much space, you have privacy. You have a very large site (180 to 300 m2) and camp on the flat grass among the trees. The sites are not very different from each other, but you do have variations in the shade.

Barbecue

The farm campsite is popular with the French, but also Dutch, Belgian and English young families and seniors come here for the peace and quiet. The owner invites the guests for a drink once a week in the high season. There is a convivial barbeque for guests looking for a lively evening, for a fee.

Bread and play

Only the necessities in groceries are sold at the receptions. The baker delivers fresh bread every morning at 9:00 a.m. You only have to drive 6 km for larger shops. Bikes are available for hire on the campground for a tour over the gravel paths.

There are various small playgrounds and a partially covered recreation space for kids and adults. You can play beach volleyball and a game of table tennis here. There are swings, slides, a sandbox and a bouncy castle for the kids.

properties.name: Camping Huttopia Vallée du Lot
properties.description:
Do you like to spend your holidays in nature on a spacious camping pitch? If so, Huttopia Vallée du Lot campsite in Saint-Étienne-de-Villeréal (Lot-et-Garonne, near the border with Dordogne) is an ideal holiday destination. On this well-maintained campsite, pitches and accommodation are far apart, so you benefit from plenty of space and privacy. Here, you camp in an unspoilt environment, far from motorways, traffic noise and big cities. The campsite's facilities include a heated outdoor pool, a small lake and a varied entertainment programme.

Spacious camping pitches

Even before you drive onto the campsite, you reach the reception, which is in an authentic building. This building is on a hill from which you have a good view of the lower campsite. The camping pitches are centrally located on the campsite, while the safari tents and chalets are located around them. Some pitches and chalets face the lake.

Splash in the outdoor pool and enjoy entertainment

Campers of all ages have a great time at this Huttopia campsite. Go for a swim in the heated swimming pool. Or visit the Centre de Vie, a cosy recreation room where you can have breakfast, play a game and enjoy a drink. There is also a bar serving delicious pizzas.

In high season, the campsite also organises all kinds of activities. Children can build tree houses together, do crafts, archery and track in the forest. The open-air cinema, music performances and theatre shows provide fun for the whole family. In the evening, there are regular campfires by the lake, where you can enjoy the most beautiful sunsets.

properties.name: Camping Aux Coeurs Vendéens
properties.description:
On the Atlantic coast in the Vendée, less than a kilometre from the Atlantic Ocean, you will find Camping Aux Coeurs Vendéens. A ten minute walk will take you to the beach. At this well-kept family campsite, you can choose a shady or sunny pitch, where you camp in peace and quiet. You'll also find relaxation in the hammam or sauna, while the children can have fun in the indoor and outdoor swimming pool.

Shady or sunny pitch

At the tidy campsite you can see that the owners take great care of their campsite. You can choose a shady or sunny pitch of different sizes. There are around fifty pitches on the campsite, as well as almost seventy rental accommodations. Perfect for a comfortable camping holiday with children: one of the equipped mobile homes or chalets.

Quiet family campsite

Camping Aux Coeurs Vendéens is a real family campsite, but it is nice and quiet. Especially in high season children are well represented. In low season it's mainly seniors who visit the campsite and the Atlantic coast.

Swimming for the whole family

When you enter the campsite you can already see them: the swimming pools. Let your children go, because they will want to run straight to them! In addition to a spacious outdoor pool, there is also an indoor pool with a sliding roof that can be partially opened when the weather is nice. A place for the whole family to enjoy swimming. A paddling pool with a small slide provides fun for the little ones. For total relaxation you can also make free use of the hammam, sauna and whirlpool.

properties.name: Huttopia Barcelona Pirineos
properties.description:
Camping El Berguedà is in the Catalonia hinterland, bordering the Cadí-Moixeró nature park. It is a small-scale campsite amid the stunning countryside, making it ideal for nature lovers and active campers. You can go on lovely walks from the campsite. The campsite has all the amenities you need as a camper. A bar, swimming pool and sporting options.

Camping with river views

At Camping El Berguedà, you can enjoy a holiday with your own camping equipment or stay in one of the characteristic wooden log cabins. The campsite is in natural green surroundings with many trees. A small river flows at the rear of the campsite. Most of the pitches have a view of the water. A walking route also starts from the campsite, which runs past the river.

Drinks at the campsite

There is a swimming pool that campsite guests can use during the summer months. It's ideal for cooling down on days when the Spanish sun is at its best. Furthermore, there is a bar where you can order snack platters as well as drinks. If you'd prefer to make your own snack platter, the small campsite shop has the basic necessities and a bread service.

Sports at the campsite

Campsite guests can have fun playing sports on the multisport field. There is also a place for recreation on rainy days. The indoor space has tables and chairs so you can play board games. There is also a table football table and billiards table to challenge your (camping) friends to a game.

properties.name: Camping Seasonova de La Forêt
properties.description:
Do you prefer spending your holiday in a peaceful setting, far from the hustle and bustle of the city and the constant traffic noise from highways? Then this campsite located in the Sarthe is the place for you! Seasonova de La Forêt Campsite is situated in the middle of a vast forest region. Here you can take beautiful walks in the woods, but also just enjoy the peace and quiet. The campsite is located on a beautiful recreational lake, which offers a wide range of activities for water sports enthusiasts. Venture from the lake's sandy beach into its cool waters for a nice refreshing dip.

Spacious campsites

Tourist camping pitches are the most abundant type of accommodation offered at Seasonova de La Forêt Campsite. There is a nice selection of spacious camping pitches here, which are neatly demarcated from each other. Some of the touring pitches are in sunny spots, while others are located in the shade.

Recreational lake with watersports activities

This campsite is ideally situated for lovers of watersports and water recreation. You'll be camping right along the Le Grand Étang recreational lake. You can go canoeing, sailing and pedal boating on this lake. Moreover, the campsite is just a few minutes' walk from a lovely sandy beach. From there you can take a nice refreshing dip in the lake.

Fine food and drink

You can get tasty snacks at the Coco-Plage Café at the edge of the beach. Not far from there is a restaurant with a cosy terrace. The campsite itself features a small shop with a modest range of foodstuffs. You can also order breakfast here.

properties.name: Camping De la Côte des Légendes
properties.description:
In Brignogan-Plage, on perhaps the most beautiful part of the northern coast of Finistère (Brittany) is the Camping De la Côte des Légendes. This three-star campsite is an excellent starting point for walks and bike rides along the North Brittany coastline. This is an ideal holiday location for beach lovers. Because the campsite is located on a large beach with water sports centre.

Accommodation in themed gardens

Tourist pitches dominate this park-like campsite. The pitches have a surface of neatly cut grass and are separated by high hedges, giving you plenty of privacy. Furthermore, the campsite rents out several dozen holiday homes. These special cottages are spread across four themed gardens: the Flower Garden, the Dune Garden, the Aromatic Garden and the Exotic Garden. Does this appeal to you? Choose your favourite garden and book a cottage there!

Plenty of fun and water sports opportunities

For water sports enthusiasts, this campsite is an ideal holiday destination. Here there is direct access to a large sandy beach with a water sports centre. From there, you can sail, windsurf, kayak, supp and kitesurf. This Centre Nautique also runs courses.

On the campsite itself, you will find an atmospheric recreation room with board games, puzzles and a mini library. There is also a bar where tasty pizzas are available in high season. In summer, there is plenty of entertainment. For example, for children up to 12 years, there are games, sports competitions, craft sessions, cooking workshops, music-making and dancing. For adults, excursions along the coastline and the music performances are fun.

properties.name: Camping Le Gouffre de la Croix
Camping Paradis Les Gorges du Haut Bugey
properties.description:
The cosy terrace campsite Camping Paradis Les Gorges du Haut Bugey is located on the shores of the lake of Samognat, in the green foothills of the Jura mountains (Ain Departement). The spacious pitches on grass are separated from each other by hedges and accessible via sloping paths. The exquisite vista over the reservoir and the hills is striking, and you have a view higher up of the swimming pool with toddler's pool and Jacuzzi.

View of the lake

The pitches at Camping Paradis Les Gorges du Haut Bugey are laid out on terraces so you will have a beautiful view of the lake and the surrounding green hills. To provide you with the privacy you need, the pitches, which always offer some shade, are demarcated with hedges. Some pitches are located along the lake and are completely free to choose from.

Luxury accommodation

Two well-maintained sanitary blocks offer showers, toilets, lavatories, a bathroom for babies and a lavatory for handicapped persons. For campers without their own tent or caravan, there are wooden chalets and mobile homes for rent, both with their own sanitary facilities and covered veranda.

Active holiday

Young and old alike will enjoy themselves at the water park, featuring a large heated swimming pool, a heated play pool with water spouts, a rapids run and a paddling pool (for toddlers only). Thanks to the location, you will have a magnificent view of the upper part of the grounds, right from your lounger.

Sports lovers can play to their heart's content at the football and volleyball pitch or work on their table tennis or jeu de boules skills. Fishing enthusiasts can cast their lines on the banks of the lake. In the evening during high season, the whole family can get together at theme nights (including dance and karaoke).

properties.name: Camping du Lac
properties.description:
Camping du Lac is situated in a peaceful setting near the pretty village of Pouzauges in the French Vendée region. Here, you can camp on the shores of a lovely lake, which has a designated swimming area. Planning a visit to the famous Puy du Fou theme park? Then you’ve come to the right place. It’s only a 15-minute drive from the campsite.

A holiday by the water

All the pitches are within walking distance of the lake. For motorhomes, there are separate, hard-surfaced pitches with a view of the water. Or choose one of the lovely mobile homes, which are fully furnished and clad in wood on the outside. Looking for a little more luxury? Then book the mobile home with its own jacuzzi.

Refreshing splash in the lake

When you visit Camping du Lac, you’ll be staying at a simple campsite. So don’t expect a swimming pool or extensive facilities. However, you’ll be able to enjoy the lake to the full. There’s a small sandy beach where you can take a refreshing dip in the water. Or you can simply lie on your towel with a good book. Need to do some shopping? There are various shops in the nearby village.

Hiking and Puy du Fou theme park

Do you enjoy walking? There are no fewer than 60 hiking routes in the immediate vicinity of the campsite. For example, to the Mont des Alouettes, the highest point in the region. At the top, you can enjoy a picturesque panorama. The Vendée region is hilly, with varied natural scenery, and is known, among other things, for its many Renaissance castles.

properties.name: Camping Les Tournesols
properties.description:
Camping Les Tournesols is a park-like campsite in Le Grez, close to the charming village of Sillé-le-Guillaume. This region is loved by people wanting peace and quiet and nature lovers. The campsite is situated in a rural setting and close to a large recreational lake with a sandy beach. In high season this is an ideal family campsite.

Neat, spacious pitches

The pitches on this park-like campsite are well-kept. You will find them both with and without shade. Would you like to give yourself some extra space and luxury? Then go for an XXL pitch and benefit from optimal privacy. In addition to touring pitches, this campsite has a number of beautiful mobile homes and lodge tents for rent.

Plenty of water fun

On this campsite you will find a beautiful swimming pool of which the water is heated to 28°C. It is not very big, but still pleasant to cool off. If you want more swimming space, visit Le Grand Étang. This is a large recreational lake with a beautiful sandy beach (Sillé Plage) three kilometres from the campsite.

Entertainment and other diversion

In the high season, there are events organised to entertain campers of all ages. A disco evening is organised once a week and you can participate in the weekly laser game. Every now and then a large slide mat, which serves as a water slide, is brought to the campsite. This often results in hilarious moments!

Catering

The campsite offers a convenient bread service, so you don't have to leave the site for fresh bread. You can also go to the (snack) bar for pizzas, fries, snacks, ice creams and drinks.

properties.name: Camping Du Bois de St. Hilaire
properties.description:
Are you looking for the tranquillity and space of the French countryside? You will find it at Camping Du Bois de Saint Hilaire, located in the French department of Vienne. You can also swim some lengths in the swimming pool or take a leisurely walk in the forest. The area is very suitable for cycling trips as well.

Camping in the forest

The campsite is easy to reach via the N-149, which leads you through a hilly and green landscape to an oak forest. The campsite is well maintained, with respect being paid to the natural vegetation of shrubs and tall trees. The pathways are partly unpaved and the pitches are very spacious. Each pitch is demarcated with natural vegetation, providing privacy and shade. There are some occasional picnic tables. Rental accommodation consists of a Mongolian yurt and luxuriously furnished glamping tents.

Swimming pool

The swimming pool is a standard type pool, but provides sufficient playing and swimming fun during warm days. It is located in full sun, so sunblock cream is recommended. It is surrounded by loungers with sun umbrellas where you can enjoy reading a book in peace.

Entertainment in various forms

The campsite has a mini golf course, two playgrounds and a recreation area with a table tennis table, table football game, pool table, small library and TV. No excuse to be bored here! You can go for fabulous walks in the adjacent forest.

Pizza from the wood-fired oven

On the campsite you can get a snack or a pizza from the wood-fired oven. There is also fresh bread daily. You will find a supermarket, a bakery and a snack bar within walking distance.

properties.name: Camping Seasonova L'Etang de la Vallée
properties.description:
Camping in a peaceful environment and wooded setting, right next to a lovely recreational lake with a large sandy beach. That's what Seasonova L'Étang de la Vallée Campsite stands for. This campsite is located in the Loire Valley (Loiret department), in the wooded area east of Orleans. Here, you can take numerous scenic biking and hiking trips, while the aforementioned lake offers opportunities for swimming and boating.

Spacious pitches with natural boundaries

At the front of the campsite, you'll find the reception where you'll be welcomed by friendly managers. The pitches at this site are of varying sizes, although they are generally spacious. They are separated by hedges and trees. Thirty sites have been stabilised and thus made ready for RVers. Pets are welcome on pitches, but not in rental accommodations.

Visit the local produce market

In high season, you can get bread and some groceries and take-out at this campsite. In addition, in July and August, there's a fun local produce market at the campsite every week. For extensive shopping, it's best to drive to the village of Fay-aux-Loges. That will take you about fifteen minutes.

From outdoor recreation to old-fashioned board games

When you stay at L'Étang de la Vallée, you certainly don't always have to leave the grounds for recreation and relaxation. Among other things, this campsite offers miniature golf, table tennis, a playground and a bocce court. You can borrow table tennis paddles and bocce balls at the reception. In addition, they lend out various board games there. Always fun, especially for days with not so nice weather!

properties.name: Camping du Château
properties.description:
Camping du Château is in the captivating town of Falaise, in the centre of Normandy (Calvados department). This quiet, small campsite is the ideal place to stay when visiting Falaise and its medieval castle and centre. There are also lovely walking and cycling routes in the surrounding area. Good to know: the opening times of the barrier coincide with the arrival and departure times of ferries from nearby Ouistreham.

Authentic municipal campsite for touring campers

If you are a fan of authentic camping life, this is the place for you. That’s because this municipal campsite only has tourist pitches. Each pitch is at least eighty square metres in size and has views of the surrounding hills. Château de Falaise is on one of these hills and there is a clear view of it from all the pitches. some of the pitches are on the banks of a small river.

What can you do at this campsite?

What to do if you return to the campsite happy but also a little tired after a great walk through the city or nature? Then head to the recreation room to unwind. Settle down in one of the recliners and borrow a good book from the mini library. This meeting room has a pool table and a TV too. The campsite also has a lovely playground, a table tennis table and a small supermarket.

Visit the castle

Once you have taken in the view of Château de Falaise, you will probably want to take a closer look at it. Go on a guided tour of this 11th-century castle, where William the Conqueror once lived.

properties.name: Camping Ruisseau du Treil
properties.description:
Camping Ruisseau du Treil is situated in a charming little valley on the banks of the Treil. You camp here in the middle of the countryside, close to the river Lot. The campsite looks like an English park, with well-kept flower beds and lawns. It is the influence of the warm-hearted British owners. Relax in one of the swimming pools or admire the starry sky. For a day out, drive to Cajarc and Figeac.

A touch of England

The friendly owners have brought a touch of England to the south of France. The natural campsite looks like a spacious English garden. Beautifully tended lawns lie between the tall trees. Flower beds add to the brightness of the place. Everything is well-taken care of. But nature is also given the freedom to bloom abundantly. In the midst of all this nature, you can camp on spacious pitches. Or in one of the modern lodge tents.

Fine spot for a swim

Two swimming pools are situated in a clearing surrounded by trees. They provide an intimate spot for a cool dip. Here you can swim and splash with your children in peace and quiet. After a swim, dry off on a sun lounger.

Two billion star campsite

Camping Ruisseau du Treil is situated far from the hustle and bustle and the urbanised world. In the evening it is very quiet and it is completely dark. Get out of your tent or caravan and look up. Without all those city lights, the starry sky is impressive. Millions of stars can be seen in the sky, shining above the French mountains. Owner Nigel calls his campsite the 'two billion stars campsite'.

properties.name: Camping Les Castors
properties.description:
Camping Les Castors is a family campsite in the village of Burnhaupt-le-Haut in the Alsace. You can camp here on spacious pitches or stay in a modern accommodation. The natural lake provides water fun and in the restaurant, open throughout the year, you can have a meal and enjoy the ambiance. Camping Les Castors is easily reached. Coming from the D83, take the exit towards the D483. Then follow the road on the Route de Guewenheim. After a while, you will see the signpost for the campsite.

A refreshing dive

The pitches on the campsite have a minimum size of 100 m². Whether you want to stand in the shade of the tall trees or with the sun shining on your head, Camping Les Castors will have a spot for you. You can also choose a spot along the water, lovely for a refreshing dive in the morning.

Natural lake

One of the campsite's favourite features is the natural lake, an excellent spot for swimming and sunbathing. The river Doller, which flows north of the camping, also makes for good swimming. You can also cast a line here and catch a few fish.

The heart of the campsite

The restaurant may well be considered the heart of the campsite. Here, great evenings and themed dinners are organised and delicacies served. Furthermore, the restaurant is open throughout the year, so you can enjoy a pizza or 'tarte flambée’ in any season.

properties.name: La Pindière
properties.description:
La Pindière is located in the quiet surroundings of Nantes, close to the beach,. This well-tended campsite is an ideal camping destination for families. You will camp on green pitches surrounded by neat hedges. With a covered, heated swimming pool, you can enjoy diving and splashing around. For A day at the beach is less than a one hour drive away.

Well-kept campsite with spacious pitches

Taut hedges, green lawns and nicely laid out paths... La Pindière is a well-tended campsite, and it shows in everything. The owners have a beautiful, spacious pitch for you. So you can camp in a nice spot where you can enjoy your holiday in peace and quiet. Would you like to add a special touch to your holiday in France? Then spend the night in a lovely gypsy caravan.

A warm pool and a day at the beach

Jump into a nice warm pool! The campsite has a heated, covered swimming pool. The whole family can enjoy a dip in the water here. Part of the pool is shallow. So the little ones can also enjoy splashing around. Please note that it is compulsory to wear a speedo. Looking for a bigger pool? Then drive to the sea! The Atlantic Ocean is only 45 minutes away. Take your bath towel and bikini and drive to Saint-Nazaire or Pornichet.

Do your shopping on foot

For the groceries you get on your bike or you go on foot. There is a large supermarket just outside Héric. Héric is also the place to go for your daily croissants. Next to the church in the centre you will find a traditional boulangerie.

properties.name: Camping La Forêt Lahitte
properties.description:
Camping La Forêt Lahitte is a family campsite near the towns of Biscarrosse (8.5 km) and Parentis-en-Born (4 km) in the Landes region. You’ll be camping on the edge of a forest and opposite a large lake. Here you can swim and go canoeing. The campsite itself has a swimming pool and a snack bar. In the surrounding area you’ll find beautiful beaches on the Atlantic coast, miles of woodland and authentic French villages. Ideal for a bike ride or a lovely walk.

Camping amid the trees

Anyone looking for a peaceful spot in nature will feel right at home here. The flat camping pitches are surrounded by a pine forest, and the beautiful Lake Parentis is just 200 metres away. There are also all sorts of glamping options. For example, you can choose a holiday in a Coco Sweet tent or a mobile home.

Go for a swim in the sea or swimming pool

Do you enjoy swimming? The choice is yours: would you rather swim in the pool or in the natural lake? The campsite has a separate paddling pool for toddlers with water games. By the lake, there are lovely spots for sunbathing or picnicking. The lake is also popular for fishing and water sports, such as canoeing and windsurfing. There are a number of cafés and restaurants near the small harbour. During the summer months, fun activities are organised for all ages. And if, after a lovely day’s holiday, you fancy grilling a nice piece of meat, why not use the communal barbecue? The campsite also has a snack bar where you can enjoy a bite to eat and a drink.

properties.name: Camping Le Moulin du Bel-Air
properties.description:
Relax and enjoy the charm of the French countryside in the heart of the Lot. You'll be staying in a beautiful wooded and hilly area. Le Moulin du Bel-Air Campsite is built around an 18th century watermill and is located on the banks of the Céou River. You can go swimming in the river and enjoy water sports, such as canoeing or kayaking.

Spacious campsite

When you arrive at Le Moulin du Bel-Air Campsite, you will be kindly welcomed by the owners Anne and Thibaud. The 71 spacious camping pitches of at least 150 m² are flat and covered with grass. The pitches are surrounded by trees, and you can choose a spot in the shade or in the sun. There is an electrical connection. There is also enough space to park your car. You can even celebrate a holiday together with your four-legged friend at this campsite. Are you a fan of glamping? Then you can rent one of the beautifully furnished lodge tents. The chalets are suitable for people with reduced mobility.

Entertainment for young and old

There is plenty to do at the campsite for both young and old alike. There is a lovely heated swimming pool, a tennis court, children can play on one of the playgrounds and you can fish in the pond near the campsite. There are also a wide range of activities organised, such as sporting events, quizzes and evening shows. To satisfy your cravings, you can go to the campsite brasserie, where you can get fresh rolls and croissants each morning.

properties.name: Wellness Sport Camping Loudenvielle
properties.description:
Wellness Sport Camping Loudenvielle is located in the middle of the French Pyrenees, not far from the Spanish border. This well-maintained terraced campsite has a spacious terrain, surrounded by a beautiful view of the mountains and the nearby lake. If you like sports and wellness, then this is the place for you. The wide, sunny valley in which the campsite is situated is the starting point for up to thirty hikes and mountain tours. Both in high and low season you can enjoy various wellness facilities at the campsite and in the surrounding area.

Terrace campsite with a view

A large part of the well-kept campsite consists of new mobile homes. Many of them are rental accommodations, but there are also some occupied by regular guests. In addition, spacious touring pitches are available for campers. The campsite is laid out in terraces, so there are many different levels. This gives you a panoramic view of the surrounding mountains from almost every pitch. The pitches are neatly laid out, well-maintained and some have some shade.

Restaurants in the village.

In the modern main building you will find not only the reception, but also a recreation room and a bar. There are some groceries for sale and in the summer months you can get fresh bread daily. There is also a restaurant where you can order some simple menus, snacks and takeaway food. In the village you will find more restaurants.

properties.name: Camping Lac de Carouge
properties.description:
Just inside Savoie, bordering the Haute Savoie and close to St. Pierre-d’Albigny, you will find the picturesque Camping Lac de Carouge. The campsite is situated on the lake with the same name. The Haute-Savoie is a very mountainous region which includes the Mont Blanc massif on the Italian/French border. The campsite therefore forms an excellent base for excursions in this challenging region.

Nature, Confort or Privilège

On the grounds you can choose between pitches of 90-140 m2 in the categories ‘Nature’, ‘Confort’ (= ‘Nature’ + electricity) or ‘Privilège’ (= ‘Confort’ + water). This makes the campsite ideal for an extended stay. It is advisable to book your preference in advance (online) to secure your pitch. In peak season the choice will be limited when you arrive unexpectedly. The campsite also has chalets, safari tents and mobile homes for rental, all with their own shower/toilet.

For the children

Camping Lac de Carouge is very suitable for families with (young) children, with lots of activities organised by the enthusiastic camping employees. Each day (excluding Saturdays) there is a Kids Club and sports and games activities are organised for the slightly older children. In addition, camping guests have free access to the nearby municipal swimming pool (800 m). Naturally, you can also swim (supervised in summer), go pedal boating or fishing in the lake.

Activities

Each week special mountain excursions are organised (at a fee) under the supervision of qualified guides. For instance, mountain excursions on a via ferrata (secured climbing trip) or canyoning along wildly churning brooks and rivers.

properties.name: Flower Camping St. Martin
properties.description:
Flower Camping St. Martin is in the village of Sorèze in the Tarn, within walking distance of the medieval centre and at the base of the richly wooded mountain ranges. This small-scale campsite is an ideal starting point for taking wonderful forest walks and for doing mountain sports. After a lovely day in the countryside, you can relax and unwind at the campsite. You can do that in the outdoor swimming pool, for example, in the atmospheric cafeteria and with the activities organised in the high season.

Neatly maintained site with lots of natural greenery

A well-maintained campsite with plenty of natural greenery has been created under the hospitable owners' management. Most of the spacious camping pitches are separated by bushes and hedges. Not only can you book a lovely pitch at Flower Camping St. Martin, but also a stay in a charming caravan, chalet, gypsy wagon or safari tent.

Themed evenings and a wonderful swimming pool

There is a lovely swimming pool at the front of the campsite. It's an ideal spot for a refreshing swim or doing some laps. The snack bar is by the swimming pool, where you can enjoy tasty pizzas, tacos, chips, ice creams and drinks. Two breakfast packages are also available. Furthermore, there is a small shop selling regional products and where you can borrow books and board games.

Fun themed evenings are organised in the high season, such as a big barbecue or mussels and chips, and live music. Other entertainment at Flower Camping St. Martin is the shape of sports tournaments and creative workshops.

properties.name: Camping des Lacs
properties.description:
Camping des Lacs is situated in Saint-Jean-de-Chevelu (Rhône-Alpes), a village in the green east of France. Tourism here is mainly about fun in the water. You will be camping at the two lakes of Saint-Jean-de-Chevelu, and the river Méline will be flowing past. There are also several lakes close to your camping pitch, including the gigantic Lac du Bourget (3 km), Lac d'Aiguebelette (20 km) or the very popular Lac d'Annecy (50 km). You won't be bored on dry land either. In the high season, the campsite has a great entertainment and excursion programme.

Spacious campsite

The grounds of Camping des Lacs are large and mainly consist of grassland with many trees. With nearly a hundred pitches for campers, you're in an average-size campsite here. But what is definitely not average is the size of the pitches. At 100-150 m2, they are definitely spacious! Trees and hedges near your pitch provide the necessary shade and privacy. From your pitch, you can look out over the green hills that surround the campsite. Are you coming without your own camping equipment? Then you can stay in one of the mobile homes, lodge tents or hiker's huts. They come in several comfort levels.

Fun in the water

The fact that there is no swimming pool on the campsite proper isn't a problem at all. You just jump into the adjacent swimming lake. The bank consists of sand and grass. Children can also play in the shallow Méline river. If you get hungry, you can get something at the snack bar. A supermarket can be found in Yenne, a town about six kilometres away.

properties.name: Camping Domaine de Bel Air
properties.description:
This campsite is located in green, flowery surroundings, near the town of Landudec in western Brittany. This is an area known for its pretty villages, extensive hiking opportunities and lovely mild climate. Furthermore, Camping Domaine de Bel Air is a true family campsite. Particularly in the high season, you will come across many families with children here. This is partly due to the spectacular indoor and outdoor pools and the varied entertainment programme.

Beautifully laid-out touring pitches with lots of comfort

On this campsite you will find dozens of pitches for tourist campers. These spacious pitches are nicely separated by hedges and flowering plants. There are touring pitches in four comfort levels. If you choose a Premium Suite or a Premium Suite XL, you will have your own bathroom facilities at your pitch. Your bathroom unit has a lovely shower cabin, a washbasin with sink, a toilet and a small fridge.

Furthermore, this campsite offers numerous permanent annual pitches and rental accommodation. Most of these are mobile homes but there is also some special accommodation, such as a wigwam and Coco Sweet lodge tents.

Two indoor pools and playfully designed outdoor pool

A key feature of the campsite is a lovely outdoor swimming pool, whose water is heated in the summer months. This is a playfully designed pool where - thanks in part to the geyser rock, water cannon and paddling pool - old-fashioned splashing fun is guaranteed. Besides this outdoor pool, you will also find two indoor pools, including a new one with built-in whirlpools. The other (circular) indoor pool has a sliding roof.

properties.name: Camping Seasonova du Chêne
properties.description:
Camping Seasonova du Chêne is in the hospitable town of Saint-Julien-de-Concelles, just outside the large city of Nantes (Pays de la Loire region). This campsite is in the perfect location for visiting Nantes. You can drive to the centre in about 20 minutes and it takes just under an hour to cycle there. Moreover, the campsite is only a few kilometres from Loire à Vélo, the tourist cycle route along the Loire. The campsite has a peaceful character and is in a lovely setting, right by a recreational lake. Here, you can do all kinds of water sports, such as standup paddleboarding, windsurfing, kayaking and pedal boating. Fishing enthusiasts can cast a line in the lake.

Spacious touring pitches and various types of accommodation

At Camping Seasonova du Chêne tourist pitches are available both in the sun as well as in the shade. You can also stay in a modern mobile home, a luxury lodge tent or an intimate bivouac tent. That last one is ideal for touring walking or cycling tourists. If you spend the night in such a tent or a standard touring pitch, you can use the modern and well-maintained toilet block in the middle of the site.

Go out for a delicious dinner at Le Kiosque by Bob

The charming restaurant Le Kiosque by Bob is on the outskirts of the campsite. The extensive menu has regional specialities, including many meat and fish dishes. You can also go grocery shopping nearby as there is a large supermarket a few hundred metres outside the campsite. The campsite itself has a convenient breakfast service.

properties.name: Camping Bel Air Village Le Plan d'Eau
properties.description:
Camping Bel Air Village Le Plan d'Eau is located in a quiet, green spot just 3 kilometres from the N10 exit near Angoulême (Charente). Here, you’ll camp close to the Coulée Verte, a twenty kilometre walking and cycling path along the river Charente. This four-star campsite is also the ideal choice for water sports enthusiasts. You can swim in a recreational lake or a swimming pool complex nearby and the campsite itself has a heated outdoor pool.

What accommodation options are there?

At this campsite, you can choose between traditional camping or the comfort of accommodation. Set up your tent or caravan on one of the large pitches, which are separated by well-maintained hedges. As a camper, your pitch will have a paved surface. For more comfort, rent a modern mobile home. There are also special tent huts for rent. They are ideal for cycling tourists and others.

Head to Nautilis for a day of water fun

Feel like heading for a dip after a day of cycling or an enjoyable city walk? The campsite has a lovely heated outdoor pool. It’s the perfect place to swim a few lengths! For even more swimming fun, head to the Nautilis swimming pool complex, one kilometre away. As a camper, you get a discount at this large water park, where there are seven indoor sports and leisure pools, a large outdoor pool, water slides and various wellness facilities, amongst other things. Back at the campsite, order a tasty pizza or a delicious meat dish at the café-restaurant. Or prepare a meal yourself. The campsite shop stocks all the essentials.

properties.name: Camping Le Chenal
properties.description:
Camping le Chenal is a charming, basic family campsite. You can relax and find enough activities in the surrounding area. You are on the edge of the woods, only 900 metres from a sandy beach. Toss a ball on the jeu de boules court, dive into the swimming pool, visit a village in the area or simply do nothing at all.

Camping on the edge of the woods

You can relax at this quiet and compact campsite. There are 20 spacious pitches and various rental accommodations, such as mobile homes (4-6 people) and safari tents (4 people) with a kitchenette and covered terrace. Because the campsite is located on the edge of a regional forest, you can either sit in the shade or choose a spot in the sun.

Swimming and delicious food

If you fancy a refreshing dip but don’t want to go to the beach, the campsite has a heated covered pool and, as an extra, a wading pool. You can walk from the swimming pool to the playground or to the play area to play a game of table tennis or table football.

In the high season, Camping le Chenal offers a few extra activities. For example, join a jeu de boules competition, go to a theme evening with the entire family, or pull up a chair for a special dinner. During the summer months, you can also get fresh rolls for breakfast at the campsite, or a simple meal from the snack bar or pizzeria. If you are going in the low season, the nearest shops are only a 10-minute walk away.

properties.name: Camping La Coccinelle
properties.description:
Camping La Coccinelle is located on the edge of the idyllic village of Blot-l'Église in the beautiful natural Auvergne region. Here you can truly relax. People who like walking, cycling and angling will feel right at home. In Blot-l'Église itself, a 500 m walk, you will find several shops and a bakery. The campsite has a restaurant where you can enjoy a good meal.

Pearl in the Auvergne

La Coccinelle is a beautiful and quiet (family) campsite with 41 spacious pitches, either in the shade or in the sun. They are generally demarcated with lots of greenery. Much attention has been paid to the pitches. A few neatly-maintained gravel roads take you to the pitches. This pearl in the Auvergne has not yet been widely discovered, so that it is still very peaceful. There is room for ten motorhomes. There are also six rental mobile homes. 

Play and sports fun

It does not come as a surprise that the campsite is popular with families with small children. After all, there is plenty to do! Children will enjoy themselves in the playgrounds, the sand pit, the slide and the trampoline. Teenagers -and adults too, of course- can indulge in a game of table tennis, tennis or jeu de boules. In addition, there is a sports field as well as a mini library. 

Everyone in the water!

The attractive swimming pool of 60m2 (open from mid-June to early September) has an inviting appearance. It is tiled all around and is securely fenced off. It is a swimming pool where smaller children, obviously with armband, can enjoy themselves under the watchful eye of a parent.

properties.name: Camping Domaine des Salins
properties.description:
Drift off on one of the Vendée's many sandy beaches! The Camping Domaine des Salins campsite is located in the west of France. Here, you will enjoy the perfect combination of sandy beaches and pine forests. Located just eight hundred metres from the beach, the campsite has a friendly atmosphere.

A friendly campsite

The campsite is well laid out and maintained. You'll find lots of greenery and beautiful plants. The camping pitches are spacious and separate from the accommodations. The sanitary building is modern, clean and practical. Special feature: the campsite always keeps a few spots free for cyclists passing through. Don't have your own camping equipment? There are many mobile homes and chalets for rent at Domaine des Salins.

Close to the beach

This quiet family campsite is situated close to the beach. Within a quarter of an hour's walk, you will find yourself at the water's edge. This makes it a wonderful holiday destination for long, languid days by the sea. But there is also plenty of aquatic fun to be had at the campsite itself. Swim, float and splash in the beautifully landscaped outdoor pool. On the terrace, you can dream away to your heart's content in the sun. You can also swim even in bad weather, because the campsite has an indoor pool with a jacuzzi and paddling pool.

Entertainment in the high season

In the high season, this campsite offers entertainment and a mini club. From drawing competitions to dance evenings, there is a wide range of activities. You can keep fit on the outdoor fitness machines or in a Zumba or water fitness class. Want to enjoy a tasty snack or a pizza? The snack bar is open every day in the high season.

properties.name: Camping La Prairie
properties.description:
Camping La Prairie is located close to the French coast and the Atlantic Ocean. There are spacious camping pitches on the clearly laid out grounds. There you can already smell the salty sea air. You can walk through woods and dunes to the sea within fifteen minutes. Of course you can walk further along the endless beach, but don't forget to take a dive! Is it too cold? Then jump into the heated indoor swimming pool or relax in the campsite's jacuzzi. The children will love the water slide. This ends up in the outdoor pool.

Orderly and spacious

The pitches are well kept, making the campsite look neat and tidy. You put your caravan or tent on one of the spacious and grassy pitches, delimited by hedges. These provide a lot of peace and privacy. A tree on each pitch provides some shade. But do you want to sit in the shade all day? Then you need an awning.

Two swimming pools

A large waterslide towers over the campsite. Your children can't wait to slide down! Swimming, splashing and diving: the swimming pool is the best place for children to play. If you drive onto the campsite, another surprise awaits you. Hidden in the modern building behind reception is an indoor pool. You can swim laps in the heated water. Then jump into the jacuzzi for a water jet massage. Meanwhile, the little ones can splash around in the water playground.

properties.name: Camping Mun. La Grange du Pin
properties.description:
In Val-Revermont, in the Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes region, lies the Camping Municipal La Grange du Pin campsite. This municipal campsite has a wonderful location: in a wooded nature reserve, at the foot of the Jura mountain range and right next to a lovely lake. In the midst of nature, you can relax, play sports or take beautiful trips here. There's something for every camper!

What kind of spot would you prefer?

Pitches vary in terms of size and amount of shade, so find a spot that suits your needs. Don't have your own camping equipment? There are beautiful wooden chalets and safari tents for rent! Many of your campsite neighbours will be French, but there will also be some foreign campers.

Enjoy nature

With the beach at the elongated Bief de la Rippe lake, this is the perfect place for aquatic fun. The eight-acre lake is a great place for swimming, paddle surfing, canoeing and fishing. With the Jura Mountains at your feet and the beautiful surroundings around the campsite, you can also make the most scenic trips by car or bicycle.

Looking for something more challenging? Behind the campsite, you will find a tree climbing course, and nearby paragliding and mountain biking are also possible. The enthusiastic entertainment team members will ensure that the children are always well looked after here.

Facilities on the campsite

At the campsite, you will find a small sthop with local basic products. Fresh bread is also provided every morning. At the lake, you will find a bar and a few catering establishments. Want to send a photo to the family back home? No problem, you will get an excellent Wi-Fi connection almost everywhere on the campsite.

properties.name: VVF Camping Le Justin
properties.description:
Camping Municipal de Justin is ideally situated between the more famous cities of Gap and Valence. You are also camping at only eight hundred metres walking distance from the village of Die. The campsite is your perfect base to explore the beautiful surroundings. On the open terrain there is a quiet and friendly atmosphere. That in combination with the small river beach, the municipal swimming pool next to the campsite and the snack bar makes this a fine place for families with children of all ages.

Camping on grass

The spacious pitches on the flat site are easily accessible thanks to the wide roads. If you come with a tent, there is a separate field. One of the most beautiful pitches is located by the river. All pitches are well kept and grassy, and in some areas hedges and bushes provide extra privacy.

The three modern and bright sanitary blocks are cleaned regularly and look neat and tidy. Would you like to rent accommodation? Then the comfortable chalets are a good choice!

Plenty of playtime fun

For children of all ages there is plenty of room to play at the campsite. In addition to a playground, there is a volleyball court and space to play jeu de boules and table tennis. The river that flows in front of the campsite is popular with many campers. From the naturally formed pebble beach you are in the Drôme within a few steps. Splashing about with a swimming tire or paddling, it's all possible. The quality of the water is regularly checked by the competent authorities. Carefree and safe water fun guaranteed.

properties.name: Camping de l'Adour
properties.description:
Located in the green plains of the Midi-Pyrénées, Camping de l'Adour is a great place for campers who love nature, tranquillity and being outdoors. You wake up here to views of mountains and meadows, while the river Adour quietly flows by. There’s plenty to do as well.

Pitches and accommodation

At Camping de l'Adour, you camp the way you want. The pitches are large, flat and spread over the green site. Don't feel like bringing lots with you? Then choose one of the comfortable mobile homes. The dome tent, which sleeps two, is a really special experience.

Facilities on the campsite

The heated swimming pool with a sliding roof is a success in any weather. Want to completely unwind? Then head for the jacuzzi or sauna. For children, there’s a small outdoor pool complex where they can spend hours. Meanwhile, you can challenge each other to a game of mini golf or enjoy a drink on the terrace. Don't fancy cooking? A food truck sells varied dishes.

Adventure and relaxation

The surroundings of Camping de l'Adour invite you to get out and about. Head off on beautiful walking and cycling trips along the river and through green valleys and quiet villages. Bagnères-de-Bigorre (2 km) is nearby and known for its thermal baths. Perfect for a relaxing day. Choose the Pyrenees for more action. Climb the Pic du Midi or cycle over legendary ‘cols’ you might know from the Tour de France.

properties.name: Camping L'Océano d'Or
properties.description:
The Océano d'Or campsite, which is well organised and well-kept, is a good place for campers who like a friendly atmosphere and well-kept facilities. There is a large bar; the place to be for a snack, a drink and evening entertainment. The proximity of several white sandy beaches (Plage de Boisvinet) and nice seaside resorts (Jard-sur-Mer) also makes a wide public happy to spend their holidays here.

Camping on grass

The pitches for campers are separate from the mobile homes and chalets. They are spacious, flat pitches on a grassy surface. High, green hedges provide privacy, but there are also pitches with less shelter. The deciduous trees provide pleasant shade all day long. The campsite has four neat sanitary blocks.

Clean swimming pool with three slides

At the front of the campsite there is a large outdoor swimming pool. There is plenty of space to relax on one of the comfortable sunbeds. For children the three slides are a real attraction. They end up in a separate pool that is beautifully landscaped with rocks and plants. Next to the main pool there is a heated children's pool. There is also an indoor swimming pool where the youngest campers will also find a nice play area.

Beaches around the corner

The nearest beach is about twenty minutes' walk away. During the summer months you can get there by the free shuttle bus offered by the campsite.

Indoor or outdoor games

Next to a gym there is a sports field for a game of volleyball or basketball. Furthermore, young people can enjoy themselves in the large indoor area, with table tennis and billiard tables.

properties.name: Camping Seasonova les Marguerites
properties.description:
Camping Seasonova Les Marguerites is set in a beautiful location in Gamaches, in the north of France. At this 3-star camping paradise, you will experience comfort with large pitches and fully-equipped mobile homes. The campsite has versatile facilities like a heated swimming pool, a playground and a restaurant that serves local culinary delights. There are also plenty of activities to enjoy in the nearby Baie de Somme nature reserve, which makes the campsite popular with nature lovers and adventurers.

Large pitches

At Camping Seasonova Les Marguerites, you can choose from large, shaded pitches for tents, caravans and motor homes and modern mobile homes. The accommodation is designed for comfort and convenience, complete with all necessary amenities. The holiday feel is enhanced by the campsite's green, peaceful surroundings, ideal for unwinding or being active.

Sports, games and swimming

Take a refreshing dip in the heated pool or relax with a game of boules. Children will enjoy playing on the specially-equipped playground. For sports lovers, there are volleyball and tennis courts and a gym. On days when the weather is less good, you can have fun in the indoor games room with billiards and table football. The swimming pool is covered, so you can splash around in the water in bad weather too.

Discover the beautiful landscape

The campsite is 16 kilometres from the beach. Ideal for a day of swimming and playing fun! Build sandcastles or enjoy a sunset walk. Head to the Baie de Somme nature reserve for a wealth of nature and adventure.

properties.name: Camping Seasonova Le Martinet
properties.description:
Camping Seasonova Le Martinet is an idyllic spot on the quiet banks of the Loire, close to the historic and tourist city of Briare (a 10-minute walk). The campsite is an oasis of peace and relaxation, in a perfect location for cyclists wanting to explore the lovely Loire à Vélo route. The touring pitches are spacious, partly demarcated by hedges and have enough shade. Great bonus: you can pick your own pitch. If you don’t have your own camping equipment, they offer some hire accommodation such as mobile homes and safari tents.

Sports and games

Information about the region is available at the campsite reception. Here, you can order fresh bread for the following morning to start your day well. Discover the amenities the campsite has to offer, including table tennis, a playground, jeu de boules and miniature golf. There is a small but lovely heated swimming pool in the summer.

Nature by the Loire

At Camping Seasonova Le Martinet, you experience nature up close, with options to discover the varied flora and fauna of the Loire. Here, there are no fewer than 60 types of dragonflies, beavers, peacocks and many bird species. Vast pine forests, the sunning Loire Valley and castles such as Château de Trousse-Barrière and Château de la Bussière are in the surrounding area.

Discover Briare

The fascinating Pont Canal de Briare, the canal bridge over the Loire, is only two kilometres away. Here, you will learn all about the local history, and you can enjoy the charm of nearby Briare.

properties.name: Camping Seasonova de Vittel
properties.description:
You will find Camping Seasonova de Vittel in Vittel, the famous spa in the Vosges region. The thermal baths are just 1.5 km away and there is much to see and do in the area, especially if you're interested in arts and crafts. The campsite has marked camping pitches. There are also mobile homes available for rent on the campsite for holidaymakers without their own camping equipment.

Shaded camping pitches

The many old and tall trees provide plenty of shade so that you can always find a nice cool spot during the hot summers. Despite its proximity to the city, the campsite is very peaceful. The tall trees may disrupt the TV reception via a satellite dish somewhat. The pitches are well-tended and separated by low hedges. Guests come from far and wide and are especially interested in the natural surroundings and the thermal baths.

Water and spas

Vittel is not only famous for its bottled water, which is sold worldwide, but you can also find the large Nestlé bottling plant (near the station) in town. Les Thermes de Vittel, the thermal baths located along the Avenue Bouloumie, are also very well-known. Those who want to try their luck at the tables can do so at Casino de Vittel.

Surroundings

There is plenty of natural beauty to be found in the area surrounding Vittel. The most beautiful spots in the Vosges region are located in the regional natural park Ballons des Vosges, a little further east. But you can also indulge yourself in the nearby area, with long cycling trips through the countryside.

properties.name: Camping Le Bahamas Beach
properties.description:
Camping Le Bahamas Beach is just 850 metres from the beach. You can easily walk or cycle there for a day of sun, sea and sand. This spacious campsite is located in the Pays de la Loire region, close to the charming town of Saint-Gilles-Croix-de-Vie. On the campsite, you can enjoy the large swimming pool with a retractable roof or the multi-sports pitch, amongst other things. You can pop into the snack bar for a bite to eat and a drink.

Camping close to the beach

The campsite has spacious grassy pitches and a wide range of accommodation for rent. The camping pitches are set along leafy pathways and offer plenty of privacy. The campsite is well-kept and tidy, with enough space to make the pitch your own. If you prefer a bit more comfort, opt for a modern mobile home. You’ll then have your own bathroom and a lovely terrace for al fresco dining.

Splashing water fun

As soon as you arrive, you’ll instantly feel the relaxed holiday atmosphere. The multilingual reception staff will help you settle in quickly. The water park is the beating heart of the campsite. Swim a few laps in the heated indoor pool or whizz down the colourful slide. The children will have a great time in the water, while you relax in the jacuzzi or unwind by the outdoor pool. Need a break after all that splashing around? Grab a tasty treat from the campsite snack bar or enjoy a simple meal in the outdoor area. Start your day off right with some fresh bread from the campsite shop.

properties.name: Camping Huttopia Beaulieu sur Dordogne
properties.description:
Camping Huttopia Beaulieu sur Dordogne is located in a unique spot: on an island in the river Dordogne, on the outskirts of the medieval village of Beaulieu-sur-Dordogne. At this family campsite, you'll be camping in a well-kept and green setting, between trees and shrubs or on the river bank. Daily there is something to do for young and old.

Camping by the Dordogne

The campsite looks very spacious and is well cared for. The pitches and rental accommodation are spread out over the beautifully mowed lawns, under tall trees and among shrubs. Alternately, you'll see spacious touring pitches, gypsy caravans, groups of lodge tents and mobile homes. A forest path takes you to the banks of the Dordogne, where shady spots overlook the water.

Swimming pool with paddling pool

The campsite's swimming pool is spacious, and alongside a large paddling pool with a playhouse: enough space for all the children on the campsite. Around the pool are sun loungers and parasols, for sun lovers who want to keep an eye on their children. The pool is surrounded by wooden poles and tropical plants.

Entertainment for young and old

In high season, the entertainment team has plenty in store for young and old alike. For example, you can climb the climbing wall and in the summer evenings there are spectacular shows. Firebreathers and magicians then take over the campsite to amaze their audience. You can also regularly enjoy an evening of music. Got hungry? At the campsite you can get snacks and pizza. The bar and snack bar are next to each other and overlook the swimming pool.

properties.name: Camping Paradis Le Giessen
properties.description:
Camping Paradis Le Giessen is in the village of Bassemberg, in a central location in Alsace (France). You will camp in a green setting, on the banks of Le Giessen, a small river, surrounded by mountains and forests. It’s the ideal base for beautiful walks and cycle rides through nature. In school holidays, it’s a lively family campsite where many activities are organised. As a campsite guest, you can swim for free in the adjacent municipal swimming pool.

Large touring pitches and modern accommodation

Accommodation is most prominent at this four-star campsite. Comfortable holidays can be enjoyed here in modern mobile homes and cottages for four to six people. Just under 40 tourist pitches are available too. Most of these large pitches are in the shade and have a grass surface, although your touring pitch also has a paved area for you to park your vehicle(s) on.

Enjoy water fun and family entertainment

The small river that runs through the campsite is a great place to paddle or build dams with the children. You can have even more fun in the water at the Aquavallées municipal swimming pool next to the campsite. As a camper, you have free access to this heated indoor and outdoor pool, where water slides, a paddling pool and a spa guarantee water fun and relaxation. In school holidays, the campsite organises fun activities for children, including (water) games, shows, mini-discos, treasure hunts and craft sessions. Later in the day, family entertainment is organised too; it includes live music, karaoke and dance evenings. The campsite also has a cosy bar and a supermarket.

properties.name: Flower Camping L'Epi Bleu
properties.description:
Camping L'Epi Bleu is located on the outskirts of the charming village of Banon, in the Alpes-de-Haute-Provence. This campsite has a beautiful location. From the swimming pool and from a number of pitches you have beautiful views over the surrounding hills and lavender fields. In high season this is a popular campsite among families with children.

Camping

This campsite, which has a relatively large number of mobile homes and bungalows, is somewhat hilly. The many oaks provide a pleasant amount of shade. Some pitches are paved, others are grass. They are all neatly levelled. Especially the pitches at the edge of the campsite are beautiful: they have an attractive view over the lavender fields.

A surprising water park

In the modern water park you'll find a pool for swimming laps and a playfully designed pool into which the water slides end. From the sun loungers around the pool you have a beautiful view of the surrounding hills.

Daily entertainment in high season

During the high season there is a lot of activity and hustle and bustle at L'Epi Bleu. Every Sunday in July and August, during a welcome drink, the entertainment programme for the following week is announced. Children up to 12 years old can meet each other every weekday morning at the entertainment chalet, where all activities are organised.

Small, but attractive restaurant

On the campsite there is a small but attractive restaurant where pizzas, snacks, à la carte dishes, drinks and ice creams are available. Sometimes theme evenings are organised here as well. The campsite's supermarket is only open in July and August. The large supermarket in Banon is only two kilometres away.

properties.name: Flower Camping de la Grande Plage
properties.description:
Flowercamping de la Grande Plage is about 5 km from the fishing port of Guilvinec. The special thing about the campsite is the beautiful location on the Atlantic Ocean, where camp guests have access to the beautiful extensive sandy beach and the granite cliffs. In the evening you can enjoy beautiful sunsets.

The spacious separate campsites are between 80 and 120 m2. Depending on the site, you are in full sun or there are some with plenty of shade. You can also hire a mobile home or bungalow here. The plants have been laid out with care. The campsite is much visited by French people due to the beautiful location.

Snorkelling

The lovely heated swimming pool (180 m2) has challenging slides and a jacuzzi. Swimming costumes are obligatory and boxer shorts are not permitted. The heated kiddie pool is about 25 m2. In a few minutes you can walk via a lovely path to the beach at Boudoul and the ocean where you can snorkel and windsurf.

Mussels

You will find super-fresh mussels on the cliffs to make yourself. At the snack bar you have a choice of simple daily menus and pizzas. The meals can also be taken away. Every Thursday in the high season the tables are ready for a lovely meal with all of the campsite guests.

Treasure hunts

There is a playground on the campsite. Twice a week in the high season there is an activity programme (English and French). Activities include: archery, treasure hunts, skateboarding and climbing. Every morning on working days in July and August there are activities in the swimming pool. Table tennis and jeu de boules are other options.

properties.name: Camping Les 3 Cantons
properties.description:
Close to the fantastic nature reserve of Quercy (Parc Naturel Régional des Causses du Quercy), lies Camping Les 3 Cantons. As the owners have taken nature into consideration when landscaping the campsite, the pitches have retained their natural look.

Camping on a domain

The campsite measures a whopping 15 ha and is dotted with oak trees. Pitches have been created in the woods and there is space for mobile homes, camping lodges and safari tents. Therefore, you can enjoy a wonderful holiday with family or friends even without bringing your own tent or caravan. Furthermore, there are paved camping pitches.

Behind the reception you will find the bar with terrace, a hall, sports terrain and a climbing hall. One of the two sanitary buildings is centrally located on the campsite, the other one is near the swimming pool. You will also find a bar there.

Underwater cycles and outdoor excursions

The owners do not focus on one specific target group. Instead they want everyone to have a good time. Do you like swimming? If you do, dive into the lovely swimming pool. Cheerful water spray features are found in the separate toddler pool. Practice your underwater cycling skills. For sure, you can do this in this pool!

You can plan a games of tennis on the tennis court of the campsite. There is a climbing wall for the real sports-minded campers and a Dutch outdoor sports company can take you on exciting tours to the gorges and mountains of Quercy. This company organises great mountain bike tours as well which are suitable for almost everyone. All of this fully in keeping with the philosophy of the owners...

properties.name: Camping Le Domaine d'Oléron
properties.description:
Camping Le Domaine d'Oléron is located on the Île d'Oléron, an island of oyster farms and salt marshes. At this family campsite near the Atlantic Ocean, you can camp on well-kept lawns or in one of the lodge tents or rental accommodation. With entertainment for everyone and a swimming pool with water slides, the whole family can have fun on the campsite. Everything on the island is within cycling distance: the centre of Saint-Georges-d'Oléron and the beach are within 15 minutes.

Well-kept pitches

The touring pitches and rental accommodation on the campsite are more or less evenly distributed. The pitches are situated on well-kept lawns delimited by hedges. Some pitches are shady and sheltered, others are spacious and are situated on a field with a more open character. Many guests on the campsite stay in one of the eco-lodge tents and various mobile homes.

Swimming and sliding

Behind the reception you’ll find the swimming pool. When the weather is nice, all the children gather here to rush down the water slidesl, which end up in a separate pool next to the rectangular outdoor pool, where everyone can have a nice swim. Attached to this pool there is a shielded shallow pool, but there is also a separate paddling pool. Here the little ones can slide down the lighthouse slide and play with the water-spouting whale.

A pizza by the pool

With a drink or a pizza you can take a seat on the outdoor café overlooking the swimming pool. The pizzeria is located near the entrance of the campsite. In the morning you can also get fresh bread here. For more groceries, take your bike or car to go to Saint-Georges-d'Oléron. In the centre of this town there is a large supermarket and also a few restaurants.

properties.name: Camping Seasonova Les Portes d'Alsace
properties.description:
On the outskirts of the beautiful town of Saverne lies the quiet family campsite Seasonova Les Portes d’Alsace. Because of the many beautiful trees, the campsite has the ambiance of a park. Between the trees on the lawn you will find beautiful, large camping pitches which are not demarcated. As a result you have quite a lot of space. Behind the residential building, which houses the reception, lies a small heated swimming pool (40 m2) with a sliding roof. Children can splash around in the paddling pool and play in a playground with slide and sand pit. Entertainment is also provided.

Signposted routes and entertainment

At the reception you can rent a mountain bike or (electric) bike to explore the area. Staying on the campsite is not a bad idea, either. During the week in peak season nice activities are organised. The table tennis table, pétanque court as well as the beach volley ball field are some of the popular facilities on this campsite.

'Can we go to the pizza car?'

You can order fresh rolls and other delicacies which are delivered daily. The camping shop stocks the most essential necessities as well as convenient take-away meals. Ideal if you arrive late and do not have time or feel like cooking. A few times a week the the popular pizza car stops by.

Inclined plane

The Arzviller inclined plane (boat lift) is part of the Marne-Rhine Canal near Arzviller. The canal has seventeen locks over a four kilometre stretch. In total a height of 44 m is bridged. You can go on a nice outing to Océanide Saverne, a swimming paradise (with fitness centre, sauna and hammam) beautifully located on a hill with gardens.

properties.name: Camping Huttopia Chardons Bleus - Ile de Ré
properties.description:
In the middle of a forest on the island of Île de Ré is the family campsite Huttopia Chardons Bleus - Île de Ré. This tourist island in the Charente-Maritime has a long coastline with many sandy beaches. The campsite is located in a wooded area about two kilometres from the beach and the Atlantic Ocean. So you will stay in an ideal place to take a dip in the sea every day.

Camping in the forest

The campsite is situated in a large pine forest, where tall trees provide plenty of shade. Almost all of the 175 touring pitches are in shady spots in the forest. The ground is sandy; pay attention when you come with a caravan or motorhome. In spite of the sandy soil, the pitches are well maintained: scattered over the campsite, with lots of privacy and space.

Family campsite on the Ile de Ré
