Young families from all over Europe are attracted to this campsite on the Ile de Ré. Especially in high season, Huttopia Chardons Bleus is a real family campsite. There is a lot to do for the younger guests. During the summer months, they are kept busy by the entertainment team. They organise activities with a specific theme every week.

Heated swimming pool

Centrally located on the campsite, near the restaurant and reception, you’ll find the large heated swimming pool. Although the swimming pool is in an open area, there are plenty of trees nearby that can provide shade. Next to the large swimming pool there are two round pools: one for toddlers, one for the slightly larger bathers. Next to the pool, between the trees, you will find a pavement café and a little bar.

properties.name: Camping Bel Air Village Barberousse
properties.description:
Camping Barberousse is in the sunny south of France, near the port town of Gruissan (750 m). It’s the perfect spot for peace and quiet but an experience too. It’s surrounded by nature, close to the salt flats and only a few kilometres from the beach. Remember to pack your walking shoes and towel too because there’s no need to sit still here.

Camp with a view of salt flats

The pitches are flat and big enough to accommodate caravans and motor homes. No camping equipment of your own? Not a problem. There are 20 modern mobile homes on the edge of the nature reserve. Look out over the vast salt flats from your veranda or through the large sliding windows.

Lots to do

For children, there’s a sheltered water play area where they can splash around without being bothered by the wind. If they still need to burn off energy, there's the kids' club with games and outdoor activities. Meanwhile, you can relax in the sauna or jacuzzi. Or you can head to the restaurant for tapas, pizzas and other small dishes. Breakfast is taken care of as well: fresh bread is waiting for you at the campsite every morning.

Discover Gruissan and the region

Gruissan comes alive on Saturdays thanks to the local market. Afterwards, it’s a short walk to the old centre, with narrow streets and views of the castle. You can be at the beach in less than 10 minutes.

properties.name: Flower Camping Le Platin Redoute
properties.description:
In Rivedoux-Plage, a lively seaside resort on the small island of Île de Ré (Charente-Maritime), is Flower Camping Le Platin - La Redoute. This three-star campsite is in an ideal location, at the front of the island, on a narrow headland. This means that the campsite is flanked on two sides by wide sandy beaches. So an ideal holiday destination for those who love the beach and water sports! There are also plenty of lovely hiking and cycling routes nearby and the campsite itself has a heated outdoor swimming pool.

Book a camping pitch by the beach

This campsite basically consists of two parts. On one side of the main road is Le Platin, where spacious tourist camping pitches are in the majority, although you can also stay on a motorhome pitch or in accommodation here. La Redoute is across the road and offers mostly accommodation like modern mobile homes and safari tents. There are four toilet and shower blocks: three on Le Platin and one on La Redoute. Want to make the most of the sea and beach during your stay? At Le Platin, there is a series of pitches right on the beach with unobstructed views over the sea.

Fun in the water in the outdoor swimming pool

Returning to the campsite after a lovely but intensive hiking or cycling tour? Then it is great to enjoy a dip in the water. At Le Redoute, you can do that in a heated outdoor pool with large paddling pool, slide and water mushroom. Water aerobics classes are often organised in summer. And in high season, there are always plenty of activities for young and old. Like sports games for children and fun themed evenings for the whole family.

properties.name: Camping Domaine de Mépillat
properties.description:
Between Dijon and Lyon, on a small lake, is Camping Domaine de Mépillat. On this rural terraced campsite you'll find spacious, flat touring pitches delimited by hedges. The outdoor swimming pool is situated in full sunshine. You can go fishing in the lake adjacent to the campsite. Because of its location, this campsite is also very suitable for campers travelling south.

Sunny pitch

Camping Domaine de Mépillat has flat touring pitches on grass, surrounded by hedges and shrubs. You can choose between a sunny pitch or one with shade. Because the terrain is a bit sloping, terraces have been created. A small lake is directly adjacent to the campsite. The campsite has several special rental accommodations, such as a traditional Mongolian yurt or a teepee chalet.

Swimming and fishing

Next to the main building, in full sun, you will find the heated swimming pool. It is a simple outdoor swimming pool that is proportional to the size of the campsite which is on the small side. You can't swim in the lake right next to the campsite. But you can throw out your fishing rod.

Sunny terrace

In the main building, near the swimming pool, you will find the bar and restaurant. There is a cosy terrace where you can sit at a table in the sun or in the shade. In the morning a varied breakfast is served, and during the day you can enjoy a drink or an ice cream. The restaurant consists of a snack bar and a pizzeria. In the evening you can go there for a simple meal (can also be picked up).

properties.name: Eco-Camping La Porte d'Autan
properties.description:
On the outskirts of Saissac, in the beautiful Languedoc-Roussillon region, you will find the small-scale campsite of La Porte d'Autan. From this ecological campsite you look out over the hills and the snowy peaks of the Pyrenees. The famous castle of Saissac is within walking distance (one kilometre). Do you prefer the quiet life? Then you're in the right place at this campsite!

A campsite with a view

At the reception you will be welcomed by the owners Jean-Louis and Stéphanie. Their campsite is neat and well-maintained. Of particular note is the beautiful panoramic view of the Pyrenees. The size of the pitches varies from medium-large (80 m2) to extremely spacious (300 m2) and the pitches are marked off. You can choose from a spot in the sun or a shady spot. The campsite also rents out nine static caravans.

Cool off

After a long trip, there is nothing better than a dip in the pool. Fortunately, the pool is easy to find: it is located at the front of the campsite, directly behind the reception building. The pool is standard in design, but is well-maintained. The campsite also has a cosy bar and snack bar with a limited menu. There is no supermarket at the campsite, but the grocery store Le Cabas d'Oc is 150 metres down the road.

Workshops and games

The campsite has fun workshops for children every week in high season, but even in low season the little campers won't need to be bored. There are several games, a playground, two miniature horses and even a library. Are you looking for outdoor activities? The area around the campsite is very suitable for hiking.

properties.name: Camping Seasonova les 7 îles
properties.description:
Enchanting Brittany is a wonderful holiday destination for nature lovers. Following the jagged coastline of the Côtes d'Armor, you'll be constantly surprised by beautiful views, quiet bays with sandy beaches and picturesque towns. And wonderful campsites right by the sea, such as Sesonova les 7 îles Campsite. From your camping pitch, you'll have a view of the sea and the seven islands after which the campsite is named. You can enjoy swimming, watersports, hiking and the beautiful nature here, all with the murmur of the waves in the background.

Camping with a sea view

You reach your camping pitch via a paved road. The pitches are spacious and almost all have a beautiful view of the bay. A large number of the camping pitches are located directly by the sea. So you'll wake up to the sounds of the waves and seabirds - the ultimate holiday feeling! The camping pitches are sheltered by hedges, and there is also a wall that offers shelter between the sea and the camping pitches.

Les 7 îles is a real French campsite offering mainly camping pitches - almost 120 in total. In addition, there are about 25 rental accommodations, such as beautiful mobile homes, an ecolodge and a tiny house.

Swimming in the sea

Its not a holiday without swimming, of course. In the summer months, you can splash around in the heated and covered swimming pool. There's also a paddling pool for the little ones. And, of course, you can also swim in the sea. There's a beautiful sandy beach next to the campsite. You reach the sea via a path from the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Huttopia Parque de Doñana
properties.description:
Camping Huttopia Parque de Doñana is located in western Andalusia, between Seville and the Spanish coast. You will camp here in the forests of Doñana National Park: a wonderful place for nature lovers. And you're only half an hour's drive from the sea. The new campsite offers pitches in the shade, but also luxury lodge tents. Jump into the swimming pools, taste the local specialities and visit Seville and 'sand village' El Rocío.

Lovely pitches in the shade

Are you coming with a tent or caravan? Then you can choose from 48 comfort pitches: lovely spots under the trees. Do you want a lot of shade? Then the touring pitches behind the swimming pool are perfect for you. You don't have a lot of privacy yet, because the planting is still quite young. For a holiday in luxury one of the new lodge tents is very suitable. These glamping tents have everything you need during a luxury holiday: soft beds, a private kitchenette and often private sanitary facilities as well.

Coolness in the pool

In that warm Spanish sun you also need to cool down every now and then. There are two swimming pools on the campsite. In the shade there is a rectangular swimming pool, where you can swim. You can relax on the sunbeds and lawn. The second swimming pool is situated in the sun. This pool is especially fun for the children.

Miniclub

Sports field and playground, paddling pool and bouncy castle provide entertainment for the little ones. Do your children want to get to know as many holiday friends as possible? Then they can join the mini-club in high season.

properties.name: Camping Dun-le-Palestel
properties.description:
This small-scale campsite has a beautiful view and is situated near the village of the same name, Dun-le-Palestel. As a sparsely populated area, the Creuse region has a great deal in store for lovers of freedom and nature. One big advantage is that all kinds of cycling and walking routes start from the campsite.

Plenty of space

On the clear and open field, you will find pitches without demarcation of an exceptionally large size. Some places are at least partly shaded, and there are also saplings that will provide additional shelter. At the edge of the campsite there are several lodges and mobile homes for rent.

Swimming with a view

The pool with waterfall and hot tub is set up on the edge of the property, overlooking the trees and the adjacent meadow. Around the pool, you can lie back and relax. There is also a table tennis table, a trampoline and a playground with a sandbox for the children to enjoy themselves.

Table d'hôte and more

The cozy bistro hosts parties no less than six nights a week. For example, a pizza night and a weekly barbecue buffet are scheduled. Every day, you can pick up fresh pizzas to eat with a nice drink at the tent or caravan.

Truly relaxing

In Camping Dun-le-Palestel, children will find a nice and safe place to play outside with friends. If your dog is coming camping with you, the stretch of forest near the campsite is an ideal place for a runaround. You can play a game of bocce on the renovated court. And during the cosy music night, you can sing along loudly with chansons sung by a local artist.

properties.name: Camping Le Verdoyant
properties.description:
Camping Le Verdoyant is located in the heart of the Dordogne, in the green Aquitaine region. You wake up here to the sound of bird song; the day starts peacefully, but there’s plenty to do. You’ll camp in the heart of nature here, with great facilities and plenty of opportunities for action.

Large pitches in a green setting

The campsite is large and green. The pitches are generous and range from 100 m2 to as much as 400 m². You’ll camp in a shady area surrounded by bushes and trees that ensure your privacy. You can choose your own pitch.

No camping equipment of your own? There’s a wide choice of accommodation, including modern mobile homes, comfortable chalets and fully-equipped gîtes.

Swim in the swimming pool

The heated swimming pool is a favourite spot on hot days. Relax in the jacuzzi, head down the slide or take a refreshing dip in the pool. There’s a separate paddling pool and water playground for young children. Fishing enthusiasts can cast their lines at one of the two private fishing ponds. The campsite also has a restaurant where you can enjoy local specialities or a tasty pizza.

On an adventure in the Dordogne

The Dordogne awaits outside the campsite. Think beautiful nature, atmospheric villages and local markets full of local produce. Visit impressive castles, like Château de la Grande Filolie (15.5 km) and Château de la Petite Filolie (14.5 km). The caves of Lascaux (12 km) are worth a visit too.

properties.name: Camping Le Neptune
properties.description:
About two kilometres from the Breton coast, near the old village of Lanloup, lies the cosy and green Le Neptune campsite. This campsite offers everything for a successful camping holiday: beautiful pitches with a lot of privacy, a swimming pool, a restaurant and fun activities for young and old. And all this in the beautiful Breton nature.

Beautiful, sheltered camping pitches

On arrival, you will be welcomed by Laurence and Franck, who have been the owners of Le Neptune since 2018. You will immediately notice the intimate atmosphere. The spacious pitches are protected by high hedges, so you have a lot of privacy. This fits with the owners' philosophy that camping and nature belong together. In addition to camping with your own caravan, tent or camper, you can also rent a mobile home or chalet here.

Traditional Breton games

From the beginning of July until the end of August, there is a lot to do for young and old. Children can learn archery, participate in bubble football or enjoy crafting. Or you can spend an hour working up a sweat to swinging beats during the Zumba fitness classes. And in the high season, artists regularly perform in the evenings. Something special for the children is that they can play traditional Breton games here, accompanied by volunteers from the area.

Swimming fun

You can also swim laps and splash in the heated and covered swimming pool. When the weather is nice, the canopy is pulled back and the swimming pool is transformed into an outdoor swimming pool with sun terrace. You can also visit the petting zoo and playground, or play a game of football on the multi-sports field. Want to read something? Then pay a visit to the camp library.

properties.name: Camping Huttopia Les Châteaux
properties.description:
Huttopia Les Châteaux campsite is a family campsite in the french Loir-et-Cher region. The river Beuvron flows on both sides of the campsite's wooded grounds. Here you camp on a spacious pitch under tall trees or stay in one of the wooden chalets. The campsite's facilities have are modern an clean.

Comfortable camping in nature

More than two hundred touring pitches are scattered aroung the extensive campsite. You camp in a wooded area on the Beuvron, which gives the terrain an extra natural character. Some of the touring pitches are situated on the banks of the river, others in shady spots under the tall trees. The rental accommodation are beautifully integrated into nature.

Covered and heated swimming pool

Especially fun for the children: the covered and heated swimming pool on the campsite. Even when it's a little colder or when it rains, you can take a dip in warm water. When the sun shines, the sliding roof opens.

Medieval workshops

Stargazing, an archery lesson or a medieval workshop: in high season, the young campers are entertained every week. Of course, they can also enjoy themselves, for example in the playground or on the tennis court (small extra fee).

Central meeting point

If you are looking for food or conviviality, the large restaurant with outdoor seating is the place to be. Not only can you eat a pizza or drink a glass of wine here, but the building is also the central meeting place for campers. Play a game of snooker, get a good book from the library or visit a live concert. Something fun for everyone!

properties.name: Camping Huttopia Saumur
properties.description:
Huttopia Saumur campsite is located in the middle of a wooded nature reserve in the Loire Valley, just above the town of Saumur. With vineyards, castles and picturesque villages nearby, there is plenty to see in the area. The campsite is located directly on a higher part of the banks of the Loire and offers a wonderful view of the river and the valley. The campsite has reserved its best spots on the riverside.

Panorama over the Loire

The showpiece of the campsite is the panoramic view. The campsite is situated on an elevated part of the site, giving you a wonderful view of the Loire from various pitches and rental accommodation. The pitches are located on the right-hand side of the campsite and are separated by hedges. Trees provide shade on these pitches.

Three swimming pools

In high season, the Huttopia Saumur campsite is particularly popular with young families with children. Small campers will mainly be found around the reception. This is where the swimming pools are located. They are not particularly large, but there are three in total: an outdoor pool, an indoor pool and a paddling pool. This means there is enough space for everyone.

Terrace with view

The restaurant is also located near the reception building and the swimming pools. The menu here is small - mainly fresh pizza is served - but the atmosphere is nice. The terrace is a lovely place to sit. Here too, the view over the valley is magnificent. Next to the terrace is the playground, where the children can let off steam while you enjoy a glass of wine.

properties.name: Camping Le Clou
properties.description:
The charming Dutch run campground of Le Clou is in a lovely location on rolling land of 4 hectares. From the spacious campsites, separated by paths, you have a panoramic view. Camping Le Clou is located on a sunny south slope 3 km from the village of Coux-et-Bigaroque in a lovely region with many historic villages and towns.

Spacious campsites

The campsites with plenty of shade are very spacious. The location on the hilly site ensures plenty of variety. The modern sanitary facilities are well maintained. The accommodations for hire are spread out over the campground. You have the choice of a sturdy safari tent with private bathroom and modern mobile homes and a charmingly furnished apartment.

Panoramic view

The sunny swimming pool complex with a low slide has three pools separated by a waterfall. The heated kiddie pool is 50m2. You have a beautiful view of the valley from the swimming pool with parasols and the sunbathing lawn.

Plenty of fun

There is an activity programme at least twice a week for the children in the high season. How about crafts or sporty games? In the evening hours the young guests can go on a treasure hunt, look for foxes, have a kid's disco or a hike with lanterns.

Sporty on holiday

You can also play beach volleyball and table tennis and use the multi-sports field and the jeu-de-boules pitch at the campground.

What's for dinner?

Each day, the baker delivers fresh bread. There is a limited selection of groceries in the campground shop, but there is a restaurant for snacks, take-away meals and pizzas. If you choose the Table d'hôte, you'll have a culinary three course menu with dishes from the Périgord.

properties.name: Camping Les Murmures du Lignon
properties.description:
Welcome to Camping Les Murmures du Lignon. This campsite is located in a hilly wooded area on the river Lignon du Velay. You will camp here near the town of Tence (Auvergne-Rhone-Alpes). The owners of the campsite care a lot about sustainability. For example, they have energy-efficient lighting and they separate waste.

Spacious campsite

You will be welcomed by the enthusiastic camping team. After this you can check out your camping pitch. The site is spacious and many pitches have a view of the river! You can choose from camping pitches of different sizes: up to 200m2. For an extra special holiday, you can choose from one of the special tents or hikers' cabins.

Entertainment at the campsite

Children can enjoy themselves on the slide or with a game of badminton. In bad weather, everyone can go to the games room. Here you will find a kid-friendly area with video games. You can also play pool, table football or a game of goose boards. In the high season, the campsite has a kids club several times a week.

The campsite bar is cosy and the restaurant is small but pleasant. In the high season the restaurant is open and you can buy breakfast, a few groceries and fresh bread.

Enjoy the surrounding countryside

The beautiful countryside around the campsite offers plenty of opportunities for a glorious walk or bike ride. Take a route along the river or climb the Pic du Lizieux (fifteen kilometres). There's a beautiful view from the top! Are you more of a water rat? In the pool you can take part in an aqua aerobics class or just float around.

properties.name: Sunêlia Mas de Nicolas
properties.description:
Camping Mas de Nicolas is situated against a hill in Provence, on the outskirts of Saint-Rémy-de-Provence. Here, campers can fully relax in the outdoor pool and wellness centre. A few touring pitches on the park-like, sloping terrain look out onto Saint-Rémy.

Camping Mas de Nicolas is located on the northern outskirts of Saint-Rémy-de-Provence, an old town in Provence. You're not far from the Mediterranean Sea; in just over an hour you'll be in the coastal town of Marseille, for example.

Swimming pool and wellness

Those looking for peace and quiet will find this campsite an excellent destination. Most pitches are demarcated by high hedges, giving you a lot of privacy. The pool area is the perfect place to relax. There are several sun loungers around the edge of the pool. There is a paddling pool for the little ones. The wellness centre is also located next to the pool. An indoor pool, whirlpool, sauna and steam bath are available here, but you can also work out on one of the fitness machines.

Saint-Rémy-de-Provence and Avignon

In the attractive old streets of Saint-Rémy-de-Provence you will find several restaurants. Be sure to visit the Wednesday market here. On Wednesday mornings, the market square, but also the narrow streets, are filled with market stalls, music and conviviality. From the campsite you can visit other beautiful places: Arles and Les Baux-de-Provence for example. But Avignon can also be reached within three quarters of an hour. Avignon is known as the Provencal Popes' city, as the city was the residence of the popes in the fourteenth century. The Palais des Papes, the enormous papal residence, still bears witness to this.

properties.name: Balatontourist Camping Napfény
properties.description:
For a carefree holiday by the famous and popular Lake Balaton in Hungary, the Balatontourist Camping Napfény campsite is the place to be. At this neat and tidy family campsite on the water, you will find all the amenities you need. Whether you like water sports, cycling, exploring the surroundings or just relaxing on the lawn, everything is possible here!

Everything in perfect order

There are many pitches of all shapes and sizes. The pitches, like the rest of the campsite, look well-kept. They are separated by some bushes. The sanitary facilities are in good order and kept very clean. For the little ones, there are children's sanitary facilities, and the campsite also has sanitary facilities for disabled campers. Don't have your own camping equipment? You can also rent a mobile home or bungalow tent here.

Water fun and entertainment

In the summer, it's a cosy affair at the Camping Napfény campsite. Families of all nationalities come here to enjoy the sun, the lake and the good atmosphere. For the children, there is plenty to do. The enthusiastic entertainment team organises all kinds of fun activities in the summer, including those on and around the water. Lake Balaton is not deep, and the bottom slopes gently, making it safe for everyone to splash around here. For the little ones, there is even a cove where the water is as shallow as a toddler pool.

There is also a small pool for children. The campsite also rents out surfboards, kayaks and pedal boats for even more fun in the water. No one need be bored on land either, with a playground, trampoline, miniature golf course, table tennis tables, go-karts, recreation room and sports field.

properties.name: Balatontourist Camping Naturist Berény
properties.description:
The Balatontourist Camping Naturist Berény campsite is a cosy naturist campsite right on the popular Lake Balaton in Hungary. This is a wonderful place for a relaxing holiday. Lay out your blanket or air mattress on the large round jetty for sunbathing, take a dip, or go for a nice walk or bike ride along the lake. A visit to the town of Keszthely or one of the thermal baths in the area is also recommended. There is an excellent restaurant on the campsite.

Cosy and green

The campsite looks green and well cared for. You can install your caravan, campervan or tent on a camping field or on a pitch demarcated by hedges. In addition to your own camping equipment, you can also spend your holidays here in a mobile home, chalet, apartment or room.

Sunbathing on the large jetty

The eye-catcher of the campsite is the large round jetty, which lies beautifully between the reeds in Lake Balaton. A lovely place to sunbathe and to enter the water via steps. Here you are on the southern shore of Lake Balaton, where the water is quite shallow. This not only ensures a pleasant water temperature, but also a safe environment for the children.

Book a massage

For the children, this is a simple but enjoyable campsite. Especially in summer, they will easily meet playmates by the water, the playground, the table tennis table and the sports field. During the summer holidays, fun activities are organised for the children. Do you want to pamper yourself a little bit more? Then book a massage at the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Torre Pendente
properties.description:
Always wanted to visit the leaning tower of Pisa? The small-scale city campsite Torre Pendente is the place to be. This campsite is only a 15-minute walk away from this unique sight. You will camp here comfortably on pitches with lots of shade. Adjacent to the restaurant you will find a pool for swimming enthusiasts.

Driving to the campsite, you will travel through the magnificent hilly Tuscan countryside dotted with cypresses. When you get close to the campsite, you will see the leaning tower between the trees from the busy Via Aurelia. The campsite is popular with Dutch guests; some of the receptionists even speak some Dutch. Handy to get information about the region, where there is a lot going on.

Camping in the shade

The city campsite is not very large, but each inch of the campsite is fully utilised. Choose a pitch between large trees or go for a pitch with shade cloth. This way you can enjoy the warm weather without getting sunburnt. The camping pitches are large enough for comfortable camping. An ablution block is always nearby. One of them is a large modern building, which is kept neat and tidy. They are often tiled with marble.

Does the Italian sun shine brightly? Take a refreshing dive in the pool which is not the same depth everywhere. For additional relaxation, you can use the jacuzzi/whirlpool. The swimming pool is located next to the restaurant. Therefore, when you sit on the terrace you can keep an eye on the children in the swimming pool.

properties.name: Camping Punta Indiani
properties.description:
Punta Indiani campsite is located in the heart of the northern Italian region of Valsugana and on the shore of Lake Caldonazzo. From your pitch by the water, you have a view of the lake and the steep slopes of the Dolomites. The campsite is divided into two parts by a small railway which is occasionally crossed by a train. Both parts are connected by a tunnel. Many facilities - such as a restaurant, supermarket and pizzeria - can be found in the neighbouring village of Valcanover.

Spot by the water

A large part of Punta Indiani campsite lies directly on the lake. The lakeside pitches are often the first to be booked, but you can also see the water from many other pitches. The pitches are located on different grassy areas and vary in size. There are also some mobile homes for rent.

The campsite is divided in two by a railway line, which is occasionally crossed by a train (not between 23.00 and 06.00). A pedestrian tunnel connects the two parts of the campsite. On both parts there is a building with sanitary facilities. One building has special facilities for the disabled.

Everything within reach

Most facilities are available in the village of Valcanover, which borders the campsite. You'll find a supermarket, restaurant and pizzeria about five hundred metres away. Fresh bread can be collected daily from the campsite reception. For the children there are two playgrounds with various pieces of equipment and there is a volleyball field where they can play sports together.

properties.name: Camping Mare e Sole
properties.description:
The friendly campsite Mare e Sole is located in Tirrenia, slightly north of the port city of Livorno. Here you camp right at the beach. On this campsite you have a wide choice of rental accommodation units (bungalows, mobile homes) and green camping pitches. Swim a few lengths in the large swimming pool, take part in the entertainment and enjoy a lovely pizza and a drink on the terrace.

Camping in the shade

Camping Mare e Sole is tightly organised and laid out in rows. In the centre of the campsite is a broad paved street lined with blossoming oleanders. The largest part of the campsite is destined for long-term sites (260). These consist mainly of bungalows and mobile homes. There are also some 100 touring pitches for tents, caravans and camper vans. These pitches have a grass surface and vary in size. 

Swimming pool and sea: enjoy

Near the entrance of the campsite, just behind the reception building, you will find the large and beautifully designed swimming pool (312 m2). Smaller children will enjoy the toddler pool. Tired of swimming? Adjacent to the swimming pool is a lawn with playground and an array of colourful play equipment. 

The additional feature making your stay at Campsite Mare e Sole so special is the private (guarded) beach which is easily accessible from the campsite. On this beach you can rent loungers and sun umbrellas. There is also a beach pool and a beach volleyball field. Also fun: in summer there is an artificial floating diving platform in the sea.

Entertainment and sports

In high season, activities are organised at least twice a week for both children and adults. You can join in, even when your Italian is not up to scratch: entertainment is offered in English as well.

properties.name: Camping C'Era una Volta
properties.description:
Every fairy tale begins with ‘C’Era una Volta’ (Once upon a time), which is how your holiday in Italy begins as well. Camping C’Era una Volta will give you a great holiday with amazing views. You camp on the Italian Riviera in a hilly area about 10 kilometres from the sea. The campsite has a shuttle service (July and August) that will take you to the private beach of Albenga.

Car-free camping

This well-kept campsite has spacious pitches that are car-free. You can spend a wonderful night here among the trees. Because of the different heights at the campsite, it may take some work to get settled, but it is certainly worth it. The campsite also rents out various accommodations, such as mobile home and bungalows.

Four swimming pools

The campsite has two competition-sized pools (open in July and August) and two other swimming pools with a paddling pool, Jacuzzi and bar (open May to September). A bathing cap is mandatory in the swimming pools. Radici restaurant supplies the most delicious wood-fired pizzas, fusilli and, in the high season, even breakfast. The Radici Summer Bar is ready to serve you during the day. There is a large supermarket just around the corner for your groceries.

If you prefer to just relax the whole day at the campsite, that is not a problem here! There is are wellness facilities with a sauna and a Turkish bath, a health club and evening entertainment (in July and August) with which to end the day.

properties.name: Camping Mun. du Champs de Mars
properties.description:
In the mountains of the Jura, in the east of France, you will find the Camping Municipal du Champs de Mars. This mountainous area is a hiking paradise in summer and a fine winter sports area in winter. You'll camp here on an open and well-organised campsite, where the spacious pitches offer a lot of freedom. The wooden chalets give you a beautiful view over the campsite.

Tranquillity and freedom

Due to the large and open lawns, the gently sloping, clearly laid out campsite exudes tranquillity and freedom. The terrain is beautiful and orderly, without too much fuss. Part of the pitches, scattered over the lawns, receive shade from the trees. At the top of the campsite, ten wooden chalets overlook the terrain. Some of these chalets are also accessible to disabled people. The chalets are perfect for a camping holiday in summer, but also for a winter holiday. In addition to the regular pitches, there are a few pitches especially for camper vans.

Lakes in the area

A swimming pool is missing on the campsite. However for swimming you don't have to go far; in the immediate vicinity are several lakes. For example, a 10 minutes drive ten minutes in southern direction brings you at the Lac de l'Abbaye. Fifteen minutes in the other direction you’ll find Lac d'Ilay and two lakes of Maclu. You can not only swim in the lakes, but the surrounding wooded mountains are fantastic for hiking and bike rides. From the mountain at Le Grand Maclu you have a beautiful view over the lakes and the surrounding area.

properties.name: Camping La Pointe Saint-Gildas
properties.description:
Camping La Pointe Saint-Gildas is located in the French department of Pays de la Loire. It is situated in a green, flat area only 800 metres from the Atlantic Ocean. The coast in this area is mostly rocky. But there are enough beaches in the area for a cooling dip in the ocean. The nearest beach is about a five-minute drive away, as is the town of Préfailles.

Camping with private toilet facilities

You can rent pitches and accommodations. Choose a mobile home with a few bedrooms or a luxury safari tent with private toilet facilities. If you have your own camping equipment but would like a little more luxury and privacy, choose a pitch with private toilet facilities. Not only will you have your own shower and toilet but a fridge, coffee pot and microwave as well.

Campsite entertainment

Camping La Pointe Saint-Gildas is a campsite for sports enthusiasts. Challenge your holiday company (or your neighbours) to a game of volleyball, jeu de boules or mini golf. For children, there is a playground with a trampoline, table-tennis table, games room and entertainment in the high season.

Water fun in Pays de la Loire

The outdoor swimming pool consists of two heated pools that are connected. The little ones are safe and have fun in the wading pool designed especially for them. You can relax in the sun loungers around the swimming pool. The restaurant’s terrace overlooks the outdoor swimming pool. The campsite restaurant has a small menu.

properties.name: Balatontourist Camping Strand Holiday
properties.description:
Come and camp by Europe's largest freshwater lake: Lake Balaton. Balatontourist Camping Strand Holiday is a campsite on the shores of this delightful lake. The campsite's elongated shape means you can camp anywhere near the lake. You will be staying a few hundred metres from the village of Balatonakali. The seaside resort of Balatonfüred is fifteen kilometres away.

Pleasant camping

You'll soon see on arrival: there are many caravans and mobile homes on this tidy campsite. There are also smaller pitches with some shade and larger pitches right by the lake. The pitches are not marked out and are fairly close together. You can therefore quickly make friends with your mostly Hungarian neighbours. Another part of the camping guests has a permanent pitch. In the low season, mainly older people from Austria and Germany visit the campsite. The sanitary facilities are quite old, but clean.

By Lake Balaton

The best thing about this campsite is, of course, Lake Balaton. The lake is fairly shallow, averaging just three metres. This makes the water nice and warm in summer and very popular with tourists. You can fish in the lake, but not in high season between 09.00 and 19.00. Furthermore, no motorboats are allowed on the lake, making it safe for swimming. There are several harbours where you can sail.

It is important, however, to remain vigilant. Sometimes there are strong gusts of wind here. There is a warning system with flashing lights set up for this.

properties.name: Camping La Coronne
properties.description:
Camping La Coronne is located amidst lavender fields in a rural setting, on the edge of lively Valréas. The campsite is an excellent base from where to explore the Vaucluse. Enjoy the beautiful area and the warm weather.

Warm French summers

The campsite is well maintained. Camping La Coronne is a small-scale campsite with shady pitches. Great to enjoy a bit of shade in the hot French summers.

Water fun and cooling down

The swimming pool is adjacent to the reception. Ideal for hours of water fun. The sun likes to hang around in this part of France; therefore, some cooling down is very welcome. By the swimming pool you will find the restaurant with terrace, where you can relax and attend live concerts.

To Valréas on foot

A visit to the supermarket in Valréas is also worth your while. A walk of some one and a half km will take you to the centre of this attractive town. A leisurely stroll through the town centre before you do your shopping is also highly recommended.

Avignon: the Provençal City of Popes

Avignon is an hour's drive from the campsite. This city was the seat of the papacy from 1309 to 1377. The French pope Clemens V was the first pope who, pressured by the French king, took up residency in Avignon. His residency led to the construction of the Palace of the Popes. This imposing gothic building, with the historic centre of Avignon, is an official World Heritage Site.

properties.name: Camping Le Soleil
properties.description:
Lac d'Esparron is one of the most beautiful spots in the Parc Régional du Verdon. Camping Le Soleil is located directly on this lake, just outside the lovely village of Esparron-de-Verdon (Alpes-de-Hautes-Provence). This is a great starting point for adventures on the lake and its tributary the Verdon River. This well-maintained campsite is located on a hill, so there are considerable height differences. Facilities include a playground, restaurant, shop and (in high season) entertainment.

What is the layout of this campsite?

The campsite offers plenty of space for touring campers. Accommodation is also available for rent, including modern mobile homes, lodges and various types of safari tents. Accommodations are mainly at the top of the site, close to the campsite entrance. Further down you will then find most of the pitches. Car-free sites for tent campers are even further towards the lake. Most of the pitches provide a great view of the water and surrounding mountains.

Swimming or boating on Lac d'Esparron

With its location on Lac d'Esparron, this is an ideal holiday address for water sports enthusiasts. Rent a canoe from reception, cruise the clear blue waters of the lake or the Verdon, and enjoy the surrounding countryside. Or take a refreshing dip from the campsite's own beach. Various fun activities are also organised in summer. For example, join a jeu de boules competition or a basketball tournament, or visit the welcoming restaurant in the evening for live music.

properties.name: Camping Liberté Lacanau
properties.description:
Camping Liberté Lacanau is in the French department of Gironde. The campsite is located in a broad-leaved forest and is a few kilometres away from Étang de Lacanau lake. This family campsite is an oasis of peace in the Médoc nature reserve. It is a place to relax, and no activities are organised. Just sit down with a book in front of your tent or caravan and enjoy the beautiful surroundings. Or go out to explore the beautiful surroundings.

Camping in the woods

The campsite is in a quiet area, in the middle of a woodland. You camp on grass here. As a holidaymaker, you can also stay in one of the safari tents or wooden mobile homes. These accommodations have an equipped kitchen and their own toilet and washing facilities. Campsite visitors with their own camping equipment use the communal toilet and washing facilities. During the high season a food truck comes regularly and there is a coffee bar with a terrace. Order your fresh rolls and cakes daily at the reception.

Swimming in a lake and the ocean

Lac de Lacanau is only a few minutes’ drive from the campsite. You can swim, stand-up paddleboard, sail and windsurf. If you would rather spend the day at the beach, the Atlantic Ocean (10 km) is also nearby. To get to the beach, you must drive through the coastal town of Lacanau, where there are several restaurant and shops.

The campsite is in green, wooded surroundings with many options for walking and cycling. The vicinity of the campsite has several chateaus with vineyards. Often a wine-tasting can be booked here.

properties.name: Camping Ushuaia Villages La Presqu'île
properties.description:
Camping Ushuaia Villages La Presqu'île is the place to enjoy your holiday in the heart of nature. You will camp on the shores of Lac de Vassivière, where you can enjoy water sports, walking and cycling. Explore the Millevaches regional nature park or one of the villages and towns in the area, like Aubusson or Limoges.

Large, open camping pitches

The campsite’s pitches are large and open. You can choose between sunny and shaded pitches. You can also rent accommodation: from cosy mobile homes to spacious lodge tents. The camping fields are flat, ideal for your tent, caravan or motor home. There are three toilet blocks, one of which is also suitable for the less mobile. Water and electricity are available, as well as a special area to maintain your motor home. Some pitches and accommodation are on slightly sloping ground, something to bear in mind if you are less mobile.

Holidays on and around the water

The biggest advantage of Camping Ushuaia Villages La Presqu'île is its special location on Lac de Vassivière, a reservoir in central France. Explore the 30 km of lake shore on foot or by bike or boat and enjoy the forests and many small islands. On the lake, you can canoe, paddle board, windsurf and water-ski. The campsite has its own jetty.

Beautiful nature

The Millevaches regional nature park, where the campsite is located, is rich in forests, marshes and biodiversity. So, it’s a real pleasure to explore the many cycling and walking routes around the campsite.

properties.name: Sites & Paysages La Pinède
properties.description:
Enjoy your holiday in the popular southern French Aude region at the lovely Sites & Paysages La Pinède campsite. Located in a pine forest, it's within walking distance of the beautiful old town centre of Lézignan. A large swimming pool next to the campsite is free for campsite guests. At the campsite's restaurant, dishes are prepared with vegetables from its own vegetable garden.

Privacy and views

Thanks to its beautiful hillside location, the campsite is made up of terraces. Because of this, the higher pitches have beautiful views of Lézignan and the surrounding vineyards. There’s plenty of privacy as well, lots of green space and a lovely smell of pine trees. Prefer accommodation? Then opt for a mobile home or lodge tent. Dog owners are welcome to bring their four-legged friends with them.

Swim, paddle-tennis or walk

Campers have free access to the large municipal swimming pool next to the campsite. There are padel and tennis courts there too, ideal for sports enthusiasts. Children on the campsite come together at the playground, which also has a trampoline. If you feel like walking, cycling or mountain biking, there are great trails in the surrounding area.

Fresh from the kitchen garden

The cosy restaurant has a large terrace and is a great place to enjoy a local wine, ice cream or a bite to eat. Many of the vegetables are sourced from the restaurant's own vegetable garden. During tours of the kitchen garden, you will learn all about the crops and herbs. In high season, regular paella evenings are organised and campers eat together around the campfire.

properties.name: Flower Camping De la Forêt
properties.description:
Only 4 km away from Arrigny you'll find the terraced campground De La Forêt. The campground stretches over a large slightly sloping property (4 hectares) and is located near the Lac du Der and the forested Presqu'ile de Larzicourt.

The campsites are located in the forest and vary in size because they are set out among the trees. The gravel paths lead you to the loping, nicely fenced off sites with usually hard ground. You will find the mobile homes for rental on a separate part of the campground.

Active around the lake

There is a large sunny terrace with lounges at the heated swimming pool and kiddie pool. For children, there is a large playground on the campground, a table tennis table, a jeu de boules pitch and you can geocache. There is a larger playground at the lake. The campground is located on a cycling route 42 km around the Lac du Der.

Eating pizza at the swimming pool

You can order fresh bread to be delivered to the campground. The nearest supermarket is in Vitry-le-François or St. Dizier. The bar/restaurant has a terrace with a view of the pool. Here you can order from the small menu, such as pizza and snacks.

Lac du Der

100 metres away from the campground is a popular sandy beach on one of the largest man-made lakes in Western Europe. The water flows slowly, which is ideal for small children. Lac du Der is a paradise for ornithologists, and you can observe the cranes here. Water sports enthusiasts love it here too, courses are given in windsurfing and sailing.

properties.name: Camping de Contrexéville
properties.description:
This spacious campsite is located close to the famous thermal baths of Contrexéville and Vittel in the Vosges. You will stay in a quiet, wooded area just outside the village of Contrexéville. From here you can embark on scenic walking and cycling tours through the spectacular countryside or visit one of the spas. Camping de Contrexéville has 49 pitches with an average size of 90 m². You can order fresh rolls for breakfast and get a refreshing drink or ice cream at the terrace bar.

The campsite is a great destination for an extended camping holiday, but is also ideal for stopovers when travelling to the south (or back north). This is due to its convenient location near the A31 motorway, a short drive south of Nancy.

Unwind

Camping de Contrexéville is set in a peaceful location nestled among verdant hills. There are many trees around the campsite, giving you the feeling that you are camping in the middle of nature. The trees also provide the campsite with plenty of shade. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the campsite. The sanitary facilities are simple but well maintained and clean. Breakfast is served with fresh rolls that you can order at the campsite. Fancy a refreshing drink or ice cream? You can get those at the terrace bar.

Relax in your own private bubbling jacuzzi

You can enjoy the ultimate spa experience not only in the nearby spas, but also at the campsite itself. Rent a motorhome with your own private jacuzzi and enjoy a good glass of wine while soaking up the bubbles.

properties.name: Camping Montmorency
properties.description:
Unwind in a classic, small-scale health spa and stay on a modest, well maintained campsite. All of this is can be done on campsite Montmorency. The Vosges is a friendly and hilly region with walking opportunities and historical and cultural sights. The region also has much to offer in the culinary sphere.

Cheerful reception

The reception is housed next to the entrance. You can also obtain tourist information here. The campsite is located on slightly sloping grounds. You have the best view from the last row.

Quiet campsite

The pitches are spacious and clearly demarcated; you can pitch your tent or caravan on a firm grass surface.

You can also rent chalets and modern tents. All in all, a campsite for seekers of peace and quiet. Most visitors are French spa guests.

Thermal baths

The thermal baths in Bourbonne date back some 2000 years. Annually, thousands of guests flock to the thermal baths for all kinds of wellness treatments. The municipal swimming pool is close to the campsite.

Pleasant terrace

There is a playground for children. Snacks are available and there is a cosy bar with a terrace. Further shopping can be done in town where you will also find restaurants.

properties.name: Camping Le Repaire
properties.description:
Within walking distance of the town of Thiviers, in a park-like area, you will find the quiet family camping Le Repaire. The campsite is close to a lake with a sandy beach where you can swim. Guests are very impressed with this beautifully located campsite with great facilities. A special feature of this campsite (9 ha in size) is that pilgrims like to spend the night here in a 'pilgrims refuge': it is located on the road from Vézelay to Santiago de Compostella.

Spacious site

At Le Repaire you have a choice between spacious pitches (120-150 m2), on grassland and demarcated with small hedges. Poplars, oaks, cherries and pine trees provide ample shade or somewhat less shade. Several wooden rental homes can be rented as well.

Entertainment for all

The campsite has a heated swimming pool (150 m2) with a separate toddler pool. There is a table tennis table and a jeu-de-boule pitch. Competitions are organised here on a regular basis. You can borrow rackets, balls and shuttles from the reception. A small fee is payable for billiards as well as for the tennis court at the nearby Nantheuil recreational lake. At this lake, complete with sandy beaches and lawns, part of the water has been sectioned off. Therefore, children can safely swim here. There is a lovely playground. The campsite also has its own playground. In the recreation area lovely activities are organised twice weekly in English and French.

Dancing on summer evenings

In summer great activities such as rock concerts, dance evenings, theme evenings and kids parties are regularly organised on the terrace.

properties.name: Camping Le Moulin
properties.description:
Camping Le Moulin lies in a valley of the Rognon river, in the vicinity of Andelot-Blancheville. You camp here in the not yet very touristy, hilly Champagne-Ardennes region. The rurally situated campsite Le Moulin measures some 1.3 ha. The campsite is very tranquil. For entertainment, you can use the swimming pool and the mini-golf course.

A warm welcome

Whether you bring your own camping equipment or are staying in one of the mobile homes or fully furnished tunnel tents, everyone feels at home on this campsite. The pitches are rather spacious, vary somewhat in size and are mostly demarcated with high hedges.

Water fun for everyone

Campsite Le Moulin has a small swimming pool with a retractable roof, so you can swim in the open air in nice weather and indoors in inclement weather. Handy!

Good restaurant with terrace

The restaurant of the campsite is popular with local inhabitants, which is an indication of the excellent quality of the meals. The kitchen is open from Wednesdays through Sundays. They serve lunch and dinner. The meals can also be taken away. From 9 a.m. each morning, delicious fresh croissants and baguettes are available in the bar. You can buy fresh trout from the fish farm close to the campsite. Delicious on the barbecue!

Sports on screen

Major sports events like the Tour de France, Roland Garros, Wimbledon and Formula 1 races are shown on the big screen in the bar. Do you want to watch other matches and tournaments? Ask about the possibilities.

properties.name: Camping Du Bas-Meygnaud
properties.description:
Camping Du Bas-Meygnaud is a small, family-friendly campsite in the Dordogne, twenty kilometres north of Périgueux. Here, you can camp far from civilisation, on a natural campsite under the trees and surrounded by vast fields. Children can enjoy some fun in the swimming pool or in the woods.

Camping in the middle of nature

There are fifty pitches on the wooded campsite of Camping Du Bas-Meygnaud. Lush trees prevent the sunlight from reaching the ground, so you will be camping on spacious, shady pitches. If you have pitched your tent at the edge of the woods, you will look out over the fields and get a bit more sunshine. The campsite also has ten rental accommodations. You can choose from lodge tents, mobile homes and a hiker’s cabin.

Quiet family-friendly campsite with swimming pool

The campsite enjoys a friendly and quiet atmosphere. The location is particularly suitable for families with children who prefer to avoid busy environments. Although the campsite does not offer a great deal of activities, younger guests can easily keep themselves entertained. You can take a dip in the swimming pool (with paddling pool), and the natural campsite grounds are a great place for a game of football or badminton.

Brantôme, the Venice of the Périgord

The Périgord is a beautiful region with plenty to do. Just half an hour’s drive from the campsite, you can admire the stalactite caves of Villars, for example. The closest destination to the campsite is the centre of Brantôme, just a ten-minute drive away. This historic town is also known as the ‘Venice of the Périgord’ due to its location on the River Dronne. You can enjoy Brantôme from the water during a boat tour. Highly recommended!

properties.name: Camping La Venise de l'Ouest
properties.description:
At Camping La Venise de l'Ouest in the Sarthe, you camp in green surroundings, in the middle of a wooded park near La Ferté-Bernard. The campsite is near a recreational lake, so water fun is always within hand’s reach. Choose a camping pitch or one of the mobile home. Plus, you're only 10 minutes from the motorway: a practical location for exploring the area, with destinations like Parc Naturel Régional du Perche (35 km) and the castles of Montmirail (17 km) and the Comtes du Perche (26 km).

Large pitches and mobile homes

The two-hectare site offers large pitches for your tent, motor home or caravan, plus mobile homes with a view. All the pitches have a 10 or 16-amp electricity connection. Don't forget your CEE adapter if you want to use electricity. Clean and tidy mobile homes can be rented too, with one, two or three bedrooms, suitable for parties of up to six people.

A personal welcome and everything at hand

On arrival, you’ll receive a warm welcome from the campsite's owners. Besides this personal touch, you’ll find everything you need: a playground for the kids, two boules courts and a table tennis table. For ecological reasons, there’s no wi-fi on the campsite, but you can go online in the reception area if you need to.

The campsite is close to a recreational lake, so water fun is always within reach. There’s a bike rental service on the campsite, so it's easy to arrange an active day out.

properties.name: Flower Camping Trémolat Les Berges de la Dordogne
properties.description:
On the banks of the French Dordogne River lies the peaceful and green Flower Camping Trémolat Les Berges de la Dordogne campsite. The campsite is located near the village of Trémola, between Bergerac and Sarlat. In this region, you will enjoy the amazing versatility of the Dordogne. Natural beauty, water sports and a world of historical trips await you here.

Green surroundings by the water

After leaving the A89, it's about a 45-minute drive before you reach the entrance to the Flower Camping Trémolat Les Berges de la Dordogne campsite. After a warm welcome, you can head for your pitch or accommodation. There are many beautiful shaded spots available by the water or close to it.

Water fun, cycling and hiking

Water lovers will be in heaven here. The river is great for swimming, water skiing, canoeing and fishing. Of course, you can also take a refreshing dip in the camping pool.

Hikers and cyclists will also get their money's worth in this region. From the campsite, take the GR6 hiking trail and discover the 'Cingle de Trémolat' on foot or by bike. On this meandering route, you'll be treated to breathtaking views of the Dordogne River.

Facilities and activities at the campsite

After an exciting day out, there is no need to cook for yourself. With a restaurant, pizzeria and snack bar, there's plenty to choose from. And every morning, you can enjoy a delicious fresh bread roll. With several sports fields, a bocce court, a library and an activity room, there is always something to do at the campsite as well. Children will have fun with the entertainment team, in the playground or on the bouncy castle.

properties.name: Flower Camping du Lac de Saint-Point Lamartine
properties.description:
Flower Camping Le Lac de Saint-Point is located in a green and wooded area in Burgundy. Here you can camp directly at the Saint Point lake and enjoy peace and serenity. There are several camping pitches and rental accommodations from which you have a beautiful view of the valley. Explore the beautiful countryside or take a nice trip to Cluny, the vineyards of Saint-Véran and the Château de Lamartine. In 2020, the sanitary facilities will be completely renovated.

The campsite is located in green surroundings, about twenty minutes drive from the A6 motorway. Once you have arrived at the reception desk, put your camping equipment on one of the eighty shaded pitches. You can also rent one of the cottages on the edge of the lake. Once nestled between the woods and valleys, you will immediately notice that peace and quiet prevail here. The ingredients for a relaxing holiday!

Water fun for young and old

Swimming, pedal boats and sailing; at the lake every camper has a great time. Here too there is a relaxed atmosphere and you will always find a spacious place for your towel. A little further from the swimming area is a nice spot for anglers.

A delicious dinner

The campsite has a bar-restaurant with a covered terrace (nicely decorated with plants and lanterns) where you can enjoy a delicious meal. You dine there with a view of the lake. There is also regular musical entertainment. What can make the evening even more beautiful? Well, that the dishes on the menu come from the region. They also work a lot with local products. A real party to eat here!

properties.name: Camping Aux Portes des Mille Sources
Flower Camping La Samaritaine
properties.description:
In the south of the French Ardennes, walking distance from Buzancy, you'll find Flower Camping La Samaritaine. Here you'll find an oasis of rest and relaxation and a wonderfully maintained site with lovely campsites in a parklike environment. The campground is located on a stream and swimming pond with a beach in a hilly region with wonderful views.

Privacy and shade

There are lovely spacious campsites on the campground that are easy to reach. For campers, there are paved spaces with a great deal of shade. There is a great deal of privacy because the sites are separated. You can choose a sunny site or shady area. There are a few mobile homes and bungalow for hire on the campground.

Entertainment

Because there is a great deal offered for children, the campground is popular with families. In the high season there is an activities programme at least twice a week. In the low season, it is popular with seniors travelling with campers or caravans.

There is a limited selection available in the campground shop, but there are local products for sale. Fresh bread is delivered in the morning by order. You can get snacks, ice cream and take away meals in the weekend at the chip shop on the campground. The villagers also frequent it.

Natural swimming pool

Nearby there is a pond with a "natural swimming pool", with a grass and sandy beach and a sunbathing area. There is play equipment on the sandy beach. There is a bouncy castle and a trampoline.

Lawn mower races

In addition to the table tennis table and the jeu-de-boules pitch, you can also take part in the activities programme (high season). For example there are running races and lawn mower races organized.

properties.name: Camping La Tour de France
properties.description:
Via narrow roads flanked by beautiful vineyards, you drive to La Tour de France campsite. Once you have arrived at this peaceful campsite, you have a choice of various camping pitches and camper pitches. The campsite also has rental accommodation. For a refreshing dive you can jump into the swimming pool. Children also enjoy themselves in the playground.

Camping pitches and accommodations

The pitches, which are delimited by low hedges, look neat. You can choose between large or small and shady or sunny pitches. The campsite also has a few motor home pitches and about thirty rental accommodations. These are suitable for four persons and have two separate bedrooms. You also have your own kitchen. You can enjoy your delicious meal on your own terrace.

Fun for everyone

You can cool down in the campsite swimming pool. The pool is half-shaded. The youngest campers can splash around in the paddling pool. In the high season, entertainment is organised for all ages. Enjoy a concert, wine tasting, dance evening, card competition or a pleasant karaoke evening, for example. There is also a special children's recreation room where they can play with their friends. For a fun evening with the whole family, you can also book an hour at the campsite's bowling alley.

Food and drink

To make a nice breakfast, you can buy fresh bread at the campsite. In the evening you can have a bite to eat in the restaurant. In high season there is also a snack bar and pizzeria open at the campsite.

properties.name: Camping L’Orée des Caps
properties.description:
Situated on a quiet river in a green valley surrounded by woods, Camping L’Orée des Caps is located in the Pas-de-Calais department in northern France. The pitches are enclosed by hedges and flowers to ensure privacy and a cosy atmosphere. The owners welcome guests with open arms and do everything they can to make your stay as enjoyable as possible. The village of Licques is less than a kilometre away for convenient shopping or eating out.

Camping pitches and accommodation units

Whether you come with a tent, caravan or motorhome, you will camp in comfort here. Every pitch has electricity and water and is neatly marked out with hedges, providing shelter as well as peace and quiet. There is a special package and a separate grassy area available for hikers and pilgrims. You can also rent a comfortable mobile home.

Enjoy a drink in the sunny outdoor area

The atmosphere at Camping L’Orée des Caps is relaxed and friendly. Don’t expect an extensive entertainment programme, just simplicity and tranquillity. Take a seat at the bar and snack bar with a sunny outdoor area for a drink, a simple meal or a charcuterie platter with local cheeses. Children can have fun at the playground while you enjoy some time to yourself. You are sure to meet some new people in the communal garden, by the boules courts or in the multi-purpose hall. Feel like getting out and about? Hire a bike and explore the area at your own pace. Mountain biking and jogging weekends are also organised on a regular basis, allowing you to develop your skills under the guidance of a professional.

properties.name: Camping Le Vallon aux Merlettes
properties.description:
Camping Le Vallon aux Merlettes is situated less than a ten-minute walk from the attractive Breton town of Matignon. This is a very pleasant spot to stay in. Not only for the spaciously laid out and park-like terrain (even the pathways are of grass), but also because of the tranquillity and lovely atmosphere. A suitable location for nature lovers and young families. The facilities are basic, but effective. The reception houses a shop, a bar and an eatery.

The first impression you get of the terrain is that it is well maintained, but also that nature is allowed to take its course. Hence not only cut grass, but also high grass, bushes and many trees. There are spacious pitches (100-130 m2) available, some of which are slightly sloping. They are mostly demarcated with hedges or with nice wooden fences.

Beautiful rental bungalows

You can rent unique rental accommodation on Camping Le Vallon aux Merlettes. For instance, fully equipped tents and bungalows. The attractive looking bungalows are at quite a distance from each other (on the edge of the field) and as a result a bit further away from the swimming pool. You have more peach and privacy here, but it involves a slightly longer walk to the facilities.

Swimming fun throughout the year

The swimming pool is modestly sized (85 m2), but is covered with a semi-circular plexiglass roof. Obviously, the roof is open on hot days. When it rains or on chilly days, the roof closes and children can enjoy themselves in the pool. Outside is a tiled terrace with sun loungers.

properties.name: Camping Dordogne Les cinq Chateaux
properties.description:
Camping Dordogne Les Cinq Châteaux is an idyllic family campsite in a green area. You camp among the medieval villages of La Roque Gageac and Beynac, on the banks of the Dordogne river. You can walk to various villages alongside the river. You can even see the famous “valley of the five castles” from the campsite. Everything needed for a relaxed holiday in the Périgord Noir can be found here, including a heated swimming pool and fun activities.

Camping with a focus on nature

The pitches at Camping Dordogne Les Cinq Châteaux are spacious and offer both sun and shade. If you don't bring your own camping equipment, you can hire an accommodation, like a safari tent or mobile home. If you would prefer to do something more extraordinary, you can fall sleep in a bivouac tent nestled in the trees – two metres high. Much attention is paid to the environment. For example, there are facilities for separating waste and sensors to prevent unnecessary use of energy. This allows you to enjoy a holiday in the middle of nature, showing respect for your surroundings.

Activities and relaxation

During the summer months, Camping Dordogne Les Cinq Châteaux offers many activities, such as creative workshops and night-time walks. There are also sports facilities. For example, you could enjoy a game of jeu de boules, table tennis, volleyball and badminton and a fish pond. The heated swimming pool is surrounded by comfortable sun loungers. Good to know: swimming shorts and Bermudas are not permitted here. You can have a delicious pizza at the bar, or you can pick up food.

properties.name: Camping L'Île Cariot
properties.description:
In the southern part of the Vendée, towards the bordering Charente-Maritime region, you will find a former municipal campsite, now called Camping L’Ile Cariot. The campsite is only five minutes from the centre of Chaillé-les-Marais. The campsite resembles an island in the heart of the Marais Poitevin, the renowned marshland. You can go for endless walks, cycle rides or road trips.

This friendly family campsite has virtually only tourist pitches. These are nice and spacious pitches on which you can easily park your car and caravan, or even a large motorhome.

Never too young to learn

In low season you will mainly find seniors of all nationalities, whereas in high season there are many families with young children. The campsite is mostly geared towards this target group, although the activities on and around the campsite are fun for children of all ages. Enjoy fishing in one of the creeks or play a game of pétanque. You are never too young to learn; this applies here, too.

Grilled chicken

In the shop you can buy lovely regional products; fresh bread has to be ordered a day in advance. On Sundays you can buy grilled chicken for lunch. Bon appetit!

Jewellery making and archery

There is a small heated swimming pool. In peak season you can design and make your own jewellery. Fun for both children and parents. On Fridays you can take archery lessons. Tennis enthusiasts take note: at a distance of some 100 m from the campsite you will find a tennis court which you can freely use. Great 'service'!

properties.name: Camping Ushuaïa Villages du Sabot
properties.description:
Lovers of the quiet and nature will certainly enjoy Camping du Sabot, located on the outskirts of Saint-Maurice-de-Lignon. The campsite is a green oasis; neatly tended and brightened up with colourful flower beds. You will have a wonderful view of this wooded, hilly part of the Haute-Loire. The campsite is mainly aimed at those looking for peace and quiet, which does not mean that the surroundings are not ideal for various outdoor activities.

Beautiful camping

The spacious, green camping pitches are generously shaded by the various types of trees on the site. The pitches have few boundaries, so you can enjoy the beautiful view all the more. The campsite is situated in an ideal location; right next to a pine forest and between the Gorges de la Loire and the river Lignon. Some pitches are equipped with a picnic table. Most pitches have an excellent Wi-Fi connection.

Free showers

The sanitary facilities may look a bit outdated at first glance, but they are kept very clean. Moreover, you can take free hot showers, so no difficult hassle with coins. The necessary motorhome services are also offered to guests free of charge. For example, there is a cistern for chemical toilets and a point to refill the water tank.

Ball sports, large and small

At this campsite you have the opportunity to play all kinds of ball sports. Think of basketball, but also table football and table tennis. You can also take part in jeu-de-boules tournaments. For the children, there is a nice playground where they can climb, swing and spin on the merry-go-round.

properties.name: Camping La Fontaine
properties.description:
Camping La Fontaine is located in the south of Brittany, between Vannes and Nantes. This quiet family campsite near the village of Guérande has spacious pitches laid out on a well-groomed terrain. Both the heated swimming pool and the modern sanitary facilities are recent. The surroundings are largely flat and therefore suitable for long bike rides.

Shady camping spot1

The campsite of La Fontaine is quiet and green. The spacious pitches are laid out on well-maintained and leveled lawns. Eighty touring pitches are available. You can choose a delimited pitch between hedges, or a shady spot under the trees on the large lawn. In addition to touring pitches, La Fontaine also has twenty permanent pitches and nineteen rental accommodations.

Families with children

La Fontaine is a nice campsite for families with children. There is a heated outdoor swimming pool with a separate paddling pool. There are comfortable sun beds all around, so you can keep an eye on the little ones from your lazy chair. The pool is only a few years old and is well maintained. Besides the pool, children can also have fun in the playground or on the bouncy castle. In high season there is also an entertainment programme at the campsite.

Bread on the campsite

If you come camping at La Fontaine in July or August, you don't have to leave the campsite. In those months you can get fresh bread every morning at the reception. The bar and snack bar are open every morning. Take away meals are also available. In the low season you will have to go to Guérande more often. There you’ll find bakeries, supermarkets and restaurants.

properties.name: Camping Les Rives de Vilaine
properties.description:
Camping Les Rives de Vilaine is located in the town of Férel on the bank of the Vilaine river. You camp here at a stone's throw away from the sea. This family-friendly campsite is a perfect choice for a holiday with family or friends. Cycling, kayaking, swimming, reading on the beach, walking or soaking up a bit of culture are just some of the possibilities during your stay in the south of Brittany.

Flowery campsite

The tranquil campsite Les Rives de Vilaine is located in a wooded and flowery park and is fully fenced in. The grounds are a few km away from the superb sandy beaches of Mine d'Or (Pénestin) and Le Remblais (La Baule). Make this campsite your base to explore the south of Brittany and the Guérande peninsula.

Spacious camping pitches

The pitches measuring between 100 - 150 m2 are really spacious. They are all equipped with a 10A-connection and never far from one of the many water connections or the sanitary and service buildings. The pitches are separated from each other by low hedges and tall trees provide the necessary shade.

Booking of accommodation

Campsite Les Rives de Vilaine has several rental mobile homes for up to six persons. All mobile homes are fully equipped with kitchen, shower/toilet, TV and electric heating.

Clean sanitary facilities

The sanitary building with showers and toilets is kept immaculately clean. One of them is adapted for disabled guests. Naturally, there are also laundry and washing up facilities.

properties.name: Camping la Belle Étoile
properties.description:
The sunny south of the Aveyron department is a real nature destination with beautiful sights and a rich history. Just above the city of Millau, Camping la Belle Étoile is situated on the edge of a typical French village. The atmosphere on the campsite is very friendly and the direct location on the river Tarn is a big plus.

Freedom in the sun

The flat, small campsite has a capacity for around seventy spacious pitches. The site has fields along various streets and also an open area. From some of the pitches, there is a view of a village nestled against the hills in the distance. The lawns are all neatly kept and there are some mobile homes.

Paddling with a view

Camping la Belle Étoile lets you experience real outdoor life. How about paddling or swimming in the river Tarn? From your pitch it is only a few steps to the pebble beach and the water.

Nice bar and pizzeria with outside seating

Fancy a bite to eat? Every evening, pizzas are baked at the bar. But you can also get delicious salads or a piece of meat from the grill. Various local shops, such as a baker and butcher, are within walking distance of the campsite. The larger supermarkets can be found in Millau.

Games and sports

Young children will also enjoy themselves, for example on the bouncy castle that is available in high season. There are sports fields next to the campsite. If you fancy a nice bike ride or walk, you can choose from various attractive trails. Furthermore, canoeing on the beautiful Tarn is a unique experience when you are on holiday in this region.

properties.name: Camping de Montolieu
properties.description:
Camping de Montolieu is located on the edge of a wooded area in the South of France, fifteen kilometres from Carcassonne. This small, well-maintained campsite has recently been taken over by a young couple, who have largely renovated it. The well-organized campsite is quietly situated and has spacious, demarcated touring pitches with lots of privacy. The nearby town of Montolieu is known as the village of books.

Lots of privacy

The well-organized campsite is located directly on the road. There are 43 touring pitches, all delimited by hedges on three sides. So you really have a field to yourself, with lots of privacy. The pitches are neatly maintained, and the straight, paved paths are lit at night. As the campsite is situated directly along the D629, you sometimes hear some traffic noise. However, it is usually nice and quiet.

Pleasant pavement café

The main building at the entrance has recently been completely renovated. In addition to the reception you will also find a well-equipped recreation room, a bar, a snack bar and a pleasant pavement café. In the morning you can get fresh bread and croissants, and you'll also find a small assortment of local products. Not only dinner, but also breakfast are served at the pavement café. Please note that these services are only available in high season.

Wine and jeu de boules

In July and August, all kinds of activities are organized on the campsite for its guests. On Wednesdays you can join the pleasant ‘table d’hôtes’ (communal meal). On Sundays there is a petanque competition, and every Friday evening you can take part in a wine tasting. There is also an excursion programme and guided hikes are organised.

properties.name: Camping La Terre de Belle Rive
Camping La Cigaline
properties.description:
The southwest of France is known for its vineyards, castles, green landscapes and ancient villages. Camping La Cigaline is the ideal base from which to explore the region. On the banks of the river Isle this well-maintained campsite has a pleasant location.

Between the green

There are several paved paths on the orderly terrain. The spacious camping pitches are situated along these streets, usually separated from each other by hedges or shrubs. They are flat with a grass surface. The mobile homes and furnished tents also have plenty of privacy.

Have a glass of wine with a view

The nice pavement café with a view of the bridge is perhaps the nicest spot on the campsite. In the restaurant you can enjoy an ice cream, drink, snack or healthy smoothie all day long. And if you don't feel like cooking in the evening, this is the place to be. The small menu includes various regional dishes.

In the pool or in nature

With a constant temperature of 28 degrees, the pool is always nice and warm. The pool is big enough if you want to swim a few lengths. In the summer for one evening weekly the pool is turned into a gem with all kinds of beautiful lights for disco swimming until 22.30 hours. Around the pool are several sun loungers for a well-deserved rest.

Outdoor entertainment

During the summer months, the campsite offers fun activities for all ages such as a petanque tournament, bingo, music evenings and karaoke shows. Outside the programme there is also plenty to do for children with a trampoline, a ping-pong table and a table football game.

properties.name: Camping Ushuaïa Villages Le Lavandin
properties.description:
