Camping Le Lavandin is located close to the Lake of Esparron. Here you camp in a rural area in southeast France with hills and trees. The site is spacious and has both rental accommodations and touring pitches. If you love nature and an active holiday, this is the right address.

Quiet surroundings

At Camping Le Lavandin you camp in a beautiful, quiet area in the woods. There are 66 pitches, half of which are accommodations and the other half pitches. In the high season you can order delicious rolls for breakfast and the restaurant with terrace is open. You can also have a snack at the snack bar and the pizzeria.

Swimming in the lake

Although the campsite has no swimming pool, you can easily drive to Lac d’Esparron (5 km) for some water fun. The water in this lake is very clear and you have an amazing view of the surrounding mountains. It is also fun to rent a boat or a pedal boat here. At the campsite, you can entertain yourself with a game of jeu de boules, badminton or mini golf. A playground has also been made for the children to enjoy themselves. Theme evenings with music are organised regularly.

Explore France’s deepest gorge

Camping Le Lavandin is a good home base to explore the Gorges du Verdon. It is France’s deepest gorge and the second-deepest gorge in Europe, covering a distance of at least 25 kilometres. It is great for activities such as kayaking, canyoneering, rafting, hiking and mountain-climbing. Thus an ideal destination for the active campsite visitor.

properties.name: Camping Le Domaine de Beaulieu
properties.description:
Camping Le Domaine de Beaulieu is a quiet campsite in the Vendée, not far from the Atlantic coast and the beach. Within a few minutes by bike you are on the long beach. However, you don't have to leave the campsite for a dip in the water. With an indoor and outdoor swimming pool with paddling pools and slides, you'll find water fun for everyone.

Quiet campsite

It’s peaceful camping on the beautifully maintained campsite Le Domaine de Beaulieu, where there are spacious touring pitches on lawns. Many of the touring pitches are shaded by trees, but there are also sunny pitches. Different types of mobile homes are situated between the pitches. At the front of the campsite you'll find all facilities and play grounds. Further back on the terrain it is quieter.

Indoor and outdoor swimming pool

The fact that the campsite is a real family campsite can be seen from the swimming pools, among other things. These can be found behind the large main building. Not only can the adult campers have a nice swim here, the little ones can also have a nice dip here. Both the indoor and outdoor swimming pools have a paddling pool with a slide and water play equipment.

Cosy restaurant

Next to the swimming pool, separated by a fence, is the outdoor café of the restaurant. Here you can sit down at your leisure to taste dishes from the Vendée or for a quick bite or cocktail. The inside of the restaurant looks lovely, with wooden ridge beams and a large bar. A great place to socialise or to have a drink with your fellow campers.

properties.name: Camping Paradis Le Coiroux
properties.description:
Camping Le Coiroux is located on the outskirts of the charming village of Aubazine, just six kilometres from the famous abbey of the same name. This green campsite in Corrèze combines nature, relaxation and fun for the whole family. You camp close to a lake and a golf course. Whether you want to walk along the Canal des Moines, take a dip in the swimming pool or enjoy French hospitality, you’ll experience a real holiday feel here.

Camp in the park

The many trees and well-kept grounds make the campsite feel like a landscaped park. The 80 to 100-m2 pitches are shady or semi-shady - just right for enjoying the French sun. Prefer to holiday in a luxury mobile home? There’s a wide choice of accommodation for 4 to 6 people, each with its own patio.

Water fun without fuss

No holiday is complete without water fun and you’ll find that here! In high season, head to the heated outdoor pool for a swim or an aqua-aerobics lesson. There’s a paddling pool and sun loungers with parasols. Lake Coiroux is just 500 metres from the campsite. It's the perfect place to relax on the beach, buy something tasty from the snack bar and swim, canoe or paddle board in the water.

Discover Corrèze

The campsite's location is ideal for campers who love nature and culture. Take a walk along the Canal des Moines (6 km) or visit charming villages like Collonges-la-Rouge (25 km) and Turenne (30 km).

properties.name: Camping Le Trivoly
properties.description:
Camping Le Trivoly is a four-star campsite in a green and flowery setting in Torreilles-Plage. The campsite is only eight hundred metres from a vast sandy beach. An ideal holiday address for sun and beach lovers! There are also several beautiful places to visit in the area. On the campsite itself you will find a heated swimming pool, an attractive cafeteria with a pavement café and well-maintained camping fields.

A cosy camping area

At Camping Le Trivoly there are relatively many mobile homes. However, all the touring pitches are grouped together. These pitches are spacious, shady and delimited by vegetation. In this way, this area conveys a well-kept and attractive impression. In high season it is mainly families with children (from France, Germany and the Netherlands among others) who visit this campsite. In low season you will find more seniors here. And no matter what age or nationality you are, as a sun worshipper you will be comfortable here anyway.

Water fun in the heated swimming pool

Centrally located on the campsite you will find the attractive and spacious swimming pool. Here you can swim laps and have fun splashing around. Even if the weather is not so good for a day, because the swimming pool is heated. The water slides are an extra attraction. Amusement on the campsite is also available in the entertainment programmes. These are for guests of all ages.

Attractive cafeteria

Right next to the swimming pool you will find a very lively café/bar with snack bar, where you can order tasty snacks and drinks. Furthermore, fresh bread is available at the campsite, as well as some groceries. On the outskirts of the village of Saint-Laurent-de-la-Salanque you will find several large supermarkets.

properties.name: Flower Camping de Mars
properties.description:
Camping de Mars is beautifully situated in one of the most beautiful parts of Central France: the Loire! The campsite has everything one needs for a carefree holiday for the entire family. There is a heated pool for water fun and some small-scale entertainment for children. Nature lovers will also really feel at home here. It is the only campsite in the vicinity with the label 'Clé Verte' as proof of their sustainable policy.

Mars Peninsula

Camping de Mars lies in a very unusual location, namely on the peninsula with the same name at the heart of the largest meander of the Loire River. From here you have a magnificent view of the river and the resevoir below.

The campsite is located in a quiet and natural setting. This feeling is also reflected in the roomy pitches which have been purposefully kept as natural as possible. There are touring pitches for hikers/cyclists and natural sites without electricity for (tent)campers. Rental units are also provided (basic Trigano-bungalow tents, mobile homes and luxury cottages with covered, wooden veranda).

Restaurant

You can find fresh bread, croissants, beverages, ice cream or a lovely meal in the restaurant. The menu includes barbecue dishes, French fries, pizzas and salads. The terrace offers a glorious view of the Loire. After dinner you are treated to a lovely sunset. There is a small supermarket on the premises.

Sport and games

Children will enjoy themselves on the trampoline and bouncing cushion at campsite De Mars. Other activities: games, table tennis, jeu de boules, beach volleyball and table football. There is a small-scale entertainment team that organises all kinds of activities (archery tournaments and visits to an educative farm).

properties.name: Camping Bel Air Village Le Brabois
properties.description:
In Villers-lès-Nancy, a quiet suburb of the cultural French city of Nancy (Meurthe-et-Moselle) is Camping Bel Air Village Le Brabois. If you would like to visit Nancy, this three-star campsite is an ideal overnight stop. And just five minutes' drive from the A37 motorway, Le Brabois is an excellent stopover for campers passing through. The campsite itself has a heated swimming pool with sliding roof, a supermarket and a snack bar.

Camping on a park-like site

By the barrier, you will find a modern reception building, behind which is a park-like area with mostly tourist pitches. The pitches are neatly maintained, covering an area of about eighty square metres and are well defined. You can choose your own touring pitch here, although you can also opt to stay in accommodation, such as a modern mobile home or safari tent.

Swimming pool and snack bar

This campsite is particularly popular with campers passing through and tourists wishing to visit Nancy. However, everyone should spend one day of their holiday on the campsite. Take a dip in the heated swimming pool, which has a paddling pool, whirlpool and massage jets. The pool has a sliding roof, so it can be used throughout the season. For the youngest campers, there is a fun playground and a mini farm with chickens and rabbits. It also has a fairly large supermarket and a cafeteria with bar.

Enjoy cultural city of Nancy

A bus stops a hundred metres from the campsite which takes you to Nancy. In the city centre, make sure to visit the beautiful Place Stanislas, the chic Parc de la Pépinière and the picturesque Place de la Carrière.

properties.name: Camping La Trévillière
properties.description:
La Trévillière campsite is situated In the sunny Vendée, not far from the Atlantic Ocean and the beach. This family campsite has several swimming pools, a large paddling pool and a water slide, so children can have fun here. You'll camp on green pitches, delimited by thick hedges and shaded by trees. The Atlantic coast is ten minutes away by bike.

Camping in the green

With around seventy touring pitches and over a hundred rental units, La Trévillière is not a particularly large campsite. The touring pitches are very spacious and delimited by thick hedges. The ground is grassy, shade comes from tall trees. So you'll be camping among the greenery, on a quiet spot in the Vendée.

Quiet family campsite

Many different campers can enjoy themselves on the campsite. Families with children will particularly appreciate the many playing facilities - the swimming pools, the large playground and the mini-golf course. Those looking for peace and quiet will enjoy the calm surroundings near the French west coast. This area is easy to explore by bicycle, while you can have lovely walks along the coast itself.

Restaurant and swimming pools

At the front of the campsite, near the spacious entrance, you will find the restaurant. The pavement café overlooks the swimming pools, so you can enjoy the sun with a nice drink, while the children play on the slide. In fact, the swimming complex is the biggest attraction for small campers. With an indoor pool, an outdoor pool and a large paddling pool with fun water play equipment, there is plenty to swim. But the red water slide is especially popular with children.

properties.name: Camping Huttopia Lac de la Siauve
properties.description:
On the banks of a large reservoir, on the border between the Limousin and the Auvergne, lies Camping Huttopia Lac de la Siauve. This terraced campsite has shady pitches with a magnificent view over the lake. This family campsite has a heated swimming pool and direct access to the sandy beach by the lake.

Lake view

The campsite of Camping Huttopia Lac de la Siauve is laid out in terraces. There are 171 spacious touring pitches, many with breathtaking views of the lake. The pitches (grass) are separated from each other by high hedges. The campsite mainly consists of touring pitches, but there are also about twenty permanent annual pitches. In addition, there are just over fifty rental accommodations, spread out in groups throughout the campsite.

Enjoy swimming

On one of the lower terraces is a heated swimming pool with a sliding roof. Weather permitting, the walls and roof are slid open. Around the pool are sun loungers, there is also a beautiful sundeck. Outside is a small, heated paddling pool. From the pool there is a path through the forest to the banks of the reservoir. You can enjoy swimming, windsurfing, sailing and water-skiing.

Outdoor activities for young and old

There are many facilities for children on the campsite, including a recreation room and a water playground. In high season there is a mini-club for the little ones and an entertainment programme with all kinds of outdoor activities. For teenagers there is a separate entertainment programme, just like for adults. In the evenings there are regular live concerts and dinners with regional dishes.

properties.name: Camping Paradis Soleil d’Oc
properties.description:
The Soleil d'Oc campsite is situated in the southernmost part of France, between Narbonne and the Mediterranean Sea. This campsite is perfect for the whole family, with plenty for the little ones to enjoy. Its unique lagoon pool is guaranteed to provide hours of fun in the water for the kids. The campsite is located within walking distance of the beaches along the wide Mediterranean coastline.

A refreshing atmosphere

The straight paths, flat pitches and carefully maintained rental accommodation in fresh colours create a vibrant atmosphere on this campsite. The palms, olive trees and oleander constantly remind you that you are camping along the Mediterranean coast. 

Tropical lagoon

Soleil d'Oc is a favourite among couples and families with young children. That is because there is plenty for them to do here: a playground with climbing frames, bouncy castles in different sizes and a beautiful lagoon. The round pool has a gentle slope and a maximum depth of 1.4 metres at the centre. Even though it's child-friendly, the pool is still a great place for adults to cool off with a swim or to float about and relax. The blue water is surrounded by white sand with loungers and straw umbrellas. The palm trees complete the tropical ambience. 

Up and down the trails

The Soleil d'Oc campsite is located in the Parc Régional Naturel de la Narbonnaisse en Mediterranée , a protected nature reserve that is rich in biodiversity. The varied landscape boasts lagoons, sandy beaches, reed marshes and ponds and is an important breeding ground for unique migratory birds. 

The hiking here is fantastic, but there are all kinds of beautifully paved cycling routes at the entrance to the campsite as well. They take you through the unspoilt natural setting towards the nearby coastal areas. For example, you can bike eight kilometres out to Gruissan, a charming fishing village that is typical of the Mediterranean.

properties.name: Camping Plein Sud
properties.description:
On the Atlantic coast in the Vendée, between the seaside resorts of Notre-Dame-de-Monts and Saint-Jean-de-Monts, you will find the quiet campsite Plein Sud. At this family campsite, you camp on well-maintained pitches or stay in one of the various cottages. The water playground and swimming pool are especially fun for children.

Green pitches

Most mobile homes are located at the front of the campsite. You can choose from almost forty different types of cottages, but you can also camp in a (simply furnished) lodge tent or a cosy hiker's hut. Some of the pitches are situated between the rental accommodations, but you'll find the spacious pitches mainly on a separate part of the terrain. What's striking is the greenery: beautifully maintained hedges delimitate the green lawns and give you plenty of privacy on your pitch.

Swimming pool with water playground

The outdoor swimming pool is situated at the front of the campsite, on the left after the entrance. With nice weather, this spacious pool is a great place for a cooling dip. All around are sun loungers and umbrellas, and the whole is enclosed by glass walls. If you are on holiday with children, you will probably often find them in the water playground next to the pool, across the driveway.

If you are camping in low season, you can make free use of the indoor pool, sauna and hammam of campsite Aux Coeurs Vendéens, located across the street.

Sports and games

Also at the front of the campsite are the sports field and playground. The multisport field is for football and basketball players, while the children can have fun on the climbing frames.

properties.name: Camping L'Olivier
properties.description:
Camp among the olive trees at L'Olivier campsite, a small campsite in the Gard. This campsite is situated in the medieval village of Junas, just between Nîmes and Montpellier. It is an intimate campsite where you can fully enjoy the peace and quiet. Here you will find that relaxed atmosphere you are looking for during your holiday. Need to cool down? Then dive into the fresh water of the swimming pool.

Charming campsite among the olives

L'Olivier campsite is not particularly large. Yet you will not be short of space. Many of the fairly spacious pitches are situated under old olive trees. Sit down in the shade on your lovely pitch. Pick up a book and enjoy the peace and quiet around you. At this campsite, in the middle of the quiet French countryside, you can really relax.

Swimming with the sun on your head

At the edge of the campsite is the playground. Here children can enjoy swinging and jumping on trampolines. Are you going to the playground? Then put on your swimwear! Because next to the playground is the swimming pool. Dive into the refreshing water with the sun on your head. Swimming laps or splashing around with the children: the pool is perfect for both.

Fresh bread and pizza

A small shop at the campsite provides you with the ingredients you need for your meal at the campsite. In high season, you can also go there for fresh rolls. Forgotten to order? No problem, because the baker's is 400 metres away. A short morning walk and you are surrounded by baguettes and croissants. If you don't feel like cooking, check out the snack bar at the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Les Garennes de la Mer
Le Vaugrais
properties.description:
At the foot of the Columbier mountain, within walking distance of the village of Artemare, lies the small and friendly campsite Le Vaugrais. The site is quietly situated in a beautiful, green mountainous area with picturesque villages and green pastures.

The pitches, on a lawn and demarcated with greenery, are level, spacious and in a sunny position. On top of it, you will find an abundance of flowers on this friendly, well maintained campsite.

Table tennis and swimming pool

There is some playground equipment for children as well as a table tennis table. Near the swimming pool (70 m2), heated in peak season, you will find a few loungers. A small river flows past the campsite, ideal for children to play in. In the surrounding area you can also follow the signposted, beautiful walking and cycling routes. You can rent bicycles and mountain bikes at the reception.

Daily fresh bread

There is no shop on the campsite, although fresh bread can be ordered on a daily basis. You can do your shopping at the supermarket in Artemare. In peak season camping guests can order a bite to eat from the snack bar. Take-away meals are also offered.

Peaceful environment

In the area you can enjoy the mountains, beautiful landscapes and waterfalls. At the foot of the campsite you will find the 64 m high Cerveyrieu waterfall. Experienced cyclists like to climb the Col du Grand Colombier (1,700 m), one of the most challenging mountain passes in the country. The Lac du Bourget, the largest natural ice lake in the country, is located on the top. This blue-coloured lake contrasts beautifully with the extraordinarily green landscape. Beautiful pictures guaranteed!

properties.name: Camping Seasonova Les Prés du Verdon
properties.description:
Camping Bel Air Village Les Prés du Verdon is located in the heart of Provence Alpes Côte d'Azur. Enjoy peace, space and a landscape that will make you feel like you’re on a postcard. Camp among lavender fields, look out over the Gorges du Verdon and head out into nature for walks, canoe trips or just an afternoon of relaxation. And for a cultural outing, the villages of Moustiers Sainte Marie and Riez are nearby.

Camp with a view

You can choose to do exactly what suits you here. A large pitch, surrounded by greenery and plenty of space for chairs, bikes and picnic tables. Or a mobile home with a view of the surrounding nature. Accommodation ranges in size from 16 to 30 square metres and is equipped with everything you might need. Handy for couples but also for families that like a bit of extra convenience on their camping holiday.

Everything within arm's reach

On hot days, take a dip in the pool and cool off. Children enjoy the entertainment and soon find new friends. You won't need to leave the site for food either: take a seat in the restaurant or order something from the bar. Head to the solarium and spa for extra relaxation.

Visit the Gorges du Verdon

The Gorges du Verdon, the region's most famous tourist attraction, is just around the corner. It’s a must. On foot, climbing along rock faces or by canoe: the choice is yours.

properties.name: Flower Camping du Lac de la Seigneurie
properties.description:
Flower Camping du Lac de la Seigneurie is situated in the Alsace. This part of the region is not very touristy as yet and is very suitable for walkers and cyclists. The village of Masevaux is a ten-minute drive away and larger towns such as Belfort and Mulhouse are located less than half an hour away.

Camping terrain divided by a road

A noticeable feature of the terrain is that it is divided in two by a road running over the camping grounds. The terrain is well maintained and clean. The pitches are spacious to very spacious and level. The camping pitches vary in size and offer ample privacy. Both sections of the campsite have a fairly large ablution block.

In addition, there are also some modern wooden chalets, mobile homes and caravans available for rent. Some rental caravans come with an additional wooden cottage on/near the pitch.

Heated swimming pool

There is a beautiful outdoor swimming pool on the campsite which consists of three parts: a toddler pool, a bubble bath and a swimming section. The swimming pool is located on the boundary of the campsite.

There is a playground for children and a sports field on the campsite. Some twenty minutes away from the campsite you will find various outdoor activities. There are only few organised activities on the campsite. You can find shops and restaurants in Marveaux or another village in the vicinity.

properties.name: La Ferme des 4 Chênes
properties.description:
This campsite is located in the village of Urt (French Basque Country), quite close to the Spanish border. From the campsite you have a view of the Adour in the distance. This is the largest river in the region. The Adour flows into the Atlantic Ocean via Bayonne (25 km away) and the Bay of Biscay. The campsite is located six hundred metres from Urt's village centre. You will find shops and restaurants there.

Welcome!

The terrain of La Ferme des 4 Chênes is slightly hilly in places. The camping pitches are generally quite large. They vary from 75 to 250 m2. Trees provide plenty of shade. They also give the site a nice, green appearance. In the middle of the campsite is a beautiful lawn with palm trees. There are also a few camper pitches and about forty rental accommodations (mobile homes and lodge tents). In the campsite shop you can buy fresh bread, pastries, soft drinks and ice cream.

Fun in the water for young and old

Take a refreshing dip in the campsite's sleek swimming pool (with paddling pool). This is close to the reception. Plenty of sun loungers are available for sun worshippers. There is also a cosy terrace with a sitting area by the pool.

Lovers of the sea can choose from several coastal towns with numerous beaches. Among the most beautiful cities on the Atlantic Coast are Biarritz, Bidart and Saint-Jean-de-Luz. The campsite does not organise activities. There is a nice petting zoo and a playground with a sandpit and a bouncy castle. You can also go for a workout. There is a table tennis table and jeu-de-boules court for this.

properties.name: Bel Air Village Sous le Moulin
properties.description:
Camping Bel Air Village Sous le Moulin is on the shores of Lac de Coiselet, at the edge of the French Jura department and the mountain range of the same name. Enjoy stunning views of the mountains from the campsite. Add to this, the direct access to the lake and the versatile surroundings and you’ll understand why this campsite is popular with outdoor enthusiasts. Fishing, walking, cycling or just relaxing by the water: this is the place to be.

Camp by the water

The campsite has 58 large pitches (approx. 100 m²) for tents, caravans and motor homes. The pitches are private thanks to dividing hedges and are shaded because they are under the trees. The campsite extends 600 metres along the lake, so you’re never more than a few steps away from having your feet in the water. Many of the mobile homes also have lake views and a covered patio.

Friendly family campsite

The heated and covered swimming pool is fun all year round, but you’d prefer to splash into the lake right from your tent, of course. Cast a fishing rod, hire a kayak or bring your own boat to the campsite for even more water fun. The campsite also has a playground, a boules court and a table tennis table. In high season, there’s also a mini club for children aged 6 to 12.

Head to the snack bar for a snack and drink. The pizzas are a must! You can order fresh bread at reception. Several villages with restaurants and a supermarket are a 15-minute drive away.

properties.name: Camping Bel Air Village La Pointe de Roscoff
properties.description:
Camping La Pointe de Roscoff is a small campsite right on the Atlantic Ocean, in northern Brittany. It’s a top destination for anyone seeking peace, space and fresh sea air. The campsite is located in a beautiful part of Natura 2000 area. There’s no swimming pool here, but there is a beach for water fun. The town of Roscoff, with one of the region's most beautiful harbours, is close by. Be sure to bring your walking shoes, as the famous GR34 trail is close to the campsite.

Camp in green surroundings

The campsite is located on a large wooded site. Camp on natural, shaded pitches with no fixed boundaries. Pitch your tent under the trees or park your caravan with a view of the surrounding greenery. Coming without camping equipment? Opt for a mobile home. Thanks to its location by the sea, you can walk straight onto the beach. In bad weather, the thermal spa, three km away, is a good option.

Everything you need for a relaxing holiday

There are plenty of facilities on the campsite to make your stay even more enjoyable. For example, a supermarket for essentials, a launderette with washing machines, dryers and detergent, and sports fields for exciting games. Nearby, you can play golf or cycle, with equipment rental via the campsite. For children, there’s a playground with play equipment.

Brittany's rugged coast

The campsite is near Roscoff (4 km), an atmospheric coastal town full of pavement cafés, fish restaurants and Breton charm, with 16th and 17th-century buildings. From the port, take a boat to Île de Batz.

properties.name: Village de L'Armorique
properties.description:
Camping Village de l'Armorique is wonderfully peaceful, just 400 metres from the beach on Brittany's Pink Granite Coast. You will camp in the heart of nature here but close to the lively town of Morlaix (20 km). The campsite is simple and basic but has some nice extras like a heated, indoor swimming pool and a free wellness area with a sauna, Turkish bath and whirlpool. It's easily accessible from the N12 and ideal for campers who love peace, the sea and walking along rock formations.

Unmarked pitches and rental accommodation

The campsite is quiet, sometimes even in high season. The pitches are large and on an open grassy field. They aren't clearly separated from each other. This creates freedom but also limits privacy. Bungalows, chalets and mobile homes can be rented too. The mobile homes in particular are modern and comfortable.

Swimming pool with sliding roof and free wellness

Covered and heating swimming pool. Roof open in good weather. Around the pool, sunbeds are positioned in the sun. The sauna, Turkish bath and whirlpool are free. In July and August, there is a small snack corner and some entertainment, mainly in the day. Basic toilet and washing facilities.

Explore the pink rocky coast and Morlaix

From the campsite, it’s a short walk to the beach via a 400-metre path. The Pink Granite Coast is known for its impressive rock formations, a must-see during your stay. For a cultural outing or a terrace drink, Morlaix is a short drive away.

properties.name: Camping Les Saules de Cormery
properties.description:
Camping Les Saules de Cormery is situated in the lush Indre Valley, in the heart of the Touraine region of France. Here you can camp at a modest and peaceful campsite, surrounded by nature and history. The charming village of Cormery, known for its impressive abbey, is nearby. Lace up your walking boots, hop on a bike or relax outside at a café in the village. The atmosphere is friendly and the pace here is wonderfully relaxed.

Camping in the greenery of the Indre Valley

The campsite is modest in size and offers spacious, shady pitches for tents, caravans and motorhomes. You can choose whether you want a pitch with or without electricity. Thanks to the green surroundings, every pitch has a peaceful atmosphere. Prefer a little more comfort? Then the fully equipped tents are a great option.

Sports, games and leisure at the campsite

There’s plenty to do for all ages at Camping Les Saules de Cormery. Children can burn off some energy in the playground or build sandcastles in the sandpit. If you fancy a bit of action, there’s a multi-purpose sports field and a boules court. Want to play a game of tennis? The courts are within walking distance of the campsite. Those who prefer a quieter pace can go fishing in the River Indre, which is close to the campsite.

Discover castles, villages and French delicacies

The area around Cormery is perfect for lovely day trips. Just a short distance away is the impressive Cormery Abbey (0.5 km), a historic monument well worth a visit. Cycle or walk through the green countryside of the Indre Valley and discover the region’s charming towns.

properties.name: Camping Seasonova Les Vosges du Nord
properties.description:
Old half-timbered houses, a beautiful village and a regional nature park. At the Camping Seasonova Les Vosges du Nord campsite, you'll feel like you're camping in Alsace. The surroundings are green and hilly. You will find the campsite in the Northern Vosges Regional Nature Park, 1.5 km from the lovely village of Oberbronn. Beautiful Strasbourg is 50 kilometres away, and the German city of Karlsruhe is 85 kilometres away.

This campsite is highly suitable for campers who enjoy their peace and quiet. You will be surrounded by space, nature, forests and lots of storks. The campsite is located in the northeast of France, about 30 kilometres from the border with Germany.

You will feel completely at home

At the neat reception of Seasonova Les Vosges du Nord, you will receive a friendly and helpful welcome. You can order bread for the next day here from May to August. There is also a small shop at the back. In the same building, you will find an indoor pool and bar/restaurant. The campsite has a very pleasant atmosphere, which soon makes you feel at home. The place is quiet and clean. The new owners are busy refurbishing the property.

A view over the wooded area

Would you like to choose your own camping spot? You can do that at this campsite! From many places, you have a beautiful view of the wooded surroundings. There is also a wide choice of chalets, mobile homes and even a nomadic tent. There are also accommodations available for campers who have difficulty walking or are in wheelchairs.

properties.name: Camping Les Portes de l'Anjou
properties.description:
Camping Les Portes de l'Anjou is located in the Pays de la Loire, on the banks of the river Loire. This well-maintained campsite has shaded pitches right on the water's edge where you can go fishing. Especially those looking for peace and quiet will find the campsite a suitable destination. The centre of Durtal is closeby, so you can do your shopping on foot.

Camping on the bank

On the campsite, which has beautiful trees and lawns, there is room for around ninety shady touring pitches. Some pitches are situated on the side of the (quiet) road, but the most beautiful spots can be found directly on the bank. A green hedge separates the pitches from the water. In addition to touring pitches, there are twenty-five different rental accommodations available.

Castle within walking distance

There are relatively few facilities on the campsite itself. However, you can get a tasty snack. In the immediate vicinity you'll find more catering establishments. The municipal swimming pool (for a fee) is just a few minutes' walk away. Don't forget to visit Château de Durtal. This imposing castle is located in the middle of Durtal and overlooks the Loire.

For the fishermen

There are special fishing spots on the campsite, and you can buy a fishing license. Moreover, you camp here far away from the busy cities and mass tourism, so it's nice and quiet.

properties.name: Camping La Bolée d'Air
properties.description:
Within walking distance of the coastal town of Saint-Vincent-sur-Jard, Camping La Bolée d'Air is conveniently located. You are also close to the Atlantic Ocean and the unique marshlands of the Parc naturel régional du Marais Poitevin.

Heart of the campsite

The campsite entrance is immediately recognisable by a high, green arch. Behind it is a central square with the reception. This is the heart of the campsite; you'll find two swimming pools, the bar and the playground. The site is flat and consists of a part with rental accommodation and a part with touring pitches.

Beach or swimming pool

The campsite has two swimming pools, one of which is covered. Outside there is a spectacular slide and you can cross over via a footbridge. The indoor pool is nicely heated and has a sliding roof. Of course, the sea is just around the corner, so those who prefer to cool off in the fresh sea water will be on the beach in no time.

Outdoor café

For a tasty takeaway meal or a snack you can go to the bar. The outdoor café is a pleasant meeting place for campers. At the small shop you can buy, among other things, fresh vegetables. A larger supermarket is a short distance from the campsite. Don't forget to taste the traditional wines from this area. This is a dry white wine that has been made with love for decades.

Effort or relaxation

Both younger children and teenagers will find plenty of entertainment on the campsite. There are many sports possibilities and there is a nice miniature golf course. At the reception you can rent bikes and explore the region with the whole family.

properties.name: Camping Mun. les Feuilles
properties.description:
Camping Municipal les Feuilles is a low lying and quiet municipal campground on a babbling brook. The campground is within walking distance of the charming village of Chauffailles in the South Burgundy wine region.

For campers with a caravan and campers, there are sites with a paved section, but also sites on the grass. The well maintained campsites vary in size and are separated by hedges. There are trekker huts and mobile homes for hire. The sanitary facility is simple and clean. You can pick up fresh bread in the morning.

Swimming pool

The campsite has a heated indoor swimming pool that is only accessible to campsite guests. About 100 metres from the campsite, you will also find the heated municipal swimming pool with a paddling pool.

Small children will love the playground with a few pieces of equipment and a round of mini golf. You can play table tennis, use the jeu-de-boules pitch, play tennis and even play sports on the sports field.

Charming village

In Chauffailles you'll find a supermarket, a market (Friday mornings) with artisinal regional products and a restaurant. The 15th century castle is near the campground, where there are art exhibitions in the summer. In the weaving museum you can relive part of the history of Chauffailes's traditions.

Green hills

You can explore the hilly and green landscape in an active way from the campground. You can take a hike and follow the marked route, or have a guided tour in the high season. The campground lies on cycling routes, but note that most of them are challenging.

properties.name: Camping Les Terrasses de Dordogne
properties.description:
Camping Les Terrasses de Dordogne is situated on a hill in the popular Dordogne region, in the south west of France. A lovely, green camping destination known for its picturesque villages and old castles. The panoramic views over the valley from the pitches are a big plus for this child-friendly campsite. In the summer months, there is a trampoline and entertainment.

Deer and rabbits

The entire camping site breathes nature and that includes quiet pitches with privacy. Wherever you pitch your tent, caravan or motorhome, you will find verdant vegetation. Most of the pitches also have a view to dazzle you with. The safari tents, chalets and mobile homes are mixed between the touring pitches on different terraces.

Water Paradise

The whole family can enjoy water fun in not one, but two swimming pools. The pools are heated, there is a slide and you can relax on a sun bed. The indoor pool with a transparent sliding cover is heated and great fun for the smallest swimmers. There are also colourful games and water-spouting animals.

Eating at L'Olive Bleue

The tasteful restaurant L'Olive Bleue has an indoor dining room and a fine outdoor patio. Choose for example for a pizza, a hamburger or one of the local dishes with meat or fish.

Large playground

The colourful playground is great for children. There is plenty to do for kids of all ages. A slide, climbing rope, trampoline, petting zoo and even a fast rope slide guarantee days of fun. Three mornings a week the programme includes games such as treasure hunt, mask making and bag races.

properties.name: Camping Ramstein Plage
properties.description:
At this campsite, you are surrounded by vast forests, with pretty lakes and babbling brooks. A perfect place for those looking for peace and quiet and nature lovers, as well as for cyclists and hikers! Ramstein Plage campsite has an ideal location in the unspoiled Regional Nature Park Vosges du Nord, near the village of Baerenthal in the Moselle department. The campsite has an excellent restaurant and a great swimming pool, although you can also swim in the lake right next to the site.

Secluded fields and charming hiker's huts

Ramstein Plage is a campsite with a relatively large number of permanent places. However, these are clearly separated from the pitches for visitors. So tourers can really experience the true spirit of camping at this campsite. And all that on beautiful, large pitches in a wonderfully wooded area! There are also charming, but efficiently furnished hiker's huts for rent for two to four people.

Swimming fun in lake and pool

In the corner of the campsite, just next to the lake, you'll find a good rectangular swimming pool. You can also splash around in the lake and swim to improve your fitness. The lake has a marked swimming area with an adjoining two-metre-wide sandy strip. How about sunbathing on the waterfront? The sunny grassy meadow is the perfect place to do so.

Plenty of entertainment in the summer holidays

In the summer holidays, a professional entertainment team works at this campsite. They organize varied activities for the whole family every day, including sports tournaments, quiz nights, themed dinners, mini concerts and family afternoons. Each Sunday, over drinks, the programme for the following week is announced.

properties.name: Camping Domaine des 2 Soleils - Ciela Village
properties.description:
Camping Domaine des 2 Soleils is located in the village of Serres, in the French Provence-Alpes-Côte-d'Azur region. The campsite offers spacious camping pitches and a variety of rental accommodation. The entertainment team provides plenty of activities in the high season, for both young and old. The swimming pool is a popular spot. Take a refreshing dip or relax in a sun lounger. Tasty snacks, sandwiches and salads are available at the restaurant.

Comfort rentals

Camping Les 2 Soleils offers various types of accommodation. You can choose from comfortable mobile homes, unusual rental accommodation, cosy chalets and bare pitches for tents, caravans and camper vans. The accommodations are suitable for up to 6 people.

Fun at the campsite

In the high season (July and August) the entertainment team provides the necessary amusement at the campsite. During the week there is a special kids club where various activities are offered. From making bracelets to archery. There is also a playground, table football, volleyball, basketball and petanque field.

Swimming pool with slide

The swimming pool is a popular spot at the campsite. The little ones can splash around in the children's pool and the rest can dive into the large pool. Next to the swimming pool, you can relax on the sun loungers under the parasols. At the snack bar, you can enjoy a meal on the terrace and the wonderful view of the mountains.

properties.name: Camping Lido Tellina
properties.description:
If you prefer to spend your holidays on an amazing South European beach, the Italian campsite Camping Lido Tellina is an ideal holiday destination. The shady camping site of this friendly family campsite is located right on a sandy beach that goes on for miles. It is also a good home base for, for example, surfing, rafting or kayaking. Camping Lido Tellina is just outside the village of Manfredonia in the Italian region of Apulia. You will be camping here near the beautiful peninsula Gargano, known for its natural beauty and authentic towns.

Choose your own site at this shady camping site

This campsite is situated beautifully, with numerous eucalyptus trees, weeping willows and ancient pines that provide plenty of shade. These trees also define the tourist pitches to some extent. If you visit this campsite without making arrangements beforehand, you can choose your pitch yourself. In addition to booking a pitch, at Lido Tellina you can also rent a caravan. Do keep in mind that these rental caravans are old.

Swimming in the sea

From the camping site you need only cross a car park to get to the beach. This wide sandy beach, which goes on for miles, has more than enough room to enjoy life on the beach in peace and quiet. There are parasols and chaise longues for rent. It is also perfect that the seabed has a very gentle slope. In the high season, fun activities on the beach are organised regularly for children and adults.

properties.name: Flower Camping Les Fauvettes
properties.description:
Near the village of Anduze, in the South of France, you will find Flower Camping Les Fauvettes. Behind the campsite flows the river Gardon. At the campsite you can choose between pitches and rental accommodation. During the high season, the entertainment team provides plenty of entertainment for young and old. The campsite's restaurant offers an extensive menu. Would you rather cook yourself? Close to the campsite you will find several large supermarkets. Every morning you can get fresh bread at the campsite.

Camping situation

On arrival at Les Fauvettes, you will receive a warm welcome from the Duquesnoy family, the owners of this terraced campsite. The pitches have different surface areas, but are all nicely positioned. In addition to the pitches, the campsite also offers various rental accommodations, including chalets and mobile homes. The sanitary facilities are well maintained. In addition to the large sanitary building, there is another smaller building at the bottom of the campsite.

Sports entertainment

The campsite has various recreational facilities: a playground, bowling alley, table tennis, table football and billiards tables. There is also another dedicated activity room. In the high season, the animation team organises the best activities for young and old five times a week.

Cooling off

For a refreshing dip, head to the campsite's swimming pool. The pool is large and heated. Go down the slide for a bit of extra fun. There is also a wading pool, especially for the little campers. There is a lake six kilometres from the campsite, which is also nice to explore. You can go fishing in the nearby river Gardon. A path will take you there in no time.

properties.name: Billingens Stugby och Camping
properties.description:
Thanks to the beautiful nature with forests, lakes, beautiful beaches and even mountains, Sweden is a wonderful holiday destination. At this campsite you camp in the southern Swedish province of Västergötland, four kilometres from the centre of the city of Skövde. Billingens Stugby och Camping is located in the middle of the forest and near a small lake. This family campsite is suitable for active campers, but also for holidaymakers who want to relax in nature.

Holidays in nature

The leafy campsite is located in a pine forest, on a plateau that lies above the neighbouring town of Skövde. This plateau, the Billingen, is a table mountain whose highest point is 304 metres above sea level. You camp here among the trees or on one of the spots in the open field. At the edge of the campsite is a lake where you can go swimming and fishing. Not a fan of natural water? There is an outside swimming pool next to the campsite, which camping guests can use for a small fee. Because of the pool's elevated position, you have great views of the surrounding area.

Back to basics

Billingens Stugby och Camping is not a campsite with an extensive entertainment programme and many facilities. At this campsite you go back to basics, but you will still find everything you need here. There is a heated toilet block and a fully equipped communal kitchen. The kitchen has several gas stoves with an oven and even a coffee maker. The campsite also features a playground for young children and a mini golf course. The campsite has 129 camping spots and a number of rental accommodations.

properties.name: Fagervik Camping
properties.description:
In the northernmost part of western Norway, Fagervik Camping extends over more than seven hundred metres along the waters of the Tresfjord. You camp here on the green, wooded banks directly on the fjord. You can cast a line from your pitch and catch a fish for your supper. All around, you have a spectacular view of the mountain tops that are reflected in the clear water. Several hiking routes lead directly into the mountains from the campsite.

In the middle of nature

Fagervik is a relatively small campsite, with fifty touring pitches, twenty motorhome pitches and fifteen permanent pitches. There are also a few chalets available for rent. At Fagervik Campsite, the pitches are laid out in two rows along the shore of the fjord: the first row of pitches directly on the waterfront, the second row behind the first on an elevated terrace. Each pitch has its own picnic table. Each pitch offers a magnificent view of the fjord and the surrounding mountains with their snow-capped peaks. The blue water of the fjord reflects the panorama. 

Fishing spot

The campsite is mainly frequented by hikers and angling enthusiasts. After all, the fjord is a fishing opportunity par excellence. The campsite is fully geared towards anglers. You can cast your line from your pitch, but there is also a jetty which is perfectly suited to fishing. Of course, you can also get onto the water by boat. 

Tresfjord

In the southernmost tip of the fjord lies the village of Tresfjord, at some three km from the campsite. Here you will find a supermarket, a restaurant and a petrol station.

properties.name: Camping Les Cantarelles
properties.description:
Camping Les Cantarelles is near the town of Alrance at a central location in the Aveyron in the Southern French region of Occitania. Here, you camp in a sparsely populated region and in a yet unspoiled area filled with hills, forests, meadows, rivers and lakes. One of those lakes is Lac de Villefranche-de-Panat. The campsite has a private beach by this recreational lake, where you can go swimming and do water sports. You can also take advantage of the lovely outdoor swimming pool at this campsite and there is a fun entertainment programme in the high season.

From spacious grass pitches to sleeping barrels and mobile homes

There are mainly tourist pitches on the level grounds of this small-scale campsite. The camping pitches consist of neat grass pitches measuring at least 80 square metres. Considering the modern mobile homes at Camping Les Cantarelles are for hire, you are in a good place here if you like luxury accommodation. Furthermore, you can spend the night in a cosy hiker's cabin or sleeping barrel.

Plenty of options for swimming fun and water sports

Camping Les Cantarelles's lovely swimming pool is on the edge of the campsite, on the banks of the lake. You have a lovely view of the lake of Villefranche-de-Panat from the swimming pool. This lake is also ideal for water sports enthusiasts. You can go paddleboarding, pedal boating, fishing, windsurfing, water skiing, kayaking and snorkelling, among others.

Plenty of entertainment in the high season

There is plenty of entertainment in the summer holidays at Camping Les Cantarelles. You can for example join in with group sports activities, miniature discos, themed evenings and other enjoyable activities. Curious about the latest programme? Come to the welcome drinks on Sunday or check the campsite's Facebook page.

properties.name: Camping Le Lac des Varennes
properties.description:
Campsite Le Lac des Varennes is situated in the south of the Sarthe, in the region of Marçon. You will find lots of opportunities here for canoeing, fishing, windsurfing and waterskiing. Adjacent to the campsite there is a 50 ha lake on the one side and the Loir River on the other side. In the vicinity of the campsite there are all kinds of opportunities for walking and fishing.

Camping between water

The grounds are tidy with good, paved pathways. The campsite actually consists of two sections. Both sections have two sanitary buildings. These were renovated in 2013 and look spotless. The circular section of the campsite borders the sandy beach by the lake. The pitches here are demarcated with hedges. In addition, there are several types of rental accommodations (such as bungalow tents, mobile homes, chalet homes and a Tit'home).

Activities by and on the lake

The campsite is located on a lake and the adjacent beach consists partly of sand and partly of grass. It lies in full sun, but there are a few sun umbrellas for some shade. The lake makes this a very popular campsite for families with small children, but also among anglers and water sports enthusiasts.

You can practice your skills in several sports on the campsite, such as tennis, pétanque and beach volleyball. Entertainment for children and adults is organised in peak season. For instance, sports tournaments, live music and karaoke.

Dining with a view

In July and August, the café-restaurant is open and you can choose from a limited menu. You can enjoy your meal with a view of the lake.

properties.name: Camping La Chatonnière
properties.description:
In the heart of the French Dordogne, Camping La Chatonnière is set in a beautiful location right by the water. There is a private sandy beach and you can swim in the river. The medieval village of Jumilhac-le-Grand is just 500 metres from the campsite.

Spacious, quiet pitches

You can feel the space as soon as you drive up to your pitch. Because of the difference in height, the site consists of several parts. Here you will find beautiful spots for your tent, caravan or motor home. On the lower part, the pitches are close to the river. All the pitches offer privacy and are landscaped with bushes and trees. You can also spend the night in a robust safari tent or a nicely furbished mobile home among the greenery.

Swimming and playing in the river

Looking for some refreshment on hot days? Go paddle in the river, which is near the campsite. The water is fairly shallow and both the water and the beach on the bank are great places for children to splash around and play. The sunbathing area has shade.

Walking and cycling

There is plenty to do in the area surrounding Camping La Chatonnière. Want to go hiking? Various trails leave from the site. Prefer to go cycling? Then hire a bicycle on the campsite, but bear in mind that the surroundings are hilly.

properties.name: Flower Camping du Lac de la Thésauque
properties.description:
The Flower Camping du Lac de la Thésauque campsite is quietly located on the shores of the lake of the same name, near Montgeard in the Haute-Garonne department. Thanks to its beautiful lakeside location, there are plenty of water activities available. Take to the water in a canoe, go for a swim or enjoy a trip in a pedal boat. This terraced campsite is the perfect place for both young and old.

Fine camping

Flower Camping du Lac de la Thésauque is a terraced campsite with pleasant, spacious pitches. The pitches have both sun and shade. Here and there, shrubs separate the pitches from the trees. If you prefer a little more luxury, you can choose a chalet or a mobile home. These rental accommodations are located on the side of the campsite.

Something for everyone

In addition to all the possible (water) activities on and around Lake Thésauque, there is much more to experience at the campsite. For example, you can play table tennis, a game of miniature golf or use the bocce court. The children can play in the playground, while the adults relax on the surrounding lawn among the trees.

Snacks and drinks in the campsite restaurant

Don't feel like cooking? Then you can enjoy a snack and a drink on the terrace of the campsite restaurant. The terrace offers views of the lake. It is also possible to take some goodies away with you. There is a small supermarket at the campsite for purchasing groceries. In the high season, the campsite has fresh bread daily. For more shopping you can go to the surrounding villages and towns.

properties.name: Camping Ushuaia villages Rives d'Olt et Aubrac
properties.description:
Located alongside the river Lot, you’ll be in holiday mode straight away at Camping Ushuaia Villages Rives d'Olt et Aubrac. Peace, space and nature all come together here. There’s plenty to do for anyone who likes to be active too. You can swim in the swimming pool and fun activities are organised.

Pitches and accommodation

You will camp on large, green pitches of 60 to 90 m². Pitch your tent in the sun or find a shady spot under the trees: the choice is yours. The pitches are suitable for tents, caravans and motor homes and all have an electricity connections. Prefer accommodation? Choose from a lodge tent, mobile home, wooden chalet or floating accommodation on the lake.

Fun in the swimming pool and the river

The pool is the place to be on hot days. Take a dip, soak in the bubble bath or relax on a lounger under a parasol. Small children can splash about in the separate paddling pool. Other entertainment is available in the playground (which has a slide), while sports enthusiasts can let off steam on the multi-sports field. Sports tournaments, workshops and fun theme evenings are organised regularly.

Explore the surrounding area

The surroundings invite you to get out and about. Walk along the river to the charming St Geniez-d'Olt (1.5 km) or head into the nature of the Lot valley and the Monts d'Aubrac. Canoeing, kayaking, fishing, walking or just enjoying the scenery: it's all possible here. Along the way, you'll pass atmospheric villages and taste local cuisine.

properties.name: Camping Domaine de Gaujac
properties.description:
Campsite Domaine de Gaujac is a quietly located campsite in the Cevennes. Surrounded by vineyards and near the town of Anduze, you're in a lovely place here. The famous bamboo forest "Bambouseraie" is just 10 kilometres from the campsite, as is the steam train on which you can take a ride through the mountains. Entertainment and recreation are central at the campsite. Activities are organised every day in the high season.

Camping in the natural shady surroundings.

The touring pitches on the campsite Domaine de Gaujac are spacious and nearly all sheltered. On cloudy days, it may seem a bit dark, but here you are camping surrounded by nature. This campsite also has a section with plenty of mobile homes.

Swim in the swimming pool and in the river

If you want to swim laps or use the slide, this campsite has a large swimming pool available. This swimming pool is arranged in a playful manner with fountains and plants. The slides offer the necessary fun, while you can relax in the whirlpool. You can also swim in the nearby river. It flows only a hundred metres from the campsite.

Jeu de boules paradise and plenty of entertainment

In the high season, the entertainment team of campsite Domaine de Gaujac provides plenty to do. Kids will certainly not be bored. Six mornings a week there are activities for them such as playing outside, crafts and dancing. But there is also plenty to do for teenagers and adults. Participate in a football or table tennis tournament, for example. Fans of jeu de boules can play to their heart's content on the 26 pitches on this campsite.

properties.name: Camping Bel Air Village de la Baie
properties.description:
Camping Bel Air Village de la Baie is located in the heart of the Vendée, close to the coastal town of L'Aiguillon-sur-Mer (1 km). This 4-star campsite is an ideal base: the coast and the town centre are just around the corner. Take a refreshing dip in the heated pool or jump on your bike and discover the most beautiful routes through the countryside. Oyster farms, a castle and lovely sandy beaches are nearby too.

Large pitches and cosy accommodation

With 164 large pitches, both sunny and shady, you’ll always find a spot that suits you here. You camp on private pitches in the heart of nature. Prefer more comfort? Then opt for a fully-equipped mobile home. Ideal for families or a romantic weekend away. You are very welcome if you are travelling alone too, thanks to the facilities for solo campers.

Swimming pool and restaurant

There’s plenty to do at the campsite. Swim a few lengths in the heated swimming pool, or relax with a book on a deckchair. The children can play in the adventure playground. Feeling hungry? Order a quick bite or a meal in the welcoming dining area.

Explore the Vendée

The campsite is a convenient base from which to experience the Vendée at its best. The golden yellow beaches are nearby. Fancy something typically local? Sample fresh oysters at one of the farms nearby. Prefer some culture? Visit the historic castle of Talmont (41 km) or opt for water fun at the nearby Splash Game water park (1 km).

properties.name: Camping L'Or Bleu
properties.description:
Camping L'Or Bleu lies a couple hundred metres from Barrême, a friendly village in the centre of the Provence. You are practically next door to the famous Napolean Route and close to highlights such as Digne-les-Bains Castellane and the Verdon Gorge. It is an ideal home base for enjoying the Provence. The campsite itself is small-scale and in a quiet location. You will find a beautiful outdoor swimming pool, a charming bar and fun activities during the high season.

Spacious pitches and modern toilet facilities

The campsite’s reception is centrally located on the grounds. The average pitch at Camping L'Or Bleu is level, spacious, shaded and neatly demarcated. As a campsite visitor, you have access to a modern toilet block. The toilet block also contains facilities for people with reduced mobility. You can also book a stay in a comfortable mobile home at Camping L'Or Bleu.

Relax in the pool and at the bar

It can get pretty hot in the summer in the southern part of the French interior. Luckily, there is also a lovely pool. The outdoor swimming pool is fairly large and ideal for swimming lengths or just looking to cool off. You can also cool off in the L’Asse de Clumanc, the river that runs past the campsite, where you can dip your feet in the water.

Another place to relax is the bar, where you can get breakfast in the morning and later in the day enjoy a pancake, drink or ice cream cone. There are fun theme evenings during the high season. Other entertainment at Camping L'Or Bleu consists of, for example, jeu de boule competitions, evenings of bingo, karaoke and disco.

properties.name: Flower Camping Le Jas du Moine
Camping Pen er Malo
properties.description:
Camping Pen er Malo is a quiet campsite situated in the dunes of the Brittany coast, close to the French port of Lorient. Here you camp in the southwest of Brittany with the Atlantic Ocean just a few paces from the campsite. Pen er Malo is a simple dune campsite which breathes nature and freedom. The refreshing sea breeze blowing over the campsite adds to the peace and sense of freedom.

Pitches

The campsite may seem somewhat dated, but every camper can find a pitch here to their liking. The front end of the campsite is reserved for mobile homes. Further back are the demarcated level pitches. Here you will also find the 'Coco sweets', two adorable lodge tents for a romantic camping holiday. The grounds are more open at the back of the campsite, with little demarcation. You also won't fail to notice the large bunker standing on the camping grounds.

Covered swimming pool

Is it raining out and do you still feel like going for a swim? In that case, you can still go swimming at the campsite's covered swimming pool. You can find the pool behind the reception building. With a sliding roof and sliding walls, the pool can also be converted to an outdoor pool. Outside of the covered area lies the paddling pool, accompanied by a beautiful wall mural.

Picture(sque) restaurant

For a simple but tasty meal, visit the campsite restaurant. On the terrace, the campers are entertained by live performances. The restaurant has a unique interior. The plastic furnishings may be somewhat simple, but the wall (covered in numerous paintings) gives the restaurant a cosy atmosphere.

properties.name: Camping Du Pont de Vicq
properties.description:
Camping Du Pont de Vicq is situated right on the banks of the Dordogne. It’s a lovely spot for campers who love peace and quiet, open spaces and nature. You will be staying in Aquitaine, close to the charming village of Le Buisson-de-Cadouin. The river flows gently past the campsite, inviting you to stop for a moment or take a dip in the water. Or you can take a refreshing swim in the heated pool. Here, it’s all about relaxing, being outdoors and enjoying the French way of life.

Enjoyable camping on the Dordogne

The camping pitches at Camping Du Pont de Vicq are spacious and clearly marked out. Some are even situated right next to the river – that view never gets old. The campsite may look a bit simple here and there, but the location certainly makes up for it. You will be camping in beautiful green surroundings, with the gentle rippling of the water in the background. And with around 100 pitches and 30 mobile homes, there’s plenty of choice.

A splash in the swimming pool or the river

This is the place to be for fun water activities. Camping du Pont de Vicq has two heated outdoor pools that are open from May to September. The outdoor pool is accessible to people with disabilities and perfect for a refreshing swim. There is also a separate paddling pool and a baby pool for the little ones. You can also lay out your towel by the river and cool off in the water there. Children can burn off some energy at the outdoor playground, which has a swing, slide and trampoline. Sports enthusiasts can head over to the large rugby pitch. And if you get peckish, it’s just a short walk to the (snack) bar for a drink or a quick bite to eat.

properties.name: Vallée du Lot
properties.description:
Camping Vallée du Lot offers an unforgettable holiday experience in the heart of Aquitaine, France. Discover medieval charm, modern facilities and an oasis of peace and relaxation. A perfect combination of adventure and relaxation awaits you here.

Pitches and accommodation

Camping Vallée du Lot has large, comfortable pitches. The park has recently been landscaped and has a modern ambience with shaded pitches. From tent to caravan, you will find the ideal place to enjoy your holiday here. For anyone looking for more luxury, fully-equipped mobile homes are also available. Everything is designed to make your stay as pleasant as possible.

Facilities at the campsite

The facilities at Camping Vallée du Lot are second to none. The heated swimming pool has a sliding roof, which means that you can swim all season long. There’s also a restaurant where you can enjoy regional specialities and a cosy bar for a relaxing evening. In high season, live concerts and the open-air cinema provide extra entertainment. Modern toilet and washing facilities with heated showers make camping extra comfortable.

Surroundings and activities

Camping Vallée du Lot is located at the foot of the beautiful town of Pujols. This medieval village is one of the most beautiful villages in France. Its historic charm can be admired from the campsite. A visit to Villeneuve-sur-Lot is a must.

properties.name: Camping Les Borgnes
properties.description:
Camping Les Borgnes is in the friendly village of Saint-Sozy in Lot, close to the border with the Dordogne. This small-scale campsite is just outside the most touristy part of this popular French region. That makes it the ideal base for holidaymakers who are looking for peace, but who also want well-known sights within arm's reach. The campsite has a large outdoor swimming pool and a private beach by River Dordogne that runs right past the campsite.

Spaciously appointed site with lots of natural greenery

If you like lots of space on and around your camping pitch, then this campsite is ideal. The touring pitches are exceptionally large. Furthermore, every pitch at Camping Les Borgnes offers adequate shade and the pitches are separated by trees. Some pitches are right by the Dordogne. Furthermore, you can book a stay in a mobile home or modern Coco Sweet tent.

Themed evenings and large swimming pool

There is a lovely, heated outdoor swimming pool with a paddling pool at the front of the site. If you prefer natural water, then you're in luck. The campsite has a private mini beach by the Dordogne. Many campsite guests can be found at the cafeteria and the accompanying patio in the evenings. Certainly in the high season, because special themed evenings and music performances are held regularly.

Explore the surrounding area

The campsite is an ideal starting point for campers who like to see some of the surrounding area. Visit the Gouffre de Padirac stalactite caves in Padirac (23 km) and the famous village of Rocamadour (14 km).

properties.name: Les Rives de l'Adour
properties.description:
Camping Les Rives de l'Adour is not far from the town of Saint-Sever. You are in the Landes department, about seventy kilometres from the Atlantic coast. Saint-Sever is a medieval town with plenty of shops. The small-scale campsite, situated by the river Adour, offers about eighty touring pitches and twenty rental accommodations (mobile homes and lodges).

Camping in the green

The campsite is very well looked after and has mainly demarcated touring pitches. The natural boundaries are neatly trimmed. You can choose from pitches with a lot of sun or more shade. The flowering shrubs and high trees give the site a pleasant, green appearance. Those without camping equipment can stay in one of the mobile homes or lodges. The campsite is mainly visited by French families with children.

Enjoy sports and play

The campsite is situated next to the municipality's sports fields. From 1 July to 31 August, you have free use of the football pitches, tennis courts, beach volleyball courts and swimming pool (with diving tower). Anglers can choose a nice spot at the river Adour. You can walk there in less than a minute. On the campsite itself, you will find a jeu-de-boules court, table tennis table and miniature golf course.

Children can play in the playground or on the inflatable cushion. Furthermore, an entertainment team is active in the high season. Especially for the youngest campers, there is a mini club. Later in the day, themed evenings are organised. Fun for the whole family!

properties.name: Camping Paradis Le Val de Coise
Camping La Fougeraie
properties.description:
The terraced Camping La Fougeraie borders a small lake and is situated in the heart of the Morvan Regional Nature Park, a unique natural area in the Bourgogne, eminently suitable for walking. It is an ideal spot for families with young children, walkers, seekers of peace and quiet and angling enthusiasts.

View of the valley

From the sloping grounds you have a magnificent view of the valley. The pitches are situated on terraces and vary in size. Medium-sized trees dotted around provide nice shade in places. Want to hire something? Choose from a variety of lodge tents, mobile homes and chalets. At the bottom of the campsite is a nice small fishing lake.

Playful swimming pool

The small swimming pool with separate toddler pool has a playful design. Surrounding the pool are comfortable sun loungers on attractive, ochreous tiles.

The surrounding vegetation offers some shade in places. There are also some sun umbrellas. 

Large inflatable bouncing castle

There is a playground for children with a trampoline and a large inflatable bouncing castle. The playground lies partly in the shade. There are also table tennis tables and a pétanque pitch. Every now and then the campsite organises paintball (age 6 and up).

A cheerfully appointed restaurant

The campsite restaurant with varying daily menu, is cheerfully furnished and has a large, covered terrace. The campsite shop has a limited selection and also stocks fresh bread. You will find a larger supermarket in Château-Chinon (10 km).

Clean sanitary facilities

There are two ablution blocks, both looking neat and tidy. For hygiene reasons, guests are required to remove their shoes before entering the sanitary facilities.

properties.name: Flower Camping Les Nauves
properties.description:
Flower Camping Les Nauves is just outside Belvès, in the south of the Dordogne. Due to the outdoor swimming pool, the many fun activities and range of sports and recreational facilities, this is an ideal family campsite, particularly in the high season. Here, you camp in surroundings that are typical of the Dordogne. The campsite is surrounded by vast forests, historic cities and medieval castles. You can drive to Monpazier in 15 minutes, to Saint-Cyprien in 20, to Beynac-et-Cazenac in 30 minutes and it takes 45 minutes to get to Sarlat-la-Canéda. With seven clock towers, exceptional troglodyte houses and the excellently preserved medieval centre, Belvès itself is also certainly worthwhile.

Neatly maintained site with spacious camping pitches

The enthusiastic owners Fanny and Cyril always give new campers a friendly welcome. This campsite's neatly maintained site has various types of spaciously laid out touring pitches. Along the edge of Flower Camping Les Nauves, you can stay on a pitch offering panoramic views of the nearby meadows. You can also spend the night in a mobile home or lodge tent.

Wonderful relaxation in the campsite's swimming pool

Flower Camping Les Nauves has a rectangular swimming pool where you can go for a lovely swim on summer days. They often have aqua aerobics sessions here in the high season. There is a paddling pool specially for the youngest campers. You can relax on the patio and green strips by the swimming pool, for example in the shade of the many trees along the edge of the swimming pool zone.

properties.name: Glamping Sainte-Suzanne
properties.description:
Glamping Sainte-Suzanne is located in an unspoilt area, surrounded by the green hills of the Coëvrons. You’ll completely unwind at this friendly campsite. Wake up in the morning to the cheerful singing of birds, while at night you’ll often enjoy a clear starry sky. This region is not overly touristy, but there’s still plenty to do and see. For example, the medieval village centre of Sainte-Suzanne-et-Chammes is only seven hundred metres away and there are many beautiful walking and mountain bike routes as well.

Large touring pitches with open views

The spacious layout and beautiful views of the rolling countryside are typical of the campsite. Tourist pitches are most prominent on this site. The pitches are at least 60 m2 in size, while the regular pitches are about 100 m2. The touring pitches are separated by hedges, posts and fences. Different types of accommodation are available to rent as well, including different types of cosy camping huts and tents, including fully-equipped safari tents with their own kitchen and bathroom.

Swim in the adjacent outdoor pool

If you’re at this campsite in the summer holidays and fancy an afternoon’s swim, you’ll be pleased to know that Glamping Sainte-Suzanne is right next to a large, heated outdoor swimming pool with a paddling pool and water slide. Another big advantage at this campsite is Leeo Pizza, where delicious home-made pizzas are available to take away throughout the season.

properties.name: Camping L'Ondine de Provence
properties.description:
Just outside La Motte-Chalancon, a lovely village in a quiet part of Provence, is Camping L'Ondine de Provence. You camp here in a valley and right next to the river Oule. This is a beautiful area to explore on foot or by bike. The well-maintained family campsite has plenty to offer too. You will find a nice swimming pool, a good restaurant and a varied programme of activities.

Authentic campsite with new toilet facilities

As a camper, you choose your own pitch. Do you like a spot in the sun or somewhere shadier? And do you like to have your own electricity or are you fine without it? Let them know and the campsite will arrange it. There are also two toilet and shower blocks on the site, which are open all season. A third toilet block also opens in high season. Rather have your own kitchen and bathroom? Book a stay in a modern safari tent, chalet or mobile home.

What is there to do on this campsite?

This is a campsite where you can really retreat from the hustle and bustle. Still feel like some activity? Take a dip in the large outdoor pool or from the little beach in the Oule. There is also regular entertainment. Join an aquagym session or an African dance class, and enjoy live music, karaoke or a magic show in the evening. You can get something tasty at the good La Piboure restaurant or at the ice cream van. You can also borrow free board games, books and toys from the reception.

properties.name: Camping Paradis Les Chanterelles
properties.description:
Are you looking for a quiet campsite amidst nature? And where children will thoroughly enjoy themselves? If so, a camping holiday at campsite Paradis Les Chanterelles is just the thing for you. You camp here on sunny and generously laid out grounds (partly terraced), by an open lake with a sandy beach. The lake is sufficiently large for dozens of boats. But you can also swim there, of course! More water fun is to be had in the campsite swimming pool.

Your pitch: peace and tranquility

The campsite measuring 4 ha consists of flat grounds and a slightly sloping terrain with terraces. There is a good view of the lake from everywhere and all pitches are within walking distance from the lake. There is sufficient room for the 140 touring pitches (100-120 m2). These pitches have a nice grass surface, are more or less demarcated, and are shaded or partly shaded by tall trees. There are five motor home pitches available as well as fourteen rental lodge tents or bungalows.

Water fun in lake and swimming pool

The swimming pool consists of two pools and two low water slides, creatively and safely located on a pontoon which is connected to the shore. All of this looks very attractive. The lake can easily be reached from different sides of the campsite via walkways. In addition to swimming, you can also indulge in boating, sailing, canoeing and windsurfing. 

Eating by the lake

The campsite only sells the most essential items; however, there is a bread service in the morning. The campsite itself has no eating establishment, so why not head for the pizzeria in the village of Saint-Rémy-sur-Durolle for a nice Italian meal. There are several restaurants in the towns around the lake.

properties.name: Camping Les Rives du Lac de Vinça
ClicoChic Camping Les Bastets
properties.description:
A cosy little campsite located in Marsanne in the middle of the Drôme. The campsite has a friendly atmosphere, a personalised approach and owners who care about their campers. The terraced campsite Les Bastets is an oasis for all ages. Here you will wake up to a view over the lavender fields, because the camping pitches overlook the rolling landscape of Plaine de la Valdaine. There is also a beautiful view from the pool.

Mobile homes with private spa

You will be warmly welcomed at the reception by owner Martine and her son Rémi. The grounds are steep, but camping owner Jean-Yves drives your caravan into place with his tractor without any problems. The camping pitches are spacious and have sufficient privacy. Due to the difference in level, the pitches are very diverse. The lower part of the campsite has been newly constructed. Camping Les Bastets also has a choice of spacious mobile homes and chalets. In 2022, five and six-person mobile homes with a private spa will even be added!

Carefree play

At this campsite you can enjoy nature and your family in peace. It is a campsite with plenty of space for children, but seniors will also feel at home. Les Bastets has a large playground with trampolines, bouncy castles and a zip line. The campsite is small enough to let your children play freely. They can play football, table tennis and mini golf. There is also a mini club for children aged 6 to 12 where they can do crafts and play.

properties.name: Camping de Masevaux
properties.description:
In the French Alsace, on the banks of the Doller River, lies the peaceful family campsite de Masevaux. This well maintained campsite has spacious pitches and a few comfortable rental accommodation units. The campsite offers all basic amenities. Adjacent to the campsite are communal sports fields.

Flowery reception
