You will be given a warm and floral welcome at the reception of the campsite. This is because the reception is nestled among flowers and a green hedge. Once on the campsite you will see at a glance that it is well maintained. The grounds are level and cared for and also the large camping pitches look well maintained. Not all camping pitches are clearly demarcated. If you are looking for a bit more privacy, you would be better off with a pitch near the hedge.

Natural area

The campsite forms a good base to explore the natural area, but the range of activities is not very comprehensive. There is some basic play equipment for children and every now and then camping guests are treated to a performance by a local music group. Directly next to the campsite, guests can make use of the communal sports fields.

Basic supplies

The facilities on the campsite have recently been updated and offer basic services. There is one large ablution block for the entire campsite, which is adequate for the number of guests. The campsite shop, located in the reception building, offers a limited assortment of regional products, but you can go to the village of Masevaux for all other shopping.

properties.name: Camping Golden Sunset
properties.description:
On the northern shore of the Peloponnesos, the largest peninsula in Greece, lies Camping Golden Sunset. This spacious shaded campsite is located in Alissós , about a half hour's drive from Patras. The campsite has a large water park, which is also accessible to day trippers. From the sun deck, you have a view of the bay and the narrow beach. The campsite itself is somewhat dated and its prime feature is the water park. This campsite is closed outside of the peak season; you can only stay here in July and August.

Shaded pitches

The campsite has many trees and bushes; the pitches, therefore, have plenty of shade. The pitches are situated along straight, paved lanes. During the worst of the crisis in Greece, this campsite was closed for a while, and you still see some of those effects today. This explains why the campsite hasn't yet had many camping visitors. 

Water park

Camping Golden Sunset's biggest asset is the large swimming paradise with water slides. There are all several outdoor pools with a total surface area of 940 m2. There is also a large whirlpool and no less than six water slides of varying heights. Don't expect top quality, however; the complex is somewhat out of date.

properties.name: Camping Hippodrome La Prairie du Château
Les Truffières de Dordogne – La Bouquerie
properties.description:
Camping in a hilly landscape and a wooded area in the Périgord Noir in the Dordogne. All that while still being close to lovely towns and many interesting sightseeing spots, including the Caves of Lascaux. That's what awaits you when you choose Les Truffières de Dordogne – La Bouquerie Campsite as your holiday address. This is an ideal base for exploring the Dordogne. With a beautiful water park, an excellent restaurant, plenty of sports and games facilities and (in high season) many fun activities, the campsite itself also offers plenty of entertainment and relaxation.

Beautifully landscaped touring pitches and various rental accommodations

At this campsite, you can choose from three types of tourist camping pitches. All touring pitches are of a good size and beautifully integrated into the surrounding nature. The most comfortable pitches have their own storage room, where you will find garden furniture, sun loungers, a parasol and a refrigerator. There are also different types of mobile homes, chalets and lodge tents for rent.

Plenty of swimming fun in the beautiful water park

Les Truffières de Dordogne – La Bouquerie has a water park with no fewer than three large swimming pools. Three water slides lead to one of the pools. There is also a nice paddling pool. Around this water park are both sunny and shady areas where you can relax on a lounger.

Varied entertainment programmes in the high season

There is a colourful playground on the edge of the site for children. There's also a children's club for our youngest camping guests in the summer months. There is also a special animation team for teenagers. Wednesday evenings are especially fun for them. After a festive meal, they can play laser tag or go disco swimming, for example.

properties.name: Camping Les Vailhes Onlycamp
properties.description:
Camping Les Vailhes Onlycamp is at a unique spot just outside Lodève (Hérault), by the stunning Lac du Salagou. Here, you camp in a hilly, forested area. On many pitches, the ground of the Salagou Valley is a bright red colour. The campsite itself has a natural green character and is like a green oasis in a lunar landscape. You can go on lovely walking and mountain bike trips in the mountainous area. You can also go for a lovely swim and sail in the aforementioned lake.

Camp on the beach or go higher up

As a camper, you have plenty to choose from at this campsite. You can choose a spacious camping pitch right on the beach or a pitch on one of the terraces. You have breath-taking views of the surrounding mountains from many pitches. Glamping fans will also have a great time at Camping Les Vailhes Onlycamp, as you can book a stay in a modern canvas tent or fully furnished tiny house.

Ideal destination for beach and water sports fans

Several paths on the campsite lead to the large beach belonging to the campsite. Go for a lovely swim in the clean water of Lac du Salagou. It's definitely safe in the high season, as there is a separate swimming zone. There are also water sports options, such as surfing, kayaking and sailing. You will also find a restaurant by the lake where you can eat tasty dishes. Furthermore, there is entertainment on the beach in the summer in the form of music evenings.

properties.name: Camping Tours Val de Loire Onlycamp
properties.description:
This campsite is located in the Loire Valley, just a few kilometres from the popular Loire à Vélo cycle route, in the town of Saint-Avertin. This is a suburb of the larger city of Tours, the centre of which is about five kilometres from the campsite. While Camping Tours Val de Loire Onlycamp thus has a nice central location, you will still be camping in a quiet spot along the banks of the River Cher. This campsite attracts campers from around the world. Many of them are in transit. The campsite is located near the exit of the A10 motorway (Paris-Bordeaux).

Flat terrain with spacious camping pitches

The terrain of Tours Val de Loire Onlycamp is completely flat. Tourist camping pitches are the primary form of accommodation here. Campers can choose from sunny and shady spots. In addition to spacious touring pitches, this campsite also offers various rental accommodations. These include chalets, lodge tents and charming looking Bivouac tents on stilts.

Swimming laps in the municipal swimming pool

Right next to the campsite is the Piscine Municipale de Saint-Avertin, or the Saint-Avertin municipal swimming pool. This is a beautiful, rectangular indoor pool in which you can swim laps. There is also a paddling pool, a sauna and an outdoor area where you can enjoy the sun in the summer.

Shopping

The campsite features a small shop with a modest range of foodstuffs. Here you can buy ice creams, regional products and cold and hot drinks. You can also order fresh bread and croissants for breakfast.

properties.name: Camp Zagreb
properties.description:
As its name suggests, Camp Zagreb is an excellent base for people visiting Zagreb. It is an ideal transit campsite, but it is also highly suitable for longer stays. The campsite is located on a recreational lake in the village of Rakitje, directly to the west of the Croatian capital. The site is conveniently arranged in the shape of a roundabout, and has pitches for every type of camper.

Simple or luxury accommodation

The campsite accommodates every kind of camper, whether you come with a tent or a motor home. And if you prefer to rent accommodation, there are plenty of choices at Camp Zagreb. From teepees and glamping tents to luxury eco-cottages that feature television, air conditioning and wifi. There is even a special wellness suite with Finnish sauna, waterbed, jacuzzi and private terrace.

Various cycling routes

Most of the guests who visit here are in transit, wanting to visit Zagreb. That said, there are plenty of reasons to stay longer. It is therefore an excellent base for a wide range of bicycle routes. The lakeside trail is unchallenging and doable for most campers. Cyclists looking for more of a challenge can keep going all the way to the Samobor Mountains, an impressive natural park.

Horseback rides

Horse lovers take note! Novice riders can join an organised tour around the lake. Advanced riders can go all the way to Zagreb on horseback, if they wish. If you find all this a bit scary and want to get to know the noble animals first, then you are welcome to pet and cuddle them!

properties.name: Camping de Châlons-en-Champagne Onlycamp
properties.description:
Camping de Châlons-en-Champagne is situated in a green suburb of the town of the same name, approx. 2.5 km from the centre. This campsite is a good base for visiting the town and the Champagne region and is situated next to a fish pond. The grounds are well-tended and offer camping pitches on grass or hardened surfaces with shade trees and occasionally separated by hedges.

On a separate section of the grounds are some 10 static caravans available for rent. There are hardened sites for campers and there is a service station. The facilities are modest and are mainly used by overnight guests.

Centre of champagne

Châlons-en-Champagne is the centre of the champagne production in the vineyards around the town. The campsite is a convenient base for visiting the town and the surrounding vineyards.

Sport and games

The campsite is mainly frequented by people who visit the vineyards and wine cellars of the Champagne. The campsite is also popular with travellers on their way to the south. The facilities are therefore limited; there is no swimming pool or lake to swim in.

However, there is a mini-golf course, tennis court, petanque pitch, children playground, snack bar and convenience store. Fishing in the lake is allowed. The nearest supermarket is 200 m away.

properties.name: Recreatiepark Samoza
properties.description:
Camping Samoza is a wonderfully maintained campground in the northwest corner of the Veluwe. Nunspeet, located only 10 km away, is the closest larger town. The campground offers wonderful opportunities to explore this part of the Veluwe. The bicycle is the preferred mode of transport. In addition to the beautiful nature, the area has all kinds of sights more than worth a visit.

Beautiful campsites

The campsites are very spacious, laid out on grass and all look very good. There are great differences in size. The quality of the sanitary facilities is outstanding. There are many trees on the campground, primarily around the camping fields.

There are also many types of rental accommodation available on the campground, including 4-6 person bungalows and chalets. Some of them are located among the trees in the forest. Dogs are allowed in some accomodations. You are in a great place with your four-legged friend at Camping Samoza.

Bored? Impossible!

The motto of the campground is: "You can't be bored at Samoza". It's not a lie. Swimmers can swim in the heated interior pool with large slide, outdoor pool and kiddie pool. Around the pool are spacious grassy fields where children can galavant and where you can relax in the sun. On the site you will find a jeu-de-boules pitch, table tennis tables, children's farm, playgrounds and tennis courts.

Riding out and half day trips

Horse lovers take note! There are stables in the park. You can participate in a trail ride or a half day trip. You can bring your own horse with you, as it's easy to rent accommodation. If you don't have a horse or equipment, you can rent them at the campground.

properties.name: Terrassen Camping Schlierbach
properties.description:
This beautiful, green terraced campsite is located in the middle of the Bergstrasse-Odenwald UNESCO Global Geopark. This is not a touristy area, but there are still tons of activities available. You'll discover small picturesque villages, and the hilly surroundings are ideal for hiking and climbing enthusiasts. The campsite therefore mainly attracts active people, seniors and groups. Please note: Terrassen Camping Schlierbach has rest times between 13:00 and 15:00 and 22:00 and 06:00. It is not possible to drive onto or off of the campsite during these times.

Sleep in your own bubble

The campsite is playfully laid out, and the pitches are spacious and neatly demarcated. The pitches have their own water, electricity and waste water supply. There is a separate youth area at the edge of the property. The campsite also rents out some unique types of accommodation: two glass bubbles offering spectacular views and one vehicle with a rooftop tent. These are turnkey accommodations ready for you to settle in.

A sportsman's paradise

The campsite mainly attracts active people, seniors and groups. The surrounding area is a mecca for those who enjoy mountain biking, hiking and rock climbing. There is no swimming pool on the campsite, but there is a heated municipal swimming pool nearby (2.5 km).

Peace, space and tons of greenery

This German campsite brings you right back to nature. There is no restaurant, supermarket or swimming pool on the campsite, but you will find peace, space and abundant greenery. The sanitary facilities are neat and comfortable.

properties.name: Gitavillage Talamone
properties.description:
If you would like to stay overnight among the olive trees and enjoy real Italian coffee, fish dishes and the pleasure of doing nothing, come to Gitavillage Talamone! This campsite is on a bay in the area of the fishing village of Talamone (2 km) and the Maremma nature reserve. The prospect of sun, sea and beach will put you totally in holiday mood.

The hills and the sea

The campsite is well-maintained and organised. The spacious reception can be found in the centre of the campsite. Part of the campsite is on level ground, the other part on terraces built into a hill. The bungalows are at the top, allowing you to overlook the hills and the sea.

Bay of Talamone

There are several options for swimming. Will you choose the panoramic swimming pool or do you prefer the sea? The campsite’s swimming pool overlooks the bay. The beach and the Bay of Talamone are about five hundred metres away from the park. Find a spot on a sun lounger, settle down in a hammock or sit under a parasol.

Mediterranean cuisine

Dining with a gorgeous view is possible in the restaurant of Gitavillage Talamone. The restaurant’s terrace overlooks the bay and the swimming pool. Choose something from the menu and become acquainted with the delicious Mediterranean cuisine.

Entertainment for everyone

Entertainment, baby dancing, tennis and kite surfing. This campsite has a wide range of fun in store for you. There are, for example, athletic fields, a playground and a mini club. There are shows and sports competitions for the entire family.

properties.name: Gitavillage Le Marze
properties.description:
Looking for a relaxing camping holiday in Tuscany? At Gitavillage Le Marze, relax in the beautiful Maremma nature reserve. Lay your towel on the beach, take a walk through the forest, or visit villages and towns like Marina di Grosseto and Siena. Its strategic location makes this campsite a convenient base for exploring Tuscany.

Camping among the pine trees

At Gitavillage Le Marze, you won't find any average pitches. You have a choice of spacious, shaded pitches ranging from 60 to 100 square metres, set among pine trees. Prefer glamping? If so, nice suites, hiker's huts and lodge tents are available for rent. The accommodation is somewhat outdated, but this actually adds to the cosiness of the experience.

Fun for young and old

There is also plenty to do on the site. Dive into the supervised pool, for example. Hungry? In the restaurant, you can enjoy a dish from the small menu. For a quick snack or brunch, visit the bar. Also convenient: the mini market offers all kinds of local food and camping gear. And for entertainment, you're in the right place: there are lots of activities and shows.

Discover Tuscany from the campsite

There is also plenty to do on the campsite itself. A short walk from the campsite, for example, is a beautiful sandy beach along the Mediterranean. Or visit art cities like Florence (165 km), Siena (92 km) and Pisa (143 km) which can easily be reached by car. The lovely seaside town of Marina di Grosseto (6.5 km) is less than a ten-minute drive away.

properties.name: Gitavillage California
properties.description:
At Gitavillage California, different worlds come together. It is situated between the countryside and the coast, as well as on the border between Lazio and Tuscany. Maremma, the name of this region, has a rich history and has everything for a successful sunshine holiday. Dive into the pool or the sea, relax in the spa or enjoy your accommodation or camping pitch in the shade of the pine trees.

Comfortable pitches

At Gitavillage California, you have a wide choice of pitches and accommodation. Set up your tent, caravan or motorhome on a sunny grassy pitch, or choose a comfort pitch under the pine trees. The accommodations are suitable for two to six people and are nicely distributed around the grounds. So you can be on the beach in no time.

Sports, games and swimming fun

At the heart of the campsite is the swimming pool with paddling pool. With waterfalls and a slide, you'll have hours of fun here, while soaking up the sun in the solarium. The restaurant and bar are next to the swimming pool. Prefer to swim in the sea? You can easily reach the beach via the paved path that crosses the campsite. Take a refreshing dip in the sea, read a good book on one of the beach beds or set out in one of the campsite's canoes.

During the day, you can join sports activities or hit a ball on one of the sports fields. Relaxation has also been considered: enjoy a massage or unwind in the sauna. At night, the campsite buzzes with entertainment and live entertainment (mainly in Italian).

properties.name: Camping Libranoo Bélézy
properties.description:
Libranoo Bélézy is located just outside of Bédoin, in the department of Vaucluse in the south of France. This is a naturist campsite in the unspoilt countryside of Provence. The campsite is constructed around an authentic Provençal country house (also called ‘mas’), in a wooded area at the foot of Mont Ventoux. A beautiful home base for discovering the beauty of Provence. With three swimming pools, numerous activities and various sports facilities, the campsite itself has plenty to do.

Plenty of choice for touring pitches and accommodations

For campsite visitors with their own caravan, motorhome and/or tent, there are four types of pitches, all with an electricity connection. The espace pitches are larger pitches and the residential pitches also have a water supply and drain. If you would prefer to rent an accommodation, book a stay in, for example, a modern chalet, maisonette or safari tent. For tourists wanting to hike or cycle, there are special bivouac tents on wooden poles.

Lots of fun swimming, a charming Plane Tree Square and numerous activities

In front of the mas is a charming square with plane trees. Get to know the other campsite visitors during the welcome drink and get an impression of the activities that the campsite organises for the entire family. There are lots of them! Music, theatre, open-air movie nights, sports competitions, excursions and workshops – all of these are offered. The campsite also has its own library and various athletic fields and play areas, such as playgrounds, a giant swing and a challenging climbing course.

Libranoo Bélézy also has a beautiful swimming pool complex with two swimming pools as well as a large wading pool with colourful water-playing equipment and small slides, Guaranteeing hours of splashing fun!

properties.name: Libranoo Domaine de la Sablière
properties.description:
The naturist campsite Libranoo Domaine de la Sablière lies just outside of the charming town of Barjac, on the border between Gard and Ardèche. You camp in a beautiful setting on the wooded slopes of the banks of the Cèze river. This terraced campsite is very well maintained and very spacious. With its wonderful swimming complex, a varied activities programme, sports facilities and catering establishments, it is a good holiday location.

Enjoy peace, space and privacy

Domaine de la Sablière is a large campsite, but you won’t notice it at your pitch. Lots of greenery and the spacious layout allows each pitch to enjoy peace and privacy. As a campsite visitor, you can choose from standard and VIP pitches. If you choose the latter, you will have a private connection to the electricity, a fridge and private toilet and washing facilities with toilet, shower, and wash basin. You can also stay in a modern mobile home, a chalet or a safari tent.

An extraordinarily beautiful swimming pool complex

The swimming pool complex is the pièce de resistance of this naturist campsite. The three swimming pools are at different levels. The large wading pool had a small slide and water play equipment. A playfully designed swimming pool is one level higher. And at the uppermost terrace, the large basic swimming pool with sliding roof has room for swimming laps. If you like to swim in natural water, wander down to the (pebble) beach at the bottom of the campsite, where you can paddle to your heart’s content or swim in the river.

This campsite also organises many activities during the high season. Entertainment at Domaine de la Sablière includes walks in the woods, sports sessions, evening entertainment and workshops in pottery, making jam, painting and body painting.

properties.name: Camping de l'Argenté Onlycamp
properties.description:
Camping de l'Argenté Onlycamp is in the landscape of the French department of Gers, close to the authentic town of Condom. This neat and spaciously laid out campsite offers visitors fully equipped camping pitches and chalets. If you are looking for peace and relaxation, the natural green surroundings of the campsite are exactly that. You can do a range of sports and cultural activities in the vicinity of the campsite, such as visiting the nearby water park and River Blaise. Furthermore, there are many charming French villages within a radius of several kilometres.

Spacious camping pitches

Once at the site, the spacious layout with straight paths and the shade of the tall trees immediately stand out. The camping pitches are spacious and barely demarcated. You can choose from pitches in the shade or sun. As the campsite is completely level, you can go there with any type of vehicle. The campsite also offers a choice from various chalets for five people. There are also wooden chalets suitable for the disabled.

Grocery shop and recreation centre

The campsite has a small grocery shop where you can get ice cream and cold drinks in the high season. When you want to do a more extensive shop, there is a large supermarket close to the campsite (850 m).

The site also has a children's play area and there are three swimming pools with slides and paddling pools at 400 metres from the campsite. There is also a recreation centre at 200 metres for all ages where you can play miniature golf, go roller skating, skateboarding, play football, do fitness and go fishing, among other things.

properties.name: Camping Les Premières Vignes Onlycamp
properties.description:
This lovely and quite natural campsite is in the heart of the French Burgundy region. Camping Les Premières Vignes Onlycamp is on the outskirts of the wine growing village of Savigny-Lès-Beaune and on River Le Rhoin. This location is a joy for wine lovers and connoisseurs. Due to its location five kilometres from the motorway, the campsite often serves as a stopover campsite on the way to the south. But the green hilly surroundings and charming town of Beaune make it very appealing for longer stays too. There are plenty of options for campers who want to go out and about. For example, cycle along the Route des Grands Crus to admire the beauty of the Burgundian vineyards or walk to one of the castles in the village. There are also various restaurants and winegrowers where you can sample the local delicacies.

Small-scale campsite

Your holiday will be peaceful and relaxing at this small-scale campsite. There are spacious pitches, demarcated with green hedges, bushes and oleanders. There are pitches with or without shade and some accommodation for hire. The toilet and washing facilities have recently been renovated and are good quality.

Everything looks neat and tidy and the basic facilities are present. There is a nice playground for the children with some play equipment and you can get fresh bread and local produce, such as Burgundian truffles, from the small campsite shop. There is also a snack bar where you can get take-away meals and pizzas are available from May to September. You can of course have a lovely glass of wine at the bar but you can also spend a long enjoyable evening with a drink in front of your own tent, motorhome or caravan.

properties.name: Camping La Roseraie Onlycamp
properties.description:
At Camping La Roseraie Onlycamp you camp on the banks of the Creuse river in the French Descartes district. At this small, quiet family campsite, you imagine yourself in a park full of trees, plants and flowers. Just a stone’s throw away are historic cities, a fun water park, a botanical garden with various animals, and many options for cycling and hiking.

Small-scale campsite in green setting

The campsite has camping pitches and rental accommodations. If you are on holiday with the entire family, you can also rent the group cottage (up to 14 people). You then stay in the middle of the botanical garden that borders the campsite. The campsite is very accessible for wheelchair users or the disabled.

Come relax

Relax completely at Camping La Roseraie Onlycamp. Toss a ball at the jeu de boules court or play with your children in the playground. When ready, you can get an ice cream or nice cold drink at the small campsite shop. You can walk from the campsite down to the Creuse river. It is nice and quiet and green here.

Lots of history and fun

The campsite is between the historic towns Loches and Chinon, both of which are certainly worth a visit. From here you can explore the Touraine province, known for its wine. Botanical garden René Boylesve, which includes a rose garden, wildlife park and view of the river, is 500 m from the campsite. There is also a water park to splash all day long, a great mini golf course and kayak rental within walking distance.

properties.name: Camping la Rochette Onlycamp
properties.description:
Sunbathing next to the swimming pool with an all-round view of the green mountains? You can do this on campsite La Rochette. The campsite is situated at an altitude of 1000 m, in the heart of the French Alps, with favourably located arterial roads to the surrounding valleys. Your fellow campers are mostly sports-minded nature lovers: mountain climbing, rafting or hang gliding are high up on their wish list.

Orderly campsite

There is an convivial atmosphere on campsite La Rochette. There are almost two hundred touring pitches, located on a flat surface with plenty of grass and ample shaded spots. The reception building is basic, but functional. There are fine rental accommodation units, convenient in early spring when the nights can still be very chilly.

Swimming fun

The heated swimming pool in straightforward design (open from the end of June to the end of August) is located next to the campsite and is managed by the municipality. The swimming pool is free for campsite guests. It measures some 200 m2 and is ideal for swimming lengths. It does not cater for playing children, although there is a toddler pool. 

The tennis courts are located next to the swimming pool. Feel like doing something else? You can do white river rafting or canoeing in the area. The Guile river flows a bit further along and there is a recreational lake at less than 10 km from the campsite.

Eating and drinking

There is a small campsite shop (with daily fresh bread) but the shops and supermarket in Guillestre are within walking distance. The restaurant (including snack bar and pizzeria) has a small menu and is open during the same period as the swimming pool. You can enjoy the fresh air on an attractive terrace.

properties.name: Camping L'Etang des Forges Onlycamp
properties.description:
Camping L'Etang des Forges is located on the banks of a lake outside of the town of Belfort. From this well-maintained campsite you can walk within half an hour to the old town centre, situated in the shadow of the fortified fortress of Belfort.

Camping L'Etang des Forges is located on the lake of the same name, north of the town centre of Belfort. Although you camp close to the town, not far from busy roads, it's nice and green and relatively quiet. You can reach the campsite by taking the D13 from the centre of Belfort in a northerly direction. The campsite is on the edge of a residential area. The entrance to the campsite is lined with trees and ends at a small roundabout. The reception is a beautiful, modern, semicircular building.

Beautifully maintained campsite

The 110 touring pitches and around twenty rental bungalows are located on separate, well-tended lawns. The other side of the campsite is enclosed by tall trees and shrubs. The heated swimming pool is located at the front of the site, near the reception building. The sanitary facilities are kept perfectly clean throughout the day.

Belfort

The centre of Belfort is easily reached on foot or by bike. Especially the fortress, on top of a hill, is a place of interest. Near the fortress you will also find the statue of the Lion of Belfort. It was made by Frédéric Bartholdi, the sculptor who also made the Statue of Liberty.

properties.name: Camping Le Champ d'Été Onlycamp
properties.description:
The peace and quiet you'll enjoy at this family campsite in the French region of Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes is rarely disturbed. Boating, fishing, swimming and cycling are just a few of the many recreational options that this verdant, water-rich environment offers. The campsite is within walking distance of the town of Pont-de-Vaux, which is known for its beautiful surroundings and cosy atmosphere.

Park-like camping

This park-like campsite offers a relaxed atmosphere. The terrain is flat and consists of 107 spacious sun-and-shade pitches situated among the trees. Dogs are also very welcome here. Those who do not have their own camping equipment can stay in one of the rental accommodations, such as a mobile home or chalet.

Swimming pool with slides and wellness facilities

The whole family will have a great time at the modern swimming pool next to the campsite. The municipal swimming pool is accessible to everyone, but you'll enjoy free admission as a guest of Camping Le Champ d’Été Onlycamp. The slides offer plenty of thrills while the hammam and saunas ensure ultimate relaxation. The campsite has a beautifully landscaped children's playground, a multi-sport field, and a jeu-de-boules court.

Plan d'eau de Pont-de-Vaux

Plan d'eau de Pont-de-Vaux is located less than a five-minute walk from the campsite. This is a large recreational area with a lake that is popular with both tourists and locals. Here you can enjoy various activities such as swimming, fishing, canoeing and sailing.

Walking to the village

In the nearby town (1 km) you'll find everything you need, such as a bakery, supermarket, cafes and restaurants. And every Wednesday there's a nice market offering local specialities and regional products.

properties.name: Camping de Besançon Onlycamp
properties.description:
Camping de Besançon - Chalezeule is situated in Besançon. This campsite with swimming pool is located along the river Doubs and is suitable for campers looking for quietude. The large lawn around the swimming pool is well suited for a variety of sports and games. Close to the campsite is a tram stop from where you can get to the town centre. When you travel eastward for an hour, you reach the Swiss border.

Blue and green

Although slightly hidden from view behind the trees, the camping is quite easy to find. You can recognise it by the off-beat reception: a blue-coloured building on stilts. Entering the camping grounds, you are surrounded by greenery. Amidst trees and on lawns are the pitches, the bungalows and rental tents. There are even sites along the river where you can put up your tent.

Swimming and sunbathing

Camping de Besançon - Chalezeule is eminently suitable for people who are looking for peace and quiet. The campsite does not offer entertainment. However, children can play to their heart's content in the playground, the swimming pool and on the sports fields.

At the heart of the campsite, you will find the swimming pool. Not only can you take an impressive dive off one of the diving boards or swim as many laps as you like, but the large lawn around the pool also offers many possibilities. You can play table tennis, volleyball, games or just enjoy sunbathing on the lawn. Close to the swimming pool, bordering the lawn flows the river Doubs.

properties.name: Camping Vauban Onlycamp
properties.description:
Camping Vauban Onlycamp is right next to the beautiful fortified town of Neuf-Brisach in Haut-Rhin (France). This campsite is in natural, level area that is very popular with cyclists. From the campsite, you can take lovely bike rides to the beautiful city of Colmar. The campsite is close to the German border. A visit to the city of Freiburg or Europa-Park theme park is easily done from the campsite. This small-scale campsite has been subtly integrated into the surrounding countryside. The campsite is mainly popular among Dutch and German tourists, especially those seeking a quiet holiday destination from where you can go on lovely cycle rides.

A site beautifully incorporated into the countryside

This campsite is ideal for those who love the authentic camping life. Tourist pitches are clearly in the majority here. Above all, you camp in a natural setting. The spacious pitches on this neatly maintained site have been beautifully incorporated into the countryside. Besides touring pitches, Camping Vauban also has some lodge tents and chalets for hire, like the special bivouac tents for cycling campers.

Snack bar and fresh bread rolls at the campsite

When you stay at this campsite, you can do you grocery shopping in one of the large supermarkets in Volgelsheim. It's only a kilometre to walk or drive there. The campsite itself has a small shop and you can get salads, pizzas, pastries and delicious drinks from the snack bar. You can order fresh bread rolls croissants from reception for the following morning.

properties.name: Camping Pierre et Sources Onlycamp
properties.description:
Camping Pierre et Sources Onlycamp is situated on the foothills of the largest volcanic complex in Europe, in the centre of the Puy-de-Dôme department in Auvergne. This modern campsite is an ideal point of departure for viewing the volcanoes of the Auvergne region. You camp in the charming town of Volvic, known for its mineral water. The springs as well as the imposing caves of Volvic are easy to visit from the campsite. Because the campsite is located right next to the D986, it is ideal as a stopover destination.

Choose your own spot carefully

Tourist pitches dominate the campsite, which has been set up on a sloping site on which flat terraces have been created. You have breath-taking views of the surrounding mountains and Tournoël Castle from many of the pitches. If you are concerned about traffic noise from the D986, book a pitch on the left side of the site (with the reception behind you). Various types of accommodation are also available. You can stay overnight in a modern chalet or a safari tent.

Lovely outdoor swimming pool

In the French interior, it can get pretty hot in the summer – which makes it all the better that Camping Pierre et Sources Onlycamp has had a swimming pool since 2024. The outdoor swimming pool is an ideal spot to freshen up after a lovely day out in the countryside. There is also outdoor entertainment in the form of beach volleyball, table tennis and two playgrounds. If the weather is not that nice, simply go to the recreation room, which has a table football game, and books and board games that you can borrow.

properties.name: Camping Les Adoubes Onlycamp
properties.description:
Camping Les Adoubes Onlycamp is located in a quiet spot near river L'Arly, within walking distance of the charming town of Albertville (Savoie). This small campsite is ideal for campers who are passing through - because it's just 2 km from the N90 motorway exit. A longer stay is a good idea too, as it gives you the chance to enjoy the beautiful, mountainous surroundings. There are many walking and cycling routes close by that take you past the most beautiful spots. For example, the campsite is right next to the popular La Belle Via cycling route to Annecy.

Chalets, elevated tents and large camping pitches

At this well-maintained campsite, you choose a pitch when you arrive. They are large and clearly separated by trees, bushes, hedges and/or boulders. Shade lovers can choose a touring pitch at the back of the site. This Onlycamp campsite also rents out large camping tents on wooden poles, ideal for cyclists, amongst others. Would you prefer to have your own toilet and washing facilities? Then choose one of the comfortable chalets.

What can you do at this campsite?

Need a rest after a long journey or a long walk or bike ride? Then order a snack and drink from the campsite bar and enjoy them on the bar terrace. The campsite also has a shop, which sells essentials. Sports options consist of a large boules court, an outdoor fitness trail and table tennis tables. Children will love the playground.

properties.name: Camping Le Pont Romain Onlycamp
properties.description:
Camping Le Pont Romain Onlycamp is on the outskirts of the town of Yvré-l'Évêque, in the centre of the Sarthe. Here, you camp close to the lovely city of Le Mans with its famous circuit. Furthermore, it's a good stop off point for tourists following La Vélobuissonnière cycle route. This small-scale campsite includes camping pitches, a heated outdoor swimming pool and a snack bar.

What accommodation options are there?

This level campsite has sunny and shaded touring pitches available. They also have accommodation. You can also book a glamping stay in a modern mobile home, chalet or lodge tent. Adventurers and cycling tourists often spend the night in the cosy bivouac tents.

Enjoy the heated swimming pool

The lovely swimming pool is in the middle of the site. Jump in the heated swimming water of the basic swimming pool, which is big enough to swim laps. Meanwhile, the youngest campers can play in the adjacent paddling pool. A fun outdoor playground and a lovely recreational hall offer even more entertainment. Additionally, there is a small shop, a snack bar and a bakery service.

Ideal for motor sport fans

La Vélobuissonnière is a popular cycle route between Normandy and the Loire castles. This roughly 250-kilometre route leads you over green paths through quiet countryside. Camping Le Pont Romain Onlycamp is only a few kilometres from this route. You can also get to Papéa Parc amusement park (6 km) and the Pescheray zoo (18.5 km) in no time. Furthermore, the campsite is close to the historic centre of Le Mans (8 km), a city famous for its circuit.

properties.name: Camping Les Peupliers du Lac Onlycamp
properties.description:
Camping Les Peupliers du Lac Onlycamp is a quiet campsite in Chindrieux, Savoie. This French campsite is simple and does not have a WiFi connection. So, you can completely unwind here. Lac du Bourget with its fine beach is two kilometres from the campsite. Take the time to walk in the surrounding area and to visit Lyon's old city centre (130 km drive).

For all types of camping equipment

This campsite has shaded camping pitches and open, sunny pitches. You will also find various mobile homes and a chalet. If you want to be deeper in the countryside and yet enjoy the luxury of an accommodation, go for a Ponza tent! You can then use the toilet and washing facilities at the campsite, which are open day and night.

Completely away from it all

Camping Les Peupliers du Lac is the place to be for quiet and space. There are no special amenities, but there is a small shop and a snack bar in the high season (only in the weekends). For the little ones, there is a playground and a ping pong table and a tennis court for the adults. In the high season, you can start your day with fresh bread rolls that you can order from reception.

In the vicinity

If you like the beach, you can go to the beach at Châtillon. This beach is by Lac du Bourget, two kilometres from the campsite. You can do water sports and swim under the watchful eye of a lifeguard in the high season. Furthermore, there are two nature parks with lovely walking routes in the vicinity of the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Le Sabot Onlycamp
properties.description:
The Loire region is known for its many Renaissance castles. Château d'Azay-le-Rideau is one of the most beautiful castles in this region. Camping Le Sabot Onlycamp is right next to this castle, in the village of Azay-le-Rideau in the department of Indre-et-Loire. This spaciously appointed campsite is in a wonderful setting, tucked between the castle, forest and River Indre. Furthermore, you camp right next to a municipal outdoor swimming pool that campsite guests can use for free in the summer.

Book a spacious touring pitch

When you walk or drive over this site for the first time, you will soon notice it is an authentic campsite; tourist pitches are clearly in the majority here. At Camping Le Sabot you can pick a spacious pitch close to the entrance or the toilet and washing facilities, or you can book a pitch by the river. This campsite also has some accommodation for hire.

Swim for free in the municipal swimming pool

Azay-le-Rideau's municipal outdoor swimming pool is beside the campsite. In the high season, you can swim laps here in the 25-metre-long swimming pool. There is an adjacent round paddling pool where young children can play and splash about in the water. Admission to this swimming pool is free for guests at Camping Le Sabot.

Plenty of water sports options

River Indre, flowing past the campsite, invites you to do water sports. You can hire a standup paddleboard at the campsite and go standup paddleboarding on the river. There are many more water sports options in the surrounding area, such as kayaking and canoeing.

properties.name: Camping du Lac de Roybon Onlycamp
properties.description:
Camping de Roybon can rightly be called an idyllic natural campsite, situated on the banks of a fishing lake in the Isère. Here you'll camp in a very peaceful environment, between the trees and shrubs of the beautifully landscaped, sloping terrain. The enthusiastic owners are passionate about their campsite and contribute to the convivial atmosphere.

Campsite with natural character

The campsite is situated slightly elevated against the slope of a wooded hill. The natural character of the site is not disturbed, but nicely complemented by the winding sandy paths that run along the more than eighty pitches. Green hedges provide demarcation in some places. From some pitches you can see the lake between the trees.

Camping at the lake

The campsite is situated on the shore of a large lake, which you can reach through a gate. The campsite is separated from the lake by a fence: very safe for children. You can swim and fish in the lake.

Natural playground

There is no entertainment programme at Camping de Roybon. Especially children that like real adventurers and playing outside will like it here. Nature is their big playground: the lake offers a lot of fun and as well as at the stream that crosses the campsite. Small campers who don’t like water so much can enjoy themselves at the sports fields, playground equipment and bouncy castle.

Restaurant with regional dishes

The campsite's small restaurant serves tasty regional dishes. Simple snacks are also available.

properties.name: Camping Des Halles Onlycamp
properties.description:
Located on a peninsula, surrounded by the Loire and the Canal du Nivernais, Camping des Halles is the perfect location in Burgundy for anglers and cyclists. And for those looking for peace and quiet, as there is no busy road or other noise around the campground.

Camping on the Loire

Choose a campsite among the trees with a beautiful view of the water. When evening falls, you'll see the beautiful sunset. Swans paddle serenely on the water and you can drink the wonderful French wine of the Loire region. A holiday in France just doesn't get better than that. The campsites are equipped with grass spread between the trees. So you'll have plenty of shade. There are paved sites for camper parking. If you are coming to camp at campsite des Halles with a tent, you can use the communal space which has a gas stove and a microwave.

Plenty of water activities

How about a swim? Then you can use the neighbouring communal swimming pool free of charge during the free swimming times. Or you can go to the recreation park on the other side of the campground. Entry is free, and there is a playground, spray park, dock, bar with terrace and a mini golf course.

properties.name: Karlstad Swecamp Bomstad Baden
properties.description:
Do you want to experience Sweden at its best? Then go camping at Karlstad Swecam Bomstad Baden. This child-friendly campsite is located in a pine forest right on the Vänernmeer. It is the perfect place for those who seek peace and quiet and water sports enthusiasts. A good starting point to explore the natural attraction of Värmland. Due to the lovely location, the Swedes themselves love to have a holiday here.

Camping with a lake view

On this campsite, you can choose from a spacious pitch in the pine forest or a spot on the beach side. The spots on the beach side offer a lovely view of the Vänernmeer. The sanitary facilities are well-maintained and very clean.

Water fun galore

The Karlstad Swecamp Bomstad Baden campsite is located on the north side of the Vänernmeer. This is not the largest lake in Western Europe. It looks more like a sea! The Vänernmeer is therefore the perfect place to explore with a kayak, canoe or raft. Is it a sunny day? Relax on the sandy beach or take a dip in the fresh water.

Time to get a bite after a day full of water fun? Then take a seat in the camping restaurant Bomstad Kitchen & Bar. It is open from May through the start of September. The menu offers plenty of diversity; from fresh salmon and salads to hamburgers and pizzas.

Also great for the kids

For children between 5 and 12, there are many activities organised in the summer. For example, cuddling an elk - not a real one, naturally, but with the campsite mascot. There are some playgrounds spread out over the campsite. The campsite also has a disc golf course and a mini-golf pitch.

properties.name: Camping Resort Turnersee
properties.description:
The well-maintained campsite Resort Turnersee is in the beautiful region of Jauntal, located in bucolic Carinthia. The camp grounds directly border the crystal clear Turnersee lake. The campsite has a large jetty and a sunbathing lawn on the banks of the lake. Swimming, sunbathing and boating are the activities that are sure to enhance an already relaxing holiday.

Inviting family camping

What first strikes you is how well maintained this campsite is. Here you camp on large, flat fields laid out at different heights. They slightly incline to the banks of the Turnersee. The seasonal pitches and touring pitches are spread out across the campgrounds.

The pitches differ in size (70-130 m²) and are flanked by tall trees or with green hedges. These pitches have a lot of shade, while others are located more in the sun. The campsite rents out well-equipped mobile homes. In the high season, there is a separate field for dog owners.

Sunning, swimming and boating

You get to the shore from the campsite via a short path. There they have built an enormous jetty where you can sunbathe to your heart's content. You can also sunbathe on the sunbathing lawn. Convenient: by the lake there is also a sanitary building and a bar. You can enjoy wonderful boating on the placid lake in a canoe, kayak or a dinghy.

For active people

Do you want to do sporty activities with the family? Then you've come to the right place! In the area you can enjoy fantastic hiking and cycling. The local tourist office organises lots of excursions. In July and August there is an entertainment programme for children.

properties.name: Camping Les Mizottes / Camping Hevea
properties.description:
The Camping Mizottes campsite is located in the Marais Poitevin Regional Nature Park, not far from the Atlantic coast. This neat campsite on the Vélodyssée is a quiet, sought-out address for French families, cyclists and beachgoers. With an indoor and outdoor swimming pool, the whole family can enjoy a swim, rain or shine. The area offers plenty of activities. The beach is five kilometres away while the port city of La Rochelle is just an hour's drive from the campsite.

Elongated campsite

The Camping Mizottes campsite is elongated. Camping pitches are located on both sides of long paved roads. The spacious touring pitches offer a fair amount of privacy. Every pitch has a tree that provides shade. The campsite is calm and peaceful, especially during the daytime. Evenings can be a bit noisy owing to the parties and disco music.

Indoor and outdoor swimming pool

Can't decide between a dip in an indoor or outdoor swimming pool? Camping Mizottes has both! The outdoor rectangular swimming pool is located behind a low wall, and there are sun loungers to relax on after a dip. In the unlikely event that the weather is not cooperative, the indoor swimming pool is heated. The pool has a slightly shallower end where most children can stand.

Pizzeria

At the front of the campsite is a pizzeria that also offers tasty snacks and drinks. The campsite does not have a supermarket, but there's a fresh bakery and a few other shops in the village of Saint-Michel-en-l'Herm.

properties.name: Camping Paradis Albret
properties.description:
Camping Paradis Albret is in the heart of the Landes region, a prime location near the Atlantic. Peace, space and the beach are all close by. The sandy beach at Messanges is a short walk away. There’s much more to discover too, like the Courant d'Huchet nature reserve (14 km) and Bayonne (45 km).

For every type of camper

The pitches at Camping Paradis Albret are surrounded by green and are large and shady. Prefer a little luxury? Then choose a modern chalet or mobile home, fully equipped and ready to use. With 267 rental accommodation options and pitches, there’s something for everyone.

A relaxing holiday

There’s always something to do at Camping Paradis in Messanges. Children run around in the playground and the entertainment team organises fun activities for the whole family every day. Take a dip in the pool or unwind at the spa. And if you’re a sports fan, you can head down to the sports field or gym. Don't fancy cooking? Enjoy the restaurant’s delicious local dishes or visit the snack bar.

Discover the Landes

The area is best explored by bike or on foot. With more than 150 kilometres of cycle paths, the vast nature of the Landes region is literally at your feet. Rather go horse riding? There are some riding schools nearby.

Fancy an active day out? Then explore the Courant d'Huchet nature reserve in Moliets-et-Mââ (12 km), just a 15-minute drive away. Or visit the Plage des Sablères (3 km) in Vieux Boucau, where time seems to stand still.

properties.name: Camping Kirnermartes Hof
properties.description:
The Kirnermartes Hof campsite is located in the heart of the Black Forest, against the flank of the Todnauberg mountain. The owners of this quiet family campsite also manage the farm opposite. It's the perfect place to experience relaxed farm life. There’s a shop that sells farm produce, a gin distillery and a petting zoo. Head to the restaurant if you’re hungry and to the wellness area to relax.

Sloping site with fruit trees

The campsite is 100 metres above sea level and embedded in nature. There are beautiful views from the higher pitches. The site is full of fruit trees and surrounded by meadows. The lower part of the campsite has taller trees and there are hedges between most of the pitches. There’s a separate field for tents. The family also rents out apartments and neat and tidy mobile homes.

Water fun and lots of animals

A stream runs alongside the campsite; it’s ideal for children to play and splash around in. Kirchzarten's modern municipal swimming pool is two kilometres from the campsite. Children will also enjoy all the animals. Fun activities are regularly organised, like caring for and feeding goats and pony riding. The owners’ involvement means that everything is always very relaxed.

Various farm products, like fresh milk, apple juice and homemade Schnaps, can be bought in the main building near reception. For a bite to eat, head to the cosy restaurant. To complete the holiday feel, there’s a paid sauna where you can completely unwind.

properties.name: Campingpark Wißmarer See
properties.description:
Do you dream of a holiday by a lovely lake, close to a river and also in the woods? Then Campingpark Wißmarer See will fulfil your wishes. The campsite is located on Lake Wißmarer See in central Hesse. You will be camping in a vast recreational area with many possibilities. With so much nature and water around you, this campsite is ideal for families with children and couples alike. Take a dip in the lake, go canoeing on the river or hiking and cycling in the surrounding area. This is holidaying as it was meant to be.

Camping around the lake

The campsite pitches are nicely situated around the lake. So you almost always have a beautiful view from your pitch! The pitches vary in size, from 60 m² to 100 and even 120 m². There are pitches in both the sun and shade. Don't have your own camping equipment? No problem, you can rent a tent or caravan. The sanitary facilities are clean and easily accessible for people with reduced mobility.

Building sandcastles and swimming

The lake has a lovely sandy beach where the children can build sandcastles and you can enjoy the sun on your beach towel. Of course, for a refreshing dip you can simply jump into the water. For water fun you can also go to the river Lahn. This river surrounds the campsite. You can also take beautiful canoe trips along beautiful forests. The area is also perfect for hiking and cycling.

properties.name: Stevns Camping
properties.description:
In the charming coastal town of Strøby, on the Danish island of Zealand, you will find Stevns Camping. This is an ideal base for beautiful hikes and bike rides around Zealand. You’ll be camping just 800 meters from the beach. Want to explore some fun cities during your camping holiday? Køge and Copenhagen are within easy reach. The campsite itself offers a heated outdoor pool and a mini-golf course.

What accommodation options are available?

At this three-star campsite, most of the pitches are for camping. The pitches vary considerably in size. Want to make sure you have enough space? Choose a comfort pitch, which is at least 144 m². Additionally, you can book a modern cabin with your own kitchen and bathroom.

Dive into the sea or the campsite pool

The campsite is located by a narrow, elongated beach on the Baltic Sea. It’s a great place to visit year-round. In spring and autumn, enjoy nice beach walks, and in summer, you can wade or take a refreshing dip in the sea. Is that too cold for you? Then dive into the campsite’s heated outdoor pool, which also has a toddler pool and a slide. Campers can further enjoy the animal petting area, playground, or the challenging mini-golf course.

Relax on the beaches or visit Copenhagen

Are you a beach lover? Then visit the Strøby Ladeplads Strand (2 km). This beach is located next to a vast forest. In the Danish capital, Copenhagen (58 km), you can admire many historic buildings, stroll along the inner waterways, and enjoy excellent shopping and nightlife.

properties.name: Almtal Camp
properties.description:
Looking for an authentic, stylish Austrian campsite with a touch of luxury? Almtal Camp, just outside the friendly village of Pettenbach in Upper Austria, is then a great choice. This is an excellently maintained campsite with luxurious toilet and shower facilities, a very good restaurant and a large wellness centre. The campsite is located on the river Alm and only five kilometres from the A9 motorway, making it a good transit campsite.

Stylish campsite with adjoining hotel

That this is a stylish campsite becomes clear as soon as you drive onto the site. The drive is expansive and open, and at the entrance there is a hotel building that resembles a chic castle. This hotel has several luxury studios and apartments. The campsite itself offers both permanent pitches and spacious touring pitches. The area for permanent guests is separated from the tourist pitches. Are you passing through and want to drive off early the next morning with your motorhome? Then book one of the fast drive in / drive out pitches at the front of the campsite.

Visit the WellnessWelt and dine at Florianistubn

Do you want to fully relax and unwind on holiday? The WellnessWelt includes a Finnish sauna, bio steam sauna, infrared cabin and Kneipp bath. You will also find an indoor pool whose water is heated to 32 degrees. When the weather is nice, you can naturally swim in the heated outdoor pool. You can eat well in restaurant Florianistubn. From meat and fish dishes to pastas, salads, soups and plant-based meals, there is something for everyone!

properties.name: Campingpark Erfurt
properties.description:
Erfurt is one of Germany's most beautiful cities. Campingpark Erfurt is an excellent starting point for anyone wanting to admire the historic centre of Erfurt (Thüringen). This campsite is in a quiet setting at only three kilometres from the centre.

Clear laid out site with mainly camping and motorhome pitches

The campsite is neatly landscaped and well-maintained. You can stay here on a motorhome pitch or on the tent camping field. You can of course also book a pitch at Campingpark Erfurt. If you want to visit this campsite without your own camping equipment, stay in one of the lovely hiker's cabins.

Own shop and close to T.E.C. Erfurt

Next to reception, there is a small shop where you can get a range of basic necessities. If you want to do an extensive shop, you are best walking or driving to the T.E.C. Erfurt indoor shopping centre.

New, top-quality toilet and washing facilities

The toilet and washing facilities at Campingpark Erfurt are new, modern and well-maintained. The toilet block also contains a toilet-shower combination for the disabled. You can also hire private bathrooms and family bathrooms.

Visit Erfurt's Altstadt or go for a lovely walk in the woods

What can you see and do in the Altstadt of Erfurt? Well, there is the Krämerbrücke for example. This is a bridge on which beautiful, authentic houses have been built. Be sure to keep walking to the Domplatz.

If you are looking for a day trip of a totally different calibre, go for lovely walks or bike trips in the forests to the south and southeast of this city.

properties.name: Erholungsgebiet DoktorSee
properties.description:
The DoktorSee recreation area is located in the Weserbergland region, near the charming half-timbered town of Rinteln. It is a wonderful place to relax and have fun. Enjoy hours of swimming in the lake, relax in the sauna or enjoy a delicious dinner in one of the restaurants.

Camping by the lake

Around the Doktorsee, you can enjoy a wonderful holiday at the campsite. The grounds are well maintained and the pitches are of average size, with a grass surface and partially paved. Of course, you can bring your own tent, caravan or motorhome, but you can also rent accommodation right by the water.

Water fun and relaxation

You can enjoy hours of swimming fun in the lake. There is an 80-metre-long slide, water trampolines and a climbing tower on the water. In addition to swimming, stand-up paddling or take a nice pedal boat ride on the lake. Ready for some extra relaxation? Then visit the SeeSa sauna landscape, where you can enjoy a view of the lake from the floating sauna.

Plenty of entertainment and restaurants

For the youngest campers, there are several playgrounds, a mud playground and an entertainment programme in the summer. The site has an adventure mini golf course and several sports fields and table tennis tables. The site has two restaurants (Doktorweide and Terrassen-Café) and a bistro at the wellness centre.

Exploring the surrounding area

The surrounding area is ideal for day trips, for example to Hamelin (25 km), where you can visit the Rattenfängerhaus or the Rattenfängerspiele. The landscape around the campsite is also perfect for long walks and bike rides. The Weserradweg cycle path runs right past the campsite.

properties.name: Ferienpark Geesthof
properties.description:
Ferienpark Geesthof is located just outside Hechthausen, a charming village in the German district of Cuxhaven (Lower Saxony). This campsite is mainly popular with people who love horses and horse riding. All kinds of horse riding activities take place on and around this campsite's riding school, including horse-riding lessons for novice riders. The campsite is in a forested area in a sparsely populated region. So, it is an ideal place to completely relax and unwind! There are plenty of options for outings in the vicinity. You can, for example, take lovely walks in the woods around the campsite or visit interesting cities such as Stade (22 km) and Hamburg (80 km).

Nature campsite with forested touring pitches

When you walk or drive over this campsite, you will soon notice that it is a nature campsite. All the camping pitches are on unpaved paths. The site is also in the forest, which means you have plenty of privacy at every pitch at Ferienpark Geesthof. The campsite also has various types of accommodation. Book a stay in a comfortable mobile home, a luxury holiday home or a neat hotel room above the restaurant. There is free wifi everywhere at Ferienpark Geesthof.

Wonderful swimming in an indoor and outdoor swimming pool

You can take full advanatge of the swimming pool at Ferienpark Geesthof from April to October. This campsite's lovely indoor swimming pool is open during that period. The indoor pool has recently been installed and there is a paddling pool and a small water slide. There is also an outdoor swimming pool. The water in both swimming pools is heated to a pleasant temperature.

properties.name: Gäddede Camping och Stugby
properties.description:
In the heart of the Jämtlandsfjällen, near the village of Gäddede, you will find the campsite by the same name, Gäddede Camping och Stugby. This campsite caters mainly for guests visiting this Swedish region for its the largely pristine natural beauty. The campsite lies directly on the water and not far from the village centre. As the shops of the village are within walking distance, you will want for nothing. Gäddede lies on the so-called Vildmarksvägen (wilderness road), which runs through an astonishingly beautiful landscape.

Typical Swedish campsite

The campsite is a typical Swedish campsite with fairly spacious pitches, but little shade. The different fields are separated from each other by low hedges. The last two fields are intended for tents. Just like virtually every Swedish campsite, Gäddede Camping och Stugby has quite a number of simple trekker huts and some fully equipped holiday cottages, which are sufficiently warm in winter as well.

Dining with a view

The reception is the heart of the campsite, where you can obtain all information about the whole region, such as tips for walking trips in the mountains. There is also a small, but attractive restaurant where you can dine with a view of the lake.

Active in the vicinity

The waters around the Gäddede campsite abound with fish. At the reception they will assist you to find your best beat. One can fish for trout and salmonidae (röding in Swedish) which can grow very big here. You can make a beautiful canoeing trip from Gäddede back to Strömsund via the watery area of Ströms Vattudal..

properties.name: Hätte Camping
properties.description:
Lake Sommen is located on the border between Småland and Östergötland. On the Småland bank of the lake you'll find Hätte Camping, only 4 km from the town of Tranås. The campground is located in a typical Småland environment with many trees and lakes. The camping guests have over 100 campsites with electrics and 30 spots for tents. There are also ten or so red stugas (trekker huts) for hire.

The sites on the campground are separated, so you always have plenty of space for your tent, caravan or camper along the paved roads. Some of the sites are located in a field under trees.

The beating heart

The reception building is the beating heart of the campground, where the owners will give you a warm welcome. You can do your daily shopping in the shop. The Sjökrogen restaurant is right next to the camping. Boats and canoes can be rented at Petrus Kajak.

Spacious options

Many of the activities start right at the campground: cycling excursions (campground rents bikes), hikes and kayak trips will lead you through the varied landscape of Småland and Östergötland. This is a typical Swedish landscape: slightly rolling, full of dark forests and blue lakes with red houses dotted here and there. You have a good chance of seeing a moose...

Even if you don't want to leave the campground, you'll have plenty of fun along Lake Sommen, where you can have a swim and where children will feel safe.

properties.name: Camping Le Point de Vue de Guerlédan
Camping Le Paradis Onlycamp
properties.description:
Right next to the medieval town centre of Pons, one of the most beautiful towns in the Charente-Maritime, is Camping Le Paradis Onlycamp. This small three-star campsite is a popular overnight stop for campers passing through. This is because of its convenient location just four kilometres from the A10 motorway, but also due to its well-maintained facilities. If you stay a little longer, be sure to visit Pons town centre or spend a day at the Marais Poitevin regional natural park or the beaches on the Bay of Biscay (40 km).

Neat grass pitches and a cosy tent on stilts

On this campsite, paved paths lead to about 60 spacious touring pitches. The pitches are level and covered with grass. Some pitches face directly onto a stream that runs alongside the campsite. Is it just the two of you on holiday and are you open to a special experience? Then book a stay in a tent on wooden stilts; a cosy cocoon consisting only of a bedroom. Below the sleeping area, you also have a picnic table with benches. Ideal for couples, but also for cycle tourists!

What entertainment does the campsite offer?

Visiting this campsite with children? They can entertain themselves in the playground and at the table tennis table, at the front of the site. Then buy a drink, ice cream or snack at the snack bar and get your main groceries at the campsite shop. Fancy an afternoon swim? In summer, you can swim in the municipal swimming pool next to the campsite. Camping guests have free access to this water park, which consists of two large outdoor pools and a wonderful water slide.

properties.name: Camping de Chamarges Onlycamp
properties.description:
This small-scale campsite is situated in a beautiful spot in the Drôme Valley, in the department of the same name in the Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes region. The Drôme offers plenty of variety in terms of landscapes. While the western part is relatively flat, in the eastern part you'll find a low mountain range belonging to the foothills of the French Alps. Camping de Chamarges Onlycamp is located in the east, just outside the picturesque town of Die and right on the river. The campsite is surrounded by lavender fields, vast forest areas and imposing mountain peaks and massifs. It is a quiet, authentic campsite with an outdoor swimming pool and a snack bar with terrace.

Beautiful spots on the river or with a mountain view

The reception, where new campers are extended a friendly welcome, is located at the centre of the campsite. There are mainly shady camping pitches on this campsite's flat terrain, though there are also some sunny spots available. If you book a spot on the river side, you can enjoy the sound the Drôme River's running waters. And you have a beautiful view of the surrounding mountains from the other side of the campsite. In addition to regular camping pitches, Camping de Chamarges Onlycamp rents out a small number of accommodations, such as lodge tents and chalets.

Cool off in the pool or the river

The outdoor swimming pool is located at the front of the campsite. You can not only cool off in this rectangular pool on hot summer days, but you can also swim a few laps. From the campsite you can reach the river bank via two paths. You can enjoy wading in the waters here. It's also a good starting point for a canoe or kayak trip. Kayaks can be rented at the reception.

properties.name: Camping L'Orée d'Alsace Onlycamp
properties.description:
Camping de Wasselonne Onlycamp is in a quiet setting on the outskirts of the town of Wasselonne in the Alsace in France. This is the perfect holiday destination for those seeking quiet as well as active people. Indeed, the campsite is at the foot of the Vosges, a range of low mountains where it is lovely for walking, mountain biking and climbing. Furthermore, the campsite is surrounded by beautiful vineyards and you are close to the start of the well-known Alsace wine route. Moreover, you can walk straight into the charming centre of Wasselonne from this small-scale campsite.

Spacious touring pitches and modern accommodation

If you would like to book a camping pitch at Camping de Wasselonne, you can choose from pitches in the sun, but shaded touring pitches are also available. The pitches are spacious in size and well maintained.

You can also hire a modern chalet or lodge tent at the campsite. There are 12 chalets and three lodge tents in total.

Walk through the Vosges or climb the Kronthal rock

The campsite is in an ideal location in the versatile Alsace. The campsite is on the outskirts of the Vosges. One of the best places for climbing in the Alsace, the Kronthal rock, is less than a 10-minute drive from the campsite. This massive cliff is a challenging test for even the most experienced climbers.

properties.name: Camping Les Tuillères Onlycamp
properties.description:
Camping Les Tuillères Onlycamp has a magnificent location on the edge of the Drôme river. This charming family campsite, located in the centre of the Ardèche, is a quiet home base for many excursions. For example, visit the charming village of Saillans or go on a walking tour of the surrounding mountains. Both the large outdoor swimming pool and the river provide water fun for young and old.

Camping along the French river

There are several pitches along the banks of the Drôme, most of which are sheltered under the trees. The pitches are not strictly enclosed, which is very pleasant. If you enjoy luxury camping, the charming tiny houses and glamping tents are fully furnished and fit five people. Although the camping site is on a main road, you don’t hear much traffic on the campsite.

Swimming with mountain views

If you would like to paddle in the water, go down the stairs at the waterfront. If the water level in the river is high enough, you can swim in it, go canoeing or drift about on an inflatable bed. In addition to this natural swimming hole, the campsite also has a large swimming pool. A chaise longue will allow you to enjoy the magnificent view of the tall mountains.

Relaxed life outdoors

The daily programme includes a football match for enthusiasts. The covered terrace is also an excellent spot for a relaxed evening. During the high season, treat yourself to a self-made pizza. The playground has two trampolines for the youngest campsite visitors.

properties.name: Camping Le Petit Bocage Onlycamp
properties.description:
The interior of the French department of Vendée is known for its green landscapes and its many small rivers. Camping Le Petit Bocage Onlycamp is located centrally in the Vendée department, in the town of Essarts-en-Bocage. It’s only thirty minutes to the famous park Pur du Fou and the charming town of La Roche-sur-Yon. This small-scale campsite is an ideal holiday address for people who want to enjoy the typical rural life of this part of France. Families with young children also enjoy coming to this campsite, located right next to the municipality’s indoor and outdoor swimming pool.

Original campsite with spacious pitches

If you like original campsites where touring campsite visitors are in the majority, then this is a suitable holiday destination. Tourist camping pitches are clearly in the majority at this well-kept campsite. If you have decided to book a pitch at Camping Le Petit Bocage Onlycamp, then there is a spacious spot in a grassy location in store for you. There are both sunny and shady pitches. Some pitches are demarcated by hedges.

Swim for free in Piscine Oasis

Essarts-en-Bocage’s municipal swimming pool, Piscine Oasis, is right next to the campsite. There is no charge for guests of Camping Le Petit Bocage Onlycamp using this swimming pool, which underwent major renovations in 2022. A gate provides direct access from the campsite to the swimming pool. Piscine Oasis has a heated indoor and outdoor swimming pool, both 25 metres in length. There is also a wading pool and a relaxation area with a sauna, Turkish bath, ice fountain and sensory shower.

properties.name: Camping Les Pins Onlycamp
properties.description:
This quiet nature campsite is in a lovely setting in a forested area south of the city of Orléans. And very close to Nançay, seeing as Camping Les Pins Onlycamp is on the outskirts of this picturesque village. In addition, this region in Central France is known as an excellent area for walking and cycling. Besides the spacious camping pitches, there are comfortable mobile homes and a glamping tent on the friendly site under pine and coniferous trees. Quiet is the key word here. Children can have fun playing in the playground or go crazy on the sports field.

Amid the trees

With 83 camping pitches, 16 motorhome pitches and 20 accommodation, it is not a small campsite, but it does feel like one. When you walk over the level site, you notice the extremely spacious pitches that offer plenty of privacy. The trees mark out the pitches, which further strengthens the natural experience. The toilet and washing facilities are not new, but they are nice and clean. If you would rather enjoy a holiday without taking your own camping equipment, a stay in one of the neat accommodation is recommended.

Time for coffee

You can go to the supermarket in the village of Nançay for your daily groceries. There are also lovely restaurants within two kilometres, where you can enjoy the French cuisine. And when you are at the campsite, the small grocery shop offers ice cream, drinks, a cup of fresh coffee and bread rolls and croissants in the morning. Camping Les Pins does not have a swimming pool, but at a 15-kilometre drive you will find a lovely swimming pool with outdoor pool, paddling pool and beach for a lovely day out.

properties.name: Camping Sous les Pommiers Onlycamp
properties.description:
Looking for a great base for exploring Normandy? Then Camping Sous les Pommiers Onlycamp is highly recommended. You’ll be camping right next to a small river, surrounded by apple trees. The area is ideal for those seeking peace and quiet, as well as cyclists and walkers. The famous D-Day beaches from the Second World War, such as Omaha Beach, are also nearby.

Camping amid the apple trees

The well-maintained campsite has spacious, level pitches suitable for tents, caravans or motorhomes. You’ll be surrounded by the shade of mature fruit trees. Prefer a bit more comfort? Then rent one of the fully equipped tents. For example, the Bivouac tent on stilts. You’re guaranteed an adventurous stay here!

Traditional and simple camping

Simple camping is at the heart of the site. Children can enjoy themselves in the playground, on the bouncy castle or at the table tennis table. You can also borrow board games or books. Grab a tasty snack at the small snack bar. You can also use the launderette, and for families with babies there is a changing table, baby bath and cot.

Head out and explore the local area

Here you can fully enjoy the picturesque countryside. Grab a bike and go exploring, or dig out your walking shoes. Plage de Saint-Honorine-des Pertes (13 km) is a lovely beach for stretching your legs. There are also beautiful marshlands nearby where storks live. History buffs will also find plenty to enjoy here. The historic D-Day landing beach, Omaha Beach, is nearby (7.5 km). This special place holds a huge appeal for visitors from all over the world.

properties.name: Camping du Moulin Onlycamp
properties.description:
Camping du Moulin Onlycamp is surrounded by the beautiful Muscadet vineyards, in the town of Clisson in the French department of Loire-Atlantique. It's a short walk to the historic centre of Clisson from this campsite. The site of the annual Hellfest Festival is only a short walk away. The surrounding area is lovely for walking and cycling, while the lively city of Nantes is also within arm's reach. It is a spaciously laid out campsite with a quiet character.

Plenty of different touring pitches and accommodation

This friendly campsite has small-scale camping fields with spacious touring pitches. There are mainly sunny pitches available, though the site gets increasingly forested at the rear. So, there are also shaded pitches. You can also spend the night in a modern mobile home or in a charming tiny house, safari tent or Lonna tent. The last one is a tent on two-metre-high wooden poles with little more than a double bed. A nice detail is that you can unzip the top of the tent. This gives the Lonna tent the character of a back-to-nature accommodation.

Playground, jeu de boules and shopping options

At this campsite, you enjoy the quiet in a green setting. For entertainment, there is a playground, a jeu de boules court and a recreation room. The campsite also offers the convenience of its own shop and a bakery service (during the high season).

Ideal starting point for walkers, cyclists and festival visitors.
