The campsite is especially popular among walking and cycling tourists. Furthermore, the medieval centre of Clisson (1 km) is within walking distance. The campsite is also just a 30-minute drive from the big city of Nantes (30 km).

properties.name: Camping Les Deux Rives Onlycamp
properties.description:
Camping Les Deux Rives Onlycamp is near the famous pink granite coast the Côtes-d'Armor in Brittany. Here, you camp next to the River Léguer, on the outskirts of the charming town of Lannion. This is a wonderful place for people seeking peace and quiet and wanting to experience the traditional camping feeling. The surrounding area is very much worth exploring. Take lovely walks or bike rides, go to the vast beaches, visit medieval villages and picturesque harbour towns.

Small-scale campsite

A calm atmosphere dominates the spacious campsite, and you can enjoy a pleasant silence. There are a total of 50 touring pitches and about 25 lovely accommodation for hire, including chalets and wooden houses on poles. You can pick your own camping pitch. Most camping pitches are on grass and nice and spacious. Hedges and bushes provide extra privacy between the various fields.

Ideal for those seeking peace and quiet

The campsite is simple and does not have many facilities. This place is mainly visited by people who like quiet and the countryside. There is a playground for children and you can play a game of jeu de boules. The campsite is well equipped for cyclists. There is a fridge and a microwave to use. Bike storage can also be arranged on request. In July and August, you can start the new day with fresh bread rolls that are available from the bar. You can go to Lannion for supermarkets and restaurants.

properties.name: Camping du Rouergue Onlycamp
properties.description:
Camping du Rouergue is on the edge of Villefranche-de-Rouergue in the department of Aveyron, in the south of France. The campsite itself is located in a green setting. Numerous trees on this well-maintained site provide plenty of shade. Moreover, the campsite is almost right on the Aveyron river, where you can go on fun canoe and kayak trips. As a campsite visitor you have free access to the small campsite swimming pool as well as the nearby swimming pool complex Aqualudis.

Shady pitches and colourful caravans

When you look at the map of Onlycamp du Rouergue at the reception or online, you see that this elongated site consists of playfully shaped camping fields, consisting mainly of touring pitches.

In addition to the touring pitches, this campsite also rents out various types of accommodation. At Onlycamp du Rouergue you can rent a tent or a colourful caravan.

A free afternoon of swimming in Aqualudis

The campsite has a small outdoor swimming pool at the beginning of the site. This swimming pool is in a sunny location. Furthermore, as a guest at Onlycamp du Rouergue, you can swim for free in the swimming pool next to the campsite: Aqualudis. This is a splendid complex with a large indoor and outdoor pool. There is a competition pool, a paddling pool, Jacuzzis, water slides and a rapids.

Wandering about in the narrow streets of the bastide of Villefranche

If you are staying at this campsite, you simply must visit the centre of Villefranche-de-Rouergue. With its rectangular blocks of houses around the central square, the centre of this town is a true @@@bastide. Around this central square (Place Notre-Dame) you will find graceful galleries and an imposing cathedral.

properties.name: Camping L'Oree des Vosges Onlycamp
properties.description:
If you prefer to spend your holidays at a quiet location in a green setting, then L'Oree Des Vosges Onlycamp in the cute French village of Val d’Ajol (Vosges) is an excellent holiday address. This small-scale campsite is nestled among the rolling hills. Many spots allow you a wonderful view of the expansive meadows and fields of grass. If you plan to visit this campsite, be sure to take along your hiking shoes. You can go for many beautiful walks in this unspoilt area.

Choose your favourite pitch and enjoy the view

This friendly campsite has just under 50 tourist camping pitches. If you want a pitch at L’Oree Des Vosges, you are free to choose your own favourite spot. And there is a lot to choose from here because there are huge differences between the pitches with respect to surface, shape and position. Along the edge of the grounds, most of the pitches have a good view of fields and meadows. The touring pitches are separated by neatly kept hedges. At L’Oree Des Vosges you can also book a stay in a chalet. Two beautiful chalets, one of which has wheelchair access, are situated in the corner of the grounds.

Purchases done on foot or go out to eat

In a central relaxation area on the campsite, all campsite visitors may use a fridge, freezer, microwave and coffee maker. For groceries and other purchases, you can visit the charming village centre. The shops in Le Val-d’Ajol include two supermarkets, bakeries and catering establishments.

properties.name: Camping La Confluence Onlycamp
properties.description:
The historic Loire Valley in central France is a picturesque area known for its rich nature and centuries-old castles. If you are looking for peace and quiet, if you like cycling and hiking, you have come to the right place at Camping La Confluence Onlycamp.

Spacious in the shade

Thanks to its location on the Loire à Vélo route, this campsite is very popular with cyclists. A special field has been laid out for small tents. Those who do not have a tent with them can rent one of the robust furnished tents for a comfortable stay with plenty of sleep. The spacious pitches for a caravan or large tent are located along several narrow streets in the shade. Some pitches offer a view of the water. Motorhome owners can count on a pitch on a paved surface. Always a pleasure!

Cycling, swimming and playing

You don’t have a bike with you, but would still like to explore the beautiful surroundings? Rent one at the campsite. Or a kayak if you prefer a trip on the river. But a swim in the Cher river is also great. If you come camping with children, you can count on a small playground with climbing frames and in the summer months there regularly is a bouncy castle.

Granny in the kitchen

Right next to the campsite is the wooden restaurant À la soupette de Mémère (literally: 'in grandma's kitchen'). On the patio of this relaxing place you can enjoy a delicious meal and a splendid view over the river.

properties.name: Camping La Potinière Onlycamp
properties.description:
In a wonderfully peaceful spot, at the edge of the charming village of Écueillé (in Indre, central France), lies Camping La Potinière Onlycamp. You camp here in a rural area free from mass tourism. The beautiful walking and cycling paths around the campsite and in the nearby nature park can be explored in complete tranquillity.

Pods, safari tents, and spacious campsites

On this authentic and small-scale campsite, you'll find several dozen spacious pitches, separated by hedges. As a touring camper, you can choose your own spot on this open terrain. In addition, there are a few modern safari tents and cosy camping pods available for rent. These accommodations do not have their own sanitary facilities, so if you stay in one, you’ll use the central toilet building.

Picnic by the lake

Just outside the campsite is a lovely lake. A popular spot for many campers, but also a favourite with locals, who come to fish or simply relax. You can enjoy a pleasant picnic on the grass or at one of the picnic tables. An added bonus is the playground next to the lake. On the campsite itself, there is a small shop where you can find cold drinks, local wines, and various basic necessities.

Enjoy peace, natural beauty, and a visit to the zoo

For those seeking peace and nature lovers, Camping La Potinière Onlycamp is an excellent holiday destination. A short drive south takes you to the Parc naturel régional de la Brenne. The campsite is also close to ZooParc de Beauval (22 km), considered one of the most beautiful zoos in the world.

properties.name: Camping Le Petit Port Onlycamp
properties.description:
Camping Le Petit Port Onlycamp is the sort of place where you can unwind straight away. This campsite is situated in the heart of Burgundy, right on the banks of the River Yonne, less than a 2.5-hour drive from Paris. On site, you’ll find a range of facilities at your disposal, including clean toilet and shower blocks and a snack bar. There is plenty to do outside the campsite too, such as cycling along the Canal du Nivernais or visiting one of the surrounding villages.

Dozens of camping pitches and holiday rental accommodations

The campsite has spacious pitches. All of the spots are surrounded by green hedges, ensuring plenty of privacy, and ideal for your tent, caravan or motorhome. Most pitches are equipped with electricity.

Coming without your own camping equipment? Then choose one of the fully equipped mobile homes, a Bengali family tent, a Ponza tent or a Bivak tent on stilts. You can also opt for a tiny house, with two bedrooms, a private kitchen and a toilet.

Everything you might need

The sanitary facilities are modern, hot showers are always available and there is a launderette with washing machines and dryers. Children will have a great time in the playground and at the table tennis table. Fancy a bite to eat? The snack bar has a small menu with snacks and drinks. There is also a convenient bike hire service.

Around the area

Take a boat trip on the Yonne and discover the region from a completely different perspective. There are also all sorts of charming villages in the immediate vicinity. Culture lovers will be in their element here with the many old churches and castles.

properties.name: Camping La Gâtine Onlycamp
properties.description:
This campsite is located on the edge of the French village of Bléré. Right on the banks of the Cher River. Camping La Gâtine Onlycamp is a perfect base for campers who want to discover the castles of the Loire region. The well-known La Loire à vélo cycling route runs right past the campsite, so the campsite is also easily accessible for cyclists. You can enjoy a holiday at the campsite with your own camping equipment, but you can also rent accommodation.

Camping on the Cher

Camping La Gâtine Onlycamp has 210 camping pitches and 11 rental accommodations (safari tents) without private sanitary facilities. The campsite is located directly on the river and has a beach with access to the water. So you can take a refreshing dip in the Cher on hot days! There's also a playground for small children, a table tennis table and various sports activities are organised.

Picturesque French village

Just a stone's throw from the campsite is Bléré, a typical French village with cosy streets and old buildings. The village features a number of small shops, a supermarket, several cafes and restaurants and, of course, an 'Artisan Boulanger' - a bakery where fresh baguettes and croissants are baked daily.

Castles of the Loire

Camping La Gâtine Onlycamp is located in the Loire Valley. This region of France is renowned for the beautiful castles you can visit and explore here. The Chateau Chaumont sur Loire is less than 30 kilometres from the campsite. And Chateau Chenonceau is very close by - just 7 kilometres away. Here you can rent canoes and kayaks and even sail under the castle's gallery.

properties.name: Jogersö Eco Camp
properties.description:
On the east coast of Sweden, slightly south of Oxelösund, you find Jogersö Eco Camp in a private penisula. Off the coast are several large and small islands, making this a very popular water sports area. Oxelösund also has a few marinas. The spaciously laid out campsite is in a well-sheltered location directly by the sea.

Space in abundance

Most pitches are spacious and are part of the large lawn, which forms the centre of the campsite. The sites are attractively laid out, but not demarcated. Jogersø has a rather large number of larger and smaller trekker huts, the largest of which are equipped with a seating area, a TV and a refrigerator. Showers and toilets can be found in the service building. One of the bungalows has a private sauna.

Good restaurant

A special feature of Jogersö Eco Camp is Restaurang Källan, where Chef Conny Steisjö serves very creative dishes made from locally produced, organic ingredients.

Long summer days on the beach

Swedish summers can be very warm. Because of the northern location, the days are long and even the nights not dark. Because the campsite is directly situated by the sea, you can take full advantage of those summer days. You can relax on the long sandy beach with lovely lawn, all the more because the water of the Baltic Sea soon reaches a comfortable temperature. On the beach you will find a jumping tower and a few bathing jetties.

Canoeing and cycling

From the beach you can make wonderful kayaking trips between the islets. You can take longer and short bicycle trips from the campsite . Kayaks and bicycles can be rented from the campsite.

properties.name: Camping De Regenboog / Kemp Sluknov
properties.description:
In the north of the Czech Republic, you will find the Camping De Regenboog / Kemp Sluknov campsite near the village of Šluknov. The campsite is located just five kilometres from the border with Germany, on the edge of the beautiful Bohemian Switzerland nature reserve. Here you will find yourself at a friendly family campsite with a Christian identity (such as a day of rest on Sundays). Those who enjoy being active can go swimming or boating. This is because the campsite borders a vast recreational lake!

Quiet and space

The camping pitches at Camping de Regenboog / Kemp Sluknov are very spacious, giving you all the peace and quiet you need to enjoy yourself. Each pitch is at least 100 m² and suitable for tents, caravans and campervans. A number of rental accommodations are also available, including tents, log cabins and an apartment.

For those looking to cool off

For a refreshing swim, you can go to the recreational lake next to the campsite. You can swim and sail here, but the lake is too deep for children without swimming certificates. But not to worry, there are children's pools set up for the little ones in several areas of the campsite. Camping de Regenboog / Kemp Sluknov is a real family campsite. There is also a playground, beach volleyball court, table tennis table and even an animal pasture. There is a sandwich service and a restaurant with a small menu.

Out and about in the area

In summer, the campsite itself offers an extensive recreation programme and organises excursions based on interest. These include a city trip to Prague and a tour of the Skoda factory in Mladá. For sports enthusiasts and nature lovers, the Bohemian Switzerland National Park is perfect for hiking, cycling and mountain biking. And for a day out with the children, we recommend the Adrenalin Park in Jedlová, a 20-minute drive from the campsite, or the Liberec Zoo, an hour's drive away.

properties.name: Camping Au Fil de l'Eau
properties.description:
The Camping Au Fil de l'Eau campsite is located in Antonne-et-Trigonant, a village in the heart of the Dordogne. This department is known for its many castles, caves and delicious local produce. At the campsite itself, you'll find yourself immersed in greenery, surrounded by meadows and with the River Isle just a stone's throw away. Welcome to a peaceful campsite with a friendly atmosphere!

A place to suit your tastes

The pitches are very green and delineated by hedges. Each pitch has its own story to tell. One offers views of the meadow and grazing cows, the other of the River Isle. And whether you value shade or electricity, at Camping Au Fil de l'Eau, you are guaranteed to find a spot that meets your needs. If renting is more your thing, you can stay in one of the mobile homes. Or how about a luxury bungalow tent or cute Coco Sweet?

Sociability in peace and quiet

Despite the quiet atmosphere, there is no shortage of sociability at Camping Au Fil de l'Eau. For example, markets are organised at the campsite and bands play in the evenings. Children can have fun in the playground or play a game of table football in the games room.

Swimming pool and river

In addition to all this, the campsite has a simple swimming pool that is wonderful in the sun. For more fun in the water, head towards the rear of the campsite where the River Isle flows. This is an ideal place to cast a fishing rod or launch a canoe.

properties.name: Camping Les Philippons
properties.description:
In the area of the gorgeous Côte d’Azur and the famous beach resort of Cannes you will find the well-run campsite Les Philippons. Sophisticated coastal resorts as Saint-Tropez, Antibes and Nice are easy to reach from here. After a day at the beach it is great to spend some time on the campsite, for instance at the nicely designed swimming pool or in the attractive restaurant next to it.

Diverse camping

The wooded terrain with numerous large oaks and century-old olive trees has a natural layout and is located on various elevations. From the higher pitches you have a splendid view of the Esterel Mountains, whereas on the lower pitches it feels like you are camping in beach-like surroundings. The pitches are demarcated in a natural manner and generally sufficiently spacious. The rental accommodation is made up of bungalow tents, holiday bungalows and a villa.

Swimming pool, lake and sea

Although the swimming pool is not very large, it is beautifully shaped and has decorative tiles, plants, loungers and sun umbrellas around it. There is a separate toddler pool and a female supervisor keeps a friendly eye on things. Looking for a larger pool? The idyllic Lac de St.-Cassien is located at a distance of 10 km. Rather head for the Mediterranean Sea? Cannes is 18 km away from the campsite. Théoule-sur-Mer is even closer (thirteen km).

Summer swimming festivals

On the campsite grounds children can enjoy themselves in the swimming pool, at the table tennis table, the table soccer game and the pétanque court. There is a playground for the little ones. Pool parties are held on Wednesday evenings, complete with music and mood lighting and are an unforgettable experience for young and old.

properties.name: Mikkelparken Ferietun
properties.description:
Fruit trees, green valleys, steep rock walls, clear blue water and high mountains. This is the setting for your holiday on Norway's Hardangerfjord. The child-friendly Mikkelparken Ferietun Campsite is located directly on a river in this paradise for lovers of nature, hiking and mountaineering. You can enjoy these surroundings while your children play in the swimming pool. Make the most of your holiday in the beautiful Hardanger region!

In the orchard or by the fjord

You'll be camping in the orchard. The pitches between the trees are spacious but can be tight for large motorhomes. In that case, you can always move to a pitch with a view of the fjord. There are also beautiful tents, apartments and bungalows available for rent.

The numerous sanitary facilities are modern and well maintained. There are also more spacious sanitary facilities especially for families.

From swimming to wilderness trail

You'll meet many (Norwegian) families with children at the campsite. Thanks to its location and surroundings, however, you can also enjoy a wonderful holiday here if you're out and about without children. Nature is your closest neighbour at Mikkelparken Ferietun.

Scandinavian champagne

The area around Husedalen is a popular place to go for a walk. The walking path starts near the campsite and goes along a river. You'll encounter waterfalls all along the way.

The campsite is pure enjoyment as well. The fruit trees you'll be camping among are apple trees. Apple juices and ciders made from Hardanger apples are considered among the best in the world. The Hardanger cider is also known as Scandinavian champagne.

properties.name: Camping Chvalsiny
properties.description:
Camping Chvalšiny is located in the charming village of Chvalšiny (South Bohemia), at the foot of the Blanský les nature reserve, where you can enjoy hiking, cycling, and mountain biking. The campsite is just ten kilometres from the beautiful Český Krumlov. The campsite itself is situated in a peaceful spot and is excellently maintained.

Spacious pitches with panoramic views

The majority of the pitches are tourist pitches. They are spacious, open, and offer a beautiful view over the hilly surroundings. You can also stay in a modern safari tent, a luxury holiday home, or one of the two tiny houses.

What entertainment is available on the campsite itself?

Especially during the high season, this is a popular campsite for families, mostly from Germany and the Netherlands. With three playgrounds, a beach volleyball court, table tennis tables, and a soundproofed disco with a large screen, there is plenty to do. There is also a proper pizza oven where you can bake your own pizzas with fellow campers during the summer holidays. Other fun activities include smoking trout, feeding animals at the petting farm, survival trails, baking bread, and chatting around the campfire. Additionally, there is a cosy bistro and a beautiful outdoor pool.

Attention sports enthusiasts and adventurers!

For nature lovers, this campsite has a stunning location at the foot of Blanský les. This nature reserve offers numerous trails for hikers, cyclists, and mountain bikers. Additionally, there are several spots near the campsite where you can go rafting or canoeing. Lastly, you’ll be camping less than half an hour’s drive from Lake Lipno, with plenty of opportunities for kayaking, boating, surfing, and fishing.

properties.name: Capfun Camping Plage des Tonnelles
properties.description:
Campsite Plage de Tonnelles is located approximately three hundred metres from the Atlantic Ocean, in the north-west of the Vendée. Here you camp on a typical beach campsite, on a sloping property in a forest. Campers come here primarily for the lovely nature. On the campsite, you'll enjoy a swimming pool, sauna, entertainment team, sports fields, snack bar and well-tended sanitation facilities.

Camping and renting

At the campsite Plage des Tonnelles-Dornier, you camp on nice, spacious camping pitches. There are about two hundred touring pitches (70-110 m²). There are also thirty permanent annual pitches. If you don't have your own camping equipment, you can rent one of the 250 rental accommodations: mobile homes, bungalows, lodge tents and chalets. The lodge tents (150) are by far the majority. Most have bathrooms.

Fun in the water

There is a large outdoor swimming pool (heated) in a sunny location. It is 288 m². The toddler pool is also not small with 60 m². Looking for the ultimate fun in the water? Walk from the campsite to the dunes and beach and jump into the sea. When you return to the campsite you can relax in the jacuzzi or the sauna.

Entertainment for the whole family

The mini club provides activity for the littlest campers in the morning and afternoon. But there is also an activity programme for teenagers and adults. Various workshops are held and games played. The dance evenings and musical performances are also popular. Sports fans can work up a sweat on thee multi-sports field (football, basketball, handball) or play a round of table tennis, mini golf or jeu de boules.

properties.name: Camping Rijsterbos
properties.description:
Camping Rijsterbos is an ideal campsite for families with children. There is no need to get bored on this campsite, because there is always something to do for everyone. The entertainment team will take care of that! On and around the campsite there are all kinds of sports and play options such as mini golf, fishing, swimming and much more. In bad weather children can do crafts in the youth centre.

Wooded campsite

Camping Rijsterbos lies directly on the edge of the woods with the same name. The pitches are reasonably spacious and numbered, but not demarcated. Each pitch has its own water and electricity connection. A limited number of pitches have rental private sanitary facilities. The campsite has a small swimming pool on the boundary of the campsite.

Unique woodland

Rijs is located on the edge of the Rijsterbos and close to the IJsselmeer. The woodland, measuring a total of 72 ha, was planted in the seventeenth century and today consists of a diverse deciduous woodland with numerous old oaks and beeches. The woodland is a unique spot for birds, who use the Rijsterbos as resting place on their migration route. The badger is also a permanent resident and has a number of setts in the area.

properties.name: Camping Neumühle
properties.description:
Slightly north of Ermsdorf, a village of less than four hundred inhabitants, you will find the terraced campsite Camping Neumühle. Here you are camping between trees and bushes on some five terraces. There is no reason to get bored on this four-star campsite: there is ample amusement for all with a swimming pool and sports field

Camping on terraces

Most pitches on Camping Neumühle are fully or partly demarcated with hedges. You will reach your pitch via paved roads. The pitches all have a grass surface. You have a choice of pitches with a lot or little shade. In addition to some one hundred pitches for your own tent, caravan, motorhome or trailer tent, there are also a few luxury rental accommodation units available. The boundary of the campsite offers a beautiful view.

Cooling off in the swimming pool and get sporty

There is a modest size swimming pool (50 m2) on the campsite where you can cool off. Another possibility is to wade through the brook running alongside the campsite.

You can play sports on the football pitch. Table tennis and bowling are also available at Neumühle campsite. Looking for an original activity? Then try geocaching, an outdoor game where a hidden treasure must be found using GPS or a phone.

Affordable bistro and bread

On the camping grounds is a bistro with a limited menu. They serve basic, but tasty dishes. From the restaurant and covered terrace you have a good view of the swimming pool. The snack bar is open during July and August. You can buy a snack here when you are peckish after a swim or playing sports.

properties.name: HOCHoben camp & explore
properties.description:
If you prefer spending holidays in the middle of the countryside, far from motorways and urban bustle, HOCHoben camp & explore is the ideal destination. This campsite is in the village of Mallnitz in the Austrian state of Carinthia. Here, you camp in Tauerntal, in Hohe Tauern National Park. This is known as the most beautiful natural walking areas in the Alps. People who love challenging mountain walks will enjoy themselves to the full here, though it's also a wonderful place for cycling, mountain biking, paragliding, rafting and wakeboarding. The campsite itself is still new. So, all facilities are still in immaculate condition. You can enjoy a wonderful view of the surrounding mountains from your pitch.

Book a large camping pitch or stay in a luxury chalet

This campsite is mainly dominated by tourist pitches. The touring pitches differ considerably in size. If you would like to book a large pitch at HOCHoben camp & explore, go for a Stellplatz Edelweiss. Besides a camping pitch, you can also hire a mobile home or luxury chalet at HOCHoben camp & explore.

Go for an enjoyable swim in Tauernbad Mallnitz

If you want to go swimming for an afternoon during your stay at this campsite, you can go to Mallnitz. The lovely Tauernbad Mallnitz outdoor swimming pool is on the north side of this village. This swimming pool is a 10-minute walk from HOCHoben camp & explore. Besides a large leisure pool, it also has a fun slide, a hot tub, paddling pool and a sauna.

properties.name: First Camp Sjöstugan
properties.description:
First Camp Sjöstugan is situated on a promontory jutting into a large lake (Möckeln) in the south of Sweden. On this family campsite you may choose your own spot on the lake shore. You camp here amidst nature: on grass under trees, with a splendid view of the water. In the nearby town of Älmhult, the first IKEA store was opened in 1958. Nowadays, there is an IKEA museum here.

Amidst greenery

First Camp Sjöstugan is attractively located on a wooded promontory. You camp here on grass under tall trees. The site slopes and has substantial height differences. There are no demarcated pitches. If you arrive early in the day, you are likely to have a wide choice of pitches. If you get there a bit later, chances are that you will stand on a less level pitch. Make sure you bring adequate tools to level your camping equipment.

Terrace by the water

The campsite offers a variety of catering facilities, including a beautiful restaurant directly by the water. The view from the conservatory and the terrace is spectacular. 

Beaches and islands

Möckeln is a large lake which lends itself perfectly to various watersports. Furthermore, it is an ideal spot for fishing. Along the wooded banks of the lake there are numerous jetties, pebble beaches and sandy beaches. The campsite has its own beach with a jetty and beach showers. You can hire canoes, kayaks and rowing boats to explore the lake. Tip: pack some food and sail to one of the many islands for a picnic. Adjacent to the campsite is Bökhults Badplats, a public beach which is very popular with swimmers.

properties.name: First Camp Orsa
properties.description:
First Camp Orsa is situated in the town of Orsa. It forms an ideal base because of its location at Lake Orsasjön, a spur of the popular Siljan Lake. This part of Dalarna has much to offer the tourist: natural beauty and many attractions such as museums.

This large campsite is easy to reach from the E45; when you come from Mora, turn left at the first traffic circle and drive through the village, where road signs will send you in the right direction. You will be assisted by helpful staff members in the sleek and businesslike reception. The same building also houses a restaurant and a bowling alley. The spacious pitches (637 with electricity) are laid out along dirt roads and between trees. Most of the pitches offer a view of the lake.

A hut or a cottage?

The large campsite has a large number of holiday cottages in the shape of solid log cabins with all amenities, such as a private shower/toilet and fireplace. They are suitable for four to six persons. These cabins form their own neighbourhood on the campsite. You can also rent mobile homes. They have three bedrooms with two beds each, own shower/toilet and a fully equipped kitchen.

properties.name: First Camp Moraparken-Dalarna
properties.description:
The town of Mora lies in the heart of the tourist province of Dalarna, on Lake Siljan. First Camp Mora Parken lies adjacent to the town centre and on the banks of the Österdalälven River. It is a large but friendly campsite with many spacious pitches, nice cottages and ample play opportunities for young and old. Because of its proximity to the town, it is also in an excellent location when the weather is unfavourable. The campsite is really ideal as a base for the many attractions in the area.

Rental accommodations

The pitches are partly paved and partly covered with grass. The grounds are large and very diverse with trekker huts spread throughout the site. Some of these huts look like traditional sheds and have rather basic furniture. They have no shower or toilet. In addition, the campsite has two luxury semi-detached apartments with all amenities (TV, fully-equipped kitchen and private shower/toilet).

Camping shop

The camping shop stocks the essential foodstuffs, but there are some large supermarkets within walking distance in the centre of Mora.

Heroic ski race

Mora is known mainly as the finish for the Vasaloppet, a cross-country ski race over 90 kilometres from Sälen to Mora, which takes place each year on the first Sunday in March. During the week preceding this day several races are held. The course transverses the camping grounds.

properties.name: First Camp Röstånga-Söderåsen
properties.description:
If you are looking for a family campiste in Sweden, First Camp Röstånga- Söderåsen is an excellent choice. Not only can you enjoy the impressive Swedish countryside here in the summer holiday but also the wonderful outdoor swimming pool with slide. Go kayaking or fishing in the lake or take a lovely boat ride through Söderåsen National Park.

Pick your own pitch

There are a total of 190 camping pitches and 29 huts. When you book, you can choose your own camping pitch: close to the swimming pool or in a quiet spot on the edge of the forest. Dogs are more than welcome at this campsite. The toilet and washing facilities have been renovated and, besides showers and toilets, you will also find a kitchen with a microwave, fridge, freezer and dishwasher.

Eat out at the campsite

The bistro at the campsite is open in the high season, from June to late August. You can go here for a tasty snack or meal. You can also buy fresh sandwiches at the campsite and more groceries are available in the summer. There is a larger supermarket in Röstånga.

Plenty of fun in the water

The swimming pool is big and has a water slide. It guarantees fun for the children, but adults can also swim laps here. Furthermore, there is plenty of entertainment for the whole family. The swimming pool and bouncy castle are of course popular, but you can also hire canoes, bikes, go fishing in the lake or play a game of table tennis or miniature golf.

properties.name: First Camp Västerås-Mälaren
properties.description:
The lovely First Camp Västerås-Mälaren campsite is on the outskirts of the charming city of Västerås by Lake Malar. Here, you combine the spacious Swedish feel of camping by a lake, with lovely outings to lively cities such as Stockholm. Discover the lovely beaches around the lake and on the islands and enjoy the enchanting sunsets.

Spacious waterfront campsite

When you come onto the site, you instantly see that it's a spaciously laid out campsite. With roughly 260 pitches and about 30 chalets and hiker's cabins, there is plenty of choice for your overnight stay. There are also 60 pitches for regular guests. The site is divided into various fields with paved paths. All the pitches are spacious and the toilet and washing facilities are neat and quite new.

In the countryside and yet central

The campsite attracts a varied public including families, seniors and water enthusiasts, who come for the beautiful setting by Lake Malar. The campsite is in a reasonably central location, on the outskirts of the city of Västeräs, which is a 15-minute cycle ride away. And yet, it offers more than a purely countryside experience. You can take a boat to the various forested islands, where you will find beautiful swimming beaches. Ideal for summer days!

Kayaks, sauna and ‘fika’

The campsite offers excellent facilities and there is plenty to do for young and old. There is a miniature golf course, and you can join in with sports lessons in the summer. There is a great playground for the children and, like at many Swedish campsites, a sauna too. You can hire canoes and kayaks to explore the lake.

properties.name: Agricampeggio Da Scarpa
properties.description:
At the tip of the Cavallino-Treporti peninsula, amidst agriculture and horticulture, lies Agricampeggio Da Scarpa. This small, quiet farm campsite near Punta Sabbioni has a campsite in the orchard. You camp in the green, between the fruit trees. The campsite is five hundred metres from the beach and is the perfect base for visiting Venice.

In the orchard

Agricampeggio Da Scarpa is an agriturismo: a campsite near a farm. The Da Scarpa family runs an agricultural and horticultural business. The campsite, simple and small-scale, is situated next to the farm in the orchard. There are 24 small pitches laid out on the grass, in the shade of the deciduous trees.

Within walking distance of the beach

There is no swimming pool on the campsite, but five hundred metres away you will find the sea and the beach. The Cavallino-Treporti peninsula is about fifteen kilometres long and lies between the Adriatic Sea and the Venice lagoon. A wide (public) sandy beach stretches along its entire length. The sea remains shallow for a long time and is therefore ideal for small children. In ten minutes you can walk to the beach.

Freshly harvested

This family that manages the campsite is extremely hospitable. They love to share their love for the land with their guests. Agricampeggio Da Scarpa has a farm shop where you can buy delicious fresh fruit and vegetables. Everything is home-grown. In the shop you will also find some basic necessities for campers.

In the taverna you can have breakfast in the morning. If you book in advance, you can visit Locanda Scarpa in the evening for a traditional Venetian dinner.

properties.name: Killarney Flesk Caravan Park
properties.description:
Killarney Flesk Caravan Park is located on the outskirts of the popular town of Killarney in county Kerry. Despite being a real town campsite, the site exudes peace and quiet. The campsite is located where town and nature meet. With the Killarney National Park as backdrop, the campsite is very popular with nature lovers, walkers and cyclists alike. Discover the rugged mountains and lakes of the park and County Kerry, or visit the lively pubs in Killarney.

Quiet town campsite

Killarney Flesk Caravan Park is a town campsite, fairly close to the built-up area. Yet it is very peaceful. As the campsite is not located along the road, the traffic noise does not reach your pitch. You camp here on grass fields or a hardened surface, with the mountains of Killarney National Park in the background.

Indoor swimming pool

Adjacent to the campsite you will find an indoor swimming pool and other sports facilities. Perfect for swimming a few lengths or to work up a sweat. You have to pay an entrance fee for the swimming pool.

Ring of Kerry

Killarney is located on The Ring of Kerry, an (auto)route of some two hundred km which leads you through the most beautiful natural areas and along the rugged coast with its steep cliffs. An absolute must if you want to explore the splendour of the south of Ireland.

Pubs and restaurants

Next to the campsite is a restaurant, but tourist-oriented Killarney also has an abundance of eateries. And of course, the lively pubs are well worth a visit as well. With its charming colourful streets, Killarney has an authentic Irish look.

properties.name: Camping Smeraldo
properties.description:
The Italian Ligurian coast is known for the colourful villages of Cinque Terre, picturesquely positioned against the rocks above the sea. On that same steep coast, Camping Smeraldo is located on a rocky ridge above the clear blue water. Camping Smeraldo is a unique place for the somewhat adventurous campsite visitor. Once you have reached the place with your tent or motorhome, a special stay awaits you with the sea, beach and mountains playing a major role. You can also book a bungalow or apartment at this dream location.

A tunnel through the rocks to the campsite

You access the campsite in a unique way, namely, via a tunnel through the rocky coast. At one time, steam trains rode through this tunnel – now, you drive through it in your car. Although it is only possible for traffic to travel in one direction, this changes every twenty minutes, making your waiting time a maximum of twenty minutes.

The campsite is not suitable for very large recreational vehicles because of the width of the tunnel and the rocky terraces on which the pitches are located. Tent pitches are 4x4 metres and equipped with a shade sail. The pitches are paved, and all have a view of the sea. This also applies for the charming bungalows and apartments.

Sun, sea and beach

Camping Smeraldo is a perfect spot for those who love the sea and the beach. You can rent stand up paddleboards and canoes at the campsite. You walk from your tent straight to the pebble beach. Beach lounges are available for rent for wonderful long days by the water. The toilet blocks have both sitting and squatting toilets.

properties.name: First Camp Hagön-Halmstad
properties.description:
Looking for the perfect combination of sea, nature and city for your holiday? Then First Camp Hagön-Halmstad is the place for you! At this campsite, the beach and the sea are your closest neighbours. And the cosy city of Halmstad, with its many shops and restaurants, is just 6 kilometres away. You'll be camping between beautiful green dunes. Your children can enjoy themselves both in and outside the campsite. This place offers an ideal base for hiking and cycling trips, beach days and city visits all year round.

From tent to hiker's cabin

First Camp Hagön-Halmstad is a large campsite with 550 touring pitches, 170 of which are permanent pitches. The pitches are between 80 and 100 m² in size. Caravans, motorhomes and tents are all welcome.

Do you not have your own camping equipment but would still like to spend your holiday in this special place? Then you can rent a bungalow. The campsite also has a number of hikers' cabins.

Beach and sea as your closest neighbours

You can walk to the beach after enjoying your breakfast in the morning. This beach is 7 kilometres long. Your children can play there while you enjoy the view of the sea. There are also plenty of things to do at the campsite. Have fun on the mini golf course or play a game of pétanque. Children have a lot of fun on the playground and on the bouncy castle.

Evening out

Don't feel like cooking yourself? You can also visit First Camp Hagön-Halmstad for a night out. You can enjoy pizzas and more in the bistro restaurant.

properties.name: First Camp Björkäng-Varberg
properties.description:
The Swedish province of Halland is a mix of sandy beaches and forests. At First Camp Björkäng-Varberg, the forest and beach are within arm's reach. The campsite is just behind the dune area, at 50-metres walk from a child-friendly beach. Campers describe this campsite as quiet but with enough facilities and entertainment in the high season.

Good toilet and washing facilities

First Camp Björkäng-Vabeg is a campsite with both camping pitches as well as accommodation for hire. Here, you camp on grass and the pitches vary from between 80 to 100 m2. All camping pitches have electricity. Campers describe the toilet and washing facilities as modern and clean.

Facilities at the campsite

There are plenty of facilities at the campsite to keep you occupied. Challenge each other on the miniature golf course or play a game of padel. There is a playground for the youngest campsite guests, with a bouncy castle.

You can buy basic products, such as snacks and sandwiches from the small supermarket at the campsite. Or end the day with a bite to eat in the campsite's restaurant.

Explore the surrounding area

Camping First Camp Björkäng-Varberg is in the province of Halland. The province is ideal for long walks and bike rides. And the coastal area is a Valhalla for surfers. The nature reserve, Utteros Naturreservat, is right next to the campsite and where you can go for lovely walks.

Day in Varberg

The small city of Varberg is about 15 kilometres from the campsite. This harbour region has a fort from the 13th century with the Halland Museum of Cultural History. The city is also known for its wellness centre.

properties.name: Camping Baia San Nicola
properties.description:
Camping Baia San Nicola is close to the Italian coastal resort of Peschici, on the mountainous peninsula of Gargano (Apulia region). Gargano, also called the 'spur on the Italian boot' is known for its rugged, rocky coastline. There are also many sandy beaches on the coast. This quiet family campsite is in the Baia di San Nicola bay. Here, you camp on a shaded site with many height differences. You can walk straight onto the beach from your camping pitch.

Book a shaded touring pitch

On entering the campsite, you need to drive a little further to reception. It is about 100 metres on the left by the bar. There, the Mastromatteo family welcomes new campers. Here, you camp on a lovely pitch in the shade of the centuries-old pine trees on the site. You are more than welcome to bring your dog to Camping Baia San Nicola; they are allowed and for free as well. If you like a bit more luxury, pick one of the apartments.

Ideal for beach lovers

The campsite's location is ideal for beach lovers. You can walk straight onto the beach from the campsite. Partly thanks to the wicker parasols, you feel like you are on a tropical island. From the campsite, if you walk a short distance along the beach, you will reach Ristorante La Paranza Da Lina. This colourful restaurant with a lovely patio also belongs to the campsite. Here you can, for example, enjoy the fish specialities from the menu while looking out over the sea.

properties.name: Campingplatz Wetzlar
properties.description:
A holiday amongst hills, vast forests and budding mountains. Who wouldn't want that? Especially if you're camping within walking distance of a lovely river. This ideal becomes reality at Campingplatz Wetzlar in the German state of Hesse. This campsite is located on the Lahn River. That means you'll enjoy a camping holiday full of fun water recreation activities. You'll find the perfect combination of relaxation and recreation in the Lahn Valley. From a relaxing day at the river to cycling and canoeing trips. And you can be in the old centre of Wetzlar (3 km) within just 10 minutes.

From tent to bungalow

You'll be camping on an expansive lawn and can choose from pitches in the sun or in the shade. The pitches vary from 50 to 80 m². Campingplatz Wetzlar has a number of rental accommodations to choose from if you don't have your own camping equipment. These include caravans, bungalows and a tipi tent.

Enjoy floating on the water

The campsite's location on the Lahn River is ideal. You can get from your camping pitch to the water in no time. Your children will enjoy playing in the water or on the beach. The river is also ideal for a kayaking, canoeing or supping trips. Kayaks and canoes are available for rent at the front desk.

Not a water rat? Then you can enjoy hiking and cycling in the area. A cycle path runs directly past the campsite to Wetzlar. Do you enjoy fishing? You can also do this near the campsite. You can buy a fishing license for a day at the reception.

properties.name: Camping Waldberg
properties.description:
This stunning UNESCO Rhön Biosphere Reserve is in the border area of the states of Beieren, Hessen and Thüringen, in the centre of Germany. This low mountain range has large, forested areas, vast valley meadows and tree-less mountain peaks. Camping Waldberg has been erected on the sunny side of the Kreuzberg on a site with old trees and two idyllic streams. This quietly located campsite is ideal for nature lovers. Explore the unspoiled nature of the Rhön on foot or on a mountain bike.

Pick your own pitch at this natural campsite

What all the pitches at Camping Waldberg have in common is that they are all level and on grass. Furthermore, all touring pitches are unique and situated in the countryside. There are lovely pitches by the streams, but you can also camp at a shaded pitch on the edge of the forest. Or pick a pitch with views of the Kreuzberg.

Sample local delicacies in the beer garden and restaurant

When you return to the campsite after a day of walking or mountain bike riding, you can enjoy a delicious Privatbrauerei Strecks beer in the Biergarten. Other drinks are available too, of course. The campsite also has a café, a lounge and a restaurant, where the smoked trout is the house speciality. You can order fresh bread daily in the café.

There is also a small shop at the campsite. You can go to Wildflecken and Bischofsheim in der Rhön for more extensive grocery shopping. These towns are about a 15-minute drive from the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Ouranoupoli
properties.description:
Camping Ouranoupoli is situated directly by the sea, along the access road to the Mount Athos peninsula, which is part of the larger Halkidiki peninsula. The Mount Athos peninsula is a monastic republic, an autonomous area which is only accessible to men. The village of Ouranopoli is within walking distance of the campsite.

Crystal-clear seawater

The campsite grounds are well-maintained and look neat and tidy. The campsite is situated directly by the beach so that you can fully enjoy the sandy beach and the crystal-clear water.

Well-maintained pitches

The pitches are of average size and many have a sunshade. The pathways are paved and the pitches are situated on grass. Luxury caravans by the beach as well as luxury bungalows and apartments are available for rent. In the peak season, the permanent pitches are occupied by Greek and Bulgarian families, and tourists from Eastern and Western Europe come and stay here. In the low season, Greek and Bulgarian families come and stay on the weekends, and there are also many seniors from Western Europe.

Traditional Greek food

The shop has a limited range of basic supplies and local produce such as wine and olive oil. The charming restaurant is located directly on the beach and has a fine menu with traditional Greek dishes. The sanitary facilities are located centrally on the campsite, and they are well-maintained and clean. There are facilities available for the disabled.

Monastery cruise

Taking a cruise from Ouranoupoli along the Athos coast to see the monasteries is a must.

properties.name: Schwimmbad Camp. Mössler
properties.description:
At a distance of 500 m from the Millstätter See lies Schwimmbad Camping Mössler. Amidst mountains, forests and green meadows, this campsite is well suited for nature lovers. You can walk directly to the lake from the campsite. Camping on this beautifully laid out campsite is a real party. The campsite is located in a valley, close to a beautiful lake and you can get to one of the many attractive villages in the area in no time at all.

The camping pitches offer ample privacy and shade. You are warmly welcomed at the campsite by the owners. The central point on the campsite is without a doubt the beautiful and well maintained swimming pool where you can take a refreshing dive on a summer's day. Each Tuesday evening there is a market in the town of Döbriach, which is within easy walking distance. Towns like Villach and Klagenfurt are easily reached by car.

Lake and swimming pool

As the name suggests, at Schwimmbad Camping Mössler there is no lack of water. The large heated swimming pool, located near the reception, is made entirely of stainless steel and therefore easy to keep clean. Just outside the campsite you will find the Millstätter See, a large lake with numerous water sports possibilities and beaches. There is a jetty for boat owners where you can moor your own boat during your stay on the campsite.

The restaurant is located near the reception, where you will also find the supermarket. You can sit outside at long wooden tables, while tasty dishes are served. The speciality is the Mösslers Geheimnis (Mössler's Secret).

properties.name: Camping Beau Rivage
properties.description:
Between the medieval villages, castles and caves of the Perigord Noir lies Camping Beau Rivage. Rent a kayak or canoe and paddle down the Dordogne, go for a swim in the swimming pool or sing your favourite song during karaoke night.

Pitch your tent among the trees or in the sun

Camping Beau Rivage is a large but peaceful campsite. You will notice this as you drive to your camping pitch. Choose a pitch on the grass in the sun or in the shade of the broad-leaved trees. Did you come without camping equipment? In that case, there are various mobile homes or furnished tents with a terrace available for rent. 

Canoeing on the Dordogne

At the campsite, you meet many campers who have brought along their own boat. You can explore the region not only by land, but also by travelling down the Dordogne river. At Beau Rivage, you can rent a kayak or canoe for a daytrip down the river.

Dive in the sunny swimming pool

Besides access to the river, there is also a heated swimming pool, centrally situated at the campsite on a sunny location. The poolside parasols and loungers also offer the necessary shade when you need it. From the swimming pool, you have a view of the tennis courts, which are free to use for campsite guests during the low season. 

Karaoke and concerts

In July and August, our French-speaking entertainment team organises fun evenings with karaoke, concerts and sports events. Children between the ages of three and twelve will have the most wonderful adventures in l'Amigo Club. Together with our mascot, Amigo the snail, they can do crafts, join in an exciting treasure hunt, or dance with their new friends at the children's disco.

properties.name: Camping U Farniente Pertamina
properties.description:
This typical family camp site has a large outdoor pool and is a fifteen minute drive away from iconic Bonifacio. Between oleanders and olive trees: that is where you will find camping U Farniente Pertamina. When you drive towards the camping, you will observe how green the south of Corsica is as well as the natural setting of the site. The site has two sections. At U Farniente you will find camping pitches and a few mobile homes while Pertamina has the majority of the rental accommodations. The large and attractive coastal town of Bonifacio is a mere 15 minute drive away. Here you can admire the impressive white cliffs or enjoy a bite to eat or a drink. 

Camping under the trees

Camping U Farniente Pertamina offers something for everyone. Whether you like camping in your tent between the trees or enjoy a bit more luxury, this camping has it all. The pitches are generously spaced and have sufficient shade. You also have a choice of renting mobile homes, chalets, apartments or even small villas. Accommodation is available in various sizes. The maximum number of persons is six.

There is no time to get bored...

... as there is always something going on at camping U Farniente Pertamina . Are you a sports enthusiast? Then sport tournaments, a game of volleyball or line dancing may be just up your street. Fans of the water can reach the beach from the camp site in a mere 15 minutes. At the beach are kayaking, diving and jet-skiing facilities, but a lazy afternoon on the beach is also an option, of course. Each night there are various performances and theme evenings which you can participate in, such as an 80s evening or white party or socialising at the lounge bar.

properties.name: Zvíkov Village Kemp
properties.description:
Zvíkov Village Kemp is in the South Bohemian Region of the Czech Republic, where the Moldau and Otava rivers converge. At this campsite, close to the historical Zvíkov Castle (650 m), you camp with panoramic views of the bridge over the Otava. The wooden cottages make you feel like you are in a Scandinavian village, surrounded by stunning countryside with many walking and cycling paths. Visit the surrounding villages or stunning Prague for a cultural excursion.

Camping in a Scandinavian atmosphere

First impressions of Zvíkov Village Kemp are of a well-maintained, new campsite where you encounter the Scandinavian-style all over. Here, you camp on spacious pitches suitable for tents, motorhomes and caravans. If you don’t have your own camping equipment, book one of the luxury wooden chalets or cottages.

More than basic amenities

The campsite's most impressive amenity is the natural swimming pool with a landscaped sandy beach. It is surrounded by wooden pods, so a refreshing swim is within arm's reach from these rental accommodation.

The campsite also has new, modern toilet and washing facilities. The saunas add to the feeling of Scandinavian comfort. Worked up an appetite? Visit the campsite restaurant with patio, including a lovely view of River Otava.

Forest and mountains, village and city

Take your walking shoes with you because the immediate vicinity is rich in natural beauty. If you would prefer an excursion in civilisation, visit Pisek (15 km) or Orlik Castle (16 km). Or go to Prague, the lively capital city of the Czech Republic.

properties.name: Camping Villaggio dei Fiori
properties.description:
In San Remo, on the Italian coast, the jet set once used to paint the town. Those days are now long gone, but you can still have a taste of the good life. Especially when you camp at Camping Villagio dei Fiori. This campsite is located just two kilometres from San Remo. On the campsite itself, all sorts of tropical trees provide the necessary shade. The free WiFi, the sea water swimming pool and the facilities all ensure a fine camping holiday.

Swimming in sea water

All the pitches are level on this terraced campsite. The paved paths are surrounded by lush greenery. Eucalyptus trees, banana trees, palm trees, pines and ficus plants provide colour and a pleasant Mediterranean atmosphere. The swimming pool and the adjacent paddling pool are filled with sea water. If things get too crowded here, walk over a narrow road past rock formations to the private beach for a dip in the sea. 

Gastronomic enjoyment

The restaurant, made from wood and glass, is new. It has two floors and is surrounded by greenery. On the top floor, relax and enjoy a drink while you savour the breathtaking view of the sea. The menu features various regional and local dishes. Take-away meals are also available. 

Amateur chefs take note: a supermarket lies three hundred metres away from Camping Villagio dei Fiori. Here, you can find everything you need for a delicious meal.

Entertainment for the whole family

The camping grounds features a fun playground with plastic play equipment for the children. There is a special mini club for the smallest campers. And the entire family can join in the many activities which are organised by the campsite.

properties.name: Camping U Casone
properties.description:
If you are looking to camp on the Corsican coast, head to the U Casone campsite. It is located on the Costa Serena in eastern Corsica. A ten-minute walk takes you to the beach on the Mediterranean. Time for a swim! Prefer to stay at the campsite? No problem. You can also happily spend the whole day by the pool. If you’re feeling a bit peckish, simply take a seat at the poolside café.

Luxury lodge tents

One hundred spacious pitches are spread across the grounds of the U Casone campsite. You will be camping on lovely grassy pitches. While most of the spots do not have much shade, there are a few tall trees, particularly at the back of the site. If you pitch your tent there, you can enjoy camping in the shade. If you fancy a bit of luxury, camp in one of the eco-lodge tents. These spacious tents have virtually everything you need: a private kitchenette, furniture, comfortable beds and a large terrace.

Take a swim with mountain views

You can admire the mountain views while you swim at the U Casone campsite, although the pool is mainly intended for a refreshing dip. In the evening, the pool is beautifully lit up so you can enjoy a nice, long swim.

Dining by the pool

Another advantage of lingering at the pool for a while is the campsite restaurant. Located in the fresh air right next to the pool, it's the perfect spot to enjoy a meal. After a swim, you can relax in the outdoor area. It’s a lovely spot for a leisurely meal, especially in the evening. The illuminated pool adds to the atmosphere.

properties.name: Førde Gjestehus og Camping
properties.description:
At the beginning of the Sunnfjord, in the westernmost part of Norway, lies the small town of Førde. On the outskirts of Førde you will find the quietly situated Førde Gjestehus og Campsite. The location is perfect and the campsite can easily be reached from the E39. Because of its proximity to the town, the sights are at walking distance. The campsite of Førde forms an ideal departure point for expeditions in the beautiful world of ‘fjord and fjell’, the fjords and mountains of Norway.

Førde Gjestehus og Camping is directly situated on the Jølstra river, which flows from the mountains into the fjord. The turbulent water is extremely suitable for challenging rafting trips. You can go on forest walks from the campsite. The campsite grounds are flat with paved, spacious pitches for campers and caravans. There is also a grassed area where you can pitch your tent.

Rental accommodation for all

The reception is situated in the main building, where you can also rent rooms, apartments and conference rooms. It goes without saying that this Scandinavian campsite also offers rental accommodation such as hikers huts/holiday bungalows, from basic to luxury. In the communal kitchen you can use the oven and microwave to prepare your meals.

Activities in the area

Førde has a few museums, including the Sogn of Fjordane Kunst Museum and the regional museum Sunnfjordmuseum. Furthermore, the Førdehus in town houses a large, indoor swimming pool with separate children's pool, a 38 m high climbing wall, a bowling alley, a cinema and a library. Perfect for rainy days.

properties.name: Camping Vallée de l'Our
properties.description:
Camping Vallée de l’Our is located in the beautiful hilly landscape of the Luxembourg Ardennes, near the German border. The campsite setting is quiet and natural along the Our river and is ideal for nature lovers and those seeking peace and quiet. With a wide range of pitches and modern accommodations, as well as extensive amenities such as a care, dog park and sports facilities, Camping Vallée de l’Our guarantees a relaxed and varied stay for young and old.

Pitches and comfortable accommodations

There are various pitches for tents, caravans and motorhomes. Choose a pitch by the river for a panoramic view of the water or a protected pitch with lots of shade from the trees. All pitches have an electricity connection and vary in size (small with 50 m2, average with 100-110 m2 and large with 120-140 m2). For extra comfort, fully furnished accommodations are also available, which means you stay in a modern mobile home or safari tent with its own terrace, comfortable beds, a kitchen and bathroom. Ideal for families or couples who want to experience camping life without sacrificing comfort.

Charming cafe, playground and dog park

Camping Vallée de l’Our has extensive amenities that contribute to a carefree stay. The campsite shop carries daily shopping and fresh rolls in the morning. The charming cafe provides an attractive place to relax and meet up, and has a menu filled with local specialities and snacks. For relaxation and fun, play a game of darts, with the children in the playground and on the playing field.

properties.name: Stadscamping Deventer
properties.description:
At Stadscamping Deventer you stay on a green small-scale campsite along the IJssel River. The grounds offer a view of the centuries-old Hanseatic town of Deventer. The campsite is fairly standard, but offers good facilities and spacious, well maintained pitches. Freedom and happiness prevail on this quiet site close to town. A small ferry next to the campsite will take you quickly across the IJssel to the historic centre of the town. In the vicinity of Deventer you can take lovely walking and cycling trips.

Choose your own pitch

You can choose your own pitch on the campsite, which stretches over its full length along the IJssel River. All pitches are well maintained and you can choose between pitches with shade or with more sun. The sanitary facilities behind the reception are somewhat dated, but well maintained and clean. At the back of the field you also find a lavatory truck to reduce the distance to the toilets for this section of the campsite.

Freedom and happiness

The campsite is popular with visitors who want to visit the town of Deventer and environs. The number of camper vans is relatively high. Pitches are almost always available and most of the time there is no need to book in advance. However, reservations are recommended during larger events, such as the book market (August) or the Dickens festival (December).

Sandy beaches and small ferry next to the campsite

Right next to the campsite is a lovely sandy beach on the IJssel River. Ideal for swimming. It is a unique site with a view of the historic centre of the town, dominated by the Grote Kerk. The ferry to the centre of Deventer departs next to the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Grandes Jorasses
properties.description:
Camping Grandes Jorasses is located in the Val Ferret (North Italian Valle d’Aosta region), in the vicinity of the village of Entrèves. Here you find yourself in an Alpine paradise at the foot of the Grandes Jorasses, a mountain range with peaks of over 4000 m in the northern part of the Mont Blanc Massif. From the campsite, you have a lovely view of the Mont Blanc, the highest peak of the Alps.

Alpine campsite

The campsite which lies against a slope, mostly under spruce, has a lovely ambiance. Everything looks well-maintained and the campsite exudes an authentic alpine atmosphere with its reception in chalet style and its rustic wooden bungalows. The hilly terrain is somewhat difficult to negotiate and the pitches, although beautifully laid out, are not very spacious. The rental accommodation units have a cosy appearance.

Mountain hiking paradise

Valle d’Aosta, in the extreme north-west of Italy, is officially a dual-language region, where both Italian and French are spoken. You are only a stone's throw away from the French border and the Mont Blanc tunnel, which ends near well-known Chamonix. The surroundings of the campsite are characterised by high mountains and deeply incised valleys. 

The campsite is modest in terms of facilities. The reception also serves as a restaurant, campsite shop and bar. The restaurant is amicable and the service is friendly and accessible. The owner's wife is an excellent cook and bakes fantastic pizzas, which go down well after a day in the mountain air.

Sanitary facilities

The sanitary facilities are modest but are kept very clean.

properties.name: Camping Penhoat Côté Plage
properties.description:
Vamping Penhoat Côté Plage is located in the south of Finistère, on the coast of Brittany. You camp here three hundred metres from the Atlantic Ocean. Get ready for a real camping holiday by the sea: get a breath of fresh air on the beach, swim in a clean sea and taste paella. The campsite exudes tranquillity, as does the beautiful coastal walking area. For more than a touch of Breton folklore, Quimper is the perfect destination.

Staying in a gîte

The tranquillity of the coastal area can also be felt on the campsite. There are many mobile homes. Most of these accommodations are rented to permanent guests. There are also some for rent for touring campers, just like the Coco Sweet tents and the gîtes: typical Breton cottages, built of stone, with pointed roofs and blue shutters. There are also 145 touring pitches.

Atlantic Ocean: the largest swimming pool

Maybe the children are disappointed when they notice that there is no swimming pool at the campsite. But they don't have to worry. Only three hundred metres away is the biggest swimming pool they could wish for: the Atlantic Ocean. Via a paved road you can walk to the beach and the sea within five minutes. Both are very clean.

Paella and mussels

A small restaurant is located on the campsite. In this attractive wooden house with covered patio you can taste paella, fries with mussels and other seafood. However, the menu is quite simple. So if you really want to dine extensively, it is advisable to look for a restaurant nearby.

properties.name: Recreatiepark De Boshoek
properties.description:
The well maintained and complete campsite De Boshoek lies on the edge of the Veluwe, more or less between Amersfoort and Apeldoorn. You can enjoy the surrounding nature and calm atmosphere here with the entire family. Yet there is more than enough to do! For instance, swimming in the (covered) swimming paradise, tennis, soccer and basketball. There is also a wellness centre.

Pitch Beaver or Goat?

The campsite is fairly new, with well maintained fields (paving bricks) and pathways with woodchips. There is little demarcation. The fields are named, for instance the Beaver Field and the Goat Field. The 112 touring pitches and 8 motorhome pitches are spacious and offer ample privacy. The 73 contemporary rental accommodation units consist of safari tents, trekker huts, bungalows and rooms.

Dutch swimming paradise

The beautiful indoor pool (the sometimes unpredictable weather conditions in the Netherlands have been taken into consideration) has a few slides. A wellness centre is linked to it. When the weather allows it, you will of course dive into the outdoor swimming pool (open from May -September). It also has a sunbathing lawn.

Lots of activities...

The entertainment programme offers too much to mention. You can take part in bowling, quad biking or attend a cookery workshop. The large playground, with sand surface, is full of challenges for children. There is also a petting zoo, a panna cage, a tennis court and a soccer and basketball field. Also fun: play a game of mini golf.

Eating and drinking

The camping shop (with limited assortment) is adjacent to the reception. Voorthuizen has a number of good supermarkets, however. There are two restaurants on the Boshoek. There is an extensive menu and good quality meals are served.

properties.name: Camping De Linie
properties.description:
The Betuwe is known for its riverscape, horticulture and orchards. Camping De Linie is situated in the heart of the Betuwe, between the villages of Opheusden and Kesteren. What's more, this campsite is located on historic grounds. There is a Roman watchtower located right next to the campsite. It is certainly worth taking a look inside this tower, not to mention climbing to the top to enjoy the beautiful view. De Linie is a charming family campsite with renovated sanitary facilities, its own sandy beach on a small recreational lake and entertainment during the high season.

Camp on the long pathway or by the avenue tree nursery

The campsite has an elongated shape with an additional section on the right-hand side, next to a beautiful nursery for avenue trees. This extension was completed in 2019. Most of the permanent pitches are at the front along the long pathway, while the touring pitches are located further back and near the orchard. You can also book a holiday cottage, a hiker’s cabin or an apartment in a bed & breakfast. Your four-legged friends are also welcome. Only the B&B does not allow pets.

Go for a refreshing dip in the recreational lake

There is a small recreational lake where you can enjoy swimming and fishing. You can access the water from the sandy beach, but you can also jump in from the jetty. There is also a range of entertainment activities. In the high season, there is a nice programme of activities for both children and adults. The schedule includes, for example, children’s bingo, flea markets, sports activities and barbecues.

properties.name: Camping International Torre Cerrano
properties.description:
Near the town of Pineto on the Abbruzo coast, you will find the elongated and quiet campsite Camping International Torre Cerrano. Especially Italian families like to stay on this campsite. This is due to its location: near a sandy beach on a beautiful seashore with a protected area status. But the camping itself also attaches cares for the protection of the environment. For instance, camping guests are encouraged to use water sparingly.

Camping with the beach within walking distance

There is a central lane across the elongated camping terrain with camping fields on the seaside each offering room for approximately six camping pitches. Most camping pitches are provided with shade from the poplars of the pine forest. From many pitches, measuring between 50-100m2, you can see the sandy beach. This beach, very clean and safe, is considered to be one of the ten most beautiful in the country. The bottom gently slopes into the sea, making it ideal for small children. Activities like snorkelling and sailing are allowed in the sea.

Catering

On the campsite is a small bar and a shop for a few groceries such as fresh bread. In the restaurant you can enjoy basic traditional dishes which are typical for the Abruzzo region. You can also get pizzas, snacks and take-away meals here. 

Sports entertainment

Furthermore, there is a playground and a sports terrain. Here you can play a game of beach volleyball, for instance. Various activities for guests are organised on the campsite and on the beach. You can explore the area in comfort and quickly on a hired electric bicycle.

properties.name: Camping Al Boschetto
properties.description:
On the peninsula of Cavallino-Treporti, directly on the beach and the Mediterranean Sea, is Camping Al Boschetto. Here you can camp on delimited touring pitches in the shade of tall trees, directly on a wide beach. Despite the fact that this large campsite is located in a tourist area, you will find yourself on a quiet spot. With playground, sports fields and animation there is a lot to do for the youth.

Shady and expansive

A large part of the well-maintained campsite lies in the shade of tall pine trees. Especially by Italian standards, the touring pitches, most of them delimited by hedges, can be spacious. There are 350 pitches on the extensive grounds. And although there are a lot less rental accommodations (60 in total), the range of cottages, chalets and mobile homes is also very extensive.

Beach campsite

Especially beach-goers will feel at home at camping Al Boschetto. Every year, many Italian and German campers go to the Mediterranean coast near Venice to enjoy the long beaches and beautiful weather. Although there is plenty to do for young and old - an entertainment programme, a playground in the woods, sports fields provide entertainment - this campsite is also particularly quiet.

Beach and Mediterranean Sea

Behind the pine forest, beach and sea hide. Just a few steps and you are already standing with your feet in the warm sand. Many Italian campsites fill their beaches with sun loungers and umbrellas, but Al Boschetto does not. The campsite has only reserved a small part of the beach for this purpose. This gives a free feeling when you walk with your towel to the Mediterranean Sea.

properties.name: Camping Casa dei Prati
properties.description:
The island of Elba is known for its natural beauty and beautiful beaches. Camping Casa dei Prati is right next to the beach of Lacona. You camp in the centre of Elba, at the foot of wooded hills that guarantee great hiking and mountain biking. After a great walk through the countryside, you return to this green family campsite and relax in the outdoor swimming pool or at the charming bar.

Shady site with various accommodation options

At Camping Casa dei Prati you camp in the shade of eucalyptus and pine trees. In combination with the (other) typical Mediterranean vegetation, this ensures a wonderful natural setting. You are at one with nature, even if you stay overnight in a bivouac tent. If you would prefer a little more luxury, book a stay in a modern bungalow or apartment. Glamping enthusiasts choose a Starsbox at Camping Casa dei Prati – a luxury safari tent that can be zipped open at the top. This allows you to enjoy a clear starry sky from your own bed!

Swimming pool, playground and playing field

At a sunny location at the front of the site is a lovely outdoor swimming pool where you can swim some laps. The youngest campsite visitors will enjoy splashing about in the paddling pool while you relax in the Jacuzzi. More entertainment can be found in the form of a fun playground and a playing field for football and volleyball. Camping Casa dei Prati also has some summer entertainment for children in the summertime as well as a mini market and a charming bar.

properties.name: Villaggio Camping Lungomare
properties.description:
Only a road separates the family campsite Case Vacanza Lungomare from the beach on the Ionian Sea. Here you'll be camping in Calabria, a region which has not yet been affected by mass tourism. This is probably due to its southern location. If you are prepared to travel the distance, you will find a basic, clean campsite in a beautiful region. You can swim here in the clear blue sea.

Well-maintained campsite

This well-maintained campsite (2.1 ha) consists of one hundred touring pitches. You will be provided with a spacious pitch between tall pine trees. You will also find attractive rental bungalows on the campsite. The sanitary facilities are cleaned three times per day during high season. 

Sports on land and in the sea

The campsite has a playground and a sports area. The entertainment programme is only offered in Italian. Sports tournaments for campers are organised on a regular basis. Camping guests of all ages can join fitness sessions in the sea. 

Clear blue sea

If you feel like going for a swim, all you have to do is head towards the beautiful sandy beach. It can be accessed via a gate which is locked at night. The sea at the beach is a beautiful, clear blue. A charming esplanade runs along the beach. As the esplanade ends in a cul-de-sac, there is relatively little traffic. 

Eating out

On the campsite ,you can enjoy a meal in a great restaurant that also serves pizza. You can enjoy a meal on the terrace as well. The campsite organises regular discos. Roughly 200m away, in the village of Cropani Marina, you will find a few shops, eateries and bars.

properties.name: Camping Agriturismo Fontanelle
properties.description:
In the heel of Italy's boot, between Lecce and Otranto, lies Agriturismo Fontanelle. This simple family campsite belongs to a farm in the Puglia countryside. You camp on the elongated grassy field behind the farm. A path through the pine forest leads you in five hundred metres to a secluded sandy beach on a beautiful bay.

Grass and olive trees

The campsite is neatly laid out on an elongated grassy field lined with olive trees. The new planting that marks out the pitches will provide additional shade in the future. The campsite is visibly well-maintained. Thirty touring pitches are arranged in two long rows on either side of the lawn. Although they differ in size, none of them is very spacious.

Azure water

At the end of the lawn, you can enter the forest through a gate. A winding forest path leads to a narrow sandy beach, which is embedded in the rocky coast around the Baie dei Turchi. It is about five hundred metres to the beach, so you can walk there in less than ten minutes. The water here is beautifully azure and crystal clear. The small sandy beach is nicely sheltered between the high rocks.

Fresh from the land

The owners of Agriturismo Fontanelle are happy to let you enjoy the products they grow. Fresh seasonal fruit and vegetables are available every day. In the campsite shop you will find everything you need to make the most delicious local dishes: tomatoes, courgettes, aubergines, peppers and onions, but also olive oil and pasta. Eggs, herbs and various fruits are also available, all fresh from the land.

properties.name: Hoddom Castle Caravan Park
properties.description:
