Hoddom Castle Caravan Park is in the Scottish Dumfries and Galloway. Here, you camp in a unique way. This park-like campsite is on the estate of a 16th century castle. It's ideal as a stop-over campsite when travelling from England to Scotland (or vice versa), but certainly also great for a longer stay.

View of the 16th century castle

This large campsite has around 90 camping pitches, both with and without electricity. You can also choose one of the 11 hire accommodation. Here, you can camp in the grass and amid large ancient trees. You have views of the castle from various pitches. This makes you feel like you are in a completely different world.

Shower in a stable

In the outbuildings of this castle from 1560, you can enjoy a drink by the open fire in the pub, eat pizzas from a wood-fired oven in the restaurant and you can also get take-away meals. There is also a shop where you can get fresh bread, pastries and milk, among other things. You will find the rest of the amenities in the outbuildings. You even shower in the castle's old stables, for example.

Play a game of golf

You will enjoy yourself to the full at Hoddom Castle Caravan Park. Hit a ball on the golf course - with views of the castle - or have fun on the tennis court. Children can go out with the forest ranger. He teaches them all about working on the estate, such as checking bird houses, spotting wild deer and badgers and planting trees.

properties.name: Forest Glade Holiday Park
properties.description:
Forest Glade Holiday Park is a campsite in Cullompton, near Kentisbeare, in County Devon. The campsite is situated in the middle of the woods and hills of the Blackdown Hills. It is a paradise for outdoor enthusiasts. From the campsite you have direct access to several walking routes. After all the outdoor activities, the heated swimming pool or sauna provide a relaxing end to the day. The campsite has a shop, a liquor store and a restaurant for take-away meals.

Forest Glade Holiday Park has it all!

In its wooded and hilly surroundings, Forest Glade Holiday Park offers spacious and level pitches. The pitches have paved surfaces and are sheltered from the wind by high hedges at the edge. You can also choose a mobile home, a flat or a cosy pod. This is a simple but comfortable cabin.

Heated indoor swimming pool

The campsite has a heated indoor swimming pool with a separate paddling pool. The pool offers fun for the whole family. Would you like to relax after a busy day? Then head for the sauna. Are you a fan of the sea and the beach? The popular seaside resorts Sidmouth and Exmouth are about a thirty-minute drive away.

Sporty entertainment

There is a tennis court, a football pitch and a cricket field. The campsite organises nature walks, with the chance of spotting wildlife. And what about stargazing in the countryside? There is also an information room about wild life. The children can amuse themselves in the playground or in one of the playrooms.

properties.name: Cofton Holidays
properties.description:
Want to spend your holiday in the green hills of the English countryside? Then you've come to the right place. You come to this place to enjoy nature, the sea and all the extensive campsite facilities! Cofton Holidays is a neat, well-maintained family campsite with spacious camping pitches. Your camper or tent gives you a great view of the rolling landscape.

Luxury five-star campsite

When you arrive at Cofton Holidays, you'll first notice the spacious and well-maintained grounds. There are many camping and motorhome pitches, either paved or grass. In addition to camping pitches, there are also various rental accommodations, including mobile homes, apartments and lodges. Cofton Holidays' sanitary facilities are excellent. The main sanitary building was renovated in 2019, and a brand new building was recently added.

Swimming fun all year round

At the campsite, you will find a large outdoor swimming pool that is only open during the summer. Next to the outdoor pool is a spacious sunbathing area where you can enjoy the sun while relaxing on the grass. The indoor swimming pool at Cofton Holidays is open all year round. It is also possible to book a swimming lesson here or to participate in an Aquafit session.

Entertainment for all

No shortage of entertainment at Cofton Holidays! There is a Kids Club for small children where all kinds of fun activities are organised, such as craft mornings and pirate adventures. There is also an indoor play paradise for young children. Teenagers can enjoy themselves in the indoor arcade with bowling, pool, air hockey and video games, among other things.

properties.name: Gåsevig Strand Camping
properties.description:
Gåsevig Strand Camping occupies a a quiet spot on the coast near Haderslev (South Jutland). You camp on the Kleine Belt, in a typical Danish rural environment. From here, water sports are possible and beautiful walks and cycle rides through forests and along lakes and charming market towns. The campsite is well-maintained and offers fun activities for the whole family.

Large pitches with a sea view

The campsite has a varied site with both small and larger camping fields. The pitches are large, grassy and separated by neat hedges. The most beautiful pitches are close to the sea and have a wonderful view of the water. Prefer to stay in accommodation? At Gåsevig Strand Camping, you can also book a stay in a modern safari tent or a cosy hiker's hut.

Plenty of entertainment in the cosy activity tent

Gåsevig Strand Camping offers entertainment and facilities to keep you entertained all day. Stop by the activity tent to play table tennis, pool, air hockey or darts. Stay there into the evening and you might enjoy live music, a nice themed dinner, an atmospheric summer party or a children's disco for the little ones. You can do your grocery shopping on the campsite too, at the shop that sells a wide range of food and camping products.

A paradise for water sports enthusiasts

This campsite is perfect for anyone who loves the beach, sea and water sports. The campsite is next to a kilometres-long sandy and pebble beach. Take a refreshing dip, sail out of the estuary in a rented kayak or book a diving trip to an abandoned submarine station.

properties.name: Camping Le Pra de Mars
properties.description:
This atmospheric campsite featuring 78 camping pitches and a number of rental accommodations is situated among the green hills in the Auvergne. Le Pra de Mars Campsite is located directly on the Loire River, where you can swim and canoe. This medium-sized campsite is all about the luxury of nature, with a restaurant, river and swimming pool, beautiful views and tranquillity. That's all you need here.

Spot on the river

Le Pra de Mars Campsite is a place that attracts families and nature lovers seeking peace and tranquillity. The camping area is spacious with many trees. You can choose a spacious pitch on the camping field, but also directly on the banks of the Loire. The campsite is a wonderful place for tent campers, but those with other camping equipment are also very welcome! You can expect a personal welcome from the campsite owners who will be looking forward to your arrival.

Swimming fun

The river is a wonderful place for swimming or floating on an air mattress. Near the river is a small beach of sand, pebbles and grass. Kids can catch crayfish under the rocks on the shore, dive from the rocky outcrop and zip through the rapids on a tire. For those who aren't quite as adventurous, there is also a campsite swimming pool. Not big, but perfect for cooling off or reading a book under one of the umbrellas. Those who need a moment for themselves can relax in the sauna or enjoy a massage.

properties.name: Camping Val di Rhêmes
properties.description:
This is the perfect campsite for nature lovers and keen walkers. Campsite Val di Rhêmes is situated on the edge of the Aosta Valley in the Gran Paradiso National Park. Here you camp amidst nature with a splendid view of the high mountainsides. The natural surroundings create a sense of freedom and space when you camp here. The campsite borders a babbling stream.

View of imposing mountainsides

The campsite is very green and well maintained. This is borne out by the camping fields, which are neatly mowed. The camping pitches are spacious and, because they are not demarcated, offer a stunning view of the beautiful surrounding area. It is also possible to rent wooden caravans, which are simply but cosily furnished.

The sanitary facilities are basic, but meet all requirements. There are toilets, showers and good wash up areas with professional rinse sprayers.

A campsite for all

The campsite also has a lively bar, where you can enjoy a drink. Info evenings about the Gran Paradiso park are organised here on a regular basis. The campsite is small-scale and especially popular with older couples and keen walkers. However, there is also plenty for children to do here. They can play for hours in the large public playground next to the campsite. 

Veritable paradise for walkers

The area is perfect for walks through the mountains and past waterfalls. Follow the winding paths into nature, guiding you past numerous waterfalls and spectacular vistas. And who knows - you may even spot an ibex or an eagle, so keep your eyes peeled!

properties.name: Camping Arvier
properties.description:
The small but rustic Camping Arvier is located in the Aosta Valley. Located in the rugged mountain landscape on the edge of the Gran Paradiso National Park, it is a camping destination for lovers of walking and nature. Campsite Arvier is situated on the outskirts of the village of the same name, and therefore restaurants and shops are close by. Venture also on exciting activities such as rafting or take a relaxing trip to the capital of Aosta.

Green pitches

The terrace shaped terrain of the campsite is a well maintained lawn. Here you will find both pitches under tall trees and pitches with less shade. The camping pitches are not clearly demarcated, so that you are at liberty to establish your own pitch around the power poles. 

Sun and water fun

For water fun, you can take a dive into the outdoor pool of the campsite. The swimming pool is small, but well maintained. There is also ample space to soak up the sun on the the sunbathing lawn. Please note that during low season the swimming pool has restricted opening hours. Bathing caps are compulsory. The chlorinated water can afterwards be rinsed off at the neat and clean sanitary facilities. Hot water from the wash basins and showers is included in the price. 

Rugged mountain landscape

Campsite Arvier is beautifully situated in a rugged mountain landscape on the edge of the Gran Paradiso National Park. This makes it an great destination for the camper who likes sporty hikes. The hiking routes take you into the national park, past lush greenery, deep gorges and gently lapping mountain streams. Yet another exciting activity to indulge in is rafting on calm or wild rivers.

properties.name: Camping-Appartement-Bungalow Erlengrund Gastein
properties.description:
Bad Gastein is one of the most well-known spas in Austria and even in Europe. Camping-Appartement-Bungalow Erlengrund Gastein is on the outskirts of Bad Gastein (Salzburgerland), which is mainly popular for its thermal baths with radon water. There is also a stunning waterfall in the centre of Bad Gastein. Here, you camp in a central location in Gastein Valley. From your camping pitch, you have impressive views of the surrounding mountains that of course offer an extremely varied range of mountain and winter sports activities.

Book a spacious touring pitch or stay in a luxury apartment

When you arrive at the campsite, the reception is right there. On the site behind it, various paved paths lead to the spacious apartments. If you decide to book a pitch at Camping-Appartement-Bungalow Erlengrund Gastein, you will probably stay on a sunny camping pitch. There are pitches with more shade here and there. Wi-Fi is available on the entire site at Camping-Appartement-Bungalow Erlengrund Gastein.

As well as on a tourist camping pitch, you can also enjoy a holiday in a mobile home here. There are also luxury studios and apartments for hire.

Relax in the swimming pool or in one of the saunas

The lovely swimming pool is at the side of the site at Camping-Appartement-Bungalow Erlengrund Gastein. This is an outdoor swimming pool with heated water, situated in the sun. It's a wonderful place for swimming some laps and for relaxing! You can also do the latter in the campsite's wellness zone. There you have three saunas at your disposal: a Finnish sauna an infrared sauna and a bio sauna.

properties.name: Camping Olachgut
properties.description:
Camping Olachgut is situated in the heart of the green Styria region, on the banks of the River Mur and next to a recreational lake. This popular five-star campsite combines nature, relaxation and activities for all ages. It is a particularly lovely spot for nature lovers and horse enthusiasts, as the campsite has its own riding school and offers plenty of opportunities for beautiful walks.

Camping pitches and accommodation units

At Camping Olachgut, you can choose from comfortable camping pitches with connections for electricity, water and drainage. The pitches are suitable for tents, caravans and motorhomes and are spread across a green site with trees and open spaces. This ensures you always have a nice balance between sun and shade. If you are looking for more comfort, wooden bungalows, chalets and apartments are also available.

Swimming, horseback riding and fishing

The large recreational lake is a central feature of the campsite, where you can swim, relax or fish. For children, there are play areas and sports fields where they can entertain themselves for hours. Horse enthusiasts will feel right in their element here. At the site, you will find a riding school where you can go horse riding or take lessons. The modern sanitary facilities are well maintained and help to ensure a carefree holiday. For a enjoyable evening, head over to the campsite restaurant with its typical Austrian atmosphere.

An active day, out and about

Directly from the campsite, you can walk or cycle along the River Mur, following well-maintained routes through the valley. Active guests can make use of the sports fields or join in organised activities during the high season. Dogs are also welcome and can enjoy themselves in the special facilities provided.

properties.name: Svendborg Sund Camping
properties.description:
The child-friendly Svendborg Sund Camping lies directly at the seaside on one of the islands of the South Funen Archipelago. Camp in an attractive setting with gently sloping hills and a shoreline which stretches for several kilometres. The bridge to the largest island of Funen, with its old towns, castles and beautiful gardens, is not far from the campsite. This is an ideal area for anglers, cyclists and nature explorers.

Beautiful grounds

The pitches on the park-like grounds are neatly maintained, specious and vary in size. Some pitches have a splendid view of the sea. You can opt for a pitch in the sun or partly shaded. The site is surrounded by trees offering protection against the onshore wind. At the centre of the campsite is a small pond with ducks.

Searching for crabs

The campsite is directly located at the seaside. The beach consists partly of sand and partly of grass. Boats can be moored at a pier. Children can play in the water or search for small crabs. There are also a few playgrounds. There is also a petting zoo with rabbits, goats and birds.

The campsite is an ideal base for kayaking, walking and cycling trips. You can also rent equipment for this. In inclement weather you can use the dry and warm 'strohhutte'. Occasionally, a communal barbecue is organised.

Camping shop and sanitary facilities

The camping shop is small, but is well-stocked (with bread service). There is a supermarket some 2 km away. Very convenient: the campsite offers luxury kitchen facilities with ovens and microwave ovens. The heated sanitary facilities are neat and modern.

properties.name: Camping Berggruss
properties.description:
Camping Berggruss is located in the Austrian state of Carinthia, in the municipality of Berg im Drautal. This family-friendly campsite has 65 spacious pitches. The campsite has a swimming pool and behind the campsite flows the Drau river. You can go white-water rafting or kayaking on this river. Children can enjoy themselves on the campsite in the playground or play a game of beach volleyball.

Spacious camping

Once you arrive at the campsite, you will be warmly welcomed by the owner. His family-friendly campsite has spacious pitches that vary between 80 and 130 m2. In total there are 65 pitches. The camping guests come from different countries.

There is no shop or restaurant on the campsite. However, there is a supermarket at only one kilometre from the campsite where you can get all your groceries.

Plenty of water fun

The campsite has a small outdoor swimming pool of 50m2 to cool down in. From mid-June to mid-September, the sunbathing area by this pool is open. A larger swimming pool is about ten minutes walking distance from the campsite. This swimming pool is located in the village and is free of charge for everyone. Behind the campsite flows the river Drau. This river is one of the last natural river landscapes of the Southern Alps. Adventurers can go white-water rafting or kayaking on the river.

Sport and games

Do you want to stay active at the campsite? Then play a game of beach volleyball with your campsite neighbours. There is also plenty to do for children. There is a playground with a table tennis table, slide, merry-go-round, sandpit and swing.

properties.name: Campingplatz Nehren
properties.description:
Camping Nehren-Mosel is located in an island on a bend of the Moselle River, close to the village of Nehren. You are allowed to choose your own pitch here. The nicest pitches are close to the river. From Nehren you can walk directly to the famous vineyards of the Moselle region. Cyclists will enjoy the landscape from the Moselle cycle route, which runs past the campsite. Cochem and Zell are historic towns worth visiting.

Beautiful spots on the Moselle

Camping Nehren-Mosel is a beautiful and quietly located campsite. The terrain has a combination of permanent and tourist camping pitches. The pitches all measure 100 m2. There is little demarcation between the pitches, with here and there trees providing shade. Obviously, the most beautiful pitches are located close to the river. The Moselle cycle path runs between the river and the pitches.

Campsite with private slipway

You share the campsite with more senior camping guests and families with young children. The campsite is quite unpretentious: there is some playground equipment, a table tennis table and a dartboard. The river is suitable for fishing and swimming. Camping guests with their own boat can easily launch this using the slipway.

Small supermarket, modest restaurant

In the small supermarket at the entrance of the campsite you can do your basic shopping. You will also find a restaurant here. This restaurant has a small menu, a bar and a terrace. Take-away meals are also available. There is a larger supermarket in Zell, some twenty km down the road.

properties.name: Tällbergs Camping
properties.description:
On the eastern bank of lake Siljan, between Leksand and lRättvik, you will find the historical small town of Tällberg. When Siljan tourism became popular in the late 19th century, the first tourist hotels were constructed here. It is exactly these kinds of classic hotels that give the village its reputation. Tällbergs Campsite, on the other hand, is a very basic and unpretentious campsite, ideal for people who like peace and quiet.

View

The focus is on the view over Siljan, although this rural area is also excellent for lovely walks and cycle trips. The pitches are spacious and especially the pitches at the water's edge are magical. Of course, this Swedish campsite also has camping huts for rent. They are all rather basic, but clean and well-maintained. Especially the ‘härbre’, an old type of storage shed, is popular with visitors.

Shopping

Surprisingly, Tällberg is a nice place to find local arts and crafts. For serious shopping, you will have to go to Rättvik or Leksand.

Santaworld

The surroundings of Siljan form part of the most popular tourist areas of the country and people come from far afield to enjoy nature, the culture and the imposing views. From the campsite, you can easily make day trips to towns in the vicinity of Siljan, such as Mora. This larger town has everything to offer. In Gesunda, not far from Mora, it is Christmas all year round in Tomteland (Santaworld) : you will find out everything there is to know about Santa.

properties.name: Camping De Somerweij
properties.description:
Campsite De Somerweij is located in Someren in Brabant, between Eindhoven and Weert. You will immediately feel at home at this small, quiet family campsite. The campsite is located in the countryside between the Peel and the Kempen. The surroundings are great for cycling. The campsite is spacious and beautifully laid out, with spacious pitches on the grass. There is no restaurant at the campsite, but there is a cosy coffee house with a small terrace.

Large small campsite

De Somerweij only has twenty-four touring pitches. Nevertheless, with a surface area of five hectares, it is not a small campsite. The campsite is spacious, with large pitches laid out on well-maintained lawns. You have a beautiful view of the surrounding fields and woods. De Somerweij has a separate tent pitch, but you can pitch your tent anywhere on the campsite.

Outdoor swimming pool in Someren

Five kilometres from the campsite is De Diepsteeckel, an open-air swimming pool that is open from May to September. You can cycle there in fifteen minutes. There is a 25-metre pool, a recreational pool with waterslide and a separate toddlers' pool. There is also a football and volleyball field and a sunbathing area.

Enjoying the peace and quiet

Camping De Somerweij has extensive facilities for walkers and cyclists. For example, there is a bike shed, a charging point for electric bikes and a place to clean your bike. The owners are happy to share their walking and cycling maps and the most beautiful spots in the area. For children there is a playground with play equipment and an animal pasture with farm animals. Under the pergola, you can enjoy the peace and quiet and the view from a hammock.

properties.name: Camping Reiterhof
properties.description:
A short distance away from Hopfgarten, adjacent to the Salvenaland Amusement Park, lies the beautiful panoramic campsite Reiterhof. You camp here in well-known Tyrol, where you can enjoy nature and all the typical features of Austria. Reiterhof is a well-maintained campsite with several fields, partially laid out on terraces. Opposite the campsite is a restaurant.

Camping in the shade

On the campsite, you have a choice of several fields. You can spend your holiday here with plenty of shade and privacy. Prefer to have sun all day? Choose a pitch on the left-hand side of the grounds. The pitches are level and have a hard surface. The sanitary facilities are modern and well-maintained.

Year-round enjoyment

You are welcome throughout the year at campsite Reiterhof. The campsite is home to both young and old. True nature lovers can enjoy the mountains, lakes and the beautiful vegetation here. For instance, there are guided walking and cycling tours (in low season). More sporty activities, like climbing, are also possible. If you want to soak up some culture, you can opt for the hustle and bustle of nearby towns (Salzburg, Innsbruck). 

Swimming and playing fun

You don't have to go far for a refreshing dive. You can get to Salvenaland Amusement Park within five minutes. You will find a heated swimming pool and separate children's pool there. Do you prefer open water? Then head for the large swimming lake. You can relax on the green sunbathing lawn around the swimming lake. However, there is also plenty to do away from the water. There are all kinds of playgrounds and you can indulge in go-karting, karting, tobogganing, bowling, tennis and mini golf.

properties.name: Camping de la Vallée de l'Oise
Camping La Fressange
properties.description:
Camping La Fressange is located in the French department of Haute-Loire, on the outskirts of the medieval village of Saint-Didier-en-Velay. This family campsite is ideal for exploring the beautiful surroundings. Less than an hour’s drive from the campsite are Pilat Natural Regional Park, the mountains of the Massif Central, various waterfalls as well as charming villages and interesting museums.

Camping surrounded by nature

At this campsite, camping is done on the grass between the trees. The elongated campsite is built against a hill, so there are some differences in height. You camp surrounded by nature and a small stream flows through the grounds. The camping pitches are spacious and not demarcated. Options include renting a luxury mobile home or safari tent.

Open-air cinema and massages

The municipal outdoor swimming pool is right across from the campsite. You can swim here for free as a campsite guest. The outdoor swimming pool consists of several pools and is the perfect place for a refreshing dip. During the high season, the campsite organises many activities for the entire family. An open-air cinema regularly allows you to enjoy popular films. If you would like to relax completely, choose a massage.

Hiking and cycling from the campsite

Camping La Fressange is in an area where there is plenty to do. The Pilat Natural Regional Park is less than 10 kilometres from the campsite. Other mountains are also within easy reach. The Vélorail de Dunières or Dunières rail bike is a 20-minute drive from the campsite. You pedal along a beautiful route over an old railway.

properties.name: Camping Du Lac
properties.description:
Camping Du Lac is a small-scale campsite in the mountains above Argelès-Gazost, in the south of France. This well-kept campsite is located next to a large lake surrounded by mountains. The Pyrenees are the perfect location for hikes through the beautiful countryside. Nearby, cyclists can climb infamous cols from the Tour de France. The campsite is well cared for and very quiet.

View of the mountains

The first thing you see when you drive onto the property are the wooden chalets. These offer views of the surrounding mountains. The views from the touring pitches, a little further up the campsite, are also magnificent. You camp on an undulating campsite, which feels more like a park thanks to its uncluttered layout. The grounds are maintained very neatly. All the touring pitches are equally spacious and offer plenty of privacy.

Heated swimming pools

The campsite gets its name from the lake that lies across from the campsite. You only have to cross a main road to reach the water's edge. Here you can go for a nice walk. There is no swimming allowed in the lake, however. For this, you have to stick to the campsite itself, where there are two heated pools.

Shopping in Argelès-Gazost

Basic groceries can be purchased from the small shop in the reception building. You can also order bread, have a drink and eat breakfast there in high season. For more major shopping, Argelès is the best destination. There are some larger supermarkets there. You will also find several smaller shops and you can dine in the evening at one of the cozy terraces.

properties.name: Camping Domaine du Lac de Champos
properties.description:
An hour south of Lyon, near the village of Saint-Donat-sur-l'Herbasse, you will find the Domaine du Lac de Champos campsite. The campsite is situated by a large natural swimming lake, between the small river l'Herbasse and a main road. It is part of a 'base de loisirs', a recreation area. In the snack bar you can get a quick snack or a complete takeaway meal.

The choice is enormous

Domaine du Lac de Champos is a terraced campsite and has more than ninety spacious, delimited pitches. In addition, there is a separate area with various rental accommodations: twenty fully equipped chalets and four lodge tents. The campsite is very spacious and is situated in quiet surroundings with vineyards and fruit trees. The campsite is very suitable for a family holiday, as there is plenty of playground equipment, a tennis court and a recreation room. Furthermore, the entertainment is of a high standard.

Water rats get together!

As the campsite lies directly on a large natural bathing lake, it is a paradise for water lovers. Here you can swim, fish (with permit), enjoy the beautiful sunbathing area and slide down the slides. You can also rent canoes, pedal boats and paddle surfboards. For the little ones, there is a shallow area with water jets and for the experienced swimmers, a floating diving platform. Supervision ensures that everyone can swim in safety.

Doing your shopping

For some shopping you will have to leave the campsite; in the village of Saint-Donat-sur-l'Herbrasse, a ten minute drive away, you will find a supermarket and some other shops. You can also reach the village on foot, as there is a lovely footpath along the river.

properties.name: Camping Ushuaïa Villages  l'Oasis
properties.description:
The child-friendly campsite l'Oasis is situated on the banks of the clean river Ay. Here you are in an open area alternated with woods, between the towns Sarras and Eclassan. Nature lovers can hike and cycle to their heart's content. An entertainment team provides amusement in high season.

Camping on grass

At Camping l'Oasis, choose the pitch that suits you best. A spacious pitch at the top of the hill is most suitable for caravans. Or you refer your pitch to be down by the river. The pitches are a bit smaller, but with more shade and closer to the swimming pool and the bar. The shrubs and trees that demarcate many of the pitches give the campsite a relaxed character. There are also several rental accommodations to book.

Water fun

Adjacent to the restaurant you’ll find the rectangular swimming pool, with next to it a small paddling pool. The solar collectors ensure that the water is always nice and warm. You can get a tan or read a book on the sunbeds around the pool.

At the bottom of the campsite meanders the shallow, clean river. A popular place for children to play and for adults to cool off or catch a fish. The water is not deep enough for swimming. The campsite offers direct access to the river.

Daily menu and fresh pizzas

The bar and swimming pool are the heart of the campsite. You can go there for a drink, an ice cream or something to eat. It’s open all day. Occasionally there is a musical performance in the evening. In the shop at the reception you can buy some basic groceries.

properties.name: Le Village du Port
properties.description:
Le Village du Port Sites & Paysages lies far from the bustle of the city, at a location where you wake to the sound of birds singing. You camp here in the valley of the Dordogne, next to the Dordogne river. This is a nature campsite that allows you to relax completely. Le Village du Port Sites & Paysages is located in the town of Saint-Sozy, close to popular attractions in the departments of Lot and Dordogne. Beautiful towns like Rocamadour, Martel, Souillac and Sarlat-la-Canéda are close together, and the magnificent caves of Gouffre de Padirac and Lacave are within easy reach.

Environmentally friendly and car-free

The team at the campsite does everything possible to minimise the impact on the environment and to promote local biodiversity. The accommodations are built out of natural materials, rainwater is caught and used for the toilets, nesting boxes are placed for birds and hiding spots for hedgehogs and squirrels, organic waste is composted and, where possible, local ingredients and products are purchased. The campsite is also car-free.

Well-balanced variety of camping pitches

Most of the touring pitches have water and electricity and are suitable for caravans and motorhomes. These pitches are at the front of the campsite. Touring pitches are towards the orchard and the river and are more natural in character. Some of these are meant only for tent campsite visitors – ideal for those who want to retreat into nature for a while. You can also stay in a luxury holiday home or a glamping tent. The toilet facilities are brand new and of five-star quality.

properties.name: Camping & Bungalows Poros Beach
properties.description:
Enjoy a wonderful holiday on one of the Ionian Islands in Greece at Camping & Bungalows Poros Beach. Here, you will be camping near the village of Póros in the south of Lefkada, also known as Lefkas. This island is loved for its picturesque villages, wooded interior and beautiful beaches next to a clear blue sea. One of those beaches is just a hundred metres from the campsite. The campsite itself is beautifully situated on a hillside. Facilities include a lovely outdoor swimming pool, a supermarket and a good restaurant with sea views.

Green space with shady spots

When you arrive at this well-maintained campsite, the welcoming reception will be the first place you reach. Several comfortable studios and flats for two to five people are available for rent in the same building. The camping area is behind the reception, where you can set up your caravan, motorhome and/or pitch your tent in the shade of olive and orange trees.

Supermarket, restaurant and swimming pool

Next to the reception is the outdoor swimming pool, which is open in July and August. It is truly large enough for swimming laps. The campsite also has a lovely playground, a large supermarket and Menta Kitchen & Bar. At this restaurant, you can enjoy delicious dishes such as souvlaki, pasta and steamed mussels. On top of that, the outdoor seating offers a fantastic view of the bay.

Enjoy the beaches and forests

No holiday on Lefkas is complete without a visit to the beach, of course. The nearest beach is just a short hundred metres from the campsite. The campsite is also an excellent starting point for walking and mountain biking trips.

properties.name: Camping Bispen NAF
properties.description:
In Bismo, the main town of the municipality of Skjåk in the Oppland province, lies the magnificent and idyllic Bispen Campsite. The camping is situated on the outskirts of the village, directly on the Otta river and is surrounded by an attractive nature area with numerous trees. From Bismo you have direct access to the impressive mountain world of Breheimen en Reinheimen, while the Jotunheimen en Rondane national parks are also not too far away.

Campsite with intimate character

The campsite has spacious pitches along fields which are separated from each other by trees and bushes. This creates an intimate character on the campsite. In addition, the campsite has 10 hikers huts, two of which with shower and toilet and all with hot and cold running water.

Very good facilities

The other facilities are all fine. You can buy basic foodstuffs at the reception. However, due to the proximity on the edge of the village, the nearest COOP-supermarket is not far away.

Activities

Those who like to take things a bit easy can go for walks from the campsite in the immediate vicinity or in the surrounding mountains. Of course, the campsite also offers entertainment: mini golf, tennis and swimming/playing in the pond.

properties.name: Sølenstua Camp & Hytter
properties.description:
You will find Camping Sølenstua Camp & Hytter on the east coast of the south of Norway, close to the village of Engerdal (province of Innlandet). This campsite is in an ideal spot for those seeking peace and quiet and for nature lovers. Indeed, Innlandet is sparsely populated, mountainous and rich in forests. This campsite is also a great starting point for lovely walks through the mountains. This area offers extensive options for mountain climbing, cycling, swimming, kayaking and winter sports. Furthermore, the many rivers and lakes in this region are excellent for fishing.

Stay in an authentic hiker's cabin or pick your own touring pitch

You can find various small and larger camping fields behind the reception. As a camper, you can pick your own pitch at this clearly laid out site. You can book a stay in an authentic hiker's cabin at Camping Sølenstua Camp & Hytter. They come in different versions and levels of comfort. Furthermore, as a campsite guest you can use the recently renovated toilet and washing facilities. The amenities inside the toilet block are neatly maintained.

Own cafeteria and kiosk

This campsite has a lovely cafeteria where you can go for delicious breakfasts and dinners in the summer months. The campsite also has a small kiosk where you can get essential groceries. The closest large supermarket is in the centre of the village of Engerdal, a good 18 kilometres from the campsite.

Old-fashioned winter fun with skis and snowmobiles

This part of Norway has a stable winter climate. That means there is a high degree of snow certainty. It is therefore the perfect place to go skiing, cross-country skiing and for exploring the area on a snowmobile.

properties.name: Camping Aan Noordzee
properties.description:
Camping Aan Noordzee is in Sint Maartenszee on the beautiful North Sea coastline in the northern most part of the province North Holland. It is an ideal spot for lovers of the sun, sea and nature. You camp close to Het Zwanenwater nature reserve and the charming village centre of Callantsoog. With an extensive network of paved bicycle paths and walking tours, you will never get tired of it here.

Luxury and comfort in the countryside

Camping Aan Noordzee focuses on rest and privacy. Each pitch is set up spaciously and surrounded by vegetation. Each pitch also has private toilet and washing facilities. If you would like even more comfort, rent a nice holiday home. Children will have fun in the small playground and there is a local supermarket within walking distance for all of your daily needs. Our handy online booking system allows you to go straight to your pitch when you arrive, without having to stop at reception.

Beach with a blue flag

The beach at Sint Maartenszee is one of the cleanest in the Netherlands. A blue flag has been flying here for years already. This mean clean water, a clean beach and good amenities for the entire family. There are beach pavilions where you can grab a bite to eat or have a drink – all with a beautiful view of the sea. You can also rent sun beds, chairs and wind screens.

Explore the surrounding area

In addition to enjoying beach days, there are plenty of other activities in the vicinity. Wander through the dunes, cycle past the lakes in the dunes or spot seals at the Hondsbossche Zeewering dyke. Visit historic cities like Alkmaar, Enkhuizen or Medemblik, and go on an excursion to the famous cheese market in Alkmaar. The bustling capital city of Amsterdam is only an hour’s drive away.

properties.name: Vakantiepark Sallandshoeve
properties.description:
Camping Sallandshoeve is part of a holiday park with, for children, a lovely play pond with rope bridge to an island. They will also enjoy themselves in the swimming pool, with the entertainment and on the go-karts. The area is also stunning: You can make wonderful cycling and walking tours in and around the National Park Sallandse Heuvelrug. Camping in an ideal spot for families with children.

Safari tents

Via a paved road you reach the campsite, where the spacious and demarcated pitches are located in a large circle around the newly established play pond. There are additional pitches on the side of the circular road of the campsite. All pitches were newly laid out in 2017. Want to hire something? The five new safari tents with sanitary facilities, a terrace and terrace heater are very attractive.

Safe play pond

The indoor swimming pool with small slide is situated in the rear part of the farmstead. It is a lovely pool to swim some laps or to play. There is also a toddler pool. The (shallow) play pond on the campsite is an absolute Valhalla for children, of course. This is located in the centre of the campsite, so there is proper overview from the surrounding camping pitches and safari tents.

Active entertainment team

Children have the time of their life on this campsite. In addition to the play pond and the large sandy area around it, there is a large bouncer in the cellar of the farmstead. Outside you will find some playground equipment, a sports field and an 18-hole mini-golf course. During school holidays, an entertainment team organises all kinds of activities to keep the children occupied: from arts and craft to games, go-kart races and jewellery making.

properties.name: Camping Port Zélande
properties.description:
You will always be close to the water at Camping Port Zélande in Zeeland. This medium-sized campsite lies directly on the Grevelingen Lake, the largest salt water lake of Western Europe and within walking distance (0.5 km) of the North Sea beach. Simply cross the road and the North Sea hits your feet. Port Zélande borders the holiday park of Center Parcs with the same name. As a camping guests you have free access to this park with its numerous facilities and activities.

You reach the campsite via the Brouwers Dam (N57). Wind down your window to inhale the salty see breeze and get into that holiday mood straight away. Port Zélande is located halfway. The campsite forms part of Center Parcs Port Zélande, therefore, upon arrival make sure you take the correct exit and don't end up in the bungalow park.

Green camping pitches

The terrain, surrounded by trees and in a park-like setting, offers sufficient shelter against the sea breeze. All camping pitches are located on lawns surrounded by woodland. You can camp here with your caravan or tent. There are approximately ten paved pitches available for motorhomes. Prefer to park your motorhome on on grass? Then contact the campsite reception before your departure.  

Water fun galore

So close to the sea and directly on a lake with its own beach ...Perfect conditions for a holiday of water fun. On the Gravelingen Lake you can go sailing, water pedalling and windsurfing. In addition, as a campsite guest you are also allowed to use for a charge the sub-tropical swimming pool Aqua Mundo in the adjacent bungalow park, which has a whitewater course and spectacular slide.

properties.name: Stadscamping Zeeland
properties.description:
Camping by the sea in the Netherlands: this is possible on Stadscamping Zeeland. The beaches being only 15 minutes away by car and the city centre of Middelburg within walking distance, you can breathe in the salty sea air and absorb the culture of Zeeland. You stay here in the Walcheren peninsula on a campsite which was renovated completely in 2017. On the outskirts of the town, but without the hustle and bustle. Stadscamping Zeeland forms an ideal base from where to explore Zeeland.

Luxury camping pitches

The campsite is surrounded by trees, but further than that there are no trees on the camping grounds. Lange Jan (the abbey tower) and the roof peak of the Middelburg town hall tower above the trees. 

The campsite consists basically of three sections. The right hand side is reserved for modern rental accommodation. Splendid luxury: if you stay in one of these accommodation units, you can make use of a breakfast service. On the left hand side are the motorhome pitches and the pitches for caravans and tents. A few motorhome and touring pitches are extra comfortable. If you stay on one of these luxury pitches, you will have (heated) private sanitary facilities. All pitches are spacious.

Zeeland beaches

Is any coast more beautiful than the coast of Zeeland? Lots of people born and bred in Zeeland will say no to this. And they certainly are justifiably proud of their Zeeland beaches. These are wide, extremely long and pristine. An ideal spot for a swim or a walk, but you can also make endless cycling tours along the beaches and on the dykes. Incidentally, you can hire a bicycle from the campsite, if you have not brought your own along. From the campsite to the beach is about six kilometers.

properties.name: Domaine du Bocq
properties.description:
Note to nature lovers and those seeking tranquillity! On the adventurous campsite Domaine du Bocq, you camp right in the heart of the Belgian Ardennes. For complete peace and quiet, this is the place to be, but there is also plenty to do. From the campsite, discover all the beauty the area has to offer.

Pitches and accommodations

You can choose from a variety of camping pitches and fields, glamping options and cosy gîtes. So it's entirely up to you whether you pitch your tent right next to the river Le Bocq, or choose a more luxurious option. All around, you have views of green hills and you can even rent fire bowls to make a campfire. Cosy camping doesn't get any cosier. And dogs are allowed here too!

Tranquillity and adventure

Don't be fooled by the quiet atmosphere on the campsite, because there is plenty to do here for young and old alike. Fancy an adventure? The campsite offers lots of activities, such as rock climbing, scootering through the hills or learning archery. Or rent a mountain bike and explore the area yourself! Take a dip in the river, play a game in the café or live it up on the beach volleyball or football pitch.

After an active day, visit the terrace of the campsite restaurant. Here you can order tasty local beers and appetisers or a simple meal. This is also the place to be if you want fresh rolls in the morning! After dinner, you can enjoy another drink while the children play in the playground.

properties.name: Baia Holiday Piccola Gardiola
properties.description:
Baia Holiday Piccola Gardiola is on the mountainous west coast of Lake Garda. Here, you camp in the less touristy part of the lake, it's wonderfully quiet. The small campsite mainly consists of modern lodges, of which some have a private whirlpool. There are also some pitches right by the lake.

Luxury lodge with whirlpool

The name says it all: Baia Holiday Piccola Gardiola is a very small campsite. The campsite mainly consists of modern lodges. Several of the accommodations have added luxury: a whirlpool on the patio. The site is against a hill, so that even the accommodation that are located slightly to the rear have views of the water.

Small-scale luxury

The pitches at the campsite offer stunning views of the lake. They also offer all the necessary luxuries: each pitch has its own private sanitary facilities and parking space.

Patio with lake views

 As you could expect, the bar with its large patio is right by the lake. There are lovely seats and sun loungers with parasols on the slightly higher sun deck. Here, you can get a tasty snack on a spot in the sun or shade, while enjoying the views. There are several large supermarkets within a five-kilometre radius.

properties.name: Løkken Maritime Naturcamp Vestkystcamping
properties.description:
Løkken Vestkyst Camping is in the north of Denmark, close to the old fishing village of Løkken. This is a child-friendly campsite in the countryside that exudes simplicity. The North Jutland Region has not yet been discovered by the masses so you will find space, quiet and unspoiled nature. There are several lovely nature reserves in the area. The landscape mainly consists of open plains. You can easily walk to the broad sandy beach that is only 500 metres from the friendly campsite. Children can have plenty of fun playing at the campsite in the playground, during a game of miniature golf or on the trampoline.

Camping by the sea

At Løkken Vestkyst Camping, you camp on neat grass fields surrounded by various planting, with the murmur of the sea in the background. You can safely call the camping pitches generous, with dimensions up to 150 m². The feeling of space is emphasised by the lack of demarcation. The toilet and washing facilities are not new, but they are clean and there are plans for a second toilet block. If you would like to spend the night in a chalet or hired tent, you will find neat basic accommodation.

Tasty and local food

You can find a spot at the campsite's bistro and enjoy a schnitzel, chicken, sausages or burger and chips. Rather have a fish pizza, that's on the menu too. Not only can you buy tasty bread rolls for breakfast in the small shop, but also locally made produce such as honey, potatoes, jam, wine and beer. You can even get a complete breakfast to take away.

properties.name: Campingplatz Storchencamp Rust
properties.description:
The Storchencamp Rust campsite is located near the town of Rust (Northern Burgenland).If you want to enjoy an active holiday as well as peace and quiet, you are in the right place at this campsite. From active water sports and cycling through the impressive countryside to relaxing by the lake in the sunbathing area with deckchairs and parasols.

Camping and rental accommodations

At the Storchencamp Rust campsite you can camp with your tent, caravan or motorhome. The pitches are spacious and bordered by greenery, giving you plenty of privacy. There are special spaces for motorhomes. If you do not have your own camping equipment, you can stay in a fully equipped tipi tent or in a luxury mobile home.

Plenty of water sports

The campsite's trump card is undoubtedly its special location by the lake. The campsite rents out boats and a hundred metres away you can do numerous water sports. You can also swim in the public swimming pool next to the campsite. As a guest of the Storchencamp Rust campsite entry is free.

Always something to do

Although there is no entertainment team, you can have fun with all kinds of activities on and around the campsite. There is a children's playground, sports field, table tennis table, volleyball court and miniature golf course. Rent a boat and explore the Neusiedler See or maybe you will try your hand at paddle boarding, canoeing or kayaking.

Eating at the lake

If you don't feel like cooking, you can eat and drink at the restaurant of the water sports club with a view of the lake. For fresh rolls at breakfast just knock on the door of the campsite bakery.

properties.name: Camping Le Querce
properties.description:
Camping Le Querce is located in a wooded area in the Apennines, between Bologna and Florence. The campsite is dotted with large oaks from which this peaceful campsite takes its name. In the hilly terrain some terraces have been created. From the spacious pitches under the trees you have a beautiful view of the wooded hills surrounding the campsite.

Under the trees

The campsite, which measures no less than twelve hectares, is wooded and hilly. The pitches are not equally flat everywhere, but fortunately some terraces have been laid out for camper vans and caravans. You camp here on the grass, in the shade of the large deciduous trees. Actually, it's always quiet on this campsite, but there's more activity around the swimming pool.

Cosy sunbathing lawn

The spacious grounds are landscaped around a large sunbathing lawn, with a beautiful swimming pool in the middle. You have a beautiful view of the surroundings. In high season this is the cosy centre of the campsite. There is a bar where you can get drinks, snacks and ice creams. There are sun loungers and parasols, and the trees provide the necessary shade. In short, everything you need on an Italian summer's day.

Good food

Camping Le Querce has a small shop with a limited supply of groceries. There's a small supermarket five kilometres from the campsite, but for your larger purchases you'll have to drive a little further. For a good restaurant you don't have to leave the campsite. Against the hill is a large restaurant, where you can sit on the cosy terrace for a simple but tasteful meal.

properties.name: Gitavillage Club degli Amici
properties.description:
Gitavillage Club degli Amici is a friendly family campsite in Pescia Romana, on the coast of the Maremma region of southern Tuscany. Here you camp right by the sea, in a quiet and green environment, mostly visited by Italian tourists. The campsite offers spacious, shaded pitches and a variety of accommodation. Nearby, you will discover Etruscan excavations and charming villages. Ideal for families and those seeking tranquillity who love nature and culture.

Shaded pitches and comfortable cottages

The pitches on the green site are spacious and mostly surrounded by trees, providing plenty of shade. In the new section, the spots are a bit sunnier. For those seeking comfort, bungalows and wooden chalets are available. These are simply but nicely furnished. The layout of the site is uncluttered, providing a peaceful atmosphere and privacy.

Practical facilities for young and old

The campsite has a small supermarket for daily shopping and a restaurant where you can enjoy a traditional Italian meal. As a child-friendly campsite with activities and entertainment, it is also ideal for families with children. In the high season, you'll mainly find Italian families here. Youngsters entertain themselves on the sports fields. There is a relaxed family atmosphere on the campsite.

Discover Maremma and its past

Gitavillage Club degli Amici is a short distance from numerous Etruscan sites, such as Tarquinia (28 km) and Vulci (25 km). The atmospheric fishing village of Capalbio is also just 18 km away. For those who love nature, the Maremma Natural Park (42 km) is a must.

properties.name: Camping Penisola Verde
properties.description:
Campsite Penisola Verde is a little campsite right on the south-west bank of the beautiful Lake Caldonazzo, surrounded by an exquisite mountain landscape. The campsite has its own pebble beach with two swimming docks. In the surrounding area you can enjoy some wonderful cycling on mostly flat paths. You can also go for a hike in the mountains. The lake is suitable for water sports.

Beautiful view

The location of the property on the water is beautiful. The campsites vary, both in size and view as well as in price. There are spacious pitches with beautiful views over the lake (A location), small pitches close together in the middle section (B location) and a field with pitches at the back (C location). There are also a number of mobile homes for rent.

Warm, clear water

Lake Caldonazzo is known for being the warmest mountain lake in the Alps. Furthermore, the water is so clean that it has received an international "Blue Flag" certification. There are many opportunities for water sports and a sectioned-off swimming area.

Not to be missed

Everything on and around the lake is fun if you like water sports, cycling and hiking. Particularly fun is the cycle path along the western shore of the lake, which eventually leads to a cycle path along the Brenta River via meadows and forest roads. Hiking in the foothills of the Dolomites is also a good idea. Looking for more liveliness than the villages of Calceranica and Caldonazzo? Then visit Levico, 7 km away. Heading towards this town, you'll also pass a cheaper supermarket.

properties.name: Camping Waikiki
properties.description:
Camping Waikiki is situated in Lido di Jesolo surrounded by pine trees. This is the place to be for lovers of both a quiet and an active holiday. You can easily walk from the campsite to the beach of the Adriatic Sea. And with Venice less than an hour's drive away, the cultural aspect is also not overlooked.

Beautiful, demarcated pitches in the shade

Camping Waikiki has around 20 touring pitches and some 200 rental accommodation units. These are mostly mobile homes for up to five persons. The touring pitches are also very comfortable: the large number of pine trees provide a lovely shade.

A refreshing dive in the pool or the sea

The Italian sun is ideal to work on your tan. In summer the temperature regularly reaches more than thirty degrees. For the necessary refreshment you can go to the outdoor swimming pool. There is also a separate children's pool with water slide and equipment. The direct location on the sea makes this campsite ideal for the water sports enthusiast.

Entertainment

In addition to water activities, there is enough to do on the campsite. The entertainment team works almost all day to keep young and old busy. The mini club takes care of the little ones. There is fun to be had for all in the playground and with the many sports facilities (table tennis, volleyball, mini golf, fitness).

Italian Cuisine

Groceries and handy camping items are available in the small supermarket on the campsite. Don't feel like cooking today? Come and have a bite to eat in restaurant Kiki!

properties.name: Camping Alpenfreude
properties.description:
Camping with a view. That is what you can expect when you stay on campsite Alpenfreude, situated near the village of Sankt Georgen. You can admire the magnificent mountain peaks from every conceivable angle. Enjoy fine food, visit attractive mountain villages and go for a ride over the Alpine roads when you spend your vacation here. Let the holiday begin!

Down the slide

The municipal swimming pool is located next to the campsite. The swimming pool is surrounded by trees and mountains. Whichever way you look, you always have a feeling of being amidst nature. Another great feature is that the swimming pool is heated, so you can still enjoy a swim later on in the season or in spring. Not to mention the large water slide, of course! Around the swimming pool there is a spacious lawn to spread your towel.

Entertainment for the whole family

Bored? No such thing on campsite Alpenfreude! Children can enjoy themselves in one of the playgrounds or kick a ball around on the multi-sports field. There is no entertainment programme.

Ready for a physical challenge? The mountains beckon you to go on a hike. The KärntenCard is also available for purchase at reception. This card entitles you to discounts or free admission to many attractions and mountain railways.

Campsite restaurant with terrace

Fine food is inextricably linked to a great holiday. The campsite restaurant certainly takes this into account. The restaurant has an extensive menu with regional specialities. And don't forget to enjoy the splendid view of the surrounding mountains from the terrace.

properties.name: Club del Sole Tenuta Primero Grado Family Coll.
properties.description:
Tenuta Primero Grado Family Resort is located in a beautiful nature reserve with a lagoon and sandy beach on the Gulf of Trieste near Grado. You will stay in luxurious accommodation here. The campsite features an outdoor swimming pool, golf course, marina, water park and a water sports school. And there is an extensive entertainment programme! Fancy an Italian meal? Then you can visit one of the two restaurants.

Luxury accommodation

If you like a bit of comfort, this is the place for you. You can choose from a range of luxury accommodation options. There are hotel suites with a large double bed and beautiful bathrooms. Some rooms even have a sea view. It is also possible to rent a modern mobile home, which come in various types and sizes. And finally, there are bungalows. In these cosy cottages, you can enjoy a wonderful holiday with the whole family.

Swimming pool or beach?

You can enjoy a swim in the beautiful swimming pool with several whirlpools. There are paddling pools for small children. After swimming, sun loungers and parasols are available for you to relax. And for a refreshing drink, head to the pool bar. Are you a beach lover? The campsite is located directly on a quiet lagoon and the Adriatic Sea. This means there are also many water sports opportunities, such as kitesurfing and sailing.

Two restaurants

There are no fewer than two restaurants at this campsite. Enjoy a delicious meal with the whole family at the Terrazza Mare Restaurant. The terrace offers stunning views of the sea. Prefer something a little more sophisticated? Restaurant Al Casone, located next to the golf course, serves refined Italian cuisine.

properties.name: Campingplatz Passrucker
properties.description:
Campingplatz Passrucker is beautifully located on the outskirts of Altenmarkt, Salzburg, amid breathtaking mountain scenery. This small, well-kept campsite is open all year round. It’s ideal for walking and cycling in summer and the perfect base for winter sports in the winter.

Comfortable pitches

The pitches at Campingplatz Passrucker are large and not separated, creating a sense of freedom. Whether you arrive with a tent, caravan or motor home, you’ll find there’s plenty of space. On arrival, you will be warmly welcomed by the owners. The campsite is ideal for campers who are passing through but also for anyone who wants to stay longer.

Swim with a great view

At Campingplatz Passrucker, you’ll find a small but good swimming pool, perfect for a refreshing dip after a day of activities. From the campsite, you can enjoy stunning views of the surrounding mountains. Children will have fun on the playground, trampoline, go-karts or football pitch. There’s a small shop where you can buy drinks and takeaway meals, and there are fresh rolls as well. The cosy village of Altenmarkt im Pongau with shops and restaurants is close by too.

Walking and winter sports

There are endless opportunities for adventure in the immediate surroundings of Campingplatz Passrucker. Visit the local thermal spa for a day of relaxation, or set off on one of the many cycling and walking trails the mountainous region has to offer. In winter, the region is ideal for winter sports, with numerous ski resorts within easy reach.

properties.name: Campingplatz Niemeyer
properties.description:
Campingplatz Niemeyer is in the quiet village of Mardorf, in Lower Saxony, 300 metres from beautiful Lake Steinhude. This campsite is also an ideal home base for nature lovers, water sports enthusiasts and families. With its well-kept pitches, modern amenities and various recreational options in the surrounding area, there is something for everyone. Whether planning a short stay or a longer holiday, Campingplatz Niemeyer combines comfort with a beautiful location.

Spacious pitches in a green setting

The campsite has well-kept pitches suitable for tents, caravans and motorhomes. Each pitch has an electricity connection. You choose a pitch that suits your camping equipment and the space you need. The quiet atmosphere and natural surroundings soon make you feel right at home.

Clean toilet and washing facilities with sauna

Campingplatz Niemeyer has clean toilet and washing facilities, a small kiosk and a playground for the youngest guests. The toilet block is also a sauna with a relaxation area. The campsite attracts both active holidaymakers and families with young children who appreciate tranquillity and nature. Dogs are permitted, which means your four-legged friend will enjoy himself too.

Explore Steinhude and its lake

The area around campsite offers numerous options. Water sports enthusiasts can indulge themselves at Lake Steinhude. Motorboats are not permitted on the lake, which means that you can go swimming, standup paddleboarding, windsurfing, kitesurfing, rowing and go on a pedal boat in peace and safely.

The lively village of Steinhude (22 km) is on the southern banks of the lake and is certainly worth a visit. Bird lovers can admire the Meerbruch nature reserve (13 km).

properties.name: Odenwald River Camp
properties.description:
Like camping in greenery and by the water? Odenwald River Camp is beautifully located on a tributary of the Rhine, the Neckar. The surroundings are peaceful and you camp within walking distance of the village of Neckargerach. The young owners have added modern facilities to the campsite and transformed it into an atmospheric campsite. This south-western part of Germany is known as a popular destination for cyclists and walking enthusiasts, partly because of its beautiful nature.

River-side pitches

Odenwald River Camp is a neat and tidy campsite and has about 70 flat pitches on large grassy fields. The riverside pitches add to the camping experience. The baby changing room is handy for young families. At the edge of the campsite, there are some tepees with a campfire area and communal grill.

Bar with living-room atmosphere

The welcoming bar, which has a terrace, has lovely light furniture. It’s the perfect place to experience a living-room feel. Head here in the morning for a tasty breakfast and a good cup of coffee. Later in the day, snacks, small meals, soft drinks, wine and beer are served too. Interesting fact: waste separation is taken seriously on the campsite.

Top nature destination

The campsite is right next to the Neckar. You can go kayaking, paddle boarding or canoeing on this flowing river. Boats also often sail by, which is fun to watch. Would you like to swim? Then head to the indoor pool nearby. Odenwald River Camp is perfect for campers who like cycling and walking.

properties.name: Campingplatz Platzermühle
properties.description:
Campingplatz Platzermühle is located in the hilly landscape of Bavaria, in the east of Germany and close to the Czech border. This small-scale terraced campsite is an ideal holiday destination for those looking for peace and quiet. For total relaxation, the Sibyllenbad spa, with its thermal baths, hammams and sunbathing areas, is the perfect destination.

In Bavaria's rolling countryside

Well-tended terraces with grassy soil offer 44 spacious touring pitches. Almost all pitches are shaded by tall trees, while some have a view of the surrounding hills of the gentle Bavarian landscape. In addition to the touring pitches, you also have to share the tidy campsite with annual guests, who occupy the 22 permanent pitches. For a special night's stay, the wine barrels are great rental accommodations.

Fresh rolls

If you want to be sure of a tasty breakfast in the morning, make use of the bread roll service. The fresh rolls are delivered to the door of your camping means.

Sanitary

The sanitary facilities on the campsite are modern. It offers camping guests comfort and space. Moreover, the sanitary facilities are kept very clean and tidy, so that every camper can use clean showers and toilets on a daily basis.

Sibyllenbad spa

Those looking for peace and quiet will feel right at home at Platzermühle and its surroundings. The hills radiate peace and the forests are wonderful hiking areas. If you want to relax even more, head to Sibyllenbad. In this large spa west of Neualbenreuth, you can enjoy various massages, bathe in the hammam or thermal baths and take in the fresh outdoor air while stretching out on one of the sunbathing lawns.

properties.name: Camping Clausensee
properties.description:
Camping Clausensee is located in the vast wooded areas of the northern Vosges, just outside the town of Waldfischbach-Burgalben (Rijnland-Palts). You camp here in a wonderfully quiet spot from where you can follow great hiking and cycling trails through the Pfälzerwald (Palatine Forest). The sunbathing area by the recreational lake is the biggest eye-catcher at this beautifully kept campsite.

What accommodation options are there?

At Camping Clausensee, you can book a stay on a spacious pitch or in a cosy hiker's cabin or a mobile home. Regular pitches are available for touring campsite visitors. The campsite also has special motorhome pitches and a meadow for campsite visitors with tents. If you would rather rent an accommodation, the Blaues Haus (Blue House) comes highly recommended. This charming furnished holiday home is right next to the lake.

Plenty of water recreation on and around the Clausensee

The Schwarzbach river causes a pleasant stream flows through the campsite. One of the winding side branches discharges into the Clausensee. The campsite has a great sunbathing area in front of this recreational lake. Here you can enjoy the outdoor life by the lake on the grass or in the sand, where you can swim safely. The water remains shallow for quite a distance. You can also go on the lake on a pedal boat or an SUP board, both of which can be rented at the campsite.

Lovers of yoga will also feel at home here. Yoga classes are also often offered at this campsite. If you want more of a challenge, book a yoga lesson on an SUP board in the middle of the lake! A relaxing day can be closed off at the campsite restaurant Fischerhaus am Clausensee with its charming Biergarten (beer garden).

properties.name: Camping Resort Rülzheim
properties.description:
Camping Resort Rülzheim is in the heart of the green Palatinate countryside and you’ll feel like you’re on holiday straight away. Whether you’re an old hand or a complete novice: this is the place for you. You camp in quiet, natural surroundings. Walk to the nearby swimming lake for a refreshing dip. Children will enjoy the playground and the petting zoo.

Sleep in a wine barrel or rooftop tent

The accommodation here is a little different. You can sleep in a wine barrel, rooftop tent or a so-called witch's house. There are large pitches for campers who prefer to use their own tent, caravan or motor home. These offer plenty of freedom and are suitable for both small motor homes and large caravans.

Swim in the lake

From Camping Resort Rülzheim, it’s a short walk to the nearby swimming lake. For a small contribution, you can take a refreshing dip here and laze about on the beach. Children can have fun in the playground and cuddle animals at the petting zoo. In the meantime, you can play a game of beach volleyball, boules or table tennis. In the morning, you can order fresh rolls for breakfast from the bread-roll service. Fun: live music evenings are organised occasionally during the holiday period.

Explore the surrounding area

There’s plenty to discover outside the campsite too. Get on your bike and ride along the Rhein cycle path, right through the rolling wine landscape. You can also take beautiful walks in the local area. For a day of culture, visit the historic city centre of Speyer (28 km).

properties.name: Camping Pressegger See
properties.description:
Lake Pressegger is a beautiful lake in Carinthia, the sunny state in southern Austria. Here you can enjoy nature, the water and the beaches. Just northeast of the lake is the pleasant Camping Pressegger See. This campsite has its own beach and sunbathing area on the water.

Camping between the Carnic Alps

Here, you'll be camping amidst beautiful views of the wooded mountains. Most pitches are nice and spacious (70-150 m2), but have little demarcation. There are trees that provide shade here and there. There are fifty touring pitches in total. If you don't have your own camping equipment, you can rent one of the apartments.

Water fun in and on the lake

The greatest advantage of this campsite is its location by Lake Pressegger. You can quickly walk from your camping pitch to the private beach and sunbathing area. Lake Pressegger is relatively shallow (thirteen metres at its deepest), and in summer the temperature is very pleasant (26 degrees). Guests come here mainly to swim, snorkel, row or pedal boat. You'll also find many water sports enthusiasts here, as they love to show off their windsurfing and sailing skills. At the campsite, you can rent surfboards, pedal boats and rowboats.

Fresh bread

The campsite shop sells fresh bread and pastries. There are also some other food products and local produce for sale. A larger supermarket is about a ten-minute drive away. There is no restaurant on the campsite, but there is one near the lake.

properties.name: Campingpark Sanssouci
properties.description:
Just outside of Potsdam, in the Havel Lake District, you'll find the quality campsite Campingpark Sanssouci. Directly on Lake Templin and among the trees you really have the feeling of camping in the midst of nature, while Potsdam and Berlin are nearby. Don't want to go to town, but want to see the surrounding area? The nature is beautiful and perfect for a nice cycle tour. You can bring your own boat and take a surfing course. Children can even join a surf camp one weekend!

Surfing, swimming and lazing about

Because your camping site is right on a large lake, water fun is guaranteed. You can play on the beach in the fine sand and next to the beach there is a grass meadow for lazing around.

All kinds of water activities are arranged for the kids. How about a course in surfing, canoeing or stand up paddling (SUP)? When children are between 9 and 14, they can take part in a surf camp lasting from Friday to Sunday, to really get surfing under their belts.

Ideal for a visit to Potsdam and Berlin

From the campsite you can practically see Potsdam, this is how close the campsite is to this historic city. It's less than a half hour away by bike. Berlin is a bit further, but is easy to reach with public transport. Get on the shuttle bus at the campsite which will take you to the closest stop for public transport, and in 45 minutes you're in the heart of Berlin.

properties.name: Camping La Croix Badeau
properties.description:
Champagne-Ardennes is a rural region in Northern France with a large number of small farming villages and vast fields. Camping La Croix Badeau is situated on the outskirts of Soulaines-Dhuys, a village intersected by the Laine River. There are several bridges over the river as well as beautiful half-timbered houses on the water. The region has several beautiful nature reserves around large lakes. In the vicinity of those are all kinds of lovely sights and museums.

Quiet, neat and green

La Croix Badeau is a small, very quiet and neat campsite. The grounds are remarkably green. There are bushes, trees and flowers everywhere. The pitches, demarcated by hedges, are well maintained. There are special caravan and camper van pitches with a surface of stone chippings and adjacent a stretch of lawn as seating area. There are several types of rental accommodation. The sanitary facilities are adequate and kept clean and tidy.

Swimming pool with terrace

The campsite is appreciated by seekers of peace. There is a small outdoor swimming pool to cool off on hot days. Around the pool is a tiled terrace with tables and sun umbrellas. The fencing offers protection from the wind.

Snack bar

For those who fancy a bite to eat there is a snack bar on the campsite. You can enjoy your snack and drinks at leisure on the modest terrace. You can order bread on the campsite. In the village is a shop for basic necessities within walking distance from the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Le Pyrénéen
properties.description:
Camping Le Pyrénéen is located in the heart of the Pyrenees. On this friendly, small-scale site, you'll be camping with a view of the mountain peaks, on a green and well-kept terrain. Young and old will have a great time on the campsite. For example, take a dip in the heated outdoor pool or play a game of petanque. The cosy restaurant is the centre of communal dinners and bingo evenings.

View of the Pyrenees

The small-scale campsite has 36 touring pitches. The many trees and shrubs provide intimate pitches, which are delimited by hedges. The very well-kept pitches provide a lot of privacy. Besides the touring pitches there are 15 mobile homes, also situated in the greenery. No matter how you camp: the view of the peaks of the Pyrenees and the fresh mountain air will make you feel completely at ease.

Heated swimming pool

For young and old there is plenty to do on the campsite. In the middle of a beautiful sun deck lies the heated outdoor swimming pool. Especially for the small-scale character of the campsite this is a spacious swimming pool. Everyone can enjoy the water and the sun here, even the little ones. For them there is a paddling pool. You can also play jeu-de-boules while your children enjoy themselves in the adjoining playground..

Conviviality in the restaurant

The campsite has a friendly atmosphere. You will also find this atmosphere in the restaurant, with a terrace overlooking the swimming pool. In addition to eating french fries or pizza, you can find conviviality in the restaurant during joint theme meals or bingo evenings.

properties.name: Camping Le Manoir de Bezolle
properties.description:
This campsite is highly recommended for those who prefer to use their holiday to fully recharge their batteries in a natural environment. Here you'll be camping in the middle of a large nature reserve in the Morvan, in the Bourgogne-Franche-Comté region of central France. This is a beautiful area to discover on foot or by bike. Camping Le Manoir de Bezolle is also subtly integrated in nature. The campsite features a cosy restaurant and two large outdoor swimming pools.

Camping in a natural ambiance

Driving from the campsite entrance to the reception, you'll immediately notice that this is a spacious campsite with an abundance of greenery. The huge camping pitches are beautifully integrated into nature. The touring pitches and hillside accommodations offer beautiful views over the Morvan.

Two surprisingly large outdoor pools

The campsite's two outdoor swimming pools are located behind the reception. These swimming pools are really quite large, especially considering the capacity of this campsite. So you'll have enough space in the pool to swim some laps. There's also a paddling pool for the youngest campers. A beautiful grass sunbathing area surrounds the swimming pools.

Sports activities, farm animals and evening entertainment

In addition to swimming, you can also enjoy playing table tennis, pétanque and mini golf at this campsite. Le Manoir de Bezolle also has a beautiful playground and an animal meadow, where children can playfully meet fun farm animals.

properties.name: Campasun Mas de Pierredon
properties.description:
Located about three kilometres from the sea and the centre of Sanary-sur-Mer, you will find Campasun Mas de Pierredon campsite. It is in a very favourable place for taking great trips in the Var and to cities such as Toulon, Marseille or Hyères. The town of Sanary-sur-Mer itself has an authentic harbour, where you will see the fishermen sail in with their fresh catches if you get up early enough. You will have no trouble keeping yourself entertained at the campsite either, in the spacious swimming pool for instance.

The campsite is situated in a wonderful natural green environment and it is ideal for campers who like a sunny destination. Campasun Mas de Pierredon is easy to reach from the motorway and because the campsite is quite close to the motorway, you may hear it on occasion.

Private toilet and washing facilities and accommodation with a hot tub

There are various camping pitches at the Campasun Mas de Pierredon campsite. The ‘Confort’ pitches are approximately 80m2, ‘Grand Confort’ are 120m2 and there are camping pitches with private toilet and washing facilities. These pitches are demarcated by natural planting. The campsite's sanitary facilities have self-cleaning toilets, showers and wash cabins.

Furthermore, on the campsite you can choose from different types of rental accommodation. Unique to this campsite are the chalets and mobile homes with a private hot tub.

Children’s club, aqua gym and sports tournaments

In the months of July and August entertainment is provided at Campasun Mas de Pierredon. At the children’s club children of various ages can do all kinds of activities, such as crafts and games.
