Furthermore, in the high season you can take part in the aqua gym in the mornings and various sports tournaments are organised for young and old. There are varied theme nights in the evenings.

properties.name: Camping Le Champ du Moulin
properties.description:
Camping Le Champ du Moulin is located i.In the high mountains of the French Alps, in the north of the Parc National des Écrins. From the spacious campsite, popular with mountain lovers, you have a panoramic view of the surrounding Alps. These mighty mountains offer campers many sporting challenges.

Camping with panoramic view

The campsite is divided into several well-kept lawns, which can be reached via straight paths. On these lawns there are spacious touring pitches, which all have a beautiful panoramic view of the Alps. Some of the fifty touring pitches are shaded by large trees, others are in the sun. Because there are no hedges for demarcation, you lack a bit of privacy. You can also spend the night in classic mobile homes and chalets or in an apartment in the large mountain hut.

Outdoor pool with water slide

Outside the campsite there is a large outdoor swimming pool, open during the summer months. This competition pool is certainly popular with campers that like to swim a few laps The large and winding water slide offers the perfect adventure for children. Even when the summer is a bit colder you can take a dip in this heated pool.

Organic dishes

The facilities on the campsite are simple, but complete. There are plenty of sanitary facilities, which are cleaned regularly. And in the main building, the mountain hut that is so typical of this area, you'll find a small supermarket. The food sold here is mainly organic. At the restaurant, which is also located in the main building, the dishes that are served are prepared with mainly organic ingredients.

properties.name: Camping San Damiano
properties.description:
On the North-East coast of Corsica, situated directly at the seaside, lies the well-tended camping San Damiano on a small promontory south of Bastia. The pitches are located in the pine forest, are spacious, quite shady and are separated by hedges. The pitches near the beach are less spacious and have no electricity. The dozens of rental accommodations are separate from the camping pitches.

Swimming in the sea or swimming pool

Families with young children from all over Europe are often drawn to camping in the vicinity of the Lido de Marana sandy beach. The average temperature of the seawater in summer is 25 degrees. The beach slopes gently into the sea so that children can play safely in the water.

On the campsite itself, there is a large swimming pool and a toddler pool. Activities are organised in the swimming pool, such as water aerobics and swimming in the dark. Children can amuse themselves to their heart's content in the swimming pool with slides, on the generously-sized swings and the large trampoline. In high season, an entertainment programme is offered in French and there are disco evenings.

Sporting events on the campsite

You can play table tennis, beach volleyball and jeu de boules. There are competitions on a regular basis. You can also take part in water aerobics, step sports, Zumba fitness and yoga lessons. Near the campsite, you will find moderately heavy cycling routes and a fishing spot.

8 am to 8 pm supermarket

At the entrance, there is a supermarket, well-stocked for a camping shop and with fresh bread. The restaurant offers a wide choice of regional products and pizzas. In the evenings you can dance in the Cocoon, watch a performance or join in the karaoke or a quiz. Important sporting events are shown here on a large screen.

properties.name: Camping Les Hautes Prairies
properties.description:
Camping Les Hautes Prairies is located in the Vaucluse, south of Luberon. You can go on some fun day trips in the area. This well-known touristic region is full of fun sightseeing opportunities, such as castles, vineyards, and charming villages.

Pleasant and tranquil atmosphere

The campsite grounds are well cared-for and rich in flowers. At the spacious reception, which also has tourist brochures available, you will receive a warm welcome. On your way to your pitch, you will experience the peace and tranquility that is characteristic of this campsite. The spacious camping pitches are separated by shrubs and trees and have sufficient shade. A few of the pitches offer a beautiful view of the valley. Slightly less alluring are the pitches situated next to the road.

There are two sanitary blocks in which self-cleaning toilets have been installed. The campsite also offers accommodations for rent. There are mobile homes and chalets, but you can also book a hotel room.

Long water slide and loungers for relaxation

In the peak season, you will find an international mix of people on Camping Les Hautes Prairies. There are especially many hikers and backpackers. In the low season, you will share the camping grounds with campers looking for peace and quiet. There is a large and relatively deep swimming pool with a water slide and a view of the mountains.

Charming restaurant

The campsite features a restaurant with a terrace. The menu is simple and offers a selection of regional dishes. There are also pizzas and takeaways available. There is also a shop for the most basic supplies. For your daily shopping, you can visit the supermarket at the Centre commercial, approximately 3 kilometres outside the village.

properties.name: Camping des Gorges de la Méouge
Campasun Parc Mogador
properties.description:
If you are looking for a relaxed camping holiday along the mediterranean coast, the family campsite Campasun Parc Mogador, about 800 metres from the beach, offers everything you are looking for. There is a heated swimming pool with sun loungers and parasols, a Jacuzzi, a charming restaurant and the centre of Sanary-sur-Mer (2 km) is nearby.

Pitches among the greenery

The pitches at Campasun Parc Mogador are around 80 m2 and encircled by natural green, giving you the necessary privacyh. There are two types of pitches: Grand Confort (electricity, water and drain) and Confort (electricity).

The campsite also offers several mobile homes, equipped with modern amenities such as air conditioning and wifi. The mobile homes vary in size from 20 m2 (with one bedroom) to 34 m2 (with three bedrooms). You can choose from different models. What they all have in common is that they have a cosy and covered terrace.

Bubbles in the Jacuzzi

Campasun Parc Mogador has excellent amenities. Go for a swim in the heated swimming pool. There is a separate paddling pool for the little ones. The swimming pool is surrounded by chaise longues with parasols for that extra bit of relaxation and shade. There is also a Jacuzzi where you can enjoy the bubbles.

Your daily shopping can be done at the small shop. Not in the mood to cook? Treat yourself to a meal in the restaurant, which offers a varied menu at a reasonable price. The campsite excels further with its clean (self-cleaning) toilet facilities.

properties.name: La Salvinie
properties.description:
Just outside Terrasson-Lavilledieu, a friendly village in the Périgord Noir (eastern Dordogne), is La Salvinie. Here, you camp in a wonderfully quiet setting, in a hilly, wooded environment and right by the Vézère River. This is the ideal base for discovering the beauty of the Dordogne. There is also plenty to do on this small family campsite. For example, there is a lovely outdoor pool, a varied entertainment programme, a large playground and sports facilities.

Spacious pitches with lots of privacy

As a camper, do you think it is important to have enough space and privacy? The shaded campsite has large touring pitches separated by high hedges. In the middle of the campsite is a large toilet block, where private toilets and showers are available in low season. Still prefer your own kitchen and bathroom? Book a stay in a modern mobile home or safari tent.

Plenty of water fun, sports and conviviality

Next to the toilet and shower building, you will find a fun shaped outdoor pool. Young children have fun in the shallow end here, while adults relax in the hot tub. The double slide that exits into the heated water of the pool provides fun for the whole family. Fancy even more sporting entertainment? Have a game of volleyball, table tennis or jeu de boules, do some exercises in the outdoor gym or take part in the revolutionary game of home ball. There is also plenty of entertainment in high season, including shows and theme nights for the whole family. Want to take it a little easier? Go to the bar and borrow a board game or a good book for free.

properties.name: Camping Voraparc
properties.description:
Campsite Voraparc is situated in the Spanish Pyrenees, at the entrance of the large National Park Aigüestortes i Estany de Sant Maurici. This peaceful mountain campsite, located at an altitude of 1400 m, is truly picturesque. The camping grounds are located along a river, at the end of a valley and in the midst of a veritable walking paradise. The view of the surrounding mountains is breathtaking. The campsite is well maintained, with lots of grass and deciduous trees. The grounds are laid out on a few terraces.

Shaded pitches

The campsite is green, attractively designed and well maintained. The shaded pitches are laid out on level grassy fields. They vary quite substantially in size (70-150 m²). You should, therefore, choose a spot which is sufficiently large for your camping equipment. Deciduous trees provide shade and privacy. Most pitches offer ample shade, but you can also opt for a sunnier spot. 

Swimming pool in nature

Campsite Voraparc has a small, octagonal swimming pool with a toddler pool. The outdoor swimming pool is located in the middle of a sunbathing lawn. The surrounding deciduous trees provide some shade. In high season this is an ideal spot for swimming or relaxing after an active day in the mountains. The panoramic view of the surrounding mountains is breathtaking. And the sound of the roaring river completes this experience of nature. 

Active holiday

Most campers are sports inclined and love the great outdoors. They like to stay on the campsite for walks in the area, kayaking or rafting. The river flowing along the campsite lends itself excellently to adventurous watersports. In addition to whitewater rafting, you can engage in horseback riding, bungee jumping and quad biking. In peak season, the campsite offers an excursion programme as well as guided walking tours.

properties.name: Nantes Camping
properties.description:
The Nantes Camping campsite is the ideal place to get to know the colourful side of Nantes. Discover this artistic and creative city on the Loire with the historic Château des ducs de Bretagne. The cosy city camping ground is located in the north of Nantes, on a narrow and elongated site along a stream in the municipal park. The spacious camping pitches are shaded by trees, and comfortable chalets and cottages are available for rent.

Nature in the city

The spacious pitches at the Nantes Camping campsite are almost all under trees. Pitches for tent campers are on the grassy field; the other pitches have a paved surface. You can also choose to stay in a comfortable chalet or holiday cottage.

“Guinguette” Le Bivouac

With the city of Nantes all around you, you will naturally find many amenities already nearby. So you'll never have to walk far to reach a supermarket, eatery or café. But there's also plenty to do at the campsite. For the kids, there is a playground, and for some family entertainment, there is a bocce court and a miniature golf course.

At “Guinguette” Le Bivouac, simple home-cooked dishes are served. You can enjoy a refreshing drink on the bar’s terrace. During the summer season, entertainment evenings are organised almost every day.

Water park

The campsite has a heated outdoor swimming pool with a water play area, a relaxation room and a private hammam. Camping guests can also use the municipal swimming pool right across from the property for free. And it's not just any pool. Le Petit Port is a complete indoor water park with heated pools, a lovely sunbathing area and the spectacular "Black Hole" slide no less than 76 metres long. For younger children, there is a separate pool with its own children's slide.

properties.name: Le Pavillon
properties.description:
Le Pavillon is on the outskirts of the town of La Mothe-Achard in the Vendée (France). Here, you camp on a tree-filled site in an area mainly filled with vast meadows. You can plenty of great excursions in the area. You are only 20 kilometres from the charming coastal resort of Les Sables-d'Olonne, for example. If you drive 30 minutes inland, you will reach the lovely city of La Roche-sur-Yon. For families with children, the rope trails in recreational park Le Grand Défi (a 10-min drive) and the leisure pool and slides at O'Gliss Park (30 min) are highly recommended. Le Pavillon is a reasonably small but charming campsite that has a lovely aqua park and plenty of entertainment in the high season.

Park-like site with spacious grass pitches

This campsite's park-like site has spacious grass pitches, which are neatly demarcated, and most have lots of shade. If you'd rather hire accommodation, you can do that at Le Pavillon too. Here, you can spend the night in a mobile home, a chalet or a bungalow tent.

Wonderful swimming in an indoor and outdoor swimming pool

The water park is at the front of the site. You can't fail to notice the large outdoor swimming pool with its spectacular water slides. You can also swim here in cold or rainy weather, as the swimming pool has a retractable roof. The water in both swimming pools is heated to 27 degrees. There is a paddling pool with a fountain next to the outdoor swimming pool.

properties.name: Seecamp am Oderbruch
properties.description:
In the eastern German state of Brandenburg, this campsite is idyllically situated on the shore of the lake. Seecamp am Oderbruch is characterised by its small-scale, intimate premises set amidst the beautiful landscape on the river Oder. Here, you will camp by a stunning lake where you can enjoy swimming, fishing and boating. The nature-rich area, which is a popular haven for assorted migratory bird species, features several marked cycling and hiking trails that run near the campsite. Young children will have plenty of fun on the playground or by the grassy beach near the water.

Camping in East Germany

You can expect a warm welcome from Jorg Wedde and Christina Ventzke, the campsite's new and enthusiastic owners. You will find them in the tidy building that houses both the reception and the restaurant. Since taking over in 2018, Wedde and Ventzke have been breathing new life into this quiet campsite.

Trim pitches on the grass

Strolling on the lawns — with their views on the lake, immediately gives visitors a feeling of calm and spaciousness. The manicured grounds are car-free and inviting with tall trees lining the perimeter for plenty of shade. There are grass pitches especially for caravans, and even spaces for tent camping on a field by the water. There are two washrooms, both of which are clean and modern. No coins are necessary to take a nice shower.

properties.name: Die Geheime Welt von Turisede
properties.description:
Die Geheime Welt von Turisede is a campsite located next to the eponymous adventure theme park. Thanks to its maze-like design, the crazy play areas and the surprising tunnel systems and shows, this is an amazing adventure theme park for families with young children. Die Geheime Welt von Turisede is close to the village of Zentendorf in the Lausitz, at the easternmost point of Germany. The theme park and the campsite extend into Poland.

Stay in a unique tree house

The campsite mainly attracts tourists who want to enjoy the theme park. The campsite is also an experience in itself. The wooded site actually has a lovely tree house hotel with the most imaginative tree houses. The one more original and colourful than the next. Each one has a seating area, bedroom and toilet. Moreover, three of the tree houses have been equipped with a bathroom. The tree houses are connected via winding suspension bridges. Besides a tree house, you can hire a spacious camping pitch or a modern glamping tent here.

What other surprises await you at the campsite?

This campsite surprises you with many more striking structures and fun displays. It starts at arrival in a veritable cave reception. Furthermore, there is a haunted house with a communal recreation room and there is often a big campfire in the evenings. If you like a bit more adventure, sign up for the witching hour or a thrilling midnight adventure. Or go to the Erdhuis (group accommodation) and jump into the so-called cannibal pool, where you will be slowly 'boiled'.

properties.name: Campingplatz Kassel
properties.description:
Campingplatz Kassel is located in the German city of Kassel. You camp at the edge of the Karlsaue city park and are within walking distance of the centre. Kassel is charming with many historic buildings. The city is surrounded by the beauty of nature. Campingplatz Kassel is an ideal home base for a city trip in combination with excursions into the green surroundings. As an extra service, campsite guests receive the MeineCardPlus which gives you access to many attractions and free public transport.

Camping by Fulda river

The pitches are grassy and vary in size from 70 m2 to 200 m2. They are clearly demarcated and are partially separated by low hedges. There are also a fair number of trees on and around the campsite, giving the feeling that you are camping in the countryside – whereas you are just a stone’s throw from the city! The Fulda river flows past the campsite and a some of the pitches overlook the water.

Inclusive campsite

Next to reception, there is a small shop where you can get snacks and drinks. The toilet and washing facilities are spacious and fully accessible for people with a physical restriction and wheelchairs users. The same building also contains the washing machines and the communal kitchen. Inclusivity is an important value for the campsite owners. This applies not only to guests but also to staff, which is why many of the staff at Campingplatz Kassel have some sort of impairment.

Explore the beautiful Kassel

Kassel is known for its rich history and the nature surrounding it. The most famous attraction is the Bergpark Wilhelmshöhe, listed on UNESCO’s World Heritage List, only 15 minutes away from the campsite by car. It is here that the iconic Hercules statue stands, gazing over the city.

properties.name: Camping Le Pré des Moines
properties.description:
Want to marvel at the many famous sights of Paris, but also prefer to spend the night in a more quiet, natural setting? Then this is the campsite for you! Camping Le Pré des Moines is located in a wooded area and lies almost directly on the banks of the Oise River. Here you can enjoy beautiful hiking and cycling trips through vast forests. This campsite has been carefully integrated into nature. At the same time, you'll be camping close to a train station where you can catch a train that will take you to the French capital in fifty minutes.

Lovely camping in a green setting

The campsite's grounds feature a rich variety of vegetation. The plants and trees are very well maintained. With a bit of luck you'll also spot rabbits and squirrels on the campsite, especially shortly after sunrise. This is a wonderful place to camp, especially when you consider that the camping pitches are up to 180 square metres in size. In addition to touring pitches, there are various types of mobile homes for rent. Looking for a unique camping experience? Then book a stay in the luxurious yurt with its own sauna!

Meet fun farm animals

Camping Le Pré des Moines also features a nice mini farm. There the youngest campers can meet rabbits, chickens, sheep and goats. There's also a nice vegetable garden. Camping guests can learn the basics of vegetable gardening there. You can also play tennis, jeu-de-boules, table tennis and board games at this campsite.

properties.name: Krik Vig Camping
properties.description:
Krik Vig Camping is close to the stunning Thy nature reserve in the Danish North Jutland Region. What makes this campsite so special is the possibility to sail with a boat or canoe directly to the Limfjord from the campsite. This fjord landscape is known for its rugged countryside and unique bird areas, making it a paradise for bird watchers and nature lovers.

Spacious camping pitches

To get to the campsite, you take the ferry from Thyborøn to Agger, which is an exceptional experience in itself. The route takes you further through a stunning nature area, past dunes, heathlands and fens and lakes here and there. Various types of accommodation are available at Krik Vig Camping, including hiker's cabins and bungalows, which all look neatly maintained. The camping pitches are spaciously laid out and demarcated by hedges with blooming rose hips. This creates charming and natural green surroundings and the hedges provide good shelter.

Peace, quiet and countryside

The campsite mainly appeals to surfers, water sports enthusiasts and families, who enjoy the peace, space and countryside here. There is a small shop in reception for daily necessities and a supermarket in Agger at only 1.5 km away. There are numerous activities for children, such as miniature golf, a playground and various ball games. You can go to the cafeteria for a snack.

Sailing, fishing or cycling

There are plenty of activities to do in the area, such as bird watching in Thy National Park and water sports on the Limfjord. You can hire canoes at the campsite for a lovely trip.

properties.name: Camping de la Cascade
properties.description:
De La Cascade campsite is a friendly family campsite located in green surroundings on the River Tarn. It's a paradise for water sports and outdoor enthusiasts. There are boat rides aplenty, and hiking and cycling tours are organised from the campsite itself, with a guide on hand to tell you everything that you need to know about this beautiful area.

Camping on the river

The camping pitches and accommodation are set out on terraces. The narrow, elongated nature of the campsite means that you will always be camping very close to the river itself, and some of the spacious camping pitches are right on the water. The pitches, mobile homes and bungalows are all spacious and separated by high hedges for maximum privacy.

Kids and kayaks

De La Cascade is a true family campsite and you will get to know many families with children during your holiday. The campsite and surroundings are ideal for active campers and outdoor enthusiasts, and children will love a holiday here too.

They will have a great time in the swimming pool on the campsite, or taking in part in one of the sports competitions, cooking activities and dance evenings. The campsite team also organises group hikes, cycling tours and kayaking, all with a guide on hand. You can take a kayak or canoe from the campsite's own quay and experience the Tarn for yourself. Sailing under the waterfall is an absolute must for campers at De La Cascade.

In addition to kayaks and canoes, pedalos and motor boats are available for hire from the campsite's jetty.

properties.name: Camping De Finne
properties.description:
Camping is Friesland means wide expanses, quiet and of course water sports. For that, you are at the right place at the beautiful, small-scale Camping De Finne. You stay right by the water so you only have to walk off the camping field for sailing, fishing and swimming. The owners will be happy to help with tips for lovely sailing and cycling routes. Children can have a great time here in the playground, on the trampoline or in the recreation room. You can enjoy a refreshing drink on the lovely patio.

Small-scale camping fields

You arrive at a small-scale campsite in the countryside, beside a small river. You arrive at a farmyard, pass the large sheds and then get to a large camping field with about 50 pitches. The friendly owners will be more than happy to help you decide which field is best for you. There are fields for those seeking quiet, people who love views, families and a short-stay tent field. If you would like to go glamping in Friesland, rent a spherical 'geodome'. You can also hire a Tipi tent and four-person bell tent.

Water fun in the canal

A holiday at Camping De Finne is all about having fun in water. The campsite is by a canal with private jetties where you can go swimming, sailing and fishing. You can take your own boat or stand-up paddleboard, but the campsite also rents various boats and canoes. Anglers will find lovely spots by the water. The campsite does not have a swimming pool, but a water slide board is sometimes set up for the children in hot weather.

properties.name: Landgoed de Barendonk
properties.description:
In the countryside of Brabant, near the village of Beers, you will find Landgoed de Barendonk. This old family estate not only houses a dairy farm, but also a beautiful natural campsite. Only fifteen kilometres from Nijmegen you can experience the hospitable Brabant country life. The various small fields look out over the meadows. Luxurious holiday homes have been created in the beautiful old barns.

Luxury and comfort

The campsite is situated at the edge of the forest and offers a panoramic view over the surrounding countryside. There are thirty touring pitches, which have been laid out on various small lawns. For the many tent campers there is a separate field. For campers travelling by bike there are special pitches and extra facilities. If you travel without camping equipment, you will find a wide range of rental accommodations such as comfortable hiker's huts and luxurious holiday homes and apartments.

All year round

You will mainly see active campers, campers that look for peace and quiet and nature lovers. The campsite is open all year round. In winter the rental accommodations are very popular, while in high season you'll see a lot of campers with tents.

All sorts of things to discover

There is no entertainment programme on the campsite, but children won't get bored for a moment. There is plenty to discover in the woods and ditches on and around the estate. Moreover, the campsite has a gnome's path, a toad pool and a campfire area. In high season there is a tent of IVN (the institute for nature education and sustainability) on the estate for five weeks where children can discover the nature around the tent under supervision.

properties.name: Camping Nij Wybranda
properties.description:
Do you like to camp in a peaceful spot where it’s really quiet and completely dark at night? Then perhaps Camping Nij Wybranda near Boazum (Friesland) is for you. This small campsite is completely surrounded by vast meadows. So, as a camper, you’ll enjoy plenty of peace, space and an unobstructed view of beautiful sunrises and sunsets. This authentic farm campsite is also the ideal starting point for lovely cycle rides through the Frisian countryside.

Enjoy camping between the Frisian meadows

A Medieval path of more than one kilometre leads from the village centre of Boazum to the campsite. This path (now paved) runs right through the Frisian meadows, which you have a clear view of from most touring pitches. There are fifteen pitches in total. Five of them are paved. In the campsite's rose garden, you’ll also find a comfortable log cabin for four people. And three beautiful apartments have been created in the charming 19th-century farmhouse. You can enjoy contemporary comfort here, although many original features have been preserved, such as the possibility to spend the night in a real box bed.

Enjoy real life on the farm

The youngest campers can help feed and look after the horses, goats and cows on the farm in the morning and evening. Children will enjoy the (free) pony rides too. The farm also has a shop that sells souvenirs, ice creams, honey and home-produced meat. You can order your breakfast here for the next morning as well.

properties.name: Campingplatz am Marktler Badesee
properties.description:
Campingplatz am Marktler Badesee is located in the heart of the green recreational area of Altötting, in Southern Germany. The pace slows down automatically there. You’ll camp among hills, water and open countryside here, overlooking the river Inn. No crowds, no rush. Ideal if you want to escape your day-to-day routine.

Large pitches with character

The campsite, a former farm, has about 30 well-tended pitches, making it feel well-organised and personal. The pitches are flat, large and neatly laid out. Some pitches even have their own wooden decking and sunshade. Would you like a view of the lake or a sheltered spot among the greenery? Both are possible.

Great facilities for young and old

This is a lovely place for families with young children. The swimming lake is just 50 m away, perfect for a refreshing dip on hot days. There are also amazing indoor and outdoor play areas for children. Cyclists will love this campsite too. There is covered storage with charging points for e-bikes, so you can hit the road carefree.

Explore the surrounding area

Campingplatz am Marktler Badesee is the ideal starting point for walking, cycling and canoeing trips. The routes start at the campsite and take you through the changing landscape along the river Inn. Marktl, with its shops and cosy restaurants, is just 2 km away. Fancy some culture? Visit the pilgrimage town of Altötting (17 km) or the impressive Burghausen (13.5 km) with the longest castle in Europe.

properties.name: Camping Lou Gourdan
properties.description:
Lou Gourdan is a lovely, small campsite with a contemporary look. The campsite is located in a natural area where a river winds its way through the mountainous landscape. The campsite and buildings have a designer look with a bright, neat and amiable atmosphere. The facilities are also very modern. Welcome to a campsite which is ideal for anyone who likes an active holiday in nature. This may be families, couples, groups as well as individual travellers.

Modern grounds, level fields

The campsite is beautifully designed with rectangular laid-out fields which are nice and level. You can pitch your tent or caravan here on beautiful green grass. A number of fields are shaded by young trees. This is a real modern campsite where everything looks well-maintained. The pitches are demarcated with hedges and lamp posts.

Lodge tents and a Pipo wagon

The rental accommodation is found on a separate field on the other side of the building. Some of the units are slightly dated but well-maintained. On the outskirts of the campsite is a Pipo wagon. The mobile homes are located next to each other but have ample privacy. The lodge tents are nicely distributed throughout the grounds.

Municipal swimming pool

A bit further along, you can swim in the municipal swimming pool, which is in a sheltered location with lots of shade provided by the surrounding trees. It is a short walk to the village centre (only 300 m) where you can enjoy a bite to eat or a drink, or do your shopping.

Designer sanitary equipment

The sanitary building deserves a special mention. It is architecturally designed, fitted according to the latest trends and with all amenities.

properties.name: Recreatie- & Hertenboerderij De Weerd
properties.description:
Camping Recreatie- & Hertenboerderij De Weerd is near the village of Nijbroek in Gelderland, somewhat northwest of Deventer. With the Veluwe so close by, you are in the right place here if you love nature. But the immediate surrounding area is also very beautiful, with its various farms and estates. The campsite itself is located on the site of a deer farm. Be sure to camp here with your children, who will love these cute animals. With plenty of opportunities for play, they will amuse themselves the entire holiday!

Camping and renting

The pitches are set up in two opposing rows with playground equipment in the middle. You will be camping in peace and quiet at this well-maintained campsite. In addition to pitches for tents, trailer tents and caravans, there are several paved motorhome pitches. For those without camping equipment, lodge tents (for 4-7 people) or mobile homes are available. The lodge tents are set up safari style and have real beds.

Animal lovers

Do your children love animals? This deer farm will definitely be a big hit! In addition to deer, there are also alpacas, pigs, chickens and rabbits. The campsite has an extensive programme that enables children to acquire a farming diploma. They must help care for the animals. They can also mow grass and have fun with wheelbarrows and other work materials.

Other fun is possible on the multi-sports fields or on the jeu-de-boules course. A playground (indoor and outdoor sections), water playground and recreation area give even more activities to do. And the cherry on top? The entertainment programme in the high season!

properties.name: Minicamping Lindershoeve
properties.description:
Do you love peace, space and nature? Then Minicamping Lindershoeve, on the outskirts of Bergeijk (North Brabant), is the ideal holiday destination for you. This campsite is surrounded by vast meadows. Large wooded areas and heathlands that are part of De Kempen nature reserve can be found beyond the meadows. This small nature campsite has modern facilities, including a toilet and washing block with underfloor heating and luxury private bathrooms.

Open views from every pitch

When you arrive at this mini-campsite, you will see the luxury bed & breakfast first. Behind it, there’s a central car park and a well-kept (and car-free) campsite. There’s plenty of space and privacy thanks to the clever layout and large pitches. You will enjoy panoramic views of the beautiful countryside everywhere. Alternatively, opt for an attractive glamping tent, gypsy caravan or camping pod.

Tips for walking and nature enthusiasts

Do you enjoy walking or cycling through nature? The Kempen is one of the most beautiful natural destinations in the Netherlands. Located in the heart of this nature reserve, Minicamping Lindershoeve is an ideal starting point for walkers, cyclists and mountain bikers alike. For instance, the vast heaths and picturesque fens of the beautiful Cartierheide are about six kilometres away. And what about De Malpie? This varied nature reserve (15 km) has lovely walking and cycling routes along and through heathlands, forests, fens and streams.

There are many attractions just across the border with Belgium too. For example, the sandy plains and pine forests of Lommel Sahara.

properties.name: Camping Louisa
properties.description:
Camping Louisa is located in the southern part of the Greek Pelion peninsula. This quiet sanctuary is near the traditional village of Platanias, and Platanias Beach and Mikro Beach. It has all the ingredients for a relaxing sun, sea and beach holiday. But there is also plenty to do here, including walking through the natural green surroundings, a boat trip along the coast or visit the city of Volos

An ecological farm by the Aegean Sea

Camping Louisa's camping grounds are on an ecological farm measuring 25,000 m². Every camping pitch, surrounded by trees, plants and colourful flowers, offers privacy and sea views. The pitches vary in size and are partly on level ground and partly on terraces, giving you the choice of various options./p>

At the campsite

Although the campsite does not have a swimming pool, it is only a short walk to the nearby sandy beach of Platanias (300 m). Outdoor areas, including tables and chairs, are available for group gatherings. The buildings are old and simple but neatly maintained. The snack bar is open from 15 July to 15 September, so you can get something tasty to eat.

Explore the area of Pilion

Camping Louisa is ideally located for exploring the Pilion peninsula. At a short distance from the city of Volos (60 km), you walk through the Pillon mountain landscape. And for a refreshing swim, walk to the nearby beach. For a traditional Greek meal, go to the village of Platanias (300 m) with its many traditional restaurants right by the water.

properties.name: Camping Agrituristico Carso
properties.description:
The quiet natural campsite Agrituristico Carso is located in a forest close to the sea in a beautiful rocky coastal region. The coastal town of Triëst is only 20 km away. The campsite forms part of an organic farm. This operation comprises meadows, woods and biological market-gardening fields. The campsite is especially popular amongst guests from the Netherlands.

Organic farm with campsite

This well maintained terraced campsite (measuring 1 ha) is managed by two sisters and their mother and is located in a forest in a natural design. The twenty camping pitches on this campsite are not demarcated. You are allocated a spacious pitch (60-80 m2) with ample privacy. The campsite is located in a forest with oak and berry trees. These provide shade on some of the pitches. 

Swimming and walking

In the outdoor pool (110 m2), playing children and adults who like to swim a few lengths are separated from each other by a cork rope. Great arrangement. On the campsite you will also find some play equipment and a recreation area. You can ask the reception about the marked walking routes in the surroundings. For the active holiday maker, guided hiking trips are organised in October.

Eco camping with vegetable gardens

Agrituristico Carso is recognised as an eco campsite. Vegetables, herbs and fruit are on sale in the organic shop, where locally produced wine and honey are also available. The vegetables are grown in an organic manner and water is sparingly used as a result of drip irrigation. 

Guests are allowed to keep perishable foodstuffs in the fridge or freezer. In addition, there is a communal barbecue area.

properties.name: Minicamping De Heuvel
properties.description:
If you are looking for a relaxed pitch at a small-scale campsite, surrounded by meadows and with the sea in the vicinity, Minicamping de Heuvel on the Schouwen-Duiveland in Zeeland is what you’re looking for. Located by the picturesque village of Kerkwerve, this charming campsite has all you need for an unforgettable stay.

Enjoy yourself in comfort

You will not lack anything at Minicamping de Heuvel. The toilet facilities are in tiptop condition and you can rent private toilet facilities for extra privacy. Begin each morning right with the fresh bread service. The wifi at the campsite is excellent. There is handy bicycle parking where you can charge your e-bike after an amazing trip through the Zeeland polders. Also a charging station is available for electric cars.

Fun for the kids

Children have the time of their lives at Minicamping de Heuvel. There is a fun playground with go-karts, bicycles, a trampoline and a table-tennis table. The grounds allow a clear view, which means you can rest easy when the little ones go to play. If the weather is not so nice, the games room is open for fun. When the weather is nice, the ice cream bike will come by for a refreshing treat.

Beach and towns

The location of the campsite is deal for alternating lazy days with excursions to tourist sites such as Zierikzee (4.5 km), Burgh-Haamstede (14.5 km) and Renesse (14 km). The beautiful wide sandy beaches of the North Sea coast are never far away. And how would you feel about an excursion to Neeltje Jans (20 km)?

properties.name: Camping Domaine de la Grande Veyière
properties.description:
Camping Domaine de la Grande Veyière is situated near the village of Molières, amidst the beautiful nature of the Dordogne. The campsite is beautifully located in the forests of the Dordogne and Vézère river valleys. You camp here in the vicinity of pre-historical sites where you can visit caves, but also near castles and beautiful towns and villages. The heated lagoon pool and unspoilt surroundings ensure a successful family holiday.

Friendly farm campsite

The reception exudes an atmosphere of the original farmlife. When you drive to your pitch, you will discover a beautifully located campsite surrounded by forests with centuries-old oak trees. The 9-hectare site has 45 pitches. Those travelling without their own accommodation can rent one of the comfortable wooden chalets with air conditioning, a mobile home or a lodge tent. Camping Domaine de la Grande Veyière is a terraced campsite: the higher your pitch, the more spectacular the view.

For children, there is a mini farm with donkeys and sheep. During the high season, they can visit the mini club. The campsite has a friendly atmosphere with theme nights and tastings of Périgord specialities.

Cafeteria and shop

In the campsite shop you can buy basic groceries and regional specialities. Fresh bread rolls are available every morning. The campsite also has a snack bar serving hot dogs, hamburgers and pizzas. You can eat these on site or take them away. There is also a communal barbecue area on the grounds.

Extensive sanitary facilities

Camping Domaine de la Grande Veyière has beautiful and extensive sanitary facilities. These include individual cubicles, showers, toilets and sanitary facilities for the disabled. Also available: a baby room and family sanitary facilities.

properties.name: Camping Moulin de Chaules
properties.description:
Camping Moulin de Chaules is a pleasant campsite situated in the middle of the beautiful nature of the Auvergne. Christelle, half of the friendly couple that owns the campsite, runs the restaurant and makes delicious homemade pizzas. Building dams in the river, taking part in the activities and sitting around the campfire together: get ready for a varied holiday!

Cosy and small-scale campsite

The small-scale and friendly campsite breathes tranquillity. Behind the flat area are terraces, which accommodate a total of around forty touring pitches and eleven rental accommodations. The pitches on the terraces are naturally laid out and have no clear demarcation. The pitches on the flat terrain, on the other hand, are delimited by hedges. Some pitches are idyllically situated by the river.

For small campers

Camping Moulin de Chaules focuses specifically on families with smaller children. With a swimming pool, nicely sheltered between the main building and the owners' house, a playground and various activities, small campers will have the holiday of a lifetime here.

In high season, something is organised every day of the week: baking bread together (and eating it by the campfire), treasure hunts and games. Young and old can join all activities, but the focus is on children.

Queen of the kitchen: Christelle

The old stone main building houses a cosy restaurant, where owner Christelle herself stands behind the stove and conjures up the tastiest pizzas from the oven. Here, too, the youngest guests are taken into account. In addition to various pizzas, fries with a snack are also on the menu. You can also take a seat at one of the bistro style tables on the shady pavement café.

properties.name: Camping de l'Aigrette
properties.description:
Do you like a small-scale campsite in a quiet, rural area? This campsite is situated right on a lake near the town of Attichy in the Oise, about 90 kilometres northeast of Paris. Camping de l'Aigrette is an ideal starting point for beautiful hiking and cycling trips through the wooded area of Attichy. The campsite has a cosy cafeteria and good sanitary facilities.

Book a spacious touring pitch or stay in an authentic yurt

This campsite's spacious grounds feature large pitches for touring campers. Most of these pitches are separated by neat hedges. A small number of touring pitches are located directly on the water. These are only rented to tent campers. Camping de l'Aigrette also rents out special accommodations. Here you can spend the night in an attractively furnished lodge tent, a tipi tent or a traditional yurt.

Walk in the vast forests and visit Pierrefonds castle

Camping de l'Aigrette is a great holiday destination for those seeking tranquillity and nature lovers, especially those who prefer to discover the natural beauty on foot or by bike. Right from the campsite you can go for a beautiful walk. You can walk all the way around the lake where the campsite is located. To the west of the campsite there are also two extensive wooded areas where you can take lovely nature trips. A visit to the impressive Château de Pierrefonds is also worthwhile. This beautiful castle is less than a twenty-minute drive from the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Les Eymes
properties.description:
Les Eymes campsite is located on a mountain plateau in the Vercors, amidst green Alpine meadows and mountain peaks. This small-scale campsite is a great destination for nature lovers and hikers. Camp on a green hillside overlooking the mountains, exuding tranquillity. You'll have this view from almost every spot on the campsite: from the heated swimming pool, the rental accommodation and the restaurant.

Peaceful view over Alpine meadows

A panoramic view of the Alpine meadows and the surrounding mountain peaks for almost all 35 touring pitches and 10 rental units. The mountains are not only beautiful to see; they also provide a soothing atmosphere. This is exactly what campers on Les Eymes are looking for during their holiday. If you want to camp completely secluded, walk up to the higher tent pitches. Some of these pitches are only accessible on foot.

Small swimming pool, great view

The swimming pool is situated below the large building in which the restaurant is located. This outdoor pool is heated with solar energy. The pool is not particularly large, but the view from the water and the sun loungers around is beautiful. Swimming while enjoying the impressive mountains.

Homemade pizzas

The restaurant, built of solid wood, fits perfectly into the mountainous surroundings. Large windows offer mountain views. In addition to the beautiful view, you can enjoy good food. Cakes and excellent pizzas are both homemade. Accompanied by a cold beer - the choice is enormous - and the meal is complete.

properties.name: Camping Le Cul de la Lune
Camping Rio Verde
properties.description:
Rio Verde Campsite is located in a quiet spot among the mountains of Umbria. This is a hospitable, green campsite where you camp under the trees. Find peace and tranquillity, dive into the pool and enjoy the sun. Or go for a walk. A challenging hike takes you to the top of Monte Cucco. This is the highest mountain in the region and the premier spot for hang gliders. For those who really know no fear... After such a challenging hike (or flight), you have earned the right to enjoy a delicious pizza at the campsite restaurant!

Camping pitches in the great outdoors

A wall of wisteria, tall trees and green bushes... At the Rio Verde Campsite, nature has the freedom to flourish. Just like her camping guests. It is one of the many charming aspects of this campsite. You can choose your own spot on the green camping grounds. The pitches all differ in size. But there is a good chance that you will be camping among the trees.

Are you not coming to Italy with a camper, caravan or tent? Then you can spend the night in one of the stone bungalows. Or, even more special, in the nineteenth-century country house.

Daily swim

Up for a daily dip in the pool? You can do this at Rio Verde Campsite. The large swimming pool is located next to the reception and campsite restaurant. It is situated in the middle of a large lawn where you can sunbathe. Had enough of swimming? Then you can dry out on the restaurant terrace. A nice drink or an Italian pizza will help make your day complete.

properties.name: Camping Villaggio Nettuno Srl
properties.description:
Camping Villaggio Nettuno Srl is located on the Amalfi Coast, in the west of the Sorrento peninsula. From this campsite you have a view over the Mediterranean Sea and the rocky coast. A flight of stairs lead to a private beach, where you can take a dip in the shallow water.

Small pitches, great views

On the campsite there are about sixty touring pitches. They are small and look a bit untidy because of the differences in surface. However, the view from the different terraces is beautiful. Almost all pitches overlook the Mediterranean Sea. You can also spend the night in one of the rental accommodations or apartments.

Unique place by the sea

You can take a dip in the small inflatable swimming pool at the campsite, but you are rewarded when you descend the stairs to the small private beach: a unique place. The pebble beach lies between the steep rocks There is also a diving school near the campsite.

Pizza with a view

From the covered sidewalk cafe of the campsite pizzeria you have beautiful sea view. In the restaurant you can also try one of the Mediterranean seafood dishes. You will probably dine out more than once during your holiday, because a larger supermarket is hard to find in the vicinity. On the campsite you'll find a mini market, but it has a rather limited range.

properties.name: Donau Camping Marbach
properties.description:
Donau Camping Marbach is located right on the Danube in Austria. You wake up with a view of the water and passing ships. The campsite is ideally located on the Danube route - perfect for nature lovers and active campers. Here you can walk, cycle or enjoy the water. Add Austrian hospitality and delicious regional dishes, and your camping holiday is complete.

Camping pitches and holiday homes

Whether you like sun or shade, you will always find a nice spot at Donau Camping Marbach. The pitches are clean, demarcated and range from 70 to 100 m². Prefer to camp? Then choose one of the nice holiday homes such as Haus Wachau or Haus Nibelungen - ideal for families or groups of friends up to six people. These accommodations are fully equipped, with a private kitchen, comfortable beds and a terrace.

Relaxation and facilities

The marina around the corner attracts water sports fans. Rent a SUP and explore the Danube at your own pace.

In the village of Marbach (900 m) you will find numerous eateries, including restaurants serving delicious Austrian food and shops for your daily needs. Feel like swimming? The public swimming pool is just one kilometre away. Children can have fun on the playground equipment, while you enjoy a drink on the terrace.

Local activities and places of interest

The region is brimming with nature, culture and adventure. You will camp in picturesque Lower Austria, along the famous Danube Cycle Route. Explore hiking trails such as the Steinbachklamm (3.9 km) or the Welterbesteig Wachau. Those who like action can wakeboard or sail. Sample local wine and apricot products in the Wachau (40 km) or visit the pilgrimage church Maria Taferl (4 km).

properties.name: Camping Domaine Papillon
properties.description:
Camping Domaine Papillon is situated in a quiet spot in the middle of the Lot nature. This small-scale campsite, formed around an authentic building, is very suitable for campers seeking the silence of the countryside. Despite its secluded location, there is plenty to do nearby. Nature lovers can hike, visit caves and kayak, while Figeac is a nice place for an excursion.

Small-scale campsite with charm

Camping Domaine Papillon can justifiably be called a small-scale campsite. Not only because of its size and number of pitches (18 touring pitches and 16 rental accommodations), but also because of the charm typical of many smaller campsites. The touring pitches - not delimited, but very spacious - are situated on a beautiful green terrain next to a small pond. Unpaved paths take you to your pitch. On the higher part, where the mobile homes are located, it is shady. Despite the sloping terrain, all touring pitches are flat.

For the children

Although there is little entertainment, there is plenty to do for children at campsite Domaine Papillon. The swimming pool is of course a regular attraction for the smaller guests, but they can also have fun with the animals that roam the grounds: ducks, sheep and pigs. And sitting around a campfire makes their camping holiday quite special.

Attractive restaurant

The restaurant is housed in one of the old buildings on the campsite. The authentic interior is full of atmosphere which makes the restaurant an attractive place to eat or have a drink. You can eat off the menu, but there are also takeaway meals available.

properties.name: Aktiv-Camp-Purgstall
properties.description:
Aktiv-Camp-Purgstall is a small-scale campsite in Lower Austria, at the foot of the Alps. You can camp here on a comfort pitch on the natural campsite or in rental accommodation. Fun for the children: the cuddly bunnies roaming freely around the campsite.

Comfort pitches on a natural site

Around fifty comfort pitches are located on the beautifully maintained campsite of Aktiv-Camp-Purgstall. Most of the touring pitches are marked by a tree, which at the same time provides shade. It gives the campsite a green and natural character, which is not disturbed by the rental accommodations: a spacious chalet, wooden bungalows and the appartment in the Gästehaus.

Natural swimming pond

The campsite does not have a swimming pool, but it does have a swimming pond. In this small natural pond at the back of the campsite you can always cool off. Swimming laps is difficult, but there is plenty of space for children to have fun in the water.

Cuddly animals

The chicken coop and rabbit hutch on the campsite are open during the day. The cuddly creatures can roam freely over the grassy areas of the campsite. So don't be surprised if you see a fluffy rabbit sniffing around or a perky parading rooster parading in front of your tent.

Homemade ice cream and your favourite dish

Whether you fancy a pastry for breakfast or a tasty pizza or bratwurst for lunch, you can always enjoy a treat on the covered outdoor café. You can also have dinner. If you let them know in advance that you would like to join for dinner, the cook will be happy to prepare your favourite dish. Be sure to try a scoop of homemade ice cream for dessert.

properties.name: Camping Alpenferienpark Reisach
properties.description:
Terraced campsite Alpenferienpark Reisach is located on a southern slope in the Gailtal, near the town of Reisach. You''ll stay in a beautiful quiet and very wooded hilly area in Carinthia. Alpenferienpark Reisach has a natural swimming pool where children can play to their heart's content. This simple family campsite guarantees the enjoyment of nature and rest.

Half-timbered building

The first impression of the campsite is that it is clean, convivial and green. The campsite has the atmosphere of a farm. The reception is in the half-timbered building, where there is also a small campsite shop (fresh bread in the morning).

Location with privacy

All pitches have grassy ground and are spacious or relatively spacious. Thanks to the many plants with bushes and hedges, you can expect reasonable privacy on your campsite. All the pitches are flat and nicely arranged, some on terraces due to the altitude difference. The pitches at the edge of the campsite have the best views of the valley. You can spend the night in log cabins or mobile homes.

A special natural swimming pool

The natural swimming pool with a lovely view of the valley is in full sunshine. There are sunbathing lawns around it. The pool has a shallow section with a bottom of large flat pebbles and without plants. There is also a deeper section with water plants and a large (sunbathing) dock and a wooden ladder out of the water. Would you rather walk? There are plenty of marked hiking and cycling routes from the campsite.

Restaurant with terrace

The restaurant has excellent dishes. It cooks with local produce. Inside, it is ‘Austrian’ in décor, with fixed benches around the tables and lots of wood. You can also eat outside on the large cosy covered terrace.

properties.name: Camping Etang du Camp
properties.description:
Camping Etang du Camp is located in Sénergues, a medieval village in the Aveyron department. Sénergues is on the route to Santiago de Compostela. The campsite is situated at an altitude of over six hundred metres, on a plateau between the valleys of the Lot and the Dourdon. You can enjoy nature to the full, because the campsite is situated along the River Ouche and is full of flowers and plants. You will even camp between some rocks.

Camping in nature

With forty touring pitches (100-200 m2), camping here is not large-scale. But you do have plenty of room for your motor home, caravan or tent. Tall trees provide shade. The pitches are well distributed over the site and are mostly on grass. The nicest spots are by the river, which is as wide as a lake here. Are you coming without your own camping equipment? Then there are two mobile homes and four tents to choose from. They differ in luxury, but are all equally tidy.

Modest entertainment

The entertainment on the campsite is modest, but fun. You can play a few sports, such as table tennis and jeu de boules. On the river, kayaking is a popular activity. Children can enjoy themselves with some playground equipment. In bad weather, the recreation room offers a solution.

Culinary campfire

In the morning, fresh bread is available. But you can also order a complete breakfast including fresh fruit, yoghurt and orange juice. In the evening, the bar is the place to be for a pizza and a drink. In the high season, there is a lot of culinary experience outside. Campfires are regularly held to roast sandwiches. Also fun: the weekly group meal.

properties.name: Camping Le Bois Guillaume
properties.description:
Camping Le Bois Guillaume is in a quiet, rural location in the French Burgundy region. Here, you camp in a large forested area. This spot is perfect for people who like the countryside and quiet. This is also a wonderful campsite for families. The heated outdoor swimming pool is open during the high season and you can go for a lovely swim here. There are plenty of fun activities to do such as playing on the swings, treasure hunts, table tennis, miniature golf and there is even a real escape room. The campsite is open throughout the year.

Camping in the forest

You feel at one with nature at Camping Le Bois Guillaume! There are lots of trees at the site, providing many pitches with shade. The campsite has 38 spacious camping pitches, separated by hedges. You can also hire accommodation. There are mobile homes, chalets, lodge tents and group accommodation for 20 people. Le Bois Guillaume has two toilet blocks, of which one is open all year and is heated during the cold winter months.

Countryside, castles and cities

Burgundy is a beautiful hilly region with lots of countryside. You can go on wonderful walks and bike rides here. If you love history and culture, there are many beautiful castles in the area, for example, Saint-Fargeau (14 km), Château de Ratilly (29.5 km), Druyes-Les-Belles-Fontaines (42 km) and La Bussière (32 km). A visit to the city of Auxerre (43.5 km) is also recommended. Wander through the historic city with its timber-framed houses and walk along the River Yonne that flows through the city.

properties.name: Camping Le Mondou
properties.description:
In the rural area of the valley of the Dordogne, five hundred meters from the river, lies the small-scale campsite Le Mondou. The summer activities bring the camping guests into contact with each other in a relaxed way. You'll camp on spacious pitches with panoramic views. Sail the Dordogne by canoe, discover the many castles and visit medieval towns.

Wide views

The owners have chosen a nice spot for their campsite. Le Mondou is situated in the flat countryside of Saint-Julien-de-Lampon. There are no busy roads, high buildings or tourist attractions here. So you can fully enjoy the peace and quiet. Although there are enough trees to provide shade you have panoramic views over the fields, with the hills in the background. There are about fifty pitches in total. You can also choose from a few mobile homes, chalets and luxury lodge tents.

Conviviality

At the front of the campsite is the spacious, rectangular swimming pool. Here you will also find the restaurant and a pleasant sidewalk café. Thanks to the fun and friendly activity program, you will effortlessly get in touch with your fellow campers. Every day of the week there is something to do. Monday is often reserved for a jeu de boules tournament and the Tuesday for a canoe trip on the Dordogne. Occasionally excursions are organised to the nearby climbing park.

Tasty

Especially the organised meals are very enjoyable: you can enjoy a good pizza or a home-smoked trout together with your fellow campers.

properties.name: Flower Camping Le Clot du Jay
properties.description:
At Flower Camping Le Clot du Jay, you'll be camping in a picturesque valley nestled in a beautiful mountain landscape in the South of France. Do you enjoy peace, nature and outdoor activities? You can indulge in all of these here. Go hiking along a waterfall and then take a dip in the campsite's lovely swimming pool. And at night you'll enjoy the stars and silence.

The campsite is located in the Alpine region of south-eastern France, between the famous Les Ecrins and Mercantour National Parks. It is nestled in a low-lying valley, providing warm temperatures in the summer.

Pitches in the sun and shade

The campsite is terraced against a green hill. There are about 45 camping pitches of various sizes. In addition to pitches, Le Clot du Jay also features about thirty rental accommodations, such as mobile homes, chalets and lodge tents.

Swimming pool with waterslide

What could be better during your holiday than a refreshing dip in the pool? At Le Clot du Jay, you're guaranteed to have fun in the water thanks to the lovely swimming pool, which features a waterslide and a paddling pool. The waterslide often opens a little later in the day, so that the pool is nice and quiet during part of the day as well.

Kids club and stargazing

The campsite may be quiet and small-scale, but there's still plenty to do for the little campers. They can meet each other on the playground, at the table tennis table or on the bouncy castle. The adults and teenagers can also enjoy fun evening activities, such as nighttime swimming, concerts or quizzes.

properties.name: Camping am Badesee
properties.description:
Camping am Badesee is situated in a wonderfully peaceful spot on the sunny side of the Seetaler Alps. This campsite is located near the village of Mühlen in the unspoilt south-west of Styria in Austria. Here, you’ll be camping right next to a natural swimming lake, at the foot of the Zirbitzkogel and just a 15-minute walk from the Graggerschlucht waterfalls. In high season, this campsite is also popular with families with children.

Beautiful terraced pitches with sweeping views

If you decide to book a pitch at Camping am Badesee, you will be allocated a lovely spot on one of the six flat, terraced levels. The terraced layout slopes gently down towards the Badesee. Around half of the campsite is reserved for long-stay campers. The other half consists of touring pitches.

In addition to camping pitches, you can rent a holiday home for seven people at Camping am Badesee. You are also welcome to bring your dog to Camping am Badesee. Dogs are welcome on both the touring pitches and in the accommodation.

Ideal location by a warm swimming lake

This campsite is situated right on the shores of the Badesee. The recreational lake is supplied by a small freshwater stream. It is between two and eight metres deep. In short, a lovely spot for a dip or a swim.

High season entertainment: what’s on?

In summer, Camping am Badesee offers entertainment for children from around three years old. Plenty of fun activities are organised. Children can also learn to felt with real sheep’s wool or go on a proper wild herb walk. All the herbs they collect are then actually used to prepare dishes.

Camping am Badesee is also situated close to the 2,396-metre-high Zirbitzkogel mountain. You can drive up to an altitude of around 1,600 metres. From there, you’ll need to continue on foot. A two-hour walk will take you to the summit, where you’ll be rewarded with a magnificent view of the surrounding area. Other beautiful walks can be taken to the waterfalls of Graggerschlucht, a 15-minute drive from the campsite. In addition, visits to the castle town of Friesach and Hochosterwitz Castle are well worth the effort.

properties.name: Camping Fraiteux
properties.description:
The quiet and small Camping Fraiteux is in the French village of Plombières-les-Bains, in the Vosges. Here, you camp amid the meadows on one side and a hilly landscape on the other. It is the ideal place to relax! Perhaps in the spa that is only 2 km away or go on a fun excursion.

Camping in natural greenery in your own way

The campsite offers spacious camping pitches and motorhome pitches. You can come here with your own tent, trailer tent, caravan or motorhome, but there are also options to hire a mobile home or chalet. Although you stay in the middle of a village, you are surrounded by a natural green landscape on all sides.

The campsite owner cooks for you

You can use the bakery service at the campsite throughout the year and there is a small shop. Search for local products and grill them on the barbecue! Not in the mood to cook? The campsite has a small restaurant, where the campsite owner is more than happy to personally cook you a meal.

Discover the surrounding area

There is a spa nearby, where you can wonderfully relax after completing one of the walking, cycling or mountain bike routes. You can also go here for an extensive dinner. La Ferme Aventure is less than 20 kilometres away and where, in the high season, you can explore several mazes, visit a petting zoo and climb and clamber on the playground equipment with the whole family. You can swim in an outdoor swimming pool that is three kilometres away

properties.name: Camping de Coulvée
properties.description:
Camping de Coulvée is situated near Chemillé in the Anjou. Characteristic for this region are the vineyards, picturesque villages and the many castles in the Loire Valley such as Château de Saumur and Château d'Angers.

Comfort pitches

The campsite makes a well maintained impression and the pitches are spacious. The pitches are separated by hedges and shrubs, offering some privacy. Many pitches have water, electricity and are shaded. The comfort pitches are all shaded.

Swimming in a reservoir

This is a fairly quiet and small-scale campsite popular with senior citizens as well as families. Here the small river empties into a reservoir. You can swim here under the watchful eye of a lifeguard. There are pedal boats for rent. Fishing is allowed in the lake and you can buy a fishing permit near the campsite. Adjacent to the campsite is a beach where children can play and enjoy the sun.

Children's club in high season

Campsite le Coulvée has a games room where you can play billiards and table football. There is also a TV room. Children between six and twelve can join a supervised children's club in high season, where they can play games, do crafts, cook or go on treasure hunts. During the day you can get ice cream, coffee and other drinks from the small bar. The terrace is located near the beach.  In July and August you can also get fresh bread each day. For a great start to your day.

properties.name: Camping Le Plô
properties.description:
Camping Le Plô is a small-scale campsite with Dutch owners, located in the heart of the Sidobre, a mountainous area in the Tarn department. This nature reserve is a paradise for cyclists and hikers, where walking routes lead you along special rock formations. Without holiday homes, lawns in the shade of fullgrown trees, overlooking the valley: the natural grounds of camping Le Plô give you a real camping feeling.

Real camping in nature

Spacious touring pitches are situated on well-tended lawns with a very open character. Many of these pitches receive shade from fullgrown trees, which surround the campsite and make it a cosy, secluded spot. Because the terrain is slightly elevated, you can look out over the valleys and peaks of the mountainous nature reserve from quite a few places. Every year a few comfortable lodge tents are set up.

Swimming pool and paddling pool

The swimming pool is situated on the edge of the campsite, partly in the sun and partly in the shade. In this outdoor pool you can take a cooling dip every day. For the children there is a special paddling pool, in a beautiful oval shape. Slides and a waterfall provide extra water fun. The pools are surrounded by a fence, for the safety of the little ones.

Delightful outdoors

Next to the swimming pool there is a lot of space to romp around. Children can have fun on the large trampolines on the playground, while the little ones play in the sandpits or the playhouse. Sports enthusiasts can be found on one of the sports fields, where football and volleyball are played. Children who prefer to play indoors will find games and a table football table in the recreation room.

properties.name: Camping Dolina
properties.description:
The small-scale Camping Dolina is close to the village of Prebold in the middle of the Slovenian countryside. Here, you camp on spacious camping pitches and can cool down in the swimming pool in summer. The campsite's location makes it suitable for those seeking peace and quiet as well as for active campers. The traditional village of Prebold (1 km) is within walking distance, for instance. And the capital of Slovenia, Ljubljana (62 km), is less than an hour's drive from here. Or walk or cycle through the stunning countryside, with the nearby Kaplja Vas observation point (750 m) as the literal highpoint.

Peace and space

Despite the small-scale character of the campsite, here you will find a grassy field with spacious pitches for tents, caravans and motorhomes, including electricity connections. The intimate atmosphere at the campsite makes it easy to get to know other campers and at the same time, the pitches are laid out in such a way that you have maximum privacy.

If you don't have your own camping equipment, hire one of the modernly furnished rooms and apartments.

A well-maintained basis

Camping Dolina prioritises simplicity with well-maintained basic amenities. The toilet and washing facilities are neat and you can use the washing and drying room. Visit the sauna for even more relaxation. And for that genuine camping feeling, use the grill to make your evening meal.

Camping Dolina's reception has a mini bar, great for a drink and a chat with the owners. And refreshment has been considered: there is a swimming pool at the site.

properties.name: Camping Barétous-Pyrénées
properties.description:
Camping Barétous-Pyrénées is a small campsite in the southern French town of Aramits, at the foot of the Pyrenees. On a green camping ground you camp on delimited touring pitches, situated under trees and next to a river. Walkers and cyclists will be in their element: the friendly owners know the area like the back of their hand and organise excursions and cycling tours through the valley of Barétous and over the cols of the Pyrenees.

Colourful campsite

A variety of different species of trees provide shade on the campsite; flowering shrubs give colour to the terrain the elongated campsite is quite spacious and offers almost forty pitches and over twenty rental accommodations. The bungalows are situated between the tall trees at the back of the campsite, overlooking the river and the woods in the background. Between the touring pitches, delimitated by hedges and on beautifully tended lawns, there are rental tents.

Heated outdoor pool

You will find the outdoor swimming pool next to the reception building. A nice place to swim: high trees provide shade to a large part of the pool and the surrounding sun loungers. The smallest swimmers can safely bathe in the fenced off paddling pool. Like to sweat? Then step into the sauna and relax even more in the whirlpool.

Pleasant pavement café

Getting out of the pool, you can dry up on the pleasant adjoining pavement café. The restaurant is open from June to September. Here you can enjoy a takeaway meal, snacks and a drink. You can also it out In the village. Besides a pizzeria and restaurant there is also a supermarket.

properties.name: Camping Iserand Calme et Nature
properties.description:
Camping Iserand Calme et Nature is situated between the vineyards of the Ardèche hills, less than three hundred metres from the Rhône. This small-scale campsite is situated on the slope of a hill, where trees of up to fifty different species provide many shady spots. The spacious pitches on the terraces have been carefully laid out in nature. Especially with a tent you get a real camping feeling here.

Camping in nature

The elongated campsite is situated on the slope of a hill, in the shade of tall trees. A special fact: there are no less than fifty different species of trees shading your pitches. Because of the sloping character of the terrain, the pitches are situated on different terraces, and despite the irregular landscape, most of the pitches have a flat surface. Should this not be the case, there is always a solution to be found. The freedom and tranquillity of camping in nature makes up for a lot.

For the whole family

The swimming pool at the front of the campsite is not only a nice place for a refreshing dip, it is also often used for water games. Do not expect large shows, disco and musicals on this campsite, but small scale entertainment. The table tennis matches, jeu de boules tournaments and games are fun activities for the whole family.

Groceries

In the small shop on the campsite you can get the much-needed things, but for your daily shopping the range is too limited. There are several supermarkets at less than a quarter of an hour’s drive.

properties.name: Camping Ecochiocciola
properties.description:
Near the town of Montese, situated in a mountainous and wooded area, is the simple, small campsite Ecochiocciola. Here you'll be camping in the Emilia-Romagna region, less touristy than the famous and popular Tuscany, but also definitely worth a visit.

Panoramic view for tent campers

On the basic terraced camping (1 ha) much attention has been paid to the greenery and flowers. The various deciduous, fruit and pine trees provide shade. There are demarcated camping pitches for campers, which boast a lovely view, surrounded by flowers and plants. The 43 touring pitches vary in size from 50 to 75 m2. The campsite is less oriented towards camper vans and caravans, so there are fewer available pitches for them. 

Vibrant rental accommodation

In addition to camping pitches, rental accommodation is also available, including eight vibrant wooden cottages. You can also opt for a Hobbit or a tree house as well as a bungalow with a bath and large windows. 

Beautiful view from the swimming pool

There is a small swimming pool (99 m2) on the campsite, which may fill up quickly with children at play. From the swimming pool and the sunbathing lawn, you have a beautiful view of the mountain landscape of the Apennines. There is some playground equipment for children and a table tennis table. You can also play volleyball or a game of tennis. 

Enjoying global cuisine

The owner Ottavio will prepare meals for the camping guests upon request. He serves very tasty local dishes, but also prepares dishes from around the globe. These are inspired by the faraway lands he has travelled to, such as South America and Nepal. You can get a drink at the bar.

properties.name: Camping Azun Nature
properties.description:
Camping Azun Nature has a unique location in the midst of the nature of the Hautes-Pyrénées. This well-maintained campsite offers a panoramic view of the surrounding mountains and is within walking distance of the village of Aucun. The site has been carefully laid out with native plants, in perfect harmony with the beautiful surrounding landscape.

It’s a free country!

Thanks to the large fields, campers enjoy an unforgettable view of the Balaïtous massif. Some pitches are delimited by low shrubs. Wherever you put up your camping gear, everywhere you camp on beautiful grass. And in general you have plenty of space. The tasteful wooden chalets on the grounds are a feast for the eyes.

Sauna and spa

What could be nicer than sitting in a warm jacuzzi as soon as the stars are in the sky? Or after a long day of walking to relax in the sauna? It is all possible in the spa at the campsite. In the summer months you can take a dip in the municipal swimming pool in Arrens-Marsous, where there is also a small supermarket.

Mountain tours and regional beers

The mountainous surroundings and clean outdoor air are ideal for outdoor activities such as cycling, mountain biking, motorcycling and hiking. Joëlle and Yves will be happy to tell you about the most beautiful tours, some of which start from the campsite. Admire the crystal clear waters of the Lac de Gaube and the imposing peaks of the Pic du Midi de Bigorre.

Cyclists are close to the starting point for the ascent of the Col d'Aubisque. Afterwards, you can relax on the pavement café of the campsite while enjoying a delicious local beer.

properties.name: Hammarstrands Camping
properties.description:
Hammarstrands Camping is situated in the middle of the Swedish countryside. With a beautiful view over the river Indalsälven, this is a unique and very quiet camping spot. Take a morning dip in the river and finish the day with a campfire. In the meantime, enjoy Swedish delicacies.

Camping between forest and river

A crackling fire in front of your caravan or tent. The starry sky that stretches above you. The babbling water of the river, the wind rustling through the trees. That is camping at Hammarstrands Campsite. The pitches are situated on the grass between forest and water. You can spend a real Swedish holiday in a stuga: one of those typical red wooden holiday homes.

Fika and syrup waffles

Fancy a treat after a dip in the river? Then take a stroll to the café at reception. A 'fika' awaits you there: this is a social tradition in Sweden where people get together for a hot cup of coffee and a tasty treat. Be sure to bring the children along too, for a delicious syrup waffle, for example.

Cooking in a real kitchen

You don't have to worry about dinner. A nice fish and chips, hamburger or schnitzel: everything is prepared for you. Would you rather cook and shop for yourself? Then you can find everything you need in Hammarstrand. And a three-course meal is prepared in no time at this campsite. You can use the heated service house for a fully equipped kitchen.

properties.name: Camping Maltschacher Seewirt
properties.description:
The small-scale Relax Camping Maltschacher Seewirt is located in the south of Austria, in the state of Carinthia. You camp here directly on Maltschacher Lake. During the holiday period, the campsite provides an entertainment programme for young and old. Next door to the campsite is a hotel where you can have a nice bite to eat and sit on the terrace.

Entertainment for all

The campsite provides plenty of entertainment for the whole family. Various activities are organised for both adults and children.
