During the holiday period, you can cook, party and sit around a campfire together with the entertainment team. Sporting activities are also possible here. For example, there are tennis and golf courts in the immediate vicinity of the campsite, as well as fields for volleyball, badminton and football.

Directly on the lake

It's hard to imagine a better view than Maltschacher Lake: beneath the hotel's large terrace, you will find a large sunbathing lawn. Here you can relax and enjoy life on the water. That part belongs to the municipality, by the way. This ensures that not only camping guests can enjoy a day at the lake here, but also people from the surrounding area. Extra cosy!

Restaurant

The restaurant in the hotel is recommended. When the weather is fine, you can enjoy good food on the terrace and also enjoy a beautiful view of the lake. You can also get fresh bread in the restaurant every day. Other groceries are available in the village. The shop is just a few minutes' walk away.

properties.name: Camping Savinja
properties.description:
Camping Savinja is a great campsite in Rečica ob Savinji, Slovenia. This campsite offers a quiet camping experience surrounded by nature. You camp at the edge of the woods within walking distance of the clear Savinja river. The campsite has spacious camping pitches and modern, well-kept toilet facilities. During the high season it is possible to purchase fresh bread daily from the local baker.

Camping on the edge of the woods

At Camping Savinja you can choose from 30 pitches from 80 to 120 square metres. All pitches have plenty of natural shade from the old fruit trees that surround them. Thirteen of these pitches are equipped with both water and electricity connections. The other pitches only have electricity. For campsite visitors with a motorhome, there is a special service point where water can be added and waste water can be discharged.

Clean amenities

Camping Savinja has modern and well-kept amenities. The main building has luxury toilet facilities that are heated with a heat pump. Relax in one of the hammocks or enjoy a refreshing drink at the bar. The campsite also provides free wifi and fresh bread daily from a local baker during the high season.

Green surroundings

There is plenty to do in the area around the campsite. Hike and cycle through the green hills and mountains of the Savinja valley or visit the nearby Mozirje (6.5 km) with its beautiful arboretum. For an active excursion, go on a guided e-bike tour through the valley or visit the nearby farm Blatnik for some horseback riding.

properties.name: Camping Les Sapins
properties.description:
Les Sapins campsite is located in the high mountains of the Pyrenees. Here you can camp far away from the hustle and bustle, in unspoilt nature and with a view of the valley and surrounding mountains. A swimming pool, a restaurant with garden and a sports programme complete the outdoor experience.

Welcome!

Six kilometres southwest of Belcaire is the village of Camurac. On a slope about two kilometres outside Camurac the Dutch Lia and Jos welcome you to their campsite. Les Sapins has 72 touring pitches: some are sheltered under high pines and between hedges, others are on lawns with a more open character. Especially these last pitches are not all equally flat. The sanitary facilities on the campsite are not new, but they are well maintained.

Playing outside

The campsite is an outdoor paradise for children. They can have fun on the volleyball court, on the playground or in the swimming pool. It is situated in a sunny spot and is fenced off for the safety of the children. There is also a separate paddling pool.

Active in nature

Active campers will appreciate the location of the campsite. Excursions are regularly organised from the campsite. Accompanied by certified Dutch instructors you can go into nature for rafting or rock climbing. But also canyoning (climbing in a river gorge) and abseiling are among the possibilities. Various walking and cycling routes lead from the campsite into the mountains. And after an active day you can relax in the pleasant restaurant. Every day Lia and Jos prepare simple but delicious dishes.

properties.name: Camping La Genziana
properties.description:
The modestly sized terraced campsite, Camping La Genziana, is situated in the heart of the Abruzzo National Park. That means camping with views of the mountains, fresh mountain air and the tranquillity of nature all around you. Lake Barrea is about three kilometres away, a lovely spot for a walk or an afternoon by the water. Walking trails pass nearby, and historic towns such as Barrea (800 m) and Alfedena (9.5 km) are just around the corner.

Camping the way you like it

The campsite has sixty spacious pitches, spread over an area of around twenty thousand square metres. Thanks to its layout across several terraced levels, you can enjoy views of the valley and the surrounding mountains from almost anywhere. The pitches are nestled among acacia, maple and beech trees, so you’re sure to find a shady spot. The campsite is easily accessible.

Drinks at the bar or a communal barbecue

Camping La Genziana has all the facilities you need for a relaxing stay, without feeling overcrowded. Grab a drink at the bar, or join in at the communal barbecue. On less sunny days, the communal area is a lovely spot to sit for a while, read a book or make plans for the next day. Cyclists feel right at home here. The campsite offers bike hire, secure storage and even a repair service for minor issues.

Explore the mountainous surroundings

For hiking enthusiasts, the Abruzzo National Park is a true paradise. There are a variety of routes, such as K3, K4 and K6, winding through unspoilt nature. With a bit of luck, you might just spot some wildlife along the way.

properties.name: Camping de la Claysse
properties.description:
The small-scale Camping de la Claysse is in the south of the Ardèche. This campsite, close to the Gorges de l’Ardèche nature reserve, is surrounded by rivers and offers stunning views of the surrounding mountains. Moreover, a holiday at this spot offers you everything you expect from the Provence: stunning countryside with rocks, caves, lavender fields, olive trees and the relaxing atmosphere typical of Southern France.

Comfortable mobile homes and spacious touring pitches

Camping de la Claysse has something for every type of camper: 15 comfortable mobile homes, 30 spacious camping pitches by the river and a wonderful atmosphere. Mobile homes are available for four, five and six people. Campers with their own camping equipment can enjoy their holiday on spacious, shaded pitches measuring from 120 to 150 m², perfect for tents, caravans and motorhomes. In both the low as well as high season, your campsite neighbours mainly consist of a mix of French, Dutch, Belgians and Germans.

Entertainment at the campsite

The fairly large oval swimming pool provides refreshment on sun-drenched days. You can wonderfully relax under the straw parasols while enjoying the beautiful views. A meandering river with a small beach runs beside the campsite. It is also wonderful for swimming.

In the months of July and August, the entertainment team organises sporting activities and cultural excursions and there is also a programme for children from aged 4. The restaurant with patio serves dishes prepared with regional produce and is also popular among the local population, so you get a nice mix of guests.

properties.name: Camping Les Graves
properties.description:
This simple but neat French campsite is located in a beautiful location on the edge of the Parc Naturel régional des Causses du Quercy. Here you can relax and enjoy the beautiful nature that the area offers. You are also in the right place for culture. The historic city of Cahors is about 10 kilometres away. Because Les Graves campsite is located on a hill, you have a fantastic view over the green, rolling landscape.

The campsite does not have an entertainment programme, but it does have facilities such as a table tennis court, play equipment and a trampoline. There is also a lovely swimming pool with a paddling pool. You can go to the two indoor areas when the weather is bad. There is a small shop where you can buy local products, and there are fresh bread rolls for breakfast every morning. The terrain on the campsite is slightly sloping. The camping pitches are spacious, well maintained and have grass as a surface. You can choose from places in the sun or shade. The pitches are separated from each other by hedges, and there is a lot of vegetation. For more comfort, rent a mobile home or chalet.

Taste local products

In the high season, you can order lunch and dinner at the restaurant on the campsite. There is a small menu with tasty dishes made from mostly fresh and local products. A get-together is organised every Tuesday afternoon, and on Thursday evening, a delicious meal is prepared according to a set menu, where you can enjoy local delicacies.

properties.name: Paradies-Camp
properties.description:
This campsite is located in a beautiful spot near the hospitable wine-producing village of Kröv, located in the centre of the Moselle region. Here you'll be camping in perhaps the most beautiful part of the Moselle region. The Moselle River is at its windiest in the area around the campsite. Paradies-Camp is located almost directly on this river as well as on the Moselle promenade, along which you can take wonderful hikes and bike rides. The surrounding countryside is mountainous, and there are numerous vineyards in the region. The campsite itself is small-scale. There are not many facilities, although the campsite is located right next to Kröv's municipal outdoor swimming pools.

Touring pitches with nice views

Paradies-Camp has well-organised grounds roughly consisting of two camping fields with touring pitches. There are considerable differences between the pitches with respect to shade, size and demarcation. Many of the camping pitches offer a beautiful view of the Moselle and the vineyards. Long-term campers can rent a seasonal pitch upon request.

Enjoy Kröv's municipal outdoor pools

Right next to the campsite is Freibad Kröver Reich, Kröv's municipal swimming pool. It features two large outdoor swimming pools and a paddling pool. It also has a water slide that lets out into one of the two large swimming pools. There's a large grass sunbathing area around the pools where you can completely relax and unwind.

Campsite restaurant with cold and hot meals

There's a cosy bistro on the campsite where you can enjoy a delicious breakfast and some hot meals. The restaurant also has a nice outdoor terrace where you can enjoy your snack and drink when the weather is nice.

properties.name: Camping Lentemaheerd
properties.description:
Camping Lentemaheerd is in Uithuizermeeden, a village in North Groningen and is the most northern campsite on the Dutch continent. You will be camping here in the vast landscape of the province of Groningen, near both the Wadden Sea and the bustling city of Groningen. The small campsite is an oasis of rest yet has all the amenities that a campsite visitor could need.

Reception and Tourist (Information) Office in one

This small-scale campsite has various pitches on two camping fields. Choose a spot on the open field with a view over the open landscape of Groningen, or camp sheltered under the fruit trees. All pitches are spacious, equipped with electricity and carless.

Camping visitors are welcomed by one of the owners in the roomy reception area, which is located in the former farmhouse. It has plenty of information about activities in the surrounding area. The toilet block at the campsite was renovated in 2024. The building is heated and has adapted facilities for the disabled.

Cuddling with rabbits

The campsite is ideal for young families. The children can keep themselves busy for hours in the playground, on the trampoline and driving around in karts or on scooters. There is also a small petting zoo with donkeys and rabbits. For rainy days there is a ‘bad-weather’ area. It has a television, various board games and toys.

Stroll along the Wadden Sea

The many hiking and cycling trails in the area give nature and culture enthusiasts plenty from which to choose. Visit the Dutch mud flats or take the boat to the German East Frisian island of Borkum. Did you know that the Wadden Sea is on UNESCO’s World Heritage List?

properties.name: Camping It Krúswetter
properties.description:
Looking for a campsite that combines peace, nature and cosiness with activities on and around the water? Then Camping it-Krúswetter in Friesland is the place for you! This small campsite is located at the junction of two canals, near the village of Easterlittens. You camp in the countryside, with Leeuwarden, Sneek and Franeker all close by. Whether you want to sail, cycle or just enjoy the quiet and the vast landscape, this is the place for you!

Panoramic views of fields and canals

The campsite is conveniently organised into six green fields surrounded by trees. From the fields, there’s a beautiful view of the fields or the canal. The campsite also rents out various types of accommodation. Rent a furnished caravan for the real camping experience, or opt for a comfortable chalet or log cabin. Prefer something unique? The camping pods are great.

Marina and lovely terrace

The campsite has a good restaurant with a terrace by the water. Ideal if you don't fancy cooking. The terrace looks out over the marina, where you can hire a sloop, motorboat, canoe or paddle board. The campsite also has a playground, you can have a lovely swim in the clean Krúswetter and walking and cycling routes through the Frisian countryside start there too.

Nature within cycling distance

The campsite is located in the Greidhoeke. A beautiful area from which you can sail to the Frisian lakes via narrow waterways. Bird lovers will feast their eyes in the Skrok and Skrins nature reserves.

properties.name: Camping Manoir de Penn ar Ster
Camping Le Moulin du Roy
properties.description:
East of the city of Toulouse and on the edge of the Montagne Noire mountain range, Le Moulin du Roy campsite has a rural location. You are here just outside the town of Revel. A river flows in front of the small campsite and the idyllic recreational lake of Saint-Ferréol is about two kilometres away. You can also swim in the public swimming pool which is on the other side of the road. Plenty of water fun possible! In the snack bar you can get ice creams, drinks and fresh rolls.

Green and friendly

At Le Moulin du Roy campsite, you can pitch your caravan, motorhome or tent on grass. All the pitches are situated along a circular street with a playing field in the middle. In the distance you can see the foothills of the Montagne Noire. The eye-catcher on the campsite is the Coco Sweet, a tent accommodation with a nice design and its own wooden deck.

A refreshing dive

The beautiful Lac de Saint-Ferréol is easily accessible and is situated in the middle of a beautiful forest. Many water sports enthusiasts and fishermen come here. But taking a dip in the lake is always a good idea. For the pool complex, just cross the road. Campers have free use of the outdoor pool.

Relaxed or sporty

At the campsite, there is a relaxed and peaceful atmosphere where children can play safely. A playground, large jeu-de-boules pitch and several table tennis tables are located in the centre of the campsite. Feel like relaxing with a book? Maybe there is a nice one in the mini-library. Put on your walking shoes or take a bike for a beautiful route along the Canal du Midi Greenway.

properties.name: Le Grand Fay
properties.description:
Welcome to Le Grand Fay, a small and friendly campsite in the beautiful Pays de la Loire region of France. Just nine kilometres from the sea, the campsite is the ideal base for anyone who wants to combine peace, nature and culture. From here, you can discover the cultural highlights of St. Nazaire and Nantes and enjoy relaxed French life. The owners welcome you to their authentic campsite.

Comfortable accommodation and large pitches

Le Grand Fay has large and partially-shaded pitches that are perfect for anyone seeking privacy and tranquillity. Modern cottages and mobile homes are available for campers who prefer a little more comfort. The facilities are designed for relaxation and holiday enjoyment; the small-scale campsite and intimate atmosphere ensure you feel at home very quickly.

Relaxation facilities

The campsite has a heated swimming pool, which is perfect for a refreshing dip after a day of discoveries. In high season, you can enjoy tasty snacks, including local specialities. Whether you relax by the pool or explore the green surroundings of the nearby park with its lake, there’s always something to do. Thanks to its small size, you will enjoy peace and quiet here, while regularly organised activities provide entertainment for young and old.

Visit cities

The Loire-Atlantique department is brimming with nature and culture. For example, visit the cities of St. Nazaire (25 km) and Nantes (47 km). Nantes has a surprising mix of modern art, history and vibrancy.

properties.name: Camping Marie-France
properties.description:
For many people, camping on a small-scale French campsite with a view of the mountains sounds like music to their ears. At Marie-France Campsite in Aigueblanche, Savoie, the tranquillity of the the surrounding French Alps is rarely disturbed. The area has everything you need, whether you're looking to enjoy an active or relaxing holiday.

Personal reception

At Marie-France Campsite, the owner provides you a personal welcome. The campsite has 27 large camping pitches with plentiful flowers and shade. But you are also quite welcome here even without your own camping equipment. You can spend the night in a luxury mobile home or in one of the apartments. This also makes the campsite particularly suitable for disabled campers. The sanitary facilities were partially renovated in 2021.

Municipal waterpark

The campsite does not have a swimming pool, but you can walk to the municipal waterpark in about ten minutes. This waterpark is freely accessible to guests of Marie-France Campsite and provides you a cool spot to enjoy water recreation activities on hot days. Go down the waterslide or swim laps in the lap pool. For the smallest guests there is a wonderful paddling pool with play equipment. You can read a good book on the sun loungers along the side of the swimming pool or on the extensive green lawn.

Beautiful environment

The campsite is simple but beautifully situated. There is a playground where children can swing and play table tennis. Although there is no entertainment program at the campsite, there is plenty to do within walking distance. For example, you can admire the natural beauty of the Morel waterfall and discover the history of nearby ancient structures.

properties.name: Camping Le Domaine du Castex
properties.description:
Do you like to holiday in quiet surroundings, where you wake up to the sound of bird song? Then Camping Le Domaine du Castex near Aignan in Gers is the place for you. Gers is one of the most sparsely populated regions of France and also free of mass tourism. The campsite has a park-like allure, with a friendly atmosphere all year round. In short, it’s the ideal place to completely unwind.

Pitches and accommodation

This small campsite offers a variety of accommodation options, although it has more tourist pitches than anything else. Sunny and shaded pitches are available. All the touring pitches have a beautiful view of the hills and agricultural fields. On clear days, you can even see the Pyrenees! Rental accommodation is available too. For example, a cosy safari tent, a modern mobile home, chalet, luxury hotel rooms or a gîte full of character. The gîte accommodates groups of 12 guests.

What can you do at this campsite?

Need some refreshment after a nice walk or bike ride through Gers? Then take a refreshing dip in the campsite's outdoor swimming pool. Afterwards, relax on a lounger around the pool, where you will often find shady spots. The campsite also has a large playground and various sports facilities. End the day with a tasty local meal prepared by the campsite owners themselves.

Authentic villages

Gers is a rural area that is very popular with cycling enthusiasts. Take beautiful trips past rolling vineyards. On the way, you’ll pass pleasant villages where it seems as if time has stood still.

properties.name: Camping Serro da Bica
properties.description:
Campismo Serro da Bica provides a good holiday location for hikers, bird-watchers and nature lovers in Alentejo, Portugal. The campsite is close to the city of Ourique (11 km), known for its local delicacy ‘Black Pork’. It is a campsite that embraces simplicity, with various pitches among the hills. Trees provide the necessary shade but, to really cool off, go to the nearby Rio Mira river.

Back to the basics

At this campsite, you really go ‘back to the basics’ with your own camping equipment. The pitches are distributed over a hilly area, giving you a choice between a spot in the sun or under the shade of a tree. The pitches are simple but neat and have the necessary connections.

Although the campsite focuses on a rustic experience, it does not lack the most essential amenities. The sanitary facilities are clean and well-maintained, and the pathways are paved.

Connection with nature

On the other side of the hill is the Rio Mira, a river that winds through the green landscape and flows into the Santa Clara reservoir some 20 kilometres further. Cast your line out into this river or lay your towel on its banks or go for a swim.

Alentejo is known for its beautiful natural environment: from glowing hills to thick wooded areas and from vast plains to swamps. It is a true paradise for many species of birds. Around the campsite you will spot bee-eaters, blue magpies, long-legged buzzards, storks, flamingos and vultures.

properties.name: Camping Les Oliviers
properties.description:
Alpes-de-Haute-Provence is a tourist region with hundreds of lovely sights to see and beautiful nature. The lovely campsite of Les Oliviers, named for the campsite's grounds (a former olive grove), is the ideal place to enjoy it. The campsite is on a height with a wonderful view of the valley of the river Durance. From the campsite, you can take a lovely walk down a path to the town of Oraison. It's worth taking a visit to one of the atmospheric towns, especially when there's a market.

Cosy and with plenty of privacy

The site lies against a slope. On the way to your camping pitch, you can enjoy the beautiful view. The camping fields are built between olive trees and accessible via well-maintained roads. The dimensions of the pitches vary, but you'll have privacy wherever you are. There are plenty and clean sanitary facilities.

Lovely view, terrace with loungers

There is a simple, medium-sized swimming pool with a paddling pool. The tiled terrace offering a view of the wider area. Sun loungers are available for everyone wanting to relax.

In the cosy snack bar, also entertainment room, simple meals are available. Get a meal to eat at your tent or sit outside on the terrace. For groceries, you can drive to a supermarket a few kilometres away.

Away on a boat

The campsite is fairly central in a lovely region where you can enjoy wonderful landscapes and lovely towns. A few kilometres from the campsite, you can hire canoes at a range of locations around Lac d’Esparron to sail on the lake.

properties.name: Camping De Blikvaart
properties.description:
Camping de Blikvaart in Sint Annaparochie is located in the middle of the Frisian countryside, on the Elfsteden sailing route. Here you will camp in peace surrounded by panoramic views and water. The campsite is ideal for fishermen, cyclists and families who love the outdoors. Children can play with animals, ride ponies or go on a tractor ride adventure. For an outing, visit the Wadden Sea or Leeuwarden.

Spacious pitches and special accommodation

The campsite has spacious pitches, some of which are right by the water. Don’t have your own camping equipment? Choose a holiday house or one of the atmospheric gypsy wagons. Group accommodation for 22 people is also available. All accommodation is simply but comfortably furnished, giving you all the comforts you need.

Facilities for young and old

There is plenty to do on the campsite. Children can have fun with trampolines, go-karts and the sandpit. The waters of the Blikvaart invite swimming and trout fishing. Want to discover Friesland in a fun way? Then hire a Solex bike.

Discover Friesland from the water or by bike

Want to know what there is to do in the vicinity? Leaflets with tips for excursions are available in the toilet and shower building. The immediate surroundings of the campsite are perfect for cycling and boating trips. You can easily sail to Franeker (18 km) or Bartlehiem (25 km), two well-known spots on the Elfsteden sailing route.

Prefer to go to the coast? At the Wadden Sea (8 km), you can go on lovely walks or a boat trip to the islands. For a day of shopping, visit the bustling city of Leeuwarden (16 km).

properties.name: La Baie des Veys
properties.description:
Right on the beautiful coast of Normandy on the Cotentin peninsula, the campsite has a special location near the Utah Beach invasion beach. Here families and couples who love nature, silence and neat facilities will feel right at home.

There are many monuments to visit in the area, and Camping La Baie des Veys is an ideal base for such visits. Or trek through the beautiful surroundings on foot or by bicycle. With its charming location, it is only a few steps from the pitches to the bayfront.

Camping near Utah Beach

The French region of La Manche is located in the heart of Normandy. Coming from the N13, there is a good road leading to the pleasant Camping La Baie des Veys. The coastal area is a popular spot for seals. At high tide, the area is largely flooded, which prevents it from being a real beach. The enthusiastic and friendly managers are one of the reasons that campers love coming back here.

Beautiful pitches

As you walk through the campsite, you will immediately notice the beautiful planting. The well-maintained property consists of two parts. One part is occupied by regular guests and the other by guests renting a lodge tent or a hikers' hut. Motor homes, caravans and tents are located on the other part. The modern sanitary facilities are adjacent to the reception building and are very clean.

properties.name: Camping Les Berges du Doux
properties.description:
Fancy a holiday surrounded by the beautiful nature of the department of Ardèche? Then Les Berges du Doux Campsite is the place for you! Here you'll be camping in a beautiful green setting along a river. The pitches are spacious and shaded. You can also rent nice accommodations here, such as cottages, pods, chalets, bungalow tents and a gîte.

You can cool off in the nice swimming pool and in the Doux River. And for the little ones there's a paddling pool and a fun playground. The Doux valley in the north of the Ardèche is a perfect environment for the active holiday maker. Explore the area by bike, by train or on a nice hike.

Entertainment at the campsite

The campsite features a jeu-de-boules court, table tennis table, trampoline and badminton court. You can also take a refreshing dip in the pool. There's a terrace where you can enjoy a snack and a drink.

Splashing in the Doux River

Les Berges du Doux Campsite is located near the Doux River. Only a road separates the campsite from the river. Cool off by taking a dip in the fresh water. This is also an ideal place for fishing enthusiasts to cast a line.

Explore the green north of the Ardèche

There is a lot of natural beauty to discover in the area. The Gorges du Doux is beautiful and can be explored in different ways. An old train runs along the historic Chemin de Fer du Vivarais railway line (14 km), from which you have a beautiful view.

properties.name: Camping La Ferme de Clareau
properties.description:
Enjoy peace and tranquillity at this small-scale campsite in the heart of the Drôme Provençale. La Ferme de Clareau Campsite is a wonderful place for peace seekers, nature lovers, hikers and cyclists. Campers with and without children can enjoy a relaxing summer holiday here, far away from the hustle and bustle of the city. At this campsite you can count on a personal welcome and unrivalled hospitality. It is not for nothing that many campers come back again and again.

Camping by the river

The campsite has camping pitches situated at various elevations and ranging from spacious to very spacious. Most pitches are close to the river and the others are higher up. There are both places with a lot of shade and places in the sun. Those camping without their own equipment can stay in one of fully equipped rental accommodations.

Swimming with a view

The circular swimming pool with panoramic views is located on the hillside near the reception and the bar. You can also cool off in the river that flows alongside the campsite. Just a five-minute drive from the campsite, you can take a dip in the man-made recreational lake between the mountains. Once the children have finished playing at the swimming pool and the river, they can enjoy themselves on the playground, at the table tennis table or in the recreation room with games. The campsite better suits the interests of young children than those of teenagers.

properties.name: Camping Presa La Viñuela
properties.description:
Want to enjoy the beautiful region of Andalusia, just a 20 minute drive from the Spanish coast? You can do this at Camping Presa La Viñuela, located on the La Viñuela reservoir. This small-scale campsite is a peaceful oasis. Here you'll enjoy views over the beautiful, mountainous surroundings. There are plenty of hiking trails in the area. Don't expect an extensive entertainment programme, but you definitely won't be bored. Relax by the pool or venture into the surrounding area, where there is plenty to do for active campers. For a day in the city, you can also go to bustling Málaga.

Perfect place for peace seekers

The friendly staff of this small, quiet campsite will welcome you upon your arrival. There are 39 camping pitches and 11 mobile homes. The camping pitches are equipped with a pergola shade. This is especially nice on hot days. There are limited facilities, which makes the campsite particularly suitable for those seeking peace and quiet.

Swimming with a view

You can cool off in the outdoor swimming pool with a beautiful view of the lake and the mountains. There are sun loungers around the pool where you can relax with a good book. There's also a table tennis table and a small football field. No activities are organised on the campsite. However, you can explore the area on foot or by bicycle from the campsite. Pets are also welcome at the campsite. Don't feel like cooking? The campsite has a grill restaurant with a large terrace. You'll enjoy a beautiful view of the reservoir from the terrace.

properties.name: Camping Le Paroy
properties.description:
In the south of the Burgundy region, just within the boundaries of the Parc Régional du Morvan, lies the small-scale campsite Le Paroy. You camp here in a hilly area amidst woodlands, meadows and lakes. On this campsite you can unwind completely. The natural environment in which the campsite is located is ideally suited to walking, cycling and fishing.

During high season, guests can enjoy meals on the terrace. You can buy vegetables from the vegetable garden and fresh eggs from the chicken coop. The campsite has a swimming pool for you to enjoy.

This terraced campsite offers spaciously laid-out camping pitches. There are pitches with ample shade or little shade. Le Paray mainly attracts lovers of tranquillity and nature. The campsite is classified as a so-called 'adult campsite'. This means that there is limited space for families with children.

In the immediate vicinity you can visit sites such as Autun and Bribacte, as well as the Buddhist temple in La Boulaye. The large number of markets are also worth a visit or you can go on a day trip to Beaune.

properties.name: Camping River
properties.description:
Between the mighty Alps in southeastern France, directly on the river Ubaye, lies Camping River. You camp here in the mountainous east of Provence, in the middle of nature. With forty touring pitches on a sloping, shady site, camping River is a small-scale campsite. Lovers of 'vintage' camping can rent the retro caravan.

Camping in nature

The mighty Alps watch over the campsite River. You will find forty touring pitches here, located in the wilderness. Due to the sloping, natural character of the terrain, not all pitches are suitable for caravans. These pitches are all the more beautiful for tent campers. Tall pine trees provide shade for most of the touring pitches. In addition, some furnished mobile homes and simple and luxurious lodge tents can be booked. For a 'vintage' camping holiday, the retro caravan is a nice accommodation.

For sporty campers

Although in the Ubaye valley, between the high peaks of the Alps, you'll find a peaceful piece of nature, it's mainly the sporty campers who see camping River as a great holiday destination. The mountainous nature is the domain of fanatical hikers and cyclists, who like to climb the challenging Alpine cliffs. The fast-flowing Ubaye attracts water sports enthusiasts, who try to conquer the river by kayak or raft.

Fresh croissants on the river

A homemade pizza, a local wine or a fresh croissant? In the attractive main building of the campsite you'll find the restaurant, where they serve various Provencal dishes. The terrace, situated directly on the banks of the river, is a lovely place to eat your breakfast. The restaurant has an informal atmosphere.

properties.name: Camping Alba-Agricampeggio
properties.description:
The natural campsite Alba-Agricampeggio stretches out across the base of the Colli Euganei regional park. In this area you can explore the Euganean Hills, former volcanoes that reach heights of six hundred metres. The region gets its charm from the viticulture, the orchards as well as countless medieval villages and fortified cities.

Camping in a beautiful location

You will be warmly welcomed to this campsite by the owner or his wife or sister. The reception area is located in a restored 18th-century farmhouse. This peaceful, small-scale campsite (0.7 ha) features 25 touring pitches and is part of an estate. The demarcated pitches vary in size from 60 to 70 m2 and offer differing degrees of shade. All camping pitches boast gorgeous locations amidst the natural surroundings. You can also rent detached, ecologically constructed bungalows. These boast spacious rooms. 

Swimming with a view

The sanitary facilities have been thoroughly renovated. There is an outdoor swimming pool (200 m2) near the camping pitches as well as a sunbathing lawn. These boast a stunning view of the hilly setting. Children can entertain themselves with the available playground equipment and a table tennis table.

Delicious meals made with local ingredients

Old recipes passed down by farmers are prepared using local ingredients at the farmhouse restaurant to create delicious dishes. Of course, wine from the vineyards in the Euganean Hills is served with the meals. Olive oil is delivered by friendly farmers from the area.

The restaurant is open on Fridays and during the weekend. It features a lovely terrace that offers some shade. Eating here is highly recommended! The Alba-Agricampeggio campsite doesn't disappoint when it comes to breakfast either. During high season, fresh bread is available.

properties.name: Camping Gauglerhof
properties.description:
Camping Gauglerhof is situated on a sunny hillside above Lake Millstatt in Carinthia. From the campsite, you can enjoy stunning views over the lake and surrounding mountains. The campsite is based around a farmhouse that is over 100 years old, which houses the bar today. The modestly sized campsite enjoys a quiet location. During your stay here, you will be surrounded by greenery, just a short distance from water and nature.

Spacious pitches and comfortable accommodation

This modestly sized campsite offers well-maintained pitches for tents, caravans and motorhomes. The pitches are partly terraced, offering plenty of privacy and often overlooking the lake or mountains. You will have access to electricity hook-ups and modern sanitary facilities. Those looking for a bit more comfort can opt for one of the attractive glamping tents or the flat in the farmhouse.

Welcoming atmosphere and convenient facilities

Camping Gauglerhof is popular among campers who appreciate tranquillity and nature. There is a playground for children and plenty of space around the campsite to play outdoors. As you will be camping on a farm, there are also animals at the campsite. Children will love visiting the ducks, horses, cats and rabbits. And the snack, pizza and bread roll service will make your stay even more convenient.

Enjoy the mountains and water

Lake Millstätter See is about three kilometres from the campsite. Here, you can swim, go boating or simply relax on the beach. In the centre of Millstatt (4 km) you will find a number of shops and places to eat and drink. Walkers and cyclists can start their routes directly from the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Bozanov
properties.description:
Camping Bozanov offers an authentic camping experience amid the natural green surroundings of the Czech Broumovské Steny (Broumov Walls). With its own swimming pool, entertainment and a bar you can enjoy a relaxing stay here. Surrounded by the Broumovské Steny mountains, the campsite is a starting point for active nature lovers and those seeking peace and quiet. This historical town of Broumov is certainly worth visiting.

Camping with mountain views

If you come with your tent, caravan or motorhome, you will camp on one of the 48 spacious camping pitches. The spacious and level camping pitches vary in size from 90 m2 to 130 m2. Due to the way they are spread out and the size of the pitches, you have plenty of privacy. All the pitches are also provided with an electrical connection. If you would prefer to stay in accommodation, book an apartment or bungalow. Whatever you pick, the views are beautiful all over.

A comfortable camping holiday

The campsite, located at an altitude of 400 metres, is known for its tranquillity and child friendliness. That is thanks to the car-free site, entertainment in the high season and nearby natural swimming lake. There is also a small swimming pool, which is a great alternative to the lake. And go to the modern bar for a lovely evening with your fellow campers.

The natural green border region with Poland

The area around Camping Bozanov is rich in nature. Here, you camp with views of the Broumovské Steny mountains, ideal for walking and cycling trips. A trip to the dinosaur park, Park Dinozaurów/ Karłów (30 km), just over the Polish border, is recommended for children.

properties.name: MiO-Minicamping
properties.description:
Do you like charming farm campsites, good food and visits to historic cities? Then this German 'Geheimtipp' is not to be missed. In East German Saxony, between Chemnitz and Dresden, you will find the attractive campsite and restaurant MiO Made. Here you will not only enjoy the beautiful view and excellent sanitary facilities, but also the delicious home-made dishes.

On top of a hill

MiO minicamping is located on a hill near a farm. The establishment is a nice mix between a mini campsite and a 'food workshop'. The heart of the campsite is a large converted barn that houses the food workshop and a covered patio. You can also rent a safari tent.

Camping and making a campfire

The camping pitches are situated on open grassy ground and offer a beautiful view of the surroundings. There is not much shade on the terrain, but because of its location on the hill you can enjoy a nice breeze. To make it all the more idyllic, you can pick your own herbs and apples on site. You can make a fire or roast potatoes on the public fireplace. For the children there is some playground equipment and a trampoline.

Fine dining evenings

If you like good food, we recommend you to sign up for the fine dining evenings. The chef is known for her good cooking skills and love to share them with the guests. The rest of the week, you can always visit the dining area for a cup of coffee, a glass of fine wine or a cold beer. You can also order fresh bread rolls here for breakfast.

properties.name: Minicamping De Zeeuwse Vlag
properties.description:
Minicamping De Zeeuwse Vlag is located in the middle of the Zeeland island of Schouwen-Duiveland. This small, family-friendly campsite exudes space and tranquillity. The green camping site, located next to an apple orchard, offers space for twenty-five spacious camping pitches and looks immaculate. Here you will find a relaxed, pleasant destination for a camping holiday in your own country. The surrounding area is ideal for cycling. If you are a reasonably fit cyclist, this is a great way to explore the island.

Space and freedom

The campsite looks very well maintained. The lawn, surrounded by a hedge of trees and an apple orchard, exudes spaciousness. The campsite lives up to its name: the site has only twenty-five tourist pitches. However, these camping pitches are exceptionally spacious.

From the pitches, you have a view over a large part of the site. They are partly separated by hedges, giving you plenty of privacy. But the hedges do not block the view. This creates a feeling of freedom, which is further enhanced by the fresh breeze that blows across the campsite from the sea.

Standard facilities

The campsite is really just a base for excursions in the surrounding area. Only the most essential facilities are available: a toilet block with clean sanitary facilities, a launderette with washing machine and dryer, and playground equipment for the children. That's all you need. There are farm shops in the neighbourhood, and you can find a supermarket in Nieuwerkerk, Brouwershaven or Zierikzee. All these places are within ten minutes' drive.

properties.name: Camping Groot Antink
properties.description:
For an idyllic spot in nature you don't have to drive far. Camping Groot Antink is located close to the fortified town of Groenlo. This tiny farm campsite is situated between fruit orchards, which are full of fresh fruit in the summer months. You may pick them yoursel, and in the farm shop you can buy all kinds of homemade products.

Wooded camping field

In the farmhouse, which is also the home of the owners, a hospitable welcome awaits you, fitting for such a small-scale campsite. At the top floor, is an apartment for rent. But especially the pitches on the wooded terrain are beautiful. After arrival you can choose your own spot. Choose one of the spacious touring pitches under the trees or go for a spot in the sun.

Homemade jam

Camping Groot Antink is a farm campsite, situated between fruit orchards. Currants, raspberries, blueberries: a variety of different fruits are grown on the farm. After picking, these delicious fruits are transformed into different kinds of jams, sauces, syrups and chutneys. All these homemade products are for sale in the farm shop.

Renovated sanitary facilities

Recently, the sanitary block has been completely renovated. Campers can now make use of modern and functional sanitary facilities. It does look small but it is big enough for the number of camping guests.

Picking fruit

When the berries and raspberries are ripe between June and August, then you may pick them yourself. Taste them right away or take some with you to make jam at home; it's all allowed. Better first ask which fruit you can pick..

properties.name: Minicamping Pitteperk
properties.description:
Between the sea, the beach and historic Middelburg lies Minicamping Pitteperk. The spacious pitches on the grassy meadows have a panoramic view of the countryside. Here, you can be sure of enjoying a peaceful camping holiday. You can have a nice rest, but you can also choose to be active. Help the farmer, explore the cheese shop and cycle to beautiful Middelburg. Pedal towards the coast, and within ten minutes, your feet will be immersed in the sea.

Wide open views and little wind

Set up your caravan on one of the spacious pitches and enjoy the panoramic view. You can look out over the Walcheren countryside from your camping chair. The arable fields are endless. It gives you a wonderful sense of freedom and space. Meanwhile, the tall trees and bushes protect you against the wind.

Helping with the cows

It's not only farming assistants and volunteers who work in the dairy farm. Campsite guests may also lend a helping hand. If they want to, of course. You are not obliged to do anything. So go and have a look without interrupting your holiday. If you like cheese, you'll feel right at home here. In fact, in the stables, you will also find a large cheese-making facility. Select the tastiest cheeses in the shop for a well-stocked cheese board.

Historical Middelburg

Are you looking for a wonderful place to do your daily shopping? Try Koudekerke or Middelburg. There are plenty of supermarkets here. In Middelburg you can also visit the historic centre of this beautiful Zeeland city. With the old abbey tower, Kloveniersdoelen and the gothic town hall, there is much to admire.

properties.name: Camping Le Logis de la Lande
Camping La Prade
properties.description:
Right on the border of Tarn and Aveyron, in the south of France, you’ll find campsite La Prade. You camp here on the banks of the river Viaur. For those looking for peace and quiet, this is a lovely place. Children can play in the shallow water of the river. The swimming pool is also popular with the little ones. In the vicinity are some of the most beautiful medieval villages of France.

Small-scale camping by the river

On this small-scale campsite everyone will find a suitable pitch under the trees. The pitches are situated between shrubs, giving you a lot of privacy. And there is always shade from a tree. The most beautiful pitches are probably on the banks of the river. You don't come with your own caravan, campervan or tent? Then you can opt for a mobile home or cosy mini hut.

A football match or walk in nature?

The centre of conviviality on the campsite is the little restaurant. Sit in the shade of a tree and enjoy a plate of artisan chips. And a cool drink of course. For the children there is more than enough space to play. The large lawns invite you to a football match. Would you like to take a beautiful walk in nature? From the campsite there are several footpaths into the woods and hills.

Fresh breakfast

Owners Nadine and Giles take good care of their customers. Be pampered in the high season with a fresh breakfast in the early morning. Prefer to eat in peace and quiet in front of your caravan or tent? Then pick up your fresh rolls at the restaurant. Also the place for dinner.

properties.name: Minicamping Heksenheuvel
properties.description:
Camping Heksenheuvel is a mini campsite located in the farmyard of a farmhouse near Someren in North Brabant. Here you will camp on spacious touring pitches on a beautiful lawn, or in the cosy log cabin. Young and old can enjoy the friendly atmosphere, peaceful surroundings and beautiful nature. For dogs, we even organise dog camping weekends. From 2025, the campsite will be a non-smoking area.

Comfortable and spacious camping

Behind the farmhouse is the beautifully maintained camping field of Camping Heksenheuvel. The grassy field is surrounded by woods and offers about twenty spacious touring pitches. Every camper can enjoy a comfortable pitch with plenty of space in front and a water point. For some extra comfort you can stay in the cosy log cabin with own bathroom or a studio.

Child friendly campsite for young and old

Young and old know how to find Camping Heksenheuvel, whether they are parents with children or grandchildren visiting their grandparents. The entire campsite is a non-smoking area.

For older campers, the campsite is a good starting point for walks and cycle rides through the Brabant countryside. And with the playground in the middle of the field, the campsite is child-friendly. The youngest guests can also enjoy themselves in the play barn. Here you will find climbing equipment, a trampoline and a handicraft and play corner.

Dog camping weekend

Campers with dogs will also find Heksenheuvel campsite a great place to camp. Dogs even get special treatment. Your four-legged friend is allowed to run free on the recreation field. You can also train your dog there; special training equipment can be borrowed from reception. In spring and autumn we even organise dog camping weekends. Then you can train, walk and even swim together with your pet.

properties.name: Vakantiepark De Toffe Peer
properties.description:
In the countryside of Drenthe, near three national parks, lies Holiday Park De Toffe Peer. This quiet and small-scale campsite has an extremely well-maintained camping area, consisting of three camping fields. You will have a beautiful panoramic view over the fields and the beautiful Drenthe farm that the campsite belongs to. Children can help care for the chickens, goats and rabbits.

A cosy campsite

The small-scale campsite of De Toffe Peer consists of three camping fields, each with its own character. You can choose a spacious pitch in a cosy field completely surrounded by vegetation, or a spot in an open field with a wide view. The camping fields are neatly tended and have partially paved areas: convenient for your caravan or campervan. In addition to the 26 touring pitches, there are also several comfortable rental accommodations available, including an attractive sod house with a box bed.

Little animal friends

The Toffe Peer is a wonderful place for young families. There is a nest swing, a cool play hut, a sandpit and an animal pasture. Fun go-karts allow children to explore the campsite. The chickens, which roam freely on the property, may be fed every day. Of course, there are eggs to collect. Little animal friends may also help care for and cuddle the goats and rabbits.

Ruinerwold, Meppel and Giethoorn

There is no campsite shop at De Toffe Peer, but you don't have to go far for your groceries. In Ruinerwold, three kilometres from the campsite, there is a supermarket. In Meppel, about eight kilometres away, you will find even more supermarkets. It is also a great place for shopping, and there are many fine restaurants.

properties.name: Museumboerderij Mariahoeve
properties.description:
Mariahoeve campsite is located on the edge of the Veluwe in an agricultural landscape. The Nuldernauw as well as Strand Nulde are in close proximity, as are the woodlands and heathlands of the Veluwe. The campsite forms part of the Mariahoeve museum farm. Despite this museum environment, the campsite does not make a touristy impression thanks to the natural surroundings.

Welcome!

The reception is housed in a modern building, where you will also find the sanitary facilities. The building also serves as tearoom and visitors centre for the museum. The campsite is managed by eager volunteers. The modern sanitary facilities are housed in a new sanitary building which complies with the highest standards. It is also very easy accessible for disabled persons.

Free camping

The camping area is not subdivided, so that the space you have depends on the number of guests. As a rule the pitches are sufficiently spacious. As there are no hedges or hedgerows there is little privacy and only the trees surrounding the campsite provide some shade. A number of basic trekker huts are available for rent on the campsite. 

A day to the beach

The campsite has no swimming facilities, but it is only a 10 minute bicycle ride to Strand Nulde where you can swim in the Nuldernauw. On warm days it may get pretty crowded there.

Bar with friendly terrace

As mentioned above, the reception building has a tearoom. There is no restaurant. For groups, who can stay in group accommodation (suitable for a maximum of eighteen persons), a caterer can be arranged. There is a bar with a friendly terrace. You can do your daily grocery shopping in Ermelo and Putten.

properties.name: Boerencamping Remmelink
properties.description:
Farm camping Remmelink is a friendly campsite where everyone will feel at home straight away. Children can play to their heart's content with the playhouse, the sandpit and various skelters. They can play games in the recreation area. When it is cold, the wood stove will be lit here. The campsite is car-free.

Farm shed

A section of the farm shed has been converted to reception aka recreation area. The owners will give you information here about the ins and outs of the campsite. You are also given a lot of information about the area. The campsite is car-free, but you can park your vehicle on a parking area near the entrance. 

Amiable campsite...

Remmelink is an amiable, small-scale campsite, mainly frequented by families with young children. Despite this, the setup of the campsite is spacious, and the camping grounds with fruit trees have been subdivided into smaller fields. This ensures ample privacy and shade. There is no swimming pool on the campsite, but less than 3 km away there is a lovely beach on the IJssel river. 

...with basic facilities

Except for some play equipment for children, there are few facilities on the campsite. You will therefore have to entertain yourself. There is also no shop, but sometimes an apple pie is made and there are, of course, the eggs from the chickens. The sanitary facilities are basic, but adequate. They are kept immaculately clean.

Unique Bronkhorst

The town of Bronkhorst is very special and is located seven km from the campsite. This is namely the smallest town of the Netherlands with just 157 inhabitants. Not much is left of the castle and medieval houses, but by contrast the town farms are very impressive.

properties.name: Camping Slingeland
properties.description:
In the vast polders of the Green Heart lies Camping Slingeland. This pleasant, small-scale farm campsite, which has 25 spacious pitches, is located in the middle of meadows. It is a great campsite for children: feeding the lambs and taking pony rides are very popular.

Open and spacious campingsite

Behind the farm is the vast camping field. A paved road runs across the field, so that you can easily reach one of the 25 spacious, unfenced pitches. These pitches are all on the same field and face inwards. This way you can easily make contact with your fellow guests. This gives the campsite an open and spacious character, just like its surroundings. You can also stay in a lodge tent completely furnished with a cooker, refrigerator and comfortable beds.

Pony workshop

As befits a farm campsite, children can get to know all kinds of animals. They can help feed the little lambs, ride on the hay wagon and participate in a real pony workshop. Here, they can learn how to handle a pony and go for a ride. There is also playground equipment and a trampoline. And of course, when it is nice, the go-carts are brought out of the barn. In the unlikely event of bad weather, children can enjoy themselves in the recreation room.

Rural shopping

Camping Slingeland does not have a campsite shop or supermarket, but there are all kinds of nice shops nearby. For an ice cream you can visit the ice cream farm, one kilometre away. And in Giessenburg, four kilometres from the campsite, is the Graanbuurt. Here you can go 'country shopping' in the Graanschuur and the Kolenbeurs. There is also a supermarket in Giessen.

properties.name: Domaine La Chabanne
properties.description:
Nature campsite Domaine La Chabanne is located amongst the rolling landscapes of the authentic French region of Auvergne. This holiday spot is small-scale, friendly and offers plenty of space in the middle of the Montagne Bourbonnaise nature. The camping pitches are spacious (200-400 m2), and you can also rent a luxury safari tent or dome. You can cool off in the neatly landscaped swimming pool, the roof of which can be closed in bad weather. The children will have a great time with their peers playing a game of pétanque or climbing and scrambling on the new playground (2022). The town of Châtel-Montagne is 5 kilometres away.

Spacious camping pitches and luxury rental accommodations

This small-scale family campsite is spacious and the grounds are terraced. The camping pitches for touring campers are huge (200-400 m2). These pitches are mainly suitable for people who camp with a tent or trailer tent. There are also pitches more suitable for motorhomes and caravans elsewhere on the site. A number of new 50 m2 domes have been installed in 2023. You have a beautiful view from the dome and can admire the starry sky at night. You can also rent a luxury safari tent.

Enjoy a relaxing day at the campsite

You can be at the pool in no time to enjoy a refreshing dip. The kids can let off steam on the playground, which is located next to the swimming pool. For a sporty end to the day, be sure to enjoy a game of table tennis table and jeu-de-boules. To help ensure a peaceful atmosphere, no extensive entertainment programme is offered here.

properties.name: Camping Halve Maan
properties.description:
Do you like small-scale camping close to beautiful nature? Camping Halve Maan in the North Limburg town of Well is ideal for you. You camp next to De Maasduinen National Park where you can take lovely walks. On the campsite itself, you will enjoy simplicity and tranquillity. And you are right by the Leukermeer, where swimming and water sports are available.

Small campsite

The mini campsite has spacious pitches, which are both sunny and shady. The campsite is surrounded by trees, bushes and meadows. Besides tents and caravans, motorhomes are also welcome here. Do you like to travel with your dog? Your four-legged friend is also welcome here!

Swimming in the Leukermeer

Anyone who loves tranquillity and nature will feel particularly at home here! That means there is no entertainment or facilities for children. Near the campsite is the Leukermeer, a large recreational lake where it is nice to relax. Take a dip in the water from the little beach or immerse yourself in the world of water sports.

Relax in the countryside

Beautiful hiking and cycling trips can be made directly from the campsite. In De Maasduinen National Park, you will find forests, sand dunes, lakes and heathland. Lake Reinders is right behind the campsite, where you will find relaxation and tranquillity. The campsite is also located on the long-distance cycle route LF3. Fancy an outing to a city? Venlo (27.5 km) and Venray (16.5 km) are nearby.

properties.name: Camping Duinzoomhoeve
properties.description:
Between the bulb fields and the dunes in the north of North Holland lies the small campsite Duinzoomhoeve. You can look out over the tulip fields from your spacious pitch on this child-friendly campsite. You will be camping less than a kilometre from the North Sea beach.

Grand panoramic view

Tulips as far as the eye can see: from a large part of the pitches at Camping Duinzoomhoeve you have a view over the bulb fields. These fields are at their most beautiful in the spring, but even after that the view is special: no coloured fields, but a vast panorama that gives a feeling of space and freedom. You camp on a flat grass field with room for thirty spacious touring pitches. For extra luxury, you can choose a comfort pitch, which has private sanitary facilities.

On the North Sea beach

The campsite is practically on the dunes, so the North Sea and the beach are never far away. A quarter of an hour's walk and your feet are in the sand. In the summer and with nice weather, the beautiful, clean North Sea beach is a wonderful place to sunbathe. And then the sea is warm enough for a swim. If the weather does not allow for a swim, you can always enjoy a nice long walk on the beach or a stroll through the wide dunes.

Children playing

Although the campsite does not have many play facilities, it is very child-friendly. The children can play to their heart's content on the various playground equipment. But the go-karts are especially popular. The flat terrain is perfect for an exciting race. Campfires are lit on the communal barbecue area on spring and summer evenings.

properties.name: Camping Zeevangshoeve
properties.description:
Zeevangshoeve Campsite is located right on the Markermeer, nicely sheltered behind the dike. At this small-scale farm campsite, you will be camping in the countryside, overlooking the vast meadows all around. The well-kept campsite is spacious. The stairs over the dike lead to a recreational beach on the Markermeer. It's a great place to swim and there are plenty of options for water sports.

Sheltered by the dike

Zeevangshoeve Campsite is a genuine farm campsite, located on a dairy farm. The well-kept campsite is beautifully landscaped, spacious and remarkably clean. It is located directly on the dike and is surrounded by a tall hedge. On one side you look out on the dike, on the other sides on the farm and the vast meadows around it.

The campsite has twenty-five spacious touring pitches and six dedicated motorhome pitches. There is also a luxury hiker's hut for rent. The pitches are on the grass and delineated with beautiful greenery. They have a paved area, which is very nice for caravans, awnings or canopies. The entire campsite is car-free.

Swimming in the Markermeer

The stairs over the dike lead to a recreational beach on the Markermeer. There you have a beautiful view over the water and over the Edam harbor. In the summer you can enjoy swimming, but you can also sail, kite surf and fish.

Nearby amenities

There is no campsite store, restaurant or bar at Zeevangshoeve Campsite. As a result, it is wonderfully quiet day and night. Fortunately, you will find all possible amenities in the immediate vicinity of the campsite, such as supermarkets, cafes and restaurants.

properties.name: Camping des Neiges
properties.description:
If you're looking for a campsite surrounded by greenery but still close to the centre, Camping des Neiges in Aigueblanche, Savoie is the place for you. This family campsite is located in the heart of the Alps. Thanks to its proximity to several spas, it offers the perfect combination of adventure and relaxation in the mountains, whether it's 20 degrees or -10.

Camping by the river

Camping des Neiges is a small-scale campsite where guests are personally greeted by the owners. The grounds are situated amongst the trees along the Isère River. Passing through a gate, you'll find the water just a few steps from your camping spot. There are spacious shaded pitches for motorhomes, caravans, folding caravans and tents. You can also choose to stay in one of the comfortable rental accommodations.

Winter skiing holiday

The campsite is - with the exception of November - open all year round. From 3 December to 25 March you cannot rent pitches, but you can rent one of the mobile homes or chalets with heating. Ideal for a winter sports holiday at the well-known ski areas of Valmorel La Belle and Les 3 Vallées.

Waterpark next to the campsite

Directly adjacent to the campsite is a large waterpark with a heated indoor and outdoor pool with a waterslide, sunbathing area and play equipment. There's also a paddling pool, so that even the little ones can have fun in the water. Guests of Camping des Neiges have free access to the waterpark.

properties.name: Camping De Grienduil
properties.description:
De Grienduil is a charming campsite at the edge of the village of Nieuwland (Utrecht) in the midst of the river region, near the Linge. The nice, well maintained campsite is characterized by a cheery atmosphere. The view from the campsite is a typical Dutch scene: pollard willows, meadows, ditches and cows.

There are pitches in all types and sizes

The approximately forty camping pitches on the grass are nicely maintained. They are located amongst the greenery (bushes and trees) and have a view of the surrounding meadows. The pitches are varied, not only in size (100-150 m2) but also regarding demarcation, shade and wind. There are also fourteen paved pitches of 110 m2.

Want to hire a cottage?

The rental accommodations have a special atmosphere. Overnight in a Bed & Breakfast, a luxury motorhome or in one of the large bungalows and trekker huts. The wooden trekker huts are brand new. They are built in the shape of a hefty half barrel, with doors opening on the front. The interior is also all of wood. 

Especially for the little campers

The campsite is not really suited to older children with regard to facilities. There is a safe fenced playground with some play equipment where babies and toddlers can have fun. There is not much to do for teenagers.

Charming atmosphere on the terrace

The restaurant is right behind the owners' house and has a small menu. There is a lovely terrace with beautiful parasols. There is no shop, but you can get a few basics.

properties.name: Camping Le Picard
properties.description:
Le Picard is a small, green campsite in Tournières, in the Calvados region. You camp here in the beautiful countryside of Normandy. The campsite is located in the centre of the village, behind an old farmhouse. There is a small lake near the campsite. The campsite is small and basic, but the service and quality of the amenities are very good. Enjoy the heated swimming pool, the playground and the restaurant.

Camping or renting?

When you drive to your pitch, you will see well-maintained grounds with grass surface in front of you. The number of pitches is limited here (35). There are pitches with and without demarcation. The degree of shade also varies for each pitch. Some pitches have no grass, but a pebble and crushed stone surface instead. The 21 rental accommodation units on Camping Le Picard are owned by people who stay here regularly. Three of them are available for rental.

Mini swimming pool and lake

The swimming pool is small but adequate. It measures some 5 x 10 m and is open from mid-June to the end of August. The swimming pool lies directly behind the restaurant. The lake is located near the entrance of the campsite. You are allowed to fish here, but you have to return your catch to the water.

A simple French meal

You can enjoy a good meal at the restaurant of Le Picard. This has a cosy ambiance. It is a simple establishment, more like a canteen. You can order a 'menu simple' here, but in France, 'simple' often means delicious. There is no campsite shop, but in July and August, you can get daily fresh bread.

properties.name: Camping Ushuaïa Villages Les Pommiers Pays d'Auge
properties.description:
Camping Les Pommiers Pays d'Auge is located in the rural region of Upper Normandy (named Haute-Normandie). The campsite measuring two ha is small, but very attractive. Thanks to the beautiful vegetation and the numerous types of plants and flowers, exotic bird species also consider the greenery of the campsite as their home. With a covered swimming pool and a playground there is no need for children to get bored.

You're very welcome!

Les Pommiers Pays d’Auge is located on a beautiful, well laid out terrain with 44 spacious touring pitches. These vary in size: from 120 to a whopping 200 m2. On the level terrain you will find numerous trees and flowering bushes. These also often serve as demarcation.

Don't have a tent, folding trailer, caravan or motorhome? No problem! There are eight attractive bungalows on the campsite. These are constructed of wood. Some are small (though practically furnished), others are much larger and have everything you could wish for.

Long lasting swimming fun

At the far end of the campsite is the heated swimming pool of 50 m2. You will also find sanitary facilities here. The swimming pool is covered with glass retractable roof sections. The walls of the swimming pool can also slide open. In summer they are usually open. The advantage of this construction is that everything can be covered in inclement weather. As a result the swimming pool can remain open for an extended period; you can use the pool from 1 May to 1 November. 

Catering

You will be looking in vain for a camping shop or restaurant, but the snack bar is a good compensation. You can buy simple snacks here. In high season they also do more extensive meals at a very reasonable price. The building is entirely made of wood and looks very attractive.

properties.name: Camping les 2 Salamandres
properties.description:
Camping les 2 Salamandres is situated in a typical rural French setting, a few kilometres outside the pretty village of Arces (Charente-Maritime). This small-scale two-star campsite is located in an ideal area for cycling. From here, you can also easily visit the charming seaside resorts along the Gironde. The campsite features an outdoor swimming pool, a restaurant, evening entertainment and a small shop selling essentials and local produce.

What accommodation options are there?

This campsite offers a good mix of accommodation and camping pitches. The pitches are spacious, have a neatly mown grass surface and are separated by trees. You’ll enjoy even more comfort in a canvas tent or a wooden cabin. In the latter, you even have your own bathroom facilities. This is, of course, also the case in the modern mobile homes available for rent at Les 2 Salamandres.

Beautiful outdoor pool and attractive restaurant

At the edge of the site, you’ll find the lovely outdoor swimming pool. A wonderful spot to take a refreshing dip and swim a few lengths, while the children enjoy themselves in the shallow end at the corner of the pool. After a swim, pop into the adjacent restaurant, where drinks and ice creams are available all day. You can also pick up your baguettes and sweet rolls here in the morning. In the afternoon, enjoy aperitif snacks or an extensive menu featuring burgers, salads, paninis and meat dishes. In the summer, there is also regular evening entertainment at the restaurant. In addition, there is a weekly themed meal featuring mussels and chips. Book your table in advance if you’d like to join in.

properties.name: Camping Les Fruits du Passau
properties.description:
Do you enjoy spending your holidays in a peaceful rural setting? Then how about a stay at Camping Les Fruits du Passau, near the village of Saint-Désiré in the Auvergne? This small, family-friendly campsite is exactly the sort of place where you will wake up to the cheerful chirping of birds and, with a bit of luck, spot a rabbit or a lizard darting away. You will be camping in a sparsely populated and non-touristy region. That makes it ideal for those seeking some peace and quiet. At the campsite itself, you will find very spacious pitches, a lovely outdoor swimming pool and a go-kart track.

Small plot, large pitches

Right at the entrance to this campsite is a large, authentic-looking house, containing the reception. This building also houses three spacious family rooms (chambres d'hôtes) for rent. Behind this main building is the well-maintained camping area. There, campers enjoy touring pitches of at least 150 square metres. The comfortable safari tents are on pitches of similar sizes and have their own kitchen.

Outdoor swimming pool, go-kart track and table d'hôtes

In the centre of Camping Les Fruits du Passau is a lovely swimming pool, where the water is heated to 28 degrees. It has a shallow end for small children. Swimming lessons are regularly offered for them throughout the summer.

Had enough swimming for a while? The campsite also has playground equipment on dry land, as well as a go-kart track, which is also great fun for older children and adults. The best way to finish off a pleasant day at the campsite is to join the evening table d'hôtes. Especially in high season, the campsite owners often cook for all campsite guests, for which a reservation is needed of course.

properties.name: Camping Aire Naturelle le Bois de Sibourg
Camping Pyrénées Emotions
properties.description:
In the French Pyrenees, at an altitude of almost eight hundred metres, you will find Camping Pyrénées Emotions. This well-maintained mini-campsite is surrounded by nature and offers breathtaking views of the surrounding mountains. The surroundings of the campsite are perfect for all kinds of outdoor activities.

In the heart of nature

Around the main building, a traditional mountain chalet, is a large garden surrounded by beech woods. There you will also find the mini campsite, which has only eight touring pitches. Reservations are therefore recommended. The touring pitches are spacious and shady, with natural boundaries and shelter. You really camp in the heart of nature. If you travel without your own camping equipment, you can rent a small tent or book a room at the campsite. There are six accommodations in the chalet: a studio and five rooms.

For sporty campers

In high season you will see many sporty families on the campsite who love an adventurous, active holiday in the mountains. Many campers come especially to Pyrénées Emotions to practice all kinds of adventurous sports. In addition to families with older children, you will also see many sporty couples, groups of friends and campers that are trekking alone.

To the water

About two kilometres away, near the village of Saint-Pé-d'Ardet, there is a natural mountain lake. It can be reached on foot and in summer you can swim there. If you want to visit larger mountain lakes or waterfalls, you have to go by car. For example, drive to the Lac d'Oô (45 km) or the Lac de Bareille (65 km) for a nice walk.

properties.name: Minicamping De Vijverhof
properties.description:
Minicamping De Vijverhof is a small-scale campsite in the Betuwe countryside. You camp in the middle of beautiful orchards of fruit trees and extensive river landscapes for which the region is so famous. This is an authentic farm campsite that still honours Sunday as a day of rest. At the same time, you benefit from modern amenities on these grounds, including a toilet block renovated in 2018.

Enjoy camping on freshly mown lawn

If you like to camp on a well-kept location with plenty of room, this campsite will certainly make you happy. At Minicamping De Vijverhof every pitch is kept neat and mowed several times a week. You can leave your caravan on the pitch’s tiled terrace and your car at the central parking at the front of the grounds. There are three special pitches available with a paved underground. At Minicamping De Vijverhof it is also possible to book a stay in a holiday home or a modern mobile home with an awning. There are also caravans for hire.

Plenty of fun for the youngest campsite visitors

There are go-karts on the premises for children to drive around the grounds. If they drive past the campsite’s petting zoo, naturally they will stop to visit with the chickens, rabbits, goats and sheep that wander around together with care pony Fientje. Another favourite among the youngest campsite visitors is the outdoor playground with trampoline, swing, climbing frame, sandbox and see-saw. De Herberg has a great recreational area as well, with a table-tennis table, pool table, football table and a corner for playing and reading.

properties.name: Camping Het Koetshuis
properties.description:
Somogy County is located in the Hungarian region of Southern Transdanubia, a sparsely populated area with rolling landscapes. This is the location of Het Koetshuis campsite. A camping holiday here guarantees peace, space, freedom and a friendly atmosphere. In the surroundings there are plenty of walking- and cycling possibilities.

Hungarian countryside

At the entrance of this quiet terraced campsite is the homely main building with the terrace, attractively laid out with a garden and a pond. If you drive further back, the green camping grounds begin with special paved areas for motorhomes.

Camping with a view

Camping Het Koetshuis (Kemping Hintóház in Hungarian) is a Valhalla for those who seek rest and love nature. All large pitches are distributed on grassy terraces. The fact that the pitches are not marked out enhances the feeling of freedom. The view of the sloping surroundings is a real gift. On clear nights, enjoy the beautiful starry sky.

Hungarian snack

In the cosy bar you can not only drink a good beer, but also enjoy a Hungarian meal three times a week. When the weather is nice, the terrace with comfortable seats is a nice place to enjoy. When it gets dark, the atmospheric lighting is switched on. To the left of the exit, at the village shop, you can buy bread in the morning.

Culture and relaxation

Although the campsite is in a very rural and quiet location, there is plenty to do when you get in the car. For example, a visit to the university town of Kaposvar is a nice outing. This charming town, situated on the Kapos river, has many cultural attractions.

properties.name: Camping Harta
properties.description:
Camping Harta, a small campsite in the north of the Czech Republic, is located in the historic region of Upper Lusatia. This is where Germany, Poland and the Czech Republic meet at the border triangle. You will be welcomed by the owner of the campsite. You will be camping in a hilly, vast landscape of fields and woods: a wonderful area for walking and cycling. You can also explore the surroundings on horseback or on a dirt bike. You can also visit the special castle in Frýdlant.

Camping in green surroundings

About thirteen touring pitches fit on the green campsite. You camp on grassy fields, delimited by high hedges. The touring pitches are not all the same size, but they do have a lot of privacy. If you are travelling with a small tent, you can camp on a separate tent pitch. This field is also used for groups. The whole place looks a bit messy, but the lawns and plants are well maintained.

Swimming pool

The pool at Harta campsite is small, but warm and deep. It is situated next to the owner's house, in a sunny spot. In the unlikely event of rain, the pool is transformed into an indoor pool by means of a sliding roof. The pool remains open until late at night.

Beer garden and disco

Jos regularly organises parties or joint barbecues. During these cosy gatherings you can taste Czech specialities from the grill. You can eat them in the restaurant or in the Biergarten, at picnic tables under the trees. The barbecue can turn into an evening of disco, when the tables in the restaurant make way for the dance floor.

properties.name: Camping Le Mouliat
properties.description:
In a peaceful location in the southern French region of Gers, this campsite is situated on the banks of the River Baïse. All facilities, such as the swimming pool and sports ground, are well looked after and the campsite bistro offers a varied menu.

Surrounded by rolling countryside, Camping Le Mouliat is situated in green surroundings. The varied Armagnac region is ideal for outdoor activities such as canoeing, cycling, walking and fishing.
