Families who appreciate tranquillity and a friendly atmosphere and who are looking for some nice facilities for the children, are camping here at the right place. From the spacious pitches you can walk to the swimming pool, the river or to the charming patio.

Camping in the Gers

Camping Le Mouliat is located in the countryside next to the village of Moncrabeau and the river Baïse. For a number of years now it has been run by enthusiastic owners who have made many improvements and who do everything in their power to ensure that campers have a good time. The campsite has space for only fifty pitches, which guarantees a small-scale atmosphere. You arrive at the reception desk where the bar is also located.

Snug and yet private

All spacious and attractive pitches are situated in a U-shape behind the swimming pool. Most of the pitches are delimited by shrubs and hedges, but not completely separated from the neighbours. The sanitary facilities look neat, the lawns are tidy and thanks to the various trees there is enough shade for everyone. Besides the tourist pitches, you can also spend the night in comfortably furnished cabins, mobile homes and canvas tents.

properties.name: AB&C Arco bed and camping
properties.description:
In the Italian Alps, close to Lake Garda, lies the AB&C Arco bed and Camping campsite. This small, quiet agri-campsite is managed by the Amistadi family. From the neat camping area, you have a panoramic view of the surrounding mountains. The campsite is near the town of Arco, which has a beautiful historic centre. You can reach Riva del Garda in 20 minutes by bike and stand on the shore of one of Italy's most famous lakes.

Quiet and small-scale

Arco bed and Camping is a small campsite with approximately twenty touring pitches and six rental accommodations. From the campsite, you have a beautiful view of the surrounding mountains. The pitches are on the small side, but they are laid out nice and flat on the grass. The pitches are clearly defined, but there is little vegetation or shelter between them.

Fine swimming pool

Next to the main building is a pleasant but simple swimming pool. It is well maintained. Around the pool, there are plenty of sun loungers and parasols, so you will always be able to find a nice spot in the shade. Next to the pool is a playground with swings, playhouses and a slide. If you are looking for a bit more aquatic fun, Lake Garda is a logical choice.

Wine and olive oil

There is no shop at the campsite, but the Amistadi family sells their own delicious wine and olive oil. Arco is a nice little town with a beautiful historic centre. You will find several supermarkets, the nearest of which is less than half a kilometre from the campsite. In addition, there are all kinds of restaurants and pizzerias serving tasty food.

properties.name: Agriturismo la Concia
properties.description:
Agriturismo La Concia Campsite is located in the Apennines, not far from the city-state of San Marino. This well-kept, terraced campsite has a stylish outdoor pool, a quiet camping area and an excellent restaurant. La Concia is situated in the hills, offering you a breathtaking view of the surrounding area and the characteristic Italian mountain village of Pennabilli from your pitch. The Republic of San Marino is a half-hour drive by car. And the long, sandy beaches of Rimini are just an hour's drive away.

Follow the E45 via Bologna and stay on the road until the Sarsina exit. From Sarsina, follow the signs for Pennabilli. Signs for Agriturismo La Concia are posted in the village. A narrow road takes you through the rolling countryside to the campsite. You will be welcomed at the reception by the friendly owner, who lives next door.

View over the valley

La Concia is a beautifully landscaped, small-scale terraced campsite with pitches on the grass. There are twenty-five touring pitches, eight motorhome pitches and seven rental units. A simple but stylish outdoor pool is located by the main building. You can enjoy a delicious meal in the quaint campsite restaurant. The regional dishes are largely prepared with ingredients from our own local harvest. Here you can taste the real Italy!

A hike in the hilly surroundings is highly recommended. If you are a sport cyclist, be sure to bring your racing bike because you can also do some fantastic cycling here. Pennabilli is a typical Italian mountain village. Enjoy a bit of Italian village life while sitting on a terrace or on the steps in front of the church.

properties.name: Camping Le Beaupré
properties.description:
Camping Le Beaupré is located in Mesquer, a friendly village on the Loire-Atlantique coast. This peaceful campsite is surrounded by salt marshes and a jagged coastline with wide sandy beaches. This makes it a great destination for peace-seekers and beach lovers. It’s also an excellent base for beautiful walking and cycling trips. Not just along the coast but also through the varied hinterland.

Park-like site with large pitches

This campsite has a park-like site with plenty of shade. The tourist pitches are well-maintained and have an average size of 90 square metres. Most pitches are relatively shady. There are also different types of modern mobile homes on this gently sloping site. They can accommodate four to six people.

Local specialities in high season

In high season, you can collect tasty meals from the snack bar. They are especially good at weekends, when fresh chips with mussels or home-made hamburgers are on the menu. A food truck comes to the campsite once a week too in the summer holidays. It sells delicious local specialities, like savoury pancakes. The campsite also offers a bakery service during the summer months and fun board games can be borrowed from reception.

Gaze at the jagged coastline

The Loire-Atlantique coast is known for its large tidal ranges and wide sandy beaches. The spectacular coastline is popular with walkers and cyclists. The campsite is right next to the long-distance GR 34 walking route and the Vélocéan cycle route between Saint-Nazaire and Saint-Molf. A day at the beach (300 metres from the campsite) is an option as well.

properties.name: Agricampeggio La Buona Terra Borgo
properties.description:
Agricampeggio La Buona Terra Borgo is a small family campsite west of Padua. Italian conviviality, of course with good wine and honest home-grown food, is central here. You camp on the grounds of an organic farm, where you have a view of the Euganean Hills from the pitches.

Italian charm

The central stone houses with the little square, the shady spots under the trees, the view of the orchard and the Eugenic Hills (originally volcanic hills): the campsite has plenty of Italian charm. You will quickly feel at home at this campsite. There are around forty touring pitches along a long path. You can also stay in one of the stone cottages. These have an atmospheric interior, to emphasise that true Italian holiday feeling.

Swimming pool with sunbathing area

The swimming pool at the side of the grounds is one of the luxurious elements of this small farm campsite. Perhaps not very special in terms of design, but a great place to cool down. The swimming pool, with a small paddling pool at the side, lies in the sun, but is enclosed by high trees. This allows you to sunbathe on the surrounding lawn or find a spot in the shade.

Farm animals

Apart from the swimming pool, the farm animals at the campsite (goats, ponies, chickens) are especially fun for the children. During the high season, they can also help with baking bread and do all kinds of other things on the farm. For adults, cycling and walking excursions are organised. All in a relaxed manner. If you prefer to relax at the campsite, then that is also possible of course.

properties.name: Camp Vodenca
properties.description:
Camp Vodenca is situated between high mountains, in the middle of the unspoilt nature of Triglav National Park. At this small campsite, camping is still real camping: crawl into your tent after an evening under the stars, while the campfire is still smouldering. You camp on a lawn on one of the terraces, from where you have a view of the surrounding mountains. Camp Vodenca is an ideal base for mountain hikers and water sports enthusiasts (e.g. kayakers and rafters. Please note that the access road and the campsite itself are not suitable for larger motorhomes and double-axle caravans.

Camping with a view

The green terrain area of Camp Vodenca has some difference in height, so there are several camping fields. In a slightly more open area there is space for campers and caravans, while the higher situated tent field receives more shade from the trees. Everywhere you have a view of the mountains. If you want more comfort you can rent one of the large furnished tents.

Together under the stars

Especially in high season, the tent field is a cosy sight, when it is completely full of tents and the campers enjoy a starry sky. Around the tent field there are several covered patios, where tent campers can sit dry when the weather is not so good. There is room for a campfire in a central place.

Facilities

The facilities on the campsite are quite simple, but all equally tidy. At the reception you can have a drink at the bar or on the patio. The sanitary facilities for the touring campers are standard, but look like new. For the groceries you can go to Bovec. There you'll find the supermarket, but also a shop with outdoor gear.

properties.name: Långsjön Stugor & Camping AB
properties.description:
Långsjön Stugor & Camping is surrounded on all sides by the Långsjön Lake and is situated on road number 40, no more than 2 km from the village of Ankarsrum. You are staying here in Småland, a province that abounds in woods and water. The campsite forms an ideal basis for long walking and cycling trips through the forests of Småland.

Modern service building

The campsite owners take good care of their attractive campsite, where -as the name suggests- you will find a lot of 'stugor' (holiday cottages). Most cottages have their own kitchen, shower and toilet. Guest of the remaining cottages and owners of caravans and motorhomes have to use the sanitary facilities in the modern service building.

Pitches with a view

The pitches are spacious and beautifully laid out between greenery. From most pitches you have a vast view of the lake. Generally speaking: the higher up on the campsite, the more beautiful it gets.

Regional products in the restaurant

The restaurant is down the road near the parking area off road number 40. The ingredients are from surrounding farms and bakeries in the vicinity. In the shop near the reception you can only buy the bare necessities, but there is a large supermarket in Ankarsrum.

Fun on the water

As a result of its location along the Långsjön, a large part of camping life takes place on the water. You can rent boats and canoes and buy a fishing permit. The campsite has a grill area where you can prepare your catch of the day. Along the lake there are several beaches, and you can swim safely in the crystal clear water.

properties.name: Camping Berkel
properties.description:
The quiet Camping Berkel campsite is located on the Sûre River in the Luxembourg Ardennes. It's a small-scale family campsite with a friendly atmosphere. Next door is the hamlet of Bockholtz-Moulin, which consists of only a few houses. Eight kilometres away, you will find the beautiful village of Esch-sur-Sûre. In the surrounding area, you will find wooded hills, gorges, rivers and reservoirs.

Beloved by hikers and cyclists

The campsite is divided into two parts: one with touring pitches and one with permanent pitches. There are sixty camping sites, around twenty of which are permanent sites. The pitches in the field are spacious and not clearly defined. Camping Berkel is mainly visited by tent campers, hikers and cyclists. The touring field features a fire pit, and there are two safari tents for rent. In the farmhouse, you will find a bed and breakfast and an apartment.

Feeding the cows together

You won't find a pool at this simple campsite, but the adjacent river is a great place to play and splash around. In the evening, people often socialise around the fire pit. In addition to the farm, there is a mill on the property and a barn with cows and calves. You will also come across cats and dogs.

Bingo night and ball game

Various activities are organised in the recreation area of the farm, such as a playback show or a bingo evening. There are games for the children, and there's also a bar and a small library. For fresh bread, head over to the reception in the morning. The campsite also has a snack bar, which is open every day. Outside, next to the terrace, you will find a table tennis table.

properties.name: Camping La Pedrera
properties.description:
Enjoy peace and charm in the Spanish inland of Alicante at the green, welcoming Camping La Pedrera campsite. It is located on the outskirts of the village of Bigastro. The nice swimming pool, fine restaurant and the well-kept premises make this a comfortable place to be. Bring your hiking boots or bike and take a scenic ride through a landscape of orange and almond trees.

An idyllic campsite

You will arrive on a hilly and green terrain with approximately fifty camping pitches, a number of campervan pitches and some permanent year-round pitches, holiday homes and mobile homes. The pitches are at different heights, among the trees and bushes. The planting creates an idyllic atmosphere. The pitches themselves are flat and are reasonably shaded or in the sun. La Pedrera is open all year, so you can also spend the winter here.

Take a dip

At the front of the campsite is the fun pool with hot tub. This is a cosy place surrounded by trees. Around the pool are plenty of sunbeds and parasols for relaxing or enjoying a siesta. The pool is sometimes used by people from the village, who come here for a fee to take a dip. There is also a playground, table tennis table, bowling alley, football/basketball field and recreation room. During the school holidays, the children can play together here.

Popular with the locals

For a tasty plate of paella or the "Menú del día", you can visit the restaurant. The prices here are very reasonable. The bar and restaurant are also popular among the locals, which is always a good sign. In addition, fresh bread rolls and take-out meals are available.

properties.name: Camping Gyvelborg
properties.description:
Campsite Gyvelborg is situated amidst the hills of Central Jutland, not far from Nørre Snede. It lies within the triangle formed by the towns of Horsens, Silkeborg and Billund. From Gyvelborg, it is just as far to the west coast (with its beautiful sandy beaches) as it is to the east coast (with the fascinating city of Aarhus). The campsite is surrounded by nature.

Spacious campsite

The campsite gives a spacious, clean and welcoming impression. The pitches vary in size, but are always spacious enough. The farm shop sells organic produce, sourced locally from Denmark or Europe wherever possible. You can also buy bread and a few other everyday groceries there.

Book one of the accommodations

There are three wooden chalets on the site, each offering stunning views. These chalets sleep six people and comprise a living room with an open-plan kitchen, a bathroom with shower and toilet, and two bedrooms. The chalets are spaced well apart, ensuring plenty of privacy. For a unique nature experience, you can also stay in one of the shelters or in the fully equipped tent with its own kitchen. There is also a comfortable apartment available.

Activities on and around the campsite

At the campsite, children can have their own adventures: feeding alpacas, picking fresh grass for the rabbits and feeding it to them, playing in the woods and at natural play areas, or helping out in the organic vegetable garden. Meanwhile, parents can enjoy the peaceful atmosphere and natural tranquillity. You can also go for walks around the campsite in the beautiful countryside of Central Jutland.

properties.name: Camping La Montagne
properties.description:
On this small and well-maintained family campsite in the southern French department of Vaucluse, you will enjoy the feeling of being completely surrounded by nature. You will camp just north of the medieval city of Avignon, within cycling distance of the town of Sorgues. La Montagne Campsite is situated among the pine trees on a lovely site featuring both a swimming pool and a terrace. There are many nice villages to visit in this part of Provence, and nature lovers can explore the beautiful surroundings on foot or by bike.

Well-kept and intimate

Spread over the beautiful grounds are around 21 camping pitches with adequate shade. Many pitches are unpaved and offer plenty of room, with a surface area of between 80 and 100 m2. The sanitary facilities look neat and clean. The building is heated during the winter months. Would you enjoy some additional comfort? Then choose a hip gypsy wagon or one of the mobile homes. The abundant trees are a favourite spot for crickets, who's regular chirping helps enhance the feeling of nature.

Heated swimming pool

The small swimming pool on the campsite is ideal for both young and old. The outdoor pool is beautifully decorated with palm trees and boulders. There are also sunbeds with umbrellas around the pool. There is a paddling pool for the youngest swimmers and older children can enjoy themselves on the waterslide. You can regularly participate in an aquagym lesson or take a moment of rest in the jacuzzi. Looking to relax even more? Inquire at the reception about the massages that are available.

properties.name: Camping L'Escale Occitane
properties.description:
Camping L’Escale Occitane is situated between Carcassonne and Castelnaudary, nestled amongst the vineyards of the Aude. It is a small-scale campsite with a personal atmosphere, run by Rémy and Nadia. Here you can enjoy the good life in France: a glass of wine with a view of the countryside, a refreshing dip in the pool and a plate of homemade cassoulet in the outdoor terrace. Stop for a quick break, or stay a little longer and enjoy the tranquillity and space of the French countryside.

Spacious pitches and overnight stops

With just 16 pitches spread over three hectares, there’s always room to breathe. You’ll be on a green pitch of at least 100 m², screened by hedges and equipped with electricity (15 amps). Those who prefer to travel light can make use of the chairs and tables available on site. There is also a separate area for motorcyclists and cyclists. Well-known routes passing by the campsite include “Le Canal des 2 Mers” (cycling) and the Trans Euro Trail (motorbike).

Eat, swim and relax

At the campsite, it’s all about the little things that feel like a big deal. There’s a swimming pool, a playground, a boules court and a bar with a shady outdoor area. In the Le Galley restaurant, Rémy serves his famous cassoulet, pizzas and burgers. For relaxation, book a massage or settle down with a book in the relaxation tent.

Your dog as the guest of honour

For dogs, there’s a dedicated play area, a small dog bath, a dog shower and plenty of space to sniff around. Add to that the welcome gift and special dog ice creams, and it’s clear: your pet isn’t just an afterthought here, but a guest.

properties.name: Odmoree Camp & Hostel
properties.description:
Odmoree Camp & Hostel is located in Croatia, on a peninsula on the Dalmatian coast. This small, comfortable campsite has pitches with views of the sea and the surrounding islands. The mini campsite has modern facilities: a heated outdoor swimming pool, a lounge bar and new sanitary facilities.

Welcome! Welcome!

If you follow the E71 from the Croatian border, you can take exit 16 in the direction of Posedarje and Otok Pag. Turn left onto the D106. After about seventeen kilometres, past Rtina, the campsite is signposted on the left. The steep, narrow road down is difficult for large motorhomes and caravans.

Green mini campsite

If you want to spend your holiday at Odmoree Camp & Hostel, it's best to book in time, even in low season. The campsite has only thirteen touring pitches, laid out on terraces. They are lined up next to each other and are well delimited with low walls and vegetation, which provides shade. The pitches are a bit cramped, which makes this campsite less suitable for campers with a large caravan or motorhome.

Swimming pool and azure sea

The heated outdoor pool is small and simple. However, it is more than sufficient for the number of camping guests. There is a lounge bar next to the swimming pool. From your campsite it is only a few tens of meters walk to the beach and the sea. Here you can sail and water-ski, and you can bring your own motorboat or sailboat. There is a trailer slipway and a small harbour where you can moor your boat

properties.name: Kamp Tura
properties.description:
Camp Tura is situated in the lush Vipava Valley and serves as a peaceful base for nature lovers and active holidaymakers. This is not surprising, as the campsite is located on the Gradiška Tura, where you can enjoy hiking and climbing. Here, you will be camping in the middle of the natural beauty of a Natura 2000 site and in the heart of the Slovenian wine region, all while still being close to amenities and villages.

Camping with a view of the valley

The campsite offers a varied selection of pitches. While the pitches may not be overly spacious, they do offer sufficient comfort and are neatly divided by with hedges. There are pitches tucked away in the woods, and some are easily accessible for caravans and motorhomes. You will find a well-maintained site here, adjacent to sports fields with stunning views of the surrounding countryside.

The place to be for active spirits

On and around the campsite, you will find a variety of sports facilities such as tennis courts, a climbing wall and football and volleyball pitches. There is a children’s playground and a snack bar for a simple meal. Bicycle and e-bike hire is also available. The campsite is ideal for sports enthusiasts, walkers and those seeking peace and quiet. Dogs are welcome and the campsite is open all year round. Although there is no swimming pool on site, if you would like to cool off, there is a small pool just a 15-minute drive away. The Italian and Slovenian coasts can be reached within an hour.

Head for the mountains

The centre of Vipava is 2 km away, with shops and restaurants. Climbing enthusiasts can easily hike to the Gradiška Tura rock face, and several walking and cycling routes start right from the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Le Garel
properties.description:
Camping Le Garel is a small-scale nature campsite near the town of Poussan in the southern French Hérault. This is a very green campsite with many different types of trees. Here people still work with love for nature. There is a relaxed atmosphere at the campsite, so you choose your own pitch. There is a beautiful swimming pool with sliding roof.

Choose your favourite pitch

The pitches at Camping Le Garel are very green and well maintained. New campers can choose their own pitch. Will you choose a free spot on a grassy field surrounded by trees, or do you prefer a neatly delimited spot? Feel free to tell Danielle. Besides touring pitches, there are mobile homes and two Coco Sweets available. A Coco Sweet is a combination of a tent and a mobile home.

Swim in the indoor swimming pool

Centrally located on the campsite grounds, there is a swimming pool with an accompanying paddling pool. This is a pool which, depending on the weather, can be covered by a sliding roof. This is a multi-purpose pool: both sporty lane trekkers and people who just want to take a refreshing dive can go here. Furthermore, the nearest beaches are about ten kilometres away. Swimming in the sea is therefore also possible from this campsite.

Breakfast service and shopping

A small selection of groceries is available in the reception building. Think about fresh bread for your breakfast, but also some regional products and (soft) drinks. You don't have to drive far to do your shopping. In the nearby villages of Poussan and Gigean (at 1,5 km from the campsite) there are several good supermarkets.

properties.name: Agricamping La Villa
properties.description:
This small-scale agricampsite is located in the mountains near Garlenda. La Villa is located in the peaceful Ligurian countryside, in an agricultural setting and surrounded by woods. The sea and the Italian Riviera are just ten kilometres away. You can take a dip in the outdoor swimming pool for some relief from the warm temperatures.

Camping in an idyllic location

This small, well-maintained campsite La Villa boasts a beautiful view of the mountains. The owners' focus is primarily on campers with tents. You will be camping in the shade of the centuries-old olive trees surrounding the home of the campsite owners. There is only room for a few small campervans.

Participate in workshops or go for a swim

One great thing about this campsite is its range of workshops. You can learn how to make pesto. Calling all aquaphiles: there is an outdoor swimming pool (100 m2) on the La Villa campsite.

Get a taste of local delicacies

Here you can enjoy countless products made by regional businesses. Indulge yourself on local items like olives, olive oil, honey, vegetables, strawberries, jam, fruit and sauces. These can all be purchased on the campsite. Tastings with snacks and wine are held regularly. 

Perfect for athletic types who love the outdoors

This campsite is popular among athletic types who enjoy the outdoors. You should also ask about the various cycling routes that you can take. Mountain bikes are available for hire in the reception area. The island of Gallinara makes for a fantastic diving trip, while Finale Ligura is an excellent destination for those looking to go paragliding.

properties.name: De Betuwe Hoeve
properties.description:
Camping De Betuwe Hoeve is located in the middle of the Betuwe, not far from Tiel en Rhenen. This small-scale, quiet campsite has spacious pitches on a green, sheltered campsite. The young owners provide a warm welcome and friendly cocktail hours. During your stay you can leave your car as all amenities are within cycling distance. In the surroundings you can make beautiful walking and cycling trips.

Spacious pitches

Twenty-eight spacious touring pitches have been laid out on the elongated, green terrain. Some of them are sheltered at the edge of the forest; these are the pitches where you have the most privacy. The other pitches are a bit more open, but they are also delimited on one or two sides by hedges. So you can choose a spot with more or less shade, and with more or less privacy. All pitches are nicely laid out on the well-maintained lawn.

Everything within cycling distance

The Betuwe Hoeve does not have a swimming pool, nor a camping shop, restaurant or bar. However, you will find all possible amenities in the immediate vicinity. Right next to the campsite there's a tea garden on one side and an apple pub and country shop on the other, where you can buy fresh, local produce. In Lienden, two kilometres away, you'll find a supermarket, various shops and several bars and restaurants.

Cosy and convivial

The atmosphere at the campsite is friendly and relaxed. Few activities are organised: there is no entertainment or excursion programme. However, every week there is a pleasant cocktail hour on the campsite. While enjoying a snack and a drink, you can get to know your fellow campers.

properties.name: Camping De Kan Hoeve
properties.description:
Do you like to camp at a small-scale campsite surrounded by nothing other than nature and meadows? At Camping De Kan Hoeve you stay in the Frisian countryside, close to Drachten and the Alde Feanen National Park. In addition to the mini campsite, De Kan Hoeve also has attractive holiday cottages and a B&B with group accommodation. No entertainment is organised here, but you enjoy the peace and quiet as well as the countryside.

Quiet holiday in the countryside

The mini campsite has spacious pitches that are suitable for motorhomes, caravans, tents and cars with roof tents. The pitches have 10-ampere power and water tap stations. The toilet block is heated. The comfortable tiny houses are suitable for two people and have all of the modern conveniences. The house includes your own terrace. Finally, there is also a B&B in an attractive, former stables. After a wonderful night’s rest, enjoy a fresh breakfast in the kitchen-diner. Groups of up to 11 people can stay here.

Sustainable accommodations

The owners of Camping De Kan Hoeve place great value on sustainability. The power in the tiny houses and the B&B is generated with solar panels and the hot water with a solar boiler.

Explore the Frisian area

The vicinity is great for hikes and cycling tours in the countryside. The location is close to the Alde Feanen National Park, a lowland moor area of almost 2,500 hectares with lakes, reed land and swamp forest. If you want a little more action, get on your bicycle. You’ll arrive in Drachten in no time (9 km)! It has plenty of shops and restaurants.

properties.name: Flower Camping Soleil des Bastides
properties.description:
Camping Soleil des Bastides is located in a wooded area just outside of the town of Cahuzac-sur-Vère in the department of Tarn (France). This campsite is near beautiful historic towns, of which Albi, Gaillac and Cordes-sur-Ciel are the most well-known. Vast vineyards surround the campsite. The amenities of this small-scale campsite include an outdoor swimming pool, a charming restaurant and various sports and games facilities.

Wide choice of accommodation

The most varied types of accommodation can be found at the campsite. You can book a stay in a modern mobile home, an original log cabin and various types of safari tents and chalets. Naturally, there is plenty of room for campsite visitors. There are three types of pitches available. For maximum comfort, at Soleil des Bastides, choose a premium pitch. You will have your own veranda, garden furniture, fridge and private bathroom.

Good for nature and the environment

Have you tried to find a paper brochure for this campsite to no avail? That could be right! To save on paper, this campsite no longer prints any brochures. And that is just one of the many measures this campsite has taken for the environment: they work with LED lights, make use of solar energy and a heat pump and have two charging stations for electric cars. In addition, they also promote biodiversity. For example, the campsite is a refuge for hedgehogs.

What kind of entertainment is there at the campsite?

To cool off, visit the swimming pool at the campsite. Next to the pool is a charming outdoor restaurant. Delicious dishes are served at reasonable prices. Plus, in the high season, special cocktail evenings and musical performances take place.

properties.name: Parco Camper La Torre
properties.description:
In the heel of the boot of Italy, near the beautiful coastal town of Torre dell'Orso, lies Parco Camper La Torre. This quiet and small-scale campsite has beautiful marked out pitches on a park-like terrain. There is only a limited number of touring pitches, but they are wonderfully shaded and bordered by greenery.

Shady campsite

Although Parco Camper La Torre covers seven hectares, there are only 36 touring pitches. They are nicely delimited by hedges, and they vary in size. The campsite is beautifully green, with many trees that provide refreshing shade. The pitches are paved, so you don't camp on grass here. This makes the campsite less suitable for tents. At Parco Camper La Torre there are also beautiful studios and flats for rent. In total there are 25 rental accommodations.

Azuur-blue water

Parco Camper La Torre does not have a swimming pool. However, about one and a half kilometres away are the rugged rocky coast and the beautiful sandy beaches of the Adriatic. The sea here is beautifully clear and azure blue. Spiaggia di Torre dell'Orso is a wide, white sandy beach that is largely open to the public. You will also find nice beach pavilions where you can rent sun beds and parasols. In the high season, it can be crowded. It is about a twenty minute walk to the beach. If you find that too far, you can rent a bike at the campsite, or use the owner's shuttle service. Giuseppe will bring you to the beach and pick you up again.

Shaded terrace

There is no shop, restaurant or bar on the campsite, but with the centre of Torre dell'Orso at walking distance, this is not a problem. Parco Camper La Torre does have a nice shaded terrace with vending machines for coffee and soft drinks. In high season, fresh bread is available at the campsite. The nearest shop is 400 metres from the campsite, and in the centre of Torre dell'Orso you will find several supermarkets where you can do all your shopping. There are also plenty of restaurants and bars, the best with a view of the bay.

properties.name: Minicamping de Reekens
properties.description:
Minicamping de Reekens is located on the outskirts of the historic fortified town of Heusden in Brabant. You can see the ramparts from your pitch. But the campsite is very quiet and peaceful!

Pitches with historic views

There are about 20 large camping pitches at this mini campsite. You can see Heusden's historic city walls and also the playground in the middle of the camping field. So, the little ones can play safely, while you relax. You could also book a gypsy wagon or caravan. Because the campsite is car-free, it’s always nice and quiet.

With all the mod cons

You come here to relax, so remember to bring a good book! Children can burn off their energy on the playing field and in the recreation room. Or see the rabbits, pony, goats and pigs in the animal meadow. There’s no hassle with tokens or passes for the showers either: it’s easy to use the toilet and washing facilities here. A paid washing machine and dryer are available as well.

Have you bought a little too much shopping or just don’t have much space? Then use the campsite's fridge (and freezer compartment). And grab some fresh eggs from the chickens in the meadow; they're replenished every day!

Lose yourself in the countryside

You don’t have to go far for hustle and bustle. Heusden is within walking distance. Bigger cities nearby are Tilburg (29.5 km) and Den Bosch (17 km). Nature lovers will enjoy De Loonse en Drunense Duinen and National Park de Biesbosch.

properties.name: Camping Pré Fixe
properties.description:
Camping Pré Fixe is a small-scale campsite in the south of France, close to the Pyrenees. Its well-maintained pitches are located on well-kept terraces surrounded by greenery. Everything here is equally well appointed: from the heated outdoor pool and the wine bar to the beautiful terrace and the sanitary facilities. Take a seat at a table on the terrace and sample French wines and a meal made from fresh, local products.

Well-kept, naturally terraced campsite

At the end of the driveway appears the campsite, which is set against the slope of a hill and runs downward. Especially striking is the natural tranquillity that predominates over the grounds. Campers looking for a sense of peace and relaxation will therefore appreciate this campsite. Thirty-two spacious, well-kept touring pitches are located on different terraces, between thick hedges and in the shade of trees.

Glamping

A lower part of the campsite features some glamping tents: luxury lodge tents and cosy wigwams. You can also stay in the spacious eco-chalets for a luxury camping holiday. The most beautiful spots, both camping pitches and rental accommodations, offer views of the high mountains of the Pyrenees.

Heated and well-maintained pool

To the left of the entrance is the heated pool. This has the natural shape of a puddle; that is, it is not rectangular, but rather slightly rounder. The shrubs, the grass all around, the ornamented walls: everything by the pool looks equally well cared for and all contributes to the feeling of pure relaxation. The entire pool area is surrounded by a fence to provide security. This ensures that the youngest campers can't just venture into the water.

properties.name: Flower Camping La Pibola
properties.description:
This small-scale family campsite is located in the beautiful Ariège region in the Midi-Pyrénées. Here you are within walking distance of the charming village of Camon and close to the historic town of Mirepoix. At Flower Camping La Pibola you'll enjoy a holiday amongst castles, medieval villages and unspoilt landscapes with lakes and rivers. In short, all the beauty that France has to offer!

Spacious pitches and comfortable accommodations

The wooded camping area offers 28 shaded pitches ranging from 80 - 150m2. The many (fruit) trees and shrubs offer a great deal of privacy for almost all pitches. There's also a sort of treehouse, perfect for the adventurous campers. For those looking for more comfort, a number of comfortable mobile homes, chalets and bungalows are available. The campsite is also suitable for disabled people.

Facilities for all ages

At Flower Camping La Pibola you'll find everything you need for a great holiday. There's a heated outdoor swimming pool with a paddling pool for the little ones. Next to the swimming pool is a cosy terrace under the trees where you can relax and enjoy the beautiful weather. For the children there is also a playground, a trampoline and a field for playing volleyball or badminton.

Dive into Lake Montbel

Lake Montbel is located about 10 kilometres east of the campsite. It's a wonderful place for a day of swimming, boating, canoeing, fishing or picnicking.

properties.name: Camping Ushuaïa Villages de Pont Calleck
Mountain Camping & Glamping
properties.description:
In the north of Slovenia, near the border with Austria, lies Cvet Gora - Camping & Glamping. At this mini camping site, you will be camping in the middle of nature at an altitude of almost nine hundred metres. You will have a magnificent view of the Kamnian Alps and the Jezersko valley from the camping area. Choose one of the many mountain trails for a hike or go swimming in the nearby mountain lake.

In the green valley

Cvet Gora - Camping & Glamping is located in a beautiful green valley. The camping area is flat and offers panoramic views of the surrounding mountains. Sixteen touring pitches are available. The pitches are on a nice grassy field with low vegetation. The camping sites are not spacious, but they are large enough to camp on comfortably. There is also a hostel and five hiker's huts.

Nature lovers

Most campers are nature lovers, who come to the campsite to hike or bike. Many come with their caravan or motorhome, but you'll also see many campers here who are on a cycling holiday. They bring a tent or use the hiking cabins or the hostel.

An atmospheric terrace with a view

At Cvet Gora - Camping & Glamping, there is no camping shop, but you can get fresh bread. In Zgornje Jezersko, there is a supermarket where you can do your shopping. Through the valley, you can walk there in fifteen minutes. The campsite does have a bar, where you can have breakfast in the morning. On the cosy terrace, you can sit and enjoy an amazing view of the mountains. Inside is a wonderful open fireplace. Tanja also sells homemade liqueur, herbal tea, syrup and jam there.

properties.name: Camping Ushuaïa Villages Le Viaduc
properties.description:
Camping Le Viaduc is located in a quiet spot on the banks of the river Doux, in the north of the Ardèche. On this small campsite in the heart of nature, you'll camp on a shady pitch on the banks of the Doux or in a special rental accommodation such as a tree house or yurt. Here you'll experience the tranquillity of the hilly Ardèche and the conviviality of a small-scale campsite.

Informal and warm

25 kilometres after entering the Ardèche, deep in the rugged nature, you reach the charming campsite. It is enclosed by the meandering river Doux. In a small stone building you'll find the reception. The warm welcome of the owners sets the tone for the informal atmosphere on the campsite.

Special accommodations

For a special camping night, you can choose from a selection of special rental accommodations. For example, camp in a Coco-sweet tent, wigwam, yurt, tree house or wine barrel. All these accommodations, situated between the trees, are neat and tidy and give you that cosy camping feeling. However, this feeling can also be found on the beautiful lawns. There you will find spacious touring pitches on a very well-tended grass surface.

Charming restaurant

The natural stone building at the front of the site is characteristic of the charming character of the campsite. On the covered terrace you can enjoy breakfast, lunch or dinner. For a fair price you can taste homemade dishes in this charming little restaurant, with a nice ice cream for dessert. There is a children's menu for small campers.

properties.name: Camping Lo Schioppo
properties.description:
The quiet terraced campsite Lo Schioppo extends at an altitude of almost seven hundred metres into a forest near a river. You camp here in the Abruzzo region. The village of La Grancia is at a distance of three km from the campsite. In Morion (a ten minute drive away) you will find some more amenities such as restaurants, shops and a railway station.

Welcome!

You will reach the attractively located campsite along a hilly road and a beautiful valley. You are welcomed by the hospitable Tagliola family. Their terraced campsite has well maintained, spacious pitches (50). There are also two rental apartments.

Enjoy the peace and the view

Campers who love peace and nature like visiting here because of the panoramic view of the mountains. In summer you will predominantly find families with young children here, while in the off-season the campsite is frequented by senior citizens and hikers.

The footpath adjacent to the campsite takes you to the river in less than five minutes. There are several signposted walking trails across the nearby nature reserve. These differ in degree of difficulty. In high season there are guided walking tours enabling you to visit the small villages in the area with the owner.

Breakfast on the terrace

Near the friendly reception you can enjoy a cup of coffee, tea or a cool drink, as well as order breakfast. There are only a few products available, including fresh bread. The owners will happily give you advice about sights and activities in the area. The village of Grancia, where you will find an eating establishment and a small supermarket, is located at a distance of some three km.

properties.name: Camping Las Casitas de las Arribes
Agricamping Oasi del Belvivere
properties.description:
In the Italian province of La Spezia, in the Montemarcello Natural Park, you’ll find Agricamping Oasi del Belvivere. This small agritourismo has only eight pitches for tent campers. The hilly campsite consists of several terraces. It is park-like and completely car-free.

Charming camping

In the characteristic pink house you will be warmly welcomed by Alessandra herself. The campsite is charming; it looks more like a garden than a campsite. The many oleanders and rose bushes give it a lovely atmosphere. Beautiful tent pitches have been laid out on the terraces against the hill. They can be reached via narrow, somewhat steep paths. The whole campsite is car-free and only suitable for tent campers.

Day at the beach

Oasi del Belvivere does not have a real swimming pool, but it does have a small children's pool. However, you can get to the beaches of San Terenzo, on the Gulf of La Spezia, in fifteen minutes by car. Baia Blu and Spiaggia di San Terenzo are beaches with many amenities. Baia Blu is smaller, with many pebbles in the sand.

Eating and picking fruit together

On the campsite you will find only the most necessary facilities. You can use the communal kitchen with fridge and freezer. And outside there is a large barbecue with some wooden picnic tables. In the communal area of the campsite there is a wood-burning stove. From the fruit trees on the campsite you can pick and eat as much as you can.

properties.name: Agriturismo Il Giardino degli Ulivi
properties.description:
Peace, simplicity, space and a fantastic local cuisine. These are the ingredients that you find on Agriturismo Il Giardino degli Ulivi ('Garden of the Olive Trees'). The campsite is situated in a very quiet location in the historical town of Lasize, some 30 km west of Verona. The terrain is one enormous lawn. The swimming pool is surrounded by flowering plants. A bit further along you will find lawns for touring pitches, with olive and fruit trees. The high residential building with six rental apartments and the kitchen is located near the entrance.

Camping or renting?

There are spacious touring pitches, located between olive trees and fruit trees. The grass has not been mowed everywhere, so keep in mind there may be some higher, 'wild' grass. The mobile homes are basic, but well equipped. The are grouped together in a separate section. Finally, the large residence includes six rental apartments. They are clean, neat and simply furnished.

Gone swimming!

The swimming pool (70 m2) forms an attractive entity. There are a few palm trees, a tiled sun terrace and a fence around it. Beyond this, you will find an enormous sunbathing lawn with beautifully kept grass. Sun umbrellas and loungers await you there. Out with the suntan lotion and soak up the Italian sun which hardly ever lets you down.

Excellent restaurant

The restaurant with covered terrace is at a somewhat higher elevation than the sunbathing lawn and the swimming pool. As a result you have splendid view over the surroundings, with Lake Garda further along. The chef/owner prepares excellent meals with local products and produce which he cultivates and sells himself.

properties.name: Camping Milo Moje
properties.description:
At the foot of the Biokovo Mountains and overlooking the crystal clear waters of the Adriatic Sea, Camp Milo Moje is a wonderful place to spend a holiday. Here you'll find peace, plenty of space and freedom. You can be on the beach with your children in no time, and the nearest town of Drvenik is just 5 kilometres from the campsite. The town has beautiful bays and is an ideal place for shopping and grabbing a drink on a terrace. You'll find even more terraces and restaurants in the pleasant coastal town of Makarska (22 km).

You'll be pitching your tent, caravan or motorhome on spacious terraced pitches. Camping Milo Moje offers luxurious and modern rental accommodation.

Pebble beach

You can spread out your towel on the nearby pebble beach. And what could be better than being able to walk straight into the sea from your caravan or bungalow? Your children can play in the shallow water.

You'll find peace, tranquillity and nature at this campsite. There's no entertainment programme or swimming pool, but you can splash around in the sea.

The campsite is located on the Makarska Riviera. Here you can walk along miles of beaches.

Chill at the beach bar

The campsite features a beach bar and a restaurant. Breakfast sandwiches are also available.

Take the boat to Hvar and Brač

You can take the ferry from Makarska to the island of Brač. South of Brač lies the island of Hvar with its hip Hvar Town. For a city trip you can drive to the world heritage city of Split.

properties.name: Quinta do Retiro
properties.description:
In the Portuguese countryside, seven kilometres west of the city of Oliveira do Hospital, lies Quinta do Retiro. From this campsite you have a view of the hilly area. To enjoy the silence, this rural spot with swimming pool and sauna is ideal.

Located in a forest

The beautiful country estate ('quinta' means 'estate' or 'wine estate') is situated at an altitude of 325 meters on the outskirts of the village of Covas. An extremely well-kept terrain where many fruit trees grow. The green pitches are divided over a low terrain and a higher part that looks a bit rougher and offers more sun. For larger caravans a spot at the top is worth considering because of its accessibility.

The nice thing is that the picturesque pitches are not demarcated and that everyone still enjoys peace and privacy. The many trees and shrubs provide a relaxed atmosphere. There is also a small stream running across the campsite.

Ecological swimming pool

At the lowest point of the campsite, an ecological swimming pool has been set up between the greenery. Beautiful flowers, shrubs and stones surround the pool, which is continuously purified. The clean water comes directly from its own source. Pure nature! Those looking for even more relaxation after a few laps can use the sauna.

Bread from the baker

For a supermarket or a nice restaurant are the most possibilities in Oliveira do Hospital. But for fresh bread you don't have to leave the campsite in the morning. Every day the local baker delivers bread on the 'quinta'. On the local market you can do your shopping tasty, cheap and fresh.

properties.name: Camping Ter Leede
properties.description:
In the polder landscape of Utrecht, close to the river Linge, is Ter Leede campsite. On this small-scale campsite, you will camp in an orchard in the peaceful surroundings of Leerdam, known as the glass city of the Netherlands. Experience the peace and quiet on the car-free campsite and the spacious touring pitches, from which the view of the polders is beautiful.

To your pitch with a tractor

You leave your car on the car park when you install your caravan or camper. To ensure the peace and quiet, the campsite is car-free. John-Paul brings you and your camping equipment with the tractor to your place. The campsite consists of two beautifully tended lawns. The spacious touring pitches are laid out in a vapour pattern, with a hedge next to each pitch. This creates a spacious feeling for each camper.

Camping with a view and comfort

On the side of the grounds, by the pond, is a separate tent site. The most beautiful camping pitches are to be found right at the back. From these places, situated by the stream that marks the end of the camping field, you have an unobstructed view of the vast fields. You can also enjoy the comfort of the holiday home on the campsite. With underfloor heating, a large terrace, a fitted kitchen and private sanitary facilities, you can enjoy a luxury camping holiday here.

Walking and cycling

Camping Ter Leede is centrally located in Vijfheerenland, which borders the Betuwe. The flat landscape is ideal for cycling and walking, along rivers like the Linge and the Lek. The meadows are criss-crossed by well-maintained cycle and footpaths, so you need never fear getting your feet dirty.

properties.name: Camping Julianadorp Aan Zee
properties.description:
In the Kop van Noord-Holland, in the middle of the vast bulb fields, lies the small Camping Julianadorp Aan Zee campsite. You will be camping here close to the seaside town of the same name. This small-scale farm campsite was opened in 2017, and you can tell by its modern facilities. You will be camping here on spacious, open touring pitches equipped with all the necessary amenities. It is easy to walk or cycle to the cosy village or the beach.

Spacious comfort pitches

The campsite consists of grassland without paved paths. Here you will have a truly unobstructed view of the surroundings and the space around you. And that also means you will need to create a little more shelter and privacy around your camping spot yourself, if that is what you wish. The sites are all spacious comfort sites with their own power connection, water drainage and water supply. The sanitary facilities are modern and heated.

Canoeing from the campsite

In the spring, it is wonderfully quiet at the Camping Julianadorp Aan Zee campsite. Cycling and walking among the blooming bulb fields, through the dunes and over the beach: what more could you want? In the summer, families also come to this campsite, but it is not the kind of campsite that offers entertainment, discos and crowds. For the children, there is a playground, and you can rent canoes for a nice day of paddling in the water.

Fresh sandwiches in the summer

From the beginning of June to the end of August, you can get fresh bread rolls at the campsite. For the rest of your shopping or for an evening out, you can cycle to Julianadorp in no time. A shopping centre is located about ten minutes by bike from the campsite.

properties.name: Camping en Camperpark Het Gelders Eiland
Agricampeggio Abbruzzetti
properties.description:
Agricampeggio Abbruzzetti is located between green hills, extensive vineyards and olive trees. From this farm campsite, you have a beautiful view over the hills to the sea. Here, you can unwind and enjoy a relaxing holiday at the coast of Le Marche.

Terraced campsite with panoramic views

The whole family is involved in running the farm campsite. They ensure that you have a carefree holiday on their vast estate. Here you will camp on a terraced hillside with 25 spacious pitches. From your spot you can dream away at the panoramic view over the Italian hills to the sea.

Picking fruit

Over the years, the farm grounds (and the mill) have developed into a campsite where camping at the farm takes on a special meaning. It is possible to pick your own fruit and make jam together with the owners. You can also buy local products such as vegetables and homemade olive oil on the farm.

Entertainment and facilities

For relaxation, you can take a dive in the beautiful swimming pool. If you prefer swimming in the sea, you don't have to walk far. The sandy beaches of Porto San Giorgio are less than five minutes away. The campsite also offers good basic facilities such as modern sanitary blocks and Wi-Fi. The sanitary building is new and the water is heated by solar panels.

Pizzas and more delicious food

If you like Italian food, the campsite's organic restaurant is the right place for you. Here you can enjoy delicious pizzas and local specialities such as pasta with seafood, lemon and olive oil.

properties.name: Mons Gibel Camping Park
properties.description:
Mons Gibel Camping Park Belpasso is a small-scale campsite with a unique location on the slopes of the Mount Etna volcano. Campers enjoy the beautiful views of the volcano, the serene tranquillity, a lovely swimming pool and well-maintained sanitary facilities.

The campsite is known for its hospitable atmosphere and its ideal location for visiting the most beautiful places in Sicily. The young owners offer a shuttle service to Mount Etna. There are also many beautiful hiking routes to choose from.

Swimming and sunbathing

There is a nice outdoor swimming pool which is open in the summer months. The wooden terrace features comfortable sun loungers and parasols. A wonderful place to read a book or feel the warmth of the sun on your skin.

The fun playground, with its wide range of equipment, is also popular among the youngest campers.

Sicilian barbecue

Pizza is a must-have when on holiday in Italy! You'll find a flyer from the local pizzeria that will deliver to your camping spot at the reception. For the connoisseur there is a traditional Sicilian stone barbecue. And if you would like fresh rolls or croissants for breakfast, you can place the order a day in advance.

To Mount Etna

Impressive nature and history complement each other perfectly in Sicily. An organised hike to the most active volcano in the world, Mount Etna, makes for an unforgettable experience and should certainly top your list. The volcano is on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

There is a shuttle service from the campsite to Nicolosi, one of the main starting points for excursions on the southern flank of Mount Etna.

properties.name: Camping Laouba
properties.description:
Close to the vast beaches of the Atlantic Ocean, Camping Laouba is situated on the edge of the village of Vendays (Gironde). This charming campsite has a charming outdoor bar and you can use the pizza oven. With a huge network of beautiful cycle paths and footpaths, the area is very popular with sporty campers. But also water sports enthusiasts know how to find this region because of the high waves and the Lac d'Hourtin-Carcans.

Attractive pitches

On the campsite you will find spacious pitches with a fine shelter and natural shade. Those who prefer a place in the sun can choose a suitable spot on the well-kept lawn. Don't have your own tent, caravan or motorhome? Then you can still experience the ultimate camping life. A number of pitches with a tent or caravan are available for hire.

Swimming in the sea

For swimming enthusiasts, the most beautiful beaches of Gironde are within reach. Just south of the seaside resort Montalivet lies Plage du Pin Sec and north of it Plage Vensac. Both beaches are popular with surfers, kiters and SUP'ers, as the waves here are often metres high. Lac d'Hourtin-Carcans is about half an hour's drive away and is the largest freshwater lake in France. Also a lovely place to swim, canoe, pedal boat, surf or fish.

Lovely outdoor bar

At the attractive bar, you immediately feel welcome. In a relaxed atmosphere, everyone can sit down to read a book or play a game. Drinks and snacks are served. And in the evening, you can make your own pizza in the wood-burning oven. Campers can cook a delicious camping meal in the beautiful and covered outdoor kitchen.

properties.name: Camping de la Rue Koffie & zo
Camping Le Casties
properties.description:
This friendly, French family campsite is located in the heart of the Haute-Garonne. This southern region of France features a varied and hilly landscape with the majestic Pyrenees in the background. Camping Le Casties is a neat, small-scale campsite on a pleasant terrain. Attention to sustainability and conscious use of energy is of paramount importance to its owners. There is plenty to keep children entertained, including the swimming pool, the playground and the petting zoo.

Quiet and space

Here you can enjoy the verdant surroundings from neat camping pitches. These are separated from one another by green hedges and thus afford plenty of space and privacy. There is an abundance of shade all around and plenty of comfortable grass beneath your toes. In addition to the twenty camping pitches, there are also beautiful chalets and mobile homes. Those who don't feel like bringing all their camping gear with them can spend the night in the ready-made tents. These are great if you prefer to just immediately unpack your bags upon arrival. The sanitary building is fairly new and looks nice.

Enjoy swimming and playing outside

To cool down, you can visit the small swimming pool, which is nicely laid out in a circle and enclosed by a fence. The pool is open from May to September. The youngest campers can play and cuddle with the bunnies and goats in the animal meadow. In the summer months, the music nights provide a wonderful get-together, for which a local restaurant also provides delicious meals. You can also explore the specially-designed GR footpaths on foot or take your bike for a nice ride.

properties.name: Camping Lika
properties.description:
This small-scale campsite is located in a quiet spot in an extremely sparsely populated area, in the hilly hinterland of the Dalmatian coast. Here you'll be camping near the village of Gračac, in the Croatian province of Zadar.

Given its location on the D1, Camping Lika is an ideal transit campsite, but guests also enjoy coming here for longer stays. Doing so gives you the opportunity to explore this beautiful area on foot or by bike. You can also visit the phenomenal Cerovač Caves, which are only five kilometres from the campsite. Moreover, this is a new campsite with a nice outdoor swimming pool, neat sanitary facilities and very large touring pitches (120-400 m2).

Beautiful, generous-sized lawns

Camping Lika offers both shady and sunny tourist camping pitches. The pitches have a grass surface and are separated by neat hedges.

The temperature is pleasant due to its location behind the Velebit Mountains, at an altitude of 650 metres. It is often 10 degrees cooler than on the warm coast, especially in the evenings.

Go for a refreshing dip in the outdoor pool

At the front of the grounds, you'll find the campsite's beautiful outdoor swimming pool. This is a rectangular swimming pool that is in full sun, so the water quickly becomes nice and warm in the summer. The pool is also sometimes open in the evening. It is then stylishly illuminated.

properties.name: Camping de la Seine
properties.description:
Attention nature lovers! You'll find this friendly and simple campsite in the north of France, near Rouen. This part of the interior of Normandy exudes tranquillity and has beautiful cycling routes. Camping de la Seine is located on the river of the same name and has waterfront pitches offering a beautiful view. The area offers plenty of activities. From watersports on Lake Jumièges to interesting cultural attractions in the city of Rouen. Around the corner is a vast nature park with forests, wetlands and castles.

Nice view over the water

A number of camping pitches offer beautiful views of the water and the wooded banks on the other side. All pitches on the campsite are demarcated by bushes, guaranteeing peace and privacy. You can choose between pitches with or without electricity, and there are grassy areas especially for tent campers. There are also various rental accommodations, such as mobile homes and apartments.

There is limited entertainment on the campsite, but guests can play a game of pétanque and there is a trampoline for children. During the summer holidays you can enjoy a delicious baguette in the morning.

Winding along the Seine

Do you love cycling? The famous La Route des Fruits (Fruit Route) runs past the campsite. Free ferries will take you across the Seine. You can rent bicycles at the campsite if you haven't brought along your own. The route, which totals 40 to 60 kilometres in length, is also suitable for travelling by car.

properties.name: Camping Flintstones Park
properties.description:
Camping Flintstones Park, located in the south of Sicily, is characterised by rest, relaxation and contact with nature. The campsite is lovingly cared for by the owners. The stone swimming pool, the green pitches and the atmosphere all make it a suitable retreat for every campsite visitor looking for a friendly campsite.

Oasis of peace and quiet

The campsite is remarkably green, which means that it is refreshing on hot days and has many shady pitches for your camping equipment! The relatively small swimming pool is beautifully finished with stone and is a real eye-catcher. If you prefer to swim in the sea, Bruca’s two-kilometre-long sandy beach is only 200 metres away.

Lovely family campsite

The campsite’s character is reflected everywhere. Each camping field is equipped with water, electricity and a barbecue pit. Hammocks, ready for you to daydream in them, are everywhere on the site. The reception has a small bar where you can get a delicious cappuccino or another type of drink. There is also a small play area for the children, and pets are more than welcome. If you are looking for a little more comfort or privacy, you can stay in one of the three rental accommodations.

Baroque highlights

No fewer than eight cities in southern Sicily are on UNESCO’s World Heritage List. These cities were all rebuilt in 1693 after a major earthquake and are considered the pinnacle of Baroque art in Europe. Many of these cities can be reached from the campsite within an hour by car.

properties.name: Camping Papafigo
properties.description:
Do you prefer to spend your holidays in a quiet, natural setting, but are you attached to luxury and privacy? At Papafigo Camp Site you will camp in an olive grove on the Croatian Istrian peninsula, just seven kilometres from the Adriatic coast. This is a small-scale campsite, where luxury, comfort and personal attention are paramount.

Opened in 2022, the campsite has a beautiful outdoor swimming pool, a wonderful wellness area, luxurious sanitary facilities and a modern restaurant. You can enjoy panoramic views and spectacular sunsets from several spots, including the large roof terrace.

Spacious camping pitches and luxury accommodation

On the beautifully landscaped campsite you will find eight spacious pitches. There are also eight modern mobile homes, seven glamping tents and a luxury villa (with private pool) for rent.

A wonderful wellness area

A wonderful wellness area has been created in the central building. This can be hired completely so that you can use the steam bath, Finnish sauna, whirlpool bath and massage room with your own camping party. The sanitary facilities are luxurious and spacious.

Visit the seaside resorts

Just west of Vodnjan is a wooded area where you can take lovely walks. Of course, relaxing at the beaches of Fažana and Peroj is always a good idea too. The popular towns of Pula and Rovinj are less than half an hour's drive away.

Take a boat excursion

Finally, there are fun boat excursions to take. You can sail to a picturesque lagoon for a swim. Another tip is to visit the small islands of the Brijuni archipelago by boat.

properties.name: Fonclaire Holidays
properties.description:
If you are looking for a small-scale campsite in a typical French rural environment, we can recommend Fonclaire Holidays. The campsite is located in the outskirts of the village of Blond in the department of Haute-Vienne (Limousin). You camp in a rural, hilly area with lots of wooded areas. A few kilometres southeast is Monts de Blond, a beautiful nature reserve. The campsite, run by hospitable Brits, invites you to swim, fish and just relax and enjoy the peace and quiet.

Open camping meadow and various opportunities for glamping

As a campsite visitor, you will have a pitch on an open field of grass. Will you decide to book a pitch at Fonclaire Holidays? Keep in mind that about half of the pitches have their own electricity connection. Moreover, as a campsite visitor, you will have access to a modern toilet block that also has private bathrooms available. Those who love glamping can stay overnight in a completely furnished safari tent or a luxurious holiday home.

Have fun swimming, participating in sports and fishing

Those who love participating in sports outdoors will feel right at home at this campsite. First of all, there is a great outdoor swimming pool. The pool water is heated to an agreeable temperature. You can also have fun playing football, table tennis and badminton. Children can play in the playground or play one of the fun board games that can be borrowed at the campsite. There are also two lakes for excellent fishing. The campsite is right next to some woods, where hiking enthusiasts can follow the Woodland Walk.

properties.name: Wine Camp Hazic
properties.description:
Just outside of Sveti Martin na Muri in the province of Medimurje, in the far north of Croatia, lies Wine Camp Hazic. Whoever stays at this luxury campsite may sample free wine. Wine Camp Hazic first opened its doors in 2021 and has received many enthusiastic campsite visitors since then.

Spacious pitches with clear view of vineyards

The open grounds of this campsite has two rows with spacious touring pitches. The bottom row is somewhat lower, so that each pitch has a clear view of the hilly vineyards around the campsite. In addition, each pitch at Wine Camp Hazic has a paved surface.

This campsite has high glamping quality due to the tidy character of the campsite, the ultramodern toilet facilities and the spacious pitches with a great view. For even more comfort, if your are a true lover of glamping, you can also book a luxury chalet at Wine Camp Hazic.

Sample wine and juice for free in the Hazic wine bar

Winegrowing is an important part of the traditions and culture in this region. This applies even more so at this campsite. Wine Camp Hazic is part of the Hazic wine bar, which is located right next to the camping grounds. Delicious wines are made from the hand-picked grapes. From harvesting to storing grapes in the cellar – everything is done under own management in this wine bar. Sampling is free and you can also purchase a bottle to take home with you.

properties.name: Nås Camping
properties.description:
Nås Campsite is an ideal place for those who prefer to enjoy a relaxing holiday. This campsite is centrally located in Sweden, in the sparsely populated and unspoilt landscape of Dalarna. Here you'll be camping next to meadows and fields, surrounded by numerous lakes and vast forests, where you can enjoy walking and cycling.

You can also explore Dalarna's natural beauty by canoe, as the campsite is right on the Västerdalälven River.

Nås Campsite is a small-scale campsite equipped with only the most necessary facilities. There is a friendly and relaxed atmosphere in which you can do everything or nothing at all.

Spacious touring pitches

At Nås Campsite, you'll be camping on a spacious touring pitch. These are neatly maintained grass pitches that are generally not demarcated from each other.

There are also six authentic looking 'stugas' for rent, suitable for two to four people. One of these distinctive accommodations features its own sanitary facilities.

Supermarket and sanitary facilities

You can do your shopping in the village supermarket (1 km away). There is also a nice restaurant in Nås.

The central service building features a communal kitchen, toilets, showers and washing facilities: simple, but clean.

Back to basics in a forest hut

Fancy spending some time in the wilderness? Then rent one of the three forest huts at the campsite. These cottages are located on a lake near Nas. There is no electricity or running water, but there is a gas heater, an outdoor toilet, a kitchenette and sleeping gear. You can explore the lake on your own personal rowing boat and stock up on fresh drinking water.

properties.name: Agricampeggio Oro Verde
properties.description:
This campsite in Verona is a fantastic place for anyone who enjoys the outdoors and the quiet charm of the Italian countryside. Situated between beautiful green fields, orchards and vineyards, this agri-campsite is the perfect place to enjoy peace and relaxation. It's also a great place for those who like to alternate quiet days in nature with a city trip. You can cycle to the historic city of Verona (4 km) in twenty minutes.

Small and cosy

The campsite's natural terrain offers 15 pitches in a quiet and green environment. What makes this campsite special is the combination of comfort and authenticity. You'll find all the modern amenities you need for a comfortable stay, such as spacious and well-equipped pitches, electricity, hot showers and free Wi-Fi. The view from your camping pitch will amaze you every day.

Oil, wine and honey

This is a paradise for foodies, as the campsite produces and sells its own organic products, such as olive oil, wine, honey and marmalade. You'll find everything you need in the immediate vicinity of the campsite. There is a supermarket 500 metres away and a pizzeria and a bakery 1 kilometre away.

City trip to Verona

Verona is a historic city known for its beautiful architecture, rich history and cultural heritage. It's the perfect destination for a day trip from the campsite. You'll find interesting sights here, such as the famous Roman amphitheatre, the balcony of Romeo and Juliet, and many beautiful churches and museums.

properties.name: Camping Dimore Montane
properties.description:
You have to drive over some narrow (yet passable) roads, but it is worth it. Camping Dimore Montane at Roccamorice in the Abruzzo region is a gem for those who want a quiet holiday out in the countryside. This campsite is in the middle of the wooded Maiella National Park, in a beautiful part of Italy that has not yet been discovered by mass tourism. You breathe clean mountain air and the only sounds you hear are relaxing forest sounds.

The campsite has an environmentally friendly approach. It uses renewable energy, recycled paper and biodegradable cleaning substances. The use of plastic is kept to an absolute minimum.

Great camping in the countryside

The small-scale camping site has been neatly integrated into the surrounding countryside. There are a few attractive fields with touring pitches. At Camping Dimore Montane you can also stay in an accommodation, like a modern hotel room, safari tent or wooden cabin. The wooden cabins have glass walls, allowing you to fully enjoy the natural outdoor decor from indoors as well.

Local specialities in Dimore Montane Restaurant

You can enjoy a delicious dinner with delightful regional dishes in the campsite’s restaurant. The items on the menu depend partially on the season. Due to the environmentally friendly approach, the restaurant also only uses local ingredients and products. The wine list contains only good wines from the Abruzzo region.

Varied walking tours

Camping Dimore Montane is in a mountainous area with opportunities for mountain sports such as mountain biking and abseiling. There are also great hiking paths for hikers at all levels.

properties.name: Ecocamping Rural Valle de La Fueva
Björsarv Camping
properties.description:
Nature lovers beware! Björsarv Camping is a great holiday destination for anyone who likes to unwind in unspoilt nature, far away from (urban) hustle and bustle. It's located near the village of Bjuråker, in the beautiful Svågadalen nature reserve in central Sweden. You will camp by the babbling river Svågan. The campsite is also surrounded by forests and mountains. So, it’s a beautiful nature campsite with facilities (like the toilet and washing facilities) that are up to modern standards.

Forested site with large pitches

After arriving at this campsite, you’ll pass a swimming lake near the accommodation. These are hiker's huts and a large holiday home, fully equipped, for up to six holidaymakers. You will then walk or drive a little further downhill. The tourist pitches are in the wooded part of the site, neatly arranged next to each other, without too much separating them, for a freer feeling. These large touring pitches have a lovely view of the forests and the river valley through which the river Svågan flows.

Splash around in clean natural water

Returning to the campsite on a beautiful summer day after a long car journey or a brisk walk? Then go for a nice swim in the river or take a refreshing dip in the swimming lake. You can also go paddle boarding or canoeing. The campsite also has its own playground, with a trampoline, sandpit, slide, swing and table tennis table. A visit to reception is always fun too. You’ll find an original Swedish loppis there: a cosy shop that sells surprising bits and bobs.

properties.name: Camping Terme Snovik
properties.description:
Camping Terme Snovik in the Slovenian town of Laze v Tuhinju is located between two wooded hills. The ideal place to fully relax and enjoy yourself. Relax in the thermal indoor and outdoor pools and get a massage, rent a bike to explore the green valley or plan a trip to the capital Ljubljana.

Peace, quiet and countryside

The campsite has 20 spacious pitches for tents and 9 pitches for a caravan or motorhome. From all the pitches, you have breathtaking views over the Tuhinj valley. This place exudes peace, freedom and tranquillity with the luxury of free Wi-Fi. If you do not have your own camping equipment, Terme Snovik also has several apartments and rooms you can rent.

Relax in the thermal baths

A real eye-catcher at this campsite is the swimming pool, on which you get a discount as a camping guest. Live it up in the indoor and outdoor pools (filled with thermal water!) or relax on loungers in the sun. The youngest campers have fun in the paddling pool, while slightly older children slide down the water slides. This thermal swimming complex works with the Kneipp method (water, exercise, nutrition, herbs and balance).

Afterwards, unwind further in the restaurant, where you can enjoy a delicious breakfast, lunch or meal with a refreshing drink. There are lots of fun activities for children. They can play in the playground, take part in all the games and competitions or make something nice during a creative workshop. Want to blow off some steam yourself? Check out the outdoor gym.

properties.name: Offroadcamp
properties.description:
Just outside of the Swedish town of Nornäs, in the Dalarna region, you will find Offroadcamp, a small campsite on a hill, surrounded by nature. You will completely relax here and enjoy the beautiful Swedish landscape. A lake, where you can participate in various water sports activities, is just a few minutes’ walk away. The campsite organises fun and adventurous excursions into the countryside, such as a packrafting trips. In short, a perfect holiday spot for nature lovers and adventurers.

Idyllic Swedish log cabin

The pitches at Offroadcamp are all spacious, and either grassy or pebbled. The accommodations at the campsite are uniquely furnished and fit in with the offroad theme of the campsite. Will you choose a vintage caravan? Or would you rather have a red Swedish log cabin with a beautiful view of the woods? Some of the accommodations have the luxury of private toilet and washing facilities and a fully equipped kitchen.

Rest and relaxation by the lake

Five hundred metres from the campsite is a lake, in the middle of the countryside. The lake can only be reached on foot and is a beautiful spot in the woods. You can swim, and there is a raft, a pedal boat and a fishing boat that you, as a campsite guest, can use.

Taste moose burgers

The campsite has a small restaurant where you can eat mainly local dishes. Taste the burgers made of moose, reindeer and bear. A daily breakfast is also an option here.

properties.name: Camp Virpazar
properties.description:
Camp Virpazar is nestled in the picturesque countryside of Montenegro, close to Lake Skadar and just about a kilometre from the charming village of Virpazar. This charming campsite, run by a friendly family, offers a relaxing stay surrounded by nature. Thanks to its proximity to walking and cycling trails and the Crmnica wine region, it is also an ideal base for explorers.

Pitches and accommodations

The campsite has pitches for tents, caravans and motorhomes, each with its own water and electricity connection. The pitches are spacious and surrounded by trees, providing shade on hot days. There is a covered dining/barbecue area where you can get together. For those seeking a little more comfort, Camp Virpazar also offers comfortable apartments for rent.

Boat trip on Lake Skadar

Although Camp Virpazar is modest in size, you’ll experience the perfect blend of simplicity and comfort. The campsite owner organises boat trips on Lake Skadar, where you can enjoy stories about the region’s rich history and culture as a passenger. The family’s personal touch and attention to detail make this experience truly unique. After a day full of adventure, you can relax with a delicious meal in the covered dining area, where local wine and traditional dishes are regularly offered.

From the mountains to the coast

The village of Virpazar and the impressive Lake Skadar are just a ten-minute walk away. For wine lovers, the nearby Crmnica wine region is highly recommended: famous for its rich history and distinctive wines.
