Thanks to the campsite’s central location, you can explore both mountainous regions and coastal areas

properties.name: ACA Alpen Camping Aigner
properties.description:
If you are looking for a charming campsite in the Austrian Alps for a holiday filled with countryside and mountain sports, ACA Alpen Camping Aigner is a great choice. You can completely relax and unwind at this small-scale and friendly campsite with mountain views. Toilet and washing facilities, restaurant and water sports facilities, everything is tip top here. So bring on that Alpine holiday filled with mountain walks, bike rides and winter sports adventures.

Friendly and small scale

The friendly and helpful owners will welcome you on arrival. With around 50 camping pitches and no accommodation for hire, this really is a small-scale campsite in every sense of the word. The campsite looks neat and is well maintained. The camping pitches are on grassland with paved paths.

Summer and winter sports campsites

The campsite has exactly the facilities you need for a wonderful holiday. The toilet and washing facilities are neat and clean and there are various play equipment for the young ones. There is a bus stop at 300 metres from the campsite. The campsite is open almost all year round and it is well equipped for winter sports. There is a dry room where you can hire and store skis. The ski resorts are not far from the campsite.

Guided walks are organised in the summer periods. Walk into reception for tips for great walks and outdoor sports.

Delicious pizza

Breakfast in the morning with fresh bread rolls and views of the mountains, now that's what we call a holiday! You don't have to leave ACA Alpen Camping thanks to the fresh bread service. You can also enjoy a delicious pizza or other snacks in the restaurant or a cold beer on the charming patio.

properties.name: Ballinacourty House Caravan and Camping Park
Camping L'Etang Bleu
properties.description:
Camping L'Etang Bleu is located in a wonderfully peaceful place in Green Périgord county, a few kilometres from the village of Mareuil. This campsite is surrounded by extensive wooded areas. There is also a hidden lake on this green camping site. In short, it is an ideal holiday address for those seeking complete for those who want to completely relax. If you like to go on excursions, visit one of the nostalgic castles, impressive cave systems or authentic little towns in the neighbouring area. At the campsite, relax in the swimming pool or at the pool bar.

Camp at your favourite pitch

When you arrive, you can choose your own favourite pitch. Each pitch at Camping L’Etang Bleu is demarcated by well-kept hedges, providing plenty of privacy. If you stay overnight at one of these spacious green pitches, you can use the renovated toilets and showers in the communal toilet block. If you would rather have your own toilet and kitchen, book a stay in a modern mobile home.

Complete relaxation by the swimming pool and the pool bar

When you enter the campsite, you can’t miss it: the beautiful outdoor swimming pool next to the reception. You can relax around the water, making use of one of the sun loungers or at the pool bar. A delicious bite to eat and a drink can also be had at the campsite restaurant. The menu includes home-made burgers, pizza and prawn dishes. On special themed evenings, the menu is supplemented with delicacies from the barbecue or with mussels and fries.

properties.name: Camping Rothenfels
properties.description:
Camping Rothenfels is a quiet campsite in the Austrian state of Styria for nature lovers. This terraced campsite near the mediaeval castle Rothenfels has ordinary pitches and a separate nudist section. It is still really dark here at night, making it an ideal location for stargazers. If you would like to go out during the day, the hills, wooded areas and mountain huts are beckoning.

A place for contemplation

Time for relaxation. It is peaceful both day and night at Camping Rothenfels. You camp next to the Rothenfels castle, a beautiful mediaeval castle in the Wölzertal region. At this campsite, you can choose your own pitch. There is a large terraced section and a separate nudist section with its own toilet facilities. It is also possible to stay at Camping Rothenfels with a large group. Ideal for a camping weekend or a team-building event.

Sun terrace and winter garden

Go for a swim in the nearby lake, laze about in the sun and end the afternoon with a delicious cup of coffee and Apfelstrudel. All of this is possible at this beautiful location. The campsite has a cafe with a sun terrace and a winter garden where you can relax. What’s more, you will find peace and quiet at Rothenfels and a thousand stars in the sky. The nearby castle organises tours on Thursdays and Saturdays from June through September.

Explore all legends

The surrounding area is perfect for hiking, mountain biking and cycling. The ‘Sagenhaftes Wölzertal’ (Mythical Wölzertal) hiking trail is located in the area around the castle. On this Legend Trail, you can admire the various legends of the city of Oberwölz from close up. There are also miles of hills and wooded areas in the area.

properties.name: Camping Uffenheim RENARO-Brueckner GbR
properties.description:
Camping Uffenheim is located in the Germany’s Bavaria, on the outskirts of the village with the same name. It is a small-scale, green campsite. The centre of Uffenheim is fifteen minutes away on foot. It is not a green city, but does have enough fun shops, good restaurants and typical German bakeries. The municipal swimming pool is right next to the campsite. Campsite guests can swim here for a fee.

Pleasant beer garden

The well-kept, small-scale campsite is a good home base for a holiday in southern Germany. You camp on grass. Dogs are welcome at the campsite. The campsite has a beer garden with a small menu – ideal for when you are not in the mood to cook. Sports enthusiasts have great fun at the multi-functional playing field. Whether you feel like playing football, basketball or tennis, it’s all possible.

Municipal swimming pool next to the campsite

The municipal outdoor swimming pool is right next to the campsite. As a campsite guest, you can use it for a small fee. The spacious pool has a slide and a high diving board for the real daredevils. Settle down with your beach towel in the large sunbathing area with volleyball field and snack bar.

Visit Rothenburg ob der Tauber

The charming city of Rothenburg ob der Tauber (21.5 km) is one of the most well-known places along the Romantische Strasse, a scenic route that passes amazing places in southern Germany. The attractive medieval city is fully encircled by a city wall that has six entrance gates and impressive towers.

properties.name: Camping Leiputrija
properties.description:
Leiputrija is a small-scale campsite, centrally located in Latvia at some 25 km from the capital Riga. You camp here in a predominantly flat, rural and wooded area. The Gauja river flows a few hundred metres from the campsite. The campsite offers a broad range of activities and excursions, such as trips with a quad, canoe, kart or buggy.

Camping in nature

The 35 demarcated camping pitches at Leiputrija offer ample space for your camping equipment. The grounds consist mainly of grass. There are some spots where it is possible to camp between trees. Two separate sections are reserved for tent campers.

Wooden rental accommodations

In addition to camping pitches, rental accommodation units including a mobile home and basic log cabins are also available. These vary considerably in size (9-25 m2) and can house two to eight persons. Prefer a bit more luxury? If so, choose one of the rooms. Depending on which room you book, you will have private sanitary facilities and shared facilities such as a sauna, recreational area and patio.

Entertainment and amenities

Camping Leiputrija has everything you need for an active holiday. Sports grounds (basketball, volleyball, soccer), a playground, seven fishing ponds, the Gauja river (ideal for canoeing) and a wide range of excursions. Rent a bike, quad, kart or buggy to explore the nature-rich area. The campsite also organises canoe and kayak trips. You can also get onto the water with a pedalo. 

The sanitary facilities are excellent. There is a communal kitchen, ideal for tent campers. Fresh bread is available from the small shop at the reception.

properties.name: Club del Sole Bologna Easy Camping Village
properties.description:
City campsite Centro Turistico Città di Bologna is located in the northern Italian region of Emilia-Romagna. You will be camping a stone's throw from the beautiful city centre. The bus to the centre stops right in front of the campsite. On the campsite's well-kept grounds you will find the swimming pool next to the bar where you can order breakfast in the morning. Delicious!

Shady pitches

After being welcomed at the modern reception building, you can make your way to your pitch. These are neatly laid out with plenty of shade. This is especially pleasant in the summer months. To be sure, put a bottle of mosquito repellent in your suitcase if you want to sit outside undisturbed in the evening.

Cooling down after a day in the city

What could be better than taking a refreshing dip after a long walk through the city? The campsite has a spacious swimming pool in a sunny and open space. There are comfortable sun loungers on the poolside. Drinks and snacks are available from the bar. Don't forget your swimming cap at this Italian campsite. You can rinse off the chlorine in the shower. The campsite's sanitary facilities are somewhat dated, but clean.

Bologna: university city with lively atmosphere

Bologna is the capital of the province you are in. It is a pleasant student city with the oldest university in Europe. This makes it a lively city to stroll around. Looking at the many beautiful churches while enjoying an Italian ice cream, is even more fun! Piazza Maggiore is the central square of the city. Here, you will find the most important historical sights.

properties.name: Club del Sole Jesolo Family Resort
Club del Sole Marina Family Resort
Club del Sole Pini Boutique Resort
properties.description:
Pini Beach Village is a beach campsite on the Mediterranean. The campsite is located directly on the beach of the Italian east coast, at Ravenna. The campsite, situated lengthways along the beach, has an open character. Some pitches overlook the water. The campsite is popular with sun worshippers.

The site is well kept. Despite the open and sunny nature of the site, there are still some trees that provide the necessary shade. From the beachfront you have a nice view of the Mediterranean. You can stay in one of several accommodations.

Sun, sea and beach

Do you like the sun, sea and beach? If so, Pini Beach Village is the right holiday destination for you. Many guests find their peace and quiet by the Mediterranean Sea. Within a few steps you can reach the beach and dive into the water. In the area and on the beach there are several playgrounds.

Terrace with sea view

Close to the beach is the restaurant, where you can order a pizza. The roof terrace is a particularly nice place: from the upper sun deck you can look out over the Mediterranean while enjoying a drink. At the side of the roof terrace is a shallow pool. Fun for children!

Ravenna: city of mosaics

Although the beach and the Mediterranean Sea especially beckon, there is also plenty to do in Italy's interior. For example, the city of Ravenna is just a 15-minute drive from the campsite. Several buildings in Ravenna are on UNESCO's World Heritage List.

properties.name: Club del Sole Milano Marittima Boutique Resort
properties.description:
Pineta Family Camping Village is a beach campsite located on Italy's east coast, just south of Ravenna. The campsite is situated between a pine forest and the beach, directly on the Mediterranean Sea. The grounds of the campsite, along with its shady touring pitches, are just steps away from the sea.

Shaded camping area

The touring pitches are situated beneath large trees, which provide plenty of shade. A paved road takes you to your camping spot or to one of the rental accommodations. The touring pitches are not particularly large, but they are spacious enough. The further you drive into the campsite, the closer you get to the Mediterranean Sea. Some of the touring pitches are right on the beach. Views of the sea are somewhat obscured by a fence, though.

Swimming in the sea and the pool

You're never far from the beach and the sea when camping at Pineta Family Camping Village. The sea water is nice and warm - ideal for taking a nice dip. The beach gets quite full in the summer months. If the beach is too busy for you, you can always take a dip in the pool instead. This simple swimming pool with paddling pool is located in a clearing close to the sea, at the rear of the site. There are also a number of sun loungers here, albeit far fewer than on the beach.

Campsite restaurant and supermarket

The campsite features a simple restaurant where you can order some meals. There's also a supermarket offering a fairly wide range of products. Not only can you get fresh vegetables here, but there are also beach items for sale.

properties.name: Club del Sole Rimini Family Resort
properties.description:
International Italia Family Camping Village is located on the coast of the Italian region Emilia Romagna in the coastal town Viserba di Rimini, which borders the well-known Rimini. You will camp at this large, child-friendly camp site directly by the sea. International Italia Family Camping Village has an excellent location near the centre and directly opposite the golden beach. You only have to cross the road and your feet are in the sand. The gently sloping coast makes this destination very suitable for families with young children. Enjoy a snack and a drink on the campsite's attractive terrace while the children join the Kidsclub.

Sun, sea and sand

Italian beaches, that's what it's all about in Rimini. From your campsite you can walk to the sea at your leisure, where there is also a nice playground and enough sunbeds and parasols for a real holiday feeling. Do your children feel like dancing or playing a game with their camping friends before or after playing in the water? Then they are welcome at the Kidsclub, which offers a great programme every day in high season.

Under the pine trees

Thanks to the many trees and oleander bushes, you can always find a pleasant spot of shade. The pitches are fairly spacious, are situated along narrow streets and are not really marked out. The sanitary facilities are clean, but not very modern. Would you like to stay in a ready-made mobile home? There are various types on the site for a comfortable glamping holiday.

properties.name: Club del Sole Le Mimose Family Resort
properties.description:
Club del Sole Le Mimose Family Resort is right by the sea, in the heart of the beautiful countryside of the Italian Marche region. Either roll out your towel on the white pebble beach or head to charming towns like Porto Sant'Elpidio (2.5 km) and Fermo (11 km). The campsite is well-maintained, on the coast and perfect for campers who love sun, sea and adventure.

Choose your spot: camping or luxury lodge

There’s plenty of choice at this campsite. The pitches are medium-sized, shaded and quiet. Prefer slightly more comfort? Then choose a modern air-conditioned lodge with its own kitchen. The Deluxe Lodge and Superior Family Lodge are spacious and stylishly furnished.

Your dog is also welcome in special pet-friendly accommodation. There are also great bungalows: ideal for families who like everything close at hand.

Everything you need for a relaxing day

From pool to theatre, you won't be bored for a moment here. The pool is right by the sea, with stunning views. You can relax in peace on the solarium (especially for women). Feeling hungry? The cosy restaurant serves delicious pizzas.

There’s also plenty of entertainment, sports (like beach volleyball) and a separate dog area with dog shower. Everyone will enjoy a carefree and well-deserved holiday here.

Holidays in the Marche

Explore the campsite's beautiful surroundings. Walk or cycle through the green hilly countryside, or relax by the crystal-clear water. Discover local markets, regional cuisine or charming towns.

properties.name: Club del Sole La Risacca Family Collection
properties.description:
If you enjoy spending your holiday in a diverse environment, where you can go from taking beautiful walks in the mountains to visiting relaxing seaside resorts and the beach, then this campsite is the ideal place for you! Here you'll be camping directly on the Adriatic Sea, in the town of Porto Sant'Elpidio in the Marches region of Italy. La Risacca Family Camping Village is a family campsite par excellence. This holiday park is especially popular with Italian families. It features, among other things, a private sandy beach and a beautiful open-air waterpark.

Beautiful camping fields and numerous rental properties

La Risacca Family Camping Village is a well-organised holiday park where rental properties are the primary form of accommodation. There are various types of accommodations for rent. These include mobile homes, apartments and lodge tents. Of course, there are also neatly maintained fields with tourist camping pitches. Regular camping pitches are about 40 m² in size, while the deluxe pitches are around 70 m².

Relax in the waterpark

At the front of the campsite is a beautiful waterpark with two large outdoor swimming pools. One of these is a real semi-Olympic swimming pool, where you can work on your fitness by swimming laps. There is also a playfully designed lagoon pool featuring fun water games and activities. Two spectacular waterslides let out into this pool.

Direct access to a sandy beach

You can also swim in the sea. This is an ideal campsite for beach lovers, because the grounds flow directly into the campsite's own private beach. Here you can get to know the wonderful waters of the Adriatic Sea not only by swimming, but you can also rent stand-up paddleboards, canoes and pedal boats.

properties.name: Camping Wetland
properties.description:
On the border of Noord-Brabant and Limburg, within walking distance of National Park De Groote Peel, lies campsite Wetland. This landscape campsite consists of a farm, a fishpond, ponds, wooded areas, a dyke and of course a well-maintained campsite. It has been laid out with an eye for nature and the landscape. The facilities are simple, but the price-quality ratio is excellent. In the surroundings you can enjoy walking and cycling.

Naturally landscaped grounds

The naturally landscaped campsite has plenty of space and a varied range of pitches. You can choose your own pitch on one of the camping fields. Do you choose a spacious pitch by the pond or rather a sheltered spot in the greenery? There are 45 touring pitches available, as well as 15 paved camper pitches, 2 simple hiker's cabins and 3 comfortable chalets.

Playground and fishing pond

The grounds around Wetland campsite cover no less than six hectares. You can take a lovely walk along the pools and over the dyke. There is even a special playground for dogs, where they can run free. Fishing is allowed in the pond, but you can also enjoy sitting on the natural banks, overlooking the water.

Simple facilities

In terms of facilities, Wetland is a simple campsite, but the price-quality ratio is excellent. The sanitary facilities are very sober and at full occupancy not sufficient, but they are well cleaned and toilet paper and soap are available. There is no campsite shop or restaurant on the campsite, but there is a communal kitchen. This is mainly used by tent campers. For your groceries you can go to Neerkant, a small village two kilometres from the campsite.

properties.name: Thyborøn Camping & Hotel
properties.description:
Thyborøn Camping & Hotel is in the fishing town of Thyborøn, on the west coast of Denmark. Here, you camp in a water-rich environment, between the North Sea and the Limfjord. This is therefore an ideal spot for beach, water sports walking and cycling enthusiasts. This campsite is also a great place for families with (young) children. Here, you will find things including a lovely indoor swimming pool, a large sports hall, a restaurant, little shop and a great indoor and outdoor playground.

Open camping fields and various types of accommodation

If you come with your own caravan, motorhome or tent, you pitch on the well-organised open camping fields. You can also spend the night in a modern holiday home, a charming camping pod or a hotel room. The accommodation are on a separate part of the campsite.

Wonderful relaxation by the swimming pool

There is plenty of entertainment during your holiday, even when the weather is less favourable. There is Vandwærket, a lovely indoor swimming pool right next to the campsite. This swimming pool is free to use for all guests of Thyborøn Camping & Hotel. There is a paddling pool, a large basic pool and a pleasant wellness zone. Besides the swimming pool, there is also a large sports hall and an indoor playground

Water sports and swimming

On hot summer days, you can go paddling or swimming in the North Sea. Thyborøn's long sandy beach is 300 metres away. So, walk down the dune path and you are there. The beaches of Thyborøn are excellent for surfing, standup paddleboarding, diving and snorkelling.

properties.name: First Camp Duse Udde
properties.description:
This campsite on Lake Vänern (the largest lake in Sweden) is located 6 km from the town of Säffle, Vänernland, on a partly wooded promontory. Along the shore, small beaches are interspersed with cliffs. Water recreation comes first here. The beautiful sandy beach of the campsite with its clear water invites you to go swimming, fishing and boating. It is the true nature lover who comes to camp here.

Spacious pitches and cabins

Duse Udde is a large, spaciously laid out campsite with lots of greenery and demarcated pitches and with a view of the lake from virtually every pitch. There are 344 touring pitches (100-160 m2). These are located on a beautiful grass surface with few trees. The rental accommodation will definitely not disappoint you because all cottages here (cabins) are well maintained, complete with IKEA furnishings. Lots of wood, white and dark red. Real eye catchers!

Active with or without water

Enjoy yourself on the golden sandy beach, interspersed with rocky beaches and reed belts. The rocks along the shore are in places large and flat, perfect for sitting on or for sunbathing. There is a playground for children on the beach. The campsite activities are mainly focused on water: fishing, canoeing, kayaking or rowing. However, you can also keep yourself busy with mini golf, walking, cycling (bicycles can be rented) volleyball and beach volleyball.

Eating in the lighthouse

The camping shop is well stocked and is located in the same building as the reception. The reception is in a quirky location: a bit higher up in a lighthouse on the campsite. From here you have a splendid view of Lake Vänern.

properties.name: Camping Port Sainte Marie Onlycamp
properties.description:
At this family campsite in Malicorne-sur-Sarthe, France, south of Le Mans, you’ll find peace and quiet as well as a friendly atmosphere. You can camp here on the banks of the River Sarthe here, where you can swim, fish, canoe and kayak to your heart’s content, surrounded by green fields and woods.

Camping by the river

The campsite mainly offers pitches for tents, caravans, motorhomes or trailer tents. They are spread across a number of lovely fields, and some pitches offer views of the river. Alternatively, you can opt for one of the cosy accommodation options. There’s plenty of space at this spacious campsite.

Luxury breakfasts

Take a dip in the municipal swimming pool, which is right next to the campsite. Campsite guests can use it for free! Not in the mood for a swim, but fancy a bit of exercise? Then have a game of tennis or round of football on the court or pitch. Worked up an appetite from all that action? The bar sells delicious snacks.

In the morning, you can pick up fresh rolls. Want a hearty breakfast? Then you can choose a complete breakfast box. And you don’t even have to get out of bed or your sleeping bag early. Your breakfast will be delivered right to your pitch or accommodation!

Discover the Pays de la Loire

Camping Port Sainte Marie is located in the Pays de la Loire region. Here you can admire beautiful landscapes, visit charming villages, explore stunning nature and sample the tastiest regional dishes. Hire a bike at the campsite and explore the surrounding area.

The village of Malicorne-sur-Sarthe is within walking distance. Here you can do your shopping or grab a bite to eat in one of the restaurants.

properties.name: Camping La Varenne Onlycamp
properties.description:
Away from the hustle and bustle? Camping La Varenne Onlycamp is in the middle of the forests and ponds of Sologne, about 2 hours from Paris. Here, you can breathe fresh air and enjoy the silence. Camp on large pitches or choose a comfortable mobile home. The focus is on relaxing in green surroundings.

Camping pitches and rental accommodation

Are you bringing your own camping equipment? Pitch your tent in a shady spot or park your motor home on a large pitch with electricity. If you want a little more comfort, opt for a modern mobile home. The mobile homes are fully equipped, with a kitchen and patio: ideal for a relaxing evening outdoors. Prefer something more adventurous? Then book a Ponza or Lonna tent. Cosy, simple and perfect for anyone who wants to be close to nature.

All the facilities you need for a relaxing holiday

The campsite has everything you might need. Collect fresh bread from the bread point in July and August. While children head to the playgrounds, you can play a game of boules or tennis. You can always ask reception for tips. Want to bring your bike? There’s a covered area with facilities where you can rest after your ride.

Explore the Sologne and beyond

The charming village of Neung-sur-Beuvron is within easy reach of Camping La Varenne (1 km). Visit the impressive Loire castles, such as Chambord (31 km) or Cheverny (32 km). A day out with the family? The Zoo de Beauval (59 km) is within driving distance and highly recommended.

properties.name: Camping La Montagne de Reims Onlycamp
Camping Le Curtelet Onlycamp
properties.description:
Camping Le Curtelet Onlycamp is in a charming spot located on the peaceful banks of Lake Aiguebelette, France's warmest lake. The campsite's setting is genuinely unique: by the lake with views of the green mountains, where you can enjoy delicious gastronomy and regional wines from the Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes region.

Cosy campsite by the lake

On arrival, you are warmly welcomed by the friendly owners, who are ready to make sure you have an unforgettable stay. The campsite extends along the lake and is not very large, giving it a cosy feel. Almost all pitches benefit from the shade of the trees. There is no organised entertainment at Le Curtelet Onlycamp.

Water sports and relaxation

The campsite appeals to a varied audience, from families who enjoy the water to couples who appreciate the peace and space of the low season. For relaxation and fun, you can swim in the lake or get active on a canoeing, kayaking or standup paddleboarding trip. The village of Lépin-le-Lac is only 800 metres away. There, you will find shops for your daily groceries. The snack bar at the campsite provides you with simple meals and there is a bakery service.

Walking, tasting and exploring

You can go on wonderful walks in the mountains and cycle through the stunning countryside. After a relaxing trip, you can enjoy the delicious local cuisine in the restaurants and cafés in the surrounding area. Explore the local market in nearby towns and villages such as Chambéry (23 km) and Aix-les-Bains (29 km). There, you can sample local delicacies, cheese, wine and other artisan products.

properties.name: Camping Les Mélèzes Onlycamp
properties.description:
Looking for fresh mountain air, beautiful walking trails and some peace and quiet? Camping Les Mélèzes Onlycamp is situated at an altitude of 1,700 metres, right in the heart of the impressive Queyras Nature Park. Book a pitch for your tent, campervan or caravan, or opt for a wooden cabin if you’re coming without camping equipment. This campsite offers a simple yet well-maintained camping experience and is within walking distance of the village of Ceillac.

Camping with a great view

The pitches are spacious and scattered in the middle of natural surroundings, offering views of majestic mountain peaks over 3,000 metres high. You can pitch your tent between the trees or park your campervan on a flat spot with a lovely view. Coming with a caravan? No problem. Everything is easily accessible. The atmosphere is simple and relaxed. In terms of accommodation, you can choose from a number of wooden cabins that blend in well with the mountain scenery.

Natural campsite for peaceful retreats

No entertainment or swimming pool here, just peace, nature and a relaxed atmosphere. The campsite offers basic facilities: water, electricity, sanitary facilities and areas for washing up. For a hot meal, visit the village of Ceillac, within walking distance, where you can choose from eight restaurants. Please note: outside of high season, some restaurants are closed. One restaurant near the campsite serves local produce. Delicious and locally sourced.

Lace up your hiking boots

This area is popular with hikers. From the campsite, you can walk straight into the nature park. Glacial lakes, alpine meadows, steep cliffs: the routes are diverse and well marked. Along the way, you’ll spot chamois, marmots and perhaps even an ibex.

properties.name: Camping Les Bords de Vienne Onlycamp
properties.description:
Fancy camping by the water, surrounded by greenery and close to a charming French village? You can at Camping Les Bords de Vienne Onlycamp. This peaceful, well-organised campsite is situated right on the River Vienne in the Centre-Val de Loire region. You can walk straight to the beach, and the centre of L'île-Bouchard is just around the corner. And with the famous châteaux of the Loire within driving distance, this is also the perfect base for day trips.

Enjoying the Vienne

The campsite offers spacious pitches. In the sun or would you prefer the shade? The choice is yours. The pitches are flat and suitable for tents, caravans or motorhomes. Many pitches have electricity. Don’t feel like pitching a tent? Then the Treck tent is a great alternative for two people. Simple, but with everything you need for a short stay. Travelling with a group? The cottage (gîte) can accommodate 16 people.

Amenities for a carefree holiday

From July onwards, you can take a refreshing dip in the river, right below the campsite. The swimming area is safely marked off. There’s also entertainment for children in the playground. For an ice cream, a drink or a tasty treat, pop into the small campsite shop (open in high season).

Out and about in the Loire region

From the campsite, you can walk straight into the village of L'île-Bouchard. Small, but full of charm and history. Hop in the car to Chinon (17 km) and visit the fortress, or sample the local Chinon wines. Canoeing or kayaking on the Vienne? Definitely worth a go.

properties.name: Camping Domelin Onlycamp
properties.description:
The small, quiet mountain campsite Camping Domelin Onlycamp dazzles in the southeast of France, not far from the Swiss and Italian borders. The campsite is a 10-minute walk from the lovely village of Beaufort where you'll find many shops and restaurants. This clearly laid out campsite has spacious pitches for your tent, caravan or motorhome or you can stay in one of the lovely glamping tents. You can completely relax and unwind in the natural green area with lovely views.

Camping amid greenery

As you drive further on to the campsite, you look out at the enormous wooded mountains in the distance. You will also instantly notice how attractive the grassy fields are. All numbered pitches are spacious and nicely appointed without demarcation. Tall trees are spread over the fields, providing adequate shade.

The clean toilet blocks are seen as an important plus point by many campers. The glamping tents, hired by the campsite, blend in well with the natural surroundings.

Active in the mountains

In the summer, the baker comes to the campsite in the mornings with fresh bread. Once you have had breakfast in the outdoor air, it's time to explore the area. Beaufort is a lovely nearby village at 750 metres altitude and known for Beaufort cheese. You are in for a treat!

The region mainly consists of mountain lakes, meadows, forests, steep hills and challenging descents. That makes it a great starting point for challenging mountain hikes or easier walks. There are also over 20 mountain bike routes, ranging from 3 to 27 kilometres.

properties.name: Camping Les Peupliers Onlycamp
properties.description:
Camping Les Peupliers is a quiet family campsite nestled among the impressive mountains of the French Savoy. You will be camping right next to a natural lake. The campsite has its own beach for swimming. The snack bar serves snacks and drinks on the terrace and there is a team that provides the necessary entertainment. Explore the beautiful countryside in the area while following a walking tour or cycle route.

A place by the water

The compact campsite consists of an elongated site that ends at the lake. There are plenty of trees and most touring pitches are located along two well-maintained lanes. Would you rather have a more luxurious overnight stay? The fully furnished glamping tents, tiny houses and chalets are very inviting. Several of them are located on the banks of the lake. A good night’s rest is high on the campsite’s agenda, which is why quiet time begins at 22.30.

Swimming in the lake

Nothing beats swimming in natural water. From the waterfront you can see the whole of Lac d'Aiguebelette, also popular among rowers, kayakers, stand up paddleboarders and fishermen. Motor boats are prohibited because the lake has been declared a nature reserve. Due in part to this, the atmosphere is very relaxed. Real adventurers go paragliding and admire the magnificent lake from the air.

The shop sells local products, such as fresh rolls. Want a pizza or a cold drink? Have a seat on the shaded terrace at the entrance. You can also pick up a meal to take to your pitch.

properties.name: Camping Le Port Onlycamp
properties.description:
Looking for a simple camping experience near a river? Camping Le Port Onlycamp is situated right on the banks of the Loire, in the heart of the lush Centre-Val de Loire region. Here you can camp without any fuss but with everything you need, all within walking distance of the fishing village of St. Benoît-sur-Loire (4 km). Want to explore walking and cycling routes through the French countryside? The surrounding area is full of them.

Camping pitches and fully equipped tents

The campsite has spacious pitches suitable for caravans, motorhomes and tents. Plenty of shade, a 10A electricity supply and enough space to relax. Ideal for a short stopover or a longer stay. Don’t forget your European adapter!

Not bringing your own camping gear? Then choose one of the fully equipped tents. The Tente Treck, for example, is very handy for cyclists. The larger Tente Ponza accommodates up to five people, ideal if you are travelling with family or a group of friends.

Everything you need

Here, it’s all about convenience. There’s a simple motorhome service point for waste water disposal. Need to do some laundry? No problem – the launderette is ready and waiting. And especially for the cyclists: Camping Le Port is located right on EuroVelo 3 and 6. Great for a stop along the way. And a friendly team is always on hand at reception with information about the local area, tips for day trips, or just a chat.

Explore the area

The campsite is beautifully situated on the banks of the Loire, close to the village of Saint-Benoît-sur-Loire (4 km). It’s perfect for a morning stroll or a peaceful evening with a view. Venture out to visit the impressive Basilica of Saint-Benoît-sur-Loire, a must-see in the region.

properties.name: Camping le Val Joyeux Onlycamp
properties.description:
In the heart of France, near the charming village of Château la Vallière, lies Camping le Val Joyeux Onlycamp at a nice, quiet location. At the edge of the woods and within walking distance of the village. Next to the small campsite is a recreational area with a swimming lake and a nice beach. The multifaceted department of Indre-et-Loire has many hidden gems, such as magnificent castles. And if you enjoy cycling or hiking, you can choose from numerous routes through the countryside that will take you past idyllic hamlets.

Camping in the Loire

The last part of the route will take you through a rural area east of the city of Tours. The campsite is easily accessible from various motorways. This also makes it a good location to stay overnight if you are passing through.

Space and peace

Surrounded by woods with ancient oaks, you can set up a spacious pitch. All 42 of the pitches are fairly large and demarcated with hedges. Plenty of privacy. If you would like a shady or sunny pitch, both are possible. A bonus is that the grassy surface is flat. The quiet grounds are well-kept, and the white toilet block also looks neat.

Go for a lovely swim

To cool off, the lovely lake of Val Joyeux is only 300 m away. You can swim there in the months July and August, and there is a lifeguard who keeps an eye on things. The small beach is a great place for children to play.

properties.name: Camping Le Clos Imbert Onlycamp
properties.description:
Camping Le Clos Imbert Onlycamp is situated in a green setting on the banks of the River Thouet, close to the historic town of Thouars. This small-scale campsite is a peaceful base for nature lovers and cyclists, partly thanks to its location on the Vélo Francette cycle route. The combination of nature, the nearby town and simple facilities makes the campsite ideal for a short stopover or a longer stay in the Deux-Sèvres region.

Camping at the Thouet river

The campsite has around 44 pitches, most of which are spacious and partly sheltered by greenery. You can choose your own spot, with sun or shade, and always close to the river. Electricity is available at many pitches (optional). For those who want to travel light, wooden pods are available to rent. These cosy tents feature two single beds and are equipped with electrical outlets and heating. Ideal if you’re passing through by bike and fancy a bit of comfort!

Everything you need nearby

On site, you’ll find a boules court and a toilet block with hot showers and accessible facilities. For a refreshing dip, head to the municipal swimming pool Les Bassins du Thouet, just a short distance away (2.5 km), where you’ll receive a discount. Here you can enjoy indoor and outdoor pools, a splash park and a slide for the children. There are even saunas and a hammam. For a tasty bite to eat, head to the Le S’Potes restaurant next to the campsite (100 m). Dogs are welcome (on a lead) and the site is also well-suited for guests with reduced mobility.

properties.name: Camping Boucocers Onlycamp
properties.description:
From Camping Boucocers Onlycamp, there’s a great view of one of the most beautiful villages in France: Lagrasse. You will camp on a hill in the heart of nature here. This cosy small campsite in the French countryside is sure to relax you! It makes a great base for anyone who loves walking, culture and exploring the surrounding vineyards. And Lagrasse is very close by, where there’s plenty to discover too. For example, the Sainte-Marie abbey and the medieval bridge Ponte Vieux.

Camp with a view

The campsite has large pitches on an open site. You can choose where to pitch your tent, caravan or motor home yourself. There are great views of the historic village and green hills here. Would you like a little more comfort when camping? Then choose a cosy safari tent. Dog owners are welcome to bring their four-legged friends to the campsite too. There’s a small shop on the campsite that sells some essentials. You can also challenge your fellow campers to a game of boules or table tennis.

Cathar castle and a day at the beach

Nearby, you can make beautiful trips through the Corbières and along the river Orbieu. If you love history, you can visit the impressive Cathar castles, like Château de Peyrepertuse (51 km) and Château de Quéribus (46 km). Carcassonne (37 km) and Narbonne (40 km) are easily accessible as well. Fancy a day at the beach? The Plage Port La Nouvelle beach on the Mediterranean (56 km) is ideal for a day trip.

properties.name: Camping au Cœur du Parc Onlycamp
Camping de l'Orée des Boires Onlycamp
Camping au Coeur du Lac Onlycamp
Camping Vahrner See
properties.description:
Camping Vahrner See is nestled in a forested area near the charming town of Bressanone or Brixen as this town is called in German. Favourably located close to the Brenner Pass, this campsite in South Tyrol is the perfect place for travellers to stopover. But the adventurous setting in the Eisack Valley also makes it a wonderful holiday destination for nature lovers and active types.

Nostalgic camping

With 70 camping pitches on grass, Camping Vahrner See has been offering the nostalgic experience of a real camping adventure since 1956. Here, you can pick your own pitch for your tent or motorhome in the sun or shade. Motorbike riders are also warmly welcome at Vahrner See.

Important to know

If you are travelling with a motorhome or caravan, it's good to know that the entrance to the campsite is restricted by two small underpasses. The maximum clearance is 2.70 m (high) x 2.65 m (wide).

Eat at the tavern

The lovely family restaurant spoils guests from morning to evening with delicious local dishes. It is highly enjoyable on the sunny patio or in the charming tavern. The 3D archery range and the adjacent playground offer fun for young and old.

Walking and cycling routes from the campsite

This campsite in the middle of the Eisack Valley is a heavenly spot for walkers and cyclists. Follow the path through the old chestnut groves and by Lake Vahrn and discover rare animals and plants. The campsite is right by the Eisacktal cycle route between Brenner and Bozen on the junction to the Pustertaler cycle route.

properties.name: Camping Obstgarten
properties.description:
Camping Obstgarten is in a wonderfully quiet spot, surrounded by green hills, fruit trees and vineyards. This friendly family campsite is in the village of Cortaccia sulla Strada del Vino, better known as Kurtatsch an der Weinstraße, in the southernmost part of South Tyrol (North Italy). This region is known as naturally green and hilly, making it perfect for walking and cycling tourists.

Authentic camping on a small-scale site

This is an authentic campsite intended solely for campers with their own caravan, motorhome or tent. There are three rows with a total of 25 touring pitches. You can see exactly where which camping pitch is on Camping Obstgarten's map. Here, you camp on neatly maintained grass fields. You have breathtaking views of the surrounding mountains from many pitches.

Wonderful swimming in the beautiful natural lake

One of this campsite's showpieces is the natural swimming lake beside the camping pitches. You can go for a lovely refreshing swim in the swimming lake. You get into the water via a swimming jetty or small ladder. Meanwhile, the youngest visitors can play completely safely in the shallow paddling area, which is separated from the rest of the lake.

Cycle through the vineyards and walk along the Bletterbach

You can do numerous active outdoor sports in the direct vicinity of Camping Obstgarten. It's wonderful cycling past the many vineyards, while you can take lovely walks in the green hills around Kurtatsch. Finally, the Geoparc Bletterbach walking and hiking area is highly recommended.

properties.name: Camping Vogelsang
properties.description:
Enjoy all the natural beauty of the Italian province of South Tyrol at Camping Vogelsang. This simple campsite offers beautiful views of the mountains. Put on your hiking boots and go for a brisk walk or take the bike and tour around the area. You can go to the campsite's bar for a refreshing drink. And if you fancy a swim, there's a swimming pool close by that you can use for free.

Small-scale campsite with vast views

There are 60 pitches of various sizes at the terraced campsite. Every pitch offers stunning panoramic views of the mountains and the apple orchards. The campsite was established in 2017 and the toilet and washing facilities are modern and clean.

People looking for peace and quiet and nature lovers

Camping Vogelsang is perfect for people who like the countryside and quiet. There are not many facilities at the campsite. However, as a campsite guest you can use the nearby swimming pool for free. It is open from June to August. Even more fun: during your stay, you get a card enabling you to use the public transport in the region for free.

Discover South Tyrol

Get the train and explore the area. The charming Merano is certainly with visiting. It has lovely outdoor cafés and authentic buildings. The impressive Trauttmansdorff Castle with surrounding gardens is just outside the centre. You can also go on a Sissi walk of about three kilometres, which takes you past places associated with the Austrian empress.

properties.name: Camping Le Sérignan-Plage Nature
properties.description:
Camping Le Sérignan-Plage Nature is located in Sérignan in the south of France. This is a nudist campsite right by the beach with lots of amenities. It has a large swimming pool with sun loungers, wellness facilities with several swimming pools and there are lots of activities for children such as a playground, games room and a mini club. You are at the right address here for delicious meals as well.

Glamping with sea views

Camping Le Sérignan-Plage Nature is a large campsite with both camping pitches and accommodations. The grassy pitches are situated among the trees or right on the beach. You can also choose from pitches with or without shade. If you rent an accommodation, you can choose from a luxury mobile home of a glamping tent. Several premium huts are also available, being glamping tents right on the beach with a view of the sea.

Have fun swimming and relax in the wellness centre

Camping Le Sérignan-Plage Nature has plenty of room for relaxation. There is a large swimming pool surrounded by chaise longues for relaxing. Behind the swimming pool is the wellness centre, built in a Greco-Roman style. Swimming costumes are not allowed in the swimming pool and the wellness centre. The neighbouring campsite, Yelloh! Village Le Sérignan, has a large swimming pool complex with water slides. As a campsite guest, you can swim here for free. Note: do take into account that wearing clothes is mandatory at this campsite.

Tasty food

At the restaurant at Camping Le Sérignan-Plage Nature, fresh food is prepared daily and you can purchase drinks, snacks and a meal there throughout the entire day. There are also several shops on the campsite grounds for souvenirs and art.

properties.name: Natur Camping Lärchwiese
properties.description:
Natur Camping Lärchwiese is located in the Alpine region of Gitschberg Jochtal in South Tyrol (Italy). The Fischnaller family welcomes you to this modern campsite, where you can choose from among 91 pitches. The campsite is right next to the lifts going up to the Gitschberg Jochtal ski resort, so you can get from the campsite to the slopes in no time. But there is also plenty to do in this hiking and skiing area in the summer. There are bicycle tours and mountain walks or you can visit the charming city of Bolzano.

Five types of pitches

The campsite has five types of pitches: Lärche Premium (130-160 m²), Fane Superior (100-130 m²), Zirbe Deluxe (75-100 m²), Jochtal Comfort (70-100 m²) and Arnika Classic (50-75 m²). The pitches have electricity, gas, water and drainage, free wifi and an optional TV connection to Sky. There is also a separate field for tents. Dogs are welcome at the camping site as long as they are kept on a lead.

Modern amenities

At Natur Camping Lärchwiese the necessary amenities are easily within reach. There are two luxury toilet blocks, equipped with showers, toilets, baby areas, chemical toilet facilities and facilities for wheelchair users. There are also separate areas with washers and dryers.

Visit the campsite shop for your daily shopping. If you are not in the mood to cook, the reception building houses a restaurant and pizzeria, including takeaway. For families, the covered play areas provide hours of fun, even when the weather is less accommodating.

Explore South Tyrol

The campsite is surrounded by many hiking and cycle routes through the mountainous terrain, allowing you to enjoy yourself here in every season. In addition, the campsite changes in the winter into a winter sports paradise.

properties.name: Il Tridente Camping Village
properties.description:
In the Venice region, near the charming resorts of Bibione and Bibione Pineda, you'll find the campsite Residence Il Tridente. Here you camp directly on a lovely and wide sandy beach, nicely in the shade of a pine forest. A holiday here means really enjoying the Italian atmosphere.

Campsite and holiday park

A large part of Il Tridente consists of a holiday park with mobile homes. There is also a hotel with about 50 rooms. But this doesn't mean that the campsite doesn't get any love and attention. The campsites are nicely laid out, often in the shade of the trees and vary in size.

Entertainment for the whole family

Sun, beach, pizzas and day trips to famous Venice. It's not surprising that the campsite Il Tridente draws a broad crowd. The enthusiastic entertainment team provides varied entertainment for guests from the age of 5 during the high season. From crafts and make up to survival, building huts and sports.

Relaxing on the beach

Campsite Il Tridente is located right on a lovely broad sandy beach of outstanding quality. It is even awarded the ecolabel Blue Flag. As on most Italian beaches, there are beach chairs and parasols available. On the campsite there is also a nice outdoor swimming pool with toddler pool. So you can start your day sporty while swimming some laps or taking an aquarobics class.

properties.name: Camping Moselhöhe
properties.description:
Nestled in the green hills of the Moselle Valley, close to the Moselle itself, is Moselhöhe campsite. The owners have turned their quiet campsite into a pleasant place for a relaxing camping holiday. From the pitches on the terraces you have a beautiful panoramic view of the valley and the surrounding hills. Those seeking some peace and quiet and nature lovers will quickly feel at home here.

Pitches with panorama

You can tell that the owners have thought carefully about their campsite. Sixty-five green, partially bounded touring pitches are located at different heights on the open camping area. You can pitch your caravan or camping car so that from the terraces you can always enjoy the wonderful panoramic view of the hilltops of the Moselle region and the surrounding vineyards.

Peace, quiet and nature

You choose the Moselhöhe campsite above all for its peace and quiet. At this campsite, you will mainly find couples and senior citizens, but in the high season, you can also meet families with children. They can burn off energy in the playground with its hill slide and rope slide. They can also enjoy the round swimming pool. However, the campsite is more suitable for adults who appreciate the peace and quiet on the campsite and in the surrounding area.

Restaurant with terrace

At the front of the campsite, near the reception, you will find the small restaurant with terrace. Here you can enjoy a pleasant meal. The menu is not extensive, but the food is good. Fresh rolls in the morning can be reserved at the campsite, but for daily shopping you have to go to a nearby supermarket.

properties.name: Vakantiepark Bergumermeer
properties.description:
Bergumermeer Holiday Park, in the Dutch province of Friesland, is a child-friendly campsite where you can also do watersports. The campsite is directly on the water, so it's a great base for all sorts of water sports. The campsite on the Frisian Bergumer Lake is less than half an hour's drive from the provincial capital, Leeuwarden. The campsite is located in flat, green, woody countryside: perfect for cycling and walking.

From the N31 and the N356, you can easily reach the campsite via the village of Suameer (Sumar).

On the water

At the campsite, there's water almost everywhere: the Princess Margaret canal streams alongside the campsite, and traverses the Bergumer Lake there. In the southern part of the campsite, you'll find a large pond. Many of the pitches and the rental accommodation options are located on the water. The holiday villas - including villas for people with disabilities - are located right on the canal, while from the terrace of the beach lodges, you can see the whole Bergumer Lake. You'll also find comfortable bungalows right on the water. The campsite has its own beach, where you can take a dip in the lake. There are also plenty of opportunities for watersports. Various boats are available to hire, from motorboats to canoes to Skûtsjes (traditional Frisian sailing boats) so you can easily navigate the huge lake. Not quite such an experienced captain? Bergumermeer Holiday Park has its own sailing school, so you can learn. You can even go fishing. In particular, the Princess Margriet canal is a great place for pike and carp fishing.

properties.name: Camping and Caravanning Club Site Windermere
Wolvey Villa Farm C. & C. Site
Hollands Wood Camping in the forest
Lee Valley Caravan Park Dobbs Weir
Abbey Wood Caravan and motorhome Club Site
Skye Camping and Caravanning Club Site
Braemar Caravan Park
properties.description:
Braemar Caravan Park is surrounded by the picturesque mountains of Scotland's Cairngorms National Park: a landscape of impressive mountains, beautiful valleys and lovely rivers. The campsite is near the quaint village of Braemar, in the middle of Royal Deeside – where the British Royal Family have spent their summers since the reign of Queen Victoria. In the winter, you can ski at the Glenshee Ski Centre, which is just half an hour's drive from the village.

Camping in all seasons

This beautiful campsite is accessible via one of the most beautiful routes in Scotland, the road from Perth to Aberdeen. The surface is level and well maintained. The friendly and helpful staff will be happy to help you plan day trips and activities. Braemar Caravan Park is open all year round, and every season has its own charm. In the winter, a snowplough is used to ensure that the site is still easily accessible. Lockers are available for ski equipment.

Wildlife and whisky

Thanks to its ideal location and good amenities, Braemar Caravan Park is the perfect base for discovering the Scottish Cairngorms. The environment is carefully managed, which means you're likely to encounter wild animals such as red squirrels, deer and – with a bit of luck – an eagle. You can go wildlife spotting yourself along the countless footpaths that lead deep into the park, or go on an organised safari or walk with a guide. Fancy something completely different? Not far from the campsite is Royal Lochnagar Distillery, where you can learn all about whisky and sample this ‘water of life’ yourself.

properties.name: Emolahti Camping
properties.description:
Welcome to Emolahti Camping. It's a great place to unwind or be active. The campsite is alongside clear Lake Pyhäjärvi, with a wide sandy beach and plenty of space. On the campsite, you’ll find ‘Sauna Land' with two saunas, a jacuzzi and a large terrace overlooking the lake. And nearby? Plenty of forests, lakes and the E75 to the cities of Jyväskylä (177 km) and Oulu (165 km).

Pitches and cabins

There are large pitches for tents and caravans here; all within walking distance of the beach. Want slightly more luxury? Then choose a cosy cabin for five to ten people, with its own sauna, shower, toilet and fully-equipped kitchen. In the summer, there are also cosy cabins for two to four people. They are close to the central service building with everything you might need. Wherever you stay on the site, you will always be close to the water and in the heart of nature.

Saunas, a restaurant and more

The site itself has everything you might need. Sauna Land has two large saunas and an open-air hot tub for anyone wanting to relax. Are you hungry? In the summer, you can enjoy a buffet of Finnish and international dishes in the café or restaurant every day in the summer.

Things to do?

The wooded surroundings are the perfect place for peace and quiet. The campsite is by a lake, so you can swim, paddle board, canoe and fish here.

properties.name: Slow Village Pornic
properties.description:
You can enjoy a wonderful holiday just three kilometres from the most beautiful beaches in Loire-Atlantique. So visit the family campsite Les Vallons de l'Océan in La-Plaine-sur-Mer! This rural campsite offers everything you need for a relaxing stay on the beautiful Jade Coast.

Spacious pitches

At this large, yet quiet campsite, you will find spacious pitches. There is a lot of difference in height on the campsite, which makes the pitches more private. At the top of the campsite there is a flat area with hedges and trees.

Swimming pool and sea

Whether you like to splash around in the sea or in a pool, you won't have to choose during your holiday at Les Vallons de l'Océan campsite. In the low season you can swim warm and 'dry' thanks to the indoor, heated swimming pool and outdoor pool with slides. Young campers can splash around in the paddling pool. And a day of sun sea and beach is only a ten-minute car drive away.

Something different every day

The entertainment team is on hand daily with fun and varied activities for young and old. From sporting events to magic shows and concerts. Still have some energy left? There is a bouncy castle, a playground, a new miniature golf course, a climbing wall and a multisport field. Animal lovers can pet sheep, goats, cows and alpacas at the mini farm or explore the campsite's educational vegetable garden.

Salads, pizzas and more

The campsite has a bar and a (snack) restaurant. There is also a shop where you can buy fresh rolls and other products daily. In the low season there is a convenient bread service, but you do have to book in advance.

properties.name: Le Ranch
properties.description:
The five star Le Ranch campsite located on the west coast of the Cotentin (Normandy) is beautifully situated by the sea. From the campsite, you can walk straight to the beach! The spacious and sunny pitches are located in the dunes and are separated by low bushes and posts. The sanitary facilities are modern and well-equipped.

Something for everyone

There are two heated swimming pools: one is covered by a retractable, roof and the other has a large slide on which several people can slide down at once. Smaller campers are sure to enjoy the playground, trampolines, and bouncy castles. You can also play a free game of miniature golf with your whole family. Feeling peckish? On the campsite, you will find Le Ranch restaurant, which is decorated in a Western style with wooden elements.

Water sports

The wide sandy beach in front of the door invites you to take endless walks. If you are looking for more adventure, you can also go windsurfing or water skiing. The (public) beach near the Le Ranch campsite is quite popular with surfers because of the high waves. You can also go to sea in a kayak. In Les Pieux, you will find larger supermarkets.

Discover Cotentin on foot

There are numerous hiking trails in the vicinity of the campsite. From the campsite, you can walk a part of the GR223 ‘Sentier des Douaniers’. The trail runs along the coast through a mountainous area and can have some steep climbs at times. But the beautiful nature and views are worth it.

properties.name: Camping Sun Océan
properties.description:
The three-star campsite Sun Océan is located between Les Sables d’Olonne and Jard-sur-Mer, on the outskirts of Talmont-Saint-Hilaire. This authentic medieval village is less than 5 minutes away from the beach. You can stay in a mobile home, a chalet, an Amazone hut or on a spot for your own caravan, motorhome or tent. You are camping here in a dynamic and hospitable region between the Atlantic Ocean and the flatlands of the Vendée.

Neat, well-tended campsite

This is a quiet, not too large campsite with a large number of pitches and a few mobile homes at the far end of the grounds. In short: very well-ordered. The terrain is neat and well maintained. From the reception you have an immediate view of the pitches and the swimming pool surrounded by greenery. The whole campsite makes a calm and laid-back impression as do most of the guests. The pitches are separated from each other by low hedges and shrubs, with many large trees providing shade.

Swimming pool and entertainment for children

At Sun Océan you will find a modest, heated outdoor pool with a separate toddler pool for the little ones. Around the pool you can relax on one of the loungers shaded by sun umbrellas. In peak season there is a shuttle bus to the beach of Veillon (six km). During this period entertainment for children and water aerobics are offered each day. You can keep an eye on the children in the swimming pool from the bar with terrace.

Cooking a meal

The campsite does not have a shop, but there is a Lidl supermarket across the street. You can buy enough ingredients there to whip up a camping meal.

properties.name: Camping Des Familles
properties.description:
In the northern tip of the Médoc peninsula you will find camping Des Familles. This family campsite is just five kilometres from the beach and the Atlantic Ocean. The waves here are ideal for surfers. With a nice swimming pool on the campsite, with spouting animals in the paddling pool, children can also have a good time here.

Camping Des Familles is located in Grayan-et-l'Hôpital. If you arrive on the island from the north, by ferry from Royan, take the D1215 towards the village. From the south, the D101 will take you to the campsite. A side street leads you through trees and bushes to the entrance gate.

Sheltered touring pitches and luxury lodges

On the natural terrain there are about fifty spacious touring pitches. You'll find them between shrubs and under trees, providing shelter and privacy. Of the thirty rental accommodations, the luxury ecolodges are particularly beautiful. They offer you the comfort of private sanitary facilities and an equipped kitchen.

Water fun and kitchen secrets

The heated pool is not that big, but spacious enough for water games. Next to the pool is the paddling pool. In the attractive restaurant you can taste typical French dishes such as duck breast and mussels with fries. But the menu also includes hamburgers and pizza.

Renewed sanitary facilities

To the left of the entrance you will find one of the sanitary buildings. This old building, together with its contents, is in need of renovation. Fortunately, you can also make use of new and neat sanitary facilities in the sanitary block behind the swimming pool. This building is heated by solar panels and is therefore environmentally friendly.

properties.name: Camping Les Peupliers
properties.description:
Les Peupliers campsite is located on the Médoc peninsula, north of Bordeaux. Here you camp ten kilometres from the Atlantic coast. This smaller campsite is a great destination if you're looking for a quiet camping spot. Take a dip in the pool or get on your bike to Montalivet beach.

You will find the campsite on the outskirts of the village of Vendays-Montalivet. During the last kilometers, the high church tower of this village is a nice landmark. From there it is only a short distance to the campsite. The reception is located in a small building where the owners welcome you on their friendly campsite.

Shady campsite

The variety of trees gives the campsite a park-like appearance. The spacious touring pitches are separated by trees and hedges. You can also camp in a mobile home, bungalow or lodge tent. The beautiful swimming pool is located in a sunny area at the entrance to the campsite. There is no separate paddling pool. You can order snacks, pizza or a drink at the pavement café.

Fresh bread

Fresh bread is available at the campsite shop. A large supermarket is almost next to the campsite. A large network of cycling routes has been mapped out around the campsite. Many of these routes lead you through the woods to the beach. The nearest beach is in Montalivet, about ten kilometres from the campsite. It is really suitable for surfing. The market in the centre is also recommendable.

properties.name: Camping Les Maritimes
properties.description:
Camping Les Maritimes is in the French Landes department, only two kilometres from the Atlantic Ocean. You stay in a green, natural environment, which makes it an ideal home base for hikers and cyclists. The campsite has a swimming pool, surf bar and restaurant that serves sumptuous meals. If you would rather cook yourself, the campsite has a Casino supermarket for all your purchases.

Camping in a pine forest

Camping Les Maritimes has both pitches and accommodations. The site has lots of pine trees and consists for the most part of sandy ground. All pitches are spacious, shady and some pitches even have private toilet facilities. You can also stay in a mobile home, chalet or safari tent. These differ in degrees of luxury. There are basic accommodations without separate bedrooms and very luxurious chalets with their own Jacuzzi.

Book a surf lesson

You can cycle to the Atlantic Ocean (2 km), following the bicycle path from the campsite. If you would rather stay at the campsite to swim, there is a swimming pool complex with several swimming pools and a separate section for children. Part of the swimming pool is covered, which means you can swim on rainy days as well. The surf bar next to the swimming pool serves refreshing drinks and takes bookings for surf lessons. If you have no experience, that is not a problem. There are lessons for beginners as well.

Visit Bayonne or cross the Spanish border

The French-Basque city of Bayonne (35 km) is a good destination for a day out. Wander through the narrow streets of the old city centre, admire the impressive cathedral and enjoy the ambiance of the lively markets.

properties.name: Camping Le Colombier
properties.description:
Camping Le Colombier is near the village of Saint-Martin-Lars-en-Sainte-Hermine, in the south of the department of Vendée. This naturist campsite is located on a wonderful quiet location next to a large woods. Space and freedom are the main focus at this well-kept campsite, with several buildings constructed in the style of the local country houses providing an extra ambiance.

Enjoy camping on a roomy pitch

If you want plenty of space around your pitch while on holiday, a stay at a pitch at Camping Le Colombier is definitely recommended. The average size of a pitch here is at least 198 square metres. What’s more, this site is very spacious. You can also book an overnight stay in a large lodge tent or in a mobile home. The accommodations, like the pitches, are distributed over several secluded meadows.

From the swimming pool and wellness facilities to an extensive entertainment programme

This is a holiday address where those seeking peace and quiet are completely at home, but those who love comfort and entertainment have plenty to do as well. Camping Le Colombier has an outdoor swimming pool that is heated. There is even more relaxation in the form of an outdoor Jacuzzi, sauna, Turkish bath and massage and reiki treatments. The campsite has a shop and a charming restaurant with a bar as well.

During the summer holiday, there is a full entertainment programme for the children. Which kind of activities are organised? Well, think of colouring contests, crafts hours, ghost tours and swimming exercises. For adult campsite guests, the jeu-de-boule tournaments and the music evenings are fun.

properties.name: Camping des Landes d'Armagnac
properties.description:
Camping des Landes d'Armagnac is located in a forest with oak trees and pines. Guests who come here love nature, tranquillity, and appreciate fine food and wine. The region you are in, Landes, is renowned for its rich gastronomy. The campsite is located just under three kilometres from the tiny village of Saint-Justin, where you will find a few shops (bakery, supermarket). You might think that this campsite is more suitable for couples without children but nothing could be further from the truth. The swimming pool and play equipment are guaranteed to provide entertainment to children of all ages.

Pitch under the trees or in the sun

You choose your own pitch and depending on the amount of shade you prefer, you choose a spot in the sun or underneath the pines or oak trees. The grass surface and the hedges provides the required privacy.

Everything is very neatly maintained: not just the greenery, but also the swimming pool and sanitary facilities. The rental accommodation (caravans, bungalows and mobile homes) are located separately from the camping pitches. 

Things to do around here

There is a cheerful swimming pool measuring some 110 m2. This is located in full sun. Around the pool is a strip of greenery and a generous terrace with loungers and sun umbrellas. The bar and restaurant are adjacent to this. There is also a small lake on the campsite, in which angling is freely allowed.

A varied environment

The campsite is ideally located for day trips to Bordeaux, Lourdes, Biarritz or Mimizan. Or hop on your bike and discover all kinds of interesting medieval villages. Another advantage of cycling: there are numerous Armagnac distilleries close to the campsite where you can buy and taste this drink.

properties.name: Camping Uhaitza-Le Saison
properties.description:
In the southern French Pyrénées-Atlantiques lies the small-scale Camping Uhaitza-Le Saison. Here you will be camping in the forest, by the river Saison and close to the giant mountains of the Pyrenees. Relax on the pebble beach, dive into the pool or take beautiful trips from the campsite. Charming towns, castles and the Spanish border are only a short distance away. Choose a pleasant pitch in the shade or opt for a rental.

A beautiful arrival

At Camping Uhaitza-Le Saison, you will be camping in the French Basque Country, the precursor to the Pyrenees. The campsite is situated beautifully between a mountain and a valley, directly by the River Saison. The most beautiful spots even have a view of the water. On the way to the campsite, the view is already worth the effort. After all, you are in the middle of unspoilt nature here.

When you arrive, you will see that the reception is also the bar, the recreation room and the owners' home. After a warm welcome, you can drive down a large avenue towards your pitch. The many different types of trees and the river that lies below are striking. The sites are well cared for, spacious and delineated with plenty of greenery and flowering plants. You can also rent a mobile home or bungalow here!

Facilities on the campsite

Back from a nice day out or done with swimming in the river? Then take a dip in the outdoor pool! Don't worry about food; thanks to the snack bar, there's always something tasty to eat. The same goes for the morning, when you can enjoy freshly baked bread.

properties.name: Camping Plein Soleil
properties.description:
Just north of the pilgrimage site of Lourdes, Camping Plein Soleil has a very central location. Several restaurants and shops can be found within a few minutes walk of this green terraced campsite. The excellent bus connection with the centre of Lourdes makes the compact campsite an ideal base for a city visit.

Flat pitches

You camp here on flat, marked out pitches that are divided over three terraces. Some pitches have more surrounding vegetation than others, but they are all well kept. The pitches are situated on the higher ground where you will be treated to a panoramic view of the surrounding hills and mountains. The mobile homes and wooden chalets for rent are situated at the back of the campsite.

Heated swimming pool

The rectangular pool is located at the entrance and has a transparent sliding cover. In bad weather, the pool can be covered and thanks to the heated water, it stays at a nice temperature. Around the pool you will find some deckchairs and a small children's pool.

Indoor and outdoor fun

For children there is a playground with swings and slides. Inside, in the recreation room, there is a pool table, pinball machine and a dartboard. There is also a terrace near the reception where you can have a drink.

On your bike

Even if you have not brought your own bike, you can discover the surroundings by bike. There are various bicycles for rent at the campsite. Take a look at the lake of Lourdes for example. Mountain bike tours through the Pyrenees are a popular activity in this area.

properties.name: Camping Huttopia Les Falaises - Normandie
properties.description:
In Saint-Pierre-en-Port, a small coastal village in Normandy, you will find the quiet campsite Huttopia Les Falaises - Normandie. This campsite is situated near the sea (a 500 m walk). There are two footpaths leading to the chalk cliffs (‘falaises’), which rise proudly and majestically from the pebble beach. Each pitch on the campsite offers a splendid view of the sea and beach. Motorhomes and caravans over 7.5 metres in length are not accepted at this campsite.

Camping on uncluttered grounds

The camping terrain is uncluttered, quiet and open. It consists of an older and a newer section. The camping pitches on the newer section are fairly spacious and are the most beautiful sites. Hedges and shrubs around the rows are mainly found in the older section. This is the place to be when you prefer more privacy. There are two sanitary blocks, one of which is equipped for families and the disabled. The rental accommodation units of Camping Huttopia Les Falaises - Normandie look attractive.

To the beach and the chalk cliffs

You have a sea view from every angle on the campsite. You can follow the footpath from the reception, but it is quite steep. You can also go via the village, a less steep route, to get to the pebble beach by car. The sea is suitable for swimming, provided you like a pebble beach.

Eating and drinking

In Saint-Pierre-en-Port itself you will find a number of shops, a bakery and a butchery. On the campsite you can order pizzas and fresh bread.

properties.name: Camping municipal du Val de Sarthe
Camping Le Domaine du Bois Coquet
properties.description:
Campsite Le Domaine du Bois Coquet can be found hidden in the heart of the Périgord Noir, close to the village of La Douze. This small-scale campsite is an ideal spot for those who want to escape the busyness of daily life and are looking for rest, nature and a charming atmosphere.

Space and privacy

A small gravel road in a green setting will take you to the site, where you will immediately notice the spacious layout. The pitches are spacious and enclosed by high hedges, giving you your own private space. Those travelling without their own camping equipment can choose from various accommodations, including cottages, lodge tents and mobile homes.

Sustainable camping experience

The campsite was set up with respect for nature. The owners are in love with the Dordogne and have applied themselves to a sustainable camping experience. Car-free camping, water-saving facilities and energy-efficient measures such as low-energy light bulbs and a heat pump for the swimming pool water are only a few of the green initiatives at the campsite.

Fun things to do

Le Domaine du Bois Coquet is very suitable for families with young children. There is a great swimming pool, a playground and even a bouncy castle. There are also athletic fields and fun games like table tennis and jeu de boules. The small petting zoo with its sheep, goats, guinea pigs, pigs and ducks is extra fun. These animals are cared for with a great deal of love and offer both children and adults the opportunity to learn more about farming living.

properties.name: Camping Les Bö-Bains
properties.description:
Camping Les Bö-Bains is in an ideal location in the south of the Dordogne region, just outside the village of Badefols-sur-Dordogne. This attractive family campsite is a good starting point for fun excursions in the multi-faceted Dordogne. There’s always plenty to do in high season. Facilities include two outdoor swimming pools, a varied entertainment programme, a restaurant, a shop and sports and play facilities.

Modern accommodation and large touring pitches

The main emphasis is on accommodation at this four-star campsite. There are modern mobile homes and chalets, located on spacious, shaded plots. There are also several dozen shaded camping pitches, which are also large. Many of the accommodation options and touring pitches are alongside the river Dordogne and have unobstructed views of the water.

Plenty of fun in the high season

There’s plenty to do at the campsite in high season in particular. Take a refreshing dip in the two outdoor pools, for example. Meanwhile, the youngest campers can have fun in the paddling pool or doing the fun games and sports activities organised by the entertainment team. In summer, the restaurant and adjoining bar are open. Enjoy a tasty meal and then hang around to catch a live music performance, a karaoke session or a dance night.

What can you do in the area?

A holiday in the Dordogne always includes varied excursions and day trips. The region has a lot to offer nature lovers, who enjoy walking or cycling along the river or through wooded hills. There are also various cave systems nearby. The Grottes de Maxange are closest to the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Terme d'Astor
properties.description:
Camping Terme d'Astor is in the heart of the Dordogne, amid the green hills and forests. This naturist campsite is a haven of peace, where you can enjoy the surroundings, large camping pitches and atmospheric facilities. From cosy caravan sites to luxury chalets, there’s something for everyone. The campsite is also close to historic villages and impressive castles, ideal for cultural trips.

Large pitches

You will feel at home at Camping Terme d'Astor straight away thanks to the spacious and well-appointed pitches. Whether you choose a spot in or on the edge of the woods, each pitch is private. If you want extra comfort, opt for fully-equipped luxury chalets and mobile homes. With the freedom to select your arrival and departure days, relax and avoid stressful travel days.

Swimming pool, whirlpool and sauna

The swimming pool is central to the campsite and is perfect for a refreshing dip. There’s also a whirlpool and sauna for ultimate relaxation.
