The restaurant and bar are a focal point and the place to enjoy tasty meals and cosy evenings by the fire. Sports and music lovers will enjoy everything from sports events on the big screen to communal activities in the bar.

History and culinary delights

Explore medieval towns like Monpazier and Sarlat, or visit the impressive castles of Castelnaud and Beynac alongside the river. This region is also known for its culinary delights, including truffles and walnuts. You can take beautiful nature walks in the Périgord region, part of the Dordogne.

properties.name: Camping Des Bastides
properties.description:
This is one of those campsites where you really wake up to the sound of birds singing. Indeed, this campsite is far removed from urban hectic. It is located in a wooded area, on a hill near the village of Salles (Lot-et-Garonne).

At Camping Des Bastides you will enjoy a beautiful outdoor swimming pool, large camping pitches, a good restaurant and modern sanitary facilities. There is a varied entertainment programme in high season.

Book a large camping pitch or an authentic yurt

The camping pitches are spacious and neatly delineated. So you can enjoy plenty of privacy in a green ambiance. In addition to camping pitches, the campsite rents out various types of accommodation, such as lodge tents and mobile homes. You can also spend the night in a traditional yurt.

Water fun and light therapy in the beautiful aquapark

At the front of the site is a rectangular outdoor pool, where you can enjoy swimming your laps. In an adjacent area, there is a separate pool where the spectacular water slide ends. This water park also has a large paddling pool with, among other things, a cheerful mushroom fountain.

Varied entertainment programme in high season

During the summer months, this campsite offers all kinds of fun activities for the whole family. You can take part in the weekly bingo as well as football, basketball and boules tournaments. In the evening, there is regular live music.

This campsite has a pleasant restaurant open all year round. Here you can enjoy both a tasty lunch and a delicious evening meal. Right next to the swimming pool there is also a cafeteria. Here you can order ice creams, snacks, cheese boards and delicious cocktails.

properties.name: Camping Mun. du Pont de Pierre
Village Camping Les Vignes
properties.description:
Peace and friendliness are the key words that apply to camping Les Vignes. The grounds are situated in an idyllic setting amidst sloping vineyards and by a meandering river. Camping guests from all corners of the world pitch their tents or caravans here on the spacious pitches with filtered sunlight. There are ample swimming, play and sports opportunities for all.

Idyllic setting

The first impression on arrival is certainly idyllic; this is a park-like setting with a view of the rolling hills. The sunlight is filtered by the leafy trees.

Shaded camping pitches

The pitches are very spacious, with shade from the green foliage and a view of the beautiful surrounds. The spacious pitches ensure ample privacy. Bordering the campsite is a small bungalow park. There are various types of guests on the campsite: families, couples and senior citizens.

Swimming in the swimming pool or the river

The swimming pool has a classic shape and is in a sunny spot, so that the water temperature is nice and warm. At a distance of some 100 m you will find the (private) beaches, with nearby restaurant-bar. Ideal for swimming, fishing, boating and more. The restaurant has a beautiful wooden canopy construction and can be closed off with perspex wall segments. You can also rent canoes near the water. The campsite shares some of the lovely playground equipment, a large playing field and the tennis court with the adjacent bungalow park.

Restaurant with limited menu

The small shop stocks basic necessities, but for other groceries you will have to go to the Intermarché, located on a through road. The restaurant has a limited menu.

properties.name: Village des Bons-Hommes Le Pré-Cathare
properties.description:
You can't get much further south in France than this: Camping Village des Bons-Hommes le Pré-Cathare in Lavelanet is a 90-minute drive from Toulouse and two-hours from Andorra. This campsite in the Land of the Cathars was named after the Christian movement from the 12th and 13th centuries. The campsite is committed to sustainable tourism and has an organic kitchen garden. Visit Toulouse (111 km) or the beautiful village of Saint-Lizier (71 km).

For walkers and cycling enthusiasts

This campsite at the foot of the Pyrenees exudes peace and quiet. You have spectacular views of that mountain and Montségur Castle from the demarcated pitches. There are 11 camping pitches and various accommodation for disabled campers. There are also various standard mobile homes.

There are also special pitches for long-distance walkers. The campsite is on the GR7 long-distance walking trail and 6 kilometres from GR107. That makes Village des Bons-Hommes perfect for a stop off. There is a special overnight rate for campers who come to the campsite by bike or walking.

Enjoy organic tastiness

A brand-new swimming pool was installed at the campsite in 2022. This semi-Olympic swimming pool of 25 by 12 metres is open in July and August. That also applies to the snack bar and the shop with regional products. Camping Village des Bons-Hommes is committed to sustainable tourism. There is a small farm with organic kitchen garden, pigs and free-range chickens. Furthermore, they promote activities in the surrounding area, such as (long-distance) walks, cycling, horse riding.

properties.name: Camping Le Haut Salat
properties.description:
In the beautiful Midi-Pyrénées, near the town of Seix, lies the French Le Haut Salat Campsite. Enjoy the sun, the mountains and the Salat River in the so-called gateway to the Pyrenees. Here you will camp five hundred meters above sea level with breathtaking views. A wonderful base for a relaxing or sporting holiday - whatever you feel like.

Beautiful route to your camping spot

Take the A64 toward Saint-Girons, a pleasant route to drive. Fun fact for in the car: this road is regularly used by the cyclists of the Tour de France. The campsite is hidden behind some green space but is still easy to find. And although you are in the mountains, the campsite is nice and flat.

A long driveway takes you to the reception area, located next to the heated pool. This is located between a playing field and the bar. The available pitches are spacious and surrounded by a hedge. The deciduous trees provide the necessary shade. Don't have your own camping equipment? There are several types of rental accommodations available at Le Haut Salat Campsite.

Grab a bite

Didn't manage to fish a trout out of the Salat? Or would you just prefer something else? With a snack bar and pizzeria, there is always a tasty snack to be had! You can also enjoy fresh bread every morning. The children can have fun on the playground or the sports field before dinner. Take a walk to the village of Seix or ask reception about the beautiful bicycle routes in the area.

properties.name: Camping Le Bois de la Justice
Camping Les Prés Onlycamp
properties.description:
Camping Les Prés is located in a wooded area in the heart of France near Grez-sur-Loing. The historic town centre is within walking distance and a river runs alongside the peaceful campsite.

The île-de-France region is centrally located, southwest of Paris. Just 10 minutes from Les Prés campsite is the town of Fontainebleau with its castle of the same name in the forest. This area is world famous among climbers who come to practise on the immense boulders. Nature lovers and those looking for peace and quiet as well as hikers and cyclists will enjoy themselves here. Campers can cool down in the river surrounded by beautiful trees. In addition, the volleyball field invites sports enthusiasts to play a game.

Camping near Fontainebleau

From Fontainebleau it is only a short drive on the D607 before you arrive at the quiet campsite. Immediately, a spacious feeling dominates. The reception building has a recognisable flat roof and there you will meet the young owners of the campsite. Climbers like to stay at this campsite because of the 'boulders' where the training takes place. For children there is a small playground and in the river you can paddle. The bakery and a small supermarket are within walking distance in Grez-sur-Loing.

Choose a lovely pitch

The campsite has many beautiful spots that are all spacious. Some are situated in an open field, others along neat little streets with lots of greenery. A special field has been set up for tent campers who want to enjoy the simplicity of camping without electricity. The sanitary facilities are adequate, but are in need of renovation.

properties.name: Camping Goudal
properties.description:
Camping Goudal is a charming campsite in the forested countryside of Languedoc-Rousillon. Here, you wake up to fresh baguettes, croissants and pains au chocolat, after which you can play outside, swim and build sandcastles endlessly. The surrounding area is quiet but there is plenty to do for people who like peace, adventurers and families with children.

Warm welcome

You are welcomed by the enthusiastic Belgian owners, who like to keep the campsite natural and welcome guests of all nationalities. During the high season, it is mainly families with young children who camp here. In the low season, mainly seniors and couples without children come here to enjoy the quiet camping life. Camping Goudal also offers chalets and furnished tents as accommodation options.

Jump in the swimming pool or the lake

With a natural lake and a swimming pool measuring 100 m2, there is no lack of water fun here. The sandy beach is a lovely place for relaxing, and children can get into the water on a slide. When you've finished swimming, join in with activities organised by the entertainment team or grab a seat on Bistro Goudal's lovely patio. In the high season, you can enjoy pizzas from the stone oven, mussels with chips, boeuf bourguignon and much more at the Bistro!

Excursions

Camping Goudal is ideal for those seeking quiet but who also like to go on excursions without the bustle of mass tourism. There are stunning walking and mountain bike routes in the immediate vicinity. You can go to the sea for day (90 km), explore the Minervois wine region (70 km) or visit the picturesque medieval village of Minerve (55.5 km).

properties.name: Camping Du Riuferrer
properties.description:
In lovely quiet surroundings, within walking distance of the centre of Arles-sur-Tech, is Camping Du Riuferrer. This campsite is named after the babbling river on which it is located, the Riuferrer. This is a tributary of the Tech, a larger river flanked by the forested mountains of the eastern French Pyrenees. It is therefore a great area for hiking, cycling and mountain biking. On the campsite itself, there are sports and play facilities and regular fun activities for the whole family.

Friendly family campsite with beautiful natural pitches

A wooded camping area surrounds the reception, although there are also open spaces for sun worshippers. The pitches are located on unpaved paths and blend nicely into the landscape. As a result, they are all different shapes and sizes. The pitches are separated by bushes, trees and large boulders. You can also rent a comfortable mobile home for two to six people.

Fun activities and two swimming facilities

On the other side of the river, a few hundred metres' walk away, is Arles' municipal swimming pool. This large outdoor pool is open in summer and as a campsite guest you can swim here at a discount. Lover of natural water? Then go paddling in the shallow waters of the Riuferrer. The campsite also organises regular activities such as boules tournaments, karaoke, cabaret shows and bingo. There are also often entertaining theme nights. Specially for children, there are face painting sessions, balloon sculpture workshops, bouncy castles and magic shows.

properties.name: Camping Les Bords du Tarn
properties.description:
Just enjoy the camping experience or explore the campsite and vicinity, the choice is yours on Camping Les Bords du Tarn. Tourism is limited here and the nature is both challenging and relaxing. The campsite Les Bords du Tarn has a playful layout and provides spacious and sheltered pitches close to the water.

Sheltered campsite by the river

The campsite grounds are nicely sheltered, with spacious, beautiful pitches directly by the river. The reception is housed in a slightly older building with a small shop. Heading for your pitch, you will see a clean and spacious terrain with playfully laid out sites. Apart from the camping fields, there are a number of mobile homes and rental caravans. Every now and then there are organised activities, fun for young and old.

Swimming paradise

There are two new swimming pools, creating a lovely play paradise for children. The heated swimming pools are well laid out. You can also hire canoes from the campsite. The river's pebble beach runs the entire length of the campsite and is easily accessible. There is also a section with a sandy beach.

Clean sanitary facilities

The campsite has a small shop which stocks a few necessities. The small town of Le Rozier is within walking distance and you can do your additional shopping at the local Spar. The sanitary facilities are new and are kept neat and clean. There is more than sufficient sanitary capacity, even when the campsite is fully booked.

Challenging surroundings

This campsite forms an ideal base to explore the Tarn by kayak. Also fun: explore the adventurous surroundings and visit picturesque villages, gorges, plateaus and caves.

properties.name: Camping Huttopia Gorges du Tarn
properties.description:
The Huttopia Gorges du Tarn campsite is within walking distance of the typical French village of Les Vignes. From the campsite you overlook the river Tarn. The campsite offers pitches with stunning views over the river and the mountains. It is also possible to rent a chalet, mobile home or tent. At the campsite you can use the swimming pool or spend a day at the private beach by the river. In high season the staff pays a lot of attention to entertainment for young and old.

Diversified camping

The campsite offers pitches for tents, campers or caravans. The pitches are laid out on terraces throughout the campsite. You can choose a pitch overlooking the mountains, a shady pitch under oak trees or a pitch near the water. There you can enjoy the view over the river Tarn. It is also possible to book rental accommodation. There is a choice of chalets, mobile homes and Toile & Bois tents.

Private beach

For a day of relaxation you can go to the campsite's swimming pool. Here you have a beautiful view of the mountains. From the campsite you have direct access to the river Tarn. There is also a private beach. There is no hustle and bustle of canoes here, just relax and unwind. The children can also play safely.

Entertainment for everyone

In high season, children can participate in activities every morning. They build huts and go on a treasure hunt. New on the campsite is the possibility of renting electric mountain bikes! Make sporty trips and discover the surroundings. The campsite also organises daytime activities. For example, a day on the zip line or beautiful hikes. Furthermore, sometimes a night walk is organised. In the summer you can participate once a week in authentic wood games. The evenings with live music are very popular.

Roulotte-Snack

Next to the swimming pool is the terrace, where you can relax a bit. In the Roulotte-Snack you have a choice of simple but delicious dishes. Every morning you can enjoy fresh bread. Just place your order the night before! Not enough luxury yet? You can also opt for a full breakfast: tea, coffee, juice, sandwiches and croissants.

properties.name: Camping de L'Arche
properties.description:
The campsite exudes a very luxurious atmosphere when you arrive. The stylish reception building looks chic and is managed by a friendly French couple. The entire campsite is extremely well cared for with spacious, beautifully located pitches.

A place to come back to

The lawns are spacious and are partly shaded. In high season there are many families with children, some of them returning regularly. In low season many senior citizens enjoy their stay here.

Swimming between the rocks

There are many amenities as sports fields, a luxury outdoor and indoor swimming pool and a playground for the little ones. The river Gard runs along the campsite. You can jump in the water from the rocks and swim in the recesses of the rocks. In the meantime the steam train chugs along above you.

Dining in style

The shop is well-stocked. The restaurant, with comprehensive menu, is tastefully decorated and is in a beautiful setting. Especially in low season it is lovely to sit around the fireplace.

It is obvious that the sanitary facilities near the pool have recently been renewed; they are modern and kept very clean.

With the steam train or to the bamboo forest

You can make a trip to Saint Jean de Gard with the steam train which runs along the campsite. Furthermore, a trip to the mountain or a day at the sea are a must. The nearby bamboo forest is very nice to visit.

properties.name: Camping Le Sainte Marie
properties.description:
In the heart of the Pyrenees-Orientales you will find Camping Le Sainte Marie. You camp in a flowery forest, on spacious pitches under high trees. And the campsite is only one kilometre from the beach. Dive into the sea or the large swimming pool on the campsite. The children can splash and play or slide down the slides. There is also a nice children's farm.

Spacious pitches in green surroundings

Have you checked in at the friendly reception? Then you can make your way to your pitch. A wide, paved road brings you to your spot for this holiday. The pitches are situated under tall trees. They are spacious with plenty of shade. Hedges, flowers and shrubs demarcate them. All this greenery gives the campsite a soothing appearance.

Running and jumping with holiday friends

Your children will have no trouble finding holiday friends at this campsite. There are many play areas for young and old. See them run and play football on the sports fields. And they can jump all day on the bouncy castles and trampolines. And of course, there are also many organised activities at this family camp site. In the mini club, the little ones can do crafts and cook together. For you, this is the moment to enjoy a nice swim in the pool.

Large and playful swimming pools

The large swimming pool is in the middle of the campsite, near the restaurant. For a refreshing dive or an hour of swimming, this pool is ideal. But there is a surprise waiting for you ... Cross the footbridge to the new swimming area.

properties.name: Camping Bellevue
properties.description:
The quiet and small-scale campsite of Bellevue is located in the hilly and forested Belgian Ardennes, along the Meuse river and the Voie Verte, an 80 km-long cycling route. The small town of Fumay, with its shops and places to eat, is located 1 km away. The camping pitches are 80 to 100 m2 and are separated by hedges. The pitches along the Meuse are not marked. There are relatively few trees on the campsite grounds.

The campsite shop offers the essential groceries, as well as fresh bread on weekdays. Here, you will come across mostly Dutch and French fishing enthusiasts, hikers and cyclists.

Green cycling route

The campsite is often used by cyclists who follow the car-free cycling route along the Meuse from Givet, which is located along the Belgian border, to Charleville-Mézières. The 80 km-long green 'Voie Verte' cycling route is almost entirely flat. Horseback riders and skaters often use this route as well. The campsite is situated approximately halfway along the route. A set of train tracks runs parallel to the route, so you can catch the train back at one of the stations.

You can also follow the marked hiking trails leading from the campsite, which are also suitable for novice hikers. The campsite also features a table tennis table, a sports field and a boules court.

Climbing and jumping

On the other side of the Meuse is a starting point for paragliding, which gives you a fine view of paragliders launching from the mountain and landing near the campsite. Camping Bellevue is located in a beautiful landscape with plenty of slate rock, and there are various old slate quarries. In TerrAltitude park, you will find climbing routes, climbing towers which are five or eight metres high, and paintball facilities.

properties.name: Camping Huttopia Meursault
properties.description:
Vast vineyards everywhere; yes, the view from the Huttopia Meursault campsite is magnificent. This peaceful campsite is located north of Meursault, the centre of Burgundy wines. Your camping pitch is the ideal base for trips to the many wine cellars in the area. And between Dijon and Santenay there is the Route des Grands Crus, a sixty-kilometre route past countless wineries.

Camping between the vineyards

You will receive a warm welcome at this recently refurbished campsite. Are you bringing your own tent, camper or caravan? Then book one of the spacious pitches on this terraced campsite. Here you can enjoy the beautiful view over the vineyards. But you can also stay in one of the new accommodations, including fully equipped chalets, lodge tents and gypsy caravans.

A good glass of wine

Do you prefer breakfast with a fresh croissant and a glass of orange juice? Then you are in luck, because you can order it from the Huttopia Meursault campsite. After a delicious breakfast you can take a refreshing dip in the pool. Or enjoy a game of table football in the meeting room. In the afternoon, it's time for a drink or an ice cream in the new restaurant. In the evening, you can enjoy a good meal with a glass of wine.

Stopover in Beaune

If you pass Beaune on your way to the campsite, be sure to make a stop here. There are some wonderful buildings; especially the Hospices de Beaune, a former poor people’ hospital, is remarkable. The roofs of the buildings are decorated with turrets and the roof tiles are laid in special patterns. You can also find several large supermarkets here.

properties.name: Camping La Buissière
properties.description:
Camping La Buissière is a quiet and friendly family campsite near the authentic town of Barjac (in the Gard department). The campsite is located amidst green surroundings. Camping or glamping? You can choose from a spacious camping pitch or one of the accommodations. At the campsite, you can relax by the pool. For those with a craving, a snack bar is located at the campsite.

Camping between trees

Camping La Buissière has a sloping and extensive campsite with many different types of trees. The campsite offers spacious pitches with a hard surface and plenty of privacy. Do you like glamping? Then at this campsite, you can also choose a mobile home or a fully equipped lodge tent.

Swimming fun for the entire family

Camping La Buissière is ideally located for holidaymakers who want to unwind in nature. But there is also plenty to do here for action lovers. In the surrounding area, there are many beautiful walking and cycling routes. And water lovers can kayak and canoe on the local rivers.

The pool at the campsite is a lot quieter. You'll also find a toddler pool. Taking a break? On the sun terrace by the pool, you can sunbathe and relax. After spending a day swimming and sunbathing, you can freshen up in the shower at the campsite sanitary facilities.

Fun away from the pool

On dry land, there is also plenty to enjoy. You can play table tennis or volleyball, and there is also a petanque court. In addition, the children have been well provided for with various play equipment, a trampoline and a kids' club (in the high season).

properties.name: Capfun Camping La Bastide
properties.description:
Does a holiday full of water recreation, culture and entertainment in the South of France sound like music to your ears? Then Capfun's La Bastide Campsite may be your ideal holiday destination. Especially if you enjoy staying in a beautiful mobile home. Water recreation abounds thanks to the waterpark with waterslides and the Mediterranean Sea just a half an hour's drive away. And there is always something to do at this campsite during the summer holidays. The campsite is located on the edge of the historic city of Nîmes, known for its impressive amphitheatre.

Luxury mobile homes

This campsite mainly offers rental accommodations. There are more than 230 beautiful mobile homes for rent in a range of sizes - for example, for four to six people. Some mobile homes can even accommodate ten people. The mobile homes all feature air conditioning, a dishwasher and a television. You are in the right place for a comfortable stay.

Waterpark with four slides

Is your holiday incomplete without a beautiful waterpark? Then you will certainly enjoy yourself at this campsite. With several heated outdoor pools, paddling pools, and no less than four waterslides, guests of all ages are guaranteed to enjoy plenty of water recreation. One of the slides is even a so-called 'Space Bowl' in which you spin around. Part of the pool can be covered with a sliding roof.

Half an hour to the sea

Would you also like to enjoy a dip in the Mediterranean Sea? You can get there in no time from the campsite! You can drive to the famous coastal town of Aigues-Mortes in about half an hour and to La Grande-Motte in 45 minutes.

properties.name: Camping du Herisson Relais de l'Eventail
Camping Les 7 Laux
properties.description:
This green campsite is located in the heart of the French Alps, at an altitude of at least 650 metres. It is uniquely situated in the Belledonne mountain range, near the cities of Grenoble and Chambéry. Here you can enjoy rugged nature, a picturesque view of the mountains and the best hiking trails, all within easy reach. Les 7 Laux Campsite is a small-scale campsite with nice facilities. You'll be camping on a higher plateau in a popular skiing area. This means you can enjoy pure nature with all kinds of outdoor activities nearby, such as cycling, climbing and even paragliding.

Camping in the French Alps

Prepare yourself for the unique location of this campsite. As you drive through the most beautiful landscapes of the department of Isère, south of the town of Theys, you'll notice the campsite slowly approaching. You'll soon arrive at a classic reception building that fits in well with its surroundings. The new and enthusiastic owners, Michel and Monique, offer you a well-maintained campsite with a relaxed atmosphere. Not too big, with lots of trees, a lovely swimming pool and a nice bar.

Among the deciduous trees

Mountain enthusiasts, nature lovers and peace seekers will all find a wonderful holiday spot here. The 55 spacious camping pitches are spread over one of the four gently sloping terraces.

The sanitary facilities are cleaned regularly, so they always look neat. Be sure to bring some thick pajamas with you, because at night it cools down quite a bit here. Those who prefer to spend the night in a different way can book a nice gypsy wagon, a dome (wooden igloo) with private bathroom or one of the beautiful chalets.

properties.name: Au Tylo Soleil
properties.description:
Stay overnight in green surroundings between the Luberon mountain range and the Durance river. Here in the Alpes-de-Haute-Provence there is plenty of beauty to admire. Camping Sites & Paysages Au Tylo Soleil is the ideal home base for visits to beautiful fields of lavender or a daytrip to the Gorges du Verdon. The campsite is close to the Forcalquier (6.5 km).

Swimming in the new swimming pool

Owners Loïc and Thierry took over the campsite in 2021. The campsite is now called Au Tylo Soleil Camping instead of Camping l’Eau Vive. The enthusiastic owners have fixed up various parts of the campsite. There is a new covered heated swimming pool, the AquaZen and AquaFun areas have new water slides, and the terrace has been renovated. The snack bar, brasserie and pizzeria complete the picture.

Enjoy your holiday or work remotely?

Are you going on holiday with a caravan or motorhome? The pitches here are spacious, being at least 100 m2. The comfort pitches are even larger than 100 m2 and the premium pitches have their own water supply and drainage. If you would rather rent an accommodation, this campsite has good standard and comfort mobile homes.

Sporty or relaxed

At Au Tylo Soleil you will find a relaxation area, a supermarket, a bar and a restaurant. The campsite also has a special chalet set up with a beauty salon. If you would rather do something sporty, practice your strokes at the miniature golf course, join the aqua gym class or go on a guided hike.

properties.name: Camping Les Granges Bas
properties.description:
Camping Les Granges Bas is a relatively simple, but beautiful campsite in the commune of Gérardmer, in the heart of the Vosges. The campsite is located two kilometres from the lake of Gérardmer. Boats, canoes and pedalos are used often here, and it is also possible to swim and fish. The campsite itself has a playground, table tennis table, boules pitch and tennis court.

A well-maintained campsite

Les Granges Bas campsite is located on a slope. You camp on well-kept lawns, separated by hedges or bushes. There are also several trees, nice for some shade. The smallest pitches are almost 100 m2 , the largest up to 160 m2. Many of the pitches have a beautiful view of the wooded hills that surround Les Granges Bas campsite. The campsite has ample sanitary facilities.

Are you here without camping equipment? In that case, you can stay in a mobile home, flat or lodge tent (without sanitary facilities). The mobile homes are suitable for two to six people, so larger families are also more than welcome.

For nature lovers and sports enthusiasts

This campsite is not brimming with entertainment, but it doesn't need to be. Listening to the birds in the sun in such a beautiful natural environment is also a treat. With a tennis court, table tennis table and boules pitch, there is plenty to do for sports enthusiasts. Children can burn off energy in the playground. In case of bad weather, the recreation room with television offers a solution.

In the winter, the more active people can also be found here. After all, you are camping close to a large winter sports area (located fifteen kilometres away). Skiing and cross-country skiing are favourites.

properties.name: Capfun Camping Les Fuvettes
properties.description:
This green campsite is located in the French department of Doubs near the town of Malbuisson. The campsite is located just a few kilometres from the border with Switzerland and near the Jura Mountains. Capfun Camping Les Fuvettes is a good base for a camping vacation in the mountains. The campsite lies directly on the lake and has two swimming pools. The entertainment team organises activities for all ages.

Accommodation rental

Capfun Camping Les Fuvettes has 54 touring pitches. There are also rental accommodations at the campsite. Sleep in a luxury mobile home with private bathroom and enjoy a wonderful vacation with modern conveniences.

Fun in the water

Water lovers will never be bored at Capfun Camping Les Fuvettes. The campsite has not one but two pools. Race down the spectacular slides in the outdoor pool, or enjoy swimming in the open air. When the weather isn’t so great, you can use the indoor pool. Do you prefer to swim in open water? You can do that, too. The campsite is located directly on Lake Saint Point, where you can also swim.

Camping entertainment

At the campsite, activities are organised for children of all ages. Six days a week, the youngest children are welcome at the kids club. Twice a week, there are activities for teens up to 17 years of age. For adults, there are activities such as aqua gym and sports tournaments. Three nights a week, there is an evening program with various activities.

properties.name: Camping du lac de Remoray
properties.description:
Camping du lac de Remoray is situated in the village of Labergement-Sainte-Marie in the French Jura, at an altitude of around 870 metres. The campsite borders the nature reserve surrounding Lac de Remoray and is set in peaceful, green area. Thanks to its lakeside location and the surrounding countryside, this is an ideal spot for those seeking peace and quiet, as well as hikers and cyclists who are keen to explore the Jura at a leisurely pace.

Camp by the water

All pitches are on grass, suitable for tents, caravans or motorhomes. The camping pitches are spacious, easily accessible and all situated close to the lake. The rental accommodation is located slightly further from the lake and is also situated at a higher elevation. This allows you to enjoy greater privacy and a view over the campsite and the lake.

Sports and games

Camping du lac de Remoray is a smaller campsite where the focus is on peace and quiet and experiencing nature. The owners have deliberately opted for a minimalist approach: no entertainment and no swimming pool, but a peaceful setting where you can fully enjoy the mountains and nature of the Haut-Jura Regional Nature Park.

But this is certainly not a boring campsite. There is a multi-sports pitch, a gym, and a playground and recreation area for the children. For a refreshing dip, you can jump into the lake. Sports and music events are also regularly organised nearby.

Nature at your feet

Various walking routes start from the campsite. An accessible route is the path around Lac de Remoray, with views of both lakes. The route around Lac de Saint-Point also takes you past woods, meadows and the water.

properties.name: Camping De l'Iscle de Prelles
properties.description:
This campsite is located in a beautiful, wooded area in the south of France. You'll be camping at the Camping l’Iscle de Prelles campsite on the banks of the Durance River. Everywhere you look, you will see imposing mountains. The campsite is close to Prelles and seven kilometres from the town of Briançon. Here, you are five minutes from the Serre Chevalier winter sports area. The campsite is open from mid-December through to the end of September.

A large, shady campsite

The campsite has a spacious feel. The pitches are sufficiently large and shaded. Because the grounds are naturally landscaped, the camping pitches vary in size. Camping De l’Iscle de Prelles has pitches for tents, caravans and motor homes. All camping pitches are close to the river.

A special stay

In addition to camping pitches, this campsite also has a nice selection of accommodations. How about a real Finnish kota? The most luxurious kota has a wood-fired Scandinavian bath and an Italian shower. In addition, De l’Iscle de Prelles has chalets and mobile homes. The mobile homes are available for rent in the spring and summer, and the chalets can be booked throughout the season.

Enjoy yourself in the sun

This family campsite is very suitable for sports enthusiasts. In summer, take a dip in the heated pool. It feels so good in the sun! Would you rather go fishing in the river? The Durance can be reached by a path. Also worthwhile: follow the path along the river to get to Prelles. There is plenty for the whole family to do at the campsite. Think playgrounds, miniature golf, ping pong tables and a volleyball court.

properties.name: Camping Domaine de l'Ubaye
properties.description:
Domaine Loisirs de l'Ubaye is located in the Ubaye valley, right by the river and surrounded by tall Alpine peaks. This campsite is the only four-star campsite in the region. The large, comfortable grounds provide guests with every convenience. The recently renovated reception building and restaurant are very well-maintained. There are numerous playing opportunities for the children. In the low season, the campsite also draws seniors who want to enjoy the peace and quiet and walk in the beautiful natural surroundings.

Although the campsite is situated on sloping terrain, the terraced pitches are mostly level. The pitches are spaciously marked. Some of the pitches have a view of the river. Most of them are separated by bushes and are situated along narrow pathways. As you descend, you approach the river. You can be in the water in no time. Take a relaxing or an invigorating trip with a raft or kayak. There is also a beach where you can sunbathe.

Coco or Glamping?

There are three sanitation facilities, one of which is new. The sanitation is clean and well-maintained. There is a range of chalets and mobile homes available for rent. The Coco Sweet and the Glamping tent (simple tents without sanitation) and the luxury mobile home Loggia Bay (with three bedrooms and all modern comforts).

Children's paradise

The campsite is a real family campsite. Children can visit the mini club or play in the playground or on the bouncy castle. Sports opportunities are also available: tennis, football, basketball, table tennis, badminton and jeu de boules. There is a heated swimming pool with a small water slide. Plenty of activities are organised as well (fun and game afternoons, disco, guided hiking and rafting trips).

properties.name: Camping Les Mûres
properties.description:
If you would like to enjoy the beaches of the Côte d’Azur, visit St Tropez or go into the mountains for a day, you can do it all from the French Camping Les Mûres. This campsite by the sea in Var has everything you will need. With ancient pine trees, a lovely sandy beach and mobile homes and pitches right on the beach, this campsite has the full package for an ideal holiday. And that is no matter whether you are looking for relaxation or an adventurous, active holiday. Visit this stunning region and enjoy a four-star campsite with your feet in the water.

Camping at the beach

Camping les Mûres consists of two parts that are separated by the coastal road from Sainte-Maxime to Saint-Tropez. You walk from one side of the campsite to the other via a tunnel. There are lovely pitches on the beach. Another part of the campsite is in the vineyard. You can find extra comfort in one of the mobile homes between the trees or at a few steps from the beach. There are also 10 luxury mobile homes with hot tub and lovely Coco Sweet tents.

Fun and games in the playground

The campsite is ideal for people who love the sun and beach, but also for campers who want to get out and about and see a bit of Var. Jump into the sea for a refreshing swim. At Camping Les Mûres, children can play in the playground and in the high season, they can take part in activities organised by the Kids' Club and Teenagers' Club such as painting and playing music.

properties.name: Capfun Camping Marina d'Aléria
properties.description:
On the east coast of the French island of Corsica, only three kilometres from the town of Aléria, you can enjoy a wonderful beach vacation at this vibrant family campsite. The Marina d’Aléria campsite is located directly on the sea and has everything you need to have fun and relax. The interior of this beautiful hilly island – with its charming villages and towns – will also surprise you.

Camping and renting

Aléria is an old village with a rich history located on the river Tavignano. From Aléria, the campsite is well signposted. There are many pine trees on the camping grounds, so most spots have plenty of shade. The beach front camping sites are a lot sunnier. You’ll also enjoy a great view. In addition to 65 touring pitches, the campsite also offers rental accommodations of all shapes and sizes.

Sea and pool

Prepare for a vacation full of fun in the water Those camping at the Marina d’Aléria campsite can choose between pool and beach. The private beach of the campsite is only 50 metres away. There is a water park with pools and facilities for campers of all ages.

Plenty of activities

At this campsite, there are plenty of activities to keep you busy from morning to night. Start your day with a class in the aqua gym or a game of tennis. Afterwards, you can laze in one of the hammocks on the beach or on a sunbed by the pool. The entertainment team will do everything they can to ensure that not a day goes by without fun activities such as disco evenings.

properties.name: Camping De la Côte des Nacres
Camping Tikiti
properties.description:
Camping Tikiti is located in the southwest of Corsica. Situated on a vast site (12 hectares) with a view of the Valinco Gulf, this is a wonderful location for a relaxed holiday. After all, that is what it is all about: tranquillity, peace and enjoying nature. Go for a refreshing dip in the swimming pool, go to the nearby beach or explore the south of Corsica. Everything is possible, starting at Camping Tikiti!

Free choice of pitches and view of the Valinco Gulf

The camping section of the campsite is huge. There is plenty of room for your motorhome, caravan or tent. And best of all? You can choose your own pitch. Choose a pitch right next to the swimming pool or drive a bit further up the hill for the best view of the Valinco Gulf. There are plenty of pitches in the shade. The campsite also has a spacious selection of rustic chalets and modern mobile homes that hold up to 6 people. Ideal if you are looking for a little more comfort and privacy.

Swimming and relaxation for young and old

The swimming pool (200 m²) is located in the centre of the campsite. With a paddling pool, water cascade and, during the high season, even a pool bar, you’ll be here for the remainder of your holiday. Rest and relaxation are paramount at Camping Tikiti. With this in mind, during the high season there is a special swimming pool schedule for young and old, so that everyone can enjoy the swimming pool in their own way. From mid-June to mid-September, the pizzeria is open for a delicious breakfast or authentic Neapolitan pizzas.

properties.name: Camping Di Liccia
properties.description:
This pleasant campsite is located in southern Corscia. Camping Di Liccia is an ideal campsite for a carefree holiday with children on the Gulf of Santa Manza. Centrally located near the port of Bonifacio, you will enjoy a pleasant outdoor swimming pool, plenty of natural shade, clean sanitary facilities and also modern glamping accommodation under the olive trees. The islets of Cerbicales and Lavezzi lie offshore from the campsite in the azure Tyrrhenian Sea.

Camping on Corsica

The neat campsite is located conveniently on the T10 road, the transit route between the northern and southern parts of the island. Because the campsite has a long driveway, no noise disturbance is caused by the road. The surrounding countryside is characterised by rugged cliffs and high mountains, interspersed with villages such as Porto-Vecchio and Sartène.

Spot under the trees

The generous pitches are neatly laid out among the olive, eucalyptus and oak trees. The pitches differ in size, but in general they are nice and spacious. The two well-arranged and modern sanitary blocks are set out in a large square with a special children's section. For the glamping accommodations you walk to the small hill a little further on.

Water fun everywhere

Will it be swimming laps in the pool or going a short drive in the car for a dip in the sea? The sun-filled swimming pool has sun loungers, thatched umbrellas and a wooden fence around it for safety. Toddlers have a nice paddling pool for themselves. There is plenty to enjoy at the lively beaches nearby. Discover all the gems in the area and enjoy the beautiful coast.

properties.name: Camping Panoráma
properties.description:
Camping Panoráma is mainly visited by people who enjoy peace and quiet and the thermal baths in neighbouring Hévíz. You can experience the hustle and bustle and excitement at the Balaton Lake, some 5 km away. The campsite lives up to its name with a magnificent view over the pleasant landscape and the Hévíz health resort. The small-scale campsite has relatively basic facilities, but everything functions as it should.

As if stuck in a time warp

When you enter the reception, it feels as if time has stood still. Everything looks the same as decades ago, but it well maintained. The entire campsite looks well-cared for. On the attractive terraced campsite you have a choice of well maintained pitches. Camper van owners can also find a spot here. Here and there is some afforestation, so that you have a choice of pitches with lots or somewhat less shade. Besides you own camping equipment, you can also rent an apartment or caravan.

Small swimming pool

There is a beautiful, small swimming pool with a lawn with loungers, located at the bottom of the campsite. On the campsite is ample space for sports and games.

Fresh bread

Fresh bread is available from the reception as well as some quaffable red wine. Within walking distance of the campsite you will find the nearest restaurants. A large supermarket is some 3 km further down the road.

Shuttle bus Balaton Lake

The campsite has a shuttle bus, which will take you to the thermal baths in Héviz or to the nearby Balaton Lake.

properties.name: Pelso Camping
properties.description:
Directly on Lake Balaton in Hungary lies Pelso Camping, a large campsite with shaded camping pitches. From the camping grounds, you have a wonderful view of the lake and the Tihany peninsula. Choose your camping pitch or rental accommodation directly on the water and enjoy the fine view.

Renovations

Pelso Camping is a four-star campsite, but this is according to Hungarian standards. And although investments have been made in new mobile homes, the facilities are somewhat lacking for the touring campers. The camping pitches are shady and neatly separated by hedges, but they are not big and the drainage doesn't always work well. A lot of the sanitary facilities have been renovated in recent years, but the work has not yet been completed in some places.

Warm water

Pelso Camping is situated on Lake Balaton, the largest lake in Central Europe and an important tourist attraction. The campsite can be found on the northern shore of the lake and has its own grassy bank across the entire length of the camping grounds. Because Lake Balaton has an average depth of just three metres, the water is pleasantly warm in the summer and is, therefore, also highly suitable for children to swim in. 

Swimming pool and natural pool

Pelso Camping has all sorts of facilities in and on the lake. For example, there are water slides into the lake, goals and basketball nets in the water, as well as a floating playground with play equipment on the water.

Pelso Camping also has a heated outdoor swimming pool with a water slide. The swimming pool and the lake form a varied water park. On the lake, you can go fishing, sailing and windsurfing, but motorboats are prohibited on Lake Batalon.

properties.name: Camping Forrás
properties.description:
Camping Forrás lies on the outskirts of the village of Magyarhertelend. You are here at the foot of the low Mecsek mountain range, a landscape with wooded hills and valleys. This tranquil and natural region is ideal for exploring by bicycle or for walking. With the Orfü lakes (6 km) and culture city Pécs (24 km) in close vicinity, a variety of day trips are possible.

Camping in a green oasis

When you arrive on the campsite, you will immediately notice the large number of trees and the lush grass. This is an oasis of peace. The reception will gladly assist you with your questions and a bread and grocery service. 

The pitches on Camping Forrás measure approximately 100 m2. There is little demarcation, but ample privacy for everyone. There are 45 pitches in total as well as one rental accommodation unit: a caravan for four persons. Paving of several pitches and construction of an infill area for motorhomes is planned for 2019.

Water fun around the corner

As a campsite guest, you will be entitled to a 20% discount at the adjacent swimming complex. This small swimming paradise consists of a thermal bath, a few swimming pools, bubble baths, toddler pools, a slide and hydro massage. It is possible to swim indoors as well as outdoors. The outdoor portion is beautifully landscaped with trees and exotic plants. 

Bites and drinks

In the campsite bar (with terrace) you can enjoy a cup of coffee or tea, but also ice cream sundaes and small refreshments. With two pétanque courts, a small playground and adjacent soccer field, young and old can show off their sports skills. In high season the owners organise great tasting sessions, workshops and excursions on a regular basis.

properties.name: Camping Piccolo
properties.description:
The Piccolo Domaso campsite is located on the northwest bank of Lake Como only a few minutes from the town of Domaso. As the name suggests, it is a small campsite, right on the lake. A lovely place for water sports enthusiasts, while the mountains around the lake are an eldorado for hikers and mountain bikers.

Nice little campsite

Piccolo is a nice and well-designed campsite. The camping pitches are of normal size, have grassy ground and offer some shade. There are no separations between the pitches. You share the campsite with Germans, Swiss and English people, mostly water sports enthusiasts. The modern, new sanitation facility looks excellent and is accessible to everyone, even less mobile campers.

From the campsite, you walk through a gate to the lake and the public beach. Swimming, surfing, kite surfing, sailing... you can do it all here. You can also take wonderful hikes and mountain bike tours in the mountains.

Also small in terms of the facilities

Camping Piccolo is also small in terms of its facilities. The reception right in the front also serves as a bar with a terrace with a view of the lake. Great for a morning cappuccino or an aperitif at the end of the day. In nearby Domaso there is a supermarket for daily shopping and shops and restaurants and cafés.

What can you do here?

In addition to all of the sports we've listed, making it possible to have an active holiday, you can also take a boat tour on the lake, such as to cosmopolitan Bellagio, the pearl of Lake Como. Or go to Como, the city that gave the lake its name.

properties.name: Camping Rosselba Le Palme
properties.description:
Camping Village & Glamping Rosselba Le Palme lies among the palm trees and tropical plants on Elba. You can access the beach via a steep staircase from the campsite. From there you'll have a lovely view to the capital Portoferraio. At the campsite, there's a great pool with slides and waterfalls, there's a gym, and plenty of entertainment for the kids.

Napoleon and Monte Capanne

Camping Village & Glamping Rosselba Le Palme is on the Italian island of Elba. From Piombino on the mainland, it's just 30 minutes by boat to reach this little island. There are beautiful bays, beaches and lively villages on Elba. The island isn't very big, so you'll find yourself driving along the same roads from time to time if you're doing various daytrips. Something you definitely shouldn't miss is a visit to the house where Napoleon was in exile, and a trip on the cable car to the top of Monte Capanne, which has a fantastic view of the whole island.

Camping amongst the palm trees

The campsite is beautifully landscaped with palm trees, tropical flowers and plants, which gives it an exotic feel. There are various different options for camping here. You can camp with your own tent or caravan in the shade of the palm trees, or you can book one of the many rental cottages. Take a dive into the cool water of the swimming pool, with three different levels, connected to each other by pool slides and waterfalls. You can reach the sea and a private stony beach in about 10 minutes, via a steep staircase.

properties.name: Camping Village St. Michael
properties.description:
At the Village St. Michael campground, in a lovely location in a nature park, there's plenty of fun and shady campsites near the sea. It is a charming and quiet family campground with a beautiful outdoor swimming pool and a playground, activities team and pizzeria. It's easy to visit the historic towns of Pisa, Livorno, Florence and Lucca with public transport or by car.

Camping in Tuscany

The campground is located in a green forested area and eminates peace. The campsites are spacious (about 70 m2) and the trees provide shade. The sites are delineated with a hedge to provide the necessary privacy. The toilet facilities are a bit dated, but are nicely maintained and cleaned. Want to go camping, but don't have a tent or a caravan? Stay in a Coco Sweet. These unique and cosy lodge tents have a terrace and a little kitchen with refrigerator and stove. You can also hire a caravan.

Water fun for everyone

Camping Village St. Michael is only 800 metres from the sea, and the private beach can be reached on foot. Don't want to walk in the hot weather? You can take the free shuttle bus to the beach (only in high season). If you are staying in one of our caravans during your holidays, you will have two lounge chairs and a parasol on the beach. There is also a lovely outdoor pool on the campsite, with an area to play and a deeper area to swim laps.

properties.name: Camping & Glamping Le Capanne
properties.description:
Campsite Le Capanne is located in a quiet village in the northern part of Tuscany. The central location and easy accessibility is a large advantage. The Mediterranean and the campsite are separated only by the coastal through road. The campsite offers a free shuttle service in peak season to the beach of Marina di Bibbona.

Complete camping pitches

Camping Le Capanne is landscaped as a park. On one side of the campsite are the spacious pitches along neat streets. The many rental accommodation units are on a separate section of the campsite. The touring pitches are sheltered by natural vegetation. Campsite guests can park their car near their tent or caravan. You have a choice of five types of pitches. They vary in size, but share a comfortable feature. All pitches have their own electricity and water connections as well as drainage.  There are several sanitary buildings on the camping section. They were not built recently, but are kept spotless.

Swimming paradise

The tropical swimming pool, which was built recently, may justifiably be referred to as the highlight of Camping Le Capanne. Several pools are located in a garden adorned with palm trees, colourful flowers and plants, between rocks and with a wooden footbridge. Around the swimming pool there is sufficient space to sunbathe on the lawn, therefore enough room to spread your towel or choose a lounger. The convivial swimming pool bar overlooks the water. Gymnastics lessons are offered several times a week. Other sports activities include Zumba lessons or spinning.

properties.name: Camping Park Dolomiti Village e Golf
Camping Catinaccio Rosengarten
properties.description:
In the heart of the Dolomites, the Catinaccio Rosengarten campsite enjoys a picturesque location. All facilities are of high quality, and sports enthusiasts or nature lovers will find tranquillity and a perfect environment for walking and cycling in these high mountains.

Trentino is located in the south of Tyrol, and the Catinaccio Rosengarten campsite shines amidst that natural beauty. A big plus is the quiet character of the campsite in combination with the lively village of Pozza di Fassa that's within walking distance. The cosy campsite bar looks inviting, and after an active day, the sauna, steam bath or thermal bath awaits you for well-deserved relaxation. Beautiful routes start next to the campsite and let you discover the special nature of the Dolomites.

Camping in the Dolomites

Surrounded by a natural ambience with the highest point of the Dolomites nearby, the Marmolada, you'll be camping in a popular ski area. This is also an ideal gateway in the summer to impressive nature. The Catinaccio Rosengarten campsite is on the road through the valley wedged between the breathtaking mountains. You can't miss the beautiful reception building, a large log cabin in the Tyrolean architectural style that also houses a meeting room. Please note that the campsite has an afternoon siesta.

Idyllic camping

On the flat and compact site, the pitches are on an open field with a hard surface. The pine trees provide shade, but there are also plenty of places in the sun. There are cooking facilities for tent campers, and the sanitary facilities are very modern and well-finished. A river flows past the campsite and can be reached by crossing a cycle path. You can also enjoy a holiday in this little bit of paradise in a beautiful mobile home, chalet or luxury hotel room.

properties.name: Camping Colleverde Siena
properties.description:
Camping Colleverde Siena is uniquely situated in the heart of Tuscany, in a suburb in the northern part of Siena. Campers stay here to explore this very special city (at 2.5 km from the campsite). Other pearls in the region, such as San Gimignano or Firenze are also easy to reach.

The drive to the campsite via rolling hills past vineyards and tall cypresses, is an extraordinary experience.

Panoramic view and shade

On the neatly laid out campsite are winding paved roads which lead you to the various pitches. This gives the campsite its small-scaled character. From the campsite you have a panoramic view of the towers rising above Siena.

On the slightly sloping grounds are various types of camping pitches which differ in size. The surface is made of grass or gravel. There is also a separate section for trekker huts, demarcated with wooden fencing. Adjacent to the camping pitches there are also modern rental tents and mobile homes on Camping Colleverde.

Cooling off in the pool

The beautiful swimming pool is spacious, rectangular and is located in the middle of the grounds. Next to the pool are a number of sun loungers. Directly behind the swimming pool is a large lawn with trees. The bar can also be found there. The swimming pool may be slightly too deep (1.20) for small children.

properties.name: Gitavillage Il Gabbiano
properties.description:
Gitavillage Il Gabbiano is located on the Tuscan coast, between the Monte Argentario peninsula and the port town of Talamone. With direct access to the beach, the shade of the pine forest and all the child-friendly facilities, this is a great place for a family holiday.

Fairytale fun

The campsite is a paradise for the youngest guests: the colourful cottages are set in green surroundings, each with its own theme. So imagine yourself in a jungle, at the bottom of the sea or flying through Neverland like a real Peter Pan. The standard accommodations are comfortable and have a Mediterranean feel.

The murals can be found throughout the campsite. So plenty to discover! And there are fun activities too. From the swimming pool with paddling pool and child-friendly beach to the shady playground and entertainment.

Swim, feast and relax

From your sun lounger by the pool, walk straight to the bar and restaurant for a drink or delicious meal. Or walk on and take a dip in the sea. Here you will find a floating play platform and you can rent a beach bed with umbrella or a kayak or pedalo.

And: a campsite shop, bike rental and entertainment for young and old ensure comfort and fun - no fuss, just well organised.

The varied Tuscan coast

Natural parks, quaint villages and a whole peninsula to explore. There is plenty to do here! The Parco della Maremma (21 km), Orbetello (15.5 km) and Monte Argentario (18 km) are all easily accessible by car.

properties.name: Gitavillage Argentario
properties.description:
At Gitavillage Argentario, you will be camping in a magical spot in Tuscany. You will holiday among centuries-old pine trees and right by the sea, overlooking the islands of Giannutri, Giglio and Montecristo.

Camping in green surroundings

Choose a spacious lodge, a cottage in the greenery, a cosy tent or one of the atmospheric camping pitches. Whether you're travelling with a tent, caravan or camper van, this is a great site. In all the accommodation (2-6 people), you will enjoy the campsite's Mediterranean atmosphere.

Enjoyment and social activities

Holidaymakers aged between 4 and 10 can join the Mini Club. Older children and adults can participate in group games or sports competitions and enjoy live music and themed evenings. Take a refreshing dip in the pool or join an aqua gym class. Or splash together in the children's pool, including play equipment and slide. The campsite also has a private beach, where campers big and small can play safely to their hearts' content. Parasols, loungers and chairs are provided.

Traditional Tuscan dishes

You can also enjoy yourself in the campsite restaurants. Visit the restaurant right next to the pool. Here you will taste traditional Tuscan dishes, pizzas and tasty drinks. At the beach, enjoy fresh fish and seafood.

Discover Tuscany in and around the water

There is a lot to discover around Gitavillage Argentario. Rent a bike or scooter on the campsite and explore the area together. Or book a mini-cruise from Porto Santo Stefano to the islands of Giannutri and Giglio. From here, you have a unique view of the coastline.

properties.name: Portofelice Camping Village
properties.description:
Portofelice Camping Village is a luxury campsite on the Italian east coast. With a private beach, the campsite is located directly on the Mediterranean Sea, about fifty kilometres from Venice. Young and old can expend their energy in the large swimming pool complex. For young sports fans, there is a real football school. And the entertainment team has a varied programme for young and old.

Well-kept holiday village

The pitches all look very well cared for. But the campsite is particularly special for holidaymakers who choose rental accommodation. And they have a lot to choose from: different types of mobile homes, chalets and bungalows are available in this holiday village. Many of them have small private gardens and their own stone oven.

Swimming between the palm trees

The campsite's pool complex is impressive. Of the three large pools, one is for swimming laps and the other two are for toddlers and children. Here, palm trees give the whole a tropical touch. Between the palm trees lies the large whirlpool. Around the swimming pools, there are several sun decks and lawns where you can enjoy the warm sun.

By the Mediterranean Sea

If all the loungers at the swimming pool are taken, you can try your luck on the beach. This is easy, because the campsite has a private beach directly on the Mediterranean. A narrow strip of woodland leads to the beach within a few minutes. Here too, the parasols and sun loungers, which you have to hire, are lined up in beautiful rows. Of course, you can also just lay down in the sand with your towel.

properties.name: Camping Sant'Angelo Village
properties.description:
On the Adriatic coast, near Venice, lies this beautiful beach campsite. Sant'Angelo Village Campsite is a true children's paradise. You and your family can enjoy splashing around in the many pools here. Float around in the unique butterfly pool as the kids race down the large water slides. Luxury is the key word at this campsite. A variety of stylish rental properties offer you plenty of choice here. And having the beach and sea as your backyard: that's pure enjoyment! Sant'Angelo Village Campsite is truly a five-star campsite.

On the east coast of Italy

Sant'Angelo Village Campsite is located on the east coast of Italy. This beach campsite is situated between the Adriatic Sea and the Venetian Lagoon. This strip of land is a popular holiday destination. Not surprising, given you are camping right on the beach and can be in Venice in no time. You have your choice of campsites here. At Sant'Angelo Village Campsite, they do their best to stand out. Tall trees, colourful flower beds and friendly receptionists: everything about the campsite is tip notch.

Wide choice of camping options

Sant'Angelo Village Campsite's camping area is located in a forest along the coast. If you come here to camp, you will have a wide variety options. Want a smaller, cosy pitch under the trees? Or would you prefer a large pitch close to the beach? No matter what you choose, all the pitches look nice and well cared for. Sant'Angelo Village Campsite has an even greater range of rental accommodations. These range from colourful bungalows to luxury apartments and spacious motorhomes.

properties.name: Camping Villa Al Mare
properties.description:
Between the sea and the lagoon, with Venice a stone's throw away, you'll find Villa al Mare campsite, a very child-friendly campsite. You can stay here on an attractive pitch, or in one of the comfortable rental cottages. Get your breakfast at the campsite shop, and walk to the beach to enjoy a delicious sea breeze.

From tent to studio

Villa al Mare campsite is on a headland between the Adriatic and the Venice Lagoon. You can see Venice just on the other side of the lagoon. A daytrip to this special city is very easy to do. The pitches here are neatly kept. There's always an electricity point nearby, and some pitches have satellite TV and a water outlet and drain. You can also stay in one of the comfortable mobile homes, bungalows and studios, all of which have air conditioning and TV.

A relaxed children's campsite.

You'll probably come across many families with young children here. Particularly around the pool - with a slide - since it's very popular with little children. The beach, less than 100 metres away, is perfect for children: there's play equipment, good lifeguards, and pedal boating is both fun and safe. You can buy all the essentials in the campsite shop - if you want a wider range of products, you take a bike (which you can rent at the campsite) or the car to a larger supermarket nearby. A fishmonger visits the campsite with fresh fish for sale every week.

properties.name: Camping Bosco Selva
properties.description:
Camping Bosco Selva is a small-scale campsite in Apulia, not far from Alberobello. This town is known for its trulli, the typical limestone houses with conical roofs. The campsite is simple and has limited amenities. So you'll have to do without a swimming pool and entertainment programme. The campsite is above all a beacon of peace and tranquillity. You'll be camping in a beautiful forest in a peaceful environment.

Shaded camping area

At Camping Bosco Selva, you'll be camping on a natural and rugged campsite full of tall trees. The abundance of shady spots contributes to the calm atmosphere on the campsite. There are only forty touring pitches and nine rental units. Even when the campsite is full, which can be the case in the summer months, it is still nice and quiet. The trees provide natural demarcation for the pitches, giving you the feeling of camping freely.

A quick trip to Alberobello

The campsite also lacks a restaurant and supermarket. But you can still order fresh bread in the small campsite shop. And you don't have to drive far for a larger supermarket: the centre of Alberobello is just five minutes away by car. There you have plenty shops and restaurants to choose from.

Trulli capital of Alberobello

You may have already seen some on the way to the campsite: trulli. Alberobello is the real Italian 'trulli capital', famous for the white limestone houses with their conical roofs. These trulli, which originated in the late fourteenth century, were said to be easy to build and, above all, cheap. Most trulli can be seen in the Rione Monte and Aia Piccola districts.

properties.name: Camping Santa Maria di Leuca
properties.description:
Camping Santa Maria di Leuca is located in the southeastern region of Apulia. The Italians who live here are the proud inhabitants of Salento. This region, which forms the entire ‘heel of the boot’, is known for its delicious wines and olive groves. Taste Salento's cuisine at this family campsite while you enjoy a live performance on the large patio.

Wooded campsite

The largest part of the wooded campsite is intended for touring campers. Two hundred shaded touring pitches are available. The slightly smaller pitches are suitable for tents, while the pitches for motorhomes and caravans are fairly spacious (by Italian standards). The pine trees form a natural demarcation of the touring pitches, which are mainly located on hard sand. If you prefer to stay in a rental accommodation, that's also possible. Twenty-five mobile homes and ten mini-apartments are available.

Outdoor pool with paddling pool

On a sunny spot in the centre of the campsite there is a large outdoor swimming pool. The rectangular pool is not really special, but it is large and ideal for water games, water aerobics and swimming laps. The smallest swimmers are also catered for. Next to the large pool is a smaller paddling pool with a slide. A nice place for the little ones to play in the refreshing water.

Specialities of Salento

In the high season you can get to taste the southern Italian cuisine of Salento. Because one evening weekly the restaurant is offering a joint buffet with all dishes from the region. During dinner there are live performances, which you can continue to enjoy while you linger at the table.

properties.name: Camping Village Šimuni
properties.description:
In the heart of Croatia, on the unique Pag peninsula with its beautiful moon landscape and panoramic views, Camping Šimuni lies in an oasis of greenery by the sea. Here you camp in the shade of old pine trees, with glorious beaches and the luxury of a large, well-maintained campsite close at hand. A great spot for a real beach holiday with the entire family.

Camping under the old pine trees

You will immediately notice that Šimuni is a large campsite. There are nine hundred camping pitches, partly on terraces. This may seem a bit on the busy side. However, it is a well-organised campsite where you have ample privacy. The smaller and larger camping pitches are all located in the shade of an old pine tree. Some of the camping pitches are located by the sea or have a sea view. 

A complete beach holiday

Campsite Šimuni is located on the bay of an inland sea. The pebble beaches are great for families. The depth increases gradually and the water is calm. You have your choice of no less than six beaches. For instance, there is a beach where you can enjoy a wellness treatment, yoga and massages. There is also a wheelchair-accessible beach, two beaches where pets are allowed and a beach with water sports facilities. 

Entertainment for the whole family

On the campsite there are daily activities for children, teenagers and adults. Live entertainment is available in the evenings. With all this on offer, the high season may be rather crowded. 

Dining options and supermarket

You don't have to leave the campsite for a snack or meal. There are several restaurants, including a seafood restaurant and pizzeria. You can also go to the supermarket in Šimuni.

properties.name: Autocamp Korana
properties.description:
Plitvice Lakes National Park is considered one of the most beautiful places in Croatia. If you want to admire all the natural beauty of this park, you will definitely need a whole day to do so. Looking for a campsite near Plitvice? Then Autocamp Korana is an excellent choice. This campsite is six kilometres from the park. Korana is a large, internationally-oriented campsite, where most guests stay for a day or two.

Choose your pitch

Autocamp Korana is a campsite with a real camping atmosphere. After checking in, you can enter the campsite and choose your favourite pitch. There are over 500 camping pitches and 47 wooden bungalows for rent.

Korana restaurant

On the edge of the campsite, near the Korana River, you will find the campsite's restaurant. Korana Restaurant can accommodate several hundred guests. Here you can order tasty meals from the menu, or take advantage of an extensive buffet.

The campsite has a reasonably sized supermarket.

Lakes, waterfalls and caves

Autocamp Korana is located in a wooded nature area where you can take numerous beautiful hiking and cycling trips. Most campers staying at this campsite do so because they want to visit the Plitvice Lakes. These lakes are located in the national park. In this park, you walk on good footpaths along sixteen lakes, ninety waterfalls and several caves.

properties.name: Camping Recreatiecentrum De Vogel
properties.description:
Camping Recreatiecentrum De Vogel is located in the east of Zeeuws-Vlaanderen, next to a recreational lake. At this family campsite, children can play in the large swimming paradise with outdoor swimming pool, water slides and water playground. The indoor playground and cinema also offer a lot of entertainment. In short: a complete campsite for a camping holiday with the whole family.

Camping at the waterfront

The large campsite of camping Recreatiecentrum De Vogel is divided in two by the inland lake 'De Grote Vogel'. On both sides of the water there are several camping fields for touring pitches. There are 215 pitches for touring campers. These pitches are undefined and are situated on spacious lawns. A large part of the campsite is intended for fixed annual pitches: 300 in total. The classic and modern mobile homes and chalets complete the camping offer. The most beautiful spots can be found on the banks of the lake.

Family campsite

Especially in the high season, children will meet many potential holiday friends at the campsite. They do this at the petting zoo, in one of the playgrounds or at the 'De Vogel' children's club. Here children of all ages can let themselves be immersed in the full entertainment programme for every school holiday. Together with mascot Paco, musicals, sports competitions, pony rides and much more are organised.

Even more fun

When the weather is bad, the indoor playground is an excellent solution. Here the youngest campers can clamber and play with mega-legoblocks. The slightly older youth can enjoy themselves in the game zone, complete with table football, air hockey and pool table. And don't forget the children's cinema, where children can watch the best films.

properties.name: EuroParcs Het Amsterdamse Bos
properties.description:
EuroParcs Het Amsterdamse Bos is located between Amsterdam, Amstelveen and Schiphol and yet in a natural setting. You combine the best of two worlds at this campsite. You stay in forested surroundings, where you walk past little lakes and grazing Scottish Highlanders. At the same time, the vibrant city of Amsterdam is practically around the corner and easy to reach by car, bike and public transport. This holiday park has various options for overnight stays, a playground, some sports facilities and a supermarket. You have free WiFi throughout EuroParcs Het Amsterdamse Bos.

From spacious camping pitches to luxury glamping tents

If you like authentic camping, this campsite is the perfect spot. Indeed, this holiday park have relatively few touring pitches. The camping pitches are at the rear of the site. At EuroParcs Het Amsterdamse Bos, you can also book lovely accommodation, such as a modern mobile home, a luxury glamping tent, a charming log cabin or a Forest Lodge.

Like to take your dog with you on holiday? Then this is also the perfect holiday address because there are many suitable spots to walk your dog and lovely paths at this park and in the surroundings. Furthermore, your dog is welcome on all camping pitches and in some of the accommodation.

Shopping tips

There is a shop beside reception where you can go for daily groceries. That includes bread rolls and toppings for breakfast. Fresh bread can be ordered in the low season. If you would like to do a more extensive shop, you are best going to Amstelveen.

properties.name: Camping De Mussenkamp
properties.description:
De Mussenkamp is a beautifully maintained tranquil campsite with a luxurious appearance. It is mainly frequented by families with young children and guests looking for greenery, peace and spaciousness. Therefore, silence on the camping grounds is to be strictly observed from 23:00 to 07:00. There is a farm which belongs to the campsite: you may enter the stable and have a look at the cows and horses. Some 15 minutes away you will find the glorious Heerder beach with a lake to swim in.

Grass and greenery

All pitches are demarcated, in rows, either without or with some shade. All pitches measure 10 x 10 m2 with nice grass and their own water and electricity connections. Each pitch is separated by neatly clipped hedges (at different heights) or other greenery. Children will enjoy the large sandpits, playground and sports field. The sanitary facilities, in a spacious and modern building, are extremely luxurious. Everything is spotlessly clean. There are also family showers.

Water fun and pets

There is no swimming pool on the campsite. This does not matter, as there is a fairly large lake, the Heerderstrand, not far away in a northerly direction. Clean swimming water, wide sandy beach, sunbathing lawns and facilities (toilet, catering). You can really enjoy yourself here, also with activities such as beach volleyball, water polo and canoeing.

The farm of the Jalink family forms part of the campsite. Guests are welcome to visit the stables and have a look around. It is lovely for children to see cows and horses up close. You can also amuse yourself on the volleyball field or the jeu de boules pitch. There are bicycles and pedal karts for children.

properties.name: Camping Klein Canada
properties.description:
Camping centre Klein Canada, where you can enjoy a holiday with a touch of Canada, is situated next to the Limburg Nature Reserve De Maasduinen. Enjoy the beautiful nature, the peace and Burgundian Limburg with the whole family. Kampeercentrum Klein Canada is located in the small North Limburg village of Afferden. The wooded and vast nature reserve is a lovely area for a long walk or cycling trip.

When you drive onto the campsite you will immediate notice the Canadian influence. The reception building, called 'Saskatchewan’ (after a Canadian province and river by the same name), is decorated with a Canadian flag, a totem pole and the familiar maple leaf.

For young and old

Kampeercentrum Klein Canada is eminently suitable for the somewhat older guest. The reason for this is the great walking and cycling opportunities in the beautiful surrounding nature and the fact that the campsite is a great place to enjoy reading a book in peace. However, families with young children will also enjoy themselves. You will come across a lot of Dutch people here. They may at times consider camping in Limburg a bit like spending a holiday abroad, even more so when the campsite has a Canadian atmosphere.

Fun in the water

On the campsite there is an indoor and outdoor swimming pool with slide for water fun. There is a separate toddler pool for the little ones. In the centre of the campsite there is even more water to be found. Amidst several types of accommodation and camping pitches is a fishing pond, where you can cast a line.

properties.name: Camping Vakantiepark De Bergen
properties.description:
Vakantiepark De Bergen, located in the nature area of Noord-Brabant is a campsite with lots of action.
