The indoor and outdoor playground, skelter track and beach are guaranteed to ensure a lovely holiday for young and old. The natural surrounding is ideal for walkers and cyclists. Vakantiepark De Bergen is located in a wooded area near the village of Wanroij. The campsite lies amidst nature. From the campsite you can reach the towns of Nijmegen, Den Bosch and Eindhoven in less than 45 minutes.

A place for everyone

There are different sites for camping. You can choose between standard, comfort and luxury pitches, but they also have special sites for families with children, where they can play safely in the middle of the field in the sand pit or on playground equipment. Furthermore, there are dedicated pitches where your dog is allowed. There are also chalets and lovely tepee tents. This is camping in style in a tent, with flat screen TV and a terrace with picnic furniture.

The campsite is suitable for various target groups. There are, for instance, many attractions for children of all ages, but camping guests looking for tranquillity and nature will also feel at home. The lovely natural area is extremely suitable for walking and cycling trips.

Beach pool

The beach pool is the very heart of the campsite. In the large natural lake, at the heart of the camping grounds, you can swim, float in the water and go down the slide. The surrounding beach is an ideal spot for an afternoon of sunbathing or building sand castles.

d

properties.name: Camping Cottesserhoeve
properties.description:
Cottesserhoeve is an attractive campsite, situated at the foot of a low hill on the border between the Netherlands and Belgium. From the campsite, you have a beautiful view over the surrounding hilly landscape. From here you can go on beautiful (and challenging) walks and cycling trips. The atmosphere of the grounds is determined by the beautifully renovated farmhouse (where the reception and the tavern are located).

Charming half timber farmhouse

The reception is housed in the main building of the splendidly preserved half timber farmhouse. In the same building you will find a cosy tavern with rustic interior. Outside in the court yard of the farm you can look for nice spot on the unique terrace and enjoy a refreshment and the surrounding scenery.

Sleek lay-out and well maintained grounds

The camping pitches are quite spacious and partly hardened. Each pitch faces the road and is separated by a high hedge at the back. Adjacent pitches are separated by low hedges. In addition to the regular pitches, there are comfort pitches and hardened pitches for campers with a rubber mat. The sanitary facilities are very neat.

Luxury mobile homes and apartments can also be rented on the grounds. A few apartments are on the first floor of the farmhouse. When you rent one of those, you will have to climb stairs!

Basic recreational facilities

On the grounds is a basic swimming pool where you can splash around in summer to ward off the heat. There is a toddler pool for the little ones. Apart from a playground and jeu de boule pitch, there are very few recreational facilities on the camping.

properties.name: Camping Diever
properties.description:
Campsite Diever is situated in the woods and is very peaceful and spacious for nature lovers. It is also well suited for children, with surprising play opportunities. Furthermore, the delightful village of Diever is within walking distance. All of this makes campsite Diever a venue, which attracts young and old, families and individuals alike.

The road to this forest camping is well signposted and runs partly alongside woods and fields. This immediately puts you in the right mood for a sojourn in this beautiful region.

Preservation of forest

The car-free grounds have an overall clean, spacious and pleasant appearance with clearly laid-out pitches. These have been laid out in such a manner that the surrounding forest has been preserved as much as possible and you will always be sheltered between trees. You will always have the feeling that you are camping in the middle of the forest. The hilly terrain adds to the feeling of spaciousness and offers ample privacy.

Play areas

Especially in spring and autumn, it is lovely and peaceful here. During the school holidays it may get a bit busier and livelier. During those periods children have lots of fun in the various playgrounds with great climbing and clambering equipment. Otherwise, there is also the entertainment team to keep them busy.

Picturesque village

The campsite has no restaurant facilities, but daily fresh rolls are available. Although the campsite is situated in the forest, the outside world is not far away. The rustic village of Diever is slightly less than one-and-a-half km away.

Sanitary facilities

The toilet buildings are modern and very well maintained. If required, pitches with their own sanitary facilities can also be rented.

properties.name: Pure Camping - Happy Glamping
properties.description:
Pure Camping – Happy Glamping has spaciously laid-out camping pitches, various recreational facilities, great fishing water and beautiful nature reserves in the vicinity. The campsite offers ample opportunities for both exuberant holiday fun and more restrained scenic beauty and tranquility. Using the campsite as a base, you can visit some lovely villages. You can also make endless cycling and walking trips. In other words, a real family campsite for young and old.

Natural

The campsite looks very neat, in keeping with the predominantly natural atmosphere of the surroundings. A few small elevation differences and forest ridges contribute towards the cosy ambiance. The pitches are generous, with a good deal of privacy and vegetation of grass and shrubs. The sandy terrain also prevents the build-up of mud or surface water. The pitches are equipped with water and electricity. The sanitary facilities on the camping are neat and well maintained.

Attractive swimming pool

In low season you will predominantly find the somewhat older lovers of quietude. But in busier times mainly families are staying here, which contributes to a lively ambiance. The grounds have a lot to offer for children: there is a playground, jeu de boule pitch, sports field and swimming pool with bubble baths, slides and toddler pools. In inclement weather conditions the swimming pool sides can be closed. Entertainment is provided in the holiday periods.

Environment

Outside the campsite, the countryside awaits for beautiful excursions and plenty of natural beauty. Like the Dwingelderveld, Holtingerveld, Drents-Friese-Wold, or attractions such as the Drents Museum in Assen and Wildlands in Emmen. And of course, making beautiful walking and cycling trips in this area are almost a matter of course.

properties.name: Camping De Adelhof
properties.description:
Camping De Adelhof is located in a green setting amidst nature in the west of Drenthe. It is a lovely spot for nature lovers and active campers. The campsite is part of a recreational park which is also contains a bungalow park, swimming pool and sports facilities. You will be camping on spacious, grassy pitches or at the edge of the fishing pond.

Camping pitches and bungalows

The campsite is part of a larger holiday park with a large number of permanent pitches. There are also plenty of touring pitches available. You camp on the pitches, which are located on large lawns. However, you can also opt for a spot by the fishing pond between the tall trees. For a more luxurious camping holiday, there is a selection of various types of bungalows and pod cabins. These are also located at the water's edge and between greenery.

Outdoor swimming pool: Het Bospad

Adjacent to the campsite, between the trees, lies the outdoor swimming pool Het Bospad. Guests of the campsite De Adelhof can obtain a discount by visiting the reception area. The swimming pool is surrounded by a sunbathing lawn and sandy beach, and it has playground equipment for children.

Children 

Camping De Adelhof takes good care of its younger guests as well. There is plenty to do for children, with a lovely entertainment programme during the high season (for young children and teenagers), a mini golf course and an indoor playground (Speelstee ’t Hofje) as well as a petting zoo. 

For avid sports enthusiasts and laid-back anglers

Sporty campers can also burn off energy. The campsite boasts a tennis court, a multi-sports field for soccer and volleyball and a pétanque court. Last, but not least, there is the fishing pond, of course. Here you can relax and cast a line (no permit required).

properties.name: Kampeerterrein  De Blauwe Haan
properties.description:
Looking for a peaceful, immaculate campsite with loads of nature and space, but that's also got enough entertainment for the children? At the campsite De Blauwe Haan in the Drenthe town of Uffelte you can have the best of both worlds. This site, located in a woody area on the edge of the Holtingerveld, is perfect for nature lovers and children alike. Even those who prefer more luxurious amenities for their stay are well provided for at the De Blauwe Haan campsite.

Farm atmosphere

As soon as you arrive you immediately feel the cosy farm atmosphere of this holiday site. The site offers spacious camping pitches, with or without private sanitary facilities. There are also chalets, hikers' cabins, holiday bungalows and tents for hire. Those looking for a truly special overnight stay can find it in the luxury holiday homes, which include a home theatre, jacuzzi and outdoor shower.

Campsite living room

At the centre of this campsite is the cosy sitting room. In this room, you can enjoy a drink or a snack (chips, ice cream, pizza or pancakes). It's also a great place for when the weather's inclement where you can snuggle by the fire or play a game of billiards.

Kids and smaller children, in turn, can play to their heart's content in one of the playgrounds with slides and a castle with a maze. De Blauwe Haan also has an indoor playground, a sandpit with water pump, a paddling pool and a football cage. There are several public swimming pools in the immediate vicinity of the campsite. At the campsite, you can buy discount cards for the swimming pool in Havelte.

Luxury bathroom facilities

In the morning, you can get fresh rolls in the croissant bakery. You will find extensive shopping options in Havelte or Meppel. An old barn on the site houses a modern and luxurious bathroom facility.

properties.name: Vakantiepark De Wiltzangh
properties.description:
EuroParcs De Wiltzangh is located in the woods between Ruinen, Ansen and Dwingeloo, not far from the Dwingelderveld National Park. The campsite is less than 2.5 km from the always charming village green of Ruinen in Drenthe. De Wiltzangh is surrounded by extensive heathlands and forests and numerous characteristic Drenthe villages. This makes it an ideal base for long hiking and cycling tours in the wider surrounding area.

Holiday park

De Wiltzangh is not just a campsite – it also has a camper park and bungalows. There is also a swimming pool. All this forms a beautiful whole, with peace, space and nature. The motto of the province, 'Drenthe really does something to you' finds its true expression here.

Activities

On sunny days you can use the heated swimming pool (with paddling pool) or participate in one of the many activities that are organized at De Wiltzangh, especially for children, such as hut building and following a gnome trail.

properties.name: EuroParcs Ruinen
properties.description:
EuroParcs Ruinen campsite is located in the hamlet of Engeland on the edge of the Dwingelderveld national park, a vast heathland landscape between the charming villages of Ruinen and Dwingeloo. Ruinen is a village with a green, restaurants and a supermarket. Also worth a visit: the vast heathlands and woods and the many typical Drenthe villages around the campsite.

Camping or glamping?

EuroParcs Ruinen is spaciously laid out with play equipment in the fields in the shelter of the forest. The pitches are at least 100 m2 large and consist of grassland over sandy soil. You can choose from a basic comfort pitch or a basic comfort pitch with private bathroom facilities. Thanks to the layout of the fields, you almost always have enough privacy.

Rental accommodation

The campsite rents out a great variety of accommodations, from safari tents to what are called Drenthe 'kappen' (little farmhouses). New are the luxury lodges that are available all year round and which are equipped with every possible amenity.

Activities

The campsite has a large indoor swimming pool with a separate paddling pool. The pool is always 28 degrees and the indoor temperature is even a few degrees higher. This way, it always feels comfortable when you get out of the water. The municipal swimming pool (for a fee) is also next to the campsite and has three more baths and high water slides. In the high season, there is entertainment for children organised.

properties.name: Camping Jena
properties.description:
Camping on a country estate amidst vast woodland and natural areas? You can do this on Camping Jena in Hummelo. This campsite is a stone's throw away from Doetinchem. It is an ideal location for families with small children and nature lovers. They like to explore the attractive area by bicycle or on foot. The reception of the campsite is located in a stately, characteristic farmhouse.

Enghuizen Estate

The grounds of the campsite are located on Landgoed Enghuizen, in the middle of the woods. The terrain is orderly, calm and peaceful. The spacious, sunny pitches vary in size and are located on a beautiful lawn at the edge of the woods. There is a separate field for groups with a maximum of thirty camping set-ups. You can also rent trekker huts.

Gnome tours and canoe trips

Children have sufficient space to really enjoy themselves. For instance, there is a large play and sports field, measuring a whopping 1.5 ha. Also good fun: the air-trampoline and the bicycle cross track. Furthermore, there is a (beach)volleyball field and a bad weather provision in an attractive barn. From the campsite there is a lovely gnome tour into the woods, where children find their way around with a GPS.

In summer, bread rolls are made on a campfire and canoe trips are organised in Laag-Keppel, located at 1 km from the campsite.

Fresh bread and snacks

Groceries are in limited supply at the campsite. However, fresh bread is available daily. More shopping options are at a distance of some 2 km from the campsite. There is a snack bar on the campsite. Do you want a wider choice? There are a large number of restaurants in close proximity (Hummelo and Doetinchem).

properties.name: Familiecamping De Otterberg
properties.description:
This cosy family campsite is located in the middle of Drenthe, in the north of the Netherlands. Both young and old alike can enjoy a wonderful holiday surrounded by nature near the town of Wijster. De Otterberg Family Campsite is a well-equipped holiday resort with abundant facilities, including an outdoor swimming pool, monorail, fishing pond and numerous playgrounds. The camping pitches are spacious and tidy. Those who prefer to rent accommodations can stay in a comfortable chalet. The campsite is an ideal base from which to explore Drenthe, go in search of megaliths, visit camp Westerbork or take a look around the lively monument village of Orvelte.

Choose the camping pitch that suits you

This cosy family campsite is spacious and offers a choice of annual pitches, seasonal pitches or touring pitches. With more than 100 pitches spread over the campsite, there is always a spot that suits your needs. The camping pitches are divided over several large and small fields that are separated from each other by hedges. There are places without shade for sun worshippers, but those who prefer the cool can count on a shady spot. Those who do not have their own camping equipment can rent a luxury chalet.

The best facilities for the whole family

There is always something to do here for both young and old alike! The campsite has several playgrounds spread over the site. But the highlights are the monorail, the fishing pond, the cosy outdoor pool and the canoe pond. And, of course, the bouncy castle installed in 2022 is not to be missed.

properties.name: Capfun de Sprookjescamping
properties.description:
Fairy tales exist! In any case, they do at Capfun Fairy-tale Campsite in Rheeze, Overijssel. Here, you will enter a completely different world with castles, fairies and a fairy pond. It is a special place where the entire family, maybe even grandparents, will experience a family holiday like we all dreamed of as a child.

For the entire family

When you arrive at the colourful campsite next to the forest, you are immediately given a fairy-tale welcome at the reception desk at the beautiful castle. Here, small and large camping parties are welcomed by all kinds of fairy-tale characters. Camping is possible at the Fairy-tale Campsite on a spacious camping pitch or in beautiful accommodations. The campsite is aimed primarily at families with young children (up to 10 years old).

Splishing and splashing

At Capfun Fairy-tale Campsite, you will experience a holiday with loads of water fun year round. Both a heated indoor and outdoor pool are available where you can swim and play. There are slides, toddler pools with a water play area and baby splash pools. The Fairy-tale Campsite also has a beach lake where you can float on your air mattress or even make sand castles nearby. Maybe you'll catch your first fish or spot Louis the frog prince in the fish pond.

On the photo with princesses and pirates

What is special about this campsite is that every day, even during low season, features entertainment and a fairy-tale theatre show. After the performance, children can collect autographs and have their picture taken with the fairy-tale characters. There are also (indoor) playgrounds and sports fields where you can quickly make friends and play for hours.

properties.name: Camping De Klimberg
properties.description:
Camping De Klimberg is in a wonderfully quiet spot in the beautiful Vechtdal, just outside Hardenberg. This campsite is in rural surroundings, right next to a vast woodland. This is an ideal starting point for varied walks and cycle rides through the Vechtdal. Thanks to the swimming pool, the swimming lake, the many sports and games facilities, and the fun activities, you can easily entertain yourself for days at the campsite. This is a modern campsite with a Christian identity. You have free Wi-Fi all over Camping De Klimberg.

From touring pitches to luxury accommodation

Paved paths lead to various open camping fields at this well-maintained campsite. If you want to book a camping pitch at Camping De Klimberg, you can choose from a standard camping pitch or a comfort camping pitch. If you opt for the latter, you can book private toilet and washing facilities with your camping pitch.

For those who love the camping life but prefer not to bring their own camping equipment, the campsite has a range of accommodation available. You can, for example, hire a chalet, caravan or luxury safari tent. Moreover, there is a special care chalet and an authentic residential farm for 12 people.

Two lovely swimming options

The lovely swimming pool at De Klimberg is right behind reception. This is a large, basic swimming pool with a paddling pool with a slide alongside. The ideal thing about this swimming pool is that it can be used in any weather conditions. That is because the swimming pool has a retractable roof. There are also two ponds, a swimming lake and a fishing pond.

properties.name: Vakantiepark Mölke
properties.description:
The child-friendly Vakantiepark Mölke is located on the border of Twente and Salland, some five km of the Salland Ridge. The Regge river flows along the campsite. From the campsite you can get onto the water in one of the whisper boats, explore the area by covered wagon or climb on your bicycle. You can camp here in real luxury. Book one of the special glamping accommodation units.

Camping in privacy

The campsite has a relatively large number of rental accommodation units. When you stay here with your caravan, motorhome or tent, you will invariably camp on separate camping fields. Some pitches are located between mobile homes, but most camping pitches offer ample privacy. The most beautiful camping pitches are located directly on the bank of the Regge. 

Glamping: from safari tent to tree house

Vakantiepark Mölke is a veritable glamping paradise. In addition to the mobile homes and bungalows, you can rent luxury glamping accommodation. Book a holiday bungalow with sauna, a safari tent or -when you come with a large group- the stunning farmhouse with thatched roof. The accommodation in the tree house, directly by the river, is truly spectacular.

Family campsite

Vakantiepark Mölke is a true family campsite. In high season you will meet many families with (young) children. The campsite is entirely designed with young guests in mind, which is borne out by the numerous facilities. They can enjoy themselves in the bowling alley and the indoor playground. There is also a small petting zoo. 

Young and old will thoroughly enjoy the covered swimming pool (with toddler pool) on the campsite. Children are entertained by an entertainment team during the holidays (except for the Christmas holiday). This renders the campsite also very suitable for a children's party.

properties.name: Panorama Camping Sonnenberg
properties.description:
Camping Sonnenberg can justifiably call itself one of the most beautifully located Alpine campsites. From the campsite you have a magnificent view of the three thousand metre high surrounding mountain ranges. Mountains that invite you to make lovely walking tours or car trips. The Alpine towns of Bludenz en Nüziders are just a stone's throw away.

Friendliest campsite

At the reception the hospitable owners, Matthias and Beate, extend you a warm welcome and will assist, where possible, with setting up your tent or mobile home, or with any other practical matters. Not surprising that Sonnenberg has already received recognition as 'the friendliest campsite in Europe'. The terrain is laid out in terraces and is mostly car-free. The boundaries of the terraces are dotted with colourful wild flowers. You reach the clean and comfortable camping pitches via neat gravel pathways. There is also a separate section on the campsite where pets are allowed.

Diversity of guests

In high season the campsite is frequented by a variety of guests. There is a fun, sheltered play area for the youth and ample room to 'chill'. In low season it is mainly the more senior walkers and seekers of peace and quiet who visit here. The swimming pool in the village of Bludenz is freely accessible to camping guests. It has a water slide and a spacious sunbathing lawn.

You can order fresh bread for the next day on the campsite. Restaurants and shops are within walking distance in the village.

Beautiful sanitary facilities

The sanitary facilities on campsite Sonnenberg leave nothing to be desired: they are kept immaculate and offer a wide range of convenient amenities such as an ironing boards and irons, tumble dryers and a drying room. There is also a dedicated corner for hair care and shaving.

properties.name: Naturcamping Kuprian - Ötztal
properties.description:
Naturcamping Kuprian is in a central location in the Ötztal, a popular region in the state of Tirol in Austria. This is a nature campsite in a quiet setting on the edge of a densely forested slope. This is a wonderful all-year destination for nature lovers. You can do plenty of winter sports activities here in winter. The large ski resort of Sölden is only 10 kilometres away. Furthermore, you can go on lovely walks and do other mountain sports in the summer. Mountain climbing, canyoning and mountain biking for example.

Authentic campsite with three types of pitches

If you are looking for an authentic campsite that is not yet focused on touring camping, this is the perfect place for you. You only find camping pitches at this site. You can choose from three types of pitches: Panorama Terrassenplatz, Wiesenplatz or Komfortplatz. The toilet and washing facilities are modern, luxurious and equipped with all conveniences.

What relaxation and recreation does the campsite offer?

The campsite is split in two by a stream as it were. In the middles of the site, there is a spot where you can play and paddle in the slow flowing water. For more relaxation, there is a fun recreation room (with miniature library and TV), a herb garden and a wellness area with a Finnish sauna.

Delicious dining in Måhlzeit Restaurant

The campsite restaurant is a popular eatery with an extensive menu with plenty of variation. It's an excellent place to relax after a lovely day in the countryside and to enjoy a tasty meal. There is also a special barbecue evening in Måhlzeit once a week.

properties.name: Camping Alpen-Caravanpark Achensee
properties.description:
The Alpine Caravan Park Achensee is located in the beautiful mountains of Tyrol. Campsites and plumbing are extremely modern and you are therefore optimally equipped for camping. Children are guaranteed hours of gaming fun which frees up parents, allowing them to think about their own relaxation.

The beautiful location right on the largest lake in Tyrol between mountains and greenery provides a wonderful panorama for the whole holiday. An easily accessible town that you can even reach from the north without incurring tolls: via Munich - Holzkirchen - Tegernsee - Achenpass – Achenkirch.

Modern camping

The beautiful, sunny campsites are all centrally located to the sanitary facilities. The comfort pitches offer a little extra: with water, electricity, gas connection, cable TV and private cleaning area for chemical toilets, nothing is missing from the pitch. Furthermore, you can also rent apartments and rooms with modern furnishings.

Your pitch neighbours are typically young families with small children, but there is also something here for teenagers.

Play and discover

From your pitch or accommodation you can quickly reach the beautiful, clear waters of the Achensee. For children there is also a water amusement park. Here they can build dams with their friends and play other water games.

The water park isn't the only thing offering your children hours of fun, there is also a large beach volleyball area, an adventure playground and you can rent paddleboats and explore the surroundings from the water. Real adventurers can even paraglide together in the mountains.

properties.name: Camping Schlossberg Itter
properties.description:
If you were to describe how to get to Camping Schlossberg in the Austrian Tyrol by saying, ‘turn right at Wörgl’, you would be spot on. A small tributary of the River Inn winds its way towards Hopfgarten, and the turn-off point to the town of Itter and the campsite is located nearby. The terraced layout of the pitches gives you the instant feeling of camping in a mountainous area. They are nice and flat, and some are shaded.

A summer swim

The outdoor pool is small yet lovely, and is rectangular in shape. Sun loungers are arranged around its perimeter. Next to the heated pool, there is a paddling pool with a small slide. You can either relax in the sun or the shade.

For the children

Next to the campsite, there is a playground with climbing structures, a climbing wall, slides, swings, and a toboggan run. A small train runs through the campsite every day, which the children can board for free. During the summer holidays, the entertainment team keeps youngsters busy with crafts, drawing and painting activities. Another highlight is the campfire where children can toast their own bread and sausages.

Underground

A visit to the silver mine in Schwaz, just a half-hour’s drive away, is an exciting experience, especially for children. After travelling 800 metres along the mine’s tracks underground, you follow in the footsteps of the miners who extracted silver and copper there some 500 years ago.

In the winter months

And what about wintertime? That’s when you strap on your cross-country skis or head over to the Kitzbühel Alps ski resorts. For a unique experience, enjoy a horse-drawn sleigh ride through the countryside. A romantic outing ...

properties.name: Camping Seeblick Toni
properties.description:
Camping Seeblick Toni is located on Reintaler Lake in a winter sports area. Children will have a blast in Toni's 'robber land' and nature playground. Special activities , such as Tyrol evenings, torch-lit hikes and theme weeks are organised on a regular basis. You can also visit the hotel's own wine tasting and schnapps distillery.

Upon arrival at the campsite you will receive the Alpbachtal Seenland Card. This gives you free access to swimming pools, museums and public transport in the region. The campsite has developed a special camping app for camping guests with information about the campsite and walking and cycling routes in the area.

Swimming in the lake

When the weather is nice, a visit to Toni's Nature Playground is not to be missed. In this play paradise you will find water games, trampolines and a large playground. If you walk past the nature playground, you end up at Toni's play beach on the lake: Reintaler Lake. Here you can swim or fish or you can relax in sunbathing area.

Children sanitary facilities in aquarium style

Much attention has been paid to the sanitary facilities at the campsite. The marble bathroom for adults has a luxurious look and for the little ones there is sanitary in aquarium style. In an underwater landscape with rocks, mosaics and atmospheric wall paintings, a complete children's wash area has been set up. Bathing is possible in a life-sized fish, brushing teeth in a shell sink and showering in a colourful cave.

Wintersport camping

You can also camp in winter at Camping Seeblick Toni. The campsite is located at the Ski Juwel Alpbachtal Wildschönau, SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser - Brixental and Zillertal Arena ski areas. A cross-country ski run is adjacent to the camping and the ski bus stops at the entrance. When Reintaler Lake is frozen over, you can skate there, play ice hockey and curling.

properties.name: Camping Berau
properties.description:
The clear blue Wolfgangsee is located in the Austrian lake district of Salzkammergut. Berau Campsite is right on the shores of this beautiful lake and features a private beach and jetty. This is a luxurious four-star campsite where you can completely relax and unwind. The beautiful surroundings also invite you to venture out and explore.

Camping on the Wolfgangsee You'll be welcomed by the camping staff in traditional Austrian costume. Some of the camping pitches are located directly on the water's edge. You'll be camping on grassy pitches that are all equipped with electricity. The campsite and the lake are surrounded by high mountains.

Swimming in the Wolfgangsee

The Wolfgangsee is a large lake of almost 13 square kilometres. It is a nice place to swim in the summer. You can also take to the water with a rowing boat, canoe or pedal boat.

The village can be reached via a beautiful walking path along the shores of the lake.

Stone oven pizzas at the campsite

There is a modern Italian restaurant on the campsite where you can enjoy wood-fired pizzas. There is a small bakery and a small supermarket.

There's also a fully equipped fitness room for sporty campers. And of course the area is perfect for outdoor sports.

Explore the surroundings

St. Wolfgang is considered one of the most romantic villages in the region. The village is located at the foot of the Schafberg, where you'll be taken by steam train to the observation point at an elevation of 1,782 metres.

Just outside Strobl is a summer toboggan run where you can whiz down the mountain. The city of Salzburg is just a 45-minute drive away.

properties.name: EuroParcs Presseggersee
properties.description:
EuroParcs Presseggersee is located in the southern Austrian province of Carinthia. On this well-maintained five star campsite, nestled against a hill in the Gail Valley, you camp between trees with stunning views of the Carinthian Alps. Lake Pressegg is a few hundred meters from the campsite. Perfect for bathing and soaking up the sun on the generous lawn and on the beach.

Terraced campsite

The camping pitches are located on beautifully laid out terraces between tall pine trees. Every pitch offers a stunning view of the mountains and forests. You can also stay in one of the various types of mobile homes with covered terrace. Paved roads lead to your camping pitch. The roads are properly constructed and not too steep. As a result you, can always get to your camping pitch with a large caravan or motorhome without too much difficulty.

Swimming with a view

In the central area of the campsite is a heated outdoor swimming pool with a small toddler pool. The swimming pool is surrounded by a lawn with loungers. And always with a fantastic view of those wooded mountains.

For children

This campsite provides plenty of activities for children. Children of all ages will enjoy themselves with the entertainment programme being offered in high season. In addition, the campsite has a playground where they can enjoy climbing and sliding. And, of course, nature is the largest playground of all!

Restaurant Waldschenke

Restaurant Waldschenke is located in the large, white building at the entrance of the campsite. You can enjoy an Austrian dish or a cup of coffee here. The covered terrace offers -inevitably- a majestic view of the green mountain ridge.

properties.name: Camping Gössl
properties.description:
The quiet campsite Gössl is located on the far side of a valley, approximately 350 metres from Gössl. The campsite terrain is essentially one big Alpine pasture, without trees, where you can pitch your tent or caravan as you see fit. Surrounding the campsite is also a meadow, separated from the campsite by a simple wooden fence. You will really be camping in the middle of nature here! The campsite is situated directly on the crystal-clear Grundlsee. The lake has not been discovered by tourists yet.

Choose your own pitch

Everything looks well-tended. The grassy meadow has a couple of paths in good condition. The pitches are not marked: everyone can choose their own spot. This can be fun, although it can quickly get chaotic once it gets busy. Bear in mind that you will need to create your own shade; you will not find any trees here. The campsite is situated practically on the lake. The campsite also has a couple of decent caravans available for rent.

Active neighbours

Your neighbours come from Germany and the Netherlands, both in the peak and in the low season. Many Austrians come here on the weekends as well. The reason for this is the public swimming beach, which is situated next to the campsite. People come here for the mountains and for the lake, which is suitable for many activities such as swimming, surfing, boating and scuba diving (there is a diving school).

The campsite does not have a campsite shop or restaurant. Next to the camping grounds, you will find a small supermarket (and a larger one 5 km away), a bakery and a butcher. You will find a couple of restaurants on the lake. The restaurant situated right next to the campsite has a fine patio.

properties.name: Ideal Camping Lampele
properties.description:
Camping Lampele is located along the eastern shore of the Ossiacher See, directly on the water's edge. Everything is very well organised on this neat campsite in scenic Carinthia. The lake is ideal for anyone who loves water or water sports. There is a strip of beach along the shoreline and a wooden pier which juts out into the lake. The somewhat older children can use the water slide, which hurdles them a bit further on into deeper water at quite a speed.

Ample privacy

The pitches are located on a well maintained, vast and slightly sloping terrain with excellent turf. The pitches are spacious or in any case sufficiently large. This means a reasonable degree of privacy. The pitches extend to the lake shore, but those places are very popular and therefore quickly occupied.

Restaurant

The restaurant is located near the entrance of the campsite. The atmosphere is very convivial and the prices are remarkably reasonable. You can also enjoy sitting on the terrace! Also here: a snack bar and a pizzeria (take-away possible). Furthermore, the campsite has a supermarket with a good range.

Water fun in and on the lake

You can have a nice swim in the lake. The lake is also excellent for canoeing, kayaking, snorkelling, windsurfing, waterskiing, or floating around in a rubber dinghy. For the sporty holiday maker the campsite has a fitness room, excursion programmes, walking trips (also guided) and cycling routes.

properties.name: Ilsenhof am Turnersee - Panoramacamping
properties.description:
Ilsenhof am Turnersee - Panoramacamping is situated near Sankt-Kanzian, in the Austrian region of Southern Carinthia. This is a quiet campsite in a beautiful nature reserve, far from the crowds. From many spots around the campsite, you can enjoy panoramic views of the mountainous surroundings. On top of that, you will be camping just half a kilometre from Turnersee, a lovely little swimming lake. It’s an ideal destination for those seeking peace and quiet as well as for active nature lovers, as the area offers mountain sports opportunities and walking and cycling routes. With the free Aktiv Card Südkärnten, you can receive discounts on a wide range of organised activities in the region.

Choose a spot with a panoramic view

At this family campsite you will find a well-maintained camping area. You can walk or cycle to your pitch along gently sloping gravel paths. Many pitches offer unobstructed views of the surrounding mountains and fields, and of course Lake Turnersee. The campsite rents out various fully equipped holiday homes and apartments by this lake.

Lovely days at the beach at the Turnersee

Do you enjoy beach life and swimming in natural waters, but prefer to avoid the crowds of popular seaside resorts? Then this is your ideal holiday destination. Just a ten-minute walk from the campsite takes you to a lovely little beach on the Turnersee, one of the warmest swimming lakes in Europe. In summer, the water temperature can reach 28 degrees! The grassy sunbathing areas by the lake offer sunny and shady spots to relax, with unobstructed views of the Karawanken mountains. At this beach you will also find a good restaurant: Strandrestaurant Ilsenhof. You can order a refreshing drink, a tasty snack or a nutritious meal here.

properties.name: Camping Finsterhof
properties.description:
This nature campsite in Neulengbach, Austria is located in a quiet, green area and is surrounded by fields, meadows and forests. This makes the campsite a perfect base for hiking and cycling trips. Camping Finsterhof is an ideal campsite for nature lovers and active holidaymakers who are looking for peace, relaxation and a cosy atmosphere.

Family business

The campsite is on the grounds of a beautiful old farm. Here you can opt for a spacious camping pitch with plenty of privacy. There are both sunny and shady pitches. Dogs and cats are also very welcome here. The campsite is still a family business and has been passionately run by the third generation since 2022. A lot of work has been done since then, including the installation of a Wi-Fi connection and the renovation of the sanitary facilities.

Pick your own fruit

Camping authentically and in harmony with nature is of paramount importance to the owners, and this is reflected throughout the campsite. For example, seasonal organic vegetables are grown, and fresh fruit, such as strawberries and other berry varieties, can even be picked on site. The patisserie and bread service from the local bakery complete the feel-good factor during your holiday.

Playground and petting zoo

The little ones can romp around on the playground or marvel at the animals in the small petting zoo. The campsite organises various workshops and events such as yoga, picnics and craft afternoons. Those looking for fun water recreation activities can go to one of the many swimming pools and lakes in the immediate vicinity of the campsite.

properties.name: MICAMPA Wien Donau
properties.description:
With its stately opera houses, huge palaces and the amazing city hall, Vienna is a popular destination for a city break. MICAMPA Wien Donau is located just outside the centre of Vienna. Many campers stay at this campsite for one or several nights before visiting Vienna. Planning to stay a bit longer? There is still plenty to do. For example, visit the Donauinsel, cycle along the Danube or hike through the Donau-Auen National Park.

Well-maintained site with only camping pitches

The pitches on the MICAMPA Wien Donau site are well maintained and all separated with hedges and plants, giving you plenty of privacy. At the back of the site, there is another large field that can accommodate about 100 tent campers.

Enjoy a delicious evening meal in the campsite restaurant

Have you returned to your tent after a long day in Vienna's city centre, tired but satisfied? Then you can grab a bite to eat at the restaurant with outdoor terrace. For example, pizzas, sandwiches, pastries and cold and hot drinks. Prefer to prepare your own meal? Then get your groceries from the shop at reception.

Vienna: a paradise for culture lovers

This campsite is ideally located for visiting Vienna. In ten minutes you can walk to the Donaustadtbrücke metro station, from where you can take the metro to the city centre. Bus 92B (from a stop close to the campsite) also gets you there quickly. Once in the city centre, admire the many historic buildings and (art) museums, or enjoy an opera or operetta, for which Vienna is so famous.

properties.name: MICAMPA Wien Wienerwald
properties.description:
Vienna is one of Europe's most beautiful cities with its monumental buildings, chic city centre and, of course, its many operas. MICAMPA Wien Wienerwald is an ideal base to discover the beautiful Austrian capital. Renovated in 2024, this city campsite is located in the quiet district of Penzing, in the west of the city. It is also a good starting point for hiking and mountain biking in the vast, forested mountains west of Vienna.

What is the layout of this campsite?

Behind the barrier and reception, you'll find a well-organised camping area, where all pitches are located along an oval-shaped road. In the middle of the site, there are two large tent camping fields. Especially for holidaymakers sleeping in tents, there is a charging station for smartphones. Prefer a bit more luxury and your own toilet and shower facilities? By 2024, modern tiny houses were installed.

Dine in the cosy café-restaurant

When you get back to the campsite after a long day of city walks, you might not feel like cooking. Fortunately, the campsite has its own café-restaurant with a cosy terrace. Conveniently, there is also a shop for your basic necessities at reception. For relaxation, this campsite has a meeting room, a playground and a mini library.

Enjoy Vienna's architectural beauty

Most campers stay at this campsite for one or two nights before visiting Vienna's historic city centre. Conveniently, you can leave your car on the campsite. Take the bus to Hütteldorf and travel on by metro, and you'll be at Karlsplatz in half an hour.

properties.name: Camp. Costa Nova do Prado
properties.description:
Camping Nova da Prado is a campsite on the west coast of Portugal, located directly on the Atlantic Ocean. As a result the campsite attracts many water sports enthusiasts, especially surfers. The colourful campsite is specially laid out for campers with tents. The campsite is situated near the fishing village of Costa Nova, on a green piece of land between the Aveiro River and the sea.

Colourful

The campsite is in the style of the colourful, striped buildings one finds in Costa Nova. The entrance gate, which gives access to a driveway leading to the reception building, has a cheerful white and blue striped motif, which is regularly repeated on the campsite.

Pitches galore

The pitches have the upper hand on the campsite. With no less than 450 camping pitches you are spoilt for choice to find an ideal one: at the foot of the dunes, near the entrance or close to the toilet block. Please note: some tent pitches are rather small and are close together, especially in peak season. If you value privacy, make sure that you choose a slightly larger pitch or one of the rental accommodation units.

Surfing

You don't have to leave the camping grounds for an active challenge. Climb over the dunes, get into your wetsuit and hop on a surfboard. The sea immediately behind the campsite is a surfers' paradise. However, it is not only surfers that are welcome here. You can bring your fishing rod, boat or canoe as well.

properties.name: Camping Arenal de Morís
properties.description:
Camping Arenal de Morís is situated on the greenest coast of Spain: the Costa Verde in the north of Spain. Here you will find calm, wide sandy beaches, steep cliffs and mountainous hinterland. Parque Nacional Picos de Europa, recognised as one of the most beautiful nature reserves in Europe, is situated in this area. An ideal spot for nature lovers, birdwatchers, surfers and sea anglers.

Camping with a sea view

The neat pitches are laid out on terraces or in rows, all along paved roads on a large open field. The terrain is slightly sloping. There is little shelter, but this makes for a superb sea view throughout. The campsite is surrounded by the mountains of the Suave nature reserve. Rather rent accommodation? There are some nice bungalows on the campsite.

Swimming a few lengths and bodyboarding

Camping guests who like swimming have a choice between the campsite swimming pool and the beach. The rectangular swimming pool is centrally located - ideal for swimming a few lengths. A neatly clipped hedge around the swimming pool provides privacy. From the swimming pool you have a view of the wooded and mountainous surroundings. Rather swim in open water? Within walking distance lies the beautiful, child-friendly sandy beach, surrounded by green cliffs. The sea has perfect waves for bodyboarding.

Playing in a lemon orchard

Tired of swimming? Towel dry and hit a few balls on the tennis court. Children will enjoy themselves in the playground, located in an idyllic lemon orchard. You will also find picnic benches here.

Tapas on the terrace

The campsite shop is well stocked. In the restaurant you can order daily menus, mostly regional dishes. When the weather is good, you can relax on a large terrace.

properties.name: Camping Carlos III
properties.description:
Camping Carlos III is in the heart of the Spanish Andalusia, not far from Córdoba. This level site has both pitches and accommodations. For a refreshing dip, go to the large swimming pool surrounded by a sunbathing area with parasols. A delicious meal can be had in the restaurant Camping Carlos III is a good home base for exploring the interior of Andalusia.

Camping in a quiet area

Camping Carlos III is in a quiet area. The spacious site has sandy or pebbled pitches that are at least 70 m2. These pitches are equipped with electricity and drinking water. The pitches are encircled by trees, providing shade on sunny days. You can also stay overnight in a mobile home, studio, wooden chalet or luxury villa.

Animal park and a supermarket

At Camping Carlos III you can have fun on the mini golf course or the tennis court and children can play in the playground. Animal lovers will also feel at home here. The campsite’s animal park has various species of animals, such as chickens, rabbits, goats and ducks. The restaurant serves local dishes.

Explore Córdoba and Seville

You experience the real Andalusia in Córdoba (34 km). The Mezquita, a building that is both a mosque and a cathedral, is a must-see. Other recommendations in Córdoba include the Alcazar de los Reyes Cristianos palace, the charming patios in the San Basilio district and the Puente Romano de Córdoba bridge. Seville (109 km) is another one of Andalusia’s gems.

properties.name: Costa del Sol Glamping Village
properties.description:
The sun on your face, a gentle breeze through the palm trees and the feeling of really getting away from it all. Welcome to Costa del Sol Glamping Village, a lovely base in sunny Andalusia. The focus here is on relaxing, enjoying and doing what you like. On site, you will find a swimming pool, bungalows, luxury glamping accommodation and all kinds of modern facilities. For a trip, visit cities like Málaga (34 km) and Marbella (30 km). The Costa del Sol is literally at your feet here.

Accommodation for everyone

The accommodation at Costa del Sol Glamping Village is different. No standard tent, but stylish accommodation combining comfort and outdoor living. Just the two of you? Then the Amos Studio bungalows and access to the spa are a good choice. The Leo and Neri bungalows, with multiple bedrooms, are the right choice for families. Some accommodation is pet-friendly too. Fancy the real glamping feel? The Hanna tent feels like camping but with the comfort of a bungalow.

Everything you need

Start your day with a refreshing dip in the pool or work up a sweat in the modern gym. Afterwards, relax in the spa with a lovely wellness treatment. Meanwhile, the children can have fun at the Mini Club. You can relax on the terrace or have a nice lunch at Gastro Suel Restaurant. In the evening, there’s plenty of fun in the open-air Anfiteatro, where shows and entertainment are on the programme.

properties.name: Camping Playa Joyel
properties.description:
The large, lively campsite Playa Joyel is directly located by the sea and on a beautiful sandy beach. Camping guests enjoy coming to this luxurious campsite with its excellent facilities for sun, sea and beach. On the well maintained campsite you will be allocated a pitch which varies in size (70 - 100 m2). With eight hundred touring pitches and two hundred permanent pitches, this is a very large campsite (24 ha). There are 115 rental bungalows available.

Swimming

There is an attractive swimming pool (200 m2) with lawn and jacuzzi. The toddler pool measures 80 m2. On the large lawn you can play soccer or badminton. You can also play a game of tennis or mini golf for a fee.

Animal park

The private animal park of the campsite is worth a visit. In peak season this animal park opens for an hour twice a week. Watch the indigenous cows, bulls, ducks, pigs and ostriches. Children will also enjoy themselves in the playground. In summer fun activities are organised for children from five to ten years old.

Campsite shop

In the campsite shop you will find a wide range of groceries, but also sun umbrellas, kites and everything you need for a perfect beach holiday. It goes without saying that fresh bread is delivered daily.

Pasta by the sea

In the modest restaurant you have a choice of a small menu (mainly different kinds of pasta and take-away meals). In peak season you can order grilled chicken or fetch a cold treat from the ice cream kiosk. It is a ten-minute walk to the lively town of Noja, a beach resort with many eateries and a splendid view of the bay.

properties.name: Camping Sol i Neu
properties.description:
A hidden gem in Spanish Catalonia. At Camping Sol i Neu, you’ll enjoy the peace and beauty of nature, close to Aigüestortes National Park and Lake Sant Maurici. The campsite is mainly popular with children but is also a wonderful destination for couples. With a swimming pool with a waterfall, the Escrita river running right through the campsite and unbeatable views, you’ll find everything you need for a great camping adventure.

Between the mountains and near the river

You’ll camp here on large, green pitches, with a view of the surrounding mountains. And maybe even of the river too because some of the pitches are on the other side of the water. Cross the small bridge to access your pitch. Previous campers praise the campsite for its clean toilet and washing facilities and good showers.

Enjoy water and fresh rolls

Take a dip in the pool or lay on a towel by the side of the pool. The pool isn’t big, but it’s clean and you’ll have a great time there. Fresh rolls and croissants can be ordered at reception. Or stretch your legs early in the morning and get your breakfast from the bakery in the village nearby.

Explore nature

Here, you'll camp close to Aigüestortes National Park, where you'll also find Lake Sant Maurici. Wear your walking boots here because you won't want to miss the extraordinary views and fresh mountain air.

properties.name: La Siesta Salou Resort & Camping
properties.description:
In the centre of Salou you will find the child-friendly campsite La Siesta Salou: an oasis of peace and quiet in a vibrant environment. From the campsite you can reach the fine sandy beaches of Salou within a few minutes. On the campsite there are no fewer than four outdoor swimming pools and several restaurants. The entertainment team also organises all kinds of activities. For young and old from morning to evening.

Well-kept grounds

On the way to your camping pitch you can already start admiring the lush vegetation and flowers that adorn the paved roads of the campsite. On the well maintained grounds you will find camping pitches in various sizes. On another portion of this resort there are luxury bungalows (with flat screen TV, verandah and air conditioner), mobile homes and apartments. 

Swimming paradise for all ages

With as many as four outdoor swimming pools there is plenty water fun to be had on this campsite from the end of March to mid-October. Via various flights of stairs you can enter the water and swim past little islands with palm trees, rock formations and waterfalls. The swimming pools also have several water slides and the little ones have not been forgotten either with their own water slide and toddler pool. You can relax under the massage jets, in the hot tub or on one of the many freely available loungers next to the swimming pool. 

Sanitary facilities and car wash

The sanitary facilities on the campsite are spotless. There are two dedicated cabins for disabled persons. There is also a special area with a baby bath and a spot to empty a chemical toilet. At the entrance of the campsite and there is a car wash area. Here you can conveniently wash your car, caravan or camper van. It is also possible to scrub down your awning with some soapy suds here.

properties.name: Talaia Plaza Ecoresort
properties.description:
Pine forests, beach and sea. These are the key ingredients for a holiday on the Costa Brava. And Talaia Plaza EcoResort has them all. Here you'll enjoy a relaxing holiday on the crystal clear waters of the Sa Riera Bay, less than 400 metres from the Mediterranean Sea. You and your children will be at the beach in no time. The cosy and typically Spanish village of Begur is just around the corner.

Sustainable and tasteful

Once you arrive at the resort, you'll head to your accommodation. All accommodations underline the luxurious feeling that Talaia Plaza exudes. From bungalows and lodges to glamping tents, all accommodations are made of sustainable and tasteful materials.

From swimming in the sea to relaxing in a jacuzzi

What could be better than starting the day with a swim? You can do this in the beautifully landscaped swimming pool. Your children can enjoy themselves in the shallow end of the pool while you relax on one of the sun loungers. And its not just the water in the swimming pool that is so wonderful. The waters of the bay are also blissful and above all… close by! You can walk to the beach with the children in your flip flops.

Pizza from the food truck

At the end of the day you don't have to go straight into the kitchen to make dinner. The park has a restaurant with a beautiful view over the hills and the Mediterranean Sea. The pool also features a bar where you can order a nice drink after a refreshing dip. Craving home-made pizza? You can get it from the food truck.

properties.name: Kim's Camping S.L
properties.description:
Kim's Camping is a quiet family campsite just five minutes from the seaside resort of Llafranc on the Mediterranean shore. This promises to be a fun water holiday at the beach! There is a large swimming pool with a water playground and opportunities for the children to join in crafts, play games and dance at the kids club. Disabled people can book a bungalow with customised facilities.

Shaded terraced campsite

Driving onto the campsite, you first follow a somewhat steep road. The central part of the campsite is level. The well laid-out and marked camping pitches are medium-sized and vary in size. They are located on the plateau or up against the hilly part of the campsite. The pitches are mostly shaded, ideal during a hot summer. There are also larger camping pitches. If you didn't bring your own camping equipment with you, there is a wide range of mobile homes, chalets, apartments and bungalows to choose from.

Large swimming pool with water playground

The large swimming pool is centrally located on the campsite, next to a lovely sunbathing lawn. There is also a toddler pool. In 2018, a new water playground for children was built, the Splashground, with water jets and fountains. Next to the swimming pool is café-restaurant Toc de Sal. The terrace has a view of the pool so that you can relax and enjoy a drink whilst keeping an eye on the children. The lifeguard will help you by looking out for them as well. 

Playing at the kids club

At the kids club, it's time for face-painting, playing, painting, crafts and dancing. Children can keep themselves entertained during the entire week in July and August and on the weekends from Easter until the end of June.

properties.name: Ragnerudssjöns Camping & Stugby
properties.description:
Amidst the typical Swedish landscape of Dalsland, on a lake which is surrounded by forests on all sides, you will find Ragnerudssjöns Camping & Stugby. The campsite with more than one hundred pitches is located at the foot of the vast Kroppefjäll nature reserve. In addition, the campsite also has fourteen holiday cottages (stugor) suitable for four to eight persons. You feel one with the breathtaking Swedish nature here.

Nature lovers

With its location on the lake, between forests and at the edge of the Kroppefjäll nature reserve, the campsite attracts mainly nature lovers who can indulge in long walking and cycling trips in this area. At the reception you will be given all information you need (maps, tips, routes). If you wish, you can join a guided tour.

Family campsite

Ragnerudssjöns is a real family campsite where you can hire boats for fishing on the lake. A great activity for adults, while the children are being entertained (in peak season only). You can also swim in the lake, which has a sandy beach and lawn.

Restaurant and snack bar

Restaurant Ragnerud Kök offers a small menu, but also take-away meals. There is also a snack bar where you can order a quick bite to eat. Food is almost exclusively prepared with ecologically and locally produced ingredients.

Elk spotting

The forests of Dalsland are teeming with eland, but it takes some doing to spot them. You stand the best chance of seeing them at dusk and dawn along one of the narrow forest pathways.

properties.name: Camp Route 45AB
properties.description:
Camp Route 45 is in a lovely spot by River Fyrån between the Swedish cities of Östersund and Strömsund. A pleasant atmosphere dominates this small-scale nature campsite, and everything is well maintained. The natural swimming pond invites you for a refreshing swim. You can even camp right by the water. It is ideal for those that like quiet and space. The village of Hammerdal with a supermarket and several restaurants is within walking distance. You experience the impressive landscapes at their best walking, cycling, from a kayak or on a horse. Besides the lovely pitches, there are also comfortably furnished huts.

By the water

You can choose from various types of spacious pitches surrounded by the natural green, unspoilt nature. If you'd rather pitch by the river than runs past the campsite or the large field appeals to you, there are smaller tent pitches specially for cyclist and motorbike riders. The clearly laid out site also has nice huts and cabins equipped with all modern conveniences. The toilet and washing facilities are very neat and tidy, with nice hot showers. Within a few steps, you arrive at the natural swimming lake with a small diving board.

Delicious burgers

You can try owner Martijn's homemade burgers in the charming restaurant. There are various menus, and this restaurant has become popular among the Swedish population. When you wake up in the morning, you can start the new camping day with fresh bread rolls. Walk to the village for your groceries and you can get a bite to eat there too.

properties.name: Dragsö Camping & Stugby
properties.description:
The vibrant city of Karlskrona is easily accessible from Dragsö Camping & Stugby by bicycle, boat or on foot. The Blekinge region is nicknamed "the garden of Sweden" because of its versatile nature. You will find lovely villages, deep coniferous forests and a vast coast. Which makes camping in the heart of this archipelago perfect for anyone who loves natural beauty and culture.

View of the water

Next to the log cabin where the reception is located is one of the highlights of the campsite; the mini golf course where the cultural heirlooms from Karlskrona have been recreated. The campsite is laid out as a U-turn. The pitches differ in size and in the distance to the sea. You can choose your pitch yourself. Although you'll have a sea view from every pitch, there are about fifty pitches where you can camp directly on the water.

There are also typical Swedish cabins to stay in, which have been furnished with great care and with high-quality materials.

Natural pool in front of your door

As soon as you get out of your tent or caravan, you can look out on the Baltic Sea and walk directly onto the sandy beach. There is access to the sea at various places on the campsite, for example via a jetty or the beach.

Restaurants around the corner

Both the camp shop and the restaurant are located at the entrance. There is an extensive selection for your daily shopping. Larger supermarkets can be found around Karlskrona, as well as restaurants and cafes. But you don't really have to leave the campsite for a tasty snack. There is a small restaurant with a terrace overlooking the water.

properties.name: Bergafjärdens Camping
properties.description:
Amidst nature and located directly on the Gulf of Bothnia, slightly to the south of Sundsvall, lies the beautiful Bergafjärdens Campsite. There is nothing but nature in the surrounding area. The campsite also has a large number of trees, which provide ample shade on the spacious pitches. The campsite has a very spacious private beach along the Bergafjärden. Because the Gulf of Bothnia is relatively shallow, the water warms quickly in summer. Glorious!

Wonderful facilities

The reception also serves as a shop, which is quite well stocked. There is also a lot of tourist information available here. You will not have want of anything at this campsite. Everything is in excellent condition, well-maintained and kept clean. Showers are payable with a chip card which will be issued to you when you check in.

Restaurant

The campsite has an amiable restaurant with an extensive menu. You can also get takeaway meals to eat in your own tent, caravan or motorhome. Jenny’s café forms the friendly meeting point of Bergafjärden with lovely coffee and cake.

Coast and sea

The coast north of Sundsvall is also referred to as ‘Höga Kusten’ (the high coast). The reason for this is that some parts rise steeply from the sea. Distinctive is that the land, and with it the coast, are still rising due to post-glacial rebound after the retreat of the ice cap of the last Ice Age. As a result, the land rises by some 8 mm each year.

properties.name: Camping La Cibourg Centre de vacances
TCS Camping Estavayer La Nouvelle Plage
Camping Clos de la George SA
Camping Jungfrau
properties.description:
The campsite is situated in the Lauterbrunnen region, in the town with the same name, in a beautiful valley with stunning views of the mountains. The centre of Lauterbrunnen and the train station are within walking distance of the campsite.

Where will you sleep?

Camping Jungfrau is a large, well maintained terraced campsite with mainly spacious pitches, which are not demarcated everywhere. This means that in high season the pitches may gradually become more compact. There is much greenery and well maintained grass. There are pitches with and without shade, also depending on the position of the sun behind the mountains. The sanitary facilities are very clean and tidy. They also have family bathrooms. You have not brought your own tent or caravan? You can rent all types of accommodation: mobile homes, trekker huts, rooms, studios and bungalows.

Natural beauty

The region is perfect for outdoor activities. Hiking in the truly beautiful countryside is an absolute must. Within walking distance of the campsite, you’ll find Switzerland’s largest waterfall, the Trumbach Falls. You can also go mountain biking and trail running. The campsite is also a good base to visit the Jungfraujoch.

Cooking or the Chef?

The supermarket sells fresh bread and has quite a large assortment of groceries, thus cooking your own meals should not be a problem. However, the restaurant is a serious contender. The amiable atmosphere, comprehensive menu and lovely terrace complete the picture. Not to forget the sociable bar.

properties.name: Camping Simplonblick
properties.description:
Valais is a region in the south of Switzerland with the most sunshine hours and the highest mountains in Europe, for instance, the Matterhorn. Just an hour's drive from the Italian border lies this quiet campsite. Camping Simplonblick is a good match for campers who don't set great store by luxury. At the back of the campsite, there is a forest, and the view of the beautiful mountain peaks is picture-perfect. Put on your hiking boots or grab a bike to explore the beautiful nature reserve. The campsite looks dated, but the new manager is changing things up.

Camping in Valais

Just steps from the A9, the campsite driveway is behind a motel and gas station. Even if you are travelling through to Italy, the location is very central, and in the beautiful surroundings, there are many places of interest within easy reach. Once you arrive at the camping fields, everything gets quieter, and a sprawling view of the high mountains awaits you. There is a small supermarket a ten-minute walk away, and the Rhone River flows behind the nearby village of Raron.

A view from your pitch

The highlight of the campsite is the view of the mountains. As soon as you step out of the tent or caravan, you are already enjoying the beauty of nature. In the summer, you will find campers from different countries, including many Swiss families staying on a permanent site.

The sanitary building has been refurbished by the new manager. Please note that at the front of the site, you may hear traffic at some times of the day.

properties.name: Camping Seefeld Park Sarnen
properties.description:
Camping Seefeld Park Sarnen is a very luxurious campsite with beautiful pitches in the fascinating Obwalden region. A prime location, situated directly on Lake Sarnen. You will be surrounded by quiet lakes and tall mountains. The campsite is also a water paradise with the lake, a very large outdoor swimming pool, a heated outdoor pool with a water slide, and a wading pool. Everything is extremely well-maintained.

Luxurious ambiance

Like the entrance, the grounds make a very well-kept and high-quality impression. Everything is clean, harmoniously structured and pleasantly decorated. The campsite has both paved pitches and grass pitches, some of which have trees. The entire site is flat and the pitches are 80-100 m2 in size. There are different categories available, so there is something for every budget.

Swimming fun

On the campsite, directly next to Lake Sarnen, you will find a beautiful swimming pool/water paradise, which is also the public pool. Entrance to the pool is free for campsite guests. The swimming pool is very large and luxurious. The pool is elevated so that you will be able to enjoy the beautiful views of the region while swimming. By the lake is a large terrace with a jetty.

The playground with a lighthouse is located directly in front of the restaurant. For older children, there is a larger playground within walking distance.

Excellent dining

The campsite has an excellent restaurant with a beautiful terrace, directly on Lake Sarnen. In the reception building, there is a small campsite shop with local products for daily use, including fresh bread (seasonal).

Sanitary facilities

The sanitary facilities are high-quality, clean and heated.

properties.name: Camping Hüttenberg AG
properties.description:
Camping Hüttenberg is well organised and exudes a stylish and high quality ambiance. It is a site which scores highly in terms of atmosphere and well-being. The bonus of this partly-terraced campsite is the spectacular panorama of the Rhine Valley and the Bodensee. At the heart of the campsite is a sizeable and excellently cared for swimming pool. There is a creatively equipped playground for children, a true play Valhalla.

Great pitches

The grounds are neatly laid out and well maintained. The pitches are demarcated, spacious and differ from each other. Some pitches have a vast view of the area, others have less view. Some pitches are located on terraces. The surface is made of grass and hardened in places. Outside the barriers there are additional pitches for campers. Do you want to rent overnight accommodation? Book a quirky pod, a barrel-shaped little house. Beautifully furnished and well maintained.

Beautiful swimming pool

At the heart of the campsite is an outdoor swimming pool (and toddler pool) which has been tastefully designed. The swimming pool borders on a terrace, sun loungers and a large lawn with nice grass. The large, creatively equipped playground for children is very attractive and includes a trampoline, sizeable sandpit, climbing wall and alternative mini golf course (at eye level).

Grocery shopping and dining out

There is a modern, well maintained and well-stocked supermarket. You will find all ingredients here for a cooked meal or a lovely breakfast. There is also a restaurant with terrace from where you have a spectacular view of the Rhine Valley and the Bodensee.

properties.name: Camping Seehorn
properties.description:
Camping Seehorn is popular and highly praised for its location and tranquillity. The campsite has a private lawn located directly along the beach of the Bodensee. On this unique piece of land, where you also find the restaurant, you can enjoy yourself all day. You can embark on endless walks and cycle trips along the Bodensee, so you are assured of yet another bit of holiday pleasure.

A warm welcome

You are warmly welcomed on this modestly equipped, but well maintained campsite.

The pitches have electricity and water connections. There are only few trees, so roll down the sunshades! The majority of pitches have a grass surface. There is a separate section for motor homes. The campsite is frequented by a diverse, international public throughout the year.

Swimming and cycling

By the lake shore you can find a beautiful playing and sunbathing lawn. Lovely if you prefer spending the day on grass rather than on sand and pebbles. You can swim in the Bodensee and there is a toddler pool for the little ones on the campsite. The campsite borders directly on the cycle path around the Bodensee.

Eating and drinking

The restaurant with cosy terrace is located on the lawn. There is also a snack bar and a smaller restaurant (with small menu). Do your own cooking? If so, you can go to the supermarket in Arbon or Egnach. Fresh bread is available on the campsite. You can prepare your meals in the communal cooking area.

Luxury bathroom facilities

The luxury sanitary facilities have recently been completely renovated. There are also family bath rooms with double basins, spacious showers and a private toilet.

properties.name: Camping Drusus
properties.description:
Prague is undoubtedly one of the most beautiful cities in Europe. Would you like to visit this city from a quiet campsite? Then campsite Drusus, near the village of Třebonice, about ten kilometres from Prague centre, is truly ideal. At this modestly sized family-friendly campsite you will find the tranquillity of a green rural environment. And at the same time, you can be in the bustling city centre within half an hour by public transport. There you can admire a number of sites such as Prague Castle, Charles Bridge and the Old Town Square with its astronomical clock. This campsite is also convenient for campers passing through. The nearest exit from the E50 motorway is just one kilometre away.

Modest in scale and park-like

Drusus is a park-like campsite with beautiful vegetation and several different types of trees. The surface of the pitches are short-mowed grass. When booking, please feel free to specify whether you would prefer a sunny or a shady pitch. The campsite also rents out fully equipped mobile homes (with air conditioning) and cosy holiday cottages. There is also a guesthouse with six charming rooms. This guesthouse is open all year round.

Own restaurant with brewery

If you are returning to the campsite tired but satisfied after a day in Prague, the campsite restaurant is the ideal place to unwind. You can enjoy delicious meals in the eccentric ambiance of this restaurant. The menu includes freshly brewed beers from the brewery next to the campsite. Basic necessities are also available at reception, where you can order your breakfast for the next morning.

properties.name: Camping La Garenne
properties.description:
Fancy a holiday at a quiet campsite with a lovely swimming pool for your children? Then Camping La Garenne is the place for you! The Périgord Noir region is the most well-known and touristic part of the Dordogne department. But you won't notice the crowds at this campsite! Set amongst oak and coniferous trees, La Garenne is an idyllic place where you can relax and unwind. The Vézère River is located about 7 kilometres from the campsite and offers plenty of fun water recreation activities. This campsite is an ideal base for exploring all the Périgord Noir has to offer. The nearest village of Peyrignac is less than a 2-minute walk from the campsite. So you can easily go shopping when needed.

Family campsite surrounded by nature

At La Garenne campsite, you'll be camping in shady spots situated among the trees. Don't have your own camping equipment? Then consider renting one of our lovely accommodations. You can choose from mobile homes, chalets and bungalows. You'll be camping alongside lots of families with children up to the age of twelve, but also campers without children.

Take it to the next level

Start your day with a refreshing dip in the pool. Your children can play in the water while you kick back and relax on a comfortable lounge chair.

Camping La Garenne considers hospitality to be of paramount importance and ensures that guests will always have plenty to do. There are a wide variety of activities to choose from - both on and near the campsite - each and every day.

properties.name: Country Park Touquin
properties.description:
The friendly family campsite Country Park Touquin is situated in a quiet forest, some sixty km south- east of Paris. This means the hustle and bustle of the metropole or Disneyland during the day and enjoying the peace and quiet on the campsite at the end of the day. A day at leisure is another option, because there is enough to do for young and old 'at home'.

Well maintained grounds

The site looks quiet, friendly and well maintained. You are staying on beautiful pitches, demarcated with a variety of bushes. They are partly shaded by different trees. The new terrain is rather open, therefore, an ideal spot for sun worshippers. If you prefer to rent accommodation, you can rent a tent or chalet.

Water slide

The heated swimming pool is centrally located on the campsite and has been updated with a long water slide. Great fun for children. The swimming pool has a playful design and lies partly in the shade. It is surrounded by a large number of loungers for sunbathers. There is also a toddler pool.

Multisports terrain and fishing pond

For children there is a multisports terrain, a playground with some equipment, a table football game and table tennis tables. The café has a TV and a piano. Fishing enthusiasts can cast a line in the fish pond (with carp and trout). You can make use of the mini golf course for a fee.

Attractive campsite restaurant

In peak season you can enjoy basic dishes in the large and friendly campsite restaurant. You can also order take-away meals, as well as fresh bread (on order). Rather go to the bakery? You will find one in the village of Touquin (5 minute drive). There is a supermarket at some 7 km from the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Château de Lacomté
properties.description:
Camping Château de Lacomté is situated at the top of the Parc Naturel et Géoparc Des Causses du Quercy. This nature park in the south of the country is very thickly wooded. There are also large limestone plateaus and wild rivers. To fully enjoy this natural beauty, book a pitch at this child-free, and therefore quiet campsite situated on the grounds of a small castle.

Camping pitch with car?

You have arrived on a well maintained campsite with lots of green. The pitches, just over eighty in total, are beautiful and spacious (minimum 110 m2). Special to this campsite are the so-called 'Freedom Pitches'. These are specially designed for campervan owners, cycle campers or backpackers because you get a small car at your disposal. There are also four special pitches for motor home owners. These are paved and no less than 140 m2 in size.

Water fun!

At this campsite you will find a swimming pool (300 m2) with sun loungers and parasols on the side. The pool is in full sunlight. For even more relaxation, you can book a treatment, such as a massage or manicure, at the beauty centre. There is also a sauna.

Cosy music evenings

In high season, there is entertainment twice a week. All sorts of things are organized. How about quizzes, live music, cocktail evenings and sociable get-togethers? During these evenings, tasty dishes from the barbecue are often served. During the day, you can play sports, including tennis, table tennis and jeu-de-boules. Feeling hungry? Then head to the Château de Lacomté's beautiful restaurant: named Les Étoiles.

properties.name: Monti’s Camping
properties.description:
Monti’s Camping is located at the foot of the German Siebengebirge mountains. The campsite is located in the village of Oberpleis and has a special location between town and country. Nearby you will find the vast natural area of the hills and the Rhine. Historical towns like Königswinter, Bonn and Cologne are also only a short distance away.
