Stay overnight in a log cabin

After the friendly welcome, you will easily find your way to the campsites. This campsite has many permanent sites and a separate field for tourists. You do not want to sleep in your own tent, camper or caravan? Then rent one of the authentic "Forest Spirit Huts".

Shopping and sports

For your shopping, you will have to go to the village (800 m). Here you will find a few supermarkets, shops, restaurants and (ice cream) cafes. The sports fields are located just outside of the camping. Here there is a (gravel) soccer pitch.

Town and nature

With so much beauty in the surrounding area, this campsite is a fantastic starting point for day trips and there is a vast choice of excursions in this region. Nature lovers will thoroughly enjoy the Siebengebirge Mountains, one of the most beautiful hilly areas in Germany. Alternatively, enjoy one of the hiking and cycling routes along the Rhine and take a boat trip on the river.

properties.name: Familienpark Senftenberger See
properties.description:
Senftenberger See Family Park is located in an ideal location, right on a large recreational lake in the middle of the Lausitzer Seenland. This campsite is situated in a beautiful area with forests, rivers and lakes. You can discover all this scenic beauty by bike, as there are more than five hundred kilometres of cycle paths in the vicinity. This campsite is very popular with families with children, especially during the high season. The campsite offers its own beach, entertainment, a nice indoor playground, sports facilities, a waterslide, a large supermarket and various restaurants, among other amenities.

A well-designed campsite

Senftenberger See Family Park is a campsite with a well thought-out layout. There are circular camping fields. The pitches on this wooded site are separated from each other by trees and shrubs. There are rental accommodations for two to six people and in different comfort levels.

There are three sanitary buildings spread across the grounds. The facilities are well maintained. Two of the buildings are wheelchair accessible.

Ideal location on the Senftenberger See

This campsite is located directly on a large sandy beach on the Senftenberger See recreational lake. You can swim, fish, dive, windsurf, sail and sup on this lake. The campsite also features a fun waterslide.

Plenty of entertainment for the youngest campers

There's a lot to do at the campsite, especially for children. For example, they can participate in fun craft mornings guided by our mascot, Froggi. There's also a beautiful indoor playground, an escape room, a children's cinema and fun nature lessons from a real forest ranger.

properties.name: Camping Le Reclus
properties.description:
A stone's throw away from Italy and bordering the Vanoise National Park you will find Camping Le Reclus. A magnificent spot for seekers of tranquillity, nature lovers and mountain hikers. There are endless possibilities to explore the area. Furthermore, there are lively terraces and fine restaurants in the nearby town of Bourg-Saint-Maurice (only 2 km).

Enjoying life on a shaded campsite

The wooded terrain is situated against a mountain slope with tall deciduous and pine trees providing ample shade. The grounds are interspersed with rather steep tarred and gravel roads and a small mountain stream flows along the campsite. The demarcated camping pitches vary in size and are not all level. If you like to rent accommodation, you can choose between yurts, chalets, mobile homes and caravans. The sanitary facilities of Le Reclus are completely renovated and perfectly maintained.

(Ski)bus is on its way

There are bad weather facilities on the campsite and you can rent bicycles. Children can enjoy themselves in the playground, at the table tennis table and on the trampoline. The ski bus to Les Arcs stops in front of the campsite.

Snacks and fresh bread

The campsite has a restaurant with a limited menu where you can buy snacks as well as (daily) fresh bread. Prefer a more extensive dinner? Then you can go to Bourg-Saint-Maurice. 

Nature lovers please note

The Vanoise National Park is one of the largest national parks of France. It borders the Italian National Park Gran Paradiso. The French National Park is home to some 1,200 different flower and plant species. In addition, there are ibexes, chamois, golden eagles and some 125 species of breeding birds.

properties.name: Camping l'Eden de la Vanoise
properties.description:
Nature lovers will have a wonderful holiday at Camping l'Eden de la Vanoise. This medium-sized campsite in Haute-Savoie is situated on the edge of the village of Landry. Go for a walk in the National Park de la Vanoise or go for a white-water experience on the river Isère. There are also several ski resorts nearby. There is a pleasant terrace on the campsite and in the summer you can visit a mobile organic food shop.

A mountain holiday for everyone

The touring pitches are spacious and bordered by bushes. If you like luxury camping, you can choose one of the bungalows or furnished tents. The campsite l'Eden de la Vanoise wants to offer all guests the possibility to enjoy this beautiful place. There are pitches and accommodations adapted for campers with reduced mobility.

Swimming all year round

Enjoy the campsite's indoor pool, open all year round. In fine weather the sides can be opened. For children there is an extra long inflatable water slide. You can sunbathe in the sunbathing area or on the covered terrace with sunbeds.

Yoga and swimming under the moon

The campsite organises fun activities for an unforgettable time with your friends and family. In summer, concerts are organised on Fridays and every Thursday evening you can have a swim under the moonlight. During this period you can also join free yoga classes on Thursday mornings. For children there is always plenty to do in and around the campsite: bouncy castles, trampolines, table tennis tables, table football and billiards.

properties.name: Camping Mun. Rives de la Marne
Flower Camping La Bexanelle
properties.description:
Do you enjoy spending your holidays in the mountains and going on the most spectacular mountain hikes? Flower Camping La Bexanelle is located in the beautiful Vicdessos valley in the Ariège, in the middle of the French Pyrenees. In the immediate vicinity of the campsite, you can go on wonderful hikes through the rugged mountain landscape for which the Pyrenees are so famous. This is a small-scale campsite in a green setting, right on the Vicdessos River. Among other things, the campsite offers a swimming pool, various sports and play facilities and a cosy cafeteria.

Green grounds with spacious touring pitches

This wooded site features several spacious fields where you can experience the real camping life. Guests camp on large touring pitches that are neatly demarcated from each other. Some of the camping spots are located almost directly on the river. There are also a variety of accommodations for rent, including a number of beautiful chalets. The largest ones can accommodate as many as ten holidaymakers, and you can also rent an efficiently furnished chalet for one person. Most pitches and accommodations offer a wonderful view of the surrounding mountains.

Swimming pool equipped with a sliding roof

The swimming pool is centrally located on the site. The sliding roof ensures that the pool can also be used in cold or rainy weather. There's also a large paddling pool. Children can let off steam there and whiz down the fun waterslide.

properties.name: Camping Le Esperidi
properties.description:
The beautiful Italian region of Tuscany is known for its rolling hills and idyllic old towns. This region, in a pine forest near the sea, is where you'll find Le Esperidi Campsite. This green campsite has a beautiful natural swimming pool, various sports and games options and entertainment in the high season. From the campsite, you can walk directly onto the lovely beach of Marina di Bibbona.

A sustainable camping holiday

You drive via the E80 towards Marina di Bibbona through the hilly landscape of Tuscany. Once you have arrived at Le Esperidi Campsite, you will find yourself in an oasis of peace. The campsite is in a pine forest, beautifully green, well maintained, and sustainably run.

Camping in the pine forest

There are many shady camping pitches thanks to the pine trees, which are very pleasant during hot summer days. You camp here on spacious, flat camping pitches that vary in size. The campsite's sanitary facilities are located in a modern building, with special children's sanitary facilities for the little ones. There are various wooden chalets available for those who prefer to rent accommodation. Here you can enjoy the luxury of spacious bedrooms, your own bathroom and a covered terrace.

Entertainment for young and old

You can fully enjoy the Italian sun on the sandy beach that is directly adjacent to the campsite. In addition to swimming in the wonderful waters of the Tyrrhenian Sea, you can also take a dip in the campsite's beautiful natural swimming pool. The campsite also has a fitness room, beach volleyball court, jeu de boules court, table tennis and a sports field.

properties.name: EuroParcs Markermeer
properties.description:
EuroParcs Markermeer is located in the North Holland town of Bovenkarspel, on the banks of the Markermeer. At this campsite you stay in one of the luxury accommodations at the park. Participate in activities at the campsite, go for a swim in the lake or go out and explore the area. Cities like Enkhuizen, Hoorn and Volendam are less than 30 minutes away by car. Flevoland can also easily be reached via the N307, which runs straight through the Markermeer.

Luxury accommodation with a view

During your holiday at EuroParcs Markermeer, you stay in one of the beautiful accommodations. Some of the chalets have a view of the water. All of the chalets have their own toilet facilities, one or more bedrooms and are equipped with every luxury. Order your fresh rolls daily at the reception. Dogs are welcome at most accommodations. The park has plenty of poles with dog poo bags and garbage bins.

Exciting Experience Game

There is lots to do at and around EuroParcs Markermeer. On sunny days, jump into the lake to cool off. Rent a SUP board at the reception and get out on the water. There are also (electrical) bicycles, children’s bicycles and E-choppers for rent. Several hiking and cycle routes through the beautiful surrounding area begin at the park. Young holidaymakers can amuse themselves in the playground or with the Experience Game. Step into the shoes of an adventurous archaeologist and search for the City of Ra. To do so, you must follow instructions, solve riddles and unravel secrets.

properties.name: Camping Recreatiepark Sevink Molen
properties.description:
Just north of Winterswijk, in the far east of the Achterhoek region, lies campsite Camping Recreatiepark Sevink Molen. This family campsite forms part of a recreational park with a swimming lake, two restaurants, an indoor playground and a petting zoo. You camp here in one of the most beautiful parts of Gelderland, adjacent to recreational lake Het Hilgelo.

A superbly comfortable camping holiday

Most of the camping pitches on the grounds are for guests with a caravan or motorhome. They are always given comfort pitches, but you also have a choice of a few super comfort pitches. The pitches are all larger than 100 m2. The super comfort pitches have their own sanitary facilities. Looking for even more luxury? Opt for one of the safari tents for a true glamping holiday.

Beach in the east of the Netherlands

You may not exactly expect this, but the campsite has a beach. Adjacent to the campsite you will find Het Hilgelo recreational lake. Ideal for swimming and sunbathing on the beach. Incidentally, the surrounding scenic landscape forms a beautiful cycling and walking area.

Covered wagon tours and obstacle courses

Besides playing in the outdoor playground or stroking goats and sheep at the petting zoo, children can join the entertainment programme. Bread baking, taking part in sports tournaments and rides on covered wagons: it is all possible. Do you want to do fun things with your children? Then run down the inflatable obstacle course or slip and slide on the soap slope.

Pancakes galore

The terrace of one of the two campsite restaurants is located next to the outdoor playground. The region is traditionally known for its pancakes: these are abundantly available on the campsite. If you don't feel like pancakes, you can head for the stone grill restaurant.

properties.name: Camping La Belle Henriette
properties.description:
A quiet beach campsite in the Vendée with a beautiful location in the Belle Henriette nature reserve. The sea is only 400 meters away via a boardwalk. The whole family can also enjoy themselves at the heated indoor and outdoor swimming pool. The small scale gives La Belle Henriette Campsite a friendly atmosphere. For cycling enthusiasts, there are plenty of beautiful cycle paths around the campsite, and in the pleasant seaside resort of La Tranche-sur-Mer, you will find restaurants and a daily market.

Camping in the Vendée

You will find a beautiful coast in the deep south of France in the southern Vendée. Lively seaside resorts such as La Tranche-sur-Mer, L'Aiguillon-sur-mer and La Faute-sur-Mer are popular for their mild climate, varied landscapes and beautiful beaches.

Behind the dunes

On the open and flat camping site, there are mainly mobile homes spread over several streets. In addition, there are more than 30 touring pitches where you can set up a spot for your tent or caravan. All pitches are reasonably spacious, and the sanitary building looks neat. Chances are good; your neighbours are French campers who enjoy staying at this well-maintained family site. If you want to camp with more comfort, there are also ecolodges for rent in addition to the different types of mobile homes.

Take a dip

On the street side, you will find comfortable swimming pools. The indoor pool is heated to 29 degrees and has a whirlpool in the shape of a semicircle. There is also a paddling pool where the youngest campers can splash around. The water slide is perfect for children and ends in a separate pool.

properties.name: Camping La Ferme de la Serraz
properties.description:
Camping La Ferme de la Serraz is a friendly campsite located in Doussard (Haute-Savoie), a village just south of the impressive Lake Annecy. You will enjoy views of the mountainous surroundings, which are very popular with paragliders. At the campsite pool, campers young and old can go for a swim.

Spacious pitches

The spacious grounds of La Ferme de la Serraz offer tourist pitches and a wide range of accommodation options. The camping pitches are 80-120 m² in size and are shaded by trees. If you like to holiday in luxury, the chalets are an excellent choice. They are equipped with a kitchen with dishwasher, private sanitary facilities, a TV and heating. There are also all kinds of mobile homes.

Entertainment and amenities

At Camping La Ferme de la Serraz, you will find a large heated indoor swimming pool. There is also a paddling pool for the smallest campers. Or you can relax in the wellness area.

Just two kilometres away is the greatest source of water fun: Lake Annecy. Here you can relax on a beach and take a refreshing dip in the water. There are also endless water sports possibilities. When you get back to the campsite, you'll probably be hungry. Then order something from the small menu in the restaurant (with bar), like snacks or a pizza.

The campsite also has a recreation room with pool table, table football, television and slot machines. Outside there is also a table tennis table and a playground. If the children aren't feeling inspired, they can go to the animation team. They organise all kinds of things for campers up to twelve years old.

properties.name: Camping de la Lyre
properties.description:
Camping de La Lyre, located in the beautiful Pyrénées-Orientales, allows you to escape the hustle and bustle of life and enjoy the fresh healthy mountain air. Wake every morning to a panoramic view of the south side of the Pic de Canigou. This small-scale campsite provides an intimate and peaceful atmosphere with 50 pitches and 10 mobile homes, which ensures a personal holiday experience.

Sporty excursions

During the high season, Camping de La Lyre attracts many families looking for adventure and sporting activities. The campsite’s favourable location enables many options for outdoor activities. Hiking on the flanks of the Pic de Canigou is a must for both experienced and beginner hikers. The footpaths offer not only a challenge but also spectacular views and an intense experience of nature. Next to hiking, there are also options for cycling, climbing and water sports.

If you would like to explore the area in a different way, you can rent an electric mountain bike and explore the great routes that start right at the campsite. When back at the campsite, the children can play in the playground or enjoy a game of jeu de boules.

Enjoy a meal

After a day filled with activities, you can relax in the campsite’s small restaurant. Here a modest yet tasty menu is offered – perfect for a delicious meal without having to leave the campsite. The dishes are simple but good quality, and the pleasant atmosphere makes it a great place to close the day.

properties.name: Camping l'Air du Temps
properties.description:
Camping l'Air du Temps is a beautiful small-scale farm campsite in the midst of the unspoilt nature of the village of Beaulieu. From this campsite you have a magnificent view of the lake of Bort-les-Orgues. Here you are in the heart of the volcanic mountains of the Parc Naturel Régional des Volcans d'Auvergne.

Charming campsite

On arrival at this friendly campsite, you will be warmly welcomed by the owner and her son. Their campsite consists of twenty spacious touring pitches that are marked out in a natural way. The campsite is aimed at campers who like peace and quiet. In the high season, these are often families, in the low season pensioners and nature lovers.

Those who do not have their own camping equipment can choose one of the rental accommodations. For example, a bungalow, Finnish hut or mobile home. There are accommodations especially designed for families with a baby and for disabled campers. A communal washing machine and fridge-freezer are available on the campsite free of charge.

Enjoying country life

Not everyone likes big campsites with a swimming pool, snack bar and disco. No problem: Camping l'Air du Temps and the surrounding area offer plenty of other entertainment! Cast your fishing line in the lake or go for a swim at Beaulieu beach. You can also follow the farm life from your pitch. The campsite is part of a farm with cows and rabbits. In the high season you can get fresh milk and delicious bread for breakfast. About six kilometres away, in the town of Lanobre, you will find shops and a nice summer market.

properties.name: Campingpark Hüttensee
properties.description:
The German Lüneburg Heath is a large nature reserve known for its vast heaths and woodlands. There is a lovely area of lakes on the southern side of Lüneburg Heath called the Meißendorf Lakes. Campingpark Hüttensee is in the wonderful setting of this lake landscape. There are four lakes on the campsite itself, including a swimming lake that is surrounded by a white sandy beach. Several gentle streams also run through this forested campsite. The campsite offers many recreational activities, also in terms of water sports. You can take many lovely walks and bike rides in the surrounding area.

A large but convivial campsite

The campsite at Campingpark Hüttensee is, without a doubt, large. But partly thanks to the spacious layout, the streams, ponds and many dead-end paths, this campsite exudes peace and conviviality. Part of the spacious touring pitches is demarcated. Some pitches are fully enclosed. These are specially for campers with dogs, who can then run around the plot freely. As well as touring pitches, there are seasonal pitches, mobile homes, sleeping barrels and hiker's huts for hire.

Private swimming lake and in an area of lakes: ideal for water sports enthusiasts.

This campsite has a lovely swimming lake. It's highly enjoyable around this lake, which is largely in the sun, but you can also find shaded areas. The Meißendorf Lakes are behind this swimming lake. There, you can go sailing, pedal boating and canoeing to your heart's content. You can also take your own sloop into the water at the jetty on the edge of the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Isábena
properties.description:
This beautiful campsite is located in a broad valley of the Spanish Pyrenees. If you like motorcycling you will feel at home at Isábena camp site. You can hire a motorbike at the campsite to explore the beautiful surroundings. But anyone looking for peace and quiet will also feel at home here. With a fine, large swimming pool and an excellent restaurant, you can enjoy the peace and quiet of the site.

The Spanish Pyrenees

Camping Isábena is located in the middle of the Spanish Pyrenees in the north of the country. The campsite is located in a wide valley through which the river Isábena flows. The last part of your drive will take you alongside the river. You will soon notice that you are far from the inhabited world here.

Beautifully tended pitches

On the beautifully maintained campsite, spacious pitches are neatly lined up. That is also the general impression of the campsite: it is tidy, clean and nicely decorated. You may not have much privacy on your pitch. But you will find peace and quiet. That is because all guests are looking for a peaceful camping destination in beautiful nature.

Large swimming pool

Peace and quiet, sun and water: that's all you need on your camping holiday. You'll find it all at Isábena campsite. The large swimming pool is situated in a sunny spot. Here you can start your day with a refreshing dive. While the children are still splashing about, you can dry off in the warm sunshine. The beautiful view over the mountains will be a great bonus.

properties.name: Nordseecamping Zum Seehund GmbH & Co KG
properties.description:
Nordseecamping zum Seehund is a luxury German campsite near the North Sea. Head to the far north of Germany for a luxury holiday by the sea! A visit to the sauna, a massage, a steam bath: for some pampering during your stay. For some fun, jump into the swimming lake. Or take the children for a mud bath in the playground.

On the North Sea dike

The journey to Nordseecamping zum Seehund takes you to Sleeswijk-Holstein. Your camping destination is on this coastline, near the dike. The North Sea is beyond. You won’t be able to help noticing how tidy the campsite is straight away. The perfectly-cut grass invites you to camp. The large swimming lake attracts the whole family. You will find plenty of opportunities to pamper yourself on the campsite. The wellness building will make you feel completely zen. Sweat away your cares in the sauna or steam bath.

A walk along the North Sea

Walk from the campsite across the dike to the North Sea. The tide is usually quite low. This makes swimming difficult and mudflat walking easy. Put on your boots and explore the coastline. A lovely walk along the North Sea, enjoying nature in peace and quiet. This is also possible by bike. Enjoy the cool sea breeze as you cycle through the meadows full of sheep.

properties.name: Camping Panorama Del Chianti
properties.description:
At Camping Panorama Del Chianti, you can enjoy the view of the green Tuscan hills from your caravan or tent. All this while sipping a glass of lovely wine. The campsite is located on a wine route, not far from a national park and several art cities, which you should have visited at least once in your lifetime. In short, an ideal location for lovers of art, nature and wine.

Camping amidst green

On the green terraced campsite, you first have to follow a very steep path downhill until you get to the pitches. Here the trees offer ample shade. The pitches vary in size. Halfway up the mountain, you have the most beautiful view. For tent campers, there are all kinds of lovely spots hidden between greenery. Want to hire something? In this case, you can hire a modern tent (Coco Sweet). 

Swimming pool with a view

The swimming pool is small and standard but certainly suffices for cooling down. And what a view you have here! Near the swimming pool, you will find a lovely sunbathing lawn with a few loungers. It is partly in the shade.

Bicycle hire and wine tour

You can hire bicycles and scooters on Camping Panorama Del Chianti. From the campsite, you can make wonderful walks through the olive groves and vineyards. A wine tour of Stefano is highly recommended and can easily be booked via the campsite.

Salads and pizzas

Don't feel like cooking one day and don't want to go out either? The campsite has a snack bar. On Sundays, there is a 'special dinner' and each Friday there is a salad buffet and pizza evening. The eatery has a tiny but amiable terrace.

properties.name: Camping APV Aventuriers de la Calypso
Camping Am Deich
properties.description:
Camping Am Deich is sheltered behind a wide Wadden Sea dyke in the green countryside of East Frisia, in the very north of Germany. As soon as you arrive, you can instantly feel the peace and quiet. The campsite is well-maintained and spacious, and has its own restaurant. Cycling, walking, a visit to Emden (21 km) or the Wadden Sea islands of Juist and Norderney: there is plenty to do here.

Camping the way you like it

What immediately stands out at Camping Am Deich are the spacious pitches. You look out over open grassy fields with no boundaries, creating a sense of space. Your tent, caravan or motorhome will always have plenty of room here and be clearly laid out. Prefer a bit more comfort? The chalets are fully furnished and perfect for families or couples who like a touch of extra luxury during their camping holiday.

Facilities on the campsite

The campsite itself is a lovely place to be. Scattered across the grounds, you’ll find play equipment where children can easily entertain themselves for hours. Or take a seat in the restaurant’s outdoor area for a relaxed meal or a drink in the sun. After a day out, the wellness oasis is a lovely place to unwind completely.

The sanitary facilities are modern and clean, with eye-catching buildings shaped like boats. And you don’t need to leave the campsite for breakfast, as you can pick up fresh bread rolls every morning from the small shop.

Discover Ostfriesland

The campsite is a convenient base from which to explore East Frisia. For example, head to the mouth of the Ems, visit a typical East Frisian village or take a day trip to a Wadden Sea island.

properties.name: Campingpark Gartow
properties.description:
The spaciously laid out Campingpark Gartow is centrally located in the village by the same name. The village lies in a wooded area. The forests around Gartow are a legacy of the noble family Von Bernstorff, who planted them in the eighteenth and nineteenth century. The campsite borders these forests and the campsite itself also boasts a large number of trees. These create a relaxed atmosphere and provide ample shade. The various attractive fields are separated by rows of trees, but the individual pitches are not demarcated.

Beautifully located campsite

The beautiful four-star campsite, located in the Lower Saxony Elbtalaue biosphere reserve, has won a number of awards. You are only a few minutes' drive away from the Elbe, the Nemitzer Moor or the large Gartower Tannen forest reserve. Lots of natural beauty in the vicinity, therefore!

Many pitches on Campingpark Gartow have water and electricity connections. Near the entrance is a dedicated field for tents of youngsters. They also have their own ablution block.

Young families rule the roost!

Campingpark Gartow attracts many families with young children. They can play safely on the spacious pitches. There is plenty of entertainment for them, such as crafts, carriage tours and singing around the campfire. The swimming pool has a water slide and there is a separate toddler pool. With the focus being on families with young children, the campsite has dedicated children's sanitary facilities and a baby room.

The adjacent Wendland-Therme is a typical German spa, where you can go for wellness treatments and a sauna. There is also a large recreational swimming pool with many water slides and other entertainment.

properties.name: Camping Weichselbrunn
properties.description:
On the banks of Lake Hammersee, in Bavaria, Germany, is Camping Weichselbrunn. This is an ideal campsite for nature lovers and those seeking peace and quiet. The area is characterised by beautiful nature with lakes and forests. The nearest village, Bodenwöhr, is less than a kilometre's walk from the campsite. Here you will find several restaurants, a baker, a butcher and a supermarket.

Camping shop with regional products

Camping Weichselbrunn consists of two sections separated by a street. Some of the pitches are right by the beach. You camp on grass on spacious pitches. Some of the pitches are rented for short stays, but there are also annual pitches. The campsite shop offers various basic items and a wide range of regional products. Order fresh rolls for breakfast here daily.

Campsite for those seeking tranquillity

The well-kept, green campsite is a lovely place for campers who love peace and quiet. No activities are organised, but there is certainly plenty to do. The campsite is located on the shores of a lake with a sunbathing area, where you can relax with a good book. And you can go swimming, canoeing or supping here. The area also lends itself to endless walks and bike rides through the forest and along many lakes.

Visit Regensburg

The city of Regensburg (43.5 km) is one of the best-preserved medieval cities in Europe. Stroll through the narrow streets with colourful facades, visit the impressive Regensburg Cathedral and admire the historic villas.

properties.name: Kur & Feriencp Holmernhof Dreiquellenbad
properties.description:
Recovering from an illness, injury or just a hectic year? There's no better place to do that than at Kur & Feriencamping Holmernhof Dreiquellenbad. This is a luxury campsite renowned for its range of specialist cures, treatments and wellness facilities and that is aimed specifically at adults and the elderly. The campsite features an upscale restaurant and a boutique shop.

It is located just south of the town of Bad Griesbach im Rottal in Bavaria. Here you'll be camping in natural surroundings. The area is hilly and partially wooded, so you can enjoy cycling and hiking. Golf enthusiasts can also indulge themselves here, as there are several beautiful golf courses in the area. Furthermore, this region offers plenty to discover on a cultural level. Beautiful places such as Ortenburg, Obernberg and Passau are located within about a thirty kilometre a radius of the campsite.

A spacious and well-maintained campsite

There are camping pitches available at three comfort levels. The pitches are beautifully laid out and well cared for. There is a special area for motorhomes and caravans. There are also very comfortable studios, apartments, maisonettes and bungalows for rent here. There are two sanitary buildings on the campsite. The quality of the sanitary facilities is very high.

Experience soothing luxury at this genuine spa campsite

This campsite is renowned for its expertise in the field of wellness, cures and spa treatments. Some of the therapies offered include physiotherapy, fangotherapy and cryotherapy. Get a massage or relax in a sauna or steam bath.

properties.name: EuroParcs Wörthersee
properties.description:
The charming towns and villages, the beautiful landscape and sunny climate make Wörthersee an extremely popular holiday destination. EuroParcs Wörthersee is located almost right by this clear blue lake. Here, you camp in wooded surroundings near the town of Schiefling am Se in the Austrian state of Carinthia. That you can go on wonderful mountain walks from here is ideal. Moreover, the campsite is close to the Pyramidenkogel Observation Tower and the lovely town of Velden am Wörther See and city of Klagenfurt. This is a fairly small-scale campsite. It has a private swimming jetty by the lake, a restaurant within walking distance, a small shop and lovely camping pitches on terraces.

Book a lovely terrace pitch or spend the night in a sleeping barrel

The touring pitches are separated from the accommodation. Here, you camp on a spacious grassy pitch on the terraced section. There is also a camping meadow specially for campers with tents. At EuroParcs Wörthersee, you can also hire a sleeping barrel, a holiday home or a studio.

Private swimming jetty

A lovely walking path runs downhill from the campsite. Cross over the road at the bottom and you arrive at a swimming jetty. This jetty belongs to the campsite. Jump into the Wörthersee from the swimming jetty for a refreshing swim.

Restaurant, shop and fresh bread rolls

Within a few minutes' walk, you will find a charming restaurant where you can enjoy delicious dishes. There is a park shop at the campsite itself. This shop has a reasonably extensive range of groceries. You can also order fresh bread rolls for the following day.

properties.name: Terrassen-Camping Traisen
properties.description:
Terrassen-Camping Traisen is on a hill in the town of Traisen, surrounded by the wooded mountains of Lower Austria. This small-scale campsite is an ideal starting point for nature lovers who want to enjoy the Austrian mountain landscape by bike or on foot. The campsite itself has an outdoor swimming pool and a bistro among other things. The same hospitable family has run this campsite for dozens of years. The owners maintain the campsite with love. The wonderfully landscaped and neatly maintained shrubs and flowers are proof of that.

Enjoy a terraced pitch with mountain views

This terraced campsite offers playfully landscaped grass fields, various annual pitches and tourist camping pitches. These vary in size but are generally spacious enough. The touring pitches all have one thing in common: you can enjoy the wonderful views of the mountainous landscape around the campsite from all pitches. Besides on a lovely camping pitch, you can also stay in a charming hiker's cabin for three or four people or on a large filed for groups of campers at Terrassen-Camping Traisen.

Lovely meal at Café Bistro Wallentino

The lovely swimming pool is in the middle of the site. The water in the outdoor swimming pool is heated using solar energy. That also applies to the water in the toilet block. Café Bistro Wallentino is right next to the swimming pool. There you can enjoy tasty refreshments in the lovely indoor section or on the shaded patio. Food includes fresh pastries, spicy snacks, chunks of sheep's cheese or pumpkin oil from Styria. Top it off by ordering a glass of homemade fruit juice or a schnapps alongside.

properties.name: Fliegercamp Franz Mandl
properties.description:
This cosy campsite has a beautiful location right next to a small lake in the heart of the Austrian Alps. You can enjoy cycling and walking around the area thanks to its rural location and the beautiful nature surrounding it. It is also ideal for paragliders and hang gliders who begin and end their flights at Fliegercamp (Flight Camp). The campsite has now become an authority in organising this adventurous sport.

Camping in Carinthia

Located in the southernmost part of Austria, close to the Italian border, the Oberes Drautal is a lovely destination with a mild climate. The warm air from Italy is important for fliers who come especially to this mountainous part of Carinthia. Everything here revolves around paragliding. There is a landing area next to the campsite where training courses are provided.

Fresh mountain air

The main building is the central focal point on the flat terrain. The touring pitches are located on different streets and offer plenty of space and privacy. The sanitary facilities are modern and clean, just like the rest of the campsite. Many guests are involved with the flying activities, but other campers are also very welcome.

Swimming in the lake

The swimming lake at the campsite is ideal for water recreation in warm weather. The sandy beach features a sunbathing area and children can also have fun at the nearby playground. You can also go for a swim in the pool at nearby Camping am Waldbad.

properties.name: Camping Ter
properties.description:
Only 2 km away from the beautiful beach of the coastal town of L'Estartit, situated in the north-eastern tip of Catalonia, you will find campsite Ter. Campsite Ter is a quiet, modest family campsite, ideally located for excursions to Gerona and Figueres or one of the other idyllic coastal towns Catalonia calls its own.

Shade and sun

The camping grounds are not very remarkable; quite straightforward in fact. Yet everything is well-maintained. Wide roads lead you past the camping pitches and rental accommodation units. Many pitches are found in the shade under the trees, but you can also choose a sunnier spot. If you prefer to stay in a rental accommodation, you have a choice of mobile homes with and without air conditioning.

The beach of L'Estartit

The small swimming pool on the edge of the campsite is excellent for a few hours of water fun. When you camp this close to the Mediterranean Sea, you really do not need a larger swimming pool. The coastal town of L'Estartit is within walking distance. You can also go by car. Parking is easy there. The beach of L'Estartit is beautiful and wide as far as beaches of the Costa Brava go. From the shore, you have a splendid view of the Medes Islands, an archipelago consisting of seven small islands. L'Estartit is popular with both beach lovers and water sports enthusiasts.

Restaurants

You can enjoy a drink in the bar next to the swimming pool. The campsite does not have a restaurant, but you will find a large supermarket adjacent to the campsite. Rather go out for a meal? If you are looking for a restaurant, you will be spoilt for choice in L'Estartit. Paella or those delicious tapas always go down well.

properties.name: Capfun Camping De Wâldsang
properties.description:
Camping De Wâldsang is located in the middle of the Friesche Wouden, a quiet family campsite with good facilities. At this four-star campsite you will camp in the greenery and enjoy warm hospitality, pleasant tranquillity and a wooded environment. De Wâldsang has its own fishing pond and an indoor playground. During the holiday periods there is professional entertainment for the whole family.

Green camping fields

Camping De Wâldsang stretches over thirteen hectares and has its own fishpond. The whole campsite looks neat and tidy. The campsite consists of all kinds of camping fields of different sizes, surrounded by tall trees and green areas. There are 160 fixed annual pitches: mainly mobile homes. There are 140 spacious touring pitches on separate fields. There is a separate field with paved camper pitches, and in high season there is a special tent field. There are also pitches that have their own sanitary facilities.

Indoor playground

Camping De Wâldsang has all kinds of facilities for children of all ages. For example, an indoor playground with different areas especially for the little ones. But also bouncy castles, trampolies and rope bridges for the biggest daredevils. On beautiful days they can let off steam on the sports fields and in the playground. For little animal friends there is a nice animal pasture. Teenagers have a recreation room at their disposal. A professional animation team is active during the May and summer holidays.

Fresh scoop ice cream

There is no campsite shop on De Wâldsang, but there is a supermarket five hundred metres away. At the campsite you can get fresh bread. In the snack bar you can get fries, snacks, pizzas and fresh scooped ice cream. There is also a grand café on the campsite: De Kienstobbe.

properties.name: EuroParcs Hindeloopen
properties.description:
Just two kilometres from Hindeloopen, one of the most beautiful towns in southwestern Friesland, lies EuroParcs Hindeloopen. This holiday park is located directly on the IJsselmeer and even has its own sandy beach. For water sports enthusiasts, this is a fantastic vacation destination. Additionally, this modern resort, which opened in 2023, is an excellent base for cycling tours along the IJsselmeer and the Frisian Lakes. On-site, you'll find luxury accommodations, a supermarket, and a snack bar. During school holidays, fun activities for children are organized.

Modern accommodations with plenty of privacy

Spread across this beautifully landscaped park, with plenty of water, trees, and grassy fields, are around one hundred accommodations. A large portion of these are located directly on the inland waters of the park. Thanks to the spacious layout, you’ll enjoy plenty of privacy everywhere. The park rents out various types of modern holiday homes (for four to ten people) and cosy tiny houses, suitable for up to two guests.

Ideal holiday spot for water sports enthusiasts

With its location on the IJsselmeer, this is an ideal destination for water sports lovers. Take a refreshing swim from the private sandy beach or go out on the water with your boat or surfboard. Renting a SUP and paddling across the inland water is also a popular activity. Please note: due to nature protection, water recreation is only allowed on the west and north sides of the park.

Visit the picturesque Hindeloopen

From the resort, you can bike to Hindeloopen in just ten minutes. Here, you can enjoy a lovely city walk along the many canals and authentic little houses. A visit to the beautiful city of Sneek (38 km) is also well worth it.

properties.name: Park Drentheland
properties.description:
Camping Drentheland has a unique location near three national parks, nearby the friendly village of Zorgvlied. It is a spacious, modern and well-maintained campsite where people of all ages can enjoy camping. Horse lovers have come to the right place because you can board your horse here. The surrounding area is ideal for discovering nature on horseback, walking or on a bike. Drentheland is one of the more luxury campgrounds in the region.

Space and freedom

Upon arrival, you will be warmly greeted by the park Drentheland team. On the way to the site, you'll see how spacious everything looks, and that gives you a feeling of freedom. The entire campground makes a clean and well-organized impression, even in the high season. The modern campsites all have power and water connections.

For all ages, and especially for horseback riders

In addition to families with young and growing children, you'll also meet seniors and couples. The park can truly call itself animal-friendly, seeing as you can bring your horse and board it in a reserved location. Dogs are also permitted, but should preferably be kept on a leash.

The spacious outdoor pool at the entrance is a real eye-catcher. Small and older children and teenagers love to play in the water. You'll also find a mini-golf course and tennis courts for your pleasure. There is a shop in the park, and you can also rent bikes.

Easily accessible

The heated sanitation building is spacious, clean and accessible for less mobile campers. There is free WiFi on the entire campsite (good reception on 80% of the property).

properties.name: Capfun Camping De Scheepsbel
properties.description:
Are you looking for the ideal place to discover the Veluwe? And do you want to be sure that the children will have plenty of fun? Then Capfun Campsite De Scheepsbel fulfils your requirements. Young and old will not only enjoy themselves in the woods but also on the campsite itself. Splash in the pools, whiz down the Spacebowl slide, and discover the play castle and climbing paradise.

You can camp in a park-like environment and choose from spacious pitches.

Camping or more comfort

Here you camp on one of the tourist pitches or stay in rental accommodation. For camping, you can choose between a shady spot between the trees with lots of privacy or a sunny spot on a camping field surrounded by trees. Are you looking for more comfort? You will find one of our luxurious accommodations, such as a mobile home, camping bungalow, chalet or hiker's cabin, to offer you more comfort.

Swim and slide away

Not only will the children enjoy themselves in the beautiful water park. Adults also like to take a dip in one of the three heated outdoor pools. And, of course, you can't resist giving that huge water slide a go. The Spacebowl is a super exciting slide where you end up in a large funnel. The little ones can splash about in a cheerfully coloured paddling pool.

From Play Pirate to animal pasture

The children can also play in the various indoor and outdoor playgrounds. This is how children climb and scramble in the indoor playground of De Speelpiraat. There is a glass wall between the climbing area and the restaurant so that you can keep an eye on your children while enjoying a cool drink.

properties.name: Capfun Camping Eibernest
properties.description:
Campsite Capfun Camping Eibernest is located in a rural countryside near the fortified town of Groenlo. This lively family campsite has two swimming pools and during school holidays lots of entertainment for children. But you can also enjoy the peace and quiet of the area, with lots of possibilities for walking and cycling.

Well-maintained and orderly campsite

The campsite is well-kept and very orderly. Despite the fact that there are permanent pitches and rental accommodations, you are also at the right place as a touring camper. All touring pitches can be found at the back of the campsite. Most of them are situated together on clearly laid out lawns. At the front of the campsite there are bungalows.

Summery entertainment

During the summer holidays, the campsite is enlivened by an entertainment team that organises many activities. With games on the large sports fields, dance performances and barbecues, children won't be bored for a minute. If the weather is not so good, the fun simply moves to the recreation shed.

A warm bath

At the entrance of the campsite there are two large swimming pools. In the first pool - with colourful play equipment in the middle - the little ones can stand. The second pool is a little deeper and ideal for children who are novice swimmers. In addition, the pools are heated. Around the pools there is plenty of space for sunbathing on a deckchair.

Conviviality in the canteen

Next to the swimming pool is the campsite canteen: the pleasant cosy meeting point at all weathe. A game of pool or a bingo drive is always possible. But you also can enjoy a nice meal .Fresh bread for breakfast? You can order fresh bread daily at the campsite.

properties.name: Camping De Spaendershorst
properties.description:
Camping De Spaendershorst is a beautiful campsite with excellent facilities. The campsite is situated in a tranquil area in the wooded landscape south of Tilburg, not far from the Belgian border. The region is known for its beautiful nature, pretty market towns and rivers. Esbeek is 1 km away and the slightly larger Hilvarenbeek 2 km. This is where you can do your shopping. The Rovertse Heide nature area, the Campines and the Acht Zaligheden are great day trip destinations.

Park-like grounds and spacious pitches

You are warmly welcomed in the star-shaped reception building. When you enter the grounds, you will see the beautiful park-like design. The facilities are excellent and much attention and dedication is invested in maintaining the high standards of the campsite. One of the points of attention has been the sanitary building which is now well cared for.

The campsite is mainly frequented by families with children. The sizes of the camping pitches vary from 80 to 130 m2. There is a large number of pitches for annual and seasonal campers. In between are the camping fields for other campers. Trees and bushes usually offer sufficient shade and privacy.

Heated swimming pool and covered stage

Camping De Spaendershorst offers all kinds of facilities for children. There is a solar-heated swimming pool and a playground. The covered stage, which plays a central role for a lot of events, is a very special feature. Adjacent to the reception is a snack bar. There is no shop or supermarket on the campsite. You will have to go to Hilvarenbeek for this.

properties.name: Huttopia Arcachon
properties.description:
Huttopia Arcachon is a charming campsite in the chic coastal resort of Arcachon, on the southwest coast of France. Here, you can expect a holiday full of hours of sun, days at the beach, and delicious fish and shellfish dishes. Camping Arcachon is located in a large pine forest measuring six hectares. The camping pitches are cosy and with plenty of shade. Enjoy the well-maintained swimming pool, entertainment for the whole family and a small restaurant.

Holiday amongst the pine trees

Camping Arcachon's site is very green. The pines trees provide plenty of shade, demarcation and a fresh appearance. The campsite mainly offers accommodation, but also has a few touring pitches. The pitch are situated amongst the trees and are only suitable for motorhomes, caravans and campervans.

If you come here without camping equipment, you can choose from a wide range of rental accommodation, mainly chalets. They are all in nice spots in the countryside.

Sport, games and entertainment

At this campsite, you can challenge each other to a game of table tennis, jeu de boules or beach volleyball. Furthermore, everyone can have fun on the multisport field. There is a fun mini club for the youngest campsite visitors. There is a varied entertainment programme for children and adults. The recreation room has a pool table, television and gaming machines.

Water fun for the whole family!

The heated outdoor swimming pool is very complete with a paddling pool and a slide. A lovely sunny deck with loungers is ideal if mum or dad want to read a book.

A snack and a drink

Fresh bread is available every morning from mid-April to mid-October. There is also a modest shop. If you don't feel like cooking, reserve a table in the restaurant or grab a quick bite from the snack bar.

properties.name: Camping Le Moulin de Paulhiac
properties.description:
Treat yourself to a wonderful holiday full of water fun in the beloved Dordogne at the Camping Le Moulin de Paulhiac campsite. With spacious and shaded pitches, a water park and a good restaurant, campers are in the right place.

Spacious shaded pitches

On the way to your spacious camping pitch, you'll see a cosy green area with camping fields. Here and there across the campsite are a few mobile homes and rental tents. The pitches are about 120 square metres and are nicely shaded by trees. The shrubs and hedges on the property create a nice, green look. The sanitary facilities are modern and well-maintained.

Slides, water park and swimming in the river

With a large outdoor pool, three beautiful slides, a paddling pool and a pool with a diving slide, it's water fun every day here in the summer. The water playground is a wonderful place to cool off with the smallest campers. The pools are all heated. And then the campsite is also situated on the lovely little river Céou.

From mini club to canoe trip

In July and August, the campsite offers entertainment for all ages. From mini club to performances by acrobats. In the evenings, a band plays and gets the crowd going. Do you enjoy sporting activities? Then rent a kayak, mountain bike or bicycle and go exploring.

Feeling hungry after swimming or just don't feel like cooking? At the snack bar, you can treat yourself to snacks, pizzas or fries. Or enjoy a nice dinner at the restaurant. There is a decent daily menu for a reasonable price. There is also a campsite shop with an excellent selection.

properties.name: Flower Camping Le St. Michelet
properties.description:
The Flower Camping Le St. Michelet campsite is within walking distance of the charming village of Goudargues, also known as the 'Venice of the Gard'. You can camp here on a spacious pitch or book one of the accommodations. There are plenty of opportunities to enjoy fun in the water at the campsite thanks to its location on the Cèze river. And then there is also a swimming pool (with a toddler pool) at the campsite. There is entertainment for all ages in the peak season. You can enjoy a snack and drink at the campsite restaurant.

Camping with a view

Thanks to the wooded location of the Flower Camping Le St. Michelet campsite, the pitches have plenty of shade. There are three different types of camping pitches: by the pool, by the river and facing the river. All pitches are spacious and demarcated by hedges. In search of more luxury? Then at this campsite, you can also choose a mobile home or a furnished tent (without sanitary facilities).

Water fun in the river or pool

There is no shortage of water fun at this campsite, which is located on the Cèze river. This is a shallow river with a weak current. From the campsite, there is direct access to a private beach. Parents can relax in the sun here while the kids splash around in the water. The campsite also has a heated outdoor pool with a wading pool.

Hit or throw a ball

Fishermen and lovers of canoeing will enjoy the Cèze. And how about a game of table tennis or volleyball? A bocce court is also available. The campsite has an entertainment team for the benefit of young and old alike during high season.

properties.name: Camping Beau Rivage - Ciela Village
properties.description:
Camping Beau Rivage, a cheerful family campsite with a surprisingly attractive swimming pool, lies on the shore of Thau Lake. The lake is in the vicinity of the campsite and the beach is only an eight-minute walk away. In addition to swimming, you can enjoy sailing and windsurfing there. The campsite is quiet during the day and at night, even though entertainment is arranged for children. Apparently, the abundance of flowering plants and the palm trees are a trigger for relaxation...

Lovely pitches

The campsite has 92 demarcated touring pitches located along hardened pathways. You are standing on surface of soft sand or grass. Please take into consideration that as summer progresses, the grass gets more yellow and arid. The pitches measure 80-95 m2, with beautiful colourful vegetation all around you. This provides adequate privacy. There are some fifty mobile homes available for rent. 

Swimming near the flowers

The swimming pool is fairly large (162 m2) and slopes down gently. Early in the morning it is great to swim a few laps there. There is a separate toddler pool for the little ones. Both swimming pools are not heated and fairly basic (no slides or other play equipment). Around the swimming pool is a cosy terrace with sun loungers, thatch sun umbrellas, colourful vegetation and palm trees. 

To Thau Lake

You can, of course, also go to the lake for a swim. There is a small beach, but a bit further along you will find another, wider and longer beach. You will also see people fishing and surfing, so bring your fishing rod and surf board.

properties.name: Camping Lou Vincen
properties.description:
Camping Lou Vincen is a small campsite in Provence, located between Avignon and Nîmes. You camp here on the outskirts of the village of Vallabrègues, directly on the Rhone. Especially for those looking for peace and quiet, both the campsite and its surroundings make a great holiday destination. Find a quiet spot on the Rhone for fishing or visit the old towns nearby: Avignon, Nîmes and Beaucaire.

The campsite is situated on the Rhone, which flows in the direction of Beaucaire from Avignon. The last part of the journey, between the orchards, takes you along the river to the campsite. At the front of the campsite is the reception. In the white building you will be helped by the friendly Hélène and Myriam.

Cosy and spacious camping

At the front of the campsite, just behind the reception building, there are ten mobile homes. Behind them you will find the almost seventy touring pitches. Hedges provide demarcation and privacy, trees provide shade. The campsite is small and cosy. Next to the reception is the swimming pool.

The sanitary facilities are a bit outdated, but they are kept perfectly clean. Furthermore, there are relatively few facilities on the campsite. Luckily you stay close to the centre of Vallabrègues. There you'll find for example a small supermarket.

Quiet camping

The Lou Vincen campsite is very quiet. Families with young children are well catered for. There isn't much to do for slightly older children. There are numerous excursions in the area. In the vicinity you will find some beautiful cities such as Avignon, Nîmes or the less well-known Beaucaire.

properties.name: Camping Les Pêcheurs
properties.description:
Campsite Les Pêcheurs is located in the Mediterranean landscape of the Provence, slightly north of Roquebrune-sur-Argens. The Argens river flows alongside the campsite and feeds into the Mediterranean Sea some 10 km further along, after it has first divided the beach of the coastal town of Fréjus in two. Camping les Pêcheurs is a colourful family campsite where there is always something to do, but where you can also unwind.

Camping between oleanders

Driving through an archway of trees and oleanders you will get to your shaded camping pitch. The pitches are spacious and offer ample privacy. The numerous rental accommodation units are also located amidst greenery, some in the shade, some in the sun. You can stay in various types of mobile homes, all well equipped with kitchen and bathroom. Alternatively, choose one of the luxury lodge tents or fisherman's huts. 

Campsite for children with entertainment

Campsite Les Pêcheurs is primarily geared towards families with children. This is borne out by the entertainment on offer in high season. During this period, the entertainment team adds extra colour to the holiday with a mini club, sports tournaments and theme evenings. Incidentally, these are also enjoyed by adults. The entertainment is not excessive, so that the small scale character of the campsite is maintained. 

Palm trees and sun umbrellas

At the back of the campsite, between palm trees and sun umbrellas, you will find the swimming pool. Ideal for swimming a few lengths and water fun for the entire family. Adjacent to the large swimming pool is a smaller pool, a toddler pool and a whirlpool. The sauna and wellness are located near the whirlpool. This section is only accessible to adults.

properties.name: Camping Le Grand Paris
properties.description:
The Camping Le Grand Paris campsite is located about thirty kilometres north of Paris. The campsite is located close to the friendly village of Nesles-la-Vallée. Also, you are only ten minutes from the town of L'Isle Adam, where there is a train station (train to Paris). The green camping area (5.8 hectares) is full of trees that provide fine shade. There is also a small lake for fishing and boating. The campground restaurant is a nice place to grab a bite to eat.

Camping or renting?

The eighty camping sites are spacious and equipped with water and electricity. The degree of privacy varies, but the trees and shrubs provide all sorts of possibilities. This green camping decor is not only very pretty and soothing, it also provides shade.

There are also about seventy bungalows and one hundred mobile homes. Tip: book accommodation with a view of the lake. Fantastic!

Sport and games

Children can have fun in the playground and on the bouncy castle. There are also table tennis tables, a bocce court and a multi-sport court. On weekends (high season) there are shows and concerts. The campsite's petting zoo does especially well with the youngest campers. The beautiful recreation room has a pool table, a television and some slot machines.

Water fun for everyone

At the campsite, you can swim in a heated pool of modest size. There are deck chairs around the pool. For the little ones, there is a paddling pool with all kinds of water play equipment. The swimming complex is in full sunlight, so put on your sunscreen! Fishing can be done in the lake, as well as boating. Boats are available for rent at the campsite itself.

properties.name: Camping des Drouilhèdes
properties.description:
In the south of France, in the heart of the magnificent Cévennes Natural Park, Camping des Drouilhèdes has a quiet and idyllic location and id full of atmosphere. The campsite beach near the river Cèze that flows by is a popular spot.

Privacy in nature

Campsite des Drouilhèdes has been laid out with great attention. Tall trees and hedges provide pleasant shade and a neat demarcation of the spacious pitches. A few tents and caravans are allowed near the river. Everywhere on the terrain there are plenty of playgrounds for children. The real eye-catchers on the campsite are the furnished Coco tents.

Swimming at a private beach

What could be nicer than having your own natural pool in front of your tent or caravan? At the bottom of the terrain is a gravel beach on the banks of the river Cèze. A dam has been built there, creating a swimming lake. There are sun loungers and parasols and on the edge trees provide natural shelter.

Attractive pavement café

A drink, sitting down for breakfast in the morning or enjoying a hot meal at the end of the day. It's all possible on the pavement café which is partly covered. In the summer there is live music every week. For fresh baguettes and other small groceries you don't have to leave the campsite.

Playing outside

Mini golf, table tennis, football or a game of jeu de boules. For children this is also an ideal place to enjoy themselves outdoors. During the summer holidays there is a fun activity for the youngest campers every morning.

properties.name: Camping Le Bois Joli
properties.description:
Camping Le Bois Joli is located close to the beaches of the Vendée. On this cozy campsite in Bois-de-Céné, you'll find spacious pitches under the trees. Perfect for a sunny vacation in France. The indoor and outdoor pools are also ideal. The whole family can splash and play for hours. Dry off while enjoying your chips on a sun lounger. Planning a day at the beach? Be sure to drive to Île de Noirmoutier. The beaches on this island are stunning.

Charming campsite in the Vendée

Camping Le Bois Joli is just a fifteen-minute drive from the sea. It’s not difficult to find a nice spot to camp on the site. The pitches are located along the little paths on the grass. You can camp on a spacious pitch under the trees or enjoy your holiday in a comfortable mobile home or a cosy bungalow.

Indoor and outdoor pools

The pool is the main attraction for young campers. In the indoor and outdoor pools, they can splash and play for hours. For the little ones, there is a separate toddler pool. After swimming, you'll surely be in the mood for a tasty snack. Luckily, the restaurant is right next to the pool. At the edge of the campsite, you can cast your fishing rod into the fishing pond. Just a fifteen-minute drive and you'll be on the beaches of the Vendée. The Atlantic Ocean is waiting for you to take a dip!

properties.name: Trossachs Holiday Park
properties.description:
Camping Trossachs Holiday Park in Gartmore (Stirling) is a friendly campsite where everyone is made to feel welcome. Especially active nature lovers visit the campsite for its beautiful surroundings and the nearby nature parks. The pitches are relatively spacious and set in green surroundings. Pitching your camper van or caravan may sometimes be a little difficult, but the campsite owners will be happy to help with that. The campsite is beautifully landscaped with trees and flower beds.

Terraces with a view

The reception also has a small shop and a coffee and tea corner. The pitches are situated on terraces with clearly-marked parking spaces. Everyone has a beautiful view of the surroundings from the terraces. Despite its well-organised structure, the campsite's appearance is natural and fits in well with the surrounding landscape.

Nature lovers and sports enthusiasts

The campsite does not cater to one particular group of guests, but mostly nature lovers and sports enthusiasts find Trossachs Holiday Park particularly appealing because of the surrounding area. Your campsite neighbours will most likely be active tourists from all over the world.

Simplicity and comfort

The coffee and tea corner is simply yet comfortably and pleasantly furnished. You can also make use of the internet facilities while you are enjoying your drink. The small shop has a limited range of supplies, but enough for you to be able to cook your own meal.

properties.name: Parque de Campismo de Porto Côvo
Camping Domaine du Perche Bellemois
properties.description:
Camping Domaine du Perche Bellemois is located in the village of Bellême, in the quiet south of Normandy. This is a simple but well-maintained two-star campsite. Next to the campsite, there’s a large municipal swimming pool, and the medieval village centre of Bellême is half a kilometre away. There are also lovely walking and cycling routes in the varied, sparsely-populated landscapes around Bellême.

What accommodation options are there?

This small campsite is located in a protected nature reserve (Perche Regional Nature Park) with small differences in altitude. There are about 40 large tourist pitches. Some touring pitches are on open ground, while others are fully shaded. Some of the pitches are separated by hedges and trees. Want a little extra comfort? Then rent one of the modern mobile homes, glamping lodges or wooden chalets, or opt for maximum luxury in the larger holiday home with its own hot tub.

Swim in the adjacent municipal pool

Fancy a nice swim? Camping Domaine du Perche Bellemois is next to a large swimming pool, which is managed by the municipality. Next to the heated basic pool, there’s a paddling pool with a small slide. Around it, there’s a lovely grassy sunbathing area, part of which is shaded. Enjoy your own snacks and drinks, or buy something tasty from the pool's snack bar. Activities are often organised here too, such as swimming lessons, aquagym sessions and parties with inflatable water toys. Staying at the campsite for a week or more? Then access to this municipal swimming pool is free. If not, you will pay a small entrance fee.

properties.name: Waldbad Camping Isny GmbH
properties.description:
This campsite, located in a wooded area just outside the German town of Isny, is surrounded by nature. Here you'll be camping among the trees in a tranquil forest. Another major draw at Waldbad Camping Isny GmbH is the lake, which features a natural fountain. It is a wonderful place to swim! You can dry off on the large lawn after taking a cool dip. Then enjoy the lake even more with a view from the restaurant terrace. Or take a walk in the beautiful German countryside.

Camping holiday in nature

Your trip to Waldbad Camping Isny takes you all the way to southern Germany. The campsite is located exactly on the border of Baden-Württemberg and Bavaria. It is perched on a hillside just outside the town of Isny. The landscape here is hilly and wooded: a perfect location for a camping holiday in nature. What immediately catches your eye when you enter the campsite is the lake. This body of water, which features a natural spring, is located in the middle of the campsite. It spouts a fountain of water up to six metres high.

Quiet, spacious and in the woods

A wonderfully quiet, spacious camping pitch under the trees: you'll find that at this campsite. Here you'll be camping surrounded by German nature, never far from the natural spring. Some camping pitches are even close to the lake. If you camp on the tent field, you'll wake up with a view over the water. But you can also choose a spot deeper in the woods. No matter what you choose, you'll enjoy plenty of peace and tranquillity here.

properties.name: Camping Drei Gleichen
properties.description:
Drei Gleichen Campsite is located in the hills of Thuringia, Germany. You can choose your own camping pitch on the neat grounds of this green, sustainable campsite. Here you will enjoy tranquillity and nature. Sit together around a crackling campfire while enjoying a bratwurst sandwich. Want to go out? Then the swimming pool in Gotha, designed entirely in Art Nouveau style, is a perfect family outing. Or walk into the hills, where Burg Gleichen is located. The view from this castle is magnificent.

Green camping

Everything at Drei Gleichen Campsite is green. You'll be camping on a very neat camping site in the great outdoors. Set up your camping equipment on a spacious camping pitch on one of the beautiful lawns. You can choose the most beautiful spot yourself. Or perhaps you'll be staying in a cosy holiday cabin this holiday. Even then you'll camp green: the electricity generated on the campsite is completely sustainable. The campsite is officially listed as one of the campsites that are particularly sustainable and economical with resources.

Crackling campfire

Drei Gleichen Campsite is a child-friendly campsite, but you don't have to worry about overly-enthusiastic entertainment teams here. Fortunately, there are plenty of nice children's playgrounds on the site. Here you'll experience quiet camping surrounded by pristine nature. Enjoy the setting sun together around a crackling campfire. The newly constructed stone fire pit is the perfect spot for this. Peace, freedom and nature: these are precisely what attract campers to this campsite.

properties.name: Komfortcamping Senftenberger See
properties.description:
You'll have a good time at this relaxing campsite in Senftenberg, Brandenburg. The campsite is located by Lake Senftenberg, in the scenic Lusatian Lake District. At the Komfortcamping Senftenberger See you will stay on a pitch in the midst of nature. For those who do not have their own camping equipment, it is also possible to rent a fully equipped caravan including an awning.

Beautiful location by the lake

On arrival at the campsite, your eye is immediately drawn to the beautiful lake on which the campsite is situated. Once you have parked your car, the experienced team of the Komfortcamping Senftenberger See await you in the reception building. After you have received all the information and checked in, it is time to enter the well maintained campsite and go to your holiday destination for the time ahead.

Spacious pitches

Komfortcamping Senftenberger See offers spacious pitches for those going on holiday with their own camping equipment. The sanitary facilities are modern and well maintained and clean. But you do not have your own camping equipment available? The campsite also offers caravans with awning. The caravans are suitable for two adults and two children.

Gastronomy and relaxation

After an active day on the bike or a long walk, you can relax at the snack bar with terrace and view over the lake. But that's not all. This genuine German campsite also has its own Biergarten.

The campsite makes every effort to make you completely relaxed and offers various spa facilities. Book a massage or unwind in the sauna or infrared cabin.

properties.name: Camping Karlsmark
properties.description:
Camping Karlsmark is situated in a peaceful rural setting in the far north of Germany, just outside the village of Leck (Schleswig-Holstein). It is an ideal destination for nature lovers and those seeking some peace and quiet. From the modestly-sized campsite, you can walk straight into the adjacent Langenberger Forest. There are also lovely cycling routes. This campsite is suitable for a longer stay, but thanks to its location close to the B199 and B5, it is also an excellent stopover for campers travelling to and from Denmark.

Well-kept campsite with spacious grassy pitches

At this clearly laid-out campsite, paved paths lead to the pleasant camping pitches, which are separated from one another by tall hedges. Touring campers with a caravan and/or tent can choose one of the spacious grass pitches themselves. For guests arriving in a motorhome, paved motorhome pitches have been provided. The campsite makes a well-maintained and professional impression.

Meet fellow campers in the recreation room

The campsite mainly attracts visitors who want to enjoy the peace and quiet of the countryside. Looking for a bit of entertainment? Then do drop by the campsite’s communal recreation room. With its shared kitchen, numerous tables with seating for around twenty, this common room is the vibrant hub of the campsite. You can go there to prepare your meals, play a board game, read a good book or simply have a chat with fellow campers. You will also find a small shop selling local produce at reception.

The village of Leck offers plenty of options for fun day trips. For example, you could spend an afternoon swimming at the Erlebnisbad, an indoor water park.

properties.name: Flower Camping Les Mijeannes
properties.description:
At the foot of the Pyrenees, Flower Camping Les Mijeannes is a friendly family campsite. Here you camp on an island in the river Ariège, where you can swim, fish and canoe. For children and adults, the campsite organises fun dance and karaoke evenings, while you can also enjoy your privacy on the spacious, delimitated touring pitches. Foix is located close to the campsite. For a day out this old town with its castle and caves is a beautiful destination.

You'll find the campsite on the outskirts of Rieux-de-Pelleport, a small village about thirteen kilometres above the town of Foix. With the Pyrenees in the background, you drive over a small bridge into the campsite, where you'll find the reception in a large building on the spacious grounds.

Spacious pitches with privacy

The almost one hundred particularly spacious pitches are all delimited. In addition to the touring pitches, you can also choose from various rental accommodation such as eco mobile homes and lodge tents. In high season, many families with young children come to the campsite. There are plenty of organised activities for young and old on the campsite: Dance evenings, karaoke, children's disco. But if you prefer the peace and quiet, you'll also be fine at Camping Les Mijeannes. Furthermore you can enjoy cycling in the wooded surroundings.

Island in Ariège

You walk from the campsite to the river, where children can play in the shallow parts of the water. The river is also a paradise for anglers. You can also take a dip in the heated camping pool.

properties.name: Alton, The Star C&C Club Site
Market Rasen Racecourse Caravan Club Site
Brook Lodge Farm C. & C. Park
Camping la Pineda de Salou
properties.description:
Camping La Pineda de Salou serves as a wonderful base on the Costa Dorada. It’s only a five-minute walk to the beach, and the vibrant town of Salou is just around the corner. The campsite has three swimming pools, including a semi-Olympic pool. The site also features a bar and a restaurant.

Camping pitches and accommodation units

At Camping La Pineda de Salou, you can choose between pitches or rental accommodation. The pitches are well-maintained and have water and electricity connections. For more greenery and privacy, there are also refurbished premium pitches. If you are coming without your own camping equipment, you can opt to stay in a bungalow. These are bright, spacious and ideal for families.

A semi-Olympic swimming pool and more

There are three swimming pools, including a semi-Olympic pool where you can swim laps to your heart’s content. There is also a paddling pool for small campers. The slide ensures plenty of fun in the water. Surrounding the pools is a spacious sunbathing area of no less than 1,000 m² where you can relax in the sun. Looking to truly unwind? Then take advantage of the wellness facilities.

This is the perfect spot for families with children, where they can burn off some energy at the playgrounds or sports grounds. For a drink, head over to the bar, and the restaurant offers a limited but tasty menu to choose from. In short, everything is within easy reach here.

Explore the area

La Pineda beach is just 500 metres away. Feel like some excitement? PortAventura theme park (5 km) and Aquópolis water park (2 km) are nearby. Tarragona is about 6 kilometres away.

properties.name: Camping Cabopino
properties.description:
On the coastal road from Málaga to Marbella, just a few hundred metres from the beach and sea, you'll find the well-equipped Cabopino campsite. This part of the coast is the touristic Costa del Sol: an ideal location for sun worshippers. Many restaurants offer local specialties to enjoy while you admire the view over the beach and the Mediterranean Sea.

Wooded terraced campsite

Lovely flowerbeds and a striking dark red reception building give the campsite a colourful character. Terraces characterize the wooded terrain of Cabopino. Especially the front part of the terrain is nicely shaded. The pitches are well maintained, have a flat surface and are situated between flowers and shrubs. On every two or three pitches you'll find a garbage can, so that the campsite stays tidy and doesn't lose its charm because of sloppy camping guests.

Lively campsite with swimming pool

Camping Cabopino is a lively campsite and offers many opportunities for relaxation. For example, there is a large rectangular swimming pool in a clearing on the east side. The pine trees do not block the sun here. Sun loungers around the pool and a sunbathing area offer plenty of space for an afternoon of tanning.

Fitness equipment, a sauna and some slot machines are all at your disposal. In addition, the summer evenings are regularly smartened up with disco music and you can join excursions to nearby places like Marbella and Málaga.

Pleasant pizzeria

Conviviality and good food can be found at the bar and pizzeria, at the front of the campsite. The low wooden building may look simple, but that doesn't make it any less convivial. The pizzeria is open all day.

properties.name: Camping Lac des Brenets
properties.description:
Camping Lac des Brenets is located in the west of Switzerland, less than a kilometre from the border with France. This campsite is within walking distance of the lake of the same name. Lac des Brenets is a lake in the river Doubs. The terraced campsite offers a view of the lake and the surrounding hills. In the green surroundings of the Swiss Jura, the focus is on nature and relaxation. The well-maintained campsite is ideal for sporty people who also like peace and quiet. There is no entertainment programme and no swimming pool.

Enjoy the tranquillity

When you enter the campsite, you will be welcomed by a friendly staff member. The campsite has a limited number of pitches for short stays. The majority of the pitches are rented out to seasonal guests. The guests come mainly for their rest and to enjoy the green surroundings. Several walking and cycling routes depart from the campsite. At the campsite itself, you will find a playground and a table tennis table. Next to the campsite is a tennis court for campsite guests to use.

Cheese fondue at the campsite
