Convenient: next to the campsite is a petrol station with a small supermarket for basic groceries. You will find a larger supermarket seven kilometres away. Don't feel like cooking yourself? There is a restaurant on the campsite where you can enjoy a tasty dinner. Restaurant Bellevue serves various fish, meat and pasta dishes. But you can also join them for a traditional Swiss cheese fondue. The village of Le Locle is a 15-minute drive from the campsite. There are several well-regarded restaurants here.

properties.name: Family Camping
properties.description:
Family Camping is a convivial campsite along the Moselle, in the Rhineland-Palatinate natural region. You camp here in a quiet, excellently maintained spot, with lots of swimming fun for the young thanks to the large children's swimming pool. When you look around you, you will see the hills covered with vineyards. Be sure to visit a vineyard, wine festival or wine tasting. Also fun: take a trip on the Moselle or enjoy the historical towns in the region. The favourite Moselle Cycle Route takes you to places where time seems to stand still.

A place between the grapes

The terrain has neat, demarcated fields and spacious pitches (80 - 100 m2) on a well maintained grass surface. You will also find some pitches between the vines, directly along the Moselle. The bungalow tents that are set up each year, offer unique overnight accommodation. There is also a large apartments with a view of the Moselle.

Entertainment for all children

At Family Camping children can romp and play in the wonderful playground. Children up to 12 can participate in the extensive entertainment programme and in peak season there are also fun activities for teenagers (volleyball in the pool, aerobics). 

Two pools and a cosy terrace

There are two (heated pools) mainly enjoyed by children. The little ones can splash around in a shallow pool (100 m2, directly near the terrace) and older children can use the somewhat deeper pool (120 m2, a bit further from the terrace). This cheerful set-up is in full sun, surrounded by loungers, sun umbrellas and sunbathing lawn. Tired or hungry? Relax on the Mediterranean terrace for a drink or a snack.

properties.name: Camping Les Charmes
properties.description:
In the heart of the Dordogne, in the middle of the forest, lies Les Charmes. This family campsite lives up to its name: it is pleasant, quiet and fitted out with all conveniences. You camp on the grass under the trees. The owners will do everything they can to give their guests a pleasant holiday.

Natural camping

The campsite consists mainly of touring pitches, but there are also four lodge tents, four cabins and eight mobile homes. The pitches and rental accommodations are scattered along the winding paths. There are no straight roads or well-defined rows of camping pitches here. The pitches are laid out in the natural landscape. You camp here as if you were in a park: on the grass at the edge of the wood. The pitches are surrounded by tall trees and shrubs. Not only they provide enough shade and shelter, but you also have privacy around your tent or caravan.

Adventure and water fun

In addition to a covered, heated indoor pool with sliding roof, Les Charmes also has an outdoor pool. Moreover, there are two water slides that lead into a separate pool. The whole is laid out on terraces, surrounded by a sundeck from where you have a panoramic view over the surrounding hills. If you like more adventurous water fun, then you don't have to go very far. The river Dordogne is twelve kilometres from the campsite.

Always something to do

There are countless sights in the area. From castles and prehistoric cave paintings to impressive gorges and characteristic villages. The friendly owners know everything about the area and are happy to give tips about the most beautiful places and the best day trips

properties.name: Camping Belvédère de l'Obiou
properties.description:
In the heart of the French Pre-Alps, Camping Belvédère de l'Obiou is surrounded by various walking and cycling routes. Next to the friendly family campsite is the enormous National Park Les Ecrins, with its eternal snow and vast forests. Everything on the campsite is well-maintained with comfortable, clean facilities. There is a small restaurant, playground, covered recreation room and a swimming pool with sliding roof.

View of the mountains

Thanks to the spacious pitches, you can experience real outdoor life here. The fresh mountain air and the beautiful views are combined with high pine and deciduous trees. Most of the pitches are partly paved and provided with a grass area. Separate pitches are reserved for motorhomes, and gîtes and furnished mobile homes are also available. The sanitary facilities are clean, modern and even heated.

Swimming all day long

Behind the reception is the swimming pool where you can swim in heated water. The roof can also be closed, ideal when the temperature is a bit lower in the mountains. Around the pool are sunbeds, so relaxing and reading a book in the sun is also possible.

Pizza and French breakfast

What's better than waking up on holiday to a fresh breakfast? At Camping Belvédère de l'Obiou you can choose; get fresh bread and croissants at the shop or treat yourself at the restaurant where they also serve breakfast. During the day, the cook prepares regional dishes, pizzas and also vegetarian menus.

properties.name: Camping Ascou la Forge
properties.description:
In a mountainous area in the Ariège, right next to a lovely mountain lake, lies Camping Ascou la Forge. This campsite is an ideal base for sporty holidaymakers such as hikers and cyclists. Other forms of mountain sports are also practiced in the area. In high season the campsite organises all kinds of activities for outdoor enthusiasts.

Camping with lovely view

The campsite has an open character. This allows you to enjoy a beautiful view from all the pitches. In the low season you are free to set up your camping equipment wherever you want. In high season, caravan pitches and tent pitches are separated from each other. Tent campers can even make use of a separate tent area that is completely car-free. Modern and well-maintained sanitary facilities are available for all campers.

Refreshment in swimming pool and river

The climate of Ariège provides many sunny and warm days. Taking a refreshing dip now and then is no superfluous luxury. Fortunately there is an inflatable swimming pool at Camping Ascou la Forge. Furthermore, the small river that runs along the campsite is a nice place to bathe and build dams, for example.

Restaurant and cosy bar

The campsite restaurant has a simple menu with delicious homemade dishes. The cosy bar is where campsite guests like to gather. You are always welcome to come here for a drink. Among other things, you will find a billiards table and various board games here. There is also a shop where you can get fresh bread and some groceries.

properties.name: Glamping de Cerveira
properties.description:
Looking for a place to really unwind for a while? Silence embraces you straight away at Glamping de Cerveira in Viana do Castelo. It’s located in the far north of Portugal, close to the Spanish border. The site is small, terraced and wonderfully simple. The renovated facilities feel luxurious, but nature is the main attraction here. Walk straight into the hills, listen to the birds and pick up fresh bread every morning.

Beautiful glamping accommodation

Choose from glamping tents, bungalows or cosy cabins here. The glamping tents are large enough for families or groups of friends and sleep up to six people. Prefer slightly more homely comfort? Then the renovated bungalow with private patio is a great base. Traditional campers will find large pitches for tents and caravans spread across the site, in the middle of a peaceful green setting.

Jacuzzi, yoga and a vegetarian restaurant

After an active day, take a dip in the saltwater pool. The jacuzzi is already bubbling. If you want to give your muscles some TLC, roll out the yoga mat or book a massage. In the restaurant, taste vegetarian dishes and wine from the region. The atmosphere is relaxed, the service personal. New toilet and washing facilities were added in 2024.

Explore the surrounding area

The area is a walker's paradise. You walk through forests, past small villages and you can even walk some of the famous Camino de Santiago. A visit to the pilgrimage site is possible too. Santiago de Compostella is about 126 km away.

properties.name: Camping du Bas-Larin
properties.description:
Treat yourself to a wonderful break in the Ardèche countryside. Camping du Bas Larin is nestled in the green hills, less than 20 minutes from Annonay and close to the Peaugres Safari Park (7 km). You can camp here in complete peace and quiet, surrounded by a warm, family-friendly atmosphere.

Pitches and rental accommodation

You can choose how you’d like to enjoy your stay here. You can opt for a shady camping pitch with your tent, caravan or motorhome and immerse yourself in the great outdoors. Prefer a bit more comfort? Then you can rent a mobile home, bungalow or chalet. Or go for something a bit more special, like a lodge or bivouac. All of the accommodation units are located in a green, peaceful area surrounded by nature.

Three-star accommodation in the heart of nature

There is a launderette, a bar, a snack bar and a small campsite shop. Order your bread and croissants in the evening, and a fresh breakfast will be ready for you the next morning. Pets are welcome, and groups can also enjoy a pleasant stay here in the Ardèche.

Entertainment under the sun

As soon as the sun comes out, the swimming pool is the perfect place to cool off. Take a refreshing dip in the main pool or let the little ones splash about in the paddling pool. There is a spacious grassy sunbathing area around the pool. You can relax on a sun lounger under a thatched parasol. After arriving, children often run straight to the playground with its XXL trampoline. You can also play a game of boules, mini-golf or have a match at the sports field. There are even chickens roaming around the grounds.

properties.name: Camping-Villaggio-Glamping Torre del Porticciolo
properties.description:
Torre del Porticciollo Campsite is located on the northwest side of Sardinia. You'll experience a different sunset every night at this island campsite in the picturesque bay of Porticciolo. The child-friendly beach, refreshing swimming pool and numerous recreational activities make this a wonderful holiday destination.

The terraced campsite features bungalows, mobile homes and glamping tents. There are also a large number of both sunny and shaded camping pitches for tents, caravans and motorhomes.

The sanitary facilities will be renovated in 2022. There is a strong focus on sustainability.

Child-friendly bay

The campsite is located high above the beach, giving you a beautiful view of the rocky coast and the sea. A long staircase leads you to the private beach, an ideal location for snorkelling.

The swimming pool is also a wonderful place to enjoy your holiday.

Sardinian specialities

The campsite shop has freshly baked bread rolls every day. The campsite also features a restaurant and a bar, where you can enjoy drinks and traditional Sardinian dishes, such as filled pastas, fish dishes and cheeses such as pecorino. There is also a snack bar and a beach bar.

Entertainment team and kids club

Torre del Porticciollo Campsite has a playground where you can play football, (table) tennis, exercise and take part in Pilates. And, of course, campers of all ages can take part in the activities organised the entertainment team and enjoy the night-time musical shows for the whole family. You can also take part in sporting activities such as kayaking, supping or cycling.

Discover Sardinia

The Porto Conte Regional Natural Park is nearby and is a wonderful place for walking and picnicking. The historic city of Alghero is also located just 15 kilometres from the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Neumannshof
properties.description:
Do you enjoy holidays in peaceful surroundings, where you can enjoy water sports and walks in the woods? Then Camping Neumannshof near Gössitz (Thuringia) is an excellent choice. The campsite has its own beach and jetties on the Hohenwarte Stausee, a winding reservoir offering a wide range of water-based activities. The surrounding area offers wonderful walking and cycling routes through vast forests.

Book a spot by the reservoir

This campsite has an elongated layout. Half of the touring pitches are situated by the water, while the other half are spread across the beautifully landscaped terraced levels at the edge of the forest. Most pitches are separated by tall hedges, ensuring plenty of privacy. You can also book a stay at Camping Neumannshof in a modern bungalow or a comfortable apartment.

Enjoy the watersports lifestyle

The location of this campsite is ideal for water sports enthusiasts, right next to a lovely grass and pebble beach about fifty metres long and fifteen metres wide. Several jetties have been built, so feel free to bring your own boat. Of course, you can also take a refreshing dip in the lake. Afterwards, why not head over to Vier Jahreszeiten, the excellent restaurant attached to the campsite? If you prefer to cook your own meals, basic essentials are available in the shop at reception.

Walking trails through nature

One of the best ways to explore this part of Thuringia is by taking a boat trip across the lake. This offers unobstructed views of the forests surrounding the lake. A lovely walk is, of course, also highly recommended.

properties.name: Camping d'Angers-Lac de Maine
properties.description:
Camping d'Angers-Lac de Maine is a family campsite within cycling distance of Angers, capital of the Maine-et-Loire department. The campsite is situated on the Lac de Maine near a leisure park. Here you can camp in a park-like nature reserve ideal for walking and cycling tours. Children can also experience all sorts of things here.

Lac de Maine

If you stay at camping d'Angers-Lac de Maine, you are only a few steps away from Lac de Maine, a vast recreational lake. Around the lake it is lovely to walk and cycle, and in the lake you can have a nice swim. In addition, you have the opportunity to surf, canoe and sail. Get in that sailing boat and enjoy the expansive water and the view of Angers, which protrudes above the trees in the background.

Swimming pool

f you prefer to swim in a swimming pool, you can do so at the campsite. Although not very special, the swimming pool is a nice place for an hour of water fun. Next to the swimming pool is a terrace.

Supermarket

For fresh sandwiches you can go to the reception. Within a five minute drive you are in front of a supermarket, ideal for the rest of the groceries.

properties.name: EuroParcs De Achterhoek
properties.description:
EuroParcs De Achterhoek is located in the beautiful Lochem countryside, with its forests and vast grasslands. At this holiday park, you will stay in nice accommodation. There is something for everyone, whether young and old. The combination of its location and facilities makes EuroParcs De Achterhoek an ideal base from which to explore the Achterhoek region.

Accommodations in all shapes and sizes

The park offers a variety of accommodation, ranging from detached chalets to spacious bungalows with even a sauna. For example, 'Pavilion 4' sleeps 4 and features modern furnishings. 'De Wiersse 6' is a stone bungalow by the water, ideal for 6 people looking for peace and nature. For larger groups, there is the 'Boekhorst l'etage 12', a chalet with wooden elements for 12 people. This diversity ensures that there is a suitable accommodation option for every desire.

Play, swim and feast

EuroParcs De Achterhoek targets families and nature lovers. Children have fun in the (indoor) playground or cool off in the recreational pond. In less fine weather, they dive into the indoor pool. During school holidays, the entertainment team organises various activities for young and old. There are also sports fields, bike rental and a restaurant, ensuring the whole family enjoys a relaxing holiday.

Surroundings and activities

The area around campsite offers numerous options for trips. For example, you can cycle the 34-kilometre Achtkastelenroute in Vorden, passing impressive castles. Fun outings with children include the climbing forest in Ruurlo (13 km) and Hof van Eckberge in Eibergen (21.5 km).

properties.name: Camping La Gorga
properties.description:
Camping La Gorga, located in the charming Boltaña in the Spanish province of Huesca, Aragón, offers an idyllic camping experience in the Spanish Pyrenees. Right by River Ara, it is the perfect place for nature lovers and the adventurous. The campsite is close to nature parks and historic towns, such as Aínsa.

Lovely, terraced pitches and modern bungalows

The campsite is designed as a terraced campsite with well-maintained grassy pitches and modern bungalows, ideal for glamping. The bungalows were fully renovated in 2023, providing comfortable options to stay.

Swimming in the swimming pool and river

You can choose between swimming in the campsite's swimming pool, complete with hot tub and paddling pool, or in the River Ara. The swimming pool is covered and heated outdoors in the high season. The retractable roof opens in the summer, providing natural heating. The river offers safe swimming options with a sandy beach and shallow water.

Fun activities in the high season

During the high season, the campsite offers a range of activities, including sports, crafting, themed parties and yoga. Guests highly appreciate the entertainment.

Traditional meals and local amenities

The campsite restaurant serves traditional dishes. Guests wanting more eateries and shops can walk to the nearby village.

Modern toilet and washing facilities

The campsite has two modern toilet blocks, with facilities such as a baby bathroom and adapted bathroom for the disabled.

Paradise for nature lovers and those who enjoy mountain sports

Camping La Gorga is an excellent departure point for exploring the Spanish Pyrenees, with nature parks such as Ordesa y Monte Perdido (45 km) and the Sierra de Guara (124 km). These areas are ideal for walking, canyoning and caving.

properties.name: Ötscherland-Camping
properties.description:
Ötscherland-Camping is a campsite in the mountain sports village of Lunz am See, Lower Austria. This lovely setting amid the Alps and on the banks of the Lunzer See ensures that there are plenty of lovely things to see and do throughout the year. The campsite has various walking and cycling routes for active holidaymakers. Furthermore, guests can enjoy activities like skating on the nearby lake in the winter months. This makes the campsite an attractive destination for both summer and winter camping holidays.

Motorhome pitches and log cabins

Ötscherland-Camping has something for everyone. Whether you are a camper coming with a tent, caravan or motorhome, the campsite offers spacious camping pitches with modern amenities such as electricity, good toilet and washing facilities, and free Wi-Fi. There are also ten paved camping pitches. If you prefer to hire comfortable accommodation, you could opt for one of the lovely wooden log cabins.

Fresh bread rolls and Austrian pastries

This campsite offers an extensive breakfast service, with freshly baked bread rolls and tasty Austrian pastries to get your day off to a good start. For winter guests, there is a heated ski hut for safely storing your winter sports equipment. The toilet and washing facilities are maintained with great care.

Playing in River Ois

The campsite has direct access to the calm River Ois. Many campers set up their camping equipment right on the riverbanks for a wonderful view. And although there is fun playground equipment at the campsite, the calm river is often the best playground nature has to offer children.

properties.name: Camping Wagenhausen
properties.description:
The Wagenhausen campsite is located right next to the Rhine in Thurgau, Switzerland. The campsite is the perfect base for exploring one of Switzerland's most beautiful lake and river regions. Book a large pitch or choose one of the special accommodation options, such as a circus wagon or tiny house. Fun places like Stein am Rhein and Wagenhausen are a short distance away.

Pitches and unique accommodation

You can choose from 280 pitches. Do you want a large pitch with an unobstructed view or would you rather cosy up with the regulars? Both are possible. For anyone who wants to try glamping, there are atmospheric circus wagons and modern tiny houses. You’ll sleep a stone's throw from the Rhine with a view of the water, waking up to bird song in the morning. That's real relaxation.

Everything you might need

After an active day, take a dip in the pool. This sunny, newly-constructed area is on the edge of the campsite and the ideal place to cool off. Hungry? The restaurant serves local dishes and the spacious terrace is a lovely place to sit. Locals like to sit here too. Fresh bread or a tasty local product can be bought at reception, which also serves as a small shop.

Explore the Rhine and surrounding area

Camping Wagenhausen is located in Swiss Thurgau, next to the Rhine. Stein am Rhein (1.5 km) and Wagenhausen (1.7 km), small towns full of timber-framed houses and cosy streets, are close by. The Rheinfall (20.5 km), Europe's largest waterfall, is nearby too.

properties.name: Camping Le Muret
properties.description:
Camping Le Muret is a lovely spot for those seeking peace and quiet in the Aveyron. This modestly sized, family-friendly campsite is surrounded by greenery, offering sweeping views. The campsite is spacious and shady, you can swim in a natural lake and enjoy local dishes in the bistro in the evening. There is also plenty to do in the surrounding area. For example, you can visit the villages of Najac and Saint-Salvadou, or explore the Viaur valley on foot. You can truly escape the hustle and bustle here while enjoying the French outdoors.

Spacious pitches and luxury accommodation

With around 40 spacious pitches, it never feels crowded here. You can set up your tent, caravan or motorhome under the ancient trees or enjoy a view over the rolling meadows. Everywhere you go, you will enjoy privacy and space. The naturally landscaped pitches offer pleasant shade on hot days. Prefer a bit more comfort? Then choose a fully equipped glamping tent or a luxury tepee. Then you can enjoy the great outdoors without having to compromise on comfort. Ideal for families or couples looking for that little bit of extra luxury.

Everything you might need

Here, your days begin with fresh bread rolls and a cup of coffee in the morning sun. Afterwards, you can take a refreshing dip in the natural lake or cast your fishing rod. At the end of the afternoon, you can take a seat outside at the bar and bistro, where you can choose from local specialities and order a nice glass of wine. There is often live music or a fun theme night.

properties.name: Woodlands Caravan Park
properties.description:
About eighteen kilometres from the Welsh seaside resort of Aberystwyth is the attractive Woodlands Caravan Park campsite. Aberystwyth is a lively university town with lovely sandy beaches and the beautiful sea. You can camp here in a wooded area close to the centuries-old Devil's Bridge waterfalls and a steam railway. An ideal place for seekers of peace, nature-lovers, fans of the beach and, of course, those who love Wales. The campsite is easy to reach.

Gypsy pod

The green, well maintained site looks atmospheric. Set up your caravan, camper van or tent on the beautiful, gently sloping lawn dotted with deciduous trees and the forested low mountain range in the background. The pitches are spacious and partly paved. Want to hire something? It's good to know that you could end up in a hiker's hut, bungalow or an adventurous 'gypsy pod'. The sanitary facilities are new, look well maintained, and are kept nice and clean.

Playing paradise

Children have plenty of space on this campsite. There is a wonderful playing area with several pieces of play equipment, perfect for entertaining the children. The wooded area is great for walking (not suitable for those who are less mobile). The nearby area is home to a mountain bike trail. The campsite has various bicycle and hiking routes available for guests. 

Afternoon tea

The tea room, complete with a cosy terrace on a wooden deck, is great for breakfast, lunch, an afternoon tea (always with 'homemade cake') or simple, hot meals. You can also get take-away meals in high season. The small camping shop features a limited range of groceries and a few typically Welsh products. You can also go there for camping gear.

properties.name: Camping de Reenert
properties.description:
If you like to spend your holiday in natural surroundings with lots of natural greenery, quiet and space, then this naturist campsite in central Luxembourg is certainly a good option. You benefit from plenty of space and privacy at Camping de Reenert. Beside an indoor swimming pool, wellness zone and some pieces of playground equipment, there are few amenities. You can use all the amenities at Fuussekaul, the large campsite on the other side of the road. That campsite includes a heated swimming pool, several outdoor playgrounds, a lovely indoor playground and a good restaurant.

Report to the reception at Fuussekaul

The campsite is on the left side of the road. You can also first park your car at Fuussekaul's large car park. Check in at reception next to the car park. You will then be given an access code for De Reenert's site. The entrance gate is behind the camping pitches at Fuussekaul.

Spacious touring pitches with power supply

A winding path runs over De Reeneert's site. Various dead-end paths branch off from this path, which lead to the camping pitches. They are spacious pitches demarcated with neat hedging. All camping pitches have electricity. People coming without their own camping equipment but who still want to give a naturist campsite a go, can hire a mobile home or chalet.

Swimming pool and wellness in the large log cabin

The heated indoor swimming pool is in the log cabin. The modern wellness centre is one floor up. Here, you can use the Finnish sauna, a steam bath, a cold water bath and a relaxation room.

properties.name: Jambo Feriepark
properties.description:
Head to Jambo Feriepark for an unforgettable camping adventure in Denmark's North Jutland. Whether you like peace and quiet or action and adventure, this is the place to be. There’s lots to do for young and old, at the campsite and just outside.

Pitch or cosy wooden cabin?

At Jambo Feriepark, you can choose between large pitches or comfortable accommodation, like cabins. The pitches are ideal for campers travelling with a motor home, caravan or tent. Prefer a little more luxury? The wooden cabins and cosy caravans are fully equipped.

Fun for the whole family

You won’t need to leave Jambo Feriepark for holiday fun. Take a dip in the heated swimming pool, relax in the sauna, play some mini golf or have fun in one of the (indoor) playgrounds. Who can jump the highest on the trampolines or pedal the fastest on the go-karts?

After a day of exercise or relaxation, take a seat in the campsite restaurant. While the young campers enjoy the entertainment or playground, parents can relax on the terrace with a good glass of wine. Will you stop off at the ice cream parlour next to the restaurant afterwards? It has 24 different flavours!

Nature, adventure and beautiful towns

Jambo Feriepark is located in Saltum, in the heart of North Jutland. Go walking or cycling in the forests and dunes. There are numerous mountain bike trails in the area. Or rent a canoe, and explore the area from the water. And the North Sea is just 3 km away!

properties.name: Camping Am Ziernsee
properties.description:
Ziernsee campsite is located in Germany's largest forest lake district, close to the town of Radensee (Priepert), about 100 kilometres north of Berlin. You will be camping here in the Mecklenburg Lake District. This is also known as 'the land of 1000 lakes'. If you are a water lover, you can have plenty of fun here.

Camping in the green

At this tidy campsite you will find spacious pitches of different sizes so you can always find a nice spot. Putting up a tent can be quite a challenge, because the ground is not always soft. Once installed, you can enjoy the beautiful view of the lake surrounded by a forest. When you have recovered from putting up your tent, you can dive into the lake or step into a boat from the jetty.

Out and about in a canoe

Less than ten minutes' drive from the campsite you can hire a boat for a day on the water. Ideal if you like to go on a boat trip, but don't have a boat of your own. The lake is also great for water activities such as snorkelling and windsurfing: hello water sports! The campsite is also a must for the 'wasserwanderer'. These are holidaymakers who travel by canoe.

Having fun at the campfire

After a day on the water, catch your breath at the campfire. During the school holidays, once every fortnight you can enjoy music, bread and the company of the other camping guests around a crackling fire. Are you ready for a cultural outing after swimming and sailing? A real must is Schloss Rheinsberg. This castle is about fifteen kilometres from the campsite.

properties.name: Naturcamping am Grossen Pälitzsee
properties.description:
Camping by a lake in unspoilt nature, that is possible in the German 'Land of a thousand lakes', or the 'Mecklenburg Seenplatte'. This beautiful area full of forests and interconnected lakes is located in the northeast of Germany. It is a Valhalla for nature lovers, water sports enthusiasts and bird watchers. The small-scale Naturcamping am Grossen Pällitzsee is an ideal place for campers to completely immerse themselves in this area.

Directly by the lake

You arrive at an oasis of calm in the middle of nature. Here you are between the woods and by the water, away from the hustle and bustle. The campsite is well looked after with pitches of different sizes in the woods and in open spaces. The campsite is situated directly on the Grosser Pällitzsee lake.

Swimming and canoeing

It is not surprising that the campsite attracts many canoe and kayak enthusiasts. In this lake district, many lakes are connected by canals and small rivers. This also applies to the Grosser Pällitzee. So it's ideal if you want to go on a hiking trip with a canoe and a tent. These hikers are also very popular guests.

Summer campfire evenings

In the summer, you will also find many families here who are looking for pure nature and water. Most families come from Germany, the Netherlands and Switzerland. The children can have fun in the water and in the forest. There is also a playground and sports field, and in the summer holidays you can roast a sandwich in the campfire every evening, accompanied by pleasant music. In the summer holidays there is also entertainment for children once a week.

properties.name: Eidertal Camping GmbH
properties.description:
In the north of Germany, along the meandering Eider River, lies this small-scale campsite. On the grounds of Eidertal Camping GmbH, you will camp together with other tourists on the open fields and next to the permanent pitches. During the hot summer months, you can cool down in the refreshing swimming pool with a paddling pool for the smallest guests. Are you looking for more water fun? On the Eider river you can do water sports or go fishing.

Relax at this friendly campsite

Eidertal Camping GmbH is a small campsite with many permanent pitches. But the tourist pitches are also very clean and are booked by families with children in high season and senior citizens in low season. The pitches are spacious with some privacy. The unique location of this campsite on the Eider river makes it special. Here you can enjoy the peace and quiet of nature.

Swimming fun and water sports

After a day of walking or cycling, it's great to cool down in the campsite pool. The swimming pool at Eidertal Camping GmbH is the perfect size for swimming laps. For the little ones, there is a special paddling pool next to the main pool. You can hire canoes at the campsite for a lovely trip on the Eider river. From the campsite you walk over the dyke to the river, where you can relax. Besides canoeing, you can also fish here. The campsite provides a special fishing permit.

properties.name: Camping Huttopia Fontvieille
properties.description:
Camping Huttopia Fontvieille is located at the foot of the Alpilles, the low mountain range in Provence,. This quiet, green campsite is situated in a large pine forest. A great place for campers looking for peace and quiet. Young and old can have fun here: enjoy a relaxing camping holiday among the pines, take a dip in the sunny swimming pool and explore the forests by mountain bike.

Camping among the pines

The campsite is situated in the middle of a pine forest with tall pine trees. Because of this you might think it is very dark, but nothing could be further from the truth. The terrain is very spacious and the trees let in a lot of sunshine, which makes the pitches nice and light. Breathe in the fresh scent of the pine trees and enjoy the sun: at this campsite you can really unwind.

Sunny pool

The swimming pool is situated in a sunny spot behind the reception. Or rather, there are two: a round paddling pool where the smallest swimmers can splash around, and a slightly deeper pool. Around the pools you'll find sun loungers. If you want to go to the sea for a day, that's also possible. A fifty-kilometre drive through the unique Camargue nature reserve brings you to the elongated beach of Saintes-Maries-de-la-Mer and the Mediterranean Sea.

Mountain bikes for rent

In addition to the paddling pool and swimming pool, children can have fun in the children's playground or during the craft afternoons of the summer entertainment programme. You will also find a petanque court and volleyball court on the campsite. Youcan also explore the forest and the beautiful surroundings on a mountain bike. Don't have one yourself? Then just rent one at the campsite.

properties.name: Campingpark Oderhaff
properties.description:
Go on holiday by the Baltic Sea at Campingpark Oderhaff. At this campsite, only three kilometres from the coastal resort of Uckermünde, you can enjoy the tranquillity and space with swimming water on your doorstep. And that's whether you come for the night or a longer stay. There is plenty of space under the trees for tents, caravans and motorhomes. And within a few steps, you will be on the private beach by the Baltic Sea. This area is also known for the lovely cycle routes such as Ostseeradweg and Oder-Neisse.

Nature campsite among the trees

Oderhaff is a forest campsite with high birches and pine trees that provide plenty of shade. The site is open on one side, allowing sun worshippers to choose a sunny pitch. There is a path from the campsite to a lovely sandy beach. The two modern toilet blocks offer comfortable facilities, and for those who like convenience, the campsite has a handy bread service.

Open all year round

Guest are welcome throughout the year at Campingpark Oderhaff. You can count on a lovely stay even if you go camping in the winter. And in December, you can even enjoy one of the charming Christmas markets in the vicinity. From June, you can take part in summer activities such as stand-up paddleboarding, swimming lessons, yoga and fitness. Dogs are warmly welcome and even have their own beach to enjoy. Explore the beautiful cycle routes in the area, so make sure you take your bike or hire one at the campsite.

properties.name: Capfun Camping Zeumersehof
properties.description:
You will find this cosy family campsite on the edge of the Veluwe in the wooded outskirts of Voorthuizen. At Capfun Campsite Zeumersehof, you can stay in a mobile home or chalet in a beautiful green environment. Children play and swim here all day long. The beautiful forests of the Veluwe are just around the corner. Perfect for a walk or bike ride. Although the campsite is surrounded by nature, the village of Voorthuizen is nearby for shopping and groceries.

Surrounded by greenery

You can only rent accommodations at the Zeumersehof. You can find that camping feeling in a mobile home or spend your holiday in a chalet. The caravans and chalets are nestled among the trees on various natural ponds. The rental accommodations are fully equipped. Families with young children will find the special mobile homes for kids interesting. These are designed in such a way that the children can play without sneaking off.

From swimming to jumping fun

Rain or shine, you can always swim here! There is an indoor swimming pool with a sliding roof that can be opened on sunny days. Young and old can enjoy themselves on a number of colourful slides. Small children will experience the best adventures on the pirate boat in the paddling pool.

Are you tired of the water? Children can continue playing in one of the playgrounds. In Boeing Land, there are no fewer than four bouncy castles. A game of football or jeu de boules is also possible. In high season there is also an animation team where kids can do crafts, dance or participate in treasure hunts.

properties.name: EuroParcs Beekbergen
properties.description:
EuroParcs Beekbergen is a resort with glamping accommodations. The luxury cottages and the wooded location allow you to relax completely. At the same time, this child-friendly holiday park with an indoor swimming pool, a children's entertainment programme and various catering establishments also provides plenty of entertainment and activity. You also profit from a central location on the Veluwe, making it a beautiful holiday address for nature lovers, hikers and cyclists.

Plenty of choice in accommodation

The large holiday park has three different entrances. The main entrance, which is where the reception is (also called the blue entrance), is on the Hoge Bergweg. The other two entrances (red and green) can be accessed from the Lage Bergweg. Check the map of EuroParcs Beekbergen to see which entrance is closest to your accommodation. The park offers accommodation that includes luxury holiday cottages, modern chalets or trendy tiny houses.

What does the park offer in the way of entertainment?

Great swimming can be done in the indoor swimming pool. The youngest guests usually enjoy themselves immensely in the large paddling pool. Children will also have the time of their lives in the playgrounds. EuroParcs Beekbergen has children's entertainment during the high season. Eating out can be done at Sophia’s Italian. In addition to this restaurant, the park has a snack bar, lounge, shop and even an automatic pizza kiosk.

Surrounded by fun attractions

Leaving from the park, you can go on great hikes and bicycle rides through the extensive wooded areas of the Veluwe. The holiday park is a maximum of twenty minutes driving from amusement parks such as Apenheul, Kinderpretpark Julianatoren and Burgers’ Zoo.

properties.name: Vakantiepark de Zeeuwse Parel
properties.description:
Going on holiday to Zeeland? Camp at Vakantiepark de Zeeuwse Parel. The beach is within walking distance and there’s always something fun to do. Get some fresh air at the coast, splash in the pool or enjoy the wellness facilities. Or will you be active and try your hand at bowling or go cycling?

Accommodation right for you

At Vakantiepark de Zeeuwse Parel, you can choose how you want to camp. Opt for a standard or luxury camping pitch, or one with private toilet and washing facilities. If you prefer more comfort, you can choose from a range of mobile homes and chalets. Extra luxury? Hotel rooms are available too. And for campers who can't get enough of this campsite: annual and seasonal pitches are available as well.

Facilities that make your holiday complete

You don't really need to leave the campsite to have a fun camping holiday. There’s so much to do! Little campers can have fun in the indoor and outdoor playgrounds, the trampoline park and the kids' club. Active campers can rent a bike or electric bike, play boules, head for the paddle court, or spend an afternoon in the fitness areas.

You can also relax in the spa, take a dip in the indoor pool, spend an evening at the bowling alley and enjoy the beach.

Explore the surrounding area

The surroundings of De Zeeuwse Parel are as varied as the holiday park itself. Look for shells on the beach or get on your bike. Take a trip across the dikes, past picturesque villages or head to nature reserves De Pluimpot and Het Rammegors.

properties.name: EuroParcs Hoge Kempen
properties.description:
EuroParcs Hoge Kempen is in a wonderfully quiet spot, amid the forests near Zutendaal in the Belgian province of Limburg. You can take numerous lovely walks and bike rides in the immediate vicinity of this holiday park. In the high season, this is a popular holiday address for families with children. This is partly due to the large outdoor swimming pool opposite the campsite and the fun activities organised in the summer. Outside the season, this campsite is mainly visited by nature lovers, walkers and cyclists.

Shaded touring pitches and various types of accommodation

Accommodation dominate at this forested holiday park. At EuroParcs Hoge Kempen, you can hire lodge tents, tiny houses, cottages and luxury holiday homes, for example. Besides glamping options, EuroParcs Hoge Kempen also offers touring pitches. There are several lovely camping fields in the middle of the site where you can book a spacious shaded camping pitch.

Cool down in the spray park or in 't Soete Dal swimming pool

There is a fun spray and splash swimming pool for children right next to the restaurant. This spray park has numerous play equipment and fountains where the youngest campers can play and splash about in and with the water.

The lovely Zwembad 't Soete Dal is also opposite EuroParcs Hoge Kempen. It is a large outdoor swimming pool with paddling pool. You can swim here for free as a campsite guest. You can also swim for free in Zwembad De Kimpel in Bilzen.

Plenty of sport, games and entertainment

There is plenty of entertainment in the high season at EuroParcs Hoge Kempen. They often have disco evenings, dance parties and sports tournaments. The youngest campers can do crafts or go on a treasure hunt together.

properties.name: Camping Les Plans
properties.description:
At the foot of the wooded Cevennes, on the river Le Gardon de Mialet, you can enjoy a peaceful holiday. Where? At camping Les Plans, of course! The campsite is located on a modestly equipped terrain. The swimming pool, however, is not in the least modest. As a result of a recent renovation, young and old can have endless water fun, both in the large pool and separate toddler pool.

Playful pitches

The pitches on the shaded terrain are spaciously laid out. No 'narrow-mindedness' here, everything is playfully designed and the pitches are randomly located in terms of size. As there are no hedges or bushes, privacy is limited.

Water galore

The beautiful swimming pool (heated, 220 m2), with three slides, is located at the edge of the campsite and has a separate toddler pool of 23 m2. The trump card of Les Plans: the campsite is located on an attractive pebble beach on the river Le Gardon de Mialet. The river flows peacefully along the campsite. Imagine this in your mind's eye: clear water between white, low rock formations and river banks lined with bushes and trees.

Also a hotel

The campsite has rental accommodation units as well as a hotel. This is located across the road. The hotel also has a restaurant, decorated in Provençal style. What luxury! The campsite is very popular with families. They can swim, play mini golf or participate in the entertainment. There is also a sports field for volleyball, basketball and soccer.

properties.name: Camping Eldorado
properties.description:
Camping Eldorado is situated in a beautiful location at the Mookerplas, a branch of the river Meuse in the north of Limburg, close to the tiny village of Plasmolen. This cosy family campsite with adjacent marina is a true paradise for watersports enthusiasts. Culture and nature lovers will also enjoy themselves here.

Beautiful view

The terrain is elongated and follows a bend of the Mookerplas. The marina across the public road also belongs to the campsite. There you will find the field with camping pitches. Do you have a tent or a caravan? Make a selection of generous pitches amidst greenery or on the bank of the Mookerplas. From the edge of the lake you have a splendid view. Many of these pitches are reserved for seasonal campers, however.

Good sanitary facilities

Spread over the park are several well maintained sanitary buildings. Some of them have recently been renovated and look fantastic. The pitches have their own sanitary building.

Swimming pool for the little ones

In the holidays the campsite is very popular with families with young children. In high season all kinds of activities are organised for them (craft, live Risk, water spectacles). In addition, the campsite has two playgrounds. You can swim in the Mookerplas, but there is also a children's swimming pool with water play equipment, fountains and a small water slide.

Fine dining or a small snack

Near the entrance of the campsite, next to the reception, is a well-stocked shop. You can go there in the morning for breakfast (fresh rolls). On the camping grounds are several catering facilities (brasserie and cafetaria).

properties.name: Camping Krieghuusbelten
properties.description:
The well maintained family holiday park Kriegshussbelten is located in the heart of Overijssel, a forested environment. The campsite is located in Salland, an area known for its quiet environment with many historic villages, estates and farms. It is a lovely campsite for the entire family, where you camp on fabulous comfort sites on well maintained fields.

Spacious pitches

The campsites are scattered over multiple nicely maintained grassy fields. In the middle there are sandboxes and great play equipment for the kids. All campsites are spacious and not separated. You can choose a place in the sun or sites in a more forested area. Luxury safari lodges and completely furnished camping lodges are spread out over the property. There is a hiking and play forest in the north-east part of the property.

Innumerable play options

This family campsite offers children plenty of play options. There is a large playground in addition to the playgrounds on the camping fields. There are also multiple volleyball, football and badminton pitches. In poor weather we offer the sports hall and the indoor playground (with trampoline and a building corner with big Lego blocks). The interactive play field is very special, where mobile technology and traditional play come together. In the weekends and in the holiday periods there is a great activities team.

Super-long water slide

At the front of the property there is a heated swimming pool with a 50 m long water slide and a separate kiddie pool. In warm weather the sliding roof can be partially opened. And it's always nice to go to the pond (only accessible to campsite guests). There is also a sandy beach and sunbathing meadow. You can swim, fish or take a boat ride on the pond.

properties.name: Drau-Camping Sachsenburg
properties.description:
Attention all nature lovers! Are you looking for a nice, quiet campsite in Carinthia, in the middle of Austria, for a holiday that is all about hiking, cycling, water sports or swimming? Then Drau-Camping Sachsenburg is the right campsite for you. This friendly, small campsite is located directly on the Drau river. This is also a great place to discover the mountain world with a young family or to enjoy the early and late season in peace and quiet.

Upon arrival at the campsite, you will receive a warm welcome at the reception desk from the friendly owner. Here you will also find information about trips and routes. In addition, you will find a pleasant recreation room on the top floor of this building.

Excellent sanitary facilities

The campsite itself is a beautifully maintained area with neat and spacious camping fields. These are very suitable for touring campers. There are also some mobile homes and log cabins for rent. The sanitary facilities are particularly clean and tidy and there are good facilities for disabled campers. You can walk straight into the village for your daily shopping and there are also several restaurants in the area. There is no shop or restaurant on the campsite itself.

Free access to the outdoor swimming pool

The campsite is popular with those looking for peace and quiet, walking and cycling enthusiasts and campers who come for water sports on the Drau. The heated open-air swimming pool in Sachsenburg is a 15-minute walk away and accessible free of charge to campers. Here you can swim and relax on the sunbathing lawn, while enjoying the view of the mountain landscape.

properties.name: Camping l'Île du Chéran
properties.description:
The Savoie is known for its high mountains with snowy peaks. And its cheese is famous throughout France and the rest of Europe. At L'île de Chéran Campsite you'll be camping in the Savoie, close to the border with the Haute-Savoie. Surrounded by mountains and forest, L'île du Chéran Campsite is a good base for sporty campers. You can practice various water sports such as water skiing in the recreational lake next to the campsite.

Beautiful surroundings

Campers choose this campsite mainly because of its beautiful location. It lies directly on a recreational lake and close to the Chéran river. You'll enjoy a view of the surrounding mountains and the green environment from your camping pitch. The medium-sized campsite has many camping spots, but you can also rent accommodation here. The campsite is suitable for sporty campers because you can walk and cycle endlessly in the area. Don't feel like cooking? Then you can eat in the campsite restaurant where simple dishes are served.

Fun in the water

You are guaranteed to have fun in the water at L'île du Chéran Campsite. The campsite is located directly on a small recreational lake with a water ski track. Here you can wakeboarding on a cable installation. This lake is also suitable for anglers. Right next to the campsite (300 metres away) is a lake where you can swim, canoe, rent a pedal boat or go paddleboarding. Ideal for cooling off on hot days. There is even a waterslide that you can whiz down. There is also a beach with a sunbathing area where you can enjoy the warmth of the sun.

properties.name: Camping Universal
properties.description:
Camping Universal is a small family campsite in green surroundings. You will immediately feel at home in this oasis of peace. The campsite is situated in the countryside by the river Cèze. From the campsite you have direct access to the river. Saint-Ambroix is eight kilometres away. This is a pleasant medieval town with many catering facilities and various shops.

Enjoying the shade

The hospitable owners welcome you at the entrance of their campsite in the reception annex bar. You are on a flat campsite with various accommodations to the right and the pitches between the trees. Extra pleasant: the sanitary facilities are modern and well maintained.

Camping at high altitude

The high trees on the site provide plenty of shade on your spacious pitch. You can also camp at a great height. The campsite has two tree houses at no less than 10 and 12 metres. Great fun for an adventurous holiday. Do you prefer to stay closer to the ground? You can also rent a wooden house on stilts (two metres high), a gypsy caravan or a mobile home. At this campsite, you will mainly be accompanied by families with children.

A fresh dive every day

As the campsite is situated directly on the river, you can start every day with a fresh plunge. Camping Universal also has a beautifully landscaped swimming pool lying in the sun. Afterwards, you can enjoy a tasty snack or something from the extensive menu in the restaurant. The campsite also has a shop with a small selection. For more extensive shopping, you can make a trip to Saint-Ambroix.

properties.name: Campingplatz am Garder See
properties.description:
Campingplatz am Garder See is in the East German Mecklenburg-Vor-Pommeren or Mecklenburg–Western Pomerania. The campsite is close to the lake and is surrounded by a large forest. It is an ideal location for exploring the surroundings on foot or on a bicycle. The green campsite is a perfect home base for campsite visitors who love nature.

Great campsite

The green Campingplatz am Garder See is given an excellent review by campsite visitors. There are both touring pitches and pitches for seasonal campsite visitors. It is also possible to rent bungalows or an idyllic wooden chalet for two guests at the campsite. Fresh rolls can be purchased daily at the small supermarket. Campsite visitors have rated the toilet block as clean and neat.

Holiday by the water

The campsite is within walking distance of a lake. You need only cross the access road to the campsite. There is a small harbour for row boats, canoes and pedal boats. There is also a section of the lake where you can go swimming. The water deepens gradually, making it suitable for swimming with small children.

properties.name: Camping Il Boschetto di Piemma
properties.description:
Those looking for a campsite in or around San Gimignano, perhaps the most beautiful village in Tuscany, would make an excellent choice with a stay at Il Boschetto di Piemma Campsite. This campsite is only two kilometres from the medieval village centre. Furthermore, it only takes you half an hour from here to reach the iconic towns of Siena and Volterra. Florence, Pisa and Lucca are also close by.

A well-maintained, wooded campsite

Il Boschetto di Piemma is located in a forest, so most camping pitches are shaded. The site is well maintained and efficiently laid out, with both modest and (very) spacious touring pitches. You can also rent a mobile home here. Units are available for two to seven people. These accommodations are on a separate site, apart from the camping area.

Swim for free in the lovely municipal swimming pool

Fifty metres from the campsite is the wonderful Piscina Comunale San Gimignano swimming pool. This is a public municipal swimming pool that is accessible free of charge for guests of this campsite. It consists of a large, rectangular pool with a beautiful paddling pool next to it. Both baths have heated water. The swimming pool is in full sun, although parasols can of course provide some shade.

Dining out? Do that at Ristorante Selva Delle Torri

Ristorante Selva Delle Torri is located at the edge of the campsite. This restaurant ensures that you don't necessarily have to leave the premises for a nice meal, as Selva Delle Torri has an extensive range of tasty dishes.

properties.name: Camping Haus am See, Dreifelder Weiher
Camping de L'Eau Mère
properties.description:
The green location of Camping de L'Eau Mère is an asset for nature lovers and those seeking peace and quiet. The Allier valley between the Parc Naturel Regional des Volcans d’Auvergne (Auvergne Volcanoes Regional Nature Park) and the Parc Naturel Regional Livradois-Forez (Livradois-Forez Regional Natural Park) is a popular camping destination. Within walking distance of the campsite lies Sauxillanges, which is the starting point for beautiful short and long walking tours through the volcanic landscape. You can also go here for your daily shopping. Fishing is permitted in the stream that flows past the campsite.

Camping in the Puy-de-Dôme

While driving towards the campsite, you will pass the foothills of the Livradois mountains in a hilly region close to the A75. The campsite is only 15 minutes away from the exit, making it a good place to stop on your journey. The historic city Issoire and the capital city of Puy-de-Dôme, Clermont Ferrand, are both easily accessible. Perfect for a day out. You will be warmly welcomed at the reception by the cheerful owner Sébastien. The extensive site is well-organised and has spacious pitches, some of which have a panoramic view of the surrounding hills.

Pitches under the trees

Several high trees enhance the calming effect of the campsite. All pitches are imaginatively demarcated using low railway sleepers and are at least 90 m2 in size. The main toilet block, in the same building as the reception, has all necessary amenities for children and disabled persons. For guests without their own camping equipment, various types of mobile homes are available for comfortable overnight stays.

properties.name: Halse Farm Car. & Tent Park
properties.description:
The Halse Farm Caravan & Tent Park is located in the picturesque Winsford, in the heart of the British Exmoor National Park. This small-scale park, run by a family, is on a hilltop, surrounded by the Exmoor countryside. This setting ensures panoramic views over the moors.

Camping pitches with character

You make your way to this campsite via narrow, characteristic winding roads. Once you have arrived, you see an open site with spacious non-demarcated pitches. The pitches with an electrical connection are clearly numbered. Wherever you pitch you tent, park your motorhome or caravan, the views of the surrounding hills are stunning.

Simplicity and authenticity

Although Halse Farm doesn't go all out with excessive amenities, the quality and neatness of the toilet and washing facilities are very good. These facilities are in the farm's outbuilding. The simplicity underlines the campsite's focus on an authentic camping experience, aimed at those seeking peace and quiet and walkers.

Walking trips in every wind direction

The campsite is in the middle of Exmoor National Park, a green nature reserve that invites you to go on endless walking adventures through the hills, valleys and rugged countryside. The picturesque village of Winsford (1.5 km) is a stone's throw away. This village offers an insight into the rural culture and several eateries.

For adventurous visitors, the rugged North Devon coastline is nearby, ideal for a day by the sea. Here, visit the charming coastal resort of Minehead (22 km) for example, for a pavement café by the sea. For an historical outing, visit Dunster Castle (18 km), a medieval castle with a windmill.

properties.name: Camping Le Saint-Pal et son Parc Longue-Lègue
Camping Duca Amedeo
properties.description:
Camping Duca Amedeo is right next to the beach of the town of Martinsicuro, separated by a low-traffic boulevard. This small-scale campsite offers peace and quiet and a personal atmosphere – ideal for families and dog lovers, since your faithful four-footed friend is also welcome. The hinterland of the Abruzzo region invites you to explore, using the campsite as an excellent home base for both relaxation and adventure. Enjoy the combination of a beautiful coastline and cultural excursions in the region.

Shaded pitches and lovely accommodations

The campsite has compact, demarcated pitches with lots of shade. The pitches are in rows along an attractive lane, suitable for tents, caravans and motorhomes. Although the pitches are not especially spacious, the layout ensures a friendly atmosphere with privacy. Extra attention is paid to pets, such as a special field for dogs, dog-sitting services and a dog shower. A welcome package is given to dogs and their owners upon arrival.

If you do not have your own camping equipment, you can stay in the flower garden with its charming cottages or in a comfortable apartment. The accommodations are equipped with a kitchen, toilet and washing facilities and air conditioning.

Entertainment for young and old

Camping Duca Amedeo focuses on families and holidaymakers with pets. The toilet facilities have been renovated recently. The campsite has a small swimming pool that overlooks the boulevard – ideal for children. Although the campsite has no restaurant, the boulevard is home to various beach bars and restaurants where you can enjoy drinks and dinner with a view of the sea. The mini club provides entertainment for the children and there is an entertainment team for adults with sporting activities, parties and theme nights.

properties.name: Ilsenhof am Turnersee - Terrassencamping
properties.description:
Ilsenhof am Turnersee - Terrassencamping is situated directly on the shores of Lake Turnersee, one of Carinthia's warmest lakes. Here you will be camping on a well-maintained terraced campsite with views of the water and mountains. The campsite has its own restaurant and modern sanitary facilities. The village of St. Kanzian (4 km) is nearby as well as a variety of walking routes along lakes and through the mountains.

Camping pitches with a view of the lake

The panoramic campsite has been open since 1990 and is especially popular for its spacious pitches and easy access. Even with a large motorhome or caravan, you can drive straight onto your pitch. The campsite has terraced layout, meaning almost every pitch has a view of the lake. The pitches are about 80 m², and because cars remain off-site, it feels spacious and peaceful. Here you can camp with a stunning view of the South Carinthian landscape and the Karawanken mountains in the background.

Relaxing by the water

The campsite itself is a lovely place to be. The restaurant offers a varied menu and takeaway is also available. From the outdoor area, you can overlook the lake. Fancy a dip? Just head out to the sunbathing area by the water, where you can sunbathe and swim. The sanitary facilities are modern, well-maintained and located across two terrace layers.

Entertainment beyond the campsite

In the Klopeiner See Südkärnten region, you will find plenty of lakes and mountains for fun day trips. The Activ Card gives you discounts at a number of attractions. Fancy a bit of excitement? A golf course and horse riding facilities are just 500 metres away.

properties.name: Camping Am Wiesengrund
properties.description:
Camping Am Wiesengrund is located under the smoke of the village of Malliss, right on the water of the Ziegelei Canal and in the midst of nature. You'll camp here on little fields, on a spacious campsite surrounded by greenery and various types of trees. An oasis of peace where you'll primarily see families with small children or even seniors setting their camp chairs on the edge of the water to leisurely gaze at the passing boats.

Barrier closed? No problem!

Holidaymakers who arrive late will find two spaces at the entrance to the campground where they can park between ten o'clock in the evening and eight o'clock in the morning. Officially, these two campsites are for single overnights. There are also three very spacious sites for campers on the campground.

Top conviviality

It's more than convivial on the campground. We've thought of everything: you have a restaurant with a small menu based on regional products. Next door there is a café, a little campground shop with regional products and an herb garden. Further back you walk past the immaculate bathroom building and arrive at the beach volleyball court. Here you'll find the communal grilling area and a lovely playground for the children.

Sail or look at the boats

Because you're in the midst of an area with many canals, there are many pleasure boats. You can hire a canoe (at the campground) and explore these waterways. See if you can spot the kingfishers. Paddle surfing (also called Stand Up Paddling) is perfect on these calm waters. Looking for something special? Hire a Trabant. You'll have a great drive with the Trabi2Go.

properties.name: Camping Les Grottes de Roffy
properties.description:
The Les Grottes de Roffy campsite is situated in the hills of the Dordogne. There is always something to do at this colourful campsite. In the heart of the campsite, you will find a large swimming pool. Your spacious, green camping pitch is the perfect resting place. While your kids are playing, you can enjoy the view. There is a lovely restaurant with a terrace. If you would like to explore the Dordogne, the medieval Sarlat-la-Caneda is a good starting point.

Wooded campsite with spacious pitches

All pitches on the wooded campsite are situated between bushes and trees. Wherever you look, there is greenery all around you. You have a large pitch with plenty of space for your caravan, camper, or tent. There is also plenty of room to create a nice seating area next to your camping equipment.

Nice warm pool

Between the terrace and the playground lies the swimming pool: the main attraction of the campsite. Especially for the younger guests. A dip in the pool is also possible when it’s a bit colder. The water is kept at a comfortable temperature. Are your kids looking for some excitement? They will love the big water slides. Thy are sure to have hours of fun! A nice extra: the view of the hills is quite breath-taking.

Unforgettable holidays

In high season, your children can play with their holiday friends. Don’t be surprised if they come back tired from a sports tournament. Or if they bring a nice craft to your caravan. Evening activities. There is also plenty to do in the evening. You can see a musical, dance night, or performance.

properties.name: Regenbogen Ferienanlage Husum
properties.description:
This campsite is very suitable for an overnight stop on the way to Denmark, Sweden or Norway. At some two km from Husum, an attractive harbour town on the west coast of Schleswig-Holstein, lies the Husumer Campingplatz, directly behind the sea dike. From the camping pitches you have a view of the dike, where the many ambling sheep seem to enhance the tranquillity of the campsite.

Camping behind the dike

The flat countryside behind the sea dike consists primarily of grasslands, as does the campsite itself. You camp here on an open field, as there is little vegetation. You can reach the dike via a gate at the edge of the campsite. Behind the dike is the North Sea, but at low tide the area falls completely dry and you cannot even see the water. 

Wadden

This part of Schleswig-Holstein, on the Wadden Sea, is called Nordfriesland. The Nordfrisian Wadden Islands, which are located off the coast here, do not all have a sea wall. The smaller islands, the so-called 'Halligen', only have man-made mounds; at very high tide they are submerged and the sea has free reign. 

The larger islands are certainly worth visiting. From the mainland you reach the Nordstrand island via a dam, from where you can cross to the island of Pellworm by ferry. Great for cycling. Don't have your own bicycle? You can hire one from the campsite!

Four-legged friends are welcome

If you want to bring your dog along on holiday, this campsite is the right place for you. Dogs are very welcome here. What's more, there is also a special dog beach. A breath of fresh sea air with your faithful four-legged companion.

properties.name: Domaine Le Poteau
properties.description:
Domaine Le Poteau is a small-scale campsite in a remote part of the Gers countryside, in the heart of Gascony. It is a charming camping destination for those seeking peace and quiet.

Welcome!

The campsite is located a little outside the village of Castelnau-d'Auzan. You will be camping in a perfectly tended orchard, far away from big cities and tourist attractions. So you can count on finding the peace you're looking for here. The small scale also contributes to this. In 2019, the sanitary facilities at the campsite were renovated. So you can use modern and very well-maintained sanitary facilities.

Authentic villages

In the immediate vicinity of Domaine Le Poteau are the most beautiful French villages. 17 kilometres away, for example, is Fourcès. In this fortified town, the houses are built in a circle inside the city walls. Montréal-du-Gers (12 kilometres away) and Larressingle (23 kilometres away) are also worth a visit.

properties.name: Camping Domaine La Garenne
properties.description:
The well maintained terrain of terraced campsite Domaine La Garenne lies against a pine tree-covered hill. As a result you have a lovely view from many pitches. You camp here in Saint-Avit, a village in the heart of the Rhône-Alpes. Especially families with children of primary school age enjoy themselves thoroughly on this campsite.

Very spacious pitches

In front of you lies a sizeable and well maintained terrain. In the lower located section the pitches are partly demarcated. There are a total of fifty very spacious touring pitches (150-300 m2). The sizes vary more or less depending on the season. The spaciousness is great for privacy, but also for larger families that like to stand close to each other.

A round over the campsite and take your pick!

Upon arrival you can do a tour of the camping grounds with a map. The map shows the vacant pitches with a cross, so you can take a closer look. Don't have camping equipment? You can book one of the forty accommodation units (mobile homes and cottages). These are all on an elevated section of the campsite.

Great swimming

The swimming pool complex is adjacent to the cafe terrace. It has three heated pools. Dive in on of the two larger pools or splash around in the toddler pool. The pools are surrounded by a wide, tiled terrace. Ideal for sunbathing (bring your own sun umbrella). The campsite offers an entertainment programme, which is predominantly in French.

Local bites to eat

Great feature on this campsite: local shop owners come and offer their produce here, such as bread, pizzas, grilled chicken, goat's cheese, mustard, jam and olives. Enjoy!

properties.name: La Vallée des Vignes
properties.description:
In the Loire Valley, on the wooded banks of the river Layon, you will find camping La Vallée des Vignes. At this rural family campsite you'll camp in the green. On this quiet 4-star campsite you'll find a heated swimming pool and a pleasant terrace.

Rural family campsite

On this rural family campsite the pitches are situated on sheltered lawns, surrounded by hedges and deciduous trees. The campsite is green, spacious and clearly laid out. The rental accommodations are situated together, just like the permanent pitches. The campsite consists mainly of touring pitches, which are grouped around the sanitary building. The pitches vary in size, ranging from spacious to very spacious. Because of the many hedges and shrubs, you are wonderfully sheltered and have a lot of privacy around your tent or caravan.

Swimming, jumping and sports

La Vallée des Vignes is, especially in high season, a great place for families. There are many facilities for children, such as a swimming pool with paddling pool, playground and sports facilities. There is also an entertainment programme.

A picnic on the river bank

On the edge of the campsite there is a large heated outdoor swimming pool surrounded by a spacious sun deck with sun loungers and parasols. There is a separate paddling pool for the little ones, which is also heated. It is beautifully situated in the full sun and adjacent to the restaurant's cosy sidewalk café. A path takes you to the river Layon. At the water's edge there are beautiful spots where you can fish and go for a picnic.

properties.name: Camping Les Sapins de Corrèze
properties.description:
Camping Les Sapins de Corrèze is located in a unique place: at 650 metres altitude in the mountains in the vicinity of the picturesque village of Palisse. This campsite has room for every kind of campsite visitor, from pitches for campsite visitors with a tent to chalets. The pine forest provides shade while you enjoy a walking tour, a yoga session or the peace and quiet that this campsite offers. No large entertainment teams here but, rather, peace and quiet, space and nature.

Van life or a roof tent

The spacious well-kept campsite has all kinds of accommodations and pitches. The accommodations vary from a special Cyclo tent for cyclists to completely furnished chalets. Or you can enjoy the greenery on a pitch amid the pine trees. Pitches for motorhome owners and campsite visitors with a tent to pitches for wanderers can be booked.

Small but good entertainment

This quiet campsite in the French region of Nouvelle-Aquitaine has free wifi throughout the campsite. If you enjoy sports, you can play tennis, jeu de boules or go mountain biking at the campsite. The little ones have their own playground and an area with games, books and craft supplies. The campsite also has a heated swimming pool with a paddling pool, open from mid-May/mid-June.

Picking blueberries

The surrounding area begs to be explored extensively. The Regional Natural Park of the Millevaches in Limousin is nearby (44 km). The campsite is also situated between various lakes, such as the Triouzoune lake (20 km). An hour’s drive away (65 km) is a pick-your-own farm for blueberries. Those who admire ruins can visit the ruins of Les Tours de Merle (63 km).

properties.name: Camping Costa d'Argento
properties.description:
Camping Costa d’Argento is located between the blue of the sea and the green of the Tuscan hills. You immerse yourself in the unspoilt countryside of the Maremma, a beautiful region in the south of Tuscany. Only a fifteen-minute drive away lies the picturesque village of Capalbio, known for its medieval charm, narrow streets and impressive village walls.

Camping or more luxury?

At Camping Village Costa d'Argento you have plenty of choice as to how you want to spend your holiday. You can choose for a level, demarcated pitch for your tent or caravan. If you would prefer something more luxurious, there are also comfortable mobile homes, bungalows or glamping tents available.

Beach just a stone’s throw away

One of this the big advantages of this campsite is the proximity of the beach. Every half hour a shuttle service leaves for a nearby beach, taking only five minutes. Taking the shuttle means no worries about parking and carefree enjoyment of the sun, sea and beach.

Entertainment for young and old

There is also plenty to do at the campsite itself. Children can amuse themselves in the playground, the children's swimming pool or at the children’s club where activities are organised daily. While the children play, the adults can relax at the large swimming pool, surrounded by tall pine trees. Or enjoy yourself at the athletic fields, like the volleyball fields and tennis courts.

Enjoy Tuscan cuisine

At Camping Village Costa d’Argento you can enjoy the Tuscan cuisine to the fullest. In the restaurant you can try different dishes each day and taste a delicious wood-fired pizza.

properties.name: Camping De Vossenburcht
properties.description:
De Vossenburcht campsite is located just north of 'De Zwarte Dennen', a recreation area that is part of a larger nature reserve in IJhorst. You will find this campsite on the border between Overijssel and Drenthe. The road leading to family campsite De Vossenburcht runs through beautiful and expansive fields, with plenty of nature and picturesque farms in a wooded area. The surroundings are therefore highly suitable for beautiful cycling and hiking trips. When you arrive back at the campsite, you can have a bite to eat at the campsite restaurant (with bar).

Camping in comfort

Here, you will find yourself on a clean and well-maintained campsite with neat grassy pitches. The pitches are landscaped with plenty of greenery. De Vossenburcht is a true family campsite and caters to families with children, although seniors regularly come and stay at the campsite as well.

The comfort pitches are spacious camping pitches with electricity, water and drainage. These pitches measure approximately 100m2 in size. There is little traffic on the fields with the comfort pitches. The comfort pitches are located near the sanitary building. The campsite also offers an extensive range of rental accommodations, such as holiday homes, tent homes, cabins, cottages, luxury mobile homes and even a real treehouse.

Heated swimming

Camping de Vossenburcht features a heated outdoor swimming pool with a special paddling area for the little ones. Recreation area 'De Zwarte Dennen', which is maintained by Staatsbosbeheer (the Dutch forestry commission) also has recreational lake, where children can play in safety.

Children's campsite

Camping De Vossenburcht is one of the most fun children's campsites in the Netherlands. In the peak season, the entertainment team from TOP Recreatie provides a fun entertainment programme for the children. Every morning, they can join in with the arts & crafts at the new entertainment building, De Burcht. The afternoons are devoted to sports and games and there are shows in the evenings. Being bored is really not an option here...

properties.name: Camping Am See
properties.description:
Camping am See is situated in a beautiful region. The campsite, located on the south side of the Walensee, is nestled against the Swiss village of Murg (Sankt Gallen). The campsite goes down to the crystal clear lake, which is excellent for swimming. Your pitch is surrounded by high mountains, offering you an unequalled view. The key words that apply here are: tranquillity, nature and sports activities. In winter Camping am See is an excellent base for the ski enthusiasts. For instance, the Flumserberg is a lovely ski area (65 km of pistes), which you can reach in a 15-minute drive.

Camping on a green campsite

The pitches are separated from each other. There are permanent pitches and touring pitches. The grass surface is well maintained. Everything looks green, although there are only a few trees that offer ample shade. Fortunately, the young vegetation is trying its utmost!

The 'W' of Walking and Water

The crystal clear Walensee is excellent for swimming. There are large boulders along the banks from which you have to clamber down. Water sports lovers are allowed to do kite(surfing) and canoeing on the lake. Apart from a small play area with slide, there is not much to do on the campsite for small children.

Nice food and fresh bread

There is a snack bar and a restaurant on the campsite. The restaurant is convivial and has a small, but fine menu. There is no real campsite shop on the grounds, although there is a kiosk with the most essential products, such as fresh bread. You can do your daily shopping in Murg. Alternatively, you can drive to the village of Mollis (south-westerly) or to Walenstadt (easterly) for more shops.

properties.name: Camping In het Fruit
properties.description:
At Camping In het Fruit, a mini campsite near Purmerend, you camp between the fruit trees. This piece of nature contrasts sharply with large cities such as Amsterdam, Alkmaar and Hoorn, which are not far from the campsite. This simple campsite has few facilities and is especially suitable for campers who want to find peace and quiet. For children there is less to do.

Camping in the orchard

Your pitch is situated between the fruit trees of the orchard. The more than thirty pitches receive shade from the trees and the abundant greenery gives the campsite a natural character. This really gives you the feeling of camping in the open nature. You are not far away from the big cities of the Randstad.
