Although the tranquillity prevails on this mini campsite, the noise barriers along the motorway do not manage to keep out all the traffic noise. In addition to camping in the orchard, you can also choose to spend the night in one of the two appartments in the former farmhouse.

Simple camping

Camping In het Fruit is a simple campsite. You won't find many facilities there. The sanitary facilities are fairly basic and there is no shop. If you are staying in an appartment, you will have private sanitary facilities, your own fridge, television and microwave. Purmerend is the best place to go for your groceries. There are several supermarkets within a radius of three kilometres from the campsite. A short bike ride will take you to the shop in no time.

properties.name: Camping Sütel
properties.description:
Sütel Campsite is located right on a beautiful sandy beach on the German Baltic Sea, in a quiet spot in the east of Schleswig-Holstein. With a beautiful outdoor playground, extensive sports and play facilities and its varied entertainment programme, among other amenities, this is a popular campsite for families with children, especially in high season.

The campsite is located near the village of Sütel in the Kreis Oost-Holstein. This is a coastal area ideal for those who love the beach life and watersports. This area also has a lot to offer for cycling and hiking enthusiasts. Inland you can explore a hilly landscape with a nice variety of forests, meadows and lakes.

Neat grounds with three tourist camping fields

The neat grounds is comprised of three sections with spacious tourist camping pitches. Those wishing to rent accommodations can choose from various mobile homes, bungalows and charming beach houses. The sanitary facilities are modern and in good condition.

A varied entertainment programme during high season

The campsite organises fun activities in the summer months. There is a lot to do, especially for children. For example, they can do crafts or go on a treasure hunt. There are also dress-up parties and sporting tournaments. In addition, the youngest campers will have a great time on the beautiful playground.

Plenty of beach and watersports activities

Sütel Campsite is beautifully situated on the Baltic Sea. You can walk straight onto the beach from the campsite. In addition to sunbathing on the beach and taking a refreshing dip in the water, you can also play beach volleyball and go diving, surfing, sailing and jet skiing.

properties.name: Camping L' Evasion
properties.description:
Enjoy sun, sea and sand at Camping L’Evasion in the French Vendée. You stay at only five kilometres from the Atlantic Ocean and not far from the coastal resorts of Les Sables d’Olonne and Saint-Gilles-Croix-de-Vie. It is about a 60-minute drive to the historic theme park Puy du Fou. You can have plenty of fun swimming at L’Evasion. There is a water park with a lagoon, where you almost feel like you are in the Caribbean when lying on the white beach. The enthusiastic entertainment team provides the necessary entertainment and there are fun evening shows.

Camping pitches with private toilet and washing facilities, mobile homes and luxury lodges

If you like camping in luxury, you are at the right address at L’Evasion. All 12 camping pitches have private toilet and washing facilities and a private kitchenette. Most of the accommodation consists of mobile homes. You can choose from several types of mobile homes and they are accessible to the disabled. Finally, there are adventurous lodges on poles, from where you look out over the lagoon.

Tropical vibes in the lagoon

The lagoon is a real eyecatcher at Camping L’Evasion. It is a wonderfully landscaped beach, complete with palm trees, white sand, loungers and wicker parasols. But that's not all! The outdoor swimming pool is a bit further along and where you can go for a refreshing swim. This pool has two fun slides. And there is also the indoor swimming pool, where you can go in less favourable weather. There is also a paddling pool here for the littlest campers.

properties.name: Camping De Koppenjan
properties.description:
Just south of the Frisian village of Jubbega, in the Frisian Forest region, is campsite De Koppenjan. On the spacious camping field of this mini campsite there is room for twenty-five spacious touring pitches, where you can camp in peace and quiet. Attention children: next to the campsite is a pancake restaurant, where you can choose from up to eighty different pancakes. Also located near the campsite: a petting zoo. Hikers can enjoy the many hiking trails in the Frisian Forests.

Spatiality and tranquillity

A large lawn forms the spacious camping area. Tall trees screen off the field, allowing you to shut yourself off from the outside world for a while in a quiet spot in the Dutch countryside. The twenty-five touring pitches on the lawn are spacious and undefined. This preserves the open character of the terrain. This camping field is a wonderful place for those looking for peace and quiet.

Creative children's campsite and petting zoo

For children, such a mini campsite may seem a bit boring, but nothing could be further from the truth. Candle making, pottery, threading your own soap chains: at camping De Koppenjan the most creative side of your child will emerge. Next to the campsite there is a children's play farm with a large playground. Here the donkeys and rabbits are ready for a cuddle.

Pancake farm De Koppenjan

Next to the mini campsite is Pancake Farm De Koppenjan. This restaurant will be particularly popular with younger campers. Not only can you pick up your pancakes here, there is also plenty of space in the restaurant for extensive dining. With up to eighty different pancakes and an extensive ice-cream menu, there is something for everyone. Bon appetit!

properties.name: Camping Le Céou
properties.description:
Not even twenty kilometres to the south of the medieval town of Sarlat you'll find the Le Céou campsite. The campsite is located in a quiet and green environment. Plants and flowers ensure a cosy atmosphere. This part of the Dordogne is known for the hills and caves, the clear rivers, the old towns and castles. The famous Château Castelnaud is only three kilometres from the campsite.

Under the trees

The green campsites are located not far from the swimming pool. The low bushes form a natural division between the spacious and tidy camping pitches. The small river of Céou, with crystal clear water and waterfalls is only a stone's throw from the campsite. You can easily walk this stretch from the field for those who hike in. The sanitation building is well-maintained and is close to the pitches.

Heated swimming pool

The lovely swimming pool is a favourite part of the campsite for all ages. Wonderful for a fresh dip after a day of walking or cycling. But the water isn't cold, as it is heated. There are comfortable loungers for the real sun worshippers at the swimming pool. The long and curvy slide that kids can't get enough of is a separate part next the larger pool.

Terrace in French atmosphere

In the summer months, you can enjoy the authentic restaurant La Taverne every day. You can choose one of the delicious local dishes, a pizza or a tasty surprise during the theme evenings. During the day, you can sit on the terrace under a parasol for an ice cream or drink. If you want to have a pizza at your tent, you can pick one up on the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Le Pradal
properties.description:
Camping Le Pradal is located near the village of Anduze, along the Gardon river. The campsite is situated on the outskirts of the famous bamboo forest "Bambouseraie", in a wonderfully quiet area in the middle of unspoilt nature.

There are countless possibilities for trips in the area. Travel with the steam train of the Cevennes between Anduze and Saint-Jean-du-Gard, visit the caves of Trabuc, see the Pont du Gard and the Arena of Nîmes, go climbing in Forest Parc, or hike into the regional natural park of the Camargue.

Instant holiday mode

As soon as you drive onto the campsite, you're instantly in the holiday mood. You drive past the swimming pool and at the end of the drive stands a beautiful French residence. Camping Le Pradal is a small-scale campsite where all the pitches are, on average, between 80 m2 and 100 m2. Very spacious, in other words. The pitches are flat and shaded by poplar trees.

Sweet Coco

Campsite Le Pradal has several rental accommodations, the most striking of which is Sweet Coco. This is a combination of a tent and a mobile home. There are also various bungalow tents and mobile homes where you can spend the night in comfort.

Private beach on the Gardon

Campsite Le Pradal features an outdoor swimming pool. The pool is divided into two parts: a shallow part and a deep area. Loungers and sunshades are available next to the pool. From the campsite, you can walk directly to the private pebble beach on the banks of the Gardon river.

Music and bingo nights

Every Wednesday night is music night, from karaoke to nostalgic song evenings. You can listen to the music during dinner, or join in later on with the other campers. Monday night is bingo night, where you can win fun prizes.

properties.name: Camping Aux Lodges du Mas de Nadal
properties.description:
Do you like camping in the great outdoors, in a quiet spot with plenty of privacy? Then Camping Aux Lodges du Mas de Nadal, near the village of Sauliac-sur-Céle (Lot), is an ideal holiday destination. This is an authentic nature campsite where the pitches are far apart, guaranteeing peace and privacy. You camp here in the centre of the Causses du Quercy regional nature park, close to the beautiful Célé valley and far away from motorways, big cities and mass tourism.

Nature site for tent campers and glamping enthusiasts

To reach this campsite, you drive north from Sauliac for about four kilometres on a narrow, often steep road. Once you arrive, it will certainly have been worth it. You are immediately surprised by the vastness of this wooded campsite. Camping Aux Lodges du Mas de Nadal is also ideal for glamping enthusiasts. The luxury safari lodges that can be rented are not inferior to a hotel stay in terms of comfort.

Fabulous infinity pool and excellent restaurant

There is a lovely swimming pool at the front of the campsite. The water of this infinity pool is heated to a pleasant temperature, so you can enjoy a swim in the morning or in the low season. Feel like a hearty meal after an afternoon of swimming or a nice nature walk? The campsite has its own supermarket and restaurant. You can enjoy delicious meals in the restaurant.

Walking in the countryside

Be sure to bring your hiking boots, because there are lovely walks in the unspoilt forests around the campsite. Stroll along the River Célé, where there are hidden sandy beaches, perfect for a dip in the river water!

properties.name: Camping La Comtesse
properties.description:
La Comtesse is a small-scale campsite located in Bélus, in the heart of the Landes, nestled in a forest of poplars on the edge of a fishing pond. This sustainable campsite offers everything you'd expect on a camping holiday in France. After a personal welcome by the campsite owners, you'll enjoy a green environment with rivers, the sprawling beaches of the Landes coast and the typical French villages in the area. Furthermore, the location of the campsite is ideal for discovering the Spanish region of the Basque Country.

Small and cosy

This small-scale campsite offers a family atmosphere. The green grounds situated amongst the trees feature 47 spacious, demarcated camping pitches where you'll have plenty of privacy. You can choose a sunny or shady pitch. If you don't have your own camping equipment, you can also stay in one of the 40 air-conditioned rental accommodations.

Eco-camping

Choosing a holiday at Camping La Comtesse offers you the chance to get closer to nature. The campsite is committed to sustainable tourism in various ways. For example, local products are served in the snack bar, cleaning is done with environmentally friendly products and children can participate in fun environmentally conscious activities at the 'kids' nature club'.

Endless fun in the water

The campsite swimming pool features a nice fast slide. There's also a separate paddling pool for the smallest campers. The loungers along the edge of the pool offer you a perfect view of all the action, or you can dream away while enjoying the sun.

properties.name: Camping Brione
properties.description:
This beautiful four-star campsite is located on the edge of the stunning town of Riva del Garda and within walking distance of numerous beaches on the popular Lake Garda. It is situated on the north side of Lake Garda, in the middle of a centuries-old olive grove. The area offers numerous tourist activities, such as hiking, mountain biking, windsurfing and visiting the many beautiful places around the lake. Brione Campsite itself has a large outdoor swimming pool, a cosy bar and neat sanitary facilities.

Want to enjoy a real camping experience? Here you can!

At Brione Campsite you'll experience real camping. Tourist camping pitches are clearly the major offering here. Most pitches can be found on the flat central part of the property. There are also a number of beautiful pitches on the hill along the edge of the campsite. These pitches have a lot more shade thanks to the old olive trees. They are especially intended for tent campers who want to experience a wonderful holiday in the middle of nature. Additionally, fifteen mobile homes are available to rent on this campsite.

Cool off in the campsite swimming pool and in Lake Garda

You'll find the campsite's beautiful outdoor swimming pool at the centre of the property. It is a rectangular pool more than large enough to swim laps. Of course, you can also refresh yourself in the pleasant bathing waters of Lake Garda. The beaches begin at the charming harbour, half a kilometre from the campsite, and extend nearly to the centre of Riva del Garda.

properties.name: Camping Huttopia Lac d'Aiguebelette
properties.description:
Near Lake Aiguebelette, in the beautiful nature of the Rhône-Alpes, Huttopia Lac d'Aiguebelette campsite is located. The leafy campsite is sloping, with spacious pitches and paved paths. The pitches are laid out on grass and are separated by hedges and trees. This gives you a lot of privacy on your pitch.

Plage du Sougey

From the entrance to the campsite it is about three hundred metres walk to Plage du Sougey, a sandy beach with a beautiful sunbathing area on the shores of Lake Aiguebelette. You can relax in the shade of the trees, and the beautiful blue water is ideal for swimming. Access to the beach is free of charge for campsite guests; a pass is issued for each family.

No dog beach

In order to preserve the natural character of the lake, there are few water sports facilities on the lake of Aiguebelette. You can take a canoe, rowing boat or pedal boat on the lake. If your dog is going on holiday with you, keep in mind that he is only allowed on the beach in the evening. During the day you have to find another place to walk with your four-legged friend. Fortunately, there is plenty of opportunity for this in the wooded surroundings of the campsite.

Terraces with a view

At the campsite you can get fresh rolls every day. There is also a limited range of groceries available in the campsite shop. For your other purchases and groceries you can go to the shop three kilometres away. Pizza and snacks are available at the campsite in July and August. The bar is also open in July and August.

properties.name: Camping Le Coteau de l'Herm
properties.description:
Camping Naturist Le Coteau de l'Herm is hidden in the heart of the Dordogne. You will find this naturist campsite in a beautiful location in the hilly countryside of the Périgord Noir. Enjoy peace, space and privacy. Whether you are using your own camping equipment or prefer to rent accommodation, this campsite has plenty of choice for you.

Naturist hiking area

The small naturist campsite is about 8-hectare. The owners have created a lovely, green holiday spot with plenty of privacy. Here it is all about relaxing and enjoying nature, away from the hustle and bustle of everyday life. You can choose from spacious 100 m2 pitches on the meadow, in the forest, the centre area or on 'the promenade'. There are also a few other accommodation options, like a petithome, caravans and chalets, or a characteristic chambre. The rest of the campsite is a naturist hiking area, with stunning panoramic views over the Dordogne.

Relax in the sauna or by the pool

A special facility at Camping Naturist Le Coteau de l'Herm is the Zodiac swimming pool. This above-ground pool is great for cooling off and has a nice inflatable lounger for sunbathing. In high season, the paddling pool is also open. You will find even more relaxation in the Finnish Kota sauna, on the boules court or on a lovely hike. The owners regularly organise fun activities such as joint pizza dinners or wine tastings.

properties.name: Rohloff Ferienpark Buschhof
properties.description:
In the middle of Germany, you will find vast rolling landscapes, peace and quiet and a friendly atmosphere. This is where the Camping & Ferienpark Buschhof campsite is located, a wonderful place for nature lovers and those looking for peace and quiet. With a nice nature pool, fine restaurant, animal pasture and beautiful hiking and biking trails, this is a relaxing place to spend your holiday.

Camping in an oasis of peace

You will arrive at a beautifully manicured site where you will check in at the reception. It is located in an old farmhouse. There you will be welcomed by the helpful manager. The campsite is not too big and consists of neat camping fields with spacious, defined plots. You will be staying here in the middle of nature and among the fields, making the campsite an oasis of peace. In addition to sites for touring campers, there are also a number of permanent sites here. There are also some mobile homes for rent and a few new "camping barrels". The sanitary facilities are clean.

Swimming pool and petting zoo

Of course, that doesn't mean there's nothing to do here. Thanks to the fun natural swimming pool, there is plenty of opportunity for water fun in the summer. The little ones can also romp around in the playground and meet on the sports field or at the table tennis table. For little (and bigger) animal lovers, there is a nice petting zoo with ponies, goats and donkeys, among other things.

After a nice walk or an afternoon of swimming, did you get a craving for a tasty schnitzel? Then you'll be able to fulfil your desire at the camping ground restaurant, which is open from sometime around the beginning of May until the end of September. The restaurant has a fairly limited menu, but the portions are large.

properties.name: Camping 2000
properties.description:
Camping 2000 is hidden among the hills of Czech North Bohemia. It's a place where you’ll get into holiday mode straight away. There’s peace, greenery and plenty of space for families to enjoy time together. The campsite has large pitches, modern facilities and plenty to do for young and old. The iconic Ještěd Tower is a stone's throw away and has views that you won't soon forget.

Space for camping

There is plenty of choice at Camping 2000. The camping pitches are playfully spread across the site and are very private thanks to the green planting. Have a tent, caravan or motor home? All are welcome. If you prefer more comfort, choose a bungalow or a cosy hiker's hut. Handy for families or campers who like to travel light.

Water fun in the swimming pool

The facilities make your stay even more relaxing. The swimming pool has a slide and children head to it straight away. It’s right next to the restaurant, so you can enjoy an ice cream, snack or hot meal after your swim. In high season, the entertainment organised creates a lively atmosphere on the campsite. Ideal, as it gives you some time to yourself.

Nature, city and the iconic Ještěd Tower

The campsite is in a protected nature reserve where you can enjoy walking and cycling. Woodland, hills and panoramic views to enjoy. Fancy a day out? Liberec (19 km) is the fifth largest city in Czechia and has beautiful historic buildings, atmospheric squares, interesting museums and plenty of restaurants and shops too.

properties.name: Flower Camping Val de Vie
properties.description:
Young families will enjoy spending a relaxing holiday at this wonderful campsite that's set in the middle of rural surroundings. Flower Camping Val de Vie is a child-friendly gem of a place in the west of France. The heated swimming pool is the big attraction for young campers. The many organised games and the playground are popular too. The campsite enjoys a convenient location on the edge of the village of Maché, where you'll find a little supermarket and a bakery. Follow the routes that lead off from the campsite to discover some lovely cycle rides and walks.

Camping in the Vendée countryside

This undulating part of the Vendée is known for its many hours of sunshine and for La Roche-sur-Yon, the area's largest town that lies around 25 kilometres from the well-maintained campsite. Another enticing attraction is the campsite's proximity to Lake Apremont with its lovely little beach. Elodie & Nicolas – the attentive owners of this orderly site – know a great deal about the diverse local area and speak English too.

Spacious, open pitches

After leaving the small, modern reception, you'll walk onto the open site that's looked after with a great deal of loving care. That's also true of the spacious pitches, which are located on little lawns and separated from each other by low hedges. Want to enjoy a more luxurious camping experience? You'll find various glamping caravans waiting for you in the ZEN zone with their own jacuzzi. Or opt for a pitch with its own kitchen unit and a private toilet. The two sanitary buildings in the middle of the site also look excellent and clean.

properties.name: Camping Waterhout
properties.description:
Camping Waterhout is situated on the southern shore of the Weerwater, a man-made lake located in the central city district of Almere Stad. This campsite is not only situated on a lake but is also surrounded by a forest. You can camp on the beautifully landscaped grounds with your own camping equipment or you can make use of one of the many available rental accommodations. There is plenty of entertainment on the campsite itself and the possibilities for going on trips in the surrounding area are endless.

Camping with plenty of choice

This medium-sized campsite has 160 touring pitches, 40 permanent annual pitches, 15 pitches for motor homes and 11 rental accommodations. There are standard pitches (without electricity and parking space) as well as luxury pitches available. The so-called panorama pitches are pitches with views of the lake. The pitches are spacious and are separated by hedges, offering sufficient privacy. 

A versatile lake and entertainment

Although the campsite does not have a swimming pool, there is plenty of water fun to be had here. The Weerwater is a source of all sorts of fun. What can you do here? You can go swimming, water skiing, surfing, canoeing, fishing, or just get your feet wet. 

At Camping Waterhout, you will find a playground for the little ones as well as a small vegetable garden and a petting zoo. Here, children learn all about vegetables and animals and how to care for them. Guests looking for a little more action can indulge on the large trampoline or football field. An entertainment team is available in the peak season.

Brasserie with terrace

In the brasserie with terrace you can have breakfast, lunch, drinks or dinner.  The sunny terrace outside is ideal for enjoying a drink and soaking up the relaxing atmosphere.

properties.name: Capfun Rakelbos
properties.description:
This pleasant holiday park is located in the south of bustling Brabant. With Tilburg 20 kilometres away and Eindhoven 25 kilometres away, it is a great starting point for fun excursions. Capfun Rakelbos is a genuine family park with a variety of accommodations to choose from. For example, there are even special children's accommodations with a fenced-off terrace and a playroom. Favourite campsite activities among campers include foam parties, lounging by the lake and watching the mascot parade.

Holidays together

At this Dutch family campsite, you have a wide choice of chalets. There are accommodations for four, but also large, semi-detached accommodations for ten. For example, the Tribu Top TV consists of two mobile homes with a shared terrace. Perfect for when you want to go on holiday with family or a family friend but don't want to share a chalet. The park also has special children's accommodations. An added extra: almost every field has a playground. So if you are located near a playground, you can easily keep an eye on your (grand)children.

Swimming pool with new roof

A heated outdoor pool, an outdoor children's pool and several slides: there is plenty of swimming fun to be had here. The outdoor pool has a roof that can be closed at night or in bad weather. As a result, you always have the opportunity to enjoy a nice swim. For children, there is a nice paddling pool with all kinds of play equipment. Older children have a great time with the pool's many slides, including a real Spacebowl.

properties.name: Camping Domaine de Kerelly
properties.description:
Camping Domaine de Kerelly is within walking distance of the centre of Josselin, centrally located in Morbihan (Brittany). This campsite is located halfway between the Breton cities of Rennes and Lorient, just 800 metres from the N24 motorway exit and right on the D724. So, an ideal stopover for campers passing through. A longer stay is worthwhile too because it gives you plenty of time to explore the surrounding area. For example, lovely walks in the Brocéliande forest.

From natural camping pitches to accommodation

This well-maintained family campsite consists of a flat section and some terraces. The terrace pitches are at the edge of the forest, so there’s plenty of shade. Do you like to go back to basics on holiday? Then book one of the lovely tent pitches in the forest. A rental tent on wooden poles is possible too; ideal for walking and cycling tourists! Would you like a bit more comfort? Rent a modern mobile home.

Enjoy a tasty meal

Returning to the campsite after a long walk, bike ride or car journey? Head to Le Garvig, a cafeteria with a large terrace and a cosy indoor area. The menu includes ice creams and crêpes, as well as meat dishes, salads and home-made pizzas. Order your breakfast for the following morning as well. Camping Domaine de Kerelly has a small heated outdoor pool, which is open in summer depending on the weather. There are also table tennis tables, a boules court and a mini library.

properties.name: Camping Le Daguet
properties.description:
Camping Le Daguet is situated on a hill in the woods of the French department of Dordogne. This small-scale campsite is the perfect place to relax completely in the midst of nature. Enjoy a glass of French wine with a baguette and cheese while you view the beautiful surroundings from your camping chair. Go for a dip in the outdoor swimming pool to cool down. You needn’t leave the campsite for a French meal. However, the surrounding area is very much worth exploring.

Camping with a panoramic view

The pitches here are large and demarcated, separated by hedges. Some pitches at this small-scale campsite have beautiful panoramic views of the green, hilly surroundings. The campsite is well-kept, has lots of greenery and more than enough pitches in the shade. If you don’t have your own camping equipment, stay in one of the luxury mobile homes or safari tents.

Swimming and theme nights

Camping Le Daguet gives you a chance to relax completely. But there is plenty to do here as well. The swimming pool is in the sun and provides a beautiful view of the landscape in the valley of the Dordogne. There is a wading pool especially for young campsite guests to have fun in the water. Next to the swimming pool is a playground for the children who are somewhat older. Many fun activities are organised for children during the high season. In the evening the restaurant is open, welcoming everyone for a drink on the terrace and a French dinner. Theme nights are organised regularly during the high season.

properties.name: Heidi's Camping
properties.description:
Have you ever seen the ‘Alpenglühen’? They are mountain peaks that light up orange-red or pink at sunrise and sunset. With a bit of luck, you can admire this beautiful phenomenon from your own pitch at Heidi’s Camping. The views of the mountains from this small campsite are actually phenomenal. If that makes your mountain walking or winter sport heart beat faster, this campsite could be your ideal destination. Heidi’s Camping is in the Voralberg region, in the northwest of Austria, just shy of an hour's drive from Lake Constance.

Friendly and small scale

You arrive at a small-scale campsite in an open landscape, bordering the road. The campsite is situated next to a hotel and huts from the same owner. The site has space for about 30 camping vehicles and there are about 15 permanent pitches. The campsite is fairly basic, but the amenities are decent and the atmosphere is friendly. The toilet and washing facilities are neat and clean and family showers are available.

Panoramic views

This campsite is also popular among sportive families. There is playground equipment for children, and you can play a game of table tennis at the campsite. Furthermore, they are well-equipped for winter sports here and for the sometimes changeable weather conditions that you find in the Alps. There is a recreation room and a drying room. You can also relax your muscles in the infra-red sauna for a fee. But this campsite's main attraction is perhaps the panoramic views of the surrounding mountains.

properties.name: Camping Papillon Kinrooi
properties.description:
In the northeast of Belgium, just over the Dutch border, lies Camping Papillon Kinrooi. Here you camp in the beautiful Limburg landscape, surrounded by wooded countryside and the Maas. This green campsite has much to offer, such as a swimming lake, a bistro and two padel courts for the sports-loving campsite visitors. The beautiful surroundings invite you to go on long walks and bicycle rides.

Gypsy wagon island

At camping Papillon Kinrooi, you camp on the grass or on a paved motorhome pitch. Most of the pitches have a view of the water of the swimming lake. If you don’t have your own camping equipment, choose a luxury mobile home or gypsy wagon. All gypsy wagons are on an island in the centre of the pond.

Take a refreshing dip in the fishing and swimming pond. For a delicious lunch or an extended dinner, go to the bistro.

Sports and entertainment

Camping Papillon Kinrooi is a true family campsite. The youngest campsite guests can live it up in the playground and cuddle with the goats at the petting zoo. In the high season there is entertainment for the children and activities for the entire family are organised in the bistro.

Hoge Kempen National Park and Maastricht

Ther is enough to do in the surrounding area. The Vrijthof square in Maastricht is less than 50 kilometres from the campsite. Go shopping in the outlet centre in Roermond (21.5 km) or enjoy a cold drink on a terrace in Maaseik (5 km). The Hoge Kempen National Park (15 km) is definitely worth a visit. Explore the area on foot or cycle along one of the many cycle routes.

properties.name: Camping Greendale Farm C & C Park
Seläter Camping
properties.description:
Seläter is a quiet campsite for nature lovers and active beach visitors. The campsite is situated in a pristine landscape on the west coast of Sweden, close to Norway. The popular Capri beach attracts a fair amount of tourists to the area, but it is not often really busy. The beach is glorious, with an impressive water chute and a jumping/diving platform. The nearby town of Strömstad is worth a visit.

Secluded camping terrain

When you arrive, you initially only see the reception and a mini golf course. Once you pass the gate, you will see the sloping camping grounds. The staff at the reception will extend you a friendly welcome and will gladly assist you with any questions.

Spacious pitches on a level field

The camping pitches are spacious and are located on level fields with grass. The terrain has a typical Swedish appearance with lots of trees. You can choose a pitch with lots or only a bit of shade. The five lodge tents next to the trekker huts are new. You can also rent bungalows and chalets.

Beach with spectacular slide

The Capri beach is located less than a km from the campsite. On this beautiful beach you can have a great time on the gigantic water slide, the jumping/diving platform and on the beach, of course. You can see Norway to the north. Because of the distance, it might be fun to rent a bicycle to go to the beach. There is an 18-hole golf course across the campsite.

Basic supplies

In the campsite shop you can buy a few necessities, such as fresh bread. There are restaurants some five km down the road in Strömstad. The sanitary facilities on the campsite are neat and tidy.

properties.name: Trendcamping Wolfach
properties.description:
Trendcamping Wolfach is centrally located in the Black Forest, in a wonderful spot in the beautiful Kinzigtal. This campsite is an ideal starting point for fantastic walks and cycling and mountain bike tours in this densely wooded nature reserve. In addition, spectacular sights such as the Feldberg and the Triberger waterfalls are not far from this campsite. This is a south-facing terraced campsite that offers a unique view of the Kinzigtal from every pitch. You will find a lot of natural greenery, modern sanitary facilities and an excellent restaurant on the premises.

Dozens of touring pitches, all of them unique!

Touring pitches are the predominant form of accommodation offered at this well-maintained campsite. What is special about these pitches is that they are all different in terms of their layout and the view they provide. Some spots also receive significantly more sunlight than others. So feel free to indicate your preferences at the reception, and they will take this into account. In addition to camping pitches, Trendcamping Wolfach also offers a number of hikers' cabins and rooms for rent.

Platzhirsch Restaurant: delicious dining guaranteed

If you stay at this campsite and you want to go out for dinner, you do not have to leave the premises. Platzhirsch Restaurant is located on-site and offers a typical Black Forest atmosphere. There are numerous tasty meat dishes on the menu, but also some excellent vegetarian options. Of course, all those goodies taste best with a freshly tapped glass of beer or a quality German wine. You can enjoy all these delicacies in the cosy indoor area or on the spacious terrace.

properties.name: Camp Hammer
properties.description:
Does your ideal holiday include nature, hiking and endless evenings under the starry sky? Then Camp Hammer, a campsite in the German district of Eifel, may well be your next destination. The campsite has an idyllic location in a green valley by the Ruhr river, which is great for playing and paddling. At night the lights go out and you can enjoy an impressive starry sky. The campsite has prioritised sustainability and respect for nature.

Star gazing

The campsite is very clean and consists of two parts. The ‘main campsite’ has spacious demarcated pitches and a field for tents. Dogs are not permitted in this section of the campsite. Over the bridge there is a second field. Your faithful four-footed friend is welcome here. Both sites have their own toilet facilities, which are kept very clean. What is unique here is that, in addition to normal toilets, you can also choose to use several environmentally friendly compost toilets. If you would like a comfortable stay overnight and do some star gazing, choose one of the two star-gazing huts.

Enjoying nature

The people who come to Camp Hammer come to get in touch with nature. This thinly populated region has very little light pollution, which means that you can enjoy the impressive starry sky in the evening. It is also possible to participate in a special stargazing excursion. The pony walks are recommended for children. The children may ride the ponies as well. There is also a small playground, table football, a ping pong table and a recreation room where you can play games. Nature itself is, of course, the biggest playground.

properties.name: Camping au Mica
properties.description:
The child-friendly and small-scale Camping Au Mica is situated in the beautiful nature area Ballons des Vosges in north-eastern France. This is a perfect walking area with unspoiled nature, vast forests, wonderful creeks and beautiful lakes. A shallow brook with boulders runs along the campsite. It has a small beach where children can play to their heart's content.

Spacious pitches

On the well-maintained grounds situated at an elevation of 550 m, there are spacious pitches on grassland with birches providing shade (not everywhere). There is a separate field for tent campers. If you want to hire something, you have a choice of wooden chalets in the style of the Vosges as well as luxuriously appointed tents.

Paddling and building sand castles

Centrally positioned on the campsite is a small, rectangular heated swimming pool with a toddler pool. The pool is surrounded by a fence to keep small children from accidentally falling into the water. Children can paddle and build dams in the creek that runs along the campsite. You can build sand castles on the adjacent sandy beach.

Entertainment for children and herb garden

Children enjoy themselves on a spacious playing field and in the playground with a trampoline, jungle gym and a table tennis table. In high season there is a daily Mini Club where children can be creative with arts and crafts. Wine tasting is organised on a weekly basis. Furthermore, there is a herb garden where guests can help themselves to herbs. A playful forest walk for children has also been set up.

Table d’hôtes

Camping guests can join the weekly sociable table d'hôtes (shared dining) in high season. The snack bar is open each day for snacks which you can enjoy on the terrace. There is also a small shop with daily fresh bread.

properties.name: Camping De Domp
properties.description:
Right on the water, in the centre of Sneek is De Domp: a campsite and marina all in one. This lush urban campsite has its own marina for transient docking, but offers permanent docking space as well. You can look out over the boats in the harbour from your camping pitch. This allows you to enjoy the best of three worlds: you'll be peacefully camping in nature, with the historic centre of Sneek within walking distance, and on the water with an open connection to the Sneekermeer (lake).

Camping by the water

The camping pitches here are on grass, but there are also paved pitches for campervans. The pitches are separated from each other by hedges and shrubs. There are pitches located directly on the water. However, you would be best served to book these in advance, especially during high season. If you bring your own boat, please be advised that you cannot reserve spaces in the transient marina.

In and around Sneek

De Domp campsite is within walking distance of the centre of Sneek. The historic city centre is known for its charming outdoor cafes and stylish shopping streets. Sneek is a great place to begin a cycling adventure, e.g. a ride around the Sneekermeer. Make sure that you stop in Joure along the way. The surrounding area is also a wonderful place to hike, with water practically everywhere around you, of course. If you do not have your own boat, but think that sailing would be fun, you can also ride the ferry in Sneek.

De Kajuit

After a day of sailing, cycling or hiking, pull up a chair at De Kajuit, the fantastic restaurant on the campsite with a terrace along the water. You can enjoy long and lively meal here, all while admiring the boats in the marina.

properties.name: Insel-Camp Fehmarn
properties.description:
Camping Insel-Camp Fehmarn is on the Baltic Sea island of Fehmarn in Germany. Here, you camp in an idyllic setting right by a fine sandy beach. Due to the island's southern location, the sun spoils you the entire day here, making it the perfect destination for a beach holiday full of water sports.

Beach fun within arm's reach

From the campsite, you walk straight to the vast, gently sloping beach. Various sections of the beach are ideal for water sports, such as surfing, sailing, water skiing, snorkelling and diving. Dogs are also welcome on parts of the campsite, and after a lovely day at the beach, they can freshen up in the special dog shower.

Extensive entertainment programme

With the extensive amenities and varied activities, Insel-Camp Fehman ensures everyone feels completely at home. From the playground to the child-friendly beach to the fun entertainment programme in the bustling high season, there is always something for every age group to do.

Relaxation and culinary indulgence

Treat yourself to a relaxing sauna session, an invigorating massage or a training session in the gym. Enjoy culinary highlights in the restaurant and the bistro for lunch, dinner or a drink.

Out and about in the surrounding area

There is plenty for active campers to explore in the immediate vicinity. Put on your walking shoes and take a long walk to Burg auf Fehmarn. It is lovely wandering through this picturesque old town with houses in Danish style, lovely cafés and shops. For those who like a bit of history and lovely landscapes, a walk to Staberhuk cliff is a nice challenge.

properties.name: Lido Camping Paradise
properties.description:
Lido Paradise is a beach campsite on the east coast of Sicily. Here you can enjoy a holiday on the beach and by the Mediterranean Sea. With 350 touring pitches, the campsite is mainly used by holidaymakers with camper vans, caravans or tents. The most beautiful spots offer a view of the sea, the least of them are on a railway line. For a beach holiday, this campsite is ideal: the Mediterranean sea and an elongated beach are just a few steps away.

Camping on the beach

The Lido Paradise campsite has 350 touring pitches. The site is situated on the flat coastline, between the Sicilian mountains and the beach. The most beautiful pitches are closest to the beach: they offer a beautiful view of the Mediterranean Sea. If you camp in front of the campsite, you will be faced with a problem that many of the Sicilian coastal campsites experience. There is a railway which runs right next to the campsite. The campsite looks neat and tidy everywhere. Trees and shade cloths provide shade on the pitches.

For the sporty camper

Not only for the beach-goer, but also for the sporty camper, the campsite is well equipped. The small gym allows you to keep in shape during your camping holiday, while the modern football and tennis court invites you to play a game. You can also play beach volleyball on the beach.

Restaurant by the sea

Large glass doors give you the opportunity to look out over the sea from the restaurant, while enjoying a traditional Sicilian dish or a pizza from the stone oven. In summer, the doors open and a warm sea breeze blows through the restaurant.

properties.name: Camping Le Hounta
properties.description:
Camping Le Hounta is a friendly family campsite located at the foot of the Pyrenees, in the heart of the Midi-Pyrénées. Peace, space and nature come together here. The large, flat pitches are sheltered by trees. Head off from here for beautiful walks or challenging bike rides through the mountains.

Large pitches and comfortable camping

You’ll feel at home straight away at Le Hounta campsite. Most of the large, well-maintained pitches are in the shade. So, you’ll be cool even on hot summer days. Whether you have a tent, caravan or motor home, the friendly atmosphere and personal contact will make your stay even more pleasant.

Food truck, yoga and playground

Simple and quiet camping is key at Le Hounta. So, don't expect a swimming pool or entertainment programme. In high season, a food truck comes to the campsite several times a week to sell tasty food. And you can order a delicious breakfast via the bread-roll service. Want to relax? Then do a yoga class, while the youngsters have fun in the playground.

Discover the Pyrenees at their best

The adventure starts from Camping Le Hounta. Cyclists test their legs on the famous Col du Tourmalet, while walkers enjoy panoramas in the Cirque de Gavarnie and the Cirque de Troumouse. Real daredevils can go paragliding, canyoning or rafting. The nature is rugged, green and breathtakingly beautiful. And anyone who wants to take in some culture can drive to Lourdes (30 km) for a day full of history and impressive stories.

properties.name: Camping Alkenhaer
properties.description:
Camping Alkenhaer lies on the border of Friesland and Drenthe in the vicinity of Appelscha. You can camp here in peace and quiet in a beautiful natural area. Not far from the campsite are the National Parks Drents-Friese Wold and Fochteloërveen. Guests mainly come here to enjoy the peace and quiet, the space and the convivial atmosphere.

A spacious and clean campsite

The entire campsite makes a quiet, clean and spacious impression. The camping pitches are also spacious and well maintained. They have a slightly quirky and natural design and therefore vary in size and location.

Lovely swimming pool

Camping Alkenhaer does not have its own swimming pool, but the Appelscha forest pool is within walking distance (1.1 km) of the campsite. Laco Bosbad Appelscha has a heated outdoor swimming pool with a family slide and diving boards. For the little ones, there is also a safe toddler and preschooler pool with a water playground. You can also go swimming in the Aekingermeer recreational lake, which is a 15-20 minute bike ride from the campsite.

Catering

The eatery is the real centre of the campsite, where everyone comes together. Here you can enjoy a delicious meal or a drink on the terrace. It is also possible to order snacks to take away. Meanwhile, children can entertain themselves on the playground equipment.

Natural surroundings

The campsite's greatest asset is undoubtedly its location near the Drents-Friese Wold and Fochteloërveen national parks. Here you can wander through landscapes that are unique in the Netherlands, with a particularly rich variety of plants and animals.

properties.name: Camping Namasté
properties.description:
Want to enjoy a holiday in a quiet spot in an unspoiled natural environment? Then travel to Camping Namasté, near the village of Puysségur in Haute-Garonne. This four-star campsite is located in the woods, far away from big cities, motorways and mass tourism. A good spot for nature lovers to unwind. This well-kept terraced campsite has spacious touring pitches, an attractive restaurant and a heated outdoor pool with paddling pool.

Wooded site with spacious pitches

On this wooded campsite, most pitches are in the shade, although there are a few sunny ones too. Prefer a bit more comfort and your own bathroom? Book a stay in a modern wooden chalet or apartment.

What does a camping day at Namasté look like?

First thing in the morning, collect your (pre-ordered) breakfast from reception and enjoy it at the bar. Breakfast includes baguettes, fruit, croissants and chocolate rolls. Then go for a nice morning walk, for example on the camping's marked parcours de santé, which runs around the site. In the afternoon, take a dip in the outdoor pool and then head to the campsite restaurant for a lovely evening meal. In high season, enjoy music or a film at the open-air cinema in the evening.

Take lovely forest walks

From the campsite, there are some lovely walks through the forest. The campsite owners know this forest inside out, so be sure to ask them about the most beautiful spots and paths. There are also great cycling routes. You may cycle past of the many castles during your ride, such as the stately Château de Laréole (6 km).

properties.name: Camping Du Colombier
properties.description:
Do you like camping on a small, quiet campsite with lots of greenery? Camping Du Colombier is located in French Auvergne, in the heart of the volcanic region. This friendly campsite is ideal for families with (small) children and nature lovers. It is also ideal as a transit campsite, given its convenient location near the A89 motorway.

Small family campsite

Camping Du Colombier has pitches with a grass base. You camp on grass and the pitches vary in size from 80 to 100 m2. Don’t have your own camping equipment? You can also book accommodation. For example, a chalet, bungalow or gîte. Dogs are welcome on the campsite.

Swimming pool, good food and sports activities

The campsite is simple, but there are enough facilities for a nice stay. There is a small swimming pool that is partly covered. Ideal for a refreshing morning dip! Has swimming made you hungry? Order a tasty dish from the snack bar. Want to do something active? Play a game of table tennis, jeu de boules, volleyball or minigolf. There is also a playground, board games and you can borrow a book.

Volcanoes and beautiful nature

The region is known for several (extinct) volcanoes. For example, the famous Puy de Dôme (27.5 km) is just half an hour's drive away. You can climb to the top on foot or take the cogwheel train for spectacular views.

A fun outing for the whole family is the Vulcania theme park (25.5 km). This interactive science park combines education and entertainment relating to volcanoes and natural phenomena. Here children and adults can enjoy fascinating exhibits and attractions.

properties.name: Camping L'Eau Vive
properties.description:
Camping L'Eau Vive is a quiet family campsite on the river Dordogne, within walking distance of the medieval town of Carennac. Camp among the trees and have direct access to the river water. It's the ideal place to cool off! At the campsite, enjoy the swimming pool, the sports field or the entertainment organised in high season.

Shaded pitches near the river

The pitches are large, up to a maximum of 120 m2, and surrounded by trees, bushes and flowers. You camp on a flat grass surface. For campers without camping equipment, there are lots of different accommodation types to choose from. Mainly mobile homes but also bungalow tents or a coco sweet tent.

Fun in the swimming pool or the river

On hot days, it’s great to cool down in the pool, at the front of the campsite. From the campsite, you also have direct access to the river. Wonderful canoe trips on the river are possible too. Other facilities include a multi-sports field, mini golf, a playground and table tennis tables.

Castles and historic towns

The beautiful historic town of Carennac is just 1.5 km away. So, within walking distance! This little town is one of the 'les plus beaux villages' and there's a good reason for this. There are other beautiful places in the area too, including the stalactite cave Gouffre de Padirac (9 km), the castle of Castelnau (8.5 km), the famous Rocamadour (23 km) and medieval towns like Collonges-la-Rouge (24 km), Autoire (12 km) and Loubressac (8 km).

properties.name: Camping Laspaúles
properties.description:
Camping Laspaúles (near the village with the same name) is centrally located in the Spanish Pyrenees, in the midst of the nature area Aragón, with ample scope for culture lovers as well. The mountainous area is suitable for all kinds of mountain hikes, ranging from very easy to steep climbing. Especially families with children can experience all kinds of walking adventures.

Reception

The very well maintained campsite offers pitches on well-kept grass (in very hot summers the grass may become a bit dry) under scattered trees with pleasant shade. The pitches are not separated by hedges or bushes. This is an advantage if you want space, but less so if you are looking for privacy. Some rental accommodation is available.

Swimming or trekking into nature

There is a medium-sized deep swimming pool and a smaller toddler pool. The swimming pools are surrounded by a tiled terrace and sunbathing lawn. Excursions are organised from the campsite, and you can also hire a guide. From the grounds you can immediately venture into unspoilt nature along signposted pathways, adapted for young and old. In the vicinity you will also find a nature trail especially laid out for wheelchair users.

Special trips are organised for children (with helmet and walking sticks), as well as ball games and mountain bike excursions. Adolescents can do rafting on the local river.

Special restaurant

The shop on the campsite is also the village shop! How simple life is, you can get anything you want here. The large restaurant (open throughout the year) offers something special, namely a delicious breakfast. Next feature: most dishes are traditional and homemade.

properties.name: Residence Club Les Dolmens Camping
properties.description:
Residence Club Les Dolmens Camping is a quiet family campsite in the Gard tourist area. Here you camp in green surroundings and enjoy the restaurant, swimming pool and children's playground. There is plenty to do in the immediate surroundings: from many sporting activities to pottery with a local painter or swimming in the River Cèze. The campsite is also a great base from which to explore southern France. Pont d'Arc, the Camargue marshland and cities like Nîmes make nice trips.

Camping in green surroundings

The campsite is surrounded by amazing nature. Not surprisingly, you will see a lot of greenery on the campsite itself. Bushes and trees surrounding the pitches ensure you enjoy privacy. You can also rent a mobile home or a unique Coco Sweet. This four-bed tent has its own kitchen, terrace and two bedrooms. Great when you are looking for convenience and more comfort!

Quiet family campsite

On the grounds of the quiet family campsite, you will find a restaurant and bar, a multi-sports pitch, jeu de boules court and playground. There are also two swimming pools. One is heated and covered with a sliding roof in the off-season. Ideal for a refreshing swim. The lively village of Méjannes-le-Clap can be reached within minutes by car.

Nature and culture on your doorstep

Residence Club Les Dolmens Camping is located in the Cèze Mountains through which the similarly named river runs. Close to the campsite, you will find several beaches where you can swim, sunbathe and picnic. The Grotte de la Salamandra (6 km) cave system is also nearby.

properties.name: Toscana Holiday Village
properties.description:
The campsite Toscana Holiday Village is surrounded by hills, near the well-known cultural cities of Florence, Pisa and Lucca. The campsite is situated in a valley, close to the fortified town of Montopoli. Take a refreshing dip in the swimming pool on the campsite, enjoy the fantastic view from your pitch and savour some delicious Italian cuisine.

Here, you will be camping in Tuscany. This region boasts picturesque, rolling hills full of cypresses and olive orchards. The area is dotted with quaint towns and villages. Simply put, it is a cultural wonder overflowing with natural beauty. Come explore it all during a camping holiday at the Toscana Holiday Village campsite.

Camping with a view

The receptionists on the campsite will welcome you warmly. After you have checked in with them, you will follow a steep, paved road downwards. It is almost as if you are diving into the valley. The camping pitches are also located at different heights. It doesn't matter which pitch you choose, because they all feature stunning views of the valley.

To the beach

Tuscany is famous for its impressive countryside, but you shouldn't miss out on a visit to its coast. The campsite is an hour's drive from the beach in Marina di Massa. It is the perfect place to spend the day sunbathing, building sandcastles or playing a game of beach volleyball. The beach boasts a view of both the clear blue sea and the impressive mountains in the area. It is a truly unique combination!

Campsite swimming pool

Do you have to leave the campsite to cool off in the water? Fortunately for you, no! The campsite features a fantastic swimming pool for you take a refreshing dip in. Just spread your towel out across one of the loungers near the pool and relax. There are plenty of umbrellas for those who like a bit more shade.

properties.name: Camping Le Douzou
properties.description:
Camping Le Douzou is a quiet and small-scale terraced campsite in the middle of nature with spacious shady camping pitches. You have a choice of a spot by the river or on one of the terraces. As the pitches are generally separated by natural vegetation, you will enjoy a great deal of privacy. The campsite is car-free, hence children can play safely on the camping grounds.

A number of separate spots on the campsite are available to guests who arrive with a camper and wish to arrive/leave at any time of the day. These spots, too, are spacious and are situated between trees. In addition to camping pitches, you can also rent a mobile home. These are equipped with all modern conveniences and accommodate 4-6 people. Furthermore, fully-equipped lodge tents with a semi-covered outside terrace can also be rented.

From a fast-flowing stream to the Dordogne

The Céou, a fast-flowing stream with crystal clear water, runs across the camping before it eventually empties into the well-known Dordogne river. The river is eminently suitable for swimming, fishing and canoeing. The river water is quite chilly, so if you are looking for some water fun in slightly warmer water, you can make use of the camping swimming pool.

Jogging with the sporty camping owner

In peak season, Camping Le Douzou organises various activities. Sports activities for children and adults, such as jeu de boules competitions or basketball games. You can also join the camping owner for a morning jog three days a week.

In the recreation area, you will find a pool table, a shuffleboard and DVD player with (Dutch) children's movies. Once a week, some fun crafts activities are organised for the tiny ones.

properties.name: Camping La Bretèche
properties.description:
'The best theme park in France', this was the title given to theme park Puy du Fou in 2014. Are you or your kids completely wild about this sort of theme park? In that case, you're in the right place at Camping La Bretèche, where you will be camping a mere three kilometres away from the theme park! It is just a fifteen-minute bicycle ride away.

A good impression

First impressions count. This is also the case when you arrive at Camping La Bretèche. Everything looks well-maintained and there is plenty of greenery with many trees and plants. The campsite grounds are divided up into different camping fields where you can - if it's not too busy yet - choose your favourite pitch.

The pitches vary somewhat in size. If you are camping with a caravan or motorhome, you will need a more spacious pitch. Hedges and shrubbery separate the camping pitches. The furnished lodge tents, mobile homes and chalets are located in a separate part of the campsite.

Swimming in the swimming pool

The swimming pool is not only a fun place to splash around in, you can also swim lengths and join in with an aqua gym lesson. There are several poolside loungers where you can catch a tan. The separate paddling pool is very much appreciated by families with small children.

Shop and restaurant

Do you enjoy cooking your own meal at your camping pitch? In that case, you can find the most basic groceries in the small on-site shop. Or you can dine at the restaurant on the campsite. Here, you can try some delicious dishes while enjoying the view of the lake.

properties.name: Camping Parfums d'été
properties.description:
The fine sandy beach of the Atlantic Ocean nearby, a small harbour at only 300 m from your pitch and the lively resort town of Jard-sur-Mer within walking distance. Welcome to Camping Parfums d'été, situated in the south of the Vendée, the departement with no fewer than eighteen seaside resorts.

Rent a covered wagon or an eco lodge

During quiet periods at the campsite, you can choose one of the demarcated pitches yourself. These are beautifully located between trees. Most camping pitches are sufficiently large for a car and caravan. Rather rent accommodation? Choose between one of the covered wagons, eco lodges and natura tents. An eco lodge is a dwelling of cotton sheeting and wood, fully equipped with a kitchen and private terrace.

The sea or the campsite swimming pool

Where to go when you want a swim? The heated campsite swimming pool with separate toddler pool, or the sea and sandy beach near Jard-sur-Mer? In fact, why should you choose, just alternate between the two! For children the sandy beach is of great interest, of course. Building castles, paddling in the sea, and carrying water from the sea to the sand castle... 

Getting sporty during your holiday

Built up a healthy fitness condition before leaving home? If so, at Camping Parfums d'été you can simply continue to maintain your condition on the fitness track. Also fun: play a game of soccer on the multifunctional sports field.

Campsite shop and snack bar

The campsite has a small shop with a limited selection. At the bar aka snack bar you can buy pizzas, sandwiches, salads, French fries, drinks and ice cream. There is also a bread service.

properties.name: CampingPark Murner See
properties.description:
Water and nature lovers take note! If you stay at CampingPark Murner See, you will be at a unique location in a lake area in southeastern Germany, less than 100 kilometres from Neurenberg. The campsite is uniquely located on a peninsula between two lakes, the Murner See and the Brückelsee. And that means lots of water fun as well as fantastic views and sunsets.

Camping by the lake

The campsite borders the Murner See and many of its pitches are located by the lake. Use the map to figure out just how close you want to be to the lake, but the water is never far away here. A part of the campsite is for touring campsite visitors, another part for fixed pitches, and there is a meadow for motorhome owners. There are also several lovely mobile homes for hire. The pitches are level and kept neat, with a nice grass surface. If you want to be in the shade, you must provide your own canopy or parasol.

Beautiful sunsets

You have access to the lake from the campsite. There are several jetties with small sandy beaches. The water is clean and clear, so feel free to go for a swim. Or spread out a blanket in the evening and enjoy a magical sunset above the glistening water. CampingPark Murner See has all the amenities needed for a comfortable holiday. There is a bread service and a restaurant with a wonderful terrace that looks out over the water. For the little ones, there are all kinds of fun options just outside the campsite, such as a fairy tale forest, a fun water playground and mini golf.

properties.name: Camping Domaine d'Anglas
properties.description:
Four-star campsite Domaine d'Anglas is situated in the heart of the Gorges de l'Hérault. You are surrounded by an organic vineyard and vast nature. The river Hérault is nearby. Delicious floating or swimming in the river. Or let yourself be spoiled in the campsite's restaurant. There are also regular wine tastings. These are often organic and sulphite-free.

Camping under the trees

Between the trees of the somewhat rugged camping grounds there are several grassy fields. On these you will find spacious pitches. Here you can enjoy a quiet stay in the shade. You do not need to bring a table. At many of the pitches a picnic table has been provided.

Comfortable, snug and luxurious

You can experience a really comfortable camping holiday in one of the accommodations. If you choose a gypsy wagon, then you opt for comfort and snugness. But if you stay in a lodge tent, you will be looking for just that little bit of extra luxury. You will find even more luxury in a 'wine cottage'. With a whirlpool bath, wonderful view, fully equipped kitchen and private sanitary facilities, you will want for nothing here.

Natural swimming pool

With its organic vineyard, Domaine d'Anglas is a perfect holiday destination for wine lovers. But also for the youthful camper, the campsite is a nice place to be. Not only can they play in the playgrounds. They can also take a dip in the swimming pool. It is situated in a sunny spot at the edge of the forest. Take the whole family for a dip in the natural swimming pool. Afterwards, you can lie in the sun and dry off.

properties.name: Camping De Durnal 'Le Pommier Rustique'
properties.description:
On the slope of a hill at the edge of the Ardennes, in the sloping landscape of the surroundings of the Belgian town of Namur, you will find campsite De Durnal 'Le Pommier Rustique'. From the terraces on the campsite you have a view on the valley of the river Bocq. Because of its location, close to the motorway, this campsite is ideal for campers travelling south.

View over the valley

The image of the campsite is determined by the mobile homes that overlook the landscape on several terraces. The campsite mainly welcomes regular guests, but there are also around forty pitches and around twenty rental units for touring campers. The small hiker's huts are great fun where the two of you can have a cosy camping holiday. The touring pitches are spacious and open, but don't have too much shade and privacy. What you do have from your camping pitch is a beautiful view of the vast fields and the wooded valley.

The highest part of the campsite is reserved for (youth) groups. They can camp on a separate terrain. This keeps possible disturbance to a minimum.

Simple facilities

The facilities on the campsite are quite simple and not too extensive. For children there are playgrounds with a trampoline and swings, while the athletes can let off steam on the outdoor fitness area. If you're tired of sports, you can go for a tasty snack or a fry in the 'friterie'. If you want to relax completely, you can do so in the log cabin, where you'll find a sauna and whirlpool.

properties.name: Camping Les Rives du Lac
properties.description:
Camping Les Rives du Lac is a family campsite in the western part of the Alps. Here, the Provence is dominated by the mountains, making it a paradise for walkers and cyclists. The campsite is in a valley, on the banks of a recreational lake. There is also an heated indoor swimming pool.

Welcome!

You will find the campsite just south of Veynes. Drive over the undulating surface of the D994 and you will come across a campsite sign. The campsite has touring pitches and rents new chalets. With such a chalet, you get the luxury of your own barbecue and a private hot tub. The general toilet and washing facilities are also luxurious and well-maintained, and environmentally friendly, with solar panels.

Walking and swimming

Dutch families are in the majority at Les Rives du Lac. Day trips are organised from the campsite: a guide will tell you all about the flora and fauna in the mountains. The part of the recreational lake, where the campsite is situated, is all about swimmers. So you will not encounter any sailing boats in 'your' swimming water. In less favourable weather, you can go the campsite's indoor swimming pool. It's not massive but it is lovely swimming in the heated water.

Veynes and Gap

There are two restaurants by the lake, one belonging to the campsite. For more choice, you can go to the centre of Veynes, which is a five-minute drive. You can take a fun 30-kilometre cycle ride to the lovely town of Gap, with its old cathedral and many shops and restaurants.

properties.name: Camping Domaine La Gautière
properties.description:
In an olive grove on the border between the Drôme and the Vaucluse, not far from the mighty Mont Ventoux, you’ll find Camping Domaine La Gautière. This small, quiet 3-star campsite has spacious touring pitches between olive trees on a sloping terrain. Surrounded by vineyards extending as far as the hills. The campsite has a beautiful outdoor swimming pool.

Natural campsite

The natural grounds of this small campsite is situated in an olive grove. Except for the olive trees, there is no delimitation between the spacious pitches. The touring pitches are situated on sloping terrain, so you have some extra work to level your caravan or camper.

Refreshing outdoor pool

Next to the main building, close to the entrance of the campsite, there is a simple outdoor swimming pool. It is open from mid-May to the end of September, but it is not heated. The swimming pool is beautifully landscaped, with a separate paddling pool and all around a narrow, tiled sun deck.

A simple restaurant

Most of the campsite’s facilities are open from early May to mid-September. During this period, you can buy fresh bread and some groceries in the small shop by the reception. The simple restaurant serves snacks and pizza. From the terrace, you have a lovely view of the surrounding area.

Buis-les-Baronnies

The area surrounding the campsite is rich in attractions. You’ll find all sorts of wine routes, which take you past the many winegrowers and wine cellars in the area. There are also charming villages, many with a picturesque historic centre. Buis-les-Baronnies, the region’s capital, is a charming Renaissance town with a picturesque market square.

properties.name: Camping Le Plein Air Neuvicois
properties.description:
In Neuvic, a friendly village in the Périgord Blanc, you will find Camping Le Plein Air Neuvicois. This natural campsite is beautifully integrated in a recreational area with all types of water and sports facilities. Stunning camping on the Isle river or on the Le Biacle creek. There is a tranquil and peaceful ambiance on the campsite. You can do your shopping in the camping shop. There is also a restaurant/snack bar.

Camping in the shade and with privacy

The small scale campsite makes a well maintained impression. There are some sixty touring pitches and twenty rental accommodation units, mainly mobile homes and a few tents. The camping pitches are mostly demarcated with hedges and trees. As a result you have ample privacy and shade.

From the slide into the warm water!

Adjacent to the campsite is a large municipal swimming pool (400 m2). There is also a toddler pool (100 m2) with lovely toadstool shower. As a campsite guest you have free access to the swimming complex.  Tanning and relaxing can be done on the sunbathing lawn adjacent to the swimming pool.

But there is much more to experience on the campsite. How about a playground with some equipment, swing and slides? The trampoline will also keep children entertained for hours. Entertainment is offered for both children and adults (French).

Get busy with sports

Sporting opportunities are available in many different forms on the campsite and the surrounding grounds. You can indulge in fishing, rafting, pedal boating or kayaking. Equipment can be rented. Do you prefer to stay dry? You can also play a game of table tennis, jeu de boules or tennis. But also fitness training (outdoor) and even ziplining are possible.

properties.name: Camping Bockenauerschweiz
properties.description:
Bockenauer Schweiz Campsite is located on the edge of the gorgeous Soonwald, along an idyllic stream in a beautiful valley. This is first and foremost a campsite where you can really enjoy peace and quiet. The campsite is almost exclusively used by tourist campers. In addition to very spacious camping pitches, the campsite features two fishing ponds, an excellent restaurant and modern sanitary facilities. This campsite is also an ideal base for hiking and cycling enthusiasts.

Choose your own camping pitch at your leisure

The campsite's reception is located in the restaurant. The owners will cordially welcome you there. Campers are encouraged to first choose a suitable pitch. The paperwork is taken care of later.

While searching for the perfect camping spot on this extensive campsite, you'll quickly notice that there are no specific pitch designations around. It's not always possible to have these given the height differences on the site.

Stream, fishing ponds and a playground

A small stream flows past this campsite. This is a nice place for children to swim and build dams, for example. Its also an ideal spot for campers to let their dogs take a refreshing dip on hot days. Bockenauer Schweiz also offers two beautiful fishing ponds and an adventure playground where children can enjoy themselves.

Come have a nice meal at Gaststätte Zum Budche

At the front of the campsite you'll find the Gaststätte Zum Budche restaurant. You can enjoy a traditional German meal here. Of course, you can also order German specialty beers and delicious Naheland wines at Zum Budche.

properties.name: Camping Kost Ar Moor
properties.description:
Brittany is a unique French region with a beautiful coastline and a distinctive culture. It is an ideal destination for those who enjoy swimming, watersports and nature. At the cosy, flower-covered Kost ar Moor Campsite, you'll enjoy gracious hospitality, a lovely atmosphere and plenty of fun in the water. Here you'll be camping on spacious, sheltered pitches in beautiful surroundings. Walk to the sandy beach for a dip in the sea or rent a bicycle and explore nature.

The Breton Riviera

The campsite is located in the beautiful Finistère-Sud region, about twenty kilometres from the capital of Quimper. This region is renowned for its beautiful coastline and southern Brittany's sunny climate. It is even called the Breton Riviera!

Campsite full of flowers

You'll arrive at a beautifully landscaped campsite covered in flowers. Here you'll be warmly welcomed by the friendly and hospitable owners. The camping pitches are very spacious and beautifully laid out. There is plenty of shade and privacy thanks to the hedges and trees. The sanitary building is modern and very clean. The campsite has about 100 pitches for touring campers and a number of mobile homes and safari tents. There's also a mobile home that is easily accessible for campers with disabilities.

Swimming pool and sandy beach

In the centre of the campsite is a playful swimming pool with a water slide and a paddling pool. Next to the pool you'll find the bar. This is a lovely place to spend long sunny afternoons. But you can also walk to a beautiful sandy beach in ten minutes.

properties.name: Herrfallet Stugby & Camping
properties.description:
Sweden is known for its lakes, vast coniferous forests and beautiful nature. At Herfallet Stugby & Camping, you'll be camping amongst the pine trees on a peninsula on the vast Hjälmarenmeer. Endless cycling and hiking paths await you outside the campsite. And fishermen can enjoy fishing on the lake.

Camping in a nature reserve

There's no shortage of nature at Herrfallet Stugby & Camping. Here you'll be camping in a nature reserve. Your pitch is right on the water. The pitches are spacious, with dimensions ranging from 100 m² to 120 m².

Don't have your own camping equipment, but still want to spend your holiday in this beautiful place? Then rent one of the simple wooden bungalows, also known as stugas.

Dive into the clear water

Lake Hjälmaren is shallow and has gently sloping sandy beaches. Children will have a great time swimming and splashing around in its waters. The lake also has rocky islands for sunbathing.

Are you the more active type? Then this lake is also great for you. Windsurfing and sailing are allowed on the water. You can also take a canoe trip. Fishermen can rent a boat or go out with their own boat. Cyclists and hikers will also get their money's worth in the vicinity of the campsite.

From cycling to shopping in Stockholm

Consider taking a day trip to Stockholm (164 km). It's about a two hour drive by car. Or take the train. You'll then be in the centre of Stockholm within 1.5 hours. This city is well worth a visit. It offers museums, a boat tour, shopping and great food.

properties.name: Camping Holmernhof
properties.description:
Camping Holmernhof is located in the German state of Bavaria, near the spas of Bad Füssing. The pitches on this campsite have plenty of amenities and the sanitation is luxurious. You can visit the Biergarten or the bowling alley for many hours of fun.

Pitches with ample amenities

All pitches are equipped with a frost-free water tap, drainage, a place where you can empty your chemical toilet, electricity, internet and a TV connection. The pitches also have a gas connection, so you won't have to bring bottled gas or replace empty bottles.

Thermal springs and a swimming pool

Camping Homernhof guests can make free use of the swimming pool in the nearby tennis court complex. There is a water slide, a diving board, a paddling pool and a spacious sunbathing area.

On the campsite, you can play a game of beach volleyball or table tennis, and there is a playground for the children. Is the weather a little cooler? No problem, there is also an indoor playroom with a variety of toys.

The thermal springs of Bad Füssing are just 350 metres away. With dozens of baths and a total water surface area of 12,000 m2, this is a huge complex where you can completely relax and unwind.

Hotel luxury on the campsite

The sanitary facilities on Camping Holmernhof are very luxurious, clean, and fitted with a variety of modern features. There are two sanitary facilities, the most luxurious of which is "Innenauen".  You can imagine yourself being in a hotel rather than at a campsite. There are even built-in television screens, displaying news and information about the surroundings. You can also make use of the family bathroom, which is equipped with a waterfall shower with coloured LED lighting. Or you can rent a private bathroom.

properties.name: Camping Erodios
properties.description:
The luxury three star campsite Erodios is located on Navarino Bay. Here the Greek defeated the Ottomans in a gigantic sea battle in 1827, and as a result won their fight for independence. It is a piece of history every Greek knows, palpable in the bay, on the island of Sphacteria, in the town of Pylos and in the nearby Navarino castle.

Green and clean

Erodios is an eco campsite. The terrain is level, beautifully laid out and well maintained. When you bring your tent, you will be allocated a pitch in the olive grove. The remainder of the campsite is also very lush. Where this provides insufficient shade, shade cloth has been put up. Along the paved roads and pathways there are brick buildings, which house the reception, the restaurant and the (spotless) sanitary facilities. This is an exceptionally clean campsite, certainly by Greek standards.

Bathing in the bay

You camp here on a level, demarcated camping pitch along a paved road which leads to the beach. From your camping pitch you can walk directly onto the beach and into the sea. The campsite has a private beach with loungers, beach showers and thatched beach umbrellas.
