Perfect for sunbathing, paddling, bobbing in the water and swimming, of course. The bay lends itself excellently to all kinds of water sports, but particularly to sailing, windsurfing and kitesurfing.

The most beautiful beach

If you like a good walk, why not walk a bit further along to Paleokastro, the old castle of Navarino. The view from there is without a doubt worth the climb. The uphill road takes you to the ruin of the castle, overlooking the bay and the Mediterranean Sea.

properties.name: Linwater Caravan Park
properties.description:
Close to the east coast of Scotland, at cycling distance from Edinburgh and amidst open farmland, lies the quiet Camping Linwater Caravanpark. It is an ideal spot for seekers of peace and quiet, walkers or those interested in a city trip to the Scottish capital. The Pentland Hills Regional Park and various other country parks are in the immediate vicinity.

Luxury lodges

The well-kempt terrain consists of an open camping lawn with some flower beds, partially shielded by trees and shrubs on the periphery. There are paved pitches along gravel paths for caravans and campers, while tents stand on grassland. Want to hire something? You can choose between hiker's cabins and luxury Scandinavian lodges with a terrace, barbecue and chairs.

Playground

Recently, a playground was laid out for children; otherwise, there is not much to do on the camping grounds. This in contrast to the surrounding area. Close to the campsite lies the Calderwood and Almondell Country Park; from there you can go on lovely walks along the river Almond. There is a walking trail along the Union Canal in the direction of Linlithgow, which starts in Ratho. Are you looking for something else? People at the reception will gladly assist you. Furthermore, you will find all necessary information about sights in the region there.

Small shop

At the reception is a small shop with a limited assortment. Milk, bread and newspapers can be ordered daily. In East Calder (3 km away) you can do your daily shopping and in Livingston (6 km away) you will find large supermarkets.

properties.name: Glen of Aherlow Caravan & Camping Park
Camping ABC am Großensee/Hamburg
properties.description:
Camping ABC am Großensee/Hamburg is half an hour's drive from Hamburg, on the banks of the Großensee. At this small campsite, you camp alongside the swimming water, in a wooded area. For a refreshing dip in the lake, step from the campsite into the water via a small bridge.

Camp next to the Großensee

The campsite's camping area is enclosed by woods on one side and the Großensee on the other. Despite its location, in a wooded area, the campsite's pitches have an open character. They are located (45 of them in total) on grassy fields at the edge of the forest. Aren’t bringing any camping equipment? Then stay in the white holiday home, located near the water, or in a lodge tent.

Swim in the Großensee

A lovely swim in natural water: what could be better than that? If you are camping at camping ABC am Großensee/Hamburg, you can take an early dip in the large swimming lake. You'll have to grit your teeth though because the water can be a bit chilly. From the campsite, the Großensee can be reached via a footbridge; just pick up the key from reception.

In the area

As mentioned: the campsite facilities are pretty basic. You won't find a supermarket here, for example. You will find one in Trittau, a ten-minute drive east of the campsite. The campsite doesn't have a restaurant either, but you don't have to go far for that. There’s an Italian restaurant that serves great food a short walk away.

properties.name: Campingpark Heidewald
properties.description:
In North Rhine-Westphalia in the north of Germany, Campingpark Heidewald is nestled in the Münsterland. The campground, near the town of Sassenberg, is located in a green environment of the Feldmark recreation area, only a stone's throw away from the Feldmarksee. Driving through the lovely entrance, you'll find peace in the green environment of trees, bushes and grassy fields.

Sleeping in a wine barrel

The campground has a large reception, with a coffee corner where you will be given a friendly welcome. The route to the camping field is clearly marked and leads along the comfort and seasonal campsites. The open campsites at the back of the campground are spacious and the terrain is very well cared for. Want to do something completely different? For a special experience you can also choose to overnight in a big wine barrel, safari tent, igloo, tiny house or Schäferwagen.

Provided with all comforts

You'll find everything you need for your holiday on site. The toilet facilities and the wash room are clean and functional and there is a separate disabled toilet. For groceries you can go to the supermarket in nearby Sassenberg (2 km). Prefer not to cook? There are several restaurants on the campsite and in the surrounding area.

Water fun at the Feldmarksee

Kids can have fun in the playground with some play equipment or play a round of ping pong or volleyball. Highlight is the large bouncy castle. Love the water? You can walk through the woods (800 metres) from the campground to the recreation lake, the Feldmarksee.

properties.name: Camping Rialto Village
properties.description:
Camping Rialto, a small town camp site, is situated in a tranquil, green environment on the outskirts of Venice. It is the ideal basis for a visit to this town, the bus will take you to the Canal Grande in 15 minutes. The bus stop is directly in front of the camping and the buses run very frequently. Tickets are available from the reception, where you will be welcomed by the friendly owner or one of the employees.

Camping or glamping?

The camping has demarcated spots, with adequate space for a few nights. Many pitches are shaded due to the green surroundings. The sanitary facilities have recently been renovated and are basic but clean. Didn't bring a tent? No problem, because we have rental accommodation. You can spend the night in a fully equipped tent for two persons or you can book glamping accommodation in a bungalow tent. There are also (mini)chalets for rent.

Young and international

Most camping guests spend a couple of nights here as a base for visiting Venice. Your neighbours are young and come from various parts of the world; your one neighbour may hail from as far as China and the other neighbour from Peru.

Unique boat excursion

The camping offers private excursions, cruising the Venetian Lagoon. This fantastic trip includes a visit to the idyllic islands of Torcello and Burano. The final destination is the magnificent Punta Sabbioni beach, where you can spend the entire afternoon. For those who prefer to explore the other islands, there is a further boat trip.

properties.name: Camping Lou Cantaïre
properties.description:
Camping Lou Cantaïre lies in a wooded area of the French Provence. It is a family campsite with luxury accommodation and a swimming pool complex. The medieval village of Fayence is only 4 kilometres from the campsite. Famous coastal resorts like Fréjus and Cannes are less than an hour’s drive away.

Luxurious accommodations in the woods

At Camping Lou Cantaïre you can only rent accommodations. Stay in a luxury mobile home or chalet with private toilet facilities. All accommodations are among the trees and have their own terrace, allowing you to enjoy the long summer evenings with French wine, a baguette and cheese. Sustainability is an important theme at the campsite. All waste is sorted, and catch basins for rain and compost bins have been installed at the campsite.

Entertainment in the high season

Camping Lou Cantaïre is a family campsite with plenty of activities for the entire family. During the high season, the campsite restaurant with its large terrace is open and daily activities are organised for the entire family. Fetch fresh baguettes and croissants at the reception every morning. Campsite visitors can have fun with various sports activities, such as tennis, volleyball, fitness or a game of jeu de boules. There is a playground for small campsite guests.

Water park in the sun

Water fun is guaranteed at the campsite with its large water park, a wading pool, Jacuzzi and water slides. There is plenty of room to enjoy the French sun on a chaise longue. Beaches along the Mediterranean Sea are about half an hour’s drive from the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Le Lac de Mondon
properties.description:
On the Étang de Mondon, a lake in the quiet surroundings of the village of Cromac in the Limousin, is camping du lac de Mondon. Light terraces offer shady and sunny touring pitches, situated on well-kept lawns. Travellers stay overnight, while families with children enjoy the swimming pool, large playing fields and friendly activities.

Terrace campsite by the lake

From the shores of the lake, the campsite slopes gently, allowing some terraces to flow into one another. Sixty touring pitches fill the quiet campsite. Most pitches are shaded by trees and delimited by hedges. Some pitches are sunny. You have a choice of pitches suitable for tents, but also extra spacious pitches for larger caravans and campers. On all pitches, the grass base is nicely cared for. Cosy mini-chalets and classic mobile homes complete the camping offer.

Family camping

Even campers who want to stay longer than one night at the campsite will find a great camping destination. In high season these are mainly families. The children have plenty of space to play, on and in the water. There is also a playground on the shore, while the sports fields and large open lawns also provide entertainment. In addition, regular activities are organised for the children: a film evening, treasure hunt or hand archery workshop, for example.

Large yellow slide

The swimming pool at the campsite is one big attraction. The spacious outdoor pool overlooks the lake and offers plenty of space for campers. Only when the pool is open to locals on weekends, it can get quite crowded. Next to the rectangular pool is a round paddling pool.

properties.name: Camping Château de la Rolandière
properties.description:
Camp on the estate of a castle at camping Château de la Rolandière. This small-scale campsite is situated on a secluded spot in the Loire Valley, in the middle of the undulating landscape of the Touraine. You arrive at a shady estate, where you camp in peace and quiet, in an intimate setting. You don't need much more than that. Perhaps a dip in the outdoor swimming pool, which offers a view of the castle.

Restful camping

Within the castle walls an attractive, peaceful campsite appears. The front part of the terrain is resembling an orchard. Here you camp under the trees, with a view of the castle, on touring pitches delimited by hedges. Further down the campsite has a more open character. Because of just fifty touring pitches you camp in an intimate setting, but you will always find company when you want to have a chat with one of your fellow guests. If you want a real royal overnight stay, book one of the rooms in the castle.

Swimming pool at the castle

At the back of the campsite, next to the castle, you will find the swimming pool. This simple swimming pool is not particularly royal, neither in size nor in appearance. Still, you can enjoy a lovely swim while looking out over the castle. The outdoor pool is well cared for and is large enough for the amount of guests.

Foodtruck

Next to the castle there is an old building that a.o. houses the recreation room. Here you will also find a bar and, at the back, a pavement café. In the summer months a food truck comes every evening attracting the campers with the smell of homemade hamburgers.

properties.name: Camping Heidkoppel
properties.description:
Heidcouple Campsite is in a quiet location, far from the hustle and bustle of the city and its accompanying traffic, and lies almost directly on a large sandy beach on the Baltic Sea. This campsite is located in Heidkate, a town in Schleswig-Holstein that is geared towards tourism and therefore always has a relaxed holiday atmosphere. In this northern German region, with its mild, invigorating climate, you can enjoy walking and cycling, especially along the extensive sandy beaches. The campsite itself has excellent sanitary facilities and some fields that are specially equipped for touring campers.

Separate fields for touring campers

Seasonal pitches are the primary form of accommodation at Heidcouple Campsite. However, there are also sixty spacious pitches for touring campers. These are neatly grouped together on a few separate fields. These are large, clearly demarcated touring pitches on grassy lawns, which offer little or no shade for the most part.

Enjoy swimming in the Baltic Sea

This campsite is located almost directly on a sandy beach hundreds of metres long. You can reach this clean beach on the Baltic Sea in just a few minutes by foot. You can swim safely in the sea here. It is also suitable for children, because the water quality is excellent and there are several shallow coastal zones. In addition to swimming, you can also kite and windsurf in this part of the Baltic Sea.

Entertainment in the high season

Those staying at Heidcouple Campsite during the summer holidays can look forward to a varied entertainment programme. In July and August, the campsite organises various activities for camping guests of all ages. In addition, the campsite has a toddler playground, a sports field and a beach volleyball court.

properties.name: Camping de Retourtour
properties.description:
Camping de Retourtour welcomes you for a wonderful holiday in the heart of the Ardèche. This 4-star campsite is situated on the banks of the River Le Doux, where you will wake up every day to the sound of gently flowing water. At the campsite, you will find a heated swimming pool, a gym and a restaurant serving local specialities. But be sure to explore the surrounding area as well, with charming villages such as Lamastre and Desaignes. Cycling enthusiasts will thoroughly enjoy the famous L’Ardéchoise cycle route.

Pitches and accommodation

Here, you will camp on spacious, flat and shady pitches surrounded by greenery. Although the pitches are somewhat closer together, the beautiful riverside location more than makes up for it. Prefer a bit more comfort? Then opt for a mobile home or rental accommodation. Then you can stay in comfort while still enjoying the great outdoors to the fullest.

Lots of amenities

There is plenty to do on the campsite itself. The heated swimming pool is open from May. Young campers can burn off some energy in the playground, and if you want to stay fit on holiday, you can work out in the gym. Or go for the real camping classic: a game of boules. Fancy a treat? Grab a seat outside at the restaurant and enjoy some local dishes.

In high season, the campsite is even more lively. Take part in creative workshops, have some fun on the sports field or enjoy an evening show. And for all you nature lovers, there are several walking and cycling trails that start near the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Erholungspark Wehlingsheide
properties.description:
Camping Erholungspark Wehlingsweide is in a wonderfully quiet setting, in a rural area and near the vast national forest Die Haard. This campsite is a few kilometres north-west of the town of Datteln in North Rhine-Westphalia. This is an ideal campsite for those seeking peace and quiet. Furthermore, you can go on many lovely walks and cycle rides in the vicinity. The campsite itself offers amenities including a luxury wellness centre and a tropical style water landscape where you can relax. Additionally, the site has been landscaped with care and is well maintained.

Something for everyone

Erholungspark Wehlingsweide has a relatively large number of permanent pitches and accommodation for hire, but the campsite is laid out so that the tourist pitches are next to each other. There are camping pitches in various sizes and levels of comfort. The special motorhome pitches are opposite the entrance, on the other side of the road.

A tropical water landscape

A wonderful water landscape has been created close to the campsite entrance. There are palm trees, a sandy beach and water valley around this pond. That makes it an ideal place to relax and unwind.

Pamper yourself in the wellness garden

As well as the aforementioned water landscape, the campsite has also created a lovely wellness garden. You can immerse yourself in the heat of the Finnish sauna (with coloured light), an infrared cabin and a veritable cave sauna. You can also get various types of massages, including a foot reflexology massage. Qualified specialists give these massages. Besides all this, the campsite hires out some mobile homes with a private sauna and whirlpool.

properties.name: Flower Camping des Lacs
properties.description:
Camping des Lacs lives up to its name. The campsite 'of the lakes' is all about the adjoining lake of Lavaud and the beach of La Guerlie. The campsite is situated in green surroundings in the Charente-Limousin region. You reach this oasis of peace by driving from the A20 in the direction of Limoges. Then take the N141 towards Angoulême, exit at Chabanais and head towards Pressignac. The campsite signs will direct you.

Spacious pitches and a Coco Sweet

Here you live the good life! There are more than 100 spacious camping pitches (130 m2 on average). The surrounding hedges offer you enough privacy. The pitches are easily accessible, so positioning your caravan or camper van is no problem at all. The campsite also offers mobile homes, a chalet and a Coco Sweet (a combination between a tent and a mobile home).

Water fun

Camping des Lacs has three swimming pools: an outdoor pool, a toddlers' pool and a heated indoor pool. More water fun can be had on the sandy beach at La Guerlie. Follow the forest path through the car park to get to the accompanying reservoir. In the lake of Lavaud you can swim, fish (permit available at the reception) and do water sports. In July and August there is an inflatable obstacle course in the water.

Communal baking and roasting

In the evening you can have a barbecue with all your new camping friends, because there are five shared barbecues on the campsite. If you don't feel like baking and roasting yourself, you can go to the snack bar. It is located on the beach and has a view of the lake.

properties.name: Camping Les Bateaux
properties.description:
The river Meuse meanders in the north of France through the Champagne-Ardenne region. The green hills and narrow roads are an invitation to go on sporty cycling trips. Grazing white cows will gaze at you, and every now and then the crews of passing boats and anglers on the banks will cast you a glance .. You stay in idyllic surroundings like these when you have a booking at Camping Les Bateaux, located in Revin.

Spacious pitches

If it is not too busy on the campsite, you may be able to choose your own nice and spacious pitch. The pitches are square with hedges on three sides and a power pole on the side of the paved road. Tall weeping willows and other deciduous trees create an impression of camping in a forest. You can also hire one of the four mobile homes.

Simplicity prevails

The small camping shop has a limited assortment of groceries. On weekday a baker stops by with baguettes, croissants and 'normal' bread. The lack of other amenities is not a problem, as Revin lies within walking distance. There is a small playground for children on the campsite.

Excellent sanitary facilities

There is only one ablution block on the campsite, located next to the reception. It is heated, clean and equipped with nice showers. There are also facilities for disabled persons, of course.

Enjoy tasting!

A tasting of regional products is organised on Saturday evenings between 19:00 and 20:00 from mid-July to mid-August.

properties.name: Camping L'Etoile d'Or
properties.description:
Camping l'Etoile d'Or, a four-star campsite specially for families, is between the mountains of Pyrénées-Orientales and the Mediterranean Sea. This campsite, close to the sea at Argelès-sur-Mer, offers a range of child-friendly activities and entertainment. Camping l'Etoile d'Or has the ‘Famille Plus’ label. That label indicates that you will find all kinds of amenities specially for children, whereby the campsite is a guarantee for successful family holidays.

Lovely camping pitches and nice cottages

If you come with your own tent, motorhome or caravan, you can book a camping pitch. But you can also hire accommodation. There are various cottages, mobile homes and holiday homes at the campsite. They vary in size and amenities.

Days filled with fun in the water

Families can easily entertain themselves the whole holiday without having to leave the campsite. Camping l'Etoile d'Or has an extensive water park with a heated swimming pool, Jacuzzis and several slides. So fun is guaranteed for the children! There are aqua aerobics lessons in the morning for an active start to the day. There is also a paddling pool for the smaller children where they can splash about.

Everything at hand

Everything is within arm's reach at Camping l'Etoile d'Or. For example, you can go to restaurant Grande Voile every evening where young and old can enjoy a tasty meal. After dinner, you and your family can take a leisurely stroll to the central stage, where there is an entertainment programme every evening in the high season.

For groceries, you can go to the Au P'tit Marché supermarket for seasonal vegetables, fruit, packaged foods, drinks, local wines, ice cream and souvenirs. Freshly baked bread and pastries are available throughout the day.

properties.name: White Water Park Caravan Club Site
Cambridge Cherry Hinton Caravan Club Site
Buxton Caravan and Motorhome Club Site
Coniston Park Coppice Caravan Club Site
Camping Grohnder Fährhaus GmbH
properties.description:
Camping Grohnder Fährhaus is located on the banks of the Weser river in the friendly and hilly Weserbergland region. This area with mostly flat roads is highly suitable for exploration by bicycle. The meandering river with its green banks makes for beautiful canoeing trips.

Tall hedges

The well-tended and paved grounds are located in an open landscape with the hills in the distance. A few tall trees are scattered here and there. The pitches vary in size and are separated by tall hedges offering plenty of privacy. A few pitches are large enough for a car and a caravan with an awning; the other pitches are on the small side. The campsite caters particularly to campers with a motorhome. They will appreciate the paved surfaces. A large field for tents is situated along the Weser.

In the Weser or on dry land

You can go for a refreshing swim in the Weser. The jetties provide easy access to the water. But there is also plenty to keep everyone entertained on dry land! There is a playground with a sandbox, swing set, jungle gym and a slide for the little ones. Or you can play an exciting game at the table tennis table or on the small sports field. Boating lovers will appreciate the mooring jetty and the slipway. 

A beautiful cycling route (Weser Radweg) runs past the campsite. You can park your own bicycle or motor in a covered bicycle shed. You can also go for walks along the Weser. The European hiking route E-11 passes through the Weserbergland region.

Restaurant

The restaurant has an extensive menu and a large patio. The campsite offers a bread roll service, but you can also book a full breakfast at the hotel.

properties.name: Camping Les Sous Bois du Lac
Camping De la Romiguière
properties.description:
Amidst pristine nature you can spend your holidays in this well maintained oasis of peace and quiet. You camp here on the banks of the Lac de la Selve reservoir, near the town of Laguiole. The small campsite De la Romiguière lies in its full width in the bay of the reservoir. The region is characterised by forests, nature and agriculture. The lake is directly accessible to camping guests. Diving, swimming and boating are allowed.

Sand and grass

The terrain consists of grass (hard surface) interspersed with some sand. Hedges and trees can be seen everywhere. The 33 demarcated pitches vary in size. The terrain is not entirely level. The twenty rental caravans are modest, but well equipped. Your neighbours are sporty water and nature lovers.

The swimming pool or the lake

There is a heated swimming pool (open from mid-June to mid-September) of 145 m2, with tiny toddler pool. This can be found near the reception and the bar. Swimming is mostly done in the lake, however. The beach strip is partly made of grass and partly of sand. Beach showers are available. The lake can be reached from the full width of the campsite.

Terrace with sunset

The shop has a limited range. However, fresh bread is available on a daily basis. The modest, but large restaurant offers a view of the lake. In addition, there is a snack bar, a pizzeria and a bar. In the evenings when the sun sets, the panorama from the terrace is magical: the evening light over the water creates a magnificent contrast with the dark mountains.

properties.name: Camping Le Soustran
properties.description:
The small campsite Le Soustran is located in the green surroundings of the Corrèze. The Dutch owners have turned this beautiful piece of nature into a wonderful camping destination. There is a relaxed atmosphere on this quiet and friendly campsite. You will camp on very spacious pitches, close to the lake of Triouzoune. Walk or cycle into nature or sail across the lake.

Extremely spacious pitches

The owners take good care of their campsite, you can see that immediately. The beautiful grassland has height differences, giving the campsite a fanciful character. On this nicely laid out terrain, there are extremely spacious camping pitches. Forty in total. They are delimited by large hedges, which provide a nice shelter and privacy. In spite of this demarcation, you get a feeling of freedom and space. Because the campsite is situated on a hill, you can look far into the distance.

Relaxed atmosphere and a crackling campfire

A crackling campfire, the sun just going down. The marshmallow on your stick is already turning brown. The children are allowed to stay up late. There is a relaxed atmosphere, people chatting quietly with each other. That's camping at Le Soustran. Every camper will find the peace and quiet he is looking for.

Romping and sailing

Children can horse around on the campsite. One moment they jump on the trampolines, the next they run across the grass fields. They can swing in the playground or play in the sandbox. And of course, a splash in the swimming pool is also a daily occurrence. Are you looking for an adventure in the surrounding area? Then the canoes are ready for you. After a trip, you can relax on the campsite's patio with a snack and a drink.

properties.name: Rådastrands Camping, Stugor & Outdoor
properties.description:
On the shores of the idyllic Lake Rådasjön, nestled in the unspoilt countryside of Värmland, lies Rådastrands Camping, Stugor & Outdoor. This charming woodland campsite by the water is managed by Dutch owners. Here you can camp in the heart of Sweden, surrounded by forests, lakes and tranquillity. Perfect for families who love adventure and the great outdoors.

Family campsite

At Rådestrands Campsite you camp under tall coniferous trees. The camping pitches are spacious and you can park your car next to your tent or caravan. The campsite is aimed at touring campers, but you can also rent lovely, traditional log cabins ('stugor'), fully equipped safari tents or tunnel tents. The view of the lake and the wooded shores is magnificent. 

Exciting entertainment programme

The entertainment programme at Rådestrands Campsite is a bit more adventurous than on most campsites. In high season a number of outdoor activities are organised for children. For instance, the enthusiastic entertainment team teaches children how to build rafts, make their own bow and arrow, build huts and climb trees. 

For nature lovers

Adults will also enjoy going into the forest or onto the water. This is a campsite for nature lovers. Weekly excursions are organised in high season. Go on a canoe trip on the lake or on a rafting trip on the Klarälven river. Prefer to explore on your own? Then choose from one of the marked walking or cycling routes through the woods, past lakes and rivers. With a bit of luck, you might spot a beaver, or even a moose, along the way!

properties.name: Kalmar Camping Rafshagsudden
properties.description:
Kalmar Camping Rafshagsudden is a quiet campsite with a full view of the sea. The campsite is on a peninsula in a green setting in the province of Småland, only 10 kilometres away from the city of Kalmar. The campsite offers pitches, lodge tents and huts. It is here that you can discover the peace and quiet of the Swedish countryside. Just the last few kilometres to the campsite, a winding forest road, already puts you in a holiday mood.

Relaxing by the sea

The spacious pitches are distributed over the site with a choice of sunny pitches or shaded corners under the trees. Some pitches are so close to the sea that you can hear the sound of the waves! If you don't have your own camping equipment, at Kalmar Camping Rafshagsudden it is possible to rent a cottage or a luxury glamping tent.

A carefree camping holiday

The campsite has modern amenities, including two well-kept toilet blocks. There is a small supermarket with a wide range of goods. Uddens Bistro & Bar is the right address for local dishes or a drink with a view of the sea. During the high season the campsite organises all kinds of activities, such as live music and themed evenings.

Explore Kalmar and Småland

There is also plenty to do in the surrounding area. The surrounding area is perfect for hiking and cycling trips through the countryside. Be sure to visit Kalmar (17 km), known for, among other things, its castle and its historic city centre. And don’t forget to visit the glassworks in the area to admire this old craft.

properties.name: Camping Il Cicero
properties.description:
Il Cicero Campsite is located on the north coast of Sicily, directly on the Tyrrhenian Sea. This campsite is comprised of two parts. The first part is a luxury bungalow park situated in a botanical garden. The second part is a simple camping area. Both parts are separated by a railway line. The campsite is located on a beautiful beach and has a stylish swimming pool. The beach looks out over the Aeolian Islands.

Take the Patti exit from the A20 and turn onto the SS113 towards Patti. After the hairpin bend, turn left towards Palermo and keep following the SS113 until you see the signs for San Giorgio. You'll eventually see Il Cicero Campsite on your left, between the wooded hills. First park your caravan or motorhome along the road outside the gate. You'll be directed to a special entrance once you've checked in at the reception.

Simple camping area

The camping area has spacious and shady pitches. A tunnel under the railway connects the campsite with the bungalow park. Campsite guests pay an entrance fee for the swimming pool next to the reception. Il Cicero Campsite has its own beach. You can take a day trip from the campsite to the Aeolian Islands, which are visible from the beach.

Simplicity and luxury

The sanitary facilities are very simple but clean. You can go to San Giorgio for shopping. In the morning there's a bakery at the entrance of the campsite. In the afternoon you'll find a fruit and vegetable stall there.

properties.name: Flower Camping L'Escale du Perthuis
properties.description:
Are you looking for a campsite where holidaymakers of all ages can enjoy themselves throughout the day? Flower Camping L'Escale du Perthuis, four kilometres from the charming seaside resort of La Tranche-sur-Mer (Vendée), is a lovely family-friendly campsite. At this well-maintained holiday park, you can stay in a comfortable mobile home and enjoy a wonderful water park. There is also a restaurant and supermarket, as well as sports and recreational facilities. During the summer holidays, there is also a diverse entertainment programme. The resort is situated in a quiet spot, just 200 metres from a large sandy beach.

Standard, comfort or premium: which will you choose?

L'Escale du Perthuis is ideal for holidaymakers who like to enjoy the same comforts on holiday as they do at home. This resort offers modern mobile homes for rent. These come in three categories: standard, comfort and premium. It is also worth noting that the mobile homes are suitable for four to six people and that some are wheelchair accessible. What’s more, every mobile home has its own terrace, often with a canopy too.

Plenty of entertainment for young and old

With a bowling alley, zip lines, a multi-sports pitch, an indoor and outdoor playground and a chill-out zone for teenagers, there’s plenty to do. During the high season, activities are organised for all ages. At the kids’ club, children aged 4 to 12 enjoy creative workshops and fun games five mornings a week. Later in the day, there are sports competitions and themed evenings for the whole family. This resort also features a beautiful water park with a heated indoor and outdoor swimming pool. The outdoor pool has a spectacular family slide and a paddling pool with various playful water features.

properties.name: Rosapineta Camping Village
properties.description:
Camping Village Rosapineta is situated in the coastal resort town of Rosolina Mare. The setting is very attractive: on a peninsula on the edge of the Po delta, close to the mouth of the Adige River.

The campsite is not too far from interesting towns: Venice (70 km), Padua (64 km) and Ferrara (84 km). Rosapineta is an extensive campsite with numerous facilities. Sun, sea and beach are never far away.

Space for all

Because of its large scale, it is clear that Rosapineta focuses on mass tourism.

The campsite is spaciously laid out. The camping pitches are located along wide lanes. There are all kinds of pitches. Large caravans, camper vans and tents will have no problem finding a spot. The camping pitches close to the sea have a cover of shade cloth, whilst the pitches further inland are shaded by the many pine trees. There is also an abundance of rental accommodation (bungalows, chalets, holiday cottages and mobile homes).

Relaxing and perhaps a little bit of sports...

The campsite has a private beach with loungers and sun umbrellas, accessible over footpaths crossing the dune ridge. Furthermore, there are two swimming pools on the beach, one of which has a slide. There is a fitness area for the sporty guests. Other options include tennis, soccer and beach volley ball. There is a playground and a mini golf course for the little ones. Each night a train rides over the camping grounds. Of course, in high season all kinds of entertainment is available for children and teenagers.

Good meals

On the Rosapineta campsite you will find several restaurants: a classical camping restaurant with take-away facility, a beach restaurant-pizzeria and a culinary restaurant with fine cuisine.

properties.name: Campeggio Villaggio Sos Flores
properties.description:
Campeggio Villaggio Sos Flores is located on the eastern side of the island of Sardinia. This campsite is situated near the town of Tortolì and the town of Arbatax. A large part of the campsite borders the quiet beach of San Gemiliano.

Plenty of accommodation to choose from

At this large, friendly campsite there is always a suitable place or accommodation for you to stay. There are particularly many accommodations; almost 250 of them. These mobile homes, flats and bungalows are grouped around the grounds. The more luxurious mobile homes are closer to the beach. From the main road with several side roads you can drive to one of the spacious pitches in the forest. The pitches are not marked out. Electricity is available throughout the campsite. There are sanitary facilities in several areas on the site.

Close to the beach

There is no swimming pool on the campsite, but you can cool down in the sea. When it is time for a dip, just walk straight down the campsite. Hire a sunbed and parasol and bask in the warm sunshine. From here you can see the Torre di San Gemiliano, which you can also climb.

Restaurant with pizza service

You can eat well at Campeggio Villaggio Sos Flores. The restaurant and the supermarket are open in high season. The restaurant has a large menu and a pizza service. Take a seat on the patio or find a place inside the restaurant. Through the large glass windows, you can enjoy staring at the outside while enjoying a good glass of wine.

properties.name: Camping Landes Bleues
properties.description:
Camping Landes Bleues is located close to the lake of Aureilhan, in the forests of the Landes. You'll camp here on a wooded campsite, on beautiful lawns. Camping Landes Bleues is very child friendly. Small campers can let off steam in the playground or the indoor swimming pool with its large water slides.

Well-maintained campsite

Behind the main building there is a very well maintained campsite. Many trees accompany the pitches and provide most of them with shade. The touring pitches are situated on a grassy ground and are spacious. Where the rental accommodations (mainly mobile homes and bungalows) are situated in tight rows next to each other is the campsite more playfully laid out for touring campers.

Child-friendly family campsite

A large playground with bouncy castle, a swimming pool with slides and a full entertainment programme; Landes Bleues campsite is a real family campsite. As a child-friendly campsite, the campsite welcomes many families with children from different European countries every high season. Water sports enthusiasts and sea lovers are also in the right place, here in the Landes coastal area. A large lake, but also the Atlantic Ocean, are nearby.

Indoor swimming pool with water slides

If you drive through the barriers, the big pool immediately catches the eye. This is mainly because of the spacious sliding roof that covers the pool. When the weather is nice, this roof can be slid almost completely open, so you can swim in the sun. There is a whirlpool attached to the pool. The children will probably mainly be found outside the canopy. where a few large water slides are.

properties.name: Camping Le Parc
properties.description:
Looking for a camping holiday that allows you to combine the city and the beach? At Camping Le Parc you are a stone’s throw away from Montpellier. The tram will bring you to this busy student city in 20 minutes. Just half an hour of cycling will take you to the beautiful beaches of Palavas-les-Flots. Camping Le Parc has many trees, a beautiful swimming pool and is open all year round.

Spacious, shady pitches

Despite the campsite being so close to the city, the number of trees at Le Parc make it feel like an oasis of greenery. The 66 camping pitches are spacious and shaded. If you don't bring your own camping equipment, you can hire a mobile home or a fully furnished Coco tent. Your faithful four-footed friend is also welcome at the campsite.

Go for a refreshing swim

Camping Le Parc has a heated outdoor swimming pool, open from April to mid-October. There is a separate paddling pool for the youngest campsite visitors. Children can have the time of their lives in the playground with a trampoline. During the months of July and August, extra activities are organised, such as a workshop for painting, jeu-de-boules competitions and karaoke evenings.

Explore the charming city of Montpellier

The campsite is a perfect home base for exploring Montpellier. A tram stop close to the campsite allows you to travel directly to the city in about 20 minutes. Visit Place de la Comédie, viewed by some as the most beautiful square in France. See the Porte du Peyrou, Montpellier’s Arc de Triomphe, and visit Jardin des Plants, Europe’s oldest botanical garden.

properties.name: Camping Du Lac Mercus
properties.description:
Camping Du Lac Mercus is a small campsite next to the lake with the same name, located in the heart of the Ariège in the Occitanie region, Midi Pyrénée. A well-kept campsite situated on the water's edge, where low-hanging trees provide shady pitches. Here you camp in peace and quiet, in the middle of nature. The shallow lake is ideal for water sports enthusiasts and anglers.

Pitches on the bank

Spacious camping pitches are situated under low trees on the shores of the lake Mercus, a widening of the river Ariège. They provide plenty of shade on the touring pitches right by the water, but the pitches on the higher terraces are also shady. On some touring pitches you can camp with extra privacy, because they are protected by hedges. There are about the same number of pitches as rental accommodation.

Swimming and sunbathing

A small swimming pool allows you to cool down in the water. This is also possible in the lake, but it is less suitable for swimming. The bottom is quite muddy and the water is shallow, so it is better to dive into the campsite's swimming pool. The swimming pool, accompanied by a small paddling pool, is in full sun. An ideal location for sunbathing.

Water sports on the lake

Because the lake on which the campsite is situated is unfortunately not so suitable for swimming, water sports enthusiasts have free rein. On the flowing water you can sail and paddle surf very well. Canoes and kayaks can be rented near the campsite, but you can also take to the water from the jetty on the campsite. Fishermen will also love it there.

properties.name: Camping Solaire
properties.description:
Camping Solaire is located on the outskirts of Veynes, on a large green site with mountain views. The clear swimming lake is just a short walk away from the campsite. The atmosphere is both relaxed and active. Every day feels different thanks to the sports fields, swimming pools and the many walking options in the area.

Well-organised family campsite

The pitches are flat and very large: up to 150 m2! The combination of sun and shade makes it easy to choose a pitch to suit you. The panoramic and wooded pitches all have their own individual feel: with a panoramic view or quiet under the trees. There are hardly any hedges on the fields. This makes it a good, overseeable family campsite.

There’s plenty of choice if you prefer accommodation. For example, mobile homes with two bathrooms for large families. You will always have your own patio to relax on.

All-day entertainment

Camping Solaire has three swimming pools: two large ones and one paddling pool for the little ones. The pools are centrally located on the campsite near the restaurant. Take a seat on one of the sun loungers, relax in the jacuzzi and enjoy the view of the mountains!

The site has volleyball courts, a football pitch and table tennis tables; they are often used for tournaments. Children and teenagers are entertained throughout the day with workshops, games and evening activities. On quiet evenings, there’s sometimes a campfire, where young and old come together.

properties.name: Camping Beloofde Land
properties.description:
Camping Beloofde Land, a Christian campsite for campers of all ages, is close to Voorthuizen. Surrounded by the forests and heathlands of the Veluwe, you enjoy a holiday filled with countryside and peace here. The campsite is easy to reach via the A1, with the Voorthuizen exit a short distance away.

A wide range of camping pitches

Whether you come with a big caravan or a small tent there is always a suitable place for you at Camping Beloofde Land. You can choose from various types of camping pitches. If you don't have your own camping equipment, opt for one of the hire accommodation, such as the holiday homes or Swedish houses. For families with young campers, the tipis and themed tents (with themes such as Miffy, LEGO and Jungle) are great options.

Neat, modern amenities

The amenities at the campsite make your stay that bit nicer. There is an outdoor swimming pool for a refreshing swim on hot days. There are paved sunbathing areas around the swimming pool to work on your tan. And there is an entertainment team that provides entertainment for children. Meanwhile, you can open a book or visit the snack bar on the site for a snack and drink.

Explore the Veluwe

There is plenty to see and do in the area around Camping Beloofde Land. Go on lovely walks in the Veluwe countryside, in peace and quiet, for example. The nearby recreational lake Zeumeren (2.5 km) offers water-based fun for young and old. Additionally, various annual events are organised in the area, such as the Sheepshearing festival (usually in May and June).

properties.name: Tørring Camping
properties.description:
Tørring Camping is located in the heart of Denmark's Mid Jutland region, on the banks of Denmark's longest river, the Gudenåen. Here, you’re in the heart of nature but also in the centre of the town of Tørring. Whether you’re looking for peace or adventure, a quiet place to fish or relax, or the ideal base for trips in Jutland, this is the place for you.

Under trees or by the water

Prefer being under trees or close to water? You’ll find your ideal pitch here. If you prefer to leave your tent, motor home or caravan at home, you can also rent accommodation here. There are several places where you can pitch your tent on a wooden platform. So, no more wet tent canvas!

Back to basics

You really go back to basics here. Children have fun in the playground, or paddle in the river. Bad weather? Then just head to the activity room to watch TV, read a book or play a game.

You won't find a campsite shop or restaurant here, but there are plenty of options for shopping or something tasty to eat or drink in Tørring.

Nature, culture and LEGOLAND®

At Tørring Camping, you’ll camp in nature, by the river Gudenåen. Go fishing or canoeing, or relax by the water. The lively student city of Aarhus (64 km) is fun for a day trip. The campsite is also close to Givskud Zoo (13 km), LEGOLAND® and Lego House (35 km).

properties.name: Harz Mountain Camp Am Schierker Stern
Trehörningsjö Camping & Stugor
properties.description:
Welcome to Trehörningsjö Camping & Stugor, a place where peace, space and adventure come together. Surrounded by forests and lakes, this campsite has been the base for nature lovers for more than 50 years. Enjoy swimming, fishing, kayaking or hiking in the beautiful Swedish countryside.

Spacious pitches and typical Swedish accommodation

The pitches are suitable for any camping equipment. You can choose between pitches on grass or paved surfaces, among trees for shade or in the sun overlooking Inre Lemesjö Lake. There are also several stugor for rent. These cosy Swedish cottages are not only practical because of the beds and kitchen appliances, they also look great!

A real family campsite

Start your day with fresh bread from reception and then dive into the water for a swim or rent a kayak on the campsite. Children can blow off steam in the playground or in the entertainment room, while adults relax in the hot tub or sauna. Would you rather do something together? Then try the 18-hole mini golf course!

Discover the beauty of northern Sweden

Unspoilt nature is never far away here. Skuleskogen National Park is a bit of a drive (about an hour and a half) but is well worth it. Here you hike through forests and cliffs overlooking the Gulf of Bothnia.

Combine your active holiday with some cultural trips, and visit cities like Umeå (90 km) and Örnsköldsvik (60 km).

properties.name: First Camp Hökensås-Tidaholm
properties.description:
Fishing and nature lovers take note! First Camp Hökensås – Tidaholm is in a lovely, forested area in the Swedish region of Västra Götaland. You camp amid the countryside with dozens of lakes nearby, where you can fish for trout and rainbow trout. Lake Vättern, one of Sweden's largest lakes, is less than a 10-minute drive. You can do various water sports here, such as kayaking, sailing or swimming. It is also an ideal area for walking and cycling. The campsite itself has a padel court, playground, miniature golf course and a restaurant, among others.

Spaciously laid out campsite in the countryside

When you arrive at the campsite, the lovely and spacious layout of the camping pitches stands out. The pitches are level and covered with grass. For people without their own camping equipment, the campsite offers accommodation for hire. You can choose from various chalets.

There are two spacious toilet blocks, including a special space for babies. There are also laundry rooms with washing machines and dryers. There is also a kitchen with an oven, microwave and a place to wash up. Your dog is welcome at the campsite. There is even a special dog shower available.

Delicious food in the restaurant

Not in the mood to cook? You can go to the restaurant at the campsite for both lunch as well as dinner. Choose the day special or enjoy an à la carte dinner.

And if you want to eat your freshly caught fish, no problem. The campsite has a barbecue area where you can prepare your delicious fish.

properties.name: Camping Landes Azur
properties.description:
Camping Landes Azur, located at only 10 kilometres from the Atlantic Ocean and close to Lake Soustons, is a wonderful family campsite in the quiet French region of Landes. Surrounded by pine forests, beaches and lakes, it is a paradise for surfers and nature lovers. The campsite serves as a good starting point for exploring the area, with options for cycling and walking trips.

Spacious and shaded pitches

The campsite offers spacious, shaded pitches, separated by hedges. As well as using your own camping equipment, you can hire mobile homes and wooden huts on poles, suitable for two to eight people. The toilet and washing facilities are well maintained and include facilities for babies and the disabled.

Go for a swim in the swimming pools

Landes Azur has two heated swimming pools, one indoors, and a separate paddling pool with water play equipment. Relax on a sun lounger while the children play or enjoy an ice cream on the patio.

Children's club

In the high season, there is a children's club with various activities. You will also find a playground and a bouncy castle. Popular activities such as jeu de boules tournaments, live music, karaoke and themed meals provide plenty of entertainment.

Bite to eat in the restaurant

The campsite restaurant offers a wide range of dishes, including pizzas, local specialities, and it has a spacious patio. Fresh bread is available daily. For grocery shopping and more dining options, Soustons is only six kilometres away.

Day at the beach

The campsite is in an ideal location for exploring the wide sandy beaches by the Atlantic Ocean. Surfing fans can go to Hossegor (25 km) or Mimizan (53 km). For a day out, Aquatic Landes Park in Labenne (40 km) is recommended and Spain is only a few hours' drive away.

properties.name: Camping Paradis Les Rives de l'Hérault
PuntAla Camp & Resort
properties.description:
Do you like camping as close as possible to a lovely sandy beach and enjoying a Mediterranean climate? PuntAla Camp & Resort is located at the edge of a vast pine forest in a hilly region of Tuscany. This campsite is ideal for families with children of all ages, especially in high season. There is plenty to keep everyone occupied thanks to the beach, the watersports activities, the sports and games facilities and the wide range of entertainment options.

A wooded and shaded camping area

The wooded and flowery grounds offer a plethora of shaded camping spots. The pitches are also demarcated by natural features. In addition to camping pitches in three comfort levels, various other accommodations can also be rented here. There are six sanitary blocks spread over the campsite. Three of these were renovated in 2021. The sanitary facilities are well maintained and very clean.

Enjoy swimming in a calm part of the sea

PuntAla Camp & Resort is located on a sandy beach. This beach offers you a beautiful view over the Tuscan archipelago and, of course, over the deep blue sea. Parasols, beach chairs and sun loungers make your beach visit even more pleasant. There are also pedal boats, catamarans, stand up paddleboards and surfboards for rent on the beach.

Plenty of fun for the whole family

At PuntAla, campers of all ages can enjoy themselves all day long. Children can let their imaginations run wild while enjoying the playfully set up slides, climbing installations, space stations and the pirate boat. There is also a mini club where fun activities such as treasure hunts, games, dance nights and shows are organised. Various workshops are also organised, and there is an open-air cinema where you can enjoy family-friendly films and shows.

properties.name: Ostseecamping Am Salzhaff
properties.description:
Ostseecamping Am Salzhaff is located directly on the Baltic Sea, in northern Germany. Due to its sheltered location on an inlet, the water here is calmer, ideal for surfers and families with small children. The campsite therefore attracts many water sports and nature lovers.

Camping next to the Baltic Sea

The campsite has spacious pitches in open fields, equipped with electricity and water. There are also special spots for campers at the entrance. Don’t have your own camping equipment? Then choose a camping pod or bungalow, both with kitchen, toilet and shower facilities and a terrace.

Facilities for a relaxing holiday

The campsite has a surf school where you can have lessons. Children can have fun on the playground and there is entertainment during the summer months. The toilet facilities are modern and well maintained, with spacious showers. For something to eat and a drink, visit Seaside Pepelow restaurant, where locals also like to eat at weekends. The menu includes schnitzel, spare ribs, a hamburger and a variety of fish dishes.

Explore the surrounding area

There is plenty to do in the vicinity. For example, the lovely harbour town of Wismar (21 km) is half an hour's drive away, with its historic town centre and nice shops. The island community of Poel (18 km) is also worth a visit, with its lighthouses and nature reserves. For a day at the beach and promenade, visit Kühlungsborn (22 km) or Rerik (11.5 km). Walkers and cyclists explore the area via the East Coast Route.

properties.name: Camping- und Wohnmobilpark Sommersdorf
properties.description:
Do you want to escape the hectic pace of everyday life? And do you enjoy beautiful walking and cycling tours? Then Camping- & Wohnmobilpark Sommersdorf, in the German state of Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, is an ideal holiday destination for you! This cosy campsite is located in the Mecklenburger Großseenland, a sparsely populated area teeming with natural beauty. The campsite is located directly on the banks of a recreational lake and has its own sandy beach.

A neatly laid out site for every type of camper

Camping- & Wohnmobilpark Sommersdorf features a neatly laid out camping area. There's a field for tent campers along the beach. There's also a designated area for caravans and motorhomes at the entrance of the campsite. Most pitches offer little shade and not much privacy. The sanitary building is located at the centre of the campsite. The modern facilities you'll find here are clean and in very good condition.

A nice recreational lake for swimmers and fishing enthusiasts

This campsite is located directly on the attractive Kummerower See recreational lake. You can walk straight from your camping pitch onto the wide sandy beach that belongs to the campsite. There you can take a nice refreshing dip on hot summer days. The Kummerower See is also known to be an excellent fishing lake. Fishing enthusiasts can obtain a fishing license at the campsite reception and rent a rowing boat.

Supermarket and restaurant tips

There is a small bistro on the campsite. Its open daily from May to September. Coffee, cake and various small snacks are available here. There's also a shop where you can order fresh bread rolls every day.

properties.name: Camping Sonnenland
properties.description:
This campsite is in the sunniest part of Austria. And that is how the campsite got its name. Camping Sonnenland is in the far east, near the village of Lutzmannsburg in the state of Burgenland. You can take varied walks and bike rides around the campsite, through level landscapes in Austrian terms. The area is also known for its viticulture. You can sample the delicious wines made in Burgenland at winemakers and Weinstuben (wine bars). The campsite itself is ideal for dog owners and families with (young) children.

Pick your own camping pitch

This campsite has two types of tourist camping pitches. You can choose a Luxusstellplatz (about 118 m²) or a XL Luxusstellplatz (180 to 240 m²). If you come on the off chance and go to reception to book a pitch at Camping Sonnenland, you can pick your own spot.

Nice swimming lake with inflatable slide

There is a lovely swimming lake on this campsite's grounds. You can reach this lake via two fine sandy beaches and a solid swimming jetty. There is an inflatable slide next to the lake which you can have fun sliding down. You can also swim with your dog in the swimming lake. Dogs can go into the water via their own beach.

From corn pit to haystack

The campsite has many playing facilities. There are various sports fields and playgrounds. Furthermore, the youngest campers can have lots of fun on the bouncy castles, in the corn pit, on the pump track and in the large haystack. There is also a lovely petting zoo at the campsite.

properties.name: Camping St-James-les-Pins
properties.description:
Are you looking for a small campsite with plenty of shade? In the Alps, in the South East of France, you will find the wooded campsite St-James-les-Pins. The town of Guillestre is two kilometres away. This region is ideal for sporty campers. The campsite has a beautiful natural water basin. There is also a public swimming pool 300 metres from the campsite.

Shade everywhere

The pitches are naturally situated. So expect pitches of various sizes. There are about one hundred marked out pitches in the shade of pine trees. The campsite is two and a half hectares and has several mobile homes and chalets. There is also a group chalet for up to nineteen people.

Like a fish in the water

The natural surroundings alone make it worth your while to book a pitch here. The campsite is also suitable for cycling fans, especially because of the various cols of the Tour de France. Think of the Col du Galibier, the Col d'Izoard and the Col de la Croix de Fer. The ultimate destination for cyclists! Also motorcyclists, fishermen and mountain bikers feel like a fish in water here.

Surprise yourself

Will you be camping at this campsite? Then don't forget to visit the restaurant. Take a seat on the small terrace and let your taste buds be spoiled. The food in this small restaurant is surprisingly good! For your own groceries, you have to go to the shops in Guillestre. The sanitary facilities at this campsite are also excellent. No frills, but they are heated. Very nice if you are staying in St-James-les-Pins in a colder period.

properties.name: Campingplatz Ostseequelle GmbH
properties.description:
In Niendorf/ Hohenkirchen (Mecklenburg-Vorpommern), located between Boltenhagen and Wismar, you will find this campsite. For beach lovers, this is an ideal holiday destination, as you camp right next to a large sandy beach on the Baltic Sea. This beach is located in a bay, where swimming is great in summer, also because the bottom only slopes very slowly and the water is therefore relatively warm.

Campingplatz Ostseequelle is located next to a small primeval forest and is surrounded by meadows. This campsite offers a neatly maintained campsite, a good restaurant and renovated sanitary facilities.

Camping pitches, bungalows and sleeping barrels

Campingplatz Ostseequelle is a well-organised campsite with tidy fields, accessible via paved paths. You camp here on neat grassy pitches.

Bungalows and sleeping barrels are also available for rent at this campsite.

Entertainment and relaxation

At this campsite children can have fun in the playground. At the little bridge in the southern part of the site there is access to a small stream.

There are also various sports facilities and a new sauna on the edge of the campsite, which can accommodate six people. In the sauna you can relax and enjoy panoramic views of the surrounding forest.

Italian food at Ristorante Salvatore

Right next to the campsite entrance you will find Ristorante Salvatore. This is an Italian restaurant where you can enjoy tasty pizzas and pastas, as well as meat, fish and vegetable dishes.

The campsite has a small shop, Minimarkt Fruchtquelle.

properties.name: Camping The Quiet Site
properties.description:
Camping The Quiet Site is situated on a hill overlooking Ullswater, in the heart of the Lake District National Park. From the site, you have sweeping views of the lake and the surrounding fells. Thanks to its elevated position, you can enjoy impressive skies and ever-changing colours in the landscape. The campsite has been around for over fifty years and has a traditional atmosphere, yet it also boasts modern facilities with a focus on sustainability.

Pitches and a special glamping experience

The pitches are spacious and suitable for tents, caravans and motorhomes. You can choose between grassy pitches or paved pitches with electricity. Several pitches offer views of Ullswater or the surrounding hills. There is also a wide range of glamping accommodation, including wooden pods, cabins and characteristic hobbit houses, some of which are built into the hillside. These lodgings are well insulated and attractively furnished, making them comfortable even outside the high season.

Authentic bar and modern facilities

One special feature is The Quiet Bar housed in a barn over 300 years old. In this charming space with wooden beams and natural stone walls, you can sample local beers and cider. Guests appreciate the warm, informal atmosphere. There are family bathrooms, washing-up areas and a small shop selling basic necessities. The campsite caters to those seeking peace and quiet, hikers and couples, but there is also play area for children.

Boating and culture in the area

The large Ullswater glacial lake is about a kilometre away. You can go kayaking, supping or take boat tours there. The village of Pooley Bridge is two kilometres away and has a variety of cafés and shops.

properties.name: Camping La Soleia d'Oix
properties.description:
The beautifully situated terraced campsite with its many trees is surrounded by beautiful countryside. The mountainous region of L'Alta Garottxa is a paradise for nature lovers and active campers.

La Garrotxa region is located in the north-east of Catalonia. Camping La Soleia d'Oix is situated next to the village of Oix and is in a quiet location. There are many walking paths close to the campsite, but interesting sights are also within easy reach of this charming mountain campsite.

Camping in the mountains

On the way to the campsite, you will already experience the vast landscapes and the mountain peaks in the background. The campsite is located on a slight slope and is reached via an easily passable mountain road. At the entrance, you come face to face with a large country house that has been converted into a characteristic restaurant. The owner welcomes all campers at the reception building.

Pitch under the deciduous trees

The spacious camping pitches are situated along various tree-lined streets. The majority of the pitches are about 100 m2 in size. The sanitary facilities look neat. You will meet many Spanish families here who celebrate their holidays in the mountains. The campsite also rents out chalets and bungalows and there are a number of hotel rooms.

Eating out in style

You'll want to visit the charming restaurant just for the unusual decor. The menu is diverse and includes local dishes. Breakfast is served at the bar and later in the day you can go there for a sandwich or a pizza. There are also seats under the tall trees to enjoy a drink.

properties.name: TAIGA Bassegoda Park
properties.description:
Taïga Bassegoda Park is located in the mountain region of Alta Garrotxa. It is a quiet campsite where people treat nature with respect. From this campsite, discover the unique Catalan region by bicycle or by foot, or hang your hammock up between two trees and relax. The Bassegoda Park campsite is situated some distance from the Catalan mountain village of Albanyà in the protected nature reserve of Alta Garrotxa, a mountainous region that merges with the Spanish Pyrenees. The easiest way to reach the campsite grounds is by taking exit 3 on the N15 and then follow Llers. From Llers, Albanyà is signposted.

Splendid surroundings

During your drive to the campsite, you can enjoy the splendid surroundings: you drive (over well-maintained roads) amid the green forested mountains and past the most beautiful panoramas. The enjoyment does not end when you arrive at the campsite grounds. Bassegoda Park is situated by a river, between the high mountains and with many trees. Here, you camp in the middle of the countryside. The forestation provides the spacious pitches, which are suitable for tents, caravans and motorhomes, with lots of shade and privacy. The campsite also has a ‘free camping field’. Where you can pick your own spot for your tent: ideal for those travelling around and backpackers. For campers seeking luxury, the campsite has a park with various bungalows and lodge tents.

Relaxing with respect

One thing that all campers have in common is that they love the countryside and they treat it with respect. Bassegoda Park is a perfect place for a relaxing holiday, so particularly those looking for peace and quiet will be at home here.

properties.name: Sites & Paysages Les Hirondelles
properties.description:
Sites & Paysages Les Hirondelles is located in the southern Lot department. This well-maintained French campsite is spacious, with mainly rental accommodations. The number of camping pitches is limited. The campsite has many trees, giving you the feeling of camping in a forest. Some of the pitches have a view of the green valley.

Luxury mobile homes

Camping Les Hirondelles has a limited number of tourist pitches for holidaymakers with their own camping equipment. The pitches are between 80 and 160 square metres. The majority of campers, however, make use of the accommodations on the campsite. Rent a luxury mobile home, chalet, hut on stilts or safari tent. Camping Les Hirondelles has something for everyone.

Water fun for everyone

Les Hirondelles has a heated swimming pool with a sliding roof. When the sun shines, the roof opens. On less beautiful days you can swim indoors. For the younger guests there is a paddling pool. This is not covered and can therefore only be used in good weather. In July and August you can join the weekly aquarobics lessons.

Activities at the campsite

Wake up in the morning to the music of the entertainment team. That won't happen to you at Les Hirondelles. The campsite has no entertainment team. However, various activities are organised to strengthen the mutual contact between camping guests. There are sports tournaments and gourmet evenings. The multi-purpose sports field is used for various sports activities. For children between two and twelve, there is a real 'adventure playground'. Older children can let off steam with table football, board games and the TV room.

properties.name: Knattercamping
properties.description:
Camping in a peaceful ambience, in woody surroundings and directly by a lovely recreational lake. All this awaits you when you stay at Knattercamping in Bantikow, in the German state of Brandenburg. Knattercamping is a neatly laid out and well maintained family campsite. Those looking for peace and quiet and families with young children especially appreciate this campsite. There is also a separate FKK section (naturist area).

Wonderful camping in a wooded setting

On the wooded grounds of Knattercamping, well-kept paths lead to different camping fields that are clearly separated from each other. The campsite also has a separate (naturally demarcated) FKK area. In the high season, Knattercamping is mainly frequented by German and Danish families. Furthermore, in the low season, mainly pensioners and families with young children are present.

Recreational lake with several sandy beaches

This campsite is located directly on the beautiful recreational lake Bantikower See. Several sandy beaches belong to the site, including a special dog beach and a FKK beach. The latter is directly accessible from the naturist part of the campsite. In addition to being a great place to swim, the lake also offers various water sports.

Shopping tips

At the entrance of the campsite you will find a small shop with a limited supply. You can buy delicious bread here. Would you like to do more extensive shopping? Then you can go to Wusterhausen, about a five-minute drive from the campsite. In Wusterhausen you will also find a number of good and charming restaurants for an enjoyable evening out.

properties.name: Camping & Ferienpark bei Jena
properties.description:
Camping & Ferienpark bei Jena is situated in a peaceful, green spot in Thuringia, on an island between the Saale and the Lache rivers. Here, you can camp surrounded by nature, with plenty of space all around you. Yet you can still easily reach the city of Jena. The camping site has a bar and a beer garden, among other amenities, and you can choose exactly where you would like to pitch your tent.

Spacious pitches and complete freedom

The pitches are spacious and you can choose your favourite spot. Whether you are travelling with a tent, caravan or motorhome, you will have plenty of space. Electricity is available and you can simply park your vehicle right next to your pitch. One handy tip: be sure to bring an extension lead for the connection. If you don’t have your own camping gear, you can rent one of the cabins or holiday cottages.

A bar and even a beer garden

At the entrance, you will find a welcoming bar overlooking the lake. A lovely spot to sit and relax for a while. Swimming is not allowed here, but it is perfect for a stroll along the water’s edge. Don’t feel like cooking? The beer garden is highly recommended for a bite to eat and a drink. There’s also a bread roll service.

Explore the Neuengönna region

Visit the charming town of Jena (10 km) for some culture, or head out into nature for a lovely hiking or cycling trip. Fancy something a bit more exciting? Then you can go paintballing or go-karting nearby. The three beautiful Dornburger Schlösser castles (6 km) are also well worth a visit. And cities such as Erfurt (65 km) and Weimar (36 km) are close by.

properties.name: NaturCamp Steinwald
properties.description:
NaturCamp Steinwald is located among the forested hills of northern Bavaria; it’s a small campsite with a focus on nature. Here, you’ll camp next to a modest swimming lake surrounded by green vegetation. The campsite is close to Naturpark Steinwald, a place that caters for walkers, cyclists and mountain bikers at every level.

Ecological camping

The paved pitches for caravans, motor homes and trailer tents are available in three lengths, for vehicles 6, 8 and 10 metres long. You can park your car in a separate car park, or near your caravan if you rent a large pitch. Of course, there’s also a grassy field for tent campers.

The owners like to offer campers a nature-rich experience. To promote biodiversity, wild bushes and flowering hedges full of berries and herbs surround the various pitches.

Sunbathing meadow and beach bar

NaturCamp Steinwald is right next to a bathing lake and hours of (swimming) fun! There’s a 300-m2 sandy beach and a great beach bar where you can order all kinds of drinks and snacks. There’s also a children's playground and a beach volleyball court.

Be amazed by nature

The campsite is close to Naturpark Steinwald, a beautiful walking and cycling area full of granite rocks and forests. Famous local attractions include the ruins of Burg Weißenstein and the Oberpfalzturm observation tower. The region is popular with walkers and mountain bikers. For example, explore the trails along the river Waldnaabtal. The GEO-Zentrum is interesting too. At this science museum and research centre, you’ll learn more about the earth, in a place where they’ve drilled down 9,101 m (!).

properties.name: EuroParcs Brunssummerheide
properties.description:
EuroParcs Brunssummerheide is located in Brunssum in south Limburg. You can walk from the holiday park right onto the Brunssummerheide. This nature reserve is characterised by hills, fens and various species of heather. The park has many things for the entire family to do. Swimming and fishing in the large pond, playing in the many playgrounds and cuddling with the goats in the petting zoo.

Luxury 12-person chalet

At EuroParcs Brunssummerheide you stay in one of the luxury accommodations for two up to twelve people. Will you choose a mobile home or a large chalet with several bedrooms? All chalets and mobile homes have their own toilet facilities and a kitchen that is equipped with all conveniences. The amenities at the park are there for all holidaymakers.

Swimming and jumping

There is no need for holidaymakers to get bored during their stay at EuroParcs Brunssummerheide. Naturally, the adjoining nature reserve is very inviting for cycling or hiking. If you did not take your own bicycles along, rent some from the park’s reception. You can choose from regular bicycles, e-bikes and children’s bicycles.

On summer days the swimming pond is the ideal place for hours of water fun. The beach has fun playground equipment and a bouncy castle. There is also enough room to sunbathe or find a spot in the shade. Fishing is permitted in the pond. During school holidays there is an extensive entertainment programme for children of all ages.

Limburg flan with a view

Enjoy a delicious meal at the park’s brasserie six days a week. The brasserie has a large terrace with a view of the natural pond, the countryside and the park. The restaurant is open for breakfast, lunch, dinner and, of course, for Limburg flan.

properties.name: Camping de la Cascade
properties.description:
In the Belgian Ardennes, on the banks of the river Amblève, you will find Camping La Cascade. This small, quiet campsite has a beautiful natural camping terrain. The touristic town of Coo, with its beautiful waterfall and nice terraces, is at walking distance from the campsite.

Lovely camping

The campsite is laid out on a grassy field on the banks of the river. Despite the proximity of the lively town of Coo, it is wonderfully quiet. On the car-free campsite, there are a few high trees here and there. However, you can also choose a spot in the full sun. There are fifty touring pitches, the most beautiful of which lie directly by the river. There are no permanent year-round pitches and there is only one mobile home for hire.

Dams and rapids

Camping La Cascade is situated on the banks of the Amblève. The water is not very deep and the current is not too strong near the campsite. Children can splash around, paddle and build dams in the river. Of course you can also swim. To explore the river with its rapids, waterfalls and wooded banks, a canoe or kayak is ideal. By the way, there are also a lot of trout in the river, good news for fishing enthusiasts.

Campfire and pizza

There are only a few playgrounds on the campsite, but children can have endless fun in and around the water. In bad weather, they can go to the bar for all kinds of games, books and even musical instruments. The fire pit on the terrace is often used for making a cosy campfire. In high season, you can bake your own pizza in the pizza oven.

properties.name: Camping de la Vall d'Àger
properties.description:
In rugged northern Spain, in the foothills of the Pyrenees, is the comfortable Camping de la Vall d'Agèr near the atmospheric mountain village of Agèr. As its name suggests, it is located in a valley between two mountain ranges. From the terraces, you have a lovely view over the valley. So enjoy it from your camping chair! Particularly for active campers and nature lovers, this campsite is highly recommended.

Stargazing from your terrace

The campsite is like an oasis among sun-drenched fields. Almond and olive trees provide the pitches with shade. Pitches are located on straight terraces on the elongated site. At the entrance, you will find the reception with restaurant and the sports field. On the other side of the site is the outdoor swimming pool. Driving past the entrance, you will enter the grounds with rental bungalows and hotel suites. These are set around a beautiful lawn in their own little park. From the balcony of the suites, you have an impressive view of the starry night sky.

Strolling in the village

It is only a few minutes’ walk to the mountain village of Agèr. Here you have a wide choice of restaurants, bars and shops. The campsite also offers several dining options, from a snack bar to a restaurant serving local produce. Prefer to eat at your tent? Then you can also pick something up.

Sporting challenge

The mountainous surroundings offer great hiking and climbing. For an intensive bike ride, rent an electric mountain bike on the campsite. And the real thrill-seeker can go paragliding or whitewater canoeing.

properties.name: Parque de Campismo Lagoa de Santo André
Camping de la Mer de Glace
Camping Village Lago Arsiè
properties.description:
Village Lago Arsiè is situated near the town of Arsiè (Belluno) directly on Lago di Corlo. The campsite is surrounded by greenery, large fields and generously vegetated rocky outcrops. If you are looking for peace and quiet on your holidays, this is the place for you. Yet it is also a popular family campsite, as the lake is ideal for swimming, fishing or boating. The campsite stands out for its simplicity and peacefulness.

Welcome to a restful campsite

When you drive to your pitch, you will immediately feel the tranquillity around you. Everything is well maintained and clean. The touring pitches are remarkably spacious. When it is not very busy, you can pick your own pitch. Don't feel like putting up your tent? You can then spend the night in one of the rental accommodation units.

Onto the lake!

Canoeing and sailing are the favourite pastimes on the lake. You can take an easy walk (on level surface) or go on a somewhat more sporty hike in the mountains. The lake is ideal for swimming. It can be reached via an access gate. The bank/beach consists of grass. Here you will find a beach volleyball field and a lawn with nice thick grass.

Lovely food

Camping Village Lago Arsiè has a fine restaurant. You can also have breakfast here. Furthermore, you can get a quick bite to eat in the snack bar or order a cool drink from the bar. The pizzeria is also great. A surprise is the pizzeria where the freshly-baked pizzas are taken from the oven in front of your eyes by the pizza baker.

properties.name: Camping Historische Mühle Vogelsang
properties.description:
