At Camping Historische Mühle Vogelsang you camp in a valley on the edge of the woods, close to the German municipality of Brodenbach. The quiet site has a view of the Ehrenburg castle and you set up your camping equipment on the banks of the Ehrbach river.

Open in the autumn as well

Camping Historische Mühle Vogelsang has 45 pitches. The spacious pitches in a meadow allow you to relax completely. Make the evening even more charming by lighting the barbecue or a campfire. If you prefer a little more luxury, you can also stay in one of the six rooms of the renovated barn or in the wooden log cabin. There are also several mobile homes with views of the woods.

Camping Historische Mühle Vogelsang is open 365 days a week, which makes it a wonderful place to stay in the autumn as well.

Herbs from its own mill garden

The campsite is small and basic, and yet it offers all you need for a nice, quiet camping holiday. The campsite has an extraordinary restaurant: a 450-year-old water mill. It serves home-made, local specialities with herbs that grow around the mill. Choose to enjoy breakfast or grab a delicious snack in between. The mill also has a beer garden, where you can relax in the sunshine.

The smallest campsite visitors have also been considered. They can have fun playing in the playground, bounce a ball on the table-tennis table or snuggle with all kinds of animals in the petting zoo.

properties.name: Capfun Camping La Licorne
properties.description:
Fancy a nice beach holiday just across the border? The French town of Dunkirk, full of history, is ideal for this. Walk directly from La Licorne Campsite via the dunes to the beach or stroll along the boulevard with an ice cream. Are you on your way to the ferry to Dover? Then this is also an excellent stopover for one or more days. The campsite is located on the outskirts of Dunkirk, and a bus stops in front of the entrance and takes you to the centre for free.

Via a dune path to the beach

The campsite's location is perfect for a beach holiday in any season. You can reach the beach easily and quickly via a nice path through the dunes. In summer, you will find many families who come here to enjoy a week's beach holiday. But even in the low season, it is ideal for getting a breath of fresh air by the sea or for taking a walk on the boulevard. Do you also want to swim outside the beach season? Then take a dip in Dunkirk's indoor swimming pool, which is located 3 kilometres from the campsite.

Sporty by the sea

There is no special entertainment for families with young children. There are two playgrounds, a recreation room, table tennis and a sports field. But with all the entertainment offered by the beach and the sea, there is plenty to do. You can surf, sup, blokart or kitesurf. You can also enjoy a visit to the harbour museum or the Tourville Shipyard where you can admire historic ships.

properties.name: Domaine du Lac de Soursac
properties.description:
Domaine du Lac de Soursac is one of those places where you feel at home straight away. You camp in the green heart of Corrèze, alongside beautiful Lac de Soursac. Want to escape the hustle and bustle for a while? Relaxation is guaranteed here. The pitches are all under tall trees. Or choose a cosy gîte overlooking the shimmering lake. With forests all around and plenty of space to relax or be active, this is a wonderful destination for campers who love peace and nature.

Camp or accommodation: always a great place to stay

At this small campsite, you’ll find large pitches and some rental accommodation. So, there’s always a pitch to suit you. Pitch your tent overlooking the water, park your motor home in the shade or choose the convenience of a chalet or gîte.

Flavours of Corrèze

Bring your swimming stuff because a dip in the adjacent lake is a must. This is a great place for very young campers to play too. They can head straight into the water from the slide. The friendly owners regularly organise fun activities, like walks in the area or archery. Don't fancy cooking? The restaurant at Domaine du Lac de Soursac makes life easy for you. The terrace overlooks the lake: it’s a great location for lunch, an ice-cream or dessert in the evening sun.

properties.name: La Clairière
properties.description:
Come and camp at the French campsite La Clairière. Here, you spend the night with views of Le Mont-Dore. The campsite is in the vicinity of Lac d'Aydat and the eponymous town of Aydat. This campsite is in the Auvergne, near the extinct volcano Puy de Dôme. The region is also known for its volcanoes, and it is a lovely area to go trekking and on hikes.

Spacious pitches and chalets

This quiet and simple campsite has spacious camping pitches (100 m2) for motorhomes, caravans and tents, but also special pitches and a shared chalet (dormitory) for walkers and cyclists. If you would rather stay in accommodation, choose a chalet, mobile home, safari tent or pod.

Lovely barbecues together

The heated, indoor swimming pool at Camping La Clairière is a wonderful place to start the day in the mornings or to cool off at the end of the afternoon. Please note: tight-fitting trunks are compulsory for men.

This lovely campsite also has a restaurant with a patio and a bar. You can also have a barbecue at the communal barbecue area.

At La Clairière you can enjoy activities such as fun themed evenings, wine tastings and yoga sessions in the high season. There is not a big entertainment team or shows, but there is a playground, jeu de boules court, ping pong table and a chess set. Interesting fact: the campsite is working on attaining La Clef Verte ecolabel certification, so they pay extra attention to environmentally friendly camping.

properties.name: Camping de Saint-Just Onlycamp
properties.description:
The Cantal department in the Auvergne region is one of France’s thinnest populated areas. Camping Municipal de Saint Just is centrally located in this region, in the middle of the friendly little village of Saint-Just. You can go for lots of lovely walks and bicycle rides in the hills of the surrounding area. This municipality campsite is run by a friendly young couple. In the high season you benefit from a heated swimming pool and an entertainment programme.

Authentic campsite with new toilet facilities

Tourist pitches dominate the campsite, with about two/thirds of these flat and shady grounds reserved for touring pitches. The toilet block was renovated in 2024. It also contains a fully equipped bathroom for the disabled. If you would rather have your own bathroom, book a stay in a wooden mobile home or chalet. Furthermore, there are several motorhome pitches available.

Enjoy the lovely outdoor swimming pool in the summer.

A beautiful outdoor swimming pool with heated water is located at the centre of the ground, open only during the summer holidays. For sports enthusiasts the campsite also has a multi-sports field, a tennis court and a table-tennis table. Various kinds of balls, rackets and bats can be borrowed from the reception, as well as board games and toys. During the high season, entertainment is provided for both children and adults and a food bus comes to the campsite daily with fresh bread and other groceries.

Explore the surrounding area

The region has a nice variety of wooded areas and meadows. The landscape around the Lac du Barrage de Grandval reservoir is also definitely worth a visit. Or visit the Viaduc de Garabit, a beautiful railway bridge (designed by none other than Gustave Eiffel) over the Truyère river.

properties.name: Le Sous Bois
properties.description:
Le Sous Bois Campsite is a small-scale family campsite located in Saint-Maurice-d'Ibie, in the heart of the Ardèche. The campsite is located in a natural, wild environment and is an ideal base for peace seekers and adventurers all year round.

Insane view

Opt for the comfort of one of the luxury mobile homes or studios. Or go for an authentic camping experience on a camping pitch with an amazing view of the Ibie Valley.

The sanitary facilities were completely refurbished in 2022 and offer clean and modern spaces.

Swimming in jade-coloured water

Enjoy a great view of the surrounding forests and hills from the swimming pools at Le Sous Bois Campsite. The children can have a great time in the separate children's pool.

You can also swim in clear jade-coloured natural water in the l'Ibie River, just 3 kilometres from the campsite.

Age is just a number

The campsite organises pétanque competitions, aqua fitness, water polo, beach volleyball and an exciting treasure hunt. The playground and the table tennis tables are ideal places for children to meet holiday friends.

Pizza and ice cream

You'll never be short on food and drink thanks to the snack bar-pizzeria and ice cream parlour. There are supermarkets and small shops in Saint-Maurice-d'Ibie (1.8 km away). You can also do some minor shopping at the campsite itself.

On a journey of discovery

Le Sous Bois is located near the famous Vallon-Pont-d'Arc and La Grotte Chauvet (19 km away), which is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Book a canoe trip on the Ardèche River at the reception or explore the area on your mountain bike.

properties.name: Campingpark Nabburg
properties.description:
The new and modern Campingpark Nabburg is in Bavaria, Germany. Surrounded by the beauty of nature, you camp next to an amazing swimming pool complex and close to the Naab river. It is ideal for those who love peace and quiet as well as water sports. The campsite has a self-check in and check out, but there is also someone at the reception to answer any questions you may have. The historic centre of Nabburg is three kilometres away.

Camping in a tiny house

At Campingpark Nabburg you can bring your own camping equipment or rent an accommodation. In addition to the usual touring pitches there is also a special field for tents. The pitches are level and grassy. The site also has various tiny houses that all have modern furnishings and air conditioning.

Swimming in the adjacent swimming pool

Right next to the campsite is a swimming pool complex with several outdoor swimming pools, a slide, diving boards and a large sunbathing area with shady areas. Be sure to take your beach towel, swimming costume and a good book! You can use this swimming pool for a fee. If swimming has made you hungry, the Italian restaurant ‘La Piscina’ is near the swimming pool.

Outdoor museum and canoes

The open-air museum Oberpfalz is only 2.2 kilometres away from the campsite. A walk through this open-air museum will give you a good impression of the life of farmers in the region in the 19th century. If you'd like to do something active, you can go on beautiful canoe trips on the nearby Naab river. The beautiful green surroundings are also suitable for hiking and cycling.

properties.name: Goldberg-Camping Mörslingen
properties.description:
Goldberg-Camping Mörslingen is a small, friendly family campsite in the centre of Bavaria. The campsite is in the municipality of Finningen and attracts campsite visitors who prefer peace and quiet and nature. The pitches, some of which are in the shade, are spacious and equipped with all necessary connections. The campsite has a swimming pool and clean toilet facilities. With Giengen an der Brenz (24 km), Nördlingen (34 km) and LEGOLAND Deutschland (34 km) in the area, there is enough for everyone to do in the vicinity.

Personal service and spacious pitches

When you arrive at the campsite, you will be welcomed personally by the Dußling family and invited to find your pitch. You can choose a pitch that is between 70 and 90 square metres. The pitches are equipped with connections for water, sewerage and electricity. Because the site is surrounded by trees, there are also shady pitches. If you have questions during your stay, the friendly owners are always happy to be of service.

Small but beautiful

Goldberg-Camping Mörslingen has modern toilet facilities, with a recently renovated building and automatic taps. To cool off on hot days, there is an outdoor swimming pool 8x4 metres in size. Those who want to cook outdoors can use the barbecues and the necessary accessories. The nearby farm shop sells basic shopping items, such as fresh eggs and pasta. Wifi is available for a small fee.

properties.name: Camping du Lion d'Angers Onlycamp
properties.description:
If you are looking for a good starting point for wonderful bicycle rides through the French countryside, Camping du Lion d'Angers Onlycamp, in the village with the same name and along the Oudon river, is an excellent option. This campsite is suitable for a longer stay but is also good as a stopover for cycling tourists following the long-distance bicycle route La Vélo Francette. A lot of equestrian enthusiasts also come to this campsite, which is located right across from a large racecourse. Camping du Lion d'Angers Onlycamp is also known for being quiet, small-scale and having friendly owners.

Well-kept touring pitches and mobile homes

This neatly kept campsite has two options for accommodations. You can stay overnight in a modern mobile home or on a spacious pitch in a green setting. Some touring pitches are specifically for tents (handy for those on a cycling or walking holiday), while other pitches are for campsite visitors with a caravan or motorhome. Are you planning to stay overnight at Camping du Lion d'Angers Onlycamp with your dog? If you stay at least one week, when you arrive, you will receive a special doggy package with dog waste bags, snacks and a toy.

Sporty entertainment and fun theme nights

Sports enthusiasts can have the time of their lives at and around this campsite. There are options for volleyball and badminton. There is also a mooring place for canoes and kayaks, making it the ideal home base for a boat trip on the Oudon river. Two hundred metres away you will find a fun playground while the campsite itself has a recreational hall with party games. Entertainment, for example, fun themed nights with music and wine, is organised regularly in July and August.

properties.name: Camping-Caravaning La Forêt
properties.description:
The La Forêt campsite and caravan site is a small-scale family campsite in a convenient location in the Vendée. A beautiful forest path of four hundred meters separates the campsite from a wide sandy beach. This campsite has a peaceful atmosphere. Furthermore, this campsite has a wide variety of trees and plants, a modern heated swimming pool with jacuzzi, a luxury sanitary building and neat camping pitches.

Fine camping

When you walk or drive to your pitch, you soon notice that this is a small-scale campsite with a friendly atmosphere. The grounds are beautifully landscaped and there is a wide variety of trees and shrubs. The pitches are well maintained and separated from each other by hedges and trees, which is a nice way to achieve some privacy.

Ideal for those seeking peace and quiet

Thanks to its natural and small-scale character, this campsite is ideal for people seeking peace and quiet. They tend to come in the off-season. In July and August, families with (young) children know exactly where to find this campsite. Nevertheless, the relaxed atmosphere is maintained, partly due to the campsite's quiet-time rule between 11 pm and 8 am.

Modern swimming pool with jacuzzi

In 2020, a new, heated swimming pool was constructed at the campsite. This is a nice pool in a mostly sunny spot, though there are also shady spots. The showpiece of the pool area is the Jacuzzi. In addition, at the campsite, you will find a small playground, recreation room, bowling alley and table tennis table.

Where can you get food?

La Forêt offers fresh bread and some groceries. In the high season, you can also buy some take-away food. Want to get a bit more shopping done? Then it's best to head off to the supermarkets in Notre-Dame-de-Monts (1.5 km).

properties.name: Camping Le Balcon de la Baie
Camping Langstone Manor Park
properties.description:
Langstone Manor Park is a top campsite in the UK for anyone who enjoys nature and tranquillity. You will camp on the south-west side of the impressive Dartmoor National Park, in the heart of a quiet, nature-rich area. Want to relax? Or head off on long treks through the typical English landscape? Both are possible here. Facilities are top-notch as well and include a restaurant in an old mansion and a small campsite shop.

Camping or luxury accommodation

At Langstone, you choose your camping experience. There are large grassy and paved pitches for tents, caravans and motor homes. Want a little more comfort? Book a mobile home, a cosy camping pod or a glamping pod with all mod cons included. There are also large holiday homes and flats for families or groups of friends. Many pitches have a patio with beautiful views of the hills.

Well-maintained facilities

The facilities are top notch. In the old mansion, there’s a cosy restaurant where delicious food is served in the evenings. Your dog is welcome too. The toilet and washing blocks are spotless and well maintained. For your daily shopping and freshly baked bread, head to the small campsite shop. Children can play in the safe playground. So, you don't have to worry about anything and can enjoy your holiday to the full.

In the heart of nature and history

Its location in Dartmoor National Park makes it perfect for walking and cycling. Tavistock (5 km) and Princetown (11.5 km) are nearby and have cosy markets and quaint shops. Fancy a dip in the sea? The north and south coasts of the peninsula are within an hour's drive.

properties.name: Flower Camping Le Val de la Marquise
properties.description:
The Perigord Noir, a beautiful part of the Dordogne known for hills, forests, caves and medieval villages, is a wonderful holiday destination for families. Le Val de la Marquise Campsite provides a peaceful base from which to discover this region. Children are prioritised at the campsite. In summer, the animation team is ready for small-scale and fun activities.

Spacious and shady

The pitches extend far back onto the wooded and spacious grounds. If you're at the front, you'll be at the bar and pool within a few steps. All sites are spacious and look neat. Most pitches are clearly separated for privacy.

Luxury Cooling

Swimming or relaxing on the sunbed overlooking the green valley? The compact pool is in a sunny, open part of the campsite. There is also a shallow pool for toddlers, and around it is comfortable sunbeds to doze off in the sun. Another fishing pond with a small sandy beach under the trees is by the stream.

Eating pizza at the Tiki bar

The Tiki bar offers a small menu that includes pizza. Snacks are also available in the afternoon. You overlook the playground from the cosy terrace, which is a lively centrepiece of the campsite. There is also a small store.

Fun in the tepee

There is plenty for children to do at the campsite. But the Kids' Club is the icing on the cake. Indoor activities, such as crafts and playing games, take place in a real American Indian tepee. Outside, people can dance in the mini-disco, and the bouncy castle is also a big favourite among young campers. Older children can join a canoe trip or an exciting night swimming session.

properties.name: Camping les Poutiroux
properties.description:
Camping les Poutiroux is a small-scale campsite in the Dordogne. The campsite is situated in the rolling hills of the Périgord. Here you'll find total peace and quiet on a sheltered campsite with spacious, shady touring pitches. Here you can enjoy a quiet camping holiday in the Dordogne in all privacy. With a heated swimming pool and paddling pool, jeu de boules court and a playground, there's also plenty of room for fun.

Campsite of peace and shade

They have a soothing effect, the hills of the Dordogne. On the campsite you'll find the same peace that the surroundings exude. The 26 touring pitches are spacious and receive plenty of shade from dense trees and shrubs. As a result, you will be camping on a spot with a lot of privacy, in the middle of nature. In addition to the touring pitches, there are 23 rental accommodations. Most of them are well maintained mobile homes, but you can also camp in a lodge tent without sanitary facilities.

Heated swimming pool and paddling pool

The swimming pool is located to the right of the campsite entrance, on a slightly higher part. It may not be necessary because the pool is in the sun, but it is heated. So in colder days you can take a warm dip. Next to the rectangular pool, which is surrounded by sun loungers, is the heated paddling pool.

Shop and restaurant

The yellow main building not only houses the reception, but also a small shop and a restaurant. The outside may look old and authentic, the interior is modern looking. Here you can go for a snack, a pizza, but also for breakfast. Of course, fresh bread and baguettes are not lacking.

properties.name: Camping Domaine Du Lac
properties.description:
Camping Domaine Du Lac is located in Plazac in the heart of Dordogne. For forty years now, this traditional French campsite has been run by the same family, giving it a charming atmosphere where everyone soon feels at home. In the high season, this campsite is the stage for cheerful family fun, while the quiet low season forms an oasis of serenity, perfect for seniors looking to relax.

Camping with space and privacy

At Camping Domaine Du Lac, you enjoy a charming, small-scale setting. Whether you prefer your own tent, trailer tent, caravan or motorhome or choose for a comfortable mobile home or chalet, you will experience the perfect mix of space, privacy and friendliness. The pitches are spacious (at least 100 m²) and shady, surrounded by green hedges, enabling everyone to enjoy their own pitch.

Swimming and fun in the lake

Splash in the refreshing swimming pool, or dive into the lovely lake. There are fun extras for kids, like an inflatable slide and trampoline in the water, so they won’t get bored, while you read a book on the sandy beach. People who love to fish can undertake a fishing adventure on the lake.

Explore the beautiful surroundings of Dordogne

Explore the beauty of Dordogne from Camping Domaine Du Lac, located in the centre of the Périgord Noir. The surrounding area is perfect for hiking and cycling. With the car, it is easy to reach places of interest such as the famous caves of Lascaux (15 km) and various charming villages.

properties.name: ClicoChic Camping Lou Castel
properties.description:
Camping Lou Castel is just outside the town of Castelnaud-la-Chapelle in the southeast of the Dordogne. Castelnaud is mainly known for its impressive medieval castle that towers above the centre. In any case, you will find numerous picturesque towns and photogenic castles in the Dordogne. If you want to admire some of these, this campsite is a perfect departure point. From Lou Castel, you can reach tourist attractions such as Saint-Cyprien, Belvès, Beynac-et-Cazenac and the famous Sarlat-la-Canéda in 30 minutes by car at the most. Furthermore, you can take wonderful forest walks and mountain bike trips in the direct vicinity. This campsite is ideal for families with children, especially in the high season.

Book a spacious touring pitch or stay in a lovely mobile home

You will find the reception right by the campsite entrance. The tourist pitches take up about half the site. If you decide to book a pitch at Camping Lou Castel, a neatly demarcated pitch on grass awaits you. The other half of this campsite has various types of accommodation. You can spend the night in a mobile home, lodge tent or a charming motor home.

Lots of water fun in the aqua park

You will find two heated indoor swimming pools, one with a retractable roof. Between both swimming pools, there are three water slides you can whizz down. And the youngest campers? They will have lots of fun in the large paddling pool, where the water sprays, fountains and small slides allow them to have fun and play in the shallow water. Everyone staying at the campsite can go to this swimming pool for free.

properties.name: Camping Le Lieu / Bar-Food & Camp
properties.description:
The rurally situated campsite Maissonneuve is situated near St.Jory-de-Chalais in the Dordogne-Vert. The friendly owners will warmly welcome you on their well-maintained campsite with its tranquil atmosphere. The camping guests are from various countries with the common interest of camping in peace and quiet. There are many castles, caves and beautiful towns in the area.

Spacious camping in the shade

The 46 lovely, demarcated camping pitches are relatively large and shaded by trees, but there are also sunny camping pitches. A pitch measures 100 m2 on average and has access to electricity. Some pitches have their own water tap. You can also spend the night in beautifully furnished chalets or in a mobile home.

French kitchen

At the French restaurant Au Château d’Eau, named after the nearby water tower, frequent use is made of regional products. You can therefore be assured of traditional, French dishes. You can enjoy your meal in the tastefully renovated 19th century barn or outside on the terrace. In high season you can join other camping guests for paella or for a barbecue.

Sport and games

There is ample space on the campsite to play and exercise (table tennis, tennis, jeu-de-boule). You can enjoy a swim in the lovely swimming pool (14 x 7 m). There is also a private sauna. There is some playground equipment for children, but they can also enjoy themselves in the recreation centre. For a fee you can go pony riding and horse riding in the area. The Touroulet river, where you can follow a nature trail, runs approximately half a km from the camping. Camping guests are allowed to use the private fish pond.

properties.name: Vimmerby
properties.description:
Welcome to Vimmerby Camping, a child-friendly campsite nestled in the heart of the Kalmar County countryside in Sweden. Here, you’ll be camping on the northern shore of the idyllic Lake Nossen. Tranquillity and open spaces are in abundance, but there’s also plenty to keep you entertained. You can swim in the lake, go for a walk or a cycle, or simply relax by the water: it’s all possible here. Dogs are also more than welcome.

Camping with a view of the sea

The camping pitches are spread across several grassy fields, each with its own atmosphere. There are pitches with electricity and, where available, water connections for added comfort. Fancy waking up to a view of the lake? Then choose a pitch right on the shore. The site also features stugas and bungalows in various sizes. Practically furnished and ideal for those who like to combine camping with convenience.

Relax in the sauna by the water

Vimmerby Camping is fully equipped for a carefree holiday. Children can burn off some energy at the playgrounds or on the sandy and grassy beach by the lake. The calm waters are perfect for canoeing, stand-up paddleboarding or a trip in an electric boat. A special highlight is the sauna on the water: warm up first, then take a refreshing dip in the lake. After an active day, head to the restaurant and enjoy a meal outside overlooking the water.

Immerse yourself in Swedish life

Discover Astrid Lindgren’s World (4.5 km), a magical outing for families with young children. The surrounding area offers beautiful nature, moose parks and a narrow-gauge railway between Västervik and Hultsfred (23 km).

properties.name: Camping de Keralouet
properties.description:
Camping de Keralouet is a quiet, small-scale campsite with a stylish outdoor swimming pool. The white sandy beaches on the Atlantic Ocean, where you can surf, sail and snorkel,are about a ten minute walk from the reception. Half of the well-maintained campsite consists of rental accommodation. Swimming lessons are given in the heated outdoor pool.

Clean and quiet

The small campsite is clean and quiet. The pitches are smallish and close to each other. There are 27 touring pitches and 23 rental accommodations scattered around the terrain. You can rent a mobile home, chalet or family tent. Hedges, trees and shrubs provide the necessary shade and shelter.

Swimming pool

As the campsite is a small and quiet there is little to do for older children. There is no entertainment programme, playground, recreation room or sports field. However, there is a new outdoor swimming pool opposite the entrance. It is beautifully landscaped, but not too big. For the little ones there is a separate paddling pool, like the large pool it is also heated.

White sandy beaches

From reception you can walk to the beach in less than ten minutes. There you dive into the beautiful blue water of the Atlantic Ocean. There are a lot of water sports possibilities: you can snorkel, sail and surf.

Food trucks and ice creams

In the morning you can get fresh bread, baguettes and croissants at reception. There is also a small bar where you can get drinks and ice creams. You don’t want to cook every night? In high season several food trucks come to the campsite every week..

properties.name: Camping Les Charmes
properties.description:
Camping Les Charmes is a small campsite in the Vendée, near the Lac d'Apremont. You'll camp here in the French countryside, twenty kilometres from the Atlantic Ocean. On the very spacious, sheltered touring pitches on the park-like grounds, you'll be able to completely unwind. Need some extra relaxation? Take a massage at the wellness centre.

Very spacious touring pitches

The campsite looks like a park. Wide gravel and sandy paths take you over the green terrain to the very spacious touring pitches and well-kept mobile homes. The touring pitches are situated on lawns, delimited by hedges and trees. This gives you a nice sheltered pitch with a lot of privacy, which makes it extra calm on the already quiet campsite. Something the guests of camping Les Charmes appreciate.

Swimming pool, lake, ocean

Near the reception, at the front of the campsite, you’ll find the indoor swimming pool. This heated swimming pool, equipped with a paddling pool, is ideal for small children. Would you like it a little bigger? About four kilometres south of the campsite, the river Vie flows into the Lac d'Apremont. There you can lie down on a beach and take a dip in the natural water, but it is also possible to take a boat on the vast lake. The ocean and its beach are at 20 kilometres from the campsite.

Totally zen

Camping at Les Charmes is relaxing enough for many people, but you can add a little more. In the wellness centre you'll become totally zen. Let yourself be pampered with a massage, or let the bubbles do the work in the whirlpool. You can sweat it out in the sauna.

properties.name: Hôtellerie de Plein Air Les Playes
properties.description:
Hôtellerie de Plein Air Les Playes is located in the South of France, on the Côte d'Azur. This small terraced campsite consists for the most part of rental accommodation, but there are also touring pitches and campervan pitches available. The campsite is laid out on a slope, at the edge of a forest. The beautiful sandy beaches and the pleasant promenade on the Bay of Sanary are just two kilometres from the campsite.

Terraced campsite

The wooded campsite is laid out in terraces, with a considerable difference in height between them. The paths are steep and winding. Not all pitches are equally easy to reach. The largest part of the campsite is occupied by mobile homes. In addition to the seventy rental accommodations, there are also nineteen touring pitches and fifteen campervan pitches available.

Considerable climb

Many campers use Hôtellerie de Plein Air Les Playes as a transit campsite and only stay one night. This can be particularly useful in the low season, because the campsite is open all year round. Because of the sloping terrain Les Playes is not very suitable for disabled campers.

Swimming pool in the sun

At the entrance of the campsite there is a heated outdoor swimming pool in full sun. It is beautifully landscaped and has a separate paddling pool. Around it is a tiled sundeck, which like the rest of the campsite is laid out in terraces. In the low season you can also swim as the swimming pool is open from the end of March to the end of October.

New snack bar

The campsite's new snack bar is open in July and August. You can enjoy breakfast, drinks, ice creams, pizzas and takeaway food. The bar offers themed evenings and entertainment. Outside the high season, all these facilities are closed.

properties.name: Camping An de Waterkant
properties.description:
Camping An de Waterkant is in a rural area, just outside of Westerdeichstrich in the Dithmarschen (Sleeswijk-Holstein) region. You camp right on the beach here. You can walk over mudflats or cycle over the dike. This quiet campsite is surrounded by vast farmlands.

What accommodation options are there?

The grounds of this campsite are large yet surveyable, and neatly kept. Fixed annual pitches dominate here, but there is plenty of room for touring campsite visitors too. The average pitch at Camping An de Waterkant is spacious with an open character. You can also book a stay in a charming camping pod, which can hold a maximum of two adults.

Mudflats and water sports

There is a shop by the reception where you can order rolls for your breakfast. It also has a terrace, where you can relax and enjoy a drink. Another big plus of this campsite is that it is close to the beach. Just cross the road and the dike and you are there. This beach borders on an enormous tidal area of the Wadden Sea. At high tide various water sports are possible, and at low tide you can go for an amazing (guided) walk over drying mudflats and sandbanks.

Cycling and hiking

The campsite is an excellent home base for beautiful hikes and bicycle rides in the vicinity. For example, cycle over the dike along the Wadden Sea. If you travel a few kilometres south along the dike, you will enter the lovely village of Büsum. Admire the picturesque harbour, the beautiful lighthouse and the seal sanctuary.

properties.name: Autocamp Planik
properties.description:
This small-scale campsite with a typical Croatian character is only 20 kilometres from the city of Zadar. Autocamp Planik is slightly hidden in a small, quiet hamlet within walking distance of the Adriatic Sea. The charming fishing village of Ražanac is also close by. The region of Dalmatia is known as a quiet and authentic region of Croatia. This is a spectacular spot in the middle of a forest for people seeking quiet. Here, you camp amid the pine trees. A pleasant atmosphere combined with the beauty of the surrounding area ensure for plenty of relaxation.

Camping in Dalmatia

Dalmatia is a versatile region in Croatia, located in the south of the country. The relatively small strip of coast near Autocamp Planik has not yet been discovered by large groups of tourists and is therefore still authentic. Yet you can go on lovely excursions, such as visiting the island of Pag. From the campsite, you have views of the Velebit mountain range, a unique walking destination in Croatia.

Surrounded by trees

What instantly stands out on the slightly sloping site is the many trees that have canopies offering adequate shade. The flowers also make it a lovely area. All pitches are spacious but differ in size. Both toilet blocks look well kept. You can also stay in a mobile home if you wish. It's lovely sitting under the covered patio with wooden benches, and there is a communal barbecue for those who want to use it. There is a large supermarket for daily groceries in the village.

properties.name: Camping Puchner
properties.description:
The basic and rurally located Campsite Puchner lies on the Danube, in the town of Feldkirchen. The immediate surroundings are green and flat. Many cyclists visit the Upper Austria region and like to follow the beautiful routes along the well-known river. Adjacent to the campsite you will find a golf course and also the four so-called Badeseen, four lakes which are ideal for swimming.

Your pitch

The thirty touring pitches are spacious, although they vary in size. You camp here on a beautiful grass surface. The facilities are basic, but fine. There is no rental accommodation available for tourists. The permanent pitches are fully booked, mainly by Dutch and German guests.

Golfing or swimming?

Adjacent to the campsite, on the Danube cycle route, are the four so-called Badeseen. They are only a short walk away (100 m). There are beaches, beach showers and sunbathing lawns. The four lakes are small and have different features each. Please note that local residents also like to visit the lakes, especially on weekends. Do not feel like swimming? There is a beautiful golf course next to the campsite.

Romantic river

Camping along the Danube ... that almost certainly means hiking or cycling too. The Danube is a beautiful, romantic river with a rich history. Also visit Linz, with its many shops, restaurants and terraces. And, of course, the golf course (Golfclub Donau Freizeitland Linz), which is directly adjacent to the campsite, beckons.

properties.name: Camping Al Comu
properties.description:
Campsite Al Comu is situated on a cork tree-covered hillside in the Pyrénées-Orientales department, just outside the lovely Catalonian village of Llauro. The campsite is situated in a very peaceful area with few tourists. The coast, however, is nearby, where you will find beautiful beaches such as the one at Argelès-Plage. In this mountainous coastal area, you will also find many places where you can enjoy spectacular panoramic views both along the coast and further inland.

View of the mountain landscape

You reach the pitches via a partly paved road which makes a loop over the campsite grounds. The camping pitches are reasonably clearly marked and are situated on a paved surface. Some pitches have plenty of shade, others have more sunshine. The most beautiful pitches are located along the eastern edge of the campsite. They offer the most privacy and the best views of Thuir and Perpignan.

Basic amenities

The amenities on the campsite are very basic. The sanitary facilities, for example, are not very modern but they are clean. People wishing to dine out can do so in Llauro. Here, you will find a fine restaurant that serves local wines and cooks for the campsite guests every week. Would you prefer a little more variety? Then you can drive to Thuir or Céret. You can also do all your grocery shopping there.

Flashlight

In the low season, there are many Dutch campers on the campsite. The campsite is very quiet in the preseason. Make sure you have a good flashlight because there is no lighting on the campsite at night. The darkness ensures that you will enjoy a wonderful night's sleep, though.

properties.name: Camping Le Clupeau
properties.description:
In the heart of the green Dordogne, you'll be camping at this campsite in a natural setting away from the crowds, but next to a small village. Within a few steps, you will find yourself on the beach on the river with lots of trees, where children can swim and play nicely at the small reservoir. The area around Camping Le Clupeau is known for its many attractions, such as old villages, caves, castles and play parks. Hiking and cycling enthusiasts will be in the right place, because there are no less than 120 kilometres of marked trails around the campsite.

Camping by the water in the Dordogne

Following a rural road south of the Périgord-Limousin Natural Regional Park, you will arrive at the campsite's entrance by the water. The attentive owners will welcome you, and at the front of the campsite you will find the terrace, the playground and the reception. A walk to the nearby village of Cherveix-Cubas is a pleasant outing if you want to stretch your legs.

Privacy and quiet

Peace and quiet are the key words at the campsite. And this is reflected in the 33 beautiful demarcated pitches surrounded by numerous trees and shrubs. That means both pleasantly shaded sites for a tent, campervan or caravan and plenty of privacy. Right on the waterfront, you'll find the most appealing pitches, but the spots in the midfield also look neat and spacious. You also camp there if you rent a mobile home. There is a sanitary block that looks very clean and modern.

properties.name: Camping Erden
properties.description:
Camping Erden is a beautifully situated campsite on the banks of the Moselle river, not far from Erden and Bernkastel-Kues (Rheinland-Pfalz). This region is famous for its wonderful Rhine and Moselle valleys. Enjoy the river and the passing boats, the beautiful historical towns, the impressive castles and, of course, the countless vineyards, wine tastings and lively wine festivals. This campsite will immediately help you appreciate the beautiful landscape: many pitches offer wonderful views of the vineyards on the other side of the river.

Well equipped

Right in front of you, you will find the seasonal pitches. The touring pitches are located on a large camping field further down on the right-hand side. They are accessible via a paved road, Interspersed with the odd tree. The grounds look well-cared for and you have a beautiful panoramic view almost everywhere you go.

Beautiful pitches by the Moselle river

The camping pitches are not demarcated, but they are numbered. They have a grass surface and provide sufficient space. The most beautiful spots are located right on the banks of the Moselle river. The sanitary facilities are clean, but not very modern. Dogs are welcome at campsite Erden. There is even a separate playing and training field for your faithful four-legged friend.

Swimming in the river

You will not find a swimming pool at this campsite, but you can go swimming in the river. There is also a restaurant with a conservatory where you can sit in comfort. The light menu offers good food. A small shop is located in the reception building. Visit Bernkastel for a larger selection of supplies.

properties.name: Campingplatz unterm Dilsberg
properties.description:
This German campsite is located in the bend of Neckar river, 35 kilometres from Mannheim. The basic campsite was taken over by new owners in 2023. Although there is still work in progress to improve the campsite, the toilet facilities have been renovated, there are new pitches and there is a new ‘Campsite butler’. The latter is a machine with which the toilet cassette of your motorhome or caravan is cleaned automatically. Very gratifying for a comfortable camping experience!

Plenty of peace and quiet and the sounds of nature

This campsite in Baden-Württemberg has about one hundred pitches. There are no accommodations. The road to the campsite is narrow. Take the arrival time (after 14:00) and departure time (before 12:00) into account so as to avoid oncoming traffic. Campingplatz unterm Dilsberg is in a lovely green setting with a view of at least four different castle ruins. There is also a bicycle path along the campsite, which makes it an ideal home base for wonderful bicycle rides. From your pitch you can enjoy plenty of peace and quiet as well as the sounds of nature.

The campsite’s toilet block has underfloor heating, which makes showering more pleasant on colder days. Or you can warm up in front of the fire in the sitting room.

Swimming in the river

The campsite is on the Neckar river, where you can go swimming, standup paddleboarding and canoeing. There is a private jetty and a boat ramp. If you are a boat enthusiast, you can admire the boats in the nearby lock (500 metres). Campingplatz unterm Dilsberg does not have a swimming pool, but there is a swimming pool half an hour away in Sinsheim.

properties.name: Touristencamp Entenfarm
properties.description:
Touristencamp Entenfarm is near the town of Hohnstein, on the German side of the Elbe Sandstone Mountains. This campsite borders the Sächsische Schweiz National Park and is an ideal starting point for lovely day trips through this impressive nature area. The campsite itself is small scale and quiet by nature. The flower-filled site at this campsite is neatly maintained by the friendly campsite team.

Open camping pitches

If you like a small-scale campsite with an open character, then this is the place for you. At Touristencamp Entenfarm, you can book an overnight stay on a spacious pitch or in a pleasant camping hut. In both cases, you stay on a sunny camping field without much demarcation between the pitches.

Order your daily breakfast from the campsite kiosk

In the main building there is a small shop where you can buy basic necessities, camping equipment and regional products. You can also get delicious ice cream and drinks at the kiosk at Touristencamp Entenfarm. You can sit down on the small patio beside it. Furthermore, you can collect freshly baked bread rolls every day for breakfast from 8 am.

Enjoy the imposing natural beauty of Saxon Switzerland

This campsite borders the north-eastern outskirts of the Sächsische Schweiz National Park. The Bastei Bridge is one of the absolute highlights of this mountainous nature area. This is a series of remarkable rock formations that tower high above the landscape. Another popular attraction is the impressive Königstein Fortress. Furthermore, this is a good starting point for day trips to lovely places such as Stolpen (14 km) and Dresden (49 km).

properties.name: Camping Landidyll
properties.description:
Camping Landidyll is an idyllic camping destination on the outskirts of the spa town of Bad Lausick in Saxony, Germany. You'll camp on a small, quiet campsite among sprawling fruit orchards. There are well-maintained toilet and washing facilities, beautiful nature around the corner and you can take a cultural trip to Leipzig.

Large camping pitches

You will find inviting camping pitches scattered across Camping Landidyll. The pitches, with an average size of about 100 square metres, have a grass surface. There’s room here for both tents and caravans and you can choose your own pitch. Dogs are welcome too. The campsite gives very easy access to the surrounding nature.

Peace and simplicity

This campsite is particularly popular with people who love peace and quiet. So, don’t expect extensive facilities or entertainment. The campsite doesn’t have a swimming pool, but the large Bad Lausick pool complex is close by (4 km) for a swim and relaxing sauna. On the campsite itself, there’s a bread-roll service, a small kiosk and the option to rent bikes. There’s a playground for children.

Hit the road and discover Saxony

Bad Lausick is 2 km from the campsite; it has various restaurants and shops. Fans of walking and cycling have plenty of options. For example, in the Colditzer Forst or around Lake Bockwitzer See. Prefer a day in the city? That’s possible too! From Bad Lausick, you can catch a direct train to Leipzig (38 km). Dresden (98 km) is close by for a cultural day out as well.

properties.name: Haarstubencampingplatz Reingers
properties.description:
If you would like to enjoy your holiday in a quiet spot in an unspoiled nature area, then Haarstubencampingplatz Reingers, right next to the village of Reingers in the Waldviertel in Austria, is an ideal destination. This campsite is located in a non-touristy section of the Lower Austria state, a couple of hundred metres from the Czech border. You can go on wonderful hikes, cycling and enjoy the peace and quiet in this region. The campsite is right next to a lake where you can go swimming.

Small-scale campsite with open camping meadows

This campsite has clearly laid out grounds with gravelled paths leading to the small-scale camping meadows. All in all, there are several dozen spacious touring pitches, most of which are separated from one other by green bushes. In addition, almost every pitch at Haarstubencampingplatz Reingers is in the sun.

Plenty of entertainment at Hanfdorf Reingers

Haarstubencampingplatz Reingers is about 150 metres from the Hanfdorf Reingers recreation area. This is convenient because Hanfdorf has a fun playground with a climbing wall, a mountain bike course and a charming restaurant with a cafe. There is also a large sunbathing area at the Müllerteich pond, where you can go for a refreshing swim in the summertime. The sunbathing area also has showers and a beach volleyball court.

Ideal holiday address for hiking and cycling enthusiasts

If you are looking for a campsite that will serve as a starting point for great hiking and cycling trips, you are in the right place here. You can go on many lovely walks from the campsite. For example, follow the wood-paths around Müllerteich. The woods connect to a vast forested area that continues for many kilometres right into the Czech Republic.

properties.name: Kolpa Resort glamping
properties.description:
In the southeastern part of Slovenia, a few kilometres from the Croatian border, lies Camping Kolpa Resort Glamping. You camp in a mountainous, wooded area in the tourist region of Bela Krajina (White Carniola). The small, ecological campsite is a beautiful place for a relaxed (glamping) holiday in Slovenia. Enjoy the tranquillity, go for a swim in the swimming pond and eat in the campsite restaurant.

Luxury safari tents or wooden chalets

At the campsite, you can choose a pitch or a luxury accommodation. You camp on grass and all pitches at the campsite are the same size. If you love glamping, you have come to the right spot. You stay in a luxury safari tent or a wooden chalet with its own bathroom. The safari tent is the best of two worlds. You experience the free feeling of camping and do indeed sleep under tent canvas, but in a comfortable bed and with a kitchen and bathroom. All accommodations have their own terrace with outdoor furniture.

Dive into the natural pool

At Kolpa Resort Glamping you spend your holiday close to nature. The central point of the campsite is the natural pool. The clear water invites you to go for a refreshing swim. Swim in the fresh water and enjoy the beautiful view of the surrounding hills and valleys. The restaurant, where you can enjoy an extensive meal, is right next to the swimming pool. The majority of the ingredients come from the vegetable garden that is also located on the campsite grounds. Children can amuse themselves in the natural playground or on the bicycle track. There is also a multi-functional playing field for campsite visitors who love sports.

properties.name: Ylseröd-Camping
properties.description:
On the Swedish west coast, close to the Norwegian border, lies Ylseröd-Camping. It is on a bay of the Baltic Sea, in a beautiful green area in the Västra Götalands Län region. This is where you can relax completely in the countryside. Go for a refreshing swim in the sea or the swimming pool. Catch crabs or fish and get out to enjoy the surrounding area. Strömstad, where the ferry departs for the Koster Islands, is a ten-minute drive away (9.5 km). Norway’s capital city Oslo (127 km) is about one and a half hours away.

Camping in a wooded area

Ylseröd-Camping is in a wooded, hilly area. Camp in a relaxed atmosphere, without demarcated pitches, with a few pitches that overlook the Baltic Sea. Campsite visitors without their own camping equipment stay in wooden chalets that are distributed throughout the campgrounds and have their own terrace. The chalets have a kitchen, bathroom and dining table.

Relax by the water

You can swim in the campsite’s heated outdoor swimming pool or in the sea. Sun loungers surround the swimming pool, allowing you to relax completely. The sea guarantees hours of pleasure. There are options to go kayaking, fish off the campsite’s jetty and there is even a small harbour for people with boats. The youngest guests can live it up in the playground or on the bouncy castle while the sports enthusiasts can enjoy the volleyball court or go for long walks in the beautiful countryside. The surrounding area offers a nice contrast with its cliffs, wooded areas and charming fishing villages.

properties.name: Flower Camping le Tiradou
properties.description:
The Dordogne has been a popular holiday destination for years. And the Périgord Noir is regarded as one of the most beautiful areas of the Dordogne. Flower Camping le Tiradou is located in the heart of the Périgord Noir, close to the Dordogne River and just a 15-minute drive from the beautiful medieval town of Sarlat-la-Canéda. The campsite itself attracts campers from around the world. It also features an outdoor swimming pool, a cafeteria and a small shop.

Small-scale campsite with neat camping pitches

Three types of tourist camping pitches are available on this fairly small-scale campsite. These are spacious pitches separated by neat hedges. In addition, there are beautiful mobile homes, holiday homes and lodge tents for rent.

Swim and splash around in the heated outdoor swimming pool

At Flower Camping le Tiradou, you can go for a dip in the beautiful outdoor swimming pool. This pool's water is heated, so you can enjoy a nice swim even on less sunny days. The youngest campers can romp around in the large paddling pool.

Fun activities during the summer months

Fun activities are regularly organised at this campsite during high season. For example, there's a special children's entertainment team along with regular live music performances and themed meals in the evenings. In addition, the campsite features table tennis and a pétanque court. There is a fun playground for children.

Order a tasty meal at the cafeteria

There's an attractive cafeteria located behind the reception. Here you can pick up pizzas, burgers and fries, among other things. You can also enjoy a fresh breakfast here in the morning. There's also a cosy campsite bar where ice cream, pancakes, waffles and tasty drinks are served.

properties.name: Camping Beau Rivage
properties.description:
Camping Beau Rivage is situated at the foot of the fortress walls of medieval Navarrenx. Here you will camp in the Pyrenees, on a campsite full of flowers and shrubs. Everything on this campsite makes it a friendly campsite in the South of France: the spacious pitches in nature, the warm-hearted owners and the beautiful location.

A camping pitch for everyone

There is a pitch for everyone on this campsite. Are you coming with a larger motor home? Then the paved pitches are ideal. Here you can enjoy your privacy. You can pitch your tent or caravan on the spacious lawns. On these pitches, you are in the middle of nature. Surrounded by trees and bushes, these are lovely spots. Sit down on a camping chair and enjoy the peace and quiet and the greenery. On every pitch, you can sit in the shade of a tree.

Swimming in the Gave

Swimming, kayaking, fishing: it's all possible at Beau Rivage. The river Gave flows right next to the campsite. Take a run and dive into the water! It's a great place to swim. Or rent a canoe or kayak. Want to cool down quickly after a long walk? Then you can also jump into the swimming pool at the campsite.

A good dose of sociability

The owner of Beau Rivage campsite is passionate about his little restaurant. Every evening he bakes fresh pizzas and fries, always with a smile on his face. For a good portion of fun and chips, you can order in advance. Would you like to arrange your own camping meal? Then it's only a few minutes' walk to the supermarket.

properties.name: Camping Les Bombes
properties.description:
In the heart of the Auvergne, near the village of Chambon-sur-Lac, lies eco campsite Les Bombes. This quiet campsite has a park-like layout, with flat pitches and flowers and plants everywhere. The campsite is visibly well maintained and the view of the surrounding mountains is magnificent. In the surroundings you can make beautiful walking and cycling trips.

Park-like campsite

Les Bombes is a large, well-maintained campsite. The various camping fields are laid out in a park-like manner in open spaces between the trees. Gravel paths meander along the lawns and strategically placed vegetation provides atmosphere, shade and shelter. The campsite is flat, with spacious pitches on the grass. You can choose a pitch with more or less shade.

Family campsite

In high season you will see many young families at Les Bombes campsite. It is therefore an ideal place for a camping holiday with small children with facilities such as a playground, a fenced swimming pool (with paddling pool) and a baby room. In high season, the restaurant and bar are open. You can also get pizzas, baguettes and pastries.

A nice spot at the swimming pool

In the centre of the campsite there is a heated outdoor swimming pool, surrounded by a tiled terrace. On the edge is a stylish sun deck with parasols and sun beds. The swimming pool is completely fenced, so that small children cannot just walk to the water. The separate children's pool is also fenced. Outside the fence is a beautiful sunbathing area, where you can overlook both the pool and the playground from one of the sun loungers. An ideal place to sunbathe and keep an eye on things.

properties.name: Camping de Tauves Onlycamp
properties.description:
The quiet campground of de Tauves lies at an elevation of 850 m. It is located in the Auvergne, at the foot of the Massif du Sancy. The new French managers (since 2017) will welcome you to their well maintained camping where you will have a lovely, spacious campsite (80-110 m2) on one of the terraces . The campsites, delineated by high hedges, are more or less shaded. Various caravans can be rented on the site (2.5 hectares).

From the higher campsites, you walk down to the outdoor swimming pool (169 m2) with a sunbathing area and heated toddler pool (16 m2). Next to this you will find the playground. You can order fresh bread from the camping shop.

Get sporty

The campground is a good starting point for exploring the beautiful scenery, waterfalls, lakes, forests and castles. There is a centre for paragliding/climbing/canoeing at about 25 km from the campground. The climbing forest is a bit closer.

Guests of the well maintained campground are allowed to use the nearby municipal sports facilities (football, basketball and volleyball) in high season.

Fresh products at the market

There is a market on Thursday mornings in nearby Tauves, which sells regional products. The festival of Laquias de Tauves takes place in August. Nearby you can play tennis, fish or go on horseback rides.

The Parc Naturel Régional des Volcans d'Auvergne is a hilly area with eighty different old volcanoes and beautiful views, Romanesque villages and castles. The interesting Vulcania theme park is a nice attraction where you learn about the volcanic region in an enjoyable way and at the same time increase your knowledge.

properties.name: Camping Municipal du Parc du Château
Camping de Locouarn
properties.description:
Camping de Locouarn is in peaceful southern Finistère, on the outskirts of the Breton village of Clohars-Carnoët. A green, 3.6-hectare campsite with 100 large pitches among trees and close to the coast. You’ll always find a great spot here, whether you have a tent, caravan or motor home. You can be on the beach in five minutes, and cosy villages and towns like Le Pouldi, Lorient and Quimper are nearby as well.

Camping plus

The pitches are large, partly shaded and have electricity. Perfect for a relaxing stay. Prefer something different? Then the wooden cabins are a good option. Cosy and convenient for a short stop. Anyone seeking more comfort can book a fully-equipped mobile home with its own patio. Enjoy a delicious breakfast outside with fresh croissants!

Great facilities for young and old

In summer, take a refreshing dip in the heated pool, while the little ones splash around in the paddling pool. Afterwards, laze around on a deckchair or read a book from the campsite library. Children have fun in the playground or on the trampoline. Fancy being active? There’s room for a game of volleyball or boules. You won't be bored even when the weather’s not great: games and books are within easy reach.

Brittany at its best!

Camping de Locouarn is a great base for anyone wanting to discover Brittany. The beach is close by: Plage de Kérou (2.5 km) is a 5-minute drive away. You can get a breath of fresh air here, build a sandcastle or enjoy the view.

properties.name: Camping de Kergo
properties.description:
Camping de Kergo is located iIn a wooded area in Brittany, near the village of Ploemel. Its central location makes this quiet 3-star campsite the ideal base from which to discover the many sights in the area. Visit the prehistoric monuments of Carnac, the Quiberon peninsula and the vast natural park on the Gulf of Morbihan.

Surrounded by green

At Camping de Kergo you'll be camping on a spacious touring pitch, surrounded by greenery. You can choose from a sheltered pitch on one of the fields with six pitches, separated by hedges. Or an open pitch on the lawn field, under the trees. There are 87 touring pitches available. In addition, the campsite has 31 permanent pitches and 17 rental accommodations, some of which are beautiful lodge tents and cosy hiker's huts.

Wellness and beach

There is no swimming pool at the campsite. Partly because of this it is very quiet on the campsite. If you like wellness, you can make use of the sauna or whirlpool. If you still want to swim during your holiday, drive to the beaches of Carnac or Erdeven. You will also find beautiful sandy beaches on the Quiberon peninsula. The Atlantic Ocean is about twelve kilometres from the campsite.

Fresh bread and ice creams

To buy your fresh bread you’ll find a local baker coming to the campsite every morning. In high season you can get take-away meals in the evening. In the campsite shop you can buy some groceries and of course ice creams. At one kilometre there is a small supermarket for your daily groceries. For more extensive shopping it's best to drive to Auray.

properties.name: Camping Village de la Champagne
properties.description:
Camping Village de la Champagne is located in the French region of the same name, a few kilometres from the Forêt d'Orient Regional Natural Park. This campsite offers rental accommodations in a wooded area. Here you'll spend your holiday near a river and within walking distance of the village centre of Bar-sur-Aube. The campsite itself has a swimming pool, snack bar and covered recreation room. The area is especially popular with active holidaymakers and wine lovers.

Sleep in a troll house

Camping Village de la Champagne offers rental accommodations only. You can spend the night here in a 'standard' mobile home, but you can also choose from special accommodations. Enjoy a holiday in a bright blue wooden cabin, a caravan, camping pod or a 'troll house'. Some of the accommodations have their own kitchen and private sanitary facilities. All accommodations can be booked with breakfast included.

Covered swimming pool

The campsite features plenty of facilities and offers plenty to do. You can cool off in the swimming pool, which features a glass roof so you can also take a dip on rainy days. There's also an indoor game room with a TV, board games and books.

Close to Forêt d'Orient Natural Park

The lookout point over the Forêt d'Orient Natural Park's two large lakes is half an hour's drive from the campsite. The park has three large reservoirs with a combined surface area of ​​5,000 hectares. The lakes are located in the middle of a vast forest. You can sail and swim in the largest lake. The second lake is especially suitable for anglers and the smallest is popular with water skiers.

properties.name: Les Chalets du Lac Belcaire
properties.description:
Camping Les Chalets du Lac Belcaire is located in an extraordinary area in the south of France. This is the country of the Cathars, in the foothills of the Pyrenees and only 50 kilometres from the border with Andorra and Spain. The campsite is next to Belcaire Lake (no swimming allowed) and is open all year round. In the winter, you can enjoy the snowy mountains and participate in fun winter sports activities. The campsite has spacious pitches as well as rental accommodations. There is plenty to experience at Camping Les Chalets du Lac Belcaire. Enjoy the tennis court, the ping pong table, play board games in the games bar or go for a swim in the swimming pool.

Choose your pitch

After arriving at the campsite and checking in, you may choose a pitch. Pitches are available on the open meadow or in the shade under the trees, and are at least 100 m2 in size. The campsite also rents out fun accommodations, such as a wooden cabin or an eco-lodge tent.

A choice of swimming pools

Camping Les Chalets du Lac Belcaire has three new swimming pools, and an outdoor swimming pool with a fun slide. There is also a shallow wading pool. Indoors, there is a heated swimming pool with a Jacuzzi.

Playing sports and games

With a tennis court, ping pong table, games bar, playground, trampoline, sports area and bouncy castle, there is something for everyone at this campsite. Plenty of fun activities are organised during the high season.

properties.name: Camping La Bernede
properties.description:
Cathar Country, located in the south of France, is a region which is simply bursting with its impressive history. A region with mountain rivers meandering through the landscape and with castles on high mountains speaking to the imagination. Camping in Cathar Country is perfect on Camping La Bernède, located near the spa town of Rennes-les-Bains. This is a campsite to relax, far from the main road.

Welcome

You will feel immediately at home. The serene tranquillity on the campsite will soon engulf you. Unscrew the caravan legs, pegs in the ground and enjoy! In low season you will see many French guests with a motorhome. They often stay overnight only and continue their journey in the morning.

Swimming and sports

The swimming pool is partly in the shade and borders a terrace with restaurant. The campsite has a tennis court, a volleyball field and a pétanque pitch. In high season all kinds of activities are organised for camping guests. Does the sea appeal to you? If so, it will only take an hour's drive to get there.

Cathar Country: wellness therapy and Carcassonne

The cold water and hot water springs of Rennes-les-Bains are famous. Slightly north of the campsite you will find the spa of Rennes-les-Bains, perfect to relax after a short stroll through the village itself. Visit the castles from the Cathar period, such as the amazingly impressive Peyrepertuse castle.

It goes without saying that you will also explore the narrow alleyways within the city walls of Carcassonne with its inviting side walk cafes around just about every corner. In peak season it is invariably teeming with people, but always has a lovely atmosphere.

properties.name: Camping des Randonneurs
properties.description:
Camping des Randonneurs is an authentic outdoor gem surround by the French mountains. This small, child-friendly campsite in the heart of the Pyrénées-Orientales offers many unique glamping accommodations and lovely pitches. You camp in a 2.5-hectare green oasis in some woods with the village of Fenouillet close by. The beautiful swimming pool, the restaurant with its good food and the hospitable owners complete the camping experience.

Rustic and amazing

The green site is laid out naturally and attractively with just over 40 pitches, resulting in a surprisingly nice layout and a huge diversity in glamping and camping pitches. There are comfortably furnished teepees, yurts, gypsy wagons and mobile homes with their own outdoor terrace. Everything is very well-kept and the atmosphere is very tranquil. Several spots will give you a great view of the village of Fenouillet and the two Cathar castles.

Outdoor paradise with delicious food

Children will run out of time here. They can have fun playing in nature, jumping on the trampoline or go swimming. Wander to the campsite shop to purchase basic products, including fresh bread and filled picnic baskets. The restaurant is attractive with a nice menu. Tastings are held regularly, and the communal barbecue is a favourite of many guests.

Castles and gorges

There is much to explore in the country of the Cathars at a cultural level as well. This section of the Pyrenees has magnificent castles. Visit the impressive rocky Gorge of Galamus or the gorges of Gouleyrous, where you can swim, hike or laze about in the sun.

properties.name: Camping La Rivière
properties.description:
Camping la Rivière is situated in the southwest of France, surrounded by lush countryside. Here, you can camp right by the River Goul and enjoy shady camping pitches that offer plenty of privacy. The surrounding area, with its mountains, lakes and rivers, is perfect for hikers and cyclists. And there are plenty of historical sights, viewpoints and fun activities to enjoy.

Plenty of privacy and shade

At the campsite, you will find spacious, shady camping pitches separated by hedges, ensuring plenty of privacy. All of the pitches have electricity, and there are several water points spread out across the campsite. You can also rent different chalets of various sizes, suitable for 4 to 6 people.

Child‑friendly pool and river swimming

The campsite’s swimming pool is also open to local residents, but with a standard pool as well as a paddling pool, it’s spacious enough for everyone to share. It is also a very pleasant way to cool off on hot days! Of course, you can also choose to go for a refreshing dip in the river. The Goul flows right behind the campsite and has shallow water, so children can play there safely and enjoy themselves. You can soak up the sun on the wide grassy riverbank. It’s also a great spot to cast a line into the river!

Adventure in Aveyron

The area around Camping La Rivière is a paradise for hikers and cyclists. Several routes through valleys and mountains start right from the campsite. For example, you can walk to the dams at Couesque and Goul in an hour, or make a day of it and visit the Château de Valon (15 km).

properties.name: Camping Les Angeles
properties.description:
Camping Les Angeles is just outside the village of Cézan, in the middle of Gers, one of the sunniest and rural departments of France. The last kilometres on route to this well 'hidden' campsite are on narrow rural roads through a undulating landscape. Once at the campsite, you will only hear the sound of birds and crickets. Furthermore, (in clear weather) you can enjoy amazing views over the peaks of the Pyrenees, and you can admire the stunning starry sky at night.

This campsite was taken over by a hospitable Dutch family in 2023, and they wasted no time modernising the campsite. The two toilet blocks, the hire accommodation and the playgrounds have been renovated.

Spacious pitches with sun and shade

This campsite has small-scale camping grounds with mainly tourist pitches. Most of the pitches have natural demarcation. Almost every camping pitch at Camping Les Angeles is set up so that you have both sun as well as shade. You can book overnight stays in a modern safari tent, chalet or mobile home.

Themed evenings, crafting hours and a wonderful swimming pool

Gers is one of the sunniest and one of the warmest regions in France (in the summer). The campsite has a wonderful swimming pool to cool down in. There is also a charming restaurant where you can enjoy a fresh lunch, evening meal or drinks platter. Furthermore, entertainment is sometimes organised at Camping Les Angeles in the form of fun themed evenings. When there are enough children at the campsite, they sometimes organise crafting hours.

properties.name: Camping le Soleil du Gers
properties.description:
In the countryside of the south-western corner of France, in the town of Lelin-Lapujolle, lies Camping le Soleil du Gers. Le Soleil du Gers is a quiet campsite with pitches between green trees, with a hospitable owner and a lovely swimming pool. Advance booking for peak season is advisable.

Amiable holiday atmosphere

The owner, Mrs Crésut, is a walking encyclopedia of tourist information about sights and activities in the area. There are 86 pitches on her campsite. These are divided in touring pitches, sites for mobile homes, gîtes and paved pitches for motorhomes.

Colours on the campsite

The pitches are located along dirt roads between colourful plants. The campsite radiates a remarkable calmness. The grounds are clearly well-tended while maintaining their natural vegetation. It is nice to see that trees determine the size of the pitches while demarcating them at the same time.

The campsite lies on the Santiago de Compostella pilgrimage route. This explains the mobile homes and gîtes, which provide accommodation to pilgrims. Although the campsite exudes tranquillity, it is also a perfect base for attending the races on the Nogaro racing circuit, located at some 20 km from the campsite.

Swimming and fishing

The swimming pool and the separate toddler pool are both designed in a kind of drop shape. Next to the pool there are a few loungers on which to soak up the sun or to enjoy the shade. The campsite borders on a lake which suitable for angling, but not really for swimming!

properties.name: Barnard Castle Camp. & Carav. Club Site
Camping Llavorsi
properties.description:
If you are looking for a campsite that offers both peace as well as adventure, then Camping Llavorsi in the Spanish Catalonia is where you want to be. Here, you camp amid the mountains of the Spanish Pyrenees. You are surrounded by several nature reserves with many options for relaxing or active pursuits. Your children are sure to be happy with the swimming pool in the village of Llavorsí, three minutes away.

Green all over

Pitch your tent, park your caravan or motorhome on one of the spaciously laid out pitches, and your holiday can begin. The pitches on grass range from 40 to 80 m². Furthermore, you can hire a furnished Bell tent, mobile home or a wooden holiday home.

Camping Llavorsí is by a river and is a well-maintained campsite with 50 touring pitches. It's green wherever you look.

From swimming to rafting

Children can have fun in the playground at the campsite. Temperatures can soar in the Pyrenees. So it's great that campsite guests can swim for free in the public swimming pool at Llavorsí.

The area around the campsite has plenty of spectacular things to offer older children and adults. You are in the right place for kayak tours, rafting, canyoning and zip lining. Horse riding is one of the options for younger children.

Tapas and more

After a day full of activities, a snack or meal always goes down well. You can go to the campsite's bar-restaurant for that. In the village of Llavorsí and just outside, there are a number of restaurants where you can enjoy delicious Spanish tapas.

properties.name: Camping de la Lande
properties.description:
Camping de la Lande is a small and quiet campsite in Brassac, in the heart of the green landscape of the Parc Naturel Régional du Haut-Languedoc. You will camp on the banks of the river Agout, surrounded by woods and hills. The campsite is well organised and ideal for campers who appreciate simplicity, nature and relaxation. Its central location makes it a great base for exploring the Tarn and the surrounding mountainous areas.

Large pitch or comfortable accommodation

The pitches at Camping de la Lande are large and suitable for tents, caravans and motor homes. A lot of pitches have an electricity connection and offer a mix of sun and light shade. There’s plenty of space and privacy, which adds to the peaceful atmosphere of the campsite. There are also several furnished rental tents for campers seeking the convenience of accommodation but still wanting to stay close to nature.

Ideal place for peace seekers

The campsite has practical and well-maintained facilities in keeping with its small size. There are neat and tidy toilet and washing facilities with hot showers, a washing-up area and facilities for young children. There’s a small restaurant on site that serves simple meals and snacks. Camping de la Lande focuses mainly on campers who are seeking peace and quiet, couples and families who enjoy being outdoors and don’t want large-scale entertainment. If you fancy a dip, you can head to the municipal swimming pool next to the campsite. Entry is free for campsite guests.

properties.name: Camping Huttopia Pays de Cordes sur Ciel
properties.description:
This beautifully landscaped campsite is located in a hilly area in the Tarn, just three kilometres from Cordes-sur-Ciel (one of the most beautiful villages in France). There are also more of these beautiful medieval towns in the area. This makes Huttopia Pays de Cordes sur Ciel Campsite an ideal base for culture lovers. This small-scale campsite also offers an extensive entertainment and activity programme in high season. The campsite is spacious and has modern facilities, including a heated outdoor swimming pool.

A playfully designed site with special accommodations

Huttopia Pays de Cordes sur Ciel is a spacious campsite. At its centre is an area exclusively for tourist camping pitches. These come in three comfort levels. There are also a variety of rental accommodations playfully spread across the site. These include modern chalets, atmospheric gypsy wagons and comfortable lodge tents.

Enjoy water recreation in the heated swimming pool

At the front of the campsite is a heated swimming pool with a paddling pool next to it. A wonderful place to swim some laps or to play around in the water. The pool is surrounded by a large wooden terrace with sun loungers. It is fully exposed to the sun, but umbrellas also provide some shade here and there.

A renovated, fully equipped sanitary block

Guests at this campsite have access to two sanitary buildings. The large building, in the centre of the campsite, has been completely renovated. This is a spacious building with lots of light. It is fully equipped, including a baby changing room and facilities specifically designated for people with reduced mobility.

properties.name: Camping Les Galets de la Mollière
Sites & Paysages De La Baie
properties.description:
Camping De La Baie is a simple campsite in the north of France, not far from the village of Pendé. You are here in Picardy, the north-eastern part of Normandy. With thirty touring pitches, almost seventy permanent annual pitches and fourteen rental accommodations, a stay here is nice and quiet. Camping guests have access to a bocce court, miniature golf course, playground and recreation room.

Camping and renting

In 2018, the campsite was taken over by the current owners. The site was somewhat neglected at first, but they have made many improvements since then. The pitches of their campsite are between 80 and 110 m2. They lie on a grass surface. Hedges provide the necessary privacy. There are also fourteen accommodations (mobile homes and bungalows) available at the Camping De La Baie campsite. All accommodations have a kitchenette, bathroom and terrace.

Modest, but fun entertainment

Camping de la Baie has a children's playground with some equipment. There is also a trampoline. The recreation room is also home to some slot machines and a foosball table. And what could be more fun than a game of miniature golf with your entire camping party? Or a competition against your campsite neighbours to see who is the best? Of course, the archetypal French game of pétanque is not to be missed among the offerings. There is no entertainment team at this campsite.

Fresh bread and shared meals
