You can get fresh bread at this campsite, ideal for a good start to the day. There are also some food items for sale. In the high season, communal evening meals are sometimes served. Here, you can get to know your fellow campers while enjoying something tasty.

properties.name: Camping La Vallée de Poupet
properties.description:
La Vallée de Poupet campsite is located in a remote spot in the Vendée. You camp here right by the river La Sèvre Nantaise. Find a pitch by the water and enjoy the peace and quiet and the view. Don't forget to take a dip in the river or discover the area by canoe. A wonderful outing for the whole family. And a visit to Puy du Fou theme park will make your camping holiday truly unforgettable.

Camping in the countryside

Arrived at the campsite? Then it's time to find your pitch. The spacious pitches are set amidst flowering trees and bushes. The campsite is very well-looked after. Nevertheless, nature has every chance to take its course here. The most beautiful spots are by the river. Here you will wake up every day to the sound of murmuring water.

Water fun

Children have plenty of room to play at La Vallée de Poupet camp site. Nature is the greatest playground and they know it at this campsite. They will often be found by the river in particular. Do they prefer to dive into the pool? You can do that too! The campsite has a lovely indoor swimming pool, suitable for both adults and children. Your little ones can splash about in the shallows safely here.

Fresh croissants for breakfast

For a delicious croissant for breakfast, get on your bike in the morning. A fifteen-minute ride and you are in Saint-Malô-du-Bois. There you will already smell the fresh bread. There is also a modest neighbourhood supermarket for some small groceries.

properties.name: Camping Les Falquets
properties.description:
If you like a small campsite with a relaxed atmosphere, then camping Les Falquets near the town of Charmes-sur-l'Herbasse (Drôme) is ideal. This simple, but good quality campsite is situated in the middle of the greenery. You can choose whether you want a shady or a sunny pitch. You can swim and bathe in the river that flows alongside the campsite.

Natural pitches

In the wooden reception building, the campsite owner will give you a warm welcome. You can then choose your own spot on the circular campsite. Do you prefer a shady pitch? Then it is convenient to stand on the right-hand side. The more open and sunny places are on the left-hand side. It is nice that most of the pitches are designed in a natural way. They are delimited by neat hedges or bushes.

Water fun in the little river

The little river Herbasse flows along the campsite. In the shallow parts, building dams is a popular activity among young and old. Of course, this is also a nice place to find some coolness.

Bar and fresh bread

The campsite has a modest bar where you can get some refreshments. Fresh bread is also available in high season. For shopping, the supermarket at Saint-Donat-sur-l’Herbasse is the nearest option.

properties.name: Flower Camping L'Abri-Cotier
properties.description:
Flower Camping L'Abri-Cotier is located to the west of the port of Rochefort, one and a half kilometres from the Atlantic Ocean. Here you can camp in peace and quiet close to the varied French west coast. Here you can visit the famous Fort Boyard, but also Île Madame, an island that can only be reached at low tide.

Via Rochefort you drive along a two-lane road between fields towards the Atlantic coast. With an entrance full of flowers and trees - even palm trees greet you as you enter the grounds - camping L'Abri-Cotier lives up to its name. Here you can camp in the shade of full trees. Hedges ensure that you camp with a lot of privacy.

Indoor swimming pool

The indoor swimming pool on the side of the campsite is ideal for lazy swimmers and for children who want to play in the water. For toddlers there is a paddling pool next to the large rectangular pool. There is a playground with a trampoline, swings and a climbing frame.

Fort Boyard and more

Rochefort is definitely worth a visit. The coastline is also interesting here. The port area is interspersed with small sandy beaches and nature reserves where water birds feel at home. Bird watchers can have a great time here. From the tip of the peninsula on the Charente River, a road leads to Île Madame, a small island in the Atlantic Ocean. This island can only be reached at low tide, via the Passe aux Bœufs, the 'cow corridor'. A little further out to sea is Fort Boyard.

properties.name: Camping Carrefour de l'Ardèche
properties.description:
Camping Carrefour de l'Ardèche is located in the sunny south of the Ardèche, just outside the charming village of Saint-Remèze. Surrounded by lavender fields, vineyards and the beautiful Ardèche countryside, this friendly, family-friendly campsite is a great base for campers wanting to combine tranquillity, nature and adventure.

Lovely pitches and mobile homes

At Camping Carrefour de l'Ardèche, you’ll find large, green pitches for your tent, caravan or motor home, all with electricity, toilet and washing facilities and wi-fi. Pets are allowed, making it a great destination when travelling with your four-legged friend. Anyone seeking more comfort will enjoy the rental accommodation, such as mobile homes and furnished tents. The site's location means that the atmosphere is quiet and relaxed with plenty of shade and sunny spots.

Facilities to enjoy

The campsite has an outdoor pool where you can cool off on hot days and a playground for children. A game on the boules court guarantees fun for the whole family. Communal activities and music evenings are organised regularly in the summer. The restaurant and bar offer local dishes, drinks and a welcoming place to catch up after a day of adventures. Guests praise the friendly and helpful staff, the well-kept pitches and the relaxed atmosphere on the campsite itself.

Explore the surrounding area

Camping Carrefour de l'Ardèche is close to some of the region's most famous attractions. The spectacular Gorges de l'Ardèche (29 km) and the iconic Pont d'Arc (12 km) are perfect for day trips full of nature and adventure, with canoeing and kayaking opportunities on the river.

properties.name: Camping Ushuaïa Villages Les 4 Saisons
properties.description:
In the Drôme valley, near the historic town of Crest, is the Les 4 Saisons campsite. This green campsite is run by the French owner, Didier. You will be camping on a natural site with differences in height. Find a nice spot among the vegetation and enjoy the peace and quiet. The mountainous Drôme is ideal for enjoying a holiday away from the crowds. Take a dip in the pool or visit the picturesque Mirmande.

Camping in nature

Nature is allowed all the freedom it could desire at the Les 4 Saisons camping ground. This gives it a somewhat chaotic appearance, but above all, a green one. You'll be pitching your tent among the flowering shrubs. A wonderful experience for campers who love nature.

For large caravans, it's sometimes a little more difficult to manoeuvre. Especially due to the height differences. Once you are in your spot? Then you'll have a nice, green camping spot to enjoy for the rest of your holiday. Looking for a modern, luxurious location for your camping holiday? Then the brand new wooden chalets will be just the thing for you.

A holiday to unwind

Swimming in the pool, sunbathing in front of your caravan... at the Camping Les 4 Saisons campsite, you can take the time to relax a bit. You can fully enjoy your holiday in peace and quiet because you will be camping here far from the big crowds and tourist towns. In Grane, the small village nearby, you will find a supermarket. This is where you can go to get some groceries. Still need a larger shop? Then drive to Crest, fifteen minutes from the campsite. Several restaurants are also located there. Ideal if you want to enjoy a nice dinner.

properties.name: Camping Le Chassezac
properties.description:
In the south of the Ardèche, along the banks of a small river, you’ll find camping Le Chassezac. This quiet campsite has a friendly French atmosphere. The wooded campsite has a Provençal look. In summer this is a real family campsite, with lots of entertainment for children. Ruoms is a charming place.

Wooded bank

The campsite is quietly situated between the vineyards along the river. On the wooded campsite you will find shady pitches on straight, unpaved paths. The campsite has mainly touring pitches, but also twenty permanent pitches and as many rental units, which are located in a separate part of the campsite. The most beautiful pitches are on the edge of the campsite, overlooking the surrounding vineyards.

River with pebble beach

Camping Le Chassezac is situated directly on the river of the same name. Within a few minutes you are on the pebble beach by the water. Because the river is fed by a spring, the river is never dry. Children can paddle in the shallow area, play in the water and make dams. You can even go horseback riding in the river. If the water is too cold for the little ones, they can also swim in the heated outdoor swimming pool on the campsite.

Entertainment for the whole family

There is plenty to do on the campsite. Of course, the river is an endless source of entertainment, but also all kinds of activities are organised. In high season there is entertainment for the whole family and guided hikes are organised. Especially for children there is a lot of entertainment. Adults can enjoy wellness and massages in the beauty centre.

properties.name: Camping Des Dunes
properties.description:
Normandy is known for its beautiful coastline and huge sandy beaches. Camping Des Dunes is located on one of those beaches: Créances-Plage near the village of Créances (Manche). Thanks to this location, a wide range of water sports are within hand’s reach. The campsite is also close to the long-distance GR 223 walking route, which runs along the length of the Normandy coast. On the campsite itself, you’ll find well-tended pitches, a supermarket, a cafeteria and various sports and games facilities.

Sheltered camping by the English Channel

Enjoy camping by the beach, but in a sheltered spot? Then this campsite is for you; the trees and high bushes around the large pitches will shelter you from the wind. Des Dunes also has a wide range of accommodation options. For example, cosy rental tents and cabins for two to four cyclists, walkers, or tourists just looking for a unique nature experience. The campsite also has fully-equipped holiday homes up to eighty square metres in size. The pitches are in a separate area and available all year round.

Cafeteria, supermarket and sports facilities

Returning to the campsite after a fun day's holiday? Then nothing beats a quick but tasty takeaway. The cafeteria serves burgers, fries, pizzas, salads and sandwiches, etc. You can order your breakfast for the next day here too. The campsite also has its own supermarket that sells essentials and local products. There's plenty to do on the site. Have a game of volleyball, boules or table tennis, or try out Mölkky , a surprising throwing game. If the weather’s bad? Have fun in the games room.

properties.name: Camping Loisirs Vacances Languedoc Les Ayguades
Camping Huttopia Ars-en-Ré
properties.description:
Looking for a place where you can breathe in the salty sea air as soon as you wake up? Camping Huttopia Ars-en-Ré is located in a gently sloping area of dunes, just 50 m from the beach. It’s a relaxing place where you can cycle through the dunes, gather shellfish or just relax with a good glass of wine on the terrace. With child-friendly facilities, sports facilities and a friendly atmosphere, this is a great base for young and old.

Space, peace and a bit of wild camping

The large site has pitches of up to 100 m², suitable for tents, caravans or motor homes. Remember that the site is quite open and there aren’t many shaded areas. But that's not a problem: you sleep in the heart of nature here, with the murmur of the sea in the background.

The toilet blocks are scattered around the campsite and have a separate area for families. For more comfort, choose rental accommodation with its own toilet and washing facilities.

Simple conviviality and lots to do on the site

Whether you like being active or relaxing with a drink, you can do it all at Huttopia Ars-en-Ré. Children have fun in the playgrounds or take part in the daily entertainment programme. For sports enthusiasts, there are beach volleyball courts, table tennis tables and even archery. Don't fancy cooking? The Coffee Corner serves simple meals, fresh bread and also home-made pizzas in the summer. There’s also a bar and a small campsite shop. In the evening, the terrace is lively, with occasional live music or an open-air film.

properties.name: Camping et Lodges du Bois Dodo
properties.description:
Camping et Lodges du Bois Dodo is surrounded by forest and is located at the edge of the village of Septfonds. The campsite is located in an environment with numerous beautiful medieval villages and towns. It is also beautiful for hiking and cycling. In short, the ideal spot for seekers of peace and quiet and lovers of the authentic French countryside.

Beautiful grounds

The campsite is small, very well maintained and is laid out like a park. The layout is open, so you have a good overview of the property. Handy for kids. The pitches are nice and spacious and shady under the numerous oak trees. If you want to rent something, book one of the new luxurious safari tents or chalets.

Intimate swimming pool

The swimming pool is reasonably large, but intimate through the leafy surroundings. Note: shorts and bermudas are not permitted in the swimming pool. There are sun loungers to relax on. Some of them are in the shade.

Entertainment for all

Children have plenty to do here. Just send them to the playground, the ping pong table, the jeu-de-boules pitch, the trampoline or the treehouse. In the high season the owners organise a lovely walk in the area every Tuesday morning. On Friday afternoon there is always a jeu-de-boules tournament. There is also a famous communal mussel dinner. Multiple walking and cycling routes start right from the campsite.

Enjoy yourself on an idyllic terrace

You can get fresh bread on the campsite. There is also a a cafe with a small menu. In front of the reception building there is an idyllic terrace with some shade from the tall trees. You can get take away meals there. In nearby Septfonds you'll find a small supermarket, a bakery and a butcher.

properties.name: Capfun Camping Tensch Jolie
properties.description:
Are you looking for the ultimate family campsite, where you can enjoy yourself as a family with both younger and older children? Then this campsite in the village of Grostenquin (in the Moselle department in the northeast of France) is certainly the right choice. Capfun's Tensch Jolie Campsite has several beautiful playgrounds and a beautiful waterpark with three spectacular waterslides. There are also activities organised for guests of all ages in high season.

Shaded camping pitches and an abundance of mobile homes

Rental properties are the primary type of accommodation offered at Capfun's Tensch Jolie Campsite. You will find a variety of modern mobile homes and bungalows here. The smallest can accommodate three people, while the largest can accommodate as many as ten.

You will also find camping pitches, especially at the front of the campsite, where you can use your own camping equipment. These are situated on a neatly laid out field, where large trees provide plenty of shade. The sanitary facilities at Capfun's Tensch Jolie Campsite are modern, in good condition and clean.

Beautiful waterpark with three waterslides

The campsite's waterpark offers two large outdoor swimming pools and a separate paddling pool. You can enjoy swimming and splashing in heated water in each of these pools. In addition, there are three spectacular waterslides. Be sure to try the Space Bowl! In this slide you end up in a funnel, where the aim is to spin as many laps as possible. And what about the Rafter? Here you slide down in a buoy at an exhilirating speed.

properties.name: Recreatiepark  Klein Paradijs
properties.description:
You will find this campsite in a rural environment, right next to the vast Chaamse Bossen and close to more beautiful nature reserves where you can enjoy walking and cycling. This is an ideal holiday address for people who like peace and nature. This is also a popular campsite among families with children - especially in the high season. This is thanks to the animation programme, the large outdoor swimming pool and the cosy canteen.

Spacious grounds with a nice tourist area

Recreatiepark Klein Paradijs sits on a large and spacious site. This benefits the people camping here, giving them plenty of room to stretch out and move around and large camping pitches. This campsite is predominately made of permanent annual pitches. However, this well-maintained site also has a beautiful field with tourist camping spots. These are neat grass pitches that are sometimes separated from each other by hedges.

Take a refreshing dip in the outdoor pool

In the centre of the campsite, you will find an outdoor swimming pool where you can take a wonderfully refreshing dip. Water fun is guaranteed here for the whole family because there is a beautiful children's paddling pool next to the large outdoor pool. Of course, you can also swim laps in the pool.

Varied entertainment programmes in the high season

There are two nice playgrounds on this campsite. One can be found next to the canteen, and the other is on the tourist camping field. Klein Paradijs also organises fun activities in the summer for campers of all ages. During the day, for example, there are sporting tournaments in the open air. Later in the day, there are bingo nights, party nights and/or darts and billiards tournaments.

properties.name: Camping Le Verdier
properties.description:
Camping Le Verdier in Saumane is ideal for nature lovers. This French campsite is located in the heart of the Cévennes, on the banks of the Gardon Saint-Jean river. This makes it a perfect base for walking, fishing and discovering the area's cultural heritage. Whether you love mountainous landscapes like Mont-Aigoual, or want to experience the beautiful monuments of Anduze, you can enjoy everything the region has to offer here.

Connection with nature

This quiet and small campsite is divided into two parts: one with camping pitches and chalets and one with mobile homes. Opt for comfortable accommodation or connect with nature on a well-equipped pitch. Whatever you prefer, you will always find a spot to suit your needs here. The campsite is popular with couples but also families with older children.

Heated swimming pool and fries

Le Verdier has well-maintained facilities for a wonderful stay. During high season, enjoy a dip in the heated pool. You will also have a great time playing table football, boules and table tennis. No entertainment is organised, but there is a cosy bar where you can also order pizza, chips and roast chicken. Don't forget to enjoy an ice cream as a sweet end to your day!

Perfect if you love the outdoors

There’s plenty for outdoor enthusiasts to do in the surrounding area. The river Gardon Saint-Jean is opposite the campsite; perfect for a dip or fishing. For walkers, there are marked trails, like the famous Stevenson Trail (GR70).

properties.name: Camping Les Cerisiers
properties.description:
Camping Les Cerisiers is situated on the banks of the River Tarn, within walking distance of the village of Ispagnac in Lozère. Here, you can camp in the Gorges du Tarn, nestled between limestone cliffs and green hills. The campsite is modestly sized and easy to navigate, with direct access to the river. This is an ideal spot for those seeking peace and quiet, for walkers and all those who enjoy active holidays in the countryside.

Spacious pitches and great accommodation

The pitches are located on gently sloping terrain and are partially divided by hedges and trees. You can choose between sunny or shady spots, and most pitches have electricity. From your pitch, you can walk straight to the river running alongside it. There are also a variety of rental accommodations available. For example, you can choose a fully equipped safari tent or a mobile home with its own bathroom facilities and terrace.

Cool down in the swimming pool

The campsite has a heated swimming pool with a separate paddling pool and a sun terrace. In high season, there is a bread roll service and you can visit the bar for a drink or a simple meal. Thanks to its peaceful atmosphere and natural setting, the campsite attracts mainly families with young children, couples and active seniors.

Around Ispagnac and the Cévennes

From the campsite, it is an easy walk to the centre of Ispagnac (1 km), which has a few shops and restaurants. The Gorges du Tarn are ideal for canoeing and swimming. You can also go walking and cycling straight from the site. The Cévennes National Park is a short distance away (approx. 18 km). The villages of Florac (10 km) and Sainte-Enimie (17 km), one of the most beautiful villages in France, are well worth a visit.

properties.name: Les Étangs du Longeau Foxy Camp
Camping Le Montbartoux
properties.description:
In the Auvergne, in the heart of a regional natural park you will find camping Le Montbartoux. This small, quiet family campsite has a heated outdoor swimming pool, a friendly bar and a small restaurant. The Dutch owner ensures a warm welcome and a relaxed atmosphere. Because of its altitude, the campsite has a beautiful view over the valley and the surrounding mountains.

Small terraced campsite

Le Montbartoux is a small terraced campsite. Most pitches are situated in full sun and vary in size from spacious to very generous. Not all pitches are equally flat, but the owner will be happy to help you find a suitable pitch for you. There are 42 touring pitches, 5 permanent pitches and 6 rental accommodations on the campsite. The most beautiful pitches offer breathtaking views over the Auvergne and the volcanoes of the Puy-de-Dôme.

Swimming pool with a view

In the centre of the campsite there is a simple outdoor swimming pool. It is recent and is situated in full sunshine. Around it a tiled terrace with seats and sun loungers. You can sunbathe there and also have a panoramic view of the mountains and the valley below. The swimming pool is heated, fully fenced and equipped with a hoist lift.

Excellent cook

The owner himself is standing in the kitchen of the small restaurant, and he does not do it without merit. Please let him know if you want to enjoy his cooking in the evening. At the pavement café you can dine and enjoy the view, but inside is also very pleasant. From May to September you can get fresh bread and some groceries at the campsite.

properties.name: Gold Coast Camping Village
properties.description:
The spaciously laid-out, medium-sized Camping 5 Stelle is beautifully situated near a nature reserve. You will find the campsite on the Verano peninsula near Lake Verano and the Adriatic Sea. Here you'll camp on sandy pitches. There are a lot of pine trees, which provide ample shade. The campsite has 150 touring pitches and 50 motorhome pitches. The pitches vary in size from 80 to 100 m2. The campsite also has more than 100 mobile homes and bungalows for rent.

Swimming pool, sea and lake

This is a great campsite for children: you can get to the water from everywhere. A lifeguard is in attendance at the outdoor swimming pool (300 m2), which is attractively surrounded by greenery. Toddlers enjoy themselves in the shallow children's pool (72 m2). During high season there is a kid's club, although it is only offered in Italian. At night many campers go to the disco evenings.

In addition to the swimming pool, you can also go to Lake Verano and, of course, the sea. It is a short walk through the dunes to the nearby beach. The sea is great for snorkelling, windsurfing and waterskiing.

Large shop and restaurant

The shop on the campsite is well stocked. The restaurant can serve a large number of guests. The wood-fired pizza is one of the many reasons that they come here, There is a good selection of dishes, including take-away meals. You can eat inside and al fresco. 

Athletic activity on the campsite or in the vicinity

On the campsite, there is a sports field, a table tennis table, a beach volleyball court and a tennis court. There are guided hikes for guests through the forest and the nature reserve on a regular basis.

properties.name: Camping Trevélez
properties.description:
You camp here at about twenty minutes' walk from Trevélez, a small white mountain village in Andalusia situated at an altitude of 1,476 metres. Yes, here you are at the foot of the Sierra Nevada. And at the highest campsite in Spain! Incidentally, this does mean that you can only reach this place with a strong (towing) car or motorhome. The area is very isolated, which makes it nice and quiet.

Camping in silence and in the mountains

Once you arrive, you will see that it is a green and quiet campsite with a hundred or so pitches. These are mostly flat and have a fair amount of shade. The pitches are situated on different terraces against a steep slope. Pay attention to the pitch you book. Manoeuvring a large caravan or motorhome is difficult at some levels.

At Trevélez campsite there are also several bungalows, chalets, safari tents and tents for rent. These are suitable for two to six people. The campsite's sanitary facilities are very clean. There is paper on the toilets and the shower water is warm.

Modest entertainment and charming restaurant

There is a small swimming pool to cool down in. There are also several loungers on the side to relax with a book or to enjoy the sun. There is also a table tennis table and a playground for children.

The restaurant is charming and authentically decorated. At the bar, you can sit and enjoy drinks and a view of the valley. There is also a small shop for basic groceries.

properties.name: Stensjö Camping
properties.description:
Stensjö Camping is in the forested hinterland of the Swedish province of Blekinge, in the village of Västra Stensjö. Here, you camp in a varied landscape with vast forests, large farmlands and clean lakes. The surrounding area is excellent for walking and cycling. Blekinge is sparsely populated and not overly touristy, so you can enjoy the natural beauty in peace and quiet. The campsite is basically right by a lovely recreational lake. This is a friendly family campsite that is very popular among families in the high season.

Spacious camping pitches, nice houses and a group accommodation

The camping pitches are on a different part of the site than the accommodation. The pitches are spacious and in a sunny location. You have free Wi-Fi at Stensjö Camping. If you would rather book a house, you can choose for a fully equipped holiday home or a hiker's cabin without toilet and washing facilities. There is also a large group accommodation with 12 bedrooms.

Sailing, fishing and swimming in Stora Alljungen

This campsite is practically right by Stora Alljungen recreational lake. There is a small beach about 200 metres from the campsite and from where you can go into the lake. As well as swimming, you can go sailing and fishing in the Stora Alljungen.

From laser tag to building rafts

There is entertainment every day during the summer holidays. The programme runs until September and comprises extremely original activities. These are things like carving spoons, making boomerangs from Swedish wood, laser tag, dropping games, hexathlons, archery and making pancakes and baking bread and pizzas.

properties.name: Camping Ushuaïa Villages Le Parc de la Grève
properties.description:
Camping Le Parc de la Grève is located at the highest point of the village of L'Aigullon-sur-Vie in the French Vendée. The small-scale family campsite is located in a quiet and green area, 7 kilometres from the Atlantic Ocean and the fine sandy beaches of the Vendée. Camping Le Parc de la Grève has a lot to offer families and couples looking for a relaxing and adventurous holiday on the sunny west coast of France. For example, take a refreshing dip in the swimming pool or cast your rod in the fishing pond.

Spacious campsites

When you arrive at Camping Le Parc de la Grève, you'll immediately notice how green the grounds are. There are a total of 97 pitches here, including shaded pitches for tents, caravans and motorhomes. The spacious pitches range from 80 to more than 120 m². There are also well-maintained mobile homes, chalets and safari and lodge tents for rent. Hot tub lovers can even rent a mobile home featuring its own jacuzzi.

Water and playing fun

The campsite has a large heated outdoor swimming pool with a slide, surrounded by a sun deck with lounge chairs and parasols. The little ones can enjoy themselves in the separate children's pool, on the bouncy castle next to the pool or on the playground. In high season there is a fun activity programme with a children's club for kids between 5 and 12 years old, family activities and fun themed nights. What's more, the swimming pool remains open until 11 pm on Saturday evenings so that everyone can enjoy it a little bit longer.

properties.name: Flower Camping Le Kerarno
properties.description:
Flower Camping Le Kerarno is located in Saint-Philibert, a cosy town on the Bay of Quiberon (Morbihan). This holiday park is conveniently located in the Morbihan, close to some of the main attractions. There are also beautiful sandy beaches nearby. The campsite’s facilities include a heated aqua park, a good restaurant and a varied entertainment programme.

Holiday park, mainly with mobile homes

This campsite clearly has more accommodation than pitches. Five different types of mobile homes can be rented and can accommodate four to six holidaymakers. At the back of the site, you will find a well-tended camping field with large touring pitches. These are nicely embedded in the forest, which means that there’s plenty of shade; they are separated by trees and high bushes.

Heated aqua park and lots of fun activities

The campsite's beautiful water park has a large basic pool with a spectacular water slide. Young children can splash around in the paddling pool, which has a slide. Campers aged 4 to 12 can have fun in the kids' club during the summer holidays. Activities for the whole family are organised too. For example, sports tournaments, creative games, dance evenings, bingo, karaoke sessions and surprising shows. The campsite also has an excellent restaurant, where you can enjoy Breton specialities and home-made pizzas, etc.

La Trinité and Carnac's megaliths

All kinds of great day trips are possible in this part of the Morbihan. For example, drive to La Trinité-sur-Mer (5 km) and stroll along the attractive harbour and through the picturesque streets. Carnac is a little further away; it's the place to admire a series of megaliths. Or spend a day shopping in Lorient (50 km).

properties.name: Kings Down Tail Car. and Camp. Park
Villaggio Camping Calapineta
properties.description:
Located on the magnificent east coast of Sardinia, Villaggio Camping Calapineta will provide an unforgettable holiday for families and nature lovers. The campsite is situated in a beautiful nature reserve within walking distance from a pebble beach and sixty kilometres from port of Olbia. You camp amid centuries-old pine trees and Mediterranean vegetation in a quiet environment.

Shaded pitches and comfortable accommodations

Villaggio Camping Calapineta has spacious, shaded pitches suitable for tents, caravans and motorhomes. The pitches are spread out throughout the trees, enabling you to fully enjoy the natural environment. If you would prefer some more comfort, there are also various accommodations for rent, such as mobile homes and bungalows, complete with their own terrace and cooking facilities.

Sports and relaxation for the entire family

The campsite organises a wide range of activities for both young and old, from windsurfing and sailing on the crystal-clear water of the Mediterranean Sea to guided hiking and cycling tours through the rugged interior of Sardinia. Children will amuse themselves with the entertainment team while the adults enjoy a relaxing yoga lesson or a game of beach volleyball. The campsite also has a swimming pool with a paddling pool and a charming bar and restaurant, where you can enjoy local specialities.

Explore the multifaceted Sardinia

The area surrounding Villaggio Camping Calapineta is perfect for excursions. Explore the rugged cliffs and hidden inlets along the coast or visit the famous caves of Dorgali (54 km) and the heavenly beaches near San Teodoro (37 km). In Bidderosa, the nearby nature reserve (18 km), you can go on magnificent walks along unspoilt beaches.

properties.name: Camping Gippelblick Kernhof
properties.description:
This campsite is located in a green, wooded area in Lower Austria. It is 20 kilometres from the pilgrimage site of Mariazell and just one kilometre from the village of Kernhof. As its name suggests, Camping Gippelblick Kernhof offers you a view of the 1,669 metre high Gippel Mountain. This small-scale campsite is ideal for peace seekers and nature lovers. There's plenty to do in the area and you can completely relax and unwind at the campsite.

Small-scale campsite

Camping Gippelblick is a small-scale campsite with 25 touring pitches and 65 pitches for seasonal campers. The camping pitches are located on a green meadow where you can choose a spot yourself. All pitches offer a view of the Gippel mountain. The campsite has a covered recreation room that everyone can use. There's also a playground, a tennis court where you can play a game for a fee, and a spacious toilet block. A small contribution is requested for hot water because the campsite owner wants to prevent excessive water consumption.

The centre of Kernhof is one kilometre from the campsite. In the village, you’ll find a supermarket, a bakery, a café, a bank and a post office.

Discover the area

Camping Gippellblick Kernhof is located at the foot of the Alps, in an area offering plenty to do. In the summer you can enjoy endless hiking, mountain biking and cycling. There's also a swimming lake with a sunbathing area just a 25-minute drive from the campsite. The nearest swimming pool is 5 kilometres away.

Mariazell is a half-hour’s drive from the campsite. This village is best known for its basilica, the most visited pilgrimage church in Austria.

properties.name: Camping Locronan
properties.description:
In the south of the Finistère department (Brittany), near Quimper, lies the Camping Locronan campsite. This terraced campsite is located in the medieval village of the same name, amidst forests and on a hill. Thanks to its location on a steep slope, the campsite offers views of the rolling countryside, Mount Ménez-Hom and Douarnenez Bay.

Camping with panoramic views

Camping Locronan is a quiet and well kept campsite. The spacious pitches are located on terraces and delineated by hedges. Thanks to its location, the pitches have a panoramic view of Douarnenez Bay. In addition, they are flat and overgrown with grass. Do you love luxury? Then here, you can also choose a wooden mobile home or a furnished tent.

Water fun for everyone

There is an indoor, heated pool with a paddling pool. While the kids splash around in the pool, parents can relax on the lounge chairs. Do you prefer to lie on the beach? Five kilometres from the campsite, the fine sandy beaches of Douarnenez Bay await you. After a day full of (water) activities, you can take a nice shower in excellent campsite sanitary facilities.

Fresh baguettes and croissants

In the high season, you can use the bread service. Tasty croissants and baguettes for breakfast every day: that's what everyone wants, right? In the high season, there is also a food truck with typical Breton products. The campsite also has a small supermarket. For more shopping, you can go to the centre of Locronan. Fancy a cold beer? The campsite bar has a variety of beers.

properties.name: Camping le Bois Flottant
properties.description:
If you like going on holiday in a natural setting, on a secluded pitch where you can completely unwind, Camping le Bois Flottant is the ideal holiday address. Here, you camp in an unspoilt environment, far from motorways, traffic noise and urban bustle. This is an authentic campsite where you wake up with the relaxing sounds of a babbling river, whistling birds and rustling leaves. This makes Camping le Bois Flottant an excellent destination for people who like to go back to basics during their holiday.

Camping amid the countryside

You can pick your own pitch on this site that has been beautifully incorporated into the countryside. As you can see on the map of Camping le Bois Flottant, there are two rows of camping pitches along a central path. The pitches greatly differ in size, shape and the amount of shade, so you really have plenty to choose from. Besides staying on a lovely pitch, you can also spend the night here in a charming safari tent, which is located almost right by the river Agout.

Go for a refreshing swim in the Agout

In the hinterland of Southern France, temperatures can rise considerably in the summer, even in the forest. This campsite's location right by the Agout is therefore favourable. You can cool down swimming or paddling in the shallow river water. There are more forms of entertainment at the campsite itself. There is a darts board, and a jeu de boules court and billiard table are available.

properties.name: Flower Camping Tamarins Plage
properties.description:
Flower Camping Tamarins Plage is a place where you automatically switch into holiday mode. You camp here on the island of Île de Ré, just 300 m from the soft sandy beach of Petit Sergent. The campsite combines tranquillity with great facilities and plenty of entertainment for the whole family. You’ll wake up to the sound of the sea.

Easy camping with mobile homes

You’ll camp in comfort at Tamarins Plage. The mobile homes are modern, fully equipped and ideal for families and groups. No tent poles, no caravan manoeuvring; just roll your suitcase in and start your holiday. The mobile homes are scattered among the greenery, so peace and quiet are guaranteed.

Excellent facilities

The campsite itself has everything you’ll need for a carefree time. Start the day with fresh rolls from reception and then take a refreshing dip in the pool. The children can entertain themselves with little activities and will soon find holiday friends. There’s a small campsite shop for everyday essentials, so you don't need to leave the site for them.

Explore the island

Île de Ré is begging to be discovered and you can head out into it from Tamarins Plage in no time at all. Pedal at a leisurely pace to Saint-Martin-de-Ré (7 km) or La Flotte (9.5 km) and enjoy the cosy little ports, terraces and boutiques. Climb the Phare des Baleines (17 km) for great views of the island and the Atlantic coast. The salt marshes at Loix and Ars-en-Ré (8 km) are a must for nature lovers.

properties.name: Camping Huttopia Forêt de Janas
properties.description:
Are you looking for a campsite from which you can take beautiful walks through unspoilt nature? But a campsite that also offers adequate comfort and entertainment? Then Huttopia Forêt de Janas Campsite is the ideal place for you! This campsite is located in the vast, hilly forest of La Forêt de Janas, on a peninsula in the Var department of southern France. This makes it an excellent holiday destination for hiking enthusiasts. But you'll also find many families with children here in high season.

Naturally landscaped camping pitches

At this campsite you can choose from camping pitches in three comfort levels. No matter what you choose, you're certain to enjoy a real camping experience. All pitches are beautifully integrated into nature. Campers also enjoy plenty of privacy.

In addition to touring pitches, Huttopia Forêt de Janas has numerous rental accommodations, such as charming gypsy wagons and various lodge tents and chalets. Thanks in part to the help of a mobility consultancy, one of the chalets has been made barrier-free and is therefore suitable for people with limited mobility.

Cool off in the pool or in the sea

There is a heated swimming pool and paddling pool at the front of the campsite. This is an ideal place to swim a few laps or to just cool down on hot summer days. Around the pool is a beautiful deck terrace, where parasols and some trees provide a bit of shade. Do you prefer to swim in the sea? Then you can reach the beautiful beaches on the east side of the peninsula by taking a nice half-hour walk through the forest.

properties.name: Walch's Camping & Landhaus
properties.description:
Walch's Camping & Landhaus is located in a beautiful valley, centrally located in the Vorarlberg region. The open pitches offer a beautiful view of the surrounding mountains. Camping guests enjoy the wellness centre at the campsite and spectacular hiking and biking tours throughout the area. In winter, this is an excellent base for winter sports enthusiasts.

Open pitches with mountain view

The flat lawns on which the pitches are laid out are well maintained. The sunny touring pitches are not separated from each other. That is why Thomas indicates where you can stand and how big your pitch is. Normally caravans and motorhomes are set up in such a way that campers do not 'spoil' each other's view. This means that you don't look at the back of the neighbour's campervan, but that you have a clear view of the surrounding mountains as much as possible. In the country house are also attractive and luxurious rooms for rent.

Swimming and shopping in Braz

Fresh bread is available to order at Walch's Camping & Landhaus. For further shopping the Spar in Braz is the nearest option. A little further down the road in Braz you will find an outdoor swimming pool which you can use as a camping guest. On the campsite itself you will find a large playground with a football field, a volleyball court and a climbing pyramid.

Sanitary building with wellness centre

The beautiful wellness area of this campsite can be found on the second floor of the sanitary building. Various saunas, tanning beds and infrared cabins are available here. Before or after you can relax in the furnished sitting area or on the terrace in front of the building. The modern facilities on the ground floor are cleaned regularly.

properties.name: Flaeming-Camping
properties.description:
If you like the countryside, cycling and have always wanted to visit Berlin, Flaeming-Camping-Oehna could be your ideal destination. This naturally green, well-maintained campsite is just under 700 kilometres from Utrecht. The campsite is on the Flaeming-Skate. That is a unique network of car-free cycle paths where you can cycle or skate safely in relaxed way. With an outdoor swimming pool around the corner, excellent amenities in Berlin as a great option for a day trip, nothing stands in your way from having a wonderful holiday.

Simply a good campsite

The campsite is quiet, small scale and well organised. The camping pitches are spacious, and you can choose between pitches in the sun or shade. Whether you come with a small tent or a motorhome, the amenities such as power supply, water points and water discharge are in good order. The toilet and washing facilities are also neatly maintained. You don't have to leave the campsite for breakfast as they have a bread roll service. You can also get some groceries. There is a small playground for children. In short: no fuss but simply a good campsite.

Water fun in the Freibad

There is an outdoor swimming pool, the Freibad Oehna, right next to the campsite. It's ideal for cooling down and for water fun in the summer. Relax on the sunbathing meadow on a hot summer day or jump in the pool after a day of cycling or walking. The town of Jüterbog is a 10-minute drive or 30-minute cycle ride away. It's an authentic town with amenities such as a supermarket and lovely traditional restaurants. If you didn't bring your bike, you can hire bikes at the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Praha Klánovice
properties.description:
Close to Prague and in the middle of the woods: sounds like the best of both worlds, and quite rightly so! Camping Praha Klánovice is ideal for a comfortable and active holiday for all kinds of groups: senior guests, families with young children or with teenagers, in fact, for everyone. What can they all do here? Swim a few laps in the swimming pool, go on walking or cycling trips, explore Prague and enjoy the peace and quiet upon return.

Modern and well maintained

You arrive at a very well maintained and organised campsite with modern reception and buildings. The employees in the reception provide you with all kinds of information about the campsite, transport and the surrounding area. On the way to the pitch, you will see several sports fields and some playground equipment.

Spacious pitches with privacy

The pitches are spacious and offer ample privacy. The camping pitches are numbered, all of the same size and are located on well-tended grass. Some pitches have more shade than others. There are also several rental mobile homes and tents, which are modern and clean. The other guests are mainly families with children (including teenagers) from several European countries.

Large swimming pool

There is a beautiful, large pool to swim a few lengths, complete with lawn (in full sun). In peak season excursions are organised daily and entertainment with sports and games is provided for children.

Supermarket and lovely restaurant

The campsite has a well-stocked supermarket, where you can buy fresh bread each day. The tastefully furnished restaurant-café has a cosy terrace and offers a view of the swimming pool. The ablution blocks are modern and have a toilet and shower for disabled persons.

properties.name: Camping La Ribière
properties.description:
This campsite is a real gem for those who prefer to spend their holidays in unspoilt nature. Motorways and urban bustle are nowhere to be found in this part of the Alpes-de-Haute-Provence. Moreover, La Ribière Campsite is a great base for going on beautiful hikes. Mountain bikers, climbers and kayakers will also enjoy themselves in this rugged environment. There are several historic sites in the area, including the medieval village of Annot, which the campsite is right next to. Furthermore, this is a quiet campsite with modern facilities.

Beautifully laid out campsite on two levels

The camping area offers abundant greenery and is situated on two levels. The pitches are slightly larger in the lower part of the campsite (near the river). There are smaller pitches designated for tent campers in front of the reception. There are also a number of accommodations for rent, such as chalets and lodge tents.

La Ribière has a neat sanitary block with modern facilities that are well maintained. This sanitary block is also heated. This building is easily accessible for people with reduced mobility.

Visit the bar for a tasty snack and drink

This campsite features a small but cosy bar with a beautiful terrace. Some tasty meals are also served there. The house specialities? These are the carefully composed salads and the home-made pizzas. You can also order your breakfast for the next day here. The nearest large supermarket is just a few minutes' walk from the campsite.

properties.name: Recreatiepark Het Eperwoud
properties.description:
Recreatiepark Het Eperwoud is situated in a forested area in the Veluwe between Epe and Heerde. This campsite is located along a beautiful cycling route and a sheepfold. These woolly herd animals can be found wandering the open heath in the summer. The Veluwe is a magnificent nature reserve with many forests, ideal for exploring by bike. The campsite has a fine brasserie.

Spacious campsite

At the campsite, you will camp on lovely green fields. Hedges and trees scattered around the grounds provide the necessary shade. A comfort pitch measures 100 m2 and is suitable for a maximum of six people. Wherever you camp, the sanitation building is always within walking distance.

Lovely rental accommodations

Campers who don't have their own camping equipment can stay in one of the rental accommodations on the grounds. Options include a fully equipped woorden log cabin, a safari tent or a cosy cabin. Each accommodation has its own level of comfort.

Food and drink

The brasserie serves a variety of warm meals. But you can also choose to have a drink on the terrace. There is also entertainment Entertainment is also available, every weekend in July and August a cosy evening with, for example, live music, a beer tasting or a barbecue is organised.

Adjoining the terrace is a playground with fun play equipment. A second playground with sandpit can be found elsewhere on the campsite grounds. The pétanque court is ideal for challenging your fellow campers to a friendly game.

properties.name: Camping Altea
properties.description:
Just a few kilometres from the Mediterranean Sea, in the Languedoc-Roussillon wine region, is Camping Altea. This is a campsite on the popular southern French coast where you will still experience a small-scale camping feeling. From the beach to the amusement park and from centuries-old cathedrals to wineries, in this beautiful area between Montpellier, Sète and Agde there is something for everyone.

Small-scale feeling

Camping Altea has a small-scale atmosphere and a good balance between pitches and rental accommodation, such as mobile homes and bungalows. The sanitary facilities are neat and also accessible to disabled people. The campsite is located in the small village of Vic-la-Gardiole, between the towns of Montpellier and Sète.

Water fun and entertainment on dry land

The youngest campers won't be bored for a moment at Camping Altea. In July and August they can join in with the entertainment programme and get their feet off the floor during the disco evenings. A bouncy castle completes the holiday feeling.

You can splash around in the campsite's swimming pool with paddling pool. The pools are ecological and beautifully designed with natural stone. Don't expect spectacular swimming pools with slides, just a place to enjoy a nice swim during a warm southern French day.

Restaurant and wine tasting

For some snacks, fries and pizza you can go to the campsite's restaurant. In the summer there are also fresh rolls and some groceries available. In the village you'll find some small supermarkets and bakeries within walking and cycling distance. And while we're on the subject of food and drink: you're camping here in the Languedoc-Roussillon region: the largest wine region in France.

properties.name: Camping Mohrenhof
properties.description:
Camping Mohrenhof lies in the Bavarian countryside, close to the medieval town of Rothenburg. Here you pitch your tent at the beautiful swimming lake. Children have a great time in the indoor play hall or with an alpaca walk or pony ride. Want to go out for the day? Then drive to Rothenburg ob der Tauber (14 km). On your return, enjoy your meal on the terrace of the campsite restaurant SeeKneipe.

Camping with charm

Every camping pitch at Camping Mohrenhof has its own charm. Do you prefer a pitch at the edge of the campsite? Or on one of the terraces? And what about a spot by the bathing lake? The comfort pitches are extra large. You can also rent accommodation. Choose, for example, a gypsy wagon, tiny house, sleeping barrel or chalet. Extra fun are the campsite's typical fire pits.

Swimming, wakeboarding and aqua park

Do you fancy taking a boat out on the water or a nice refreshing swim? The campsite is located directly to a swimming lake. So you can jump straight into the water from your caravan or tent. There is a small sandy beach on the shore, where you can sunbathe. It is also possible to do some wakeboarding on the water or to run and jump over the obstacles in the aquapark.

Alpaca walks and archery

At Camping Mohrenhof, young and old enjoy themselves. For example, you can take an archery course here. Animal lovers can cuddle alpacas and hike with these woolly animals. Or how about a fun pony ride? Children also have fun in the indoor playground, on go-karts and with a game of adventure golf.

properties.name: Campingpark Buntspecht
properties.description:
Havelland is a forested area near the town of Rathenow. Campingpark Buntspecht is located in the midst of this lovely, sparsley populated area. The property borders a long lake, just outside of the village of Ferchesar in the Westhavelland nature reserve. A fantastic place for anyone looking to enjoy the peace and nature. Fantastic biking and hikes in the area. Berlin is naturally a top destination for a day trip. You reach the city quickly and easily by train (three quarters of an hour from Rathenow).

Spacious pitches

The camping pitches of Campingpark Buntspecht are spacious and located on a large camping field with large pine trees and some deciduous trees here and there. There is dense, forest vegetation along the edge. The pitches have a great substrate ground of grass. The sanitary facilities are fantastic, clean and have all comforts. If you want to rent accommodations, choose one of the nice new cottages.

Swimming and boating

There is no pool at Campingpark Buntspecht. If you want to swim, you can swim in the long lake accessible right from the campsite. The banks have a thick reed bed, but there is a beach where you can get into the water. You can hire boats not far from the campsite. So take a lovely afternoon out on the water...

Charming restaurant and well stocked camping shop

The restaurant has a cheery atmosphere. You can also eat well! There is a spacious terrace with a nice view of the greenery and the campsite. In the reception building you'll find a nice camping shop with a limited assortment.

properties.name: Campingplatz Saalthal-Alter
properties.description:
Do you like to holiday in quiet surroundings and enjoy water sports and beautiful walks? Then Campingplatz Saalthal-Alter near the hamlet of Bucha in Thuringia is the ideal destination for you. With its own beach and jetties on the Hohenwarte Stausee, there are plenty of water sports options. You can also head off on beautiful walks and bike rides in wooded surroundings around this beautiful reservoir. The campsite is well-kept and has modern facilities.

Camp with an unobstructed view of the lake

This campsite has a relatively high percentage of permanent pitches. There are plenty of tourist pitches too. Most are located along the lake and some touring pitches even have a clear view of the water. Don't have your own tent, caravan or motor home but still want to stay at this four-star campsite? You can rent comfortable caravans and cosy sleeping caravans. All campers use one large toilet and washing block with a special section for children, with colourful decorations and lowered sinks.

Private beach and jetties

The location of this campsite is perfect for water sports enthusiasts, right on the Hohenwarte Stausee. The campsite has a long grass and pebble beach alongside this lake. It’s ideal for a refreshing dip. There are also two large jetties. Reserve a spot for your own boat there, or rent a kayak, pedal boat or motorboat. Need a boat licence? You can buy one at the campsite. At reception, there’s also a shop that sells essentials and camping items and offers a breakfast service.

properties.name: Camping Forteca
properties.description:
Camping Forteca is close to the town of Uciechów, not far from the Krkonoše (south-west Poland). You can camp in a lovely, partly hilly region with plenty of castles. The large swimming lake takes pride of place on the site. In addition, camping pitches are located on little fields. A whole range of fun family activities are arranged on family camping Forteca. You won't be bored outside the campsite either. The versatile area allows you to enjoy nature and a whole range of cultural excursions.

Lovely grounds around the pretty lake

The site is lovely and offers plenty of comfort. The camping pitches are located on grass fields planted with trees, around a lovely swimming lake. The edge of the site is set apart by a thick row of trees. You can also see plenty of greenery around the pond. The lake is ideal for both swimming and sailing.

A range of fabulous rental accommodation is available on the site: select a stylishly furnished guest home on the farm or go for one of the lovely wooden chalets. The sanitary facilities are tidy and are well maintained.

Barbecue or watch sport together

Anyone who loves barbecues will find this campsite perfect for them. There are permanent barbecue areas complete with tables and chairs. There is also a large communal barbecue. Anyone preferring to have their food made for them can head to the farm restaurant. Apart from a tasty lunch, they also serve a lovely breakfast or dinner here. 

This space also functions as a communal area, and is a great place for meeting other guests and watching sports together, for example. There is a terrace with wonderful lounge chairs outside, and a pretty border of flowers and bushes.

properties.name: Camping Le Siléo
properties.description:
Camping l'Anjou is a small campsite near the village of Montesquiou. The campsite is situated in a hilly area, amidst vast corn fields and forests. This is an environment where the air is still clean and nature is untouched. This makes it an ideal holiday destination for those seeking peace and quiet and nature lovers. In high season this campsite is also suitable for families with (young) children.

Green campsite

The pitches have privacy and shade thanks to the many shrubs, hedges and trees. There is also some variation in the shape of the touring pitches. Do you prefer to stay in rental accommodation? Then opt for a glamping tent, hiker's hut, bungalow or mobile home.

Sheltered outdoor swimming pool

In the centre of the campsite you will find a swimming pool to take a refreshing dip on sultry summer days. Although this pool is not overly large, it has three different depths. This makes it easily accessible even for small children. The pool is surrounded by trees and shrubs that provide pleasant shelter.

Sports, games and entertainment

At the edge of the campsite, picnic tables and table tennis tables are set up under a barn. On the right you will find a beach volleyball court. Children will have a lot of fun with the petting zoo and the entertainment programmes (only in high season). Books and games can be borrowed at the bar.

Restaurant with attractive pavement café

In high season the campsite restaurant is open. The dishes or snacks from the modest menu taste good on the beautiful patio. Fresh bread is also available. The nearest large supermarkets can be found in the towns of Mirande and Marciac, about fifteen minutes by car from the campsite.

properties.name: Nuraghe Ruiu Holiday Village and Campsite
properties.description:
If you like seeking out the peace of an unspoiled nature area in a sparsely populated area during your holiday, Nuraghe Ruiu Holiday Village and Campsite in Sant'Ignazio on Sardinia is the ideal holiday destination for you. You can go on countryside walks for hours on end around this campsite without bumping into anyone. This part of the Sardinian hinterland is mainly known for its many archaeological sites and lovely inland lakes, where you can see exceptional animal species in the wild. With an outdoor swimming pool, a restaurant and a bar, the campsite itself offers the requisite comfort and relaxation.

Explore the site and pick your favourite spot

Charming bungalows are spread over the campsite. This campsite is mainly aimed at tourist campers. You can pick and set up your own pitch at this spaciously appointed campsite. The campsite has something for everyone, as it has shaded as well as sunny areas. And no matter whether you stay in a bungalow or on a camping pitch, you have free Wi-Fi all over.

Enjoy Sardinian specialities

There is a lovely swimming pool at the front of the campsite. It includes two paddling pools, making this a great place for families with young children. And for campers who like to bring their dog, because the swimming pool at Nuraghe Ruiu Holiday Village and Campsite has its own dog pool. Beside the swimming pool, you will find a lovely bar and a good restaurant, with various Sardinian specialities on the menu.

properties.name: Camping Paradis La Baie de Ploemeur
properties.description:
Camping Paradis La Baie de Ploemeur is in a prime location on the Breton coast. You camp near the Atlantic Ocean, with everything you need for a relaxing and active holiday. Mobile homes, glamping tents, a great entertainment programme and a lovely atmosphere make this a wonderful place for young and old. Thanks to its elevated location, you can enjoy sea views from various places on the campsite.

Camp with a sea view

You sleep in comfort at this campsite. On this two-hectare site, you can choose between modern mobile homes, compactly-designed and with plenty of sun. Some are on pitches overlooking the Atlantic Ocean. Want something a little different? Then head to the Coco Sweet: a cosy glamping tent with a cosy feel.

Every convenience within hand’s reach

You will want for nothing at Camping Paradis La Baie de Ploemeur. Start the day with fresh rolls from the bread-roll service or buy everything you need for breakfast from the well-stocked campsite shop. Don't fancy cooking? Join us at the restaurant or have a drink on the bar's cosy terrace. Relax in the TV room inside. There’s also free wi-fi access everywhere. Your dog is welcome too.

Always something to do

There’s plenty to entertain yourself with from morning to night. Take a dip in the heated outdoor pool or join in with the aquagym and water polo. On sunny days, relax on a lounger by the water while the children have fun on the campsite playground or in the kids' club.

properties.name: Camping les Naïades
properties.description:
Camping Les Naïades is situated in the heart of the French Ardennes. Just outside the quiet village of Châtel-Chéhéry, you can camp here among the forests, hills and winding country lanes. You can hear birds singing, walk straight into nature and completely unwind. With spacious pitches, comfortable bungalows and excellent facilities such as a swimming pool, this is a wonderful place for a holiday in the countryside.

Camping surrounded by greenery

Camping Les Naïades has around 100 camping pitches dotted across a wooded site covering three hectares. The pitches are spacious and often surrounded by greenery, offering plenty of privacy and natural shade. Some pitches are beautifully situated by the fishing pond. Prefer a bit more comfort? Then choose one of the well-maintained bungalows. These accommodation units have their own terraces, a lovely spot to peacefully wake up to in the morning with a cup of coffee. Your four-legged friends are also welcome at the campsite.

Enjoy swimming, animals and the friendly atmosphere

Both young and old can enjoy themselves at the campsite. On warm days, the heated swimming pool is a popular spot. Swim a few laps or let the children splash about in the shallow end. There are also sports fields, a pump track, and the entertainment team regularly organises activities such as creative workshops and sports tournaments. For a bite to eat or a drink, head over to the welcoming bistro with bar. And if you are travelling with children, the little mini-farm is a lovely place to encounter animals up close.

properties.name: Camping Domaine des Mathevies
properties.description:
Camping Domaine des Mathevies is situated in the heart of the Dordogne Valley in Sainte-Nathalène. This small-scale yet modern campsite has a relaxed atmosphere. All the necessary facilities are within easy reach. Perfect for families who enjoy peace and quiet, but who also like to explore the surroundings.

Unique accommodation and spacious camping pitches

Don’t have your own camping equipment? At Camping Domaine des Mathevies, there are several chalets and cottages available for rent. Of course, you can also book one of the spacious camping pitches, with a choice of wooded pitches or spots with a view over the valley.

Everything within arm's reach

Despite the campsite’s humble size, there is no shortage of amenities. For example, there are two swimming pools (open daily from 09.30 to 21.00), equipped with sun loungers and parasols. The children can burn off some energy at the playground or in the sandpit. Fancy a game? Then why not have a go at a round of boules or (table) tennis.

You don’t need to leave the campsite to enjoy a meal. The Cosy Nook Café serves fresh croissants in the morning and delicious meals from food trucks in the evening. Think galettes & crêpes, stone-baked pizzas, Vietnamese specialities, fish ’n chips and gourmet burgers. Vegetarian and vegan menu items are always available, as are children’s portions. Want to keep waste to a minimum? Feel free to bring your own plates and cutlery.

Explore the area

The Dordogne region is known for its traditional villages and impressive castles. Visit, for example, the medieval town of Sarlat-la-Canéda (8 km) or the village of Sainte-Nathalène (3 km). Be sure to explore the Lascaux Caves (24 km) too.

properties.name: Camping La Sierrecilla
properties.description:
Camping La Sierrecilla is situated some 70 kilometres from the Spanish south coast, right in between the cities of Sevilla, Málaga, Granada and Cordoba. The campsite, overlooking the vineyards of a wooded hill, is open and uncluttered. Children can play to their heart's content in the beautiful swimming pool and on the ropes course. The facilities on the campsite, such as the sanitary facilities, are modern, but maintenance could be improved upon in places. Because of its favourable location, the campsite is particularly suitable for excursions to one of the Spanish cities.

Sunny and shaded pitches

The campsite is mostly flat and orderly. The campsite has some 120 touring pitches, which can be reached via well-maintained pathways. Many of the pitches are located in the sun, while others are shaded by trees or shade cloths. The sun can get rather hot there, hence a pitch in the shade is not a mere luxury. On the perimeter of the campsite are a few chalets and bungalows constructed in the same style as the reception building.

Swimming pool

Centrally located on the campsite you will find the beautiful swimming pool with an adjacent toddler pool. Safe for children as there is always a pool attendant on duty. You can soak up the sun on the (really green) lawn around the pool. Please note: the swimming pool is open from June through September. Therefore, if you stay here in the low season, the swimming pool will probably be closed.

Climbing wall and zip-line

Children can thoroughly enjoy themselves on campsite La Sierrecilla. Besides the offered entertainment, the ropes course is especially popular: here they can play the hero on a climbing wall, dangling rope bridges and an exciting zip-line.

properties.name: Camping Ty-Coët
properties.description:
Close to the attractive town of Vannes, in the heart of Southern Brittany, lies the child- friendly campsite Ty-Coët. Here you can spend you holidays in your own camping equipment on spacious pitches. But you can also opt for one of the mobile homes which the campsite has available. This campsite offers ample shade thanks to the large number of trees. Campsite Ty-Coët has a veritable water paradise, where children in particular will have a great time. In this part of Brittany you are always close to nature. There are also many historic villages and towns that are well worth a visit.

Camping or renting?

The campsite is open throughout the year. On this family camping, there are about 40 pitches for people with their own camping equipment and you can rent a mobile home. The sanitary facilities on the campsite are more than adequate for the number of guests. The sanitary facilities are cleaned on a regular basis.

Water fun!

Entertainment is available in the form of an indoor heated swimming pool measuring 13 x 7 m. It has a maximum depth of 1.25 m. It is surrounded by a sunbathing lawn with loungers and sun umbrellas. In addition, there is a wonderful water park for children which is open in good weather.

Shopping in the vicinity

Although the campsite does not have its own shop or restaurant, you will find shops and catering facilities in the immediate vicinity. For your shopping you can, for instance, head for the Intermarché in Surzur (two km).

properties.name: Camping Borje
properties.description:
Borje Campsite is located in the beautiful Lika region of Croatia, just south of the village of Korencia. It is an ideal place for active nature lovers who want to experience the beauty of the Croatian forests and lakes. You'll be camping close to Plitvice Lakes National Park. The campsite features a playground and a number of sports fields where you can play to your heart's content.

Choose your own pitch

The campsite is located on an open area surrounded by woods and is divided into several flat, grassy terraces. You're free to choose your own camping pitch after checking in. You park your car at your camping spot. This well-maintained campsite is surrounded by nature and offers a beautiful setting for camping and relaxing.

Discover the beautiful nature

Most visitors come to this beautiful campsite in order to enjoy the nearby national park. But there's also plenty for children to do at the campsite. In addition to discovering the beautiful nature, they can enjoy themselves on the playground. You can play a game of table tennis, grass volleyball, football or hanging bowling on the sports fields.

Take the shuttle bus to Plitvice

While visiting this campsite, you shouldn't miss the Plitvice lakes. These sixteen lakes are surrounded by beautiful forests and nature and are connected by endless waterfalls. The campsite is only 16 kilometres from the Plitvice National Park. A shuttle bus takes you from the campsite to the entrance of the park each day.

properties.name: Camping Aktief
properties.description:
Camp Aktief is located in the nature reserve of Adršpach-Broumov, in the northern part of the Czech Republic near the Polish border. You camp here on the property of the hospitable Dutch owners Mien and Bert near the village of Vernéřovice. Explore the varied nature on foot and by bike, such as the special rock formations in Adršpach.

Welcome!

In addition to pitches in the yard, the campsite also has a holiday home. Here you can stay in several luxury apartments. Besides a stove and refrigerator you can use a dishwasher, oven, shower and toilet. The house is heated by underfloor heating, but there is also a cosy wood-burning stove. Even more luxury: for a fee and by appointment you can step into the large six-person sauna in the farmhouse of the owners.

Environmentally friendly campsite

The underfloor heating of the holiday home and all the hot water are heated by solar collectors. In addition, the campsite has its own water purification system, which purifies the waste water so that it flows clean into the stream. The sanitary facilities are well cleaned.

Rocks of Adršpach

At Camping Aktief you camp in a beautiful and extensive nature reserve. Just over ten kilometres away from the town of Adršpach are the rocks of Adršpach. In the midst of forests and lakes, these strange rock formations protrude steeply into the air. Via wooden footpaths you can admire the rocks, which tower like raised hands above the trees, from all sides. If you don't want to go out on your own, the Dutch campsite owners will be happy to take you on an excursion.

properties.name: Min y Don Holiday Home Park
Orchard View Caravan and Camping Park
Camping La Ferme des Hauts Frênes
Camping La Clé des Champs
properties.description:
Camping La Clé des Champs is a small-scale campsite in the Vendée countryside. You will camp in the unspoilt surroundings of Luçon, in the Marais Poitevin Regional Natural Park. The campsite has very spacious touring pitches, situated under the trees on the park-like grounds. Authentic buildings house the reception, a shop with local produce and modern sanitary facilities.

Peace, space and nature

Peace, space and nature surround you when you camp on the grounds of camping La Clé des Champs. The many trees give a park-like impression. Beneath the trees there are 27 very spacious touring pitches (of at least 200 m2), delimited in pairs or set of fours. Tables for a picnic are scattered between the pitches. You can also spend the night in a gîte. This old stone house has been completely renovated, without losing its authentic features, such as the heavy wooden beams.

Farmers life

Agnès and François are passionate about their peasant life and are happy to share their passion and knowledge with their camping guests. Every Tuesday you can find out all about their work and the region in a special way. François will take you on a trip through the polder landscape on his tractor with a covered wagon. Children can also explore the area from the back of a donkey.

Breakfast with croissants

In the reception building you can buy some local products, but every morning there are also sandwiches and croissants available. If that's not enough for you, you can also sit down on the sidewalk café with a complete breakfast. Are you looking for a nice restaurant? You’ll find it at walking distance in the centre of Luçon.

properties.name: Camping Le Bois de Beaumard
properties.description:
Camping Le Bois de Beaumard is on the edge of the La Grande Brière nature park, hidden among the trees. Wake up to bird song. Walkers and cyclists are well catered for with beautiful routes in the area. Families feel at home here very quickly thanks to the small size of the campsite and peaceful atmosphere.

Camp in green surroundings

Some of the pitches are in the woods and some in bright clearings, giving you a choice between shade and sun. They are surrounded by greenery and feel very private. You can also opt for a modern mobile home or a lovely rental caravan. The toilet and washing facilities have a family area with low-level toilets for children. Great if you're travelling with young children.

Animal cuddling, boules competitions and good food

A game of boules, table football, darts or jumping on the trampoline. There’s plenty to do for young and old alike. The animals in the petting zoo include chickens, guinea pigs, rabbits and a goat. Children can come along to feed the animals. In spring, you might even be able to cuddle baby animals!

Don't fancy cooking at the campsite? In high season, you can order a tasty pizza or snack. And for a refreshing drink, take a seat on the sunny terrace. Fresh rolls are available in the morning if you order them the day before.

From the campsite, it’s five minutes to the edge of the La Grande Brière marshland. The Atlantic coast is half an hour away by car too.

properties.name: Camping a la ferme Mon Repos
Camping Trouvé
properties.description:
Outsider and mini camping Trouvé, located in the Puy-de-Dôme (Auvergne), does not really qualify for any star ranking. There is no shop, no restaurant and also no entertainment. However, in terms of setting, atmosphere and ecological character it is worth five stars and more! In a former farmstead near the town of La Crouzille the two owners have achieved their unique Garden of Eden.

Quiet and space

Trouvé offers seven bewitchingly beautiful touring pitches on the edge of the terrain. These measure some 140 m2 each and are separated by trees and bushes. The pitches are surrounded by a wealth of flowers and plants. Privacy is therefore guaranteed. The modest swimming pool lies in the heart of the campsite. 

Don't have your own camping equipment? In the farmhouse there are two attractive gîtes available for rent. One gîte is suitable for two persons (in the former stable) and one gîte for five persons (in the former hay barn). In addition, there is a dormitory for up to eight persons available.

Sustainability reigns!

For maintaining the campsite the owners use only non-chemical products. In addition to water-saving showers and toilets (where use is made of spring water) the campsite also has its own vegetable garden. A unique feature is the septic tank, a water purification system, whereby waste water is purified through sedimentation.

Massage and shiatsu

The majority of guests at Campsite Trouvé are Dutch families. In low season these are mainly senior citizens. The owners clear focus on this target group. This is reflected in the fact that both have qualifications in sports relaxation massage and shiatsu (Japanese body therapy). After a long walk or strenuous cycling trip you can therefore have a relaxing massage...

properties.name: Camping à la Ferme de Rivet
Camping La Corconne
properties.description:
A lovely family campsite in a unique location in a rugged nature reserve. Camping La Corconne is north of the French city of Montpellier in the department of Gard. Camping beside the beautiful River Hérault and amid the trees is a wonderful experience for people seeking peace and nature lovers. A friendly, non-nonsense atmosphere dominates the campsite with neat facilities, such as a lovely restaurant with its own pizza oven. Children can play and swim in the river's clean water that can be reached directly from the campsite. There are stunning walking and cycling routes in the immediate vicinity.

Camping in the Southern French countryside

The nature-rich campsite is quite remote and surrounded by unspoilt nature. The small bridge measuring 2.5 metres wide and the steep incline to get to the campsite make it extremely difficult with motorhomes and caravans longer than 6.5 metres.

Once you arrive at the campsite, you will see a lovely restaurant with covered patio by reception. The owners hold nature close to their hearts and have set up the campsite with that in mind. Everything has been constructed with respect for the surroundings.

Relax amid the natural greenery

This terraced campsite has 33 camping pitches with natural demarcation and mainly in the shade. Campers are spread out in the forest and by the river with the sound of the babbling water in the background. There is more than enough space and privacy. There is also a tent field if you are camping with a tent or coming with a small group.

If you want to enjoy the comfort of a chalet or a lovely lodge, or enjoy a holiday in a small romantic gîte, you can here!

properties.name: Camping Le Mouretou
properties.description:
Camping Le Mouretou is a small-scale campsite in the Cevennes National Park. This campsite is situated in the valley of the river Hérault. You will camp on intimate lawns that offer a view of the surrounding mountains. The Mont Aigoual, whose summit is thirty kilometres from the campsite, is the highest mountain in the Gard department. A climb of the mountain (by car or bicycle) pays off, because the view is beautiful.

Intimate camping lawns
