The campsite Le Mouretou is situated on a branch of the Hérault. A murmuring brooklet flows along the campsite. There are 25, large enough, touring pitches situated on intimate camping fields. This gives you the real camping feeling: camping in nature and in peace and quiet. The rental accommodations can be called quite special. In addition to mobile homes, there are a number of attractive lodge tents and bivouac tents on stilts.

Swimming pool and river

The swimming pool is situated near the entrance of the campsite, in a sheltered spot between shrubs, hedges and trees. This outdoor pool is not large, but large enough for a small-scale campsite. For the children it is also nice to walk to the river. Within a few steps you are at the quietly flowing water, where you can paddle or build dams.

Pizza

You'll find conviviality and and good food in the campsite's restaurant. The professionalism and good food is shown by the fact that this restaurant is also used for weddings and parties. Take a seat in the attractive restaurant or on the spacious terrace for a pizza from the wood-burning oven and a large ice cream.

properties.name: Camping Au Jardin de la Ferme
King's Lynn Caravan and Camping Park
Camping de kleine Stroet
properties.description:
Camping de kleine Stroet is a campsite in Voorthuizen, Gelderland. The campsite has pitches without shade and pitches with some shade.

The following rules apply to pets at (Camping de kleine Stroet):

- Dog(s) permitted in low season (if on a lead)

- Dog(s) permitted in high season (if on a lead)

For sportive holidaymakers the camp site offers various cycle routes.

You can also use the internet, as you can access the internet with your own laptop in 100% of the camp site.

properties.name: Camping De Sangershoeve
properties.description:
Camping De Sangershoeve is situated in the peaceful Limburg village of Ohé en Laak, on the Meuse and nestled amid the lakes of Maasplassen. At this adults-only camping site, relaxation is the top priority. You can camp here in the tranquil surroundings, immersed in nature and water. A lovely spot for those who love nature, open spaces and tranquillity.

Camping at an old farmhouse

This mini-campsite features spacious pitches of around 125 m², situated in a former orchard. Motorhomes up to eight metres long are welcome and can be safely parked on special paved pitches. All pitches are located around an old farmhouse dating from the early 17th century. Prefer a little more comfort? Four spacious apartments for 2 to 4 people have been converted in the upper part of the tithe barn. Alternatively, you can spend the night in a restored retro caravan or a modern camping pod.

Simplicity and tranquillity

De Sangershoeve is a small-scale campsite that focuses on simplicity, quality and tranquillity. Only guests aged 18 and over are welcome here, which helps to create a peaceful atmosphere. Cyclists can make use of the covered bike shed, which is equipped with charging points for e-bikes. That means you can hop on your bike every day without a care in the world. And why not challenge your fellow campers to a game of boules? You can also use the washing machine, refrigerator and microwave, and there is also free WiFi.

An adventure in Central Limburg

Just a stone's throw away is the Molenplas (1 km), ideal for a stroll along the water's edge. Visit Thorn (14 km), the famous white town, or historic Stevensweert (4 km). Water sports enthusiasts can have a blast on the Maasplassen.

properties.name: Blaney Caravan Park and Camping Site
Camping Le Valenty
properties.description:
This campsite is located in a sparsely populated and quiet area in the Lot department of France. Its a place where you can still wake up to the relaxing sounds of birds singing and hedgehogs and squirrels rustling through the bushes. Le Valenty Campsite is a campsite with great respect for nature. The camping pitches on this extensive campsite are situated far apart from one another in the natural surroundings. Moreover, this is a car-free campsite. It is therefore an ideal holiday destination for nature lovers and peace seekers. Fun activities are organised during high season.

Car-free camping pitches in a natural setting

Le Valenty's spacious camping pitches are situated in nature. Some of these camping pitches offer a beautiful view of the surrounding area. Please bear in mind that this is a car-free campsite. This means that you can only drive to your camping pitch during check-in and check-out. You'll be expected to leave your car in the campsite's central parking lot during the rest of your time here. The sanitary facilities are modern, clean and well maintained.

Swim laps in the renovated swimming pool

At the edge of the campsite is an outdoor swimming pool that is large enough to swim laps. There is a separate shallow area at the end of the pool especially for small children. The swimming pool was renovated in 2022 and has a sun terrace and a grassy area.

Treasure hunts and rugby lessons

Fun and unique activities are organised at the campsite during high season. Children can participate in treasure hunts, for example. There are also guided nature walks.

properties.name: Camping Le Bonheur est dans le Pré
Camping Le Bonheur Côté Pré Lestréguéoc
Camping à la Ferme les Pierres Chaudes
Camping Het Groene Hart van Ternaard
Camping De Tulpenweide
properties.description:
Camping De Tulpenweide is a cosy mini campsite on the edge of Breezand, in the heart of the vast bulb fields in the northernmost past of the province of North Holland. The campsite is arranged around a charming farmhouse and is a peaceful base between the North Sea coast and the Amstelmeer. Here, you can combine outdoor life with the beach, water and plenty of opportunities for cycling and walking. A day trip to Texel is possible too.

Exceptional accommodation

The Tulpenweide has varied pitches tailored to the type and size of your camping equipment. You are welcome with your own tent, caravan or motor home, but various rental accommodation options are available too. For example, an American school bus, chalets and glamping tents. This mix makes the campsite suitable for groups with different requirements, from simple camping to comfortable accommodation in a rural setting.

Explore farm life

On arrival, you’re welcomed by enthusiastic and friendly owners, which creates a personal and relaxed atmosphere straight away. The campsite has various facilities, including private toilet and washing facilities in different parts of the site and central toilet and washing facilities in the farmhouse. These central toilet and washing facilities are simple but well cared for, with spacious showers and a rain shower head. The little ones can have fun with farm life and ride on toy tractors and feed the small farm animals. In high season, regular cosy campfire music evenings and tasty dinner parties are organised.

Relax by the water

The campsite is near the Amstelmeer (about 5 km), where you can swim, surf, sail or relax on the beach. Around the water, there are also great paths for walking and along picnicking alongside.

properties.name: Camping De Zwammenberg
properties.description:
Do you enjoy spending your holidays in a quiet setting with a natural atmosphere? Camping De Zwammenberg is located in the rural outskirts of the village of De Moer (North Brabant), at the foot of the Huis ter Heide Nature Reserve. Behind it are the Dunes of Loon and Drunen. This makes it an ideal holiday destination for nature lovers, especially those who want to discover all this natural beauty by bike or on foot. It's also close to the Efteling: World of Wonders theme park and the Beekse Bergen Safari Park. The campsite is small in scale and renowned for its typical Brabant hospitality.

Two open camping fields and luxury hotel rooms

The tourist camping pitches at Camping De Zwammenberg are spread over two car-free camping fields. These are attractive, open grassy areas with touring pitches separated by hedges. All pitches are spacious and include electricity, water connection and drainage, among other amenities.

There are also three comfortable safari tents for rent. There's also a building featuring a few luxury hotel rooms. This building also contains the sanitary facilities for campers to use. The sanitary facilities are clean and tidy.

Go out for a nice meal in Restaurant De Zwammenberg

There's an excellent restaurant located next to the reception. Here you can enjoy both lunch and a wonderful dinner. The menu at Restaurant De Zwammenberg mainly features meat dishes, though there are also several dishes in which oyster mushrooms take centre stage. This restaurant is also known for its casual atmosphere. Every third Sunday of the month you can join us for an extensive Sunday Brunch.

properties.name: Opperland Camping
properties.description:
Opperland Camping is situated in the hilly countryside of the Sauerland, in the in the Medebach region of North Rhine-Westphalia. You can camp at a modestly sized site located here next to a working farm. Ideal if you are looking for tranquility and space. From the site you have sweeping views over the surrounding fields and woods. The personal welcome and friendly atmosphere will very quickly make you feel right at home. The campsite is open all year round.

Large pitches

The modestly sized grounds of Opperland Camping feature spacious pitches for tents, caravans and motorhomes. The camping site is on gently sloping terrain and the pitches are equipped with electricity connections. Water facilities are available centrally on the site. Thanks to the spacious layout, you can enjoy privacy and views of the surrounding countryside. If you are travelling without your own camping equipment, you can opt for a holiday apartment.

Well-maintained facilities and fun activities

There is plenty of space for children to play, with a large playground featuring swings, a trampoline and more. They can also have fun driving go-karts around the grounds. While the children are having fun, you can relax at your pitch or enjoy the view. The rural setting ensures a peaceful atmosphere without large-scale entertainment or crowds.

Enjoy the outdoors around Medebach

Directly from the campsite, you have access to walking and cycling routes through the Medebacher Bergland, which is known for its varied nature and panoramic views. For families, the Aventura climbing and play park in Medebach (12 km) is a popular day out. Winter sports resorts such as Winterberg and Willingen are also just a short drive away.

properties.name: Jindris Autocamp
properties.description:
Amidst cornfields and forests in a beautiful rolling landscape in the Czech Republic, is Jindris Autocamp. This campsite is located in the town of Jindřiš in South Bohemia. This is a small campsite with a relaxed character in clean surroundings. Nature lovers and those looking for peace and quiet will feel right at home here. The campsite is laid out in terraces.

Camping with panoramic views

You are here on a well-maintained campsite. If you are on one of the higher terraces, you drive up over the grassland. The best views of the hilly surroundings can be had from the highest pitches. In addition to touring pitches, there are also a number of accommodation units for rent on this campsite.

Swimming near the campsite

About 700 metres from the campsite is a sand quarry. The water here is of good quality, so you can swim in it. You can also swim in the town of Jindřichův Hradec, about four kilometres from the campsite. Here you will find a real swimming paradise with indoor and outdoor pools and various water slides.

Drinks, ice creams and bread

Ice creams and drinks are available at the campsite reception. The campsite also offers a bread service and there is a spacious kitchen with several fridges. All campers may use these. In Jindřichův Hradec there are several large supermarkets. Here you will also find authentic restaurants where you can dine at a reasonable price.

In the surrounding area

There is a narrow-gauge railway running close to the campground, over which an authentic steam train travels. This railway connects Jindřichův Hradec with Nová Bystřice, where the train also stops in Jindřis. A steam train ride is a special experience and very convenient if you want to visit the historic town of Jindřichův Hradec.

properties.name: Autokemp Tanvaldská Kotlina
properties.description:
Autokemp Tanvaldská Kotlina is situated on the outskirts of Tanvald, in the Liberec region of the Czech Republic, between the Jizerské hory and the Krkonoše Mountains. You will camp here in a green valley by a river. This is an ideal base for hikers, cyclists and winter sports enthusiasts. The campsite is located in a quiet, natural setting within walking distance of the centre of Tanvald, with shops and restaurants within easy reach.

Camping pitches and basic accommodation

The campsite has spacious pitches for tents, caravans and motorhomes. The pitches are on a grassy field, partly sheltered by trees. Electricity hook-ups are available. You can also stay overnight in simple wooden cabins, suitable for those travelling without their own camping equipment. The accommodation is furnished for practical use. Sanitary facilities with showers and toilets are centrally located on the site.

Facilities for active campers

Autokemp Tanvaldská Kotlina caters to active holidaymakers, families and groups. At the campsite, you will find a restaurant with an outside seating area, a playground and sports facilities such as a volleyball court. There is a communal fire pit and regular activities are organised in high season. The campsite is pet-friendly and, partly due to its simple layout, is ideal for campers who want to spend most of their time outdoors.

Discover mountains, nature and day trips

In the surrounding area, you can enjoy beautiful walks and cycle rides in the Jizerské hory. There are also plenty of fun things to do with children, such as racing down the pump track or playing a round of mini-golf. The Tanvaldský Špičák observation tower is about five kilometres away. The Harrachov mountain area (12 km) is known for its waterfalls and ski jumps. Liberec, with its zoo and the Ještěd Tower, is 25 kilometres away.

properties.name: Verona City Camping Castel San Pietro
Camping La Belle Étoile
properties.description:
Camping La Belle Étoile is located at the edge of the picturesque village of Reygades. This campsite is a hidden gem on a hill in the beautiful Limousin region of France. Here, you will enjoy breathtaking views of the green Lot valley. It’s the perfect place for nature and peace lovers and for families with children too. The sun always shines here and fun and relaxation are guaranteed.

Comfortable pitches

Camping La Belle Étoile has a wide range of shaded and sunny pitches. Whether you have a tent, caravan or motor home, you will always find the right pitch for you here. The toilet and washing facilities are modern and well maintained, making your stay extra comfortable. There are also a range of rental accommodation options.

Excellent facilities

Cool down in the campsite's heated swimming pool, a unique plus in this region. You won’t have to look far for a delicious meal: the campsite restaurant has a tasty menu with local specialities. Fresh bread and local products are available from the shop every day. While the children have fun in the playground or take part in organised activities, you can relax in the bar or on the sun-drenched solarium.

Explore the surrounding area

The picturesque surroundings of the Limousin region are perfect for walking and cycling. Explore small villages and local markets, or venture out on a canoe trip on the river Dordogne. The medieval towns of Collonges-la-Rouge (32 km) and Rocamadour (51 km) are definitely worth a visit too.

properties.name: Camping Muschelgrund
properties.description:
Picture a campsite that borders on the Wadden Sea, a large forest and an extensive heathland. Camping Muschelgrund is a beautiful destination for nature lovers in the broadest sense of the word. Crossing mudflats, walking through the woods or cycling through a varied landscape can all be done right from your pitch. Camping Muschelgrund is about 7 kilometres from Cuxhaven, one of the nicest places in Lower Saxony.

What accommodation options are there?

On the neatly landscaped and well-maintained grounds of this campsite, there are demarcated pitches. As a rule, the largest touring pitches are reserved for large motorhomes and caravans. It is also striking that there are a fair number of fixed pitches. However, the young owners want to realise more touring pitches in the long run.

Enjoy life on the beach at the Wadden Sea

This campsite is an excellent holiday address for those who love life on the beach. To get to the vast Sahlenburger Strand, you only need to cross a cycle/footpath at the campsite entrance. Then you can go for a lovely swim or go kitesurfing. A recommendation is a guided walk over the mudflats to the Neuwerk island, which is a couple of kilometres from the coast. If you like to travel with your dog, there is a dog beach right next to the campsite.

A variety of hiking/cycling options

If you fancy something other than the beach and mudflats, grab your hiking shoes or your (rental) bicycle and go on great trips through the interior of this part of Lower Saxony. There is a lovely variety of rural areas and wooded landscapes.

properties.name: Eco Camping de la Base Nautique
Camping Mandala
properties.description:
If you prefer going on holiday in quiet, natural surroundings, far from mass tourism, Camping Mandala in Prads-Haute-Bléone in the Provence is an ideal destination. Here, you camp in a wonderful quiet spot in a stunning valley and at the foot of the Massif des Trois-Évêchés. You can go on spectacular mountain walks right from your camping pitch or go paddling in River Bléone.

Furthermore, this is a campsite with relatively simple amenities, but with a high wellbeing content. For example, they offer yoga classes and massages. From the reviews of Camping Mandala, it appears that a nice, personal atmosphere dominates. You are best reaching this campsite via the D900. Do keep in mind that the access route can cause some challenges for caravans and motorhomes.

Car-free site with spacious pitches and traditional yurts

New campers receive a friendly welcome from the owners in the wooden reception building. After that, the idea is that you leave your car outside the grounds. That keeps the campsite car free, which is good for the silence and calm that dominates here.

You can book a stay in a comfortable chalet at Camping Mandala. There are also traditional Mongolian yurts for hire. And of course, you can also opt for a camping pitch at Camping Mandala.

Enjoy Fred's delicious wood-fired pizzas

Anyone camping at this campsite and wanting to go out for dinner in the evening does not have to leave the site. Fred comes to the campsite to make wood-fired pizzas every Tuesday and Saturday.

properties.name: Camping Entre Terre et Mer
properties.description:
Camping Entre Terre et Mer is located in southern Brittany, two kilometres from the town of Pont Scorf. Holiday here in peaceful surroundings between the French countryside and the Atlantic Ocean. There’s a great swimming pool, a bar and an animal pasture. In inland Breton, there’s plenty to do for culture and nature lovers alike.

French family atmosphere

The pitches at Entre Terre et Mer campsite consist of a combination of touring pitches, ready-to-use rental mobile homes and fixed pitches. The pitches have a minimum size of 120 m2 and are separated by hedges. Prefer unique accommodation? Then book one of the great cabins. Although the campsite is located on a through road, noise is minimal. A private patch of forest is part of the site as well.

Swim in the sea or the pool

There’s a heated and covered swimming pool at the centre of the campsite. The cover is open in good weather and there’s a paddling pool at the front. Want to swim in the sea? Then drive to beautiful beaches like Lorient Plage (20 km). Next to the pool, take a seat on the terrace for a drink or a snack. In summer, enjoy a fresh breakfast here.

Outdoor paradise for children

A bouncy castle, a trampoline and a fun playground; in summer it’s an outdoor paradise for children. The animals are especially popular. From time to time, young guests are allowed to ride ponies and help feed them. There’s also a ping-pong table and fitness equipment.

properties.name: Camping Sopra e Sotto Agriturismo & Outd
Camping Erve Hesselink
properties.description:
Camping Erve Hesselink is located between Winterswijk and the German town of Vreden, both of which are easily accessible and at a distance of approximately 3 km. The landscape is best explored by bicycle or on foot. A large number of routes start within a radius of two hundred metres from the campsite.

Mini camping

Camping Erve Hesselink is a cosy small-scale campsite, situated around the former farmhouse. The campsite is named after the first inhabitants of the farmhouse, which was later converted into a mini campsite. The rural atmosphere is enhanced by various fruit and nut trees, a vegetable garden and a chicken club.

Ample privacy and panoramic views

Camping Erve Hesselink can justifiably call itself a small campsite; there are only fourteen small but well maintained pitches. They are positioned in a U-shape around the farmhouse. It is a very well-tended campsite with spacious pitches offering panoramic views of farmland and surrounding woodlands. Some pitches are somewhat shaded by trees. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the campsite.

Campsite for nature and cycling enthusiasts

Not only the campsite, but also the immediate surroundings have much to offer to guests. Behind Camping Erve Hesselink lies the Dottinkrade forest area, full of deciduous trees and streams. From your pitch you can walk straight into this typical Achterhoek nature reserve. There are also plenty of cycling and walking routes in the area.

properties.name: Camping Bardenas
properties.description:
Campsite Bardenas is situated near the northern Spanish town of Villafranca, close to nature reserve Bardenas Reales. Bardenas is situated in a quiet area amidst nature. Not much tourism in evidence. The campsite lies along a main road. This minor issue is more than compensated for by the presence of the sun, the large swimming pool and the excellent restaurant.

New campsite

Camping Bardenas is a rather new campsite, hence the facilities (such as reception, sanitation, restaurant) are contemporary and good. The demarcated pitches are fairly large. There are many trees on the grounds, offering shelter against the blazing sun. The sandy/loamy ground is rock hard when dry, so please bring nail tent pegs and a hammer. Do not feel like hammering pegs into the ground? You can hire one of the hiker's huts, apartments or bungalows. The sanitary facilities are modern and clean.

Swimming pool

The large and well-kept swimming pool is located in a corner of the camping grounds. Generously tiled around the pool and enclosed (mesh fencing), hence safely fenced off for the little ones. The surrounding large sunbathing lawn with a lovely grassed surface is located directly behind the enclosure. There are some fixed sun umbrellas in places. There is a small playground, a fitness room and some other sports facilities, such as a badminton field and tennis court.

Excellent food

The spacious restaurant is also frequented by non-camping guests because of the chef's cuisine. Take-away meals are also offered. The camping shop is compact, but stocks all basic necessities and has fresh bread daily. Otherwise, you can do your shopping in the village of Villafranca, 2 km down the road.

properties.name: ClicoChic Camping Bordénéo
properties.description:
Belle-Île-en-Mer is the largest Brittany island in the Atlantic Ocean. You will find Camping de Bordénéo in a quiet setting on the northern side of this island, close to the village of Le Palais (Morbihan). The campsite itself has an indoor and outdoor swimming pool, a good restaurant and entertainment in the high season.

The island is perfect for exploring by foot, just follow the GR340 footpath. Furthermore, Belle-Île-en-Mer is known for its mild sea climate and rugged coastline. Yet, you will still find plenty of lovely sandy beaches.

Spacious pitches and luxury accommodation

Half the site at Camping de Bordénéo is used for tourist pitches. You can choose from three categories: Comfort, Premium and Exclusive. Campers who opt for Premium or Exclusive have their own toilet unit by their touring pitch.

Besides a spacious pitch, you can also rent a lovely mobile home at Camping de Bordénéo. There are even luxury mobile homes with private hot tub available. Another type of glamping at Camping de Bordénéo is expressed through the modern lodge tents for rent.

A lovely leisure pool for the whole family

You will find the lovely swimming pool, an asset at Camping de Bordénéo, at the front of the site. The sleekly designed aqua park consists of a heated indoor and outdoor swimming pool. The indoor swimming pool opened in 2021. Thanks to the massage jets and hot tub, you can wonderfully relax and unwind in the playfully shaped swimming pool. The adjacent outdoor pool is great for swimming some laps at your own pace. The outdoor swimming pool also has a fun paddling pool and a spectacular water slide.

properties.name: Camping Emmen
properties.description:
The hospitable Camping Emmen is in Schoonebeek in Drenthe. Here, you camp in the middle of the countryside on open grass fields. With a swimming pool and playground equipment, this campsite is a very child-friendly camping destination. Walkers and cyclists can indulge themselves in the quiet Drenthe countryside. If you want to go on a day trip, Wildlands Adventure Zoo is a fun excursion for the whole family.

Fishing from your tent

The six open camping fields offer space for 50 spacious touring pitches. One of the fields is the Vijverveld. There is a lovely pond here where you can cast a line. There are also pitches with private toilet and washing facilities.

Anyone who would like to hire lovely glamping accommodation can spend the night in a luxury safari tent with or without private toilet and washing facilities, a holiday home, a chalet or a cosy wooden igloo.

Tasty meal after swimming

The various play options make the campsite very child friendly. Go for a swim in the heated outdoor swimming pool or join in with the fun activities organised during the holidays, such as a treasure hunt or bingo evening.

And if you'd like a tasty meal after swimming or playing, they grow their own vegetables at Camping Emmen, and you can taste that in the dishes in the campsite restaurant. Furthermore, pizza and barbecue evenings are organised regularly.

Quiet nature area

You camp in a quiet area, where forests and fields alternate. There is piece of peatland in the nearby Bargerveen (14 km). The various walking and cycling routes through the stunning nature area mean this place is also popular among active campers.

properties.name: Camping Les Brugues
properties.description:
Camping les Brugues is in the centre of the countryside of southern France. The small-scale campsite is on a farm close to Fanjeaux, Aude, and has been managed by three generations of the same sheep-breeding family. They love showing you what the rural life is like, giving guided tours and hosting tastings for local delicacies. The campsite itself is characterised by tranquillity, nature and a friendly atmosphere. Wander about the surrounding area or explore medieval castles, villages and cities in the vicinity.

Spacious shaded pitches

The cosy campsite only has 25 pitches, 20 of which are equipped with power. The pitches are all at least 200 m2, giving you plenty of space for your tent, caravan or motorhome. Add to this the open view and the mature trees all around and you will immediately see that it is good to be here. It gets really dark in the evening in and around the campsite, allowing you to enjoy the clear starry sky. The toilet and washing facilities are well-maintained, and there is a communal area with picnic tables and a playground for the children.

Staying overnight on the farm

Next to the campsite is a lake, which is a good place to fish or to enjoy the view. Unfortunately, swimming is not permitted. The remainder of the landscape consists of rolling hills and sheep-filled fields. The campsite owners are proud of their farm. They can tell you all about their sheep, the milk that is used to make Roquefort cheese and other local delicacies. In addition to the sheep, there are also chickens, rabbits and pigs at the farm. Great for young and old!

properties.name: Campingplatz & Bungalowdorf Erlau
properties.description:
In a beautiful location, just outside the charming town of Schleusingen and at the edge of the Thüringer Wald, lies Campingplatz & Bungalowdorf Erlau. Thanks to its location near the nature reserve, this is a fantastic vacation spot for hiking and cycling enthusiasts who love exploring the forest. The campsite itself is peaceful and small-scale, making it particularly suitable for those who enjoy tranquillity and nature. The site is spacious and partly terraced.

Spacious pitches, bungalows, and group cabins

This campsite has twenty spacious pitches for caravans and motorhomes. In addition, there are several grass fields specifically for tent campers. If you prefer a bit more comfort and privacy, you can book a bungalow. These bungalows, which can accommodate two to six people, each have their own kitchen and bathroom. Finally, the campsite offers a few charming camping cabins that can host up to twelve holidaymakers. These are perfect for larger families or groups on a hiking or cycling holiday!

Enjoy dinner at the campsite restaurant

At the entrance of the campsite, there's a small restaurant run by the campsite owner. In this cosy Gaststätte of Campingplatz & Bungalowdorf Erlau, you can enjoy delicious meat dishes, pizzas, and salads. The restaurant is open daily from 5:00 PM during the season. You can also order breakfast for the following morning.

Enjoy the Thüringer Wald

The campsite is an ideal starting point for hikes or bike tours through the Thüringer Wald. Looking for something a bit different? Then take a drive to Coburg (42 km), a beautiful town with a charming market square and numerous historical buildings, including the Veste Coburg, which rises 170 meters above the town.

properties.name: Camping & Freizeitanlage Dreiländersee
properties.description:
Camping & Freizeitanlage Dreiländersee is on the edge of clear Lake Dreiländersee. Wake up to views of the water and the green space of North Rhine-Westphalia. It's a place where peace and nature come together, but where there’s also plenty to do. Get on your bike, put on your walking shoes or head for the water for a refreshing dip. This is camping with a touch of adventure, in the heart of nature.

Pitches and accommodation

The pitches are simple, with no defined boundaries. Whether you have a tent, caravan or motor home (up to 7 m), you’ll always find a great spot. There are sunny and shaded pitches, perfect for every season. Prefer slightly more comfort? Then rent one of the cosy wooden holiday homes.

Facilities for young and old

There’s no need for a pool because the campsite is right on the edge of a lovely swimming lake with a sandy beach. Take a dip, hire a pedalo or build sandcastles. Children will love the playground, which has a slide and swings. Feeling active? Head for the 18-hole mini golf course. After all that outdoor air, an ice cream or snack at the bistro will taste even better.

Explore the surrounding area

The Dreiländersee is in an ideal location for nature lovers and explorers. Jump on your bike and head to the local bird sanctuary, a paradise for birdwatchers. The area is bursting with great cycling routes and walking trails overlooking the water and fields. You're not far away from Enschede (20 km) either for a day of shopping.

properties.name: Camping Lindlbauer
properties.description:
Puynadal ne dispose pas de magasin ou de restaurant. Aux mois de juillet et d'août, du pain frais y est toutefois disponible et le snack-bar est ouvert. Vous y trouverez une charmante terrasse. Pour faire vos courses, rendez-vous à Brantôme.

Spacious pitches in the fresh mountain air

The pitches on Camping Lindlbauer are spacious to very spacious. You camp on a flat surface. The larger (more expensive) pitches are located on the terraces higher up on the campsite. The smaller pitches are found on the lower section of the terrain. The view here is not quite as beautiful, but the prices are lower. Don't feel like putting up your tent? Find out if one of the two cottages is still available. The sanitary facilities of the campsite are new and luxurious.

Focus on the sports-minded

At Lindlbauer you will mainly find guests who like outdoor activities. The children are of all ages, but most of them have a love of summer and winter sports in common. In terms of amenities and information, the campsite is in summer geared towards guests for walking, cycling and mountain biking, and in winter for cross-country skiing, skiing and skating.

Breakfast with pastries

In front of the chalet, in which the reception is also housed, you will find a small terrace. You can have a nice cup of coffee here or enjoy a meal or a piece of home-made pastry. You are served by waitresses in traditional Bavarian dirndl dresses. There is also a small bar inside as well as a mini shop.

properties.name: Perth Caravan Park
properties.description:
If you are looking for peace and quiet in the Scottish countryside, Noah's Ark Caravan Park will certainly be a good choice. The campsite is located near the old city of Perth and the river Tay. With the indoor playground, carting track and mini golf course, even the kids will not be bored. The tourist road NC500, Edinburgh and the Cairngorns National Park are within driving distance.

Open field

The property is a green open field with little protection from wind and sun. There are paved, flat spaces for campers and caravans. If you want to rent something, there are trekker huts with a view of the practice range for golfers and the surrounding hills.

Indoor playground

You don't even have to leave the property with an indoor playground, a carting track and a mini golf course: ideal if you're out and about with the kids. Always wanted to hit a golf ball? You don't have to walk far: there is a driving range just outside of the campsite, a practice range for golfers. You can also take lovely walks in the area. You can check out the cycling routes at the reception.

Economical restaurant

There is a simple, economical restaurant by the indoor playground.

Sanitary facilities

The sanitation is located in two adjacent units at the entrance. Because they are not the same type of units, it looks a bit messy. The sanitation is older, but works well and is kept nice and clean. There is also children's sanitation.

Not to be missed

One thing you certainly must do: Discover Perth! It is one of the oldest cities in Scotland, and has a lovely and compact centre with lovely terraces and shops.

properties.name: Hungry Hill Lodge and Campsite
properties.description:
Hungry Hill Lodge and Campsite is located in Adrigole at the foot of the Healy Pass. Situated in the heart of the Beara Peninsula on the Wild Atlantic Way, it’s perfect for visiting the South West of Ireland and Dursey Island with its cable car and an excellent base for walking, cycling, kayaking and shore fishing. A local store is just 100 metres away and stock daily fresh products.

Space and greenery

Upon arrival you will see a neat and well-maintained terrain, with groomed grass surface. There are a total of 32 mains hook up points and several water points, some pitches are hardstanding with many suitable for awnings. All tent pitches are on flat level ground with facilities close by. The site also has parking area for motorhome stopovers.

Camping and self-catering accommodation combined

The family run campsite also has 6 self-catering rooms in the main lodge building suitable for singles, couples, friends and families. Some rooms have ensuite, others have shared shower/toilet facilities. You can also rent a stone cottage, log cabin or camping pod.

properties.name: Hultsfred strandcamping
properties.description:
Småland is Sweden in miniature: there is a wealth of forests, lakes and traditions. In Hultsfred, in the heart of Småland, lies campsite Hultsfred on Lake Hulingen. The campsite is only a 10-minute walk away from the centre of the small town and approx. 20 km from Astrid Lindgren's Värld, the theme park based on the characters from Astrid Lindgren's stories.

Nature camping with spacious pitches

One could best describe the campsite as a natural campsite with open grounds and spacious pitches. The campsite has a small reception where you can buy bread in peak season. The campsite has seventeen basic trekker huts (maximum four persons).

Småland forests

The campsite is situated amidst the vast Småland forests and serves well as a base for cycling and car trips in the surrounding area. The campsite has a small sandy beach on the lake, where the shore gradually slopes down. At the reception you can hire boats for trips on the lake, also suitable for angling, of course.

Astrid Lindgren

The main attraction in the area is the Astrid Lindgrens Värld theme park. Young and old can lose themselves in the stories of the author Astrid Lindgren, who grew up in this region. The house in which Astrid grew up is located in Näs (22 km) and the farm of her grandparents is in Bullerby (23 km). Thus, if you want to find out more about Astrid Lindgren, there is no better campsite than Hultsfred!

properties.name: Campingplatz am Polygon
properties.description:
Campingplatz am Polygon is in a beautiful location, in the woods near the village of Ensdorf in Saarlan. The campsite owes its name to its location within walking distance of the Saar Polygon, from the top of which you can enjoy a panoramic view of the surrounding area. There are many beautiful walking and cycling trips through the flat countryside in the surrounding area. There’s a large outdoor pool next to the campsite and the campsite itself has a cosy restaurant.

Wooded site with stream

This neatly laid-out municipal campsite is surrounded by woods and a babbling brook flows across the site. This well-maintained campsite has many regular guests, but touring campers are welcome too. The pitches along the edges of the site have plenty of shade thanks to the surrounding woodland. Prefer a sunny spot? Opt for a pitch in the centre of the campsite.

Large municipal swimming pool

Feel like taking a refreshing dip after a nice walk? Freibad Ensdorf is next to the campsite - one of the largest outdoor swimming pools in this part of Germany. This municipal pool measures 50 by 125 metres and has a spectacular 59-metre-long water slide. Around it, there’s a grassy sunbathing area with sunny and shady spots. After an afternoon swim, enjoy a meal at Campingstubb, the atmospheric campsite restaurant.

Panoramic view from the Saar Polygon

This campsite is an ideal starting point for an ascent of the Saar Polygon. This rock mountain is approximately 150 metres high, with a 30-metre-high polygonal viewpoint on the summit. It takes an hour on foot to reach the summit from the campsite.

properties.name: Camping La Cigale de l'Allier
properties.description:
Camping La Cigale de l'Allier is on the east coast of Langogne, a lovely village in the Southern France department of Lozère. The campsite is on the banks of the Allier. This left tributary of the Loire forms a natural border between the Lozère and the Ardèche. This campsite is popular among those who like walking and cycling and who seek peace and quiet. Entertainment is in the form of an outdoor swimming pool, a playground and various sports facilities. You can also borrow books and board games from the miniature library.

Book a lovely spot by the Allier

You walk or drive down a slight slope to get to the camping pitches. The camping pitches themselves however are nicely level and spacious. Some of the touring pitches are on the banks of the Allier. Besides a pitch, you can book a stay in a modern mobile home, chalet, lodge tent or hire caravan.

Fun swimming in the swimming pool or river

The heated swimming pool is right by the entrance, and surrounded by a decked terrace with sun loungers. You can cool down swimming in the shallow river water of the Allier. You can also drive to the recreational lake, Lac de Naussac, which is about a kilometre to the west of Langogne. It's a lovely place for swimming as well as doing other water sports activities.

Cafeteria with tasty pizzas

There is a cafeteria next to the reception with a few lovely dishes on the menu. Taste a delicious pizza here. Furthermore, themed meals are offered once a week in the high season. You can also get bread rolls and pastries there in the mornings.

properties.name: Camping De 4 Elementen
properties.description:
Camping De 4 Elementen is a small campsite in the north of the Netherlands, on the border of Friesland and Groningen. Here you will camp directly on the water of the Prinses Margrietkanaal and you have access to a small harbour with moorings for boats. The campsite is part of a care institution that offers assisted living programmes. The residents of this care institution work in the campsite's shop and restaurant.

Camping pitch by the water

The campsite, which stretches across the rear part of the long peninsula, is particularly well looked after. Twenty-five narrow, but spacious touring pitches lie directly on the canal and offer beautiful views across the flat Frisian landscape. Paved roads take you to your camping spot, situated on a tight grass field in the shade of some trees.

For fishermen and people looking for peace and quiet

The campsite has good fishing spots where you can fish for hours on end. Due to its small size and remote location, the campsite is very suitable for campers looking for peace and quiet. In high and low season, the campsite is mainly occupied by senior citizens.

Your own boat

If you have your own boat, you can moor it at one of the jetties of the campsite. This way the campsite can serve as a short or long stopover during your boat trip through Friesland and Groningen. The Prinses Margrietkanaal starts at Lemmer, one of Friesland's most famous water sports centres, located directly on the IJsselmeer. At the border with Groningen, exactly where the campsite is located, the canal changes into the Van Starkenborghkanaal, which runs all the way to the provincial capital Groningen.

properties.name: Camping Weihersee
properties.description:
In the middle of Steigerwald Nature Park, in typical Bavaria, you will find Camping Weihersee. As the name suggests, the campsite is situated on the shores of the lake of the same name. The campsite is interwoven in a network of walking and cycling routes, which take you to the most beautiful spots of the nature park. The campsite also has a nature experience park with a large climbing track.

Sleeping in a wine barrel

Camping Weihersee is a terraced campsite divided into a number of elongated grassy areas, across which the pitches are distributed. Trees and bushes provide some privacy and the pitches are on grass on either side of two paved paths. Do you want something different? Then choose one of the special rental accommodations. At this campsite you can spend the night in a wine barrel!

Nature pool

In addition to the nature experience park, the campsite also has a well-equipped playground and there are a number of sports fields next to the site. You can also swim in the chlorine-free Acqua Sana natural swimming pool, which is located 300 metres from the campsite. Here you can also enjoy the sun on the large sunbathing lawn.

For the tasty appetite

To round off an active day you can go to the Acqua Sana restaurant on the sun terrace. Or at one of the restaurants in Ebrach, five minutes from the campsite. Here you will find a pizzeria, among other things. At the campsite's kiosk you can order fresh rolls delivered direct to your caravan! They also sell Weiherer beer and honey from their own bee hives.

properties.name: Camping Brantôme Far Ouest
properties.description:
When you camp on Camping Puynadal, you are only three km south of the beautiful town of Brantôme, also referred to as the ‘Venice of the Périgord’. When you arrive at the campsite, you will immediately get an extraordinary sense of serenity. This modern and child-friendly campsite lies in a quiet, green area at an elevation of 150 m. Do not expect any luxury or entertainment programmes here: instead you will find stylish simplicity in a nutshell. There is an amiable atmosphere on the campsite.

Spacious campsite

The terrain (2.5 ha) of Puynadal provides room to 34 demarcated, very spacious touring pitches of no less than 150-180 m2. The campsite is quiet during the day and at night. Camping Puynadal has an almost park-like appearance with the well-tended grass surface and rich variety of trees. You can also rent a mobile home (16). These are suitable for up to five persons.

Swimming, cycling, horseback riding

Puynadal is especially popular with families with young children. Near the reception you will find the swimming pool (5 x 14 m), the bouncy castle and the modest playground. The sports field is often used, mainly for all kinds of ball games. You can cycle in the area, but it is advisable to use a mountain bike, e-bike or racing bike to get around. Walking is possibly a better option. The organised horse riding tours are also very enjoyable.

Eating and drinking

Puynadal does not have a shop or restaurant. During the months of July and August fresh bread is available and the snack bar is open. It has a cosy terrace. You can do the necessary shopping in Brantôme.

properties.name: Camping de la Gères
properties.description:
Camping de la Gères is a quietly located and child-friendly family campsite on the outskirts of the town of Surgères. With some fifty pitches, both camping pitches and rental accommodation, it is a rather small campsite. Yet all facilities are neatly and well maintained. There is a playground for children and in peak season activities are organised regularly.

Well-maintained campsite

The entire terrain of Camping de la Gères looks well maintained and cared for. The campsite has some fifty pitches, divided between free camping pitches and rental accommodation (chalets, mobile homes and lodge tents). The camping pitches are located on a grass surface and are separated from each other by small hedges. Therefore, each camper has his own spot with ample privacy.

Entertainment for all

Although the campsite is quietly located and relatively small, it is also very suitable for families with young children. They amuse themselves in the playground or (in peak season) with one of the activities organised by the entertainment team. They can do horseback riding or take part in bingo. Entertainment is also organised in the heated outdoor swimming pool. It is attractively located in the sun with a sunbathing lawn. You will find a few beach chairs here.

Everything within walking distance

After your swim, you can get dry on the campsite terrace whilst enjoying a refreshing drink or an ice cream. You can also get a quick meal from the camping snack bar, but you have to leave the campsite to do your shopping. Fortunately, all amenities are literally around the corner, because you will find a bakery and a supermarket just down the road.

properties.name: Ai Colli Fioriti
properties.description:
Camping Ai Colli Fioriti is close to the Swiss border, between the Italian Lake Como and Lake Lugano. The Lombardy region is known for its many lakes and the beauty of the countryside. Here, you camp in a quiet area in the natural green Intelvi Valley with panoramic views of the hills. The campsite is ideal for active campers who like outdoor activities such as mountain biking and hiking. Ai Colli Fioriti is also a nice place for people seeking peace and quiet. The village of Castiglione d'Intelvi is only 1.5 kilometres away. You can go here for groceries and restaurants. Sustainability is an important theme at the campsite.

Italian hospitality

When you come to the campsite, you soon feel the calm and Italian hospitality. The 155 pitches are spread over several terraces with fields and lanes. If you don't bring your own camping equipment, you can hire a bungalow or mobile home. Besides the spacious demarcated touring pitches, which are neatly laid out on grass, you also encounter many regular guests at the campsite. They are mainly Italian families with seasonal pitches. The toilet and washing facilities are simple but always clean.

Eat the tastiest pizzas

It goes without saying that you eat the tastiest pizzas in Italy! So of course you want to try one here. You can get take away pizzas in the high season. Furthermore, you can get fresh bread rolls and other necessities from the mini market at the campsite. You are welcome to have a drink in the lovely bar or to borrow a book from the miniature library.

properties.name: Camping Le Fief Angibaud
properties.description:
Peace and quiet are the key words of Le Fief Angibaud campsite, a small-scale campsite in the Vendée, not far from the Atlantic Ocean and the island of Noirmoutier. You will camp here in the French countryside on very spacious touring pitches of at least 200 m2. Without many amenities, but with good sanitary facilities and spacious fields, this campsite is ideal for campers looking for the simplicity of real camping.

Very spacious touring pitches

Two large lawns, bordered by trees and shrubs, form the campsite. The lawns can accommodate as many as fifty or more pitches, but there are only twenty-five. This means that you camp on very spacious pitches and that you can look out ahead. The touring pitches are not demarcated, but you still have a sense of privacy.

Different from other coastal campsites

Camping Le Fief Angibaud is different from other campsites on the Atlantic coast: without a large swimming pool, extensive restaurant or entertainment programme. But that doesn't bother the guests. On the contrary, they love the peace and quiet and the space that reigns there. The campers on the campsite do not need extensive facilities and they like the fact that the campsite is not directly by the sea. This makes it a good starting point for a cycling tour through the French countryside.

Clean sanitary facilities

One of the advantages of a small-scale campsite: the toilet block is never far away. It is close to the pitches. A nicely renovated old building offers modern sanitary facilities, all very clean.

properties.name: Camping Kallsedets Fjällcenter
properties.description:
Camping Kallsedets Fjällcenter is a small-scale campsite in Järpen, a village in the east of Sweden. You will camp between two large lakes. The area is very rich in nature. There are many reindeer, elk and beavers. You can spot them during a walk, an absolute must if you are here.

Welcome!

The enthusiastic owners welcome you at the reception. Their campsite looks well-maintained and the pitches are spacious (100-140 m2). There are about thirty touring pitches where you can put up your own camping equipment. The nicest spots are by the lake. Don't have your own camping equipment? In the accompanying hostel you can sleep in one of the four rooms. There is a common living room with kitchen. There are also four 'stugor' (typical Swedish cottages) for rent.

Shop and café

Fresh bread is available in the bakery. For the basic groceries you can visit the shop. There is also a café where you can combine a hot drink with all kinds of sweet delicacies and fresh sandwiches. The café is open until 17h30, so you have to take care of your own dinner. Buy something in the shop or find a restaurant nearby. For example in Kolåsen (10 km).

Water fun

You can swim in the lake that borders the campsite or in the lake a bit further away. If that's too cold for you, a trip in a kayak or rowing boat is a nice alternative. And don't forget your fishing rod, because there is plenty to catch. There is some playground equipment, a recreation room and a table tennis table.

properties.name: Camping Aux Mêmes
properties.description:
If you want to go on holiday in one of the most sparsely populated and most rural regions of Western Europe, than staying at Camping Aux Mêmes near Masseube in the French department of Gers is a great choice. As well as being unspoiled, Gers is known for being sunny. There is no where in France that registers as many sun hours as in Gers. The immediate vicinity is excellent for going walking and cycling through the varied landscapes. This friendly family campsite is in a wonderful setting on a hill in a undulating agricultural landscape. Camping here guarantees a calming experience.

Tidy grass pitches with wide views

There is well-maintained camping grounds are behind reception. You find spacious touring pitches on grass. They are demarcated with neat hedges. From many of the camping pitches, you enjoy panoramic views of the surroundings. At Camping Aux Mêmes, you can book a stay in a gîte, a holiday home. Your dog is also welcome.

Surprisingly large swimming pool

You will find the lovely swimming pool that adorns Camping Aux Mêmes by reception. With a surface area of 72 square metres, this is a large outdoor swimming pool for a campsite of this size. The swimming pool is open from early-June to late-September.

Order a fresh meal in the campsite restaurant

The campsite's charming restaurant is open in July and August. The menu contains dishes such as pizzas, meat dishes and salads. The meals are prepared with local produce as much as possible. The eggs even come from their own chickens that walk around the campsite.

properties.name: Casa Tartufo
properties.description:
In the rolling hills of the Marches, in the middle of a truffle forest, lies Casa Tartufo. The camping site of this quiet, small campsite is laid out in terraces against the hill. The spacious pitches are spacious and wonderfully shaded. In high season Casa Tartufo organises all kinds of culinary excursions for its guests and you can enjoy delicious local specialities.

Terrace campsite on the hillside

Casa Tartufo has twenty-four spacious pitches laid out in a truffle forest. You can go there not only with your tent, but also with your caravan or motorhome. This is special for this type of campsite. Keep in mind, however, that Casa Tartufo is a terraced campsite and not all pitches are equally easy to reach. There are six appartments for rent in the main building, each with its own terrace. There are also two fully equipped lodge tents on the campsite, where you can camp in luxury and comfort.

Luxury swimming pool

Casa Tartufo has a large, luxurious swimming pool. From May to October you can swim here. The outdoor pool is beautifully landscaped, surrounded by a beautiful sun deck from where you have a magnificent panoramic view over the valley and the surrounding hills.

Luxury breakfast

Casa Tartufo does not have a camping shop. The nearest shopping facility is three kilometres away. Within a radius of ten kilometres you will find several supermarkets where you can do your shopping. At the campsite you can get fresh bread and there is even a luxury breakfast service. In the evening you can use the communal barbecue. The sanitary facilities are recent and look neat.

properties.name: Camping de la Plage
properties.description:
Camping de la Plage is a surprising campsite, situated on the Lac de Monteynard, in the lesser-known region of Trièves. The campsite, near the town of Treffort (some 35 km south of Grenoble) is a real gem, waiting to be discovered by sporty holidaymakers. The large number of trees provide ample shade on the terraced campsite. All pitches differ in size and location. The campsite and surrounding area are ideally suited for activities which are of interest to active campers of all age groups.

Various pitches on terraced campsite

Upon arrival, you will see the shaded terraces with all types of trees. You will find the reception in the brick building, where the helpful owners will gladly assist you. You have a wide choice here, as no two pitches are similar. In addition to spacious pitches, you can on the highest terrace also opt for a lodge tent or a dedicated accommodation for bicycle campers.

Water sports and walking

Camping de la Plage is situated on the beautiful blue lake, near the port of call Le Mira. This location and the sporty disposition of the owners make this campsite extremely suitable for sporty campers, also with children of all age groups. Water sports and walking are favourite. There is a sailing/kitesurfing school and you can cross the lake by boat. Walking over the two passerelles (hanging footbridges) is also a lot of fun. To get to the public beach, you cross a small road from the campsite.

Restaurant and sanitary facilities

The campsite restaurant is near the reception and also has seats in the garden. You have a view of the lake and the mountains. The sanitary facilities are housed in two buildings. Both are tidy and clean.

properties.name: Campingplatz Schachenhorn
properties.description:
Campingplatz Schacherhorn is situated in a stunning location in the south of Germany: a stretch of forest along the Bodensee. You will be camping at the edge of a nature reserve, which is a breeding area for various species of birds. Fantastic biking and hikes in the area. The long, thin shape of the campsite means that you'll almost always be on the water.

Camping by the water

At Campingplatz Schachenhorn, you'll be camping among the trees and you'll always be near the water. The pitches don't have defined borders, which creates a disorganised, casual feel on the camping property. It can be fairly busy here, especially during high season. The busier it gets, the smaller the pitches become. If you are able to look past that, you will be rewarded with a stunning, panoramic view of the lake and the surrounding greenery. You can also opt to stay in one of the cosy pod cabins.

Thai cuisine

The restaurant on the campsite serves marvellous Thai dishes, but you can also drop by for some chips. There is a lively Thai buffet on every Friday during high season. 

Getting active on the Bodensee

The location of the campsite is unique: right on the Bodensee and in the midst of a beautiful nature reserve. It's the perfect location to fully unwind. Please note: swimming in the water near the campsite is prohibited. This part of the reserve is a protected breeding area for birds. There are fantastic hiking and cycling options in the immediate vicinity. You can also head out onto the water by boat, canoe or pedalboard.

properties.name: Camping le Néri
properties.description:
A quiet family campsite with spacious camping pitches that offer plenty of privacy. Located in a rural setting with panoramic views of the hilly surroundings. That's what you can look forward to if you decide to travel to Camping Le Néri. This campsite is located near the village of Mauroux in the southern French department of Gers. This is one of the most sparsely populated and rural areas of Western Europe. It is therefore a place where you can still typically admire a clear starry sky in the evening. In addition, Gers records more sunny days annually than any other French department.

Spacious pitches with plenty of privacy

Le Néri is a well-ordered campsite consisting of two long paths. Spacious camping pitches have been created on both sides of these paths, along with a number of rental accommodations. The pitches are surrounded by high hedges, so you have plenty of privacy here. Moreover, some camping pitches offer you a panoramic view of the surrounding landscape.

Large, sheltered outdoor pool

On the edge of the campsite you'll find a beautiful outdoor swimming pool. This swimming pool is twenty metres long and therefore quite large for a campsite of this size. The swimming pool is not heated. Because it is lower than the rest of the campsite and is hidden between the trees, the swimming pool is sheltered. Next to the swimming pool is a lake where you can fish.

Pétanque competitions and themed meals

Fun activities are organised for campers of all ages during high season. There are regular pétanque competitions for players of all levels. There are also fun performances and special themed meals on occasion.

properties.name: O'Connors Riverside C. and C. Park
Campingpark im Bergischen Land
properties.description:
This campsite is located in the middle of the Bergisches Land region, a vast nature reserve east of Cologne. It is therefore an ideal holiday destination for peace seekers, but also for avid walkers and cyclists. Campingpark im Bergischen Land is also built on a hill. You'll thus enjoy a wonderful view of the surrounding area from your camping pitch. This fairly large campsite also offers a separate area for touring campers, a stylish restaurant, various sports and play facilities and extremely modern sanitary facilities.

A private camping area for touring campers

The largest part of this campsite consists of permanent annual pitches. However, a beautiful area for touring campers has been created at the front of the campsite. This area features spacious, level pitches, usually with a stunning view of the hilly surroundings. The campsite also offers a handful of rental accommodations, including three sleeping barrels that are bursting with character.

Good food and celebrations at Gaststätte Zur Knödelkiste

Gaststätte Zur Knödelkiste is located across from the reception. You can enjoy a tasty meal in this restaurant's cosy indoor seating area or on its large outdoor terrace. Every Sunday afternoon you can also indulge in one of the house specialities: freshly prepared waffles.

Luxurious sanitary facilities in pristine condition

There are two sanitary blocks at Campingpark im Bergischen Land. One of these is located at the centre of the tourist camping pitches. This sanitary block was newly built in 2015 and features luxurious, well-maintained facilities. There are also special children's toilets and facilities for people with reduced mobility. The sanitary facilities are heated during the winter.

properties.name: Camping CosyCamp
properties.description:
CosyCamp is an environmentally-friendly campsite, located near the village of Chamalières-sur-Loire in Haute-Loire on the banks of the Loire Sauvage. Come and live a glamping experience in a 4.5 hectare botanical garden where cars are not allowed. Large pitches, upscale atypical accommodation, a wellness area, outdoor swimming pools, swimming in the Loire, canoeing, games and bicycles available, and campfires. In short: everything you need for an exquisite holiday.

Forested area on the Loire

CosyCamp is in a stunning forested area, right on the Loire. You'll find one nature reserve after the other in the area. The campsite is in between three French pearls: the regional nature reserve Livradois-Forez, regional nature reserve of Pilat, and the Monts d'Ardèche nature reserve. The campsite grounds are all about nature too. They have been designed with an emphasis on the relationship between people and nature. Totally environmentally-friendly. You'll find botanical gardens here, with the most extensive flora, and all the buildings are made from untreated wood.

Environmentally-friendly glamping

All of the rentals are also designed with conservation in mind. Don't be afraid that you'll have to spend the night in a small wooden hut, though. CosyCamp has the look of a luxury campsite. With very special rentals, including treehouses, lodges and gypsy wagons, you can definitely consider this 'glamping'. The pitches are spacious: the smallest is no less than 100 m².

Fresh, local food

At CosyCamp, simple, local and environmentally-friendly food is served. In the organic kitchen, they make their hamburgers from cows from the Haute-Loire, and every day, there's a special on the menu from the region. You can also have breakfast in the communal dining room, and order picnic baskets with fresh local produce.

properties.name: Village Nature Zen
properties.description:
Camping La Turelure, an oasis of peace in the Ardèche, lies on the outskirts of the French village of Uzer. Here you camp alongside the river or have views of the beautiful farmlands. This is the perfect place for those seeking peace and quiet and love yoga and meditation. Explore the surrounding area with its many rivers, rock formations and picturesque villages. Take time to relax in the area designed especially for yoga and workshops.

Camping with a view

The pitches at Camping La Turelure are spacious, varying from 150 to 300 m². You camp on the grass with a view of the river or farmlands. If you don’t have your own camping equipment, the campsite has various accommodations such as luxury mobile homes or lodge tents. There is a small but charming terrace to enjoy a drink or snack during the high season. A food truck visits regularly in the summer time.

Cool down in the river

The Lande river flows past the elongated campsite and converges with the Ligne river at the end of the campsite. This offers plenty of options for cooling down. Fishing is also permitted in the river, so be sure to pack your fishing rod! There is also an outdoor swimming pool at the campsite.

Total zen through yoga and meditation

Camping La Turelure is a beautiful spot for campsite visitors who want to relax. It has a large yurt where various workshops are offered. Choose from yoga, mindfulness or meditation.

properties.name: JUFA Vulkan Thermen Resort es Camping
EuroParcs Marina Strandbad
properties.description:
EuroParcs Marina Strandbad is a quiet holiday park by River IJssel where you can stay in lovely, luxury accommodation. The village of Olburgen is nearby. You reach it via narrow asphalt roads that zigzag through the farmland. It's a 15-minute drive to picturesque Doesburg with its old city centre. Cycling enthusiasts can take nice trips along the IJssel and to various lovely, old towns.

Stay the night in exceptional accommodation

EuroParcs Marina Strandbad looks very neat and well maintained. The park offers exceptional accommodation. You can spend the night in a luxury water lodge or a wellness lodge with private sauna. The park is an oasis of peace and is mainly visited by people who like doing water sports. Some guests even have a boat moored in the marina. The guests are mainly families with children.

Swimming beach and lovely patio

The IJssel is easily reached via the dyke. In the summer, you can also cool down in the small and simple outdoor swimming pool. It's wonderful sunbathing on the adjacent meadow. The patio of the catering establishment beside reception is also highly enjoyable. You have views of the marina, and it is visited by passing cyclists, passers-by from the marina and of course park guests.

Lovely day trips

Everything is devoted to water sports at and around the park. The surrounding area is also lovely to explore. Dieren, Zutphen, Brockhorst and Doesburg are close by, and you can get to Veluwezoom National Park in no time.

properties.name: Camping Les Gorges de l'Hérault
properties.description:
If you would like to enjoy a holiday in a natural setting, far away from the daily hustle and bustle, Camping Les Gorges de l'Hérault is highly recommended. This campsite is right by River Hérault, close to the commune of Sumène in the Cévennes (southern France). You can do mountain sports in this forested mountain area. During walking, cycling and climbing trips, you will pass the most beautiful spots with impressive viewpoints. You can also easily enjoy yourself at this small-scale campsite. Go for a swim in the swimming pool or in the river and many fun activities are organised in the high season.

Choose a lovely spot with river views

This campsite has an elongated site along River Hérault. This means many of the touring pitches are right on the river banks. Generally, the pitches at this neatly landscaped campsite have quite a lot of shade. There are also 22 accommodation for hire. These are mobile homes and comfortable canvas tents.

Go for a refreshing swim

In summer, temperatures can get quite high in the Southern French hinterland. The setting by the river is therefore really nice. Furthermore, the campsite has a private swimming pool with paddling pool. The outdoor swimming pools are next to reception and are open in the high season.

Entertainment in the high season

There is plenty of entertainment in the summer holiday. For example, there are special themed evenings with fun shows, performances, bingos and karaoke. During the day, there are sporting activities and tournaments. Creative workshops and surprising treasure hunts are organised specially for children.

properties.name: Camping Porat
properties.description:
Do you prefer to spend your holiday in a quiet environment, not surrounded by tourists? And do you love being able to enjoy beach life in peace? Then Camp Porat is really a must. This small-scale campsite is located in the authentic village of Povljana on the island of Pag in Croatia. The campsite is located in a small pine forest. So the site has plenty of shade. In addition, there are numerous beautiful beaches around the campsite.

Shaded camping pitch and luxury mobile homes

You will find about eighty tourist camping pitches on this newly furnished campsite. The many pine trees ensure that most touring pitches are well-shaded. There aren't large boundaries between the camping pitches, but the pitches are numbered and spacious. In addition, there are two luxury mobile homes for rent. These can accommodate up to six people.

Highly modernised sanitary facilities

This campsite has a recently refurbished sanitary building. Here you will find high-quality facilities. This includes hot showers, a laundry room, children's toilets and facilities for people with reduced mobility. Moreover, there are even special dog showers.

Enjoy beach life to the fullest

Directly around the campsite are several beautiful beaches, from which you can swim in the sea. Would you really prefer to go to a sandy beach? Then it is best to walk or drive a short distance to the south. There you will find, among other things, the fine sandy beaches of Perilo and Livade. The seabed slopes very gradually at these beaches, so there are large shallow areas.

properties.name: Camping De la Belle Etoile
properties.description:
Are you looking for a simple, peaceful campsite in an area near the mighty Loire river? The campsite De la Belle Etoile, located on the outskirts of Saint-Bonnet-le-Château may be just what you are looking for. This campsite boasts a view of the church, which stands high atop the centre of the city. Although the swimming pool attracts young families in summer, this campsite is primarily a favourite among people looking for some peace and quiet.

Simple yet effective

This well-arranged campsite has demarcated pitches which vary in size. Some are located in the shade, others in partial shade and others in the sun. Not all paths are paved. The green of the hedges, trees and shrubs allow the natural wilderness to peek in from all sides.

Heated swimming pool

The campsite boasts a heated swimming pool (60 m2) and a toddler pool. These pools are surrounded by a terrace with some loungers and umbrellas. There is a modest activity programme during the summer and you can also play a game of petanque or go fishing.

In high season you will find many families on the campsite. In low season, your fellow campers are primarily people seeking peace and quiet.

Bites and drinks

You don't always have to cook for yourself, as the campsite has a snack bar that is open from June to August. However, the village boasts many delightful food stands and restaurants that serve well-known French cuisine. You can also buy fresh bread on the campsite every day.

properties.name: Seepark Ternsche
properties.description:
At Seepark Ternsche, you can enjoy a lovely camping holiday by the water in North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany. Relax on the sandy beach, explore Lake Ternscher, and immerse yourself in the adventure and tranquillity this campsite has to offer.

Enjoy the water

Here you can choose from a variety of camping pitches and accommodation options. From a cosy safari tent to a luxurious Swedish cottage with a view over the lake: the choice is yours! The pitches are also situated close to the lake. Looking for even more comfort, or are you travelling with the whole family? Then the holiday homes on the campsite are a great choice. For those who want to be truly close to the water, choose a holiday home right on the shores of Lake Ternscher, complete with private access to the water!

Adventure and peace seekers

The water offers all sorts of fun activities. Take a dip in the lake, hire a SUP board or relax on the sand. The beach is clearly laid out, so you always have a good view of the little ones playing.

For adventurers and water lovers, there’s the Aqua-Climb, Germany’s largest floating climbing course. Finish off your day at the beach café. Enjoy a refreshing drink and a delicious meal in the charming outdoor area while watching the sunset together.

Genuinely German

Seepark Ternsche is situated in the beautiful Münsterland, an ideal spot for walks and bike rides. Set off to explore the vast meadows and forests, and discover all the sights in the region. Be sure to visit the Ruhr area, a region with an interesting mining history, and the charming city of Münster (39 km).

properties.name: Recreatiepark Aalsmeer
properties.description:
A holiday at Recreatiepark Aalsmeer means quiet and comfortable camping in the middle of nature. At this neat, small-scale campsite and marina in one, you will enjoy a very relaxed atmosphere. Its location directly on the water makes it the ideal place for sailing and water sports. From your pitch in the green you can reach the Westeinderplassen in no time and experience a camping holiday full of freedom and serenity.

Sail, sleep, enjoy

Do you like to stay by the water or do you have your own boat, then Recreatiepark Aalsmeer is a fine camping destination for you. Set yourself up on one of the seventeen spacious pitches (100 - 130m2) on the grassland. The pitches are separated by hedges for the necessary privacy. In some places you can even moor your boat next to your pitch! For motorhomes, there are some comfortable, hard-surfaced pitches. The campsite has playground equipment and in the recreation room you can play a game of table tennis or table football.

Activities on and near the water

The surprising area of the Westeinderplassen offers countless possibilities for activities on and near the water. Here, you can enjoy a relaxing boat tour or go active with supping (paddle surfing) or canoeing. Those who like to fish can cast their rod at this campsite.

Swimming is possible from the swimming jetty at the campsite or the swimming jetty Kudelstaart. A great place to swim with children is Surfeiland, three kilometres away. Thanks to its location, the Surfeiland offers a sheltered and surveyable environment. The sandy beach here slopes gently and is therefore ideal for small children.

properties.name: Camping L'Avelanède
properties.description:
Nature campsite L’Avelanède is situated in the south of the Verdon, a region which is characterised by lakes and forests. The natural campsite, measuring some 30 acres, has a limited number of camping pitches. The camping grounds are divided into 5 sections, each with its own character.

Charming squares

The reception is housed in the same fetching building as the bar and restaurant. The site has a typical Provençal appearance with lively squares and covered terraces. The fountain, low walls and arches of rough stone complete the setting. The camping grounds are rugged and natural with spacious pitches between trees. 

Rugged and natural

There are only fifty touring pitches and thirty permanent camping pitches. Are you an adventurous camper, or do you cherish your privacy? If so, you can choose a great spot in a slightly more isolated location on the camping grounds. However, you will also find pitches near the swimming pool or at the edge of the forest. 

Family campsite

You will come across many families with children at L’Avelanède. In high season the campsite is mainly frequented by Dutch guests. In low season there are more international visitors. Especially families with young children can spend a wonderful, quiet holiday here. There is no entertainment, hence the camping is less suitable for teenagers looking to be entertained. 

Fun in the water

There are two sanitary buildings on the camping grounds. One building is slightly older, but the other one is entirely new (2018). The sanitary facilities, like all other facilities, are beautifully maintained and pristine. Adjacent to the restaurant and the bar lies a beautiful, heated outdoor swimming pool surrounded with loungers. There is also a separate heated toddler pool.

properties.name: Neiße Camp
properties.description:
This cosy campsite is located in the far east of Germany, near the Polish border. Neiße Camp is surrounded by beautiful nature and vast forests. It is the perfect base for actively exploring the area by bike, on foot or by boat. The Neisse River is located nearby.

Neiße Camp is a small-scale campsite. You'll be camping on a neat lawn encircled by trees. There are several sports facilities, and you can practice archery on the 3D archery range. Children can have fun on the on-site playground. You can go to the Neisse River or to an indoor swimming pool three kilometres away to enjoy a nice swim.

Active holiday

The campsite features modern sanitary facilities, a self-catering kitchen, a washer/dryer and an indoor recreation room. You can choose your own camping pitches on the site, and your pets can come along free of charge. Start your day off right with fresh bread rolls for breakfast, which you can order at the reception. You'll never be bored at Neiße Camp. You can enjoy a game of table tennis, basketball, volleyball or football. Free Wi-Fi is also available at the campsite.

On the river

The jetty on the Neisse River is about 200 metres from the campsite. You can rent kayaks and enjoy wonderful rafting trips from this point. You can also enjoy one of the many boat trips offered on this beautiful river. Fancy a day of swimming? Take your towel and head to a sandy beach on the river's banks.

properties.name: Les Voiles des 2 Caps
properties.description:
Have you ever heard of the Opal Coast? This is a beautiful piece of coastline in northern France. Just a few kilometres from a beautiful sandy beach is the Les Voiles des 2 Caps campsite (formerly the de la Vallée campsite). This welcoming campsite is an excellent starting point to discover this beautiful region. Enjoy relaxing summer days on the beach, the lovely atmosphere of the old seaside resorts, or an invigorating bike ride along the coastline.

Camping and glamping
