Upon arrival, you will find the reception desk in the building that doubles as a bar and recreation room. There you will be warmly welcomed by the owners of the campsite. The grounds are well kept and have about 30 small-scale pitches. There are also about 70 pitches for permanent guests and a number of mobile homes and glamping accommodations – some even with their own jacuzzi!

You camp on spacious, defined pitches on the grass. The pitches are nice and green. The hedges provide plenty of privacy. Some pitches are slightly sloping. The sanitary facilities are reasonably modern. They are kept in pristine condition. And that pristine image is reflected throughout the campsite.

Summer fun

In the summer, many families come to enjoy a quiet beach holiday. The campsite is ideally situated. Peacefully located between the green, sloping fields and 4 km from the sandy beach and lively Wissant seaside resort. Your children can enjoy the playground. In summer, they can have fun on the bouncy castles and other inflatable playground equipment. Of course, you can also play a nice game of table tennis, boules, or football together.

properties.name: NaturistenCamp Sonnensee des BffL Hannover e. V.
Camping Waldviertel
properties.description:
Waldviertel Camping is close to the town of Groß-Gerungs in the west of the Austrian state of Lower Austria. Here, you camp in a wonderful peaceful spot, in natural green surroundings, far from traffic noise and urban bustle. You can take wonderful walks through the alternating hilly landscapes in this unspoiled area. This is also a suitable base for winter sports enthusiasts. This campsite is right on a cross-country trail and 20 km from the closest ski lift. Waldviertel Camping has a good restaurant, an outdoor playground and a sauna, among other things.

Open campsite around granite boulders

The reception is in what they call the Gasthof. There, Christoph and Christina give campers a friendly welcome. Behind this building there is a neatly levelled grass field with numbered touring pitches. A nice thing is that there are a few large granite boulders in the middle of this open campsite. Besides a spacious camping pitch, you can stay in an apartment, a room or hiker's cabin at Waldviertel Camping. You have free WiFi throughout the campsite.

properties.name: Mereoja Camping
properties.description:
With a location right on the Gulf of Finland, surrounded by steep limestone cliffs, and with the towns of Aseri (9 km) and Rakvere (39 km) within driving distance, Mereoja Camping in Estonia provides a home base for both those seeking peace and quiet and active campsite visitors. Go to the nearby beach, explore the area by bicycle or on foot and experience the peace and quiet of the surrounding green.

Camping with a view of the sea

Mereoja Camping offers both pitches and accommodations. The campsite is characterised by its well-maintained grounds with a variety of pitches. Some pitches on the large grass field are demarcated with hedges or are partially paved, which contributes to the spaciousness and privacy. There is also a special section for tents. The campsite has quiet hours between 23.00 and 07.00.

If you have no camping equipment, reserve a cottage or a luxury glamping tent. The glamping tents offer a combination of camping and the comfort of beds, storage room and heating, but you must take along your own bed clothes. The cottages provide room for up to four people and are equipped with their own kitchen.

What is there to do?

Camping Mereoja is a simple campsite with some amenities, such as luxurious toilet facilities, a sauna, barbecue pit and playground for the children. The surrounding area offers the most enjoyment. From the campsite, you can walk to the beach in just a few minutes and the immediate vicinity is also a paradise for bird-watchers. North Estonia also has many castles and hiking trails. For culture enthusiasts, a visit to the nearby town of Rakvere (39 km), with its imposing castle is a must.

properties.name: EuroParcs Cadzand-Bad
properties.description:
EuroParcs Cadzand-Bad is in the very south of Zeeland, close to the border with Belgium. Here, you’ll find wide sandy beaches, relaxed beach bars and a great holiday atmosphere. When you arrive, you’ll be welcomed by the salty sea air and relaxed atmosphere. The park has luxury accommodation in the heart of nature, close to the sea. There’s plenty to do in the surrounding area too, like a visit to Bruges (26 km) or Vlissingen (70 km).

Luxury holiday homes close to the beach

At EuroParcs Cadzand-Bad, you’ll stay in comfortable holiday homes, suitable for up to 10 people. The homes are modern and fully equipped: good beds, a spacious kitchen and a lovely patio. You can breakfast outside, read a book in the sun or toast together after a day on the sea. Simply park your car next to your home. Very handy if you have children or beach gear.

Wonderful facilities at the park

Everything you need is within easy reach. Rent bikes and explore Zeeland's coast at your own pace. The dunes, beach and quaint villages are close by. Don't fancy cooking? Order a BBQ package and enjoy grilling on your own patio. Electric cars can be charged at your accommodation or elsewhere on the park. Fancy doing something active with the family? Try the Pyramid Escape Box at the campsite.

Out and about in Belgium

Cadzand-Bad is very close to Belgium. Cycle to chic Knokke (14 km), or drive half an hour to Bruges (26 km) for a day of culture and Belgian chocolate.

properties.name: Sonnencamping Albstadt
properties.description:
Sonnencamping Albstadt is located near the friendly village of Albstadt in the Schwäbische Alb, a versatile low mountain range in Baden-Württemberg, Germany. From this campsite, you can head off on beautiful (mountain) walks; there are winter sports facilities too in winter. This is also one of the sunniest regions in Germany and this terraced campsite is located on a southern mountainside. If there’s a day of bad weather? Not a problem because there’s an indoor swimming complex with a wellness oasis next to the campsite.

Three terraces with sunny pitches

This campsite has three beautiful terraces, mainly with tourist pitches. Here, you camp on a well-tended grassy pitch and with a beautiful panoramic view of the Schwäbische Alb mountains. The best view is from the upper terrace. You’ll find special areas for tent campers there and a number of attractive stilt houses. They are fully-equipped wooden holiday homes with an upper floor. You can also book a modern bungalow or a cosy sleeping barrel at Sonnencamping Albstadt.

Discount for swimming complex Badkap

Sonnencamping Albstadt is right next to the beautiful Badkap swimming pool, which is managed by the municipality of Albstadt. This is a large swimming complex with both indoor and outdoor areas. In the indoor pool, you can enjoy a wave pool, a large paddling pool and multiple spectacular water slides all year round. There’s also a wellness zone with saunas, steam baths, sunbeds and a massage department. Discounted tickets are available at the campsite reception. There’s also a shop that sells essentials and provides a bread-roll service.

properties.name: Camping Verte Rive
properties.description:
The campsite Verte Rive lies in the green Vallée de l'Ognon. You are camping here within walking distance of the river de Ognon where you can kayak and swim. This small-scale campsite is quiet and green. Within walking distance of the campsite (seven hundred metres) is the village of Cromary, where you can, by arrangement, visit the lovely garden "Le Jardin du Presbytère". Here you will find a vegetable garden, fruit trees a rock garden and lots of other lovely things.

Quiet and space

The campsite Verte Rive is a small campsite of 0.7 hectares. The campsite is clean and well-tended. The camping pitches are spacious (between 80 and 120 m2) and easy to reach. There are various camping options six accommodations such as lodge tents and mobile homes. Above all the camping pitches between the large hedges offer plenty of policy but you can also choose a place by the river.

Sports entertainment

Your fellow campers in the high season are above all families and groups from Europe. If you go in the low season, you share the campsite mostly with older couples from Belgium, the Netherlands and France. In any case there is plenty of space for all ages. If you want a bit of adventure, follow the path from the campsite and take a dip or kayak on the river.

Catering

Have breakfast every day with fresh bread from the campsite or drive ten minutes to the supermarket (eight kilometres). Here you will find everything you need for a great barbecue. Finish your day with a drink in the bar (limited hours) or a nice shower. The sanitation facilities are a bit older but very clean.

properties.name: Camping De Oude Trambrug
properties.description:
Enjoy peace and nature with an extensive view of the surrounding countryside from your spacious pitch. You can count on this when you choose a holiday at Camping De Oude Trambrug, a small campsite on a former farm in southeast Friesland. This is one of those campsites where you can still wake up to the sound of birdsong.

Choose how and where to set up camp

Those arriving at this campsite with their own camping equipment may choose a spot on the sheltered field or on the other field. Here, you can enjoy a wide view of the surroundings. At Camping De Oude Trambrug, you can also enjoy the camping life by hiring the beautiful safari tent. In addition, the farm's luxurious upstairs room is available for rent. The latter is suitable for up to two people.

Coffee and tea

This campsite features a lovely recreation room where you are always welcome to have a cup of coffee or tea. In consultation with Adrie and Piet, breakfast or dinner can also be arranged for you. Those who want to do their shopping are best off driving to surrounding villages like Jubbega or Donkerbroek. Both villages are just under five kilometres away from the campsite.

Neat facilities

You will find the sanitary facilities that belong to this campsite in the farmhouse. There is a separate men's and women's area with two showers, two toilets and two high-quality washbasins. At the farmhouse, campers may also use the covered dishwashing area, refrigerator-freezer, washing machine and dryer.

properties.name: Camping du Lac de Groléjac
properties.description:
In the popular French holiday region of Dordogne, Camping du Lac de Groléjac is set amidst greenery beside a lake. This fairly small-scale and family campsite with its hundred or so pitches really does exude tranquillity. You can enjoy the lake and the beautiful surroundings with old villages, castles, gardens and lovely markets.

Swimming, fishing and sailing

During your holiday on Camping de Lac de Groléjac you will have plenty of fun in the water. You'll enjoy a beautifully landscaped outdoor swimming pool (heated) and a toddlers' pool. Just outside the campsite is a large lake where you can enjoy swimming, fishing and sailing. The campsite's sandy beach is right next to the lake. Bring an umbrella, an inflatable boat and a book and you will be entertained for hours. Fishing enthusiasts will find a quieter corner of the lake to their hearts' content.

Fun and entertainment in high season

In high season, you will find many families with children here. During this period, fun activities are organised for all ages. Such as a mini club, sports tournaments, theme nights and concerts. The children will also have a great time in the playground, on the trampolines or at the table tennis table. A traditional game of jeu de boules is also possible. In the low season, you will find mainly older visitors and families with young children here.

Restaurant and fresh bread rolls

From about mid-June to mid-September you can get fresh rolls at the campsite. The restaurant is also open during this period, offering pizzas, snacks and take-away food. For more shopping, it is a five-minute drive to a small supermarket.

properties.name: Camping Igara de San Sebastián
properties.description:
Everything at Camping Igara de San Sebastián revolves around San Sebastian, the beautiful Basque coastal town in the north-west of Spain. This modern campsite is located in the wooded hills on the outskirts of the city, some seven km from the centre and less than five km from the beach.

Well maintained camping

The campsite looks well-tended and the touring pitches and rental accommodation units have an uncluttered layout. As a result, the campsite lacks some of the charm of a real nature campsite. The pitches are also very well maintained, albeit somewhat tight. Therefore, they are not suitable for very large camping equipment. In addition, there is a possibility that you stand in between mobile homes. There are separate pitches for motorhomes as well as a separate field for tent campers who are free to pick their own spot. Leaving the caravan, motorhome or tent at home? If so, you have a choice of various mobile homes. 

Cocktails by the pool

The pleasant campsite swimming pool is located at the edge of the woodlands. After having spent the day in San Sebastian, a refreshing dip in the pool is very welcome. Or start your day with a workout of a few laps in the morning sun. Colourful cocktails are served at the lounge bar next to the swimming pool.

Restaurante Mario’s

The large building with its lovely wooden shutters is home to Restaurante Mario's. Here you can enjoy a meal in a charming setting with a choice from an extensive menu. The small supermarket on the campsite, also centrally located like the restaurant, stocks a limited range.

Sanitary facilities with sauna

The sanitary facilities are located in the building adjacent to the restaurant. You will also find the sauna here. The sanitary facilities are modern and neat, just like the rest of the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Au Valbonheur
properties.description:
In southeast France, in the Écrins massif, lies the cosy family campsite of Camping Au Valbonheur. You camp here in a very natural environment, so it almost feels like you are camping in the wild. With swimming lake and private beach and sport opportunities. The camping is situated at the foot of the French Alps. From the highway it is approximately 45 minutes' drive through a green and mountainous region. You will be welcomed with a smile by the owners and employees. The proprietor has owned this campsite since 2015 and does his utmost to make this a real quality campsite.

Special camping between the trees

You will find spacious pitches for your caravan, camper or tent amidst trees, brooks and greenery. The generous pitches ensure a peaceful holiday. In addition, Camping Au Valbonheur offers very special accommodation to stay in. For instance, tepee tents, huts on stilts and igloo huts. You can also spend the night in a chalet or mobile home for a slightly more luxurious feel. This campsite is mainly frequented by families with young children.

Own beach

Camping Au Valbonheur is situated alongside a small lake with private beach with loungers for camping guests. This lake is suitable for swimming, kayaking and canoeing. On the beach you can have a game of volleyball. Children will love the soccer field and the inflatable bouncers.

properties.name: Sauga Fishing Village
properties.description:
This campsite is located in a seaside resort in the Baltic country of Estonia. Its location on the Sauga River and close to the Baltic Sea makes it an ideal destination for watersports enthusiasts. Camping Fishing Village has its own jetty, including boat rental, a small shop with fishing equipment, and offers endless opportunities for fishing. It's also a good starting point to explore western Estonia.

Fishing on the campsite

The campsite is mainly aimed at fishermen, and you can buy both fishing gear and bait here. Fishing excursions, where you go out on the water with an instructor to fish, are also organised. The campsite restaurant mainly serves freshly caught fish.

The river is also suitable for boating or swimming.

Outdoor sports activities

Other outdoor sports activities are also organised. These include archery, participating in sports tournaments, target shooting or going out with the campsite owner to spot wild bears. There's also a football field where camping guests can kick a ball.

Camping Fishing Village has both camping pitches and rental accommodations.

Pärnu

Camping Fishing Village is located about 3 kilometres from the centre of Pärnu. With about 38,000 inhabitants, Pärnu is one of the major cities in Estonia. The city is also called the 'summer capital' of Estonia.

The campsite is located in a wooded area, but the beach is also not far away. Along the coast of Pärnu you'll find a 2 kilometre long sandy beach and a boulevard with nice shops and restaurants.

properties.name: Agricampeggio La Stadera
properties.description:
The simple and small Agricampeggio (rural campsite) La Stadera, extends across the slope of a mountain, roughly 300 metres above sea level. The hills, mountains and sea are all relatively close by. The city of San Vittore di Cesena is ten kilometres away. The rustic location of this terraced campsite is a favourite of those seeking peace and quiet. It is a wonderful place for roaming campers of all ages and nationalities to set up camp. The thermal spa resort Fratta Terme is located just four kilometres from the campsite, including the associated Indiana Park with swimming pool.

Cosy Italian agritourism

La Stadera's eight camping pitches vary in size (60-100 m2) and are clearly marked out. The campsite is part of the organic farm of the same name, which is located on an 8.5 ha estate. The farm specialises in all kinds of berries, which are used to make jam. Olive oil is produced here as well. 

Fine food and drink

The camping restaurant, which features a traditional look and feel, is open from Thursday to Sunday. The food is prepared using local produce from the farm. The home-made pasta is an absolute must. This region is also where the prestigious Sangiovese red wine is made. You can purchase this wine and other local items at one of the many different producers in the region. 

World heritage just around the corner

Nearby San Vittore di Cesena is home to the Malatestiana library. This library (one of the oldest in Europe) is on the UNESCO World Heritage list. Its 340 Latin, Greek and Hebrew manuscripts date back to the 11th-15th centuries. The city's cathedral has a Roman facade and a Gothic interior.

properties.name: Camping Peenecamp
properties.description:
Camping Peenecamp is on the banks of the Peene and close to Lake Kummerow. Here, you can only stay on a spacious pitch with your own camping equipment, but also in a holiday home by the water. The campsite is close to the idyllic German village of Neukalen and is a handy base for exploring the area. The charming port city of Rostock (71 km) is under an hour away.

The Amazon of the North

Camping Peenecamp offers a relaxing stay on the banks of the Peene, a river that is also known as the Amazon of the North due to its lush vegetation. Every camping pitch at this campsite is spaciously laid out and offers plenty of privacy due to natural separation with trees and bushes. This natural green environment not only provides a calming sleeping environment, but also a setting in which you can unwind.

If you don't have your own camping equipment, hire one of the holiday homes. What makes these little house so special is that they are by the water of the river which adds to a feeling of calm and a bit of adventure.

Explore Mecklenburgische Schweiz

Camping Peenecamp serves as an excellent starting point for trips to explore Mecklenburgische Schweiz, the 'Switzerland of Mecklenburg-Voor-Pommeren'. As a walker or cyclist, you will find numerous routes here that take you along Lake Kummerow, through forests and past rural villages.

The nearby village of Neukalen (500 m), with its charming street, shops and restaurants offer enjoyment every day of the week. For families, there is also a playground and animal pasture in the vicinity.

properties.name: Charmecamping & Appartementen De Regge-Vallei
properties.description:
Camping De Regge-Vallei is a beautifully situated campsite in the village of Den Ham. Here in the north of Overijssel, you can enjoy a pleasant camping holiday. Nature is your best friend here, as you can explore the Sallandse Heuvelrug, Twente and the Vecht region easily by bike or on foot.

Camping and renting

The Regge-Vallei is a friendly campsite with approximately 55 comfort pitches. Here you can camp comfortably with your own camping equipment. In addition to the usual amenities (electricity, water, drainage), there is also free Wi-Fi (fibre optic). Furthermore, campers without their own camping equipment are also welcome. They can stay in a large tent, apartment or holiday home.

A special motorhome area

Since 2019, De Regge-Vallei has had a camper field with twenty "XL comfort" pitches. The pitches on this field are paved, as is the access road to it. Around it is grass. In addition, the pitches are very spacious: about 250 m2. As a result, you will have plenty of space and privacy as a camper. You also have a panoramic view everywhere, which only enhances this feeling. What makes the camper field so special is that campers with a caravan or folding trailer may also book a spot there.

Entertainment for young and old

You can show off your sporty side on the boules court. Children also have access to a play area with a sandpit, seesaw, jungle gym and trampoline. There are also go-karts and children's bikes to use. In bad weather, look for the covered recreation room. Here, a table tennis table, billiard table, shuffleboard, dartboard, reading table and ball pit provide the necessary entertainment. During the high season, guests of the campsite can use the swimming pool located two kilometres away free of charge.

properties.name: Camping Am Treidlerweg
properties.description:
Campingplatz am Treidlerweg is right on the Elbe, on the famous Elbe cycle path and in the middle of the hilly, forested landscape of Saxon Switzerland. You will often have an unobstructed view of the water; landmarks include the Lilienstein and the fortress of Königstein.

Camp by the water

The campsite is terraced and well-organised, with many waterfront pitches. The pitches are not huge but big enough. Along the Elbe, caravans and motor home pitches are usually positioned sideways on so that as many guests as possible benefit from the view.

Apartment above the toilet and washing facilities overlook the Elbe. A number of unusual cabins and lodge tents are available to rent for campers who like to try something different. Good to know: the campsite is close to a railway line and trains can be heard passing by.

Food and play within walking distance

The Elbe-Freizeitland amusement park is right next to the campsite. Climbing, scrambling, sliding, karting. Children can play to their heart's content there. Bonus: campsite guests get a discount on admission.

The hotel-restaurant nearby is a good place to eat. Take a seat on the waterfront terrace and enjoy the good and reasonably-priced cuisine.

Saxon Switzerland around the corner

From the campsite, explore the region at your own pace. Cycle for kilometres along the Elbe, or walk through Saxon Switzerland National Park. The routes to Paptstein and Gohrischstein and the fortress of Königstein start at the campsite. The area’s main attraction is the Bastei rock formation with a bridge of the same name.

properties.name: Sites et Paysages La Torche
properties.description:
Camping La Torche is located in Plomeur in the Finistère, 1.3 km from the Atlantic Ocean. The campground is close to the popular surfing spot of "La Torche". The campground, where you can also hire mobile homes, is 4 hectares. You have the choice of separated, green campsites with much, little or no shade.

Horseback riding along the sea

There is a heated covered pool on the campsite with a sliding room and a kiddie pool. For children there is a mini club and an activity programme in French and English. The campground has a playground for children up to 6 years, trampoline, bouncy castle, multi-sport field and there is a disco in the evenings. There is an equestrian centre nearby where you can take rides along the sea. Bikes and mountain bikes can be rented on the campground.

Activities

Various activities are organised. In the high season you can take part in sports activities and workshops. In the evening there are concerts, karaoke and dance evenings. The necessities in groceries and fresh bread are available in the campground shop. You'll find a large supermarket in Plomeur. Pizzas and take-away meals are for sale on the campground in the high season.

Surfing beach

Take the dune path to the broad 1300 metre long sandy beach. La Torche is popular for beginner and advanced surfers due to the high waves. Even for non-surfers, it is a beautiful spectacle to watch, or you can learn to surf at one of the surf schools. There are two beaches where the surfers and bodyboarders are separated from the kite surfers and the beachgoers. Due to the strong current, the beach is monitored by life guards.

properties.name: Camping Paradis Les Capucines
properties.description:
Camping Paradis Les Capucines is situated in the Côte d'Armor region of northern Brittany. This quiet, family-friendly campsite is set on partially sloping grounds with beautiful terraced levels. The lovely green pitches are separated from one another by well-maintained hedges. Camping Paradis Les Capucines is a four-star campsite with a friendly look and a welcoming atmosphere.

Greenery and flowers

The Les Capucines campsite has ninety spacious touring pitches, all laid out on grassy fields and separated by attractive hedges. You can choose a sunny spot or one with plenty of shade. The best pitches are on the left-hand side of the toilet facilities. The campsite offers rental accommodation, including mobile homes, lovely chalets, spacious safari tents and tree houses.

Covered swimming pool

There is a heated, covered swimming pool right by the entrance and reception area. On nice days, the roof can be fully opened. There is also a separate paddling pool which is also heated. Outside, there is a large water slide. Les Capucines is only about a kilometre from the coast, so you don’t have to walk very far to enjoy a dip in the sea. The beautiful sandy beaches of Saint-Michel-en-Grève are a twenty-minute walk away.

Petting zoo and indoor playground

There are plenty of activities for children at the campsite. In addition to the swimming pool with water slide, there are many other facilities designed especially for children. There is a trampoline, a bouncy castle, a playground, a mini-golf course and a petting zoo with small farm animals. The campsite has an outdoor playground as well as an indoor play area.

properties.name: MS Vacances - Camping Club Pontaillac Plage
properties.description:
Camping Campéole Pontaillac Plage is a beautiful park campsite located about three hundred metres from a lively boulevard and the beach. You are close to the larger town Royan. Here in the Charente-Maritime, maritime life is visible everywhere. Enjoy beaches, bays, picturesque fishing villages, chic seaside resorts, marshlands and oysters!

Renting

You drive to your pitch via well-paved paths. Then the enjoyment can really begin. The campsite has various types of rental accommodation for up to 6 people. The rental accommodations are comfortable and offer plenty of luxury. The campsite restaurant is the place to be for a tasty snack. Go for a pizza, fish dish or something else from the menu. In Royan you will find many more catering establishments, mainly fish restaurants.

Fun in the water

There is a small swimming pool on the campsite. It has a nice spot among the trees. Next to the deep pool is a shallow paddling pool with water games. You can have more fun in the sea. You walk in a few minutes to the beautiful, clean beach of Pontaillac. Bring a shovel and bucket so you can collect shells. A nice memento of your holiday!

Sport and games

If you have had enough fun in the water, you can continue the fun on dry land. Hit a ball on the tennis court, get some people together to play volleyball and challenge each other to a game of pétanque. Children can play in the playground and on the bouncy castle. In the evening there is always plenty of entertainment. Check out the magic shows or performances. Fun!

properties.name: Camping Château de Chanteloup
properties.description:
Château de Chanteloup is a castle campsite in the Sarthe close to Le Mans. The campsite is situated on the beautiful estate around the castle with lawns, forests and ponds. The camping pitches on grass are spacious and demarcated by trees, flower fields and woodpiles.

Estate campsite

The camping fields are located around the castle and the historical outbuildings. The history of Chanteloup, originally a small stately home, dates back to 1400, but the main buildings are from the fifteenth and nineteenth centuries. The swimming pool is nicely blended into the landscape and is surrounded by lawns and greenery.

A sense of calmness prevails at the swimming pool. Not far from the swimming pool you will find playground equipment for children, such as a trampoline, bouncer and swings.

Historical guest quarters

Château de Chanteloup has five guest quarters established in the old buildings. They are furnished with antique or rural family heirlooms, yet equipped with modern comforts like television and dishwasher. Almost all quarters have a private garden with garden furniture, loungers and a barbecue. In addition, there are glamping tents which have also been partly fitted out in authentic style. Children will be delighted with their own small tent next to the large tent with all conveniences.

Plenty to do

The campsite also offers amenities for sports and games. There are soccer and volley ball fields and a fitness area. Activities such as sports tournaments, games and building huts, are organised on a regular basis. In high season there is a mini club for children aged 4 to 10. Activities such as canoeing, paintballing or tree climbing are available in the immediate vicinity. Car racing fans can go to the racing circuit of the 24 hours of Le Mans.

properties.name: Camping Fontaine du Roc
properties.description:
In the green interior on the border of the Périgord and Agenais regions, the Fontaine du Roc campsite has a rustic location. Here you will experience a camping holiday in the middle of nature with fine facilities such as a swimming pool with jacuzzi. The picturesque village of Villeréal is just eight kilometres away.

Open campsite

If you look around you will mainly see trees and shrubs on the open terrain which offer plenty of shade. You have all the space you need thanks to the large pitches. Several pitches have a beautiful view over the valley or even on the castle of Biron. The furnished tents, chalets and mobile homes look neat and tidy and are located at the back of the campsite.

Swimming or in the jacuzzi

The very spacious swimming pool is a lively and popular place on the campsite. Next to the large pool is a paddling pool. You can also relax here thanks to the sunbeds. Extra fun is the jacuzzi with a view of the castle. For safety there is a fence around the pool.

Playing outside

Small campers can have fun on the trampoline or in the playground. During the summer holidays, it is party time at the children's theatre and the fun games organised by the campsite. The joint petanque competitions are popular among young and old.

Limited menu

In the pleasant bar you can get an ice cream, snack, cup of coffee or cold beer. If you want a bite to eat, choose something tasty from the simple menu. For fresh bread in the morning and some basic groceries you can also go here.

properties.name: Capfun Camping La Grenouillère
properties.description:
Do you enjoy a family campsite with fun and entertainment? Then you are in the right place. You don't just come to this campsite to rest, but also to have fun! Capfun's La Grenouillère Campsite has an extensive range of French-language entertainment and three beautiful swimming pools. The children can let off steam on the waterslides and the spectacular Space Bowl. You have a wide choice of rental accommodations and will find several beautiful castles to visit in the area.

Discover your accommodation

Once you drive onto the camping grounds, it's time to get out and stretch your legs. Sign up at the reception and find out which of the accommodations you'll be staying in this holiday. You will find a wide range of mobile homes on the site. There are even extra large accommodations for up to eleven people. Think of two connected mobile homes with a shared terrace or a large accommodation especially aimed at children. You will experience the ideal family holiday here.

On to the Space Bowl

The swimming pools are well cared for, just like the rest of the campsite. The pools are located in the middle of the camping area. There is a heated indoor pool and three unheated pools. The little ones can play safely in the heated paddling pool. Meanwhile, the older children can slide down the spectacular Space Bowl or one of the three other waterslides. Even more fun can be had on the playground, in the bouncy castle or around the table tennis tables. Satisfy your appetite with snacks from the supermarket or a meal in the restaurant.

properties.name: Camping Le Pont de Mazerat
properties.description:
Camping Le Pont de Mazerat is situated in the woody and hilly landscape of the Dordogne, more specifically the Périgord Noir. This region is known for the Caves of Lascaux, the many castles and the characteristic towns of Montignac and Sarlat. The small-scale campsite is situated exactly between these towns. You will find an open campsite in the free nature, where you can camp in all peace and privacy.

Privacy and quiet

On the campsite Le Pont de Mazerat you will camp in the open air. The pitches are all equally spacious and are situated between trees and high hedges. This gives you a lot of privacy and peace. In addition to the fifty or so touring pitches, the campsite has ten special camper pitches and almost forty rental accommodations: mobile homes, Coco Sweet lodges and safari tents.

Swimming in the sun

Next to the grassy field is the campsite swimming pool. This is not particularly large, but for an hour of water fun it is fine. The shallow end can accommodate smaller children, and next to the pool is a paddling pool for the little ones. The swimming pool is in the sun; for a place in the shade you can sit on one of the deck chairs under the parasol.

The Tamniès bathing lake

Do you find the swimming pool too crowded? No problem, because a few minutes walk and you are at the Etang de Tamniès. This large recreational lake is almost always quiet, so you can swim extensively. A part of the lake is fenced off for swimmers. Sun lovers can spread out their towel on the sandy beach at the edge of the lake.

properties.name: Camping Huttopia Versailles
properties.description:
At Camping Huttopia Versailles you would never guess that you are less than 20 kilometres from the Eiffel Tower. The campsite is in the middle of the woods. The famous castle of Versailles is 4 kilometres away. At this comfortable campsite, you combine a city trip to Paris with a relaxed stay in the country.

Luxury or simplicity?

Camping Huttopia Versailles has 169 pitches. If you are camping with your own tent, caravan, motorhome or van, there are pitches of various sizes available. You can also rent one of the tents, cabins or bungalows. Something for everyone. Will you choose a basic mobile home or a luxury bungalow with bathroom and kitchen?

Some tents are equipped with a wood burner, which makes camping possible all year round. There is free wood available. Camping becomes even more comfortable!

Dive into the pool

After a busy day, relax in the heated swimming pool with sliding roof. There is a wading pool for little campsite visitors.

Not in the mood to cook? At the terrace by the pool, you can enjoy pizzas you make yourself, local wine and a delicious canapé board. In the morning fetch your rolls and sweets, or choose one of the extensive breakfast menus in the Koffie Corner. In the relaxation area, enjoy playing a game or playing table football. There is also a fun playground. In the high season there are various fun activities for young and old the whole day long.

properties.name: Flower Camping Le Port de Neuvic
properties.description:
This campsite is located in the east of the Corrèze, a French department known for its tranquillity, low population density and unspoilt nature. Corrèze is very wooded, but its varied landscapes also feature moors, meadows, dams and lakes. Flower Camping Le Port de Neuvic is located on one of those lakes. It is a popular campsite, especially among peace seekers and nature lovers. In the high season, watersports enthusiasts and families with (young) children also find themselves at home at this campsite.

Lovely touring pitches, some right on the lake

Flower Camping Le Port de Neuvic has a relatively large number of seasonal pitches and rental accommodations, such as mobile homes and lodge tents. There are also a number of neat tourist camping pitches available. Some pitches are beautifully situated right on the lake. Choosing a premium camping pitch? Then you'll have your own sanitary unit at your pitch. The sanitary facilities are modern, clean and easily accessible.

Plenty of fun in the water on the recreational lake

The campsite has its own sandy beach on the Lac de la Triouzoune recreational lake. This is a great place to swim. In addition to swimming, you can also participate in watersports on the lake. These include jet skiing, water skiing, sailing, canoeing and fishing. The swimming area is clearly demarcated from the rest of the lake.

Entertainment in the high season

A variety of activities are organised in high season. For example, there is a festive theme night featuring live music or karaoke several times a week. This is often accompanied by (tastings of) mussels, paella, truffles or other regional products. In addition, there is a pétanque tournament once a week.

properties.name: Camping La Pommeraie
properties.description:
The Camping La Pommeraie campsite is located in the south of Auvergne. From this terraced campsite, you have a beautiful view of the surrounding hills. There are many activities on offer for young campers, including night swimming, magic shows and fun workshops. You can participate in guided hikes or an adventurous Via Ferrata. But those looking for peace and quiet are also well served here.

Follow the N122 to Vic-sur-Cère. On the way, you can enjoy the rugged mountain scenery of the Auvergne Volcanoes Regional Nature Park. From Vic-sur-Cère, you can follow the signs to the campsite. Are you driving through the village? Then just after the river, you will see the campsite. In the main building, you will find the reception, small but pleasant, where you will be welcomed by the friendly hostess, Mrs Romiguière.

A view over the Auvergne

The pitches are at different heights and are lovely and green. The view over the hills and mountains of Auvergne is beautiful there. Around the pools, there is plenty of room to enjoy the water and the view. Of course, there is also a nice paddling pool. At the restaurant, you can get mostly snacks. In the café, you can have breakfast, have a drink, eat an ice cream, or play a game.

For young people, there are magic acts, night-time swimming and archery workshops. There is also plenty for the adult camper to do. For example, hiking tours through the beautiful nature of the Auvergne are organised from the campsite. Real sports enthusiasts can also conquer the Via Ferrata.

properties.name: Camping Sunêlia La Source
properties.description:
Camping La Source is a campsite with a unique location: on the edge of the Sarrans reservoir. From the campsite you have a view over the lake, the wooded area and the peninsula of Laussac. Your holiday will take place in the triangle between Aveyron, Cantal and Aubrac.

Spend the night in a Robinson boat

The pitches are perfectly laid out and offer a view of the lake. Choose a spot in the shade or in the sun. The partitions are low, but the pitches are safely situated on the slope. There are also several special accommodations for rent, such as a wigwam tent, a surfer's hut and a Robinson boat.

Swimming, fishing or defying the track

The swimming pool is at the front of the campsite. Take a dip or find a deckchair for sunbathing on the edge of the pool. The water is heated by a heat pump, so it is also pleasant on a cooler day. You can also take a dip in the nearby reservoir. The banks of the lake are only accessible from the reception.

Fresh bread rolls

The restaurant offers tasty snacks, home-made pizza or a local dish. Or enjoy a drink at the bar. The campsite also has a small shop for some basic groceries. If you want, you can also reserve your fresh bread rolls in the shop. It is even possible to have your groceries delivered or order a basket with local products.

Entertainment

There is plenty of entertainment available at this campsite. For example on the multi-sports field or the jeu-de-boules court. You can also hire canoes and pedalos. In high season there is a mini club and sports events and music evenings are organised.

properties.name: Camping Huttopia Millau
properties.description:
Huttopia Millau campsite is situated on the edge of Millau in the southern French region of Midi-Pyrénées. The campsite is surrounded by the Grands Causses regional natural park and is highly suited to nature enthusiasts and, thanks to the many sporting opportunities, sports lovers too. It's also no more than a kilometre from the centre of this pleasant little town. The Dourbie, an offshoot of the river Tarn, runs right past the campsite. The surrounding green hills emphasise the beauty of the of Grands Causses natural park.

Countryside camping

Camping at the heart of the countryside, that's Huttopia Millau, whether amongst the trees with views of Millau or the Millau viaduct, or on the banks of the Dourbie. Some of the accommodation is immediately adjacent to the river so you can jump from your gypsy wagon or lodge tent right into the water! Some of the lodges are situated a little away from the river. There is also a selection of comfortable cottages.

Fun in the water

Water enthusiasts will love Huttopia Millau campsite. There is a swimming pool for cooling off in warm weather and if the weather is on the cool side, the water can be heated up. You can also take to the river for a swim, plus the River Tarn is great for canoeing and kayaking.

Outdoor sports

Millau is considered the capital of outdoor sports, and a great many activities are organised from the town, including canoeing, rafting, diving, paragliding, mountain biking and mountain climbing. And if you don't feel like joining in, spectators are always welcome!

properties.name: Camping Oasis Palavasienne
properties.description:
This campsite is located in a wonderfully quiet spot in a green area in the Hérault, between Montpellier and the popular Palavas-les-Flots. The beach is only a few kilometres away. And you'll be camping right on the River Lez. Oasis Palavasienne Campsite is a large family campsite that is very popular with families with children, especially in high season. The campsite features two amazing waterparks and wellness, sports and play facilities, among other amenities. In the summer there are plenty of activities and entertainment.

Rent a neat touring pitch or stay in a mobile home

This large campsite has several camping fields with neat tourist camping pitches. There are both sunny and shady spots to be found. The campsite also rents out many mobile homes and some nice tipi and lodge tents.

Water fun galore

This campsite has two beautiful waterparks. The newest park is located at the front of the campsite. Its rectangular swimming pool features three spectacular water slides, including a real funnel slide. The other waterpark consists of a playfully designed outdoor pool with water heated to 27 degrees. A whirlpool, waterfalls, geysers and rapids guarantee you'll have plenty of fun in the water here.

Activities and entertainment in high season

There's a welcome party every Sunday evening during the summer months. There are also many activities for children aged 6 to 12, such as crafts, painting, dancing, magic and treasure hunting. Sports tournaments take place almost every day and offer fun for the whole family. During the high season, you'll round out your evenings with activities such as karaoke nights, cabaret performances, magic shows and dance nights.

properties.name: Capfun Camping Las Bousigues
properties.description:
Are you going to holiday on the Mediterranean Sea in the south of France? You will have a wonderful time with the entire family at this child-friendly campsite featuring five fantastic swimming pools and exciting waterslides. In addition to enjoying themselves swimming, the children will also have a great time here watching the fun live entertainment and playing in the cowboy village.

Comfortable wooden chalets

At this well-maintained holiday park, all holidaymakers stay in a wooden chalet of their choice. There are no camping pitches here. The chalets are located on neat lanes with low vegetation and small trees. It is never far to walk from your chalet to the swimming pools.

Plenty of fun for everyone

The FUN meter is on high at this Capfun campsite! This means that many activities appropriate for children of all ages are organised during the high season. There are three different kids clubs: a mini club (4-7 years), kids club (9-12 years) and a teen club (13-17 years). In addition, you can enjoy fun shows and spectacular performances five nights a week. Or cut loose and join the Capfun summer dance party!

Swim, splash and slide

With no less than five swimming pools, including heated paddling pools and an indoor swimming pool, water rats will never be bored here. And those looking for a little more adventure can take a ride on the spectacular Spacebowl waterslide. Whoever goes around the most laps in the big funnel wins! Or do you prefer speed? Then slide together down the high, coloured slides and see who finishes first.

properties.name: Camping de Saulieu Onlycamp
properties.description:
Camping de Saulieu is a small-scale campsite in Burgundy, on the edge of the Parc naturel régional du Morvan. The campsite is quite simple: don't expect hypermodern sanitary facilities and fully equipped mobile homes. But you do enjoy spacious, sunny pitches and a friendly atmosphere.

Spacious pitches

The campsite radiates tranquillity. Spacious pitches are neatly laid out between the trees and on green lawns. Natural, green fencing ensures privacy. You also have the option of staying the night in one of the rental accommodations. These mobile homes and chalets are scattered across the grounds.

Nature lovers and water sports enthusiasts

The campsite does not focus on a specific target group, but its guests can justifiably be called nature lovers. In the hilly surroundings of the Morvan you can enjoy cycling and walking. In the vicinity of Saint-Martin-du-Puy, some forty kilometres west of the campsite, fanatical rafters can lose all their adrenaline.

Swimming pool and sports fields

The campsite has a simple swimming pool with a separate paddling pool. You will find it at the back of the reception building. Next to it are the sports fields. Don't expect a brand new multi-sports field with a cage construction and artificial grass. The sports fields are somewhat outdated, but kicking, hitting or throwing a ball is fine.

Supermarket in Saulieu

Adjacent to the reception building, between reception and swimming pool, is the bar. Here you have to be for an ice cream, snack or something inbetween. However, you can't get enough to get through the day. Luckily, the supermarket in Saulieu is not far from the campsite: you don't have to drive two kilometres for the groceries.

properties.name: Camping D'Arpheuilles
properties.description:
The charming family campsite Camping d'Arpheuilles is located in a lovely natural area on an inlet of the Loire river in Rhône-Alpes. This is a special location right at the spot where the Loire flows into Lake Villerest. You can boat on the river and swim in the recreation lake. On the banks there is a sandy beach where you can sun yourself and play during the day, and site by a campfire in the evening.

On the lake

The location on the lake at Villerest, an inlet of the Loire river, gives the campsite that something extra. Not only due to the natural experience and the lovely view, but also due to the natural beach and options for fishing, swimming, canoeing or sailing your old boat. About an hour away by boat there is a centuries old castle on the rocks in the lake that you can visit.

Camping with a view

The spacious campsites on grass are partially on terraces and vary in shape and size and are sometimes separated by hedges. Electricity and water are never far away. Some sites are on the lake or on the banks of the river. It is a typical French campsite with a charming atmosphere, sometimes with music in a restaurant that has a covered terrace (roof made of grape leaves).

Campers without their own equipment can get to know glamping in charming lodge tents on the banks of the lake with a beautiful view. The tents do not have their own sanitary facilities, but the chalets and mobile homes do. There are also adapted accommodations for the disabled.

properties.name: Sites & Paysages de Vaubarlet
properties.description:
Sites & Paysages de Vaubarlet is situated In the midst of the wooded and hilly nature of the Haute-Loire. This campsite is a beautiful destination for nature lovers and a paradise for children. With a extensive entertainment programme, a large playground and a swimming pool, the youngest campers can enjoy themselves here. Relax in nature, for example on the river La Dunières, which flows along the campsite. This is also a great place for fishing and paddling.

In the valley, between the hills

Well-kept touring pitches are situated on large lawns at the edge of the forest. Because of this you always have enough shade at the back, while you have an expansive view. Although you'll see mainly touring pitches on the campsite, the choice of rental accommodation is quite varied. You can choose from mobile homes, chalets, lodge tents and roulottes.

Paradise for children

Sites & Paysages de Vaubarlet is fully equipped for smaller children. This youngest camper will have the time of his life at the campsite. In high season, six out of seven days a week are filled with entertainment activities, especially in the open air. If they prefer not to join in, they can let off steam in the playground, on the bouncy castle or in the swimming pool. This heated outdoor pool has a separate pool for the youngest swimmers.

Homemade pizzas

A takeaway meal or rather extensive dining? At this campsite you can do both. Next to the swimming pool you'll find the restaurant, where the dishes are prepared with fresh local produce. Try one of the homemade pizzas, for example.

properties.name: Camping du Pont d'Avignon
properties.description:
Camping in the Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur region means spending your holiday in surroundings filled with lavender fields, vineyards, mountain ridges and historical towns. You can enjoy all this to the fullest when you camp at campsite du Pont d'Avignon. This child-friendly campsite is located on an island in the Rhône river. This campsite is especially popular because it is a municipal campsite in Avignon. From the campsite, you can easily cross the river using the free ferry service or you can walk to the beautiful town centre in 20 minutes.

Camping in comfort

When you drive through the campsite, you can imagine yourself in a lush, green park. There are many trees and the camping pitches are situated on grass. Do you value your privacy during your holiday? Then choose a spacious camping pitch between tall hedges, which also provide plenty of shade. There are also open fields where you can pitch your tent or caravan.

Water fun in the swimming pool

The entire campsite is very green, and this also applies to the swimming pool area. The playfully constructed swimming pool is surrounded by plants, giving you that true holiday feeling when you go for a swim. There is also a paddling pool for the little ones. There are a number of loungers at your disposal.

The restaurant with a terrace is located directly next to the pool, allowing you to keep an eye on the children while they are busy splashing in the water. The children will not be bored in the peak season, with an enthusiastic entertainment team thinking up the most fun activities and games.

properties.name: Camping Le Fou du Roi
properties.description:
This small-scale campsite is located in a quiet spot on the edge of the town of Lansargues, in the Hérault (southern France). This is an ideal starting point for excursions in the area. The campsite is also close to interesting cities such as Montpellier and Nîmes. Camping Le Fou du Roi is a true family campsite, especially in high season. In the summer, fun activities are organised for campers of all ages. There is a beautiful outdoor swimming pool and a cosy snack bar with a terrace.

Neat grounds with spacious touring pitches

This campsite gives a neat, well-kept impression from the start. There are well-maintained touring pitches which are neatly demarcated. You can choose from sunny and shady spots. Some of the deluxe pitches are up to 150 m² in size. In addition to tourist camping pitches, this campsite offers seasonal pitches and rental accommodations, including mobile homes and charming-looking Coco Sweet tents.

Sunny outdoor swimming pool

The outdoor swimming pool is located right next to the reception. This is a wonderful place for a refreshing dip in the summer. There is also a separate paddling pool by the swimming pool. The swimming pool is also in a sunny location, although a number of thatched parasols offer some shade. Of course, you can also swim in the Mediterranean Sea. The nearest beaches are about a twenty-minute drive away.

Lively atmosphere in high season

There are regular aqua gym sessions in the pool. In high season there are also regular dance parties, quiz nights and karaoke events. In addition, there are often fun table tennis, table football and pétanque tournaments. There is also an entertainment team that offers suitable activities for children in the summer months.

properties.name: Camping Couriou
properties.description:
Domaine du Couriu is located in the Drôme and has a beautiful view. The campground is located in an environment with varied landscapes, such as high mountains, lavender fields and Provençal villages.

You can hike a few hills on this terraced campground. This starts right when you walk through the entrance to the reception. At the reception, you'll find a bar, restaurant and terrace. The campground looks well maintained, with spacious camping pitches. A Dutch couple recently took over the campground. They will give you a warm welcome. You'll find quite a few hire tents of a travel organisation among the tents and caravans.

View of the mountains

The campground has spacious pitches with a view of the mountains. You can choose from various sites, with more and less shade. Here, you are camping in an international community. In the high season, there are many families with children, in the low season mostly seniors.

One of the largest in the surrounding area

The swimming pools are located on the lower level of the campground and are some of the largest in the area, with slides. You swim in the sun with a fantastic view of the mountains. In the summer season, the activities are focused on the children.

Well-maintained restaurant

There is a shop on the campground with the necessities. For larger shops, drive to Die (with a weekly Provençal market). The restaurant with bar is well maintained and is located in the same building as the reception. You look out over the swimming pools and the surroundings. There are multiple nice sanitation blocks, distributed throughout the campground.

properties.name: Capfun Camping Le Carpe Diem
properties.description:
Enjoy a wonderful holiday at this campsite, located in the department of Provence in the sunny south of France. Travel back in time by visiting the ancient sights of the historic town of Vaison-la-Romaine, located within walking distance of the campsite. The sporty holidaymaker can also scale the mythical peak of Mont Ventoux by bike or car. But there is also plenty to do at Capfun Le Carpe Diem Campsite itself. For example, you can enjoy the spectacular water park featuring four swimming pools and fun waterslides. Or imagine yourself in Roman times as you defend the campsite from the sturdy play fort. Finally, after an enjoyable day playing outside and splashing in the swimming pool, you can completely relax in your wooden chalet or mobile home.

An accommodation for everyone

As there are no camping pitches here, you will be spending the night in one of this cosy holiday park's rental accommodations. However, Capfun always offers a wide range of accommodation types. You can choose a mobile home with all basic amenities, but you can also book wooden chalets. In these more luxurious accommodations, for example, you have two bathrooms and a dishwasher at your disposal.

Great fun for young and old

Many activities are organised during high season. The campsite is also the place to be for real water rats. With no less than four swimming pools, several waterslides and a water playground for toddlers, you can splish and splash to your heart's content. Two pools are unheated and the other two are heated and covered. So you can always get in the water, in good weather or bad.

properties.name: Camping Huttopia Bourg-St-Maurice
properties.description:
The Huttopia Bourg-St-Maurice campsite is located in the high mountains of Savoy, on the edge of the Vanoise National Park. This is a large and well-maintained campsite with new sanitary facilities and spacious pitches. From the pitches on the verdant campsite you have a view of the surrounding Alps. A great place for the active camper.

Spacious camping

There are around 130 pitches on the spacious campsite. These vary in size, but most of them are quite large. You can choose a nature pitch or a comfort pitch. The nature pitches (without electricity) are especially nice for tent campers: they are situated on a sloping part of the site, in the shade of a tree or in the sun. The comfort pitches are slightly more spacious and do have electricity. In addition, there are around twenty-five paved camper pitches and almost three times as many rental units.

Swimming with a mountain view

There are three swimming pools on a sun deck close to the reception. One of them is a paddling pool. From the completely new swimming pools and the sun loungers on the sun deck you look out over the high mountains. The campsite is situated in the blazing sun, but even in less warm weather you can take a dip. The water is heated.

Pizza from the ‘Roulotte’

If you are camping in high season and you feel like a pizza or a cool drink, go and look for the ‘Roulotte” by the pool. They serve snacks and drinks there during the summer months. In the morning you can go there for fresh bread. You can do your daily shopping in Bourg-St-Maurice. This is a tourist town with many amenities.

properties.name: Camping Huttopia Gorges du Verdon
properties.description:
Huttopia Gorges du Verdon campsite is an active family campsite in Provence, located directly on the banks of the Verdon river. It finds its way through the steep cliffs from which you have a view from your pitch on the green campsite. The campsite lends itself perfectly as a stopover for a journey to the south coast of France, but also as a base from which to discover the Gorges du Verdon.

Pitches by the river or road?

The campsite has two faces: one side is situated on the busy access road to the Gorges du Verdon, the other side borders on the river. Here, on the Verdon, you will find the most beautiful pitches. Some of them have a view over the flowing water and the cliffs. If you are close to the busy road, you would do well to ask for another spot. In addition to pitches, there are many rental accommodation on the large campsite, all in safari style.

Swimming, sunbathing and summer entertainment

Juggling, archery, games in nature: the entertainment on the campsite is quite versatile. During the summer months, various activities are organised for children of all ages. For their own amusement they can go to the playground, but especially the swimming pool is a place where you will meet many children. The swimming pool, with paddling pool at its side, is surrounded by a terrace with sun loungers and parasols.

Groceries in Castellane

For the most necessary groceries you can go to the campsite shop, but for the daily groceries you have to go to Castellane. On the campsite they serve pizza and snacks, but for a more elaborate dinner you can choose the restaurants in Castellane.

properties.name: Thermal Camping Zalakaros
properties.description:
In the heart of Hungary’s green countryside lies Thermal Camping Zalakaros. An oasis of peace and relaxation. Here you camp in the shade of trees and wake up to the sound of singing birds. You would never guess that you were camping so close to a spa complex. Are you looking for action and relaxation during your camping holiday? Whether you come for the tranquillity, the wellness, or the natural surroundings, this campsite is perfect for you.

The peace and quiet of a forest

At Thermal Camping it is like camping in a forest. The spacious, unmarked pitches give a feeling of space and freedom. And you have as much as 100 m2 for yourself, whether you are camping with a campervan, caravan or tent. Thanks to the trees, there’s almost always a shaded spot to be found. And there’s no need to worry about finding a pet-sitter – dogs are welcome throughout the campsite.

Relax and enjoy

Take a seat at the Zalakaros Camping Restaurant and enjoy local specialities together. Here you can taste traditional Hungarian dishes and international favourites. For a little extra relaxation, you don't necessarily have to leave the site. Book a professional massage and completely unwind.

From the campsite, it’s just a five-minute walk to the famous Zalakaros Spa. You can buy tickets at the campsite with a 10% discount. Enjoy a variety of pools, saunas and treatments – and for the kids, there’s a dedicated adventure pool with slides.

properties.name: Camping Mirabella
properties.description:
Mirabella Camping is a paradise on the banks of Lake Balaton in Hungary, with a vast sandy beach that begs you to sunbathe, swim and play. The central location of the campsite makes it easy to reach the charming village of Tihany by ferry. The site itself has numerous amenities, including a heated swimming pool to cool off on hot days and a well-stocked campsite shop for all your shopping. Both young and old will enjoy themselves in the high season with the many activities that are organised.

Camping on the edge of Lake Balaton

Mirabella Camping gives you complete freedom to map out your ideal camping experience, whether you choose for the adventurous feeling of a tent on the grassy field, the convenience of a motorhome pitch or a comfort pitch with your own water and electricity. There are also beachside pitches with a clear view of Lake Balaton. Mobile homes with air conditioning are also available.

Fun for young and old

You will not lack anything at Mirabella Camping. Go for a nice swim in the heated swimming pool while the children amuse themselves in the large playground. If you want a bite to eat and a drink, visit the restaurant or the snack bar. And for a bit of shopping, you can go to the campsite shop. During the high season the entertainment team organises many activities for young and old. Naturally, there is also plenty of fun to be had in Central Europe’s largest lake. You can go swimming and participate in water sports, such as standup paddleboarding and windsurfing. Equipment for these activities can be rented at the campsite.

properties.name: Lakeview Cannobio Camping & Resort (ex Camp Bosco)
properties.description:
The major attraction of the small-scale and quiet Lakeview Cannobio Camping & Resort (ex Camping Bosco) is the splendid view over Lago Maggiore with the surrounding mountain scenery. It is only a short distance away from the convivial little town of Cannobia. The campsite is particularly suited for tent campers and couples; the campsite is not quite as suitable for families with small children and teenagers. You will find a large number of German and Dutch campers here.

Terraced campsite

The shaded grounds are of a modest size and extremely suitable for tent campers, although caravans and mobile homes can also be accommodated. The camping pitches are situated on terraces and vary in size. The pitches are not marked and have a grassy surface. The rental accommodations (mobile homes) are somewhat dated, but very clean. The campsite is situated along a busy road; especially in morning peak hours, this may cause some noise nuisance.

Private beach

The Lago Maggiore is close by: it is a few minutes' walk via an underpass of the main road to the private grassy beach with a wide choice of free sun loungers. The lake is ideal for swimming. Windsurfing, whitewater kayaking, rafting and waterskiing are also possible and allowed here. Tip: please bring your water shoes as there are pebbles in the water. There are but few facilities on the camping grounds.

Small camping shop

There is a small shop for daily necessities and a bar. A bread service is also available. In Cannabio, at a 10-minute drive from the campsite, there are two supermarkets and a lively promenade with numerous sidewalk cafés and restaurants. You will need a car (or bicycle) to get to Cannobio.

properties.name: Camping Residence Campagna
properties.description:
At Camping Residence Campagna you'll stay right on the lovely Lago Maggiore, not far from the Swiss border. The property is nicely maintained and divided up in a well arranged manner. The campsites are located in rows on grass fields. The most lovely places are along the lake with a beautiful view of the water and the surrounding mountain landscape. There are plenty of sites with shade. The lovely, modern sanitation facilities kept very clean.

Accessible to everyone, even for disabled campers. The mobile homes and apartments look very nice. Because of the cars parked here and there, the property is sometimes a bit cramped. You can hear the road passing the campground.

Lago Maggiore

Camping Residence Campagna is located on Lago Maggiore and has direct access to a pebble beach with two docks. You can take a lovely swim in the lake. You can also wind surf, wild water raft, kayak, raft and water ski.

An area of game and mountains

There is little to do for children on the property itself, but the lake nearby offers daily swimming, snorkelling, taking a boat ride or jumping from the dock. In the area surrounding the campground there are many hiking routes among the mountains and the lake and the Val Grande national park (one of the largest game areas in Europe).

Tasty dishes

The campground restaurant offers a small menu with tasty dishes for a friendly price. Even campground guests from nearby campgrounds come to eat here. There is bread service. There is also a small shop with a limited selection. In Cannobio, there is a supermarket and numerous restaurants and terraces.

properties.name: EuroParcs Kohnenhof
properties.description:
EuroParcs Kohnenhof is a relaxed campsite along the Luxembourg bank of the Our. You can camp here in peace and enjoy the lovely nature of the area. The river is a convenient place for playing, boating and fishing. The camping pitches are located by the river. The campsite also has several rental accommodations.

Elongated along the river

The camping pitches are located along the river and may be somewhat soggy in wet weather. All pitches are spacious and some are hardened. Many camping pitches are separated. In addition to camping pitches, various types of bungalows are available for rent.

Water pleasure

On the campsite you can have a lot of water fun in the Our, where you can wade along the banks. There is also a bridge to keep your feet dry when crossing into Germany.

Lovely food

The shop has a limited selection. Besides some basic necessities you can order fresh bread each day. You will be able to do all your shopping less than ten minutes away by car. In the cosy restaurant in an old farmhouse you can enjoy a lovely dinner. Luxembourg residents also come here for dinner. The sanitary facilities are neat and tidy and were newly built in 2018.

properties.name: EuroParcs Schoneveld
properties.description:
Looking for a campsite by the sea? EuroParcs Schoneveld is in the southernmost tip of Zeeland, near Breskens. You’ll literally be camping with your feet in the sand: the beach overlooking the Westerschelde estuary is close by. Ideal for families, peace seekers and anyone who likes being outdoors. The dunes are within walking distance and the sea is your back garden: you’ll really unwind here.

Large pitches, plenty of comfort

This campsite combines space with comfort. The pitches are large (120 m²), well maintained and surrounded by green. So, there’s a lot of privacy. Don't fancy pitching your own tent? Then choose a chalet or lodge. They are all fully equipped. So, you can combine outdoor life with luxury: very relaxing.

Activities for the whole family

There’s plenty to do at the park. For example, take a dip in the heated indoor pool, while the children have fun in the playground, or join in with the entertainment team. For a tasty lunch or dinner, head to the park restaurant to experience fresh Zeeland cuisine. Need a moment to yourself? Relax in the spa or have a drink at the bar!

Discover Zeeland at your leisure

From the campsite, walk or cycle straight into nature. Enjoy fresh air on the beach, stroll through the fishing village of Breskens and enjoy fresh fish in the harbour. Discover the charming villages in the region or take a trip through the vast polder landscape.

properties.name: Kennemer Duincamping Geversduin
properties.description:
Kennemer Duincamping Geversduin is located in a wooded dune reserve, close to the beach. Given the extensive entertainment programmes and beautiful playgrounds, this large campsite is ideal for families with children, especially during school holidays. Nevertheless, this campsite, with its many pitches subtly integrated into nature, does not radiate mass tourism at all. This campsite convincingly shows how recreation and nature conservation can go hand in hand.

Atmospheric camping pitches

Many of the camping pitches are subtly integrated into the dune landscape and therefore give a cosy impression. They are also separated from each other in a natural way. Would you like to take your dog with you? Then the campsite management will assign a pitch on the De Hoepse Beek field. Pets are not allowed on the other camping fields.

Furthermore, only on the camping fields De Binnenduinrand and Het Duinstruweel your car can stay at your pitch. All other fields are car-free. In terms of rental accommodation, this campsite offers beach cottages, vegetable houses, tree houses and even a real underground hobbit's house.

Plenty of entertainment for children

At Kennemer Duincamping Geversduin everything is done to give children and adults a great holiday. The youngest children can start the day swinging with mascot Ullie and then participate in creative or sportive activities. The varied entertainment programme during the school holidays also includes sports tournaments, scouting days, pony riding and hiking in the woods. Apart from this there are several original playgrounds. These are invariably built from natural residual materials such as lo pand crop. There is also a watchtower from which you have a beautiful view over the campsite and the surrounding dune landscape.

properties.name: EuroParcs Spaarnwoude
properties.description:
EuroParcs Spaarnwoude is located in the heart of North Holland. This diverse province is known for its beautiful natural areas, historic cities and wetlands. The park offers every comfort: a heated swimming pool, wellness, restaurant and luxury chalets. Explore Spaarnwoude Park on foot or by bike, or hit a ball on one of the nearby golf courses. In addition, Amsterdam, Haarlem and the Zaanse Schans are just a short distance away.

A chalet as a second home

At this holiday park, there are no caravans or endless row of tents. No, here you will find only the finest accommodation. The 2 to 8-bed chalets are fully equipped, with some having even more options than others. All the chalets have a nice terrace with garden furniture. Air conditioning, an outdoor fireplace or even a waterfront terrace are optional. Good to know: due to its location near Schiphol Airport, planes do occasionally fly over.

A luxury holiday park

As befits a real holiday park, at EuroParcs Spaarnwoude you will find everything you need for a successful weekend break or a complete holiday. Enjoy a meal at Sophia's restaurant or get your daily groceries and fresh sandwiches in the park shop. Make your way to the centre building for the heated pool with children's pool and gym. You can also use the wellness area with infrared cabin and sauna here for a fee.

On holiday with the dog and/or children?

Pets are allowed in several accommodations and your four-legged friend will be delighted by the surroundings with its many hiking trails. The children can entertain themselves in one of the playgrounds or in the petting zoo.

properties.name: EuroParcs Veluwemeer
properties.description:
EuroParcs Veluwemeer is just outside the village of Nunspeet, in the north of Gelderland. As the name of this holiday park suggests, the site is right by Lake Veluwe (Veluwemeer in Dutch). This resort is an excellent starting point for day trips to the beautiful villages of Elburg and Harderwijk and Nunspeet itself of course. The Dolfinarium and Walibi Holland theme park are also within easy reach. Furthermore, this park is just outside the Veluwe, meaning it's also possible to visit this beautiful nature reserve. There is also plenty to do at the holiday park itself. You can go swimming, play sports, games and go out to dinner. There is plenty of entertainment during the school holidays.

Choose from luxury accommodation

Anyone who likes to enjoy home comforts while on holiday is at the right place at this resort. EuroParcs Veluwemeer offers extensive glamping options. There are many different luxury holiday homes, chalets and tiny houses for hire. Some of the accommodation are by the water. You can also book a stay in a modern lodge tent with private toilet and washing facilities. The accommodation are suitable for two to 12 holidaymakers.

Have fun swimming in the swimming pool or Lake Veluwe

The park has a lovely swimming pool, which is large enough for swimming laps. There is also a large paddling pool with a fun slide. If you would prefer to swim in natural water, simply walk to the beach that belongs to the holiday park. From here, you can go for a lovely swim in Lake Veluwe. A large part of the water is shallow, making it a safe place for children to swim too.

properties.name: EuroParcs Maasduinen
properties.description:
EuroParcs Maasduinen is in natural surroundings, close to the village of Belfeld in the north of Limburg. If you like walking, this is a good place to be as this campsite is surrounded by a large forest that is largely on German soil. Moreover, this campsite is an ideal starting point for lovely day trips to, for example, Roermond, Venlo, the Maasduinen National Park, Toverland Amusement Park and Arcen, a village known for its stunning castle gardens. Families will feel perfectly at home at EuroParcs Maasduinen. And mainly in the high season when numerous fun activities are organised for children.

Luxury holiday homes and spacious camping pitches

There are mainly holiday homes on this forested site. In terms of maintenance and furnishings, a lot of attention has been paid to the accommodation. At EuroParcs Maasduinen you can book a glamping holiday in a large holiday villa, a modern mobile home or a charming tiny house, among others.

Two neat camping fields have been set up in a corner of the site. If you choose a camping pitch at EuroParcs Maasduinen, you will be on a pitch measuring around 8 square metres with (usually) little shade.

Beautiful indoor swimming pool with paddling pool and sauna

You will find the lovely swimming pool that adorns this park at the front of the site. This is an indoor swimming pool that has the atmosphere of an outdoor pool due to the glass walls around it. Besides the standard swimming pool, there is also a paddling pool with a fun slide. You can walk from the swimming pool straight into the wellness zone. Here, you can relax and unwind in the infrared sauna.

properties.name: Armenistis Camping & Bungalows
properties.description:
Armenistis Camping & Bungalows is a spacious campsite in the Greek peninsula of Sithonia. It is in a very pretty location alongside a beautiful wide beach. They offer a wide range of sports, music and beach activities for young children and teenagers. The shop and eating establishments are also excellent.

Large campsite with variation

The campsite is large and varied. When you arrive, you will see lots of activities and a large number of young camping guests. The pitches are spacious, level and good. They have a sandy surface and the most beautiful pitches are located adjacent to the beach. Thanks to the many festivals and the generous number of sports facilities, this camping is popular with families, also with teenagers.

Life here is all about the beach

The beach is the main attraction of Armenistis Camping & Bungalows, but the sports activities, entertainment for children and music festivals all contribute towards the popularity of the campsite. Many sports, dancing and music activities are held on the beach. Plenty of fun to be had!

Supermarket and beach bar

The campsite has a well-stocked supermarket with fresh meat products. Next to it is a restaurant with bar and a beach bar. The restaurant has a beautiful terrace with a view of the sea and the beach. You have a wide choice of dishes from the menu. The sanitary facilities are spread over several buildings. They are basic, but well maintained and clean.

Nature, music and sports

The campsite is perfectly suited for entertainment on site. The extensive range of sports, games and music will definitely see you through the holidays without getting bored. Furthermore, the area is eminently suitable for walking trips.

properties.name: Camping Madrid Arco Iris
