properties.description:
The attractive feature of this campsite is its proximity to the heart of Madrid in less than one hour by bus. The bus stops in front of the campsite and departs every hour. Nothing wrong with that! Another advantage of this campsite is the large swimming pool. As the campsite is located at an altitude of approx. 700 m, it is cool and has an open feel.

Well maintained pitches

Camping Madrid Arco Iris is a terraced campsite with a large number of deciduous trees on a slightly sloping grounds. The roads on the campsite are paved. The pitches are well maintained, have little or no demarcations and are located on grass, tamped down clay or fine gravel. Some pitches have private sanitary facilities. The pitches measure 70 to 200 m2. You can rent modest to luxury or highly luxury (with jacuzzi) bungalows.

Lovely pool and clean sanitary facilities

The swimming pool (opened from 1 June to 15 September) is large enough (450 m2) to swim a few lengths. Around it you find a sunbathing lawn, the terrace and some playground equipment. You can enjoy the sun over there but also look for a shaded spot. The sanitary facilities are clean and function well, although they are somewhat dated. On the other hand you can rent private sanitary facilities on some of the pitches.

Restaurant, terrace, bar...

There is a spacious, convivial bar (with terrace) where you can also have breakfast. The restaurant has lovingly set tables and stylish furniture. You can choose from the extensive menu or take the set daily menu. The numerous paintings made by the wife of the campsite owner lend a nice touch to the restaurant.

properties.name: Camping Paradis Le Val de Trie
properties.description:
The friendly campsite Le Val de Trie is situated in the lush, wooded Trie valley. It is a peaceful, rural location near the village of Moyenneville. The landscape here boasts country manors, castles and monasteries. The campsite is fairly small and simple, but there is still plenty for children to enjoy.

A place for everyone

The campsite is a great mix of rental accommodations and camping pitches. Guests stay on beautiful, spacious pitches with plenty of sunlight and shade. Gravel paths lead to the pitches. Typically, guests choose their pitches themselves. For example, you might pick a lively location near the reception area or decide to set up shop on a quieter pitch farther away.

Child-friendly

There is plenty for the little ones to do on this child-friendly campsite. They will love the two play areas, bouncy castle and trampoline. The site also features a simple, partially covered swimming pool. During high season, activities are organised as well. 

Eating out

Those who prefer not to cook all the time when on holiday can pay a visit to Le Val de Trie's charming bar. You can choose to enjoy a simple and delicious dish at the bar or take it away with you. If you are looking for good seafood restaurants, they can be found half-hour's drive away on the coast.

Bread delivery service

The small camping shop stocks only the basic necessities. Larger supermarkets are only a few kilometres away from the campsite. However, you can order fresh bread every morning from the campsite. It will be delivered to your camping spot. The sanitary facilities are simple but clean.

properties.name: EuroParcs Bad Hoophuizen
properties.description:
EuroParcs Bad Hoophuizen is in the north of Gelderland, just outside Hulshorst and right by Lake Veluwe. With a water sports centre, a private marina and a long sandy beach by Lake Veluwe, every water sports fan will be at home at this holiday park. Furthermore, the surrounding area offers lovely cities such as Elburg and Harderwijk and the popular Dolfinarium and Walibi Holland theme parks are nearby. Thanks to the indoor swimming pool, the many sports and games facilities and the varied range of entertainment, you will be well entertained at this resort.

From camping pitches to tiny houses and luxury chalets

There are a range of overnight options at this resort which is part of the EuroParcs chain. Modern tiny houses, spacious holiday homes, luxury chalets and large group accommodations, EuroParcs Bad Hoophuizen has them all. Traditional campers can also come to this holiday park.

Relax in the swimming pool and the wellness zone

There is a large indoor swimming pool with a cheerfully decorated paddling pool in the middle of the site. If you would like to swim laps without disruption, make sure you go there at 8 am because the swimming pool is open exclusively for lap swimming from 8 to 9 am. Beside the swimming pool there is a wellness centre with a Finnish sauna and steam bath.

Ideal destination for water sports enthusiasts

You can also go for a lovely swim in natural water when you stay at this resort. The park has a grand 1,100 metres of private beach by Lake Veluwe. This is also a popular location among water sports enthusiasts. You can, for example, go standup paddleboarding, wind-surfing or cruise around in a canoe or on a pedal boat. Moreover, there is a water sports centre that offers water sports lessons in the holiday periods.

properties.name: Camping L'Arize
properties.description:
Camping L’Arize is located at the foot of the Pyrenees, in the southern French department of Ariège. At this small campsite you camp in a mountainous and wooded area, on sheltered pitches. You'll mainly meet young families. The small river L'Arize flows through the campsite and is ideal for small children. In the rugged nature you can go hiking or visit caves and castles.

La Bastide-de-Sérou is a village in the north of the Parc Naturel Régional des Pyrénées Ariégeoises, at the foot of the Pyrenees. The campsite is situated slightly below this village, on a sloping road (well passable}, which runs south from La Bastide-de-Sérou.

Natural campsite

The campsite is situated at the edge of a forest and has many shady pitches. Large hedges provide privacy. There are special pitches for campers. You can also camp in one of the rental accommodations. In the middle of the campsite are the sanitary facilities, in a building made of stone.

Family camping for nature lovers

Camping L'Arize is a real family campsite. Especially in high season you'll see many young families with children. Also nature lovers are bound to like the campsite. In the mountainous surroundings you can enjoy walking and cycling. The shallow Arize meanders through the campsite and is a great play area for children.

Underground river

The underground river system ‘Rivière Souterraine de Labouiche’ is a fifteen minute drive from the campsite, near the town of Foix. The medieval castle Château de Foix is also worth a visit.

properties.name: Ahoi Camp Darß Prerow
properties.description:
The expansive grounds (35 ha) of campsite Prerow (Regenbogen Ferienanlage Prerow in full) are situated in a fairy-tale-like setting on the Baltic Sea, on the northernmost tip of the northern German region of Mecklenburg-Vorpommeren. It is an eco-campsite with an area reserved for naturists. Here, you will find nothing but sea, dunes and sands (fine, almost white sand) as far as the eye can see. An enormous forest lies behind the campsite. It's the perfect place to become one with nature.

Camping behind the dunes

The grounds are expansive, which may not appeal to everyone. If you enjoy small, cosy and structured spaces, you might feel lost here. The (supervised) grounds have 850 touring pitches (12-100 m2), 100 camping pitches and 43 rental cabins. The touring pitches are mostly located in the sand (with or without a dune with beach grass) but there are also paved grassy areas. Camping like this behind a low row of dunes with a private beach at your doorstep is a luxury experience, heightened by the peace and quiet that you will find here day and night.

An active holiday

The Baltic Sea offers many water sports opportunities (snorkelling, windsurfing, kayaking, canoeing and sailing). You can rent surfboards, canoes, kayaks and sailing boats on location. Cycling in the vicinity can sometimes be difficult; ask at the reception which cycling routes are most suitable. Children will enjoy themselves immensely on Prerow with its playground, sports field and entertainment programme.

Fine food and drink

Prerow has multiple restaurants, offering you a wide selection. You can also enjoy an extensive breakfast here. There is a snack bar and a pizzeria. Take-away meals are also offered.

properties.name: Regenbogen Ferienanlage Nonnevitz
properties.description:
The large campsite Regenbogen Ferienanlage Nonnewitz is very special, as all pitches are located in a forest. The campsite is situated at the northernmost tip of Rügen island, on the Baltic Coast, and has a lovely and clean private beach. Nonnewitz is a campsite with all the comfort you will expect from a five star campsite. Large numbers of trees provide lots of shade and privacy on the pitches.

Camping pitches

The campsite is car-free; there is a large parking lot near the reception. After having registered with the friendly receptionists, you will be allocated a pitch. You will often be accompanied by the manager. There is a wide choice of pitches. Behind the entrance of the premises, closed-off with a barrier, you will find a long pathway through the forest to the actual campsite. This hardened pathway (400 m long) is suitable for driving.

Privacy

The pitches are mostly located under trees in the forest. Privacy on most pitches is adequate, certainly in low season. The sites on the far end of the grounds are obviously the quietest pitches. The ablution blocks are clearly visible and kept very clean.

Own beach

The campsite has its own beach which is easy to reach from all pitches via different beach entrances. The Baltic Sea is not deep, so the water warms up quickly in summer. On the campsite you will also find a playground, a restaurant and snack bar. There is also a medium-sized supermarket, where you will find most necessities.

properties.name: Camping Ushuaïa Villages Au Bois Joli
properties.description:
Camping Au Bois Joli is situated near the town of Andryes, in the heart of the Burgundy region. You are on a campsite with lots of trees and hedges. As a result, your camping pitch always looks different from the adjacent pitches. In 2012 the campsite owners joined the French campsite organisation Sites & Paysages.

Welcome!

The reception is housed in a wooden log cabin. You will be warmly welcomed by the enthusiastic employees. When you arrive, you will straight away notice the shop and the large supply of tourist information. Outside the reception area, your eyes are drawn to the children's playground and swimming pool. 

Terraced campsite

The campsite is laid out against a slope. Therefore, some of the pitches are located on a terrace. Other pitches are located on a slightly sloping section. Because of the design, the camping pitches vary from one hundred to two hundred square meters.

Adapted for children

Very convenient for families with young children: one of the sanitary buildings has been adapted for the youngest guests. It is complete with private toilet and wash basins where children can brush their teeth. Also handy: the restaurant has a dedicated menu for children.

Swimming with a view

The straightforward swimming pool has a separate toddler pool. The view is truly spectacular. From here you have a view of the forested part of Burgundy. Challenge each other to a game of table tennis, volleyball or soccer. In peak season a professional entertainment team organises all kinds of activities. 

Catering

The shop offers a modest assortment of groceries. Fresh bread has to be ordered the day before. You also do not have to leave the camping site for a tasty meal. The campsite restaurant has an attractive terrace.

properties.name: Camping de Lyon
properties.description:
On the outskirts of Lyon, in the village of Dardilly, you’ll find Camping de Lyon. This city campsite is an excellent base from which to visit the historic centre of Lyon. Because of its location, close to the motorway, you can also use the campsite for a stopover during a journey to the south of France, Spain or Italy.

Park-like campsite

The campsite of Camping de Lyon has a park-like appearance. You camp in green surroundings under tall trees. However, the maintenance of the greenery leaves something to be desired: the trees could use some pruning and the lawns/pitches could be mowed more often. However, you will be nicely sheltered under the trees, which not only provide shady and cool spots, but also stop most of the noise from the nearby motorway. The pitches are not particularly spacious, but an average caravan and motorhome will do just fine.

Campers stopping over and city visitors

Campers stopping over will find Camping de Lyon a great place to rest for a night on their journey to or from southern Europe. And then they could stick another day and night to their stay to visit Lyon. For a longer camping holiday of one or two weeks, the campsite is less suitable.

Spacious swimming pool

After a day of wandering around Lyon, a refreshing dip in the pool might be nice. The swimming pool at the campsite is nice and spacious, so you can swim a few lengths. Next to it a paddling pool and around the pool there is plenty of space to sunbathe.

properties.name: Homair Saint Avit Loisirs
properties.description:
Five-star campsite Saint Avit Loisirs is located in the atmospheric heart of the Dordogne, a wooded area. The luxury terraced campsite of 52 hectares has a lovely set-up and is situated on lightly rolling hills. The pitches are all in the greenery and are very spacious. And in the evening, after a lovely day in the swimming paradise, you can dine in the French restaurant.

Spacious pitches among the greenery

The nearly two hundred touring pitches look well-maintained. They are spacious (100 m2) and offer plenty or a little bit of shade. The greenery on and around the campsite is nicely maintained. The 179 rental accommodations are distributed over the entire campsite, varying from standard to very luxurious. You have the choice of lodge tents, mobile homes, bungalows and apartments.

Swimming in a paradise

The large swimming pool, in the shape of a clover leaf, is impressive. The outdoor pools measure a total of 500 m² . The indoor pool has a surface area of 140 m² . There is also a toddler pool. All pools are heated and there is a long water slide. Rightly called a swimming paradise!

All kinds of entertainment

In the high season, the campsite offers plenty of entertainment for children of all ages. Young campers can also have fun at the mini club, the playground and the sports field. For the adults, dance evenings, hikes and cycling tours are organized. A jacuzzi, multiple thermal baths and hydro-massages provide plenty of relaxation.

French cuisine

There is a well-stocked supermarket on the site. Many options for amateur chefs. The restaurant (with bar) is highly recommended. Here you can choose something the tasty from the extensive menu.

properties.name: Camping APV Au Vallon Rouge
properties.description:
Camping Le Vallon Rouge lies in an idyllic setting deep inside the forest, adjacent to the river Loup and only 9 km from the Mediterranean. The beautiful coastal resorts of Nice, Antibes, Cannes and Monaco (Côte d’Azur) are within reasonable distance. You camp here in a picturesque region where you can enjoy nature, beautiful towns and a superb coastline. The campsite is particularly suitable for families with (small) children.

Shaded pitches with grass surface

The well maintained terrain provides ample shade due to the numerous deciduous and pine trees and offers very attractive, demarcated pitches. The surface is rather hard and largely covered with grass. In addition to camping pitches, there are tents, mobile homes and bungalows for rent.

Water fun galore

Swimming enthusiasts have ample choice at Le Vallon Rouge: there is a (renovated) swimming pool and a toddler pool with compacted sunbathing lawn surrounded by loungers. The swimming pool is located in full sun. The lawn is partly in the shade. You can also swim in the river Loup. Children can play to their heart's content in shallow spots. There is a pebble beach.

Karaoke and children's club

Amenities for children include a small playground, a sports terrain, a mini golf course, bad weather provision and entertainment (dance evenings, karaoke, disco and children's club). Anglers (with licence) can cast their line in the river. For the more active guests there are rental bicycles.

Snacks and pizzas

Daily fresh bread is available on the campsite. There is also a restaurant with a limited menu, where you can get mostly snacks and pizzas. This is only open during high season (July and August) and in the evenings.

properties.name: Camping Château de Martragny
properties.description:
Camping right next to a castle: that is possible at campsite Château de Martragny. This castle campsite is located in the French department of Calvados, close to the Normandy beaches. A twenty kilometre drive takes you to the coast. The campsite itself is one big playground for children. They can run across the lawns and play everywhere. And of course, diving into the swimming pool is also a favourite activity of the younger campers. Those looking for peace and quiet will find space and freedom.

Space and freedom on your pitch

Space and freedom: the two key words of this campsite. On the one hand the camping site is filled with apple trees. On the other hand, there are large, open lawns. The spacious pitches on these lawns are not really defined. Therefore you have a free view. And you always have a view of that beautiful castle that towers above the trees. In this castle, you can have breakfast and delicious dinners. You can also choose a pitch a little further into the forest. Where it is extra quiet and shady.

One big playground, with swimming pool

For children, the campsite is one big playground. There is a playground on the site where they can climb and clamber around. But they can also let off steam on the large lawns. So don't forget the football, the boules and badminton rackets, because there is plenty of room for them.

Looking for another great spot for the whole family? Behind the castle is the swimming pool. Quiet laps are particularly attractive in the low season, when there are fewer families staying at the campsite.

properties.name: Camping de Strasbourg
properties.description:
In the east of Alsace, on the outskirts of Strasbourg, you will find Camping de Strasbourg. This well-maintained city campsite is an ideal starting point for visits to the historic heart of the campsite's namegiver. By car or public transport you will be in the city centre within half an hour.

A green part of town

The campsite is situated in a beautiful green part of the outskirts of Strasbourg. Tall trees surround the campsite; on the edge, you will soon find a shady camping pitch. In the middle part of the campsite, the trees are still young and cannot offer much shade. Still, you will be fine on this new and well-maintained terrain. The pitches, all about the same size, are neatly laid out. You can also choose one of the chalets, gypsy caravans or lodge tents.

Sunbathing and swimming

If you come back to the campsite after a day in town, you can look forward to cooling off in the swimming pool at the campsite. This new swimming pool, located on the side of the campsite, is not particularly large. Doing laps would be difficult, but an hour of relaxing after a long day is fine. At the edge of the swimming pool, on the sun deck, are sun loungers for sunbathing.

Quick bite

You can get fresh bread at the campsite, and less than a kilometre from the campsite there is a large supermarket. The campsite is perfect for a quick bite: drinks and pizzas are served in the modern restaurant and on the large covered outdoor café.

properties.name: Camping du Nord
properties.description:
This small and very reasonably-priced campsite has everything for families who like peace and quiet, simplicity and nature. The campsite is situated in the hamlet of Goebelsmühle, against the bank of the brooklet the Sûre. You are standing in a sunny location surrounded by lots of greenery.

Where is your pitch?

The campsite is located on an elongated terrain. Most of the touring pitches are located next to each other, directly alongside the brook. You are standing on grass and there are sufficient trees, if you are looking for some shade. The pitches are not demarcated. You can choose where you want to stand. There are also rental lodge tents, trekker huts and chalets on Camping du Nord.

Splash about safely

The river which runs along the campsite is safe enough for children (with swimming certificate) to play in. Approximately 16 km down the road you will find a reservoir with beach, where you can swim as well.

Eating and drinking

There is no restaurant, bar or café on the campsite, but there is a small terrace. You can easily order a meal or sandwiches for the next morning via the campsite app. There are ample restaurants in Ettelbruck and Diekirch (both at a distance of some 15 km), where you will also find a few supermarkets.

Modern sanitary facilities

The sanitary block is centrally located on the campsite and is very modern. The building is equipped with a dishwasher, floor heating, LED lighting and solar panels.

properties.name: Camping du Lac de St-Pardoux
properties.description:
Camping du Lac de St-Pardoux is located in the western part of the Limousin in France. Situated at swimming lake Lac de Saint-Pardoux, the second largest lake in the Limousin, you are surrounded by water, trees, woodlands and greenery. The family camping is located in a quiet environment with lovely French villages nearby. The nearest large town is Limoges, 30 km away.

Quiet and space

The campsite is terraced and in addition to pitches for campers, you can also rent a chalet or mobile home. These rental accommodations are separate from the tourist pitches for campers. The wooded surroundings ensure that the sites are well shaded and almost all camping pitches are spaciously laid out.

The camping has a small kiosk for groceries as well as a basic café-restaurant. The sanitary facilities, accessible to disabled persons as well, are basic, but clean and well maintained. The pearl of the campsite is the well maintained outdoor pool with adjacent sunbathing areas where you can enjoy the French sun.

Lac de Saint-Pardoux

The location on Lac de Saint-Pardoux makes the camping ideal for lovers of water sports. From morning to evening you can waterski, canoe, swim, sail, go boating or fish. The lake, naturally, also has a sandy beach with a sunbathing area and some sports fields. In high season a lifeguard/first aider is on site daily.

Cable car over the water

Near Santrop (5 km), you can gaze at the treetops from the tree climbing park or whizz over the lake at high speed in a cable car.

properties.name: Camping Aranypart
properties.description:
Just a few kilometres from the centre of Siófok – a lively resort town on Lake Balaton in Hungary – you'll find Aranypart Camping & Apartments. This large campsite is the perfect holiday destination for families with children of all ages. With a heated outdoor pool, plenty of activities, sports and play facilities, and three full-service restaurants, you will want for nothing. The campsite is located on a long grassy beach on Lake Balaton, ideal for water sports and swimming fun.

Spacious pitches, comfortable mobile homes and luxury holiday homes

Aranypart Camping & Apartments is a well-maintained campsite with lots of colourful flowering plants. Short lanes lead to the various camping pitches, which come in different sizes. There are also fields specifically for tent campers. No matter where you pitch your tent or caravan, you’re never more than a hundred metres from the lake. Prefer your own kitchen and bathroom? Opt for a comfortable mobile home or a luxury holiday home.

Beach parties and fine dining in one of the restaurants

In summer, the campsite offers a varied programme of activities for campers of all ages. Children can enjoy fun craft sessions, games, or treasure hunts. The entertainment team also organises sporty activities and competitions, such as challenging obstacle courses and relay races.

Also popular are the beach parties regularly held in the evenings, featuring music, singing, dancing and a cheerful atmosphere. For a tasty meal, there’s no need to leave the campsite. Sample traditional Hungarian dishes at The First Kitchen restaurant, enjoy a Mediterranean meal at the Egyálom Corner on the beach terrace, or tuck into a buffet at Golden Lake Buffet restaurant.

properties.name: Camping Huttopia Divonne-les-Bains
properties.description:
In the department of Ain of the Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes region, near the Swiss border, the Huttopia Divonne-les-Bains campsite offers everything for a family holiday in the heart of nature. There is a large swimming pool, a restaurant, a tennis court and Lac de Divonne four kilometres away.

Sleeping in the forest

What do you prefer? A pitch without electricity in the middle of unspoilt nature or a comfortable pitch with all modern conveniences. Shrubs and trees delimitate most of the pitches. If you want to stay in luxury accommodation, you can rent a gypsy caravan, a lodge tent or a wooden chalet.

The smell of bread in the morning

In the morning you can wake up on the pleasant outdoor café with a nice breakfast. The baker from the village delivers fresh rolls to order. You can also go to the campsite shop for some basic groceries and local products. In high season you can order something from the snack list in the restaurant.

Large swimming pool

The heart of the campsite is near the heated swimming pool. Parasols and sunbeds are available in the sunbathing area. Next to the swimming pool, tennis enthusiasts can play tennis on the professional court. Want to swim somewhere else? Lake Divonne and Lake Geneva are also lovely places for a cooling dip.

Tree climbing or going to a show?

Family campsite Huttopia Divonne-les-Bains has everything to entertain young campers. There is a well-stocked games room and a ping-pong table, as well as entertainment at the children's club. Children can also go tree climbing, take a scooter ride, go horseback riding and attend a performance or concert.

properties.name: Camping Park Beaufort
properties.description:
This campsite is located in Beaufort, on a hill at the edge of the forest. Beaufort is located in the Luxembourg region of Müllerthal, known for its beautiful ruins of a medieval castle. One of the draw cards of the camping is the spacious swimming pool. A nice thing is that you can also stay at Camping Plage Beaufort in winter. Then you should surely visit the nearby ice rink. There are restaurants and shops in Beaufort.

Forest and grass

When you explore the property further, you'll first come to a zone with the permanent pitches. Then you'll come to a forested area, with open stretches of grassland for the touring pitches. You'll then leave the paved road to get to the tourist area. Before you is a well maintained area with separate rows, but without demarcation between the pitches. You'll find a tennis court on the property and several play areas for the children.

Sleeping in a teepee village

The teepee village with rental accommodation consists of four small teepees (two to five persons) and a larger teepee (four to eight persons). There is a spot to make a campfire and a real totem pole. There are also trekker huts and mobile homes for rent. 

Swimming and ice carting 

You have to leave the campsite to reach the entrance to the swimming pool. There you'll find a festive water world: multiple pools, a long, winding slide, water cannons, a water stream, bubble zone and a separate wading pool. Around it is a sunbathing lawn with sunny and shady spots. The ice rink is open in winter, and you can ice cart there, too. Fun for all ages!

properties.name: Camping Paradis La Grand' Métairie
properties.description:
This amiable, very child-friendly campsite with plenty of greenery and a rural, slightly casual appearance, is located close to the centre of the village of Saint-Hilaire-la-Forêt. The campsite has a gorgeous and extensive swimming pool which guests of all ages are guaranteed to enjoy. Cool off in the different pools, swish down the chutes or enjoy the play equipment. In high season there is a bus service from the campsite to the beach of Les Sables-d’Olonne.

Rural campsite

The reception, constructed of wood, enhances the rural character of the campsite, almost like a farm. With a campsite name like this (‘métairie’ = smallholding) this comes as no surprise. There is also a lovely petting zoo which gives the campsite its rural character.

Camping amidst green

Camping La Grand’ Métairie is situated on a beautifully finished and well maintained terrain with room for 42 touring pitches. You are camping here close to the village, but due to the abundance of greenery from the trees, plants and hedges it feels like you are staying in the countryside. The pitches are level, measure between 80 to 100 m2 and are separated from each other by hedges and shrubs. Most pitches are sufficiently spacious for a car and caravan or a motorhome.

They also offer ample shade

In addition, there are some 125 rental accommodation units (caravans, mobile homes and furnished tents) on a separate site.

Ride on the tractor

Near the petting zoo is a vegetable garden at children's height with nameplates of the different vegetables. The kids club organises regular gardening workshops. Each evening children can join a 'children's parade' in the cart behind the old tractor of owner Denis. What fun!

properties.name: Camping L'Hirondelle
properties.description:
Camping L'Hirondelle is a charming family campsite in Drôme Provençale. The area around the campsite is remarkable, surrounded by fields of lavender, wooded areas, mountains and rivers. This elongated campsite is on a small river with a view of the Vercors, a mountain plateau at an altitude of 2,341 m above sea level. The campsite is easily accessed via the Crest/Gap route and is close to the charming village of Die (11 km). Upon arriving at the camping site, you are welcomed in a chalet that makes you feel right at home – something you feel throughout the campsite.

Camping in the forest

The pitches of Camping L'Hirondelle are spread throughout a large forest. Most of the pitches are spacious and offer a lovely view of the fields and mountains at the edge of the woods. For those who prefer a darker, shaded pitch, there are lots of pitches deep in the forest. If you don't have your own camping equipment, that is not a problem: there are also lodge tents and mobile homes available, including models suitable for six to eight people, ideal for families.

Hours of fun

The excellent amenities at the campsite offer something for everyone. The swimming pool, at the front of the campsite, has a slide and a view of the mountains. For children, there is a water park with small water cascades and fountains. There are also three bouncy castles to provide hours of fun for the little ones.

Not in the mood to cook? The restaurant at the campsite has an extensive menu with delicious dishes.

properties.name: Regenbogen Ferienanlage Boltenhagen
properties.description:
Regenbogen Holiday Resort Boltenhagen is a large campsite on the edge of the historic resort of Boltenhagen. You'll camp here just five hundred metres from the Baltic Sea. There is a lovely forest between the campsite and the beach.

Well maintained grounds

The property is well-arranged and looks neat. The pitches are located in rows along paved paths and vary in size. Here and there there are deciduous trees providing some shade. The tourist pitches are located among the numerous seasonal pitches. The tents are on a separate field. Campers can be parked outside of the campsite. Want to rent something? Book a mobile home or a bungalow.

On foot to the beach

The sandy beach is about 500 metres away. You can walk there through the forest or via the promenade. In the sea you can snorkel and 1.5 kilometres away there is a diving school.

Kid's club, wellness room and excursions

For kids there is a spacious playground a multi-sports field and recreation (Kid's Club and other activities). There is also a tennis court and a mini golf course. Want to relax? Go to the wellness room. There is a sauna, steam room, jacuzzi and a beauty centre.

Great walking and cycling possibilities in the area. If you didn't bring your bike, hire one on the campsite. Rather go out with a group? The campsite offers guided walks and excursion programmes.

Extensive menu

Taking things easy today? Plenty of choice! You can enjoy delicious dishes from the extensive menu in the campsite restaurant. Get a quick bite at the snack bar. The camping shop has an extensive choice of groceries.

properties.name: EuroParcs Kaatsheuvel
properties.description:
EuroParcs Kaatsheuvel is just under three kilometres from the entrance of Efteling theme park, just outside Kaatsheuvel. This holiday park is ideal for people who want to enjoy the exceptional, magical and spectacular attractions at Efteling for several days. Furthermore, this bungalow park is on the outskirts of the Loonse and Drunense Duinen National Park, one of the most beautiful nature reserves in the Netherlands. From the resort, you can take lovely walks and cycle rides through this national park.

Hire lovely accommodation

You can choose from a wide range of accommodation at this holiday park. At EuroParcs Kaatsheuvel. you can book a stay in a luxury holiday home, a modern mobile home, a cosy tiny house and in cottages that are decorated in a cheerful, colourful style specially for children. Furthermore, this park has lovely glamping tents for hire.

Old-fashioned water fun in the indoor and outdoor swimming pool

Park guests can relax and unwind in a playfully landscaped indoor swimming pool during their stay. In this indoor leisure pool, you can swim laps or whizz down a water slide, have fun in the lazy river and splash about in the paddling pool. Good to know: the indoor swimming pool is being renovated. It will re-open in August 2025. Fortunately, EuroParcs Kaatsheuvel also has another swimming pool: a heated indoor swimming pool.

Culinary enjoyment in Het Wapen van Kaatsheuvel

If you like to go out to eat during your holiday but don't want to walk or drive far, you are in the right place here. Het Wapen van Kaatsheuvel is at this resort. This eatery has a Grand café and a steakhouse.

properties.name: Camping Huttopia Lac de Serre-Ponçon
properties.description:
The campsite Lac de Serre-Ponçon is located in St-Vincent-les-Forts (Alpes-de-Haute-Provence), a village on the Lac de Serre-Ponçon. This is the largest reservoir in Europe. So fun in the water is guaranteed. Various sports facilities, a restaurant, a shop and well-tended sanitation facilities are just some of the facilities that will make your stay comfortable and pleasant.

Camping with a view

On the campsite you will find nearly 200 campsites. You are on a large, extensive campsite open from the middle of May through the middle of September. The most beautiful pitches have a view of the lake. Don't have your own camping equipment? There are lodge tents, bungalows and mobile homes available.

Entertainment and amenities

You can enjoy many sporting activities on the campsite. Play a round of jeu de boules or volleyball, discover the playground and participate in the activities provided by the entertainment team (great for kids of all ages). In the high season, there is a music evening once a week. So, hit that dance floor!

If you're a bit peckish, visit the restaurant (with terrace). Here you can dine with a view of the lake. There is also a pizzeria. The offering in the camping shop is limited, but there is a larger supermarket (Proxi) about 20 minutes away by car, where you'll find what you need.

Endless water fun

Next to the campsite there is Parc Aquasplash, great for children and adults. In the water there are all types of colourful play equipment. Slide, jump and plunge; a day of fun in the water is guaranteed here. You can also swim and surf, naturally. There is no sandy beach, but a section with pebbles and a concrete slab. On the camping property itself there is a swimming pool filled with salt water.

properties.name: Camping De Bergougne
properties.description:
In the north of the department Lot-et-Garonne - bordering on the Dordogne - is the friendly family campsite Camping De Bergougne. It is situated almost exactly between the rivers Dordogne (30 km north) and Lot (30 km south). In this hilly landscape you will find many forests, nature, bastides (fortified towns) and nice cities. The campsite's swimming pool is beautiful. After swimming a few lengths, you can sunbathe on the surrounding lawns.

Lots of space

It's not only the surroundings that are characterised by space, the pitches are also very spacious. The exact size varies, but there are pitches with as much as 200 square metres. In addition, your pitch offers a lot of privacy as it is surrounded by green vegetation. The entire campsite - laid out in terraces - is well maintained and even for campers without their own tent, campervan or caravan, there is plenty of choice. Comfortable mobile homes, chalets and special Coco-tents are available for rent.

Local delicacies

At the heart of the Bergougne campsite are the campsite restaurant and the swimming pool. The restaurant has a varied menu, including tasty local dishes. On the terrace you have a view of the swimming pool, the playing field behind it and the rolling hills.

Next to the swimming pool is a snack bar, where you can go during the day for a snack or a refreshing drink. In high season, the terrace is also the scene of entertaining theme evenings full of games, dance and music. During the day, young and old can enjoy themselves around the playing field, where you will find games, climbing equipment and a petanque court.

properties.name: Camping de la Serre
properties.description:
Camping de la Serre is located in the southern French department of Ariège, at the foot of the Pyrenees. This small-scale family campsite pays a lot of attention to sustainability and has spacious pitches with lots of privacy. During your holiday you can stay active on the sports field, the children can play on the playground with lots of wooden play equipment. And of course, after a day in the Mediterranean sun, you can cool off in the swimming pool. Or you can enjoy a drink, a good book or a puzzle on a lounger with parasol.

Space and privacy

Camping de la Serre is spacious and almost completely immersed in nature. The pitches are situated on different terraces. Due to the separation of trees, hedges and winding roads, you have a lot of privacy on your pitch. The pitches are well maintained and are (mostly partly) in the shade. Besides the touring pitches there is the possibility to rent a chalet or lodge tent - with its own terrace. The sanitary facilities have been renewed in 2019 and have a family room and separate baby sanitary.

Market with local delicacies

Sustainability comes first at Camping de la Serre, so most of the products in the small campsite shop are made locally. In order to give the international guests at the campsite a chance to discover all these delicacies, a market with local products is organised every Thursday. This includes a large barbecue to get a direct taste of what you have bought. You can also get your fresh sandwiches from the campsite. For more shopping you can go to the surrounding villages like Laroque-d'Olmes (5 km).

properties.name: Broager Strand Camping
properties.description:
On the southernmost tip of Denmark, on the eastern coast of Southern Jutland, lies the small-scale and charming campsite Broager. You will camp in a very peaceful area in the middle of the natural landscape. Broager is a campsite for adults or families with children who are looking for peace and quiet and enjoy an active lifestyle.

Well-cared-for

As soon as you arrive, you will notice the care and attention that has been devoted to the campsite. The campsite has a welcoming atmosphere, which fits in well with the simplicity and tranquillity of the area. There are no roads nearby, so you will have peace here day and night.

Your pitch

Everything on the grounds is well-maintained and in good condition. You will find fine grass pitches, with wide, gravelled paths in between. There are few trees on the campsite grounds. The terrain is, therefore, quite open. The newly planted trees do not yet offer much shade and coolness. Further back on the camping grounds, there is a thicket which provides some shelter. The terrain is slightly more hilly here. You can also rent a hiker's cabin at this campsite.

For active campers and people looking for peace and quiet

You will not find a swimming pool or an entertainment programme here, but the natural surroundings more than make up for this. There are plenty of hiking and cycling opportunities in this attractive region. If you're looking for water sports, you only have to cross a dead-end street. Go wild in and on the water: swimming, snorkelling, windsurfing, kayaking or canoeing. At the tranquil water's edge, you will find a sand and a pebble beach. There is a grassy playing/sunbathing field, a few picnic tables, and a small playground.

properties.name: Bearsted Camping and Motor Home Club Site
Campingplatz am Leppinsee
properties.description:
Camping am Leppinsee is located between pine trees in the vast Mecklenburg Lake District. From this campsite you have a wonderful view of the Leppinsee. Water sports enthusiasts will be in their element here. And not only on this lake. The campsite is close to the Müritz National Park, which has 130 lakes. It is also a true paradise for hikers and cyclists.

Spacious pitches with beautiful view

At the campsite the manager will greet you in English or German. On her campsite, which is full of nature, you will find spacious pitches between the pine trees. Take a deep breath and enjoy the freshness of this pine forest. The most beautiful pitches have a view of the vast recreational lake Leppinsee. In the high season many families come here with a tent or caravan, while in the early and late season it is mainly people over 50 who enjoy a camping holiday.

Good basic facilities

The campsite offers good basic facilities, such as heated sanitary blocks and Wi-Fi. In addition, the modern sanitary building is equipped with a launderette and cooking facilities. Bread for breakfast is ordered, so don't forget to let them know how many rolls you want. Other shopping can be done in the small town of Mirow, a 15-minute drive from the campsite. Here you will also find some restaurants and shops.

Walking, cycling and sports

Tip: take a cycling tour through the local national park. Walkers will also find what they are looking for. A well-signposted walking network lies at your feet. Children can play on the playground, at the table tennis table or on the beach next to the lake. There is also a beach volleyball court.

properties.name: Skagen Sydstrand  Camping-Bunken
properties.description:
Skagen Sydstrand Camping-Bunken is situated in a beautiful spot, nestled between woods, dunes and a vast sandy beach near Ålbæk (North Jutland). It is an ideal base for lovely walks and bike rides through the surrounding countryside, as well as for a relaxing day at the beach. This campsite is also a popular stopover for campers travelling to and from Sweden and Norway. Major port towns such as Hirtshals (35 km) and Frederikshavn (27 km) are within easy reach.

Wooded site with large touring pitches

This well-maintained campsite in the far north of Denmark caters primarily to holidaymakers. In total, there are around seven hundred spacious pitches. Yet you don’t get the feeling that you’re on a massive campsite. Thanks to the tall hedges, the spacious layout and the wooded setting, this is a lovely destination to unwind. Accommodation units are also available: there are luxury glamping suites available for rent for two people.

Plenty of entertainment at the campsite and beyond

The campsite has several open access points to the adjacent sandy beach. On summer days, take a refreshing dip, or enjoy paddling in the sea, which remains shallow for a long way out. The Baltic Sea can sometimes feel perfectly warm even early in the summer. Back at the campsite, children can enjoy themselves in the playgrounds, in the bouncy castles, on the football pitch and on the mini-golf course. In between, grab a tasty ice cream from the ice cream parlour or sit down for a cosy meal in the campsite restaurant. Prefer to prepare your own meals? Opposite the reception, there is a large supermarket with a wide range of groceries.

properties.name: Camping Huttopia Vallouise
properties.description:
On Huttopia Vallouise campsite, located in the Écrins National Park in the Hautes-Alpes, you camp with a view of the Alps. The campsite is located on the outskirts of the village of Vallouise, between the high peaks; an ideal place for active campers and adventurers. Of course they can go mountain hiking here, but there are many more outdoor activities possible. On the strongly flowing mountain rivers Le Gyr and L'Onde you can kayak very well. There is also a paragliding landing site near the campsite, which is great for campers who like to explore the heights.

Camping between the mountains

The campsite has an open character: on a vast lawn, situated between the trees and the high mountains, there is room for about a hundred pitches. On the edge of the trees are chalets and lodge tents, on pitches with lots of privacy. These are beautifully integrated into the landscape. From every spot you have a beautiful view of the surrounding Alps.

Swimming in the sun

After a tiring mountain hike you might be ready for a dip in the pool. It is located behind the wooden reception building, in a sunny spot. The round swimming pool is not very spacious, but you can relax and cool down.

Excellent facilities

There are not many facilities on the campsite, but you will find everything you need. And the facilities that are available all look great. You can order a drink, a sandwich or a pizza at the bar o the gypsy caravan. The sanitary facilities on the campsite are modern and tidy.

properties.name: Camping du Moulin Brûlé
properties.description:
Looking for a quiet, small-scale campsite in the French countryside? Then Camping du Moulin Brûle is the place for you! Located on the edge of a nature reserve, about fifty kilometres from the beautiful city of Lyon, this is the perfect place to relax and unwind. In the summer you can enjoy water recreation in the swimming pool and the catering facilities are open. Fun activities are also organised during the summer months.

Ultimate peace and tranquillity

Due to the mountainous environment, there is no telephone coverage here. It is therefore an ideal place for those seeking maximum peace and tranquillity. Please note: the campsite prohibits entry between 12:00pm and 2:00pm. So if you arrive around that time, it's best to do a little shopping first.

Small-scale camping

This small campsite in the Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes has about twenty touring pitches and ten accommodation units. The camping pitches are small in size. In terms of accommodation, you can choose from chalets and mobile homes. It should come as no surprise that nature lovers flock to this campsite!

Summer fun in the pool

The campsite has a heated swimming pool with waterslide, which is open in July and August. There is also a paddling pool for the little ones. At Camping du Moulin Brûlé you can play table tennis and pétanque. A bouncy castle is also set up regularly. The catering facilities only open during the summer holidays, in July and August.

Feast in the 'bouchons lyonnais'

The campsite is located close to Lyon (50 km). Ideal for taking a day trip to this historic city. If you do, be sure to visit one of the 'bouchons lyonnais'. These are cosy restaurants typical of the city of Lyon.

properties.name: Camping Le Colombier
properties.description:
The park-like campsite Le Colombier (Rhône-Alps region) is located next to a municipal recreation park with a swimming pond. Here you are in a region that is attractive to holidaymakers who love the mountainous nature and the sights. A reliable small family campsite where you come for relaxation as well as for practising (mountain) sports.

Are you looking for a bit of shade?

The spacious camping pitches are simple, but nicely laid out. They are usually on grassland and are demarcated for privacy with green hedges or bushes. The campsite has pitches in the shade, but also sunnier pitches. It is possible to hire a mobile home or a lodge tent. There are also paved sites for campers. 

Lovely swimming pond

Le Colombier does not have a swimming pool, but there is a small yet lovely swimming pond just near the entrance. This pond with a sandy beach and sunbathing lawn is also very suitable for small children. An attractive spot, as the local residents also come here regularly. 

Fun away from the pool

The little campers will thoroughly enjoy themselves with the lovely play equipment on the campsite. The property is surrounded by the municipal sports park. Here you will find a soccer field, mini golf course and running track. It is all very green.

Pizza van in the car park

You can get fresh bread every morning on the Le Colombier campsite. There is also a snack bar where you can get snacks and drinks. At set times in high season there is a van with fresh pizzas in the parking area in front of the campsite. There is a supermarket three minutes' drive from the campsite. Walking or cycling to the supermarket is also an option.

properties.name: DCU-Camping Rønne Strand - Galløkken
properties.description:
Galløkken Strand Camping is located on the Danish island of Bornholm, just a hundred metres from the beach. You can choose your own spot on the wooded campsite, which is spacious. Galløkken Strand Camping is a quiet three-star campsite with simple facilities. The nearby harbour town of Rønne can be reached on foot.

Natural campsite

Galløkken Strand Camping has 125 touring pitches and five fixed annual pitches. The campsite is situated in the forest, but not densely wooded. As a result, there are many sunny spots. Would you like to camp, but don't want to bring your own tent or caravan? Then you can go to one of the 35 rental accommodations. There are wooden cabins and bungalows on the edge of the site. There are also caravans and bungalow tents for rent.

Skelters and trampolines

Galløkken Strand Camping is a cosy family campsite, where children quickly make friends. Especially for small children there is a lot to do. There is a playground with playground equipment, trampolines and a bouncy castle. Moreover, there are all kinds of go-karts to ride around with. In high season there is a barbecue evening with live music every week. There is no entertainment programme, but in July there is a nice clown coming to the campsite.

Fresh bread

At the reception there is a small camping shop where you can get fresh bread and some groceries. Luckily you can also go to Rønne for your groceries. Galløkken Strand Camping is not only close to the sea, but also very close to this nice harbour town. Rønne is also known for its many restaurants.

properties.name: Regenbogen Ferienanlage Born
properties.description:
Camping Regenbogen, located in the German peninsula of Zingst, is the perfect place for peace-seekers, water sports (and kitesurfing) enthusiasts and bird watchers. You stay in the middle of the The National Park of Vorpommersche Boddenlandschaft (one of the two largest nature parks in Germany) and on the banks of the Saaler Bodden inland lake.

In a deciduous forest

The simple grounds are located in a deciduous forest and are kept as naturally as possible. It's like taking a step back in time, a time when camping still meant freedom, peace and space. You can choose a spot in the sun, a spot that's partially shaded by deciduous trees or a spot that's almost entirely surrounded by greenery. There are bungalows for rent.

(Kite)surfing school

The Saaler Bodden lake is right at your feet. You can also swim in the Baltic Sea, on the other western side of the island. There is a (kite)surfing and canoeing school that also gives lessons. They also have equipment and gear for rent. There is a playground for children. In addition, there is an entertainment programme in the high season. Adjoining the grounds there is a climbing course and two kilometres away, you'll find a riding stable.

Snack bar

There is a campsite shop with a limited assortment and daily fresh bread. There is also a snack bar. In the neighbouring village of Born, 3.5 kilometres away, you'll find several restaurants and a supermarket.

An active area

The island is perfect for water sports, hiking and cycling tours. Born am Darβ is famous for being the kitesurfing place par excellence. You can take hikes in the Osterwald and the Daβerwald forests. Cyclists will be in cycling heaven on the Europa cycle path that runs along the campsite.

properties.name: Stonehaven Queen Elizabeth Park Caravan Club Site
Milestone Caravan Park
properties.description:
Would you like to camp at a neat and highly rated campsite in the East Midlands region of England? Then you're in the right place. Milestone Caravan Park is a 5-star campsite with spacious caravan and motorhome sites. You will camp here by a lake close to the A1 motorway. Fishing enthusiasts are in for a treat as the lake is full of fish. So don't forget to bring your fishing rod. The village of Cromwell is within walking distance and you can go to Newark-on-Trent (12 km) for groceries.

Warm welcome

On arrival at the campsite, you immediately notice the beautifully landscaped and open grounds. Reception is in the low, grey building. You know immediately that you are in England, because opposite reception there is a typical red, British telephone booth. At the reception, you receive a friendly welcome from the manager couple. Not only will you receive a warm welcome, your four-legged friend is also more than welcome at this holiday park.

Spacious motorhome and caravan pitches

The name of the campsite says it all, this holiday park is specially equipped for caravan and motorhome owners. As the campsite is open all year round, there are pitches with different types of surface to choose from. Hard surface with gravel for all-weather conditions and grass pitches where you can camp in better weather. All pitches are very spacious and are enclosed by low hedges. There are some trees in some areas, but generally the vegetation near the pitches is low.

properties.name: Camping La Gartempe
properties.description:
Do you like to holiday in quiet surroundings, far away from big cities, motorways and mass tourism? Then you’ll enjoy Camping La Gartempe, centrally located in the sparsely populated Haute Vienne department. This campsite is located on the outskirts of the friendly village of Châteauponsac and is surrounded by a varied landscape of large fields and vast forests. The campsite’s facilities include a heated outdoor swimming pool, a snack bar and various sports and games facilities.

What does this campsite look like?

At La Gartempe, you camp on a neatly landscaped site with slight differences in height. There are a variety of well-tended cherry trees, walnut trees and apple trees, so there’s plenty of shade. The pitches are also separated by neat hedges. Want more luxury and your own toilet and washing facilities? Then opt for a modern mobile home, chalet or cottage. Pets are allowed on the camping pitches and in the accommodation.

Plenty of sport, games and fun

This is a small but friendly campsite, where there’s plenty to do, especially in the summer holidays. For example, take a dip in the heated outdoor pool; like the adjacent paddling pool, it’s surprisingly large for a campsite of this size. Also have a game of table tennis, basketball, boules or mini golf. When the weather's not good, head to the recreation room where a pool table, mini library, table football, TV corner and several board games will keep you entertained. At Snack de la Gartempe, the campsite’s snack bar, you can order tasty snacks, meat dishes, and salads.

properties.name: Flower Camping La Rochelambert
properties.description:
Flower Camping La Rochelambert is located in the mountainous countryside just above the old town of Le Puy-en-Velay in the Haute-Loire department. The hospitable owners at this campsite provide a quiet, friendly atmosphere. You can camp on well-kept terraces, on spacious touring pitches or in sheltered spots along the river La Borne. There are many ways to unwind at this child-friendly campsite. For example, a visit to the sauna or a dip in the outdoor pool.

Terraced campsite in the countryside

Long avenues lead to the very well-kept terraces, where you’ll find flat touring pitches between trees and shrubs. Each pitch is different: at the top spacious and delimitated, or on the lower part under tall trees on the banks of the river. Common denominator: it is quiet everywhere. You can also stay in one of the hiker's huts or lodge tents.

Child friendly: swimming pool and climbing cage

The campsite is also very suitable for children. Probably they can frequently be found in the heated swimming pool, not far from the reception. This outdoor swimming pool with paddling pool is situated in a sunny spot overlooking the dense woods. A playground on one of the higher terraces is especially fun for small climbers.The 'squirrel's nest', a climbing cage for real climbers, is also popular.

Lovely evening at the pavement café

The restaurant has a nice pavement café, where you can sit in the sun. Michel lights up the barbecue or delicious dishes, made entirely of local produce, are served. In the summer months you can also enjoy a live performance every week.

properties.name: Sandkaas Familiecamping
properties.description:
In the north of the beautiful Danish island of Bornholm is Sandkaas Family Camping. You will find this atmospheric terraced campsite just a short walk (5 min) from Sandkaas beach. From the site, you have a fantastic view of the Baltic Sea. Thanks to its relaxed atmosphere and proximity to nature and culture, this is the ideal place for a friendly camping holiday.

Wake up with waves in the background

At Sandkaas Family Camping, you wake up to the sound of the waves and the smell of pine trees. The breakfast buffet (June to mid-August) provides a delicious start to the day. Crawl out of your tent, caravan or wooden hut and visit the large terrace of the "gule Poppelhus". This will give provide an excellent foundation for an active day in the Bornholm surroundings. The campsite owner will be happy to tell you what you can do there.

Bouncy castles and family bathrooms

The campsite has a child-friendly swimming pool with sliding roof. The pool is open from 1 June to 31 August and can accommodate the whole family. You will also find playgrounds, bouncy castles, a café, a big kitchen and spacious family bathrooms at this campsite. Use of the toilets and showers is free, except for the family bathrooms.

Swim on solar energy

The owner not only wants to look after his guests, but the environment is also high priority for him. Sandkaas therefore had solar panels installed, powering almost 40 percent of the campsite. The beautiful pool is additionally heated by solar collectors. So you can dive into the warm water with peace of mind. In summer, the sea is great for swimming.

properties.name: Hasle Camping & Hytteby
properties.description:
Hasle Camping & Hytteby lies in a charming fishing village called Hasle, in the west of the Danish island Bornholm in the Baltic Sea. The campsite is only two hundred metres from a beautiful sandy beach and in the neighbourhood of traditional fish smokehouses. One of those smokehouses is located next to the campsite, along with a restaurant the name of which is well known on Bornholm. The campsite itself also has a good restaurant. There is an outdoor swimming pool and a fun mini golf course as well.

Attractive campsite with various accommodation options

The reception of this attractive campsite is situated in an authentic timbered house. Behind it lies a camping site that has been landscaped whimsically. Some touring pitches are demarcated with green hedges and there are also open fields for more campsite visitors. The accommodations are grouped along the southern edge of the grounds. You can choose from a modern chalet or a friendly camping pod.

Great outdoor swimming pool with water playground

An activity ticket can be purchased at Hasle Camping & Hytteby at a good price. This ticket allow you to use the campsite facilities, such as the mini golf course and the swimming pool. This swimming pool is very popular among the children, especially the water playground with its many fountains. After a fun day at or around the campsite, order a delicious cafe dish or a tasty pizza from the campsite restaurant.

Explore the island of Bornholm

The beach of Hasle is a short walk from the campsite. Towards the south this sandy beach changes into a rocky coastline where many birds can be spotted. If you follow the coastline to the north, you will run into Hasle and its little harbour.

properties.name: Camping du Lac Onlycamp
properties.description:
In the still unspoiled and rustic French region of the Corrèze, you'll find Camping du Lac in beautiful location in a forest and next to a large lake, Lac de la Valette. Numerous water sports are possible on this lake, from water skiing and surfing to (catamaran) sailing and canoeing. The location is ideal for water sports lovers and families.

View

You have a view of the water and the beach from the campground. There is plenty of shade, but not a great deal of privacy on the lovely laid out campsites. Want to hire something? You can choose from chalets and caravans.

Water sports

The lake is naturally the big attraction of this campground. Right next to the campground there is a public beach with some sand, some grass. For kids there is a swimming platform with a slide. There are also sports fields, a playground, kiosk, bar and restaurant. In the high season there is supervision, so your children can play safely. There is a new little pool 1 metre deep on the campground.

Tennis and activities

In addition to the sports fields and playground at the beach, there is also a playground on the campground. There is a tennis court at the entrance to the campground. In the summer months, the kids can have fun in the Kids Club.

Extensive menu

The campground restaurant at the beach offers an extensive menu and take aways. There is no shop on the campground, but there is a bread roll service. 2 km away is the centre of the village of Marcillac-la-Criosille, where you can do all of your shopping.

Sanitary facilities

The toilet facilities have been renovated and are kept very clean. There are also facilities for babies. The two toilet blocks are not very centrally located, however.

properties.name: Camping Huttopia Lac de Sillé
properties.description:
Huttopia Lac de Sillé is a campsite in a wonderful location, in the middle of a large forest and on the banks of a recreational lake. About three kilometres from the charming village of Sillé-le-Guillaume, this campsite is an ideal place to unwind. The campsite has a small swimming pool and beautiful pitches in the forest. In high season, especially families with (young) children will have a great time here, because there is entertainment for everyone: archery, pony riding, circus, live music, open air cinema.

Large shady pitches

Most of the pitches on this wooded campsite have a lot of shade. The pitches are divided into three different comfort levels. Whatever type of pitch you choose, pleasant camping is a guarantee here. The 'normal' pitches are also large and well maintained. There are lodge tents in various sizes and mobile homes for rent.

Recreational lake and swimming pool

The recreational lake Le Grand Étang is a favourite spot for both residents of this region and tourists. Certainly on and around the beach Sillé Plage is the place to be. In and on the lake you can go pedal boating, sailing, canoeing, fishing and of course swimming. However, for a quick dip, you don't have to leave the campsite. There is a small but comfortable (and heated) swimming pool.

Complete breakfast packages

In high season there is a snack truck available. The Huttopia Lac de Sillé campsite also offers an excellent breakfast service. You can order complete breakfast packages including tea, coffee, orange juice, toast and pastries. There is also a small shop where you can buy camping gear.

properties.name: Camping Homair Parc de la Fecht
Holstebro Søpark
properties.description:
In a lovely quiet location, two kilometres from the beautiful town centre of Holstebro (Central Jutland), is Holstebro Søpark. You camp here in an extensive residential area and on the recreational lake Vandkraftsøen, which is great for canoeing. This is otherwise a neat, small campsite with a compact layout. That means you are always near all the facilities, which are clustered around the reception. Among those facilities are a heated outdoor swimming pool, a playground and a shop.

Well-maintained grassy pitches and cosy reception

The cosy reception area has a coffee bar. Be sure to come here for a coffee or ice cream, or wander through the shop selling local produce. On the campsite itself, you will find spacious pitches on neatly maintained grassy fields with hedges. From some of the pitches, you have a lovely view over the lake. At Holstebro Søpark, hiker's huts for two to six people are also available for rent.

Swimming and canoeing

There is a lovely swimming pool at the front of the campsite. You can have even more water fun in Vandkraftsøen. From the campsite, you walk straight to the shores of this lake, where you can also swim. Good to know: this lake was artificially created in the 1940s with the construction of a dam a bit further on. Below the water's surface is the original, winding course of the Storå river. That creates different water depths and currents. So an ideal place for an exciting canoe or kayak trip!

properties.name: Capfun Camping La Grande Cosse
properties.description:
'We offer you the family holiday you always dreamed of as a kid.' That is the mission of the Capfun camping chain. This mission is clearly evident at Capfun's La Grande Cosse Campsite in the southern French department of Aude. There is plenty to do for the whole family. Go whooshing down the slides in the water park, challenge your friends on the obstacle course, enjoy a performance at the evening show, or just do it all. And a major plus: the beach is within walking distance of the campsite.

Camping holiday in France

Capfun's La Grande Cosse Campsite primarily offers luxury mobile homes for guests to rent. But there are also a number of touring pitches for campers who prefer to holiday using their own camping equipment. Are you bringing your pet along on holiday? They are also welcome at the campsite for an additional surcharge. First- and second-category dogs such as pit bulls and mastiffs are not allowed.

Water fun in the water park

The campsite has not one, but four different swimming pools. There is a special paddling pool for small children. And there are three somewhat deeper pools. What makes the water park really unique are the three water slides that you can whiz down. The Crazy Cone slide offers an especially fun adventure for older children. Do you prefer to swim in the sea? That is also an option! The Grande Cosse beach is about 500 metres from the campsite. You walk to the sandy beach on the Mediterranean Sea via a path through the nature reserve.

properties.name: Camping Le Kergariou
properties.description:
Flower Camping Le Kergariou is a typical Breton campsite situated between vast fields just outside Clohars-Carnoët. You'll camp here on a spacious and green campsite one and a half kilometres from the rocky coast. On this small-scale campsite the whole family can enjoy a quiet camping holiday by the sea.

Spaciousness and tranquillity

Because of the spaciousness, large pitches and greenery, the campsite breathes tranquillity. On one side of the campsite there are pitches delimited by high, green hedges, while the other side has a more open character. Here you look out over the fields. In addition to the sixty touring pitches, the campsite has another thirty or so mobile homes of various types.

Covered and heated swimming pool

You can already see the swimming pool when you enter the campsite. The glass dome rises above the fence at the barrier. Your children will probably spend a lot of time here. Because of the glass dome with sliding doors it is a great place to swim in all weathers; the pool is wonderfully heated. For the little ones there is a small paddling pool.

Pleasant animation programme

Small-scale entertainment suits a friendly campsite like Le Kergariou. In the high season, a few mornings a week, games are organised for the younger campers. The rest of the time they can let off steam in the swimming pool or the playroom. There is fun for the whole family during the games, sports competitions and themed meals. These take place a few times a week (in summer).

properties.name: Camping Midden Drenthe
properties.description:
Camping Midden Drenthe is a quiet campsite in the countryside near the village of Zwiggelte. Surrounded by the natural beauty of Drenthe, this is an ideal campsite for those seeking rest, cyclists and walkers. Here you will find beautifully laid out camping fields with spacious and well-maintained touring pitches. Young children can enjoy themselves in the animal pasture and on the playing field.

Attractively decorated camping fields

This campsite consists of several attractively furnished and well-maintained camping fields. You can choose between a basic pitch and a comfort pitch. Please indicate whether you would like a shady or sunny pitch. The campsite offers both options. Furthermore, there are two hiker's huts and a fully equipped mobile home for rent. The cabins are ideal for cycling and hiking campers.

Entertainment on and around the campsite

Entertainment at the campsite includes the jeu-de-boules pitch. Balls can be borrowed at the reception. The Oranjekanaal also runs right past the campsite; an excellent spot for fishing. Avid readers are also well catered for at Camping Midden Drenthe, as books can be borrowed free of charge from the canteen. Young children will enjoy the playground and the Villa Kakelbont petting zoo right next door.

Have a snack in the canteen

There is a small canteen where refreshments such as hot drinks, ice creams, pastries, sandwiches and some local products are available. You can also order your breakfast for the next day here. The nearest place to do your shopping is in Westerbork, about five kilometres from the campsite. Here you can find two large supermarkets.

properties.name: Vedersø Strand Camping
properties.description:
Vedersø Klit Camping is located in a beautiful location against the dunes, 500 m from a vast sandy beach. The campsite has numerous facilities, such as a tennis court (artificial grass) and a skate track. There are ample walking and cycling opportunities in the area and the sea is perfect for wind and kitesurfing.

Hiker's cabins

The grounds are fairly open with a row of hedges or a tree here and there. The pitches are located on fields. The pitches around the swimming pool offer limited privacy. However, the pitches on the perimeter offer ample privacy. Vedersø Klit Camping also has a few rental hiker's cabins and studios.

Water slide

The spacious swimming pool with slide, whirlpool and water mushroom is a large attraction. It is surrounded by numerous sun loungers to dream the day away. The pool is in full sun, although one side offers some shade part of the day. The beautiful, wide beach is within walking distance.

Wellness

There is a small playground with jungle gym, play house, slide and swing for the tiny ones. Slightly older children can enjoy themselves with a gigantic bouncer, the table tennis table, skate track and the multi sports field. Entertainment is offered in high season. In addition, there is a tennis court with artificial grass, a pétanque court and an 18-hole mini-golf court. Wellness enthusiasts can make use of the sauna, sunbed, a whirlpool and a steam bath.

Cooking area

The campsite restaurant is beautifully decorated and offers a wide choice. There is also a supermarket with daily fresh bread. The campsite also has a large kitchen area with microwave ovens, stoves and a chest freezer.

properties.name: Camping Seasonova Les Plages de Loire
Flower Camping Beauchêne
properties.description:
Flower Camping Beauchêne is a green campsite situated along a stream in the Vendée, not far from the Atlantic Coast. The town of Avrillé is just over half a kilometer away. In Avrillé you will find all kinds of small shops and you can get your daily provisions from there. The region also offers nice options for day trips and sporty activities at the seaside or in nature (walking and cycling).

Tall trees and a small stream

You will be welcomed in the small reception building. Thanks to the tall trees the site may be quite shady in places. The clearly demarcated tourist camping pitches are located along the stream. They have a grass surface, are located amidst greenery and offer ample room for a camper van or a vehicle plus tent or caravan. There are some furnished tents and two bungalows available for rental. Otherwise, there a quite a number of mobile homes on the campsite.

Large play square and heated swimming pool

There is a large play square and a heated swimming pool. The sun umbrellas and loungers around the swimming pool are eagerly awaiting you. The swimming pool is covered. For the tiny ones there is a paddling pool and in high season there is an entertainment programme for the slightly older children.

Bread and take-away meals

Near the reception is a small shop with limited range. You can get fresh bread here in the mornings. Other shopping can be done in shops that are located at a distance of approx. 500 m from the campsite. If you feel like a pizza or another snack, you can get these from the basic (snack)bar. You can also get take-away meals there.

properties.name: Le Fort Espagnol
properties.description:
Campsite Le Fort Espagnol in Morbihan is located not far from the sea. Here you'll camp not even four kilometres from a few fine sandy beaches near the town centre of Crac'h. You'll find all of the amenities in this small typical Breton town. Near the campsite is the regional nature park of the Gulf of Morbihan as well as a few larger resorts.

Camping with space and privacy

Here you will find mainly accommodation and a few tourist pitches on a total area of five hectares. The spacious pitches at the Le Fort Espagnol campsite offer plenty of privacy and are separated.

Aqua park with everything you could want

The swimming paradise is correctly named: you'll enjoy a heated, covered swimming pool of 120 m2 (maximum depth 1.40 metres). It is open all season. For the little ones there is a wading pool inside and outside. The water is heated there too.

The outdoor pool of 300 m2 (maximum depth 1.20 metres) is open from the end of May (depending on the weather) to the middle of September. You can also use the water slide. For relaxation there is a jacuzzi, a bubble bath and a massage table.

Entertainment for the entire family

There are many activities organised at the Le Fort Espagnol campsite, so no one will be bored. A large entertainment team will amuse everyone in the high season from morning to late at night. For the little ones, the campsite has a playground and a play area. A number of competitions and theme evenings are organised.

properties.name: Camping de l'Ill - Colmar
properties.description:
On the edge of characteristic Colmar in Alsace, not far from the German border, you’ ll find Camping de l'Ill. You will camp on an elongated green area on the banks of the river Ill. Its location, close to Colmar and the motorway, makes it ideal for visits to the city centre.

Camping by the river

You camp in a green spot on the outskirts of town. As a result, traffic noise from the motorway can reach the campsite fairly easily. Something to take into account. On the extensive campsite there are about one hundred and fifty shady touring pitches on the riverbank.

There are also almost one hundred paved campervan pitches, especially for the many motorhome owners who visit the campsite for a city visit or as a stopover. Rental accommodations are less available, but even there you still have plenty of choice.

Modest entertainment on the campsite

For entertainment at the campsite you can take a dip in the modern swimming pool. Around the pool are sun loungers, for when you want to spend an hour lazing in the sun. The shallow part of the Ill is also suitable for bathing. There is not much to do for children, although they can have fun in the playground at the campsite.

Shops within walking distance

If you want a quick bite, you can go to the cafeteria on the campsite. Here you can order french fries or drink in the outdoor café. For your daily shopping you don't have to go far: everything is within walking distance.

properties.name: Regenbogen Ferienanlage Ladbergen
properties.description:
In the midst of Münsterland, right on the large swimming lake "Buddenkuhle", you'll find Regenbogen Holiday Complex Ladbergen. The campground is easily accessible from the German motorway A1. The campground is located in a natural environment with many forests, fields, meadows and a few villages. The nearest large cities are Münster (to the south) and Osnabrück (to the north), both about 30 km away.

Spacious sites and private bathrooms.

After being welcomed in the spacious reception, you'll drive on paved roads to the campsite. The campsite is suitable for campers, caravans or tents, and the campsites are spacious and have power connections. Except for free campsites, the campground also has a large number of set sites. If you want more privacy, luxury and comfort, you can rent a private bathroom on location.

Swimming in the Buddenkuhle

Regenbogen Holiday Complex Ladbergen is focused on the whole family, and there is plenty for every member of the family to do. The children will have fun in the playground or with the activities team, and older kids can use the sports facilities (tennis, table tennis, football, beach volleyball). Naturally the Buddenkuhle provides water fun for all ages. Take a dip in the lake, enjoy sun on the sandy beach, build a giant sand castle or go surfing or waterskiing on the lake.

A drink on the terrace

The campground has a bar with a sunny terrace. You can relax here with a coffee or a German beer. Is it warm weather? Then drop in to the beach bar for a snack or a cold ice cream.

properties.name: Camping Domaine Aramis
properties.description:
