Camping Domaine Aramis is located in the heart of the green Midi Pyrenees. You can’t help but unwind here. This four-star campsite is eco-friendly, large and quiet. You camp among greenery, have plenty of space around you and choose from a range of comfortable accommodation options. Feel like being active? There are a number of cycling and walking paths in the area. Various cities, like historic Auch and lively Toulouse, are within easy reach as well.

Large pitch or comfortable accommodation

Do you have a tent, caravan or motor home? You’ll always have plenty of space here. The pitches are large, well-organised and surrounded by trees and bushes. And for anyone without camping equipment, the mobile homes and chalets have everything you might need. Perfect for families, groups of friends or campers looking for convenience.

Everything you need for a relaxing holiday

There’s plenty to do at Camping Domaine Aramis. For example, take a dip in the pool, dream away in the sun or relax in the spa. The sauna and massages are the icing on the cake. Children can race down the slide or play for hours in the water park. Active guests can head to the city stadium or start the day in the gym.

As soon as you start to feel hungry, head to the restaurant or bar for local dishes, street food and surprisingly tasty cocktails. This campsite feels like a small village in itself. Everything is at hand and you won’t need to leave the campsite for anything.

properties.name: Camping Huttopia Oléron Les Chênes Verts
Camping Huttopia La Clarée
properties.description:
Close to the French-Italian border, in a beautiful valley of the river Clarée, you’ll find Huttopia La Clarée campsite. Here you camp in a wooded area surrounded by the Alps. The pitches are situated in the heart of the countryside and the rental accommodation on the campsite is luxurious. The campsite is suitable for families, but above all for the more active and nature-loving.

Camping by the river

The campsite is located in a protected natural area in the valley of the river Clarée, the namegiver of the campsite. It is beautiful here: tall trees fill the terrain, which is surrounded by the peaks of the Alps. During the renovation of the campsite, many luxury lodge tents have been set up. Still there are mainly touring pitches to be found. They are located in the countryside, in the woods or on the banks of the river.

Sunny swimming pool

The swimming pool is situated in a sunny spot, almost against the cliff. Here you can take a dip while looking out over the mountain tops. The pool is not very big, but the sundeck around is all the more spacious. Next to the pool is a paddling pool. The pool is fenced by wooden poles. Fancy a drink? Then, just outside the fence, you can take a seat on the pavement café or at the bar.

Visit to Briançon

Apart from the bar and a campsite shop with a small assortment, the campsite does not have a catering service. For your groceries it is best to drive to Briançon where there are several supermarkets. If you're in Briançon, pay a visit to the fortress.

properties.name: Camping Huttopia La Côte Sauvage-Ile de Ré
properties.description:
Fancy a holiday on an idyllic island, with the sea, beach and tranquillity? The Huttopia La Côte Sauvage - Île de Ré campsite is just 20 m from the Atlantic Ocean. You camp in the heart of nature here. La Flotte, one of the most beautiful villages on the island, and the beach are close by. It’s a great spot for anyone wanting to alternate relaxation with trips.

Camping or glamping?

Will you choose a pitch with your own tent, caravan or motor home? Or will you opt for the comfort of a Classic or Family Lodge tent for four people? You camp under tall pine trees here, on large pitches, with the sound of the sea in the background. Back to basics, but with modern facilities.

Facilities with a plus

No need for a pool here: sea is close by. After refreshing morning dip, grab breakfast from counter-service café. Later, have drink on sunny terrace. Relaxed atmosphere and geared towards convenience. Fun activities and entertaining theme nights are regularly organised for children and adults. The campsite is informal, which is exactly what you want on holiday.

Discover Île de Ré

The campsite is right on the Plage de la Basse Benaie beach. It's quick to walk or cycle to La Flotte (750 m), one of the most beautiful villages on the island. Stroll through local markets or drink a glass of wine at the port. Want to be more active? Rent a bike, or go surfing at Grenettes.

properties.name: Camping Domaine du Lac de Néguenou
Camping Huttopia Noirmoutier
properties.description:
Huttopia Noirmoutier campsite is a large campsite located on Île de Noirmoutier, on the west coast of France. You camp here on an elongated campsite directly on the beach on shady pitches or stay in one of the comfortable lodge tents. Explore the surroundings on a bike, take a dip in the Atlantic Ocean or go in search of shells, cockles and mussels on the beach.

Camping on the beach

Some pitches on the campsite are only separated from the beach by a wooden fence. Try to get hold of one of these spots, because these are the most beautiful. The campsite has space for almost four hundred touring pitches. These pitches are not all equally spacious - some are even small - but they are nicely situated under the tall pine trees.

In addition to the touring pitches, there are one hundred rental units. The lodge tents, whether furnished or not, are particularly well represented. The tents are spacious and quite luxurious, but they do make the campsite reasonably crowded. Especially at the front of the campsite you might find it rather busy.

Supermarket and snack bar

There is a small supermarket on the campsite, but this is not worth mentioning. However, within three kilometres you will find a larger supermarket for your daily groceries. The snack bar on the campsite is very special. It is located in a food truck. In this large aluminium 'Airstreamcaravan' you can order a pizza or french fries. Have a seat on the wooden terrace, where you can enjoy the shade of one of the parasols or the large trees.

properties.name: Flower Camping Les Gorges de l'Aveyron
Camping Clos Cacheleux
properties.description:
On a hilltop in beautiful Picardy, next to the castle of Bouillancourt, lies campsite Le Clos Cacheleux. This large campsite has many large pitches. Families like staying here as there are ample facilities for children. With its location not too far from the sea (25 km), coast and beach can be reached quickly.

Spaciously laid-out camping grounds

With 70 pitches distributed over no less than 17 ha, the campsite is very spaciously laid out. The slightly sloping camping pitches for tents and caravans, surrounded by greenery, measure up to 275 m2. The view from the terrain over the green valley of the Trie is exceptionally beautiful. The sanitary facilities of the campsite are good. 

Inventive rental accommodation units

If you prefer to rent accommodation, varied and inventive options such as teepee tents, eco lodges and exciting tree huts are available. Tall trees surround the mobile homes, which are separated from the tourist section. 

Swimming at the neighbours' place

There is no swimming pool on Le Clos Cacheleux, but you are very welcome to enjoy a refreshing dive at the neighbouring Camping Val de Trie. This somewhat lower lying terrain, a few minutes' walk away, belongs to the same owner. There you will also find a trampoline, petting zoo and a fish pond.

Bread rolls in the tent

The 'sister' campsite also has a small shop, bar and restaurant with good, basic meals. Real aficionados can also visit the many restaurants serving fresh fish dishes in the nearby coastal towns. At Clos Cacheleux, ordered rolls and croissants will be delivered to your doorstep in the mornings. The larger supermarkets are located a bit further along.

properties.name: Camping Huttopia Font-Romeu
properties.description:
Fancy waking up with a spectacular view of the Pyrenees' mountaintops from your tent? At this French campsite, you'll enjoy your holiday at a breathtaking altitude of 1,800 metres. Huttopia Font-Romeu Campsite is ideal for nature lovers and active holidaymakers. Two heated outdoor swimming pools and a paddling pool offer plenty of water recreation. You can enjoy the beautiful view over the mountains and the pine trees whilst swimming. The swimming pool is located next to the entrance, where you'll also find an authentic restaurant serving local dishes. Enjoy the beautiful surroundings during your stay at Huttopia Font-Romeu Campsite!

Nature pitches and attractive wooden chalets

Campers can choose from three types of pitches: Nature, Comfort and Comfort Plus. The nature pitches are located on the hills. If you opt for a Comfort pitch, you'll have access to electricity. The Comfort Plus pitches are located in the most beautiful spots. In addition to electricity, these also provide you with a wooden picnic table. The campsite's sanitary facilities have recently been renovated and look neat and tidy.

Enjoy nature while the children have their own fun

At Huttopia Font-Romeu Campsite, you can enjoy table tennis, swimming, table football or a game of boules. There's also a spacious playground where the children can enjoy themselves. In summer, outdoor activities are organised for young children aged five to twelve. These include building huts or going on treasure hunts, for example.

properties.name: Camping Le Petit Rocher
properties.description:
In the southern Vendée, near La Tranche-sur-Mer (15 km) and Les Sables d'Olonne (30 km) you'll find the charming resort of Longeville-sur-Mer. You can find many restaurants and shops there. There you'll also find campsite Le Petit Rocher, a terraced campsite in the midst of the forest only 150 m from a fine sandy beach along the Atlantic Ocean.

Site in nature

The separated sites are in the midst of nature on sandy grass ground amidst the trees. Most of the sites are spacious enough for a car and caravan, and are available with or without shade. Outside of the dimensions, there are few differences between the campsites. In addition to many mobile homes, there are also gypsy caravans, canvas bungalows and ecolodges for rent. This real family campsite attracts a varied public: families with young children, teenagers young couples and seniors.

Water sports and other fun

Water lovers can surf, sail, land sail and kayak, while others enjoy fishing or cycling tours on the special paths along the Côte de Lumière.

Campsite Le Petit Rocher has a heated and covered pool with free jacuzzi and three water slides, a separate kiddie pool with slide and a water playground. The outdoor pool is in the sun, with plenty of space around it to sunbathe in beach chairs. From the campsite it is only 150 m to the lovely sandy beach of Longeville-sur-Mer.

For children from 3 to 12 years, there are creative workshops for crafts, games and performances in the mini fun club. There is aquagym every day in the pool and in the evening there are cabaret performances, magic shows, disco evenings, karaoke and concerts.

properties.name: Sites & Paysages de l'Etang de Bazange
properties.description:
In the midst of the beautiful forested Dordogne you'll find the family campground Sites & Paysages de l‘Etang de Bazange. This is located between Saint-Emilion and Bergerac. You have many options for luxury camping on the quiet campground with spacious campsites located on a little lake. Many families with young children come here for the nature and the small scale activities.

Glamping

You can camp here in many ways. A standard site is between 80 and 100 m2. Or choose glamping. You hire a covered wooden terrace and a summer kitchen as well. The most luxurious variation is the glamping pitch XL, a space of 120 to 150 m2, with a garden set and a terrace with wooden pergolas for extra privacy.

Waterlodge

There are 35 accommodations to hire, whereby you have the choice of a furnished lodge tent with or without bathroom, a mobile home or a bungalow. You can also overnight in a tent of wood and fabric which is furnished with trendy furnitures. You might also choose the luxurious lodge floating on the water. You walk from the waterlodge to the campground over a bridge.

Beautiful swimming pool

The campsites are all near a fishing pond. Surrounding it is a 10 hectare forested park with many opportunities to play. The heated 200 m2 swimming pool (with three water slides and a kiddie pool) is in a lovely location and has a view of the lake.

Entertainment

During the summer months there are activities for kids of various ages at least twice a week. There are all kinds of activities organized for adults as well.

properties.name: Camping Huttopia Oléron Les Pins
properties.description:
The Huttopia Oléron Les Pins campsite is located not far from the beach on the Atlantic coast, in a large pine forest on Ile d'Oléron. Here you can camp in the shade of tall pine trees, on one of the spacious pitches or stay in a lodge tent. Take a dip in the outdoor pools with the children, discover Saint-Trojan-les-Bains from the tourist train or cycle through an area where salt extraction and oyster and mussel farming dominate the scene.

Camping under the pines

The pine forest is beautiful: it gives the campsite colour and provides many sheltered spots. All the more than one hundred and fifty touring pitches, large and small, are therefore in the shade. The disadvantage, however, is that there is little grass. The ground is sandy, becoming muddy quickly after rainfall. Nevertheless, the campsite is well looked after.

Swimming pools and beach volleyball

The main attraction on the campsite are the swimming pools. These two outdoor pools are centrally located on the campsite, surrounded by a wooden sun deck and enclosed by wooden poles. The pools are beautifully situated between the trees in an open spot in the sun. Next to the swimming pools, a beach volleyball court has been laid out, which gives a summery beach atmosphere. By the way, the beach is only a few kilometres from the campsite. On the coast you can pick mussels especially well.

Gypsy caravan as food truck

Pizzas, wines and meat plates are served on the campsite from a wooden gypsy caravan. You can eat at one of the picnic tables on the pavement café. Apart from fresh bread rolls in the morning and a few groceries, you can't get much more on the campsite. The best place to go for a supermarket is Saint-Trojan-les-Bains.

properties.name: Camping Le Clos de Balleroy
properties.description:
Camping Le Clos de Balleroy is situated in the heart of Normandy’s countryside and is a lovely spot for those who enjoy tranquillity, space and variety. Here, you’ll be camping amidst woods and open countryside, with culture and history always close by. Fun activities are organised for all ages, and there is a swimming pool with a retractable roof.

Camping in green surroundings

The pitches at Camping Le Clos de Balleroy are spacious and set in green surroundings. You’ll enjoy privacy, peace and plenty of outdoor activities. Whether you’re coming with a tent, caravan or motorhome, you’ll always find a spot that suits you. Prefer a bit more comfort? Then choose one of the fully equipped accommodation options.

(Sports) activities and a great swimming pool

There is plenty to do at the campsite for young and old alike. Among other things, there is a children’s playground, a trampoline and an enthusiastic entertainment team. On hot days, you can cool off in the swimming pool. Or settle down at the bar for a drink. Good food has also been taken care of. You can enjoy simple meals in the (snack) bar.

Explore the area

Within walking distance lies the Château de Balleroy (1.5 km), an impressive 17th-century castle with beautifully landscaped gardens. Set off on walking and cycling routes through vast woodlands and past charming villages. Bayeux (15 km) is also nearby, famous for the world-renowned Bayeux Tapestry and its charming streets. You’re also just a short drive from the famous D-Day beaches of Normandy.

properties.name: Camping de Kersentic
properties.description:
In the French town of Fouesnant, located on the Breton coast, is the Camping de Kersentic campsite. With the beautiful sandy beach of Cap Coz and the beautiful natural environment of the Finistére department, this is a lovely place for everyone to enjoy. There is plenty to do for both active and relaxed campers. Owners Corinne and Marc provide a nice family atmosphere at the campsite.

Well equipped

The helpful owners, or one of their colleagues, will give you a warm welcome upon arrival. Before you know it, you'll be checked in and setting up your camping gear on the well-kept and spacious pitches. Then your holiday can really begin!

Water fun and sporting fun

With Cap Coz beach within walking distance, aquatic fun is guaranteed. In addition to a refreshing swim, you can also enjoy excellent windsurfing and snorkelling here. Of course, there's also the opportunity to relax and read a book in the sand! And when the weather is bad, the campsite's indoor pool and paddling pool offer a great solution.

Walkers and cyclists are in luck, because you can make beautiful trips in the vicinity of the campsite. The GR34 is one of the big recommendations. Children can have fun in the playground, on the multi-sport field or with the enthusiastic entertainment team. For game fanatics, there is a real game room that includes a pool table, foosball table and television.

Facilities on the campsite

You don't have to leave the campsite to enjoy a nice bite to eat. An extensive snack bar and pizzeria are available. Every morning, you can take up the offer of fresh bread. There is also a small shop with some basic necessities and Wi-Fi.

properties.name: Domaine de Kervallon
properties.description:
At the edge of the Brocéliande Forest lies this nature-rich campsite. A small-scale gem in the countryside with good amenities, including two pools, Kids Club, a spa and a restaurant.

Domaine de Kervallon Maeva respire is located in the south of Brittany, near the village of Ploërmel. The gently rolling region is very popular with hikers and cyclists.

Space and greenery all around you

On the way to your camping spot, you'll see lots of open space everywhere where as much natural vegetation as possible has been preserved. Most pitches for a camper, caravan or tent are pleasantly large. Always wanted to sleep in a sturdy lodge tent, a tiny house or a beautifully furnished cottage? The campsite offers these wonderful glamping opportunities to families looking for comfortable accommodation in nature.

Water fun galore

The campsite's main attraction is its beautiful water park. There is an outdoor pool with a paddling pool, as well as an indoor heated pool with a glass canopy. Outside, the kids will have the most fun on the two water slides.

For extra relaxation, comfortable sunbeds surround the pool, and a sauna is available. This luxury is specifically for adults and can be used for a fee.

Indulge yourself on the terrace

A delicious pizza, a salad with figs and goat's cheese or a homemade burger prepared by the chef? The campsite's restaurant is well regarded and also offers local dishes. There is even an extensive wine list for the connoisseur.

properties.name: Camping des Cerisiers
properties.description:
Camping des Cerisiers is situated in Morbihan, in the south of Brittany. Here you are only two km away from the medieval town of Josselin with its imposing castle. Des Cerisiers is a small campsite with pitches in sheltered locations in a cherry orchard. The campsite is at a distance of five hundred metres from the Napoleonic canal Brest-Nantes.

Camping or renting?

In addition to pitches, there are also accommodations available. You can rent these if you do not have your own camping equipment. In addition to classic types of accommodation, there is also some more unusual accommodation, such as bulles (type of transparent bubbles), one yurt, one Campétoile, Coco Sweets and Coco Duos. Those pitches are spacious (between 80 m2 and 130 m2) and all have electricity.

Entertainment and amenities

On the campsite children can enjoy themselves in the playground with various kinds of playground equipment. Furthermore, there is a table tennis table and a table football game. In addition to the usual sanitary facilities, there is a laundry area with washing machine and tumble dryer.

The small shop stocks basic supplies and a few local products. In the snack bar you can buy drinks and snacks, of course. In the mornings you can get breakfast here. There are also two charcoal barbecues on the campsite.

Especially for hikers and cyclists

This campsite is eminently suitable for hikers and cyclists. One hundred metres from the campsite you can find the GR37 trail.

properties.name: Camping Bellevue
properties.description:
Camping Bellevue is located centrally in the Lot, close to the village of Reilhaguet. This campsite is located in a hilly region where you can go on lovely forest walks and bike rides. Furthermore, the campsite is in a favourable location between Rocamadour, Sarlat-la-Canéda and Gouffre de Padirac, three of the most popular tourist sites in this region. Here, you camp in a quiet spot in a natural setting. The most significant amenities include a lovely outdoor swimming pool, a fun playground, a petting zoo and a lovely bar with recreation room.

Spacious touring pitches and various types of accommodation

On arrival, Mrs Thomas, the campsite owner, will give you a friendly welcome at reception. If you look at the map of Camping Bellevue when there, you will see that most of the spacious tourist pitches lie nicely together. The camping pitches can be reached via paved pebble paths. Most of the pitches are level, some are sloping. Besides a camping pitch, you can also hire a mobile home, chalet, bungalow or lodge tent at Camping Bellevue.

Lovely outdoor swimming pool

The lovely outdoor swimming pool at Camping Bellevue is right behind reception. The swimming pool has a large paddling pool where the youngest campers can splash about in the water. The swimming pool is in the full sun. So, the swimming water soon reaches a pleasant temperature on hot days.

Cuddling animals at the petting zoo

Children can entertain themselves in many more ways at this campsite. One way is at the petting zoo, where you can get acquainted with sweet animals such as goats, horses, guinea pigs and chicken in a playful way.

properties.name: Camping Le Petit Pyrénéen
properties.description:
Camping Le Petit Pyrénéen is located in the French Pyrenees, on a river near the village of Le Mas-d'Azil. This small, friendly family campsite has a well-maintained terrain, a simple outdoor swimming pool and plenty of play facilities for children. At Le Petit Pyrénéen you'll camp on grass, on a spacious, sheltered pitch with plenty of shade. The impressive prehistoric caves of Le Mas-d'Azil are close to the campsite.

Warm welcome

Coming from Toulouse you can follow the A65 until exit 25. Now follow the D25 and in Montesquieu-Volvestre take the D628 to Sabarat. In Sabarat take the D119 to Le Mas-d'Azil. The road follows the course of the river Arize. After about four kilometres the campsite is on the left side of the road. The wooded terrain is shady and well maintained. At the reception building there is a pleasant pavement café. You will be warmly welcomed by the hospitable owners Anne and Philippe.

Shady camping site

On the spacious camping site 44 beautiful touring pitches have been laid out. You camp on grass, on a spacious and shady pitch. Petit Pyrénéen is a real family campsite. There is plenty of space for children to play, both indoors and outdoors. They can play to their heart's content in the outdoor pool and in the river where can build dams, play and splash around. There is no entertainment programme, so for older children this campsite may be less interesting. The village of Le Mas-d'Azil is famous for its prehistoric caves. The only cave in Europe you can even drive through by car!

properties.name: Camping Huttopia Lac de Carcans
properties.description:
In the west of the Médoc region, between Lake Carcans and the Atlantic Ocean, you’ll find the Huttopia Lac de Carcans campsite. You will camp here on the shores of the lake in a large pine forest, which provides shady touring pitches. There is a wide range of comfortable lodge tents, so you can also enjoy a touch of glamping here. Children can have fun in the playground and swimming pool, while water sports enthusiasts can enjoy themselves on the lake and in the sea.

In the shade of pine trees

The touring pitches are nicely laid out between the winding roads, which are sometimes somewhat difficult to access. Many of the pitches have a sandy surface, which can make pitching your tent more difficult. However, you will always have shade from tall pine trees, which fill the hilly dune area. There are also various types of lodge tents (without and with private sanitary facilities).

Family campsite with outdoor pool

The vast forest is one big playground, but children can also have fun on the campsite's wooden playground equipment. There is also an outdoor swimming pool, situated in a sunny spot surrounded by trees. This spacious swimming pool is surrounded by a fence so safe for small children.

Snacks and groceries

In a modern 'roulotte' (gypsy caravan) in the heart of the campsite you will find the snack bar. The bar is surrounded by a wooden terrace, where you can sit in the sun or the shade of the pine trees. Fresh bread is available on the campsite, but for more groceries you will have to leave the campsite. There is a small supermarket a hundred metres away.

properties.name: Camping Huttopia Landes Sud
properties.description:
The Huttopia Landes campsite is located in the south west of France, in the woods. From this family campsite it is only a twenty-minute drive to the Atlantic coast, but you can also take a dip in the water at the campsite. The campsite is located directly on a recreational lake.

Camping in the forest

The campsite is situated in the woods, is rough and in some places a bit hilly. Here you can still camp in the wild, even though there are luxury lodge tents and gypsy caravans scattered throughout the terrain. These are nicely integrated into the landscape, which is mainly characterised by the towering pines. These provide shade on the more than one hundred and thirty touring pitches, and they give the campsite a peaceful atmosphere.

A refreshing drink

When you get thirsty from all that swimming, you don't have to walk far to recover. Right next to the swimming pool is the restaurant. The wooden building mainly serves pizzas, and you can also go there for a cool drink. Next to the restaurant is a nice terrace with parasols.

Beach at the campsite

If you are camping at Huttopia Landes Sud campsite, you are less than twenty kilometres from the Atlantic Ocean. The white sandy beach here is very long, so you'll have a spot in the sand to choose from. But you don't even have to leave the campsite. You camp directly on a large recreational lake and a sandy beach. In the lake itself you can swim, of course, but you can also paddle surf, go boating and much more.

properties.name: Flower Camping Lac aux Oiseaux
properties.description:
Flower Camping Lac aux Oiseaux is a family campsite in the Aveyron, located on the edge of the Parc Naturel Régional des Causses du Quercy. With its covered outdoor swimming pool with water slides and its high altitude course, this campsite is ideal for families with children. But nature lovers will also enjoy the campsite, situated directly on a large lake in a nature reserve. A great destination for camping.

Potential beauty

Due to various renovation works, the beauty of the campsite is not shown to advantage yet, but it certainly has potential. The site is situated in the middle of nature, next to a large lake. The more than sixty touring pitches have an average size. You can also choose from one of the mobile homes or family tents.

Indoor swimming pool with slides

The swimming pool is one of the things on the campsite that has been renovated. It is rectangular and covered by a sliding roof. So you can swim whatever the weather. Next to it a smaller pool with a few large water slides.

Villefranche-de-Rouergue

The campsite restaurant is situated next to the ruins of an old mill. It serves small delicacies. For fresh bread you have to go to the village of Martiel, about three kilometres from the campsite. A larger supermarket can be found in Villefranche-de-Rouergue. Within a quarter of an hour's drive you're in the centre of this old town, where especially the Notre Dame church is worth a visit.

properties.name: Barack Thermal Camping
properties.description:
Barack Thermal Camping lives up to its name with its extensive swimming pool and well-maintained restaurant. Several thermal baths can be found in the area. The campsite is suitable for seniors and families with children of all age groups.

Cosy and well maintained

The campsite is tidy, cosy and well maintained. Friendly receptionists will welcome you in German or English. The area looks beautiful, marked by the many hedges and trees.

Varied public

The camping pitches are demarcated by hedges and differ in terms of the amount of shade. In addition, you can also rent a hotel room, apartment or bungalow. Most guests here are from Germany, Hungary, the Czech Republic or the Netherlands. Campers of all ages will find something to suit them here.

Wellness and swimming

The swimming pool features two thermal baths, a toddler pool, a shallow kid's pool, two large pools with slides and an indoor pool with jacuzzi. You can find plenty of sunbathing lawns around the pools. You can always find plenty of kid's and sports activities to do, from beach football to dance performances. In addition to the large playground, there is also an indoor playground and a sports pitch.

A la carte or buffet

The best place for groceries is the village, where you can find excellent shops. The restaurant is located next to the swimming pool. You can dine a la carte or opt for the buffet. The restaurant is very child-friendly. From the shaded terrace you have a great view of the children's pool and the playground. Swimsuits are permitted in the snack bar, the restaurant and the terrace, meaning that swimming, playing and eating are easy to combine.

The sanitary facilities are simple but clean.

properties.name: Camping Le Bois Verdon
properties.description:
Camping Le Bois Verdon is located in the well-known West French seaside resort of Saint-Jean-de-Monts. You are camping here in the Vendée, close to the Atlantic coast. Typical of Saint-Jean-de-Monts are the extensive forests. The campsite is situated on the edge of these. In less than ten minutes you can cycle to the city centre or to the long sandy beach. A day at the seaside is definitely on your programme!

A peaceful campsite

With less than forty tourist pitches and just over twenty rental accommodations (for 2-6 persons), this is not a large campsite. That is why you can enjoy peace and quiet. Yet you don't have to compromise on conviviality during a holiday at Le Bois Verdon. You can take a dip in the heated swimming pool (with sliding roof). Next to it is a toddlers' pool, also heated. Here the youngest campers can play with some colourful playground equipment. There is also enough space to read a book on a lounger by the water.

Entertainment on land

Two of the most popular campsite sports are table tennis and boules. Lucky you! At campsite Le Bois Verdon you have two table tennis tables and two jeu de boules lanes at your disposal. The younger campers can play in the playground, complete with slide and trampoline.

Snack and drink

In July and August you can get fresh bread at the campsite. The pizzeria and bar are also open during this period. You can do some shopping at the campsite shop, but for the rest you have to go to Saint-Jean-de-Monts. Leave the car or motor home and go by bike. You can hire one at the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Le Sorgenti
properties.description:
If you want to wake up to the sound of a cascading waterfall and chattering of a small river, Camping Le Sorgenti in Tuscany is the place to go. A quiet green oasis in a beautiful mountainous area. Go for a refreshing dip in the river or go hiking through the countryside. The lovely village of Palazzuolo sul Senio is within walking distance. This is an excellent operating base for exploring the Apennines. This is also a good place for cultural excursions. You can visit Florence or Bologna.

Shady terraced campsite

The campsite is managed by a friendly and hospitable family. There is a large difference in altitude at Le Sorgenti, which has 80 spacious pitches, all with electricity. You are in the countryside here, which is why you benefit from plenty of shade from the trees. In addition to a traditional pitch, you can also choose a mobile home, bungalow or wooden chalet.

Swimming by the waterfalls

Cooling off and swimming is done here in a natural swimming pool. A river flows straight through the campsite with a beautiful waterfalls at its foot, where you can go for a nice dip. Children enjoy swimming here too.

Those who love tranquillity and nature feel quite at home at Camping Le Sorgenti! While there is no entertainment organised, you can play table tennis, use the barbecue and participate in the hiking excursions that are organised. The bar offers various drinks and there is a mini-market where you can buy some supplies.

properties.name: Camping Domaine du Lac de Feyt
Camping Santa Clorinda
properties.description:
The small campsite Santa Clorinda is located in the midst of the Tuscan hills. You camp here on the terraced slope of a hill. The view from your pitch is truly magnificent. The campsite, in the middle of the quiet Italian countryside, is mostly peaceful. Want to go out for a day? Then drive within half an hour to Grosseto or to Castiglione della Pescaia. The latter town is located on the Italian coast. There, you can also have a swim in the Tyrrhenian Sea.

In the Tuscan countryside

This camping holiday takes you all the way to the south of Tuscany. On the coastal road you'll pass La Spezia, Pisa and Cecina. You follow the E80 in the direction of Grosseto. At Gavorrano, a small town in the hills, you leave the motorway. Between the hills you drive into the Tuscan countryside. There, against a slope, is campsite Santa Clorinda.

Peace and quiet against the hill

Peace and quiet reigns against that hill in Tuscany. If that is what you are looking for then this is the right place. There are sunny pitches on the green terraces. From here you have a beautiful view over the valley. There is nothing but spaciousness around you. Not only because of the wide surroundings, but also because of the spacious pitches.

Walking to the supermarket

Camping Santa Clorinda has the facilities you would expect from a small campsite. There are not many, but what there is, is perfect. The sanitary facilities, for example, are clean and modern. You won't find a shop on the campsite, but there is one nearby. Walk for a few minutes and you already reach a supermarket.

properties.name: Gwersyllfa Pant Yr Onnen Lakeside Campsite
Asc. Amigos de Acampada Campo Alegre
Camping De Wedze
properties.description:
Camping De Wedze is situated in the nature reserve De Friese Wouden. On this mini campsite you will camp between the Frisian meadows. The wide view from your spacious pitch gives you a feeling of freedom. Freedom that you have plenty on and around the campsite. You can choose your own pitch. And don't forget to explore the beautiful surroundings. Cycle to nature reserves such as the Mieden or 'it Bûtenfjild'. Here you can admire the marshes, woods and meadows.

In the Frisian Woods

In the north of Friesland, in the middle of the meadows, you will find campsite De Wedze. You drive into peace and quiet when you reach the outskirts of the village of Twijzel. After a hedge of trees you arrive at this mini campsite. You are camping here in De Friese Wouden: there is nothing but nature around you. A wonderful holiday address for nature lovers and those looking for peace and quiet.

A campsite to suit you

Find your own pitch on the park-like camping site. The large lawns are neatly mowed and offer space for twenty-five spacious pitches. Would you like some privacy with a pitch next to a large hedge? Or will you go for the unobstructed view over the meadows? Luxury campers will also find the perfect place to stay at De Wedze campsite. The large safari tents look like hotel rooms. With a fully equipped kitchen, large patio and soft beds, the rooms are very comfortable.

Well-kept and complete sanitary facilities

The facilities on this mini campsite are excellent. Are you ready for a hot shower? Everything is at hand in and around the well-kept sanitary building. Showers, senior showers, toilets, washbasins, chemical toilets: everything is there.

properties.name: O2 Camping
properties.description:
O2 Camping is situated in the middle of the countryside near the French town of Longueville (Normandy). You will enjoy an oasis of peace at this family campsite. You can go for lovely walks and cycle rides in the area. Or visit one of the sandy beaches with their special history. You will not be bored for a single moment here!

Respect for nature

In the surroundings of this campsite you can enjoy both the beautiful nature and the sea. O2 Camping is an ecological campsite that respects the natural environment as much as possible. The campsite only exists since 2019 and it shows! For example, the reception building is beautiful and modern.

Plenty of space!

You have a lot of space on the totally new campsite grounds. The pitches are also very large. Motorhomes are also allowed on this campsite. Do you fancy an extra special stay? Rent one of the mobile homes, tents or a real wooden cabin. You can have a cup of coffee on your own patio in the morning!

Relaxation through exercise

At the campsite you can enjoy a covered and heated indoor swimming pool with sunbathing area. You can also book a relaxing massage (for a fee). Or you can relax by playing table tennis or jeu-de-boules. Of course you can also choose to step on your bike. Several walking and cycling routes have been mapped out in the area.

properties.name: Camping La Ferme de la Corbière
Camping des Nières
properties.description:
The shaded Camping des Nières is situated in the Auvergne region, directly on the banks of the Sioul River in the small town of Ebreuil. This is an ideal region to unwind, swim a few laps in the river, cast a line or paddle in a canoe or kayak. The grounds are elongated and offer ample shade. The spacious, demarcated pitches are located on both sides of a wide central street. The most beautiful pitches are to be found on the river. There are free motorhome pitches outside the campsite grounds.

Swimming in the river and canoeing

The Sioul River is well-suited for swimming. There is a sunbathing lawn along the banks. Near Vichy, some 30 km away, is a reservoir with recreation opportunities. There is an extensive range of playground equipment for small children on the campsite. Other than that, the river is the real trump card: for swimming, fishing, canoeing and kayaking. There are a number of places where one can hire a canoe. In peak season, the town of Ébreuil regularly organises various activities for inhabitants and campsite guests.

Basic necessities

There is no shop or restaurant on the campsite. However, a baker drops by daily and in the village (within walking distance) you will find a Spar, a bakery and a butcher. If you are looking for a wider selection, you will find a few large supermarkets at a distance of some 10 km.

In the surrounding area

The medieval village of Charroux, one of the Plus Beaux Villages de France (most beautiful villages in France), is 11 kilometres away. Vichy is also not far away: a half-hour drive (33 km) will take you to beautiful shopping streets, spas and walking parks. A little further away (50 km) is Clermont-Ferrand, a Burgundian attraction with two historic centres.

properties.name: Camping Lou Dahu
properties.description:
In one of the most beautiful valleys in Piedmont – the Maira Valley – lies Camping Lou Dahu. This small-scale and quiet campsite is located in the middle of nature and has spacious pitches on a well-tended and green site. You can also choose one of the three apartments or a spot in the field with teepees.

Teepee tents in Tatanka Village

Camping Lou Dahu is situated on a well-kept site with lots of greenery. The pitches at this small campsite are very spacious. They are demarcated by wooden fences, and there are pitches in the sun and in the shade. You can also choose to stay in one of the three beautiful apartments or in the Tatanka Village teepee tent camp.

Taste the region

The reception building also looks neat and fits perfectly into the landscape. In addition to the reception desk, you will find the campsite shop with some basic local products. The restaurant is also located in this building and has a small menu of mostly local dishes. You can have your meal in the atmospheric restaurant itself or on the outdoor terrace. Right next to it is a sunbathing area, and there is a field where you can play volleyball or football.

Steps down to the river

Steps lead down to the mountain stream that flows right next to the campsite. At the water's edge is a beautiful picnic area where you can enjoy a meal in a special setting. The river is also a wonderful place to take a paddle after an active and sporty day in the mountains.

properties.name: Camping L'Orangerie de Beauregard
properties.description:
In the middle of the Loire Valley forests you’ll find the campsite l'Orangerie de Beauregard. Camp here like royalty near the castle of Beauregard. The beautiful pitches are situated under tall trees or on grassy fields. Here you camp with the whole family in the middle of nature. Visit the local markets with regional products or enjoy a delicious meal in the restaurant. You can also take a dip in the heated swimming pool.

Royal camping

The camping pitches are on grassy fields between the trees. You can even reserve a spot in the middle of the forest. Delightful! Even in the countryside, you sometimes need a bit of comfort. Then book a comfort pitch. It has a barbecue and a picnic table. So you can enjoy a long dinner at your own caravan. Would you like some extra regal camping? Then stay in one of the cottages at the castle.

Play table tennis with your holiday friends

Your children will have the holiday of their lives at L'Orangerie de Beauregard. They can play with many other children under the age of twelve. Together with their new holiday friends, they can play table tennis, do crafts and much more. In the meantime, you take it easy: sip Vouvray, a sparkling white wine, during a wine tasting. A local and worldwide celebrity.

Markets at the campsite

Every week in the high season, fun markets are organised at the campsite. Here you can browse through the local products. Or sit on the terrace with a glass of wine and a steaming hot pizza. Would you like to visit a slightly bigger market? Then cycle or walk through the woods to Villedômer.

properties.name: Camping Huttopia Vanoise - Bozel
properties.description:
Huttopia Bozel en Vanoise campsite is located in the French region of Savoie, in the heart of the Tarentaise. Surrounded by the Alpine giants, here you camp in an oasis of tranquillity, surrounded by natural beauty. The spacious camping pitches and rental accommodation are situated on several terraces, hidden under stately pine trees. Everything on the campsite has been completely renovated in 2019, including the swimming pool and the surrounding terrace.

Characteristic style

The campsite is decorated in the typical Huttopia style with lots of wood and greenery. The site is made up of several terraces dotted with stately pine trees. In the shade of these trees are the pitches and the various rental accommodations. Completely renovated in 2019, everything looks new and well maintained. This also applies to the campsite's sanitary facilities, which are also designed in the Huttopia style.

Food trucks and family games

After waking up in the green nature with birds singing in the background, you can go to the campsite shop for fresh buns and bread. The shop also provides a small basic assortment. During the day you can get a drink, an ice cream or a slice of homemade pizza, served from food trucks. There is a cozy wooden terrace to relax and enjoy.

In the summer months there is entertainment for the children. There are also regular sports tournaments for the whole family. And if it's too cold outside in the evening, go to the communal recreation room which is in a large tent with a wood-burning stove. Here you will find comfortable chairs and fun family games.

properties.name: Flower Camping Le Dolium
properties.description:
In the touristy Gard department, between the fields of the outlying area of Laudun-l’Ardoise, lies campsite Le Dolium. With some thirty spacious pitches and approximately the same number of rental accommodation units, this is a small-scale campsite with an amiable atmosphere. There is plenty to do for the entire family. Especially the large swimming pool with its water slide is a real selling point for children. And everyone enjoys the lively musical evenings near the snack bar, the heart of the campsite. You can visit a large number of tourist attractions in the area, the Pont du Gard and towns such as Avignon and Nîmes being the highlights.

Spacious pitches

The pitches are spacious and beautifully laid out. On the right hand half of the campsite and on the sides you will find the mobile homes. These are not very remarkable; it is much more fun to visit the campsite with your caravan or motorhome and to choose a lovely spot under a tree.

Swimming pool with water slide

The swimming pool is quite large for a small-scale campsite such as Le Dolium. In any event, sufficiently large for hours of water fun with the entire family. The water slide runs into the beautifully shaped main pool. Adjacent is a toddler pool with different depths. Around the swimming pools there is plenty of space to spread out your towel and soak up the sun.

Social evenings

In summer around the bar area live concerts and dance evenings are enjoyed by all until the early hours. There is a lively atmosphere during these evenings. You can also order a delectable cocktail, pizza or other snack from the bar.

properties.name: Camping Waldenstein
properties.description:
The cosy Camping Waldenstein is located amongst the green hills of the Austrian Waldviertel. Want to recharge and relax in nature? Then this is the place for you! The area is perfect for beautiful hiking and cycling trips. And afterwards you can head to the sports restaurant to satisfy your appetite.

Small-scale camping

If you like small campsites, then this is the place for you. There are just 12 camping pitches at Camping Waldenstein. The pitches are spacious and level and are separated from each other by hedges and wooden fences. You'll find the heated sanitary facilities in the adjacent sports and cultural centre. The sanitary facilities are clean and well maintained. The showers were originally built for the tennis hall and are therefore not separated. Please note: Pets are not allowed at the campsite.

Sports activities

Next to the campsite is a large tennis complex that sports enthusiasts can use. It has three outdoor tennis courts and an indoor tennis court. Besides tennis you can also play squash and padel. There are also various hiking and cycling routes in the area. The 50 kilometre Robert Hamerling Weg trail and 17 kilometre Kneipp hiking trail run directly past the campsite.

Relax with Kneipp therapy

Waldenstein is known for Kneipp therapy. Hydrotherapy is central to this - a water cure that is good for body and mind. There's a small swimming pond at the campsite, where you can join the frogs for a dip. Or walk around on the barefoot path, a special experience that stimulates your senses.

properties.name: Camping Au Jardin près de l'Océan
Camping Liefrange
properties.description:
Camping Liefrange is on top of a hill in the west of Luxembourg, beside the stunning Upper-Sûre reservoir. The quiet and small campsite is laid out with an eye for detail. From your camping pitch, you can walk straight into the countryside or get on a stand-up paddleboard and take a trip on the water or go for a refreshing swim there. Besides the lovely pitches, you can spend the night in a gypsy wagon or a pod. A separate area has been reserved for motorhomes, and it also offers views of Luxembourg's rolling green hills. They serve tasty lunch dishes and snacks on the lovely patio.

Camping in the Luxembourg Ardennes

The route to Camping Liefrange takes you along good roads where you pass dreamy villages. Once you arrive at the campsite, the reception will give you all the info you need about your stay. Here, you can also order bread rolls for the following morning and buy local products such as homemade beer and toiletries.

Camping pitches and glamping accommodation

The site exudes calm. On some of the terraces, touring pitches alternate with fun accommodation with plenty of comfort, such as a tipi tent, a gypsy wagon, mobile homes, safari tents and spacious pods. The comfort pitches are slightly larger than the standard pitches and ideal for caravans. The toilet block looks neat and clean.

Delicious and honest food at the campsite

The small yet quality snack bar offers a wide range of tasty snacks, such as chips, sausages, croque monsieurs, sandwiches, salads and ice cream. The lovely patio is the centre point at the campsite and a food truck comes there regularly. You can get fresh potatoes, eggs, fruit, vegetables and apple juice from the local organic farmer's self-service vending machine.

properties.name: Camping Het Scholtemeijer
properties.description:
Camping Het Scholtemeijer is a small-scale farm campsite in the countryside of Overijssel, between Ommen and Hardenberg. The campsite is situated in the Vechtdal, in an area with vast meadows. You can camp on the well-kept campsite behind the farm, on spacious touring pitches or in the luxury safari tent. Everyone is welcome on the campsite, even horses. Stables are available.

Panoramic camping

The terrain of campsite Het Scholtemeijer lies behind the beautiful farm. On the well-kept lawns there is room for fifteen spacious touring pitches. The young plantation offers little shade, but on the other hand the wide view is not disturbed. From the touring pitches you look out over the vast meadows, which gives you a feeling of tranquillity and spaciousness. If you want a luxurious camping holiday, make a reservation for the very complete Woody Safari tent.

Camping with your horse

If you like a quiet camping holiday in your own country, then camping Het Scholtemeijer is the place to be. Young families and seniors in particular stay at the campsite. If you don't want to go on holiday without your horse, just take it with you to. There is a place not only for you, but also for your horse.

Goats and bunnies

Small children can enjoy camping at Het Scholtemeijer campsite together with mum and dad or grandma and grandpa. On the campsite there is a small playground with a trampoline, playhouse and swing. But the most interesting will probably be found in the animal meadow. Bunnies and goats are eager to be petted. A real hit with the youngest campers!

properties.name: Camping Le Moulin du Luech
properties.description:
Camping with the sound of a babbling river and chirping birds and enjoying the clear starry sky at night. If that appeals to you, it is a reality at Camping Le Moulin du Luech near Peyremale in the Cévennes! Here, you camp in an oasis of peace, in wooded surroundings. The reception is in the ruins of an old water mill. There, the friendly owner Jonathan family welcomes new campers.

Spacious pitches

This campsite only has a few dozen tourist camping pitches. They are separated by natural elements, giving you plenty of privacy. Most touring pitches have a good bit of shade. However, sunny pitches are also available.

Characterful accommodation with views of the stars

Campsite owner Jonathan is someone who really cares about the environment and his living environment. So he only hires accommodation that can be disassembled at the end of the season. This ensures the impact on the countryside is as low as possible. If you are looking for an unique experience, stay in one of the 'châtaignes'. These are safari tents with a transparent top so you can see the stars. Furthermore, you can book a stay in a charming wooden mobile home.

Countryside, meditation and yoga

You are in the right place here if you like nature activities and yoga. You can do gardening, pottery or make driftwood at the campsite. They also often have yoga and meditation workshops, for example. If you an expert in these areas, you could also give a workshop yourself. Furthermore, there are yoga weekends in September.

properties.name: Verwood New Forest C&C Club Site
Camping Santa Tecla
properties.description:
Camping Santa Tecla is situated within a protected nature reserve at the mouth of the Minho river. This river forms the border between Spain and the northern part of Portugal. You camp here on Spanish territory in the province of Galicia and 'across' from Portugal. The campsite derives its name from the Santa Tecla mountain. The campsite is located at the foot of the mountain. An amiable family campsite which is mainly frequented by senior citizens and families with preschool children in the low season. The campsite takes its young guests into consideration and has made a separate section of the camping grounds available to them.

Various camping pitches

There is a choice of various camping pitches which are all more or less the same size. Some have shade, some don't. The degree of privacy also differs. There are also pitches with and pitches without trees or bushes. 

Swimming pool and river

And after a day of exploring the area, isn't it wonderful to dive into the large swimming pool? When the sun is no longer at its zenith, that plunge in the pool is really refreshing. Afterwards, you can dry off on the sunbathing lawn next to the pool. The Minho river is also great fun. It is directly accessible via a pathway. The river is suitable for all kinds of watersports.

Excellent facilities

The facilities on the campsite are excellent. The restaurant prepares tasty meals. There is a playground for children and guests can kick a ball about on the sports field. The supermarket stocks a wide range of ingredients for your breakfast, lunch or camping dinner. The sanitary facilities are very good, with provisions for persons with limited mobility.

properties.name: Grotta del Saraceno
properties.description:
Grotta del Saraceno is a large Italian family campsite on the Adriatic coast. Because the campsite is situated higher you have beautiful views over the Adriatic Sea. The spacious campsite has a lively Italian atmosphere. Join in the Italian rhythm and enjoy a dip in the pool or a drink on one of the pavement cafés.

Spacious and shady

The campsite of Grotta del Saraceno is spacious. The pitches are laid out on several fields, so you don't have the idea that the campsite is very large. The 250 touring pitches and more than 120 rental units prove that it is: mainly mobile homes and bungalows. All the touring pitches are equipped with cloths to provide shade. There are also many trees that provide the necessary shady spots.

Camping by the Adriatic Sea

If you stand on a pitch on the sea side, on the edge of the cliff, you will enjoy a beautiful view over the Adriatic Sea. There's another advantage: the sounds of passing trains barely reaches these pitches. If you're standing a bit closer to the front of the terrain, you might be bothered by this sometimes.

Large swimming pool with sea view

A large round swimming pool and a paddling pool form the beautiful swimming area of the campsite. These outdoor pools are situated on a sun deck at the far end of the cliff. A gentle sea breeze cools down the plateau, where sun loungers and parasols are set up around the pools. Besides a refreshing dip you can enjoy the unobstructed view over the Adriatic Sea.

properties.name: ALL-on-SEA Camp und Sport Resort GmbH
properties.description:
Camp David Sport Resort is in the west of the German state of Saxony, close to the village of Rackwitz and about 15 kilometres north of Leipzig. The campsite is very popular among water sports fans and various nationalities. Here, you camp right by Schladitzer See, a recreational lake where people enjoy various water sports. From the campsite you can do things including sailing, canoeing, standup paddleboarding, surfing, swimming and have fun playing and climbing on the inflatable water playground. There are also plenty of options for sports and active enjoyment on land. Additionally, there is a restaurant, a beach club and a snack bar.

What accommodation options are there?

At Camp David Sport Resort touring pitches have been created at three spots, spread across the site. There are also two fields specially for campers with tents. As a camper, you can use the four well-maintained toilet blocks that are spread over the site. If you like a bit more comfort, you could opt for glamping. There are luxury holiday homes, lovely mobile homes and traditional yurts. You are welcome to bring your dog to Camp David Sport Resort. However, pets are not welcome in the mobile homes or yurts.

Enjoy a Spanish meal at Restaurant Levante

There are several eateries spread over the campsite. If you want an extensive dinner out, Restaurant Levante is the place to go. The menu has mainly Spanish dishes and tapas. There is also a lovely beach club by the beach volleyball field. The closest large supermarket is in Rackwitz (2.5 km).

properties.name: Camping Pod Brzozami
properties.description:
The Polish Camping Pod Brzozami is 300 metres from the Baltic Sea and a stone's throw from the centre of Ustronie Morskie. With spacious camping pitches, luxury apartments and a restaurant, this campsite is not lacking in comfort. The lovely surroundings, with a beach within walking distance and lovely cities in the vicinity, complete the camping experience.

Spacious camping pitches and neat apartments

At Camping Pod Brzozami, you find well-maintained camping pitches. The site, surrounded by trees, offers both sunny and shaded pitches. The amenities, such as electricity connections and drainage, are excellently arranged. If you don't have your own camping equipment, book an apartment, equipped with all home comforts.

Enjoy a delicious meal

This campsite is more than just a place to sleep. Go for a refreshing swim in the sea or join in one of the many activities organised by the entertainment team. You can eat a delicious meal in the restaurant, where they serve fresh, local dishes. Children can have fun in the water and at the playground. Meanwhile, you can relax with a book or join in with a game of volleyball.

Beach and stunning countryside

There is also plenty to see and do in the surrounding area. A short walk takes you to the beach. Cycle over the nearby cycle paths running through the picturesque countryside and along the coast. For a day out, the historic city of Kołobrzeg (14 km) and surrounding nature reserves are worth visiting.

properties.name: Domaine de Sery
properties.description:
Domaine de Séry is located on a quiet estate near an old abbey in northern France. The estate covers five hectares and is very green. The campsite is small, which is ideal if you like peace and nature! The abbey has a number of communal areas. Festivals and parties are organised there too sometimes as well.

Various cultural and active excursions are possible in the region. For example, the chalk cliffs of Le Tréport, various cycling and walking trips and castles like Château de Rambures.

Camping on green abbey estate

There are plenty of places on the estate for your tent, caravan or motor home. The pitches are all on the same open field but have some privacy because of the hedges that separate them. The various mobile homes are on a separate field, closer to the abbey.

Modest family campsite

Domaine de Séry is a modest campsite that is popular with campers who enjoy peace and quiet. But the campsite still has plenty of facilities for a comfortable stay! For example, a multi-sports field, a playground and an area where you can play various games. Challenge your neighbours to a game of boules, cast a rod in the fishing pond or take a dip in the swimming pool.

Discovery tours in the ‘glass valley’

The Musée du Verre is close to the campsite (3 km). Head there to learn all about glass blowing and the production of perfume bottles, the speciality of the valley. Explore the surrounding forests or follow the river Bresle on foot or by bike.

properties.name: Camping du Nizour
properties.description:
Do you like to holiday in quiet surroundings, far away from big cities and mass tourism? Then Camping du Nizour near Sireuil (Charente) is the ideal destination for you. This small campsite is located in woodland near the river Charente. It’s an excellent place to start wonderful cycling or boating trips through the varied surroundings, or for a visit to Angoulême a little further away. Of course, you could also just stay on your pitch and enjoy the peace and quiet.

Large pitches on a wooded site

This friendly family campsite is beautifully located in a small wood. So, most pitches have plenty of shade. The pitches are between 90 and 120 square metres and all have their own electricity connection. Water taps are usually nearby too. Want to stay in the clean outdoor air but with your own kitchen and bathroom? Then opt for a modern mobile home, chalet or holiday home, which can accommodate two to eight people.

Shop, snack bar and large outdoor pool

Have you just returned to your camping pitch feeling a bit tired after a nice walk? You’ll be pleased to know that the campsite has its own supermarket and snack bar. The snack bar is right next to the large outdoor swimming pool. It’s a great place to take a refreshing dip and swim some laps. The campsite also organises fun activities for the whole family in high season. For example, regular evening entertainment in July and August. Enjoy a themed meal, take part in a dance party and show off your singing skills at a karaoke evening!

properties.name: Le Bellevue
properties.description:
Welcome to Camping Le Bellevue in quiet Barzan, France. From your camping pitch, you’ll have views of the Gironde. You’ll camp in the heart of nature, close to charming Talmont-sur-Gironde (3.5 km): one of the most beautiful villages in France. And the beach at Meschers-sur-Gironde? It’s just 8 kilometres away. This makes Le Bellevue a great base for culture and peace-seekers.

Pitch or rental?

Prefer a pitch with your own tent, caravan or motor home? This is the place for you. The large pitches (70 to 80 m²) combine sun and shade. With or without electricity, whatever you need. Prefer more comfort? The mobile homes are fully equipped with a kitchen, bathroom, separate bedrooms and a private patio with garden furniture.

Everything you need for a relaxing camping holiday

Start the day with a refreshing dip in the heated pool. Afterwards, get a drink from the bar, or order something tasty from the snack menu (available from June to August). The kids? They’ll have a great time in the playground or with a game of table tennis. There’s plenty to do indoors too, with board games for young and old. Want to share your holiday photos? WI-fi is available throughout the campsite.

Discover Barzan

There’s plenty to do in the surrounding area. For example, visit the archaeological site of Gallo-Romain de Barzan (2 km) and learn about the Roman past. Or stroll through the narrow streets of Talmont-sur-Gironde (3.5 km) and see the church of Sainte-Radegonde.

properties.name: Chipping Norton Camping and Caravanning Club Site
Camping Village Costa Verde
properties.description:
Camping Village Costa Verde is located in the Italian seaside resort of Porto Potenza Picena, near the city of Macerata. Here you'll be camping on a quiet campsite, right on the Adriatic coast. The whole family can enjoy both the beach and the pool and go on scenic trips in the area.

A pleasant arrival

Camping Village Costa Verde is close to the motorway and is therefore easily accessible. You can get there in no time via the B-road along the coast. After a warm welcome at the reception, you can look for your camping pitch or rental accommodation. You can choose from a lodge tent, apartment or mobile home. The pitches are spread between the accommodations. The fifteen touring pitches and thirty accommodations make for a cosy campsite.

Swimming, playing and sports

With the Adriatic coast at your feet and a spacious outdoor pool with a waterslide, water lovers are sure to have a great time at this campsite. Relax on the beach with a good book while the children take part in the entertainment activities there. Fancy a sporting activity? Then you can play a game of beach volleyball!

When on dry land, children can enjoy themselves on the playground equipment or by taking in some of the fun entertainment shows. The entertainment is offered in Italian.

Campsite facilities

Camping Village Costa Verde offers fresh bread every morning in the Village Bar. With a mini supermarket and a restaurant/pizzeria, you will also have plenty to satisfy your nighttime cravings. There are two restaurants and a market nearby the campsite.

properties.name: Suze Luxe Nature
properties.description:
At Suze Luxe Nature campsite, you camp in a fairytale location, namely at the foot of a castle in the French Drôme. Here, you are surrounded by green forests and lavender fields. Take a dip in river Le Lez and enjoy the tranquillity of Suze-la-Rousse. Whether you are looking for tranquillity or adventure, you will find it all here.

Camping in the woods

This small-scale campsite offers intimate camping. Spacious pitches and rental accommodations. Will you choose a lodge, tent or cabin? They are all surrounded by nature and offer views of the church, the castle or a waterfall.

A special feature is the private spa in some accommodation. Of course, it doesn't get any better than having your own jacuzzi on your covered terrace!

Ultimate enjoyment

In the morning, get delicious fresh rolls from reception for your breakfast. Travelling with young campers? They are bound to have fun in the outdoor playground! Or romp together on the river banks. You can play here without worrying because the campsite is car-free.

In high season, relax by the pool. From your lounger, you can already see the campsite restaurant. After an afternoon of splashing around, sit down on the terrace and enjoy local dishes.

Rest or adventure?

This is the right address for an active holiday too! Rent bikes for the whole family on the campsite, choose the loveliest cycling route and explore the area. Put on your hiking boots and explore the Forêt de Saou. Or go on an exciting underground exploration, at Grotte de Rochecourbière.

properties.name: Terme Jezercica
properties.description:
Camping Terme Jezerčica is in the green north of Croatia, just above Zagreb. Here, you camp among the rolling hills of Hrvatsko Zagorje, right next to natural hot springs. Choose a camping pitch, mobile home or luxury cabin. The hot baths, aqua park and spa are always within walking distance. The Neanderthal Museum (33 km) and castles like Oršić (43 km) and Stubički Golubovec (2.8 km) are nearby too.

Camp in comfort

This campsite has everything you might need. You camp on large pitches with electricity, water and drainage. Want more luxury? Rent a mobile home with air conditioning and a private veranda. The campsite is next to the hotel, so it’s easy to use extra facilities like restaurants, saunas and swimming pools. All within easy reach.

Activities and relaxation

Eight pools filled with hot, 38-degree thermal water. That's Terme Jezerčica's aqua park. For children, there are slides and play areas. Adults seek tranquillity in the modern wellness centre with saunas, massages and relaxation rooms. Physiotherapists are on hand for relaxing treatments.

Visit castles and prehistory

Want to take a break from camping? Then visit the Krapina-Zagorje region. Here you can visit the Krapina Neanderthal Museum (33 km), a modern and interactive place to learn all about prehistoric man. The site of one of the largest Neanderthal excavations in Europe is right next door. Veliki Tabor Castle (38 km) is a little further away, high on a hill overlooking green hills.

Besides castles and museums, you’ll also find hot springs and quiet villages with traditional houses here. Visit a wellness centre and hot springs in Tuheljske Toplice (20 km).

properties.name: De Zeven Geitjes
properties.description:
Looking for a casual, cosy campsite? De Zeven Geitjes is located in the green heart of Antwerp, in the middle of the Herental and Vorselaar forests. Wake up to the sound of bird song, fresh forest air and views of the nature beyond. Whether you have a motor home, caravan or tent, you’ll camp on large, private pitches. The site is well laid out and child-friendly, making families feel right at home. Here, you will experience relaxation, personal contact and a friendly atmosphere. An ideal place for anyone who likes small, quiet campsites with all the mod cons.

Pitches on the edge of the forest

You can choose between different types of pitches at De Zeven Geitjes. Motor homes are parked on flat gravel pitches along the forest edge, while tents and caravans are on the grass with both sunny and shady spots. The green surroundings and wood-rich nature of the site create a natural and cosy feeling. Anyone wanting a little extra comfort can ask about rental accommodation or a pitch close to the toilet and washing facilities. Whatever you choose, you will always enjoy a relaxing stay with nature within walking distance.

Facilities for young and old

There’s a cosy bar with a terrace where you can go for a drink, a snack or an ice cream and look out over the campsite. Children will enjoy the playground, the goats and the refreshing water playground on hot days. When the weather’s less good, head to the indoor area where activities like dancing or music evenings are regularly organised. So, there’s always something to do.

properties.name: Camping Rives du Lac Sainte Croix
properties.description:
In the south of France, the Camping Rives du lac Sainte Croix campsite is located three hundred metres from the lake of the same name. You are here in the heart of the Verdon, the region known for its beautiful nature and Provençal specialities. There is a tremendous amount to do around the campsite and lake, from water sports to wine tastings. The nearest village of Bauduen is a five-minute drive away. Here, there is a market every Sunday in the summer.

Welcome!

Since 2024, Camping Rives du Lac Sainte Croix has merged with Camping Le Vieux Chêne. The grounds of the campsite are shaded. You'll find mostly pitches. All sites are equipped with electricity. It is also possible to rent a mobile home. These have two or three bedrooms, a refrigerator, a bathroom (with toilet and shower) and a spacious terrace on which to enjoy the outdoors.

Le lac de Sainte Croix

From the campsite, you have direct access to the Lake of Sainte Croix. There is plenty to do around the lake. Rent a pedal boat or go sailing or kayaking. But you can also go fishing or simply take a dip in the water. Furthermore, it's well worth taking a walk or bike ride around the lake. This can be done on a guided basis or on your own initiative.

The medieval village of Bauduen

In the village of Bauduen, a five-minute drive from the campsite, you can buy fresh baguettes and enjoy a revitalising cup of coffee or a delicious glass of wine overlooking the lake. In the summer, there is also a takeaway service at the campsite with fresh bread, croissants and muffins. The medieval village of Bauduen hosts a large Provençal market every Sunday in summer.

properties.name: Camping Le Mas d'Ayen
properties.description:
Set in the peaceful, green countryside of Limousin, the Le Mas d'Ayen campsite is an ideal destination for campers who love nature, space and relaxation. Surrounded by rolling hills, meadows and forests, the campsite has a friendly, rural atmosphere. Here, you can escape the crowds and enjoy outdoor life the French way: quiet, pure and casual.

Natural pitches and romantic accommodation

The campsite has large pitches for tents, caravans and motor homes. The pitches are green, well-maintained and very private. Thanks to the natural location, each pitch has a slightly different feel, often with a beautiful view of the surroundings. If you want to camp with a little extra comfort, choose a fully-equipped gîte or a romantic Bell tent. These are tastefully furnished and a great base for campers who want to combine outdoor life with convenience.

Swimming and Table d'Hôte

On hot days, you can cool off in the pool and you’ll find plenty of space all around it to relax in the sun. Cosy evenings with delicious meals are organised on a regular basis. The restaurant is located in the old cowshed and serves local dishes prepared with local produce.

Enjoy French life

The campsite's location makes it easy to explore the Limousin region. Nearby Ayen (2 km) is a charming village with historic streets and beautiful views. In July and August, there’s a weekly market here that sells delicious local produce. The residents of the village get together to eat and drink then. You’re welcome to join them!

properties.name: Camping Solau
properties.description:
If you are looking for peace and quiet and like to recharge in the countryside amid the mountains, then in this idyllic spot in the north of Spain, you camp at a small-scale campsite close to Aigüestortes i Estany de Sant Maurici National Park. This campsite attracts many walkers and nature lovers due to the beautiful setting at an altitude of 1,300 metres on the GR11 walking trail. The village of Espot is only a five minute walk, where there are some shops and restaurants. Will you be going camping in the Spanish Pyrenees?

Small-scale campsite with shaded pitches

After arriving at the campsite, you will be allocated a pitch on the camping ground. There are only 20 camping pitches so it is nice and quiet. The camping pitches are reasonably large and shaded. You see lots of campers with tents and hiker's tents. It's also fine for large motorhomes and caravans, but the pitch may feel somewhat cramped. You set yourself up on a grass surface and enjoy the shade of the trees.

If you don't bring your own camping equipment, you can hire one of the hotel rooms or apartments. Here, you spend the night in a clean room with wonderfully soft beds.

Charming, cosy campsite

You come here if you enjoy quiet, conviviality and stunning countryside. The operators have genuine attention for every camper and ensure they want for nothing. They are more than happy to help with tips and advice about the nearby national park and lovely walking and cycling routes.

properties.name: Domaine l'écrin vert
properties.description:
In the Midi-Pyrénées, on the banks of the river Tarn you’ll find Camping Domaine l'écrin vert. Located in the southern French town of Réquista, this campsite is a wonderful place for families who love peace and nature. Enjoy the forests, the river, the beautiful country roads and the various castles nearby. The campsite is well maintained and has a heated swimming pool.

At the reception you will be kindly welcomed and brought to your place. The pitches on this terraced campsite are well maintained and separated from each other. You can also rent a beautiful chalet, for which a separate part of the campsite has been set up.

Nature and tranquillity

If you like greenery and relaxation, Camping Domaine l'écrin vert is the place to be. From your pitch you'll have a wonderful view of the Tarn, an excellent spot for swimming, kayaking, fishing and even diving.

You can also enjoy nature on dry land. Read your favourite book on the river banks. Take a trip by car, rent a bike at the campsite or go for a walk. In this wooded area with beautiful country roads and beautiful views there is something for everyone. Because the campsite is small and quiet, relaxing on your own pitch is also nice.

Relaxing on the campsite

On the campsite you will not only enjoy peace and quiet, there are also various facilities available. The heated swimming pool, a playground with trampoline, a jeu-de-boules court and a library ensure that young and old can enjoy themselves. And with a cold drink the bar is a pleasant place to be.

properties.name: Camping La Baie du Mont Saint Michel
Camping Domaine les Rives de l'Oust
properties.description:
Would you like to camp at an authentic campsite, by a river and within walking distance from a charming city centre? Camping Domaine les Rives de l'Oust in France’s Brittany fulfils all of these desires. You stay in a hilly area with lots of cycle and walking tours. After a great day out in nature, you come back to the campsite and, in less than ten minutes, you walk to the shops and restaurants of the attractive city centre of Malestroit, one of the many lovely towns in the department of Morbihan.

Accommodation options: something for everyone

If you want to book at stay at Camping Domaine les Rives de l'Oust, you can choose a spacious pitch, a modern safari tent, a cozy mobile home or a luxury studio or holiday cottage. This campsite concentrates mainly on campsite visitors as tourists. Handy to keep in mind: there is full shade along the edges of the site, while the central section is open and sunny. Most of the pitches have a grassy surface, there is little demarcation and the pitches are spacious in size.

What is there to do at and around the campsite?

You camp here right next to the calmly flowing water of the Oust river. If you want to go swimming, go to the public swimming pool, less than a kilometre away from Camping Domaine les rives de l’Oust. This municipal indoor swimming pool has a large basic pool and a lovely paddling pool. The campsite itself has a few sports and play areas, a mini library, a breakfast service (during the high season) and two modern toilet and washing facilities.

properties.name: Slow Life Camping Venta del Moro
properties.description:
This small campsite is located near the Hoces del Cabriel Nature Reserve, which is characterised by gorges and steep rock walls. Slow Life Camping Venta del Moro is an ideal base from which to discover the surrounding nature. The small campsite offers a few camping pitches as well as a number of rental accommodations. But despite this mini campsite's small size, there is plenty to do for both young and old alike.

Small-scale camping in nature
