As the name suggests, you can completely relax and unwind in the Spanish nature at Slow Life Camping Veneta del Moro. The small-scale campsite has 14 rental accommodations, such as glamping tents without their own sanitary facilities. There are also log cabins with their own sanitary facilities and an outdoor kitchen. You can also spend your holiday on one of the 14 camping pitches using your own camping equipment.

Fun in the water

The campsite has a small outdoor swimming pool where you can cool off. There is also a municipal swimming pool 750 metres from the campsite. Pool parties with live music are organised there in the summer.

Hoces de Cabriel Nature Reserve

There's plenty for campers of all ages to do in the vicinity of the campsite. This includes quiet activities, such as a visit to a cheese dairy. You can also enjoy more active and adventurous outings, such as rafting, canyoning or a hike through nature. The protected Hoces de Cabriel Nature Reserve is just around the corner.

properties.name: Agricamp Poggio ai Pini Wine Camping
Seecamping Kleblach-Lind
properties.description:
Seecamping Kleblach-Lind is located by a wonderful recreational lake just outside of the village of Kleblach, central Upper Carinthia. Its favourable location makes it an ideal departure point for excursions to the most popular attractions of this part of Austria. Additionally, this area is ideal for practicing mountain sports and, of course, the hiking and cycling is great here. In the winter this region is very popular among winter sports enthusiasts. This new campsite is especially well-kept and simply exudes tranquillity. The campsite has its own grassy beach and swimming dock in the lake mentioned above.

Young campsite with an open character

After your arrival, it will quickly become clear that this is a new campsite. The reception and the main toilet block are modern and the vegetation on the site is still new. This means that most of the pitches are sunny by nature. Seecamping Kleblach-Lind also has options for glamping, because you can also book a stay in a luxury mobile home. These mobile homes, lovingly called Wood Cubes by the campsite, are suitable for a maximum of four holidaymakers.

Sports options, bistro and a wonderful little lake

Those who are natural water swimming enthusiasts are in the right place here because it is possible to walk right from your pitch to the recreational lake that belongs to the site. After a nice swim in the water, you can work on your tan on the grassy sunbathing area. A beach volleyball field and a table-tennis table ensure even more fun. Children can amuse themselves in the campsite’s two sand boxes. End your holiday day in the bistro, where you can enjoy a delicious dish.

properties.name: Camping Huttopia Lac de l'Uby - Gers
properties.description:
Relaxation is guaranteed at this neat, French family campsite on Lac de l'Uby. The campsite is located north of the Pyrenees, in the charming southwest region of France. The lakeside location is ideal for families who love nature, watersports and picturesque villages. At Huttopia Lac de l'Uby – Gers campsite, you can enjoy swimming in the beautiful outdoor swimming pool and in the lake. Explore the bucolic region on foot or by bicycle, as there are all kinds of nice routes in the area. In the summer there is theatre, a children's club and live music on the cosy terrace.

Space in nature

The campsite is located in a natural environment. The pitches come in different sizes. They have a flat surface and are surrounded by shrubs and plants to provide privacy. A number of camping pitches are located right on the water, providing you a beautiful view. In search of more luxury? Then spend the night in a trendy glamping tent, a beautiful wooden chalet or a cosy gypsy wagon.

Swimming fun

A real eye-catcher at the campsite is the outdoor swimming pool. The pool has a beautiful sun terrace with sun loungers, heated water, a paddling pool and a slide. You can also swim in the lake for a fee. The beach is within walking distance of the campsite (300 meters).

Home-made pizzas

You can enjoy good food at the restaurant, which features a cosy terrace. On the small menu you'll find dishes such as home-made pizzas and burgers. Fresh bread rolls are available each morning. Or let yourself be pampered and enjoy a complete breakfast at the bar.

properties.name: EuroParcs Reestervallei
properties.description:
EuroParcs Reestervallei, located in IJhorst on the border between Drenthe and Overijssel, guarantees a relaxing holiday surrounded by greenery. The park is located in the Reestdal, a nature reserve known for its heathland, vast forests and babbling brooks. Explore the natural surroundings, visit Slagharen amusement park or take a dip in the outdoor pool.

Spacious pitches and many types of accommodation

At EuroParcs Reestervallei, you have a choice of spacious pitches surrounded by well-maintained greenery. There are also several mobile homes and glamping tents you can rent. Ideal for families, those seeking peace and groups of friends who like a bit of comfort. There are different sizes of accommodation. The largest option is a villa that can accommodate as many as 23 people.

Facilities for young and old

In the park, you will find many facilities for a nice holiday. This includes an outdoor pool where you can take a refreshing dip on sunny days. For the youngest guests, there is an entertainment programme with varied activities during the holiday periods. Worked up an appetite? Then visit the snack bar or pizzeria with its spacious terrace. Here you can enjoy a delicious meal in the open air.

Explore the surrounding area

The area around EuroParcs Reestervallei has many excursions and activities. Visit National Park Weerribben-Wieden (33 km) for a day of hiking and cycling fun through marshes and forests. Or take a trip to Giethoorn (29 km), also called the 'Venice of the North' because of its many canals. WILDLANDS Adventure Zoo in Emmen (52 km) and Slagharen Amusement Park (22 km) are well worth a visit if you have children.

properties.name: De Noorde
properties.description:
If you like small-scale campsites in a quiet area, then Camping De Noorde in Overijssel is what you’re looking for. Settle down on one of the ten pitches, set up your tent on the tent field or choose a rental accommodation. Be sure to take your bicycle and hiking shoes with you to explore the surrounding rural area.

Small-scale and yet large

At Camping De Noorde you camp in rural surroundings with a view of the meadows. It is a small-scale campsite with 10 spacious pitches (100 m2) with electricity. There is also a separate tent field, where no caravans or motorhomes are allowed. If you prefer a little more comfort, book a safari tent (6 people) or one of the cabins (2 or 4 people). You can relax on your own terrace or play a game and cook yourself a delicious meal in your own kitchen.

Relaxation away from your pitch

If you would like to relax in surroundings other than your tent, trailer tent, caravan or motorhome, the old barn has been converted into a recreational area. You can show off your table tennis skills, prepare a delicious meal in the communal kitchen or relax in the lounge area with a cup of coffee.

Hanseatic cities and cycle routes

The central location of the campsite makes it easy to go on excursions to cities like Zwartsluis (2.2 km), Giethoorn (13 km), Kampen (28.5 km) or Zwolle (22 km). Mount your bicycle or put on your hiking boots and explore the surroundings. There are various hiking trails right next to the campsite, such as the Christoffelpad, the Jabikspaad and the Rietlandroute. And the Weerribben-Wieden National Park is not that far away.

properties.name: Camping Hoeve De Schaaf
properties.description:
The Hoeve De Schaaf campsite is located in the Limburg village of Heijen near Gennep and Boxmeer. You are not far from the German border – nice for a trip to our neighbours to the East! Because the campsite is located on the edge of the De Maasduinen National Park, you can be in the middle of nature in just a few steps.

Pitch with private sanitary facilities

The Hoeve De Schaaf campsite has annual pitches, seasonal pitches, and tourist pitches. In the tourist section, no fewer than 12 pitches are equipped with private sanitary facilities. You can also hang a hammock at various places. If you don’t have one, you can rent one at the reception. The pitches are well demarcated out and vary in size. The pitches at the edge of the forest are quite spacious.

Slide and splash

This is a family campsite – this is reflected in the visitors. In the high season, mainly young Dutch and German families spend on or several nights here. The off-season tends to attracts seniors. The pool is fun for everyone – young and old alike. This outdoor pool is located in the sun and features a long slide. The entertainment team provides fun activities for children in summer.

Enjoy a cool beverage in the sun

The restaurant at Hoeve De Schaaf campsite has a small menu. Pull up a chair for a tasty meal, or take a seat on the terrace for a cocktail in the sun! There is no supermarket at the campsite. However, there are supermarkets in the nearby Boxmeer and Gennep. The plumbing is well maintained and clean. Dogs are also welcome at the campsite. However, they must be kept on a lead.

properties.name: Forest Camping Mozirje
properties.description:
This campsite is an ideal place for those who prefer to spend their holidays in harmony with nature. Here you'll be camping on the Savinja River in the Slovenian Alps, in a wooded atmosphere with a view of the surrounding mountains. This is a great base for spectacular hikes and biking tours in the mountains. The surrounding area also offers plenty of mountain sports options, such as mountaineering, canyoning, rafting and kayaking. Forest Camping Mozirje is also an extremely environmentally conscious campsite.

Beautiful campsite integrated into nature

This campsite is beautifully integrated into nature. You'll find tourist camping pitches in a wide variety of shapes and sizes on the wooded grounds. Some of the pitches offer views of the surrounding mountains, while others overlook the surrounding countryside.

You can also rent a tent with mattresses and bedding at this campsite. In addition, there are five wooden holiday homes that can accommodate a maximum of three people per house.

Many relaxation options

There are excellent sports facilities, a small petting zoo and play equipment. There's also a campfire area for optimal relaxation. You can also enjoy paddling in the river from the nearby beach.

What's more, the campsite features water-saving eco showers.

Cooking with fellow campers

This campsite features a beautiful communal kitchen. The extensive facilities and the picnic tables set up next to them invite you to cook and socialise together.

You can also experience the rich culinary offerings of this region in restaurants, guest houses and (tourist) farms in the area.

properties.name: Camping Plitvice
properties.description:
Only three kilometres from the Plitvice Lakes National Park is the modern Plitvice campsite. This small camping destination is perfect for seekers of peace and quiet and nature lovers. A shuttle bus takes you to the Plitvice Lakes, where you can enjoy lovely walks. Once you get back, you can relax again. Take a dip in the pool while enjoying a beautiful view. Afterwards, why not sample some Croatian dishes in the restaurant.

Modern and high quality

The large reception building sets the tone for the rest of the campsite. It has a modern, sophisticated appearance. And you will be welcomed there with enthusiasm. And while you check in, the kids can play a game in the game room.

The odd one out

The Camping Plitvice campsite is a bit of an oddity. Among all the mega campsites in Croatia, this one is small and nice. With about thirty pitches, you'll enjoy plenty of peace and quiet here. The campsite is set up around a traffic circle, with a playground in the middle. The pitches are well looked after and are flat, despite the hilly terrain. Camping in luxury is possible in a modern mobile home.

Swimming and eating with a view

You will experience the most beautiful view of the green valley and the hills when you swim. At the edge of the campsite is the swimming pool. So take a refreshing dip and enjoy nature! Afterwards, you can continue to admire the view while you grab a bite to eat. In the restaurant next to the pool, you can taste the specialities of Croatian cuisine. Find a spot on the terrace and watch the sun set over the valley.

properties.name: Camping Ushuaïa Villages Domaine La  Roudelière
Naturcamping & Hafen Bermudadreieck
properties.description:
Naturcamping & Hafen Bermudadreieck is located in the middle of Mecklenburg's natural landscape, in a forest clearing and alongside the river Elde. It’s a beautiful place where you can enjoy your holiday in peace; there’s plenty to do there too.

Camp by the water

Tent campers can choose between a spot on the edge of the forest or the waterfront. Travelling with a caravan or motor home? Then you’re welcome on the large sunbathing meadow. There’s always a nice spot available if you come by bike or canoe - yes, you read that right. Boats are regularly moored on the 70-metre-long pier, which completes the campsite's relaxed atmosphere. The atmosphere is familiar and relaxed: no fixed pitches or crowds but freedom and nature.

Relax in the beer garden

The 'Bermuda Hafenbar’ is centrally located on the grassy field. Head there for coffee, ice cream, a drink and a small selection of dishes. The beer garden has deck chairs, a terrace and a campfire area. It’s a lovely place where community evenings are organised occasionally! For entertainment, rent canoes, bikes and various games. Or take a dip in the river. For relaxation, book a massage or the sauna hut.

Charming villages and beautiful nature

There’s plenty to do in the area around the campsite. Visit the medieval town of Plau am See (14.5 km) or the DDR museum in Malchow (26.5 km). Paddle across the River Elde and explore the surrounding forests on foot or by bike.

properties.name: Tisza White House
properties.description:
This mini campsite is located near Lake Tisza, Hungary's second largest lake, and the Tisza River. The campsite has camping pitches located between the fruit trees. Or you can stay in one of the rental accommodations. Cool off by taking a dip in the swimming pool.

Fully furnished caravan

This small-scale resort has seven camping pitches where you can stay with your own camping equipment. All pitches have electricity, and the toilet block is for communal use. Campers describe this building as clean and tidy. Don't have your own camping equipment? Then enjoy a holiday in one of the luxurious caravans or B&B rooms with private sanitary facilities.

Panoramic view

Camping Tisza White House is located on the edge of the village of Tiszaszőlős and overlooks green meadows. Here you'll be camping between the fruit trees and waking up to panoramic views. The campsite has a terrace, breakfast area and a saltwater swimming pool with sun beds. Each morning you can enjoy a fresh breakfast made from local ingredients.

Theme nights

The campsite owners regularly organise theme nights that all guests can attend. For example, they prepare traditional Hungarian stews or light the barbecue.

A bird watcher's paradise

There's plenty to do in the vicinity of Camping Tisza White House. You can enjoy watersports, fishing and swimming in the lake. The water is not very deep, and the lake has many small islands. Ideal if you want to canoe or pedal boat. There are many unique varieties of birds in the area, making the campsite an ideal base for bird watchers.

properties.name: Camping Opatija
properties.description:
Camping in an oasis of peace and quiet with sea views? You can at Camping Opatija! This hospitable terraced campsite is in the east of the Croatian region of Istria. You can walk straight to the town of Ičići from the campsite, where you can get a delicious meal and some entertainment. At the campsite, you feel at one with nature, as you camp under the many deciduous and conifer trees. There is a lovely playground for the little ones. And if you fancy a swim, just jump in the Adriatic Sea. The campsite is close to Učka Nature Park where you can take lovely walks and see exceptional flora and fauna.

Camping with sea views

Once you have arrived at Camping Opatija, its beautiful setting will catch your eye. The campsite is on slightly higher ground so the camping pitches are terraced. This means you will have big chance of having stunning sea views from your camping pitch.

You will be warmly welcomed by the receptionist at the reception. You can pick a camping pitch that best suits your wishes. Various pitches are available for tents, motorhomes and caravans.

Valhalla for those seeking peace and quiet

If you go camping to escape the masses and want to unwind in the countryside, this is the place for you! Indeed, there is no swimming pool, entertainment or other facilities at Camping Opatija. Here, you entertain yourself with a good book or a game of jeu de boules under the shade of the trees. A simple playground is available for small children.

properties.name: Domaine Les Filloux
properties.description:
This small-scale, charming campsite in the heart of France is a wonderful destination for peace seekers. Here you'll be staying in the rolling countryside northeast of the city of Limoges, with sweeping views from your camping pitch. Domaine Les Filloux is located in a region known for its majestic nature and beautiful hiking trails. It's easy to imagine you're in another world in the French countryside. There is a major focus on eco-conscious camping here. You can also enjoy a freshly prepared dinner or take part in a creative workshop in the art studio.

Surrounded by peace and nature

If you enjoy camping in a remarkable location, then this leisurely mini-campsite is really a sight to behold. The spacious pitches are surrounded by greenery and spread across the 1.5 hectare site. The sanitary facilities are located in the farmhouse and are very neat and clean. Prefer a bit more luxury? Then the furnished nature cottages are highly recommended. Domaine Les Filloux also offers a bed and breakfast.

Several nights a week, the owners prepare an exciting three-course menu with as many ingredients as possible from their own vegetable garden.

Art and relaxation

Feel like being creative? Then Domaine Les Filloux is the right place for you. Workshops are held in the studio. For optimal relaxation, there are plenty of corners on the premises where you can relax with a book, on a yoga mat or with meditation.

properties.name: Les Bois de Prayssac
properties.description:
Looking for a lovely quiet campsite by the Lot? At Les Bois de Prayssac, you stay in one of the lovely holiday homes, chalets or glamping tents. Here, you can enjoy the swimming pool, a fun playground and activities for children, and as the cherry on the cake, stunning views of River Lot and the valley. Explore Causses du Quercy Natural Regional Park and the picturesque villages and towns in the vicinity.

Holiday homes, chalets and glamping

You arrive at a small-scale and natural green holiday park with about 40 holiday homes, roughly 20 chalets and two lodge tents with toilet and washing facilities. The accommodation are equipped with all modern conveniences and nicely nestled amid the natural greenery with adequate privacy. From the hilly holiday park, you have stunning views of the countryside.

Everything well arranged

Here, you can let everything go and completely relax. That is thanks to the beautiful setting, but also because the enthusiastic owners have taken care of everything. The holiday homes and chalets are well-maintained and that applies to the playground, the swimming pool and the sports field too.

Swimming fun for everyone

The outdoor swimming pool, nicely amid the natural greenery, is a wonderful place. There is also a paddling pool for the little ones and sun loungers and parasols for relaxing.

Games, sports and entertainment

Lots of activities are organised in the summer period for all ages. From sports tournaments to fun evenings. And it's lovely and quiet again at the end of the evening. For the children, there are plenty of places to play together, such as the playground, the multi-sports field or the recreation room with a table football.

properties.name: Camping Les P'tites Maisons dans la Prairie
properties.description:
Bring your cowboy hat when you head to this western-style French campsite. You'll be staying in the Vendée department, which is one of the sunniest destinations in France. There is a lot to do and discover here. Les P'tites Maisons dans la Prairie Campsite is about a 20-minute drive from the beach and has a swimming pool that you can splash around in to cool off. All kinds of fun activities are organised for young and old alike. And heads up, animal lovers! There is a real animal farm on the campsite. Mount a horse like a real cowboy for an adventurous ride across the prairie!

Sleep in a beautiful accommodation

Guests at Les P'tites Maisons dans la Prairie Campsite stay in a rental accommodation. There is a wide selection of mobile homes, which can accommodate from 2 to 8 people. Each features its own terrace and TV. You can visit this family campsite all year round.

Cool off in the pool

The swimming pool is located at the centre of the campsite and is open from April to October. It is a heated and covered pool. Around the pool is a sunbathing area with sunbeds where you can relax and dive into a good book. Fancy a day at the beach? That's also an option. The Atlantic Ocean, with its numerous beaches, is about a 20-minute drive from the campsite.

Restaurant with bar

You don't have to leave the campsite for a tasty snack and drink. There is a restaurant and bar where you can choose from all kinds of tasty dishes, including fries and burgers.

properties.name: Castelwood
properties.description:
This small-scale leisure park located in the middle of the forest exclusively offers luxurious glamping accommodations. It is an oasis near the town of Biron, in the beautiful green surroundings of the French Dordogne. Families with young children who love peace and comfort will especially enjoy a wonderful holiday at Castelwood.

Charming villages where you can stroll through typical French markets are located nearby, as are beautiful caves and rivers. In the summer months, the entertainment programme at this child-friendly park includes fun games for the youngest guests. The swimming pool, trampoline and playground ensure they will have even more fun!

Glamping in the Dordogne

The beautiful wooden chalets and charming safari tents are playfully distributed across the site, surrounded by trees. All were made by the owner using ecologically sound construction methods and are neatly maintained.

Fresh sandwiches and fries

The smell of fresh bread rolls and croissants greets you each morning. There is a supermarket just a ten minute drive away. There is also a snack bar for fries, burgers and other treats.

Crafts and campfires

Children can participate in the craft afternoons, water balloon fights or a game of table football in the indoor area. Or they can enjoy themselves on the playground. And how about an evening by the campfire eating toasted marshmallows whilst enjoying guitar music?

Close to the Middle Ages

A walk to Biron Castle is a fun activity with children. The medieval commune of Monflanquin, which is located on a hill, is also highly recommended.

Or drive to Parc en Ciel, a professional climbing park for all ages.

properties.name: Recreatiepark De Markplas
properties.description:
Between the villages of Opheusden and Kesteren, centrally located in the Betuwe, lies Recreatiepark De Markplas. This playfully designed holiday park is surrounded by lush greenery, including several old fruit trees, characteristic of the Betuwe region. More than a third of the park consists of water, offering plenty of opportunities for swimming, boating, and fishing. Also good to know: this campsite observes the tradition of Sunday rest, meaning arrivals and departures are not possible on Sundays.

Spacious camping plots and luxury accommodations

This well-maintained recreational park features paved paths leading to the accommodations and spacious camping plots. The pitches are flat and have a grassy surface, with a paved area beside them to park your caravan or motorhome. You can also book a pitch with private sanitation. Prefer to stay in an accommodation? Choose from a luxury holiday home or safari tent (for two to eight people).

Swim in the lake or book an alpaca walk

Life on this campsite mainly revolves around the recreational lake. You can enjoy boating, stand-up paddleboarding, and fishing here year-round. On summer days, it's a great spot to take a refreshing swim. Looking for a special outing? Go for a walk with one of the alpacas that live on the campsite. Want to end your day with a nice meal? Just a five-minute walk away, you'll find Molen De Zwaluw, a modern restaurant where you can enjoy a delicious dinner.

properties.name: Freizeitpark Klaukenhof
properties.description:
In the German state of Noordrijn-Westfalen, near the town of Datteln, lies Freizeitpark Klaukenhof. You stay in a natural environment surrounded by hiking and cycling trails. This is an excellent place to explore the industrial culture of the Ruhr area. At Freizeitpark Klaukenhof, dogs are very welcome as guests, as proven by the presence of a dog shower. There is also a petting zoo, a playground and a restaurant.

Spacious pitches

Freizeitpark Klaukenhof is a spacious family campsite that is open all year round. You can pick out your own pitch on the camping field. There is a separate field for tent campsite visitors and specific motorhome pitches. Are you on a cycling holiday? Then you profit from extra services, such as a drying area for your cycling clothes, assistance with bicycle breakdowns and there is a parking place for your bicycle. If you don't bring your own camping equipment, you can also hire an apartment.

Animal paradise

Children enjoy themselves thoroughly at Freizeitpark Klaukenhof. There is a petting zoo with donkeys, goats, rabbits and other animals. It is great to start the day checking up on these animals and petting them. There is also a pasture for horses and ponies. Something unusual at the campsite is the apiary, giving you a look at the life of the honey bee.

Explore the Ruhr area and Münsterland

There are various lovely cycle routes in the immediate vicinity of the campsite. There is the Römer-Lipperoute, a lovely cycle route alongside the water, and the 1000 Kastelenroute, where you cycle from castle to castle through Münsterland. You can explore the beautiful surroundings on foot as well.

properties.name: Bernsteinreiter Barth
properties.description:
Bernsteinreiter Barth is a few kilometres outside the lovely fortified town of Barth. It is a large riding school where they offer numerous activities related to horse riding. You can spend the night on the terrace-like campsite, from where you have panoramic views of the surrounding area. At this campsite, you will mainly find families with children and then of course mainly people who are passionate about horse riding. Furthermore, this campsite is a few kilometres from the Baltic Sea and close to a lake.

Camping with a lovely view of the surrounding area

There are dozens of tourist camping pitches on the well-maintained campsite section. The pitches are generally spacious in size. You can also spend the night in a hikers' cabin or in a hostel on the site at Bernsteinreiter Barth.

Delicious dining in Hofküche & Hofcafé Barth

Hofküche & Hofcafé Barth is right next to the campsite. This restaurant mainly serves regional dishes. The handy thing is that you can also get a tasty breakfast or delicious lunch here. The campsite also has a small shop where you can buy the most basic necessities. The closest large supermarket is in Barth, less than a 10-minute drive from the campsite.

Valhalla for horse riding enthusiasts

Bernsteinreiter Barth is a place where horse riding enthusiasts will feel right at home. Numerous activities are organised whereby you take lovely group horse rides on a horse or pony. In any case, there are daily horse riding lessons for riders of every level.

properties.name: Strandbad & Camping Oderbruch am Baggersee Gusow
properties.description:
Strandbad & Camping Oderbruch am Baggersee Gusow is in the extreme east of Germany. You camp right by a lovely lake, with a private sandy beach where you can go swimming. It is a quiet and rural area close to the border with Poland. This region is known for its castles, lakes and forests. It is also a spectacular region for cyclists and walkers. The metropolitan of Berlin is only 75 km away, and you can easily get there by train. At this campsite, you are away from the hustle and bustle, as you stay amid the countryside where you can pick a lovely camping pitch.

Pick your own pitch

If you would like to experience the freedom of camping in the countryside, you are at the right place here! You can pick your own pitch, as big or small as you like. Some tent pitches are under tall trees. The campsite attracts many German families with young children. Anyone coming without a tent, motorhome or caravan can hire a basic caravan. The toilet and washing facilities are simple but neat and clean.

Cool down and have fun in the lake

The beautiful lake is a big plus for the campsite. This is more than ideal for families with children because the swimming water is safe. The lovely beach is surrounded by tress providing plenty of shade and part of the beach is designated as a nudist section. After swimming, you can get something refreshing to drink or something tasty to eat on the lovely patio at the campsite's snack bar. You can also have a bite to eat there in the evenings.

properties.name: Camping Le Petit Voilier
properties.description:
A lovely, peaceful campsite close to the centre of Saint-Briac-sur-Mer and just 600 metres from a picturesque bay. The rest of the unique emerald coast in this northern part of Brittany is also easily accessible when camping here. Hikers and cyclists will find beautiful routes through the natural beauty along the rugged coast and a green hinterland. Camping Le Petit Voilier is a great place for campers who appreciate simplicity and like to stay close to a lot of nature and culture. In the high season, fun activities are regularly organised for both young and old. There is a small shop and you can enjoy fresh rolls for breakfast.

Bay view

There are 60 neat touring pitches on the open grounds, both with and without electricity. They all offer shade to a greater or lesser extent. There is sufficient privacy thanks to the adequate space and the demarcation between pitches. Many pitches even offer a view of the bay. The sanitary facilities are neat and heated in the colder months. If you come without your own tent, camper or caravan, the furnished mobile homes are also a nice way to spend the night at Camping Le Petit Voilier.

Swimming in the sea

Being located directly by the sea is of course a major plus. You can choose from numerous beaches in the immediate vicinity. The entire coastal area is characterised by jagged and rocky landscapes. When you return the to campsite, you can grill a piece of meat or a fresh fish on the large communal barbecue. There is regularly a food truck that serves tasty pizzas, burgers and crêpes.

properties.name: Camping L'Etruyère
properties.description:
Do you enjoy peaceful camping on a small-scale campsite in the middle of nature? The small and lovely Camping L'Etruyère campsite is located in the French Vendeé. Here you'll be staying in a green oasis in an idyllic spot by a lake. In addition to camping pitches, the campsite also offers safari tents, chalets and a hiker's cabin. Enjoy a nice swim in the heated swimming pool with waterslide. There's a restaurant with a beautiful terrace where you can enjoy lunch or dinner. Do you like fishing? Then you can indulge yourself in the adjacent lake.

Small-scale camping

When you arrive at Camping L'Etruyère, you'll immediately notice the beautiful green location on the lake. The campsite has 16 camping pitches, all of which are spacious. There are plenty of shady spots thanks to the many trees. Do you want something more luxurious? Then rent a safari tent or chalet. The safari tent offers space for 6 people and is fully furnished.

The sanitary facilities are neat, tidy and well maintained. There are also baby changing facilities here. And sanitary facilities for disabled people.

Whoosh down the waterslide

The heated swimming pool is located at the front of the campsite. It features a fun waterslide that children can slide down. There's a separate paddling pool for the smallest campers. You can keep an eye on your children while enjoying the sun from the chairs and sun loungers next to the pool.

You cannot swim in the lake. However, you can explore the lake on a pedal boat or SUP board that you rent at the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Village Loisirs de Goule
properties.description:
Are you a real watersports enthusiast who enjoys going out on the water with a sailboat, catamaran or canoe? Or who even takes it to the next level by windsurfing or wing foiling in your free time? Then Camping Village Loisirs de Goule is the place for you! This campsite is located directly on the large Étang de Goule recreational lake. And this lake is located on the edge of the Cher department, in central France. In addition to numerous watersports activities, this sparsely populated and at times wooded area offers beautiful hiking and cycling routes.

Beautiful campsite integrated into nature

Camping Village Loisirs de Goule offers the feeling of real camping. The spacious touring pitches are beautifully integrated into nature. Hedges help provide some additional separation between the pitches. There are also different types of accommodations for rent on and right next to the campsite. These include lodge tents, chalets, hotel rooms and authentic tipi tents.

Plenty of sports, games and activities

There are a variety of recreational and sports facilities. You can play (table) tennis, mini golf and workout. Fun activities for guests of all ages are also regularly organised. For example, there are sailing competitions and archery lessons, as well as guided sailing lessons and adventure tours through the forest. There are also fun theme parties and small festivals on occasion.

Good food at La Terrasse

At the edge of the campsite you will find La Terrasse. This is a restaurant with a bar and a cosy terrace, which serves salads, sandwiches and meat dishes.

properties.name: Bel Air Village Les Demeures du Lac
properties.description:
Bel Air Village Les Demeures du Lac is located in atmospheric St Rémy-sur-Durolle in the Auvergne region. You will camp between green hills and Lac des Prades. With a lovely swimming pool, a playground and sports activities, there’s plenty to do for young and old. The beautiful nature around the campsite is ideal for walkers and cyclists. Attractions include the UNESCO World Heritage-listed Puy-de-Dôme volcano.

Chalets in green surroundings

The park has chalets that guarantee a wonderful holiday, suitable for 2 to 6 people. For a comfortable stay, choose a chalet with a covered patio, fully-equipped kitchen, bathroom and often a view of the lake or wooded area. You’ll wake up to a beautiful view every morning.

Plenty of facilities for young and old

The focus is on water fun: you can swim in the heated indoor pool. The park is also right next to the lake, which is ideal for swimming, fishing, canoeing, paddle boarding or relaxing by the water. For children, there’s a playground, mini-karts and an entertainment programme in high season. Sports lovers can play tennis or squash, rent bicycles or e-bikes and explore the area via walking and mountain bike trails.

Nature, tranquillity and local charm

The holiday park is located in the heart of the Parc naturel régional du Livradois Forez, a green region with forests, hills and a volcanic landscape. It’s the perfect base for beautiful walks and cycle rides. Fancy some culture? Then places like Thiers (10 km) and Vichy (41 km) are just a stone's throw away.

properties.name: Camping La Vaugelette
properties.description:
In a beautiful location, near the village of Montclar-sur-Gervanne (central Drôme), is Camping La Vaugelette. For nature lovers, this is an amazing location. The Vercors Regional Natural Park is nearby, while an idyllic stream flows across the wooded campsite itself. This neatly maintained campsite has a lovely outdoor swimming pool and an attractive restaurant. Good to know: everyone is welcome at this campsite, but the main target group is clearly motorcyclists.

What are the accommodation options?

The site offers a balanced mix of spacious pitches and comfortable accommodation. So you can sleep in an original tipi tent or gypsy caravan, or a modern mobile home or safari tent. There is also a large group accommodation for twelve people. If you come by motorbike, you can simply park it at your pitch or accommodation. Cars are parked in a central car park next to the campsite entrance.

A paradise for swimming enthusiasts

Camping La Vaugelette is a popular base for motorcyclists. Which is not surprising, because the Drôme is one of the loveliest regions of France for motorbike routes. Take a thrilling ride through impressive alpine landscapes, or take it easy riding on flat country roads. Tinkering with the tuning or making a minor repair on holiday? You can, because the campsite has a workshop with specialist tools that you can use for free. After a nice motorbike ride, sit down for a cool beer and a tasty meal in the welcoming campsite restaurant, which also sometimes hosts Argentine barbecue evenings.

properties.name: Camping Rouillères
properties.description:
A holiday on the beach in the middle of nature. Who wouldn't want that? On the Atlantic coast, Camping Les Rouillères offers you a fantastic place to spend your holiday. From swimming in the campsite swimming pool to splashing in the sea. In addition to swimming, there are many cycling options. You can be in La Tranche-sur-Mer (5 km) in fifteen minutes by bike.

Comfortable mobile homes

This campsite offers different types of mobile homes for rent. It does not offer camping pitches. The rental accommodations are suitable for two to six people. All accommodations feature a wooden terrace (covered or uncovered) with garden furniture.

Swimming pool or sandy beach

You and your family don't have to go far to cool down. Your children will have tons of fun in the campsite's waterpark, which features two swimming pools. The large swimming pool is semi-covered, and there's a paddling pool especially for small children. You can keep an eye on the kids from a comfortable lounger. They'll also have a blast sliding down the waterslide.

Had enough of the pool and fancy the sea? You can reach the beach via a paved path from the campsite. And you can be there in two minutes by bike. Ther's also a shuttle bus that takes you to the beach or La Tranche-sur-Mer.

Burgers, pizzas and more

Everyone's sure to be hungry after a day full of activities or lazing around. Don't feel like cooking? You don't have to go far for a night out for dinner. Head to the campsite's snack zone for burgers, pizzas and other snacks.

properties.name: Camping La Clairière
properties.description:
Camping peacefully and with respect for nature in one of France's most popular regions, that is possible at this small-scale, ecological campsite. You will experience an oasis of calm in a wide pool and great activities such as yoga and pilates, you can completely unwind at Camping La Clairière. The communal dinners make for great encounters with other campers.

Playful and green grounds

With only 34 pitches and 14 rental accommodations, the campsite is charming and small-scale. The site is playfully designed with all round shapes. The pitches lie in the sun or in the shade of trees and are delimited by natural planting. The rental chalets, caravans, tents and hiker's huts are spread throughout the forest. The pitches are not visible from the access road. So you have complete freedom. The site is managed ecologically and is car-free, so even the little ones can run and cycle around safely.

Meeting each other in nature

The atmosphere at La Clairière is friendly and welcoming. Respect for each other and for nature goes without saying here. Electricity is generated green, cleaning is done with environmentally friendly products and the bedding is made of organic cotton. The love of nature is shared by the guests who come here. People visit the campsite for the peace and quiet, but also for the contact with other guests during the fun activities or meals you can join.

properties.name: Camping Résidentiel La Pinède
properties.description:
Camping Résidentiel La Pinède is in a central location in the Hérault, in the Southern French region of Occitania. This holiday park is in a lovely pine forest and is surrounded by slopes that are optimally exploited for viticulture. Furthermore, here you stay near the charming village of Castelnau-de-Guers and close to tourist sites such as Pézenas, Marseillan-Plage and Cap d’Agde. At La Pinède itself, you will find a lovely aqua park, many sports facilities and an excellent restaurant, among other things.

Choose from a wide variety of mobile homes

At Camping Résidentiel La Pinède you can only book a stay in a mobile home. Mobile homes are available for two to six people. At this site in a forested location, you benefit from plenty of shade in most mobile homes.

Unique leisure pool with lovely infinity pool

In the middle of the site at Camping Résidentiel La Pinède, you will find a lovely swimming pool that is only open to guests of the holiday park. It is a terrace-like landscaped aqua park consisting of a hot tub, a paddling pool and two large swimming pools. The swimming water is heated to 30 degrees throughout the season.

Visitors can't get enough of the pools, particularly the upper level outdoor pool. This is a veritable infinity pool, where the water level is level with the edge of the swimming pool.

Enjoy regional specialities in l’Orangerie

There is a themed evening twice a week in the high season at l’Orangerie. Then they serve a delicious paella or a portion of mussels with chips, for example. These are sometimes combined with a wine tasting and/or live music.

properties.name: Schaalsee-Camp
properties.description:
Schaalsee-Camp is a small campsite in the Lauenburg lake district in northern Germany. The terrain is idyllic and peaceful. All pitches are beautifully situated in the woods. With the many routes laid out in the area, it is also perfect for hiking and cycling enthusiasts. If you'd like to go on a canoe adventure, various canoe trips leave from the campsite’s own canoe and SUP station. The nearby lake is a great place to swim.

Fun together around the campfire

This basic campsite only has touring pitches, teepee tents and covered wagons. As a rule, a pitch in the woods is somewhat smaller than a pitch by the water. Do take a citronella candle with you to keep any mosquitos at bay. At 22.00, complete silence descends. Until that time, you can enjoy an informal and fun evening outdoors at the campfire location.

Out and about with the canoe

Water lovers will soon feel right at home here because of its location between the Schaalsee and the Salmersee. You can go on a canoe trip for one or more days on these lakes. Such an extraordinary excursion is easy to book at the campsite. Small groups leave from the jetty and fun information about the surrounding area is given while canoeing. If you would like to go swimming or rent an SUP, you can do that in one of the lakes, too.

Excursions by bicycle or on foot

Wooded areas and water largely dominate the landscape, making it a beautiful area for hiking and bicycle rides. You can find village charm in Ratzeburg or Mölln. Hanzestad Lübeck is only 30 kilometres away.

properties.name: Barracuda Beach Camping am See
properties.description:
Barracuda Beach Camping am See is a well-maintained campsite in the German Mecklenburg-Vorpommern. It is an area with beautiful countryside, endless walking and cycling routes, picturesque towns and cities and many historic attractions. At Barracuda Beach Camping am See, you stay at a lovely location right by a reasonably large lake, the Neustädter See. It's a lovely place for swimming. The friendly beach bar, the spacious camping pitches and the relaxed atmosphere make this a wonderful destination for families. From the campsite, you can get to the centre of Neustadt-Glewe in no time and there are several lovely towns you can visit at a short cycling or driving distance.

Camping by the water

Camping close to the water transports you to another world. There are several pitches that look out over the lake. There are various fields a little further away from the lake. All camping pitches are open without demarcation. There is enough shade if you'd rather be sheltered. The neat and clean toilet and washing facilities stand out.

White sandy beach with lively beach bar

Barracuda Beach Camping am See's main attraction is the swimming lake with lovely adjacent patio. It's ideal for families with children. There is a sandy beach that is freely accessible to campers. With the white sand and wonderfully furnished beach bar, it even has a bit of a tropical vibe. There is a large beach volleyball field beside the clean beach. Those who like to be active on the water can get in a pedal boat or on a standup paddleboard that you can hire at the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Kohlhofmühl
properties.description:
Camping Kohlhofmühl is by the town of Pernitz, in the south of the Austrian state of Lower Austria. Here, you camp on a quiet spot close to River Piesting, in the heart of the Piesting Valley. A forested landscape surrounds this valley. You can enjoy a wonderful view of the surrounding mountains from your pitch. Those seeking peace and quiet and nature lovers feel at home in this unspoiled part of Austria and at this campsite. That also applies to fanatic walkers, mountain bikers and climbers.

Spacious camping pitches with lovely views

It's good to know that this campsite basically consists of three parts. First, there is a neat field with spacious camping pitches for guests coming with a caravan or motorhome. Furthermore, there is a special tent camping filed and finally, a field with seasonal pitches. You enjoy beautiful views of the mountains from every pitch at Camping Kohlhofmühl. You have free WiFi everywhere.

Have a tasty meal at Wirtshaus in der Kohlhofmühl.

When you stay at this campsite, you don't have to walk far to go out to dinner in the evening. The restaurant Wirtshaus in der Kohlhofmühl is by reception. Keep your eyes on the opening hours, because the restaurant is sometimes closed and on certain days, you can only go there around lunchtime. The menu mainly comprises local specialities. You can find supermarkets and shops in the centre of the village of Pernitz, which is about 15 minutes' walk from the campsite.

properties.name: Hafencamp Senftenberger See
properties.description:
Hafencamp Senftenberger See is just outside the village of Großkoschen, in the Lusatian Lake District in the east of Germany (state of Brandenburg). This campsite is in a forest on the banks of Lake Senftenberg. You are at the right address if you are a water sports enthusiast. The alternating landscapes of Lusatia are wonderful for cycling. This campsite is part of the larger Familienpark Senftenberger See that is right next door. Hafencamp is mainly aimed at holidaymakers coming with a motorhome.

Camping pitches with lake or forest views

At this campsite, new guests are welcomed in the campsite's main building. Hafencamp Senftenberger See's neatly maintained site, the space is mainly used for paved motorhome pitches. Some of these pitches offer views of the lake, while others have forest views.

Furthermore, you can book a stay in a charming hiker's cabin or an efficiently furnished mobile home. If you are looking for an unique holiday experience, book an overnight stay in one of the beautiful tree houses.

What can you do on and around Lake Senftenberg?

For water sports fans, this campsite is an excellent holiday address. This campsite has its own marina. You can sail straight on to Lake Senftenberg from there. Around Lake Senftenberg, you can, for example, hire a speed boat, sailing boat, raft, pedal boat, kayak or standup paddleboard. Furthermore, there are a number of sandy beaches around the lake, so that you can also go for a lovely swim in the water on summer days.

properties.name: Parque de Campismo Rural Lapa dos Gaivões
Camping Zomerzicht
properties.description:
Welcome to Camping Zomerzicht, a small-scale campsite in the green countryside of Drenthe, close to Assen. Here you can camp in peace and quiet, surrounded by nature and just a stone’s throw from the Baggelhuizerplas recreational lake (0.2 km). Thanks to its location next to woods, water and cycle routes, this is a lovely place to unwind. And yet, you can also cycle to the centre of Assen in just 15 minutes, making it ideal for a day out.

Camping in green surroundings

Camping Zomerzicht has around 25 spacious pitches spread across two campervan fields and a separate tent field. You can pitch your tent, park your caravan or motorhome on a spot either in the sun or in the shade. Every pitch has electricity, and there are drinking water points in the motorhome field.

Peace and quiet, and practical amenities

This campsite is aimed primarily at campers who appreciate simplicity and peace and quiet. There is no swimming pool, restaurant or campsite shop, but you will find modern sanitary facilities with separate shower and toilet blocks, including facilities for disabled guests. There is also a covered washing-up area and free Wi-Fi. For added convenience, there is a covered bike shed with a charging point for e-bikes, ideal for trips through Drenthe.

Excursions to Drenthe

Right next to the campsite lies the Baggelhuizerplas, with a sandy beach, play equipment and opportunities for swimming, walking or relaxing by the water. In Assen (3 km), you can visit the Drents Museum or stroll through the shops and past the outdoor cafés. The TT race track is also nearby (6 km). For a day trip, Wildlands Adventure Zoo in Emmen (45 km) and the city of Groningen (30 km) are easily accessible.

properties.name: Camping Le Bourgogne
properties.description:
Camping Le Bourgogne, located on River Yonne and at 500 metres from the centre of Villeneuve-sur-Yonne, offers rural and historic surroundings in the French department of Burgundy. With nearby cities such as Villeneuve-sur-Yonne and Sens, rich in historic architecture such as cathedrals and timber-framed houses, the campsite is an ideal starting point for exploring the region.

Camping on spacious pitches

The campsite, with a new owner and undergoing renovations, offers 50 touring pitches in natural green surroundings, with an average size of 125 m², including some motorhome pitches. For those without their own camping equipment, there are mobile homes for up to six people and Coco Sweet tents available. Pets are also welcome.

Swimming in River Yonne

Although the campsite is simple without entertainment or a swimming pool, River Yonne offers refreshment and options for water sports such as canoeing, stand-up paddleboarding, rowing and sailing. A supervised beach in the summer makes it ideal for swimming.

Discover Villeneuve-sur-Yonne and Sens

The historic centre of Villeneuve-sur-Yonne, with shops, restaurants and remarkable architecture such as the cathedral of Notre Dame, is within walking distance. A train station near the campsite offers easy access to the larger city of Sens (17 km), famous for its Gothic cathedral Saint-Etienne.

Countryside and wine tasting

The area is perfect for cycling and walking trips, with a cycle path along the Yonne. Wine lovers can visit the Chablis vineyards (61.5 km) to taste local wines and learn more about wine growing.

properties.name: Camping l'Orée du Bois by Noricamp
Agricamp San Pio X Farm Since 1708
Camping Nasza Dolina
properties.description:
Camping Nasza Dolina is at the edge of the Poland’s Ojców National Park, in the village of Sułoszowa and on the banks of a small stream. This is a new campsite for which the enthusiastic owners have many plans. The grounds are quiet, well-kept, and the campsite is ideal as a starting point for hiking and cycling trips through the Kraków-Częstochowa Upland nature reserve.

Original campsite with panoramic view

Camping Nasza Dolina is a unique campsite that focuses on tourist campsite visitors with their own camping equipment. Leaving the main road, you cross a bridge to enter the level camping site. Paved paths take you to the neatly kept touring pitches. At the campsite your pitch is grassy with a beautiful panoramic view of the surrounding hills. Here and there the pitches are separated by young trees.

Which amenities will you find at this campsite?

The toilet facilities were new in 2019 with a minor renovation in 2023. This modern toilet block includes toilets, basins and shower stalls, where you can enjoy shower water that can reach 42 degrees. Next to the toilet facilities is a small, round wading pool that is used often. Camping Nasza Dolina also has its own snack bar with several delicacies.

Explore the surrounding area

This campsite is a good home base for excursions to Kraków (30 km) and the Auschwitz-Birkenau State Museum (60 km). There are also great hiking and cycle routes to follow in the area. Go, for example, to the Kraków-Częstochowa Highland, which borders against Sułoszowa.

properties.name: Ferienpark Thüringer Wald
properties.description:
Back-to-basics camping among the wooded areas of the German Thüringerwoud or Thuringian Forest can be done at Ferienpark Thüringer Wald. It has simple wooden huts, apartments and various types of group accommodation for rent. You can also bring your own camping equipment. The campsite is a good point of departure to go out into the surrounding countryside.

Green area with woods and hills

Ferienpark Thüringer Wald is a simple park with rental accommodations (primarily wooden huts) and touring pitches. Your accommodation or pitch allows you a view over the wooded areas and the green hills. It is ideal for those who love peace and quiet as well as nature!

Fun around the campfire

There is an open-air stage in the woods where performances are held occasionally. It is also possible to play beach volleyball, football and table tennis here. Cooling off on hot days can be done in the swimming pond. Kids will also have the time of their lives in the playground. The campfire location, where people gather around the fire, guarantees cosy evenings.

Explore Thüringerwoud

If you visit Ferienpark Thüringer Wald, be sure to remember your hiking boots or bicycle! This is an ideal location for exploring the beauty of nature with plenty of hiking and cycle routes from which to choose.

The city of Sonneberg (18.5 km) is known as world toy city because it was the centre of the toy industry and trade before the Second World War. Another fun city is Coburg (24.5 km), with its charming squares, beautiful buildings and castles.

properties.name: Camping Maslina
properties.description:
Camping Maslina, located in Buljarica at 2 km from Petrovac, is a green paradise on the coast of Montenegro. The campsite is located amid lush natural greenery, where old olive trees throw shade over the open camping grounds. It is an ideal destination for campers who like to be in nature, love the beach and to stay within walking distance of shops and restaurants.

Choose your own pitch

This family friendly campsite welcomes campers from cross Europe with open arms throughout the year, making it a unique destination for adventures in any season. The campsite has about 100-120 pitches and you can pick your own spot. While parents enjoy the peace at their pitch, the children have the freedom to run and around and play in the playground without a care.

Direct access to the sea

An exceptional feature of Camping Maslina is the direct access to the azure blue sea. A footpath of about 150 metres takes you from the campsite to the beautiful beach. Here, you can fill days with refreshing swims and relaxing sunbathing at only a stone's throw from where you are camping.

Food, drinks and shopping

Camping Maslina not only offers an idyllic setting but also convenience and liveliness. A neighbourhood supermarket ensures you will want for nothing, while the nearby restaurant on the beach is an excellent place to try local dishes. Furthermore, there are good shops and restaurants within walking distance, making it easy to discover the local culture.

properties.name: Base Camp Medvedin
properties.description:
At Base Camp Medvedin in the Czech Špindlerův Mlýn, you camp in a breathtaking location at the foot of the mountain and ski slope of Medvědín. Summer or winter: here, you experience the countryside in a unique way. Here, you are at an altitude of 750 metres in the Giant Mountains, the highest mountain range in Central Europe north of the Alps. Enjoy a holiday in comfortable accommodation or set up your tent or caravan on a lovely spot between the trees.

For nature lovers and active holidaymakers

An enthusiastic team of nature lovers is ready to provide you with an unforgettable holiday. From adventurous tent campers to glamping lovers and everything in between, the breathtaking countryside is what unites at this campsite. Seek refreshment in River Elbe, relax on a hammock or make your own camp fire. You can also order fresh bread rolls for with breakfast or sausages for by the camp fire.

Walk to Špindlerův Mlýn

This campsite is an ideal base for walkers and mountain bike riders; various routes of various levels start in the vicinity. You can also walk to the famous mountain town of Špindlerův Mlýn. Here, you enjoy local cuisine and sample a typical Czech beer, brewed according to ancient traditions. In the town, you will also find the Na Pláni cable car, the LEGO Museum and an indoor aqua park.

Out in the countryside together

The location between rivers, waterfalls, meadows, valleys and mountain peaks means there are endless adventurous options around the campsite. Skiing, sledging, paragliding, horse riding, hiking and cycling are just the tip of the iceberg.

properties.name: Purple Eye Estate - Camp and Winery Jokas
Camping Costabella
properties.description:
Camping Costabella is situated in a peaceful, green setting in Località Gea, near the seaside resort of Deiva Marina in Liguria. Here, you can camp close to the famous Cinque Terre, making it easy to combine culture, nature and the sea. The surrounding area is hilly and covered in pine trees, and the camping pitches are on a terraced layout with views of the sea or the wooded slopes.

Camping with a view

There are pitches of various sizes for tents, caravans and motorhomes, as well as rental accommodation (apartments and bungalows). The pitches are spread across terraced levels, mostly in the shade or partial shade, and are separated by low hedges. Some pitches are a bit narrower or less suitable if you need plenty of space or have a large caravan.

Basic comfort with a smile

Visitors appreciate the friendly welcome and the relaxed atmosphere at the campsite in particular. Wi-Fi is available across much of the site and children can enjoy themselves in the playground. Within a short walking distance (approx. 300 metres) you’ll find a pizzeria/restaurant and a small supermarket for daily shopping. Camping Costabella is especially popular with families and those seeking some peace and quiet and who enjoy a natural setting and a friendly camping experience.

Cinque Terre around the corner

The campsite is three kilometres from Deiva Marina beach. The town of Deiva Marina itself is also the same distance away, offering amenities such as shops and restaurants. Thanks to a free shuttle service (in summer) to the nearest train station, the campsite is also a good starting point for train journeys to the Cinque Terre (38 km). Furthermore, Portofino (48 km) and Genoa (68 km) are easily accessible for a day trip.

properties.name: EuroParcs Bad Hulckesteijn
properties.description:
If you are looking for a holiday filled with relaxation and water sports, EuroParcs Bad Hulckesteijn offers an ideal combination of rest and activity. Located centrally in the neighbourhood of the charming city of Nijkerk (6 km), this holiday park is an excellent home base for exploring this part of the Netherlands. You will have an unforgettable holiday here.

Wide choice of accommodations

This beautiful, well-organised holiday park offers more than twenty types of accommodations. This means that all you need to do is choose the perfect ‘cube’, tiny house or villa. EuroParcs Bad Hulckesteijn is beautifully situated on the water. Do keep in mind that this means there will be mosquitos in the summer.

Water fun every day

Situated right next to the Nijkerkernauw lake, EuroParcs Bad Hulckesteijn is a paradise for water sports enthusiasts, with options from sailing to standup paddleboarding – the possibilities are endless. If it rains or you are looking for some shelter, the park has a modern indoor swimming pool (not supervised) where you can go for a refreshing swim. Relaxation can be found in the wellness facilities, equipped with an infrared booth and sauna.

Something for everyone

During your stay, there is plenty for young and old to do. While the entertainment team keeps the children busy during the school holidays, you can enjoy yourself in the well-equipped health club.

And then it is already time to close the day together. Will you be cooking the shopping purchased from the mini market or would you rather eat out? Brasserie De Vuurtoren is happy to welcome you. Its main focus is sustainability and local ingredients. Enjoy sustainable fish and organic local products.

properties.name: EuroParcs Bad MeerSee
properties.description:
EuroParcs Bad MeerSee is located in a great spot on the coast of Zeeland, near the village of Nieuwvliet in Zeeuws-Vlaanderen. You will stay in a luxury holiday home. The beaches and special nature reserves are both close by. Leave your car behind and set off on your bike.

Spacious and modern accommodation

You’ll notice that the park is small straight away. No crowds but plenty of space and a relaxed atmosphere. You’ll stay in modern, bright holiday homes with a large garden. Perfect for a quiet breakfast in the morning or to sit outside of at the end of the day. Travelling with your dog? Not a problem. Pet-friendly accommodation is available. You can be on Nieuwvliet beach by car in just five minutes.

Quiet atmosphere

The focus is on tranquillity at EuroParcs Bad MeerSee. There are a limited number of facilities. If you don't fancy cooking, it's easy to order a barbecue or gourmet package and equipment at the park. You can also rent (regular) bikes for an enjoyable ride through the Zeeland countryside.

Discover Zeeland

The surroundings invite you to get out and about. Walk through Het Verdronken Zwarte Polder nature reserve or stop for a while at the wide beach at Nieuwvliet, known for its clean sand and peaceful atmosphere. For a day out, Deltapark Neeltje Jans (86 km) is fun for young and old. Explore the region by bike and ride along dikes and through places like Breskens (9.5 km) and Sluis (10.5 km).

properties.name: EuroParcs De Biesbosch
properties.description:
EuroParcs De Biesbosch is on the outskirts of Dordrecht, right next to the Hollands Diep river. You overlook the water, watching ships pass by peacefully on their way to cities like Rotterdam and Antwerp. The holiday park has rental accommodations and several amenities: swimming pools, a playground and a brasserie. The vicinity also contains De Biesbosch National Park (10 km), Breda (25 km) and Rotterdam (29 km).

Stay just a stone’s throw away from the water

At EuroParcs De Biesbosch you can choose from various accommodations, including tiny houses and chalets. The holiday park has a marina where you can rent a mooring.

Having both an indoor and an outdoor swimming pool, a refreshing swim is always possible. For children there is a playground and entertainment programmes. If you like to stay active while on holiday, use the athletic fields or rent a bicycle to explore the surrounding area. For a delicious meal, visit the brasserie or the snack bar.

Explore Biesbosch and surrounding area

A visit to De Biesbosch National Park (10 km), known for its creeks, willow and islands, is naturally a part of this. Go on a boat trip, wander through the osiers or see if you can find the beavers. For a fun day shopping, cities like Dordrecht (14 km), Rotterdam (29 km) and Breda (25 km) are a short drive away.

properties.name: EuroParcs Texel
properties.description:
EuroParcs Texel is located on the largest Wadden Island Texel. The sea and nature is never far away on this popular holiday island. EuroParcs Texel is located centrally on the island, making it easy to reach everything. Fifteen minutes on your bicycle will take you to the village of De Koog on the vast sandy beach. The boat to Den Helder is a fifteen-minute drive from the holiday park.

Stay in a luxury chalet or dune villa

At EuroParcs Texel you stay in one of the luxury accommodations distributed throughout the park. Choose from two types of accommodation: a chalet for a maximum of four people or a dune villa. The latter is a detached house with a hot tub in the garden. Both types of accommodation have their own terrace, air conditioning, private toilet and washing facilities and a luxury kitchen with induction hob.

Bicycle rental and having fun

EuroParcs Texel is surrounded by meadows. Several cycle routes leave the park towards different sides of the island – perfect for exploring the island by bicycle. If you did not take your own bicycle along, you can rent one at the reception. Children can have the time of their lives in the playground on the air trampoline, on the football field or at the table-tennis table.

Spotting seals on Texel

Texel is an ideal holiday destination for hikers and cyclists. Along the way you go through beautiful nature areas, the dune area and, of course, the beach is always close by. Going out on the sea is a fun excursion. Go seal hunting, climb on board a shrimp fishing boat or take a trip on an authentic sailing ship.

properties.name: EuroParcs De IJssel Eilanden
properties.description:
Note to water sports enthusiasts! This is undoubtedly one of the most water-rich holiday parks in the Netherlands. Because EuroParcs De IJssel Eilanden is located right on the Reevemeer and near the Drontermeer, the Ketelmeer, the mouth of the IJssel and the IJsselmeer. In the park itself, you will find a large marina and numerous canals, all of which are connected with the lock to the Reevemer. So do you want to enjoy sailing, supping, canoeing or swimming on holiday? This is an ideal base.

Luxury holiday homes with private jetty

There are only rental accommodations at this holiday park. Stay overnight in a modern chalet or a luxury holiday home for 4 to 12 people. Many of the accommodations have their own jetty on the water. It is also worth noting that this resort is still under development, so renovation work may take place.

Wide range of sports, games and entertainment

Many guests stay at this park for the water sports. However, there is also plenty to do 'on dry land', especially for children aged 4 to 12. During the school holidays, for example, there is entertainment at six days a week. Activities such as sports competitions, shows and creative craft hours are just some of things on the varied programme. In addition, the park has its own indoor and outdoor playground, a panna field, a bouncy castle and a small petting zoo with goats, sheep and rabbits. Fun for the family is the life-size Foot Pool, a combination of football and billiards. End the day at the atmospheric park restaurant Friends 'n Bites or get your own groceries at the self-service supermarket.

properties.name: EuroParcs IJsselmeer
properties.description:
Modern cottages right on the water’s edge, with only a dyke separating them from the IJsselmeer. Welcome to EuroParcs IJsselmeer in Medemblik! Everything at this holiday park revolves around water. You can hire a boat at the park and cast a line from your own jetty. You can also enjoy some time in the water at the indoor swimming pool with a slide, and within just a few minutes’ walk you’ll be at the sandy beach on the Ijsselmeer.

Luxury waterfront villas

When you visit EuroParcs IJsselmeer, you’ll stay in one of the luxury cottages. There’s a special villa suitable for families with young children. There are also cottages available to rent with a sauna and jacuzzi. Whichever you choose, every cottage is situated by the water and has its own garden with a jetty.

Fun at the pool and on the beach

You can easily spend an entire afternoon in the heated indoor pool! Whizz down the slide or brave the rapids. For a refreshing drink or a tasty snack, head to the De Zoete Zee beach pavilion.

Back to the VOC era in Medemblik and Enkhuizen

EuroParcs IJsselmeer is situated in Medemblik, a picturesque town with characteristic facades and narrow streets. Step back in time to the Middle Ages at Radboud Castle and wander around the marina where you can spot charming little boats. One of the best VOC towns in the Netherlands is Enkhuizen (17 km). The town centre still exudes the atmosphere of the Golden Age. You can visit the Zuiderzee Museum here, take a boat trip through the inland waterways and wind down on a charming outdoor café.

properties.name: Camping de la Ferme des Saules
properties.description:
Camping de la Ferme des Saules is in the northern French town of Belle, close to the Belgian border. This quiet farm campsite is located in beautiful surroundings for walkers and cyclists. Produce from the land is for sale in the campsite's shop. Cuddle with the farm animals, challenge your neighbours to a game of boules and head out to explore the surroundings.

From basic to luxury

Campers at Camping de la Ferme des Saules camp on large grassy pitches. You can also rent accommodation. For the real camping feel, choose a standard caravan or a wooden chalet without a kitchen or toilet and washing facilities. Prefer more luxury? Then choose a mobile home, an atmospheric wooden chalet or a flat in the former farmhouse. The more luxurious accommodation has fully-equipped kitchens and private toilet and washing facilities.

Farm shop on the campsite

You can buy tasty local produce in the campsite shop. Organic fruit and vegetables come straight from the land and free-range eggs come from the chickens in the yard. Other products sold here, such as meat, dairy products and jams, come from nearby farms. Cook a tasty local meal in the communal kitchen and enjoy dining with others at the long tables in the covered area. The campsite has a petting zoo with chickens, ponies and goats. For children, there’s a small playground with a trampoline and plenty of space to play football. There’s also a boules court.

properties.name: Camping Le Cottet
properties.description:
Camping Le Cottet is a magical camping location in the heart of France's Rhône-Alpes region. You’ll find peace and relaxation in the heart of nature at this charming, small campsite.

Shade, privacy and comfort

There’s plenty of choice at Camping Le Cottet. The tent, caravan and motor-home pitches are located among the trees, giving you plenty of shade and privacy. All pitches are accessible for people with reduced mobility too. Looking for a little more comfort and luxury? Then choose one of the wooden chalets, romantic dome tents or mobile homes.

Fun close at hand

You don't have to look far for a fun activity here! Dive into the pool and, in high season, conquer a spot at the guinguette: the campsite restaurant, which serves local dishes. If you prefer to cook yourself or with other campers, you can also use the communal kitchen. Have a game of boules on the boules court or stroke horses and donkeys in the animal pasture.

If your bike breaks while you're here, there’s even a workshop where you can get your bike fixed. E-bikes are also available for hire. The campsite is designed with sustainable development in mind. It works with local producers and suppliers as much as possible, and energy and water consumption is controlled too.

Walk or cycle

The campsite is located in the heart of the Parc du Pilat nature reserve. Walk or cycle through the rolling countryside and explore the charming villages. And if you’re a real daredevil, go mountain biking, kayaking or paragliding.

properties.name: Camping Sérendipité
properties.description:
Looking for an authentic camping experience, on a quiet campsite where you can still wake up to the sound of bird song? Camping Sérendipité, near the village of Neuvéglise-sur-Truyère in Cantal (Auvergne), is just such a campsite. It’s the ideal starting point for nature lovers who enjoy walking, cycling or mountain biking. This terraced campsite is also a wonderful place to unwind.

Beautiful terrace pitches with unobstructed views

Camping Sérendipité's tourist pitches and accommodation are laid out on a number of terraces. Most of the pitches have a fair amount of shade, thanks in part to trees and bushes that also separate them. If you would prefer to stay in accommodation, book an authentic hiker's hut or a modern chalet or camping pod. Good to know: you’ll have an unobstructed view of the hilly surroundings from every pitch and type of accommodation.

Aperitif snacks and relaxing activities

Returning to campsite happy after a nice walk? Then order a cold drink and some tasty appetisers, like local cheeses and cold meats, at the cafeteria. There’s also a shop that sells local products, and books and games can be borrowed at reception. The campsite has a playground and a boules court, where spontaneous tournaments are held if there are enough people to join in. There’s also an entertainment programme, with activities like shiatsu, yoga, land art, massages, food tastings and fun theme evenings.

Valhalla for walkers

This campsite is an excellent starting point for walking enthusiasts who want to discover Cantal. The La voie de Rochegonde walking trail (15 km) starts right next to your pitch. The regional natural park of Aubrac is close by as well.

properties.name: Camping Cañones de Guara y Formiga
Camping De Kleine Wereld
properties.description:
Camping De Kleine Wereld is situated in the countryside within cycling distance from the city of Groningen (14 km). It is a family campsite where there is plenty to do but you can also relax completely. Activities are organised for children during the high season. The youngest campsite guests can play for hours in the natural playground, on the playing field or in the swimming pool.

Wooden chalets with air conditioning

Camping De Kleine Wereld has a spot for everyone. It doesn’t matter whether you choose a pitch without electricity or a spacious premium pitch with electricity. You camp on grass here. If you don’t have your own camping equipment, book a Swedish cabin for a maximum of five people. The attractive wooden cabins are equipped with a kitchen with a dishwasher, a bathroom with a rain shower and air conditioning.

Dining locally and campfire nights

On sunny days you can go for a refreshing swim in the large swimming pool. There is also a separate paddling pool. The bar and the large sunbathing area are next to the swimming pool. An extensive dinner can be had at the bistro. The dishes are prepared with fair and, where possible, local products. Close your evening with a campfire at your own pitch or at one of the organised campfire evenings.

Relaxing in the countryside

The Appèlbergen and Drentsche Aa nature areas are near the campsite. The marked walking tours take you past burial mounds and megaliths that are centuries old. Both nature areas can also be explored by bicycle.

properties.name: Obonjan Island Resort
properties.description:
There are, of course, plenty of luxury resorts in Croatia and Europe but ... a resort that extends over an entire uninhabited island? This is the case with the Obonjan Island Resort, which covers the entire island of Obonjan in the Šibenik archipelago (Croatia). This small wooded island, surround by the clear blue water of the Adriatic Sea, can be accessed by boat from the city of Šibenik. Once you are at this heavenly island resort, you lack for nothing. There is an outdoor swimming pool, various beaches, entertainment, three restaurants, three bars, a supermarket and a medical post.

What kinds of accommodation are there?

You go glamping on Obonjan Island Resort. Stay overnight in one of the glamping lodges with a view of the sea or woods. Luxury holiday cottages and safari tents can also be rented. If you choose the latter, then you use one of the three communal toilet blocks.

Lots of fun in the outdoor swimming pool

Plenty of options for swimming. Obonjan Island Resort has a beautiful swimming pool where you can cool off or swim some laps. Aqua-aerobic classes, pool volleyball games and swimming races take place regularly in this outdoor pool.

Enjoy Dalmatian beach life to the fullest

Several swimming docks have been installed along the rocky island coast, including at East Beach, the most popular beach on the island. The West Harbor beach, where it is calmer, also has a ladder to reach the water. In addition, there are several well-hidden inlets where, with a bit of luck, you can set up a private beach. Water sports enthusiasts can go kayaking, standup paddleboarding, snorkelling, jet skiing or take a ride on a banana boat.

properties.name: Prima Resort Boddenblick
properties.description:
Prima Resort Boddenblick is situated in the lush countryside of Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, right on the shores of the Barther Bodden lagoon in the Baltic Sea. Here, you’ll stay at a modern and luxurious campsite where relaxation is a given. Take a dip in the natural, chlorine-free swimming pool or pull up a chair in the restaurant overlooking the water.

Camping sites and tiny houses

Whether you come with a tent, a caravan or prefer something a bit more comfortable, Prima Resort Boddenblick is always the right choice. The camping pitches range from standard to extra-spacious and comfortable. There are also modern tiny houses dotted around the site. You will sleep surrounded by nature, yet still have all the comforts you need within easy reach.

A dip in a natural pool

The natural swimming pool is an absolute showstopper. You can swim here in crystal-clear, chlorine-free water.
