After swimming, you can warm up in the Finnish sauna or relax outside at the pool bar, with views over the Baltic Sea lagoons. Fancy a treat? The restaurant serves dishes made with local ingredients. Finish off your day with a cocktail in hand while enjoying a slow sunset.

Cycling, beach and cultural excursions

The Bodden–Baltic Sea cycle route is just a kilometre away and is perfect for long trips. From the harbour in Barth (10 km), you can easily catch the ferry to other places in the region. Fancy a day at the beach? Zingst (25 km) has a wide, clean sandy beach. There’s plenty to do for culture lovers too, with Ralswiek (55 km) and Rostock (60 km) nearby.

properties.name: Campingplatz Quellental
properties.description:
At the edge of the Teutoburgerwald Forest is Campingplatz Quellental. From the campsite you already have one foot in nature for cycling or hiking on the famous Hermannsweg, for example. The campsite itself has spacious, car-free pitches where you can relax after an active day outdoors.

Spacious pitches in a green setting

The campsite has spacious pitches for your tent, caravan or motorhome with sufficient electricity and water connections. Found your place and unpacked? Then park your car in a central car park so that everyone can enjoy a car-free and relaxed environment. A lovely, quiet place to spend your holidays. Especially when combined with all the greenery on and around the campsite!

Small, simple and effective

Modern facilities, bread service and a children's playground: this small campsite has all the comforts. The campsite itself does not have a swimming pool, but a refreshing dip is not far away. There is an outdoor swimming pool just a kilometre away. A supermarket and some restaurants are a 5 minute drive.

Everything for an active family holiday

Walking and cycling enthusiasts are in the right place. Step straight from your tent or caravan into nature and enjoy various hiking and cycling routes, like the famous Hermannsweg. Or take the car to admire the Externsteine rock formation (19 km). This natural monument is both a place of worship and watchtower where, after a nice walk and a short climb, you have a beautiful view of the surrounding area.

properties.name: Camping Resort Bayerwald GmbH
properties.description:
Camping Resort Bayerwald is just outside the cosy town of Waldkirchen, in the east of the German state of Bavaria. Here, you camp in a wooded area on the edge of the Bavarian Forest. This is a beautiful and relatively undiscovered low mountain range near the border with Austria and Czechia. This campsite opened in 2023 and is still partly under construction.

Large pitches and luxury sleeping barrels

This campsite is located on a former golf course. Large and smaller camping fields are playfully laid out and connected by paved paths. Campers camp on comfort or premium pitches. Comfort pitches are 80 to 100 square metres and premium pitches are twice as large. Campers can also rent a private bathroom. Travelling with a motor home and staying a maximum of two days? Then you can book a special pitch. You can also opt for a cosy, luxurious sleeping barrel.

Dine at Zum Sepp and get discounted admission to Karoli Badepark

If you are staying at this campsite, you should definitely eat at the atmospheric Zum Sepp restaurant. It has a delicious breakfast buffet and an extensive range of tasty meat dishes and home-made pizzas. The campsite also has a great petting zoo and a natural swimming lake. If it’s too cold to swim outside, drive five minutes to Karoli Badepark, where you’ll find a large sports pool, a paddling pool and wellness facilities. Camping guests get a discount on the entrance fee at Karoli Badepark.

properties.name: San Servolo Wellness Camping & Resort
properties.description:
Do you prefer to use your holidays to rest and recharge your batteries? San Servolo Wellness Camping & Resort is then the ideal place for you. This is a stylish five-star campsite where luxury, comfort and wellness take centre stage. Its amenities include a heated indoor and outdoor swimming pool, two restaurants and wellness facilities. San Servolo Wellness Camping & Resort is located in a quiet, wooded area just outside the town of Buje in Istria (Croatia), close to the border with Slovenia.

Neat pitches, some with private hot tub

You will find several dozen touring pitches at this small resort. Here you camp on neat lawns on fairly open ground. Staying overnight in a luxury accommodation is also possible. All accommodation and some of the camping pitches have private hot tubs.

San Servolo: a place to truly relax

Many visitors choose this campsite specifically because of all its wellness facilities. Be sure to visit the relaxation area and unwind with some fresh fruit and a cup of tea. For even more relaxation, enjoy a massage or visit the Finnish or Turkish sauna.

More active relaxation is also possible, because the resort has its own fitness studio and indoor and outdoor swimming pool. For delicious food, there is no need to leave the campsite either. There are two restaurants here. Get a tasty pizza or burger at San Servolo Pizzeria, or head to San Servolo Steakhouse to enjoy regional specialities like the steak tartare prepared at your table.

properties.name: Domaine Aigoual Cévennes
properties.description:
Camping in the heart of nature, but with a bit of luxury? Domaine Aigoual Cévennes is in the Cevennes and combines peace, space and comfort. The accommodation is well-equipped and set among mountains, forests and rivers. The campsite has a practical location: the village of Meyrueis is just around the corner, and plenty of trips are possible.

Large and comfortable accommodation

Great rental accommodation is always available at Domaine Aigoual Cévennes. The Grand Gîte is a large holiday home for up to eight people, complete with a private jacuzzi, modern kitchen and large living room. Perfect for a cosy stay with family or friends.

Prefer something smaller but just as comfortable? Then opt for the Maison EXCLUSIVE or Maison PRIVILEGE. Both have a patio, a fully-equipped kitchen and a television. All this accommodation is surrounded by greenery and very private.

Everything you need for a carefree holiday

The campsite is uncluttered, tidy and tranquil. River Brèze is close by for a refreshing dip or a relaxing moment by the water. The atmosphere is relaxed and welcoming. Hygiene and maintenance are very good. There is no restaurant or spa, but the basic facilities are in perfect order. For example, toilet and washing facilities, electricity points and plenty of shady spots.

Discover and relax in the Cévennes

Domaine Aigoual Cévennes is in the heart of nature. You will stay near Meyrueis (1 km), where three rivers meet: the Jonte, the Brèze and the Béthuzon. From this mountain village, you can walk straight into the mountains, with views up to 1567 metres.

properties.name: Camping du Vignal
properties.description:
Camping du Vignal is in the heart of the French Ardèche. Here, you will camp among vineyards and olive trees. This small family campsite is the perfect place to escape the hustle and bustle. With less than 20 pitches, you will find peace and quiet here. Enjoy the silence and the view of the Cevennes.

Camp with a view

This former farm campsite is laid out on terraces, giving you lovely views in many places. But the pitches are surprisingly flat. No hassle with wobbly tables or a sloping bed! Every pitch is wonderfully shaded. You’ll go back to basics here. Camping in its purest form: no fuss, but very cosy and beautiful views.

Relax in the pool and at the bar

Unwind by the pool or in the spa. Relax in the hot tub or splash around in the paddling pool with your little one. Don't feel like swimming any more? Grab a book and settle down on one of the sunbeds, in the sun or under a shade.

At the campsite, you can buy local products like olive oil and seasonal vegetables from its own garden, wines and beers from the region and all kinds of delicious delicacies. Although there’s no restaurant on the campsite, the owners are happy to recommend some hidden gems in the area. In high season, an aperitif evening is organised once a week. There’s also a communal barbecue area, where you can grill with other campers.

properties.name: Camping Baleia
properties.description:
Camping Baleia is a friendly eco-campsite in the heart of Romanian Transylvania. Here, you camp by the River Barbat, in the quiet village of Pui, in a setting rich with mountains, forests and history. This campsite is ideal for both a short stop and a longer holiday. The forests and valleys around Pui give you that real 'alone in the world' feel.

Camp by the river

At Baleia, you choose how adventurous you want to be. Caravans and motor homes have large, separate pitches with water and electricity. Do you drive an off-road vehicle? The campsite has a 4x4 field for you. Tent campers will really enjoy the car-free zones, tent pitches with a view, or a sheltered spot in the woods alongside the river. Don't have a tent? Just rent one.

Eco-friendly facilities

The campsite is the result of a green mindset. Thanks to solar panels, you always have hot water for showers and cooking. Bicycles are available free of charge for some quick shopping or a leisurely ride through the valley. All over the site, you’ll find picnic areas with electricity, ideal for coffee makers, toasters or just your power bank. This makes the camping feel rustic and practical at the same time.

Discover Transylvania

The Transylvanian Alps are practically at your feet here, so pull on your walking boots. There are historical highlights too: the ruins of Sarmizegetusa Regia (73 km) and the Corvin castle in Hunyad (46 km) are must-sees. Love the beautiful nature? Then you must visit the Fundatura Ponorului viewpoint (14 km) and the Cheile Crivadiei gorge (12 km).

properties.name: DieOutdoorSchmiede
properties.description:
DieOutdoorSchmiede is located in the middle of the green landscape of Lower Saxony, alongside peaceful river Ilmenau. This small nature campsite is a great place for anyone seeking peace and quiet, outdoor sports enthusiasts and anyone who likes to be close to nature. The focus is on simplicity, space and outdoor life here. You wake up to bird song, see the mist lifting over the river and immediately feel the relaxed atmosphere that makes this place so special. For a good meal, head to the Bootshaus restaurant, known for its local dishes and informal atmosphere.

Free camping in natural surroundings

At DieOutdoorSchmiede, you choose where to put your tent, caravan or motor home. The pitches are spread out in an open wooded area and are very private. Thanks to the natural layout, each pitch feels unique. Campers who prefer a little more comfort can opt for accommodation like the cosy sleeping barrels or comfortable chalets. The focus is on a relaxing stay, without excessive luxury but with atmosphere and the nature experience in mind.

Simple facilities, plenty of outdoor life

The campsite has basic facilities that reflect the outdoor character of DieOutdoorSchmiede. There are neat and tidy toilet and washing facilities and enough space to relax in nature. The river Ilmenau invites you to canoe, paddle or just sit quietly on the bank with a book. The friendly team is on hand with tips about the surrounding area and nature activities. Mass entertainment isn’t key here but real attention to being outdoors.

properties.name: Gites et Camping Le Vallon d'Estivaux
Camping de la Pra
properties.description:
Camping de la Pra in Saint-Germain-Laval is a small, green campsite in the Loire region. Here you can camp by a small river, in peaceful surroundings with views of the surrounding hills. The campsite is conveniently located near the A89 motorway, yet still feels rural and relaxed. Whether you’re stopping for a night on the way or a longer stay, this is a pleasant spot for families, cyclists and those seeking some peace and quiet.

Relaxed atmosphere

The campsite offers spacious pitches with plenty of greenery and ample shade. The pitches are suitable for tents, caravans and motorhomes, with both sunny and more sheltered options. Prefer a bit more comfort? Then opt for a fully equipped mobile home. They have charming wooden verandas where you can enjoy a lovely breakfast in the morning.

Refreshing swimming pool

At Camping de la Pra, you’ll find the basic facilities to make your stay comfortable. There’s a lovely swimming pool where you can cool off on hot days, and for children there’s a playground and a small sports field. A game of table tennis or pétanque is also among the options. By the pool there’s a small bar where you can order a cup of coffee, an ice cream or a light snack.

Walking and cycling in nature

Very close to the campsite, you can access walks and bike rides through the rolling countryside of the Loire. The village of Saint-Germain-Laval (2 km) has shops and restaurants. For a day out, you can visit Roanne (33 km), known for its gastronomy, or the historic city of Clermont-Ferrand (90 km).

properties.name: Camping La Faloise
properties.description:
Looking for a simple campsite just north of Paris? Camping La Faloise is located in the village of Angicourt. You camp in wooded surroundings here. Bring your bike and walking shoes because there are plenty of opportunities for a nice walk or cycling trip here. Impressive sights in Chantilly and Senlis are easy to visit.

Simple camping in green surroundings

Camping La Faloise is surrounded by trees and consists mainly of accommodation options. There’s plenty of choice; from striking red cabins to wooden chalets and mobile homes. Some are occupied by regular guests. The campsite is simple and ideal for pilgrims and campers on a cycling holiday, for example. Or stop here with your caravan or motor home en route to the south of France.

Dog-friendly accommodation

Your four-legged friend is very welcome here! If your dog comes camping with you, your pet can count on a basket, food bowls and dog waste bags. There’s even a special dog bar at reception. There are also great walks in the woods around the campsite.

Eat pizzas and go bowling

Don't fancy cooking yourself while you’re at the campsite? Then enjoy an artisan pizza, fresh from the stone oven. At reception, they also sell cold beer and other drinks. For entertainment, head to the on-site bowling alley and young kids can have fun in the playground.

French castles

Fancy an excursion? The imposing Château de Chantilly (21.5 km) is a must, as is the extraordinary Château de Compiègne (34.5 km). A day out with children? Parc Asterix (36 km) is a must.

properties.name: Camping de Pontivy
properties.description:
Friendly Camping de Pontivy is located in the Breton town of Pontivy, near the banks of river Blavet and the Nantes-Brest canal. You will camp just a few minutes from the old centre with its cafés, bars restaurants and shops. There’s something for everyone at this campsite: fun play equipment, an enthusiastic entertainment team and sports tournaments. You can swim in the public swimming pool or in the river.

French hospitality

Camping de Pontivy, in the heart of Brittany, has greenery all around. The medium-sized site has been laid out carefully. Motor home owners use a separate field. Tent and caravan owners are given a pitch of between 100 and 110 m2. Prefer a little more luxury? Then rent a furnished mobile home or a pod.

Water fun in the river

The campsite doesn’t have a swimming pool, but the river is a great place to enjoy water fun. Or go to the open-air swimming pool in Pontivy. Or how about a day at the Spadium indoor swimming complex (5 km) with all its slides? The nearby Blavet leisure centre is in the heart of beautiful nature and rents out canoes and organises boat trips.

A day at the campsite

Would you like to spend a day relaxing at your tent or caravan? For a drink or ice cream, just walk to the bar or the shop, while the children have fun in the playground or indoor play area. In the summer holidays, you can take part in tournaments and fun workshops, and evening entertainment is provided too.

properties.name: Camping de Bourg-Charente
properties.description:
Camping de Bourg-Charente is on the bank of the Charente, near the town of Cognac. This region in western France is famous for its vineyards and its many cycling and walking routes through picturesque villages and rolling countryside. At Camping de Bourg-Charente, delicious pizzas are cooked in a wood-fired oven and the river is a real draw.

Small campsite in beautiful countryside

Do you like small campsites? Then book a spot at Camping de Bourg-Charente. There are 35 pitches, including 8 mobile homes. The campsite is simple and quiet, so this is the place for you if you like traditional camping. A father and daughter take care of the upkeep together. The family's involvement adds to the cosy atmosphere that campers experience here.

Water fun in the river and wood-fired pizzas

There’s no swimming pool at the campsite, but it is right next to a beautiful river. You can rent a canoe and take a trip on the water. On hot days, you can swim here too. If you fancy a nice, fresh, wood-fired pizza with a glass of local beer afterwards, take a seat at the campsite bar.

By bike or on foot

This part of France is a dream destination for cyclists. Its ideal location near the famous Flow Velo cycling path make it easy to discover varied landscapes. The campsite itself has facilities for cyclists too. For example, a charging point for electric bikes and a repair room. Prefer walking? Beautiful walking trails for every level start at the campsite too.

properties.name: Camping La Roussie
properties.description:
Located in the sunny heart of the Dordogne, Camping La Roussie is a relaxing retreat for campers who love space, tranquillity and the real French outdoors. The rolling hills, charming villages and local sights make the area special. This small campsite's facilities include a swimming pool and petting zoo.

Natural sites and beautiful accommodation

Whether you’re camping with a tent, caravan or motor home, the large, well-tended pitches are in the heart of a green oasis of peace and privacy. Prefer more comfort? Choose from various accommodation options like modern mobile homes and cosy chalets, fully equipped for a carefree stay. Relax here after a full day out and about. The on-site fishing pond is a great place for a quiet hour of angling among the singing birds and the gentle rustle of nature.

Enjoy local delicacies

The swimming pool (open from June to mid-September) is a popular meeting place for campers of every age. Take a refreshing dip here on a hot summer’s day. Children can have fun at the petting zoo, which has goats and rabbits, etc. The playgrounds and table tennis table are lots of fun too. The supermarket sells regional specialities and you can order delicious rolls for a fresh breakfast.

Location on the Flow Vélo

Camping La Roussie’s location on the Flow Vélo make it an excellent choice for cyclists and walkers. The route takes you along rivers, forests and ancient, unspoilt villages. Visit the market of Sarlat-la-Canéda, admire the prehistoric art in Lascaux or discover castles, caves and other historic sites.

properties.name: Camping Les Lodges du Lagon
properties.description:
Camping Les Lodges du Lagon is located in the south of France, between Nĩmes and Montpellier. This is a popular region with many lovely towns and sights. You will camp here in a modern glamping park. As the campsite is located on a slope, you will enjoy beautiful views. Relax by the pool and enjoy a drink at the bar.

Luxury and comfortable accommodation

At Camping Les Lodges du Lagon, you will stay in beautiful, luxury accommodation that overlooks the Vaunage valley. The valley consists of pine forests, vineyards and olive groves. Good to know: there are no traditional pitches here. A lot of wood has been used to create the accommodation, bar and other facilities. The comfortable mobile homes are spread across the site on different terraces.

Cool off in the swimming pool

Fancy cooling off on a hot day? Then head to the compact swimming pool. The loungers invite you to spend an afternoon lazing in the sun, surrounded by French nature. Afterwards, enjoy a refreshing drink on the bar terrace. Prefer the sea? The Mediterranean Sea is a short 20-minute drive away for beach lovers.

Playground and car-free park

Travelling with young children? They haven't been forgotten: there’s an outdoor playground with several slides. For youngsters, the beach volleyball court is a fun place. Parking spaces are at the front, near the entrance, so the park is car-free. If you want to eat out, there’s a restaurant just around the corner; meat, fish and pizza are all on the menu.

properties.name: Camping Glamping Le Pré des Chênes
Campingresort Hinterstoder
properties.description:
Campingresort Hinterstoder is situated in the heart of Upper Austria’s impressive mountain landscape and is an ideal destination for a relaxing camping holiday in the Alps. This modern campsite is located beside a tranquil stream and is surrounded by mountains and forests. Here you can truly unwind while enjoying the fresh mountain air and stunning views.

Spacious pitches and special overnight stays

You will stay on spacious, flat and modern pitches with all the connections you need for water and electricity. The well-organised layout ensures plenty of peace and privacy. You will also have a lovely view of the surrounding mountains from your pitch. If you are travelling in a large motorhome or a longer vehicle, special XL pitches are available. In addition to camping pitches, you can also opt for unique accommodation options, such as camping barrels or luxury hotel rooms, for those seeking a little more comfort during their holiday.

Outdoor pool, sauna and restaurant

During your stay, you will have access to excellent facilities. And the reception is happy to provide tips on activities and excursions in the area. On hot days, the outdoor swimming pool is a lovely place to cool off. You can relax in the sauna or enjoy the fire pit. The campsite restaurant serves local and international dishes, ideal after an active day outdoors. Bring your walking boots or bike, as you have direct access to beautiful routes from the campsite.

The area around Hinterstoder is a paradise for nature lovers and active holidaymakers. Visit the Schiederweiher (6 km) or take a walk through the spectacular Dr Vogelgesang Gorge (9 km).

properties.name: Camping Ushuaïa Villages l'Estuaire
properties.description:
Camping Ushuaïa Villages l'Estuaire is situated in Paimboeuf, in the heart of a green area at the banks of the Loire. Here you can enjoy a peaceful camping holiday, surrounded by trees and nature, close to where the Loire flows into the Atlantic Ocean. The campsite is modest in size and well laid out, with excellent facilities for a relaxing stay. An ideal spot for those who want to explore the Pays de la Loire region and enjoy a holiday close to the water in the great outdoors.

Camp in comfort amongst the trees

The campsite offers spacious pitches for tents, caravans and motorhomes. Many pitches offer shelter under the shady trees and have an electricity hook-up. Thanks to the green settings, you will have plenty of privacy and space. Those looking for a bit more convenience can opt for a lodge or a mobile home. Or stay in a Caballon, a zeppelin-inspired accommodation that lets you feel completely at one with nature.

Swim, have fun and relax

At Camping Ushuaïa Villages l'Estuaire, you can enjoy excellent facilities and relaxation for all ages. There is a covered heated swimming pool. Children can have fun at the playground, and there are planned activities during the high season. For animal lovers, the mini-farm is a true highlight. It is home to small animals that, under the watchful eye of the campsite staff, can even be cuddled. There are also recreational options such as table tennis and boules. For a drink or a light meal, head over to the friendly snack bar and bar on the campsite.

properties.name: Wald- und Naturcampingplatz am Tonsee Süd
Camping Les Lodges de Blois Chambord
Blauwe Meer
properties.description:
Blauwe Meer in Lommel is an inviting campsite in a green, forest environment. As the name suggests, there is a lake in the centre of the park featuring a sunbathing lawn. Fans of indoor water fun will enjoy a swimming paradise. After a day full of fun, head to the campsite restaurant for a tasty meal. You can also hire a barbecue and gourmet set from reception for a fun, culinary evening.

Accommodation on a green campsite

Blauwe Meer is an inviting, tidy campsite with spacious pitches that are demarcated and surrounded by nature. The rental accommodation includes well maintained, furnished bungalows and mobile homes. Groups of up to 24 people can stay in the De Lommelse Hoef group accommodation with a private swimming pool and sauna. 

Water fun outside and inside

The centre of campsite Blauwe Meer features a lovely lake with a wonderful sandy beach. Enjoy fun in the water in and around the recreation lake during a camping holiday. Head out on the pedal boats or relax on the sunbathing lawn. For indoor water fun, visit the indoor complex with beach pool. This beautiful indoor building is an attraction for young and old, with a water play park, play beach, indoor pool and wellness area. The indoor pool area has a paddling pool and a large slide.

Entertainment for all

Young members of the family are entertained in the Kids club during most of the high season.  Teenagers haven't been left out, of course - there's a varied recreation programme for them too.  The whole family can enjoy themselves on the sports fields.  With outdoor activities such as basketball, volleyball, mini golf and boules nobody has to be bored.

properties.name: Løkken Strandcamping
properties.description:
This beach camping is situated directly at the North Sea, along the not very touristy west coast of North Jutland. Here you will encounter high waves and strong winds, ideal for windsurfing and kiteboarding. Nice for slightly older children, although the youngest campers will also enjoy themselves with a kite on the wide beach. The beach can be reached via a flight of stairs from the campsite dunes. Do not expect luxury on this campsite, but enjoy nature to the fullest: the sea, beach and the dunes.

The campsite is situated close to the attractive town of Løkken and has spacious camping pitches, sheltered from the wind with fencing.

Spacious, straight pitches

The campsite is not unduly large, but the pitches are spacious enough. These are straight pitches without further demarcation. There is a playground. Would you prefer to hire accommodation? You can book a trekker hut. The sanitary facilities on the campsite are basic but clean.

Find it all in Løkken

A shop and restaurant are lacking on the campsite, but you can find anything in Løkken, only 1 km away from the campsite. Easy and fast to reach on foot or by bicycle. Løkken itself is small, but beautiful. You will find some nice small shops, several supermarkets and good restaurants there.

Enjoy yourself...even without the sea

At a distance of 800 m from the campsite, you will find an indoor play paradise where you can practice bowling, karting and laser games. In Løkken you can visit the Family Farm Fun Park. Here you can enjoy yourself with the animals or with the pedalos. The entrance fees are very reasonable and coffee and tea are free. A real fun day for the family.

properties.name: Bovbjerg Camping
properties.description:
Bovbjerg Camping is located right on the rugged west coast of Denmark. At this natural campsite, it’s all about spaciousness and fresh sea air. You will be camping on roomy pitches with views of the sea and the surrounding villages. The vast dunes and the lapping of the waves create a relaxed atmosphere where you will instantly feel at ease. The site also features modern facilities, a restaurant and a playground. Don’t forget to bring your bike and walking shoes!

Choose your camping spot

The camping pitches offer plenty of space for your tent, caravan or motorhome. You can choose the pitch that suits your holiday: a family pitch close to the playground, a pitch with a view of the North Sea, or a central pitch right next to the kiosk and the toilet facilities. All camping pitches are equipped with an electricity hook-up. Don’t have your own camping equipment? Then book one of the Scandinavian cabins.

Modern sanitary facilities, a restaurant and more

Although it is a natural campsite, there are extensive facilities available. The sanitary facilities are modern and open 24/7. Don’t feel like cooking? Pull up a chair at the friendly restaurant. Children can burn off some energy in the playground or with the entertainment team. There is also a communal kitchen and a laundry room.

Walking or cycling through the surrounding area

Lace up your walking shoes or hop on your bike. Visit the 42-metre-high Bovbjerg Klint with its iconic red lighthouse. Along the coast, you will find beautiful walking trails through the dunes, and you can easily explore the charming villages in the area by bike.

properties.name: Humlum Camping
properties.description:
In the middle of Jutland, in a very water-rich area, lies the village of Humlum, between the Nissum Bredning and the Venø Sund,. Humlum Camping is located right by the harbour of the town on the Venø Sund. From the somewhat higher Humlum, which is reached via road 11, a signposted road leads down directly to the harbour and the campsite.

Once you arrive at the campsite you can see that it is in an open area and on the waterfront, directly connected to the marina. The campsite consists of nine streets on which the pitches are neatly arranged.

Danish camping

Humlum Camping is a typical Danish campsite: modern and well maintained and tightly organised with demarcated pitches. The campsite, like most Danish campsites, has quite a few seasonal pitches, while travelling through tourists are of course welcome on their own part of the site. The pitches are spacious, but offer little shade. The campsite has five modern, well-equipped hiker's huts and holiday cottages.

Swimming and fishing

The Venø Sund offers plenty of opportunity for swimming and sunbathing on the beach and the campsite has many playgrounds for children. Kayaks can be rented from the reception. The reception is the heart of the camping complex with a small shop (købmand) for daily shopping. The nearest supermarket can be found in Humlum (2.5 km). The campsite has two toilet blocks with particularly good facilities for families with small children.

properties.name: Frederiksværk Citycamping
properties.description:
Want to camp in a quiet spot in nature, but with shops on your doorstep? Frederiksværk Citycamping is ideally located next to the centre of Frederiksværk, a friendly town in the north of the Danish island of Zealand. You camp in a small forest by the Frederiksværk canal. From the campsite you can go on lovely canoe trips. Furthermore, you camp six kilometres from a wooded nature reserve and just under an hour's drive from capital Copenhagen.

Wooded site with spacious pitches

After arriving on the campsite, sign in at reception and drive a little way across a wooded area before arriving at the open camping fields. On this green site, you choose your own spot. Besides large camping pitches, there are a number of well-maintained accommodations for rent. For example, modern mobile homes and hiker's huts. You can also book a place to sleep at the hostel.

Excellent holiday address for sports lovers

There are lots of things to do on and around the campsite, particularly sports related. Children can have fun in the playground, while tennis enthusiasts can hit a ball at Frederiksværk Tennisklub, next to the campsite. There is also a canoe and kayak rental company next to the campsite. And the nice thing is that your rented boat sails across the Frederiksværk Canal straight into the welcoming city centre. Got the hang of it? Then feel free to sail on a bit more. Because the canal continues through a forest and ends in Lake Arresø. Going in the opposite direction takes you on a lovely trip to Roskildefjord.

properties.name: Grønninghoved Strand Camping
properties.description:
Grønninghoved Strand Camping is your perfect holiday destination for a week at the beach in Denmark. This spacious, modern campsite is located a hundred metres from the beach. Ideal for water sports enthusiasts. So get on that SUP board and conquer the Danish inland sea! Or dive with the kids into the warm water of the swimming pool.

Spacious pitches, cute little cabins

With the sea as a view, you drive onto the spacious campsite. After a warm welcome, you may proceed to your spacious pitch. All pitches here are large. You may pitch your caravan, camper or tent on one of the beautiful lawns. These are screened by green hedges. You'll be between the apple trees, but they don't give much shade. Don't have your camping equipment with you on holiday in Denmark? Then you get to stay in one of those cute red cabins.

Real family campsite

This Danish campsite is an ideal holiday destination for families. You camp close to the beach. And on the campsite, there are more than enough play options. The children can play football or badminton on the spacious lawns. But you'll also often find them in the playground, clambering, sliding and swinging, or jumping around on the huge air cushion.

A warm pool with slides

The big attraction for the whole family is the swimming pool. The large swimming pool has two smaller slides where you can go tobogganing. Want something wild? Then try the big red slide. It takes you on a bouncing ride down into a small pool one level below. There you will also find a paddling pool, where the little swimmers can splash around.

properties.name: Falsled Strand Camping
properties.description:
The attractive family campsite Falsled Strand Camping is on Funen, a southern Danish island. You’ll camp right by the beach and near vast meadows and forests. Have fun in the outdoor swimming pool, eat something tasty at the café and sleep in neat and tidy accommodation. Or bring your own tent, caravan or motor home instead. You’ll always find nature and Danish hygge (cosiness) here!

Sleep by the sea or among the trees

At Falsled Strand Camping, you’ve got a few choices. For example, a beach pitch by the water, a parking place under the trees or a special tent pitch. Would you prefer accommodation instead? Then choose a cosy nature cabin, a lodge or a fully-equipped tent suite. Some accommodation has its own toilet and washing facilities, while you’ll need to use the central toilet and washing facilities for others.

Jump in the swimming pool or the sea

The outdoor pool isn’t very big, but it is heated. The campsite is very close to the sea too. You can rent kayaks and paddle boards. Or you could just dive into the water. This is a great place to watch the sun set in the evening. It's about a 15-minute walk to the little port of Falsled, a great route along the beach. Prefer to hop on a bike? The campsite rents out (electric) bikes in the summer months.

Other options are a wild-picking walk, yoga classes and creative workshops. Evenings are cosy too. Head down to the campfire and enjoy live music.

properties.name: Uhlenköper-Camp
properties.description:
Uhlenköper-Camp is located in the German region of Lower Saxony, near the forests and heathlands of Lüneburg Heath. If you want to spend your holiday on a small eco-friendly family campsite in the middle of nature, then this is the place for you! The sustainable and ecological elements reflected in the campsite's modern facilities are priority number one. These ensure that environmentally conscious campers will be able to enjoy the pristine nature in which this campsite is located for many years to come.

Ideal for a family holiday

With its small petting zoo, playground, entertainment program and swimming pond, this is a wonderful place for young families. When it rains you can play table football or another game in the lounge next to the swimming pond. When the weather is nice you can relax on the restaurant's rooftop terrace.

A natural purification system ensures that the water in the two swimming ponds remains clean. With different zones for swimmers, non-swimmers and a shallow area for toddlers, everyone can take part in the water recreation.

Special accommodation

Uhlenköper-Camp has wonderfully spacious and shady pitches for campers with their own camping equipment. Many guests consider the campsite's luxurious and modern sanitary facilities as a major plus. The campsite also offers a number of modern and unique accommodations, such as an adventurous yurt or a cosy camping barrel.

Organic shop & breakfast service

In the campsite's organic shop, you will find basic products such as eggs, sausage, cheese, fruit, vegetables and various dairy products. For campers who prefer to be pampered in the morning, there is a choice of various breakfast menus. The cosy snack bar with terrace is open daily in high season. Vegetarians will also find themselves at home here.

properties.name: Campingpark Extertal
properties.description:
In the hilly and green Weserbergland, not far from the Teutoburger Forest with its agricultural and nature reserves, you will find Campingpark Extertal. The campsite is located between forests and fields in this quiet, rural area. There is a former farmhouse on the grounds. The camping pitches measuring on average some 100 m2 are located on both sides of a paved road which meanders over the campsite. You can choose a pitch with morning sun or evening sun, whichever you prefer.

Picturesque

At the campsite you are welcomed in the spacious reception, which is housed in an attractive half-timbered farmhouse. The original outbuildings of the former farmhouse also contribute towards the picturesque atmosphere. Inside the farmhouse you will also find the Gaststätte. Snacks and drinks are served here. After a hectic day in the leafy surroundings you will be ready to enjoy a refreshing draught beer, preferably outside on the lovely terrace.

Children's paradise

The campsite is in a lovely child-friendly design with a spacious playground and a safe swimming pond (with slides and playground equipment). A nice but not too extensive entertainment programme is also available. There are several ponies and other animals on the grounds.

Into nature

Around Campingpark Extertal several well maintained and signposted walks take you into the glorious nature of the Extertal. One of the highlights of the region is the Externsteine near Bad Meinberg in the Teutoburg Forest. This sandstone rock formation in the green landscape was formed in the Cretaceous and is therefore some 120 million years old. On the rocks you will find several traces of human actitivity from prehistory and the Middle Ages.

properties.name: Campingplatz Am Furlbach
properties.description:
Looking for a quiet campsite in a forested natural area, where you can go on lovely walks and cycle rides? If so, Campingplatz Am Furlbach near to the city of Schloß Holte, in the east of the German state of North Rhine-Westphalia, is a good choice. This hospitable family campsite is an ideal starting point for lovely walks through the countryside. Furthermore, at Campingplatz Am Furlbach, you can book a spacious pitch for a reasonable price.

Camping on a forested site

Campingplatz Am Furlbach is a reasonably large campsite, but you notice little of that when camping there. That's because a large part of the campsite is in the forest. Tent campers can pick their own pitch in the densely forested section at the rear of the site. The other camping pitches are neatly demarcated. You can also choose to stay in a luxury holiday home.

Playing, fishing and romping around

There are several fun playgrounds and sports facilities spread over the campsite. Furthermore, it's lovely to play in the Furlbach on hot days. This stream is only 250 metres further along and has slow flowing water that reaches knee-height. There is also a fishing pond where you can go fishing.

Walk through Teutoburg Forest

The area is particularly interesting for cycling and walking enthusiasts. The Furlbachtal and around the Moosheide are lovely walking routes for example. Slightly to the east, there is an even larger nature reserve, the Teutoburg Forest. The Externsteine (30 km) are also recommended. This is a series of lovely rock formations that tower high above the surrounding natural landscape.

properties.name: Regenbogen Ferienanlage Bad Harzburg
properties.description:
Regenbogen Ferienanlage Bad Harzburg is located on the northern edge of the Harz Mountains, not far from Bad Harzburg. This four-star campsite has a well-tended camping area surrounded by woodlands. The slightly sloping terrain is partly laid out in terraces. The campsite has a sauna area with indoor pool where you can relax.

You will always find a pitch

The neat campsite consists of two areas: one area has touring pitches on a slightly sloping terrain, the other area has annual pitches and is laid out in terraces. All pitches are located on grass along straight paths. Most pitches have little vegetation and demarcation. However, some sites offer pitches with slightly more trees and shelter.

Extensive sauna landscape

The campsite is located on the northern side of the Harz Mountains, in a beautiful hiking area. After an active day outdoors, you can relax on the campsite. In the main building there is an extensive sauna landscape. You will find five different saunas and steam baths, a solarium, a heated indoor pool, a plunge pool and even a salt cave. There is also a nice relaxation area with loungers. As a campsite guest, you can relax and enjoy all the wellness facilities here. Just keep in mind that these facilities are not free, and are closed on public holidays.

properties.name: EuroParcs Biggesee
properties.description:
EuroParcs Biggesee is situated in the heart of the Ebbegebirge Nature Park in the German Sauerland region. It is a peaceful campsite surrounded by greenery. Here, you camp right on the shores of Waldenburger Bucht, a bay of Lake Biggesee. You'll wake up to a view of the water, lace up your walking boots or step straight onto your SUP board. For a day out, you can be in the Hanseatic town of Attendorn in no time.

A comfortable stay in the Sauerland

EuroParcs Biggesee has 85 spacious pitches of around 100 m². Plenty of space for your tent, caravan or motorhome, and for enjoying the great outdoors. Some pitches offer views of the lake or are a short distance from the shore. Fancy a bit of extra comfort? Then choose one of the modern chalets, fully furnished and equipped with all modern conveniences.

Everything you need for a carefree holiday

You'll also find excellent facilities here. For families, there are special children's toilet facilities, and those seeking a bit more privacy can hire a private toilet block. For a drink or a simple meal, it's just a short walk to the beach bar. With a view over Lake Bigge, everything tastes just that bit better. In the campsite shop, you can pick up fresh bread rolls and a coffee-to-go in the morning for a relaxed start to the day. There’s also a launderette, and you can hire (electric) bikes.

Explore the area

Visit the charming town of Attendorn (4.5 km) with its historic centre or head to the impressive Atta Cave (3 km). Fancy some action? AquaMagis Water Park (20 km) is renowned for its spectacular slides. Of course, you can also opt for something more peaceful. There are lovely walking and cycling routes around the lake.

properties.name: Camping Wiedschleife
properties.description:
Camping Weidschleife is located in a bend of the river Wied and in the Wiedtal, near the village of Roßbach. It is wonderfully quiet and ideal for campers looking for simplicity and relaxation. No mini disco, football tournaments and live music, just peace and quiet in nature. There are lots of lovely walking and cycling routes nearby, and the hustle and bustle of villages and towns are easy to find.

Camping along the river

At Camping Wiedschleife, you choose your own camping pitch. Because here you camp on a large meadow by the river. Its size does not detract from the complete tranquillity you experience here. From here, you have a gorgeous view over the Wiedtal. Check in and out whenever it suits you, because you do it all by yourself!

Take a dip or play a game

Here there are no entertainment programmes, just quiet and relaxation. Start the day with a morning walk and get fresh rolls from the baker’s 5 minutes away. Before, or after, dive into the river for a fresh morning swim. And don’t forget your badminton racket or other favourite camping game, because there is plenty of space to play on the camping meadow. Camping Wiedschleife does not have a campsite restaurant or shop, but you are close to bakeries, shops and welcoming restaurants.

Walking and cycling

This campsite is ideal for walkers and cycling enthusiasts. For example, hike the Wiedweg (117 km total), the Wäller Tour Bärenkopp (11 km total) or the Klosterweg (17 km total). Or get on your bike and cross the Wieddal valley on a 100-kilometre bike ride.

properties.name: Camping Losheim am See
properties.description:
Enjoy going on idyllic walks through the forest during your holiday? Then you should definitely consider a stay at this campsite located just outside Losheim am See in the German state of Saarland. Here you'll be camping in the middle of expansive forests in a beautiful low mountain range. Losheim am See Campsite is also located right on the Stausee Losheim reservoir. There is a sandy beach with water sports facilities right next to the campsite. This campsite began undergoing major renovations in 2021. Renovations will continue through 2023 and 2024. The sanitary facilities, camping pitches, rental accommodations, reception and catering area, among other parts of the campsite, will all receive a major makeover.

Spend the night in a retro caravan

At Losheim am See Campsite, the tourist camping pitches are generally located along the edges of the site. A separate field has been set up near the lake for tent campers. This campsite also offers various types of rental accommodations, such as hikers' cabins, chalets and tiny houses. Are you looking for a truly unique and nostalgic experience? Then spend the night in a retro caravan. The campsite rents out a number of refurbished vintage caravans from the 1960s.

A popular recreational lake

There is a beautiful sandy beach close to the campsite. You can enjoy swimming in the lake there. The large sunbathing area and the waterslide help make it even more enjoyable. It can be crowded in sunny weather, especially during weekends and holidays, due in part to the arrival of residents from this region. This popular lake also offers water sports activities. In addition to swimming, you can go diving, sailing, surfing, stand up paddle boarding, canoeing and pedal boating.

properties.name: Family-Resort Kleinenzhof
properties.description:
In the heart of the Black Forest you will find Family Resort Kleinenzhof. This luxury campsite is situated on the banks of the Kleine Enz river. The campsite is surrounded by attractive, wooded hills and picturesque villages. The entire region exudes an atmosphere of health and sportsmanship, which allows you to relax in a laid-back environment.

Entertainment throughout the year

The campsite makes a well-maintained impression with beautifully laid out and spacious pitches. There are several luxury rental accommodation units on the campsite. During winter, the campsite is mainly geared towards winter sports enthusiasts as the area is eminently suitable for cross-country skiing. In summer you will enjoy swimming in the (outdoor and indoor) swimming pool of the campsite.

Dining with a view

The campsite has a fine restaurant with a spacious terrace from where you will enjoy the splendid view of the area. There is an extensive menu which offers mainly dishes that are prepared with regional products. If you would rather do your own cooking, you can visit the small but well-stocked campsite supermarket.

Top sanitary facilities

As on many German campsites, the sanitary facilities are impeccable. Everything is well maintained with more than sufficient capacity in peak season. Not only do they have special sanitary facilities for children, but also private sanitary facilities and sanitary facilities for families.

Exploring the diverse area in an inexpensive way

Upon arrival on the campsite you will be given a pass in exchange for payment of the mandatory tourist tax, providing you with free access to public transport in the Black Forest. This offers unlimited options for exploring the region.

properties.name: Camping Schüttehof
properties.description:
Camping Schüttehof is situated in the lush countryside of Baden-Württemberg, close to the impressive Black Forest. Here you can camp in complete peace and quiet, surrounded by hills and woodlands. Lace up your walking boots or hop on a bike, as the surrounding area is perfect for exploring. The charming town of Horb am Neckar is about a twenty-minute walk away; a medieval town with half-timbered houses and lively squares. With facilities including a swimming pool and a restaurant on the campsite, you’re sure to have a lovely holiday here.

Camping in the heart of nature

The pitches at Schüttehof are well-maintained and range in size. This means you can always choose a spot that suits your camping style. Whether you’re staying in your own tent, caravan or motorhome, you’ll enjoy the great outdoors, with the forest practically on your doorstep. Fancy trying something different? Then spend the night in a cosy pinewood sleeping barrel. Modern mobile homes are also available if you’re looking for a bit more comfort.

Facilities for young and old

Take a dip in the swimming pool, which is beautifully situated in the sun behind reception. Children can burn off some energy at the playground or at the petting zoo, where there’s always something to discover. Sports enthusiasts can burn off some energy on the football pitch, tennis court or over a game of boules. After an active day, you can grab a quick bite to eat at the snack bar or take a seat in the restaurant and enjoy a relaxing evening. Practical conveniences have also been considered: the bread roll service, kiosk, launderette and e-bike charging point add the finishing touches to your stay.

properties.name: Camping Kirchzarten
properties.description:
Campsite Kirchzarten is next to the village of Kirchzarten, to the south of the Black Forest. Although you camp close to the village, you feel like you are in the middle of the mountainous Dreisamtal countryside. The campsite is situated near the lovely city of Freiburg and the Europa-Park theme park and resort (Germany’s largest theme park) is close by.

You can reach the campsite easily via the A5. You can make your camping holiday as comfortable as you wish. There are lovely pitches on the grass for your own tent or caravan, but there are also various holiday homes and mobile homes for rent.

Free swimming and public transport

Next to the campsite there is a wonderful swimming pool complex. Admission to this pool is included in the overnight rate in the high season. Also included in the price is a KNOUS card for public transport. The train station is a ten-minute walk from the campsite and in 15 minutes you can be standing in the historical centre of Freiburg. If you want to plan a day trip for the next day, then you can use the free Wi-Fi connection at the campsite.

Day trips for young and old

There is plenty for children to do at the campsite. They can design their own t-shirt in the T-Shirt Factory and there are special ‘Dinners for Kids’ where children can sit down at a table together with their camping buddies. If you prefer cycling or walking then the Black Forest is a perfect location for a hiking or cycling tour.

properties.name: Campingpark Gitzenweiler Hof
properties.description:
Camping park Gitzenweiler Hof, also referred to as GITZ, is located in the town of Lindau. From this campsite it is only a ten-minute drive to Lake Constance. When you drive towards the five star campsite, you will see the snow-capped mountain tops in the background, an idyllic sight!

Comfortable camping

The standard pitches (partly compacted, partly grass) are suitable for smaller caravans. Like to have more space? Opt for a comfort pitch. There is a separate lawn for tent campers. The sanitary facilities of the campsite are really nice. For instance, sanitary building 4 has a genuine wash paradise for children complete with Fany the Elephant, the cheerful mascot of the campsite. 

Take a refreshing dive

Head for Lake Constance if you want to cool down. A ten-minute drive takes you there. It is ideal for swimming, windsurfing, kayaking or just soaking up the sun on the beach. 

Family campsite in Bavaria

Children are the main focus during this holiday in Bavaria. They can do crafts, dance, learn conjuring tricks, play soccer, go on pony rides and so on. And what's more, they will go on a treasure hunt, make apple juice or bake bread. Feel like a sports-filled afternoon? If so, you can play beach volleyball, table tennis, soccer or go slacklining. 

Italian or German?

This campsite offers you a choice of two restaurants. Feel like Italian? Grab a seat in Pizzeria & Restaurant Pinocchio. But you can also get a bite to eat in the tavern on the campsite. For a quick snack you can go to the snack bar. Obviously, you may want to get a currywurst or schnitzel here. Another option is to prepare your own meal. The campsite supermarket stocks a wide range of products.

properties.name: Fishguard Bay Caravan and Camping Park
Domaine d'Haulmé
properties.description:
If you prefer spending your holidays in the unspoiled countryside, far away from urban bustle and motorways, then Domaine d'Haulmé is highly recommended. This campsite is in a secluded spot in the French Ardennes, right by the River Semois. Here, you camp in a hilly, forested area. The campsite has a restaurant, a small shop, an outdoor swimming pool and clean toilet and washing facilities.

Hire a tiny house or camp right by the Semois

You can camp anywhere on the forested site. The pitches, just like the campsite itself, are nicely integrated into the countryside. There are about 30 pitches on the banks of the Semois.

Besides the tourist pitches, various types of accommodation are available. At Domaine d’Haulmé, you can hire a mobile home, but also special accommodation such a tiny house, a vintage caravan and a large dome tent.

Go for a refreshing swim in the campsite's swimming pool

On summer days, you can jump into the wonderful water of the heated swimming pool that adorns Domaine d’Haulmé. The swimming pool is in the sun. That means you can relax nicely on the loungers that are on the decking around the swimming pool. Furthermore, you can go paddling in the water of the Semois on the outskirts of the campsite.

Ideal starting point for varied forest walks

Domaine d’Haulmé is in the heart of the French Ardennes. This campsite is surrounded by a hilly landscape with vast forested areas. You can take lovely walks straight from the campsite. As well as easy and hard walking trails, this region is excellent for mountain biking, climbing and canoeing.

properties.name: Camping Bellevue Erquy
properties.description:
Some 5 km away from the small harbour town of Erquy, on the north coast of Brittany, the Côtes-d’Armor, lies Camping Paradis Bellevue Erquy. This well maintained campsite is laid out as a park with hedges offering ample privacy and a varying amount of shade. You can choose between a pitch of 90 to 100 m2 or a pitch with 'grand confort' (some 120m2 to 130 m2). From the campsite you have a splendid view of the sea, of cloud formations and sunsets.

A number of mobile homes, bungalows and a few tents are available for rent.

Cooling off

The large swimming pool of the campsite has a retractable roof. In high season water aerobics is offered here on weekday mornings. The swimming pool is surrounded by lawn. The beach is a 10-minute drive by car.

Great food

The bar has a limited menu and serves pizzas, French fries, ice cream and take-away meals in high season. Across from the campsite is a pancake restaurant.

Go-karting and sports

You can rent nice go-karts for children, but also for adults, to explore the campsite. The playgrounds are equipped with some great equipment for infants and toddlers. There is a trampoline for children up to age 12. In high season there is an entertainment programme, also in Dutch, as well as a mini club. This includes tournaments, treasure hunt, sports activities, dancing and board games, as well as creative workshops when the weather is not so good. Disco evenings are organised on a regular basis.

properties.name: Camping Huttopia Rambouillet
properties.description:
The Huttopia Rambouillet campsite is located in the middle of a vast forest some fifty kilometres south-west of Paris. Here, nature is your camping spot: you can stay in beautiful hiker's huts, lodge tents or on camping pitches under trees. With a natural swimming pool, a fishing lake and summer entertainment, there is plenty to do for everyone.

Camping under the trees

Camping at the Huttopia Rambouillet campsite is tantamount to camping in unspoilt nature. The vast wooded area provides a sense of freedom. The delimited pitches are located under the tall trees of the Rambouillet forest. Shadow can be found everywhere. The large lodge tents, caravans and hiker's cabins are also - partly - in the shade of the trees. Some rental accommodation can be found directly by the fishing lake.

Swimming, of course!

At the entrance to the campsite, on the left, is the natural swimming pool. This swimming pool, with a separate area for toddlers, is kept clean naturally and therefore contains no chlorine. Right next to the campsite is a large lake, the Etang d'Or. Here anglers can cast their fishing rod, and around the lake is a great place for walking.

One large playground

The Huttopia Rambouillet campsite is not really a children's campsite, but children will have a great time there. Of course, the forest is one big playground where they can play to their heart's content. In high season, entertainment is provided in a mini-club. With crafts and treasure hunts on the programme. There is also summer entertainment for adults, especially in the form of live concerts in the evening. Not a very extensive entertainment programme, but enough to amuse yourself for a day/evening.

properties.name: Camping de Paris
properties.description:
This modern campsite in Paris, in the Bois de Boulogne, makes you feel as if you're in the countryside, thanks to all the greenery. Even so, the metropolis is just a stone's throw away. Due to its central location, Paris campsite is easy to get to from the motorway, and is therefore also ideal as somewhere to stop on a longer journey. The friendly staff will be happy to help you find your pitch. The reception is open till 22:00, and in July and August till 23:00, so a late arrival is no problem at all.

Camping on the River Seine

You'll camp on a shady, spacious camping pitch that's separated from other pitches with greenery. Some campsites are even on the banks of the Seine. There's a motorhome service point at the campsite. As well as camping, it's also possible to stay in wooden caravans, cottages, and mobile homes.

Cycling

In the summer, you can rent a bike at the campsite. You can be standing under the Eiffel Tower in the heart of Paris in 20 minutes, having enjoyed the beautiful Bois de Boulogne on your bike ride in. In the café/restaurant, and at the food truck on the terrace, you can eat pizza, salads, and meat from the barbecue. It's a lovely place to enjoy your day in Paris with a good glass of wine.

The forest

In the Bois de Boulogne, there are plenty of opportunities to enjoy the greenery and natural scenery. For example, it's possible to take a boat trip on one of the lakes, and you can walk to a waterfall.

properties.name: Country Park Crécy La Chapelle
properties.description:
Disneyland Paris is known as the most popular amusement park in Europe. If you are looking for a great campsite close to this famous theme park, Country Park Crécy in Crécy-la-Chapelle (Seine-et-Marne) is certainly recommended. You can get to Disneyland in no time with a car or bus from this campsite. You can reach the centre of the metropolis of Paris within 30 minutes. Despite the proximity of these major attractions, you stay at a quite spot in forested surroundings in Crécy.

Stay the night on a neat touring pitch or in a modern mobile home

When you drive to the campsite grounds, the first thing you see is lots of accommodation. There are many glamping options, for example a modern mobile home for four to six people. You can also book a spacious pitch at Country Park Crécy. The pitches are separated by neat hedges.

Fantastic water park for young and old

Country Park Crécy's lovely swimming pool is at the front of the site. This water park consists of a rectangular, outdoor swimming pool and an adjacent large paddling pool. The water in both swimming pools is heated to a pleasant temperature.

This campsite offers even more forms of entertainment for (young) children. How about the exceptional playground with all its spectacular bouncy castles? You can also play at the multi-sports ground or entertain yourself with a game of table tennis or petanque.

properties.name: Libranoo Héliomonde
properties.description:
Libranoo Héliomonde is a naturist campsite located in a large forest under Paris. Because of its location the campsite is suitable for a stopover, but also for a longer holiday in nature you can camp here. Relax or exercise: on the wooded campsite you can do both. Take a dip in the outdoor swimming pool, relax in the sauna or hit a ball on the tennis court.

Camping in the forest

The campsite of camping Héliomonde is surrounded by the greenery of the dense forest. This provides a lot of shade on the fifty touring pitches. These pitches are spacious and not delimited. In the forest there is total tranquillity. Car-free pitches contribute to this. The site is mainly filled with permanent pitches. There are also some forty rental accommodations: mainly mobile homes and chalets, but also furnished lodge tents and special tree houses.

Sporting relaxation

In a clearing, surrounded by woods you'll find the swimming pool: ideal for a cooling dip, but also for an intensive session of aquagym. Sauna and hammam provide total relaxation, while you can also work up a sweat on the tennis court. After all that you can relax at the artificial sandy beach or in the spacious relaxation room.

Extensive dining or a takeaway?

Near the swimming pool you'll find the catering facilities. You can linger over your dinner on the pavement café or you can pick something up at the snack bar or pizzeria. Cook for yourself? The mini market on the campsite has a fairly limited range of products, but a large supermarket is just a ten minute drive away.

properties.name: Camping Presqu'Ile de Champaubert
properties.description:
Camping Presqu'Ile de Champaubert is located in Braucourt, right next to the vast Lac du Der, one of the largest man-made lakes in Western Europe. The campsite is on a peninsula and surrounded by space, water and nature. Thanks to its location by the lake and its sandy beach, this is a great place for a relaxing holiday, combining rest and recreation.

Large pitches and accommodation

The campsite has large pitches for tents, caravans and motor homes, with electricity connection and water taps nearby. The pitches are spread over a green area and provide enough privacy. There are also various mobile homes for rent, suitable for multiple people. This accommodation is practical and a comfortable base for anyone wanting to combine camping with extra convenience.

Facilities for a carefree stay

Camping Presqu'Ile de Champaubert has various facilities for young and old. There is a heated and covered swimming pool with a separate children's pool, a playground and sports fields. For a snack and drink, head to the restaurant and snack bar. There’s also a small shop for essentials and bread service. The campsite is suitable for families, couples and anyone who loves water and nature.

Active enjoyment around Lac du Der

From the campsite, walk to the sandy beach of Lac du Der to swim, sail or relax by the water. Around the lake, there are cycle paths and walking trails with views of the countryside and nature reserves. The town of Montier-en-Der is about ten kilometres away with its shops and restaurants.

properties.name: Resort & Camping - Val de Braye
properties.description:
Resort & Camping - Val de Braye is in the charming city of Bessé-sur-Braye, on the outskirts of the French department of Sarthe. Here, you camp in a quiet setting right by River Braye. This spaciously laid out campsite has a small restaurant, two well-maintained toilet blocks and various sports and games facilities, among others. Moreover, this campsite is right next to a large municipal swimming pool. The rural surroundings are perfect for going on lovely bike rides. Furthermore, there are numerous impressive castles to admire in the Sarthe.

Camping by the water

As a camper, you have plenty of choice at this campsite. If you like to be near the water and on a sunny pitch, then ask for a touring pitch on the banks of the Braye. Those wanting more shade are best picking a camping pitch in the middle of Resort & Camping - Val de Braye.

Furthermore, this campsite has several types of accommodation for hire. You can book a stay in a mobile home, a chalet or a real tipi tent.

Swim for free in the municipal swimming pool

Resort & Camping - Val de Braye is right next to a large swimming pool that you can use for free as a campsite guest. This is a swimming pool complex with both an indoor as well as outdoor swimming pool. Both pools are large enough to enjoy swimming laps. The outdoor part also has a spectacular water slide, while a hot tub and fun paddling pool are available indoors.

properties.name: Camping Les Saules
properties.description:
In a wooded area, a stone's throw away from the famous castles of the Loire you will find Camping Les Saules, a place of peace, relaxation and space. You will find the campsite in the vicinity of Cheverny in the department Loir-et-Cher. This area offers you a wide range of options: active walking and cycling, leisurely enjoying culture and nature. You imagine yourself in the green garden of France.

Quiet and space

Almost all the camping pitches have ample shade so that it is pleasant even in the height of summer. Here and there there is a pitch that goes without, however. Have you brought your tent? If so, you can use a field, fitting in nicely with the rest of the grounds, with like-minded fellow campers. The entire campsite has been attractively laid out with easy to reach pitches. Rental accommodation comprises chalets (from 24 to 36 m2), bungalow tents and sporty tents. In short: something for everyone.

Activities

The campsite mainly caters for people looking for peace, nature and culture. As a result, teenagers may not feel in their element here. There are covered and heated swimming pools with separate toddler pools. Near the reception there are several sports options and you can also rent a bicycle (with handy route descriptions).

Shop/restaurant

Similar to the reception, the shop and restaurant building also has a Spanish appearance. The restaurant, just like a Spanish bodega in France, has a fairly extensive menu and reasonably priced daily menus. The shop stocks everything you need and has fresh bread every morning.

properties.name: Flower Camping Les 3 Ours
properties.description:
Camping Les 3 Ours lies in the town of Montbarrey (the Jura) and is situated on the Loue river. This makes the campsite an ideal base for a true holiday in nature. However, you can also enjoy their own swimming pool (outdoor pool). In addition, numerous activities are organised for children and there are several sports fields (pétanque, volleyball, badminton). Walkers and cyclists will, of course, explore the beautiful surrounding area.

Paddling almost directly from your tent

The campsite lies directly on the Loue river and immediately creates a pleasant impression because of the vegetation. The pitches on the water's edge, in particular, offer a splendid view. Get those feet out of the tent and into the water! The camping pitches are neatly demarcated with low hedges. Shade and privacy are created by the numerous trees on the grounds.

Restaurant with a fine menu

The campsite has its own restaurant with an amiable bar. The campsite shop stocks basic items, but there are sufficient large supermarkets and speciality shops in Montbarrey and Dole.

Clean sanitary facilities

The sanitary facilities are located near the reception. They are well maintained.

Beautiful historic walking tour

You can follow various signposted walking trails directly from the campsite. There is a very interesting trail along the path of the 'radliers' (wood rafters) who used the river in the past to transport their felled logs. You can follow this trail for some four or five hours before it ends at an authentic forester's dwelling.

properties.name: Camping Du Pont Vert
properties.description:
Du Pont Vert Campsite is situated along the Drée River, in the middle of Burgundy. Its simplicity is its strength: providing basic facilities without all the unnecessary bells and whistles helps ensure you'll experience the peace and tranquillity of nature in Burgundy. This campsite is therefore especially well suited for peace seekers, cyclists and fishing enthusiasts. Looking for a nice place to go for a bike ride? Then cycle to the Renaissance castle Château de Sully.

Camping in nature

This is a quiet and well-maintained campsite. You'll be camping on a large campsite in the middle of nature, with the most beautiful touring pitches located on the banks of the river. Low hedges help demarcate the 71 camping pitches, which are nicely shaded by tall trees. Situated among these touring pitches are about twenty rental accommodations: standard mobile homes, but also cosy hikers' cabins (especially suitable in the winter months).

Warm bread rolls

The campsite's simple facilities contribute to its calm atmosphere. There's no supermarket on site, just a simple snack bar. For groceries its best to drive to the centre of Épinac. This is only a short drive, less than one kilometre. The bakery is even closer. You can walk there to get fresh bread rolls in the morning...

Trip to Château de Sully

Château de Sully is located north of the town of Sully, six kilometres from the campsite. It is one of the larger Renaissance castles in Burgundy. Its completely surrounded by a moat and has richly decorated rooms. If you've brought your bicycle along on holiday, then you can cycle to the castle.

properties.name: Camping d'Autun
properties.description:
Camping d'Autun is a quiet campsite in the Bourgogne, situated along a river. It is a very green campsite, giving you the feeling that you are camping in the middle of nature. The historical town of Autun, meanwhile, is just one kilometre away. Seniors and people looking for peace and quiet in particular will feel right at home at campsite d'Autun, both in the low and in the peak season. Do you fancy a quick bite to eat? Then visit the snack bar at the campsite.

Camping out in the open or with more privacy?

There is enough privacy available during your camping holiday at this campsite near Autun. Some of the pitches are separated by tall hedges. Do you prefer camping with a wide, open view? Then you can camp on the field, under the trees. And your faithful four-footed friend is also welcome on campsite d'Autun. If you would like to experience camping life but with slightly more luxury than in a tent or caravan, you can rent one of the luxury mobile homes on the campsite. These are suitable for four to six people.

Quiet campsite in the low and peak seasons

In July and August, children between the ages of 4 and 12 can really enjoy themselves at the Kids' Club, which organises one or two fun activities every week. There is also a playground with a slide, a table tennis table and a boules court. And, seeing as the campsite is situated by the river, you can also go canoeing here.

properties.name: Camping Huttopia La Plage Blanche
properties.description:
This well-organised campsite is located not far from the village of Ounans. Here you'll camp at the foot of the Jura mountain range with the Loue river flowing past the campsite. The area is hilly and has many rivers, lakes and streams. La Plage Blanche is a true campsite for lovers of space and nature.

Lovely location on the Loue

The leafy campsite is located right on the north bank of the Loue. This river offers the option to bathe, swim and canoe/kayak. You can hire equipment from Val'Nature - Sports Loisirs Jura, located at the entrance to the campsite. 

The pitches are spacious and have sufficient privacy. The loveliest pitches are right on the river. The rental accommodation consists of mobile homes and luxury tents on decks. Not far from the entrance is the swimming pool, complete with sunbathing lawn and parasols.

All kinds of activities

There is a playground for the kids on the campsite, a jeu-de-boules pitch and a few volleyball courts. For children from five to twelve years there is an entertainment team in high season for activities outdoors, such as archery and pony rides. On Wednesday evenings there are magic shows and concerts you can attend.

Pizzas, grilled dishes and salads

The cafeteria of Huttopia La Plage Blanche serves simple meals, such as pizzas, grilled dishes and salads. Of course, you can also come here for an ice cream or a drink to enjoy on the lovely terrace on the river. The shop offers only the basics, such as fresh bread. In Ounans there are more shops and in Dole a few large supermarkets.

properties.name: Camping Les Bruyères
properties.description:
Camping Les Bruyères is situated on the outskirts of the small town of La Clayette, in the southern part of the Bourgogne. You reach the campsite via provincial roads through a hilly area. Les Bruyères is a neat, quiet campsite on gently sloping grounds with some tall trees. Because the campsite is slightly elevated, you have a view of the large lake and the castle of La Clayette.

Camping with a view of the lake

There are camping pitches with a grassy surface and hardened pitches. These all vary in size and degree of shade. The sanitary facilities are basic, but neat and heated in low season. You can also rent chalets and bungalow tents. The chalets have a well-equipped kitchen, bathroom and terrace with view of the lake. The bungalow tents have a kitchenette and terrace with barbecue.

Free use of the municipal swimming pool

The municipal swimming pool with slide is adjacent to the entrance of the campsite. As a camping guest you have free access to the pool. To get to the lake, you go from the campsite down a flight of stairs to the road which runs along the lake. Please note: swimming in the lake is not allowed.

Sports activities

You can play mini-golf or a game of tennis on the campsite. There is also a multi sports field for basketball and more.  They also have fitness walking equipment. Want to explore the area by bicycle? You can rent electric bicycles from the campsite. Close to the campsite there are ample opportunities for walking, quad-biking, canoeing or fishing.

properties.name: Camping de Matour Onlycamp
properties.description:
A neatly maintained French family campsite in Burgundy's magnificent south Thanks to the campsite's stunning locale amidst the hills and a lake, you can take in the natural surroundings with just a 500-metre walk from the village of Matour's intimate city centre. Camping de Matour is right next to a large recreational park with a spacious outdoor swimming pool, sauna and playground that are available free of charge for camping guests. Explore the beautiful landscapes on foot or bicycle; the location marks a good starting point for tours of various lengths.

Camping in Burgundy

This welcoming campsite is easily accessible from the A6 motorway, on the well-known Route du Soleil. The quiet campsite is situated at the edge of the village of Matour. Your eyes will be drawn to a riot of colourful flowers nearby the main building visible from the campsite's entrance barrier. There, you'll find the reception and, behind that, a bar with terrace, followed below by one the sanitary buildings. The local shops are 500 metres away, including a very good bakery, a supermarket and assorted restaurants.

A range of beautiful pitches

Camping de Matour has approximately 80 pitches which are quite large, but sometimes the surface is not completely level. Visitors can choose from a good selection of sunny and shady places. The two sanitary buildings are clean and well maintained, one of which is fairly new. Would you like to enjoy that camping feeling, only with a bit more luxury? Camping de Matour's charming wooden chalets are on a separate field. And, if you overnight in one of the delightful lodge tents, you'll be close to the touring pitches.

properties.name: Flower Camping Le Périgord
properties.description:
Camping Le Périgord is in the heart of the green Périgord region, an area that invites you to get out and about. The campsite is near the River L'Isle, within walking distance of the charming village of Saint-Astier. Camp quietly in green surroundings; a terrace or bakery is always nearby. The campsite is simple, clean and attractively set up. Perfect for campers who like the outdoors and discovering the surroundings but also for families who like a relaxed holiday atmosphere.

Special accommodation

At Camping Le Périgord, you can choose from different types of pitches for tents, caravans and motor homes. Or stay in ready-made, furnished tents. Prefer more luxury? Then some surprising accommodation is available too. For example, a romantic wooden log cabin with a jacuzzi or a special geodome where you can see the stars at night.

Fun for young and old

The campsite's facilities will make your stay extra comfortable. Near the entrance, there’s a swimming pool, partly shaded, where you can cool down on hot days. Feel like being active? Play a game of volleyball or head to the multi-purpose sports field. There’s plenty for children to do, including mini golf and other games. After a great day, you can enjoy a tasty meal at the campsite’s restaurant too.

properties.name: Camping APV La Pélonie
properties.description:
Camping de la Pélonie is situated in a rural, forestry area in the Dordogne Blanc, a region with caves, castles and several beautiful towns and villages. You will find this campsite near St.-Antoine-Auberoche. The two swimming pools, one of which with three slides, are heated. The other swimming pool can be locked.
