There is no entertainment programme, although they have a mini club and disco evenings. The playgrounds (with trampoline) are favourite with young guests.

Demarcated, shaded pitches

Guests come here for peace and quiet and an opportunity to indulge in sports and activities. In summer, there are many families with young children and in low season the campsite is frequented by active senior citizens. The demarcated camping pitches of between 80 and 100 m2 on pathways are shaded by oak trees, birches and poplars. They also have fully-furnished mobile homes for rent.

Pig on a spit

From the restaurant you have a beautiful view of the campsite. There is a wide selection to choose from and you can also get pizzas, snacks and take-away meals. The camping shop only stocks the most essential groceries. On Monday evenings guests are invited to join around a large table for a 'pig-on-spit', which makes for great barbecue evenings. Wednesday evening is family evening for children's entertainment. Thursday night is musical night.

Pony riding

On the campsite you will find a sports field, a jeu-de-boule pitch and a table tennis table. Horseback riding, pony riding and archery are available at a fee. On Sundays there are pony and horse shows and on Mondays you can go for a ride yourself near the stables.

There are moderately difficult bicycle and walking trails in the vicinity.

properties.name: Camping Les Tourterelles
properties.description:
If your dream holiday is camping at a quiet and friendly campsite in the Dordogne, then you have found your perfect holiday destination in Camping Les Tourterelles. It's lovely at this quiet campsite in the woods with a nice outdoor swimming pool.

Camping in the shade

You arrive at a well-maintained site in a quiet and rural part of the Dordogne. With around 70 camping pitches and over 20 mobile homes, chalets and gîtes, this is a small-scale campsite. The camping pitches are spacious and there are six special motorhome pitches. You camp in the lovely countryside on a grass field under the shade of the trees.

Lovely swimming pool

And of course, an outdoor swimming pool is a must. It's ideal for cooling down on hot summer days or for doing some laps in the morning. There is a paddling pool for the little ones and a patio with sun loungers. The swimming pool was fully renovated in 2021.

Caves and markets

Les Tourterelles is in the middle of a quiet part of the Périgord, as the French call the Dordogne. It is a forested, hilly region with charming villages, old castles and enchanting caves. The campsite is five minutes from the ‘Grotte de Tourtoirac', a beautiful cave with rock formations that you can walk through during a guided tour of about an hour. The larger towns of Périgueux, Sarlat-la-Canéda and Brive-la-Gaillarde are less than 30 minutes away. An enjoyable tour of the smaller villages is highly recommended. There are often lovely antique and flea markets there in the summer.

properties.name: Camping du Lac de Miel
properties.description:
Camping Du Lac de Miel is located on a beautiful lake in the Limousin, near Beynat. On the sloping campsite you'll mainly see many mobile homes, but there are also touring pitches available. The campsite is situated in beautiful natural surroundings, and the terrain is wooded and green.

Mainly rental accommodations

The campsite stretches over seven hectares and consists of lawns with many trees. There are over 200 rental accommodations and 30 very spacious touring pitches available. Some of the touring pitches are laid out between the rental units, others are located together on separate fields.

Swimming pool and entertainment

Even on less beautiful days you can swim at campsite Du Lac de Miel, because there is a heated swimming pool with sliding roof. The separate heated paddling pool and water playground guarantee lots of water fun for the little ones. In addition to the swimming pool, you can also exercise on the sports fields. In high season there is an entertainment program for all ages.

Until the wee hours

In July and August, a limited range of groceries is available on the campsite. You can also buy fresh bread, but you have to order it in advance. There is no restaurant on the campsite, but there is a snack bar at the lake where you can get pizzas as well as snacks. In the evenings music is played at the snack bar, often until the wee hours.

Public sandy beach

The campsite is beautifully situated around the public sandy beach at the Lac de Miel. From the campsite you have direct access to the sandy beach. You can walk straight into the water for a refreshing dip.

properties.name: Camping Lac du Marandan Onlycamp
properties.description:
Camping Lac du Marandan borders on a lake with the same name. Campers will love playing, swimming, fishing or tanning in this location. The campsite is situated in the Isère region, in southeastern France. Camping with a view of the mountains of Parc Naturel Regional du Vercors on spacious pitches with lots of trees.

With lots of space around you

Considering that the camping grounds are 22 ha in size with only 100 pitches, you know that you will have ample space around your caravan, tent or chalet. The numerous trees also provide shade, lovely when the sunlight is a bit fierce.

Children keep themselves busy

A wide range of facilities will ensure a top holiday for you at Camping Lac du Marandan. Your offspring will be busy having fun in the water all day long. Whether it is building sand castles or filling the moat with water, children will keep themselves entertained. The playground with bouncer and the active entertainment team might pose a bit of a problem trying to get the children into bed at night...

Sports on and around the campsite

Near the campsite you will find a tennis court, jeu-de-boule pitch and activity hall. You can go fishing, look for shells and shellfish, take endless walks or enjoy paddlesurfing on the lake.

Eating

Don't feel like cooking after a hectic day? If so, visit the snackbar for a pizza or other take-away meal. Or enjoy a meal at the campsite restaurant.

properties.name: Camping Huttopia Val d'Ambin
properties.description:
Campsite Le Val d'Ambin is located in Savoy, on a quiet alpine meadow with a view of the surrounding mountain peaks. The nearby village of Brasmans at an altitude of 1200 metres consists of two hamlets, Bramans and Le Verney. The campsite has changed over 50 years, from a little property with a few campsites and cold shower to a full campsite with all of the facilities you need. There are spacious campsites for tents, caravans and campers, and tents and chalets to hire.

Panorama

Campsite Le Val d'Ambin is located in the high mountains of Savoy in a special location where you'll enjoy a 360 degree panorama. The location is lovely: the property is located next to a solitary old church in the midst of the mountain landscape. The stone reception building is built in local style. Here you'll find all of the information you need about mountain hikes and sports in the area.

On the front part of the property there are paved campsites. The campsite looks very well maintained with many flowers and an eye for detail. The spacious campsites on grass have some shade from the high trees and have limited separation. There are three sanitation blocks, also accessible to the disabled.

Mountain sports

In the summer, guests can have fun playing table tennis, on two tennis courts, on the volleyball court and the training course. For little ones there is a playground and a relaxation room with games and books. A themed path runs from the campsite to the villages. If you want to get out, the shuttle bus will take you to the valley or to the Vanoise national park. There you can climb, take a cable car ride, mountain bike and paraglide.

properties.name: Camping La Forêt
properties.description:
Forty kilometres from Sarlat, in the French Dordogne, you will find Camping La Forêt. This family campsite in the countryside has a quiet character. Enjoy beautiful views from your pitch, soak up the fresh air and take a dip in the pool. Relax on the spacious pitches or in one of the rental properties.

Peace, space and recreation

There is peace and conviviality on the campsite. The pitches are no less than 110-150 m² big. You can also choose one of the rental accommodations. With a swimming pool, playground and various sports fields, young and old will have a great time on the campsite. In high season there is also entertainment for children. There is also a relaxation area with various games, a billiard table and a library.

Necessary facilities

In high season the campsite supermarket is open with tasty regional products. Be sure to taste a wine from Bergerac. For big groceries it's best to go to Lalinde and Le Bugue. Fresh rolls and croissants are available every day upon reservation. This way you can start the day extra well! In the bar or restaurant you can relax with a nice snack and drink. Want to catch up with the home front in the meantime? Free wifi is available here.

Across the Dordogne

The Dordogne is a beautiful region in the South West of France. From the campsite you have a beautiful view, but you only really explore the region when you go out and about. Take a ride in the car, go cycling or go for a nice walk. You can also go canoeing on the river of the same name.

properties.name: Camping Les Bruyères
properties.description:
Les Bruyères Campsite is located in Sainte-Eulalie-en-Born, France, in the middle of the Landes forest. Here you will camping just south of the Biscarrosse-Parentis lake and a few miles from the Atlantic Ocean. The campsite offers a beach, nature and plenty of activities. It is fun for young and old alike!

Water fun and recreation

With a water park featuring two large pools and a paddling pool, water lovers will adore this place. And you're close to the beach too! It is just a twenty-minute drive to Mimizan-Plage, located on the Atlantic Ocean. Prefer a lake? There are numerous lakes in this wooded region. The nearby Landes de Gascogne Regional Natural Park, the largest landscaped forest in Europe, is a great place for cycling and hiking. You can also enjoy numerous other fun activities in the region. These include fishing, golfing, kayaking and horseback riding.

There are all kinds of things to do at the campsite as well. For example, there is an entertainment team that provides welcome cocktails, theme nights, a raffle, karaoke and boules competitions. In addition, there is a program of various activities for children. They can also have fun on the playground or on one of the sports fields.

Campsite facilities

With a snack bar, pizzeria and restaurant on site, there's always a tasty snack waiting for you. This is also the case in the mornings, when the campsite provides delicious fresh bread. There is also a grocery store at the campsite. A larger supermarket can be found in the village of Sainte-Eulalie-en-Born, a six-minute drive away.

properties.name: Camping Atlantica - Ciela Village
properties.description:
At the foot of the Pyrenees and just 650 m from the beaches on the Atlantic Coast, lies Camping Atlantica. You camp here in the French Basque Country, on a colourful campsite with attractive pitches laid out around a spacious swimming pool. Camping Atlantica is located near the town of Saint-Jean-de-Luz. The campsite is very popular with overnight guests en route to Spain or Portugal.

Spacious pitches

Many of the pitches stand out because of their size (up to 120 m2!). At the far end of the campsite are a few terraces where you will find the rental accommodation. These are also remarkably spacious. The pitches themselves look very well maintained and are easily reached via paved roads. Trees provide ample shade.

Entertainment and more

Lots to do at Atlantica. The campsite offers a diverse range of activities for all ages. For children, there is a kids' club with various age-appropriate activities. On site, there is everything you need to not be bored: multi-sports ground, aquagym, gym, playground, bouncy castle, theme nights, barbecues for teenagers, shows, etc.

Swimming pool and sandy beach

The swimming pool is very attractive and is divided into three baths, complete with slides and a toddler pool. There is a diverse entertainment programme here with aqua gym, water games and more fun. Around the swimming pool is a lawn and a terrace. As mentioned above, the beautiful sandy beach is only some 650 m away from the campsite.

Restaurant and services

Camping Atlantica has a restaurant with an attractive indoor dining room and a shaded terrace. The restaurant offers a menu with mainly Basque specialities. You will also find a bakery and a launderette on site. Several supermarkets can be found at a distance of approximately two kilometres from the campsite.

properties.name: Capfun Camping Côte Vermeille
properties.description:
Let yourself be carried away by the waves of the Mediterranean or the current of one of the adventurous water slides. The Côte Vermeille Campsite is a family campsite right by the sea in Languedoc-Roussillon. Here you can enjoy swimming in the huge water park. An ideal sun destination for a holiday with children of all ages: lots of splashing, sunbathing and lazing around!

Quiet location

At the Côte Vermeille Campsite, you and your loved ones can really get away from it all. You can spend the night in one of the fully equipped mobile homes or chalets. Because the campsite sits nestled between the trees and on the beach, you'll feel like you're in the middle of nowhere. But it's not actually that bad because you can be in the nice coastal town of Port-la-Nouvelle in no time. Here you can stroll along the harbour with sailing boats.

Walk to the beach

You'll have your feet in the sand after a five-minute walk from your camping spot. The beach here is so wide that it never seems crowded. You have plenty of space to run into the waves or build sandcastles. The beaches in this area are also known for being used for water sports.

Exciting slides

The people who run this campsite know all too well that swimming pools with slides are much more fun. Enjoy the crazy SpaceBowl slide, or compete on the two identical water slides. There's also a paddling pool with a water playground for the little ones. If the day turns a bit chilly, the roof of the heated swimming pool can be closed.

properties.name: Camping Mun. Les Rives du Lac
Camping Vicenza
properties.description:
Located in the heart of Veneto, Camping Vicenza is an ideal base for tourists wishing to visit the cities of Venice, Padua, Verona and Vicenza. It is also an excellent transit campsite, right by the motorway between Milan and Venice. The campsite has a fine swimming pool, a good restaurant and a beautiful shaded camping field.

Comfortable camping in the shade

When you arrive at the campsite, you will soon notice that there is a noise barrier between the main road and the campsite. This means that campers at Camping Vicenza do not experience too much noise from passing traffic. The campsite is green and shady. Paved pitches for camper vans or caravans are also available. It is also possible to rent a mobile home or even a tent.

Relax in the swimming pool and wellness centre

Would you like to take a refreshing dive or swim a few lengths? You can do so in the outdoor pool that belongs to the neighbouring Hotel Viest. For even more relaxation, various wellness facilities are available at the hotel. For example, make use of the sauna and steam bath in the beauty centre. For ultimate relaxation, choose one of the massages.

Try a delicious fish or meat dish in the restaurant

Those who return to the campsite in the evening after a successful, but tiring city visit will be pleased by the presence of the hotel restaurant and bar. This pleasant restaurant offers a wide selection of quality fish and meat dishes.

properties.name: Camping Village Tahiti
properties.description:
Camping Village Tahiti is located just to the south of the Podelta nature reserve, where the longest river in Italy flows into the Adriatic Sea. This spacious, well maintained campground has wonderful facilties. The three swimming pools and the spa facilities are really special. The campground also has a private beach. Camping Village Tahiti is an ideal campground for families with children through the many play and sporting options.

Camping and bungalow park

Camping Village Tahiti is located in Lido delle Nazioni (municipality of Comacchio). The campground is nicely designed and the campsites are all flat and have a great deal of shade. There are also bungalows and mobile homes for rent.

Quiet Mediterranean oasis with private beach

The campsite lives up to its name. One of the three pools, Atol Beach will remind you of a tropical atol with its palm trees. Aqua Therm Beach is in the shape of a Mediterranean lagoon, surrounded by cliffs and waterfalls. There is also a 25 metre pool and a private beach (800 m from the campground).

Spa Park

The Spa Thermae Oasis has its own spring with thermal mineral water. It is the perfect place to relax.

So much to do

Camping Village Tahiti provides full entertainment and is ideal for families with children. An activities team provides a programme every day with sports, recreation and educational activities for even the youngest campers (Mini Club) and for adults.

Culinary enjoyment

Tickle your taste buds in one of the two restaurants, both serve wonderful pizzas in addition to Italian and international meat and fish dishes. You can enjoy a drink, snack or ice cream in the Discopub while enjoying the view over the pools.

properties.name: Camping  e village Heliopolis SRL
properties.description:
Camping Heliopolis is in the Italian region of Abruzzen, right by the Adriatic Sea. You camp at about 30 kilometres from the coastal resort of Pescara. The region is relatively unknown and there are plenty of wonderful things to discover, from picturesque villages to impressive mountain ranges. There is a lovely swimming pool, a private beach with sun loungers and parasols, an Italian restaurant and entertainment for the whole family.

Camping pitches with our without private toilet and washing facilities

When you access the site, the size and many flowers stand out. You can choose from various camping pitches. There are pitches with private toilet and washing facilities and a kitchenette. If you would rather hire accommodation, there are plenty to choose from. They range from villas, bungalows to mobile homes. Your pet is welcome on most pitches.

Lots of water fun in the sea or swimming pool

There is a lovely triangular swimming pool by the campsite entrance. There is a separate paddling pool for small campers. Sun loungers surround the swimming pool, where you can relax and unwind or read a good book. If you'd rather go for a swim in the sea, you can do that too! In fact, the campsite has a private beach that is 150 metres long and where children can play safely.

Entertainment for young and old

The campsite has an enthusiastic entertainment team that organises fun activities for all ages. There is the Mini Club for children from 4 to 12 and the Junior Club for the older children. Adults can also keep busy here with fitness, Zumba, Pilates and aqua aerobics.

properties.name: International Glamping Lago Di Bracciano
properties.description:
International Glamping Lago Di Bracciano is situated in a quiet location on the banks of Lake Bracciano. The beautiful lake is surrounded by twelve hills and is formed by a volcanic crater. Here you will camp in the protected Bracciano-Martignano Nature Reserve, of which the lake is a part. The attractive small town of Trevignano Romano is only 4 km away and has a lovely boulevard.

To Rome!

The well maintained campsite is situated only 50 km north of the Italian capital Rome. There is a good public transport connection to centre of the city. The bustling city is in contrast to the quiet atmosphere of the campsite.

Camping amidst green

All camping pitches at International Glamping Lago Di Bracciano are well maintained. At the lake are also some camping pitches along the water. Many pitches have trees or flowering bushes, finding a shady spot is therefore not a problem. In addition to camping with your own equipment, you can also rent lodge tents, bungalows and mobile homes on the campsite.

Get into the water

Adjacent to the restaurant is a small, but beautiful swimming pool. On the lawn around the swimming pool are loungers and sun umbrellas. The small playground is also located next to the pool. If you prefer swimming in the lake, you can enter the private beach from the campsite. This lake is one of the cleanest lakes in the country!

Real Italian pizza

A holiday in Italy would not be complete without a tasty pizza, of course. Fortunately, you don't have to look any further, because at International Glamping Lago Di Bracciano they are only too happy to prepare one for you.

properties.name: Camping Kautenbach
properties.description:
Situated in the bend of the Clerve River, Camping Kautenbach boasts a unique location in a wooded area. Ideal to explore the Luxembourg Ardennes by bicycle or on foot. Children also enjoy themselves on this campsite, which, in 2014, was declared one of the most hospitable campsites of Luxembourg.

Slightly north-east of the small village of Kautenbach and in the heart of a vast hiking area, you will find this friendly campsite. For over 60 years Camping Kautenbach has been a paradise for nature lovers as well as a convenient base for cultural excursions to the many beautiful towns in this small country, such as Vianden and Diekirch.

Go anywhere you want

There are 180 camping pitches to choose from which are located under or near tall trees. The touring pitches are divided over a fairly large terrain and are on attractive and well maintained lawns. Tent owners are allocated a nice pitch of approx. 50 m2. Motorhomes and caravans will have a site of approx. 100-120 m2. Lots of hikers also rent accommodation.

Fun playing outside!

Playing outside is a real adventure here. Children cannot be lured away from the shallow river where they can splash around, paddle or float on the water. The water laps calmly past the campsite and can easily be reached from the banks. The river bank is also a lovely spot to soak up the sun. There is also a playground and you can practise various sports.

properties.name: Camping Martbusch
properties.description:
Camping Martbusch is situated in the heart of one of the most beautiful regions of Luxembourg: the Müllerthal. The campsite is harmoniously situated in the recreational area of Berdorf, in close vicinity of playgrounds, a mini golf course and sports fields for beach volleyball, soccer and basket ball. Signposted walking paths and mountain biking routes lead you from the camping grounds into overwhelming nature and eventually to the rock climbing region of Waanterbach.

A pristine campsite

Upon arrival you can tell straight away that you are staying at a well maintained campsite (newly laid out pathways). The neatly pruned trees separate some of the pitches while other pitches are separated by hedges. There is a new sanitary building with modern and well cared for sanitary equipment. Rental accommodation consists of mobile homes and 'pods', both two-person and four-person units. A 'pod' is a modern version of the trekker hut and is equipped with a kitchenette.

Shop and catering

Unfortunately, there is no shop or restaurant on the camping grounds, but Berdorf offers a wide selection of hotel-restaurants with Italian, Chinese, French or indigenous dishes. Adjacent to the camping is also a small snack bar where you can get something to eat or drink. However, there are hardly any shops in Berdorf, so that you will have to go to Echternach for your grocery shopping.

Sanitary facilities

Spread over the campsite are two ablution blocks, one of which has recently undergone a complete renovation. The sanitary facilities are adequate for the number of guests on the campsite. The renovated ablution block is equipped with roomy showers, family showers and special children facilities.

properties.name: Camping 't Strandheem
properties.description:
't Strandheem Campsite lies in a natural and quiet location in the far north of the country, between the lively provincial capitals of Groningen and Leeuwarden. Children of all ages will have the time of their lives here; they will even be one step ahead with the welcoming Brems family. Next to the campsite there is a large recreational lake where guests can enjoy the beautiful sandy beach. But that's not all there is at this family campsite. An indoor swimming pool, a covered playground, a snack bar and many lively activities organised with plenty of enthusiasm by the double entertainment team; 't Strandheem Campsite offers everything you need for a relaxing holiday.

Camping

There are more than 200 pitches divided between multiple compact camping fields with lots of trees. The pitches are not divided from one another, creating an open atmosphere. The size of the pitches varies, from standard pitches, to comfort pitches which are very spacious. If you're coming with the car, you can park at your pitch.

Barefoot walking

Between Peebos and the Kalewag, about 10 minutes' drive from the campsite, there is a special path: 't Blôde Fuottenpaad, the Barefoot Path. Here you can experience the beautiful natural surroundings in a different way; walk the 3km round trip on bare feet. Enjoy walking through the mud, water and grass. On the way, you can relax in a hammock or on a bench. On one side of the Kaleweg, there is water with a beach. At Peebos, you can have a drink. If you'd prefer to leave your shoes or boots on, that's allowed too. It's all about enjoying being outdoors with each other.

properties.name: Ronostrand
properties.description:
Camping Ronostrand is located on a recreational lake in the Drenthe countryside. On this family campsite you camp between the woods, on demarcated lawns. Your children will have the time of their lives here. Together with entertainers Rik and Sunny, they can play and dance here every school holiday during the children's disco. But the child-friendly swimming lake also offers a lot of fun.

Pitch/rental accommodation

You will find almost four hundred camping pitches on the extensive camping grounds. About half of these pitches are reserved for regular guests. The camping pitches are located between these permanent annual pitches, but also on separate camping fields. Because the camping pitches are on separate lawns, which are demarcated with plants, you can enjoy a peaceful camping experience. The camping pitches themselves are not demarcated, which creates a spacious feeling. No camping equipment? Then book a mobile home, hiker's cabin, bungalow or lodge tent.

Pizza or pancakes

The restaurant with its large terrace is located on the beach and the recreational lake. You can go there for an ice cream in between swimming, but also for lunch, pizza or a three-course dinner. Be sure to take a seat on the beautiful panorama terrace, which offers a fantastic view of the water. Great for the kids: they also serve pancakes in the restaurant.

Swimming!

The showpiece of Ronostrand is, without a doubt, its swimming lake. Not only does this water, surrounded by forests, provide a beautiful camping spot, it also offers many recreational opportunities. For example, swimming! The lake is shallow at the edges: ideal for small children so they can safely wade and paddle. The older children and adults can swim in the deeper part. After a dip in the water, you can dry up on the large sandy beach or the grassy meadow.

properties.name: EuroParcs Molengroet
properties.description:
Looking to enjoy a holiday filled with fun in the water? We've got just the campsite for you in the heart of North Holland! EuroParcs Molengroet is located in the middle of the Geestmerambacht recreation area, which features a wonderful swimming lake and beautiful nature. It'll be difficult to choose between the park's swimming pool or a refreshing dip in the lake. Besides the activities in or around the park, there is plenty to see and do in the surrounding area. Discover Alkmaar (8 km) with its famous cheese market. A little further out, but easily accessible by car, is Egmond aan Zee (17 km). This is a nice destination for a day at the beach.

Tent, glamping or a chalet

At EuroParcs Molengroet you can camp on a beautiful pitch or opt for a rental accommodation. The camping pitches are spacious and vary in size from 80 to 100 m².

But you can also go glamping. There are glamping tents for 2 to 6 people for rent. For even more comfort, choose one of the many bungalows or chalets. You can also relax in the wooded areas surrounding these rental accommodations.

From swimming pool to the North Sea

You don't have to go far to enjoy fun water recreation activities at the park. Your children will quickly find their way to the heated swimming pool. Do not feel like swimming? Then enjoy the sun on the tranquil sunbathing lawn.

Lake Zomerdel (400m) is a great place to take a dip in natural waters. In addition to swimming, you can also go fishing and supping here. You can alternate a day at the swimming lake with a day at the beach. Within half an hour's drive you can have your feet in the sand at Egmond aan Zee.

There's much more to do besides all the water recreation activities in and around the park. Jump on the large air trampoline or play a game of basketball or table tennis. There are also several playgrounds. During the summer holidays children (12 years of age and younger) can also enjoy playing and doing crafts with the entertainment team.

properties.name: EuroParcs Enkhuizer Strand
properties.description:
EuroParcs Enkhuizer Strand is on the banks of Lake IJssel, just outside the beautiful fortified city of Enkhuizen (North Holland). Enkhuizen is at the most eastern point of North Holland, so it is largely surrounded by Lake IJssel. Thanks to this location and the extensive water sports options, Enkhuizen is very popular with tourists. Here you camp in an area that always has a nice holiday atmosphere. Enkhuizer Strand is also still a new park. As a camper you can benefit from luxury facilities here, including toilet and washing facilities that were renovated in 2023.

Paved camping pitches and glamping options

There is an info point, also called the lobby, at the front of the campsite. It's the location of the reception, where enthusiastic receptionists welcome new camping guests. To the right of reception, there is a large site with paved pitches for caravans and motorhomes.

If you like camping but want the same luxury as at home during your holiday, then you can book a stay in a luxury holiday home at EuroParcs Enkhuizer Strand. Glamping enthusiasts can also come to EuroParcs Enkhuizer Strand for one of the four modern lodge tents located beside the camping pitches.

Enkhuizen beach and Recreatiebad Enkhuizer Zand (swimming pool) at walking distance

This campsite is a good holiday address for water sports enthusiasts. This holiday park has a private boat ramp and there are plenty of options for windsurfing and kite surfing, and other activities, in the immediate vicinity. Furthermore, you are only a 15-minute walk from Enkhuizen beach. Recreatiebad Enkhuizerzand is right near there. This is a lovely indoor swimming pool with a competition pool, a recreational pool and a spectacular water slide.

properties.name: EuroParcs Buitenhuizen
properties.description:
You will enjoy a nice holiday between the beach and the bustling capital city of Amsterdam at EuroParcs Buitenhuizen. Although close to various cities, you stay in the middle of the Spaarnwoude recreational area. Will you choose a relaxed day at the beach, a city tour through Amsterdam or a hike in the woods? You can do all of these here! In the park itself, enjoy the swimming pool, relax in the wellness facilities or play a game of golf on the nearby golf course. A delicious bite to eat and a drink can be had in the restaurant.

Luxurious accommodations in a green setting

EuroParcs Buitenhuizen is a spacious park with much greenery and water. You can choose from various luxury accommodations. There are tiny houses, chalets and studios, some of which have a terrace on the waterfront. It is good to know that EuroParcs Buitenhuizen is close to Schiphol, meaning you can sometimes hear low-flying planes.

Swimming pool, goats and golf

Begin your day with a refreshing swim in the outdoor swimming pool. This heated pool is open from the end of April to October. More fun can be had at the playgrounds with bouncy castles, at the jeu de boules court, the multi-sports field and the table-tennis table. Animal lovers will enjoy the goat pasture and the butterfly garden.

Bustling cities, beach and the beauty of nature

The location of EuroParcs Buitenhuizen is ideal if you like to go out. In half an hour you can be in Amsterdam (29 km). Cities such as Haarlem (14.5 km) and Zaandam (25 km) are also in the area. Visit the famous Zaanse Schans with its windmills.

properties.name: EuroParcs Poort van Amsterdam
properties.description:
Waterland is a region north of Amsterdam, consisting largely of a peatland area with ditches and canals. EuroParcs Poort van Amsterdam is located in the east of Waterland, next to the Markermeer, in the village of Uitdam. There are stunning views of the Markermeer from many places on this holiday park. It's also the ideal base for visits to Marken and Volendam. Both these tourist attractions are less than fifteen minutes' drive away.

Various types of accommodation in Zaandam style

Camping pitches are available at this resort, but the main focus is on accommodation. At EuroParcs Poort van Amsterdam, you can book a luxury holiday home for 4 to 18 people or large hotel rooms. Free wi-fi is available throughout EuroParcs Poort van Amsterdam.

Indoor swimming pool and wellness amenities

Just behind the reception, you’ll find the swimming pool at EuroParcs Poort van Amsterdam. This is a lovely indoor pool with a beautiful paddling pool with a real pirate ship. You can also relax in the wellness area in the same building. You can use a sauna and a Turkish steam bath there.

Entertainment for young and older children

Planning to visit this holiday park with children? Then we recommend you book to come in one of the school holidays. They’ll love the Fun Heroes entertainment that’s on site then. The programme includes children's shows, active and exciting games and tasks in which children can let their creativity run wild.

properties.name: EuroParcs Zuiderzee
properties.description:
A lovely indoor swimming pool, playgrounds sports fields, restaurants and numerous fun activities in the high season. One thing is for sure, EuroParcs Zuiderzee is a campsite where families with children feel right at home.

This holiday park is a few kilometers from Biddinghuizen, right on the beach. On hot days, you can go for a wonderfully refreshing swim in Lake Veluwe. There are also various water sports options (such as windsurfing, canoeing and pedal boating) and there is an exclusive marina with jetties.

In the immediate vicinity, as well as pleasant walks and bike rides, you can go over the dyke or through the forest next to the campsite. Furthermore, this holiday park is near Walibi Holland theme park and lovely places such as Harderwijk and Elburg.

Book a lovely camping pitch by the beach

Holiday homes dominate at this holiday park. There are also glamping options at EuroParcs Zuiderzee. In fact, you can hire extremely luxurious holiday villas here but they also have nice lodge tents and tiny houses.

There are also a large number of camping pitches available. If you decide to book a pitch at EuroParcs Zuiderzee, you will be camping on a neat pitch close to the beach. Around the camping fields there are various communal parking spaces where you can park your car.

Lovely swimming pool with spectacular slides

This campsite's lovely indoor swimming pool is in the main building, or Plaza, at the front of the site. The swimming pool at EuroParcs Zuiderzee has a spectacular slide measuring a grand 40 metres in length. The youngest campers will have great time in the paddling pool with the pirate ship.

properties.name: EuroParcs De Zanding
properties.description:
With its beautiful forests and vast heathlands, De Hoge Veluwe National Park is one of the most beautiful nature parks in the Netherlands. EuroParcs De Zanding is on the outskirts of this national park, in the village of Otterlo, in the middle of the Veluwe. Here, you camp about two kilometres from Ingang Otterlo, one of the three entrances to the park. The impressive sand drifts of Het Kootwijkerzand are just north of De Hoge Veluwe. The campsite itself has a private swimming lake with sandy beach, an indoor swimming pool and a restaurant, among other things. You have free WiFi throughout EuroParcs De Zanding.

Many luxury accommodation and several camping fields

Glamping lovers with have the time of their lives at EuroParcs De Zanding. You will find various types of luxury holiday home at this forested site. You can book a stay in a villa, but you can also spend the night in a tiny house, a fully equipped lodge tent, a modern chalet or group accommodation, for example. Dogs are welcome in some of the accommodation at EuroParcs De Zanding. At the rear of the site, this holiday park has created space for several camping fields.

Swimming in the recreational lake and indoor pool

This is an excellent holiday address for swimming enthusiasts. There is a lovely swimming lake on the site. This lake is completely encircled by a sandy beach. There are trees around it providing the necessary shade. You can also go swimming in the indoor pool. By this swimming pool, you will also find a paddling pool and a wellness zone with Finnish sauna, infrared cabin, Turkish steam bath and heated relaxation benches.

properties.name: Capfun Camping Vlinderloo
properties.description:
On the outskirts of the town of Enschede lies Capfun Holiday Park Vlinderloo. So close to town and yet amidst nature, this only happens in Twente. At this family campsite there is plenty to do for all. Take a refreshing dive in the swimming pool, play a game of table tennis or fish for carp in the campsite fishing pond. A campsite for all

Vlinderloo Holiday Park offers various types of accommodation. Choose a comfortable mobile home or one of the chalets by the water, for example. There are also mobile homes specially equipped for children, including a colourful playroom with toys. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the campsite.

Cool off in the swimming pool

You can cool off in one of the swimming pools. The holiday park has a heated outdoor pool, a paddling pool and an indoor pool. Another fun feature is the space bowl, a spectacular waterslide.

Catering and shop on the grounds

The holiday park has a cafeteria, a restaurant and a camping shop for your daily grocery shopping. Obviously, Enschede offers ample opportunities for shopping or a bite to eat. 

All types of activities

There are various play areas for children throughout the park. The playground with its colourful play castle is particularly striking. In high season, children can take part in activities organised by the entertainment team. At the kids' club, they can do crafts, dance and take part in a treasure hunt or one of the other games. Sports tournaments and other activities are also organised. The grounds also feature a pump track, fishing pond and table tennis tables.

properties.name: Camping Aan Veluwe
properties.description:
Camping Aan Veluwe is a quiet campsite in a beautiful, wooded and hilly area. It is the ideal place for nature lovers, those seeking peace and quiet, hikers and cyclists. All pitches have a private bathroom, which is great if you want some extra privacy during your camping holiday. This campsite has no entertainment and no swimming pool, but there is a lot of greenery, a jeu de boules court and a table-tennis table. Surrounded by woods, a lovely hiking trail is never far away. For this reason, you are free to take your dog along to this campsite.

Charm within walking distance

The car-free pitches at Camping Aan Veluwe are extra-large. They are perfect for setting up your tent or caravan. There are also several partially paved pitches. Next to the campsite is a sports park, which may be a source of noise at times. There is no restaurant at the campsite, but the village of Oosterbeek (2.5 km), which is within walking distance, has a charming centre with shops and places to eat. If you are a nature lover, you can indulge yourself in nature reserves such as Planken Wambuis, the Deelerwoud or the Hoge Veluwe National Park. There is also a beautiful Klompenpad or pathway, the Rosandepad, along the Lower Rhine.

Visit Arnhem

Next to Oosterbeek lies the capital city of Gelderland, Arnhem (9 km). Cycle to the Dutch Open Air Museum and Burgers’ Zoo, go shopping in the Modekwartier (the fashion quarter) and in Arnhem’s charming city centre or wander through the beautiful Sonsbeek Park or Zypendaal Park. Somewhat further away from the campsite is the Kröller-Müller Museum (20 km) and the Veluwezoom National Park (19 km).

properties.name: EuroParcs Limburg
properties.description:
EuroParcs Limburg holiday park is in the 'green waistline of Limburg', the narrowest piece of the Netherlands. This holiday park is in the border region and close to charming villages and cities such as Sittard (9 km), Roermond (21 km), Heerlen (32 km) and the Belgian Maasmechelen (22 km). Furthermore, the park is surrounded by forests, fields and grassland so a trip to the countryside is never far away.

A neat park with lovely little houses

You won't find any camping pitches at Europarcs Limburg, but you can choose from a variety of holiday homes. The site is well-maintained and the holiday homes look neat too.

You can choose from cute tiny houses, bungalows and large accommodation. These holiday homes are typified by their modern appearance. Most houses have many windows, making it very bright inside. Furthermore, the houses have a neat kitchen, a living room and a modern bathroom.

Indoor swimming pool with wellness amenities

The park has an indoor swimming pool with wellness amenities that is open from Wednesday to Sunday. There is a separate paddling pool for the youngest visitors. Relax and unwind in the wellness centre that includes a sauna, Turkish steam bath and an infrared cabin. If it's a hot day, go for a swim in the refreshing nature and beach pool.

Sports, games and climbing

Don't forget to bring your sports shoes along because the site also has a multi-functional sports field. For children there is a nature playground with a bouncy castle, climbing equipment, swings and playground equipment in the sand. And if the weather is less favourable, the children can run around and play in the indoor playground.

properties.name: Euro-Camp Wilder Kaiser
properties.description:
Camping in Tirol means mountain walks in summer and skiing in winter. Convenient therefore that Euro Camp Wilder Kaiser is open throughout the year. Kössen is the nearest town, located at some 3 km from the campsite. From many pitches you have a view of an attractive part of the Kaiser mountains, the Wilder Kaiser.

Camping in a Tyrolean Almhut

If you are lucky, you may still have a choice of various camping pitches. The camping pitches vary quite a bit in size. There are a few trees on the touring section of the campsite, which provide shade during summer days. Would you prefer to rent a mobile home? No problem, throughout the year! Or you can opt for one of the Tyrolean alpine huts (suitable for two people) with stunning views over the valley.

Fine dining in the restaurant

The campsite seems to consist of two sections. On the one side of the street lies the campsite with reception and all amenities, on the other side you will find a second restaurant and a large playground. The well stocked supermarket offers everything to prepare your own meals.

River walks

Sporty holiday makers never want for things to do. They have a host of activities at their disposal. How about walking and cycling trips to the attractions in the area.

In winter you can hit the slopes for skiing. In summer children will soon make new friends at the swimming pool, where parents can join in for water aerobics. Moreover, you can do mountain climbing, rafting, kayaking and -very special- river walking.

properties.name: Wellness Seecamping Parth GmbH
properties.description:
Wellness Seecamping Parth is a beautiful terraced campsite located on the south side of the Ossiacher See, Carinthia's third largest lake. The nature here is beautiful because of the many lakes, forests and mountains. The campsite has about 150 touring pitches and 20 rental accommodations. Several pitches offer a beautiful view over the lake. The wellness centre - including a sauna, solarium and whirlpool - is also a great asset of the campsite.

Camping and renting

The camping pitches at Wellness Seecamping Parth are beautiful and varied. Large, small, standard or with more comfort; just what you want. There are also some rooms, mobile homes and lodges for rent. The wellness facilities attract many campers who love luxury. They can enjoy a sauna, whirlpool, steam bath, solarium and various massages (for a fee).

On the lake

Holidaymakers come here to swim, canoe, dive, sail or fish. You can bring your own boat or hire a canoe or boat at the campsite. There is also plenty of other equipment. For example, bicycles, mountain bikes, surfboards or diving equipment. So you don't have to bring all that along from home. The beach by the lake consists of pebbles. There is also a sunbathing area.

Fun on dry land

Nobody needs to be bored at this campsite. The youngest campers can join the mini club and the entertainment team. There is also a playground and plenty of opportunity for sports. Think table tennis, tennis (course possible), fitness and minigolf. There are also many organised activities for adults, including guided walks and yoga by the lake. Entertainment is offered in English and German.

properties.name: Ursand Resort & Camping
properties.description:
Not far from Vänersborg on the banks of the Vänern, you'll find Ursands Resort & Camping. The campground has a lovely sandy beach along the largest lake in the country. The campsites are located among the trees: ideal for the warm summer days that are not unusual here. You can take walks and cycling tours right from the campground in the varied landscape of Västergötland.

Impressive greenery

The greenery on Ursands Resort & Camping makes a great first impression: wherever you look you'll see trees around the campsites. There are special paved campsites and along the beach there are spaces for tents. The rental holiday homes and mobile homes are spread around the site. From simple and small to large and luxurious.

Children's paradise

Ursands Resort & Camping is ideal for families. Children can play safely and swim in the new swimming pool with various slides. There are numerous activities for the young camper, primarily in the high seasons, and there is a special playground with supervision and pedal car rental.

Shop and restaurant

Even though the campground is not far from Vänersborg, it is easy to do your shopping in the shop on site for daily groceries. The restaurant is in a lovely location and offers an amazing view of the lake. In the high season (15/6 - 31/8) we recommend the dish of the day (dagens rätt).

Surroundings

Vänersborg and Trollhättan are charming towns where there is great shopping. They are both on the Göta älv, that connects the Vänern to the North Sea (Kattegat).

properties.name: Degernäs Camping
properties.description:
Degernäs Camping is in a quiet area, right by Lake Möckeln and surrounded by typical Swedish woodlands. This is a neatly maintained campsite with new toilet and washing facilities and a private sandy beach by the recreational lake. Special dog shows take place here several times a year. Degernäs Camping is in the town of Degerfors, about 50 kilometres west of the city of Örebro.

At Degernäs Camping, you camp in a sparsely populated area in the Swedish Värmland landscape. The area around Degerfors is mainly forested. You will frequently encounter photogenic lakes during walks and cycle rides.

Select your pitch carefully on this sloping site.

After arriving at the campsite, you can choose from various marked pitches. There are unmarked pitches for tents on the river side. The camping pitches are spacious, but they are not all equally level. There are also accommodation for hire, including a number of lovely hiker's cabins. Some are right by the lake. A number of huts are suitable for people with limited mobility. The toilet and washing facilities at the campsite are good. There are adequate toilet and washing facilities and a large part of them are new.

Go for a refreshing dip in Lake Möckeln

Degernäs Camping is right by Lake Möckeln, where it is safe to swim. You walk straight out of your tent onto the sandy beach and into the water! Swimming jetties are installed on hot days, so that you can also literally dive into this recreational lake. There is an outdoor playground by the lake. Fun activities are regularly organised for children in the summer holidays.

properties.name: Camping de l'Ile Onlycamp
properties.description:
On the left bank of the Loire, in the village of Cosne-Cours-sur-Loire, you'll find Camping de l'Ile. Here you'll be camping right along the river in a wooded area. The campsite is part of Aquadis Loisirs, a chain of campsites with sixteen small-scale natural campsites all across France.

Camping in the greenery

Camping de l’Ile has spacious, well-maintained pitches, many set in shady spots. That's because the campsite is located in a forest. Pick a place from the nearly two hundred touring pitches or rent a mobile home or lovely bungalow tent. The campsite is most popular with families with children. This is borne out by the amenities. 

Sporty on holiday

Children can enjoy themselves in the playground or on the bouncy castle. But there's also plenty to do for sporty campers at the multi-sport field, the jeu-de-boules pitch, the beach volleyball court or the table tennis table. Also fun for the whole family: a round of mini golf or geocaching. There's an entertainment programme in the summer months (at least twice a week).

The campsite is right along the Loire river. This is a veritable paradise for canoeists and kayakers. You can paddle down the river at a leisurely pace, but you can also seek adventure on a raft. And those simply looking to relax can head off to the campsite's sunbathing lawn.

Dining with a view

The campsite has a restaurant (limited menu) where you can also choose an unlimited buffet plan. Take-away meals are also available. From the terrace you can look out over the lively Loire river. This makes enjoying a bite outside even more fun! The campground shop offers fresh bread and breakfast. You can also go there for some groceries.

properties.name: Camping Village Panoramico Fiesole
properties.description:
Camping Village Panoramico Fiesole is situated in the peaceful village of Fiesole in Tuscany, close to Florence. This is the ideal base if you want to make the most of the Renaissance city of Florence. The city centre is just seven kilometres away and is easily accessible by bus. In addition, the campsite’s elevated position offers a magnificent view of the city. This campsite is also a good starting point for lovely walks through the Tuscan hills, where forests, vineyards and olive groves create a varied landscape.

Beautiful campsite on a hill

From the centre of Fiesole, a narrow mountain road 200 metres long leads to the campsite. This road climbs steeply, with an average gradient of 16 per cent. This can be a challenge for long vehicles and vehicle combinations. But once you are there, it is all worth the effort. The campsite is spacious and set on a hill, with plenty of greenery and several terraced levels with camping pitches that are well spaced out. There are also accommodation options in well-maintained lodgings, such as modern mobile homes and luxury lodges.

Pool and restaurant with a view of Florence

Life at the campsite revolves mainly around the large swimming pool and the restaurant. These are situated in the most beautiful part of the grounds, on a panoramic terrace with a wonderful view over Florence. Come and swim a few laps in the pool during the day (please note: swim caps are required) and then have a seat for a tasty meal at La Dolce Fiesole, before rounding off the day with a nice drink while enjoying a spectacular sunset over Florence.

properties.name: Camping Du Viaduc
properties.description:
If there is such a thing as a prefect campsite, Du Viaduc would qualify. This campsite with its beautiful surroundings of mountain and river valleys stands out for its tall trees which provide ample shade on the camping pitches. It will never be very quiet here, but the hustle and bustle is amicable. The entertainment team is very active and is concentrated on various age groups, so that young children as well as teenagers are catered for.

Ambiance under tall trees

You will arrive at a shady camping with a cheerful coming and going. You will find the reception with shop, restaurant and bar in a centrally located building. On your way to the camping pitch you will notice the tall trees and lively ambiance. All pitches are located along pathways. The smallest pitches are 100 m2 in size, the largest 'XXL-pitches' as much as 400 m2.

Swimming pool and beach

There is an active entertainment team which runs a comprehensive programme for all ages. There is regular live music. Tip: make sure to attend the foam parties. Across from the reception is the swimming pool with slide. The wellness centre is a recent addition. You can walk to the beach via a central road located between the reception and the sanitary building.

Eating and drinking

On the campsite is a small shop with a surprising assortment. Still not sufficient? In Millau you have a choice of several mega supermarkets with regional function. The bar and kitchen offer a wide (à la carte) range. There is regular live music in the restaurant. On the terrace (covered, if so wished) you can enjoy an al fresco dinner in a pleasant temperature.

properties.name: Camping & Resort Sangulí Salou
properties.description:
This spacious, first class holiday park is right on the Costa Dorada, also known as the 'Golden Coast'. Families with children will find a vibrant spot in lively Salou at Sangulí Resort Campsite. The famous seaside town is a paradise for carefree time characterised by sun, sea and sand. Sangulí Resort Campsite has been a household name for more than 50 years in this diverse location.

Neatly landscaped with plenty of choice

Sangulí Resort Campsite is spread over a large area, but the grounds are very clearly marked. One side of the park is designed for campers, who have a choice of five types of pitches. There are beautiful plants all around. Towards the back of the campsite, seen from the beach, there are the luxurious glamping spots. In the stunningly landscaped themed areas, you can spend the night in a particularly beautiful Caribbean-style mobile home, an atmospheric chalet on a Polynesian island, or a cool African lodge where you'll feel as if you're in the wild savannah. The campsite offers a free little train that goes around the campsite during the day, stopping at four stops in the park.

First class swimming paradise

As well as its location, Sangulí Resort has another highlight. The unique aqua parks with different themes spread out over the large camping grounds. Spectacular closed pool slides in the Happy Pool, huge exotic baths with an in-pool bar at the Fiesta Pool, or swim lengths in between the elephants and giraffes in the cool Africa Pool. Plenty to do for weeks of water fun in the midst of palm trees and well-landscaped lawns with comfortable sunbeds.

properties.name: Camping Paxariñas
properties.description:
Camping Paxariña is situated in the extreme west of Spain, at an extraordinary location: on a rock. It is close to the fishing village of Portonovo and a stone's throw away from a beautiful, secluded bay, great for a refreshing dive. A bit further on lies the large sandy beach Praia de Montalvo, also a popular weekend destination for the local population.

The entrance of the campsite is adjacent to a hotel in a curve of the cul-de-sac. On the gently sloping grounds there are several pitches on small, modest fields, surrounded by paved pathways that run across the campsite. Some pitches are partly shaded, but most of them are open and all have a hardened surface. At the edge of the campsite you have a spectacular view of the water. The panoramic pitches on this location are most in demand. At the entrance of the campsite are wooden bungalows.

Bird watching

The entire coastline of this region has a length of some 1300 km and with 700 beaches you will always find a spot to enjoy the colourful rocky coastline. This is definitely an ideal location for bird watchers. You will experience the ultimate feeling of freedom when you leave the mainland behind you and pay a visit to the Ons and Cíes islands.

Do you feel like a bit more action during your camping holiday? Thanks to the many beaches, participating in a variety of water sports such as windsurfing, sailing and diving here is an unforgettable experience.

properties.name: Camping Zum Örtzewinkel
properties.description:
Zum Örtzewinkel Campsite has a charming location in the beautiful Oertzetal. This is an ideal location for both short and long hiking and cycling trips. Following these excursions, the restaurant terrace awaits you for a tasty bite to eat. There is also a nice play forest for the children.

Space is the keyword at Zum Örtzewinkel Campsite. No matter where you set up your pitch on the green, flat terrain, you'll enjoy plenty of privacy. You'll also be surrounded by the greenery from old fruit trees, hedges and lawns. There are even a few extra spacious pitches at the swimming pond.

Well equipped

You can even spend the night at this campsite without brining your own camping equipment. This can be done by staying in one of the five wooden log cabins. These are all fully furnished. They are ideal for families passing by or for cyclists and hikers who stop over at the campsite. The tipi tent is another nice form of accommodation. The sanitary facilities at this well-maintained family campsite are also neat and clean.

Local offerings

Next to the entrance of the campsite is a nice restaurant with an appetizing menu. And just as important: it has a nice terrace. The offerings at the small campsite shop are limited but carefully curated. There are also many local products for sale.

Swimming and climbing

There is plenty of thought given to the youngest campers as well. There's a nice playground and several sandpits close to the pitches. However, the swimming pond is the big favourite. Along with the play forest, where young campers can climb and scamper around from early in the morning until late at night.

properties.name: Vier Jahreszeiten-Camping Biggesee
properties.description:
Vier Jahreszeiten-Camping Biggesee is a peaceful family campsite located on the German peninsula of Am Sonderner Kopf. You will camp here on the banks of the Biggesee, where the campsite has a private beach with a beautifully-landscaped swimming island. There are also various water sports options. You can relax in the wooded surroundings and take beautiful walking and cycling trips.

Camp near woods and water

The lake is just a few minutes' walk from the pitches, which are located on terraces at a higher level. Some of the standard pitches are grouped in circles. There are also comfort pitches, which are bigger and more private. Not bringing your own camping equipment? Then opt for a wooden gypsy wagon or a comfortable nature lodge.

Unique swimming island in the Biggesee

Besides paddle boarding, pedal boating and sailing, the Biggesee is ideal for swimming. An island made up of floating elements has been created in the water near the campsite. Steps provide safe and easy access to the pool. There’s even a slide, a large air cushion and a tower to jump on or off. Near the water, you’ll also find a large sunbathing area that belongs to the campsite.

Play in the outdoor air

In the summer months, the youngest campers enjoy all kinds of activities in the KidsClub. There’s also a playground and ping-pong tables. Anyone wanting extra relaxation can book a session in the sauna.

properties.name: Camping Heidehof
properties.description:
Hiking, biking, horseback riding or swimming: it's all possible at Camping Heidehof. Nature lovers and campers looking for peace and quiet gladly come here to enjoy the beauty of the Swabian Alps. But also, of course, to enjoy a tasty bite to eat in the campsite restaurant or go for a refreshing swim in the swimming pool. With Legoland just a twenty-minute ride away, many families with children also come to camp here.

Just passing through or staying?

The first part of the campsite caters to campers who are passing through. In the second part of the campsite, you will find touring pitches for your own camping equipment. The pitches are not demarcated, which allows the campsite to retain its natural beauty. Cyclists and hikers who are passing through can stay in the large wooden barrels. This often includes breakfast. 

Water fun

Feel like cooling down on a hot summer day? Campers of all ages can take refreshing dive in the campsite pool centrally located on the campsite. There is even a shallow end so smaller children can also stand in the pool. The swimming pool is surrounded by green sunbathing lawns, ideal if you want to soak up some sun and catch up on some reading.

Enjoy your meal!

Want to flop down into one of the campsite restaurant chairs after a busy day? Sounds like an excellent plan! The shaded terrace is especially inviting for grabbing a pizza or having an ice-cold drink. But a refreshingly cool ice cream by the pool is also something you don't want to miss. Would you rather relax next to your own caravan or tent and prepare your own meal? In the supermarket, you will find everything you need for a delicious camping meal.

properties.name: Camping de mon Village
properties.description:
Camping de mon Village is located in the French Champagne-Ardennes region and is popular as a transit camp for many campers. This campsite is close to the toll road while still green and peaceful in nature. You camp within walking distance of the centre of the town of Montigny-le-Roi in the small municipality of Val-de-Meuse.

Perfect stopover

The campsite is open all year round for camper van owners with their own facilities. During the period that the sanitary facilities are open (from 1 May to 30 September), you can also camp with your caravan or tent.

The campsite is only half a kilometre away from the motorway which makes it easily accessible. The campsite is on a hill, which means that the last part of the ride is quite steep. The campsite is in a park that is well-maintained. With a little luck, you will see squirrels running through the trees during a walk around the campsite. The campsite is primarily a popular stopover on the way to southern Europe.

Different pitches

There is no reception on the campsite; everything goes via a pay machine. Spacious pitches with and without shade are available. The most beautiful pitches have a beautiful view of the surroundings. There are special pitches for disabled campers on the flat part of the campsite.

Essential amenities

The sanitary facilities at the campsite are shipshape. Disabled campers have been kept in mind here as well. There is also Wi-Fi in most places and the children can release their energy in the playground. At a small snack bar you can refill you energy stores. Do you want a more complete meal? Then drive or walk to the village. In the small centre of Montigny-le-Roi are, in addition to restaurants, some shops and a supermarket.

properties.name: Camping Huttopia Wattwiller
properties.description:
Huttopia Wattwiller campsite is located on a ridge in the middle of Alsace. This modern family campsite offers pitches and various types of rental accommodation. The campsite has all the basic facilities and offers a wide range of sports, games and activities. There is also a small riding school with ponies and both an indoor and outdoor swimming pool. Without too much fancy, but nice to cool off. Afterwards you can grab an ice cream at the pavement café.

Camping under the trees

Because the campsite is situated on a hill, it takes careful steering to your pitch or rental accommodation. The pitches are very different in size and are often located on hard surface. The exact demarcation between the pitches is sometimes somewhat unclear, but one thing is certain: the location under trees provides sufficient shade.

Regional products

The campsite works as much as possible with local produce. In the restaurant, these products are used in the dishes, especially the pizzas are very tasty. Next to the restaurant is outdoor seating, where you can relax in the sun with an ice cream or a cold drink from the bar.

Swimming pool in the sun

Both an indoor and an outdoor swimming pool are available to cool off for a while. For small children there is a separate paddling pool. The pools do not have too much decoration, but are of course suitable for a refreshing dip. And because the pool is lovely situated in the sun, it is also equipped with a sunbathing area with chairs and parasols.

properties.name: Camping Du Bois de Reveuge
properties.description:
Close to a tiny village, named Huanne-Montmartin, lies this rural, terraced camping. It is a quiet region with ample opportunities for walking and cycling, which extends to the larger towns of Besançon, Vesoul and the Swiss border. There is plenty to do and to explore in this versatile region of well-preserved French countryside charm.

Large numbers of trees on the medium-sized camping grounds create a lovely atmosphere. The pitches close to the lake offer a beautiful open view. On the slightly sloping terrain, you can opt for a generously-sized pitch, although a comfort pitch offers even more space. At the front of the camping are very attractive mobile homes, chalets and cottages for rent. The four sanitary buildings are well-distributed over the camping grounds.

Aqua park with beautiful view

At the perimeter of the camping, with a lovely view over green fields, guests can enjoy a refreshing dive in the glorious swimming pools. A small pool for the little ones, a large and heated pool for all (can be covered) and a beautifully laid-out water playground. To top it all, the campsite has two water slides that end in a separate pool. In high season the lifeguard keeps an eye on the bathers.

Going underground

Feel like a new experience? Get in the car, drive for an hour through beautiful scenery in a southerly direction to the town of Gouffre de Poudrey. Here, you will find a magnificent cave system at a depth of 70 m. A guided tour will take you through this mysterious underworld.

properties.name: Flower Camping L'Air du Lac
properties.description:
Flower Camping L’Air du Lac is located in the south of Limousin - in the present province of Haute-Vienne - This family campsite is situated south of the city of Limoges and close to the charming village of Saint-Hilaire-les-Places. From the campsite you have direct access to a sandy beach at the swimming lake Lac de Plaisance. During your holiday you can buy fresh bread daily at the campsite.

Spacious and green

Flower Camping L'Air du Lac is well looked after. From the camping fields to the pitches and from the accommodation to the sanitary facilities: everything is clean. The camping fields consist of several terraces with spacious pitches. Low hedges delimit the pitches and trees on the site provide shelter from the French sun. Don't feel like bringing your own camping equipment? Then you can rent a mobile home or a fully equipped tent at the campsite.

A sporty holiday

In high season the campsite organises activities for the whole family and there is regular evening entertainment in the form of dance and music. During the day you can easily stay active, as there are many sports and games on offer. From jeu-de-boules to miniature golf and from beach volleyball to playing in the indoor playground.

Swimming, sliding and diving

From the campsite you have access to the sandy beach where you can laze about on your towel. The pure water of Lac de Plaisance is perfect for a refreshing dive, a jump from the diving board or a slide. The lake is also suitable for water sports such as windsurfing.

properties.name: Flower Camping et base de loisirs de Rouffiac
properties.description:
At this site, you will camp near a lake in the Dordogne. As a water sports enthusiast, Camping et base de loisirs de Rouffiac is the place to be. On the lake, you can canoe, paddle, wakeborad, swim or even ride a pedalo. If you prefer land sports, you can go hiking, climbing, archery of mountain biking. But those seeking peace and quiet will also find what they are looking for. Lay down your towel on the sandy beach and soak up the sun. Or enjoy the peace and quiet on your spacious camping pitch under the old oak trees.

Views in the Périgord Vert

This campsite is located on Lake Rouffiac. This wonderful place for water sports enthusiasts is located in the north of the Dordogne, in the Périgord Vert. After a drive full of beautiful views, you'll enter the woods. That's where the campsite is hidden away. With its trees and large lawns, it is very much like a park overlooking a huge lake.

Camping pitches under the oaks

The large pitches are located in small groups together. Often these groups are separated by hedges. So you can enjoy your well-deserved rest. But a chat with the neighbours is also always enjoyable. Will you be travelling without camping gear this year? Then this campsite has a variety of accommodations to choose from. Will you opt for a chalet overlooking the water? Or perhaps a mobile home under the trees?

properties.name: Camping Le Moulin de David
properties.description:
In a valley forest in Périgord, you will find the 4-star family campsite Le Moulin de David. The campsite is located in the forest, right by a stream (Le Soulauret) where you can swim. A short distance away is Monpazier (4 km), a charming village which is one of the loveliest in France. The green surroundings are ideal for hiking, so be sure to bring your hiking boots when camping here.

Camping pitches and rental accommodation in green surroundings

On the 16-hectare campsite, you have a choice of pitches for your tent, motorhome or caravan. These are spacious and surrounded by trees and bushes, providing shade and privacy. For sun worshippers, there are also pitches without shade. Don’t have your own camping equipment? In that case, you can choose from lodge tents and mobile homes.

A stream and a swimming pool

The campsite is by a stream where you can enjoy a swim on hot days. The double water slide provides additional fun for the children. The campsite also has a swimming pool surrounded by loungers and parasols.

Clean amenities

For everyday shopping, there is a campsite shop with a modest selection. Not in the mood to cook? Then visit the restaurant with covered terrace. From here, you have a wonderful view of the campsite and the swimming pool.

Discover the Dordogne and its castles

There is also plenty to do in the surrounding area. For example, visit the medieval castles of the Dordogne or the vineyards of Bergerac. A visit to one of the region's fun night markets is also very worthwhile.

properties.name: Camping Le Relais du Campeur
properties.description:
This campsite is located in the village of Rocamadour, in the French department of Lot. Le Relais du Campeur Campsite is the perfect base from which to explore this remarkable pilgrimage site. Visit the castle at the top of the cliffs. This is also where all the shrines and churches can be found. And be sure to take your kids to le Fôret des Singes as well. They will be delighted by the free roaming monkeys.

On the outskirts of Rocamadour

The French department of Lot is home to beautiful forests, dripping caves and ancient buildings. All of these come together in Rocamadour. This village is built against the white cliffs, among deep valleys and large forests. It is your special camping destination this holiday. The campsite is located just outside the centre of Rocamadour. In a quiet place on the edge of civilisation.

Camping under a tree

The campsite has space for one hundred pitches. You can choose a spot on one of the rectangular lawns. There you can sit back and relax in the shade of a tree. So leave your bags unpacked for a while. Your vacation in France has begun!

A dip in the pool

Just what you need after a day of hiking: a dip in the pool. At this campsite you can enjoy this luxury. All you have to do is walk to the edge of the campsite. That is where the rectangular outdoor pool is located. The pool is quite simple. But you don't need more than some nice cool water either.

properties.name: Flower Camping Le Belvédère
properties.description:
In the Cantal region and the impressive Gorges de la Truyère nature reserve, Flower Camping Le Belvédère offers a relaxed camping destination. Especially ideal for families who love peace and the real outdoors, but where there is also plenty to do for children. During the summer months you can participate in fun activities such as theme nights with music performances, shows, painting, games and sports competitions.

Camping in the Auvergne

During the drive to the campsite you will see that the area consists of mountains, valleys, forests and rivers. A friendly and hospitable welcome awaits you at the reception. What is striking are the spacious grounds, which are located on a southern slope of a hill with unforgettable views of Lake Lanau. For large campers and caravans there are separate pitches that are slightly lower.

Panoramic view

Find a nice spot in the middle of untouched nature. The pitches are marked out on the well-kept grounds and there is plenty of shade. All the pitches offer a wonderful view. The two sanitary blocks are not very modern but neat and clean. Those who like camping with more luxury can choose from beautiful mobile homes and chalets or sturdy glamping tents that are fully equipped.

Swimming fun

Take a dip in the pool at any time of the day. The water of the outdoor pool is wonderfully heated between 26 and 28 degrees and the roof can be used in less nice weather. There is a small, shallow pool for toddlers. Next to the pool are sunbeds and the sauna and fitness room.

properties.name: Camping Lou Broustaricq
properties.description:
Camping Lou Broustaricq is very close to the Étang de Cazaux et Sanguinet, one of the large lakes in the Landes department (southwest France). You can walk from this family-friendly, four-star campsite to one of the lake’s beaches. The campsite itself also has a beautiful swimming pool complex. Fun activities are organised during the high season and there are amazing hiking and cycle routes to follow through the woods around the lakes in the Landes department.

Modern accommodations and great pitches

Modern mobile homes are most prominent at this campsite. There is a wide range of mobile homes for 4 to 8 people. A charming pitch can also be booked for an overnight stay. All of the touring pitches are demarcated with neatly kept bushes and hedges, ensuring your privacy as a campsite visitor. Do take into account that the pitches differ considerably in size.

What does the campsite offer in the way of fun?

A beautiful water park is next to the reception. Water fun can be had in a heated indoor and outdoor swimming pool complex, which has five pools, three paddling pools, a Jacuzzi and two water slides. During the summer holiday, Camping Lou Broustaricq offers entertainment for campsite visitors of all ages. The youngest campsite guests can go to mini discos and face-painting sessions, while older children and adults experience wonderful moments with sports competitions, evening entertainment and outdoor sports activities.

Cycling around the lakes

Swimming in natural water is possible at the Étang de Cazaux et de Sanguinet, a nearby lake. There are various sandy beaches only a few hundred metres from the campsite. Most of the lake is surrounded by woods, providing a wonderful environment for hiking or cycling.

properties.name: Camping Les Reflets du Quercy
properties.description:
The campsite is located at the top of a limestone plateau, high above a river in the French department of Lot. This beautiful location makes for even more beautiful views of the valley. Les Reflets du Quercy Campsite is a camping destination where you can spend your holiday in total peace. You can do this on one of the pitches or in a luxury lodge tent.

Limestone plateau

Limestone cliffs tower high above the water along the Lot River. The campsite is located at the top of one of the limestone plateaus. This plateau is situated in the middle of the woods. It is a lovely place in the French department of Lot.

Camping with a view

Beautiful pitches are situated beneath the oak trees of the sloping campsite. They are ideal places to unwind. Nice and cool in the shade, amongst all the greenery. Many of the pitches also have beautiful forest views. You won't believe your eyes! You will also enjoy this view from one of the luxury lodge tents. Plus a nice soft bed and a private shower. And, as an added luxury, underfloor heating. Perfect if you come camping in the late season.

Swimming pool with water playground

The pool: a wonderful place for both young and old to cool off. You can enjoy floating in the pool. The children will have a great time in the water playground. They always have the most fun playing under the spraying arches and mushroom. The tall trees provide quite a bit of shade, so thankfully you won't burn too quickly.

properties.name: Camping Parc d'Audinac les Bains
properties.description:
Looking for a lively family campsite in a beautiful natural area? Then Camping Parc d'Audinac les Bains, near the town of Montjoie-en-Couserans (Ariège), is highly recommended. You camp on the edge of the Ariège-Pyrenees regional natural park. So, this campsite is an excellent base for nature lovers, walkers and mountain sports fans. The campsite’s facilities include a heated outdoor swimming pool, a good restaurant and an extensive entertainment programme in the summer holidays.

Natural campsite

This campsite is beautifully laid out on an attractive site with ponds, a stream and plenty of green space. The large pitches are at the front of the campsite, close to the communal toilet and washing block. Accommodation is available too: modern mobile homes, chalets and small and larger safari tents.
