Want to enjoy a clear starry sky from your bed at night? Then book a stay in the cosy bubble hotel; unusual, dome-shaped accommodation with 360-degree glazing.

Plenty of enjoyment for the whole family

If you’re looking for a campsite where you can enjoy yourself for days on end, this is the place for you. Particularly in high season. For example, take a dip in the heated outdoor pool or take part in fun activities. There’s an entertainment programme for young and old with activities like crafts, educational forest walks, nature workshops and horse riding. For the ultimate in relaxation, head to the wellness zone. Enjoy a sauna or an invigorating massage. Follow this up with some time on the cosy terrace at La Marmotte, the campsite restaurant that serves pizzas, meat dishes, salads, snacks and ice creams.

properties.name: Camping Les Lauriers Roses
properties.description:
At campsite Les Lauriers Roses you will experience the ultimate holiday. This campsite, named after the oleander, is in a unique setting surrounded by typical Mediterranean vegetation. Take full advantage of the shade of the majestic cork oaks and stone pines on the grounds. Many guests, mostly families with children, return year upon year. A good sign. Especially young children will make friends quickly.

Pleasant terraced campsite

Les Lauriers Roses is an uncluttered campsite with only eighty pitches on the 2 ha terrain. On the neatly laid out terraced campsite you will find 57 camping pitches for caravans and tents, 19 mobile homes and 4 lodge tents. The mobile homes and lodge tents are very well equipped. 

To the swimming pool and beach

The swimming pool of Les Lauriers Roses is centrally located on the campsite and is surrounded by trees. Adjacent to the swimming pool you will find the bar and restaurant with a lovely, also shaded terrace. The campsite is only 3 km from the sea and the beach is easily reached by bus which stops directly in front of the campsite.

Restaurant and shop

The restaurant is the social hub of the campsite. You can dine here in a relaxed atmosphere. Adjacent to the campsite is a larger supermarket (Carrefour Contact), where you can find everything you need. During high season fresh bread is available on the campsite. 

Sports activities

On campsite Les Lauriers Roses you will find fitness equipment (outdoor), a table tennis table, a table football game and a snooker table. You are in France, hence there is also a pétanque court. On the multi-sports terrain you can also play volleyball.

properties.name: Camping Cevedale
properties.description:
Campsite Cevedale is located in the Trentino region, in the pretty Val di Sole, flanked on both sides by a beautiful mountain landscape in the Stelvio and Adamello national parks in the Italian Alps. Three lively villages are within walking distance. The area is ideal for nature lovers, winter sports enthusiasts, mountain hikers and a number of adventurous outdoor sports.

Enthusiastic reception

The access to the campsite is charming and hospitable. There is a bar next to the entrance. Come into the charming little reception, an enthusiastic welcome by the Depetris family and the receptionist awaits you. The campsite guests are families and sport and nature lovers from Italy, the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany.

Strong mountain stream

The tourist sites are located on opposite sides of a fast flowing (fenced) mountain stream. There are small sites for tents, basic sites and spacious comfort sites. They are reasonably spacious, well maintained and you can choose between shady and sunny sites. All sites have a view of the surrounding mountain landscape and a castle. There are sanitation buildings on both sides of the river. There are also chalets for rent on the campsite. There is a through mountain road along the property, which you don't hear.

Up for adventure

There is plenty to do and experience for children and adults on the campsite and in the surrounding area. Quite a few activities are organised. There is a multilingual activities programme for all ages, from crafts, sports and a children's disco to guided adventure tours, karaoke and dance evenings.

The campsite is located within walking distance of three small villages with a few restaurants and a couple of shops including a supermarket. In the winter, a ski bus stops at the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Porticciolo
properties.description:
The simple but friendly campsite Porticciolo is situated near the village of Bracciano in the Lazio region. Here, you will find enough shade during the warm Italian summers; the campsite is covered with trees. The leaf canopy not only protects you from the sun, it also adds to the atmosphere.

Do you enjoy swimming, canoeing and surfing? Then you have come to the right place because the campsite is situated on the crystal-clear waters of Lago di Bracciano. And the children can paddle safely at the water's edge on the beach (sand/pebble). Rome is an hour away by train. The campsite bus will bring you to the station for free.

Your pitch

Porticciolo has marked and unmarked pitches, depending on the season. The pitches are spacious, well-maintained and generally well-shaded. There is also an entrance suitable for large camper vans. There are a limited number of pitches directly on the lake. Mobile homes and (large) caravans are available for rent. Your fellow campers will mostly be Europeans looking for water, sunshine and culture.

Beside and on the water

You will not miss a swimming pool or entertainment team while you're spending your days relaxing in the water or at the beach. The Lago has plenty of water fun opportunities. Motor yachts are not allowed here, making this a quiet area.

Pico bello restaurant

The campsite shop is small and basic, but there is fresh bread available daily. The restaurant (with a patio), on the other hand, deserves praise. Here, you will discover what makes the Italian cuisine famous: simple and fresh food with plenty of flavour. Nobody will be surprised to hear that grandma is standing in the kitchen, baking fresh pizzas in the wood-fired oven.

properties.name: Mobile Homes Camping Resort Medveja
properties.description:
In the east of the Istrian peninsula you will find Mobile Homes Camping Resort Medveja. Here you camp by the Adriatic Sea. The clear blue water invites you for a refreshing dive. Discover the Croatian coast, with colourful towns like Opatija, and enjoy the sun. The campsite's restaurant takes good care of you.

Large choice of pitches

Once you have been received in the new reception building, you can look for your camping pitch. The pitches are marked out and situated on grass. There are more than 200 of them, so the choice is substantial. On the green campsite, they leave the grass nice and long.

Tasty dishes made from local produce

The restaurant may look a little outdated, but the food is very good. The kitchen prepares beautiful dishes using local produce. Sit on the patio and let yourself be pampered. Have a fresh salad, a fresh pizza or a Croatian fish dish.

The clear blue sea

Cross the coastal road and you will arrive at the beautiful pebble beach. The water of the Adriatic is a crystal clear blue here. Rent a sun lounger and parasol at the campsite and enjoy the sun. A dip in the sea and your holiday is complete. Would you like to discover a different part of the coast? Drive to Opatija for a beautiful coastline.

properties.name: Camping Auf Kengert
properties.description:
This campsite is located in the beautiful nature of Central Luxembourg, very close to the famous Mullerthal Trail hiking route. You will be camping here two kilometres from the lovely town of Larochette. Auf Kengert is a quiet campsite with a modest amount of things to do. For example, you won't find an entertainment programme, but you will find a nice pool and some playgrounds.

Camping in nature!

Here you will find yourself on a natural campsite full of trees. The pitches are spacious (100–120 m2) and numbered. Hedges and shrubs provide demarcation in certain places; in other places, there is a little less privacy. Despite the sloping nature of the campsite, the pitches are relatively flat. If you have come without your own camping equipment, you can stay in one of the cabins, tents or chalets.

Modest entertainment

The campsite intentionally does not offer entertainment or other bells and whistles. Instead, Auf Kengert focuses on families with young children who can entertain themselves. But sporty campers will also get their money's worth at this campsite. For example, the area in which you are staying is a real walking and cycling paradise. The biggest source of entertainment at the campsite itself is the swimming pool. Here, there is also a small area for the youngest campers. There is also an outdoor and an indoor playground at the campsite.

Good food for a good price

There is a small shop selling some basic necessities, such as fresh bread. For other groceries, you'll need to take a trip to Larochette. Or you can take the easy option and join us at the campsite restaurant. Here, you will have a wide choice of dishes. And the prices are very reasonable. You can also visit for breakfast.

properties.name: Vakantiepark Westerbergen
properties.description:
Vakantiepark De Westerbergen, a true camping paradise for children, is located right next to Ruinen forestry, just a five-minute drive away from the historical village of Echten. During the school holidays, an enthusiastic entertainment team keeps both young and older children entertained. But that's not all. What about the many playgrounds, a swimming paradise and even an indoor playground? In the region surrounding the campsite, vast moors and forests, mysterious dolmens and characteristic Drenthe villages await you.

Camping amidst green

This park-like terrain is playfully designed: no 'straight' roads, but winding paths leading to wonderfully spacious camping pitches. There is little to nothing to mark the pitches, but this is compensated by plenty of grass, trees and shrubs.

The sanitary facilities are excellent at De Westerbergen. For campers looking for a little more luxury, camping pitches with a private bathroom are available. Particularly unique are the safari tent lodges, where you can camp in luxury. This is glamping at its best.

Children reign supreme

On this welcoming family campsite, everything revolves around the children. They can play in one of the many playgrounds dotted around the campsite, go wild in the woods, or play to their heart's content in the indoor swimming pool or the heated water playground in the outside part of the pool. For rainy days, there is also an indoor playground with no fewer than three floors of playing fun (with slide, ball pit and jungle gyms).

Laser tag

There are also activities for the older children, such as laser tag and archery. During the school holidays, an enthusiastic entertainment team organises all sorts of fun and exciting activities for the children.

properties.name: EuroParcs De Utrechtse Heuvelrug
properties.description:
EuroParcs De Utrechtse Heuvelrug is between the towns of Maarn and Woudenberg, in the middle of the Utrechtse Heuvelrug National Park. There are numerous walking and cycling paths in the versatile countryside around this holiday park. Great attractions in the vicinity are The Pyramid of Austerlitz and Henschotermeer Recreation Area. Furthermore, here you stay at only a 30-minute drive from the lively centre of Utrecht and 20 minutes from Amersfoort. You can easily entertain yourself for days at the campsite with its lovely indoor swimming pool, various playgrounds and a large hospitality area.

Wide range of overnight options

You can stay in various types of accommodation at this neatly maintained holiday park. Glamping fans are in the right place at EuroParcs De Utrechtse Heuvelrug. Besides lovely glamping tents, you can also book a stay in a modern chalet or a luxury tiny house, among others.

Swimming fun in the indoor swimming pool and the Henschotermeer

This resort's beautiful indoor swimming pool is beside reception. The youngest park guests can have plenty of water-based fun in the paddling pool with water games and a slide. There is also a deep pool with spectacular water slides where you can swim laps. If you prefer swimming in natural water, walk to the Henschotermeer, which is only a few hundred metres from the park.

Delicious dining in Brasserie Laag Kanje

There is a large hospitality area on the outskirts of the park where you will find Brasserie Laag Kanje. This wonderfully furnished restaurant offers dishes with Dutch and French influences. And there is also a cafeteria where you can take away tasty snacks and chips.

properties.name: EuroParcs Resort Poort van Zeeland
properties.description:
EuroParcs Resort Poort van Zeeland is close to Hellevoetsluis and Rockanje in South Holland. The lively holiday park is ideal for families. There is an indoor playground, bouncy castle, water playground, an active entertainment team and a good restaurant. It is a 10-minute walk to Quackstrand from the campsite. This is a lovely beach for children, as you have clear views, it is shallow, clean and the lovely beach bar completes the picture. Due to the calm water, it is also a perfect spot for novice surfers, sailors and canoeists.

Luxury holiday by the sea

When you go to EuroParcs Resort Poort van Zeeland, you get a wonderful holiday by the sea. The park is neatly landscaped and spaciously laid out. There are various furnished accommodation you can hire, such as lovely chalets, bungalows and luxury tiny houses. There is a charming restaurant where you can enjoy the culinary delights both indoors and outdoors. You don't have to leave the park for a lovely lunch either.

Beaches in abundance

A lovely thing about this park, is that you can stand with your feet in the sand in no time. A lovely path runs straight through a nature reserve and to the beach. The Quackstrand is by the Haringvliet. You can also go to Rockanje or Ouddorp for lovely North Sea beaches.

Playground for children

There is playground for children indoors as well as one outdoors in the healthy open air. How about an escape room or laser game? Kids can have the time of their lives in the water playground. There are fun activities scheduled for all ages and provided by the enthusiastic entertainment team.

properties.name: Alpencamping Nenzing
properties.description:
Looking for a beautiful campsite in a mountainous area? Then a stay at Alpencamping Nenzing, near the village of Nenzing in Vorarlberg, is definitely a great choice. This terraced campsite offers stunning views of the surrounding mountains, where you can enjoy unspoilt nature while hiking or cycling. In winter, there are winter sports facilities nearby. At the campsite, you can make use of the luxury facilities that are entirely befitting of a five-star campsite. These include two excellent restaurants, a stylish wellness area and a heated indoor and outdoor swimming pool.

Beautiful terraced pitches with a mountain view

This beautifully landscaped campsite caters mainly for touring campers. Most touring pitches are on well-maintained terraced levels, although the site also has a flat section. Many of the pitches have lovely views of the surrounding mountainous landscape. There are five categories of pitches to choose from. The most luxurious of which have a large outdoor terrace and sometimes even a private bathroom and spa lodge with a sauna.

Sports, games, wellness and two restaurants

Children can enjoy themselves here in the adventure playground, on the sports fields, in the ‘Indian forest’ or in the indoor playground with a climbing wall and cinema. In high season, there are fun activities such as creative workshops and lively parties. And we haven’t even mentioned the heated indoor and outdoor swimming pools yet! There is also a luxury wellness oasis with a Finnish sauna, herbal sauna, steam room and massage salon.

For a delicious dinner, take a seat at the inviting Garfrenga restaurant or the slightly more exclusive Himmelwärts restaurant. The latter serves steaks and fish dishes that are particularly popular.

properties.name: Camping Sölden
properties.description:
Camping Sölden is right next to the lively centre of Sölden, in the Ötztal valley in Tyrol. The location of this neatly kept campsite is ideal for winter sports enthusiasts. You stay next to the ski lift to Skigebiet Sölden, which is known as one of the best ski resorts in Austria. In the summer, the campsite attracts many hikers and cyclists, who enjoy the many beautiful routes through and around the Ötztal valley.

Car-free campsite with an old and a new section

If you have checked in and set up your pitch, park your car in the campsite’s underground car park. The benefit is that your car stays nice and cool in the summer and that you don't have to scrape ice off the windows in the winter. What’s more, this means that the camping site remains car-free.

Above the car park is the new, level section of the campsite. The older section is terraced. As a campsite visitor, you have access to a luxury sanitary building finished with marble. The toilet facilities are also top quality. You can also book a stay in a modern apartment.

Relax in the wellness oasis

If the purpose of your holiday is to recharge completely, then this campsite is an ideal destination. Camping Sölden has a wellness zone that is at least 500 square metres. You can relax in various saunas, the Turkish bath or the infrared booth. You can also rest up in the lounge, or go for a walk in the fresh, clean mountain air.

properties.name: Terrassencamping Ossiach
properties.description:
This campsite is located directly on the crystal clear Lake Ossiach, some 2 km from the town of Ossiach (Carinthia). This is a region with lakes, mountains, forests and a great many walking and cycling opportunities. The friendly, quietly situated family campsite has a few beautiful private beaches (sand and pebbles). The beach slopes down very gently into the water, so that it is also a safe spot for small children.

A wide variety

You can pick your own spot on the Ossiacher See terraced campsite. Everything is possible as far as the pitches are concerned: small or larger pitches, spacious or more compact terraces and also some pitches on lawns (prices vary). The pitches, separated by hedges or shrubs, offer ample privacy. The more elevated terrace pitches offer a splendid view of Lake Ossiach. There is also a wide range of rental accommodation units (from tent to bungalow) on the campsite.

By and on the lake

The campsite has several lakeside beaches. The lake is excellent for swimming or playing. Children can jump off the wooden jetty, enjoy playing with the water play features and swish down the slides. You can enjoy yourself on the water with a rubber dinghy, canoe, kayak or surfboard. There are also trampolines, playgrounds and a tennis court. Children can also join the entertainment programme.

Fine food and beverages

The large supermarket (at the entrance) sells everything you need for delicious meals. The supermarket is opened throughout the day. The decor of the campsite restaurant is unpretentious, but the food and excellent service make up for this.

properties.name: Seecamping Mentl
properties.description:
Seecamping Mentl lies south of Lake Ossiach, between Villach and Ossiach (Carinthia). This campsite’s terrain has two sandy beaches along the aforementioned lake. There are also plenty of water sports activities in the immediate vicinity. With an extensive network of hiking and cycle routes, this region is an amazing destination for hikers and cycling enthusiasts. The campsite is spacious and nicely landscaped. In the high season, this is a popular holiday address for families with children.

Camping by the lake

At Seecamping Mentl it is possible to stay overnight in a modern mobile home or apartment. Tourist pitches, however, are clearly in the majority here. Are you planning to book a pitch? Keep the layout of the campsite in mind. The large pitches are mainly by the lake. This is great for those who love to swim and for beach lovers but do be aware that, if you camp near the lake, you are somewhat further from the entrance to the campsite. This is where you will find the most important amenities, including the modern toilet block.

Beach, entertainment and wellness facilities

At the far end of the campsite there is a large grassy meadow that flows into Lake Ossiach. You can access the water, which often reaches a temperature of 27 degrees in the summer, by means of two sandy beaches and a swimming dock. Additionally, during the summer holiday, Mentl has a full entertainment programme for the children. The spa treatments and massages that are offered allow adults to relax as well. Café Mentl is a charming campsite café where you can enjoy delicious cakes and drinks.

properties.name: Camping Playa Almayate Costa
properties.description:
Almayate Costa campsite is situated on the south coast of Spain between Málaga and Torre del Mar. You camp right by the beach in the less touristy area of the Costa del Sol. You can walk down the beach and dive straight into the Mediterranean Sea. The pitches, located under trees and shade cloths, are cool and have ample shade.

Shaded camping pitches

The pitches are demarcated by trees. You will not enjoy a great deal of privacy as the pitches are fairly close together, but there is ample shade. The trees take care of that. Additional shade is created by the shade cloths over the camping pitches. The most beautiful pitches are to be found at the perimeters of the campsite. The pitches are somewhat sunnier here and you have a view of the beach and sea.

Dive into the Mediterranean Sea

Although you camp in the shade, you can swim in full sun on Camping Almayate Costa. At the edge of the campsite, beyond the shaded grounds, you will find the outdoor swimming pool. Do you prefer swimming in the sea? When you walk through the gate you find yourself directly on the beach of the Mediterranean Sea. 

Polonaise

In summer you will most likely see the children parade in a polonaise line or slide down an inflatable water slide. The entertainment team provides entertainment throughout the day and organises all kinds of events.

Feeling peckish?

You don't have to leave the campsite for your daily meal. The campsite shop has a fairly good selection. The restaurant is open throughout the day for breakfast, lunch and dinner.

properties.name: Camping Nahemühle GmbH
properties.description:
Camping Nahemühle is located just outside Monzingen, in the German state of Rhineland-Palatinate. This campsite is located in a quiet spot on a tributary of the Nahe River. Some of the spacious touring pitches are located directly on this river. This campsite is an ideal base for beautiful hiking and cycling trips in the area, as well as for visits to Rüdesheim and Burg Rheingrafenstein, for example.

Book a spot on the water or spend the night in the mill

Camping Nahemühle features a relatively large number of permanent pitches. Separate fields with tourist camping pitches have also been created on this well-organised campsite. You'll find both sunny and shady spots on these neatly maintained fields. There are also various types of accommodations for rent. You can spend the night here in a mobile home, a hiker's cabin, an authentic circus wagon or in a room in the mill.

Building dams, entertainment and a wine tour

From the camping area, you follow a path that passes by a nice nature garden and ends at a kind of beach. This little beach lies on the tributary of the Nahe. It is an ideal place to take a dip and cool off on hot summer days. Children can enjoy themselves here by building dams. You can also enjoy swimming outside at the large outdoor swimming pool in Bad Sobernheim, about five kilometres east of the campsite.

Restaurant with regional dishes and pizza nights

Camping Nahemühle has its own restaurant where delicious regional dishes are among the house specialities. A fun pizza night is also organised each week.

properties.name: Camping Christophorus
properties.description:
Christophorus Campsite is surrounded by extensive forests and situated next to three beautiful recreational lakes. This campsite is located in a quiet spot near the village of Kirchberg an der Iller (Baden-Württemberg). You can enjoy swimming in both the Sinninger Badesee swimming lake and the heated indoor pool. The campsite also offers various sports and play opportunities, a good restaurant and an entertainment programme in high season. This is a popular place for families with children during the summer holidays. This neatly laid out campsite is mainly frequented by seniors during the low season. The campsite is only five kilometres from the A7 motorway. Please note that dogs are not allowed.

Spacious, level, grassy pitches

Christophorus Campsite has a flat camping terrain with excellently maintained camping pitches. These are numbered grass pitches with little or no shade. They are demarcated by neat hedges. You can also go here with a large caravan combination without any problems.

Splashing in the swimming lake or the heated indoor pool

Just next to the campsite is the Sinninger Badesee. This is an artificial recreational lake perfect for swimming and diving. You can sunbathe on grassy lawns in various places around the lake.

Those who prefer to swim in a pool can use the campsite's beautiful indoor swimming pool. Here you can swim laps or refresh yourself after a visit to the sauna, for example. This heated swimming pool is part of a wellness centre, which also features a bio sauna, a Finnish sauna, a solarium and a nice relaxation area.

properties.name: Westport House C. & C. Park
properties.description:
The three-star Westport House Caravan & Camping Park is on the west coast of Ireland, in County Mayo (Maigh Eo in Irish). From cycling the Great Western Greenway to climbing the Croagh Patrick, you are guaranteed an unforgettable experience in the countryside here. The charming town of Westport is close by at only a 15-minute walk. In short, the campsite is a handy starting point for both an adventurous as cultural outing.

A three-star campsite in the Irish countryside

The campsite's grounds are a stone's throw from the historical Westport House (800 m), a country estate that is over 300 years old and that nowadays serves as the setting for a range of activities. This adds a touch of Irish history to the dense forests, green hills and babbling rivers characterising the area.

At the campsite, you can choose from various camping experiences, ranging from traditional camping pitches to luxury glamping tents with beds, outdoor furniture and your own barbecue set. Whatever you prefer, you always have views of the beautiful countryside, including Ireland's sacred mountain: Croagh Patrick.

With all modern conveniences

Westport House offers all the modern conveniences for a relaxing stay. As well as the basic amenities, there is a café and a little shop for fresh coffee and snacks.

For recreation, go to the swimming pool, the sauna, gym or the indoor gaming zone. And if you would like to learn more about the history of the 300-year-old Westport House, go on a guided tour full of art, old objects and stories about kings and pirates.

properties.name: Musique Camping Les Grèbes du Lac de Marcenay
Sunêlia Camping Le Petit Bois
properties.description:
Camping Le Petit Bois is a quiet family campsite in a varied setting full of castles, old villages, pretty coastal towns and charming bays. The wooded campsite is situated on an old estate and has a beautiful swimming pool. For the youth there is plenty to do.

Shadow of old pines

Spacious pitches are no exception on the beautifully landscaped grounds. A large number of them are situated under tall old pines with a grass surface. But fortunately there are also plenty of possibilities for sun lovers. Low hedges provide the necessary privacy.

Lovely swimming pool

The round outdoor swimming pool is the pride of the campsite. The attractive decoration plays an important role in this. Rocks around the pool, a small bridge, waterfalls and palm trees in the middle; really a pretty picture. The two slides lead into the heated pool. Also in the paddle pool there is a nice play equipment.

For the ultimate holiday feeling, grab a book from the small library at the reception and sit back and relax in one of the sun loungers. The old castle in the background enhances the holiday feeling.

Entertainment for teenagers

In addition to a large asphalt sports field for playing basketball or football, there is more to do for young people at Camping Le Petit Bois. Sports enthusiasts can work up a sweat during the day at various sports tournaments. After that take a quick shower, have a bite to eat and go on to the evening programme: shows and musical performances at the bar. For the youngest campers there is a playground with slides and a climbing frame.

properties.name: Camping Het Bosbad
properties.description:
In Noordoostpolder, in a wooded area just above Emmeloord, is Camping Het Bosbad. This simple, small-scale campsite is the perfect place to come to enjoy your well-earned rest. You can camp on spacious pitches or in a cosy hikers' hut in the middle of the Emmeler forest, where it is lovely to walk and cycle.

Wooded area

Camping Het Bosbad has more than thirty touring pitches in addition to forty permanent year-round pitches. Although the campsite is quite small and simple, most of these touring sites are quite large. You will be camping here among the tall trees of the Emmelerbos, on green pitches with plenty of privacy. If you are travelling with a tent, you can camp on the hiker's field at an extra discount.

Looking for a quiet place

The campsite has room for every camper, young and old. You will encounter families with children, but also couples. In any case, the campers all have one thing in common: they are people seeking peace and quiet. By the way, that doesn't mean that there's nothing to do at the campsite. In high season, you can join the weekly bingo night. Bridge tournaments, treasure hunts and barbecues are also regularly organised.

Facilities on and near the campsite

In the cosy campsite restaurant (with terrace) you can order breakfast as well as dinner. For daily shopping, you have to go to nearby Emmeloord. This can be done on foot or by bike. The playground with trampoline, swings and go-karts and the volleyball field are fun for the younger campers. The campsite does not have its own swimming pool, but the municipal swimming pool is right next to the campsite.

properties.name: EuroParcs De Hooge Veluwe
properties.description:
EuroParcs De Hooge Veluwe is amid the lush countryside of the Veluwe, in a top location right opposite De Hoge Veluwe National Park. Whether you opt for a stylish holiday home, a comfortable mobile home or a cosy tiny house, here you experience the best of the countryside with vibrant Arnhem around the corner.

De Hoge Veluwe National Park

You can have a relaxing holiday where countryside and city come together at EuroParcs De Hooge Veluwe. You won't find traditional camping pitches here, but you can stay in one of the lovely accommodation in the forest. From the holiday park, cross the road and you reach the Schaarsbergen entrance to De Hoge Veluwe National Park. You can explore the vast heathlands and forest of the largest national park in the Netherlands by bike or on foot.

Swimming pools and wellness

You are guaranteed water fun at EuroParcs De Hooge Veluwe, whatever the weather. Here, you can go swimming in the summer as well as the winter thanks to the indoor and outdoor swimming pool. The wellness centre has various facilities including a sauna and infrared cabin for relaxation. There is also a special section with gym equipment for sports enthusiasts.

Playgrounds and entertainment

Little adventurers will have a wonderful time here. The holiday park has adventurous playgrounds, sports fields and go-kart hire, among others. The entertainment team offers fun activities for all ages during the (school) holidays. Whether you want to do crafts, play a game or explore the countryside with your holiday friends, there is always something to do!

properties.name: Naturcamp. Wienerwald
properties.description:
Camping Wienerwald is a peaceful nature campsite in the heart of the Wienerwald, also called the lungs of Vienna. The campsite is divided into large grassy fields, on which the pitches are situated. In the morning you can enjoy fresh bread. Nature lovers will love the various walking and cycling routes you can find in the vicinity. For a day of culture, you can reach the centre of Vienna within half an hour.

Spacious pitches

The small-scale terraced campsite offers pitches on grassy banks. The spacious pitches allow for rustic and pleasant camping. You will find both shaded and unshaded pitches.

Good morning!

In the morning you can enjoy freshly baked bread, ideal to start the day with. Five kilometres from the campsite you'll find a supermarket to get your daily groceries. If you would like to have a bite to eat, we recommend Renate's Postschänke. This restaurant is only one kilometre from the campsite.

Playing in nature

For the real nature lovers, nature park Sparbach is a must. This is the oldest nature park in Austria. It has various hiking trails and is less than twenty kilometres from Vienna. Watch out and spot the wild boar and deer in the area! Children will have a great time in the large playground with tree houses and a water and sand play area.

properties.name: Camping Nord-Sam
properties.description:
On the outskirts of the city of Salzburg lies Nord-Sam, a well-maintained and cheerful four-star campsite with lots of green, a beautiful swimming pool and a good connection (bike path and bus stop) to Salzburg. Nord-Sam is a truly wonderful base for visiting this classic, atmospheric city. Salzburg is full of history, if for no other reason than it is where Mozart was born and gave his concerts. The Salzburg-Salzkammergut region is ideal for relaxing cycling and hiking tours.

Four-star campsite

The reception building is built in a traditional style with different floors. Downstairs you will find the sanitary facilities and the kitchen, on the first floor is the restaurant with terrace, the reception and the shop. Everything here is clean and well organised. Due to its favourable location vis-à-vis Salzburg, Nord-Sam is not the cheapest campsite in the country. But speaking of this nearby tourist attraction: the campsite offers excursions to Salzburg.

Sun and shade

The pitches on this little campground are small but well maintained. They have good grass surfaces and are demarcated by carefully pruned bushes. In the months before and after the July-August period, you camp with a bit more space and have more privacy. There are a lot of trees, so many pitches are wonderfully shaded. The sanitary facilities at Camping Nord-Sam are clean and stylish.

Pleasant swimming pool

The swimming pool (limited hours: from 9-12 and from 14-19:00) is heated and well maintained. Around the pool you will find some loungers and sun umbrellas. The whole area is surrounded by walls, beautifully tiled with blue and white mosaics. Three hundred metres from the campsite you will find a large supermarket, a butcher and a pizzeria.

properties.name: ArdenParks Tulderheyde
properties.description:
Camping Tulderheyde is a real family park. This Belgian campsite is located in a beautiful area close to the Dutch border. In the surroundings you will find the nature reserves 'Gorp en Roovert' and 'De Utrecht'. In the warmest region of Belgium, where heath, woods and small waters surround you, you are guaranteed a great holiday.

A very quiet spot

Are you booking a camping pitch? Then you will find a spacious undefined pitch around a grassy field. All pitches are the same size. There is not much shade, but you will be camping in a very quiet spot at the edge of pine woods and large meadows. The pitches are arranged in groups of four on a marked field. The campsite also has cute hiker's huts and many different types of lodges.

Swimming, fishing and sunbathing

Of course you come to this campsite to swim! There is a swimming pond with a defined area for the smallest swimmers and a lovely sandy beach. You can fish in the adjacent area. You don't have to walk far for a drink. The beach bar and a restaurant are close to the swimming lake. THe campsite also has several restaurants. Bread and some basic products are available at the campsite.

Time for a game

Do you like a game? Various tournaments are organised in summer, such as cards, darts and billiards. In addition, in high season there are various music evenings and fun activities for children. There is also a playground and a bouncy castle where your children can have fun.

properties.name: EuroParcs Zilverstrand
properties.description:
EuroParcs Zilverstrand is located in the wooded and water-rich Antwerp Kempen. The campsite is named after the park's white sandy beach. The area invites you to enjoy myriad cycling and walking tours, but there are also many facilities on the campsite itself. There's something for everyone: all kinds of sporting activities, a beautiful natural pond, a nice restaurant and even a wellness centre.

Spacious campsites

The bungalows are located behind the pond, and the camping area is hidden behind old pine trees. This is separated from the rest of the bungalow park. The pitches on the campsite are very spacious with no demarcations. The sanitary facilities are neat and there are free hot showers.

Rental accommodations

It's also possible to rent accommodations at EuroParcs Zilverstrand. There are several safari tents with their own sanitary facilities. There are also detached chalets that are fully equipped. You can also to stay in an apartment for 4 to 6 people.

Take a dip indoors or outdoors

You don't have to leave EuroParcs Zilverstrand to enjoy yourself. There's an indoor swimming pool near the main building. It features a waterslide as well as a paddling pool. The natural pond is the central point of the park. You can sup and sail on the natural water.

Abundant facilities

EuroParcs Zilverstrand's spacious restaurant offers an extensive menu and a cosy bar. The animation team organises various activities for all ages. You can also relax and unwind in the wellness centre, which includes a Turkish steam bath and sauna.

properties.name: Camping Huttopia Vallée de la Semois - Ardenne
properties.description:
Want to wake up to the pleasant sound of a babbling river? At Huttopia Vallée de la Semois - Ardenne campsite in Mauzaive, in the south of the Belgian Ardennes, that dream becomes reality. This campsite is in a beautiful spot, right on the Semois river, and in the middle of the wooded, hilly Vallée de la Semois National Park. In short, an ideal holiday address for hikers, mountain bikers and water sports enthusiasts, and above all for nature lovers. In high season, many families visit this Huttopia campsite.

Lovely camping on the waterfront

On this authentic campsite, you will mainly find tourist pitches, often separated by green hedges. Several dozen pitches are located directly on the Semois. Would you like accommodation with private bathroom? Then book a modern chalet, safari tent or gypsy caravan.

Ideal family destination during the summer holidays

There is also plenty to do in the surrounding area, particularly in the summer holiday. Fun activities are organised for the youngest campers, such as a nature walk, tracking, treasure hunts or hut building. Later in the day, they will romp in the playground, swim in the two swimming pools (one with sliding roof) or relax in the cosy centre de vie with table football, board games and a reading corner. In the evening, enjoy a musical performance, a theatre show or a film in the open-air cinema.

Enjoy the natural beauty

This part of the Ardennes is especially popular with nature lovers. From the campsite, you can go on lovely walks and cycle rides in the surrounding area. One of the most beautiful spots is the village of Rochehaut (7 km), from where you can enjoy panoramic views of the surroundings.

properties.name: Le Florenville Camping
properties.description:
Camp by the river Semois, in the Ardennes, at Le Florenville Camping. You stay in a beautiful location with lots of greenery, within walking distance of the village of Florenville. You have access to the lake from the campsite. The area is ideal for nature lovers and campers who enjoy hiking, cycling and visiting picturesque villages. On the campsite, the large swimming pool provides lots of entertainment.

Camping on a green site

Le Florenville Camping has a mix of camping pitches and rental accommodation. If you come with your own tent, caravan or motorhome, then you pitch on grass. The pitches are about 80 m2 and there are some pitches with private toilet and shower facilities. If you prefer accommodation, there are several types of chalets and mobile homes to choose from. The site has lots of trees, providing shade on hot, sunny days.

Swimming in the swimming pool

The central point of the campsite is the open-air swimming pool. Fun for young and old! The pool is large enough to swim lengths and enjoying hours of fun. Finished swimming? Then settle down on a lounger on the lawn around the pool. Get a nice ice cream or refreshing drink from the snack bar.

Enjoying the Ardennes

The river Semois offers many opportunities for relaxation. Rent a kayak or canoe and take an adventurous trip on the water. You can also go on lovely walking and cycling tours along the water and through the countryside. And be sure to visit Bouillon (26 km), a medieval town with a beautiful castle.

properties.name: ArdenParks Comblain au Pont
properties.description:
Arden Parks Comblain-au-Pont is situated in the heart of the Belgian Ardennes, right on the banks of the River Ourthe. It is a modern campsite where you are completely surrounded by fresh air, greenery and tranquillity. The facilities are well-maintained, and there is a wide range of pitches to choose from. From here, you can easily head into the woods, out onto the water or up into the hills. Fancy a day out in the city? Maastricht is less than a 40-minute drive away.

Camping with a tent, caravan or motorhome

Whether you come with a tent, stay in a caravan or travel in a motorhome, there are plenty of spacious pitches at this campsite. You can choose whether you want to be in the sun or in the shade. The campsite is open all year round, although the toilet blocks are closed between 15 November and 1 March. Not a problem for self-sufficient campers.

Everything you might need

The facilities on the campsite are simple but good. The toilets and showers are well maintained and there is electricity everywhere. Check-in and check-out are automatic. That means: no reception, no queues, and at a time that suits you. Don’t feel like cooking? You will find lovely restaurants with outdoor seating within walking distance in the village.

An active holiday in the Ardennes

Here, you start every day with a fresh plan. Walking and cycling routes start right at the campsite. Go kayaking on the Ourthe, or climb the rocks at Comblain. Be sure to visit the nearby caves to learn all about the subterranean world. The Spa-Francorchamps circuit is less than an hour’s drive away.

properties.name: Camping Aux Sources de Lescheret
properties.description:
Camping Aux Sources de Lescheret, located in the Belgian Ardennes, is a small (partially car free) and sustainable natural campsite of about two and a half hectares. There are three spring lakes on the campsite, which give the campsite its name. Here you can swim, fish and play. The atmosphere on the campsite is laid back and very relaxed, so guests can really relax here. 

Camping in a green and shady paradise

The first glance of the campsite is one of a green paradise full of bushes, leafy and pine trees. These provide lovely shade. A large part of the campsite is taken up by the cooling water of the three lakes. The pitches around these lakes are primarily intended for tents. If you are travelling without your own camping equipment, you can book an accommodation on the campsite.

Swimming fishing, hiking and cycling

One of the three lakes is a swimming lake and is surrounded by a sunbathing lawn with grass and bushes. The two others are fishing lakes. In one of the lakes you can cast your hook for free, fishing in the other lake does have a fee. But in the "paid" pond you have a better chance of a good catch to take home. The campsite also functions as a hub for the extensive hiking and cycling routes.

Natural surroundings

The campsite is located in the Haute-Sûre Forêt d'Anlier nature park, which consists of the Haut-Sûre valley and the Forest of Anlier. The Haute-Sûre valley is a true paradise where you will find many protected plant and animal species. This valley is the largest wetland nature reserve in Belgium and is of great importance to many species.

properties.name: Camping Anderegg
properties.description:
Campsite Anderegg is located in Waimes, Belgium, near the German border. The campsite is situated in beautiful surroundings, close to Lake Robertville. The pitches are spacious and several are situated directly along a small stream. The surroundings are perfect for cycling, walking or just enjoying the peace and quiet and nature.

Hiking and biking along highlights

Sporty campers will find what they are looking for at Camping Anderegg. Various hiking, cycling and mountain biking routes depart from the campsite. Just four kilometres from the campsite you will find the starting points of the RAVel routes. These cycle routes are suitable for all levels and take you over old railway lines and towpaths along all kinds of beautiful places. Enjoy a break in nature, far away from the busy car traffic.

If you choose the leg wagon, you also have numerous options. Walk through the beautiful forest near the campsite or set course towards Lake Robertville. Enjoy the sun or enjoy the various water sports you can do here. The lake and the 55 metre high dam are a beautiful picture!

Facilities for young and old

Camping Anderegg is small, but still offers the necessary facilities. In the campsite shop you can buy groceries, tasty local wine, ready-made meals and cycling and walking maps.

You can relax on the terrace while the children have fun in the recreation room, the playground or the play stream. The campsite also has a bowling alley and heated sanitary facilities.

properties.name: Camping Oos Heem BVBA
properties.description:
In the Belgian Ardennes, between Malmedy and Sankt Vith, lies campsite Oos Heem. This small family campsite is true to its name: it has a convivial and homely atmosphere. There is even a communal living room. Oos Heem lies in the middle of nature; there are endless hiking and cycling opportunities in the area surrounding the campsite. During the peak season, there is an extensive entertainment programme for both children and adults.

Welcome!

At campsite Oos Heem, you camp on demarcated grass pitches. The terraced campsite is situated on gently sloping grounds and is beautifully landscaped; there are flowers everywhere. There are many permanent year-round pitches, but also sufficient touring pitches. There are also mobile homes, furnished (safari) tents and even fun Gypsy wagons available to rent. Next to the swimming pool lies a field for pitching tents, where groups will sometimes set up camp. 

Petting zoo

There are all sorts of activities for the entire family on the campsite. There is a petting zoo where the children can feed the chickens, pet the goats and even ride on the pony. They can also help with taking care of the animals. 

Plenty of fun

On the outskirts of the campsite lies a covered heated pool. But there is also plenty to do on dry land. In the peak season, there is an extensive entertainment programme for all ages (from children and teenagers to adults). Activities for during the day include a crafts club, face painting workshop or children's theatre. You can also join a mountain bike excursion or a dance party. In the evening, there are events such as bingo and disco nights. Are you looking for more adventure? Every week there's an exciting night orienteering event and a large campfire.

properties.name: Henne Strand Resort
properties.description:
Henne Strand Resort is in the middle of the village of Henne, in south-west Jutland. Five-star campsite on the North Sea coast. Facilities include an indoor swimming pool plus slide, a wellness centre, playground and restaurant. Entertainment programme for children, including children's disco. In the area, visit the cosy town of Esbjerg (44 km) or walk through the nature around the Ringkøbing Fjord (25 km).

Luxury pitches and accommodation

Five types of pitches are available, ranging from standard (100 m²) to deluxe (140 m²), all with water and electricity connections (16A). There are specific pitches for motor homes (80 m²) and tents (60-80 m²).

Don't have your own camping equipment? Then opt for rental accommodation. Options include the round, luxurious 'Lerchennest', including a double bedroom and a bathroom with a sauna. Or choose a cabin, suitable for up to six people.

Nothing has been forgotten

A swimming pool with a water slide, a bar, a wonderful restaurant and a wellness centre: what more could you want when you’re on holiday? If you're looking for more of a glamping camping experience, this campsite is the place for you.

The Danish North Sea coast

There’s plenty to do around the campsite too. The beach is within walking distance and the perfect place for long walks and water sports. The village of Henne is literally around the corner and has shopping streets with restaurants, cafés, and shops, including a supermarket. Don't forget your walking shoes or bike: an exploration of the surrounding forests and heathlands is a must.

properties.name: Give Camping
properties.description:
Give Camping is located in the green interior of Jutland, within walking distance from the centre of Give. The campsite is suitable for families, offering a relaxed atmosphere with facilities for young and old. Located just a 15-minute drive from Legoland Billund (15 km) and Givskud Zoo (8 km), it is an ideal base for day trips. Guests appreciate the peaceful surroundings and friendly welcome. The campsite is open all year round.

Pitches and rental accommodation

There are about 130 spacious tourist pitches available at Give Camping, ranging from sunny to shady spots on grass. The toilet and shower facilities are modern and have facilities for the disabled and families. There are special facilities for campers such as a waste water and chemical toilet discharge area. Dogs are welcome as they are kept on a lead.

Activities for the entire family

The campsite has an outdoor swimming pool and a paddling pool with slide. For the children, there is various play equipment, trampolines and a bouncy castle. Sporty guests can use the multi-sport field, the tennis court and mini-golf course. Feeling hungry after an active day on holiday? There is a small restaurant on site where you can order a simple meal or snack. There is also a communal kitchen and barbecue area.

Day trip to Legoland or the zoo

The campsite is close to Legoland Billund (15 km) and Givskud Zoo (8 km). For fun in the water with the entire family, a day at Aquadome in Lalandia (18 km) is a good idea. Other attractions in the area include the rune stones of Jelling (10 km) and the town of Vejle (25 km). For nature lovers, there are hiking and cycling routes in the area.

properties.name: Løgstør Camping
properties.description:
On the Danish Limfjord, in the north of Denmark, this campsite lies close to the sea. A short walk through the woods, and you're at the water's edge. That's a lot of fresh air every day! Are you coming back to Løgstør Camping? Then you can read a book in peace and quiet on your pitch. It will be located on one of the large lawns. At Løgstør Camping, you will discover complete relaxation.

Conviviality, peace and nature

Løgstør Camping is not an ultra-modern, super-sleek campsite. But that's not why campers come here. They come for the conviviality, peace and nature. And you will find it here, in northern Denmark, some fifty kilometres from Aalborg. You will be camping here almost directly on the Limfjord. The beach and the water are very close by. At this campsite, you'll quickly feel at home. This is due to the friendly owners, but also to the wonderful atmosphere. Everyone is looking for the same thing: peace and quiet. And that's exactly what you'll find here.

Pitches with privacy

Do you like to camp in a spot in the sun? Or do you prefer the shade of trees? At Løgstør Camping, you will find a pitch to your liking. You can park your camping equipment on one of the elongated grassy fields. These are separated by hedges. As a result, the place is always quiet, and you can enjoy your privacy. Whether you are in the open field or at the edge of the forest. At this campsite, you can also rent a spacious bungalow or cosy hiker's hut.

properties.name: Silkeborg Sø Camping & Feriehuse
properties.description:
Looking for a lovely family-friendly campsite near the woods, with its own sandy beach next to a recreational lake? Silkeborg Sø Camping & Feriehuse, situated on the outskirts of Silkeborg (Central Jutland), is an excellent choice. Here, you will be camping right on the shores of Silkeborg Langsø, one of the lakes in the Danish Lake District. In this wooded and water-rich area, there are lovely walks and cycling and mountain bike trails to explore. A great destination for a long stay, and also a suitable campsite for campers passing through.

Green spaces and small plots

At Silkeborg Sø, touring pitches are in the majority. The spacious pitches are spread across several small fields, divided by well-tended trees and bushes. Upon arrival, you can choose your favourite free spot yourself. For families with children, there is a specially designated field right next to the playground and the mini-golf course. At the back of the campsite, you will find a number of accommodation options, including comfortable mobile homes, camping cabins and bungalows.

Perfect for paddleboarding and canoeing

From the camping area, a path leads to the private sandy beach that belongs to the campsite. At this beach, you will also find a jetty and a set of steps. This is an excellent spot for a refreshing dip in the lake, or a starting point for a trip on a stand-up paddleboard or canoe. For a snack and drink, several communal dining and recreational areas have been set up. There is a covered terrace next to the playground and a charming dining room near the reception. An ideal spot to enjoy your freshly collected breakfast in high season.

properties.name: Anslet Strand Camping
properties.description:
This small-scale campsite in the southeast of Jutland is ideal for those looking for peace and quiet. Anslet Strand Camping offers you a wonderful stay by the sea with a view. There are pitches right on the beach, and you look out over the strait of the Little Belt. The town of Haderslev is about twenty kilometres away. You can take beautiful walks and bike rides in the area. Or go on the beach.

Overlooking the water's edge

This campsite has beautiful pitches with a grass surface. Here you can enjoy peace, space and greenery. Your neighbours are mostly Danes and Germans. The pitches are different in size, but they are hardly marked. A number of places are shielded. From the pitches at the edge of the campsite, you have a view over the water. In addition, the campsite has two nice wooden bungalows for rent.

Between fields and forests

This campsite is especially attractive to anglers and those looking for peace and quiet. You are surrounded by fields and forests. The campsite is situated in a gorge. From the adjacent hill, you can look out over the landscape. The campsite borders a mixed beach (sand and pebbles) that slopes gently into the sea. You can swim comfortably with your children, but do bring water shoes. There is also a slide.

Swimming in the Little Belt

For your basic shopping, you go to the small campsite shop. Here you can also buy fresh bread. The sanitary facilities are somewhat outdated but clean. The children can enjoy themselves in the playground with a climbing tower. There is no pool at this campsite, but the Little Belt offers plenty of fun for swimmers, anglers and amateur boaters.

properties.name: Terrassen Camping
properties.description:
Terrassen Camping is located in the heart of the Danish lake district in Central Jutland. Camping here? You’ll wake up to impressive views over the water and mountains. The campsite is a paradise for nature lovers, peace seekers and families. Head off out on an adventure in the woods and enjoy your camping holiday undisturbed at this campsite; it's the second-highest in Denmark!

Camp with a view

As the campsite's name suggests, its large pitches are set against a mountain slope. There are beautiful views almost everywhere. Are you travelling with your own camping equipment or renting accommodation? Choose a bungalow, glamping tent or mobile home.

Facilities for everyone

You can also enjoy the view of the Silkeborg lakes from the heated water in the campsite's swimming pool. Children can play in the playgrounds and on the mini-golf course. Entertainment is organised in the high season. Your four-legged friend is welcome too. Let's be honest: with this wonderful view, you won't need much else.

Explore the beautiful surroundings

A train station nearby takes you to Silkeborg in 11 minutes and Aarhus in 38 minutes. Prefer to go by boat? You can do that too! There is a direct connection by water to Silkeborg, Ry and Himmelbjerget, amongst other places. The Hjejlen, a steam-powered paddle steamer from 1861, is a relaxing way to explore the water. Prefer to explore the water yourself? Then hire a canoe at the campsite. A visit to LEGOLAND® (80 km) is a must too, of course.

properties.name: Aa-Strand Camping
properties.description:
For those looking for a combination of water, sun, wind and nature, Aa-Beach is the place to go. Surrounded by nature and close to the beach, the campsite looks nice and well-kept. The enthusiastic owners do everything in their power to ensure a pleasant stay for their guests. Despite the rather isolated setting, this campsite is easy to reach.

Roomy, quiet and green campsite

The campsite is well maintained and exudes peace and space. The pitches for campers are spacious and surrounded by greenery. You can choose a pitch with more or with less shade. In addition to camping pitches, there are apartments for rent in the main building as well as a few hiker huts. It is obvious that the pitches and accommodation units are continuously being updated. You will mostly come across Danish, Dutch and German guests. Guests stay here for peace and for the water.

Enjoying water and wind

Boating and fishing from the campsite is very popular. Furthermore, the beach is extremely suitable for kitesurfing, windsurfing and waterskiing. Less than 100 m away is a swimming beach where you can also do some walking or running.

Daily necessities

You can do your grocery shopping at the Spar in Ebberup, a 5 minute drive. In about 15 minutes you reach the town of Assens, where you will find quite a few restaurants. You can order fresh bread on the campsite and you can also buy ice creams and cool drinks from them. The sanitary facilities are more than adequate and include baby and child facilities. The centrally situated sanitary building is well maintained.

properties.name: Sønderborg Camping
properties.description:
Family campsite Sønderborg Camping is located in the port town of Sønderborg in southern Denmark. The town is built around Sønderborg Castle and is partly located on Als Island. A bridge connects it to the rest of the town on Jutland. With the beach, town and beautiful nature in the region, you have everything close by for a varied holiday.

Spacious camping pitches

The campsite can accommodate 800 people. There are tent pitches among the trees and several accommodation and glamping tents for rent, ranging in size from 2 to 7 people. Most of the pitches can be found on one of the large, open lawns. The pitches are spacious and easily accessible by the tarmac road that crosses the campsite.

Activities for the entire family

From your spot, you can easily reach one of the two service buildings. Besides the children's toilet and disabled toilet, the communal kitchen and living room are also worth mentioning. But when the weather is nice, you naturally prefer to go outside! For example, to play in the playground or play sports on the tennis or padel court, which you can book through the campsite. Hungry? Then there is a campsite shop with groceries and a bread service.

A region full of history and nature

Sønderborg town centre is just a 10-minute walk away and offers a mix of historical sights, shops and cosy cafés. Cycle or walk along the coastline and enjoy the beautiful views, or explore the many nature reserves nearby.

properties.name: Nakskov Fjordcamping
properties.description:
Nakskov Fjordcamping is located right on the coast of Denmark, in a lovely spot for campers who love nature, water and a feeling of freedom. You can walk straight onto the sandy beach and enjoy great views over the fjord. Feel like a bit of life? The town of Naksov, with shops, cafés and restaurants is less than 3 kilometres away.

Wake up with views over the fjord

Pitch your tent on one of the natural pitches without electricity, or choose a large pitch with electricity. Cabins and mobile homes are available too. The cabins along the path are a little closer together, but the view over the fjord more than makes up for that. A morning coffee with that view? What a great start to the day.

Hygge on the campsite

The campsite is small and neatly kept. The toilet and washing facilities are simple but clean. There’s no shortage of fun either: light the campfire in the evening and bake snobrød, a typical Danish delicacy, on the fire together. There's plenty to do during the day: a game of beach volleyball on the sports field, a dip in the sea, or join in one of the activities that are organised.

Surroundings and activities

Nakskov Fjordcamping is located right by the water and has a jetty you can fish from. In the area, you can cycle, walk or take a boat trip along the small islands of Nakskov Fjord (24 km). Visit the Maritime Museum, or take a tour of Nakskov's historic centre.

properties.name: Nysted Strand Camping
properties.description:
On the Danish island of Lolland, the fine Nysted Strand Camping is situated at the edge of a bay. Whether you're on a hiking or cycling holiday or just looking for a relaxing place to spend a fortnight with your family, this green campsite is the perfect place for you. Go swimming, fishing, or canoeing in the sea, do some reading on the beach, or walk to the cosy harbour town of Nysted.

From family destination to cycling holiday

Nysted Strand Camping is a neat green campsite divided into several camping fields. You can also rent bungalows, hiker's huts, caravans and apartments. The touring pitches are spacious, and the sanitary facilities are well maintained. There are also sanitary facilities for the disabled and children's and family sanitary facilities. The campsite is right on the water, and from all the pitches, you can walk right to the beach. For campers on the move, there are convenient facilities such as a kitchen and a communal barbecue area.

Catching shrimps

The campsite attracts a diverse clientele of families, itinerant campers and hiking, cycling and fishing enthusiasts. There is no planned entertainment for the children here, but there is a playground, bouncy castle, sports field, table tennis table and a giant chessboard. That's plenty of great places to meet new playmates! And of course, you'll feel drawn to the beach, where you can swim and build sandcastles every day. Other fun activities include pony rides and catching shrimp. Or why not rent a canoe or kayak and explore the bay.

Fresh rolls

During the high season, from June to September, the campsite restaurant is open. You can also get snacks and pizza from the snack bar and fresh bread rolls for your breakfast. A campsite shop offers some necessary items. Additional shopping can be done in Nysted in a matter of minutes.

properties.name: Wilsumer Berge
properties.description:
Wilsumer Berge is a large-scale German campsite less than twenty kilometres from the Dutch border. The campsite is located in a beautiful nature reserve, right next to a recreational lake and amidst forests and heaths. At this campsite, you'll find the best of both worlds: a place for a relaxing camping holiday and an entertainment programme filled with fun activities for children.

Spacious pitches

The campsite is bordered by large trees, but the campground itself is very open. The terrain is hilly: the pitches are at different levels. This creates a nice effect. Some pitches are slightly elevated, while others are situated around large, open grassy areas. Some of those fields have play facilities for younger children. The pitches are not marked out and are not fenced in, creating a sense of spaciousness and allowing you to see far ahead.

Swimming in the lake

The campsite is adjacent to a recreational lake, where you can enjoy a swim in good weather. A shallow area allows the little ones to bathe safely. Much of the lake is surrounded by beach, so you can also soak up the sun.

Plenty to experience

From March and during every school holiday, the entertainment programme at the campsite is diverse. Most activities take place outdoors, but even if the weather doesn't cooperate, there is always a solution. Simply move over to the "Ranger Club" at the campsite.

properties.name: Camping Frings-Mühle
properties.description:
A warm-hearted family runs this simple campsite surrounded by a beautiful forest In the German state of North Rhine-Westphalia. At the entrance to the campsite, the associated hotel-restaurant offers fine terraces which are a pleasant place to linger. The campsite is located directly on the popular Ahr hiking and biking trail, making it a fine location for nature lovers, peace seekers and action lovers.

Water mill

The Gasthof is easily visible from the quiet road. From there you turn off over a small bridge to the adjacent campsite. The campsite is named after a water mill, which was built in 1818.

View of the woods

The elongated and flat site has predominantly seasonal pitches. If you are coming with a group, a special field has been set up for you. Located centrally near the playground there is space for touring pitches on well-maintained grassy areas. On both sides of the campsite there are also sites set up for caravans, tents and campers. The sanitary facilities, which are centrally located, look rather dated, but they are clean.

Schnitzel on your plate

Many believe that a holiday in Germany includes a local meal. Campers at Camping Frings-Mühle really love the schnitzels served in the restaurant. If you are having breakfast at the restaurant in the morning you can order them in advance. The same goes for the fresh bread rolls available in the small supermarket. During the day, the terrace is a lively break location for passing cyclists and walkers. But in the evenings, silence reigns, as the owners value a good night's sleep for their guests.

properties.name: Eifel-Camp Freilinger See
properties.description:
Eifel-Camp Freilinger See is located in green North Rhine-Westphalia. It's great for families but also ideal if you like to camp in peace and quiet. The campsite is located among forests and hills and a clear reservoir is a few minutes' walk away. Space is combined with comfort and a relaxed atmosphere. Wake up here to the gentle rustling of trees.

Comfortable pitches, private toilet/washing facilities

The pitches are large and neatly separated by greenery. Each luxury pitch even has its own adjacent bathroom and kitchen. Very practical and adds freedom. Prefer slightly more comfort? The wooden cabins are well insulated, heated and equipped for all seasons. Ideal for early spring or late autumn camping.

Swim in the lake and relax in the sauna

There’s plenty to do on the campsite. An entertainment programme for all ages is organised during holiday periods. Children have fun at the Indian camp, while teenagers like to hang out at the skate park or the relaxed chill area overlooking the surrounding area. You can take a dip in the water at the lake. Afterwards, retreat to the private sauna with rain shower and infrared cabin. Pure luxury after a day full of activities.

Nature and wine festivals

The green surroundings invite you to get out and about. Walk around Lake Freilinger See or a longer route. The Ahrsteig and Eifelsteig meander through forests, valleys and open fields. The Lamperstal nature reserve is perfect for an afternoon outdoors.

properties.name: Naturcamping Vulkaneifel
properties.description:
Naturcamping Vulkaneifel is on the outskirts of the village of Manderscheid, a spa town in the middle of the Volcanic Eifel. The campsite is surrounded by forests, meadows and streams. Here, you camp in one of Germany's most beautiful walking areas. You can take lovely country walks straight from the campsite. The famous Eifel lakes are also close by. There is respect for plants and animals at this typical nature campsite. The campsite management lets nature take its course as far as possible. However, there is space for playgrounds, a camp fire, grill areas and of course camping pitches. This campsite is ideal for campers who are looking to stay in the countryside during their holiday.

Wonderful camping spot in a natural context

When you come to the campsite, you don't notice straight away that it's a relatively large site. This campsite is discreetly and, above all, beautifully tucked away in the countryside. About a third of this partly terraced site consists of camping pitches. Nature is allowed to take its course on the rest of the campsite. Here, you can spend the night in a pleasant hiker's cabin or a wooden holiday home.

Fresh bread and meals on request

There is a small shop by reception with a modest range of groceries. Fresh breakfasts are also available daily. If you would also like to dine at this campsite, let reception know. Perhaps one of the owners can cook for you individually. You can also buy groceries and go out for dinner in Manderscheid, at walking distance the campsite.

properties.name: Campingpark Reinsfeld
properties.description:
This campsite is located in western Germany in the forested Saar-Hunsrück Nature Park. You will find Campingpark Reinsfeld one and a half kilometres from Reinsfeld, and about thirty kilometres from Trier, the oldest city in Germany. Reinsfeld is a large campsite that still manages to feel quiet and small. Just like how camping is supposed to be!

Open all year round

Campingpark Reinsfeld is vast and very quiet. The grounds are divided into circular camping fields. This gives the whole place a cosy and small-scale atmosphere. Because the campsite is open year-round, many people have permanent pitches there. The RV site is located at the entrance, next to the reception.

Fun and games

There's plenty of room for fun in the water at this family camping ground. There's an outdoor pool with a children's pool for the little ones. And there's also a small lake on which you can sail with inflatable boats. In the nature playground, children will have fun playing with water and sand. For climbing and scrambling around, they can head to the regular playground. Camping Reinsfeld also has a beach volleyball court and a tennis court, and there is space to play table tennis and football.

Make friends here

There is an active recreation team that organises fun activities for the children in the high season. The entertainment team, called MausRekrea, consists of a group of families who organise fun activities together. Crafts, karaoke and blowing giant bubbles; there really is a lot to do! You can also play golf near the campsite (24 km), go summer tobogganing (21 km) or visit the Freisen Nature Wildlife Park (43 km). The small campsite shop will provide you with fresh bread rolls for the road.

properties.name: Häppy Life Camping Burgen
properties.description:
The village of Burgen is located at the mouth of the romantic Baybach stream. It is part of the Mayen-Koblenz district, better known as the Moselle region. This picturesque wine region is known for its steep slopes and vineyards, historic towns and centuries-old castles. Camping Burgen is the ideal starting point for unforgettable cycle rides and walking trips.

Watch the boats from your camping pitch

The open grounds of Camping Burgen have several grassy fields without boundary markings. There are also a few pitches right at the water’s edge, some of which are usually occupied by regular guests. But they are also sometimes available for touring guests. It’s a nice extra touch to watch the boats go by from your own terrace. Once the sun goes down, the castle on the opposite bank is beautifully lit up. Very romantic!

Fun on the water

If you’re looking to cool off on hot days, head over to the modestly sized swimming pool. Since it enjoys full sun, it’s a great place to swim and sunbathe. Prefer to enjoy the water in a different way? You can launch your own boat from a spot along the river, or you can hire one and take it out for a spin.

Relaxed life outdoors

Fresh bread rolls in the morning, a small campsite shop, a playground for (grand)children and even a dedicated dog park for four-legged friends. Everything you could possibly need is available at this friendly campsite. Young and old can play a game of chess together on the outdoor chess set with large pieces, located right in the middle of the campsite. For larger shopping trips and lovely restaurants, Burgen is just around the corner.

properties.name: Camping Sensweiler Mühle-Naturlich Camping
properties.description:
Camping Sensweiler Mühle - Natürlich Camping is surrounded by woods, streams and the hills of the Hunsrück. It is a small, charming campsite where you can enjoy an authentic camping experience thanks to its hospitality and beautiful location. Despite the main road running alongside the campsite, all you can really hear here is the babbling water and the birds in the trees.

Comfortable camping by the water

The river Idarbach flows past much of the campsite. So there are plenty of spots by the water! Choose a pitch on one of the grassy areas (both with and without a vehicle) or opt for the paved and partially enclosed comfort pitches. There are also a few self-catering units available to rent.

Beer, sandwiches and the best schnitzel in the Hunsrück

At the campsite, you’ll find everything you need for a carefree stay. Start your day with fresh bread rolls from the bakery, pick up cold regional drinks at reception or book a fridge. At the mill inn, you can enjoy hearty meals, including daily specials, the crispiest schnitzel in the region as well as vegetarian options. When the weather is fine, the beer garden is open – a lovely spot to relax after a walk with a local beer or a good glass of wine. Fresh cakes are baked on Saturdays. Delicious with a cup of coffee!

Out exploring nature

The area around Sensweiler Mühle is rich in nature and culture. Climb the Erbeskopf – the highest point in Rhineland-Palatinate – and enjoy the view from the wooden tower or the Windklang sculpture. The Droomlus Gipfelrauschen (7.5 km) loop runs around the Erbeskopf and is a beautiful, peaceful route through the countryside.

properties.name: Camping Harfenmühle
properties.description:
Camping Harfenmühle is in the west of Germany, in the heart of the Hunsrück nature reserve. This friendly family campsite is between the famous wine regions of Nahe and Mosel. There is a swimming lake in the middle of the lovely site, ideal for children. The campsite restaurant is known as being good and offers a varied menu. The location on the Deutschen Edelsteinstrasse (German Gemstone road) is exceptional, this region has been known for its gemstones for hundreds of years.

Families who appreciate peace and quiet and the countryside can spend a relaxing holiday here in surroundings that have not yet been discovered by the masses. Several small villages are within driving distance of five to 10 kilometres.

Pleasant, open pitches

The unmarked camping pitches are playfully laid out and do not have demarcation. They are spread over the site, which is not completely level, but is divided into terraces. All camping pitches are surrounded by hedges and trees. If you hire a chalet or mobile home, you will be staying in a lovely part in the valley where the permanent pitches are. The toilet and washing facilities are modern and neat.

Paradise in the countryside

Go paddling, swimming, down the slide or splash about in the water; you can do it all in the swimming lake. Children have the upper hand at this campsite and that's clear from the fun activities in the high season. As genuine adventurers, children can take part in the search for gemstones and fool's gold in the brook at the campsite in the summer months every day for free. There is also a playground and a bouncy castle.

properties.name: Campingpark Waldwiesen
properties.description:
Camping Waldwiesen is situated just outside the small town of Birkenfeld (Rheinland-Pfalz) in a non-tourist region with beautiful scenery. The campsite consists of a 'nature area', beautifully laid out like a park with very well-maintained greenery. The sanitary facilities are slightly dated but are kept very clean. There is a wide range of rental accommodations on the grounds.

Reception in cosy log cabin

The reception is housed in a wooden log cabin. Guests are welcomed by Mrs Schuller, the enthusiastic proprietress. There is no shop on the campsite. You will have to go to Birkenstock for your shopping (500 m only).

Well-kept greenery

Directly to the right of the entrance, there is a large tent lawn, surrounded by trees. The pitches are not demarcated. The terrain makes a well-maintained impression. The vegetation is remarkably lush. The pitches are spacious and surrounded by trees and shrubs, allowing for ample privacy and shade. Several types of accommodation can be rented on the campsite (holiday home, holiday apartment, three mobile homes and an equal number of camping-pods)

Nature lovers and gemstone searchers

Campsite Waldwiesen with its reputation as a nature campsite, is mostly frequented by seekers of quietude and nature lovers. Gemstone enthusiasts are faithful visitors to the region.

Large swimming pond

Halfway on the grounds, you will find a large swimming pond of some 2000 m2. The water in the pond is strictly monitored. It's an ideal spot for children for swimming, splashing around and boating.
