Adjacent to the pond is a large play and sunbathing lawn. When this kind of water fun is still not sufficient, you can go to the sub-tropical swimming pool, 5 km further on. Also great: there are six fire pits on the campsite.

properties.name: Campingpark Ohmbachsee
properties.description:
Campingpark Ohmbachsee is located near the French border, directly on the Ohmbachsee reservoir. Here you'll be camping in the mountainous landscape of the Pfalz. A nice place to enjoy nature, relax and unwind. Or, alternatively, for sporty exploration with a variety of hiking tours. Exhausted from hiking? Then go for a schnitzel in the cosy campsite restaurant.

Separate touring pitches on green lawns

The seasonal pitches for regular guests are separate from the touring pitches. You'll find your pitch on one of the small lawns. They are separated from each other by green hedges. The most beautiful places are those with a view of the lake. Those who do not have camping equipment can book a stay in one of the unique wine barrel accommodations.

Relax on the Ohmbachsee

Tranquillity is the key word at this German campsite. And where can you find more peace and quiet than by and on the water? There are many quiet places under the trees around the whole lake. So don't be surprised if you see several fellow campers carrying fishing rods. But true tranquillity can only be found on the water. You can rent a pedal boat at the campsite. Then pedal to the middle of the lake, rest your legs up and enjoy the view.

Hiking through Rhineland-Palatinate

The green mountains of Rhineland-Palatinate are perfect for long, challenging hikes. The Ritter-Gerin-Weg runs along the Ohmbachsee. This hiking route starts and ends in Schönenberg-Kübelberg. The entire route is thirty kilometres long. But you can make your hike as long or short as you want.

properties.name: Camping Zur schönen Aussicht
properties.description:
The panoramic views and high altitude of Camping Zur Schönen Aussicht make this campsite unique in the Tecklenburger Land region. The campsite is surrounded by woods, where various hiking and cycling trails begin. Campers will find various shops and restaurants just three kilometres away. It's a lovely walk from the campsite.

Well-kept camping pitches

Camping Zur schönen Aussicht is a fine spot for campers who prefer to camp on a grass pitch. There are sunny, marked pitches with fine views as well as shady pitches, which are located at a lower elevation. These are situated in a former quarry, surrounded by a small wood where you can welcome the first rays of sunshine every morning. Have you come to the campsite without camping equipment? Then you can stay in one of the five fine guest rooms.

Heated swimming pool

The small rectangular swimming pool is located at the front of the campsite, next to the bar. The water has been heated to a comfortable 26 degrees and the pool features a retractable roof, allowing the swimming pool to be covered. This makes it possible to go swimming at this campsite even in bad weather.

Themed sanitary facilities

The sanitary facilities are located near the playground and the swimming pool. The buildings are neatly furnished and the children who come and camp here love the Jungle-themed family shower with fun murals.

Beer specialities

The bar is the social heart of the campsite. On the adjoining terrace with seating, you can enjoy one of the beers on the menu, for example. Every month, a new beer speciality is featured.

properties.name: Camping Ulmbachtalsperre
properties.description:
Camping Ulmbachtalsperre is a few kilometres outside of Greifenstein in the German Hessische Westerwald. Here, you camp in a hilly setting where you can go on lovely walks and cycle rides through the forest. The campsite is by the Ulmbachstausee reservoir. This lake offers plenty of options for water recreation. The campsite has a private sunbathing meadow, sandy beach and swimming jetty.

What accommodation options are there?

The campsite covers the full west bank of the lake. If you want to stay at the campsite as a touring camper, you will probably end up on one of the well-maintained camping fields by the water. It is also possible to stay in a charming tiny house.

Lots of water fun in the Ulmbachstausee

One of the reasons that this campsite is so popular is due to the wonderful grass meadow by the lake. This meadow opens out onto a sandy beach. It is the ideal spot to go safely into the water. There is also a swimming jetty and there are two pontoons. So, playing and swimming fun are guaranteed! Furthermore, you can go on the lake with your own boat or standup paddleboard.

Explore the surrounding area

Camping Ulmbachtalsperre is an ideal starting point for taking lovely walks and bike rides through the forested hills in the surrounding area. And there is plenty more to do in this part of Hessen. You can, for example, visit one of the zoos, museums, castles or charming villages in this region. Burg Greifenstein castle is about a 10-minute drive from the campsite and it is famous for its Baroque church and clock museum.

properties.name: Camping Schwarzwaldhorn
properties.description:
Looking for a lovely terraced campsite in the Black Forest with views over mountains and meadows? Camping Schwarzwaldhorn near Simonswald is situated in a relatively quiet part of the Black Forest, surrounded by unspoilt nature. You can go on lovely walks from here. You can truly unwind under the fruit trees on the campsite. In high season, fun activities are organised for the whole family.

Lovely terraced layout with panoramic views

A short but steep path leads from the centre of Simonswald to the campsite. The campsite itself is also situated on a slope. There is a beautiful terraced layout that allows you to enjoy the view of the valley, the village and the surrounding mountains from a number of spots. The touring pitches are at the front, on the lower part of the campsite. Further up, you’ll find the accommodation options, such as comfortable (static) caravans and safari tents. There is also a central toilet block where the dishwasher is particularly popular with campers. Your dishes will be ready in two minutes!

Free swimming at Freibad Simonswald

Fancy a refreshing dip on holiday? As a campsite guest, you can swim for free at Freibad Simonswald, just a few hundred metres away. This municipal swimming pool has a spacious heated outdoor pool, a diving board, a small slide and a large paddling pool. There is a shady grassy area surrounding the pool where you can relax. During the summer holidays, the campsite itself also offers fun activities for campers of all ages. This includes sports competitions, creative games, children’s discos, exciting discovery tours and talent shows.

properties.name: Campingplatz Bederkesa
properties.description:
Campingplatz Bederkesa is a large, well maintained campsite, situated northeast of Bremerhaven and southeast of Cuxhaven. An ideal overnight stop when you are on your way to Scandinavia or when you want to explore the forests, lakes and marshes in the state of Lower Saxony. Cyclists and water sports enthusiasts are also at the right address here. Enjoy the large variety of dishes in camping restaurant 'Das Landhaus' and visit the nearby wellness centre Moor-Therme ‘Aqua Vitalis’.

Camping on the water

On the way to your camping pitch, you will notice that the campsite is larger than it seems at first glance. There are deciduous trees in various places and the camping pitches are spaciously laid out and numbered. Because of the trees and bushes it is easy to create a private spot or a spot in the shade. There are also large fields, where you can meet your fellow campers. Or try and get a camping pitch with a view of the lake. 

For water sports enthusiasts

Campingplatz Bederkesa is located on Lake Bederkesa. It can easily be reached via the main road of the campsite. At the lake, there are a large number of water sports opportunities, such as pedal boating, boating and fishing. In addition, water sports enthusiasts can enjoy themselves on the 61.5 km long Elbe-Weser Waterway. 

Explore the area

In high season the animation team is available to entertain children of up to twelve. On the edge of the campsite you will find an adventurous playground, including a large outdoor chess set and Bolzspiel (type of soccer). Explore the area? Hire a bicycle on the campsite and discover the variegation of forests, lakes and marshes with the extensive network of cycle paths. You can explore the Ahlen-Moor with the Moorbahn, a small train that drives through the region.

properties.name: Camping-und Ferienpark Spadener See Gmbh & co. KG
Camping Sonnenwiese
properties.description:
Located on the banks of a quiet river, right next to a charming recreational lake and with a view of a beautiful hilly landscape. Who wouldn't want to spend a camping holiday here? At Camping Sonnenwiese, near the town of Vlotho in North Rhine-Westphalia, it's possible. The proximity of the river (the Weser) and the lake makes this an ideal campsite for water sports enthusiasts. At the same time, especially in the high season, this is an extremely child-friendly campsite. As a camper here, you will benefit from, among other things, a modern swimming pool and an excellent restaurant.

Location

This campsite is located near the town of Vlotho in northeastern North Rhine-Westphalia. Here you will be camping in a green, wooded and hilly area. So it's an ideal destination for cyclists and hikers! Furthermore, there are characteristic cities in the vicinity that are worth a visit. This is especially true for Minden and Rinteln.

Camping in a natural setting

This campsite consists of beautiful grassy fields where the touring pitches are separated from each other in a natural way, for the most part. Want some extra luxury and comfort? Then go for a comfort camping pitch with private sanitary facilities and, with a bit of luck, a site directly by the lake. In addition to touring pitches, you will find numerous year-round pitches and some rental accommodations at this campsite.

Modern sanitary facilities that will bring a smile to your face

In a central position on the campsite, you will find the sanitary building with very modern facilities. A separate area of the building is cheerfully decorated especially for babies and children. The adults' section is also remarkably tastefully furnished and decorated.

properties.name: Nibelungen-Camping am Schwimmbad
properties.description:
Nibelungen-Camping Am Schwimmbad is a lovely campsite for seekers of peace and quiet, but who also enjoy active sports and nature. Senior citizens are also keen to stay here. Everything is clean and well organised. The surrounding area has much to offer for walkers and cyclists.

Well maintained and clean

On arrival the campsite immediately makes a neat impression. The permanent pitches also look well cared for. You get to the reception on the first floor via a flight of stairs. The owners, brother and sister, are happy to assist you. The tourist pitches are directly located near the entrance of the campsite. The entire campsite is well maintained, neat and tidy. Dogs are not permitted.

Space and quiet

The camping fields are spacious, and every two or three are demarcated with bushes and streets. If preferred, you can also park your motorhome on a paved site. Other than that, there is little difference between the pitches. This is the place to be for guests looking to enjoy their quiet surroundings.

Swimming in the sun

Adjacent to the campsite is the municipal swimming pool with water slide. You can soak up the sun here. Near the reception there is also a lovely recreation room.

Sanitary facilities looking brand new

The sanitary facilities are pristine and complete (you will even find baby powder in the baby room). The room looks like new and is regularly adorned with fresh flowers. You can do your shopping around the corner from the campsite. It is only a short walk further down to two large well-stocked supermarkets. In the village you will find quite a number of eating establishments.

properties.name: Campingpark Bad Liebenzell
properties.description:
At Campingpark Bad Liebenzell, located near the city of Stuttgart in the German state of Baden-Württemberg, you'll experience a relaxing holiday with all the necessary comforts. There's a large municipal swimming pool with a waterslide located right next to the campsite that is freely accessible to campers. You can walk to the supermarket and the village renowned for its thermal baths within a few short minutes. This cosy campsite is located in a green environment and offers spacious pitches, a kitchen for tent campers and even private sanitary facilities.

Camping in the Black Forest

The Black Forest in the south of Germany is known for its hilly landscape. If you enjoy cycling or hiking through nature, you'll absolutely love this area. The local spas are also a major draw. Campingpark Bad Liebenzell has been carefully arranged on a wooded, park-like site. Everything is neatly maintained and adorned with trees and shrubs.

In the grass

The campsite offers a nice mix of 70 spacious and level camping pitches, 80 permanent pitches and a variety of neat glamping accommodations. For example, a stylish, furnished tent or a nice bungalow on stilts. All pitches are on neat lanes and the grass is well maintained. There is a kitchen with a fridge and freezer for tent campers to use. Some pitches offer a view of the village castle atop the hill. There is also room for 10 campers just outside the campsite. Both sanitary buildings are neat and clean. One of them has even been renovated. You'll be given a card on which you can put credit in order to shower.

properties.name: Camping Carpe Diem
properties.description:
Camping Carpe Diem is located in the northern foothills of the Black Forest, near the quiet town of Wildberg. The campsite is by a small river, surrounded by green hills and wooded areas, making it a good destination for those seeking peace and quiet and for nature lovers. The friendly owners will welcome you warmly and provide a friendly atmosphere at the site.

Pitches, cabins and caravans

At Camping Carpe Diem you can choose from spacious, neatly kept, grassy pitches with plenty of privacy. Many pitches are in the shade by the Nagold river. If you don't have your own camping equipment, there are also cabins and caravans for rent. Curious as to who your neighbours are? The spacious layout and quiet, friendly atmosphere have made this campsite popular among families and seniors.

Clean basic amenities

At Camping Carpe Diem you experience camping as it should be: in the middle of nature but with several basic amenities for the necessary entertainment and comfort. There is a basic but clean swimming pool, great for cooling off during those hot summer days and fun for the children. The restaurant, which has a small but tasty menu, also provides takeaway meals. There is also a small campsite shop for daily shopping.

Explore the Black Forest

There is plenty to do in the area around the campsite. Wildberg (2 km) is a charming town. The historic town of Calw (16 km), with its beautiful timbered houses and castle ruins, is definitely worth visiting. Nature lovers will come into their own here with the numerous hiking and bicycle paths through the Black Forest.

properties.name: Campingplatz Horn
properties.description:
Camping Horn is located in the southernmost part of Germany on the Untersee. The border with Switzerland runs through this lake and the adjacent Bodensee. When you camp at Camping Horn, you will have a view of Switzerland on the other side of the lake. If you look left, you will see the island of Reichenau which lies in the middle of the Untersee. If you're visiting with children, you will have a wonderful time on this campsite.

Camping Horn is ideal for families with children. The camping pitches are free of cars and are laid out in a circular pattern, which leaves a grassy field in the middle for the children to play on. Parents can keep an eye on their kids from their own pitch. Teenagers will no doubt want to explore the lake next to the campsite.

More than just camping

The campsite offers more than just a place to set up camp. You will find a mini-golf course and a restaurant serving German and Turkish cuisine. You camp here in an area that's ideal for cycling and hiking. Did you leave your bike at home? Not to worry: the campsite rents out bicycles, even electric bikes. It's the ideal way to explore the surroundings in comfort. 

Swinging, climbing and treasure hunting

For the children there is climbing and playing equipment on the campsite, such as tall swings by the lake and slightly less adventurous swings on the campsite itself. Especially exciting is the Krimi-Tour in Gaienhoffen, where you can go treasure hunting with a GPS tracker.

Montastic island of Reichenau

Reichenau Island deserves its name as a monastic island, because each of the three villages features an abbey. The island is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. You can travel to the island by boat or by car from the opposite shore of the Untersee.

properties.name: Moin Camp
properties.description:
Grüner Jäger is a basic, attractive campsite amidst farming fields in the North of Germany. This is more than an overnight stop; you will never be bored during a longer stay either. Nearby you will find the nature area of Everinghausen where you can go cycling and swimming. A day trip to Bremen will also be on the cards. The camping is in a somewhat remote location in an agricultural landscape, but with the nearby A1 Autobahn it can easily be reached.

Choice of spacious pitches

You can make a choice of the well laid out, specious pitches on grass. Some pitches are unshaded and some are more shady. The pitches are all different, but clearly demarcated. Because the campsite is best reached from the A1, it is especially popular with North Europeans. For people in transit it is very convenient that they can spend the night in a hitched caravan.

Playground and swimming pool

The campsite is child-friendly, with a lovely playground and an animal camp. You can also fish in the nearby river. Near the restaurant at the front you will find the swimming pool with toddler pool and sunbathing lawn.

Sanitary facilities with sauna

The camping shop stocks the basic necessities. There also is daily fresh bread. The rest of the shopping can be done in the village some 5 km away. The heated sanitary facilities are modern and well maintained. You can find every comfort, such as individual washing cubicles, sanitary facilities for families and disabled guests.There is also a sauna .

The restaurant has a wide choice of simple dishes of good quality. There is also a terrace. Take-away is also possible.

properties.name: Camping am Waldbad
properties.description:
Am Waldbad is a campsite without pretensions, situated in the hilly and wooded Weserbergland, 4 km from the town of Hameln. If you like camping and exploring, you will have a fantastic holiday here. A campsite with active amenities and a surrounding region with hills, forests, interesting towns, castles and villages are the ingredients for this.

On the edge of the forest

The campsite lives up to its name and is located at the edge of the forest adjacent to the swimming pool. The site is on a hill next to a large, open field. The campsite managers, the Meyer family, extend you a warm welcome on arrival. When you proceed to the camping field, you will pass the swimming pool and the section with the permanent accommodation units.

Select a pitch that you like

The open camping field looks well maintained and the pitches are not demarcated. Therefore, you can select a pitch that suits you. On this campsite you will come across families, couples and senior citizens. Teenagers will also enjoy themselves here.

Active and sporty

From the campsite you can reach the municipal swimming pool via a small pathway (not free of charge). On the campsite you can partake in volleyball, table tennis and soccer or play in the playground. Starting from the campsite there are several pathways inviting you to explore the beautiful Weserbergland on foot, by bicycle, or running.

Basic supplies

In the shop you can buy the most basic necessities. The restaurants serves good and simple meals. The basic sanitary facilities, clean and heated, lie at some 100 m from the camping field.

properties.name: Friday im Edertal - Naturcampingplatz
properties.description:
Camping Ideal is in the countryside in the heart of Germany, near Kellerwald-Edersee National Park. You camp next to the river Eder and the Edersee recreational lake is close by. It’s a great place to swim, canoe, pedal boat or fish. The wooded surroundings are great for walking and cycling. In short: an ideal place for nature lovers and anyone seeking peace and quiet!

Camp in the countryside

Campers appreciate the tranquillity on the well-kept site. All the pitches are close to the water, some even directly on the river. The young, committed owners are creating a welcoming, contemporary camping paradise with a focus on sustainability. The atmosphere is relaxed and friendly. There's little luxury, but that’s this campsite’s added value. There are 47 pitches and no rental accommodation. This is camping as it’s meant to be!

Chill by the river

The river that runs alongside the campsite is a great place to cool off in summer. When the campfire is lit in the evening, it’s the ultimate end to the day. A little further away, at Edersee, there are plenty of opportunities to swim, rent a canoe or go fishing. At the entrance to the campsite, there's a cosy kiosk that serves freshly tapped German beer, snacks, homemade cake, coffee and ice cream.

Walk in the beautiful surroundings

The Kellerwald-Edersee National Park with its many beautiful walking trails is just around the corner. The most accessible is the Hagenstein-Route. Prefer to cycle? You might like to explore the Ederseebahn cycle path and the Edersee-Radrundweg, for example. The area is also great for cyclists.

properties.name: Camping Kellerwald
properties.description:
In wooded and mountainous Hesse lies the German Camping Kellerwald. With beautiful nature surrounding this child-friendly campsite, it's a pleasure to walk here. Hike the Kellerwaldsteig, a route that takes you right through the forests. From the Kellerwaldturm, you will have the most beautiful view of the area.

The Kellerwald

The Kellerwald: a low mountain range in Hesse, Germany, just across the border from North Rhine-Westphalia. It's your forested camping destination this year. In the middle of the forests of the Kellerwald lies the village of Jesberg. On the edge of it, just outside the centre, you'll find the campsite. Winding roads take you to the entrance. In the white reception building, you will receive a friendly welcome.

Open character

Many of the pitches at the campsite belong to regulars. But there are also plenty of camping spots available for touring campers. Some sixty spacious pitches are situated on neatly mown lawns. The camping area has an open character. There are few tall trees or hedges to get in the way of your view. Looking for a spot of shade? Then it's best to camp at the edge of the site where it's forested.

Child-friendly campsite

Camping Kellerwald is very child friendly. So feel free to take your children here on holiday. The playground is a great deal of fun for the little ones. Here they can swing, slide and climb. But the nature all around is perhaps the finest playground. In the play forest, they can clamber in the trees to their heart's content. And the stream near the campsite is also an excellent place for an adventure.

properties.name: Campingpark Breitenauer See
properties.description:
Campingpark Breitenauer See is just outside the city of Löwenstein, in the German state of Baden-Württemberg. Here, you camp in a hilly landscape with many vineyards and vast forests. It is therefore a wonderful area for taking varied walks and bike rides. The campsite itself is in a large recreational area by a lake, the Breitenauer See. This lake is a lovely place for swimming and doing water sports activities. This is a real five-star campsite, with high-quality facilities.

Neat site with spacious pitches – some with private toilet and washing facilities

On arrival, you can report to reception first, where you will be warmly welcomed. The reception looks modern and sleek, making it exemplary of the campsite as a whole. Paved paths lead to small-scale camping fields, often playfully landscaped.

The campsite has five options for stays. You can book an overnight stay in a modern mobile home or a cosy sleeping barrel, but you can of course also choose a pitch. The camping pitches are spacious and shaded at times. Some pitches have a private toilet block.

Wide selection of sports and play options

There is plenty to do at this campsite, especially for children. For example, there are two large playgrounds and a lovely mountain bike track. Furthermore, there is a large recreational area with an adventure playground and various sports fields just outside the campsite. On cold or rainy days, you can go to the top floor of toilet block 4. It houses a recreation room where you can play table tennis and table football. Fun activities are organised in the summer holidays.

properties.name: AZUR Camping Schwäbische Alb
properties.description:
AZUR Camping Schwäbische Alb is located among the beautiful mountains in south-west Germany. This is a beautiful place for nature lovers and adventurers to enjoy to the full. Surrounded by castles, fortresses and caves, the region feels like it's straight out of a fairy tale. Open all year round, the campsite's facilities include an outdoor swimming pool, bistro and playground.

Choose a camping pitch or unique lodge

As a guest on the campsite, you can choose from several options. There are spacious pitches for tents and caravans, as well as unique lodges and mobile homes for a bit more space and comfort. These accommodations have modern amenities such as a well-equipped kitchen. Dog lovers can bring their four-legged friend with them to the campsite. There is even a dog shower!

Swimming, playing and sports

AZUR Camping Schwäbische Alb has a seasonal outdoor swimming pool, ideal for cooling off on hot summer days. There is also a playground and sports field where children can enjoy themselves. There is a bread service for daily necessities and the campsite also has a bistro where you can grab a bite to eat.

Active holidaymakers and culture lovers

Outdoor enthusiasts enjoy themselves optimally around the campsite. Hikers and cyclists enjoy scenic routes through the Schwäbische Alb, with its unique rock formations, deep caves and picturesque valleys. Also explore historical sights such as Lichtenstein Castle (15.5 km) and the Hohenmelchingen Ruins (7.5 km). The towns of Tübingen (32 km) and Reutlingen (23 km) make a nice day trip with cultural and historical attractions.

properties.name: Camping-Park Lüneburger Heide
properties.description:
At the heart of the Bremen, Hamburg, Hanover triangle you will find Camping Park Lüneburger Heide. This campsite has been designed to resemble a park, with numerous small gardens, planting and even two themed gardens: the music garden and heather garden. The campsite has fully equipped modern bathrooms. For a snack, head to the campsite restaurant, which cooks tasty dishes using local produce.

The camping pitches on this family campsite are spacious and have been separated from one another by hedges, flowers and trees. A separate area in front of the campsite has been set aside especially for motorhomes, and you can check in 24 hours a day by machine. For those who want to camp right next to the water, caravans that sit on the shores of the lake are available for hire.

Build sandcastles and feed animals

On a warm day, there's nothing nicer than being able to cool off in the water, and the lake next to the campsite is perfect for it! There is a large sandy beach where you can build sandcastles, plus a sunbathing lawn. For the children, there is small farm that is home to goats, chickens, rabbits and guinea pigs — children are welcome to come and help with feeding between 4 and 5 pm every day.

The Lüneburg Heath

A stay on this campsite would not be complete without a visit to the Lüneburg Heath. There is a pick-up point next to the campsite for the 'Heide Shuttle', which takes guests to the heart of the Heath free of charge. In high season, night owls can also visit the Heath in the evenings with a ranger. All excursions are organised from the campsite and are suitable for the whole family.

properties.name: Campingplatz Auf dem Simpel
properties.description:
Just above the town of Soltau is the park-like and orderly Campingplatz Auf dem Simpel. From your camping pitch, you can walk or cycle to one of the most beautiful nature reserves in the state of Lower Saxony: the Lüneburger Heide. Those who like to enjoy the outdoor life in peace and quiet can easily alternate that with a dip in the pool and visits to the restaurant.

A tent, a caravan or a wine barrel

The campsite is very diverse and consists of landscaped alleys with spacious pitches on grassy terrain. There are few tall trees, which creates a pleasant and open atmosphere. At the edge of the forest, tent campers can set up a pitch.

A number of campervan spaces are available just outside the site, and the campsite also has several permanent pitches. If you're looking for a comfortable accommodation, the wine barrels might be a good idea. There are also mobile homes, lodges, guest rooms and a holiday home.

German cosiness in the Biergarten

Even if you don't drink beer, the beer garden and the cosily decorated terrace hold considerable appeal. In addition to a simple menu, you can enjoy a drink here on the partially covered terrace. Or you can sit inside, because it is attractively furnished there as well. In the summer months, they serve delicacies from the grill once or twice a week. In the morning, the smell of fresh bread will welcome you. If you really want to make things easy for yourself at the start of the day, you can sign up for a breakfast buffet in advance. There is also a campsite shop offering groceries and camping supplies.

properties.name: Campingpark Südheide
properties.description:
Unwind at Campingpark Südheide, nestled amidst the lush countryside of Lower Saxony, Germany. Here you’ll be camping amidst vast forests and beside the babbling Örtze river. Take a dip in the natural swimming lake, relax in the spa or play a game on the volleyball court. The campsite is situated on the southern edge of Central Europe’s largest contiguous heathland area, the Lüneburg Heath.

Camping in the heart of nature

The camping pitches are spacious and surrounded by greenery. The choice is yours: a sunny spot or a bit of shade under the trees. Many pitches have a tidy grassy surface and are bordered by hedges, giving you that little bit of extra privacy. Travelling without your own tent, caravan or motorhome? Then stay in a comfortable chalet or a charming Heidjer cottage. These cosy accommodations are located close to the river.

Amenities for people and animals

You’ll also be well catered for in terms of facilities. Take a refreshing dip in the natural swimming pool or unwind completely in the wellness centre with its Finnish sauna and sanarium. Children can burn off some energy in the playgrounds or at the water pump play area, where they can splash about endlessly in the water and sand. Your pets are also more than welcome here. Enjoy beautiful walking routes and special dog beaches nearby. After a day full of adventure, you can easily wash your four-legged friend at the washing area. And for horse lovers: thanks to the horse boarding facility, you can bring your own horse and explore the vast heathland and forests together. So everyone can enjoy a relaxing holiday together in nature.

properties.name: Friday im Niemetal - Naturcampingplatz
properties.description:
If you are looking for a charming family campsite in the middle of Germany, you've come to the right place at Camping Am Niemetal. This small campsite has all of the facilities you need for a wonderful camping holiday in the midst of nature. The kinderclub organises all kinds of activities for children. Adults can enjoy the barbecue evenings and lovely nature for hikes and cycling tours.

Surrounded by meadows and forests, you're really camping in the midst of nature. You'll stay in the Niemetal, named after the Nieme river flowing through the valley. As soon as you leave the valley, you have a lovely view of the surrounding area. Lovely German towns such as Hannoversch Münden (with many half-timbered houses) and the university town of Göttingen are close by.

Camping among the trees on green grass

A predominant feature at campsite Am Niemetal is the amount of greenery. Wherever you pitch your camping equipment, you are among the trees on a fresh green lawn. The campsites are located on both sides of the river and are about 100 m2. There is a separate field reserved for tent campers.

Playing in the river De Nieme

The river De Nieme flows right through the campsite. This river is very narrow and shallow in some spots, which is fun for young and old for playing and cooling off on a warm summer day. On both sides of the river there are many trees and bushes, so it seems you are in the midst of nature. Get to the campsite!

properties.name: Camping Hann. Münden Grüne Insel Tanzwerder
ALB-Camping Westerheim
properties.description:
Welcome to ALB-Camping Westerheim, a great destination in the nature of the Schwäbische Alb. Camp and unwind here among forests and heathland all year round. Whether passing through or looking for an active holiday, this campsite is a perfect base for every camper.

Spend the night in a cosy kota or safari tent

Different types of pitches are available, so you will always find one that’s right for you. Standard pitches are 100 m², paved and have plenty of space for motor homes and caravans. Or choose a comfort gravel pitch with electricity, water and drainage connection. Tents are on the separate tent field and have electricity too. For special accommodation, opt for a cosy kota, a tent lodge or a round camping barrel. Prefer more luxury? Choose a safari tent, mobile home or apartment.

Swim, relax and play sport

At ALB-Camping Westerheim, you can relax and be active. Take a dip in one of the three heated swimming pools or whizz down the wide wave slide. Work up a sweat in the fitness room and head to the halfpipe and sports fields for extra exertion. In need of relaxation? A visit to the massage parlour will make your muscles supple again. And if you get hungry, take a seat in the restaurant to enjoy local cuisine: hot, hearty and delicious after an active day on holiday.

properties.name: Ostsee Camping Familie Heide
properties.description:
Are you looking for a campsite that makes every effort to entertain and pamper its campers? Then this is the campsite for you! Ostsee Camping Familie Heide is located on the Eckenförder Bucht, directly on the sprawling beaches of the Baltic Sea.

This quality campsite offers countless fun activities, numerous sports and play facilities, luxurious sanitary facilities, a beautiful wellness centre with indoor swimming pool and various restaurants and bars. In short, it is an ideal holiday destination for families with young and older children alike.

Natural sandy beach on the Baltic Sea

Two fairly steep paths lead from the camping area to the beach. This naturally formed beach is mostly covered with sand, but there are also portions with rocks and pebbles.

Two restaurants, a Biergarten and a beach club

There are two restaurants where you can go out for a nice meal: Meeresblick Restaurant and Strandgut Restaurant. There is a cosy Biergarten and a snack bar. And then of course there's also the Sunshine Beach Club, an attractive beach bar where you can lounge comfortably.

There is a supermarket on the campsite with an extensive range of foodstuffs.

Activities for young and old

There are seven large playgrounds spread across the campsite. There's also a beautiful indoor playground. Activities for the youngest campers include: playing together, crafting, painting, drawing, singing, riding a train and reading books.

There are sports tournaments for the older youth, but they can also come together in the music hall or in the designated youth area, where a DJ booth has been set up.

And quiz games, music performances and cinema screenings offer fun for all ages.

properties.name: Camping Am Hardausee
properties.description:
Campers looking for a well-kept campsite in the middle of nature will feel right at home at Camping Am Hardausee. This camping destination is named after the lake right next to it: the Hardausee. For children, the playground is ideal, and the sandy beach around the corner offers a solution during the summer holidays. Here, you can discover the rolling landscape of the Lüneburger Heide by bike or on foot, and reach the village of Hössingen in no time.

Neat lawns

Along various lanes, there are beautiful pitches. Low bushes and hedges in between provide additional privacy. A separate grassy field is reserved for tent campers. The three modern and comfortably furnished sanitary buildings are thoroughly cleaned on a daily basis. There is always background music playing, and for children, they have really gone all out with special sanitary facilities.

Swimming lake, including a beach

From the reception, it is only a five-minute walk down the hill to reach the Hardausee. What treasures will you find here? A swimming lake with good water quality and a real sandy beach with a beach volleyball court. It's lovely to spend a day here. At the kiosk, you can buy a drink or a snack. If you feel like it, rent a pedal boat or go fishing.

Sampling regional products

In the campsite's small restaurant, you can enjoy delicious food. The small menu also features a variety of local dishes. Lovers can raise a toast to each other with a special beer from the region. On the cosy terrace, you can sit both inside and outside. Pastries, ice creams and fresh rolls are also available here, as are other foodstuffs, newspapers and some souvenirs.

properties.name: Regenbogen Ferienanlage Bad Gandersheim
properties.description:
Regenbogen Ferienanlage Bad Gandersheim is an ideal destination for camping enthusiasts looking for space, comfort and beautiful surroundings. The campsite offers spacious pitches, luxurious accommodation and is just a few minutes' walk from charming Bad Gandersheim. A picturesque stream divides the campsite into two areas, and the flat terrain is easy to explore. Enjoy the excellent facilities, including a restaurant with a wide selection of dishes.

Spacious pitches and accommodation

At Ferienanlage Bad Gandersheim, you can expect spacious pitches, all equipped with electricity. Whether you prefer to stay in your own tent or caravan, you will have plenty of space here. For those looking for something special, there are also simple pods and various chalets available to rent. A particularly unique option is the opportunity to stay in an exclusive tree house.

Natural swimming lake

The grounds are well maintained and offer numerous facilities for all ages. The restaurant with terrace invites you to enjoy a delicious meal from the extensive menu. In the middle of the campsite is a natural lake where you can relax and swim. There are also excellent cycle paths in the surrounding area.

Discover the charm of Bad Gandersheim

The idyllic town of Bad Gandersheim is only a five-minute walk away through the adjacent spa gardens. This charming town offers a rich history and cosy restaurants. Whether you want to enjoy a drink on a cosy terrace or plan a cultural excursion, Bad Gandersheim has something for everyone.

properties.name: Camping Prahljust
properties.description:
Camping Prahljust is situated near the town of Clausthal-Zellerfeld (Upper Harz) in the German federal state of Lower Saxony. As the name Oberharz suggests, you are here in the higher part of the Harz. It is traditionally a mining area which has resulted in the creation of a large number of lakes. The Oberharz is a nature and walkers' paradise which can be explored on foot or by bicycle from the campsite.

For seekers of tranquillity and nature

Prahljust is a well maintained, quietly located campsite. The pitches are not demarcated. When it is not busy, you can choose your own spacious pitch (100 m2). When it gets busy, you will be allocated a slightly more compact pitch (80 m2). You will find a mixed public on the campsite; in peak season mostly families, and more seniors out of season. Whether young or old, your neighbours are most likely walking enthusiasts or nature lovers.

Own Gasthof and lake

Prahljust has a private lake, surrounded by woodlands. This is eminently suitable for a wide range of water sports (swimming, sailing, canoeing and fishing). You can enjoy a meal on the campsite in the Greek restaurant, which has a full menu. There is also a playground for the little ones on the grounds.

Clean sanitary facilities

The sanitary facilities are not the latest in design, but they are kept spotless. There is also more than enough hot water to shower and wash the dishes. There is a separate dog shower, so your four-legged friend is always sufficiently clean to enter the caravan.

properties.name: Natur & City Camping Ellwangen
properties.description:
Do you like to camp in a natural setting with a town close by? Then Natur & City Camping Ellwangen, near the old town centre of Ellwangen (Baden-Württemberg), is the place for you. This campsite is located in a restored nature park on the floodplains of river Jagst. The town centre of Ellwangen is a short walk from here. The surrounding countryside is the perfect place for various walking and cycling tours too. In short, a great holiday address for a longer stay and its location near the A7 and B290 motorways make it the perfect campsite for a stopover.

Beautiful site with plenty of accommodation options

At this neatly laid-out campsite you will find different types of pitches. For example, various annual pitches and over a hundred well-tended tourist pitches. There are also two open fields for tent campers, one of which is car-free. Coming for a stopover with your motor home? Even before the barrier, you'll find a number of well-tended camping pitches. You can also book overnight stays in a cosy camping pod or a cosy rooftop tent.

Enjoy the adjacent pool complex

You will camp right next to the Ellwanger Wellenbad. This is an indoor pool complex with a large wave pool, a paddling pool and various bubble pools and water slides. You can also relax in the relaxation area or steam sauna. After an afternoon's swim, enjoy a meal in Loft. Enjoy typical German dishes in this atmospheric campsite restaurant. The campsite also has a cosy Biergarten and a daily bread service via a local bakery.

properties.name: Naturpark-Camping Prinzenholz
properties.description:
Spend your holiday in beautiful, natural surroundings at this campsite in the German state of Schleswig-Holstein. Naturpark-Camping Prinzenholz is located directly on the Kellersee, a beautiful recreational lake surrounded by forests. You can enjoy cycling and hiking through rolling landscapes in the immediate vicinity, which offers a nice variety of rural and wooded areas. Prinzenholz is also a quiet and well-maintained campsite. Many pitches offer a beautiful view over the lake.

Neat campsite with variable elevations

When you walk or drive across Naturpark-Camping Prinzenholz for the first time, you'll quickly notice the large variations in elevation. It slopes sharply towards the lake. The paths on this campsite are easy to drive on. They're dotted mainly by tourist camping pitches, which can differ considerably in size. This neatly maintained campsite also offers a small number of rental accommodations. These include a few a charming camping barrels and two fairytale glamping tents.

Cool dip in the Kellersee

The campsite has its own sandy beach on the Kellersee. In addition to swimming, this lake is excellent for canoeing and supping. You can also relax in the Finnish sauna. Yoga classes and massages are also offered from time to time. Adventurous holidaymakers can also sign up for fun survival training near the campsite.

There's a small bar next to the reception where you can get a nice drink. It features a lovely terrace from which you can enjoy a beautiful view of the lake.

properties.name: Naturcamping Buchholz
properties.description:
Right on Radzeburg Lake in Schleswig-Holstein, in northern Germany, is this nature campsite. This place is perfect for active campers. Hiking, playing football, volleyball and, of course, the lake. Everything is possible at Naturcamping Buchholz. A beautiful lake view from your pitch will make your holiday at this terraced campsite complete. Be sure to bring the kids along, too. They can play in the playground and swing in the cable car. Want to end the day on a good note? Dinner at the Die Angelsmühle restaurant is highly recommended.

At Radzeburg Lake

Naturcamping Buchholz is less than forty kilometres from the coast of the Baltic Sea. You'll find your holiday destination northeast of Hamburg, in an area full of lakes. One such lake is Lake Radzeburg, on the border of Schleswig-Holstein and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern. There, right on the waterfront, is the campsite. Standing at the reception, you will have a charming view over the lake.

Conviviality or peace and privacy

Do you like to seek out lively crowds? Or do you prefer a little peace and privacy? At Naturcamping Buchholz, you get to choose. On the large camping meadow, you'll find clearly laid-out pitches and a sociable atmosphere. Also perfect for tent campers. The smaller fields on the lower terraces are well screened. Are you fond of your rest? Then a pitch on one of these fields is your ideal camping spot. Many of the pitches have a view of the water. Either way, the lake is never far away.

properties.name: Camping Am Waldbad
properties.description:
Camping Am Waldbad is on the edge of the low mountain range the Harz Mountains, in the German state Thüringen. At this small-scale and friendly campsite, you camp in the middle of the countryside. Go for a swim in the forest pool opposite, or grab a delicious snack at the snack bar. This campsite is ideal for those seeking peace and quiet and for nature lovers. You stay about 1.5 kilometres from the village of Neustadt and 12 kilometres from Nordhausen.

Camping in the countryside

At Camping Am Waldbad you camp on a pitch that is demarcated with hedges. There are special fields for tent campsite visitors and for caravans and motorhomes. Dog lovers love it here because their faithful four-footed friend is also welcome. The campsite is situated on the edge of the woods, allowing you to take the most beautiful walks straight from your camping pitch.

Hiking, castle ruins and exhibitions

Exploring the beautiful countryside in the immediate vicinity of the campsite on foot is an excellent idea because there are plenty of hiking paths. The Hohnstein castle ruins are within walking distance and well worth the trouble of visiting. The tower ruins give an excellent view, and you can enjoy a drink or bite to eat at the adjacent restaurant with terrace. The city of Nordhausen (12 km) is great for a day out. Wander through the city centre, go to the Harz Railway with its steam trains or to the Meyenburg Art House, where changing exhibitions can be seen.

properties.name: Camping Pilsensee
properties.description:
Camping Pilsensee is on the banks of the idyllic Lake Pilsensee. It is a place where active campers and those seeking quiet come together to enjoy the beautiful countryside around Munich (45 km). The lively village of Seefeld, where there is plenty to do, is only a 10-minute walk and there are also castles in the area. You are at the right place here for a relaxing holiday in the heart of Southern Germany.

Spacious camping pitches

The 100 m2 camping pitches at Camping Pilsensee are spaciously laid out. Some camping pitches are right by the water. Caravans, motorhomes and tents: every type of camping equipment is welcome. Besides the traditional camping pitches, the campsite offers accommodation such as mobile homes, chalets and sleeping barrels.

Right by the lake

You won't get bored for a moment at this campsite. Here, you have direct access to a grassy beach and the lake. It's great for hours of water fun, or if you simply want to relax with a book. For active campers, there are numerous (water) sports options, such as standup paddleboarding, yoga and surfing.

Explore the stunning surrounding area

The area surrounding Camping Pilsensee invites you to explore. Climb the 'holy mountain' in Andechs, the oldest pilgrimage site in Bavaria, for a meal and a beer with a view. In less favourable weather, take the S-Bahn from Hechendorf station (9 km) for an excursion to Munich. The iconic Neuschwanstein Castle (79 km) is easily reached from the campsite.

properties.name: Campingpark Kühlungsborn GmbH
properties.description:
The spacious five-star campsite Kühlungsborn is located in the northern Mecklenburg-Vorpommern state of Germany. Nature enthusiasts and beach goers will love this campsite, which is located immediately adjacent to the beach. Luxury toilet facilities and spacious camping pitches combine to ensure maximum comfort for guests. The campsite is on the Baltic Sea coast in an environment that is perfect for hiking, either along the beach or through the beautiful countryside, and for cycle rides. The village's boulevard, harbour and beach hotels are also nearby.

Germany as you'd expect to find it

As you would expect from a German campsite, Kühlungsborn is well maintained, orderly and spacious. The roads to the pitches are wide and of high quality, and the camping pitches themselves are separated from one another by hedges, while tall trees provide plenty of shade. The campsite also has a number of holiday cottages for rent.

Pirates on the Baltic

Kühlungsborn campsite is suitable for everyone. Water sports enthusiasts and beach goers will be in their element, while outdoor enthusiasts will also have a fantastic time. The local environment has a lot to offer. In addition, the campsite also does all that it can to make its younger guests feel welcome, with pirate shows, magicians and sports competitions, amongst a range of other activities. There's also a multi sports field.

Lose yourself on the beach

The wide sandy beach wends its way through the trees for several kilometres, which is ideal for long hikes, soaking up a little afternoon sun or just a dip in the sea.

properties.name: Camping Schliersee
properties.description:
Do you like camping in the heart of nature, by the water and with a charming village within walking distance? Then this campsite is for you. Schliersee campsite is located directly on the lake of the same name in the German region of Bavaria. The small campsite has a private lakeside beach, a small playground, a restaurant and a beach bar. Everything you need for a relaxing holiday in nature.

Clean sanitary facilities

The campsite has about 50 pitches for small campervans, trailer tents and caravans. There is also a field for tents. There is a toilet block with heated sanitary facilities. Campsite guests describe the sanitary facilities as modern and clean.

Swimming in the Schliersee

The campsite is located directly on the Schliersee lake of the same name. On hot days you can cool off in the clear blue water. Or take to the water in a canoe or sup. There is a private grass beach for campsite guests. On warm days, there is a food truck where you can order a drink.

Vegetarian and vegan food

The campsite has a restaurant where you can drop in for a bite to eat during high season. The menu ranges from burgers to salads, but it is also possible to eat vegetarian or even vegan here.

Day trip to Munich

Camping Schliersee is 50 kilometres below the Bavarian capital Munich. Within an hour's drive you are in the city centre. Germany's second largest city is of course known for the Oktoberfest and the beautiful Christmas market. But Munich also has plenty to offer the rest of the year.

properties.name: Camping Wusterhausen
properties.description:
In the German state of Brandenburg, some eighty kilometres north-west of Berlin and Potsdam, lies campsite Wusterhausen. This is a tranquil campsite with many permanent pitches, situated between tall trees and on a large lake. You will have at your disposal a fitness area and a sauna, all small-scale. From the campsite, you can go on lovely walks and cycling trips or pay a visit to Berlin.

Quiet and friendly

The campsite grounds are relatively peaceful, but there is a convivial atmosphere. This is primarily because of the considerable number of permanent pitches. Many of these mobile homes are decorated with garden ornaments and wooden fences. The pitches are all situated on the western side of the grounds. You camp here amidst the greenery: on the grass and under the tall trees. Campers with a tent are situated on a separate field.

Keeping fit

The campsite is also home to a fitness club. You can go here for various types of training and lessons. You will also find a sauna and solarium.

Discover the Klempowsee

The campsite is situated directly on the Klempowsee. This lake, surrounded by forests, is ideal for swimming. Would you rather be on the water instead of in it? You can do that, too. Next to the campsite are jetties from which you can venture onto the lake by boat. Or you can choose to put on your hiking boots or get on your bike; the Klempowsee is a fine location for hiking and cycling.

properties.name: AZUR Campingpark Regensburg
properties.description:
AZUR Campingpark Regensburg is alongside the Danube and close to Regensburg. You camp in green surroundings here but within cycling distance of the city centre. The campsite is well organised and attractive, with pitches on small fields. Its location in a residential area makes it quiet and its easy to find because of the clear signposting from the A93.

City campsite on the Danube

The camping pitches are spread over a wooded area and vary in size. There is little separation, which makes the site open and spacious. You can stay here in a tent, caravan or motor home. Not bringing your own camping equipment? Then choose one of the wooden Campingfässer (wine barrels) or Bikelodges on stilts. These are ideal for short stays or a cycling holiday. The atmosphere is relaxed and international: many guests stay a few nights to explore Regensburg.

Everything within arm's reach

The campsite is basic but clean and well-maintained. The restaurant is popular with both campers and local residents. The supermarket is 1.5 km away. For a refreshing dip, walk through a gate to a swimming area in the Danube. Or head to the Westbad swimming pools and wellness, within walking distance. Children will have fun in the adjoining Danube Park, with a play and water playground, skate park, football pitch and volleyball court.

Explore Regensburg and the surrounding area

From the campsite, you can be in the heart of Regensburg's old town in 15 minutes by bike. This UNESCO city is a maze of alleyways; highlights include the Dom, the Steinerne Brücke and bustling terraces. Prefer nature? The Danube-Radweg runs right past the campsite.

properties.name: Blütencamping Riegelspitze
properties.description:
For a perfect base during your city trip to Berlin, Blütencamping Riegelspitze is the right address. From the campsite, you can reach the centre of the German capital within 30 minutes. Furthermore, the historical town of Potsdam can easily be reached by bicycle. The campsite is situated in a green location, at one of the Havel Lakes, the Glindower Lake. Start the day with a lovely breakfast in breakfast café Apfelblüte. The lake provides the necessary coolness and water fun.

Bed&Bike concept

Have you ever spent the night in a gypsy wagon, wine barrel or boathouse? You can do it all at Blütencamping Riegelspitze! You can rent these types of wooden accommodation for a maximum of two persons. The campsite keeps some of these barrels for overnight stops by people arriving by bicycle, motorbike or on foot, the so-called Bed&Bike concept.

To Berlin and Potsdam

There is a bus service to Berlin from the bus station in Werder, close to the campsite. 30 minutes later, you exit at the Zoologischer Garten and you are smack in the middle of this extraordinary city. Include a visit the Bandenburger Tor, the Reichstag and of course the Potsdamer Platz for a good impression of this city's rich history.

When you wish to combine culture and nature, go to Potsdam by bicycle. The major part of the city is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and you will certainly see this when you cycle through this city. Forgotten your bike? No problem, you can rent them from reception.

properties.name: Adventurecamp 'Schnitzmühle'
properties.description:
Far away from the rest of the world in the Bavarian Forest is Adventure Camp Schnitzmühle. The campsite is nestled in an idyllic location next the Black Rain river in a valley around three kilometres from the town of Vietach. The campsite is reached by driving over a bridge. The campsite, run by the Nielsen brothers, is located in an area famed for its many attractions, including museums, glass art and geology.

Bring your canoe with you

The camping pitches are separated from one another by trees and lie on the banks of the river itself. If you choose to bring your own canoe, you can opt for a special camping field with direct access to the water. The campsite has a number of accommodation options, such as Hacienda rooms and Lodge accommodation.

Activities on and near the campsite

The sandy beach by the lake has sunbeds for soaking up the rays, and you can relax while the children swim and play in the water. The campsite is the perfect base for outdoor activities in the local area. In the summer, you can enjoy mountain biking, horse riding, survival and hiking. In the winter, there are horse and cart rides and hikes in the dark with torches and toboggans. The ski slopes are no more than 15 minutes' drive away.

For those looking to unwind, Adventure Camp Schnitzmühle has a number of wellness facilities including beauty treatments, massages and relaxing yoga sessions.

properties.name: Regenbogen Ferienanlage Göhren
properties.description:
Camping Regenbogen Ferienanlage Göhren is located in the extreme south-eastern part of the island of Rügen. You camp here on a beautiful spot along the thirty metre wide sandy beach of the Baltic Sea. Göhren is an elongated campsite with a large number of pine and deciduous trees. The campsite is located in the Baaber Heide nature reserve. Between the beach and the campsite you will successively find a strip of sand dunes, a cycle path and an esplanade.

A great place to camp

It is a comfortable ride to your pitch over attractive roads and pathways. The nearest field is intended for caravans. This area is split into three sections by intersecting pathways and divided into pitches. Tent campers stand on a separate section of the campsite between the touring pitches. An additional large terrain is allocated to motorhomes.

Wellness

As befitting a campsite on a wellness island, it has an extensive wellness centre with steam baths, saunas, a beauty centre and massage rooms. Qualified personnel ensure that you will not want for anything. The campsite does not have a swimming pool, but it is only a few hundred metres' walk to the beach...

Unique rental accommodation

The campsite has different types of rental accommodation. You can stay in the regular caravans or mobile homes or go for something more exciting. You can book one of the Tepee-holiday homes, for instance. Contrary to what the name suggests, these are not tents but wooden octagonal dwellings with a pointed roof.

Market in summer

The campsite has a fairly large supermarket with a wide range. There are a number of catering facilities on the grounds, including a very amiable restaurant with terrace. In summer there is a lively atmosphere as various food stands are set up.

properties.name: Campingplatz Krossinsee 1930 GmbH
properties.description:
Campingplatz Krossinsee 1930 is a welcoming, somewhat cluttered campsite in the woods to the east of Berlin. The campsite is located in the Müggelspree-Löcknitzer forest and lakes region. Driving along the road to the campsite, you'll ride through the woods, along the lakes, streams and fens. The campsite is located on a large lake and features its own sandy beach and grassy beaches along its banks.

A feel-good free-for-all

Campingplatz Krossinsee 1930 is located just outside the ring roads of Berlin, in a wooded region. You'll be camping on grass under tall conifers and you can choose your own pitch. This campsite is a feel-good free-for-all: tents, mobile homes and camper vans are all interspersed with each other.

An athletic environment

The surrounding area is perfect for hikes and bike rides. Campers can also go swimming, canoeing, kayaking, fishing and sailing. You can walk straight from your camping pitch to the water for a refreshing dip, especially if you have a VIP pitch right on the water. 

Watching the boats

There is a traditional German restaurant with a terrace on the water, which is lit up beautifully in the evenings. You're treated to a view of the lake and the dock. Water sports fans and boat lovers will really love it here. There are various boat hire businesses on and around the campsite, but you can also bring your own boat with you. 

Visit the city: Berlin

In reality, you're actually on a true urban campsite: Berlin is just a 20-minute drive away. This means that you can enjoy a day out to the city and still combine it with a cool morning swim, a beautiful evening hike and a German beer on a terrace along the water. If that's what you're looking for, then look no further than Campingplatz Krossinsee 1930.

properties.name: Cheddar, Mendip Heights C&C Club Site
The Isle of Avalon Touring Caravan Park
Highlands End Holiday Park
properties.description:
The Highlands End Holiday Park, a holiday park with fantastic views of the English Channel, is on the coastline of the British Dorset. Besides spacious pitches for caravans, motorhomes and tents, there are all kinds of rental accommodation, such as lodges, apartments and glamping tents. Cliffs and several beaches are within walking distance. Charming villages, such as Seatown (6 km) and Bridgeport (4 km), are within driving distance.

Camping by the English Channel

Highlands End Holiday Park offers a camping experience focused on comfort and convenience, right by the English Channel. The accommodation have something for everyone and some offer views of the Jurassic Coast, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. If you are bringing your dog camping, your lovely four-legged friend can stay at the pitches and in some lodges.

All modern conveniences

The park has amenities such as a SPAR for daily groceries and access to the Highlands End Leisure Club. This has a swimming pool, sauna and steam bath (for a fee) for relaxation after a day full of activity.

For food and entertainment go to Martin’s Bar & Restaurant, where you will be treated to local delicacies and evenings full of live music. There is an indoor playground for children. And play a game of Foot Golf with the whole family.

Charming Dorset

This luxury park is a convenient starting point for exploring Dorset. The nearby fishing village of West Bay (4 km) not only offers lovely beaches but also fresh local delicacies. You must walk over the South West Coast Path. This route runs right past the park and offers access to kilometres-long coastal walks.

properties.name: Grafham Water Caravan and motorhome Club Site
Camping Sandaya La Barque
properties.description:
Camping Sandaya La Barque is on the banks of the Argens river in the French Riviera. The many amenities, such as the water park with a heated outdoor swimming pool, water sports centre and entertainment, are available all year round. This is where you can take a break, regardless of the season! The area around the campsite also has plenty to offer. Visit the beaches of Fréjus or go hiking or cycling in the Massif de l'Esterel.

Always find a pitch that suits

Will you choose a pitch close to the swimming pool, do you prefer the sun, or will you choose a pitch that is well-shaded? At Camping La Barque, you are free to choose the location of your pitch yourself. Any disturbance from the busy road next to the campsite can easily be avoided in this way. There is also a wide selection of mobile homes.

Fun all year round

Enjoy everything the campsite has to offer in both the high season and the off season. Relax in the heated swimming pool or go up the river in a canoe at the water sports centre. For children aged 5 and up there is also plenty to do. Together with a member of the entertainment team, they can go exploring to learn about the local flora and fauna. Or how about the science workshop?

The perfect home base

Enjoy the sun, sea and beach in Fréjus (3 km). The Massif de l'Esterel (22 km away) offers the perfect home base for walking tours, bicycle rides or even a ride in a buggy. For an excursion to a city, visit the historic Saint-Raphaël (7 km) or the famous Saint Tropez (32 km).

properties.name: Camping Bonte Hoeve
properties.description:
Bonte Hoeve Campsite is located in a wonderfully quiet spot in rural Zeelandic Flanders. This is a cosy family campsite where the spacious field for touring campers is separated from the permanent annual pitches. The campsite also offers extremely luxurious sanitary facilities, a beautiful restaurant with a bar and a varied entertainment programme in high season. This is an ideal campsite for peace seekers and nature lovers, especially those who enjoy exploring their surroundings by bike.

A lovely field for touring campers

Bonte Hoeve Campsite offers a relatively large number of permanent (annual) pitches. At the front of the campsite, however, you'll find a large field specially equipped for tourist campers. This well-maintained field has spacious grassy pitches separated by hedges. Those coming without their own camping equipment can rent a hiker's cabin, a chalet or a luxury villa tent at this campsite.

Never a dull moment thanks to our enthusiastic entertainment team

The campsite employs a professional entertainment team during the summer holidays. This team shares their infectious enthusiasm by organising all kinds of fun activities. These include exciting sports tournaments (including pétanque championships), entertaining shows by and for children, and bingo and karaoke nights.

Enjoy a snack and a drink at the Brasserie Bonte Bar

Most parts of the entertainment programme take place in the Brasserie Bonte Bar. This is a modern and tastefully decorated restaurant with a large bar and a nice outdoor terrace. An ideal place to relax and enjoy a snack and a drink in peace. Bonte Bar is open on weekends during low season and every day during high season.

properties.name: Camping De Watermolen
properties.description:
In Opende, the westernmost village of the province of Groningen, you will find camping De Watermolen. At this campsite peace, nature and space are the key words. You camp here on a sheltered and car-free terrain. An area offers many cycling possibilities. Very special rental accommodations on the campsite are the water chalets and the straw hut.

Sheltered touring pitches and special rental accommodations

If you are camping at De Watermolen, you have a terrain of 12.5 hectares at your disposal. A large part of this terrain consists of two lakes. Next to the first lake you'll find various camping fields, where about seventy spacious touring pitches are situated. Each field is ringed by trees and shrubs, so you will always have some shade on your pitch. On the campsite you have a wide choice of special rental accommodations: three water chalets, a water villa, safari tents, a real fire engine and a straw hut.

More than one lake

Especially the two lakes offer a lot of fun. Not only for children, but also for adults. In both lakes you can fish. Part of the smaller lake is set aside for swimmers. This part is also bordered by a beach and a grassy meadow. Around the lake is a forest with hiking trails.

Bistro with pavement cafe

Next to the reception, in the old cowshed, is the bistro. On the attractive pavement cafe you can enjoy a drink or ice cream. During weekends in high season you can also eat there. For fresh bread you don't have to leave the campsite. For your daily shopping you have to be in Opende.

properties.name: Camping Sandaya Riviera d'Azur
properties.description:
The well-tended campsite Riviera d'Azur Sandaya is located on the banks of the Argens river. The campsite has beautiful, marked camping pitches. You can also choose to have your own private bathroom. Most campers stay here in a mobile home, but there are also lodge tents with sanitation available for rent. The generally spacious camping pitches usually have plenty of shade.

The mini club organises all sorts of activities four times per week (peak season). It does help here if you understand English or French. Fine amateur productions are also performed here. If you are less interested in entertainment, you can request a quiet spot near the entrance of the campsite.

Swimming lengths

The 530 m2 large aqua park with a sunbathing lawn has five pools, including a semi-Olympic swimming pool, a lagoon pool, water slides, and a heated paddling pool. Here, you can join in with activities such as water polo and aquafun. The swimming pool is nicely situated amongst the palm trees, next to the restaurant with a terrace.

There is a diverse selection of places to eat. You can choose from a snack bar, a pizzeria, and a restaurant with light meals and a more extensive menu. The supermarket offers a wide range of quality products.

Go-karting

A wide range of both sportive and recreational activities are available. There are multiple sports opportunities (table tennis, beach volleyball, archery and, for an additional fee, tennis and mini golf). Across from the boules court is a go-kart track with karts for both children and adults.

Bodyboarding

You can explore the beautiful surroundings with a (rented) bicycle or mountain bike. There is plenty to do. For instance, you can rent a kayak, play a game of paintball, or try and keep your balance on a bodyboard. These are available for rent for one or multiple people.

properties.name: Vakantiepark De Rijp
properties.description:
Vakantiepark De Rijp is amid the vast polder landscape of North Holland, on the outskirts of the village of West-Graftdijk. You stay in a water-rich area at this holiday park, which is excellent for exploring by boat or on a bike. Furthermore, thanks to the central location in the province, attractions such as Volendam, Marken, Alkmaar, Amsterdam and Zaanse Schans can all be reached within no more than 30 minutes. That also applies to the vast dune reserves and lovely coastal resorts on the North Sea, such as Egmond aan Zee. At this park, you benefit from two swimming pools, a charming restaurant and children's entertainment (in the school holidays), among others.

From charming tiny houses to luxury holiday bungalows

Do you enjoy going on holiday in natural surroundings, but do want the luxuries you are used to at home? As a glamping fan you are at the right place because here you can book a stay in a luxury holiday home, a modern mobile home or charming tiny house, for example. You can also bring your dog to some of the accommodation.

Wonderful swimming in an indoor and outdoor swimming pool

You will find the lovely swimming pool that adorns this holiday park by reception. The swimming pool is the ideal place for relaxing, also because there are various wellness facilities by this indoor pool. For example, a Finnish sauna, a steam cabin and a salt cave. This park also has an outdoor swimming pool with paddling pool.
